en: The Order of the White Greyhound was founded in 1391. Its badge was a gold greyhound suspended from a chain with chestnut-leaf links, and its French motto meant “In good faith”. In 1393 Charles III admitted 56 squires and men-at-arms whom he sent to defend Cherbourg.
zh: 白灵缇骑士团创立于1391年，其徽记是一只金灵缇，悬挂在栗叶形链环组成的项链上；法语格言意为“秉持诚信”。1393年查理三世接纳了56名侍从和披甲战士，并派他们前去保卫瑟堡。

official_raw.en: The Order of the White Greyhound was established by Charles III the Noble as the highest chivalric distinction of the $NAV$ Crown, selecting from the most loyal and distinguished knights of the realm. Its members, bound by an oath of mutual brotherhood and fidelity, are expected to embody the swiftness and loyalty of the greyhound in all their deeds. The order stands as a mark of royal prestige and trust, binding the Crown's closest allies in perpetual service and honor.
official_raw.zh: 白灵缇骑士团由“高贵者”查理三世创立，作为$NAV$王冠领的最高骑士荣誉，从王国最忠诚、最杰出的骑士中选拔成员。骑士团成员以兄弟情谊与忠诚之誓相互约束，被期望在所有行动中体现灵缇犬的迅捷与忠诚。该骑士团是王室威望与信任的象征，将王冠最亲密的盟友紧密联结于永恒的服务与荣耀之中。

en: The Order of Saint George was founded by King Charles I of Hungary and existed by 23 April 1326, its patron's feast. Members wore black hooded mantles inscribed with a pledge of justice to their fellowship. The society prospered under Charles and his son Louis I, but the struggle for the throne after Louis died in 1382 destroyed it.
zh: 圣乔治骑士团由匈牙利国王查理一世创立，至迟在1326年4月23日其主保圣人的节日时已经存在。成员身穿黑色连帽斗篷，上面绣有对团体恪守公正的誓言。骑士团在查理及其子拉约什一世统治下兴盛，但拉约什于1382年去世后的匈牙利王位争夺摧毁了这一团体。

official_raw.en: This order, known as the 'Chivalric Society of Saint George,' embodies a commitment to the ideals of chivalry and honor, promoting these values through knightly tournaments and festivals.
official_raw.zh: 这一组织被称为“圣乔治骑士社团”，体现对骑士精神与荣誉理想的坚守，通过骑士比武与节庆活动来弘扬这些价值观。

en: Alfonso XI of Castile instituted the Order of the Band in 1332, the year of his coronation. Its name came from the red sash worn by its knights, and admission required at least ten years of service at court or in the army. The order declined and was considered extinct by 1474.
zh: 卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索十一世于1332年加冕，同年创立绶带骑士团。骑士团以成员佩戴的红色绶带得名，入团者须在宫廷或军中服役至少十年。骑士团后来衰落，到1474年已被认为不复存在。

official_raw.en: The Order of the Band is composed of the most excellent knights, who swear their loyalty and obedience to the ruler of [GetCountry('CAS').GetName]. Its members are held to high standards of scrupulous and impeccable courtly behavior, regularly participate in jousts, and must be above all else supportive and loyal to their ruler.
official_raw.zh: 绶带骑士团由最卓越的骑士组成，他们宣誓效忠并服从[GetCountry('CAS').GetName]的统治者。其成员须恪守严谨无瑕的宫廷行为准则，定期参与骑枪比武，且首要原则是支持并效忠于统治者。

en: Elector Frederick III of Brandenburg founded the Order of the Black Eagle on 17 January 1701, the day before he crowned himself King Frederick I in Prussia at Königsberg. His son Frederick William was its first member. During Frederick I's reign, which ended in 1713, the order was awarded 57 times.
zh: 勃兰登堡选帝侯腓特烈三世于1701年1月17日创立黑鹰骑士团，次日他在柯尼斯堡加冕，成为普鲁士国王腓特烈一世。他的儿子腓特烈·威廉是骑士团的首位成员。在腓特烈一世统治期间，直到1713年他去世为止，骑士团共授予57次。

official_raw.en: The secular Order of the Black Eagle is more of a military order than a spiritual one. Members of this Order tend to include members of the royal family, visiting foreign royals, and distinguished generals who have been awarded for their merit.
official_raw.zh: 世俗性质的黑鹰骑士团与其说是精神性团体，不如说是一个军事骑士团。其成员往往包括王室成员、来访的外国王室，以及因功绩受嘉奖的杰出将领。

en:
Sigismund of Luxembourg and his queen Barbara of Cilli founded the Order of the Dragon on 12 December 1408. Its members included the Orthodox Serbian ruler Stefan Lazarević as well as Catholic nobles.

The order declined in Western Europe after Sigismund died in 1437, but remained significant in lands facing Ottoman incursions. Vlad II of Wallachia took the name Dracul from it.
zh:
卢森堡的西吉斯蒙德与王后采列的芭芭拉于1408年12月12日创立龙骑士团。成员既有天主教贵族，也有信奉东正教的塞尔维亚统治者斯特凡·拉扎列维奇。

西吉斯蒙德于1437年去世后，骑士团在西欧衰落，但在面临奥斯曼入侵的地区仍有影响。瓦拉几亚的弗拉德二世便从骑士团得到了“德拉库尔”的称号。

official_raw.en: Also known as the '#italic Societas Draconica#!', this Order was dedicated to defending the [GetCountry('HUN').GetAdjective] monarchy, the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] Church, and [ShowReligionGroupName('christian')] against the threat of the [GetCountry('TUR').GetLongName], heretics, and pagans. Modeled after the Order of St. George and inspired by the crusading spirit of the time, it unites the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')] and the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')] under the symbols of the ouroboros and the red cross, fostering a collective defense against foreign and domestic threats while offering the $nobles_estate$ royal protection and honors in return for their loyalty.
official_raw.zh: 龙骑士团又称“#italic 衔尾龙会#!”，致力于保卫[GetCountry('HUN').GetAdjective]君主、[ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')]教会以及整个[ShowReligionGroupName('christian')]世界，抵御[GetCountry('TUR').GetLongName]、异端与异教徒的威胁。该团以圣乔治骑士团为蓝本，受时代十字军精神的激励，以衔尾蛇与红十字为象征，联合[ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]阶层与[ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')]，共同抵御内外威胁，同时以王室保护与荣誉换取$nobles_estate$的忠诚。

en:
John IV, Duke of Brittany, founded the Order of the Ermine in 1381 after returning from exile in England. In 1448 it became the Order of the Ermine and the Ear of Grain.

Duchess Anne appointed Katherine Potier as an officer of arms after the death of her husband Yves. The order fell into disuse after Anne's daughter Claude died in 1524.
zh:
布列塔尼公爵约翰四世从英格兰流亡归来后，于1381年创立银貂骑士团。1448年，骑士团改称银貂与麦穗骑士团。

女公爵安妮在伊夫去世后，任命其妻凯瑟琳·波捷为纹章官。安妮的女儿克洛德于1524年去世后，骑士团逐渐停止活动。

official_raw.en: The Order of the Ermine draws inspiration from the [GetCountry('ENG').GetAdjective] Order of the Garter. With the ermine as its symbol, representing unwavering personal honor, the order recognizes both men and women, regardless of social status, for exceptional service to the Duchy of [ShowAreaName('brittany_area')].
official_raw.zh: 银貂骑士团的灵感源自[GetCountry('ENG').GetAdjective]的嘉德骑士团。该团以银貂为象征，代表毫不动摇的个人荣誉，不问社会地位，同时接纳男女成员，以表彰其对[ShowAreaName('brittany_area')]公国的卓越贡献。

en:
Edward III founded the Order of the Garter around the time he claimed the French throne; the traditional foundation year is 1348. Its founding knights included his son Edward, the Black Prince, and Henry of Grosmont, Earl of Lancaster.

The order's chapel at Windsor was extensively rebuilt from 1475 under Edward IV and his successors. George III had it restored between 1780 and 1790.
zh:
爱德华三世在宣称法国王位前后创立了嘉德骑士团，传统上认为创立年份是1348年。创始骑士包括他的儿子“黑太子”爱德华和兰开斯特伯爵格罗斯蒙特的亨利。

骑士团在温莎的礼拜堂从1475年起在爱德华四世及其继任者治下大规模重建。乔治三世又于1780—1790年命人修复了礼拜堂。

official_raw.en: Established in the tradition of the legendary Knights of the Round Table, the Order of the Garter is the most prestigious [chivalric_order|e] in the realm. Its motto, '#italic Honi soit qui mal y pense#!', speaks to the honor demanded of its members.
official_raw.zh: 建立于传说中的圆桌骑士的传统上的嘉德骑士团是国内最具威望的[chivalric_order|e]。其格言#italic “心怀邪念者蒙羞”#!表达了对其成员的荣誉要求。

en:
Philip established the Order of the Golden Fleece at Bruges in 1430 to celebrate his marriage to Isabella of Portugal. Its knights initially numbered 24, rising to 30 in 1433 and 50 in 1516, apart from the sovereign.

After the War of the Spanish Succession ended in 1714, the Spanish Bourbons and Austrian Habsburgs each maintained a branch of the order. The order's treasure and archives passed to the Austrian Netherlands.
zh:
腓力于1430年在布鲁日设立金羊毛骑士团，庆祝他与葡萄牙的伊莎贝拉成婚。除团长外，骑士人数最初为24人，1433年增至30人，1516年增至50人。

1714年西班牙王位继承战争结束后，西班牙波旁王朝和奥地利哈布斯堡王朝各自保留了骑士团的一个分支。骑士团的财宝和档案则转到了奥属尼德兰。

official_raw.en: Founded by Philip the Good of Burgundy, the Order of the Golden Fleece is among the most illustrious [chivalric_order|e]s in Christendom. Membership binds its knights by solemn oath to uphold the glory and honor of their lord, and to stand united against all threats to Christendom.
official_raw.zh: 金羊毛骑士团由勃艮第的好人腓力创立，是基督教世界最著名的[chivalric_order|e]之一。骑士受到庄严誓言的约束，以维护其领主的荣誉，并团结起来对抗基督教世界的所有威胁。

en:
Ferdinand of Antequera founded the Order of the Jar at Medina del Campo in 1403 and gave its collar to his sons and favoured knights. Its emblem included a jar of lilies representing the Virgin Mary's purity and a griffin suspended from the collar.

The order became royal when Ferdinand became king of Aragon in 1412. It lasted until 1516.
zh:
安特克拉的斐迪南于1403年在梅迪纳德尔坎波创立罐子骑士团，并将骑士团项链授予自己的儿子和受宠的骑士。徽记包括一只插着百合的罐子，象征圣母玛利亚的纯洁；项链上还悬挂着一只狮鹫。

斐迪南于1412年成为阿拉贡国王后，骑士团成为王室骑士团。它延续至1516年。

official_raw.en: Using the fervor of the people in [ShowRegionName('iberia_region')], the $order_of_the_jar$ is meant to serve as a way to reward knights loyal to the [ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')], whilst also playing a prominent role in court ceremonies.
official_raw.zh: 借助[ShowRegionName('iberia_region')]民众的热忱，$order_of_the_jar$奖励了骑士对[ShowEstateTypeName('crown_estate')]的忠诚，同时也在宫廷仪式中扮演了重要角色。

en: Elector Frederick II of Brandenburg founded the Order of the Swan on 29 September 1440. Its headquarters stood at St Mary's pilgrimage church near Brandenburg an der Havel, and in 1459 Margrave Albert Achilles established a branch at St Gumbertus in Ansbach. The order had about 330 members in 1464, but disappeared during the Protestant Reformation.
zh: 勃兰登堡选帝侯腓特烈二世于1440年9月29日创立天鹅骑士团。骑士团的总部设在哈弗尔河畔勃兰登堡附近的圣玛利亚朝圣教堂；1459年，藩侯阿尔布雷希特·阿喀琉斯在安斯巴赫的圣贡贝图斯教堂建立分部。骑士团在1464年约有330名成员，但在宗教改革期间消亡。

official_raw.en: The Order of the Swan is dedicated to promoting piety and spreading the cult of the Virgin Mary. Members of this Order include many princes from the ruling dynasty as well as the [ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')], all united in perseverance.
official_raw.zh: 天鹅骑士团致力于弘扬虔敬之心并传播圣母玛利亚崇拜。该团成员包括许多统治王朝的王子以及[ShowEstateTypeName('nobles_estate')]阶层，皆以坚忍不拔之心团结一致。

en: Augustus II of Poland instituted the Order of the White Eagle on 1 November 1705. Its original badge bore the Polish white eagle; a Maltese cross replaced it in 1709. The order was abolished in the third partition of Poland in 1795, renewed in the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807, and incorporated into the Russian honours system in 1831.
zh: 波兰国王奥古斯特二世于1705年11月1日创立白鹰骑士团。最初的徽章饰有波兰白鹰，1709年改为马耳他十字。1795年波兰第三次被瓜分后，骑士团被废除；1807年华沙公国恢复了它，1831年它又被纳入俄罗斯帝国的荣誉体系。

official_raw.en: The military $order_of_the_white_eagle_policy$ is awarded to the closest supporters of the state and the most brilliant of our citizens as a reward for their service to the country. It is also bestowed upon high-ranking visitors who have graced us with their presence.
official_raw.zh: 军事气息浓重的$order_of_the_white_eagle_policy$授予国家最忠诚的支持者以及最卓越的公民，作为对其为国效劳的奖赏。该团亦颁赠予为本国增光添彩的高规格来访贵宾。

en: The Bengler Society was founded on 29 September 1391 by Konrad Spiegel of Desenberg, Frederick of Padberg and other nobles. Archbishop Konrad II of Mainz took the league under his protection and allied with it that November. Its members fought the bishop of Paderborn; in 1396 the bishops of Paderborn and Münster crushed them.
zh: 1391年9月29日，德森贝格的康拉德·施皮格尔、帕德贝格的腓特烈和其他贵族创立棍棒协会。美因茨大主教康拉德二世将协会置于保护之下，并在当年11月与其结盟。协会成员与帕德博恩主教交战；1396年，帕德博恩和明斯特的主教联手将他们击溃。

en:
The Elefantenbund was formed in 1406 by 21 Tyrolean nobles to defend their privileges against Duke Frederick IV and his governor Henry of Rottenburg. Led by Ulrich of Matsch, its members wore a silver elephant on their breasts; the poet Oswald von Wolkenstein was among them.

Although formed for five years, the league ended in 1407. Most members joined the Falcon League founded by Henry of Rottenburg.
zh:
大象协会于1406年由21名蒂罗尔贵族组成，旨在对抗公爵腓特烈四世及其总督罗滕堡的亨利，维护贵族特权。协会由马奇的乌尔里希领导，成员胸前佩戴银象，诗人奥斯瓦尔德·冯·沃尔肯施泰因也是其中一员。

联盟原定存在五年，却在1407年解散。多数成员加入了罗滕堡的亨利创立的猎鹰联盟。

en:
The Fürspang Society was founded at Würzburg in 1396 by 26 nobles from twelve Franconian families. Originally a burial and altar brotherhood devoted to Mary, it supported churches in Bamberg, Nuremberg and Würzburg. Its name referred to a brooch understood as a clasp from Mary's girdle.

Membership was hereditary within eligible families and was enlarged in 1505. The society inspired the Unicorn Society of 1481, but dwindled after the Reformation and dissolved in 1648.
zh:
胸针协会于1396年由来自12个法兰克尼亚家族的26名贵族在维尔茨堡创立。它最初是敬奉圣母玛利亚的丧葬与祭坛兄弟会，支持班贝格、纽伦堡和维尔茨堡的教堂；协会名称所指的胸针被认为是圣母腰带上的搭扣。

成员资格在符合条件的家族中世袭，1505年扩大了接纳范围。胸针协会启发了1481年成立的独角兽协会，但在宗教改革后日渐衰落，于1648年解散。

en: The Order of Saint Hubert was founded by Gerhard of Jülich-Berg in 1444 or 1445 to commemorate his victory over Arnold of Egmond at Linnich on Saint Hubert's day in 1444. Gerhard's son William renewed its statutes in 1475. In 1778 Charles Theodore brought the order to Bavaria when he inherited its electorate.
zh: 圣胡贝图斯骑士团由于利希-贝格公爵格哈德于1444年或1445年创立，以纪念他在1444年的圣胡贝图斯日于利尼希击败埃赫蒙德的阿诺德。格哈德之子威廉于1475年更新了骑士团章程。1778年卡尔·特奥多尔继承巴伐利亚选侯国后，将骑士团带到了巴伐利亚。

en: Seventeen counts, knights and squires founded the Society with the Lion at Wiesbaden on 17 October 1379. Its members openly supported the Avignon claimant Clement VII, while their opponents backed Urban VI in Rome. The league allied with Basel in 1380 and fought against leagues of cities; its last official mention came with the peace of Ehingen in 1382.
zh: 1379年10月17日，17名伯爵、骑士与侍从在威斯巴登创立雄狮协会。成员公开支持阿维尼翁的教宗克雷芒七世，而对手拥护罗马的乌尔巴诺六世。协会于1380年与巴塞尔结盟，并与城市联盟交战；1382年埃欣根和约是官方记录中最后一次提及该协会。

en: The Society with the Donkey first appears in records in 1387. Its northern and southern branches centred on Frankfurt and Heidelberg respectively, each led by elected kings. Several members served King Rupert of the Palatinate, and the society counted 110 companions in 1408. Its political influence declined after Rupert's death in 1410; the southern branch was refounded in 1478.
zh: 驴子协会最早见于1387年的记载。其南北两支分别以海德堡和法兰克福为中心，各自由推选出的“国王”领导。数名成员为普法尔茨的国王鲁普雷希特效力，1408年协会有110名同伴。鲁普雷希特于1410年去世后，协会的政治影响力下降；南支于1478年重新成立。

en:
Aachen was a Free Imperial City of the Holy Roman Empire, grown from Roman Aquae Granni. Charlemagne made it his residence and built the Palatine Chapel, where he was buried in 814; after Frederick Barbarossa canonized him in 1165 it became a major pilgrimage site. From Otto I in 936 to Ferdinand I in 1531, thirty-one kings of the Germans were crowned, and Barbarossa's charter of 1166 gave the city its imperial liberties.

Religious strife followed the Reformation: Protestant office-holders were expelled in 1598, and the Spanish siege of 1614 sealed Catholic restoration. The congresses of 1668 and 1748 made Aachen the venue of major peace treaties.

French troops occupied it in 1794 and ended its self-rule; the Peace of Lunéville annexed it to France in 1801, and the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
亚琛是神圣罗马帝国的帝国自由城市，前身为罗马浴场阿奎埃·格拉尼。查理曼以此为居所，修建行宫礼拜堂，并于814年安葬于此；1165年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将其封圣，这里成为重要朝圣地。936年奥托一世至1531年斐迪南一世，共有三十一位德意志国王在此加冕；巴巴罗萨1166年特许状赋予城市帝国自由权。

宗教改革后教派冲突不断：1598年新教官员被驱逐，1614年西班牙军队围城，天主教恢复统治。1668年、1748年两次亚琛会议在此签署重要和约。

1794年法国军队占领亚琛，城市自治告终；1801年《吕内维尔和约》将其割让给法国，1815年维也纳会议将其划归普鲁士。

en:
Al A'idh is an Arab tribe of central Arabia, whose old genealogies derive them from the Banu A'idh ibn Sa'd, a branch of the Banu Amir ibn Sa'sa'a of the great Hawazin tribal group, although in later centuries they were counted among the Qahtan. They ranged across Najd, Asir and Kuwait, and many clans settled as townsmen in the valleys of Najd, including Sudair, al-Majma'ah, al-Ghat and Zulfi.

Their leading houses supplied rulers to the region's small townships: Zamil ibn Uthman of the Al Zamil was emir of al-Kharj in 1687, and Hasan ibn Rashid al-Bajadi of the Al Bajadi held the emirate of al-Yamama until his death in 1781.

Another A'idhi family, the Al Ufaysan, rose with the first Saudi state, and Ibrahim ibn Ufaysan became emir of Unaizah in 1814 after leading Saudi campaigns to the Gulf coast.
zh:
阿伊兹是阿拉伯半岛中部的阿拉伯部落，按古老谱系，他们出自巴努·阿伊兹·伊本·萨阿德，属哈瓦津大部落群中巴努·阿米尔·伊本·萨阿萨阿的一支，但在后世被归入盖哈坦人。他们活动于内志、阿西尔和科威特，许多氏族在苏代尔、迈季迈阿、加特和祖勒菲等内志河谷定居为城镇居民。

其名门望族为当地小镇提供了统治者：扎米勒家族的扎米勒·伊本·奥斯曼于1687年担任海尔季埃米尔，巴贾迪家族的哈桑·伊本·拉希德·巴贾迪占据耶马迈埃米尔之位，直至1781年去世。

另一个阿伊兹家族欧费桑家族随第一沙特王国崛起，易卜拉欣·伊本·欧费桑在率军征战海湾沿岸后，于1814年成为欧奈宰埃米尔。

en:
Alastani was a Georgian princely domain in the province of Javakheti, centred on the castle of Alastani north of Akhalkalaki. Early in the thirteenth century it was held by the crown prince Lasha-George, the future King George IV, whose successors bore the title Alastaneli.

After David VIII lost the struggle for the Georgian throne to his brother Vakhtang III in 1302, he withdrew to Javakheti and founded a line of provincial kings, nominally subject to the crown at Tbilisi. His son Andronicus died in 1354.

David VIII's grandsons David and George the Great held the domain until George fell fighting the Turks in 1373. The Alastaneli line became extinct early in the following century, and Javakheti was eventually absorbed into the neighbouring Jaqeli principality of Samtskhe.
zh:
阿拉斯塔尼是格鲁吉亚贾瓦赫季地区的王公领地，以阿哈尔卡拉基以北的阿拉斯塔尼城堡为中心。13世纪初，它属于王储拉沙-吉奥尔基，即后来的吉奥尔基四世，后继者都拥有“阿拉斯塔尼”的头衔。

1302年，达维德八世在与弟弟瓦赫坦格三世争夺格鲁吉亚王位失败后退守贾瓦赫季，开创了一支名义上臣服于第比利斯王权的地方王统。他的儿子安德洛尼卡于1354年去世。

达维德八世的孙子达维德与大吉奥尔基相继领有此地，1373年大吉奥尔基在与土耳其人作战时阵亡。阿拉斯塔尼王统在15世纪初绝嗣，贾瓦赫季最终并入邻近的贾凯利家族萨姆茨赫公国。

en:
The Al 'Ali were a Bedouin clan of the Banu Rabi'ah, a branch of the Banu Tayy, whose nomads roamed the northern Arabian oasis of Al-Jawf before Islam and entered Syria with the Jarrahid dynasty in the tenth and eleventh centuries.

Under Ayyubid and Mamluk rule the sultans governed the Syrian desert through the office of amir al-arab, and the Banu Rabi'ah split into houses: the Al Fadl held the northern steppe, the Al Mira became virtually independent lords of the southern desert with the title malik al-arab, and Al Ali emirs at times held the amir al-arab themselves. In 1337 the Al Ali's tents reached Dumat al-Jandal, and the clan held its grazing grounds as Mamluk vassals.

Branches later migrated to the Arab Gulf: from 1739 an Al Ali chiefdom ruled Persia's Shibkuh coast, and kinsmen settled at Umm al-Quwain, whose Al Mualla rulers claim Tayyid descent.
zh:
阿里家族是贝都因氏族，属巴努·拉比阿——泰伊大部落的分支；泰伊牧民在伊斯兰教兴起前游牧于阿拉伯北部的焦夫绿洲，10至11世纪随贾拉王朝进入叙利亚。

阿尤布与马穆鲁克统治时期，苏丹通过阿拉伯埃米尔一职管理叙利亚沙漠，巴努·拉比阿分成几个望族：法德勒家族占据北部草原，米拉家族以阿拉伯人之王的名号成为南方沙漠近乎独立的主人，阿里家族的埃米尔也曾几度取得阿拉伯埃米尔之位。1337年，阿里家族的帐篷远达杜马詹达勒，以马穆鲁克附庸身份领有牧场。

后来支系迁往阿拉伯湾：1739年起，一个阿里酋长政权统治波斯的希卜库海岸，另有族人定居乌姆盖万，当地穆阿拉统治者自称泰伊血统。

en: Abdari denotes a Jurchen clan polity of the lower Tumen River valley, with its seat at Kahari in present-day Yanbian. In 1337 these Tungusic villagers and hunters acknowledged the Yuan as overlords. From 1405 the Ming enrolled Tumen-basin chieftains in guards such as the Maolian Guard, and the local clans were later drawn into the Jianzhou Jurchen consolidation.
zh: 阿卜达里指图们江下游流域的女真氏族政权，治所喀哈里位于今延边境内。1337年，这些通古斯语的村民与猎户奉元朝为宗主。1405年起，明朝把图们江流域的首领编入毛怜卫等卫所，当地各氏族后来被卷入建州女真的整合之中。

en:
Alba, the Roman Alba Pompeia, was granted town status by Gnaeus Pompeius Strabo and gave birth to the emperor Pertinax, who ruled briefly in 193. After the Western Empire fell it was repeatedly sacked by Ostrogoths, Lombards, Saracens and others.

In the eleventh century it became a free commune and joined the Lombard League against the Hohenstaufen, but its position in southern Piedmont exposed it to stronger neighbours: Montferrat and the Visconti of Milan fought over it, and it later passed to the Gonzaga. Charles Emmanuel I of Savoy twice conquered it in the Italian wars, and the Treaty of Cherasco in 1631 assigned Alba to Savoy.

In 1796 French revolutionary troops set up a short-lived Republic of Alba, then folded the town into the Subalpine Republic and in 1802 into the French Empire; it was restored to the Kingdom of Sardinia in 1814.
zh:
阿尔巴古罗马时称阿尔巴·庞培亚，格奈乌斯·庞培·斯特拉波授其城市地位，也是193年短暂在位的皇帝佩蒂纳克斯诞生地。西罗马灭亡后，它屡遭东哥特人、伦巴第人、撒拉森人等洗劫。

11世纪成为自由市镇，加入伦巴第联盟对抗霍亨施陶芬皇朝，但地处皮埃蒙特南部，屡为强邻争夺：蒙费拉托与米兰维斯孔蒂家族反复交锋，后转入贡扎加家族之手。萨伏依的卡洛·埃马努埃莱一世在意大利战争中两度攻占此城，1631年《凯拉斯科条约》将阿尔巴划归萨伏依。

1796年法国革命军在此建立短命的阿尔巴共和国，随后将该城并入阿尔卑斯山南共和国，1802年又并入法兰西帝国；1814年它回归撒丁王国。

en: Arbabni was a small Muslim sultanate in present-day Arsi, Ethiopia, founded around the 12th century. Its inhabitants followed the Hanafi school of Islamic law, and geographers counted it among the lands of Zeila. Emperor Amda Seyon conquered Arbabni in the 14th century and incorporated it into Fatagar; the region was later affected by Oromo migrations.
zh: 阿尔巴卜尼是一个约于12世纪建立的穆斯林小苏丹国，位于今埃塞俄比亚的阿尔西地区。居民遵循伊斯兰法的哈乃斐派，中世纪地理学家将它列为泽拉地区的一部分。14世纪皇帝安达·塞永征服阿尔巴卜尼并将其并入法塔加尔；这一带后来受到奥罗莫人迁徙的影响。

en:
The Ambundu were Kimbundu-speaking people of the highlands north of the Kwanza River. Among their states was Ndongo, whose ruler bore the title ngola and whose lands lay between the Kwanza and Lukala rivers.

In 1518 Ngola Kiluanji sent envoys to Portugal, and a Portuguese mission reached Ndongo in 1520. War followed in 1579; a Portuguese army attacking the capital Kabasa was defeated in 1590 after Ndongo allied with Matamba.
zh:
安本杜人说金本杜语，居住在宽扎河以北的高地。他们建立的国家中有恩东戈，其统治者称恩戈拉，领土位于宽扎河与卢卡拉河之间。

1518年，恩戈拉·基卢安吉派遣使节前往葡萄牙，葡萄牙使团于1520年抵达恩东戈。1579年双方爆发战争；恩东戈与马坦巴结盟后，于1590年击败了进攻首都卡巴萨的葡萄牙军队。

en:
Ardabil in northwestern Iran was the home of the Safavid Sufi order, named for Safi al-Din Ardabili, who died in 1334. His successors inherited its leadership, and by the mid-fifteenth century the order had adopted Shiite beliefs and become militant under Junayd and Haydar.

Both Junayd and Haydar died in battle, in 1460 and 1488 respectively. Haydar's son Ismail began his campaign to unite Iran from Ardabil and founded the Safavid dynasty in 1501, making Tabriz his capital. Ardabil remained the site of Safi al-Din's shrine and Ismail's tomb.
zh:
伊朗西北部的阿尔达比勒是萨法维耶苏菲教团的发源地，教团得名于1334年去世的萨菲丁·阿尔达比利。他的后代世袭教团领袖之位，到15世纪中叶，教团已接受什叶派信仰，并在朱奈德和海达尔领导下转向军事活动。

朱奈德和海达尔分别于1460年和1488年战死。海达尔之子伊斯梅尔从阿尔达比勒出发统一伊朗，1501年建立萨法维王朝，定都大不里士。阿尔达比勒仍保有萨菲丁的圣陵和伊斯梅尔的陵墓。

en: The Abitibi were an Algonquin people living around Lake Abitibi, between the routes to James Bay and the Ottawa River. The Jesuit Relations recorded their name in 1640. Pointe Abitibi was a summer gathering place, and in 1686 Pierre de Troyes established a trading post on the lake. The Hudson's Bay Company opened Abitibi House there in 1794.
zh: 阿比蒂比人是居住在阿伯蒂比湖一带的阿尔冈昆人，当地位于通往詹姆斯湾与渥太华河的路线之间。1640年的《耶稣会年报》记载了他们的名称。阿比蒂比角是夏季聚会地点，皮埃尔·德·特鲁瓦于1686年在湖畔建立贸易站。1794年，哈德逊湾公司在湖边开设了阿比蒂比商站。

en:
Ambovontany is the chief settlement of Androy, the arid thorn country at the southern tip of Madagascar and homeland of the Tandroy, whose name means people of the thorns and whom seventeenth-century European sailors called the Ampatres. The Tandroy lived by herding zebu and growing drought-resistant tubers and millet, marking their tombs with piles of zebu skulls.

Their clans kept separate traditions: the Karimbola of the west claimed always to have lived there, while the eastern Mahandrovato were gradually joined by Antanosy and Bara refugees.

In the early eighteenth century the Zafimanara dynasty united the country between the Menarandra and Mendare rivers into a single confederation, but severe flooding around 1790 drove the dynasty to the Manombo plateau and the kingdom broke apart. The harsh land afterwards spared the Tandroy from conquest by the expanding Kingdom of Imerina.
zh:
安布翁塔尼是马达加斯加最南端干旱多刺的安坦德鲁伊地区的主要定居点，也是坦德罗伊人的故土；坦德罗伊意为荆棘之地的人，17世纪的欧洲水手称他们为安帕特尔人。坦德罗伊人以放牧瘤牛和种植耐旱的块茎与小米为生，墓地上堆饰着瘤牛头骨。

他们的氏族各有传统：西部的卡林博拉人自称自古就住在当地，东部的汉德罗瓦托人则逐渐接纳了安塔诺西和巴拉难民。

18世纪初，扎菲马纳拉王朝将梅纳兰德拉河与门达雷河之间的地区统一为联盟，但约1790年的特大洪水迫使该王朝逃往马农博高原，联盟随之瓦解。此后严酷的环境使坦德罗伊人免遭扩张中的伊梅里纳王国征服。

en:
Al-Abwab, whose Arabic name means the Gates, was a medieval Nubian Christian kingdom of the Nile-Atbara region in central Sudan. It began as the northernmost province of Alodia and broke away in 1268 or 1269 as Alodia itself weakened.

Its best-known king, Adur, courted Egypt's Mamluk sultanate: in 1276 he captured King David of Makuria, fleeing Baybars's invasion, and handed him to the Muslims, and in 1286 sent Cairo an embassy with an elephant and giraffe to profess obedience. Al-Abwab repeatedly sided with the Mamluks against its northern neighbour Makuria.

Early fifteenth-century Arabic writers still called it a Christian kingdom, even as Arab Bedouin drifted in and Islamised the countryside. Al-Abwab vanishes from records after 1367, but Christian pottery found with Funj wares suggests survival into the fifteenth or sixteenth century, when the Funj sultan Amara Dunqas absorbed it.
zh:
艾卜瓦卜阿拉伯语意为“诸门”，是苏丹中部尼罗河与阿特巴拉河之间的中世纪努比亚基督教王国。它本是阿洛迪亚最北的省份，1268或1269年趁阿洛迪亚衰落独立。

名王阿杜尔结好埃及马穆鲁克苏丹国：1276年俘获拜巴尔入侵后南逃的马库里亚国王大卫，交予穆斯林；1286年又遣使携大象、长颈鹿赴开罗称臣。艾卜瓦卜一再联合马穆鲁克对付北方邻邦马库里亚。

15世纪初阿拉伯作家仍称其为基督教王国，同时阿拉伯贝都因部落迁入，使乡间渐趋伊斯兰化。1367年后艾卜瓦卜不再见于记载，但与丰吉陶器同出的基督教陶器显示，它可能延续到15或16世纪，最终为丰吉苏丹阿马拉·敦卡斯吞并。

en:
Acatic was one of the independent señoríos of the Tecuexe, set in the Los Altos highlands of what is now Mexico on the northern border of the Coca kingdom of Coinan. Like its neighbours Mitic and Xalostotitlan it was remembered as a town raided by the Mexica during their long migration.

In August 1530 its cacique offered vassalage to the Spanish captain Pedro Almíndez Chirino as he swept through the region for Nuño de Guzmán. When the Mixtón War erupted in 1541, Acatic did not hold out with the Nochistlan rebels: the holders of the town had already capitulated before the viceroy Antonio de Mendoza's army moved on to besiege Nochistlan and the Mixton stronghold.
zh:
阿卡蒂克是特库埃克人的独立小邦之一，坐落在今墨西哥的阿尔托斯高原，南接科卡人的科伊南王国。与邻邦米蒂克、沙洛斯托蒂特兰一样，相传墨西加人在漫长迁徙途中曾攻掠此地。

1530年8月，西班牙队长佩德罗·阿尔门德斯·奇里诺奉努尼奥·德·古斯曼之命横扫该地区时，阿卡蒂克的酋长向他称臣纳贡。1541年米斯特翁战争爆发后，阿卡蒂克没有随诺奇斯特兰的叛军顽抗：总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨的大军进逼诺奇斯特兰和米斯特翁要塞之前，控制该城的人便已经归降。

en:
The Acciaioli were a Florentine family whose bank, founded in the thirteenth century, operated from Greece to western Europe. Niccolò Acciaioli went to Naples in 1331 to manage its interests and gained influence at the royal court.

The bank collapsed in 1345, but Niccolò acquired Greek estates and became lord of Corinth in 1358. Another branch of the family ruled the Duchy of Athens from about 1390 until 1460.
zh:
阿恰约利是佛罗伦萨的一个家族，其银行创立于13世纪，业务从希腊延伸到西欧。尼科洛·阿恰约利于1331年前往那不勒斯管理家族的银行业务，并在王室宫廷中获得影响力。

银行于1345年倒闭，但尼科洛在希腊获得领地，并于1358年成为科林斯领主。家族的另一支从约1390年到1460年统治雅典公国。

en:
The Principality of Achaea was the strongest of the crusader states established in Greece after the Fourth Crusade. It began in 1205, when William of Champlitte and Geoffrey I of Villehardouin conquered the Peloponnese, and was organised into twelve baronies under the Assizes of Romania, growing rich on wine, oil and silk.

Under Prince William II of Villehardouin the principality reached its height. His capture at Pelagonia in 1259 forced him in 1262 to surrender Mistra and Laconia to the Byzantines, who built up the Despotate of the Morea. By the Treaty of Viterbo in 1267 Achaea became a fief of Charles of Anjou, and after William's death in 1278 Angevin bailiffs governed it.

In 1337 its princess was Catherine of Valois, titular Latin empress of Constantinople and a vassal of Naples. Naples annexed it in 1383 and sold its rights to the Zaccaria family in 1404. Byzantine despots overran its heartland in 1430; the last prince, Centurione II Zaccaria, died in 1432, ending Latin rule in the Morea.
zh:
亚该亚亲王国是第四次十字军东征后在希腊建立的最强盛的十字军国家。1205年，尚普利特的威廉和维尔阿杜安的杰弗里一世征服伯罗奔尼撒，按《罗马尼亚法典》划分为十二个男爵领地，凭当地的葡萄酒、橄榄油和丝绸致富。

威廉二世亲王在位时国势达到顶峰。1259年他在佩拉戈尼亚被俘，1262年被迫将米斯特拉斯和拉科尼亚割让给拜占庭，后者建立起摩里亚专制国。1267年的《维泰博条约》使亚该亚成为安茹的查理的封邑，1278年威廉死后由安茹王朝的代理官治理。

1337年在位的是名义上的拉丁帝国女皇帝瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳，为那不勒斯的附庸。1383年那不勒斯将其吞并，1404年又把统治权卖给扎卡里亚家族。1430年拜占庭专制君主攻占其腹地，末代亲王琴图廖内二世·扎卡里亚于1432年去世，拉丁人在摩里亚的统治终结。

en:
The Acolapissa were a Native people of the Pearl River between present-day Louisiana and Mississippi. In 1699 Chickasaw raiders led by English slave traders attacked their villages.

The Acolapissa moved to Lake Pontchartrain around 1702 and to the Mississippi near New Orleans in 1722. Disease and pressure from French settlement reduced their numbers; by 1739 their remnants had joined the Houma.
zh:
阿科拉皮萨人是生活在今路易斯安那州与密西西比州之间珀尔河流域的原住民。1699年，英国奴隶贩子率领奇克索袭击者进攻他们的村落。

阿科拉皮萨人约于1702年迁至庞恰特雷恩湖，1722年又迁至新奥尔良附近的密西西比河畔。疾病和法国殖民带来的压力使其人口减少，到1739年，余众已融入霍马人。

en:
Áak'u, better known as Acoma, is a Western Keres pueblo on a sheer sandstone mesa in present-day New Mexico, one of North America's oldest continuously inhabited towns. Acoma tradition dates its Sky City to the eleventh century and archaeology its emergence by the thirteenth, when Ancestral Puebloan and Mogollon peoples gathered on the defensible rock, farming the valley and trading pottery.

Hernando de Alvarado of Coronado's army saw it in 1540, marvelling at a fortress no enemy could take. That independence ended bloodily: after the Acoma killed Juan de Zaldívar in 1598, Vicente de Zaldívar stormed the mesa in 1599, killing perhaps eight hundred in three days and enslaving or mutilating the survivors.

Rebuilt under mission rule, Áak'u joined the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 and returned to Spanish control only after Diego de Vargas's 1690s campaigns, after which its people returned and kept their Keres language and ceremonies alive.
zh:
阿库（西班牙人多称阿科马）是西凯雷斯人的普韦布洛，雄踞今新墨西哥州陡峭砂岩台地，是北美持续有人居住的最古老城镇之一。阿科马口传将“天空之城”追溯到11世纪，考古学认为其至迟13世纪已成，古普韦布洛人和莫戈永人聚守险岩，在谷地耕作、贸易陶器。

1540年科罗纳多麾下的埃尔南多·德·阿尔瓦拉多见此无人能陷的堡垒，惊叹不已。独立终以血泊收场：1598年阿科马人杀死胡安·德·萨尔迪瓦尔，维森特·德·萨尔迪瓦尔1599年强攻台地，三天杀约八百人，余者或被奴役或被断肢。

传教统治下重建，阿库参加1680年普韦布洛大起义，17世纪90年代迭戈·德·巴尔加斯再度用兵后重新臣服，此后居民返乡，仍保有凯雷斯语与仪式。

en:
The Accawmacke were an Indigenous chiefdom on Virginia's Eastern Shore, with a principal settlement near present-day Cheriton. Across Chesapeake Bay from the Powhatan Confederacy, they retained considerable autonomy under their chief Debedeavon when English colonists arrived in 1608.

Debedeavon supplied the colonists with food and left his rule to his daughter in 1657. By the mid-seventeenth century the English had taken most Accawmacke land, though communal lands survived until 1812.
zh:
阿卡瓦马基是弗吉尼亚东岸的原住民酋邦，主要聚落位于今切里顿附近。切萨皮克湾将他们与波瓦坦联盟隔开，1608年英国殖民者到来时，酋长德贝德阿冯治下的阿卡瓦马基仍有相当大的自主权。

德贝德阿冯向殖民者供应粮食，并于1657年将统治权留给女儿。到17世纪中叶，英国人已夺走大部分阿卡瓦马基土地，但公有土地保留到了1812年。

en:
The Acaxee lived in independent chiefdoms in the Sierra Madre Occidental, in what are now eastern Sinaloa and northwestern Durango in Mexico. They cultivated crops and gathered wild plants and animals. Spanish forces conquered their lands between 1529 and 1531, imposing encomiendas and exposing the population to disease.

In 1601 an elder named Perico led the Acaxee in revolt against Spanish rule and forced labor. The rebels halted silver mining in their territory, but a Spanish army and its Indigenous allies defeated them in 1603 and executed most of their leaders.
zh:
阿卡塞生活在西马德雷山脉的多个独立酋邦中，位于今墨西哥锡那罗亚东部和杜兰戈西北部。他们种植作物，也采集野生动植物。1529年至1531年，西班牙军队征服了他们的土地，推行监护征赋制度，带来了疾病。

1601年，一位名叫佩里科的长者带领阿卡塞人起义，反抗西班牙统治和强迫劳动。起义者使当地银矿停产，但西班牙军队及其原住民盟友于1603年击败他们，并处死了大多数首领。

en:
Adal was a Muslim sultanate in the Horn of Africa, founded on the Harar plateau after the fall of Ifat. Its towns and ports, including Harar and Zeila, linked inland trade to the Red Sea and Indian Ocean.

In 1529 Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi began a war against Christian Ethiopia, conquering much of the empire with forces that used firearms. Ethiopian troops, aided by Portuguese soldiers, defeated and killed him in 1543. Adal moved its capital to Aussa in 1577.
zh:
阿达尔是非洲之角的穆斯林苏丹国，伊法特衰亡后在哈勒尔高原建立。哈勒尔和泽拉等城镇港口将内陆贸易与红海、印度洋连接起来。

1529年伊玛目艾哈迈德·本·易卜拉欣·加齐对基督教埃塞俄比亚发动战争，率使用火器的军队征服了帝国大片领土。1543年埃塞俄比亚军队在葡萄牙士兵协助下击败并杀死了他。1577年阿达尔迁都奥萨。

en:
Anding was a Zhuang tusi on the Hongshui River in the Si'en prefecture of central Guangxi, its valley lying in present-day Du'an County under Hechi.

It was created in 1528, when Wang Shouren, the grand coordinator who had just pacified the Tianzhou rising, reorganised the former Tianzhou borderlands into nine hereditary chief's offices under Si'en. Anding stood alongside Duyang, Baishan and the other Si'en tusi, and its native chiefs held the office through the Ming and the Qing.
zh:
安定是广西中部思恩府境内、红水河畔的壮族土司，辖地在今河池市都安瑶族自治县一带。

1528年，刚刚平定田州变乱的总督王守仁把原田州府边缘的溪洞重新编组，划归思恩府管辖，设立包括安定在内的九个世袭长官司。安定与都阳、白山等土司并列，土官在明、清两代替朝廷治理境内村寨。

en:
Ayodhya was a walled town on an island of the lower Chao Phraya, the site that later became Ayutthaya. Thai chronicles place its first settlement, Mueang Nong-sano, in the 930s, founded by the monk Phuttha Sakhon. In 1082 Narai I of Lavo moved his court there from Lavapura and renamed the place Ayodhya, after which the old capital was known as Lopburi.

Its position on the river trade routes drew merchants and settlers, and Chinese and Vietnamese records of the period call the polity Xian. Descendants of Sai Nam Peung, later called the Uthong or Lavo dynasty, ruled it until the fourteenth century. In 1337 Ayodhya was a small vassal town of Lavo.

In 1351 its lord Uthong V united it with Lavo and Suphannaphum to found the Ayutthaya Kingdom, and the old town was absorbed into the new capital.
zh:
阿踰陀是昭披耶河下游一处岛上城邑，即后来阿瑜陀耶城的所在。按泰国编年史传统，其最早的聚落农萨诺城建于10世纪30年代，由僧人佛陀萨恭创立。1082年，罗涡的那莱一世把宫廷从罗哇补罗迁到此处，改名阿踰陀，旧都此后称华富里。

凭借扼守河上商路的位置，这里吸引了商人和移民，中国与安南史籍把这个政权称为暹。赛南蓬的后裔——即后世所称的乌通（罗涡）王朝——在此统治到14世纪。1337年，阿踰陀还是罗涡治下的一座附庸小城。

1351年，其领主乌通五世将它与罗涡、素攀那蓬合为一体，建立阿瑜陀耶王国，旧城随之并入新都。

en: Ado, at present-day Ado Ekiti, is an Ekiti-Yoruba kingdom whose rulers hold the title of Ewi. Its founder Ewi Awamaro was descended from a party that left Ile-Ife with Oranmiyan and, after long wanderings through the Benin forests and several interim settlements, finally made his home at Ulesun, the site of the present-day town.
zh: 阿多（即今阿多埃基蒂）是埃基提约鲁巴人的王国，统治者称“埃维”。开国君主埃维·阿瓦马罗的先辈随奥兰米扬离开伊费，在贝宁丛林中长期辗转、几经迁居，最后他在乌莱孙（今阿多埃基蒂所在地）定居建城。

en: The Aondironon were an Iroquoian people belonging to the Neutral Confederacy in what is now southern Ontario. The confederacy dispersed after Haudenosaunee attacks in 1651 during the Beaver Wars.
zh: 阿昂迪罗农是易洛魁语族人，属于今安大略省南部的中立联盟。海狸战争期间，豪德诺索尼人在1651年发动袭击，联盟随之瓦解。

en: Andalusia evokes al-Andalus, the Muslim-ruled lands of the Iberian Peninsula after the conquest of 711. Its last Muslim state, the Nasrid Emirate of Granada, surrendered to Castile and Aragon in 1492.
zh: 安达卢西亚指向711年征服后伊比利亚半岛上的穆斯林统治地区安达卢斯。当地最后一个穆斯林政权、纳斯尔王朝的格拉纳达酋长国于1492年向卡斯蒂利亚和阿拉贡投降。

en:
Dankali was the Muslim kingdom of the Afar, or Danakil, people on the arid Red Sea coast below the Ethiopian highlands. Thirteenth-century writer Ibn Sa'id located the Danakil on this shore, and in the 1470s their ruler sent Emperor Ba'eda Maryam gifts offering help against the Dobe'a.

Dankali's wealth rested on Arho's salt plains in the Afar depression: amole rock-salt bars went by camel caravan to highland markets and served as currency across Ethiopia. Its kings were Ethiopian vassals; in 1620 King Kamil, overthrown by his brother, sought Emperor Susenyos's camp at Dehana to be restored and crowned.

From the late sixteenth century Baraytuma Oromo raids split the Danakil north and south. In the eighteenth century the loss of the salt plains and Ottoman control of the ports broke Dankali into petty sultanates, its rulers confined to the Buri Peninsula.
zh:
丹卡利是阿法尔人（又称达纳基尔人）的穆斯林王国，地处埃塞俄比亚高原之下干旱的红海沿岸。13世纪作家伊本·赛义德已记载达纳基尔人住在此地；15世纪70年代其统治者向巴埃达·马里亚姆皇帝献礼，请缨助攻邻邦多贝亚。

丹卡利的财富仰仗阿法尔洼地阿尔霍盐原：阿莫莱岩盐条由骆驼商队运往高原集市，在埃塞俄比亚充当货币。国王是埃塞俄比亚皇帝的附庸：1620年被兄弟推翻的卡米勒王前往德哈纳的苏塞尼奥斯行营复位加冕。

16世纪末起巴赖图马奥罗莫人不断袭掠，将达纳基尔人割裂为南北两支。18世纪盐原丧失、港口为奥斯曼人控制，丹卡利瓦解为小苏丹国，统治者退缩到布里半岛。

en:
Augsburg was founded by the Romans in 15 BC as Augusta Vindelicorum and became capital of Raetia in 120 AD. In 1276 it became a Free Imperial City, independent of its Prince-Bishop, and its trade routes into Italy made it a major textile and metalwork centre.

The Fugger and Welser banks made it among the Empire's richest cities in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries; Jakob Fugger founded the Fuggerei almshouses in 1516. The Reformation made it a centre of German religion: the Augsburg Confession was presented at the 1530 Diet, and the 1555 Peace of Augsburg left a mixed Catholic and Protestant council over a mostly Protestant population.

Swedish troops occupied it in 1632, and the imperial siege of 1634 to 1635 killed thousands by hunger and disease. It kept self-government until mediatization in 1803, after which it passed to Bavaria.
zh:
奥格斯堡公元前15年由罗马人建立，初名奥古斯塔-温德利科鲁姆，120年成为雷蒂亚首府。1276年成为帝国自由市，独立于本地采邑主教；凭意大利商路发展为纺织与金属加工中心。

富格尔、韦尔泽两银行家族使它在15至16世纪跻身帝国最富庶城市，雅各布·富格尔1516年捐建济贫住宅区富格莱。宗教改革中它成为德意志宗教事务中心：1530年帝国议会呈交《奥格斯堡信纲》，1555年《奥格斯堡和约》后天主教与新教混合市政厅治理以新教徒为主的市民。

1632年瑞典军占领该城，1634至1635年帝国围城战数千人死于饥馑疫病。自治维持至1803年帝国代表会议决议，后并入巴伐利亚。

en:
The Angoche Sultanate was a Swahili Muslim polity on the Angoche islands off the coast of what is now northern Mozambique. The islands held trading communities from around 500, and oral tradition holds that Kilwa refugees founded it late in the fifteenth century, installing Xosa as its first sultan and establishing ruling noble houses known as the inhapakho.

As Kilwa and Sofala declined, Angoche became an alternative port for ivory, gold and slaves bound for the Indian Ocean. Portuguese Zambezi factories in the 1530s and Marave control of the hinterland cut its caravan routes, and after loose Portuguese overlordship the old town was abandoned and rebuilt elsewhere.

A visitor in 1752 found the sultanate restored and expanding, and from the 1830s Angoche grew wealthy again on ivory, rubber and a slave trade beyond European control.
zh:
安戈谢苏丹国是今莫桑比克北部近海安戈谢群岛上的斯瓦希里穆斯林政权。群岛约500年起已有贸易聚落；据口述传统，基尔瓦苏丹国流亡者15世纪末建立苏丹国，拥立霍萨为第一任苏丹，形成称inhapakho的统治贵族家族。

基尔瓦和索法拉衰落后，安戈谢成为输往印度洋的象牙、黄金和奴隶的替代港口。1530年代葡萄牙人在赞比西河设商站，马拉维人又控制内陆，商队通道被切断；经历一段松散的葡萄牙宗主权后，旧城废弃，迁至新址重建。

1752年来访者发现苏丹国已经复兴并向外扩张；1830年代起，安戈谢凭象牙、橡胶和游离于欧洲人控制之外的奴隶贸易再度兴盛。

en:
Aning was a Yi tribal polity centred on Ami, the broad basin of present-day Kaiyuan in south-eastern Yunnan. Under the Dali kingdom the Aning tribe was administered through the Zuining garrison, and after the Mongol conquest it was reorganised as the Aning Ten-Thousand-Household. The early Ming turned the territory into Ami Department under Lin'an Prefecture, ruled by hereditary Pu-family native chieftains.

In 1631 the Ami chief Pu Mingsheng rose in the great Sha-Pu rebellion that shook southern Yunnan and stormed the neighbouring Mile Department, before Ming forces brought it down.

In 1648, after Li Dingguo had crushed the related rising of Sha Dingzhou, the Southern Ming renamed Ami as Kaiyuan County, the first use of the name Kaiyuan; the Qing restored the old name Ami Department when they entered Yunnan in 1659.
zh:
阿宁是以阿迷（今云南东南部开远一带的宽阔坝子）为中心的彝族部落政权。大理国时期，阿宁部归最宁镇管辖；蒙古征服后被改编为阿宁万户府。明初在其地设阿迷州，隶临安府，由普氏土官世袭。

1631年，阿迷土酋普名声发动了震动整个滇南的沙普之乱，一度攻陷邻境弥勒州，最终被明军平定。

1648年，李定国平定沙定洲之乱后，南明改阿迷州为开远县，开远这个地名由此首次出现；1659年清军入滇，又恢复阿迷州旧名。

en: The Attignawantan, or Bear people, were a Wendat nation in present-day Ontario. They joined another nation to form the Wendat confederacy in the 15th century; the Arendaronon joined around 1590. Quienonascaran was their principal village when Gabriel Sagard visited. In the 17th-century Beaver Wars, the Haudenosaunee defeated and dispersed the Wendat, who had allied with the French.
zh: 阿蒂格纳万坦人又称熊族，是今安大略省的温达特部族。他们在15世纪与另一个部族联合，组成温达特联盟；阿伦达罗农人约于1590年加入。加布里埃尔·萨加尔到访时，基耶诺纳斯卡朗是他们的主要村落。17世纪的海狸战争中，豪德诺索尼人击败并驱散了与法国结盟的温达特人。

en: The Kel Ahaggar were a Tamahaq-speaking Tuareg confederation of the Hoggar Mountains in present-day Algeria. Local traditions traced the ancestors of the Ahaggar Tuareg to Tin Hinan, whose reputed tomb lies at Abalessa.
zh: 凯尔阿哈加尔是说塔马哈克语的图阿雷格部族联盟，居于今阿尔及利亚的霍加尔山脉。当地传说将阿哈加尔图阿雷格人的祖先追溯到廷希南，她的传说墓地位于阿巴莱萨。

en:
The Ahis were a fraternity of Muslim craftsmen and merchants who ruled Ankara as a self-governing commonwealth in the late thirteenth and fourteenth centuries. The order grew out of the guilds organised by the preacher Ahi Evran, a leather trader from Kayseri who bound urban workmen into religious and commercial fellowships across Seljuk Anatolia.

After the Mongol victory at Kösedağ in 1243 broke Seljuk power, the Ahis of Ankara used the resulting vacuum to declare semi-independence around 1290 under Ilkhanid suzerainty. Unlike the neighbouring Turkmen beyliks, they had no ruling dynasty: their sheikhs, titled ahi baba, governed through a republic-like guild order with ranks from apprentice to master craftsman.

The Ottoman ruler Orhan first occupied Ankara in 1354, and after a brief Ahi attempt to restore their rule, Murad I absorbed the commonwealth into the Ottoman state in 1362.
zh:
艾赫是穆斯林手工业者和商人组成的兄弟会，13世纪末至14世纪以自治共同体统治安卡拉。组织源于传教士艾赫·埃夫兰在塞尔柱安纳托利亚各城建立的行会：他出身开塞利皮匠，把城市工匠编入兼具宗教与商业性质的互助团体。

1243年蒙古人在克塞山战役中击垮塞尔柱后，安卡拉的艾赫人趁权力真空于约1290年宣布半独立，奉伊儿汗国为宗主。与周围的突厥蛮贝伊国不同，他们没有统治王朝，由称艾赫巴巴的长老按行会式的共和体制治理，成员等级从学徒一直到工匠师傅。

奥斯曼统治者奥尔汗于1354年首次占领安卡拉，艾赫人一度试图恢复自治，1362年穆拉德一世将这块共同体并入奥斯曼国家。

en:
The Ahom kingdom was a Tai state of the Brahmaputra Valley, founded in 1228 when Möng Mao prince Sukaphaa crossed the Patkai and settled Charaideo in 1253. Built on wet-rice and Burhagohain and Borgohain offices, it called itself Mung Dun Shun Kham, absorbing nearby peoples. In 1337 its ruler was Sukhrangpha (1332 to 1364).

Under Suhungmung (1497 to 1539) it grew powerful, annexing Chutia in 1523 and doubling in size; he took the Hindu title Swarganarayana. Under Pratap Singha the Paik system was reorganised in 1609 against the Mughals; Mughals stormed the capital Garhgaon in 1662, but Lachit Borphukan broke their fleet at Saraighat in 1671. After the Battle of Itakhuli in 1682, the Mughals were held west of the Manas.

The Moamoria rebellion of 1769 to 1805 shattered central authority; Burmese intervention from 1817 followed, and the 1826 Treaty of Yandabo gave Assam to the East India Company, ending nearly six centuries of rule.
zh:
阿洪姆是布拉马普特拉河谷泰人国家。1228年勐卯王子苏卡法越帕特开山，1253年在查莱碉定居，以水稻及布尔哈戈汉、巴尔戈汉两职为基，号孟顿顺坎，逐渐吸纳邻族。1337年君主苏克朗帕（1332—1364）。

苏洪蒙（1497—1539）时强盛，1523年吞久蒂亚，疆域翻倍，他取印度教头衔斯瓦尔加纳拉亚纳。普拉塔普·辛格在位时，1609年改组派克劳役制抗莫卧儿；1662年首都加尔冈陷于莫卧儿军，1671年拉吉特·巴尔普坎萨拉伊加特破其舰队，1682年伊塔胡利战役后莫卧儿被挡在马纳斯河以西。

摩亚马里亚叛乱（1769—1805）动摇中央，1817年缅人干涉，1826年《杨达坡条约》割阿萨姆予东印度公司，近六百年统治终结。

en:
The Hata were a branch of the Matsuura warriors, based at Kishidake Castle in Hizen Province. Their family tradition traced the name to Matsuura Mochi, who moved to Hata in 1102. A succession dispute erupted in 1564, and in 1569 Ryūzōji and Arima forces helped the faction supporting Hata Chikashi recover the castle.

Chikashi retained his lands after Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign in 1587. In 1593, during the invasion of Korea, Hideyoshi recalled him and confiscated his domain.
zh:
波多氏是松浦武士集团的一支，以肥前国岸岳城为据点。家族传说称，松浦持于1102年迁至波多并以地名为姓。1564年，波多氏爆发继承之争；1569年，龙造寺氏和有马氏的军队帮助拥立波多亲的一派夺回城池。

1587年丰臣秀吉征讨九州后，波多亲保住了领地。1593年侵朝战争期间，秀吉召回波多亲并没收了他的领地。

en:
Ahuacatlan was a small indigenous community of the Xalisco country in what is now southeastern Nayarit; its Nahuatl name joins ahua, avocado, and tlan, place, meaning the place of avocados. Its people were the Tecuales, whom Spanish records also labelled Otomies, speaking a language of the Corachol branch closely related to the Huichol of the nearby Wixarika highlanders.

Nuno de Guzman's expedition overran the Xalisco region from 1531 and folded it into the kingdom of Nueva Galicia, called Chimalhuacan in Nahuatl; the local peoples joined the Cora, Guachichil and Caxcan rising known as the Mixton War of 1540 to 1541.
zh:
阿瓦卡特兰是今纳亚里特州东南部哈利斯科地区的一个小型原住民聚落，其纳瓦特尔语名称由“阿瓦”（鳄梨）和“特兰”（地方）组成，意为“鳄梨之地”。当地居民是特夸尔人，西班牙文献也曾把他们称作奥托米人，所讲语言属于科拉—维乔尔语支，与邻近维夏里卡斯高地居民的维乔尔语相近。

1531年起，努尼奥·德·古斯曼的远征队横扫哈利斯科地区，将其纳入纳瓦特尔语称奇马尔瓦坎的新加利西亚王国；1540至1541年，当地各部族又与科拉人、夸奇奇特尔人和卡克斯坎人联合发动了米斯特顿战争。

en: Antsohihy is a town on the Loza River in northern Madagascar, in a region that in the 1300s belonged to the Antalaotra Muslim Swahili city-state world of Irodo and Mahilaka. The present town was founded at the end of the 1600s by Sakalava, Makua and Tsimihety settlers and named after the local sohihy tree.
zh: 安楚希希是马达加斯加北部洛扎河畔的城镇，1300年代其所在地区属于伊罗多、马希拉卡等安塔拉特拉穆斯林斯瓦希里城邦的圈子。今镇建于1600年代末，由萨卡拉瓦人、马夸人和齐米赫蒂人拓居，得名于当地的索希希树。

en: Arabia is the peninsula between the Red Sea and the Persian Gulf. From its base at Diriyah, the Saudi state founded in 1744 expanded across much of the peninsula before Egyptian forces captured its capital in 1818.
zh: 阿拉伯是红海与波斯湾之间的半岛。1744年建立的沙特政权以德拉伊耶为基地，扩张至半岛的大部分地区，1818年埃及军队攻陷了它的首都。

en: Aidan denotes a Jurchen clan group settled around present-day Yanji in the Buerhatong and Hailan river valleys, a region the Jin ruled through its Halan route and the Yuan through the Kaiyuan circuit of Liaoyang province. In 1337 it was a small tribal polity under Yuan overlordship, and the Ming later placed the area under its Buerhatu Guard within the Nurgan Regional Military Commission.
zh: 艾丹指定居在今延吉一带、布尔哈通河与海兰江流域的女真氏族群体。这一地区金代由曷懒路管辖，元代划归辽阳行省开元路；1337年它是臣属元朝的小型部族政权，明代当地被纳入奴儿干都司体系下的布尔哈图卫。

en:
The Aimoré were indigenous peoples of eastern Brazil, whose lands extended inland from Espírito Santo towards the Doce River. In 1535 the Portuguese settler Vasco Fernandes Coutinho built a fort on Espírito Santo Bay against the Aimoré and other peoples.

Conflict over enslavement helped bring about the Aimoré War, which began in 1555; Aimoré attacks destroyed colonial outposts around 1558. Colonists later drove them west into Minas Gerais, where frontier wars from 1790 to 1820 brought further violence.
zh:
艾莫雷是巴西东部的原住民族群，其土地从圣埃斯皮里图向内陆延伸至多西河一带。1535年，葡萄牙殖民者瓦斯科·费尔南德斯·科蒂尼奥在圣埃斯皮里图湾筑堡，防御艾莫雷人和其他族群。

奴役原住民引起的冲突促成了1555年开始的艾莫雷战争；艾莫雷人约于1558年摧毁了殖民据点。殖民者后来将他们向西驱逐到米纳斯吉拉斯，1790—1820年的边境战争又带来了更多暴力。

en:
The Aisu were a maritime warrior family based at Gokasho Castle on the coast of Ise Province, under the influence of the Kitabatake. They took part in the Muromachi shogunate's trade with Ming China from 1451; Aisu Hisatada travelled to Beijing with a mission that left Sakai in 1483.

Hisatada, known as Ikōsai, founded the Kage school of swordsmanship. After the Kitabatake fell, the Aisu served the Satake of Hitachi and took the name Hirasawa, moving with them to Dewa after the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600.
zh:
爱洲氏是以伊势国沿海的五个所城为据点的海上武家，受到北畠氏影响。1451年起，爱洲氏参与室町幕府与明朝的贸易；爱洲久忠随1483年从堺出发的使团前往北京。

久忠号移香斋，是剑术阴流的创始人。北畠氏灭亡后，爱洲氏效力常陆的佐竹氏并改姓平泽，在1600年关原之战后随佐竹氏迁往出羽。

en:
The kingdom of Ait Abbas ruled parts of Lesser Kabylie from the Kalâa of Ait Abbas, a fortress in the Biban mountains. After Spain took Béjaïa in 1510, Ahmed strengthened the Kalâa and proclaimed himself its sultan; his Mokrani descendants ruled the kingdom.

By the late eighteenth century the Mokrani realm had fragmented. The sheikh of the Medjana continued to govern his principality independently while paying tribute to the bey of Constantine.
zh:
阿伊特阿巴斯王国从比班山脉的阿伊特阿巴斯堡垒统治小卡比利亚的部分地区。1510年西班牙占领贝贾亚后，艾哈迈德加固堡垒并自称苏丹；他的穆克拉尼家族后裔统治了这个王国。

到18世纪末，穆克拉尼领地已经分裂。梅贾纳谢赫继续独立治理自己的领地，同时向君士坦丁的贝伊纳贡。

en:
The Ais chiefdom occupied Florida's eastern coast around the Indian River, with local chiefs subordinate to a paramount chief. In 1565 Pedro Menéndez de Avilés visited their chief town and obtained its chief's pledge of loyalty to Spain, but Spanish attempts to seize food led to fighting.

Shipwrecked merchant Jonathan Dickinson passed through Ais territory in 1696. Soon after 1700, raids by Carolina colonists and their Indigenous allies carried Ais captives away for sale; disease and raids devastated the people in the following decades.
zh:
艾斯酋邦占据佛罗里达东岸的印第安河一带，各地酋长服从一位大酋长。1565年佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯到访其主城，让酋长宣誓效忠西班牙，但西班牙人试图夺取食物，引发了战斗。

1696年，遭遇海难的商人乔纳森·迪金森经过艾斯领地。1700年后不久，卡罗来纳殖民者及其原住民盟友发动袭击，掳走艾斯人贩卖；此后数十年，疾病和掳掠重创了这一族群。

en:
Axochitlan, later spelled Ajuchitlan, takes its Nahuatl name from atl, water, and xochitl, flower, meaning water with flowers. The town lay in the hot Balsas River lowlands of the Tierra Caliente, in what is now north-western Guerrero, and was one of the Cuitlatec-speaking communities of the region.

By the late Postclassic period the Balsas basin had fallen under the Purépecha Empire of Michoacán, which kept garrisons and war bands in the jurisdiction and drew tribute from its towns.

After the Spanish conquest an encomienda was set over Ajuchitlan in 1528 and resumed by the Crown in 1534; in 1579 it was the head of its own jurisdiction, and the Relación de Ajuchitlán, compiled through Tarascan and Cuitlatec interpreters, recorded that the Cuitlatec tongue was still spoken in its villages.
zh:
阿霍奇特兰的名字后来定拼为阿胡奇特兰；其纳瓦特尔语名字由atl（水）和xochitl（花）组成，意为“有花的水”。这座城镇位于炎热的巴尔萨斯河低地火地地区，即今格雷罗州西北部，是当地讲奎特拉特克语的社群之一。

后古典期晚期，巴尔萨斯盆地落入米却肯普雷佩查帝国势力之下，后者在这一辖区驻扎守军和武士，向各城镇征收贡赋。

西班牙征服后，阿胡奇特兰1528年被划为监护领地，1534年收归王室；1579年它成为辖区治所，当时在塔拉斯科语和奎特拉特克语译员协助下编写的《阿胡奇特兰记述》记录奎特拉特克语仍在其村庄使用。

en: The Kel Ajjer were a Tamahaq-speaking Tuareg confederation in present-day southwestern Libya and southeastern Algeria. Their principal stronghold was Ghat in the Fezzan, with other centres at Ubari and Djanet.
zh: 凯尔阿杰尔是说塔马哈克语的图阿雷格部族联盟，分布在今利比亚西南部和阿尔及利亚东南部。他们的主要据点是费赞的加特，其他中心包括乌巴里和贾奈特。

en:
The Ajuran Sultanate was a Somali Muslim empire of the Horn of Africa, ruled by the House of Garen, which grew from a thirteenth-century kingdom to dominate the Banaadir interior from the late 1300s. In 1337 it was the paramount power on the southern Somali coast, holding Mogadishu as a client and ruling from Merca over coastal and riverine towns.

As Africa's only hydraulic empire of the age, it monopolized the Shebelle and Jubba rivers with dykes, dams and limestone wells, and grew rich on Indian Ocean trade, minting coinage for commerce reaching Arabia, Persia and China. At its height it stretched from Hobyo to Kismayo and Qelafo.

It repelled the Oromo in the Gaal Madow Wars of the mid-seventeenth century and fought the Portuguese, who sacked Barawa in 1507, but by the end of the seventeenth century taxation and revolts tore the empire apart. The Hiraab Imamate seized Mogadishu while Ibrahim Adeer founded the Gobroon dynasty of Geledi, and by the early 1700s Ajuran rule had vanished from Banaadir.
zh:
阿朱兰苏丹国是非洲之角的索马里穆斯林帝国，由加伦家族统治，该家族从13世纪的王国崛起，自14世纪末起主宰巴纳迪尔内陆。1337年时，它已是索马里南部沿海的头号强权，把摩加迪沙收为附庸，以梅尔卡为中心统治沿海与河畔城镇。

作为当时非洲唯一的水利帝国，阿朱兰用堤坝、水坝和石灰岩水井控制谢贝利河与朱巴河，靠印度洋贸易致富，自铸钱币，商路远达阿拉伯、波斯和中国。极盛时其势力北起霍比奥，南至基斯马尤，西抵克拉福。

它在17世纪中叶的加尔马多战争中击退奥罗莫人，又与1507年焚毁巴拉韦的葡萄牙人交战；但到17世纪末，苛税与起义使帝国四分五裂：希拉卜伊玛目国夺取摩加迪沙，易卜拉欣·阿迪尔建立格勒迪的戈布龙王朝，到18世纪初，阿朱兰在巴纳迪尔的统治已荡然无存。

en:
The Atchakangouen, or Crane band, were the largest division of the Miami people. Their main village, Kekionga, stood where the St. Joseph and St. Marys rivers form the Maumee in present-day Indiana.

In 1780 their war chief Little Turtle defeated Augustin de La Balme's force after it plundered Kekionga. He later led a Native confederation against the United States, defeating General Arthur St. Clair's army in 1791. During the nineteenth century the name Miami came to refer particularly to the Atchakangouen.
zh:
阿查坎古恩又称鹤部，是迈阿密人最大的支系。他们的主要村庄基基翁加位于今印第安纳州圣约瑟夫河与圣玛丽斯河汇成莫米河之处。

1780年，奥古斯丁·德·拉巴尔姆的部队劫掠基基翁加后，阿查坎古恩战首小龟将其击败。小龟后来率原住民联盟对抗美国，于1791年击败阿瑟·圣克莱尔将军的军队。19世纪，“迈阿密人”这一名称逐渐专指阿查坎古恩人。

en:
The Aki were local lords of Aki district in eastern Tosa, counted among the seven leading powers of the province. Their lord Aki Kunitora contested territory with Chōsokabe Motochika and attacked his castle at Okō in 1563, but was repulsed.

A truce followed in 1564, but fighting resumed in 1569. Motochika defeated Kunitora at Yanagare and besieged Aki Castle; Kunitora killed himself after the siege, ending the family's rule.
zh:
安艺氏是土佐东部安艺郡的地方领主，被列为土佐七雄之一。家主安艺国虎与长宗我部元亲争夺领地，于1563年进攻元亲的冈丰城，却遭到击退。

双方于1564年议和，但1569年再起战事。元亲在八流击败国虎，包围安艺城；国虎在围城后自尽，安艺氏的统治随之结束。

en:
The Anenokōji of Hida Province were a courtier family whose branches held lands in the province. Anenokōji Ietsuna was its provincial governor by 1378; in 1411 the shogunate sent Kyōgoku Takakazu against the family in the Hida rebellion.

The Miki family expanded in Hida and adopted the Anenokōji name around 1560. Anenokōji Yoritsuna later fought Kanamori Nagachika, whose invasion on Toyotomi Hideyoshi's orders destroyed his rule.
zh:
飞驒国的姊小路氏是公家出身的家族，其各支在当地拥有领地。姊小路家纲在1378年之前成为飞驒国司；1411年飞驒之乱中，幕府派京极高数征讨姊小路氏。

三木氏在飞驒扩张，约于1560年改称姊小路。此后姊小路赖纲与金森长近交战，后者奉丰臣秀吉之命进攻，终结了赖纲的统治。

en:
The Akamatsu were a Japanese warrior family associated with Harima Province. Akamatsu Norimura allied with Ashikaga Takauji against the Kamakura shogunate, and the family later became eligible to head the shogunate's samurai board.

In 1441 Akamatsu Mitsusuke killed Shogun Ashikaga Yoshinori, then took his own life after attacks by the Yamana and Hosokawa. During the Ōnin War of 1467–1477, Akamatsu Masanori fought as a leading general for the Hosokawa.
zh:
赤松氏是以播磨国为根据地的日本武家。赤松则村与足利尊氏结盟反抗镰仓幕府，此后赤松氏成为有资格担任幕府侍所长官的家族之一。

1441年赤松满祐杀死将军足利义教，随后遭山名氏和细川氏进攻，自尽身亡。在1467—1477年的应仁之乱中，赤松政则是细川方的主要将领。

en:
The Akana were local lords of Akana estate in Izumo Province, descended from the Sawa family of Iwami. Their mountain castle stood near the borders of Izumo, Iwami and Bingo.

In 1542 Akana Mitsukiyo held the castle against Ōuchi Yoshitaka for two months before he was killed and the garrison surrendered. Akana Morikiyo submitted to the invading Mōri in 1562; in 1599 his successor Motoki adopted the name Nakagawa, and the family continued in Mōri service.
zh:
赤穴氏是出云国赤穴庄的地方领主，出自石见国佐波氏。他们的山城位于出云、石见和备后三国交界附近。

1542年赤穴光清在城中抵抗大内义隆两个月，阵亡后守军投降。1562年赤穴盛清向入侵的毛利氏归降；其继承者元奇于1599年改姓中川，家族继续效力毛利氏。

en:
Akure is counted among the sixteen ancient Ekiti kingdoms of the Yoruba, set in the upland country north-east of Ife. An earlier settlement had a chief called Alakure, but the present dynasty was founded by Omoremilekun Asodeboyede, a prince of Ile-Ife descended from Oduduwa, who passed Oduduwa's test, migrated there and conquered the indigenous ruler.

His regnal name was Ekun, meaning leopard, which remains the royal totem and gives the Akure people their praise-name of Omo Ekun, children of the leopard. Their king, the Deji of Akure, is assisted by six high chiefs called the Iwarefa.

The central palace, traditionally dated to 1150, grew into a complex of more than sixteen courtyards, each reserved for a rite, court assembly or punishment. Through these institutions the small kingdom preserved its autonomy among the rival Ekiti and Ijesha states.
zh:
阿库雷是约鲁巴人十六个古老埃基提王国之一，地处伊费东北丘陵。早先定居点由酋长阿拉库雷统治，现存王朝开创者是奥杜杜瓦后裔、伊莱-伊费王子奥莫雷米尔昆·阿索德博耶德：他通过奥杜杜瓦的考验，迁徙至此征服土著首领。

他的王号“埃昆”意为豹，豹成为王室图腾，阿库雷人颂名称“奥莫·埃昆”，即豹的子孙。国王称阿库雷的德吉，由六位号“伊瓦雷法”的高级酋长辅政。

城中心王宫相传建于1150年，后发展成十六处以上庭院的建筑群，各院分别用于仪式、朝会或行刑。凭借这套制度，小王国在埃基提与伊杰沙诸邦间维持自治。

en:
The Andō were a warrior family whose power extended from Tsugaru into northern Dewa and Mutsu. The family later divided between Hiyama and Akita, before reuniting; its leading house adopted the name Akita in the late sixteenth century.

Akita Sanesue submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1590 and sided with the eastern army at Sekigahara in 1600. In 1602 he was transferred to Shishido in Hitachi; his descendants later ruled Miharu in Mutsu.
zh:
安东氏是势力从津轻延伸到出羽、陆奥北部的武家。家族后来分为桧山和秋田两支，之后重新合并；本家在16世纪后半期改称秋田氏。

秋田实季于1590年向丰臣秀吉效忠，1600年在关原之战中支持东军。1602年，实季被转封至常陆的宍户；其后裔后来统治陆奥的三春藩。

en:
The Taku were local lords of Taku in Hizen Province, central Kyushu. A later Taku family, descended from the Ryūzōji, succeeded an earlier family of the same name and served the Nabeshima lords of Saga.

Taku Yasutoshi brought Korean potters, including Yi Sam-pyeong, to Taku after the campaigns in Korea. In 1708 Taku Shigefumi built a Confucian shrine in his domain and used it for teaching.
zh:
多久氏是九州中部肥前国多久的地方领主。出自龙造寺氏的后多久氏接替了此前同名的家族，并为佐贺的锅岛氏效力。

朝鲜之役后，多久安顺将李参平等朝鲜陶工带到多久。1708年，多久茂文在领内建造供奉孔子的圣庙，并在那里讲学。

en: The Atikamekw lived in the forests of the upper Saint-Maurice River in present-day Quebec. Early seventeenth-century French records describe their seasonal gatherings at places such as Wemotaci and their dispersal into smaller hunting camps in winter. They traded furs for European goods, but smallpox devastated them around 1670—1680, and warfare with the Mohawk caused further losses.
zh: 阿提卡梅克人生活在今魁北克圣莫里斯河上游的森林中。17世纪初的法国记载称，他们在韦莫塔西等地季节性聚集，入冬后散居于较小的狩猎营地。他们用毛皮交换欧洲货物，但约1670—1680年的天花重创了他们，与莫霍克人的战争又造成进一步损失。

en: Atrakwaye was the principal town of the Akhrakouaeronon, an Indigenous people on the east bank of the Susquehanna in present-day Pennsylvania. John Smith's 1608 map called the town Quadroque.
zh: 阿特拉夸耶是阿克拉夸埃罗农人的主要聚落，位于今宾夕法尼亚州萨斯奎汉纳河东岸。约翰·史密斯1608年的地图将这座聚落称作夸德罗克。

en:
The Akizuki were a warrior family of Chikuzen Province in northern Kyushu, descended from the Harada. In 1557 Ōtomo Sōrin attacked their stronghold at Koshosan, forcing Akizuki Tanezane to flee after his father and elder brother died. With Mōri support, Tanezane recovered the castle and much of the family's land in 1559.

Toyotomi Hideyoshi confiscated the Akizuki lands during his Kyushu campaign in 1587, but granted Tanezane's son Takanabe in Hyūga Province. The family remained daimyō of Takanabe throughout the Edo period.
zh:
秋月氏是九州北部筑前国的武家，出自原田氏。1557年大友宗麟进攻其据点古处山城，秋月种实的父兄身亡，种实被迫逃走。1559年，种实在毛利氏支持下收复城池和家族大部分领地。

1587年丰臣秀吉征讨九州时没收了秋月氏的领地，但将日向国高锅赐给种实之子。秋月氏在江户时代一直担任高锅藩主。

en:
The Albaamaha were a Muskogean-speaking people of the upper Alabama River and members of the Creek Confederacy. They encountered Hernando de Soto's expedition in 1540, and later divided their towns between peacekeeping white towns and red towns responsible for warfare.

Pressed by settlers and neighboring enemies in the eighteenth century, Alabama and their Koasati allies moved west through Louisiana. By 1805 a group of Alabama had settled at Peach Tree Village in eastern Texas, where the two peoples continued to hunt together.
zh:
阿拉巴莫是阿拉巴马河上游说马斯科吉语族语言的族群，也是克里克联盟的成员。1540年他们遇到了埃尔南多·德索托的考察队，后来他们的聚落分为负责维持和平的白色聚落和负责战争的红色聚落。

18世纪，阿拉巴莫人和盟友科阿萨蒂人在殖民者及周边敌人的压力下向西迁入路易斯安那。到1805年，一批阿拉巴莫人在得克萨斯东部的桃树村定居，两族继续在那里共同狩猎。

en:
The medieval Kingdom of Albania was a Catholic realm on the Adriatic, ruled from Durrës. Charles of Anjou, King of Sicily, took the Byzantine coastlands with local nobles' backing and was proclaimed king in 1272, his realm stretching south to Butrint.

His drive toward Constantinople collapsed at Berat in 1281, and the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 weakened the Angevins so that the Byzantines confined them to Durrës and its district. The city fell to Serbian rule in 1296, returned to Angevin rule under Philip of Taranto in 1304, and from 1336 passed to Charles, Duke of Durazzo, as a Neapolitan appendage.

Serbian pressure under Stefan Dušan brought all Albania under his rule by 1346. After the empire disintegrated, Karl Thopia seized Durrës in 1368 and called in Ottoman troops to defeat Balša II at Savra in 1385; his son Gjergj surrendered it to Venice in 1392.
zh:
中世纪阿尔巴尼亚王国是亚得里亚海沿岸的天主教政权，以都拉斯为中心。西西里国王安茹的查理受当地贵族支持取得拜占庭沿海之地，1272年称王，疆域南至布特林特。

向君士坦丁堡的推进1281年破灭于培拉围攻战，1282年西西里晚祷战争重创安茹家族，拜占庭人随即将其限制在都拉斯一带。1296年都拉斯陷于塞尔维亚人统治，1304年塔兰托的腓力恢复安茹统治；1336年起归都拉斯公爵查理，附属那不勒斯王权。

斯特凡·杜尚南下扩张，1346年整个阿尔巴尼亚并入其版图。帝国瓦解后，卡尔·托皮亚1368年夺取都拉斯，1385年引奥斯曼军队在萨夫拉击败巴尔沙二世，其子乔治1392年将该城交予威尼斯。

en: The Allentiac were Huarpe speakers in the Cuyo region of present-day Argentina. In the late sixteenth century, Spanish encomenderos moved Huarpe people from Cuyo to Chile, where the Jesuit Luis de Valdivia documented their language.
zh: 阿伦蒂亚克是居住在今阿根廷库约地区、使用阿伦蒂亚克语的瓦尔佩人。16世纪末，西班牙殖民者将库约的瓦尔佩人迁往智利，耶稣会士路易斯·德·瓦尔迪维亚在那里记录了他们的语言。

en:
The County of Alençon, on the border of Normandy and Maine with its seat at Bellême, was held by the House of Bellême from the tenth century. It became a royal appanage under the Capetians, granted to Peter, son of Louis IX, and in 1293 to Charles of Valois, brother of Philip IV.

In 1337 it belonged to his son Charles II of Valois, who was killed fighting the English at Crécy in 1346. Raised to a dukedom in 1414, its first duke John died at Agincourt the next year; his son John II was captured when the English took the duchy at Verneuil in 1424 and recovered it only in 1449.

The line ended with the childless Duke Charles IV in 1524, after which it reverted to the French crown, the title later revived as an appanage for princes.
zh:
阿朗松伯国地处诺曼底与曼恩交界，主府在贝莱姆，10世纪起由贝莱姆家族领有。卡佩王朝时期成为王室封禄，先封给路易九世之子皮埃尔，1293年又封给腓力四世之弟瓦卢瓦的查理。

1337年在位的是其子瓦卢瓦的查理二世，1346年在克雷西战役中与英军作战时阵亡。1414年伯国升为公爵领，首任公爵约翰次年战死于阿金库尔；其子约翰二世在1424年韦尔讷伊战役中兵败被俘，公爵领被英军占领，他到1449年才将其收复。

1524年末代公爵查理四世无嗣而终，阿朗松收归法兰西王室，公爵头衔后来又作为封禄封给诸亲王。

en:
The Regency of Algiers was an Ottoman frontier state based at Algiers, founded in 1516 by the corsair brothers Aruj and Hayreddin. Its fleets fought Spain and seized ships across the Mediterranean, while local rulers retained considerable autonomy in the interior. After a Janissary coup in 1659, its rulers were chosen by the council in Algiers rather than appointed by the Ottoman sultan.

A dispute between Dey Hussein and the French consul in 1827 led to a blockade, followed by the French invasion and capture of Algiers in 1830. Resistance continued under Ahmed Bey at Constantine and Emir Abdelkader in the west.
zh:
阿尔及尔摄政领是以阿尔及尔为中心的奥斯曼边疆政权，由私掠船长阿鲁杰与海雷丁兄弟于1516年建立。其舰队与西班牙作战，在地中海各地劫掠船只，而内陆的地方统治者保有相当大的自主权。1659年禁卫军政变后，统治者改由阿尔及尔的议事会推选，不再由奥斯曼苏丹任命。

1827年，戴伊侯赛因与法国领事的争执引发封锁，法国于1830年入侵并占领阿尔及尔。君士坦丁的艾哈迈德贝伊和西部的埃米尔阿卜杜勒卡迪尔继续抵抗。

en: Kaili was a Miao tusi south of Pingyue attached to the Bozhou chiefdom; its name is a Miao form meaning the fields of the Mujiu people. The Yuan maintained a Kaili anfusi there, and after several Ming changes of guard jurisdiction it became the Kaili zhangguansi in 1607 under Pingyue Prefecture.
zh: 凯里是平越以南的苗族土司，依附于播州土司；“凯里”为苗语译音，意为木佬人的田地。元代曾设凯里安抚司，明代几经卫所改隶，至1607年降为凯里长官司，划归平越府管辖。

en:
Allstedt, south of the Harz, grew up around a royal palace first recorded in 777, where Henry the Fowler issued a charter in 935; Ottonian kings kept it as an imperial estate.

From the twelfth century the castle was administered by the lords of Allstedt, whose line died out in the mid-fourteenth century. In 1348–1356 Charles IV formed the surrounding estates into the County Palatine of Saxony-Allstedt and enfeoffed the Ascanian Duke Rudolf I of Saxe-Wittenberg as count palatine.

In 1369 the castle passed to the lords of Querfurt, who held it until 1496, when it fell to the Ernestine Wettins. Allstedt became an early Reformation centre when Thomas Müntzer served as its pastor in 1523 and preached the Sermon to the Princes in the castle chapel in 1524. The Amt was pledged to counts of Mansfeld and Stolberg before returning to Wettin dukes of Saxony in 1575.
zh:
阿尔施泰特位于哈茨山以南，围绕777年即有记载的王宫发展起来，935年捕鸟者亨利在此颁布文书；奥托王朝将其作为帝国领地。

12世纪起城堡由阿尔施泰特贵族管理，该家族14世纪中叶绝嗣。1348至1356年间，查理四世将周边领地组建为萨克森—阿尔施泰特行宫伯爵领，授阿斯坎尼家的萨克森—维滕贝格公爵鲁道夫一世为行宫伯爵。

1369年城堡转入奎尔富特贵族之手，1496年归韦廷家族恩斯特支系。1523年托马斯·闵采尔在此任牧师，1524年在城堡小教堂发表《诸侯讲道》，阿尔施泰特遂成宗教改革早期中心。该领地后抵押给曼斯费尔德、施托尔贝格两家伯爵，1575年复归萨克森韦廷公爵。

en:
The Almohads were a Berber dynasty that ruled a North African caliphate from Marrakesh. Their movement began among the Masmuda under Ibn Tumart, whose successor Abd al-Mu'min captured Marrakesh in 1147 and extended his rule across the Maghreb and into al-Andalus.

In 1212 a coalition of Castile, Aragon and Navarre defeated the caliph al-Nasir at Las Navas de Tolosa. Almohad power declined, and the Marinids captured Marrakesh and killed the last ruler in 1269, before the beginning of the fourteenth century.
zh:
穆瓦希德是柏柏尔人王朝，以马拉喀什为都城统治北非的哈里发国。其运动由伊本·图马尔特在马斯穆达部族中发起；继承人阿卜杜勒·穆民于1147年攻占马拉喀什，把统治扩展到整个马格里布和安达卢西亚。

1212年，卡斯蒂利亚、阿拉贡和纳瓦拉的联军在拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨击败哈里发纳西尔。穆瓦希德的势力此后衰落，马林王朝于1269年攻占马拉喀什并杀死末代统治者，结束了其统治。

en:
Alania was the medieval kingdom of the Alans, Iranian-speaking Sarmatian horsemen who settled the North Caucasian plain. Free of Khazar rule in the late ninth century, they adopted Orthodox Christianity through Byzantine missionaries early in the tenth. Under King Durgulel in the eleventh the kingdom reached its peak, rich from Darial Gorge trade and famed for its cavalry.

It weakened from the twelfth century, when its best-known prince David Soslan married Queen Tamar of Georgia. In 1239–1240 the Mongols stormed its capital, Maghas, and carried off thousands of Alan horsemen to China as the Yuan imperial guard, though highland Alans kept their freedom and faith.

Timur's 1395 campaigns shattered the lowland remnant; survivors retreated into the gorges and became the Ossetians, divided into Iron and Digor, while those on the plain merged with the Kabardians and the Karachay-Balkars. The Ossetian highlanders lived in near-isolation until 1774, when they sought Russian protection.
zh:
阿兰尼亚是阿兰人的中世纪王国。阿兰人是萨尔马提亚体系的伊朗语骑兵民族，分布在北高加索平原。9世纪末摆脱可萨人统治，10世纪初经拜占庭传教士皈依东正教；11世纪杜尔古列尔王时国力鼎盛，凭达里亚尔峡谷商路致富，骑兵闻名。

12世纪起王国转弱，这一时期最著名的王公大卫·索斯兰迎娶格鲁吉亚塔玛尔女王。1239—1240年蒙古人攻破都城马加斯，掳走数千阿兰骑兵远赴中国充当元朝护军，山地阿兰人则保住自由和信仰。

1395年帖木儿远征摧毁平原残余，幸存者退入高山峡谷，形成分为伊龙和季戈尔两支的奥塞梯人，留在平原的融入卡巴尔达人、卡拉恰伊人和巴尔卡尔人。奥塞梯山民几乎与世隔绝，直到1774年主动请求俄罗斯保护。

en:
Alodia, or Alwa, was the southernmost and for centuries the greatest of Nubia's three medieval Christian kingdoms, ruling the Gezira and Butana plains from its capital Soba at the confluence of the Blue and White Niles. It emerged after ancient Kush, appearing in records from 569 and adopted Christianity in 580.

Between the ninth and twelfth centuries it outshone its northern neighbour Makuria. Soba was famed for its gold-hung churches, drew goods from the Middle East, India and China, and nurtured literacy in Nubian and Greek.

Decline began in the twelfth century, through invasions, droughts and rival Red Sea cities; by 1276 al-Abwab had broken away, and in 1337 Alodia was a shrinking, fragmenting realm. Arab Bedouin migrations eroded what remained, until around 1500 Soba was destroyed, whether by the Arab leader Abdallah Jammah or the Funj king Amara Dunqas, who founded the Funj Sultanate of Sennar on its ruins in 1504. Nubian Christianity lingered on, and in 1520 envoys travelled to Ethiopia begging for priests.
zh:
阿洛迪亚又称阿尔瓦，是中世纪努比亚三个基督教王国中最南、也曾最强大的一个，以青尼罗河与白尼罗河交汇处的索巴为都，统治杰济拉与布塔纳平原。它在古库施王国灭亡后兴起，569年首见记载，580年皈依基督教。

9至12世纪是它的鼎盛期，国势超过北方邻邦马库里亚。都城索巴以饰金教堂闻名，货物来自中东、印度和中国，努比亚语与希腊语的书面文化都很繁荣。

12世纪起，入侵、干旱和红海商埠竞争使它衰落；到1276年，艾卜瓦卜已分裂独立，1337年时阿洛迪亚已是萎缩、趋于瓦解的王国。阿拉伯贝都因人的迁徙侵蚀其残余疆土，约1500年索巴陷落，摧毁它的或为阿拉伯首领阿卜杜拉·贾马，或为丰吉国王阿马拉·敦卡斯；后者于1504年在其废墟上建立丰吉森纳尔苏丹国。努比亚基督教余脉存续，1520年使者远赴埃塞俄比亚恳求派遣神父。

en:
Strasbourgum is the prince-bishopric of Strasbourg, the secular territory ruled by the city's bishop beside his ancient diocese. Between 1223 and 1260 the bishops built a lordship from the Palatinate to the Black Forest.

Their hold on Strasbourg itself broke in the Bellum Walterianum, when the burghers defeated Bishop Walter of Geroldseck at the Battle of Hausbergen in 1262, and the city became fully imperial in 1352. In 1337 Berthold of Buchegg held the see, ruling until 1353; under his successors the bishops from 1359 styled themselves Landgraves of Alsace.

The Reformation turned the city Protestant and led to a long chapter dispute that ended only in 1604. Louis XIV forced recognition of French sovereignty over the left-bank territories in 1680, confirmed at Ryswick in 1697. After French occupation of the rest in 1789, the right-bank lands were secularised to Baden in 1803.
zh:
斯特拉斯堡即斯特拉斯堡采邑主教区，为主教在古老教区外兼领的世俗领地。1223—1260年间，主教建起从普法尔茨到黑林山的领地。

对斯特拉斯堡城的控制在“瓦尔特战争”中瓦解：1262年市民在豪斯贝根战役击败盖罗尔德塞克的瓦尔特主教，1352年城市成为完全的帝国自由市。1337年在任的布赫格的贝特霍尔德任职至1353年；此后主教从1359年起自称阿尔萨斯方伯。

宗教改革后城市改宗新教，主教座堂纷争直到1604年才平息。路易十四迫使主教区1680年承认法国对莱茵河左岸的主权，1697年《赖斯韦克条约》确认。1789年法军占领余部，右岸1803年世俗化后划归巴登。

en: The Altai principality of the Telengits emerged in the Altai Mountains in the fourteenth century. Its princes, known as biy, retained considerable independence between Russia and the Dzungar Khanate. In the 1700s the Dzungars conquered the Telengits and resettled some on the Ili River; during the khanate's turmoil, these people attempted to return to the Altai.
zh: 阿尔泰地区的帖良古惕人在14世纪建立了自己的部族政权。其首领称为比，在俄国和准噶尔汗国之间长期保持相当程度的独立。18世纪准噶尔人征服了帖良古惕人，并将其中一部分迁往伊犁河；汗国发生动乱时，这些人试图返回阿尔泰。

en:
The Alupa dynasty ruled the forested coastal strip of Tulu Nadu, called Alvakheda, from about the year 200 to the fifteenth century. The Alupas held their own in the age of the Kadambas of Banavasi, then served in turn as feudatories of the Chalukyas, Rashtrakutas, Hoysalas and finally Vijayanagara.

Their kings ruled first from Mangalore, later from Udyavara and then Barkur, and used Kannada as the language of administration; their pagoda and fanam coins carried the Two Fishes emblem.

Originally Jain followers with marriage ties to the Santara dynasty of Karkala, many branches later turned to Hinduism. The line ended with Kulasekharadeva Alupendradeva, whose last inscription was placed in the Jain monastery at Mudabidri in 1444, after which the Alupa lands passed under the direct rule of Vijayanagara.
zh:
阿楼波王朝统治图卢纳德林木茂密的沿海地带，其地称阿尔瓦凯达，从约200年延续到15世纪。阿楼波人在巴纳瓦西的卡丹巴王朝时代保持自立，此后先后臣属于遮娄其、罗湿陀罗拘陀、曷萨拉，最后归附毗奢耶那伽罗。

其君主先以门格洛尔为都，后来迁往乌迪亚瓦拉，再迁至巴尔库尔，行政语言用卡纳达语；所铸宝塔金币与法南铜币上刻有“双鱼”王徽。

王室原本信奉耆那教，与卡尔卡拉的桑塔拉王朝联姻，后来许多支派改宗印度教。末代君主库拉谢卡拉提婆·阿楼彭陀罗提婆的最后一方铭文1444年立在穆达比德里的耆那教寺院，此后阿楼波故地归毗奢耶那伽罗直接管辖。

en:
The Kingdom of the Algarve was a nominal realm in southern Portugal, without separate institutions or significant autonomy. Afonso III completed its conquest from Muslim rulers by taking Faro in 1249; the Treaty of Badajoz settled Castilian claims in 1267.

From 1471 the royal title referred to the Algarves on both sides of the sea, including Portuguese possessions in North Africa. Portugal abandoned its last North African outpost in 1769, and administrative reforms replaced the Algarve with the district of Faro in 1835.
zh:
阿尔加维王国是葡萄牙南部的名义王国，没有独立的机构或显著的自治权。阿方索三世于1249年攻占法鲁，完成了从穆斯林统治者手中征服阿尔加维的过程；1267年的《巴达霍斯条约》解决了卡斯蒂利亚对该地的主张。

从1471年起，王室头衔中的阿尔加维包括海峡两岸的领地，涵盖葡萄牙在北非的属地。葡萄牙于1769年放弃最后一个北非据点，1835年的行政改革则以法鲁区取代了阿尔加维。

en:
Alaiye, the medieval name for the port of Alanya on Anatolia's southern coast, was a Turkmen beylik whose chiefs traced their origin to the Karamanlu branch of the Afshar tribe. After the Seljuk defeat at Kösedağ in 1243 the port slipped from Seljuk control, and in 1293 the Karamanid prince Bedreddin Mahmud captured it and founded the ruling line.

The traveller Ibn Battuta later found Yusuf Bey, who reigned from about 1330 to 1337, governing the city as an effectively independent ruler. Christian pressure from the sea continued, and attacks by Henry II of Jerusalem in 1291 and Peter I of Cyprus in 1366 both failed.

In 1427 the Karamanid Ibrahim Bey II sold Alaiye to the Mamluk sultan Barsbay for five thousand gold coins, and in 1471 the Ottoman general Gedik Ahmed Pasha conquered it from the last bey, Kılıç Arslan, ending the principality.
zh:
阿拉耶是安纳托利亚南岸港口阿拉尼亚的中世纪名称，这里的突厥蛮贝伊国统治家族出自阿夫沙尔部落卡拉曼卢支系。1243年克塞山战役后该港脱离塞尔柱控制，1293年卡拉曼王公贝德尔丁·马哈茂德攻取此港，开创统治世系。

伊本·白图泰后来到访时，见约1330—1337年在位的优素福贝伊近乎独立地治理此城。基督徒的海上压力持续，耶路撒冷国王亨利二世1291年、塞浦路斯国王皮埃尔一世1366年的进攻均告失败。

1427年卡拉曼的易卜拉欣贝伊二世以五千金币把阿拉耶卖给马穆鲁克苏丹巴尔斯拜；1471年奥斯曼将领格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏从末代贝伊克勒奇·阿尔斯兰手中攻克该城，贝伊国亡。

en:
Armagh was above all an ecclesiastical city, built around the see Saint Patrick founded around 445 at Ard-Macha. Its bishop claimed Patrick's succession and primacy over the whole Irish church; the Book of Armagh preserved its traditions, and Viking raiders sacked the city many times.

The Synod of Kells in 1152 made Armagh a metropolitan archbishopric whose holder bore the title Primate of All Ireland, the archbishops ruling both a diocese and a compact temporal lordship around the city. In 1337 the archbishop was David Mageraghty, ruling until 1346 and followed by the theologian Richard FitzRalph.

At the Reformation the see split into Catholic and Church of Ireland successions; after the Williamite war Catholic primates were driven into exile or hiding under the penal laws, and only in the nineteenth century could a Catholic archbishop reside openly again.
zh:
阿马首先是教会之城，围绕圣帕特里克约445年在阿尔德马卡建立的主教座发展起来。其主教自称继承帕特里克之位，享全爱尔兰教会首席地位；《阿马书》保存教区古老传统，维京海盗则多次洗劫此城。

1152年凯尔斯宗教会议将阿马升格为都主教大主教区，其主教领有“全爱尔兰首席主教”头衔，大主教既治理教区，也领有城市周围一片世俗领地。1337年在任的是大卫·马杰拉蒂，任职至1346年，继任者是神学家理查德·菲茨拉尔夫。

宗教改革后天主教与爱尔兰国教各有一套主教传承；威廉战争之后，天主教首席主教在宗教迫害法律下被迫流亡或藏身，直到19世纪天主教大主教才能公开驻锡阿马。

en: Amberd was an Armenian fortress and noble holding on the slopes of Mount Aragats. Rebuilt by the Pahlavuni prince Vahram, it passed to Vache Vachutian in 1215 and was destroyed by the Mongols in 1236.
zh: 安贝尔特是阿拉加茨山山坡上的亚美尼亚堡垒和贵族领地。帕赫拉武尼家族的瓦赫拉姆亲王重建了堡垒；1215年它转入瓦切·瓦丘蒂安手中，1236年被蒙古人摧毁。

en:
Amdo, also called Domey, is the north-eastern of the three traditional Tibetan regions, from the upper Yellow River and Lake Qinghai to the Yangtze headwaters, bounded south by the Bayan Har Mountains; its people are the Amdowa. Before the Tibetan Empire, it held the Sumpa and Tuyuhun, both absorbed by Tibet in the seventh century.

After the empire's ninth-century collapse, Tibetan royal descendant Gusiluo built the Tsongkha theocracy, lasting from 997 to 1104. The thirteenth-century Mongol conquest opened the priest-and-patron bond between Tibetan lamas and Mongol khans, and from the fourteenth to the sixteenth centuries the Ming held only its eastern marches while Mongol tribes dominated the grasslands.

In 1642 Gushri Khan's Khoshut Mongols occupied the Kokonor pastures, and after the Qing campaign of 1723 the Yongzheng emperor separated Amdo from central Tibet and placed it under the Qinghai amban at Xining, ruling through Tibetan chiefs and monasteries. Amdo was the birthplace of Je Tsongkhapa, reformer of the Gelug order.
zh:
安多又称朵麦，是藏族传统三大区域中位于东北方的一个，范围从黄河上游与青海湖延伸到长江源头，南以巴颜喀拉山为界，居民称安多人。吐蕃之前，这里有苏毗和吐谷浑，二者都在7世纪被吐蕃吞并。

吐蕃帝国9世纪崩溃后，吐蕃王室后裔唃厮啰建立宗喀国，统治997年至1104年。13世纪蒙古征服此地，开启藏族喇嘛与蒙古汗王之间的供施关系；14至16世纪，明朝只控制安多的东部边缘，蒙古部落称雄草原。

1642年固始汗率和硕特蒙古占据青海湖牧场，1723年清朝用兵后，雍正帝将安多从西藏地方划出，交由驻西宁的青海办事大臣管辖，通过藏族首领和寺院统治。安多也是格鲁派改革者宗喀巴的诞生地。

en:
Ameca, whose Nahuatl name Amecatl means string of water, was a small Nahua kingdom in the Valles region of western Jalisco, watered by the river still bearing its name.

In 1522 the soldier Juan de Anesta entered the town alone and barefoot, sword in hand, and its people, recalling a prophecy of strangers who would come to rule, received him as a son of the sun; the kingdom came under Spanish control in 1524.

From 1529 Fray Antonio de Cuellar built an adobe chapel and laid out the central square, but was killed by arrow wounds in the Etzatlan mountains during the Mixton War rising of 1541, when Ameca's warriors fought beside those of Tequila and Ahualulco. The town became a Spanish municipal seat in 1549, passed to the Cocula department in 1824, and was declared a city in 1833.
zh:
阿梅卡的纳瓦特尔语原名阿梅卡特，意为“水绳”，是哈利斯科西部巴列斯地区的小型纳瓦王国，同名的阿梅卡河穿境而过。

1522年士兵胡安·德·阿内斯塔赤脚孤身、手持长剑走进城中；当地人想起一则预言，说将有外来者前来统治，便把他当作太阳之子迎接，1524年这个小王国落入西班牙人控制。

1529年起修士安东尼奥·德·奎利亚尔建起土坯礼拜堂并规划中央广场；1541年米斯特顿战争爆发，阿梅卡战士与特基拉、阿瓦卢尔科的义军并肩作战，奎利亚尔同年在埃察特兰山中中箭身亡。1549年城镇成为西班牙人治下的市政驻地，1824年划入科库拉行政区，1833年升格为城市。

en:
The County of Armagnac lay between the Adour and Garonne below the Pyrenees, with its chief town at Auch. Split from the County of Fezensac in 960 under Count Bernard le Louche, by the 1229 Treaty of Meaux it was Gascony's strongest fief.

In 1337 the count was John I, who succeeded in 1319 and began the family's fourteenth-century expansion, adding Rodez, Carlat and other lands by marriage and purchase. The 1360 Treaty of Brétigny handed the region to England, but the Black Prince's harsh rule drove John to seek Charles V's protection in 1369.

Under Count Bernard VII the family led the Armagnac party against Burgundy in civil wars lasting until 1435. Jacques d'Armagnac was attainted in 1477 and his lands seized by Louis XI; the county reverted to the crown in 1751.
zh:
阿马尼亚克伯国位于比利牛斯山北麓阿杜尔河与加龙河之间，主城欧什。960年它在贝尔纳·勒卢什治下从更古老的费藏萨克伯国分出，到1229年《莫城条约》签订时已是加斯科涅最强大的封地。

1337年在位的让一世1319年继位，开启家族在14世纪的扩张，通过联姻和购地取得罗代兹、卡拉等领地。1360年《布勒丁尼条约》把这一地区割给英格兰，但黑太子的苛政迫使让于1369年向查理五世寻求庇护。

贝尔纳七世伯爵时期，家族在延续至1435年的内战中率领阿马尼亚克派对抗勃艮第。雅克·德·阿马尼亚克1477年被判叛国，领地被路易十一没收；伯国最终于1751年收归王室。

en:
Ardmire was the chiefry of the Ó Dochartaigh clan in the Laggan district around Raphoe in eastern Donegal, within the Gaelic kingdom of Tyrconnell. The O'Dohertys, named from the tenth-century Dochartach, were a leading sept of the Cenél Conaill and kinsmen of the O'Donnells.

Their seat at Raphoe was an old monastic place founded by Saint Columba around 550, though John de Courcy's Normans sacked its church in 1198. In the fourteenth century the clan held these Laggan lands as vassals of the O'Donnells, and after 1359 began moving north under Conor-an-Einigh O Dochartaigh, the first of the line to settle in Inishowen, where the O'Dohertys became lords early in the fifteenth century.

They kept it until 1608, when Cahir O'Doherty's rebellion ended with his death at Kilmacrennan and the confiscation of all the clan's lands for the Ulster plantation.
zh:
阿德迈尔是奥多尔蒂氏族在多尼戈尔东部拉福周围拉根地区的酋长领地，地处盖尔人的泰尔康奈尔王国境内。奥多尔蒂氏得名于10世纪的多哈尔塔赫，是康纳尔部族的重要支系，与奥唐纳家族同宗。

驻地拉福是古老修道院重地，约550年由圣科伦巴建立，其教堂1198年遭约翰·德库西率领的诺曼人洗劫。14世纪该氏族作为奥唐纳家族附庸领有拉根故土，1359年后才在科纳尔·安埃尼·奥多尔蒂带领下开始北迁，他是第一个定居因尼肖温的族人，奥多尔蒂氏15世纪初成为此地领主。

他们保有此地直到1608年：卡希尔·奥多尔蒂爵士发动起义，最终在基尔麦克雷南战役中阵亡，氏族全部土地被没收，用于阿尔斯特种植园。

en:
Amollan, called Amole in the Spanish accounts, was the leading state of the Amula country in the highlands of southern Jalisco. Two smaller states, Copalla and Teotitlan, depended on it, while Cozolapa and Tuxcacuexco bordered it. Its people spoke Amultecan and other languages of the western Otomi group, distinct from the Otomi of central Mexico. Early in the sixteenth century Amollan and its neighbours fought off attempts by the Purépecha to overrun the region.

Spanish forces took the area in 1523, and by the early 1530s its towns had been grouped into the colonial province of Amula; Franciscan friars arrived in the 1540s, although a permanent parish organization was not set up until 1579.
zh:
阿莫兰在西班牙文献中称阿莫尔，是哈利斯科南部阿穆拉高地最主要的政权。科帕亚和特奥蒂特兰两个小邦附属于它，邻邦则有科索拉帕和图斯卡库埃斯科。居民使用阿莫尔特卡语等西奥托米语支语言，与墨西哥中部的奥托米语不同。16世纪初，阿莫兰与邻邦联手击退普雷佩查人的多次入侵。

1523年西班牙军队夺取该地区，到16世纪30年代初，这些村镇被编入殖民时期的阿穆拉省；方济各会修士在40年代已经到来，固定的教区组织却迟至1579年才建立。

en: Camana refers to the coastal valley of Camaná in southern Peru, a region possibly conquered by the Inca ruler Pachacuti. Spaniards founded Villa Hermosa in the valley in 1539, before moving the settlement to Arequipa in 1540.
zh: 卡马纳指秘鲁南部沿海的卡马纳河谷，印加统治者帕查库特克可能曾征服这一地区。西班牙人于1539年在河谷建立埃尔莫萨镇，1540年将定居点迁往阿雷基帕。

en:
Amapila represents the small mountain polity of the Tlacalahuastla district, a Nahuatl name meaning the place where blowguns abound, in the rugged highlands on the border of Colima and Michoacán, around modern Minatitlán. Its scattered villages were inhabited by Otomí-speaking and Nahua groups who kept to the sierras rather than the coastal plains.

After the Spanish conquest the district was granted in 1551 to the soldier Francisco de Santos as an encomienda; harsh labour demands drove its people to take refuge in the Telcruz and Tocxin mountains, and the neighbouring Coalcomán range remained a centre of indigenous revolt through the early colonial years.
zh:
阿马皮拉对应特拉卡拉瓦斯特拉地区的山地小邦，这个纳瓦特尔语地名意为“盛产吹箭筒之地”，位于科利马与米却肯交界的崎岖高地，即今米纳蒂特兰一带。散布的村落由说奥托米语的族群和纳瓦人居住，他们固守山区而不下到沿海平原。

西班牙征服后，该地区于1551年被作为监护征赋地封给士兵弗朗西斯科·德·桑托斯；沉重的劳役迫使居民逃入特尔克鲁斯山和托克辛山，邻近的科阿尔科曼山区在殖民早期也一直是土著起事的中心。

en:
The Al Mira were the leading Bedouin tribe of the Hauran in southern Syria, grazing from Golan through the Harra towards Arabia. With the Al Fadl they formed the two main branches of the Banu Rabi'ah; their forefather Mira was a son of the emir Rabi'ah, who led tribal cavalry for Damascus.

After the Mamluk conquest of 1260 they became known as the muluk al-arab, kings of the Bedouin of the south, Baybars leaving them largely independent of the Al Fadl amir over the tribes of northern Syria. From Irbid they policed desert roads, supplied horses and guarded Hajj caravans.

Around 1389 their emir Anqa joined rebel Mintash against Sultan Barquq and was killed soon after; after Tamerlane's 1400–1401 invasion Mamluk troops crushed their rising at Suwayda. After the Ottoman conquest of 1516 they were eclipsed in the Hauran by the Mafarija and Sardiyya.
zh:
米拉人是叙利亚南部豪兰的首要贝都因部落，牧场从戈兰经哈拉伸向阿拉伯。与法德勒人同为巴努·拉比阿的两大支系，始祖米拉是埃米尔拉比阿之子，拉比阿曾率部落骑兵为大马士革效力。

1260年马穆鲁克征服后，米拉人称南方贝都因之王，拜巴尔斯让他们几乎不受统领北叙利亚诸部的法德勒系埃米尔节制。以伊尔比德为据点，他们维持沙漠道路治安、供应马匹、护卫朝觐商队。

约1389年埃米尔安卡加入叛将蒙塔什一方反对苏丹巴尔库克，不久被杀；帖木儿1400—1401年入侵后，马穆鲁克军队在苏韦达镇压其起事。1516年奥斯曼征服后，米拉人在豪兰被马法里贾和萨尔迪耶取代。

en: Amacoztitlan was one of the small Nahua altepetl of the Tlalnahuac, the cotton-growing Amatzinac basin of eastern Morelos, whose Tlahuica people had settled there in the early fourteenth century. Like the rest of the Tlalnahuac it entered the Aztec tribute system under Moctezuma I around 1440, and Sandoval's army overran the district in March 1521.
zh: 阿玛科兹蒂特兰是特拉尔纳瓦克的一个纳瓦人小邦，地处莫雷洛斯东部阿马齐纳克河流域的产棉之地，居民属于14世纪初就定居于此的纳瓦支系特拉维卡人。与特拉尔纳瓦克的其他城镇一样，它在1440年前后被蒙特祖马一世纳入阿兹特克贡赋体系，1521年3月又被桑多瓦尔的军队攻占。

en:
The County of Arnsberg was a Sauerland lordship between the Ruhr and the Möhne, created in the eleventh century when the counts of Werl moved their seat to a castle above Arnsberg. The town grew up beneath it, while a junior branch received the County of Rietberg, ceded in 1237.
