Hemmed in by expanding Cologne and the County of Mark, the counts could not enlarge their lands and consolidated them internally, keeping one of Westphalia's earliest feudal registers. When the last count, Gottfried IV, remained childless, he sold the county to the archbishopric in 1368.

Arnsberg became the centre of the Cologne Duchy of Westphalia; in 1437 it also took the Vehmic court moved from Dortmund, and after the Napoleonic upheaval it was assigned to Prussia in 1815 as an administrative centre of Westphalia.
zh:
阿恩斯贝格伯国是鲁尔河与默讷河之间绍尔兰山区的领地，11世纪由韦尔伯爵家族建立，他们把治所迁到阿恩斯贝格上方的新城堡，城镇便在城堡脚下兴起。家族旁支受封里特贝格伯国，该伯国于1237年被割让。

由于被扩张中的科隆大主教区和马克伯国夹在中间，伯爵们无力向外扩张，转而对内整合领地，保有威斯特伐利亚最早的封建登记册之一。末代伯爵戈特弗里德四世无嗣，于1368年把伯国出售给科隆大主教区。

阿恩斯贝格从此成为科隆属下威斯特伐利亚公国的中心，1437年又成为从多特蒙德迁来的菲姆法庭所在地；拿破仑时代的动荡之后，它于1815年划归普鲁士，成为威斯特伐利亚省的行政中心。

en:
Ancona was founded around 387 BC by Greek settlers from Syracuse, named after the elbow-shaped promontory guarding its harbour. Under Rome it was the Adriatic naval station nearest Dalmatia; Caesar seized it after crossing the Rubicon, and Trajan enlarged the port, whose Arch of Trajan was raised in 115. After Saracen raiders burned the city in 840, it became capital of the March of Ancona.

From the eleventh century it was a free maritime republic, minting the agontano coin and trading with Ragusa and Byzantium against Venetian competition; it beat off imperial assaults and never became a signoria, save when the Malatesta exploited the Black Death to seize it in 1348.

They were expelled in 1383. In 1532 Pope Clement VII ended its freedom and built the Citadel, Ancona remaining a Papal fortress where French troops landed in 1832.
zh:
安科纳约在公元前387年由叙拉古的希腊移民建立，因护卫海港的肘形海角得名。罗马时代它是亚得里亚海距达尔马提亚最近的海军基地；恺撒渡过卢比孔河后占据此城，图拉真扩建港口，图拉真凯旋门于115年立起。840年撒拉森人焚毁城市后，它成为安科纳边区首府。

11世纪起它成为自由海洋共和国，自铸阿贡塔诺钱币，为抗衡威尼斯与拉古萨和拜占庭通商，多次击退神圣罗马帝国进攻。它从未沦为个人独裁，只有马拉泰斯塔家族趁黑死病之乱于1348年夺城。

马拉泰斯塔家族1383年被逐走。1532年教皇克雷芒七世终结其自由并修建要塞，安科纳从此成为教皇国要塞，1832年法军在此登陆。

en:
Angoulême County, or Angoumois, centred on Angoulême, Roman Iculisma, taken from Visigoths by Clovis in 508. Vikings sacked it in 848. Count William I took the nickname Taillefer after defeating a later Norse band; his line bore it until heiress Isabella married John of England and then Hugh X of Lusignan in 1220.

The Lusignan line dying out in 1302, it reverted to the crown, later granted to Philip of Évreux, the future Philip III of Navarre, and his wife Joan II; in 1337 they held it as an appanage. The 1360 Treaty of Brétigny ceded it to England, until Charles V's troops retook it in 1373.

In 1394 it passed to Louis of Orléans, whose grandson Francis inherited the French throne in 1515 as Francis I, making Angoumois a royal duchy. Calvin sheltered there in 1533 while drafting his Institutes, and in 1548 the countryside rose in the Pitauds revolt against the salt tax.
zh:
昂古莱姆伯国即昂古穆瓦，以同名城为中心，城前身是罗马的伊库利斯马，508年克洛维从西哥特人手中夺得。848年维京人洗劫此城，纪尧姆一世后来击败诺斯人，得“铁裁”绰号；女继承人伊莎贝尔先嫁英格兰的约翰，1220年改嫁吕西尼昂于格十世。

1302年吕西尼昂家族绝嗣，伯国归王室，后封给埃夫勒的腓力及其妻让娜二世，腓力即后来的纳瓦拉国王腓力三世；1337年他们以封禄领有此地。1360年《布勒丁尼条约》将昂古穆瓦割让英格兰，1373年查理五世军队逐走英军。

1394年伯国转归奥尔良的路易，其孙弗朗索瓦1515年登法兰西王位，即弗朗索瓦一世，昂古穆瓦成为王室公爵领。1533年加尔文在此避难、起草《基督教要义》，1548年爆发反盐税皮托起义。

en:
Anhalt was the Ascanian dynasty's homeland, whose ancestors, the counts of Ballenstedt, held lands in Eastphalia from the eleventh century. Count Otto the Rich built Anhalt Castle; his son Albert the Bear founded the Margraviate of Brandenburg in 1157. After Henry the Lion's Saxon duchy broke up, Bernhard of Ascania's son Henry I secured Anhalt in 1212 and became an imperial prince in 1218.

His sons partitioned it in 1252 into the Aschersleben, Bernburg and Zerbst lines; Aschersleben died out in 1315 and its lands passed to Halberstadt. In 1337 the Zerbst line under Albert II survived; the Bernburg line died out in 1468 and its lands fell to Zerbst.

Anhalt embraced the Reformation early: Wolfgang of Köthen was among the first rulers to introduce Protestantism and signed the Augsburg Confession in 1530. On the empire's dissolution in 1806 Napoleon raised the surviving Anhalt-Bernburg, Anhalt-Dessau and Anhalt-Köthen to sovereign duchies.
zh:
安哈尔特是阿斯坎尼家族故土，先祖巴伦施泰特伯爵11世纪起领有东法伦。富人奥托伯爵建安哈尔特城堡，其子大熊阿尔贝1157年创勃兰登堡藩侯国。狮子亨利的萨克森公国瓜分后，阿斯坎尼的伯恩哈德之子亨利一世1212年获得安哈尔特，1218年受封帝国诸侯。

诸子1252年把亲王国分为阿舍斯莱本、贝恩堡、采尔布斯特三支；阿舍斯莱本支1315年绝嗣，地归哈尔伯施塔特。1337年阿尔贝二世的采尔布斯特支尚存；贝恩堡本支1468年绝嗣，领地入采尔布斯特。

安哈尔特很早接受宗教改革，克滕的沃尔夫冈是最早推行新教的统治者之一，1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》。1806年帝国解体，拿破仑将尚存的安哈尔特-贝恩堡、安哈尔特-德绍和安哈尔特-克滕升为主权公国。

en: The Aruni were a people of the Arequipa region in the southern Peruvian Andes, whose valley settlements lay around the Cotahuasi river country together with the Alca and Kutawasi peoples. After the Inca conquests of the fifteenth century their lands were absorbed into the Inca huamani, or province, of Contisuyo.
zh: 阿鲁尼人是秘鲁南部安第斯山区阿雷基帕一带的族群，与阿尔卡人、科塔瓦西人相邻而居，分布在科塔瓦西河谷地带。15世纪印加征服后，他们的土地被并入印加的孔蒂苏尤行省。

en:
Anjou, ruled from Angers, was the homeland of the Gallic Andes, later a Roman civitas and Frankish county. Its first line came from Viscount Ingelger and counts Fulk, who expanded it in the tenth and eleventh centuries. Geoffrey the Handsome married his son Henry to Eleanor of Aquitaine; Henry inherited the English crown in 1154 as Henry II.

Philip Augustus retook Anjou from John Lackland in 1202–1204, confirmed by the defeat of the English and imperial allies at La Roche-aux-Moines in 1214. Louis IX granted it to his brother Charles in 1246; it returned to the crown with Philip VI in 1328. In 1337 the king's son John, future John II, held it.

John made his son Louis duke in 1360, founding the Valois-Anjou line, heir to Provence and a Naples claim in 1382, ending with Good King René's death in 1480; Louis XI absorbed the duchy into the royal domain in 1482.
zh:
安茹以昂热为中心，原为高卢安德斯人居地，后成罗马城邦、法兰克伯国。首个伯爵家族出自子爵安热尔热，富尔克诸伯爵10—11世纪扩张。美男子若弗鲁瓦为其子亨利娶阿基坦的埃莉诺，亨利1154年登英格兰王位，称亨利二世。

1202—1204年腓力·奥古斯都从无地王约翰手中夺回安茹，1214年英军与皇帝联军在拉罗什欧穆瓦讷战败确认此失。1246年路易九世以安茹赐弟查理，1328年随腓力六世归王室。1337年安茹归国王之子约翰（后为约翰二世）。

1360年约翰封其子路易为安茹公爵，开创瓦卢瓦-安茹支系；1382年继承普罗旺斯与那不勒斯王位主张，末代贤王勒内1480年卒，路易十一1482年吞并安茹。

en:
The Antankarana kingdom arose at the northern tip of Madagascar among communities led by a branch of the Sakalava royal line. Andriantsirotso, who ruled from 1692 to 1710, united people around the limestone rocks of Ankarana and declared his sovereignty over the north.

Sakalava armies attacked the kingdom, whose people sheltered among Ankarana's rocks and caves. Antankarana later paid tribute to Boina and again used the caves as refuge during nineteenth-century conflict with Imerina.
zh:
安坦卡拉纳王国兴起于马达加斯加北端，其居民由萨卡拉瓦王室的一个分支领导。1692年至1710年在位的安德里安齐鲁楚联合了安卡拉纳石灰岩地区的居民，宣布统治北方。

萨卡拉瓦军队进攻王国时，居民躲入安卡拉纳的岩石和洞穴。安坦卡拉纳后来向博伊纳纳贡，19世纪与伊梅里纳交战时再次以洞穴为避难所。

en: Anilco was an Indigenous province encountered by Hernando de Soto's expedition in what is now Arkansas. The Menard–Hodges site, with its large platform mounds, has been proposed as a possible location.
zh: 阿尼尔科是埃尔南多·德索托的探险队在今阿肯色州遇到的原住民地区。拥有大型台形土丘的梅纳德—霍奇斯遗址被认为可能是它的所在地。

en:
The Asonuma were a warrior family whose Tōno branch held lands in Mutsu Province. Asonuma Hirotsuna gained the stewardship of Tōno after the Ōshū campaign of 1189, and his descendants ruled from Yokota Castle. In 1334 Kitabatake Akiie confirmed Asonuma Tomotsuna's possession of Tōno.

The family came under Nanbu authority after failing to join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590. In 1600, while Asonuma Hironaga was away on campaign, relatives seized his castle; he failed to recover Tōno and died in exile in Date territory.
zh:
阿曾沼氏是武家，其远野一支领有陆奥国的土地。阿曾沼广纲在1189年奥州合战后获得远野的地头职，后代以横田城为统治中心。1334年北畠显家确认阿曾沼朝纲对远野的领有。

1590年阿曾沼氏未参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，此后归于南部氏麾下。1600年阿曾沼广长出征在外时，族人夺取了他的居城；他未能收复远野，最终客死于伊达领内。

en:
Annaly was a Gaelic Irish lordship in the midlands, covering roughly the later County Longford around its chief seat at Longford. It was named for Angaile, a king of the Fortuatha who conquered the district in the tenth century; his great-grandson Fearghail became the ancestor of the O Fearghail, or O Farrell, family, which supplied the princes of Annaly for centuries.

In 1337 the lordship remained in O Farrell hands, but the coming of Tudor rule broke its independence. From 1552 onward the crown granted large tracts of Annaly to the Nugent barons of Delvin, including Granard and the northern districts in 1556 and 1557.

The territory was shired as County Longford, and further patents under James I between 1605 and 1612 handed over castles, monasteries and market rights, ending the O Farrell principality.
zh:
安纳利是爱尔兰中部的盖尔人领地，范围大致相当于后来的朗福德郡，以朗福德为统治中心。它得名于10世纪征服这一地区的福尔图阿萨国王安盖尔；安盖尔的曾孙费尔盖尔是奥法雷尔家族的始祖，该家族世代出任安纳利酋长。

1337年时这块领地仍在奥法雷尔家族手中，但都铎王朝的到来终结了它的独立。从1552年起，英格兰王室把安纳利的大片土地封给纽金特家族的德尔文男爵，1556至1557年又封出格拉纳德和北部地区。

这片领土随后被划为朗福德郡；1605至1612年间詹姆斯一世再颁特许状，把城堡、修道院和集市经营权一并交出，奥法雷尔酋长国就此告终。

en:
Andorra is a small Pyrenean valley polity that began as part of the Frankish Spanish March and was held by the counts of Urgell until 988, when it passed to the Bishops of Urgell. In 1095 the bishop shared rights with the Lord of Caboet, whose claim passed by marriage to the Counts of Foix.

A dispute was settled in 1278 by the first paréage, which divided sovereignty between the Count of Foix and the Bishop of Urgell. The Andorrans gained representation in 1419 with the Consell de la Terra.

The Foix title descended through the kings of Navarre, and in 1607 an edict of Henry, King of Navarre and France, fixed the French head of state and the Bishop of Urgell as co-lords. Absorbed into the French Empire in 1812 and 1813, Andorra had independence restored by imperial decree in 1814.
zh:
安道尔是比利牛斯山中的山谷小国，最初是法兰克西班牙边区的一部分，由乌赫利伯爵统治，988年转归乌赫利主教。1095年主教与卡博埃特领主分享统治权，后者的权利经联姻转入富瓦伯爵手中。

一场争端于1278年以第一份《共治契约》解决，主权由富瓦伯爵与乌赫利主教分掌。1419年安道尔人设立代表机构陆地会议。

富瓦一方的头衔经纳瓦拉国王传承，1607年身兼纳瓦拉与法国国王的亨利颁布敕令，确定法国国家元首与乌赫利主教为共治君主。1812至1813年安道尔曾被并入法兰西帝国，1814年帝国敕令恢复其独立。

en:
Ansbach grew up on the Franconian Rezat around a Benedictine abbey founded by Saint Gumbertus in the eighth century and first appears as a town in 1221. The surrounding lands belonged to the Burgraviate of Nuremberg, held since 1192 by the House of Hohenzollern, who took Ansbach from the counts of Oettingen in 1331 as their seat.

In 1337 the burgrave was John II, called the Acquirer. In 1398 the burgraviate was partitioned: Frederick VI kept the Ansbach lands and in 1415 became Elector of Brandenburg, raising the Hohenzollerns to the rank of prince-electors.

After 1440 a younger branch ruled Ansbach as margraves of Brandenburg-Ansbach; Margrave George the Pious introduced the Reformation in 1528, and Gumbertus Abbey was dissolved in 1563. The last margrave sold the principality to Prussia in 1791, and under Napoleonic pressure Prussia ceded it to Bavaria in 1806.
zh:
安斯巴赫位于法兰克尼亚雷扎特河畔，围绕8世纪圣贡贝尔图斯建立的本笃会修道院发展，1221年首见城市记载。周边土地属于纽伦堡城堡伯领，1192年起由霍亨索伦家族执掌；1331年该家族从厄廷根伯爵手中取得安斯巴赫本城，并以之为驻地。

1337年在位的城堡伯爵是人称“获得者”的约翰二世。1398年城堡伯领一分为二：腓特烈六世分得安斯巴赫，又于1415年成为勃兰登堡选帝侯，霍亨索伦家族由此跻身选侯之列。

1440年后，家族幼系以勃兰登堡-安斯巴赫藩侯的身份统治此地；“虔诚者”格奥尔格于1528年引入宗教改革，1563年贡贝尔图斯修道院被解散。末代藩侯于1791年把领地卖给普鲁士，1806年在拿破仑的压力下普鲁士又将它割让给巴伐利亚。

en:
Arianiti was the lordship of an Albanian noble house whose lands straddled the Shkumbin valley and the old Via Egnatia linking the Adriatic to the interior, with Sopot as one of its strongholds. The family's wealth came from guarding and taxing the grain and salt convoys on that road.

An Alexius Arianiti appears in 1274 among the Albanian nobles swearing allegiance to Charles I of Anjou's Kingdom of Albania, and Angevin charters of 1304 and a papal letter of 1319 again name the house, marking it as a leading Catholic family of central Albania under Angevin protection.

After the Ottoman conquests cost the family its eastern estates, Gjergj Arianiti from 1430 won repeated victories over Ottoman armies, joined the League of Lezhë in 1444, and in 1451 gave his daughter Donika to Skanderbeg. Later many Arianiti converted to Islam and took office under the sultans, while others settled in Italy.
zh:
阿里亚尼蒂是一个阿尔巴尼亚贵族家族的领地，其地横跨什昆宾河谷与连接亚得里亚海和内陆的古道埃格纳提亚大道，索波特是其据点之一。家族的财富来自把守这条大道、向粮食和食盐商队征税。

1274年，一位名叫亚历克修斯·阿里亚尼蒂的成员已出现在向安茹的查理一世所建阿尔巴尼亚王国宣誓效忠的贵族名单中；1304年的安茹文书和1319年的教皇书信又提到这个家族，可见它是安茹庇护下阿尔巴尼亚中部的主要天主教家族之一。

奥斯曼征服夺去家族的东部领地后，乔治·阿里亚尼蒂自1430年起连挫奥斯曼军队，1444年加入莱什联盟，1451年又将女儿多妮卡嫁给斯坎德培。后来许多阿里亚尼蒂家族成员改宗伊斯兰教、出仕苏丹，也有人迁居意大利。

en:
The Ainu lived in communities across Hokkaido, Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands, trading with their neighbors as Japanese settlement spread in southern Hokkaido. In 1457 Koshamain led Ainu attacks on Japanese forts on the Oshima Peninsula, but Takeda Nobuhiro's forces defeated them.

The Tokugawa shogunate granted the Matsumae clan exclusive trade with the Ainu in 1604. Discontent with Japanese control helped provoke Shakushain's revolt in 1669, and in 1789 Ainu on Kunashir and in Menashi attacked Japanese traders and workers; the Japanese executed 37 Ainu after the uprising.
zh:
阿伊努人生活在北海道、萨哈林和千岛群岛的各个社群中，与邻人贸易，而日本人的聚落逐渐扩展到北海道南部。1457年，胡奢麻尹率领阿伊努人进攻渡岛半岛上的日本人据点，但被武田信广的军队击败。

1604年，德川幕府授予松前氏与阿伊努人贸易的独占权。对日本人控制的不满促成了1669年沙牟奢允起事；1789年，国后和目梨的阿伊努人袭击日本商人和工人，起事后日本人处死了37名阿伊努人。

en:
The Anizah were one of the oldest Arab tribal groupings, counted by classical genealogists among the Rabi'a branch of the Adnanites. Even before Islam they had split into nomadic clans on the steppes toward Syria and Mesopotamia and settled clans in the wadis of Al-Yamama, and four thousand armored warriors fought for Caliph Ali at the Battle of Siffin in 657.

In the late tenth century they established themselves in the oases of Khaybar in the Hejaz, and the thirteenth-century geographer Ibn Sa'id found them the last Rabi'a tribe still fully living the Bedouin life between Khaybar and the Syrian desert.

The fourteenth-century chronicler al-Umari counts them among allies of the Al Fadl princes, and under Ottoman rule their camps dominated the oases of Khaybar and Al-Ula and the steppes beyond, levying brotherhood tribute, or khuwwa, on the settled villages.
zh:
阿尼扎是最古老的阿拉伯部落群之一，古典系谱学家把它归入阿德南人的拉比阿支。早在伊斯兰教兴起之前，它就分为两支：游牧氏族漫游在通往叙利亚和美索不达米亚的草原上，定居氏族居住在叶麻麦的干谷中；657年，阿尼扎的四千名甲士曾在隋芬战役中为哈里发阿里作战。

10世纪末，他们在汉志的海拜尔绿洲立足；13世纪地理学家伊本·赛义德发现，阿尼扎是拉比阿诸部中最后一个仍在海拜尔与叙利亚沙漠之间完整保持贝都因生活的部落。

14世纪编年史家欧麦里把他们列为法德勒王公的盟友；到奥斯曼时代，他们的营地控制了海拜尔、欧拉等绿洲及更远处的草原，向定居村庄征收名为胡瓦的兄弟贡。

en:
The Duchy of Aosta was the Alpine valley state of the House of Savoy, guarding the St Bernard passes between Burgundy and Italy. In the tenth century the valley was ruled by its bishops, but on Bishop Anselm's death in 1026 Emperor Conrad II transferred its secular powers to his ally Humbert the White-handed, the founder of Savoyard power.

Once part of the kingdom of Burgundy, the county was raised to a duchy by Frederick Barbarossa and stayed among the oldest Savoyard possessions. In 1337 Count Haimo of Savoy, called the Peaceful, held it with Savoy and Piedmont.

Duke Emmanuel Philibert made French the language of administration in 1561; the duchy kept its own institutions and taxation until their alignment with Piedmont in the later eighteenth century, and Napoleonic troops ended its separate existence in 1798.
zh:
奥斯塔公国是萨伏依家族在阿尔卑斯山区的河谷邦国，扼守连接勃艮第与意大利的圣贝尔纳山口。10世纪时河谷由本地主教统治；1026年主教安塞尔姆去世后，皇帝康拉德二世把世俗权力转交给盟友白手亨伯特，即萨伏依势力的奠基人。

该地原属勃艮第王国，伯国后来被腓特烈·巴巴罗萨升格为公国，是萨伏依最古老的领地之一。1337年，和平者萨伏依伯爵海莫同时领有此地与萨伏依、皮埃蒙特。

1561年，埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托公爵定法语为行政语言；公国保留自身的机构和税制，直到18世纪后期才与皮埃蒙特接轨，1798年拿破仑军队终结了它的独立存在。

en: The Apalachee lived in farming chiefdoms between the Aucilla and Ochlockonee rivers in northern Florida. Their capital was Anhaica when Hernando de Soto occupied it in 1539. Spanish missions later spread through Apalachee territory. In 1704 English colonists and Muscogee allies destroyed the mission network, and the Apalachee fled, were captured or moved to other settlements.
zh: 阿巴拉契人在佛罗里达北部的奥西拉河与奥克洛科尼河之间建立了农耕酋邦。1539年埃尔南多·德·索托占领阿奈卡时，那里是他们的中心。此后西班牙传教站遍布阿巴拉契人的领地。1704年，英国殖民者与马斯科吉盟友摧毁了传教站网络，阿巴拉契人逃亡、遭到俘虏或迁往其他聚落。

en:
The Apardi were a Turco-Mongol tribal tumen of the mid-fourteenth-century Chagatai ulus, whose pasturelands lay along the upper Murghab and the desert edge south of the Amu Darya, around Andkhoy and Sheberghan. Their amir Muhammad Khoja governed Sheberghan from at least 1351 and joined Qazaghan's expedition against Herat.

Around 1360 he was killed while charging the army of the Kart malik of Herat. In the 1359 partition of the Chagatai Khanate the Apardi seized parts of Khuttalan, and amir Oljeitu Apardi led the vanguard of Amir Husayn and Timur at the Battle of the Mire in 1365 before submitting to Timur in 1369.

His kinsman Zinda Hasham held Sheberghan's white fortress and twice rebelled until his death around 1371, after which the Apardi were absorbed into Timur's tribal following, their amirs still holding commands and marrying into Timur's family.
zh:
阿帕儿迪是14世纪中叶察合台兀鲁思的一个突厥-蒙古部落万户，牧场位于穆尔加布河上游与阿姆河以南的沙漠边缘，以安德霍伊和舍巴尔甘为中心。其异密穆罕默德·火者至少从1351年起统治舍巴尔甘，曾随合扎罕远征赫拉特。

约1360年，他在冲锋陷阵时被赫拉特卡尔特马利克的军队杀害。1359年察合台汗国的瓜分中，阿帕儿迪人夺取了忽都的部分土地；异密完者都·阿帕儿迪在1365年的泥沼之战中统领异密忽辛与帖木儿的前锋，1369年归附帖木儿。

他的族人欣都·哈沙姆据守舍巴尔甘的白色城堡两度反叛，约1371年败亡，阿帕儿迪部随后被并入帖木儿的部落阵营，其异密仍出任军职并与帖木儿家族通婚。

en:
Prüm was the territory of Prüm Abbey, a Benedictine imperial abbey in the Eifel whose abbot ranked as a prince of the Empire. Founded in 721 by the Frankish widow Bertrada and her son Charibert, the abbey was favoured by the Carolingians, and Pepin the Short enriched it in 762.

Its estates grew into an immediate principality. Abbot Regino, who died in 915, was a famed historian and canonist, and the abbey guarded the relic of the Sandals of Christ. Sacked by the Normans in 882, Prüm declined in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, its protection falling to the lords of Schönecken, advocati from the counts of Vianden.

The archbishops of Trier became its perpetual administrators in 1576. French troops occupied it in 1794, and in 1801 the abbey was secularized and its estates sold; the lands passed to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
普吕姆是普吕姆修道院的领地：这座位于艾费尔山区的本笃会帝国修道院，院长位列神圣罗马帝国诸侯。修道院由法兰克寡妇贝尔特拉达与其子卡里贝尔特于721年创立，是加洛林王朝宠爱的修道院，矮子丕平曾于762年大加赏赐。

修道院的地产发展成帝国直辖领地。915年去世的院长雷吉诺是著名史学家与教会法学家，院中还珍藏着基督凉鞋圣物。882年修道院遭诺曼人劫掠，13至14世纪日渐衰落，世俗护法官之职落入源自菲安登伯爵的舍内肯领主之手。

特里尔大主教于1576年成为修道院的永久管理者。1794年法军占领普吕姆，1801年修道院被世俗化、地产变卖，1815年这片土地转入普鲁士。

en:
The Duchy of Aquitaine, ruled from Bordeaux, was the great fief of south-west France, stretching in its heyday from the Loire to the Pyrenees. It grew from the Roman province of Gallia Aquitania, which fell to the Franks after Vouillé in 507. Under Odo the Great it defeated the Moors at Toulouse in 721.

Reconstituted after Verdun in 843, it became famous for troubadour dukes, from William IX in 1087. Its heiress Eleanor married Louis VII and then, in 1152, Henry Plantagenet, later Henry II, carrying it into the Angevin Empire. Thirteenth-century French reconquests reduced it to Gascony and Guyenne, defined by the Treaty of Paris in 1259.

In 1337 Philip VI reclaimed it from Edward III, who responded by claiming the French crown, opening the Hundred Years' War. The 1360 Treaty of Brétigny gave Edward sovereignty over Aquitaine ruled by the Black Prince, but France soon reconquered most of it. Victory at Castillon in 1453 ended English rule, and Aquitaine was absorbed into the royal domain.
zh:
阿基坦公国以波尔多为统治中心，是法兰西西南部的大封建领地，鼎盛时疆域从卢瓦尔河延伸到比利牛斯山。它源自罗马的阿基坦高卢行省，507年法兰克人在武耶之战后将其夺取。伟大的奥多治下，721年在图卢兹击败摩尔人。

843年《凡尔登条约》后重新组建，以游吟诗人公爵闻名，自1087年纪尧姆九世始。女继承人埃莉诺嫁给路易七世，1152年又改嫁金雀花的亨利，即后来的亨利二世，由此并入安茹帝国。13世纪的收复行动把它压缩为加斯科涅和吉耶讷，1259年《巴黎条约》划定新界。

1337年，腓力六世向爱德华三世收回阿基坦，爱德华遂主张法兰西王位，百年战争爆发。1360年《布勒丁尼条约》使爱德华对阿基坦拥有主权，由黑太子统治，但法军很快收复大部分土地。1453年法军在卡斯蒂永获胜，英格兰统治终结，阿基坦并入王室领地。

en:
The Aq Qoyunlu were a Turkoman confederation led by the Bayandur clan, whose principality grew around Amid in eastern Anatolia. Timur rewarded its leader Qara Osman with the city in 1400, and it became the confederation's capital.

Uzun Hasan defeated the rival Qara Qoyunlu in 1467 and moved his capital to Tabriz after conquering much of Iran. The Ottoman sultan Mehmed II defeated him at Otlukbeli in 1473. Civil wars weakened his successors, and the Safavid Ismail I defeated the Aq Qoyunlu in 1501, taking their remaining territories over the following years.
zh:
白羊是由巴延杜尔部领导的土库曼部落联盟，其政权在安纳托利亚东部的阿米德一带兴起。1400年帖木儿将阿米德赐给白羊首领卡拉·奥斯曼，此城成为联盟的都城。

乌尊哈桑于1467年击败宿敌黑羊，征服伊朗大部后迁都大不里士。1473年奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德二世在奥特卢克贝利击败他。此后的内战削弱了他的继承者，萨法维的伊斯迈尔一世于1501年击败白羊，并在随后数年夺取其余领土。

en:
Aquileia was the state of its patriarch, one of the great ecclesiastical princes of the Empire. The see, said to have been founded by Saint Mark, became a patriarchate around 560 and fled to Grado when the Lombards took the old Roman city in 568, while the line remaining in Lombard territory later settled at Udine.

Its temporal power was born in 1077, when Henry IV, returning from Canossa, granted Patriarch Sieghard comital rights over Friuli. In 1337 its patriarch was Bertrand of Saint-Geniès, a Gascon jurist appointed in 1334.

He beat Rizzardo da Camino in 1335 and founded a university at Cividale in 1344, until Friulian nobles murdered him in 1350. Venice conquered the patriarchal lands in 1420, ending the patriarchs' temporal rule, and the see itself was suppressed in 1751.
zh:
阿奎莱亚是其牧首的领地，也是神圣罗马帝国最重要的教会邦国之一。当地主教座相传由圣马可创立，约560年升为牧首区；568年伦巴第人攻占这座古罗马名城后，牧首逃往格拉多，留在伦巴第境内的一支后来驻于乌迪内。

它的世俗政权诞生于1077年：从卡诺莎返回途中的亨利四世授予牧首西格哈德弗留利的伯爵权。1337年在位的是加斯科涅法学家贝特朗·德·圣热涅，他于1334年受任牧首。

他1335年击败里扎尔多·达·卡米诺，1344年在奇维达莱创办大学，最终于1350年被弗留利贵族刺杀。威尼斯于1420年征服牧首领地，终结牧首的世俗权力，牧首座本身也在1751年被废除。

en:
Aragon in 1337 was the head of the Crown of Aragon, a composite monarchy born in 1137 from the marriage of Petronilla and Ramon Berenguer IV, Count of Barcelona, whose son Alfonso II joined both titles in 1162.

James I conquered Mallorca and Valencia, and after the Sicilian Vespers of 1282 Peter III took the Sicilian crown; the pope enfeoffed Aragon with Sardinia and Corsica in 1297. Each realm kept its own laws and Corts; Barcelona was the centre of a maritime power spanning the Balearics and Sicily.

Under Peter IV, Mallorca was reunited with the Crown in 1349. Alfonso V added Naples in 1442. The House of Barcelona ended with Martin I in 1410; the 1412 Compromise of Caspe called the Trastámara Ferdinand I to the throne. Ferdinand II's marriage to Isabella of Castile in 1469 joined the two crowns in 1479, though Aragon's institutions survived until Philip V's Nueva Planta decrees of 1707 to 1716.
zh:
1337年阿拉贡是阿拉贡联合王国的核心。这个复合君主国诞生于1137年佩德罗尼拉与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世的联姻，其子阿方索二世于1162年兼领两衔。

海梅一世征服马略卡和巴伦西亚；1282年西西里晚祷事件后，佩德罗三世取得西西里王位；1297年教皇将撒丁岛和科西嘉册封给阿拉贡。各成员邦保留自己的法律和议会，巴塞罗那是这个海上强权的中心，势力遍及巴利阿里和西西里。

佩德罗四世治下，马略卡1349年并回联合王国。阿方索五世1442年拿下那不勒斯。巴塞罗那王朝随马丁一世于1410年终结，1412年《卡斯佩妥协方案》迎立特拉斯塔马拉家族的费尔南多一世。1469年费尔南多二世与卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉结婚，两顶王冠1479年合流，但阿拉贡制度保留到1707至1716年费利佩五世颁布《新基本法令》为止。

en:
Arborea was the most enduring of the four Sardinian judicates, autonomous states born of Byzantine island administration after ninth-century raids cut Sardinia off from Constantinople. Its judges, bearing the title of judex, ruled the centre-west from Oristano, to which Orzocorre I moved the court from Tharros in 1070.

In 1164 Barison II paid Frederick Barbarossa to crown him King of Sardinia, though the emperor revoked it a year later. While the other judicates fell to Pisa and Genoa by 1300, Arborea kept its freedom under the De Serra-Bas dynasty, and in 1337 its judge was Peter III.

His brother Marianus IV, called the Great, revolted against Aragon and by the 1360s held nearly the whole island. Eleanor, regent from 1387, codified Sardinian customary law. Aragon won Sanluri in 1409 and took Oristano in 1410, buying the remaining claims in 1420.
zh:
阿尔博雷阿是撒丁岛四个裁判国中存续最久的一个。9世纪的袭扰使撒丁岛与君士坦丁堡失联，岛上的拜占庭行政体系遂演变为这些自治政权。其统治者继承裁判官头衔，领有岛屿中西部，以奥里斯塔诺为都——1070年奥尔佐科雷一世把宫廷从塔罗斯迁至此地。

1164年，巴里松二世出资请腓特烈·巴巴罗萨加冕他为撒丁国王，但皇帝次年便收回成命。到1300年前后，其他裁判国相继落入比萨和热那亚之手，唯有阿尔博雷阿在德·塞拉-巴斯王朝治下保持独立，1337年在位的是彼得三世。

其弟马里亚努斯四世号称大帝，起兵反抗阿拉贡，到14世纪60年代已控制几乎全岛。1387年起摄政的埃莉奥诺拉将撒丁习惯法编为成文法典。1409年阿拉贡在圣卢里获胜，1410年攻占奥里斯塔诺，1420年又买下剩余权利。

en:
Ardalan was the hereditary Kurdish emirate of the Bani Ardalan tribe in western Iran's mountains, around Sanandaj and the Sharazor plain. Its ruling family claimed descent from Saladin, and the Kurdish historian Sharafkhan Bidlisi relates that its early chief Bani Ardalan settled among the Goran Kurds and seized Sharazor at the end of the Mongol era.

In 1337 the emirate was a tribal vassal of the Jalayirids, and Baba Ardalan's successors built it into an independent state whose court used Gorani as its literary language and lingua franca.

The Ardalans kept freedom by switching allegiance between the Safavids and Ottomans until 1617, when Ahmad Khan submitted to the Safavids as a semi-independent frontier governor. Nader Shah's Ottoman wars repeatedly swept the emirate, and in 1749 Karim Khan Zand sacked Sanandaj; the Ardalans then carried on under Qajar overlordship.
zh:
阿达兰是巴尼·阿达兰部落的世袭库尔德埃米尔国，位于伊朗西部山区，以萨南达杰和谢赫雷祖尔平原为中心。统治家族自称是萨拉丁的后裔；据库尔德史家沙拉夫汗·比特利西记载，其早期首领巴尼·阿达兰在蒙古时代末期定居于戈兰库尔德人之中，夺取谢赫雷祖尔。

1337年时，该埃米尔国是札剌亦儿王朝的部落附庸；巴巴·阿达兰的后继者把它建成独立政权，宫廷以戈拉尼语为书面语和通用语。

阿达兰人在萨法维王朝与奥斯曼帝国之间反复改换门庭以维持自由，直到1617年艾哈迈德汗臣服萨法维，成为半独立的边境总督。纳迪尔沙对奥斯曼的战争屡次席卷该埃米尔国，1749年卡里姆汗·赞德洗劫了萨南达杰；此后阿达兰人在卡扎尔王朝宗主权下延续统治。

en:
The Lordship of Argos and Nauplia was a Frankish fief in the Morea, built around the fortresses of Argos and Nauplia. The towns had formed Greek magnate Leo Sgouros's domain before the Crusaders took them, Nauplia falling in 1210 and Argos in 1212; Prince Geoffrey I of Achaea then granted them to Otto de la Roche, Duke of Athens.

His de la Roche and Brienne heirs kept the fief even after the Catalan Company took Athens in 1311. In 1337 the lord was Walter VI of Brienne, an absentee prince.

On his death in 1356 it passed to the Enghien family, and through Maria of Enghien's marriage to the Venetian Pietro Cornaro it came under Venice. Maria sold both cities to Venice in 1388; Argos was briefly held by the Byzantine despot Theodore I until handed to Venice in 1394.
zh:
阿尔戈斯与纳夫普利翁领地是摩里亚的法兰克人封邑，以阿尔戈斯和纳夫普利翁两座要塞为中心。两城本是希腊豪强利奥·斯古罗斯的领地，十字军先后于1210年攻克纳夫普利翁、1212年攻克阿尔戈斯；亚该亚亲王杰弗里一世随即将它们封给雅典公爵奥托·德·拉·罗什。

他的后裔拉罗什家族及后来的布里耶纳系公爵，在1311年加泰罗尼亚佣兵团攻占雅典后仍保有这块封邑。1337年的领主是常年在外的沃尔特六世·德·布里耶纳。

1356年他去世后，领地转入昂吉安家族，又因玛丽亚·德·昂吉安嫁给威尼斯人彼得罗·科尔纳罗而归附威尼斯。1388年玛丽亚把两城卖给威尼斯；阿尔戈斯一度被拜占庭专制君主狄奥多尔一世占据，最终于1394年移交威尼斯。

en:
The Arima were lords of the Arima estate in Hizen Province, Kyushu, where their family emerged in the Kamakura period. Arima Harunobu, a Christian daimyō, was baptized in 1580 and joined Ōtomo Sōrin and Ōmura Sumitada in sending an embassy to Europe in 1582. In 1584 he allied with the Shimazu and defeated Ryūzōji Takanobu at Okitanawate.

Harunobu submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi and kept his lands, but was executed in 1612 after the Okamoto Daihachi affair. His descendants remained daimyō and moved to Maruoka in Echizen Province in 1695.
zh:
有马氏是九州肥前国有马庄的领主，其家族兴起于镰仓时代。基督徒大名有马晴信于1580年受洗，1582年与大友宗麟、大村纯忠共同派遣使节前往欧洲。1584年，晴信与岛津氏结盟，在冲田畷击败龙造寺隆信。

晴信归顺丰臣秀吉并保住领地，但因冈本大八事件于1612年被处死。他的后代继续担任大名，于1695年迁至越前国丸冈。

en:
Launggyet was the last Arakanese kingdom of the Lemro period, ruling the fertile Kaladan River valley of northern Rakhine from its walled capital of the same name. The chronicle Rakhine Razawin Thit dates its founding to 1251, when King Alawmaphyu established it after the earlier Vesali kingdom fell. Sitting between Burma and Bengal, the city grew rich on the trade in rice, ivory and lacquerware.

A Shan invasion of 1294 was driven off, and in 1327 the Pinya kingdom raided Ramree Island. Another Shan attack came in 1334, after which King Min Hti sent his army across the Arakan Mountains to raid Thayet and founded the staging town of Ann in 1335.

In 1406 Ava sacked it under Crown Prince Minye Kyawswa, and the last king, Min Saw Mon, fled to the Bengal Sultanate. He returned with Bengali troops in 1429 and in 1430 founded a new capital at Mrauk U, where the Arakanese monarchy continued for nearly four more centuries.
zh:
隆邑是莱姆罗时代最后一个阿拉干人王国，以同名都城统治若开邦北部肥沃的加拉丹河谷。编年史《若开瑞汶》将建国系于1251年，阿隆马菲在维沙利王国衰落后建立此国。隆邑夹在缅甸与孟加拉之间，靠稻米、象牙和漆器贸易致富。

1294年掸人的入侵被击退，1327年彬牙王国袭掠兰里岛。1334年掸人再次来攻，闽提王派军越过阿拉干山脉袭击德耶，并于1335年修建中转城镇安城。

1406年，阿瓦王储明耶觉苏瓦率军攻陷隆邑，末代国王敏苏蒙逃往孟加拉苏丹国。1429年他借孟加拉军队复国，1430年在妙乌另建新都，阿拉干王权在那里又延续了近四百年。

en:
Armenia in 1337 was the rump of the Zakarid princedom, held by the Zakarid-Mkhargrdzeli dynasty from fortresses such as Yerevan under Georgian overlordship. The family's rise began when Queen Tamar of Georgia enfeoffed Zakare with the city of Ani in 1201.

The Zakarids governed northern and eastern Armenia with their own courts and taxes, building the church of Saint Gregory of Tigran Honents at Ani in 1215. The Mongols took Ani in 1236, after which the dynasty ruled as Ilkhanid vassals, Armenian troops marching with the Mongols to the siege of Baghdad in 1258.

When the Ilkhanate collapsed in 1335, Jalayirid and Chobanid factions fought over the country; Ani's Zakarid line ended around 1350 when the Chobanids sacked the city, soon made the Kara Koyunlu capital. Timur's raids of 1386 to 1404 carried the old Zakarid lands into his empire.
zh:
1337年的亚美尼亚是扎卡良公国的残余，由扎卡良-姆哈尔格尔泽利王朝据守埃里温等要塞，尊格鲁吉亚王室为宗主。这个家族的崛起始于1201年，格鲁吉亚女王塔马尔把阿尼城封给扎卡雷。

扎卡良家族此后以自己的法庭和赋税治理北亚美尼亚与东亚美尼亚，1215年在阿尼修建了蒂格兰·霍年茨圣格列高利教堂。1236年蒙古人攻占阿尼，该家族转而作为伊儿汗国的附庸统治，亚美尼亚军队还随蒙古人参加了1258年的巴格达之围。

1335年伊儿汗国崩溃后，札剌亦儿与楚邦诸派争夺此地；1350年前后楚邦王朝洗劫阿尼，该城的扎卡良王统终结，阿尼不久成为黑羊王朝的都城。1386—1404年帖木儿的扫荡把扎卡良故地并入他的帝国。

en: The Arendaronon, or People of the Rocks, were a Wendat nation in present-day Ontario. They joined the Wendat confederacy around 1590. In 1648–1649 Haudenosaunee attacks killed many Wendat after epidemics had weakened the confederacy; survivors fled east to Quebec or west to other Indigenous communities.
zh: 阿伦达罗农人又称岩石之民，是今安大略省的温达特部族。他们约于1590年加入温达特联盟。1648—1649年，在疫病削弱联盟之后，豪德诺索尼人的进攻杀死了许多温达特人；幸存者向东逃往魁北克，或向西投奔其他原住民群体。

en:
The Archbishopric of Riga grew out of the Bishopric of Livonia, founded at Ikšķile in 1186 as the first Christian see among the pagan Livs. Bishop Albert moved its seat to the new city of Riga in 1202, and in 1255 it was raised to an archbishopric covering all of medieval Livonia.

The archbishop also ruled a secular principality of castles and estates across central Livonia. This made him the chief rival of the Livonian Order, whose knights seized much of his land early in the fourteenth century; Archbishop Frederick von Pernstein recovered it through a papal ruling in 1335.

Later archbishops helped organize the Livonian Confederation, whose diet first met in 1419. The Reformation ended the see: in 1561, under its last archbishop William of Brandenburg, its territory was secularized amid the Livonian War and absorbed into the Duchy of Livonia.
zh:
里加大主教区的前身是1186年在伊克什基莱建立的利沃尼亚主教区，这是异教利夫人当中的第一个基督教教区。主教阿尔伯特于1202年将教座迁至新建的里加城，1255年升格为大主教区，统辖整个中世纪利沃尼亚。

大主教还统治着横跨利沃尼亚中部、由城堡与庄园组成的世俗领地。这使他成为利沃尼亚骑士团的主要对手：骑士团在14世纪初夺取了大主教的大量领地，大主教弗雷德里希·冯·佩恩施泰因依据1335年的教皇裁决收回了这些地产。

后来的大主教又推动组建利沃尼亚邦联，邦联议会于1419年首次召开。宗教改革终结了这个教区：1561年，在末任大主教威廉·冯·勃兰登堡任内，其领地在利沃尼亚战争中被世俗化，并入利沃尼亚公国。

en:
The County of Artois, centred on Arras, was the northernmost great fief of France, bordering Flanders. A Carolingian county, it passed to Flanders after 898, returning to France in 1180 as Isabelle of Hainaut's dowry to Philip II, whose Bouvines victory in 1214 secured the claim.

In 1237 Louis VIII made it an appanage for his son Robert, founder of the Artois line; Count Robert II fell at the Golden Spurs in 1302. After a succession dispute, Joan III, wife of Odo IV of Burgundy, ruled it in 1337. It passed to Flanders and in 1384 to Philip the Bold's Burgundy.

After Charles the Bold fell at Nancy in 1477, Louis XI occupied Artois; the 1493 Treaty of Senlis gave it to the Habsburgs. Louis XIII conquered it in 1640, and the Treaty of the Pyrenees confirmed it to France in 1659.
zh:
阿图瓦伯国以阿拉斯为中心，是法兰西最北的大封土，与佛兰德斯接壤。它本是加洛林王朝的伯国，898年后转入佛兰德斯手中，1180年作为埃诺的伊莎贝尔嫁给腓力二世的嫁妆回归法兰西，1214年的布汶大捷巩固了这一权利。

1237年，路易八世把它封给儿子罗贝尔，开创阿图瓦卡佩支系；伯爵罗贝尔二世1302年战死金马刺战役。一场继承纠纷之后，嫁给勃艮第公爵厄德四世的让娜三世于1337年统治伯国。伯国后来转入佛兰德斯，1384年并入勇敢的菲利普的勃艮第领地。

1477年大胆的查理战死于南锡后，路易十一占领阿图瓦；1493年的《桑利斯条约》把它交给哈布斯堡家族。1640年路易十三将其征服，1659年的《比利牛斯条约》确认它归属法兰西。

en:
The Arlat, or Arulat, were a Mongol tribe already counted among the clans of the steppe in the age of Genghis Khan. A tumen of the Arlat followed the Mongol conquests west and settled in the western part of the Chagatai ulus, around Maymana and the pastures of eastern Khorasan.

There they became one of the semi-nomadic tribal confederations that dominated the khanate after it fractured in the fourteenth century. Arlat amirs later served the Timurids: Yadgarshah Arlat, commander of the Arlat tumen, married a granddaughter of Timur and died in 1438 after serving Shah Rukh.

A separate branch ruled Shaki in Azerbaijan as Timurid governors, where Sidi Ali Arlat held out against the campaigns of Miran Shah until he was killed in battle around 1398 and was succeeded by his son Sidi Ahmad.
zh:
阿鲁剌惕又译阿鲁剌，是成吉思汗时代已见记载的蒙古部落。其一个万户随蒙古西征迁居察合台兀鲁思西部，在梅马内和东呼罗珊草原一带游牧。

14世纪察合台汗国分裂后，它成为左右汗国的半游牧部落集团之一。阿鲁剌惕异密后来效力于帖木儿王朝：万户长也的哥儿沙阿黑剌娶帖木儿孙女为妻，历事沙哈鲁，于1438年去世。

另有一支以帖木儿地方长官的身份统治阿塞拜疆的舍基，西迪·阿里·阿鲁剌惕曾抵抗米兰沙的进攻，约1398年战死，其子西迪·艾哈迈德继立。

en:
Aru, also written Haru, was a Malay kingdom on the eastern coast of North Sumatra, its capital at Kota Rentang. The early kingdom mixed animism with Hinduism before Islam reached its court in the late thirteenth century.

In 1282 Kublai Khan demanded its submission, and Aru sent tribute in 1295. In 1339 a Majapahit expedition brought Aru under Javanese control, and the Nagarakretagama of 1365 lists it among Majapahit's vassals. Ma Huan visited with the Zheng He fleets and wrote in 1416 that the king and his people were Muslims.

In the fifteenth century Aru was a formidable maritime power controlling the northern entrance to the Strait of Malacca, rivalling Pasai and Malacca. Aceh ended it: the capital withdrew inland from Kota Rentang to Benteng Putri Hijau, and Aceh probably took the old port in 1539. Aceh's Iskandar Muda struck the final blow in 1613, and Aru dissolved; its successor state of Deli became an Acehnese protectorate in 1632.
zh:
哑鲁又译哈鲁，是北苏门答腊东海岸的马来人王国，都城哥打兰樟。早期王国万物有灵信仰与印度教并存，13世纪末伊斯兰教传入宫廷。

1282年忽必烈要求哑鲁臣服，哑鲁于1295年遣使朝贡。1339年满者伯夷的远征使哑鲁落入爪哇人控制，1365年的《爪哇史颂》把它列为满者伯夷的属国之一。马欢随郑和船队到访，在1416年写成的记述中记载哑鲁国王和臣民都已信奉伊斯兰教。

15世纪的哑鲁是控制马六甲海峡北口的海上强国，可与八昔和马六甲比肩。亚齐终结了这一局面：都城从哥打兰樟退守内陆的普特里希乔要塞，旧港可能于1539年被亚齐攻占。1613年亚齐的伊斯坎达尔·穆达给予最后一击，哑鲁解体；后继的碟里于1632年成为亚齐的保护国。

en: Te Arawa is a confederation of Māori iwi and hapū around the Rotorua lakes and the Bay of Plenty. Its peoples trace their ancestry to the Arawa canoe, traditionally captained by Tama-te-kapua, and settled around lakes including Rotorua and Rotoiti.
zh: 特阿拉瓦是新西兰罗托鲁阿湖区和丰盛湾一带的毛利部族与支族联盟。各部族追溯祖源至阿拉瓦独木舟，传说该舟由塔马·特卡普阿率领；他们在罗托鲁阿湖、罗托伊蒂湖等地周围定居。

en:
Arezzo was a Tuscan city-state whose commune escaped its bishop's control in 1098. Generally aligned with the Ghibellines, it fought Guelph Florence and its allies at Campaldino in 1289, where Bishop Guglielmino degli Ubertini was killed.

The city recovered briefly under the Tarlati family, including Guido Tarlati, bishop from 1312 until his death in 1327. Arezzo passed under Florentine rule in 1384 and later became part of the Medici Grand Duchy of Tuscany.
zh:
阿雷佐是托斯卡纳的一座城邦，其公社于1098年摆脱主教的控制。阿雷佐通常支持吉伯林派，1289年在坎帕尔迪诺与圭尔夫派的佛罗伦萨及其盟友交战，主教古列尔米诺·德利·乌贝尔蒂尼战死。

塔尔拉蒂家族统治期间，阿雷佐一度复兴；该家族的圭多·塔尔拉蒂从1312年起担任主教，直到1327年去世。1384年阿雷佐归于佛罗伦萨统治，后来成为美第奇家族的托斯卡纳大公国的一部分。

en:
The Asakura were samurai lords of Echizen Province, based at Ichijōdani Castle. In 1471 they displaced the Shiba as military governors in part of Echizen; Asakura Yoshikage inherited Ichijōdani in 1548 and made it a refuge for people fleeing warfare around Kyoto.

Allied with the Azai, Yoshikage opposed Oda Nobunaga and was defeated at Anegawa in 1570. Nobunaga took Ichijōdani in 1573, and Yoshikage was betrayed and forced to kill himself.
zh:
朝仓氏是以一乘谷城为据点的越前国武家领主。1471年，朝仓氏取代斯波氏，成为越前部分地区的守护；朝仓义景于1548年继承一乘谷，使这里成为京都战乱避难者的容身之处。

义景与浅井氏结盟对抗织田信长，1570年在姊川之战中战败。信长于1573年攻占一乘谷，义景遭到背叛，被迫自尽。

en:
Ascoli, the ancient Asculum, stands on the Tronto at the eastern edge of the Apennines in the Marche. Founded by the Piceni, it became a nominally independent allied city of Rome after 268 BC, but was the first Italian city to rise in the Social War of 91 BC and was stormed by Roman legions two years later.

It later belonged to the Lombard Duchy of Spoleto, after which Frankish officials and its bishops held power. A free commune was set up in 1189, though family feuds repeatedly opened the door to outside lords.

In 1337 Ascoli still governed itself as a republic under a hired podestà, but within a few years the condottiero Galeotto I Malatesta made himself its tyrant. Cardinal Albornoz restored papal authority over the Marche in the 1350s, and after Francesco Sforza was driven out in 1482 Ascoli submitted to the papacy.
zh:
阿斯科利古称阿斯库卢姆，位于马尔凯亚平宁山脉东缘的特龙托河畔。它由皮切尼人建立，公元前268年后成为罗马名义上独立的同盟城市，却在公元前91年的同盟者战争中率先举事，两年后被罗马军团攻陷。

它后来隶属伦巴第人的斯波莱托公国，此后由法兰克官员、继而由本地主教掌权。1189年，阿斯科利建立自由公社，但家族仇杀一再引外邦领主入城。

1337年，它仍是靠雇佣执政官治理的共和国；没过几年，雇佣兵队长加莱奥托一世·马拉泰斯塔便自立为城市僭主。14世纪50年代阿尔沃诺斯枢机在马尔凯恢复了教皇权威，1482年弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎被逐后，阿斯科利臣服于教皇。

en:
Alessandria was founded in 1168, when the Lombard League built a fortified town facing Montferrat. Two years later it was entrusted to Pope Alexander III, its namesake, and survived Frederick Barbarossa's siege of 1174, a prelude to his defeat at Legnano.

As a free commune it was torn by Guelph and Ghibelline feuds, still a republic in 1337. After Gamenario in 1345 it passed under the protection of Luchino Visconti of Milan, and Gian Galeazzo Visconti's 1391 victory at Alessandria bound it to the Duchy of Milan.

A 1403 revolt let the condottiero Facino Cane make himself lord, but after his death in 1412 it returned to the Visconti and later the Sforza. In 1707 the Peace of Utrecht assigned it to Savoy, which built its star-shaped citadel; after Marengo in 1800 France annexed it, and Savoy recovered it in 1814.
zh:
亚历山德里亚是1168年伦巴第同盟各城邦建起的设防城镇，与蒙费拉托侯国相望。两年后城市被托付给教皇亚历山大三世并以他的名字命名，它顶住了红胡子腓特烈1174年的围攻，这也是他在莱尼亚诺战败的先声。

作为自由公社，城市长期被圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的仇杀撕裂，1337年时仍以共和国自治。1345年加梅纳里奥战役后，它转入米兰的卢基诺·维斯孔蒂保护之下；1391年吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂在亚历山德里亚之战中获胜，城市命运就此与米兰公国绑在一起。

1403年的一场叛乱让雇佣兵队长法奇诺·卡内自立为领主，但他1412年死后城市复归维斯孔蒂家族，后来又随斯福尔扎家族沉浮。1707年《乌得勒支和约》将其划给萨伏依，后者在此修建了星形要塞；1800年马伦戈战役后法国吞并此城，1814年又归还萨伏依。

en:
The Ashalaho, or Mountain Crow, were a Crow people of the upper Yellowstone and the Bighorn and Absaroka ranges. They separated from the Awatixa Hidatsa and moved west under the leader No Intestines, whose vision led him in search of sacred tobacco.

By the early nineteenth century the Mountain Crow formed a largely independent group within the Crow. In 1825 their chief Long Hair joined other Crow leaders in signing a treaty of friendship and trade with the United States.
zh:
阿沙拉霍人又称山地克罗人，是居住在黄石河上游、大角山脉和阿布萨罗卡山脉的克罗族群。他们从阿瓦蒂萨希达察人中分离，在首领无肠的带领下西迁；无肠因异象而寻找神圣的烟草。

到19世纪初，山地克罗人已是克罗族内部一个大体独立的群体。1825年，他们的首领长发与其他克罗领袖一道同美国签订友好贸易条约。

en:
The Ashikaga shogunate was a military government that ruled Japan from Kyoto. Ashikaga Takauji helped overthrow the Kamakura shogunate in 1333, then turned against Emperor Go-Daigo and seized Kyoto in 1336. Takauji became shogun in 1338, while rival Northern and Southern courts claimed imperial authority until 1392.

The third shogun, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, built his residence in Kyoto's Muromachi district in 1379. The Ōnin War began in 1467 and ushered in an age of civil war; in 1573 Oda Nobunaga expelled the last Ashikaga shogun, Yoshiaki, from Kyoto.
zh:
足利幕府是以京都为中心统治日本的武家政权。足利尊氏于1333年协助推翻镰仓幕府，随后倒戈反对后醍醐天皇，并于1336年攻占京都。尊氏于1338年就任将军，互相对立的南北朝廷则争夺皇权，直到1392年才告统一。

第三代将军足利义满于1379年在京都室町建造府邸。1467年爆发的应仁之乱开启了战乱时代；1573年，织田信长将最后一位足利将军义昭逐出京都。

en: The Orang Asli are diverse indigenous peoples of the Malay Peninsula, including the Semang of the north and the Senoi of the central region. Their communities had distinct languages and customary lands.
zh: 阿斯里是马来半岛多个原住民族群的统称，包括北部的塞芒人和中部的塞诺伊人。各群体拥有不同的语言和传统土地。

en:
The Ashina were a warrior family who ruled Aizu in Mutsu from Kurokawa Castle. Their ancestor Sawara Yoshitsura received Aizu for his service in the northern campaign of 1189, and his descendants took the Ashina name.

Ashina Moriuji expanded his power in Aizu after succeeding his father in 1541. The family weakened after his death in 1580, and in 1589 Date Masamune defeated Ashina Yoshihiro at Suriagehara and seized Kurokawa Castle.
zh:
芦名氏是以黑川城为据点统治陆奥会津的武家。其祖佐原义连因参加1189年的奥州征伐而获封会津，后代改称芦名。

芦名盛氏于1541年继承家督后，在会津扩张势力。他于1580年去世后家族逐渐衰落，1589年伊达政宗在摺上原击败芦名义广，夺取黑川城。

en:
The Aso were a family of priests at Aso Shrine who built a warrior following in Higo Province. In 1333 Aso Koretoki joined the attack on the Kamakura shogunate's Rokuhara headquarters in Kyoto.

Rival branches backed opposing courts during the civil wars; in 1341 Aso Koresumi killed a Northern Court rival at Nangō Castle. The Shimazu invaded the Aso lands in 1585, and the family lost its position as daimyō. Aso Koreyoshi later regained lands and the chief priesthood under Katō Kiyomasa.
zh:
阿苏氏是阿苏神社的神官家族，在肥后国建立了武士势力。1333年阿苏惟时参加攻打镰仓幕府在京都的六波罗探题。

南北朝内战中，家族各支分别支持不同的朝廷；1341年阿苏惟澄在南乡城杀死一名北朝对手。1585年岛津氏侵入阿苏领地，阿苏氏失去了大名地位。后来阿苏惟善在加藤清正安排下重新获得领地和大宫司职位。

en:
The Ashshipite, or River Crow, were a Crow people who lived along the Yellowstone and Musselshell rivers and in the Powder River country. They separated from the Hidatsa and by the early nineteenth century formed a largely independent Crow group.

In 1825 their chief Arapooish left a gathering where other Crow leaders signed a treaty with the United States. In 1837 Hidatsa refugees joined the River Crow as smallpox swept through the Hidatsa villages.
zh:
阿什希皮特人又称河流克罗人，是居住在黄石河、马瑟尔谢尔河沿岸及保德河流域的克罗族群。他们从希达察人中分离，到19世纪初成为克罗族内部一个大体独立的群体。

1825年，其他克罗领袖与美国签订条约时，他们的首领阿拉普伊什离开了会场。1837年天花席卷希达察人的村庄，部分希达察难民加入了河流克罗人。

en:
Astarābād, on the Caspian-facing plain of ancient Hyrcania, replaced old Gurgān, destroyed in the thirteenth-century Mongol invasion, as the region's chief city. In the 1330s its governor was Shaykh 'Alī Hindu, supporter of Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür, based in Gurgān and western Khorasan.

After the Sarbadars murdered Togha Temür in 1353 and annexed Astarābād, Amīr Valī, son of Shaykh 'Alī, fled to a neighboring tribe and fought his way back: he declared for Shiism to win over the Mazandaranis, seized Astarābād in 1356 and took Bistam around 1360.

Driven out around 1366, he retook the city by 1374 and captured the Sarbadar capital Sabzevar around 1380. His wars with the Sarbadars and Jalayirids ended with Timur, who forced him out in 1384 and gave the city to Togha Temür's son Luqman; Astarābād later became a stronghold of the Qajar tribe.
zh:
阿斯塔拉巴德位于濒临里海的古希尔卡尼亚平原，取代了13世纪蒙古入侵中被毁的旧戈尔甘，成为该地区的首要城市。14世纪30年代，长官谢赫·阿里·欣杜是伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的支持者，后者以戈尔甘和呼罗珊西部为根基。

1353年萨尔巴达尔人杀害脱合帖木儿并兼并阿斯塔拉巴德后，谢赫·阿里之子阿米尔·瓦利投奔邻近部落，随后又打了回来：他改奉什叶派以争取马赞达兰人，于1356年夺取阿斯塔拉巴德，约1360年又占比斯塔姆。

约1366年他被逐出，1374年前再度夺回该城，约1380年甚至攻下萨尔巴达尔人的都城萨卜泽瓦尔。他与萨尔巴达尔人、札剌亦儿人的战争随帖木儿到来而结束：1384年他被迫出逃，帖木儿把该城交给脱合帖木儿之子卢格曼；阿斯塔拉巴德后来成为卡扎尔部落的据点。

en:
The County of Astarac was a hilly Gascon lordship between Armagnac, Bigorre and Comminges, in the Baïse and Gers basin, where Gascon was spoken and livestock farming dominated. It was created in the tenth century when the Duchy of Gascony was divided among the sons of García II Sánchez, the youngest, Arnold I, receiving Astarac.

Its counts founded the bastide of Mirande in 1280 and made it their capital in 1297; the county was administered through four castellanies. In 1337 the count was Centule IV of the native house of Astarac, a vassal of the French crown.

His line held the county until the sixteenth century, when an heiress carried it to the House of Foix in 1536; it later passed through the houses of Roquelaure and Rohan-Chabot. Under the old monarchy Astarac remained part of the province of Gascony.
zh:
阿斯塔拉克伯国是加斯科涅的一处丘陵领地，地处阿马尼亚克、比戈尔与科曼日之间的拜斯河与热尔河流域，当地通行加斯科涅语，以畜牧业为生。10世纪加斯科涅公爵加西亚二世·桑切斯去世后，公国被诸子瓜分，幼子阿尔诺一世分得阿斯塔拉克，伯国由此诞生。

伯爵们于1280年兴建了设防新城米朗，并在1297年定其为首府；伯国由四个城堡区统辖。1337年在位的是本土阿斯塔拉克家族的桑图勒四世，为法兰西国王的封臣。

他的家族一直统治到16世纪，1536年女继承人把伯国带入富瓦家族，后来又先后转入罗克洛尔家族和罗昂—沙博家族手中。旧制度时期，阿斯塔拉克始终是加斯科涅行省的一部分。

en: Asu was a Hurka Jurchen polity centered on Ningguta in the Mudan river basin, whose Manchu name means a group of six. Hurka clans held the wooded Mudan and upper Ussuri country through the Ming, and in 1652 the Qing posted a garrison at Ningguta, making it the chief base on the Amur frontier.
zh: 阿苏是以宁古塔为中心的虎尔哈女真政权，地处牡丹江流域；宁古塔在满语中意为“六”。明代虎尔哈诸部据有这片山林，入清后于1652年向宁古塔派驻重兵，使其成为清朝在黑龙江边疆的首要据点。

en: The Asayama were a warrior family based in Asayama in Izumo Province. From the Edo period, the family served the Kujō house as hereditary household officials.
zh: 朝山氏是以出云国朝山乡为根据地的武家。江户时代起，朝山家世代担任九条家的家司。

en: The Antambahoaka lived near Mananjary on Madagascar's southeastern coast, where local kings governed groups of villages. In the fifteenth century Ravalarivo founded Masindrano, the community from which Mananjary grew, after separating from the Antemoro.
zh: 安坦巴华卡人居住在马达加斯加东南海岸的马南扎里附近，当地国王各自统治若干村庄。15世纪，拉瓦拉里沃从安泰莫罗人中分出，建立了马辛德拉努聚落，马南扎里后来由此发展而来。

en: The Ataronchronon, or Bog people, were a Wendat group in the region between Lake Simcoe and Georgian Bay in present-day Ontario. They may have been a division of the Bear nation rather than a full member of the Wendat Confederacy.
zh: 阿塔龙克罗农又称沼泽人，是生活在今安大略省锡姆科湖与乔治亚湾之间的温达特人群体。他们可能是熊族的一支，而非温达特联盟的正式成员。

en:
The Antaifasy lived in the coastal region of Ifasy around Farafangana in southeastern Madagascar, divided into three groups with their own kings. From the 1680s they fought the neighboring Antemoro, whose brief domination was ended by the Antaifasy king Maseba.

In the eighteenth century King Ifara controlled trade with European ships on the Manampatra River. The army of Imerina invaded in 1827 and made the Antaifasy kingdom a vassal, but resistance to Merina rule continued.
zh:
安泰法西人居住在马达加斯加东南部法拉凡加纳周围的伊法西沿海地区，分为三个各有国王的群体。自17世纪80年代起，他们与邻近的安泰莫罗人交战；安泰莫罗一度占据优势，后来被安泰法西国王马塞巴赶走。

18世纪，国王伊法拉控制了马南帕特拉河上与欧洲船只的贸易。伊默里纳军队于1827年入侵，使安泰法西王国成为附庸，但当地对梅里纳统治的抵抗仍在继续。

en: The Attigneenonghahac, or Cord people, were a Wendat nation in the Georgian Bay region of present-day Ontario. In the mid-fifteenth century they formed an alliance with the Attignawantan, laying the foundations of the Wendat Confederacy. During the Beaver Wars the Haudenosaunee defeated and dispersed the Wendat, whose confederacy broke apart in the 1650s.
zh: 阿蒂格尼农纳哈克又称绳族，是生活在今安大略省乔治亚湾地区的一个温达特族群。15世纪中叶，他们与阿蒂格纳旺坦人结盟，奠定了温达特联盟的基础。海狸战争期间，豪德诺索尼人击败并驱散了温达特人，联盟在1650年代瓦解。

en:
The Duchy of Athens was a crusader state founded in 1205 after the Fourth Crusade, covering Attica and Boeotia with its capital at Thebes, while the Acropolis of Athens served as the dukes' palace. Its first ruler, the Burgundian knight Otto de la Roche, founded a French dynasty that held it until 1308, when Walter V of Brienne inherited.

Walter hired the Catalan Company, then tried dismissing it without pay; at the Battle of Halmyros in 1311 the Catalans killed him and most Frankish nobles, seizing the duchy. From 1312 they acknowledged the suzerainty of Sicily, and the title passed to the Crown of Aragon.

In 1337 its Aragonese duke was William, and Catalan had replaced French as the administrative language. The Florentine Acciaioli family captured Athens in 1388, and in 1444 the duchy became tributary to the Byzantine despot Constantine; the Ottomans conquered it in 1458, ending Latin rule over the city.
zh:
雅典公国是1205年第四次十字军东征后建立的十字军国家，疆域包括阿提卡和维奥蒂亚，以底比斯为首都，雅典卫城则是公爵的宫殿。首任统治者是勃艮第骑士奥托·德·拉罗什，他开创的法国裔家族统治到1308年，公国由布列讷的戈蒂埃五世继承。

戈蒂埃雇用加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，事后却想赖账遣散他们；1311年的哈尔米罗斯战役中，加泰罗尼亚人杀死戈蒂埃和大部分法兰克贵族，夺取了公国。1312年起他们承认西西里的宗主权，公爵头衔归入阿拉贡王室。

1337年在位的是阿拉贡王室的威廉，加泰罗尼亚语已取代法语成为行政语言。1388年佛罗伦萨的阿恰约利家族攻占雅典，1444年公国沦为拜占庭专制君主君士坦丁的附庸，1458年奥斯曼人征服雅典，拉丁人的统治告终。

en:
Asti, the Roman Hasta on the Tanaro plain in Piedmont, grew from a Ligurian settlement into a Roman colony and one of the thirty-six Lombard duchies. The first consuls of its free commune appear in 1095, and Frederick Barbarossa stormed and burned the city in 1155.

The thirteenth century was its heyday: merchants and bankers prospered on the Ligurian trade routes and the commune at one point controlled Chieri and Turin. A Ghibelline coup in 1339 opened Asti to Luchino Visconti of Milan, who took control in 1340.

In 1389 Asti passed to the French dukes of Orléans as part of the dowry of Valentina Visconti, and in 1531 it was granted to the House of Savoy. It endured seventeenth-century sieges and plague, fell to France in 1703 and was retaken by Savoy in 1705, returning to Savoy in 1814 after the Napoleonic occupation.
zh:
阿斯蒂古称哈斯塔，坐落在皮埃蒙特的塔纳罗平原上，最初是利古里亚人的聚落，后来成为罗马殖民地，又是伦巴第人三十六公国之一。1095年，自由公社的首批执政官出现；1155年，红胡子腓特烈攻陷并焚毁此城。

13世纪是阿斯蒂的鼎盛期：商人和银行家靠利古里亚商路致富，公社一度控制基耶里和都灵。1339年吉伯林派发动政变，为米兰的卢基诺·维斯孔蒂入主铺平道路，后者于1340年掌权。

1389年，阿斯蒂作为瓦伦蒂娜·维斯孔蒂嫁妆的一部分转归法国奥尔良公爵，1531年又被封给萨伏依王室。17世纪它历经围攻与瘟疫，1703年陷于法国，1705年被萨伏依收复，拿破仑占领结束后于1814年复归萨伏依。

en:
Aceh occupies the northern tip of Sumatra, ruled from Bandar Aceh. Before the sultanate the region was known as Lamuri and was among the earliest places in the archipelago to receive Islam. In 1520 Ali Mughayat Syah began the campaigns that founded the Aceh Sultanate, absorbing Lamuri by the early sixteenth century.

His son Alauddin al-Kahar pushed south through Sumatra and attacked Portuguese Malacca. The sultanate reached its height under Iskandar Muda from 1607, who brought most of Sumatra under his overlordship, conquered Pahang in 1617 and issued the Adat Meukuta Alam law code, though his fleet was destroyed before Malacca in 1629.

After a line of female sultanas the coastal chiefs became effectively independent, and in 1727 a Bugis dynasty took the throne. In the 1820s Aceh produced more than half the world's pepper, and Tuanku Ibrahim rebuilt the sultan's authority over the pepper-growing rajas.
zh:
亚齐位于苏门答腊岛北端，以班达亚齐为统治中心。苏丹国建立之前，这一地区称蓝里，是群岛最早接受伊斯兰教的地方之一。1520年，阿里·穆哈亚特·沙开始扩张，建立亚齐苏丹国，并在16世纪初吞并蓝里。

其子阿拉丁·卡哈尔向南推进，进攻葡萄牙人占据的马六甲。1607年即位的伊斯坎达尔·穆达把苏丹国推向鼎盛，使苏门答腊大部臣服，1617年征服彭亨，颁布《穆库塔阿拉姆习惯法》；但他的舰队于1629年在马六甲城下覆灭。

此后历经数位女苏丹，沿海酋长实际上纷纷自立，1727年武吉斯王朝登上王位。19世纪20年代，亚齐胡椒产量占世界一半以上，端古·易卜拉欣重新树立了苏丹对各地胡椒拉贾的权威。

en:
The Antesaka kingdom arose on Madagascar's southeastern coast, south of Farafangana. Its founders came from Sakalava Menabe, reaching Nosipandra by the 1650s; tradition names the exiled prince Andriamandresy as their leader.

By the early eighteenth century the Antesaka had built one of Madagascar's largest kingdoms. King Lengoabo expanded it to its greatest extent, but in the nineteenth century Merina armies invaded, killing or enslaving many Antesaka.
zh:
安特萨卡王国兴起于马达加斯加东南海岸、法拉凡加纳以南。其创建者来自萨卡拉瓦人的梅纳贝，至17世纪50年代抵达努西潘德拉；传说他们的首领是被放逐的王子安德里阿芒德雷西。

到18世纪初，安特萨卡人建立了马达加斯加最大的几个王国之一。国王伦古阿布将领土扩展至最大范围，但19世纪梅里纳军队入侵，许多安特萨卡人被杀或沦为奴隶。

en:
Autlán, whose Nahuatl name combines aotli, a water channel, with tlan, a place, and means beside the ditch, was the seat of a lordship in the southern highlands of what is now Jalisco; chiefdoms such as Tenamaxtlán recognised its authority.

The wider country was divided among more than thirty tiny states, which Spanish forces overran in 1523 and 1524. In 1534 the crown established the corregimiento of Autlán, which stretched from the interior around Ameca to the Pacific harbour of Puerto de la Navidad.
zh:
奥特兰的名称来自纳瓦特尔语，由意为水渠的奥特利和意为之地的特兰组成，合指水渠旁的地方。它是今哈利斯科南部高地一个领主邦的治所，特纳马斯特兰等城邦都承认它的权威。

更广阔的地区分裂成三十多个小国，1523—1524年被西班牙军队攻灭。1534年，王室设立奥特兰督办区，辖地从内陆的阿梅卡一带延伸到太平洋的纳维达港。

en:
The Antemoro kingdom arose on Madagascar's southeastern coast in the sixteenth century, replacing the power of the Zafiraminia. Migrants with Muslim connections settled in the Matitana region around 1500, and their descendants formed prominent Antemoro clans.

Antemoro scribes used the Arabic-derived Sorabe script to write Malagasy. In the late eighteenth century the Merina king Andrianampoinimerina summoned them to teach his court, including the future Radama I.
zh:
安泰莫罗王国于16世纪在马达加斯加东南海岸兴起，取代了扎菲拉米尼亚人的势力。约1500年，与穆斯林有联系的移民在马蒂塔纳地区定居，其后裔组成了安泰莫罗的显赫宗族。

安泰莫罗的书吏使用源于阿拉伯字母的苏拉贝文书写马达加斯加语。18世纪末，梅里纳国王安德里安安普伊尼梅里纳召他们教授宫廷子弟，未来的拉达马一世也在其中。

en: Atocpan, meaning on fertile soil in Nahuatl, was a Chichimeca village in the Milpa Alta valley south of Lake Xochimilco, one of nine villages tradition credits to thirteenth-century Chichimeca migrants and later subject to Xochimilco. In the fifteenth century it came under Mexica rule as part of the altepetl of Malacachtepec Momoxco, until the Spanish takeover of 1529.
zh: 阿托克潘在纳瓦特尔语中意为沃土之上，是霍奇米尔科湖以南米尔帕阿尔塔山谷的奇奇梅卡村落，相传为13世纪奇奇梅卡移民所建九村之一，后来臣属于霍奇米尔科。15世纪它作为马拉卡特佩克-莫莫克斯科阿尔特佩特尔的一部分落入墨西加治下，直到1529年西班牙人接管。

en: Atepec, whose Nahuatl name means the hill where water abounds, was a small mountain community in the Sierra Norte of Oaxaca, between the Zapotec polities of the Oaxaca valley and the unconquered Mixe country. In prehispanic times it was a subject town of neighbouring Teococuilco, whose people honoured the deity Quezelao as provider of the seasonal fields.
zh: 阿特佩克的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“多水之山”，是瓦哈卡州北部山区的一个小型山地聚落，地处瓦哈卡谷地的萨波特克诸邦与东面未被征服的米赫人地区之间的崎岖高地。前西班牙时代，它是邻近中心特奥科奎尔科的附属城镇，居民尊奉克塞劳神，视其为时令农田的赐予者。

en:
The Artuqids were a Sunni Turkoman dynasty of the Oghuz Döger tribe, named after Artuk Bey, a Seljuk general governing Jerusalem from 1086. After Artuk's death his sons Sökmen and Ilghazi were driven out by the Fatimids in 1098 and carved out al-Jazira principalities at Mardin and Hasankeyf.

Ilghazi of Mardin crushed Antioch at the Ager Sanguinis in 1119, and the dynasty later split into Hasankeyf, Harput and Mardin branches. The first two fell to the Ayyubids and the Seljuks of Rum in the 1230s, while the Mardin line endured as vassal to the Ayyubids, Ilkhanids and Qara Qoyunlu.

In 1260 Qara Arslan submitted to the Mongols, and in 1337 the ruler of Mardin was as-Salih Mahmud, reigning from 1312 to 1364. The Qara Qoyunlu overran Mardin in 1384 and annexed it in 1409, ending three centuries of Artuqid rule.
zh:
阿尔图格王朝是乌古斯都客儿部的逊尼派突厥蛮王朝，得名于塞尔柱将领阿尔图克·贝伊，他1086年出任耶路撒冷长官。阿尔图克死后，其子索克曼与伊尔加齐1098年被法蒂玛王朝逐出，转而在杰济拉的马尔丁、哈桑凯伊夫开拓领地。

马尔丁的伊尔加齐1119年在血田战役中大破安条克，王朝后来分裂为哈桑凯伊夫、哈尔普特和马尔丁三支：前两支13世纪30年代亡于阿尤布王朝和鲁姆塞尔柱人，马尔丁一支相继向阿尤布王朝、伊儿汗国和黑羊王朝称臣。

1260年，卡拉·阿尔斯兰向蒙古人投降；1337年马尔丁在位的是萨利赫·马哈茂德，统治1312年至1364年。黑羊王朝1384年攻陷马尔丁，1409年正式吞并，延续三百年的阿尔图格统治终结。

en:
The Astrakhan Khanate was a Tatar successor to the Golden Horde on the lower Volga, with its capital at Xacitarxan near the river's delta. Mahmud bin Küchük established the khanate in the 1460s; its merchants connected Moscow, Crimea and Central Asia.

In 1554 Russian forces installed Dervish Ali as khan after Yamghurchi turned against Moscow. Ivan the Terrible's forces conquered Astrakhan in 1556, and a new Russian fortress was built downstream in 1558.
zh:
阿斯特拉罕汗国是金帐汗国在伏尔加河下游的鞑靼继承国，首都哈吉塔尔汗位于河口三角洲附近。马哈茂德·本·库楚克在15世纪60年代建立汗国，商人往来于莫斯科、克里米亚和中亚之间。

1554年，俄军在亚姆古尔奇背离莫斯科后扶植德尔维什·阿里为汗。伊凡雷帝的军队于1556年征服阿斯特拉罕，1558年俄国在下游修筑了新要塞。

en: Atitlan was a Mixe mountain town in the Sierra Mixe of northern Oaxaca, a Midland Mixe community between the Choapam highlands and the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. Like all the Mixe, it was never subdued by the Zapotec kingdom of Zaachila or the Aztec Empire, and Spanish arms failed; Dominican friars made the first contact only in 1555.
zh: 阿蒂特兰是瓦哈卡北部米赫山区的一座米赫人山城，属于乔阿潘高地与特万特佩克地峡之间崎岖地带的中部米赫方言聚落。与其他米赫人一样，无论是萨波特克人的萨奇拉王国还是阿兹特克帝国都未能完全征服它的居民，西班牙人的武力征讨也告失败；直到1555年，多明我会修士才与米赫人实现首次和平接触。

en:
The Kingdom of Asturias arose in northern Iberia under Pelagius after the Muslim conquest of the Visigothic kingdom. His victory at Covadonga in 722 became associated with the beginning of the Christian reconquest. Alfonso II ruled from Oviedo, and the kingdom expanded southwards under Alfonso III.

In 924 Fruela II ruled from León, and the Asturian kingdom gave way to the Kingdom of León. From 1388 the heir to the Castilian crown bore the title Prince of Asturias; during the Napoleonic Wars, Asturias rose against the French in 1808.
zh:
穆斯林征服西哥特王国后，佩拉约在伊比利亚半岛北部建立了阿斯图里亚斯王国。他于722年在科瓦东加的胜利后来被视为基督教再征服运动的开端。阿方索二世从奥维耶多统治王国，阿方索三世在位时王国向南扩张。

924年弗鲁埃拉二世从莱昂统治，阿斯图里亚斯王国演变为莱昂王国。自1388年起，卡斯蒂利亚王位继承人使用阿斯图里亚斯亲王的头衔；拿破仑战争期间，阿斯图里亚斯于1808年起兵反抗法国。

en: The Atavillos were a pre-Inca people of the highlands of present-day Lima, Peru, who built the settlement of Rúpac. After Manco Inca's unsuccessful siege of Lima in 1536, the Spanish sent Francisco de Chaves to subdue communities still in revolt in Atavillos and neighbouring districts.
zh: 阿塔维约斯人是今秘鲁利马地区高地的前印加人群，建有鲁帕克聚落。1536年曼科·印卡围攻利马失败后，西班牙人派弗朗西斯科·德·查韦斯镇压阿塔维约斯及邻近地区仍在反抗的村社。

en:
Artaz was the Armenian principality of the Artazian branch of the Amatuni nakharar house, an ancient noble family attested from the fourth century in the canton of Artaz between lakes Van and Urmia. The principality's seat was the castle of Shavarshan, the later town of Maku.

The Amatuni kept to the Armenian Apostolic Church and held the region through Arab, Seljuk and Mongol overlordship; in 1337 the prince of Artaz was a vassal of the Jalayirids in Baghdad. The dynasty weathered Timur's invasion, when its garrison held out through the siege of Maku castle, an episode recorded by the Castilian envoy Clavijo.

A branch of the family kept the fief of Artaz until the early sixteenth century, when Ottoman expansion and the arrival of Kurdish tribes ended Armenian rule in the region.
zh:
阿尔塔兹是阿马图尼家族阿尔塔兹支系的亚美尼亚亲王国。阿马图尼是古老的亚美尼亚贵族世家，4世纪时已见载于凡湖与乌尔米耶湖之间的阿尔塔兹地区，其治所在沙瓦尔尚城堡，即后来的马库。

阿马图尼家族始终信奉亚美尼亚使徒教会，在阿拉伯人、塞尔柱人和蒙古人的宗主权下保有这片土地；1337年时，阿尔塔兹王公是巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的附庸。帖木儿入侵时，其守军在马库城堡围城战中坚守不退，卡斯蒂利亚使臣克拉维约曾记载此事。

该家族的一支继续统治阿尔塔兹领地，直到16世纪初，奥斯曼的扩张和库尔德部落的到来终结了当地的亚美尼亚人统治。

en:
The Arundel lordship was the FitzAlan family's marcher estate on the Shropshire border, centred on Oswestry Castle. A castle stood there by 1086, when Domesday Book records it in Norman hands, and Henry I granted the feudal barony to the Breton knight Alan fitz Flaad, ancestor of the FitzAlans.

The Welsh seized Oswestry in 1149 and held it until 1157. Through marriage the FitzAlans inherited the earldom of Arundel in Sussex in 1243, combining southern rank with a border power base. In 1337 the lord was the young Richard FitzAlan.

Richard FitzAlan became an admiral and fought at Sluys in 1340 and Crecy in 1346. Owain Glyndwr's revolt left Oswestry burned in 1400, and the Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 ended the marcher jurisdiction.
zh:
阿伦德尔领主领是菲查伦家族在什罗普郡边境的边境领产业，以奥斯沃斯特里城堡为中心。1086年的《末日审判书》已记载那里有一座诺曼人掌管的城堡，亨利一世把这块封建男爵领封给布列塔尼骑士艾伦·菲茨弗拉德，他便是菲查伦家族的祖先。

1149年威尔士人攻占奥斯沃斯特里，占据到1157年。1243年，菲查伦家族通过婚姻继承萨塞克斯的阿伦德尔伯爵头衔，把南方爵位与边境权力根基合为一体。1337年的领主是年轻的理查德·菲查伦。

理查德·菲查伦后来成为海军将领，参加1340年的斯鲁伊斯海战和1346年的克雷西战役。1400年欧文·格林杜尔起义中奥斯沃斯特里被焚，1535至1542年的《威尔士法令》终结了边境领的独立司法权。

en:
Augusta Vindelicorum was the Roman name of Augsburg; the Prince-Bishopric of Augsburg was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in Swabia, distinct from the free city of the same name. The prince-bishops kept their residence at Dillingen. Saint Ulrich held the city against the Hungarian siege of 955 before the victory on the Lechfeld.

In the eleventh century the bishops won the right of coinage; in 1337 the see belonged to Ulrich II von Schönegg. During the Reformation Bishop Otto Truchsess von Waldburg led the Catholic revival, founding the university of Dillingen in 1554 and entrusting it to the Jesuits.

The Edict of Restitution of 1629 briefly restored lost church lands, but Swedish troops occupied Augsburg in 1632 and the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 fixed a Catholic and Protestant parity. The prince-bishopric was secularized and handed to Bavaria in 1802.
zh:
奥古斯塔-温德利科鲁姆是奥格斯堡的古罗马名称。奥格斯堡采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国在施瓦本的教会邦国，与同名自由市互不统属，采邑主教驻跸于迪林根。圣乌尔里希在955年马扎尔人围城时坚守城池，为莱希费尔德大捷立下功劳。

11世纪主教取得铸币权，1337年在任的是乌尔里希二世·冯·舍内格。宗教改革时期，主教奥托·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡力推天主教复兴，于1554年在迪林根创办大学并交由耶稣会主持。

1629年的《归还敕令》一度恢复流失的教会地产，但瑞典军队于1632年占领奥格斯堡，1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》确立天主教与新教的对等地位。1802年，采邑主教区被世俗化并划归巴伐利亚。

en:
The County of Aumale, called Albemarle by the English, stood on the River Bresle on the border between Normandy and Picardy. William the Conqueror made the town a county for his half-sister Adelaide of Normandy, and Norman and English lords held it until Philip II of France captured the castle in 1196 during the conquest of Normandy.

The crown then granted it through the houses of Dammartin and Castile. The Castilian line included John I, who fell at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, and his son John II, count until his death in 1343, who held Aumale in 1337.

During the Hundred Years' War the English kings repeatedly granted the title of Aumale to their own magnates. The French county afterwards passed to the Harcourts and then the Lorraines, and in 1547 it was raised to a duchy for Francis of Lorraine.
zh:
欧马勒伯国地处诺曼底与皮卡第交界处的布雷勒河畔，英格兰人后来称之为阿尔伯马尔。征服者威廉把这座城镇封为伯国，授予同父异母的姐姐诺曼底的阿德莱德，此后由诺曼和英格兰贵族领有，直到1196年腓力二世在征服诺曼底时攻占其城堡。

王室后来将它封给达马尔坦家族和卡斯蒂利亚家族：卡斯蒂利亚支系的约翰一世于1302年战死在金马刺战役，其子约翰二世任伯爵直至1343年去世，1337年时正领有欧马勒。

百年战争期间，英格兰国王屡次把欧马勒头衔封给本国重臣。法兰西方面的伯国后来转入阿库尔家族，再归洛林家族，1547年为洛林的弗朗索瓦升格为公国。

en:
Auvergne is a mountainous country in south-central France, taking its name from the Arverni, the Gallic tribe whose chieftain Vercingetorix led the revolt against Julius Caesar in 52 BC. It passed from the Visigoths to the Franks in 507, and later its lands split into several fiefs, including the County of Auvergne formed around 980.

At Clermont in 1095 Pope Urban II preached the First Crusade. In 1332 the county passed to the child countess Joan I, whose marriage in 1350 to the future John II of France made her queen of France.

Raided during the Hundred Years' War, the county later passed to the House of La Tour d'Auvergne and in 1531 to Catherine de' Medici before becoming royal domain; in 1790 the province was divided into departments.
zh:
奥弗涅是法兰西中南部的山地，其名来自高卢部族阿维尔尼人——公元前52年，首领维钦托利领导了反抗尤利乌斯·恺撒的起义。它507年从西哥特人转入法兰克人之手，后来分裂为数块封地，包括约980年形成的奥弗涅伯国。

1095年，教皇乌尔班二世在克莱蒙布道，号召第一次十字军东征。1332年伯国传给年幼的女伯爵让娜一世，1350年她嫁给后来的法兰西国王约翰二世，由此成为法兰西王后。

百年战争期间此地屡遭袭扰，伯国后来转入拉图尔·德奥弗涅家族，1531年归凯瑟琳·德·美第奇所有，最终成为王室领地；1790年奥弗涅旧行省被划分为多个省份。

en:
The County of Auxerre, centred on Auxerre on the Yonne river in northern Burgundy, was one of the oldest fiefs of the West Frankish kingdom. Around 859 Charles the Bald granted it to Conrad of the Welf family, and it later passed into the Burgundian dominion of Richard the Justiciar.

For two and a half centuries Auxerre was ruled together with Nevers and Tonnerre, until the three were divided among the daughters of Countess Mahaut II in 1262. It then came to the House of Chalon, and in 1337 its count was John II of Chalon, held prisoner in London during the Hundred Years' War.

His son John III sold the county to King Charles V in 1370; the Treaty of Arras assigned it to the Duchy of Burgundy in 1435, and the French crown recovered it in 1477.
zh:
欧塞尔伯国以勃艮第北部约讷河畔的欧塞尔为中心，是西法兰克王国最古老的封地之一。约859年，秃头查理把它封给韦尔夫家族的康拉德，后来并入正义者理查的勃艮第领地。

在此后两个半世纪里，欧塞尔与讷韦尔、托内尔合并统治，直到1262年三地被女伯爵玛奥二世的女儿们瓜分。后来伯国遂转入沙隆家族，1337年在位的是沙隆的约翰二世，在百年战争中被囚于伦敦。

其子约翰三世于1370年把伯国卖给法王查理五世；1435年的《阿拉斯条约》将它划归勃艮第公国，1477年法兰西王室将其收回。

en:
The Guaraní were related indigenous peoples living between the Paraná and Paraguay rivers and across parts of southern Brazil. Their villages grew manioc and maize, and families shared large communal houses under local chiefs.

In the early seventeenth century Jesuits established missions among the Guaraní. The 1750 Treaty of Madrid ordered seven missions east of the Uruguay River to move; their inhabitants resisted under Sepé Tiaraju, but Spanish and Portuguese forces defeated them at Caiboaté in 1756.
zh:
瓜拉尼是居住在巴拉那河与巴拉圭河之间以及巴西南部部分地区的亲缘原住民族群。他们在村落里种植木薯和玉米，多个家庭在地方首领治下共住大屋。

17世纪初，耶稣会士在瓜拉尼人中建立传教村。1750年的《马德里条约》要求乌拉圭河以东的七个传教村迁移；居民在塞佩·蒂亚拉茹领导下抵抗，但于1756年在凯博阿特被西班牙和葡萄牙联军击败。

en:
Avaria, also called the Avar Nutsaldom after its ruler the nutsal, was the highland state of the Avar people in the mountains of Dagestan, seated at Khunzakh. Christianity, brought from Georgia, lingered in its valleys until the fourteenth or fifteenth century, and although the Golden Horde overran the country in 1241, the Avar khans kept their practical independence through the fourteenth century.

The rise of a neighbouring shamkhalate after the Golden Horde's fifteenth-century collapse narrowed their power. Caught between the Ottomans and the Safavids in the sixteenth century, the Avar tribes adopted Islam in the seventeenth century.

In 1741 they destroyed the army of Nader Shah in the Dagestan mountains, and under Umma-Khan, who ruled from 1775 to 1801, neighbouring rulers paid them tribute. The khanate submitted to Russia in 1803, and Russian rule drove the highlanders into the Muslim imamate's rising from the late 1820s.
zh:
阿瓦尔又称阿瓦尔努茨尔邦，得名于统治者称号努茨尔，是阿瓦尔人在达吉斯坦山区的高地政权，统治中心在洪扎赫。格鲁吉亚传入的基督教在山谷中延续到14或15世纪；1241年金帐汗国虽攻占此地，阿瓦尔诸汗在14世纪仍保持实际独立。

15世纪金帐汗国崩溃后，邻近沙姆哈尔国兴起，压缩了阿瓦尔汗的权势。16世纪夹在奥斯曼与萨法维两强之间的阿瓦尔诸部于17世纪改宗伊斯兰教。

1741年，他们在达吉斯坦山区歼灭纳迪尔沙的大军；1775—1801年乌玛汗在位时，邻近统治者向其纳贡。1803年汗国归附俄国，俄国的统治又迫使山民从19世纪20年代末起投身穆斯林伊玛目的起义。

en: The Avoyel lived along the Red River near its junction with the Atchafalaya in present-day Louisiana, with a palisaded village near Marksville. French records counted 280 Avoyel in 1698; their numbers fell sharply thereafter. By the late eighteenth century survivors had intermarried with neighbouring Tunica, Ofo and Biloxi communities.
zh: 阿沃耶尔人居住在今路易斯安那州红河与阿查法拉亚河交汇处附近，在马克斯维尔附近有一座围有栅栏的村庄。法国记录称1698年有280名阿沃耶尔人，此后人口急剧减少。到18世纪末，幸存者已与附近的图尼卡、奥福和比洛克西人通婚。

en:
Te Āti Awa were a Māori iwi whose ancestral lands lay in Taranaki on New Zealand's North Island. Their traditions identify Te Awanuiarangi as an ancestor, and Mount Taranaki as sacred.

During the Musket Wars, Te Āti Awa fought Waikato forces and won at Motunui in 1822. Continuing pressure encouraged migrations south, including a movement to Wellington Harbour around 1824 and another to Petone in 1832.
zh:
特阿提亚瓦是毛利人的一个部族，祖地位于新西兰北岛的塔拉纳基。其传统视特阿瓦努伊阿朗伊为祖先，并尊塔拉纳基山为圣山。

在火枪战争中，特阿提亚瓦与怀卡托部族交战，1822年在莫图努伊取胜。持续的压力促使族人南迁，其中一批约于1824年迁至惠灵顿港，另一批于1832年迁至佩托内。

en:
The Awori are a subgroup of the Yoruba whose homeland lies at the southwestern edge of Yorubaland, among the creeks and lagoons of the Guinea coast. Tradition holds that they moved down the Ogun river under their ruler Olofin, and their earliest centre was Isheri on the lower Ogun.

As lagoon trade grew, their chief settlements shifted from Ebute-Metta to Iddo and then to the island of Èkó, a fishing and farming hamlet whose name means farmstead in Yoruba.

In the sixteenth century the Benin kingdom brought Èkó under its control and installed obas, while Portuguese traders, visiting the coast from about 1472, drew the lagoon towns into Atlantic commerce. Through these changes the Awori kept their Yoruba dialect and Isese faith, living by fishing, farming and waterborne trade that linked them to Ijebu.
zh:
阿沃里人是约鲁巴人的一支，传统家园在约鲁巴兰西南边缘、几内亚沿海的河汊与潟湖之间。相传他们在首领奥洛芬率领下沿奥贡河迁徙，最早的中心在奥贡河下游的伊谢里。

随着潟湖贸易兴盛，聚居中心先从埃布特梅塔迁至伊多，最后转到以渔耕为生的岛村埃科；在约鲁巴语里，埃科意为农庄。

16世纪，贝宁王国控制埃科并册立奥巴；约1472年起葡萄牙商人到访海岸，把潟湖诸城带入大西洋贸易。在此变局中，阿沃里人保留约鲁巴方言和奥里沙教信仰，以捕鱼、农耕和水上贸易为生，与伊杰布往来。

en:
Aussa was a Muslim polity in the Afar lowlands of the Horn of Africa. In 1577 Muhammad Gasa moved his seat from Harar to Aussa, establishing an imamate after Adal's division; Harar broke away in 1647.

In 1734 the Afar leader Data Kadafo established the Mudaito dynasty in Aussa. His successors ruled a sultanate whose primacy other Afar rulers nominally acknowledged. Sultan Hanfadhe Aydahis consolidated Mudaito control with victory at Darma in 1834.
zh:
奥萨是非洲之角阿法尔低地的穆斯林政权。1577年穆罕默德·加萨将统治中心从哈勒尔迁到奥萨，在阿达尔分裂后建立伊玛目国；哈勒尔于1647年脱离。

1734年阿法尔首领达塔·卡达福在奥萨建立穆代托王朝。他的继承者统治的苏丹国在名义上获得其他阿法尔统治者的尊奉。苏丹汉法德·艾达希斯于1834年在达尔马取胜，巩固了穆代托人的统治。

en:
Axochiapan, whose Nahuatl name means place of water flowers after the white lilies that carpet its ponds and streams, lies in the warm valley of the Amatzinac River in the southeastern corner of Morelos.

Human settlement in the district goes back to Olmec times, when the nearby centre of Chalcatzingo dominated the area, but the town itself was a Tlahuica community, one of the Nahua groups that settled eastern Morelos from the early fourteenth century.

Axochiapan appears in the Mexica tribute rolls as one of the towns of Tlalnahuac, the cotton country subdued for the Aztec Empire under Moctezuma I around 1440. Like its neighbours it passed to the Spanish crown when Gonzalo de Sandoval's troops overran the district in March 1521. Franciscan and later Augustinian friars put up its first churches in the sixteenth century.
zh:
阿索奇亚潘的纳瓦特尔语名字意为水花之地，得名于铺满池塘溪流的白色睡莲；它坐落在莫雷洛斯东南角阿马齐纳克河的暖谷中。

这一带的人类居住史可上溯到奥尔梅克时期，当时邻近的查尔卡钦戈是区域中心；城镇本身则是特拉维卡人的聚落，特拉维卡人是14世纪初起定居莫雷洛斯东部的纳瓦支系之一。

阿索奇亚潘出现在墨西加人的贡税册中，是特拉尔纳瓦克的城镇之一；这片产棉之地在1440年前后被蒙特祖马一世为阿兹特克帝国征服。1521年3月桑多瓦尔的军队攻占该地区后，它与邻邦一同转归西班牙王室，16世纪方济各会及后来的奥斯定会修士建起最早的教堂。

en:
Axocopan, whose Nahuatl name means place of bitter waters, was an Otomi polity in the arid northern region called Teotlalpan, the present-day Mezquital Valley in the state of Hidalgo.

After the fall of Tula in the twelfth century the region was settled by Otomi and Nahua groups who built a string of small kingdoms, and in the later fourteenth century these were conquered by the Tepanecs of Azcapotzalco.

Axocopan kept its own rulers until the Aztec expansion under Moctezuma I in the middle of the fifteenth century, when it submitted. It became one of the strategic provinces of the Aztec empire, whose hold on the north was fully consolidated only under Ahuitzotl in 1488.
zh:
阿霍科潘的纳瓦特尔语名字意为苦水之地，是干旱北部特奥特拉尔潘地区的一个奥托米人政权，其地即今伊达尔戈州的梅斯基塔尔谷地。

12世纪图拉灭亡后，奥托米人和纳瓦人迁入这一地区，建立起一连串小王国；14世纪后期，这些小邦被阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克人征服。

阿霍科潘保留了自己的统治者，直到15世纪中期蒙特祖马一世发动阿兹特克扩张时才臣服。它成为阿兹特克帝国的战略行省之一，帝国对北方的控制到1488年阿维索特尔在位时才完全巩固。

en:
The Ayarmaca were the leading chiefdom of the Cusco region in the two centuries before Inca supremacy. Emerging around the thirteenth century from the ruins of the Wari culture, they built a state the Spanish sources credit with eighteen towns, controlling the country north and northwest of Cusco, including Pisac, their assigned seat in 1337.

The Ayarmaca overshadowed the Inca polity and warred with it for roughly two hundred years. Their king Tocay Capac, the ruler shown in 1337, fought the Inca lords Sinchi Roca and Lloque Yupanqui, and the chronicles make him captor of the young prince Titu Cusi Huallpa.

Towards the end of the fourteenth century the Chankas pressed the Ayarmaca from the south and west. After the Incas under Pachacuti broke Chanka power in the 1430s, the Ayarmaca domains were split into three chiefdoms and absorbed into the Inca Empire.
zh:
阿亚尔马卡是印卡称霸前库斯科地区首屈一指的酋长国。它约在13世纪从瓦里文化的废墟上兴起，西班牙史料称其拥有十八座城镇，控制库斯科以北和西北的土地，包括1337年作为其治所的皮萨克。

阿亚尔马卡令印卡城邦相形见绌，双方交战约两百年。1337年在任的首领托凯·卡帕克曾与印卡首领辛奇·罗卡、略克·尤潘基作战，史籍还记载他曾俘获年幼的王子蒂图·库西·瓦尔帕。

14世纪末，昌卡人从南面和西面逼近阿亚尔马卡。1430年代帕查库特克率领印卡人击溃昌卡势力后，阿亚尔马卡的领地被拆成三个酋长国，随后并入印卡帝国。

en:
The Aydınids were a Turkoman naval beylik on the Aegean coast of Anatolia, ruled from Birgi and famed for seaborne raiding. The sons of Aydın, led by Mehmed Bey, seized Ephesus in 1304; Mehmed made himself an independent emir after eliminating his rival in 1308.

His son Umur, called the Lion, completed the long siege of Smyrna in 1329 and turned the port into a pirate base. In 1337 Umur commanded a fleet said to number three hundred and fifty ships, and his attacks on Christian shipping drew the Smyrniote crusade, proclaimed in 1343; a Christian coalition took Smyrna in 1348 and Umur died storming its walls.

The beylik passed to Umur's brother Hızır and to İsa, fell to the Ottomans in 1390, was briefly restored by Timur in 1402, and was permanently absorbed after the fall of its last bey Junayd in 1425.
zh:
艾登王朝是安纳托利亚爱琴海沿岸的突厥蛮海上贝伊国，以比尔吉为统治中心，以海上袭击闻名。艾登诸子在穆罕默德贝伊率领下于1304年攻占以弗所，穆罕默德1308年除掉竞争者后自立为埃米尔。

他的儿子绰号狮子的乌穆尔1329年结束对士麦那的长期围攻，把港口变成海盗基地。1337年，乌穆尔拥有据称多达三百五十艘船的舰队；他对基督徒商船的劫掠招致1343年发起的士麦那十字军，1348年基督教联军攻陷士麦那，乌穆尔在攻城时战死。

贝伊国先后传给乌穆尔的兄弟赫泽尔和伊萨，1390年被奥斯曼吞并，1402年由帖木儿短暂恢复，末代贝伊居内伊德败亡后于1425年永久并入奥斯曼。

en:
Ayotlan, later known as Ayutla, was a Tlapanec town of the Costa Chica, the hot coastal belt of eastern Guerrero, lying on the border of Yopitzinco, land of the related Yopi people. Its districts mixed Nahuatl speakers on the coastal plain with Tlapanec speakers in the inland hills, and the region drew wealth from gold and cacao.

Long independent of Tenochtitlan, the area was conquered by the Aztec Empire, probably under Ahuitzotl in the 1480s, and turned into the strategic province of Ayotlan, which sent twice-yearly tribute of cotton, fish, jaguar and deer skins, gourds and gold bars.

Warfare with the Yopi and rival towns led the Mexica to post a garrison and a calpixqui, or tribute steward, in the province. Spanish forces overran the coast in the 1520s and Ayutla became a colonial town of the Costa Chica.
zh:
阿约特兰即后来的阿尤特拉，是科斯塔奇卡（格雷罗东部炎热沿海地带）的一座特拉帕内克人城镇，毗邻同族约皮人的土地约皮钦科。辖区里沿海平原多为纳瓦特尔语居民，内陆山地讲特拉帕内克语，当地以黄金和可可为财富来源。

这里长期独立于特诺奇蒂特兰之外，可能在1480年代阿维索特尔在位时被阿兹特克帝国征服，改设为战略要地阿约特兰省，每年两次缴纳棉花、鱼、美洲豹皮和鹿皮、葫芦及金锭。

由于与约皮人及敌对城镇交战，墨西加人在该省派驻守军和名为卡尔皮斯基的贡赋官。1520年代西班牙军队攻占海岸，阿尤特拉成为科斯塔奇卡的殖民城镇。

en:
Ayutthaya was a Thai kingdom founded in 1351 around its capital in the Chao Phraya valley. It became a Burmese vassal in 1569 but regained independence in 1584. Under King Narai, Ayutthaya traded widely and sent an embassy to the French court of Louis XIV in 1686.

In 1765 Burmese armies invaded from the north and west and converged on the capital. After a fourteen-month siege, they took and destroyed Ayutthaya in 1767, ending the kingdom.
zh:
阿瑜陀耶是1351年建立的泰人王国，以湄南河流域的阿瑜陀耶城为首都。1569年王国成为缅甸的附庸，1584年重获独立。纳莱王在位时，阿瑜陀耶广泛开展贸易，并于1686年派遣使团前往法国路易十四的宫廷。

1765年，缅军从北方和西方入侵，在都城会合。经过14个月的围攻，缅军于1767年攻陷并摧毁阿瑜陀耶，王国随之灭亡。

en:
Al-Zafir, more fully the Dhafeer, is a Bedouin Arab tribe of the Tayy stock; genealogists derive them from the Banu Lam and place their ancestral grazing grounds at al-Dhaghn, opposite Medina. In that earliest period their camps lay in the desert east of the holy city, around the wells and pastures there.

Having no fixed settlements, the tribe spread by raiding and migration, moving first into central Najd and then to the deserts of northern Najd, southern Iraq and Kuwait, earning the nickname People of Flowing Hair and Camel Caravans because even their women and children rode along on their raids.

In 1782 a Dhafeer cavalry contingent answered the call of the House of Khalifa of Kuwait, sailed to Bahrain and fought in the Battle of Zubarah, which ended Zand Persian rule over the island.
zh:
扎菲尔，全称达菲尔，是泰伊系的贝都因阿拉伯部落。谱系学家把他们归入巴努·拉姆，将其祖居牧场定在麦地那对面的达甘。最早的时候，他们的营地散布在圣城以东的沙漠里，围绕当地的水井与牧场活动。

由于没有固定居地，全族靠劫掠和迁徙向外扩散，先进入内志中部，再深入内志北部、伊拉克南部和科威特的沙漠；他们连妇女儿童都随队出征，因而得到垂发与驼队之民的绰号。

1782年，一支达菲尔骑兵应科威特哈利法家族之召渡海前往巴林，参加祖巴拉战役，此役终结了赞德王朝波斯人对该岛的统治。

en:
Aztatlán was a pre-Hispanic señorío on the Pacific coast of north-western Mesoamerica, stretching from the Acaponeta river in what is now northern Nayarit to the San Pedro river in southern Sinaloa; its Nahuatl name means the kingdom of the place of herons.

It had no large cities but many small villages, Tecuala and Mexcaltitán among them, and the chiefdoms of Centispac, Acaponeta and Tzapotzinco paid it tribute. Its people spoke Nayarita Nahuatl, while Cora, Tepehuán and Totorame communities also lived within its borders.

Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's expedition overran the señorío in 1530 and pushed on into Sinaloa in 1531. Its coast had earlier been the heartland of the Aztatlán trading culture that flourished from about 850 to 1350.
zh:
阿兹塔特兰是美索美洲西北太平洋沿岸征服前的领主邦，辖地从今纳亚里特北部的阿卡波内塔河延伸到锡那罗亚南部的圣佩德罗河，纳瓦特尔语意为苍鹭之地的王国。

境内没有大城市，只有众多小村庄，特夸拉和梅斯卡尔蒂坦都在其中，森蒂斯帕克、阿卡波内塔和察波钦科等邦向它纳贡。居民讲纳亚里特纳瓦特尔语，境内还散居着科拉人、特佩万人和托托拉姆人。

1530年，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的远征军攻灭该邦，并于1531年继续向锡那罗亚推进。更早的时候，这片海岸还是约850—1350年兴盛的阿兹塔特兰贸易文化的中心地带。

en:
The Aztec Empire began in 1428 as an alliance of the Nahua city-states of Tenochtitlan, Tetzcoco and Tlacopan in the Valley of Mexico. The allies conquered much of central Mexico, leaving local rulers in place in return for tribute and military support. Tenochtitlan became the dominant partner and the effective imperial capital.

In 1519 Hernán Cortés arrived on the Mexican coast and made alliances with peoples opposed to Aztec rule. After a smallpox epidemic, his Spanish and Indigenous forces, especially Tlaxcalans, besieged Tenochtitlan and captured it in 1521.
zh:
阿兹特克帝国始于1428年墨西哥谷地三个纳瓦城邦的联盟：特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科和特拉科潘。盟军征服了墨西哥中部大片地区，保留当地统治者，换取贡赋和军事支持。特诺奇蒂特兰成为联盟中的主导者和帝国实际上的首都。

1519年埃尔南·科尔特斯抵达墨西哥海岸，与反对阿兹特克统治的族群结盟。天花流行之后，他的西班牙军队和原住民盟军，尤其是特拉斯卡拉人，围攻特诺奇蒂特兰，并于1521年攻陷该城。

en:
The Bara were zebu herders of Madagascar's southern central plateau, with a historic center at Ihosy. Around 1640 a Mahafaly noble imposed his family as rulers under the name Zafimanely, but rivalry among the nobles unsettled Bara territory until around 1680.

Around 1800 King Raikitroka introduced regulations that eased internal tensions. After his death the ruling line split into several kingdoms; the Merina established a garrison at Ihosy but did not fully subjugate the Bara.
zh:
巴拉人是马达加斯加中部高原南部的瘤牛牧民，历史中心位于伊胡西。约1640年，一位马哈法利贵族将自己的家族立为统治者，称扎菲马内利；但贵族之间的争斗使巴拉地区动荡，直到约1680年才平息。

约1800年，国王赖基特鲁卡制定规章，缓和了内部矛盾。他死后统治家族分裂为多个王国；梅里纳人在伊胡西设立驻军，却未能完全征服巴拉人。

en:
Bacan was one of the four kingdoms of Maluku, ruling the mountainous Bacan group south of Ternate from its chief town Amasing on the main island's isthmus. Its earliest rulers kept their seat on Kasiruta and drew wealth from cloves. In 1337 it was still ruled under the old local cults, its elite only accepting Islam around the late fifteenth century.

The first Portuguese fleet to reach the Moluccas opened a trading post there in 1513, and in 1557 a missionary converted the sultan and his court to Catholicism. Invasions from Ternate after 1570 forced the ruler back to Islam and reduced Bacan to intermittent vassalage.

After the Dutch East India Company gained hegemony in 1609, its power rested on Fort Barnaveld, and the sultanate became a Dutch protectorate bound by the clove monopoly. In 1705 the fort's officers seized the English explorer William Dampier for breaking it.
zh:
巴占是摩鹿加四大王国之一，统治特尔纳特以南多山的巴占群岛，重镇是主岛地峡上的阿马辛。最早的君主驻跸于卡斯鲁塔岛，靠丁香贸易致富。1337年时它仍信奉本土古老信仰，统治阶层约在15世纪末才改宗伊斯兰教。

1513年，第一支抵达摩鹿加的葡萄牙船队在此设立商馆；1557年一名传教士使苏丹及其宫廷皈依天主教。1570年以后特尔纳特屡次入侵，迫使君主改回伊斯兰教，巴占也沦为时断时续的附庸。

1609年荷兰东印度公司确立霸权后，依托巴尔纳费尔德堡控制此地，巴占苏丹国成为受丁香垄断条约约束的荷兰保护国，1705年该堡守军还以违反垄断为由扣押了英国探险家威廉·丹皮尔。

en:
Baudh, on the middle Mahanadi in western Orissa, grew out of the old Bhanja country of the Khinjali mandala, whose capital Dhritipura stood on the site of modern Boudh.

The Bhanjas were an ancient line of Kshatriya chiefs whose peafowl emblem and peahen founding myth went back to early medieval times; they ruled as feudatories first of the Bhauma-Kara kings and then of the Somavamshis, until the Eastern Gangas absorbed the region and installed chieftains as tributaries.

In the fourteenth century a childless Brahmin chief of Baudh adopted a nephew of the Bhanja raja of Keonjhar; the prince took the name Ananga Deva and made himself raja of Baudh, founding the line that ruled when the Garhjat chiefs came under Maratha tribute in the eighteenth century and British protection after 1803.
zh:
包特位于奥里萨西部的默哈讷迪河中游，其前身是古老班杰人经营的金贾利曼陀罗，其都城德里蒂普拉就在今包特城一带。

班杰人是古老的刹帝利首领世系，孔雀徽记和雌孔雀起源传说可追溯到中世纪早期，他们先后作为巴乌马-卡拉诸王和索马瓦姆希王朝的附庸，直到东恒伽王朝吞并该地，改由首领纳贡称臣。

14世纪，包特一位没有子嗣的婆罗门首领收养了克翁贾尔班杰王的侄子；这位王子取名阿能伽·提婆，自立为包特王，开创的王统一直延续到18世纪——那时迦尔贾德诸邦向马拉塔人纳贡，1803年后又归入英国保护。

en: Bagua refers to a people of the Marañón basin in northern Peru, where the Bagua language was recorded. At the time of the Spanish conquest, the region had many distinct languages.
zh: 巴瓜指秘鲁北部马拉尼翁河流域的人群，当地曾记录到巴瓜语。西班牙征服时，这一地区通行着多种不同的语言。

en:
The Bahmani Sultanate arose on India's Deccan plateau in 1347, when Zafar Khan took power during a revolt against the Delhi Sultanate. Its rulers fought the Vijayanagara Empire to the south, and Ahmad Shah I moved the capital to Bidar in the fifteenth century.

The minister Mahmud Gawan expanded the sultanate and founded a madrasa at Bidar in 1472, but was executed in 1481 amid factional conflict. Provincial governors began establishing independent sultanates in 1490; the Bahmani dynasty formally ended in 1527.
zh:
巴赫曼尼苏丹国于1347年兴起于印度德干高原，当时扎法尔汗在反抗德里苏丹国的叛乱中掌权。苏丹国与南方的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国交战，艾哈迈德沙阿一世于15世纪将首都迁至比德尔。

大臣马哈茂德·加万扩大了苏丹国的疆域，并于1472年在比德尔创办经学院，却在派系斗争中于1481年被处死。1490年起，各省总督开始建立独立的苏丹国；巴赫曼尼王朝于1527年正式终结。

en:
