14世纪末起詹达尔人面临奥斯曼扩张：1391年苏莱曼二世在抵御巴耶济德一世攻打卡斯塔莫努时战死；伊斯凡迪亚尔贝伊成为奥斯曼附庸，1402年帖木儿击败巴耶济德后，其统治权获得确认。该王朝后来又称伊斯凡迪亚尔王朝，在锡诺普保持自治，直到1461年穆罕默德二世攻占该城，吞并贝伊国。

en: The Caüinachis were an Opatan group in Sonora, associated with towns including Tonichi and Mátape. In the seventeenth century the Jesuits established a mission at Tonichi near the Yaqui River.
zh: 卡维纳奇斯人是索诺拉的奥帕塔族群之一，与托尼奇和马塔佩等城镇有关。17世纪，耶稣会士在亚基河附近的托尼奇建立了传教区。

en: The Chinook comprised Indigenous communities along the Columbia River and the nearby Pacific coast, in present-day Oregon and Washington. They lived in settled villages, fished for salmon and traded along the river; wealthy traders and warriors held high status. In 1805 the Lewis and Clark expedition encountered Chinook people on the lower Columbia.
zh: 奇努克人由哥伦比亚河及附近太平洋海岸的原住民社群组成，居住地在今俄勒冈州和华盛顿州境内。他们定居于村落，捕捞鲑鱼并沿河贸易；富有的商人和战士地位较高。1805年，刘易斯和克拉克探险队在哥伦比亚河下游遇到了奇努克人。

en:
Ah Canul was a Maya kuchkabal on the northwest Yucatán plain, ruled from Calkiní by the Canul lineage. The Canul were guards of foreign origin, perhaps from Tabasco, whom the Cocom of Mayapan had hired as mercenaries in their long feud with the Xiu.

When Mayapan fell in the wars of 1441 to 1461, the discharged guards moved west, and in 1443 eight local lords met under a ceiba tree at Calkiní to found their polity; its name means the protectors. They first chose Ah Tzab Canul as halach uinik, but after his death the eight batabob governed as a senate rather than crown a new king.

During the third Spanish invasion the lords rejected alliance, and Calkiní's men fought Francisco de Montejo's nephew's column before being overwhelmed; the Spaniards took Calkiní and neighboring towns in 1541.
zh:
阿卡努尔是尤卡坦平原西北部的玛雅城邦，由卡努尔家族以卡尔基尼为中心统治。卡努尔人是外来武士，可能来自塔巴斯科，玛雅潘的科科姆家族在与休族的长期争斗中雇他们充当雇佣兵。

1441—1461年内战中玛雅潘覆灭，被遣散的武士西迁，1443年八位地方首领在卡尔基尼的一棵木棉树下集会，建立自己的城邦，国名意为“守护者”。他们先推举阿·察布·卡努尔为最高统治者，他死后八位首领不再拥立新君，改以元老院议事治国。

西班牙人第三次入侵时，各首领拒绝结盟，卡尔基尼人迎战弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍之侄的部队，最终不敌；1541年西班牙人进占卡尔基尼及邻近城镇。

en:
Connacht, the western fifth of Ireland beyond the Shannon, was the kingdom of the Connachta dynasties. Its ruling O'Conor house held the kingship from 1102 and produced Ruaidrí, the last high king, whose quarrel with Diarmait Mac Murchada brought the Anglo-Normans.

Civil war let Richard Mór de Burgh into Connacht in the 1230s, but after the Earl of Ulster's murder in 1333 the Norman colony shrank and the Burkes Gaelicised, leaving the O'Conors a reduced kingdom around Roscommon. The dynasty split into O'Conor Don and O'Conor Roe branches; the last fully recognised king of Connacht died in 1474.

The Tudors created the Presidency of Connacht in 1569, and the Composition of 1585 turned chiefly lands into crown baronies. Connacht became the heartland of Confederate Ireland, suffered the Cromwellian conquest, and Aughrim in 1691 sealed Jacobite defeat; the O'Conor Don survived at Clonalis.
zh:
康诺特是香农河以西的爱尔兰西陲，康诺塔诸王朝的王国。奥康纳家族自1102年世袭王位，出末代至高王鲁艾德瑞；他与迪尔梅德·麦克默罗冲突，引盎格鲁-诺曼人登岛。

13世纪30年代内战使理查德·莫尔·德·伯格进入康诺特；1333年阿尔斯特伯爵遇刺后殖民地收缩，伯克家族盖尔化，奥康纳仅保住罗斯康芒的缩水王国。王朝分奥康纳·唐、奥康纳·罗两支，末代获普遍承认的康诺特国王1474年去世。

1569年都铎设康诺特总督区，1585年《康诺特协定》把首领领地改为王室男爵区。后为天主教联盟爱尔兰腹地，遭克伦威尔征服；1691年奥赫里姆之战定詹姆斯党败局，奥康纳·唐家族在克洛纳利斯存续。

en:
The Chono were canoe-borne hunter-gatherers of the Chiloé, Guaitecas and Chonos archipelagos off southern Chile. They first encountered Europeans when Francisco de Ulloa's expedition reached their lands in 1553. After a Spanish decree in 1608, raids from Chiloé carried Chono into slavery and servitude.

In 1710 a group fleeing internal conflicts reached Calbuco and was settled on Guar Island. In the 1740s Spanish fears of British incursions prompted removals to Chiloé, while other Chono moved south of the Taitao Peninsula.
zh:
乔诺人是智利南部沿海奇洛埃、瓜伊特卡斯和乔诺斯群岛上乘独木舟往来的狩猎采集者。1553年，弗朗西斯科·德·乌略亚的远征队抵达他们的土地，双方首次相遇。1608年西班牙颁布法令后，来自奇洛埃的袭击者将乔诺人掳去充当奴隶和劳役者。

1710年，一批逃离内部冲突的乔诺人抵达卡尔武科，被安置在瓜尔岛。1740年代，西班牙人担心英国入侵，将居民迁往奇洛埃，另有乔诺人南迁至泰陶半岛以南。

en:
The Guanche were the indigenous peoples of the Canary Islands, whose language was related to the Berber languages of North Africa. Tenerife was divided among nine kingdoms when Castilian conquerors arrived; Taoro, ruled by Bencomo, was among the strongest.

Castile began conquering the islands in 1402 and completed the conquest in 1496. Many islanders died during the conquest, and survivors were assimilated into the new population.
zh:
关切人是加那利群岛的原住民，其语言与北非的柏柏尔语有关。卡斯蒂利亚征服者到来时，特内里费岛分为九个王国；本科莫统治的陶罗是其中最强大的王国之一。

卡斯蒂利亚于1402年开始征服群岛，1496年完成征服。许多岛民在征服期间死亡，幸存者被融入新的人口之中。

en:
Cainta was a fortified Tagalog settlement on the river draining Laguna de Bay, east of Manila. When the Spaniards arrived in the 1570s its people had turned the riverside bamboo groves into a thick lash-and-liana wall behind ramparts and water-filled moats, with stone bulwarks and bronze lantaka cannon covering the approaches.

In August 1571 Miguel López de Legazpi sent his nephew Juan de Salcedo with Spanish soldiers and Visayan allies against Cainta and neighbouring Taytay. The chiefs rejected his peace offer and fought from their fort, but mortar fire and an assault over the walls carried the town, which joined the new Spanish colony.

Formally established as a town on 15 August 1571, Cainta became one of Luzon's oldest municipalities. During the British occupation of Manila of 1762 to 1763, mutinous Tamil sepoys settled there and intermarried with the local Tagalog population.
zh:
卡伊安塔是马尼拉以东、内湖出水河畔的设防他加禄人聚落。16世纪70年代西班牙人到来时，当地人把沿河竹林用藤条扎成厚墙，墙内有护墙和注满水的壕沟，石砌棱堡与青铜兰塔卡炮封锁通道。

1571年8月，米格尔·洛佩斯·德·莱加斯皮派侄子胡安·德·萨尔塞多率西班牙士兵和米沙鄢同盟军攻打卡伊安塔及邻近的泰泰。首领拒绝议和，凭要塞据守，但臼炮轰击与越墙强攻破城，卡伊安塔并入新建的西班牙殖民地。

它1571年8月15日正式设镇，是吕宋最古老的市镇之一。1762年至1763年英军占领马尼拉期间，哗变的泰米尔印度兵在此定居，与当地他加禄人通婚。

en:
Canavese is the hill country between Turin and the Graian Alps, centred on Ivrea, the Roman colony of Eporedia, founded in 100 BC. After Rome fell Canavese passed to the Lombards, who made Ivrea a ducal seat, then to the Franks, under whom it became the March of Ivrea; Margrave Arduin crowned himself king of Italy in the early eleventh century.

When his line failed, self-styled counts of his descent split the region among their castles. Ivrea became a free commune in the twelfth century, later disputed between its bishops, the marquises of Montferrat and House of Savoy. In 1337 the effective ruler was Bishop Palladio Avogadro, who had taken the see in 1326.

Amadeus VI, the Green Count of Savoy, took Ivrea in 1356 and built its brick castle the next year. Canavese later shared French and Spanish occupations of Piedmont before returning to Savoy in 1814.
zh:
卡纳韦塞是都灵与格拉耶山之间的丘陵地带，以伊夫雷亚为中心，该城即公元前100年设立的罗马殖民地埃波雷迪亚。罗马灭亡后，卡纳韦塞先归伦巴第人，伊夫雷亚成为公国都城；卡纳韦塞后转入法兰克人之手，成为伊夫雷亚侯国；侯爵阿杜因11世纪初加冕为意大利国王。

阿杜因王朝绝嗣后，自称其后裔的众伯爵瓜分土地，各据城堡。伊夫雷亚12世纪成为自由公社，后在本地主教、蒙费拉托侯爵与萨伏依家族之间反复争夺。1337年实际掌权者是主教帕拉迪奥·阿沃加德罗，他1326年接掌主教区。

萨伏依绿伯爵阿梅迪奥六世1356年取得伊夫雷亚，次年筑砖砌城堡。卡纳韦塞后来随皮埃蒙特历经法国与西班牙占领，1814年复归萨伏依。

en:
The Cocom were the ruling Maya dynasty of Mayapan, the dominant power of late Postclassic Yucatán. The family rose under Hunac Ceel, who seized the League of Mayapan, a confederation joining Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan from the tenth century, making Mayapan its seat.

Cocom power rested on tribute from northern-plain towns from Sotuta to Motul, until 1441, when Ah Xiu Xupan of the rival Xiu lineage massacred the Cocom household; only one heir, away in Honduras, survived. The league collapsed into civil war, and by 1461 Yucatán had split into some seventeen kuchkabals.

The surviving Cocom ruled Sotuta. When Spaniards invaded, Nachi Cocom, halach uinik of Sotuta, had the Xiu ambassadors massacred in 1536 and led Maya resistance against Francisco de Montejo the Younger until defeat at the ruins of T'ho, the future Mérida, in 1542. He submitted and was baptized as Juan Cocom, dying in 1562.
zh:
科科姆是玛雅潘的统治王朝，也是后古典期晚期尤卡坦的霸主。该家族在乌纳克·塞尔治下崛起，他掌控自10世纪起联合奇琴伊察、乌斯马尔和玛雅潘的玛雅潘联盟，把玛雅潘变成盟主驻地。

科科姆的权势建立在北部平原索图图到莫图尔等城镇的贡赋之上。1441年，敌对休族的阿·休·舒潘屠灭科科姆全族，只有一位身在洪都拉斯的继承人幸免。联盟陷入内战，到1461年尤卡坦分裂为约十七个城邦。

幸存的科科姆人统治索图图。西班牙人入侵时，索图图的最高君主纳奇·科科姆于1536年下令屠杀休族使节，并率众抵抗小弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍，1542年在特奥废墟（即后来的梅里达）战败。他随后臣服，受洗改名胡安·科科姆，1562年去世。

en: Caotang was an anfusi, a pacification commission, of the Bozhou chiefdom, covering the Wengshui valley in present-day Weng'an County. After the Bozhou rebellion was crushed in 1600, the Caotang and Wengshui native offices were merged into the new Weng'an County under Pingyue Prefecture in 1601.
zh: 草塘是播州土司属下的安抚司，辖有瓮水河谷一带，地当今瓮安县境内。1600年播州之乱被平定后，草塘与瓮水两处土司辖地于1601年合并设置瓮安县，隶属平越府。

en:
Yodzo Coo, the Mixtec name for Coixtlahuaca, meaning Plain of Snakes, was a multi-ethnic state of the Mixteca Alta, home to Chochos and Mixtecs and overlord of the Cuicatecs, with Nahuatl as its lingua franca. Its dynasty traced to a Toltec lord, Four Jaguar Night Face, installed around 1096, and later rulers bore the name Atonal.

The city kept a great market linked to the Valley of Mexico, Cholula and the Pacific coast, trading gold, cacao and cochineal. In the mid-fifteenth century its ruler Atonal II had the Central Mexican merchants in his city killed and their goods seized, drawing Moctezuma I's armies: in 1458 the Mexica took Coixtlahuaca and executed him.

It became the seat of an Aztec tributary province over the Nochixtlan valley and Cuicatlan country, guarded by a Mexica garrison and governor. City envoys surrendered to Hernan Cortes in September 1520.
zh:
尤佐库是科伊斯特拉瓦坎的纽萨维语名，意为“蛇之平原”，为米斯特卡高地多民族政权，居民有乔乔人和纽萨维人，统辖奎卡特克人，通用纳瓦特尔语。王朝可追溯到约1096年受封的托尔特克贵族虎四日·夜之面容，后来君主多名阿托纳尔。

城中有大集市，商路连通墨西哥谷地、乔卢拉和太平洋沿岸，交易黄金、可可和胭脂虫。15世纪中叶，君主阿托纳尔二世处死城中的墨西哥谷地商人并没收货物，招来莫克特苏马一世大军；1458年墨西加人攻克科伊斯特拉瓦坎，将他处死。

此后它成为阿兹特克纳贡省治所，辖诺奇斯特兰谷地和奎卡特兰地区，由墨西加驻军、总督镇守。1520年9月，城使降于埃尔南·科尔特斯。

en:
Coligua was an Indigenous polity recorded by Hernando de Soto's expedition in the Arkansas region. It may have been the Koroa, who may have met the expedition near present-day Little Rock in 1541.

When the French encountered the Koroa in the late seventeenth century, they lived on both sides of the Mississippi. La Salle visited a Koroa town in 1682; after disease caused heavy losses, many Koroa joined the Tunica, Chickasaw or Natchez.
zh:
科立瓜是埃尔南多·德索托的探险队在阿肯色地区记载的原住民政权。它可能对应科罗阿人；科罗阿人可能于1541年在今小石城附近遇到这支探险队。

17世纪晚期法国人遇到科罗阿人时，他们住在密西西比河两岸。拉萨尔于1682年造访了一座科罗阿城镇；疾病造成重大损失后，许多科罗阿人加入了图尼卡人、奇克索人或纳奇兹人。

en:
The County of Comminges occupied the upper Garonne valley on the northern slopes of the Pyrenees, around the ancient town of Lugdunum Convenarum, later Saint-Bertrand-de-Comminges. A county emerged there in the early tenth century, part of Gascony; its counts set their capital at Muret, a strategic bridge town between Gascony and Languedoc.

In 1337 the count was John I of the native house of Comminges, which had held the county for four centuries. The last hereditary ruler, Countess Margaret, married into the houses of Armagnac and Foix and at her death in 1443 bequeathed her lands to the French king.

After the life tenancy of Matthew of Foix, Comminges was incorporated into the royal domain in 1454. It was briefly granted out twice more before Louis XII reunited it definitively to the crown in 1498.
zh:
科曼日伯国据有比利牛斯山北坡的加龙河上游谷地，环绕古城卢格杜努姆·孔韦纳鲁姆，即后来的科曼日的圣贝特朗。10世纪初这里形成伯国，隶属加斯科涅，伯爵把首府设在米雷，一座扼守加斯科涅与朗格多克通道的战略河镇。

1337年在位的是本土科曼日家族的让一世，该家族统治伯国已四百年。末代世袭统治者玛格丽特女伯爵先后嫁入阿马尼亚克与富瓦家族，1443年去世时把领地遗赠给法兰西国王。

富瓦的马蒂厄终身享有之后，科曼日1454年并入王室领地。它此后又两度短暂封出，最终1498年由路易十二永久收归王冠。

en:
Coinan was a late Postclassic hereditary monarchy on the north-eastern shore of Lake Chapala in what is now Mexico, whose people were the Coca, a western Mexican nation. Its capital stood at Tototlan, with chiefdoms such as Atotonilco and Ocotlan paying tribute, while its borders met the Tecuexe señoríos to the north and the Purépecha Empire to the south.

Tradition dated its foundation to 1210, when the leader Xitecomotl defeated the earlier Tecos inhabitants and set up his own dynasty. Its kings kept the Tarascans of the Purépecha Empire in almost constant war, though they held aloof from the Saltpeter War, and honoured the god Ixtlacateotl with a shrine on the hill of Las Villas.

In 1541 Coinan joined the Mixtón War beside the Caxcanes and Tecuexe, fielding perhaps fourteen thousand rebels; when the Caxcanes broke, the Coca surrendered too.
zh:
科伊南是后古典期晚期的世袭君主国，位于今墨西哥查帕拉湖东北岸，居民为墨西哥西部的科卡人。首府设在托托特兰，阿托托尼尔科、奥科特兰等酋邦向它纳贡；北境接特库埃克人诸邦，南邻普雷佩查帝国。

相传它建于1210年，首领希特科莫特尔击败更早的特科斯居民，建立王朝。历代国王与普雷佩查帝国的塔拉斯科人战事不断，却未卷入硝石战争；他们在拉斯维利亚斯山上为神祇伊斯特拉卡特奥特尔修建祭坛。

1541年，科伊南与卡什坎人、特库埃克人并肩加入米斯特翁战争，起兵者可能约一万四千人；卡什坎人战败后，科卡人也随之投降。

en:
Coosa was a paramount chiefdom centered on the Coosawattee River in what is now northwestern Georgia. Its capital had a plaza and three platform mounds, and its chiefs commanded a wider alliance of smaller chiefdoms extending into Tennessee and Alabama.

Hernando de Soto's expedition entered Coosa in 1540, and later Spanish expeditions visited in 1560 and 1566–1568. By the end of the sixteenth century, disease and disruption had contributed to the abandonment of most of Coosa's heartland; survivors withdrew to villages on the Coosa River in Alabama.
zh:
库萨是一个以今佐治亚州西北部库萨沃蒂河为中心的酋长国。其都城有一座广场和三座台形土丘，酋长还统领着延伸至田纳西和亚拉巴马的较小酋长国联盟。

埃尔南多·德·索托的探险队于1540年进入库萨，后来的西班牙探险队又于1560年和1566—1568年到访。到16世纪末，疾病和社会动荡促使库萨的核心地区大部被弃，幸存者退往亚拉巴马库萨河沿岸的村落。

en: The Xawiƚƚ Kwñchawaay, also known as the Cocopah, were a Yuman-speaking people of the lower Colorado River and its delta. Hernando de Alarcón's expedition probably encountered them in 1540, and Juan de Oñate's expedition mentioned them by name in 1605.
zh: 哈维希‑库尼查瓦伊人又称科科帕人，是生活在科罗拉多河下游及其三角洲、使用尤玛语系语言的族群。埃尔南多·德·阿拉尔孔的探险队可能于1540年与他们相遇，胡安·德·奥尼亚特的探险队在1605年明确记载了他们的名称。

en:
Corsica was a Mediterranean island long contested by Pisa and Genoa. In 1755 Pasquale Paoli proclaimed a republic seeking independence from Genoa, whose forces retained only a few coastal towns. Paoli established a constitution, an army and a university at Corte, and minted coins bearing the Moor's Head in 1761.

Genoa transferred its claims to France in 1768, and French forces took the island in 1769. A Corsican kingdom in union with Britain briefly followed the French Revolution, before French rule returned in 1796.
zh:
科西嘉是地中海上的岛屿，长期为比萨和热那亚争夺。1755年帕斯夸莱·保利宣布成立共和国，争取脱离热那亚独立；热那亚军队当时只保有少数沿海城镇。保利制定宪法、组建军队，在科尔泰创办大学，并于1761年铸造印有摩尔人头像的硬币。

1768年热那亚将其对科西嘉的权利转让给法国，法军于1769年占领该岛。法国大革命后，科西嘉曾短暂成为与英国共主的王国，1796年法国恢复统治。

en:
Cortona is a hill town in the Val di Chiana in Tuscany, an Etruscan foundation and one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League. Its Etruscan walls date to the fourth century BC, and the bronze Tabula Cortonensis bears one of the longest known Etruscan inscriptions.

Under Rome it became the colony of Corito, then was sacked in the sixth-century Gothic War. It re-emerged as a medieval Ghibelline commune that minted its own coinage; from 1325 the Ranieri-Casali family held it as signori, including Ranieri II Casali in 1337.

Casali rule ended in 1409 when Ladislaus of Naples seized the town and sold it in 1411 to the Florentine Medici, after which Cortona shared Florentine rule. When the senior Medici line died out in 1737 it passed with Tuscany to the House of Lorraine.
zh:
科尔托纳是托斯卡纳基亚纳山谷中的山城，由伊特鲁里亚人建立，为伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一。公元前4世纪筑起伊特鲁里亚城墙，当地出土的青铜板《科尔托纳表》刻有已知最长的伊特鲁里亚语铭文之一。

罗马统治时期它成为科里托殖民地，6世纪哥特战争中遭洗劫。中世纪重新崛起为吉伯林派自治公社，自铸货币；1325年起拉涅里-卡萨利家族任领主，1337年在位的是拉涅里二世·卡萨利。

1409年那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳攻占该城，卡萨利家族统治结束；1411年他把科尔托纳卖给佛罗伦萨美第奇家族，此后该城随佛罗伦萨统治而行。1737年美第奇嫡系绝嗣，它随托斯卡纳转入洛林家族。

en:
Coweta was a Muscogee tribal town on the Chattahoochee River and one of the four mother towns of the Muscogee Confederacy. It was a trading center of the Lower Towns in the region the Spanish called Apalachicola.

William McIntosh, a chief of Coweta, signed the Treaty of Indian Springs in 1825, ceding much of the remaining Muscogee land to the United States. The Muscogee National Council condemned the agreement as a violation of its laws, and McIntosh was executed that year.
zh:
考维塔是查塔胡奇河畔的马斯科吉部族城镇，也是马斯科吉联盟的四座母城之一。它是西班牙人称为阿巴拉契科拉地区的下游城镇贸易中心。

1825年，考维塔酋长威廉·麦金托什签署《印第安泉条约》，将马斯科吉人剩余的大部分土地割让给美国。马斯科吉全国议会认定该协议违反本族法律，麦金托什于当年被处死。

en:
The Coyaima were a Pijao people of the upper Magdalena valley, living along the lower Saldaña and Ortega rivers in present-day Colombia. They belonged to a lowland federation that also included the Natagaima, while other Pijao communities occupied the central Andes.

During the Spanish conquest, Juan de Borja exploited rivalries between the Coyaima and other Pijao peoples and enlisted the Coyaima as allies. A colonial settlement bearing their name was founded in 1608 and moved to the Saldaña in 1778.
zh:
科亚伊马人是马格达莱纳河上游河谷的皮豪人，居住在今哥伦比亚的萨尔达尼亚河下游和奥尔特加河一带。他们属于一个低地联盟，成员还包括纳塔盖马人；其他皮豪社群则居住在安第斯山脉中部。

西班牙征服时期，胡安·德·博尔哈利用科亚伊马人与其他皮豪人的矛盾，招募科亚伊马人作为盟友。以他们命名的殖民聚落于1608年建立，1778年迁至萨尔达尼亚河畔。

en:
The Principality of Copa was a Circassian feudal state of the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, one of the coastal principalities of Zichia, controlling the shore between the Kuban River and the Sea of Azov from its chief town Copa. Known mainly through Genoese records, Copa was the second largest city of Circassia after Matrega and held a great annual spring fair, where Genoese merchants bought fish and slaves under a consul sent from Caffa.

In the later fifteenth century it was ruled by Prince Berzebuk, who built a stone castle and in 1471 joined the other Circassian princes in a treaty with Caffa.

Ottoman troops sacked Copa in 1475 and returned to storm its fortress in 1479, ending the principality, which is regarded as the forerunner of the sixteenth-century Principality of Zhaney.
zh:
科帕公国是14至15世纪切尔克斯人的封建政权，泽希亚沿海诸公国之一，以重镇科帕为中心，控制库班河与亚速海之间的海岸。其事迹主要见于热那亚文献：科帕是切尔克西亚仅次于马特列加的第二大城，每年春天举办大集市，热那亚商人在卡法派出的领事监管下收购鱼和奴隶。

15世纪后期，王公贝尔泽布克统治此地，他修建石砌城堡，1471年与其他切尔克斯王公一同同卡法缔约。

1475年奥斯曼军队洗劫科帕，1479年又回师攻占其要塞，公国灭亡；它被视为16世纪热内公国的前身。

en: Tzoapan was centred on Choapan, a town in the forested Choapam highlands of northern Oaxaca, in the humid Papaloapan headwaters on the edge of Mixe and Chinantec country. Its people spoke a local Zapotec tongue, Choapan Zapotec; the Popoloca label attached to such neighbours was the Nahuatl exonym for peoples whose speech the Nahua could not understand.
zh: 佐阿潘以乔阿潘为中心，是瓦哈卡北部林木茂密的乔阿潘高地、帕帕洛阿潘河湿润源头上的小邦，与米赫人和奇南特克人的地区相邻。当地居民讲本地的乔阿潘萨波特克语；波波洛卡本是纳瓦人对听不懂其语言的邻族的他称。

en: Capachequi was an Indigenous community on the Chickasawhatchee River in present-day Georgia, subject to Apalachee. Hernando de Soto's expedition passed through it on its journey across Georgia in 1540.
zh: 卡帕切基是今佐治亚州奇克索瓦奇河畔的原住民聚落，隶属于阿帕拉奇。1540年，埃尔南多·德索托的考察队穿越佐治亚时经过此地。

en: Cuquimpu was a name for the Elqui valley in present-day Chile, inhabited by Indigenous communities under Inca rule when the Spanish arrived. In the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, the Incas incorporated the valley into their empire and relocated Churumata people there from the vicinity of Tarija.
zh: 库奎姆普是今智利埃尔基河谷的旧称，西班牙人抵达时，当地原住民社群处于印加统治之下。15世纪末至16世纪初，印加帝国将河谷纳入版图，并从塔里哈附近迁来丘鲁马塔人。

en:
The Charca were an Aymara-speaking people of the south-eastern Andes, spread across the high plains and temperate valleys of present-day central Bolivia. They traded with their neighbours but were repeatedly raided from the eastern lowlands by the Ava Guarani.

Inca forces first entered their country in the mid-fourteenth century, yet the Charca held out through several campaigns; only under Tupac Yupanqui, late in the fifteenth century, did their chief Copacatiraca persuade the elders to submit, and Charca warriors became valued troops in the Inca armies of Collasuyo.

The Portuguese castaway Aleixo Garcia, with Guarani raiders, was probably the first European to meet them around 1520. In 1538 Gonzalo Pizarro entered the region and the Spanish set up the Provincia de los Charcas, whose silver mines foreshadowed Potosi; on 16 April 1540 Pedro Anzures founded Villa de la Plata, the future Chuquisaca, later renamed Sucre.
zh:
查克拉人是安第斯东南的艾马拉语族群，散居今玻利维亚中部的高原与温带河谷。他们与邻邦贸易，却不断遭东部低地阿瓦·瓜拉尼人袭掠。

14世纪中期印加军队首次进入其地，查克拉人在多次战役中坚持抵抗；直到15世纪末图帕克·尤潘基在位时，首领科帕卡蒂拉卡才说服长老归降，查克拉战士成为印卡科利亚苏尤军中受重视的兵员。

葡萄牙流落者阿莱绍·加西亚随瓜拉尼袭掠者同行，约1520年可能成为最早接触他们的欧洲人。1538年贡萨洛·皮萨罗进入该地区，西班牙设查克拉行省，银矿预示了后来的波托西；1540年4月16日佩德罗·安苏雷斯建拉普拉塔镇，即后来的丘基萨卡，后改名苏克雷。

en: The Kingdom of Córdoba was a Castilian territorial jurisdiction in Andalusia, centred on Córdoba. Once the capital of an Umayyad emirate and caliphate, Córdoba was conquered by Castile in 1236. It remained one of the four kingdoms of Andalusia until Spain's territorial division of 1833 abolished the kingdom.
zh: 科尔多瓦王国是卡斯蒂利亚在安达卢西亚的一处领地，以科尔多瓦为中心。科尔多瓦曾是倭马亚埃米尔国和哈里发国的首都，1236年被卡斯蒂利亚征服。它是安达卢西亚四个王国之一，直到1833年西班牙进行领土区划时被废除。

en:
Carinthia was a duchy of the Holy Roman Empire in the eastern Alps, covering parts of present-day Austria and Slovenia. Emperor Otto II separated it from Bavaria in 976, and in 1335 it passed to the Habsburgs.

The Treaty of Neuberg in 1379 assigned Carinthia, Styria and Carniola to Leopold III's branch of the family, which ruled Inner Austria from Graz. Carinthia remained under Habsburg rule through the dissolution of the Empire in 1806 and formed part of the Austrian Empire.
zh:
卡林西亚是神圣罗马帝国在东阿尔卑斯山的公国，地跨今奥地利和斯洛文尼亚的部分地区。976年皇帝奥托二世将它从巴伐利亚分出，1335年它转入哈布斯堡家族之手。

1379年的《诺伊贝格条约》将卡林西亚、施蒂里亚和卡尼奥拉分给哈布斯堡家族的利奥波德三世一支，该支从格拉茨统治内奥地利。1806年神圣罗马帝国解体时，卡林西亚仍由哈布斯堡家族统治，并且属于奥地利帝国。

en:
The Crimean Khanate was a Tatar state founded by Haji I Giray as the Golden Horde broke apart. In 1441 he struck coins at Chufut-Kale, a date often taken as the beginning of his khanate; his dynasty fought rival steppe rulers for control of Crimea.

Sahib I Giray made Bakhchysarai his residence in 1532, establishing the khanate's later capital. The 1774 Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca guaranteed non-interference by Russia and the Ottoman Empire, but Russia annexed Crimea in 1783.
zh:
克里米亚汗国是哈吉一世·格来在金帐汗国瓦解时建立的鞑靼政权。1441年他在楚福特卡莱铸造钱币，这一年常被视为汗国的开端；他的家族与草原上的对手争夺克里米亚。

萨希布一世·格来于1532年将宫廷设在巴赫奇萨赖，使这里成为汗国后来的首都。1774年的《屈楚克开纳吉条约》保证俄国和奥斯曼帝国不干涉汗国事务，但俄国仍在1783年吞并了克里米亚。

en: The Carijó were a Guarani-speaking people of the Brazilian coast from Cananéia to the Lagoa dos Patos and the area around Asunción in Paraguay. They lived around São Vicente when Portuguese colonization began in 1532. In 1554 Carijó joined an Indigenous raid on the new settlement of São Paulo dos Campos de Piratininga.
zh: 卡里若是说瓜拉尼语的原住民，居住在巴西从卡纳内亚到帕图斯湖的沿海地带，以及巴拉圭亚松森周围。1532年葡萄牙人开始殖民圣维森特地区时，卡里若人是当地原住民之一。1554年，卡里若人参加了原住民对新建的圣保罗－坎普斯－迪皮拉蒂宁加定居点的袭击。

en: Churumekua was a small Purépecha-speaking settlement in the hot lowlands of southeastern Michoacán; its name, carried by the later town of Churumuco, means bird's beak in the Purépecha language. It was one of many minor local communities over which the expanding Purépecha kingdom of Tzintzuntzan claimed dominion before the Spanish arrival.
zh: 楚鲁梅夸是米却肯东南部炎热低地上一个讲普雷佩查语的小聚落，后来的楚鲁穆科镇沿用了这个名字，它在普雷佩查语中意为“鸟喙”。在西班牙人到来之前，它是扩张中的钦聪灿普雷佩查王国所控制的众多地方小社群之一。

en: Urtsun was a Kalash chiefdom in the Urtsun valley of southern Chitral, whose people spoke the Kalasha-mun dialect later called Urtsuniwar and kept the old Kalash beliefs. In the fourteenth century the Rais dynasty of Chitral conquered the Kalash valleys, and Urtsun became a tributary hill domain gradually absorbed into the Chitral kingdom.
zh: 乌尔岑是吉德拉尔南部乌尔岑谷地的卡拉什人酋邦，居民说卡拉什语的乌尔岑方言，信奉卡拉什人的古老信仰。14世纪吉德拉尔的赖莎王朝征服卡拉什诸谷地后，乌尔岑沦为纳贡的山地附庸，逐渐被并入吉德拉尔王国。

en:
Cremona was a Lombard city on the Po that emerged as a free commune by 1093. After struggles between local families, the Visconti of Milan gained control in 1322, although their rule was interrupted. In 1406 Cabrino Fondulo seized the city after killing the men of the Cavalcabò family, then ceded it to Filippo Maria Visconti.

Cremona became part of the Duchy of Milan, but Venice held it from 1499 to 1509. The city later passed under Spanish rule and, with Milan, to Austria in 1707.
zh:
克雷莫纳是波河畔的伦巴第城市，至1093年已成为自由公社。当地家族争斗之后，米兰的维斯孔蒂家族于1322年取得控制权，但其统治曾被打断。1406年，卡布里诺·丰多洛杀害卡瓦尔卡博家族的男性成员后夺取该城，随后将其让给菲利波·玛丽亚·维斯孔蒂。

克雷莫纳成为米兰公国的一部分，但在1499—1509年间受威尼斯统治。此后城市归于西班牙，并于1707年随米兰转归奥地利。

en:
Cornwall was a Brittonic kingdom in the southwest of Britain, emerging after the decline of Dumnonia and coming under Wessex by the mid-ninth century. In 1337 the English crown created the duchy of Cornwall for the king's eldest son and heir; local stannary institutions retained some control over tin mining.

In 1497 taxation for Henry VII's Scottish war helped provoke a Cornish rebellion, defeated at Deptford Bridge near London. The stannaries regained a measure of autonomy in 1508, but Tudor centralisation eroded much of Cornwall's remaining autonomy.
zh:
康沃尔是不列颠西南部的布立吞人王国，在杜姆诺尼亚衰落后兴起，至9世纪中叶已受威塞克斯控制。1337年英格兰王室为国王的长子和继承人设立康沃尔公国；当地的锡矿管理机构保留了部分采矿事务的管辖权。

1497年，亨利七世为对苏格兰作战而征税，是引发康沃尔起义的原因之一；起义军在伦敦附近的德特福德桥被击败。锡矿管理机构于1508年恢复部分自治权，但都铎王朝的集权削弱了康沃尔剩余的大部分自治权。

en:
The Kingdom of Croatia arose from a seventh-century Slavic duchy and was raised to kingship around 925 under Tomislav of the Trpimirović dynasty, which ruled until 1091. A succession crisis then brought the Hungarian king Coloman, crowned King of Croatia and Dalmatia at Biograd in 1102, the crowns entering personal union.

Croatia kept the Sabor assembly and a viceroy, the Ban, while lords such as Paul Šubić wielded near-independent power; the Mongols sacked Zagreb in 1242, and the coastal cities of Dalmatia were repeatedly disputed with Venice. After the Árpád line ended in 1301 the Angevin Charles Robert ruled in 1337; his son Louis I won Dalmatia by the 1358 Treaty of Zadar, though Venice regained the coast in 1409.

Ottoman conquests shattered the kingdom in the early sixteenth century, and after the Battle of Mohács in 1526 the Croatian crown passed to the Habsburgs.
zh:
克罗地亚王国源于7世纪斯拉夫人建立的公国，约925年在特尔皮米罗维奇王朝的托米斯拉夫治下升格为王国，该王朝统治到1091年。继承危机随后引来匈牙利国王卡尔曼，他1102年在比奥格勒加冕为克罗地亚和达尔马提亚国王，两顶王冠结成君合国。

克罗地亚保留萨博尔议会和称巴昂的副王，保罗·舒比奇等贵族几近独立；1242年蒙古人洗劫萨格勒布，达尔马提亚城市反复与威尼斯争夺。1301年阿尔帕德绝嗣，1337年安茹家族查理·罗贝尔在位；其子拉约什一世1358年凭《扎达尔条约》取得达尔马提亚，威尼斯1409年夺回海岸。

16世纪初奥斯曼征服重创王国，1526年莫哈奇战役后，克罗地亚王冠转入哈布斯堡家族。

en:
The Marquisate of Finale was a small imperial fief on the Ligurian coast, centred on fortified Finalborgo. It grew from the march Otto I granted Aleramo of Montferrat in 967; after a twelfth-century partition, Enrico I del Carretto received the March of Savona from Barbarossa in 1162, and his son Enrico II first styled himself Marquis of Finale.

The del Carretto marquises, Ghibellines, long defended their independence against Genoa, which in 1385 secured the submission of half their territory. Genoa burned Finalborgo and forced a submission in 1448, but Giovanni I del Carretto retook it in 1450.

Genoa struck again in 1558, and in 1598 the last marquis, Sforza Andrea, sold the state to Philip II of Spain, effective in 1602. After the War of the Spanish Succession it passed to Genoa in 1713, keeping its statutes until the French invasion of 1797.
zh:
菲纳莱侯爵领是利古里亚海岸的小帝国封邑，以防城菲纳尔博尔戈为中心。它源于967年奥托一世封给蒙费拉托的阿莱拉莫的边疆领；12世纪分家后，恩里科一世·德尔·卡雷托1162年从巴巴罗萨手中接过萨沃纳边疆领，子恩里科二世最先称菲纳莱侯爵。

吉伯林派德尔·卡雷托侯爵长期抵御热那亚，1385年半数领土被迫臣服。1448年热那亚焚毁菲纳尔博尔戈，迫其归顺，乔瓦尼一世·德尔·卡雷托1450年收复该城。

热那亚1558年再攻，1598年末代侯爵斯福尔扎·安德烈亚把国家卖给西班牙国王腓力二世，1602年生效。西班牙王位继承战争后，它1713年划归热那亚，留法规至1797年法国入侵。

en:
The Choros were the ruling clan of the Oirat tribes of the western Mongols, at times leading the Four Oirat alliance. Their chiefs claimed descent from a baby found beneath a sacred tree, after whom the clan was named.

In the first half of the fifteenth century Mahamud, Toghon and his son Esen Taishi built Oirat power across the Mongolian steppe; Esen had himself enthroned as khagan before the other Oirat tribes overthrew him in 1455. Raids by Khalkha and Inner Mongolian princes in 1552—1628 scattered the clan, some fleeing to Siberia, but around 1620 the Choros recovered and, with the Dörbet and Khoid, settled the Black Irtysh and Ili country to found the Dzungar Khanate.

Under Khara Khula and Galdan Boshugtu Khan it became the last great nomadic empire, until Galdan's wars with the Qing ended in defeat in 1696 and death in 1697; the surviving Choros were overrun when the Qing destroyed the Dzungar Khanate in 1755—1758.
zh:
绰罗斯是西部蒙古瓦剌诸部的统治氏族，曾统领卫拉特四部；其首领自称始祖是圣树下捡到的婴儿，氏族也因此得名。

15世纪上半叶，马哈木、脱欢及脱欢之子也先太师把瓦剌势力扩张到整个蒙古草原，也先自立为大汗，1455年被其他瓦剌诸部推翻。1552—1628年喀尔喀与漠南王公的侵袭使绰罗斯部众离散，一部分远逃西伯利亚；约1620年他们重新振作，与杜尔伯特、辉特在黑额尔齐斯河和伊犁河流域定居，建立准噶尔汗国。

在哈喇忽剌和噶尔丹·博硕克图汗治下，它成为最后一个强大的游牧帝国；噶尔丹与清朝连年交战，1696年兵败、1697年身死，幸存的绰罗斯人在1755—1758年清朝攻灭准噶尔汗国时被彻底征服。

en:
Candia was the Venetian name for Crete. After the Fourth Crusade broke up the Byzantine Empire in 1204, Crete was allotted to Boniface of Montferrat, who sold his rights to Venice; troops occupied it from 1205 to 1212, organising the Duchy of Candia, named after its capital, as Venice's largest colony.

Its Orthodox Greek population rose repeatedly against Catholic rule, fourteen times up to the 1360s Revolt of Saint Titus, when Greek peasants and Venetian settlers joined against the mother city's taxes. From the fifteenth century Crete prospered as a Renaissance outpost: the Cretan School blended Byzantine and Italian forms and produced El Greco; vernacular literature culminated in Erotokritos.

After Cyprus fell in 1571 Crete was Venice's last major eastern possession. The Ottoman Cretan War of 1645 to 1669 overran it, and after one of history's longest sieges the capital fell in 1669; three fortresses passed to the Turks in 1715.
zh:
干地亚是威尼斯对克里特的称呼。1204年第四次十字军肢解拜占庭后，克里特分给蒙费拉的博尼法斯，他将岛上权利卖给威尼斯；军队1205至1212年占领全岛，以首府之名设干地亚公国，为威尼斯最大殖民地。

岛上东正教希腊人多次反抗天主教统治，到14世纪60年代圣提多大起义为止共十四次；那次起义中希腊农民与威尼斯移民联手抗母邦苛税。15世纪起克里特成为文艺复兴前哨：克里特画派融拜占庭与意大利风格，出埃尔·格列柯；方言文学以《埃罗托克里托斯》为顶峰。

1571年塞浦路斯失守，克里特成威尼斯东方最后主要领地。1645至1669年奥斯曼克里特之战席卷全岛，经史上最漫长围城战之一，首府1669年陷落；最后三要塞1715年落入土耳其之手。

en: Casma refers to the coastal valley of the Casma River in present-day Peru. In the late pre-Inca period, Casma was a source of Chimú cultural influence at Kajur in the nearby highlands.
zh: 卡斯马指今秘鲁沿海的卡斯马河谷。印加征服前的晚期，附近高地的卡胡尔受到来自卡斯马的奇穆文化影响。

en:
The Cusabo were a loose group of tribes on the South Carolina coast, between Charleston and the Savannah River. After English settlers founded Charles Town in 1670, the colony fought the Kussoe and Stono and forced them to cede land.

Cusabo warriors later served the colony in the Tuscarora War of 1712–1713. After the Yamasee War began in 1715, surviving Cusabo migrated to join the Muscogee or Catawba.
zh:
库萨博是南卡罗来纳海岸上一组松散的部族，居住在查尔斯顿与萨凡纳河之间。英国殖民者于1670年建立查尔斯镇后，殖民地与库索人和斯托诺人交战，迫使他们割让土地。

库萨博战士后来在1712—1713年的塔斯卡洛拉战争中为殖民地作战。1715年亚马西战争爆发后，幸存的库萨博人迁去加入穆斯科吉人或卡托巴人。

en:
The Shun was a short-lived Chinese dynasty founded at Xi'an in 1644 by the rebel leader Li Zicheng. His forces captured Beijing that April, ending Ming rule in the capital. In May the combined armies of the Qing prince Dorgon and the Ming general Wu Sangui defeated Li at Shanhai Pass.

Li abandoned Beijing and died in 1645 after further defeats. Shun remnants fought on and joined the Southern Ming; Li Guo, one of their leaders, died in 1649.
zh:
顺是起义军领袖李自成于1644年在西安建立的短暂王朝。同年4月，顺军攻占北京，结束了明朝在京城的统治。5月，清朝摄政王多尔衮与明将吴三桂的联军在山海关击败李自成。

李自成放弃北京，接连战败后于1645年去世。顺军余部继续作战并与南明联合，其领袖之一李过于1649年去世。

en:
Li Zicheng, a native of Shaanxi, led the rebellion that founded the Great Shun state. He rose among the peasant armies fighting the Ming and established Shun at Xi’an in 1644. His forces captured Beijing that April, ending Ming rule in the capital.

In May 1644 Li was defeated at Shanhai Pass by Wu Sangui and the Qing prince Dorgon. He abandoned Beijing and died in 1645; remnants of his army later joined the Southern Ming, and his nephew Li Guo died in 1649.
zh:
陕西人李自成领导起义，建立了大顺政权。他在反明农民军中崛起，1644年在西安建立大顺；同年4月，他的军队攻入北京，结束了明朝对京城的统治。

1644年5月，李自成在山海关被吴三桂和清朝摄政王多尔衮击败。他放弃北京，1645年去世；其部余众后来归附南明，侄子李过于1649年去世。

en:
The Chōsokabe were samurai lords of Tosa Province on Shikoku. Chōsokabe Motochika defeated the Aki clan in 1569, overthrew the Ichijō in 1574 and extended his rule across Shikoku by 1583.

Toyotomi Hideyoshi invaded in 1585, forcing Motochika to surrender all but Tosa. His successor Morichika lost the domain after supporting the losing side at Sekigahara in 1600 and was executed after the Siege of Osaka in 1615.
zh:
长宗我部氏是四国土佐国的武家领主。长宗我部元亲于1569年击败安艺氏，1574年推翻一条氏，到1583年将势力扩展至四国全境。

1585年丰臣秀吉入侵四国，迫使元亲放弃土佐以外的领地。继任者盛亲在1600年的关原之战中支持败方，随后失去领地，1615年大阪之役后被处死。

en:
Cosamaloapan was the head town of a pre-Hispanic Nahua lordship on the Papaloapan river in the warm lowlands of central Veracruz. Between 1452 and 1457 Mexica armies conquered the town and its province, and it was tied to the Aztec empire through the garrison of Tuxtepec, where its tributes were delivered.

This lasted until the Spanish conquest, after which Cosamaloapan became one of the first two Spanish corregimientos of the Papaloapan basin, established around 1534 alongside Guaspaltepec. In 1560 the two districts merged into a large corregimiento stretching from Chinantla to Tlacotalpan.

Around 1640 the district became an alcaldia mayor and took the name of Cosamaloapan; in 1696 it was attached to the alcaldia mayor of Chinantla, an arrangement that lasted until 1746. The reforms of 1786 turned Cosamaloapan into a partido of the Intendancy of Veracruz.
zh:
科萨马洛阿潘是前西班牙时期纳瓦领主邦的首镇，位于韦拉克鲁斯中部湿热低地的帕帕洛阿潘河畔。1452年至1457年墨西加军队征服该镇及其行省，它通过图斯特佩克驻军与阿兹特克帝国绑定，贡物都交到那里。

这一格局维持到西班牙征服；此后科萨马洛阿潘成为帕帕洛阿潘盆地最早的两个西班牙督办辖区之一，约1534年与瓜斯帕尔特佩克相继设立。1560年两个辖区合并为大型督办区，范围从奇南特拉延伸到特拉科塔尔潘。

约1640年该辖区改为市长辖区并改用科萨马洛阿潘之名；1696年并入奇南特拉市长辖区，延续至1746年。1786年行政改革把科萨马洛阿潘改为韦拉克鲁斯都督府下辖的分区。

en:
The Song was a Chinese dynasty founded in 960, with its northern capital at Bianjing, now Kaifeng. After the Jin conquered northern China in 1127, the Southern Song ruled from Lin'an, now Hangzhou, until the Yuan defeated it at Yamen in 1279.

In 1355 the Red Turban leader Liu Futong proclaimed Han Lin'er emperor of a restored Song at Bozhou. Their forces briefly held Kaifeng, but lost it in 1359; Han drowned in 1367, shortly before Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming.
zh:
宋是960年建立的中国王朝，北宋都城位于汴京，即今开封。1127年金朝占领中国北方后，南宋以临安（今杭州）为都，直到1279年在崖山被元军击败。

1355年，红巾军首领刘福通在亳州拥立韩林儿为帝，复国号宋。宋军曾短暂占据开封，1359年失守；韩林儿于1367年溺亡，不久朱元璋建立了明朝。

en:
Casqui was an Indigenous polity of fortified villages in eastern Arkansas, named for its chief when Hernando de Soto arrived in 1541. Its principal town is thought to have stood at Parkin, where a palisaded village existed from around 1350 to 1650.

Casqui was at war with neighboring Pacaha. In 1541 Casqui followers accompanied de Soto toward Pacaha and looted its village; after the goods were returned, de Soto brought the two chiefs together and arranged peace.
zh:
卡斯奎是阿肯色州东部由设防村落组成的原住民政权，得名于埃尔南多·德索托1541年到来时的酋长。其主要城镇据信位于帕金，当地约1350—1650年间有一座栅栏围护的村落。

卡斯奎与邻近的帕卡哈交战。1541年，卡斯奎人随德索托前往帕卡哈并劫掠其村落；归还掠夺的物品后，德索托召集两位酋长议和。

en:
The Kingdom of Qusqu, or Cusco, was the Andean city-state from which the Inca Empire grew. Tradition holds that Manco Capac led ten ayllus from Pacaritambo into the Cusco valley, defeating or expelling the Huallas and other peoples and founding the city around the early thirteenth century. Its first five rulers, the Hurin Cusco dynasty, ruled a compact state rivalled by the larger Ayarmaca kingdom.

In 1337 the throne belonged to Capac Yupanqui, who defeated the Cunti and allied with the Quechua against the Chankas. Around 1350 he was poisoned; Inca Roca seized power, opening the Hanan Cusco dynasty as the first ruler to call himself Inka. He and his successors enlarged Cusco with canals and palaces and intervened in Collao wars.

In 1438 a Chanka invasion nearly destroyed Cusco, but Prince Pachacuti repelled it, seized the crown and reorganized the kingdom into the Inca Empire, which lasted until the Spanish took Cusco in 1533.
zh:
库斯科王国是安第斯山区的小城邦，印卡帝国由它发展而来。相传曼科·卡帕克率十个艾柳氏族从帕卡里坦博迁入库斯科河谷，击败或驱逐瓦亚人等族群，于13世纪初建城。最初五位君主属下库斯科王朝，统治着与更强的阿亚尔马卡王国争战的小国。

1337年在位的是卡帕克·尤潘基，他击败孔蒂人，与克丘亚人结盟对抗昌卡人。约1350年他被毒杀，印卡·罗卡夺权，开创上库斯科王朝，成为第一位称印卡的统治者。他和后继者以水渠和宫殿扩建库斯科，并插手科利亚奥战事。

1438年昌卡人入侵，库斯科几近覆灭，王子帕查库特克击退敌军、夺取王位，把王国改组为印卡帝国，直至1533年西班牙人攻占库斯科。

en:
Coatlicamac, a Nahuatl name hispanized as Guatinicamanes, was a lowland kingdom on the swampy frontier between the Aztec province of Tochtepec and the Chinantla jungles, where southern Veracruz meets Oaxaca. Its settlements, including Suchilapan, stood in the Gulf Zoquean belt toward Coatzacoalcos, home to the Zoque, possible kin of the ancient Olmecs, who farmed maize, fished and traded cacao and rubber.

The Mexica knew the district as a restless borderland: after campaigns against the Chinantec towns in the 1470s, the emperor Ahuitzotl defeated the Zoque in 1494 and bound their settlements to pay tribute, though highland and jungle communities kept much of their autonomy.

Spanish conquest under Luis Marín began in 1523, his encomiendas parceling out the villages, and by 1580 the whole district around Suchilapan and Texistepec had been incorporated into the colonial province of Coatzacoalcos.
zh:
夸特利卡马克是纳瓦特尔语地名，西班牙化拼作瓜蒂尼卡马内斯，是阿兹特克托奇特佩克省与钦安特拉丛林之间沼泽边疆的低地王国，地处韦拉克鲁斯南部与瓦哈卡交界。聚落地处通向夸察夸尔科的海湾索克语地带，包括苏奇拉潘；索克人可能是古奥尔梅克人的亲族，种玉米、捕鱼，贸易可可与橡胶。

墨西加人视这一地区为难驭的边疆：1470年代对钦安特克城镇用兵后，皇帝阿维索特尔1494年击败索克人，迫使各聚落纳贡，但山地与丛林社群仍保留相当多自治权。

1523年路易斯·马林开启西班牙征服，他的监护领地瓜分了村庄；到1580年，苏奇拉潘和特克西斯特佩克周边整个地区并入殖民时期的夸察夸尔科省。

en:
Cuitzeo was a Purépecha lakeside town on the shore of the large shallow lake that bears its name in northern Michoacán. Its name comes from a Purépecha word meaning place of water containers, and the area had earlier felt the influence of Chupícuaro, Teotihuacan and Tula.

As the kingdom of Tzintzuntzan expanded under Hiripan, son of the founder Tariácuri, the Lake Cuitzeo basin was absorbed into the Purépecha state, and Cuitzeo remained a town of that state at the Spanish arrival. It became an encomienda in 1528. In 1550 Augustinian friars began the monastery around which the present town grew.
zh:
奎采奥是米却肯北部同名浅水大湖畔的普雷佩查城镇，其名来自普雷佩查语，意为“水罐之地”；更早时这一地区曾受丘皮夸罗、特奥蒂瓦坎和图拉文化影响。

随着开国君主塔里亚库里之子伊里潘率钦聪灿王国扩张，奎采奥湖盆地并入普雷佩查国家，西班牙人到来时奎采奥仍是其属下城镇。1528年它成为委托监护地。1550年奥斯定会修士开始修建修道院，今日的城镇即围绕这座修道院发展起来。

en:
Dongning was a maritime state ruled by the Zheng family from southwestern Taiwan. The Ming loyalist Zheng Chenggong attacked the Dutch on Taiwan in 1661 and forced their surrender at Fort Zeelandia in 1662. He intended to use the island as a base to restore the Ming on the mainland.

His son Zheng Jing renamed the territory Dongning in 1664. The Zheng regime also controlled Penghu and maintained trading links from Japan to Southeast Asia until the Qing annexed it in 1683.
zh:
东宁是郑氏家族以台湾西南部为中心统治的海上政权。明朝遗臣郑成功于1661年进攻台湾的荷兰人，1662年迫使热兰遮城的守军投降。他打算以台湾为基地，在大陆恢复明朝。

他的儿子郑经于1664年将这片领地改名东宁。郑氏政权还控制澎湖，贸易网络从日本延伸到东南亚，直到1683年被清朝吞并。

en: Carthage began as a Phoenician settlement in present-day Tunisia and became a maritime power in the western Mediterranean. Rome destroyed the city in 146 BC after the Third Punic War and later founded a Roman city on the site.
zh: 迦太基起初是今突尼斯境内的一处腓尼基人定居点，后来成为西地中海的海上强国。罗马在第三次布匿战争后于公元前146年摧毁了迦太基城，此后又在原址建立了一座罗马城市。

en:
The Chitimacha lived in villages among the waterways of the Atchafalaya Basin in Louisiana and spoke a language unrelated to any established family. They cultivated maize, beans and squash and travelled in canoes carved from cypress logs.

In 1707 the Chawasha joined a French expedition against them; a long war with the French, epidemics and enslavement devastated the Chitimacha and drove them from Bayou Lafourche. Some Chawasha joined them after a French massacre in 1730.
zh:
奇蒂马查人居住在今路易斯安那州阿查法拉亚盆地水道间的村落，所说语言与任何已确立的语系都没有亲缘关系。他们种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，乘坐柏木独木舟出行。

1707年，查瓦沙人参加法国人讨伐奇蒂马查人的行动；与法国人的长期战争、疫病和奴役重创了奇蒂马查人，并迫使他们离开拉富什河口湾。1730年法国人屠杀查瓦沙人后，部分幸存者加入了奇蒂马查人。

en:
Chiyautla, recorded in colonial sources as Chiyahutla, was a Nahua-speaking town in the Mixteca lowlands of southern Puebla, on the frontier between Nahua and Mixtec country. With Cuetzallan, Ocotlán and Tzontecomapan it dominated the district, and under Aztec rule became the seat of a strategic province whose subject towns supplied cotton, copal and salt; the salt came from a local salt lake and was traded to towns in what is now Morelos.

Spanish forces seized the town at the end of 1520 and granted it in encomienda to Diego de Ordaz. It became a royal corregimiento in 1534, and silver finds in the 1540s raised it to an alcaldía mayor, with an Augustinian convent founded in 1550.
zh:
奇尧特拉在殖民文献中记作奇亚乌特拉，是普埃布拉南部米斯特卡低地的纳瓦语城镇，地处纳瓦人与米斯特克人地区之间的边境。它与奎特萨兰、奥科特兰和聪特科马潘一同主宰这一带；阿兹特克时期成为战略省治所，属下城镇供应棉花、柯巴脂和盐，盐取自当地盐湖，销往今莫雷洛斯一带。

1520年底西班牙军队攻占此城，把它作为监护征赋地封给迭戈·德·奥尔达斯。1534年成为王室辖区，16世纪40年代因银矿发现升格为大市镇，1550年奥斯定会建立修道院。

en:
Chactemal, later called Chetumal, was the southernmost Putún Maya kuchkabal, on the coast between southern Quintana Roo and northern Belize. Its capital was a trading port of some 2,000 households on Chetumal Bay, ringed by cacao orchards, maize fields and stingless-bee apiaries. Chactemal was Yucatán's only notable cacao province; its merchants reached Honduras, where they held a quarter of Nito.

Around 1450 to 1500 the Chontal ruler Pachimalahix I of Acalan sailed against the port and exacted tribute. At contact the province's ruler was Nachan Kan, whose slave and later son-in-law Gonzalo Guerrero, a Spaniard shipwrecked in 1511, rose to war captain, or nacom, and led resistance to early entradas.

Alonso Dávila found the capital deserted and was besieged into retreat in 1531 and 1532; the province fell only to Gaspar Pacheco's bloody expedition of 1543 and 1544, its lands absorbed into Spanish Yucatán.
zh:
查克特埃马尔后称切图马尔，是普屯玛雅人最南边的城邦，地处金塔纳罗奥南部与伯利兹北部之间的海岸。都城是切图马尔湾上约两千户的大港，环以可可园、玉米地和无刺蜂蜂场。查克特埃马尔是尤卡坦唯一重要可可产区，商人远贸洪都拉斯，在尼托港独占商馆区。

约1450—1500年，阿克兰的琼塔尔首领帕奇马拉希一世水师临城，强索贡赋。西班牙人到来时，君主纳昌·坎的奴隶、后为女婿的贡萨洛·格雷罗为1511年沉船的西班牙人，后升任战将，主持对早期入侵的抵抗。

1531—1532年阿隆索·达维拉见都城空城，被围困撤退；1543—1544年加斯帕尔·帕切科血腥征伐，该邦才陷落，地并入西班牙治下尤卡坦。

en: Carantouan was an Indigenous community in the Susquehanna region, allied with the Wendat. In 1615 Étienne Brûlé visited it with Wendat warriors to seek help for Samuel de Champlain's expedition against the Iroquois. The party reached the appointed meeting place too late to assist Champlain.
zh: 卡伦图安是萨斯奎汉纳地区的原住民聚落，与温达特人结盟。1615年，艾蒂安·布吕莱与温达特战士前往卡伦图安，为萨缪尔·德·尚普兰讨伐易洛魁人的远征寻求援助。他们抵达约定地点时已太迟，未能帮助尚普兰。

en: Coto, also called Coctú, was an indigenous chiefdom in the Diquís region of southern Costa Rica. In 1562 its people opposed the expedition of Juan Vázquez de Coronado, who had advanced south from Quepos; the fighting ended in a truce.
zh: 科托又称科克图，是哥斯达黎加南部迪基斯地区的原住民酋邦。1562年，胡安·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多率远征队从克波斯向南推进，科托人予以抵抗，双方最终达成停战。

en:
Chitral was a Hindu Kush mountain kingdom along the Chitral river and its high valleys, its rulers titled mehtar. Chronicles divide its early history into the Kafir, Rais and Kator periods. Before the fourteenth century upper Chitral obeyed Gilgit's Trakhan rulers while Kalasha chiefs held the lower valleys; tradition says that in 1320 a foreign chief, Shah Nadir Rais, perhaps from Turkestan, founded the dynasty.

Islam came in the sixteenth century with Chagatai power, as Mirza Haidar campaigned from Yarkand between 1520 and 1550 and Muslim garrisons took root at Mastuj and Yasin.

The Rais lost ground to the Kator house in a long struggle around Mastuj and the battle of Danin; the last Rais chief was driven into Badakhshan in 1775, and after wars with his Khushwaqt kinsmen Mohtaram Shah II Kator became supreme in 1833, ruling from the Kunar valley towards Gilgit.
zh:
吉德拉尔是兴都库什山王国，沿吉德拉尔河与高山谷地分布，统治者称梅赫塔尔。编年史分早期历史为异教、赖莎、卡托尔三期。14世纪以前上吉德拉尔臣属吉尔吉特的特剌汗统治者，卡拉什酋长据下游；相传1320年外来首领沙·纳迪尔·赖莎（可能来自突厥斯坦）建该王朝。

16世纪伊斯兰随察合台进入：1520—1550年米尔扎·海达尔自叶尔羌远征，穆斯林据点在马斯图吉、亚辛扎根。

赖莎家族在长期争斗中被卡托尔家族压倒，战事围绕马斯图吉、达宁之战；1775年末代赖莎首领被逐往巴达赫尚，莫赫塔兰姆沙二世·卡托尔与其胡什瓦克特同族多年厮杀后，1833年成吉德拉尔之主，势力从库纳尔河谷延伸到吉尔吉特方向。

en:
The Chatot, also called Chacato, lived along the upper Apalachicola and Chipola rivers in present-day Florida. Spanish missionaries established two missions in their villages in 1674, but attempts to impose Christian observances provoked a revolt.

After English and allied raids destroyed the Apalachee missions in 1704, surviving Chatot moved west toward Pensacola and Mobile bays. Some moved on to Louisiana when Britain acquired West Florida in 1763.
zh:
查托特人又称查卡托人，居住在今佛罗里达州阿巴拉契科拉河上游和奇波拉河流域。1674年，西班牙传教士在他们的村落建立了两处传教站，但强制推行基督教仪规引发了反抗。

1704年，英国人及其盟友的袭击摧毁了阿巴拉契地区的传教站，幸存的查托特人向西迁往彭萨科拉湾和莫比尔湾附近。1763年英国取得西佛罗里达后，一部分人继续西迁至路易斯安那。

en:
Tianwan was a Red Turban state founded in Hubei during the revolt against the Yuan. In 1351 Zou Pusheng captured Qishui and enthroned the cloth seller Xu Shouhui as its emperor. The rebels briefly occupied Hanyang and Wuchang before losing them in 1352.

The commander Ni Wenjun retook Hanyang and made it the capital in 1356. Chen Youliang later gained control of the army, killed Xu in 1360 and renamed the state Han.
zh:
天完是反元战争中在湖北建立的红巾军政权。1351年，邹普胜攻占蕲水，拥立布贩徐寿辉为帝。起义军曾短暂占据汉阳和武昌，1352年失去这两座城。

将领倪文俊于1356年收复汉阳，将其定为都城。此后陈友谅掌握军权，1360年杀死徐寿辉，改国号为汉。

en:
Cuetlaxtlan was a Nahua-speaking altepetl of the Gulf plain, its population mixed with non-Nahuatl Pinome peoples. In the fifteenth century it lay on the frontier between the expanding Aztec Empire and its rival Tlaxcala, which treated the region as a proxy front.

Mexica and Acolhua armies under Moctezuma I and Nezahualcoyotl campaigned there from the 1460s and eventually overran it, and Cuetlaxtlan became an Aztec tributary province paying mantas, cacao and tropical feathers under a Mexica governor styled Pinotecuhtli, lord of the Pinome. It later rebelled, whereupon Axayacatl reconquered it, replaced its rulers, stationed a garrison and sharply increased the tribute.

Restive under Tenochtitlan, the coastal towns offered no resistance when Hernan Cortes landed in 1519, and their Mexica watchmen were among the first to report the Spanish ships to Moctezuma II.
zh:
奎特拉斯特兰是海湾平原上讲纳瓦特尔语的阿尔特佩特尔城邦，居民混有不讲纳瓦特尔语的皮诺梅人。15世纪时它处在扩张中的阿兹特克帝国与宿敌特拉斯卡拉之间的边境，特拉斯卡拉视其为代理人冲突前沿。

15世纪60年代起，蒙特苏马一世与内萨瓦尔科约特尔麾下的墨西加和阿科瓦军队反复攻入，终征服此地，奎特拉斯特兰成为阿兹特克朝贡行省，进献棉布、可可和热带鸟羽，由封号皮诺梅人之主的墨西加总督管辖。后来当地反叛，阿萨亚卡特尔再度征服，撤换统治者、派驻驻军，大幅加重贡赋。

1519年埃尔南·科尔特斯登陆时，不堪特诺奇蒂特兰压迫的沿海诸城未作抵抗，墨西加瞭望兵也是最早把西班牙船只禀报蒙特苏马二世的人之一。

en:
Coatzacualco, whose Nahuatl name means “where the serpent hides”, stood at the mouth of its river on the Bay of Campeche, in southern Veracruz. Local legend held that the god Quetzalcoatl sailed east from here and promised to return.

By the early sixteenth century it was the capital of a trading polity covering much of the Olmeca region, with subject and allied settlements such as Acayucan; its people were mostly Isthmus-dialect Nahuas, alongside Popoluca communities and Zapotec minorities. Canoes carried cacao, rubber and textiles to markets whose merchants rivalled the Mexica pochteca of the Aztec garrison at Tochtepec. Despite fighting with the garrison, Coatzacualco never became an Aztec subject; the Mexica instead negotiated safe passage through to Tabasco.

In 1522 Cortés sent Gonzalo de Sandoval to the estuary, where he founded Villa del Espíritu Santo beside the native capital and brought the polity under colonial rule.
zh:
科亚特萨夸尔科的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“蛇藏匿之处”，位于同名河流注入坎佩切湾的河口，地处韦拉克鲁斯州南部。当地传说，神祇克察尔科亚特尔正是从此扬帆东去，许诺终将归来。

到16世纪初，这里已是一个贸易政权的首都，势力覆盖奥尔梅卡地区的大部，属镇和盟邦包括阿卡尤坎；居民以讲地峡方言的纳瓦人为主，另有波波卢卡人社群和少数萨波特克人。舟楫把可可、橡胶和纺织品运抵此地市场，本地商人与托奇特佩克阿兹特克驻军的墨西加商人竞争。双方兵戎相见，但科亚特萨夸尔科始终未被征服，墨西加人反而通过谈判取得了取道此地前往塔巴斯科的安全通行权。

1522年，科尔特斯派贡萨洛·德桑多瓦尔前往河口，在本土都城旁建立圣神镇，把该政权纳入殖民统治。

en:
The Charrua were semi-nomadic Indigenous communities of the Río de la Plata region, living by hunting, fishing and gathering. After resisting Spanish settlement, they concluded a peace treaty with the colonial authorities in 1732. In the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries the expansion of cattle ranching disrupted their livelihoods.

In 1831 Uruguayan forces under President Fructuoso Rivera attacked Charrua people at Salsipuedes. Many were killed or taken prisoner, while others escaped to neighbouring regions.
zh:
查鲁亚人是拉普拉塔河地区半游动的原住民社群，以狩猎、捕鱼和采集为生。他们抵抗西班牙殖民，1732年与殖民当局缔结和约。18至19世纪，养牛业的扩张破坏了他们的生计。

1831年，乌拉圭总统弗鲁克图奥索·里韦拉率军在萨尔西普埃德斯袭击查鲁亚人，许多人被杀或被俘，另一些人逃往邻近地区。

en: The Cuica were an Indigenous people of the Venezuelan Andes, related to the neighboring Timote. They inhabited the area of present-day Trujillo, where Andean communities farmed irrigated terraces and grew crops including potatoes and maize.
zh: 奎卡是委内瑞拉安第斯山地区的原住民，与邻近的蒂莫特人关系密切。他们居住在今特鲁希略一带，当地安第斯社群利用灌溉梯田种植马铃薯和玉米等作物。

en:
Cuismancu, also called Guzmango, was the kingdom that ruled the Cajamarca highlands of northern Peru from about 1250, in the Final Cajamarca phase. Its hilltop centres, Tantarica and Guzmango Viejo, overlooked the mountain-to-coast route, while Kasha Marka, the future Cajamarca, had been founded by about 1320.

Its rulers bore the title Guzmango Capac; in the first half of the fifteenth century one of them conquered the lordship of Huamachuco and allied with Minchancaman of Chimor, and the kingdom's fine kaolin ceramics carried its influence across the northern Andes.

The alliance could not stop the Incas: after building the Incahuasi fortress around 1453, the generals Capac Yupanqui and Tupac Inca Yupanqui overwhelmed the confederate army, the ruler Cuismanco fell defending Cajamarca in about 1460, and his realm became an Inca province and the base for the later conquest of Chimor.
zh:
奎斯曼库又称古斯曼戈，是1250年前后起统治秘鲁北部卡哈马卡高原的王国，对应卡哈马卡末期阶段。它的山城中心坦塔里卡和古斯曼戈维霍扼守山区通往海岸的道路；卡沙马卡即后来的卡哈马卡，约在1320年便已建立。

统治者称古斯曼戈·卡帕克，15世纪上半叶，一位古斯曼戈·卡帕克吞并了瓦马丘科领主邦，并与奇穆的明查卡曼联盟；王国精美的高岭土陶器把它的影响带到整个安第斯北部。

但联盟挡不住印加人：1453年前后印加军建起印卡瓦西要塞后，将领卡帕克·尤潘基和图帕克·印卡·尤潘基击溃联军，统治者奎斯曼库约在1460年保卫卡哈马卡时战死，他的国家成为印加行省，也是日后征服奇穆的基地。

en:
Culhuacan was a Nahua altepetl on the Ixtapalapa peninsula between Lake Texcoco and Lake Xochimilco, and one of the earliest chinampa towns, with floating gardens dating to around 1100. Tradition held that Toltecs under Mixcoatl founded it as their first city, and the Culhua were regarded as heirs of Tollan and the first to call their ruler tlatoani.

In 1299 its ruler Coxcoxtli joined the Tepanecs in expelling the Mexica from Chapultepec and settled them at Tizaapan as vassals and mercenaries. Marriage ties from those years mattered later, for Acamapichtli, the first tlatoani of Tenochtitlan, was Coxcoxtli's grandson. In 1337 the throne belonged to Achitomecatl Teomecatl II.

The city's independence ended in 1377, when Azcapotzalco subdued it largely with Mexica troops, and when Itzcoatl overthrew Tepanec power in 1428 he took the title Ruler of the Culhua.
zh:
库尔瓦坎是特斯科科湖与索奇米尔科湖之间伊斯塔帕拉帕半岛上的纳瓦城邦，属最早的奇南帕城镇之一，浮园耕作可追溯到1100年前后。相传托尔特克人在米斯科瓦特尔率领下建此城为第一座城市，库尔瓦人被视为托兰继承者，也是最早把君主称为特拉托阿尼的族群。

1299年，统治者科克斯科特里联合特帕内克人把墨西加人逐出查普尔特佩克，安置在蒂萨潘，充作附庸和雇佣兵。这段时期结下的联姻后来影响深远：特诺奇蒂特兰首任特拉托阿尼阿卡马皮奇特利正是科克斯科特里的外孙。1337年在位的是阿奇托梅卡特·特奥梅卡特二世。

1377年阿斯卡波察尔科主要依靠墨西加军队征服库尔瓦坎，独立就此终结；1428年伊兹科阿特尔推翻特帕内克霸权后，接过“库尔瓦人之主”的称号。

en:
Cuauhtochco was a Nahuatl-speaking province on the north bank of the Río Atoyac in the Veracruz lowlands, its capital at the site now called Huatusco. It had once been part of Totonacapan, and around 1454 a son of the Texcocan ruler Nezahualcóyotl conquered it for the allied Acolhua and Mexica.

Under Aztec rule it became a Gulf-coast tributary province, governed from a garrison capital whose nearly intact Postclassic pyramid still stands, and it shipped up the cacao, cotton and vanilla of the lowlands. Towns such as Otlaquiquixtla answered to its governor.

After Tenochtitlan fell, the garrison held out until November 1521, when Gonzalo de Sandoval stormed it; the district lost population in the early colonial years.
zh:
夸赫托奇科是韦拉克鲁斯低地阿托亚克河北岸的纳瓦特尔语省份，都城即在瓦图斯科遗址。这一地区原属托托纳卡潘，约1454年，特斯科科君主内萨瓦尔科约特尔的一个儿子替阿科卢阿与墨西卡联军征服了它。

在阿兹特克统治下，它成为墨西哥湾沿岸的纳贡省，由一座驻军都城管辖，城中有一座保存基本完好的后古典期金字塔，省内把低地出产的可可、棉花和香荚兰输向高原，奥特拉基基斯特拉等城镇都听命于其长官。

特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，这支驻军坚守到1521年11月，被贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔攻破；殖民初期当地人口流失。

en:
The Chutia kingdom, also called Sadiya after its capital, was a late medieval state in the upper Brahmaputra valley, covering Lakhimpur, Dhemaji and Tinsukia districts and adjoining Arunachal Pradesh plains and foothills. The Chutias, a confederation of Bodo-Kachari clans, had built a settled kingdom around Sadiya before the 1228 Ahom arrival, and grew into the region's most advanced tribal state, with trade and Hinduised royal cult; its kings patronised tribal goddess Dikkaravasini, served by Deori priests.

Relations with the Ahoms opened badly: around 1376 the Ahom king Sutuphaa was killed during a Chutia encounter, and Tyaokhamti's expedition against Sadiya failed.

Border war began in 1512, when Suhungmung seized the Chutia dependency of Panbari; King Dhirnarayan was routed in 1523 and fell with his son, and the Ahoms annexed the kingdom under a Sadiakhowa Gohain. Spoils included cannons and thousands of blacksmiths, whose gunmaking supplied the Ahom army.
zh:
久蒂亚王国又称萨地亚，得名于都城，是布拉马普特拉河上游的中世纪国家，疆域含拉金布尔、德马吉、丁苏吉亚诸县及相邻的阿鲁纳恰尔平原与山麓。久蒂亚人是博多-卡恰尔诸氏族的联盟，早在1228年阿洪姆人到来前便在萨地亚周围建立定居王国，后来发展为当地最先进的部族国家，有贸易和印度教化王室崇拜；历代国王供奉部落女神迪卡罗瓦西尼，由德奥里祭司主持。

久蒂亚与阿洪姆一开始便交恶：约1376年阿洪姆国王苏图法在与久蒂亚的一次接触中被杀，陶坎蒂征讨萨地亚的远征也无果而终。

1512年边境开战，苏洪蒙夺取久蒂亚属地潘巴里；1523年国王迪尔纳拉扬战败，与儿子一同被杀，阿洪姆吞并其国，设萨迪亚科瓦·戈汉管辖故地。战利品有火炮和数千名铁匠，其造炮技艺此后供阿洪姆军队所用。

en:
Cuauhnahuac, renamed Cuernavaca by the Spaniards, was the principal town of the Tlahuica, a Nahua people holding the warm valley of Morelos since the twelfth century. Its name means beside the trees, and in 1337 it was still an independent kingdom in western Morelos; in 1365 its lord Macuilxochitl marched north and collided with Tzalcualtitlan, lord of Chalco.

The Aztecs came for its cotton: Huitzilihuitl of Tenochtitlan was refused a marriage alliance, made war, and won in 1396, wedding the princess who would bear Moctezuma I. Conquered Tlalnahuac was renamed Cuauhnahuac, and a rebellion under Miquiuix was crushed in 1433 by Nezahualcoyotl; its cotton, amate paper and flowers flowed to Tenochtitlan.

In April 1521 Gonzalo de Sandoval and Cortés stormed the city, burning it before marching on Tenochtitlan. Cortés later made the valley his favourite seat, building a palace there in 1526.
zh:
库埃纳瓦卡是特拉维卡人的主城，西班牙人后改名奎尔纳瓦卡；特拉维卡人是纳瓦人的一支，12世纪起便占据莫雷洛斯温暖的河谷。它的名字意为树木环绕之地，1337年仍是莫雷洛斯西部的独立王国；1365年君主马基尔索奇特利北上，与查尔科君主察尔夸尔蒂特兰相撞。

阿兹特克人为它的棉花而来：特诺奇蒂特兰的维齐利维特尔求娶公主遭拒，随即开战，1396年取胜并娶了这位公主，她就是蒙特祖马一世的母亲。被征服的特拉尔纳瓦克省改名库埃纳瓦卡；1433年内萨瓦尔科约特尔镇压了米基维什的叛乱。棉花、阿玛特树皮纸和花卉运往特诺奇蒂特兰。

1521年4月，贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔和科尔特斯攻陷此城，焚城后继续向特诺奇蒂特兰进军。科尔特斯后偏爱此河谷，1526年在此修建宫殿。

en:
Cutzamala, whose Nahuatl name means place of rainbows and which Purépecha speakers called Apatzingani, lies in the hot Tierra Caliente lowlands on the border between Guerrero and Michoacán. During the Postclassic it was the Purépecha kingdom's easternmost garrison outpost, facing the Aztec Empire across a heavily fortified frontier: the Relaciones geográficas report up to ten thousand Purépecha warriors stationed there, matched on the Aztec side by the fortress of Oztuma.

The border hardened after 1476, when the Tarascan army inflicted on Axayacatl the only major defeat the Aztecs had yet suffered, ending Mexica hopes of pushing west into Michoacán.

The garrison lost its purpose only when the Purépecha kingdom lost its independence to the Spanish in 1530; the old frontier town is present-day Cutzamala de Pinzón, site of the first Tierra Caliente battle of the 1810 independence uprising.
zh:
库察马拉的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“彩虹之地”，普雷佩查语称阿帕钦加尼，地处炎热的暖地，位于格雷罗与米却肯交界。后古典期，它是普雷佩查王国最东端的驻军要塞，越过重兵把守的边境与阿兹特克帝国相望：《地理记述》记载当地常驻多达万人的普雷佩查战士部队，阿兹特克一侧则以奥斯图马要塞相对。

1476年，塔拉斯卡军队让阿萨亚卡特尔遭遇阿兹特克人当时唯一一场重大惨败，墨西加人西进米却肯的企图就此终结，此后边界更加壁垒森严。

直到1530年普雷佩查王国被西班牙人征服、丧失独立，这座要塞才失去原有作用；古城即今日的库察马拉-德平松，1810年独立起义中暖地第一场战斗便发生于此。

en:
East Breifne, or Breifne O Reilly, was a Gaelic kingdom of 1256 to 1607, roughly the later County Cavan. The O Reillys had once been vassals of Breifne's O Rourkes, but long revolt ended with the 1256 division and the Battle of Magh Slecht, after which they ruled the east from their castle at Tullymongan Hill. Under Giolla Iosa Ruaidh the Cavan market town grew below the castle; in 1337 his son Richard held the kingship.

Unusually for Gaelic Ireland, it struck silver coinage, O Reilly money, minted at Cavan from the early fifteenth century; English parliaments outlawed the coins in 1447 and 1456, yet the kingdom stayed a prosperous trading country.

The O Reillys joined the Nine Years War; after the 1603 Treaty of Mellifont and 1607 Flight of the Earls, dozens were attainted and their lands opened to the Plantation of Cavan.
zh:
东布雷夫讷，又称奥赖利的布雷夫讷，是1256至1607年间的盖尔人王国，疆域大致相当于后来的卡文郡。奥赖利家族原本是布雷夫讷奥罗克家族的附庸，但长期反叛以1256年分裂和马什莱克特战役告终，此后奥赖利家族从塔利蒙根山城堡统治东部。吉奥拉·伊奥萨·鲁艾治下，城堡脚下兴起卡文集镇；1337年其子理查德继任国王。

与盖尔爱尔兰其他地区不同，它铸造银币，即15世纪初起在卡文打造的“奥赖利币”；英格兰议会1447年和1456年两度立法禁用，它仍是富庶的商贸之邦。

奥赖利家族加入九年战争，1603年《梅利丰特条约》和1607年“伯爵出逃”后，数十名族人被褫夺公权，土地没收划入卡文种植园。

en:
Clanwilliam, in Irish Clann Liam, was the Munster lordship of the junior Burkes of the House of Burgh, named from William de Burgh, founder of the dynasty in Ireland. Its country lay along the Shannon in eastern County Limerick, with Castleconnell its chief seat. The line descended from Sir Edmond de Burgh, born in 1298, youngest son of Richard, Earl of Ulster and lord of Connacht. His grandsons founded the three septs of Castleconnell, Brittas and Muskerryquirk, the Burkes of Clanwilliam.

In 1338 Edmond was seized by his rival Edmond Albanach Burke and drowned in Lough Mask with a stone about his neck, yet his sept held the Limerick lands.

In 1580 Sir William Bourke was created Baron Bourke of Castleconnell; the title was forfeited in 1691, when the eighth baron was attainted after the Williamite war.
zh:
克兰威廉，爱尔兰语称克兰·利亚姆，是伯格家族旁支在芒斯特的领地，名称取自伯格王朝在爱尔兰的始祖威廉·德·伯格。其地在利默里克郡东部香农河沿岸，以卡斯尔康奈尔为首要驻地。这一支系出自1298年生的埃德蒙·德·伯格爵士，他是阿尔斯特伯爵兼康诺特领主理查德的幼子。他的孙子建立卡斯尔康奈尔、布里塔斯和马斯凯里夸克三个支系，合称克兰威廉的伯格人。

1338年埃德蒙被对手埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳克·伯格擒获，颈上拴石沉入马斯克湖，但他的支系仍保住利默里克的土地。

1580年威廉·伯格爵士受封卡斯尔康奈尔伯格男爵；1691年威廉战争后，第八代男爵被褫夺公权，爵位遭没收。

en:
Xia was a rebel state in Sichuan founded by Ming Yuzhen, a general of the Red Turban state of Tianwan. Ming captured Chongqing in 1357 and refused to submit when Chen Youliang killed Tianwan's ruler in 1360. He proclaimed the Great Xia in 1362, with Chongqing as its capital.

An attempt to conquer Yunnan failed in 1363. Ming Yuzhen died in 1366, and his young son Ming Sheng surrendered to the Ming dynasty in 1371.
zh:
夏是天完红巾军将领明玉珍在四川建立的政权。明玉珍于1357年攻占重庆，1360年陈友谅杀死天完君主后，他拒绝归附。1362年，他以重庆为都建立大夏。

夏军于1363年进攻云南，未能取胜。明玉珍于1366年去世，他年幼的儿子明升于1371年向明朝投降。

en:
Sacha-p-qulla is the Quechua name, meaning roughly qulla people of the woods, for the Chachapoya, the Warriors of the Clouds, who held the misty eastern Andean slopes around the Utcubamba River in northern Peru. Their culture took shape around 800, and its strongholds were walled ridge citadels; Kuelap, begun in the sixth century and largely built between 900 and 1100, enclosed over four hundred circular stone houses behind twenty-metre limestone walls and held some three thousand people.

The Inca emperor Topa Inca Yupanqui opened a hard conquest campaign in the 1470s, taking one hill fort after another, and deportations and revolts continued under Huayna Capac.

When the Spanish invaded Peru, many Chachapoya sided with them, and the newcomers founded Chachapoyas in 1538; Kuelap was abandoned in 1570.
zh:
查查波亚的克丘亚语名称为Sacha-p-qulla，原意大致是林中的科利亚人，他们又被称为云中之战士，据守秘鲁北部乌特库班巴河一带云雾缭绕的安第斯山东坡。其文化约800年成形，据点是雄踞山脊的围墙城堡；库埃拉普始建于6世纪，主要建于900至1100年间，二十米高的石灰岩围墙内有四百多座圆形石屋，居民约三千人。

印加皇帝图帕克·印卡·尤潘基1470年代发动艰苦征服战，逐个拔除山头堡垒，强制迁徙和反抗在瓦伊纳·卡帕克时期仍在继续。

西班牙人入侵秘鲁时，许多查查波亚人倒向西班牙人，西班牙人1538年建立查查波亚城，库埃拉普1570年被废弃。

en: Copayacu was a settlement and valley in the Diaguita lands around present-day Copiapó in Chile. In the late fifteenth century the Inca Empire expanded into the region, later distinguishing a province of Copayapo from its province farther south.
zh: 科帕亚库是迪亚吉塔人地区的一处聚落和河谷，位于今智利科皮亚波一带。15世纪末印加帝国向这一地区扩张，后来将科帕亚波省与南方的行省区分开来。

en:
The Kingdom of Cyprus was a crusader state of the French House of Lusignan. Richard I of England seized it from Byzantine prince Isaac Komnenos in 1191 during the Third Crusade and sold it to the Templars, who in 1192 handed it to Guy of Lusignan. After Acre fell in 1291 Cyprus became the main Christian trading hub of the eastern Mediterranean, Famagusta drawing merchants from Genoa and Venice.

In 1337 the throne belonged to Hugh IV, whose reign and that of his son Peter I marked its peak: Peter captured Antalya in 1361 and led the sack of Alexandria in 1365, before his knights murdered him in 1369.

Genoese intervention from 1373 curtailed it, and a Mamluk invasion in 1426 captured King Janus and reduced Cyprus to tributary status. Its last queen, Catherine Cornaro, was forced to sell Cyprus to Venice in 1489.
zh:
塞浦路斯王国是法兰西吕西尼昂家族统治的十字军国家。第三次十字军东征期间，英格兰国王理查一世1191年从拜占庭王公伊萨克·科穆宁手中夺取该岛，转卖圣殿骑士团；骑士团1192年把它交给吕西尼昂的居伊。1291年阿卡陷落后，塞浦路斯成为东地中海最主要的基督教贸易枢纽，法马古斯塔云集热那亚、威尼斯商人。

1337年在位的是于格四世，他与儿子彼得一世两朝正值国力顶峰：彼得1361年攻占安塔利亚，1365年领军洗劫亚历山大，1369年被自己的骑士刺杀。

1373年起热那亚人的干涉削弱王国，1426年马穆鲁克入侵，国王雅努斯被俘，塞浦路斯沦为附庸。1489年末代女王卡特琳娜·科尔纳罗被迫把岛屿卖给威尼斯。

en:
Tanico was a town in the land of the Cayas, visited by Hernando de Soto's expedition during its journey through the southeast of North America in 1539–1543. The chief of Palisema directed the expedition there.

The people of Tanico made and traded salt from the sands of a stream flowing into the Cayas River, later identified as the Arkansas River. They poured water through baskets of sand, then dried the brine in shallow bowls and scraped out the salt.
zh:
塔尼科是卡亚斯人土地上的一座城镇，埃尔南多·德索托的探险队于1539—1543年间穿行北美东南部时曾到访此地。帕利塞马的酋长指引探险队前往塔尼科。

塔尼科人从汇入卡亚斯河的溪流沙土中制盐并进行交易；卡亚斯河后来被认作阿肯色河。他们用篮子盛沙，淋水制成卤水，再将卤水放在浅碗中晒干，刮取盐粒。

en:
The Duchy of Czersk was the southernmost of the Masovian Piast duchies, covering the middle Vistula around Czersk and Warsaw castles. It arose from the 1313 partition of Mazovia, when Trojden I, the ruler shown in 1337, received the Czersk lands and held them until 1341.

His son Siemowit III inherited Czersk and used it as a base to reunite most of Mazovia under his rule; he accepted Polish suzerainty in 1351.

In the renewed 1381 partition Czersk went to Janusz I, who in 1413 moved his residence from Czersk castle to growing Warsaw, which became the permanent capital of the Masovian dukes. The reunited Duchy of Masovia, including the old Czersk lands, was incorporated into Poland in 1526 after the Masovian Piast line died out.
zh:
切尔斯克公国是马佐夫舍皮亚斯特诸公国中最南的一个，领有维斯瓦河中游及切尔斯克、华沙城堡一带。1313年马佐夫舍分封，1337年在任的特罗伊登一世分得切尔斯克领地，统治到1341年。

其子谢莫维特三世继承切尔斯克，以此为根基重新统一马佐夫舍大部，1351年接受波兰宗主权。

1381年再度分封，切尔斯克归雅努什一世；1413年他把驻地从切尔斯克城堡迁至日益繁荣的华沙，华沙从此成为马佐夫舍公爵的固定都城。1526年马佐夫舍皮亚斯特血脉断绝，连同旧切尔斯克领地在内、重新统一的马佐夫舍公国并入波兰。

en:
Cozalapan corresponds to the pre-conquest state of Cozolapa in the Amula highlands of what is now southern Jalisco. Its people spoke the extinct western Otomi language of Jalisco, and Nahuatl was also used in its villages, chief of them Cuzalapa. Together with the neighbouring states of Amole and Tuxcacuexco it defeated Purépecha incursions early in the sixteenth century.

The Spanish overran Cozolapa with the rest of Amula in 1523 and incorporated it into the colonial province of Amula, where Franciscan friars began missionary work in the 1540s.
zh:
科萨拉潘对应征服前阿穆拉高地的科索拉帕邦，位于今哈利斯科南部。居民使用已消亡的哈利斯科西奥托米语，各村庄同时也通行纳瓦特尔语，其中以库萨拉帕最为重要。16世纪初，它与阿莫兰、图斯卡库埃斯科等邻邦一起击退了普雷佩查人的进犯。

1523年，西班牙人在征服阿穆拉各地时拿下科索拉帕，将其并入阿穆拉省，方济各会于16世纪40年代进入当地传教。

en:
Daura, a desert-edge town in northwestern Nigeria, was the spiritual home of the Hausa and one of their seven true states. Hausa tradition places the founding story of all Hausa dynasties there in the 800s: wandering hero Bayajidda crossed the Sahara to Daura, slew the serpent Sarki, whose name means king, guarding the town well and stopping its people drawing water, and married the reigning queen Magajiya Daurama. The Kusugu well remained the kingdom's most sacred site, and sons of Bayajidda's two wives ruled Daura and six sister states.

Hausa tradition called Daura and Katsina kings of the market, for caravans carried Sahara salt south and cloth and slaves north; it was an ancient seat of Islamic learning, though weaker than Kano or Katsina.

In 1805 Fulani warrior Malam Ishaku overran it in jihad and founded an emirate; displaced Hausa princes kept rival courts at Zango from 1825.
zh:
道拉是尼日利亚西北部沙漠边缘的小镇，是豪萨人的精神故乡，也是豪萨七城邦之一。豪萨传统把所有豪萨王朝的起源故事放在9世纪的道拉：流浪英雄巴亚吉达穿越撒哈拉抵达道拉，杀死盘踞镇中水井、阻止居民取水的巨蛇萨尔基（意为“国王”），娶在位女王马加吉亚·道拉马为妻。库苏古井长期是王国最神圣的场所，巴亚吉达两位妻子所生的儿子分别统治道拉和六个姊妹城邦。

豪萨传统把道拉与卡齐纳并称“市场之王”：商队把撒哈拉的盐南运，把布匹和奴隶北贩；它也是古老的伊斯兰学术中心，只是实力不及卡诺和卡齐纳。

1805年富拉尼战士马拉姆·伊沙库在圣战中攻占道拉，建立埃米尔国；流亡的豪萨王公1825年起在赞戈维持对抗的王庭。

en:
Dahomey arose around 1600 among the Fon on the Abomey plateau in present-day Benin, as an offshoot of the royal dynasty of Allada. King Houegbadja built the royal palaces at Abomey and expanded beyond the plateau during his reign from about 1645 to 1685.

His grandson Agaja conquered Whydah in 1727, giving Dahomey access to the Atlantic slave trade. Dahomey's armies included a corps of women soldiers; under King Ghezo, who came to the throne in 1818, their military organisation was strengthened.
zh:
达荷美约于1600年在今贝宁境内阿波美高原的丰人中兴起，其王室出自阿拉达王朝。国王韦格巴贾在约1645—1685年统治期间修建阿波美王宫，并向高原以外扩张。

他的孙子阿加贾于1727年征服维达，使达荷美得以参与大西洋奴隶贸易。达荷美军队中有一支女性部队；1818年即位的国王盖佐加强了这支部队的军事组织。

en:
Đại Việt, centred on the Red River delta at Thăng Long, grew from tenth-century kingdoms independent of Chinese rule. Đinh Bộ Lĩnh ended the Anarchy of the Twelve Warlords and proclaimed Đại Cồ Việt in 968, shortened to Đại Việt in 1054. The Lý and Trần dynasties patronised Mahayana Buddhism and chữ Nôm letters and repelled three Mongol invasions, crowned by the Bạch Đằng victory of 1288.

In 1400 the minister Hồ Quý Ly seized the throne, and seven years later the Ming conquered the country and ruled it as Jiaozhi. Lê Lợi's Lam Sơn uprising drove the Ming out in 1427 and founded the Later Lê dynasty; Lê Thánh Tông shattered Champa in 1471 and pushed south.

A Mạc usurpation in 1527 and the Trịnh–Nguyễn rivalry split the country for two centuries, the Lê emperors mere figureheads. The Tây Sơn overthrew both houses, but in 1802 the Nguyễn defeated them, founded a dynasty at Huế, and in 1804 renamed the kingdom Việt Nam.
zh:
大越以红河三角洲的昇龙为中心，由10世纪摆脱中原统治的越南诸政权发展而来：丁部领结束十二使君之乱，968年建国号大瞿越，1054年改名大越。李朝、陈朝推崇汉传佛教，扶持字喃文学，三次击退蒙古入侵，以1288年白藤江之战最为著名。

1400年大臣胡季犛篡位，七年后明朝征服该国，将其作为交趾管辖。黎利发动蓝山起义，1427年驱逐明军，建立后黎朝；黎圣宗1471年击破占婆，向南开拓。

1527年莫氏篡位，此后郑主与阮主纷争，国家分裂两个世纪，黎皇仅存虚名。西山起义推翻两大世家，1802年阮氏攻灭西山，在顺化建新朝，1804年将王国改名越南。

en:
The Daju kingdom was the first historically recorded state in Darfur, ruled from Jebel Marra's southern slopes by the Daju people, who probably came from the Nubian Nile valley and displaced the older Tora culture. The geographer al-Idrisi described it in 1154 as a pagan camel-herding land between Kanem and Nubia with only two towns, Tajuwa and Samna, the latter destroyed by a Nubian governor.

A century later Ibn Sa'id found them partly Islamized and tributary to Kanem, and around 1400 al-Maqrizi noted their stoneworking skill. Royal power rested on loose military overlordship, tribal chiefs paying tribute; the kings may have been divine sovereigns seldom seen in public.

In the fifteenth century the Tunjur settled northern Jebel Marra and supplanted the Daju; tradition calls the last king, Ahmad al-Daj, a tyrant exiled to Dar Sila, now in Chad, where his line ruled as local sultans. His flight likely came in the late fifteenth century; the Tunjur kingdom inherited Darfur.
zh:
达朱王国是达尔富尔第一个见诸史籍的国家，由达朱人在马拉山南麓统治；他们很可能来自努比亚尼罗河谷，取代了更早的托拉文化。地理学家伊德里西1154年记载，这是加涅姆与努比亚之间信奉异教的养驼之国，仅有塔朱瓦、萨姆纳两座城镇，后者被一位努比亚总督摧毁。

一个多世纪后，伊本·赛义德发现达朱人已部分伊斯兰化，沦为加涅姆附庸；约1400年马克里齐称道他们擅长石工。王权建立在松散的军事支配之上，各部首领纳贡，国王还可能是极少公开露面的神人君主。

15世纪通朱尔人在马拉山北部定居并取代达朱人；口述传统称末代国王艾哈迈德·达吉是暴君，被逐后流亡到今乍得境内的达尔西拉，后裔在那里世代为苏丹。这场流亡很可能在15世纪末，通朱尔王国随即继承达尔富尔。

en:
Dalmatia is the Adriatic coastal region around Zadar, Split and Dubrovnik. Its cities passed between Venice and the Hungarian-Croatian crown; Venice ruled much of the coast from 1420 until 1797, while Ragusa remained a separate republic.

The Treaty of Campo Formio transferred Venetian Dalmatia to Austria in 1797. After French rule during the Napoleonic wars, the Congress of Vienna created an Austrian Kingdom of Dalmatia in 1815, with its capital at Zadar.
zh:
达尔马提亚是亚得里亚海沿岸的地区，包括扎达尔、斯普利特和杜布罗夫尼克一带。当地城市曾在威尼斯和匈牙利－克罗地亚王权之间易手；威尼斯从1420年到1797年统治了大部分海岸，拉古萨则是独立的共和国。

1797年的《坎波福尔米奥条约》将威尼斯属达尔马提亚转交奥地利。拿破仑战争期间法国统治之后，维也纳会议于1815年设立奥地利属达尔马提亚王国，以扎达尔为首府。

en:
Damot was a medieval kingdom in the western Ethiopian highlands, south of the Blue Nile, its kings titled motalami and holding court at Maldarede. Possibly formed in the tenth century, it was formidable by the thirteenth: it forced Shewa's Muslim sultanate to pay tribute and destroyed Zagwe armies sent against it. Its best-remembered king is Motolomi Sato, whom some scholars link to Wolaita's Malla dynasty.

In 1316 or 1317 Emperor Amda Seyon invaded and annexed it, deporting part of its people but leaving the royal line; the motalami title survived into the fifteenth century.

From the fourteenth century it weakened as Oromo clans pressed in; by the late sixteenth century Macha Oromo under Mula'ata Lubas overran the region, and many fled into Gojjam. A Christian Damot province survived in the Ethiopian empire, ruled by a ras from Gojjam.
zh:
达莫特是埃塞俄比亚西部高原的中世纪王国，地处青尼罗河以南，国王称莫塔拉米，在马尔达雷德设朝。它可能形成于10世纪，到13世纪已是强权：迫使穆斯林绍阿苏丹国纳贡，歼灭扎格维王朝派来征讨的军队。最著名的国王莫托洛米·萨托，部分学者将他与沃拉伊塔马拉王朝联系起来。

1316或1317年皇帝阿姆达·塞翁入侵并吞并达莫特，迁走部分人口，但保留王室，莫塔拉米头衔沿用到15世纪。

14世纪起奥罗莫诸部进逼，王国日趋衰弱；16世纪末，穆拉阿塔·卢巴斯率领的马查奥罗莫人席卷该地，许多居民逃入戈贾姆。基督教的达莫特省仍留在埃塞俄比亚帝国境内，由戈贾姆的拉斯治理。

en:
The Danish kingdom, based on Jutland and Zealand, was unified under Gorm the Old and Harald Bluetooth, who Christianized the Danes around 960, as the Jelling stones proclaim. Cnut the Great briefly led a North Sea empire with England and Norway.

By 1337 the crown was at low ebb: under Christopher II the realm had been mortgaged to magnates and Scania sold to Sweden. Valdemar IV, elected in 1340, restored the crown, sold Estonia to the Teutonic Order in 1346 and seized Gotland in 1361; his wars ended in concessions to the Hanseatic League at Stralsund in 1370.

Valdemar's daughter Margaret I built the Kalmar Union of 1397, uniting Denmark, Norway and Sweden. The union endured until the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520 and Sweden's breakaway in 1523, and Denmark adopted the Lutheran Reformation in 1536. Wars with Sweden cost it Skåneland under the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658, and after Copenhagen's bombardment in 1807 the Treaty of Kiel detached Norway in 1814, though Iceland, Greenland and the Faroes remained.
zh:
丹麦王国以日德兰和西兰为根基，在老戈姆和蓝牙哈拉尔治下统一，约960年丹麦人皈依基督教，耶灵石仍记载此事。克努特大帝曾统领涵盖英格兰和挪威的北海帝国。

到1337年王权跌入谷底：克里斯托弗二世治下，国土被抵押给贵族，斯堪尼亚被卖给瑞典。1340年当选的瓦尔德马四世重振王权，1346年把爱沙尼亚卖给条顿骑士团，1361年夺取哥特兰，最终于1370年在施特拉尔松德向汉萨同盟让步。

瓦尔德马的女儿玛格丽特一世1397年缔造卡尔马联盟，使丹麦、挪威、瑞典共戴一君。联盟维系到1520年斯德哥尔摩惨案和1523年瑞典脱离；丹麦1536年接受路德宗改革。与瑞典的战争使它在1658年《罗斯基勒条约》中丧失斯堪尼亚诸地；1807年哥本哈根遭炮轰后，1814年《基尔条约》剥离挪威，只有冰岛、格陵兰和法罗群岛仍归丹麦。

en:
The Dauphiné of Viennois, ruled from Grenoble, grew from the County of Albon, whose lords united Alpine and Rhône valley fiefs after the Kingdom of Burgundy passed to the Holy Roman Empire in 1032. Count Guigues IV of Albon put a dolphin on his arms in the twelfth century and was nicknamed le Dauphin, the title his descendants adopted.

In 1337 the La Tour du Pin line held it under Humbert II, an imperial prince of Arles whose Alpine towns included Gap and Briançon. His only son died in childhood, and burdened with debt he sold the Dauphiné to the French crown on 16 July 1349, handing it to Prince Charles, future Charles V.

The treaty required the French heir apparent always to bear the title Dauphin, and granted the region autonomy and tax exemptions, mostly withdrawn in 1457. Valentinois and Vienne were added in 1404 and 1450; the Dauphiné remained a French province until the Revolution.
zh:
以格勒诺布尔为中心的维埃努瓦多菲内，前身是阿尔邦伯国；1032年勃艮第王国并入神圣罗马帝国后，阿尔蓬伯爵把阿尔卑斯山区与罗讷河谷的一批封邑联合起来。12世纪伯爵吉格四世在纹章上使用海豚图案，得到“多芬”绰号，后代沿用此头衔。

1337年在位的是拉图尔迪潘支系的安贝尔二世，他是阿尔勒治下的帝国诸侯，领有加普、布里扬松等山城。他独子幼年夭折，又债台高筑，1349年7月16日把多菲内卖给法兰西王室，交付给王子查理，即日后的查理五世。

条约规定法兰西王太子一律称多芬，并给予当地自治和免税特权，这些特权大部分在1457年被收回。瓦朗蒂努瓦和维埃纳于1404年、1450年先后并入，多菲内作为法兰西行省一直延续到法国大革命。

en:
Dawaro was a small Muslim principality on the eastern Ethiopian highland edge, east of Hadiya and north of Bale. Its Hanafi Muslim people grew cereals, reared horses and used iron pieces called hakuna as money. In the late 1320s its ruler Haydara joined Sabr ad-Din of Ifat's rebellion and put imperial envoys to death; Amda Seyon I retaliated, devastating Dawaro and reducing it to tributary vassalage, its position in 1337.

For two centuries it was a contested frontier: Emperor Zara Yaqob planted Christian garrisons and in 1445 defeated and killed Adal sultan Badlay at Gomit. The Adal imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi first targeted Dawaro, raiding it in 1526, crushing imperial forces at Shimbra Kure in 1529 and occupying it in 1531.

Emperor Gelawdewos reconquered it, and Portuguese briefly held it. But in the 1540s Oromo overran Dawaro and the principality disappeared.
zh:
达瓦罗是埃塞俄比亚高原东缘的小型穆斯林公国，位于哈迪亚以东、巴莱以北。居民是遵奉哈乃斐学派的穆斯林，种植谷物，饲养马匹，用叫“哈库纳”的铁条充当货币。14世纪20年代末，统治者海达拉加入伊法特的萨卜尔丁叛乱，处死皇帝的使节；阿姆达·塞约恩一世蹂躏全境作为报复，把达瓦罗降为纳贡附庸，即它1337年的地位。

此后两世纪这里成为拉锯边疆：扎拉·雅各布皇帝驻扎基督教守军，1445年在戈米特击败并击毙阿达尔苏丹巴德莱。阿达尔伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐首先进攻达瓦罗，1526年先行劫掠，1529年在辛布拉库雷击溃帝国军队，1531年占领该省。

格拉德沃斯皇帝收复该地，葡萄牙人曾短暂据守。但16世纪40年代奥罗莫人席卷达瓦罗，公国随之消失。

en:
The Kingdom of Dambadeniya was a Sinhalese realm that arose after Kalinga Magha shattered Polonnaruwa. Vijayabahu III made Dambadeniya his capital around 1220 and reunited the Sangha at a convention in 1226. His son Parakramabahu II, a poet whose Kausilumina became a Sinhala masterpiece, repelled the Malay chieftain Chandrabhanu.

Vijayabahu IV was crowned in 1270 and murdered by his minister Miththa; Bhuvanekabahu I moved the court to the rock fortress of Yapahuwa in 1273. In 1284 the Pandyas raided and carried off the Sacred Tooth Relic, recovered from India by Parakramabahu III in 1288.

From 1303 kings ruled from Kurunegala, where Parakramabahu IV translated the Jataka tales into Sinhala and reorganized the Tooth Relic rituals. In 1337 Vijayabahu V ruled, but the line was nearly spent: around 1341 the court moved to Gampola, and the Dambadeniya period ended in 1345.
zh:
檀婆提尼耶王国是卡林加·马加摧毁波隆纳鲁沃后兴起的僧伽罗政权。维贾雅巴胡三世约1220年定都檀婆提尼耶，1226年召集集会使四散的僧团重新统一。其子波罗迦罗摩巴忽二世是诗人，所作《考西卢米纳》为僧伽罗文学杰作，他还击退马来酋长昌德拉巴努的入侵。

维贾雅巴胡四世1270年即位，旋即被大臣米塔杀害；布伐奈迦巴忽一世1273年把宫廷迁到磐石要塞亚帕胡瓦。1284年潘地亚人来袭，掠走佛牙舍利，波罗迦罗摩巴忽三世1288年从印度将其迎回。

1303年起诸王以库鲁内格勒为都，波罗迦罗摩巴忽四世在此把《本生经》译为僧伽罗语，并重整佛牙仪轨。1337年维贾雅巴胡五世在位，但王统已近尾声：1341年前后宫廷再迁甘波勒，1345年檀婆提尼耶时代结束。

en:
The Dobe'a were the people of Doba in northeastern Ethiopia, between Enderta and Lake Ashenge, on the highland edge above the Afar lowlands. Pastoralists famous for large cattle, they lived partly by raiding under twenty-four leaders, twelve customarily at war while twelve kept the peace. Chief town Manadeley, on the trade route to Afar, grew into a great market for merchants from Cairo, Jeddah and India.

The Dobe'a enter written history through the campaigns of Emperor Ba'eda Maryam, who reigned from 1468 to 1478: after inconclusive expeditions his armies broke their resistance, many Dobe'a accepted Christianity; the emperor built a church of the Virgin Mary there, garrisoned it and ordered them to settle as cultivators.

In the 1520s Portuguese priest Francisco Álvares still found Manadeley a flourishing city, though drought and heavy gold dues under Emperor Lebna Dengel had begun impoverishing the region.
zh:
多贝亚人居住的多巴在埃塞俄比亚东北部，位于恩达尔塔与阿申盖湖之间、俯瞰阿法尔低地的高原边缘。他们是以高大牛群闻名的牧民，兼以劫掠为生，由二十四名首领治理，按惯例十二人负责征战、十二人维持和平。重镇马纳德利在通往阿法尔的商路上，发展成大集市，开罗、吉达和印度的商人都在此交易。

多贝亚人因1468至1478年在位的巴埃达·马里亚姆皇帝的征讨进入文字记载：连年远征无果后，皇帝军队击垮其抵抗，许多人皈依基督教，皇帝在当地修建圣母教堂、派驻军队，下令众人定居务农。

16世纪20年代葡萄牙神父弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯仍见马纳德利繁盛，只是旱灾和莱布纳·丹格尔皇帝所征沉重黄金贡赋，已开始使当地贫困。

en:
Decies was the anglicised name of the Déisi, a western County Waterford district and kingdom of the Déisi Muman, vassals of the Eóganachta kings of Cashel since the early Middle Ages. After the Anglo-Norman invasion Henry II granted it to Sir Roger le Puher in 1177, and his family, later called le Poer or Power, made Curraghmore their seat and became Decies's principal lords.

The territory preserved its ancient identity in the baronies of Decies-within-Drum and Decies-without-Drum. In the fifteenth century a younger son of the Earl of Desmond held Decies as an appanage, while the le Poer line continued at Curraghmore and was made Baron la Poer in 1535 and Viscount Decies and Earl of Tyrone in 1673.

The le Poers' male line died out in 1704. Their Curraghmore inheritance then passed on through marriage to the Beresford family.
zh:
迪希斯是迪希的英语化名称，在沃特福德郡西部；中世纪早期这里是迪希·蒙曼人的王国，臣属卡舍尔的埃奥赫塔诸王。盎格鲁—诺曼入侵后，亨利二世1177年把土地封给罗杰·勒普尔爵士，其家族（后称勒普尔或鲍尔）以卡拉莫尔为治所，成为迪希斯的主要领主。

鼓内迪希和鼓外迪希两个男爵区保留了古老的地域认同。15世纪德斯蒙德伯爵的幼子也曾以迪希斯为封地，勒普尔本支则继续盘踞卡拉莫尔，1535年受封拉普尔男爵，1673年进封迪希斯子爵和蒂龙伯爵。

1704年勒普尔家族男嗣断绝。其卡拉莫尔遗产随后经婚姻转入贝雷斯福德家族。

en:
Dongchuan occupies the Jinsha River valley of northeastern Yunnan, home to the Bipan tribe of the Wuman Yi under the Dali Kingdom. Under the Yuan and Ming, hereditary Yi Lu chiefs ruled as tusi; the Ming made it Dongchuan Prefecture in 1382 under Sichuan, not Yunnan. Copper hills at Tangdan made it among the southwest's richest mining lands.

In the Ming-Qing wars the Western army's general Ai Nengqi died of a poisoned-arrow wound in 1648; the chieftain Lu Changxian rose in 1665 against Qing replacement of native chiefs.

A 1699 Lu-clan succession feud gave the court its opening: appointed officials replaced the native prefect, the prefecture moved from Sichuan to Yunnan in 1726, and Huize County, added in 1727, became prefectural seat the next year. Qing Dongchuan copper fed the imperial mints while the native polity survived only in name.
zh:
东川地处云南东北部金沙江峡谷，大理国时期是乌蛮彝族閟畔部居地。元明时世袭彝族禄氏任土司，1382年明朝置东川府，划归四川而非云南。汤丹铜矿使其成为西南最富庶矿区之一。

明清之际，大西军将领艾能奇1648年中毒箭伤重而亡；1665年土司禄昌贤举兵反抗清朝改土归流。

1699年禄氏争继承权自相残杀，朝廷乘机派流官；1726年东川府由四川改隶云南，1727年置会泽县，次年成为府治。清代东川铜矿供应铸钱，土司政权名存实亡。

en: The Dai were Tai-speaking peoples of Yunnan, including the Tai Lü of Chiang Hung in Xishuangbanna. After the Mongol conquest of 1296, the rulers of Chiang Hung served as native governors under the Ming and Qing; Burma captured the kingdom in 1563.
zh: 傣是云南讲傣语的多个族群，包括西双版纳车里的傣泐。1296年蒙古征服后，车里统治者在明清两朝充任土司；1563年缅甸攻占了车里。

en: The Deccan is a plateau in southern India where the Persianate Bahmani Sultanate arose in 1347. Its territories later fragmented into five Deccan sultanates, several of which allied against Vijayanagara at Talikota in 1565.
zh: 德干是印度南部的高原，波斯文化影响下的巴赫曼尼苏丹国于1347年在这里兴起。其领土后来分裂为五个德干苏丹国，其中数国于1565年在塔利科塔结盟对抗毗奢耶那伽罗。

en: The Degar are diverse indigenous peoples of Vietnam's Central Highlands, including the Jarai, Rade and Bahnar. In the early fifteenth century, a highland ruler known as the Elephant King was a vassal of the Cham king Indravarman VI.
zh: 德加是越南西原多个原住民族群的统称，包括嘉莱人、埃地人和巴拿人。15世纪初，一位被称为象王的高地统治者是占婆国王因陀罗跋摩六世的附庸。

en:
The marcher lordship of Denbigh grew out of Perfeddwlad, the Welsh patrimony east of Snowdonia. Dafydd ap Gruffudd held it from 1277 and rebuilt stronghold Dinbych, but after his revolt Edward I's army took it in a 1282 siege. The king granted a new lordship to Henry de Lacy, Earl of Lincoln, who raised a castle and walled English borough under royal mason James of St George.

On Henry's 1311 death it passed to daughter Alice and her husband Thomas of Lancaster, and after Thomas's 1322 execution passed rapidly between Hugh Despenser, Roger Mortimer and William Montagu, the 1337 lord. Mortimers recovered it in 1355; Owain Glyndwr's rebels sacked the town in 1400, and in 1425 the lordship passed to Richard, Duke of York.

In the Wars of the Roses the town burned; in the English Civil War Denbigh fell to Parliament in 1646 and the castle was dismantled.
zh:
登比边区领的前身是佩费斯乌拉德，即斯诺登尼亚以东的威尔士世袭领地。1277年起达菲德·阿普·格鲁菲德领有此地，重修丁比赫要塞；他反叛后，爱德华一世的军队1282年围攻将其攻克。国王新设领地封给林肯伯爵亨利·德·莱西，由御用石匠圣乔治的詹姆斯主持，修建城堡和英格兰移民的有墙自治市镇。

1311年亨利去世后，登比传给女儿艾丽斯和她的丈夫兰开斯特的托马斯；1322年托马斯被处决后，领地在休·德斯潘塞、罗杰·莫蒂默和1337年领主威廉·蒙塔古之间迅速转手。莫蒂默家族1355年重新取得领地；1400年欧文·格兰道尔起义军洗劫市镇，1425年领地传给约克公爵理查。

玫瑰战争中市镇被焚，英国内战中登比1646年落入议会军之手，城堡随后拆毁。

en:
Diafunu is a historical Soninke region on the upper Kolinbiné river in the Sahel west of the Niger, a land its name calls the country of the people of Dia. Al-Bakri mentioned it as early as 1068, and between the 900s and 1100s it was a trade crossroads for salt, gold, horses and slaves, drawing merchants from Sijilmasa and Ghadames.
