In the 1100s clans fleeing Wagadu's decline settled here: the Dukure founded Tambacara and Gory after the old capital Sain Demba was destroyed, their elders ruling as tunka, or king. In the 1220s Yaqut al-Hamawi knew Zafunu's ruler as a powerful king honoured by the Almoravids of Marrakesh.

Diafunu had backed Soumaoro Kante and the Sosso against Sundiata Keita, so Mali's victory brought it under Mandinka rule, and in the 1300s it was a chief province of the Mali Empire. Later it was raided from the desert, fought Khasso, and from 1774 paid tribute to Kaarta, the Bambara kingdom.
zh:
贾富努是索宁克人的历史地区，位于尼日尔河以西萨赫勒的科兰比内河上游，地名意为迪亚人的土地。巴克里1068年已有记载；10至12世纪间，这里是盐、黄金、马匹和奴隶贸易的枢纽，吸引西吉勒马萨和古达米斯的商人。

12世纪，逃避瓦加杜衰乱的诸氏族迁居于此：旧都桑·登巴被毁后，杜库雷氏族建立坦巴卡拉和戈里两镇，长老以通卡（即国王）之号统治。13世纪20年代，雅库特·哈马维笔下的扎富努国王权势显赫，在马拉喀什受到穆拉比特人隆重接待。

贾富努曾支持苏毛罗·坎特的索索对抗松迪亚塔·凯塔，马里获胜后归入曼丁卡人治下，14世纪时是马里帝国的主要行省之一。此后它屡遭沙漠袭掠，与哈索交战，1774年起向班巴拉人的卡尔塔王国纳贡。

en:
Dagbon is the kingdom of the Dagomba people in northern Ghana, tracing its line to Naa Gbewaa. Gbewaa and his successors unified communities once ruled loosely by Tindaamba earth priests. His son Shitobu moved the dynasty south, and Shitobu's son Naa Nyagsi, reigning from 1416 to 1432, conquered the surrounding peoples, built the first capital at Yani Dabari near Tamale and installed his kin as chiefs while the surviving earth priests kept their ritual role.

Gonja attacks later drove the court east to Yendi, where Naa Zanjina defeated the invaders and became the first Muslim Yaa Naa, the Dagbon royal title.

Dyula and Hausa merchants made Yendi a flourishing market linked by caravan to Fezzan and the Bight of Benin. By 1788 it was said to exceed Kumasi and Salaga in size, though most Dagomba kept their old earth shrines beside the court's Islam.
zh:
达格邦是加纳北部达贡巴人的王国，世系追溯到纳阿·格贝瓦。格贝瓦和继承者统一了廷达阿姆巴土地祭司松散管辖的地方社群。他的儿子希托布将王廷南移；希托布之子纳阿·尼亚格西（1416—1432年在位）征服周边各族，在塔马利附近的亚尼·达巴里建立首个都城，分封亲族为酋长，幸存的土地祭司仍掌宗教职能。

后来贡贾人来攻，迫使王廷东迁延迪。纳阿·赞吉纳在当地击败入侵者，成为第一位穆斯林出身的亚阿·纳，即达格邦国王的称号。

迪尤拉和豪萨商人把延迪变成繁荣的市场，驼队商路远接费赞和贝宁湾。到1788年，据说其规模超过库马西和萨拉加，多数达贡巴人在宫廷伊斯兰教之外仍守古老的土地神龛。

en:
The Döger were one of the twenty-four tribes of the Oghuz Turks, and the eleventh-century scholar Mahmud al-Kashgari ranked them eighteenth among the Oghuz. They supplied warriors to the Seljuk armies that conquered Iran and Anatolia, and the Artuqid dynasty of the Jazira and northern Syria sprang from their stock.

In the fourteenth century the Döger pastured around Urfa as Mamluk vassals. They joined neither great Turkoman confederation, lending their swords to the Kara Koyunlu and Ak Koyunlu by turns, and by the early fifteenth century were among Mamluks' chief Turkoman allies on the northern frontier.

Their last independent feat of arms came in 1435, when Sultan Barsbay ordered them against the Ak Koyunlu near Amid, and their victory proved their final appearance as a power in the region. Under Ottoman rule their clans were settled around Urfa and Aleppo.
zh:
都客儿是乌古斯突厥二十四部之一，11世纪学者马哈茂德·喀什噶里将其列为乌古斯第十八部。他们为征服伊朗和安纳托利亚的塞尔柱军队提供兵源，统辖杰济拉和北叙利亚的阿尔图格王朝即出自该部。

14世纪，都客儿人作为马穆鲁克的附庸在乌尔法周边游牧。他们没有加入黑羊或白羊任何一个突厥蛮大联盟，却轮番为两者助战，到15世纪初已是马穆鲁克北部边境最重要的突厥蛮盟友之一。

他们最后一次独立用兵是在1435年，苏丹巴尔斯拜命他们进攻阿米德附近的白羊部，这场胜利成了他们作为地区强权的最后亮相。奥斯曼统治时期，其部众被安置在乌尔法和阿勒颇一带。

en:
The Dughlat were a Mongol, later Turco-Mongol, clan that served the Chagatai khans as hereditary lords of the western Tarim cities. When Chagatai power collapsed, the Dughlat amirs became kingmakers: in 1347 Amir Bulaji enthroned Tughlugh Timur over Moghulistan, whose conversion to Islam the clan followed while long keeping Genghis Khan's Yasa law.

Bulaji's brother Qamar ud-Din then murdered Khan Ilyas Khoja and proclaimed himself khan, the only Dughlat to take the title, and fought Timur until he vanished during Timur's invasion of 1390. Amir Khudaidad restored the Chagatayid Khizr Khoja and divided the Tarim cities among his kinsmen.

Mirza Aba Bakr built an independent kingdom with Yarkand as its capital, until Sultan Said Khan overthrew him in 1514, ending Dughlat rule there. The most famous Dughlat, Mirza Muhammad Haidar, fled to the Mughal emperor Humayun, conquered Kashmir in 1541 and wrote his Tarikh-i Rashidi there, until a Kashmiri revolt killed him in 1551.
zh:
朵豁剌惕（又译杜格拉特）是蒙古、后来突厥化的蒙古氏族，世代作为察合台汗的封臣，统治塔里木盆地西部诸城。察合台汗国衰乱后，朵豁剌惕异密成了拥立新汗的人：1347年，异密播鲁只把秃忽鲁·帖木儿扶上蒙兀儿斯坦汗位，全族随新汗改宗伊斯兰教，却长期沿用成吉思汗的《大札撒》。

播鲁只之弟哈马儿子随后杀害汗也里牙思火者，僭称汗号——他是唯一称汗的朵豁剌惕人，并与帖木儿连年交战，直到1390年帖木儿入侵时失踪。异密忽歹达拥立黑的儿火者复位，又把塔里木诸城分给亲族。

米尔咱·阿巴·伯克尔建立以叶尔羌为都的独立王国，1514年被赛德汗推翻，朵豁剌惕在塔里木的统治终结。族中最著名的米尔咱·马黑麻·海答儿逃奔莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍，1541年征服克什米尔，在那里写成《拉失德史》，1551年在克什米尔人的叛乱中被杀。

en:
The Maldives is a chain of twenty-six coral atolls southwest of India and Sri Lanka, whose rulers held court on Male, the King's Island. Settled by seafarers from the subcontinent over two and a half thousand years ago, the islands were a Buddhist kingdom for roughly fourteen centuries, when Dhivehi, scripts and institutions took shape.

In 1153 the last Buddhist king, Dhovemi, adopted Islam and reigned as Sultan Muhammad al-Adil, opening the line of six Muslim dynasties. Arab and Persian traders made the islands a cowrie-shell trade hub.

After the Portuguese killed Sultan Ali VI and occupied Male in 1558, Muhammad Thakurufaanu of Utheemu drove them out in 1573 and ruled as sultan, a victory kept as national day. Dutch hegemony from Ceylon followed; when the British seized Ceylon in 1796, the islands entered the British orbit but kept their sultans.
zh:
马尔代夫是印度和斯里兰卡西南方的26个珊瑚环礁，历代君主在有“国王之岛”之称的马累施治。2500多年前印度次大陆航海者来此定居；这里曾是佛教王国约1400年，迪维希语、文字和制度都在此时成形。

1153年末代佛教国王多维米改宗伊斯兰教，称苏丹穆罕默德·阿迪勒，开启六个穆斯林王朝世系；阿拉伯和波斯商人使群岛成为贝币贸易枢纽。

1558年葡萄牙人杀害苏丹阿里六世、占领马累，乌蒂姆的穆罕默德·塔库鲁法努1573年将其逐出并即位苏丹，这一胜利被定为国庆日。此后苏丹国受制于锡兰的荷兰势力；1796年英国夺取锡兰，群岛转入英国势力范围，仍保留自己的苏丹。

en:
Bagar is the game's name for Vagad, the forested southernmost tract of Rajputana, historically the Dungarpur state. In the twelfth century the land was held by Bhil chiefs until Mahup, disinherited eldest son of Karan Singh of Mewar, took refuge with his mother's Chauhan kin and seized Vagad from them; his Guhila line became the elder Sisodia branch, while Mewar passed to his younger brother's line.

The early raws ruled from Baroda. Virasimhadeva appears in Sanskrit inscriptions of 1287 and 1302, and his grandson Dungarasimha founded and named Dungarpur, tradition says after the Bhil chieftain Dungaria.

In 1527 Rawal Udai Singh of Vagad fell at Khanwa beside Rana Sanga, fighting Babur, and his sons split his lands into Dungarpur and Banswara. Dungarpur accepted Mughal suzerainty under Askaran, faced Maratha pressure from 1736, and came under British treaty protection in 1818.
zh:
婆迦尔是游戏对瓦加德的称呼，即拉杰普塔纳最南端林地，历史上为栋格尔布尔土邦。12世纪这里由比尔首领占据；梅瓦尔王卡兰·辛格被废继承权的长子马胡普投奔母族乔汉人，夺取瓦加德，其古希拉支系成为西索迪亚长支，梅瓦尔传给其弟一系。

早期罗瓦尔都于巴罗达。维拉辛哈提婆见于1287年和1302年梵文铭文，其孙栋加拉辛哈建栋格尔布尔并以己名命名，相传城名得自比尔首领栋加里亚。

1527年，罗瓦尔乌代·辛格在坎瓦随拉那·桑伽抗击巴布尔战死，儿子们分领地为栋格尔布尔和班斯瓦拉。阿斯卡兰时栋格尔布尔接受莫卧儿宗主权，1736年起遭马拉塔人施压，1818年订约受英国保护。

en:
Deheubarth was a group of south Welsh realms united around 920 by Hywel Dda, whose dynasty made its base at Dinefwr. Norman lords seized much of the territory after Rhys ap Tewdwr was killed resisting them in 1093.

His grandson Rhys ap Gruffudd recovered much of Deheubarth and made peace with Henry II in 1171. After his death in 1197 his sons divided the realm; its remaining lords lost control after joining the failed Welsh rebellion of 1282.
zh:
德赫巴思是南威尔士的一组领地，约于920年由海威尔·达统一，其家族以迪内弗尔为根据地。1093年里斯·阿普·特乌德尔抵抗诺曼领主时阵亡，此后他们夺取了大部分领土。

他的孙子里斯·阿普·格鲁菲兹收复了德赫巴思的大部分地区，并于1171年与亨利二世议和。1197年他去世后，诸子瓜分领地；余下的领主参加1282年失败的威尔士起义后失去了统治权。

en:
Dhofar was the frankincense coast of southern Arabia, whose harbor city of Zafar, medieval al-Baleed near modern Salalah, had exported incense to India and China since antiquity.

Around 1300 the Venetian traveler Marco Polo found it a Muslim city whose local lord acknowledged the sultan of Aden, and in the fourteenth century a side-branch of the Yemeni Rasulid dynasty governed this distant province from Zafar, holding the neighboring Mahra coast and the island of Socotra on a loose rein.

The incense trade sustained the city's Manjawi civilization until the Kathiri sultanate of Hadhramaut, founded in 1395, seized Dhofar in 1414. Mahri tribesmen then made Socotra their own base around 1480, and a Portuguese fleet stormed the island in 1507 before abandoning it in 1511. Dhofar stayed under Kathiri rule until Omani power rose in later centuries.
zh:
佐法尔是阿拉伯半岛南部的乳香海岸，港口佐法尔城即今塞拉莱附近的巴利德遗址，自古向印度和中国输出乳香。

约1300年威尼斯旅行家马可·波罗见到这里已是穆斯林城市，地方首领臣服于亚丁苏丹；14世纪也门拉苏尔王朝的一支旁系以佐法尔城统治这个偏远行省，对邻近的迈赫拉海岸和索科特拉岛只维持松散控制。

乳香贸易支撑着当地的曼贾维文明，直到1395年建立的哈德拉毛卡西尔苏丹国于1414年夺取佐法尔。此后迈赫拉部落约在1480年把索科特拉岛变成据点，葡萄牙舰队1507年攻占该岛，1511年弃守。佐法尔本地长期归卡西尔人统治，直到几世纪后阿曼势力兴起。

en:
The Daihōji were a warrior family descended from the Mutō, who entered the Shōnai region of Dewa Province as estate stewards. They took their name from Daihōji Castle and later ruled as local deputies; in 1463 Daihōji Atsuuji visited Kyoto and paid homage to Shogun Ashikaga Yoshimasa.

Daihōji Yoshiuji restored the family's power in Shōnai, but in 1583 a retainer rebelled and surrounded his castle, leading to his death. His successor Yoshikatsu recovered Shōnai with his father Honjō Shigenaga in 1588, but lost his domain in 1591 and entered Uesugi service.
zh:
大宝寺氏是武藤氏的后裔，作为庄园地头进入出羽国庄内地区。他们以大宝寺城为氏，后来作为当地代官统治；1463年大宝寺淳氏赴京都拜见将军足利义政。

大宝寺义氏重振了家族在庄内的势力，但1583年家臣叛变、包围居城，义氏身亡。继任的义胜于1588年与其生父本庄繁长夺回庄内，却在1591年失去领地，转而侍奉上杉氏。

en:
Dahlak was a Muslim sultanate of the Dahlak Archipelago off the Eritrean Red Sea coast, at its height ruling Massawa through a deputy titled the nai'b. The islands had served the Umayyads and Abbasids as a place of exile before passing under the Abyssinian king in the ninth century. The first sultan known by name is Mubarak, whose stele records his death in 1093.

Dahlak grew rich on the monopoly of Ethiopia's foreign trade, and minted coins. When the Zagwe opened a southern route to Zeila in the mid-thirteenth century, Dahlak lost its monopoly and fell under Yemen's Rasulid dynasty.

Emperor Zara Yaqob sacked Massawa and the islands in 1464 and 1465. The sultanate became a Tahirid vassal before the Portuguese destroyed it again in 1541. In 1557 the Ottomans annexed the islands, and the state disappeared.
zh:
达赫拉克是厄立特里亚红海沿岸达赫拉克群岛的穆斯林苏丹国，鼎盛时以奈布副手统治马萨瓦。群岛曾为倭马亚和阿拔斯王朝流放地，9世纪转归阿比西尼亚。最早有名可考的苏丹穆巴拉克，墓碑载其1093年卒。

达赫拉克靠垄断埃塞俄比亚外贸致富，自铸钱币。13世纪中期扎格维开通泽拉南方商路，达赫拉克丧失垄断，沦为也门拉苏里王朝附庸。

1464—1465年扎拉·雅各布皇帝洗劫马萨瓦和群岛。后为塔希尔王朝属国，1541年葡萄牙人再度洗劫达赫拉克。1557年奥斯曼人吞并群岛，古国遂亡。

en:
Durham was England's greatest ecclesiastical palatinate, whose bishop held powers normally reserved to the Crown. It grew from the Patrimony of St Cuthbert, lands between the Tyne and Tees held by the community that carried the saint's relics away from Viking raids; the region was so autonomous it was omitted from the Domesday Book.

Bishop Walcher added the earldom of Northumbria in 1075, and by the late thirteenth century the bishop could raise armies and mint coinage, guarding the Scottish frontier from the fortified Wear city. In 1337 Richard de Bury held the see, Edward III's former tutor and the most celebrated book collector of his age, who wrote the Philobiblon.

The palatinate's border role was proved in 1346, when David II's invasion was shattered at Neville's Cross outside Durham and he was captured. After the 1536 Act of Resumption the Crown removed the bishop's rights; the last palatine powers passed to it in 1836.
zh:
达勒姆是英格兰最大的教会巴拉丁领地，主教手握通常属国王的权力。它源出“圣卡斯伯特遗产”，即携圣徒遗骨躲避维京人劫掠的教团在泰恩河与蒂斯河之间拥有的土地；该地区自治程度极高，未载入《末日审判书》。

1075年瓦尔赫主教为教区取得诺森伯兰伯爵位；13世纪末主教已能征召军队、铸造货币，据威尔河畔设防城镇守苏格兰边境。1337年在任的理查德·德·伯里曾任爱德华三世之师，为当时最负盛名的藏书家，著《爱书论》。

1346年戴维二世的入侵军在达勒姆城外内维尔十字被击溃，国王被俘，印证达勒姆领地的边防价值。1536年《权力收回法令》后王室削夺主教特权，残余巴拉丁权力1836年移交王室。

en:
Amber was the Kachhwaha Rajput state of Dhundhar in Rajputana, later Jaipur. Founder Rao Dulha Rai, perhaps of Gwalior's Kachchhapaghata dynasty, migrated in the eleventh century and, with Chauhan help, took Dhundhar from Meena and Bargujar chiefs; his successor Kakil seized Amber fort as capital.

Overshadowed by Mewar, it paid Rana Kumbha tribute in the fifteenth century. Bharmal changed its fortunes, marrying a daughter to Akbar in 1562 and becoming the first Rajput raja in Mughal service; his son Bhagwant Das and grandson Man Singh I commanded Mughal armies.

Jai Singh I, a general of Shah Jahan, lost Aurangzeb's favour after Shivaji's 1666 escape from his custody. Jai Singh II won effective independence in 1708 and founded Jaipur as capital in 1727, building the Jantar Mantar observatories. Succession wars and Maratha tributes drained it until an 1818 subsidiary alliance with the East India Company.
zh:
安泊尔是拉杰普塔纳东北敦达尔的卡奇瓦哈政权，即后来斋浦尔。开创者拉奥·杜尔哈·拉伊或出瓜廖尔卡奇帕加塔王朝，11世纪迁来，借乔汉支持从迷那和巴尔古贾尔首领手中取敦达尔；卡基尔继任后取安泊尔堡为都。

小邦久处梅瓦尔阴影，15世纪向拉纳·昆巴纳贡。巴尔马尔1562年嫁女阿克巴，成最早效力莫卧儿的拉杰普特罗阇，扭转国运；子巴格万特·达斯与孙曼·辛格一世皆统莫卧儿军。

杰伊·辛格一世为沙贾汗名将，因1666年西瓦吉脱其看管而失宠奥朗则布。杰伊·辛格二世1708年实际自立，1727年建斋浦尔为新都，并建詹塔尔·曼塔尔天文台。继承内战与马拉塔贡赋疲敝邦国，1818年君主接受东印度公司的附属同盟。

en:
The County of Diez was a Holy Roman Empire lordship on the river Lahn, first recorded in 1073 and probably built from the former lands of the Conradines in the Niederlahngau. From their castle at Diez the counts held territory stretching up the Lahn to Weilburg and into the Westerwald. They rose as loyal servants of the Hohenstaufen: Henry II of Diez accompanied Frederick Barbarossa on his Italian campaigns and inherited estates in the Wetterau, and the county was known in its heyday as the Golden County. In 1207 the lords exchanged the bailiwick of Mainz-Kastel for imperial immediacy, and in 1289 Count Gerhard VII merged the family's collegiate foundation at Salz into the collegiate church of Diez.

The fall of the Hohenstaufen in 1254 began a long decline, and a collateral Weilnau line split off in 1302. With Count Gottfried judged unfit to rule, Nassau-Hadamar held the guardianship until 1332, when Gottfried's son Gerhard VI, the count ruling in 1337, took over; he died fighting Limburg in 1343. The last count, Gerhard VII, died in 1388, and Diez passed through his daughter Jutta to Adolf I of Nassau-Siegen. The county was then repeatedly partitioned among Nassau, Eppstein, Katzenelnbogen, Hesse and Trier, until the Diez Treaty of 1564 divided it between Nassau-Dillenburg and the Electorate of Trier. From 1606 the Nassau line took the name Nassau-Dietz, ancestor of the House of Orange-Nassau; the lands went to France in 1795 and to the Duchy of Nassau in 1815.
zh:
迪茨伯国是神圣罗马帝国在兰河畔的领地，最早见于1073年的记载，很可能由康拉丁家族在下兰高的旧地发展而来。伯爵们以迪茨城堡为治所，领土沿兰河上溯至威尔堡，并伸入韦斯特林山。他们作为霍亨斯陶芬家族的忠仆而崛起：迪茨的亨利二世随腓特烈·巴巴罗萨出征意大利，又继承了韦特劳的地产，鼎盛时期的伯国被称为“黄金伯国”。1207年，领主们以美因茨-卡斯特尔的管辖权换取帝国直辖地位；1289年，格哈德七世伯爵把家族在萨尔的修道基金会并入迪茨的修道院教堂。

1254年霍亨斯陶芬家族倒台后，伯国长期衰落，1302年旁支韦尔瑙一脉分出。戈特弗里德伯爵被判定无力执政，拿骚-哈达马尔家族监护领地至1332年，其后戈特弗里德之子、1337年在位的格哈德六世亲政，他于1343年与林堡作战时身亡。末代伯爵格哈德七世于1388年去世，迪茨经其女尤塔传给拿骚-锡根的阿道夫一世。此后伯国在拿骚、埃普施泰因、卡岑埃尔恩博根、黑森和特里尔之间一再分割，直到1564年的《迪茨条约》将它分给拿骚-迪伦堡和特里尔选侯国。1606年起，拿骚一支以拿骚-迪茨为号，是奥兰治-拿骚家族的祖先；这片土地1795年落入法国之手，1815年并入拿骚公国。

en:
The Dilmaçid beylik was a Turkoman principality born of the Seljuk victory at Manzikert in 1071. Its founder Mehmed Bey, an Alp Arslan commander, received Bitlis as an iqta in 1085, and under his son Togan Arslan it shook off Seljuk overlordship and fought Crusaders with the Artukids, notably at Ager Sanguinis in 1119.

In 1192 the Ahlatshahs seized Bitlis, after which the Dilmaçids held only Erzen and its countryside around Kozluk and Hazo north of Siirt, where the rump state survived through the fourteenth century under greater overlords. It vanished around the 1410s, absorbed by the Aq Qoyunlu.
zh:
迪尔马奇贝伊国是1071年塞尔柱人在曼齐刻特获胜后兴起的突厥蛮小邦。开国者穆罕默德贝伊为阿尔普·阿尔斯兰将领，1085年受封比特利斯为伊克塔；子托甘·阿尔斯兰时摆脱大塞尔柱宗主权，随阿尔图格王朝与十字军作战，1119年血地之战尤为著名。

1192年阿赫拉特沙王朝攻占比特利斯，迪尔马奇人只保有埃尔曾及周边，即锡尔特以北科兹卢克和哈佐一带；小邦在更强宗主名义下延续整个14世纪，约1410年代为白羊王朝吞并。

en:
The Dimasa (Kachari) kingdom was a state of the Dimasa people in medieval Assam. By the late thirteenth century it ruled from Dimapur. In 1490 the Dimasa destroyed an Ahom Dikhau outpost and forced King Suhenphaa to buy peace with a princess, and King Khorapha struck the Brahmaputra valley's first Hindu-style coin at Dimapur in 1520.

Long Ahom wars followed: Suhungmung's forces killed Khorapha and took Dimapur in 1536, and the rulers abandoned it. After a twenty-two-year interregnum, Nirbhaya Narayana founded Maibang as the new capital in 1558. The Koch general Chilarai made it a feudatory in 1564.

When Tamradhwaj claimed independence, Ahom king Rudra Singha stormed Maibang in 1706 and made the kingdom a vassal. In 1745 it absorbed Koch Khaspur and moved its court there; Burmese rule followed, and after the Treaty of Yandabo the British took its plains in 1832 and hills in 1834, ending the kingdom.
zh:
底马撒又称卡恰尔王国，是中世纪阿萨姆的底马撒人国家。13世纪末它以迪马布尔为都。1490年底马撒人摧毁阿洪姆人迪考河据点，迫国王苏亨法以公主和亲；1520年国王科拉法在迪马布尔铸出布拉马普特拉河谷首枚印度教样式钱币。

后与阿洪姆长期交战：苏洪蒙军队杀科拉法，1536年克迪马布尔，君主弃城。经二十二年空位期，尼尔巴亚·纳拉扬1558年建迈邦为新都。1564年科赫将领奇拉赖收其为属国。

塔姆拉德瓦杰宣称独立后，阿洪姆王鲁陀罗·辛格1706年攻陷迈邦，将底马撒降为附庸。1745年底马撒吞并科赫人的卡斯布尔并迁都；后遭缅甸占领，《杨达坡条约》后英国1832年取平原、1834年取山区，底马撒王国灭亡。

en:
Disentis was a Benedictine imperial abbey in the Surselva valley of Graubünden, dedicated to Saint Martin of Tours, around whose walls the town grew. Founded in the early eighth century by the Frankish monk Sigisbert and local landowner Placidus, it held great estates at Bishop Tello of Chur's testament in 765; Charlemagne visited it on his return from Rome in 800.

As a Reichskloster it answered directly to the emperor, and its Lukmanier Pass, crossed by Otto I and Barbarossa on journeys to Italy, brought lands in Lombardy. Abbot Udalric I, who ruled from 1031 to 1055, was the first abbot made a prince of the empire.

Its Cadi territory, the House of God, gained a seal in 1285, a Landammann in 1371 and entered the Grey League in 1401. The abbey joined the Swiss Benedictine Congregation in 1617 and was burned by French troops in 1799.
zh:
迪森蒂斯是格劳宾登苏尔塞尔瓦河谷的本笃派帝国修道院，奉图尔的圣马丁为主保，镇子绕修道院围墙而起。8世纪初法兰克修士西吉斯贝特与当地地主普拉西杜斯创建该院；765年库尔主教特洛立遗嘱时它已领有大片地产，查理曼800年自罗马返程造访。

作为直属皇帝的帝国修道院，它扼守卢克马尼尔山口，奥托一世与巴巴罗萨南下意大利均经此，领地扩展至伦巴第。1031—1055年在任的乌达尔里克一世，是首位帝国诸侯院长。

领地称“卡迪”，意为“上帝之屋”，1285年启用印章，1371年设长官，1401年加入灰盟。1617年入瑞士本笃会联会，1799年遭法军焚毁。

en:
Dithmarschen was North Sea marsh between the Eider and Elbe, whose free peasants acknowledged only Bremen's Prince-Archbishopric as remote overlord. From the thirteenth century elected elders governed at Heide, making it a rare imperial peasant republic allied with Hanseatic towns.

Its flooded fields and ditches were its best defense: in 1319 peasants destroyed Count Gerhard III's Holstein army at Wöhrden, and Count Gerhard VI fell campaigning against them in 1404. In 1447 they fixed a government of forty-eight regents, and from 1474 to 1481 defeated Holstein's claims in imperial courts and won recognition as a direct imperial fief.

Their most famous victory came at Hemmingstedt in 1500, where the militia shattered King John of Denmark's army. The republic adopted the Reformation in 1533, but independence ended in the Last Feud of 1559, when Frederick II's general Johan Rantzau took Heide and Meldorf; peasants kept wide self-rule under Denmark and the Holstein dukes.
zh:
迪特马尔申是北海艾德河与易北河间沼泽低地，自由农民不认领主，只名义尊奉不来梅大主教区宗主权。13世纪起推选的长老在海德集会理政，为帝国少有的农民共和国，与汉萨城市结盟。

水网即最好防线：1319年农民在沃尔登歼格哈德三世的荷尔斯泰因军，1404年格哈德六世征讨丧命。1447年立四十八摄政政府；1474—1481年在帝国法庭驳回荷尔斯泰因主权要求，获认帝国直属封地。

1500年黑明施泰特之战为其最辉煌胜利，民兵击溃丹麦王约翰大军。共和国1533年接受宗教改革，独立却于1559年“最后之争”终结，弗雷德里克二世将领兰曹攻占海德和梅尔多夫；农民在丹麦王室和荷尔斯泰因公爵治下仍保大量自治。

en:
Djerid, palm oases on the Saharan border, has its seat at Ghadames, one of the desert's oldest towns, where modern Libya, Tunisia and Algeria meet. The Romans knew it as Cydamus and garrisoned it, and under the Byzantines it was a Christian bishopric before Uqba ibn Nafi brought Islam in the 660s.

In the Islamic Middle Ages its Berber townspeople lived by the caravan trade: Ghadames joined the Tripoli road through the Jabal Nafusa to routes south to Ghat, the Fezzan and Timbuktu, handling gold, slaves and dates. It belonged to an Ibadi oasis network from the Tunisian Jerid to the M'zab, a region often ruled by local imams and elders while paying nominal tribute to Tunis's Hafsids.

Its greatest prosperity came in the eighteenth century, when Ottoman Tripoli made it the leading caravan mart of the western Sahara.
zh:
杰里德是撒哈拉边境的棕榈绿洲之地，首邑盖达米斯是沙漠最古老的城镇之一，地处今利比亚、突尼斯和阿尔及利亚交界。罗马人称其为西达穆斯并在此驻军，拜占庭时它是基督教主教区，7世纪60年代乌格巴·伊本·纳菲将伊斯兰教带到这里。

中世纪伊斯兰时代，柏柏尔居民以商队贸易为生：的黎波里经奈富塞山的道路在盖达米斯与南往加特、费赞和廷巴克图的商路交汇，经手黄金、奴隶和椰枣。它属于从突尼斯杰里德延伸到姆扎卜的伊巴德派绿洲网络，这一带往往由本地伊玛目和长老治理，只向突尼斯哈夫斯王朝缴纳名义贡赋。

18世纪，的黎波里奥斯曼政权将盖达米斯建成西撒哈拉首要商队贸易城，城镇达到鼎盛。

en:
Dala had its seat at Odoli on the Mudan river, one of the Jurchen myriarchies of the late-Yuan lower Songhua, where of five commands only three, Odoli, Huligai and Taowen, survived into the fourteenth century. The Odoli clans counted themselves descendants of the Jin Jurchens, later revered as the ancestral line of the Aisin Gioro, the Qing imperial house.

Hard pressed by Wild Jurchen raiders, Odoli and Huligai migrated south around the turn of the fifteenth century to the Tumen river and Korean borderlands. In 1406 the Ming recognised Odoli chief Mengge Temur as a Jianzhou Guard commander, and in 1416 his following was split off as the Jianzhou Left Guard.

After Mengge Temur was killed in 1433, the remnant moved west in 1440 to the Suzi river in Liaodong and merged with the Huligai as Jianzhou Jurchens, from whom Nurhaci built the Later Jin.
zh:
达拉以牡丹江边的鄂多理为中心，是元末松花江下游女真五万户府之一；五万户到14世纪只剩斡朵里、胡里改、桃温三个。斡朵里人自称金朝女真后裔，后被尊为清朝皇室爱新觉罗氏的先祖之部。

受野人女真袭扰，斡朵里与胡里改在14、15世纪之交南迁图们江及朝鲜边境一带。1406年明朝封斡朵里酋长猛哥帖木儿为建州卫都指挥使，1416年又析出其部为建州左卫。

1433年猛哥帖木儿被杀，余部1440年西迁辽东苏子河，与胡里改部汇合为建州女真，努尔哈赤即由此建立后金。

en:
The Delhi Sultanate was founded in 1206, when after Muhammad of Ghor's victories over the Rajputs his Turkic generals divided the conquests and Qutb ud-Din Aibak established the Mamluk dynasty. The Khaljis seized power in 1290, and under Alauddin Khalji Muslim arms reached deep into the Deccan while Mongol invasions were repelled.

In 1320 the throne passed to the Tughlaq dynasty, and under Muhammad bin Tughluq from 1325 the sultanate reached its greatest extent, from the Indus to the Tamil country. His forced transfer of the court to Daulatabad and ruinous taxation provoked revolts: in 1335 Ma'bar broke away, Bengal and the new Bahmani sultanate of 1347 soon followed, and Vijayanagara rose in the south.

The later Tughlaqs never recovered the lost provinces; after Timur sacked Delhi in 1398, power passed to the Sayyid dynasty in 1414 and then the Afghan Lodis. In 1526 Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat and replaced the sultanate with the Mughal Empire.
zh:
德里苏丹国建立于1206年：古尔的穆罕默德击败拉杰普特人后，突厥将领们瓜分了战果，库特布丁·艾伊拜克建立马穆鲁克王朝。1290年卡尔吉王朝夺权，在阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉治下把穆斯林的兵锋深入德干，又击退了蒙古入侵。

1320年王位转入图格鲁克王朝；穆罕默德·图格鲁克1325年起在位，苏丹国版图达到极盛，从印度河延伸到泰米尔地区。他强迁朝廷到道拉塔巴德，又以苛重的赋税激起反叛：1335年马巴尔独立，孟加拉和1347年新建的巴赫马尼苏丹国相继脱离，南方又兴起毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。

后期的图格鲁克君主再未能收复失地；1398年帖木儿洗劫德里后，1414年政权落入萨义德王朝，随后是阿富汗人的洛迪王朝。1526年，巴布尔在帕尼帕特击败易卜拉欣·洛迪，以莫卧儿帝国取代了德里苏丹国。

en:
Donglan was a Zhuang native prefecture on the Hongshui River in northern Guangxi, roughly present-day Donglan County, ruled by the hereditary Wei clan. The Song created it as Lan Prefecture in 1106 under local chief Wei Aannao, and under the Yuan it was renamed Donglan and placed under the Qingyuan-Nandan commission; it submitted to the Ming in 1379.

A disputed succession followed when household agent Wei Qianbao stole the tribute mission and seized the prefect's seal. His exactions drove the legitimate chief Wei Funao into revolt, suppressed in 1385, though the Wei kept office with a Chinese assistant.

Its chiefs later joined the Sicheng attack on Tianzhou and the 1526 campaign against Cen Meng. The Wei submitted to the Qing in 1652, and in 1729 the gaitu guiliu reform split the prefecture, leaving the Wei as junior native officers at Fengshan while regular officials took the main seat.
zh:
东兰是广西北部红水河畔的壮族土州，辖境大致当今东兰县，由韦氏土司世袭知州。1106年北宋纳土置兰州，授当地首领韦宴闹知州事并准世袭；元代改名东兰州，隶属庆远南丹安抚司。1379年东兰归附明朝。

其后家人韦钱保隐匿贡物、冒名夺得知州之职，横征暴敛，逼土官韦富挠1385年起兵，变乱随即被明军讨平；事后朝廷仍准韦氏袭职，另派流官吏目辅佐。

东兰土官后来随泗城岑氏攻入田州，又奉调参与1526年平定岑猛之乱。1652年韦氏归附清朝；1729年改土归流，东兰设流官知州，韦氏降为驻凤山的土州同。

en:
Domboli-Bokht represents the Bokht branch of the Donboli, a Yazidi Kurdish tribe whose name points to its origin in the Bohtan country between Siirt and Cizre. In the fourteenth century its clans held hill fortresses around Akre and Hakkari, on the Jazira-Armenian frontier, its first attested leader, Isa Beg, ruling Sokmanabad.

The Donboli long kept to the Yazidi faith before parts of the tribe later converted to Islam. Sharafkhan Bidlisi records that under the Ilkhans emir Ibrahim stood high with Ghazan Khan, his successors dying in the Mongol wars of the 1340s and 1350s.

Under the Aq Qoyunlu, Shaikh Ahmad Beg conquered the Hakkari territory southeast of Lake Van and held the castle of Bay. A century later most of the tribe moved north-west to Khoy and Salmas and built the Khoy Khanate, some clans staying in the Diyarbakr highlands.
zh:
东博利‑博赫特对应敦布利部落的博赫特分支。敦布利是信雅兹迪派的库尔德部落，其名表明源起锡尔特与吉兹雷之间的博赫坦。14世纪其部族据守阿克拉与哈卡里周围的山间要塞，地处杰济拉与亚美尼亚高地之间；最早见载的首领伊萨贝伊统治索克马纳巴德。

敦布利人长期保持雅兹迪信仰，后来部分部族改宗伊斯兰教。沙拉夫汗·比特利西载，伊尔汗国时埃米尔易卜拉欣深受合赞汗信任，继任者在14世纪40至50年代蒙古战事中阵亡。

白羊王朝时期，谢赫·艾哈迈德贝伊征服凡湖东南的哈卡里地区，占据巴伊城堡。下一世纪部落主体西北迁至霍伊和萨尔马斯，建立强盛的霍伊汗国，部分氏族留在迪亚巴克尔山区。

en:
The Principality of Dmitrov was a small Rus' principality centered on Dmitrov, founded by Yuri Dolgorukiy in 1154 on the Yakhroma north of Moscow. It emerged from the breakup of Galich-Dmitrov, held since the 1240s by descendants of Yaroslav II of Vladimir; after Prince David died around 1280 his lands split, and by the 1330s Boris ruled Dmitrov while kinsman Fyodor held Galich.

Boris's son Dmitry Borisovich, prince in 1337, took the Galich table with Golden Horde backing in 1360, and Dmitrov itself was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Moscow by 1364.

It became a Muscovite appanage for younger sons: Vladimir the Bold held it from 1372, the town gained rights in 1374 and Tokhtamysh burned it in 1382. The appanage lasted until 1569, when Ivan the Terrible abolished it among the last in Rus'.
zh:
德米特罗夫公国是以德米特罗夫为中心的罗斯小公国，城在莫斯科北亚赫罗马河畔，1154年尤里·多尔戈鲁基所建。出自加利奇-德米特罗夫的分裂：13世纪40年代起雅罗斯拉夫二世后裔领有该地，达维德约1280年死后领地分裂，14世纪30年代鲍里斯治德米特罗夫，同族费奥多尔领加利奇。

鲍里斯之子德米特里·鲍里索维奇1337年在位，1360年靠金帐汗国支持入加利奇，德米特罗夫1364年前并入莫斯科大公国。

此后成为莫斯科封给幼支的封邑：勇者弗拉基米尔1372年受封，城镇1374年获城市权，1382年脱脱迷失焚城；封邑延续至1569年，伊凡雷帝撤之，属罗斯最后一批封邑。

en:
The Domboli, or Donboli, were a Kurdish tribal dynasty, originally Yazidi, holding the highland country around Khoy and Salmas from their rise under Ayyubid overlordship in 1210. Their emir Ibrahim Donboli, who died in 1320, stood well with Ilkhan Ghazan and was said to have saved the Ilkhanate; in 1337 the tribe held Khoy under its own chief as a vassal of the Jalayirids.

Successors Jamshid and Behlul fought and made peace with the Mongols before the line passed under Aq Qoyunlu and Safavid suzerainty. After a Safavid massacre in 1548 the Donboli fled to Ottoman territory, but recovered Khoy by the 1620s and ruled as hereditary khans.

They served Nader Shah on his Indian and Caucasian campaigns, dominated Azerbaijan in the later eighteenth century under Jafar Qoli Khan, and were broken by Qajar prince Abbas Mirza in 1799.
zh:
东博利又译敦布利，为库尔德部落王朝，初信雅兹迪派，1210年在阿尤布宗主权下兴起，领霍伊与萨尔马斯一带山地。埃米尔易卜拉欣·东博利1320年卒，生前与伊儿汗合赞交好，据说曾挽救伊儿汗国；1337年该部由本族首领据有霍伊，为札剌亦儿王朝附庸。

继任者贾姆希德和贝赫卢勒先与蒙古人交战、后又言和，家族相继臣属白羊、萨法维两王朝。1548年萨法维屠其部众，部落逃入奥斯曼，17世纪20年代收复霍伊，以世袭汗号统治。

他们曾随纳迪尔沙远征印度和高加索，18世纪后期在贾法尔·戈利汗治下称雄阿塞拜疆，1799年为卡扎尔王子阿巴斯·米尔扎攻灭。

en:
Desmond, from the Irish Deasmhumhain, or South Munster, was a Gaelic kingdom founded in 1118 across County Cork and most of Kerry. Its east fell to the Anglo-Normans as the Earldom of Desmond, the west surviving as a semi-independent Gaelic kingdom until 1596.

The earls belonged to the Munster branch of the FitzGeralds, the Geraldines, who crossed from Wales in the Norman invasion of the twelfth century. John FitzThomas received Desmond from Prince Edward in 1259 as first Baron Desmond; his grandson Maurice FitzGerald became Earl of Desmond in 1329. The earldom later covered County Limerick and parts of Cork, Kerry and Waterford.

The Geraldines grew Gaelic, and later in the sixteenth century led the Desmond Rebellions against the English crown. The last earl was killed in 1583, his estates confiscated and title suppressed; recreations after 1600 carried no Geraldine lands.
zh:
德斯蒙德得名于爱尔兰语德斯蒙温，意为南芒斯特，本为1118年所建盖尔王国，辖科克郡和凯里郡大部。东半部沦于盎格鲁—诺曼人为德斯蒙德伯爵领，西部作为半独立盖尔王国存至1596年。

伯爵为菲茨杰拉德家族芒斯特支系杰拉尔丁人，12世纪诺曼入侵时自威尔士渡海。1259年约翰·菲茨托马斯受封德斯蒙德，为初代德斯蒙德男爵；其孙莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德1329年晋封伯爵。伯爵领后辖利默里克及科克、凯里、沃特福德诸郡土地。

杰拉尔丁人日渐盖尔化，16世纪后期发动反英的德斯蒙德叛乱。末代伯爵1583年败死，领地没收、头衔废止；1600年后复封不附杰拉尔丁旧地。

en:
Dinkelsbühl stands on the Wörnitz, where a Carolingian royal court existed around 730. The Hohenstaufen fortified the crossing of two trade routes around 1130, and the town received the municipal rights of Ulm in 1305 before becoming a Free Imperial City in 1351.

Its walls went up from 1372 and the great Gothic minster of Saint George was finished in 1499, marking the height of its medieval wealth. Around 1534 most citizens turned Protestant, but the Thirty Years' War brought alternating imperial and Swedish garrisons and heavy contributions; after the 1648 Peace of Westphalia it became one of the Empire's few bi-confessional cities, with Catholic and Lutheran offices shared equally.

In 1802 it lost its imperial status to Bavaria, went briefly to Prussia with the Ansbach-Bayreuth lands in 1804, and was annexed by Bavaria in 1806.
zh:
丁克尔斯比尔在韦尔尼茨河畔，约730年已有加洛林王宫。约1130年霍亨斯陶芬家族在两条商路渡口修筑要塞；1305年取得与乌尔姆相同的市政权利，1351年升为自由帝国城市。

城墙1372年起修建，哥特式圣乔治大教堂1499年落成，标志城市中世纪财富的顶峰。约1534年多数市民改信新教，三十年战争中帝国与瑞典军队轮番驻守，摊派沉重；1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》后成为帝国少数双教派城市，天主教与路德宗官职均分。

1802年它失去帝国直辖地位划归巴伐利亚，1804年随安斯巴赫-拜罗伊特领地短暂属普鲁士，1806年被巴伐利亚王国吞并。

en:
The Diné, also known as Navajo, were Athabaskan-speaking communities of the American Southwest. They adopted farming from Pueblo neighbors and sheep and goat herding from the Spanish. By the 1670s Spanish accounts placed them in Dinétah, west of the Chama valley.

Spanish expeditions attacked Navajo country in the 1770s, while Diné groups also traded and allied with Hopi and Spanish neighbors. In 1823 they rejected Mexican demands for settlement in pueblos and conversion; Governor José Antonio Vizcarra then led an expedition against them.
zh:
迪内人又称纳瓦霍人，是北美西南部说阿萨巴斯坎语的部族群体。他们从普韦布洛邻居那里学会农耕，又从西班牙人那里引入绵羊和山羊的放牧。到17世纪70年代，西班牙记载称他们居住在查马河谷以西的迪内塔。

18世纪70年代，西班牙军队进攻纳瓦霍人的土地，而迪内部族也与霍皮人和西班牙邻居贸易、结盟。1823年，他们拒绝墨西哥当局要求其迁入村镇并改宗的条件；总督何塞·安东尼奥·比斯卡拉随后率军远征。

en:
Donggo was a Jurchen tribe whose ruling family had moved from Warka to Donggo. It fought the Aisin Gioro before its chief Hohori brought his people to Nurhaci in 1588.

Nurhaci married his eldest daughter to Hohori, who later commanded the Plain Red Banner and fought in the conquest of Ula. In 1616 Hohori became one of the five founding ministers of Later Jin.
zh:
董鄂是一个女真部，其统治家族从瓦尔喀迁到董鄂。董鄂曾与爱新觉罗氏交战，1588年首领何和礼率部归附努尔哈赤。

努尔哈赤将长女嫁给何和礼，后者后来统领正红旗，参加了征服乌拉的战事。1616年，何和礼成为后金开国五大臣之一。

en: The Doeg were an Algonquian-speaking people of Virginia's upper Potomac. In 1608 John Smith recorded their principal town, Tauxenent, on what is now Mason Neck; they grew maize and gathered fish. A Doeg raid in 1675 contributed to the tensions preceding Bacon's Rebellion against the Virginia colonial government.
zh: 多埃格人是弗吉尼亚波托马克河上游的阿尔冈昆语族人群。1608年约翰·史密斯记载了他们位于今梅森半岛的主要聚落陶克塞嫩特；他们种植玉米，也捕鱼为生。1675年多埃格人的一次袭击加剧了紧张局势，随后爆发了反对弗吉尼亚殖民政府的培根起义。

en:
The Dogra hill country, called Duggar after the ancient kingdom of Durgara named in an eleventh-century Chamba inscription, lay between the Chenab and Ravi rivers in the Punjab hills. Its early chiefdoms appear in Kalhana's Rajatarangini, and Aurel Stein later counted some eleven Dogra states there, all gradually absorbed by Jammu.

Jammu itself, traditionally founded by Raja Jambulochan around 900, was already strong enough for Timur to pass through on his return from Delhi in 1398. In 1423 the warlord Jasrat killed Raja Bhim Dev and made Jammu his vassal, yet under the Mughals its hill rajas kept broad autonomy as allies of the empire.

The Jamwal rulers Dhruv Dev and Ranjit Dev, the latter reigning from 1728 to 1780, made Jammu supreme among the Dogra states. In time the Sikh misls overwhelmed it, and Ranjit Singh annexed Jammu in 1808.
zh:
多格拉山地古称杜加尔，得名于11世纪昌巴铭文所记的杜尔加拉王国，地处旁遮普山区奇纳布河与拉维河之间。当地早期小邦见于卡尔哈纳的《王河》，奥里尔·斯坦因后来统计有约十一个多格拉小邦，最终都被查谟吞并。

查谟相传由罗阇詹布洛钦于900年前后建立，1398年帖木儿从德里回师时即途经此城，足见其地位。1423年豪强贾斯拉特杀死罗阇比姆·德夫，使查谟沦为附庸；但在莫卧儿治下，山区罗阇作为帝国盟友保留了很大自治权。

贾姆瓦尔家族的德鲁夫·德夫与1728至1780年在位的兰吉特·德夫，使查谟成为多格拉诸邦之首。此后锡克教米斯尔诸邦将其压服，兰吉特·辛格于1808年吞并查谟。

en:
The Doi were a branch of the Kōno clan with lands at Minami-Doi in Iyo Province. In 1333 Doi Michimasu and his kinsmen rose for Emperor Go-Daigo, taking Fuchū Castle and defeating the shogunate's forces at Ishihama.

During the ensuing struggle between rival courts, Michimasu and Tokunō Michitsuna followed Nitta Yoshisada for the Southern Court. They were besieged at Kanegasaki Castle in Echizen, where Michitsuna died in 1337.
zh:
土居氏是河野氏的一支，在伊予国南土居拥有领地。1333年土居通增与同族响应后醍醐天皇，攻下府中城，并在石井浜击败幕府军。

此后南北朝相争，通增与得能通纲追随新田义贞，为南朝作战。他们在越前金崎城遭到围攻，通纲于1337年战死。

en:
Dompu was an old chiefdom, or kedatuan, on central Sumbawa in the Lesser Sunda Islands, lying between the stronger kingdoms of Bima to the east and Sumbawa to the west. The fourteenth-century Javanese poem Negarakertagama already named it among the principalities of eastern Sumbawa, and in its early centuries the court followed Buddhist-influenced native traditions.

Counted among the six historic kingdoms of the island, Dompu adopted Islam in the seventeenth century, amid the Makassar campaigns that spread the faith across Sumbawa, and became one of its four sultanates, linked by marriage and alliance to the courts of Bima and Sumbawa.

Its old royal palace was later replaced by the Grand Mosque of Dompu, and in 1815 the eruption of neighbouring Mount Tambora brought widespread destruction and famine to its lands.
zh:
栋普是小巽他群岛松巴哇岛中部的古老邦国，东邻强国比马，西接松巴哇。14世纪的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》已把栋普列为松巴哇东部的邦国之一，早期王廷奉行受佛教影响的本土信仰。

栋普被视为岛上六个历史王国之一；17世纪，在望加锡人征战并向全岛传播伊斯兰教的浪潮中，栋普君主改宗，成为岛上四个苏丹国之一，通过联姻和同盟与比马、松巴哇两廷维系在一起。

它的旧王宫后来被改建为栋普大清真寺；1815年邻近的坦博拉火山喷发，使其土地遭受大面积破坏和饥荒。

en:
The County of Diepholz, at first a lordship, was a Holy Roman Empire territory in the Lower Rhenish-Westphalian Circle, centred on Diepholz between the Weser and the Dümmer lake. Its rulers were ancient Saxon Uradel who held their core lands as allodial property rather than imperial fiefs; the family name first appears in 1160.

In 1291 they acquired the Vicecomitat of Sudholte and its full jurisdiction. Rudolf IV, ruling in 1337, enlarged the territory and founded the parish church in 1350; his grandson Johann III granted the town its rights in 1380.

Threatened by the Bishops of Minden, Rudolf VIII surrendered his sovereignty to the Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg in 1510. The Reformation followed in 1528, and when Friedrich II died in 1585 most of the county passed to the Welf dukes and the Auburg lands to Hesse.
zh:
迪普霍尔茨伯国（初为领主领地）是神圣罗马帝国下莱茵-威斯特伐利亚行政圈的邦国，以威悉河与迪默湖之间的迪普霍尔茨为中心。统治者出身古老的萨克森世袭贵族，核心领地是自主地而非帝国封邑，家族姓氏于1160年首次出现。

1291年取得苏德霍尔特子爵辖区及完整司法权。1337年在位的鲁道夫四世扩张领地，1350年修建教区教堂，其孙约翰三世1380年授予城镇权。

迫于明登主教的威胁，鲁道夫八世于1510年将主权交给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵。1528年伯国推行宗教改革；1585年弗里德里希二世去世后，伯国大部并入韦尔夫公爵领地，奥堡一带归属黑森。

en: Dara was one of the Muslim states of the Ethiopian region grouped with Bale, Hadiya and Dawaro among the lands associated with Zeila.
zh: 达拉是埃塞俄比亚地区的穆斯林小国之一，与巴莱、哈迪亚和达瓦罗同被列为泽拉相关的地区。

en: Dalriada was a Gaelic kingdom spanning Argyll in western Scotland and Antrim in northeastern Ireland. It reached its height in the sixth and seventh centuries and later became part of the Kingdom of Alba.
zh: 达尔里阿达是横跨苏格兰西部阿盖尔与爱尔兰东北部安特里姆的盖尔王国。它在6至7世纪达到鼎盛，后来成为阿尔巴王国的一部分。

en:
The County of Dreux was a small royal appanage between Normandy and the Île-de-France, centred on Dreux castle. The lands passed through the counts of Vexin and dukes of Normandy before Robert II confiscated them, and in the twelfth century Louis the Fat granted Dreux to his younger son Robert, founder of the Capetian House of Dreux. Early in the thirteenth century Peter of Dreux of that house, called Mauclerc, won Brittany through marriage to its heiress Alix of Thouars.

In 1337 its count was Peter I, who had fought for Philip VI at Cassel in 1328. He died in 1345 leaving a daughter, Joan II; her marriage to Simon de Thouars produced only daughters.

These heiresses eventually sold the county to Charles VI. In 1382 it passed as Marguerite de Bourbon's dowry to Albret, reverting to the French crown in 1556.
zh:
德勒伯国是诺曼底与法兰西岛交界处的小型王室采邑，以德勒城堡为中心。领地曾先后属韦克桑伯爵和诺曼底公爵，后被罗贝尔二世没收；12世纪胖子路易把德勒封给幼子罗贝尔，开创卡佩旁支德勒家族。13世纪初，家族的皮埃尔·德·德勒（绰号“莫克莱尔”）因迎娶女继承人阿丽克斯·德·图阿尔而取得布列塔尼。

1337年在位的皮埃尔一世曾在1328年卡塞尔战役中为腓力六世作战。他1345年去世，只留下女儿让娜二世；让娜与西蒙·德·图阿尔婚后仅育有女儿。

这些女继承人最终把伯国卖给查理六世。1382年，德勒作为玛格丽特·德·波旁的嫁妆转入阿尔布雷家族，1556年复归法兰西王室。

en:
The Kingdom of Derge was a Tibetan polity in Kham, ruled from Derge in present-day Sichuan by the Gar Clan, which traced its descent from Gar Tongtsen, a seventh-century minister of Songsten Gampo. In the thirteenth century clan leader Sonam Rinchen won favour from Sakya hierarch Phagpa, and in the mid-fifteenth century the seat moved to Derge, where kings later founded Gongchen Monastery.

Allied with the Khoshut Khanate, Derge overthrew the Bön Beri polity in 1639, took the title Dharma King around 1640, and held ten districts by 1775. The Qing recognised its ruler as a tusi in 1728, and in 1729 King Tenpa Tsering founded the Derge printing house, whose wooden-block Kangyur made the kingdom a centre of Tibetan learning and later of the Rimé movement.

Two queens regnant, Yangchen Drolma and Tsewang Lhamo, ruled between 1774 and 1812. A family feud in 1799 began its decline.
zh:
德格是康区的藏族政权，治所在德格（今四川境内），统治的噶氏家族自称是7世纪吐蕃松赞干布朝大臣禄东赞的后裔。13世纪首领索郎仁钦受到萨迦派法王八思巴赏识；15世纪中叶家族迁治所于德格，历代德格王后来在此兴建更庆寺。

德格与和硕特汗国结盟，1639年攻灭信奉苯教的白利土司，约1640年采用法王称号，到1775年已扩张至十个地区。1728年清朝封其首领为土司，登巴泽仁1729年创办德格印经院，院藏木刻版《甘珠尔》使德格成为藏学中心，后来又成为利美运动的重镇。

1774至1812年间央珍卓玛与策旺拉姆两位女王先后执政。1799年王族内讧，国势由此转衰。

en:
The small kingdom later famous as Dharampur was founded in 1262 under the name Ramnagar, when Ramsingh, a Sisodia Rajput of the Chittor clan and younger son of the house of Udaipur, overthrew the local tribal chief and made himself ruler of this wooded, hilly corner of south Gujarat.

His descendants kept their independence while Muslim sultanates arose all around them: the hill state controlled a ring of forts and was never overrun, and its ranas gave shelter and patronage to Parsi refugees and drew revenue from Portuguese trade at the nearby ports.

In 1766 the ruler Dharamdevji moved his capital to Mandvegan and renamed it Dharampur, the name thereafter used for the state. On the last day of 1802 Dharampur accepted British protection and became a nine-gun-salute princely state, still governed by the same Sisodia line.
zh:
这个后来以达尔兰布尔闻名的小邦，建于1262年，初名拉姆讷格尔：奇托尔出身的西索迪亚拉杰普特人、乌代布尔家族的幼子拉姆辛推翻当地的部落首领，在南古吉拉特这片丛林丘陵之地自立为主。

他的后裔在诸穆斯林苏丹国环伺之下保持了独立——这个山地小邦控制着一圈堡垒，从未被外敌攻破；历代拉纳还庇护、资助帕西难民，并从附近港口的葡萄牙贸易中抽取收入。

1766年，君主达尔马德夫吉把都城迁往曼德韦甘，并将其改名为达尔兰布尔，土邦此后也以此名行世。1802年最后一天，达尔兰布尔接受英国保护，成为享有九响礼炮待遇的土邦，统治家族仍是同一条西索迪亚世系。

en:
The Principality of Drutsk was a small appanage centred on Drutsk on the river Drut, in the borderlands between the later Vitebsk, Minsk and Mogilev regions. It was created in 1101, when the lands of Polotsk were divided among the sons of Prince Vseslav and Drutsk fell to Rogvolod-Boris.

The young principality was soon seized by the princes of Minsk, taken by Kiev under Vladimir Monomakh in 1116, returned to Minsk in the 1150s and absorbed outright by Minsk in the later thirteenth century, before passing to Vitebsk early in the fourteenth.

With the marriage of Grand Duke Algirdas to Maria of Vitebsk, Drutsk entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, where it survived as an autonomous appanage until the reform of 1565 and 1566, which merged it into Orsha county in the Vitebsk Voivodeship.
zh:
德鲁茨克公国是以德鲁季河畔德鲁茨克城为中心的小封邑，地处后来的维捷布斯克、明斯克和莫吉廖夫三地交界。1101年波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫的诸子瓜分父土，德鲁茨克分给罗格沃洛德—鲍里斯，公国由此建立。

这个年轻的公国不久便被明斯克公国夺取，1116年又被弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫的基辅大公国占领，12世纪50年代复归明斯克，13世纪下半叶被明斯克彻底吞并，14世纪初转归维捷布斯克。

随着立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯迎娶维捷布斯克的玛丽亚，德鲁茨克并入立陶宛大公国，作为自治封邑一直存续到1565年至1566年的改革，随后被并入维捷布斯克省的奥尔沙县。

en:
Dadrewa was a small Chauhan Rajput chiefdom in the Jangal Desh, the dry north-eastern Rajasthan country now in Churu district. It was reputedly the home of the Chauhan warrior Goga, later worshipped across northern India as the folk saint Gogaji, held to have ruled Dadrewa in the days of Prithviraj Chauhan.

In 1337 its raja was Motay Rao Chauhan, whose son Karamchand embraced Islam at the court of Sultan Firuz Shah Tughluq in about 1352 and took the name Qaim Khan. Rising high in the Delhi sultanate, Qaim Khan was made governor of Hisar Firoza with the title Khan-e Jahan, until he was trapped and murdered on the Yamuna by Khizr Khan in 1419.

Qaim Khan's Muslim descendants, known as the Qaimkhanis, went on to rule the Shekhawati towns of Fatehpur, Jhunjhunu and Singhana from 1384 until their line ended in 1731.
zh:
陀多瓦是乔诃那拉杰普特人的一个小酋长国，地处拉贾斯坦东北部干旱的“丛林之地”，即今丘鲁县境内。相传这里是乔诃那武士戈加的故乡，戈加后来被北印度广泛尊为民间圣人戈加吉，相传在普利色毗罗阇·乔诃那时代统治陀多瓦。

1337年在位的酋长是摩泰·拉奥乔诃那，其子羯罗摩旃陀约于1352年在苏丹菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克的宫廷改宗伊斯兰教，得名凯姆汗。他在德里苏丹国仕途显赫，出任希萨尔菲罗扎总督，封号“世界之汗”，最终于1419年被希兹尔汗设计擒杀于亚穆纳河畔。

凯姆汗的穆斯林后裔称凯姆卡尼家族，从1384年起统治谢卡瓦蒂的法塔赫布尔、琼丘努和辛加纳诸城，直到1731年世系终结。

en:
Dasni was the land of the Dasini, the Kurdish tribe that gave the Yazidis their earliest name: before the twelfth century sources call the Yazidis simply Dasini, after the Dasin country north-east of Mosul between the Tigris and Great Zab. Fourteenth-century writers made them a Bokhti Kurdish branch around Duhok, Sheikhan and Sinjar.

They followed the Adawiyya order of Sheikh Adi ibn Musafir, from which Yazidism took shape, and as early as 906 rose against Mosul's Hamdanids and formed a chiefdom centered on Sheikhan and the Lalish valley. By the early fourteenth century hereditary Mirs were both their princes and religious chiefs.

Bahdinan attacks on their strongholds in the fifteenth century were followed in the seventeenth by Ottoman service: Ezidi Mirza governed Sinjar in 1644 and Mosul in 1650. Istanbul tried repeatedly to reduce the sanjak, yet its emirs kept a measure of self-rule around Sheikhan.
zh:
达斯尼是达斯尼人的土地。达斯尼是库尔德部落，雅兹迪人最早的称呼便来自它：12世纪以前文献即称他们为达斯尼人，得名于摩苏尔东北、底格里斯河与大扎卜河间的达斯尼地区。14世纪作家视其为博赫蒂库尔德人一支，聚居于杜胡克、谢赫坎、辛贾尔一带。

他们信奉谢赫·阿迪·本·穆萨菲尔的阿达维教团，雅兹迪派由此成形；早在906年便起兵反抗摩苏尔哈姆丹王朝，在谢赫坎与拉利什山谷建酋邦。14世纪初，世袭米尔兼任政教首领。

15世纪巴赫迪南进攻其山寨；17世纪其王公转投奥斯曼，埃齐迪·米尔扎1644年任辛贾尔总督、1650年任摩苏尔总督。伊斯坦布尔屡欲裁撤该桑贾克，埃米尔们仍在谢赫坎周围保有一定自治权。

en:
The Date were a warrior family of northern Japan, named for their lands in Date district of Mutsu. Their ancestor Isa Tomomune received the district from Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1189, and the family supported the Southern Court in the 1330s.

Date Masamune defeated the Ashina at Suriagehara in 1589 and took Aizu, but Toyotomi Hideyoshi required him to surrender that conquest in 1590. After supporting Tokugawa Ieyasu against the Uesugi in 1600, Masamune established the family's domain at Sendai.
zh:
伊达氏是日本北部的武家，得名于陆奥伊达郡的领地。其祖伊佐朝宗于1189年从源赖朝处获得该郡，家族在14世纪30年代支持南朝。

伊达政宗于1589年在摺上原击败芦名氏，夺取会津，但丰臣秀吉在1590年命他放弃这一征服地。1600年政宗支持德川家康对抗上杉氏，此后在仙台建立藩领。

en:
The Doti kingdom was a Hindu state in far western present-day Nepal, ruled from the hill forts of Ajayameru and Dipayal between the Kali and Karnali rivers. It emerged in the thirteenth century when the Katyuri kingdom of Kumaon split among eight princes; Niranjan Malla Dev, son of its last ruler, founded the Raika line, whose kings defeated the Khasa Mallas of the Karnali basin and built a strong hill kingdom.

In the sixteenth century a Mughal army under Hussain Khan, sent from Lucknow under Akbar, sacked Ajayameru, yet the Raikas survived and later adopted the title Shahi.

The kingdom lasted until the Gorkha expansion of 1790, when its forces were beaten on the Seti River; the last king, Prithivipati Shahi, fled into British-held plains and fought the Gorkhalis alongside the British in 1814, while his lands were absorbed into Nepal.
zh:
多提王国是今尼泊尔远西地区的印度教政权，以卡利河与格尔纳利河之间的阿贾梅鲁和迪帕亚尔山城为统治中心。13世纪库马盎的卡图里王国分裂给八位王子，多提即为其中一支；末代卡图里君主之子尼兰詹·马拉·德夫开创了统治者称“拉伊卡”的王朝，拉伊卡诸王击败格尔纳利河流域的卡萨·马拉政权，建立起稳固的山地王国。

16世纪阿克巴在位时，驻勒克瑙的莫卧儿将领侯赛因·汗率军洗劫阿贾梅鲁，但拉伊卡统治者得以存续，后来改用“沙希”称号。

1790年廓尔喀扩张，多提军队在塞蒂河畔战败；末代国王普里特维帕蒂·沙希逃入英属平原，并于1814年配合英军对廓尔喀作战，其土地最终并入尼泊尔王国。

en:
Dortmund, first recorded around 882 as Throtmanni, grew beside the Ruhr on the Sigiburg hillfort site captured by Charlemagne in the Saxon Wars. Frederick Barbarossa rebuilt it after a fire in 1152 and resided there.

It became an Imperial Free City and in 1293 won an early official brewing right. Through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it led the Hanseatic League's Rhine, Westphalia and Netherlands circle, merchants lending to Edward III of England against his crown in 1344. Besieged for eighteen months in 1388 and 1389 by the count of Mark and the archbishop of Cologne, the city held out, earning the motto as firm as Dortmund.

The Thirty Years' War shattered its prosperity, and it lost free-city status under the 1803 Reichsdeputationshauptschluss, passing through Nassau-Orange-Fulda and the Grand Duchy of Berg before the Congress of Vienna gave it to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
多特蒙德882年前后以Throtmanni之名见载，地处鲁尔河畔西吉堡山垒故地，查理曼在撒克逊战争中夺此山垒。火灾后腓特烈·巴巴罗萨1152年重建该城并驻跸。

它成为帝国自由城市，1293年获得早期官方酿酒权。13至14世纪为汉萨同盟莱茵、威斯特伐利亚、尼德兰分区首席城市，1344年商人以王冠为抵押向英王爱德华三世放贷。1388至1389年马克伯爵与科隆大主教围城十八个月，该城坚守不降，赢得“坚如多特蒙德”之名。

三十年战争摧毁其繁荣，1803年《帝国代表重要决议》剥夺其自由城市地位，先后归属拿骚-奥兰治-富尔达与贝格大公国，1815年维也纳会议划归普鲁士。

en:
The Dulkadirid beylik was a Turkoman principality of the Bozok branch of the Oghuz, which arose in southern Anatolia as the Seljuk Sultanate of Rum collapsed. Its founder, the chieftain Qaraja Bey, installed himself around Elbistan in 1335 and took the town in 1337, accepting the title of na'ib from the Mamluk sultan al-Nasir Muhammad.

For nearly two centuries the beylik balanced between the Mamluks to the south and the Ottomans to the west, controlling the mountain passes from Elbistan and Marash. Its dynasty became closely tied to the Ottoman house through marriage, giving brides to several sultans, among them the mothers of Mehmed II and Selim I.

Ottoman-Mamluk rivalry nevertheless ended its independence: after the Battle of Turnadağ in 1515, Selim I and his grand vizier Sinan Pasha annexed the beylik and reorganized it as an Ottoman sanjak.
zh:
杜尔卡迪尔贝伊国是罗姆塞尔柱苏丹国崩溃时兴起于安纳托利亚南部的突厥蛮政权，属乌古斯人博佐克支。开国首领卡拉贾贝伊1335年进驻埃尔比斯坦一带，1337年夺取该城，并从马穆鲁克苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德手中接受纳伊布头衔。

近两个世纪里，贝伊国在南方马穆鲁克与西方奥斯曼之间周旋，凭埃尔比斯坦和马拉什控制山间要道。其王室与奥斯曼家族联姻极深，多位公主嫁入奥斯曼宫廷，穆罕默德二世和塞利姆一世的母亲都出自杜尔卡迪尔家族。

但奥斯曼与马穆鲁克的争夺终结了它的独立：1515年图尔纳达格战役后，塞利姆一世与大维齐尔锡南帕夏吞并贝伊国，将其改组为奥斯曼的桑贾克。

en:
The Lordship of Daun was a small Eifel territory centered on Daun Castle on the Lieser, the ancestral seat of the lords of Daun, documented from 1075. The original free lords died out in 1163, and their ministerialis Richardus de Duna took the castle, name and arms, founding a second dynasty.

Wedged between Trier and Cologne, the lordship's independence was precarious: in 1340 Ägidius von Daun held the town as a fief of King John of Bohemia, but in 1353 the archbishops of Trier and Cologne stormed the castle on the pretext that he was a robber baron, and Daun passed under Trier.

The family continued as castle lords, raised Imperial counts in 1643, later supplying two Habsburg field marshals, Wirich Philipp von Daun and his son Leopold Joseph of Seven Years' War fame. French forces destroyed the castle in 1689, and the comital line died out in the eighteenth century.
zh:
道恩是艾费尔山区的小领地，以利瑟河高地的道恩城堡为中心，为道恩领主家族祖堡，1075年首见文献。最初的自由领主家族1163年绝嗣，家臣里夏杜斯·德·杜纳接管城堡，沿用旧主姓氏纹章，开创第二个道恩家族。

领地夹在特里尔与科隆之间，独立朝不保夕：1340年埃吉迪乌斯·冯·道恩以波希米亚王约翰封臣身份领有城镇，1353年特里尔与科隆的大主教以他是强盗骑士为由攻破城堡，道恩沦为特里尔附庸。

家族继续担任城堡领主，1643年升为帝国伯爵，后来出了两位哈布斯堡陆军元帅——维里希·菲利普·冯·道恩及其子利奥波德·约瑟夫，后者以七年战争闻名。1689年法军摧毁城堡，伯爵支系18世纪绝嗣。

en:
The Daur were a Mongolic people whose settlements in the seventeenth century lay along the upper Amur and its tributaries. In 1640 the Qing defeated the Evenk leader Bombogor, whose followers included Daur, and brought the region under their influence.

Russian forces under Yerofei Khabarov attacked Daur towns in 1651. Facing Russian expansion, the Qing moved the Daur south to the Nen River in 1654–1656 and recruited them into the banners.
zh:
达斡尔人是蒙古语族人群，17世纪的聚落分布在黑龙江上游及其支流沿岸。1640年，清军击败了拥有达斡尔部众的鄂温克首领博穆博果尔，使这一地区落入清朝势力范围。

1651年，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫率领的俄国军队袭击了达斡尔城镇。面对俄国扩张，清朝在1654—1656年将达斡尔人迁往嫩江，并征入八旗。

en:
Centered on the Sanmao cave in the upper Youshui valley, on the lands of present-day Laifeng County in southwestern Hubei, this was a Tujia native chieftaincy of the Wuling mountains.

In 1294 the Yuan turned the Sanmao cave into a prefecture under Sichuan Province, and in 1346 reorganized it as the Sanmao Military-Civil Pacification Commission, ruled by the hereditary Tan clan. Early Ming warfare left the office vacant until 1404, when the chieftain Tan Youliang gathered the scattered population and had it restored; the court first reduced it to a longship office under the Datian garrison, then raised it back to a pacification commission in 1406.

The chieftaincy lasted until 1735, when the Qing abolished Sanmao and six neighboring tusi in the gaitu guiliu reforms. Laifeng County was founded on its territory in 1736.
zh:
这是武陵山区以散毛洞为中心的土家族土司，地处酉水上游，其地在今湖北西南部的来凤县。

1294年元朝以散毛洞置散毛府，隶属四川行省，1346年改置散毛誓崖等处军民宣抚司，由覃氏世袭。明初战乱后诸司荒废，1404年土官覃友谅招回流散人众、奏请复设，朝廷先将散毛降为长官司，隶属大田军民千户所，1406年又升回宣抚司。

1735年清朝推行改土归流，废散毛等七个土司，1736年以其地置来凤县。

en:
The Dawasir are a large Arab tribe of southern Najd, whose stronghold is the Wadi al-Dawasir, a well-watered valley once known as al-Aqiq. A confederation rather than a single lineage, they drew on the Azd and Banu Taghlib, in two divisions, the Al Zayed and the Taghlib. Their name derives variously from an ancestor called Dosser or an Arabic word for soldiers.

Unusually, they combined herding with settled life: part pastured camels and flocks in the desert while the rest tended palm groves, wells and farms in a fertile corner of the peninsula, whose oases had earlier supported the Kindite capital of Qaryat al-Faw before its abandonment in the 400s.

From the mid-1700s rise of the first Saudi state they were among its closest tribal allies, marriage ties with the Al Saud making them kinsmen and supporters.
zh:
代瓦西尔是内志南部强大的阿拉伯部落，根据地是水源丰沛的代瓦西尔干河，河谷旧称阿基克。它并非单一血缘部落，而是艾兹德人与巴努·塔格利卜人组成的联盟，分阿勒·扎耶德与塔格利卜两大支系；名称一说来自先祖多塞尔，一说来自阿拉伯语“士兵”一词。

与半岛常见的纯游牧不同，代瓦西尔人兼营游牧与定居：一部分人在沙漠放养骆驼和羊群，另一部分人在半岛肥沃角落经营椰枣园、水井和农庄。这里的绿洲曾供养肯德王国都城盖里耶·费乌，该城于5世纪荒废。

从18世纪中叶第一个沙特国家兴起时起，代瓦西尔就是其最亲近的部落盟友之一，与沙特家族的联姻使他们既是支持者又是姻亲。

en:
Duyang was a Zhuang tusi of the Si'en prefecture in central Guangxi, seated on the Hongshui River in present-day Du'an County under Hechi.

Together with Anding, Baishan and six neighbouring offices, it was set up in 1528 as part of Wang Shouren's settlement after the Tianzhou war, which replaced the broken power of the Cen chiefs with a ring of smaller hereditary chieftaincies. Duyang's native officers answered to the Si'en prefect and kept their hereditary posts through the Ming and the Qing.
zh:
都阳是广西中部思恩府的壮族土司，衙署在红水河畔，辖地在今河池市都安瑶族自治县一带。

1528年田州战事结束后，总督王守仁主持善后，设立都阳、安定、白山等九个长官司，用一圈较小的世袭土司取代岑氏留下的权力真空。都阳土官隶属于思恩府，在明、清两代世袭不绝。

en:
Duyun, then still written with the cloud character after the cave above the town, is the chief center of the Sui and Bouyei hill country of southern Guizhou. The Tang held it loosely through the jimi Ying prefecture, and in 1284 the Yuan set up the Duyun military and civilian chief's office, leaving local headmen to rule under the tusi system.

Ming armies entered Guizhou in the 1380s and set up chief's offices and a pacification commission; after a Miao rising was put down in 1390, the general He Fu had the name's second character changed for luck, the Duyun Guard following in 1395.

In 1494 the court converted the garrison into Duyun Prefecture, the administrative center for the surrounding native subprefectures. The Qing kept the prefecture and in 1672 attached Duyun County to it, tightening direct rule over the Sui valleys.
zh:
都匀原名都云，因城东的都云洞得名，是贵州南部水族、布依族山区的中心。唐代朝廷只能通过羁縻应州松散地控制这里；1284年元朝设置都云军民长官司，由本地头人按土司制度统辖。

1380年代明军进入贵州，在这里次第设立长官司、安抚司；1390年苗民起事被平羌将军何福镇压后，朝廷取均匀之意改都云为都匀，1395年驻军设立都匀卫。

1494年朝廷改卫设都匀府，成为管辖周边土司的正式行政中心。清朝沿用府制，1672年又置都匀县附郭，对水族各河谷的直接统治不断加强。

en: Dǐzhài was a small Miao chieftaincy centered on Longchang, in the Shunyuan hills northwest of Guiyang in present-day Xiuwen County, Guizhou. The country was Shuixi tusi land until the Ming opened the first of the nine Longchang post stations there in 1386.
zh: 底寨是以龙场为中心的苗人小土司，地处今贵州修文县、贵阳西北的顺元山区；在明代于1386年开设龙场九驿之首驿以前，这里一直是水西土司的领地。

en:
Georgian, Armenian and Arabic sources called the Durdzuks' mountain country Durdzuketia. The Durdzuks, Vainakh ancestors of the Chechens and Ingush, held the gorges of central and southern Chechnya and parts of Ingushetia. The Georgian Chronicles derive the name from a legendary lord, Durdzuk, who settled there and named the land after himself.

Its warlike clans aided the Georgian kings against the Mongols. The lowlands had earlier been ruled by the Khazars and Christian Alania. Thirteenth-century Mongol invasions and Timur's fourteenth-century campaigns drove the Durdzuks into the high valleys, where they reorganized into free, egalitarian teips and tukkhums under the Mehk-Khel council.

Islam, known since the fourteenth century, spread slowly and long coexisted with pagan cults. Seventeenth-century leaders kept the clans free of empire, until Sheikh Mansur's rising in the 1780s and the Russian building of Fort Grozny in 1818 opened the long Caucasian War.
zh:
格鲁吉亚、亚美尼亚和阿拉伯文献把杜尔祖克人的山地之国称作杜尔祖克。杜尔祖克人是车臣、印古什人的瓦伊纳赫祖先，据有车臣中南部与印古什部分地区的峡谷。《格鲁吉亚编年史》称其名来自传说王公杜尔祖克，他入山定居并以己名命名此地。

其善战氏族曾助格鲁吉亚诸王对抗蒙古人。低地早先受可萨人与基督教阿兰尼亚统治；13世纪蒙古入侵和14世纪帖木儿征战把杜尔祖克人逼入高山峡谷，他们在那里重组为自由平等的泰普、图克洪氏族，以议事会梅赫-凯尔治理。

伊斯兰教14世纪已传入，却传播缓慢，长期与多神崇拜并存。17世纪首领使山地氏族不受帝国掌控；18世纪80年代谢赫曼苏尔举兵，1818年俄罗斯修建格罗兹尼要塞，高加索战争就此开启。

en:
Egil was the Bulduqani hill principality, seated at Eğil fortress on the Tigris between Harput and Diyarbakr. Its founder Pir Mansur, a Sufi born in 989 claiming descent from the Prophet, led Kurdish followers from Hakkari and took Eğil around 1049. His son Pir Musa and grandson Pir Bedir built it on the Mirdesan tribe's support; Bedir died in the Seljuk siege of 1087.

The dynasty named for a later emir, Bulduk, expanded under Emir Muhammed as far as Karaca Dag, Palu, Cermik and Lice. In the fifteenth century they were drawn into Aq Qoyunlu politics: Uzun Hasan married Emir Dawlatshah's daughter, but her brother Isa fought him at the Battle on the Tigris in 1457.

After the Safavids' brief rule, Selim I's conquest left Eğil under Ottoman overlordship with self-rule and exemption from the timar system, privileges lasting until dissolution in the mid-nineteenth century.
zh:
埃伊尔是布尔杜卡尼王朝的山地公国，都于埃伊尔要塞，在哈尔普特与迪亚巴克尔间底格里斯河畔。开国者皮尔·曼苏尔生于989年，苏菲，自称先知后裔，率库尔德部众自哈卡里迁来，约1049年取埃伊尔；子皮尔·穆萨、孙皮尔·贝迪尔靠米尔迪桑部落建国，贝迪尔1087年死于塞尔柱围攻。

王朝得名于后来的埃米尔布尔杜克；穆罕默德时疆土从卡拉贾山延及帕卢、切尔米克、利杰。15世纪卷入白羊朝政：乌尊·哈桑娶道拉特沙阿之女，其兄弟伊萨却于1457年底格里斯河之战与之为敌。

萨法维短暂占据，塞利姆一世征服后埃伊尔成为奥斯曼属国，享有自治、免于蒂马尔制度，特权维持到19世纪中叶埃米尔国解散。

en:
Egypt became an Ottoman province after the conquest of the Mamluk Sultanate in 1517, but Mamluk leaders retained considerable power. Napoleon's army invaded in 1798 and was expelled by British and Ottoman forces in 1801.

In 1805 the Ottoman commander Muhammad Ali became governor and made Cairo the centre of a largely autonomous state. He crushed the Mamluks, reformed the army and economy, and conquered Sudan. In 1831 his forces invaded Ottoman Syria, beginning a war with the sultan that ended in 1833.
zh:
1517年奥斯曼帝国征服马穆鲁克苏丹国后，埃及成为奥斯曼的一个省，但马穆鲁克首领仍有很大权势。拿破仑的军队于1798年入侵埃及，1801年被英国和奥斯曼军队逐出。

1805年，奥斯曼指挥官穆罕默德·阿里出任总督，以开罗为中心建立了高度自治的政权。他清除了马穆鲁克势力，改革军队和经济，并征服了苏丹。1831年，他的军队入侵奥斯曼治下的叙利亚，与苏丹的战争持续到1833年。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Eichstätt was a small Holy Roman Empire ecclesiastical state in the Franconian Jura, centred on Eichstätt on the Altmühl. Its see was founded in 746, when Anglo-Saxon missionary Willibald was consecrated first bishop by Boniface. Bishops won princely rank inheriting the Franconian lands of their advocates, the Hirschberg counts, whose castle above Beilngries gave the bishopric a second town.

In 1337 the bishop was Heinrich V Schenk von Reicheneck, imposed by Pope John XXII in 1329. When he accepted imperial regalia from Louis IV in 1334 the pope excommunicated him; he spent much of his reign quarrelling with his chapter and pawning lands, among them Schweinfurt, over debts.

Eichstätt remained Catholic at the Reformation, joined the Catholic League in 1617 and became a Counter-Reformation and witch-trial stronghold. Secularized in 1803, it passed to Bavaria after the 1805 Treaty of Pressburg.
zh:
艾希施泰特采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国弗兰肯汝拉山区的小型教会邦国，中心在阿尔特米尔河畔艾希施泰特。教区创于746年，盎格鲁-撒克逊传教士维利巴尔德由波尼法修祝圣为首任主教。主教们继承代行权官希尔施贝格伯爵的法兰克尼亚领地而获诸侯地位，拜尔恩格里斯上方的城堡使主教区有了第二座小城。

1337年在任主教海因里希五世·申克·冯·赖谢内克，1329年教皇约翰二十二世任命；1334年接受路易四世授予的帝国领主权，随即被绝罚。在位时多与参事会争执，典当施韦因富特等地偿债。

宗教改革时艾希施泰特仍奉天主教，1617年入天主教联盟，成反宗教改革与猎巫审判重镇。1803年世俗化，1805年《普雷斯堡和约》后归巴伐利亚。

en: Ejimi was a Haixi Jurchen group settled on the Hulan river, called hvlan in Manchu after the word for chimney; the same river gave the Hulun confederation its name. The Hulan basin was occupied at the fall of the Yuan by Weji clans moving south and later entered the Ming Nurgan guard system.
zh: 埃吉米是定居在呼兰河流域的海西女真群体；呼兰河满语称 hvlan，意为烟囱，扈伦之名即来自这条河。呼兰河是松花江左岸支流，其流域是元末南下的兀者诸部占据的核心地带，明代隶属奴儿干都司下辖的羁縻卫所体系。

en:
Elayadathu, or the Elayadathu Swaroopam, was a small principality of southern Kerala with its capital at Kottarakkara, the land of palaces east of Kollam. Its ruling house was a collateral branch of the old Venad dynasty, kin to the royal family of Travancore.

The court won lasting fame in the seventeenth century when Prince Kottarakkara Thampuran composed the Ramanattam dance plays, the seed from which Kathakali, the classical dance-drama of Kerala, grew.

In the 1730s the expansionist Marthanda Varma of Travancore seized Kottarakkara and carried off its chief, who died in confinement in 1739. A princess then claimed the succession and the Dutch governor van Imhoff restored her in 1741, but Marthanda Varma defeated the combined Kottarakkara and Dutch forces and annexed the chiefdom to Travancore, while the queen fled to Cochin.
zh:
伊罗耶达都又称伊罗耶达都斯瓦鲁帕姆，是喀拉拉南部的小邦，首府科塔拉卡拉位于奎隆以东，地名意为宫殿之地。统治家族是古老吠那住王朝的旁支，与特拉凡哥尔王室同宗。

17世纪，科塔拉卡拉·坦普兰亲王在宫中创作了罗摩纳塔姆舞剧，喀拉拉古典舞剧卡塔卡利即由此萌芽，这个小朝廷也因此留名。

18世纪30年代，锐意扩张的特拉凡哥尔君主马尔坦达·瓦尔马攻占科塔拉卡拉，掳走其酋长，后者于1739年死于囚禁。一位公主随后主张继承权，荷兰总督范·伊姆霍夫出面于1741年扶她复位，但马尔坦达·瓦尔马击溃科塔拉卡拉与荷兰联军，将该邦并入特拉凡哥尔，女王则逃往科钦。

en:
Ellwangen, on the river Jagst in Swabia, grew up around Swabia's oldest Benedictine monastery, said to have been founded around 764 by Herulph and Ariolf. Emperor Louis the Pious took it under royal protection in 814, and it became an imperial abbey, probably under a privilege of King Henry II in 1011, confirmed by Emperor Charles IV in 1347.

Benedictine observance declined in the fifteenth century, and in 1460 Pope Pius II allowed the abbey to become a college of secular canons under a provost, who took the rank of a prince of the Empire with a vote in the Reichstag.

Ellwangen joined the Catholic League in 1609 and was held by Swedish troops in 1632 during the Thirty Years' War. In the mediatization of 1802 Ellwangen passed to the Duchy of Württemberg.
zh:
埃尔旺根位于施瓦本的亚格斯特河畔，围绕施瓦本最古老的本笃会修道院发展起来；据传修道院由黑鲁尔夫与阿里奥夫于764年前后创立。虔诚者路易于814年将其置于王室保护之下，它后来成为帝国修道院，豁免权可能源于1011年亨利二世的特许，并在1347年由查理四世确认。

15世纪修院纪律松弛，1460年经教宗庇护二世批准改为世俗咏祷司铎团，由修道长统领，修道长位列帝国王侯并在帝国议会拥有一票。

埃尔旺根于1609年加入天主教联盟，三十年战争期间的1632年被瑞典军队占据。1802年德意志调停中，埃尔旺根并入符腾堡公国。

en:
Ely, in Irish Eile, was a petty kingdom of Gaelic Ireland between the Slieve Bloom Mountains and the Suir, with Birr as its principal seat. Its people claimed kinship with the Eoganachta of Munster through Cian, son of Ailill Aulom.

The kingdom housed early monasteries at Birr, where a synod met in 697; the Book of Dimma was later given a jewelled shrine for the O Carroll kings. By the twelfth century Ely had shrunk to two lordships, the northern Eile Ui Chearbhaill under the O Carrolls and a southern one under the O Fogartys.

The O Carroll king Cearbhall fought alongside Brian Boru at Clontarf in 1014, and in 1337 the sept held the country around Birr. Gaelic rule ended in 1552, when the last king, Tadhg Cian O Carroll, surrendered his lordship to the Tudor crown and received it back under English tenure.
zh:
伊莱，爱尔兰语称埃莱，是盖尔爱尔兰的小王国，地处斯利夫布卢姆山脉与苏尔河之间，以伯尔为首要驻地。其居民自称通过奥利尔·奥卢姆之子基安与芒斯特的尤加纳赫塔王族同源。

王国境内有早期修道院，伯尔的修道院曾于697年举行宗教会议；《迪马之书》后来配有奥卡罗尔国王定制的珠宝书匣。到12世纪，伊莱缩小为两个领地：北部奥卡罗尔家族的埃莱·伊·卡鲁尔和南部奥福加蒂家族的领地。

奥卡罗尔国王卡鲁尔曾在1014年随布莱恩·博鲁参加克朗塔夫战役；1337年，该家族占据伯尔一带。盖尔人的统治于1552年结束，末代国王泰格·基安·奥卡罗尔向都铎王室交出领地，再以英格兰式的土地保有形式领回。

en:
The Ema were a warrior family based in Takahara in Hida Province, where they rose to become Sengoku lords. In 1564 Ema Tokimori gained Takeda support against the rival Miki and Ema Terumori; Terumori then also submitted to the Takeda.

After Oda Nobunaga's death in 1582, Terumori advanced against Anegakōji Yoritsuna for control of Hida. Terumori was killed at the Battle of Yōkamachi that October, and the Ema rapidly lost power.
zh:
江马氏是以飞驒国高原乡为根据地的武家，后来成长为战国大名。1564年，江马时盛得到武田氏援助，压倒对手三木氏和江马辉盛；辉盛随后也归附武田氏。

1582年织田信长死后，辉盛出兵与姊小路赖纲争夺飞驒。同年10月，辉盛在八日町之战中战死，江马氏迅速衰落。

en:
Enderta was a province on the eastern edge of the Ethiopian highlands of Tigray, ruled by hereditary governors. Its governor Tesfane Igzi called it his kingdom in 1305, and his successor Ya'ibika Igzi rebelled against Emperor Amda Seyon.

The emperor crushed the revolt and appointed his queen Bilén Saba, then his son Bahr Seged, to govern Enderta. Its governors also supervised the salt caravans and taxation connecting the highlands to the Afar lowlands.
zh:
恩德塔是埃塞俄比亚提格雷高地东缘的一个省份，由世袭总督统治。总督特斯法内·伊格齐在1305年称它为自己的王国，其继任者亚伊比卡·伊格齐则反抗皇帝安达·塞永。

皇帝镇压叛乱后，先任命王后比伦·萨巴，后任命儿子巴赫尔·塞格德治理恩德塔。当地总督还监管连接高地与阿法尔低地的盐商队及其税收。

en:
The Kingdom of England took shape in 927, when Athelstan of Wessex united the Anglo-Saxon and Viking realms under one crown. The Norman Conquest of 1066 placed William of Normandy on the throne; in 1154 Henry II founded the Plantagenet line, whose continental lands were largely lost under King John, forced to seal Magna Carta in 1215.

Edward I conquered Wales in 1283; in 1337 Edward III held Gascony and claimed the French throne, opening the Hundred Years' War, and by 1453 England held only Calais on the continent.

The Wars of the Roses ended with Henry VII's Tudor dynasty in 1485; his son Henry VIII broke with Rome in 1534, and Elizabeth I's navy defeated the Spanish Armada in 1588. In 1603 James VI of Scotland inherited the English crown; civil war, the execution of Charles I in 1649 and the Glorious Revolution of 1688 established parliamentary sovereignty, and the 1707 Acts of Union merged England with Scotland into Great Britain.
zh:
英格兰王国成形于927年，威塞克斯的埃塞尔斯坦把盎格鲁-撒克逊诸王国与维京领地统一在一顶王冠之下。1066年诺曼征服使诺曼底的威廉登上王位；1154年亨利二世开创金雀花王朝，其大陆领地在约翰王治下大部丧失，约翰于1215年被迫签署《大宪章》。

爱德华一世在1283年征服威尔士；1337年爱德华三世仍领有加斯科涅并主张法国王位，百年战争由此爆发，到1453年英格兰在大陆只剩加来。

玫瑰战争以亨利七世于1485年建立都铎王朝告终；其子亨利八世在1534年与罗马决裂，伊丽莎白一世的舰队于1588年击败西班牙无敌舰队。1603年苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世继承英格兰王位；内战、1649年查理一世被处决和1688年光荣革命确立了议会主权，1707年的《联合法令》使英格兰与苏格兰合并为大不列颠。

en:
Ennarea, called Hinnario in the Gonga tongue, was a kingdom of the Gibe region in the southwestern Ethiopian highlands, ruled by the Hinnare Bushasho clan. A province of Damot in the thirteenth century, it broke away in the fourteenth century and became the strongest state of the non-Muslim south, reducing Kaffa to a tributary.

From 1578 the Borana Oromo and their Sadacha federation overran the Gibe lands: Ennarea was briefly occupied in 1588, when Emperor Sarsa Dengel marched south and converted its elite to Christianity.

Sadacha attacks continued for more than a century, and in the mid-1600s the royal clan of Kaffa seized power and made Kaffa independent. Around 1710 the Sadacha overran Ennarea under King Shisafotchi, who led his people into exile in Kaffa; Oromo settlers later founded the five Gibe kingdoms on Ennarea's lands.
zh:
恩纳雷亚在贡加语中称欣纳里奥，是埃塞俄比亚西南高原吉贝地区的王国，由欣纳雷·布沙绍氏族统治。它13世纪时是达莫特的一个省，14世纪独立，成为南方非穆斯林地区最强的国家，迫使卡法称臣。

1578年起，博兰奥罗莫人及其萨达查联盟席卷吉贝地区：1588年恩纳雷亚一度被占，同年萨尔萨·丹格尔皇帝南下，使其统治阶层皈依基督教。

萨达查人的进攻持续了一个多世纪；17世纪中叶，卡法的王室氏族夺权，卡法就此独立。约1710年，萨达查人在国王希萨福奇治下灭了恩纳雷亚，希萨福奇率部流亡卡法；定居恩纳雷亚旧地的奥罗莫人后来在那里建立了五个吉贝王国。

en:
The En'ya were a branch of the Sasaki family, named for En'ya in Izumo Province and long established as its governors. En'ya Takasada supported Emperor Go-Daigo against the Kamakura shogunate in 1333, then joined Ashikaga Takauji.

Accused of plotting against the Muromachi government, Takasada fled Kyoto and killed himself in 1341. En'ya Mitsumichi revived the family as shogunal retainers in the early fifteenth century, but the later En'ya were taken over by the Amago in the sixteenth century.
zh:
盐冶氏是佐佐木氏的支族，以出云国的盐冶为名，长期担任出云守护。盐冶高贞于1333年支持后醍醐天皇讨伐镰仓幕府，后来转而追随足利尊氏。

高贞被指谋反，逃离京都后于1341年自尽。15世纪初，盐冶满通以幕府奉公众的身份重兴家门；16世纪，后盐冶氏被尼子氏控制。

en:
The Despotate of Epirus was a Greek successor state of the Byzantine Empire, ruled from Arta on the Ionian coast. After the Fourth Crusade seized Constantinople in 1204, Michael I Komnenos Doukas founded it in 1205 as a refuge for Byzantine Greeks, alongside Nicaea and Trebizond.

His half-brother Theodore Komnenos Doukas built an empire around Thessalonica in 1224 and was crowned emperor, but his bid for Constantinople ended in defeat by the Bulgarians at Klokotnitsa in 1230. Epirus then passed through vassalage to Nicaea and the Palaiologan empire; after the Italian Orsini family seized power in 1318, Emperor Andronikos III reannexed it in 1337.

A despotate under Serbian and then Italian lords revived around Ioannina from 1367, and Carlo I Tocco reunited most of Epirus by 1416. The Ottoman advance swallowed its towns; the last fortress, Vonitsa, fell in 1479.
zh:
伊庇鲁斯专制国是拜占庭的希腊人继承政权，以爱奥尼亚海沿岸的阿尔塔为统治中心。1204年第四次十字军攻占君士坦丁堡后，米哈伊尔一世·科穆宁·杜卡斯于1205年建立此国，收留拜占庭希腊难民，与尼西亚帝国、特拉比松帝国并立。

他的异母弟狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯于1224年在塞萨洛尼基一带建立帝国并加冕为帝，但他收复君士坦丁堡的图谋在1230年的克洛科特尼察之战中被保加利亚人击碎。此后伊庇鲁斯臣属尼西亚和巴列奥略王朝；1318年意大利奥尔西尼家族夺权后，安德洛尼卡三世皇帝于1337年重新兼并该国。

1367年起，以约阿尼纳为中心、由塞尔维亚和意大利贵族先后统治的专制国复兴，卡洛一世·托科于1416年重新统一伊庇鲁斯大部。奥斯曼人逐个吞没其城镇，最后一座要塞沃尼察于1479年陷落。

en:
Eranshahr was the Sasanian Empire's name for its Iranian realm, ruled chiefly from Ctesiphon. Ardashir I founded the empire after defeating the Parthian king Artabanus IV in 224. Sasanian kings promoted Zoroastrianism and fought repeated wars with Rome and its Byzantine successor.

After the Byzantine war of 602–628, civil conflict weakened the empire. The Rashidun Caliphate invaded in 633, and the Sasanians lost their lands west of the Iranian plateau after the battle of al-Qadisiyyah in 636. By 651 most Iranian cities had come under Muslim rule, and the empire had fallen.
zh:
埃兰沙赫尔是萨珊帝国对其伊朗疆域的称呼，帝国主要以泰西封为都。阿尔达希尔一世于224年击败帕提亚国王阿尔达班四世后建立帝国。萨珊诸王扶持祆教，并与罗马及其继承者拜占庭屡次交战。

602—628年的拜占庭战争之后，内战削弱了帝国。正统哈里发国于633年入侵，萨珊在636年的卡迪西亚战役后失去伊朗高原以西的领土。到651年，伊朗大部分城市已受穆斯林统治，帝国也随之灭亡。

en:
The Lordship of Erbach was an Odenwald territory in the valley of the Mümling, ruled by a Rhine Franconian noble house first documented with Eberhard I of Erbach in 1148. The family began as ministeriales who held the bailiwick of Lorsch Abbey, and around 1226 the Wittelsbach counts palatine of the Rhine made them their hereditary cup-bearers, an office the lords of Erbach kept until 1806 and the origin of their title Schenk von Erbach. In the thirteenth century the house split into the Erbach and Reichenberg lines; its water castle at Erbach, where Schenk Conrad ruled in 1337, was first recorded in 1303.

The lords gained a seat among the imperial estates in 1422, and in 1532 Emperor Charles V raised Erbach to an immediate county of the Empire in reward for Count Eberhard's services in the Palatine Peasants' War. The Reformation was introduced throughout the county in 1544. In 1717 the family divided into the Erbach-Fürstenau, Erbach-Erbach and Erbach-Schönberg lines. Under the Rheinbund act of 1806 the county, by then about five hundred square kilometres with some thirty thousand inhabitants, was mediatized, most of it going to the Grand Duchy of Hesse and the remainder to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh:
埃尔巴赫领地是奥登林山米姆灵河谷中的一片领地，统治它的莱茵法兰克贵族家族最早以埃尔巴赫的埃伯哈德一世之名见于1148年的文献。该家族出身家臣，原本担任洛尔施修道院的辖区官；约1226年，维特尔斯巴赫家族的莱茵行宫伯爵把他们变为自家的世袭司酒官，埃尔巴赫领主保有此职直至1806年，“埃尔巴赫司酒”的头衔也由此而来。13世纪，家族分为埃尔巴赫和赖兴贝格两支；其位于埃尔巴赫的水堡最早见于1303年的记载，1337年在位的正是司酒官康拉德。

1422年，领主们取得帝国等级席位；1532年，为酬报埃伯哈德伯爵在普法尔茨农民战争中的功劳，查理五世皇帝将埃尔巴赫升格为帝国直辖伯国。1544年，宗教改革推行到整个伯国。1717年，家族分为埃尔巴赫-菲尔斯滕奥、埃尔巴赫-埃尔巴赫和埃尔巴赫-舍恩贝格三支。根据1806年的《莱茵邦联法案》，这个面积约五百平方公里、人口约三万的伯国被调停瓜分，大部分并入黑森大公国，其余归入巴伐利亚王国。

en:
The Eretnid state ruled central and eastern Anatolia from Sivas and Kayseri between 1335 and 1381. Its founder Eretna was an Ilkhanid officer of Uyghur origin who rose to hold Anatolia as governor under the Jalayirid ruler Hasan Buzurg. After an unexpected victory at the Battle of Karanbük over rival Mongol warlords, he claimed independence and took the title of sultan; his orderly, prosperous rule earned him the nickname Köse Peygamber, the beardless prophet.

Under his son Muhammad I, who ruled from 1352, the emirs grew restive: he was deposed and restored, lost Ankara to the Ottoman Murad I in 1361, and was murdered by his own emirs at Kayseri in 1365.

His young son Ali could not check the local lords and died on campaign in 1380. The seven-year-old Muhammad II Chelebi reigned only months before his regent, the judge Kadi Burhan al-Din, seized the throne in 1381 and brought the Eretnid dynasty to an end.
zh:
埃雷特纳政权于1335至1381年间以锡瓦斯和开塞利为中心，统治安纳托利亚的中部和东部。开国者埃雷特纳是畏兀儿出身的伊儿汗国将领，后来在贾拉伊尔王朝的哈桑·布祖格麾下出任安纳托利亚总督。在卡兰比克战役中出人意料地击败相争的蒙古军阀后，他宣布独立并自称苏丹；其治世安定富庶，为他赢得“无须先知”的绰号。

其子穆罕默德一世1352年继位后，埃米尔们日益跋扈：他一度被废又复辟，1361年安卡拉被奥斯曼的穆拉德一世夺走，1365年在开塞利被自己的埃米尔谋杀。

年幼的儿子阿里无力约束地方领主，于1380年死在征战途中。七岁的穆罕默德二世·切莱比在位仅数月，担任摄政的法官卡迪·布尔汉丁便在1381年篡位，埃雷特纳王朝就此终结。

en:
Erfurt, on the Gera and the great Via Regia road, was first mentioned in 742, when Saint Boniface established a diocese there; in 755 the see was absorbed into the Archdiocese of Mainz. Woad made it the wealthiest of the Thuringian trading towns, and after 1200 a city council emerged, buying nearly a hundred villages under Mainz's overlordship.

Its Jewish community was destroyed in the Black Death pogrom of 1349. The University of Erfurt, founded in 1379, was the earliest founded in the German lands and counted Martin Luther among its students.

Erfurt adopted the Reformation in 1521, but its independence ended in 1664 when Mainz imposed direct rule and built the Petersberg citadel. In 1802 the city passed to Prussia and then became the French Principality of Erfurt, where Napoleon met Tsar Alexander I at the Congress of Erfurt in 1808.
zh:
爱尔福特位于格拉河畔与大道“皇帝之路”上，最早见于742年圣博尼法设立教区的记载；755年该教区并入美因茨大主教区。菘蓝贸易使它成为图林根最富庶的商贸城市，1200年后市议会形成，在美因茨宗主权下陆续购入近百个村庄。

当地犹太社区在1349年黑死病排犹屠杀中被毁。1379年创立的爱尔福特大学是德意志地区最早建立的大学，马丁·路德曾在此求学。

爱尔福特于1521年接受宗教改革；1664年美因茨实行直接统治并修建彼得斯贝格要塞，城市独立告终。1802年它划归普鲁士，随后成为法国治下的爱尔福特亲王国，1808年拿破仑与沙皇亚历山大一世在此召开爱尔福特会议。

en:
The Erielhonan, or Erie, were a loose confederacy of Iroquoian communities southeast of Lake Erie, in what is now western New York and northwestern Pennsylvania. Their fortified villages sheltered families who grew maize, beans and squash.

In 1654 Seneca and Onondaga forces attacked an Erie fort during the Beaver Wars. By 1656 the Erie confederacy had collapsed; many survivors were taken captive and absorbed into Haudenosaunee communities.
zh:
伊利霍南人又称伊利人，是伊利湖东南岸一个松散的易洛魁语族社区联盟，位于今纽约西部和宾夕法尼亚西北部。他们居住在设有围栅的村庄，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。

1654年，塞内卡和奥农达加军队在海狸战争中进攻一座伊利堡垒。到1656年，伊利联盟已经瓦解；许多幸存者被俘，融入豪德诺索尼社区。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Warmia, or Ermland, was the most independent of the four Prussian bishoprics founded by papal legate William of Modena in 1243. Its cathedral chapter, constituted in 1260 and seated at Frombork, stayed independent of the Teutonic Order, freely electing its bishops, later recognized as prince-bishops.

For more than two centuries Warmia was a protectorate of the Teutonic state, but in 1440 its estates joined the Prussian Confederation and in 1454 asked Poland for protection. The Second Peace of Thorn in 1466, after the Thirteen Years' War, confirmed it as Polish; a later election dispute kindled the War of the Priests, settled for Poland in 1479.

Warmia became a centre of learning, where Nicolaus Copernicus worked at Frombork as a canon. The First Partition of Poland in 1772 delivered Warmia to Prussia, which secularized the prince-bishopric in 1773 and folded it into East Prussia.
zh:
瓦尔米亚采邑主教区又称埃尔姆兰，是1243年教皇使节摩德纳的威廉在普鲁士设立的四个主教区中最独立的一个。它的主教座堂参事会1260年成立，驻于弗龙堡，始终保持对条顿骑士团的独立，可自由选举主教，主教后来获称采邑主教。

两个多世纪里，瓦尔米亚是条顿国家的保护领，但1440年其贵族和城镇加入普鲁士邦联，并于1454年请求波兰保护。十三年战争后，1466年的《第二次托伦和约》确认它归属波兰；后来的选举争执引发教士战争，1479年以波兰获胜告终。

瓦尔米亚成为学术中心，哥白尼曾作为参事在弗龙堡工作。1772年第一次瓜分波兰使瓦尔米亚落入普鲁士之手，1773年这个主教邦被世俗化，并入东普鲁士。

en:
Essen was the territory of Essen Abbey, a foundation of secular canonesses on the Ruhr. The Saxon cleric Altfrid founded it around 845, and under Ottonian patronage it gained imperial immediacy. Its golden age came under Abbess Mathilde, granddaughter of Otto I, who ruled from 973 to 1011 and enriched the minster with treasures including the Golden Madonna.

From 1228 the abbesses bore the title of princess, ruling their lands and repeatedly defeating Essen's attempts to become a free imperial city. In 1337 Katharina von der Mark, daughter of Count Engelbert II of the Mark, was elected princess-abbess, securing an imperial confirmation of the abbey's rights from Charles IV in 1357.

Its protectors passed from Berg and Mark to Cleves and, after 1609, to Brandenburg. Prussian troops occupied it in 1802 and the abbey was dissolved in 1803, its lands returning to Prussia in 1813.
zh:
埃森是埃森女修院的领地，这座鲁尔河畔的修院由世俗修女组成。撒克逊教士阿尔特弗里德约于845年创建修院；在奥托皇朝的庇护下，它获得帝国直辖地位。修院的黄金时代在院长玛蒂尔德任内，她是奥托一世的孙女，973至1011年主持修院，为教堂积累了包括黄金圣母像在内的礼器。

1228年起，修院院长获封亲王头衔，屡次挫败埃森成为帝国自由城市的企图。1337年，马克伯爵恩格爾贝特二世之女卡特琳娜·冯·德·马克当选亲王女院长，并于1357年取得皇帝卡尔四世对修院各项权利的帝国确认。

护院领主先后由贝格与马克、克莱沃以及1609年后的勃兰登堡担任。1802年普鲁士军队占领修院，1803年修院被解散，其领地1813年重回普鲁士。

en:
The County of Étampes lay in the Hurepoix, south of Paris on the edge of the Beauce, an appanage of the French crown. Philip III gave the lordship to his younger son Louis of Évreux; it was raised to a county in 1327 under Louis's son Charles d'Évreux, who died in 1336 leaving infant Louis I.

Louis fought in the Hundred Years' War, was captured at the Battle of Poitiers in 1356 and later served as one of the royal hostages guaranteeing the Treaty of Brétigny. He died childless in 1400, and the county passed to John, Duke of Berry; Burgundian troops seized the town in 1411 before the county reverted to the royal domain.

In 1536 Francis I made Étampes a duchy for his mistress Anne de Pisseleu, and the town was badly damaged by royal troops during the Fronde in 1652.
zh:
埃唐普伯国位于巴黎以南、博斯边缘的于尔普瓦，是法兰西王室的封邑。腓力三世把这片领地封给幼子埃夫勒的路易；1327年，在路易之子埃夫勒的查理治下，它被升为伯国。查理于1336年去世，继承人路易一世尚在襁褓之中。

路易一世参加了百年战争，1356年在普瓦捷战役中被俘，后来又成为保证《布勒丁尼条约》履行的王家人质之一。他于1400年去世且无嗣，伯国转入贝里公爵约翰手中；1411年勃艮第军队攻占埃唐普城，此后伯国又重归王室领地。

1536年，弗朗索瓦一世把埃唐普升为公国，封给宠姬安妮·德·皮瑟勒；1652年投石党战争期间，该城遭到王军严重破坏。

en:
The Ethiopian Empire, long known abroad as Abyssinia, was the Christian highland state of the Horn of Africa. In 1270 Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe dynasty and founded the Solomonic line, whose kings claimed descent from King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. In 1337 the throne belonged to Amda Seyon I, who reigned from 1314 to 1344: when the Sultanate of Ifat seized his envoy, he invaded, killed Sultan Haqq ad-Din I and sacked the Ifat capital, tilting the Horn toward the Christian highlanders for two centuries. The long reign of Zara Yaqob from 1434 to 1468 marked the empire's peak, as he replaced regional warlords with imperial officials and founded churches and monasteries across the land.

In the early sixteenth century the Adalite imam Ahmed Gran, backed by the Ottomans, overran most of the empire until Portuguese musketeers helped defeat him in 1543. The wars and the Oromo migrations that followed cost Ethiopia its southern provinces and its Red Sea coast. Recovery came under Fasilides, who in 1636 founded Gondar as a permanent capital, opening the Gondarine age of palaces, church building and painting around Lake Tana. After the death of Iyasu the Great in 1706 the crown weakened, and from 1769 the Zemene Mesafint, the Era of the Princes, left the emperors puppets of rival ras warlords around Gondar, a fragmentation that still defined the empire in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
埃塞俄比亚帝国在国外旧称阿比西尼亚，是非洲之角的基督教高原国家。1270年，耶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝，建立所罗门王朝，历代国王自称是所罗门王与示巴女王的后裔。1337年在位的是阿姆达·塞翁一世，他于1314至1344年统治：伊法特苏丹国扣押他的使节，他便挥师入侵，杀死苏丹哈克·丁一世并洗劫伊法特都城，使此后两百年间非洲之角的天平倒向基督教高原一方。1434至1468年扎拉·雅各布的漫长统治是帝国的顶峰，他以帝国官吏取代地方军阀，在各地广建教堂和修道院。

16世纪初，阿达尔的伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰在奥斯曼人支持下攻陷帝国大部，直到1543年葡萄牙火枪手协助将其击败。连年战争和随后的奥罗莫人迁徙，使埃塞俄比亚丧失了南方诸省和红海沿岸。复兴始于法西利德斯，他于1636年定都贡德尔，开启了贡德尔时代，塔纳湖周围宫殿林立、教堂广建、绘画兴盛。1706年伊亚苏大帝死后王权转弱，1769年起进入泽梅内·梅萨芬特，即王子时代，皇帝沦为贡德尔周围相互争战的拉斯军阀手中的傀儡；这种分裂局面一直延续到19世纪初。

en:
Etzatlan, recorded by the first Spaniards as Itzatlan, was a town in the Valles region of western Jalisco, its Nahuatl name read either as place of the Itzas or as the place of bloodied water. Before the conquest its valley had passed under Tarascan power after ten years of border wars, and by 1524 its settlements held Mexica and Toltec communities alongside Caxcan and Chichimeca groups.

In that year Francisco Cortes de San Buenaventura received the submission of the senorio of Etzatlan and assigned it as an encomienda; Nuno de Guzman followed in 1530. A Franciscan convent was begun in 1534, and the town received the rank of villa in 1537.

During the Mixton War of 1541 Pedro de Alvarado passed through, and the friar Juan Calero, killed in the rising, was buried in the Etzatlan convent.
zh:
埃察特兰在最早的西班牙文献中记作伊察特兰，是哈利斯科西部巴列斯地区的一座城镇，其纳瓦特尔语名称或解作“伊察人之地”，或解作“血水之地”。征服之前，经过十年边境战争，这处山谷已落入塔拉斯科人之手；到1524年，境内各聚落除卡克斯坎人和奇奇梅克群体外，还住着墨西卡人和托尔特克人。

1524年，弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉接受了埃察特兰领地的归降，将其封为监护领地，1530年努尼奥·德·古斯曼又接踵而至。方济各会修道院于1534年动工，1537年城镇获封西班牙式城镇名号。

1541年米斯特顿战争期间，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多途经此地，在起义中殉道的修士胡安·卡莱罗就葬在埃察特兰修道院。

en: The Eudeve were an Opatan people of Sonora in northwestern Mexico, speaking a language closely related to Opata. In the sixteenth century the Opatan valleys contained independent farming towns supported by irrigation.
zh: 尤德韦人是墨西哥西北部索诺拉的奥帕塔族群，所说语言与奥帕塔语关系密切。16世纪，奥帕塔地区的河谷中分布着依靠灌溉农业的独立城镇。

en:
The Eufaula were a Muskogean-speaking people of the Creek Confederacy, with settlements along the Chattahoochee River. Lower Creek Eufaula had settled there by 1733, while their Upper Creek counterparts counted Yoholo Micco among their leaders.

In 1825 Yoholo Micco went to Washington to contest the cession of Creek lands, but the Treaty of Indian Springs forced further losses. In 1836 Eufaula people were driven west toward Indian Territory along with other Creeks.
zh:
尤福拉是克里克联盟中说马斯科吉语族语言的族群，在查特胡奇河沿岸有聚落。下克里克的尤福拉人至迟在1733年已在那里定居，而上克里克的尤福拉领袖中有约霍洛·米科。

1825年，约霍洛·米科前往华盛顿反对割让克里克土地，但《印第安斯普林斯条约》仍迫使他们失去更多土地。1836年，尤福拉人和其他克里克人被迫向西迁往印第安领地。

en: Europa is a name for Europe, the continent between the Atlantic and Asia. Charlemagne united much of western and central Europe under Frankish rule and was crowned emperor in Rome in 800.
zh: 欧罗巴是欧洲的名称，指大西洋与亚洲之间的大陆。查理曼在法兰克人的统治下统一了西欧和中欧的大部，并于800年在罗马加冕为皇帝。

en: The Evens were Tungusic-speaking communities of northeastern Siberia, including reindeer herders near the Sea of Okhotsk. In the seventeenth century they included the Lamut and other clans as well as settled Arman speakers.
zh: 鄂温人是西伯利亚东北部讲通古斯语的族群，其中包括鄂霍次克海附近的驯鹿牧民。17世纪的鄂温人包括拉穆特等氏族和定居的阿尔曼语人群。

en:
The Evenk were Tungusic peoples spread across Siberia and the Amur basin. The Solon along the Amur bred horses, while Evenk farther north herded reindeer.

In 1639 the Solon leader Bombogor fought Qing forces at Gualar with Evenk and Daur followers. Captured and executed in 1640, he was the last leader of that resistance; the Qing incorporated Evenk and other local peoples into the Eight Banners.
zh:
鄂温克人是分布在西伯利亚和黑龙江流域的通古斯语族人群。黑龙江沿岸的索伦人饲养马匹，更北方的鄂温克人则饲养驯鹿。
