1639年，索伦首领博穆博果尔率鄂温克和达斡尔部众在瓜拉尔与清军交战。他于1640年被俘处死，这场抵抗随之瓦解；清朝将鄂温克等当地人编入八旗。

en:
The County of Évreux was a royal fief in Normandy, centred on Évreux. At the end of the thirteenth century Philip III granted it as an appanage to his younger son Louis, who founded the Capetian House of Évreux.

His son Philip inherited the county in 1319, married Joan, daughter of King Louis X, and in 1328 the couple succeeded to the Kingdom of Navarre as Philip III and Joan II, ending Navarre's forty-four-year personal union with France. In 1337 Évreux was thus ruled by a king of Navarre and powerful Valois vassal; Philip died in 1343 while on crusade against Granada.

His son Charles II, called the Bad, intrigued against the French crown until Charles V seized his Évreux lands in 1378. Charles III exchanged Évreux for the Duchy of Nemours in 1404, returning it to the royal domain.
zh:
埃夫勒伯国是诺曼底境内的王室封邑，以埃夫勒为中心。13世纪末，国王腓力三世的幼子路易受封埃夫勒，开创了卡佩王朝的埃夫勒支系。

他的儿子腓力于1319年继承伯国，又娶国王路易十世之女让娜为妻；1328年，夫妇二人一同继承纳瓦拉王位，称腓力三世与让娜二世，结束了纳瓦拉与法兰西四十四年的共主邦联。因此1337年，埃夫勒的统治者是纳瓦拉国王，也是瓦卢瓦王室的强大封臣；腓力三世于1343年在征讨格拉纳达的十字军途中病逝。

他的儿子恶人查理二世一再与法兰西王室勾斗争权，1378年查理五世没收了他在埃夫勒的领地。1404年卡洛斯三世以埃夫勒换取内穆尔公国，伯国重归王室领地。

en:
The County of Everstein was a lordship built from allodial lands in the Weser hills between Höxter, Holzminden and Hameln. Kinsmen and clients of the Hohenstaufen, the family took its name in 1116 from its two castles above Holzminden, and it rose after the fall of Henry the Lion in 1180, when Albrecht III entered the service of the Archbishop of Cologne.

When the Staufer collapsed, the Welfs forced the sale of Everstein Castle in 1284, and the counts moved to Polle; around 1335 they had to surrender Ohsen Castle to Brunswick-Lüneburg.

The end came through the Everstein succession feud of 1405 to 1407: after Count Hermann VII's only son died, his inheritance treaty with Lippe was overridden by the Welfs, and in 1408 the county with Polle Castle passed to Brunswick-Lüneburg. A Pomeranian branch, Eberstein-Naugard, survived until 1663.
zh:
埃弗施泰因伯国是埃弗施泰因伯爵家族在赫克斯特、霍尔茨明登和哈默尔恩之间的威悉山地，以自家世袭领地建立的小型领邦。该家族是霍亨斯陶芬家族的亲族和附庸，1116年以霍尔茨明登上方的两座城堡得名；1180年狮子亨利倒台后它趁势崛起，埃弗施泰因的阿尔布雷希特三世投身科隆大主教麾下。

霍亨斯陶芬王朝覆灭后，韦尔夫家族于1284年强迫他们出售埃弗施泰因城堡，伯爵家族遂迁往波勒；约1335年，他们又被迫把奥克森城堡交给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵。

终局来自1405至1407年的埃弗施泰因继承纷争：伯爵赫尔曼七世的独子夭折后，他与利珀订立的继承条约被韦尔夫家族推翻，1408年，伯国连同波勒城堡一并落入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡之手。家族在波美拉尼亚的支系埃伯施泰因-瑙加德一直延续到1663年。

en:
Ewyas was a marcher lordship in the hills where Herefordshire meets Wales, running from the Vale of Ewyas in the Black Mountains to Longtown. It began as a Welsh commote, and around 1046 Osbern Pentecost raised one of the earliest motte-and-bailey castles in Britain at Ewyas Harold.

The de Lacy family then held it as a largely autonomous marcher lordship, building Longtown Castle after 1216. When the de Lacy line failed in 1241, the inheritance passed through the Verdun family, and Elizabeth de Verdun carried Ewyas to her husband Bartholomew Burghersh, who held it in 1337.

Longtown Castle had decayed by the fourteenth century but was briefly reoccupied during Owain Glyndwr's rising in 1403. Under the Laws in Wales Acts of 1536 the lordship was dissolved: Ewyas Lacy was absorbed into Herefordshire and the Vale of Ewyas into Monmouthshire.
zh:
尤亚斯是赫里福德郡与威尔士交界处山区的边境领主领，从布莱克山的尤亚斯谷一直延伸到朗敦。它最初是威尔士人的康莫特，约1046年奥斯本·彭蒂科斯特在尤亚斯哈罗德建起不列颠最早的土岗城郭式城堡之一。

德·莱西家族后来以近乎自治的边境领形式持有此地，并在1216年后修建朗敦城堡。1241年德·莱西家族绝嗣，遗产经韦尔登家族传承，伊丽莎白·德·韦尔登把尤亚斯带给丈夫巴塞洛缪·伯格斯，1337年由他领有此地。

到14世纪朗敦城堡已趋荒废，但在1403年欧文·格林杜尔起义期间曾被短暂重新启用。根据1536年的《威尔士法令》，该领主领被撤销：尤亚斯莱西并入赫里福德郡，尤亚斯谷则划入蒙茅斯郡。

en:
Fabriano was a commune in the Esino valley of the Italian Marche, formed from two fortified settlements and established as a free commune in 1234. Its paper mills, recorded from 1276, helped make the town prosperous during the later Middle Ages.

In 1378 the Chiavelli family imposed its lordship over Fabriano. After the family was massacred in 1435, Francesco Sforza ruled the town until 1444, when it passed to the Papal States.
zh:
法布里亚诺是意大利马尔凯埃西诺河谷的一个公社，由两座设防聚落合并而成，1234年成为自由公社。当地的造纸业最迟在1276年已有记载，推动了中世纪晚期的繁荣。

1378年，基亚韦利家族在法布里亚诺建立领主统治。1435年该家族遭到屠杀后，弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎统治此地至1444年，随后法布里亚诺并入教宗国。

en:
Faenza, the Roman Faventia, stands on the Lamone River in Romagna on the Via Emilia. In 774 Charlemagne granted it to the Papal States, but in the communal age it governed itself as a Guelph town and member of the Lombard League, enduring sieges by Frederick II.

From 1319 the Manfredi family made themselves signori, their rule interrupted by direct papal government; Riccardo Manfredi held the lordship around 1337. The family kept Faenza independent until Astorre III was driven out by Cesare Borgia in 1501, and after a brief restoration in 1503 the city was absorbed into the Papal States.

Faenza won fame for its glazed maiolica pottery, so widely exported that faience derives from the city's name. Napoleonic armies swept away papal rule in 1797, and the Congress of Vienna returned it to the Papal States in 1815.
zh:
法恩扎古称罗马时代的法文提亚，位于罗马涅的拉莫内河畔，在艾米利亚大道上。774年查理曼将该城赠予教皇国，但在自治公社时代它作为圭尔夫派城市和伦巴第联盟成员自行治理，曾顶住腓特烈二世军队的围攻。

1319年起曼弗雷迪家族成为城市的领主，其统治几度被教皇直接管辖打断，1337年前后由里卡尔多·曼弗雷迪在位。该家族维持法恩扎的独立，直到1501年阿斯托雷三世被切萨雷·博尔贾驱逐；1503年短暂复辟后并入教皇国。

法恩扎以锡釉彩陶闻名，远销各地，欧洲语言中的“法恩斯陶”（faience）一词便源自该城之名。1797年拿破仑的军队终结了教皇统治，1815年维也纳会议又把它交还教皇国。

en: Fal was the coastal district around the town of Fal on the hot Garmsirat plain of southern Fars, part of medieval Laristan; its port of Siraf had been a great Sasanian and early Islamic trading city before earthquakes ruined it around the year 970. By the fourteenth century it was a small tribal polity overshadowed by its powerful neighbour, the Kingdom of Hormuz.
zh: 法勒是法尔斯南部炎热的加尔姆西拉特平原上以法勒镇为中心的沿海地区，属中世纪拉里斯坦的一部分；其港口锡拉夫曾是萨珊王朝和早期伊斯兰时代的贸易重镇，约970年毁于地震。到14世纪，它是一个受制于强邻霍尔木兹王国的小部族政权。

en:
The County of Freiburg grew out of the Zähringen inheritance: when the Zähringen dukes died out in 1218, Count Egino of Urach, whose mother was Agnes of Zähringen, took Freiburg and the Breisgau and styled himself count. Founded by the Zähringer as a free market town in 1120, the city drew wealth from its silver mines on the Schauinsland; in 1327 it began minting the Rappenpfennig.

In a feud against Count Egino II the burghers battered down his castle on the Schloßberg with catapults, and in 1299 they killed his brother-in-law Conrad of Lichtenberg, Prince-Bishop of Strasbourg, afterwards paying an annual silver tribute of 300 marks.

In 1368 Freiburg ransomed itself under Habsburg protection. The counts kept only their Badenweiler estates, until the last, Johann, bequeathed them to the margraves of Hachberg-Sausenberg in 1444.
zh:
弗赖堡伯国源自策林根家族的遗产：1218年策林根公爵绝嗣，母亲是策林根的阿格妮丝的乌拉赫伯爵埃吉诺取得弗赖堡和布赖斯高，自称伯爵。城市1120年由策林根家族建为自由集市镇，绍因斯兰山的银矿带来财富；1327年起铸造拉本芬尼银币。

在与埃吉诺二世伯爵的冲突中，市民用投石机摧毁了他在城堡山上的城堡，1299年又杀死了他的姻亲、斯特拉斯堡采邑主教利希滕贝格的康拉德，此后每年缴纳300马克白银作为赎罪金。

1368年城市赎身，转投哈布斯堡保护。伯爵们只保留巴登韦勒领地，末代约翰于1444年将其遗赠哈赫贝格-绍森贝格藩侯。

en:
The Free County of Burgundy, later called Franche-Comté, lay east of the Saône across from the Duchy of Burgundy, ruled from Dole while Besançon remained a free imperial city. The county formed in 982 around the domains of Count Otto-William and passed with the Kingdom of Arles to Emperor Conrad II in 1032; its rulers held the German title of Freigraf, or free count, from which Franche-Comté derives.

From 1295 French influence grew; in 1330 it passed to Joan III, daughter of Philip V of France, whose marriage to Odo IV of Burgundy joined it to the duchy in personal union until 1361.

Valois-Burgundy ruled it from 1405 until Charles the Bold died in 1477 and France occupied it; the Treaty of Senlis in 1493 returned it to the Habsburgs. France conquered it in 1674, and the Treaties of Nijmegen in 1678 made its rule permanent.
zh:
勃艮第自由伯国后称弗朗什‑孔泰，位于索恩河以东，与勃艮第公国隔河相望；伯爵以多勒为治所，贝桑松则为自由帝国城市。伯国982年围绕奥托-威廉的领地形成，1032年随阿尔勒王国并入康拉德二世的帝国；其统治者拥有德语“自由伯爵”头衔，弗朗什‑孔泰之名即由此而来。

1295年起法兰西影响日深，1330年伯国传给法兰西国王腓力五世之女让娜三世，她嫁给勃艮第公爵厄德四世，使伯国与公爵领结成共主邦联，维持到1361年。

1405至1477年由瓦卢瓦-勃艮第家族统治；大胆的查理死后法兰西随即出兵占领，1493年的《桑利斯条约》又把它归还哈布斯堡家族。1674年法国征服伯国，1678年的《奈梅亨条约》使其统治永久化。

en:
Firceall was a Gaelic Irish territory in the south-west of the ancient Kingdom of Meath, centred on Tullamore in what is now County Offaly. Its ruling family, the O'Molloys, claimed descent from Niall of the Nine Hostages, the high king of Tara, and the name Firceall means Men of the Churches, reflecting the many abbeys and monastic churches founded at Rahan, Lynally and Kilcormac.

The territory bordered Éile to the south and Uí Failghe to the east. Its chieftains kept their independence through the later Middle Ages.

When the midlands were shired under Mary I in 1556 and planted in the decades that followed, Firceall was broken into the baronies of Ballycowan, Ballyboy and Eglish within the new King's County, and the O'Molloys lost their ancient lordship.
zh:
菲斯卡尔是古米斯王国西南部的一块盖尔人领地，以今奥法利郡境内的塔拉莫尔为中心。统治这里的奥莫洛伊家族自称是塔拉至高王“九质之尼尔”的后裔；“菲斯卡尔”一名意为“教会之人”，得名于拉汉、利纳利和基尔科马克等地众多的修道院与教堂。

该地南接埃伊尔，东邻乌伊法尔格。其酋长在中世纪后期一直保持着独立。

1556年玛丽一世将中部地区设郡、随后开展殖民垦置，菲斯卡尔被划入新设的国王郡，拆成巴利考恩、巴利博伊和埃格利什三个男爵领，奥莫洛伊家族也丧失了世袭的首领之位。

en:
The Al Fadl were an Arab Bedouin dynasty of the Syrian steppe and the senior branch of the Banu Rabi'ah. Their ancestor Fadl, son of the emir Rabi'ah, led auxiliaries for Damascus atabegs in the twelfth century; driven from the Hauran by their cousins the Al Mira, they moved north to Homs pastures.

Under the Ayyubids and Mamluks their emirs made the office of amir al-arab, commander of the Bedouin of northern Syria, hereditary; Sultan Baybars confirmed Isa ibn Muhanna in the post after 1260. In 1337 the reigning emir Musa ibn Muhanna, who had succeeded his father in 1335, stood so high in Sultan an-Nasir Muhammad's favour that Musa received a fief worth a million dirhams in exchange for one Arabian horse. Musa died in 1341, and his descendants kept the office through the fourteenth century.

The Ottomans conquered Syria in 1516 and preserved the emirate, but in the later sixteenth century the leading Al Fadl house joined the Mawali confederation. By the eighteenth century the Mawali had given way before the Anazzah.
zh:
法德勒是叙利亚草原上的阿拉伯贝都因世家，为巴努·拉比阿的长支。先祖法德勒是埃米尔拉比阿之子，12世纪曾率骑兵辅助大马士革阿塔贝格；被同宗的米拉人逐出豪兰后，他们北迁到霍姆斯牧场。

在阿尤布和马穆鲁克王朝治下，其埃米尔使北叙利亚贝都因统帅阿拉伯埃米尔一职世代相传，1260年后苏丹拜巴尔斯确认伊萨·伊本·穆海纳担任此职。1337年在位的穆萨·伊本·穆海纳1335年承袭父职，深受苏丹纳绥尔·穆罕默德宠信，竟得到岁入一百万迪尔汗银币的封地，代价只是他的一匹阿拉伯良马。穆萨1341年去世，后裔在整个14世纪仍保有该职。

奥斯曼人1516年征服叙利亚并保留埃米尔国，但16世纪后期，法德勒的主支加入马瓦利联盟。到18世纪，马瓦利又在阿纳扎人面前失势。

en:
Feltre was a town and territory in the southern Alps, near the Piave River in northern Italy. After rule by Ezzelino da Romano and the da Camino family, it belonged to the Scaliger lords of Verona from 1315 to 1337.

The Carrara and Visconti families later held Feltre before Venice took it with Belluno in 1404. Fighting between Venice and the League of Cambrai devastated the town centre in 1509; it was rebuilt under Venetian rule and passed to Austria after the Napoleonic wars.
zh:
费尔特雷是意大利北部南阿尔卑斯山区的一座城镇及其领地，位于皮亚韦河附近。它先后受埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺和达卡米诺家族统治，1315—1337年属于维罗纳的斯卡利杰里家族。

此后卡拉拉和维斯孔蒂家族先后占有费尔特雷，1404年威尼斯夺取了费尔特雷和贝卢诺。1509年威尼斯与康布雷同盟的战事摧毁了大部分市中心；城镇在威尼斯统治下重建，拿破仑战争后转归奥地利。

en:
The Principality of Theodoro, also called Gothia, was a small Greek-speaking state in the mountains of southern Crimea and the last surviving fragment of the Byzantine world, with its capital at Mangup. It grew out of the Byzantine theme of Cherson after the Mongol invasion of 1238 left the Crimean highlands autonomous under a light tribute.

The principality's Gabras princes ruled a population of Crimean Goths alongside Greeks. The principality paid tribute to the Golden Horde and fought the coastal Genoese colonies for control of Crimean harbours; after Timur's raid of 1395 it recovered as a minor Black Sea power in the fifteenth century.

One of its princes, Stephen, moved to Moscow around 1402, where his family founded the Simonov Monastery. The Ottomans ended it in 1475, when Gedik Ahmed Pasha stormed Mangup and carried off its last prince.
zh:
狄奥多罗公国又称哥提亚，是克里米亚南部山区一个讲希腊语的小国，也是拜占庭世界最后残存的碎片，都城是曼古普。1238年蒙古入侵后，克里米亚高地在轻微的贡赋义务下自行其是，公国便从拜占庭赫尔松军区脱胎而生。

狄奥多罗的加夫拉斯王朝治下居民有克里米亚哥特人和希腊人。公国向金帐汗国纳贡，又为争夺港口与沿海热那亚殖民地冲突；1395年帖木儿袭击后它恢复元气，在15世纪成为黑海小强权。

约1402年，王公斯捷潘迁居莫斯科，其后人在那里修建了西蒙诺夫修道院。1475年奥斯曼人终结了它的独立，格迪克·艾哈迈德帕沙攻陷曼古普，掳走末代王公。

en:
Ferrara lies on a branch of the Po in Emilia. The Lombards took it from the Exarchate of Ravenna in 753, the Franks granting it to the Papacy; after Canossa rule it became a free commune on Matilda of Tuscany's death in 1115.

The Este family backed the winning faction, and in 1264 Obizzo II d'Este was made lifelong lord, adding Modena in 1288 and Reggio in 1289. In 1337 Obizzo III d'Este held the signory; his descendants made the court brilliant in Renaissance Italy: Borso d'Este became Duke of Ferrara in 1471, Ercole I commissioned the Erculean Addition plan of 1484.

When the main Este line failed in 1597, Pope Clement VIII took Ferrara under papal rule, the family keeping Modena and Reggio. It remained a papal legation until French entry in 1796, and the Congress of Vienna returned it to the Papal States in 1815.
zh:
费拉拉位于艾米利亚的波河支流畔。753年伦巴第人从拉文纳总督区夺取该城，法兰克人旋即将它赠予教皇；一度归卡诺萨统治，1115年托斯卡纳女伯爵玛蒂尔达去世后成为自由公社。

埃斯特家族在城市党争中押对了阵营，1264年奥比佐二世·德斯特被推举为终身领主，又于1288年和1289年先后取得摩德纳与雷焦。1337年奥比佐三世·德斯特执政，其后裔把宫廷经营成文艺复兴意大利的重要中心：博尔索·德斯特于1471年成为费拉拉公爵，埃尔科莱一世于1484年下令实施“埃尔科莱扩建”规划。

1597年埃斯特嫡系绝嗣，克雷芒八世将费拉拉收归教皇直接统治，家族保留摩德纳和雷焦。此后它为教皇代牧区，直至1796年法军进入；1815年维也纳会议将其交还教皇国。

en:
The kingdom of Fez was a Moroccan state ruled from Fez by the Zenata Berber Wattasid dynasty. The Wattasids had served as viziers to the Marinids, whose last sultan was killed in a revolt in Fez in 1465. Muhammad al-Sheikh established Wattasid rule, but controlled only northern Morocco, while the south was divided among principalities.

The Saadi dynasty gained power in the south and captured Fez. In 1554 the Wattasid Abu Hassun briefly recovered the city, but was defeated and killed by the Saadis, who brought the Wattasid dynasty to an end.
zh:
非斯王国是以非斯为中心的摩洛哥政权，由泽纳塔柏柏尔人的瓦塔斯王朝统治。瓦塔斯家族曾担任马林王朝的维齐尔，马林王朝最后一位苏丹于1465年在非斯的起义中被杀。穆罕默德·谢赫建立了瓦塔斯统治，但只控制摩洛哥北部，南部则分属多个小邦。

萨阿德王朝在南方兴起，随后攻占非斯。1554年，瓦塔斯家族的阿布·哈松短暂收复该城，但被萨阿德军队击败并杀死，瓦塔斯王朝随之灭亡。

en:
Finland was the eastern part of the Kingdom of Sweden before becoming an autonomous grand duchy under Russia. In 1581 King John III adopted the title Grand Duke of Finland, but the title brought no separate autonomy.

Russia invaded in 1808 during the Finnish War. At the Diet of Porvoo in 1809, Alexander I promised to uphold Finland's laws and religion; the Treaty of Fredrikshamn later that year transferred the territory from Sweden to Russia. In 1812 the grand duchy acquired Old Finland, territory previously ceded by Sweden to Russia.
zh:
芬兰原是瑞典王国的东部地区，后来成为俄国治下的自治大公国。1581年，瑞典国王约翰三世采用芬兰大公的头衔，但这一头衔没有赋予芬兰独立的自治权。

1808年，俄国在芬兰战争中入侵芬兰。1809年，亚历山大一世在波尔沃议会上承诺维护芬兰的法律和宗教；同年晚些时候，《弗雷德里克斯港条约》将这片土地从瑞典割让给俄国。1812年，大公国获得了瑞典此前割让给俄国的旧芬兰地区。

en: Franconia was a region along the Main where a medieval German duchy fragmented after Duke Eberhard's defeat in 939. In 1500 the eastern part of the former duchy became the Franconian Circle of the Holy Roman Empire, while the bishops of Würzburg claimed the ducal title.
zh: 法兰克尼亚是美因河沿岸的地区，其中世纪德意志公国在公爵埃伯哈德于939年战败后分裂。1500年，旧公国东部成为神圣罗马帝国的法兰克尼亚行政圈，维尔茨堡主教则声称拥有公爵头衔。

en:
The County of Flanders grew from small lands around Bruges into one of medieval Europe's richest lordships, its wealth built on the cloth trade. Its first count Baldwin I received it from the West Frankish king Charles the Bald in 862.

Under the Dampierre dynasty, Count Guy clashed with King Philip IV: town militias won the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, but the 1305 Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge cost it Lille and other towns. In 1337 Louis I of Dampierre still ruled it as a French fief. His granddaughter Margaret married the Burgundian duke Philip the Bold, and in 1384 Flanders passed to the Valois dukes of Burgundy.

In 1482 it passed to the Habsburgs, and the Pragmatic Sanction of 1549 made it one of the Seventeen Provinces. Reconquered for Spain in the Eighty Years' War, its southern strip was ceded to France in 1678; the rest passed to the Austrian Habsburgs, then to France in 1795 and Belgium after 1830.
zh:
佛兰德伯国从布鲁日周边的小块土地发展为中世纪欧洲最富庶的领地之一，财富来自呢绒贸易。862年，西法兰克国王秃头查理将这片土地封给第一代伯爵博杜安一世。

当皮埃尔家族的居伊伯爵与国王腓力四世冲突，市民武装于1302年赢得金马刺战役，但1305年的《阿蒂斯条约》使佛兰德失去里尔等城镇。1337年当皮埃尔家族的路易一世仍以法兰西封邑的身份统治此地。他的孙女玛格丽特嫁给勃艮第公爵勇敢的腓力，佛兰德遂于1384年转入瓦卢瓦家族的勃艮第公爵之手。

1482年它归哈布斯堡家族，1549年的《国事诏书》将其定为十七省之一。八十年战争期间它被西班牙重新征服，南部地带于1678年割让给法兰西；其余部分先归奥地利哈布斯堡家族，1795年并入法兰西，1830年后并入比利时。

en:
Fulda was a Benedictine monastery and ecclesiastical principality on the river of the same name, founded in 744 by Saint Sturm, a disciple of Saint Boniface.

When Boniface was martyred in Frisia in 754, his body was brought back to Fulda, making it one of Germany's foremost pilgrimage sites and centres of learning; the Annals of Fulda, a chief source for ninth-century Carolingian history, were compiled in its scriptorium.

In 1221 the abbot was granted an imperial estate, and Fulda became a princely abbey whose ruler sat as a prince of the Holy Roman Empire. In 1356 Emperor Charles IV added the honorific title of Archchancellor of the Empress to the prince-abbot's dignities. In 1752 Fulda was raised to a prince-bishopric, until the monastery was dissolved in 1802 and the principality secularized in 1803.
zh:
富尔达是同名河畔的本笃会修道院兼教会邦国，744年由圣博尼法的弟子圣斯图姆创立。

754年博尼法在弗里斯兰殉道后，遗体被运回富尔达，使这座修道院成为德意志最重要的朝圣地与学术中心之一；记载9世纪加洛林帝国历史的核心文献《富尔达编年史》便出自它的抄写室。

1221年，修道院院长获封帝国领地，富尔达成为亲王修道院，其院长以神圣罗马帝国诸侯的身份位列帝国等级。1356年，皇帝查理四世又将“皇后大总理”的荣誉头衔授予院长。富尔达于1752年升格为主教采邑区，最终修道院在1802年解散，邦国于1803年被世俗化。

en:
Falkenstein was the lordship of the counts of Bolanden-Falkenstein, named after their castle in the Palatinate. Philipp of Bolanden, keeper of the imperial regalia at Trifels, married Isengard, heiress of the counts of Hagen-Münzenberg, and from 1255 the family held her Münzenberg inheritance in the Wetterau, including Offenbach am Main.

The Falkensteins made the Taunus their new centre, building the castle of Neufalkenstein at Königstein while keeping their Palatine lands. In 1372 they pledged Offenbach to the imperial city of Frankfurt for one thousand gulden, and Count Werner III served as Archbishop of Trier from 1388 to 1418.

A side line received the comital title in 1398, but the Hessian Falkensteins died out in 1418 and their Rhenish lands passed to the counts of Virneburg. The Palatine county was sold in 1456, passed to Lorraine in 1667, and ceded to France in 1801.
zh:
法尔肯施泰因是博兰登‑法尔肯施泰因伯爵家族的领地，得名于其在普法尔茨的城堡。博兰登的菲利普在特里费尔斯看管帝国信物，他娶哈根‑明岑贝格伯爵家族的女继承人伊森加德为妻；1255年起，家族领有她在韦特劳的明岑贝格遗产，包括美因河畔奥芬巴赫。

法尔肯施泰因家族以陶努斯山区为新的统治中心，在柯尼希施泰因修建新法尔肯施泰因城堡，同时保留普法尔茨的祖产。1372年，他们以一千古尔登把奥芬巴赫抵押给帝国城市法兰克福；维尔纳三世伯爵在1388年至1418年间担任特里尔大主教。

家族旁支于1398年获得伯爵头衔，但黑森的法尔肯施泰因家族于1418年绝嗣，莱茵地区的产业转入维尔讷堡伯爵家族。普法尔茨伯国于1456年售出，1667年归入洛林，1801年割让给法国。

en: Fulun was a small Hūrga Jurchen community of the Hailang River valley, a 222-kilometre left-bank tributary of the Hurka, or Mudan, flowing through present Hailin. Its fishing and farming villages belonged to the Hurka tribal world and stood under the loose suzerainty of the Chinese dynasties, like the other Jurchen groups of the Sungari and Ussuri country.
zh: 富伦是海浪河流域的虎尔哈女真小聚落。海浪河长222公里，是流经今海林市的虎尔哈河（即牡丹江）左岸支流，河畔村落兼事渔猎与农耕，属于虎尔哈部落圈，并与松花江、乌苏里江一带的其他女真群体一样，对中原王朝保持松散的臣属关系。

en:
Florence was founded as a Roman colony in 59 BC on the Arno. After Matilda of Tuscany died in 1115 it formed a commune, documented as a republic from 1138. Power rested with merchant guilds through two centuries of Guelph and Ghibelline, then Black and White Guelph, wars.

Wool and the Bardi and Medici banks made Florence rich, its gold florin, struck from 1252, becoming the standard trade coin of Western Europe. From Dante onward it was the cradle of the Renaissance, a position reinforced after the Medici returned under Cosimo in 1434 and reached their height under Lorenzo the Magnificent.

Expelled in 1494, the Medici returned in 1512, were expelled in 1527 and reimposed after the siege of 1529 to 1530. Alessandro de' Medici became hereditary duke in 1532; Cosimo I took Siena in 1555 and became Grand Duke in 1569. The dynasty ended in 1737, when Tuscany passed to Lorraine.
zh:
佛罗伦萨于公元前59年在阿尔诺河畔建立，本是罗马殖民地。1115年托斯卡纳女伯爵玛蒂尔达去世后，它组成自治公社，1138年已有共和国的记载。政权掌握在商人行会手中，两百年间圭尔夫派与吉伯林派、后来黑党与白党之间党争不断。

呢绒业和巴尔迪、美第奇等银行家族使佛罗伦萨富足，1252年起铸造的金币弗罗林成为西欧通用的贸易货币。从但丁的时代起，它便是文艺复兴的摇篮；1434年美第奇家族随科西莫回归，到“豪华者”洛伦佐时权势达到顶峰，进一步巩固了这一地位。

美第奇家族1494年被逐，1512年回归，1527年再遭驱逐，1529至1530年围城后又被扶立。亚历山德罗·德·美第奇1532年成为世袭公爵，科西莫一世1555年攻取锡耶纳，1569年成为大公。王朝于1737年绝嗣，托斯卡纳转入洛林家族手中。

en:
Offaly preserves the name of Uí Failghe, a Gaelic kingdom in the midlands of Ireland whose lands included the area east of Tullamore in the present county, western Kildare and parts of north-eastern Laois. It claimed descent from the early sixth-century king Rus Failge and for centuries held its own against the Uí Néill and the Normans, though each round of warfare cost it territory.

From the middle of the eleventh century its rulers were the Ó Conchobhair Failghe, or O'Conor Faly, a dynasty unrelated to the O'Conors of Connacht. After the Norman invasion they moved their seat from Rathangan to the fortress at Daingean.

The kingdom's independence ended in the mid-sixteenth century. When its last de facto king, Brian mac Chathaoir, died about 1556, Ireland's Parliament passed the Settlement of Laois and Offaly Act, and Uí Failghe was partitioned among the King's County, the Queen's County and County Kildare under the Tudor plantations.
zh:
奥法利之名源自乌伊·法尔盖，那是爱尔兰中部的盖尔王国，疆域包括今同名郡内图拉莫尔以东、基尔代尔西部和莱什东北部一带。王国自称是6世纪初国王拉斯·法尔盖的后裔，数百年来顶住了伊·尼尔人与诺曼人的侵逼，只是每轮战事都要割让部分土地。

11世纪中叶起，统治者是奥康诺·法利家族，与康诺特的奥康诺家族并无亲缘。诺曼入侵后，他们把治所从拉杭根迁到丹甘要塞。

王国的独立在16世纪中叶终结。最后一位实际掌权的国王布莱恩·麦克·卡希尔约于1556年去世，爱尔兰议会随即通过《莱什与奥法利安置法令》，乌伊·法尔盖在都铎殖民中被拆分给国王郡、女王郡和基尔代尔郡。

en:
Fermanagh, in Irish Fir Manach, was a Gaelic kingdom among the loughs and islands of upper Lough Erne, covering what became County Fermanagh. It took shape in the tenth century from the older kingdom of Ui Chremthainn in Airgialla, and by the late eleventh century ruled the whole later county.

Early rulers came from Clann Lugainn, until the Mag Uidhir, or Maguire, clan seized the kingship in the late thirteenth century and kept it to the end, despite challenges from the O Donnells of Tyrconnell. The Maguires seated themselves at Lisnaskea, and in 1337 Roderick Maguire ruled a kingdom that answered to no English sheriff.

That independence ended in the Nine Years War, when Hugh Maguire led Fermanagh against English rule. His successor fled in the Flight of the Earls in 1607, and the kingdom was absorbed into the Kingdom of Ireland as County Fermanagh.
zh:
弗马纳，爱尔兰语称菲尔·马纳赫，是盖尔爱尔兰的王国，位于上厄恩湖的湖泽与岛群之间，疆域即后来的弗马纳郡。它10世纪从更古老的伊赫雷姆坦王国中分出，原属阿吉亚拉联盟；到11世纪末，已统治后来全郡之地。

早期国王出自卢甘族，13世纪末马圭尔家族夺取王权，此后虽受到蒂尔康奈尔的奥唐奈家族挑战，仍一直掌权到王国终结。马圭尔家族以利斯纳斯基为驻地；1337年，罗德里克·马圭尔统治着一个不受英格兰治安官管辖的王国。

这份独立在九年战争中终结：休·马圭尔率弗马纳起兵对抗英格兰统治，他的继承人在1607年的“伯爵出逃”中离开爱尔兰，王国随后被并入爱尔兰王国，改为弗马纳郡。

en:
The Fomin-Berezuesk principality was a small Rurikovich appanage of the Smolensk land, centered on the fortified town of Fomin Gorodok on the Vazuza river. It split from the Smolensk principality in the first half of the thirteenth century, when it was granted to Yuri, son of the Smolensk prince Konstantin Davydovich, and became one of the smallest principalities of Rus.

The town of Fomin is first mentioned in writing in 1371. By the fourteenth century the original domain had broken into the Fomin, Berezuy and Rzhev appanages, all held by descendants of the same line, from whom the Rzhevsky boyar family later traced its origin. In the early fifteenth century the Fomin lands were absorbed by the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
zh:
福明‑别列祖斯克公国是斯摩棱斯克领地下属的留里克王朝小封邑，以瓦祖扎河畔的设防城镇福明戈罗多克为中心。它在13世纪上半叶从斯摩棱斯克公国分出，封给斯摩棱斯克王公康斯坦丁·达维多维奇之子尤里，后来成为罗斯最小的公国之一。

福明镇最早见于1371年的文献记载。到14世纪，原有领地分裂为福明、别列祖伊和勒热夫三个封邑，均由同一家族的后裔统治，勒热夫斯基波雅尔家族便出自这一支。15世纪初，福明诸领地被立陶宛大公国吞并。

en:
Fuman is the historic capital of Bia-pas, the western half of Gilan, set in the rice- and silk-growing lowlands west of the Safid Rud. From 660 to 760 it was the seat of the Zoroastrian Dabuyid rulers, and after Gilan's conversion to Islam it became the centre of the Sunni Shafi'ite Eshaqvand dynasty, which ruled western Gilan from Fuman from the middle of the thirteenth century.

The Ilkhan Öljaitü's campaign of 1306 and 1307 won only nominal submission, and the geographer Mustawfi described Fuman as a large city in a wealthy region producing wheat, rice and silk. The Eshaqvand rulers kept their autonomy through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries and briefly acknowledged Ottoman suzerainty in 1534 and 1591.

Jamshid Soltan moved the Bia-pas capital to Rasht in 1572, and in 1592 Shah Abbas I abolished the local dynasties, placing Gilan under Safavid-appointed governors.
zh:
富曼是吉兰西半部比亚帕斯地区的历史都城，地处萨菲德河以西盛产稻米和生丝的低地。660—760年间，它是信奉祆教的达布亚王朝君主的驻地；吉兰改宗伊斯兰后，它又成为持逊尼派沙斐仪教法的埃沙克万德王朝的中心，该王朝自13世纪中叶起在富曼统治西吉兰。

伊利汗完者都1306—1307年的远征只换来名义上的臣服；地理学家穆斯陶菲称富曼是一座大城，位居盛产小麦、稻米和生丝的富庶地区中心。埃沙克万德君主在14、15世纪保持自治，并于1534年和1591年短暂承认奥斯曼的宗主权。

1572年，贾姆希德苏丹把比亚帕斯的都城迁往拉什特；1592年，阿拔斯一世废除地方王朝，吉兰改由萨非王室任命的总督治理。

en: The Berta are a people associated with the Sennar region on the Blue Nile, where the Funj Sultanate was founded in 1504. During the sixteenth or seventeenth century, Berta communities moved into western Ethiopia. There, conflicts and slave raids from Sudan encouraged them to build villages on defensible hills among rocky outcrops.
zh: 贝尔塔人是与青尼罗河畔森纳尔地区有关的族群，丰吉苏丹国于1504年在这一地区建立。16或17世纪，贝尔塔人的一些社群迁往埃塞俄比亚西部。当地冲突和来自苏丹的掳奴袭击促使他们在岩石嶙峋、易于防守的山丘上建立村落。

en:
The County of Foix was a Pyrenean fief centred on its castle above the town of Foix. Its first count, Roger, died around 1064; early counts were vassals of Toulouse and Barcelona. Raymond Roger backed the Cathars in the Albigensian Crusade, lost his lands to Simon de Montfort and recovered them. In 1290 the counts acquired Béarn, which became the centre of their power.

Gaston II ruled in 1337, having succeeded as a child under his mother's regency; in 1331 he imprisoned her at Foix. He died in 1343 after serving at the Siege of Algeciras. His son Gaston III Phoebus, author of Livre de chasse, ruled to 1391.

After a disputed succession Foix-Grailly took over, its heirs becoming kings of Navarre. The last inherited the French throne as Henry IV in 1589, Foix joining the French crown in 1607.
zh:
富瓦伯国是比利牛斯山区的封地，以雄踞富瓦城上方的城堡为中心。首任伯爵罗歇约于1064年去世，早期伯爵臣属于图卢兹和巴塞罗那。雷蒙·罗歇在阿尔比十字军战争中支持清洁派，领地一度被西蒙·德·孟福尔夺走，后来又收回。1290年富瓦伯爵取得贝阿恩，那里此后成为他们权势的中心。

1337年在位的加斯东二世幼年在母亲摄政下继位，1331年又把她囚禁在富瓦。他1343年在参加阿尔赫西拉斯围城战后去世。其子加斯东三世·费比斯著有《狩猎之书》，统治到1391年。

经过一场继承纠纷，富瓦‑格拉伊家族接管伯国，其继承人后来成为纳瓦拉国王。最后一位于1589年以亨利四世的身份登上法国王位，富瓦于1607年并入法兰西王室领地。

en:
The Kingdom of France grew from the West Frankish realm assigned to Charles the Bald by the Treaty of Verdun in 843. The Carolingian line ended in 987 with the election of Hugh Capet, whose Capetian descendants ruled France. Philip II first styled himself King of France rather than King of the Franks and broke the Plantagenets' power on the continent.

In 1328 Charles IV died without a male heir and Philip VI of Valois took the throne; Edward III of England disputed the succession, opening the Hundred Years' War of 1337 to 1453, which left England only Calais on the continent. The Valois then fought the Italian Wars, and the late sixteenth century saw the Wars of Religion, ended by the Edict of Nantes in 1598.

Under Louis XIV, who built Versailles, absolute monarchy made France Europe's leading power; colonial empire stretched from New France to India. The Revolution of 1789 led to the monarchy's abolition in 1792, and after Napoleonic wars the Bourbons returned in 1814.
zh:
法兰西王国的前身是843年《凡尔登条约》划给秃头查理的西法兰克王国。加洛林王统于987年断绝，贵族选举于格·卡佩为王，其卡佩后裔统治法兰西。腓力二世最早自称法兰西国王而非法兰克人之王，并摧垮了金雀花家族在大陆的势力。

1328年查理四世无男嗣而终，瓦卢瓦的腓力六世继位；英格兰国王爱德华三世争夺继承权，引发1337至1453年的百年战争，战后英格兰在大陆只剩加来。瓦卢瓦王朝又卷入意大利战争，16世纪末爆发宗教战争，直到1598年《南特敕令》颁布才告结束。

路易十四修建凡尔赛宫，绝对君主制使法兰西成为欧洲首强，殖民帝国从新法兰西延伸到印度。1789年革命导致1792年君主制被废除，拿破仑战争后波旁王朝于1814年复辟。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Freising was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire, a scatter of small estates reaching from its capital on the Isar in Bavaria as far as Tyrol. Saint Corbinian founded an abbey around 724 and Saint Boniface established the diocese in 739; early bishops gathered lands including Bischoflack, granted by Otto II in 973.

Rich Werdenfels followed in the late thirteenth century, and in 1294 the bishop became an imperial prince. He ruled a larger diocese including Munich, a grievance of Bavaria's Wittelsbach dukes. Freising paid Gustavus Adolphus ransom in 1632 yet was still sacked, and suffered famine and plague on the Swedes' return in 1646.

The principality was secularised and annexed to Bavaria in 1802 and 1803. Freising keeps the memory of the Freising Manuscripts, the oldest known Slovene text, written under Bishop Abraham in the late tenth century.
zh:
弗赖辛主教侯国是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，领土由零散的小块领地拼成，从伊萨尔河畔的巴伐利亚都城远及蒂罗尔。圣科尔比尼安约于724年创建修道院，圣博尼法斯于739年建立教区；历任主教陆续取得远方土地，如973年奥托二世赐下的比绍夫拉克。

13世纪末，富庶的韦登费尔斯伯国并入；1294年主教升为帝国王侯。他还管辖着更大、连慕尼黑也在其中的教区，这一直让巴伐利亚的维特尔斯巴赫公爵耿耿于怀。1632年弗赖辛向古斯塔夫·阿道夫缴纳赎金仍遭劫掠，1646年瑞典人再犯时又遇上饥荒和瘟疫。

1802至1803年，主教侯国被世俗化并并入巴伐利亚。弗赖辛还留有《弗赖辛手稿》的记忆，那是10世纪末亚伯拉罕主教时期写下的现存最古斯洛文尼亚语文献。

en:
Fourteenth-century Frisia was not a monarchy but a network of self-governing coastal communities from the Zuiderzee to the Weser. Feudalism never took root: rural communes ran their affairs through assemblies and elected judges under the Frisian freedom, a system legend traced to a grant by Charlemagne.

The Frisians defended it in long wars against the counts of Holland. In 1345 they routed the invaders at the Battle of Warns near Stavoren, killing the count of Holland. From the mid-fourteenth century elected war leaders, hoofdelingen, became a landed aristocracy and the old equality eroded.

The chieftain Ulrich I founded the County of East Frisia in 1464, while western factional wars let in the Duke of Saxony, governor from 1498. His rights were sold to the Habsburgs in 1515; the west became Charles V's Lordship of Frisia in 1524 and joined the Dutch Republic against Spain.
zh:
14世纪的弗里西亚并不是君主国，而是须德海到威悉河之间沿海自治社群连成的网络。封建制度从未在这里扎根：乡村公社通过集会和民选法官管理事务，这套制度称为弗里西亚自由，传说其特权来自查理大帝的敕授。

弗里斯兰人为保卫这一秩序，同荷兰伯爵长期作战。1345年，他们在斯塔弗伦附近的瓦恩斯战役中大破入侵者，击杀荷兰伯爵。然而从14世纪中叶起，民选军事首领霍夫德林根逐渐演变为地产贵族，旧有的平等不断瓦解。

东部的首领乌尔里希一世于1464年建立东弗里斯兰伯国；西部的派系内战则让萨克森公爵在1498年出任总督。相关权利1515年卖给哈布斯堡家族，西部于1524年成为查理五世的弗里斯兰领地，后来加入尼德兰联省共和国对抗西班牙。

en:
Fermo sits on a hill in the Marche overlooking the Adriatic, on the site of Firmum Picenum, a Latin colony founded in 264 BC. In the eighth century it passed with the Pentapolis to the Holy See and became the chief town of the March of Fermo, its bishops winning comital then princely rights.

It became a free city in 1199, and its papal loyalty in the Guelph and Ghibelline wars brought sieges and captures by Henry VI in 1192 and Frederick II in 1241. Lords more or less recognised as papal vassals then held the city, among them the Monteverde family, in power in 1337.

Oliverotto Euffreducci seized power in 1495 and was murdered on Cesare Borgia's orders in 1503; his son Ludovico fell at Montegiorgio in 1520. Fermo then passed to direct Papal States rule and remained a provincial capital of the March of Ancona.
zh:
费尔莫坐落在马尔凯一座俯瞰亚得里亚海的山丘上，其前身是公元前264年建立的拉丁殖民地皮切努姆的菲尔穆姆。8世纪时，它随五城地区一并划归教廷，成为费尔莫边疆区的首邑，当地主教先后取得伯爵乃至诸侯的权利。

1199年它成为自由城市；在圭尔夫与吉伯林战争中，它因效忠教皇而屡遭围攻，1192年被亨利六世、1241年被腓特烈二世攻占。此后城市由一代代领主统治，他们大体是教廷承认的封臣，其中包括1337年执政的蒙泰韦尔德家族。

奥利韦罗托·欧弗雷杜奇1495年夺取政权，1503年奉切萨雷·博尔贾之命被谋杀；其子卢多维科1520年战死于蒙泰焦尔焦。费尔莫此后由教皇国直接管辖，一直是安科纳边疆区的行省重镇。

en:
Frankfurt grew up at a ford of the Main on the site of a Carolingian royal court, first named in 794 when Charlemagne held a church council there. In 1147 Bernard of Clairvaux preached the Second Crusade in its church, and from the election of Frederick Barbarossa in 1152 it became the customary place where German kings were chosen, a role fixed by the Golden Bull of 1356. Long a self-governing city under imperial protection, it bought the imperial bailiwick and was formally declared a Free Imperial City in 1372. Its trade fairs drew merchants from across Europe, and from the fifteenth to the seventeenth century it hosted Germany's most important book fair.

The city adopted the Lutheran Reformation in 1533, and from 1562 the emperors were crowned in Frankfurt Cathedral instead of Aachen. Guild unrest against the patrician council exploded into the Fettmilch uprising of 1612 to 1614, which ended in a pogrom in the Jewish lane. Frankfurt kept its neutrality through the Thirty Years' War, even when Gustavus Adolphus demanded quarters for his troops, and the Peace of Westphalia confirmed its freedom in 1648. With the collapse of the Empire in 1806 it passed to Karl von Dalberg and became part of the Grand Duchy of Frankfurt in 1810; the Congress of Vienna restored it as a sovereign Free City in 1815 and made it the seat of the German Confederation's diet.
zh:
法兰克福兴起于美因河上的一处渡口，其地原为加洛林王室的行宫，794年查理曼在此召开宗教会议时首次见诸文献。1147年，明谷的伯尔纳在当地教堂鼓动第二次十字军东征；自1152年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨当选以来，这里成为德意志国王选举的惯例地点，1356年的金玺诏书又确认了这一地位。它长期是受皇帝保护的自治城市，1372年买下帝国辖区权后正式成为帝国自由城市。当地的集市吸引了全欧洲的商人，15至17世纪这里还举办德意志最重要的书展。

1533年，城市接受路德宗改革；1562年起，皇帝在法兰克福大教堂而非亚琛加冕。行会对抗贵族市议会的骚动演变为1612至1614年的费特米尔希起义，最终以犹太巷的一场屠杀告终。三十年战争期间，法兰克福保持中立，即便古斯塔夫·阿道夫要求为军队提供驻地也未改其立场，1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》确认了它的自由地位。1806年帝国解体后，它落入卡尔·冯·达尔贝格之手，1810年成为法兰克福大公国的一部分；1815年维也纳会议恢复其主权自由城市地位，并将德意志邦联议会设于此地。

en:
The County of Ferrette, called Pfirt in German, was a feudal lordship of southern Alsace covering much of the Sundgau, with towns including Ferrette and Belfort. It took shape in the twelfth century, when the old Elsgau split between Ferrette and Montbéliard; its Scarponnois rulers are recorded from 1105.

When Ulrich III died without sons in 1324, his heiress Joanna, born at Basel about 1300, married Albert II of Habsburg; Basel's prince-bishop enfeoffed the Habsburgs in 1325. Joanna ruled the county until her death in 1351 and also became Duchess of Austria; Ferrette was thereafter administered as part of Further Austria.

In 1469 Archduke Sigismund mortgaged it with Upper Alsace to Charles the Bold for 50,000 florins; it returned to the Habsburgs after Charles died in 1477. The Peace of Westphalia gave it to France in 1648, and Louis XIV granted it to Cardinal Mazarin in 1659.
zh:
费雷特伯国德语称普法特，是阿尔萨斯南部的封建领地，大体覆盖松德高，城镇包括费雷特、贝尔福。12世纪旧埃尔斯加乌拆分，费雷特与蒙贝利亚尔分地而立，统治此地的斯卡波努瓦家族自1105年起便有记载。

1324年乌尔里希三世无子而终，他的女继承人、约1300年生于巴塞尔的乔安娜嫁给哈布斯堡的阿尔布雷希特二世，巴塞尔采邑主教又于1325年把伯国封给哈布斯堡家族。乔安娜统治伯国直至1351年去世，同时成为奥地利公爵夫人，费雷特此后作为前奥地利的一部分管理。

1469年，奥地利大公西吉斯蒙德以5万弗罗林为押，把它和上阿尔萨斯一并抵押给大胆查理；1477年查理死后伯国复归哈布斯堡。1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》把伯国划给法国，1659年路易十四又把它赐给红衣主教马扎然。

en:
The County of Forez covered the upper Loire plain between the Lyonnais and Auvergne, taking its name from Feurs, the Roman forum of the Segusiavi; its counts made Montbrison their capital. A comitatus forensis is documented from the tenth century, and from the early twelfth century it was held by the house of Albon.

They long disputed rights over Lyon with its archbishop until an exchange in 1173 confined them to Forez. In 1337 the count was Guigues VII of Albon, a French crown vassal. His son Louis I died fighting the free companies at Brignais in 1362.

When later counts died without heirs, the county passed in 1372 to Anne Dauphine, whose marriage to Louis II of Bourbon carried Forez into the House of Bourbon. It joined the French royal domain in 1531 and later became the province of Forez.
zh:
福雷伯国据有卢瓦尔河上游的平原，夹在里昂地区与奥弗涅之间，其名得自弗尔——罗马时代塞古西亚维人的集市；伯爵们后来把首府设在蒙布里松。福雷伯国的建制在10世纪已有文献可征，12世纪初起由阿尔邦家族世袭。

该家族长期与里昂大主教争夺对里昂的权利，直到1173年双方交换领地，伯爵的势力才被限定在福雷。1337年在位的是阿尔邦家族的吉格七世，为法兰西国王的封臣。他的儿子路易一世于1362年在布里涅战役中讨伐自由佣兵团时阵亡。

其后的伯爵相继无嗣，伯国遂于1372年传给安妮·多菲娜；她嫁给波旁公爵路易二世，福雷由此并入波旁家族的产业。1531年，福雷并入法兰西王室领地，后来成为福雷行省。

en:
Great Fulo was a Pulaar kingdom of the Denianke dynasty in Futa Toro, along the Senegal River. After the Songhai killed the Fula chief Tenguella in 1512, his son Koli led an armed migration from Futa Jallon and established his rule in Futa Toro, with a capital at Tumbere-Jiinde.

By the end of the sixteenth century the Denianke received tribute from Jolof and other neighboring kingdoms. In 1776 Sulayman Bal led a revolution against the dynasty, giving rise to the Imamate of Futa Toro.
zh:
大富洛是塞内加尔河沿岸富塔托罗地区的普拉尔语王国，由德尼安凯王朝统治。1512年，桑海人杀死富尔贝首领滕盖拉后，他的儿子科利率武装人群从富塔贾隆迁徙，在富塔托罗建立统治，首都设在通贝雷金德。

到16世纪末，德尼安凯王朝从卓洛夫等邻国收取贡赋。1776年，苏莱曼·巴尔领导革命推翻该王朝，富塔托罗伊玛目国随之兴起。

en:
The County of Fürstenberg was a Swabian imperial state in the Black Forest and Baar, near the source of the Danube. It grew from Egino IV of Urach, who inherited much of the extinct Duchy of Zähringen when Berthold V died in 1218. The lands were first known as the County of Freiburg, until his grandson Henry named himself after Fürstenberg Castle around 1250.

The county split in 1284 with Villingen's secession and in 1408 into Fürstenberg and Wolfach lines, whose branches added Baar, Stühlingen, Heiligenberg and, in 1607, Weitra in Austria. The Heiligenberg line won princely rank in 1664 and a Diet vote in 1667.

After the other lines ended, the territories were reunited as the Principality of Fürstenberg in 1744, ruled from Donaueschingen. The 1806 Rheinbund Act dissolved it, most going to Baden and smaller shares to Württemberg, Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Bavaria.
zh:
菲尔斯滕贝格伯国是黑森林与巴尔、多瑙河源头附近的施瓦本帝国邦国。1218年策林根公爵贝尔托德五世去世后，乌拉赫的埃吉诺四世继承了策林根公国的大片遗产；这些领地起初称弗赖堡伯国，直到约1250年，其孙亨利以驻地菲尔斯滕贝格城堡为家族名号。

伯国1284年因菲林根分出而首次分裂，1408年分为菲尔斯滕贝格与沃尔法赫两支。此后各支不断扩张，陆续取得巴尔、施蒂林根、海利根贝格，并于1607年获得奥地利魏特拉。海利根贝格一支于1664年晋升诸侯，1667年获得帝国议会投票权。

其余各支绝嗣后，领地于1744年重新合并为菲尔斯滕贝格亲王国，以多瑙艾辛根为驻地。1806年的《莱茵邦联条约》将它解散，大部划归巴登，余者分属符腾堡、霍亨索伦‑锡格马林根和巴伐利亚。

en:
Futi was a Jurchen polity on the lower Songhua's southern bank in the Sanjiang plain, centred on the fortified town also recorded as Futiqi, west of present-day Fujin in Heilongjiang. In 1337 its clans lived under Yuan overlordship with the other lower-Songhua tribes.

In 1409 the Yongle Emperor split the Futi Guard from the Hurhai Guard under a local chieftain, and Futi officers appear among the Jurchen dignitaries on the Yongning Temple stele erected at the Nurgan headquarters in 1413. Under the Qing the district came under the Ilan Hala commandant in 1715, administered through the three-surname garrison on the lower Songhua.
zh:
弗提是松花江南岸三江平原上的女真政权，治所是又名富提希的城堡，位于今黑龙江省富锦市以西。1337年，其各氏族与松花江下游诸部一样臣属元朝。

1409年，永乐帝从忽儿海卫分置弗提卫，以当地首领统领；1413年立于奴儿干驻地的永宁寺碑上，就刻有弗提卫官员的名字。清代这一地区于1715年划归三姓协领，由松花江下游的三姓驻防城管辖。

en:
The Fuyu polity took its name from the old kingdom of Fuyu and held the lower Nen River and the Wuyur basin on the northern Songnen plain.

In 1389 the Ming dynasty enrolled its Mongol and Tungusic groups as the Fuyu Guard, one of the Three Uriankhai Guards, whose chiefs claimed descent from Temuge, youngest brother of Chinggis Khan. Pressed by the Eastern Mongols and the Oirats, the guard moved south after 1449 into the Liaodong marches around Liaoyang and Shenyang.

In 1424 the Khorchin, defeated by the Oirat leader Toghon, sought shelter with Fuyu, and command passed from the Odchigin line to the Khasar line. Fuyu groups later joined Mongol raids on the Ming border and were absorbed by the Khorchin in the mid-sixteenth century.
zh:
福余因古夫余国故地得名，据有松嫩平原北部的嫩江下游与乌裕尔河流域。

1389年，明朝将当地蒙古、通古斯部落编为福余卫，为兀良哈三卫之一，其首领自称是成吉思汗之弟铁木哥斡赤斤的后裔。因受东蒙古和瓦剌逼迫，1449年以后福余卫南迁至辽阳、沈阳一带。

1424年科尔沁部被瓦剌首领脱欢击败后投奔福余卫，卫中首领之位自此由斡赤斤系转入哈萨尔系。此后福余诸部参与蒙古各部对明朝辽东边境的侵扰，16世纪中叶被科尔沁部吞并。

en:
Fezzan is the desert region of south-western Libya, where chains of oases support settled life deep in the Sahara and control the trans-Saharan trade routes. In antiquity it was the country of the Garamantes, who ran the caravan trade between Carthage, Rome and the Sahelian lands to the south from the fifth century BCE to the fifth century CE.

Arab armies conquered it in the seventh century, and during the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it fell under the Kanem Empire, whose power reached as far north as the oasis of Zella; in 1337 it therefore appears as a dependency ruled from the Lake Chad basin.

After wars with Kanem-Bornu in the early sixteenth century the Awlad Muhammad dynasty made Murzuk its capital and ruled the oases until Ottoman Turks from Tripoli occupied Fezzan in 1574, after which its rulers governed as vassals of the sultan with only intermittent Ottoman interference.
zh:
费赞是利比亚西南部的沙漠地区，一连串绿洲让人得以在撒哈拉腹地定居，并控制着跨撒哈拉商路。上古时代这里是加拉曼特人的国度，公元前5世纪到公元5世纪间，他们经营着迦太基、罗马与南方萨赫勒地区之间的驼队贸易。

7世纪阿拉伯军队征服此地；13至14世纪，费赞落入卡涅姆帝国之手，其势力北抵绿洲宰拉，因此1337年它表现为受乍得湖盆地政权统辖的附庸。

16世纪初，在与卡涅姆-博尔努的战争之后，奥拉德·穆罕默德王朝以迈尔祖格为都统治诸绿洲，直到1574年来自的黎波里的奥斯曼土耳其人占领费赞；此后其统治者以苏丹附庸的身份治理地方，奥斯曼中央只偶尔插手。

en: Fuzhou was the native Zhuang subprefecture covering present-day Funing County in southeastern Yunnan, set up by the Yuan in 1276 under the Guangnan West Route commission. In 1383 the Ming merged the neighboring Luozuo and Anning subprefectures into it, placing Fuzhou under Guangnan Prefecture with its seat at Puting; during the Chongzhen reign the chief's seat was moved to Guichao.
zh: 富州是管辖今云南东南富宁县一带的壮族土州，1276年元朝置州，属广南西路宣抚司。1383年明朝把相邻的罗佐、安宁两州并入富州，改属广南府，州治设在普厅；崇祯年间土州治所又迁往归朝。

en:
Gallura was one of the four medieval Sardinian judicates, ruled by judges in the northeast of the island around Olbia. It emerged from Byzantine provincial government as Sardinia became isolated from Constantinople. In 1207 the heiress Elena married the Pisan Lamberto Visconti, bringing Gallura under his family's rule.

Pisa took control after Nino Visconti was expelled in the late 1280s, and Aragon conquered the territory in 1323–1324. Nino's daughter Joanna continued to claim Gallura until her death in 1339.
zh:
加卢拉是中世纪撒丁岛的四个裁判官国之一，由裁判官统治岛东北部奥尔比亚一带。撒丁岛与君士坦丁堡的联系中断后，它从拜占庭的行省政府中发展而来。1207年，女继承人埃莱娜嫁给比萨人兰贝托·维斯孔蒂，加卢拉由此进入他的家族的统治。

1280年代末尼诺·维斯孔蒂被逐后，比萨控制了加卢拉，阿拉贡于1323—1324年征服该地。尼诺的女儿乔万娜继续主张对加卢拉的权利，直至1339年去世。

en: The Guamar were a Chichimeca people centered in the mountains of Guanajuato, in present-day Mexico. The White Chichimecas lived between Jalostotitlán and Aguascalientes and painted their heads white. From 1550 to 1590 the Guamar joined other Chichimeca groups in war against Spanish settlers and their Indigenous allies. The Spanish sought peace through goods and land grants.
zh: 瓜马尔是奇奇梅克人的一支，主要居住在今墨西哥瓜纳华托的山区。被称为白奇奇梅克人的一支住在哈洛斯托蒂特兰与阿瓜斯卡连特斯之间，将头部涂成白色。1550—1590年，瓜马尔人与其他奇奇梅克群体共同抵抗西班牙殖民者及其原住民盟友。西班牙人最终通过提供物资和土地寻求和平。

en: Garabito was a Huetar chiefdom in the western Central Valley of present-day Costa Rica, extending towards the Pacific. Its ruler Garabito succeeded a relative around 1561 and commanded subordinate chiefs in places including Barva and Yuruste. He resisted the Spanish expeditions of Juan de Cavallón and his successor Juan Vázquez de Coronado during the 1560s.
zh: 加瓦比托是韦塔尔人的酋邦，位于今哥斯达黎加中央谷地西部，领地延伸至太平洋沿岸。统治者加瓦比托约于1561年继承一位亲属的地位，辖下包括巴尔瓦和尤鲁斯特等地的酋长。16世纪60年代，他抵抗了胡安·德·卡瓦隆及其继任者胡安·巴斯克斯·德·科罗纳多率领的西班牙远征军。

en:
Gaur, also called Lakhnauti, was a walled Ganges capital in western Bengal. In the seventh century Shashanka founded the Gauda kingdom there, and under the Sena dynasty the city was renamed Lakhnauti after King Lakshman Sena. Bakhtiyar Khalji conquered it in 1203 and made it the seat of Delhi's governors of Bengal; Nasiruddin Bughra Khan briefly ruled it independently from 1281 before the province returned to Delhi. In 1337 Governor Qadar Khan held it for the Delhi sultan.

After Qadar Khan's death his officer Alauddin Ali Shah seized Lakhnauti; Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah overthrew him in 1342 and united Bengal into an independent sultanate in 1352. The first capital was Pandua, but Sultan Mahmud Shah moved the court back to Gaur in 1453; it then flourished with mosques, palaces and Portuguese merchants who likened its wealth to Lisbon's.

Humayun occupied it and renamed it Jannatabad before a Mughal army took it in 1575. Plague and a shifting Ganges then emptied it, leaving the walls and Great Golden Mosque of 1526 as ruins.
zh:
高达又称拉克瑙提，是孟加拉西部恒河畔的设防都城。7世纪设赏伽在此建立高达王国，犀那王朝时该城依国王拉克什曼·犀那之名改称拉克瑙提。1203年巴赫蒂亚尔·卡尔吉攻克此城，将其作为德里派驻孟加拉的总督驻地；1281年纳绥鲁丁·布格拉汗曾在此短暂独立称王，后来孟加拉又重归德里管辖。1337年，总督卡达尔汗仍为德里苏丹镇守这座城市。

卡达尔汗死后，他的部将阿拉乌丁·阿里沙占据拉克瑙提，1342年被沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙推翻；后者于1352年统一孟加拉，建立独立的苏丹国。苏丹国最初定都潘杜阿，1453年马哈茂德沙把朝廷迁回高达。此后城中清真寺与宫殿林立，葡萄牙商人往来不绝，把它的富庶比作里斯本。

胡马雍一度占领该城并改名詹纳塔巴德，1575年莫卧儿军队将其攻取。随后瘟疫流行，加上恒河改道，城市逐渐荒废，只留下城墙和1526年的大金清真寺等遗迹。

en: Guaynia was a Taíno territory along the southern coast of Puerto Rico. Its chief Agüeybaná ruled near Guayanilla when Christopher Columbus reached the island in 1493. Agüeybaná II later led Taíno resistance against the Spanish, and was reportedly killed during the rebellion of 1511.
zh: 瓜伊尼亚是波多黎各南岸的一片泰诺人领地。1493年克里斯托弗·哥伦布抵达该岛时，酋长阿圭巴纳在瓜亚尼利亚一带统治。后来阿圭巴纳二世领导泰诺人抵抗西班牙人，据称在1511年的起义中阵亡。

en:
Gazaria was the name for Genoese trading colonies along the Crimean peninsula and Black Sea coast, ruled from the port of Kaffa. Genoa won exclusive Black Sea trading rights from the Byzantine emperor in 1261, Kaffa came to Genoese merchants in 1266, and other settlements included Tana at the Don's mouth.

Administered by an elected consul and the eight-man Officium Gazarie, its laws codified in the Liber Gazarie of 1341, the colony grew rich on silk, grain and slaves shipped west through the Bosphorus. The Golden Horde stormed Kaffa in 1308; Genoa recovered it only in 1313. During the Mongol siege of 1347 plague-fleeing Genoese ships carried the Black Death into the Mediterranean.

After Constantinople fell in 1453 Genoa handed Gazaria to its Bank of Saint George, but the Ottomans took Kaffa in 1475, ending Genoese Black Sea rule.
zh:
加扎里亚是热那亚人在克里米亚半岛和黑海沿岸一系列贸易殖民地的统称，以港口卡法为统治中心。1261年，热那亚从拜占庭皇帝手中取得黑海独占贸易权，卡法于1266年交到热那亚商人手中，其他殖民点包括顿河河口的塔纳。

殖民地由民选执政官和八人加扎里亚公署治理，法律于1341年汇编为《加扎里亚法典》，依靠经博斯普鲁斯海峡西运的丝绸、粮食和奴隶贸易致富。1308年金帐汗国攻陷卡法，热那亚直到1313年才将其收回；1347年蒙古人围城时，逃离瘟疫的热那亚船只把黑死病带入地中海。

1453年君士坦丁堡陷落后，热那亚把加扎里亚移交圣乔治银行，但奥斯曼人于1475年攻占卡法，终结了热那亚在黑海的统治。

en:
The Principality of Grubenhagen, also called Brunswick-Grubenhagen, was the smallest Welf subdivision of Brunswick-Lüneburg, on the south-western edge of the Harz. It split from Brunswick in 1291 in an inheritance division by Albert the Tall's sons, first ruled by Henry the Admirable from Grubenhagen Castle.

His sons partitioned it again in 1322, and in 1337 Henry II held the Einbeck portion, including Duderstadt. The continuing fragmentation weakened the line beside its Welf cousins; one younger son, Otto, married Queen Joan I of Naples in Italy in 1376. Duderstadt was ceded to Mainz in 1366.

Duke Philip I reunited the scattered lands in 1526, but when his son Philip II died in 1596 the line became extinct. A 1617 Imperial Chamber Court ruling gave the territory to the Lüneburg branch; Calenberg dukes ruled from 1665, and it survived only formally as an imperial estate until 1806.
zh:
格鲁本哈根侯国又称不伦瑞克‑格鲁本哈根，是韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克‑吕讷堡最小的支系领地，地处哈茨山西南麓。1291年高个子阿尔贝特诸子分割遗产时，它从不伦瑞克分出，首任统治者亨利以格鲁本哈根城堡为驻地。

1322年他的儿子们再次瓜分这个小邦，1337年亨利二世领有包括杜德施塔特在内的艾恩贝克部分。不断析产使该支系在韦尔夫诸堂兄弟面前势单力薄，其中一位幼子奥托远赴意大利，于1376年娶那不勒斯女王乔安娜一世为妻。1366年杜德施塔特被割让给美因茨。

1526年菲利普一世重新统一这些分散的领地，但他的儿子菲利普二世1596年去世后，该支系绝嗣。1617年帝国枢密法院裁定将其判给吕讷堡支系，1665年起由卡伦贝格诸公爵统治，仅作为帝国等级名义上存续到1806年。

en:
The Kingdom of Great Britain was formed in 1707 when England and Scotland joined under a parliament at Westminster. The crowns had already been united in 1603 under James VI of Scotland, but the two kingdoms kept separate legal and religious institutions after union.

The Jacobite bid to restore the Stuarts ended in defeat in 1746. Victory in the Seven Years' War brought Britain Canada and other French territories under the Treaty of Paris in 1763, although the American Revolution later cost it the Thirteen Colonies. In 1801 Great Britain and Ireland became the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland.
zh:
大不列颠王国于1707年由英格兰与苏格兰合并而成，议会设在威斯敏斯特。早在1603年，苏格兰国王詹姆士六世就已兼领两国王冠；合并后，两地仍保留各自的法律和宗教制度。

詹姆斯党为复辟斯图亚特王朝而发动的战争以1746年的失败告终。七年战争胜利后，英国依据1763年《巴黎条约》获得加拿大等法国领地，但后来在美国独立战争中失去了十三个殖民地。1801年，大不列颠与爱尔兰合并为大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国。

en:
Gabès, the ancient Tacapae, lies on the Gulf of Gabès at the edge of a coastal oasis on the road south from Tunis. A Carthaginian foundation and then a Roman trading colony and bishopric, it was conquered with the rest of Ifriqiya in the seventh century, and the Prophet's companion Abu Lubaba al-Ansari is honoured there as its patron.

After the Hilalian invasions the Arab Banu Jami' dynasty ruled Gabès from about 1096 until the Almohads overthrew it in 1159. Under Hafsid overlordship the local Banu Makki family secured the governorship in 1282 and built an effectively independent power, holding Gabès, the Jabal Nafusa, Sfax, Djerba and Tripoli, and from 1380 the Jerid oases. The Hafsid sultan broke their power at the Battle of Gabès in 1387 and restored direct rule by 1394.

Al-Idrisi praised its orchards and markets, and the traveller al-Tijani called it Little Damascus; Gabès passed to the Ottomans with the rest of Tunisia in 1574.
zh:
加贝斯古称塔卡佩，濒临加贝斯湾，地处一片沿海绿洲的边缘，位于从突尼斯南下的道路上。它先是迦太基人的据点，后成为罗马贸易殖民城和主教区，7世纪随伊弗里基亚一起被阿拉伯征服，先知的伙伴阿布·卢巴巴·安萨里在这里被尊为守护者。

希拉尔入侵之后，阿拉伯的巴努贾米王朝约从1096年起统治加贝斯，1159年被穆瓦希德人推翻。在哈夫斯王朝宗主权下，本地的巴努马基家族于1282年取得总督之位，建立起事实上独立的政权，领有加贝斯、奈富塞山、斯法克斯、杰尔巴和的黎波里，1380年又取得杰里德绿洲。哈夫斯苏丹在1387年的加贝斯战役中击垮其势力，到1394年恢复直接统治。

伊德里西曾盛赞它的果园和市场，旅行家提贾尼则称它为‘小大马士革’；1574年它随突尼斯一并归入奥斯曼版图。

en:
Cuauhchinanco, whose Nahuatl name means within a wall of trees, was a Nahua altepetl in the forested Sierra Norte de Puebla, on the route between the Mexican highlands and Gulf lowlands. Chichimeca followers of Nopaltzin settled the valley between 1116 and 1121 and built a dominion there, and in the fifteenth century Nezahualcoyotl, Acolhua king of Texcoco, conquered it and installed calpixque tribute stewards.

As an Aztec tributary province it provisioned Mexica armies against the Huastecs and ruled either thirty-five or sixty-four subject towns; during the reign of Ahuitzotl, from 1486 to 1502, its lord was Xochitl Tecuhtli. Its court produced the poet Tlaltecatzin, who sang at Texcoco in the days of Techotlalatzin.

After the Spanish conquest it became Juan de Jaso's encomienda, keeping that status into the eighteenth century and passing to the province of Puebla in 1792.
zh:
夸乌奇南科是林木茂密的普埃布拉北部山区中的一座纳瓦城邦，纳瓦特尔语名称意为“树墙之内”，扼守墨西哥高原与海湾低地之间的通道。1116至1121年间，诺帕尔辛率领的奇奇梅克人进入山谷建立领地；15世纪，特斯科科的阿科尔瓦国王内萨瓦尔科约特尔将其征服，派去卡尔皮斯克贡赋官。

作为阿兹特克的纳贡省，它为征讨瓦斯特克人的墨西卡军队提供粮草，统辖着35座或64座属城；1486至1502年奥伊佐特在位时，当地君主是索奇特尔·特库特利。这座城邦还走出了诗人特拉尔特卡钦，他在特乔特拉拉钦时代的特斯科科宫廷吟诗作歌。

西班牙征服后，此地被封给胡安·德·哈索作为监护领地，这一身份一直保持到18世纪，1792年划入普埃布拉省。

en:
The Guancavilca inhabited the coast of present-day Ecuador, from Puná Island and Guayaquil to Santa Elena and southern Manabí. Their pre-Columbian culture lasted until about 1530.

Guancavilca artisans worked copper into tools and axe-shaped currency, while Spondylus shells also served as objects of exchange. The Italian traveler Girolamo Benzoni described their coastal country after visiting the region in 1547—1550.
zh:
万卡维尔卡人居住在今厄瓜多尔海岸，分布范围从普纳岛和瓜亚基尔延伸至圣埃伦娜及马纳比南部。他们的前哥伦布时期文化延续至约1530年。

万卡维尔卡工匠用铜制作工具和斧形货币，棘牡蛎贝壳也用作交换物。意大利旅行者吉罗拉莫·本佐尼在1547—1550年游历这一地区后，记述了他们的海岸地带。

en:
The Goitacaz were indigenous hunter-gatherers of Brazil's coast between the São Mateus and Paraíba do Sul rivers. They hunted with bows and fished, and were divided into rival groups including the Goitacá-guassu.

Portugal's division of Brazil into hereditary captaincies in 1534 placed their lands under several colonial grants. After slave raids by colonists, the Goitacaz attacked settlements in the 1540s, and the captain of São Tomé abandoned his enterprise.
zh:
戈伊塔卡斯是巴西海岸圣马特乌斯河与南帕拉伊巴河之间的原住民狩猎采集群体。他们以弓箭狩猎，也捕鱼为生，分为相互敌对的若干群体，其中包括戈伊塔卡瓜苏人。

葡萄牙于1534年将巴西划分为世袭领地，他们的土地被划入数块殖民领地。殖民者掳人为奴后，戈伊塔卡斯人在16世纪40年代袭击定居点，圣多美领地主最终放弃了殖民事业。

en:
The Godara were a Jat clan whose chieftaincy lay in Jangladesh, the dry country of northern Rajasthan around modern Bikaner. Between the tenth and twelfth centuries the Jats of the region lived under their own chiefs and customs, while Bhati Rajputs held much of the north and west.

The Godara state kept its seat at Shekhsar, where the chief Pandu Godara is said to have ruled over seven hundred villages. In the fifteenth century a feud with neighbouring Jat rulers drove Pandu to seek the help of Rao Bika, son of the Rathore chief Rao Jodha of Marwar.

Bika's coalition of Rathores, Charans and Godara Jats conquered Jangladesh and founded Bikaner, its city established in 1488; Pandu ceded his lands to the Rathores, ending Jat rule and bringing the Godara under the new state.
zh:
果达拉人是贾特人的一支，其首领领地位于禅伽罗德什，即今拉贾斯坦北部比卡内尔一带的干旱地区。10至12世纪间，这一地区的贾特人在本族首领和习俗下自治，而巴蒂拉杰普特人控制着北部和西部的大片土地。

果达拉政权以谢赫萨尔为治所，据说首领潘杜·果达拉统辖着七百个村庄。15世纪，与邻近贾特诸首领的仇争迫使潘杜向马尔瓦尔拉托尔首领拉奥·乔达之子拉奥·比卡求援。

比卡率领拉托尔人、查兰人与果达拉贾特人的联军征服禅伽罗德什并建立比卡内尔，城池于1488年动工；潘杜将土地割让给拉托尔人，贾特人在当地的统治就此终结，果达拉人归入新邦。

en:
Gwynedd was a Welsh kingdom centred on northwestern Wales, with a royal seat at Aberffraw on Anglesey. Its rulers rose to dominance over other Welsh princes, and Llywelyn the Great proclaimed a principality of Wales at Aberdyfi in 1216.

Edward I of England reduced Gwynedd in 1277 and conquered its remaining territory in 1282–1283. Welsh resistance later revived under Owain Glyndŵr, who claimed the title Prince of Wales in 1400 and held a parliament at Machynlleth in 1404, but English forces retook Anglesey in 1407.
zh:
圭内斯是以威尔士西北部为中心的王国，王庭位于安格尔西岛的阿伯弗劳。圭内斯统治者一度压服其他威尔士诸侯，伟大的卢埃林于1216年在阿伯代菲宣告建立威尔士公国。

英格兰的爱德华一世于1277年削减圭内斯的领土，并在1282—1283年征服其余土地。威尔士的抵抗后来在欧文·格林杜尔领导下复起；他于1400年自称威尔士亲王，1404年在马汉莱斯召开议会，但英军于1407年夺回安格尔西岛。

en: Giduwa was a Cherokee mother town on the upper Tuckasegee River in the southern Appalachians. Its platform mound dated to about 1000; Cherokee communities later built council houses on it. The Cherokee lost control of the site to the United States in the early nineteenth century.
zh: 基杜瓦是南阿巴拉契亚地区塔卡西吉河上游的一座切罗基母城。城中的台地土丘约建于1000年，切罗基人后来在丘上修建议事屋。19世纪初，切罗基人失去了对这处城址的控制，土地转入美国手中。

en:
Gedi was a Swahili stone town in the forest behind the Kenyan coast near Malindi, its coral ruins among the best-preserved medieval Swahili settlements. Founded around the eleventh century, it grew behind inner and outer walls into a grid of stone mosques, a palace, pillar tombs and merchants' houses, reaching its peak of population and wealth in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries.

Imports dug from its floors, Chinese celadon and blue-and-white porcelain, Islamic glazed ware and two Chinese coins, show its Indian Ocean trade, and an inscribed pillar tomb bears the date 1399. Gedi left no recorded dynasty and is known almost entirely from archaeology.

Its decline came quickly: Portuguese efforts to monopolize coastal trade, a falling water table, the Wazimba raid of 1589 and raids by migrating Oromo from Somalia emptied the town, which was abandoned by the middle of the seventeenth century.
zh:
格迪是一座斯瓦希里石城，隐于肯尼亚沿海马林迪附近的林中，珊瑚石废墟属斯瓦希里世界保存最完好的中世纪聚落之列。它约建于11世纪，在内墙与外墙之内发展出由石砌清真寺、宫殿、柱墓和商人宅邸组成的网格城市，人口与财富在15至16世纪达到顶峰。

遗址出土的中国青瓷和青花瓷、伊斯兰釉陶乃至两枚中国钱币，表明它参与了印度洋贸易；一座刻有铭文的柱墓标注着1399年。格迪没有留下王朝记载，世人几乎全凭考古了解它。

它的衰落十分迅速：葡萄牙人对沿海贸易的垄断、地下水位下降、1589年的瓦津巴人袭击，以及来自索马里的奥罗莫人迁徙与劫掠，使该城人口流散，到17世纪中叶已遭废弃。

en:
Guelders grew from a county on the Lower Maas, first documented around 1096; in 1127 it gained Zutphen by marriage. Worringen in 1288 ended its Limburg claim. Its territory comprised four river-separated quarters.

In 1337 Reginald II of the House of Wassenberg ruled; he was raised to duke in 1339. When the line died out in 1371, a succession war passed it to William of Jülich. Egmond rule lasted until Charles the Bold bought the succession in 1473; after 1477 Guelders passed to the Habsburgs.

Charles of Egmond, ransomed by his townsmen in 1492, was its last independent duke and long defied Charles V, until the 1543 Treaty of Venlo surrendered it to the Habsburgs. Its three northern quarters joined the United Provinces in the revolt, while Upper Guelders remained Spanish until Utrecht partitioned it in 1713; French armies overran it in 1795.
zh:
海尔雷起源于马斯河下游的伯国，约1096年见载，1127年通过联姻取得聚特芬。1288年沃林根之败使其丧失林堡继承权。领地分为四个被河流隔开的区。

1337年在位的是瓦森贝格家族的雷金纳德二世，1339年升为公爵。1371年该支绝嗣，继承战争后归于于利希的威廉。埃格蒙特家族统治至1473年大胆查理买下继承权，1477年后转入哈布斯堡手中。

1492年被市民赎回的埃格蒙特的查理是末代独立公爵，长期对抗查理五世，1543年《芬洛条约》将其割让给哈布斯堡。革命中北方三区加入联省共和国，上海尔雷仍属西班牙，1713年《乌得勒支和约》将其瓜分，1795年法军席卷此地。

en:
Genoa grew from a small Ligurian port, sacked by a Fatimid fleet in 934 to 935, into the self-governing Compagna Communis of the eleventh century. Its galleys joined the Crusades and built trading colonies across the Mediterranean and Black Sea, among them Caffa in the Crimea from 1266.

Victory over Pisa at Meloria in 1284 made Genoa mistress of the Tyrrhenian Sea, and from 1347 it held Corsica, though its commercial duel with Venice ended in defeat at Chioggia in 1380. In 1339 it chose its first doge, an office contested by rival clans.

Andrea Doria's 1528 constitutional reform settled an oligarchic order, and Genoa became a banking power financing the Spanish Empire. Revolt drove it to sell Corsica to France in 1768; in 1797 Napoleon overthrew the republic for the Ligurian Republic, which France annexed in 1805. After a brief restoration the Congress of Vienna assigned Genoa to Sardinia in 1815.
zh:
热那亚本是利古里亚的一座小港，934至935年曾遭法蒂玛舰队洗劫，11世纪发展为自治的“公社联合体”。它的桨帆船参加十字军东征，并在地中海和黑海沿岸建起贸易殖民地，包括1266年起占有的克里米亚卡法。

1284年热那亚在梅洛里亚海战中击败比萨，成为第勒尼安海的霸主；1347年起它据有科西嘉岛，但与威尼斯的长期商战以1380年基奥贾战败告终。1339年该城选出首任总督，这一职位后来成为敌对世家角逐的目标。

1528年安德烈亚·多里亚改革宪法，确立寡头体制；热那亚由此转型为金融强国，为西班牙帝国提供资金。后来的起义迫使它在1768年把科西嘉卖给法国，1797年拿破仑推翻共和国、另立利古里亚共和国，又于1805年将其并入法国。短暂复辟后，1815年维也纳会议将热那亚划归撒丁王国。

en:
The Kingdom of Georgia arose around 1008, when Bagrat III united the Iberian and Abkhazian realms under the Bagrationi dynasty, in a land whose kings had accepted Christianity as early as the fourth century. David IV threw off Seljuk rule and built an empire after Didgori in 1121, and under Queen Tamar (1184 to 1213) it became the leading Christian power of the Near East.

The Mongols made it tributary in the 1240s, but George V the Brilliant expelled Mongol garrisons in the 1330s and restored a united kingdom at Tbilisi. The Black Death of 1346 and Timur's campaigns of 1386 to 1403 broke its power, and after Turkmen invasions the realm split in 1490 into Kartli, Kakheti and Imereti.

The 1555 Peace of Amasya split Georgia into Safavid and Ottoman spheres. Heraclius II reunited the east in 1762, and his 1783 Treaty of Georgievsk made Kartli-Kakheti a Russian protectorate. After Tbilisi's sack in 1795 Russia annexed Kartli-Kakheti in 1801 and Imereti in 1810.
zh:
格鲁吉亚王国形成于1008年前后，巴格拉季奥尼王朝的巴格拉特三世将伊比利亚与阿布哈兹诸领地合为一体，当地国王早在4世纪就已皈依基督教。大卫四世摆脱塞尔柱统治，1121年在迪德格里之战获胜后建立帝国；塔玛尔女王1184至1213年在位期间，格鲁吉亚成为近东首屈一指的基督教强国。

13世纪40年代蒙古人将其降为附庸，但“明君”乔治五世在14世纪30年代驱逐蒙古驻军，以第比利斯为都重建统一王国。1346年的黑死病和1386至1403年帖木儿的征伐摧毁了它的国力，土库曼人入侵之后，王国于1490年分裂为卡特利、卡赫季和伊梅列季三个王国。

1555年的《阿马西亚和约》将格鲁吉亚划入萨法维与奥斯曼两大势力范围，伊拉克略二世于1762年重新统一东部；他1783年签订《格奥尔基耶夫斯克条约》，使卡特利-卡赫季成为俄国保护国。1795年第比利斯遭洗劫后，俄国于1801年吞并该王国，1810年又吞并伊梅列季。

en: Germany was a region of Central Europe whose lands formed much of the Holy Roman Empire. After the empire dissolved in 1806, the Congress of Vienna established the German Confederation of sovereign states in 1815.
zh: 德意志是中欧的一个地区，其土地构成神圣罗马帝国的大部分。帝国于1806年解体后，维也纳会议在1815年建立了由主权邦国组成的德意志邦联。

en:
Gafsa, the ancient Capsa in the oases of the Tunisian Jerid, was a Numidian stronghold where Jugurtha kept his treasure before the Romans under Marius stormed it in 106 BC. It became a Roman colonia and later a Byzantine fortress, falling to Uqba ibn Nafi in 688.

In the eleventh century, as the Banu Hilal overran Ifriqiya, its governor Abdullah ibn al-Rand made himself independent in 1053, and the whole Jerid pledged him allegiance. The Banu al-Rand brought the oases a revival until the Almohad caliph Abd al-Mu'min received the city's surrender in 1159. Under the later Hafsids the south remained restive, until a Hafsid army retook rebel Gafsa in 1344.

The oasis grew dates, henna and cotton, and its fifteenth-century kasbah rose on Byzantine foundations; after the Ottoman conquest of 1574 Gafsa became a provincial garrison on the desert road.
zh:
加夫萨古称卡普萨，位于突尼斯杰里德绿洲，是努米底亚重镇，朱古达曾把财宝藏在这里，公元前106年罗马将领马略攻陷该城。后成为罗马殖民城和拜占庭要塞，688年被乌格巴·伊本·纳菲攻取。

11世纪希拉尔部落席卷伊弗里基亚时，总督阿卜杜拉·伊本·兰德于1053年自立，整个杰里德都向他效忠。其治下绿洲复兴，直到1159年穆瓦希德哈里发阿卜杜勒·穆明接受该城投降。哈夫斯王朝治下南方依旧不安，1344年哈夫斯军队收复被叛军占据的加夫萨。

绿洲出产椰枣、指甲花和棉花，15世纪的城堡矗立在拜占庭地基上；1574年奥斯曼征服后，成为沙漠商路上的行省驻军地。

en:
Guangxi is a karst highland region of eastern Yunnan, between Qujing and the border of the like-named southern province; the two are not the same place.

Under the Dali kingdom its valleys were held by several of the thirty-seven eastern tribes, among them the Jilu at present-day Luxi and the Weimo at Qiubei, whose chiefs took part in the Shicheng alliance of 971.

The Mongols formed the territory into Guangxi Route in 1276, and the Ming made it Guangxi Prefecture in 1382, with its seat at Luxi. In 1731 the Qing posted an assistant subprefect at Qiubei, and in 1770 the prefecture was reduced to the Guangxi Independent Subprefecture.
zh:
广西是云南东部的喀斯特高原地区，在曲靖与同名南方省份的边界之间，二者并非一地。

大理国时，这里的河谷分属滇东三十七部中的数部，包括治今泸西的际鹿部和治今丘北的维摩部，其酋长参加了971年的石城会盟。

1276年元朝将这一带设为广西路，1382年明朝改为广西府，府治在泸西。1731年清朝在丘北派驻州同，1770年广西府降为广西直隶州。

en:
Ghana, called Wagadu by its Soninke founders, was the first great empire of the western Sahel, ruling the edge of the Sahara from its capital Koumbi Saleh. Arab writers first noted the dynasty in 830; its kings, titled Ghana or Kaya Maghan, grew rich taxing the salt and gold caravans, and in 990 seized the trading town of Awdaghust.

Al-Bakri described Koumbi Saleh around 1068 as two towns, one royal and one Muslim. The Almoravids took Awdaghust in 1054, and a disputed tradition dates their sack of the capital to 1076; drought and the southward shift of trade then eroded Ghana's power. Ghana later fell to the Sosso, until Sundiata Keita defeated them at Kirina in 1235, after which Ghana's ruler joined the Mali Empire.

By 1337 it survived as a Mali vassal kingdom, still prestigious: around 1340 al-Umari noted its ruler as the only subject king allowed to keep the title malik, though Koumbi Saleh was abandoned in the 1400s.
zh:
加纳被它的索宁克建立者称为瓦加杜，是萨赫勒西部第一个大帝国，以沙漠边缘的昆比萨利赫为都统治一方。阿拉伯作家在830年首次记载这一王朝；其国王称号为加纳或卡亚·马甘，靠向盐队和金队征税致富，990年夺取商镇奥达古斯特。

约1068年，巴克里笔下的昆比萨利赫是双城，一为王城，一为穆斯林城。穆拉比特人于1054年攻占奥达古斯特，一个有争议的说法称其在1076年洗劫了加纳都城；此后干旱和商路南移不断侵蚀加纳的国力。加纳一度落入索索人之手，直到1235年松迪亚塔·凯塔在基里纳战役中取胜，加纳君主遂加入马里帝国。

到1337年，加纳作为马里的附庸王国存续，声望犹存：约1340年，欧麦里记载它的君主是唯一获准保留马利克称号的属国国王，不过昆比萨利赫城在15世纪已遭废弃。

en:
Gohilvad was the land of the Gohil Rajputs, a clan tracing its line to Mewar's Guhilas, on the eastern side of the Saurashtra peninsula. Their ancestor Sejakji entered Saurashtra around the thirteenth century's turn and served the Chudasama kings of Junagadh; his descendant Ranoji later built Ranpur and took Vala.

In 1337 the chief was Ranoji's son Mokhdaji, who had seized Umrala and the port of Ghogha, conquered Piram Island in the Gulf of Cambay and turned to sea-raiding. His piracy angered the Delhi Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq, who slew him in 1347 and took Ghogha and Piram.

Dungarji, son of Mokhdaji, was later reinstated at Ghogha, and Visoji captured Sihor and fortified it as the clan's capital. Later chiefs prospered until Bhavsinhji moved the seat to the new city of Bhavnagar in 1723; the region around it kept the name Gohilvad.
zh:
格锡瓦德是戈希尔拉杰普特人的地盘，位于萨乌拉施特拉半岛东岸，戈希尔人自称源出梅瓦尔古希拉王朝。先祖塞贾吉约在13世纪之交迁入萨乌拉施特拉，投效朱纳格特的珠多娑摩诸王；后裔拉诺吉后来修筑兰布尔、夺取瓦拉。

1337年在位的是拉诺吉之子莫克达吉，他攻占乌姆拉拉和戈加港，又征服坎贝湾中的皮拉姆岛，干起海上劫掠。海盗行径激怒了德里苏丹穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克，后者于1347年将他击杀，夺取戈加和皮拉姆。

莫克达吉之子东加尔吉后来回到戈加复位，维索吉则攻取锡霍尔、筑城为都。此后历代首领日渐强盛，1723年巴夫辛吉迁都新建的巴夫纳加尔城，周围地区一直保留格锡瓦德之名。

en:
Garha, later called Garha-Mandla or Garha Katanga, was the first large kingdom of the RajGond people in central India, covering the Narmada valley and the Satpura hills. Its first Gond king, Jadurai, deposed his Kalachuri masters to rule, and Kharji enlarged the state and built up its army in 1440–1460.

Its greatest ruler Sangram Shah conquered the Narmada valley and beyond, secured his realm with fifty-two hill forts called garhs, and ruled from Singhorgarh. His daughter-in-law Rani Durgavati, a Chandela princess, moved the capital to Chouragarh, defeated Malwa's last sultan Baz Bahadur, and fell against Akbar's Mughal army at Narrai in 1564.

Restored to a Gond raja as a Mughal fief, it slowly declined: the Maratha Peshwa reduced it to tribute in 1742, the Sagar Marathas annexed it in 1781, and after rule by Nagpur's Bhonsles it passed to the British in 1818.
zh:
加尔哈后称加尔哈-门德拉或加尔哈卡坦加，是拉杰贡德人在中印度的第一个大王国，据有讷尔默达河谷与萨特普拉山区。首代贡德国王贾杜赖推翻卡拉丘里旧主自立，卡尔吉1440—1460年间扩军拓土。

最杰出的君主桑格拉姆沙征服讷尔默达河谷等地，以五十二座加尔山寨拱卫疆土，定都辛格奥加尔。儿媳杜尔加瓦蒂为昌德拉王族之女，迁都乔拉加尔，击败马尔瓦末代苏丹巴兹·巴哈杜尔，1564年纳赖之战中迎战阿克巴的莫卧儿大军，战死。

王国后交还贡德罗阇，作为莫卧儿封国，国势日衰：1742年马拉塔佩什瓦将其降为纳贡国，1781年被萨格尔马拉塔人吞并，经那格浦尔邦斯勒家族统治，1818年入于英国。

en:
The Gilemi, whose Manchu-Chinese name was rendered Gilyak by Russian explorers, were the fishing people of the lower Amur and northern Sakhalin now usually called Nivkh. Chinese records called them Jilimi under the Jin and Yuan, and Fiyaka under the Qing. They lived by fishing, sea-mammal hunting and dog rearing, moving between summer coasts and winter rivers, their shamanism centred on the bear festival.

After 1291 the Yuan posted a military command at Nurgan near the Amur mouth, partly to check raiders from Sakhalin who crossed the sea to plunder the Gilemi. Under the Ming the Nurgan commission of 1409 enrolled their chiefs. When the Gilemi destroyed the Yongning Temple built there in 1413, the eunuch Yishiha returned in 1432 to find its ruins and pardoned those responsible.
zh:
吉烈迷在满汉文献中作吉里迷，俄人转读为吉利亚克，是黑龙江下游与库页岛北部以渔猎为生的民族，今多称尼夫赫人。中国史籍中，金、元两代称吉里迷，清代定名费雅喀。他们捕鱼、猎海兽、养犬，夏居沿海、冬转内河，信奉以熊祭为核心的萨满教。

1291年后元朝于黑龙江口附近的奴儿干设征东元帅府，部分原因是防御渡海掳掠吉烈迷的库页岛人。明朝1409年设奴儿干都司，册封其酋长；1413年所建的永宁寺后被吉烈迷毁去，太监亦失哈1432年再至仅见寺基，赦免毁寺者。

en:
Gojjam was a provincial kingdom in the northwestern Ethiopian highlands. Emperor Amda Seyon's campaigns incorporated it into Ethiopia in 1316–1317; a map around 1451 and Emperor Dawit II's letter to Portugal in 1526 nevertheless described it as a kingdom.

Adal captured Gojjam after the Battle of Zari in the sixteenth century. During the era of weakened imperial authority known as the Zemene Mesafint, Fasil of Damot appropriated its revenues and Gojjam became a base for regional lords.
zh:
戈贾姆是埃塞俄比亚西北高地的一个地方王国。皇帝安达·塞永于1316—1317年的征战将其并入埃塞俄比亚，但约1451年的一幅地图和皇帝达维特二世1526年写给葡萄牙的信仍称它为王国。

16世纪阿达尔在扎里战役后占领了戈贾姆。王子时代的皇权衰弱，达莫特的法西尔夺取了当地收入，戈贾姆也成为地方领主的势力基地。

en:
Glauchau was the chief lordship of the lords of Schönburg, a Saxon-Thuringian noble family first documented in 1130 at their Saale castle. In the later twelfth century they moved to the Zwickauer Mulde, became imperial ministeriales, and built Glauchau castle around 1170 above a Slavic settlement; the town below was first mentioned in 1240.

Glauchau became the family's allodial seat in 1256, and the Schönburgs added Lichtenstein in 1286, Waldenburg in 1378 and Hartenstein county in 1406. To hold off the Saxon electors, they held Glauchau, Lichtenstein and Waldenburg as Bohemian crown sub-fiefs. In 1337 the lord was Frederick VII.

The Schönburg lands accepted the Reformation from 1542, the house was raised to imperial counts in 1700 and its upper line to princes in 1790. By a 1740 recess the lords surrendered most autonomous rights to Electoral Saxony, and mediatization in 1803 ended their standing as ruling princes.
zh:
格劳豪是舍恩堡领主家族的核心领地。该萨克森-图林根贵族家族1130年首见记载于萨勒河畔城堡，12世纪后期迁至茨维考穆尔德河，成为帝国陪臣，约1170年于斯拉夫聚落上筑格劳豪城堡，堡下城镇1240年见载。

1256年格劳豪成家族世袭治所，后又于1286年取利希滕施泰因、1378年取瓦尔登堡、1406年取哈尔滕施泰因伯国。为抵御萨克森选侯，家族将格劳豪、利希滕施泰因和瓦尔登堡作为波希米亚王冠次级封邑持有。1337年领主为弗里德里希七世。

舍恩堡领地1542年起接受宗教改革，家族1700年升帝国伯爵，1790年长支升诸侯。1740年协议将大部分自治权让予萨克森选侯国，1803年帝国代表会议决议终结其诸侯地位。

en:
The Kingdom of Galicia occupied the northwest of the Iberian Peninsula. After the partition of Asturias in 910, Galicia passed to Ordoño II, who later united it with León; in 1230 it came under the Crown of Castile. Santiago de Compostela had become its capital in the eleventh century.

In 1467–1469 the Great Brotherhood rose against Galician nobles, but the revolt failed. Galicia retained a representative assembly under the Castilian and Spanish crowns; during the Napoleonic invasion, the assembly briefly claimed sovereignty. The kingdom and its assembly were dissolved in 1834.
zh:
加利西亚王国位于伊比利亚半岛西北部。910年阿斯图里亚斯王国分裂后，加利西亚传给奥多尼奥二世，后者又将其与莱昂合并；1230年，加利西亚归入卡斯蒂利亚王室。圣地亚哥-德孔波斯特拉在11世纪成为其首府。

1467—1469年，大兄弟会起兵反抗加利西亚贵族，最终失败。加利西亚在卡斯蒂利亚和西班牙王室治下保有代表会议；拿破仑入侵期间，会议曾短暂宣布拥有主权。王国及其会议于1834年被废除。

en:
Galicia-Lodomeria was a Habsburg crown land created from territories taken from the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in the First Partition of Poland in 1772. Its royal title recalled medieval Hungarian claims to Galicia and Lodomeria, although the new province also included much of Lesser Poland.

The Third Partition in 1795 added territory known as West Galicia, which Austria lost in 1809. In 1804 Galicia-Lodomeria became a crown land of the Austrian Empire.
zh:
加利西亚‑洛多梅里亚是哈布斯堡王朝的王室领地，由1772年第一次瓜分波兰时夺取的波兰立陶宛联邦领土组成。王国的头衔援引了中世纪匈牙利对加利西亚和洛多梅里亚的主张，但新领地也包括小波兰的大部分地区。

1795年第三次瓜分波兰时，奥地利又取得了称为西加利西亚的领土，并于1809年失去该地。1804年，加利西亚‑洛多梅里亚成为奥地利帝国的王室领地。

en:
The Geledi Sultanate was a Somali kingdom centered on Afgooye, between the Jubba and Shabelle rivers. In the late seventeenth century Ibrahim Adeer overthrew the Silcis rulers and founded the Gobroon dynasty as the Ajuran Sultanate declined.

Yusuf Mahamud Ibrahim became sultan in 1798 and governed a confederacy through local chiefs and religious leaders. His capital Afgooye stood at the meeting point of southern Somali caravan routes, with workshops producing textiles, pottery and jewelry.
zh:
格勒迪苏丹国是一个以朱巴河与谢贝利河之间的阿夫戈耶为中心的索马里王国。17世纪末，阿朱兰苏丹国衰落之际，易卜拉欣·阿德尔推翻锡尔西斯统治者，建立了戈布伦王朝。

优素福·马哈茂德·易卜拉欣于1798年成为苏丹，通过当地首领和宗教领袖治理联盟。首都阿夫戈耶位于索马里南部商队路线的交汇处，城中工坊生产纺织品、陶器和珠宝。

en:
The Ulus of Jochi, the Golden Horde or Kipchak Khanate, was the westernmost inheritance of Genghis Khan's eldest son Jochi, enlarged into an empire by his son Batu, whose campaigns of 1237 to 1242 sacked Kiev and made the Rus' principalities tributary. Its capital was Sarai on the lower Volga.

After the Mongol Empire split in 1259 the Horde went its own way and gradually Turkicized. Its power peaked under Özbeg Khan, who ruled from 1313 to 1341, made Islam the state religion and in 1337 still received tribute from princes as far as Moscow and Novgorod.

The Great Troubles after 1359 shattered its unity; Tokhtamysh briefly restored it before Timur's invasion of 1395 broke the Horde for good. It splintered into the khanates of Kazan, Crimea and Astrakhan and the rump Great Horde, whose defeat at the Great Stand on the Ugra in 1480 freed Moscow from the Tatar yoke and whose last remnants were destroyed in 1502.
zh:
术赤兀鲁思即金帐汗国，又称钦察汗国，是成吉思汗长子术赤的西方封地，由其子拔都扩张为庞大帝国：1237—1242年的西征攻陷基辅，使罗斯诸公国沦为藩属，统治中心是伏尔加河下游的萨莱城。

1259年蒙古帝国分裂后，金帐汗国自成一体，并逐渐突厥化。它的国力在月即别汗（1313—1341年在位）时达到顶峰，他立伊斯兰教为国教；1337年时，远至莫斯科和诺夫哥罗德的王公仍要向萨莱纳贡。

1359年后的“大动乱”撕裂了汗国的统一，脱脱迷失一度重振，但1395年帖木儿的入侵给了它致命打击。此后它分裂为喀山、克里米亚、阿斯特拉罕等汗国和残余的大帐汗国；1480年的乌格拉河对峙使莫斯科摆脱鞑靼枷锁，最后的残部也于1502年覆灭。

en:
Gilgit was the royal seat of the upper Indus valley, an oasis town where the Gilgit river meets the Hunza, on the Silk Road between Kashmir, Ladakh and the Tarim basin. In the seventh and eighth centuries it was the heart of the Buddhist kingdom called Little Balur in Chinese records, whose Patola Shahi kings followed Vajrayana Buddhism and produced the Gilgit manuscripts; Tang China and the Tibetan Empire fought for its allegiance until Tibetan rule prevailed late in the eighth century.

Muslim rule came with the Trakhan dynasty, which tradition derives from a Persian adventurer called Azur Jamshid: he overthrew Shri Badat, last of the old Hindu Ras, married his daughter Nur Bakht Khatun, and founded a line named after the Ra Trakhan who reigned about 1300. Its rajas governed Gilgit and a ring of tributary valleys including Yasin, Punial, Astore and Chilas. Raja Torra Khan, ruling from 1421 to 1475, split the family when his stepbrother Shah Rais Khan fled to Badakhshan and seized Chitral, where he founded the Rais line. In the seventeenth century Queen Dadi Jawari held Gilgit and built its irrigation canals. The Trakhan dynasty ended about 1810 with the death of Raja Abbas, after which the rival rajas of Yasin, Punial and Nagar fought over the Gilgit oasis.
zh:
吉尔吉特是印度河上游的王权重地，为吉尔吉特河与罕萨河交汇处的绿洲城镇，地处连接克什米尔、拉达克与塔里木盆地的丝绸之路上。7至8世纪，这里是汉文史料所称小勃律佛教王国的核心，帕托拉·沙希诸王信奉金刚乘佛教，留下了吉尔吉特文书；唐朝与吐蕃曾争夺其宗主权，直到8世纪末吐蕃确立统治。

穆斯林时代由特剌汗王朝开启。按传统说法，王朝开创者是来自波斯的冒险者阿祖尔·贾姆希德：他推翻古老印度教罗阇的末代君主什里·巴达特，娶其女努尔·巴赫特·哈敦为妻，其后裔以约1300年在位的名王特剌汗之名为王朝名。历代罗阇统治吉尔吉特，并统辖亚辛、布尼亚尔、阿斯托尔、奇拉斯等一圈朝贡谷地。1421年至1475年在位的托拉汗时期家族分裂，他的异母弟沙·赖莎汗逃奔巴达赫尚并夺取吉德拉尔，在那里开创赖莎支系统治。17世纪，女王达迪·贾瓦里执掌吉尔吉特，主持修建了灌溉渠。约1810年末代罗阇阿巴斯去世，特剌汗王朝终结，此后亚辛、布尼亚尔和讷格尔的罗阇们为争夺吉尔吉特绿洲连年攻战。

en:
The Principality of Galich, later called Galich-Mersky after the Merya people of the region, was a Rus' appanage centered on the town of Galich on Lake Galichskoye, northeast of Moscow. First recorded in 1234 as Grad Mersky, it grew rich on the salt trade. In 1247 the combined Galich-Dmitrov principality was granted to Konstantin, son of Yaroslav II of Vladimir and brother of Alexander Nevsky; when it split in the 1330s, Fyodor Davydovich took Galich while his brother Boris took Dmitrov, and in 1337 Fyodor's son Ivan Fyodorovich ruled here.

In 1360 the displaced Dmitrov prince briefly held Galich with the Golden Horde's support, but in 1363 Muscovite governors arrived and the ruling family was driven out to Novgorod.

Dmitry Donskoy regranted Galich to his son Yuri in 1389, and Yuri's son Dmitry Shemyaka used its salt wealth to press his claim to the Muscovite throne, until Vasily II annexed the principality in 1450.
zh:
加利奇公国，后按当地的梅里亚部落称加利奇-梅尔斯基，是以莫斯科东北、加利奇湖畔的加利奇城为中心的罗斯封邑。它1234年以梅尔斯基城之名首见记载，靠盐业贸易致富。1247年，加利奇-德米特罗夫公国封给弗拉基米尔的雅罗斯拉夫二世之子、亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟康斯坦丁；14世纪30年代这个合并公国分裂，费奥多尔·达维多维奇分得加利奇，其弟鲍里斯分得德米特罗夫，1337年在位的是费奥多尔之子伊凡·费奥多罗维奇。

1360年，失去德米特罗夫的王公曾在金帐汗国支持下短暂入主加利奇，但1363年莫斯科总督到来，统治家族被逐往诺夫哥罗德。

1389年德米特里·顿斯科伊把加利奇重新封给儿子尤里，尤里之子德米特里·舍米亚卡凭借这里的盐利争夺莫斯科大公之位，直到1450年瓦西里二世吞并公国。

en:
The County of Gleichen took its name from Gleichen Castle, first mentioned in 1034. In 1162 the archbishop of Mainz enfeoffed the counts of Tonna, his protectors at Erfurt, with it, the branch later styling itself counts of Gleichen.

In the thirteenth century the family ranked among Thuringia's leading comital houses, but its Mainz ties brought feud with the Ludovingian landgraves, and debt forced sale of the Erfurt advocacy in 1290 and Eichsfeld estates in 1294. Count Hermann bought the burgrave's office at Ohrdruf in 1332 and received the town in fief from Landgrave Balthasar of Thuringia in 1342; Ohrdruf became the centre of the scattered county.

In 1599 the counts left the old hill castle for their Ohrdruf palace, and on the family's extinction in 1631 the upper county passed to Hohenlohe and the lower county to Schwarzburg-Sondershausen, while Gleichen Castle itself reverted to Mainz.
zh:
格莱兴伯国得名于1034年首见记载的格莱兴城堡。1162年美因茨大主教将城堡封给保护埃尔福特的托纳伯爵，该支系后来改称格莱兴伯爵。

13世纪时格莱兴家族是图林根最显赫的伯爵家族之一，但与美因茨的封建纽带使其与路德维希家族的领地伯爵结仇，债务迫使他们1290年卖掉埃尔福特护佑权、1294年卖掉艾希斯费尔德地产。赫尔曼伯爵1332年购得奥尔德鲁夫城堡长官职，1342年从图林根领地伯爵巴尔塔萨手中受封全城，奥尔德鲁夫成为分散伯国的中心。

1599年伯爵们离开山上古堡，迁入奥尔德鲁夫宫邸；1631年家族绝嗣，上伯国传给霍恩洛厄，下伯国传给施瓦茨堡‑松德斯豪森，城堡本身则归还美因茨。

en:
The Duchy of Głogów, centred on Lower Silesian Głogów, was a Silesian duchy born of medieval Poland's fragmentation. It first appeared in 1177 under Piast prince Konrad and was re-established in 1251, when Konrad I received its northern lands from his brother, Legnica's duke.

When Przemko II died without heirs in 1331, Bohemia's John the Blind seized it as a royal fief and in 1337 enfeoffed Henry I of Jawor. Henry died without issue, and Charles IV joined half to the Bohemian Crown, giving the rest to Żagań's dukes in 1349. The local Piast line ended in 1476, and the Hungarian king Matthias Corvinus conquered it in 1488.

In 1506 Głogów became a direct dominion of the Bohemian Crown, passing to the Habsburgs in 1526; Prussia seized it in 1742, and reform dissolved the duchy in 1815.
zh:
格沃古夫公国是中世纪波兰分裂时期产生的西里西亚公国之一，中心在下西里西亚的格沃古夫。1177年首见于皮亚斯特王公康拉德治下，1251年再度确立，康拉德一世从莱格尼察公爵兄长手中分得北部领地。

1331年普热姆科二世无嗣而终，波希米亚国王盲人约翰收为王室采邑，1337年封给亚沃尔的亨里克一世。亨里克亦无后，查理四世将一半并入波希米亚王冠领地，余者1349年封给扎甘公爵。1476年皮亚斯特血脉断绝，匈牙利国王马加什·科尔温1488年征服公国。

1506年成为波希米亚王冠直属领地，1526年随王冠转入哈布斯堡，1742年被普鲁士夺取，1815年行政改革中废除公国。

en:
Glarus was a Swiss canton in the Linth valley, centred on the town of Glarus. Säckingen Abbey held the area from the ninth century, but by 1288 the Habsburgs had claimed its rights. Glarus joined the Swiss Confederacy in 1352 and declared itself free of Habsburg rule in 1387; its victory at Näfels in 1388 secured that freedom.

Religious division brought separate Catholic and Protestant assemblies in 1623. After Glarus formed part of the canton of Linth from 1798 to 1803, its constitution reunited the assemblies in 1836.
zh:
格拉鲁斯是瑞士的一个州，以林特河谷中的格拉鲁斯镇为中心。塞金根修道院自9世纪起拥有这一地区，但到1288年哈布斯堡家族已宣称取得修道院的权利。格拉鲁斯于1352年加入瑞士邦联，1387年宣布摆脱哈布斯堡统治，并在1388年的内费尔斯战役中获胜，确保了自由。

宗教分歧使天主教徒和新教徒从1623年起分别召开州民大会。1798—1803年格拉鲁斯曾是林特州的一部分，1836年宪法重新合并了两个大会。

en:
The Glens are the nine wooded valleys of the Antrim coast, between the Antrim Plateau and the North Channel, only eighteen miles from the Mull of Kintyre; with Rathlin Island they formed the lordship of the Glens, seated at Glenarm.

The Bissetts, a Norman family from Scotland, reached Ulster in the thirteenth century and became lords of the Glens, among the most Gaelicised of Anglo-Norman settler families. Sir Hugh Bisset opposed Edward Bruce's invasion of Ireland in 1315 and held the barony of Glenarm from 1338.

In 1399 the heiress Margery Byset married John Mór MacDonnell of Clan Donald, giving the Scottish MacDonnells their claim to the Glens, made good by the early sixteenth century. In 1603 Sir Randal MacDonnell received the Glens and the Route from the crown, founding the fortune of the Earls of Antrim.
zh:
格伦斯指安特里姆海岸的九条林木峡谷，夹在安特里姆高原与北海峡之间，距苏格兰金泰尔角仅十八英里；加上拉斯林岛，构成以格莱纳姆为治所的峡谷领地。

比塞特家族是来自苏格兰的诺曼人，13世纪进入阿尔斯特成为峡谷领主，是盖尔化最深的盎格鲁-诺曼移民家族之一。休·比塞特爵士1315年抵御爱德华·布鲁斯入侵爱尔兰，1338年受封格莱纳姆男爵区。

1399年家族女继承人玛杰丽·比塞特嫁给唐纳德家族的约翰·莫尔·麦克唐奈，使苏格兰麦克唐奈家族取得峡谷继承权，并在16世纪初实际接管。1603年兰德尔·麦克唐奈爵士从王室获封峡谷与鲁特地区，奠定安特里姆伯爵家族的基业。

en:
Gaoluo was a Tujia tusi on the upper Qing River in western Hubei, its lands in present Xuan'en County, ruled by a house with the Han surname Tian. Under the Yuan it was a pacification commission, and during the Xia interlude Ming Yuzhen reduced it to a pacification office. The Ming abolished it in 1373 and restored it in 1406 under Yongle, among the chiefdoms rebuilt around the Shizhou guard.

Gaoluo then passed peacefully from Ming to Qing as a hereditary Shinan tusi. It ended in the Yongzheng reforms of 1735, when western Hubei's native offices gave way to appointed magistrates; Xuan'en County was created on the old tusi lands the following year.
zh:
高罗是鄂西清江上游的土家族土司，辖地在今宣恩县一带，统治者汉姓田。元代为宣抚司，大夏明玉珍时改为安抚司。明朝1373年将其废除，1406年永乐年间重新设置，是施州卫周边复建的土司之一。

此后高罗作为施南土司群中的世袭辖地，平稳由明入清。1735年雍正改土归流，鄂西土司机构被流官取代，次年在旧土司地上设宣恩县。

en:
Galloway was a lordship in south-west Scotland, named for people of Gaelic and Norse descent. Its rulers could acknowledge the Scottish king while exercising considerable authority at home.

Fergus took power in the early twelfth century, and his descendants ruled until Alan died in 1234. Alexander II then divided the lordship among Alan's daughters, despite a revolt in favour of his son Thomas.
zh:
加洛韦是苏格兰西南部的领地，得名于盖尔人与诺斯人的混血后裔。其统治者有时承认苏格兰国王的宗主权，同时在本地拥有很大权力。

弗格斯于12世纪初掌权，他的后代一直统治到1234年阿兰去世。尽管有人发动起义支持阿兰之子托马斯，亚历山大二世仍将领地分给阿兰的女儿们。

en:
Glamorgan was the richest Welsh marcher lordship, seated at Cardiff Castle on the south Wales coast. It was created around 1093, when Robert Fitzhamon overthrew Iestyn ap Gwrgant, Morgannwg's last king, and divided the lowlands among his Twelve Knights of Glamorgan.

It passed to the earls of Gloucester and then to the de Clare family, whose marcher rights allowed war and castle-building without crown leave. When Gilbert de Clare fell at Bannockburn in 1314, his sister Eleanor brought Glamorgan to her husband Hugh Despenser the Younger, whose hunger for Welsh lands helped provoke the 1321 baronial revolt before his execution in 1326.
