Restored to the Despensers in 1338, it passed through the Beauchamp and Neville families, reaching Richard III before 1485, and merged with the crown under Henry VII in 1495. The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535–1542 ended those privileges.
zh:
格拉摩根是威尔士最富庶的边境领主领，治所设在南威尔士沿海的加的夫城堡。约1093年罗伯特·菲茨哈蒙推翻摩根努格末代国王叶斯汀·阿普·古尔甘特，把低地分封给麾下十二骑士。

领地先后传格洛斯特伯爵家族与德·克莱尔家族，凭边境领特权不经王权批准即可开战、筑城。1314年吉尔伯特·德·克莱尔战死于班诺克本，其妹埃莉诺把格拉摩根带给丈夫小休·勒德斯潘塞；他贪求威尔士土地成为1321年贵族叛乱的诱因之一，1326年被处决。

1338年归还勒德斯潘塞家族，后经比彻姆、内维尔家族，1485年前由理查三世领有，1495年亨利七世时并入王冠。1535—1542年《威尔士法令》废除这些特权。

en:
The County of Mark was an imperial Westphalian state straddling the Ruhr, seated at Burg Mark near Hamm. It grew from the lands of a collateral Berg line: Frederick I built Mark Castle c. 1198, his son Adolf I founding Hamm in 1226.

At Worringen in 1288 Eberhard II fought with Brabant against Cologne, and Cologne's defeat made Mark southern Westphalia's leading lordship; Münster wars added the northern Higher Mark. In 1337 Count Adolf II ruled; his younger son inherited Cleves in 1368 and Mark in 1391, uniting them as Cleves-Mark in 1394.

From 1521 it lay in the Jülich-Cleves-Berg union; on the dynasty's extinction in 1609 the 1614 Treaty of Xanten assigned it to Brandenburg. The 1807 Tilsit treaties gave it to France, and it passed to the Grand Duchy of Berg in 1808; it returned to Prussia in 1813 and Westphalia Province in 1815.
zh:
马克伯国是帝国跨鲁尔河的威斯特伐利亚邦国，治所为哈姆附近的马克城堡，源出贝格旁支。弗里德里希一世约1198年筑马克城堡，其子阿道夫一世1226年建哈姆城。

1288年沃林根战役，埃伯哈德二世联布拉班特抗科隆，科隆战败后马克成威斯特伐利亚南部首要领地，对明斯特战争再夺北方上马克。1337年阿道夫二世在位，幼子1368年继克莱沃、1391年继马克，1394年合为克莱沃-马克。

1521年入于利希-克莱沃-贝格邦联，1609年王朝绝嗣，1614年《克桑滕条约》归勃兰登堡选帝侯。1807年《提尔西特条约》归法国，1808年入贝格大公国，1813年归普鲁士，1815年入威斯特伐利亚。

en:
The Gong tusi in southern Sichuan, seated at Luoji in the hills above the Yangtze, was the country of the Bo people and preserves their best-known hanging-coffin cliffs at Matangba. The early Tang used loose-rein prefectures there, and under the Song it answered to the Changning military prefecture.

It submitted to the Mongols in 1276, the Yuan setting up the Lower Luoji chief's office over its tribes; when neighbouring peoples rebelled in 1285, Lower Luoji alone stayed loyal. At the end of the Yuan, Ming Yuzhen of the Xia state reorganized it as Gongzhou, and in 1371 the Ming demoted it to Gong County under Xuzhou.

The Bo rising of 1573 reached Gong County, and imperial troops besieged its cliffs; afterwards the Bo were absorbed or gone, though their log coffins still mark the gorges.
zh:
珙地土司位于川南，治所罗计地处长江上游山地，是僰人故土，麻塘坝僰人悬棺崖是现存最集中的悬棺遗址。唐初以羁縻州治理，宋代归附长宁军。

1276年投降蒙古，元朝设下罗计长官司统辖当地部族；1285年周边诸蛮反元，唯有下罗计长官司忠心不贰。元末大夏明玉珍改置珙州，1371年明朝降为珙县，隶属叙州府。

1573年僰人起事波及珙县，官军围攻这里的山崖；此后僰人或被同化或离散，只有整木凿成的悬棺仍留在峡谷中。

en:
Gonjo, called Guanjue in Ming records, was a small Khampa chiefdom in the gorges of eastern Kham, centred on the Gonjo valley in present Chamdo, where Kagyu and Sakya monasteries had stood since the thirteenth century. Its ruler was a Karma Kagyu hierarch whose ancestors held the Yuan-era Do-Kham guard commission.

In 1406 the monk Nankar Balsang sent tribute to the Yongle court at Nanjing and received the title State Preceptor, and in 1407 was enfeoffed Guardian King of the Faith with a golden seal. On his death in 1414 his nephew inherited the rank in 1415, but died without an heir and the Ming title lapsed.

It remained one of the patchwork of Kham chiefdoms lying between Derge and Chamdo. In the Qing period it fell within the Tibetan-administered portion of Kham.
zh:
贡觉明代文献译作馆觉，是康区东部峡谷中的康巴小酋长政权，中心在今昌都贡觉一带，13世纪起这里建有噶举派和萨迦派寺院。统治者是噶玛噶举派高僧，祖先曾受封元代朵甘卫指挥使。

1406年僧人南喀巴藏卜遣使到南京向永乐皇帝朝贡，受封灌顶国师；1407年又封护教王，赐金印。1414年他去世，侄子1415年袭封，死后无嗣，明朝封爵断绝。

此后贡觉仍是德格与昌都之间的康区酋长政权之一。清代它处于拉萨管辖的康区一侧。

en:
Guangnan was a Zhuang tusi prefecture in the karst hills of southeastern Yunnan, centred on present Guangnan in Wenshan, astride the old routes between Yunnan, Guangxi and Annam. Under the Song it was the jimi Temo circuit, a stronghold of the Nong clan: Nong Zhigao took refuge there after his 1052–1053 rebellion was crushed by Di Qing, and his descendants kept the chiefship.

In the 1270s the Yuan set up the Guangnan West Route pacification commission, which at first oversaw five native subprefectures. The Ming conquest made it Guangnan Prefecture under hereditary Nong native prefects; unrest among native officials required campaigning as late as the 1630s.

The Qing brought in circulating officials from 1661, added the Weimo district in 1669, and set up Baoning County at the seat in 1736, leaving only Fuzhou as a native subprefecture.
zh:
广南是云南东南喀斯特山区的壮族土司府，治所在今文山广南，扼守云南、广西与安南之间的古道。宋代为羁縻特磨道，是侬氏大本营：1052—1053年侬智高反宋被狄青镇压后退入此地，后裔世代承袭首领。

1270年代元朝设广南西路宣抚司，初领五个土州。明军平云南后改广南府，仍由侬氏世袭土知府，直到1630年代朝廷仍需用兵平定土官的骚乱。

清朝1661年起派流官，1669年并入维摩州地，1736年在府治设宝宁县，府下只剩富州一个土州。

en:
The County of Geneva emerged in the tenth century in the Burgundian Kingdom of Arles, which passed to the Holy Roman Empire in 1032. Its counts ruled the Genevois countryside around Annecy, their capital from 1219, but not the city of Geneva, governed by its bishops from 1124, while the Counts of Savoy encircled the county and held its trade routes.

In 1337 the count was Amadeus III, whose mother was a daughter of Amadeus V of Savoy; he served the Savoy court as regent. His youngest son Robert became the antipope Clement VII in 1378 and inherited the county in 1392, but his death in 1394 ended the House of Geneva.

The heiress married into the lords of Thoire-Villars, whose heir Odo sold the county to Amadeus VIII of Savoy in 1401. Amadeus merged it into lands Sigismund raised to the Duchy of Savoy in 1416.
zh:
日内瓦伯国出现于10世纪，地处勃艮第阿尔勒王国境内，该王国1032年并入神圣罗马帝国。伯爵统治以阿讷西为中心的日内瓦乡野，阿讷西1219年起为都城，但不统治日内瓦城：该城1124年起由主教治理，扩张的萨伏依伯爵则四面包围伯国、控制商路。

1337年在位的是阿梅迪奥三世，其母为萨伏依阿梅迪奥五世之女，他在萨伏依宫廷担任摄政。幼子罗贝尔1378年被选为对立教宗克莱门特七世，1392年继承伯国，1394年去世后日内瓦家族绝嗣。

女继承人嫁入图瓦尔-维拉尔家族，1401年继承人奥多把伯国卖给萨伏依的阿梅迪奥八世，后者将其并入皇帝西吉斯蒙德1416年升为萨伏依公国的领地。

en:
Goa is an island-studded harbour on the Konkan coast, where the Mandovi and Zuari meet the Arabian Sea. The Kadambas established their kingdom in 960 and moved their court to Gopakapattana. The Kadamba kings, devout Shaivites, built Shiva temples.

Delhi's armies reached the Konkan early in the fourteenth century and sacked Gopakapattana; on 16 October 1345 the last Kadamba king Suriya Deva was assassinated. Bahmani sultans held Goa from 1350 until Vijayanagara retook it in 1370, its harbours receiving Arabian horses for the cavalry. Bahmani forces returned in 1469, and in 1492 it passed to Bijapur's Adil Shahis, who made Old Goa their second capital.

In 1510 Afonso de Albuquerque seized the city for Portugal on a second assault. It became capital of the Portuguese Estado da India, seat of the viceroy and the 1560–1812 Goa Inquisition, staying Portuguese long after surrounding lands passed to Britain and the Marathas.
zh:
果阿是孔坎海岸的岛港群，曼多维、祖阿里河在此注入阿拉伯海。960年卡达姆巴人建立王国，将朝廷迁至戈帕卡帕塔纳。虔诚信奉湿婆的卡达姆巴诸王广建湿婆神庙。

14世纪初德里兵抵孔坎，戈帕卡帕塔纳遭洗劫，1345年10月16日末代国王苏利耶提婆被刺。巴赫马尼1350年据果阿，1370年毗奢耶那伽罗收复，各港输入阿拉伯战马装备其骑兵。1469年巴赫马尼再占，1492年归比贾布尔阿迪勒沙王朝，果阿旧城成第二都城。

1510年阿尔布克尔克经第二次强攻为葡萄牙夺城，果阿成葡属印度首府、总督驻地，1560—1812年设宗教裁判所，周围土地落入英国和马拉塔人之手后仍长期属葡萄牙。

en:
Gobir, northernmost of the seven Hausa states, was by tradition war-king guarding Hausaland against the Tuareg; its Gobirawa kept a fierce martial name for nearly seven centuries. Founded in the 1100s, it first grew in the Aïr mountains.

In the 1400s Leo Africanus found herdsmen and linen weavers whose goods reached Timbuktu and Gao; Tuareg pressure and the rising Agadez sultanate drove the Gobirawa south, and they settled on Zamfara land early in the 1700s. Babari (1742–1770) destroyed his hosts' capital Birnin Zamfara about 1756 and built walled Alkalawa.

Its match was the reformer Usman dan Fodio, welcomed by Sarki Bawa in 1774. His pupil Yunfa, king from 1803, expelled him; dan Fodio proclaimed the Fulani jihad, took Alkalawa in 1808 and killed Yunfa. Remnant Gobirawa founded rival Tibiri in 1836, but Sokoto crushed them at Gawakuke that year.
zh:
戈比尔是豪萨七城邦最北者，传统上身为战争之王，守豪萨兰、御图阿雷格人，戈比拉瓦人近七百年武名不坠。王国建于12世纪，最初在阿伊尔山地发展。

15世纪利奥·阿非利加努斯见其牧人、织工遍布，布履远销廷巴克图、加奥；图阿雷格压迫与阿加德兹崛起迫使戈比拉瓦人南迁，18世纪初落脚扎姆法拉。巴巴里（1742—1770年在位）约1756年摧毁东道主都城比尔宁扎姆法拉，筑有城墙的新都阿尔卡拉瓦。

劲敌是改革者乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥，1774年为国王巴瓦迎入。学生云法1803年继位后逐走他，丹·福迪奥发起富拉尼圣战，1808年破阿尔卡拉瓦、杀云法。残部1836年另立蒂比里，同年败于索科托加瓦库凯。

en:
Golog is the loose confederation of Tibetan nomad tribes pasturing around the upper Yellow River and the sacred mountain Amnye Machen in southern Amdo. Its people were not one stock but an amalgam of refugees and migrants drawn from across Amdo and Kham. The Tibetan name mgo log is glossed as turned head or rebellious.

The Golog were famed in both Lhasa and Beijing as fierce fighters whom neither Tibetan nor Chinese power subdued for long; legend remembered rule by a queen, an incarnate goddess whose office passed from mother to daughter. Some tribes gave allegiance to Labrang Monastery while many remained independent.

In 1828 Golog tribes plundered the caravan of the Amdo mystic Shabkar despite letters of passage from the Dalai and Panchen Lamas, and the Qing amban at Xining admitted the tribes lay beyond imperial control.
zh:
果洛是安多南部、黄河上游与圣山阿尼玛卿山一带游牧的藏族部落松散联盟。果洛人并非同族同源，而是从安多和康区各地汇聚而来的避难者与移民融合而成。藏语“果洛”有“掉头”“反叛”之意。

无论拉萨还是北京都深知其善战，西藏和中国的势力都无法长久降服他们；传说中果洛曾由一位女王统治，她是化身的女神，权位母女相传。部分部落归附拉卜楞寺，许多部落则保持独立。

1828年，果洛部落洗劫了安多修行者夏嘎巴的商队，尽管后者持有达赖喇嘛和班禅喇嘛的通行文书；驻西宁的青海办事大臣也承认，这些部落不在朝廷掌控之中。

en:
The County of Gorizia was a state of the Holy Roman Empire whose lords, the Meinhardiner counts, held lands split between Gorizia in Friuli and Lienz in the upper Drava valley. Originally stewards of the Patriarchs of Aquileia, the family was enfeoffed with Gorizia early in the twelfth century and reached its height in 1253, when Count Meinhard inherited Tyrol.

The heritage was divided in 1271. Count Henry III's assassination in 1323 brought another split among heirs; the Tyrolean branch died out in 1335, the Gorizia line keeping Lienz and Friuli. In 1365 Emperor Charles IV raised Gorizia to a princely county.

Pressed by the Habsburgs and Venice, the Meinhardiner declined until the last count, Leonhard, died in 1500, when the estates passed to Emperor Maximilian I.
zh:
戈里齐亚伯国是神圣罗马帝国邦国，迈因哈德家族的伯爵们领有分处弗留利戈里齐亚与德拉瓦河上游利恩茨的两片土地。家族本是阿奎莱亚宗主教区的地方长官，12世纪初受封戈里齐亚庄园，1253年迈因哈德伯爵继承蒂罗尔伯国，势力达到顶峰。

1271年家族遗产被瓜分。1323年亨利三世遇刺后土地再被继承人分割，蒂罗尔支系1335年绝嗣，戈里齐亚支系继续领有利恩茨和弗留利。1365年查理四世将戈里齐亚升格为藩侯伯国。

在哈布斯堡与威尼斯夹逼下，迈因哈德家族日渐衰落，末代伯爵莱昂哈德1500年去世，领地归入皇帝马克西米利安一世。

en:
Goslar was a Free Imperial City on the north-western slopes of the Harz, wealthy from the silver mines of the nearby Rammelsberg. First mentioned in 979, it became a favoured imperial residence, and Henry IV was born in its Imperial Palace in 1050. An anti-king was crowned in Goslar in 1081, when the town gained the status of an Imperial City.

Goslar joined the Hanseatic League in 1267 and secured full Vogt rights by 1290, becoming a free imperial city whose mining law of 1359 was copied across the region.

In 1527 Duke Henry V of Wolfenbüttel seized the Rammelsberg mines, opening a long feud. The Reformation was introduced in 1531. Occupied by Swedish troops during the Thirty Years' War, Goslar never recovered the mines. Prussian troops annexed it in 1802, and the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Hanover in 1815.
zh:
戈斯拉尔是哈茨山西北麓的帝国自由城市，因附近拉默尔斯贝格的银矿而富庶。它最早见于979年的记载，后成为皇帝喜爱的驻跸地，亨利四世于1050年出生在当地的帝国行宫。1081年一位对立国王在戈斯拉尔加冕，该城由此取得帝国城市地位。

戈斯拉尔于1267年加入汉萨同盟，1290年前取得完整的地方长官权，成为帝国自由城市；其1359年编纂的矿业法被各地仿效。

1527年，沃尔芬比特尔公爵亨利五世夺取拉默尔斯贝格银矿，开启长期争端。1531年宗教改革传入。三十年战争期间瑞典军队占领戈斯拉尔，该城再未能收回银矿。1802年普鲁士吞并该城，维也纳会议于1815年把它划归汉诺威。

en:
Gowa was the dominant kingdom of the Makassarese people at the southern tip of Sulawesi. The realm early split into the two kingdoms of Gowa and Tallo, reunited under King Tunipalangga early in the sixteenth century as a twin polity often called Makassar. Its rulers welcomed foreign merchants, and Makassar grew into a busy trading port in eastern Indonesia.

In 1605 its king accepted Islam and took the name Sultan Alauddin, turning Gowa into a sultanate. The Islamic wars of 1611 brought the rival Bugis state of Bone and the rest of southwest Sulawesi under its sway.

Conflict with the Dutch East India Company followed. In the Makassar War of 1666 to 1669 the VOC, allied with the Bugis prince Arung Palakka, defeated Sultan Hasanuddin, imposed the Treaty of Bungaya in 1667 and stormed Somba Opu in 1669, ending Gowa's status as an independent great power.
zh:
戈瓦是苏拉威西岛南端望加锡人最强盛的王国。早期王国分裂为戈瓦和塔洛两个王国，16世纪初在国王图尼帕朗加治下重新合并为一个二元政权，常被称作望加锡。历代君主欢迎外国商人，望加锡由此成为印度尼西亚东部繁忙的商港。

1605年，国王皈依伊斯兰教，改名苏丹阿拉丁，戈瓦成为苏丹国。1611年的伊斯兰战争使其世仇布吉人国家波尼及苏拉威西西南部尽入其掌控。

此后戈瓦与荷兰东印度公司发生冲突。1666至1669年的望加锡战争中，公司联合布吉王公阿隆·帕拉卡击败苏丹哈桑丁，1667年迫其签署《邦加亚条约》，1669年攻陷松巴奥普，戈瓦从此失去独立强国的地位。

en:
Granada was the Nasrid emirate, last independent Muslim state in the Iberian Peninsula. When the Almohads withdrew in 1228, the commander Muhammad Ibn al-Ahmar was proclaimed emir at Arjona in 1232 and entered Granada in 1238, making it his capital and founding the Alhambra. By 1250 it was the only Muslim polity left in the peninsula, and the Treaty of Jaén of 1246 had already made it a Castile tributary.

In 1333 the Marinids retook Gibraltar for the Nasrids, and Yusuf I opened the emirate's golden age, though the allied Marinid and Granadan army was crushed at the Battle of Río Salado in 1340 and Algeciras fell in 1344. Under Muhammad V, who died in 1391, the Alhambra gained the Palace of the Lions.

Dynastic strife weakened the emirate, Castile took Gibraltar in 1462, and the Granada War began in 1482 with Alhama's fall. After Málaga fell in 1487, Boabdil signed the Treaty of Granada in 1491 and surrendered on 2 January 1492.
zh:
格拉纳达是奈斯尔王朝的酋长国，也是伊比利亚半岛最后一个独立穆斯林政权。1228年阿尔摩哈德人撤离后，将领穆罕默德·伊本·艾哈迈尔于1232年在阿尔霍纳被拥立为埃米尔，1238年进入格拉纳达并定都于此，兴建阿尔罕布拉宫。到1250年，它已是半岛仅存的穆斯林政权，而1246年的《哈恩条约》早已使它成为卡斯蒂利亚的附庸。

1333年马林王朝替奈斯尔人夺回直布罗陀，优素福一世开启了酋长国的黄金时代，尽管1340年马林与格拉纳达联军在里奥萨拉多战役惨败，1344年阿尔赫西拉斯也告失守。穆罕默德五世（1391年去世）在位时，阿尔罕布拉宫增建狮子庭院。

王朝内讧削弱了国家，1462年卡斯蒂利亚夺取直布罗陀，1482年格拉纳达战争以阿尔阿马失守开局。1487年马拉加陷落后，布阿卜迪勒于1491年签订《格拉纳达条约》，并于1492年1月2日献城投降。

en:
Greece emerged as an independent state from a revolt against the Ottoman Empire. The Greek War of Independence began in 1821, and the assembly at Epidaurus adopted a constitution and established a central administration in 1822. Civil wars and an Egyptian intervention threatened the revolution, but British, French and Russian fleets destroyed the Ottoman-Egyptian fleet at Navarino in 1827.

Ioannis Kapodistrias arrived as governor in 1828 and was assassinated in 1831. Independence was recognized in 1830, and in 1832 the powers established a kingdom under Otto of Bavaria.
zh:
希腊在反抗奥斯曼帝国的起义中成为独立国家。希腊独立战争于1821年爆发，埃皮达鲁斯议会在1822年通过宪法并建立中央政府。内战和埃及的干预威胁着革命，但英国、法国和俄罗斯舰队于1827年在纳瓦里诺摧毁了奥斯曼与埃及的联合舰队。

爱奥尼斯·卡波季斯第亚斯于1828年抵达希腊担任总督，1831年遇刺身亡。希腊的独立于1830年获得承认，列强又在1832年建立王国，由巴伐利亚的奥托担任国王。

en:
The County of Hals was an imperial-immediate lordship of the Bavarian Forest, named after Hals Castle on a loop of the Ilz near the Danube. A noble called Rotbert is first attested at Hals in 1112 and probably built the castle.

Around 1160 Albert of Kamm inherited the lordship through marriage, and in 1280 King Rudolf I raised his successor to imperial count. The counts pushed their lands north through the Nordwald to the Bohemian border and secured the Goldener Steig trade route into Bohemia.

In 1337 Count Johann of Hals was the last of his line. When the family died out in 1375, Landgrave Johann of Leuchtenberg won the fief with Emperor Charles IV's favour. Mounting debt then fragmented the county, and the remaining shares were sold to the Wittelsbachs in 1517.
zh:
哈尔斯伯国是拜恩林山中的帝国直辖领地，得名于伊尔茨河一处河弯上、靠近多瑙河的哈尔斯堡。1112年，一位名叫罗特贝特的贵族首见于记载，城堡大概就是他所建。

约1160年，卡姆的阿尔伯特通过联姻继承这片领地；1280年，国王鲁道夫一世将其继承人封为帝国伯爵。历任伯爵向北穿过北林开拓疆土，直抵波希米亚边境，控制了通往波希米亚的“黄金小道”商路。

1337年在位的哈尔斯伯爵约翰是家族末代传人。1375年家族绝嗣，洛伊希滕贝格藩侯约翰凭借皇帝查理四世的恩宠得到采邑。此后债务缠身，伯国四分五裂，剩余份额于1517年卖给维特尔斯巴赫家族。

en:
Gurgan was the power base of Togha Temür, the last major Genghisid claimant to the Ilkhanid throne. He was descended from Qasar, a brother of Genghis Khan, and led the Chete, a nomadic tribe settled between Astarabad and Gorgan on the Caspian's south-eastern shore.

After Abu Sa'id's death in 1335, the princes of eastern Iran accepted Togha Temür as Ilkhan; in 1337 he marched west and occupied Soltaniyeh, but the Jalayirids and Chobanids drove him back, and after 1344 his authority was confined to Gurgan, Mazandaran and much of Khurasan.

The Sarbadar revolt began in his own tax lands: the rebels defeated his armies, killed his brother, and in 1353 their leader Yahya Karawi murdered him in his camp near Astarabad, slaughtering his household and troops. Togha Temür's governor's son Amir Vali seized the Gurgan lands, while Togha Temür's son Luqman-Padishah was restored at Astarabad only in 1384 as Timur's vassal, his descendants holding the town into the early fifteenth century.
zh:
朱里章是脱合帖木儿的权力根基，他是伊儿汗位最后一位有力的成吉思汗家族竞争者。他是成吉思汗之弟合撒儿的后裔，统领游牧的切特部，该部已在里海东南岸阿斯塔拉巴德与戈尔甘之间定居。

1335年不赛因死后，东伊朗诸王公拥戴脱合帖木儿为伊儿汗；1337年他西征并占领苏丹尼耶，但被札剌亦儿王朝与楚邦王朝击退，1344年后其权威仅限于朱里章、马赞达兰和呼罗珊大部。

萨尔毕道朗起义爆发于他的税地：起义军屡败其军队、杀死他的兄弟，1353年其首领叶海亚·卡拉维在阿斯塔拉巴德附近的营帐中将他刺杀，并屠戮其家眷部众。此后脱合帖木儿的总督之子埃米尔·瓦利篡取了朱里章领地，而脱合帖木儿的儿子鲁克曼-帕迪沙直到1384年才被帖木儿立为附庸、恢复在阿斯塔拉巴德的统治，其后人保有该城直至15世纪初。

en:
Gurk was the small prince-bishopric in the Gurk valley of Carinthia, whose bishops were suffragans of the Archbishop of Salzburg. It grew from the piety of Countess Hemma, who founded a Benedictine monastery at Gurk in 1043 and was buried there. After her death Archbishop Gebhard of Salzburg in 1072 erected the Diocese of Gurk on her endowment, Salzburg's first bishopric of its own.

The bishops only received a defined diocese in 1131; their efforts to break free of Salzburg, even through forged charters, never fully succeeded. The Romanesque cathedral was raised between 1140 and 1200, and Hemma's relics were translated to its crypt in 1174.

For centuries the bishops resided at Strassburg Castle near Gurk, moving to Pöckstein in 1783 and to Klagenfurt in 1787 under Josephinist reforms, when the diocese was greatly enlarged.
zh:
古尔克是克恩滕古尔克河谷的小型主教诸侯邦，主教是萨尔茨堡大主教的副主教。它的建立源于女伯爵赫玛的虔诚：她于1043年在古尔克创办本笃派修道院，身后葬于该院。她去世后，萨尔茨堡大主教格布哈德于1072年用赫玛的遗产建立古尔克教区，这是萨尔茨堡第一个自有教区。

主教们直到1131年才得到划定的教区；他们试图摆脱萨尔茨堡的控制，甚至伪造文书，始终未能完全独立。罗曼式主教座堂建于1140至1200年间，赫玛的遗骸于1174年迁入座堂地宫。

数百年间，主教驻在古尔克附近的施特拉斯堡城堡，1783年迁往珀克施泰因，又在约瑟夫主义改革中于1787年移驻克拉根福，教区此时大幅扩张。

en:
Greenland entered medieval history when Erik the Red, exiled from Iceland, led Norse settlers to its ice-free southwestern fjords in 985 or 986. They built the Eastern and Western Settlements, Erik's farm standing at Brattahlid, and in 1126 Garðar became Greenland's bishop's seat.

The settlers kept cattle, exported walrus ivory and furs, and in 1261 accepted Norwegian sovereignty; around the same time the Thule Inuit spread south and became the dominant population by 1300. Cooling climate, failing trade and weakening contacts doomed the Norse colonies: the Western Settlement was empty by the mid-fourteenth century, and the Eastern Settlement's last record is a wedding at Hvalsey in 1408, after which it was abandoned.

For centuries only Inuit remained, while Denmark-Norway maintained its claim. In 1721 the missionary Hans Egede founded a new colony but found no Norse survivors, and Danish stations and a monopoly followed; the Treaty of Kiel in 1814 confirmed Greenland as a Danish dependency when Norway passed to Sweden.
zh:
格陵兰进入中世纪史，始于985或986年：被冰岛放逐的红发埃里克率领诺斯人移居到岛上无冰的西南峡湾。他们建立了东、西两个殖民地，埃里克的农庄设在布拉塔利德；1126年，加尔扎尔成为格陵兰的主教驻地。

定居者饲养牲畜，出口海象牙和毛皮，并于1261年接受挪威宗主权；与此同时，图勒人沿海岸南下，到1300年已成为占优势的居民。此后气候转冷、贸易萎缩、与挪威和冰岛的联系减弱，诺斯殖民地走向灭亡：西殖民地在14世纪中叶已空无一人，东殖民地留下的最后文字记录是1408年赫瓦尔塞的一场婚礼，随后也遭废弃。

此后数百年间岛上只剩因纽特人，而丹麦—挪威始终未放弃主权主张。1721年传教士汉斯·埃格德建立新殖民地，却没有找到任何诺斯幸存者，丹麦商站和贸易垄断随之而来；1814年《基尔条约》在挪威被割让给瑞典时，确认格陵兰为丹麦属地。

en:
The Germiyanid beylik was a Turkoman dynasty that ruled western Anatolia from Kütahya from around 1300 to 1429. First recorded near Malatya in the thirteenth century, where it helped the Seljuks of Rum suppress the Babai revolt in 1239, the tribe moved west under Mongol pressure; as the Sultanate of Rum dissolved, Yakub I made Germiyan independent, warring with the Ottomans and the Byzantine Empire.

The beylik reached its height in the fourteenth century, its Kütahya court becoming a center of architecture and letters, where Persian works were translated into Turkish. Under Suleiman the marriage of his daughter Devletşah Hatun to the Ottoman prince Bayezid I in 1381 brought Kütahya and much of the realm as her dowry.

Yakub II was imprisoned by Bayezid in 1390 but escaped to Timur, fought at the Battle of Ankara in 1402 and recovered his lands. After further occupations by the Karamanids and the Ottomans, Yakub died without a male heir in 1429, leaving Germiyan to the Ottoman sultan Murad II in his will.
zh:
盖尔米扬贝伊国是约1300至1429年间以屈塔希亚为都、统治安纳托利亚西部的突厥蛮王朝。该部落13世纪首见于马拉蒂亚附近的记载，1239年曾协助罗姆塞尔柱人镇压巴巴起义，后在蒙古压力下西迁；罗姆苏丹国瓦解时，雅各布一世使盖尔米扬独立，与奥斯曼人和拜占庭帝国交战。

14世纪是贝伊国的鼎盛期，屈塔希亚宫廷成为建筑和学术中心，多部波斯作品在此被译成土耳其语。苏莱曼在位时，女儿黛夫莱莎哈屯于1381年嫁给奥斯曼王子巴耶济德一世，屈塔希亚和大片国土作为嫁妆转入奥斯曼之手。

雅各布二世1390年被巴耶济德囚禁，后逃脱投奔帖木儿，参加1402年的安卡拉战役并得以复国。历经卡拉曼人和奥斯曼人的占领之后，没有男性继承人的雅各布于1429年去世，遗嘱中把盖尔米扬留给奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德二世。

en:
Garrochamba was one of the chiefdoms of the Palta nation, the agricultural, Amazonian-derived peoples of the Loja highlands in southern Ecuador. Its main town, also called Garrochamba, stood on the summit of the El Cascajo hill at a site called Pueblo Viejo, overlooking the fertile Catamayo valley.

Along with other Palta groups it belonged to the confederation that fought the invading Inca armies of Tupac Inca Yupanqui, Sapa Inca from 1471 to 1493, before being incorporated into the Tahuantinsuyo.

After the Spanish conquest the first town of Loja was founded in the Garrochamba valley in 1546, and in 1571 the indigenous settlement was replaced by the reduction town of Catacocha; its people were dispersed and the old chiefdom extinguished.
zh:
加罗钱巴是帕勒塔民族的酋长邦之一，帕勒塔人是渊源于亚马孙的农耕民族，聚居于厄瓜多尔南部的洛哈高地。其主城也叫加罗钱巴，坐落在埃尔卡斯卡霍山顶的普埃布洛维霍遗址，俯瞰肥沃的卡塔马约河谷。

它与其他帕勒塔族群同属一个联盟，曾抗击1471年至1493年在位的萨帕·印卡图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的入侵大军，最终被并入塔万廷苏尤。

西班牙征服后，洛哈城于1546年首次建在加罗钱巴河谷；1571年，原住民聚落被归化城镇卡塔科查取代，居民流散，古老的酋长邦就此消亡。

en:
Gorodets is a Volga fortress town northwest of Nizhny Novgorod, traditionally founded in 1152 by Yury Dolgoruky and first chronicled in 1172. It served the princes of Vladimir and Suzdal as a base against Volga Bulgaria, was burned by Batu Khan in 1239, and in 1263 Alexander Nevsky died there.

His son Andrey of Gorodets made the town his residence, and from his appanage the Gorodets principality emerged in the late thirteenth century. When his line died out the town escheated to Vladimir's grand prince in 1320, so Ivan I Kalita held it in 1337. In 1341 it joined the Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal grand principality, which Moscow absorbed in 1392.

In 1408 Edigu's Mongol army razed the town, which lay deserted for two centuries as Gorodets Pustoy, Gorodets the Empty, before it was reborn as a trading village.
zh:
戈罗杰茨是下诺夫哥罗德西北方的伏尔加河要塞城镇，相传1152年由尤里·多尔戈鲁基修建，编年史首次见于1172年。它是弗拉基米尔和苏兹达尔王公征伐伏尔加保加利亚的基地，1239年被拔都汗焚毁，1263年亚历山大·涅夫斯基在此去世。

他的儿子戈罗杰茨的安德烈以该城为治所，13世纪后期戈罗杰茨公国从他的封邑中形成。安德烈世系断绝后，城镇于1320年作为绝封领地收归弗拉基米尔大公，1337年由伊凡一世·卡利塔持有。1341年它并入下诺夫哥罗德-苏兹达尔大公国，1392年被莫斯科吞并。

1408年也迪古的蒙古军队将城池夷为平地，此后两个世纪荒无人烟，被称为“空城戈罗杰茨”，后来才作为商贸村庄复兴。

en:
Gorontalo was a kingdom on the northern arm of Celebes; its name is held to derive from Huidu Totolu, the three mountains of the peninsula. In the fourteenth century King Ilahudu is said to have bound seventeen hill chiefdoms into the kingdom of Gorontalo, held together by the kinship order called pohala'a.

In 1337 it was still a pagan inland court, its first town at Hulawa on the Bolango River. Islam reached the court in the early sixteenth century under King Amai, who took the title sultan, and King Ilato built the Otanaha fortress in 1522. By 1525, when the Portuguese reached northern Celebes, the region was divided among Muslim states.

These states had earlier stood under Ternate's influence. A later Dutch East India Company treaty folded Gorontalo into its administration, and eighteenth-century forced labour drove many of its people to migrate to Ternate, Ambon and Banggai.
zh:
哥伦打洛是苏拉威西北部半岛上的王国，其名称一般认为源自“三座山”（Huidu Totolu），指半岛上的三座山。14世纪时，伊拉胡杜王据说把十七个山地酋长邦合并为哥伦打洛王国，靠称为波哈拉的亲缘秩序维系。

1337年时它还是信奉本土信仰的内陆朝廷，最早的城镇建在博朗戈河畔的胡拉瓦。16世纪初，阿迈王接受伊斯兰教并采用苏丹称号，伊拉托王于1522年修建奥塔纳哈要塞。到1525年葡萄牙人抵达北苏拉威西时，这一地区已分属若干穆斯林政权。

这些小邦此前受特尔纳特影响。后来荷兰东印度公司通过条约把哥伦打洛纳入其管辖，18世纪的强迫劳役迫使许多居民迁往特尔纳特、安汶和邦盖。

en:
The County of Gruyère was an Alpine lordship in the upper Sarine valley, attested from the mid-twelfth century as successor to the old county of Ogoz. Its rulers took their name from the gruerie, the forest-warden's office under the kings of Burgundy, and moved their seat to Gruyères Castle.

In 1244 Count Rudolf III placed the county under Savoy's suzerainty while keeping broad autonomy, and in 1331 Count Peter III, ruling in 1337, signed a combourgeoisie treaty with Fribourg. The counts backed Fribourg against Bern at Laupen in 1339. Marriage politics extended their rule over Vaud lordships, until debt forced sales.

After 1528 the counts stood against the Reformation, worsening their quarrel with Protestant Bern. In 1554 the federal diet declared the county bankrupt, and in 1555 Bern and Fribourg divided it: Bern took the upper valley, while Fribourg kept Gruyères as a bailiwick.
zh:
格吕耶尔伯国是萨讷河上游的阿尔卑斯领地，12世纪中叶已有记载，前身为古老的奥戈伯国。统治者的名号得自他们在勃艮第国王麾下担任的森林守御官一职，后来将驻地迁到格吕耶尔城堡。

1244年，鲁道夫三世伯爵把伯国置于萨伏依宗主权之下，同时保留很大自治权；1337年在位的彼得三世曾于1331年与弗里堡签订共同市民同盟条约。1339年伯爵们在劳彭战役中支持弗里堡对抗伯尔尼。联姻策略一度把统治扩展到沃地区的领地，债务最终迫使伯国零敲碎打地变卖产业。

1528年后伯爵们反对宗教改革，与新教伯尔尼的争端加剧。1554年邦联议会宣布伯国破产，1555年伯尔尼和弗里堡将其瓜分：伯尔尼取得上游河谷，弗里堡则保有格吕耶尔本城，设为辖区。

en:
Güstrow was the chief seat of the lordship of Werle, a Wendish principality of the Holy Roman Empire held by a junior line of the Obotrite Mecklenburg dynasty. Werle was created in 1235 in the partition after Henry Borwin II of Mecklenburg died, and took its name from the Werle castle near Güstrow.

It split in 1277 into Werle-Güstrow and Werle-Parchim, was reunited by Nicholas II in 1307, and divided again in 1316 into the Güstrow and Goldberg lines. In 1337 Werle-Güstrow was ruled by John II the Bald, who had held it since 1316 and was buried at Doberan Abbey when he died that August.

When the last Werle lord, William, died without heirs in 1436, the lordship escheated to the Duchy of Mecklenburg and its title passed to the Mecklenburg dukes.
zh:
居斯特罗是韦尔莱领地的主要驻地，这块神圣罗马帝国的文德人诸侯领地由奥博特里特人梅克伦堡家族的旁支统治。梅克伦堡的亨利·博尔温二世去世后，其领地于1235年被瓜分，韦尔莱由此产生，得名于居斯特罗附近的韦尔莱城堡。

它于1277年分裂为韦尔莱-居斯特罗和韦尔莱-帕尔希姆，1307年由尼古拉斯二世重新合并，1316年又分为居斯特罗和戈德堡两支。1337年统治韦尔莱-居斯特罗的是自1316年在位的秃头约翰二世，他于当年8月去世，葬在多伯兰修道院。

1436年末代领主威廉无嗣而终，韦尔莱领地收归梅克伦堡公国，头衔由梅克伦堡公爵承袭。

en: The Gotō of Mimasaka were a warrior family based at Mitsuboshi Castle. A document of 1350 records a Gotō being recommended as steward of Shioyu estate. Gotō Katsumasa captured Miwayama Castle in 1502, defeating the Tateishi and establishing his family's power in eastern Mimasaka. In 1579 Ukita Naoie attacked Mitsuboshi; the castle fell and Gotō Katsumoto killed himself.
zh: 美作后藤氏是以三星城为据点的武家。1350年的一份文书记载，一位后藤氏成员获推荐担任盐汤乡地头。后藤胜政于1502年攻下美和山城，击败立石氏，确立了家族在美作东部的势力。1579年宇喜多直家进攻三星城，城破后后藤胜基自尽。

en:
Gubbio lies on the lower slopes of Monte Ingino in Umbria, on the site of Umbrian Ikuvium; the bronze Iguvine Tablets unearthed there in 1444 preserve the longest surviving text in the Umbrian language. A Hungarian raid largely destroyed it in 917, and the rebuilt town became a free commune. Under its bishop Saint Ubald it withstood Barbarossa in 1155.

The Gabrielli family dominated the signoria, and Giovanni Gabrielli held the city with Visconti backing from 1350 until Cardinal Albornoz received it for the papacy in 1354. Gubbio submitted to Antonio da Montefeltro in 1387 and entered the Duchy of Urbino, with a brief occupation by Cesare Borgia after 1502.

In 1624 Urbino's last duke ceded the duchy to the Church, and Gubbio stagnated under papal rule until the Napoleonic conquests of 1798 to 1814, after which it returned to the Papal States.
zh:
古比奥位于翁布里亚因吉诺山的低坡上，前身是翁布里亚人的城镇伊库维乌姆；1444年在当地出土的伊古维翁铜表保存着现存最长的翁布里亚语文献。917年匈牙利人的入侵几乎将它摧毁，重建后的城镇成为自由公社。1155年，它在主教圣乌巴尔多带领下顶住了巴巴罗萨的围攻。

加布里埃利家族把持领主之位，乔瓦尼·加布里埃利在维斯孔蒂家族支持下于1350年执政，直到1354年枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯代表教皇接收该城。1387年古比奥臣服于安东尼奥·达·蒙泰费尔特罗，并入乌尔比诺公国，1502年后曾被切萨雷·博尔贾短暂占领。

1624年乌尔比诺末代公爵把整个公国割让给教会，古比奥在教皇统治下走向萧条，直到1798至1814年拿破仑征服时期，此后重归教皇国。

en: The Cuauchichil were a Chichimeca people whose lands stretched across Zacatecas and San Luis Potosí to Saltillo. Mobile hunters and archers, they raided the roads and mines of Spanish settlers during the Chichimeca War of 1550–1600. Peace agreements brought the conflict to an end and drew the indigenous population into New Spanish society.
zh: 夸乌奇奇尔是奇奇梅克人的一支，其土地横跨萨卡特卡斯和圣路易斯波托西，向北延伸至萨尔蒂约。他们以狩猎和射箭为生，行动迅速，在1550—1600年的奇奇梅克战争中袭击西班牙殖民者的道路和矿场。和平协议结束了战争，原住民逐渐融入新西班牙社会。

en:
Guge was the kingdom of far western Tibet, spread across the Sutlej valley in Ngari with capitals at Tholing and clifftop Tsaparang. It was founded around 912 by Kyide Nyimagon, great-grandson of Langdarma, the last king of the old Tibetan Empire. Nyimagon fled turmoil in Ü-Tsang in 910, and his sons divided the inheritance.

Under King Yeshe-Ö the kingdom led Tibet's second diffusion of Buddhism; after Yeshe-Ö died a prisoner of the Karluks rather than abandon his faith, his kinsman invited the Indian master Atiśa to Guge in 1040. Reunited around 1265, Guge passed under Sakya overlordship after 1277, but revived as Yuan power faded, seizing Purang in 1378.

From 1499 it acknowledged the Rinpungpa, and in the 1630s rebel commanders called in a Ladakhi army that took Tsaparang and deported the last king; in 1679 and 1680 the Fifth Dalai Lama's government expelled the Ladakhis and annexed Guge.
zh:
古格是西藏西部的王国，疆域在阿里的象泉河流域，以托林和悬崖上的扎布让城堡为都。910年，吐蕃末代赞普朗达玛的曾孙吉德尼玛衮为避卫藏之乱西逃，约912年建立政权；他的儿子们瓜分了家业。

在意希沃王时期，古格主导了藏传佛教的后弘期复兴；意希沃被葛逻禄人俘虏，不肯弃佛而死，其族人遂于1040年迎请印度大师阿底峡来到古格。约1265年古格重新统一，1277年后沦为萨迦政权的属邦；元朝衰落后它再度振兴，1378年夺取普兰。

1499年起古格臣服于仁蚌巴；17世纪30年代，叛军引来拉达克军队攻陷扎布让，末代国王被掳走。1679年至1680年，五世达赖喇嘛的政权驱逐拉达克人，将古格兼并。

en:
The Gujarat Sultanate arose in western India when the Delhi governor Muzaffar Shah I declared independence in 1394. His grandson Ahmad Shah I moved the capital to Ahmedabad in 1411, and Mahmud Begada later expanded the sultanate and built a fleet on the coast of Diu.

Bahadur Shah conquered Malwa in 1531, but the Mughal emperor Humayun occupied Gujarat in 1535. Bahadur regained it in 1536 and was killed by the Portuguese the next year. Akbar annexed the sultanate in 1573; Muzaffar Shah III briefly recovered his throne in 1583 before being defeated.
zh:
古吉拉特苏丹国兴起于印度西部：德里派驻的总督穆扎法尔沙一世于1394年宣布独立。他的孙子艾哈迈德沙一世于1411年迁都艾哈迈达巴德；此后马哈茂德·贝加达扩张苏丹国，并在第乌海岸建立舰队。

巴哈杜尔沙于1531年征服马尔瓦，但莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍于1535年占领古吉拉特。巴哈杜尔于1536年收复领土，次年被葡萄牙人杀死。阿克巴于1573年吞并苏丹国；穆扎法尔沙三世于1583年短暂复位，随后被击败。

en: The Guale lived in organized communities on the coast and Sea Islands of present-day Georgia, where they built ceremonial platform mounds. French explorers met a Guale leader in 1562, and Spanish missionaries entered their towns in the 1560s. Warfare, enslavement and epidemics later drove many Guale from the coast; some moved to Spanish Florida and others joined the Yamasee.
zh: 瓜莱人在今佐治亚州沿海和海岛上组成多个社群，修筑举行仪式的平台土丘。1562年法国探险者遇见一位瓜莱首领，西班牙传教士则从16世纪60年代起进入他们的城镇。此后战争、奴役和疫病迫使许多瓜莱人离开海岸；一些人迁往西属佛罗里达，另一些人加入亚马西人。

en: The Gumuz are a people of the Blue Nile lowlands in western Ethiopia and the Fazogli region of Sudan. Their traditions recall displacement from western Gojjam by Amhara and Agaw neighbors, who also enslaved them.
zh: 古马兹人生活在埃塞俄比亚西部的青尼罗河低地和苏丹的法佐格利地区。他们的传统记述了阿姆哈拉人与阿高人将他们逐出戈贾姆西部并掳为奴隶的经历。

en: Guarco was an eastern Huetar chiefdom in the Central Valley of present-day Costa Rica. Its territory stretched from the Virilla River towards Chirripó, and its chief Guarco gave his name to the valley around Cartago. His son Correque ruled when the Spanish arrived; in 1569 the conqueror Perafán de Ribera assigned eastern Huetar communities to Spanish colonists.
zh: 瓜尔科是今哥斯达黎加中央谷地的东部韦塔尔酋邦，领地从比里利亚河延伸至奇里波一带。酋长瓜尔科为卡塔戈附近的山谷留下了自己的名字；西班牙人到来时，他的儿子科雷克在位。1569年，征服者佩拉凡·德·里韦拉将东部韦塔尔人的聚落分配给西班牙殖民者。

en:
Fada N'gourma, known to its own rulers as Nungu, was the capital of the Gurma kingdom in eastern Burkina Faso; its Hausa name means residence of the chief of Gourma. The town was founded as Bingo early in the 1200s by Diaba Lompo, whom Mossi tradition calls the eldest son of Ouédraogo and grandson of Yennenga, making the Gurma a sister dynasty to the Mossi kingdoms.

The early rulers kept their court at Pama until the fourteenth successor, Yandabili, who reigned from 1709 to 1736, moved the capital to Nungu, the land of the Nanumba in Gourmantché speech.

In the 1500s and 1600s the Gurma state repeatedly made war on the Songhai Empire to its north, and it kept its own king and ritual life on the eastern edge of the Mossi world long after the Songhai passed their peak.
zh:
法达恩古尔马在本国君主口中称农古，是古尔马王国的都城，位于布基纳法索东部；其豪萨语名称意为“古尔马酋长的居所”。13世纪初，迪亚巴·隆波建立此城，当时称宾戈；莫西口传传统把他视为韦德拉奥果的长子、延嫩加之孙，古尔马王统因此与诸莫西王国是姊妹王朝。

早期君主驻跸于帕马，直到第十四代继承者扬达比利（1709—1736年在位）把都城迁到农古——在古尔芒切语里意为“纳农巴人的土地”。

16至17世纪，古尔马国家屡次北伐桑海帝国；在桑海鼎盛期过后很久，它仍在莫西世界的东缘保有自己的国王和礼仪生活。

en: The Guasave were an Indigenous people of Sinaloa in northwestern Mexico. A Jesuit mission was founded at Guasave in 1590.
zh: 瓜萨韦人是墨西哥西北部锡那罗亚的原住民。1590年，耶稣会在瓜萨韦建立了一座传教站。

en: The Guaxaban were a Guachichil-speaking people of northern Guanajuato, in present-day Mexico, whose range extended to Aguascalientes. They belonged to the Guamare alliance and were associated with the Copuces.
zh: 瓜沙班人讲瓜奇奇尔语，居住在今墨西哥瓜纳华托北部，活动范围延伸至阿瓜斯卡连特斯。他们属于瓜马尔联盟，与科普塞斯人结盟。

en:
Gascony was a duchy in southwestern France, originally a Frankish frontier territory established in 602 to control the Basques. It later became linked to Aquitaine and passed under the rule of the Plantagenet kings of England in 1152.

During the Hundred Years' War the French took Bordeaux in 1451, but John Talbot recovered it for England the following year with the townspeople's help. His defeat at Castillon in 1453 ended English rule in Gascony, which passed to the French crown.
zh:
加斯科涅是法国西南部的公国，最初是法兰克人于602年为控制巴斯克人而设立的边疆领地。它后来与阿基坦相联，并于1152年转入英格兰金雀花王朝诸王的统治之下。

百年战争期间，法国人于1451年夺取波尔多，但次年约翰·塔尔博特在市民协助下为英格兰收复该城。他在1453年的卡斯蒂永战役中战败，英格兰对加斯科涅的统治随之结束，领地转归法国王室。

en:
Gwalior, crowned by a hill fort, stood on the border between Rajputana and the Gangetic plain. In 1394 Tomara leader Virasimha seized the fortress by a ruse and founded an independent kingdom, at its height under Man Singh Tomar from 1486: he built the Man Mandir palace and made Gwalior a centre of Hindu music.

Resistance to the Lodi sultans ended when Ibrahim Lodi forced Man Singh's son Vikramaditya to surrender, and in 1526 this last Tomar raja died fighting at Panipat. From 1528 Gwalior passed to the Mughals as an imperial fortress.

In 1731 Maratha general Ranoji Scindia founded the Scindia state at Ujjain; his successor Mahadji Scindia built it into central India's leading Maratha power. Defeat in the Second Anglo-Maratha War in 1803 put the Scindias under British suzerainty, and Gwalior became the largest princely state under the Central India Agency.
zh:
瓜廖尔扼守拉杰普塔纳与恒河平原之间的通道，山顶矗立着一座雄伟山堡。1394年，都摩罗首领维拉辛哈用计夺取堡垒，建立独立王国；1486年起曼·辛格·都摩罗治下王国达到鼎盛，他在堡内修建曼·曼迪尔宫，把瓜廖尔经营成印度教音乐中心。

对洛迪苏丹的抵抗最终失败，易卜拉欣·洛迪迫使曼·辛格之子维克拉玛蒂亚交出堡垒；1526年这位末代都摩罗罗阇在帕尼帕特之战中战死。1528年瓜廖尔转入莫卧儿之手，成为帝国堡垒。

1731年，马拉塔将领拉诺吉·辛迪亚在乌贾因开创辛迪亚政权，其继任者马哈杰迪·辛迪亚把它建成中印度首屈一指的马拉塔强权。1803年第二次英国—马拉塔战争战败后，辛迪亚家族接受英国宗主权，瓜廖尔成为中印度代理区最大的土邦。

en:
Gwiriko was a Dyula kingdom of the upper Mouhoun, the Black Volta, in southwestern Burkina Faso; its name means beyond the forest in Dyula, and its chief city was Sya, the town later called Bobo-Dioulasso. Founded by Bobo farmers and traders in the 1400s, Sia grew into a horse market.

In 1710 Sékou Ouattara built the Kong Empire, and around 1714 he sent his brother Famagan into the Mouhoun bend, where Gwiriko took shape. Famagan's men conquered Sia in the late 1730s and subdued the Bobo-Dioula and Bobo-Oule.

When Sékou died about 1740 Famagan refused to serve his nephews, seized Tiefo, Dafin and Bwamu and made himself independent in alliance with the Bobo-Dioula. His Ouattara descendants kept the throne, but subject peoples revolted repeatedly, and by the 1830s the Tiefo, Bobo and Bolon were breaking away as the kingdom weakened.
zh:
圭里科是穆翁河（黑沃尔特河）上游的迪乌拉人王国，位于布基纳法索西南部；其名称在迪乌拉语中意为“森林之外”，都城是锡亚，即后来的博博迪乌拉索。锡亚由博博人的农民和商人建于15世纪，后来发展为马匹市场。

1710年塞古·瓦塔拉建立孔格帝国，约1714年他派弟弟法马甘进入穆翁河河曲，圭里科由此成形。1730年代末法马甘的部众攻占锡亚，征服博博-迪乌拉和博博-乌莱人。

塞古约1740年死后，法马甘拒绝向侄子们称臣，夺取蒂埃福、达凡和布瓦穆，与博博-迪乌拉人结盟自立。他的瓦塔拉后裔世代在位，但属民一再反叛，到19世纪30年代，蒂埃福、博博、博隆等纷纷脱离，王国走向衰弱。

en:
The Kingdom of Garhwal was a Himalayan Hindu state in the upper Ganges valley, ruled by the Panwar dynasty from its traditional founding in 823. Its first king Kanak Pal, a Malwa prince on pilgrimage to Badrinath, married the heiress of Chandpur Garhi, one of fifty-two hill fortresses. His descendants subdued the others, and in 1358 Ajay Pal merged the remaining chiefdoms into a single kingdom.

After Mahipat Shah's death his queen Karnavati ruled as regent and in 1640 broke Najabat Khan's army, earning the name Nakti Rani for the noses taken from invaders. In Fateh Shah's reign the Sikh leader Ram Rai's camp grew into the town of Dehradun.

Nepal's Gorkhas overran the kingdom in 1803 and ruled it harshly for twelve years; the Treaty of Sugauli of 1815 then split Garhwal in two, the east to the British and the west to Sudarshan Shah as Tehri Garhwal.
zh:
加瓦尔王国是恒河上游河谷的喜马拉雅印度教政权，般婆罗王朝按传统说法自823年起统治。初代国王迦纳格·帕尔是来自马尔瓦的王子，前往巴德里纳特朝圣时娶了金德布尔加希的女继承人，那是当地五十二座山间要塞之一。其后人逐一征服其他要塞，1358年阿杰·帕尔把余下小邦合并为统一王国。

马希帕特·沙阿死后，王后卡尔纳瓦蒂临朝称制，于1640年击溃纳贾巴特汗的军队，因割下入侵者的鼻子而得到割鼻王后的绰号。法塔赫·沙阿在位时，锡克领袖拉姆·拉伊的营地发展为台拉登城。

1803年尼泊尔的廓尔喀人征服该国，进行了十二年的严酷统治；1815年的《苏高利条约》把加瓦尔一分为二，东部归英国，西部归苏达尔尚·沙阿，即特里加瓦尔。

en:
Gower was a marcher lordship on the coast of south Wales, covering the Gower Peninsula and the country around its chief castle at Swansea. Once a commote of Deheubarth, it was overrun by Anglo-Norman invaders around 1106, when Henry de Beaumont planted Swansea Castle and organized the territory as a lordship nearly independent of the English crown. It passed by marriage to the de Braose family and later the Mowbrays.

A disputed sale to Hugh Despenser helped spark the baronial revolt of 1321, in which John de Mowbray was executed; his widow Aline recovered the lordship in 1327, and in 1337 their son John held it.

The lordship passed to William Herbert, Earl of Pembroke, in 1468, and in 1479 Edward IV granted it to his son Prince Edward. The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 and 1542 ended its marcher status, absorbing it into the English county system.
zh:
高尔是南威尔士沿海的边境领主领，涵盖高尔半岛及首要城堡斯旺西一带。这里原是德赫巴思王国的威尔士人康莫特，约1106年被盎格鲁-诺曼入侵者攻占，亨利·德·博蒙特修建斯旺西城堡，把这片土地组建成几乎独立于英格兰王权的领主领。后来它随婚姻转入德·布劳斯家族，再归莫布雷家族。

把高尔卖给休·勒德斯潘塞的争议交易成为1321年贵族叛乱的导火索之一，约翰·莫布雷在叛乱中被处决；其遗孀艾琳于1327年收回领地，1337年由他们的儿子约翰持有。

1468年领地转入彭布罗克伯爵威廉·赫伯特之手，1479年爱德华四世又把它封给儿子爱德华王子。1535年和1542年的《威尔士法令》取消其边境领地位，将其并入英格兰的郡制。

en: Gwent was a Welsh kingdom between the Wye and Usk, named after the Roman town of Venta Silurum, later Caerwent. Gruffydd ap Llywelyn conquered it in 1055; it regained independence after his death in 1063, but Norman invaders soon overran it. Its former lands became part of the Welsh Marches, where castles marked a frequently contested frontier.
zh: 格温特是怀河与阿斯克河之间的威尔士王国，得名于罗马城镇文塔西卢鲁姆，即后来的凯尔温特。1055年格里菲德·阿普·卢埃林征服了格温特；他于1063年去世后，格温特重获独立，却很快被诺曼入侵者占领。旧王国的土地成为威尔士边区的一部分，城堡遍布这片屡遭争夺的边境。

en:
Gyaaman was an Akan kingdom spanning parts of present-day Ghana and Ivory Coast. In the seventeenth century migrants of the Aduana clan moved into the Black Volta basin and established a kingdom centered on Amanvi.

Asante armies defeated Gyaaman in 1740–1741 and reduced it to a tributary. King Kwadwo Adinkra stopped paying tribute in 1817; an Asante invasion followed in 1818, and he was killed. In 1819 Asante made Gyaaman a province and occupied it.
zh:
贾阿曼是一个阿肯王国，领土跨及今加纳和科特迪瓦的部分地区。17世纪，阿杜阿纳氏族的移民进入黑沃尔特河流域，建立了以阿曼维为中心的王国。

阿散蒂军队在1740—1741年击败贾阿曼，使其成为贡赋国。国王夸德沃·阿丁克拉于1817年停止纳贡；阿散蒂于1818年入侵，他在战争中丧生。1819年，阿散蒂将贾阿曼变为一个省并派兵占领。

en:
Gyelrong, the rGyal-mo tsha-wa rong or valley of the queen, covers the steep gorges of the Dadu River headwaters in north-western Sichuan, home to the Qiangic-speaking Gyalrong people, who call themselves Keru. The region was divided among some eighteen small chiefdoms, each ruled by a hereditary tusi under Ming and then Qing suzerainty.

Bön dominated until Gelug missionaries from central Tibet arrived in the early fifteenth century and founded monasteries such as Dhe-Tsang against strong Bön opposition. In 1726 the Yongzheng emperor's drive to replace tusi with imperial officials met armed resistance in Sichuan.

War came openly in 1747, when Slob Dpon of Greater Jinchuan attacked the Chakla chiefdom and surrendered only in 1749; a second rising ended in 1776 with the fall of Sonom after a five-year Qing campaign, among the costliest of the Qianlong emperor's Ten Great Campaigns.
zh:
嘉绒得名于藏语“嘉摩察瓦荣”，意为女王的河谷，地处四川西北部大渡河上游的深峡之中，居民是说羌语支语言的嘉绒人，自称“革如”。这一地区分成约十八个小酋长国，各由世袭土司统治，先后臣属于明朝和清朝。

苯教曾是当地主要信仰，15世纪初来自西藏中部的格鲁派传教士不顾苯教僧侣的强烈反对，建起德桑寺等寺院。1726年，雍正皇帝推行改土归流、以流官取代土司，在四川遭到武装抵抗。

1747年战争公开爆发，大金川土司莎罗奔进攻明正土司，直到1749年才投降；第二次战事中，索诺木在清军五年征讨后于1776年败亡，此役是乾隆帝“十全武功”中耗费最巨的战争之一。

en:
The Gayogohono, the People of the Great Swamp, are the Cayuga, one of the five founding nations of the Haudenosaunee. Their longhouse towns stood along Cayuga Lake in the Finger Lakes country of central New York, between the Onondaga and the Seneca.

During the American Revolution the Cayuga were divided, with warriors on both sides. After Haudenosaunee frontier raids in 1778 Washington ordered the Sullivan Expedition, which in 1779 destroyed forty to fifty league villages, including the principal Cayuga towns, burning their crops and winter stores.

Survivors joined other nations, followed Joseph Brant to the Grand River in Upper Canada, or joined Mingo bands in the Ohio Country. The New York Cayuga ceded most of their land in the Canandaigua treaty of 1794, and in 1831 the Ohio bands were removed to Indian Territory, where they became the Seneca-Cayuga.
zh:
加耶戈霍诺意为“大沼泽之人”，即卡尤加人，是霍迪诺肖尼五个创始族之一。他们的长屋村镇坐落在纽约州中部五指湖地区的卡尤加湖畔，介于奥农达人和塞内卡人之间。

美国独立战争期间卡尤加人立场分裂，战士分别为交战双方效力。1778年霍迪诺肖尼各部袭扰边疆后，华盛顿下令发动沙利文远征，1779年远征军摧毁联盟四十至五十座村落，包括卡尤加人的主要城镇，并烧掉庄稼和冬粮。

幸存者或投奔其他部族，或随约瑟夫·布兰特前往上加拿大的格兰德河，或加入俄亥俄地区的明戈群体。纽约的卡尤加人在1794年的卡南代瓜条约中割让大部分土地；1831年俄亥俄的族人被迁往印第安领地，后来形成塞内卡-卡尤加群体。

en:
The Guayupe were Arawak-speaking farming communities led by chiefs in the Ariari basin and the eastern foothills of the Colombian Andes. Their villages included palisades and concealed defensive pits, and their crops included cassava.

In 1534 Guayupe warriors attacked Alonso de Herrera's expedition near the Guaviare River. From 1535 to 1538 they fought another expedition led by Georg von Speyer as it crossed their lands in search of El Dorado.
zh:
瓜尤佩是居住在哥伦比亚安第斯山东麓和阿里亚里河流域的农耕社群，说阿拉瓦克语，由酋长统领。他们种植木薯，并在村庄周围修筑栅栏和隐蔽的防御陷坑。

1534年，瓜尤佩战士在瓜维亚雷河附近袭击了阿隆索·德·埃雷拉的远征队。1535年至1538年，格奥尔格·冯·施派尔率领的另一支远征队穿越瓜尤佩土地寻找黄金国时，也遭到他们的抵抗。

en:
Gyelthang, the royal plain in Tibetan and called Jiantang or Zhongdian in Chinese, was a Tibetan chiefdom on the high plateau of northwestern Yunnan, where Khampa pastoralists met Naxi and Han traders of the low valleys. In Song times it was known as Dandang under the Dali kingdom, and in 1293 the Yuan placed it under the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs. From the mid-Ming it fell within the Lijiang prefecture of the Naxi Mu chiefs.

Khoshut Mongol armies conquered Gyelthang in 1667, and the Fifth Dalai Lama founded the great Gelug monastery of Ganden Sumtseling in 1679, later the largest in the region.

The Qing placed the district under Yunnan's Lijiang Prefecture in 1726, and in 1756 it was organised as the Zhongdian sub-prefecture under Lijiang, with a sub-prefect.
zh:
建塘藏语意为王者的平川，汉语又作建塘、中甸，是云南西北高原上的藏族土司政权，也是康巴牧人与低地纳西族、汉族商人交汇之地。宋代这里称旦当，臣属大理国；1293年元朝将其划归宣政院下属的吐蕃等路宣慰司。明代中叶以后，此地成为纳西族丽江木氏知府辖下的忠甸。

1667年和硕特蒙古军队攻占建塘，五世达赖喇嘛于1679年敕建格鲁派大寺噶丹松赞林，后来成为迪庆最大的寺院。

1726年清朝将这一地区划归云南丽江府，1756年正式设中甸厅，置同知管理。

en:
Guzhou was a Kam chiefdom in the wooded hills of southeastern Guizhou, its seat at Luoli in Liping County. The Tang dynasty first organised the district as the prefecture of Guzhou in 638, and under the Mongol Yuan it became the Guzhou Bawandong chiefdom, ruled through the Tian family of Sizhou.

In 1397 the Kam leader Lin Kuan rose in rebellion here, killing the Ming battalion commander Wu De before it was put down. The Ming re-established the domain in 1403 as the Guzhou native long commandery, which became one of the thirteen Kam chieftaincies placed under Liping Prefecture in 1413.

In 1729 the Qing created a separate Guzhou sub-prefecture further west at Rongjiang, and the great Miao uprising of 1735 to 1736 broke out in the Guzhou country.
zh:
古州是贵州东南黎平一带山林中的侗族土司，治所在黎平县罗里。唐朝于638年在这一地区设古州，元代改设古州八万洞总管府，由思州田氏统辖。

1397年，侗族人林宽在此起兵反明，击杀千户吴得，起义最终被明军镇压。1403年明朝复置古州蛮夷长官司，1413年黎平府设立后，它成为府下十三个长官司之一。

1729年，清朝又在更西边的榕江另设古州厅，1735—1736年的苗民大起义便自古州一带爆发。

en:
The Haaninin, also called the Gros Ventre, were an Algonquian-speaking people of the northern Great Plains. Their ancestors and those of the Arapaho lived in the Red River valley before moving west and separating, probably in the early eighteenth century.

The Haaninin obtained horses in the mid-eighteenth century and hunted bison on the northern plains. Around 1793 they burned two Hudson's Bay Company posts in response to attacks by Cree and Assiniboine supplied with guns by the company.
zh:
汉尼宁人又称格罗斯文特人，是北美大平原北部讲阿尔冈昆语的族群。他们的祖先曾与阿拉帕霍人的祖先共同居住在红河流域，后来向西迁移，可能在18世纪初分离。

汉尼宁人在18世纪中叶获得马匹，在北部平原猎捕野牛。约1793年，克里人和阿西尼博因人使用哈德逊湾公司提供的枪支袭击他们，他们遂烧毁了该公司的两个贸易站。

en:
The Duchy of Austria was a Holy Roman Empire principality on the Danube, raised from the Bavarian Eastern March by Frederick Barbarossa's Privilegium Minus of 1156, which enfeoffed the Babenberg dukes. When the Babenbergs died out in 1246, King Ottokar II of Bohemia seized the lands, until Rudolf of Habsburg defeated him at the Battle on the Marchfeld in 1278 and in 1282 enfeoffed Austria to his sons, making it the Habsburg dynasty's homeland.

In 1337 the duke was Albert II, called the Wise, who held Styria and in 1335 added Carinthia and Carniola. His son Rudolf IV invented the archducal title through the forged Privilegium Maius of 1359 and gained Tyrol in 1363.

The Treaty of Neuberg of 1379 split the lands between two Habsburg lines, but after Albert V was elected King of the Romans in 1438 the imperial crown stayed effectively with the Habsburgs, and Frederick III had Austria recognized as an archduchy in 1453.
zh:
奥地利公国是多瑙河畔的神圣罗马帝国邦国，1156年红胡子腓特烈一世颁布《小特权》，把巴伐利亚东部藩侯地升为公国，封给巴本堡家族。1246年巴本堡家族绝嗣，波希米亚国王奥托卡二世夺取其地；1278年哈布斯堡的鲁道夫在杜恩克鲁特战役中将他击败，1282年又把奥地利分封给诸子，从此成为哈布斯堡家族祖业。

1337年在位的是智者阿尔布雷希特二世，领有施蒂利亚，1335年又取得克恩顿和卡尼奥拉。其子鲁道夫四世1359年以伪造的《大特权》创设大公头衔，1363年取得蒂罗尔。

1379年《诺伊贝格条约》把领地分给两个哈布斯堡支系；1438年阿尔布雷希特五世当选罗马人的国王后，皇位实际由哈布斯堡家族保有，腓特烈三世于1453年使奥地利获承认为大公国。

en:
The Margraviate of Baden-Hachberg was a Holy Roman Empire territory in the Breisgau, ruled from the Hochburg above Emmendingen. It arose around 1212 when Henry I and his brother Herman V divided their father Herman IV of Baden's inheritance, and through the thirteenth century the line held its ground against the Counts of Freiburg.

In 1306 a further partition gave Hachberg to Margrave Henry III, while his brother Rudolf received the southern Lordship of Sausenberg; it acquired Rötteln in 1315 and survived as the Hachberg-Sausenberg line until 1503. From 1390 to 1409 Hachberg fought the Counts of Fürstenberg over Prechtal, settled by shared rule.

In 1415 the last margrave, Otto II, sold the castle and lordship to his kinsman Bernard I of Baden; Otto's death in 1418 ended the line, its lands becoming the Oberamt of Hochberg. Margrave James III briefly recreated it from 1584 to 1590.
zh:
巴登-哈赫贝格藩侯领是神圣罗马帝国在布赖斯高的领地，统治中心是埃门丁根上方的霍赫堡。它约1212年由亨利一世与弟赫尔曼五世瓜分父亲巴登的赫尔曼四世的遗产而产生；13世纪该支顶住了弗赖堡伯爵家族的竞争。

1306年再分家：亨利三世得哈赫贝格，弟鲁道夫得南方的绍森贝格；后者1315年又取得勒特恩，作为哈赫贝格-绍森贝格支系延续到1503年。1390—1409年，哈赫贝格为普雷希塔尔与菲尔斯滕贝格伯爵交战，以共管收场。

1415年末代藩侯奥托二世把城堡和领地卖给亲族巴登的伯恩哈德一世；1418年奥托去世，支系绝嗣，领地成为霍赫堡高级辖区。藩侯雅各布三世曾于1584—1590年短暂重建。

en:
Hadoti is the south-eastern corner of Rajputana, watered by the Chambal and named after the Hada Rajputs of the Chauhan clan. Before them, Meena and Bhil tribes held the country around Bundi, whose name comes from Bunda Meena, a thirteenth-century chieftain.

In 1241 Rao Deva, a Hada Chauhan, seized Bundi from the Meenas and made it Hadoti's capital; his successors took Kota in 1264. For two centuries the Hadas of Bundi were vassals of Mewar's Sisodias, until Rao Surjan Singh submitted to Akbar after the siege of Ranthambore and received the title of Rao Raja in 1569.

Hada troops then served Mughal armies, and in 1631 Shah Jahan granted Kota to Rao Madho Singh as a separate kingdom. Bundi and Kota flourished as rivals but later faced Maratha and Pindari raids; in 1818 their rulers accepted subsidiary alliances with the British East India Company and continued as protected princely states.
zh:
哈多蒂在拉杰普塔纳东南隅，受昌巴尔河滋养，得名于乔汉族分支哈达拉杰普特人。此前本迪一带由迷那人和比尔部落占据，本迪得名于13世纪迷那首领本达·迷那。

1241年哈达·乔汉首领拉奥·德瓦从迷那人手中夺取本迪，定为哈多蒂都城；后继者1264年攻取科塔。此后两百年，本迪哈达人作为梅瓦尔西索迪亚王朝藩属，直到拉奥·苏尔詹·辛格在兰坦博尔围城战后归顺阿克巴，1569年受封拉奥·罗阇称号。

哈达军队随后为莫卧儿征战；1631年沙贾汗封科塔给拉奥·马多·辛格，另立科塔王国。两邦并立相争，后同遭马拉塔、平达里人劫掠；1818年两地君主同英国东印度公司结附属同盟，作为受保护土邦延续。

en:
The imperial city of Haguenau in Lower Alsace began early in the twelfth century, when Duke Frederick II the One-Eyed of Swabia built a hunting lodge on an island in the river Moder. The Emperor Frederick I Barbarossa fortified the settlement, granted it town rights in 1154 and raised an imperial palace there, where Charlemagne's crown, sceptre, orb and sword were kept.

Richard of Cornwall made Haguenau an imperial city in 1257, and under Rudolf I it became the seat of the Landvogt in Lower Alsace. From 1354 it led the Decapole, a league of ten Alsatian imperial cities.

The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 transferred imperial rights over Alsace to France, and after Louis XIV had the fortifications and ruined palace razed in 1673, the Treaties of Nijmegen in 1679 ended Haguenau's imperial status and joined it to France.
zh:
阿格诺是下阿尔萨斯的帝国城市，起源于12世纪初士瓦本公爵“独眼龙”腓特烈二世在莫德尔河一座岛上修建的狩猎行宫。皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）加固聚落，1154年授予城市权，并兴建帝国宫殿，查理曼的皇冠、权杖、宝球和宝剑都收藏于此。

1257年康沃尔的理查将阿格诺升格为帝国城市；鲁道夫一世时，它成为帝国驻下阿尔萨斯地方总督的驻地。1354年起，它主导由十座阿尔萨斯帝国城市组成的十城联盟。

1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把阿尔萨斯的帝国权利转交法国；路易十四1673年下令拆毁城防和宫殿废墟后，1679年《奈梅亨条约》终结阿格诺的帝国地位，将其并入法国。

en:
Hainaut was a French-speaking imperial lordship on the French frontier, named after the river Haine. A Frankish pagus recorded in the eighth century, it passed to Lotharingia in 843 and the East Frankish kingdom around 925. After taking roughly its final shape in 1071, its counts often inherited neighbouring lands, ruling Flanders for periods and uniting Hainaut with Holland and Zeeland in 1299.

In 1337 Count William I of Avesnes, the Good, ruled; his daughters Philippa and Margaret married Edward III of England and Emperor Louis IV. After his son William II fell in battle in 1345, the counties passed through Margaret II to the Wittelsbach dukes of Bavaria-Straubing in 1356 and to the Valois dukes of Burgundy in 1432.

The counties passed to the Habsburgs with the Burgundian Netherlands in the 1470s. France took the south in 1659 and 1678; the north stayed Habsburg until annexed by French revolutionary armies in 1797.
zh:
埃诺伯国是神圣罗马帝国在法兰西边境的法语领地，以埃讷河得名。前身是8世纪已见记载的法兰克人行政区，843年划归洛塔林吉亚，约925年并入东法兰克王国。1071年基本定型后，伯爵们常凭继承兼领邻地，曾阶段性统治佛兰德，1299年又将埃诺与荷兰、泽兰合并。

1337年在位的阿韦讷家威廉一世绰号好人，女儿菲莉帕和玛格丽特分嫁英王爱德华三世与皇帝路易四世。其子威廉二世1345年战死后，伯国经玛格丽特二世于1356年转入巴伐利亚-施特劳宾的维特尔斯巴赫公爵，1432年又归入勃艮第瓦卢瓦公爵。

15世纪70年代，伯国随勃艮第尼德兰归哈布斯堡家。南部1659年、1678年两次割让法国，北部留在哈布斯堡治下，1797年被法国革命军吞并。

en:
Halych, on the Dniester, was the center of the Principality of Galicia, formed in 1124-1144 from smaller Rus' principalities. In 1199 Prince Roman the Great united Galicia with neighboring Volhynia, creating the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, or Ruthenia, one of Kievan Rus's three chief successor states. After the Mongol invasion of 1239 to 1241 its rulers became Golden Horde tributaries, though Prince Daniel was crowned King of Ruthenia by the Pope in 1253.

When the old Rurikid line failed in 1323, the boyars accepted Boleslaw Jerzy, grandson of King Yuri I, who ruled as Yuri II and in 1337 still held Halych and Volhynia as a Horde tributary. His murder by rebellious Orthodox boyars in 1340 opened the long Galicia-Volhynia Wars.

In 1349 Casimir III of Poland conquered Galicia and took the title King of Ruthenia. In 1434 it became the Polish Ruthenian Voivodeship, losing its last separate legal status in 1506.
zh:
哈利奇在德涅斯特河畔，是1124—1144年由若干小罗斯公国合并而成的加利西亚公国中心。1199年罗曼大帝将加利西亚与沃里尼亚合并，建立加利西亚-沃里尼亚王国（鲁塞尼亚王国），为基辅罗斯三大继承国之一。1239—1241年蒙古入侵后，统治者沦为金帐汗国附庸，丹尼尔王公仍于1253年被教皇加冕为鲁塞尼亚国王。

1323年留里克旧支绝嗣，波雅尔迎立尤里一世外孙博莱斯瓦夫·耶日，改称尤里二世，1337年仍以金帐汗国附庸身份统治哈利奇与沃里尼亚。1340年他被反叛的东正教波雅尔毒杀，引发漫长的加利西亚-沃里尼亚继承战争。

1349年波兰国王卡齐米日三世征服加利西亚，加称鲁塞尼亚国王。1434年成为波兰鲁塞尼亚省，残存特殊法律地位于1506年废除。

en:
Hamburg grew up around the Hammaburg, a fortress built on Charlemagne's orders between the Elbe and the Alster in 808. A bishopric was founded there in 834 under Ansgar, soon merged with Bremen to form the archbishopric of Hamburg-Bremen, while the town was repeatedly sacked by Vikings and others.

In 1189 Frederick Barbarossa made Hamburg a free imperial city, with toll-free passage down the Elbe to the North Sea. Its 1241 alliance with Lübeck is regarded as the beginning of the Hanseatic League, and Hamburg became a leading Hanseatic port; a civic compromise of 1410 gave it its first constitution.

Hamburg adopted Lutheranism in 1529 and strengthened its walls during the Thirty Years' War. In 1806, with the Holy Roman Empire dissolved, it became a sovereign free city; Napoleon annexed it from 1811 to 1814, and the Congress of Vienna confirmed its independence in 1815 within the German Confederation.
zh:
汉堡起源于808年查理曼下令在易北河与阿尔斯特河之间修建的哈马堡。834年安斯加尔在此设立主教区，不久与不来梅合并为汉堡-不来梅大主教区，城镇本身则屡遭维京人等劫掠。

1189年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨授予汉堡帝国自由城市地位，包括沿易北河直抵北海的免税通行权。1241年它与吕贝克结盟，被视为汉萨同盟的开端，汉堡由此成为主要汉萨港口之一；1410年市政妥协案带来第一部宪法。

1529年汉堡改宗路德宗，三十年战争期间加固城防。1806年神圣罗马帝国解体，它成为主权自由城市；1811至1814年被拿破仑吞并，1815年维也纳会议确认其独立，加入德意志邦联。

en:
Hanover was a north German state ruled from the city of Hanover by a branch of the House of Welf. In 1692 Emperor Leopold I raised Ernest Augustus of Calenberg to electoral rank; the Imperial Diet approved the new electorate in 1708. His son George Louis inherited the British throne as George I in 1714, joining the two countries under one monarch.

Napoleon incorporated Hanover into the Kingdom of Westphalia in 1807. Restored as a kingdom in 1814, Hanover remained in personal union with Britain until 1837, when Victoria inherited the British throne and her uncle Ernest Augustus became king of Hanover.
zh:
汉诺威是以汉诺威城为中心的北德意志国家，由韦尔夫家族的一个支系统治。1692年，皇帝利奥波德一世将卡伦贝格的恩斯特·奥古斯特升为选侯；帝国议会于1708年批准这一新选侯国。他的儿子格奥尔格·路德维希于1714年继承英国王位，成为乔治一世，使两国共戴一位君主。

拿破仑于1807年将汉诺威并入威斯特伐利亚王国。1814年汉诺威恢复为王国，与英国的共主邦联延续到1837年；此时维多利亚继承英国王位，她的叔父恩斯特·奥古斯特则成为汉诺威国王。

en:
The Hathawekela were a Shawnee division from which political leaders traditionally came. After 1674 they settled on the Savannah River, and in 1681 helped South Carolina drive the Westo from its middle course.

Around 1697 Hathawekela people moved north to the Susquehanna and Allegheny rivers in Pennsylvania. A later band settled near Cape Girardeau in Missouri on land granted by Spain around 1793; under Black Bob, some moved to Arkansas and relinquished their Missouri claim in 1831.
zh:
哈萨韦克拉是肖尼人的一个支系，肖尼人的政治领袖传统上出自这一支系。1674年后，他们在萨凡纳河沿岸定居，并于1681年协助南卡罗来纳殖民地将韦斯托人逐出河流中游。

约1697年，哈萨韦克拉人北迁至宾夕法尼亚的萨斯奎哈纳河和阿勒格尼河流域。后来一支在西班牙约于1793年授予的密苏里吉拉多角附近土地上定居；其中一些人在黑鲍勃率领下迁至阿肯色，并于1831年放弃对密苏里土地的主张。

en:
The Hausa kingdoms were city-states between the Niger River and Lake Chad, including Kano, Katsina, Daura and Gobir. Hausa tradition traced seven of the states to descendants of Bayajidda, while their fortified cities became centres of trade and rule.

Kano's ruler Yaji I, who reigned from 1349 to 1385, accepted Islam and conquered Rano. In the early nineteenth century Usman dan Fodio's jihad overthrew Hausa rulers and brought much of Hausaland into the Sokoto Caliphate.
zh:
豪萨诸国是尼日尔河与乍得湖之间的城邦，包括卡诺、卡齐纳、道拉和戈比尔。豪萨传说将其中七邦的起源归于巴亚吉达的后裔，而各邦的设防城市成为贸易和统治中心。

卡诺的亚吉一世在1349—1385年统治期间接受伊斯兰教并征服拉诺。19世纪初，奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥发动的圣战推翻了豪萨统治者，豪萨地区的大部分被纳入索科托哈里发国。

en:
Hawai'i, largest of the Hawaiian Islands, was settled by Polynesian voyagers between 940 and 1200 and ruled by local chiefs, or ali'i, under a high chief. Its Pili ruling line was traditionally founded by Pilika'aiea, a chief from Samoa brought by the priest Pa'ao.

The islands were governed separately, with constant wars between rival chiefdoms. Early in the fourteenth century the high chief Kalaunuiohua campaigned across the chain, defeating the rulers of Maui, Moloka'i and O'ahu, but on Kaua'i his army was routed at Kawelewele and Kukona of Kaua'i held him for years.

Later chiefs included Līloa and his son Umi, who in the sixteenth century became the first ruler to unite almost the whole Big Island. The line's final heir was Kamehameha, who after James Cook's landing in 1778 used European ships and firearms to conquer the islands in 1795 and complete the unified Kingdom of Hawai'i in 1810.
zh:
夏威夷是夏威夷群岛最大的岛屿，940—1200年间由波利尼西亚航海者定居，由地方酋长（阿里伊）在最高酋长之下治理。统治家族是皮利王朝，相传始祖皮利卡阿伊埃阿是萨摩亚首领，由祭司帕奥带到岛上。

各岛各自为政，酋邦之间战争不断。14世纪初，最高酋长卡劳努伊奥华兵锋遍及整个群岛，击败毛伊、莫洛凯和瓦胡三岛统治者，但在考艾岛卡韦勒韦勒一战溃败，被考艾酋长库科纳囚禁数年。

后来的皮利朝酋长有利洛阿及其子乌米，乌米在16世纪首次几乎统一整座大岛。末代继承人卡美哈梅哈在1778年库克登陆后，借助欧洲船只和火器于1795年征服群岛，1810年建成统一的夏威夷王国。

en:
The Lordship of Heinsberg was a small Holy Roman Empire territory west of Cologne centred on Heinsberg castle. Its lords first appear in the late eleventh century, when Goswin of Wassenberg styled himself lord of Heinsberg and gained Valkenburg by marrying heiress Oda. Small as it was, it held imperial standing; Philip of Heinsberg was Archbishop of Cologne in the twelfth century.

It stayed independent by following the strongest Lower Rhine power in turn: Cologne until Worringen in 1288, then Brabant, then Jülich after Baesweiler in 1371. In 1336 Dietrich inherited Loon and Chiny through his mother; Liège later reclaimed them.

The later lord Johann II fought at Kleverhamm in 1397 and inherited a quarter of Jülich in 1423. The main male line ended in 1448; after daughters inherited, the Duke of Jülich-Berg bought the lordship in 1484 and made it the Amt Heinsberg.
zh:
海因斯贝格领地是神圣罗马帝国小邦，在科隆以西，以海因斯贝格堡为中心。11世纪末瓦森贝格家的戈斯温自称海因斯贝格领主，娶女继承人奥达而得邻近的法尔肯堡。领地虽小，却居帝国诸侯等级，菲利普12世纪出任科隆大主教。

它靠依次依附莱茵河下游最强者维持独立：1288年沃林根之战前附科隆选侯国，后附布拉班特，1371年巴斯韦勒之战后改投于利希。1336年狄奥多里克凭母亲继承洛恩、希尼两伯国，后被列日收回。

后来的领主约翰二世1397年战于克莱弗哈姆，1423年继承于利希四分之一领地。主支男系1448年断绝，经女儿一系转手，于利希—贝格公爵1484年买下领地，改为海因斯贝格辖区。

en:
The Hasbani were the Hasnaniyya, a Kurdish tribe that the Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari described in the 1340s as strong-spirited men, about a thousand of them, divided into three clans.

They held a district he calls Karkar and shared with their neighbours, the Farmawiyya, the protection money taken at the pass of Qarayli. The emir Abd Allah, son of Shihab al-Din Zanki, led two of their branches.
zh:
哈斯巴尼即哈斯纳尼亚部。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，这个库尔德部落“心志刚强”，约有一千人，分为三个氏族。

他们据有欧麦里所说的卡尔卡尔地区，并与邻近的法尔马维亚部共同收取卡拉伊里山口的护路费。谢哈卜丁·赞吉之子埃米尔阿卜杜拉统领其中两支。

en:
Heilbronn stands on the Neckar in northern Swabia, where salt springs and a river harbour gave it an early mint and market rights. It was first mentioned in 741 as villa Helibrunna, and in 1225 the Hohenstaufen made it a fortified town; the Teutonic Knights built their Deutschhof residence there from 1268.

Its Jewish community, documented from 1050, suffered the Rintfleisch pogrom of 1298 and was expelled in 1490. In 1371 Emperor Charles IV granted Heilbronn a charter making it a Free Imperial City, answerable only to him, and the surrounding villages were brought under its rule.

The city adopted the Reformation in 1528, accepted the Augsburg Confession in 1530 and joined the Schmalkaldic League in 1538. Württemberg troops occupied it in 1802, and in 1803 Heilbronn formally passed to Württemberg, where it became an early centre of industrialisation.
zh:
海尔布隆地处施瓦本北部的内卡河畔，盐泉和河港使它很早就有铸币、开市之权。741年以海利布伦纳村之名首见记载，1225年霍亨斯陶芬家族将它建为设防城镇；条顿骑士团从1268年起在此修建德意志庄园。

犹太社区1050年即见记载，1298年遭林特弗莱希屠杀，1490年被逐出城。1371年皇帝查理四世颁赐特许状，使海尔布隆成为只对皇帝负责的帝国自由城市，周围村庄也归入它管辖。

1528年城市接受宗教改革，1530年承认《奥格斯堡信纲》，1538年加入施马尔卡尔登同盟。1802年符腾堡军队进驻，1803年海尔布隆正式划归符腾堡，成为当地最早工业化的中心之一。

en:
Halberstadt began as a missionary diocese Charlemagne founded in 804 during the Saxon conversion; its seat soon moved to Halberstadt, confirmed by Louis the Pious in 814. When Otto I founded Magdeburg archbishopric in 968, Halberstadt lost the eastern half of its district.

After Henry the Lion fell in 1180, the bishops' lands became the prince-bishopric of Halberstadt, an imperial state. Bishop Conrad joined the Fourth Crusade and the 1204 sack of Constantinople, bringing back relics, and in 1315 Aschersleben was added. In 1337 Albert of the Welf house of Brunswick held it, his family long supplying its bishops.

It turned Lutheran in 1540, thereafter ruled by Protestant administrators. The 1648 Peace of Westphalia secularised it as a principality granted to the Hohenzollern rulers of Brandenburg-Prussia, and in 1815 the Congress of Vienna folded it into Prussia's Saxony province.
zh:
哈尔伯施塔特原为查理曼804年在萨克森皈依中设的传教教区，教座不久迁至哈尔伯施塔特，814年获虔诚者路易确认。968年奥托一世设马格德堡大主教区后，它失去辖区东半部分。

1180年狮子亨利倒台后，主教领地成为独立帝国邦国哈尔伯施塔特主教区邦。康拉德主教参加第四次十字军，1204年洗劫君士坦丁堡，带回圣物；1315年阿舍斯莱本并入。1337年在位的是不伦瑞克韦尔夫家的阿尔贝，该家族长期出任主教。

它1540年改宗路德宗，此后由新教管理者统治。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将其世俗化，封给勃兰登堡-普鲁士霍亨索伦家；1815年维也纳会议将其并入普鲁士萨克森省。

en:
Huamachuco was a highland lordship whose seat was the walled sanctuary-city of Markahuamachuco, set on an isolated mesa in Peru's La Libertad region. Building began around AD 400, and by the Late Intermediate Period its lords ruled a Culli-speaking polity whose influence reached across northern Peru and into southern Ecuador.

Its wealth rested on the oracle of the thunder god Catequil, whose sanctuary at Namanchugo drew pilgrims from the whole northern Andes, and on trade with the Moche, Recuay and Cajamarca cultures.

The autonomous domain survived until about 1470, when the Incas conquered it; its people were resettled in a new Inca administrative town, also called Huamachuco, laid out on the Cusco to Quito highway with more than two hundred storehouses, while Atawallpa destroyed the old Catequil shrine. Augustinian missionaries founded the Spanish town on the Inca site in 1553.
zh:
瓦马丘科是一个高原领主邦，统治中心是孤立台地上的城墙圣城马卡瓦马丘科，在今秘鲁拉利伯塔德省。约公元400年开始营建，到晚期中间期，统治者已建立讲库利语的政权，势力遍及秘鲁北部并延伸到厄瓜多尔南部。

它的财富来自雷神卡特基尔的神谕，纳曼丘戈神殿吸引安第斯北部各地朝圣者，此外还有与莫切、雷夸伊和卡哈马卡诸文化的贸易。

这个自主政权存续至约1470年，随后被印加征服；居民被迁往同名的印加行政新城瓦马丘科，城建在库斯科至基多大道旁，配有两百多座仓库，阿塔瓦尔帕则捣毁了古老的卡特基尔神殿。1553年奥古斯丁会传教士在印加城址上建西班牙城镇。

en:
The Hacıemirid beylik, also called the beylik of Bayram and Chalybia in Greek sources, was a small Turkoman lordship on the Black Sea coast of Canik, ruled by Chepni chiefs from Mesudiye. Early in the fourteenth century the region passed from Mongol rule to the Eretnids, but the first bey, Bayram, declared independence in the Mongol civil war of 1335 and 1336 and fought Trebizond, joining a failed siege in 1348.

His son Hacıemir married a daughter of Basil of Trebizond in 1358 and, backed by the warlord Kadi Burhan al-Din, took the coastal city of Ordu in 1380. Civil war with his son Süleyman followed, and Süleyman took Giresun in 1397.

After Burhan al-Din's death the beylik accepted Ottoman suzerainty, briefly reasserted itself after Timur's 1402 victory at Ankara, and was annexed by the Ottomans in 1427.
zh:
哈吉埃米尔贝伊国又称巴伊拉姆贝伊国，希腊史料称哈利比亚，是黑海沿岸贾尼克地区的突厥蛮小邦，由切普尼部首领以梅苏迪耶为都统治。14世纪初该地区由蒙古人转归埃雷特纳人，但首任贝伊巴伊拉姆趁1335—1336年蒙古内战宣布独立，与特拉布宗帝国交战，1348年参与攻城失败。

其子哈吉埃米尔1358年迎娶特拉布宗君主瓦西里之女，在军阀卡迪·布尔汉丁支持下1380年攻占海滨城市奥尔杜。此后他与儿子苏莱曼内战，苏莱曼1397年夺取吉雷松。

布尔汉丁死后，贝伊国接受奥斯曼宗主权，1402年帖木儿安卡拉获胜后一度重新自立，1427年终被奥斯曼吞并。

en:
The Hoocak were a Siouan-speaking people whose territory included Wisconsin and neighboring lands around the upper Mississippi. They lived in permanent villages, growing maize, beans and squash and gathering wild rice; disease and conflict greatly reduced their numbers in the seventeenth century.

In the Black Hawk War of 1832, some Hoocak warriors raided American settlements while most of their people tried to avoid the conflict. The Hoocak ceded Wisconsin lands to the United States in 1829, 1832 and 1837.
zh:
霍查克是讲苏语的民族，领地包括威斯康星及密西西比河上游的邻近地区。他们居住在永久村落，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，采集菰米；疾病和冲突使他们的人口在17世纪大幅减少。

1832年黑鹰战争中，一些霍查克战士袭击美国定居点，大多数族人则试图避免卷入冲突。霍查克人在1829年、1832年和1837年向美国割让了威斯康星的土地。

en:
The Hachiun horde was the eastern appanage of the descendants of Hachiun, full younger brother of Genghis Khan and third son of Yesugei and Hoelun. The Secret History calls him Hachiun-alchi and says he was five when Temujin was nine; he is rarely mentioned in later campaigns and probably died young, yet in the distribution of 1207 he received his own subjects and pastures, ranked seventh among the imperial family's households.

His son Alchidai commanded the house under the Yuan and was enfeoffed Prince of Jinan; the family joined the Eastern, or Left Wing, princes on the Mongol-Manchurian steppe. In 1337 the horde, still ruled by a Borjigin prince, pastured around Qingzhou in Songnen under the great khan's supremacy.

When the Yuan fell in 1368, these appanages were absorbed into the Ming Three Guards of 1389, their princes keeping command of the nomadic guards.
zh:
合赤温汗国是成吉思汗同母弟合赤温后裔的东部投下封地。合赤温是也速该与诃额仑第三子，《蒙古秘史》称他合赤温·额勒赤，载铁木真九岁时他五岁；他在后来征战中很少被提及，可能早逝，但1207年分封时仍领有自己的属民和牧场，在皇室各户中位列第七。

其子按赤台在元朝承袭家业，受封济南王，该家族也位列蒙古与满洲草原上的东道诸王（左手诸王）。1337年，这个仍由孛儿只斤王公统治的部落游牧于松嫩庆州一带，奉大汗为宗主。

1368年元朝灭亡后，诸弟封地在1389年被明朝整编为兀良哈三卫，这些王公继续统领游牧卫所。

en: Huacrachuco was the homeland of peoples governed by local chiefs along the eastern side of the Marañón River in Peru. Their distinctive headwear bore deer horns, and they built settlements in defensible places. During the reign of Topa Inca Yupanqui from 1471 to 1493, the Incas conquered Huacrachuco before advancing against the Chachapoya farther north.
zh: 瓦克拉丘科是秘鲁马拉尼翁河东岸诸人群的家园，他们由地方首领统治。这些人戴着饰有鹿角的独特帽子，在易守之处建造聚落。1471年至1493年图帕克·印卡·尤潘基在位期间，印加人征服了瓦克拉丘科，随后向更北方的查查波亚人进军。

en:
Hada was a Haixi Jurchen polity east of Kaiyuan, enriched by trade through Guangshun Pass. From 1548 its Nara ruler Wang Tai built the Hulun confederation, bringing Ula, Yehe and Hoifa under his influence and taking the title of khan.

After Wang Tai died in 1582, his successors lost control of the confederation to Yehe. Hada later joined a coalition against the Jianzhou leader Nurhaci, but was incorporated into his domains in 1601.
zh:
哈达是开原以东的海西女真政权，因控制广顺关贸易而兴盛。自1548年起，纳喇氏首领王台建立扈伦联盟，将乌拉、叶赫和辉发纳入其势力范围，并称汗。

王台于1582年去世后，其继承者失去了对联盟的控制，叶赫取而代之。哈达后来加入反对建州首领努尔哈赤的联军，但于1601年被并入他的领地。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Hildesheim was a Holy Roman Empire church state in the Leine valley. Charlemagne founded a diocese at Elze in 800, and Louis the Pious moved the see here in 815. The cathedral's Thousand-year Rose, a dog rose on its apse, was linked to the founding legend.

Around 1000, under Bishops Bernward and Gotthard, Hildesheim became a Romanesque art centre famed for its bronze doors. Frederick II recognized Bishop Conrad II as a prince of the Empire in 1235, and in 1337 the Welf Henry III held the see.

The 1519 to 1523 Diocesan Feud with Henry the Younger of Brunswick cost it much land. Though most inhabitants turned Protestant in the sixteenth century, Wittelsbach prince-bishops from 1573 kept it Catholic and independent through the Counter-Reformation; the last, Clemens August, held other sees too. Secularized to Prussia in 1803, it went to Westphalia in 1807, Hanover in 1815.
zh:
希尔德斯海姆采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国莱讷河谷教会邦国。查理曼800年在埃尔策设教区，虔诚者路易815年迁座于此；主教座堂后殿犬蔷薇“千年玫瑰”与建城传说相连。

约1000年贝尔瓦德、戈特哈德两任主教治下，希尔德斯海姆成为罗马式艺术中心，以青铜大门闻名。1235年腓特烈二世承认主教康拉德二世为帝国诸侯，1337年韦尔夫家亨利三世在任。

1519—1523年与不伦瑞克年轻者亨利的纷争令它丧失许多领地。16世纪居民多改宗新教，1573年起维特尔斯巴赫主教借反宗教改革保住天主教信仰与独立，末任克莱门斯·奥古斯特兼领其他主教区。1803年世俗化归普鲁士，1807年转属威斯特伐利亚，1815年入汉诺威。

en:
Hamedān, on Iran's Mount Alvand, occupies Ecbatana's site; Herodotus calls it the Median king Deioces's capital in the seventh century BCE. It served the Achaemenids as a royal treasury and the Parthians and Sasanians as a summer capital, until Nahavand in 642 opened it to Islam.

Alavid sayyids ruled from the mid-ninth century, and Mardavij sacked it in 931; after taking the last Kakuyid fortress in 1047 the Seljuks moved the capital from Baghdad to Hamedān, where Avicenna had earlier served as vizier. The Mongols destroyed it in 1220, and Timur's armies destroyed it again.

With the Ilkhanate collapsing after 1335, Hamedān passed to its governor Mahmud ibn Isan Qutlugh, who fought for Ali Padshah at Qara Darra in 1336 and joined the Khorasanid claimant Togha Temür. It revived under the Safavids; Kurdish tribes seized it in 1719, Ottomans briefly held it in the eighteenth century, and Nader Shah recovered it.
zh:
哈马丹在伊朗西部阿尔万德山上，即埃克巴坦那遗址；希罗多德称它是公元前7世纪米底王戴奥凯斯的都城。先为阿契美尼德王室府库，后为帕提亚、萨珊夏都，642年尼哈旺德战役后伊斯兰化。

9世纪中叶阿拉维圣裔执政，931年马尔达维吉洗城；1047年塞尔柱人克卡库伊德最后堡垒，把首都从巴格达迁至哈马丹，伊本·西那早年曾在此任维齐尔。1220年蒙古人毁城，后帖木儿军队再毁。

1335年后伊儿汗国崩溃，哈马丹落入长官马哈茂德·伊本·伊桑·忽都鲁之手，此人1336年在加拉达拉为阿里帕夏作战，随后追随呼罗珊汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿。萨非王朝时复兴，1719年库尔德部落攻占它，18世纪奥斯曼人一度占据，纳迪尔沙复之。

en: The Hadhur were a Kurdish Sunni tribe of the Shahrizor plain, the fertile valley around present-day Sulaymaniyah whose medieval inhabitants the geographer Yaqut al-Hamawi described as Kurds governing their own country. In 1337 their chief, Taj al-Din Hadhur, held the tribe's seat at Sulaymaniyah as a vassal of the Jalayirid sultanate in Baghdad.
zh: 哈杜尔是活动于谢赫雷祖尔平原的逊尼派库尔德部落；这片肥沃谷地在今苏莱曼尼亚一带，中世纪地理学家雅库特·哈马维曾记载当地居民全是库尔德人，自行治理其地。1337年时，其首领塔杰丁·哈杜尔以苏莱曼尼亚为治所，率部充当巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的附庸。

en:
Hadiya was a Muslim kingdom south of Shewa in the highlands of Ethiopia, of Cushitic and Semitic peoples. Tradition traced the dynasty to Harar emir Abadir, who married a local Sidama; the kingdom is named in the thirteenth-century Kebra Nagast.

When King Amano refused tribute, Emperor Amda Seyon I crushed the revolt and made Hadiya an autonomous tributary of the Christian empire, its standing in 1337 under its garad, or ruler. Al-Umari describes a small rich land using iron currency and fielding tens of thousands of cavalry.

Under Zara Yaqob the rebellious garad Mahiko was deposed and killed, and the emperor married princess Eleni of Hadiya; Hadiya's ties to Adal helped provoke the Battle of Gomit in 1445. Hadiya welcomed imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi in the 1520s, lost parts to Oromo later in the century, and in the 1600s its garad Sidi Mohammed defeated Emperor Susenyos I, guarding its independence for centuries afterward.
zh:
哈迪亚是绍阿以南埃塞俄比亚高原上的穆斯林王国，居民为库希特、闪米特语族群。传统称王朝源出哈勒尔埃米尔阿巴迪尔与锡达莫人联姻，13世纪《众王荣耀》已载其名。

哈迪亚王阿玛诺拒绝纳贡后，阿姆达·塞约恩一世平叛，把哈迪亚变为基督教帝国自治纳贡地；1337年它在加拉德治下保持此身份。欧麦里载其地小而富，以铁为币，能出动数万骑兵。

扎拉·雅各布时反叛的加拉德马赫科被废黜杀死，皇帝迎娶哈迪亚公主埃莱妮；哈迪亚与阿达尔的关联是1445年戈米特战役的诱因之一。16世纪20年代哈迪亚迎接伊玛目艾哈迈德·加齐，后期部分土地被奥罗莫人占据；17世纪初加拉德西迪·穆罕默德击败苏塞尼奥斯一世，此后数百年保住独立。

en:
Heidenheim, on the Brenz at the eastern edge of the Swabian Alb, grew up beneath Hellenstein Castle, seat of the lords of Hellenstein. Gozbert de Halensteine founded the castle in 1096; his grandson Degenhard, a retainer of Frederick Barbarossa, enlarged it, and the town's first wall went up around 1190.

The Hellenstein male line died out in 1273, and the lordship passed through several hands; in 1356 Emperor Charles IV confirmed Heidenheim's market rights. From 1351 the counts of Helfenstein held the castle, and in 1448 Heidenheim passed to the Duchy of Teck, then held by Württemberg.

It was Bavarian between 1450 and 1504, and in 1503 Hellenstein became the centre of the Württemberg lordship of Heidenheim. The castle burned down in 1530 and was rebuilt by Duke Ulrich of Württemberg, and the Reformation reached the town in the 1520s.
zh:
海登海姆在施瓦本阿尔布东缘布伦茨河畔，依黑伦施泰因堡而兴，该堡是黑伦施泰因领主的居城。城堡1096年由戈茨佩特始建，其孙德根哈特作为腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的侍从大加扩建，城镇第一道城墙约1190年筑成。

黑伦施泰因男系1273年绝嗣，领地几度易手；1356年皇帝查理四世确认海登海姆集镇权。1351年起黑尔芬施泰因伯爵入主，1448年海登海姆在其治下并入当时由符腾堡执掌的泰克公国。

1450—1504年它归属巴伐利亚，1503年黑伦施泰因堡成为符腾堡海登海姆领地中心。城堡1530年焚毁，由符腾堡公爵乌尔里希重建，宗教改革16世纪20年代传入。

en:
The Hei were warrior lords of Hei district in Mutsu Province, around present-day Miyako. After the fall of the Kamakura shogunate in 1333, Hei Chikamitsu followed Kitabatake Akiie and had his lands confirmed.

The main line later took the name Takusari and faced repeated attacks by the Nanbu clan. Takusari Mitsuyoshi and his son Mitsushige entered Nanbu service and joined the invasion of Korea in the 1590s; Takusari Castle was dismantled while they were away.
zh:
闭伊氏是陆奥国闭伊郡的武家领主，活动于今宫古市一带。1333年镰仓幕府覆亡后，闭伊亲光追随北畠显家，所领得到确认。

宗家后来改称田锁氏，屡次受到南部氏攻击。田锁光好与其子光重归附南部氏，参加了1590年代的侵朝战争；他们出征期间，田锁城被拆毁。

en:
The Chel were the priestly Maya dynasty that ruled Ah Kin Chel, a northern kuchkabal, after the fall of Mayapan. Their founder Mo-Chel, a Mayapan noble and son-in-law of the high priest Ah Xupan Nauat, foresaw war between the Cocom and the Xiu and withdrew to Tecoh near Izamal, where in 1441 he founded a state named Ah Kin, the high priest's title, and Chel, his lineage.

When the league dissolved in 1461, Ah Kin Chel became one of Yucatán's seventeen successor kingdoms, held by the Chel without interruption until the Spanish arrival. Its lands covered the dry plain around Izamal and the Dzilam fishing ports.

The last ruler, Namux Chel, already reigned when Francisco de Montejo crossed in 1527; choosing accommodation over war, he let the Spaniards pass, and the peninsula had submitted by 1547.
zh:
切尔人是祭司出身的玛雅王朝，玛雅潘覆灭后统治北部城邦阿金切尔。开国者莫-切尔是玛雅潘贵族、大祭司阿·舒潘·纳瓦特的女婿；他预见到科科姆与休族的战争，退到伊萨马尔附近的特科，1441年自立国家，国名由大祭司头衔“阿金”加自己的家族名“切尔”拼成。

1461年联盟解体，阿金切尔成为尤卡坦十七个后继城邦之一，切尔家族世代统治，直至西班牙人到来。疆域涵盖伊萨马尔周围干旱平原和齐拉姆海岸渔港。

末代君主纳穆什·切尔在1527年弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍过境时已在位；他选择妥协而非开战，放西班牙人通行，到1547年整个半岛臣服。

en: The Old North was the region of northern Britain inhabited by Brittonic-speaking peoples in the early Middle Ages, including the kingdoms of Rheged and Strathclyde. Strathclyde, based near the Clyde, was incorporated into the kingdom of Scotland in the eleventh century.
zh: 古北境是中世纪早期不列颠北部布立吞语人群居住的地区，包括雷格德和斯特拉斯克莱德等王国。以克莱德河附近为中心的斯特拉斯克莱德在11世纪并入苏格兰王国。

en:
The Landgraviate of Hesse grew out of the Hessengau, named after the ancient Chatti and once held by Thuringian landgraves. When Henry Raspe died heirless in 1247, the Thuringian Succession War followed; Sophia of Brabant secured the lands for her son Henry the Child, first Landgrave in 1264 and founder of its ruling house, whom King Adolf raised to princely rank in 1292.

Split more than once into Upper and Lower Hesse, the landgraviate was reunited by Landgrave William II in 1500. In 1337 Henry II, called the Iron, ruled from Cassel until 1376 and fought Brunswick's dukes over his nephew Hermann's succession.

Under Philip the Magnanimous Hesse embraced Protestantism at the 1526 Synod of Homberg and led the Protestant princes against Charles V. Philip's death in 1567 split the landgraviate among his four sons into Hesse-Kassel, Hesse-Darmstadt and other lines.
zh:
黑森方伯国源于黑森高，其名来自古老的卡蒂人，曾归图林根方伯。1247年亨利·拉斯佩无嗣而终，引发图林根继承战争；布拉班特的索菲亚为幼子“孩童亨利”保住领地，他1264年成为首任黑森方伯、家族始祖，1292年国王阿道夫升其为诸侯。

领地不止一次分为上下黑森，1500年威廉二世重新统一。1337年在位的绰号“铁人”亨利二世，以卡塞勒为治所统治到1376年，曾为侄子赫尔曼的继承权与不伦瑞克诸公爵交战。

“宽宏的”菲利普治下，黑森1526年于霍姆贝格宗教会议皈依新教，率新教诸侯对抗查理五世。菲利普1567年死后，方伯国被四子分为黑森-卡塞尔、黑森-达姆施塔特等支系。

en:
Hezhou was a frontier mart on the upper Yellow River in southwestern Gansu, at Fuhan, where the road from the Chinese interior enters the Tibetan plateau. Former Liang made it a prefecture in the fourth century; the Tibetan Empire took it in 762, and it remained under Tibetan rule until Wang Shao's recovery in 1073.

Under the Mongols it became Hezhou Route in 1269 under the Tufan commission governing Amdo. In 1370 Ming general Deng Yu conquered it and accepted the surrender of Sonam Gonpo, marshal of the old commission; granted the surname He, he became hereditary assistant commander of the Hezhou Guard of 1371, ruling Dongxiang hills as a native tusi.

Guarding a state tea-and-horse market, Hezhou drew streams of migrants and traders; within a century of the Ming conquest its formerly predominantly Tibetan population had become predominantly Hui Muslim. Restored as a department in 1473, it passed to Lanzhou Prefecture in 1738.
zh:
河州是甘肃西南部黄河上游的边防商贸重镇，治所在枹罕，是内地进入青藏高原的门户。4世纪前凉始置河州；762年被吐蕃攻占，直到1073年王韶收复。

蒙古时期1269年改设河州路，隶属管辖安多的吐蕃等处宣慰使司。1370年明将邓愈西征，旧任宣慰使都元帅锁南普归降，获赐何姓，1371年出任新设河州卫世袭指挥同知，其家族作为土司治理东乡山地。

河州设有官营茶马互市，移民商旅云集，归附后不过百年，原本以藏族为主的居民就转为以回族穆斯林为主。1473年复置为普通散州，1738年改属兰州府。

en:
Khongorai was a confederation centered on the Minusinsk Basin in southern Siberia, whose leading people were the Yenisei Kyrgyz. In 1399 their leader Ügechi Khashikha gave the alliance the name Khongorai. Its people later formed part of the ancestry of the Khakas.

In 1614 Prince Nomchi attacked the Russian fort at Tomsk but failed to take it. Khongorai became a vassal of the Dzungar Khanate after the Dzungars defeated the Altan Khans in 1667. Russian incorporation of the region proceeded during the eighteenth century.
zh:
洪戈赖是南西伯利亚以米努辛斯克盆地为中心的部落联盟，叶尼塞吉尔吉斯人是其中的主要族群。1399年，其首领乌格齐·哈什哈将联盟命名为洪戈赖。联盟的居民后来成为哈卡斯人的祖先之一。

1614年，诺姆奇公进攻俄国的托木斯克堡垒，但未能攻占。1667年准噶尔人击败阿勒坦汗后，洪戈赖成为准噶尔汗国的属地。俄国在18世纪逐步将这一地区并入版图。

en:
Higuey was a Taíno chiefdom at the eastern end of Hispaniola when Columbus arrived in 1492. Its leaders included Cotubanamá, who resisted the Spanish forces sent by Governor Nicolás de Ovando under Juan de Esquivel.

After a truce broke down, Cotubanamá fled to Saona island, where the Spaniards captured him. He was hanged at Santo Domingo in 1504, and by 1519 most of the surviving Taíno in the Higuey region had been enslaved.
zh:
哥伦布于1492年抵达时，伊圭是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛东端的泰诺酋长国。它的首领包括科图瓦纳马，他抵抗了总督尼古拉斯·德·奥万多派遣、由胡安·德·埃斯基韦尔率领的西班牙军队。

休战破裂后，科图瓦纳马逃往萨奥纳岛，在那里被西班牙人俘获。他于1504年在圣多明各被绞死；到1519年，伊圭地区大多数幸存的泰诺人已被奴役。

en:
Hohenberg was a Swabian county of a mid-twelfth-century Hohenzollern branch, first seen in an 1170 Barbarossa charter. From Oberhohenberg Castle its counts expanded north by marriage: Burchard III gained Nagold and Burchard IV Horb on the Neckar.

The family's standing peaked when Gertrud of Hohenberg wed Rudolf of Habsburg about 1245, becoming Queen Anna beside the German king after 1273. Albert II founded Rottenburg on the Neckar around 1280 as the county's seat and appears as a minnesinger in the Manesse manuscript.

Partitions and debts eroded it: sales to Württemberg and Count Palatine Rupert followed in the 1360s–70s, and in 1381 Rudolf III sold the core, including Hohenberg and Horb, to Austria's Duke Leopold III for 66,000 gold gulden. The main line ended in 1389 and the last sideline in 1486, though the county survived in law as Habsburg land to 1806.
zh:
霍恩贝格是施瓦本贵族领地，其统治家族12世纪中叶自霍亨索伦分出，1170年首见巴巴罗萨特许状。伯爵据上霍恩贝格堡联姻北扩：布尔夏德三世得纳戈尔德，四世得内卡河畔霍尔布。

1245年前后声望登顶，格特鲁德嫁哈布斯堡鲁道夫，1273年鲁道夫成德意志国王，她以安娜之名称后。阿尔伯特二世约1280年建罗滕堡为治所，为《马内塞手抄本》中恋歌诗人。

分家债务日削伯国：14世纪60—70年代领地陆续售予符腾堡与行宫伯爵鲁普雷希特；1381年鲁道夫三世以6.6万金古尔登把含霍恩贝格、霍尔布的核心卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世。主支1389年绝，末支1486年绝嗣，伯国名义作哈布斯堡属地至1806年。

en:
The Hohokam were farming communities of the Gila and Salt river valleys in what is now Arizona. Their extensive canals supported irrigation agriculture in the Sonoran Desert, while settlements maintained trade links across the Southwest.

The great house at Casa Grande was part of a Hohokam complex that may have been abandoned by 1450. In 1694 the Jesuit Eusebio Kino visited its ruins and gave the site its Spanish name.
zh:
霍霍坎是今亚利桑那州希拉河与索尔特河流域的农业聚落群。他们修建的庞大运河网支撑着索诺兰沙漠的灌溉农业，聚落也与西南各地保持贸易联系。

卡萨格兰德的大屋是霍霍坎建筑群的一部分，可能在1450年前后被废弃。1694年，耶稣会士尤西比奥·基诺来到遗址，并为它起了西班牙语名称。

en:
Hsawng Hsup, recorded as Somsok or Samjok in the Manipur chronicles and called Thaungthut by the Burmese, was one of the most westerly Shan principalities. Its original seat lay in the forested Kabaw Valley near the Manipur border; only in the nineteenth century did its saopha move his headquarters east to Thaungdut on the Chindwin.

In 1470 the king of Manipur and the ruler of Pong, or Möng Kawng, jointly conquered and partitioned the state, and Manipur kept its claim for centuries.
