From the time of Bayinnaung in the 1550s the Burmese crown contested that claim, and the little principality became a bone of contention between Ava and Manipur, passing back and forth as each gained the upper hand in the Kabaw Valley. The long dispute was settled only in 1834, when the British Raj ceded Hsawng Hsup to Burma.
zh:
双肃在曼尼普尔编年史中记作 Somsok 或 Samjok，缅人称之为 Thaungthut，是最靠西的掸人小邦之一。最早治所在曼尼普尔边界附近密林覆盖的格包谷地；直到19世纪，诏法才把治所东迁钦敦江畔的当都。

1470年，曼尼普尔国王与“蓬”（即孟拱）统治者联手征服并瓜分该邦，曼尼普尔此后数百年保有对它的主张。

自16世纪50年代勃印曩时代起，缅甸王室挑战这一主张，小邦成为阿瓦与曼尼普尔反复争夺的对象，随双方在格包谷地的消长数易其主。这场长期争端直到1834年才了结，英属印度当局当年把双肃割让给缅甸。

en:
The Hienuki were local lords of Hienuki district along the Kitakami River in Mutsu Province. During the Waga family conflict of 1435, they supported a Waga branch against the main line; the Nanbu intervened, and the Hienuki made peace under Nanbu authority in 1436.

In 1555 Hienuki Terutoki visited Kyoto and presented gold to the shogun Ashikaga Yoshiteru. Toyotomi Hideyoshi confiscated the family's lands in 1590 after Hienuki Hirotada failed to attend the Odawara campaign; Hirotada joined a subsequent uprising but was defeated.
zh:
稗贯氏是陆奥国北上川流域稗贯郡的地方领主。1435年和贺氏内斗时，稗贯氏支持和贺支族对抗宗家；南部氏出兵干预，稗贯氏于1436年讲和并归于南部氏麾下。

1555年稗贯辉时前往京都，向将军足利义辉献上黄金。1590年，稗贯广忠因未参加小田原征伐，被丰臣秀吉没收领地；广忠参加了随后的起义，但遭到击败。

en:
The Tō were a branch of the Chiba warrior family, named for the Tō estate in Shimōsa held by their founder Tō Taneyori. A later branch ruled from Shinowaki Castle in Gujō, Mino Province.

In 1468 Saitō Myōchin seized Shinowaki while its lord Tō Tsuneyori was campaigning in the east, but returned it the following year. Tsuneyori was also a poet; in 1471 he taught the poet Sōgi his family's interpretation of the Kokinshū anthology.
zh:
东氏是千叶氏的武家支族，得名于始祖东胤赖所领的下总国东庄。其后一个支系以美浓国郡上的篠胁城为据点。

1468年，城主东常缘在东国征战期间，斋藤妙椿夺取篠胁城，次年又将其归还。常缘也是歌人，1471年他向歌人宗祇传授家传的《古今集》诠释。

en:
Hijan was the small Hūrga Jurchen polity seated at Boli on the Amur just above its junction with the Ussuri. In 722 the Tang court appointed a Heishui Mohe chieftain prefect of Boli, and under the Liao the place, renamed Puwali, was one of the Five Nations stations governing the lower Amur.

In the fifteenth century the Ming created the Bahulu Guard within the Nurgan commission, with local Tungusic chiefs as hereditary tributary officers. In 1643 the Later Jin founded a Bohori settlement at Boli, later under the Qing Sanxing deputy lieutenant-general.
zh:
希安是以伯力为中心的虎尔哈女真小邦，地处黑龙江与乌苏里江汇流处附近。722年，唐朝封黑水靺鞨酋长为勃利刺史；辽代该地改称剖阿里，是管辖黑龙江下游的五国部节度使驻地之一。

15世纪，明朝在此设巴忽鲁卫，隶奴儿干都司，以当地通古斯酋长为世袭朝贡官员。1643年，后金在伯力设博和哩噶珊，清代归三姓副都统管辖。

en: Hindustan was a Persian name used for northern India and, more broadly, the Indian subcontinent. The Mughal Empire, founded by Babur in 1526, used Hindustan as a name for its dominion.
zh: 印度斯坦是印度北部乃至整个印度次大陆的波斯语名称。巴布尔于1526年建立的莫卧儿帝国以印度斯坦称呼自己的领地。

en:
The Hiraaca, or Hidatsa, were a Missouri River people whose villages stood near the Knife River in present-day North Dakota. Three related village groups came together after settling along the Missouri; the name Hidatsa originally belonged to one of them. Big Hidatsa village was founded around 1600.

Alongside their Mandan allies, the Hiraaca grew corn, beans and squash and traded farm produce across a wide network. In 1837 smallpox struck the Knife River villages, causing heavy losses among their inhabitants.
zh:
希拉卡人又称希达察人，是密苏里河流域的族群，村落位于今北达科他州的奈夫河附近。三个有亲缘关系的村落群在密苏里河沿岸定居后汇合；希达察原是其中一群的名称。大希达察村约建于1600年。

希拉卡人与盟友曼丹人种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，并在广阔的贸易网络中交换农产品。1837年，天花袭击了奈夫河沿岸的村落，使居民遭受重大损失。

en:
Atcik-Hata, or Hitchiti, was a tribal town on the Chattahoochee River in present-day Georgia. Its people spoke Hitchiti and belonged to the Apalachicola association of towns; Spanish reports first named it in 1675.

Shortly after 1690, Hitchiti and other Apalachicola towns moved east to Ochese Creek, now the Ocmulgee River. In 1715 they returned to the Chattahoochee, where Hitchiti remained until its inhabitants were forced west to Indian Territory.
zh:
阿奇克哈塔，又称希奇蒂，是今佐治亚州查特胡奇河畔的部族聚落。当地人说希奇蒂语，属于阿巴拉契科拉聚落联盟；西班牙人的记载在1675年首次提及它。

1690年后不久，阿奇克哈塔和其他阿巴拉契科拉聚落东迁至奥奇西溪，即今奥克马尔吉河。1715年他们返回查特胡奇河，阿奇克哈塔此后一直留在那里，直到居民被迫西迁印第安领地。

en:
Haiyan gathers the Jurchen groups of the northern Hamgyong coast and the southern Tumen bank, the belt that later held Joseon's six garrisons. In 1258 the Mongols placed the region under the Ssangseong administration, staffed by hereditary Goryeo families, and in 1337 its Jurchen villagers answered to Yuan commanders. Goryeo retook Ssangseong in 1356.

Around 1388 the Odoli tribe led by Mengtemu's father settled at Womuho. Mengtemu offered tribute to Joseon in 1395, accepted a Ming commission in 1405 and headed the Jianzhou Left Guard, before he was killed with his eldest son in a tribal feud in 1433.

That same year King Sejong's Pajiang campaign cleared the Tumen bank of Jurchen strongholds, and the six garrisons built over the following decades fixed Korea's northern frontier.
zh:
哈伊彦指咸镜北部沿海及图们江南岸的女真诸部，这一地带后来设有朝鲜六镇。1258年蒙古设双城总管府，由高丽降人世袭管领，1337年当地女真村民听命于元朝长官。1356年高丽收复双城。

1388年前后，猛哥帖木儿之父率斡朵里部南下，定居斡木河；猛哥帖木儿1395年向朝鲜朝贡，1405年接受明朝任命，后来掌管建州左卫，1433年他与长子在部落仇杀中身亡。

同年，朝鲜世宗发动婆猪江战斗，清除图们江南岸的女真据点，此后数十年间陆续修筑的六镇奠定了朝鲜的北疆。

en: Holjaon was a Jurchen group named for the Hulan River, a tributary of the Sungari in present-day Heilongjiang. In 1605 a Joseon expedition sent north by Gwanghaegun destroyed a Jurchen tribe recorded as Holjaon.
zh: 忽剌温是以呼兰河得名的女真群体，呼兰河是今黑龙江境内松花江的支流。1605年，朝鲜光海君派兵北征，消灭了一个记作忽剌温的女真部落。

en:
Huexotzinco, meaning the place of small willows in Nahuatl, was a Nahua altepetl on the slopes of the Iztaccihuatl volcano northwest of Puebla. Its rulers traced descent to the Acolhua dynasty of Coatlinchan and honoured Camaxtli, war god of the Chichimeca, and Nahuatl was the main language.

It reached its height between the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, treating with the Aztec Triple Alliance and Tlaxcala and joining their flower wars to take sacrificial captives. In the fifteenth century it fell under Aztec domination but its loyalty to Tenochtitlan remained weak, and in 1520 Huexotzinco sided with Hernan Cortes and the Tlaxcalteca against the Aztecs.

Under Spanish rule it became an encomienda and, from 1525, the site of a Franciscan monastery around which the old settlement was rebuilt; its Nahuatl-speaking community kept codices recording tribute burdens in the later sixteenth century.
zh:
韦霍津戈在纳瓦特尔语中意为小柳树之地，是普埃布拉西北、伊斯塔西瓦特尔火山坡上的纳瓦人城邦。统治者自称出自科瓦特林昌的阿科尔瓦王朝，尊奉奇奇梅克战神卡马斯特利，居民以纳瓦特尔语为主。

13至14世纪，该政权达到鼎盛，与阿兹特克三国同盟及特拉斯卡兰缔约，并参加荣冠战争，掳获人牲献祭。15世纪它被阿兹特克人征服，但对特诺奇蒂特兰始终离心离德；1520年，韦霍津戈倒向埃尔南·科尔特斯和特拉斯卡兰一方，对抗阿兹特克。

西班牙统治时期，它成为委托监护地，1525年起方济各会在此建立修道院，旧聚落迁建到修道院周围；纳瓦特尔语社区16世纪后期仍以手抄本记录贡赋负担。

en:
Hakkari is the mountain country south of Lake Van, centred on the fortress of Çölemerik. Its Kurdish tribe crossed the Great Zab in 979 and supplied the Hakkariyya regiment, which helped bring the Ayyubids to power in Egypt; its commander Sayf al-Din Mashtub held Acre against Crusaders in 1191.

Izz al-Din Shir founded the emirate in the fourteenth century, switching between Timurids and Kara Koyunlu until his death in 1423; Qara Iskander later executed most of his heirs. His descendant Asad al-Din Zarin Cang returned from Egypt and stormed the family castles on a Saturday, giving the restored Shambo dynasty its name; his son Izz al-Din Shir II was killed by Aq Qoyunlu ruler Yaqub in 1491.

Emirs balanced between Ottomans and Safavids as the emirate fragmented into fiefs. In the early nineteenth century Soran's emir reduced Hakkari to vassalage; dynastic civil wars opened the way for absorption by the Ottomans in the Tanzimat era.
zh:
哈卡里是凡湖以南的山地之国，以彻莱梅里克要塞为中心。当地库尔德部落979年渡过大扎卜河，后来组成哈卡里军团，帮助阿尤布王朝在埃及掌权，统帅赛夫丁·马什图卜1191年曾据守阿卡抵抗十字军。

14世纪建国的伊兹丁·希尔在帖木儿与黑羊两王朝间反复改换门庭，直至1423年去世，黑羊的伊斯坎达尔随后处死了他的大部分继承人。后裔阿萨德丁·扎林·章从埃及返回，在一个星期六突袭收复家族城堡，重建的王统得名尚博王朝；其子伊兹丁·希尔二世1491年被白羊统治者叶尔孤白处死。

后来埃米尔们在奥斯曼与萨法维之间周旋，国家分裂为诸采邑。19世纪初索兰埃米尔将哈卡里降为附庸；家族内战为奥斯曼坦志麦特时期的吞并铺平道路。

en:
Hkamti, usually called Hkamti Long, or the Great Place of Gold, was a remote Shan state on the Mali River in the far north of Kachin State, with its chief town at Putao.

It began as an outlying territory of Möng Kawng, settled by the Hkamti, a Tai people whose language likely originated around Mogaung and who in the 1700s spread to the upper Brahmaputra valley in Assam.

Rather than a single principality, Hkamti Long was a loose cluster of seven small chiefdoms, Lokhun and Mansi among them, bound together under a saopha. Its isolation in the Irrawaddy headwaters kept it far from lowland Burmese power and free of direct lowland administration, and in later centuries its Shan population was gradually absorbed or displaced by the surrounding Kachin.
zh:
坎底常称坎底龙，意为“金地”，是马里河畔一个偏远的掸人邦国，位于克钦邦最北部，首邑在葡萄。

它最初是孟拱的边远属地，居民为坎底人——一支傣语族群，其语言很可能发源于莫冈一带，18世纪时有支系迁徙到阿萨姆的布拉马普特拉河上游。

坎底并非单一公国，而是洛洪、曼西等七个小酋邦的松散组合，共同奉一位诏法为首。地处伊洛瓦底江源头的深山使它远离低地缅人政权，从未被直接管辖；到后来的几个世纪，当地掸人逐渐被周围的克钦人同化或排挤。

en: Hatun Kañar was a Cañari center in the southern highlands of present-day Ecuador, near Ingapirca. The Cañari resisted Inca expansion before their conquest in the early 16th century. At Ingapirca the Incas built a complex that served as a fortress and storehouse for troops traveling north. In 1739 Charles Marie de La Condamine visited and described its ruins.
zh: 哈通卡尼亚尔是佳纳利人在今厄瓜多尔南部高地的中心，靠近因加皮尔卡。佳纳利人抵抗印加扩张，最终在16世纪初被征服。印加人在因加皮尔卡建造建筑群，作为北上军队的要塞和仓库。1739年，夏尔·马里·德·拉孔达米讷到访并记述了这里的遗址。

en:
Hokuzan was the northernmost of the three kingdoms that split Okinawa after 1314, when the lord of Nakijin threw off Tamagusuku's loose overlordship and made Nakijin Castle on the Motobu Peninsula his seat. In 1337 its lord was Haniji, the first Hokuzan ruler named in Chinese records.

It was the largest but poorest and least populated of the three, with no harbour to match Chūzan's Naha, and its rulers were petty lords with their own retainers rather than true kings. After Chūzan entered Ming tribute relations in 1372, Hokuzan gained the same trading status but sent only nine missions to China in thirty years.

Vassal disputes weakened it in the 1410s; in 1416 three anji lords defected to Chūzan, Nakijin fell after a fierce defence, its king killed himself and Shō Hashi annexed the kingdom.
zh:
北山是1314年后冲绳三王国中位置最北的一个：今归仁首领脱离玉城松散的宗主权，在本部半岛的今归仁城建立统治。1337年在位的怕尼芝，是中国史籍留名的第一位北山统治者。

三国之中北山疆域最大，却最贫瘠、人口最稀，也没有可与中山那霸相比的港口；统治者只是拥有家臣的小领主，并非真正的国王。1372年中山向明朝朝贡后，北山也获得同样的贸易地位，但三十年间仅派出九次贡使。

15世纪10年代家臣内讧削弱国势，1416年三名按司投奔中山，今归仁城激战后陷落，国王自尽，北山被尚巴志吞并。

en: The Haisla were Indigenous peoples of the inlets around Kitimat on the coast of what is now British Columbia. They included the Kitamaat people of the upper Douglas and Devastation channels and the Kitlope people of the Gardner Canal and upper Princess Royal Channel.
zh: 海斯拉是今不列颠哥伦比亚海岸基蒂马特附近海湾的原住民。其中包括居住在道格拉斯海峡和德瓦斯泰申海峡上游的基蒂马特人，以及居住在加德纳水道和皇家公主海峡上游的基特洛普人。

en:
The God's House League grew from an alliance of communities around Chur in the Alpine valleys of what is now Switzerland. In 1367 delegates from the cathedral, the valleys and Chur met to resist the indebted bishop's plans and limit his power.

In 1409 they established a permanent council and appointed an officer to oversee the bishop. The league joined the Grey League and the League of the Ten Jurisdictions in 1471, forming the Three Leagues; the Ilanz Articles of 1524–1526 ended the bishop's remaining political authority.
zh:
神所同盟由今瑞士境内阿尔卑斯山谷中库尔周边的社群联合而成。1367年，主教座堂、山谷和库尔城的代表集会，反对负债累累的主教的计划，并限制他的权力。

1409年，他们设立常设议会，并任命官员监督主教。1471年，神所同盟与灰色同盟、十辖区同盟组成三同盟；1524—1526年的伊兰茨条款终结了主教剩余的政治权力。

en:
The County of Helfenstein was named for its counts' ancestral castle above Geislingen on the Swabian Alb, built around 1100 by Eberhard the Elder. It commanded the imperial road from Brabant to Italy, and Geislingen grew at its foot as a toll station. Around 1200 Count Ludwig IV of Spitzenberg married the Helfenstein heiress, and in 1226, his line failing, he merged the two inheritances as Ludwig I.

Ulrich V served Charles IV and married his kinswoman Maria of Bosnia, a costly match beginning the family's decline. In 1356 the house split into Wiesensteig and Blaubeuren branches.

Wiesensteig pledged Geislingen lands to Ulm in 1382 and, unable to repay over 123,000 gulden, lost the ancestral castle and twenty-seven villages in 1396. The Blaubeuren branch lost most of its lands to Württemberg in 1448; the male line died out in 1627.
zh:
黑尔芬施泰因伯爵领得名于盖斯林根上方的家族祖堡，该堡约1100年由埃伯哈德长者修建。祖堡扼守布拉班特通往意大利的帝国大道，盖斯林根镇在山脚税卡旁兴起。约1200年施皮岑贝格伯爵路德维希四世娶黑尔芬施泰因女继承人，1226年其本支绝嗣后以路德维希一世之名合并两份遗产。

乌尔里希五世侍奉皇帝查理四世，娶其亲族波斯尼亚的玛丽亚，奢华婚姻开启家族衰败。1356年家族分裂为维森施泰格与布劳博伊伦两支。

维森施泰格支1382年将盖斯林根领地抵押给乌尔姆，因无力偿还超过12.3万古尔登，1396年祖堡连同二十七个村庄尽归该城。布劳博伊伦支产业1448年大半落入符腾堡之手，男系1627年断绝。

en:
The Hüleguids were the Borjigin descendants of Hülegü Khan, whose Mongol army ended Abbasid rule at Baghdad in 1258 and built the Ilkhanate over Persia and Arab Iraq. Basra and the lower Tigris towns became Mongol-governed, soldier-settled lands.

When Il-Khan Abu Sa'id died without an heir in 1335, the empire shattered into rival amirates, its Hülegüid princes puppets of competing emirs. Musa Khan, grandson of Il-Khan Baydu, was enthroned in 1336 by Ali Padshah after Jaghatu, but defeated that July at Qara Darra and fled to Baghdad; in June 1337 he joined the eastern claimant Togha Temür, occupied Soltaniyeh, and was captured and killed on 10 July 1337.

With the Borjigin claimants exhausted, Arab Iraq passed to the Jalayirids of Hasan Buzurg. In the early fifteenth century the Arab Al-Mughamis held Basra under Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu overlordship, until the Moshasha and then the Safavids under Ismail I took it in 1508.
zh:
旭烈兀家族是旭烈兀汗的孛儿只斤后裔；1258年蒙古大军在巴格达终结阿拔斯王朝，建立波斯和阿拉伯伊拉克的伊儿汗国，巴士拉及底格里斯河下游城镇成为蒙古人治理、驻军屯居之地。

1335年伊儿汗阿布·赛义德无嗣而终，帝国碎为敌对的埃米尔国，旭烈兀诸王沦为埃米尔傀儡。木撒汗为伊儿汗拜都之孙，1336年贾加图战役后由阿里·帕迪沙扶上汗位，7月在喀拉达拉战败，逃奔巴格达；1337年6月与东部争夺者脱合帖木儿合兵，占领苏丹尼耶，7月10日被俘处死。

孛儿只斤争夺者凋零后，阿拉伯伊拉克落入哈桑·布祖尔格的札剌亦儿王朝。15世纪初，阿拉伯穆加米斯部落据有巴士拉，先后臣服黑羊、白羊两王朝；穆沙沙继而入主，伊斯玛仪一世最终于1508年攻占该城，并入萨法维王朝。

en:
The Heiltsuk were Indigenous peoples of the central coast of what is now British Columbia, organized in groups linked to winter villages and extended families. They probably first encountered Europeans in 1793 and became intermediaries in the coastal fur trade.

In 1833 the Hudson's Bay Company established Fort McLoughlin on Campbell Island near a Heiltsuk village. The post drew traders from neighbouring peoples, and a Heiltsuk settlement grew beside it at McLoughlin Bay.
zh:
海尔楚克是今不列颠哥伦比亚中部海岸的原住民，由与冬季村落和大家族相联系的群体组成。他们很可能在1793年首次遇到欧洲人，后来成为沿海毛皮贸易的中间商。

1833年哈德逊湾公司在坎贝尔岛的一座海尔楚克村落附近建立麦克劳克林堡。贸易站吸引了邻近各族的商人，麦克劳克林湾的堡垒旁也兴起了一处海尔楚克聚落。

en:
Al-Hillah, on the Euphrates south of Baghdad and beside the ruins of Babylon, was founded in 1012 by Ali ibn Mazyad of the Shia Banu Mazyad dynasty, becoming their walled capital under Sadaqa I after 1086.

Abbasid forces took the city in 1163, ending Mazyadid rule, yet it remained a centre of Shia learning and birthplace of the theologian Allamah al-Hilli. After the Mongol conquest of 1258 it passed from the Ilkhanate to the Baghdad Jalayirids, whose last rulers retreated to Hillah before the Qara Qoyunlu took it in 1431.
zh:
希拉位于巴格达以南的幼发拉底河畔，紧邻巴比伦废墟。1012年什叶派马兹亚德王朝的阿里·伊本·马兹亚德在此建定居点，1086年后萨达卡一世筑墙，希拉成为都城。

1163年阿拔斯军队占领该城，马兹亚德统治结束，但希拉仍是什叶派学术重镇，神学家阿拉玛·希里出生于此。1258年蒙古征服后，它先后归伊儿汗国和巴格达札剌亦儿王朝；末代君主退守希拉，1431年该城被黑羊王朝攻占。

en: Halkomelem-speaking Coast Salish communities lived on southeastern Vancouver Island and along the lower Fraser River. They included the Stó:lō of the Fraser Valley, while islanders crossed the Strait of Georgia for the summer salmon runs.
zh: 讲哈尔科梅勒姆语的海岸萨利什社群居住在温哥华岛东南部和弗雷泽河下游。他们包括弗雷泽河谷的斯托洛人，岛上居民则会横渡乔治亚海峡，赶上夏季的鲑鱼洄游。

en:
Halan takes its name from the Halan country of the Hailan River, the Helan water under the Jin and Halan river under the Ming, a Tumen tributary whose Manchu name hailan means elm. The Jin ruled Yanbian through the Halan route, and the Yuan created Halan Prefecture, its seat south of Hamhung beside the Ssangseong administration. In 1337 its Jurchen and Goryeo inhabitants answered to the Liaoyang province.

Goryeo's 1356 northeast campaign overran the Yuan border governments and took the region. In 1407 the Ming set up the Halancheng Guard on the Hailan to bind local Jurchen chiefs with titles and tribute.
zh:
哈兰得名于海兰江流域的合兰之地，这条图们江支流辽金时称曷懒水，明代称合兰河，满语hailan意为榆树。金代以曷懒路管辖延边，元朝设合兰府，治所在咸兴以南，与双城总管府相邻；1337年府内女真、高丽居民由辽阳行省统辖。

1356年高丽东北用兵，攻灭元朝边境政权，纳入朝鲜版图。1407年明朝在海兰江设合兰城卫，以封职朝贡维系女真首领。

en:
The Hamidid beylik arose around 1301 in the lakes region of southwestern Anatolia, taking in Isparta, Eğirdir and Uluborlu, its first capital. Its founder Dündar Bey, also called Felek al-Din, came of Seljuk frontier lords named after his grandfather Hamid, and the country was called Hamideli.

Dündar resisted Ilkhanid strongman Emir Çoban, whose son Timurtash had him killed and handed Antalya to a rival kinsman, from which the separate Teke beylik grew. Dündar's son Hızır recovered the core lands around Eğirdir, where the capital later moved.

In 1374 the later ruler Hüseyin, worn down by Karamanid attacks, sold Akşehir, Beyşehir and other towns to the Ottoman sultan Murad I for eighty thousand gold pieces, retaining only Isparta and Eğirdir. The reduced beylik was annexed by Bayezid I in 1391 as the Ottoman Sanjak of Hamid.
zh:
哈米德贝伊国约1301年兴起于安纳托利亚西南湖区，领有伊斯帕尔塔、埃伊尔迪尔和最早的都城乌卢博尔卢。开国者丁达尔贝伊又名费莱克丁，出身塞尔柱边侯世家，国名得自祖父哈米德，国土称哈米德之地。

丁达尔抗拒伊儿汗国权臣楚邦，其子帖木儿塔什杀了他，把安塔利亚交给争位同族，泰凯贝伊国由此分立；丁达尔之子赫泽尔收复埃伊尔迪尔周边疆土，都城后来迁到那里。

1374年后继统治者侯赛因不堪卡拉曼人攻扰，以八万金币把阿克谢希尔、贝伊谢希尔等城卖给奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德一世，只保留伊斯帕尔塔和埃伊尔迪尔。1391年，萎缩的贝伊国被巴耶济德一世吞并，成为奥斯曼的哈米德桑贾克。

en:
The Lordship of Hanau was a Wetterau territory on the lower Main, held by a noble family first recorded in 1166 that took the name of Hanau castle from 1191. Reinhard I married the heiress Adelheid of Münzenberg, and his son Ulrich I wed Elisabeth of Rieneck, whose inheritance brought Steinau in the Kinzig valley in 1290. Ulrich I became governor of the Wetterau in 1300, and in 1303 King Albert I raised the settlement beneath the castle to a market town. In 1320 Emperor Louis IV pledged the Bornheimerberg district to Ulrich II, the lord ruling in 1337, beginning a long feud with Frankfurt. The house adopted one of Germany's earliest primogeniture statutes in 1375 and inherited the Schlüchtern lands of the Rieneck counts in 1377.

Emperor Sigismund raised Hanau to a county in 1429, and in 1458 it split into Hanau-Münzenberg and Hanau-Lichtenberg. The Münzenberg line turned Lutheran in the 1520s and Calvinist in 1593, and settled Walloon and Dutch religious refugees in a fortified New Town from 1597. Hanau endured Swedish occupation and an imperial siege during the Thirty Years' War; Count Friedrich Casimir later founded Germany's first faience factory but nearly bankrupted the county with his Guiana lease scheme of 1669. The male line died out in 1736, when Hanau-Münzenberg passed to Hesse-Kassel and Hanau-Lichtenberg to Hesse-Darmstadt.
zh:
哈瑙领地是韦特劳地区位于美因河下游的一片领地，统治家族最早见于1166年的记载，1191年起以哈瑙城堡为姓。赖因哈德一世娶了女继承人阿德尔海德·冯·明岑贝格，其子乌尔里希一世又娶伊丽莎白·冯·里内克；1290年，后一桩婚姻带来的遗产使哈瑙得到金齐希河谷的施泰瑙。1300年乌尔里希一世出任韦特劳行政长官，1303年国王阿尔布雷希特一世将城堡下的聚落升格为设有集市的城镇。1320年，皇帝路易四世把博恩海姆贝格地区抵押给1337年在位的领主乌尔里希二世，哈瑙与法兰克福由此结下长期纷争。1375年，哈瑙家族订立了德意志最早的长子继承法令之一，1377年又继承了里内克伯爵的施吕希滕领地。

1429年，西吉斯蒙德皇帝将哈瑙升格为伯国，1458年它分裂为哈瑙-明岑贝格和哈瑙-利希滕贝格两支。明岑贝格一支在16世纪20年代改宗路德宗，1593年又改宗加尔文宗，并从1597年起接纳瓦隆和荷兰的宗教难民，在设防的新城安置他们。三十年战争期间，哈瑙经历了瑞典占领和帝国军队的围攻；后来伯爵弗里德里希·卡西米尔建起德意志第一家彩陶工厂，却因1669年的圭亚那租赁计划几乎使伯国破产。1736年男系绝嗣，哈瑙-明岑贝格并入黑森-卡塞尔，哈瑙-利希滕贝格则并入黑森-达姆施塔特。

en:
The County of Henneberg was a Franconian comital land between the Thuringian Forest, the Rhön hills and the Main, held by the counts of Henneberg from the late eleventh century and split into lines, of which the Schleusingen was foremost. In 1310 Emperor Henry VII raised the county to an immediate princely county.

In 1337 its ruler was Count Berthold VII of Henneberg-Schleusingen, called the Wise, who inherited as a child in 1284 and from 1323 to 1330 was guardian of Louis V, the young son of Emperor Louis IV and Margrave of Brandenburg.

His daughter married a Hohenzollern Burgrave of Nuremberg, making the counts grandparents of later Brandenburg electors, yet the Henneberg male line ran out in 1583. The inheritance fell to the Wettin electors of Saxony, who in 1660 divided the Henneberg lands, including Meiningen and Schleusingen, among their Ernestine duchies.
zh:
亨讷贝格伯国是图林根林山、勒恩山与美因河之间的法兰克尼亚伯爵领地，11世纪末起为亨讷贝格家族所有，后分成数支，以施莱辛根一支最显赫。1310年皇帝亨利七世将它升格为直属帝国的封侯伯国。

1337年在位的是施莱辛根伯爵贝特霍尔德七世，人称智者，1284年幼年袭爵，1323至1330年为皇帝路易四世之子、勃兰登堡藩侯路易五世摄政。

他的女儿嫁给霍亨索伦家的纽伦堡城堡伯爵，使伯爵夫妇成为后来勃兰登堡选侯的外祖父母；亨讷贝格男系仍于1583年断绝。遗产落入萨克森韦廷选侯之手，1660年他们把迈宁根、施莱辛根等亨讷贝格土地分给恩斯特系各公国。

en:
Huncun was a Jurchen polity at the foot of the Changbai mountains on the lower Tumen, where the borders of China, Korea and Russia meet. Sushen and Yilou fishing communities had lived there in early centuries, and the district became part of Balhae's Nanhai prefecture, with Balhae's eastern capital at Baliancheng nearby.

Under the Jin it belonged to the Hailan route and under the Yuan to Kaiyuan province; in 1337 its clans were tributary Jurchens of the Yuan court.

After 1407 the Ming planted guards around Hunchun, among them the Guluhunshan and Tongkuanshan, and the late Ming saw the area held by the Manchu Sumuru clan. From 1653 Ningguta administered it, and in 1714 the Qing posted a Hunchun commandant, the first official use of the name.
zh:
珲春是图们江下游、长白山脚下的女真政权，地处中、朝、俄三国交界。这一带早有肃慎、挹娄渔猎部落，后属渤海南京南海府，渤海东京城设在附近的八连城。

金代属海兰路，元代归开元路，1337年当地氏族是向元朝纳贡的女真人。

1407年后明朝在珲春周围设古鲁浑山卫、童宽山卫等卫所，明末为满族舒穆禄氏所据。1653年起由宁古塔统辖，1714年清朝设珲春协领，珲春一名首次见于官方建制。

en: Hunehe was a Jianzhou Jurchen tribe north of the Yalu in the Ming period. Irgen Gioro clansmen also lived in Hunehe under the early Manchu state.
zh: 浑河是明代鸭绿江以北的建州女真部落之一。满洲政权初期，浑河地区也有伊尔根觉罗氏族人居住。

en:
The Hanan Chanka, or Parkos, were the warlike upper half of the Chanka confederation that arose in the Ayacucho highlands after the Wari collapse, with chief seats at Paucara and market town Chocquemarca.

Tradition credits founder Uscovilca with beginning Chanka expansion, and colonial chronicles describe an aggressive lordship whose fighters painted their faces, carried ancestral mummies into battle and drank from skull-cups.

In 1438 commanders Astoy Huaraca and Tomay Huaraca led thirty thousand or more warriors against Cusco, but Inca prince Cusi Yupanqui, later Emperor Pachacuti, broke them at the Battle of Yawarpampa and opened the road to empire. Surviving Hanan Chanka were absorbed into the Tahuantinsuyo as soldiers and resettled colonists, and in the Inca civil war sided with Huáscar.
zh:
哈南·昌卡又称帕尔科斯，是昌卡联盟尚武的上半部，兴起于瓦里崩溃后的阿亚库乔高原，据点在保卡拉和集镇乔克马尔卡。

传说始祖乌斯科维尔卡开启昌卡扩张，殖民编年史家称其为好战的领主政权：战士脸上涂彩，肩扛祖先木乃伊出征，以敌人头骨做酒杯。

1438年将领阿斯托伊·瓦拉卡和托马伊·瓦拉卡率三万或更多人进攻库斯科，印加王子库西·尤潘基，即后来的皇帝帕查库特克，在亚瓦尔潘帕战役中将其击溃，由此踏上帝国之路。幸存的哈南·昌卡人并入塔万廷苏尤，充当士兵和屯垦者，印加内战中支持瓦斯卡尔。

en:
The Honma were warrior lords of Sado Island, descended from a family named for Honma in Sagami Province. They entered Sado as deputy governors under the Ōbutsu and held Sawada Castle, while branches established themselves at Kawarada and Hamochi.

In 1510 the Sawada and Hamochi branches helped Nagao Tamekage defeat Uesugi Akisada in Echigo. Rivalries later divided the family, and Uesugi Kagekatsu invaded Sado in 1589, defeating the Honma and taking Hamochi Castle.
zh:
本间氏是佐渡岛的武家领主，家名来自相模国的本间。家族作为大佛氏的守护代进入佐渡，以杂太城为据点，分支则在河原田和羽茂立足。

1510年，杂太和羽茂两支本间氏协助长尾为景在越后击败上杉显定。此后家族内部争斗不休，1589年上杉景胜入侵佐渡，击败本间氏并攻取羽茂城。

en: The Hinono'eino, or Arapaho, were an Algonquian-speaking people whose ancestors moved from the western Great Lakes onto the Great Plains before 1700. After acquiring horses in the early 1700s, they hunted bison across the plains. Around 1811 they allied with the Cheyenne, and by 1826 their alliance with the Lakota and Dakota had pushed the Kiowa and Comanche southward.
zh: 希诺埃尼诺人又称阿拉帕霍人，说阿尔冈昆语系语言，其祖先在1700年以前从五大湖西部迁至大平原。18世纪初获得马匹后，他们在平原上猎捕野牛。约1811年，他们与夏延人结盟；到1826年，他们与拉科塔人、达科他人及夏延人组成的联盟将凯奥瓦人和科曼奇人向南驱逐。

en:
Honnavara, Hinawr to medieval Arab sailors, is a sheltered Sharavathi-mouth port on the Kanara coast, where the Western Ghats meet the Arabian Sea. Its Nawayath community descended from Arab mariners and merchants of Yemen, Oman and the Persian Gulf who settled among the Konkani and spoke Nawayathi; by the fourteenth century their chiefs ruled it as a small Muslim sultanate.

Ibn Battuta in 1342 found Sultan Jamaluddin, whom he called one of the best and most powerful rulers, governing Hunnur with its mosque and minaret through Indian Ocean trade. Portuguese built a fortress here in the sixteenth century, and English warehouses followed in the eighteenth.

Kanara passed through Vijayanagara, Bahmani and Bijapuri spheres before Marathas took it in the 1750s and Hyder Ali and Tipu made Honnavara one of Mysore's chief ports, until the 1799 Fourth Mysore War gave the town to the East India Company.
zh:
霍纳沃尔中世纪阿拉伯海商称希瑙尔，是卡纳达海岸沙拉瓦蒂河口良港，西高止山俯临阿拉伯海。纳瓦亚特社群源自也门、阿曼和波斯湾的阿拉伯水手与商人，定居康坎人中间，使用纳瓦亚特语；14世纪首领把该港经营成穆斯林小苏丹国。

1342年伊本·白图泰到访，苏丹贾马鲁丁在位，白图泰称他是最贤明有力的君主之一，靠印度洋贸易统治建有清真寺和宣礼塔的胡努尔。16世纪葡萄牙人筑堡垒，18世纪英国人开商馆。

卡纳达先后属毗奢耶那伽罗、巴赫马尼和比贾布尔势力范围，1750年代为马拉塔人所夺，海德尔·阿里与提普苏丹将霍纳沃尔建成迈索尔主要港口之一，1799年第四次迈索尔战争后该港归东印度公司。

en:
The name Hasnuya recalls the Hasanwayhids, a Kurdish dynasty of the Barzikani tribe that rose in the mountains of western Iran in the tenth century.

Founder Hasanwayh ibn Husayn gathered fortresses around Kermanshah from the 960s, and his son Badr, honoured as Nasir al-Dawla in 998, ruled from Kermanshah and Hulwan to Nahavand and at his height held the Shahrizor plain.

The dynasty was Shia and minted its own coins, but its feud with the rival Annazids proved fatal: Badr fell fighting in 1014, the Annazids seized Shahrizor and overthrew the family by 1015, and its last heir died at Sarmaj stronghold in 1047. In 1337 the name belonged to a Kurdish tribe holding Shahrazur as a vassal of the Jalayirids.
zh:
哈斯努亚一名可追溯到哈桑瓦伊德王朝，即10世纪兴起于伊朗西部山区的巴尔齐卡尼部库尔德王朝。

始祖哈桑瓦伊·伊本·侯赛因自960年代在克尔曼沙阿一带聚堡自立；其子巴德尔998年获赐纳绥尔丁称号，全盛时疆域从克尔曼沙阿、霍尔万延伸至纳哈万德，据有谢赫雷祖尔平原。

王朝信奉什叶派，自铸钱币，与宿敌安纳兹库尔德人的争斗却致命：巴德尔1014年战死，安纳兹人夺取谢赫雷祖尔，至1015年攻灭其国，末代继承人1047年死于萨尔马杰堡。1337年这个名字属于据守萨赫拉祖尔、臣属札剌亦儿王朝的库尔德部落。

en:
Hunza was a Burusho kingdom in the Hunza valley, high in the Karakoram ranges of Gilgit-Baltistan in Pakistan, with its seat at the Baltit fort above the river.

It took shape around 1200 and stayed independent for centuries: rulers bore the title Thum, later Mir, and claimed descent from Alexander the Great, while their people were known as Kanjutis. In 1337 it was still an isolated mountain monarchy, separated from Nagar to the south, living from terraced fields and passes towards Xinjiang; Kanjuti raiders sometimes seized Kirghiz herdsmen in high pastures and sold them into slavery in China.

From 1761 the Mir sent gold dust tribute to the Qing and received silk, tea and porcelain in return, binding the kingdom to China into the nineteenth century.
zh:
罕萨是布鲁绍人在罕萨河谷建立的王国，地处巴基斯坦吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦的喀喇昆仑群山中，中心是高踞河谷之上的巴勒提特堡。

这个约1200年形成的小邦独立存在数百年：统治者称图姆，后改称弥尔，自称亚历山大大帝后裔，居民称坎巨提人。1337年它仍是闭塞的山地君主国，南与那迦罗隔河谷相望，靠梯田和通往新疆的山口为生；坎巨提骑手有时到高山牧场掳走柯尔克孜牧民，贩到中国为奴。

1761年起弥尔向清朝进贡砂金，换回绸缎、茶叶和瓷器，朝贡关系把山国与清帝国维系到19世纪。

en:
The County of Hohenzollern was the Swabian homeland of its house, ancestors documented at Hechingen in 1061, its castle hailed as crown of Swabian castles. In the thirteenth century the family split: the younger branch followed Conrad I to the burgraviate of Nuremberg, later reaching Brandenburg and Prussia, while the senior Swabian line kept the county and stayed Catholic.

The counts acquired Balingen on the Eyach in the thirteenth century and founded the town in 1255. Frederick IX, the Black Count, succeeded in 1339, led the Swabian Lion League and in 1344 divided the inheritance with a brother; his line ended when his son died in 1412.

Balingen went to Württemberg in 1403; in 1423 the Swabian League of Cities destroyed Hohenzollern Castle after a long siege. In 1576 the county was partitioned into Hohenzollern-Hechingen, Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and Hohenzollern-Haigerloch, whose lines were raised to principalities before joining the Rhine Confederation in 1806.
zh:
霍亨索伦伯国是该家族在施瓦本的祖产，先祖1061年首见于黑兴根文献，城堡被誉为施瓦本城堡之冠。13世纪家族分裂：幼支随康拉德一世任纽伦堡城堡伯爵，后至勃兰登堡与普鲁士；长支保有伯国，始终信奉天主教。

伯爵们13世纪取得埃亚赫河畔巴林根，1255年建城。1339年“黑伯爵”腓特烈九世继位，领施瓦本狮子同盟，1344年与弟分产，其支随其子1412年去世而告终。

巴林根1403年卖给符腾堡；1423年施瓦本城市同盟久围攻毁霍亨索伦城堡。1576年分裂为霍亨索伦-黑兴根、霍亨索伦-锡格马林根、霍亨索伦-海格洛赫三支，先后升侯国，1806年加入莱茵邦联。

en: Hoifa was a Jurchen polity in the Hoifa River basin, ruled by a branch of the Nara clan. Its ancestor Angguli came south from the Heilongjiang region, and Wangginu established the polity in the late Ming period. In 1607 Nurhaci defeated Wangginu's grandson Baindari, and the Hoifa ruling family and its followers were incorporated into the Eight Banners.
zh: 辉发是辉发河流域的女真部国，由那拉氏的一支统治。其祖先昂古里从黑龙江地区南迁，王机砮在明朝后期建立了辉发部国。1607年，努尔哈赤击败王机砮之孙拜音达礼，辉发统治家族及其部众被编入八旗。

en:
The County of Holland was a Holy Roman Empire lordship in the Rhine-Meuse delta, roughly later North and South Holland. First West Frisia, renamed Holland, Old Dutch for woodland, around 1100; Floris V subdued the West Frisians only in 1289.

In 1299 the native line ended; Avesnes of Hainaut inherited; William of Avesnes ruled Holland, Zeeland and Hainaut from The Hague in 1337. William II fell fighting Frisians in 1345; Wittelsbach Bavaria-Straubing dukes inherited, and the Hook and Cod Wars occurred under their rule; Burgundy's Philip the Good took over in 1433, and Holland passed to Habsburg Netherlands in 1482.

Sea Beggars took Holland in 1572 during the Eighty Years' War, and after the 1581 Act of Abjuration it became the leading province of the Seven United Provinces in their Golden Age. The county ended in the 1795 Batavian Revolution, and its lands became a province of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands after 1813.
zh:
荷兰伯国是神圣罗马帝国莱茵河—默兹河三角洲领地，沼泽约当今天的北荷兰和南荷兰省。初称西弗里斯兰，约1100年改名荷兰（古荷兰语意为林地），弗洛里斯五世1289年才降伏西弗里斯兰人。

1299年本土世系绝嗣，阿韦讷家族继承，1337年威廉在海牙统治荷兰、泽兰、埃诺。1345年威廉二世征弗里斯兰人战死，维特尔斯巴赫巴伐利亚-施特劳宾支系继位，其间爆发鱼钩与鳕鱼战争；1433年勃艮第的好人腓力接管，1482年归哈布斯堡尼德兰。

八十年战争中海上乞丐1572年夺取荷兰，1581年《誓绝法案》后荷兰成为七联省共和国首要省份，主导黄金时代。伯国终结于1795年巴达维亚革命，1813年后其故地成为尼德兰联合王国的省。

en: The Honniasont were an Indigenous people of the upper Ohio River valley, in present-day eastern Ohio, western Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Their name appeared as Oniasont on seventeenth-century French maps.
zh: 奥尼亚松特人是俄亥俄河上游流域的原住民，居住在今俄亥俄州东部、宾夕法尼亚州西部和西弗吉尼亚州一带。17世纪的法国地图以奥尼亚松特之名记载了他们。

en:
The Hopi were Pueblo communities of northeastern Arizona, organized in villages and matrilineal clans. Oraibi, founded before 1100, was among their oldest settlements; Spanish expeditions reached the region in the 16th century.

During the 17th century Hopi villages moved from the foot of the mesas to their tops for protection against Ute and Apache raids and the Spanish. In 1680 the Hopi joined the Pueblo Revolt against Spanish rule and missionaries.
zh:
霍皮人是亚利桑那东北部的普韦布洛人群体，按村落和母系氏族组织。建于1100年以前的奥赖比是他们最古老的聚落之一；西班牙探险队于16世纪抵达这一地区。

17世纪，霍皮村落从台地脚下迁到顶部，以防御尤特人、阿帕奇人和西班牙人的袭击。1680年，霍皮人参加普韦布洛起义，反抗西班牙统治和传教士。

en:
The Hor States, or Five Hors, were Mongol-derived Tibetan principalities of Tréshö, upper Yalong valley in northern Kham, covering Garzê, Luhuo and Dawu. In the 1260s Mongol prince Horsé Gyalpo, sent by Kublai Khan with Sakya master Phagpa, settled there; his son Hor Namgyal subdued the clans and founded the Hor line, blending Mongol and Tibetan culture. The area had earlier produced the first Karmapa, Düsum Khyenpa.

In the later fifteenth century Namkha Gyaltsen united the valleys from Garzê to Draggo; after his death his sons split the realm into Mazur, Khangsar, Trehor, Draggo and Beri, the five Hor states.

In 1639 Güshi Khan overthrew Beri and opened Kham to Gelug influence, the Thirteen Hor Monasteries tying the chiefs to Lhasa. Under the Qing Hor rulers received pacification commissioner titles in 1728, imperial troops ending a Khangsar-Mazur war in 1755.
zh:
霍尔巴即“五霍尔”，是康区北部雅砻江上游德雪地区、源出蒙古的西藏诸小邦，地域相当于甘孜、炉霍、道孚一带。13世纪60年代，忽必烈派蒙古王子霍尔色杰波随萨迦大师八思巴进驻，其子霍尔南嘉征服当地部族，开创霍尔王统，蒙古血统与西藏文化融为一体。更早时第一代噶玛巴都松钦巴出生于此。

15世纪后期，南喀坚赞统一从甘孜到章谷的各河谷；他死后诸子瓜分疆土，形成麻书、孔撒、朱倭、章谷、白利五个霍尔小邦。

1639年固始汗攻灭白利，为格鲁派进入康区开路，霍尔十三寺把各部首领与拉萨联系起来。清代霍尔首领1728年受封安抚司，1755年孔撒与麻书交战，清廷出兵平息。

en:
Hotonggi was a Jurchen polity of the upper Songhua valley, named after the Hotonggi River, a forested Songhua tributary, with its seat at Sunggari on the main river, known in Manchu as Sunggari Ula. In 1337 it was a small tribal domain under Yuan overlordship.

In 1409 the Ming created the Hotonggi Guard for the basin's chieftains within the Nurgan guard network, and the guard's bronze seal has since been excavated, confirming the station recorded in Ming court annals.
zh:
禾屯吉是松花江上游流域的女真政权，以松花江支流禾屯吉河得名，治所松阿里坐落于干流河畔，松阿里即满语对松花江的称呼。1337年它是臣属元朝的小型部族领地。

1409年，明朝在该河流域设立禾屯吉卫，把当地首领纳入奴儿干卫所体系，这一卫所的铜印后来出土，印证了明代实录中的记载。

en:
Corvey was a Benedictine imperial abbey on the Weser beside Höxter. Emperor Louis the Pious ordered its foundation in 815; monks from Corbie in Picardy settled the site in 822 and named it Nova Corbeia, the new Corbie. Independent from 826, it received the relics of Saint Vitus in 836 and became a major pilgrimage site and one of the richest abbeys in Central Europe.

Decline began in 1265, when the men of Höxter and the bishop of Paderborn destroyed the abbey's town. In 1337 Prince-Abbot Dietrich von Dalwigk ruled it; Charles IV confirmed his right to hold a Vehmic court in 1349.

Corvey survived the Reformation as a self-ruling principality, though its church was sacked in 1634 during the Thirty Years' War and rebuilt after 1665. Raised to a prince-bishopric in 1792, it was secularised in 1803, its lands passing to Nassau-Orange-Fulda.
zh:
科维是威悉河畔、赫克斯特城旁的本笃会帝国修道院。815年皇帝虔诚者路易下令建院，822年来自皮卡第科尔比修院的修士迁到现址，取名新科尔比。它826年成为独立修院，836年迎入圣维特圣髑，由此成为重要朝圣地和中欧最富庶的修院之一。

1265年赫克斯特市民联合帕德博恩主教摧毁修院属下城镇，科维由此步入长期衰落。1337年统治此地的是亲王院长迪特里希·冯·达尔维格，1349年皇帝卡尔四世确认他开设菲姆法庭的权利。

宗教改革中科维作为自治领地存续，但教堂在1634年三十年战争中遭劫，1665年后才重建。1792年它升为主教侯国，1803年被世俗化，领地并入拿骚-奥兰治-富尔达侯国。

en:
The County of Hoya was a state of the Holy Roman Empire on the middle Weser in present-day Lower Saxony, centred on the town of Hoya between Bremen and Nienburg. A first Count Henry of Hoya appears in 1202 as a vassal of the Archbishop of Bremen, and his family built up its Weser estates, acquiring Nienburg in 1215.

In 1337 Count Gerhard III ruled at Hoya while his brother John II held the Nienburg portion, and in 1345 the two formally divided the county. When the elder branch died out in 1497 the lands were reunited under Count Jobst I at Nienburg.

The Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg occupied the county in 1512 and became its liege lords, and when Otto VIII died without sons in 1582 Hoya was partitioned between the Brunswick-Lüneburg dukes and Hesse-Kassel.
zh:
霍亚伯国是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，位于今下萨克森的威悉河中游，以不来梅与宁堡之间的霍亚镇为中心。1202年首任霍亚伯爵海因里希作为不来梅大主教的封臣见于记载，其家族逐步经营威悉河畔领地，1215年取得宁堡。

1337年格哈德三世伯爵统治霍亚，其弟约翰二世领有宁堡部分，1345年两人正式瓜分伯国。1497年长支绝嗣，领地在宁堡的约布斯特一世治下重新统一。

1512年不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的韦尔夫公爵占领伯国并成为宗主；1582年奥托八世无子而终，霍亚被不伦瑞克-吕讷堡与黑森-卡塞尔瓜分。

en:
The County of Holstein-Plön was a state of the Holy Roman Empire, centred on Plön and the Kiel Fjord and ruled by the House of Schauenburg. It was created around 1295, when Holstein-Itzehoe was split among Gerhard I's sons, Plön becoming one of the new counties.

Its first count, Gerhard II, died in 1312; in 1314 his son Gerhard IV sold his share to his half-brother John III, who ruled alone from Plön. In 1337 John III was one of several Schauenburg cousins dividing Holstein between them. His son Gerhard V died without heirs in 1350, John in 1359.

When the Plön line ended in 1390, its lands passed to the rival counts of Holstein-Rendsburg. When that line ended in 1459, all Holstein fell in 1460 to Christian I of Denmark, who raised it to the Duchy of Holstein in 1474.
zh:
荷尔斯泰因‑普伦伯国是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，以普伦和基尔峡湾为中心，由绍恩堡家族统治。它约1295年形成：格哈德一世的儿子们瓜分荷尔斯泰因‑伊策霍，普伦成为新伯国之一。

首任伯爵格哈德二世1312年去世；1314年其子格哈德四世把份额卖给异母弟约翰三世，约翰独治普伦。1337年约翰三世是瓜分荷尔斯泰因的几位绍恩堡堂亲之一。其子格哈德五世1350年无嗣而终，约翰本人死于1359年。

1390年普伦一系绝嗣，领地落入旁支荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡伯爵之手。该系1459年断绝后，整个荷尔斯泰因1460年归于丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世，1474年伯国升格为荷尔斯泰因公国。

en: Huancapampa refers to an Indigenous people of the Huancabamba highlands in northern Peru, neighbours of the Guayacundos. After the Inca conquest of the region, Huancapampa became one of its administrative divisions.
zh: 万卡潘帕指秘鲁北部宛卡班巴高地的原住民人群，他们与瓜亚昆多人为邻。印加人征服这一地区后，万卡潘帕成为当地的一个行政区。

en:
Heqing is a Bai-populated basin north of Dali, in north-western Yunnan. Under the Nanzhao and Dali kingdoms it was organised as the Moutong Commandery and later the Moutong Prefecture; the Dali strongman Gao Shengtai enfeoffed his son Gao Taihui there, founding the Gao clan that ruled Heqing for centuries.

After the Mongols conquered Dali in 1253 the territory was renamed Hezhou, and in 1271 it became the Heqing Route, still governed by hereditary Gao native chieftains. When Ming armies entered Yunnan in 1382 the court confirmed the Gao as prefects of Heqing.

But in 1437 the native prefect Gao Lun was executed for lawlessness. The native prefecture was then abolished: Lin Daojie arrived in 1443 as its first circulating-official prefect, while the Gao were reduced to hereditary thousand-household officers and in 1683 demoted again; the prefecture became a department in 1770.
zh:
鹤庆是云南西北、大理以北的白族聚居坝子。南诏时设谋统郡，大理国时改谋统府；大理国权臣高升泰把儿子高泰惠封到鹤庆，高氏由此开始数百年的世代统治。

1253年蒙古攻灭大理后改设鹤州，1271年置鹤庆路，仍由高氏世袭土官治理。1382年明军入滇，朝廷承认高氏为鹤庆世袭土知府。

1437年土知府高伦因不法被诛，鹤庆随即改土归流，1443年林遒节到任首任流官知府，高氏降为世袭土千户，1683年再遭贬降。1770年鹤庆降为州。

en: The Hani were a Lolo-speaking people of the Ailao Mountains in southern Yunnan. On the southern bank of the Red River, Hani communities built irrigated terraces for growing rice.
zh: 哈尼是云南南部哀牢山一带讲彝语支语言的族群。红河南岸的哈尼聚落修筑了灌溉梯田，种植水稻。

en:
The Harb are a large Arab tribal federation of the Hejaz, whose genealogists count them as a Qahtanite branch of the Khawlan, tracing descent from Harb ibn Saad ibn Khawlan. Their ancestors moved north from southern Arabia into the Hejaz around 749 in search of water and pasture, and fought local Adnanite tribes, among them the Juhayna, over wells and grazing grounds.

After some three centuries of such struggles the Harb had become the dominant tribe of the central Hejaz, holding the country around the holy city of Medina. Their diyar, or tribal lands, ran from the Red Sea coast of the Tihama east into the Najd and from Medina south to al-Qunfudhah.

Later branches settled in Kuwait, Iraq and the Gulf. The tribe is divided into two sections, the Banu Salim and the Masruh, each grouping many clans.
zh:
哈尔卜是汉志的大型阿拉伯部落联盟，谱系学家将其归入豪兰人的盖哈坦分支，先祖可溯至哈尔卜·本·萨阿德·本·豪兰。其祖先约749年为寻找水源和牧场从阿拉伯半岛南部北迁汉志，为争夺水井和牧地与当地阿德南部落长期冲突，对手包括朱海纳等部。

经过约三个世纪的争斗，哈尔卜成为汉志腹地最强大的部落，占据圣城麦地那周围的乡野。其部落领地西起帖哈麦红海沿岸，向东伸入内志，北起麦地那、南至贡富宰。

后来还有支系在科威特、伊拉克和海湾地区落脚。全族分为巴尼·萨利姆和马斯鲁赫两大支，各统众多氏族。

en:
Huarco was the coastal confederation of the Cañete valley, south of Lima, uniting the warlike lower-valley Guarco and the middle-reach Lunahuaná. Its curaca Chuquimanco ruled from a string of fortresses, among them Canchari behind the great Huarco wall, and its rich irrigated fields made it a rival of Chimor.

After absorbing Chincha the Incas invaded in the 1450s under Capac Yupanqui, but four years of war failed to break the valley. They built the citadel of Incahuasi as their base and cut the irrigation canals to starve the defenders out.

The end came through a ruse credited to Mama Ocllo Coya: a promised joint fishing rite for the sea goddess Mama Cocha emptied the forts, and the Inca army struck. Surviving leaders were hanged at Canchari, the people displaced and replaced by mitmaq settlers, and a victory fortress rose at Cerro Azul.
zh:
瓦尔科是利马以南卡涅特河谷的海岸联盟，由下游好战的瓜尔科人与中游的卢纳瓦纳人联合而成。酋长丘基曼科凭一连串要塞统治，包括瓦尔科长城后的坎查里，富庶的灌溉农田使它成为奇穆的强敌。

印加人吞并钦查后，于1450年代在卡帕克·尤潘基率领下发兵来攻，但四年攻战仍无法突入河谷。他们建起印卡瓦西城寨作为基地，又截断灌溉渠，想靠饥饿迫使守军屈服。

最后破城靠玛玛·奥克略·科亚的计谋：印加人提出共同祭祀海神玛玛·科查、举行捕鱼仪式，要塞因此一空，印加军队随即动手。幸存首领在坎查里被绞死，居民被迁走，由米特马克移民取代，印加人又在塞罗阿苏尔建起庆功要塞。

en: The Holy Roman Empire was a decentralized realm in Central Europe, whose emperors traced their title to Otto I's coronation in 962. Imperial reforms in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries sought a more unified government, but the empire remained a collection of territories until Francis II dissolved it in 1806.
zh: 神圣罗马帝国是中欧的分权政体，其皇帝的称号可追溯至962年奥托一世的加冕。15至16世纪的帝国改革试图建立更统一的政府，但帝国仍由众多领地组成，直到1806年弗朗茨二世解散帝国。

en:
The Hiraga were local lords of Takaya in Aki Province, descended from a family that had also held land in Dewa. Hiraga Hiroyasu built Shirayama Castle in 1503, then Tozaki Castle after the fall of Kagamiyama in 1523.

In 1551 Mōri Motonari took Tozaki and installed Hiraga Hirosuke as head of the family. After the Mōri lost Aki following Sekigahara in 1600, the Hiraga accompanied them west; Hiraga Motosuke surrendered his reduced stipend in 1601.
zh:
平贺氏是安艺国高屋的地方领主，其家族也曾在出羽国拥有领地。平贺弘保于1503年建造白山城，1523年镜山城陷落后又建造头崎城。

1551年毛利元就攻取头崎城，立平贺广相为家督。1600年关原之战后毛利氏失去安艺，平贺氏随其西迁；平贺元相于1601年交还被削减的家禄。

en:
The Harla were a Muslim people of the eastern Ethiopian lowlands, whose kingdom is traced by archaeology to the sixth century and was the region's strongest after the decline of Aksum. Its stone towns, above all ruined Harlaa, or Hubat, northwest of Harar, held mosques and traded with the Red Sea and Indian Ocean.

In the ninth century the Makhzumi dynasty arose on Harla soil, and by the thirteenth century the Harla served the Walashma sultans of Ifat. Under the Adal Sultanate they formed an autonomous confederation and supplied its elite Malassay troops; Ahmed Gran seized power at Harar by executing the Walashma sultan.

They fought on until the late sixteenth century, when Oromo invasions and the transfer of Adal's capital to Aussa in 1577 broke their polity. Survivors merged into Somali, Afar and Oromo societies, while the Harari of walled Harar preserve seven Harla clans as founders.
zh:
哈尔拉人是埃塞俄比亚东部低地的穆斯林民族，考古发现其国家可追溯到6世纪，是阿克苏姆衰落后当地最强的政权。他们的石砌城镇以今哈拉尔西北已成废墟的哈拉阿城（即胡巴特）为首，城内有清真寺，贸易远及红海和印度洋。

9世纪马赫祖米王朝在哈尔拉土地上兴起，到13世纪哈尔拉人臣事伊法特的瓦拉什马苏丹。阿达尔苏丹国治下，他们组成自治联盟，提供精锐的马拉赛部队；艾哈迈德·格兰在哈拉尔处死瓦拉什马苏丹后夺取大权。

哈尔拉诸部一直战斗到16世纪末，奥罗莫人入侵和1577年阿达尔迁都奥萨瓦解了其政权。幸存者融入索马里、阿法尔和奥罗莫社会，而城墙环绕的哈拉尔城中的哈拉里人，仍以七个哈尔拉氏族为立族之基。

en:
The County of Horne began around 1100 as a lordship in the lower Maas valley, taking its name from the village of Horn. By 1243 it was a fief of the County of Loon. In 1337 the lord was William IV.

The family rose under the Burgundian dukes: Jacob I was raised to imperial count in 1450, after which the lordship was known as the County of Horne. Its most famous lord, Philip de Montmorency, was one of the leaders of the Netherlandish opposition to Philip II of Spain's religious policy and was beheaded at Brussels in 1568 together with the Count of Egmont.

As he left no son, the Duke of Alba confiscated his fiefs, and the Loon portion reverted to the Prince-Bishop of Liège. French troops ended the county in 1795, folding its lands into the département of Meuse-Inférieure.
zh:
霍恩伯国约于1100年作为马斯河下游的一处领地兴起，得名于霍恩村。1243年它已是洛恩伯国的封邑。1337年在位的领主是威廉四世。

家族在勃艮第公爵治下地位上升：雅各布一世1450年获封帝国伯爵，领地此后称霍恩伯国。最知名的领主菲利普·德·蒙莫朗西是尼德兰反对西班牙国王腓力二世宗教政策的领袖之一，1568年在布鲁塞尔与埃格蒙特伯爵一同被斩首。

他没有儿子，阿尔瓦公爵没收其封邑，原属洛恩的部分转归列日采邑主教。1795年法国军队终结伯国，土地并入下默兹省。

en:
Horo was the Hūrga Jurchen polity of the Khor River, a right-bank tributary of the Ussuri rising in the Sikhote-Alin, with a trading settlement at its mouth. After 1409 the Ming organised the lower Amur and Ussuri country through the Nurgan commission, and the eunuch Yishiha stationed guard units along the Khor.

The valley's chiefs held titles hereditarily as tribute bearers until the wars of 1596 to 1625, in which Nurhaci's Jianzhou armies subdued the Wild Jurchen tribes and drew the Khor people into the Eight Banners.
zh:
霍罗是霍尔河流域的虎尔哈女真小邦。霍尔河是乌苏里江右岸支流，发源于锡霍特山脉，河口处有贸易聚落。1409年后明朝以奴儿干都司经营黑龙江下游与乌苏里江地区，太监亦失哈沿霍尔河部署卫所。

河谷酋长以朝贡者身份世袭官职，直到1596—1625年的战事：努尔哈赤的建州军队征服野人女真诸部，霍尔河人也被纳入八旗。

en:
The Hansa was a trading and defensive network of merchants and towns that grew from Lübeck and other northern German ports in the late twelfth century. Its merchants established trading posts at London, Bruges, Bergen and Novgorod and gained privileges across the North and Baltic Seas.

After Denmark seized Visby in 1361, Hanseatic towns formed the Confederation of Cologne in 1367 and fought back. The Treaty of Stralsund in 1370 secured their trading privileges in the Baltic. The league gradually weakened as towns left or passed under other rulers; its last diet met in 1669.
zh:
汉萨是商人和城镇组成的贸易与防御网络，12世纪末从吕贝克等北德意志港口发展起来。汉萨商人在伦敦、布鲁日、卑尔根和诺夫哥罗德设立商馆，在北海和波罗的海各地取得贸易特权。

1361年丹麦夺取维斯比后，汉萨城镇于1367年组成科隆联盟反击。1370年的《施特拉尔松德条约》保障了他们在波罗的海的贸易特权。随着城镇退出或归于其他君主统治，同盟逐渐衰落，最后一次大会于1669年举行。

en: Hansca is the game's name for the Golden Horde's western steppe frontier around Orhei and Chișinău, between the Prut and the Dniester, where the garrison town of Shehr al-Jedid stood at Old Orhei. After the Horde's decline in the 1340s the district passed to Moldavia, and Chișinău is first documented in 1436 as a monastery village.
zh: 汉斯卡是游戏对奥尔海伊、基希讷乌一带（普鲁特河与德涅斯特河之间）金帐汗国西部草原边境的称呼，汗国的驻军城镇谢赫里杰迪德就坐落在旧奥尔海伊。14世纪40年代金帐汗国衰落后，该地区并入摩尔达维亚，基希讷乌最早见于1436年的记载，当时是一座修道院村庄。

en:
Hsenwi, called Theinni by the Burmese and known to the Chinese as Mubang, was the largest of the Shan states west of the Salween, its capital at Hsenwi town. Tai tradition dates its predecessor Siviratta before 650; at its height it covered lands later known as North and South Hsenwi among others, and held the Wa lands east of the Salween as a loose protectorate.

It submitted to the Yuan as a route command under Yunnan, and the Ming first set up a prefecture, then a pacification office there. In the Ming-Burmese wars of the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries Toungoo seized Hsenwi, drawing it into the Burmese orbit.

In the Sino-Burmese War of 1765 to 1769 Qing general Ming Rui overran Hsenwi in 1767 and made it his main supply base, before his army perished in Burma, leaving Hsenwi under Konbaung rule.
zh:
兴威缅语称兴尼，中国史籍称木邦，是萨尔温江以西最大的掸人邦国，都城在兴威城。据傣族传说，其前身尸毗国早在650年以前便已存在；鼎盛时版图囊括后来的北兴威、南兴威等地，还以松散保护关系控制萨尔温江以东的佤人地区。

它归附元朝后被设为云南辖下的木邦路，明朝先置木邦府、后改木邦宣慰司。16世纪末至17世纪初的明缅战争中，东吁王朝攻占兴威，将其纳入缅甸势力范围。

1765—1769年清缅战争期间，清将明瑞1767年攻陷兴威，作为主要粮草基地，但清军深入缅甸后覆灭，兴威仍留在贡榜王朝治下。

en:
Hersfeld was a Benedictine imperial abbey on the Fulda river in northern Hesse. Saint Sturm first founded it before 744 but moved the community to Fulda under Saxon raids, and Archbishop Lullus of Mainz re-founded it around 769. Charlemagne made it an imperial abbey in 775, and it grew rich; the relics of Saint Wigbert made it a pilgrimage centre from 780.

In the Investiture Controversy Hersfeld backed Emperor Henry IV, whose son Conrad was born and baptised within the abbey, its abbots later sitting as princes of the empire. In 1371 the town sought the protection of the Landgraves of Hesse.

By 1513 the community had so decayed that its last abbot resigned and the house was placed under Fulda. Hesse administered the territory from 1606, and the peace of 1648 turned it into the secular Principality of Hersfeld.
zh:
黑斯费尔德是黑森北部富尔达河畔的本笃会帝国修道院。圣斯图姆744年前首次建院，因萨克森人袭扰把修士迁往富尔达，美因茨大主教卢卢斯约769年重新创立。查理曼775年将其升为帝国修道院，修院日渐富庶；780年起圣维格贝特的圣骨使它成为朝圣地。

叙任权斗争中黑斯费尔德支持皇帝亨利四世，皇子康拉德出生并受洗于这座修道院，院长后来以帝国诸侯身份列席议会。1371年黑斯费尔德城转而寻求黑森方伯保护。

到1513年修院衰败至极，末代院长辞职，修院被交给富尔达管辖。1606年起黑森管理这块领地，1648年和约将其改为世俗的黑斯费尔德侯国。

en:
Hsipaw, also called Onbaung after its old capital, in the northern Shan highlands, was one of the leading Shan principalities. Local tradition claims a predecessor state named Dutthavati founded in 58 BC, and by the early fourteenth century Onbaung was strong enough to raid the Burmese kingdom of Pinya.

Hsipaw reached its height after Möng Yang overran Ava: in 1543 its saopha Hkonmaing was placed on the Ava throne itself, but his Shan confederation collapsed before Bayinnaung's Toungoo armies, which subjugated Hsipaw with the other Shan states in 1556-1557.

In the Sino-Burmese War Ming Rui's Qing army occupied Hsipaw in 1767, marching down the Namtu river, and the decisive Burmese stand at the Goteik Gorge took place just south of the state. Restored to Burmese rule, Hsipaw remained among the wealthiest of the sawbwa states.
zh:
昔卜又以旧都之名被称作温巴，位于掸邦高原北部，是最重要的掸人邦国之一。当地传说其前身杜达瓦提国建于公元前58年；14世纪初温巴已强大到敢于进攻缅甸的彬牙王国。

孟养攻陷阿瓦后的乱局中昔卜势力达到顶峰：1543年其诏法康孟被扶上阿瓦王位，但他领导的掸邦联盟在勃印曩的东吁大军面前瓦解，昔卜于1556—1557年与其他掸邦一同臣服。

清缅战争中明瑞的清军1767年占领昔卜，沿南渡河推进，缅甸军队关键的戈泰峡谷阻击战就发生在该邦以南。重归缅甸统治后，昔卜仍是最富庶的诏法邦国之一。

en:
The Hosokawa were a Japanese warrior family descended from the Ashikaga, with holdings in Shikoku and the Kyoto region. Their members became provincial governors and deputies to the Ashikaga shoguns.

In 1467 Hosokawa Katsumoto and Yamana Sōzen led opposing armies in Kyoto at the start of the Ōnin War. Katsumoto's son Masamoto dominated Kyoto politics until his assassination in 1507, after which the family split. A later Hosokawa branch ruled Kumamoto in Higo during the Edo period.
zh:
细川氏是出自足利氏的日本武家，在四国和京都一带拥有领地。族人出任各国守护和足利将军的管领。

1467年应仁之乱爆发，细川胜元与山名宗全分别率军在京都交战。胜元之子政元主导京都政局，直到1507年遇刺身亡，家族此后分裂。细川氏的一个后支在江户时代统治肥后的熊本。

en:
The Hoysalas arose in the Malnad hills of the Western Ghats as feudatories of the Western Chalukyas, claiming descent from Sala, said to have slain a tiger to save his Jain guru. Under Vishnuvardhana, who defeated the Cholas in 1116, they became an independent power ruling most of Karnataka from first Belur and then Dvarasamudra, modern Halebidu.

Veera Ballala II declared independence in 1193 and, after routing the Pandyas in 1217, took the title Emperor of the South. The Hoysala age was one of South India's great artistic periods: kings and merchants patronised Jain and Vaishnava learning and raised the sculptured temples of Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura.

Disaster came from the north: Malik Kafur sacked Dvarasamudra in 1311 and Delhi forces plundered it again in 1327. By 1336 the Hoysalas were the last resisting Hindu kingdom. Veera Ballala III, ruler in 1337, fought Delhi and Madurai until killed at Madurai in 1343; his domains passed to officers Harihara and Bukka, founders of the Vijayanagara Empire.
zh:
曷萨拉崛起于西高止山马尔纳德丘陵，原为西遮娄其附庸，自称始祖萨拉传说曾为救耆那教上师搏杀猛虎。毗湿奴伐弹那治下，曷萨拉于1116年击败朱罗人，成为独立强权，先后以贝鲁尔、德瓦拉萨穆德罗（今哈勒比杜）为都，据卡纳达大部。

毗罗·巴拉拉二世1193年独立，1217年击溃潘地亚人后获称南方皇帝。曷萨拉时代为南印度艺术鼎盛期之一：君主与商人赞助耆那教、毗湿奴派学术，建起贝鲁尔、哈勒比杜、索马纳塔普拉三神庙。

灾难来自北方：马利克·卡富尔1311年洗劫德瓦拉萨穆德罗，德里军队1327年再度劫掠。1336年曷萨拉成为唯一仍在抵抗的印度教王国。1337年在位的毗罗·巴拉拉三世两线对抗德里与马杜赖苏丹国，1343年在马杜赖战役阵亡；领地归于旧臣诃利诃罗、布卡，即毗奢耶那伽罗帝国缔造者。

en:
The Ayyubid emirate of Hasankeyf was the longest-lived remnant of Saladin's Ayyubid state, a Kurdish principality on the Tigris in the Jazira whose meliks claimed Ayyubid descent. It began in 1232, when the Ayyubid prince as-Salih Ayyub received Hasankeyf as his appanage. Its citadel town grew into a prosperous centre of learning patronised by the emirs, and the emirate outlasted the Mongol Ilkhanate under a succession of overlords.

In 1337 the throne belonged to al-Adil Shihab al-Din, who ruled until 1349. The emirate later submitted to Timur, and in the 1460s Uzun Hasan of the Aq Qoyunlu besieged Hasankeyf and killed its melik, Khalaf.

A restored Ayyubid line retook Hasankeyf and Siirt, but its last melik was captured by the Safavids and escaped only after the Battle of Chaldiran in 1514. The emirate was finally dissolved by the Ottomans in 1524.
zh:
哈桑凯伊夫阿尤布埃米尔国是萨拉丁阿尤布王朝存续最久的余脉，为底格里斯河畔杰济拉的库尔德政权，梅利克君主自称阿尤布王室后裔。它始于1232年，阿尤布王子萨利赫·阿尤布受封哈桑凯伊夫为封地。这座要塞城镇在埃米尔们扶持下成为繁荣的学术中心，政权在一连串宗主之间存续，熬过了蒙古伊儿汗国。

1337年在位的是阿迪勒·谢哈布丁，统治至1349年。埃米尔国后来臣服帖木儿，1460年代白羊王朝的乌尊·哈桑围攻哈桑凯伊夫，杀梅利克哈拉夫。

复辟的阿尤布支系一度夺回哈桑凯伊夫和锡尔特，但末代梅利克被萨法维人俘虏，1514年查尔迪兰战役后才逃脱。1524年埃米尔国被奥斯曼人解散。

en:
The County of Holstein-Pinneberg was the smallest of the three states carved out of Holstein-Itzehoe in 1290, when the sons of Gerhard I of Schauenburg divided their inheritance. Ruled from Pinneberg by the Pinneberg line of the counts of Schauenburg, who also held the County of Schaumburg on the Weser, it amounted to little more than the Pinneberg lands west of Hamburg.

In 1337 its ruler was Count Adolf VII of Schauenburg. While Christian III of Denmark imposed the Reformation on the rest of Holstein in 1537, Pinneberg remained Catholic until 1559.

When the Schaumburg line died out with Count Otto V in 1640, the county was absorbed into the Duchy of Holstein, and in 1650 its northern third was re-granted as the County of Rantzau.
zh:
荷尔斯泰因‑平讷贝格伯国是1290年荷尔斯泰因‑伊策霍分裂时产生的三个小邦中最小的一个，由绍恩堡格哈德一世的儿子们瓜分遗产形成。绍恩堡伯爵的平讷贝格支系以平讷贝格为统治中心，同时领有威悉河畔的绍姆堡伯国，辖地主要是汉堡以西的平讷贝格一带。

1337年的统治者是绍恩堡伯爵阿道夫七世。1537年丹麦国王克里斯蒂安三世在荷尔斯泰因其余地区强制推行宗教改革，平讷贝格却保持天主教信仰，直到1559年才改宗。

1640年绍姆堡支系的奥托五世绝嗣而亡，伯国被并入荷尔斯泰因公国；1650年其北部三分之一的土地被重新封为兰曹伯国。

en: The Hishikari held Ōkuchi Castle in Satsuma Province and resisted the Shimazu with neighboring families. In 1554 Hishikari Takaaki and Gamō Norikiyo attacked Kajiki Castle, while their ally Kedōin Yoshishige lost Iwatsurugi Castle to the Shimazu. The Hishikari were defeated at Togamio in 1569, after which Ōkuchi became a Shimazu outlying castle.
zh: 菱刈氏是九州南部的地方领主，掌有萨摩国大口城，并与邻近家族共同抵抗岛津氏。1554年，菱刈隆秋和蒲生范清进攻加治木城，其盟友祁答院良重则被岛津军夺去岩剑城。1569年，菱刈氏在户神尾败于岛津氏，此后大口城成为岛津氏的外城。

en:
Teayotlan was a Huastec town in the northern Veracruz Huasteca; its archaeological site is the present-day Castillo de Teayo. The Huastec name teayoc means on the stone turtle, and the town appears under the Teayotlan glyph in the Tuxpan Canvas. Huastec builders raised its pyramid between the tenth and twelfth centuries, when it was one of the lowland Huastec cities.

In the Late Postclassic it came under strong Toltec and Mexica influence, and after the Huastec polities became Aztec tributaries around 1450 its surviving temple was rebuilt in Aztec style, one of the few Huastec pyramid-temples still standing.
zh:
特奥约特兰是韦拉克鲁斯北部瓦斯特卡的瓦斯特克城镇，其考古遗址即今特阿约城堡。瓦斯特克语名字特阿约克意为石龟之上，《图斯潘画布》以特奥约特兰象形字记录此地。10至12世纪瓦斯特克工匠建起金字塔，该城当时是瓦斯特克低地诸城之一。

后古典期晚期它受到托尔特克与墨西加的强烈影响；1450年前后瓦斯特克诸邦沦为阿兹特克藩属后，留存的神庙按阿兹特克风格改建，成为为数不多留存下来的瓦斯特克金字塔神庙之一。

en:
The Hatta were the parent lineage of the Oda lords of Oda Castle in Hitachi Province. Hatta Tomoie served Minamoto no Yoritomo and became governor of Hitachi; his descendants took the name Oda and supported the Southern Court in the fourteenth century.

Oda Ujiharu lost Oda Castle to the Satake in 1569 and submitted to them in 1583. His lands were confiscated in 1590 after he failed to join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign; his son Tomoharu later resumed the Hatta name.
zh:
八田氏是常陆国小田城领主小田氏的本家。八田知家追随源赖朝，出任常陆守护；其后裔改称小田氏，并在14世纪支持南朝。

小田氏治于1569年从佐竹氏手中失去小田城，1583年向佐竹氏臣服。1590年，他因未参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐而被没收领地；其子友治后来恢复了八田姓。

en:
The Hatakeyama were a samurai family whose name and lands passed to a branch of the Ashikaga after the original line was destroyed in 1205. Their support for the Ashikaga against the Southern Court brought them provincial governorships, including Kawachi and Noto, by the late fourteenth century.

In 1467 a succession dispute between Hatakeyama Masanaga and Yoshinari contributed to the outbreak of the Ōnin War. The family divided into rival branches; the Noto line lost its independence in the 1570s, while the Mutsu branch was largely destroyed by Date Masamune in 1586.
zh:
畠山氏是日本武家，原家族于1205年覆灭后，其名号和领地传给足利氏的一支。畠山氏支持足利氏对抗南朝，到14世纪末获得河内、能登等国的守护职。

1467年，畠山政长与义就的继承之争促成了应仁之乱的爆发。家族分裂为敌对支系；能登支系在1570年代失去独立地位，陆奥支系则在1586年大部被伊达政宗消灭。

en:
Hotin perches on cliffs above a crossing of the Dniester. A Kievan Rus' settlement passed to the princes of Halych-Volhynia, and the crossing drew a Genoese trading colony by the thirteenth century. First named in 1310, it was held by Poland, which raised its first fortifications in the first half of the fourteenth century.

Lithuania took Hotin in 1351 and handed it to Moldavia three years later. After 1400 Prince Alexandru cel Bun built the stone fortress, which Poland occupied after 1433 until Ștefan the Great retook it in 1459 after a two-year siege and made it the strongest bulwark on Moldavia's northern border.

As Ottoman power advanced, Hotin became the gate between Christendom and the steppe: Polish-Lithuanian armies defeated the Turks there in 1621 and again in 1673, but the Ottomans annexed the fortress in 1713 and held it until Russia's Bessarabian conquest of 1812.
zh:
霍京雄踞德涅斯特河一处渡口上方的悬崖。这里的罗斯定居点后归属加利奇-沃伦王公，凭借渡口之利，13世纪已有热那亚贸易殖民点。1310年该地首次见于记载；14世纪上半叶波兰占据霍京，修筑最初的防御工事。

1351年立陶宛夺取霍京，三年后把它交给摩尔达维亚。1400年后亚历山德鲁大公建成石砌要塞；1433年后波兰一度占领，直到1459年什特凡大公经两年围攻收复，把它建成摩尔达维亚北境最坚固的堡垒。

随着奥斯曼势力推进，霍京成为基督教世界与草原之间的门户：波兰-立陶宛军队1621年和1673年两度在此击败土耳其人，但奥斯曼1713年吞并要塞，据守到1812年俄国征服比萨拉比亚。

en:
The County of Holstein-Rendsburg was a Schauenburg county created in 1290 when Holstein-Itzehoe was partitioned, its seat at Rendsburg on the Eider. In 1337 its count was Gerhard III, who in 1326 helped depose Christopher II and place his nephew Valdemar of Schleswig on the Danish throne, ruling as regent and securing the Constitutio Valdemariana, which detached Schleswig from Denmark.

From 1332 to 1340 Gerhard effectively ruled Jutland and Funen, until the Danish squire Niels Ebbesen slew him in his bed at Randers in 1340. Later counts kept Schleswig, Gerhard VI receiving it as a Danish fief in 1386.

When the last Schauenburg, Adolphus VIII, died childless in 1459, the Schleswig-Holstein estates elected Christian I of Denmark at Ribe in 1460, on condition the two lands stay undivided; in 1474 the emperor raised Holstein to a duchy.
zh:
荷尔斯泰因‑伦茨堡伯国是绍恩堡家族的邦国，1290年荷尔斯泰因‑伊策霍瓜分后诞生，治所在艾德河畔的伦茨堡。1337年在位的格哈德三世曾于1326年参与废黜丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世，把外甥石勒苏益格的瓦尔德马扶上丹麦王位，自己出任摄政，并通过《瓦尔德马宪章》使石勒苏益格脱离丹麦。

1332—1340年格哈德实际统治日德兰和菲英岛，1340年丹麦乡绅尼尔斯·埃贝森在兰讷斯闯入卧室将他杀死。此后的伯爵保住了石勒苏益格，格哈德六世1386年以丹麦封臣身份领有该地。

1459年末代绍恩堡阿道夫八世无嗣而终，石勒苏益格—荷尔斯泰因等级会议1460年在里伯选举丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世为君主，条件是两地永不分割；1474年皇帝将荷尔斯泰因升格为公国。

en: Hisatsinom is the Hopi name for the ancestral Pueblo peoples of the Four Corners region, who built pueblos and cliff dwellings. Their Pueblo descendants rose against Spanish rule in New Mexico in 1680; the Spanish returned twelve years later.
zh: 希萨齐农是霍皮人对四角地区古代普韦布洛人的称呼，他们建造了普韦布洛村落和崖居。1680年，他们的普韦布洛后裔在新墨西哥反抗西班牙统治；西班牙人于12年后返回。

en:
The Principality of Hatukay was a Circassian state born in the 1330s, when the Hatukay split from the neighbouring Chemguy principality. Its princes, the Cherchanuqo, traced their line to Prince Hatuqo, grandson of the legendary Inal the Great, who led his followers west to the Black Sea coast near the Taman peninsula, where the Hatukay lived in the fourteenth century.

The Hatukay governed through Circassian customary law and the princes' assembly, the Khase, and were famed as warriors, fighting the Crimean Khanate and rival principalities. Since nobles scorned trade, the large Armenian community of the Cherkesogai handled their commerce.

The principality later moved inland between the Belaya and Pshish rivers, fighting there through the long Russo-Circassian wars of the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh:
哈图凯公国是切尔克斯人的政权，1330年代哈图凯人从邻近的切姆盖公国分离后建立。统治它的切尔恰努科家族把世系追溯到传奇大王伊纳尔之孙哈图科王公：他率部众西迁到塔曼半岛附近的黑海沿岸，14世纪哈图凯人就生活在这一带。

哈图凯人依照切尔克斯习惯法和王公会议哈塞治理，以善战闻名，长期与克里米亚汗国及邻邦交兵。由于贵族鄙视经商，境内商业由人数众多的切尔克斯盖伊亚美尼亚人经营。

公国后来迁入别拉亚河与普希什河之间的内陆，在18世纪至19世纪初的俄切尔克斯战争中苦战。

en:
Huitzquilic, a Nahuatl name meaning place of thistles, was a chiefdom in the interior of what is now Jalisco, on the site of the later town of San Martín de Hidalgo. It was settled around 1480 by Coca, Purépecha and Tepenahuales peoples and ruled by the chief Huitzingarit under the overlordship of Amecatl of Ameca.

When the first Spaniards arrived in 1540 Huitzingarit submitted peacefully, was baptised Martín Santiago and was recognised as captain of his people. Around his seat the Spanish laid out the town that became San Martín de la Cal.
zh:
惠茨奎利克是纳瓦特尔语地名，意为蓟之地，位于今哈利斯科内陆，即后来圣马丁镇的所在。1480年前后科卡人、普雷佩查人和特佩纳瓦莱斯人在此定居，城邦由酋长维辛加里特统治，奉阿梅卡的阿梅卡特尔为宗主。

1540年首批西班牙人到来时，维辛加里特和平归降，受洗改名马丁·圣地亚哥，并被承认为本族人的队长。西班牙人在他的驻地旁建起城镇，后来称为圣马丁·德拉卡尔。

en:
Huaylas was an Andean lordship in the Santa River valley, in what is now Áncash, Peru. Between 1470 and 1490 the Incas subdued the Huaylas and divided their territory into Hanan and Hurin Huaylas.

In 1536 Contarhuacho, a Huaylas chief and mother of the Inca princess Quispe Sisa, sent warriors to help Francisco Pizarro defend Lima against Manco Inca. Under Spanish rule, Huaylas lands were incorporated into encomiendas and resettlement communities.
zh:
瓦伊拉斯是安第斯山脉圣塔河谷的一个领主国，位于今秘鲁安卡什地区。1470年至1490年间，印加人征服瓦伊拉斯，将其领地分为上瓦伊拉斯和下瓦伊拉斯。

1536年，瓦伊拉斯首领孔塔尔瓦乔派兵协助弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗防守利马，抵抗曼科·印加；她的女儿基斯佩·西萨是印加公主。西班牙统治下，瓦伊拉斯的土地被纳入监护采邑和集中安置的村落。

en:
The Huiba are the Jurchen tribe recorded as the Hoifa, a Haixi Jurchen group named after the Hoifa river in present-day Jilin. Its ruling house, the Hoifa Nara, descended from the Ikderi clan of the Nimaca in Heilongjiang and adopted the Nara surname after migrating south.

In the fourteenth century these Jurchens still lived along the lower Songhua under Mongol Yuan overlordship, and their move into the Hoifa valley came only under the Ming. During the Jiajing reign of 1522 to 1566 the first beile Wangginu built a triple-walled fortress on Huerqi mountain, and the Hoifa became one of the Four Hulun tribes alongside the Hada, Ula and Yehe.

The Hoifa joined the nine-tribe coalition that Nurhaci defeated at the battle of Gule Mountain in 1593. In 1607 Nurhaci stormed Hoifa city, put the last beile Baindari to death, and enrolled the tribe in the Eight Banners.
zh:
惠巴即史籍中的辉发部，属海西女真，因世居今吉林辉发河畔得名。统治家族辉发那拉氏出自黑龙江尼马察的益克得里氏，南迁后改姓那拉氏。

14世纪这些女真人还在蒙古元朝治下的松花江下游生活，入明后才南迁辉发河流域。嘉靖年间（1522—1566年）初代贝勒王机褚在扈尔奇山修筑三重城墙的辉发城，辉发从此与哈达、乌拉、叶赫并称扈伦四部。

1593年古勒山之战，辉发参加九部联军，被努尔哈赤击败；1607年努尔哈赤攻破辉发城，杀死末代贝勒拜音达里，部众编入八旗。

en:
The Huligai were a Jurchen group originally based around the lower Sungari and Mudan rivers. Under the Yuan dynasty they lived around present-day Yilan, and after 1368 they moved south with other Jurchen groups. In 1388 the Ming sought the Huligai, Odoli and Tuowen as allies against the Mongols.

In 1403 the Huligai chief Ahacu became commander of the Ming Jianzhou Guard. The Huligai became a major component of the Jianzhou Jurchens, who traded with the Ming at Kaiyuan and Fushun.
zh:
胡里改是原居松花江和牡丹江下游一带的女真群体。元朝时他们居住在今依兰附近，1368年后与其他女真群体一同南迁。1388年明朝寻求胡里改、斡朵里和脱温结盟，共同对抗蒙古人。

1403年，胡里改首领阿哈出成为明朝建州卫指挥使。胡里改成为建州女真的重要组成部分，建州女真在开原和抚顺与明朝通商。

en:
Hum was a medieval South Slavic principality in the lands later known as Herzegovina and southern Dalmatia. Its rulers at times held independent or semi-independent power, while Serbia, Hungary and Bosnia all exercised authority over the region.

In 1435 the Bosnian noble Stjepan Vukčić Kosača inherited the lordship of Hum from his uncle Sandalj. Stjepan's title of herceg gave rise to the name Herzegovina; Ottoman forces conquered the remaining lands of his successors in 1481.
zh:
胡姆是中世纪的南斯拉夫公国，位于后来称为黑塞哥维那和达尔马提亚南部的地区。胡姆的统治者有时独立或半独立地行使权力，塞尔维亚、匈牙利和波斯尼亚也都曾统治这片地区。

1435年，波斯尼亚贵族斯捷潘·武克契奇·科萨查从叔父桑达利手中继承胡姆领地。斯捷潘的公爵头衔衍生出黑塞哥维那这一地名；1481年，奥斯曼军队征服了其继承人剩余的领地。

en:
The Kingdom of Hungary arose around 1000 with the coronation of Stephen I, its first Christian king; in 1102 it entered a personal union with Croatia, and the Golden Bull of 1222 limited royal power before the Mongol invasion of 1241-1242 devastated it. After the native dynasty ended in 1301, oligarchs divided it until Charles Robert, crowned with the Holy Crown in 1310, defeated them at Rozgony in 1312, restoring royal authority by 1321.

In 1337 Charles Robert, or Charles I, ruled a gold-rich realm, though the 1330 defeat at Posada left Wallachia independent. His son Louis the Great brought Hungary to its peak; under Sigismund the Ottoman advance began, checked by Hunyadi's 1456 Belgrade victory, and Matthias Corvinus made his court a Renaissance centre.

The Ottoman victory at Mohács in 1526 split Hungary into Habsburg Royal Hungary, Ottoman Hungary and Transylvania, reunited only after the 1699 Treaty of Karlowitz. In 1723 the Diet accepted hereditary Habsburg rule, Hungary remaining a separate realm within the monarchy.
zh:
匈牙利王国约1000年伊什特万一世加冕首任基督教国王时诞生，1102年与克罗地亚结成共主邦联；1222年《金玺诏书》限制王权，1241—1242年蒙古入侵，王国惨遭蹂躏。1301年本土王朝绝嗣、寡头割据，查理·罗贝尔1310年戴圣冠，1312年罗日戈尼破敌，1321年重建王权。

1337年查理·罗贝尔即卡罗伊一世治下因金矿而富庶，但1330年波萨达战败，瓦拉几亚独立。其子拉约什大王时国势鼎盛；西吉斯蒙德时奥斯曼西进，匈雅提1456年贝尔格莱德之捷挡住其锋，马加什·科尔温建宫廷为文艺复兴中心。

1526年莫哈奇战败，匈牙利裂为哈布斯堡、奥斯曼、特兰西瓦尼亚三部，1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》后统一。1723年议会接受哈布斯堡世袭统治，匈牙利作为独立王国留在君主国内。

en:
The Hūrga, also recorded as Hurka, Huligai or Kurka, were a Tungusic Jurchen people of the Hurka River, now the Mudan, and the lower Sungari, centred on Ilan Hala, modern Yilan. Under the Jin a Huligai route administered their lands; in Yuan times they were counted among the tribes around Yilan.

In 1388 the Hongwu court enlisted the Huligai, and in 1403 their chief Ahacu was made commander of the Jianzhou Guard; that branch moved south into the Jianzhou Jurchens. The Hūrga who stayed in the river valley were later recorded as the Kurka, one of the three Donghai Jurchen groups.

Nurhaci's campaigns of 1596 to 1625 subdued these eastern tribes and enrolled many Hūrga in the Eight Banners. In 1654 the Qing resettled Ducher farmers from the Amur onto the Sungari and Hurka, and in 1692 made Sanxing, as Yilan was then known, a deputy lieutenant-general's seat.
zh:
虎尔哈（又译虎尔喀、瑚尔喀、库尔喀，即胡里改）是通古斯语族的女真人，居于虎尔哈河（今牡丹江）及松花江下游一带，以依兰哈喇（今依兰）为中心。金朝曾设胡里改路管辖其地，元代他们属聚居依兰一带的部落之一。

1388年，明朝廷招抚胡里改部；1403年，其首领阿哈出被任为建州卫指挥使，这一支南迁入建州女真。留在河谷的虎尔哈人后被清代文献记为库尔喀部，为东海女真三大部之一。

1596—1625年间努尔哈赤用兵征服这些东部部落，许多虎尔哈人被编入八旗。1654年清朝把黑龙江的杜切尔农民迁到松花江和虎尔哈河一带，1692年在三姓（即依兰）设副都统衙署。

en:
Hutaym is not the name of a single genealogical tribe but a derogatory exonym for independent nomadic groups of low social standing across the Arabian Peninsula; the word derives from an Arabic adjective for a man with broken front teeth, one who cannot trace his ancestry. Dominant tribes refused to intermarry with them, counting them as neither Qahtanite nor Adnanite.

The label principally covered Rashayida branches, along with other marginalized groups. Their main grounds lay around Khaybar, whose lava field was also called the Harrat Hutaym, and in the Nafud, with some moving south into the Tihama.

The name first appears in Arabic literature around 1200, and early sixteenth-century Ottoman tax registers list the Hutaym among the five tribute-paying tribes of the sanjak of Gaza. By the early nineteenth century European travellers used it for a low caste, not a tribe.
zh:
胡泰姆并非某个血缘部落的名称，而是阿拉伯半岛对社会地位较低的独立游牧群体使用的贬称；该词来自一个阿拉伯语形容词，意为门牙断裂的人，即无法追溯祖先血脉之人。占主导地位的部落拒绝与之通婚，认为他们既非盖哈坦人也非阿德南人。

被贴上这一标签的主要是拉沙伊达的各分支和其他边缘群体。其主要活动范围在海拜尔一带——当地的熔岩原野也被称为胡泰姆熔岩区——以及内夫得沙漠，部分群体向南进入帖哈麦。

这一名称约在1200年首次出现于阿拉伯语文献；16世纪初的奥斯曼税册把胡泰姆列为加扎桑贾克纳贡的五个部落之一。到19世纪初，欧洲旅行者已把它当作低种姓的称呼，而非部落名。

en:
Huaxtepec was a large Nahua town in the warm lowland province of Tlalnahuac, south of the Valley of Mexico in what is now Morelos; its Nahuatl name means on the mountain of the huaje tree. In 1337 it was still ruled by its own lords, and its tlatoani bore the title tultecateteutli, or Toltec lord, later shadowed by an Aztec calpixqui over tribute.

The Aztec emperor Moctezuma I conquered the town between 1440 and 1469 and turned its springs into irrigation channels feeding a royal garden counted as the first botanical garden in the Americas. It sent cotton, cacao, amate paper and rock crystal to Tenochtitlan and warred against the cities of Tlaxcala.

Huaxtepec's ruler in 1519 was Tizapapalotzin. The conquering Spaniards marvelled at the town's gardens, and in 1569 the hospital of Santa Cruz was founded to study the region's medicinal herbs.
zh:
瓦斯特佩克是温暖低地省份特拉尔纳瓦克的一座纳瓦大镇，位于墨西哥谷地以南，在今莫雷洛斯州境内；其纳瓦特尔语名称意为瓦赫树（银合欢）之山。1337年时它仍由本族首领统治，镇中特拉托阿尼拥有“图尔特卡特特乌特利”即托尔特克之主的称号，后来阿兹特克人又派贡赋官卡尔皮斯基监督贡物。

1440年至1469年间，阿兹特克皇帝蒙特祖马一世征服此镇，把当地泉水引入灌溉渠，浇灌一座王家园林，这被视为美洲第一座植物园。瓦斯特佩克向特诺奇蒂特兰输送棉花、可可、阿玛特树皮纸和水晶，并同特拉斯卡拉诸城邦交战。

1519年在位的君主是蒂萨帕帕洛钦。征服此地的西班牙人都惊叹于它的园林；1569年，圣十字医院在此建立，专门研究当地的药用植物。

en:
Havelberg was a prince-bishopric of the Holy Roman Empire, seated where the Havel meets the Elbe in the Prignitz. King Otto I founded the diocese in 946 under Mainz, and it passed to the new Archdiocese of Magdeburg in 968.

The Slav rising of 983 drove the bishops out for a century and a half, until King Lothair III retook the town in 1130 and Margrave Albert the Bear secured the eastern Elbe bank. From 1151 the bishop held princely rank; after the Wendish Crusade of 1147 a cathedral chapter was established and St Mary's Cathedral consecrated in 1170.

The bishops later moved to Wittstock, and the Holy Blood shrine at Wilsnack became a major pilgrimage site from 1383. The see turned Lutheran in the Reformation, passed to the Hohenzollerns in 1554, and was secularised into Brandenburg in 1571.
zh:
哈弗尔贝格是神圣罗马帝国的一个主教采邑，主教座位于普里格尼茨地区哈弗尔河汇入易北河之处。国王奥托一世于946年设立教区，初隶美因茨，968年改属新建的马格德堡总教区。

983年的斯拉夫起义把主教们赶走了一个半世纪，直到1130年国王洛泰尔三世收复该城，藩侯大熊阿尔布雷希特又平定了易北河东岸。1151年起主教获得诸侯等级；1147年文德十字军之后建立了主教座堂圣职团，圣马利亚主教座堂于1170年祝圣。

后来主教们把驻地迁往维特施托克，维尔斯纳克的圣血圣龛从1383年起成为重要的朝圣地。该教区在宗教改革中改宗路德宗，1554年落入霍亨索伦家族之手，1571年被世俗化并入勃兰登堡。

en: Hawea was an early Māori group of New Zealand's South Island, whose traditions give differing accounts of its ancestry. Around the 16th century, when Ngāti Māmoe crossed to the South Island, Ngāti Hawea and other early groups were collectively known as Waitaha.
zh: 哈威亚是新西兰南岛的早期毛利群体，关于其祖源有不同的传统说法。约在16世纪雅提马莫埃渡往南岛时，雅提哈威亚和其他早期群体被统称为怀塔哈。

en: Hueyacocotla, its Nahuatl name meaning place of the great pine, was a Huastec, or Teenek, town in the pine highlands of the Huasteca Baja, on the Veracruz-Hidalgo frontier. The Huastecs were a Mayan-speaking people long cut off from the other Maya, and around 1450 their towns were subdued by Moctezuma I's Aztec armies and left to rule themselves under tribute.
zh: 韦亚科科特拉的纳瓦特尔语名称意为大松之地，是下瓦斯特卡地区松树高地上的一座瓦斯特克，即特内切，城镇，地处韦拉克鲁斯与伊达尔戈交界。瓦斯特克人属玛雅语族，与其他玛雅人隔绝已久；约1450年，他们的城镇被蒙特苏马一世的阿兹特克军队征服，获准在纳贡条件下保留自治。

en:
Hy Many, in Irish Ui Mhaine, was one of the oldest and largest kingdoms of Connacht, spreading across eastern and southern Galway and southern Roscommon, with Kilconnell at its heart. Tradition made Maine Mor its founder in the fourth century, his war band conquering the older Fir Bolg; the dynasty later took the O Kelly surname.

The O Kellys ruled over a loose bundle of sub-lordships, and in 1337 their chief still answered only to the king of Connacht. In 1414 William O Kelly founded the Franciscan friary at Kilconnell, the sept's burial church.

When Connacht became a Presidency in 1569 English rule reached the kingdom, and the Composition of Connacht in 1585 turned O Kelly lands into shired baronies; Feardorcha O Kelly was counted its seventy-ninth and last king. The kindred suffered heavily at the Battle of Aughrim in 1691.
zh:
伊瓦内，爱尔兰语称乌伊·瓦内，是康诺特最古老、最大的王国之一，地跨戈尔韦东部和南部以及罗斯康芒南部，以基尔康奈尔一带为核心。相传它由4世纪的马内·莫尔建立，他的战团征服了当地更古老的菲尔·博尔格人，王朝后来采用奥凯利为姓。

奥凯利家族统治着一批松散的次级领地，1337年时，其酋长只听命于康诺特国王。1414年，威廉·奥凯利在基尔康奈尔创建方济各会修道院，后来成为该家族的安葬教堂。

1569年康诺特成为英格兰总督区，英格兰的管辖由此伸入王国；1585年的《康诺特和解协议》把奥凯利的领地改为郡下的男爵区，费尔多卡·奥凯利被列为伊瓦内第79任、也是最后一任国王。1691年的奥赫里姆战役中，奥凯利家族损失惨重。

en:
The Hytuk, also called the Adale or Getici in Italian sources, were a Circassian tribe of the Taman peninsula between the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov, whose name means the islanders or the people by the sea. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries their principality was one of the strongest coastal powers of Zichia, centred on the port of Matrega, seat of the Catholic archbishop of the Circassians.

Matrega linked the sea trade between Caffa and the northern Black Sea shore. The Genoese Ghisolfi family married into the local princes and governed Matrega from 1419, while Circassian rulers such as Usdemoroch (1446) were recognised in Italian records as independent lords.

Ottoman expansion ended the polity when Matrega fell on 12 August 1482, though local princes kept parts of the peninsula; the surviving Hytuk later merged into the Natukhaj tribe.
zh:
海图克人又称阿达拉，意大利文献称格蒂奇，是生活在黑海与亚速海之间塔曼半岛上的切尔克斯部落，名字意为“岛民”或“滨海之民”。14至15世纪，他们的公国是泽希亚最强盛的沿海政权之一，以马特列加港为中心，这里是切尔克斯天主教大主教的驻地。

马特列加联络着卡法与黑海北岸的海上贸易。热那亚的吉索尔菲家族通过联姻加入当地王公行列，自1419年起治理马特列加，1446年见于记载的乌斯杰莫罗赫等切尔克斯统治者，在意大利档案中被承认为独立王公。

奥斯曼的扩张终结了这个政权：1482年8月12日马特列加陷落，当地王公仍保有半岛的部分土地；幸存的海图克人后来并入纳图哈伊部落。

en:
Hongzhou Poli was a Kam native chieftaincy in the southeastern hills of Guizhou, its seat at the Hongzhou stockade in present-day Liping County, close to the Hunan border. Ming campaigns against the Kam caves reached the district when the general Gu Cheng put down risings at Hongzhou, Poli, Fulu and Yongcong in 1397.

The Hongzhou Poli native long commandery was re-established in 1403 under the Guizhou Guard, and in 1414 it became one of the thirteen Kam chieftaincies assigned to the newly created Liping Prefecture. Its neighbouring commandery of Fulu-Yongcong, centred on the walled settlement of Yongcong, was converted into Yongcong County in 1441.
zh:
洪州泊里是贵州东南山区的侗族土司，治所在今黎平县洪州镇，靠近湖南边界。明朝对侗寨的经略波及此地：1397年，明将顾成出兵平定了洪州、泊里、福禄、永从一带的反抗。

1403年，洪州泊里蛮夷长官司重新设置，隶属于贵州卫，1414年又成为新设黎平府下辖的十三个侗族长官司之一。与它相邻、以永从寨为中心的福禄永从长官司，则在1441年改置为永从县。

en:
Hizan is a small Kurdish emirate in the steep, oak-covered valley of the Gindig Su, a tributary of the Botan. Its rectangular fortress at Eski Hizan may have been founded under Roman rule of the region between 298 and 363, though the standing walls are mostly Kurdish work.

From perhaps the mid-thirteenth century the walled town served as the seat of a Kurdish emir whose caravanserais caught the trade from Siirt that avoided the Bitlis pass, while the side valleys sheltered Armenian and Syriac monasteries.

The emirs of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries rebuilt the town's fortifications, and Emir Dawud founded its medrese; under Ottoman rule Hizan also housed an imperial mint. Its Bekiran Kurdish clans lived beside a large Armenian peasant population until the nineteenth-century upheavals.
zh:
希赞是一个小型库尔德埃米尔国，位于博赫坦河支流金迪格河陡峭多橡的山谷中。埃斯基希赞的矩形要塞可能始建于298至363年间罗马统治该地区之时，不过现存城墙大多是库尔德时代的工程。

可能从13世纪中期起，这座有城墙的城镇成为库尔德埃米尔的驻地，当地商馆承接了避开比特利斯山口、来自锡尔特的商队贸易，两侧山谷中则散布着亚美尼亚和叙利亚语修道院。

15至16世纪的埃米尔们重修了城防，埃米尔达乌德还修建了经学院；奥斯曼统治时期，希赞还设有一座皇家铸币厂。当地贝基兰部的库尔德氏族与人数众多的亚美尼亚农户毗邻而居，直到19世纪的动荡来临。

en:
The Hazaraspids, also called the Fadluyids, were a Kurdish Sunni dynasty that ruled the Zagros highlands of southwestern Iran as the Atabagate of Greater Lorestan from 1115 to 1424. Their ancestor Fadlawi led his tribe from Syria into Luristan, and Abu Tahir, once a commander of the Salghurids of Fars, made himself independent with the title atabeg; his son Malik Hazarasp, whose name means thousand horses, gave the dynasty its name.

From capital Idaj the Hazaraspids held the great roads between the Iranian plateau and the lowlands, and under Ilkhanid suzerainty Yusuf Shah I added Khuzestan and other lands to the realm. In 1337 the ruler was Rukn al-Din Yusuf Shah II, who in the first half of the fourteenth century seized Shushtar and even Basra.

Later reigns brought Muzaffarid invasions and the temporary loss of Idaj, and the dynasty finally fell in 1424 when the Timurid Shahrukh deposed its last prince Ghiyath al-Din, ending three centuries of Lur rule.
zh:
哈扎拉斯普王朝亦称法德卢伊王朝，是1115—1424年间统治伊朗西南部扎格罗斯山区的库尔德裔逊尼派王朝，国号大罗里斯坦阿塔贝格国。先祖法德卢维率部落从叙利亚迁入卢里斯坦，曾为法尔斯萨尔古里王朝将领的阿布·塔希尔自立为君、采用阿塔贝格称号；其子马利克·哈扎拉斯普（意为千骑）成为王朝名称由来。

王朝以伊达杰为都，扼守伊朗高原与低地间的交通要道，在伊儿汗宗主权下，优素福沙一世将胡齐斯坦等地纳入版图。1337年在位的是鲁克纳丁·优素福沙二世，他在14世纪上半叶夺取舒什塔尔乃至巴士拉。

其后穆扎法尔王朝入侵，伊达杰一度失守；1424年帖木儿王朝沙鲁赫废黜末代王公吉亚斯丁，王朝终结，卢尔人三百年统治至此落幕。

en:
Hazro is a Kurdish tribal chiefdom in the rugged hills north of Diyarbakr, holding Qasaba Hazru, Kulp and the high valleys of Sasun, where Kurdish tribes had settled by the late thirteenth century and kept an autonomous emirate until the nineteenth.

A tax register of 1527 already counted this part of the Vilayet-i Kurdistan among its minor emirates, and a decree of Suleiman I around 1533 confirmed hereditary succession for loyal Kurdish beys. Evliya Celebi in the mid-seventeenth century listed Hazo among the five Kurdish hükümets of Diyarbekir: districts that paid no tax, sent no troops and chose their own rulers, while Kulp was a hereditary Kurdish sanjak.

Its old town mixed Syriac Orthodox Christians and Kurdish-speaking Armenians under Kurdish lords. Hazro's isolation in the Taurus foothills let it keep its autonomy long after the lowland emirates became ordinary Ottoman provinces.
zh:
哈兹罗是迪亚巴克尔以北崎岖丘陵中的库尔德部族酋邦，领有哈兹罗镇、库尔普以及萨松的高山谷地；库尔德部落13世纪末已定居萨松，并在那里维持自治埃米尔国至19世纪。

1527年的税册已把这一地区列为库尔德斯坦维拉耶特下的小埃米尔国之一，苏莱曼一世约在1533年颁布诏令，确认效忠的库尔德贝伊世袭继承权。17世纪中期的埃夫利亚·切莱比把哈佐列为迪亚巴克尔的五个库尔德自治政区（土耳其语 hükümet）之一：它们不纳税、不派兵、自选统治者，库尔普则是世袭的库尔德桑贾克。

老城在库尔德领主之下，居民为叙利亚正教会基督徒和讲库尔德语的亚美尼亚人。偏处托罗斯山麓的哈兹罗，在低地埃米尔国纷纷沦为普通奥斯曼行省之后很久，仍保住了自治地位。

en:
Iași lies on the Bahlui in northern Moldavia, where several long trade roads met. Its name is traced to the Sarmatian Iazyges and Alanic Jassi by the Prut, surviving in Hungarian Jászvásár, the Jassic market.

Sixth-century settlements show a town older than its first surviving charter of 1408, when Prince Alexandru cel Bun granted privileges to Lwów merchants. Around 1564 Alexandru Lăpușneanu moved the Moldavian capital from Suceava to Iași, seat of its princes. Vasile Lupu founded a school and press at the Trei Ierarhi Monastery in 1640, which printed Moldavia's first book in 1643.

Its border position brought repeated Tatar sacks and an Ottoman occupation. In 1821 Alexandros Ypsilantis raised the banner of Greek independence there, before Ottoman troops stormed it the following year.
zh:
雅西位于摩尔达维亚北部的巴赫卢伊河畔，数条长途商路在此交汇。其城名可追溯到普鲁特河一带的萨尔马提亚人伊阿居格部和阿兰人的雅西部落，匈牙利语名 Jászvásár 意为“雅西人的市场”。

6世纪的定居点遗迹表明，该城比1408年现存最早的特许状还要古老——当年亚历山德鲁大公向利沃夫商人授予贸易特权。约1564年，亚历山德鲁·勒普什尼亚努把摩尔达维亚首都从苏恰瓦迁至雅西，该城从此成为大公驻地。1640年，瓦西里·卢普在三圣主教修道院开办学校和印刷所，1643年印出摩尔达维亚第一部书籍。

地处边境使它屡遭鞑靼人洗劫和奥斯曼人占领。1821年，亚历山德罗斯·伊普西兰蒂斯在此举起希腊独立的旗帜，次年奥斯曼军队便攻破该城。

en:
Ibalon, or Ibalong, was the ancient name of the Bicol Peninsula at the southeastern end of Luzon, its settlements strung along the Bicol River and slopes of volcanoes such as Mayon. Pre-colonial society knew no king or authority above the datu: family-centered barangays followed the strongest war chief, and Islam never reached the peninsula.

The people's memory was carried by the Ibalong epic, which shows the impress of the Ramayana and Mahabharata and tells of heroes such as Baltog and Handyong clearing the land of monsters; the people's supreme god Gugurang dwelt in Mayon and guarded the sacred fire.

Spaniards landed at Gibal-ong in Sorsogon in 1567; missionaries founded the churches of Naga and turned the hardwood forests into shipyards for Manila galleons. In 1636, when the colony split Bicol into provinces, the old name survived only as the Partido de Ibalon.
zh:
伊巴隆又译伊巴隆格，是吕宋东南端比科尔半岛的古称，当地定居点沿比科尔河和马荣火山等山坡分布。殖民以前，这里没有国王，也没有凌驾于达图之上的权威：以家族为中心的巴朗盖在战时拥戴最强的首领，伊斯兰教也从未传入半岛。

比科尔人的记忆由《伊巴隆史诗》承载，史诗讲述巴尔托格、汉勇等英雄剪除怪兽的故事，其结构深受《罗摩衍那》和《摩诃婆罗多》影响；他们信奉的至高神古古朗居于马荣火山之中，守护着圣火。

1567年西班牙人在索索贡的希巴隆登陆，传教士建起那牙的教堂，并把硬木森林辟为建造马尼拉大帆船的船厂。1636年殖民地把比科尔划分为若干行政区，伊巴隆这个旧称只保留为“伊巴隆区”。

en:
Iceland was settled from the 870s, chiefly by Norwegians fleeing the unification of their homeland; tradition calls Ingólfr Arnarson, who settled at Reykjavík around 874, the first settler. In 930 the chieftains gathered at Thingvellir to found the Althing, one of the oldest assemblies, and around 1000 the island accepted Christianity by an arbitrator's ruling.

The Commonwealth produced the sagas of Icelanders, but the feuds of the Age of the Sturlungs exhausted it, and in 1262-1264 the Old Covenant placed it under the Norwegian crown. It passed into the Kalmar Union in 1397 and under Danish rule.

The Black Death of 1402-1404 carried off perhaps half the population; the Lutheran Reformation was enforced in 1550 with the execution of bishop Jón Arason. From 1602 a Danish monopoly cramped commerce for nearly two centuries. The Laki eruption of 1783 and Mist Hardships brought famine, and when the Treaty of Kiel separated Norway from Denmark in 1814, Iceland remained a Danish dependency.
zh:
冰岛自870年代起有人定居，居民主要为逃避祖国统一的挪威人；相传约874年在雷克雅未克安家的英戈尔夫·阿纳尔松是第一位定居者。930年族长在辛格韦德利集会创立阿尔庭，为最古老的议会之一；约1000年全岛经仲裁者裁决接受基督教。

独立自由邦催生冰岛人萨迦，但斯图鲁松时代的仇杀耗尽元气，1262—1264年《旧约》使它臣服挪威王冠。1397年它加入卡尔马联盟，后转归丹麦。

1402—1404年黑死病夺走可能半数人口；1550年路德宗改革强加于岛上，主教永·阿拉松被处死。1602年起丹麦贸易垄断压制岛上商业近两百年。1783年拉基火山喷发及雾灾造成饥荒，1814年《基尔条约》把挪威与丹麦分开时，冰岛仍为丹麦属地。

en:
