The Ichma, also called the Ychsma or Pachacamac kingdom, grew up around 1100 after the fall of the Wari Empire, holding the Lurín Valley on the desert coast south of present-day Lima and later spreading into the Rímac Valley.

Its heart was the ancient oracle city of Pachacamac, seat of the creator god Pacha Kamaq, whose pilgrims came from across the central Andes; Ichma rulers raised at least sixteen adobe pyramids there and watered orchards with irrigation canals across the desert.

Probably Aymara-speaking, the Ichma kept their autonomy until about 1469, when the Inca absorbed them as a province while patronizing the oracle and adding a Temple of the Sun. In 1533 Hernando Pizarro marched to Pachacamac and sacked the sanctuary; two years later the Spanish founded Lima in the neighboring Rímac Valley.
zh:
依其马又称伊奇斯马或帕查卡马克王国，约在1100年瓦里帝国崩溃后兴起，领有今利马以南沙漠海岸的卢林河谷，后来又向北扩入里马克河谷。

它的核心是古老的神谕城帕查卡马克，即创世神帕查·卡马克的居所，朝圣者从安第斯中部各地前来；依其马统治者在那里修建了至少十六座土坯金字塔，并用穿凿沙漠的灌溉渠滋养果园。

依其马人可能说艾马拉语，他们的自治维持到约1469年，随后被印加吞并为一个行省，印加人继续供奉神谕并增建了太阳神庙。1533年，埃尔南多·皮萨罗进军帕查卡马克，洗劫了这座圣所；两年后，西班牙人在邻近的里马克河谷建立利马。

en:
Idar, a hillfort town at the southern end of the Aravalli range in northern Gujarat, was held by Bhil chiefs and later by Parihar Rajputs. After the Parihar chief fell at the second battle of Tarain in 1192, the Bhil Sord dynasty ruled until 1257, when the Rathore prince Rao Sonag overthrew it and founded a line of raos that held Idar for twelve generations.

It guarded the routes between Gujarat and Rajputana and was drawn into the Gujarat sultans' wars: in 1515 to 1520 Rana Sanga of Mewar placed Raimal on the Idar throne and chased the sultan's army back to Ahmedabad.

In 1656 Mughal forces under Murad Baksh overran Idar and incorporated it into the Gujarat subah. Rathore rule returned only in 1729, when Anand Singh and Rai Singh, brothers of the maharaja of Jodhpur, seized the fort, though the state soon had to surrender districts and tribute to the Marathas.
zh:
伊德尔是古吉拉特北部阿拉瓦利山脉南端的山城，早期由比尔人首领占据，后来转入帕里哈拉杰普特人之手。1192年帕里哈拉首领在第二次塔兰战役战死后，比尔人的索尔德王朝统治到1257年，罗怙罗王子拉奥·索纳格随即将其推翻，开创了统治伊德尔十二代的拉奥世系。

这个小邦扼守古吉拉特与拉杰普塔纳之间的通道，被卷入古吉拉特苏丹国的战争：1515至1520年间，梅瓦尔的拉那·桑伽把赖马尔扶上伊德尔王位，并把苏丹的军队一路追击到艾哈迈达巴德。

1656年，穆拉德·巴赫什率领的莫卧儿大军攻陷伊德尔，将其并入古吉拉特苏巴。罗怙罗人的统治直到1729年才恢复——焦特布尔摩诃罗阇的兄弟阿南德·辛格与拉伊·辛格夺取城堡，但新邦不久便被迫向马拉塔人割地纳贡。

en:
Ifat was the leading Sunni Muslim state of the fourteenth-century Horn of Africa, ruled by the Walashma dynasty from the eastern Shewa highlands to Zeila. Founder Umar Walasma conquered the older Sultanate of Shewa, and by 1288 his successors had united Zeila with neighbouring Muslim lands. Zeila had a seventh-century two-mihrab mosque and was the main gateway for trade and Islam into Ethiopia, giving Ifat its wealth.

War with Christian Ethiopia began in 1320, when Sultan Haqq ad-Din I seized an envoy and Amda Seyon invaded; after Sabr ad-Din's 1332 rebellion the capital was sacked, Jamal ad-Din I installed, and Ifat made a tributary.

Later sultans rebelled: Haqq ad-Din II moved the court toward Harar and fought over twenty battles before dying in battle in 1376, and Sa'ad ad-Din II was killed at Zeila by the armies of Dawit I or Yeshaq around 1403-1410. The ruined sultanate was absorbed into Ethiopia, while the Walashma line re-emerged farther east as the Adal Sultanate at Harar.
zh:
伊法特是14世纪非洲之角首要逊尼派穆斯林国家，瓦拉什马王朝统治，疆土从绍阿东部高地延至泽拉。开国君乌马尔·瓦拉斯马灭绍阿旧苏丹国，1288年继承者统一泽拉及周边穆斯林地区。泽拉有7世纪双米哈拉布清真寺，为贸易与伊斯兰教入埃塞俄比亚主要门户，伊法特因之致富。

对基督教埃塞俄比亚战争始于1320年：哈克·丁一世扣押使节，阿姆达·塞翁一世入侵；1332年萨卜尔·丁叛乱，都城遭洗劫，贾马勒·丁一世继立，伊法特沦为埃塞俄比亚王室附庸。

后任苏丹反叛：哈克·丁二世历经二十余战，1376年战死，此前已将朝廷迁往哈拉尔高原方向；萨阿德·丁二世约1403—1410年被达维特一世或叶沙克军队追杀于泽拉。残破苏丹国并入埃塞俄比亚，瓦拉什马王族东向复兴，建哈拉尔为都的阿达尔苏丹国。

en:
Ife, also called Ile-Ife, is one of the oldest Yoruba cities, settled between 1000 and 500 BC and already a flourishing West African emporium by 900 AD. Yoruba tradition holds that here the deity Oduduwa moulded the first land from the primordial sea and founded the first dynasty; its king bears the title of Ooni, and Oduduwa's descendants are said to have gone out from Ife to found other Yoruba kingdoms, such as Oyo.

Between 1200 and 1400 it produced celebrated naturalistic bronze, terracotta and stone heads. Its early hegemony gave way to Oyo, dominant among Yoruba city-states from the seventeenth century, but Ife remained the Yoruba spiritual capital and authority on coronations.

In the early nineteenth century Oyo's collapse under Fulani jihad pressure sent waves of refugees into Ife and drew it into the wars dividing Yorubaland.
zh:
伊费又称伊莱-伊费，是最古老的约鲁巴城市之一，公元前1000年至前500年间已有人定居，到公元900年已是繁荣的西非商贸重镇。约鲁巴传统认为，神祇奥杜杜瓦在此从原始海洋中塑出第一块陆地并建立第一个王朝，伊费国王称“奥尼”；据说奥杜杜瓦的子孙从伊费出发，建立了奥约等其他约鲁巴王国。

1200至1400年间，伊费出产了著名的写实风格青铜、陶土和石雕头像。伊费早期的霸权后来让位于奥约，后者自17世纪起统辖各约鲁巴城邦，但伊费始终是约鲁巴人的精神之都和君王加冕的权威所在。

19世纪初，奥约在富拉尼圣战的压力下崩溃，大批难民涌入伊费，也把它卷入撕裂约鲁巴兰的战火。

en: The Igneri were an Arawakan-speaking Indigenous people of the southern Lesser Antilles. Their language developed into Kalinago, though the nature of the transition between the peoples remains uncertain.
zh: 伊涅里人是小安的列斯群岛南部说阿拉瓦克语的原住民。他们的语言演变为卡利纳戈语，但两个族群之间的转变过程尚不明确。

en:
The Ispahbad was the small Talysh principality of the Caspian coastlands between Gilan and Mughan, whose rulers bore the old Iranian military title of ispahbad. Their first seat was the fortress of Shandan north of the Astara river, and by the fourteenth century they ruled from Astara over the Talysh-speaking coastal strip that also took in Lankaran.

The line survived under the Mongol Ilkhans: in 1307 Rukn al-din Ahmad guided the Ilkhanid army through Gilan. In 1337 the ispahbad held his coast as a vassal of the Jalayirids, and later in the century Jalal al-din Husayn still kept his throne at Astara.

Whether the later Talysh khans of Astara continued the dynasty is unknown, but the region became part of the Talysh Khanate and passed to Russia in 1813.
zh:
伊斯帕巴德是里海沿岸、吉兰与穆甘之间的塔雷什人小公国，统治者使用古老的伊朗军事头衔伊斯帕巴德。其早期治所是阿斯塔拉河以北的尚丹堡垒，到14世纪时改以阿斯塔拉为中心，领有说塔雷什语的沿海地带，包括连科兰。

这一家族在蒙古伊儿汗国治下延续下来：1307年鲁克纳丁·艾哈迈德为伊儿汗军队进军吉兰引路。1337年，伊斯帕巴德作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸保有其海岸；14世纪后期，贾拉勒丁·侯赛因仍在阿斯塔拉称尊。

后来阿斯塔拉的塔雷什诸汗是否延续了这一世系已不可考，该地区最终成为塔雷什汗国的一部分，并于1813年并入俄国。

en:
The Ii were a warrior family from Tōtōmi Province and retainers of the Imagawa. After Imagawa Yoshimoto died at Okehazama in 1560, Ii Naochika was killed and Ii Naotora guarded his young son Naomasa.

Naomasa entered Tokugawa Ieyasu's service in 1575 and became one of his leading generals. Following the battle of Sekigahara in 1600, he received lands in Ōmi; the Ii ruled Hikone as daimyō throughout the Edo period.
zh:
井伊氏是远江国的武家，曾为今川氏家臣。今川义元于1560年在桶狭间阵亡后，井伊直亲被杀，井伊直虎保护了他的幼子直政。

直政于1575年开始侍奉德川家康，成为其重要将领。1600年关原之战后，他获封近江的领地；井伊氏在整个江户时代以大名身份统治彦根。

en:
Ijebu was a Yoruba kingdom of the Guinea coast, ruled from walled Ijebu-Ode by a king titled the Awujale. Its dynasty traced itself to Obanta, who led his people out of Ilé-Ifè, and the kingdom took shape around the fifteenth century. Long before, around 800 to 1000, its communities raised Sungbo's Eredo, walls and ditches enclosing the whole kingdom, one of Africa's largest earthen works.

Power was shared with the Osugbo, the titled men's council that also served as the kingdom's courts. Portuguese traders sailing the lagoon knew the state well: an account of 1508 calls Geebu a great city surrounded by a great ditch.

From the eighteenth century Ijebu grew rich on routes between the lagoon ports and inland Yoruba towns, insisting all goods pass through its merchants, a monopoly that made it one of the coast's best-organised states.
zh:
伊杰布是几内亚沿海的约鲁巴王国，以筑有城墙的伊杰布奥德为都，君主称号阿武贾莱。它的王朝追溯到率领族人离开伊莱伊费的奥班塔，王国约在15世纪成形。更早在约800—1000年间，当地社群已修筑松博壕墙，这道环绕整个王国的墙壕是非洲规模最大的土工工程之一。

权力由奥苏格博分享，这是由有头衔者组成的议事会，同时承担法庭职能。在潟湖航行的葡萄牙商人熟知这个国家：1508年的记载称格布为被大壕沟环绕的伟大城市。

18世纪起，伊杰布凭借潟湖港口与约鲁巴内陆城镇之间的商路致富，规定一切货物都须经本国商人经手，这份垄断使它成为沿海组织最严密的国家之一。

en: Ijero is one of the small Ekiti-Yoruba kingdoms in the hilly country of north-eastern Yorubaland, whose ruler bears the title of Ajero and whose people speak the Ekiti dialect. Like its neighbours it stayed largely independent until the Ekiti towns joined the Ekiti-Parapo coalition against Ibadan in the nineteenth-century Yoruba wars.
zh: 伊杰罗是约鲁巴兰东北部丘陵地带埃基提约鲁巴人的小王国之一，统治者称“阿杰罗”，居民讲埃基提方言。它与邻邦一样长期保持自治，直到19世纪约鲁巴诸邦混战时期，各埃基提城邦结成埃基提-帕拉波联盟共同对抗伊巴丹。

en:
L'Isle-Jourdain was a Gascon lordship in the valley of the Save west of Toulouse, taking its name from its island stronghold on the river. A line of seigneurs is recorded from around the year 1000, first as vassals of the counts of Toulouse; the seigneurs enlarged their lands by purchase and marriage.

In 1337 the lord was Bernard IV Jourdain, who had held the barony since about 1306 and married a daughter of the Count of Foix. His son Bertrand had the lordship raised to a county in 1340.

The comital line failed with Count Jourdain VI, who died without heirs after selling the fief in 1404 to the Duke of Bourbon; it was resold in 1421 to John IV, Count of Armagnac. The county later reverted to the French crown and formed part of the province of Gascony.
zh:
利勒茹尔丹是加斯科涅的一处领主领地，位于图卢兹以西的萨夫河谷，得名于河上的岛屿要塞。约1000年起，这里就有世代相承的领主，最初臣属于图卢兹伯爵，他们通过购买和联姻扩大领地。

1337年在位的领主是贝尔纳四世·茹尔丹，他约从1306年起统治这片男爵领地，并娶了富瓦伯爵的女儿。他的儿子贝特朗于1340年把领地升格为伯国。

伯爵一脉在茹尔丹六世时断绝：他没有继承人，1404年把封地卖给波旁公爵；1421年，这块封地又被转卖给阿马尼亚克伯爵让四世。伯国后来重归法兰西王冠，成为加斯科涅行省的一部分。

en:
Ijesha is the kingdom of the Ijesha Yoruba, with its capital at Ilesa in forested Yorubaland, west of the Effon ridge separating it from the Ekiti. It was founded around 1300 by Ajibogun Ajaka, known as Owa Obokun, the warlike youngest son of Oduduwa; tradition says he journeyed to the sea for salt water that cured his father's blindness, and his people are still called Omo Obokun.

His successors rule as the Owa Obokun Adimula of Ijesaland, and a daughter of one of them, Owa Atakunmosa, became the ancestress of the ruling houses of neighbouring Akure.

Hemmed in by Ife to the south, Oyo to the west and the Ekiti to the east, Ijesha lost ground in the nineteenth-century wars and became a leading member of the Ekiti-Parapo coalition that fought Ibadan in the long Kiriji War.
zh:
伊杰沙是伊杰沙约鲁巴人的王国，首都伊莱沙位于约鲁巴兰的森林地带，东以埃丰山脊与埃基提为界。王国约于1300年由奥杜杜瓦好战的幼子阿吉博贡·阿贾卡（即奥瓦·奥博昆）建立：相传他远行至海边取回海水，治好父亲的眼疾，臣民因此被称为“奥莫·奥博昆”。

继承者以“伊杰沙兰的奥瓦·奥博昆·阿迪穆拉”为号；其中一位国王奥瓦·阿塔昆莫萨的女儿，后来成为邻邦阿库雷诸王室的女始祖。

伊杰沙南接伊费、西连奥约、东邻埃基提，19世纪战乱中疆土日蹙，并成为埃基提-帕拉波联盟核心成员之一，与伊巴丹进行漫长的基里吉战争。

en:
The Ijūin were a branch of the Shimazu established at Ijūin in Satsuma Province. During the wars of the Northern and Southern Courts, Ijūin Tadakuni joined the Southern Court and fought the main Shimazu family, though later generations served it.

Ijūin Tadamune became a senior Shimazu retainer and received lands at Miyakonojō in Hyūga. After Shimazu Tadatsune killed him, his son Tadamasa rebelled in 1599; Tokugawa Ieyasu mediated a settlement, but Tadamasa was later killed.
zh:
伊集院氏是岛津氏的分支，以萨摩国伊集院为据点。南北朝战争中，伊集院忠国加入南朝，与岛津宗家交战，后来的家族成员则侍奉宗家。

伊集院忠栋成为岛津氏重臣，获封日向国都城。岛津忠恒杀死忠栋后，其子忠真于1599年起兵；德川家康出面调停，但忠真后来仍被杀害。

en:
The Ikeda were a Japanese warrior family with branches in Settsu and Mino, claiming descent from Minamoto no Yorimitsu. Ikeda Tsuneoki fought for Oda Nobunaga and was killed at Nagakute in 1584; his son Terumasa received Yoshida in Mikawa in 1590.

Terumasa married Tokugawa Ieyasu's daughter in 1594 and received Himeji for his service at Sekigahara in 1600. During the Edo period Ikeda branches ruled the domains of Okayama and Tottori.
zh:
池田氏是日本武家，在摄津和美浓有分支，自称源赖光的后裔。池田恒兴为织田信长作战，1584年在长久手阵亡；其子辉政于1590年获得三河的吉田。

辉政于1594年迎娶德川家康之女，1600年因在关原之战立功获封姬路。江户时代，池田氏的分支统治冈山藩和鸟取藩。

en: The Ithanktunwanna, or Yanktonai, were a Western Dakota people and one of the Seven Council Fires of the Sioux. Together with the Yankton, they lived near the Minnesota River and spoke a Western Dakota dialect.
zh: 伊桑克图纳纳又称扬克托奈，是西达科他人的一支，也是苏族七议事火之一。他们与扬克顿人同住在明尼苏达河附近，使用西达科他方言。

en: Ilocos was a region of coastal settlements on northwestern Luzon, home to the Ilocano people. Before Spanish rule, ports such as Vigan traded with merchants from across Asia. Juan de Salcedo reached Vigan in 1572, and the Spanish made it a centre of their rule; in 1818 the colonial province of Ilocos was divided into northern and southern provinces.
zh: 伊罗戈是吕宋岛西北岸由沿海聚落组成的地区，伊洛卡诺人居住于此。西班牙统治之前，维甘等港口与亚洲各地的商人进行贸易。胡安·德·萨尔塞多于1572年抵达维甘，西班牙人随后将它建成统治中心；1818年，殖民地伊罗戈省被分为南北两省。

en:
The Ilkhanate was a Mongol state in Iran and neighbouring lands, founded by Hülegü after the division of the Mongol Empire. In 1258 Hülegü captured Baghdad, ending the Abbasid caliphate there. The Ilkhan Ghazan converted to Islam in 1295, changing the religious allegiance of the ruling dynasty.

After Abu Sa'id died in 1335, rival commanders and claimants divided the realm. The Chobanids controlled Azerbaijan and installed nominal Ilkhans, but their rule ended when the Golden Horde captured Tabriz in 1357.
zh:
伊儿汗国是旭烈兀在蒙古帝国分裂后建立的蒙古政权，核心位于伊朗及周边地区。1258年，旭烈兀攻陷巴格达，终结了当地的阿拔斯哈里发政权。1295年伊儿汗合赞皈依伊斯兰教，改变了统治王朝的宗教归属。

1335年阿布赛因去世后，诸军阀和王位觊觎者瓜分了汗国。丘拜尼家族控制阿塞拜疆并拥立名义上的伊儿汗，但其统治随着金帐汗国于1357年攻占大不里士而告终。

en: Ilu was a small Hūrga Jurchen group of the Smaller Ussuri country, the forested tributary valleys east of the Ussuri. As one of the Wild Jurchen river tribes its chief held a nominal guard title under the Ming Nurgan commission, like those of the neighboring Yima and Shilimian guards, while its people lived by fishing, hunting and pig farming.
zh: 伊卢是小乌苏里地区的虎尔哈女真小群体，居于乌苏里江以东多林的支流河谷。作为野人女真的河畔部落之一，其酋长在明朝奴儿干都司下领有名义上的卫所官职，与邻近的亦麻河卫、失里绵卫同属羁縻网络，部众以捕鱼、狩猎和养猪为生。

en:
Imaal takes its name from the Glen of Imaal in the western Wicklow Mountains, the Irish Gleann Uí Mháil, recalling the Uí Máil who dominated the kingship of Leinster in the seventh century. After the Anglo-Norman invasion the O'Tooles, descended from the kings of Leinster, were driven from southern Kildare and settled in the Wicklow highlands around Glendalough, where by the fourteenth century they held the lordship of the Uí Máil.

Glendalough had been a great Irish monastery since St Kevin founded it in the sixth century, and the O'Tooles gave the Church a saint in Laurence O'Toole, once its abbot and later archbishop of Dublin.

From these glens the O'Tooles and kinsmen the O'Byrnes raided the English Pale for nearly four centuries; they joined the Confederate Catholics of Kilkenny in 1642, before the Cromwellian conquest broke the Wicklow clans.
zh:
伊马尔得名于威克洛山脉西部的伊马尔谷，爱尔兰语作 Gleann Uí Mháil，名字可追溯到7世纪主导伦斯特王权的乌伊·马伊尔部族。盎格鲁-诺曼入侵后，源出伦斯特国王的奥图尔家族被逐出基尔代尔南部，退入威克洛高地、在格伦达洛一带定居，到14世纪已领有乌伊·马伊尔部族的领主之位。

格伦达洛自6世纪圣凯文建院以来就是爱尔兰的重要修道院，奥图尔家族还为教会贡献了一位圣人：曾任该院院长、后任都柏林大主教的劳伦斯·奥图尔。

奥图尔家族与同族的奥伯恩家族以这些山谷为据点，袭扰英国人的“佩尔”地区近四百年；1642年他们加入基尔肯尼天主教联盟，最终在克伦威尔征服中丧失了威克洛诸氏族的独立。

en:
Imereti was a Georgian kingdom in the west of the country, ruled from Kutaisi by a branch of the Bagrationi dynasty. Bagrat became king in 1463, during the fragmentation of Georgia; his son Alexander II regained the throne in 1484, and the division of Georgia recognized his independence in 1490.

Ottoman incursions and the ambitions of the princes of Mingrelia and Guria weakened the kingdom. In 1804 Solomon II accepted Russian suzerainty, but Russia deposed him in 1810.
zh:
伊梅列季是格鲁吉亚西部的王国，由巴格拉季昂尼王朝的一个支系从库塔伊西统治。格鲁吉亚分裂期间，巴格拉特于1463年成为国王；他的儿子亚历山大二世于1484年夺回王位，1490年格鲁吉亚的分割承认了他的独立地位。

奥斯曼人的入侵以及明格列利亚和古里亚诸侯的野心削弱了王国。1804年所罗门二世接受俄国的宗主权，但俄国于1810年废黜了他。

en:
The Imagawa were a branch of the Ashikaga family, named after a place in Mikawa where Ashikaga Kuniuji settled in the thirteenth century. Imagawa Norikuni received Tōtōmi and later Suruga from his cousin, Shōgun Ashikaga Takauji.

Imagawa Yoshimoto secured the succession in 1536 and built a powerful domain based in Suruga. In 1560 he was killed by Oda Nobunaga's forces at Okehazama; within a decade the Takeda and Tokugawa had taken the clan's lands. Yoshimoto's successor Ujizane later served the Tokugawa as a master of ceremonies.
zh:
今川氏是足利氏的分支，得名于足利国氏在13世纪定居的三河国今川。今川范国从表兄弟足利尊氏将军处获得远江，后来又获得骏河。

今川义元于1536年确立继承地位，以骏河为根据地建立强大的领国。1560年他在桶狭间被织田信长的部队杀死；不到十年，武田氏和德川氏便夺取了今川领地。义元的继承人氏真后来在德川家担任负责礼仪的高家。

en:
Imanka was the Hūrga Jurchen group of the Iman River valley, a stream rising in the Sikhote-Alin and running west for 440 kilometres to join the Ussuri near the like-named trading town of Iman. Across the river, opposite present Hutou, the Ming established the Yima River Guard in the early fifteenth century, one of the Nurgan commission's guards holding the Ussuri line.

The valley's Tungusic chiefs combined fishing, hunting and pig farming with the tribute trade in furs and ginseng. The valley shared the fate of the other Wild Jurchen tribes when Nurhaci's forces subdued the Ussuri country between 1596 and 1625, though some communities stayed outside the banners and survived as the Hezhen and neighboring peoples.
zh:
伊曼卡是伊曼河流域的虎尔哈女真部落。伊曼河发源于锡霍特山脉，西流440公里，在同名城镇伊曼附近注入乌苏里江。15世纪初，明朝在今虎头对岸设亦麻河卫，是奴儿干都司镇守乌苏里江一线的卫所之一。

当地通古斯酋长以捕鱼、狩猎和养猪为生，并参与毛皮、人参的朝贡贸易。1596—1625年努尔哈赤征服乌苏里江流域，伊曼卡与其他野人女真部落同归其治下；也有部分聚落未入八旗，保留自身认同，成为赫哲等邻近民族的来源。

en:
Imola lies on the Santerno River in Romagna. Sulla founded it around 82 BC as Forum Cornelii; the Lombards gave the fortress its present name in the seventh century; it passed with the Exarchate of Ravenna under papal authority.

In the communal age its citizens, generally Ghibelline, fought neighbouring cities while the Alidosi and other strongmen seized the signoria. The pope enfeoffed the city to Lippo II Alidosi as pontifical vicar, so in 1337 the family ruled Imola as vassals, until Visconti of Milan took it in 1424.

Restored to the Holy See in 1426, it passed to the Sforza and then, as Caterina Sforza's dowry, to Girolamo Riario, whose lands fell to Cesare Borgia in 1499. Imola submitted in 1504 and remained a papal town until a provisional French government in 1797; the Congress of Vienna returned it to the Papal States in 1815.
zh:
伊莫拉位于罗马涅的圣泰尔诺河畔。公元前82年前后苏拉建城，取名科尔内利乌姆广场；7世纪伦巴第人将今名用于当地要塞，此后它随拉文纳总督区转归教皇。

公社时代，市民倾向吉伯林派，与邻邦交兵，阿利多西等强人几度攫取领主之位。教皇将该城封给代牧利波二世·阿利多西，1337年该家族以教皇封臣身份统治伊莫拉，1424年为米兰的维斯孔蒂所夺。

1426年伊莫拉重归教廷，后封给斯福尔扎家族，又作为卡泰丽娜·斯福尔扎的嫁妆归吉罗拉莫·里亚里奥，其领地1499年落入切萨雷·博尔贾之手。1504年伊莫拉臣服，此后为教皇国城镇；1797年法国建立临时政府，1815年维也纳会议交还教皇国。

en:
The İnançids, also called the Beylik of Lâdik, were a Turkoman frontier principality centered on Denizli, the ancient Laodicea on the Lycus from whose name Lâdik derives, in southwestern Anatolia. It emerged around 1261, when the commander Mehmed Bey rebelled against the Seljuk sultan of Rûm and founded a beylik under Ilkhanid overlordship.

Mehmed Bey was killed by the Ilkhanids in 1262 and his son-in-law Ali Bey succeeded him. After backing the failed Cimri revolt of 1277, Ali was imprisoned, and the principality passed for a generation under the Sahib Ataids, until around 1310 the Germiyanid ruler Yakup Bey restored the family, placing Ali's son İnanç Bey at its head.

Under İnanç Bey and his son Murad Arslan, the reigning bey in 1337, the beylik recovered its strength. In 1368 the Germiyanids annexed Lâdik, ending the İnançid line.
zh:
伊南奇（伊南奇奥卢）又称拉迪克贝伊国，是安纳托利亚西南部以代尼兹利为中心的突厥蛮侯国；代尼兹利古称吕库斯河畔老底嘉，拉迪克一名即由此演变。约1261年，首领穆罕默德贝伊反抗罗姆塞尔柱苏丹，在伊利汗国宗主权下建立贝伊国。

穆罕默德贝伊1262年被伊利汗国处死，女婿阿里贝伊继位。阿里因支持1277年失败的吉姆里叛乱入狱，侯国随后由萨希布—阿塔家族接管一代人；约1310年，格尔米扬的雅各布贝伊恢复其统治，立阿里之子伊南奇贝伊为首领。

伊南奇贝伊及其子、1337年在位的穆拉德·阿尔斯兰治下，贝伊国重振势力。1368年格尔米扬吞并拉迪克，伊南奇家族统治告终。

en:
The Inca Empire grew from a kingdom in the Peruvian highlands, with its political centre at Cusco. From 1438 its rulers expanded across the Andes by conquest and negotiation, incorporating lands from present-day Ecuador to Chile. Roads linked the four regions of the empire, while officials used knotted quipu cords to keep records.

In 1532 Francisco Pizarro captured the Inca ruler Atahualpa at Cajamarca. Spanish campaigns continued for decades, until the last Inca state fell in 1572.
zh:
印加帝国由秘鲁高地的一个王国发展而来，政治中心位于库斯科。自1438年起，统治者通过征服和谈判向安第斯山脉扩张，将今厄瓜多尔至智利的土地纳入版图。道路连接帝国的四个地区，官员则用打结的奇普绳索记录事务。

1532年，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在卡哈马卡俘获印加统治者阿塔瓦尔帕。西班牙人的征服持续了数十年，直到最后一个印加政权于1572年覆亡。

en:
Inhambane was a trading settlement on a deep bay of the southern Mozambique coast. By the eleventh century dhows from Arabia and Persia called there, bartering for pearls and ambergris and trading through Chibuene; inland at Manyikeni, Zimbabwe-style stone walls mark a chiefdom that funneled gold and ivory to the coast.

Local Tonga spinners grew and wove cotton; before the Portuguese arrived, Karanga invaders had set up chiefdoms over them and taken over the Muslim trade. The port recognized Kilwa's overlordship, and Vasco da Gama named it Terra de Boa Gente, the Land of the Good People.

A Portuguese factory followed in 1534, and in 1560 Inhambane became the first Jesuit mission in southeast Africa. Under mostly Indian merchants it became an ivory and slave port in the eighteenth century, until the Nguni conqueror Soshangane sacked and destroyed it in 1834.
zh:
伊尼扬巴内是莫桑比克南部海岸深水港湾上的贸易聚落。11世纪时，阿拉伯和波斯的独桅帆船已到此停泊，收购珍珠和龙涎香，经奇布埃内交易；内陆马尼凯尼留有大津巴布韦风格的石墙，那是向沿海输送黄金和象牙的酋长国。

当地通加人纺纱织棉，葡萄牙人到来之前，卡兰加入侵者已在他们之上建立若干酋长国，把持穆斯林贸易。该港承认基卢瓦的宗主权，瓦斯科·达伽马将它命名为‘善良人之地’。

1534年葡萄牙人设商馆，1560年伊尼扬巴内成为耶稣会在东南非的第一个传教点。18世纪，在以印度商人为主的经营下，它成为象牙和奴隶贸易港，直到1834年恩古尼征服者索尚加内将该城洗劫摧毁。

en:
Inishowen is the peninsula between Lough Foyle and Lough Swilly in northern Donegal, the northernmost point of Ireland. It took its name from Eógan mac Néill, son of Niall of the Nine Hostages, and was the homeland of the Meic Lochlainn, who ruled from the Grianan of Aileach ringfort and gave two high kings to Ireland.

When their power collapsed after the Battle of Caimeirge in 1241, the Norman Earldom of Ulster moved in and built Greencastle; the knight John de Courcy's earlier harrying had been checked by the O'Neills.

In the fourteenth century, after the Bruce invasion shattered the earldom, the Ó Dochartaigh gradually conquered Inishowen and the Mac Lochlainns sank to under-lords. The Ó Dochartaigh remained Lords of Inishowen until 1608, when Cahir O'Doherty burned Derry in the last Gaelic rising of the north; defeat cost them the peninsula, which passed to Arthur Chichester.
zh:
因尼肖温是多尼戈尔北部横亘在福伊尔湾与斯威利湾之间的半岛，也是爱尔兰最北端。它得名于“九质之尼尔”之子欧文·麦克尼尔，是麦克洛克林氏族的故土；该氏族以格里阿南环形堡为王庭，曾出过两位爱尔兰至高王。

1241年凯梅尔格战役后其权势崩塌，诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯爵领伸入，修建格林卡斯尔；骑士约翰·德库西此前对半岛的洗劫曾被奥尼尔氏击退。

14世纪布鲁斯入侵摧毁伯爵领后，奥多尔蒂氏族逐步征服因尼肖温，麦克洛克林氏沦为小附庸。奥多尔蒂氏一直保有因尼肖温领主之位，直到1608年卡希尔·奥多尔蒂焚毁德里，发动北方最后一次盖尔人起义；起义失败后半岛被剥夺，转封给亚瑟·奇切斯特。

en:
The Injuids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled Fars from Shiraz in the fourteenth century. Their name comes from injü, the Mongol word for royal estates: in 1304 Ilkhan Öljeitü appointed Sharaf al-Din Mahmud Shah to administer them, and his family soon built a nearly independent hold on the region.

After the Ilkhanate collapsed with Abu Sa'id's death in 1335, the Injuids ruled Shiraz and at times Isfahan as sovereigns, though Sharaf al-Din's sons fought one another and the Chobanids repeatedly seized Shiraz. In 1337 the ruler in Shiraz was Ghiyas al-Din Kai-Khusrau; from 1343 the last Injuid, Jamal al-Din Abu Ishaq, held both cities and patronized architecture and the art of the book.

His rivalry with the Muzaffarids of Yazd ended in disaster: Mubariz al-Din Muhammad took Shiraz in 1353 and Isfahan in 1357, where Abu Ishaq was executed and his lands absorbed; they stayed under Muzaffarid rule until Timur's conquests forty years later.
zh:
因珠王朝是14世纪以设拉子为中心统治法尔斯的伊朗王朝，名称来自蒙古语对王室领地的称呼inju。1304年伊儿汗完者都任命谢拉夫丁·马哈茂德沙管理这些领地，其家族很快在当地建立近乎独立的权势。

1335年不赛因死后伊儿汗国瓦解，因珠诸王以独立君主身份统治设拉子，一度据有伊斯法罕，但谢拉夫丁诸子相互争斗，楚邦王朝也曾多次攻占设拉子。1337年统治设拉子的是吉亚斯丁·凯霍斯鲁；1343年起末代君主贾马勒丁·阿布·伊沙克同时领有两城，扶持建筑与书籍艺术。

他与亚兹德的穆扎法尔王朝争雄惨败：穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德1353年攻占设拉子，1357年拿下伊斯法罕，阿布·伊沙克被处死，领土遭吞并，此后归穆扎法尔王朝统治，直到约四十年后帖木儿的征服。

en:
The Duchy of Inowrocław, in the Kuyavian lands around the towns of Inowrocław and Bydgoszcz, was split off from the Duchy of Kuyavia in 1267 and ruled by a junior line of the Piasts. Its last independent duke, Przemysł of Inowrocław, gave up the duchy in 1327 in exchange for Sieradz, and it passed to King Władysław Łokietek.

During the Polish-Teutonic War the knights of the Teutonic Order occupied Inowrocław from 1332 to 1337, when it was restored to Casimir III the Great, the Piast king shown holding it on the 1337 map.

Casimir formally incorporated the duchy into the Polish Crown in 1364 and established the Inowrocław Voivodeship on its territory; after a brief revival as a fief under collateral Piast princes, the incorporation became final in 1392.
zh:
伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫公国位于库亚维亚地区，领有伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫和比得哥什一带，1267年从库亚维亚公国分出，由皮亚斯特家族的一支旁系统治。末代独立公爵、伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的普热梅斯乌于1327年以该地换取谢拉兹，公国转入国王瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃凯泰克之手。

波兰-条顿战争期间，条顿骑士团于1332年至1337年占领此地，1337年它被归还给1337年地图上领有该地的皮亚斯特国王卡齐米日三世。

卡齐米日于1364年正式将公国并入波兰王冠，并在其领土上设立伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫省；其间虽曾短暂作为采邑封给旁支皮亚斯特王公，但并入最终在1392年确定下来。

en:
Indragiri was a Malay riverine kingdom in eastern Sumatra, on the Batang Kuantan, later the Indragiri River. Its name combines the Sanskrit words Indra and giri, hill of Indra.

Malay tradition traces its rulers to Raja Merlang I, said to be a Srivijaya prince who settled there in 1298; external accounts recognize it as a territorial entity from 1347. Long a vassal of the Minangkabau kings of Pagaruyung, it had lately gained control of its affairs when Tomé Pires wrote around 1515, though he still counted it among their subject ports. Local tradition dates the independent sultanate to 1508 under Nara Singa II, whose forces fought the Portuguese in 1523–1524.

The court had accepted Islam by the fifteenth century, when Raja Merlang II married a daughter of Sultan Mansur Shah of Malacca. Rulers later absorbed Kuantan; Sultan Ibrahim joined a campaign to retake Malacca in 1784 and founded his capital at Rengat in 1786.
zh:
丁机宜是苏门答腊东部的马来河港王国，地跨巴唐库安坦河（后称丁机宜河）。国名由梵语“因陀罗”和“吉里”拼成，意为神王因陀罗之山。

马来传说把王室追溯到1298年在此立足的拉惹·梅朗一世，据说他是室利佛逝王子；外部记载1347年起视其为政治实体。它长期臣属巴加鲁永的米南加保诸王，托梅·皮莱资约1515年著书时，它虽新近自主，仍被列为其治下港口；当地传统把独立苏丹国开端定于1508年纳拉·辛加二世时，其军1523至1524年与葡萄牙人作战。

15世纪宫廷已接受伊斯兰教，拉惹·梅朗二世娶马六甲苏丹曼苏尔·沙之女。后统治者吞并库安坦，苏丹易卜拉欣1784年参加夺回马六甲的战事，1786年建新都冷岳。

en:
Persia was reunited under the Safavid dynasty, which grew out of a Sufi order based at Ardabil. In 1501 Ismail I became shah and made Twelver Shiism the state religion. The Safavids ruled a realm extending across Iran and neighbouring lands until Afghan forces captured Isfahan in 1722; the dynasty formally ended in 1736.

After further struggles for power, Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar reunited Iran and was crowned shah in 1796. Under his successor Fath-Ali Shah, Persia lost much of its territory in the Caucasus to Russia in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
波斯在萨非王朝统治下重新统一；这个王朝源于阿尔达比勒的苏菲教团。1501年伊斯玛仪一世成为沙阿，确立什叶派十二伊玛目派为国教。萨非王朝统治伊朗及周边广大地区，直到1722年阿富汗军队攻占伊斯法罕；王朝于1736年正式结束。

此后经过一系列权力争夺，阿迦·穆罕默德汗·卡扎尔重新统一伊朗，于1796年加冕为沙阿。在继任者法特赫·阿里沙统治下，波斯于19世纪初将高加索的大部分领土失给俄国。

en:
Irodo is a settlement at the mouth of the river of the same name on the northern tip of Madagascar, beneath the Ambohitra Massif in Antankarana country. On its course to the Indian Ocean the river has cut the red Tsingy Rouge formations.

A multiethnic stopping place once called Antsampagnamahazo, Irodo grew as a transit point between the trading capital of Vohemar and the Antankarana kingdom of the interior, and local tradition remembers its founding ancestor Tsimiendrigny, who rescued five foreigners from a shipwreck.

The Antankarana, the people of the limestone tsingy, split from the Sakalava in the sixteenth century under their Zafin'i'fotsy royal line. Their first king Kozobe ruled from 1614 and divided the north among his five sons, and after Sakalava invasions King Andriantsirotso refounded the kingdom around the Ankarana rocks in 1692, sheltering his people in its caves.
zh:
伊鲁杜是马达加斯加最北端同名河流入海口处的定居点，位于安博希特拉山脚下的安坦卡拉纳人之地。这条河在注入印度洋途中侵蚀出红色石林。

伊鲁杜旧称安察帕格纳马哈佐，是多民族中转聚落，作为贸易重镇武海马尔与内陆安坦卡拉纳王国之间的转运点而兴起；当地传统还记得始祖齐米恩德里尼曾从海难中救起五个外乡人。

安坦卡拉纳意为石林之人，16世纪随扎菲菲齐王室支系与萨卡拉瓦人分裂而形成。首位国王科佐贝1614年即位，把北方分给五个儿子；萨卡拉瓦人入侵后，安德里安齐罗措王1692年在安卡拉纳石林一带重建王国，把族人安置在岩洞避难。

en:
The Kingdom of Ireland was established in 1542 under Henry VIII of England and governed from Dublin Castle. English authority had previously been strongest around the Pale, while Gaelic lords held much of the island.

The Tudor conquest provoked resistance: Hugh O'Neill and Hugh Roe O'Donnell led a confederacy against the Crown in the Nine Years' War, which ended in 1603. Land confiscations and settlement followed, and a Protestant minority came to dominate the kingdom. After the failed rebellion of 1798, the Acts of Union joined Ireland to Great Britain in 1801.
zh:
爱尔兰王国于1542年在英格兰国王亨利八世统治下建立，由都柏林城堡管辖。此前英格兰的权力主要集中在佩尔地区，岛上大部分土地由盖尔领主管辖。

都铎王朝的征服引发了抵抗：休·奥尼尔和休·罗·奥唐奈率领领主联盟，在九年战争中对抗王权，战争于1603年结束。此后土地遭到没收，移民被安置进来，新教少数派逐渐主导了王国。1798年起义失败后，联合法令于1801年将爱尔兰并入大不列颠。

en:
The Haudenosaunee Confederacy united five Indigenous nations south of the Great Lakes: the Mohawk, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga and Seneca. Its founding under the Great Law of Peace preceded European contact, though its date is disputed. In the Beaver Wars of 1609–1701, the confederacy fought French allies and expanded its reach into the Ohio valley; the Great Peace of Montreal ended the conflict with France.

The Tuscarora joined after 1722, making the league Six Nations. During the American Revolution, Oneida and Tuscarora supported the Patriots while the other nations allied with Britain; after the war many Haudenosaunee moved to the Grand River in British Canada.
zh:
霍迪诺肖尼联盟联合了五大湖以南的五个原住民族：莫霍克、奥奈达、奥农达加、卡尤加和塞内卡。联盟依据《和平大法》建立于欧洲人接触之前，确切日期尚有争议。在1609—1701年的海狸战争中，联盟与法国的盟友交战，势力扩展到俄亥俄河谷；《蒙特利尔大和平协定》结束了与法国的冲突。

塔斯卡罗拉人在1722年后加入，使联盟成为六族联盟。美国独立战争期间，奥奈达和塔斯卡罗拉支持独立派，其余各族与英国结盟；战后许多霍迪诺肖尼人迁往英属加拿大的大河流域。

en:
The Isa were a warrior family of Isa district in Hitachi Province, related to the Date. After fighting for Minamoto no Yoritomo in the 1189 Ōshū campaign, Isa Tamemune remained in Hitachi while relatives settled in Date district.

During the Northern and Southern Courts conflict, Isa Yukisuke supported the Southern Court and defended Isa Castle alongside nearby allies. The castle fell in 1343, and the family declined as the Date also lost their influence in Hitachi.
zh:
伊佐氏是常陆国伊佐郡的武家，与伊达氏同族。1189年伊佐为宗追随源赖朝征讨奥州，此后他留在常陆，亲族则迁居伊达郡。

南北朝对立期间，伊佐行资支持南朝，与附近盟友共同防守伊佐城。1343年城池陷落，伊佐氏衰落，伊达氏也失去了在常陆的势力。

en:
The Ishidō were a branch of the Ashikaga family whose leader Yoshifusa became commander in Ōshū in 1337. Dismissed in 1345, he later sided with Ashikaga Tadayoshi against Shōgun Takauji in the Kannō Disturbance.

Yoshifusa's son Yorifusa continued fighting alongside the Southern Court and drove Shōgun Yoshiakira from Kyoto in 1361. Around 1364 he surrendered to Yoshiakira and became a monk; the family subsequently disappeared from records as a house of provincial governors.
zh:
石塔氏是足利氏的分支，家主义房于1337年出任奥州总大将。1345年被免职后，他在观应扰乱中站在足利直义一边，对抗将军尊氏。

义房之子赖房继续与南朝并肩作战，1361年将将军义诠逐出京都。约1364年，他向义诠投降并出家；此后石塔氏作为守护家族的记载逐渐消失。

en: The Ise were a warrior family claiming descent from the Ise Taira, and hereditary stewards of the Muromachi shogunate's administrative board. Ise Sadachika became steward in 1460 under Shogun Ashikaga Yoshimasa. In the Edo period the family served as shogunal retainers and was known for the Ise school of warrior etiquette.
zh: 伊势氏是自称出自平氏伊势一支的日本武家，世袭室町幕府政所执事之职。伊势贞亲于1460年出任执事，在将军足利义政手下掌握实权。江户时代，伊势氏作为幕府旗本效力，以武家礼仪的伊势流闻名。

en:
The Ishak, also called Atakapa, were a group of peoples along the Gulf coast of present-day Texas and Louisiana who spoke an isolated language. In 1528 survivors of the Narváez expedition encountered a western Ishak community on the Texas coast.

In 1731 Ishak joined French and Caddo forces against the Natchez at Natchitoches. After the Louisiana Purchase of 1803, settlers increasingly acquired Ishak lands along the Mermentau and Vermilion rivers.
zh:
伊沙克人又称阿塔卡帕人，居住在今得克萨斯州和路易斯安那州的墨西哥湾沿岸，所说的语言是一种孤立语言。1528年，纳瓦埃斯探险队的幸存者在得克萨斯海岸遇到一支西部伊沙克人。

1731年，伊沙克人与法国及卡多人的部队一道在纳基托什对抗纳奇兹人。1803年美国购入路易斯安那后，殖民者逐渐取得梅尔芒托河和弗米利恩河沿岸的伊沙克土地。

en:
The Isshiki were an Ashikaga branch named for their lands in Mikawa Province. Isshiki Yoriyuki followed Ashikaga Takauji to Kyushu in 1336 and died fighting Southern Court forces the next year.

The family later became military governors of provinces including Wakasa and Tango and held high office in the Muromachi shogunate. During the Ōnin War, Isshiki Yoshinao joined the western army in 1467; the family's rule in Tango ended after the Hosokawa invasion in 1582.
zh:
一色氏是足利氏的支族，因其在三河国一色的领地而得名。一色赖行于1336年跟随足利尊氏前往九州，次年与南朝军交战时战死。

此后家族出任若狭、丹后等国的守护，在室町幕府中身居高位。应仁之乱期间，一色义直于1467年加入西军；1582年细川氏入侵后，一色氏在丹后的统治结束。

en:
Shiewhibak, the Southern Tiwa name of the pueblo Spaniards called Isleta, was founded around the fourteenth century on a knife-shaped lava flow in the middle Rio Grande, south of present-day Albuquerque.

Its name refers to a knife laid on the ground for the whib footrace, and its people speak Isletan Tiwa; the Tiwa are regarded as the earliest Pueblo inhabitants of the upper Rio Grande. Coronado campaigned through their country in the Tiguex War of 1540–1541, before Oñate's colony of 1598 brought missions and tribute.

During the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 Shiewhibak did not join the rising and instead sheltered refugees; the Spaniards nevertheless burned it in 1681, carrying hundreds south to found Ysleta del Sur near El Paso in 1682. Diego de Vargas reoccupied and rebuilt the pueblo in the 1690s, the community keeping its Tiwa speech and ceremonies.
zh:
希维巴克是南蒂瓦语名，西班牙人称这座普韦布洛为伊斯莱塔；它约建于14世纪，在格兰德河中游一道刀形熔岩流上，位于今阿尔伯克基以南。

其名源自为惠布赛跑放在地上的刀，居民讲伊斯莱塔蒂瓦语；蒂瓦人被视为格兰德河上游最早的普韦布洛居民。1540至1541年科罗纳多在蒂格斯战争中横扫此地，1598年奥尼亚特殖民队伍带来传教与贡赋。

1680年普韦布洛起义时希维巴克没有参与，反而收容难民；西班牙人仍于1681年焚毁此镇，裹胁数百居民南行，1682年在埃尔帕索附近建南伊斯莱塔。17世纪90年代巴尔加斯重新占领并重建普韦布洛，社区保留了蒂瓦语和传统仪式。

en:
Isedo, fully called Isedo-Olumo, was an ancient kingdom of the Igbomina Yoruba in north-eastern Yorubaland. Oral tradition dates its founding to between 1250 and 1400, while archaeology traces the settlement to the tenth century, when Obalumo, a hunter-prince of the older northern Oba civilization, led refugees from quarrels with neighbours including the Nupe.

At its late-fifteenth-century height the city-state grouped thirteen clans under the Obalumo, its rulers' royal title. It hosted migrants from collapsing Ila Yara, granting land where they built Ila-Magbon and then Ila-Odo, nucleus of Ila Orangun; in memory of the grant the Orangun of Ila once paid annual homage to the Obalumo.

An Isedo royal branch later helped found Oke-Ila, its head taking the title Obala. Long overshadowed by younger neighbours, old Isedo was eventually absorbed into Ila Orangun.
zh:
伊塞多全称伊塞多-奥卢莫，是约鲁巴兰东北部伊博米纳约鲁巴人的古老王国。口传传统把建城定在1250至1400年间，考古则将定居史追溯到10世纪：奥巴卢莫是北方奥巴古文明的狩猎王子，因奥巴与努佩等邻邦冲突而率难民出走。

15世纪末鼎盛时，城邦在统治者世代沿用的王号奥巴卢莫之下统辖十三氏族。它接纳覆灭的伊拉雅拉移民，拨地让他们先后建起伊拉马格邦和伊拉奥多，后者是伊拉奥朗贡的雏形；为答谢赠地，伊拉的奥兰甘曾每年向奥巴卢莫朝谒。

伊塞多王族一支后来参与创建奥凯伊拉，首领称奥巴拉。伊塞多城长期受年轻邻邦压制，最终并入伊拉奥朗贡。

en:
The Ishikawa of Mutsu were a warrior family who traced their descent to Minamoto no Yorito and ruled as independent lords. Their seat was Mitsuashi Castle in Ishikawa district. In 1563 Ishikawa Harumitsu adopted Akimitsu, a son of Date Harumune, who inherited the family in 1568.

The Ishikawa lost their domain in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's settlement of Ōshū in 1590. They became senior retainers of the Date, and in the Edo period held the foremost place among the branch houses of the Sendai domain.
zh:
陆奥石川氏是自称源赖远后裔的武士家族，曾作为独立大名统治，居城在石川郡的三芦城。1563年，石川晴光收伊达晴宗之子昭光为养子，昭光于1568年继承家督。

1590年，石川氏在丰臣秀吉的奥州仕置中失去领地，此后成为伊达氏重臣。江户时代，石川家位居仙台藩一门之首。

en: Italy comprised the peninsula's city-states and kingdoms, divided for centuries after the Lombard invasion of 568. In 1805 Napoleon became king of an Italian state centred on northern Italy, which fell with his defeat in 1814.
zh: 意大利包括半岛上的城邦和王国，自568年伦巴第人入侵后分裂了数百年。1805年拿破仑成为一个以意大利北部为中心的国家的国王，这个王国随他在1814年战败而覆灭。

en:
The Itō were a Japanese warrior family whose lands included Hyūga Province in Kyushu. Itō Yoshisuke became head of the family in 1538 and recovered territory from the Shimazu in 1542.

The Shimazu defeated him at Kizaki in 1572 and eventually drove the family from its lands. After Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign in 1587, the Itō regained territory in Hyūga, where they later ruled Obi Domain.
zh:
伊东氏是日本武家，领地包括九州的日向国。伊东义祐于1538年继承家督，1542年从岛津氏手中收复领地。

岛津氏于1572年在木崎原击败义祐，最终将伊东氏逐出其领地。1587年丰臣秀吉征讨九州后，伊东氏在日向收复领地，后来统治饫肥藩。

en: The Itun are the Jurchen group of the Itun river (Manchu Ituŋ ula), which flows past Changchun into the Second Songhua system, where the Buyeo once built a royal city. In the fourteenth century the valley belonged to the Yuan province of Liaoyang, and under the Ming it was held through the Nurgan guards before passing to the Yehe tribe.
zh: 伊图是生活在伊通河（满语伊敦乌拉）畔的女真群体，河流经长春注入第二松花江水系，夫余人曾在河畔修建王城。14世纪这里隶属元朝辽阳行省，明代由奴儿干都司诸卫管辖，明末落入海西女真叶赫部之手。

en:
The Itza were a Maya people whose kings, bearing the title Kan Ek', ruled an island kingdom on Lake Petén Itzá in Petén's rainforest. Descended from the Chanes of the Chontal coast in Tabasco, they migrated into northern Yucatán in the tenth century and became the dominant lineage of Chichen Itza, whose name means at the mouth of the well of the Itza.

After their hegemony ended, the Itza lingered at Champotón; when the Xiu overthrew the Cocom at Mayapan around 1441–1446, they fled south to found Nojpetén, the great island, dividing it into four quarters.

Cortés crossed the lake on his 1525 march to Honduras, but the Itza kept their independence for another 170 years: Franciscan missions in 1618–1619 were expelled, and a 1622 expedition was massacred. In 1697 Martín de Ursúa stormed Nojpetén, ending the last independent native kingdom in the Americas.
zh:
伊察人是玛雅人的一支，君主称坎·埃克，在佩滕雨林的佩滕伊察湖上统治岛国。他们是塔巴斯科琼塔尔海岸查内斯人的后裔，10世纪迁入尤卡坦北部，成为奇琴伊察的统治家族——奇琴伊察意为“伊察人的井口”。

霸权结束后伊察人一度居留于钱波通；约1441—1446年休人在玛雅潘推翻科科姆家族，伊察人南逃，建立诺赫佩滕，意为“大岛”，全城分为四区。

1525年科尔特斯进军洪都拉斯时曾横渡此湖，但伊察人又保持约170年独立：1618—1619年方济各会传教团被驱逐，1622年远征队遭屠杀。1697年马丁·德·乌尔苏阿攻陷诺赫佩滕，美洲最后一个独立本土王国灭亡。

en: The Ithaktunwan, or Yankton, were a Western Dakota people of the Sioux alliance. They lived near the Minnesota River with the Yanktonai and traditionally guarded the Pipestone Quarry, a sacred place for the Sioux.
zh: 伊桑克通万又称扬克顿人，是苏族联盟中的西达科他族群。他们与扬克托奈人居于明尼苏达河附近，历来守护着苏族的圣地派普斯通采石场。

en:
Iveagh, from the Irish Uíbh Eachach Cobha, was a Gaelic territory in the heart of what is now County Down, originally ruled by the Uí Echach Cobo within the overkingdom of Ulaid. From the twelfth century its chiefs were the Magennis sept, who made their base at Rathfriland and were inaugurated on Knock Iveagh.

The Magennises were vassals of the Norman Earldom of Ulster until the earldom collapsed in 1333, after which they expanded Iveagh eastward as far as Dundrum on the Irish Sea.

They later came to terms with the English crown under surrender and regrant, several chiefs being knighted in 1542, but Art Roe Magennis joined the Nine Years' War on the side of Hugh O'Neill. After the war the crown broke Iveagh into fifteen freeholds between 1607 and 1610, ending its existence as a single lordship.
zh:
艾维得名于爱尔兰语Uíbh Eachach Cobha，是今唐郡腹地的盖尔人领地，最初由乌拉德大王权下的乌伊·埃哈·科博部族统治。12世纪起马吉尼斯家族成为首领，以拉斯弗赖兰为据点，在诺克艾维山举行继位仪式。

他们原是诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯国附庸，1333年伯国崩溃后向东扩张，直抵爱尔兰海边的邓德拉姆。

后来他们通过“交土再封”与英国王室和解，数名首领1542年受封骑士；但阿尔特·罗·马吉尼斯在九年战争中加入休·奥尼尔一方。战后王室于1607至1610年间把艾维拆成十五块自由保有地，统一领主领地就此终结。

en:
The Iwellemmeden were a Tuareg confederation whose territory stretched from the Timbuktu region across the Azawagh valley. By the mid-fifteenth century they controlled land extending east toward the Air Mountains.

In the eighteenth century the confederation divided into the western Kel Ataram and eastern Kel Dinnik. The Kel Ataram later imposed indirect rule on Timbuktu, but the Fula Macina Empire drove them from the city in 1826.
zh:
伊韦勒梅登是图阿雷格部族联盟，其地域从廷巴克图一带延伸至阿扎瓦格河谷。到15世纪中叶，他们控制的土地向东伸展至艾尔山脉附近。

18世纪，联盟分为西部的凯尔阿塔拉姆和东部的凯尔丁尼克。凯尔阿塔拉姆后来对廷巴克图实行间接统治，但于1826年被富拉人的马西纳帝国逐出该城。

en:
The Inawashiro were a branch of the Ashina warrior family, based at Inawashiro Castle in Mutsu. Though senior Ashina retainers, they often asserted their independence and rebelled against their overlords.

Inawashiro Morikuni retired in 1585 in favor of his son Moritane, but later sought to disinherit him. In 1588 Morikuni defected to the Date and admitted their troops to the castle, helping bring about the Ashina defeat at Suriagehara. Date Masamune rewarded him in 1589; Morikuni later followed Masamune out of Aizu.
zh:
猪苗代氏是芦名武士家族的支流，以陆奥国的猪苗代城为据点。猪苗代氏虽是芦名家的重臣，却常寻求独立，数次反抗主家。

猪苗代盛国于1585年将家督让给儿子盛胤，后来又试图废除他的继承权。1588年盛国投向伊达氏，将伊达军引入城中，促成芦名氏在摺上原之战中的败北。伊达政宗于1589年赏赐盛国；盛国后来随政宗离开会津。

en:
Iztapan, whose Nahuatl name means place of salt, was a small salt-working town on the Costa Grande of Guerrero, on the coast later covered by the Aztec province of Cihuatlan, whose centre in this district was the bay of Zihuatanejo.

The region's ancient heart was the ceremonial city of Xihuacan, occupied for more than three thousand years and at its height between 200 and 800, later used by the Tolimecs, Cuitlatecs and Tepuztecs.

According to the sixteenth-century Relaciones geográficas, Iztapan and Pantla spoke Pantec, an otherwise unrecorded language; Tolimec was spoken in the towns to its west, while a variant of Nahuatl served as the lingua franca of the Zacatula district. Long independent of the highland empires, this coast was conquered by the Mexica emperor Ahuitzotl between 1497 and 1504 and registered as the tribute province of Cihuatlan in the Codex Mendoza.
zh:
伊斯塔潘的纳瓦特尔语名意为“产盐之地”，是格雷罗州科斯塔格兰德海岸的小型盐业城镇，所在海岸后来纳入阿兹特克的锡瓦特兰省，该省在这一带的中心是锡瓦塔内霍湾。

该地区古代核心是礼仪城市锡瓦坎，有人居住的历史超过三千年，200至800年间达到鼎盛，后来的使用者包括托利梅克人、奎特拉特克人和特普斯特克人。

据16世纪《地理记述》，伊斯塔潘与潘特拉讲潘特克语，一种此外没有记录的语言；其西诸镇讲托利梅克语，纳瓦特尔语变体则是萨卡图拉地区的通用语。这片海岸长期独立于高地帝国，1497至1504年间被墨西加君主阿维索特尔征服，在《门多萨手抄本》中登记为贡赋省锡瓦特兰。

en: Ixtlan was a small Mixtec city-state of the Coixtlahuaca valley in the northern Mixteca Alta of Oaxaca, probably the hill settlement later called Santiago Ihuitlan, whose people paid feather tribute to the Aztecs. Like the rest of the Coixtlahuaca province it passed to the Spaniards after the region's envoys submitted in 1520.
zh: 伊斯特兰是瓦哈卡北部上米斯特卡科伊斯特拉瓦卡谷地的小米斯特克人城邦，很可能即后来称作圣地亚哥·伊维特兰的山城，当地居民曾向阿兹特克人缴纳羽毛贡赋。与科伊斯特拉瓦卡省的其他城镇一样，1520年该地使者向西班牙人投降后，它也被纳入新西班牙。

en: Ixtacamaxtitlan was a Totonac town of the Sierra Norte de Puebla, in the highlands of old Totonacapan on the border with Tlaxcala. Its Nahuatl name refers to Iztacamaxtli, the white Camaxtli, the hunting and war deity also worshipped in Tlaxcala, and to the white crag beside which the settlement was founded.
zh: 伊斯塔卡马什蒂特兰是普埃布拉北部山区、旧托托纳卡潘高地上的一座托托纳克城镇，毗邻特拉斯卡拉。其纳瓦特尔语名称意为“白色的卡马斯特利”，卡马斯特利是特拉斯卡拉等地崇拜的狩猎与战争之神，名字也指城镇始建时所依的白色岩壁。

en:
Ila Yara, also called Ila-Iyara, was the original kingdom of the Igbomina Yoruba, founded in about the 1100s by Ajagun-nla, nicknamed Orangun, a legendary grandson of the deity Oduduwa, whose successors kept the title of Orangun.

Towards the end of the 1400s, after the sixth Orangun, Apakiimo, took the throne, a rival prince named Arutu lost the contest for the crown and led his supporters out in an exodus: they settled further north near the kingdom of Isedo and built the town that became Ila Orangun.

Apakiimo himself soon abandoned Ila Yara and moved east to found Oke-Ila, taking in a segment of the Isedo people along the way. In this way the old kingdom split into two sister states, Ila and Oke-Ila, whose kings both claim the Orangun title, while the original site of Ila Yara was left deserted.
zh:
伊拉雅拉又称伊拉-伊亚拉，是伊博米纳约鲁巴人最初的王国，约在12世纪由阿贾贡拉创建；他绰号“奥兰甘”，传说是神祇奥杜杜瓦的孙子，其继承者世代沿用奥兰甘的王号。

15世纪末，第六任奥兰甘阿帕基莫即位后，争夺王位失败的王子阿鲁图率支持者出走，向北迁到伊塞多王国附近定居，建起后来的伊拉奥朗贡。

阿帕基莫本人也很快放弃伊拉雅拉东迁，建立奥凯伊拉，并在途中接纳了一部分伊塞多人。古老王国由此分裂为伊拉和奥凯伊拉两个姊妹政权，两国国王都宣称拥有奥兰甘头衔，而伊拉雅拉旧城则被废弃。

en: Iztachacalapan was a small Zoque-speaking community of the Tochtepec lowlands in southern Veracruz, one of the Mixe-Zoque towns of the Papaloapan basin recorded under Nahuatl names. Like the rest of the region it was drawn into the Aztec tribute system in the fifteenth century, before the Spanish conquest of the Papaloapan towns in the early 1520s.
zh: 伊斯塔查卡拉潘是韦拉克鲁斯南部托奇特佩克低地一个讲索克语的小社群，是帕帕洛阿潘盆地以纳瓦特尔语记名的米塞-索克诸镇之一。与该地区其他地方一样，它在15世纪被纳入阿兹特克的朝贡体系，此后又在16世纪20年代初卷入西班牙人对帕帕洛阿潘诸镇的征服。

en:
Itzocan, whose Nahuatl name means place of the flint path, was a substantial Nahua altepetl in the Coatlalpan lowlands of southwestern Puebla, on the site of Izúcar de Matamoros. Its people were Nahuatl-speaking Nonoalca, and its ruling dynasty was linked by marriage and descent to those of Tenochtitlan and neighbouring Huaquechula; the region grew cotton and Itzocan's market was known beyond the district for the slaves sold there.

In Mexica foundation lore the town was counted among the cities raised by the giant Xelhua after the great flood. Itzocan was in time conquered by the Aztec Empire, which installed a garrison and made it answer to Tepeaca.

Spanish forces reached the Coatlalpan between 1521 and 1525, and the old name Itzocan was gradually softened to Izúcar; after independence the city added the name of the insurgent hero Mariano Matamoros.
zh:
伊佐坎的纳瓦特尔语名意为“燧石之路之地”，是普埃布拉西南部科瓦特尔潘低地上颇具规模的纳瓦人城邦，旧址即伊苏卡尔-德马塔莫罗斯。居民是讲纳瓦特尔语的诺诺阿尔卡人，统治王朝与特诺奇蒂特兰及邻城瓦克丘拉都有血缘和姻亲关系；这一带种植棉花，伊佐坎市场以奴隶买卖闻名。

在墨西加起源传说中，该城被列为巨人谢尔瓦在大洪水后建立的城市之一。伊佐坎后来被阿兹特克帝国征服，帝国在此驻军，令它臣服于特佩阿卡。

1521至1525年间西班牙军队进入科瓦特尔潘，旧名伊佐坎逐渐讹变为伊苏卡尔；独立之后，城市又加上起义英雄马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯的名字。

en: The Iztachichimecah, or White Chichimecas, were a group of Guamare peoples in the region between Jalostotitlán and Aguascalientes in present-day Mexico. They joined the Guamare alliance shortly before the Spanish arrival.
zh: 伊斯塔奇奇梅卡即白奇奇梅克人，是居住在今墨西哥哈洛斯托蒂特兰与阿瓜斯卡连特斯之间的瓜马尔族群。他们在西班牙人到来前不久加入瓜马尔联盟。

en: The Kingdom of Jaén was a Castilian territorial jurisdiction in Andalusia, centred on the city of Jaén. Muhammad I of Granada surrendered the city to Ferdinand III of Castile in 1246, and Jaén became an administrative and military centre near the Granadan frontier. One of the four kingdoms of Andalusia, it was abolished in Spain's territorial division of 1833.
zh: 哈恩王国是卡斯蒂利亚在安达卢西亚的一处领地，以哈恩城为中心。1246年格拉纳达的穆罕默德一世将该城交给卡斯蒂利亚国王费尔南多三世，哈恩成为格拉纳达边境附近的行政和军事中心。哈恩是安达卢西亚四个王国之一，1833年西班牙进行领土区划时被废除。

en:
The Jalayirid Sultanate was a Mongol dynasty, sprung from the Jalayir tribe of the Onon River, that ruled Iraq and western Iran from Baghdad after the Ilkhanate broke up in the 1330s. By 1337 its head Hasan Buzurg held the former Ilkhanid southwestern lands as an essentially independent ruler, fighting rival Mongol amirs for Persia.

Under his son Shaykh Uways, who reigned from 1356 to 1374, the sultanate reached its height: Tabriz and Azerbaijan were annexed in 1360, the Qara Qoyunlu were beaten at Mush in 1366, and Baghdad and Tabriz became centres of Persianate book painting.

After Uways the dynasty weakened, and in 1401 Timur sacked Baghdad and drove Sultan Ahmad into exile. Ahmad returned after Timur died in 1405 but was defeated and killed by the Qara Qoyunlu ruler Qara Yusuf in 1410. The last Jalayirids held only Hillah, Wasit and Basra in southern Iraq until the Qara Qoyunlu overran them in 1432.
zh:
札剌亦儿王朝源自蒙古鄂嫩河札剌亦儿部，1330年代伊儿汗国解体后，以巴格达为中心统治伊拉克和伊朗西部。1337年首领哈桑·布祖格已以实际独立的统治者掌管伊儿汗国西南部旧地，与其他蒙古异密争夺波斯。

其子谢赫·乌韦斯在位时（1356—1374）王朝达到鼎盛：1360年吞并大不里士和阿塞拜疆，1366年在穆什击败黑羊王朝，巴格达与大不里士成为波斯抄本细密画的中心。

乌韦斯死后国势转衰，1401年帖木儿洗劫巴格达，苏丹艾哈迈德被迫流亡。1405年帖木儿死后艾哈迈德一度复国，却在1410年被黑羊王朝首领卡拉·优素福击败身亡。末代札剌亦儿人仅保有伊拉克南部希拉、瓦西特、巴士拉，1432年被黑羊王朝攻灭。

en:
Japan in 1337 stood at the opening of the Ashikaga shogunate: after Emperor Go-Daigo's Kenmu Restoration overthrew Kamakura in 1333, his general Ashikaga Takauji rebelled and set up a Kyoto military government in 1336, opening the Nanboku-chō civil war, ended in 1392 by southern submission. Shogun Yoshimitsu built the Flower Palace on Muromachi Street in 1379 and fostered Ming trade, while Zen shaped tea ceremony, Noh and ink painting.

The 1467 Ōnin War shattered Ashikaga power and opened the Sengoku century. Oda Nobunaga entered Kyoto in 1568 and dissolved the shogunate in 1573, dying in the Honnō-ji incident of 1582; Toyotomi Hideyoshi completed unification and launched the 1592 Korean invasions before dying in 1598. Tokugawa Ieyasu won Sekigahara in 1600 and became shogun in 1603; Osaka's fall in 1615 ended rivalry.

From 1635 alternate attendance checked daimyo, and by 1639 sakoku left only the Dutch Dejima factory. Edo peace brought commerce, kabuki and ukiyo-e, but the Tenmei famine of 1782-1788 and Osaka's 1837 uprising showed strains on the Tokugawa order.
zh:
1337年日本正值室町幕府开幕：1333年后醍醐天皇建武新政灭镰仓幕府，其武将足利尊氏倒戈，1336年在京都建武家政权，开启南北朝内战，1392年南朝归降。将军足利义满1379年在室町街营花之御所，推动明朝贸易；禅宗滋养茶道、能乐、水墨画。

1467年应仁之乱瓦解幕府，开启百年战国乱世。织田信长1568年入京都，1573年废幕府，1582年本能寺之变自尽；丰臣秀吉完成统一，1592年发动侵朝，1598年病死。德川家康1600年关原取胜，1603年任将军，1615年大坂陷落，纷争告终。

1635年参觐交代钳制大名，1639年锁国完成，仅余出岛荷兰商馆。江户和平带来商业、歌舞伎、浮世绘，1782—1788年天明大饥荒与1837年大坂起义则显露德川秩序的危机。

en:
The Duchy of Jawor, with its capital at Jawor in Lower Silesia, created in 1274 from the Duchy of Legnica, stayed with the Silesian Piasts. In 1278 it went to Bolko I the Strict, who briefly joined it with Świdnica into the Duchy of Jawor-Świdnica.

After partition in 1312 Jawor passed to Henry I, who still ruled from Jawor in 1337. Henry pushed west in 1319, taking towns along the Upper Lusatian border, and unlike most Silesian dukes never did Bohemian homage.

When Henry died without male heirs in 1346, Jawor was reunited with Świdnica under his nephew Bolko II the Small, the last Silesian Piast to preserve full independence from Bohemia. Without sons, Bolko signed an inheritance treaty with Emperor Charles IV, who married his niece Anna; on the death of Bolko's widow Agnes in 1392 the duchy passed to the Bohemian Crown.
zh:
亚沃尔公国1274年从莱格尼察公国分出，都于下西里西亚亚沃尔，属西里西亚皮雅斯特家族。1278年封给博尔科一世“严厉者”，他曾短暂地将亚沃尔与希维德尼察合并为亚沃尔-希维德尼察公国。

1312年分家后归亨里克一世，1337年他仍统治亚沃尔。亨里克1319年向西扩张，沿上卢萨蒂亚边境取城；与多数西里西亚公爵不同，他从未向波希米亚行臣服礼。

1346年亨里克无男嗣而终，亚沃尔与外甥博尔科二世“小个子”的希维德尼察合并；他是最后一位对波希米亚完全独立的皮雅斯特公爵。他无子，与皇帝查理四世订继承条约，查理娶其侄女安娜；1392年博尔科的遗孀阿格妮丝去世，公国并入波希米亚王冠。

en:
Jubbal was a small Rajput hill state in the Punjab Himalayas, one of the twenty Thakuraian hill states, whose rulers bore the title Rana before British times. Its ruling house were Rathore Rajputs: founder Karan Chand, who established it in the twelfth century, was a son of the raja of neighbouring Sirmur, and Jubbal remained a Sirmur vassal for most of its history.

The country lay between the Pabar River and the Chor ridge, a thickly forested land whose timber later became its chief revenue, with smaller hill states as tributaries. During the Gurkha surge of 1803 to 1815 the Nepalese occupied Jubbal.

After their defeat the British granted its rana Puran Chand a sanad in 1815 that made the state independent of Sirmur. In 1832 Puran Chand abdicated in favour of the British, who then administered the country directly.
zh:
久巴尔是旁遮普喜马拉雅山区的拉杰普特小邦，属二十个“塔库里安”山地邦之一，英国势力到来之前君主称拉纳。统治家族为拉托尔氏族：12世纪建邦的始祖卡兰·昌德是邻邦锡尔穆尔拉贾之子，久巴尔历史上大部分时间是锡尔穆尔的附庸。

该邦位于帕巴尔河与乔尔山脊之间，森林密布，木材后来成为最主要财源，另有更小的山地邦向它纳贡。1803至1815年廓尔喀扩张期间，尼泊尔人占领久巴尔。

廓尔喀战败后，英国1815年向拉纳普兰·昌德颁发特许状，使久巴尔脱离锡尔穆尔独立。1832年普兰·昌德将政权让予英国，久巴尔改由英国直接管理。

en:
Jecen was a Jianzhou Jurchen tribe around the confluence of the Suzi and Hun rivers. Its name meant a border or walled place and referred to its position at the northwestern edge of the Jianzhou area.

In 1585 its chief joined forces with troops from Wangcheng against Nurhaci. They were defeated in the Battle of the Hun River despite heavy losses among Nurhaci's men.
zh:
哲陈是居住在苏子河与浑河汇合处一带的建州女真部落。哲陈一名意为边疆或城郭，指其位于建州地区的西北角。

1585年，哲陈部主联合王城兵马对抗努尔哈赤。哲陈在浑河之战中被击败，努尔哈赤的部众也伤亡惨重。

en:
Jersey, the largest Channel Island, became part of Normandy in the tenth century and remained loyal to the English crown when mainland Normandy was lost in 1204. It retained Norman laws and institutions and developed self-government under the crown.

During the English Civil War the de Carteret family supported the king, although Parliament's forces eventually took the island. In 1771 legislative power was concentrated in the States of Jersey; ten years later a French invasion was defeated at the Battle of Jersey.
zh:
泽西是海峡群岛中最大的岛屿，10世纪成为诺曼底的一部分；1204年英格兰失去诺曼底大陆领地时，泽西仍效忠英格兰王室。岛上保留了诺曼底的法律和制度，并在王室统治下发展出自治制度。

英国内战期间，德卡特雷家族支持国王，但议会军最终占领了泽西。1771年，立法权集中于泽西议会；十年后，法国入侵军在泽西战役中被击败。

en:
The Lordship of Jever was a Frisian state on the east of the East Frisian peninsula, of three districts ruled from Jever. Under Frisian Freedom local chieftains governed it; tradition credits Edo Wiemken the Elder with uniting them in 1359, though scholarship places the durable union in the fifteenth century.

Wiemken descendants held Jever for two centuries against the Cirksena counts, and after the castle burned in 1428 built Jever Castle. When the heir Christoph died young in 1517, the chieftain's daughter Maria was seized in her own castle in 1527 and the land was occupied until 1531, when Brunswick mercenaries drove out the occupiers.

In 1532 Maria and her sister Anna held Jever as a fief of Charles V. Last independent ruler Maria died in 1575, naming John VII of Oldenburg heir; Jever passed to Oldenburg in personal union, then Anhalt-Zerbst in 1667, Catherine the Great in 1793, before Oldenburg annexed it in 1818.
zh:
耶弗尔是东弗里斯兰半岛东部的弗里斯兰邦，领三地区，治耶弗尔。“弗里斯兰自由”时本土酋长治理；传统称埃多·维姆肯（老）1359年统一三地，后世考证认为稳固的统一迟至15世纪才完成。

维姆肯后裔统治两百年，顶住契尔克塞纳伯爵进逼；1428年旧堡焚毁后建耶弗尔城堡。1517年继承人克里斯托夫早逝，酋长之女玛丽亚1527年在自己城堡被扣押，领地被占领到1531年，直到不伦瑞克雇佣兵赶走占领者。

1532年玛丽亚与姐姐安娜以封臣身份把耶弗尔献给皇帝查理五世。末代独立统治者玛丽亚1575年去世，指定奥尔登堡的约翰七世继位；耶弗尔以共主邦联形式并入奥尔登堡，1667年转安哈尔特-采尔布斯特，1793年归叶卡捷琳娜大帝，最终于1818年被奥尔登堡彻底吞并。

en:
The Jaffna kingdom, ruled by the Aryacakravarti dynasty, occupied the Jaffna Peninsula and the northern coast of Sri Lanka from 1215 to 1619. It grew from Kalinga Magha's invasion: he overthrew Polonnaruwa's king and moved his court north behind the Vanni forests, before Madurai's Pandyans made it a tribute-paying feudatory in 1258.

After Malik Kafur broke Pandyan power in the early fourteenth century, Jaffna became independent and for a time was the island's strongest power, its overlordship accepted by the other kingdoms. Around 1450 Kotte's Parakramabahu VI sent Prince Sapumal to conquer it, but Kanakasooriya Cinkaiariyan returned from Madurai with mercenaries and restored independence in 1467.

Later kings grew rich on pearl fishing, elephant exports and land revenue, patronising Tamil letters and temples. After the Portuguese reached Sri Lanka in 1505 it faced repeated wars and treaties; the usurper Cankili II was defeated in 1617 and the kingdom annexed two years later.
zh:
贾夫纳王国由阿梨耶遮迦罗跋帝王朝统治，据有斯里兰卡贾夫纳半岛与北部沿海，存在于1215至1619年。它起于卡林加·马加入侵：他推翻波隆纳鲁沃国王，北迁宫廷至万尼森林后，1258年马杜赖潘地亚人将其降为纳贡附庸。

14世纪初马利克·卡富尔摧毁潘地亚势力后，贾夫纳独立，一度成为全岛最强政权，宗主权为岛上诸王国承认。1450年前后科特的波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世派萨普马尔王子征服之，卡纳卡苏里亚·辛凯阿里扬带雇佣兵从马杜赖返回，1467年恢复独立。

诸王靠采珠、象出口和土地税致富，扶持泰米尔文学与寺庙。1505年葡萄牙人抵达斯里兰卡后，王国屡经战和；篡位者坎基利二世1617年战败，两年后王国被吞并。

en: The Jingpo are one of the Kachin peoples of the highlands of northern Myanmar and Yunnan. Kachin communities established themselves in the northern Myanmar mountains, where they remained largely independent of the surrounding lowland states.
zh: 景颇人是居住在缅甸北部和云南高地的克钦诸族之一。克钦人在缅甸北部山区定居，在很大程度上独立于周围的低地政权。

en:
The Johiya, also called Joiya, are a tribe of the Punjab and northern Rajasthan counted at different times as both Rajputs and Jats. Alexander Cunningham derived their name from the ancient Yaudheyas, whose republic once ruled these same dry lands. Between the eighth and twelfth centuries the Johiyas were one of the dominant communities of Jangladesh and were especially strong around what became Bikaner.

From the thirteenth century many converted to Islam under the preaching of the Sufi Baba Farid of Ajodhan. In the sixteenth century the warlord Fateh Khan Jat exploited the rise of the Surs to plunder the roads as far as Panipat and briefly took Multan from the Baloch.

Later Muslim Johiya chiefs fought the Bhattis for Sirsa, Fatehabad and Hisar, shifting between Bikaner and Patiala allegiance until a treaty at Jind in 1781 settled their borderlands.
zh:
乔希亚人又称乔亚人，是旁遮普与拉贾斯坦北部的部落，不同时期或被算作拉杰普特人，或被算作贾特人。亚历山大·坎宁安认为其族名来自古代的尧德亚人，后者的共和国曾统治同一片干旱土地。8至12世纪乔希亚人是禅伽罗德什最有势力的族群之一，在后来的比卡内尔一带尤强。

13世纪起，许多人在阿焦丹苏菲圣者巴巴·法里德传道下改宗伊斯兰教。16世纪首领法塔赫汗·贾特趁苏尔王朝崛起之乱劫掠商路，远至帕尼帕特，还曾从俾路支人手中短暂夺取木尔坦。

此后穆斯林乔希亚首领为争夺锡尔萨、法塔哈巴德和希萨尔同巴蒂人交战，在比卡内尔与帕蒂亚拉间反复倒戈，1781年金德条约划定了边境。

en:
Juru Hoton, the twin settlements recorded in Chinese as Shuangchengzi, lay in the Suifen river valley near the Sea of Japan coast. The site was first held by the Yulou Mohe tribes and from the mid-ninth century belonged to the Balhae kingdom as Solbin-bu.

After Balhae fell it was settled by the Donghai Jurchens under Liao rule, and under the Jin dynasty it became the seat of the Supin circuit. It passed in turn to the Yuan and the Ming, which managed the coastal Jurchens through the Nurgan regional military commission.

The local Jurchens counted among the Wild Jurchens, and Nurhaci's campaigns of 1596 to 1625 brought the coast and its tribes under Later Jin rule.
zh:
双城子是汉文文献对绥芬河谷地、靠近日本海沿岸两座姊妹城的称呼，女真语称朱噜霍吞。这里最早是虞娄靺鞨的居地，9世纪中叶起成为渤海国的索尔宾部。

渤海灭亡后，辽朝治下的东海女真人居住于此，金朝时又成为速频路的治所。此后此地先后归入元朝和明朝版图，明朝通过奴儿干都指挥使司管辖滨海各部女真人。

当地人属于野人女真，1596年至1625年间努尔哈赤连年用兵，把这一带海岸和诸部纳入后金版图。

en:
Jishizhou was a border department named after the Jishi Mountains on the upper Yellow River, with its seat at present-day Xunhua in Qinghai. The Jin made the old Jishi military district a department in 1182.

It passed between the Jin and the Western Xia before the Mongols attached it to the Tufan Pacification Commission in Amdo. Under the Yuan the Salar chief Ghalem, whose clansmen had migrated from Samarkand to the Xunhua valley, was made its darughachi.

In 1371 the Ming converted it into the Jishizhou battalion under the Hezhou Guard, and in 1373 Ghalem's grandson Han Bao was confirmed as hereditary centurion, founding a native officer line continued under the Qing as an external tusi. The Jishi pass above the Yellow River remained a guarded gate between Gansu and the Tibetan plateau.
zh:
积石州是黄河上游以积石山得名的边州，治所在今青海循化。金朝在1182年升积石军为州。

此地曾在金朝与西夏之间易手，蒙古时期划归安多的吐蕃等处宣慰司。元代，率部从撒马尔罕迁到循化河谷的撒拉尔首领尕勒莽被任为当地达鲁花赤。

1371年明朝改置积石州千户所，隶属河州卫；1373年尕勒莽之孙韩宝被授世袭百户，开创的土官世系在清代作为外委土司延续。黄河边的积石关始终是甘肃与青藏高原之间的要隘。

en:
Jejakabhukti was the old name of the Chandela kingdom in Bundelkhand, by 1337 reduced to two disconnected strongholds, Kalinjar and Mahoba. The Chandela Rajputs began around 831 as small Khajuraho chiefs, vassals of the Gurjara-Pratiharas, and the country was named Jejakabhukti after the ruler Jayashakti.

Under Yashovarman and Dhanga in the tenth century they became sovereign, and under Vidyadhara they were the strongest power in northern India, building the Hindu and Jain temples of Khajuraho. Raids by Ghaznavids and Ghurids eroded their power, and Paramardi, their last strong king, lost Mahoba to Prithviraj Chauhan and then submitted to Qutb al-Din Aibak in 1202.

Later kings such as Viravarman II no longer dared take imperial titles, hemmed in by rising Bundelas and other clans. A branch held Kalinjar until its ruler fell fighting Sher Shah Suri in 1545, while the Mahoba line married Princess Durgavati into the Gond house of Mandla.
zh:
杰贾卡布克提是本德尔肯德昌德拉王国的旧称，1337年仅剩卡林贾尔、马霍巴两块互不相连的据点。昌德拉拉杰普特人约在831年起于克久拉霍一带，本是瞿折罗-普罗蒂诃罗藩属，国名取自首领阇耶沙克提。

10世纪亚绍瓦尔曼和丹加治下成为主权国家，维迪亚达拉时称雄北印，克久拉霍印度教与耆那教神庙群建于此时。伽色尼、古尔入侵不断削弱国力，末代强君帕马尔迪先失马霍巴于普里特维拉杰·乔汉，又于1202年向库特布丁·艾伊拜克屈服。

毗罗跋摩二世等君主不再敢称帝号，受兴起的班德拉等族挤压。昌德拉一支固守卡林贾尔，首领1545年与舍尔沙·苏利作战被杀；马霍巴一支将公主杜尔加瓦蒂嫁入门德拉贡德王室。

en:
The Jauni Kurban were a Mongol Oirat tribe that, in the disintegration of the Ilkhanate, held the Khorasan city of Nishapur under their chief Arghun Shah. As lieutenant of Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür he shaped the affairs of eastern Iran: in 1337 he executed the Khurasan governor Shaykh 'Ali Qushji, then helped Togha Temür destroy the Jalayirid governor Muhammad-i Mulai.

Rivalry with Sarbadars went badly at first: in 1340 Arghun Shah had to abandon Nishapur and fall back on Tus. After his death his successor Muhammad Beg dropped the alliance with Togha Temür and made terms with the Sarbadars; the tribe later gave refuge to the fleeing Amir Vali of Astarabad in 1353 and to persecuted Sarbadar dervishes.

Around 1381 the tribe was forced to submit to Timur, and in 1389 its chief Hajji Beg raised a revolt at Tus, which the Timurids put down. Its ruling line was called the Arghunids, a name later borne by a Turko-Mongol dynasty that ruled Kandahar and Sindh between 1479 and 1554.
zh:
札兀尼·库尔班是蒙古瓦剌部落，伊儿汗国瓦解时据呼罗珊古城内沙布尔，首领阿儿浑沙。他作为伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的副手左右伊朗东部局势：1337年处死呼罗珊长官谢赫·阿里·库什吉，又助脱合帖木儿灭札剌亦儿长官穆罕默德·穆莱。

与萨尔巴达尔为敌却起初不利，1340年阿儿浑沙被迫弃内沙布尔，退守图斯。他死后继任者穆罕默德·别克弃脱合帖木儿同盟，转与萨尔巴达尔人和解；1353年部落收容出逃的阿斯塔拉巴德阿米尔·瓦利，后来又纳受迫害的萨尔巴达尔托钵僧。

约1381年被迫臣服帖木儿，1389年首领哈吉·别克于图斯反叛，遭帖木儿政权镇压。其统治家族阿儿浑氏，后来同名的突厥—蒙古王朝1479—1554年统治坎大哈、信德。

en:
Jolemark covers the corridor south-east of Lake Van, from Van and Hoşap through Albak to Zakho, whose fourteenth-century Kurdish population was chiefly Mahmudi. Originally Yazidis from Cizre and the Jazira, they rose under the Kara Koyunlu.

In 1397–1398 they took Hoşap castle; in 1406 Qara Yusuf granted Ashut and Khoshab to Shaykh Mahmud, whose son Hussain Beg, with Aq Qoyunlu backing, seized Albak from Hakkari. They ruled as Yazidi frontier lords until Hasan Beg turned Sunni around the mid-sixteenth century and won Shah Tahmasp's confirmation as Hoşap's ruler.

Old-faith clans moved north under the Kok Agha family to the Abagha plain and formed the Yazidi principality of Ezdikhan, while the Sunni branch governed from Hoşap. Sarı Süleyman Bey rebuilt Hoşap castle in 1649; Evliya Çelebi counted twelve thousand Mahmudi warriors and 120 tribes before their polity fell in 1829 to a league of neighbouring Kurdish beys.
zh:
乔勒马克是凡湖东南山地走廊，北起凡城、霍沙普，经阿尔巴克南至扎霍；14世纪居民多为马哈穆迪库尔德人，本是吉兹雷、杰济拉迁来的雅兹迪人，黑羊王朝时崛起。

1397—1398年取霍沙普城堡，1406年优素福将阿舒特和霍沙普封给谢赫·马哈茂德；其子侯赛因贝伊得白羊王朝之助，从哈卡里夺占阿尔巴克。他们以雅兹迪领主统治边地，约16世纪中哈桑贝伊改宗逊尼派，被沙阿塔赫马斯普确认为霍沙普之主。

旧信仰氏族随科克阿加家族北迁阿巴加平原，建雅兹迪国埃兹迪汗，逊尼派一支据霍沙普。萨勒·苏莱曼贝伊1649年重修城堡；埃夫利亚·切莱比统计其战士一万二千、部落120，1829年为邻近库尔德贝伊联盟所灭。

en:
Jailolo was the oldest of Maluku's four kingdoms, centered on a bay of the same name on Halmahera's west coast; its king held the title Jika ma-kolano, ruler of the bay. Tradition calls it Halmahera's strongest power c. 1250; in the 1320s Moluccan kings acknowledged its kolano as first, though Ternate soon eroded that precedence.

Islam reached King Yusuf only in the late fifteenth century; around 1515 Jailolo was still largely heathen. After 1530 Regent Katarabumi seized the throne and held a stone fort against Portuguese and Ternate forces until a siege took it in 1551; he lost his title and took poison in 1552, and Jailolo became a Ternatan sangaji lordship.

After its last vassal Doa fell in 1613, Tidore prince Nuku briefly revived it by enthroning Muhammad Arif Bila in 1796, but Dutch and Ternatan forces crushed the restoration after 1806; the last pretenders were arrested and exiled in 1832.
zh:
贾伊洛洛是摩鹿加四大王国中最古老者，立国于哈马黑拉西海岸同名海湾，君主称吉卡·马科拉诺，意为海湾之主。相传1250年前后已是哈马黑拉最强政权；1320年代四国会盟，公认其科拉诺居首，这一地位很快被特尔纳特侵蚀。

15世纪后期优素福王改宗，伊斯兰教才入宫廷；1515年前后当地大体仍信奉本土信仰。1530年后摄政卡塔拉布米夺位，倚石堡抵抗葡萄牙人与特尔纳特，1551年久围后陷落；他被夺王号，1552年服毒，贾伊洛洛作为桑贾吉领地并入特尔纳特。

末代附庸多阿1613年战死后，蒂多雷王子努库1796年拥立穆罕默德·阿里夫·比拉短暂复国，但荷兰与特尔纳特联军于1806年后扼杀复辟，最后的觊觎者1832年被捕流放。

en:
Jalore was the kingdom of the Sonagara Chauhans, a branch of the Chahamanas of Nadol. Around 1160 Kirtipala, a younger son of the Nadol line, received twelve villages and built his seat on the Sonagiri hill, site of Jalore fort.

First feudatories of the Chaulukya kings of Gujarat, the Jalore Chauhans grew independent under Udayasimha, who took Nadol and Barmer and led a Rajput confederacy against the Chaulukyas and Delhi sultan Iltutmish, losing Mandor to him in 1226. The last great king was Kanhadadeva, who ruled jointly with his father Samantasimha from 1292 and fought a long border war with Alauddin Khalji after the fall of Siwana.

In 1311 a Delhi army stormed Jalore and killed Kanhadadeva; his son Viramadeva died within days of a coronation during the siege. His stand was later celebrated in Padmanabha's 1455 epic Kanhadade Prabandha.
zh:
贾洛尔是索纳加拉乔汉人的王国，出自纳杜拉查哈马纳家族的支系。约1160年，纳杜拉一支的幼子基尔蒂波罗受封十二座村庄，在索纳吉里山——贾洛尔城堡所在地——建立治所。

贾洛尔乔汉人本是古吉拉特遮娄其诸王附庸，乌达亚辛哈时走向独立：他取纳杜尔、巴尔梅尔，联合拉杰普特诸邦对抗遮娄其与德里苏丹伊勒杜迷失，1226年失曼多尔于对方。末代名王坎哈达德瓦1292年起与父萨曼塔辛哈共同执政，锡瓦纳陷落后与阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉长期交战。

1311年德里军队强攻贾洛尔，坎哈达德瓦战死；其子维拉马提婆在围城期间加冕，不出数日身亡。他的抵抗后由帕德马纳巴1455年的史诗《坎哈达德传》传颂。

en:
Jhalawad was the Rajput kingdom of the Jhala clan in the Kathiawar plains of Gujarat. The Jhalas, Chandravanshi Rajputs from Sindh, followed Harpal Makwana into north Gujarat and founded it in 1090; descendants served the Chaulukya kings and fought the Ghurids.

Santaldev built Santalpur in 1304, and in 1337 the Jhala rana ruled the inland tract from forts on that line. After 1408 Shatrushaldev moved the capital to Mandal and revolted three times against Ahmed Shah I; in 1487 Mahmud Begada sacked Kuva, where eight queens and seven hundred and fifty women perished in the well of Kuva-no-Ker. Raidharji made Halvad capital in 1488.

At the Mughal court Rai Singh I, who ruled from 1564, is said to have killed Akbar's champion wrestler with a single blow. In 1742 Rana Rai Singh II built Dhrangadhra fort, under which name the state entered the Kathiawar Agency.
zh:
贾拉瓦德是贾拉氏族在古吉拉特卡提阿瓦平原的拉杰普特王国。贾拉人是信德月族拉杰普特，随哈尔帕尔·马卡瓦纳入古吉拉特北部，1090年建国；后裔效力遮娄其，曾抗击古尔人。

1304年桑塔尔代夫建桑塔尔布尔，1337年贾拉拉纳仍凭堡垒统辖内陆领地。1408年后沙特鲁沙尔代夫迁都曼达尔，三叛艾哈迈德沙一世；1487年马哈茂德·贝加达陷库瓦，八位王后与七百五十名妇女于库瓦之难投井殉难。1488年赖达尔吉以哈尔瓦德为新都。

莫卧儿宫廷中，1564年继位的赖·辛格一世据说一拳毙阿克巴的宫廷角力士。1742年拉纳·赖·辛格二世修筑德朗加德拉堡，后以德朗加德拉之名入卡提阿瓦代理区。

en:
The Jalayirs were a great Mongol tribe, first named in early tenth-century Chinese records and dwelling along the Kerulen and Orkhon rivers. After a failed revolt against the Khitan in 1014 they became hereditary Borjigin clients, and gave Genghis Khan foremost commanders, above all Muqali, viceroy in northern China.

A thousand Jalayir households assigned to Chagatai carried the tribe into Transoxiana; after Qazan Khan's death in 1346 they became the strongest tribal power in the northern Chagatai ulus, holding the country around Khujand. Their chief Bayazid submitted to Tughlugh Timur's 1360 invasion and was executed the next year.

A western branch followed Hulagu into Persia: Hasan Buzurg founded the Jalayirid Sultanate over Iraq and western Persia in 1336, overthrown by the Kara Koyunlu in 1432, while the Central Asian Jalayirs remained a leading Timurid clan and later entered the Kazakh, Uzbek and Khalkha nations.
zh:
札剌伊尔是蒙古大部落，最早见于10世纪初的汉文记载，游牧于克鲁伦河与鄂尔浑河流域。1014年反辽失败后沦为孛儿只斤氏的世袭属民，为成吉思汗贡献多名将领，以经略华北的主帅木华黎最著名。

一千户札剌伊尔人封给察合台，该部由此进入河中；1346年合赞汗死后，他们成为察合台兀鲁思北方最强的部落势力，据有苦盏一带。首领巴耶济德在1360年图黑鲁·帖木儿入侵时归附，次年被处死。

随旭烈兀入波斯的一支走得更远：哈散·不札儿1336年在伊拉克和西波斯建立札剌伊尔王朝，1432年被黑羊王朝推翻；留在中亚的札剌伊尔人仍是帖木儿帝国的核心部落，后融入哈萨克、乌兹别克、喀尔喀民族。

en:
Melayu was a Buddhist kingdom on eastern Sumatra's Batang Hari rivers, its port Jambi rich on river gold and spice trade. Chinese pilgrim Yijing visited in 671, and by 692 Melayu was absorbed into the Srivijayan mandala; after eleventh-century Chola raids weakened Srivijaya, the Mauli dynasty made Jambi its centre, Buddhist kings leaving the 1286 Padang Roco inscription.

In 1275 Kertanegara of Singhasari launched the Pamalayu expedition; by 1288 his generals held Jambi and Palembang, binding Melayu to Java. Mauli rajas reigned as Javanese vassals: Tribhuwanaraja until 1316, then Akarendrawarman to 1347, still reigning in 1337 from Jambi. In 1347 Queen Tribhuwana sent Mauli prince Adityawarman to rule; he moved upstream to Pagaruyung in the Minangkabau highlands, founding a new line and taking the gold trade.

When a Palembang prince sought Chinese aid to revive Srivijaya, Majapahit sacked Palembang in 1377; last Srivijayan prince Parameswara fled via Temasik to found the Malacca sultanate, while Buddhist Jambi faded as Islam spread in northern Sumatra.
zh:
末罗瑜是苏门答腊东部巴当哈里河的佛教王国，占碑港凭河运黄金与香料贸易致富。求法僧义净671年到访，到692年末罗瑜已并入室利佛逝；11世纪朱罗入侵后室利佛逝转衰，茂利王朝以占碑为中心，佛教国王留下1286年巴当罗科铭文。

1275年信诃沙里克尔塔纳加腊发动帕马拉尤远征，1288年其将领攻占占碑、巨港，末罗瑜入爪哇体系。茂利诸王为爪哇附庸：特里布瓦纳拉贾至1316年，阿卡伦德拉跋摩至1347年，1337年仍以占碑为都。1347年女王特里布瓦纳派王族阿迪蒂亚跋摩统治；他西迁米南加保高地帕加鲁永，另立新朝，掌黄金贸易。

巨港王公求中国支持复兴室利佛逝，满者伯夷1377年洗劫巨港；末代王子拜里米苏拉经淡马锡逃，建满剌加苏丹国，佛教占碑随伊斯兰教入北苏门答腊沉寂。

en:
Junagarh was the kingdom of the Chudasama Rajputs in southern Saurashtra, rulers holding Uparkot fort at Junagadh. Tradition brings it from Sindh in the late ninth century under Chudachandra; early kings fought the Chaulukyas, and Navaghana moved the capital to Junagadh and dug Navghan Kuvo and a stepwell.

Khengara succeeded his father Mahipala I in 1331 and ruled in 1337: he drove Muslim governors out of Somnath and restored the great temple. When rebel Taghan sought refuge, Delhi's Muhammad bin Tughluq took Junagadh in 1350; Khengara was released and died in 1351.

His line remained Saurashtra's strongest Hindu power until 1472, when Mahmud Begada of Gujarat defeated Mandalika III, forced his conversion and annexed the state. In 1654 the Pashtun Babi family made Junagadh their seat and declared an independent nawabi in 1730, after tributary years under the Marathas accepting British protection in 1807.
zh:
朱纳格利是珠多娑摩拉杰普特人的萨乌拉施特拉南部王国，据朱纳格特乌帕尔科特古堡。传9世纪末由朱达钱德拉率自信德迁来；早期国王与遮娄其交战，纳瓦加纳迁都朱纳格特，堡内凿纳夫甘井和阶梯井。

肯伽罗1331年继父摩希波罗一世，1337年在位，逐穆斯林长官出索姆纳特并修其大庙。叛党塔甘来投，德里穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克1350年陷朱纳格特，肯伽罗获释后于1351年卒。

后裔世为萨乌拉施特拉最强印度教政权，1472年古吉拉特马哈茂德·贝加达破末代国王曼达利卡三世，强令改宗吞并之。1654年普什图巴比家族据此立治，1730年建独立纳瓦布政权，臣事马拉塔多年，1807年受英保护。

en:
Jaintia was the Pnar hill and plains kingdom, their Mon-Khmer tongue kin to Khasi, spanning the Jaintia Hills and the country north of the Barak River in Sylhet, capital Jaintiapur. Tradition says Guhak split his realm among three sons in 630 into Jaintia, Gour and Laur; Kamarupa Brahmins settled at court; after 1120 Brahmin ministers ruled as rajas.

The Pnar Syiem Sutnga clan, source of its later kings, rose c. 1500. Dhan Manik seized Dimarua in 1618, provoking a Kachari war; an Ahom marriage rescued Jaintia, and Shaista Khan crushed its revolt against the Mughals after 1676. King Ram Singh's 1707 kidnapping of the Kachari raja brought Rudra Singha's Ahom army, which sacked Jaintiapur and briefly annexed the kingdom before a Pnar revolt restored native rule.

The British drew lime from Jaintia's quarries after 1765. Human sacrifices to Kali killed three British subjects in 1832; the Company annexed Jaintia in 1835 and pensioned its raja.
zh:
贾因蒂亚是普纳尔人山地平原王国，语近卡西语，属孟高棉语族，跨贾因蒂亚丘陵与锡尔赫特巴拉克河以北地区，都贾因蒂亚普尔。传630年古哈克三分国予三子，成贾因蒂亚、高尔、劳尔三邦；迦摩缕波婆罗门入侍，1120年后婆罗门大臣世为罗阇。

后来国王皆出普纳尔人的西姆·苏通加家族，约1500年掌权。丹·曼尼克1618年取迪马鲁阿，启卡恰尔战，赖阿洪姆联姻脱身；1676年后反莫卧儿起义为沙伊斯塔汗平。1707年国王拉姆·辛格绑卡恰尔罗阇，鲁陀罗·辛格的阿洪姆大军洗劫贾因蒂亚普尔，一度吞并王国，普纳尔人起义后恢复本族统治。

1765年后英人取贾因蒂亚石场石灰。1832年三名英国臣民被献祭迦梨，东印度公司1835年吞并该国，予罗阇年金。

en:
Joara was a Mississippian chiefdom in the foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains in present-day North Carolina. Established around 1000, it was visited by Hernando de Soto's expedition in 1540.

In 1567 Juan Pardo built Fort San Juan there; in 1568 local people killed its soldiers and burned the buildings. Joara was abandoned before English explorers reached the region in the seventeenth century.
zh:
乔阿拉是位于今北卡罗来纳州蓝岭山麓的密西西比文化酋邦，约在1000年建立。1540年，埃尔南多·德·索托的探险队到访当地。

1567年，胡安·帕尔多在此修建圣胡安堡；1568年，当地人杀死堡中士兵并焚毁建筑。17世纪英国探险者抵达这一地区之前，乔阿拉已经被废弃。

en:
Jolof was a Wolof state in what is now northern Senegal, on the earlier Serer and Soce lands between the Senegal and Gambia rivers. Wolof tradition credits its founding to Ndiadiane Ndiaye, who united the local village chiefs; for much of its early history it was a Mali vassal, matching its position in 1337.

By the later fourteenth century Jolof was independent, a loose empire whose buurba received tribute from vassal Cayor, Baol and Waalo. In 1549 the buurba Leele Fuli Fak was killed at the Battle of Danki by the lord of Cayor and the confederation collapsed; Jolof survived as an inland rump kingdom cut off from Portuguese coastal trade.

A Mauritanian marabout invasion was driven out around 1670, but long civil wars followed, and in the early nineteenth century the Trarza Moors raided Jolof for slaves until the buurba agreed to annual tribute around 1820.
zh:
乔洛夫是今塞内加尔北部的沃洛夫人国家，兴于塞内加尔河与冈比亚河之间早先塞雷尔人和索塞人的土地。沃洛夫传说把建国归于恩迪亚迪亚内·恩迪亚耶，他统一各地村庄首领；新政权早期长期为马里帝国附庸，与其1337年地位相符。

14世纪后期乔洛夫独立，发展成松散帝国，布巴（国王）受卡约尔、巴奥尔、瓦洛等附庸王国朝贡。1549年布巴利勒·富利·法克在丹基战役被卡约尔领主击杀，邦联瓦解；乔洛夫只剩内陆残存王国，被切断沿海葡萄牙贸易通道。

1670年前后毛里塔尼亚马拉布特入侵被击退，17世纪后期却陷入长期内战；19世纪初特拉扎摩尔人为掳奴屡袭乔洛夫，直到布巴约1820年同意缴纳年贡。

en:
The Jovas were an Opatan people living in rugged country in eastern Sonora and Chihuahua, with villages including Sahuaripa. They relied more on hunting and gathering than neighboring Opatan farmers.

In 1617 the Jesuit Andrés Pérez de Ribas met the Jova chief Sisibotari in the Sahuaripa valley. Some Jovas remained independent of Spanish rule in 1678; during the eighteenth century they intermarried with the Eudeve and merged with them.
zh:
霍瓦斯人是生活在索诺拉东部和奇瓦瓦崎岖山区的奥帕塔族群，萨瓦里帕是他们的村落之一。他们比邻近的奥帕塔农民更依赖狩猎和采集。

1617年，耶稣会士安德烈斯·佩雷斯·德里瓦斯在萨瓦里帕河谷会见了霍瓦斯首领西西博塔里。1678年部分霍瓦斯人仍独立于西班牙统治；18世纪他们与尤德韦人通婚并融合。

en:
Nandapur was a highland kingdom in the forested hills of western Kalinga, in southern Odisha. Silavamsa rajas ruled from Nandapur from at least the early fourteenth century, when Ganga Raja and his son Bhairava Raja held it and married into the Matsya dynasty.

Pratap Ganga Raja (d. 1443) campaigned to the Bay of Bengal in 1434, boasting he had washed his sword in the sea, but Gajapati founder Kapilendra Deva soon subdued him and made Nandapur a tributary. Jainism and Saktism flourished, as Nandapur's ruins still show.

The line ended with daughter Lilavati, whose husband Vinayak Dev founded a new dynasty; his descendant Vishwanath Dev Gajapati moved the capital to Jeypore, giving the realm its later name. It regained freedom after the Gajapati collapse of 1540, then paid tribute to Golconda's Qutb Shahi sultans until 1671 and accepted British vassalage in 1777.
zh:
嫩德布尔是西羯陵伽山林中的高地王国，在今奥里萨南部。尸罗瓦姆沙罗阇至迟14世纪初以嫩德布尔为都，甘伽·罗阇及其子拜罗婆·罗阇保有其国，并与邻近摩蹉王朝联姻。

1443年卒的波罗陀波·甘伽·罗阇1434年远征孟加拉湾，自称以海水洗剑；但旋为伽阇波蒂建立者迦毗陵德罗·提婆降服，嫩德布尔成为附庸。当时耆那教和性力派兴盛，嫩德布尔一带仍留有遗迹。

世系最后只剩女儿莉拉瓦蒂，其夫毗那夜迦·提婆开创新王朝；后裔毗湿瓦纳特·提婆·伽阇波蒂迁都杰伊布尔，此邦后称杰伊布尔王国。1540年伽阇波蒂崩溃后重获自主，向戈尔孔达库特布沙希苏丹纳贡至1671年，1777年受英国宗主权。

en:
Jaragua was a Taíno chiefdom in western Hispaniola, ruled by Bohechío at the time of the Spanish arrival. His sister Anacaona married Caonabo of neighbouring Maguana and helped arrange tribute when Bartholomew Columbus visited Jaragua.

Anacaona succeeded Bohechío around 1500 and received Taíno refugees escaping Spanish enslavement. In 1503 Governor Nicolás de Ovando came to Jaragua; Spanish troops massacred gathered chiefs, and Anacaona was taken to Santo Domingo and executed.
zh:
哈拉瓜是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西部的泰诺酋长国，西班牙人抵达时由博埃奇奥统治。他的妹妹阿纳考纳嫁给邻近马瓜纳的卡奥纳博，并在巴托洛梅·哥伦布访问哈拉瓜时协助安排贡赋。

约1500年，阿纳考纳继承博埃奇奥，收留逃避西班牙人奴役的泰诺人。1503年，总督尼古拉斯·德·奥万多来到哈拉瓜，西班牙士兵屠杀了聚集的酋长，阿纳考纳被押往圣多明各处死。

en:
The Kingdom of Jarin was one of the six Beja kingdoms described by the Arab historian al-Yaqubi in the ninth century, built on lands the Beja had seized from the declining Aksumite empire from the late 600s onward. Its ruler held the Red Sea port of Massawa and the country stretching inland to the Gash-Barka frontier, where it bordered the Baqlin kingdom.

The trading towns of Suakin and Aydhab lay within its territory but governed themselves under Egypt's protection. Gold, emeralds and other precious stones were mined across the Beja lands, with Muslim Arab merchants and miners frequenting local courts.

Captives from the interior were shipped through the Dahlak islands to the Arabian peninsula. Like the other Beja polities, Jarin was eventually absorbed into the Balaw kingdom of the later Middle Ages.
zh:
贾林王国是阿拉伯史学家雅库比9世纪记述的六个贝贾王国之一，建立在贝贾人自600年代末起从衰落的阿克苏姆帝国手中夺取的土地上。统治者掌控红海港口马萨瓦，以及向西延伸到加什-巴尔卡边缘的内陆，在那里与巴格林王国接壤。

萨瓦金和阿伊扎布两座商贸城镇位于其境内，但在埃及保护下自行治理。贝贾各地开采黄金、祖母绿和其他宝石，穆斯林阿拉伯商人和矿工往来于当地诸邦宫廷。

从内陆掳来的奴隶经达赫拉克群岛贩运到阿拉伯半岛。与其他贝贾政权一样，贾林最终在中世纪后期并入巴劳王国。

en:
The Jarwanids were an Arab dynasty of the Bani Malik clan who ruled the Bahrayn region of eastern Arabia, the oasis of al-Ahsa and the port of al-Qatif on the Persian Gulf. They seized power in the fourteenth century by driving out the Muntafiq tribesmen of their chief Sa'eed ibn Mughamis, who had come over from Basra.

Contemporaries such as Ibn Battuta and Ibn Hajar called them extreme Rafidis, and Twelver Shi'ism was openly professed: Shi'ite scholars filled the judgeships and mosques called the faithful to prayer in Shi'ite form.

Their rule was short-lived. In the early fifteenth century the Banu Uqayl Bedouins of the Jabrid clan overran the region and killed the last Jarwanid ruler in Qatif, and the Jabrids went on to dominate the whole Gulf coast until the Portuguese conquest of Bahrain in 1521.
zh:
贾尔万王朝是巴尼·马利克氏族的阿拉伯王朝，统治阿拉伯半岛东部巴林地区，即波斯湾畔哈萨绿洲与卡提夫港一带。14世纪他们赶走从巴士拉而来的赛义德·伊本·穆加米斯所率蒙塔菲格部落，夺权。

伊本·白图泰、伊本·哈杰尔等同时代人把他们称作极端的拉菲达，即否认前三任哈里发的什叶派；治下十二伊玛目派公开传播，什叶派学者出任法官等要职，清真寺也按什叶派方式唤拜。

王朝寿命不长：15世纪初贾布里德氏族的巴努·欧盖勒贝都因人攻占该地，在卡提夫杀死末代贾尔万君主；贾布里德王朝随后称霸整个波斯湾沿岸，直到1521年葡萄牙人攻占巴林。

en:
Jianshui is a walled basin town in southern Yunnan, on the road linking the Kunming region with the Red River valley. Nanzhao founded a settlement here called Huili, rendered in Chinese as Jianshui, and the Dali kingdom made it the Jianshui Commandery, a strongpoint on its southern frontier. Under the Mongols it became Jianshui Department.

In 1382 the Ming moved the seat of Lin'an Prefecture into the town, stationed the Lin'an Guard there and rebuilt its walls in brick, so the city was thereafter also known as Lin'an.

For the next five centuries it was the political, military and cultural centre of southern Yunnan; its great Confucian temple was among the largest in south China, and examination successes earned it fame as a southern heartland of Confucian letters. In 1770 the department was reduced to Jianshui County.
zh:
建水是滇南坝子城邑，地处昆明一带通往红河流域的交通要道。南诏在此筑惠历城，汉语译作建水；大理国改设建水郡，为南部边疆重镇。元代置建水州。

1382年明朝把临安府治迁到建水，又设临安卫，改建砖城，建水城因此又称临安城。

此后五百余年，它一直是滇南政治、军事与文化中心，城内孔庙为中国南方最大者之一，科举人才辈出，素有文献名邦、滇南邹鲁之称。1770年建水州降为建水县。

en: Jask, called Jashk in medieval sources, is a small port on the Makran coast facing the Gulf of Oman, whose tribal fishing harbours lay within the shadow of the Kingdom of Hormuz. In the seventeenth century it became the first English East India Company factory on the Iranian shore, opened in 1619, and the Portuguese were driven from it after a naval battle late in the 1620s.
zh: 贾斯克在中世纪文献中称贾什克，是阿曼湾畔莫克兰沿海的小港口，这一地区长期由俾路支等地方部族首领治理，沿岸渔港处在霍尔木兹王国的势力笼罩之下。17世纪，它成为英国东印度公司在伊朗海岸的第一个商站，于1619年开设；1620年代末的一场海战后，葡萄牙人被逐出该港。

en:
Jaisalmer was the Bhati Rajput kingdom of the Thar desert, Rajputana's westernmost Hindu state. The Bhatis ruled from Multan to the Punjab, but Central Asian invasions beginning with their Shahi allies' defeat in 977 drove them into Cholistan, where Rawal Devaraja built Derawar. In 1156 Rawal Jaisal, denied Ludrava, raised the Trikuta fortress and named it Jaisalmer after himself.

Wealth came from levies on caravans crossing the desert between India and the Indus lands. After the Bhatis plundered an Alauddin Khalji treasure caravan, Delhi armies besieged the fort until 1294, when the defenders performed the first jauhar: thousands of women burned themselves and the warriors rode out to die. Firuz Shah Tughluq's late-fourteenth-century siege brought a second, and a sixteenth-century ruse a half jauhar under Lunakaran.

The Bhatis held their yellow sandstone fastness until 1818, when the maharawal accepted British protection and joined the Rajputana Agency; caravan revenues dwindled as Bombay shipping replaced overland routes.
zh:
斋沙默尔是塔尔沙漠的巴蒂拉杰普特王国，拉杰普塔纳最西印度教政权。巴蒂人曾统治木尔坦至旁遮普，977年沙希盟友战败后，中亚入侵者将他们赶入乔利斯坦，拉瓦尔·提婆罗阇建德拉沃尔堡。1156年拉瓦尔·贾伊萨尔不得旧都卢德拉瓦，在特里库塔山筑堡，以己名名之。

财富来自往来印度与印度河流域的沙漠商队之税。巴蒂人劫阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉财宝商队，德里大军围攻城堡，1294年守军行第一次乔哈尔：数千女子投火，残骑赴死。14世纪末菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克围城致第二次乔哈尔；16世纪诈降计又酿成卢纳卡兰时半次乔哈尔。

巴蒂王室坚守黄色砂岩堡垒，1818年摩诃罗阇瓦尔受英国保护，入拉杰普塔纳代理区；孟买海运取代陆道后，商队收入日绌。

en:
The County of Jülich was a Lower Rhine territory on the Rur, counts documented from the early eleventh century; Gerhard III first styled himself Count of Jülich in 1081. William IV enlarged it and began long rivalry with Cologne, Walram fighting its archbishops at Worringen in 1288.

In 1337 William V held it, his brother Walram Archbishop of Cologne; Charles IV made William duke in 1356. His son William II defeated Brabant at Baesweiler in 1371; William II's son marrying the Guelders heiress briefly united the duchies until the male line failed in 1423 and Jülich passed to Berg.
