From 1521 it belonged to the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg; the ruling line's extinction in 1609 sparked a succession war settled in 1614 by the Treaty of Xanten for Palatinate-Neuburg. French occupation followed in 1794; the Congress of Vienna gave Jülich to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
于利希伯国是莱茵下游横跨鲁尔河的领地，11世纪初有伯爵记载，格哈德三世1081年首次自称于利希伯爵。威廉四世扩张领地，开启与科隆大主教的长期对抗，瓦尔拉姆1288年沃林根战役与科隆交战。

1337年威廉五世在位，弟瓦尔拉姆为科隆大主教；查理四世1356年升威廉为公爵。其子威廉二世1371年在巴斯韦勒击败布拉班特，威廉二世之子娶海尔雷女继承人，两公国一度合并，1423年男嗣断绝，于利希转入贝格。

1521年属于利希-克莱沃-贝格联合公国；1609年该支绝嗣引发继承战争，1614年《克桑滕条约》判给普法尔茨-诺伊堡。1794年法军占之，1815年维也纳会议归普鲁士。

en: The Jurmanids were a Mongol tribal polity of the old Darabjird district in southeastern Fars, centered on the city of Darab, that emerged amid the wars after the Ilkhanate's collapse. As a Mongol successor group of the fourteenth century, they kept the nomadic steppe life and old Tengrist beliefs among the surrounding Persianate Muslim states.
zh: 尤尔曼人是一个蒙古部落政权，在伊儿汗国崩溃后的混战中据有法尔斯东南部的达拉卜吉尔德地区，以古城达拉卜为中心。与14世纪其他蒙古后继势力一样，他们在周围波斯语穆斯林政权之间保持着游牧的草原生活方式和古老的腾格里信仰。

en:
Jusheri is one of the three Changbai Mountain Jurchen tribes, alongside the Neyen and the Yalu River tribe, counted among the Jianzhou Jurchens of the Ming frontier. Its people lived along the Zhuseleng, the present Erdao Jiang, in present Antu County, Jilin, hunting and farming under headmen who held Ming tribal titles.

In 1593 its chief Yuleng'e joined the Yehe-led coalition of nine tribes that marched on Nurhaci's Jianzhou, only to be routed at the Battle of Gure. Nurhaci subjugated the Jusheri settlements later that year, and the tribe was absorbed into his growing dominion and eventually the Eight Banners that became the Manchu.
zh:
朱舍里是长白山女真三部之一，与讷殷部、鸭绿江部并列，被明朝归入建州女真。其部众居住在朱色冷河（今二道江）流域，辖地在今吉林安图县境内，在持有明朝封职的首领统领下渔猎农耕。

1593年部首领裕楞额加入叶赫牵头的九部联军征讨努尔哈赤的建州，在古勒山之战中溃败。同年努尔哈赤出兵招服朱舍里各路城寨，该部被并入其日益扩张的势力，最终纳入后来构成满族的八旗之中。

en:
Yodzo Cuiya, rendered Yosocuiya in the local Mixtec spelling and meaning Plain of the Year, was a Mixtec senorio in the Mixteca Baja; Nahuatl speakers called the place Xiuxtlahuaca, or Valley of the Wind. Its kings held two hilltop seats, Ciki-ntaha and Yucuyu'gua, above the valley.

Tradition names King Two Rabbit, married to the noblewoman Eight House, among its early rulers. Another king, Xolotl, took part in the battle of 1115 in which Eight Deer Jaguar Claw was captured and sacrificed.

It was remembered as one of the oldest towns of the Oaxacan Mixteca, a prosperous senorio dominating the Juxtlahuaca valley. Dominican friars reached it in 1536, and in 1542 they refounded the settlement on the valley floor as Santiago Juxtlahuaca.
zh:
尤佐奎亚在当地纽萨维语中拼作约索奎亚，意为年度平原，是米斯特卡低地的纽萨维领主邦；纳瓦特尔语使用者称此地为休斯特拉瓦卡，意为风之谷。君主在谷地之上的奇基恩塔哈和尤库尤瓜两座山顶设治。

传说早期君主有二兔王，娶贵族女子八屋为妻。另一位君主霍洛特尔参加1115年的战役，鹿八日虎爪即在那一仗中被俘并献祭。

它被视为瓦哈卡米斯特卡最古老的城镇之一，是统辖胡斯特拉瓦卡谷地的富庶领主邦。多明我会修士1536年抵达，1542年在谷底重建聚落，命名为圣地亚哥·德·胡斯特拉瓦卡。

en:
Jawhar was a hill state in the northern Konkan, the wooded coast east of Bombay, where Koli and Varli chiefs ruled before the Muslim conquest of the Deccan. Its house began with Koli leader Jayaba Mukne, who seized Jawhar fort in 1306.

His son Dulbarrao built a domain of twenty-two forts, and in 1343 Delhi's Sultan Muhammad bin Tughlaq recognised him, giving him the name Nim Shah and a hereditary Raja title. A later raja, Deobarrao, captured by Bahmani sultan Ahmad Shah, converted to Islam to marry the sultan's daughter, but at Deobarrao's death Hindu nobles set his Muslim son aside and kept the Hindu Mukne line.

The rajas joined Shivaji's sack of Surat in 1664, but Maratha pressure steadily stripped them until by 1782 only a small hill principality remained, surviving under British overlordship as the Thana Agency's only state.
zh:
乔哈尔是北孔坎的山地小邦，在孟买以东林木茂密的沿海地带；穆斯林征服德干前，这里由科利和瓦尔利部落首领统治。统治家族始于科利首领阇耶跋·穆克内，他1306年夺取乔哈尔堡。

其子杜尔巴劳建起二十二座堡垒的领地，1343年德里苏丹穆罕默德·图格鲁克承认其地位，赐名尼姆沙赫和世袭拉贾称号。后任拉贾德奥巴劳被巴赫马尼苏丹艾哈迈德沙赫俘获，改宗伊斯兰教并娶苏丹之女；他死后印度教贵族废黜其穆斯林儿子，王位留在印度教穆克内世系。

拉贾们1664年随希瓦吉劫掠苏拉特，但马拉塔不断蚕食，到1782年只剩山间小公国，后在英国宗主权下作为塔纳专区唯一土邦存续。

en:
Kaabu was a federation of Mandinka kingdoms in Senegambia, covering what is now northeastern Guinea-Bissau, much of the Gambia valley and Casamance. It began in the 1200s as a Mali military province conquered by general Tiramakhan Traore, ruled from Kansala by the Nyancho warrior aristocracy, who kept the old non-Islamic rites and honoured the snake shrine Tamba Dibi in its sacred forest.

As Mali weakened, Kaabu's mansas went their own way, and the independent federation is conventionally dated from 1537. Mandinka was the language of rulers and trade among mixed Balanta, Bainuk, Jola and Fulbe populations, and griots call Kaabu the birthplace of the kora harp-lute.

Its expansion wars fed the Atlantic trade: by the 1600s and 1700s Kaabu captives may have made up half the Africans sold from the region. In 1776 the Torodbe clerics of Futa Djallon founded an imamate and launched a jihad against Kaabu, opening wars that wore the Nyancho state down.
zh:
卡布是塞内冈比亚的曼丁卡诸王国联邦，地当今几内亚比绍东北部、冈比亚河谷大部和卡萨芒斯一带。它13世纪作为马里帝国军事行省兴起，由将领蒂拉马汉·特拉奥雷征服，以坎萨拉为中心，尼安乔武士贵族统治，保留旧有非伊斯兰仪礼，崇奉圣林中的蛇神坦巴·迪比。

马里衰落后，卡布的曼萨们自行其是，独立联邦通常以1537年为起点。巴兰塔、拜努克、乔拉、富尔贝等族群混居，曼丁卡语是统治者与贸易用语；格里奥把卡布视为科拉琴诞生地。

扩张战争滋养大西洋贸易：17至18世纪卡布俘获的奴隶可能占当地被卖非洲人的一半。1776年富塔贾隆托罗德贝僧侣建伊玛目国，向卡布发动圣战，开启拖垮尼安乔政权的战争。

en:
The Kam lived around the meeting point of Guizhou, Hunan and Guangxi in southern China. Ming sources recorded them as Dong, and Kam communities rose in several rebellions against Ming and Qing rule.

In 1378 Wu Mian led Kam, Miao and Han people in revolt near Liping. He rose again in 1385, took the title of king and occupied places including Liping and Tongdao, before Ming forces captured and executed him.
zh:
侗人居住在中国南方贵州、湖南和广西交界一带。明代文献记载了侗人，侗人聚居区在明清时期多次发生起义。

1378年，吴勉在黎平一带率侗、苗、汉等族起义。1385年他再次举兵称王，攻占黎平、通道等地，随后被明军俘杀。

en:
The Kagawa were a Japanese warrior family with branches in Aki and Sanuki. The Aki branch held Yagi Castle and served the Takeda of Aki before entering Mōri service.

In 1533 Kagawa Mitsukage fought the Kumagai on the Takeda's orders. As the Takeda house fractured over its succession, a rival faction attacked Mitsukage at Yagi; he repelled it with Kumagai support and later served the Mōri.
zh:
香川氏是日本武家，在安艺和赞岐都有支系。安艺一支以八木城为据点，先侍奉安艺武田氏，后来转而效力毛利氏。

1533年，香川光景奉武田氏之命与熊谷氏交战。武田家因继承问题分裂时，敌对派系进攻光景的八木城；光景得到熊谷氏援助，将其击退，后来成为毛利家臣。

en: The Kel Adagh were a confederation of Tuareg clans in the Adrar des Iforas highlands of present-day Mali. Their name means people of the mountains in Tamasheq, and their constituent groups included noble lineages and tributary tribes.
zh: 凯尔阿达是今马里伊福加斯高地的图阿雷格氏族联盟。其名称在塔马舍克语中意为山地之人，联盟由贵族谱系及其附属部族组成。

en:
Kaitag, known as Utsmiate or Khaidak, was the Kaitag Dargins' state in south-eastern Dagestan, between Derbent and Tarki Shamkhalate. Arab geographers counted it one of Dagestan's three provinces in the tenth century; its mountaineers briefly took Derbent's citadel in 1040.

Its utsmi ruled from Kala-Koreish fortress on the Derbent caravan road; trade enriched the state, which built a congregational mosque in the twelfth century. It weathered the 1239–1240 Mongol invasion, but as a Golden Horde ally it was devastated by Timur in the late fourteenth century, and metalworking Zirikhgeran, present-day Kubachi, broke away free.

Utsmi Alilbek rebuilt the lowlands and married his sister to the Shirvanshah; the court moved to Madzhalis in the sixteenth century. Kaitag bloodied Nader Shah's army in 1735 and played Russian and Persian empires off until the Russian government deposed last utsmi Adil Khan and abolished the title in 1820.
zh:
凯塔格又称乌茨米领地、海达克，是凯塔格达尔金人在达吉斯坦东南山原的政权，在杰尔宾特与塔尔基沙姆哈尔之间。10世纪阿拉伯地理学家列其为达吉斯坦三省之一，1040年山民一度攻占杰尔宾特内城。

统治者称乌茨米，都卡拉-科雷什堡，扼杰尔宾特商路，以贸易致富，12世纪建聚礼清真寺。它挺过1239—1240年蒙古入侵，却因结盟金帐汗国于14世纪末遭帖木儿重创，金属工艺城济里赫格兰（今库巴奇）此后脱离为自由公社。

乌茨米阿利尔别克重建低地，嫁妹于希尔万沙，16世纪宫廷迁马贾利斯。凯塔格1735年重创纳迪尔沙军，长期周旋俄波之间，1820年俄罗斯废末代乌茨米阿季勒汗，称号亦废。

en:
Kale, whose chief town survives as Kalay on the Myittha River, was the southernmost of the three Shan principalities of the Kale–Kabaw valley, west of the Chindwin by the Chin Hills and the Manipur frontier. Local tradition dates its founding to 966, and its original settlers were Shans.

When the Manipur king and the ruler of Pong overran and divided neighbouring chiefdoms around 1470, Kale kept its independence for a time. It was a frequent target of expanding Möng Yang, whose raids reached the Kale and Kabaw valleys from the 1370s to the 1470s.

Kale later joined the Shan confederation against the Toungoo dynasty, marching on Prome in 1543. Bayinnaung's campaigns of 1556–1559 brought Kalay under Burmese suzerainty with the rest of the Shan states, ending its career as an independent principality.
zh:
格礼首邑在米达河畔，即今格礼城，是格礼—格包河谷三个掸人邦国中最南者，地处钦敦江以西，紧邻钦山与曼尼普尔边境。当地传说建城于966年，最早居民为掸人。

1470年前后曼尼普尔国王与蓬国君主攻灭瓜分邻近酋邦，格礼一度保住独立。它屡遭扩张的孟养侵扰，14世纪70年代至15世纪70年代孟养兵锋多次深入格礼与格包谷地。

格礼后又加入对抗东吁王朝的掸邦联盟，1543年出兵卑谬。勃印曩1556—1559年的征战把格礼与其他掸邦置于缅甸宗主权下，这个独立邦国就此终结。

en:
The Kingdom of Kaimana, also called Sran, was one of the oldest polities of West Papua, traditionally founded in 1309 by Imaga, who bore the title Rat Sran Nati Pattimuni. Drawing followers from Pattimunin lands around the Kumawa Mountains, he bound coastal villages and tribes by marriage and custom, ruling from Weri on the Fakfak coast.

His son Basir Onin moved the court to Borombouw on Adi Island, better placed for the spice and bird-of-paradise trade, and under King Woran the realm grew wealthy; Javanese tradition holds Gajah Mada visited the palace, and the Negarakertagama lists Sran among Majapahit's tributaries.

Tidore fleets subdued the kingdom around 1498, imposing tribute in slaves, spices and birds of paradise, and the royal family embraced Islam in the sixteenth century. In 1808 Rat Sran IV, Nduvin, moved the capital to E'man, site of present Kaimana.
zh:
凯马纳王国又称斯兰王国，是西巴布亚最古老的政权之一，相传1309年由伊马加建立，号称拉特·斯兰·纳蒂·帕蒂穆尼。他以库马瓦山区帕蒂穆宁之地为根基，以联姻和习俗联合沿海村社部落，以法克法克海岸的韦里为都。

其子巴西尔·翁宁把宫廷迁至阿迪岛博龙布，此处更利于香料和天堂鸟贸易；沃兰王时国势兴盛，爪哇传说称加查·马达曾造访宫殿，《爪哇史颂》把斯兰列为满者伯夷朝贡国。

约1498年蒂多尔战船征服此邦，强征奴隶、香料和天堂鸟为贡，王室16世纪皈依伊斯兰教。1808年第四代拉特·斯兰恩杜温迁都埃曼，即今凯马纳镇所在。

en:
Kano was the mightiest of the seven Hausa city-states, on the savanna south of the Sahel in northern Nigeria. It grew up around Dala Hill, site of an iron-working shrine to the goddess Tsumburbura. The Kano Chronicle names Bagauda its first king in 999, and Gijimasu began the city walls in 1095.

Islam reached Kano with trans-Saharan merchants, and in the 1100s King Ali Yaji abandoned the old cult and took the title of sultan. Its golden age came under Muhammad Rumfa (1463 to 1499): pressed by the Songhai, he married a daughter of Askia the Great, laid out the Kurmi market and invited Qur'anic scholars.

Habe rule ended in the Fulani jihad: in 1805 the last sultan fell and Kano became the richest emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate, its dyed cloth and leather carried to Tripoli and Timbuktu.
zh:
卡诺是豪萨七城邦中最强盛的一个，位于尼日利亚北部、萨赫勒以南的草原上。城市围绕达拉山兴起，山上有供奉女神聪布拉的冶铁神龛。《卡诺编年史》称巴高达于999年成为第一代国王，吉吉马苏于1095年开始修筑城墙。

伊斯兰教随跨撒哈拉商人传入卡诺，12世纪国王阿里·亚吉放弃旧神崇拜，自称苏丹。卡诺的黄金时代在穆罕默德·鲁姆法治下（1463—1499年）：迫于桑海的压力，他娶了阿斯基亚大帝的女儿，开辟库尔米市场，延揽古兰经学者。

哈贝诸王的统治终结于富拉尼圣战：1805年末代苏丹败亡，卡诺成为索科托哈里发国最富庶的埃米尔国，染布和皮革远销的黎波里和廷巴克图。

en:
The Kaqchikel are a Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands whose language belongs to the Quichean branch. For generations they were allies and subjects of the K'iche'; around 1430 their elites were allowed to build their first capital at Chi Awär.

As their power grew, friction forced them to flee, and in about 1470 they founded Iximche, the maize-tree city, on a ridge ringed by ravines, ruled by four clan lords. They defeated their former K'iche' overlords around 1491.

After news of the fall of Tenochtitlán arrived, Iximche courted a Spanish alliance, and in 1524 Pedro de Alvarado was welcomed; Iximche became the first Spanish capital of Guatemala. Tribute soon drove the Kaqchikel to revolt: they abandoned the city, which was burned in 1526, and held out in the hills until their surrender in 1530. Their account survives in the Annals of the Cakchiquels.
zh:
卡克奇克尔人是危地马拉高地的玛雅民族，语言属基切语支。他们长期是基切人的盟友与臣属，约1430年其精英获准兴建第一座都城奇阿瓦尔。

随着势力壮大，摩擦迫使他们出走；约1470年，他们在四围深谷的山脊上建立伊希姆切，城名意为“玉米树”，由四位氏族首领共治。约1491年，他们大败昔日宗主基切人。

特诺奇蒂特兰陷落的消息传来后，伊希姆切向西班牙人求取盟约；1524年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多受到欢迎，伊希姆切成为西属危地马拉第一个首府。沉重的贡赋很快逼卡克奇克尔人起义：他们弃城而去，城市于1526年被焚毁，他们在山中坚持到1530年投降。他们的记载保存在《卡克奇克尔编年史》中。

en:
The Karamanids were an Oghuz dynasty of the Salur tribe whose ancestors, fleeing the Mongol invasion, migrated to Sivas around 1230, settling in the western Taurus as Seljuk clients. Karaman Bey built a lordship in Cilicia; the Seljuks granted him Larende, later renamed Karaman in his honour. His son Mehmet Bey seized Konya in 1277 and enthroned the pretender Jimri, before being executed in 1278.

Backed at times by the Egyptian Mamluks, they twice more occupied Konya early in the fourteenth century; the collapse of Ilkhanid rule in the 1330s let them make it their capital, and in 1337 the throne belonged to Alâeddin Halil Bey. His successor married Nefise Hatun, Murad I's daughter, but the marriage gave way to rivalry as Ottoman power grew.

Karamanid princes raided Bursa after 1402 and sacked Ankara and Kütahya during the Crusade of Varna, yet the Ottomans gained the upper hand and in 1487 annexed the lands into the Karaman Eyalet. The dynasty left more than sixty mosques and medreses in Konya and Karaman.
zh:
卡拉曼王朝出自乌古斯萨鲁尔部落，祖先为躲避蒙古入侵，约于1230年迁至锡瓦斯，后在西托罗斯山区定居，成为塞尔柱臣属。卡拉曼贝伊在奇里乞亚建立统治，塞尔柱人将拉伦德封给他，该城后来为纪念他改名卡拉曼。其子穆罕默德贝伊于1277年攻占科尼亚，拥立僭位者吉姆里，1278年被处死。

在埃及马穆鲁克的不时支援下，卡拉曼人14世纪初又两度占领科尼亚；14世纪30年代伊利汗国统治崩溃，遂以科尼亚为都，1337年在位的是阿拉丁·哈利勒贝伊。其后继者迎娶奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德一世之女内菲塞哈屯，但随着奥斯曼势力崛起，联姻转为对抗。

1402年之后，卡拉曼王公洗劫布尔萨，瓦尔纳十字军期间又劫掠安卡拉和屈塔希亚。然而奥斯曼逐渐占了上风，于1487年吞并其土地，设立卡拉曼行省。该王朝在科尼亚和卡拉曼留下六十余座清真寺和经学院。

en:
The Principality of Kashin was an appanage of the Tver princes, centered on Kashin on the Kashinka, a Volga tributary. The town first appeared in chronicles in 1238, when it was sacked in the Mongol invasion. In 1319 the sons of Mikhail of Tver, executed at the Golden Horde, divided his lands; the youngest, Vasily Mikhailovich, received Kashin.

Vasily, senior prince of the dynasty, disputed the Tver grand-princely table with his nephews in the 1340s, and held it for a time after the khan's patent of 1348. Driven back to Kashin in 1365, he fought Tver with Muscovite backing; from 1375 Kashin was independent of Tver until its childless prince died in 1382.

A second line of princes ruled from 1399 to 1426, after which the appanage reverted to Tver. Kashin withstood a siege by the rebel Dmitry Shemyaka in 1452, and passed to Moscow with the rest of Tver in 1486.
zh:
卡申公国是特维尔王公的封邑，中心在伏尔加河支流卡申卡河畔的卡申城。史载1238年卡申在蒙古入侵中遭洗劫。1319年，在金帐汗国被处死的特维尔王公米哈伊尔诸子瓜分领地，幼子瓦西里·米哈伊洛维奇分得卡申。

瓦西里是王族最年长的王公，14世纪40年代与侄子争夺特维尔大公之位，1348年取得汗廷诰命后一度入主。1365年他被逐回卡申，在莫斯科支持下与特维尔作战；1375年卡申独立，至1382年王公绝嗣。

1399—1426年第二支王公统治此地，之后封邑重归特维尔；1452年顶住德米特里·舍米亚卡围攻，1486年随特维尔并入莫斯科。

en:
Kauaʻi is the oldest and northwesternmost of the main Hawaiian Islands; its high chiefs, the aliʻi nui, also ruled Niʻihau. Dynasties claimed descent from Wākea; after the last Puna chief fell the island passed for a time to Kualiʻi of Oʻahu.

In 1778 Captain Cook anchored in Waimea Bay, the first recorded European contact in the islands. Kauaʻi was the only major island Kamehameha I never took by force: storms scattered his fleet in 1796 and a second attempt was abandoned during an epidemic, so in 1810 the aliʻi nui Kaumualiʻi agreed to become his vassal and will his lands to the Hawaiian crown.

In 1821 the regent Kaʻahumanu took him to Honolulu; after his death in 1824 his son Humehume failed to restore independence. In 1835 Hawaiʻi's first sugarcane plantation opened at Kōloa, beginning Kauaʻi's plantation era.
zh:
考爱是夏威夷主要岛屿中最古老、最靠西北者，最高酋长阿利伊努伊还统治尼豪岛。历代王朝自称天神瓦凯亚后裔；末代普纳酋长倒台后，考爱一度落入瓦胡的库阿利伊之手。

1778年库克船长停泊威美亚湾，考爱成为夏威夷首个与欧洲人有记录接触之地。它也是卡美哈梅哈一世唯一未能武力征服的大岛：1796年入侵舰队被风暴打散，第二次尝试因瘟疫取消；1810年阿利伊努伊考穆阿利伊同意成为附庸，许诺死后将土地归还夏威夷王室。

1821年摄政卡阿胡玛努将他带往檀香山；1824年他死后，其子胡梅胡梅恢复独立失败。1835年夏威夷首家甘蔗种植园在科洛阿开办，开启种植园时代。

en: The Kaw, or Kanza, were a Dhegiha-speaking people of the Missouri River region. In 1724 the French explorer Bourgmont visited their large village near present-day Doniphan, Kansas. By the late eighteenth century they had moved their main village to the Kansas River, closer to the bison they hunted and to the Pawnee, with whom they often fought.
zh: 坎扎人是密苏里河地区讲德吉哈语的族群。1724年，法国探险者布尔蒙造访了他们在今堪萨斯州多尼芬附近的大村庄。到18世纪末，坎扎人将主要村庄迁至堪萨斯河畔，离猎取野牛的地方更近，也更接近经常与他们交战的波尼人。

en:
The Kel Ayr were a semi-nomadic Tuareg confederation centred on the Air Mountains in present-day Niger. They controlled farming and trading settlements including Assode, Agadez and In-Gall, and helped establish the Sultanate of Agadez around 1405.

Songhai seized Agadez in 1500, but lost it before the century ended. In 1740 the Kel Owey destroyed Assode and sacked Agadez, dispersing the Kel Ayr south and west and placing them under Kel Owey overlordship.
zh:
凯尔艾尔是以今尼日尔艾尔山脉为中心的半游牧图阿雷格部族联盟。他们控制阿索代、阿加德兹和因加尔等农业与贸易聚落，并参与建立约1405年兴起的阿加德兹苏丹国。

桑海于1500年夺取阿加德兹，但在该世纪结束前失去控制。1740年，凯尔奥韦人摧毁阿索代、劫掠阿加德兹，将凯尔艾尔人驱散到南方和西方，并使其臣服。

en:
The Kazakh Khanate was a nomadic state of the Central Asian steppe, founded around 1465 amid the fragmentation of the Golden Horde. Under Kasym Khan in the sixteenth century, its authority extended from southeastern Kazakhstan to the Ural Mountains. After Tauke Khan's death in the early eighteenth century, the three Kazakh zhuzes became effectively separate khanates.

Ablai Khan fought the Dzungars and sought to reunite the Kazakhs while navigating relations with Russia and Qing China. After his death in 1781 the khanate fractured again; Russian statutes abolished the khanate in 1822–1824.
zh:
哈萨克汗国是中亚草原上的游牧政权，约于1465年在金帐汗国分裂之际建立。16世纪卡西姆汗统治下，汗国的权势从今哈萨克斯坦东南部延伸至乌拉尔山脉。18世纪初陶克汗去世后，哈萨克的三个玉兹实际上成为各自独立的汗国。

阿布赉汗与准噶尔作战，寻求重新统一哈萨克人，同时周旋于俄国和清朝之间。他于1781年去世后汗国再次分裂；俄国在1822—1824年通过法令废除了汗国制度。

en:
The Kubadids were a Turkmen emirate of the Canik group on the middle Black Sea coast around Samsun. Founded around 1318 by Tâceddin Altunbaş, son of Seljuk sultan Mesud II, their name Kubadoğulları, sons of Kubad, claimed Seljuk blood.

In 1337 Altunbaş reigned as a nominal tributary of the Eretnids; after his death in 1357 his son and grandson ruled in turn. Samsun drew the dynasty into repeated conflict with the Ottomans: Bayezid I annexed the port in 1398, but the Ottoman defeat at Ankara in 1402 allowed the Kubadids to return.

Cüneyd Bey retook Samsun in 1414, but was soon murdered in a local feud. When his son Hüseyin seized it again in 1422, the Ottomans crushed the Turkmen lords and he surrendered at Amasya. With the Kubadids, the last line claiming Seljuk descent disappeared from Anatolian politics.
zh:
库巴德是卡尼克贝伊国之一，突厥蛮人所建，领有黑海中部沿岸萨姆松一带。约1318年罗姆塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世之子塔杰丁·阿尔通巴什建国；库巴德奥卢意为库巴德之子，名号即宣称塞尔柱血统。

1337年阿尔通巴什在位，名义上向埃尔特纳纳贡；1357年他死后子孙相继继位。萨姆松之争使该王朝与奥斯曼反复冲突：巴耶济德一世1398年吞并该港，1402年安卡拉战败后库巴德人卷土重来。

居内伊德贝伊1414年夺回萨姆松，很快在地方仇杀中遇害。1422年其子侯赛因再占该城，奥斯曼镇压突厥蛮首领，他在阿马西亚投降。库巴德覆灭，宣称塞尔柱血统的最后一支家族退出安纳托利亚政坛。

en:
The Kobayakawa were a warrior family whose lands in Aki province grew from the stewardship of Numata estate granted in the early Kamakura period. The family later split into Numata and Takehara branches.

In 1544 Kobayakawa Takakage, a son of Mōri Motonari, became head of the Takehara branch and later succeeded to Numata as well. He helped expand Mōri power and served among Toyotomi Hideyoshi's five elders. His adopted heir Hideaki joined the eastern army at Sekigahara in 1600, but died without an heir.
zh:
小早川氏是日本的武家，镰仓时代初期获得安艺国沼田庄的地头职，逐渐在当地壮大。家族后来分为沼田和竹原两支。

1544年，毛利元就之子小早川隆景成为竹原一支的家主，后来又继承了沼田一支。他协助扩张毛利氏势力，并在丰臣秀吉政权中担任五大老之一。养子秀秋在1600年关原之战中倒向东军，后来去世，没有留下继承人。

en:
Kubuna was a Fijian chiefly confederacy centred on Bau, an island off eastern Viti Levu. Naulivou became Vunivalu of Bau in 1791; firearms later helped him strengthen Bau's power.

Rivalry among the chiefly houses led to the exile of his successor Tanoa. In 1837 Tanoa's son Seru Cakobau overthrew the ruling faction and restored his father to power on Bau.
zh:
库布纳是斐济的一个酋长联盟，中心位于维提岛东岸的姆巴乌岛。瑙利武于1791年成为姆巴乌的武尼瓦卢酋长，火器后来帮助他增强了姆巴乌的力量。

酋长家族之间的争斗导致他的继任者塔诺阿流亡。1837年，塔诺阿之子塞鲁·萨孔巴乌推翻了姆巴乌的执政派系，恢复了父亲的统治。

en:
Kanem was an empire of the Chad Basin, ruled from Njimi northeast of Lake Chad by kings titled mai. It took shape around 700 under the Duguwa, grew rich on trans-Saharan trade in salt, ivory and slaves, and converted to Islam in the eleventh century, when the Sayfawa replaced the Duguwa.

Thirteenth-century mai Dunama II Dibalemi brought Kanem to its zenith, fielding some forty thousand cavalry and holding Saharan trade routes. Fourteenth-century conflict with the Bilala cost the Sayfawa their homeland: Umar I Idrismi withdrew the court west to tributary Bornu; a century of instability ended when Ali I Gaji founded new capital Ngazargamu.

Idris III Katagarmabe later reconquered Kanem, and late in the sixteenth century Idris IV Alooma raised the renamed Kanem-Bornu to its greatest power, importing firearms with Ottoman advice and organising camel corps and fortified camps. Slow decline followed; early-nineteenth-century Fula jihads shattered the state, and the Sayfawa were supplanted by the al-Kanemi dynasty ruling as shehu.
zh:
加奈姆是乍得盆地帝国，以乍得湖东北恩吉米为都，君主称马伊。约700年杜古瓦王朝立国，靠食盐、象牙、奴隶的跨撒哈拉贸易致富，11世纪皈依伊斯兰教，赛法瓦王朝随之取代杜古瓦。

13世纪马伊杜纳马二世·迪巴莱米把加奈姆推向鼎盛，能出动约四万骑兵，控制撒哈拉商路。14世纪与比拉拉人的冲突使赛法瓦丧失故土：乌马尔一世·伊德里斯米把朝廷西迁附庸博尔努，百年动荡直到阿里一世·加吉建新都恩加扎尔加穆才结束。

伊德里斯三世·卡塔加尔马贝后来收复加奈姆；16世纪末伊德里斯四世·阿卢马在奥斯曼顾问协助下引进火器，编组骆驼部队、修筑设防营地，把更名后的加奈姆-博尔努带上顶峰。此后缓慢衰落，19世纪初富拉尼圣战瓦解旧邦，赛法瓦被以谢胡为号的卡奈米王朝取代。

en:
Kabura was a sultanate of the Inner Niger Delta, lying along the river upstream of its neighbour Zagha in the Macina floodplain; modern scholars identify its site with Diafarabé or Kaara opposite Kokry. Like Zagha it was ruled by a sultan who held his land as a vassal of the Mansa of Mali.

The delta had drawn Fulani pastoralists since the 1200s, and around 1400 a clan led by Maghani, migrating from Termess in Kaniaga, was allowed to settle between Mema and the Niger and gave the region its ruling line.

The country later paid tribute to Songhai, to the Moroccan pashas of Timbuktu and, from the early 1700s, to Biton Coulibaly's Bambara empire of Ségou, before the Fulani jihad of 1818 overthrew the old sultanate and set up the caliphate of Hamdullahi.
zh:
卡布拉是尼日尔河内陆三角洲的苏丹国，地处马西纳洪泛平原，在邻邦扎加上游的河畔；后世学者将其地望比定为迪亚法拉贝或科克里对岸的卡拉。它和扎加一样由苏丹统治，作为马里曼萨的附庸领有其地。

13世纪起，富拉尼牧民陆续进入三角洲；约1400年，马加尼率领一支来自卡尼亚加泰尔梅斯的氏族获准在梅马与尼日尔河之间定居，成为当地统治世系的源头。

此后这方土地先后向桑海、廷巴克图的摩洛哥帕夏，以及18世纪初塞古的比顿·库利巴利的班巴拉帝国纳贡，直到1818年富拉尼圣战推翻旧苏丹国，建立哈姆杜拉希哈里发国。

en:
The Principality of Karachev was a large appanage of the upper Desna, split from Chernihiv after Prince Mikhail of Chernihiv died in the Horde in 1246, when tradition gives it to his son Mstislav Mikhailovich. Besides Karachev itself it counted more than a dozen towns, among them Kozelsk, Bolkhov, Zvenigorod and Mosalsk, though in the fourteenth century Zvenigorod and Kozelsk broke away as separate principalities.

In 1310 Prince Vasily of Bryansk, backed by Horde troops, attacked Karachev and killed its prince Svyatoslav Mstislavich; reliable chronicles otherwise name a Karachev prince only in 1383. Around 1360, soon after Lithuania took Bryansk, the Grand Duchy annexed Karachev, its princes entering Lithuanian service as vassals.

In 1493 the Lithuanian ruler granted Karachev and most of the Chernihiv-Severian country to Prince Semyon of Mozhaysk, who in 1500 went over to Ivan III with all his lands, bringing Karachev into the Muscovite state.
zh:
卡拉切夫公国是杰斯纳河上游的大封邑，1246年切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔在金帐汗国被杀后分立，传统说法称分给其子姆斯季斯拉夫·米哈伊洛维奇。除本城还领有科泽利斯克、博尔霍夫、兹韦尼哥罗德、马萨尔斯克等十余城镇，但14世纪兹韦尼哥罗德和科泽利斯克先后分立。

1310年布良斯克王公瓦西里在金帐汗国军队支持下进攻卡拉切夫，杀死王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇；除此之外可靠编年史直到1383年才提到一位卡拉切夫王公。1360年前后立陶宛攻占布良斯克后不久，卡拉切夫被立陶宛大公国吞并，当地王公作为附庸转效力立陶宛。

1493年立陶宛君主把卡拉切夫和切尔尼戈夫-谢韦里亚大部土地封给莫扎伊斯克王公谢苗；1500年谢苗率全部领地转投伊凡三世，卡拉切夫并入莫斯科国家。

en:
Khachen was the Armenian mountain stronghold of Artsakh in the highlands of Karabakh, princes keeping autonomy through centuries of foreign overlordship. After the loss of Ani in 1045 and Seljuk victory at Manzikert in 1071 brought down the Bagratid kingdom, Khachen remained among the last Armenian-ruled lands. In 1214 Hasan-Jalal Dawla founded the Hasan-Jalalyan dynasty, and two years later work began on the Gandzasar monastery, later its mausoleum.

From fortified valleys the Hasan-Jalalyans weathered the Mongol conquest, keeping their title under Ilkhanid and later Safavid suzerainty. In the late sixteenth century the dynasty branched into the melikdoms of Gulistan and Jraberd, which joined Khachen, Varanda and Dizak as the Five Melikdoms.

In 1711 the meliks sent envoys to Peter the Great for Russian protection. Persia's Karabakh Khanate (1750) curbed their autonomy; Russian rule in 1805 ended the old order, and Khachen's last melik, Allahverdi II, died in 1813.
zh:
哈琴是阿尔察赫的亚美尼亚山地据点，地处卡拉巴赫高原，王公在外族数百年宗主权下保持自治。1045年阿尼陷落、1071年曼齐刻尔特战败后，巴格拉提德王国灭亡，哈琴仍是仅存的亚美尼亚王公统治之地之一。1214年哈桑-贾拉勒·道莱建哈桑-贾拉良王朝，两年后动工修建甘扎萨尔修道院，后来成为王朝陵寝。

家族凭险谷施行统治，熬过蒙古征服，在伊儿汗国与萨法维宗主权下保留王公名号。16世纪末王朝分出古利斯坦和日拉别尔德两个梅利克领地，与哈琴、瓦兰达和迪扎克合称“五王公”。

梅利克于1711年派使者出使彼得大帝求俄国保护。波斯1750年设卡拉巴赫汗国削其自治，1805年俄国接管，旧秩序终结，哈琴末代梅利克阿拉韦尔迪二世1813年去世。

en:
Kabardia, or Eastern Circassia, was the land of the Kabardians, easternmost of the Circassian peoples, between the Kuban and Terek. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries Adyghe clans pushed east after Timur's 1395 defeat of the Golden Horde khan Tokhtamysh, driving the Alans into the gorges. Its princely houses claimed descent from the legendary Inal the Great; the princedom took shape by the mid-fifteenth century.

In the following century Grand Prince Temryuk sought Muscovy's help against the Crimean Khanate: an embassy reached Moscow in 1557, and in 1561 Ivan IV married his daughter Maria Temryukovna. Princely factions split Kabardia into Greater and Lesser Kabardia, shifting between Russian, Crimean and Ottoman allegiance, as Christianity yielded to Islam.

Russian pressure mounted in the eighteenth century; after plague in 1803 to 1811 and Yermolov's campaigns of 1816 to 1822, Kabardia lost independence in the Russo-Circassian War and many fled south or overseas.
zh:
卡巴尔达又称东切尔克斯，是卡巴尔达人的国家，卡巴尔达人是切尔克斯人最东边的一支，据有库班河与捷列克河之间的地带。14至15世纪阿迪格诸部东迁，趁1395年帖木儿破金帐汗脱脱迷失后的真空，把阿兰人逼入峡谷。统治家族自称出自传说中的伊纳尔大帝，公国15世纪中叶成形。

16世纪大公捷姆留克联俄抗克里米亚：1557年使团抵莫斯科，1561年伊凡四世娶其女玛丽亚·捷姆留科夫娜。公族分裂为大、小卡巴尔达，在俄、克里米亚与奥斯曼间倒戈；基督教渐让位于伊斯兰教。

18世纪俄罗斯压力加剧，经1803—1811年鼠疫、1816—1822年叶尔莫洛夫征讨，卡巴尔达在俄切尔克斯战争中亡国，许多族人南逃或渡海。

en: The Kudō were a Japanese warrior family descended from the southern branch of the Fujiwara. A branch of the Izu Kudō moved through Kai to Ōshū, where it later took the name Kuriyagawa and produced several offshoots.
zh: 工藤氏是出自藤原南家的日本武家。伊豆工藤氏的一支经甲斐迁往奥州，后来改称栗谷川氏，并分出数个支系。

en:
Padinjattedathu, more often called the principality of Kodungallur, stood on the Periyar river at the northern end of the Kerala backwaters. Its harbour was the ancient Muziris, where Roman ships loaded pepper and pearls, and the Later Chera kings kept their capital of Mahodayapuram; tradition also places there the landing of the apostle Thomas and India's oldest mosque.

After the Chera kingdom broke up in the early twelfth century the Kodungallur Kovilakam family ruled the port as the Padinjattedathu Swaroopam, steering between Kozhikode and Cochin. A flood in 1341 silted up the harbour and its trade passed to Kochi.

In 1504 a Portuguese and Cochin fleet sacked the town; the Portuguese built Fort Cranganore there in 1523, the Dutch seized it in 1663, and in 1789 sold their establishments to Travancore.
zh:
帕金杰塔杜更常被称为科敦加卢尔小邦，位于佩里亚尔河畔、喀拉拉潟湖北端。其港口即古代的穆济里斯，罗马商船曾在此装载胡椒和珍珠，后期哲罗诸王也以摩诃德耶普兰为都；传说使徒多马在此登陆，印度最古老的清真寺也建在城中。

12世纪初哲罗王国解体后，科敦加卢尔·科维兰坎家族以帕金杰塔杜斯瓦鲁帕姆之名统治该港，在科泽科德与科钦之间周旋。1341年洪水淤塞港口，贸易转入科钦。

1504年葡萄牙与科钦联军洗劫全城，葡萄牙人1523年筑起格朗格努尔堡垒，1663年被荷兰人夺取；1789年荷兰人将当地设施卖给特拉凡哥尔王国。

en:
The Kadawdaachuh were a Caddo people whose communities lived near the Great Bend of the Red River in present-day Arkansas. In 1687 they welcomed survivors of La Salle's expedition and subsequently maintained friendly relations with the French.

Chickasaw attacks in the early 1700s killed or enslaved many, and survivors joined other Caddo communities. In 1835 the Kadawdaachuh signed a treaty with the United States to move to Texas, then part of Mexico.
zh:
卡达达楚人是卡多人的一支，其聚落位于今阿肯色州红河大弯附近。1687年，他们接纳了拉萨尔探险队的幸存者，此后与法国人保持友好关系。

18世纪初契卡索人的袭击使许多人被杀或被奴役，幸存者加入了其他卡多社群。1835年，卡达达楚人与美国签约，迁往当时属于墨西哥的得克萨斯。

en:
Kebbi was a Hausa kingdom in present-day northwestern Nigeria. In 1516–1517 Kanta Kuta rebelled against Songhai after a dispute over spoils from an expedition against Air, establishing Kebbi's independence. His successor Muhammad Kanta expanded the kingdom, ruled from Surame and took Agadez.

After Muhammad Kanta died in 1556, tributary Hausa states withheld their payments and Kebbi lost Agadez. During the Sokoto jihad, Abdullahi dan Fodio captured Birnin Kebbi in 1808; resistance continued, and Karari later founded Argungu as a successor centre.
zh:
凯比是今尼日利亚西北部的豪萨王国。1516—1517年，坎塔·库塔因进攻艾尔所得战利品的分配问题反抗桑海，使凯比独立。他的继任者穆罕默德·坎塔以苏拉梅为都，扩张王国并夺取阿加德兹。

穆罕默德·坎塔于1556年去世后，进贡的豪萨诸邦停止缴纳贡赋，凯比也失去了阿加德兹。在索科托圣战期间，阿卜杜拉希·丹·福迪奥于1808年攻占比尔宁凯比；凯比人继续抵抗，卡拉里后来建立阿尔贡古作为继承中心。

en:
Kedah is the oldest Muslim dynasty of the Malay Peninsula, with history long before Islam. A polity existed by the Merbok River around 788 BCE; the Bujang Valley has Hindu-Buddhist temples from the fifth to fourteenth century and Sungai Batu, dated 110 CE. Traders used Mount Jerai as landmark in the Strait of Malacca, ancient Kedah passing through Funan's and Srivijaya's spheres before local rajas emerged.

The Kedah Annals claim King Phra Ong Mahawangsa converted in 1136 as Sultan Mudzafar Shah; on this traditional genealogy Ibrahim Shah ruled in 1337. Scholars place the conversion around 1474, when Kedah sought Malacca's nobat band and accepted vassalage against Ayutthayan pressure.

Aceh carried off Sultan Sulaiman Shah in 1619; Siamese power later reduced Kedah to tributary status. In 1786 and 1800 it leased Penang and Province Wellesley to the British East India Company; a Siamese army overran Kedah in 1821, exiling its sultan.
zh:
吉打是马来半岛最古老的穆斯林王朝，历史早于伊斯兰教。公元前788年前后慕达河一带已有政权；布秧谷存5至14世纪印度教—佛教寺庙群，双溪峇都遗迹可追溯到110年。商船入马六甲海峡以日莱峰为航标，古吉打先后落入扶南与三佛齐势力范围，后有本地拉者。

《吉打纪年》称帕翁·玛哈旺沙1136年改宗，改称苏丹穆扎法尔·沙，按此世系1337年易卜拉欣·沙在位。学者则认为改宗约在1474年，时吉打为御阿瑜陀耶，向马六甲求乐队并受其宗主权。

1619年亚齐掳走苏丹苏莱曼·沙，后暹罗使吉打沦为属邦。1786、1800年吉打把槟城、威省租给英国东印度公司；1821年暹罗攻占吉打，苏丹流亡。

en:
Keenaght was the Gaelic lordship of the O'Cahan sept in the north of Ulster, covering Dungiven, Derry and Coleraine in County Londonderry. The O'Cahans belonged to the Cenél nEógain branch of the Northern Uí Néill and moved east from Laggan in the twelfth century, ousting the O'Connors from Keenaght.

As kinsmen and vassals of the O'Neills of Tyrone, they held the honour of inaugurating a new O'Neill chief by casting a shoe over his head. The lordship was often called O'Cahan's Country.

It passed to the English crown after the Flight of the Earls in 1607, when most of the chiefs fled Ulster; the last chief, Donnell Ballagh O'Cahan, died in the Tower of London in 1626, and the lordship was absorbed into the planted County Londonderry.
zh:
基纳特是奥卡恩家族在阿尔斯特北部的盖尔领主领地，范围包括伦敦德里郡境内邓吉文、德里和科尔雷因一带。奥卡恩家族属于北尼尔的康尼尔·欧文支系，12世纪从拉根东迁，把奥康纳家族逐出基纳特。

作为蒂龙奥尼尔家族的同族附庸，他们保有向新任奥尼尔首领抛鞋以示拥立的特权，这片领地常被称为“奥卡恩之地”。

1607年“伯爵出逃”后多数首领离开阿尔斯特，土地被英国王室没收；末代首领多纳尔·巴拉·奥卡恩1626年死于伦敦塔，领地随后并入殖民设置的伦敦德里郡。

en: The Kelali were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom of the Jibal highlands, holding Nahavand, Asadabad, Malayer and Sonqur. The country had been the heartland of the tenth-century Hasanwayhid Kurdish dynasty, and in 1337 its chiefs ruled it as Jalayirid vassals; it was later associated with the Kolya'i Kurds.
zh: 克拉里人是吉巴勒山区的一个库尔德部落酋长政权，据有纳哈万德、阿萨达巴德、马拉耶尔和松古尔等地。这里曾是10世纪哈桑韦赫库尔德王朝的核心地带，1337年其首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸统治该地，后来又与克利雅伊库尔德人联系在一起。

en: The Kentaientonga were an Indigenous group associated with villages in northwestern Pennsylvania and the Lake Erie region. Their villages were destroyed by the Haudenosaunee during the conflicts that disrupted the region in the seventeenth century.
zh: 肯塔恩通加人是与宾夕法尼亚西北部及伊利湖地区村落相关的原住民群体。17世纪该地区的冲突中，豪德诺索尼人摧毁了他们的村庄。

en:
Tsi'ya, the Eastern Keres name the Spanish shortened to Zia, is a Keres pueblo on the Jemez River in New Mexico. Its people descend from Ancestral Puebloans of the Four Corners who settled the Jemez valley in the thirteenth century, building adobe towns and irrigating corn, beans and squash by channels, terraces and cisterns.

Espejo visited in 1583 and found it the valley's largest pueblo; Oñate imposed a missionary in 1598, and by 1613 tribal labour had raised a church and convent. Forced labour and banned ceremonies drew the Zia into Popé's 1680 Pueblo Revolt, which drove the Spaniards out of New Mexico.

The returning Spaniards sacked the pueblo in 1689, killing six hundred and carrying off seventy; when survivors came home in 1692 only about a hundred and twenty remained. The community rebuilt, preserving its Eastern Keres speech, pottery and sacred four-rayed sun symbol.
zh:
齐亚是东凯雷斯人的普韦布洛，西班牙人把原名Tsi'ya简称为齐亚，在新墨西哥州赫梅斯河畔。居民为四角落古普韦布洛人后裔，13世纪迁入赫梅斯河谷，建土坯城镇，以水渠、梯田、蓄水池灌溉玉米、豆类、南瓜。

1583年埃斯佩霍到访，称其为河谷最大普韦布洛；1598年奥尼亚特派来传教士，到1613年村民已被迫建起教堂和修道院。劳役与仪式遭禁使齐亚人投入波佩领导的1680年普韦布洛起义，将西班牙人逐出新墨西哥。

1689年西班牙人回师攻陷此镇，杀六百人、掳走七十人；1692年幸存者返乡时只剩约一百二十人。社区此后重建，保存了东凯雷斯语、制陶术和神圣的四芒太阳符号。

en:
Ketu, one of the oldest Yoruba kingdoms, lay on the borderlands of Benin and Nigeria, with walled Kétou as its capital. Its Alákétu rulers trace their line to Ilé-Ifè and Oduduwa: tradition says founder Sopasan led his clan west from Ife to Aro, before King Ede moved a hundred and twenty families to Kétou, perhaps 1000s to 1300s.

Its fourteenth ruler, King Sa, ringed it with walls and one guarded gate, whose ruins still stand. One of the sixteen original Yoruba kingdoms, Ketu kept close ties with Oyo, whose court claimed it as a tributary ally.

From the 1700s it became a buffer between Oyo and the rising Fon power of Dahomey, fighting repeated wars against Abomey. Captives taken in these wars were carried to the coast and sold onward, so the name Ketu, Queto in Portuguese, lived on in the Candomblé temples of Brazil.
zh:
凯图是约鲁巴人最古老的王国之一，地处贝宁与尼日利亚交界，以有城墙的凯图城为都。君主称阿拉凯图，王统追溯到伊莱伊费和奥杜杜瓦：相传始祖索帕桑率族人自伊费西迁至阿罗，后埃代王率一百二十户迁至凯图，开国可能在11至14世纪之间。

第十四代君主萨王环城修筑城墙，只设一座守卫城门，遗址仍在。凯图位列约鲁巴十六古国之一，与奥约关系密切，奥约宫廷视其为纳贡盟友。

18世纪起，它夹在奥约与崛起的丰人强权达荷美之间，与阿波美反复交战。战乱中的俘虏被掳到沿海转卖，凯图之名（葡语作Queto）遂在巴西坎东布雷神庙中延续下来。

en:
The Kyōgoku were a samurai family descended from the Sasaki and named for the Kyōgoku quarter of Kyoto. Before the Ōnin War they held governorships including Ōmi, Hida, Izumo and Oki, but their fortunes declined after the war.

Kyōgoku Takatsugu restored the family's position and held Ōtsu Castle in Ōmi under Toyotomi Hideyoshi. He sided with Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1600 and received Obama in Wakasa that year. Kyōgoku branches later ruled domains on Shikoku and Kyūshū under the Tokugawa shogunate.
zh:
京极氏是出自佐佐木氏的武士家族，得名于京都的京极地区。应仁之乱以前，他们曾担任近江、飞驒、出云和隐岐等国的守护，战后家势衰落。

京极高次重振家门，在丰臣秀吉治下占有近江的大津城。1600年他站在德川家康一边，同年获封若狭的小滨。京极氏的支系后来在德川幕府治下统治四国和九州的藩领。

en:
The Kalinago were Indigenous communities of the Lesser Antilles, including Dominica and Saint Vincent. They resisted Spanish colonization and later fought French and English settlers for control of the islands.

In 1660 the French expelled many Kalinago from Martinique, while a treaty with France and England recognized Dominica and Saint Vincent as their reserves. After further wars, the British deported the Garifuna of Saint Vincent to the island of Roatán in 1797.
zh:
卡利纳戈人是小安的列斯群岛的原住民，居住在多米尼克、圣文森特等岛屿。他们抵抗西班牙殖民，后来又与法国和英国殖民者争夺岛屿。

1660年法国人将许多卡利纳戈人逐出马提尼克，同年法国和英国与卡利纳戈人订立条约，承认多米尼克和圣文森特为他们保留的岛屿。经过后来的战争，英国于1797年将圣文森特的加里富纳人流放到罗阿坦岛。

en:
Kangra, the Trigarta of the Mahabharata, was oldest and largest of Punjab Hill states, ruled from Nagarkot by the Katoch Rajputs, whose name is said to mean dwellers in the kot. Its temple wealth drew plunderers: Mahmud of Ghazni in 1009, Firuz Shah Tughluq in 1360 and Sher Shah in 1540.

The hills were its defence: in 1333 Raja Prithvi Chand destroyed Muhammad bin Tughluq's army, which could not fight there. Akbar besieged Nagarkot in vain; Jahangir starved its garrison out in 1620 after fourteen months, reducing the rajas to vassals keeping much independence.

As Mughal power faded, Ghamand Chand rose under Ahmed Shah Abdali; grandson Sansar Chand retook the fort in 1789, making Kangra first among hill states. Driven back by the Gorkhas in 1806, Sansar Chand surrendered to Ranjit Singh at Jawalamukhi in 1809, and Kangra joined the Sikh Empire.
zh:
冈格拉即《摩诃婆罗多》中的特里加尔塔，为旁遮普最古老最大的山邦，卡托奇拉杰普特人据讷格尔果德统治；据说族名意为“居于堡垒者”。神庙财富招来劫掠者：马哈茂德1009年、菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克1360年、舍尔沙1540年先后洗劫。

山地是坚固防线：1333年罗阇普里特维·昌德歼灭不善山战的穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克大军。阿克巴围攻无功，贾汉吉尔围城十四个月，1620年逼降守军，罗阇沦为附庸仍颇独立。

莫卧儿衰时加曼德·昌德借艾哈迈德沙·阿卜达利崛起，孙桑萨尔·昌德1789年复堡称霸。1806年被廓尔喀逼退，桑萨尔·昌德1809年在贾瓦拉穆基向兰吉特·辛格归降，冈格拉并入锡克帝国。

en:
The Kel Gres were a confederation of Tuareg clans who lived in the Air Mountains of present-day Niger before the 17th century. Alongside the Kel Ayr and other groups, they helped establish the Sultanate of Agadez around 1405.

During the 18th century, Tuareg groups migrated south into Air. By the end of the century the more numerous Kel Owey had pushed the Kel Gres south.
zh:
凯尔格雷斯是图阿雷格氏族联盟，17世纪以前居于今尼日尔的艾尔山脉。他们与凯尔艾尔等部族共同参与建立约1405年兴起的阿加德兹苏丹国。

18世纪，图阿雷格部族从北方向南迁入艾尔。到该世纪末，人数更多的凯尔奥韦人将凯尔格雷斯人逐向南方。

en: The Khoid, whose name means the northern people, were an Oirat tribe attached to the Choros clan and once one of the largest of the Four Oirats, and in 1337 they pastured around Zavkhan in the Mongolian Great Lakes country. They later joined the Dzungar confederation, and most Khoids perished with the Dzungars in the Qing conquest of 1755-1757.
zh: 辉特意为北方之人，是附属于绰罗斯氏族的瓦剌部落，曾是卫拉特四部中最大的部落之一，1337年时游牧于蒙古大湖盆地的扎布汗一带。后来它加入准噶尔联盟，大半部众在1755—1757年清朝平定准噶尔的战争中死去。

en:
Khaf, or Khwaf, is a fertile district of southern Khorasan, counted among the towns of medieval Quhistan, lying on the road between Herat and Nishapur. Its chief settlements were Salameh, Khargerd and Zuzan.

Zuzan, a rectangular walled city with dams and irrigation canals, flourished under the Khwarazmshahs and preserves a Hanafite madrasa dated to 1219 and the Malek Zuzan mosque; Khargerd kept a Seljuk Friday mosque and later became known for the Ghiyathiyya madrasa, built in 1444 under the Timurid sultan Shah Rukh by his vizier Sheikh Ahmad Khafi.

In the fourteenth century the district belonged to the Kartids of Herat, swallowed by Timur in 1381, after which Khaf shared in Timurid patronage and gave the Timurid world the poet Hatefi, born at Khargerd in 1454.
zh:
哈夫又称赫瓦夫，是呼罗珊南部的富庶地区，中世纪属库希斯坦，地处赫拉特与内沙布尔之间的大道上，主要居民点为萨拉梅、哈尔格德和祖赞。

祖赞是带水坝和灌渠的长方形城墙城市，在花剌子模沙阿时期繁盛，留存1219年的哈乃斐派经学院和马利克·祖赞清真寺；哈尔格德保有塞尔柱聚礼清真寺，后以吉亚西耶经学院闻名，该学院由帖木儿苏丹沙哈鲁的维齐尔谢赫·艾哈迈德·哈菲于1444年敕建。

14世纪这一地区隶属赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝，该王朝1381年被帖木儿吞并，此后哈夫参与帖木儿时代的文化营建，1454年生于哈尔格德的诗人哈特菲从这里走向帖木儿世界。

en: Khagya denotes an Amdo Tibetan herding tribe on the Tao River grasslands of present-day southern Gansu, around Amchok in present-day Xiahe and the Kajia country of present-day Hezuo. In Ming and Qing times the tribe stood within the Taozhou Guard frontier under native tusi, and Gelugpa influence grew around it after Labrang Monastery was founded nearby in 1709.
zh: 卡加（又作卡家）是安多藏族的一支游牧部落，牧地在今甘肃南部洮河草原，即今夏河阿木去乎与合作卡加曼、卡加道一带。明清时该部属洮州卫边地，由世袭土司管束，1709年邻近的拉卜楞寺建立后，格鲁派影响日益加深。

en:
The Kahokiaki, or Cahokia, were an Algonquian-speaking people of the Illinois Confederation. In the seventeenth century they lived near the abandoned Cahokia Mounds, west of the Illinois River; the earlier mound builders were a different people.

The Cahokia and Tamaroa settled together near a French mission in 1699. In 1752 Shawnee and Meskwaki allies of Britain destroyed the main Cahokia settlement, and survivors joined neighboring Illinois peoples. Cahokia leaders signed the Treaty of Edwardsville, ceding land to the United States in 1818.
zh:
卡霍齐亚基人即卡霍基亚人，是伊利诺伊联盟中说阿尔冈昆语的族群。17世纪他们居住在伊利诺伊河以西、早已废弃的卡霍基亚土墩附近；更早建造土墩的是另一个族群。

1699年，卡霍齐亚基人与塔马罗瓦人在一座法国传教站附近共同定居。1752年，英国的肖尼和梅斯夸基盟友摧毁了卡霍齐亚基人的主要聚落，幸存者并入邻近的伊利诺伊族群。1818年，卡霍齐亚基领袖签署《爱德华兹维尔条约》，向美国割让土地。

en:
The Khmer Empire, self-styled Kambuja, grew from Chenla around the Tonle Sap. In 802 Jayavarman II consecrated himself universal ruler and instituted the devaraja god-king cult, founding the Angkorian monarchy. Suryavarman II raised Angkor Wat, and after the Chams sacked the capital in 1177 Jayavarman VII rebuilt it as Angkor Thom, with the Bayon temple and vast hydraulic works.

From the thirteenth century Theravada Buddhism displaced the older court cults, and by the 1330s royal inscriptions fall silent as governors and Thai kingdoms eroded imperial power. In 1431 Ayutthaya sacked Angkor Thom, and the court withdrew to Phnom Penh and then Longvek. Longvek shared in the sixteenth-century maritime trade and received Portuguese and Spanish visitors before Ayutthaya destroyed it in 1594.

In the seventeenth century Vietnamese settlers filled the Mekong delta and cut Cambodia off from the sea. Through the eighteenth century its kings were alternating vassals of Siam and Vietnam; by the 1830s Vietnamese garrisons ruled much of the kingdom directly.
zh:
高棉帝国自称甘孛智，由洞里萨湖一带的真腊古国发展而来。802年，阇耶跋摩二世加冕为转轮王，确立神王信仰，开创吴哥王朝。苏利耶跋摩二世修建吴哥窟；1177年占婆人攻陷都城后，阇耶跋摩七世重建吴哥城，造巴戎寺和庞大的水利工程。

13世纪起，上座部佛教逐渐取代旧有的宫廷信仰；到14世纪30年代，王室碑铭戛然而止，各地豪强与泰人王国不断侵蚀皇权。1431年，阿瑜陀耶攻破吴哥城，王廷撤至金边，再退往洛韦。洛韦参与16世纪的海上贸易，迎来葡萄牙和西班牙来客，最终于1594年被阿瑜陀耶摧毁。

17世纪，越南移民涌入湄公河三角洲，使高棉失去出海口。整个18世纪，高棉国王轮番向暹罗和越南称臣；到19世纪30年代，越南军队已直接管辖王国的大片土地。

en: Kharan is the Baloch tribal country of the arid Kharan Desert in inland Balochistan, centered on the oasis town that early Islamic geographers knew as Buqan. Its clans belonged to the Baloch tribal confederacy traced to Jalal Khan in the twelfth century, whose chieftains ruled most of Balochistan from then on; the region later became the Nausherwani khanate of Kharan.
zh: 卡兰是俾路支斯坦内陆卡兰沙漠中的俾路支部落之地，以卡兰绿洲城镇为中心，早期伊斯兰地理学家称之为布干。当地诸部属于更广大的俾路支部落世界——自12世纪贾拉尔汗建立部落联盟以来，俾路支首领一直统治着俾路支斯坦大部，该地区后来成为诺希尔瓦尼家族的卡兰汗国。

en:
Kherla was the oldest of the four Gond kingdoms of Gondwana, a hill state in the Mahadeo hills south of Betul. Rajput chiefs held it before the Gonds, and Jaitpal is credited with building the fortress of Kherla; he was succeeded by Narsingh Rai, the first Gond king, said to first unite the Gond clans, whose lands reached west to the hills above Berar and the fort of Gawilghur.

In 1398 Narsingh Rai raided Berar as far as Mahur, but the Bahmani sultan Firuz Shah retook the country, captured Narsingh Rai's son in battle and forced Narsingh Rai to become a Bahmani vassal, sealing the peace by marrying his daughter.

That alliance drew the hostility of Hoshang Shah of Malwa, whose campaigns between 1420 and 1433 ended with Narsingh Rai slain in battle and Kherla absorbed into the Malwa Sultanate.
zh:
凯尔拉是冈瓦纳四大贡德王国中最古老的一个，为贝图尔以南马哈德奥山区的山地邦国。贡德人之前由拉杰普特首领统治，阇提帕尔主持修建凯尔拉要塞；继位的纳尔辛格·拉伊是第一位贡德国王，相传也是首位统一贡德各部的君主，疆域向西直抵贝拉尔以北山地和加维尔古尔要塞。

1398年纳尔辛格·拉伊攻入贝拉尔，兵锋远至马胡尔，巴赫曼尼苏丹菲鲁兹沙反攻收复失地，在战场上俘获纳尔辛格·拉伊之子，迫使纳尔辛格·拉伊称臣，并娶其女巩固和议。

这一结盟招致马尔瓦苏丹胡尚格沙的敌意，后者1420—1433年间连年征讨，纳尔辛格·拉伊最终战死，凯尔拉被并入马尔瓦苏丹国。

en:
The Khasa Kingdom was a Himalayan state of mixed Hindu and Buddhist culture, capital Sinja in western Nepal. Tradition makes Nagaraja, a prince of Ngari, its founder in the eleventh century; his successors took the title Malla.

Kings left records: Ashoka Challa called himself emperor of the Khashas on copper plates at Bodhgaya in 1255 and 1278, and Ripu Malla carved his name on Lumbini's Ashoka pillar in 1312. In 1337 Punya Malla took the throne; his son Prithvi Malla carried the kingdom to its greatest extent, taking in Guge, Purang and the Nepali hills to Dullu. His 1357 Dullu pillar inscription uses an early form of Nepali in Devanagari script.

After Chittorgarh fell in 1303 Rajput clans entering the hills weakened central power, and after Abhaya Malla's reign the empire broke into the twenty-two Baise and twenty-four Chaubisi hill chiefdoms, among them the future state of Jumla.
zh:
卡萨王国是喜马拉雅山区兼有印度教与佛教文化的政权，都城辛加位于尼泊尔西部。相传11世纪，阿里王子纳加拉杰为开国之君，后继者取末罗为号。

君主的铭刻远留群山之外：阿育王·查拉在1255和1278年菩提伽耶的铜牌上自称卡萨人的皇帝，里普·末罗于1312年在蓝毗尼的阿育王石柱上刻名。1337年普尼亚·末罗继位，其子普里特维·末罗把王国带到极盛，疆域包括古格、布让以及尼泊尔山地，直抵杜卢。他1357年的杜卢石柱铭文以天城文书写，已是早期形态的尼泊尔语。

1303年奇特托尔加尔陷落后，迁入山地的拉杰普特诸族削弱了中央王权，阿巴亚·末罗之后，帝国解体为拜塞二十二邦和乔比西二十四邦等山地酋长国，后来的朱姆拉便是其中之一。

en:
Kuhistān, or Quhistan, was the mountainous land of southern Khorasan, stretching from the Dasht-e Kavir to the borders of Sistan. At the end of the eleventh century Hassan-i Sabbah sent the da'i Husayn Qa'ini home, and Kuhistān became one of the two heartlands of the Nizari Ismaili state alongside Alamut, ruled by a governor titled muhtasham and studded with castles.

Hülegü's campaign against the Nizaris opened with attacks on Kuhistān's strongholds, and after the imam capitulated in 1256 the order was broken and its followers massacred. The province then passed under Il-Khanid rule and, when that empire dissolved, to local mountain lords.

In 1337 it was held by 'Abd-Allah b. Mulai, who joined the eastern princes in backing the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür, while his kinsman Muhammad-i Mulai, the Jalayirid governor of Khurasan, was defeated and executed by Togha Temür and Arghun Shah that autumn.
zh:
库希斯坦是呼罗珊南部的多山之地，从卡维尔盐漠延伸到锡斯坦边境。11世纪末，哈桑·萨巴赫派传道师侯赛因·加伊尼回乡，库希斯坦遂与阿拉穆特并列为尼扎里伊斯玛仪国的两大核心，由号称穆赫塔沙姆的长官治理，堡垒林立。

旭烈兀征讨尼扎里派时，首先攻打的就是库希斯坦的据点；1256年伊玛目投降后，政权被摧毁，信徒遭到屠杀。该省随后归入伊儿汗国，汗国瓦解后又落入本地山区首领之手。

1337年，它由阿卜杜拉·本·穆莱把持，他与东部王公一同支持伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿；他的同族、札剌亦儿人任命的呼罗珊长官穆罕默德·穆莱于同年秋天被脱合帖木儿和阿儿浑沙击败并处死。

en: Khunj is the small highland polity around the town of Khonj in southern Fars, in the medieval district of Irahistan. Its people were the Achomi, also called Khodmooni, Sunni Persians of ancient Zoroastrian background who lived largely by Persian Gulf trade, and the traveler Ibn Battuta visited the town in the fourteenth century and described it in his travelogue.
zh: 洪季是法尔斯南部以洪季城为中心的高地小邦，地处中世纪的伊拉希斯坦地区。居民为阿乔米人（自称霍德穆尼），是有古代琐罗亚斯德教背景的逊尼派波斯人，多以波斯湾贸易为生，14世纪旅行家伊本·白图泰曾到访洪季并在游记中记述。

en:
Khuzdar, old Qazdar or place of silk, sits in a high narrow valley of central Baluchistan, commanding routes between Makran, Sindh and the Afghan highlands. It was chief city of Turan at its submission to Ardashir I in 230 CE, and Shapur I listed Turgistan among Sasanian provinces in 262. The caliphate's armies took it around 650 and kept it as capital of Islamic Turan.

Habbari emirs held it until the late ninth century, and in 994 Baloch tribes fought Sebuktegin of Ghazna storming the town; it then passed under Ghaznavid rule and joined the caravan road to Multan.

It later rose again as capital of the Brahui kingdom of Makran, and in the seventeenth century became chief city of Jhalawan in the expanding Khanate of Kalat, taking in Wadh and Nal and the road to port Bela.
zh:
胡兹达尔旧称加兹达尔，意为丝绸之地，在俾路支斯坦中部狭窄高地上，扼守莫克兰海岸、信德与阿富汗高地间的通道。230年图兰王国向阿尔达希尔一世臣服时，它已是图兰首要城市；沙普尔一世262年的铭文将图尔吉斯坦列为萨珊行省。约650年哈里发军队攻占此地，以其为伊斯兰图兰行省首府。

哈巴里埃米尔统治到9世纪末，994年伽色尼的萨布克特勤攻城时遭俾路支部落抵抗，此后胡兹达尔归入伽色尼王朝，成为通往木尔坦商道的一环。

此后胡兹达尔再度兴起，为布拉灰莫克兰王国都城；17世纪成为卡拉特汗国扩张中贾拉万地区的首要城市，辖有瓦德、纳尔山地和通往贝拉港的道路。

en:
The Kitkehaki, also called Republican Pawnee, were a southern band of the Pawnee in the Nebraska region. Like other Pawnee bands, they combined life in earth-lodge villages with farming and seasonal bison hunts.

An account of a conflict in the late 1700s describes the Kitkehaki joining the Chaui and Pitahwarita against the Skidi Pawnee. After the battle, the Kitkehaki argued against destroying the defeated Skidi, and the southern bands made terms with them.
zh:
基特凯哈基人又称共和河波尼人，是内布拉斯加地区波尼族的一个南部分支。与其他波尼群体一样，他们住在土屋村落，以耕种和季节性猎捕野牛为生。

一则关于18世纪末冲突的记述说，基特凯哈基人与乔伊人、皮塔瓦里塔人联手对抗斯基迪波尼人。战斗结束后，基特凯哈基人反对消灭战败的斯基迪人，南方各部最终与他们议和。

en:
The K'iche' are a leading Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands; their name means many trees, and the Nahuatl rendering of it, Cuauhtēmallān, gave the land of Guatemala its name. In the Postclassic they built the most powerful of the highland Maya kingdoms. Its earliest courts sat at Jakawitz and then at Pismachi', and around 1400 King Q'uq'umatz, the Feathered Serpent, founded a new capital at Q'umarkaj, called Utatlán in Nahuatl, immediately north of the old city. Under his son K'iq'ab the kingdom reached its height, drawing central Mexican influences into its art and speech, while four ruling lineages shared the capital around the temples of Tohil, Awilix and Jakawitz. In 1470 a revolt of subject nobles stripped the K'iche' of key allies and began their decline.

When Pedro de Alvarado invaded in 1524, the K'iche' commander Tecun Uman gave battle in the valley of Xelajú and was killed together with close to ten thousand of his men. The lords then invited Alvarado to Q'umarkaj, but he suspected an ambush and burned the city. Under Spanish rule the Dominicans studied the K'iche' language, while K'iche' scribes preserved the creation epic Popol Vuh.
zh:
基切人是危地马拉高地的主要玛雅民族之一，其名称意为“众多树木”，它的纳瓦特尔语译名夸乌特马兰正是“危地马拉”一名的由来。在后古典期，他们建立了高地玛雅最强大的王国。王廷最初设在哈卡维茨，后来迁至皮斯马奇；约1400年，被称为“羽蛇”的国王库库马茨在旧城以北紧邻处建立新都库马尔卡赫，纳瓦特尔语称乌塔特兰。在他的儿子基卡布治下，王国达到鼎盛，艺术和语言吸收了中部墨西哥的影响，四大统治家族围绕托希尔、阿维利什和哈卡维茨等神庙分治都城。1470年，臣属贵族发动叛乱，使基切失去重要盟友，国势由此转衰。

1524年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多入侵时，基切统帅特昆·乌曼在赫拉胡谷地迎战，兵败身亡，近万名基切人战死。贵族们随后邀请阿尔瓦拉多进入库马尔卡赫，他却怀疑设有埋伏，纵火焚城。西班牙统治时期，多明我会修士研习基切语，基切书吏则保存了创世史诗《波波尔·乌》。

en:
Kildare was the chief seat of the senior FitzGeralds, Geraldines from Wales in the 1169 Norman invasion. The family were Barons of Offaly from about 1193; John FitzGerald became Earl of Kildare in 1316, with Pale lands around Kildare and Naas.

The 1337 earl, Maurice FitzGerald, fourth of the line, suppressed Gaelic risings in Leinster, served Edward III at the 1347 siege of Calais and was three times Lord Justice of Ireland from 1360 to 1375. Power peaked under the eighth and ninth earls, Gearóid Mór and Gearóid Óg, who ruled Ireland as Lord Deputy in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries.

The tenth earl, Thomas, called Silken Thomas, rose against Henry VIII in 1534 and was executed three years later. Restored to favour, the Kildare Geraldines became Marquesses of Kildare in 1761 and Dukes of Leinster in 1766, premier peers of Ireland.
zh:
基尔代尔是菲茨杰拉德长支核心领地，杰拉尔丁人1169年随诺曼入侵自威尔士来。家族约1193年起受封奥法利男爵，约翰·菲茨杰拉德1316年晋封基尔代尔伯爵，领地在英格兰辖区的基尔代尔、纳斯一带。

1337年第四代伯爵莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德平伦斯特盖尔起事，1347年随爱德华三世围加来，1360—1375年三度任爱尔兰司法官。权势在第八代杰拉德·莫尔、第九代杰拉德·奥格时达顶峰，两人15世纪末至16世纪初先后任爱尔兰总督。

第十代伯爵“绸服托马斯”1534年起兵反亨利八世，三年后处死，家族转衰。后重获恩宠，1761年封基尔代尔侯爵，1766年封伦斯特公爵，为爱尔兰首席贵族。

en:
The Principality of Kyiv was a Ruthenian principality centered on Kyiv on the Dnieper, carved from Kievan Rus' after its fragmentation following Mstislav I's death in 1132. The 1240 Mongol siege ruined the city and made its princes Golden Horde tributaries, though it long remained the Orthodox metropolitan see in Rus'.

Around 1300 the Olgovichi of Chernigov secured the city with khan backing. Chronicles place a Battle on the Irpin River in 1321, when Grand Duke Gediminas of Lithuania is said to have defeated Prince Stanislav, though its historicity is disputed. In 1331 the Rurikid Prince Theodore Ivanovich is first attested, ruling a diminished duchy between Lithuanian and Tatar overlordship.

After Grand Duke Algirdas defeated the Horde at Blue Waters in 1362 or 1363, Kyiv entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The princely line ended in 1471, when Casimir IV turned the principality into the Kyiv Voivodeship, which passed to the Polish Crown under the 1569 Union of Lublin.
zh:
基辅公国是以第聂伯河畔基辅城为中心的鲁塞尼亚公国，1132年姆斯季斯拉夫一世死后基辅罗斯分裂，它由罗斯核心领地演变而来。1240年蒙古大军围城使基辅遭到重创，此后王公向金帐汗国纳贡，不过基辅长期仍是罗斯东正教都主教的驻地。

1300年前后，切尔尼戈夫的奥利戈维奇家族在汗王支持下取得该城。编年史称1321年立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯在伊尔平河之战中击败王公斯坦尼斯拉夫，不过此战的真实性历来有争议。1331年，留里克家族的西奥多尔·伊万诺维奇首次见于文献，统治着一个夹在立陶宛与鞑靼宗主权之间的弱小公国。

1362或1363年，阿尔吉尔达斯大公在蓝水之战击败金帐汗国后，基辅并入立陶宛大公国。王公世系于1471年终结，卡齐米日四世将公国改设基辅省；1569年《卢布林联合》后，基辅省划归波兰王国。

en:
The K'itaish, also called Kichai, were a Caddoan-speaking people of the southern Great Plains. French explorers met them on the Red River in Louisiana in 1701. They fought the Hainai on the Trinity River in 1712, while maintaining alliances with other Caddoan groups.

By 1772 they lived mainly east of the Trinity near present-day Palestine, Texas. In 1837 they defeated Texas Rangers at the Battle of Stone Houses, although their leader was killed.
zh:
基泰什人又称基柴人，是大平原南部使用卡多语族语言的族群。1701年，法国探险者在路易斯安那的红河遇见了他们。1712年，他们在特里尼蒂河与海奈人交战，同时与其他卡多语族群保持联盟。

到1772年，他们主要居住在特里尼蒂河以东、今德克萨斯州巴勒斯坦附近。1837年，他们在石屋之战中击败德克萨斯骑警，但首领阵亡。

en:
The Kii, also called the Buzen Utsunomiya, were major landholders in Kii district of Buzen Province. Their lord Kii Shigefusa served the Ōuchi and then the Ōtomo, before turning to the Shimazu after the Ōtomo defeat at Mimikawa in 1578.

In 1587 Shigefusa resisted Toyotomi Hideyoshi's order to move to Iyo and retook Kii Valley Castle. He surrendered after fighting the Kuroda, but was murdered at a banquet in Nakatsu Castle in 1588; other members of his family were also killed.
zh:
城井氏又称丰前宇都宫氏，是丰前国城井乡的领主。家督城井镇房先后从属大内氏和大友氏，1578年大友氏在耳川战败后转而归附岛津氏。

1587年，镇房抗拒丰臣秀吉迁往伊予的命令，夺回城井谷城。他与黑田氏交战后投降，却于1588年在中津城的宴席上被谋杀，其他家族成员也遭杀害。

en:
The Kilis emirate was a Kurdish principality of Kilis and Afrin, north of Aleppo, rulers claiming descent from Yazidi saint Fakhraddin and his son Mend, Hakkari tribal leader. In the late twelfth century Saladin, Kurdish Ayyubid sultan, made Mend lord from Afrin to Kilis and Maraş, titled Emir of the Kurds.

When Ayyubid power collapsed around 1260, the Mamluks confirmed Kasım's family in Kilis. The emirate kept autonomy under the Ottomans after Selim I, though Kasım was executed in Constantinople on the Aleppo governor's report; his son Canpolat returned to Kilis in 1515, ruling until 1572.

Canpolat's son Hüseyin expanded towards Aleppo and the pasha executed him; nephew Ali's revenge failed as Ottoman troops forced him out. He was executed in Constantinople in 1610 and the emirate dissolved. His Canbolatoğulları kin fled to Lebanon in 1630; the Druze Jumblatt family descend from them.
zh:
基利斯埃米尔国是阿勒颇以北基利斯、阿夫林的库尔德公国，统治者自称雅兹迪圣徒法赫尔丁及其子、哈卡里部落首领门德之后。12世纪末库尔德人阿尤布苏丹萨拉丁封门德辖阿夫林至基利斯、马拉什，号库尔德埃米尔。

1260年前后阿尤布王朝崩溃，马穆鲁克确认卡西姆家族治基利斯。塞利姆一世征服后在奥斯曼治下自治，卡西姆后遭阿勒颇总督告发，在君士坦丁堡处死；子詹普拉特1515年回基利斯，统治至1572年。

詹普拉特之子侯赛因向阿勒颇扩张，被帕夏处死；侄阿里复仇起兵，被奥斯曼军逼逃，1610年君士坦丁堡处决，埃米尔国瓦解。族人詹普拉特奥卢拉尔1630年逃黎巴嫩，德鲁兹琼布拉特家族为其后。

en:
Kiliman was the earlier name of the people who built Buayan, upper Cotabato valley power on Mindanao, whose founding local Tarsila genealogies place in the mid-fourteenth century. Its first recorded ruler, Datu Mamu, widened his power by marrying neighboring chiefdoms' princesses; its chiefs bore the Indianized title rajah.

Centered on Buayan on the Pulangi, upstream from Maguindanao, it drew wealth from the fertile Sa-raya, or Upper Valley, rice lands, with an outlet at Sarangani Bay. After preacher Rajah Baguinda Ali came from Basilan, the people accepted Islam, and Buayan became one of Mindanao's four great sultanates, rival to downriver Maguindanao.

Under Rajah Silongan it met the Spaniards in force: in 1596 he repulsed the combined Maguindanao and Spanish armies, and in 1599 joined a three-thousand-strong raid on the coasts of Cebu and Panay. Buayan kept its independence through the long Spanish-Moro wars.
zh:
奇里曼是建立布阿延的族群旧称。布阿延是棉兰老哥打巴托谷地上游强权，当地《系谱》将其建立追溯到14世纪中叶。最早见载的统治者达图·马穆靠联姻邻近酋邦扩张势力，首领用印度化称号“拉惹”。

政权以普朗吉河畔布阿延为中心，地处马京达瑙上游，靠萨莱亚（上谷地）肥田致富，在萨兰加尼湾有出海口。传教者拉惹·巴金达·阿里自巴西兰来后，居民皈依伊斯兰教，布阿延成棉兰老四大苏丹国之一，与下游马京达瑙争雄。

拉惹·西隆安时西班牙人与布阿延正面交锋：1596年西隆安击退马京达瑙与西班牙联军，1599年又参与三千人大举劫掠宿务、班乃沿海。此后漫长的西班牙—摩洛战争中，布阿延始终独立。

en: The Kaiowá are a Guarani people of Paraguay and the region of Mato Grosso do Sul in Brazil. They are closely related to the Pai Tavytera of eastern Paraguay, who encountered Jesuit missionaries in the 17th century and often resisted assimilation.
zh: 卡约瓦是居住在巴拉圭和巴西南马托格罗索地区的瓜拉尼人。卡约瓦人与巴拉圭东部的帕伊塔维特拉人关系密切，后者在17世纪遇到耶稣会传教士，许多人抵抗同化。

en: Kipike was a Circassian tribe of the Black Sea coast around the Taman peninsula, recorded in the fifteenth century by the Venetian traveler Giosafat Barbaro, who names the Kippike as Circassians of the Great Sea shore, Christians of the Greek rite. The Taman area, called Matrega by the Genoese, was then ringed by autonomous Circassian tribal principalities.
zh: 奇皮克是黑海沿岸塔曼半岛一带的切尔克斯部落，15世纪威尼斯旅行家巴尔巴罗的游记曾记下“基皮凯”之名，说他们是大海沿岸的切尔克斯人、希腊礼基督徒。当时塔曼被热那亚人称为马特雷加，周围分布着自治的切尔克斯部落公国。

en:
Kirchberg was the county of a Swabian high-noble family with lands south of Ulm on both sides of the Iller. Their seat was Oberkirchberg, and the family first appears in 1087; in 1093 its lords endowed Wiblingen Abbey, later their burial place.

Around 1250 the counts split into three lines, including the Wullenstetten line. When Count William of the senior line died in 1366, much of the inheritance passed through his daughter to the Matsch family; the Wullenstetten line recovered the county as a pledge in 1390, and King Sigismund re-enfeoffed them in 1434.

The last cousins sold their halves to Duke George of Bavaria in 1481 and 1498. After the Landshut War of Succession Maximilian I pledged the lordship to the Fugger in 1507, who styled themselves counts of Kirchberg. The Kirchberg family died out in 1510; its most famous son was the minnesinger Conrad of Kirchberg, shown in the Codex Manesse.
zh:
基希贝格是施瓦本高级贵族的伯爵领，地处乌尔姆以南、伊勒河两岸，治所在上基希贝格堡。该家族1087年首见文献；1093年其领主捐资维布林根修道院，后成为家族墓地。

约1250年伯爵家分为三支，其中包括武伦施泰滕支。长支的威廉伯爵1366年去世后，大份遗产经其女转入马奇家族；武伦施泰滕支1390年以抵押收回旧伯国，1434年西吉斯蒙德重新册封。

末代堂兄弟于1481、1498年把各自一半卖给巴伐利亚公爵格奥尔格。兰茨胡特继承战争后，马克西米利安一世1507年把领地抵押给富格尔家族，后者自称基希贝格伯爵。基希贝格家族1510年绝嗣，最有名者是《马内塞古抄本》中有画像的恋歌诗人康拉德·冯·基希贝格。

en:
Kitara, also called the Chwezi Empire, was the great state of the interlacustrine country around the African Great Lakes, covering much of western Uganda and remembered in the oral traditions of the Banyoro, Batooro and Banyankole. Its rulers held court first at Mubende, where a hilltop palace marks the Chwezi presence, and later at Bigo bya Mugenyi on the Katonga River, whose ten kilometres of ditches date to roughly 1300 to 1500.

Tradition tells that after the Tembuzi kings Bukuku seized the throne, and his grandson Karubumbi, taking the name Ndahura, founded the Chwezi dynasty and campaigned as far as Rwanda and Busoga.

Skilled blacksmiths venerated as ancestor spirits by the Rutara peoples, the Chwezi abandoned Kitara under King Wamara after ill omens. Power then passed to the Luo Biito dynasty of Isingoma Rukidi, whose kingdom became Bunyoro. Both Bunyoro and later Buganda claimed Kitara's legacy.
zh:
基塔拉又称契韦齐帝国，是非洲大湖地区湖间地带的大国，疆域涵盖乌干达西部大部，留在巴尼奥罗、巴托罗和巴扬科勒人的口传传统中。统治者先定都穆本德，山顶宫殿遗址标示契韦齐人的踪迹，后迁都卡通加河畔的比戈比亚穆根伊；那里绵延十公里的壕沟约建于1300至1500年间。

相传滕布齐诸王之后，布库库篡夺王位，其孙卡鲁本比改名恩达胡拉，开创契韦齐王朝，兵锋远达卢旺达、布索加等地。

契韦齐人以善锻铁器闻名，被鲁塔拉各族奉为祖先神灵；到瓦马拉王时，因种种凶兆，契韦齐人弃基塔拉而去。王权随后转入卢奥人比伊托王朝的伊辛戈马·鲁基迪之手，其国家即后来的布尼奥罗；布尼奥罗以及后来的布干达都自称继承基塔拉的法统。

en:
The Kiwigapawa, or Kickapoo, were an Algonquian-speaking people from the Great Lakes region. French missionaries met them in southern Wisconsin in 1667, and they later moved into Illinois and joined the Wabash Confederacy.

Kickapoo warriors allied with the Shawnee leader Tecumseh and fought at Tippecanoe in 1811. In the 1819 Treaty of Edwardsville they ceded their Illinois lands to the United States in exchange for land in Missouri and goods.
zh:
基维加帕瓦人又称基卡普人，是源自五大湖地区的阿尔冈昆语族民族。1667年法国传教士在威斯康星南部遇到他们，此后他们迁入伊利诺伊并加入瓦巴什联盟。

基卡普战士与肖尼领袖特库姆塞结盟，参加了1811年的蒂珀卡努战役。1819年，他们在《爱德华兹维尔条约》中将伊利诺伊的土地割让给美国，换取密苏里土地和货物。

en:
Keonjhar, also called Kendujhar, was a hill kingdom in northern Orissa, covering the lands that now form Kendujhar district. Its territory fell into two parts, the low valleys of the Baitarani river and the forested highlands of the Gandhamadan range, with the raja's seat at Keonjhar.

Tradition places its foundation in the twelfth century, when the Eastern Ganga dynasty ruled the region: Jyoti Bhanja of the Bhanja dynasty was enthroned as raja with the backing of the local Bhuyan clans, whose chiefs long kept a role in the coronation ritual. Around the fourteenth century a Keonjhar prince, Ananga Bhanja, was made king of neighbouring Baudh.

The Bhanja rulers ruled as tributaries of the Orissa kings, and the same dynasty continued to rule Keonjhar without interruption through the Mughal and Maratha centuries, with rajas such as Jagannath Bhanja reigning from 1688.
zh:
盖翁切尔又称肯杜贾尔，是奥里萨北部的山地王国，疆域相当于今肯杜贾尔县。其地分为两部分：拜塔拉尼河的低缓河谷与甘达马丹山脉的森林高地，罗阇的都城设在盖翁切尔。

相传王国建于12世纪东恒伽王朝统治时期：班贾王朝的乔蒂·班贾在当地布扬氏族拥戴下登位为罗阇，布扬首领在加冕仪式中长期保有一席之地。约14世纪，盖翁切尔王子阿南加·班贾被立为邻近包德的国王。

班贾诸王作为奥里萨君主的附庸统治，同一王朝在莫卧儿和马拉塔时代始终未断，例如贾格纳特·班贾于1688年起在位。

en:
The Kajiki were local lords based at Kajiki Castle in Ōsumi Province, southern Kyushu. During the Northern and Southern Courts period the family split between the factions of Ashikaga Takauji and Ashikaga Tadayoshi, and later served the Shimazu.

In 1495 Kajiki Hisahira attacked Chōsa in rebellion against the Shimazu. Shimazu Tadamasa besieged Kajiki Castle the following year, defeated the family and moved it to Ata. In 1607 Shimazu Yoshihiro established a residence at Kajiki, with the castle behind it as a refuge.
zh:
加治木氏是九州南部大隅国的地方领主，以加治木城为据点。南北朝时代，家族分为足利尊氏和足利直义两派，后来成为岛津氏的属下。

1495年，加治木久平反抗岛津氏，进攻帖佐。次年岛津忠昌包围加治木城，击败加治木氏并将其迁至阿多。1607年，岛津义弘在加治木建造居馆，以后方的城池作为退守之所。

en:
The Kanien'kehaka, or People of the Flint Place, known to European settlers as the Mohawk, are an Iroquoian people of New York's Mohawk Valley. Corn, bean and squash farmers in stockaded longhouses, they reckoned descent through the mother's line and, as easternmost of the Five Nations, were Keepers of the Eastern Door in the Haudenosaunee league.

In 1609 Champlain joined a Wendat war party that fired on them near Lake Champlain. The Dutch at Fort Orange then supplied firearms for furs, and after defeating the Mohicans in 1628 the Mohawk dominated regional trade.

A French expedition burned their villages in 1666, and the English later inherited the Dutch alliance; four chiefs visited Queen Anne in 1710. Most Mohawk sided with Britain in the American Revolution under Joseph Brant; after Sullivan's expedition destroyed their towns in 1779 survivors resettled on the Grand River and other lands.
zh:
卡尼恩凯哈卡意为“燧石之地的人”，欧洲移民称之为莫霍克人，是纽约莫霍克谷的易洛魁民族。他们种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，住栅栏长屋，按母系计世系，作为霍迪诺肖尼联盟五族最东一员，号称“东门的守护者”。

1609年，尚普兰随温达特作战队伍在尚普兰湖畔向莫霍克人开火。奥兰治堡荷兰人以火器换毛皮，1628年莫霍克人击败莫西干人，主导地区贸易。

1666年法国远征军焚毁其村庄，英国后来接管荷兰人的同盟，1710年四位酋长觐见安妮女王。独立战争中，多数莫霍克人在约瑟夫·布兰特率领下站在英国一边；1779年沙利文远征摧毁其村镇，幸存者在格兰德河等地重新定居。

en:
The Kikuchi were a warrior family based in Higo Province in Kyushu. Kikuchi Noritaka took his name from Kikuchi district in the eleventh century, and his descendants fought in the Mongol invasions and the overthrow of the Kamakura shogunate.

In 1345 Kikuchi Takemitsu helped retake Fukagawa Castle from Northern Court forces. Supporting Prince Kaneyoshi of the Southern Court, he won the Battle of Chikugogawa in 1359 and gained control of Dazaifu; the clan was later destroyed by the Ōuchi.
zh:
菊池氏是九州肥后国的武家。11世纪菊池则隆以菊池郡为氏，其后人在蒙古入侵和推翻镰仓幕府的战争中参战。

1345年菊池武光协助从北朝军手中夺回深川城。他拥戴南朝的怀良亲王，于1359年赢得筑后川之战并控制太宰府；菊池氏后来被大内氏消灭。

en:
The Killke were the highland people who held the Cusco basin in the centuries before the Incas, their culture lasting from about 900 to 1200.

Long before the imperial fortress of Sacsayhuamán rose above Cusco, Killke builders occupied its hilltop from around 900 and, in the twelfth century, raised the first small sections of the fortification, together with its temple, streets and irrigation canals; the Incas later absorbed the site and rebuilt it on a monumental scale in the fifteenth century.

John Howland Rowe, who gave the culture its name, first identified its pottery: globular jars with vertical strap handles, slipped in white or buff and painted with simple geometric lines in black and red. When the Inca state formed in the Cusco valley during the thirteenth century, Killke lands and traditions became part of its early heritage.
zh:
基利克人是印加人之前据有库斯科盆地的高地族群，其文化存续于约900年至1200年。

早在萨克塞瓦曼雄关耸立于库斯科之前，基利克人已在约900年占据其山头，并在12世纪修筑防御工事最早的几段，以及神庙、街道和灌渠；印加人后来接管该遗址，于15世纪大规模扩建。

为该文化命名的约翰·豪兰·罗最先辨认出基利克陶器：器形多为带竖向带状把手的球状罐，施白色或米黄色陶衣，以黑、红两色绘出简洁的几何线条。13世纪印加政权在库斯科河谷形成时，基利克人的土地与传统也汇入印加早期的遗产。

en:
Kutai Kartanegara was a Hindu kingdom founded around 1300 at Kutai Lama, near the mouth of the Mahakam River in eastern Borneo, by Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti; its early rulers bore Hindu-Javanese titles reflecting contacts with Majapahit. In 1337 the throne belonged to the founder's son, Aji Batara Agung Paduka Nira.

Growing rich on river and coastal trade, the court moved several times along the lower Mahakam, to Jembayan in 1732 and later to Tenggarong. Islam arrived with traders in the sixteenth century, and in 1575 the ruler Aji Raja Mahkota Mulia Alam made the kingdom a Muslim sultanate.

In 1635 Kutai Kartanegara defeated its ancient upstream rival Kutai Martapura after seven days and nights of fighting, annexed Muara Kaman and took the combined name Kutai Kartanegara ing Martapura.
zh:
古泰‑卡塔内加拉是约1300年在东婆罗洲马哈坎河口古泰拉玛建立的印度教王国，开国君主是阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·德瓦·萨克蒂，早期君主使用印度教—爪哇式头衔，反映出与满者伯夷的往来。1337年在位的是开国君主之子阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·帕杜卡·尼拉。

凭借河流与沿海贸易致富后，王庭在马哈坎河下游多次迁移，1732年迁至占巴延，后来又迁往登加隆。16世纪伊斯兰教随商人传入；1575年，君主阿吉·拉贾·马赫库塔·穆利亚·阿拉姆将王国改为伊斯兰苏丹国。

1635年，古泰‑卡塔内加拉经过七天七夜的激战，击败上游的古老对手古泰‑摩多补罗，吞并穆阿拉卡曼，改称古泰‑卡塔内加拉英摩多补罗。

en:
The Kaskankaham, or Kaskaskia, were a people of the Illinois Confederation whose homeland lay in the Great Lakes region. In 1673 Jacques Marquette and Louis Jolliet met them at the Grand Village on the Illinois River.

In 1703 French Jesuits founded a mission at Kaskaskia near the Mississippi, where French settlers and Illinois people lived alongside one another. The town became a center of French Upper Louisiana, while the Kaskaskia absorbed survivors of other Illinois peoples, including the Tamaroa.
zh:
卡斯坎卡汉人即卡斯卡斯基亚人，是伊利诺伊联盟的一个族群，故地位于五大湖地区。1673年，雅克·马凯特和路易·若利埃在伊利诺伊河畔的大村庄遇见了他们。

1703年，法国耶稣会士在密西西比河附近的卡斯卡斯基亚建立传教站，法国移民与伊利诺伊人在此共同生活。该镇成为法国上路易斯安那的中心，卡斯坎卡汉人则接纳了包括塔马罗瓦人在内的其他伊利诺伊族群的幸存者。

en:
Khalkhal was a highland town and district in Azerbaijan, in the mountains south-west of Ardabil, which had succeeded the older city of Firuzabad as the seat of its province.

Around 1340 the chronicler Hamdallah Mustawfi described it as a former town of some size that had shrunk to a village, its province covering roughly a hundred villages in four districts within the Ardabil tuman; in 1337 its local chief held the district as a vassal of the Jalayirids of Baghdad.

After Nader Shah was killed in 1747, Amir-Guna Khan of the Afshar tribe founded the Khalkhal Khanate on the same ground, and it stayed semi-independent until Qajar forces absorbed it in 1799.
zh:
哈勒哈里是阿塞拜疆的一处高地城镇与地区，位于阿尔达比勒西南的山区，曾接替更古老的菲鲁扎巴德成为当地的治所。

1340年前后，史家哈姆杜拉·穆斯塔菲记载，它曾是颇有规模的城镇，当时已衰落为村庄，其辖区在阿尔达比勒土绵之下约有上百个村庄、分属四个分区；1337年时，当地首领作为巴格达札剌亦儿王朝的附庸领有此地。

1747年纳迪尔沙遇刺后，阿夫沙尔部的阿米尔-古纳汗在同一地盘建立哈勒哈里汗国，保持半独立直到1799年被卡扎尔王朝吞并。

en:
The Khokhra chieftaincy, or Nagvanshi dynasty, was the Hindu state of the forested Chota Nagpur plateau, centred on Khukhragarh. Its line was traditionally traced to a first-century founder, though its early chiefs probably came from the Munda tribe. In 1337 its rajas still ruled from a hill capital beyond the Bihar sultans' reach.

The Mughals later forced their way into the jungles: Shahbaz Khan Kamboh subjugated Madhukar Rai for Akbar in 1585, and in 1615 Ibrahim Khan annexed the state and imprisoned Durjan Shah, whom Jahangir released after he judged the emperor's diamonds. Restored rajas built temples, Ram Shah raising the Kapilnath temple at Navratangarh in 1643.

After the battle of Buxar the dynasty became an East India Company vassal in 1771, was reduced to zamindar status in 1817, and the Kol rising of 1831 to 1833 swept the plateau before the British put it down.
zh:
科赫罗酋长国又称那格万希王朝，是据有丛林乔塔那格浦尔高原、以库克拉加尔为中心的印度教政权。当地传说把王系追溯到1世纪的始祖，但早期首领很可能出身蒙达部族。1337年，王公们仍在山城发号施令，比哈尔苏丹们鞭长莫及。

后来莫卧儿人进入丛林：1585年沙赫巴兹汗·坎博替阿克巴降服马杜卡尔·拉伊；1615年易卜拉欣汗吞并该国，杜尔詹·沙阿被押入狱，因替贾汉吉尔鉴别钻石而获释。复辟后的王公修建神庙，拉姆·沙阿于1643年在纳夫拉坦加尔修建迦毗罗那特神庙。

伯格萨尔战役后，该王朝于1771年成为东印度公司附庸，1817年被降为柴明达尔；1831至1833年科尔人起义席卷高原，终被英人镇压。

en:
The Kikkawa were a warrior family named for a place in Suruga. After receiving stewardship of Ōasa in Aki for service in the Jōkyū War of 1221, the main family settled there in 1313. It acted as a local power and later aligned with the Ōuchi and Amago.

Mōri Motonari placed his son Motoharu in the Kikkawa house. Motoharu became a Mōri commander in the San'in region, and the Kikkawa and Kobayakawa together supported the main Mōri house. In the Edo period the Kikkawa ruled Iwakuni in Suō.
zh:
吉川氏是以骏河国地名为姓的武士家族。吉川氏因1221年承久之乱中的军功获得安艺国大朝庄的地头职，宗家于1313年迁居当地。此后吉川氏作为地方势力活动，后来先后依附大内氏和尼子氏。

毛利元就将儿子元春送入吉川家。元春成为毛利氏在山阴地区的统帅，吉川氏与小早川氏共同辅佐毛利宗家。江户时代，吉川氏统治周防国岩国藩。

en:
Kalāt, whose name comes from the Arabic word for fortress, lies in the Central Brahui Range south of Quetta. Anciently called Qiqan and later Kalat-e Sewa after the Hindu Sewa dynasty whose legendary founder gave the town its name, it saw Jat tribesmen defeat an Arab army near the Bolan Pass in 662. Hindu rulers held out until the fifteenth century, when Mirwari Brahui clans took Kalat as their stronghold.

From that fortress the Brahui Khans built the first unified state in Baluchistan. Mir Ahmad Khan I declared independence from the Mughals in 1666 and took Quetta, Mastung and Pishin.

Under Mir Nasir Khan I, who reigned from 1749 to 1794, the Khanate of Kalat stretched from Kerman to Sindh and from the Helmand to the Arabian Sea. Nasir Khan threw off Afghan suzerainty after the war of 1758, and in 1784 granted Gwadar to the fugitive Omani prince Sultan bin Ahmad.
zh:
卡拉特之名源自阿拉伯语堡垒一词，位于奎达以南的布拉灰中央山脉。它古称凯坎，后称塞瓦堡，得名于传说中奠基此城的印度教塞瓦王朝。662年贾特部落于博兰山口附近击败阿拉伯军队。印度教统治者坚守到15世纪，米尔瓦里氏族的布拉灰人才夺取卡拉特，将其建为山寨。

布拉灰诸汗从此堡建立俾路支斯坦的第一个统一国家。米尔·艾哈迈德汗一世于1666年宣布脱离莫卧儿独立，攻占奎达、马斯通和皮欣。

1749至1794年在位的米尔·纳西尔汗一世时，卡拉特汗国疆域西起克尔曼、东抵信德，北自赫尔曼德河、南达阿拉伯海。纳西尔汗1758年战争后摆脱阿富汗宗主权，1784年把瓜达尔港赠予避难的阿曼王子苏丹·本·艾哈迈德。

en:
The Banu Kilab were a great Bedouin tribe of the Banu Amir, whose original homeland was the western Najd. From the mid-sixth century they held the horse-breeding pastures of Dariyya, near later al-Yamama, and under their Ja'far clan led the Banu Amir in the raids and caravan wars of pre-Islamic Arabia, including the Fijar War against the Quraysh of Mecca.

They accepted Islam around 630, but Kilabi tribesmen later joined the Bedouin rising against the Abbasid caliph al-Wathiq, suppressed in 845, when thousands submitted and many were deported.

In the ninth and tenth centuries Kilab migrants entered northern Syria, where Salih ibn Mirdas founded the Mirdasid emirate of Aleppo in 1025; his dynasty held the city until 1080 and defeated the Byzantine emperor Romanos III at Azaz in 1030. Clans staying in Arabia kept the tribe's name around its old Najd grazing grounds.
zh:
巴努·基拉卜是贝都因大部落，属巴努·阿米尔，其祖居内志西部。6世纪中叶起，他们占据后来耶马迈附近迪里耶的牧马草场，并在贾法尔氏族率领下引领巴努·阿米尔参与前伊斯兰时代的劫掠与商队战争，包括与麦加古莱什人的菲贾尔战争。

他们约在630年皈依伊斯兰教，但后来有基拉卜人参加反抗阿拔斯哈里发瓦西格的贝都因起义，起义于845年被镇压，数千人投降，许多人被流放。

9至10世纪，基拉卜人迁入叙利亚北部，萨利赫·伊本·米尔达斯1025年在那里建立阿勒颇的米尔达西埃米尔国；王朝统治该城至1080年，并于1030年在阿扎兹击败拜占庭皇帝罗曼努斯三世。留在阿拉伯的氏族在内志旧牧场延续部落名号。

en:
The County of Cleves was a Lower Rhine state centred on the castle of Kleve. It grew from the medieval Hettergau after local nobles received the surrounding imperial forest in the early eleventh century. In 1337 its count was Dietrich the Pious.

When Dietrich's son Count John died without heirs in 1368, Cleves passed to his nephew Adolf III of the Mark; the union with Mark became permanent in 1394, and in 1417 Sigismund raised its ruler to a duke. In 1521 the lands joined Jülich and Berg in the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg, whose princess Anne of Cleves was briefly queen of England.

The dynasty died out in 1609, and the 1614 Treaty of Xanten ending the Jülich Succession War gave Cleves and Mark to Brandenburg. After 1795 the Rhine lands became a French department and the remainder joined Berg; the 1815 Congress of Vienna returned Cleves to Prussia.
zh:
克莱沃伯国是莱茵河下游的邦国，以克莱沃堡为中心。11世纪初皇帝把附近帝国森林封给当地贵族，伯国在中世纪黑特高发展起来。1337年在位的是“虔诚者”狄奥多里克伯爵。

1368年狄奥多里克之子约翰伯爵无嗣而终，克莱沃传给外甥马克的阿道夫三世；1394年与马克伯国永久合并，1417年西吉斯蒙德将其统治者晋升为公爵。1521年克莱沃-马克与于利希、贝格合并为于利希-克莱沃-贝格联合公国，公主克莱沃的安娜曾短暂成为英格兰王后。

1609年王朝绝嗣，1614年结束于利希继承战争的《克桑滕条约》把克莱沃和马克划归勃兰登堡。1795年后莱茵河沿岸领土成为法国的一个省，其余部分并入贝格；1815年维也纳会议将克莱沃归还普鲁士。

en:
The Kalanga inhabited the lands of present-day southwestern Zimbabwe and northern Botswana. In the fifteenth century, the Torwa dynasty established the Kalanga kingdom of Butua around Khami, close to the goldfields west of Great Zimbabwe.

Butua supplied gold to traders and was recorded by Ahmad ibn Majid in 1502. A dispute between the king and his brother led to civil war in the 1640s; around 1683 Changamire Dombo conquered the kingdom.
zh:
卡兰加人居住在今津巴布韦西南部和博茨瓦纳北部。15世纪，托尔瓦王朝以靠近大津巴布韦西部金矿的卡米为中心，建立了卡兰加人的布图阿王国。

布图阿向商人供应黄金，艾哈迈德·伊本·马吉德于1502年记载了这个王国。国王与兄弟的争执在17世纪40年代引发内战；约1683年，昌加米雷·东博征服了布图阿。

en:
Kalahandi is a hilly kingdom of western Orissa, watered by the Tel and known from Panini to Ptolemy for its gemstones. In earlier centuries its forts at Asurgarh and Belkhandi made it the Mahakantara country, then the Chakrakota Mandala of the Chindaka Nagas.

In the twelfth century the Eastern Gangas absorbed it as the Kamala Mandala, ruled for them by Naga chiefs from the stronghold of Kalahandinagara, later called Junagarh. When Ganga power weakened after the fourteenth century, the Naga rajas transferred their allegiance to the Suryavamsi Gajapatis and ruled independently from 1568, claiming eighteen hill forts called garhs and crowning each new raja with the Khond chiefs to legitimize his rule.

In 1788 the Nagpur Marathas intervened and Raja Purussottama Deo had to accept recognition as a Maratha tributary, the condition in which the Naga kingdom entered its closing century.
zh:
卡拉汉迪是奥里萨西部山间王国，地处泰勒河流域，波你尼到托勒密的古籍都称其盛产宝石。凭借阿苏尔加尔、贝尔坎迪等要塞，此地先后是古称摩诃坎塔拉的要地和钦达卡·那加人的察羯罗科塔曼陀罗。

12世纪东恒伽王朝将其并入，改称卡马拉曼陀罗，由那加首领以卡拉汉迪那加拉（后称朱纳加尔）要塞为治所代其统治。14世纪后东恒伽衰微，那加罗阇转投苏利耶万希·伽阇波蒂王朝，1568年起独立称王，号称统辖十八座加尔山寨，并由孔德部落首领为新王行加冕礼确认正统。

1788年那格浦尔的马拉塔人介入，罗阇普鲁绍塔马·德奥被迫接受册封，卡拉汉迪沦为马拉塔人的纳贡邦，那加王国由此步入历史的最后阶段。

en:
Karauli was the small Rajput kingdom of the Jadaun clan, who claimed the Yaduvanshi lunar lineage and traced their rule to Raja Vijay Pal, a Mathura chief who built Bayana fort in 1040 and fought Ghaznavid raiders. His successor Timan Pal (1093 to 1159) spread Jadaun power across the Braj country as far as Alwar, Gwalior and Agra.

In 1348 Raja Arjun Pal Dev founded a new capital at Kalyanpuri, which in time became known as Karauli. The kingdom's fortunes sank when Sultan Mahmud Khalji of Malwa stormed Karauli in 1454, forcing its rajas to retreat to the fortress of Untagarh, and the ancestral capital was only recovered under the Mughal emperor Akbar by Raja Gopaldas.

Karauli kept its Jadaun rulers through the Mughal centuries, accepting an 1817 subsidiary alliance with the East India Company and becoming a British Rajasthan princely state.
zh:
格劳利是阇豆那氏族拉杰普特人的小王国，该族自称亚杜万什月亮世系，统治可追溯到来自马图拉的首领毗阇耶·波罗：他于1040年修建巴亚纳堡，抗击伽色尼劫掠者。后继者提曼·波罗（1093—1159年在位）把阇豆那势力扩展到整个布拉吉地区，远及阿尔瓦尔、瓜廖尔和阿格拉。

1348年，拉贾阿尔琼·波罗·提婆在格延普里建立新都，此地后来演变为格劳利。1454年马尔瓦苏丹马哈茂德·卡尔吉攻陷格劳利，国运转衰，拉贾们退守温塔加尔小堡；直到莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴时代，拉贾戈帕尔达斯才收复故都。

格劳利在整个莫卧儿时期都由阇豆那家族统治，1817年与英国东印度公司签订附属同盟，成为英属拉杰普塔纳的土邦。

en: Killaka was one of the Aymara lordships of the Andean highlands, located in the areas of Oruro and Potosí in Bolivia. These indigenous polities arose after the disintegration of Tiwanaku around 1100 and were incorporated into the Inca realm during its expansion in the fifteenth century.
zh: 基利亚卡是安第斯高地的艾马拉领地之一，位于玻利维亚奥鲁罗和波托西一带。约1100年蒂亚瓦纳科解体后，这些原住民政权相继兴起，并在15世纪印加扩张时被纳入其领土。

en:
Kolomna was a fortified town at the confluence of the Moskva and Oka rivers, first recorded in 1177. Mongol forces destroyed it in 1238, and in 1301 it passed into the Principality of Moscow.

Dmitry Donskoy gathered his troops at Kolomna before the Battle of Kulikovo in 1380. Under Vasily III, a stone kremlin was built there in 1525–1531 as part of Moscow's southern defences.
zh:
科洛姆纳是莫斯科河与奥卡河汇合处的一座设防城镇，最早见于1177年的记载。1238年蒙古军队摧毁了它，1301年它并入莫斯科公国。

1380年库利科沃战役前，德米特里·顿斯科伊在科洛姆纳集结军队。瓦西里三世统治时期，当地于1525—1531年建造了石砌克里姆林宫，作为莫斯科南部防线的一部分。

en:
The Principality of Klin was a small appanage of the Tver grand princes, centered on the fortress town of Klin on the Sestra River, northwest of Moscow. Klin first appears in the chronicles in 1317, and in 1319 it became the seat of a separate principality granted to Konstantin Mikhailovich, a younger son of Mikhail of Tver.

Konstantin's descendants, the junior branch of the Tver dynasty known as the Dorogobuzh princes, held Klin for the rest of the fourteenth century; its strong walls made it Tver's forward outpost in the long rivalry with Moscow.

In 1409 the fortress was sacked during the raid of the Tatar emir Edigu, and the appanage was wound up in 1418. The town itself was annexed by Ivan III of Moscow in 1482, together with the other Tver lands.
zh:
克林公国是特维尔大公治下的小封邑，中心在莫斯科西北方谢斯特拉河畔的要塞城镇克林。克林在编年史中首次出现于1317年，1319年成为独立封邑的治所，封给特维尔王公米哈伊尔的幼子康斯坦丁·米哈伊洛维奇。

康斯坦丁的后裔是特维尔王族的幼支，称多罗戈布日王公，在14世纪余下的时间里领有克林；坚固的城墙使克林成为特维尔同莫斯科长期对抗中的前哨。

1409年，鞑靼首领也迪该入侵时要塞遭洗劫，封邑于1418年被撤销。1482年，克林城与特维尔其他领地一起被莫斯科的伊凡三世吞并。

en:
The Kalapuya comprised autonomous groups in the Willamette Valley of present-day Oregon. Bands occupied territories along rivers including the Willamette and McKenzie, fishing and hunting and gathering roots, nuts and berries.

They traded camas and wapato through the Columbia River network and used seasonal burning to manage grasslands. Following the arrival of European and American traders and settlers, epidemics devastated Kalapuya communities in the early 19th century.
zh:
卡拉普亚人由多个自主群体组成，居住在今俄勒冈州的威拉米特河谷。各部占据威拉米特河、麦肯齐河等河流沿岸的土地，捕鱼狩猎，采集根茎、坚果和浆果。

他们通过哥伦比亚河贸易网络交换卡马斯和野慈姑，并以季节性烧荒管理草地。欧美商人和移民到来后，19世纪初的流行病重创了卡拉普亚社群。

en:
The Kalhor are one of the oldest Kurdish tribes, native to the borderlands between Kermanshah and Khanaqin, long the region's most powerful tribe. The late-sixteenth-century Sharafnama counts them among the four great Kurdish branches, and their chiefs claimed descent from Gudarz, a hero of the Shahnama. Their speech, Kalhori, is a dialect of Southern Kurdish.

The Kalhor kept a largely independent status until the rise of the Safavids in the early sixteenth century, when they submitted and served as frontier guards against the Ottomans, keeping their own government until the reign of Shah Tahmasp I.

After the Safavid collapse they regained much of their autonomy, and under the Zand dynasty they were among the chief allies of Karim Khan, who placed Kermanshah in Kurdish hands and married a Kalhor bride. In the Qajar period gradual sedentarization eroded their old tribal cohesion.
zh:
卡尔霍尔人是最古老的库尔德部落之一，世居克尔曼沙阿与哈奈根之间的边境，长期是当地最强部落。16世纪末的《荣誉之书》将其列为库尔德四大支系之一，其首领自称波斯史诗《列王纪》英雄古达尔兹的后裔。他们使用的卡尔霍尔方言属南库尔德语。

16世纪初萨非王朝兴起前，该部落大体保持独立；此后臣服萨非，充当抵御奥斯曼人的边防力量，并保留自己的地方政权直至塔赫玛斯普一世在位时期。

萨非崩溃后，卡尔霍尔人重获相当大的自治权；赞德王朝时期，他们是卡里木汗最主要的盟友之一，克尔曼沙阿被交到库尔德首领手中，卡里木汗还娶了一位卡尔霍尔新娘。卡扎尔时期，定居化逐渐瓦解旧有部落凝聚力。

en:
Kalisusu, also spelled Kulisusu and recorded in older sources as Callasusung, was a small kingdom on the northern coast of Buton Island, in present-day North Buton Regency. Its people spoke Kulisusu, a Celebic language of the Austronesian family forming a dialect chain with neighbouring tongues, and counted among the Buton peoples.

Within the Sultanate of Buton, Kalisusu held the special status of one of the Four Barata, the four guardian kingdoms, alongside Muna and two others. Their task was to support and defend the sultanate as the outriggers stabilize a canoe.

Kalisusu embraced Islam early: by the 1530s, when the sixth ruler of Buton was converted by the Johor-trained scholar Sheikh Abdul Wahid, the people of Callasusung were already reported to be entirely Muslim, and the former royal hall at Wasalabose long remained a centre of Buton ceremonial life.
zh:
卡利苏苏（又拼作库利苏苏，旧文献称卡拉苏松）是布敦岛北海岸的小王国，辖境在今北布敦县一带。居民使用南岛语系西里伯斯语族的库利苏苏语，与邻近语言构成方言链，属布敦族群之一。

在布敦苏丹国内，卡利苏苏享有“四大巴拉塔”之一的特殊地位，与穆纳等三国并列，如同独木舟的舷外支架，承担辅佐和拱卫苏丹国的职责。

卡利苏苏很早就皈依伊斯兰教：1530年代，当布敦第六代统治者在柔佛学者谢赫·阿卜杜勒·瓦希德引导下改宗时，记载中卡拉苏松的居民已全是穆斯林；其在瓦萨拉博塞的旧王家长厅，后来长期是布敦礼仪活动的中心。

en:
Kolathunadu, kingdom of the Kolattiri rajas, covered North Malabar between the Chandragiri and Korappuzha rivers, with its ancient seat at Ezhimala near Kannur.
