It grew from older Ezhimala and Mushaka chiefdoms into one of four great Malabar coast powers after the Chera and Pandya kingdoms faded in the twelfth century.

Ezhimala was already a trading port known to Roman-era sailors and later to Marco Polo and Ibn Battuta. The Kolattiris were the permanent northern rivals of the Zamorins of Kozhikode, while their realm gradually split into vassal chiefdoms.

A Bednur invasion in 1736 and 1737 broke much of the house's power, and its title passed to the Chirakkal raja. Between 1766 and 1792 the armies of Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan of Mysore plundered North Malabar and drove the family into Travancore; after the British defeat of Mysore they returned as landlords under the Company.
zh:
科拉舒纳德是科拉蒂里罗阇的王国，据有北马拉巴尔，在钱德拉吉里河与科拉普扎河之间，古都埃日马拉邻近坎努尔。它由埃日马拉、穆沙卡等古老酋长国发展而来，12世纪哲罗与潘地亚衰落后，成为马拉巴尔海岸四大强国之一。

埃日马拉早是罗马水手所知的贸易港，后来马可·波罗、伊本·白图泰等旅人也曾提及。科拉蒂里家族一直是科泽科德扎莫林的宿敌，国土逐渐分裂为若干附庸小邦。

1736至1737年贝德努尔入侵重创王室，古老称号转入吉拉卡尔罗阇一系。1766至1792年，迈索尔海德尔·阿里与蒂普苏丹劫掠北马拉巴尔，科拉蒂里家族逃入特拉凡哥尔；英国击败迈索尔后，他们作为东印度公司地主重返故土。

en:
Kullu was a Hindu hill kingdom in the Beas valley of the Punjab Hills, whose rajas held court at Naggar for some fourteen hundred years. Tradition credits Visudh Pal with founding the state, and early on it was overshadowed by Chamba, whose Meru Varman defeated its raja; the valley only regained freedom with Bushahr's help after six generations. The Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang, visiting in 634 or 635, found a fertile enclosed valley with about twenty Buddhist monasteries and fifteen Hindu temples.

In the seventeenth century Raja Jagat Singh, ruling from 1637 to 1672, moved the capital to Sultanpur and in 1650 installed an image of Rama in the new Raghunath temple, which became the kingdom's chief shrine.
zh:
古卢是旁遮普山丘比亚斯河谷中的印度教山间王国，历代罗阇在纳加尔建都约一千四百年。传统认为维苏德·帕尔是国家的开创者；建国初期古卢受昌巴压制，昌巴的梅鲁·瓦尔曼击败其罗阇，谷地六代人之后才靠布沙尔相助恢复自由。634年或635年，中国求法僧玄奘到此，看到群山环抱的肥沃谷地，约有二十座佛教寺院和十五座印度教神庙。

17世纪，1637年至1672年在位的罗阇贾格特·辛格把都城迁往苏丹布尔，并于1650年在新建的拉古纳特神庙供奉罗摩像，这座神庙后来成为王国主神庙。

en:
Kolwa, also written Kolwah, is the inland valley country of eastern Makran, centered on the oases of Awaran, Jhao and Mashkay between the coastal plain and the Khuzdar highlands. It is arid Baloch tribal land, held from the twelfth century onward by the pastoral chiefs who dominated the interior of Baluchistan.

The region's most famous son was Mir Chakar Rind, born at Ashal in Kolwah, who succeeded his father as Great Chief of the Baloch around 1487 and built the first unified Baloch confederation with its capital at Sibi, stretching from Kerman to the Sindh border; he died in the Punjab in 1565 after leading the Rind migration eastward.
zh:
戈尔瓦又拼作科尔瓦，是莫克兰东部的内陆河谷地带，以阿瓦兰、焦和马什凯等绿洲为中心，夹在沿海平原与胡兹达尔高地之间。这里是干旱的俾路支部落之地，12世纪以后便由主宰俾路支斯坦内陆的游牧首领们掌握。

此地最著名的人物是出生在戈尔瓦阿沙尔的米尔·查卡尔·林德，他约在1487年继承父位成为俾路支人的大首领，建立了第一个统一的俾路支联盟，定都锡比，疆域西起克尔曼、东抵信德边境；后来他率领林德部东迁，于1565年在旁遮普去世。

en:
Kamata was the medieval kingdom that succeeded ancient Kamarupa in western Assam and northern Bengal. Sandhya, ruler of Kamarupanagara, repelled Delhi general Iuzbak's attack in 1257 and moved his capital to Kamatapur, styling himself Kamateswara.

In the fourteenth century the Narayan kings ruled there, Durlabh Narayan holding Kamatapur in 1337. The invasion of Bengal's Sultan Sikandar Shah weakened King Indra Narayan and let chief Arimatta usurp the throne, and in the mid-fifteenth century the Khen dynasty took over.

Its last king Nilambar ruled until Alauddin Husain Shah of Bengal overran Kamatapur in 1498 after a long siege, though the Baro-Bhuyan landlords soon expelled the garrison. Biswa Singha defeated them in 1515 and founded the Koch dynasty; after Nara Narayan's death in 1587 the realm split into Koch Bihar and Koch Hajo, the eastern half absorbed by the Ahoms in the seventeenth century.
zh:
卡玛塔是继承古迦摩缕波、据有阿萨姆西部与孟加拉北部的中世纪王国。迦摩缕波城的君主桑迪亚1257年击退德里将领伊兹巴克后，把都城西迁至迦摩多城，自称迦摩多湿婆罗。

14世纪纳拉扬世系统治此地，1337年杜尔拉布纳拉扬坐镇迦摩多城。孟加拉苏丹锡坎达尔沙的入侵削弱了国王因陀罗纳拉扬，首领阿里马塔趁机篡位；15世纪中叶肯王朝取而代之。

末代国王尼兰巴尔在位时，孟加拉的阿拉乌丁·侯赛因沙经长期围攻，于1498年攻陷迦摩多城；不过巴罗-布扬地主很快驱逐了驻军。1515年比斯瓦·辛格击败他们，建立科赫王朝。1587年纳拉·纳拉扬死后，王国分裂为科赫比哈尔和科赫哈焦，东半部在17世纪被阿洪姆吞并。

en:
Khamag Mongol was a confederation of Mongol tribes in the basins of the Onon, Kherlen and Tuul rivers during the twelfth century. Its first recorded khan, Khabul of the Borjigin clan, resisted the Jin; after his successor Ambaghai was executed by the Jin, Khabul's son Hotula fought the Tatars to avenge him.

The confederation fragmented after Yesugei's death in 1171. His son Temujin became khan in 1189 and united the Mongolian Plateau in 1206, when he took the title Genghis Khan.
zh:
蒙兀是12世纪活跃于斡难河、怯绿连河和土拉河流域的蒙古部族联盟。有记载的首位汗是孛儿只斤氏的合不勒，他抵抗金朝；继任者俺巴孩被金朝处死后，合不勒之子忽图剌向塔塔儿人作战争取复仇。

1171年也速该死后，蒙兀联盟陷入分裂。他的儿子铁木真于1189年成为汗，并于1206年统一蒙古高原，获得成吉思汗的称号。

en: The K'omoks were Coast Salish communities around the northern Salish Sea, including the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island and inlets on the mainland. Around the time of European exploration in 1792, the southward expansion of the Laich-kwil-tach displaced northern K'omoks groups. The Ieekan moved south from the Campbell River area between 1830 and 1835.
zh: 科莫克斯人是萨利什海北部的海岸萨利什社群，分布在温哥华岛的科莫克斯谷地和大陆的各处海湾。欧洲人于1792年前后勘探这一带时，莱奇奎尔塔奇人向南扩张，迫使北部科莫克斯群体迁徙。伊坎人于1830—1835年间从坎贝尔河一带南迁。

en:
Kumalarang, also called Sibuguey, was a Subanon kingdom on the Zamboanga peninsula of Mindanao, recorded in the Ming court annals as early as the fifteenth century.

In 1417 the Yongle Emperor sent the eunuch Zhang Qian with brocades and silks to its ruler, Kanlai Ipentun, who travelled to China in 1420 and was received with honours comparable to those given to the king of Sulu; he petitioned to enter the Ming tributary system. On his journey home he fell ill and died in Fujian in May 1421, where the Ming authorities buried him with the posthumous title Kangjing, and his son Lapi succeeded and sent another embassy in 1424.

After Sharif Kabungsuwan founded the Sultanate of Maguindanao in 1515, Kumalarang was reduced to a vassal keeping wide local autonomy, and Islam gradually spread until the kingdom itself became a sultanate.
zh:
古麻剌朗又称锡布盖，是棉兰老岛三宝颜半岛上的苏巴农人王国，早在15世纪就见于明朝宫廷的实录。

1417年，永乐帝派宦官张谦携带锦绮纱罗出使其王干剌义亦奔敦；干剌义亦奔敦于1420年亲赴中国，受到与苏禄国王同等规格的礼遇，并请求纳入明朝朝贡体系。归国途中他于1421年5月在福建病逝，明朝地方官为其治丧，赐谥号康靖；其子剌苾继位，并于1424年再遣使臣来华。

1515年谢里夫·卡本苏万建立马京达瑙苏丹国后，古麻剌朗沦为其附庸，但保留了很大的自治权；伊斯兰教逐渐传播，这个王国最终也转变为苏丹国。

en:
Cammin was the church principality of Pomerania. Pope Innocent II founded it as a diocese in 1140, after Otto of Bamberg's missions converted the region between 1124 and 1128. The see moved from Wolin via Grobe Abbey on Usedom to Cammin on the Oder lagoon in 1175 and was made an exempt diocese under Rome.

In 1248 the bishops exchanged the Stargard lands with the Griffin dukes for Kolberg, and their secular territory, administered from Köslin, grew to include that town and Köslin; Köslin received town rights in 1266. It remained a subfief of Pomerania, winning imperial immediacy only briefly in 1345.

After Pomerania adopted Lutheranism in 1534 the diocese withered. The last pre-Reformation bishop died in 1544; from 1556 Griffin dukes ruled the secular principality as titular bishops, and in 1650 the last incumbent resigned and Cammin was secularised into Brandenburg-Prussia.
zh:
卡明是波美拉尼亚的教会诸侯领地。班贝格的奥托于1124年至1128年间传教使该地区皈依之后，教皇英诺森二世于1140年设立教区。主教座堂先设在沃林，后经乌泽多姆岛的格罗贝修道院，于1175年迁到奥得河潟湖畔的卡明；教皇将其定为直属罗马的豁免教区。

1248年，主教们以施塔加德领地与格里芬公爵交换科沃布热格，由科沙林管理的世俗领地逐渐涵盖科沃布热格与科沙林，科沙林于1266年获得城市权。主教采邑始终是波美拉尼亚的次级封邑，仅在1345年短暂获得帝国直辖地位。

1534年波美拉尼亚改宗路德宗后，旧教区走向衰亡。末位宗教改革前的主教于1544年去世；自1556年起格里芬公爵以领衔主教身份统治这块世俗领地，1650年末位在职主教辞职，卡明被世俗化并入勃兰登堡-普鲁士。

en:
Kumaon, or Kurmanchal in older records, was a Himalayan Hindu state between the Tons and Karnali rivers. Katyuri rajas united its valleys in the seventh century and built Jageshwar's stone temples, but their eleventh-century collapse left the hills fragmented. Then the Chand dynasty rose: founder Som Chand, a Rajput immigrant, settled at Champawat perhaps in the 1020s.

In 1337 the Chand raja held only the Champawat hills, and the dynasty reunited Kumaon only in the mid-fifteenth century. The capital moved to Almora in 1563; Rudra Chand's 1587 visit to Akbar brought Kumaon into Mughal tributary relations.

The Rohillas sacked Almora in 1744 for seven months, bought off with three lakh rupees. In 1790 the Gorkhas overran Kumaon and expelled its last raja. The British took Almora in 1815, and the 1816 Treaty of Sugauli assigned Kumaon to British India.
zh:
库马翁在古文献中称库尔马查尔，是地处通斯河与格尔纳利河之间的喜马拉雅印度教政权。7世纪卡蒂乌里王公统一诸河谷，修建贾格什瓦尔石庙；11世纪该王朝崩溃后，山地陷入分裂。此后昌德王朝崛起：始祖索姆·昌德是拉杰普特移民，约11世纪20年代在恰姆帕瓦蒂立足。

1337年昌德王公仅保有恰姆帕瓦蒂一带山地，昌德王朝直到15世纪中叶才重新统一库马翁。1563年都城迁往阿尔莫拉；鲁德拉·昌德1587年觐见阿克巴，使库马翁成为莫卧儿朝贡国。

1744年罗希拉人攻陷阿尔莫拉并占据七个月，在收受三十万卢比后撤军。1790年廓尔喀人征服库马翁，驱逐末代王公。1815年英军攻占阿尔莫拉，1816年《苏高利条约》将库马翁划归英属印度。

en:
Kempten in the Allgäu is one of Germany's oldest town sites: Strabo mentioned a Celtic settlement in 50 BC, and Romans built Cambodunum, probably the first capital of Raetia. The Benedictine Abbey of Kempten, founded around 752 as the region's first monastery, became under Charlemagne's queen Hildegard one of the richest Carolingian churches.

Saint Ulrich rebuilt it in 941 after Magyar raids; Henry IV confirmed imperial immediacy in 1062, and Frederick II gave its abbots comital rights and ducal rank in 1213. In 1289 Rudolf I made the town a Free Imperial City, a rival within the abbey's lands.

The city turned Protestant in 1527, the abbey joining the Catholic League, and Swedish troops burned the monastery in 1632. The abbey held the Holy Roman Empire's last witch trial in 1775 and was secularized to Bavaria in 1803; the two Kemptens united in 1819.
zh:
阿尔高的肯普滕是德国最古老的城址之一：斯特拉波早在公元前50年就提到过当地的凯尔特聚落，罗马人后来在此建起坎博杜努姆，它可能是雷蒂亚的第一个省会。约752年本笃会肯普滕修道院建立，是当地第一座修道院，在查理曼王后希尔德加德庇佑下成为加洛林帝国最富有的教会之一。

马扎尔人劫掠后，圣乌尔里希于941年将其重建；1062年亨利四世确认其帝国直辖地位，1213年腓特烈二世授予修道院长伯爵权利和公爵头衔。1289年鲁道夫一世把城区立为帝国自由城市，在修道院领地内形成分庭抗礼的实体。

城市于1527年改宗新教，修道院加入天主教联盟；1632年瑞典军队焚毁修道院。1775年修道院主持了神圣罗马帝国最后一次女巫审判，1803年它被世俗化并划归巴伐利亚，两个肯普滕于1819年合二为一。

en:
The Kimotsuki were a warrior family of Ōsumi Province who took their name from Kimotsuki district. They supported the Southern Court in the fourteenth century and later became rivals of the Shimazu.

Kimotsuki Kanetsugu allied with the Itō and defeated the Shimazu at Takeharayama in 1561, then took Shibushi Castle in 1562. The family submitted to the Shimazu in 1574 and lost its lands in 1581; its descendants continued as retainers of Satsuma domain.
zh:
肝付氏是大隅国的武家，以肝属郡为氏。14世纪他们支持南朝，后来成为岛津氏的对手。

肝付兼续与伊东氏结盟，1561年在竹原山击败岛津军，次年攻下志布志城。肝付氏于1574年臣服岛津氏，1581年失去领地；其后人继续作为萨摩藩家臣存续。

en: The Khmu are an Austroasiatic-speaking people indigenous to northern Laos. As Tai and Lao peoples moved into the lowlands, Khmu communities settled higher ground and practised swidden agriculture.
zh: 克木人是老挝北部讲南亚语系语言的土著族群。随着傣语和老挝语族群迁入低地，克木人转而居住在较高的山地，以刀耕火种为生。

en:
The Kana, known to Spanish chroniclers as the Canas, were an Aymara people who took shape after the collapse of Tiwanaku around 1000. They lived beyond the Collao plateau, in cold grasslands north of the Vilcanota knot around the river's headwaters in southern Peru; their chief town Ayaviri became the district's main Inca centre.

With their neighbours the Canchis, the Canas dealt freely with the rising Incas. Earlier a Lupaca curaca had defeated the Canas and seized their lands, but around 1350 Inca Roca hired Canas and Canchis war bands against the Chankas, and they later served as auxiliaries in the Andahuaylas campaign for plunder.

When Viracocha Inca marched against the Collao kingdoms early in the fifteenth century, the Canas submitted without fighting. A temple went up at Ayaviri, the Canas supplied passing Inca armies, and their lands joined the Collasuyo quarter.
zh:
卡纳人在西班牙编年史中称卡纳斯人，是约1000年蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后形成的一支艾马拉人。他们不住在科利亚奥高原本体，而生活在维尔卡诺塔山结以北、维尔卡诺塔河源头一带的寒冷草原，即秘鲁南部；治所阿亚维里后来成为印卡时代该地区的主要中心。

卡纳人与邻邦坎奇人都与崛起的印卡人自由往来。他们早先被卢帕卡首领击败、土地遭夺占，但约1350年印卡·罗卡雇用两族战团攻打昌卡人；两族后来又作为辅助部队参加安达瓦伊拉斯之战，以换取战利品。

15世纪初维拉科查·印卡征讨科利亚奥诸王国时，卡纳人不战而降。印卡人在阿亚维里修建神庙，卡纳人为过境印卡军队提供补给，其地后来成为帝国科利亚苏尤的一部分。

en:
The Kawanobe were a branch of the Naka warrior family based at Noguchi Castle in northern Hitachi Province. In 1336 Kawanobe Sukeshizu fought for the Southern Court alongside Naka Michitatsu against the Satake, but was defeated and killed at Hitorimatsumine.

Surviving members continued the line, and a later descendant submitted to the Satake. In 1590 Kawanobe Shigeyuki fought for Satake Yoshishige against the Edo clan; he remained in Hitachi when the Satake were transferred to Akita.
zh:
川野边氏是那珂武家的一支，以常陆国北部的野口城为据点。1336年，川野边资镇与那珂通辰为南朝对抗佐竹氏，在独松峰战败身亡。

幸存的族人延续了家系，后来的后裔归附佐竹氏。1590年，川野边重行为佐竹义重讨伐江户氏；佐竹氏转封秋田时，他留在了常陆。

en:
Konda was a Mansi principality in western Siberia, originally part of the Pelym principality. Its capital was Kondinsky Gorodok, also called Kartauzh.

In 1594 Russian forces, aided by warriors from Koda, destroyed the principality and captured Prince Agay and his family. In 1715 Grigory Novitsky recorded the Christianization of the Konda Mansi and resistance to the destruction of their sanctuary.
zh:
孔达是西西伯利亚的曼西人公国，原属佩雷姆公国。其首府孔金斯基城又称卡尔陶日。

1594年，俄军在科达战士协助下消灭了孔达公国，俘获阿盖公及其家人。1715年，格里戈里·诺维茨基记载了孔达曼西人的基督教化，以及他们对毁坏圣所的抵抗。

en:
The Kaneko of Iyo descended from a warrior family that took its name from Kaneko in Musashi province. Kaneko Ietada gained the stewardship of Nii in Iyo, where his descendants established themselves.

In 1585 Kaneko Motoie, lord of Kaneko Castle, resisted Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasion of Shikoku. His forces fought Kobayakawa Takakage's army, and Motoie died after the fall of his castles. His brother Motoharu later founded Jigenji around 1618 to commemorate the dead.
zh:
伊予金子氏出自武藏国的武家，家族以当地金子之名为氏。金子家忠获得伊予国新居的地头职，其后裔在当地扎根。

1585年，金子城主金子元宅抵抗丰臣秀吉的四国征伐。他率军与小早川隆景交战，城池陷落后战死。其弟元春后来于1618年前后建立慈眼寺，为死者祈福。

en:
Kong began as a market town in the grasslands of north-eastern Ivory Coast, first farmed by Gur-speaking Senufo and Tyefo villagers. From the 1300s Dyula merchants moving south from Mali founded trading cities including Begho, Bondoukou and Kong.

Muslim Dyula settled among animist farmers and grew rich carrying gold and kola nuts between the Niger bend and Gold Coast posts. Kong stayed a merchant republic of rival war houses and clerics until the early 1700s, when the Dyula leader Seku Watara united its factions and built the Kong, or Wattara, Empire from 1710.

His war houses seized the Black Volta routes, reached Sya in 1737 and campaigned to Djenné on the Niger in 1739, while Kong became a centre of Islamic learning. After Seku's death around 1745 the empire loosened into near-autonomous Watara fiefs whose wealth and mosques drew caravans across the western Sudan.
zh:
孔格起初是科特迪瓦东北部草原上的一座商镇，当地最早由讲古尔语的塞努福和提埃福农人开垦。14世纪起，迪尤拉商人从马里南迁，建立贝戈、邦杜库和孔格等商业城市。

穆斯林迪尤拉人定居在信奉万物有灵的农民之中，靠在尼日尔河湾与黄金海岸商站之间贩运黄金和柯拉果致富。孔格长期是由彼此竞争的武士家族和宗教世家组成的商人城邦，18世纪初迪尤拉首领谢库·瓦塔拉统一城内各派，从1710年起建立孔格帝国（又称瓦塔拉帝国）。

他的武士家族夺取黑沃尔特河商路，1737年兵临西亚，1739年远征至尼日尔河畔的杰内，孔格也成为伊斯兰学术中心。1745年前后谢库去世后，帝国松散化为近乎自治的瓦塔拉封地，其财富和清真寺吸引西苏丹各地的驼队。

en:
The Knights Hospitaller grew from a Jerusalem pilgrim hospital founded by Amalfi merchants under Blessed Gerard. Pope Paschal II recognized the order in 1113, and in the 1120s and 1130s it took military vows to defend the crusader states, fighting until Acre fell in 1291. From Cyprus they conquered Byzantine Rhodes, whose capital fell in 1310.

In 1337 they policed the Aegean from Rhodes, defeating Andronikos III and Turkish allies in 1334. They held Smyrna from 1374 to Timur's conquest in 1402 and repelled Rhodes assaults by the Mamluks in 1444 and by Mehmed the Conqueror in 1480.

In 1522 Suleiman the Magnificent's six-month siege of Rhodes forced the knights to surrender and withdraw. Charles V gave them Malta in 1530; they survived the Great Siege of 1565 and built Valletta, until Napoleon seized Malta in 1798 and dispersed them.
zh:
医院骑士团的前身是阿马尔菲商人在耶路撒冷创办、由真福杰拉尔德主持的朝圣者医院。1113年教皇帕斯加尔二世承认其修会地位，12世纪20至30年代它许下军事誓愿保卫十字军国家，一直作战到1291年阿卡陷落。骑士们随后避居塞浦路斯，继而攻占拜占庭的罗得岛，岛上首府于1310年陷落。

1337年他们以罗得岛为基地巡守爱琴海，1334年击败安德洛尼卡三世及其突厥盟军。他们自1374年据守士麦那，1402年为帖木儿所克；又于1444年击退马穆鲁克人、1480年击退征服者穆罕默德二世对罗得岛的进攻。

1522年苏莱曼大帝围攻罗得岛达六个月，骑士团最终投降撤离。1530年查理五世把马耳他赐给骑士团，他们在那里顶住1565年马耳他大围攻并兴建瓦莱塔城，直到1798年拿破仑夺取马耳他，骑士团解散流散。

en:
Kanker was a small forest kingdom in the hills north of Bastar, on the upper reaches of the Mahanadi, whose people were mostly Gonds speaking Chhattisgarhi, Halbi and Gondi. It took shape in the fifteenth century, when the old Bastar kingdom split into Bastar and Kanker branches.

Its rajas traced their Chandra dynasty to Veer Kanhar Dev, a prince said to have come from Jagannath Puri and ruled at Sihawa until 1404. Under the Haihaiyavansi kings of Chhattisgarh the Kanker raja held the Dhamtari country as a tributary.

When the Haihaiyavansi kingdom fell to the Marathas in 1740 Kanker passed under Maratha supremacy, owing a military contingent of five hundred men, and the Bhonsles of Nagpur annexed it in 1809. The deposed raja Bhup Deo was restored by the British resident in 1818 against a small tribute, remitted in 1823.
zh:
甘盖尔是巴斯塔尔以北山区的森林小邦，地处默哈讷迪河上游，居民多为贡德人，讲切蒂斯格尔语、哈尔比语和贡德语。它形成于15世纪，当时旧巴斯塔尔王国分裂为巴斯塔尔和甘盖尔两支。

甘盖尔的罗阇把月族王朝追溯到毗罗·坎哈尔·提婆：相传这位王子来自贾格纳特普里，曾在锡哈瓦统治至1404年。在切蒂斯格尔的海诃耶瓦姆西王朝治下，甘盖尔罗阇领有达姆塔里地区，向其称臣纳贡。

1740年海诃耶瓦姆西王国亡于马拉塔人后，甘盖尔转入马拉塔宗主权之下，负有提供五百人军队的义务；1809年那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族将其直接吞并。被废的罗阇布普·提婆于1818年经英国驻扎官协助复位，只需缴纳少量贡赋，这笔贡赋又于1823年免除。

en:
The Kawano were a powerful warrior family of Iyo Province, said to descend from the Ochi, and held Yuzuki Castle from the Muromachi period. Most of the family opposed the Kamakura shogunate in 1333, but its head Michimori remained loyal to it and lost influence under the new government.

In 1584 the Chōsokabe attacked Kawano strongholds, prompting the Mōri to send help. During Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasion of Shikoku in 1585, Kawano Michinao surrendered Yuzuki Castle to Kobayakawa Takakage and lost his domain.
zh:
河野氏是伊予国的有力武家，据称出自越智氏，室町时代起以汤筑城为居城。1333年家族大多数人反抗镰仓幕府，但家督通盛仍效忠幕府，在新政权下失势。

1584年，长宗我部氏进攻河野氏据点，毛利氏派兵援助。1585年丰臣秀吉进攻四国时，河野通直向小早川隆景交出汤筑城，失去了领地。

en:
The Kutsuna were a naval clan based in the Kutsuna Islands of Iyo Province. Kutsuna Shigekiyo rose for Emperor Go-Daigo in 1331, but changed sides in 1336 and joined the Ashikaga.

His brother Yoshinori remained loyal to the Southern Court and held Kamiura Castle. From 1339 to 1342 he sheltered Prince Kaneyoshi on Kutsuna Island, and in 1348 he attacked the Shiwaku Islands in Sanuki.
zh:
忽那氏是以伊予国忽那诸岛为根据地的水军氏族。忽那重清于1331年响应后醍醐天皇，却在1336年转而投靠足利氏。

他的弟弟义范仍效忠南朝，以神浦城为据点。1339年至1342年，义范在忽那岛庇护怀良亲王，又于1348年进攻赞岐的盐饱诸岛。

en:
Konawe was a Tolaki kingdom on the southeast peninsula of Sulawesi, formed from local Tolaki chiefdoms merged into one confederation. Its founder, named as Wekoila, ruled first from Olo-oloho on the Konoweha river before the court moved to Unaaha, and its kings bore the title Mokole.

Under Mokole Tebawo it reached its height, covering the Konawe districts and Kendari port. He divided it into four provinces under the Siwole Mbatohu system and a seven-member cabinet, the Pitu Dula Batu, with portfolios from foreign affairs to security. The people farmed rice, herded buffalo and fished; all land was crown land apportioned through the nobility.

Originally animist, Konawe met Islam in the 1500s through Buton envoys and Muslim traders from Bone and other ports; the ruler Lakidende later converted, and under Lakidende II Islam became the kingdom's official religion.
zh:
哥那威是苏拉威西东南半岛上的托拉基人王国，由当地托拉基小邦合并为一个联盟而来。传说建国者韦科伊拉最初驻跸科诺韦哈河畔的奥洛奥洛霍，后来王都迁至乌纳阿哈，君主称莫科莱。

莫科莱·特巴沃治下王国达到鼎盛，势力覆盖哥那威诸地区和肯达里港。他把全国划为四个行省，称西沃莱·姆巴托胡，设七人内阁皮图·杜拉·巴图，职掌从外交到防务诸务。居民种稻、养水牛、捕鱼，土地全部归国王所有，由贵族分配。

哥那威原本信奉泛灵论，1500年代（16世纪）通过布敦使者以及波尼等地的穆斯林商人初次接触伊斯兰教；后来君主拉基登德皈依，到拉基登德二世时伊斯兰教成为王国官方宗教。

en:
Konstanz stands where the Rhine leaves Lake Constance, on the site of Roman Constantia. A bishopric founded around 585 made it for over a thousand years the seat of one of the Empire's largest dioceses. Its Rhine bridge and linen trade brought wealth, and it became a Free Imperial City in 1192.

The Council of Constance, 1414 to 1418, ended the Western Schism by electing Pope Martin V and condemned Jan Hus, burned in 1415. After the Swiss took its Thurgau hinterland in 1460, it failed to join them and entered the Swabian League instead.

It embraced the Reformation in the 1520s, but in 1548 Charles V imposed the imperial ban and handed it to Habsburg Austria, which re-Catholicised the town. In 1806 it passed to the Grand Duchy of Baden, and the old bishopric was dissolved in 1821.
zh:
康斯坦茨位于博登湖莱茵河出口处，坐落在罗马要塞孔斯坦提亚旧址上。约585年设立的主教区，使该城在此后一千多年间成为神圣罗马帝国最大主教区之一的驻地。莱茵河桥梁与亚麻贸易带来财富，1192年它成为帝国自由城市。

1414至1418年的康斯坦茨宗教会议选出教宗玛尔定五世，结束西方教会大分裂，并判处扬·胡斯火刑，他于1415年被烧死。1460年瑞士人夺取图尔高腹地后，康斯坦茨加入瑞士同盟未果，转而加入施瓦本同盟。

16世纪20年代它皈依新教，但1548年查理五世颁布帝国禁令，将它交给哈布斯堡奥地利，天主教随之恢复。1806年康斯坦茨并入巴登大公国，旧主教区于1821年撤销。

en: Africa was the name given to Sicily's possessions on the coast of Ifriqiya, in present-day Tunisia and neighbouring lands. Roger II conquered coastal towns in the 1140s, but the Almohads took them in 1158–1160.
zh: 阿非利加是西西里王国在伊夫里基叶沿海属地的名称，位于今天的突尼斯及邻近地区。罗杰二世在12世纪40年代征服了沿海城镇，但穆瓦希德王朝于1158—1160年夺取了这些地方。

en:
Koda was a Khanty principality on the Ob River in western Siberia, with its capital at Shorkar. Its princes acknowledged Moscow after an expedition in 1483, but Prince Moldan resisted and was defeated again in 1499.

In 1583 Prince Alach allied with Yermak's Cossacks and received the lands of Belogorye. Koda supplied warriors for Russian campaigns, though Alach briefly sided with Khan Kuchum in 1585. Russia annexed the principality in 1643.
zh:
科达是西西伯利亚鄂毕河畔的汉特人公国，首府位于肖尔卡尔。1483年莫斯科出兵后，科达诸公承认其宗主权，但莫尔丹公发动抵抗，并于1499年再次战败。

1583年，阿拉奇公与叶尔马克的哥萨克结盟，获得别洛戈里耶的土地。科达为俄军征战提供战士，但阿拉奇在1585年曾短暂转而支持库楚姆汗。1643年，俄国吞并了科达公国。

en: The Kingdom of Jerusalem was a Crusader state founded after the capture of Jerusalem in 1099. After Saladin took the city in 1187, the restored kingdom ruled from Acre until the Mamluks captured it in 1291.
zh: 耶路撒冷王国是1099年十字军攻占耶路撒冷后建立的国家。1187年萨拉丁夺取该城后，复建的王国以阿卡为都，直到1291年被马穆鲁克攻陷。

en:
The Kōsaka were a Shinano warrior family named for Kōsaka in Saku district and descended from the Shigeno. They built Maki Castle in northern Shinano, where Kōsaka Shinkaku rose for the Southern Court in 1336 and fought the Murakami and Takanashi.

During the Sengoku period Kōsaka Muneshige submitted to Takeda Shingen and surrendered Maki Castle without a fight. In 1556 Shingen ordered him to move to Hanishina district, and Baba Nobuharu took over the castle.
zh:
香坂氏是信浓国的武家，出自滋野氏，得名于佐久郡的香坂。香坂氏在信浓北部修建牧城，香坂心觉于1336年在此为南朝举兵，与村上氏和高梨氏交战。

战国时代，香坂宗重臣服于武田信玄，不战交出牧城。1556年信玄命他迁往埴科郡，由马场信春接管牧城。

en:
Cologne was the Electorate of Cologne, its archbishop's temporal principality and one of the Empire's three ecclesiastical electors. The see dated to Roman Colonia Agrippina; in 953 Otto I made his brother Archbishop Bruno a duke, endowing it with Lower Rhine lands and, later, Westphalia.

After Worringen in 1288 the city was effectively self-governing and the archbishops kept their court at Bonn; in 1475 it became a Free Imperial City. The 1337 elector Walram of Jülich won the see in 1332 with his brother's gold and founded Cologne Charterhouse in 1334.

In 1582 Archbishop Gebhard Truchsess turned to Calvinism and tried to secularize the electorate, triggering the Cologne War; Bavarian rival Ernst won, and from 1583 to 1761 the see was a Wittelsbach secundogeniture at the heart of the Counter-Reformation. French troops occupied Cologne and Bonn in 1794; the left bank was annexed in 1801 and the remaining territories secularized in 1803.
zh:
科隆即科隆选侯国，是科隆大主教的世俗领地，也是帝国三个教会选帝侯之一。主教座可追溯到罗马时代的科隆尼亚·阿格里皮娜；953年奥托一世封其兄、大主教布鲁诺为公爵，把莱茵河下游领地及后来的威斯特伐利亚公国授予教会。

1288年沃林根战役战败后，科隆城近乎自治，大主教转而在波恩理政；1475年科隆成为帝国自由城市。1337年在任的选侯于利希的瓦尔拉姆，1332年靠兄长花钱运作登上大主教之位，并于1334年创立科隆加尔都西会修道院。

1582年大主教格布哈德·特鲁赫泽斯改宗加尔文派，企图将选侯国世俗化，引发科隆战争；巴伐利亚的恩斯特获胜，1583年至1761年间该主教座成为维特尔斯巴赫家族的次子世袭领地，处于反宗教改革的核心。1794年法军占领科隆和波恩，莱茵河左岸于1801年被吞并，残余领地1803年被世俗化。

en:
The Kingdom of Kongo emerged around 1390 in central Africa through an alliance between the rulers of Mpemba Kasi and Mbata. Its kings ruled from Mbanza Kongo, and their authority extended across several provinces and neighbouring kingdoms.

Portuguese visitors reached the capital in 1491, when the royal family encountered Christianity. King Afonso I, who ruled in the early sixteenth century, promoted conversion, strengthened royal power and corresponded with European rulers as the Atlantic slave trade expanded.
zh:
刚果王国约于1390年在中非兴起，源于姆彭巴卡西与姆巴塔统治者之间的联盟。国王以姆班扎刚果为都，其权威覆盖数个省份和周边王国。

葡萄牙人于1491年抵达都城，王室由此接触基督教。16世纪初在位的阿方索一世推动改宗、加强王权，并在大西洋奴隶贸易扩张之际与欧洲统治者通信。

en:
Goryeo was founded in 918 by the general Wang Kŏn, who ended the Later Three Kingdoms division and made Kaesong his capital. Its kings repelled Khitan Liao invasions in 993–1020 and held off the Jurchen; Buddhism became the state religion, and celadon and the Tripitaka Koreana, some 81,000 woodblocks carved from 1236, marked its artistic peak.

From 1170 military strongmen, above all the Ch'oe family, held power. During the Mongol campaigns of 1231–1259 the court fled to Ganghwa Island, after which Goryeo was a Yuan marriage vassal for some eighty years. In 1337 King Chungsuk reigned.

As the Yuan crumbled, Gongmin purged the pro-Mongol faction in 1356, retook the northern lands and repelled Red Turban invasions in 1359 and 1361; in the 1380s Goryeo fleets, with Ch'oe Musŏn's gunpowder weapons, crushed Japanese pirates. In 1388 General Yi Sŏnggye turned back a campaign against the Ming and seized power, founding the Joseon dynasty in 1392 and ending Goryeo.
zh:
高丽由将领王建建于918年，他结束后三国的分裂，定都开城。高丽击退993—1020年契丹辽朝的入侵，抵御女真进攻；佛教成为国教，高丽青瓷与1236年起雕刻的约八万一千块《高丽大藏经》经版代表其艺术巅峰。

1170年起武臣专权，以崔氏为最；1231—1259年蒙古屡次入侵时朝廷避居江华岛，此后高丽成为元朝的联姻附庸约八十年。1337年在位的是忠肃王。

元朝衰落后，恭愍王于1356年肃清亲蒙古派、收复北方失地，并在1359年和1361年击退红巾军；14世纪80年代，高丽水师凭借崔茂宣的火药武器大破倭寇。1388年，将领李成桂在出征明朝途中回师夺权，1392年建立朝鲜王朝，高丽灭亡。

en:
Kostroma, at the Kostroma River's mouth on the Volga, was officially founded in 1152 by Yury Dolgoruky and, like other north-eastern towns, sacked by the Mongols in 1238. It became a small appanage principality when Vasily, youngest son of Yaroslav II and brother of Alexander Nevsky, received it in 1246; as grand prince of Vladimir from 1272 he kept his seat at Kostroma.

His descendants ruled another half century until Ivan I Kalita of Moscow bought it, so in 1337 Kostroma was already Muscovite. Its remote northern site made it a safe retreat for Moscow's princes during the sieges of Moscow in 1382, 1408 and 1433, though Novgorod river pirates, the ushkuiniks, sacked it in 1375.

In the Time of Troubles the Ipatiev Monastery here sheltered Mikhail Romanov, and in 1612 a Muscovite embassy offered him the Russian crown, beginning the Romanov dynasty.
zh:
科斯特罗马位于科斯特罗马河汇入伏尔加河之处，相传1152年由尤里·多尔戈鲁基建立，与东北罗斯其他城镇一样，1238年遭蒙古人洗劫。此后它成为小封邑公国：1246年雅罗斯拉夫二世的幼子、亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟瓦西里受封此地，1272年他成为弗拉基米尔大公后仍留驻科斯特罗马。

他的后裔又统治半个世纪，直到莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔买下该城，1337年科斯特罗马已是莫斯科领地。偏远的北方位置使它在1382、1408和1433年莫斯科被围时成为莫斯科大公安全的退路，不过诺夫哥罗德河盗乌什库伊尼克人曾在1375年洗劫此城。

动荡时期，伊帕季耶夫修道院在此庇护米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫，1612年莫斯科使团来此向他献上俄罗斯皇位，罗曼诺夫王朝由此开端。

en:
The Sao built fortified city-states around Lake Chad and the Chari River, in what are now Chad and Cameroon. Their cities flourished between the 9th and 15th centuries; craftsmen made pottery and figures in clay and bronze.

Bornu's expansion and conversion to Islam changed Sao society in the 16th century. The Kotoko inherited the former Sao city-states and founded a kingdom around 1500.
zh:
萨奥人在今乍得和喀麦隆境内的乍得湖和沙里河周围建立了设防的城邦。他们的城邦在9—15世纪兴盛，工匠制作陶器以及陶制和青铜人物像。

16世纪博尔努的扩张和伊斯兰教的传播改变了萨奥社会。科托科人继承了萨奥的旧城邦，并在1500年前后建立王国。

en:
The Kō were a Japanese warrior family that served Ashikaga Takauji during the wars between the Northern and Southern Courts. Kō no Moronao became Takauji's deputy and led his armies against the Southern Court.

Moronao's rivalry with Takauji's brother Tadayoshi helped provoke the Kannō Disturbance. In 1351 Moronao and his brother Moroyasu were forced to enter religious life, then killed with many relatives by Uesugi Akiyoshi's men at the Mukogawa River.
zh:
高氏是日本武家，在南北朝战争期间侍奉足利尊氏。高师直出任尊氏的执事，率军与南朝作战。

师直与尊氏之弟直义的对立促成了观应扰乱。1351年师直和弟弟师泰被迫出家，随后与许多族人在武库川被上杉能义的部下杀死。

en:
The Kowoj were a Maya polity of the Petén lakes in northern Guatemala, active from the mid-thirteenth century to the end of the seventeenth. They held that their ancestors had migrated from Mayapán in Yucatán after that city's collapse around 1441, and their towns were distinguished by a C-shaped plaza with a temple assemblage proclaiming this connection.

Their main cities were Zacpetén on Lake Salpetén, Ixlu between Lakes Petén Itzá and Salpetén, and Topoxte on Lake Yaxhá, already abandoned before the Spanish arrived. In Petén they competed and warred with neighbouring polities, above all the Itzá.

Hernán Cortés crossed the region in 1525, but the lake kingdoms long held out. In 1697 Martín de Ursúa captured the Itzá island capital Nojpetén and overran the Kowoj towns, making them among the last independent Maya polities to fall to the Spanish Empire.
zh:
科沃伊是危地马拉北部佩滕湖区的玛雅政权，活跃于13世纪中叶至17世纪末。他们自称祖先在约1441年尤卡坦的玛雅潘城陷落后从那里迁来，其城镇以C形广场和神庙组合为标志，借此宣示与玛雅潘的渊源。

主要城市包括萨尔佩滕湖畔的萨克佩滕、佩滕伊察湖与萨尔佩滕湖之间的伊什卢，以及亚克萨湖畔的托波斯特，后者在西班牙人到来之前已遭废弃。在佩滕，他们与邻邦尤其是伊察人长期争战。

1525年埃尔南·科尔特斯曾穿越这一地区，但湖区诸王国长期坚守。1697年马丁·德·乌尔苏亚攻陷伊察人的岛都诺赫佩滕，并横扫科沃伊诸城，使他们成为最后并入西班牙帝国的独立玛雅政权之一。

en:
The Kōzai were a warrior family of Sanuki; Kōzai Motonari held Shōga Castle and served the Hosokawa. He fought at Shōriji in 1547 and at Eguchi in 1549, where his lord Hosokawa Harumoto was driven from Kyoto by Miyoshi Nagayoshi.

Motonari continued to resist Nagayoshi from Tanba and attacked Kyoto in 1551. He was killed fighting the Miyoshi at Sumiyama Castle in 1560.
zh:
香西氏是赞岐的武家，香西元成据有胜贺城，侍奉细川氏。他参加了1547年的舍利寺之战和1549年的江口之战，后者使主君细川晴元被三好长庆逐出京都。

元成继续以丹波为据点抵抗长庆，并于1551年进攻京都。1560年，他在山城国炭山城与三好氏作战时阵亡。

en:
The Kispoko were a division of the Shawnee confederacy, from whose paternal lines hereditary war chiefs traditionally came. Driven from Ohio during the Beaver Wars, they lived among the Creek before returning around 1759.

The Kispoko leader Tecumseh built a multi-tribal alliance against American expansion and helped the British capture Detroit in 1812. His death at the Battle of the Thames in 1813 ended that alliance; most Kispoko later moved west of the Mississippi.
zh:
基斯波科是肖尼联盟的一个部族，传统上世袭战争酋长出自该部族的父系家族。他们在海狸战争中被逐出俄亥俄地区，曾与克里克人共同生活，约于1759年返回。

基斯波科领袖特库姆塞建立跨部族联盟，抵抗美国扩张，并于1812年协助英军攻占底特律。他在1813年泰晤士河战役中阵亡，联盟随之瓦解；此后大多数基斯波科人迁至密西西比河以西。

en: Koppula designates the country of the Koppula Velama, a Telugu-speaking Hindu community of farmers and warriors concentrated in the Uttarandhra coast of northern Andhra, with their seat at the old town of Pithapuram. Earlier known as Pishtapura, the town was the first capital of the Eastern Chalukyas before they moved their court to Vengi.
zh: 科普拉指科普拉·韦拉马人的邦国，这是一个操泰卢固语的印度教农耕与武士社群，聚居于安得拉北部沿海的乌塔拉安德拉地区，以古城皮塔普拉姆为治所。该城古称皮什塔普拉，曾是东遮娄其王朝迁都文吉之前的首个都城。

en:
The Kira were a branch of the Ashikaga, named for their estate in Mikawa Province. During the Northern and Southern Courts period, the Mikawa family divided into the Saijō and Tōjō branches.

Kira Yoshiaki came to head both branches under Imagawa influence, but joined the Mikawa Ikkō uprising in 1563 and was defeated by Tokugawa Ieyasu. A branch later served the Tokugawa as masters of ceremony. In 1702 former retainers of Asano Naganori killed Kira Yoshinaka in the Akō vendetta, and his main house lost its status.
zh:
吉良氏是足利氏的支族，以三河国的吉良庄为名。南北朝时期，三河吉良氏分为西条和东条两支。

吉良义昭在今川氏的影响下统领两支，但他于1563年参加三河一向一揆，被德川家康击败。此后吉良氏的一支为德川幕府掌管礼仪；1702年，浅野长矩的旧臣在赤穗事件中杀死吉良义央，其本家随后被改易。

en:
The Karasids were a Turkoman dynasty that held Mysia in northwestern Anatolia, with its centre at Balıkesir. Kalam Shah and his son Karasi Bey took over in the late thirteenth century while nominally serving the Seljuk sultan Mesud II.

After Karasi Bey died around 1328 the beylik split between Demir Khan at Balıkesir and Yakhshi Khan around Pergamon, ruler in 1337. Demir's fleet raided Cyzicus and the Thracian coast; he signed a truce with Emperor Andronikos III in 1328 and received Ibn Battuta in 1333.

The dynasty's end came through the Ottomans: after a succession quarrel Prince Dursun fled to Sultan Orhan and offered him the Karasid towns, and Ottoman troops occupied Balıkesir between 1335 and 1349, making the Karasid realm one of the first beyliks absorbed by the Ottomans. Its sailors and shipyards passed into Ottoman service and supported their first crossings into the Balkans.
zh:
卡拉斯（卡拉斯奥卢）是突厥蛮王朝，据有安纳托利亚西北部的密细亚地区，以巴勒克埃西尔为中心。卡拉姆沙阿及其子卡拉斯贝伊于13世纪末取得此地，当时名义上效命罗姆苏丹梅苏德二世。

约1328年卡拉斯贝伊死后，贝伊国一分为二：德米尔汗据巴勒克埃西尔，1337年在位的亚赫希汗据贝尔加马一带。德米尔的舰队劫掠库齐库斯和色雷斯海岸；他于1328年与拜占庭皇帝安德洛尼卡三世签订和约，1333年接待伊本·白图泰。

该王朝最终亡于奥斯曼：继承纠纷中，王子杜尔松投奔苏丹奥尔汗并献上卡拉斯诸城，奥斯曼军队于1335至1349年间占领巴勒克埃西尔等地，卡拉斯成为最早被奥斯曼吞并的贝伊国之一。其水手和船厂转入奥斯曼麾下，为奥斯曼人首次渡海进军巴尔干提供了助力。

en:
Karategin, also spelled Karotegin and often called Garm after its chief town, was a highland principality in the valley of the Vakhsh River, in eastern Tajikistan. Ringed by Ferghana to the east, Darvaz to the south and Hissar to the west, it was ruled for centuries by native princes who claimed descent from Alexander the Great.

Its people wove rough woolen cloth and mohair, mined gold in the hills, worked salt-pits and made firearms. In the sixteenth century some twelve thousand Kyrgyz families from the Karakorum and Kerulen regions migrated into the valley and formed a Kyrgyz-led tribal confederation.

In 1636 Nadr Muhammad Khan of Bukhara sent Haji Atalik, governor of Ferghana, to seize Karategin; the valley then became part of the Bukhara Khanate, and the incoming Kyrgyz in time accepted Islam.
zh:
卡拉捷金又译喀尔提锦，常因首府加尔姆而被称为加尔姆地区，是瓦赫什河谷中的山地公国，位于塔吉克斯坦东部。它东经费尔干纳、南接达尔瓦兹、西连希萨尔，千余年间由自称亚历山大大帝后裔的本地王公统治。

当地居民织造粗毛料和马海毛，在山里采金、开盐坑，并能制造火器。16世纪，约一万两千户来自喀喇昆仑与克鲁伦地区的吉尔吉斯人迁入谷地，组成以吉尔吉斯人为首的部落联盟。

1636年，布哈拉汗纳德尔·穆罕默德派费尔干纳长官哈吉·阿塔里克攻取卡拉捷金，谷地自此并入布哈拉汗国，迁入的吉尔吉斯人后来也皈依伊斯兰教。

en: The Kurani were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom based at Qasr-e Shirin, on the old Hulwan-Shahrizor frontier. The district had been Annazid Kurdish heartland from the tenth to the twelfth centuries; in 1337 the Kurani held it as Jalayirid vassals, and it later gave rise to the Hamawand tribe.
zh: 库拉尼人是以席林堡为中心的库尔德部落酋长政权，地当赫勒万与谢赫雷祖尔之间的旧边地。这一地区曾是10至12世纪安纳兹库尔德王朝的核心地盘，1337年库拉尼首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸据有该地，后来的哈马万德部落也发源于此。

en:
The Karanka, called Carangas in Spanish chronicles, were one of the largest Aymara lordships of the southern altiplano, emerging after Tiwanaku's collapse around 1000. Their grazing lands ran from the Mauri and Desaguadero rivers to Lake Poopo and the Coipasa salt flat, cold puna ideal for llama and alpaca herds; their caravan trade reached the Pacific valleys, where they kept detached colonies.

Their chief seat is variously given as Hatun Carangas or Corquemarca, and the chullpa burial towers of their necropolises, some with painted walls, mark their territory. Together with the Quillacas the Carangas formed part of the Charca Takusis confederation.

The Incas absorbed them into the Collasuyo around the mid-fifteenth century, and Huayna Capac later moved Caranga communities as mitma settlers to the Cochabamba valley. Under Spanish rule the Carangas' western enclaves went to the corregimiento of Arica.
zh:
卡朗卡在西班牙编年史中称为卡兰加斯，是南部高原最大的艾马拉酋长国之一，约在1000年蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后兴起。其牧场北起毛里河与德萨瓜德罗河，南抵波波湖和科伊帕萨盐沼，是适合放养骆马和羊驼的寒冷普纳草原；商队贸易远达太平洋河谷，他们在那里保有分散的殖民聚落。

主要治所有哈通卡朗卡、科尔克马卡等不同说法，境内丘尔帕葬塔墓群中一些塔墙仍留有彩绘。卡朗卡与基利亚卡人同属查尔卡·塔库西斯联盟。

15世纪中期印卡人将其并入科利亚苏尤，后来瓦伊纳·卡帕克又把卡朗卡社群作为米特玛移民迁往科恰班巴河谷。西班牙统治时期，他们在西部的飞地被划归阿里卡督辖区。

en: Karelia was a region inhabited by Karelians between the Gulf of Finland and the White Sea. In 1323 the Treaty of Nöteborg divided the Karelian Isthmus between Sweden and Novgorod; their border remained in place until the Treaty of Teusina in 1595.
zh: 卡累利阿是芬兰湾与白海之间卡累利阿人居住的地区。1323年的《内特堡和约》将卡累利阿地峡划分给瑞典和诺夫哥罗德，双方边界一直维持到1595年的《泰于西纳条约》。

en:
Kerman, the ancient Carmania, sits on the southeastern edge of the Iranian plateau. Sasanian king Ardashir I founded Veh-Ardashir in the third century, and it passed to Muslim rule after Nahavand in 642. When Marco Polo passed through in 1271 it was a great emporium linking the Persian Gulf with Central Asia.

From 1222 the Khitan Qutlugh-Khanids ruled it, until Il-Khan Öljaitü deposed their last prince in 1306. With the Ilkhanate collapsing after 1335, governor Qutb al-Din ibn Nasir held Kerman in 1337.

In 1340 Muzaffarid Mubariz al-Din Muhammad seized Kerman. Qutb al-Din briefly won it back with help from the Kartids of Herat, then lost it again. Kerman thereafter shared the Muzaffarid fate, passing to Timur in 1393 and the Timurids; its later prosperity under the Safavids ended for a time with the savage Qajar sack in 1794.
zh:
克尔曼古称卡尔马尼亚，位于伊朗高原东南边缘。萨珊国王阿尔达希尔一世于3世纪建城，名韦赫-阿尔达希尔；642年纳哈万德之战后归入穆斯林统治。马可·波罗1271年经过时，它已是连接波斯湾与中亚的大商埠。

1222年起，克尔曼由契丹人的库特鲁汗王朝统治，1306年伊儿汗完者都废黜末代王公。1335年伊儿汗国瓦解后，总督库特卜丁·伊本·纳西尔于1337年掌握克尔曼。

1340年，穆扎法尔王朝的穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德夺取克尔曼；库特卜丁借助赫拉特卡尔提德王朝的援兵一度复国，却再度失守。此后克尔曼随穆扎法尔领土于1393年落入帖木儿之手，继而归属帖木儿王朝；它在萨法维时期重现繁荣，却在1794年卡扎尔人血腥屠城后一度衰败。

en: The Karen are a group of Karenic-speaking peoples of southern and southeastern Myanmar. In the eastern highlands, local tradition holds that a Karenni principality once subject to a Shan prince became independent in the eighteenth century.
zh: 克伦人是缅甸南部和东南部讲克伦语支语言的多个族群。东部高地的地方传统称，一个曾从属于掸族王公的克伦尼公国在18世纪获得独立。

en:
Kuripan was an old Hindu-influenced kingdom of the lower Barito basin in South Kalimantan, with its seat at Danau Panggang in the North Hulu Sungai regency, downstream from Amuntai.

It is thought to be the polity called Tabalong in the Nagarakretagama of 1365, and some historians identify it with the neighbouring Ma'anyan kingdom of Nan Sarunai, while others treat the two as separate states.

The chronicle Tutur Candi, a version of the Hikayat Banjar, relates that the last king of Kuripan adopted the Majapahit commander Ampu Jatmika as his heir; when the old king died, Ampu Jatmika renamed the realm Negara Dipa and built the Candi Agung temple at Amuntai. His son Lambung Mangkurat, ruling with the title Ratu Kuripan, extended the kingdom's sway over the Dayak communities of the Kahayan, Sabangau and Mendawai rivers.
zh:
固里班是巴里托河下游的古老王国，受印度教影响，都城在北河源县的达瑙庞昂，地处阿蒙泰下游。

一般认为它就是1365年《爪哇史颂》所载的塔巴隆王国；部分史家认为它与邻近的马安亚人王国楠沙鲁奈本是一国，也有人认为二者并立。

《马辰编年史》的异本记载，固里班末代君主收满者伯夷将领安普·贾特米卡为养子兼继承人，老王去世后，安普·贾特米卡将国号改为尼贾拉·蒂帕，并在阿蒙泰修建阿贡寺。他的儿子兰邦·芒库拉特以固里班之王的头衔，把统治扩展到卡哈扬河、萨邦奥河和门达瓦伊河沿岸的达雅克诸社群。

en:
The Kiriri are an indigenous people of northeastern Bahia and the middle São Francisco River in Brazil. They belong to the wider group of peoples known as the Kariri.

From 1672 to 1683 the Capuchin missionary Martin of Nantes worked among Kariri communities on the São Francisco. Kariri peoples were among the indigenous groups involved in conflicts over Portuguese expansion into Brazil's northeastern interior from the mid-seventeenth to the early eighteenth century.
zh:
基里里是巴西巴伊亚东北部和圣弗朗西斯科河中游的原住民族群，属于范围更广的卡里里诸族。

1672—1683年，嘉布遣会传教士南特的马丁在圣弗朗西斯科河流域的卡里里社群中传教。17世纪中叶至18世纪初，葡萄牙人向巴西东北内陆扩张引发冲突，卡里里诸族是卷入其中的原住民之一。

en:
Kurdistan is the mountainous region of the Kurds around the eastern Taurus and northwestern Zagros. Its name appeared in Seljuk chronicles in the eleventh century, and Kurdish dynasties and principalities arose there over the following centuries.

From the sixteenth century, rival Kurdish emirates maintained varying degrees of autonomy amid Ottoman and Safavid warfare. The Ottoman–Safavid border settlement of 1639 divided Kurdistan between the two empires.
zh:
库尔德斯坦是库尔德人居住的山区，位于东托罗斯山脉和西北扎格罗斯山脉一带。这个名字见于11世纪的塞尔柱编年史，此后数百年间当地出现了多个库尔德王朝和公国。

16世纪起，相互竞争的库尔德埃米尔国在奥斯曼与萨法维的战争中保持不同程度的自治。1639年的奥斯曼－萨法维边界协议将库尔德斯坦分属两帝国。

en:
The Kartids were a Sunni Tajik dynasty ruling most of Khorasan from Herat from the mid-thirteenth to late fourteenth century. Founded by Shams-uddin Muhammad in 1245, it served the Ghurids and then the Ilkhanate as vassals; in 1306 Fakhr-uddin destroyed an Ilkhanid army at Herat, though the city later submitted to Öljeitü.

As the Ilkhanate fragmented after 1335, Mu'izz-uddin Husayn, Kart malik in 1337, built an independent state, allying with and tributary to Togha Temür, the Borjigin claimant in Gurgan. His reign saw victory over the Sarbadars at Zava in 1342, wars with the Chagatai and a young Timur in Kart service; from 1349 he ruled as an independent sultan.

Husayn died in 1370, leaving son Ghiyas-uddin Pir 'Ali a weakened state. Timur took Herat in 1381, deporting scholars and carrying off the Kart princes. Pir 'Ali was executed around 1383 after a revolt, and the last Kart princes were murdered at a banquet in 1396, ending the dynasty.
zh:
库尔特王朝是塔吉克裔逊尼派王朝，13世纪中叶至14世纪末以赫拉特为都统治呼罗珊大部。王朝由沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德于1245年建立，先后臣属古尔王朝与伊儿汗国；1306年法赫尔丁在赫拉特歼灭来攻的伊儿汗军队，但该城后来仍向完者都臣服。

1335年伊儿汗国瓦解后，1337年在位的库尔特马利克穆伊兹丁·侯赛因建立独立公国，与朱里章的孛儿只斤氏宗主权贵脱合帖木儿结盟并纳贡。他在位时，库尔特人1342年在扎瓦战役击败萨尔毕道朗人，又与察合台人交战，年轻的帖木儿曾在其麾下效力；1349年起他改称独立苏丹。

侯赛因1370年去世，其子吉亚斯丁·皮尔·阿里继承的国势已衰。1381年帖木儿夺取赫拉特，放逐学者并掳走库尔特王公；皮尔·阿里在叛乱后于约1383年被处死，最后的王公于1396年在宴会上被杀，王朝就此灭亡。

en:
Karagwe was a kingdom between Rwanda and Lake Victoria, in what is now northwestern Tanzania, with its capital at Bweranyange. Its rulers traced their lineage to Ruhinda, traditionally credited with founding the kingdom around 1450.

Late in the 18th century Karagwe drove out a force from Bunyoro, and traders exchanged salt, copper and other goods in the prosperous kingdom. Under King Ndagara, who came to power around 1820, Karagwe continued to grow.
zh:
卡拉圭王国位于卢旺达和维多利亚湖之间，即今坦桑尼亚西北部，首都在布韦拉尼安盖。其统治者自称是鲁欣达的后裔，相传他于1450年前后建立了王国。

18世纪末，卡拉圭击退了一支布尼奥罗军队，商人则在这个繁荣的王国交易盐、铜等货物。恩达加拉国王约于1820年掌权后，卡拉圭继续扩张。

en: Gilan is a region on the southwestern Caspian coast, home to the Gilak people. From the 1370s the local Kar-Kiya dynasty ruled eastern Gilan, until Shah Abbas I sent an army to end its rule in 1592.
zh: 吉兰位于里海南岸西部，是吉拉克人的家乡。自14世纪70年代起，当地的卡尔基亚王朝统治东吉兰，直到1592年沙阿阿拔斯一世派军终结其统治。

en:
Kāshān is an oasis city of central Persia, below the Karkas Mountains on the Dasht-e Kavir's western edge. Nearby Tepe Sialk, settled from around the sixth millennium BC, makes Kāshān one of Iran's oldest settled places.

In Islamic times it grew famous for ceramics: Seljuk sultan Malik Shah I built the Jalali fortress in the eleventh century, and the city led in fine pottery and glazed tiles from the twelfth to fourteenth centuries. The Persian word for tile, kashi, comes from the town; Kāshān's lustreware was prized under the Il-Khans.

After the Mongol breakup of the 1330s it changed hands repeatedly, falling to the Qara Qoyunlu and then the Aq Qoyunlu. Under the Safavids it became a silk and brocade centre and royal resort with the Fin Garden; the 1778 earthquake levelled it, killed some eight thousand, and it was rebuilt.
zh:
卡尚是波斯中部的绿洲城市，位于卡维尔盐漠西缘的卡尔卡斯山下。附近公元前6000年前后已有人类居住的锡亚尔克丘，使它跻身伊朗最古老的定居地。

伊斯兰时代它以陶瓷闻名：11世纪塞尔柱苏丹马利克沙一世修建贾拉利堡垒，12至14世纪陶器与釉砖生产领先。波斯语中瓷砖一词kashi便得名于这座城市，其光泽釉陶在伊儿汗国时期仍受珍视。

14世纪30年代蒙古政权瓦解后，卡尚几经易主，先后落入黑羊、白羊王朝之手。萨法维时期它成为丝绸织锦贸易中心和王室游乐地，菲恩花园建于此时；1778年大地震夷平全城，约八千人罹难，此后重建。

en:
Kashmir was the Hindu state of the Kashmir valley, ruled from Srinagar. The Karkotas made it a centre of Hindu learning and Kashmir Shaivism. Lohara rule from 1003 ended around 1320, a raid driving out the king; his widow Kota Rani ruled until 1339 and cut a canal to tame the Jhelum. In 1337 the valley was still under this Hindu queen.

Shah Mir, in Kashmiri service from 1313, seized power in 1339 and founded the Shah Mir Sultanate. Sikandar forced conversions and broke idols; Zain-ul-Abidin brought craftsmen from Persia and fostered shawl-weaving. Chak nobles replaced the Shah Miris in 1561, and Akbar annexed Kashmir in 1586.

The Afghan Durranis took it in 1752 and taxed it harshly until Ranjit Singh's Sikhs conquered it after the Battle of Shopian in 1819; an 1832 famine made the Sikh governors halve the land tax.
zh:
克什米尔是克什米尔谷地的印度教政权，以斯利那加为都。卡尔科塔王朝时期，这里成为印度教学术和克什米尔湿婆教的中心。洛哈拉王朝自1003年起统治，约1320年的一场洗劫迫使国王出逃，其遗孀科塔·拉尼执政至1339年，开凿运河疏导杰赫勒姆河水患。1337年谷地仍在这位印度教女王治下。

1313年入仕克什米尔的沙阿·米尔于1339年篡位，建立沙米尔苏丹王朝。西坎达尔强令改宗、捣毁神像，扎因·乌勒·阿比丁从波斯请来工匠，扶持披肩织造。1561年查克贵族取代沙米尔王朝，1586年阿克巴吞并克什米尔。

1752年阿富汗杜兰尼人夺得此地，苛税统治持续到1819年兰吉特·辛格的锡克军队在绍皮恩战役后征服克什米尔；1832年饥荒使锡克总督把田赋减半。

en:
The Kasai were lords of central Mutsu, with a seat at Teraike in Tome district. Their ancestor Kiyoshige received land in Mutsu after Minamoto no Yoritomo's campaign against the northern Fujiwara in 1189, and the family expanded its influence during the wars of the Northern and Southern Courts.

Kasai Harunobu faced rebellion among his own retainers and failed to attend Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590. Hideyoshi then deprived him of his lands during the settlement of Ōshū.
zh:
葛西氏是陆奥中部的领主，以登米郡寺池为据点。其祖清重在1189年源赖朝讨伐奥州藤原氏后获得陆奥的领地，家族在南北朝战争期间扩张了势力。

葛西晴信面临家臣叛乱，未能参加丰臣秀吉1590年的小田原征伐。秀吉随后在整顿奥州时剥夺了他的领地。

en: The Kaskinampo were an Indigenous people represented at Coosada, a town on the Alabama River. In the late eighteenth century, its Kaskinampo and Koasati inhabitants joined the coalition of the Cherokee leader Dragging Canoe.
zh: 卡斯基南波人是原住民族群，居住在阿拉巴马河畔的库萨达等地。18世纪末，库萨达的卡斯基南波人与科阿萨蒂人加入了切罗基首领拖舟的联盟。

en:
The Kusunoki were a warrior family based in Kawachi Province who fought for the Southern Court. Kusunoki Masashige helped Emperor Go-Daigo overthrow the Kamakura shogunate in 1333, but died fighting Ashikaga Takauji at Minatogawa in 1336.

His son Masatsura fell in battle in 1348, while another son, Masanori, later mediated with the Northern Court. As the Southern Court weakened, so did the family; in 1559 Kusunoki Masatora obtained an imperial pardon for Masashige and his kin.
zh:
楠木氏是以河内国为根据地、支持南朝的武家。楠木正成协助后醍醐天皇于1333年推翻镰仓幕府，但在1336年于凑川与足利尊氏交战时战死。

他的儿子正行于1348年战死，另一子正仪后来居中调解南北朝。随着南朝衰落，楠木氏也失去势力；1559年楠木正虎为正成及其族人取得了朝廷赦免。

en:
The Kichesipirini were an Algonquin people based on the Ottawa River, with a fortified village on Morrison Island. Their position on the route between the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence allowed them to collect tolls from travelers.

Their chief Tessouat met Samuel de Champlain in 1603, and Champlain visited the island in 1613. The Kichesipirini and Huron made peace with the Haudenosaunee in 1645, but the peace failed and by 1650 the Kichesipirini had fled their homeland.
zh:
基切西皮里尼人是以渥太华河为根据地的阿尔冈昆人，在莫里森岛上建有设防村落。他们扼守五大湖与圣劳伦斯河之间的通道，向过往旅人收取通行费。

他们的酋长泰苏阿于1603年会见萨缪尔·德·尚普兰，尚普兰又在1613年到访该岛。1645年，基切西皮里尼人和休伦人与豪德诺索尼人议和，但和平未能维持，到1650年基切西皮里尼人已逃离故地。

en:
The Koasati were a Muskogean-speaking people whose early towns lay in the Tennessee River valley. Spanish expeditions, including Hernando de Soto's in 1539–1543, recorded a town called Coste, believed to have been theirs.

During the eighteenth century some Koasati joined the Upper Creeks and maintained close ties with the Alabama. After 1763, colonial settlement pushed groups west through Louisiana; by 1795 some had reached the Big Thicket of eastern Texas, while others remained in Alabama until forced removal in the 1830s.
zh:
科阿萨蒂是说马斯科吉语族语言的族群，早期聚落位于田纳西河谷。1539—1543年埃尔南多·德索托的考察队等西班牙远征队记载了一个名为科斯特的聚落，据信属于科阿萨蒂人。

18世纪，部分科阿萨蒂人加入上克里克，与阿拉巴莫人保持密切联系。1763年后，殖民者的定居迫使一些人经路易斯安那向西迁徙；到1795年，部分人已抵达得克萨斯东部的大灌木丛地区，另一些人则留在阿拉巴马，直到19世纪30年代被迫迁走。

en:
Kishtwar was a mountain principality in the upper Chenab valley, set between Kashmir, Ladakh and Chamba, its like-named chief town above the gorges. Kalhana's Rajatarangini of the twelfth century calls it Kashthavata and records its chief Uttamaraja paying homage to Raja Kalsa of Kashmir between 1063 and 1089.

In later centuries local rana and raja lineages held the valleys, and the Kishtwar rajas extended their power southwards to absorb the neighbouring principality of Bhaderwah. The ruling house kept its independence through the Mughal and Durrani periods under its own rajas, the last of whom was Mohammed Tegh Singh.

In 1821 the Dogra maharaja Gulab Singh of Jammu invaded and annexed Kishtwar; its raja was sent to Lahore fort, where he died by his own hand, and the state was merged into the dominions of Jammu.
zh:
吉什德瓦尔是奇纳布河上游的山间土邦，地处克什米尔、拉达克与昌巴之间，同名主城高踞峡谷之上。12世纪卡尔哈纳的《诸王流派》称其为卡什塔瓦塔，并记载其首领乌塔马拉贾在1063年至1089年间向克什米尔罗阇卡尔萨朝觐。

此后数百年，本地的拉纳、罗阇家族世代统治这些谷地，吉什德瓦尔的罗阇还向南扩张，吞并邻邦巴德瓦。在莫卧儿和杜兰尼时期，统治家族仍在自己的罗阇治下保持独立，末代罗阇为穆罕默德·特格·辛格。

1821年，查谟的多格拉大君古拉卜·辛格出兵吞并吉什德瓦尔，罗阇被押往拉合尔堡垒，在那里自尽，土邦并入查谟领地。

en:
The Kitabatake were a Japanese family that ruled southern Ise Province and maintained ties with the eastern provinces by sea. Kitabatake Akiie, son of the court adviser Chikafusa, supported the Southern Court during the wars between rival imperial courts.

In 1337 Akiie marched south from Mutsu, taking Kamakura on his way to support Emperor Go-Daigo. He was defeated and killed in Izumi in 1338; his son Akinari's descendants formed the Namioka clan.
zh:
北畠家是统治日本伊势国南部的家族，并通过海路与东部诸国保持联系。朝廷顾问北畠亲房之子北畠显家在南北朝战争中支持南朝。

1337年，显家从陆奥南下，途中攻占镰仓，前去支援后醍醐天皇。1338年他在和泉战败身亡；其子显成的后代形成了浪冈氏。

en:
Kengtung, also called Chiang Tung or Moeng Khün, was the largest of the Shan states, set in a Daen Lao Range valley east of the Salween. Wa tradition recalls it as Wa country until Tai princes displaced them. In 1263 King Mangrai of Yonok sent his grandson Mang Kun to conquer the area and found the ruling line; the saopha Nam Nam later built the walled capital at Kengtung.

Although ethnically close to the Siamese, its rulers preferred sending tribute, often ritual gold flowers, to the Burmese kings. In 1405 the Ming dynasty recognized it as the tusi prefecture of Menggen.

Rivalry over the state helped spark war between Qing China and Burma in 1760. Chiang Mai seized Kengtung in 1802, but Burmese help restored its saopha dynasty in 1814, whereupon Kengtung absorbed the neighboring state of Mongyawng.
zh:
景栋，又名清栋或勐痕，是最大的掸邦，坐落在丹老山脉的河谷中，位于萨尔温江以东。佤族传说这片河谷本是佤人的土地，后来被泰人王公取代。1263年庸那伽孟莱王派孙子孟昆征服此地，开创统治世系；诏法绍南南后来修筑景栋城作为都城。

尽管族属上与暹罗人亲近，景栋统治者却更愿向缅甸国王进贡，贡品常是仪式用金金花。1405年明朝将其封为土司，置孟艮府。

对该邦的争夺促成1760年清朝与缅甸之间的战争。1802年清迈夺取景栋，但在缅甸援助下，景栋诏法王朝于1814年复辟，随后吞并邻邦孟勇。

en:
Kitikiti'sh was a name used by the Wichita peoples, a loose confederation of related communities on the southern Great Plains. They farmed around villages of grass houses and hunted bison seasonally across lands from Kansas to Texas.

By the early eighteenth century Wichita communities lived in northern Texas and traded across the Red River. In 1759 Taovaya and other Wichita groups, aided by Comanche allies, defeated a Spanish attack on their villages.
zh:
基蒂基蒂什是威奇托诸族的自称，这些亲缘群体在北美大平原南部组成松散联盟。他们在草屋村落附近耕种，并在从堪萨斯到得克萨斯的土地上季节性地猎捕野牛。

到18世纪初，威奇托人的聚落已出现在得克萨斯北部，并在红河两岸进行贸易。1759年，陶瓦亚人和其他威奇托群体在科曼奇盟友的协助下击败了西班牙人对村落的进攻。

en:
Kutlehar was a small Hindu kingdom in the hills between the Sutlej and Beas, in Himachal Pradesh's Una district. Tradition traces its founding to Raja Gopal around 750; established by the tenth century, under Jas Pal in the eleventh it is said to have ruled all the land between the rivers.

Its later history was defence against plains empires: it fought Muhammad bin Tughlaq in 1337, faced Timur in 1398, and in 1556 Akbar reduced its raja to tribute with a hostage prince at Delhi.

Around 1700 the raja defied Mughal orders to attack Guru Gobind Singh's passing Sikh army and met him at Rewalsar; his state was cut to a fraction of its size. Gorkha armies from Nepal occupied it from 1805 to 1809; in 1815 Ranjit Singh annexed it and exiled its raja, and Punjab absorbed the kingdom in 1825.
zh:
库特勒哈尔是萨特莱杰河与比亚斯河之间丘陵的印度教小王国，在喜马偕尔邦乌纳县一带。相传约750年罗阇戈帕尔建国，10世纪已是一方势力；11世纪杰斯·帕尔时，据说统治遍及两河之间全部土地。

此后主要是抵御平原帝国：1337年与穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克交战，1398年遭遇帖木儿，1556年阿克巴迫使其罗阇纳贡，并留一位王子在德里为质。

约1700年罗阇违抗莫卧儿命令，不攻路过的古鲁·戈宾德·辛格锡克军队，并在雷瓦尔萨尔与之会面，王国因此只剩原有领土的一小部分。1805—1809年尼泊尔廓尔喀人占领此地；1815年兰季德·辛格吞并该国并流放罗阇，1825年该国并入旁遮普。

en:
This Malabar chiefdom had its seat at Ponnani, a port at the mouth of the Bharatappuzha river on the central Kerala coast. The surrounding country was the original home of the Perumpadappu Swaroopam, the dynasty that later founded the Kingdom of Cochin. After the Zamorin of Kozhikode occupied the area, the dynasty's rulers moved south.

Ponnani then became the Zamorin's chief military headquarters and a flourishing Muslim trading harbour, one of the busiest spice ports on the Arabian Sea. Makhdum theologians taught there, among them Zain-ud-Din Makhdum II, who wrote in the town his chronicle of the jihad against the Portuguese; Ponnani became known as the Little Mecca of Malabar.

Portuguese fleets repeatedly sacked the harbour and built a fort there in 1585, and under a treaty of 1604 the Dutch East India Company opened a factory at the port.
zh:
这个马拉巴尔小邦以蓬纳尼为治所，该港位于喀拉拉中部海岸的巴拉塔普扎河河口。周边一带本是后来建立科钦王国的佩鲁姆帕杜斯瓦鲁帕姆王朝的故地，科泽科德扎莫林占领此地后，其统治者南迁。

蓬纳尼由此成为扎莫林最重要的军事大本营和繁荣的穆斯林商港，也是阿拉伯海最繁忙的香料港之一。马赫杜姆家族的伊斯兰学者在此讲学，其中扎因丁·马赫杜姆二世在城里写成记述抗击葡萄牙人圣战的编年史，蓬纳尼也被称为马拉巴尔的小麦加。

葡萄牙舰队多次洗劫此港，并于1585年修筑堡垒。根据1604年的条约，荷兰东印度公司在港内开设了商馆。

en:
The Kotō were a warrior family based in Nagato Province, claiming descent from the Mononobe. Kotō Takemitsu founded Shimofuri Castle, which became a family stronghold, during the late twelfth or early thirteenth century.

In 1333 Kotō Takezane turned against the Hōjō authorities in Nagato, and the Kenmu government appointed him provincial governor in 1334. He supported Ashikaga Takauji in 1336 and retained the governorship under the Muromachi shogunate.
zh:
厚东氏是以长门国为根据地的武家，自称出自物部氏。12世纪末至13世纪初，厚东武光修筑霜降城，此城成为家族据点。

1333年，厚东武实倒戈反抗长门的北条氏，建武政权于1334年任命他为长门守护。1336年，他支持足利尊氏，在室町幕府成立后保住了守护一职。

en:
Katsina was one of the seven true Hausa states, the Hausa Bakwai, and Hausa tradition gave it the title king of the market, guarding the trade routes towards the Sahara. The walled town was founded around 1100, and its pre-Islamic ruler, the Sarki, was treated as semi-divine, liable to death for ruling badly.

Islam came with Wangara and Songhai clerics, and tradition makes the cleric Muhammadu Korau the first Muslim king in 1348, builder of the Gidan Korau palace in the city centre. Under the Korau line Katsina ranked with Kano as a seat of Islamic learning, drawing scholars from North Africa.

From the 1600s to the 1700s Katsina was the commercial heart of Hausaland and largest of the seven city-states, its markets under the mud-brick Gobarau Minaret. Independence ended in 1807, when Fulani jihadists overran it and made it an emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate.
zh:
卡齐纳是豪萨七城邦（豪萨·巴克瓦伊）之一，豪萨传统授予它“市场之王”的称号，因为它扼守通往撒哈拉的商路。这座有城墙的城镇约建于1100年；伊斯兰化之前，统治者萨尔基被视为半神，治国不善便可能被处死。

伊斯兰教随万加拉人和桑海学者而来，相传教士穆罕默杜·科劳于1348年成为第一位穆斯林国王，修建了城中心的科劳宫。科劳王朝治下，卡齐纳与卡诺并列为伊斯兰学术中心，从北非延揽学者。

17至18世纪，卡齐纳是豪萨兰的商业心脏和七城邦中最大的一个，泥筑的戈巴劳宣礼塔俯瞰着城中市场。独立于1807年终结，富拉尼圣战者攻占该城，把它变成索科托哈里发国的一个埃米尔国。

en:
Khuttal, often called Khuttalan, was a medieval region and principality on the north bank of the Oxus, between the Vakhsh and Panj rivers, roughly matching Khatlon in Tajikistan. Its Iranian princes ruled from Hulbuk and defied the Arab conquest, calling in the Turgesh khagan Suluk to defeat the Umayyad armies in the 720s and 730s, until the Abbasids imposed direct rule in 751.

A branch of the Banijurids then governed under Samanid suzerainty, and the country later passed in turn under Ghaznavid, Seljuq, Ghurid and Khwarazmshah overlordship. The Mongol conquests made Khuttal part of the Chagatai Khanate, and when the khanate disintegrated in the mid-fourteenth century Khuttal re-emerged as an autonomous principality.

Its lords fought in Timur's armies. In the sixteenth century the Shaybanids absorbed Khuttal, and the old name fell out of use, the region becoming known as Kulob.
zh:
忽都常称忽都兰，是阿姆河北岸、瓦赫什河与喷赤河之间的中世纪地区和公国，大致相当于塔吉克斯坦哈特隆一带。当地伊朗语诸侯以胡尔布克为都，曾抗拒阿拉伯人征服，请来突骑施可汗苏禄，在8世纪20至30年代连败倭马亚军，直到751年阿拔斯王朝建立直接统治。

其后巴尼朱尔王朝的一支在萨曼宗主权下治理该地，忽都又先后落入伽色尼、塞尔柱、古耳和花剌子模沙之手。蒙古征服后它成为察合台汗国的一部分，14世纪中叶汗国瓦解时再度成为自治公国。

其领主曾在帖木儿军中征战。16世纪，昔班尼王朝吞并忽都。“忽都”古称逐渐弃用，地区改称库洛布。

en:
The Kathmandu valley was the Newar heartland and seat of the Malla dynasty from 1201, when Arimalla first took the title, until 1769. An earthquake in 1255 killed perhaps thirty thousand, including King Abhaya Malla, yet the valley still sent artisans to Tibet, among them Araniko, who rose high in Kublai's service.

In 1337 Jayari Malla ruled in name only, the noble houses and their queens holding power. Khasa raiders struck in 1328 and 1334, and the Bengal sultan plundered the valley's shrines in 1345. Jayasthiti Malla reunited the towns and codified the valley's laws in 1382 to 1395, and in 1482 the valley split into the kingdoms of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur.

Their courts filled the three cities with gilded pagodas and Durbar Squares. Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha stormed the valley in 1768 and 1769, overthrowing the last Malla rajas and founding Nepal.
zh:
加德满都谷地为尼瓦尔人腹心，也是末罗王朝1201至1769年的王畿，阿里末罗首用末罗称号。1255年地震夺去约三万人生命，阿巴亚末罗王亦遇难；谷地仍向西藏输出工匠，阿尼哥便在其中，后仕忽必烈朝廷。

1337年贾亚里·末罗仅为名义国王，实权归于贵族诸家与王后。卡萨人1328年、1334年两度入寇，1345年孟加拉苏丹洗劫谷地神庙。贾亚斯提提·末罗1382至1395年统一诸城、编订法典，1482年谷地分裂为加德满都、帕坦、巴克塔普尔三王国。

三国广建鎏金宝塔与王宫广场。1768至1769年廓尔喀的普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿攻入谷地，推翻末代末罗王公，建尼泊尔王国。

en: The Kartawi were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom of the Mukriyan country, the grazing lands south of Lake Urmia around Barza, Bukan and Sardasht. In the fourteenth century local Kurdish lords held the district under Jalayirid overlordship; from the late fourteenth century onward the same country became the heartland of the Mukri principality.
zh: 卡尔塔维人是穆克里扬地区的一个库尔德部落酋长政权，牧地在乌尔米耶湖以南的巴尔扎、布坎和萨尔达什特一带。14世纪时，本地库尔德头人在札剌亦儿王朝的宗主权下统治该地区；14世纪末以后，这片地方成为穆克里埃米尔国的核心地带。

en:
The County of Katzenelnbogen was an immediate state of the Holy Roman Empire, split into a lower county around Katzenelnbogen Castle on the Middle Rhine and an upper county around Darmstadt. Forebear Diether I first appears around 1070; from 1094 he and his son built their Taunus castle, and Conrad III granted the comital title in 1138.

The counts built Rhine castles, completing Burg Katz in 1371, and won customs rights. In 1260 the county split between two lines, reunited in 1402 under Johann IV, who had the Riesling vine planted at Rüsselsheim in 1435, its first documented mention.

When Philipp died without male heirs in 1479, the inheritance passed through his daughter Anna to the Landgraves of Hesse, provoking the 1500 to 1557 Succession War against Nassau-Siegen. France annexed it in 1806; the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Nassau in 1815.
zh:
卡岑埃尔恩博根伯国是神圣罗马帝国直属邦国，领土分两块：下伯国在莱茵河中游同名城堡一带，上伯国在达姆施塔特。先祖迪特尔一世约1070年首见记载，1094年起与儿子在陶努斯山筑堡，1138年康拉德三世授予伯爵头衔。

伯爵们在莱茵河筑堡，1371年建成卡茨城堡，取得关税权。1260年伯国分两支，1402年约翰四世重新统一；1435年他命人在吕瑟尔斯海姆栽种雷司令葡萄，是该品种现存最早的文字记载。

1479年菲利普无男嗣而终，遗产经女儿安娜转入黑森领地伯爵家族，引发1500至1557年对拿骚‑锡根的继承战争。1806年法国吞并，1815年维也纳会议划归拿骚。

en: The Kuba kingdom was a federation of peoples between the Sankuru, Lulua and Kasai rivers, with its capital at Mushenge. Around 1625 Shyaam a-Mbul a Ngoong united local chiefdoms under his rule. In the early eighteenth century Kuete M'bogi extended Kuba power south along the Kasai, an expansion continued by Koto Nche.
zh: 库巴王国是桑库鲁河、卢卢阿河和开赛河之间的多民族联盟，都城位于穆申格。约1625年，夏姆·姆布尔·恩贡将当地诸酋邦统一在自己治下。18世纪初，库埃特·姆博吉沿开赛河向南扩张，科托·恩切继承了这一扩张行动。

en: The Kuikuro are a Cariban-speaking Indigenous people of the upper Xingu River in present-day Brazil. They are likely descendants of the people who built the settlements known as Kuhikugu, which remained inhabited until around the seventeenth century. Around 1400, villages in the upper Xingu had palisades, gates, bridges and roads; networks of roads and bridges connected settlements across the region.
zh: 奎库罗是今巴西境内欣古河上游说加勒比语族语言的原住民。奎库罗人很可能是建造库希库古聚落的人群的后裔，那里一直有人居住到17世纪前后。1400年前后，欣古河上游的村落设有栅栏、大门、桥梁和道路，道路与桥梁组成的网络连接着各处聚落。

en:
Kuku was a Kabyle kingdom based at Koukou in the mountains of northern Algeria. Ahmed ou el Kadhi founded it around 1515 and defeated Hayreddin Barbarossa at the Battle of Issers in 1519. His forces captured Algiers in 1520 and held it until 1527.

Kuku later joined the failed expedition of Charles V against Algiers in 1541. The ruling Ath l-Qadi family lost influence as its control over local tribes weakened in the seventeenth century.
zh:
库库是北非阿尔及利亚北部山区的卡比尔王国，以库库为中心。艾哈迈德·乌勒卡迪约于1515年建立该国，并在1519年的伊塞尔战役中击败海雷丁·巴巴罗萨。他的军队于1520年占领阿尔及尔，直到1527年才失去该城。

库库后来参加了查理五世于1541年对阿尔及尔发动的远征，但远征以失败告终。17世纪，统治库库的阿特勒卡迪家族逐渐失去对当地部族的控制，势力随之衰落。

en:
The Kunama are a people of the Gash and Setit river region in present-day Eritrea and northern Ethiopia. The tenth-century geographer Ibn Hawqal described Kunama communities in the Barka valley as governed by elders and worshipping Anna.

In 1692 the Ethiopian emperor Iyasu I campaigned against the Kunama in the Mareb valley. His men killed inhabitants and plundered their settlements.
zh:
库纳马人生活在今厄立特里亚与埃塞俄比亚北部的加什河和塞蒂特河地区。10世纪地理学家伊本·豪卡勒记载，巴尔卡河谷的库纳马社群由长老治理，信奉阿拿神。

1692年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝伊亚苏一世征讨马雷布河谷的库纳马人。其部下杀戮居民并掠夺聚落。

en:
Courland was the western peninsula of Livonia, home of the Curonians, a Baltic tribe described by medieval writers as warriors, sailors and pirates raiding both shores of the Baltic. In 1230 its ruler Lamekinas accepted conversion, the Bishopric of Courland followed in 1234, and in 1253 the lands were partitioned between the bishop and the Livonian Order.

It was a scattered state of small enclaves. After the Order's defeat at Durbe in 1260 the bishop fled, returning after Curonian and Semigallian uprisings were crushed in 1290; the Piltene bishopric remained a Livonian Order client.

In 1521 it became a prince-bishopric of the Empire, but the Livonian War soon ended independence: in 1560 the last bishop sold it to Denmark, which passed it to Duke Magnus, and in 1585 the Treaty of Kronborg sold it to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, where it survived as the semi-autonomous District of Pilten.
zh:
库尔兰是利沃尼亚西部半岛，居民库尔兰人是波罗的海部族，中世纪作家称他们是在波罗的海两岸劫掠的战士、水手与海盗。1230年统治者拉梅基纳斯改宗，主教区1234年建立，1253年土地由主教与利沃尼亚骑士团瓜分。

主教区是小飞地组成的松散政权。1260年骑士团杜尔贝战败，主教出逃，1290年库尔兰、瑟米加利亚起义镇压后才返回；此后驻节皮尔泰内的主教区为利沃尼亚骑士团附庸。

1521年它升格为神圣罗马帝国采邑主教区，但利沃尼亚战争很快终结其独立。1560年末任主教将其卖给丹麦，丹麦转交马格努斯公爵；1585年克龙堡条约将其卖给波兰立陶宛联邦，此后作为半自治的皮尔泰内地区存续。

en:
Kuskatan, rendered Cuzcatlan by the Spanish, was a confederation of Nahua-speaking Pipil city-states from the Paz to the Lempa rivers in western El Salvador. Nahua migrants from central Mexico, traditionally linked to tenth-century Toltec upheavals, settled among earlier Maya and Lenca, and by the thirteenth century the Pipil cities had united.

Around 1400 a hereditary monarchy ruled from Kuskatan, backed by irrigated farming, cotton armour and an army strong enough to repel Maya attacks. Elders and priests advised the lords, and Nawat, a southern Nahuatl dialect, was the language of state.

In 1524 Pedro de Alvarado invaded and fought at Acajutla and Tacuzcalco, withdrawing within months; San Salvador, founded in 1525, fell in a 1526 rising. Alvarado campaigned again in 1528, when the storming of the Peñol de Cinacantan broke the last organized resistance, though the province was not fully pacified until 1539.
zh:
库斯卡坦（西班牙文献拼作库斯卡特兰）是皮皮尔人的纳瓦语城邦联盟，疆域自帕斯河至伦帕河，在今萨尔瓦多西部。纳瓦移民相传因10世纪托尔特克战乱自墨西哥南迁，与早先的玛雅、伦卡人共处，13世纪皮皮尔诸城联合。

约1400年形成世袭君主制，定都库斯卡坦，靠灌溉农业、棉甲和足以击退玛雅人的军队立国。长老与祭司辅佐君长，南部纳瓦语方言纳瓦特语为国家语言。

1524年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多入侵，激战于阿卡胡特拉、塔库斯卡尔科，数月即撤；1525年建的圣萨尔瓦多1526年毁于起义。阿尔瓦拉多1528年再用兵，西纳坎坦岩壁陷落，有组织抵抗终结，该省直到1539年才被视为彻底平定。

en:
Kutch was a Jadeja Rajput state on the arid peninsula north of the Gulf of Kutch, founded around 1147 when Lakho Jadani, a Samma chief adopted by Jam Jada, built his capital Lakhiarviro. On Raydhan Ratto's death in 1215 his four sons divided the lands, the senior Lakhiarviro line heading a brotherhood whose juniors held Kanthkot and Bara.

The Jadejas worshipped goddess Ashapura Mata, her chief temple at Mata no Madh. In 1410 Gujarat's Muzaffar Shah I defeated Kanthkot; Kutch paid tribute while ruling itself, and in 1472 Mahmud Begada crossed the Rann, scattered its army at Thar and took tribute without annexation.

Early in the sixteenth century Jam Rawal of Bara seized it, until Khengarji I of Morbi reconquered and united it in 1549, Jam Rawal fleeing to Saurashtra to found Nawanagar. In 1819 it became a British protectorate.
zh:
卡奇是卡奇湾以北干旱半岛上的阇提奢拉杰普特政权。约1147年，被贾姆·贾达收养的萨姆玛首领拉科·贾达尼兴建都城拉克希亚尔维拉。1215年拉伊丹·拉托死，四子瓜分领地，拉克希亚尔维拉长支统领阇提奢同盟，幼支据有坎特科特和巴拉。

阇提奢人崇奉女神阿沙普拉，主庙在马塔诺马德。1410年古吉拉特穆扎法尔沙阿一世击败坎特科特，卡奇纳贡自治；1472年穆罕默德伯克越沼泽，在塔尔击溃其军，受贡未兼并。

16世纪初巴拉的贾姆·拉瓦尔夺国，莫尔维的肯加尔吉一世1549年反攻，收复并统一卡奇，贾姆·拉瓦尔逃往萨乌拉施特拉另建纳瓦纳加尔。1819年它成为英国保护国。

en: The Kuy are a Katuic-speaking people whose lands extend from the southern Khorat Plateau to the Mekong and northern Cambodia. In the Surin area, Kuy communities traditionally captured and trained elephants, including animals caught in the Dangrek Mountains.
zh: 归人讲卡图语支的语言，居住地从呵叻高原南部延伸到湄公河和柬埔寨北部。素林一带的归人素以捕捉和驯养大象为业，捕象地点包括扁担山脉。

en: Kvenland was a northern region mentioned in medieval accounts, often placed near the northern Gulf of Bothnia. Around 890 the traveller Ohthere told of conflicts between the Kvens and Norwegians; later Icelandic sagas described kings of Kvenland.
zh: 克文兰是中世纪记载中的北方地域，通常被认为位于波的尼亚湾北部附近。约890年，旅行者奥塔尔讲述了克文人与挪威人的冲突；后来的冰岛萨迦则记载了克文兰的国王。

en:
Karvuna was a Bulgarian principality on the Black Sea coast of Dobruja, named after its first capital, the fortress of Karvuna. It separated from the Bulgarian Empire under Balik in the 1340s and reached its greatest extent under Dobrotitsa, who moved the capital to Kaliakra.

Dobrotitsa built a fleet at Varna and challenged Genoese power in the Black Sea. His successor Ivanko made a commercial treaty with Genoa in 1387; the Ottomans occupied Varna in 1389 and incorporated Dobruja in 1411.
zh:
卡尔瓦纳是多布罗加黑海沿岸的保加利亚公国，得名于首府卡尔瓦纳要塞。14世纪40年代，它在巴利克统治下脱离保加利亚帝国；多布罗蒂察在位时，公国疆域达到最大，并将首府迁至卡利亚克拉。

多布罗蒂察在瓦尔纳建立舰队，挑战热那亚在黑海的势力。继任者伊万科于1387年与热那亚订立贸易条约；奥斯曼人于1389年占领瓦尔纳，并在1411年吞并多布罗加。

en: The Kwakiutl were Kwak'wala-speaking peoples of northern Vancouver Island and the neighbouring mainland coast. Their communities relied on fishing and displayed wealth through gifts at potlatches. George Vancouver made the first documented European contact in 1792; in the early 19th century, the Laich-kwil-tach expanded southward toward the Comox country.
zh: 夸扣特尔人是居住在温哥华岛北部及附近大陆海岸的夸夸拉语族群。他们的社群以捕鱼为生，在赠礼宴上通过馈赠展示财富。1792年，乔治·温哥华与他们接触，留下了最早的欧洲人接触记录；19世纪初，莱奇奎尔塔奇人向南扩张至科莫克斯人的地区。

en: The Kallawaya are an Indigenous people of the Bolivian Andes, including the highlands around Charazani north of Lake Titicaca. Their itinerant healers use medicinal plants and a distinctive language in healing and ritual.
zh: 卡亚瓦亚人是玻利维亚安第斯山区的原住民族，居住在的的喀喀湖北方查拉萨尼一带的高地。他们的行医者四处行走，使用药用植物和独特的语言进行治疗与仪式。

en:
The Kingdom of Kottayam, called Cotiote by the British, was a Nair chiefdom of North Malabar whose hills and forests covered the Wayanad plateau. Its Purannatt Swarupam dynasty traced its rule to the legendary Harischandara Perumal, who built a fort at Puralimala, and the house gradually won independence from the Kolathiri rajas before splitting into branches, the western one seated at Pazhassi.

When Hyder Ali of Mysore overran Malabar in 1773 the raja took refuge in Travancore. Kerala Varma Pazhassi Raja of the western branch then led the kingdom and from 1793 fought the British East India Company in the long guerrilla Cotiote War, first over the government of Kottayam and then over Wayanad.

Known as the Lion of Kerala, he was hunted down and killed in 1805. His lands were afterwards absorbed into British Malabar.
zh:
科塔亚姆王国被英国人称作科蒂奥特，是北马拉巴尔的奈尔人酋长国，山林辖地包括瓦亚纳德高原。统治王朝普兰纳特·斯瓦鲁帕姆自称其统治可追溯到传奇君主哈里申达拉·佩鲁马尔，他曾在普拉利马拉筑堡；该家族逐渐摆脱科拉蒂里罗阇独立，后来分出数支，西支驻于帕扎西。

1773年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻陷马拉巴尔，罗阇逃入特拉凡哥尔避难。西支的凯拉拉·瓦尔马·帕扎西罗阇随后执掌国政，自1793年起以游击战与英国东印度公司展开漫长的科蒂奥特战争，先为科塔亚姆治权、后为瓦亚纳德归属而战。

他被誉为喀拉拉之狮，于1805年被追兵击杀。其土地随后并入英属马拉巴尔。

en:
The Burgdorf and Thun county was the heartland of the Neu-Kyburg counts, a Habsburg cadet line carrying the extinct Kyburgs' name, once among the Swiss plateau's four greatest houses. The old Kyburgs received Burgdorf and Thun in the Zähringen inheritance of 1218, their male line dying out in 1264.

Rudolf of Habsburg, a Kyburg grandson, took ward of the lands; in 1273 heiress Anna married Eberhard I of Habsburg-Laufenburg, founding the dynasty. From Burgdorf they balanced Bern, Savoy and Austria, though debt forced sales; Eberhard II, ruling in 1337, had murdered his brother Hartmann II at Thun to seize the inheritance.

Rudolf II's failed 1382 Solothurn raid sparked the Burgdorf War of 1383 to 1384, after which Bern bought Burgdorf and Thun. Last count Berchtold died in Bern in 1417 and the line ended, the Habsburgs keeping the title.
zh:
布格多夫和图恩伯国是新基堡伯爵家业。新基堡是哈布斯堡旁支，延续瑞士高原四大豪门之一基堡家族的名号。老基堡1218年在策林根遗产分得两地，1264年男系绝嗣。

基堡外孙哈布斯堡的鲁道夫监护领地，1273年女继承人安娜嫁哈布斯堡-劳芬堡的埃伯哈德一世，王朝由此建立。伯爵以布格多夫为中心，在伯尔尼、萨伏依、奥地利间周旋，入不敷出，变卖领地。1337年在位的埃伯哈德二世在图恩杀兄哈特曼二世夺取继承权。

1382年鲁道夫二世袭击索洛图恩失败，引发1383至1384年布格多夫战争，战后伯尔尼买下两地。末代贝希托尔德1417年死于伯尔尼，家族绝嗣，哈布斯堡保留头衔。

en: The Koryaks lived north of Kamchatka and along the Bering Sea, divided between coastal fishing villages and inland reindeer-herding groups. Russian Cossack Vladimir Atlasov recorded their name during his Kamchatka campaigns in the 1690s. Warfare with Cossacks and a smallpox epidemic in 1769–1770 sharply reduced the Koryak population.
zh: 科里亚克人生活在堪察加半岛以北和白令海沿岸，分为沿海渔村居民与内陆的驯鹿牧民。俄国哥萨克弗拉基米尔·阿特拉索夫在17世纪90年代进军堪察加时记录了他们的名称。与哥萨克的战争以及1769—1770年的天花流行使科里亚克人口大幅减少。

en:
The Principality of Kozelsk was a Rurikovich appanage centered on the town of Kozelsk, first mentioned in 1146 within the Principality of Chernihiv. It became a separate principality between 1181 and 1201 under Mstislav Svyatoslavich, whose son Dmitry perished at the battle of the Kalka in 1223.

Its fame came in the spring of 1238, when the boy prince Vasily and the townspeople held out against Batu's Mongol army for seven weeks; after the storm every inhabitant was killed and the town burned, and Batu is said to have called Kozelsk his evil city. Revived within a few years, the principality kept its own line of princes.

Kozelsk accepted Lithuanian suzerainty in 1371, passed to Moscow in 1408 when Vasily I granted it to Vladimir the Bold of Serpukhov, was retaken by Lithuania in 1445, and finally confirmed to Moscow in 1494.
zh:
科泽利斯克公国是留里克王朝封邑，以科泽利斯克镇为中心；该镇1146年作为切尔尼戈夫公国的一部分首见记载。1181至1201年它在姆斯季斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇治下成为独立公国，其子德米特里1223年战死卡尔卡河。

它的声名来自1238年春天：年幼的王公瓦西里与全城居民抵抗拔都的蒙古大军达七周；城破后居民被杀、城镇焚毁，据说拔都把科泽利斯克称为“邪恶之城”。数年后城镇复兴，公国保留了自己的王公世系。

科泽利斯克1371年接受立陶宛宗主权，1408年转归莫斯科，瓦西里一世将其封给谢尔普霍夫的勇者弗拉基米尔；1445年立陶宛夺回，1494年最终确认归属莫斯科。

en:
Kazym was a Khanty principality in the Kazym River basin, with its capital at Mozym near the river's mouth. It arose in the fourteenth century and later fell under the Siberian Khanate. After a Moscow expedition in 1499, its people briefly acknowledged Russian rule.

Prince Sengep submitted to Russia in 1586, and in 1593 Russian forces seized a Kazym stronghold and made the principality a tribute district. Sengep's son Bogdan joined a rebellion in 1607, but was defeated and executed.
zh:
卡济姆是卡济姆河流域的汉特人公国，首府莫济姆位于河口附近。公国兴起于14世纪，后来隶属西伯利亚汗国。1499年莫斯科出兵后，当地人曾短暂承认俄国统治。

1586年，森格普公向俄国臣服；1593年，俄军占领卡济姆的一处据点，将公国改为纳贡区。森格普之子博格丹于1607年参与起义，战败后被处死。

en:
The Sotz'leb, better known as the Tzotzil, are a Maya people of the central Chiapas highlands; both names mean people of the bat, and they call their tongue Bats'i k'op, the true language. Their ancestors entered Chiapas between 100 BCE and 300 CE, their speech descending from the proto-Ch'ol of Late Classic cities such as Palenque and Yaxchilán.

On the eve of the conquest they lived in at least seven small hilltop polities ruled by lords called aghauh, exporting quetzal feathers and amber to Tenochtitlán and trading highland salt. In 1522 the lord of Zinacantán offered his allegiance to the Spanish and helped subdue neighbouring tribes, while Chamula and Huixtlán fought the invaders and fled into the wilds.

Disease and encomienda labour cut deep into their numbers. The Sotz'leb rose in revolt in 1528 and again in 1712.
zh:
索茨莱布人又称索西人，是恰帕斯中部高地的玛雅民族，两个名字都意为“蝙蝠之人”；他们把自己的语言称为巴齐科普，意为“真正的语言”。祖先在公元前1世纪至公元3世纪间进入恰帕斯，语言源自帕伦克、亚克斯奇兰等古典晚期城市使用的原始乔尔语。

征服前夕，他们分为至少七个山头小邦，由称阿加乌的首领统治，向特诺奇蒂特兰出口格查尔鸟羽和琥珀，在高地贩盐。1522年西纳坎坦酋长主动向西班牙人效忠，协助征服邻近部落；查穆拉和维斯特兰人奋起抵抗，随后遁入荒野。

疾病与监护征赋制下的劳役使人口锐减。索茨莱布人先后于1528年和1712年起兵反抗。

en:
The Lalin are the Jurchen group of the Lalin river, the Manchu lalin bira, meaning cheerful or joyful, a right-bank tributary of the Songhua rising in the Zhangguangcai mountains, whose valley held the old Jin site of Shangjing.

This was the founding heartland of the Jin dynasty: Aguda set his capital at Huining in 1115, the imperial city was built in 1124, and in 1138 the site was named Shangjing. When the Jin moved their capital to Yanjing in 1153 the palaces were destroyed and the capital title revoked, though Emperor Shizong restored it in 1173; during the twelfth century large numbers of Chinese settler households were moved in to populate the Jin inner land.

At the end of the Jin the Mongols took the area: Huining was abandoned and the circuit abolished. The valley's Jurchens afterwards lived under Yuan and Ming frontier administration.
zh:
拉林是活动在拉林河流域的女真群体，拉林河满语称拉林比拉，河名意为爽快、欢喜，是发源于张广才岭的松花江右岸支流，河谷中坐落着金朝上京故地。

这里是金朝的发祥之地：1115年阿骨打在会宁府建都，1124年修建皇城，1138年加号上京。1153年金朝迁都燕京，上京称号被削、宫殿被毁，1173年金世宗时恢复；12世纪大批汉人被迁来充实金源内地。

金末蒙古入侵，会宁府废弃，路的建置罢撤。河谷里的女真人从此处于元、明两朝的边卫管辖之下。

en:
Lamu is a Swahili town in the Lamu Archipelago, northern Kenya, called Amu by its people and believed founded in 1370, Kenya's oldest continuously settled town. An Arab traveller noted it in 1441 after meeting a Lamu judge on pilgrimage in Mecca.

In 1506 a Portuguese fleet blockaded the harbour and forced its king to pay an annual tribute. It chafed under Portuguese controls for decades, joined the coast-wide revolt of the 1580s and sought Omani help from 1652. Omani protection from the late seventeenth century opened a golden age: ruled by its council of elders, it became a centre of Swahili poetry and scholarship, its coral-stone houses dating from these years.

A Pate-Mazrui invasion ended in slaughter on the beach at Shela; Lamu then called in an Omani garrison and built the Lamu Fort, completed in the early 1820s.
zh:
拉穆是肯尼亚北部拉穆群岛的斯瓦希里城镇，本地人称之为阿姆，相传建于1370年，是肯尼亚最古老的连续人居城镇。1441年阿拉伯旅行者在麦加遇到朝觐的拉穆法官，留下最早记载。

1506年葡萄牙舰队封锁港口，迫其国王缴纳年贡；此后数十年拉穆不堪航运管制，参与16世纪80年代海岸大反抗，1652年起向阿曼求援。17世纪末阿曼保护开启黄金时代：它由长老会议治理，成为斯瓦希里诗歌与学术中心，珊瑚石宅第多建于此时。

帕泰与马兹鲁伊联军后来入侵，在谢拉之战被歼于海滩，拉穆请来阿曼驻军，兴建拉穆堡，19世纪20年代初完工。

en:
Lancaster began as an honour around a castle Roger de Poitou raised on a Roman fort site in the 1090s. His rebellion in 1102 forfeited the lands, which came under direct royal control as the Honour of Lancaster in 1164.

In 1267 Henry III made the estates the earldom of Lancaster for his youngest son Edmund Crouchback, ancestor of the Lancaster house. In 1337 the lord was his son Henry, whose son Henry of Grosmont became a Hundred Years' War commander. In 1351 Edward III made Lancashire palatine and Grosmont duke of Lancaster; the title passed in 1362 to John of Gaunt, husband of Grosmont's daughter Blanche.

When John's son Henry Bolingbroke took the throne as Henry IV in 1399, the duchy merged with the Crown but stayed a separate inheritance, each later English monarch holding it as Duke of Lancaster.
zh:
兰开斯特本是围绕城堡形成的荣誉领地：11世纪90年代普瓦图的罗杰在罗马要塞旧址筑堡。他1102年起兵失败，领地被没收，1164年归于王室直接管辖。

1267年亨利三世将地产组为兰开斯特伯国，封给幼子“驼背”埃德蒙，即兰开斯特家族始祖。1337年领主是其子亨利，亨利之子格罗斯蒙特的亨利为百年战争名将。1351年爱德华三世升兰开夏为巴拉丁郡，封格罗斯蒙特为公爵；头衔1362年经其女布朗什传给冈特的约翰。

1399年约翰之子亨利·博林布鲁克即位为亨利四世，公国并入王权却保留为独立遗产，此后每位英格兰君主都以兰开斯特公爵身份持有它。

en: Constantinople was the capital of the Latin Empire founded by crusaders after they captured the city in 1204. The Empire of Nicaea retook Constantinople in 1261, ending Latin rule there, though claimants retained the imperial title into the fourteenth century.
zh: 君士坦丁堡是十字军于1204年攻占该城后建立的拉丁帝国的首都。尼西亚帝国于1261年收复君士坦丁堡，结束了当地的拉丁人统治，但皇位觊觎者仍保留帝号直到14世纪。

en:
Saxe-Lauenburg was an immediate duchy of the Empire held by the Ascanian descendants of the old Saxon dukes, straddling the lower Elbe around Lauenburg.

The partition of 1296 split the Saxon lands into Saxe-Lauenburg and Saxe-Wittenberg, and a 1321 settlement divided the Lauenburg line. The Lauenburg and Wittenberg lines claimed the Saxon electoral vote, their quarrel feeding the double election of 1314, until the Golden Bull of 1356 awarded it to Saxe-Wittenberg. In 1337 the Bergedorf-Mölln branch of Lauenburg was held by Albert IV.

Under Magnus I and Francis I it turned Lutheran in stages, and Francis established a state church in 1585. When the Ascanian male line died out in 1689 the duchy passed to the Welfs; the Congress of Vienna granted it to Denmark in 1815, after which the duchy was ruled in personal union by Denmark.
zh:
萨克森-劳恩堡是神圣罗马帝国直辖公国，由古萨克森公爵的阿斯坎尼后裔统治，横跨易北河下游，以劳恩堡为中心。

1296年的分割把萨克森领地分为萨克森-劳恩堡和萨克森-维滕贝格，1321年的安排又把劳恩堡一系分为两支。劳恩堡与维滕贝格两系争夺萨克森选侯票，争执促成1314年双重选举，1356年金玺诏书把选侯票判给萨克森-维滕贝格；1337年劳恩堡的贝格多夫-默尔恩支系由阿尔布雷希特四世领有。

马格努斯一世和弗朗茨一世治下公国逐步改宗路德宗，弗朗茨于1585年建立国家教会。1689年阿斯坎尼男系绝嗣，公国转入韦尔夫家族之手；1815年维也纳会议把它划归丹麦，此后由丹麦以共主邦联形式统治。

en:
The Lavo Kingdom was a mandala of the lower Chao Phraya basin, centred on Lavapura, modern Lopburi. It emerged in the seventh century as a Mon city of Dvaravati, known to Tang China as Tou-ho-lo.

In the tenth and eleventh centuries it fell under Angkor's influence: Khmer forces sacked Lavapura in 1001, and Jayavarman VII posted a kinsman to govern it late in the twelfth century. Tai settlers took dominance by the 1290s. From the 1080s its seat had shifted downstream to Ayodhya, whose rulers married into the old line.

In 1337 Lavo was among the plain's competing Thai-speaking towns. In 1351 its line joined Suphannaphum to found Ayutthaya, Lavo becoming its princely seat; the exiled king Ramesuan held it after 1370 before retaking Ayutthaya in 1388. Lopburi declined until King Narai rebuilt it as a second capital in the 1660s.
zh:
罗涡王国是昭披耶河下游的曼荼罗政权，以罗哇补罗即今华富里为中心。它7世纪兴起，是陀罗钵地的孟人城邦，唐代称堕和罗。

10至11世纪罗涡落入吴哥势力范围：高棉军队1001年攻破罗哇补罗，12世纪末阇耶跋摩七世派宗亲镇守。此后泰人定居者逐渐掌权，到13世纪90年代暹人已主导罗涡。早在11世纪80年代起统治中心已顺流南移至阿踰陀，统治者与旧王族联姻。

1337年罗涡是平原上相互角逐的泰语城邦之一。1351年罗涡一系与素攀那蓬联合建立阿瑜陀耶，罗涡成为其王子封地；失位的国王拉梅萱1370年后退守此城，1388年反攻复国。华富里后来渐趋荒废，17世纪60年代那莱王重建为别都。

en: The Luba kingdom arose in the Upemba Depression, in the south of what is now the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Oral traditions make Kalala Ilunga, associated with the 16th century, its first sacred king. In the story he killed his uncle Nkongolo, whose capital was Mwibele near Lake Boya, and took the throne.
zh: 卢巴王国兴起于今刚果民主共和国南部的乌彭巴洼地。其建国年代存在争议，口述传统则称与16世纪有关的战士卡拉拉·伊隆加为首位神圣国王。传说中，他杀死了叔父恩孔戈洛并夺取王位；恩孔戈洛的都城姆维贝莱位于博亚湖附近。

en:
Lubeca is the prince-bishopric of Lübeck, a small ecclesiastical state of the Empire, distinct from the Hanseatic city. Its diocese was founded around 970 at Oldenburg in Holstein as a mission to the Slavic Obotrites.

The 983 Slavic uprising drove the bishops out for generations, and only after the Saxon reconquest was Vicelinus appointed bishop in 1149. Henry the Lion moved the see to Lübeck in 1160; after Henry's fall in 1180 the bishopric became an immediate imperial state. When the free city won immediacy in 1226 the bishops' lands lay outside the walls; in 1309 they settled at Eutin.

The Reformation reached the cathedral chapter in 1535, when it adopted the Lutheran confession; from 1586 the prince-bishopric was ruled by Protestant administrators of Holstein-Gottorp. It lasted until 1803, when it was mediatized into the Principality of Lübeck under Oldenburg.
zh:
吕贝卡即吕贝克采邑主教区，是神圣罗马帝国小型教会政权，与同名汉萨自由城市并非一回事。教区约970年设于荷尔斯泰因奥尔登堡，向奥博特里特人传教。

983年斯拉夫起义迫使主教出逃数代，萨克森重征服后维切利努斯1149年才就任主教。1160年狮子亨利迁教座至吕贝克，1180年狮子亨利倒台后主教区成为帝国直辖政权。1226年自由市直辖，主教领地在城墙外，1309年主教们驻节奥伊廷。

1535年宗教改革波及主教座堂参议会，其改奉信义宗；1586年起由荷尔斯泰因-戈托普的新教行政官统治。它存续至1803年，当年裁并为吕贝克亲王国，属奥尔登堡。

en:
Leibo is a mountainous Yi country on the northern bank of the Jinsha River in Liangshan, facing Wumeng. The Yuan set up the Leibo chief's office in 1276, held hereditarily by the Azhuo clan and later folded into the Manyi office under Mahu.

In 1371 Azhuo chief Piya submitted to the Ming with Mahu; the office was restored and the clan granted the surname Yang. Backed by Liangshan gorges, the Yang tusi kept broad autonomy at Ming height.

In 1704 chief Yang Lawa submitted to the Qing. When Yang Mingyi joined a Yi rising against the gaitu guiliu in 1728, Qing troops suppressed it and revoked the native title; the next year Leibo was converted into a military guard, and in 1761 into Leibo Hall under an appointed magistrate, leaving the Yang family a minor native commission.
zh:
雷波是金沙江北岸凉山深处的彝族山地，与乌蒙相望。1276年元朝置雷波长官司，阿卓部酋长世袭，后并入马湖属下蛮夷长官司。

1371年阿卓土长匹夜随马湖附明，长官司恢复，家族赐汉姓杨。依仗凉山峡谷，杨氏土司在明朝盛时仍保有很大自治权。
