1704年酋长杨喇哇投清。1728年杨明义参与彝民抗拒改土归流起事，清军剿平，革去土职；次年置雷波卫，1761年升雷波厅，派流官治理，杨家保留下一个低级土职。

en:
The Duchy of Lower Bavaria was created in 1255 by the first Wittelsbach partition, Louis II keeping Upper Bavaria and his brother Henry XIII the eastern lands, seated at Landshut.

In 1337 the duke was Henry XIV, who had inherited as a child in 1310 under Emperor Louis IV's guardianship. His quarrels with his brother Otto IV drove him to ally with his father-in-law John of Bohemia; early that year he joined John's Teutonic winter campaign in Prussia. Reconciled with the emperor in 1339, Henry died of leprosy months later; his young son John I died in 1340, and Louis IV inherited Lower Bavaria and reunited the Wittelsbach duchy.

It split again after the emperor's death, producing Bavaria-Straubing and Bavaria-Landshut in 1353, and the Bavarian lands were rejoined only in 1505 after the Landshut War of Succession.
zh:
下巴伐利亚公国形成于1255年维特尔斯巴赫家族第一次分邦：路易二世保留上巴伐利亚，其弟亨利十三世取得东部疆土，以兰茨胡特为治所。

1337年在位的是亨利十四世，他1310年继位，由皇帝路易四世监护。他因分邦纠纷与弟弟奥托四世相争，转而结盟岳父波希米亚国王约翰，年初还随约翰参加条顿骑士团在普鲁士的冬季战役。1339年他与皇帝和解，数月后死于麻风病；幼子约翰一世1340年夭折，路易四世遂继承下巴伐利亚，重新统一维特尔斯巴赫公国。

皇帝死后公国再度分裂，1353年分出巴伐利亚-施特劳宾和巴伐利亚-兰茨胡特两支，巴伐利亚诸邦直到1505年兰茨胡特继承战争后才合一。

en:
The Commune of Como was a Lombard city state on its namesake lake, its territory once reaching Bellinzona, Chiavenna and the Valtellina. It fought Milan for the western Lombard roads and lost the Decennial War of 1118 to 1127, when the Milanese razed the city, sparing the churches.

Frederick Barbarossa restored its independence and granted an imperial diploma in 1175; Como remained a Ghibelline stronghold against Guelph cities. From the late twelfth century the Rusca family dominated Como. Loterio Rusca, acclaimed Lord of the People in 1276, forced Milan to recognize his rule and recovered Bellinzona; the family became lords of Como.

Franchino I Rusca made it a personal lordship as imperial vicar, but Milan's Azzone Visconti conquered Como in 1335. Later Rusca attempts to restore their rule in 1412 and under the 1447 Republic of Saint Abundius ended when Francesco Sforza subjected Como to Milan in 1450.
zh:
科莫是伦巴第城市邦国，位于同名湖畔，领土曾远及贝林佐纳、基亚文纳和瓦尔泰利纳。它与米兰争夺伦巴第西部道路，1118至1127年十年战争战败，米兰人拆毁全城，留下教堂。

腓特烈一世恢复其独立，1175年授予帝国特许状，科莫成为对抗归尔甫城市的吉伯林重镇。12世纪后期起鲁斯卡家族主导该城；1276年洛泰里奥·鲁斯卡被拥戴为人民领袖，迫使米兰承认其统治并收回贝林佐纳，家族成为科莫领主。

弗兰基诺一世以帝国代理人实行个人统治，1335年米兰阿佐内·维斯康蒂征服科莫。此后鲁斯卡家族试图恢复统治，包括1412年起事与1447年圣阿邦迪奥共和国，均于1450年斯福尔扎把科莫并入米兰后告终。

en:
The Khorshidi were the Lur dynasty of Little Lorestan, the mountain country west of the Zagros ruled from Khorramabad. They sprang from the Salburi clan, and Lur identity consolidated there under their rule. Founder Shoja al-Din Khorshid made himself lord of Lur-e Kuchak after 1184, overthrew the Annazid chief and drove the Bayat Turks out; he died about 1224.

As atabegs under Mongol overlordship, his descendants survived the purges of the Ilkhans, and after 1330 a new line claiming descent from Ali took power and held Khorramabad in 1337. Timur's 1386 invasion wrecked the kingdom: Borujerd was sacked, Khorramabad fortress razed, and the atabeg Izz al-Din deported to Turkestan.

The dynasty recovered with the Timurid decline, and its chiefs played the Safavid shahs against the Ottomans, until Shahverdi Khan's revolts ended with his execution at Changuleh in 1597. Shah Abbas dissolved the realm and granted it to the Solvizi family.
zh:
霍什迪是小洛雷斯坦的卢尔人王朝，统辖扎格罗斯山脉以西、以霍拉马巴德为都的山地国家。他们出自萨尔布里氏族，卢尔族群认同在其治下凝聚。开国君主舒贾丁·霍尔希德于1184年后自立为小洛雷斯坦之主，推翻安纳兹王朝首领，把巴亚特突厥人逐出境外，约1224年去世。

其后裔以阿塔贝格身份在蒙古宗主权下存续，熬过伊儿汗国的清洗；1330年后，自称阿里后裔的新支系掌权，即1337年据有霍拉马巴德的王族。1386年帖木儿入侵重创王国：博鲁杰尔德遭洗劫，霍拉马巴德堡垒被夷平，阿塔贝格伊兹丁被流放突厥斯坦。

王朝在帖木儿势力衰落后复兴，后来其首领让萨非沙阿与奥斯曼人相互牵制，直到沙维尔迪汗反叛，于1597年在章古莱被处死。沙阿·阿拔斯解散政权，把它封给索尔维齐家族。

en:
Lucerne is a city state where the river Reuss leaves Lake Lucerne, grown around Saint Leodegar monastery, founded around 750 and later held by Murbach Abbey. After independence from the abbey in 1178, it prospered as gateway of the St Gotthard trade route. When the Habsburgs took over the monastery's rights, it swore an eternal alliance with Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden in 1332, the first city to join the Swiss Confederacy.

Its victory over the Habsburgs at Sempach in 1386 opened an age of expansion; Emperor Sigismund granted imperial immediacy in 1415. It kept the old faith while neighbours turned Protestant, staging passion plays from 1453. After the Catholic triumph at Kappel in 1531 it led the Catholic party until defeat in the Toggenburg War of 1712.

The Chapel Bridge still spans the Reuss. French troops ended patrician rule in 1798 and Lucerne entered the Helvetic order.
zh:
卢塞恩是罗伊斯河流出卢塞恩湖处的城市邦国，围绕约750年建立、后来归米尔巴克修道院所有的圣莱奥德加修道院发展起来。1178年摆脱修道院统治获得自治后，它作为圣哥达商道的门户繁荣起来。哈布斯堡接管修道院的权利后，卢塞恩于1332年与乌利、施维茨和翁特瓦尔登立下永久同盟，成为第一个加入瑞士同盟的城市。

1386年它在森帕赫击败哈布斯堡，开启扩张时代；1415年皇帝西吉斯蒙德授予它帝国直辖地位。邻近城市改宗新教时，卢塞恩坚守旧信仰，1453年起上演受难剧。1531年卡佩尔之战天主教一方获胜后，它领导同盟中的天主教阵营，直到1712年托根堡战争中落败。

卡佩尔桥仍横跨罗伊斯河。1798年法军终结贵族政府的统治，卢塞恩被纳入海尔维第体制。

en: The Lucayans were the Indigenous inhabitants of the Bahamas and the Turks and Caicos Islands. Their ancestors crossed from the Greater Antilles by canoe and spread through the islands. Columbus encountered Lucayans on Guanahani in 1492; Spanish enslavement and deportation removed the population from the Bahamas by 1520.
zh: 卢卡约人是巴哈马群岛和特克斯和凯科斯群岛的原住民。他们的祖先乘独木舟从大安的列斯群岛渡海，逐渐遍布各岛。1492年哥伦布在瓜纳哈尼岛遇到卢卡约人；西班牙人将他们掳为奴隶并运走，到1520年巴哈马已没有卢卡约人口。

en:
The Duchy of Łęczyca, centered on the fortified town of Łęczyca in central Poland, took shape around 1231 when Konrad I of Masovia turned the Łęczyca province of the Seniorate Realm into a hereditary Piast duchy. In 1263 its eastern lands were split off to form the Duchy of Sieradz, and the remaining territory passed through several branches of the dynasty before coming to Władysław the Hunchback, the Piast duke ruling in 1337.

When he died without heirs in 1352, the duchy escheated to the Polish crown and was reorganized by Casimir III the Great into the Łęczyca Voivodeship, one of the lands of the Polish Crown.
zh:
文奇察公国以波兰中部设防城镇文奇察为中心，约1231年马佐夫舍的康拉德一世将王储领中的文奇察省改为皮亚斯特家族世袭公国时形成。1263年，其东部土地被分出，另立谢拉兹公国，剩余领地几经王朝支系转手，最后传到1337年在任的皮亚斯特公爵“驼背者”瓦迪斯瓦夫手中。

他于1352年无嗣而终，公国收归波兰王室，被卡齐米日三世改组为文奇察省，成为波兰王冠领地之一。

en:
Landau is a wine-town on the Queich in the Palatinate, first recorded in 1106 and held by the counts of Leiningen. Rudolf I chartered it in 1274 and made it a Free Imperial Town in 1291, but the Bishop of Speyer seized it in 1324, leaving its liberties suspended under episcopal rule in 1337. Emperor Maximilian I restored its rights only in 1511.

After Westphalia in 1648 it passed to France, joining the ten-city Décapole in Alsace in 1680. Louis XIV's engineer Vauban made it one of Europe's strongest citadels.

It changed hands four times in the War of the Spanish Succession between 1702 and 1713, and the folding hooded carriage Emperor Joseph I used there became known across Europe as a landau. It remained French until the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Bavaria in 1815.
zh:
兰道是普法尔茨奎希河畔的葡萄酒城镇，1106年首见记载，原属莱宁根伯爵家族。鲁道夫一世1274年授予特许状，1291年将其立为帝国自由市，但施派尔采邑主教1324年占领该城，1337年时市民自由权仍在主教统治下中止。马克西米利安一世直到1511年才恢复其权利。

1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》后兰道划归法国，1680年加入十城联盟。路易十四的工程师沃邦把它改建成欧洲最坚固的要塞之一。

西班牙王位继承战争中，它在1702至1713年间四度易手；约瑟夫一世在此使用的折叠顶篷马车后来在欧洲被称为‘兰道车’。法国统治延续到1815年，维也纳会议将它划归巴伐利亚。

en:
The Margraviate of Landsberg took its name from Landsberg Castle above the Saale, in Osterland between Saale and Mulde. Westernmost part of the former March of Lusatia, it held rising Leipzig, with Weißenfels as its residence.

Theodoric I of Lusatia built the castle from 1170 and styled himself margrave, but the territory became an imperial state only in 1261, when Henry of Meissen carved it out for his younger son Theodoric. When Theodoric's son Frederick Tuta died heirless in 1291, Brandenburg's Ascanian margraves bought the march.

It passed by marriage in 1327 to the Welf duke Magnus I, whose wife Sophia was the last Ascanian heiress; in 1347 he sold it to Margrave Frederick II of Meissen, returning it to the Wettins as a core land of their later Saxon electorate. Its arms, the Landsberg pales, survive in the arms of Leipzig, Chemnitz and Dresden.
zh:
兰茨贝格藩侯国得名于萨勒河畔的兰茨贝格城堡，地处萨勒河与穆尔德河之间的奥斯特兰。它是旧卢萨蒂亚藩侯国最西的部分，辖有兴起的莱比锡等城镇，驻地设在魏森费尔斯。

卢萨蒂亚藩侯狄奥多里克一世1170年起修建这座城堡，自称兰茨贝格藩侯，但直到1261年迈森藩侯亨利才把这片土地从卢萨蒂亚划出，封给幼子狄奥多里克，成为帝国领地。1291年狄奥多里克之子腓特烈·图塔无嗣而终，勃兰登堡的阿斯坎尼家族买下藩侯国。

1327年，它通过婚姻转入韦尔夫公爵马格努斯一世手中，他的妻子索菲娅是阿斯坎尼家最后的女继承人；1347年马格努斯把它卖给迈森藩侯腓特烈二世，使它重回韦廷家族，成为后来萨克森选侯国的核心领地之一。其纹章‘兰茨贝格竖条’保存在莱比锡、开姆尼茨和德累斯顿的市徽中。

en:
Lodi was a Lombard city on the Adda, founded by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1158 after Milan destroyed the older commune of Laus Pompeia. It was forced into the Lombard League in 1167 and fought at Legnano in 1176.

After a succession of local lordships, Lodi came under Milanese rule in the fourteenth century. The peace signed there in 1454 ended the wars between Milan and Venice; in 1796 Napoleon defeated an Austrian force at the bridge over the Adda.
zh:
洛迪是伦巴第阿达河畔的城市。米兰摧毁旧有的劳斯·庞佩亚公社后，皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨于1158年在新址建立洛迪。1167年洛迪被迫加入伦巴第联盟，并于1176年参加莱尼亚诺战役。

洛迪先后受多个地方领主统治，14世纪归于米兰。1454年在此签订的和约结束了米兰与威尼斯之间的战争；1796年拿破仑在阿达河桥击败奥地利军队。

en:
Lundu was a Maravi kingdom associated with the Mang'anja of the Shire valley. Its founder, a relative of the Kalonga, left after a succession dispute; in the late 1500s Lundu allied with the Zimba, whose warriors fought the Portuguese.

Kalonga Muzura conquered Lundu's polity in the seventeenth century. By the end of the eighteenth century the original Lundu kingdom was based in the Lower Shire valley, where Portuguese slave traders threatened it.
zh:
隆杜是马拉维人的王国，与希雷河谷的曼甘贾人有关。其建立者是卡隆加的亲属，因继承争端离去；16世纪末，隆杜与津巴人结盟，后者的战士同葡萄牙人交战。

17世纪，卡隆加穆祖拉征服了隆杜的政权。到18世纪末，原来的隆杜王国以希雷河下游河谷为根据地，受到葡萄牙奴隶贩子的威胁。

en: The Lega were a Bantu-speaking people east of the Lwalaba River in what is now the Democratic Republic of the Congo. They began migrating from the region of present-day Uganda in the sixteenth century and settled among the forests and mountains farther west.
zh: 莱加人是居住在卢阿拉巴河以东的班图语族群，其地区位于今刚果民主共和国境内。16世纪，他们开始从今乌干达一带迁徙，定居在更西面的森林和山地中。

en:
Leinster was a Gaelic Irish province, the eastern Laigin kingdom whose early kings were also high kings of Ireland. Its later rulers were the MacMurroughs of the Uí Cheinnselaig dynasty. The most famous, Diarmait Mac Murchada, was driven out in 1166 and called in Norman help in 1170, opening the Anglo-Norman invasion, after which most of Leinster passed to the English Pale and the Earls of Kildare.

A reduced kingdom survived in Wexford and the Wicklow Mountains under the Kavanaghs, descended from Diarmait's son Domhnall Caomhánach, who from their Ferns seat harried the settler colony for centuries.

Art MacMurrough-Kavanagh, king from 1375 to 1417, was the most formidable of the line, tying down Richard II of England on his Irish expeditions of 1394 and 1395. The Tudors absorbed the lordship in the sixteenth century, leaving only the English-administered Province of Leinster.
zh:
伦斯特是盖尔爱尔兰的省份，即东部莱金人的王国，早期诸王还曾出任爱尔兰至高王。后期统治者是乌伊·肯塞莱格谱系的麦克默罗家族。最著名的迪尔梅德·麦克默罗1166年被逐，1170年引来诺曼援兵，开启盎格鲁—诺曼人入侵，此后伦斯特大部落入英国人的“佩尔”和基尔代尔伯爵之手。

缩水的王国在韦克斯福德和威克洛山区延续，由迪尔梅德之子多纳尔·卡瓦纳的后裔卡瓦纳家族统治，他们以费恩斯为据点，数百年袭扰殖民区。

1375至1417年在位的阿尔特·麦克默罗-卡瓦纳是家族最强悍的国王，曾牵制英王理查二世1394年和1395年的爱尔兰远征。都铎王朝16世纪逐步吞并这一领地，王国最终只以英国治下的伦斯特省留存。

en:
Lekia, also called Lakz or Lakzan in Arabic writings, was the medieval state of the Lezgic-speaking peoples in the Samur basin of southern Dagestan, the Land of Lakz of Arab geographers.

In the eighth century its king Arbis ibn Basbas resisted an Arab commander, and in 1032 Lekian troops fought beside Derbent's emirate against northern invaders. The Shirvanshahs later occupied parts of the country and collected tribute, and by the thirteenth century it was disintegrating into village unions and hereditary lordships, among them the Kurakh union centered on the mountain town of Kurakh.

These small Lezgin societies kept their independence through the later Middle Ages and often raided Georgia alongside other Dagestani peoples, until Russian expansion into the Caucasus in the early nineteenth century brought imperial rule.
zh:
莱基亚在阿拉伯文献中又称拉克兹或拉克赞，是达吉斯坦南部萨穆尔河流域列兹金语各族的中世纪王国，阿拉伯地理学家称之为拉克兹之地。

8世纪时，国王阿尔比斯·伊本·巴斯巴斯曾抵抗阿拉伯统帅；1032年，莱基亚军队与杰尔宾特埃米尔国并肩抵御北方来犯者。后来希尔万沙王朝占领其部分领土并征收贡赋。到13世纪，王国瓦解为村社联盟与世袭领地，以山城库拉赫为中心的库拉赫联盟便是其中之一。

这些列兹金小邦在中世纪后期保持独立，常与达吉斯坦其他民族一起袭扰格鲁吉亚，直到19世纪初俄罗斯向高加索扩张，才将它们纳入帝国统治。

en:
The Landgraviate of Leuchtenberg was a small Holy Roman Empire state east of Amberg in the Upper Palatine Forest, ruled from Leuchtenberg Castle and later Pfreimd. Its lords rose to comital rank in 1158 and became landgraves in 1196, winning a seat among the imperial princes in the fifteenth century.

The native house died with Landgrave Maximilian Adam in 1646; Leuchtenberg passed to Wittelsbach Albert VI of Bavaria, husband of a Leuchtenberg heiress, and from 1650 a Bavarian duke held it as Bavaria-Leuchtenberg.

In the War of the Spanish Succession the emperor deemed it an escheated fief and enfeoffed the Lamberg family from 1708 to 1714, before the Peace of Rastatt returned it to Bavaria. Only some 250 square kilometres, it was dissolved into Bavaria in 1808. After Napoleon's fall the empty title of Duke of Leuchtenberg went to Eugène de Beauharnais.
zh:
洛伊希滕贝格领地伯国是神圣罗马帝国的小邦，地处安贝格以东的上普法尔茨林山，最初以洛伊希滕贝格城堡为治所，后来移治普弗赖姆德。其领主1158年升为伯爵，1196年受封领地伯爵，15世纪在帝国诸侯院中取得席位。

1646年末代领地伯爵马克西米利安·亚当去世，本家绝嗣，洛伊希滕贝格传给娶了该家族女继承人的维特尔斯巴赫家族的阿尔布雷希特六世；1650年起由一位巴伐利亚公爵以巴伐利亚‑洛伊希滕贝格之名领有。

西班牙王位继承战争中，皇帝将它视为收归帝国的采邑，1708至1714年封给兰贝格家族，《拉施塔特和约》后归还巴伐利亚。这片仅约250平方公里的领地1808年并入巴伐利亚。拿破仑倒台后，没有实际领地的洛伊希滕贝格公爵头衔被授予欧仁·德·博阿尔内。

en:
The Duchy of Legnica, centered on Legnica in Lower Silesia, was a Silesian Piast duchy. At nearby Legnickie Pole in 1241 the Mongols defeated High Duke Henry II. The duchy formed in 1248, when Bolesław II withdrew to Legnica after ceding Wrocław to his brother.

Its 1337 duke, Bolesław III, had been forced to do homage to John of Bohemia in 1329, making Legnica a Bohemian fief. Its Piast line, weak through partitions, died out in 1419 and the duchy passed to the Brzeg branch; Bohemia briefly annexed it in 1436.

The Reformation came in 1522 and the population turned Lutheran; the 1526 Habsburg succession in Bohemia brought recurring strife. When the last Piast duke, George William, died in 1675, it passed to direct Habsburg rule, until Frederick the Great of Prussia seized it in the First Silesian War, confirmed in 1742.
zh:
莱格尼察公国是以下西里西亚的莱格尼察为中心的西里西亚皮亚斯特公国。1241年，蒙古人在附近的莱格尼茨基波列击败波兰大公亨里克二世。公国1248年形成，博莱斯瓦夫二世把弗罗茨瓦夫让给弟弟后退居莱格尼察。

1337年在位的博莱斯瓦夫三世曾于1329年被迫向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼，莱格尼察遂成为波希米亚封邑。当地皮亚斯特支系因分家衰弱，1419年绝嗣后公国转入布热格支系，1436年被波希米亚短暂没收。

宗教改革1522年传入，居民改信路德宗；1526年哈布斯堡继承波希米亚王位后纷争不断。末代皮亚斯特公爵格奥尔格·威廉1675年去世后，莱格尼察改由哈布斯堡直接统治，直到普鲁士的腓特烈大帝在第一次西里西亚战争中将其夺取，1742年和约确认普鲁士统治。

en: Linge was a small pre-Islamic kingdom of the Gayo people in the Gayo Highlands of central Aceh, around present-day Linge south of Lake Laut Tawar. Known only from oral tradition, it is said to have arisen in the tenth or eleventh century under King Meurah Adi Genali, before the highlands passed under Aceh's rule.
zh: 邻稽是加约人在亚齐中部加约高地建立的前伊斯兰小王国，地当劳特塔瓦尔湖以南的邻稽一带。其史事仅存于口传，相传于10或11世纪在穆拉·阿迪·格纳利王时兴起，后来高地并入亚齐版图。

en:
Langkasuka was one of the earliest Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms of the Malay Peninsula, probably founded in the second century near modern Pattani, where ruins at Yarang mark its likely heartland. The Chinese Liang shu records a walled capital rich in camphor and aloeswood, and embassies from its king Bhagadatta to the Liang court between 515 and 568.

Funan checked its early power, and from the eighth century it passed into the shadow of Srivijaya, whose tributary it remained in the twelfth; the Chola king Rajendra I raided it in 1025. Song and Yuan trade guides still list it as a source of lakawood and ivory.

Its end is obscure: Malay annals place its destruction around 1370, while other accounts have it surviving into the fifteenth century. Pattani later arose on its former lands and its people turned to Islam.
zh:
狼牙修是马来半岛最早的印度教—佛教王国之一，可能约建于2世纪，位于今北大年附近海岸，也兰遗址很可能是其核心地带。中国《梁书》记载它有城墙环绕的国都，盛产樟脑与沉香，国王跋伽达多在515至568年间多次遣使梁朝。

它早期国势受扶南遏制，8世纪起落入三佛齐的势力范围，到12世纪仍是其属邦；1025年朱罗国王拉金德拉一世曾洗劫此地。宋、元商旅笔记仍把它列为产降真香和象牙的地方。

它的结局并不清晰：马来史籍称其约1370年灭亡，也有说法认为它延续到15世纪，故地后来兴起北大年王国，居民改宗伊斯兰教。

en: Longquan, centred on Longquanping in present-day Fenggang County, was a Yuan-era zhangguansi on the western edge of the Sizhou chiefdom; Longquanping itself briefly served as Sizhou's seat after 1277. The Ming kept the Dabao Longquan zhangguansi until 1601, when it was replaced by Longquan County under Shiqian Prefecture.
zh: 龙泉土司以龙泉坪为治所，当今凤冈县一带，元代处在思州土司的西缘；1277年以后思州的治所也曾一度迁到龙泉坪。明代沿袭设置大保龙泉长官司，至1601年废司置龙泉县，划归石阡府管辖。

en:
Lingtsang was one of five independent Kham kingdoms on the upper Yangtze north of Derge, in what is now southern Sêrxü. Its Gyelpo rulers claimed descent from epic hero King Gesar of Ling; in the Tibetan Empire period its capital Denkok was a leading center of Kham, and in 1216 Lingtsang forces raided the Tsurphu monastery near Lhasa.

Under Sakya rule its monk-headed dynasty won overlordship over Domé; the Yuan called the territory Dokham and made its lord chief military commander. Independent after Sakya power ended, its kings received Ming titles in the early fifteenth century to keep Kham caravan routes open.

Around 1600 it still held Derge, but the rising Derge kingdom eclipsed it after 1630. The Qing made it a pacification commission in 1728; a mid-eighteenth-century attempt to recover its lands ended in defeat by Derge, leaving it a vassal.
zh:
灵藏又译林葱，是康区五个独立王国之一，位于德格以北的长江上游河谷，即今石渠县南。其甲布王统自称出自史诗英雄格萨尔王的岭国王族；吐蕃帝国时期首府登科是康区的中心，1216年灵藏军队劫掠了拉萨附近的楚布寺。

萨迦派掌权时，世代为僧的首领受命管辖朵甘思，元朝以“朵甘思”之名封其为管军都元帅。萨迦统治结束后灵藏独立，15世纪初明朝册封其王，以保障康区商路畅通。

1600年前后灵藏仍控制德格，但1630年后崛起的德格王国反超。1728年清朝设林葱安抚司；18世纪中叶它试图收复失地，被德格击败，沦为附庸。

en:
Longzhou was a hill prefecture on the upper Fu River in northern Sichuan, around present-day Pingwu and Jiangyou, home of Di and Qiang mountain dwellers. The Shu Han kingdom built the Jiangyou barrier there in 219, and in 263 its keeper Ma Miao surrendered without a fight to Wei general Deng Ai on the march destroying Shu.

Western Wei created Longzhou in 553, seated at Nanba; under the Tang it survived as a loose-rein prefecture, and under the Yuan as Long'an department. The Ming reorganized it after 1373 and in 1432 confirmed the Longzhou pacification commission under hereditary Xue chieftains.

In 1566 the tusi Xue Zhaogan revolted and was crushed; the court replaced native rule with regular officials and created Long'an Prefecture. Under the Qing it gained Zhangming County in 1731, though one native office remained.
zh:
龙州是四川北部涪江上游的山区州，辖今平武、江油一带，本是氐、羌山民居地。219年蜀汉在此修筑江由关；263年守将马邈面对魏将邓艾不战而降，蜀汉随之灭亡。

553年西魏置龙州，治南坝；唐代为羁縻州，元代称龙安州。明朝1373年后屡有调整，1432年定为龙州宣抚司，由世袭薛氏土司统领。

1566年土司薛兆乾叛乱被讨平，朝廷改土归流，置龙安府，派流官治理。清代1731年增领彰明县，府内仍保留一个土司。

en:
Lahijan is the historic capital of Bia-pish, eastern Gilan beyond the Safid Rud, and a main silk market of the Caspian lowlands. In the twelfth century it replaced Hawsam as the seat of the Zaydi Alid sayyids, who governed eastern Gilan through loose local clans. The Ilkhan Öljaitü's campaign of 1306 to 1307 added Gilan to the Mongol empire only in name.

Around 1367 the sayyid Ali Kia founded the Kar-Kiya dynasty, making Lahijan its capital and uniting Bia-pish for over two centuries.

The Kar-Kiya rulers helped Shah Ismail found the Safavid state and became its vassals, but the last, Khan Ahmad Khan, turned to Russia, so Shah Abbas I conquered Gilan in 1592 and ended both the Kar-Kiya and the western Eshaqvand dynasties. Russian troops occupied it in 1725 during the Safavid collapse.
zh:
拉希詹是萨菲德河以东吉兰东半部比亚皮什的历史都城，也是里海低地主要的生丝市场之一。12世纪，它取代豪萨姆成为栽德派阿里德圣裔的驻地，后者靠松散的地方氏族治理东吉兰，伊利汗完者都1306至1307年的远征也只是在名义上把吉兰纳入蒙古帝国。

约1367年，圣裔阿里·基亚建立卡尔基亚王朝，以拉希詹为都，在此后两个多世纪里统一了比亚皮什。

卡尔基亚君主曾帮助伊斯玛仪一世建立萨非国家并成为其附庸，但末代君主汗·艾哈迈德汗转而向俄国求援，阿拔斯一世遂于1592年征服吉兰，终结卡尔基亚王朝和西吉兰的埃沙克万德王朝。1725年萨非政权崩溃之际，俄军占领拉希詹。

en:
Lahul was a high Himalayan valley country around the upper Chandra and Bhaga, whose waters meet at Tandi to form the Chenab; its chief seat was Keylong, reached from Kullu over the Rohtang pass. The thinly populated valleys were Tibetan Buddhist, ruled by hereditary thakur chiefs, whose strongholds included the fort and monastery of Gondhla.

Through the Middle Ages it lay within Ladakh's orbit, though the rajas of Chamba and Kullu competed for its tribute. It passed under Kullu's control in the seventeenth century, notably under rajas Biddhi Singh and Man Singh, around the Tibet-Ladakh-Mughal war of 1679 to 1684 that severed Ladakh's claims.

Lahul grew wealthy on the Central Asian caravan route linking Punjab and Kullu with Ladakh and Yarkand, until Dogra armies overran the valley in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
拉胡尔是喜马拉雅高山谷地小国，地处钱德拉河与巴加河上游，两河在坦迪汇合成奇纳布河；首要据点是吉隆，取道罗唐山口可通古卢。谷地人烟稀少，居民信奉藏传佛教，由世袭的塔库尔酋长统治，据点包括贡德拉的堡垒与寺院。

中世纪时拉胡尔处在拉达克王国势力范围内，昌巴和古卢的罗阇一再争夺其贡赋。17世纪它转入古卢控制，尤其是比迪·辛格和曼·辛格两位罗阇治下；时值1679—1684年西藏—拉达克—莫卧儿战争前后，拉达克旧日的宗主权就此终结。

连接旁遮普、古卢与拉达克、叶尔羌的中亚商路给拉胡尔带来财富，直到19世纪初多格拉军队攻占这片谷地。

en:
Lahaina, anciently Lele, is a sheltered anchorage on Maui's dry north-west coast, famed for its breadfruit groves. It was the seat of western Maui's high chiefs, who under Kaka'alaneo fixed their court at Lele on Keka'a hill, while Hana's chiefs ruled the east independently. Kaka'alaneo's descendant Pi'ilani, first to unite Maui, also controlled Lanai, Kahoolawe and parts of Moloka'i from here.

In 1738 the fields above Lahaina saw battles between chief Kamehamehanui and his half-brother, backed by Hawai'i and O'ahu rulers. Cook's ships appeared in 1778, and in 1793 George Vancouver found it impoverished by years of war.

After unification Kamehameha I anchored his war-canoe fleet here in 1802; American missionaries opened a station in 1823, and by the 1830s Lahaina was the kingdom's foremost whaling port, guarded after 1831 by a stone fort against riotous sailors.
zh:
拉海纳古称莱莱，是毛伊岛干燥西北海岸的避风锚地，以面包树林闻名。它曾是西毛伊最高酋长的驻地，卡卡阿拉内奥时宫廷定在凯卡阿山丘上的莱莱，哈纳的酋长仍独立统治毛伊东半部。卡卡阿拉内奥的后裔皮伊拉尼首次统一全毛伊，并以此为基地控制拉奈、卡霍奥拉韦和莫洛凯的部分地区。

1738年，拉海纳以北的土地上，酋长卡美哈梅哈努伊与其异母兄弟交战，背后有夏威夷岛和瓦胡岛的统治者撑腰。1778年库克的船队出现在外海；1793年乔治·温哥华见到的地区已因连年战争而贫困。

统一后卡美哈梅哈一世1802年将战舟舰队停泊于此，美国传教士1823年设立传教站；到19世纪30年代，拉海纳已是王国首屈一指的捕鲸港，1831年起以一座石堡防备闹事的水手。

en: The Lhaq'temish were a Coast Salish people of the San Juan Islands and the mainland near Bellingham. They caught salmon with reef nets around Lummi Island, named Isla de Pacheco by Spanish explorers in 1792. In the 18th and 19th centuries, smallpox and northern raids drove islanders to the mainland, where they fortified new settlements.
zh: 拉克特米什人是居住在圣胡安群岛和贝灵厄姆附近大陆的海岸萨利什民族。他们在卢米岛附近用礁网捕捞鲑鱼，西班牙探险者于1792年将该岛命名为帕切科岛。18至19世纪，天花和来自北方的袭击使岛上居民迁往大陆，并在那里筑起设防的新聚落。

en: The Lushootseed-speaking peoples included autonomous village communities around Puget Sound in western Washington. Among them, the Duwamish lived around the Duwamish and Black rivers and Lake Washington.
zh: 卢舒特西德语使用者包括华盛顿州西部普吉特海湾周围各自自治的村落社群。其中杜瓦米什人居住在杜瓦米什河、布莱克河与华盛顿湖一带。

en:
The Lordship of Lichtenberg was a Lower Alsatian Holy Roman Empire territory around its family castle, first recorded in 1206, with estates on both Rhine banks by Strasbourg. Its lords grew rich on toll and escort rights over Lombardy-Flanders roads and Rhine ferries, buying castles and acquiring Werd estates in 1332; two kinsmen became bishops of Strasbourg and returned bishopric fiefs to the family.

Around 1330 the inheritance split between John II, elder-line head in 1337, and Louis III, bound by treaties. By the fifteenth century the lordship held over two hundred villages and over thirty castles, but the last lords died sonless; heiresses carried it to Hanau-Babenhausen and Zweibrücken-Bitsch counts, who partitioned it in 1480, the Hanau line becoming Hanau-Lichtenberg.

When that Zweibrücken-Bitsch half fell in in 1570, the whole Lichtenberg inheritance was reunited under Hanau-Lichtenberg, whose castle surrendered to French troops in 1678.
zh:
利希滕贝格领地是神圣罗马帝国在下阿尔萨斯的领土，核心是1206年首见记载的家族城堡，产业在斯特拉斯堡附近的莱茵河两岸。领主凭借伦巴第至佛兰德商路的征税护送权和莱茵河渡口发家，购入城堡，1332年取得韦尔德方伯的产业；两名亲族出任斯特拉斯堡主教，又把主教区封邑回馈家族。

约1330年，遗产在1337年长系首领约翰二世与路德维希三世之间瓜分，盟约使两支不致离散。到15世纪，领地已有两百多个村庄、三十多座城堡，但末代领主没有男嗣：女继承人把它带给哈瑙—巴本豪森与茨韦布吕肯—比奇的伯爵，1480年两家瓜分其地，哈瑙一系改称哈瑙—利希滕贝格。

1570年茨韦布吕肯—比奇分得的那一半也无人继承，遗产在哈瑙—利希滕贝格名下重新合流，其城堡1678年向法军投降。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Liège was an ecclesiastical Holy Roman Empire principality whose bishop sat in the Imperial Diet. In 980 to 985 Bishop Notker won secular rule of Huy from Otto II, founding an autonomous state for nearly eight centuries; its schools made Liège the Athens of the North.

Purchases and bequests added Bouillon in 1096 and county of Loon in 1366. Its 1337 ruler Adolf II of the Mark had settled bishop and town rights by the 1316 Peace of Fexhe.

After 1384 Burgundian pressure grew, and the Liège Wars ended with Charles the Bold destroying Dinant in 1466 and Liège in 1468. The 1789 Liège Revolution briefly set up a republic, but imperial troops restored the bishop in 1791; French armies annexed the principality in 1795, its lands passing to the United Netherlands after 1815 and Belgium in 1830.
zh:
列日采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，主教在帝国议会拥有席位。980至985年间，主教诺特克尔从皇帝奥托二世手中取得于伊的世俗统治权，建立的自治国家延续近八百年；列日的学府使它赢得北方的雅典之名。

通过购置和遗赠，布永于1096年、隆伯国于1366年并入。1337年的统治者是马克家族的阿道夫二世，他曾在1316年通过费克斯和约定下主教与城市的权利边界。

1384年后勃艮第压力日增，列日战争以大胆查理在1466年摧毁迪南、1468年摧毁列日本城告终。1789年列日革命一度建立共和国，但帝国军队1791年恢复主教统治；1795年法国吞并这个邦国，其领土1815年后并入尼德兰联合王国，1830年成为比利时的一部分。

en:
Ligor, later Nakhon Si Thammarat, was the chief city on the Malay Peninsula's east coast, site of the Indianised kingdom of Tambralinga. Tambralinga traded with Song China from 1001 and grew rich on traffic across the Kra Isthmus, its king Chandrabhanu invading Sri Lanka in 1247.

Plague and defeat ended that line; by the 1280s Tai rulers took the city. It appears in the 1283 Ramkhamhaeng inscription as Sukhothai's southernmost tributary. After Ramkhamhaeng died it regained independence; in 1337 it was the peninsula's dominant Thai mueang.

Majapahit's 1365 court poem counted it among Siam's lands; in 1468 Ayutthaya listed it among its eight great cities. It kept its dynasty under Ayutthayan overlordship and twice rebelled, in 1629 and 1688, before Taksin reabsorbed it in 1769. Briefly free again after Ayutthaya's fall, it became a governorship under the Bangkok kings, whose forces it led against Kedah in 1821 and 1831.
zh:
洛坤后称那空是贪玛叻，是马来半岛东海岸的首要城市，前身是印度化古国单马令。单马令自1001年起与宋朝通商，凭借克拉地峡的过境贸易致富，国王旃陀跋努1247年跨海远征锡兰。

瘟疫与战败终结了这一王族，到13世纪80年代泰人统治者接管该城。1283年的兰甘亨碑铭把它列为素可泰最南端的属邦。兰甘亨死后它恢复独立，1337年时已是半岛上最强大的泰人城邦。

1365年满者伯夷的宫廷诗已把它算作暹罗之地，1468年阿瑜陀耶将其列入八大城市。它在阿瑜陀耶宗主权下保留王朝，曾于1629年和1688年两度反叛，1769年被郑信重新收服。阿瑜陀耶陷落后它曾短暂自立，随后在曼谷诸王治下降为行省，并领兵于1821年和1831年征讨吉打。

en:
The Duchy of Limbourg was a Holy Roman Empire estate between the Meuse and Aachen, ruled from cliff-top Limbourg on the Vesdre in Wallonia. It grew from a county built around 1020 by Frederick of Lower Lorraine, who raised Limbourg Castle; Henry IV recognised ducal title in 1101 and Barbarossa confirmed it in 1165.

Marriage widened its reach, Waleran III acquiring Luxembourg in 1214, but heiress Irmgard's childless death in 1283 sparked the War of the Limburg Succession; John I of Brabant's 1288 Worringen victory brought it under Brabant in personal union. John III of Brabant held it in 1337, though still a separate imperial state.

It passed to Valois Burgundy in 1404 and the Habsburgs in 1482, as one of the Seventeen Provinces; after Spanish and Austrian rule in the Southern Netherlands, French Revolutionary troops dissolved it in 1794 into Ourthe department.
zh:
林堡公国是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，地处默兹河与亚琛之间，以韦德尔河畔悬崖上的林堡镇为治所，在今瓦隆尼亚境内。它源于1020年前后下洛林的弗里德里希经营的伯国，他修建了林堡城堡；1101年亨利四世承认公爵头衔，1165年巴巴罗萨予以确认。

公爵们借联姻扩张，瓦勒兰三世1214年取得卢森堡；1283年女继承人伊尔姆加德无嗣而终，引发继承战争，布拉班特的约翰一世1288年在沃林根获胜，林堡以君合归入布拉班特。约翰三世1337年统治它，但它仍是独立的帝国邦国。

1404年它传给瓦卢瓦勃艮第，1482年转入哈布斯堡，成为十七省之一；历经南尼德兰的西班牙与奥地利统治后，法国革命军1794年解散公国，并入乌尔特省。

en:
Lái'ān was the Lai'an route, a military-civilian command in the hill country of western Guangxi, with its seat near present-day Tianyang and Baise. It began as the Song Lai'an military district; in 1276 its officers Li Weiping and Cen Congyi surrendered to the Yuan, and the district was raised to a route governing departments and chief's offices.

The native Cen clan held the route command by hereditary right, and in 1319 the commander Cen Shixing rose against the Yuan and seized the Tanghuo department.

When the Ming took over, the old route was split into the Anlong office around present-day Longlin and the Sicheng department around present-day Lingyun, dissolving the Lai'an polity into smaller native units.
zh:
来安即来安路军民总管府，是广西西部山区的军民建制，治所在今田阳、百色一带。其前身是宋朝的来安军，1276年来安军官员李维屏、岑从义降元，来安军升为来安路，统辖一批州县和长官司。

岑氏家族世袭路总管，1319年总管岑世兴起兵叛元，据有唐火州。

明代取其地后，来安路旧境被拆分为安隆司（今隆林）和泗城州（今凌云），来安旧邦就此解体为较小的土司。

en:
Liptako was a region around the Niger bend, spanning parts of present-day Burkina Faso, Niger and Mali. Songhai ruled the area from the late 15th century until its defeat in 1591; the Gurma later established the kingdom of Koala there.

In the early 19th century the Fula overthrew Koala and founded the Islamic emirate of Liptako under Brahima Saidu. The emirate belonged to the Sokoto Caliphate, and its rulers were based at Dori.
zh:
利普塔科是尼日尔河曲一带的地区，涵盖今布基纳法索、尼日尔和马里的部分土地。桑海从15世纪末统治此地，直至1591年战败；古尔马人后来在此建立科阿拉王国。

19世纪初，富拉人推翻科阿拉，由布拉希马·赛义杜建立伊斯兰教的利普塔科酋长国。该酋长国隶属索科托哈里发国，统治者以多里为驻地。

en:
The Grand Duchy of Lithuania grew from the Baltic lands of Aukštaitija, whose tribes Mindaugas united. Crowned Catholic king in 1253, he ruled before the country reverted to paganism. From Vilnius, traditionally founded by Gediminas (r. about 1316–1341), the duchy expanded over former Kievan Rus' principalities until it stretched from the Baltic to the Black Sea.

In 1337 Gediminas ruled a pagan state under constant Teutonic attack; his letters invited Hanseatic merchants and friars, though baptism was repeatedly postponed. His sons Algirdas and Kęstutis expanded further; in 1385 Algirdas's son Jogaila accepted the Union of Krewo and in 1386 married the Polish queen, converting Europe's last pagan state. Vytautas the Great crushed the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald in 1410.

The 1569 Union of Lublin merged Lithuania with Poland into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, though Lithuania kept its own laws, army and treasury. The Constitution of 3 May 1791 ended that status, and after Kościuszko's uprising the 1795 partitions divided Lithuania between Russia, Prussia and Austria.
zh:
立陶宛大公国起源于奥克什泰蒂亚的波罗的海诸部，明道加斯统一各部，1253年加冕为天主教国王，此后国家又恢复多神信仰。大公格迪米纳斯约1316—1341年在位，相传定都维尔纽斯；大公国吞并原基辅罗斯诸公国，疆域从波罗的海延伸到黑海。

1337年立陶宛仍是多神教国家，不断遭条顿骑士团进攻；格迪米纳斯致信汉萨诸城，邀请商人和修道士定居，受洗却一再推迟。其子阿尔吉尔达斯与科斯图提斯继续扩张，1385年阿尔吉尔达斯之子雅盖沃接受克雷沃联合，1386年迎娶波兰女王，使欧洲最后的多神教国家皈依基督教。维陶塔斯大帝于1410年在格伦瓦德击溃条顿骑士团。

1569年卢布林联合使大公国与波兰合并为联邦，立陶宛保留法律、军队和国库。1791年五三宪法取消这一独立地位，科希丘什科起义后，1795年的瓜分使立陶宛被俄罗斯、普鲁士和奥地利分割。

en:
Livonia is the state of the Livonian Order, the Baltic branch of the Teutonic Order. It began in 1202, when Bishop Albert of Riga created the Livonian Brothers of the Sword to conquer and convert pagans. Crushed at Saule in 1236, its remnants joined the Teutonic Order in 1237 as an autonomous Livonian branch.

In 1337 land master Everard von Monheim ruled from Livonia's castles while Riga's archbishop and bishops shared the country. In 1343 the Estonian St. George's Night revolt was suppressed, and Denmark sold its Estonian duchy to the Order in 1346.

Weakened after Grunwald, the masters joined the Livonian Confederation in 1435. The Livonian War proved fatal: after the Muscovite victory at Ergeme in 1560, last master Gotthard Kettler secularized the Order in 1561 and founded the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia, while Sweden, Denmark and Lithuania divided the rest.
zh:
利沃尼亚是利沃尼亚骑士团的国家，即条顿骑士团的波罗的海分支。其前身可追溯到1202年，里加主教阿尔伯特组建宝剑骑士团，以征服和归化异教民族。1236年宝剑骑士团在索莱溃败，残部于1237年并入条顿骑士团，成为自治的利沃尼亚分支。

1337年，地方长官埃弗拉德·冯·蒙海姆在利沃尼亚各城堡发号施令，里加大主教和主教与他分治其地。1343年爱沙尼亚的圣乔治之夜起义被镇压，1346年丹麦把爱沙尼亚公国卖给骑士团。

格林瓦尔德之战后骑士团日趋衰弱，1435年长官加入利沃尼亚联盟。利沃尼亚战争给了它致命一击：1560年俄军在埃尔盖梅取胜后，末任长官戈特哈德·克特勒于1561年将骑士团世俗化，建立库尔兰和瑟米加利亚公国，其余土地被瑞典、丹麦和立陶宛瓜分。

en:
Lijiang was the Naxi chiefdom in the Hengduan Mountains of north-western Yunnan, enriched by tea-and-horse roads between Yunnan, Tibet and India. The Naxi settled the Jinsha valleys and passed under Tibetan and then Nanzhao rule before their chieftain submitted to Khubilai in 1253 and the Yuan made his family pacification commissioners.

In 1382 chief Ajia Ade was among the first border rulers to submit to the Ming; Hongwu named him Mu De, founding Lijiang's Mu dynasty. Mu armies served Ming campaigns in Yunnan and Luchuan and seized neighbouring lands, peaking under Mu Zeng early in the seventeenth century with raids on Gyalrong and an invasion of Chakla; he sheltered the exiled tenth Karmapa and hosted Xu Xiake in 1639.

Under the Qing, Mu Yi refused Wu Sangui's 1673 rebellion and was imprisoned. Yongzheng's 1723 bureaucratisation replaced the chiefdom with Han magistrates, Naxi keeping Dongba religion and script.
zh:
丽江是纳西人在滇西北横断山中的土司政权，凭借连接云南、西藏和印度的茶马道致富。纳西人定居金沙江峡谷，先后受吐蕃、南诏统治；1253年其首领向忽必烈归降，元朝封其家族为宣慰使。

1382年，首领阿甲阿得是率先归附明朝的边地统治者之一，洪武帝赐名木得，开创木氏土司。木氏军队随明军出征云南和麓川，蚕食邻部，17世纪初木增当政时达到鼎盛，曾攻伐嘉绒、攻入查克拉；他收留流亡的第十世噶玛巴，1639年接待徐霞客。

入清后，木懿拒绝吴三桂1673年的叛乱，因此入狱。1723年雍正改土归流，废除土司改派流官，纳西人仍保有东巴教和文字。

en: The Lakota, or Teton, were the westernmost people of the Sioux alliance known as the Seven Council Fires. From the western Great Lakes, they moved onto the northern Plains in the seventeenth century amid conflicts with the Anishinaabe and Cree. After adopting horses around 1730, they crossed the Missouri and established themselves in the Black Hills by the 1770s.
zh: 拉科塔又称提顿人，是被称为七议事火的苏族联盟中最西部的族群。他们原居五大湖西部，17世纪在与阿尼希纳贝人和克里人的冲突中迁往北部大平原。约1730年开始使用马匹后，他们越过密苏里河，到18世纪70年代在黑山地区立足。

en:
The Collagua were an Aymara-speaking people of the upper Colca Valley in southern Peru, who had migrated from the Lake Titicaca region. They cultivated the valley's terraced slopes alongside the Quechua-speaking Cabana.

Inca rule reached the valley around 1320, apparently through marriage alliances. In 1540 Gonzalo Pizarro's Spaniards arrived, and in the 1570s Viceroy Francisco de Toledo ordered the scattered inhabitants into centralized settlements.
zh:
科利亚瓜人说艾马拉语，从的的喀喀湖地区迁至秘鲁南部科尔卡河谷上游。他们与说克丘亚语的卡瓦纳人在河谷梯田耕作。

印加人约在1320年将统治扩展到河谷，似乎主要依靠联姻。1540年，贡萨洛·皮萨罗率领的西班牙人抵达；1570年代，总督弗朗西斯科·德·托莱多下令将散居居民迁入集中聚居点。

en:
Luliang is a broad basin on the upper Nanpan River east of Kunming, regarded as the homeland of the Cuan culture; the celebrated fifth-century Stele of Cuan Longyan was erected here. The Han established Tonglao County here in 109 BC, later renamed Tongle.

After Nanzhao took the region in 748 it was called Kuilunong Chuan, and under the Dali kingdom the Luowen tribe dwelt here under Shicheng Commandery. With the Mongol arrival in 1253 the Luowen became a thousand-household unit, and in 1276 the area was organised as Luliang Subprefecture of Qujing Route, governing Fanghua and Hena counties.

The Ming renamed it Liuliang Subprefecture in 1389 and planted the Liuliang garrison in 1398, soon folding Fanghua and Hena counties into the subprefecture. The Qing abolished the garrison in 1669 and moved the subprefectural seat into the garrison town.
zh:
陆良是昆明以东、南盘江上游的宽阔坝子，被视为爨文化的发源地，5世纪的名碑《爨龙颜碑》即立于此地。公元前109年汉朝在此设同劳县，后改名同乐县。

748年南诏取其地，称夔鹿弄川；大理国时落温部居住于此，隶属石城郡。1253年蒙古入滇，落温被编为千户，1276年改设陆梁州，隶曲靖路，领芳华、河纳二县。

明代于1389年改名六凉州，1398年设置六凉卫，不久又将芳华、河纳二县省并入州。清代于1669年裁撤六凉卫，把州治迁到卫城。

en:
Luoluosi was the Mongol name for the Yi country of southern Sichuan, the Anning River valley and Liangshan highlands centred on Jianchang, modern Xichang. Nanzhao organised the region as Jianchang Prefecture in the ninth century, and the Dali kingdom in turn raised its Jianchang Commandery to a prefecture.

When the Mongols pacified the area they divided it in 1275 into five chief commands and twenty-three departments under the Luoluosi Pacification Commission, named after the local Luoluo tribes. With its seat at Jianchang, the commission supervised five routes covering roughly the present Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture; Mongol nobles held the senior posts and local chiefs served as their deputies.

In 1382 the Ming replaced it with Jianchang Prefecture and Jianchang Guard, seat of the Sichuan Regional Military Command, and in 1728 the Qing reorganised the country as Ningyuan Prefecture.
zh:
罗罗斯是元朝对川西南彝族地区的称呼，以安宁河谷和凉山山地为主体，中心在建昌，即今四川西昌。9世纪南诏在此设建昌府，大理国时期又把建昌郡升为建昌府。

蒙古平定此地后，于1275年将全境析为五个总管府、二十三州，其上设罗罗斯宣慰司，司名取自当地的罗罗部落。宣慰司治设在建昌路，统辖五路军民政务，辖境约当今凉山彝族自治州；宣慰使由蒙古贵族出任，其下官职任用当地首领。

1382年明朝将其改置为建昌府和建昌卫，建昌成为四川行都指挥使司治所；1728年清朝又把这一地区改建为宁远府。

en: The Lalu are the Hulawen Jurchens, a Wild Jurchen group named after the Hulan river (Manchu hvlan, chimney), which rises in the Lesser Khingan mountains and crosses the Songnen plain to join the Songhua east of Harbin. The Wozhe forest peoples rose twice against the Yuan in 1343 and 1346, angered by gyrfalcon tribute demands.
zh: 拉卢即忽剌温女真，属野人女真，因呼兰河（满语意为烟囱）得名；呼兰河发源于小兴安岭，斜贯松嫩平原，在哈尔滨以东注入松花江。14世纪40年代，这一带的兀者森林部落因不堪海东青贡奉之扰，于1343年和1346年两次起兵反元。

en:
Lho Mon, the southern Mon land or Monyul of the old Tibetan chronicles, is the group of Himalayan valleys centred on Paro and Punakha that became Bhutan. Its earliest named inhabitants were the Monpa peoples, among whom Buddhism took root: the Tibetan king Songtsän Gampo founded temples at Kyichu and Bumthang in the seventh century, and Padmasambhava preached in 810, planting the Nyingmapa order.

After the Tibetan Empire collapsed the valleys split into small kingdoms, Bumthang foremost. From the twelfth century the Drukpa Kagyu spread from dzong to dzong, eclipsing older sects; in 1337 the land remained a patchwork of monastic estates and rival lords.

Unity came only in 1616, when the Drukpa lama Ngawang Namgyal, the Zhabdrung, fled Gelug pressure, defeated Tibetan invasions, built dzong and promulgated the Tsa Yig code to create Drukyul; after his death civil wars troubled it for two centuries.
zh:
珞门古称“门域”，藏文编年史意为南方的门地，是以帕罗、普那卡为中心的喜马拉雅山谷，也就是后来的不丹。最早见于记载的居民是门巴山民，佛教逐渐传入：7世纪吐蕃赞普松赞干布在吉曲、布姆唐修建寺院，810年莲花生到此传法，播下宁玛派的种子。

吐蕃帝国崩溃后，河谷分裂为诸小邦，以布姆唐最强。12世纪起，竺巴噶举派借宗堡传播，压倒更古老的教派；到1337年，这里仍是寺院领地与割据贵族拼合的局面。

统一迟至1616年才到来：竺巴噶举派喇嘛夏仲·阿旺朗杰为避西藏格鲁派压力南逃，屡败入侵藏军，修筑宗堡并颁布《法令》，建立竹域；他死后内战困扰该国两百年。

en:
Lan Na was a Tai Yuan state in the northern Thai highlands, ruled from Chiang Mai. It grew from the older mueang of Ngoenyang, whose king Mangrai founded Chiang Rai in 1262, conquered Mon Hariphunchai in 1281 and founded Chiang Mai as his capital in 1296.

After Mangrai died around 1311 came succession disputes; in 1337 his great-great-grandson Phayu held the kingdom and built Wat Phra Singh. Lan Na peaked under Tilokaraj (r. 1441–1487), whose Buddhist council recompiled the Tipitaka near Chiang Mai in 1477.

Dynastic strife weakened it, and in 1558 Burmese king Bayinnaung took Chiang Mai and made Lan Na a vassal. It broke away in 1596 but fell back under Burmese-backed rulers after 1614. A 1727 revolt brought independence until the Konbaung retook Chiang Mai in 1763. In 1775 Kawila of Lampang, with Siamese aid, drove out the Burmese; Lan Na became a Siamese vassal, later split into five principalities.
zh:
兰纳是泰国北部高原上的傣阮人政权，以清迈为统治中心，由更古老的恩央王国发展而来。恩央国王孟莱1262年兴建清莱，1281年征服孟人王国哈利奔猜，1296年营建清迈并定为国都。

孟莱约1311年去世后继统纷争不断；1337年他的玄孙帕育在位，修建了帕辛寺。兰纳在蒂洛卡拉治下（1441—1487年）达到鼎盛，他于1477年在清迈附近召集佛教结集，重新编纂三藏。

此后王室内斗使国势转衰，1558年缅甸国王勃印曩攻占清迈，兰纳沦为属邦。它1596年脱离缅甸，1614年后又落回缅甸扶立的统治者手中。1727年的起义换来独立，1763年贡榜王朝再度攻陷清迈。1775年，南邦的卡威拉在暹罗援助下逐出缅人，兰纳成为暹罗属邦，后来分为五个邦国。

en:
The Lenca inhabited what are now western Honduras and eastern El Salvador. In the early sixteenth century they were divided into several confederations, each consisting of lordships and towns, rather than a single kingdom.

In 1537 the Lenca leader Lempira organized resistance to Spanish conquest from the fortified hill of Cerquín. His forces drew on many towns, but the Spaniards eventually overcame the resistance; accounts differ over the circumstances of his death.
zh:
伦卡人居住在今洪都拉斯西部和萨尔瓦多东部。16世纪初，他们分属多个联盟，每个联盟下辖若干领地和城镇，并未组成统一王国。

1537年，伦卡领袖伦皮拉以设防的塞尔金山为据点，组织抵抗西班牙征服。他的军队来自许多城镇，但西班牙人最终镇压了抵抗；关于他的死因，各种记载并不一致。

en:
Lunda was a confederation of states centred in Katanga, extending into what are now Angola and Zambia. Its rulers bore the title Mwata Yamvo and held court at a royal centre called the musumba, protected by a moat and earthen walls.

Lunda traditions recount the marriage of the Luba prince Ilunga Tshibinda to the royal woman Lueji. Nawej, who began to rule around 1695, is the first well-attested historical ruler; traditions credit him with creating the office of queen mother to help determine succession.
zh:
隆达是以加丹加为中心的国家联盟，势力伸展到今安哥拉和赞比亚境内。其统治者使用姆瓦塔·扬沃的称号，在名为穆松巴的王庭执政，王庭由壕沟和土墙保护。

隆达传说记载，卢巴王子伊隆加·奇宾达迎娶了王族女子卢埃吉。约1695年开始统治的纳韦吉是史料中首位有充分记载的统治者；传统认为他设立了王太后职位，协助决定王位继承。

en:
Liang was the appanage of the Mongol Princes of Liang, Borjigin viceroys through whom the Yuan governed Yunnan. Mongol rule began in 1253, when Kublai overran the Dali Kingdom; Yunnan became one of his empire's ten provinces.

The princes traced their line to Kublai's son Khökhechi and presided over native tusi chieftains including the Duan of Dali. When the Ming drove the Yuan from China proper in 1368, Prince Basalawarmi kept Yunnan loyal to the Northern Yuan, executing Ming envoy Wang Wei in 1374.

In 1381 the Hongwu Emperor sent Fu Youde, Mu Ying and Lan Yu with a reported 300,000 troops; Basalawarmi's army was overwhelmed, and he drowned his wife and killed himself on January 6, 1382. His family was exiled to Tamna, and Ming forces subdued the last Duan at Dali by 1383.
zh:
梁是元朝镇守云南的蒙古宗王梁王的藩国，梁王以孛儿只斤氏出任元朝在西南的最高统治者。蒙古对云南的统治始于1253年，当时还是宗王的忽必烈攻灭大理国；云南后来成为忽必烈帝国十个行省之一。

梁王一支出自忽必烈之子忽哥赤，统辖土著土司，包括大理段氏。1368年明朝把元朝逐出中原后，梁王把匝剌瓦尔密仍效忠北元，1374年处死明使王祎。

1381年，洪武帝派傅友德、沐英、蓝玉统兵，据称三十万，大举入滇，梁王军队被击溃，他先溺死妻子，随后于1382年1月6日自尽。其家族被流放耽罗；明军又于1383年平定大理段氏最后的抵抗。

en:
Landak, in full the Ismahayana kingdom of Landak, was a Hindu state in the interior of western Borneo, holding the valley of the Landak River, a tributary of the Kapuas. Local chronicles derive its rulers from a Singhasari noble, said to have been left behind by Kertanegara's Pamalayu expedition and to have sailed up the Kapuas to found a court at Ningrat Batur around 1292.

The Javanese poem Negarakretagama names Landa among Majapahit's outer states in 1365. In 1337 it remained Hindu, seated at Ningrat Batur and enriched by gold and diamonds washed from its rivers.

Islam was adopted from 1472 under Raden Abdul Kahar; the court moved before settling at Ngabang in 1768. Its rulers married into neighbouring states such as Sambas, and in the late eighteenth century Landak disputed borders with the new sultanate of Pontianak.
zh:
万那全称伊斯摩诃耶那·万那王国，是婆罗洲西部内陆的印度教政权，领有卡普阿斯河支流万那河流域。据当地编年史，其统治者出自爪哇信诃沙里的一位贵族，相传是克尔塔纳加拉发动帕马莱尤远征后滞留的人员，他沿卡普阿斯河上溯，约于1292年在宁格拉特·巴图尔建立宫廷。

1365年的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》把“兰达”列为满者伯夷的外围邦国之一。1337年时王国仍以宁格拉特·巴图尔为都，信奉印度教，靠河中的黄金、钻石致富。

1472年起拉登·阿卜杜勒·卡哈尔在位时改宗伊斯兰教，此后宫廷屡迁，1768年迁至雅邦。诸王与三发等邻邦联姻，18世纪末与新建的坤甸苏丹国发生边界争端。

en:
The County of Leiningen was an immediate lordship of the Holy Roman Empire in the Palatinate, ruled from Altleiningen Castle, built around 1100 by the noble House of Leiningen. The first count on record was Emich II, who died before 1138.

The first line of counts died out around 1220, and the lands passed through an heiress to Frederick of Saarbrücken, who took the Leiningen name and arms; himself a Minnesinger whose song entered the Codex Manesse, he built Hardenburg Castle before 1212. After 1316 his descendants divided the inheritance into the counties of Leiningen-Dagsburg and Leiningen-Hardenburg.

In 1337 the Dagsburg line was headed by Frederick VI, and the later count Frederick VIII married Yolanda of Jülich. The Hardenburg line endured through the Middle Ages: in 1803 it was raised to the Principality of Leiningen, only to be mediatized in 1806.
zh:
莱宁根伯国是神圣罗马帝国的帝国直辖领地，位于普法尔茨，统治根基是莱宁根家族约1100年修建的阿尔特莱宁根城堡。最早可考的伯爵埃米希二世逝于1138年前。

原系男嗣约在1220年断绝，领地经女继承人传给萨尔布吕肯的弗里德里希，他改用莱宁根的姓氏与纹章，本人还是《马内塞手稿》收录的恋歌诗人，并在1212年前兴建哈登堡城堡。1316年后，后裔把领地分为莱宁根-达格斯堡与莱宁根-哈登堡两个伯国。

1337年达格斯堡支由弗里德里希六世当家，后来的弗里德里希八世娶了于利希的约兰达。哈登堡支延续整个中世纪，1803年受封为莱宁根侯国，1806年遭邦君兼并而沦为陪臣。

en:
Lanao was the lake-country of central Mindanao, a ring of Maranao and Iranun settlements around Lake Lanao whose pre-Islamic life is preserved in the Darangen, an epic of seventeen cycles handed down before the fourteenth century. The Chinese chronicle Zhufan Zhi of 1225 records the islands beyond Zamboanga as a separate country.

Islam came with the missionary Sharif Kabungsuwan, whose son Sharif Makaalang became the first native Maranao sultan; Lanao for a time rotated leadership with Maguindanao. When Datu Kudarat seized the Maguindanao throne in 1616 against custom, the lords of four Lanao states met and seceded as the Four States of Lanao, still fighting alongside Maguindanao against Spain.

Spanish expeditions in 1639 and 1640 built a garrison on the lake, but the Maranaos stormed it and drove the Spaniards out; no Spanish force returned for more than two hundred and fifty years.
zh:
拉瑙是棉兰老中部湖区之国，马拉瑙、伊琅文人的定居点环拉瑙湖分布。伊斯兰化以前，当地生活凝结于《达兰根》史诗：这部吟唱史诗分十七个循环，14世纪前已口传流传。1225年中国史籍《诸蕃志》已把三宝颜以东岛屿视为独立国度。

伊斯兰教随传教士谢里夫·卡邦苏万传入，其子谢里夫·马卡朗成为第一位本土马拉瑙苏丹，拉瑙一度与马京达瑙轮流推戴共主。1616年达图·库达拉特违例夺取马京达瑙王位，四邦集会宣布独立，组成拉瑙四邦联盟，仍与马京达瑙并肩抗西。

1639—1640年，西班牙远征队在湖畔建要塞，马拉瑙人攻破要塞、逐出西班牙人，此后两百五十多年间再无西军进入湖区。

en:
The Isles were the Norse-Gaelic maritime lordship of the Hebrides and western Scotland, whose rulers were Kings of the Isles and held their seat at Finlaggan on Islay. It went back to Somerled, founder of a twelfth-century kingdom there; his Clan Donald descendants commanded galley fleets and, nominal vassals of neighbouring crowns, ruled as kings.

In 1336 John of Islay, chief of Clan Donald, styled himself Lord of the Isles. David II confirmed his possessions in 1343. A marriage brought him Garmoran and most of the Hebrides in 1346, and in 1350 he married Margaret Stewart, daughter of the future Robert II. He submitted to David II in 1369 and died in 1386, buried on Iona.

Successors fought at Harlaw in 1411 and treated with England, until John MacDonald II's pact of 1462 led James IV to forfeit the lordship in 1493.
zh:
群岛是赫布里底与苏格兰西部的诺斯-盖尔人海上政权，统治者称“群岛之王”，驻艾莱岛芬拉根。政权可追溯到12世纪在当地建国的萨默莱德；唐纳德家族后裔领有桨帆船队，名义臣属邻近诸王权，实则自行称王。

1336年唐纳德家族首领艾莱的约翰自称“群岛领主”，大卫二世1343年确认其领地。1346年他凭婚姻继承加莫兰，领有大半个赫布里底，1350年又娶后来的罗伯特二世之女玛格丽特·斯图尔特。1369年他向大卫二世臣服，1386年去世，葬艾奥纳岛。

继承人1411年哈洛一战与王权交兵，并同英格兰往来；1462年约翰·麦克唐纳二世联英事败，詹姆斯四世1493年没收群岛领主权。

en: Loloda was a small thirteenth-century kingdom on the north-west coast of Halmahera in the North Moluccas, ruling from Loloda over islands later called North and South Loloda. Its ruler held the old title kolano and later sangaji, as Loloda never joined the Moti Alliance and remained a subordinate of Ternate and Tidore until the Dutch made it a district.
zh: 洛洛达是北摩鹿加哈马黑拉岛西北沿海的小王国，传统上始于13世纪，以洛洛达为中心统治后来称北洛洛达和南洛洛达的群岛。其君主使用古老的科拉诺称号，后改称桑贾吉；洛洛达从未加入莫蒂联盟，始终臣属特尔纳特和蒂多雷，直到荷兰人将其改为辖区。

en:
The Kingdom of León emerged in 910 when the Asturian kingdom was divided and León became a royal seat. Its rulers expanded south across the Douro, while Castile and Portugal separated from the kingdom. In 1188 Alfonso IX summoned an assembly at León that included representatives of towns alongside nobles and clergy.

Alfonso captured Mérida and Badajoz in 1230. After his death that year, his son Ferdinand III united León and Castile under one crown. León remained a constituent kingdom of the Castilian and later Spanish Crown until 1833.
zh:
莱昂王国兴起于910年，当时阿斯图里亚斯王国分裂，莱昂成为王室驻地。莱昂诸王越过杜罗河向南扩张，卡斯蒂利亚和葡萄牙则先后从王国分离。1188年，阿方索九世在莱昂召集会议，城镇代表与贵族、教士一同出席。

阿方索于1230年攻占梅里达和巴达霍斯，同年去世后，其子费尔南多三世将莱昂与卡斯蒂利亚置于同一王冠之下。莱昂此后作为卡斯蒂利亚及西班牙王室下的组成王国延续至1833年。

en:
The County of Loon was a fief of the Holy Roman Empire, named after its first seat at Loon, though the counts later moved to Kuringen. The first reliably recorded count, Giselbert, ruled in the eleventh century, and from about 1190 the counts held their lands as vassals of the Prince-Bishop of Liège.

When Count Louis IV died without a male heir in 1336, the county passed, with Liège's consent, to Theodoric of Heinsberg, whose father had married Louis's sister, so that in 1337 he ruled Loon together with Heinsberg and Chiny.

In 1362 the Prince-Bishop of Liège occupied Loon and annexed it outright in 1366. Loon remained one of Liège's three quarters until French troops dissolved the bishopric in 1795, and in 1815 its lands passed to the new province of Limburg in the Netherlands.
zh:
洛恩伯国是神圣罗马帝国的封邑，得名于伯爵最初的驻地洛恩，后来宫廷迁至库林根。11世纪第一位有可靠记载的伯爵吉塞尔贝特在位；约1190年起，伯爵作为列日采邑主教的封臣领有此地。

1336年伯爵路易四世去世且无男性继承人，经列日同意，伯国传给海因斯贝格的狄奥多里克——他的父亲娶了路易四世的妹妹，因此1337年他同时领有洛恩、海因斯贝格和希尼。

1362年列日采邑主教出兵占领洛恩，1366年将其正式并入主教区。此后洛恩作为列日三大辖区之一保留建制，直到1795年法国军队解散主教区；1815年其地转入尼德兰新设的林堡省。

en:
The Duchy of Lorraine grew out of Upper Lorraine, the southern half created when the stem duchy of Lotharingia split in 959; as Lower Lorraine disintegrated, the upper duchy, with its capital at Nancy, became known as Lorraine and remained a state of the Holy Roman Empire.

In 1337 its duke was Rudolph the Valiant, inheriting as a child in 1328; that year he warred with Henry IV of Bar over refused homage until Philip VI mediated, and he later fell fighting at the Battle of Crécy in 1346.

The duchy was coveted by Burgundy, and Charles the Bold was defeated and killed besieging Nancy in 1477, after which the House of Lorraine ruled securely. In 1737 it went for life to the exiled Polish king Stanisław Leszczyński, and on his death in 1766 France annexed it as a province.
zh:
洛林公国的前身是上洛林：959年古老的洛泰尔尼亚部族公国一分为二，南部即上洛林；随着下洛林分崩离析，这个以南锡为首府的南部公国径称洛林，是神圣罗马帝国的邦国。

1337年在位的是“勇士”拉乌尔，他1328年幼年继位；同年因巴尔的亨利四世拒绝行臣服礼而出兵，直到法兰西国王腓力六世调停。他后来在1346年的克雷西战役中阵亡。

洛林一直为勃艮第所觊觎，1477年大胆查理围攻南锡时兵败身死，洛林家族此后稳固统治。1737年洛林被封给流亡的波兰国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·莱什琴斯基终身享有；1766年他去世后，法兰西将其兼并，改为行省。

en: Lotharingia was a kingdom between East and West Francia, created for Lothair II in 855 and later divided into Upper and Lower Lotharingia. In the fifteenth century, Charles the Bold sought an independent kingdom for his fragmented Burgundian lands, but died at Nancy in 1477.
zh: 洛塔林吉亚是东西法兰克之间的王国，855年为洛泰尔二世建立，后来分为上、下洛塔林吉亚。15世纪，大胆查理试图将其分散的勃艮第领地建为独立王国，但他于1477年在南锡战死。

en:
Liping is a Kam settlement in the hills of southeastern Guizhou, where the borders of Hunan and Guangxi meet. Under the Tang it belonged to Longbiao County and was known as the Wunao stockade, where native chieftain rule first took root.

The Yuan set up the Guzhou Bawandong military and civilian chiefdom here in 1283, and in 1322 replaced it with the Liping native long commandery, held under the Tian family of Sizhou. After Ming armies put down the Kam risings of 1385, it became the Wukai Guard, a garrison worked by military farmers.

In 1413 the Ming dissolved Sizhou and created Liping Prefecture with its seat at the Liping stockade, placing thirteen Kam chieftaincies under the town, which passed from Huguang to Guizhou in 1603. The great Miao uprising of 1735 to 1736 swept the region and reached Liping.
zh:
黎平是贵州东南、毗邻湖南与广西的侗族山居聚落，唐代为龙标县属地，时称五脑寨，土司统治由此发端。

元朝于1283年在此设古州八万军民总管府，1322年废总管府，改置黎平长官司，隶属于思州田氏。1385年明军平定思州诸洞侗族反抗后，废长官司，改设五开卫，以军屯驻守。

1413年明朝废思州宣慰司，在黎平寨设立黎平府，下辖十三个侗族长官司，黎平由此成为这一地区的行政中心，并于1603年由湖广划归贵州。1735—1736年，古州一带爆发的苗民大起义席卷山区，也波及黎平。

en:
Lippe began as a small lordship on the river of the same name, first attested in 1123 under Lord Bernard I. Bernard II founded Lippstadt in 1185, and his heirs added a string of towns. Simon I was its lord in 1337; acquisitions from Schwalenberg between 1332 and 1358 carried it north to the Weser, its greatest extent.

His death in 1344 brought partition and a feud with Tecklenburg over Rheda, settled in 1401, while Lippstadt passed under joint rule. Lippe gained imperial immediacy by 1413 and was raised to an imperial county in 1528.

Lutheranism reached it in 1538, and Simon VI's turn to Calvinism in 1605 caused a lasting quarrel with Lutheran Lemgo, settled in 1617. Devastated in the Thirty Years' War, Lippe survived under its Detmold line and was promoted to a principality in 1789.
zh:
利珀发端于利珀河畔的小领地，1123年在领主贝尔纳一世治下首见记载。贝尔纳二世1185年建立利普施塔特，继承人又陆续添建一串城镇。1337年领主西蒙一世在位；1332—1358年利珀从施瓦伦贝格取得土地，向北扩至威悉河，达到最大疆域。

1344年西蒙去世后领地瓜分，又与泰克伦堡为雷达长期私战，1401年了结；利普施塔特转为共治领地。利珀最迟于1413年获得帝国直辖地位，1528年升为帝国伯国。

1538年路德宗传入，1605年西蒙六世改宗加尔文宗，与路德宗的莱姆戈长期争执，1617年方告解决。三十年战争中利珀遭重创，靠德特莫尔德主支延续，1789年升为侯国。

en:
Larantuka was a Lamaholot kingdom at the eastern end of Flores, whose rajas in time ruled eastern Flores and neighbouring islands. Its genealogy runs to a man from Timor and a mythical woman of the Ile Mandiri volcano, and the fourteenth-century Javanese poem Negarakertagama places tributary lands on the sandalwood route between Bali and Timor.

The Makassarese of Gowa seized it in 1541 to control the trade, but the port's future belonged to the Portuguese, who abandoned Solor for Larantuka before 1600. After the Dutch took Solor in 1613 and Malacca in 1641, Portuguese and Dominican refugees formed the mixed Catholic community of the Larantuqueiros.

Larantuka's raja Ola Adobala was baptized a Catholic, traditionally in 1650, and swore vassalage to Portugal's king for the title Dom; later rajas ruled as Catholic monarchs under Dominican influence through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, the port largely closed to rival traders.
zh:
拉兰图卡是弗洛勒斯岛东端的拉马霍洛特人王国，拉者后来统治弗洛勒斯东部及邻近岛屿。王室世系追溯到一名帝汶男子与伊莱曼迪里火山的神话女子；14世纪爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》在巴厘至帝汶的檀香航线上提到这一带的朝贡之地。

1541年戈瓦望加锡人为控制贸易夺其地，但港口的未来属于葡萄牙人，他们1600年前弃索洛转居于此。1613年荷兰夺索洛、1641年克马六甲后，葡萄牙人与多明我会难民涌入，形成混血天主教社群拉兰图凯罗人。

拉者奥拉·阿多巴莱受洗入天主教，相传在1650年，他向葡萄牙王宣誓效忠，获唐的称号；此后拉者在多明我会影响下以天主教君主统治17、18世纪，港口对竞争商人基本封闭。

en:
Lausanne grew from the Roman lakeside settlement of Lousanna, whose inhabitants withdrew to a fortified hill in the fourth century. Its bishopric was older: the see of Windisch, whose first bishop attended the synod of Epaone in 517, moved to Avenches and around 600 to Lausanne.

From 888 to 1032 it belonged to the Kingdom of Upper Burgundy, and in the eleventh century its bishops made it their secular centre; Bishop Hugo, son of King Rudolph III, proclaimed the Peace of God there in 1037. Prosperity followed, and in 1275 the cathedral was consecrated before Pope Gregory X and King Rudolf I.

The bishops shared power uneasily with Savoy until 1536, when Bernese troops conquered Lausanne, imposed the Reformation and stripped the cathedral of Catholic fittings, ending the prince-bishopric. Under Bernese rule Lausanne became, after 1685, a refuge for French Huguenot pastors.
zh:
洛桑起源于湖畔的罗马定居点洛桑纳，4世纪居民退守上方山丘。当地教区历史更久：温迪施教区首任主教曾出席517年的埃帕翁主教会议，教区先迁阿旺什，约600年再迁洛桑。

888—1032年该城属上勃艮第王国，11世纪主教把它经营成世俗统治中心；主教雨果是国王鲁道夫三世之子，1037年在此宣布“上帝的和平”。此后城市繁荣，1275年大教堂在教宗格列高利十世与国王鲁道夫一世亲临下祝圣。

主教与萨伏依伯爵长期分享权力、龃龉不断，直到1536年伯尔尼军队攻占该城，推行宗教改革，拆去大教堂的天主教陈设，主教侯国就此亡国。伯尔尼治下，洛桑1685年后成为法国胡格诺派牧师避难地。

en:
Larestan is the arid belt of southern Fars between Kerman and the Persian Gulf, a country of bare mountains and sandy valleys whose Achomi people speak a language descended from the Middle Persian of pre-Islamic Fars and have mostly stayed Sunni.

In the Middle Ages the local Miladian dynasty ruled it; its founder Gorgin Milad claimed descent from the Kayanid hero Kay Khosrow. The dynasty's chiefs held Lar and the hot lowland of Garmsirat and kept their realm apart from Persian politics.

In the thirteenth century Lar briefly became a busy emporium on the Hormuz caravan road, and under the Miladians remained a major Gulf-route staging post through the sixteenth century, with merchants, silk-growers and a noted Jewish community attested from 1523. Independence ended in 1602, when a Safavid army annexed it; many Larestani families then migrated across the Gulf to Arab ports.
zh:
拉雷斯坦是法尔斯南部、克尔曼与波斯湾之间的干旱地带，多荒山沙谷；居民阿乔姆人的语言承自伊斯兰以前法尔斯的中古波斯方言，大多保持逊尼派信仰。

中世纪统治这一地区的是本土米拉迪安王朝，开国者戈尔金·米拉德自称凯扬王朝英雄凯霍斯鲁的后裔；其首领据有拉尔和炎热低地加尔姆西拉特，小邦长期置身波斯主流政局之外。

13世纪拉尔一度成为霍尔木兹商道上繁盛的商业中心，米拉迪安治下直到16世纪始终是通往波斯湾路上的重要驿站，富商、养蚕业者云集，1523年已有知名犹太人社群的记载。1602年萨非军队入侵吞并拉雷斯坦，此后许多拉尔家庭渡海迁往波斯湾对岸的阿拉伯港口。

en:
Litang was a high-altitude Khampa chiefdom on the open grasslands of the Shaluli Mountains, its town standing at some 4,000 metres among the highest in the Tibetan world.

The Yuan brought it under administration in 1272 with a district office and, in 1288, a revenue commissariat; the Ming appointed local rulers as pacification commissioners and later as a Thousand-Household office. Around the turn of the seventeenth century it passed to Güshi Khan's Khoshut Mongols, whose stewards ruled until 1719, when the local chiefs submitted their registers to the Qing and Litang became a Sichuan tusi, confirmed in 1729 as the principal and vice pacification commissions.

Its great monastery, founded as a Bön temple, was converted to the Gelug order by the Third Dalai Lama in 1580, and in 1708 Litang gave birth to the Seventh Dalai Lama, Kelzang Gyatso.
zh:
理塘是沙鲁里山开阔草原上的康巴土司政权，镇城海拔约4000米，是藏地地势最高的城镇之一。

元朝于1272年设李唐州，1288年又置钱粮总管府；明代封当地首领为里塘宣抚司，后改参卜郎千户所。17世纪前后理塘转入和硕特蒙古固始汗之手，由其营官统治；1719年当地土司向清军呈交户籍纳粮内附，理塘成为四川管辖的土司，1729年正式置里塘正、副宣抚司。

境内的理塘寺本是苯教寺院，1580年由三世达赖喇嘛索南嘉措改宗格鲁派；1708年，七世达赖喇嘛格桑嘉措就出生在理塘。

en: Lantu was a small Sui tusi holding in the hill country south of Duyun, on the territory of present-day Sandu County, the Sui heartland. Its chiefs kept office through the Ming and early Qing as dependants of the Duyun native administration, until the Yongzheng reforms of 1734 turned the Lantu lands into the Sanjiaotun assistant magistrate's district under Dushan Subprefecture.
zh: 烂土是都匀以南山区的一个水族小土司，辖地在今三都水族自治县境内，正是水族的聚居腹地。其土官经明代至清初世袭不绝，隶属都匀一带的土司体系；1734年雍正朝改土归流，以烂土司地设置三脚屯州同，划归独山州管辖。

en:
Lübeck stands on the Trave near the Baltic, on the site of Liubice, stronghold of the Slavic Obotrites. Count Adolf II founded a town there in 1143, and Henry the Lion rebuilt it in 1159.

In 1226 Emperor Frederick II made it an imperial free city, and commanding the short Baltic-North Sea land route it became the cradle and de facto capital of the Hanseatic League. Its merchants led Hanseatic wars against Denmark, the 1370 Peace of Stralsund marked its high point, and its law was copied by roughly a hundred Baltic cities.

The Reformation reached it in the 1530s, and its failed intervention in the Count's Feud of 1534 to 1536 was its last bid to dominate Baltic trade. Atlantic commerce eclipsed the Hansa, whose last diet met in 1669. Napoleon occupied it in 1806 and annexed it in 1811; Vienna restored it as a free city in 1815.
zh:
吕贝克临波罗的海、坐落特拉维河畔，前身是斯拉夫人奥博特里特人要塞柳比采。1143年伯爵阿道夫二世建城，狮子亨利1159年重建。

1226年皇帝腓特烈二世立其为帝国自由城市；因扼守两海间最短陆上通道，它成为汉萨同盟的摇篮和事实上的首府。商人主导对丹麦的战争，1370年《施特拉尔松德和约》标志其权势顶峰，吕贝克法被约百座波罗的海城市仿效。

16世纪30年代宗教改革传入，1534—1536年干预伯爵战争失败，是其称霸波罗的海贸易的最后尝试。随着大西洋贸易压倒汉萨，1669年最后一届汉萨议会召开。拿破仑1806年占领、1811年吞并，1815年维也纳会议恢复其自由城市身份。

en:
Lucca, once seat of the margraves of Tuscany, bought out its feudal obligations to Welf VI in 1160 and became a free commune answerable only to the emperor. Silk and banking made it rich.

The Ghibelline Castruccio Castracani ruled from 1316 and defeated Florence at Altopascio in 1325, Lucca's height of power. His 1328 death opened a decade of repeated sales: by 1335 it belonged to Mastino II of Verona, its 1337 lord, then passed to Pisa after Florentine siege.

Charles IV restored its freedom in 1369, and the republic prospered on silk until Paolo Guinigi's signoria of 1400 to 1430 ended in Florentine siege. Lucca settled into oligarchy, Libertas on its banners until French troops entered in 1799. Napoleon merged it into a principality under his sister Elisa in 1805; Vienna made it the Duchy of Lucca in 1815.
zh:
卢卡曾是托斯卡纳藩侯驻地，1160年向韦尔夫六世赎清封建义务，成为只对皇帝负责的自由公社，以丝织、银行业致富。

吉伯林派的卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼1316年执政，1325年阿尔托帕肖击败佛罗伦萨，卢卡权势达顶峰。1328年他死后十年间城市屡遭转卖：1335年归维罗纳马斯蒂诺二世，1337年受其统治，佛罗伦萨围攻后归比萨。

1369年查理四世恢复其自由，共和国倚丝绸繁荣，1400—1430年圭尼吉的领主统治在佛罗伦萨围攻中告终。此后卢卡转为寡头政体，“自由”标在旗帜上，直至1799年法军入城。1805年拿破仑将卢卡并入亲王国，交其妹埃莉萨统治；1815年维也纳会议将其重建为卢卡公国。

en:
The Principality of Lüneburg was the northern division of the Welf Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, covering the Lüneburg Heath and Wendland in Lower Saxony. In 1235 Emperor Frederick II enfeoffed Otto the Child with the new duchy; in 1269 Otto's sons split it, Lüneburg falling to John.

In 1337 brothers Otto III and William II ruled jointly, their seat the wealthy Hanseatic salt town of Lüneburg. When William died without sons in 1369 the Lüneburg War of Succession began against Saxe-Wittenberg; the town destroyed the ducal Kalkberg castle in 1371, forcing the princes to Celle, and the Welfs kept their inheritance only at Winsen in 1388.

Duke Ernest the Confessor introduced the Lutheran Reformation and signed the Augsburg Confession in 1530. A new line founded in 1648 ended in 1705, when the principality was absorbed by the Electorate of Brunswick-Lüneburg, later Hanover.
zh:
吕讷堡侯国是韦尔夫不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国的北部支系，据有下萨克森的吕讷堡灌木林与文德兰。1235年腓特烈二世把新设公国封给孩童奥托，1269年奥托诸子分家，吕讷堡归约翰。

1337年奥托三世、威廉二世兄弟共治，治所是富庶的汉萨盐城吕讷堡。1369年威廉无子而终，引发对抗萨克森-维滕贝格的继承战争；1371年城市拆毁卡尔克贝格的公爵城堡，迫使诸侯迁居策勒，韦尔夫家族1388年温森战役才保住继承权。

忏悔者恩斯特公爵引入路德宗改革，1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》。1648年开创的新支系于1705年绝嗣，侯国并入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡选侯国，即后来的汉诺威选侯国。

en:
The Lupaca were a principal Aymara kingdom formed around Lake Titicaca after Tiwanaku collapsed in the eleventh century. Their seven towns, among them Chucuito, dotted its southwestern shore; pre-Inca kings lived at Cutimbo, Chucuito becoming the Inca provincial capital. Society split into upper and lower moieties, each with its leader, and Spanish visitors found it extraordinarily wealthy, its riches resting on llama herds, lakeside farming and long-distance trade.

Before the Incas, Lupaca fought the Colla for the Collao: Inca Viracocha backed their curaca Curi, who defeated the Colla at Paucarcolla and sealed an alliance at Chucuito. Pachacuti nevertheless incorporated the Lupaca, and Tupac Yupanqui crushed a joint Lupaca-Colla revolt after 1471.

In 1538 Lupaca again warred on the Colla and were defeated at the Desaguadero River by Hernando Pizarro, yet in 1567 they still impressed a Spanish inspector with their wealth.
zh:
卢皮哈基是11世纪蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后在的的喀喀湖周围形成的主要艾马拉王国之一。七座城镇（含丘奎托）散布湖西南岸，印卡以前诸王居库廷博，丘奎托后为印卡行省首府。社会分上下两半族、各有首领；西班牙来访者称其异常富庶，财富来自骆马群、湖畔农业与长途贸易。

印卡到来前，卢皮哈基与库尧争夺科利亚奥霸权：印卡王维拉科查支持其首领库里，库里在保卡科拉击败库尧，于丘奎托结盟。尽管如此，帕查库特克仍将其并入帝国，1471年后图帕克·尤潘基镇压其与库尧的联合叛乱。

1538年卢皮哈基再与库尧交战，在德萨瓜德罗河畔被埃尔南多·皮萨罗击败；直到1567年其富庶仍令西班牙巡查官惊叹。

en:
Laur was a petty kingdom of the Sylhet region. It had earlier belonged to Jaintia within old Kamarupa, and when Raja Guhak divided Jaintia among three sons around 630, his youngest son Ladduk received the western plains that became Laur.

In 640 the Kannauj Brahman Keshab Misra founded its Hindu line; late in the thirteenth century it weathered repeated Gour attacks.

Independence ended in the Mughal age: Durbar Singh converted to Islam as Durbar Khan, and after his brother Gobind Singh converted at Delhi, the Nawab of Bengal in 1566 restored Laur to him as a feudal mahal of Sylhet Sarkar. Early in the eighteenth century the zamindar Abid Reza founded Baniachong; after the Khasi burnt Laur in 1744 many followed him there. Under the British Laur survived as a pargana, though a Khasi rising swept its estates in 1787 before the rebels withdrew into the hills.
zh:
劳尔是锡尔赫特地区的小王国。其地原属古迦摩缕波的贾因蒂亚，约630年国王古哈克把贾因蒂亚分给三子，幼子拉杜科得西部平原，是为劳尔由来。

640年曲女城婆罗门凯沙布·米斯拉建立印度教世系；13世纪后期它屡次顶住高尔进攻。

独立终结于莫卧儿时代：杜尔巴尔·辛格改宗伊斯兰，改名杜尔巴尔汗；其弟戈宾德·辛格后来也在德里入教，孟加拉纳瓦布1566年把劳尔作为锡尔赫特萨尔卡尔治下的封建税区重新封给他。18世纪初包税地主阿比德·礼萨另建巴尼亚昌，1744年卡西人焚毁劳尔后许多居民随他迁往；英国治下劳尔仅作帕尔加纳税区，1787年卡西人起义席卷其地产，起义者随后退回山中。

en:
Luwu was a Bugis-led kingdom on the Gulf of Bone in southern Celebes, its court at Malangke. Around 1300 Bugis settlers moved to its coast and built a multi-ethnic coalition through commerce and the authority of its ruler, the Datu.

Its wealth came from iron: ore from Lake Matano was smelted at Malangke into weapons and exported, and the island was known as the iron island. By the mid-fourteenth century Luwu was overlord of much of the peninsula; Majapahit poem Desawarnana of about 1365 names it among Celebes' three chief powers.

It made peace with Bone in the fifteenth century, but southern kingdoms overtook it in the sixteenth. On 4 February 1605 ruler La Patiwareq became the first great king of southern Celebes to accept Islam; the court abandoned Malangke for Palopo around 1620. Sultanahs later held the throne, though by the 1830s European visitors found Palopo decayed, with some three hundred houses.
zh:
鲁乌是波尼湾北岸、苏拉威西南部的布吉人主导的王国，宫廷设在玛琅客。约1300年，布吉人迁居这里的海岸，靠商业和统治者达图的权威结成多元族群联盟。

国家的财富来自铁：马塔诺湖的矿石运到玛琅客冶炼成兵器并出口，苏拉威西岛被称为铁岛。到14世纪中叶，鲁乌已成为半岛大部的宗主，约1365年满者伯夷史诗《爪哇史颂》把它列为苏拉威西三大强权之一。

鲁乌在15世纪与波尼议和，但16世纪被南部农耕王国超过。1605年2月4日，国王拉·帕蒂瓦雷克成为苏拉威西南部第一位接受伊斯兰教的大国君主；约1620年宫廷放弃玛琅客，西迁帕洛波。此后数位女王曾临朝听政，而到19世纪30年代，欧洲旅人看到的帕洛波已是仅有约三百户人家的衰败城镇。

en:
The County of Luxembourg was a Holy Roman Empire state in the Ardennes. In 963 Siegfried, Count of the Ardennes, built a castle on the Lucilinburhuc rock, from which his descendants took their comital title. The counts lost their Limburg inheritance to Brabant at Worringen in 1288, but Henry VII was elected King of the Romans in 1308 and crowned emperor in 1312.

His son John took Bohemia's crown in 1310 and moved his seat to Prague; blinded on a Lithuanian crusade in 1336, he ruled Luxembourg as a prince-elector in 1337 and fell commanding the French vanguard at Crécy in 1346. Charles IV raised the county to a duchy in 1353.

When the male line ended with Sigismund in 1437, the duchy passed to Philip the Good of Burgundy in 1443 and to the Habsburgs in 1477 with Mary of Burgundy's marriage to Maximilian. Its fortress became famed as the Gibraltar of the North.
zh:
卢森堡伯国是神圣罗马帝国在阿登山区的邦国。963年阿登伯爵西格弗里德在卢西林堡岩地修筑城堡，后代以此为伯爵名号。1288年沃林根战役中，伯爵们败给布拉班特，失去林堡继承权；亨利七世则于1308年当选罗马人的国王、1312年加冕为皇帝。

其子约翰1310年夺得波希米亚王位，把治所迁往布拉格；他在1336年征讨立陶宛的十字军途中双目失明，1337年以选帝侯身份统治卢森堡，1346年在克雷西指挥法军前锋时阵亡。1353年查理四世将伯国升格为公国。

1437年西吉斯蒙德去世，男系断绝；1443年公国归勃艮第好人腓力，1477年随玛丽与马克西米利安联姻转入哈布斯堡家族。其要塞后来赢得了“北方直布罗陀”之称。

en: The Baltic lands lie along the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea and include Lithuania and Prussia. The Grand Duchy of Lithuania united several Baltic tribes and by 1440 extended from the Baltic to the Black Sea.
zh: 波罗的地区位于波罗的海东岸，包括立陶宛和普鲁士。立陶宛大公国联合了若干波罗的部族，到1440年领土从波罗的海延伸至黑海。

en:
Limbuwan, Yakthung Laaje in Limbu, covers the eastern Himalayan hills between the Arun and Teesta rivers in eastern Nepal. It was never a single monarchy but a league of ten Limbu kingdoms, each ruled from a hill fort by a king titled Hang. In the ninth century Uba Hang, and later Sirijonga Hang of Yangwarok, reunited the quarrelling chiefs; Sirijonga built forts and gave them a shared script.

After losing its eastern marches to Sikkim's Namgyal kings, it fell apart in the early fifteenth century, and princes from Kamrup founded the lowland kingdom of Morang, whose ruler Pungla Ing adopted Hinduism and a Hindu raja name.

In 1609 Sen raja Lohang Sen captured Morang; his line ruled seven generations until the Limbu minister Buddhi Karna Raya took the throne in 1769. The Limbuwan-Gorkha War of 1771–1774 ended in a collective treaty, as the ten Limbu rulers submitted to Prithvi Narayan Shah and Limbuwan joined the kingdom of Nepal.
zh:
林布旺林布语称雅克通·拉杰，涵盖阿润河与蒂斯塔河之间的喜马拉雅山东段山地，在今尼泊尔东部。它从来不是统一君主国，而是十个林布小王国的联合体，每个王国都由称号杭的国王据山堡统治。9世纪的乌巴·杭以及后来的扬瓦罗克的西里琼加·杭先后压服相互争斗的首领；西里琼加修筑堡垒并为林布人统一文字。

东部边地丢给锡金南嘉王朝后，林布旺于15世纪初陷入分裂，来自迦摩缕波的王公建立低地王国莫朗，君主蓬格拉·英改宗印度教，改用印度教式拉贾名号。

1609年，森王朝的洛杭·森攻占莫朗，其家族统治七代，直到林布出身的大臣布迪·卡尔纳·拉亚于1769年登上王位。1771—1774年的林布旺—廓尔喀战争以集体条约告终：十位林布君主向普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿臣服，林布旺并入尼泊尔王国。

en:
Luoxiong is the mountainous country at the meeting point of Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi, on the upper Nanpan, a gateway between the three provinces known as the Lock of Yunnan and Guizhou. Under the Dali kingdom its people were the Luojiu, one of the thirty-seven eastern tribes whose chiefs swore an alliance with the Duan court at Shicheng in 971.

The Mongols organised the area as Luoxiong Subprefecture, which under the Ming became one of the four subprefectures of Qujing Prefecture and was renamed Luoping Subprefecture.
zh:
罗雄地处云南、贵州、广西三省交界的山区，位于南盘江上游，旧有‘滇黔锁钥’之称。大理国时，当地的罗鸠部是滇东三十七部之一，971年三十七部酋长在石城与段氏政权会盟立碑。

蒙古入滇后，这一带被编为罗雄州；明代它成为曲靖府下辖的四州之一，改称罗平州。

en:
Lyapin was a Mansi principality on the Lyapin and Northern Sosva rivers in western Siberia. Formed in the fifteenth century, it traded with Sosva and allied with Obdorsk. A Moscow expedition attacked its lands in 1499, but did not destroy the principality.

Prince Luguy accepted Russian overlordship and tribute obligations in 1586. His son Shatrov joined an uprising in 1607, was captured and hanged; the principality then broke into smaller districts.
zh:
利亚平是西西伯利亚利亚平河与北索西瓦河流域的曼西人公国。它形成于15世纪，与索西瓦贸易，并与鄂毕多尔斯克结盟。1499年莫斯科军队进攻利亚平，但未能消灭这个公国。

1586年，卢古伊公承认俄国的宗主权并承担纳贡义务。他的儿子沙特罗夫于1607年参与起义，被俘后遭绞死；此后公国分裂成较小的辖区。

en: The Liangzhai tag covers the stockaded Zhuang country around Bazhai in present-day Maguan, southeastern Yunnan, which under the Yuan was the Yinijia tribal unit under Lin'an Route. The Ming organized the same district as the Bazhai Chief's Office in 1414, directly under the Yunnan military commission, until the Qing replaced it with an ordinary township in 1662.
zh: 良寨对应的是云南东南、今马关县八寨一带的壮族寨堡地区，元代属临安路下辖的矣尼迦部。1414年，明朝在同一地区设立八寨长官司，直属云南都司；1662年清朝将其改设永平里，土司世袭就此终结。

en: Luozuo was a small Zhuang native subprefecture created under the Yuan in 1276 in the hill country of present-day Funing in southeastern Yunnan, grouped with Fuzhou and Anning under the Guangnan West Route commission. In 1383 the early Ming folded Luozuo and Anning into Fuzhou, ending its separate tusi line.
zh: 罗佐是1276年元朝在云南东南、今富宁县山区设置的壮族小土州，与富州、安宁州同属广南西路宣抚司。1383年，明初将罗佐州与安宁州一并并入富州，这一土司建制就此撤销。

en: The Maasai were Maa-speaking pastoralists in the lands of present-day Kenya and northern Tanzania. Their communities were divided into regional sections, and their ancestors reached East Africa through South Sudan.
zh: 马赛人是说马赛语的牧民，居住在今肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚北部。他们分为不同的地域群体，祖先经由南苏丹来到东非。

en:
Ma'bar was the Muslim name for the Tamil coast; the sultanate centred on Madurai grew out of the Delhi Sultanate's southernmost province. In 1335 its governor Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan declared independence as Muhammad bin Tughluq's empire began to disintegrate; Tughluq marched against him in 1337 but fell ill at Bidar and turned back.

Ruled by a Hindustani-speaking Muslim elite, the kingdom held Madurai and surrounding districts, and in 1343 Sultan Ghiyasuddin Damghani captured and killed Hoysala king Veera Ballala III. The Moroccan Ibn Battuta, who married a daughter of the founding sultan, left a grim account of its wars with the Hindu population.

Plagued by coups, Ma'bar saw eight rulers in forty-three years; in 1378 Kumara Kampana killed the last sultan at Madurai. Kampana was the son of Vijayanagara's Bukka Raya, and the sultanate was annexed, later passing to the Madurai Nayakas.
zh:
马巴尔是穆斯林对泰米尔海岸的称呼，以马杜赖为中心的苏丹国源自德里苏丹国最南端的行省。1335年，随着穆罕默德·图格鲁克的帝国走向瓦解，总督贾拉勒丁·阿赫桑汗宣布独立；图格鲁克1337年发兵征讨，却在比达尔染病退兵。

新王国由讲印度斯坦语的穆斯林精英统治，据有马杜赖一带；1343年，苏丹吉亚斯丁·达姆加尼俘获并处死曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世。摩洛哥人伊本·白图泰曾娶开国苏丹之女，在游记里留下马巴尔与印度教徒交战的残酷记载。

由于政变不断，马巴尔四十三年间换了八位苏丹；1378年末代苏丹在马杜赖被毗奢耶那伽罗君主布卡·拉亚之子库马拉·坎帕纳击杀，苏丹国被吞并，后来归入马杜赖纳亚克诸将的统治。

en:
The March was the Mortimer lordship of the Welsh border, anchored by Wigmore and Ludlow castles. Wigmore, raised around 1070 by William FitzOsbern, passed in 1075 to Ralph de Mortimer, whose family built a barony stretching into Wales.

Power peaked under Roger Mortimer, who gained Ludlow by marriage and as Queen Isabella's lover ruled England after the king's deposition in 1327, becoming Earl of March in 1328. Edward III seized him at Nottingham and had him executed in 1330; the lordship remained forfeit until his grandson Roger recovered it in 1342.

In the 1380s young Roger Mortimer was named Richard II's heir presumptive. The male line failed in 1424 and the estates passed to the House of York through Anne Mortimer, feeding the Yorkist claim in the Wars of the Roses. The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 ended the lordship's separate jurisdiction.
zh:
边区是莫蒂默家在威尔士边境的领主领，以威格莫尔、勒德洛两堡为支柱。威格莫尔约1070年由威廉·菲茨奥斯本兴建，1075年转封拉尔夫·德·莫蒂默，其家族建起伸入威尔士的男爵领。

罗杰·莫蒂默时权势达于顶峰：他靠婚姻取得勒德洛，1327年国王被废后以王后伊莎贝拉情人身份执掌大政，1328年封马奇伯爵。1330年爱德华三世在诺丁汉将他擒获处决，领地没收，1342年其孙罗杰收回。

家族复振，14世纪80年代幼辈罗杰·莫蒂默被立为理查二世推定继承人。1424年男嗣绝，地产经安妮·莫蒂默归约克家族，为玫瑰战争中约克派王位主张所本。1535至1542年《威尔士法案》结束领主领的独立司法地位。

en:
Marien was a Taíno chiefdom in northwestern Hispaniola, ruled by Guacanagaríx when Christopher Columbus arrived in 1492. After the Santa María ran aground, the chief received Columbus and allowed him to establish La Navidad near his village; its Spanish settlers were killed before Columbus returned.

Guacanagaríx refused to join the chiefs seeking to expel the Spaniards. His followers assisted the Spanish against an indigenous alliance at the Battle of Vega Real in 1495.
zh:
马里安是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西北部的泰诺酋长国，1492年克里斯托弗·哥伦布抵达时由瓜卡纳加里克斯统治。“圣玛丽亚”号搁浅后，酋长接待了哥伦布，允许他在村落附近建立圣诞堡；哥伦布返回之前，堡中的西班牙殖民者已被杀死。

瓜卡纳加里克斯拒绝加入试图驱逐西班牙人的酋长联盟。1495年皇家平原战役中，他的部众协助西班牙人对抗原住民联盟。

en:
Magdeburg, on the Elbe, was first recorded in 805 and became the favoured city of Otto the Great, who founded a Benedictine monastery in 937. To christianize Slavic lands east of the Elbe, Otto established an archbishopric there in 967.

Under Archbishop Wichmann the archbishopric's lands won imperial immediacy in 1180, making it a prince-archbishopric; its cathedral was begun in 1208. In 1325 citizens murdered Archbishop Burchard III, drawing the imperial ban on the city; peace returned only under Otto of Hesse, archbishop from 1327, who received its homage in 1333.

Magdeburg embraced the Reformation early and became a Protestant city, stormed and sacked by Tilly's army in 1631 in the Thirty Years' War. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 promised the see to Brandenburg; when its last administrator died in 1680, the prince-archbishopric was secularized as the Duchy of Magdeburg under the Hohenzollerns.
zh:
马格德堡在易北河畔，805年首见记载，为奥托大帝钟爱之城，937年他在此建本笃会修道院。为向易北河以东斯拉夫人的土地传教，奥托967年在此设立大主教区。

维希曼大主教治下，教区领地1180年取得帝国直辖地位，成为神圣罗马帝国的亲王大主教区，大教堂1208年动工。1325年市民杀大主教布尔夏德三世，城市遭褫夺法律保护；1327年就任的黑森的奥托收场，市民1333年向他效忠。

马格德堡早皈依宗教改革，成为新教重镇，1631年三十年战争中被蒂利军队攻陷洗劫。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将教区许给勃兰登堡；1680年末任管理者去世，亲王大主教区被世俗化为霍亨索伦治下的马格德堡公国。

en: The Mahiyan are the Jurchen group of the Mayan river, whose Manchu name refers to its elbow-like bends; it rises in the Zhangguangcai mountains and winds through Shangzhi, Yanshou and Fangzheng to join the right bank of the Songhua. They were among the Wild Jurchens brought under Later Jin rule in Nurhaci's campaigns of 1596 to 1625.
zh: 马希安是蚂蜒河畔的女真群体，蚂蜒河又称蚂蚁河，满语意为肘，因干流弯曲如肘得名；它发源于张广才岭，流经尚志、延寿、方正，在方正县注入松花江右岸。他们属于野人女真，在1596年至1625年努尔哈赤的征讨中被纳入后金版图。

en:
The Archbishopric of Mainz grew from Roman Mogontiacum: Saint Boniface took its see in 747 and it became an archdiocese in 781. Its archbishop, Primate of Germany and imperial archchancellor, ranked first among the prince-electors under the Golden Bull of 1356. His scattered lands included territory on the Rhine and Main and distant Erfurt.

In 1337 Henry III of Virneburg held the see; Baldwin of Luxembourg disputed his 1328 election until 1336, and he backed Emperor Louis IV until Pope Clement VI deposed him in 1346. The city was free from 1244 until the Diocesan Feud of 1461 to 1462, when Archbishop Adolf of Nassau stormed it and curbed its liberties.

Mainz was Gutenberg's home, where the 42-line Bible was printed around 1455. The electorate remained Catholic through the Reformation and was dissolved in 1803, its lands divided among Prussia, Hesse and Nassau, while Dalberg retained Aschaffenburg.
zh:
美因茨大主教区源出罗马莫贡提亚库姆：747年圣波尼法爵接主教座，781年升大主教区。大主教兼德意志首席主教与帝国大首相，选侯位列第一，1356年《金玺诏书》确认。领地分散，包括莱茵、美因河一带和远方的埃尔福特。

1337年在任者亨利三世·冯·菲尔讷堡1328年当选，卢森堡的巴尔杜因争位至1336年；他支持皇帝路易四世，1346年被教皇克莱门特六世罢免。城1244年成自由城市，1461—1462年主教区纷争中被大主教阿道夫·冯·拿骚攻陷，自由受限。

美因茨为古腾堡故乡，印刷所约1455年印出四十二行圣经。选侯区宗教改革中仍奉天主教，1803年世俗化解散，领土分给普鲁士、黑森、拿骚，达尔贝格保住阿沙芬堡。

en:
Majapahit was a Hindu-Buddhist thalassocratic empire based at Trowulan, eastern Java. It was founded in 1293 by Raden Wijaya, who used Kublai Khan's Mongol expedition to overthrow Kediri's usurper Jayakatwang, then drove the Yuan from Java, taking the regnal name Kertarajasa.

Officer Gajah Mada saved King Jayanegara in the Kuti rebellion of 1319. In 1336 Queen Tribhuwana made him mahapatih, and he swore the Palapa oath to bring the archipelago under Majapahit rule; his campaigns conquered Bali in 1343 and extended its power from Sumatra to the Moluccas. Under her son Hayam Wuruk the 1365 court poem Nagarakretagama claimed ninety-eight tributaries.

After Hayam Wuruk died, succession wars, above all the Regreg civil war of 1405 to 1406, loosened Majapahit's hold on its vassals as Malacca and Demak confined it to Java. Demak overran Trowulan in 1527, and the surviving court, priests and artisans fled to Bali.
zh:
满者伯夷是以爪哇岛东部多乌兰为都的印度教—佛教帝国。1293年拉登·韦查耶利用忽必烈的蒙古远征军推翻谏义里篡位者查耶卡旺，随即将元军逐出爪哇，以克塔拉亚萨为号建国。

加查·马达在1319年库提叛乱中救下国王查亚内加拉；1336年，女王特里布瓦纳任命他为宰相，他立下帕拉帕誓言，誓将整个群岛纳入满者伯夷版图。大军1343年征服巴厘，势力从苏门答腊扩张到马鲁古。女王之子哈奄·武禄在位时，1365年的宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》宣称领有98个朝贡国。

哈奄·武禄死后继承纷争不断，尤以1405—1406年的雷格雷格内战为重，诸附庸纷纷失控；满剌加、淡目崛起，王国版图收缩到爪哇腹地。1527年淡目攻陷多乌兰，残存王室、祭司和工匠东逃巴厘。

en:
Makuria was the medieval Nubian kingdom ruled from Dongola, founded around 500 after Kush's collapse. It converted to Christianity in the mid-sixth century and annexed its northern neighbour Nobatia in the early seventh century. An Arab invasion in 652 failed to take Dongola, and the Baqt treaty secured mostly peaceful relations with Egypt until the thirteenth century.

The ninth to eleventh centuries were its zenith: the Throne Hall and great cruciform church rose at Dongola, and Old Nubian flourished in writing. Mamluk Egypt turned hostile after 1260: its army sacked Dongola in 1276 and made Makuria a tributary. In 1316 the Mamluks installed its first Muslim king, after which Christian and Muslim rulers alternated amid Bedouin pressure and plague.

A civil war of 1365 cost the kingdom Dongola itself, and its rulers withdrew to Gebel Adda and Qasr Ibrim. Its last recorded king, Joel, appears around 1463; Makuria vanished in the late fifteenth century, and by 1523 Dongola belonged to Sennar's Funj sultanate.
zh:
马库里亚是中世纪尼罗河谷的努比亚王国，以栋古拉为都，约500年在库施崩溃后的故地上建立。它6世纪中叶皈依基督教，7世纪初吞并北邻诺巴。652年阿拉伯军队入侵未能攻下栋古拉，《巴克特条约》使它与埃及大体维持和平直到13世纪。

9至11世纪是马库里亚的鼎盛期：栋古拉建起王座大厅和大型十字形教堂，古努比亚语成为发达书面语。1260年后马穆鲁克埃及转为敌对，1276年军队洗劫栋古拉，马库里亚沦为纳贡附庸。1316年马穆鲁克扶立第一位穆斯林国王，此后基督徒与穆斯林君主在贝都因压力和瘟疫中交替在位。

1365年的内战使王国连栋古拉也告失守，统治者退守杰贝勒阿达和盖斯尔伊卜里姆。最后一位有记载的国王约耳在1463年前后仍见诸文献；马库里亚15世纪末消亡，到1523年栋古拉已属森纳尔的丰吉苏丹国。

en:
Mali began as a small Mandinka kingdom on the upper Niger around Niani, expanding as Ghana broke apart. About 1235 Sundiata Keita united the Mandinka and overthrew Sosso at Kirina, giving the state its charter, the Kouroukan Fouga; his successors ruled with the title mansa.

Its generals won the Bambuk goldfields and Timbuktu and Djenné, and Mali taxed the Sahel's gold, salt and slave caravans, dominating West Africa. After the freedman general Sakura seized the throne in 1285, the Keitas returned, and from about 1312 Mansa Musa held the golden age; his gold-funded Mecca pilgrimage in 1324 to 1326 spread Niani's fame to Cairo.

Musa died about 1337; his son Maghan I was soon set aside by Suleyman, whose reign the traveller Ibn Battuta recorded in 1352. From 1507 Songhai and other powers stripped Mali's provinces; Songhai sacked the capital in 1544. A last recovery bid failed at Djenné in 1599. The Keitas withdrew to Kangaba, and the empire ended by 1610.
zh:
马里本是尼日尔河上游、尼亚尼附近的曼丁戈小王国，趁加纳瓦解之际扩张。约1235年，松迪亚塔·凯塔联合曼丁戈人，在基里纳推翻苏苏王国，颁布国家宪章《库鲁坎·富加》；他的继承者此后以曼萨为号统治。

后来的将领夺得邦布金矿和廷巴克图、杰内，马里向萨赫勒的黄金、食盐和奴隶商队征税，称雄西非。奴隶出身的将领萨库拉1285年夺取王位，其后凯塔家族复位；约1312年起，曼萨·穆萨开创黄金时代，他以黄金资助的1324至1326年麦加朝觐，使尼亚尼声名远播开罗。

穆萨约于1337年去世，其子马甘一世不久被苏莱曼取代，旅行家伊本·白图泰1352年记下苏莱曼朝的景象。1507年起，桑海等势力相继蚕食马里的行省，桑海于1544年洗劫都城；马里最后一次复兴尝试在1599年杰内战败告终。凯塔家族退回康加巴，帝国至1610年终结。

en:
Egypt was then the seat of the Ayyubid sultanate founded by Saladin in 1171. Its imported slave-soldiers, the mamluks, overthrew the Ayyubid heir in 1250 and set up a sultanate in Cairo. The Turkish Bahri line ruled until 1382, holding an empire from the Levant to Nubia and making Cairo among the medieval Mediterranean's richest cities, fed by Indian Ocean trade and the iqta system.

In 1382 Barquq founded the Circassian Burji line.
