Barsbay reduced Cyprus to vassalage in 1426, and Qaitbay propped up the state through trade monopolies and building, while plague, Bedouin unrest and inflation eroded its strength. The Ottomans defeated the last sultan, al-Ghuri, in 1516 and took Cairo in 1517, but Mamluk houses regained influence and the province kept self-rule.

Napoleon's French army occupied Egypt from 1798 to 1801, and in 1805 the Albanian officer Muhammad Ali seized power and built a new army and state. His 1831 to 1833 war against the sultan left Egypt nearly independent, ruling Syria.
zh:
当时，埃及是萨拉丁1171年建立的阿尤布苏丹国的中心。输入的奴隶士兵马穆鲁克于1250年推翻阿尤布继承人，在开罗建立苏丹国。突厥裔的伯海里系统治到1382年，疆域从黎凡特延至努比亚，开罗凭印度洋贸易和伊克塔制度，跻身中世纪地中海最富庶的城市。

1382年，巴尔库克开创切尔克斯人的布尔吉系。巴尔西拜1426年迫使塞浦路斯称臣，盖特拜靠贸易垄断与营建支撑局面，而瘟疫、贝都因动乱和通货膨胀不断侵蚀国力。奥斯曼人1516年击败末代苏丹古里，1517年攻占开罗，但马穆鲁克世家重获权势，该行省保有自治。

1798至1801年拿破仑的法军占领埃及，1805年阿尔巴尼亚裔军官穆罕默德·阿里夺权，编练新军、改造国家。1831至1833年对苏丹的战争之后，埃及近乎独立，并领有叙利亚。

en:
Mantua is a walled city-state on the Mincio in Lombardy. After Matilda of Canossa died in 1115 it became a free commune, and in 1273 Pinamonte Bonacolsi made himself captain of the people, founding a signoria overthrown by Ludovico Gonzaga in 1328. In 1337 the Gonzaga still ruled as captains.

In 1433 Gianfrancesco Gonzaga paid 120,000 florins to Emperor Sigismund for the title of marquis. Charles V made Federico II its first duke in 1530; the Gonzaga inherited Montferrat by marriage the next year.

The Gonzaga court was among Italy's most brilliant: Giulio Romano built Palazzo Te, and Claudio Monteverdi staged L'Orfeo there in 1607. The direct line died out in 1627; the War of the Mantuan Succession ended with the imperial sack of Mantua in 1630, and in 1708 the last Gonzaga died; Mantua passed to the Habsburgs and Montferrat to Savoy.
zh:
曼托瓦是伦巴第明乔河畔的筑城城邦。1115年卡诺莎的玛蒂尔达去世后，它成为自由市镇；1273年皮纳蒙特·博纳科尔西自立市民官，建立领主统治，1328年被卢多维科·贡扎加推翻。1337年贡扎加家族仍任市民官。

1433年吉安弗朗切斯科·贡扎加付12万弗罗林给皇帝西吉斯蒙德，换得侯爵衔。1530年查理五世封费德里科二世为首任公爵，次年贡扎加家族通过婚姻继承蒙费拉托。

贡扎加宫廷为意大利最辉煌者之一：朱利奥·罗马诺建特宫，蒙特威尔第1607年首演《奥菲欧》。直系1627年绝嗣，继承战争以1630年帝国军洗劫该城告终；1708年末代贡扎加死，曼托瓦归哈布斯堡，蒙费拉托归萨伏依。

en:
Maolian was a Jurchen community around the Tumen River and the eastern coast, governed through a Ming guard under hereditary local chiefs. In 1405 the Ming appointed the chief Barsun and others as officers of the Maolian Guard; after Barsun was killed by Joseon in 1410, Mengge Buhua succeeded him.

In 1433 a Joseon campaign destroyed Jurchen guards including Maolian. Some survivors moved to the Hun River basin with Li Manzhu's followers from the Jianzhou Left Guard.
zh:
毛怜是图们江及东海滨一带的女真群体，明朝设卫，以世袭的当地首领管理诸部。1405年明廷任命把儿逊等人为毛怜卫官员；1410年把儿逊被朝鲜所杀后，猛哥不花继任。

1433年朝鲜出兵，摧毁了包括毛怜卫在内的女真卫所。部分余众随建州左卫李满住的部众迁往浑河流域。

en:
Maryul, later Ladakh, was the westernmost of the Tibetan kingdoms born from the Tibetan Empire's collapse, with capital at Shey in the upper Indus valley. Around 930 the eldest son of Kyide Nyimagon founded it, ruling from the Zoji La pass on the Kashmir border to Demchok. As senior branch it claimed suzerainty over Guge and Purang, and around 1100 King Lhachen Utpala brought a weakened Guge under his control.

The first dynasty weathered Kashmiri raids until 1460, when Lhachen Bhagan seized the throne and founded the Namgyal dynasty, under which the name Ladakh gradually replaced Maryul. Sengge Namgyal, who reigned from 1616 to 1642, built Leh Palace and the Hemis monastery and annexed Guge in the 1630s.

The resulting Tibet-Ladakh-Mughal War ended in 1684 with the Treaty of Tingmosgang, which left Guge, Purang and Rudok to Tibet. The Namgyal line survived into the 1830s, when the Dogra general Zorawar Singh invaded in 1834 and made Ladakh a tributary.
zh:
麻域后称拉达克，是吐蕃帝国解体后诞生的诸西藏王国中位置最西的一个，以上印度河谷的谢伊为都。约930年，吉德尼玛衮的长子建政，疆域西起克什米尔边境的佐吉拉山口，抵典角。长支一脉对古格、布让保有宗主权；约1100年，国王乌特巴拉迫使衰落的古格臣服。

第一个王朝在克什米尔的侵袭中延续到1460年，巴干夺取王位，建立南嘉王朝，“拉达克”之名此后逐渐取代麻域。僧格南嘉（1616—1642年在位）兴建列城王宫和黑密斯寺，17世纪30年代吞并古格。

随后的西藏—拉达克—莫卧儿战争以1684年的《廷莫斯冈条约》收场，古格、布让和日土被划归西藏。南嘉王统延续到19世纪30年代，道格拉名将左拉瓦尔·辛格1834年入侵，拉达克沦为附庸。

en: The people of Maisouna were a St. Lawrence Iroquoian group associated with the territory between Canada and Hochelaga in present-day Quebec. They may have inhabited the south shore of the St. Lawrence in the region opposite Trois-Rivières when Jacques Cartier travelled there in the 1530s and 1540s.
zh: 迈索纳人是圣劳伦斯易洛魁人的一个群体，活动于今魁北克境内卡纳达与奥什拉加之间的地区。雅克·卡蒂埃在1530至1540年代经过时，他们可能居住在圣劳伦斯河南岸、三河城对面的地区。

en:
Tollohcan was a Matlatzinca city-state in the Toluca Valley, called Matlatzinco in Nahuatl, a highland basin west of the Valley of Mexico shared by Matlatzinca, Otomi, Mazahua and Nahua peoples. By the twelfth century the Matlatzinca had emerged as a people distinct from the southern Otomi, and Teotenango and later Calixtlahuaca became the valley's dominant capitals, while Tollocan remained a secondary town overshadowed by Calixtlahuaca.

A theocratic nobility ruled, its high lords confirming local rulers, and the valley's quarrels drew in the Tepanecs of Azcapotzalco and the Purépecha empire to the west.

In the later 1470s the Aztec tlatoani Axayacatl overran the valley, destroyed Calixtlahuaca and made Tollocan seat of an imperial province collecting tribute in maize, mantles and warrior costumes. Many Matlatzinca were displaced or resettled and Nahuatl-speaking colonists brought in, beginning the decline of the Matlatzinca language.
zh:
托洛坎是托卢卡谷地的马特拉钦卡人城邦；谷地纳瓦特尔语称马特拉钦科，在墨西哥谷地以西，马特拉钦卡、奥托米、马萨瓦、纳瓦四族杂居。12世纪马特拉钦卡人已从南部奥托米人中分化，特奥滕南戈与后来的卡利斯特拉瓦卡先后为谷地首要都城，托洛坎长期只是屈居其下的次要城镇。

其地受神权贵族统治，大领主确认各城统治者；谷地纷争把阿斯卡波察尔科的特帕内克人和西方普雷佩查帝国牵扯进来。

15世纪70年代后期，阿兹特克特拉托阿尼阿哈雅卡特尔横扫谷地，毁卡利斯特拉瓦卡，以托洛坎为帝国行省治所，征收玉米、披风和战士装束。此后大量马特拉钦卡人被迁走或重新安置，讲纳瓦特尔语的殖民者移入，马特拉钦卡语遂衰。

en:
Mau Ganj, remembered as the Mau Raj, was a small Sengar Rajput kingdom in the fertile country that became the heart of Bagelkhand. The Sengars migrated from Jalaun in the eleventh century and raised a chain of mud forts, garhis, against the Kalachuri rajas to the south.

Their independence ended in the fourteenth century, when the expanding Baghelas defeated them at the battle of Mau, stormed their fort and folded the little kingdom into Bagelkhand.

Before the fall a junior Sengar prince had withdrawn to the wooded country nearby, where his son Chattradhari Singh built the fortress of Nai Garhi, meaning new fortress; its elephant gate was raised by Chattradhari's son, and the Sengar thakurs of Nai Garhi kept their small sovereign estate long after the old Mau Raj had gone, still fighting British sepoys near Itar in 1813.
zh:
毛甘吉古称毛拉杰，是后来成为巴格尔坎德核心的富庶土地上的森加拉杰普特小王国。森加尔人11世纪从贾劳恩迁来，修筑一连串称作加尔希的土堡，抵住南方迦罗朱利诸拉贾的进攻。

他们的独立在14世纪终结：扩张中的婆稽罗人在毛战役中击败森加尔人，攻陷其堡垒，把小王国并入巴格尔坎德。

城破之前，一位森加尔幼支王子已退入附近林地，王子之子查特拉达里·辛格在那里修建了意为新堡的奈加尔希堡，象门由查特拉达里之子建成；旧毛拉杰灭亡之后很久，奈加尔希的森加尔特库尔们仍守着小小的自主领地，1813年还在伊塔尔附近与英国士兵交战。

en: The Maya peoples inhabited a region stretching from Yucatán to the Guatemalan highlands, where they formed numerous kingdoms rather than a single state. The League of Mayapan joined Maya centres in Yucatán, while the K'iche' kingdom expanded in the highlands.
zh: 玛雅人居住在从尤卡坦到危地马拉高地的广大地区，建立了许多王国。玛雅潘联盟联合了尤卡坦的玛雅中心，而基切王国则在高地扩张。

en:
The Duchy of Mazovia arose from the partition of Poland in 1138 and was ruled by a branch of the Piast dynasty. After another division in 1313, Siemowit III reunited most of its lands and became a Polish vassal in 1351.

The duchy was divided again in 1381; Janusz I moved his residence from Czersk to Warsaw in 1413. In 1526 the death of Janusz III ended the male Masovian Piast line, and Poland incorporated the duchy despite resistance from some local nobles.
zh:
马佐夫舍公国源于1138年波兰的分裂，由皮亚斯特王朝的一个支系统治。1313年公国再次分裂后，谢莫维特三世重新统一了大部分土地，并于1351年成为波兰的封臣。

公国于1381年再度分割；雅努斯一世于1413年将驻地从切尔斯克迁至华沙。1526年雅努斯三世去世，马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族的男性世系断绝，波兰不顾部分当地贵族的反对吞并了公国。

en:
Mombasa is a Swahili port on an island of the Kenyan coast, its deep Kilindini harbor making it a prize of Indian Ocean powers. Founded around 900, it was prosperous when Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 and found devout Shafi'i Muslims worshipping in wooden mosques, and from the early fourteenth century it belonged to the Kilwa Sultanate.

Vasco da Gama met hostility in 1498; Portuguese fleets sacked the town in 1505 and destroyed it again in 1528. An Ottoman force seized it in 1585, but the Portuguese retook it in 1589 and built Fort Jesus in 1593.

In 1698 the Omanis stormed Fort Jesus, and Mazrui governors made Mombasa effectively independent from 1746. A short British protectorate in 1824 to 1826 gave way to Omani rule, until in 1837 Said bin Sultan of Muscat annexed it to his Zanzibar dominions.
zh:
蒙巴萨是肯尼亚沿海岛屿上的斯瓦希里港口，深水港基林迪尼使它成为西印度洋强权觊觎之地。该城约建于900年，1331年伊本·白图泰到访时已很繁荣，见虔信的沙斐仪派穆斯林在木制清真寺中礼拜；14世纪初起隶属基卢瓦苏丹国。

1498年瓦斯科·达伽马在此受冷遇，葡萄牙舰队1505年洗劫该城，1528年再度摧毁它。1585年奥斯曼军队夺取该城，葡萄牙人1589年反攻得手，1593年建成耶稣堡。

1698年阿曼人攻陷耶稣堡，1746年起马兹鲁伊总督令蒙巴萨实质独立。1824—1826年短暂英国保护国后阿曼复治，1837年马斯喀特的赛义德·本·苏丹把该城并入桑给巴尔领地。

en:
Manabondro is a coastal settlement in the Manambondro country of southeastern Madagascar, later homeland of the Temanambondro branch of the Antaisaka people. The Antaisaka descend from Sakalava royals of the Zarabehava line who crossed from Menabe in the west to the east coast between 1620 and 1650. Their leader Andriamandresy, a prince exiled after a succession quarrel, led his warriors and slaves to Nosipandra, modern Vangaindrano, by the 1650s.

From there they built a kingdom that by the early eighteenth century ranked among the four largest in Madagascar, reaching its greatest extent under King Lengoabo.

Succession disputes often weakened it, and from 1820 Merina armies from the central highlands overran the country, carrying many of its people off as slaves.
zh:
马纳邦德罗是马达加斯加东南马纳邦德罗地区的滨海定居点，后来是安泰萨卡人特马纳邦德罗支系的故土。安泰萨卡人源自萨卡拉瓦人的扎拉贝哈瓦王室支系：1620—1650年间他们从西部梅纳贝王国东渡海岸，首领安德里亚曼德雷西是因继承权之争被放逐的王子，率战士和奴隶于17世纪50年代抵达诺西潘德拉，即今万加因德拉努。

他们在此建立的王国到18世纪初已跻身马达加斯加四大王国之列，在伦戈阿博王治下扩张到最大版图。

继承纷争常削弱国力，1820年起中部高原的伊梅里纳军队攻陷安泰萨卡地区，许多人被掳为奴。

en: The Tohomé were a Native people of the Gulf Coast in southern Alabama. Around 1709 they and the Mobile people obtained French permission to settle near the fort at Mobile.
zh: 托霍梅人是阿拉巴马南部墨西哥湾沿岸的原住民。约1709年，他们与莫比尔人得到法国殖民者许可，迁居莫比尔的堡垒附近。

en:
Mbata was a Bantu kingdom whose court stood at Mbanza Mbata, in the Kwango country east of the later heartland of Kongo. Its rulers belonged to the Nsaku lineage, and in 1337 the chief was Lau Nsaku.

According to Kongo tradition, the marriage of Nimi a Nzima of Mpemba Kasi to Lukeni Lua Sange, daughter of the Mbata chief, joined the two peoples, and their son Lukeni lua Nimi became the first Mwene Kongo when the Kingdom of Kongo took shape around 1375.

Mbata entered the new kingdom as a kingdom within a kingdom: its own ruler was inherited through the matrilineal line rather than appointed from the capital, and Mbata princes traditionally conducted Kongo's diplomacy. After Kongo adopted Catholicism in the 1490s, Mbata was restyled the Duchy of Bambata, its Nsaku chiefs keeping their privileged rank under the Manikongo.
zh:
姆巴塔是班图人王国，王庭设在姆班扎姆巴塔，位于后来刚果核心地带以东的宽果河流域。统治者出自恩萨库世系，1337年在位酋长为劳·恩萨库。

按刚果传统说法，姆佩姆巴卡锡的尼米·阿·恩津加娶姆巴塔酋长之女卢凯尼·卢阿·桑格为妻，两族合流；其子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米在约1375年刚果王国形成时成为第一位马尼刚果。

姆巴塔以“国中之国”地位加入：统治者按母系世袭，不由首都任命，姆巴塔王子世代掌管刚果外交。15世纪90年代刚果皈依天主教后，姆巴塔改称班巴塔公国，恩萨库酋长在马尼刚果治下保持特权地位。

en:
The County of Bregenz lay at the eastern end of Lake Constance, guarding routes into the Vorarlberg Alps. First recorded in 1043 as seat of the Udalriching counts, the family's last male heir Rudolf died in 1160. His daughter Elisabeth married Hugo II of Tübingen, whose grandson Hugo I of Montfort carried Bregenz into the House of Montfort.

From about 1170 the Montfort-Bregenz branch ruled it; in 1337 its last count, Hugo, held the town shortly before the branch died out in 1338. It passed to the Montfort-Tettnang line, which from 1354 ruled as Montfort-Tettnang-Bregenz and produced Minnesänger Hugo von Montfort, born 1357.

The heiress Elisabeth of Hochberg sold the elder half of the lordship to Habsburg Duke Sigismund in 1451; Ferdinand I bought the rest in 1523. Bregenz then joined Further Austria as an imperial county until the Empire's dissolution in 1806.
zh:
布雷根茨伯国在博登湖东端，扼守进入福拉尔贝格山区的通道。1043年首见记载，为乌达尔里希家伯爵治所；末代男嗣鲁道夫1160年死，其女伊丽莎白嫁蒂宾根的胡戈二世，他们的孙子胡戈一世将其带入蒙特福特家族。

约1170年起蒙特福特-布雷根茨支系治此；1337年末代伯爵胡戈在位，支系1338年绝嗣。遗产转蒙特福特-泰特南支，其1354年起以蒙特福特-泰特南-布雷根茨之名统治，出了1357年生的恋歌诗人胡戈·冯·蒙特福特。

女继承人霍赫贝格的伊丽莎白1451年把领地大半卖给哈布斯堡公爵西吉斯蒙德，斐迪南一世1523年买下余半。此后属前奥地利，以帝国伯国延至1806年帝国解体。

en:
Michuachapanco is the Huastec polity centred on Pánuco, on the lower reaches of its namesake river on the Gulf coast; in the Huastec tongue Pánuco means the pass, after the river crossing there. The town was the seat of a confederation of Huastec tribes and was ruled by a lord bearing the title Cuextecatl.

Around 1450 the Huastecs were defeated by the armies of Moctezuma I and thereafter paid tribute to the Aztecs while keeping the region's local rulers.

Francisco de Garay's expedition was thrown back by local warriors at the lagoons of Chila and Tamós in 1521, but Hernán Cortés marched from Coyoacán in 1522 and took the region, founding Villa de Santiesteban del Puerto at Pánuco that December, only the second town council in the Americas and later capital of the Province of Pánuco.
zh:
米却阿潘科是以帕努科为中心的瓦斯特克政权，位于墨西哥湾沿岸帕努科河下游；瓦斯特克语中帕努科意为渡口，得名于当地过河处。该城是瓦斯特克诸部落联盟驻地，统治者拥有奎斯特卡特尔头衔。

约1450年瓦斯特克人被蒙特祖马一世的军队击败，此后向阿兹特克纳贡，但保留本地首领。

1521年弗朗西斯科·德·加雷的远征队在奇拉和塔莫斯湖区被当地武士击退；1522年埃尔南·科尔特斯从科约阿坎出兵夺取该地，12月在帕努科建立圣埃斯特万德尔普埃尔托镇，是美洲第二个市政议会，后来成为帕努科省省会。

en:
The Muscogee, also known as the Creeks, formed a confederacy of towns across much of present-day Alabama and western Georgia. Their ancestors belonged to the Mississippian mound-building cultures, and the confederacy brought together communities speaking several languages.

The Creek War of 1813–1814 began as a struggle between Muscogee factions and drew in the United States. After Andrew Jackson defeated the Red Sticks, the 1814 Treaty of Fort Jackson forced the confederacy to cede vast lands, including those of Creeks who had fought beside him. Most Muscogee were forcibly moved to Indian Territory in the 1830s.
zh:
马斯科吉人又称克里克人，在今阿拉巴马州大部和佐治亚州西部组成了聚落联盟。他们的祖先属于修建土丘的密西西比文化，而联盟汇集了使用多种语言的社群。

1813—1814年的克里克战争始于马斯科吉内部派别的冲突，随后美国也卷入其中。安德鲁·杰克逊击败红棍派后，1814年的《杰克逊堡条约》迫使联盟割让大片土地，其中包括曾与他并肩作战的克里克人的土地。19世纪30年代，大多数马斯科吉人被迫迁往印第安领地。

en:
The Manchu state arose among the Jurchen peoples of northeastern Asia. Nurhaci of the Aisin Gioro clan united Jurchen groups and founded the Later Jin in 1616, organizing his followers into the Eight Banners. In 1618 he declared his grievances against the Ming and began a war that brought Liaodong under his control.

His successor Hong Taiji adopted the name Manchu for the people in 1635 and proclaimed the Qing dynasty at Shenyang in 1636. In 1644 Qing armies entered Beijing, beginning the dynasty's rule over China.
zh:
满洲政权兴起于东北亚的女真诸部。爱新觉罗氏的努尔哈赤统一女真各部，于1616年建立后金，并将部众编入八旗。1618年他以七大恨誓师反明，发动战争，夺取了辽东。

继任者皇太极于1635年将族名定为满洲，1636年在盛京建立清朝。1644年清军进入北京，开始了清朝对中国的统治。

en:
The Muchi, better known as the Muping tusi, were a hereditary Gyalrong chieftaincy and one of the eighteen Gyalrong chiefdoms, holding the mountain country west of Yazhou in what is now Baoxing County, Sichuan. In 1410 its chief Nange submitted to the Ming and was appointed Dongbu Hanhu pacification commissioner.

Under Keluo Jiancan, who succeeded in 1438, Muping grew powerful enough to invade the neighboring Tsakho chiefdom in 1449, but it declined after his death in 1455 and lost the lands it had seized.

It submitted to the Qing in 1662, and Muping troops led the Qing assault on the rebel stronghold at Dartsedo during the Changcejilie rising of 1700; afterwards the ruling family intermarried with the Mingzheng tusi and often held both chiefdoms at once. In 1833 the Yutong branch was recognized as a separate tusi.
zh:
木赤即穆坪土司，是世袭嘉绒人土司，为嘉绒十八土司之一，辖境在今四川雅安宝兴县一带的雅州西山之中。1410年酋长南葛归附明朝，被授董卜韩胡宣慰使司职。

1438年克罗俄坚粲继位，势力强盛，1449年大举入侵邻境杂谷土司；他1455年去世后穆坪转衰，所占土地被杂谷夺回。

1662年穆坪归附清朝；1700年打箭炉昌侧集烈之乱中，穆坪兵随清军先行攻入西炉，此后其家族与明正土司联姻，常由一人兼领两司。1833年鱼通支系被认定为独立土司。

en:
This is the Gaelic kingdom of Desmond, or South Munster, ruled from the Killarney lakes by the MacCarthy Mór, head of the MacCarthy kindred. It was born in 1118, when the Treaty of Glanmire split Munster into Desmond and Thomond and Tadhg Mac Carthaigh became its first king; the dynasty traced to Carthach, an Eóganacht king who died in 1045, whose grandsons took the surname Mac Carthaigh.

It covered Cork and Kerry. After the Norman invasion the east fell to the FitzGerald earls of Desmond, but the west stayed semi-independent after Fínghin Mac Carthaigh defeated the Geraldines at Callann in 1261.

In 1337 the king was Cormac MacCarthy Mor, who reigned until 1359, and the dynasty founded Blarney Castle in 1446. Its kings kept independence until the Nine Years' War; the kingdom was dissolved in 1596 and Desmond absorbed into the Kingdom of Ireland.
zh:
这是盖尔人的德斯蒙德王国，即南芒斯特，以基拉尼湖区为中心，由麦卡锡家族宗主麦卡锡·莫尔统治。王国诞生于1118年：《格兰迈尔条约》把古芒斯特分为德斯蒙德与托蒙德，泰格·麦卡锡成为第一代国王；王朝可追溯到1045年去世的尤甘纳赫特国王卡萨赫，其孙以麦卡锡为姓。

王国领有科克和克里。诺曼入侵后东半部落入菲茨杰拉德伯爵之手，西部仍保持半独立，1261年芬因·麦卡锡在卡兰战役击败杰拉尔丁家族，保住独立。

1337年在位的是科马克·麦卡锡·莫尔，统治到1359年；王朝1446年建成布拉尼城堡。历代国王维持独立，直到九年战争，1596年王国解散，德斯蒙德并入爱尔兰王国。

en:
The Muhhekunneuw, or Mohicans, formed a confederacy in the upper Hudson valley and the Housatonic watershed. Their communities included villages near present-day Albany, at the junction of the Hudson and Mohawk rivers. Conflict with the Mohawk during the Beaver Wars drove many east toward Stockbridge in Massachusetts after 1680.

Following the American Revolution, Mohican descendants moved west to Oneida land in central New York. Under pressure to sell their land, Stockbridge people moved again to Wisconsin in the 1820s and 1830s.
zh:
穆赫康纽人又称莫希干人，曾在哈德逊河上游河谷和豪萨托尼克河流域组成联盟。他们的村落包括今奥尔巴尼附近、哈德逊河与莫霍克河交汇处的聚居点。1680年后，海狸战争中与莫霍克人的冲突迫使许多人东迁至马萨诸塞的斯托克布里奇一带。

美国独立战争后，莫希干人的后裔西迁至纽约州中部的奥奈达人土地。迫于出售土地的压力，斯托克布里奇人在19世纪20至30年代再次迁往威斯康星。

en:
The Mascouten were an Algonquian-speaking people recorded by French missionaries in southern Michigan. Driven west by the Odawa, they lived near the present Wisconsin–Illinois border.

In 1712 they joined the Kickapoo and Meskwaki after devastating conflict with the French and Potawatomi. By 1779 a Mascouten band lived on the Wabash River; survivors were later recorded among the Kickapoo Prairie Band.
zh:
马斯古顿人是说阿尔冈昆语的民族，法国传教士曾在密歇根南部记载他们。被渥太华人向西驱逐后，他们住在今威斯康星州与伊利诺伊州的边界附近。

1712年，马斯古顿人与法国人及波塔瓦托米人的冲突造成惨重损失，随后他们与基卡普人和梅斯夸基人联合。到1779年，一个马斯古顿部众住在瓦巴什河畔；此后的记录将幸存者列入基卡普草原部。

en: The Macorix were an Indigenous people of northern Hispaniola who spoke a language distinct from Taíno and Ciguayo. Their language disappeared within a century of the Spanish conquest.
zh: 马科里斯人是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛北部的原住民，所说语言不同于泰诺语和西瓜约语。他们的语言在西班牙征服后的一个世纪内消失。

en:
The Emirate of Medina was a sharifate centred on the Islamic holy city of Medina in the Hejaz, ruled by the Banu Muhanna, Husaynid Alids claiming descent from Muhammad through Ali and his son Husayn. As Abbasid power collapsed, Ubayd Allah ibn Tahir seized the city around 940, and his dynasty held it on and off until the sixteenth century.

The sharifs were Twelver Shi'ites and, because the two holy cities depended on Egyptian grain, usually recognised the suzerainty of Egypt's rulers, from the Fatimids to the Mamluks. They repeatedly clashed with the larger Sharifate of Mecca, briefly occupying Mecca itself in 1271 and 1288.

From the 1280s Cairo tightened its grip, and by the fourteenth century the Mamluk sultans appointed and deposed the emirs at will; Wudayy ibn Jammaz, son of the long-reigning Jammaz ibn Shihah, ruled in 1336 to 1343. In the fifteenth century Medina was subordinated to the Sharif of Mecca as vice-sultan of the Hejaz, and a Mamluk garrison was stationed there each year.
zh:
麦地那酋长国是以汉志圣城麦地那为中心的埃米尔国，由穆罕纳家族统治；该家族属侯赛因系阿里德圣裔，自称经阿里及其子侯赛因传承自穆罕默德。阿拔斯王朝瓦解之际，欧拜杜拉·伊本·塔希尔于940年前后夺取麦地那，其家族断断续续统治到16世纪。

历任沙里夫信奉十二伊玛目派什叶派，两座圣城依赖埃及粮食，因此通常承认埃及统治者的宗主权，从法蒂玛王朝到马穆鲁克王朝无不如此。他们与更强大的麦加酋长国屡次冲突，曾在1271年和1288年短暂占领麦加。

13世纪80年代起，开罗方面加强控制，到14世纪马穆鲁克苏丹已可随意任免埃米尔，长期在位的贾马兹·伊本·希哈之子伍代·伊本·贾马兹于1336至1343年当政。15世纪，麦地那被置于麦加沙里夫（汉志副苏丹）之下，城内每年驻扎一支马穆鲁克守军。

en:
The Sultanate of Mogadishu was a wealthy Muslim city-state on the Banaadir coast of southern Somalia, ruled by the Fakhr al-Din dynasty from the thirteenth century and held as an Ajuran client in 1337. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 he found a large city at the height of its prosperity under the Somali sultan Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh Umar.

It dominated regional gold trade, minted coinage and wove toob benadir cloth for Egypt and Syria. It sent envoys to the Ming court, and Zheng He's treasure fleets called there in the early fifteenth century.

Its multi-storeyed stone houses and mosques with cylindrical minarets impressed Vasco da Gama, and a Portuguese bombardment in 1542 forced the sultan to make peace. Around 1600 the Muzaffar dynasty took over as Ajuran clients; the Abgaal overthrew them late in the seventeenth century and folded Mogadishu into the Hiraab Imamate.
zh:
摩加迪沙苏丹国是索马里南部巴纳迪尔海岸的富庶穆斯林城邦，13世纪起由法赫尔丁王朝统治，1337年已是阿朱兰附庸。伊本·白图泰1331年到访时，见到正值鼎盛的宏大城邦，统治者是索马里苏丹阿布·贝克尔·伊本·谢赫·欧麦尔。

它主宰地区黄金贸易，自铸钱币，织造远销埃及、叙利亚的“图布·巴纳迪尔”布匹。它曾向明朝遣使，15世纪初郑和宝船队亦到访。

多层石屋和圆柱形宣礼塔清真寺令达伽马印象深刻；1542年葡萄牙炮击迫使苏丹议和。1600年前后穆扎法尔王朝作为阿朱兰代理人接管，17世纪末阿卜加尔人将其推翻，把摩加迪沙并入新建的希拉卜伊玛目国。

en:
The Viscounty of Marsan was a small Gascon lordship on the Douze and Midou rivers, whose historic capital was Mont-de-Marsan. It appeared in the late tenth century, when the Duchy of Gascony was breaking into a patchwork of viscounties, its first viscounts holding Roquefort castle.

In the twelfth century Viscount Peter of Marsan, who died in 1163 and had married the countess of Bigorre, built the old castle that grew into Mont-de-Marsan, which then became the viscounty's political centre.

Through a chain of heiresses Marsan passed to the houses of Comminges, Matha and Moncade, and when Margaret of Moncade married Roger-Bernard III of Foix in 1252 it was joined to Béarn in the Foix-Béarn inheritance. In 1337 its viscount was therefore Gaston II of Foix-Béarn, and Marsan afterwards followed the fortunes of Foix, Navarre and finally the House of Bourbon.
zh:
马桑子爵领是杜兹河与米杜河流域的加斯科涅小领地，历史首府为蒙德马桑。它出现于10世纪末加斯科涅公国裂分为众多子爵领之时，早期子爵以罗克福城堡为治所。

12世纪子爵皮埃尔·德·马桑1163年去世，他娶比戈尔女伯爵，修建了后来发展为蒙德马桑的旧堡，此地由此成为子爵领政治中心。

经过一连串女继承人婚姻，马桑经科曼日、马塔等家族转入蒙卡德家族；1252年蒙卡德的玛格丽特嫁给富瓦的罗歇-贝尔纳三世，马桑便随贝阿恩并入富瓦-贝阿恩遗产。因此1337年子爵是富瓦-贝阿恩的加斯东二世，此后马桑随富瓦、纳瓦拉最终随波旁家族起落。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Minden was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire on the middle Weser in Westphalia. Charlemagne founded the diocese in 803 after the conquest of the Saxons, and it became a prince-bishopric in 1180 when the Duchy of Saxony was broken up.

In 1337 the see was held by Louis of Brunswick-Lüneburg, a Welf who ruled from the cathedral city of Minden. The Reformation took hold in the sixteenth century under the influence of the neighbouring Welf duchies, and during the Thirty Years' War Swedish troops occupied the land and ended episcopal rule.

The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 secularized Minden and granted it to Brandenburg as the Principality of Minden. From 1719 Prussia administered it together with Ravensberg as Minden-Ravensberg.
zh:
明登采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国在威斯特伐利亚威悉河中游的教会邦国。查理曼征服萨克森人后于803年设立主教区，1180年萨克森公国拆解时升为采邑主教区。

1337年主持教区的是韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克-吕讷堡的路易，他以主教座堂城市明登为中心统治。16世纪在邻近韦尔夫诸公国影响下宗教改革扎根；三十年战争中瑞典军队占领此地，终结主教统治。

1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将明登世俗化，作为明登侯国封给勃兰登堡。1719年起普鲁士把它与拉芬斯堡合并为明登-拉芬斯堡管理。

en:
Mandara was a kingdom in the Mandara Mountains of present-day Cameroon. Around 1580 its rulers conquered Dulo and made it their capital; in 1614 Bornu's ruler Idris Alaoma installed Aldawa Nanda on the throne, extending Bornu's influence over Mandara.

Around 1715 Mai Bukar Aji converted to Islam and made Mandara a sultanate. In 1809 the Fulani leader Modibo Adama briefly captured Dulo, but a Mandara counterattack drove his forces out.
zh:
曼达拉是今喀麦隆境内曼达拉山脉的一个王国。约1580年，其统治者征服杜洛并定都于此；1614年博尔努统治者伊德里斯·阿洛马扶立阿尔达瓦·南达为王，使博尔努在曼达拉取得影响力。

约1715年，迈·布卡尔·阿吉皈依伊斯兰教，使曼达拉成为苏丹国。1809年富拉尼领袖莫迪博·阿达玛一度占领杜洛，但曼达拉反击，将他的军队逐出境外。

en:
The County of Manderscheid was the Eifel lordship of the House of Manderscheid, whose Schleiden estates were held in 1337 by William IV. It led the Eifel nobility in the fifteenth century, when Dietrich III inherited Schleiden and Blankenheim and was made imperial count in 1457.

After Dietrich died in 1498 his sons divided the inheritance, settled as early as 1488, into the Blankenheim, Kail and Schleiden lines. Schleiden lay in the Duchy of Luxembourg and passed with it to Burgundy in the 1440s and the Habsburgs.

The Eifel counties suffered plague, feuds and witch-hunts, with roughly 260 people executed for witchcraft between 1528 and 1641. The Kail line died out in 1762; when the Blankenheim male heirs failed in 1780, its last countess carried the lands to Bohemian Sternberg counts. French revolutionary troops occupied the Eifel in 1794 and abolished the county.
zh:
曼德沙伊德伯国是曼德沙伊德家族在艾费尔山区的领地，1337年威廉四世伯爵以施莱登为中心统治。15世纪其家为艾费尔头等贵族世家：迪特里希三世继承施莱登、布兰肯海姆，1457年升帝国伯爵。

迪特里希1498年死后，诸子按早在1488年定下的安排瓜分遗产，成布兰肯海姆、凯尔、施莱登三支。施莱登原属卢森堡公国，15世纪40年代随公国入勃艮第，后归哈布斯堡。

艾费尔诸伯国饱受瘟疫、仇杀和猎巫之苦，1528—1641年约260人以巫术罪处死。凯尔支1762年绝嗣；布兰肯海姆男系1780年绝，末代女伯爵将领地带归波希米亚的施特恩贝格伯爵家。1794年法国革命军占领艾费尔，废除伯国。

en:
Madya-as was the traditional kedatuan, or datu-led confederacy, of Panay in the Visayas, remembered above all in the Maragtas traditions recorded by Pedro Monteclaro from older oral accounts.

The legends tell of ten datus from Borneo, led by Datu Puti, who fled the oppressive Rajah Makatunaw and landed on Panay; they bought the coastal plains from Marikudo, chief of the native Ati, in a bargain sealed with a golden salakot and other gifts. The eldest, Datu Sumakwel, convened a council of datus at Malandog, issued the Maragtas Code and divided the island into three districts.

The dating of these events to around 1212 is doubted by historians, and the confederacy's existence rests on oral tradition rather than contemporary documents. Its settlements endured into the Spanish period and grew into the centers of the later provinces of Iloilo, Capiz and Antique.
zh:
马迪亚斯是米沙鄢班乃岛传说中的达图联盟（当地称克达图安），主要见于佩德罗·蒙特克拉罗据古老口传整理的《马拉格塔斯》。

传说达图·普蒂率十名婆罗洲达图为逃避拉惹·马卡图瑙暴政渡海而来，在班乃登陆，用一顶金盔和其他礼物向原住民阿提人首领马里库多换得沿海平原。最年长的达图·苏马克韦尔在马兰多格召集达图会议，颁布《马拉格塔斯法典》，把全岛划为三个辖区。

传说把这些事件系于1212年前后，但历史学家存疑，联盟的存在只有口传而无同时代文献佐证。这些定居点延续到西班牙殖民时期，后来发展为伊洛伊洛、卡皮斯和安蒂克三省的中心。

en:
Mecca was the seat of the Sharifate, held by the Hasanid descendants of the Prophet's clan, who governed the holy city and guarded the annual pilgrimage. Its fourteenth-century rulers belonged to the line of Qatada ibn Idris, the sharif who had seized the emirate around the turn of the thirteenth century.

By Abu Numayy I's reign, from 1250 to 1301, the sharifs ruled in the shadow of Cairo's Mamluk sultans, whose names entered the Friday sermon and whose armies installed and deposed emirs with the yearly hajj caravan. In 1337 the emir was Rumaythah ibn Abi Numayy, called Asad al-Din, who had held it on and off since 1301 and openly favoured Zaydi Shi'ism; Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad confirmed him as sole emir that year.

He died in 1346 and was succeeded by his son Ajlan, whose descendants held the Sharifate until 1517, when the last Mamluk sultan fell and the sharif acknowledged the Ottoman caliph with local autonomy.
zh:
麦加是麦加谢里夫政权的所在地，由先知宗族的哈桑后裔世袭，负责治理圣城、护卫每年的朝觐。14世纪的当政者出自卡塔达·伊本·伊德里斯一系，他在13世纪初夺取埃米尔之位。

到阿布·努麦伊一世在位时（1250—1301年），谢里夫们已在开罗马穆鲁克苏丹的阴影下统治，周五聚礼念诵苏丹之名，马穆鲁克军队随年度朝觐商队废立埃米尔。1337年在位的是鲁迈塞·伊本·阿布·努麦伊，称号阿萨德丁，他自1301年起几度执掌该职，公开支持栽德派什叶派；苏丹纳西尔·穆罕默德于同年确认他为唯一埃米尔。

他1346年去世，其子阿吉兰继位，后裔保有谢里夫之位直到1517年；末代马穆鲁克苏丹覆灭后，麦加谢里夫承认奥斯曼哈里发的宗主权，同时保有地方自治。

en:
Medri Bahri was the Christian highland country north of the Mereb River, with its seat at Debarwa. These highlands had been heartland of the Aksumite kingdom and its port of Adulis; after Aksum's decline Tigrinya-speaking communities became dominant, and from the twelfth century local governors ruled the coastal approaches.

Under Zara Yaqob in the mid-fifteenth century the Bahr Negash governed Hamasien, Seraye and other lands, drawing wealth from the gold, ivory and slave trade to Massawa. The office became a frontier command: in 1541 the Bahr Negash Yeshaq guided the Portuguese musketeers who helped break the Adalite invasion, but Ottoman forces seized Massawa in 1557 and briefly occupied Debarwa, and Yeshaq, rebelling against Emperor Minas with Turkish backing, was killed at Addi Qarro in 1578.

By the seventeenth century hereditary families such as the Hab Sellus ruled the province. It fragmented among rival highland houses during the Zemene Mesafint.
zh:
梅德里巴赫里是马雷布河以北的基督教高原之国，治所在德巴尔瓦。这片高原曾是阿克苏姆王国及其港口阿杜利斯的腹地；阿克苏姆衰落后，说提格利尼亚语的族群成为主体，12世纪起由地方长官统辖沿海通道。

15世纪中期，扎拉·雅各布皇帝在位时，巴赫里·纳加什统辖哈马森、塞拉埃等地，经马萨瓦港经营黄金、象牙和奴隶贸易积聚财富。这个职位后来变成边防统帅：1541年，巴赫里·纳加什叶沙克为协助击退阿达尔入侵的葡萄牙火枪手引路，但奥斯曼军队于1557年夺取马萨瓦并一度占领德巴尔瓦；叶沙克借土耳其支持反叛皇帝米纳斯，于1578年战死在阿迪卡罗。

17世纪时，哈布·塞卢斯等世袭家族统治该省。到王子时代，它在高原诸家族的争斗中陷入分裂。

en:
Meissen grew from a fortress Henry the Fowler built in 929 above the Elbe. After Gero's vast march broke up around 968, it became seat of a margrave and bishopric, securing the Elbe frontier among gradually Germanized Slavs. In 1089 Emperor Henry IV enfeoffed the Wettin count Henry of Eilenburg with the march, which became the dynasty's stronghold.

Silver found near Freiberg around 1168 funded the Wettin margraves from Conrad the Great onward. Victory at Lucka in 1307 over Henry VII of Luxembourg left the margraviate effectively independent. In 1337 Margrave Frederick II the Serious held it, his house also ruling Thuringia.

In 1423 Frederick IV received the heirless Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg and the Saxon electoral dignity. The 1485 Treaty of Leipzig split the Wettin lands; after 1547 the Albertines, who kept Meissen, folded the march into the Electorate of Saxony.
zh:
迈森藩侯国源于929年捕鸟者亨利在易北河畔岩石上修建的要塞。约968年格罗的庞大藩侯国解体后，迈森成为藩侯驻地，同时设立主教区，在逐渐被德意志化的易北河斯拉夫人中守卫边境。1089年，皇帝亨利四世把藩侯国封给韦廷家族的艾伦堡伯爵亨利，迈森从此成为该家族的根基。

1168年前后，弗赖贝格附近发现银矿，引来的财富从康拉德大帝起为韦廷藩侯们提供财源。1307年，藩侯国在卢卡战役中击败卢森堡的亨利七世，取得事实上的独立。1337年在位的是藩侯腓特烈二世（严肃者），其家族同时统治着图林根。

1423年，腓特烈四世获得绝嗣的萨克森—维滕贝格公国，并随之取得萨克森选侯地位。1485年的《莱比锡条约》瓜分韦廷领地；1547年后，保有迈森的阿尔布雷希特支系把旧藩侯国并入萨克森选侯国。

en:
Memmingen lies on the Iller in Upper Swabia, on the site of the Roman settlement of Cassiliacum, later an Alemannic village and a seventh-century Frankish royal palace. The town was refounded in 1158 by Duke Welf VI and became an imperial city in 1286, growing rich on the salt road that linked the Danube lands with Lindau.

It embraced the Reformation under the preacher Christoph Schappeler, and in 1525 the peasants gathering there issued the Twelve Articles, the first printed declaration of peasant rights in Europe; 25,000 copies circulated within two months.

During the Thirty Years' War Wallenstein made the town his headquarters in 1630 just before his dismissal, and an imperial siege forced its surrender in 1647. In the reorganization of 1802 Memmingen lost its imperial immediacy and was assigned to Bavaria.
zh:
梅明根位于上施瓦本的伊勒河畔，城址是罗马人的卡西利亚库姆定居点，后来先后是阿勒曼尼人的村落和7世纪的法兰克王宫。1158年韦尔夫六世重建该城，1286年成为帝国城市，依靠连接多瑙河流域与林道的盐路贸易致富。

宗教改革时期，城市在传教士克里斯托夫·沙佩勒影响下皈依新教；1525年聚集于此的农民发布《十二条款》，这是欧洲第一份印刷流传的农民权利宣言，两个月内印行两万五千份。

三十年战争中，华伦斯坦于1630年被解职前夕驻节该城，1647年帝国军队围城，城市被迫投降。1802年的格局重组中，梅明根失去帝国直辖地位，被划归巴伐利亚。

en:
The Menteşeids were the earliest of the Oghuz Turk frontier beyliks that arose as the Seljuk sultanate of Rûm collapsed. Founded by Menteşe Bey in the late thirteenth century and ruled from Milas, it covered ancient Caria, the later Muğla region.

The first seafaring Anatolian beylik saw Mesut Bey briefly seize part of Rhodes in 1300, and under Orhan Bey in 1337 its galleys extorted tribute from Negroponte and the Venetian islands. Its fleets mixed commerce with piracy, its coastal forests feeding its shipyards. It sat out the crusades that broke its Aydınid neighbours and took their Aegean trade.

An earthquake in 1389 weakened it; it submitted to Bayezid I in 1390, was restored by Timur after 1402 under İlyas Bey, accepted Ottoman overlordship in 1414 and was annexed in 1426. Its seamen supplied roughly two fifths of the fleet that besieged Constantinople in 1453.
zh:
门泰谢是罗姆塞尔柱苏丹国崩溃之际涌现的乌古斯突厥边境贝伊国中最早的一个，13世纪末由门泰谢贝伊建立，以米拉斯为都，疆域涵盖古卡里亚，即后来的穆拉地区。

这个安纳托利亚第一个面向海洋的贝伊国，其梅苏德贝伊曾于1300年短暂攻占罗得岛部分地区；1337年在位的奥尔汗贝伊时期，其桨帆船向内格罗蓬特和威尼斯各岛勒索贡赋。它的舰队兼营商贸与海盗勾当，沿海森林支撑起造船业。击垮邻邦艾登贝伊国的十字军，门泰谢基本置身事外，接手其失去的爱琴海贸易。

1389年的大地震使其元气大伤；它1390年臣服巴耶济德一世，1402年后由帖木儿归还给伊利亚斯贝伊，1414年承认奥斯曼宗主权，1426年被彻底吞并。其水手声名不坠，1453年围攻君士坦丁堡的舰队中约有五分之二来自门泰谢。

en:
Metztitlan, place of the moon in Nahuatl, was the capital of an independent Otomi kingdom in the rugged canyon country of present-day Hidalgo, ringed by mountains around its lake. Alongside Tlaxcala and Huexotzinco it was one of the few central Mexican states the Aztec Empire never conquered: Mexica armies campaigned repeatedly in its valley, but difficult terrain and modest tribute made the emperors judge the effort not worthwhile.

Its people worshipped the moon goddess Zana and kept a calendar close to the Mexica one but with day names of their own. When Hernan Cortes marched against Tenochtitlan, Metztitlan joined the Spanish alliance.

Augustinian friars founded a monastery there in 1538, rebuilt on higher ground as the great church of the Santos Reyes in 1557. Indigenous uprisings shook the town twice in 1811, early in Mexico's independence wars.
zh:
梅茨蒂特兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为月亮之地，是今伊达尔戈州崎岖峡谷地带一个独立奥托米王国的都城，群山环抱着城下的湖泊。它与特拉斯卡拉、韦霍钦戈一样，是阿兹特克帝国始终未能征服的少数墨西哥中部政权之一：墨西加军队多次攻入其山谷，但地形艰险、贡赋有限，帝国统治者最终认为得不偿失。

当地人崇拜月亮女神扎娜，使用与墨西加历相近却自有一套日名的历法。埃尔南·科尔特斯进军特诺奇蒂特兰时，梅茨蒂特兰加入西班牙同盟。

1538年奥斯定会修士在此建立修道院，1557年又在高处重建为宏伟的三王教堂。1811年墨西哥独立战争初期，当地土著两度起义，震动这座城镇。

en:
Mewar was a Guhila Rajput state in southern Rajputana, centred on Chittor. Its rulers, traditionally traced to Bappa Rawal, alternated between independence and vassalage before becoming sovereign in the tenth century. Alauddin Khalji stormed Chittor in 1303: defenders died fighting and their women performed jauhar, ending the first royal line. In 1326 Hammir Singh, head of the clan's Sisodia branch, retook Chittor and founded the Sisodia dynasty.

Rana Kumbha ringed Mewar with forts and Rana Sanga campaigned across northern India, until Babur defeated him at Khanwa in 1527. Akbar took Chittor in 1568 and Udai Singh II moved his court to Udaipur; his son Maharana Pratap fought at Haldighati in 1576, recovering much of the country by guerrilla war, before Amar Singh I accepted Mughal overlordship.

As Mughal power crumbled, the ranas won freedom in 1708 to 1710 but faced Maratha tribute demands. In 1818 Bhim Singh accepted British protection and Mewar became Udaipur State.
zh:
梅瓦尔是拉杰普塔纳南部的古希拉族拉杰普特政权，以吉多尔堡为中心。传说其君主可追溯到巴帕·拉瓦尔，王国在独立与臣服间几度反复，10世纪成为主权政权。1303年阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉攻陷吉多尔，守军战死、女眷投火自焚，王室主支断绝。1326年家族西索迪亚分支首领哈米尔·辛格收复吉多尔，开创西索迪亚王朝。

后来拉纳·昆巴在全境修筑堡垒群，拉纳·桑加兵锋遍及北印度，直到1527年在坎瓦被巴布尔击败。1568年阿克巴攻占吉多尔，乌代·辛格二世迁都乌代布尔；其子摩诃拉那·普拉塔普1576年在哈米尔加蒂迎战，后以游击战收复大片国土，阿马尔·辛格一世最终接受莫卧儿宗主权。

莫卧儿势力衰落后，历代拉纳于1708—1710年重获自由，却承受马拉塔人的贡赋盘剥。1818年，比姆·辛格接受英国保护，梅瓦尔成为乌代布尔土邦。

en:
Mexico emerged as an independent state from the Spanish viceroyalty of New Spain, with its capital at Mexico City. In 1810 the priest Miguel Hidalgo launched an uprising; after his execution, José María Morelos and then Vicente Guerrero continued the struggle.

In 1821 Guerrero joined the former royalist Agustín de Iturbide under the Plan of Iguala, and their army entered Mexico City. Iturbide became emperor in 1822, but conflict with Congress and an army revolt forced his abdication in 1823. A federal republic followed, and Spain recognized Mexican independence in 1836.
zh:
墨西哥从西班牙的新西班牙总督辖区中独立，首都设在墨西哥城。1810年神父米格尔·伊达尔戈发动起义；他被处决后，何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯和比森特·格雷罗先后继续斗争。

1821年格雷罗与原保王派军官阿古斯丁·德·伊图尔维德依据《伊瓜拉计划》结盟，联军进入墨西哥城。伊图尔维德于1822年称帝，但与国会的冲突和军队叛乱迫使他在1823年退位。此后墨西哥成立联邦共和国，西班牙于1836年承认其独立。

en:
Montferrat is a Holy Roman Empire march in southern Piedmont, ruled from Casale. Created about 967 when Otto I enfeoffed Aleramo with the western Ligurian march, it was held by the Aleramici for more than three centuries. Boniface I led the Fourth Crusade in 1202 and founded the Kingdom of Thessalonica.

Later marquesses warred with Asti and other communes and led a renewed Lombard League against Angevin expansion. When the last Aleramici margrave died in 1305, it passed to Theodore I Palaiologos, a Byzantine emperor's son, whose line ruled in 1337 and for two centuries.

Their lands shrank under pressure from Milan and Savoy; when their line ended in 1533 Charles V granted it to Federico II Gonzaga of Mantua in 1536. Raised to the Duchy of Montferrat in 1574, it fell to Savoy when the Gonzaga died out in 1708.
zh:
蒙费拉托是神圣罗马帝国在皮埃蒙特南部的侯国，以卡萨莱为统治中心。约967年皇帝奥托一世把西利古里亚边区封给亚勒拉莫，亚勒拉米契家族统治该地三个多世纪。波尼法乔一世在1202年率领第四次十字军，建立塞萨洛尼基王国。

此后的侯爵们与阿斯蒂等市镇长期交战，并领导重建的伦巴第同盟抵抗安茹家族扩张。1305年末代亚勒拉米契侯爵去世，侯国传给拜占庭皇帝之子提奥多罗一世·巴列奥略，1337年在位的正是这一支，还将延续两百年。

巴列奥略诸爵在米兰和萨伏依挤压下疆土日蹙，1533年家族绝嗣后，查理五世于1536年把它封给曼托瓦的费德里科二世·贡扎加。1574年蒙费拉托升格为公国，1708年贡扎加家族绝嗣后归入萨伏依家族。

en:
The County of Mansfeld, centred on Eisleben, was named for Mansfeld Castle. In 1069 Henry IV enfeoffed the House of Mansfeld; Hoyer the Great fell fighting Saxon rebels at Welfesholz in 1115. When the first male line died out in 1229, a Querfurt lord married the heiress and their descendants kept the title.

Eisleben, chartered in 1180, grew rich on Harz copper and silver mines. In 1512 the county joined the Upper Saxon Circle as an imperial estate. This was a Reformation homeland: Martin Luther was born in Eisleben in 1483 and died there in 1546; some counts signed the Augsburg Confession in 1530, though one line stayed Catholic.

Crippled by debt, the counts lost imperial immediacy in 1579 and were mediatised between Saxony and Magdeburg. The last branch died out in 1780; the Congress of Vienna assigned Eisleben to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
曼斯费尔德伯国以艾斯莱本周围的矿业地带为中心，得名于曼斯费尔德城堡。1069年皇帝亨利四世把伯国封给曼斯费尔德家族；先祖“伟人”霍耶1115年在韦尔费斯霍尔茨与萨克森叛军作战时阵亡。1229年第一条男系绝嗣，奎尔富特家族的领主娶女继承人，后代沿用曼斯费尔德头衔。

艾斯莱本1180年获建城权，靠哈茨山的铜银矿藏致富。1512年伯国作为帝国直属领地加入上萨克森行政圈。这里是宗教改革的故土：马丁·路德1483年生于艾斯莱本、1546年逝于此，一些伯爵1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》，只有一支仍奉天主教。

因债务缠身，伯爵们1579年失去帝国直辖地位，被萨克森和马格德堡瓜分代管。最后一支1780年绝嗣，1815年维也纳会议把艾斯莱本划归普鲁士。

en:
The County of Feldkirch was a small Holy Roman Empire lordship in the Vorarlberg. Count Hugo I of Montfort laid out the town below Schattenburg Castle, first called a city in 1218; the castle, built around 1260, became the counts' seat. In 1345 Emperor Louis the Bavarian besieged the Schattenburg without success.

The last count, Rudolf, inherited an indebted lordship and in 1375 sold it to Duke Leopold III of Habsburg; the citizens won a great charter of liberties in 1376. During the Appenzell Wars Feldkirch joined a Swiss-style league in 1405, and the Schattenburg endured an eighteen-week siege in 1405 and 1406 before being stormed and burned, then rebuilt two years later.

Swedish troops occupied the town without a fight in 1647, the Jesuits opened a college in 1649, and a battle was fought outside its walls in 1799.
zh:
费尔德基希伯国是神圣罗马帝国在福拉尔贝格的小领地。蒙特福特伯爵胡戈一世规划了沙滕城堡脚下的城镇，1218年文书首次称其为城市；约1260年建成的沙滕城堡成为伯爵治所。1345年，皇帝巴伐利亚人路易围攻沙滕城堡不克。

末代伯爵鲁道夫接手债务缠身的领地，1375年把它卖给哈布斯堡公爵利奥波德三世；市民趁易主之机在1376年争取到大自由特许状。阿彭策尔战争期间，费尔德基希1405年加入仿效瑞士邦联的同盟，沙滕城堡在1405—1406年坚守十八周后被攻陷焚毁，两年后重建。

1647年瑞典军队兵不血刃占领该城，1649年耶稣会开办学院，1799年城外又爆发一场战役。

en:
Wenduling is the name in the Yuan annals Nanhai Zhi of 1304 for a Mindanao polity then vassal to Pon-i, as Brunei was known. Most scholars identify it with animist Cotabato valley settlements, predecessors of Maguindanao, though some place it on Mindoro. Brunei held it until a Majapahit invasion weakened Brunei and Wenduling broke away.

In the sixteenth century Sharif Kabungsuwan of Johor brought Islam up the Mindanao rivers, married into local chiefly families and founded the Sultanate of Maguindanao at Cotabato. Two brothers parted between the new faith and the old mountain ways, sealing a lasting pact between the Maguindanaon and the Teduray.

Under Sultan Muhammad Kudarat in the seventeenth century the sultanate fought the Spanish-Moro Wars, took Sarangani in 1625, and Lanao seceded. It ceded Palawan to Spain in 1705 and held the Spaniards to the Mindanao coasts.
zh:
文都灵是1304年元代史籍《南海志》记载的棉兰老政权，当时是渤泥（即文莱）的属邦。多数学者比定为哥打巴托谷地的泛灵信仰定居点、马京达瑙的前身，但也有研究认为该名称指民都洛。文莱一度统治此地，直到满者伯夷入侵削弱文莱，文都灵才趁机独立。

16世纪，来自柔佛的谢里夫·卡邦苏万沿棉兰老各河传播伊斯兰教，与当地首领家族联姻，在哥打巴托建立马京达瑙苏丹国。一对兄弟分别皈依新教和退守山林坚守旧俗，缔结马京达瑙人与特杜莱人持久的和平之约。

17世纪苏丹穆罕默德·库达拉特在位时，苏丹国投身西班牙—摩洛战争，1625年夺取萨兰加尼，拉瑙则在这一时期脱离统治。1705年它把巴拉望割让给西班牙，但始终把西班牙人牵制在棉兰老沿海。

en:
The Mongol Empire arose on the Mongolian Plateau, where a 1206 assembly proclaimed Temüjin as Genghis Khan. His armies and those of his descendants conquered lands from China to eastern Europe, but succession wars divided the empire into rival realms by 1294.

In 1368 Ming forces captured Dadu and the Yuan court withdrew to Mongolia, where its successors are known as the Northern Yuan. Dayan Khan and Mandukhai Khatun reunited most Mongol tribes in the late fifteenth century, but their successors divided authority among princely branches. The Later Jin conquered the Northern Yuan in 1635.
zh:
蒙古帝国兴起于蒙古高原，1206年的大会推举铁木真为成吉思汗。他和后裔的军队征服了从中国到东欧的广大地区，但继承权战争使帝国到1294年分裂为彼此竞争的政权。

1368年明军攻占大都，元朝宫廷退回蒙古，其后继政权称为北元。15世纪末，达延汗与满都海哈屯重新统一了大部分蒙古部落，但他们的后继者将权力分给各王族支系。1635年，后金征服了北元。

en:
Mangyül Gungthang, also called Lower Ngari, was a Tibetan kingdom in the Kyirong valley on the Nepal border, guarding the trans-Himalayan trade routes from its walled capital at Dzongka. Its kings descended from the old Yarlung royal line: Sakyapa-backed forces from Gungthang defeated Purang and Yatse in 1252 and 1253, and around 1265 Bumdegon founded the formal kingdom as one of the thirteen myriarchies of Yuan-era Tibet, receiving direct Mongol recognition and dominating western Tibet for a time.

Gold finds and the mountain caravan trade made Dzongka prosperous. In the fifteenth century the princess Chökyi Drönma, daughter of King Tri Lhawang Gyaltsen, became the first Samding Dorje Phagmo, Tibet's highest female reincarnation.

Gungthang repelled a Rinpungpa invasion in 1555, but after centuries under changing Central Tibetan overlords it was destroyed by the King of Tsang in 1620.
zh:
芒隅贡塘一称下阿里，是吉隆河谷、尼泊尔边境上的西藏王国，以城堡宗葛为都，扼守喜马拉雅南北的商路。其王统出自古老的雅砻王室后裔：13世纪50年代，贡塘的军队在萨迦派支持下击败布让与亚泽；约1265年，崩德衮正式建国，成为元代西藏十三万户之一，获得蒙古的直接承认，一度称雄阿里。

西部黄金的发现与山地商队贸易使宗葛富庶。15世纪，国王赤拉旺坚赞之女、贡塘公主曲吉卓美成为西藏地位最高的女转世活佛，即第一代桑顶·多吉帕姆。

1555年贡塘击退仁蚌巴的入侵，但在历经西藏中部各势力的宗主权更迭后，最终于1620年被藏巴汗攻灭。

en:
Möng Ku denotes the cluster of small Tai Nüa chiefdoms in the hills between the Weiyuan and Zhenkang valleys, whose settlements included Kainan, Zheledian and Mengtong, the Tai name of Wandian.

The Yuan brought Kainan under the Weichu route in 1262 and made it a prefecture in 1275, then reorganised it into Jingdong Prefecture in 1331. Under the Ming the country was parcelled into native offices: the Zheledian Chief's Office was created in 1403 under the Tai officer Dao Tan, and Wandian, called Mengtong in Tai, became a native prefecture in 1407.

The Qing wound most of them down during the gaitu guiliu reforms, turning Zheledian into Enle County in 1727, while the Wandian chieftains kept their hereditary title until the twentieth century.
zh:
勐沽指威远与镇康之间山地里的一组傣那人小酋邦，聚落包括开南、者乐甸以及湾甸的傣语名勐统。

1262年元朝将开南并入威楚万户，1275年立为开南州，1331年又改设景东府。明代把这一带划为多个土司衙门：1403年设者乐甸长官司，授傣族土官刀谈；1407年将傣语称勐统的湾甸长官司升为湾甸御夷州。

清代改土归流时多数土司被裁撤，者乐甸于1727年改置恩乐县，而湾甸勐统土司的世袭头衔一直延续到20世纪。

en:
The Mogami were a branch of the Shiba who ruled from Yamagata in Dewa. Shiba Kaneyori went to the Yamagata basin in 1356, built a castle there around 1360 and took the name Mogami.

Mogami Yoshiaki expanded the family's lands and in 1600 defended them against the Uesugi while supporting Tokugawa Ieyasu. Ieyasu rewarded him with a large domain, but in 1622 the shogunate confiscated it after a dispute within the family.
zh:
最上氏是从出羽山形统治领地的斯波氏支族。斯波兼赖于1356年前往山形盆地，约1360年在那里筑城，并改称最上。

最上义光扩张了家族领地，1600年支持德川家康，同时抵御上杉氏的进攻。家康赐给他广大的领地，但幕府于1622年因家族内部争执将其没收。

en:
Möng Ngüm, the Tai chiefdom called Menglian in Chinese records and Möng Lem in Shan, held the hills of the Salween's eastern tributaries. The Yuan created it a tusi in 1289 as the Mulian Circuit, saophas ruling from the valley seat of Nayun.

In 1348 it was swallowed by the rising power of Möng Mao, and under the early Ming passed first to the Luchuan commission and, after 1402, to the Mengding prefecture. In 1406 the Ming set up the Menglian chieftaincy, whose lands took in the old Mulian Circuit and the Yinshaluo country.

Suspended in the mid-sixteenth century, it was restored in 1585 as Menglian; the chiefs submitted to the Qing in 1662 and were raised to pacification commissioners in 1709. One of the Nine Shan States, Möng Lem long paid tribute to both China and the Burmese kingdoms.
zh:
勐恩是汉文史料中的孟连、掸语称勐连的台语酋邦，据有萨尔温江以东支流的山区。元朝于1289年设木连路，以当地召法为土司，治所在娜允古镇。

1348年它被崛起的麓川吞并，明初先后隶属麓川平缅宣慰司，1402年后改归孟定府。1406年明朝设置孟琏长官司，辖地除元代木连路外，还包括银沙罗甸故地。

该长官司在嘉靖年间一度被废，1585年恢复，改称猛脸；1662年首领归附清朝，仍置长官司，1709年升格为孟连宣抚司。作为九掸邦之一，勐连长期同时向中国和缅甸诸王国纳贡。

en:
Mongolia was the centre of a Borjigin-ruled state on the Mongolian Plateau after the Yuan court withdrew from China in 1368. Rival factions weakened the authority of its khans, but in the late fifteenth century Dayan Khan and Mandukhai Khatun brought most Mongol tribes together again.

Dayan Khan distributed the eastern Mongol tumens among his sons, creating a more decentralized order. In the early seventeenth century Ligdan Khan struggled with other Mongol leaders; after his death, the remaining Northern Yuan court submitted to the Later Jin in 1635.
zh:
1368年元朝廷退出中国后，蒙古成为孛儿只斤氏在蒙古高原上统治的政权中心。各派争斗削弱了汗的权威，但在15世纪末，达延汗与满都海哈屯再次统一了大部分蒙古部落。

达延汗将东蒙古诸万户分封给儿子，使统治更为分散。17世纪初，林丹汗与其他蒙古首领争斗；他去世后，北元残余朝廷于1635年归附后金。

en:
Möng Mit, known in Burmese as Momeik, was a northern Shan state east of Bhamo. Shan tradition derives it from the ancient kingdom of Gandhalarattha and dates the present state to around 1238.

In 1413 it became a dependency of Hsenwi, a reward for Hsenwi's help to the Ming against Lan Na and Ava. But in 1450 the dowager Nang Han Lung rebelled, sent ruby tribute to China from 1465 and won Ming recognition of independence in 1484, ceding the ruby lands of Mogok to the Burmese crown.

It fought in Shan coalitions backing Prome against the Toungoo and was defeated by Bayinnaung in 1542; a bell inscription records Bayinnaung's conquest of Möng Mit and Hsipaw on 25 January 1557. In 1597 the crown tightened its grip: the saopha was forced to exchange Mogok for Tagaung and the ruby tract was annexed outright.
zh:
孟弥以缅甸语名称莫梅克（中文史籍多作孟密）更为人知，是八莫以东山地的北掸邦国。据掸人传说，其源头可溯至古老的犍陀罗国，现存邦国约建于1238年。

1413年，它成为兴威的属地，这是兴威协助明朝征讨兰纳和阿瓦所得的封赏。但1450年主母囊汉隆起兵反叛，自1465年起单独向中国进贡红宝石，1484年获明朝承认独立，代价是把红宝石产地抹谷割让给缅甸王室。

孟弥曾参加掸邦援助卑谬、对抗东吁的联军，1542年败于勃印曩；一口大钟的铭文记载，勃印曩于1557年1月25日攻灭孟弥和昔卜。1597年缅甸王室收紧控制，诏法被迫以抹谷交换太公，红宝石产区就此被正式吞并。

en:
Maguana was a chiefdom in the interior of Hispaniola. Around 1470 Caonabo, a chief from the Lucayan islands, conquered Maguana and married Anacaona, sister of the ruler of neighbouring Jaragua.

After Columbus arrived in 1492, Caonabo fought the Spaniards and attacked their settlement at La Navidad. The Spaniards captured him, and a Taíno force led by his brother Manicatex failed to rescue him; Caonabo died in Spanish captivity during the voyage across the Atlantic.
zh:
马瓜纳是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛内陆的一个酋长国。约1470年，来自卢卡扬群岛的酋长卡奥纳博征服马瓜纳，并迎娶邻近哈拉瓜统治者的妹妹阿纳考纳。

哥伦布于1492年抵达后，卡奥纳博与西班牙人交战，袭击了他们的圣诞堡聚落。西班牙人俘获了他，他的兄弟马尼卡特克斯率泰诺人营救失败；卡奥纳博在横渡大西洋途中死于西班牙人囚禁之下。

en:
Möng Hsa was a Tai Nüa polity of the Mengding basin in western Yunnan, centred on the lands that are now Gengma. Its Tai rulers had moved south from Mong Mao in the fourteenth century and settled among the Wa peoples of the surrounding hills.

Under the Yuan the area was organised as the Mengding route, and in 1382 the Ming set up the Mengding Native Prefecture, first held by a chieftain of the Dao family. During the Luchuan campaigns of the 1440s the old ruling line fled, and the Ming granted Mengding to Han Ge, a Hsenwi officer who had served in the fighting, beginning the long rule of the Han family.

In the late Ming period the chieftains also submitted to the Burmese kings, but the Qing later reconfirmed their hereditary office under Yongchang Prefecture.
zh:
勐沙是滇西蒙定坝的傣那人政权，核心区域在今耿马一带。其傣族统治者在14世纪从勐卯南迁而来，与周围山地的佤人杂处。

元朝在此设孟定路，1382年明朝置孟定御夷府，最初由刀姓土司执掌。15世纪40年代三征麓川时旧土司逃散，明朝把孟定封给从征有功的木邦土目罕葛，罕氏由此开始世袭统治。

明末孟定土司一度臣服于缅甸国王，清代又重新承认其世袭地位，划归永昌府管辖。

en:
Melahuacan was the head town of a small pre-conquest province on the southern coast of what is now Jalisco, whose people had come from Sayula. It headed a cluster of villages including Tenzitlán, Xirosto and Pampochin.

Francisco Cortés de San Buenaventura conquered the province in 1525, and in 1533 the captain Juan Fernández de Híjar, sent by Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán, founded the Spanish town of Villa Purificación in the same valley, around which the old communities were later gathered.
zh:
梅拉瓦坎是今哈利斯科南部海岸一个征服前小省的首镇，居民来自萨尤拉。它统领滕齐特兰、希罗斯托、潘波钦等村庄。

1525年，弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉征服该省；1533年，受努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼派遣的队长胡安·费尔南德斯·德·伊哈尔在同一谷地建立西班牙城镇普里菲卡西翁，旧有各村后来被归并到它周围。

en: Möng Hkeng was a small Tai Nüa Shan chiefdom in the Yongchang frontier hills of western Yunnan, around present-day Zhenkang on the border facing Burma's Kokang district. Such Chinese Shan chiefdoms gained room to themselves after the Mongols overthrew Dali in 1253, and were later enrolled as tusi, becoming the Yuan Zhenkang military administration and the Ming-Qing Zhenkang native prefecture.
zh: 勐亨是云南西部永昌边地山区的傣那掸人小邦，地当今镇康、与缅甸果敢相望的边境一带。1253年蒙古攻灭大理后，这类汉地掸邦小邦获得一定自主，后来又被纳入土司体系，先后成为元代镇康路和明清镇康土州。

en:
Mahilaka was a Swahili Muslim trading town on the north-western coast of Madagascar, in Ampasindava Bay. It was founded by the Antalaotra, Swahili-speaking migrants from the East African coast who intermarried with local Malagasy from around the year 1000, and it flourished from about 1000 to 1500 as one of the island's first urban settlements.

Excavations have uncovered a walled town of about sixty hectares with stone houses and mosques, and a central stone building of nearly four hectares that may have been a ruler's palace, together with traces of ironworking, glassmaking and local-style pottery. Its merchants linked northern Madagascar to the Indian Ocean trade of the Comoros and the Swahili coast.

The town was abandoned in the 1400s, its role passing to Vohemar, and some scholars link the rise of the kingdom of Guingemaro to slaves who escaped from Mahilaka.
zh:
马希拉卡是马达加斯加西北海岸安帕辛达瓦湾的一座斯瓦希里穆斯林贸易城镇。安塔拉特拉人——约1000年前后从东非海岸迁来、与当地马达加斯加人通婚的斯瓦希里语移民——建立了它，约1000年至1500年间它作为岛上最早的城市聚落之一繁荣一时。

考古发掘出一座约六十公顷的城墙城镇，内有石屋和清真寺，还有一座近四公顷的中心石构建筑，可能是统治者的宫殿；铁器加工、玻璃制造的痕迹和本地风格的陶器也有出土。当地商人把马达加斯加北部同科摩罗和斯瓦希里海岸的印度洋贸易连在一起。

该城于1400年代被废弃，港口地位由武希马里纳接续，有学者认为根杰马罗王国的兴起与从马希拉卡逃出的奴隶有关。

en:
Möng Hten was the native chiefdom of the Shunning hills in western Yunnan, centered on Shunning, the modern Fengqing, and holding the valleys of Baotong and Youdian. It entered the imperial record in 1327, when its ruler submitted to the Yuan and the Shunning native prefecture was created, with Baotong subprefecture and Qingdian county added the following year.

The Ming reduced it to a subprefecture in 1382 and restored it as a prefecture in 1384, leaving the native chiefs in place until 1598, when the Wanli court replaced them with circulating officials. In 1770 the Qing turned the old seat into Shunning County.
zh:
勐甸是云南西部顺宁山区的土著酋邦，以顺宁（今凤庆）为中心，领有宝通、右甸等河谷。它最早见于史籍是在1327年：其首领归附元朝，元廷设置顺宁土府，次年又增置宝通州和庆甸县。

1382年明朝把它降为顺宁州，1384年复升为府，土官世袭之制一直维持到1598年，万历朝廷在此改土归流、改派流官治理。1770年，清朝又在旧府治设置顺宁县。

en:
The Maratha state arose in the western Deccan under Shivaji of the Bhonsle clan. He seized forts from Bijapur and was crowned at Raigad in 1674, defending his kingdom against the Mughals.

In the eighteenth century the Peshwa Bajirao I and leading Maratha families expanded into northern and central India. Defeat by the Durrani Empire at Panipat in 1761 checked their advance, though they recovered much territory. After the Peshwa sought British protection in 1802, wars with the East India Company ended the confederacy in 1818.
zh:
马拉塔政权在本斯莱氏族的希瓦吉领导下兴起于德干西部。他从比贾布尔夺取堡垒，于1674年在赖加德加冕，并抵御莫卧儿进攻。

18世纪，佩什瓦巴吉拉奥一世与马拉塔诸大家族向印度北部和中部扩张。1761年他们在帕尼帕特败于杜兰尼帝国，扩张受阻，但后来收复了大片领土。佩什瓦于1802年寻求英国保护后，与东印度公司的战争最终使邦联于1818年瓦解。

en:
Miahuatlan, whose Nahuatl name means place of corn tassels and which the Zapotecs called Pelopenitza, was a Zapotec city-state in the southern mountains beyond the Oaxaca valleys.

It grew rich as a regional market centre, trading local cochineal dye, soaproot amole and cotton mantas for the salt, cotton and slaves brought from more distant lands, and it fought repeated wars with its neighbours Coatlan and Ozolotepec.

In the early sixteenth century the Aztec Empire conquered it under Moctezuma II and made it a provincial capital with a Mexica governor, extracting tribute of jewels and gold dust. After the Spanish conquest of Oaxaca in 1521 Miahuatlan remained an indigenous tribute town, its people now paying honey, gold dust, mantas and turkeys to the new authorities.
zh:
米亚瓦特兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为玉米穗之地，萨波特克语称佩洛佩尼察，是瓦哈卡谷地以南山地的萨波特克人城邦。

它是区域性的商贸中心，市场上除本地的胭脂虫染料、皂用阿莫勒和棉毯外，还有远方运来的盐、棉花和奴隶，并与邻邦科阿特兰、奥索洛特佩克屡次交战。

16世纪初，阿兹特克帝国在蒙特苏马二世在位时将其征服，把它设为行省首府，派驻墨西加总督，征收珠宝和金砂贡赋。1521年瓦哈卡被西班牙征服后，米亚瓦特兰仍是原住民贡赋城镇，居民改以蜂蜜、金砂、棉毯和火鸡向新统治者纳贡。

en:
Mahu was the country of the Mahu, a Yi people of the lower Jinsha River in southern Sichuan. The Tang held it as loose-reign prefectures named Mahu; the Yuan made it the Mahu Route. In winter 1371 the Yuan commander An Ji sent his son An Ren to submit to the Ming, who created Mahu Prefecture and confirmed the An clan as hereditary prefects over Pingshan and four offices.

The An family grew notorious for extortion and violence: An Ao charged silver by the head, taking some ten thousand taels a year, kept sorcerer monks who killed by magic, and plotted to murder the Pingyi chief Wang Taiqing.

Arrested and executed in 1495, An Ao was replaced the next year by an appointed official under gaitu guiliu, one of Sichuan's earliest such reforms. The Qing abolished Mahu Prefecture in 1727, dividing its lands among southern Sichuan districts.
zh:
马湖是彝族马湖部的居地，在四川南部金沙江下游。唐代设羁縻州，总称马湖部，元代置马湖路。1371年冬，总管安济派儿子安仁向明朝归附，明廷设马湖府，以安氏世袭土知府，下辖屏山县和四个长官司。

安氏横征暴敛、暴虐不法：安鳌按人口摊派银两，岁入白银万两，又豢养妖僧以邪术害人，甚至图谋杀害平夷长官王太庆。

1495年安鳌被逮处死，次年朝廷改土归流，以流官取代安氏，为四川最早的改流地区之一。1727年清朝裁府，其地分入四川南部各州县。

en: The Michen are the Jurchen group of the lower Nen river plain, centered on the settlement of Yilaha in present-day Nenjiang. Under the Yuan the scattered Shuidada and Jurchen population of these plains was governed through the Shuidada circuit of Liaoyang province, and in 1346 they joined the Wozhe rising against the dynasty's gyrfalcon tribute demands.
zh: 密陈是嫩江下游平原的女真群体，以今嫩江市境内的伊拉哈聚落为中心。元朝时，这一带散居的水达达和女真人归辽阳行省水达达路管辖；1346年，他们参加了兀者野人因不堪海东青索贡而发动的反元起事。

en:
The County of Maine, whose capital was Le Mans, took its name from the Gallic tribe Aulerci Cenomani. Long disputed between Anjou and Normandy, it saw William the Conqueror seize Le Mans in 1063; in 1110 Count Elias I's daughter Eremburga married Fulk V of Anjou.

Maine passed to Geoffrey Plantagenet in 1126 and to Henry II of England in 1151, until Philip II of France conquered it in 1204. Louis IX granted it in 1246 to his brother Charles of Anjou; a marriage in 1290 carried it to the Valois, and it entered the royal domain with Philip VI in 1328, passing in 1332 to his son John, the future John II, who held it in 1337.

After Verneuil in 1424 the English occupied the county and held Le Mans until 1448. In 1481 Charles IV of Anjou bequeathed it to Louis XI, and it returned permanently to the crown.
zh:
曼恩伯国的首府是勒芒，其名来自高卢部落奥勒尔克·塞诺曼尼人。曼恩长期在安茹与诺曼底之间遭人争夺：1063年征服者威廉夺取勒芒，1110年伯爵埃利亚斯一世之女埃伦布尔加嫁给安茹的富尔克五世。

伯国于1126年传给若弗鲁瓦·金雀花，1151年又归英格兰的亨利二世，1204年被法兰西的腓力二世征服。1246年路易九世把它封给弟弟安茹的查理；1290年的一场婚姻使它转入瓦卢瓦家族，1328年随腓力六世并入王室领地，1332年封给其子约翰，即后来的约翰二世，1337年时正由他领有。

1424年韦尔讷伊之战后，英格兰人占领伯国，占据勒芒直到1448年。1481年安茹的查理四世把曼恩遗赠给路易十一，伯国从此永久收归王室。

en: The Migita were a branch of the Ōuchi warrior family of Suō. The Sue family descended from the Migita, who later served the Mōri as retainers of the Chōshū domain.
zh: 右田氏是周防武家大内氏的支族，陶氏又出自右田氏。右田氏后来侍奉毛利氏，成为长州藩士。

en:
The Mihrabanids were the third indigenous Muslim dynasty of Sistan, the arid Helmand-delta country also called Nimruz and famed in the Shahnameh as Rostam's homeland. They ruled it from 1236 until the mid-sixteenth century. Taking power after the Mongol conquest, the maliks, based at Shahr-i Sistan near Zaranj, acknowledged the Ilkhans as overlords from 1256 with wide autonomy, conquered Quhistan by 1289 and fought intermittent wars with the Kartids of Herat.

The Ilkhanate's collapse left the dynasty independent for nearly half a century, and in 1337 the malik was Qutb al-Din Muhammad, who reigned from 1330 to 1346.

Timur invaded Sistan in 1383 and devastated the province, ending that independence; the Mihrabanids then served as Timurid vassals and passed to the Shaybanids in the early sixteenth century. The last malik, Sultan Mahmud, submitted to the Safavids in the 1530s and handed over Sistan, ending three centuries of rule, while its Sunni population resented the Shi'i practices introduced under Safavid suzerainty.
zh:
米赫拉班王朝是锡斯坦的第三个本土穆斯林王朝。锡斯坦又称尼姆鲁兹，地处赫尔曼德河三角洲的干旱之地，在《列王纪》中被传颂为鲁斯塔姆的故乡。王朝自1236年起统治该地区，直至16世纪中叶。蒙古征服后，历代马利克以扎兰季附近的沙赫里锡斯坦为都，1256年起奉伊儿汗为宗主但享有很大自治权，1289年征服库希斯坦，并与赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝时战时和。

伊儿汗国瓦解后，王朝独立了近半个世纪，1337年在位的马利克是库特布丁·穆罕默德（1330至1346年在位）。

1383年帖木儿入侵锡斯坦并大肆蹂躏，独立告终，此后米赫拉班王朝沦为帖木儿附庸，16世纪初又转归昔班尼王朝。末代马利克苏丹·马哈茂德于16世纪30年代臣服萨法维王朝、交出锡斯坦，延续三百年的统治就此结束，当地逊尼派民众对宗主权下引入的什叶派礼仪颇为不满。

en:
The Mi'kmaq occupied Mi'kma'ki, a homeland encompassing Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island and the Gaspé Peninsula. Their Grand Council brought together district councils and chiefs, and the Mi'kmaq were one of the nations of the Wabanaki Confederacy.

Around 1534 Jacques Cartier traded with Mi'kmaq people in Chaleur Bay. During the eighteenth century the Mi'kmaq, together with the Wolastoqiyik and Passamaquoddy, signed a series of peace and friendship treaties with the British Crown, beginning in 1725.
zh:
米克马克人居住在米克马克基，其故地包括新斯科舍、爱德华王子岛和加斯佩半岛。由地区议会和酋长组成的大议会统辖各地，米克马克人也是瓦巴纳基联盟的成员之一。

约1534年，雅克·卡蒂埃在沙勒尔湾与米克马克人交易。18世纪，米克马克人与沃拉斯托基人、帕萨马科迪人一道，与英国王室签订了一系列和平友好条约，第一份签于1725年。

en: The Hmong were communities of southern China included among the peoples called Miao in Chinese records. During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, peoples described as Miao rebelled against Ming rule in southern China.
zh: 苗是中国南方的族群，其蒙人群体也被中国史籍归入苗的称谓之下。14至15世纪，中国南方被称为苗的族群曾反抗明朝统治。

en:
The Kingdom of Imerina arose in Madagascar's central highlands, traditionally founded by Andriamanelo in 1540. His successor Ralambo named the kingdom Imerina, and Andrianjaka captured Analamanga and established Antananarivo as his capital in the early 1600s.

After decades of civil war, Andrianampoinimerina took power in 1787, reunited Imerina and extended its rule across the highlands. His son Radama I continued the conquests, ruling much of Madagascar; in 1817 Britain recognised him as King of Madagascar in return for a pledge to end slave exports. Radama also invited missionaries to establish schools in Imerina.
zh:
梅里纳王国兴起于马达加斯加中央高地，传统上认为由安德里亚马内卢于1540年建立。继任者拉兰布将王国命名为梅里纳，安德里安扎卡于17世纪初攻占阿纳拉曼加，在那里建立首都塔那那利佛。

经过数十年内战，安德里亚南普伊奈梅里纳于1787年掌权，重新统一梅里纳并将统治扩展至高地各处。他的儿子拉达马一世继续征服，统治了马达加斯加的大部分地区；1817年英国承认他为马达加斯加国王，作为交换，他承诺停止输出奴隶。拉达马还邀请传教士在梅里纳开办学校。

en:
The Principality of Minsk was a Rus' principality centered on Minsk, in present-day Belarus. It emerged from the division of Polotsk in 1101, when Gleb Vseslavich inherited the city and its surrounding lands. In 1119 Mstislav of Kiev took Minsk and carried Gleb away as a prisoner.

Lithuanian influence grew in the thirteenth century; by 1326 Minsk was under Lithuanian control, and its ruler Vasily signed a treaty on behalf of Grand Duke Gediminas. Minsk received town privileges in 1499 and passed to Russia in the Second Partition of Poland in 1793.
zh:
明斯克公国是一个罗斯公国，以今白俄罗斯境内的明斯克为中心。1101年波洛茨克分割时，格列布·弗谢斯拉维奇继承明斯克及周边土地，公国由此形成。1119年基辅的姆斯季斯拉夫攻占明斯克，将格列布俘走。

立陶宛的影响在13世纪逐渐增强；到1326年，明斯克已受立陶宛控制，其统治者瓦西里代表大公格迪米纳斯签署条约。明斯克于1499年获得城市特权，1793年波兰第二次瓜分时归入俄国。

en: Mitic was a small señorío of the Tecuexe, a Chichimeca people of the Los Altos highlands in what is now Mexico, counted among the independent chiefdoms that the migrating Mexica once raided together with Acatic and Xalostotitlan. It shared the fate of its neighbours in the Spanish conquest of 1530 and the Mixtón War of 1541.
zh: 米蒂克是特库埃克人的一个小邦，该奇奇梅克族群生活在今墨西哥的阿尔托斯高原，曾是特库埃克独立酋邦之一，迁徙中的墨西加人曾把它与阿卡蒂克、沙洛斯托蒂特兰一并攻掠。1530年西班牙征服和1541年米斯特翁战争中，它与邻邦同遭覆灭。

en:
The Miura were a warrior family named for their homeland on the Miura peninsula in Sagami. Miura Yoshiatsu, also known as Dōsun, became head of the Sagami house around 1494. In 1511 a peace with Ise Moritoki left him holding the peninsula and central Sagami.

Moritoki attacked again in 1512, forcing Yoshiatsu back to Arai Castle. After a long siege the castle fell in 1516, and Yoshiatsu and his son Yoshioki died fighting, ending the Sagami Miura as an independent power.
zh:
三浦氏是以相模国三浦半岛为故地并取其地名的武士家族。三浦义同又称道寸，约于1494年继承相模三浦家的家督。1511年，他与伊势盛时议和，控制了三浦半岛和相模国中郡。

盛时于1512年再次进攻，迫使义同退守新井城。经过长期围困，新井城于1516年陷落，义同与儿子义意战死，相模三浦氏的独立势力随之终结。

en:
Yucu Dzaa, called Tututepec in Nahuatl, both names meaning Hill of the Bird, was a Mixtec city on the Pacific coast of Oaxaca. Mixtec codices record that Eight Deer Jaguar Claw led migrants from the highlands to the coast and founded the city in 1083, then conquered dozens of neighbouring towns.

A Toltec embassy under Four Jaguar allied with him in 1097 and helped him take Tilantongo the following year. By the Late Postclassic it had grown into the largest city in Oaxaca, its subject rulers watched by governors sent from the capital.

Its northward expansion was later checked by the Aztecs. After the fall of the Aztec Empire, Pedro de Alvarado captured the city in March 1522, taking its ruler Coaxintecuhtli, who died in Spanish captivity.
zh:
玉库扎在纳瓦特尔语中称图图特佩克，两个名字都意为“鸟山”，是瓦哈卡太平洋沿岸的纽萨维城邦。据纽萨维手抄本记载，鹿八日虎爪于1083年率高地移民来到沿海建城，随后征服数十座邻近城镇。

1097年，虎四日率领的托尔特克使团与他结盟，并于次年助他攻下蒂兰通戈。到后古典期，玉库扎已成为瓦哈卡最大的城市，被征服的统治者由都城派去的官员监视。

它向北的扩张后来被阿兹特克人遏制。阿兹特克帝国陷落后，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多于1522年3月攻占该城，俘获君主科阿辛特库特利，后者最终死于西班牙人的囚禁中。

en:
The Miya were local warrior lords of Bingo, associated with the priestly family of Kibitsu Shrine. Miya Kanenobu fought for Ashikaga Takauji and became governor of neighboring Bitchū by 1364. His descendants were based at Nishi-Nakajō, while another branch held Kashiwa in Bingo.

Around 1539 Amago Haruhisa brought the Miya under his influence. The main Kashiwa line died out in 1541, and the family declined after an Ōuchi attack around 1548. Branch families later served the Mōri.
zh:
宫氏是备后国的地方武士领主，与吉备津神社的神官家族有关。宫兼信追随足利尊氏作战，至1364年已出任邻国备中的守护。他的后裔以西中条为据点，另一支则据有备后的柏。

约1539年，尼子晴久使宫氏归附。柏的宗家于1541年断绝，约1548年遭大内氏进攻后，宫氏逐渐衰落。其支族后来仕于毛利氏。

en:
Mayurbhanj was the largest of the Orissa hill states, a forested mountain country on the border of Orissa and Bengal whose people included the Santal, Munda and other tribes. Its rulers belonged to the Bhanja dynasty, heirs of the ancient Khijjinga mandala lineage, whose peacock emblem recalled a legend that their ancestors sprang from a peafowl's eyes.

The present dynasty was traditionally founded in the twelfth century by Adi Bhanja; the Bhanjas ruled as feudatories of the Eastern Ganga kings of Orissa. From the fifteenth century the capital stood at Baripada, where the royal palace was built in 1804.

In the eighteenth century Mayurbhanj passed under Maratha supremacy and paid an annual tribute of six thousand rupees, and in 1829 it became a British protectorate, keeping its own Bhanja raja.
zh:
马尤布汉杰是奥里萨各山地土邦中最大的一个，地处奥里萨与孟加拉交界的山林地带，居民包括桑塔尔人、蒙达人等部族。统治这里的班贾王朝源出古代基金伽曼荼罗的世系，其孔雀徽章源自祖先由孔雀眼中诞生的传说。

一般认为该王朝由12世纪的阿迪·班贾开创，班贾诸王作为奥里萨东恒伽国王的附庸进行统治。15世纪起都城设在巴里帕达，王宫于1804年建于该城。

18世纪马尤布汉杰转入马拉塔宗主权之下，每年纳贡六千卢比；1829年它成为英国的保护国，但仍保留自己的班贾罗阇。

en:
Möng Kawng, better known by its Burmese name Mogaung, was a Shan principality in what is now Kachin State. Tai chronicles credit its founding to Sam Long Hpa, who built his capital on the Nam Kawng and ruled a country said to stretch from Hkamti Long to Shwebo, initially as a tributary of Möng Mao.

It enters Chinese records in 1295 as Mengguang, where the Yuan set up a tribal command. When Möng Mao was broken in campaigns from 1436 to 1449, its fugitive ruler Si Jifa took refuge at Möng Kawng. Ava captured it in 1477, and China occupied it from 1479 to 1483 and briefly in 1495.

After the Toungoo era Burmese control grew: Burma held it from 1651 to 1742 and again from 1771 to 1775, before annexing Möng Kawng in 1796 and replacing its sawbwas with centrally appointed wuns.
zh:
孟拱以缅甸语名称莫冈更为人所知，是今克钦邦境内的一个掸人邦国。据傣文编年史记载，创立者三隆帕在南拱河畔建都，统治范围据说北起坎底、南至瑞波，起初是孟卯的属邦。

中国史籍中它于1295年以“蒙光”之名出现，元朝在当地设立土司。1436至1449年的战事中孟卯覆灭，逃亡首领思机法曾到孟拱避难。阿瓦于1477年攻占该邦，明朝又在1479至1483年及1495年两度短暂占据。

东吁时代之后，它日益受制于缅甸：缅甸先后在1651至1742年、1771至1775年占领孟拱，最终于1796年将其吞并，以中央任命的温取代当地诏法。

en: The Mekoche were one of the five divisions of the Shawnee confederacy, and traditionally supplied its healers. Their Pigeon Town stood on the Mad River in Ohio. Black Hoof, a Mekoche civil chief, opposed removal and sought peace with the United States; after his death in 1831, the Shawnee were compelled to move west.
zh: 梅科奇是肖尼联盟的五个部族之一，传统上由他们提供医治者。他们的鸽子镇位于俄亥俄地区的马德河畔。梅科奇民事酋长黑蹄反对迁徙，寻求与美国和平相处；他于1831年去世后，肖尼人被迫西迁。

en:
Mekongga was a kingdom of the Tolaki people on the southeast peninsula of Sulawesi, in the lands around the Mekongga Mountains, the present-day Kolaka area. Its domain was also called Wonua Sorume, the Land of Orchids, and its name derives from the Tolaki word kongga, eagle: local tradition tells of the first ruler, Sangia Larumbalangi, who slew a giant eagle named Kongga Owose and became king in the 1200s.

One of its kings, Bokeo Ladumaa, aided Luwu in its war against Suppa and was rewarded by Luwu's ruler Datu Alimuddin with a red-and-white banner bearing the Islamic confession of faith. He was afterwards known as Sangia Nibandera, the king who holds the flag.

The kings ruled with the title Bokeo, first from Bende and later from Wundulako. The small neighboring polity of Watumendonga was later absorbed into the kingdom.
zh:
梅孔加是苏拉威西东南半岛梅孔加山脉一带（今科拉卡地区）托拉基人的王国。其国土又称“兰花之地”沃努阿·索鲁梅；国名来自托拉基语kongga（鹰）：当地传说初代统治者桑吉亚·拉伦巴兰吉杀死巨鹰孔加·奥沃塞后于1200年代称王。

一位君主博凯奥·拉杜马曾出兵协助卢武对抗苏帕，卢武统治者达图·阿里穆丁赐他一面写有清真言的红白旗帜。他因此得名“持旗之王”桑吉亚·尼班德拉。

君主使用“博凯奥”称号，王都最初在本德，后迁至温杜拉科。邻近的小邦瓦图门东加后来也并入了梅孔加。

en: The Makah were a coastal people of the Olympic Peninsula around Neah Bay. They built cedar longhouses and hunted whales and seals from canoes; a mudslide buried part of their village at Ozette. In 1834 a Japanese vessel was wrecked near Cape Flattery, and the Makah held its three survivors before taking them to Fort Vancouver.
zh: 马卡人是奥林匹克半岛尼亚湾一带的海岸民族。他们建造雪松长屋，乘独木舟猎捕鲸和海豹；一场泥石流掩埋了奥泽特村的一部分。1834年，一艘日本船只在弗拉特里角附近失事，马卡人扣留了三名幸存者，随后将他们带到温哥华堡。

en:
Mecklenburg grew out of the lands of the Obotrites, a Wendish confederation between the Elbe and the Baltic. Its rulers traced descent from the Obotrite prince Niklot, whose son Pribislav submitted to Henry the Lion of Saxony in the twelfth century and was enfeoffed with Mecklenburg. German and Flemish settlers then founded or expanded towns such as Wismar and Rostock, later Hanseatic members.

In 1337 Albert II held the lordship; he had succeeded his father Henry II in 1329. A marriage to the Swedish royal heiress drew him into Scandinavian politics, and his younger son Albert became King of Sweden in 1364. Emperor Charles IV raised Mecklenburg to a duchy in 1348.

Henry IV reunited the lands in 1471; the duchy turned Protestant in 1549 and was later partitioned into Mecklenburg-Schwerin and Mecklenburg-Strelitz, both raised to grand duchies in 1815.
zh:
梅克伦堡源自奥博特里特人的土地，这是易北河与波罗的海之间的文德人部落联盟。统治家族自称出自奥博特里特王公尼克洛特，其子普里比斯拉夫在12世纪向萨克森的狮子亨利称臣并受封梅克伦堡。随后德意志和佛兰德斯移民建立或扩建了维斯马、罗斯托克等城镇，它们后来加入汉萨同盟。

1337年，阿尔布雷希特二世领有此地，他于1329年继承父亲亨利二世。与瑞典王室继承人的婚姻把他卷入斯堪的纳维亚政局，其次子阿尔布雷希特于1364年成为瑞典国王。1348年皇帝查理四世将梅克伦堡升格为公国。

1471年亨利四世重新统一梅克伦堡领地；公国于1549年改宗新教，后来被分割为梅克伦堡-什未林和梅克伦堡-施特雷利茨，两支均于1815年升格为大公国。

en: Möng Köng, rendered Maingkaing in Burmese and meaning “lac town” in Shan, was a small Tai chiefdom on the upper Chindwin, around the village of Maingkaing in Homalin Township. It belonged to the scattered group of outlying Shan principalities north of the main Shan states, alongside Hsawnghsup and Hkamti Long.
zh: 孟昆的缅语转写为 孟更，掸语意为“紫胶城”，是钦敦江上游霍马林镇区孟更村一带的小型傣语酋邦，与双肃、坎底等同属掸邦腹地以北那群分散的偏远掸人小邦。

en:
The Mashiko were warrior lords of Mashiko in Shimotsuke Province and senior retainers of the Utsunomiya. In 1339 Southern Court forces captured their castles while the family fought for the Northern Court; the Mashiko later recovered them.

Mashiko Katsumune seized the family leadership in 1546 and rebuilt Takadate Castle as his base in 1576. A later conflict with the Utsunomiya ended in the defeat of Mashiko Iemune, and the family lost its power in southern Shimotsuke.
zh:
益子氏是下野国益子的武家领主，也是宇都宫氏的重臣。1339年，益子氏为北朝作战时，南朝军攻占了他们的城堡；益子氏后来收复了失地。

益子胜宗于1546年夺取家督，1576年修筑高馆城作为据点。此后益子氏与宇都宫氏的冲突以益子家宗战败告终，家族失去了在下野南部的势力。

en:
Makran is the arid coastal strip of southern Baluchistan on the Gulf of Oman. In antiquity it was the Achaemenid satrapy of Maka; Seleucus ceded it to Chandragupta Maurya in 304 BCE, and Shapur I counted Makuran a Sasanian province in 262 CE. When the Arabs conquered the coast in 643 and 644 after the Battle of Makran, Buddhist and Hindu rajas still held parts as it became the caliphate's easternmost frontier.

The Ma'danid dynasty ruled from the tenth to the eleventh century; Buyid forces took Tiz in 971. By the fourteenth century the coast was held by Baloch rulers of the Hot, or Kalmati, line.

The most famous, Sultan Hammal Jiand, destroyed a Portuguese fleet in 1549, holding Pasni and Gwadar until captured by the Portuguese in 1581, dying in captivity as the towns were sacked. In the seventeenth century the Gichki nawabs, of Rajput convert descent, held Makran as a loose tribal principality, while Gwadar passed to Oman.
zh:
莫克兰是俾路支斯坦南部濒临阿曼湾的干旱海岸地带。古代这里是阿契美尼德王朝的马卡行省；公元前304年塞琉古将它割让给旃陀罗笈多·孔雀，262年沙普尔一世把莫库兰列为萨珊帝国行省。643至644年阿拉伯人经莫克兰战役征服海岸时，奉佛教和印度教的王公仍据有部分地区，它成为哈里发帝国最东的边地。

马丹尼德王朝于10至11世纪在此立国，971年白益王朝军队攻占提兹。到14世纪，海岸掌握在霍特（又称卡尔马提）一支的俾路支统治者手中。

其中最著名的苏丹哈马尔·吉安德1549年歼灭一支葡萄牙舰队，坚守伯斯尼和瓜达尔，1581年被葡萄牙人俘虏，死于囚中，城镇遭洗劫。17世纪，拉杰普特改宗者后裔的吉奇基纳瓦布家族把莫克兰维持为松散的部落邦国，瓜达尔后来落入阿曼之手。

en:
The Munakata were an ancient family of Chikuzen who governed the Munakata district and served its great shrine. Munakata Ujisada, lord of Tsurugatake Castle, became chief priest in 1552 after a succession struggle. He shifted between the Ōtomo and Mōri as they fought for northern Kyushu.

Ujisada recovered his lands with Mōri support in 1560 and surrendered to the Ōtomo in 1569. He died in 1586 after another struggle with the Ōtomo commander Tachibana Dōsetsu. Toyotomi Hideyoshi's conquest of Kyushu brought confiscation of the old Munakata domain.
zh:
宗像氏是筑前国的古老家族，统治宗像地区并侍奉宗像大社。筑岳城主宗像氏贞在继承之争后，于1552年出任大宫司。在大友氏与毛利氏争夺北九州时，他曾先后依附两家。

氏贞于1560年在毛利氏支援下收复领地，1569年向大友氏投降。此后他又与大友家的立花道雪交战，1586年去世。丰臣秀吉征服九州后，宗像氏的旧领遭到没收。

en:
The Makua are Bantu-speaking peoples of northern Mozambique, north of the Zambezi. Their oral traditions place their ancestral home at Mount Namuli, and Portuguese visitors described their trade and skills in the early 1500s.

Makua communities worked iron and exchanged food and metal goods for textiles and salt. From 1749 they fought a prolonged struggle against coastal rulers, the Portuguese and other groups involved in the slave trade.
zh:
马夸人是莫桑比克北部、赞比西河以北讲班图语的族群。口述传统将他们的祖居地置于纳穆利山，16世纪初到来的葡萄牙人记载了他们的贸易和技艺。

马夸社群冶炼铁器，以粮食和金属制品换取纺织品与盐。从1749年起，他们与参与奴隶贸易的沿海统治者、葡萄牙人及其他群体展开长期斗争。

en: The Merkewan were a Kurdish tribal chiefdom centered on Oshnaviyeh, medieval Ushnu south of Lake Urmia. Long Hadhabani Kurdish pasture and held by the Iva'iya clan in the thirteenth century, the district was ruled by Merkewan chiefs as Jalayirid vassals in 1337 and later joined the Mukriyan principality.
zh: 梅尔克万人是以奥什纳维耶（中世纪称乌什努）为中心的库尔德部落酋长政权，地当乌尔米耶湖以南。这里长期是哈兹巴尼库尔德人的牧场，13世纪由伊瓦亚氏族据有；1337年梅尔克万首领作为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸统治该地，后来并入穆克里扬埃米尔国。

en:
Kangleipak was the Meitei kingdom in the Imphal valley on the frontier between India and Burma. Meitei tradition traces the Ningthouja dynasty to King Pakhangba in the first century, with Kangla as its royal seat, and tells how the rulers of Imphal absorbed surrounding clan principalities. Under King Loiyumba in the early twelfth century it received its first written code.

In 1337 the throne belonged to Telheipa, whose reign the royal chronicle fills with campaigns against the hill and valley clans. Under King Kiyamba, from 1467 to 1507, Brahmins settled at court and a sacred stone from the Shan kingdom of Pong was worshipped as Vishnu, opening the way to Vaishnavism.

King Pamheiba, called Gharib Niwaz, ruled from 1709 to 1748, renamed it Manipur, and in 1729 had the Sanamahi scriptures burned, imposing Hinduism. Burmese armies held the kingdom from 1819 to 1826, and from 1824 it was a British East India Company protectorate.
zh:
刚莱博是印度与缅甸之间英帕尔河谷中的梅泰人王国。梅泰传统把宁托贾王朝追溯到1世纪的帕康巴王，以康拉为王都，并讲述英帕尔的统治者如何兼并周围的氏族邦国。12世纪初洛伊雍巴王在位时，王国有了第一部成文法典。

1337年在位的是特尔黑帕，王室编年史记载他连年对山地与河谷诸氏族用兵。1467至1507年基亚姆巴王在位时，婆罗门定居宫廷，一块从掸人蓬国带来的圣石被当作毗湿奴崇拜，为毗湿奴信仰打开道路。

帕姆海巴王（又称加里布·尼瓦兹）1709至1748年在位，将国名改为曼尼普尔，1729年下令焚毁萨那玛依教圣典，强制推行印度教。1819至1826年缅甸军队占领王国，1824年起它成为英国东印度公司的保护国。

en:
Malacca was a Malay sultanate based at the port of Malacca on the Malay Peninsula. Around 1400 Parameswara, the last ruler of Singapura, founded a settlement there after fleeing his island kingdom. The port became a major centre of trade, Islamic learning and the spread of Malay language and literature.

At its fifteenth-century height, the sultanate controlled much of the peninsula, the Riau Islands and part of eastern Sumatra. The Portuguese captured Malacca in 1511, and Sultan Mahmud Shah retreated south; his descendants founded the ruling dynasties of Johor and Perak.
zh:
马六甲是以马来半岛马六甲港为中心的马来苏丹国。约1400年，新加坡王国末代国王拜里米苏拉逃离岛上的王国后，在此建立定居点。这个港口发展为贸易、伊斯兰学术以及马来语和文学传播的重要中心。

苏丹国在15世纪鼎盛时控制了马来半岛大部、廖内群岛和苏门答腊东部的一部分。1511年葡萄牙人攻占马六甲，苏丹马末沙向南撤退；他的后裔建立了柔佛和霹雳的统治王朝。

en:
Mile takes its name from the Mile tribe, a branch of the Xiemotu Yi, whose chief called Mile settled the basins of Guodian, Badian and Bulong.

Under early Mongol rule the tribe passed through the Luomeng Ten-Thousand-Household before being organised in 1290 as Mile Department under Guangxi Route. The Ming kept it under Guangxi Prefecture from 1382; rebels rose in 1389 and Shibazhai chiefs revolted under the Zhengde reign before troops pacified them. A walled department seat was built at Badian in 1490 and brick-faced in 1572.

In 1631 rebels from Ami captured the department, and in 1668 the Shibazhai guard thousand-household was merged into it. In 1770, when Guangxi Prefecture was reduced to an independent department, Mile was itself downgraded to a county.
zh:
弥勒得名于弥勒部：它是些莫徒蛮的一支，其首领弥勒率部占据郭甸、巴甸、部笼等地而居。

元初该部先隶属落蒙万户府，1290年改置弥勒州，隶广西路。明代自1382年起沿置弥勒州，隶广西府；1389年叛军作乱，正德年间十八寨酋长又反，均被官军讨平。1490年在八甸修筑土城，1572年包砌砖石。

1631年阿迷的叛军攻陷弥勒州，1668年十八寨守御千户所被裁并入州。1770年广西府降为广西直隶州，弥勒州也随之降为弥勒县。

en:
Malong is a highland basin between Kunming and Qujing, on the old road leading into central Yunnan. The Han set up Tonglai County here in 109 BC, and under Nanzhao the area was known as Qu'e Chuan.

In the later Dali period its people were organised as the Nagou, one of the thirty-seven tribes of eastern Yunnan under Shicheng Commandery. After the Mongol conquest the Nagou became a thousand-household formation under the Moma command, and in 1276 it was made Malong Subprefecture of Qujing Route, with Tongquan County attached.

The county was merged back into the subprefecture in 1382, when the Ming reorganised the region under Qujing Prefecture. From 1432 to 1476 Malong was briefly transferred to Rende Prefecture, then returned to Qujing, under which it remained a subprefecture throughout the Qing.
zh:
马龙是昆明与曲靖之间的高原盆地，扼守进入滇中的古道。公元前109年汉朝在此设铜濑县，南诏时称曲轭川。

大理国后期，当地部众称纳垢部，是石城郡下辖的滇东三十七部之一。蒙古征服后，纳垢被编为磨弥万户府治下的千户所，1276年改置马龙州，领通泉县，隶属曲靖路。

1382年明朝整顿滇东建制，通泉县并入马龙州，改属曲靖府。1432年至1476年间，马龙州曾短暂改隶仁德府，之后复归曲靖府，清代仍为其下辖的州。

en:
Mühlhausen, on the Unstrut in the Thuringian Basin, was first mentioned in 967, when Emperor Otto II granted the estate to his wife. Its imperial palace hosted German kings down to the eleventh century, and in 1198 the newly elected Philip of Swabia received homage there.

By the mid-thirteenth century Mühlhausen had become a free imperial city and joined the Hanseatic League in 1286; textiles and woad brought it a late-medieval heyday. In 1349 its Jewish community perished in the Black Death persecutions.

After the preaching of Heinrich Pfeiffer and Thomas Müntzer, the council was overthrown during the Peasants' War in 1525, and after the rising was crushed Müntzer was beheaded and the city fined forty thousand guilders. It kept Catholicism until the Reformation was imposed by force in 1542. The Thirty Years' War brought decline, and in 1803 it was assigned to Prussia, with an interlude in Westphalia from 1807 to 1815.
zh:
米尔豪森位于图林根盆地的翁施特鲁特河畔，最早见于967年的记载，当时皇帝奥托二世把这片领地赐给妻子。皇宫在11世纪以前一直接待德意志国王，1198年新当选的施瓦本的菲利普在此接受效忠。

13世纪中叶，米尔豪森成为帝国自由城市，1286年加入汉萨同盟；纺织品和菘蓝贸易带来中世纪晚期的鼎盛。1349年，当地犹太社区在黑死病排犹浪潮中被毁。

海因里希·普法伊弗和托马斯·闵采尔布道后，市议会在1525年农民战争中被推翻；起义被镇压后，闵采尔被斩首，城市被罚四万盾。它一度坚持天主教，直到1542年宗教改革被强制推行。三十年战争开启了它的衰落，1803年它被划归普鲁士，1807至1815年间又改属威斯特伐利亚王国。

en:
Malindi was a Swahili port northeast of Mombasa on the Kenyan coast, a kingdom taking shape around the ninth century. Its first town, founded about 850, was destroyed around 1000, and the present site prospered again from the thirteenth century.

Rivaling Mombasa, it grew rich from Indian Ocean trade, and in 1414 Zheng He's fleet visited, taking a Malindian envoy and a giraffe to the Ming court. In 1498 Vasco da Gama was welcomed by its sultan, hired a pilot for India and set up a stone padrão, the Vasco da Gama Pillar.

Malindi became Portugal's closest East African ally: a factory opened in 1502, and its forces joined the Portuguese assaults of 1505. It flourished as a center of Portuguese activity until 1593, when the Portuguese and the sheikh's court moved to Mombasa. The old town withered; by the 1820s an Admiralty survey found only the pillar standing above the ruins.
zh:
马林迪是肯尼亚沿海、蒙巴萨东北的斯瓦希里港口，其王国约在9世纪成形。最早的城镇建于850年前后，约1000年被毁，现址从13世纪起再度繁荣。

它与蒙巴萨争雄，靠印度洋贸易致富。1414年郑和的船队到访此城，马林迪使者带着一只长颈鹿随船队前往明朝宫廷。1498年瓦斯科·达伽马受到苏丹热情接待，在此雇请前往印度的领航员，并立下石制标柱“瓦斯科·达伽马石柱”。

马林迪成为葡萄牙在东非最亲密的盟友：1502年设立商馆，其军队参与了1505年葡萄牙人的攻势。它作为葡萄牙活动中心兴盛到1593年，随后葡萄牙人和谢赫的宫廷迁往蒙巴萨。旧城随之凋敝，到19世纪20年代，英国海军部的测量发现废墟之上只剩那根石柱。

en:
Molokaʻi is the fifth largest of the eight Hawaiian Islands, southeast of Oʻahu across the Kaʻiwi Channel and north of Lānaʻi. Polynesian voyagers settled it in the thirteenth century, and its people lived under the kapu system, ruled by a high chief, the aliʻi nui, claiming descent from the sky father Wākea.

The island never matched its neighbours in power, its influence resting on marriage ties and the fame of its priests, the kahuna, and Oʻahu's kings held hegemony over it more than once. From the late seventeenth century Maui and Oʻahu repeatedly struck it, and it was fully under Maui before European contact.

Captain James Cook sighted it in 1778 and George Dixon made the first recorded landing in 1786. In 1795 Kamehameha I's victory at the Battle of Nuʻuanu brought Molokaʻi into the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi.
zh:
莫洛卡伊是夏威夷八大岛中的第五大岛，隔凯维海峡在瓦胡东南、拉奈以北。波利尼西亚航海者在13世纪定居于此，岛民在卡普禁忌制度下生活，由号称天神瓦凯亚后裔的最高酋长阿利伊努伊统治。

莫洛卡伊实力不及邻岛，其影响靠联姻和祭司卡胡纳的名望维系，瓦胡诸王还曾多次控制它。17世纪末起，莫洛卡伊屡遭毛伊和瓦胡的统治者攻伐，到欧洲人接触的时代之前，它已完全并入毛伊。

1778年库克船长望见该岛，1786年乔治·迪克森首次有记录地登岛。1795年卡美哈梅哈一世在努阿努山谷之战获胜，莫洛卡伊并入新生的夏威夷王国。

en:
The Kingdom of Mallorca was founded on the Balearic Islands, conquered from the Almohad Caliphate by James I of Aragon and granted in 1276 to his younger son James II. It also held the mainland counties of Roussillon and Cerdanya, but from 1279 its king was a vassal of Aragon.

Alfonso III of Aragon occupied the islands in 1286, until a treaty returned them to James II. James's son Sancho, reigning from 1324, named the Aragonese kings his heirs in 1325, and the trade war with Genoa from 1329 to 1336 deepened the kingdom's financial troubles.
