In 1337 the crown belonged to James III.

James III lost the Balearics to Peter IV of Aragon in 1343 and Roussillon and Cerdanya in 1344, his attempted reconquest ending in his death at Llucmajor in 1349. Mallorca remained in personal union with Aragon until the Nueva Planta decrees dissolved it in 1715.
zh:
马略卡王国建立在巴利阿里群岛之上：阿拉贡的海梅一世从阿尔摩哈德哈里发国手中征服这些岛屿，1276年封给幼子海梅二世。新王国还领有大陆上的鲁西永、塞尔达尼亚两伯国，但1279年起马略卡国王须向阿拉贡称臣。

1286年阿拉贡的阿方索三世占领群岛，后依条约把岛屿归还海梅二世。海梅之子桑乔1324年即位，1325年指定阿拉贡国王为继承人，1329至1336年与热那亚的贸易战又加深了财政困境。1337年在位的是海梅三世。

海梅三世于1343年被阿拉贡的佩德罗四世夺去巴利阿里，1344年又丢了鲁西永和塞尔达尼亚；他试图复国，1349年在柳克马约尔兵败身亡。此后马略卡与阿拉贡保持君合关系，直到1715年《新基本法令》将其废止。

en:
Mong Lem, called Menglian in Chinese, was a Tai Nüa state in the hills of southwestern Yunnan, ruled by saopha princes from Mùlián. The Yuan dynasty set it up as a tusi, or native chieftaincy, in 1289, and it was counted among the Koshanpye, the Nine Shan States.

In 1348 it was swallowed by neighboring Möng Mao, known to the Chinese as Luchuan, and remained under its shadow through the early Ming. The Ming re-established the territory as the Menglian Chief's Office in 1406, covering the old Mulian circuit and lands east of the Salween.

After a mid-sixteenth-century abolition it was restored in 1585, submitted to the Qing in 1662, and was raised to Xuanfu Si rank in 1709. For much of its history it sent tribute to both the Chinese court and the kings of Burma.
zh:
孟连，汉文作孟琏，是云南西南山区的傣那人邦国，由诏法家族以木连为治所统治。元朝于1289年将其设为土司，也是汉文记载中“九掸邦”之一。

1348年，它被邻邦勐卯（汉文称麓川）吞并，在明代初年一直处于麓川势力影响之下。1406年，明朝重新设立孟琏长官司，辖境包括旧木连路和萨尔温江以东的土地。

该司在16世纪中期一度被废，1585年恢复；1662年归附清朝，1709年升格为孟连宣抚司。在历史上的大部分时间里，它同时向中国朝廷和缅甸国王两边进贡。

en:
Malinalco was a Matlatzinca town in the warm hills south of the Toluca Valley, its Nahuatl name drawn from the malinalli grass and associated with the goddess Malinalxochitl. The Matlatzinca counted it among their ceremonial centres alongside Calixtlahuaca. Malinalco was later held by a Culhua group under the lord Cuauhtepexpetlatzin.

In 1476 the Aztec tlatoani Axayacatl conquered the Matlatzinca lands and Malinalco passed to Tenochtitlan. Between about 1486 and 1490 his successor Ahuitzotl had stonemasons brought from Tenochtitlan carve a sanctuary for the Eagle and Jaguar warriors directly into the rock of the Hill of the Idols, the building called Cuauhcalli; the work, built largely with forced labour, was unfinished when the Spaniards reached the valley.

After the night of Sorrows in 1520 the town rose in revolt. Andrés de Tapia was sent to subdue it together with the people of Ocuilan.
zh:
马利纳尔科是托卢卡谷地以南温暖丘陵中的马特拉钦卡人城镇，纳瓦特尔语名字来自马利纳尔利草，并与女神马利纳尔索奇特尔有关。马特拉钦卡人把它与卡利斯特拉瓦卡并列为祭祀中心之一，后来由首领夸乌特佩什佩特拉丁率领的库尔瓦人集团统治。

1476年，阿兹特克特拉托阿尼阿哈雅卡特尔征服马特拉钦卡人的土地，马利纳尔科改归特诺奇蒂特兰。约1486至1490年间，继位的阿维索特尔从特诺奇蒂特兰调来石匠，在偶像山的岩壁上直接开凿鹰战士与豹战士的圣所“鹰之屋”，工程大量使用强制劳役，西班牙人抵达谷地时仍未完工。

1520年“悲痛之夜”后，马利纳尔科起兵反抗。安德烈斯·德·塔皮亚奉命联合奥奎兰人将其镇压。

en:
Milan is a city on the northern Italian plain. As a twelfth-century commune it led the Lombard League against Emperor Frederick I; in 1277 Archbishop Ottone Visconti defeated the Della Torre, beginning Visconti rule. In 1337 Azzo Visconti held it, having bought the imperial vicar title; Gian Galeazzo Visconti united family lands by coup in 1385 and became Duke of Milan in 1395, ruling twenty-six towns.

Filippo Maria Visconti died without a male heir in 1447 and the city proclaimed the Golden Ambrosian Republic, but the condottiere Francesco Sforza, husband of Visconti's daughter Bianca Maria, took power in 1450, founding the Sforza dynasty recognized at the 1454 Peace of Lodi. Ludovico Sforza's invitation to Charles VIII helped open the Italian Wars in 1494; Louis XII conquered Milan in 1499, and after decades of intervention the last Sforza, Francesco II, died heirless in 1535.

The duchy passed to Habsburg Spain and in 1707 to Austria. Napoleon's 1796 campaign ended the duchy, which was merged into the Cisalpine Republic by the Treaty of Campo Formio in 1797.
zh:
米兰是意大利北部平原上的城市。12世纪的自治市镇曾领导伦巴第同盟对抗皇帝腓特烈一世，1277年大主教奥托内·维斯孔蒂击败德拉·托雷家族，开启维斯孔蒂家族的统治。1337年阿佐·维斯孔蒂执掌米兰，购得帝国代理人头衔；吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂1385年以政变统一家族领地，1395年成为米兰公爵，领有26座城镇。

1447年菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂无男嗣而终，米兰宣布成立金色安布罗修共和国，但维斯孔蒂之女比安卡·玛丽亚的丈夫、雇佣兵首领弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎1450年夺权，建立斯福尔扎王朝，1454年《洛迪和约》予以承认。卢多维科·斯福尔扎引法王查理八世入意大利，促成1494年意大利战争爆发；路易十二1499年征服米兰，经过数十年外力拉锯，末代斯福尔扎弗朗切斯科二世1535年无嗣而终。

公国随后归入西班牙哈布斯堡，1707年转归奥地利。拿破仑1796年的进军终结公国，1797年《坎波福尔米奥条约》将其并入奇萨尔皮尼共和国。

en:
The Wolastokwewiyik were an Algonquian-speaking people of the Saint John River valley, in present-day New Brunswick, Quebec and Maine. They belonged to the Wabanaki Confederacy and grew maize, beans and squash alongside fishing and hunting.

In the seventeenth century French traders exchanged furs with them, and their main settlement shifted upriver to Meductic. In 1776 the Houlton band became treaty allies of the United States.
zh:
沃拉斯托基维克人是圣约翰河流域说阿尔冈昆语的族群，居住地位于今新不伦瑞克、魁北克和缅因州。他们属于瓦巴纳基联盟，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，也从事渔猎。

17世纪，法国商人与他们交换毛皮，他们的主要聚居地迁往上游的梅达克蒂克。1776年，霍尔顿部众与美国缔约结盟。

en:
Malacato was the land of the Malacatos, one of the Palta chiefdoms of the Loja highlands in southern Ecuador. Their settlements climbed the flanks of the Sabanilla knot, on the route by which Palta groups had migrated out of the Amazon, and spread through the upper Catamayo valley and the valley they called Piscobamba, around the modern town of Vilcabamba, next to the country of the Bracamoros.

Like the other Palta peoples they were maize farmers ruled by local curacas within a loose confederation whose meeting place was the Cuxibamba valley. They took part in fierce resistance to the conquests of Tupac Inca Yupanqui, the Sapa Inca from 1471 to 1493.

After the Inca victory the old organization was dismantled, Spanish rule later completed its breakup, and the Palta language survived only in a handful of recorded words.
zh:
马拉卡托是马拉卡托人的土地，为厄瓜多尔南部洛哈高地的帕勒塔酋长邦之一。他们的村落分布在萨瓦尼利亚山结两侧，即帕勒塔诸族迁出亚马孙所走的通道，并延伸到卡塔马约河上游和他们称作皮斯科班巴的河谷，即今比尔卡班巴一带，与布拉卡莫罗斯人的土地相邻。

和其他帕勒塔族群一样，他们种植玉米，由本地酋长库拉卡统领，加入以库西班巴河谷为会盟地的松散联盟。他们激烈抵抗过图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的征服，这位萨帕·印卡1471年至1493年在位。

印加获胜后旧有组织被拆散，随后的西班牙统治最终使酋长邦瓦解，帕勒塔语只留下零星记录的词语。

en:
Möng Mao, or Luchuan, was a Tai state in the Nam Mao, or Ruili, river basin on the Yunnan-Myanmar border, flourishing from the fourteenth to the fifteenth century. Under Si Kefa, who built the capital Selan around 1335, his brother conquered Assam and power reached across upper Burma's Tai states; raids from 1359 helped topple Sagaing and Pinya, which fell in 1364 and opened Ava's rise. Si Kefa died in 1369.

When Ming armies entered Yunnan in 1382, the ruler Si Lunfa submitted and accepted a tusi commission, but his attacks on defecting chiefdoms brought Ming expeditions that defeated him at Dingbian in 1388, forcing his surrender. The 1397 Dao Ganmeng rebellion deposed him, and Ming help restored him; after his death Ming split Möng Mao into five chieftaincies.

Si Renfa's bid to restore the realm after 1437 drew the Luchuan-Pingmian campaigns of 1436 to 1449, defeating the Si family, who retreated to Möng Yang and left a divided Shan frontier where Toungoo later rose.
zh:
勐卯又称麓川，是云南与缅甸交界瑞丽江盆地的傣族掸人国家，兴盛于14至15世纪。思可法约1335年修建都城色兰；他在位时，其弟西征阿萨姆，势力横扫上缅甸诸掸邦。1359年起勐卯连年出兵，实皆和彬牙两王国1364年覆灭，为阿瓦王国的兴起铺平道路。思可法1369年去世。

1382年明军进入云南，君主思伦发归降并接受土司封号，但他攻打倒向明朝的属部，招致明军征讨，1388年在定边战败投降。1397年刀干孟之乱将他废黜，明朝援兵助他复位；他死后，明朝把勐卯拆分为五个土司。

1437年以后思任发试图重建旧疆，引来1436—1449年的麓川之役，思氏战败退守孟养，留下群雄并立的掸邦边地，东吁日后在此崛起。

en:
The Momonoi were a branch of the Ashikaga warrior family, named for Momonoi in Kōzuke Province. Members fought on opposing sides during Japan's Northern and Southern Courts wars.

Momonoi Tadatsune became governor of Etchū in 1344 and supported Ashikaga Tadayoshi against his brother Takauji. In 1355 he helped seize Kyoto for Ashikaga Tadafuyu, but was driven out; defeat at Nagasawa in 1370 cost him his base in Etchū.
zh:
桃井氏是足利武家的支族，以上野国的桃井为名。日本南北朝战争期间，桃井一族分属对立的阵营。

桃井直常于1344年出任越中守护，支持足利直义对抗其兄尊氏。1355年，他协助足利直冬夺取京都，随后被逐；1370年长泽之战的败北使他失去了越中的根据地。

en:
The Mam are a Maya people of the western Guatemalan highlands, around the Sierra de los Cuchumatanes and the modern city of Huehuetenango; Quetzaltenango was originally a Mam town. Their Postclassic kingdom had its capital at Zaculeu, known in Mam as Chinabajul, a fortified plateau city above the Selegua River whose name means white earth.

Settled from the Early Classic around the third century and shaped by Teotihuacán influence, it grew into the main Mam stronghold. The expanding K'iche' kingdom conquered it in the Postclassic: tradition places this in the fifteenth century, though radiocarbon work suggests as early as the twelfth. K'iche' king Q'uq'umatz died fighting the northern Mam before his son K'iq'ab completed their subjection.

In 1525 Gonzalo de Alvarado y Contreras besieged the city for months. Its last king Kayb'il B'alam, starved out, surrendered to the Spanish.
zh:
玛姆人是危地马拉西部高地的玛雅民族，聚居于库丘马塔内斯山脉一带和今韦韦特南戈城附近；克萨尔特南戈最初就是玛姆人的城镇。他们后古典期王国的都城是萨库莱乌，玛姆语称奇纳巴胡尔，城名意为“白土”，是塞莱瓜河畔一座设防的高原城。

该城约自3世纪的古典早期即有人居，建筑受特奥蒂瓦坎影响，后来成为玛姆人的主要堡垒。扩张中的基切王国在后古典期征服了它：传统说法定于15世纪，放射性碳定年则可能早至12世纪。基切国王库库马茨在与北方玛姆人作战时阵亡，其子基卡布最终完成征服。

1525年，贡萨洛·德·阿尔瓦拉多·伊·孔特雷拉斯围攻萨库莱乌数月。末代国王凯比尔·巴拉姆粮尽，向西班牙人投降。

en: The Mamaceqtaw, also called Menominee, were an Indigenous people of present-day Wisconsin and Michigan's Upper Peninsula. Wild rice and sturgeon were important foods, and French traders visited their villages for furs in the seventeenth century. Under treaties with the United States in 1831 and 1836, the Mamaceqtaw ceded extensive lands in Wisconsin.
zh: 马马切陶人又称梅诺米尼人，是今威斯康星州和密歇根州上半岛的原住民。菰米和鲟鱼是他们的重要食物，17世纪法国商人到他们的村落进行毛皮贸易。根据1831年和1836年与美国签订的条约，马马切陶人割让了威斯康星的大量土地。

en:
Maynila was a fortified Tagalog bayan on the south bank of the Pasig River, on the site of later Intramuros in Manila, facing Tondo across the delta. Oral tradition dates its founding as a Muslim settlement to the 1250s, and Muslim burials near the Pasig show Islam reaching the area by the late twelfth century.

Its rulers bore the Malay title of raja and kept close marriage ties with Brunei, notably Rajah Salalila and his son Rajah Matanda. With Tondo it shared a duopoly over the Chinese trade in the archipelago: junks unloaded at Tondo while Maynila's fleets retailed goods to other islands.

By 1570 the elderly Rajah Matanda ruled it jointly with the younger Rajah Sulayman. That May Martin de Goiti stormed it and burned its wooden palisade, and in June 1571 Miguel López de Legazpi proclaimed the Spanish city of Manila on its ruins, ending its independence.
zh:
马尼拉是帕西格河南岸设防的他加禄城邦，位于后来马尼拉王城区一带，与三角洲对岸的汤都隔河相望。口传传统称它在13世纪50年代作为穆斯林定居点建立，帕西格河附近的穆斯林墓葬表明伊斯兰教在12世纪末已传入此地。

它的统治者使用马来称号“拉惹”，与文莱保持密切联姻，著名的有拉惹·萨拉利拉及其子拉惹·马坦达。马尼拉与汤都垄断了群岛内的中国贸易：中国商船在汤都卸货，再由马尼拉的船队转销各岛。

1570年，它由年老的拉惹·马坦达和较年轻的拉惹·苏莱曼共同统治。同年5月，马丁·德·戈伊蒂攻占并焚毁了它的木栅城寨；1571年6月，米格尔·洛佩斯·德·黎牙实比在其废墟上宣布建立西班牙人的马尼拉城，独立政权就此终结。

en:
Menabe was a Sakalava kingdom founded before 1600 along the Morondava River in western Madagascar. Under Andriandahifotsy, who ruled in the seventeenth century, it expanded into the strongest kingdom on the island by the mid-eighteenth century.

Merina king Radama I invaded Menabe in 1820, 1821 and 1822. King Ramitraho sought peace through the marriage of his daughter Rasalimo to Radama, but the Merina conquered southern Menabe in 1834 after Ramitraho's death.
zh:
梅纳贝是马达加斯加西部的萨卡拉瓦王国，1600年以前建立于穆龙达瓦河沿岸。17世纪在位的安德里安达希富齐扩张了王国，到18世纪中叶，梅纳贝成为岛上最强大的王国。

梅里纳国王拉达马一世于1820年、1821年和1822年入侵梅纳贝。国王拉米特拉胡将女儿拉萨利穆嫁给拉达马以求和平，但拉米特拉胡死后，梅里纳人在1834年征服了梅纳贝南部。

en:
The Monacan were a Siouan-speaking people of Virginia's Piedmont, with their principal town at Rassawek near the junction of the James and Rivanna rivers. They competed with the Powhatan confederacy of the coastal plain.

In 1608 Christopher Newport led English settlers up the James into Monacan territory and visited two towns. Monacan settlements were still occupied in 1670, but a village above the James falls had been abandoned by the eighteenth century and its land granted to Huguenot settlers.
zh:
莫纳坎是弗吉尼亚皮德蒙特地区讲苏语的民族，主要城镇拉萨韦克位于詹姆斯河与里凡纳河交汇处附近。他们与沿海平原的波瓦坦联盟相互争夺地盘。

1608年，克里斯托弗·纽波特率英国殖民者沿詹姆斯河进入莫纳坎领地，访问了两座城镇。1670年莫纳坎的聚落仍有人居住，但到18世纪，詹姆斯河瀑布上游的一座村落已被废弃，其土地被授予胡格诺派移民。

en:
Mondovì is a hill town of southern Piedmont. It was founded in 1198, when survivors of a destroyed village and peasants from neighboring valleys gathered on Monte Regale to form an independent commune.

Asti's bishop and the marquis of Ceva stormed it in 1200 and destroyed it in 1231, but it rebuilt, and in 1260 Charles I of Anjou occupied it. It returned to Asti's bishops in 1274, bought its freedom in 1290 as Mons Regalis and fell to the Angevins in 1305; in 1337 it was held in King Robert of Naples' name.

Lords changed rapidly until the House of Savoy kept it from 1418. By the sixteenth century Mondovì was Piedmont's largest city; Piedmont's first printing press opened there in 1472 and its first university in 1560. French occupation from 1537 ended in 1559, and Emmanuel Philibert restored the town to Savoy in 1560.
zh:
蒙多维是皮埃蒙特南部的山城。1198年，一座被毁村庄的幸存者与邻近山谷的农民聚集在雷加莱山，组成独立市镇。

阿斯蒂主教和切瓦侯爵于1200年攻破此城，1231年又将其摧毁，但市镇得以重建；1260年安茹的查理一世占领此城。1274年它重归阿斯蒂主教，1290年以“雷亚利斯山”之名赎买自治权，1305年再度落入安茹家族之手，1337年它以那不勒斯国王罗伯特的名义受领。

此后领主更迭频繁，1418年起由萨伏依家族稳定领有。到16世纪，蒙多维已是皮埃蒙特最大的城市；皮埃蒙特第一家印刷所1472年在此开设，第一所大学1560年建立。1537年起的法国占领于1559年结束，埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托于1560年将该城归还萨伏依。

en:
The Yao, whose major branches included the Mien, lived in the mountains of southern China. Local chiefs collected tribute under imperial rule, but Ming and Qing officials increasingly took over direct tax collection.

Yao and Zhuang communities rebelled in the Great Rattan Gorge region of Guangxi and Guangdong. The Ming sent Han Yong against them in 1465 and Wang Shouren in 1528; warfare also drove Yao communities farther south, with some migrating into Southeast Asia.
zh:
瑶人居住在中国南方山区，勉人是其主要支系之一。地方首领曾在帝国统治下征收贡赋，明清官员后来逐渐接手直接征税。

广西、广东大藤峡一带的瑶人和壮人曾起义，明廷于1465年派韩雍、1528年派王守仁前往征讨。战乱也促使瑶人继续向南迁徙，一部分人进入东南亚。

en:
The Ming was a Chinese imperial dynasty founded by Zhu Yuanzhang, a former Red Turban rebel who captured Nanjing in 1356. He proclaimed the dynasty in 1368 and drove the Yuan court from Dadu. In 1402 his son Zhu Di seized the throne as the Yongle Emperor, built the Forbidden City in Beijing and sent Zheng He on voyages across the Indian Ocean.

In 1644 Li Zicheng's rebels captured Beijing, ending Ming rule there. Princes of the dynasty continued to resist the Qing in southern China until 1662.
zh:
明是朱元璋建立的中国王朝。朱元璋出身红巾军，于1356年攻占南京，1368年建立明朝并将元朝廷逐出大都。1402年，他的儿子朱棣夺取皇位，是为永乐帝；他在北京建造紫禁城，并派郑和远航印度洋。

1644年，李自成的起义军攻入北京，结束了明朝在北京的统治。明朝宗室在中国南方继续抵抗清朝，直到1662年。

en:
Möng Nai, also called Mone with the ritual name Saturambha, was an eastern Southern Shan state ruled from Möng Nai. Its origins are disputed: Shan histories say Sam Long Hpa of Möng Kawng conquered it in 1223 and installed a branch of the Möng Mi line as tributary rulers of Möng Mao, while Northern Thai chronicles claim it was founded in 1318 by a son of King Mangrai and thereafter owed allegiance to Lan Na.

In the sixteenth century it joined the Shan confederation that rallied after Ava's fall, and its saopha marched with Möng Yang and Hsipaw against the Toungoo dynasty until Bayinnaung overran the Shan country in 1556 and 1557.

In later centuries the state controlled the subordinate chiefdoms of Kengtawng and Kenghkam, and its rulers bore the Burmese title myoza rather than the higher saopha rank.
zh:
孟乃又称孟尼，礼仪性国名为萨图朗巴，是南掸邦东部的掸人邦国，以孟乃城为治所。其起源说法不一：掸文史籍称孟拱的三隆帕于1223年征服此地，安排旧孟弥支系的一支作为麓川的附庸统治者；泰北编年史则称它由芒莱王之子建于1318年，此后向兰纳称臣。

16世纪时，孟乃加入阿瓦陷落后各掸邦组成的联盟，其诏法与孟养、昔卜联手对抗东吁王朝，直到勃印曩在1556至1557年横扫掸地。

后来的几个世纪里，该邦控制着肯通和肯坎两个附属酋邦，其统治者改用缅甸的“谬沙”头衔，等级低于诏法。

en:
Manjung is the later name for the Dindings coast of Perak, the stretch of the western Malay Peninsula running from the Dinding River to the estuary of the Klang. Its northern shores were part of the old Hindu Malay kingdom of Gangga Negara, while the port of Klang commanded a river mouth leading into the tin-rich interior.

A bronze Klang Bell from around the turn of the era shows how early this coast joined the bay's trade networks, and in 1365 the Nagarakretagama counted Klang among the tributary lands claimed by Majapahit. In the fifteenth century the coast passed under the Malacca Sultanate, whose bendahara Tun Perak began his career at Klang.

After Malacca fell to the Portuguese in 1511 the ports acknowledged Johor, until Bugis settlers built the Sultanate of Selangor around them in the eighteenth century.
zh:
曼绒是霹雳天定海岸后来的名字，指马来半岛西部从天定河延伸到巴生河口的一带海岸。其北部本是印度教马来古国刚迦的一部分，巴生港则控制着通往产锡内陆的河口要冲。

当地出土的巴生铜钟年代约在纪元前后，说明这片海岸很早便卷入海湾贸易网；1365年的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》把巴生列为满者伯夷声称的朝贡地之一。15世纪，整条海岸归入马六甲苏丹国，盘诃罗敦霹雳早年便在巴生任职。

1511年马六甲被葡萄牙人攻陷后，这些港口转而臣服柔佛，到18世纪，布吉斯人在周围建立了雪兰莪苏丹国。

en:
Mankessim was a Fante political and spiritual centre near the coast of present-day Ghana. Fante traditions recall a migration from the interior under Oburumankoma, Odapagyan and Oson; the sacred grove of Nananom Mpow became a focus of their identity.

In 1624 the Dutch made a treaty with Ambro, the Fante brafo, against the Portuguese. From the 1660s or 1670s leaders from Mankessim founded coastal settlements including Abura and Ekumfi, while Fante power expanded over neighbouring states.
zh:
曼凯西姆是方蒂人的政治与精神中心，位于今加纳海岸附近。方蒂人的传说记载，奥布鲁曼科马、奥达帕吉扬和奥松率众从内陆迁来；纳纳诺姆姆波圣林成为方蒂人认同的中心。

1624年，荷兰人与方蒂布拉福安布罗订约，共同对抗葡萄牙人。从17世纪60或70年代起，曼凯西姆的首领建立了阿布拉和埃库姆菲等沿海聚落，方蒂势力也向邻邦扩张。

en:
Mangalai, or Mangalai Suyah, meaning the sun-facing land, was a small kingdom of the Tarim oases with its capital at Aksu, reaching from Kucha in the east toward Issyk-Kul in the north. Its ruler Babdagan submitted to Genghis Khan between 1224 and 1227, and Chagatai later granted the territory to the Dughlat lord Urtubu, so that through the later thirteenth and early fourteenth centuries it formed part of the Chagatai Khanate.

As khanal power waned, the Dughlat amirs of Mangalai became king-makers: in 1347 Amir Bulaji raised Tughlugh Timur to the khanship of the new Moghulistan.

Aksu then passed back and forth between the Moghul khans and Dughlat princes, who also held Kashgar, Yarkand and Khotan, until Sultan Said Khan's victory of 1514 folded the oases into the Yarkent Khanate, itself overrun by the Dzungars in 1680.
zh:
曼尕赖一称曼尕赖·苏雅，意为向阳之地，是塔里木盆地绿洲上以阿克苏为都的小国，疆域东起库车，北抵伊塞克湖一带。其王巴布达干于1224—1227年间归降成吉思汗，后来察合台把这片领地封给杜格拉特贵族乌尔图布，13世纪后期至14世纪初，曼尕赖是察合台汗国的一部分。

汗权衰落后，曼尕赖的杜格拉特异密成为拥立者：1347年，异密布拉吉扶立秃忽鲁帖木儿为新的蒙兀儿斯坦之汗。

阿克苏此后在蒙兀儿诸汗与杜格拉特王公之间反复转手，后者还据有喀什噶尔、叶尔羌与和阗；1514年赛德汗取胜，把各绿洲并入叶尔羌汗国，叶尔羌汗国又于1680年被准噶尔攻灭。

en:
The Minami were a branch of the Kō family who held Maruki in Ashikaga, Shimotsuke Province, and served the Ashikaga household. Minami Munetsugu followed Ashikaga Takauji east during the Nakasendai Rebellion of 1335 and later served the Muromachi shogunate as governor of Mikawa and Bitchū.

During the Kannō Disturbance, Munetsugu sided with Takauji and Kō no Moronao against Ashikaga Tadayoshi. In 1351 he was sent to Bitchū to hold back the advance of Tadayoshi's adopted son Tadafuyu.
zh:
南氏是高氏的一支，在下野国足利庄领有丸木乡，世代侍奉足利家。1335年中先代之乱时，南宗继随足利尊氏东行，后来在室町幕府担任三河和备中守护。

观应之乱中，宗继支持尊氏和高师直，对抗足利直义。1351年，宗继被派往备中，阻挡直义养子足利直冬东进。

en:
Mann is the heart of the old Norse-Gaelic Kingdom of the Isles, the Sudreyjar of the Viking sagas, which linked the Isle of Man with the Hebrides under Norwegian overlordship. From 1079 the Crovan dynasty of Godred Crovan ruled and established the open-air parliament of Tynwald.

After Norway ceded its rights to Scotland in 1266, the island changed hands repeatedly in the Scottish Wars, where Robert the Bruce stormed Castle Rushen in 1313, before Edward III granted it to William Montagu, who ruled as King of Mann and was made Earl of Salisbury in 1337.

English rule became definitive in 1346, and the lordship passed to the English Crown in 1399. In 1405 the Crown entrusted it to the Stanley family as Lords of Mann. The Atholl dukes who inherited it sold their rights to the Crown under the Act of Revestment of 1765, though Tynwald still governed the island's internal affairs.
zh:
马恩是古老诺斯-盖尔“群岛王国”的核心，即维京萨迦中的苏德里群岛，把马恩岛与赫布里底群岛连在一起，遥奉挪威为宗主。1079年起，戈德雷德·克罗万的克罗万王朝统治此地，设立露天议会廷瓦尔德。

1266年挪威依《珀斯条约》把宗主权让给苏格兰后，马恩在苏格兰战争中反复易手：罗伯特·布鲁斯于1313年攻陷拉申城堡，后来爱德华三世把它赐给威廉·蒙塔古，他以“马恩国王”的身份统治，1337年受封索尔兹伯里伯爵。

英格兰的控制在1346年定型，1399年领主权归于英格兰王室，1405年王室把它托付给斯坦利家族。继承领主之位的阿索尔公爵于1765年依《权力归还法令》把统治权卖回王室，廷瓦尔德仍治理岛务。

en: The Monpa were peoples of the southern Himalayas, including the Tawang region. Tibetan Buddhist influence reached Tawang, where the Gelug Tawang Monastery was founded in 1680–1681.
zh: 门巴人居住在喜马拉雅山南麓，包括达旺地区。藏传佛教的影响传入达旺，格鲁派的达旺寺于1680—1681年建立。

en:
The Monsii, or Munsee, were a northern division of the Lenape, living around the upper Delaware and the western bank of the Hudson. Their council village was Minisink, probably in present-day New Jersey. In 1669 they aided the Esopus against Dutch colonists and were defeated.

After the Walking Purchase of 1737, many Munsee were driven from the Delaware to the Susquehanna and then west to the Ohio. During the American Revolution many Christian Munsee moved to Canada; others joined Stockbridge communities and later migrated toward Wisconsin.
zh:
蒙西人是莱纳佩人的北部分支，居住在特拉华河上游和哈德逊河西岸一带。他们举行议事的村落是米尼辛克，可能位于今新泽西州。1669年，他们协助埃索普斯人对抗荷兰殖民者，遭到击败。

1737年的步行购地后，许多蒙西人被迫从特拉华河迁往萨斯奎哈纳河，再向西迁至俄亥俄河。美国独立战争期间，许多信奉基督教的蒙西人迁往加拿大；另一些人加入斯托克布里奇社群，后来向威斯康星迁徙。

en: Manta was a trading settlement of the Manteño people on the Pacific coast of present-day Ecuador. The Manteño-Huancavilca culture flourished from about 850 to 1600, and its coastal inhabitants cultivated maize and dived for Spondylus shells. These shells circulated in trade as far north as Mexico.
zh: 曼塔是曼塔人在今厄瓜多尔太平洋海岸的贸易聚落。约850—1600年，曼塔—万卡维尔卡文化在当地兴盛，沿海居民种植玉米，潜水采集棘牡蛎贝壳。这些贝壳通过贸易向北流通，远达墨西哥。

en:
The Melanau, who call themselves A-Likou, the river people, are among the oldest settled peoples of the Sarawak coast, living along the lower Rajang and neighbouring rivers from Igan and Mukah to Tutong. Thirteenth-century Chinese records place Igan, Tutong and Bintulu within the trading realm of Po-ni, and the Nagarakretagama of 1365 names Malano among the vassals of Majapahit.

Melanau oral tradition and the Brunei epic remember the chiefs Basiung and Tugau, who ruled from Igan over the Tutong lands; around 1400 Awang Alak Betatar's rising Brunei kingdom marched on Igan and brought the river settlements under its sway.

In 1609 Melanau chiefs joined neighbouring peoples in revolting from Brunei to Sambas, before Brunei reasserted control about 1730. The Melanau traded sago and jungle produce, and their ancient carved burial poles, the jerunei, still recall their early riverine culture.
zh:
梅拉瑙人自称阿利口，意为河上人，是砂拉越海岸最古老的定居族群之一，在下拉让河及邻近河流的伊甘、沐胶至都东一带傍水而居。13世纪的中国文献已把伊甘、都东和民都鲁列入渤泥的贸易范围，1365年的《爪哇史颂》把马拉诺列为满者伯夷的属国。

梅拉瑙口述传统与文莱史诗都记得首领巴雄和图高，他们以伊甘为中心统治都东诸地；约1400年，阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔新兴的文莱王国进军伊甘，把梅拉瑙诸河聚落纳入治下。

1609年，梅拉瑙首领联合邻近族群脱离文莱、转投三发，文莱约在1730年重新确立统治。梅拉瑙人以西米和林产贸易为生，古老的雕刻葬柱哲鲁奈仍可见证其早期河居文化。

en: The Ndau are a people of southeastern Zimbabwe and central Mozambique, including the Chipinge and Chimanimani districts. In the 1820s Nguni armies entered Mozambique, and the Gaza kingdom later subjugated many Ndau communities.
zh: 恩达乌人居住在今津巴布韦东南部和莫桑比克中部，包括奇平盖和奇马尼马尼地区。19世纪20年代，恩古尼军队进入莫桑比克，后来加扎王国征服了许多恩达乌社群。

en:
Minzhou was a border prefecture on the middle Tao River in southern Gansu, around present-day Minxian, Qiang and Di herding land incorporated by the Qin by the seventh century BC. The Western Wei created Minzhou in 544, naming it after the Min Mountains. Tibetan armies took it in 761; Wang Shao's Xihe campaigns of 1073 returned it to Chinese rule.

Under the Yuan it was the seat of the Tuosima route governing Amdo. In 1378 the Ming made it the Minzhou Guard, raised to a military-civilian commission in 1382, where native commanders such as the hereditary Wang clan kept order among Tibetan tribes.

Briefly restored as a department in 1545, it reverted to the guard in 1561. The Qing restored civilian rule in 1730, and it governed the Tao River border country until the end of the imperial period.
zh:
岷州是甘肃南部洮河中游的边州，在今岷县一带，本为羌、狄牧地，公元前7世纪已入秦国版图。544年西魏因境内岷山置岷州。761年吐蕃攻占岷州，1073年王韶熙河之役后才重归中原。

元代为管辖安多的脱思麻路治所。1378年明朝改置岷州卫，1382年升军民指挥使司，汪氏家族等世袭土官在卫任职，管束藏族部落。

1545年一度置州，1561年废州复为军民指挥使司。1730年清廷再改岷州，以民政管辖洮河边地，直至清末。

en:
Modena was the centre of an Este principality in northern Italy. In 1452 Emperor Frederick III made Borso d'Este duke of Modena and Reggio; Borso also ruled neighbouring Ferrara, where he received a ducal title in 1471.

When Alfonso II died in 1597, the papacy seized Ferrara, but his cousin Cesare retained Modena and Reggio as imperial fiefs. Napoleon expelled Duke Ercole III in 1796 and incorporated his lands into the Cispadane Republic. Francis IV of Austria-Este restored ducal rule in 1814 and inherited Massa and Carrara in 1829.
zh:
摩德纳是意大利北部埃斯特家族领地的中心。1452年，皇帝腓特烈三世册封博尔索·德斯特为摩德纳和雷焦公爵；博尔索还统治邻近的费拉拉，并于1471年获得费拉拉公爵头衔。

1597年阿方索二世去世后，教廷夺取费拉拉，但他的堂弟切萨雷保住了作为帝国采邑的摩德纳和雷焦。1796年拿破仑驱逐埃尔科莱三世，将其领地并入奇斯帕达纳共和国。奥地利-埃斯特家族的弗朗切斯科四世于1814年恢复公爵统治，并于1829年继承马萨和卡拉拉。

en:
The Despotate of the Morea was a Byzantine province in the Peloponnese, ruled from Mystras. In 1349 Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos made it an appanage for his son Manuel; the Palaiologos family took over after Manuel died in 1380.

Constantine Palaiologos and his brothers extended Byzantine rule over nearly the whole peninsula by 1430. In 1446 Sultan Murad II broke through the Hexamilion wall, and in 1460 his successor Mehmed II conquered most of the despotate.
zh:
摩里亚专制国是拜占庭帝国在伯罗奔尼撒半岛的行省，以米斯特拉斯为中心。1349年，皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯将它分封给儿子曼努埃尔；曼努埃尔于1380年去世后，巴列奥略家族接掌摩里亚。

到1430年，君士坦丁·巴列奥略及其兄弟将拜占庭统治扩展到几乎整个半岛。1446年，苏丹穆拉德二世攻破赫克萨米利翁长墙；1460年，其继任者穆罕默德二世征服了专制国的大部分领土。

en:
The Principality of Mologa was a small appanage on the Mologa River, a Volga tributary in the Yaroslavl lands. Created in 1321 after Prince David of Yaroslavl's death, when his inheritance was divided among his sons, it went to Mikhail Davidovich, who took the Mologa and upper Volga lands, settling at Mologa, while the elder, Vasily, kept Yaroslavl. In 1337 Mikhail still ruled, in loose subordination to Yaroslavl.

An international barter fair grew up at nearby Kholopy Gorodok, and in 1362 Mikhail rode with Dmitry of Moscow to the Golden Horde. His son Fyodor fought on the right wing at Kulikovo in 1380.

After Fyodor died in 1408 the appanage split into three princely lines whose descendants entered Muscovite service, and Ivan III annexed it in 1471. The town later became a flourishing Volga trading centre with a great fair relocated there in the late fifteenth century.
zh:
莫洛加公国是莫洛加河畔的小封邑，该河在雅罗斯拉夫尔地界注入伏尔加河。1321年雅罗斯拉夫尔王公达维德死后诸子瓜分遗产：长子瓦西里保有雅罗斯拉夫尔，米哈伊尔·达维多维奇取得莫洛加河与伏尔加上游的土地，驻节莫洛加。1337年米哈伊尔仍在位，对雅罗斯拉夫尔保持松散臣属。

附近的霍洛皮戈罗多克兴起国际易货集市；1362年米哈伊尔随莫斯科的德米特里同赴金帐汗国。其子费奥多尔参加1380年库里科沃战役，位列俄军右翼。

1408年费奥多尔死后，封邑分裂为三支，后裔转入莫斯科服役，1471年伊凡三世兼并该公国。莫洛加城后来成为伏尔加河上的繁荣商镇，15世纪末有大型集市迁入。

en:
Moldavia emerged in the fourteenth century between the Eastern Carpathians and the Dniester, with Bogdan I remembered as its founder. Stephen III took the throne in 1457 and defended the principality against Hungary, Poland and the Ottomans.

Stephen defeated an Ottoman army at Vaslui in 1475, but the Ottomans and their Crimean allies seized the ports of Chilia and Cetatea Albă in 1484. Moldavia later remained an autonomous principality under Ottoman overlordship.
zh:
摩尔达维亚于14世纪在东喀尔巴阡山脉与德涅斯特河之间兴起，博格丹一世被视为公国的建立者。斯特凡三世于1457年登位，保卫公国抵御匈牙利、波兰和奥斯曼帝国。

斯特凡于1475年在瓦斯卢伊击败奥斯曼军队，但奥斯曼人与克里米亚盟友于1484年夺取基利亚和切塔泰亚阿尔伯两座港口。此后摩尔达维亚成为奥斯曼宗主权下的自治公国。

en:
Momboares was the Portuguese name for the Seven Kingdoms of Kongo dia Nlaza, a loose confederation of Bantu polities that had lain east of the young Kingdom of Kongo since at least the thirteenth century. Its chief district stood on the Kwale River and took in smaller kingdoms such as Nsundi and Mpangu; in 1337 these lands were still independent of Kongo.

The region was already a major centre of textile weaving. The Jesuit Mateus Cardoso, writing in the seventeenth century, described its cloth production and recorded exports of around a hundred thousand metres of raphia cloth a year to Luanda.

Kongo expanded eastward through its province of Mbata and absorbed the Seven Kingdoms during the sixteenth century, after which their rulers appeared among the titles of the Manikongo.
zh:
蒙博阿勒是葡萄牙人对“刚果·迪亚·恩拉扎七王国”的称呼，那是班图人小邦组成的松散联盟，至少从13世纪起位于年轻的刚果王国以东。其中心在夸莱河畔，包括恩松迪、姆潘古等小王国；1337年时这些土地仍独立于刚果之外。

当地已是重要的纺织中心。17世纪著述的耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡多佐描述了这里的布匹生产，并记录每年仅向罗安达就出口约十万米拉菲草布。

刚果经姆巴塔省向东扩张，于16世纪吞并七王国，此后其君主的名号被列入马尼刚果的头衔之中。

en:
The County of Montfort centred on Montfort-l'Amaury fortress west of Paris, begun around 996 when King Robert the Pious had a castle raised against the counts of Blois. Guillaume de Hainaut built it; his son Amaury I founded the adjoining town named after him. Simon IV de Montfort led the Albigensian Crusade until his death at Toulouse in 1218; his younger son Simon died at Evesham in 1265.

By the early fourteenth century the county had passed to Yolande of Dreux, whose 1294 marriage to Arthur II of Brittany tied it to Brittany's ducal house; her son John of Montfort held it in 1337.

His claim to Brittany after 1341 opened the Breton War of Succession, and the French crown seized Montfort-l'Amaury as forfeit. English troops destroyed the castle in the Hundred Years' War, the county reverting to the French crown when Brittany joined France.
zh:
蒙福尔伯国以巴黎以西的蒙福尔拉莫里要塞为中心，始于996年前后：虔诚者罗贝尔二世下令筑城抵御布卢瓦伯爵。城堡由埃诺的纪尧姆修建，其子阿莫里一世在旁建城，城名便取自他。西蒙四世·德·孟福尔率领阿尔比十字军，1218年死于图卢兹；其幼子西蒙1265年战死于伊夫舍姆。

14世纪初伯国转入德勒的约兰德之手，她1294年嫁给布列塔尼公爵阿蒂尔二世，使伯国与布列塔尼公爵家族连在一起；其子让·德·蒙福尔1337年时正领有此地。

1341年后他争夺布列塔尼继承权，引发布列塔尼继承战争，法兰西王室随即没收蒙福尔拉莫里。百年战争中英格兰军队摧毁城堡，布列塔尼并入法兰西后伯国收归王室。

en: Moro was a small kingdom of the northern Moluccas, covering Morotai island and the adjacent north Halmahera coast, whose Galela-speaking people had little regional influence and fell within Ternate's sphere from the fifteenth century. A Portuguese Jesuit mission there was expelled in 1571, and seventeenth-century Ternate repeatedly deported its Christian villagers to Malayu on Ternate.
zh: 摩洛是北摩鹿加的小王国，地跨摩罗泰岛和邻近的哈马黑拉岛北部海岸，居民说加莱拉语，在地区内影响有限，15世纪起处于特尔纳特的势力范围。葡萄牙耶稣会曾在此传教，1571年被驱逐；17世纪特尔纳特又屡次将其基督徒村民迁往特尔纳特岛的马拉尤。

en:
The Mopan were a Maya people with a polity in southeastern Petén, in present-day Guatemala. Catholic missionaries entered southern Petén to convert the Mopan and Manche Chʼol in 1596.

In 1695 a Spanish expedition reached the town of Mopan, now San Luis, while its ruler Taxim Chan fled with many inhabitants. War and disease devastated the Mopan, and survivors were relocated to Spanish colonial settlements in Petén.
zh:
莫潘是玛雅人的一支，在今危地马拉佩滕东南部建立了政权。1596年，天主教传教士进入佩滕南部，试图使莫潘人和曼切乔尔人改宗。

1695年，一支西班牙远征队抵达莫潘镇，即今日的圣路易斯，统治者塔希姆·钱与许多居民逃离。战争和疾病使莫潘人口锐减，幸存者被迁往佩滕的西班牙殖民聚居地。

en:
The Morocco of 1337 was the Marinid Sultanate, ruled from Fez by the Banu Marin, a Zenata Berber house from eastern Algeria. Once Almohad mercenaries, they rebelled after the Almohad defeat at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212, taking Fez in 1248, Sijilmasa in 1255 and Marrakesh in 1269. Abu Yusuf Yaqub made Fez capital, founding Fes Jdid in 1276, and campaigned across the Strait to support Granada's Nasrid emirs.

At its apogee Abu al-Hasan Ali conquered Zayyanid Tlemcen in 1337 and routed the Hafsids in 1347, briefly uniting most of the Maghreb. Río Salado defeat by a Castilian-Portuguese coalition in 1340 and the loss of Algeciras in 1344 ended the Andalusian adventure, and his son Abu Inan deposed him in 1348.

After Abu Inan's 1358 murder the sultanate fragmented among viziers and rebellious tribes; the Portuguese seized Ceuta in 1415, and Wattasid regents held power. A 1465 Fez revolt killed the last Marinid, Abd al-Haqq II, beginning Wattasid rule.
zh:
1337年的摩洛哥是马林苏丹国，由马林部落以非斯为都统治。马林人是泽纳塔柏柏尔人的一支，来自阿尔及利亚东部。他们本是穆瓦希德王朝的佣兵，1212年穆瓦希德人在拉斯纳瓦斯德托洛萨战败后起兵反叛，1248年夺取非斯，1255年拿下锡吉勒马萨，1269年攻占马拉喀什。阿布·优素福·叶尔孤白以非斯为都，1276年兴建新非斯城，并渡海支援格拉纳达的纳斯里德埃米尔。

鼎盛之时，阿布·哈桑·阿里1337年攻灭宰扬王朝的特莱姆森，1347年击溃哈夫斯王朝，一度统一马格里布大部。但1340年他在里奥萨拉多被卡斯蒂利亚与葡萄牙联军击败，1344年丢失阿尔赫西拉斯，安达卢西亚远征终结，1348年儿子阿布·伊南将他废黜。

1358年阿布·伊南遇刺后，苏丹国在维齐尔专权和部落叛乱中分裂：1415年葡萄牙人攻占休达，瓦塔斯摄政掌握实权。1465年非斯起义，末代马林君主阿卜杜勒·哈克二世被杀，瓦塔斯家族由此掌权。

en:
The Grand Principality of Moscow grew from a small appanage on the Moskva River, in a town first mentioned in 1147 and granted in 1263 to Daniel, youngest son of Alexander Nevsky.

Its princes rose serving the khans of the Golden Horde: Ivan I Kalita, ruling from 1325, collected Tatar tribute from Rus' princes, grew rich and kept Vladimir's grand princely title in his line, while the Russian metropolitan moved his see from Vladimir to Moscow. Dmitry Donskoy defeated a Horde army at Kulikovo in 1380 and united the thrones of Vladimir and Moscow.

After Vasily II's long civil war, Ivan III absorbed the rival Rus' states, annexing Novgorod in 1478 and throwing off Tatar overlordship in 1480; he styled himself sovereign of all Russia and rebuilt the Kremlin with Italian architects. Vasily III completed the gathering of the Russian lands, and in 1547 Ivan IV was crowned the first Russian tsar, turning it into the Tsardom of Russia.
zh:
莫斯科大公国的前身是莫斯科河畔的小封邑，莫斯科城最早见于1147年记载，1263年封给亚历山大·涅夫斯基的幼子丹尼尔。

莫斯科王公靠为金帐汗国的汗效力崛起：1325年即位的伊凡一世·卡利塔替汗向罗斯诸公国征收鞑靼贡赋，由此致富，为家族保住弗拉基米尔大公之位，罗斯都主教也把驻节地从弗拉基米尔迁到莫斯科。德米特里·顿斯科伊1380年在库利科沃击败金帐汗国军队，把弗拉基米尔与莫斯科的公位合二为一。

瓦西里二世长期内战之后，伊凡三世兼并竞争的罗斯诸国，1478年吞并诺夫哥罗德，1480年摆脱鞑靼宗主权；他自称全罗斯君主，聘请意大利建筑师重建克里姆林宫。瓦西里三世完成罗斯土地的聚合，1547年伊凡四世加冕为第一位俄国沙皇，大公国演变为俄罗斯沙皇国。

en:
Mouzon was a small lordship on the Meuse in the Ardennes, on the border between the kingdom of France and the Holy Roman Empire. Its walled castrum belonged to the archbishops of Reims, for whom it served as a second residence until the twelfth century and as a meeting place for rulers: in 1187 Philip Augustus received Frederick Barbarossa there.

Archbishop Adalbéron of Reims re-founded its Benedictine abbey in 971. A town charter of 1182 encouraged its growth as a river crossing.

The surrounding lands, including Sedan, held of the lordship of Mouzon, were attached to the French crown by treaty in 1379. By the Treaty of Saint-Maur of 1465 the lordship passed to Duke John II of Lorraine, and in the sixteenth century it was absorbed into the Principality of Sedan.
zh:
穆宗是阿登地区默兹河畔的小领地，地处法兰西王国与神圣罗马帝国的边界。设防城堡属于兰斯大主教，12世纪以前是大主教的第二驻地，也是君主会晤之地：1187年腓力·奥古斯都在此接待腓特烈·巴巴罗萨。

971年，兰斯大主教阿达尔贝隆重建当地的本笃会修道院，1182年的城市特许状推动这座渡口城镇发展。

包括色当在内、从属于穆宗领的周围土地于1379年依条约并入法兰西王室。1465年《圣莫尔条约》将该领地划给洛林公爵让二世，16世纪它又被并入色当亲王国。

en: The Moxo were Indigenous peoples of the Mamoré River and the Moxos plains in present-day Bolivia, speaking Arawakan languages. From 1682 Jesuits gathered local peoples into mission towns, including Trinidad in 1686. Distinct Moxo communities emerged in these settlements, and their mission institutions endured after the Jesuits were expelled in 1767.
zh: 莫霍人是今玻利维亚马莫雷河流域和莫霍斯平原的原住民，讲阿拉瓦克语系的语言。1682年起，耶稣会士将当地族群集中到传教聚落，其中包括1686年建立的特立尼达。不同的莫霍社群在这些聚落中逐渐形成；1767年耶稣会士被驱逐后，传教区的制度仍得以延续。

en:
Moray, on the Moray Firth's southern shore, began as a Gaelic province whose mormaers ruled like kings, at times independent of Alba; its most famous ruler Macbeth seized the Scottish throne in 1040. David I ended the line, defeating Óengus at Stracathro in 1130 and absorbing Moray, where he planted a bishopric whose cathedral rose at Elgin.

Robert the Bruce found it loyal ground in the Wars of Independence and in 1312 made it an earldom for nephew Thomas Randolph. Thomas's son John Randolph, earl in 1337 and joint regent for the exiled David II, fell at Neville's Cross in 1346 heirless.

In the 1372 split the uplands went to Alexander Stewart, the Wolf of Badenoch, whose men burned Elgin and its cathedral in 1390. The Gordons of Huntly became chief lords in 1452; the earldom's last creation went to James Stewart, Regent Moray and illegitimate half-brother of Mary, Queen of Scots, in 1562.
zh:
默里在马里湾南岸，本是盖尔人省份，莫勒玛几乎形同君王，对阿尔巴王国时附时叛；最著名的统治者麦克白于1040年夺取苏格兰王位。1130年戴维一世在斯特拉卡思罗击败昂古斯，吞并默里，主教区座堂后来建于埃尔金。

独立战争中，罗伯特·布鲁斯以此为兵源地，1312年把它建为伯爵领，封给外甥托马斯·伦道夫。托马斯之子约翰·伦道夫1337年为伯爵，与同僚为流亡的戴维二世摄政，1346年战死于内维尔十字，无嗣。

1372年拆分时，山地归“巴德诺赫之狼”亚历山大·斯图亚特，部众1390年焚毁埃尔金城及其座堂。1452年亨特利的戈登家族成为首要领主；1562年伯爵领末次册封，受封者是苏格兰女王玛丽的异母弟、摄政马里伯爵詹姆斯·斯图亚特。

en:
The Island of Mozambique is a small coral island off the northern Mozambique coast, home to a Swahili Muslim town founded no later than the fourteenth century, whose first settlers according to tradition came from Kilwa.

By the fifteenth century its rulers were linked by kinship to those of Angoche and Quelimane, and when Vasco da Gama called there the island was ruled by the sultan Mussa Bin Bique, from whom the name Mozambique derives.

The Portuguese seized the island in 1507, built a naval base and the Fort of São Sebastião, and made it the capital of their East African possessions and a missionary centre, trading in gold, spices and slaves. It repelled Dutch assaults in 1607 and 1608 under Estêvão de Ataíde and remained Portugal's chief staging post on the voyage to India for more than two centuries.
zh:
莫桑比克岛是莫桑比克北部近海的一座小岛，岛上的斯瓦希里穆斯林城镇至迟建于14世纪，据传统说法最早的居民来自基尔瓦。

到15世纪，当地统治者已与安戈谢和克利马内的统治者联姻结盟；达伽马到访时，岛上的苏丹是穆萨·本·比克，莫桑比克一名即由他而来。

葡萄牙人于1507年夺取该岛，修建海军基地和圣塞巴斯蒂昂堡，把它作为葡属东非领地的首府和传教中心，经营黄金、香料和奴隶贸易。1607年和1608年，该岛在埃斯特旺·德·阿塔伊德指挥下击退荷兰人的进攻，此后两个多世纪里一直是葡萄牙人远航印度途中最主要的中继站。

en:
The Mapuche were Indigenous communities of south-central Chile, organised around local chiefs who could unite under a war leader. Spanish attempts to conquer their lands in the sixteenth century began the long Arauco War. In 1598 Pelantaru defeated the Spanish governor at Curalaba, sparking an uprising that destroyed seven Spanish cities.

A frontier emerged between Spanish settlements and independent Mapuche lands. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, Mapuche chiefs negotiated with colonial governors, while Mapuche groups also moved east across the Andes into the Pampas.
zh:
马普切人是智利中南部的原住民，由地方酋长领导，战时可联合推举统帅。16世纪西班牙人试图征服他们的土地，引发了漫长的阿劳卡尼亚战争。1598年，佩兰塔鲁在库拉拉瓦击败西班牙总督，随之爆发的起义摧毁了七座西班牙城镇。

西班牙殖民地与独立的马普切土地之间逐渐形成边界。17至18世纪，马普切酋长与殖民地总督谈判，马普切人也越过安第斯山脉向东迁入潘帕斯草原。

en: Maguela covers the Kongo-speaking chiefdoms around Wembo, Wandu and Masinga on the plateau east of Mbanza Kongo, small kingdoms absorbed by the expanding Kingdom of Kongo in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. Wandu later became a Kinlaza province whose queen Violante invaded Kongo in 1764, briefly deposing King Álvaro XI.
zh: 马圭拉指姆班扎刚果以东高原上温布、万杜、马辛加一带的刚果语酋邦群，这些小邦在15至16世纪被扩张中的刚果王国吞并为行省。万杜后为金拉扎家族的行省，其女王维奥兰特于1764年攻入刚果，一度废黜国王阿尔瓦罗十一世。

en:
Mamprugu is the kingdom of the Mamprusi people in the savanna of what is now north-eastern Ghana, reaching into northern Togo and Burkina Faso. It was founded in the 1200s by Naa Gbewaa, whose shrine at Pusiga remains the dynasty's ancestral home; Mamprusi tradition calls Gbewaa the common ancestor of the rulers of Dagbon and Nanumba as well.

As the eldest branch of the Mole-Dagbani cluster of peoples, Mamprugu long held ceremonial primacy in the region, and even the Moro-Naba of the Mossi is symbolically enskinned by its king, the Nayiri. The kingdom was governed through hereditary skins held by direct male descendants of the founding line, with Gambaga and later Nalerigu as its chief seats.

Through Dyula merchants the Mamprusi began converting to Islam in the 1600s. The older worship of the sky god Naa-wuni nevertheless remained widespread.
zh:
曼普鲁古是曼普鲁西人的王国，位于今加纳东北部的稀树草原，势力延伸到多哥北部和布基纳法索。它约在13世纪由纳阿·格贝瓦建立，他在普西加的神龛一直是王朝的祖庭；曼普鲁西传说称格贝瓦同时是达格邦和纳农巴统治者的共同祖先。

作为莫莱-达格巴尼族群中最年长的支系，曼普鲁古长期保有礼仪上的首席地位，就连莫西人的莫罗-纳巴也要由其国王纳伊里象征性地授予王位。王国通过世袭的“皮位”治理，只有创始血脉的男性直系后裔可以承袭，主要王庭先后设在甘巴加和纳莱里古。

17世纪，受迪尤拉商人影响，曼普鲁西人开始改宗伊斯兰教。但对天神纳乌尼的古老崇拜仍然广泛流传。

en:
Maravi was a Chewa confederacy centred in what is now Malawi, ruled by a Kalonga of the Phiri clan. After migrating from Katanga, the Phiri joined communities already settled around Msinja; the Kalonga sent relatives to found subordinate chiefdoms.

In the 1600s Kalonga Muzura expanded Maravi and conquered Lundu's polity. Succession disputes fractured the confederacy in the 1700s, and slave raids by Yao chiefs further weakened it in the nineteenth century.
zh:
马拉维是以今马拉维地区为中心的切瓦人邦联，由菲里氏族的卡隆加统治。菲里人从加丹加迁来后，与已在姆辛贾一带定居的社群结合；卡隆加派亲属建立从属的酋邦。

17世纪，卡隆加穆祖拉扩张马拉维，征服了隆杜的政权。18世纪的继承争端使邦联分裂，19世纪瑶人首领发动的掳奴袭击又进一步削弱了它。

en:
The prince-bishopric of Merseburg sat on the Saale, where Henry the Fowler had built a royal palace around 919. Emperor Otto I founded the diocese in 967 as a suffragan of Magdeburg, to Christianise the Sorbs beyond the Saale and bind the Slavic marches to the empire. Briefly suppressed, it was re-established by Henry II in 1004; its cathedral was built under the chronicler Bishop Thietmar and consecrated in 1021.

From the thirteenth century it was overshadowed by the Wettin margraves of Meissen, who secured its protectorate by the 1485 Treaty of Leipzig. Its bishop in 1337 was Gebhard of Schraplau, a lord of the Querfurt country.

The Reformation ended the see: Bishop Adolph II of Anhalt was expelled in the 1525 Peasants' War, Saxon administrators took over until Merseburg joined the Electorate of Saxony in 1565. In 1815 the Congress of Vienna assigned most of its former lands to Prussia.
zh:
梅泽堡主教区邦位于萨勒河畔，捕鸟者亨利约919年在此修建王宫。967年奥托一世设立教区，隶属马格德堡，意在使萨勒河以东的索布人皈依，把斯拉夫人边地并入帝国体系。教区一度撤销，1004年亨利二世予以重建；蒂特马尔主教任内兴建的大教堂1021年祝圣。

13世纪起，这个小国日益受迈森韦廷藩侯压制，后者依1485年《莱比锡条约》取得保护权。1337年在任主教是施拉普劳的格布哈德，出身奎尔富特一带的领主家族。

宗教改革终结了主教区：安哈尔特的阿道夫二世主教在1525年农民战争中被民众驱逐，萨克森管理者接掌权力，1565年梅泽堡并入萨克森选侯国。1815年维也纳会议把旧主教区大部分土地划归普鲁士。

en:
The County of La Marche, whose main town was Guéret on the north-western edge of the Massif Central, took its name from its role as a march, the border district between the Duchy of Aquitaine and the Frankish royal lands, when it first appeared as a fief in the mid-tenth century. In the twelfth century the county passed to the House of Lusignan.

When Count Guy died childless in 1308, King Philip IV seized it, and in 1314 it became the appanage of his son Charles the Fair, who as King Charles IV exchanged it in 1327 with Louis of Bourbon for the County of Clermont.

La Marche then followed the Bourbon line, was held by the Armagnacs from 1435 to 1477 before reverting to the Bourbons, and was finally absorbed into the royal domain by Francis I in 1527.
zh:
拉马什伯国的主城是中央高原西北缘的盖雷，其名得自边区身份：10世纪中叶它首次作为封地出现时，是阿基坦公国与法兰克王室领地之间的边境马克。12世纪伯国转入吕西尼昂家族手中。

1308年伯爵居伊无嗣而终，腓力四世没收伯国，1314年把它封给儿子美男子查理；即位后的查理四世于1327年用它与波旁的路易交换克莱蒙伯国。

此后拉马什随波旁家族传承，1435—1477年由阿马尼亚克家族掌握，之后复归波旁，最终1527年被弗朗索瓦一世并入王室领地。

en:
Muren was the Hūrga Jurchen community of the Muren Bira, the Manchu name of the Muling River, which rises on the Heilongjiang–Jilin border and runs north past Muling and Jixi, its chief seat, to enter the Ussuri near Hulin.

In the early fifteenth century the Ming planted the Mulu River Guard in this part of the Ussuri basin under the Nurgan commission, and the eunuch Yishiha's network stationed units along the Muling together with the Songari, Ussuri, Khor and Nen.

The local chiefs kept their guard titles as hereditary tributaries until the Jianzhou campaigns of 1596 to 1625, when Nurhaci's rising state brought the Ussuri tribes under its banners.
zh:
穆伦是穆伦河（满语称穆伦毕拉，即穆棱河）流域的虎尔哈女真人聚落，以鸡西为首邑。穆棱河发源于黑龙江与吉林边界，北流经穆棱、鸡西，在虎林附近注入乌苏里江。

15世纪初，明朝在乌苏里江流域这一带设穆噜河卫，隶属奴儿干都司；太监亦失哈的羁縻体系沿穆棱河与松花江、乌苏里江、霍尔河、嫩江一线部署卫所。

当地酋长以卫所官职世袭朝贡，直到1596—1625年建州女真连年用兵，努尔哈赤的政权才把乌苏里江诸部收入旗下。

en:
The Al Murrah are a camel-nomad Arab tribe whose annual circuits crossed the Rub' al-Khali, or Empty Quarter, between their original home of Najran and the al-Hasa oases on the Gulf. They claim pre-Islamic descent from the Yam, and unlike the Ismaili Yam of Najran the Murrah follow Sunni Islam; their clans were later also found along the Gulf shore.

Pasturing their camels from the wells of Yabrin, the southernmost habitable oasis on the Najd edge, they ranged along routes that had carried Oman caravans since the third millennium before the common era.

In the 1700s the Murrah backed the Wahhabi cause, and when Abd al-Aziz ibn Saud, who reigned from 1765 to 1803, was driven from power he found refuge in their oases; the tribesmen recognized him as emir, took the Wahhabi banner into their black standard, and fought beside him, an alliance later sealed by marriages with the Al Saud.
zh:
穆拉是放养骆驼的阿拉伯游牧部落，每年在鲁卜哈利（空旷之地）大沙漠往返迁徙，路线从祖居地奈季兰延伸到海湾沿岸的哈萨绿洲。他们自称伊斯兰兴起前便已存在，源出亚姆部；与奈季兰信奉伊斯玛仪派的亚姆人不同，穆拉人信奉逊尼派，后来其氏族也见于海湾沿岸。

他们以内志边缘最南端的可居绿洲耶卜林的水井为基地游牧，所走路线自公元前第三个千年起便是阿曼商队的通道。

18世纪，穆拉支持瓦哈比事业；1765—1803年在位的阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·本·沙特失势时曾在穆拉的绿洲避难，部众承认他为埃米尔，把瓦哈比旗帜纳入自己的黑色战旗并随他作战，这一同盟后来又通过与沙特家族联姻巩固。

en:
The Mōri were a samurai family named for an estate in Sagami Province, whose descendants established themselves in Aki. From Yoshida-Kōriyama Castle, Mōri Motonari expanded their power in the sixteenth century, defeating the Ōuchi and Amago and bringing much of the Chūgoku region under his influence.

His grandson Terumoto nominally led the losing western army at Sekigahara in 1600. The Mōri lost four provinces and moved from Hiroshima to Hagi, ruling the remaining lands of Suō and Nagato as the Chōshū Domain.
zh:
毛利氏是以相模国一处庄园为名的武家，后裔在安艺国立足。16世纪，毛利元就以吉田郡山城为据点扩张势力，击败大内氏和尼子氏，使中国地区大部归于其影响之下。

1600年，元就之孙辉元名义上统率关原之战的西军，最终战败。毛利氏失去四国领地，从广岛迁往萩，以剩下的周防和长门两国建立长州藩。

en: The Marajoara culture flourished on Marajó Island at the mouth of the Amazon, particularly between about 800 and 1400. Its inhabitants built settlements on mounds and made large pottery vessels decorated with plants and animals. The culture appears to have persisted into the colonial era; the scale and political organization of its settlements remain debated.
zh: 马拉若阿拉文化兴盛于亚马孙河口的马拉若岛，鼎盛时期约为800—1400年。岛上居民在土丘上建造聚落，制作以植物和动物为纹饰的大型陶器。马拉若阿拉文化似乎延续到了殖民时代，其聚落的规模和政治组织仍有争议。

en:
Marrakesh, west of the Atlas Mountains, was founded around 1070 as the Almoravid capital. Ahmad al-Araj of the Saadi family secured the city by 1525, and it became the capital of a dynasty that went on to rule nearly all of Morocco.

Sultan Ahmad al-Mansur embellished Marrakesh and sent an army against the Songhai Empire. After his death in 1603, his sons divided the realm in a struggle for succession; the Alaouite ruler Moulay al-Rashid conquered Marrakesh in 1668.
zh:
马拉喀什位于阿特拉斯山脉以西，约于1070年建为穆拉比特王朝的都城。萨阿德家族的艾哈迈德·阿拉杰于1525年前控制了这座城市，并以此为都城，逐步统治了几乎整个摩洛哥。

苏丹艾哈迈德·曼苏尔修建了马拉喀什的建筑，并派军进攻桑海帝国。他于1603年去世后，诸子争夺继承权，国家陷入分裂；阿拉维派统治者穆莱·拉希德于1668年征服了马拉喀什。

en:
The Principality of Murom, on the lower Oka, grew out of one of the oldest towns of the eastern Slavic world. A ninth-century Finnic settlement of the Muroma people, it belonged by the eleventh century to Gleb, son of Vladimir the Great. In 1127 it became the senior Murom-Ryazan seat under Yaroslav Sviatoslavich; after his sons divided the land in 1129, Ryazan broke away entirely after 1212.

A loyal ally of Vladimir's grand princes, Murom was devastated in the Mongol invasion of 1237 to 1238 and again in Tatar raids. It recovered briefly after 1345 under Yury Yaroslavich, but Moscow increasingly controlled its throne: in 1355 Ivan II won a Horde patent for his candidate Fyodor Glebovich.

In 1377 Murom troops under Dmitry of Moscow fought the disastrous Pyana battle. In 1392 Vasily I obtained a Tokhtamysh patent annexing Murom, with Nizhny Novgorod and Gorodets, to Moscow.
zh:
穆罗姆公国在奥卡河下游，起于东斯拉夫最古老城镇之一。本是9世纪穆罗马芬兰部落定居点，11世纪属弗拉基米尔大帝之子格列布。1127年成为雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇治下穆罗姆-梁赞公国长支驻地，1129年诸子瓜分领地，梁赞最终在1212年后完全独立。

穆罗姆作为弗拉基米尔大公的忠实盟友，在1237—1238年蒙古入侵和后来的鞑靼袭击中屡遭蹂躏。1345年后尤里·雅罗斯拉维奇治下短暂复兴，莫斯科却日益操控公位：1355年伊凡二世借金帐汗敕令扶立自己的候选人费奥多尔·格列博维奇。

1377年穆罗姆军在莫斯科的德米特里麾下惨败皮亚纳河。1392年瓦西里一世获脱脱迷失汗敕令，穆罗姆与下诺夫哥罗德、戈罗杰茨一同并入莫斯科。

en:
Moronene was the realm of the Moronene, one of the four large indigenous peoples of Southeast Sulawesi, held the earliest inhabitants of the peninsula's eastern coast. Their historic lands covered what is now Bombana Regency on the mainland, with the nearby island of Kabaena.

Their rulers bore the title Mokole and governed from Taubonto, whose name in the Moronene language means the year of rotting, from a legend of a rice goddess whose visit brought a harvest so huge the grain rotted in the fields; the country was remembered as the Land of the Rice Goddess.

The Moronene kingdom is said to have covered nearly 3,400 square kilometres before it was defeated by the expanding Tolaki kingdom of Konawe in the 1700s, and the Mokole domains, including the autonomous rulers on Kabaena, subsequently came under the oversight of the Sultanate of Buton.
zh:
莫罗内内是莫罗内内人的政权，属东南苏拉威西四大土著族群之一，被认为是该半岛东海岸最早的居民，历史疆域包括今朋巴纳县一带的大陆地区和邻近的卡巴那岛。

统治者称“莫科莱”，以陶邦托为中心；“陶邦托”在莫罗内内语中意为“腐烂之年”，源于稻神降临、稻米丰收到烂在田里的传说，这片土地也被传为“稻神之乡”。

莫罗内内王国据说疆域近3400平方公里，但在18世纪被扩张中的托拉基人哥那威王国击败，包括卡巴那岛上自治首领在内的各莫科莱领地，此后都转归布敦苏丹国节制。

en:
Kutai Martapura, also known to historians as Kutai Martadipura, was a Hindu kingdom on the upper Mahakam River in eastern Borneo, centred on Muara Kaman. It is the oldest known state in the Indonesian archipelago: seven stone sacrificial posts, or yupa, carved in Pallava script with Sanskrit verses, were found there, dating to the late fourth or early fifth century.

The inscriptions name the local chieftain Kudungga, his son Asvavarman, the first ruler to bear a Sanskrit name, and his grandson Mulavarman, who rewarded brahmins with thousands of cattle and gifts of gold and widened his realm through conquest and ritual.

After this early dynasty the kingdom is only faintly recorded, though the Nagarakretagama of 1365 still mentions the region. In 1635, after seven days and nights of fighting, Kutai Kartanegara stormed Muara Kaman, killed King Dermasatia and annexed the old kingdom.
zh:
古泰‑摩多补罗（史家又称古泰马尔塔迪普拉）是东婆罗洲马哈坎河上游的印度教王国，以穆阿拉卡曼为中心，是印度尼西亚群岛已知最早的国家。当地发现的七根牺牲柱（尤帕）刻有帕拉瓦文书写的梵文颂诗，年代可追溯到4世纪末或5世纪初。

铭文提到三位统治者：本土首领库东加、他的儿子——第一个使用梵文名字的国王阿斯瓦瓦尔曼，以及孙子穆拉瓦尔曼；穆拉瓦尔曼以数以千计的牛和黄金布施婆罗门，并通过征战和仪式扩大疆土。

早期王朝之后，这个王国的记载稀少，1365年的《爪哇史颂》仍提到这一地区。1635年，经过七天七夜的激战，古泰‑卡塔内加拉攻陷穆阿拉卡曼，国王德尔马萨蒂亚战死，古国被吞并。

en:
The County of Moers was a small Lower Rhine territory on the left bank, with Moers town and the Krefeld exclave. A lord of Moers is first mentioned in 1160, and the family began as vassals of Cologne's archbishops; a later count fought at Worringen in 1288 and accepted Cleves as overlord. Count Dietrich of Moers held it in 1337.

Later counts won Rhine toll rights in 1371 and minting rights in 1373, and in 1399 Count Frederick III inherited the County of Saarwerden. Burgundy's Charles the Bold overran Moers in 1473, and when the native dynasty died out in 1578 Orange-Nassau and Cleves contested the county.

The Orange princes held it from 1600 until their extinction in 1702, when Prussia took it and raised it to a principality in 1705. French annexation of the left bank ended its separate existence, and the Congress of Vienna assigned it to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
默尔斯伯国是下莱茵左岸的小领地，领有默尔斯城和飞地克雷费尔德。领主最早见于1160年记载，家族起初是科隆大主教封臣；后来一位伯爵参加1288年沃林根战役，战后承认克莱沃为封君。1337年由默尔斯伯爵狄奥多里克领有。

后来伯爵们取得莱茵河征税权（1371年）和铸币许可（1373年），1399年弗里德里希三世又继承萨尔韦登伯国。1473年勃艮第大胆查理攻占默尔斯，1578年本土王朝绝嗣，奥兰治-拿骚与克莱沃展开争夺。

1600年落入奥兰治亲王之手，1702年奥兰治家族绝嗣后转归普鲁士，1705年升为侯国。法国吞并莱茵左岸后独立法统终结，1815年维也纳会议将其划归普鲁士。

en:
The County of Mortain was a choice Norman fief on the Cotentin's edge, centred on hilltop Mortain above the River Cance and usually kept for the duke's own kin. Founded around 1027, it passed about 1049 to Duke William's half-brother Robert, who after 1066 took the earldom of Cornwall; his son William lost Mortain after capture at Tinchebray in 1106.

Stephen of Blois held it until he took the English throne in 1135, and Richard I gave it to his brother John in 1189. With the French conquest of Normandy in 1204 the county came to the French crown, and from 1328 it belonged to Joan II of Navarre, Louis X's daughter, holding it in 1337 with her husband Philip of Évreux until she died of the Black Death in 1349.

Disputed in the Hundred Years' War, it passed to Charles of Le Maine in 1449 and the royal domain in 1481.
zh:
莫尔坦伯国是诺曼底科唐坦边缘的优渥封土，以康斯河畔山岩上的莫尔坦城为中心，通常封给公爵近亲。它约1027年设立，1049年前后威廉公爵封给同母异父弟罗贝尔，此人1066年后兼领康沃尔伯爵；其子威廉1106年坦什布赖被俘后失去伯国。

布卢瓦的斯蒂芬领有此地，直到1135年登上英格兰王位；1189年理查一世把它封给弟弟约翰。1204年法兰西征服诺曼底后归于王室；1328年起属路易十世之女纳瓦拉的胡安娜二世，她与丈夫埃夫勒的菲利普共同领有，1337年仍在其手，1349年死于黑死病。

百年战争中莫尔坦几经易手，1449年落入勒芒的查理之手，1481年并入王室领地。

en:
Merv was the great oasis on the Murghab river in southeastern Khorasan and a chief city of the Silk Road. It served in turn as an Achaemenid satrapal centre and the Umayyad capital of Khorasan. Under the Great Seljuks it was an imperial capital and perhaps the world's largest city, where Omar Khayyam once worked.

In 1221 Tolui Khan's Mongols sacked it and, on contemporary reports, slaughtered some seven hundred thousand people; rebuilt, it never recovered. It later passed to the Kartids of Herat and by 1380 to Timur's empire.

The Uzbeks took it in 1505, but Shah Ismail I expelled them five years later; it then passed between Khiva, Bukhara and the Safavids. It became an independent Qajar principality, until the Bukharan amir Shah Murad killed its ruler in 1785 and razed it in 1788 and 1789, deporting its people.
zh:
木鹿是呼罗珊东南部穆尔加布河畔的大绿洲，也是丝绸之路上的首要城市之一。它先后做过阿契美尼德王朝的行省中心和倭马亚王朝呼罗珊省的首府。塞尔柱帝国时期它是帝国都城，可能是当时世界上最大的城市，奥马尔·海亚姆曾在此工作。

1221年拖雷麾下的蒙古人洗劫该城，据当时记载屠杀约七十万人；木鹿虽获重建，却再未恢复元气。它后来落入赫拉特的卡尔提德王朝之手，到1380年并入帖木儿帝国。

1505年乌兹别克人攻占该城，但五年后即被沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世赶走，此后在希瓦、布哈拉与萨法维王朝之间几度易手。木鹿成为独立的卡扎尔公国，直到布哈拉埃米尔沙阿·穆拉德于1785年杀死其统治者，并在1788至1789年间夷平城市、迁走居民。

en:
The Kingdom of Marwar was the Rathore Rajput state of western Rajputana, founded in 1243 at Pali by Rao Siha. For over a century it remained a small embattled chiefdom. Rao Chunda received Mandore fortress as a dowry in 1395 and made it his capital.

His grandson Rao Jodha recovered Mandore and in 1459 built Mehrangarh fort, around which grew his new capital, Jodhpur. Under Maldeo Rathore, reigning from 1532, Marwar became Rajputana's strongest power and resisted the Mughals. Akbar annexed it in 1581 and restored Udai Singh as a vassal two years later.

When Jaswant Singh died in 1678, Aurangzeb withheld the throne from his posthumous son Ajit Singh; the Rathore leader Durgadas fought for thirty-one years to restore him and free Marwar. In 1818 Marwar accepted a British subsidiary alliance and continued as a princely state, usually called Jodhpur State thereafter.
zh:
马尔瓦尔王国是拉杰普塔纳西部的拉托尔族拉杰普特政权，1243年由拉奥·西哈在巴利建立。此后一个多世纪里，它始终是一个四面受敌的小首领政权。拉奥·琼达于1395年通过联姻得到曼多尔堡，将其定为都城。

其孙拉奥·乔达收复曼多尔，1459年兴建梅兰加尔堡，堡下发展出新都城焦特布尔。1532年即位的马尔德奥·拉托尔治下，马尔瓦尔成为拉杰普塔纳最强的势力，并抵御莫卧儿人。阿克巴于1581年吞并王国，两年后乌代·辛格以附庸身份复位。

1678年贾斯万特·辛格去世，奥朗则布拒绝让其遗腹子阿吉特·辛格继位，拉托尔首领杜尔加达斯斗争三十一年，最终迎他复位，使马尔瓦尔摆脱莫卧儿控制。1818年，马尔瓦尔接受英国的附属同盟，此后通常称为焦特布尔土邦。

en:
Malaya's Malay sultanates included Malacca, founded around 1400 by Parameswara on the peninsula's west coast. In the fifteenth century Malacca became a major trading port, ruling much of the peninsula and spreading Islam and Malay literary culture.

The Portuguese captured Malacca in 1511, and Sultan Mahmud Shah withdrew south. His son Alauddin Riayat Shah II founded Johor in 1528; Johor fought both Portuguese Malacca and Aceh before joining the Dutch in the capture of Malacca in 1641.
zh:
马来亚的马来苏丹国包括马六甲：拜里米苏拉约于1400年在半岛西岸建立了这个政权。15世纪，马六甲成为重要贸易港口，统治半岛大部，并传播伊斯兰教和马来文学文化。

葡萄牙人于1511年攻占马六甲，苏丹马哈茂德沙退往南方。他的儿子阿拉乌丁·利亚沙二世于1528年建立柔佛；柔佛先后与葡萄牙统治的马六甲和亚齐交战，并于1641年联合荷兰人攻占马六甲。

en:
Mosbach lies in the Odenwald at the meeting of the Neckar and the Elz, and grew up around a Benedictine abbey first recorded in the ninth century. In 1241 it was granted the rights of an imperial free city, but in 1362 it passed to the Electorate of the Palatinate.

On the partition of the Palatine lands after King Rupert's death in 1410, Mosbach became the seat of the small principality of Palatinate-Mosbach under Count Palatine Otto I. Otto later added Palatinate-Neumarkt by inheritance and purchase, ruling the combined state as Palatinate-Mosbach-Neumarkt.

When Otto II died without heirs in 1499 the principality was dissolved and the town reverted to the Electoral Palatinate as the centre of an administrative district. In the reorganization of Germany after 1806, Mosbach was assigned to the Grand Duchy of Baden.
zh:
莫斯巴赫地处奥登林山区、内卡河与埃尔茨河交汇处，围绕一座9世纪已有记载的本笃会修道院发展起来。1241年它获得帝国自由城市的权利，1362年并入普法尔茨选侯国。

1410年国王鲁普雷希特去世后普法尔茨领地分家，莫斯巴赫成为小邦普法尔茨-莫斯巴赫的治所，统治者是行宫伯爵奥托一世。奥托后来又通过继承和购买取得普法尔茨-诺伊马克特，合并为普法尔茨-莫斯巴赫-诺伊马克特。

1499年奥托二世无嗣而终，小邦被撤销，城市重归普法尔茨选侯国，成为一个行政区的中心。1806年德意志格局重组后，莫斯巴赫被划归巴登大公国。

en:
The Massachuseuck were an Indigenous people of Massachusetts Bay, living in autonomous villages led by sachems along the Charles and Neponset rivers. They grew maize, beans and squash and fished the coast.

Epidemics devastated the coastal communities around 1619, and English settlers took much of their land. During John Eliot's mission, many Massachuseuck joined Christian communities at Natick and Ponkapoag; Eliot's Massachusett-language Bible appeared in 1663.
zh:
马萨诸塞是马萨诸塞湾的原住民，在查尔斯河和尼庞塞特河沿岸的自治村落中生活，由酋长领导。他们种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，也在海岸捕鱼。

约1619年的流行病重创了沿海社区，英国殖民者随后夺走了他们的大量土地。传教士约翰·埃略特传教期间，许多马萨诸塞人加入了内蒂克和庞卡波格的基督教社区；埃略特的马萨诸塞语圣经于1663年出版。

en:
The Masuda were a warrior family based at Masuda in Iwami Province. They rose under the Ōuchi, and Masuda Kanetaka and his son fought for Ōuchi Masahiro during the Ōnin War.

After the Ōuchi were weakened, Masuda Fujikane surrendered to the Mōri in 1557. His son Motonaga served the Mōri in campaigns including the siege of Kōzuki Castle in 1578; after Sekigahara in 1600, he left Iwami for Nagato, where his family held Susa as senior retainers of Chōshū.
zh:
益田氏是以石见国益田为根据地的武家。家族在大内氏麾下兴起，应仁之乱期间，益田兼尧父子为大内政弘作战。

大内氏衰落后，益田藤兼于1557年向毛利氏投降。他的儿子元祥侍奉毛利氏，参加了1578年的上月城之战等战役；1600年关原之战后，元祥离开石见前往长门，其家族作为长州藩重臣领有须佐。

en:
The Missisage were Ojibwe communities associated with the Mississagi River and northern Lake Huron. Around 1700 Ojibwe people moved into lands north of Lake Ontario after the retreat of the Iroquois, and the name Mississauga came to be applied there as well.

From 1781 the British Crown acquired lands from Mississauga communities in southern Ontario. An agreement for the Toronto area followed in 1787 and was revisited in 1805, though its terms remained disputed.
zh:
米西索加人是与米西萨吉河和休伦湖北部相关的奥吉布瓦群体。约1700年，易洛魁人撤离后，奥吉布瓦人迁入安大略湖北岸，米西索加这一名称也逐渐用于当地居民。

从1781年起，英国王室向安大略南部的米西索加群体购买土地。1787年双方就多伦多一带达成协议，1805年再次商议，但协议条款仍有争议。

en: The Mishmi were communities of the eastern Himalayan hills, around the Dibang and Lohit valleys and the mountains of Zayu. The Deng were among the groups living on the Tibetan side of the Mishmi Hills.
zh: 僜人是喜马拉雅山东部的山地族群，分布在迪邦河、洛希特河流域和察隅山区。僜人中的一些群体居住在米什米山脉的西藏一侧。

en:
The Mossi kingdoms lay in the upper Volta basin in present-day Burkina Faso. Ouagadougou was the largest, while Yatenga and Tenkodogo had rulers of their own; kinship and ritual linked the kingdoms despite their rivalries.

In 1497 the Songhai ruler Askia Mohammad I defeated Mossi forces during a campaign to spread Islam. After Morocco conquered Songhai in 1591, the Mossi states regained their independence, and in the eighteenth century their trade and military power expanded.
zh:
莫西诸王国位于上沃尔特河流域，即今天的布基纳法索境内。瓦加杜古是其中最大的王国，亚滕加和滕科多戈则各有自己的统治者；尽管彼此争雄，诸王国仍由亲缘和仪式联系在一起。

1497年，桑海统治者阿斯基亚·穆罕默德一世在传播伊斯兰教的战役中击败莫西军队。1591年摩洛哥征服桑海后，莫西诸国重新获得独立；18世纪，它们的贸易和军事实力有所增长。

en:
The Meskwaki, called Fox by Europeans, were an Algonquian people who controlled Wisconsin's Fox River, a route between the Great Lakes and the Mississippi. French attempts to secure the waterway helped bring about the Fox Wars beginning in 1712.

In 1730 French forces and their Indigenous allies killed or captured many Meskwaki in Illinois. Survivors found shelter among the Sauk, with whom they allied against the French in 1735.
zh:
梅斯夸基人被欧洲人称为福克斯人，是控制威斯康星州福克斯河的阿尔冈昆语族民族；这条河是五大湖通往密西西比河的水路。法国试图取得水路使用权，促成了1712年开始的福克斯战争。

1730年，法国军队及其原住民盟友在伊利诺伊杀死或俘虏了大批梅斯夸基人。幸存者在索克人中寻得庇护，并于1735年与索克人结盟对抗法国。

en: Misool was an island kingdom in Raja Ampat, west of New Guinea. The Portuguese navigator Jorge de Menezes reached the archipelago in 1526. In the 16th and 17th centuries, Lilinta's king claimed descent from Gurabesi of Waigeo, while Tidore appointed another at Waigama. Islam spread among local chiefs as the islands came under Tidore's suzerainty.
zh: 米苏尔是新几内亚以西拉贾安帕特群岛上的一个岛屿王国。葡萄牙航海家若热·德·梅内塞斯于1526年抵达该群岛。16至17世纪，利林塔的国王以来自韦吉奥的古拉贝西为祖先，蒂多雷则在韦加马另立国王。群岛处于蒂多雷的宗主权之下，伊斯兰教也在当地首领中传播。

en:
Musuniri was the country of the Musunuri Nayakas, Telugu warrior chiefs who rose from the ruins of the Kakatiya kingdom after the Delhi Sultanate sacked Warangal in 1323.

Its founder Prolaya Nayaka established himself around 1330 at Rekapalle near Bhadrachalam, claiming Kakatiya heritage, and his successor Kapaya Nayaka seized Warangal from the Delhi governor Malik Maqbul in 1336, bringing much of eastern Telangana under his rule and taking the Persianised title of Sultan of the Andhra country.

Kapaya's long wars with the newly founded Bahmani Sultanate cost him forts including Golconda, and in 1361 he surrendered the turquoise throne of Warangal to Mohammed Shah I under a treaty. In 1368 the Recherla Nayakas killed him in battle at Bhimavaram and replaced him as the leading power of Telangana, ending Musunuri rule.
zh:
穆苏尼里是穆苏努里·纳亚卡人的国家，这群泰卢固武士首领崛起于1323年德里苏丹国攻陷瓦朗加尔、卡卡提亚王国覆灭之后。

开国者普罗拉亚·纳亚卡约于1330年在巴德拉查兰附近的雷卡帕勒立足，自称继承卡卡提亚统绪；继任者卡帕亚·纳亚卡于1336年从德里总督马利克·马克布尔手中夺取瓦朗加尔，据有特伦甘纳东部大片土地，并采用波斯式头衔‘安得拉之苏丹’。

卡帕亚与新兴的巴赫曼尼苏丹国连年交战，陆续丢掉戈尔孔达等要塞，1361年又依约把瓦朗加尔的绿松石王座献给穆罕默德沙一世。1368年，隶契罗·纳亚卡人在比姆瓦拉姆之战将他击杀，取代他成为特伦甘纳的首要强权，穆苏努里家族的统治就此终结。

en:
The County of Mesocco was the Alpine lordship of the Sax-Misox line of the house of Sax, whose estates straddled the Alps. In 1168 the Hohenstaufen rewarded their support with the Misox valley as a fief, and around Mesocco Castle, first documented in 1219, the family built rule over the whole Val Mesolcina.

After a family partition in 1248 the southern lands became the separate Sax-Misox branch, at the height of its power in the fourteenth century. Baron Albert von Sax-Misox was a founder of the Grey League in 1395, but his murder in 1406 began the family's decline.

In 1480 Mesocco and Soazza joined the Grey League of their own will, and in the same year the last baron sold the castle and demesne to the Milanese general Giacomo Trivulzio. In 1526 the Three Leagues ordered the castle abandoned and moved the valley administration to Roveredo.
zh:
梅索科伯国是萨克斯家族萨克斯-米索克斯支系在阿尔卑斯山区的领地，其地产横跨阿尔卑斯山。1168年，霍亨斯陶芬王朝为酬谢其支持，把米索克斯河谷封给他们；家族以1219年首次见于文献的梅索科城堡为中心，逐步统治了整个梅索尔奇纳河谷。

1248年家族分家，南部领地成为独立的萨克斯-米索克斯支系，并在14世纪达到权势顶峰。男爵阿尔伯特·冯·萨克斯-米索克斯是1395年灰联盟的创建者之一，但他在1406年遇刺，家族由此走向衰落。

1480年，梅索科和索阿扎自愿加入灰联盟，同年末代男爵把城堡和领地卖给米兰将领贾科莫·特里武尔齐奥；1526年，三联盟下令废弃这座城堡，把河谷的行政中心迁到罗韦雷多。

en:
The Malaspina are a noble house of Longobard origin, descended from the Obertenghi marquesses of Luni; Alberto Malaspina, who died in 1140, first bore the name, meaning bad thorn. Marquess Obizzo I served Emperor Frederick Barbarossa before turning against him at Legnano in 1176 with the Lombard League, and the Peace of Constance confirmed his fiefs in Lunigiana.

In 1221 the house split into the Spino Secco and Spino Fiorito branches, whose heirs partitioned the lands into small marquisates; Dante, sheltered by them during his exile, praised them in the Purgatory of the Divine Comedy. In 1337 the Spino Fiorito held Lunigiana castles, and Spinetta Malaspina, called the Great, acquired Fosdinovo in 1340.

The Fosdinovo line was recognized as hereditary imperial vicar in 1529. The last sovereign marquis of Fosdinovo renounced his fiefs under the Napoleonic edict of 1797.
zh:
马拉斯皮纳是伦巴第人血统的贵族世家，出自卢尼的奥贝尔滕吉侯爵谱系；1140年去世的阿尔贝托·马拉斯皮纳最早使用该姓，姓意为“恶棘”。侯爵奥比佐一世先效力于皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨，1176年在莱尼亚诺倒戈加入伦巴第同盟，《康斯坦茨和约》确认了他在卢尼贾纳的封地。

1221年家族分裂为“枯棘”和“繁花棘”两支，众多继承人把领地分割成众多小侯国；但丁流亡时曾受这个家族庇护，并在《神曲·炼狱篇》中称赞他们。1337年繁花棘支在卢尼贾纳据有多座城堡，号称“大帝”的斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳于1340年取得福斯迪诺沃。

福斯迪诺沃一系在1529年被承认为世袭帝国代理人。末代福斯迪诺沃主权侯爵在1797年拿破仑的敕令下放弃了封地。

en:
Mstislavl is a hill town east of Smolensk, first recorded in the Hypatian Chronicle in 1156 and originally an appanage of the Principality of Smolensk; by 1180 it had become the seat of its own princes, the Mstislavsky line, who gave the small principality its name.

In 1377 the townspeople submitted of their own accord to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, whose first local duke was Karigaila, a brother of Jogaila, and the Mstislavsky princes later entered Lithuanian and then Muscovite service. Within the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth the town became capital of the Mścisław Voivodeship, with its own sejmik and court, and received Magdeburg rights from King Władysław IV in 1634.

Russian troops stormed and sacked it in 1654 during the war of 1654 to 1667, and Polish-Lithuanian forces under Stefan Czarniecki retook the ruined town in 1661. In 1772 the First Partition assigned Mstislavl to the Russian Empire.
zh:
姆斯季斯拉夫尔是斯摩棱斯克以东的山城，1156年在《伊帕季耶夫编年史》中首次出现，原是斯摩棱斯克公国的封邑，到1180年已成为姆斯季斯拉夫斯基家族王公的驻地，这个小公国也因该家族得名。

1377年，城镇居民自愿归附立陶宛大公国，立陶宛派来的首任王公是雅盖沃的兄弟卡里盖拉，姆斯季斯拉夫斯基家族的王公后来先后效力于立陶宛和莫斯科。在波兰立陶宛联邦内，该城成为姆斯季斯拉夫尔省的省会，设有自己的地方议会和法庭，并于1634年获瓦迪斯瓦夫四世国王授予马格德堡权利。

1654年至1667年战争期间，俄军于1654年攻破并洗劫了此城，1661年斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率领的波兰立陶宛军队收复了这座废墟。1772年第一次瓜分中，姆斯季斯拉夫尔被划归俄罗斯帝国。

en:
Macerata is a hill town of the Marche, standing between the Chienti and Potenza rivers. Its people descended from the inhabitants of Helvia Recina, a Roman town destroyed in the barbarian invasions, who rebuilt on the neighboring heights; the new settlement became a self-governing commune in 1138.

A university was founded there in 1290, making it one of the oldest seats of learning in Europe, and in 1320 Pope John XXII moved the bishop's see to Macerata, tying the town to the Papal States. In the sixteenth century it gained bastioned walls and civic buildings, and the Accademia dei Catenati made it a small centre of humanist letters.

When French armies entered the Marche, Macerata joined the anti-French risings of 1799, and French troops stormed and looted the town that year; it remained a provincial city of the restored Papal States thereafter.
zh:
马切拉塔是马尔凯的山城，坐落在基恩蒂河与波坦察河之间。它的居民是罗马城镇赫尔维亚·雷奇纳遗民的后代——旧城在蛮族入侵中被毁，人们在邻近高地上重建家园，新聚落于1138年组建为自治市镇。

1290年当地创办大学，是欧洲最古老的学府之一；1320年教宗约翰二十二世把主教座堂迁至马切拉塔，使这座城市归入教皇国。16世纪它修筑起棱堡城墙和公共建筑，卡滕纳蒂学院又使它成为一个小型人文主义学术中心。

法国军队进入马尔凯后，马切拉塔参加了1799年的抗法起义，法军当年即攻破并劫掠了这座城市，此后它仍是复辟教皇国治下的一座省城。

en:
The County of Montbéliard, known in German as Mömpelgard, was an immediate county of the Holy Roman Empire seated in the Jura foothills of Franche-Comté. Emperor Henry III created it in 1042 out of the County of Burgundy, and the Montfaucon lords acquired it by marriage in 1162.

In 1337 the count was Othenin, called the Mad, mentally incapable and living secluded under his uncle's guardianship. When Othenin died childless in 1338, Emperor Louis IV granted the county to Henry I of Montfaucon, husband of Othenin's sister. Henry faced a civic revolt in 1340.

The last Montfaucon male, Henry II, fell fighting the Ottomans at Nicopolis in 1396, and in 1407 the heiress Henriette married Eberhard IV of Württemberg. From 1444 Montbéliard belonged to Württemberg and was raised to a princely county in 1495. French troops occupied it in 1793; Württemberg renounced its rights in 1796.
zh:
蒙贝利亚尔伯国（德语称默姆佩尔加德）是神圣罗马帝国的直属伯国，治所在弗朗什-孔泰汝拉山麓的蒙贝利亚尔。1042年，皇帝亨利三世从勃艮第伯国划出土地建立该伯国，1162年蒙福孔家族通过联姻取得统治权。

1337年在位的是绰号“疯子”的奥瑟南，他因精神疾病无法理政，在叔父监护下深居简出。1338年奥瑟南无嗣而终，皇帝路易四世将伯国封给娶了其妹的蒙福孔的亨利一世，亨利于1340年面临市民叛乱。

蒙福孔家族最后男嗣亨利二世于1396年在尼科波利斯对奥斯曼人的战役中阵亡，1407年女继承人亨利埃特嫁给符腾堡的埃伯哈德四世。1444年起蒙贝利亚尔归属符腾堡家族，1495年升为诸侯伯国。1793年法军占领该地，符腾堡于1796年放弃其权利。

en:
The Matsuda were a warrior family based at Kanagawa Castle in Bizen Province, where they held power in the western part of the province during the Muromachi period. In 1562 Matsuda Motokata married a daughter of Ukita Naoie as part of a settlement with the rival Uragami family.

The peace failed in 1568, when Naoie's forces besieged Kanagawa Castle. Motokata's father Mototeru was killed in the fighting, and Motokata died after escaping the fallen castle.
zh:
松田氏是以备前国金川城为根据地的武家，室町时代在备前西部拥有势力。1562年，松田元贤迎娶宇喜多直家之女，作为与对手浦上氏和解的一部分。

这场和解在1568年破裂，直家的军队围攻金川城。元贤的父亲元辉在战斗中阵亡，元贤逃出陷落的城池后也被杀。

en:
Möng Ting, the Mengding of Chinese records, was a small Tai chiefdom on the Nam Ting River in Yunnan's southwest. Its Golden Teeth chiefs submitted to the Yuan in 1287 with twenty-five thousand people, the court creating Mengding Circuit in 1289 and raising it in 1294 to a military-civilian administration under Chief Aru, granted a tiger tally.

In 1348 the rising Shan power of Möng Mao swallowed the circuit, its ruler Si Lunfa posting a governor over it. Ming armies made it the Mengding native prefecture in 1382 under hereditary Dao chieftains.

During the Luchuan campaigns of the 1430s and 1440s the chief fled, and the Ming commander Wang Ji enfeoffed the Hsenwi officer Han Ge, who had served with merit, with Mengding, after which the ruling house bore the surname Han. It once acknowledged Burmese overlordship in the late Ming, and the Qing confirmed the hereditary line.
zh:
勐汀即汉文史料中的孟定，是滇西南南汀河畔的一个傣族小邦。1287年，金齿地区的首领率两万五千人归附元朝；元廷于1289年设立孟定路，1294年又升为军民总管府，任命归附官阿鲁为总管、佩虎符。

1348年，孟定路被崛起的麓川吞并，思伦发派官员治理孟定。1382年明军将其改置为孟定御夷府，由刀姓土司世袭。

15世纪30至40年代麓川之役中，孟定土司因战乱逃走，明将王骥把孟定封给从征有功的木邦土目罕葛，统治家族自此改为罕姓。明末它曾一度臣服缅甸，清朝又承认该家族的世袭地位。

en:
Meath was a kingdom in central Ireland, ruled in medieval times by Clann Cholmáin of the Uí Néill; several of its kings became High Kings of Ireland. Rival provincial kings and the rulers of Breifne repeatedly divided and overran it in the eleventh and twelfth centuries.

After the Norman invasion, Henry II granted Meath to Hugh de Lacy in 1172, and its ruling dynasty was pushed west towards the Shannon. The lordship became a county in 1297; in 1542 it was divided into Meath and Westmeath.
zh:
米斯是爱尔兰中部的王国，中世纪由尼尔家族的科尔曼支系统治；其中数位国王成为爱尔兰至高王。11至12世纪，其他地方国王和布雷夫尼统治者多次入侵并瓜分米斯。

诺曼人入侵后，亨利二世于1172年将米斯授予休·德莱西，原有统治家族被迫西迁至香农河一带。米斯领地于1297年改为郡，并于1542年分为米斯郡和西米斯郡。

en:
The Sultanate of Mataram arose in central Java, with its early capital at Kotagede. Originally subject to Pajang, it expanded under Sutawijaya, who took power around 1584 and began to throw off Pajang's control. Sultan Agung conquered Surabaya in 1625, bringing much of Java under Mataram, but failed to take Dutch Batavia in 1629.

A Madurese revolt forced the court to flee in 1677, and Agung's successor Amangkurat II sought Dutch East India Company help to regain power. Succession wars weakened Mataram, which was divided between Yogyakarta and Surakarta in the eighteenth century.
zh:
马塔兰苏丹国兴起于爪哇中部，早期首都设在哥打格德。马塔兰原本臣属于巴章，苏塔维查亚约于1584年掌权后开始摆脱巴章控制，并向外扩张。苏丹·阿贡于1625年征服泗水，使爪哇大部归于马塔兰，却在1629年进攻荷兰人的巴达维亚时失利。

1677年，马都拉人的叛乱迫使宫廷逃亡，阿贡的继任者阿芒库拉特二世请求荷兰东印度公司帮助夺回权力。此后的继承战争削弱了马塔兰，王国于18世纪分裂为日惹和苏拉卡尔塔。

en: The Moneton were a Native American people of the Kanawha Valley in present-day West Virginia. Thomas Batts mentioned them in 1671, and a 1674 account described their principal settlement as a great town. They may later have merged with other peoples, possibly including the Shawnee.
zh: 莫内顿是居住在今西弗吉尼亚州卡诺瓦河谷的美洲原住民。托马斯·巴茨于1671年提及他们，1674年的记载将他们的主要聚落描述为一座大镇。他们后来可能融入其他族群，其中可能包括肖尼人。

en: Maintirano is a Sakalava coastal settlement in the Melaky region of western Madagascar. In the 1300s this shore lay within the Indian Ocean trading network of the Muslim Swahili Antalaotra, whose dhows linked the island's western ports with the Comoros and the East African coast.
zh: 迈因蒂拉努是马达加斯加西部梅拉基地区的萨卡拉瓦人沿海聚落。1300年代，这一带海岸处于穆斯林斯瓦希里族群安塔拉特拉人的印度洋贸易网络之内，他们的独桅帆船把岛西港口同科摩罗和东非海岸相连。

en:
Mataranga was the coastal principality of an Albanian noble family holding the plain between Durrës and Vlorë. The Matranga were initially vassals of the Angevin kings of Albania, passed briefly under Byzantine rule when the empire retook the region between 1284 and 1288, and accepted Angevin overlordship again in 1304 after Philip of Taranto recovered Durrës.

In 1319 Paul Mataranga joined Philip of Taranto's coalition of Albanian lords against the Serbian king Stefan Milutin. The Serbian advance nonetheless absorbed their territory before 1343.

After Stefan Dušan's empire collapsed, Blasius Mataranga revived the principality between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers from 1358 to 1367 with the rank of sebastokrator. After the Ottoman conquest many Matranga emigrated to the Arbëresh settlements of southern Italy, while those who remained saw their name altered to Matranxhi.
zh:
马特兰加是一个阿尔巴尼亚贵族家族的滨海小邦，领有都拉斯与发罗拉之间的平原。马特兰加家族最初是安茹阿尔巴尼亚诸王的附庸，1284至1288年拜占庭收复该地区时一度臣属君士坦丁堡，1304年塔兰托的腓力夺回都拉斯后又重新接受安茹宗主权。

1319年，保罗·马特兰加加入塔兰托的腓力组织的阿尔巴尼亚领主联盟，对抗塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢丁。然而塞尔维亚的推进仍在1343年前吞并了他们的领地。

斯特凡·杜尚的帝国崩溃后，布拉西乌斯·马特兰加于1358至1367年复兴了什昆宾河与塞曼河之间的小邦，自称至尊者。奥斯曼征服后，许多马特兰加家族成员移居意大利南部的阿尔伯雷什人聚居区，留下的人则把姓氏改成了马特兰吉。

en:
The Mitoya were local lords of Izumo Province, named for the estate granted to their Suwabe ancestors in 1221. In 1337 Mitoya Sukeshige fought for Ashikaga Takauji at Kanegasaki.

Mitoya Hisasuke served the Amago before joining the Mōri in 1562. He defended Mitoya Castle against the Amago, but Mōri Terumoto later expelled him from his ancestral lands; Hisasuke died near Kyoto in 1591.
zh:
三刀屋氏是出云国的地方领主，以1221年赐予其祖先诹访部氏的庄园为姓。1337年三刀屋扶重在金崎之战中为足利尊氏作战。

三刀屋久扶曾效力尼子氏，于1562年转投毛利氏。他守住三刀屋城，抵御尼子氏进攻，却后来被毛利辉元逐出祖地；久扶于1591年死于京都附近。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Metz was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire, distinct from both the diocese and Metz, free imperial city from 1189. After the Treaty of Meerssen in 870 its bishops held lands in former Lotharingia and fought the dukes of Lorraine for independence. Civic unrest in 1234 drove the bishops from their capital.

In 1337 the ruler was Aymar Adhémar de Monteil de La Garde, bishop since 1327. He fought for Philip VI at Crécy in 1346 and invaded the Barrois. Emperor Charles IV confirmed its imperial immediacy in 1357.

From 1484 Lorraine princes held the see, their ties to France opening the way to annexation. Under the Treaty of Chambord in 1552, King Henry II of France occupied Metz with Toul and Verdun; the Empire recognized the loss only in the 1648 Peace of Westphalia.
zh:
梅斯采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的一个教会邦国，其疆域既不同于梅斯教区，也不同于1189年成为帝国自由城市的梅斯城本身。870年《梅尔森条约》后，主教们在旧洛塔林吉亚境内拥有领地，并为争取独立而与洛林公爵争斗。1234年的市民骚乱迫使主教离开首府。

1337年在位的是艾马尔·阿代马尔·德蒙泰伊·德拉加尔格，他自1327年起担任主教。他曾于1346年随法国国王腓力六世征战克雷西，还入侵巴鲁瓦。1357年，皇帝查理四世确认了主教区的帝国直辖地位。

1484年起，主教之位由洛林家族的王公把持，他们与法国的联系为兼并打开了大门。根据1552年的《尚博尔条约》，法国国王亨利二世出兵占领梅斯以及图勒、凡尔登；帝国直到1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》才承认这一损失。

en:
Muang Sua was a Lao principality on the upper Mekong, its city later Luang Prabang. In 698 prince Khun Lo, son of the legendary Khun Borom, took it, founding a dynasty ruling most of the next century; Nanzhao occupied it from 709; after its withdrawal the ruler Chanthaphanit renamed it Xieng Dong Xieng Thong. It later became Sri Sattanak, where Mahayana Buddhism overshadowed Theravada, and briefly accepted Khmer suzerainty under Jayavarman VII from 1185 to 1191.

After Mongol destruction of Dali in 1253 the middle Mekong fell under Mongol influence: Panya Lang founded a panya dynasty in 1271, his son Panya Khamphong, ruler in 1337, seized power with Mongol backing in 1286, succeeding on his father's death in 1316. Sukhothai's Ramkhamhaeng won Muang Sua's allegiance, and Muang Phuan became its vassal by 1312.

Feuds sent prince Fa Ngum into exile at Angkor; returning in 1349 with a ten-thousand-strong Khmer army, he reunited the Lao principalities in six years and in June 1354 was crowned at Vientiane king of Lan Xang, Muang Sua its capital.
zh:
孟挝是湄公河上游的佬人政权，其城邑即后来的琅勃拉邦。698年，传说人物坤博隆之子、王子坤洛夺取该城，建立的王朝在此后近一个世纪世代统治；709年南诏进占，撤走后统治者占塔帕尼将此地改名香通香东。它后来成为斯里沙达纳，汉传佛教的影响盖过上座部传统，并在1185年至1191年短暂臣服阇耶跋摩七世治下的高棉。

1253年蒙古灭大理后，湄公河中游落入蒙古影响：1271年披耶朗开创披耶王朝，其子披耶坎蓬1286年在蒙古支持下发动政变，1316年父王死后继位，1337年仍在位。素可泰的兰甘亨也赢得孟挝归附，孟潘到1312年已成为孟挝的附庸。

内讧使王子法昂流亡吴哥；1349年他率一万高棉大军返乡，六年征战统一佬人诸邦，1354年6月在万象加冕为澜沧国王，孟挝为澜沧都城。

en: The Kingdom of Murcia was a Castilian jurisdiction in southeastern Iberia, centred on Murcia. The Muslim taifa submitted to Castile in 1243, but its inhabitants joined the Mudéjar revolt in 1264. Aragonese forces conquered Murcia during the uprising and returned it to Castile, which ruled it as a kingdom until the territorial reforms of 1833.
zh: 穆尔西亚王国是卡斯蒂利亚王冠在伊比利亚半岛东南部的一处领地，以穆尔西亚城为中心。穆斯林的穆尔西亚泰法于1243年臣服于卡斯蒂利亚，但当地居民在1264年参加了穆德哈尔人起义。阿拉贡军队在起义期间征服穆尔西亚并将其交还卡斯蒂利亚，此后卡斯蒂利亚将其作为一个王国统治，直到1833年的领土改革。

en:
The Mughal Empire was a South Asian empire founded in 1526, when the Timurid prince Babur defeated Delhi's Sultan Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat. His grandson Akbar expanded the empire and built an administration supported by agricultural revenue.

Under Shah Jahan, the court patronized architecture including the Taj Mahal at Agra. Aurangzeb extended Mughal rule deep into the Deccan, but after his death in 1707 imperial power weakened. The East India Company's victory at Plassey in 1757 increased its influence in Bengal; by 1760 the emperor's effective domain had contracted to Delhi and its surroundings.
zh:
莫卧儿帝国是南亚的帝国，由帖木儿王朝王子巴布尔于1526年在帕尼帕特击败德里苏丹易卜拉欣·洛迪后建立。他的孙子阿克巴扩张帝国，并建立以农业税收支撑的行政体系。

沙贾汗在位时，宫廷资助了阿格拉的泰姬陵等建筑。奥朗则布将莫卧儿统治深入扩展到德干，但他于1707年去世后，帝国权力逐渐衰弱。东印度公司于1757年在普拉西取胜后扩大了在孟加拉的影响；到1760年，皇帝的实际领地已缩至德里及周边地区。

en:
The Muhiya are the Jurchen group of the Suifen river estuary, whose main settlement was Yongmingcheng on the site of present-day Vladivostok. The coast had belonged to the Balhae kingdom's Shuaibin circuit and then to the Liao and Jin, under which it formed the Xupin circuit, and in the early thirteenth century several cities of the Jurchen Eastern Xia stood here.

The Mongols overran the region in 1233 and destroyed its cities; under the Yuan the surviving town was called Yongmingcheng.

The Ming placed the area under the Nurgan commission, setting up the Muyanghe guard, and the eunuch Yishiha visited it on his far-eastern expeditions. In 1635 Later Jin forces under Wu Bahai campaigned through the southern coast and subjugated its remaining Wild Jurchen communities.
zh:
穆希亚是绥芬河口一带的女真群体，其主要聚落永明城就在今海参崴所在地。这片海岸先后隶属渤海国率宾府、辽朝率宾府和金朝恤品路，13世纪初，女真东夏国的数座城池都建在这里。

1233年蒙古军队攻占该地，摧毁城市，元代残存的城称永明城。

明朝将其纳入奴儿干都指挥使司，设立木阳河卫，宦官亦失哈远航奴儿干时曾到过此地。1635年，吴巴海率领后金军横扫滨海地区南部，征服了当地残存的野人女真部落。

en:
Maui is one of the four principal Hawaiian Islands, and its high chief, the ali'i nui, also ruled the smaller island of Lanai. The first recorded ruler was Paumakua, but for generations his successors held only the larger western half while Hana's chiefs kept the east independent. Early in the fourteenth century Kalaunuiohua of Hawai'i invaded and carried off Maui's chief, exposing the island's weakness.

Unity came only around the turn of the sixteenth century under Pi'ilani, the first to rule the whole island. He began a paved highway encircling Maui, wide enough for eight men to walk abreast, which his son Kiha-a-Pi'ilani completed.

In 1783 Kahekili II conquered O'ahu and built a cross-island empire, but a succession war between his son and brother tore Maui apart, and in 1795 it fell to Kamehameha and joined the Kingdom of Hawai'i.
zh:
毛伊是夏威夷四大主岛之一，其最高酋长（阿里伊努伊）还统治着较小的拉奈岛。有记载的第一代统治者是保马库阿，但此后许多代继承人只能控制毛伊较大的西半部，东部的哈纳酋长始终保持独立。14世纪初，夏威夷岛的卡劳努伊奥华入侵毛伊并俘走其酋长，暴露出该岛的虚弱。

直到16世纪前后，皮伊拉尼才成为统治全岛的第一位酋长。他动工修建一条环绕毛伊的铺路大道，宽可容八人并行，后由其子基哈·皮伊拉尼完工。

1783年，卡赫基利二世征服瓦胡，建立跨岛霸业；但他的儿子与弟弟之间的继承战争撕裂了毛伊，1795年该岛落入卡美哈梅哈之手，成为夏威夷王国的一部分。

en:
Mulhouse, first recorded in 803 as Mulinhuson, was a town of the Sundgau in southern Alsace whose seal already bore a mill wheel by the 1260s. It became a free imperial city in 1275 and joined the Alsatian Decapole when the league was formed in 1354.

In 1515 it left the Decapole to become an associate of the Swiss Confederation, a tie that spared it the French annexation of the rest of Alsace in 1648. Mulhouse adopted the Reformation in 1529 after the Zwinglian model and remained the only Reformed city in an increasingly Lutheran Alsace, governing itself as a city republic.

A customs blockade and revolutionary unrest ended its independence: on 28 January 1798 its citizens voted to join the French Republic, and the Treaty of Mulhouse sealed the union.
zh:
米卢斯最早于803年以“穆林胡松”之名见于记载，本是南阿尔萨斯孙戈地区的城镇，到13世纪60年代，其城印上已刻有磨坊水轮。它于1275年成为自由帝国城市，1354年加入阿尔萨斯十城联盟。

1515年，它退出十城联盟，转而成为瑞士邦联的结盟城市，这层关系使它在1648年阿尔萨斯其余地区被法国吞并时幸免于难。1529年，米卢斯按茨温利的模式推行宗教改革，成为日益路德宗化的阿尔萨斯境内唯一的归正宗城市，以城市共和国之名自治。

关税封锁和革命动荡终结了它的独立：1798年1月28日，市民投票加入法兰西共和国，《米卢斯条约》确认了这次合并。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Münster was one of the largest ecclesiastical states of the Holy Roman Empire, stretching from the lower Rhine to the upper Ems. Charlemagne founded the diocese around 795 under Cologne, entrusting it to the Frisian missionary Ludger, whose monastery, the monasterium, gave the city its name.
