Recognized as princes of the Empire in 1220, the bishops enlarged their territory, buying the Countship of Vechta in 1252. In 1337 the see was held by Louis II of Hesse.

Lutheran ideas spread after 1524; in 1534 radical Anabaptists seized the city and held a communal regime until episcopal troops stormed it in 1535. The Counter-Reformation followed from 1585, and in 1648 the Spanish-Dutch treaty ending the Thirty Years' War was signed there. The bishopric was secularized and partitioned in 1803; in 1815 its south went to Prussia and most of its north to Hanover and Oldenburg.
zh:
明斯特采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国最大的教会邦国之一，疆域从下莱茵一直延伸到埃姆斯河上游。查理曼约于795年设立该主教区，隶属科隆教省，交给弗里斯兰传教士卢德格尔主持，他建立的修道院（monasterium）后来成为城市名称的由来。

1220年主教被承认为帝国诸侯，领地不断扩大，1252年购入费希塔伯国。1337年在任的是黑森的路易二世。

1524年后路德宗思想迅速传播，1534年激进的再洗礼派夺取城市，建立公社式政权，直到1535年主教军队破城。1585年起反宗教改革强力推行；1648年结束三十年战争的西班牙与荷兰和约在明斯特签署。1803年主教区被世俗化并瓜分，1815年南部归普鲁士，北部大部分划归汉诺威和奥尔登堡。

en: The Muong inhabited the mountains of northern Vietnam, especially around present-day Hòa Bình, and spoke a language related to Vietnamese. Historical records mention Muong rebellions in 1351, the 1430s, 1822 and 1833.
zh: 芒人居住在越南北部山区，尤其是今和平省一带，所说的芒语与越南语相近。历史记载中，1351年、15世纪30年代、1822年和1833年都曾发生芒人起事。

en:
Murbach was a Benedictine princely abbey in an Alsatian valley at the foot of the Vosges, founded in 727 by Count Eberhard and organised by Saint Pirmin. It was exempt from all but pope and emperor and drew Charlemagne to take the secular title of abbot in 792. By about 850 its library made it an Upper Rhine intellectual centre, where in 1417 Poggio Bracciolini found Lucretius's De rerum natura.

Its estates included Lucerne, whose sale with the Unterwalden lands to Rudolf I in 1291 helped provoke the Swiss Confederation's founding. It won imperial immediacy in 1228 as a prince-abbacy, and in 1337 still contended with the bishops of Basel and the counts of Habsburg.

Its influence waned from the fourteenth century; the 1648 Peace of Westphalia reserved it to the Empire, but Louis XIV's Chambers of Reunion brought French control in 1680. In 1789 peasants looted the old abbey and the Revolution dissolved it.
zh:
米尔巴克是阿尔萨斯孚日山脚下山谷里的本笃会亲王修道院，727年由伯爵埃伯哈德创建，圣皮尔明加以整顿。它只受教皇和皇帝管辖，查理曼在792年以世俗身份兼任其修道院长；约850年时，其藏书使它成为上莱茵的知识中心，1417年波焦·布拉乔利尼在此找到卢克莱修的《物性论》。

它的产业包括卢塞恩；1291年修道院把卢塞恩和翁特瓦尔登的地产卖给国王鲁道夫一世，此事促成了瑞士邦联的诞生。它于1228年获得帝国直辖地位，成为亲王修道院，1337年时仍在与巴塞尔主教和哈布斯堡伯爵角力。

14世纪起其影响渐衰；1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把它保留给帝国，路易十四的合并署却在1680年使它落入法国实际控制。1789年农民洗劫了老修道院，法国大革命随即将其解散。

en: The Mus were a Kurdish tribal polity seated at Muş, chief town of the Taron region in the Armenian Highlands. After the Seljuk conquest of 1071 the district passed through Ayyubid, Ilkhanid and Kara Koyunlu rule, and the small Kurdish emirates of the area held their lands as vassals of the Principality of Bitlis.
zh: 穆什是一个以穆什城为中心的库尔德部落政权，穆什是亚美尼亚高地塔隆地区的首要城镇。1071年塞尔柱人征服之后，这一地区历经阿尤布王朝、伊儿汗国和黑羊王朝统治，当地的小型库尔德埃米尔国则以比特利斯公国附庸的身份保有领地。

en:
The Mutayr are a large Sunni Bedouin tribe of central Arabia, counted among the so-called noble Arab tribes and traditionally living as camel-herding nomads. Their original homeland was the highland country of the northern Hejaz between the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.

During the 1600s they began a great eastward migration into the Najd, and through the 1700s they fought a long series of wars with the Anazzah over the pasturelands of central Arabia, eventually forcing that confederation north toward the Syrian desert. They also developed a lasting rivalry with the Utaybah, who were moving into the same country from the Hejaz.

In time the Mutayr became the dominant nomadic tribe of al-Qasem, the disputed northern gateway of the Najd, while their tribal lands stretched from the Hejaz across central Arabia to Kuwait and southern Iraq.
zh:
穆塔伊尔是阿拉伯半岛中部的大型逊尼派贝都因部落，被视为阿拉伯贵胄部落之一，传统上以游牧养驼为生。其祖居地是汉志北部、麦加与麦地那两圣城之间的高地。

17世纪，他们开始大规模向东迁入内志；整个18世纪，穆塔伊尔为争夺阿拉伯中部的牧场与阿纳扎连番交战，最终迫使这一联盟向叙利亚沙漠方向北撤。他们与同样从汉志迁入这一地区的乌泰巴也结下长期对抗。

此后穆塔伊尔成为盖西姆地区占主导地位的游牧部落，而盖西姆正是内志北方的争夺要冲；其部落领地从汉志横跨阿拉伯中部，一直延伸到科威特和伊拉克南部。

en: Mulun refers to Hūrga people associated with the Muling River, a tributary of the Ussuri in northeastern China. In the Yuan period, Huligai communities lived in the wider Songhua and Ussuri river region.
zh: 穆棱指与中国东北乌苏里江支流穆棱河地区有关的虎尔哈人。元代，胡里改群体居住在松花江与乌苏里江一带。

en:
Moravia, east of Bohemia around the upper March, was heartland of ninth-century Great Moravia before the Hungarian conquest of 907. Otto I granted it to Bohemia after Lechfeld in 955, though Polish king Bolesław the Brave held it from 999 to 1019 before its Přemyslid return. In 1182 Frederick Barbarossa merged the appanages of Brno, Olomouc and Znojmo into the Margraviate of Moravia.

In 1337 young Charles of Luxembourg, son of Bohemia's King John and future Emperor Charles IV, was margrave at Olomouc, ruling the province as a Bohemian fief. Margrave Jobst was elected King of the Romans in 1410 as antiking.

Hussite wars ravaged Moravia; the Hungarian Matthias Corvinus occupied it in 1469 and it was pawned to him by the 1479 Peace of Olomouc. It passed with Bohemia to the Habsburgs in 1526. Ottoman and Tatar raids lasted into the early eighteenth century; the capital moved from Olomouc to Brno in 1641 in the Thirty Years' War, and in 1804 Moravia became an Austrian crown land.
zh:
摩拉维亚在波希米亚以东、摩拉瓦河上游一带，9世纪是大摩拉维亚的核心，907年被匈牙利人征服。955年莱希费尔德之战后，奥托一世把它封给波希米亚；波兰国王“勇敢者”博莱斯瓦夫曾在999—1019年占有此地，其后它回到普热米斯尔家族手中。1182年，腓特烈·巴巴罗萨把布尔诺、奥洛莫乌茨和兹诺伊莫三个藩国合并为摩拉维亚藩侯国。

1337年，年轻的卢森堡的查理任藩侯，他是波希米亚国王约翰之子、后来的皇帝查理四世，驻奥洛莫乌茨，领有波希米亚封邑。藩侯约布斯特1410年当选罗马人的国王，成为对立国王。

胡斯战争使摩拉维亚惨遭兵燹；匈牙利的马加什·科尔温1469年占领此地，1479年《奥洛莫乌茨和约》又将其统治权抵押给他，1526年随波希米亚转入哈布斯堡家族。奥斯曼与鞑靼人的袭扰持续到18世纪初；1641年三十年战争期间首府从奥洛莫乌茨迁往布尔诺，1804年成为奥地利王冠领地。

en: Morgannwg was a kingdom in south-east Wales, the name used for Glywysing from the late tenth century. Its last native ruler, Iestyn ap Gwrgant, probably based himself at Dinas Powys near Cardiff; Robert Fitzhamon overthrew him around 1091. The kingdom became the marcher lordship of Glamorgan, and in 1536 Glamorgan became a Welsh county under English rule.
zh: 莫甘努格是威尔士东南部的王国，10世纪末起以此名称呼格利维辛。最后的本土统治者伊斯廷·阿普·格尔甘特可能以加的夫附近的迪纳斯波伊斯为根据地；约1091年，诺曼人罗伯特·菲茨哈蒙推翻了他。旧王国随后成为格拉摩根边区领地，1536年格拉摩根成为英格兰统治下的威尔士郡。

en:
Möng Wo was a Tai Lü polity of the Weiyuan River valley in southern Yunnan, the basin that is now Jinggu. Under the Dali kingdom the area belonged to the Weichu commandery, and after its rulers submitted to the Mongols in 1262, the Yuan established Weiyuan Prefecture in 1275. The Ming kept it as a native prefecture under hereditary Tai chieftains of the Dao family.

In 1724 the Qing court, charging the chieftain Dao Guanghuan with harbouring rebels, exiled his family to Jiangxi, abolished the native prefecture and replaced it with the Weiyuan Subprefecture under Pu'er, one of the gaitu guiliu reforms that brought the Tai valleys of Yunnan under direct official rule.
zh:
勐沃是滇南威远江流域的傣仂人政权，其地即今天的景谷坝子。大理国时这里属威楚郡，1262年当地统治者归降蒙古，元朝于1275年设立威远州。明代仍以刀姓傣族土司世袭治理。

1724年，清廷以土司刀光焕藏匿罪人为由，将其全家流放江西，裁撤威远土州，改设隶属普洱府的威远厅，这是改土归流的一环，滇南傣族坝子由此逐渐纳入流官直接管辖。

en:
Mexticacán, whose Nahuatl name means place of the temple of moon worship, was a small cacicazgo in the Los Altos highlands of what is now Jalisco. Its first settlers were Tecuexe farmers who built their villages beneath mountain strongholds against Chichimeca raiders and fired earthenware by night, earning the name men who work in the moonlight; from the seventh century onward Caxcan migrants entering the region fought them for more than a hundred years.

The chiefdom outlasted these wars only to fall in the Nueva Galicia conquest, when Cristóbal de Oñate, a captain of Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán, took the town on Christmas Day 1531.
zh:
梅什蒂卡坎在纳瓦特尔语中意为拜月神殿之地，是今哈利斯科州阿尔托斯高地的一个小酋长国。最早的居民是特奎谢农人，他们把村落建在山下的要塞附近，抵御奇奇梅克人的袭扰，并在夜间烧制陶器，因而被称为月光下劳作的人；从7世纪起，迁入该地区的卡克斯坎移民与他们交战了一百多年。

这个酋邦熬过了这些战争，却在新加利西亚征服中覆灭：1531年圣诞节，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼麾下的将领克里斯托瓦尔·德·奥尼亚特攻占了该镇。

en:
Möng Yang was a Shan state centered on Mohnyin in Kachin State. It appears in Chinese records in 1295 as Yunyuan and long formed part of neighbouring Möng Mao before winning independence in 1399.

The Ming recognized it as a prefecture and then, in 1404, as a pacification commission, while from 1406 Ava claimed overlordship. From the 1470s it grew into the most aggressive Shan state, raiding Ava until its ruler Sawlon conquered Ava in 1527.

Sawlon was murdered by his ministers in 1532, and the Shan confederation after him could not withstand the rising Toungoo dynasty: Bayinnaung took Ava in 1555 and overran Möng Yang in 1557. It kept its native sawbwa dynasty under Burmese suzerainty until, under Alaungpaya or by the late eighteenth century, central governors took over.
zh:
孟养是一个掸人邦国，以今克钦邦的莫宁城为中心。中国史籍中它最早以“云远”之名出现于1295年，此后长期隶属邻近的麓川势力，直到1399年才脱离独立。

明朝先将其划为府，1404年改设宣慰司；阿瓦王国则自1406年起宣称对它的宗主权。15世纪70年代起，孟养成为各掸邦中最具扩张性的一个，不断袭扰阿瓦，1527年其首领思伦攻灭阿瓦。

思伦于1532年被大臣所杀，此后掸邦联盟抵挡不住崛起的东吁王朝：勃印曩于1555年攻取阿瓦，1557年荡平孟养。此后该邦在缅甸宗主权下保留诏法王朝，直到雍籍牙在位时或18世纪末改由中央官员治理。

en: The Millcayac were Huarpe speakers from Cuyo in present-day Argentina. In the late sixteenth century they were displaced to Chile, where Luis de Valdivia recorded their language in a grammar, vocabulary and religious texts.
zh: 米尔卡亚克是来自今阿根廷库约地区、使用米尔卡亚克语的瓦尔佩人。16世纪末他们被迁往智利，路易斯·德·瓦尔迪维亚在那里用语法书、词汇表和宗教文本记录了他们的语言。

en:
The Miyoshi were local lords of Bingo province, based at Hieoyama Castle in Miyoshi. Their ancestor Fujiwara no Kanenori came from Ōmi in the twelfth century, and his son took the Miyoshi name.

Miyoshi Munetaka fought for the Amago against the Mōri in 1540, but later changed sides. In 1553 he and his son Takasuke pledged allegiance to Mōri Motonari. After Sekigahara in 1600, Miyoshi Hirotaka entered the service of the Asano of Hiroshima, while another branch served the Mōri of Chōfu.
zh:
三吉氏是备后国的地方领主，以三吉的比叡尾山城为据点。其祖藤原兼范在12世纪从近江来到备后，其子以三吉为氏。

1540年，三吉致高曾为尼子氏对抗毛利氏，后来转向另一阵营。1553年，他与儿子隆亮向毛利元就宣誓效忠。1600年关原之战后，三吉广高投效广岛的浅野氏，另一支则侍奉长府的毛利氏。

en:
Ma-i was a medieval trading polity of the Philippines, the first of the archipelago's states in foreign records, named in the Song History as early as 971 and described in the Zhu Fan Zhi of 1225; scholars locate it either on Mindoro, old name Mait, or at Bay on Laguna de Bay.

Its people lived in villages of over a thousand households, and Chinese merchants bartered porcelain, iron pots and glass beads for kapok cotton, beeswax and tortoiseshell through an official plaza; Ma-i merchants dealt honestly. The Daoyi Zhilue of 1349 praised its fertile fields and recorded metal religious images in the wilds.

Ma-i never sent tribute to China, living by trade alone; the fourteenth-century Nanhai zhi reports Brunei invading and briefly ruling it. Chinese records fall silent after 1349; Mindoro was raided by Brunei in 1498 and conquered by the Spanish under Legazpi in 1570 and 1571.
zh:
麻逸是菲律宾中世纪的贸易政权，也是第一个见于外国记载的菲律宾古国：早在971年《宋史》中已有其名，1225年的《诸蕃志》更有详细描述；学者对其位置有两说，或在民都洛岛（古名迈特），或在内湖湾畔的巴伊。

当地居民聚居成上千户的大村落，中国商人以瓷器、铁锅和玻璃珠交换木棉、蜂蜡与龟甲，交易在官方广场进行，麻逸商人守信履约。1349年的《岛夷志略》称赞其田地肥沃，并记载荒野中有金属神像。

麻逸从未向中国朝贡，专靠贸易立国；14世纪的《南海志》记载汶莱曾入侵并短暂统治该地。1349年以后中国史籍不再提及麻逸，民都洛后来在1498年遭汶莱袭击，并于1570至1571年被莱加斯皮率领的西班牙人征服。

en: The Mayonmarka were a highland people of the Ayacucho region in the south-central Peruvian Andes. Their country lay around La Mar and Chungui near Andahuaylas, east of the Pocras, and they are known from Spanish colonial accounts of the ethnic groups living in the Huamanga highlands before the Inca conquest.
zh: 马永马尔卡人是秘鲁中南部安第斯山区阿亚库乔一带的高地族群，聚居在安达韦拉斯附近的拉马尔和琼吉，与西面的波克拉人相邻。西班牙殖民文献在记述印加征服前瓦曼加高原的诸族群时提到了他们。

en:
Mayo was the heartland of the Mac William Íochtar, or Lower Mac William, the Mayo Burkes, a fully Gaelicised branch of the Hiberno-Norman de Burgh family. Their lands covered much of northern Connacht, and their chief ruled like a regional king, receiving the White Rod at his inauguration.

The lordship grew from the Burke Civil War of the 1330s. After William Donn de Burgh, Earl of Ulster, was assassinated in 1333, the Connacht inheritance split: the Clanricarde Burkes took the south and the Mac William Íochtar the north. Its first chief was Edmond Albanach de Burgh, once a hostage in Scotland; by his death in 1375 he was the strongest lord west of the Shannon.

From Castlebar his line dominated Connacht politics for over three hundred years, often warring with its Clanricarde cousins; later branches supplied the Earls of Mayo.
zh:
梅奥是下麦克威廉（又称梅奥伯克）的核心领地，这一支系是爱尔兰诺曼裔德·伯格家族完全盖尔化的分支。其领地覆盖康诺特北部大部分地区，首领即位时接受白杖，如同地区国王一般统治。

该领地源自14世纪30年代的伯克内战。1333年阿尔斯特伯爵威廉·唐·德·伯格遇刺后，家族在康诺特的遗产分裂：克兰里卡德伯克取得南部，下麦克威廉取得北部。首任首领埃德蒙·阿尔巴纳赫·德·伯格曾在苏格兰充当人质，到1375年去世时已是香农河以西最强大的领主。

此后其家族以卡斯尔巴为根基，三百多年主导康诺特政局，时常与克兰里卡德的同宗交战，后支还衍生出梅奥伯爵一系。

en:
The Mzab is a stony valley of the northern Sahara, some six hundred kilometres south of Algiers, whose oases are held by the Mozabites, Ibadi Berbers of the Zenata branch.

Ibadi power in the Maghreb began with the Rustamid dynasty founded in 767. After the Fatimids overthrew them and seized Tahert in the early tenth century, Ibadi refugees withdrew to Ouargla, then settled the Mzab valley from 1012, building five fortified oasis towns between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries, El Atteuf the oldest and Ghardaïa the chief.

Ghardaïa heads a loose confederation ruled by a council of religious scholars, the Majlis Ammi Said, which also represented Ouargla, the towns growing rich on caravan trade and merchant networks across the Maghreb. In the sixteenth century the Mozabites recognized the nominal authority of the Ottomans of Algiers, paying tribute while keeping their Ibadi institutions.
zh:
姆扎卜是撒哈拉北部的石质河谷，位于阿尔及尔以南约六百公里，绿洲由姆扎卜人占据，他们是信奉伊巴德派的泽纳塔柏柏尔支系。

伊巴德派在马格里布的政权始于767年的罗斯图姆王朝。10世纪初法蒂玛王朝推翻罗斯图姆人、攻占塔赫特后，伊巴德派难民先退往瓦尔格拉，又从1012年起迁入姆扎卜河谷，在11至14世纪间建起五座设防绿洲城镇，阿特夫最为古老，盖尔达耶为首邑。

盖尔达耶领导松散联盟，由宗教学者组成的阿米·赛义德会议治理，瓦尔格拉亦由其代表；各城镇凭商队贸易和遍布马格里布的商人网络致富。16世纪，姆扎卜人承认阿尔及尔奥斯曼政权的名义权威并纳贡，仍保留自身的伊巴德派制度。

en:
The Muzaffarids were a Sunni dynasty of Arab descent and thoroughly Persianized, building a kingdom on the Ilkhanate's ruins. Under the Il-Khans, Sharaf al-Din Muzaffar governed Maibud near Yazd; his son Mubariz al-Din Muhammad seized Yazd around 1319; in 1337, as the Ilkhanate disintegrated, he ruled it as effectively independent prince.

He conquered Kerman in 1340, took Bam soon after, and in 1353 overthrew the Injuids, capturing Shiraz and Isfahan and making Shiraz capital; he occupied Tabriz briefly before the Jalayirids forced him back. In 1358 his son Shah Shoja blinded and imprisoned him; Mubariz al-Din died in captivity in 1363.

Shah Shoja's long reign made Shiraz a centre of Persian letters, where the poet Hafez worked; the dynasty enlarged the Jameh Mosque of Yazd. Feuding between Shah Shoja's sons after his 1384 death drew in Timur: Isfahan was sacked in 1387; in 1393 Timur defeated and beheaded Shah Mansur at Shiraz, executing the remaining princes and absorbing their lands, ending the dynasty.
zh:
穆扎法尔王朝是阿拉伯血统、完全波斯化的逊尼派王朝，在伊儿汗国废墟上建国。伊儿汗国治下，沙拉夫丁·穆扎法尔任亚兹德附近迈布德的总督；其子穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德约1319年夺取亚兹德，1337年伊儿汗国瓦解之际，他已是这座城市事实上独立的君主。

1340年他征服克尔曼，不久攻占巴姆，1353年攻灭因朱王朝，拿下设拉子和伊斯法罕，定都设拉子；他一度进占大不里士，终被札剌亦儿人逼退。1358年其子沙阿·舒贾将他刺瞎囚禁，穆巴里兹丁于1363年死于狱中。

沙阿·舒贾长期在位，使设拉子成为波斯文学中心，诗人哈菲兹在此创作，王朝还扩建亚兹德聚礼清真寺。1384年他死后诸子内讧，引来帖木儿：1387年伊斯法罕遭屠城，1393年帖木儿在设拉子击败并斩首沙阿·曼苏尔，又处死其余穆扎法尔王公，王朝灭亡，领土并入帖木儿帝国。

en: The Mazenjani were a Kurdish tribal polity whose chief held the citadel city of Erbil on the Erbil plain in the first half of the fourteenth century, when the surrounding Jazira region lay within the sphere of the Mongol Sutayid dynasty.
zh: 马赞贾尼是一个库尔德部落政权，其首领在14世纪上半叶据有埃尔比勒平原上以城堡闻名的埃尔比勒城，当时周边的杰济拉地区处在蒙古苏塔耶王朝的势力范围内。

en:
Muzaka was an Orthodox Albanian family's lordship in the Myzeqe lowlands of southern Albania. The family is first heard of around 1090; its chiefs bore Byzantine titles and played Angevin and imperial courts against each other by the late thirteenth century.

Andrea I ruled c. 1280 to 1319. Andrea II followed, received Constantinople's despot title in 1335 and joined the Angevin camp in 1336 as the Prince of Taranto's vassal. He defeated a Serbian army on Mount Pelister around 1340; Stefan Dušan overran the lands in 1343 to 1345. After Dušan's death the family re-emerged and seized Kastoria after the Battle of Marica in 1371. Andrea II died in 1372; his son Teodor fell against the Ottomans at Kosovo in 1389.

Ottoman annexation of Vlorë and Berat, 1415 to 1417, ended family rule. In 1444 Theodor Corona Musachi joined Skanderbeg's revolt; other kinsmen converted to Islam and entered Ottoman service, many exiles ending in Italy.
zh:
穆扎卡是南阿尔巴尼亚米泽切低地一个东正教贵族家族的领地。该家族最早见于1090年前后，族长有拜占庭头衔，13世纪末周旋安茹与帝国之间。

安德鲁一世约1280至1319年在位；继位的安德鲁二世1335年获拜占庭专制公衔，1336年转投安茹为塔兰托亲王附庸。约1340年败塞尔维亚军于佩利斯特山，斯特凡·杜尚1343至1345年吞并其地。杜尚死后其家复兴，1371年马里查战后取卡斯托里亚。安德鲁二世1372年卒；子狄奥多尔1389年科索沃抗奥斯曼阵亡。

1415至1417年奥斯曼吞并发罗拉、培拉特，统治告终。1444年狄奥多尔·科罗纳·穆扎基加入斯坎德培起义，另一些族人改宗伊斯兰教并出仕奥斯曼，许多流亡者在意大利终老。

en:
Tabaristan is the mountainous Caspian province later called Mazandaran, ruled from the seventh century by the Bavandids, an Iranian dynasty claiming descent from the Sasanian kings. They survived first as Zoroastrian highland princes resisting the Arab conquest, converted to Islam in the ninth century, and ruled as ispahbads, or kings of Tabaristan.

Three successive lines ruled: the Kayusiyya, the Ispahbadhiyya, centred at Sari, and the Kinakhwariyya, restored after the Mongol invasions of 1237 as vassals of the Ilkhans. In 1337 the Amol throne belonged to Hasan II, the last mainline Bavandid king. In 1349 his execution of a powerful noble provoked revolt, and his brother-in-law Kiya Afrasiyab murdered him and seized the kingdom.

Afrasiyab's Shia dynasty fell in 1359 to the sayyid Mir-i Buzurg, founder of the Marashi line; Shah Ismail's conquest of 1504 finally drew Mazandaran into the Safavid empire.
zh:
塔巴里斯坦是里海南岸多山省份，后称马赞达兰，7世纪起由巴文德王朝统治，自称出自萨珊王室。他们初为抵抗阿拉伯征服的祆教山地王公，9世纪改宗伊斯兰，以伊斯帕巴德（即塔巴里斯坦王）头衔统治。

王朝分三支相继统治：卡乌西亚支、定都萨里的伊斯帕赫巴德亚支，以及1237年蒙古入侵后作为伊利汗附庸复国的基纳赫瓦里亚支。1337年阿莫勒王位属于巴文德末代正统君主哈桑二世；1349年他处死强藩引发叛乱，姻兄基亚·阿弗拉西亚布将他谋害并篡夺王国。

阿弗拉西亚布的什叶派王朝1359年被圣裔米尔·布祖尔格推翻，后者建马拉什王朝；1504年伊斯玛仪一世征服马赞达兰，将其纳入萨非帝国。

en:
Misantla was a Totonac town in the Sierra de Chiconquiaco of northern Veracruz, in its namesake river valley; its Totonac name means the place of the deer. Originally Totonac, it was overrun in the late twelfth century by Chichimec followers of Mizantecuhtli, lord of Huejotla, leaving a Nahua minority beside the Totonac majority.

In 1486 Aztec armies made Misantla the seat of a strategic frontier province, its people carrying liquidambar resin as tribute to Tenochtitlan. When the Spanish arrived its tlatoani was Macuilcuauhhuitzli, and its market dealt in maize, cotton, fruit, fish and game from jaguars to parrots.

After the conquest Franciscan friars gathered the dispersed people into a mission town, moved in 1564 to the confluence of the Palchán and Misantla rivers and named Santa María de la Asunción Misantla, though native numbers fell sharply under colonial rule.
zh:
米桑特拉是韦拉克鲁斯北部奇孔基亚科山区的托托纳克城镇，在同名河谷上，托托纳克语意为鹿之地。此地本属托托纳克人，12世纪末被韦霍特拉领主米萨特库特利率奇奇梅克人攻占，托托纳克主体之外形成一支纳瓦人少数群体。

1486年阿兹特克军队将米桑特拉改为战略边疆省治所，当地人以枫香树脂为贡，运往特诺奇蒂特兰。西班牙人到来时，城主为马奎尔夸维特兹利，市上交易玉米、棉花、水果、鱼鲜以及美洲豹、鹦鹉等各类野味。

征服后，方济各会修士把分散人口集中为传教城镇，1564年迁至帕尔昌河与米桑特拉河交汇处，定名圣玛丽亚·德·拉·亚松森·米桑特拉，然原住民人口在殖民统治下剧减。

en:
The Mizawa were local lords of Izumo Province, based at Mizawa Castle and controlling iron-producing lands. In 1391 Mizawa Tametada died fighting for the Yamana in the Meitoku rebellion.

Mizawa Tamekiyo entered Mōri service in 1562 and helped defeat an Amago restoration army at Nunobeyama in 1570. His son Tametora was confined by Mōri Terumoto in 1589, but was later released and became a senior retainer of the Chōfu domain.
zh:
三泽氏是出云国的地方领主，以三泽城为据点，控制产铁的土地。1391年三泽为忠在明德之乱中为山名氏作战身亡。

三泽为清于1562年归附毛利氏，并在1570年布部山之战中协助击败尼子复兴军。其子为虎于1589年被毛利辉元幽禁，后来获释，成为长府藩的重臣。

en: The Naga comprise numerous peoples of the hills of present-day northeastern India and northwestern Myanmar, speaking distinct languages. Naga communities had contacts with the Ahom kingdom in the Brahmaputra valley; Burmese chronicles also describe the conquest of Naga country by the ruler of Mogaung in the mid-fourteenth century.
zh: 那加人包括今印度东北部和缅甸西北部山区的多个族群，使用不同语言。那加部落与布拉马普特拉河谷的阿洪姆王国有所往来；缅甸编年史还记载，孟拱统治者在14世纪中叶征服了那加地区。

en:
Nagar was a Burusho principality in the Nagar valley of Gilgit-Baltistan, its mountain-girt capital standing on the south bank of the river opposite Hunza.

Tradition holds that Hunza and Nagar once formed one state, ruled by a branch of the Shahreis, Gilgit's pre-Islamic ruling family, until the Thum Mayroo Khan split it between his twin sons. Ghirkis took the northern bank that became Hunza, Moghlot the southern, from whom Nagar's Mir family claimed descent. The separate principality took shape in the fourteenth century, Mayroo Khan traditionally regarded as its first Muslim Thum.

Its people were Burusho and Shina, speaking an older form of Burushaski, the steep terrain sheltering them from outside conquest. In 1337 and for centuries afterwards Nagar remained an autonomous mountain kingdom under Mirs of the Moghlot line.
zh:
那迦罗是布鲁绍人在那噶尔河谷建立的山邦，地处吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦，群山环抱的都城坐落在河南岸，与罕萨隔河相望。

相传罕萨与那迦罗本是一国，由吉尔吉特前伊斯兰统治家族沙赫雷斯的一支统治；后图姆迈鲁汗将国土分给双子：吉尔基斯得河北岸，后为罕萨，莫格洛特得河南岸，那迦罗弥尔家族自称出自其一脉。这个独立邦国在14世纪成形，传统上把迈鲁汗视为第一位信奉伊斯兰教的图姆。

居民为布鲁绍人与希纳人，使用较古老的布鲁沙斯基语，陡峻河谷替他们挡住外敌。1337年及其后数百年间，那迦罗始终是莫格洛特一脉弥尔统治下的自治山地王国。

en:
The Nagai were a branch of the Ōe family who held Nagai estate in Okitama district, Dewa Province, and made Yonezawa Castle their base. Their founder Tokihiro took the Nagai name from the estate; his son Yasuhide supported the Hōjō in the Hōji conflict of 1247.

Nagai Hirohide served Ashikaga Takauji and became his steward in 1335. The neighboring Date clan invaded Okitama in 1380 and, despite an initial repulse, seized Nagai lands in 1385, bringing the family into decline.
zh:
长井氏是大江氏的分支，领有出羽国置赐郡的长井庄，以米泽城为据点。始祖时广取庄园之名为氏，其子泰秀在1247年的宝治合战中支持北条氏。

长井广秀侍奉足利尊氏，1335年成为他的执事。邻近的伊达氏于1380年入侵置赐，虽然起初被击退，仍在1385年夺取长井氏的领地，使其走向衰落。

en: Nalaji was a Haixi Jurchen polity of the Ougen valley, the country registered under the Ming as the Ouhanhe Guard. Its commanders, including Gusen Sangguu, were Nara clansmen kin to the rulers of Ula and traced their line to Nacibulu, founder of the Hulun polity on the Songhua in 1406.
zh: 纳拉吉是欧根河流域的海西女真政权，其地明代设为呕罕河卫。卫中都督固森桑古鲁等首领属那拉氏，与乌拉国主同族，世系可上溯至1406年在松花江畔创立扈伦国的纳齐布禄。

en:
The County of Namur was a Holy Roman Empire lordship at the Sambre and Meuse confluence in Wallonia, capital fortified Namur, growing from the medieval pagus of Lomme: a count appears by 919, the title normal under Albert I around 990.

In 1190 Emperor Henry VI made it a margraviate. Baldwin of Courtenay, dispossessed Latin Emperor of Constantinople, sold his rights in 1263 to Guy of Dampierre, Count of Flanders, to fund recovery. In 1297 Guy enfeoffed it to his son John; Dampierre descendants ruled, Philip III holding it in 1337.

Last count John III sold Namur to Philip the Good of Burgundy in 1430, it joining the Seventeen Provinces of the Burgundian Netherlands. Habsburg rule made it a Catholic stronghold against Calvinism, with a bishopric from 1559; French armies conquered it in 1795, making it the department of Sambre-et-Meuse.
zh:
那慕尔伯国是神圣罗马帝国领地，在瓦隆尼亚桑布尔河与默兹河交汇处，治所设防城那慕尔，出自中世纪早期洛姆伯爵区：919年已有伯爵之名，约990年阿尔贝一世时期称号成为定制。

1190年皇帝亨利六世升为藩侯国。遭废黜的君士坦丁堡拉丁皇帝博杜安为筹措收复都城军费，1263年把权利卖给佛兰德斯伯爵当皮埃尔的居伊。1297年居伊把那慕尔封授儿子让，当皮埃尔后裔世代统治，1337年菲利普三世在位。

末代伯爵让三世1430年将那慕尔卖给勃艮第好人菲利普，入勃艮第尼德兰十七省。哈布斯堡时期为对抗加尔文宗的天主教堡垒，1559年设主教区；1795年法国征服，置桑布尔-默兹省。

en:
Naples lay south of the Papal States. The Normans united it with Sicily under Roger II, crowned in 1130. In 1266 the pope enfeoffed Charles of Anjou; the 1282 Sicilian Vespers drove the Angevin court from Palermo to Naples. Robert the Wise ruled from 1309, holding it in 1337; his 1343 death opened crisis: his granddaughter Joanna I was murdered in 1382, rivals fought until Aragon's Alfonso V, adopted by Joanna II, conquered it in 1442.

Charles VIII took Naples in 1494, but Spanish armies secured it for Aragon by 1504, confirmed by the 1559 Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis. Viceroys' taxation for Madrid's wars provoked revolt in 1647, Naples proclaiming a republic.

Rastatt gave it to Austria in 1714; a Spanish army conquered it in 1734, installing Charles of Bourbon, whose son Ferdinand IV ruled from 1759. French invasions set up the Parthenopean Republic in 1799 and kings Joseph Bonaparte and Joachim Murat from 1806. Murat's 1815 defeat at Tolentino restored Ferdinand, who merged Naples and Sicily into the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies in 1816.
zh:
那不勒斯王国统辖教皇国以南的土地。诺曼人在鲁杰罗二世治下把这些土地与西西里统一，他于1130年加冕称王；1266年教宗把王国封给安茹的查理，1282年西西里晚祷起义把安茹朝廷从巴勒莫赶到那不勒斯。1337年在位的是自1309年起统治的贤王罗伯特；他1343年去世后爆发继承危机：孙女乔万娜一世1382年遇害，两派争位直到乔万娜二世收阿方索五世为继承人，后者1442年征服王国。

1494年法王查理八世攻占那不勒斯，西班牙到1504年已替阿拉贡稳固占领，1559年《卡托-康布雷齐条约》确认其统治。总督治下，为马德里战争征税激起1647年起义，那不勒斯宣布成立共和国。

1714年《拉斯塔特条约》把它划给奥地利；1734年西班牙军队征服此地，拥立波旁的查理，其子费迪南多四世自1759年在位。法国入侵催生1799年的帕特诺珀共和国，1806年起约瑟夫·波拿巴、若阿尚·缪拉相继为王；1815年缪拉在托伦蒂诺战败，费迪南多复位，1816年合并那不勒斯与西西里，组建两西西里王国。

en:
The Nasu were warrior lords of northeastern Shimotsuke Province, with a base at Karasuyama Castle. The family split into upper and lower branches in the fifteenth century, before Nasu Sukefusa reunited them in 1514.

Nasu Sukeharu lost his domain in 1590 during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign, though his son Sukekage retained a small estate. The family regained daimyō status in the Edo period, but lost Karasuyama in 1687 after a succession dispute and continued as lesser retainers.
zh:
那须氏是下野国东北部的武家领主，以乌山城为据点。家族在15世纪分为上那须和下那须两支，1514年由那须资房重新统一。

1590年丰臣秀吉发动小田原征伐时，那须资晴失去领地，但其子资景保住了一小块采地。家族在江户时代重新成为大名，却于1687年因继承争端失去乌山，此后以较低身份延续家名。

en:
Navarre began as the Kingdom of Pamplona, a Basque polity proclaiming Íñigo Arista ruler around 824 in the Pyrenean buffer lands between the Carolingian Empire and the Emirate of Córdoba. Sancho III (d. 1035) brought it to its peak, but his will split it among his sons.

In 1199 to 1200 Alfonso VIII of Castile overran Álava, Biscay and Gipuzkoa, leaving Navarre a small mountain kingdom; the crown passed to France's House of Champagne in 1234. Joan I's 1284 marriage to Philip IV opened French rule, ending in 1328 when Joan II and Philip III resumed a Navarre governed from within.

Fifteenth-century strife let Ferdinand II of Aragon intervene: Castile took Pamplona in 1512 and annexed the south in 1515. Lower Navarre passed with Henry III to the French throne as Henry IV in 1589, merging into France in 1620.
zh:
纳瓦拉前身是潘普洛纳王国，讲巴斯克语，在加洛林帝国与科尔多瓦埃米尔国间比利牛斯缓冲地，约824年推伊尼戈·阿里斯塔为统治者。桑乔三世（1035年卒）时疆域最广，遗嘱分遗产于诸子。

1199—1200年卡斯蒂利亚阿方索八世吞并阿拉瓦、比斯开、吉普斯夸，纳瓦拉成狭小山地王国；1234年王位入法国香槟家族。胡安娜一世1284年嫁腓力四世，开法国统治，1328年胡安娜二世与腓力三世接手，本土复治。

15世纪王朝纷争予阿拉贡费尔南多二世良机：卡斯蒂利亚1512年取潘普洛纳，1515年吞南部。下纳瓦拉随亨利三世1589年以亨利四世之名登法国王位，1620年并入法国。

en:
The Nawa were a warrior family from Nawa in Hōki Province. Nawa Nagatoshi supported Emperor Go-Daigo and was killed fighting Ashikaga Takauji at Kyoto in 1336; his grandson Akioki later established himself at Furufumoto Castle in Higo.

The family fought the Sagara over Yatsushiro and moved to Uto Castle in 1504. In 1588 Toyotomi Hideyoshi's forces took Uto, ending Nawa rule there; descendants subsequently served the Tachibana of Yanagawa.
zh:
名和氏是出自伯耆国名和的武家。名和长年支持后醍醐天皇，1336年在京都与足利尊氏交战时阵亡；其孙显兴后来以肥后的古麓城为据点。

名和氏与相良氏争夺八代，1504年迁入宇土城。1588年丰臣秀吉的军队攻取宇土，结束了名和氏在当地的统治；其后裔此后侍奉柳川的立花氏。

en:
Naxos centred the Duchy of the Archipelago, a Venetian maritime state in the Cyclades founded after the Fourth Crusade. In 1207 Venetian Marco Sanudo landed with eight galleys, mastering Naxos by 1210 after besieging Apalyros. He then conquered Paros, Melos and the rest of the Cyclades, ruled as duke and split Naxos into fifty-six fiefs.

Islanders stayed mostly Orthodox under Catholic lords; the duchy was a vassal of the Latin emperors, princes of Achaea from 1248 and Naples' Angevin kings from 1278. In the late thirteenth century Byzantine Licario reduced Marco II Sanudo to Naxos and Paros, the lost islands returning by 1310. Nicholas Sanudo was duke in 1337.

Crispo rule began in 1383; as piracy spread, the duchy placed itself under Venice in 1418. Ottoman fleets made it a tributary in 1537; Selim II deposed the last Crispo duke in 1566, granting the islands to Joseph Nasi. The duchy was annexed in 1579.
zh:
纳克索斯为群岛公国中心，第四次十字军后所建基克拉泽斯威尼斯国家。1207年威尼斯人马尔科·萨努多率八桨船至，围阿帕利罗斯，1210年控全岛；继征帕罗斯、米洛斯及群岛其余岛屿，自立公爵，分地为五十六邑。

岛民在天主教领主治下多奉东正教；公国先后附庸拉丁皇帝、亚该亚亲王（1248年起）、那不勒斯安茹国王（1278年起）。13世纪末拜占庭将利卡里奥斯反攻，马尔科二世仅余纳克索斯、帕罗斯，失地1310年复。1337年公爵尼古拉斯·萨努多。

克里斯科1383年夺权，海盗起，1418年附威尼斯。1537年奥斯曼迫其纳贡；1566年塞利姆二世废末代克里斯科，以群岛封约瑟夫·纳西，1579年吞并。

en:
Nubhor, the Western Hor, was a confederation of Tibetanised Mongol pastoral tribes on the upper Salween grasslands, around the Biru, Sog, Tengchen and Riwoche districts of northern Tibet; Hor and Sog both mean Mongol in Tibetan. They grazed the high country between Chamdo and the Nagchu plateau under Lhasa's loose overlordship.

Under the Qing they were registered as the Thirty-nine Hor Tribes: in 1731 they counted 4,889 households, each tribe headed by a Thousand- or Hundred-Household chief holding a War Ministry licence. By the late eighteenth century one supreme Thousand-Household chief stood over thirteen hundred-household chiefs and fifty-three headmen, while a Mongol-affairs secretary under the Lhasa amban collected their horse tribute and judged their disputes.
zh:
西霍尔意为西部霍尔，是藏化蒙古游牧部落组成的联合体，牧地在怒江上游草原，即西藏北部比如、索县、丁青、类乌齐一带；霍尔与索克在藏语中都带有蒙古之意。诸部在昌都与那曲高原之间的高地放牧，松散地臣属拉萨。

清代被编为霍尔三十九族，1731年共有4889户，各部设千户或百户，由兵部颁给执照；18世纪末设总千户一人，下辖十三名百户、五十三名百长。驻藏大臣属下的夷情章京专管其马赋与刑名。

en:
The Nanbu were a warrior family from Kai who established themselves in northern Mutsu. In the fourteenth century Nanbu Motoyuki built Ne Castle for the Southern Court, while another branch supported the Northern Court; the branches made peace in 1393.

In 1590 Nanbu Nobunao submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, who confirmed his lands but recognized the independence of the rival Tsugaru. Nobunao began building Morioka Castle in 1592, and his son Toshinao became the first lord of Morioka under the Tokugawa shogunate.
zh:
南部氏是出自甲斐、在陆奥北部建立势力的武家。14世纪南部师行为南朝修筑根城，另一支则支持北朝；两支于1393年讲和。

1590年南部信直归顺丰臣秀吉，获确认领地，但敌对的津轻氏也获承认为独立大名。信直于1592年开始修建盛冈城，其子利直成为德川幕府治下的首任盛冈藩主。

en: The Nambya are a people of northwestern Zimbabwe and northeastern Botswana, related to the Kalanga. Their traditions describe a migration from Great Zimbabwe under the chief Denderende Sawanga and settlement around Dete and Bumbusi.
zh: 南比亚人居住在今津巴布韦西北部和博茨瓦纳东北部，与卡兰加人有亲缘关系。传说他们在首领登德伦德·萨旺加率领下从大津巴布韦迁出，在德特和本布西一带定居。

en: The Niuachi, or Missouria, were a Siouan-speaking people near the junction of the Grand and Missouri rivers. Jacques Marquette contacted them in 1673, and the French built Fort Orleans nearby in 1723. A Sauk and Meskwaki attack in 1730 killed hundreds; many survivors joined the Otoe, and after a smallpox outbreak in 1829 the remaining Missouria joined them.
zh: 纽阿奇又称密苏里亚人，是讲苏族语的族群，定居在格兰德河与密苏里河交汇处附近。雅克·马凯特于1673年与他们接触，法国人于1723年在附近修建奥尔良堡。1730年索克人和梅斯夸基人的袭击杀死数百人，许多幸存者加入奥托人；1829年天花流行后，余下的密苏里亚人也加入了奥托人。

en:
Nangchen was a Tibetan tusi polity on the Yushu grasslands of southern Qinghai. Its rulers bore the clan name Dri, one of ancient Tibet's six great clans, and the title Nangchen, meaning inner minister, from an ancestor holding it under the old Tibetan Empire.

After its collapse, forty-seventh leader Wa Alu made himself king of Nangchen and in 1175 submitted to the Southern Song, recognised as the first tusi. Mongol general Godan Khan invaded in 1239; Wa Alu's successor Ayowa submitted, and the Yuan confirmed the clan over its six tribes.

Kagyu devotees, the kings were attacked early in the Qing period by Beri's Bön ruler, but in 1639 Güshi Khan of the Khoshut helped defeat the invaders. They paid Lhasa tribute until 1726, when Yongzheng divided the Tibetan regions between administrations and put them under the Xining amban as Thousand-Household chief over Nangchen, Chengduo and Yushu.
zh:
囊谦是玉树草原的藏族土司政权，地在青海南部；统治家族姓智，为藏族古代六大姓之一，因祖先曾任吐蕃内大相，遂以藏语意为内大相的囊谦为号。

吐蕃崩溃后，第四十七代首领者哇阿路割据囊谦自立为王，1175年内附南宋，受封第一代土司。1239年蒙古将阔端入侵，继任者阿约哇归附，元朝承认其对六部落的统治。

王室奉噶举派，清初遭苯教白利土司进攻，1639年和硕特固始汗助击退敌。囊谦向拉萨朝贡至1726年，雍正帝行藏区分治，划归西宁办事大臣，封统辖囊谦、称多、玉树三地的囊谦千户。

en:
The Natchez chiefdom occupied the bluffs of the lower Mississippi, with its center at the Grand Village by 1700. Its paramount chief, the Great Sun, belonged to a ruling lineage traced through women.

In 1729 the Natchez attacked Fort Rosalie after its French commandant demanded village land. French and Choctaw forces defeated them in 1731; many captives were enslaved, while others sought refuge among the Chickasaw, Creek and Cherokee.
zh:
纳奇兹酋邦位于密西西比河下游的崖岸，至1700年其中心已转移到纳奇兹大村。最高酋长“大太阳”属于按母系传承的统治家族。

1729年，法国指挥官索取村庄土地后，纳奇兹人袭击了罗萨莉堡。1731年法国人与乔克托人联军击败纳奇兹人，许多俘虏沦为奴隶，另一些人则投奔奇克索人、克里克人和切罗基人。

en: The Nakoda, also known as the Stoney, were a Siouan-speaking people of the northern Plains and Rocky Mountain foothills. In 1754–1755 Anthony Henday camped with Stoney families near present-day Red Deer in Alberta. They traded and allied with the Cree and belonged to the Iron Confederacy.
zh: 纳科达又称斯托尼人，是北部大平原和落基山麓讲苏族语的族群。1754—1755年，安东尼·亨代记载了他在今艾伯塔省红鹿市附近与斯托尼家庭扎营的经历。当时他们已与克里人交易并结为军事盟友；斯托尼人也是北部大平原诸族所组成的铁联盟的成员。

en:
Nandan was a Zhuang tusi in the mountains of northern Guangxi, centred on the valley of Nandan County in Hechi. The Tang held it as a loose-reign prefecture, and in 974 Zhuang chief Mo Hongyan submitted to the Northern Song, recognised as prefect of Nandan with an official seal. Mo clan descendants succeeded unbroken; when Mo Shiren sent tribute in 1080 the court issued a new prefecture seal.

Under the Yuan it became an appeasement commission grouped with Qingyuan, and in 1395 the Ming stationed a military guard beside the native administration. Mo chiefs continued to rule their Zhuang subjects through the Ming and Qing, making Nandan one of the longest-lived native chieftaincies of the Guangxi uplands.
zh:
南丹是广西北部山区的壮族土司，中心在河池市南丹县一带谷地。唐代为羁縻州地，974年壮族土酋莫洪曣归附宋朝，任南丹州刺史并获赐刺史印。莫氏子孙世袭，1080年莫世忍入贡，朝廷另赐新南丹州印。

元代南丹州改安抚司，与庆远合一；1395年明朝于南丹设卫所，与土官衙门并存。莫氏首领在明清两代继续治理境内壮族部民，南丹也成为广西山地延续最久的土司之一。

en: The Ñandeva are a Guarani-speaking people of the Atlantic Forest, from eastern Paraguay and Argentina's Misiones region to southern Brazil. Their speech is closely related to Mbyá Guarani.
zh: 南德瓦是大西洋森林中说瓜拉尼语的人群，居住地从巴拉圭东部和阿根廷的米西奥内斯延伸到巴西南部。他们所说的语言与姆比亚瓜拉尼语关系密切。

en:
The Dutch Republic emerged from the revolt of the Netherlands against Spanish rule. Northern provinces formed the Union of Utrecht in 1579, rejected Philip II in 1581 and established a republic in 1588, with the States General meeting at The Hague.

Spain recognised its independence in the Peace of Münster in 1648, while retaining the southern Netherlands. The Dutch East and West India Companies built overseas trading and colonial networks, and painters such as Rembrandt worked during the republic's seventeenth-century Golden Age. In 1795 a revolution backed by French forces replaced the republic with the Batavian Republic.
zh:
尼德兰共和国兴起于尼德兰反抗西班牙统治的起义。北方诸省于1579年结成乌得勒支同盟，1581年宣布废黜腓力二世，1588年建立共和国，三级会议在海牙召开。

西班牙在1648年的《明斯特和约》中承认共和国独立，同时保住尼德兰南部。荷兰东印度公司和西印度公司建立了海外贸易与殖民网络，伦勃朗等画家活跃于共和国17世纪的黄金时代。1795年，在法国军队支持下发生的革命以巴达维亚共和国取代了这一共和国。

en:
The Triarchy of Negroponte was the Latin state on Euboea off eastern Greece, created after the Fourth Crusade. In 1205 three Veronese barons of the dalle Carceri circle split the island into thirds ruled from Oreos, Karystos and Chalkis, capital also called Negroponte. Ravano dalle Carceri became sole lord in 1209 under Venice.

In the 1255–1262 succession war the triarchs and Venice fought Prince William II of Achaea. Later Byzantine renegade Licario overran most of the island, until Latins drove the Byzantines out by 1296. The Catalan Company took Karystos in 1317 and Venice bought it in 1365; in 1337 Lombard triarch Peter dalle Carceri held Chalkis under Venice.

The last triarchs dying in 1383 and 1390, their lands passed to Venice, which ruled Euboea as a colony until Mehmed II stormed Chalkis in 1470, bringing all of Euboea under Ottoman rule.
zh:
内格罗蓬特三主国是第四次十字军后建于埃维亚岛的拉丁政权。1205年达莱·卡尔切里圈子的三位维罗纳男爵三分其地，治奥雷奥斯、卡里斯托斯与首府哈尔基斯（又名内格罗蓬特）。拉瓦诺1209年成唯一领主，受威尼斯庇护。

1255—1262年继承战，三领主联威尼斯敌亚该亚亲王威廉二世。此后拜占庭叛将利卡里奥斯攻占大半个岛，拉丁人1296年前逐走拜占庭人。1317年加泰罗尼亚佣兵团取卡里斯托斯，威尼斯1365年购；1337年伦巴第人彼得·达莱·卡尔切里在威尼斯势力内据哈尔基斯。

末任领主1383、1390年卒，地入威尼斯，埃维亚成殖民地；1470年穆罕默德二世陷哈尔基斯，全岛归奥斯曼。

en: Nekok Yaotl, or Nicoya, was a Chorotega chiefdom centred on the Nicoya Peninsula in present-day Costa Rica. Subordinate chiefs around the Gulf of Nicoya depended on its ruler, while a council of elders selected the monarch. In 1522 Gil González Dávila visited the ruler Nicoya, collected gold and had thousands of people baptized; Nicoya was later succeeded by Nambí.
zh: 内科克尧特尔又称尼科亚，是以今哥斯达黎加尼科亚半岛为中心的乔罗特加酋邦。尼科亚湾周围的酋长从属于它的统治者，而君主由长老议事会选出。1522年，希尔·冈萨雷斯·达维拉拜访统治者尼科亚，收取黄金并为数千人施洗；尼科亚后来由南比继任。

en:
Nellenburg was a county, later landgraviate, in Hegau between Swabian Alb and Lake Constance, centred on the castle above Stockach. Its first comital line descended from Eberhardinger counts of the Zürichgau and held it from the mid-tenth century; Count Eberhard founded Allerheiligen abbey at Schaffhausen in 1049, the line dying out in the male line around 1105.

The lordship passed first to Bürglen lords and around 1170 to Veringen counts, whose branch united it with Hegau before 1256 and took the landgrave title from Rudolf of Habsburg after the Staufer fell. The counts founded Stockach in the thirteenth century, securing town privileges in 1283.

That line dying out in 1422, Tengen lords inherited and sold it to Habsburgs in 1465. Further Austria held it until 1805, Stockach holding its high court and surviving a Three Leagues siege in the 1499 Swabian War, then passing to Württemberg in 1805 and Baden in 1810.
zh:
内伦堡是施瓦本阿尔布与博登湖间黑高的伯国，后升领地伯爵领，以施托卡赫上方城堡为中心。首个伯爵世家出自苏黎世高埃伯哈丁格家族，10世纪中叶据有该堡；埃伯哈德伯爵1049年在沙夫豪森创诸圣修道院，约1105年男系绝嗣。

地先归比格伦领主，约1170年转费林根伯爵；其支系1256年前并黑高伯国，施陶芬倒台后受哈布斯堡鲁道夫册封领地伯爵。伯爵13世纪建施托卡赫，1283年取得城市权。

1422年世绝，领地伯爵领传滕根领主，1465年卖与哈布斯堡。此后至1805年属前奥地利，施托卡赫为高等法院驻地，1499年施瓦本战争中顶住三盟围攻，1805年归符腾堡，1810年入巴登。

en: Nemer was a Haixi Jurchen group of the lower Nen basin, named after the Nemor river, called Nemer Bira in Manchu, a name meaning tender in Manchu and autumn in Mongolian. The river flows west from the Hailun highlands into the Nen, through country shared by forest Jurchen and Mongol herdsmen.
zh: 内梅尔是嫩江下游一带的海西女真群体，得名于讷谟尔河，满语称讷默尔必拉；河名在满语中意为嫩，在蒙古语中意为秋。该河自海伦一带山地西流注入嫩江，两岸是森林女真与蒙古牧人交错活动之地。

en:
Neopatria, the Catalan Duchy of Neopatras, covered southern Thessaly around old Neopatras, whose Doukas rulers Westerners mistakenly styled dukes reading their family name as a title. When Thessalian ruler John II Doukas died heirless in 1318, the Catalan Company, already master of Athens, marched north under Alfonso Fadrique and took Neopatras in 1319. By 1325 it held Zetounion and other fortresses, ruled as five captaincies under Sicily's crown.

Infant Manfred, son of Frederick III of Sicily, was named duke, real power lying with a vicar-general and the Company's elected marshal; Athens and Neopatras were henceforth ruled together.

Stefan Dušan overran most Thessalian lands in 1348, leaving only the district around Neopatras to the Catalans. The Navarrese Company and Florentine Nerio Acciaioli squeezed them until Acciaioli took Athens in 1388 and Neopatras in 1390. Ottomans overran the Spercheios valley and took the town in 1393 or 1394.
zh:
新帕特里亚即加泰罗尼亚人的新帕特拉斯公国，据色萨利南部，以新帕特拉斯为中心；西方人误称杜卡斯氏新帕特拉斯公爵，盖以家族名为爵。1318年色萨利统治者约翰二世·杜卡斯无嗣卒，据雅典的加泰罗尼亚佣兵团由阿方索·法德里克北上，1319年取新帕特拉斯，1325年占泽图尼翁等要塞，组五队长区公国属西西里王权。

西西里国王腓特烈三世子曼弗雷德幼龄立为公爵，实权归总督查与佣兵团选出的统帅，雅典与新帕特拉斯两公国自此合治。

1348年斯特凡·杜尚席卷色萨利大部分领地，加泰罗尼亚仅余新帕特拉斯周边；纳瓦拉佣兵团与佛罗伦萨的内里·阿恰约利进逼，后者1388年取雅典、1390年取新帕特拉斯。1393或1394年奥斯曼入斯佩尔赫奥斯河谷取城。

en:
County of Neuchâtel, on its namesake lake between Jura and Swiss plateau, began with a new castle, Latin novum castellum, recorded on its hill in 1011 under Rudolph III of Burgundy. On his heirless death in 1032 the land passed to the Empire; Conrad II enfeoffing Ulrich of Fenis, first of the House of Neuchâtel, as count in 1034, Henry III confirming in 1046.

Counts allied with the Swiss Confederation: Fribourg (1290), Bern (1308). Countess Elisabeth's death ending the native line in 1395, the county passed to south German lords, then after a 1457 dispute to Hachberg-Sausenberg margraves.

In 1504 heiress Jeanne married Louis d'Orléans, bringing the county under a French princely house. Swiss cantons held it from 1512 to 1529, subjects adopting Reformation in the 1530s. Raised to a principality in the seventeenth century, in 1707 it passed to the Hohenzollern kings of Prussia in personal union on Marie de Nemours' death.
zh:
纳沙泰尔伯国在侏罗山与瑞士高原间同名湖畔，起于1011年勃艮第国王鲁道夫三世时记载的山上新城堡，拉丁语novum castellum，地名由此来。1032年鲁道夫无嗣卒，地入帝国；1034年康拉德二世封纳沙泰尔家族始祖费尼的乌尔里希为伯爵，1046年亨利三世确认。

伯爵结好瑞士邦联：1290年联弗里堡、1308年联伯尔尼。1395年女伯爵伊丽莎白卒，本族绝嗣，伯国转南德诸侯，1457年继承纠纷后属哈赫贝格-绍森贝格藩侯。

1504年女继承人让娜嫁路易·德·奥尔良，伯国归法国宗室；1512—1529年瑞士诸州领有其地，臣民16世纪30年代接受宗教改革。17世纪升亲王国，1707年玛丽·德·内穆尔卒，传普鲁士霍亨索伦共主。

en:
The County of Nevers, centred on the Loire town of Nevers, took shape around the start of the tenth century over the later Nivernais. Long held with neighbouring Auxerre, it was tied to Burgundy's dukes, Henry I among its lords.

In the fourteenth century it passed by marriage to Flanders' Dampierre counts: Louis I, count of Flanders, Nevers and Rethel, ruled from 1322 but was driven from Flanders by Jacob van Artevelde's 1339 revolt and fell at Crécy in 1346. His granddaughter Margaret III brought it to Valois duke Philip the Bold of Burgundy, whose younger son Philip II founded a separate Nevers line; a Cleves cadet branch followed.

In 1539 it was raised to a duchy, and Louis Gonzaga gained it in 1565 by marrying Henriette of Cleves; the last Gonzaga duke sold the Nivernais to Cardinal Mazarin, whose family kept the title until the Revolution.
zh:
讷韦尔伯国以卢瓦尔河畔讷韦尔为中心，约10世纪初形成，辖地即后来的尼韦奈。它长期与相邻欧塞尔伯国合并，与勃艮第公爵关系密切，亨利一世也曾是其领主。

14世纪随婚姻转入佛兰德当皮埃尔家族：身兼佛兰德、讷韦尔、勒泰勒伯爵的路易一世1322年起统治，1339年被雅各布·范阿特维尔德起义逐出佛兰德，1346年战死克雷西。孙女玛格丽特三世把它带给勃艮第瓦卢瓦公爵大胆的腓力，幼子腓力二世另立讷韦尔支系，后由克莱沃公爵旁支承袭。

1539年伯国升公国；1565年路易·贡扎加娶克莱沃的亨丽埃特得之，末代贡扎加公爵后把尼韦奈卖给枢机主教马萨林，其家族保有头衔直到法国大革命。

en:
Neyen is the Jurchen tribe named after the Neyen river on the upper Songhua, one of the three Changbai Mountain tribes grouped with the Jianzhou Jurchens under Ming rule. In 1593 its men joined the Jusheri in a Yehe-led nine-tribe coalition against Nurhaci and, after defeat at Gure, raided a Jianzhou border hold with Yehe troops.

Leaders Sowen and Sekeshi then gathered seven villages' people into the fortified mountain camp of Fotuohe. Nurhaci sent three chief captains, Eidu, Gagai and Anfiyanggū, with a thousand men; after a three-month siege the camp fell and the two leaders were killed. The Neyen were absorbed into Nurhaci's realm and in time enrolled among the Eight Banners.
zh:
讷殷是因松花江上游讷殷河得名的女真部落，为长白山三部之一，在明朝边务体系中与建州女真同列。1593年讷殷兵与朱舍里一同加入叶赫牵头的九部联军攻打努尔哈赤，古勒山战败后，又引叶赫兵袭取建州东部洞寨。

首领搜稳、塞克什收拢七寨部众，据守佛多和山寨。努尔哈赤命额亦都、噶盖、安费扬古三大臣领兵千人围攻，三个月后山寨告破，二人被杀。讷殷就此并入努尔哈赤版图，后编入八旗。

en:
The Negüderi, or Qara'unas, were Mongol garrison troops settled in the Afghan highlands. Mongol tamna soldiers posted near the Indian frontier from 1238 watched the Delhi Sultanate, and the community took shape in 1262, when Jochid Golden Horde troops, fleeing the quarrel of Berke and Hülegü, poured into Afghanistan and were led on raids by the general Neguder, from whom they took their name. They wintered around Ghazni and summered in Ghur, raiding India; Marco Polo found them mixed, Mongol soldiers joined by Turkish and Indian women.

In the fourteenth century they ranked among the Chagatai Khanate's military groups, and emirs Qazaghan and his son Abdullah became the real masters of the western khanate until a Barlas and Suldus revolt in 1359.

Timur himself served with the Qara'unas under Qazaghan's grandson Husayn before turning on him and taking Transoxiana in 1370; the Negüderi were subdued in the 1380s and formed a large part of Timur's armies. Babur records their descendants still speaking Mongolian around Ghazni in the late fifteenth century.
zh:
捏兀迭里人又称喀劳纳人，是定居阿富汗高地的蒙古戍军。1238年起，蒙古探马赤军驻于印度边境监视德里苏丹国；1262年共同体成形，金帐汗国的术赤系军队为避别儿哥与旭烈兀反目涌入阿富汗，在将领捏古答儿率领下袭掠，捏兀迭里之名即由他而来。他们在加兹尼一带过冬，在古尔度夏，南下劫掠印度；马可·波罗发现他们已是混血族群，蒙古士兵与突厥、印度妇女通婚。

14世纪时，他们位列察合台汗国的军事集团，埃米尔喀扎甘及其子阿卜杜拉成为西汗国的实际主人，直到1359年巴鲁剌思和速勒都思贵族起兵。

帖木儿本人曾在喀扎甘之孙侯赛因麾下与喀劳纳人并肩作战，随后倒戈，1370年夺取河中；捏兀迭里人14世纪80年代被征服后，构成帖木儿大军的重要部分。巴布尔记载，15世纪末他们的后裔在加兹尼周围仍说蒙古语。

en:
Ngā Oho was a Māori iwi of Tāmaki Makaurau, the Auckland region. By the 14th century its people had settled in the Waitākere Ranges; later, a branch was based at Papakura.

In the 17th century Hua Kaiwaka united Ngā Oho with Ngā Riki and Ngā Iwi in the Waiohua confederation. Waiohua dominance ended in the mid-18th century after its chief Kiwi Tāmaki was killed fighting Te Taoū and Ngāti Whātua warriors.
zh:
雅沃霍是塔马基毛考劳，即奥克兰地区的毛利部族。到14世纪，其族人已在怀塔凯雷山脉定居；后来其中一支以帕帕库拉为据点。

17世纪，华·凯瓦卡将雅沃霍、雅里基和雅伊维联合为怀奥华联盟。18世纪中叶，联盟首领基维·塔马基在与特陶乌和雅提法图阿战士交战时阵亡，怀奥华的优势地位随之结束。

en: Ngali denotes a small Sumbawan, or Samawa, chiefdom on western Sumbawa, centred near present Sumbawa Besar and the nearby Pulau Ngali. In the fourteenth century this coast was a Majapahit dependency keeping Hindu and animist traditions, until its local chiefdoms merged into the Sumbawa Sultanate from 1648 as Islam spread.
zh: 恩加利指称松巴哇岛西部的一个松巴哇（萨马瓦）小邦，中心在今松巴哇大镇与附近的恩加利岛一带。14世纪时这里是满者伯夷的附庸，保留印度教和万物有灵传统；17世纪伊斯兰教传入，当地小邦于1648年并入松巴哇苏丹国。

en:
The Naganuma were a branch of the Oyama family, named for their estate in Shimotsuke Province. During the wars of the Northern and Southern Courts, Naganuma Hidenao moved to the family's holdings at Nagae in Mutsu Province. His son Yoshihide gained recognition of his claim to Naganuma estate in 1399 and returned there with the backing of Kamakura.

The main line was later driven out or destroyed during the Kyōtoku War. Another branch took the name Minagawa; Minagawa Hiroteru secured his lands by submitting to Tokugawa Ieyasu during the Odawara campaign of 1590.
zh:
长沼氏是小山氏的分支，以其下野国的庄园为名。南北朝战乱期间，长沼秀直迁往家族在陆奥国的长江庄。其子义秀于1399年获得对长沼庄的领有认可，并在镰仓方面支持下返回。

宗家后来在享德之乱中被逐或灭亡。另一支改称皆川氏；1590年小田原征伐期间，皆川广照投降德川家康，保住了自己的领地。

en:
The Nagano were a branch of the Kudō family who held lands in central Ise Province. During the Northern and Southern Courts period they backed the Northern Court against the Kitabatake, and the two families continued to contest Ise thereafter.

In 1558 Nagano Fujisada made peace with Kitabatake Tomonori and adopted his son Tomofuji as heir. Oda Nobunaga invaded Ise in 1568; the Nagano surrendered in 1569 and accepted his brother Nobukane as their head. The family and retainers dispersed after Nobukane lost his fief in 1594.
zh:
长野氏是工藤氏的一个支系，领有伊势国中部的土地。南北朝时代，长野氏支持北朝，对抗北畠氏；此后两家继续争夺伊势。

1558年，长野藤定与北畠具教议和，收其子具藤为养嗣子。织田信长于1568年进攻伊势，长野氏次年投降，接受信长的弟弟信包为家主。1594年信包被没收领地后，长野一族和家臣四散。

en: Ngāti Ranginui is a Māori iwi of the Tauranga area in New Zealand's Bay of Plenty. In local tradition its ancestor Ranginui, a son of Tamatea-pokai-whenua of the Tākitimu canoe, remained at Tauranga and settled along the Wairoa River while his brothers moved elsewhere.
zh: 雅提拉宜努伊是新西兰丰盛湾陶朗加地区的毛利部族。当地传统称，其祖先拉宜努伊是塔基蒂穆独木舟上的塔马泰阿·波凯费努阿之子；他的兄弟迁往别处，而他留在陶朗加的怀罗阿河畔定居。

en: The Nguni were related Bantu-speaking peoples of southern Africa, including the Xhosa, Swazi and Zulu. In the 1810s Shaka brought rival clans together in the Zulu Kingdom, centred in what is now KwaZulu-Natal.
zh: 恩古尼是南部非洲一组语言相近的班图语民族，包括科萨人、斯威士人和祖鲁人。19世纪10年代，沙卡将多个敌对氏族纳入祖鲁王国，其中心位于今夸祖鲁-纳塔尔地区。

en:
Ningzhou was a native department in central-eastern Yunnan between Jiangchuan and Huaning, where the Ningbu Yi had long lived. The Tang briefly kept Li Prefecture before Nanzhao overran it in the mid-eighth century; the native name was Langkuang, meaning a dry dragon.

Xiemotu people of the Buxiong tribe once held it, until Cuan chief A Ji ceded Langkuang to Dou Gui, chief of the Ning, giving the country its later name. In 1254 Ning chief Puti submitted to the Mongols, ruling walled Xishalong as a ten-thousand-household chief.

The administration became successively the Ningbu Ten-Thousand-Household and Ninghai Prefecture, then Ningzhou under Lin'an Route in the Zhiyuan reign, governing Tonghai, Xi'e and Xisha. Xisha County, founded in 1276 around old Xishalong, was attached to Ningzhou in 1289 and merged back into it in 1322. The Ming and Qing retained the department under Lin'an Prefecture.
zh:
宁州是滇中以东的土州，在江川、华宁一带，宁部蛮世代居此。唐朝曾短暂设黎州，8世纪中期其地被南诏攻占；夷语称浪旷，意为旱龙。

步雄部些莫徒人曾据此地，后爨蛮首领阿几把浪旷割让给宁部首领豆圭，此地遂称宁部。1254年宁部首领普提归附蒙古，坐镇所筑西沙笼城，受任万户。

此后先后改置宁部万户、宁海府，至元年间改宁州，隶临安路，领通海、嶍峨、西沙三县。西沙县1276年立于旧西沙笼城，1289年划归宁州，1322年并入州中。明清保留宁州建制，仍隶临安府。

en:
Nordhausen, at the southern foot of the Harz, first appears in 927 in Henry the Fowler's charter; the king built a castle on the Zorge. Long an imperial estate, granted to a nuns' chapter in 1158 under Barbarossa, it returned to the crown under Frederick II in 1220 and became a free imperial city under Mühlhausen's law.

In the fourteenth century burghers had to fend off extortions by the Counts of Hohnstein. In 1306 Nordhausen joined Erfurt and Mühlhausen in a Thuringian city alliance, entering the Hanseatic League with them in 1430.

It was one of the first cities to accept the Reformation in 1523, hosting Thomas Müntzer within its walls, though the cathedral chapter stayed Catholic under Habsburg protection. The Thirty Years' War broke its prosperity; Prussian troops occupied it in 1802, mediatisation ending free-city status; in 1807 it passed to the Kingdom of Westphalia.
zh:
诺德豪森在哈茨山南麓，最早见927年捕鸟者亨利的特许状，亨利还在佐尔格河畔建城堡。它本是皇室领地，1158年巴巴罗萨赐给修女院，1220年腓特烈二世治下归还皇室，后成为帝国自由城市，采用米尔豪森城市法。

14世纪市民须挡霍恩施泰因伯爵的勒索；1306年诺德豪森与爱尔福特、米尔豪森结图林根城市同盟，1430年随二者加入汉萨同盟。

1523年托马斯·闵采尔曾在此停留，诺德豪森为最早接受宗教改革的城市之一，唯主教座堂圣职团在哈布斯堡庇护下仍奉天主教。三十年战争终结其繁荣；1802年普鲁士军队占领，采邑调解废除自由城市地位，1807年入威斯特伐利亚王国。

en:
The County of Nidda was a small Holy Roman Empire state in the northern Wetterau, built from Fulda Abbey fiefs. In 1064 the abbey formed its estates into the Bingenheim jurisdiction, soon called the County of Nidda, and enfeoffed its advocacy to the lords of Malsburg, who first took the title in 1104.

On Count Berthold II's childless death in 1206, Nidda passed to his nephew Louis I of Ziegenhain. A junior line ruled until Engelbert I died sonless in 1329; his daughter Lukardis married John I of Ziegenhain, who united the counties in 1333 and ruled in 1337.

John's feud with Fulda Abbey ended in an imperial ban and a mediated peace in 1331, and debt forced him to sell a quarter of Nidda to Mainz in 1344. Nidda became an immediate county in 1420; on John II's childless death in 1450 it passed with Ziegenhain to Hesse, then Hesse-Marburg and Hesse-Darmstadt.
zh:
尼达伯国是神圣罗马帝国在韦特劳北缘的小邦，由富尔达修道院采邑拼成。1064年，修道院将产业组为宾根海姆辖区，不久称尼达伯国，并把护院之职封给马尔斯堡领主，其于1104年首次称伯爵。

1206年贝托尔德二世伯爵无嗣而终，尼达传外甥齐根海恩的路德维希一世。后旁系统治至1329年恩格尔贝特一世无男嗣而亡；其女卢卡尔迪斯嫁给齐根海恩的约翰一世，约翰1333年合并两伯国，1337年在位。

约翰与富尔达修道院的仇杀以帝国禁令和1331年调停和约收场，1344年他因债将尼达四分之一产业卖给美因茨。1420年尼达成为帝国直属伯国；1450年约翰二世无嗣去世，尼达随齐根海恩归入黑森，后属黑森‑马尔堡与黑森‑达姆施塔特。

en:
Nienburg was the eastern share of the Hoya inheritance on the middle Weser, centred on Nienburg town. First recorded in 1025 as Negenborg, it grew around a Weser ford, and in 1215 Count Henry I of Hoya made it his line's residence.

In 1337 John II of Hoya held it; his 1345 partition of the county with his brother Gerhard III created a separate Nienburg branch. When the elder Hoya branch died out in 1497 the parts reunited under Count Jobst I at Nienburg, and in 1582 the county passed to the Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg.
zh:
宁堡是霍亚遗产在威悉河中游的东部部分，以宁堡镇为中心。该地1025年首见记载，称内根堡，凭威悉河一处渡口兴起，1215年霍亚伯爵海因里希一世定为家族驻地。

1337年霍亚的约翰二世在位；1345年他与其兄格哈德三世瓜分伯国，另立宁堡支系。1497年霍亚长支绝嗣，各部分在宁堡的约布斯特一世治下重归统一，1582年伯国转入韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵之手。

en:
The Nitta were a warrior family of Nitta estate in Kōzuke Province, descended from the Minamoto. Nitta Yoshisada captured Kamakura in 1333, bringing down the shogunate, and fought for Emperor Go-Daigo against Ashikaga Takauji.

Defeated at Minatogawa in 1336, Yoshisada retreated to Echizen and died fighting in 1338. His sons continued the Southern Court's struggle, but the main line declined; the Iwamatsu branch retained a small estate in Kōzuke under the Tokugawa.
zh:
新田氏是源氏的后裔，以此得名的上野国新田庄为根据地。新田义贞于1333年攻陷镰仓，推翻幕府，随后为后醍醐天皇对抗足利尊氏。

义贞于1336年在凑川战败，退往越前，1338年战死。其子继续为南朝作战，但宗家逐渐衰落；岩松支族在德川统治下保有上野的一小块领地。

en:
The Nikaidō were a samurai family who ruled Iwase district in Mutsu from Sukagawa Castle. They traced their name to Fujiwara no Yukimasa. In 1566 Nikaidō Moriyoshi made peace with the neighboring Ashina after losing two castles, sending his son as a hostage.

The hostage succeeded to the Ashina family in 1574, and with Ashina support Moriyoshi defeated the Tamura at Miyota in 1580. After Moriyoshi's death in 1581, the Nikaidō declined and Date Masamune destroyed their power in 1589.
zh:
二阶堂氏是以须贺川城为据点、统治陆奥国岩濑郡的武士家族，家名源自藤原行政。1566年，二阶堂盛义在失去两座城池后与邻近的芦名氏议和，将儿子送去做人质。

这名人质于1574年继承芦名家；盛义得到芦名氏支援，于1580年在御代田击败田村氏。盛义1581年去世后，二阶堂氏逐渐衰落，1589年被伊达政宗消灭。

en:
Ngāti Kahungunu is a Māori iwi of the eastern North Island, centred on Hawke's Bay and Wairarapa. Its ancestor Kahungunu, who probably lived in the late 15th century, travelled from Tauranga to the east coast and married Rongomaiwahine of the Māhia Peninsula.

Their descendants formed several communities along the coast. Later, Rākei-hikuroa led followers from Māhia to Heretaunga, where his son Taraia displaced other groups and established their control over the district.
zh:
雅提卡胡伍努是新西兰北岛东部的毛利部族，主要分布在霍克斯湾和怀拉拉帕。其祖先卡胡伍努可能生活在15世纪末，他从陶朗加来到东海岸，与马希亚半岛的龙戈迈瓦希内结婚。

两人的后裔在沿海形成了多个社群。后来拉凯希库罗阿率追随者从马希亚迁往赫雷陶恩加，他的儿子塔赖亚驱逐其他群体，确立了他们在当地的统治。

en:
The Nitsuki were a branch of the Ashikaga warrior family, named for their home in Mikawa Province. In 1336 Nitsuki Yoshinaga fought for Ashikaga Takauji in Kyushu, then remained there to oppose Southern Court forces.

Yoshinaga and his brother Yoriaki became governors of several provinces; Yoriaki served as Takauji's deputy from 1351. During the Ōnin War of 1467–1477 the family divided into Tamba, Ise and Iga branches, and its power declined.
zh:
仁木氏是足利武家的一个支系，得名于三河国的居地。1336年仁木义长在九州为足利尊氏作战，随后留在当地抵抗南朝势力。

义长和兄长赖章出任数国守护；赖章从1351年起担任尊氏的执事。1467—1477年的应仁之乱期间，仁木氏分为丹波、伊势和伊贺三支，势力逐渐衰退。

en:
Nkore was a kingdom east of Lake Edward in what is now southwestern Uganda. Its early core lay around Isingiro, and tradition names Ruhinda as an early king of the Hinda lineage.

During Ntare IV's reign from 1699 to 1727, Nkore expanded north to the Katonga River and took Kabula from Bunyoro. Kings drew cattle and military service from their followers, while commanders led the kingdom's military units.
zh:
安科莱王国位于爱德华湖以东，即今乌干达西南部。王国早期的核心在伊辛吉罗附近，传说欣达家族的鲁欣达是早期国王。

恩塔雷四世于1699—1727年在位期间，安科莱向北扩展至卡通加河，并从布尼奥罗手中夺取卡布拉。国王向追随者征收牛只并要求服兵役，由军队指挥官率领各部作战。

en: The Nakawe, or Saulteaux, were a branch of the Ojibwe who moved west from the area of Sault Ste. Marie. On the northern Plains they joined the Iron Confederacy, an alliance that traded furs and European goods.
zh: 纳卡韦又称索尔托人，是从苏圣玛丽一带向西迁移的奥吉布瓦人分支。在北部大平原，他们加入了交易毛皮与欧洲货物的铁联盟。

en:
Ānlóng was a Zhuang native chief's office in the Nanpan hills on the Guizhou-Guangxi border, around present-day Ceheng and Longlin. Under the Yuan it belonged to the Lai'an route, among the native posts held by the local Cen clan.

The Ming reorganized the borderlands and created an Anlong defense battalion in 1381. In 1652 the Southern Ming Yongli emperor, fleeing the Qing, made Anlong his temporary capital and raised it to a prefecture; Qing troops took it in 1658 and renamed it Anlong. The old chief's country was later recast as guards, departments and counties under provincial rule.
zh:
安龙是南盘江山区、黔桂交界一带的僮人长官司，辖境当今册亨、隆林。元代属来安路，在岑氏土官统领的下属土职之列。

明朝重整边地，1381年设安隆守御千户所。1652年南明永历帝为避清军移跸安龙，以为陪都并升置安龙府，1658年清军攻克后改名安笼。旧日长官司地逐渐改编为卫、所、州、县，纳入流官治理。

en:
Nalou was a Yi native chief's office on the middle Red River, south of Lin'an in southern Jianshui and Mengzi. Under the Yuan its headmen held a thousand-household commission in the Hani route; after the short-lived Ming Hani prefecture was abolished, the Nalou Chadian Chief's Office was set up in 1384 under Lin'an.

It became hereditary in the Pu family, who ruled their valley villages through the Ming and Qing. In 1817 the rising of Gao Luoyi, proclaimed Hani king, swept the region and defeated chief Pu Cheng'en before Qing troops suppressed it.
zh:
纳楼是红河流域中段的彝人长官司，在临安府以南，建水、蒙自南部。元朝时其首领受任和泥路纳楼千户；明初和泥府旋置旋废，1384年改置纳楼茶甸长官司，隶属临安府。

长官由普氏世袭，历明清两朝治理河谷村寨。1817年高罗衣自称窝泥王起事，横扫这一带，击败土司普承恩，后被清军镇压。

en:
Naumburg was the seat of the prince-bishopric of Naumburg-Zeitz, a missionary diocese Otto I planted east of the Saale. Authorised in 967 and founded at Zeitz in 968, the see moved to Naumburg on the Via Regia the year after a Polish raid under Mieszko II in 1028.

The bishops' temporal lands formed an imperial state; the town, chartered in 1144, prospered from fairs, and its bishop in 1337 was Withego I. The Reformation broke the diocese: Amsdorf became its Lutheran bishop in 1542, its last Catholic bishop died in 1564, and the 1561 Diet adopted the Augsburg Confession, after which the lands went to Saxony's dukes.

Leipzig's rise and the Thirty Years' War dimmed trade. From 1657 the district belonged to the Saxe-Zeitz line, reverting to Dresden on its extinction in 1718; the 1815 Congress of Vienna gave Naumburg to Prussia.
zh:
瑙姆堡是瑙姆堡-蔡茨主教区邦的治所，该教区是奥托一世在萨勒河以东设立的传教教区。967年获准、968年在蔡茨建区。1028年梅什科二世率波兰人袭扰边境后，教座于次年迁至皇帝大道上的瑙姆堡。

主教的世俗领地是个小帝国邦国；城镇1144年获建城权，靠集市兴盛，1337年主教为维特戈一世。宗教改革瓦解了教区：1542年阿姆斯多夫就任路德宗主教，末任天主教主教1564年去世，1561年瑙姆堡议会接受《奥格斯堡信纲》，土地归入萨克森公爵。

莱比锡崛起与三十年战争令贸易转衰。1657年起该地区属萨克森-蔡茨支，1718年绝嗣复归德累斯顿；1815年维也纳会议将瑙姆堡划归普鲁士。

en:
The Duchy of Niemodlin was an Upper Silesian Piast duchy centred on Niemodlin, recorded in 1224 and chartered in 1283. Originally part of Opole, it gained its own duke in 1313, when Bolko I's eldest son Bolesław the Elder inherited Niemodlin and Wieluń.

His Luxembourg alignment brought war with Poland, which took Wieluń in 1326; in 1327 Bolesław did homage to John of Bohemia at Opava and was allowed to buy Prudnik in 1336. He died around 1365; his last son Henry ruled alone from 1369 and died childless in 1382.

Wenceslaus IV seized the fief, but a 1383 settlement gave Niemodlin to Bolko III's sons and Głogówek with Prudnik to Władysław of Opole. The duchy stayed with the Opole Piasts until their line died out in 1532; the estate then passed through Hohenzollern and other hands, and Prussia annexed the town in 1742.
zh:
涅莫德林公国是上西里西亚皮雅斯特公国，以涅莫德林为中心，1224年见载，1283年获城权。原属奥波莱，1313年博尔科一世长子博莱斯拉夫（“长者”）继承涅莫德林和维伦，涅莫德林成为独立公国的治所。

他亲近卢森堡家族，与波兰交战，维伦1326年失守；1327年博莱斯拉夫在奥帕瓦向波希米亚王约翰行臣服礼，1336年获准买下普鲁德尼克。约1365年去世，幼子亨里克1369年独治，1382年无嗣而终。

瓦茨拉夫四世没收空采邑，1383年裁断涅莫德林归博尔科三世诸子，格沃古韦克与普鲁德尼克归奥波莱的瓦迪斯瓦夫。公国后属奥波莱皮雅斯特支系，1532年绝嗣，产业经霍亨索伦等家族之手，1742年普鲁士吞并城镇。

en:
The Duchy of Namysłów was a Silesian Piast principality centred on Namysłów on the Widawa. The town was destroyed in the 1241 Mongol invasion and refounded in 1249 by Bolesław II the Bald; after passing from Wrocław to Głogów, it briefly became a duchy seat in 1312.

The 1323 Peace of Kraków gave Namysłów to Bolesław III of Legnica, and it belonged to Brzeg until 1338; Casimir I of Cieszyn held it temporarily as dowry for his daughter Anna, who married Wenceslaus I of Legnica. In 1342 Bolesław sold his rights to Poland's Casimir III, whose residence the castle became.

In the 1348 Treaty of Namysłów Casimir III renounced his claims to Silesia in favour of Bohemia's Charles IV; from 1358 the town belonged to the Bohemian Crown. It beat off a Hussite siege in 1428 and, alone with Wrocław, refused homage in 1453, passed to the Habsburgs in 1526 and to Prussia in 1742.
zh:
纳梅斯武夫公国是西里西亚皮雅斯特小公国，以维达瓦河畔纳梅斯武夫为中心。该城1241年毁于蒙古入侵，1249年博莱斯拉夫二世重建；历属弗罗茨瓦夫、格沃古夫，1312年一度成为公国治所。

1323年《克拉科夫和约》将纳梅斯武夫划归莱格尼察博莱斯拉夫三世，布热格领至1338年；切申卡齐米尔一世曾以其为女儿安娜嫁莱格尼察瓦茨瓦夫一世的嫁妆暂时管有。1342年博莱斯拉夫将其权利售与波兰国王卡齐米日三世，城堡成为其驻地。

1348年《纳梅斯武夫条约》中，卡齐米日三世向波希米亚的查理四世放弃对西里西亚的权利要求；1358年该城归波希米亚王冠。1428年却胡斯军，1453年同弗罗茨瓦夫拒臣服，1526年归哈布斯堡，1742年属普鲁士。

en:
Nuu Ndiyi, the Place of the Dead, is the Mixtec name for the city the Aztecs called Mictlan, later Mitla; the Zapotecs called it Lyobaa, the Place of Rest. In Oaxaca's Tlacolula valley it was settled from the early Classic period and grew from a fortified village into the Zapotec world's chief religious centre as Monte Alban declined.

Around 1000 Mixtec rulers took control, and the city peaked as a mixed Zapotec-Mixtec polity. Built as a gateway between life and death, it held cruciform tombs where rulers and high priests were buried, hoping to become cloud people interceding for the living.

Its walls carry intricate mosaic fretwork of polished stones fitted without mortar, unique in Mesoamerica. Still a functioning sanctuary at the Spanish arrival in the 1520s, it lost its temples in 1553 when Archbishop Albuquerque had them dismantled and a church raised on the northern platform.
zh:
纽恩迪伊意为“亡者之地”，是这座城市的纽萨维语名；阿兹特克人称米克特兰，后世通称米特拉，萨波特克人称廖巴，意为“安息之地”。它位于瓦哈卡特拉科卢拉谷地，古典期早期即有人居住，从设防村落随蒙特阿尔班衰落成为萨波特克世界首要宗教中心。

约1000年纽萨维君主取得控制权，城市鼎盛为萨波特克与纽萨维混合政权。它被建为连通生死的门户：统治者与大祭司葬于十字形墓穴，期望化作护佑生者的“云人”。

墙面铺满马赛克回纹，由打磨石块无灰浆嵌合，在美索美洲独一无二。16世纪20年代西班牙人抵此时仍为圣地；1553年阿尔武尔克尔克大主教下令拆毁神庙，于北部台基建教堂。

en:
Annan was a native chieftaincy in south-eastern Yunnan, in the country around Mengzi on the road toward Dai Viet. It grew out of the Mongol-era Annan Route Escort Army Thousand-Household, set up in 1276 from the Shezi Thousand-Household at Laozhai to guard the frontier, while the nearby Muze Thousand-Household became Mengzi County in the same year.

When Ming armies reached Lin'an in 1382 the escort-army officer Na You surrendered and was made deputy chief of a new Annan Chief's Office, while the Lu clan, descended from Abo leader Lu Azhi, held Mengzi as hereditary native magistrates. The Lu line died out in 1523 and Mengzi passed to circulating officials.

In the late Ming the Annan office became the base of the strongman Sha Dingzhou, whose rebellion of 1645 to 1648 convulsed Yunnan until the Daxi army of Sun Kewang crushed it and put him to death in 1648.
zh:
安南是滇南蒙自一带、扼守通往交趾道路的土司。其前身是1276年由老寨舍资千户改设的安南道防送军千户，用以戍边；同年附近的目则千户改置蒙自县。

1382年明军进抵临安，防送军土官那由归降，授为新设安南长官司副长官；阿僰蛮首领禄阿只的后裔禄氏世袭蒙自土知县。1523年禄氏世绝，蒙自改由流官治理。

明末安南长官司成为豪强沙定洲的根基，他1645—1648年的叛乱震动云南，终被孙可望的大西军击溃，1648年被处死。

en:
The Nogai Horde was a confederation of pastoral peoples on the steppes north of the Caspian Sea, with a winter camp at Saraychik on the lower Ural. Its ruling dynasty descended from the Manghit emir Edigu, who controlled lands between the Volga and Ural by 1396.

In 1557 Qazi Mirza broke with Ismael Beg and founded the Lesser Nogai Horde in the North Caucasus. The Great Horde north of the Caspian fragmented under Kalmyk pressure in the early seventeenth century.
zh:
诺盖汗国是里海以北草原上游牧民组成的联盟，冬营地设在乌拉尔河下游的萨莱奇克。其统治家族出自忙兀惕部埃米尔也迪古，他在1396年时已控制伏尔加河与乌拉尔河之间的土地。

1557年，卡齐·米尔扎与伊斯梅尔别克决裂，在北高加索建立小诺盖汗国。里海以北的大诺盖汗国在17世纪初受到卡尔梅克人的压力，逐渐瓦解。

en: Northumberland recalls Northumbria, the early medieval kingdom spanning northern England and southern Scotland, formed from Bernicia and Deira. After Scandinavian rule ended in 954, English kings appointed earls to govern Northumbria; its lands later became divided between England and Scotland.
zh: 诺森伯兰得名所指的诺森布里亚，是由伯尼西亚和德伊勒合并而成的中世纪早期王国，横跨英格兰北部和苏格兰南部。954年斯堪的纳维亚人的统治结束后，英格兰国王任命伯爵治理诺森布里亚；其土地后来分属英格兰和苏格兰。

en:
The Nootkah were related Indigenous communities on the west coast of Vancouver Island, later known collectively as the Nuu-chah-nulth. James Cook visited Yuquot in 1778, and maritime fur traders followed. In 1789 Spanish seizures of British ships at Nootka Sound sparked a crisis between the two empires, later settled by convention.

Maquinna, a Mowachaht chief, hosted negotiations over the sound. In 1803 he and his warriors captured the American ship Boston, killing all but two of its crew.
zh:
努特卡人是温哥华岛西岸的一组相关原住民社群，后来统称为努查努阿特人。詹姆斯·库克于1778年到访尤阔特，海上毛皮商人随后接踵而至。1789年，西班牙在努特卡湾扣押英国船只，引发两国危机，后来双方以协定解决。

莫瓦查特首领马奎纳接待了就该海湾问题进行的谈判。1803年，他与战士们夺取美国船只“波士顿”号，杀死了除两人以外的船员。

en:
The Norwegian kingdom took shape in the Viking Age, when Harald Fairhair united its fjord and coastal districts around 900, and Christianity was imposed in the eleventh century by kings such as Olaf II, killed at Stiklestad in 1030, later venerated as Norway's patron saint; Nidaros became an archbishopric in 1153. Norwegian seafarers settled Iceland, Greenland, Orkney and other crown-tied islands.

A century of civil wars ended in 1240; the 1349 Black Death halved the population and weakened the monarchy, while the Hanseatic League made Bergen its northern trading staple. In 1319 Magnus Eriksson inherited Norway with Sweden; from 1380 Norway joined Denmark in union, entering the Kalmar Union in 1397.

Sweden's 1523 breakaway left Norway in Denmark-Norway: Lutheran Reformation was imposed in 1537, absolute monarchy followed in 1661. Wars with Sweden took Jämtland and Härjedalen in 1645 and Bohuslän in 1658. After Denmark's Napoleonic defeat the 1814 Treaty of Kiel transferred Norway to Sweden; Norway answered with the Eidsvoll constitution and kept its laws and parliament under the new personal union.
zh:
挪威王国成型于维京时代：约900年金发哈拉尔统一峡湾与沿海地区；11世纪奥拉夫二世等国王推行基督教，他1030年在斯蒂克莱斯塔战死，后被尊为挪威主保圣人，1153年尼达罗斯升格大主教区。挪威航海者还定居冰岛、格陵兰、奥克尼等臣属王冠的岛屿。

一个世纪的内战1240年结束后，1349年黑死病使人口减半、王权削弱，汉萨同盟把卑尔根经营成北方贸易据点。1319年马格努斯·埃里克松同时继承挪威与瑞典，1380年起挪威与丹麦联合，1397年加入卡尔马联盟。

1523年瑞典脱离后，挪威留在丹麦—挪威联合之中：1537年路德宗改革被强行推行，1661年确立专制君主制。与瑞典的战争使它1645年失去耶姆特兰和海里耶达伦，1658年失去布胡斯兰。丹麦拿破仑战争失败后，1814年《基尔条约》把挪威割让给瑞典；挪威以埃兹沃尔宪法作答，在新的共主邦联下保留自己的法律和议会。

en:
Lord Novgorod the Great was the largest of the East Slavic city-states. Tradition says the Varangian prince Rurik was invited there in 862, the legendary starting point of the Rurikid dynasty. In 1136 the citizens made the veche supreme, though boyar families and merchant guilds held the real power. Novgorod grew rich on furs, beeswax and Hanseatic trade, while its ushkuyniki, armed river traders, pushed commerce eastward.

Prince Alexander Nevsky saved Novgorod from Swedish and Teutonic attacks in 1240 and 1242, on the Neva and the ice of Lake Peipus, though it still paid tribute to the Mongol khans. From the fourteenth century Moscow's grand princes collected that tribute and tightened their grip.

Ivan III defeated Novgorod at the Shelon in 1471 and in 1478 abolished the veche, carried off its assembly bell and annexed the republic. Ivan the Terrible sacked it in 1570, Swedish occupation from 1611 to 1617 deepened its decline, and St Petersburg's founding in 1703 turned Baltic trade from its old routes.
zh:
诺夫哥罗德正式称“大诺夫哥罗德君主”，是东斯拉夫最大的城邦。相传862年瓦良格王公留里克在此受邀入主，成为留里克王朝的传奇起点。1136年市民把“维彻”推上最高权力位置，实权却落在波雅尔家族和商人行会手中。它靠毛皮、蜂蜡和汉萨贸易致富，名为“乌什库伊尼基”的武装河上商队把贸易推向东方。

王公亚历山大·涅夫斯基于1240年、1242年先后在涅瓦河畔和楚德湖冰面击退瑞典人与条顿骑士团，但诺夫哥罗德仍须向蒙古汗纳贡。14世纪起，莫斯科大公代征贡赋，控制日紧。

伊凡三世于1471年在舍隆河击败诺夫哥罗德，1478年废除维彻、运走维彻钟，吞并共和国。1570年伊凡雷帝洗劫全城，1611—1617年瑞典占领加剧其衰落，1703年圣彼得堡兴建后，波罗的海贸易便绕开了它的旧河道。

en:
The tusi lands around Qijiang, south of Chongqing, belonged to the Nanping Liao, called Nanping barbarians under the Tang and Bandun in earlier centuries. Their Zhu-clan King of Jianli submitted to Tang, which put his land under Yuzhou. In Song times they were the Yuzhou barbarians, and after three clans were subdued the Northern Song set up the Nanping military prefecture in 1070.

Under the Yuan it ran as the Nanping Qijiang chief's office, a long-standing tusi in the southern Sichuan hills. In 1363 Ming Yuzhen of Xia merged it with Nanchuan into Qijiang County, taken by the Ming in 1371 and ruled from Chongqing.
zh:
綦江一带土司辖地在重庆以南，居民是南平僚，唐代称南平蛮，更早称板楯七姓蛮。其王姓朱，号剑荔王，附唐后该地隶于渝州。宋代称渝州蛮，三族被平定后，北宋1070年设南平军。

元代以南平綦江长官司治理，为川南山地老牌土司。1363年大夏明玉珍将其与南川县合并设綦江县，1371年明朝接管，由重庆管辖。

en:
Nepal was a Himalayan kingdom built through the expansion of Gorkha under the Shah dynasty. Prithvi Narayan Shah took the Gorkha throne in 1743, conquered the kingdoms of the Kathmandu Valley and made Kathmandu his capital in 1768.

Nepalese forces later invaded Tibet, bringing a Chinese and Tibetan counterattack in 1792. The Anglo-Nepalese War of 1814–1816 ended in defeat by the East India Company; the Treaty of Sugauli preserved Nepal's independence but required territorial concessions.
zh:
尼泊尔是沙阿王朝通过扩张廓尔喀而建立的喜马拉雅王国。普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿于1743年继承廓尔喀王位，征服加德满都谷地诸国，并于1768年定都加德满都。

尼泊尔军队后来入侵西藏，引来清朝与西藏军队于1792年反攻。1814—1816年的英尼战争以东印度公司取胜告终；《苏高利条约》保全了尼泊尔的独立，但要求它割让领土。

en:
Ngāti Porou is a Māori iwi of the East Cape and Gisborne region of New Zealand's North Island. Its people trace their name to the ancestor Porourangi, whose descendants spread across the East Cape through conquest and marriage alliances.

During the Musket Wars, Ngāpuhi raids inflicted heavy losses on Ngāti Porou. In 1819 an attack on the fortified settlement at Wharekahika Bay was repelled, but both sides suffered heavily. After another defeat in 1823, the chief Taotaoriri negotiated peace, sealed by his marriage to Hikupoto of Ngāti Porou.
zh:
雅提波卢是新西兰北岛东角和吉斯伯恩地区的毛利部族，以祖先波卢朗伊得名。他的后代通过征服和联姻扩展到东角各地。

在火枪战争期间，纳普希人的袭击使雅提波卢损失惨重。1819年，雅提波卢击退了对法雷卡希卡湾设防村落的进攻，但双方伤亡都很重。1823年再次战败后，首领陶陶里里谈成和平，并与雅提波卢的希库波托结婚以巩固和约。

en: The Niipsing were an Anishinaabe people whose homeland lay around Lake Nipissing, between the Ottawa River and Georgian Bay. The French trader Jean Nicolet lived among the people on the lake until 1633. During the seventeenth century some Nipissing moved to the Lake Nipigon area and later returned; others settled near Trois-Rivières and Oka in Quebec.
zh: 尼皮辛人是阿尼希纳贝人，家园位于渥太华河与乔治亚湾之间的尼皮辛湖一带。法国商人让·尼科莱曾在湖畔与当地人共同生活，直到1633年。17世纪，一些尼皮辛人迁往尼皮贡湖地区，后来又返回；另一些人在魁北克的三河城和奥卡附近定居。

en:
The Kingdom of Naqis was one of six Beja polities the historian al-Yaqubi recorded in the ninth century, in the Red Sea hills between Aswan and Massawa. Its chief town was Hajar, and its wealth rested on the eastern desert's gold and emerald mines, where Arab miners worked beside local Beja from the 800s to the 1200s; the fortified works at Derahib grew up in the same hills.

As in the other Beja kingdoms, mining and the captive trade from the interior underpinned its economy. Like its neighbours, Naqis was later absorbed into the Balaw kingdom of the later Middle Ages.
zh:
纳吉斯是史学家雅库比9世纪记载的六个贝贾政权之一，在阿斯旺与马萨瓦之间的红海山地。主城哈杰尔，财富来自东部沙漠的黄金与祖母绿矿；800至1200年代，阿拉伯矿工与当地贝贾人一同开采，德拉海布设防矿场兴起于同一片山地。

与其他贝贾王国一样，采矿和内陆奴隶贸易支撑其经济。纳吉斯后与邻邦一同并入中世纪后期的巴劳王国。

en:
Narbonne, on the Mediterranean coast of Languedoc, was founded as the Roman colony Narbo Martius in 118 BC and became capital of Gallia Narbonensis. After the Roman collapse it served the Visigoths as capital of their kingdom of Septimania, and from the eighth century it was the seat of the Carolingian viscounts of Narbonne, nominal vassals of Toulouse who ruled themselves and prospered from port trade.

Viscountess Ermengarde, reigning 1134 to 1192, kept one of the courts where troubadour poetry and courtly love flourished. In 1192 Peter of Lara, from a Castilian noble house, displaced her and founded the Lara line; in 1337 its viscount was Amalric III.

From the fourteenth century silting and shifts of the Aude slowly strangled the harbour. The last Lara successors, the Tinières, sold the viscounty to Gaston IV of Foix in 1447, and in 1507 Narbonne entered the French royal domain.
zh:
纳博讷在朗格多克地中海沿岸，公元前118年罗马建为纳博马蒂乌斯殖民地，后成为那旁高卢行省首府。罗马崩溃后为西哥特人塞蒂马尼亚王国都城；8世纪起为加洛林朝纳博讷子爵治所，名义臣属图卢兹伯爵，实则自治，凭港口贸易致富。

女子爵埃尔芒加德1134至1192年在位，其宫廷是游吟诗人诗歌与典雅爱情兴盛之地之一。1192年出身卡斯蒂利亚名门的皮埃尔·德·拉腊取代她，建立拉腊家族；1337年在位子爵为阿马尔里克三世。

14世纪起奥德河淤积改道，港口渐衰。拉腊后继者蒂尼耶尔家族1447年把子伯国卖给富瓦的加斯顿四世，1507年纳博讷并入法兰西王室领地。

en:
The Naiganset, or Narragansett, controlled lands west of Narragansett Bay in Rhode Island and parts of neighboring Connecticut and Massachusetts. They allied with English colonists against the Pequot in the war of 1636–1638. Roger Williams learned their language and published a guide to it in 1643.

During King Philip's War, the Narragansett initially signed a neutrality treaty with Massachusetts in 1675. That December colonial militia attacked their fort in the Great Swamp, killing many people, including women and children.
zh:
纳伊甘塞特人控制着罗得岛纳拉甘西特湾以西的土地，以及邻近的康涅狄格和马萨诸塞部分地区。1636—1638年的战争中，他们与英国殖民者结盟对抗佩科特人。罗杰·威廉斯学会了他们的语言，并于1643年出版了一部语言指南。

菲利普国王战争期间，纳伊甘塞特人最初于1675年与马萨诸塞签订中立条约。同年12月，殖民地民兵袭击了他们在大沼泽的堡垒，杀死许多人，其中包括妇女和儿童。

en:
Nri was an Igbo priestly state in the lower Niger, ruled by a divine king, the Eze Nri. Its founder Eri was remembered as a sky being sent by the creator Chukwu to order the Anambra valley; oral tradition dates his coming to 1043, and the first Eze Nri reigned around 1225.

Nri grew without armies: mbùríchi travelling converts won neighbouring towns by ritual oath, and at its late-1500s height its authority covered roughly a quarter of Igboland. Its soil was sanctuary: after the tenth Eze Nri, any slave entering it went free.

The Igbo-Ukwu bronzes, decorated with insects, birds and elephant heads, are Nigeria's oldest known bronze tradition. From the 1700s the rise of Benin and Igala and the Atlantic slave trade eroded Nri's authority, though its priests outlasted its political power.
zh:
恩里是伊博人在尼日尔河下游的神权国家，由神王埃泽·恩里统治。始祖埃里相传是造物主丘库派来为阿南布拉河谷带来秩序的天上之人，口传传统将其到来定在1043年，首任埃泽·恩里约1225年在位。

恩里不靠军队扩张：姆布里奇游方传道者以仪式誓约争取邻镇，16世纪末鼎盛时权威遍及约四分之一伊博兰。其土地是避难所：第十位埃泽·恩里之后，奴隶踏足即获自由。

伊博乌库青铜器饰有昆虫、禽鸟和象首，是尼日利亚已知最古老的青铜传统。18世纪起，贝宁、伊加拉崛起与大西洋奴隶贸易削弱恩里权威，但祭司在政权衰落后仍延续很久。

en:
Novogrudok is a fortified town in Black Ruthenia, founded by East Slavic settlers on earlier Baltic lands and first mentioned in the Rus' chronicles under 1044; the Hypatian Codex calls it Novogorodok, the new little town, in 1252. Thirteenth-century ruler Vaišvilkas, son of King Mindaugas, was followed by its rise to a core town of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, hosting a bishopric of the Lithuanian metropolitanate.

From 1329 the appanage belonged to Karijotas, a son of Gediminas, then to his son Fyodor in 1358 and Kaributas in 1386. In 1392 it entered the grand-ducal demesne and gained a stone castle.

Novogrudok received Magdeburg rights in 1511, and from 1507 to 1795 it was the capital of the Nowogródek Voivodeship, where the Lithuanian Tribunal also held its sessions.
zh:
新格鲁多克是黑鲁塞尼亚的设防城镇，由东斯拉夫人在更早的波罗的人土地上建立，1044年罗斯编年史首见；1252年《伊帕季耶夫编年史》称其为诺沃哥罗多克，意为“小小的新城”。13世纪由国王明道加斯之子瓦伊什维尔卡斯统治，后来成为立陶宛大公国核心城镇之一，设有立陶宛都主教区主教座。

1329年起封邑归格季米纳斯之子卡里约塔斯，1358年传其子费奥多尔，1386年归卡里布塔斯。1392年成为大公直领地，并建石砌城堡。

1511年新格鲁多克获马格德堡权利，1507至1795年为新格鲁多克省省会，立陶宛法庭亦在此开庭。

en:
Normandy began with the Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte of 911, when King Charles the Simple granted the Viking Rollo lands on the lower Seine; his Northmen, or Normans, gave the duchy its name and made Rouen its capital. Duke William conquered England in 1066, and for over a century the dukes were usually English kings as well. Philip II of France conquered it from John Lackland in 1204, the Channel Islands alone remaining English, and in 1259 the English renounced mainland Normandy. In 1337 its duke was John, eldest son of Philip VI and later King John II.

In the Hundred Years' War Henry V overran it, taking Caen in 1417 and starving Rouen into surrender in 1419. Charles VII recovered it after the tide turned, Rouen opening its gates in 1449.

The Battle of Formigny in 1450 destroyed the last English field army in the duchy. Normandy was briefly regranted as an appanage in 1465, then reunited to the royal domain after 1469.
zh:
诺曼底始于911年的《圣克莱尔-叙尔-埃普特条约》：国王糊涂查理把塞纳河下游土地封给维京首领罗洛，他的部属北方人即诺曼人，公国由此得名，以鲁昂为都。1066年威廉公爵征服英格兰，此后一个多世纪公爵往往兼任英格兰国王。1204年腓力二世从无地王约翰手中征服公国，只有海峡群岛仍归英格兰，1259年英王放弃大陆诺曼底。1337年的公爵是腓力六世长子约翰，即日后的约翰二世。

百年战争中，亨利五世席卷诺曼底，1417年攻下卡昂，1419年迫使粮尽的鲁昂投降。战局逆转后查理七世收复失地，鲁昂于1449年开城。

1450年福尔米尼战役歼灭英格兰在诺曼底最后的野战军。1465年公国一度再封宗室，1469年后并回王室领地。

en:
Noro took its name from the Noro Bira, the Manchu name of the Naoli River, called Nuolei under the Ming and Noro in the Qing Jilin gazetteer; the name describes its wandering, shifting bed. It flows through the country around present Shuangyashan to join the Ussuri as a larger left-bank tributary, its Hūrga Jurchen villagers fishing and hunting in the marshes.

Like other Ussuri tribes, the local chiefs held nominal Ming guard titles under the Nurgan commission. Nurhaci's eastern campaigns of 1596 to 1625 overran the river country, and its people were gradually enrolled in the Manchu banners.
zh:
诺罗得名于诺罗河，满语称诺罗毕拉，明代称诺雷河，清代《吉林通志》作诺罗河，河名取河床游荡不定之意。诺罗河流经今双鸭山一带，是乌苏里江左岸较大支流，河畔虎尔哈女真渔猎于湿地。

与乌苏里江其他部落一样，酋长在奴儿干都司下领有名义上的明朝卫所官职；1596—1625年努尔哈赤东征征服其地，部众后渐编入满洲八旗。

en:
Nurpur was a Himalayan foothill kingdom between the Ravi and Beas, guarding the route from the Punjab plains to the Kangra valley. It was founded around 1064 by Jhetpal, a Delhi Tanwar prince who seized Pathankot; his clan took the name Pathania from the town, and the state was first called Dhameri.

Its rajas held the Kangra gateway, alternately resisting and submitting to plains Muslim rulers. It peaked under Basu Dev, 1580 to 1613, who built a great fort, but Mughal pressure drove out his son Suraj Mal in 1618. In 1620 Jagat Singh renamed Dhameri Nurpur to honour Emperor Jahangir and his wife Nur Jahan, and the state became a Mughal feudatory.

It rebelled in the Taragarh war of 1640 to 1642. It broke free in 1739 amid Nader Shah's invasion and weathered Ahmad Shah Durrani's campaigns, until Ranjit Singh of the Sikhs annexed it in 1815.
zh:
努尔布尔是喜马拉雅山麓王国，在拉维河与比亚斯河之间，扼守旁遮普平原至冈格拉山谷的要道。约1064年德里坦瓦尔王子杰特帕尔夺帕坦科特要塞建国，家族以该城得名帕塔尼亚，国初称达梅里。

罗阇久扼冈格拉门户，对平原穆斯林统治者时战时降。1580至1613年巴苏·代夫时鼎盛，建宏伟堡垒，1618年其子苏拉吉·马尔迫于莫卧儿出走。1620年贾格特·辛格改达梅里名为努尔布尔，以向皇帝贾汉吉尔及其王后努尔·贾汉示好，国家成为莫卧儿附庸。

1640至1642年塔拉加尔战争中它起兵反抗。1739年纳迪尔沙入侵时它脱离独立，又挺过艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的征伐，1815年被锡克人的兰季德·辛格吞并。

en:
Narsinghpur was a small Garhjat chiefdom on the north bank of the Mahanadi in eastern Orissa, hemmed in by forested hills and Hindol and Baramba. Tradition remembered Khond war chiefs Narsingh and Poro carving out the tract in the thirteenth century and giving it Narsingh's name, before Dharma Singh overcame them; the later ruling family claimed descent from him.

It joined the Orissan order as feudatory of Puri's Gajapati rajas, from whom its chiefs took the hereditary title Harichandan Mahapatra. It stayed a quiet hill tributary with no firmans recorded from Mughal or Maratha times, and its first dated ruler, Mandardhar Harichandan Mahapatra, appears in 1671.
zh:
讷尔辛格布尔是奥里萨东部默哈讷迪河北岸的迦尔贾德小首领邦，山林环绕，与欣多尔、巴兰巴为邻。传说13世纪孔德人武首领纳尔辛格与波罗率先开辟此地，邦名取自纳尔辛格；后达尔马·辛格征服二人，后世统治家族自称其裔。

该王朝作为普里加贾帕蒂诸王附庸进入奥里萨体系，首领领得世袭头衔哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉。莫卧儿与马拉塔时期均无诏书档案，始终是安静的山间纳贡小邦；最早有确切纪年的统治者曼达尔达尔·哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉见于1671年。

en:
Nassau was a German state named for the castle on the River Lahn from which its ruling house took its name. Divided among branches of the family in 1255, its lands were reunited in 1806, when Napoleon pressed Nassau-Usingen and Nassau-Weilburg to form the Duchy of Nassau.

The duchy abolished serfdom in 1806 and adopted a constitution in 1814. After joining the coalition against Napoleon in 1813, Nassau entered the German Confederation in 1815. Wiesbaden became its sole capital in 1816, when William of Nassau-Weilburg inherited the whole duchy.
zh:
拿骚是一个德意志邦国，得名于兰河畔的拿骚城堡，其统治家族也以城堡为名。1255年领地由家族各支分割；1806年，在拿破仑压力下，拿骚—乌辛根与拿骚—魏尔堡合并为拿骚公国。

公国于1806年废除农奴制，1814年颁布宪法。拿骚于1813年加入反拿破仑同盟，1815年成为德意志邦联成员。1816年拿骚—魏尔堡的威廉继承整个公国，威斯巴登成为唯一首都。

en:
Nassau-Dillenburg was a county of the Holy Roman Empire centered on Dillenburg north of the Lahn. After the division of Nassau in 1255, the lands passed to the Ottonian branch; Dillenburg became a separate county in 1303 and was reunited with Nassau-Siegen in 1328.

In 1544 William of Nassau-Dillenburg's son William inherited the Principality of Orange and later led the Dutch Revolt. His brother John VI ruled at Dillenburg and was a principal author of the Union of Utrecht. After John's death in 1606, his lands were divided among his sons.
zh:
拿骚‑迪伦堡是神圣罗马帝国的一个伯国，以拉恩河以北的迪伦堡为中心。1255年拿骚分割后，这片土地归奥托支系所有；迪伦堡于1303年成为独立伯国，1328年又与拿骚-锡根合并。

1544年，拿骚‑迪伦堡伯爵威廉之子威廉继承奥兰治亲王国，后来领导了尼德兰起义。他的弟弟扬六世在迪伦堡执政，是《乌得勒支同盟》的主要起草者。扬于1606年去世后，领地由诸子分割。

en: The North Sea Empire joined England, Denmark and Norway under Cnut the Great, who gained their crowns in 1016, 1018 and 1028 respectively. His domains divided after his death in 1035, and the last union of the English and Danish crowns ended in 1042.
