zh: 北海帝国在克努特大帝治下联合了英格兰、丹麦和挪威，他分别于1016年、1018年和1028年取得三国王位。1035年他去世后领地分裂，英格兰与丹麦王位的最后一次联合于1042年结束。

en:
Nassau-Hadamar was the westernmost share of the Ottonian northern Nassau line. In the 1303 partition of Otto's lands north of the Lahn Emicho I received Hadamar with Driedorf, his first residence.

In 1320 he bought an Eberbach Abbey farm at Hadamar, made it a water castle and moved court there; Louis IV granted it town rights in 1324. Emicho died in 1334; his son John, count in 1337, bought the lordship of Ellar but later fell into debt and pledged much of his land.

The elder line failed with John's sons, and a succession feud ended in 1405 with Hadamar split between Nassau-Dillenburg and Katzenelnbogen; in 1557 the whole inheritance went to Nassau-Dillenburg. A younger line, created in 1607 and raised to princely rank in 1652, died out in 1711; Hadamar then reverted to the Nassau houses and in 1806 joined the Duchy of Nassau.
zh:
拿骚‑哈达马尔是拿骚家族奥托系（北支）最西的分地。1303年瓜分奥托在兰河以北的领地时，埃米希一世分得哈达马尔与德里多夫，最初驻跸德里多夫。

1320年他买下埃伯巴赫修道院在哈达马尔的庄园，改建为水上城堡并迁宫廷于此；1324年皇帝路德维希四世授城市权。埃米希1334年去世，子约翰1337年在位，购埃拉尔领主地，后债台高筑，抵押大片土地。

老支系随约翰诸子而绝，继承纠纷1405年以哈达马尔由拿骚‑迪伦堡与卡岑埃尔恩博根瓜分收场，1557年遗产全归拿骚‑迪伦堡。1607年新支系建立，1652年升诸侯，1711年绝嗣，复归拿骚各支，1806年并入拿骚公国。

en:
Nassau-Idstein was a Walramian Nassau territory in the Taunus around Idstein and Wiesbaden. Idstein Castle, recorded in 1102, was an imperial fief granted by Mainz's archbishops to Nassau's Laurenburg ancestors; the 1255 partition gave it to the Walramian line. Count Adolf, later king, won Idstein town rights from Rudolf in 1287; his son Gerlach I resided at Wiesbaden and held the undivided Walramian lands in 1337.

After Gerlach's abdication, the 1355 partition created a Nassau-Wiesbaden-Idstein line under Adolph I. The Reformation came around 1542, and the line died out in 1605, its lands passing to Nassau-Weilburg.

A younger line founded in 1629 joined the Swedes in the Thirty Years' War, was exiled in 1635 and restored in 1648; its count became a prince in 1688 and built Biebrich Palace near Wiesbaden. When the line died out in 1721, Idstein passed through Nassau-Usingen to the Duchy of Nassau in 1806.
zh:
拿骚‑伊德施泰因是拿骚瓦尔拉姆系在陶努斯的领地，核心在伊德施泰因、威斯巴登。城堡1102年首见，是美因茨大主教封给拿骚先祖劳伦堡家族的帝国采邑，1255年划归瓦尔拉姆系。后为国王的阿道夫1287年从鲁道夫争得城市权，子格拉赫一世驻威斯巴登，1337年仍领未分割的瓦尔拉姆系全境。

格拉赫退位后，1355年分家立阿道夫一世的拿骚‑威斯巴登‑伊德施泰因支系。约1542年行宗教改革，老支系1605年绝嗣，土地归拿骚‑魏尔堡。

1629年新支系建立，三十年战争附瑞典，1635年被逐，1648年恢复；伯爵1688年升诸侯，在威斯巴登附近建比布里希宫。1721年绝嗣，伊德施泰因经拿骚‑乌辛根1806年并入拿骚公国。

en:
The Principality of Novosil was one of the upper Oka principalities, lying along the Zusha and the upper Don in former Vyatichi lands. It emerged from the Glukhov principality, itself split from Chernihiv in the 1290s. Alexander Semyonovich, its first prince, was executed in the Golden Horde in 1326 at the order of Khan Uzbek.

Its princes ruled by Horde patents and balanced between the Horde, Moscow and Lithuania. After Tatar raids ruined Novosil in 1375 the seat moved to Odoyev, and in 1380 Jogaila's army burned its towns while marching to join Mamai. In 1408, after the stand on the Ugra, the principality accepted Lithuanian suzerainty while keeping wide autonomy, and in 1422 its prince Yuri routed Khan Khudaydat near Odoyev with Vytautas's help.

Around 1432 Novosil split into the Belyov, Vorotynsk and Odoyev principalities. All their princes entered Moscow's service, a settlement confirmed to Ivan III in 1503.
zh:
诺沃西利公国是奥卡河上游诸公国之一，地处祖沙河与顿河上游一带，曾是维亚季奇人的土地。它从格卢霍夫公国分出，格卢霍夫本身于13世纪90年代从切尔尼戈夫分立。首任王公亚历山大·谢苗诺维奇于1326年在金帐汗国被月即别汗下令处死。

历代王公凭汗敕统治，在金帐汗国、莫斯科和立陶宛之间周旋。1375年鞑靼人的劫掠毁掉诺沃西利后，都城迁到奥多耶夫；1380年雅盖沃的军队在前往与马迈会合途中焚毁诸城。1408年乌格拉河对峙后，公国接受立陶宛宗主权，但保留很大自治权；1422年王公尤里在维陶塔斯援助下于奥多耶夫附近击溃胡代达特汗。

约1432年，诺沃西利分裂为别廖夫、沃罗滕斯克和奥多耶夫三个公国。诸王公都转入莫斯科麾下，1503年经伊凡三世确认统辖。

en: The Nansemond were a chiefdom on both banks of the Nansemond River in Virginia and a member of the Powhatan Confederacy. They fished, gathered oysters and farmed along the river. In 1609 English settlers raided Dumpling Island, destroying the chiefs' burial places and sacred buildings. During the 1630s colonists encroached on Nansemond lands, and the community was gradually displaced.
zh: 南塞蒙德是弗吉尼亚南塞蒙德河两岸的酋邦，属于波瓦坦联盟。南塞蒙德人在河边捕鱼、采牡蛎和耕种。1609年，英国殖民者袭击邓普林岛，毁坏酋长的墓地和祭祀建筑。17世纪30年代，殖民者侵入南塞蒙德土地，当地社群逐渐被迫迁离。

en:
Nan Sarunai was a tribal state of the Ma'anyan people, a Dayak group of the Barito River basin in what is now South Kalimantan. Ma'anyan seafarers had once sailed as far as Madagascar, where their language helped shape Malagasy, but sedimentation in the Barito delta gradually pushed their settlements inland.

Around 1309 the communities along the Tabalong River formed a proto-state remembered in Ma'anyan wadian chants and the later Hikayat Banjar; its name may refer to the sarunai, a ceremonial flute.

In the mid-fourteenth century Nan Sarunai was overrun by a Majapahit expedition under Mpu Nala, and the country appears in the Negarakertagama of 1365 as Tanjung Negara. From its ruins arose the Hindu kingdom of Negara Dipa, predecessor of Negara Daha and eventually the Banjar Sultanate.
zh:
楠沙鲁奈是马安亚人的部族国家，马安亚人是今南加里曼丹巴里托河流域达雅克人的一支。马安亚航海者曾远航至马达加斯加，他们的语言参与塑造了马达加斯加语，但巴里托三角洲的淤积逐渐把定居点推向内陆。

约1309年，塔巴隆河沿岸诸社群形成一个早期国家，其名可能来自仪式笛子沙鲁奈，这段历史保存在马安亚人的瓦迪安吟唱和后来的《马辰编年史》中。

14世纪中叶，楠沙鲁奈被满者伯夷将领穆普·纳拉的远征军攻灭，1365年的《爪哇史颂》把这一地区称作丹戎尼加拉。在它的废墟上兴起了印度教王国尼贾拉·蒂帕，后被尼贾拉·达哈取代，最终演变为班贾尔苏丹国。

en:
Nassau-Siegen was the chief Ottonian northern Nassau share, covering the Siegerland on the upper Sieg. Recorded in 1079, Siegen was founded as a town in 1224 under shared Nassau-Cologne rule and passed fully to Nassau in 1381.

In the 1303 partition Count Henry I, ruler in 1337, received Siegen. In 1298 his cousin King Adolf pledged him the Ratzenscheid silver mines, and in 1328 he inherited Dillenburg, after which the line took the name Nassau-Dillenburg.

Nassau-Siegen re-emerged in 1606. John VII built the Lower Castle and in 1616 a Calvinist knightly academy, his son John VIII returning to Catholicism in 1612. From 1626 it split into Catholic and Protestant halves, reunited after both lines died out by 1743, when the emperor gave Siegen to Orange. After Orange refused to join the Rhine Confederation, Napoleon gave Siegerland to Berg in 1806 and Prussia received it in 1815.
zh:
拿骚‑锡根是拿骚奥托系（北支）最主要的分地，涵盖锡格河上游锡格兰。锡根1079年首见，1224年建城由拿骚与科隆共有，1381年才完全归入拿骚。

1303年分家，1337年在位的亨利一世分得锡根。1298年表亲国王阿道夫把拉岑沙伊德银矿抵押给他，1328年他继承迪伦堡，此后该支系改称拿骚‑迪伦堡。

独立的拿骚‑锡根在1606年分家时再次出现。约翰七世建下城堡，1616年办加尔文宗骑士学院，子约翰八世1612年改宗天主教。1626年起分裂为天主教与新教两半，两支在1743年前俱绝，皇帝将锡根封给奥兰治后方统一。奥兰治拒绝加入莱茵邦联后，拿破仑1806年把锡格兰划归贝格，1815年普鲁士得之。

en: The Nashit'ush were a Caddo-speaking people whose confederacy lived along the Red River in present-day Louisiana and Texas. In the early 1600s, Kadohadacho survivors of Chickasaw attacks joined them near the Cane River. They later allied with the French and helped defeat the Natchez in the Natchez wars.
zh: 纳什图什人说卡多语，其联盟居住在今路易斯安那州和得克萨斯州的红河沿岸。17世纪初，遭奇克索人袭击的卡达达楚幸存者在凯恩河附近加入了他们。纳什图什人后来与法国人结盟，并在纳奇兹战争中协助击败纳奇兹人。

en:
Nsundi was a small Kongo kingdom whose capital lay on the Inkisi River, near the present Mbanza Nsundi. One of the Seven Kingdoms of Kongo dia Nlaza, it ruled lesser sub-provinces until the Kingdom of Kongo conquered it, probably in the first half of the fifteenth century.

Kongo's kings then treated Nsundi as a royal province, often granted to the heir apparent: Mvemba a Nzinga, son of King Nzinga a Nkuwu, held it before his accession as Afonso I in 1507. Its governor served a limited term, often three years, and under Álvaro II in the late sixteenth century Nsundi was restyled a duchy.

The duke Manuel Jordão made and unmade kings between 1624 and 1628, until Ambrósio I deposed him. In the civil wars after the Battle of Mbwila of 1665, the Kimpanzu dukes made Nsundi virtually independent, and the ducal line withered away by the 1830s.
zh:
恩苏迪是刚果人的小王国，都城在因基西河上，即今姆班扎恩松迪一带。它原是刚果迪亚恩拉扎七王国联盟之一，治下有若干小邦，直到刚果王国大约于15世纪上半叶将其征服。

此后刚果国王把恩苏迪视为王室行省，常封给王储：恩津加·恩库武之子姆文巴·恩津加在1507年继位为阿方索一世之前，就曾受封于此。长官限期任命，任期通常三年；16世纪末阿尔瓦罗二世把恩苏迪改封为公国。

公爵曼努埃尔·若尔当在1624年至1628年间一度能废立国王，最终被安布罗西奥一世罢免。1665年姆布维拉战役后的内战中，金潘祖支系的公爵们使恩苏迪取得事实上的独立，到19世纪30年代，这一公爵世系已然凋零。

en:
Nassau-Weilburg was the southern, Walramian share of the County of Nassau. The county was built by the lords of Laurenburg above the Lahn from the twelfth century; its comital title was recognised in 1159. When Count Henry II's sons divided Nassau in 1255, Walram II kept the lands south of the Lahn, including Weilburg, and his son Adolf was elected King of the Romans in 1292 and fell in 1298.

Adolf's son Gerlach I still ruled the whole Walramian inheritance in 1337. The partition of 1355 gave Weilburg to his son John I, founder of the Nassau-Weilburg line, and after repeated partitions among kinsmen Count Louis II reunited the Walramian lands in 1605.

The Weilburg line was raised to princely status in 1688. In 1806 French pressure merged it with Nassau-Usingen into the Duchy of Nassau, with the Weilburg prince Frederick William as its joint ruler.
zh:
拿骚‑魏尔堡是拿骚伯国南部的瓦尔拉姆系领地。拿骚伯国由劳伦堡领主家族自12世纪起在兰河畔建立，伯爵头衔于1159年获得承认。1255年亨利二世伯爵的儿子们瓜分拿骚，瓦尔拉姆二世分得兰河以南、包括魏尔堡在内的土地；其子阿道夫1292年当选罗马人的国王，1298年战死。

阿道夫之子格拉赫一世在1337年仍统治整个瓦尔拉姆系领地。1355年的分家把魏尔堡分给其子约翰一世，他开创了拿骚‑魏尔堡支系；此后领地在亲族间一再分割，直到路德维希二世伯爵于1605年重新统一瓦尔拉姆系土地。

魏尔堡支系于1688年晋升诸侯。1806年，在法国压力下，拿骚‑魏尔堡与拿骚‑乌辛根合并为拿骚公国，魏尔堡亲王弗里德里希·威廉成为共同统治者。

en:
Canta was the highland lordship of the Canta people in the upper Chillón valley, northeast of Lima; in their Cauqui language the name meant a lasso for taking vicuñas. Their chief settlement, Cantamarca, rose on a pyramidal hill from about 1100 as the residence of their principal curaca, its circular stone compounds half hidden among the hillside vegetation.

Downriver the Canta had a long feud with the Colli over the waters of the Chillón, though the two peoples also traded and shared irrigation works. Around 1450 the armies of Tupac Inca Yupanqui conquered the valley and made Cantamarca an administrative centre, grouping the people into eight ayllus.

After the Spanish entered the valley in 1535, the native communities were relocated into the new town of Canta in 1544, and a chapel was raised on the old sanctuary hill.
zh:
坎塔是坎塔人的高原领主邦，位于利马东北的奇永河上游；在他们的考基语里，其名意为捕捉骆马用的套索。主要聚落坎塔马尔卡约1100年起建在一座金字塔形山丘上，是大酋长的居所，圆形石屋半掩在山坡植被间。

沿河谷而下，坎塔人与科利人为奇永河河水长期争斗，但双方也通商并共用灌溉工程。约1450年，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基的大军征服河谷，把坎塔马尔卡改为行政中心，将居民编为八个艾柳。

1535年西班牙人进入河谷后，原住民社区于1544年迁入新建的坎塔城，古老圣丘上盖起了一座小教堂。

en:
The Jimyōin line of Japan's imperial house formed the Northern Court in Kyoto during the struggle against the rival Southern Court. The two lines descended from sons of Emperor Go-Saga, whose proposed alternating succession broke down.

In 1336 Ashikaga Takauji seized Kyoto and installed Emperor Kōmyō, while Go-Daigo withdrew to Yoshino. The Ashikaga shoguns supported the northern emperors until the southern claimant surrendered his claim in 1392, bringing the courts together under Go-Komatsu.
zh:
日本皇室的持明院统在京都形成北朝，与南朝争夺皇位。两系分别出自后嵯峨天皇的儿子，他提出的两系轮流继位方案最终失败。

1336年足利尊氏攻占京都，拥立光明天皇；后醍醐天皇则退往吉野。足利幕府支持北朝诸帝，直到1392年南朝皇位主张者放弃皇位，两朝在后小松天皇之下合一。

en: Ngāi Tūhoe is a Māori iwi of Te Urewera, the forested mountain country around Lake Waikaremoana in the eastern North Island. The iwi takes its name from Tūhoe Pōtiki, a descendant of Toroa, captain of the Mātaatua canoe, and of earlier ancestors Toi and Pōtiki.
zh: 雅屠霍依是新西兰北岛东部特乌雷韦拉地区的毛利部族，居住在怀卡雷莫阿纳湖周围的森林山地。部族得名于屠霍依·波蒂基，他是马塔阿图阿独木舟首领托罗阿及更早的祖先托伊和波蒂基的后裔。

en:
Nentego was the name used by the Nanticoke, an Algonquian-speaking people of the eastern Chesapeake Bay. Their leader Unnacokasimon made peace with Maryland's government in 1668, and a reservation was defined on the Nanticoke River in 1684.

Faced with encroaching settlers, some moved to Pennsylvania in 1744 with permission from the Iroquois. During the American Revolution, Nanticoke allied with Britain, and in 1778 some moved north to Fort Niagara; others later settled on the Six Nations reserve in Ontario.
zh:
嫩特戈是楠蒂科克人的自称，他们是切萨皮克湾东岸的阿尔冈昆语族人群。1668年，首领乌纳科卡西蒙与马里兰政府议和；1684年，双方在楠蒂科克河一带划定了保留地。

面对殖民者侵占土地，一部分人于1744年获易洛魁人许可迁往宾夕法尼亚。美国独立战争期间，楠蒂科克人与英国结盟，部分人于1778年北迁至尼亚加拉堡；后来一些人在安大略的六国保留地定居。

en:
Mahajanga is a seaport on the north-western coast of Madagascar, at the mouth of the Betsiboka River on Bombetoka Bay. Its shores belonged to the trading world of the Antalaotra, Muslim Swahili-speakers whose city-states had dotted northern Madagascar since the tenth century.

Around 1690 the Sakalava prince Andriamandisoarivo founded the Kingdom of Boina in the region, and early in the eighteenth century his successors made Mahajanga their commercial capital after conquering the Antalaotra port of Mazalagem Nova.

An English captain visiting in 1764 found a cosmopolitan town built in the Indian fashion, with stone houses, mosques and Muslim merchants from Surat and Anjouan; an Indian trading community of some two hundred people had formed there by the 1780s. After 1832 the kingdom was occupied by the forces of Imerina, and Boina's independence came to an end.
zh:
马哈赞加是马达加斯加西北海岸的海港，位于邦贝托卡湾的贝齐博卡河口。这一带原属安塔拉特拉人的贸易世界——这些说斯瓦希里语的穆斯林自10世纪起在马达加斯加北部建起众多城邦。

约1690年，萨卡拉瓦王公安德里亚曼迪索阿里武在此建立博伊纳王国；18世纪初，他的继承者征服安塔拉特拉港口马扎拉任诺瓦后，把马哈赞加作为商业都城。

1764年一位英国船长到访时，看到的是一座按印度风格建造的国际化城镇，石屋与清真寺林立，苏拉特和昂儒昂的穆斯林商人云集；到1780年代，这里已形成约两百人的印度商人社群。1832年后，博伊纳被伊默里纳的军队占领，独立走向终结。

en: Nu Tireni refers to New Zealand, home to Māori peoples descended from Polynesian settlers. In 1835 northern Māori chiefs declared the independence of the United Tribes, a confederation based in the north of the North Island.
zh: 纽蒂雷尼指新西兰，是波利尼西亚移民后裔毛利人的家园。1835年，北方毛利酋长宣布新西兰联合部落独立，建立了以北岛北部为中心的联盟。

en:
The Nottoway were an Iroquoian-speaking people in Virginia, whose towns stood along the Nottoway River and Stony Creek. English explorer Edward Bland visited two towns in 1650, when they were led by the brothers Oyeocker and Chounerounte.

A Nottoway representative signed the Treaty of Middle Plantation in 1680, making the tribe tributary to Virginia. War forced the Nottoway southward, and in 1694 they moved again to a swamp in what is now Southampton County. In 1820 John Wood recorded words of their language from Edith Turner.
zh:
诺托韦人是弗吉尼亚讲易洛魁语族语言的族群，村镇位于诺托韦河和斯托尼溪沿岸。1650年英国探险者爱德华·布兰德到访其中两座村镇，当时的首领是奥约克和丘纳龙特兄弟。

1680年，一名诺托韦代表签署《米德尔普兰泰申条约》，部族成为弗吉尼亚的朝贡者。战争迫使诺托韦人南迁，1694年他们再次迁往今南安普敦县的一处沼泽。1820年约翰·伍德向伊迪丝·特纳记录了他们语言的词汇。

en: Nubia is the Nile region between the First Cataract and the confluence of the Blue and White Nile. The Christian kingdom of Makuria ruled part of it from Dongola until civil war reduced the kingdom in 1365.
zh: 努比亚是尼罗河第一瀑布至青尼罗河与白尼罗河汇合处之间的地区。基督教马库里亚王国曾从栋古拉统治其中一部分，直到1365年的内战使王国缩小。

en:
Numakaki was a collective name for the Mandan, a farming people of the upper Missouri River in present-day North Dakota. Their permanent villages of round earth lodges stood near the Heart and Knife rivers, and their corn surpluses were exchanged for bison meat and other goods.

Around 1750 the Mandan had nine large villages, but earlier smallpox outbreaks had reduced them to two by the early nineteenth century. In 1837 another epidemic devastated the Mandan after an American Fur Company steamboat traveled up the Missouri.
zh:
努马卡基是曼丹人的一个统称，他们是今北达科他州密苏里河上游的农耕族群。他们在哈特河和奈夫河附近建有圆形土屋组成的定居村落，以多余的玉米换取野牛肉等物资。

约1750年，曼丹人有九个大村落，但此前的天花疫情使村落到19世纪初减至两个。1837年，美国毛皮公司的一艘汽船沿密苏里河上行后，另一场疫情重创了曼丹人。

en:
Nupe is the country of the Nupe people in the basin between the Niger and Kaduna rivers in central Nigeria, where villages farmed and traded for centuries before a kingdom took shape.

Tradition gives the unification to Tsoede, also called Edegi, of Igala origin, who conquered neighbouring tribes in the 1400s and took the title Etsu, king, making himself the first ruler of a Nupe kingdom, a cavalry power on the middle Niger. The Nupe kept their own gods and river cults and traded with the Yoruba states.

Islam came late: Etsu Jibiri became the first Muslim ruler around 1770, and the kingdom reached its greatest strength under Etsu Ma'azu before his death in 1818. The Fulani jihad exploited the ensuing succession wars, and by 1835 the old kingdom was reorganized as a Fulani-led emirate, later seated at Bida.
zh:
努佩是努佩人的国度，位于尼日利亚中部尼日尔河与卡杜纳河之间的盆地；王国形成之前，村落已在此农耕贸易数百年。

传说统一归功于出身伊加拉的首领措埃德（又名埃代吉），他在15世纪征服邻近各部，采用“埃楚”（国王）称号，成为努佩王国的第一位统治者；该王国在中尼日尔河地区以骑兵见长。努佩人信奉自己的神祇与河流崇拜，并与约鲁巴诸邦贸易。

伊斯兰教来得很晚：埃楚·吉比里约在1770年成为第一位穆斯林统治者，王国在埃楚·马阿祖治下达到极盛，直到他1818年去世。富拉尼圣战随即利用继位战争介入，到1835年，旧王国被改组为富拉尼人主导的埃米尔国，王庭后来设在比达。

en:
Nuremberg grew up around an imperial castle on the Pegnitz, first documented in 1050. King Conrad III set up a burgraviate there, but Emperor Frederick II's Great Charter of Freedom of 1219 gave the town imperial immediacy, and power passed from the burgraves to a municipal council.

On the route between Italy and northern Europe, Nuremberg became one of the richest trading cities of the Holy Roman Empire; the Golden Bull of 1356 required each newly elected German king to hold his first diet there, and from 1424 the Imperial Regalia were kept there. Dürer and the Nuremberg Chronicle of 1493 made it a German Renaissance centre.

The city accepted the Reformation in 1525. Wallenstein besieged it in 1632 during the Thirty Years' War, and its population nearly halved; it never fully recovered, and in 1806 it passed to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh:
纽伦堡环绕佩格尼茨河畔的皇家城堡发展起来，最早见于1050年的记载。康拉德三世曾在此设立城堡伯领，但皇帝腓特烈二世1219年颁布的《大自由特许状》赋予城市帝国直辖地位，权力随之从城堡伯爵转入市议会。

地处意大利与北欧之间的商路要冲，纽伦堡成为神圣罗马帝国最富庶的贸易城市之一；1356年的《金玺诏书》规定每位新当选的德意志国王必须在此召开首次帝国议会，1424年起帝国圣器长期收藏于此。丢勒与1493年的《纽伦堡编年史》使它成为德意志文艺复兴的中心。

1525年城市接受宗教改革。三十年战争中，华伦斯坦于1632年围城，城市人口几乎减半，此后再未完全恢复，1806年被并入巴伐利亚王国。

en: Nusantara is an Old Javanese term for the islands of the archipelago. The Javanese kingdom of Majapahit claimed tributaries across much of that region in the fourteenth century.
zh: 努山达拉是古爪哇语中对群岛诸岛的称呼。14世纪，爪哇的满者伯夷王国宣称群岛大部分地区的诸国向它朝贡。

en: The Nutabes were Indigenous communities in the Aburrá valley and northern highlands of present-day Antioquia in Colombia. They grew maize and beans, mined gold and traded across a bridge at Bredunto. Their population fell sharply during Spanish colonization in the 16th century; the bridge was destroyed during the conquest and later rebuilt by Andrés de Valdivia.
zh: 努塔贝是今哥伦比亚安蒂奥基亚阿武拉谷地和北部高地的原住民社群。他们种植玉米和豆类，开采砂金，并经由布雷敦托的一座桥梁与邻族交易。16世纪上半叶西班牙殖民期间，努塔贝人口急剧下降；征服过程中桥梁被毁，后来由安德烈斯·德·巴尔迪维亚重建。

en:
The Nuwuvi, or Southern Paiute, lived in small communities across the Colorado River basin in southern Nevada, northern Arizona and southern Utah. They farmed floodplains using reservoirs and irrigation ditches, growing crops including maize and beans.

In 1776 the Franciscan explorers Domínguez and Escalante met Southern Paiute people while seeking a land route to California. From about 1830 traders used the Old Spanish Trail through the region to connect New Mexico with California.
zh:
努维人又称南派尤特人，以小型社群散居在内华达南部、亚利桑那北部和犹他南部的科罗拉多河流域。他们利用蓄水池和灌溉渠在泛滥平原种植玉米、豆类等作物。

1776年，方济各会探险者多明格斯和埃斯卡兰特寻找通往加利福尼亚的陆路时遇见了南派尤特人。约1830年起，商人使用穿过这一地区的旧西班牙小径，往来于新墨西哥与加利福尼亚之间。

en: The Nuxalc were Indigenous communities of the Bella Coola valley and neighbouring inlets on the central coast of what is now British Columbia. Their ancestral villages included settlements along the Bella Coola and Dean rivers and around Kwatna Inlet.
zh: 努哈尔克是今不列颠哥伦比亚中部海岸贝拉库拉河谷及邻近海湾的原住民群体。他们的祖居村落分布在贝拉库拉河、迪恩河和夸特纳湾一带。

en:
Novara was a city west of Milan that acquired the rights of a free imperial city in the Middle Ages. It joined the Lombard League in 1167, but by the end of the twelfth century had accepted Milanese protection and later fell under the Visconti and Sforza.

In 1513 Swiss troops defending the Sforza cause defeated a French army near Novara. The city passed to the House of Savoy in 1735; after the Napoleonic period it returned to Savoy in 1814.
zh:
诺瓦拉是米兰以西的一座城市，中世纪时获得自由帝国城市的权利。它于1167年加入伦巴第联盟，但到12世纪末已接受米兰的保护，此后落入维斯孔蒂和斯福尔扎家族之手。

1513年，为斯福尔扎家族作战的瑞士军队在诺瓦拉附近击败法军。1735年该城转归萨伏依家族；拿破仑时期结束后，诺瓦拉于1814年重新归属萨伏依。

en: The Nivkh were fishing and hunting communities of the lower Amur and northern Sakhalin. In the late thirteenth century they allied with the Mongols against the Ainu on Sakhalin.
zh: 尼夫赫人是黑龙江下游和库页岛北部以捕鱼、狩猎为生的族群。13世纪后期，他们与蒙古人结盟，对抗库页岛上的阿伊努人。

en:
The Principality of Novgorod-Seversk was a Rurikovich appanage in the basin of the middle Desna and the Seim, with its capital at Novhorod-Siverskyi. Created at the Council of Liubech in 1097 within the Principality of Chernihiv, it passed to a separate Olgovichi line in 1164.

Its most famous prince, Igor Svyatoslavich (1180 to 1198), led the disastrous 1185 campaign against the Cumans that became the subject of The Tale of Igor's Campaign. After the Mongol invasions the principality passed to the princes of Bryansk and then to Lithuania.

The principality passed through the hands of Gediminid princes until Casimir IV granted it in 1454 to the fugitive Muscovite prince Ivan Shemyakin. His son Vasily went over to Ivan III, and the truce of 1503 confirmed the principality as Muscovite. The last appanage prince, Vasily Shemyakin, died in prison in 1523, when the principality was abolished.
zh:
诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基公国是留里克王朝的封邑，位于杰斯纳河中游与谢伊姆河流域，以诺夫霍罗德-西韦尔斯基为都。它在1097年的柳别奇大会上设立，原属切尔尼戈夫公国，1164年起由奥利戈维奇家族的一支统治。

最著名的王公伊戈尔·斯维亚托斯拉维奇于1180—1198年在位，他1185年征伐波洛伏齐人惨败，成为《伊戈尔远征记》的题材。蒙古入侵后，公国先后落入布良斯克王公和立陶宛之手。

立陶宛统治时期，它几经格迪米纳斯王族王公之手，1454年卡齐米日四世把它封给从莫斯科逃来的王公伊凡·舍米亚金。其子瓦西里转投伊凡三世，1503年的停战协定确认其归属莫斯科。末代封邑王公瓦西里·舍米亚金1523年死于狱中，公国随即被撤销。

en:
Naugard, present-day Nowogard, grew from a fortified Slavic settlement on the Oder Lagoon whose name meant new stronghold in the Pomeranian tongue. It first appears in the records in 1268, when Duke Barnim I of Pomerania enfeoffed the stronghold and its lands to the Bishopric of Cammin, whose bishops built a castle there.

From 1274 the estate was administered by Otto von Eberstein, whose comital family held Naugard as vassals of the Cammin bishops for centuries. The town received German municipal law in 1309, and in the first half of the fourteenth century it was ringed with new walls around an oblong market square, where St Mary's Church went up.

When the last Eberstein died in 1663, Naugard passed to Ernst Bogislaw von Croÿ, and in 1684 to the electors of Brandenburg.
zh:
瑙加德（今诺沃加德）起源于奥得河潟湖畔一座设防的斯拉夫聚落，其名在波美拉尼亚语中意为“新城堡”。它最早见于1268年的记载，当时波美拉尼亚公爵巴尔宁一世把要塞及其土地封给卡明主教区，主教们在此修建了城堡。

1274年起，这份产业由奥托·冯·埃伯施泰因管理，其伯爵家族作为卡明主教的封臣世代领有瑙加德。1309年该镇获得德意志城市法，14世纪上半叶绕着长方形集市广场筑起新城墙，广场上建起了圣马利亚教堂。

1663年末代埃伯施泰因去世后，瑙加德传给恩斯特·波吉斯瓦夫·冯·克罗伊，1684年又转归勃兰登堡选帝侯。

en:
The Assiniboine were a Siouan-speaking people of the northern Plains, separated from the Sioux before the seventeenth century. They moved west from the Minnesota woodlands, acquired horses and hunted bison across a territory reaching from the North Saskatchewan to the Missouri.

In the eighteenth century they joined the Cree in the Iron Confederacy, whose bands traded furs and European goods across the northern Plains. By 1806 the Assiniboine were recorded in the Assiniboine River valley.
zh:
阿西尼博因是北部大平原上讲苏族语的族群，17世纪以前已与苏族分离。他们从明尼苏达的林地向西迁移，获得马匹，在北萨斯喀彻温河至密苏里河之间猎捕野牛。

18世纪，他们与克里人结成铁联盟，联盟中的部族在北部大平原各地交易毛皮和欧洲货物。到1806年，已有记载将阿西尼博因人置于阿西尼博因河谷。

en:
Niuwu was a small highland chiefdom of the Hani villages south of Yuanjiang, in the country the Ming called the Hani lands. Early Ming practice granted hereditary native offices to Hani headmen who opened hill fields, and in 1433 the headmen Ren Zhe and Tuo Bi travelled to Beijing to offer tribute and request titles.

The Xuande emperor accordingly created the Niuwu Chief's Office under Lin'an Prefecture, naming Ren Zhe chief and Tuo Bi his deputy over the Niuwu and Wulong villages.
zh:
钮兀是元江以南山地的哈尼人小酋邦，辖下钮兀、五隆等寨位于明代所称的和泥之地。明初对率众开辟山田的哈尼首领授予世袭土职。1433年，首领任者、陀比等到北京朝贡并请求授予官职。

明宣宗批准设立隶属临安府的钮兀长官司，以任者为长官、陀比为副长官，统领当地寨众。

en:
Nyarong, known to the Qing as Zhandui, was a remote agricultural valley on the middle Yalong River in eastern Kham, corresponding to present Xinlong County in Sichuan. Its steep, narrow gorge kept it off the main Tibetan trade routes, and for most of its history it was divided among competing tribes rather than ruled by one prince.

Tradition traces its chiefly line to 1253, when the monk Sherap Gyeltsen is said to have knotted an iron club before Kublai Khan and received a seal as chief of the valley, earning the family the name Iron Knot.

The Qing organised it into tusi, creating Nyarong commissions in 1728 and 1745. When the Lower chief Bangön defied the court, the Nyarong campaign of 1746 ended with his flight and a nominal Qing victory, though the isolated valley remained effectively in local hands.
zh:
娘绒清代称瞻对，是康区东部雅砻江中游的偏僻农业河谷，大体相当于今四川省新龙县。峡谷陡窄，远离藏地主要商路，历史上大多时候由互相争雄的部落分治，而非一统于某位君长。

当地首领世系相传始于1253年：僧人喜饶坚赞相传在忽必烈面前把铁棍打成结，受封印信，成为娘绒之长，家族也得名铁结。

清朝在当地推行土司制度，于1728年和1745年分设瞻对诸土司。下瞻对土司班滚抗命，引发1746年的瞻对之战，最终班滚逃走，清军名义上告捷，而闭塞的河谷实则仍由当地头人掌控。

en:
Boeny is the name of the trading settlements around Boina Bay on the northwest coast of Madagascar, the heart of the island's Antalaotra merchant communities. From the tenth and eleventh centuries Arab and Swahili sailors founded Muslim trading posts on this shore, and Antalaotra migrants came to control the Indian Ocean trade of Madagascar's northwest; by the late fifteenth century the Arab geographer Ibn Majid could list at least a dozen northern ports.

Around 1690 the Sakalava prince Andriamandisoarivo built on this coast the kingdom of Boina, also called Iboina or Boeny, served by the port of Mahajanga, where an English captain in 1764 found stone houses, mosques and Muslim traders from Surat and Anjouan.

Sakalava rulers allowed the Muslims freedom of worship in exchange for control of trade, until the kingdom was occupied by Imerina after 1832.
zh:
布埃尼是马达加斯加西北海岸布埃纳湾一带贸易定居点的名称，也是岛上安塔劳特拉商人社群的中心。10至11世纪起，阿拉伯和斯瓦希里水手在这一带建立穆斯林商站，安塔劳特拉移民逐渐掌控马达加斯加西北部的印度洋贸易；到15世纪末，阿拉伯地理学家伊本·马吉德已能数出北方至少十余个港口。

约1690年，萨卡拉瓦王子安德里亚曼迪索阿里沃在此建立布埃纳王国，又称伊博伊纳或布埃尼，以马哈赞加为港；1764年一位英国船长在城中看到石屋、清真寺和来自苏拉特、昂儒昂的穆斯林商人。

萨卡拉瓦诸王允许穆斯林自由信教，以此换取贸易管控权，直到1832年以后王国被伊梅里纳占领。

en:
The Duchy of Nysa was the only ecclesiastical Silesian duchy alongside Siewierz, ruled by the bishops of Wrocław from Nysa, probably founded in the tenth century. In 1198 Jarosław of Opole received the lands on becoming bishop of Wrocław, and in 1290 Henry IV Probus granted the bishops autonomous privileges that gave the duchy its legal basis.

The Mongols sacked Nysa in 1241, and the 1335 Treaty of Trentschin put the principality under Bohemian suzerainty. Its bishop in 1337, Nanker, excommunicated King John of Bohemia that year and died at Nysa in 1341.

Nysa beat off the Hussites in 1424, became a Polish printing centre in the sixteenth century, and was thrice besieged in the Thirty Years' War. Prussian troops took it in 1741, and the 1742 Treaty of Breslau split the duchy between Prussia and Austrian Bohemia; the Prussian part was secularized in 1810.
zh:
尼萨公国是西里西亚诸公国中除谢维日之外唯一的教会公国，由弗罗茨瓦夫主教以尼萨城为都统治，该城大概建于10世纪。1198年，奥波莱的雅罗斯瓦夫出任弗罗茨瓦夫主教时获得尼萨一带土地；1290年亨利四世（普罗布斯）授予主教自治特权，奠定公国的法律基础。

1241年蒙古人洗劫该城；根据1335年的《特伦钦条约》，公国转入波希米亚宗主权之下。1337年在任主教南克尔当年绝罚波希米亚国王约翰，1341年在尼萨去世。

1424年尼萨击退胡斯派，16世纪成为波兰语印刷中心，三十年战争中三次被围。1741年普鲁士攻占该城，1742年《弗罗茨瓦夫条约》将公国分为两部分，北归普鲁士、南属奥地利治下的波希米亚；普鲁士部分于1810年世俗化。

en:
Ningyuan Prefecture was a border native prefecture in the upper Black River valley, in country that now belongs to Vietnam's Lai Chau province. The Yuan created it in 1323, with its seat near modern Lai Chau, and placed it under Yunnan; the Ming transferred it to Lin'an Prefecture in 1382.

When the Ming withdrew from Jiaozhi, the territory passed to Annam in 1427 and remained under Vietnamese rule for more than a century. In 1540 Mạc Đăng Dung, ruler of the Mạc dynasty, returned part of the old prefecture to China, and in 1586 the Ming re-established Ningyuan Prefecture, only to abolish it in 1620.
zh:
宁远州是黑水河上游的边境土州，辖地今属越南莱州省。1323年元朝置州，治所在今莱州一带，隶属云南行省；1382年明朝将其改隶临安府。

明军撤出交趾后，其地于1427年归入安南，受越南统治一百余年。1540年，莫朝君主莫登庸把原宁远州的一部分归还明朝；1586年明朝复置宁远州，1620年又废州。

en:
Nizhny Novgorod, at the confluence of the Oka and the Volga, was founded in 1221 by Yuri II of Vladimir as a frontier fortress, for a century and a half the easternmost Russian settlement. In 1264 it passed to the princes of Vladimir-Suzdal; after its ruling line died out in 1320 it escheated to the grand prince of Vladimir, and in 1337 Ivan I Kalita held it.

In 1341 Konstantin of Suzdal secured Nizhny Novgorod, and in 1350 moved his seat there from Suzdal and took the title of grand prince, creating the Grand Principality of Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal, rival of Moscow.

The principality was crushed by the Golden Horde on the Pyana River in 1377, and Moscow annexed it in 1392. In 1612 Nizhny Novgorod was the base from which Kuzma Minin and Dmitry Pozharsky raised the militia that liberated Moscow.
zh:
下诺夫哥罗德位于奥卡河与伏尔加河交汇处，1221年由弗拉基米尔大公尤里二世修建为边防要塞，在一个半世纪里都是罗斯最东端的定居点。1264年它归入弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔王公治下；1320年王公世系断绝，城镇收归弗拉基米尔大公，1337年由伊凡一世·卡利塔持有。

1341年苏兹达尔的康斯坦丁取得下诺夫哥罗德，1350年把治所从苏兹达尔迁来并自称大公，建立下诺夫哥罗德-苏兹达尔大公国，与莫斯科争雄。

1377年公国在皮亚纳河战役中被金帐汗国击溃，1392年莫斯科将其兼并。1612年，库兹马·米宁和德米特里·波扎尔斯基以这座城市为基地组建民军，解放了莫斯科。

en:
Nanzan, called Sannan before the eighteenth century, was the southern of the three Sanzan kingdoms of Okinawa, founded around 1314 when the lord of Ōzato withdrew from Tamagusuku and entrenched himself at Ōzato Castle.

Small and poor, it lived chiefly by sea trade, its dock serving junks from China and Southeast Asia. It gained Ming tributary status after Chūzan's tribute in 1372, though each mission was limited to one ship; Ofusato, its first known lord, appeared at the Ming court in 1388 and died in Korea in 1398.

His brother Yafuso then seized power, and King Taromai won Chinese investiture in 1415. Court feuds kept it weak until Shō Hashi of Chūzan annexed it in 1429, completing the unification of Okinawa.
zh:
南山在18世纪以前称山南，是冲绳三山时代三个王国中位置最南的一个，约1314年大里首领脱离玉城，在大里城立寨建国。

南山国小民贫，主要依靠海上贸易，码头停泊着来自中国和东南亚的商船。1372年中山入贡明朝后，南山也获得朝贡地位，但每次贡使仅限一艘船；已知的初代首领承察度于1388年亲赴明朝宫廷，1398年死于朝鲜。

其弟屋富祖随后夺权，国王他鲁每于1415年获得明朝册封。宫廷内讧使南山始终孱弱，直到1429年中山的尚巴志将其吞并，完成冲绳的统一。

en:
Oʻahu is the third largest of the Hawaiian Islands, formed of two volcanic ranges. Polynesian settlers arrived around the tenth to twelfth century, and in the fifteenth century the island was unified under a high chief, the aliʻi nui.

Its first great ruler, Maʻilikūkahi, was a lawgiver whose dynasty lasted 304 years; later kings such as Kualiʻi made war on their neighbours and more than once held hegemony over Molokaʻi, and Oʻahu produced the first queen regnant recorded in the islands.

In January 1778 Oʻahu was the first Hawaiian island sighted by Captain James Cook, who landed on Kauaʻi instead. Kahekili II of Maui conquered Oʻahu in 1783 and set his son Kalanikūpule over it as a puppet king, until Kamehameha I broke his army at the Battle of Nuʻuanu in 1795 and added Oʻahu to the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi.
zh:
瓦胡是夏威夷第三大岛，由两条火山山脉构成。波利尼西亚定居者约在10至12世纪抵达，15世纪全岛统一在最高酋长阿利伊努伊之下。

第一位伟大统治者是立法者马伊利库卡希，他开创的王朝延续304年；此后库阿利伊等好战君王频频对外用兵，不止一次取得对莫洛卡伊的宗主权，瓦胡还出了夏威夷诸岛有记载的第一位女王。

1778年1月，瓦胡是库克船长望见的第一个夏威夷岛屿，不过他实际登岸的是考爱。1783年毛伊国王卡赫基利二世征服瓦胡，立其子卡拉尼库普莱为傀儡王；1795年卡美哈梅哈一世在努阿努之战击溃其军队，瓦胡并入夏威夷王国。

en: Oapan was one of the Coixca towns of the multiethnic Coixcatlalpan country in northern Guerrero, in the present-day municipality of Tepecoacuilco, where Nahuatl-speaking Coixca communities were interspersed with Tlapanec and Chontal villages. Like the other Coixca settlements it held out against Aztec expansion for a long time before accepting the rule of Tenochtitlan.
zh: 奥阿潘是格雷罗北部多族杂处的科伊什卡特尔潘地区的科伊克斯卡城镇之一，其地在今特佩科阿奎尔科境内；讲纳瓦特尔语的科伊克斯卡聚落在那里与特拉帕内克、琼塔尔人的村落交错分布。与其他科伊克斯卡聚落一样，它曾长期抵抗阿兹特克扩张，最终才接受特诺奇蒂特兰的统治。

en:
The Ōba were a warrior family who controlled the Ōba estate in Sagami Province. In 1180 Ōba Kagechika defeated Minamoto no Yoritomo at Ishibashiyama, but was later captured and executed; his brother Kageyoshi served Yoritomo.

The family's power in the Kantō declined, and in 1213 Ōba Kagetsura established a castle in Bingo Province. During the Sengoku period the Koshi, retainers of the Amago, took that castle; other members served the Ōuchi and Mōri.
zh:
大庭氏是控制相模国大庭御厨的武家。1180年，大庭景亲在石桥山击败源赖朝，后来被俘处死；他的兄长景义则效力于赖朝。

大庭氏在关东的势力逐渐衰退，1213年大庭景连在备后国筑城。战国时代，尼子氏家臣古志氏夺取了这座城；其他族人则效力于大内氏和毛利氏。

en:
Obdor was a Khanty principality around the lower Ob River in northwestern Siberia, with its centre at Pulvonat-Vosh. Novgorodian expeditions reached the lower Ob in 1364, and Obdor acknowledged Moscow's authority in 1500.

After siding with Kuchum of Sibir in 1563, its princes renewed their allegiance to Moscow in 1585. Russian settlers founded Obdorsk at the site of the Khanty settlement in 1595; resistance continued, but Prince Mamruk's revolt failed in 1609 and the principality became dependent on Russia.
zh:
奥布多尔是西西伯利亚北部鄂毕河下游的汉特人公国，中心位于普尔沃纳特沃什。诺夫哥罗德的远征队于1364年抵达鄂毕河下游，奥布多尔于1500年承认莫斯科的权威。

1563年公国转而支持西伯利亚汗库楚姆，其诸侯又于1585年重新归附莫斯科。1595年俄国人在汉特人聚落所在地建立奥布多尔斯克；抵抗仍在继续，但马姆鲁克公爵1609年的起事失败，公国遂依附于俄国。

en:
Obwalden is the upper valley of Unterwalden, south of Lake Lucerne around Sarnen. Alemannic settlers came around 700, and after Emperor Conrad II's campaign of 1032 to 1033 it passed to the Empire, enfeoffed to the counts of Lenzburg.

As part of Unterwalden it joined Schwyz and Uri in the Eternal Alliance of 1291, and in 1309 Emperor Henry VII granted the valleys imperial immediacy. Its men fought at Morgarten in 1315, guarding the Brünig Pass, and the valley communities governed themselves through open-air assemblies; it fought at Sempach in 1386.

In 1481 Obwalden's hermit Niklaus von der Flüe mediated the Stans compromise that admitted Fribourg and Solothurn to the confederation. Obwalden rejected the Reformation and stood with the Catholic cantons in the Kappel wars; in 1798 it became a Helvetic district, until the Act of Mediation of 1803 made it a half-canton again.
zh:
上瓦尔登是翁特瓦尔登的上游谷地，位于卢塞恩湖以南、萨尔嫩一带。约700年阿勒曼尼人迁入，1032—1033年皇帝康拉德二世远征后，此地归入神圣罗马帝国，被封给伦茨堡伯爵。

作为翁特瓦尔登的一部分，它在1291年与施维茨、乌利结成永久同盟；1309年皇帝亨利七世授予诸谷地帝国直辖地位。1315年乡民在莫尔加滕作战、守卫布吕尼格山口，各社区通过露天议会自治，后来又参加1386年的森帕赫之战。

1481年，当地隐士尼克劳斯·冯·德·弗吕促成施坦斯妥协，弗里堡和索洛图恩由此入盟。上瓦尔登拒绝宗教改革，在卡佩尔战争中站在天主教诸州一边；1798年成为海尔维第的一个区，1803年《调解法令》重新确立它为半州。

en: Occitania was the historical region of southern Europe where Occitan was spoken, encompassing much of southern France. The County of Toulouse ruled part of this region until its lands passed to the French crown in 1271.
zh: 奥克西塔尼亚是南欧历史上通行奥克语的地区，包括法国南部的大部分土地。图卢兹伯国曾统治其中一部分，其领地于1271年归入法国王室。

en:
Ocute was a paramount chiefdom in the Oconee River valley of present-day Georgia. Its alliance of towns formed around 1325, and its rulers fought Cofitachequi across the Savannah River basin. In 1540 Hernando de Soto's expedition entered Ocute and obtained laborers from its chief.

By the seventeenth century Altamaha had become the leading center, and the Spanish called the chiefdom La Tama. Westo slave raids fragmented it in the 1660s; some Ocute people moved toward the Chattahoochee, while others joined the Lower Yamasee towns near the coast.
zh:
奥库特是位于今佐治亚州奥科尼河谷的一个大酋邦。它的聚落联盟约在1325年形成，其统治者与萨凡纳河流域另一侧的科菲塔切基交战。1540年，埃尔南多·德索托的考察队进入奥库特，并从酋长那里征得劳力。

到17世纪，阿尔塔马哈成为主要中心，西班牙人将该酋邦称为拉塔马。韦斯托人在17世纪60年代发动的掳奴袭击使它瓦解；部分奥库特人迁往查特胡奇河，另一些人加入了沿海的下亚马西诸聚落。

en:
The Oda were samurai lords who followed the Shiba governors from Echizen to Owari Province. Oda Nobuhide took Nagoya Castle in 1538, and his son Nobunaga overcame rival branches of the family to unite Owari.

Nobunaga brought much of central Japan under his control and removed Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiaki in 1573. In 1582 his retainer Akechi Mitsuhide trapped him at Honnō-ji in Kyoto, where he killed himself. Toyotomi Hideyoshi surpassed the Oda, although family branches remained daimyō during the Edo period.
zh:
织田氏是日本武家领主，曾随守护斯波氏从越前迁往尾张国。织田信秀于1538年夺取名古屋城，其子信长击败家族中的对手，统一尾张。

信长将日本中部大片地区置于控制之下，并于1573年废黜将军足利义昭。1582年，家臣明智光秀在京都本能寺包围信长，信长自尽。此后丰臣秀吉的势力超过织田氏，但织田氏的分支在江户时代仍是大名。

en:
The Odoli were a Jurchen group from the lower Sungari and Mudan River region, where the Yuan established an Odoli command of ten thousand households. In the late fourteenth century their chief Mengtemu led them south to the Tumen River after attacks by other Jurchens. He paid tribute to Joseon in 1395 and later accepted Ming authority.

In 1411 Mengtemu moved his followers west to Fengzhou; the Ming established the Jianzhou Left Guard under his command. Mengtemu died in 1433, and his descendants included the ancestors of Nurhaci's Aisin Gioro clan.
zh:
斡朵里是松花江和牡丹江下游地区的女真群体，元朝在当地设置斡朵里万户府。14世纪末，首领孟特穆因其他女真部落的进攻率众南迁至图们江。1395年他向朝鲜进贡，后来又接受明朝的统辖。

1411年孟特穆率部西迁凤州，明朝设立建州左卫，由他统领。孟特穆于1433年去世，努尔哈赤的爱新觉罗氏出自他的后裔。

en:
The Odawa were an Anishinaabe people whose homelands included Manitoulin Island and the Bruce Peninsula on Lake Huron. Known as traders, they exchanged furs, food and other goods between communities and later settled around Michigan and Wisconsin. They were allied with the Ojibwe and Potawatomi in the Council of Three Fires.

In 1763 the Odawa war leader Pontiac besieged British-held Fort Detroit as a wider Indigenous war against British rule spread through the Great Lakes. He failed to take the fort and made peace with the British in 1766.
zh:
渥达瓦人是阿尼希纳贝人，家园包括休伦湖上的马尼图林岛和布鲁斯半岛。他们以贸易闻名，在各群体之间交换毛皮、食物和其他物品，后来也在密歇根和威斯康星一带定居。他们与奥吉布瓦人和波塔瓦托米人结成三火理事会。

1763年，渥达瓦战争领袖庞蒂亚克围攻英军占据的底特律堡，原住民反抗英国统治的战争同时扩展至五大湖地区。他未能攻下堡垒，于1766年与英国人议和。

en:
The Duchy of Oleśnica was a Silesian duchy. First part of Głogów, it became a separate duchy in 1313 for Bolesław, son of Henry III of Głogów; from 1321 it was ruled by his brother Konrad I, still the ruling Piast in 1337.

To shield himself from rival Piast claims and the Polish king, Konrad swore allegiance to King John of Bohemia in 1329, and Oleśnica remained a Bohemian fief. His successors bought estates and acquired Koźle in 1355, though the Hussites overran the country in 1432.

The local Piast line ended with Konrad X in 1492, and in 1495 the duchy passed to the Poděbrad dukes of Münsterberg. When that family died out in 1647 the emperor enfeoffed Silvius Nimrod of Württemberg, whose house held Oleśnica until Prussia took Silesia in 1742; in 1792 the duchy passed to the Welf dukes.
zh:
奥莱希尼察公国是西里西亚诸公国之一。这片土地原属格沃古夫公国，1313年格沃古夫公爵亨里克三世之子博莱斯瓦夫受封，成为独立公国；1321年起由其弟康拉德一世统治，他正是1337年在位的皮亚斯特公爵。

为抵御皮亚斯特同族的争夺和波兰国王的压力，康拉德于1329年向波希米亚国王约翰宣誓效忠，奥莱希尼察此后一直是波希米亚封邑。继承者们不断收购地产，又在1355年取得科伊兹莱，扩大了疆域；但1432年胡斯派军队曾席卷此地。

当地皮亚斯特支系随康拉德十世于1492年去世而终结，1495年公国转归波杰布拉德家族的明斯特贝格公爵。该家族1647年绝嗣，皇帝封给符腾堡的西尔维乌斯·尼姆罗德，其家族持有公国至1742年普鲁士征服西里西亚；1792年转归韦尔夫公爵。

en:
The County of Oettingen was the Swabian estate of the House of Oettingen, a noble family related to the Hohenstaufen and first documented as counts in 1147, with lands around Nördlingen. By the fourteenth century the Oettingens held the largest secular territory in eastern Swabia, and in 1337 it was ruled by Count Louis VI.

The partition of 1410 split the county into branches: the main line turned Protestant and was raised to princes in 1674 but died out in 1731, while the Catholic Oettingen-Wallerstein and Oettingen-Spielberg lines inherited its lands and became princely houses in 1774 and 1734.

In the mediatisation of 1806 the county passed to Bavaria, and part of it was ceded to Württemberg in 1810.
zh:
厄廷根伯国是厄廷根家族的施瓦本领地。该贵族世家与霍亨斯陶芬家族有亲缘，1147年首次以伯爵身份见于记载，领地围绕内德林根展开。到14世纪，厄廷根家族已领有东施瓦本最大的世俗领地，1337年在位的是路易六世伯爵。

1410年的分家把伯国分成各支：主支皈依新教，1674年升为亲王，1731年绝嗣；信奉天主教的厄廷根-瓦勒施泰因和厄廷根-施皮尔贝格两支继承其地，分别于1774年和1734年成为亲王家族。

1806年的陪臣化浪潮中，伯国并入巴伐利亚，1810年其一部分被割让给符腾堡。

en:
Offenburg stands at the mouth of the Kinzig valley where it opens into the Upper Rhine plain, a position that earned it the name gateway to the Black Forest. Roman remains have been found there, and the town is first documented in 1148 under the Zähringer; by 1240 it was a free imperial city. Emperor Frederick II had silver denars struck at its imperial mint, until King Albert closed it in 1300.

Offenburg briefly accepted the Reformation after 1525 but returned to Catholicism after 1530; between 1586 and 1631 witch trials put 104 people on trial and executed 89.

French troops occupied it in 1688 and burned it to the ground in 1689, sparing only the Capuchin monastery and two houses. Rebuilt, Offenburg kept its imperial status until the Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803 assigned it to the Grand Duchy of Baden.
zh:
奥芬堡位于金齐希河谷通往上莱茵平原的出口，这一位置为它赢得“黑林山门户”之称。境内发现有罗马时代遗迹，城市在1148年策林根家族统治时期首见记载；1240年已成为帝国自由市。皇帝腓特烈二世在奥芬堡帝国造币厂铸造银迪纳厄斯，1300年国王阿尔布雷希特关闭造币厂。

1525年后奥芬堡一度接受宗教改革，1530年后又回归天主教；1586至1631年间滥施猎巫审判，104人受审、89人被处死。

1688年法军占领该城，1689年又纵火将全城夷为平地，仅嘉布遣会修道院和两栋房屋幸免。灾后重建的奥芬堡保住帝国城市地位，直到1803年的《帝国代表重要决议》把它划归巴登大公国。

en:
The Ofo, also known as the Mosopelea, were a Siouan-speaking people of the upper Ohio River. Driven south during Haudenosaunee expansion in the 1670s, they lived briefly with the Quapaw and then joined the Tunica.

Around 1700 French travelers recorded Ofo villages on the Yazoo River in Mississippi. The Ofo later moved farther south and were absorbed into the Tunica and Biloxi of Louisiana.
zh:
奥夫又称莫索佩莱亚，是居住在俄亥俄河上游、讲苏语的民族。1670年代，易洛魁联盟的扩张迫使他们南迁；他们曾短暂与夸波人同住，随后加入图尼卡人。

1700年前后，法国旅行者记下了密西西比地区亚祖河畔的奥夫村落。奥夫人后来继续南迁，融入路易斯安那的图尼卡人和比洛克西人。

en:
The Ogamo were a family of eastern Hōki Province, originating in Ogamo district and holding Iwakura Castle. Under the Yamana governors, Ogamo Yukimoto helped defeat Akamatsu Mitsusuke in the Kakitsu rebellion of 1441.

The Amago took Iwakura in the sixteenth century, but the Ogamo later recovered it with Mōri support. After the Nanjō and Ogamo sided against the Mōri, Kikkawa Motonaga captured the castle in 1582; the family recovered it before losing its lands following Sekigahara in 1600.
zh:
小鸭氏是伯耆国东部的家族，出自小鸭乡，以岩仓城为居城。1441年嘉吉之乱中，小鸭之基在守护山名氏麾下参与击败赤松满祐。

16世纪尼子氏攻取岩仓城，小鸭氏后来在毛利氏支持下收复。南条氏与小鸭氏转而对抗毛利氏后，吉川元长于1582年攻下此城；小鸭氏随后收复城池，却在1600年关原之战后失去领地。

en:
The Ögedei descended from Ögedei Khan, Genghis Khan's third son and the Mongol Empire's second great khan, whose appanage lay on the upper Irtysh. After the Toluid seizure of the great khanate in 1251 the house was overshadowed until Ögedei's grandson Kaidu built a steppe state in the 1260s, dominated the Chagatai Khanate, briefly occupied Karakorum and warred for decades against Kublai and his Yuan successors until his death in 1301.

His heir Chapar submitted to the Yuan in 1310 and the Ögedei lands were partitioned between the Yuan and Chagataids. Ögedeid princes kept Irtysh appanages as Yuan vassals, while others ruled as puppet khans in the Chagatai realm and Northern Yuan. In 1337 the Irtysh horde was held by Temurchi of the Borjigin clan.
zh:
窝阔台人是成吉思汗第三子、蒙古帝国第二任大汗窝阔台的后裔，封地在额尔齐斯河上游。1251年拖雷系夺取大汗之位后该家族失势，直到窝阔台之孙海都在13世纪60年代建起草原政权，控制察合台汗国，一度攻占哈拉和林，与忽必烈及其元朝继承者鏖战数十年，1301年死去。

继承人察八儿于1310年向元朝投降，领地被元朝与察合台汗国瓜分。诸王仍在额尔齐斯河保留小块封地作为元朝附庸，另一些人则在察合台汗国和北元充当傀儡汗王。1337年，额尔齐斯河上的游牧部落由孛儿只斤氏的塔哈察儿统领。

en:
Ouargla is an ancient oasis town of the Algerian Sahara, built on what was once the country's largest palm grove. Its Berber inhabitants, the Banu Wargla, a Zenata people, adopted Ibadi Islam in the eighth century under the Rustamid imams. When the Fatimids destroyed the Rustamid capital of Tahert in 909, Ibadi refugees founded the caravan city of Sedrata.

Sedrata was destroyed in the thirteenth century, and Ouargla became the region's chief centre, usually independent under local dynasties but at times acknowledging the Hafsids of Tunis and the emirs of Biskra. Ibn Khaldun called it the gate of the desert, the obligatory passage of M'zab merchants to the Sudan.

As Touggourt drew the caravans away, Ouargla declined. In 1552 Salah Raïs of Algiers made it pay tribute; it was later attached to the Beylik of Constantine, with the Friday prayer pronounced in the name of the Ottoman caliph.
zh:
瓦尔格拉是阿尔及利亚撒哈拉的古老绿洲城镇，建在曾为全国最大椰枣林的绿洲上。居民巴努瓦尔格拉人属柏柏尔泽纳塔族群，8世纪在罗斯图姆伊玛目治下皈依伊巴德派伊斯兰教。909年法蒂玛王朝摧毁罗斯图姆都城塔赫特后，伊巴德派难民建起商队城塞德拉塔。

塞德拉塔13世纪被毁后，瓦尔格拉成为地区首邑，通常由本地王朝独立统治，有时承认突尼斯哈夫斯王朝和比斯克拉埃米尔的权威。伊本·赫勒敦称它为‘沙漠门户’，是姆扎卜商人前往苏丹地区的必经之地。

图古尔特吸走商队后，瓦尔格拉渐衰。1552年阿尔及尔的萨拉赫·赖斯迫其纳贡，此后并入君士坦丁贝伊里克，周五呼图白以奥斯曼哈里发的名义诵读。

en:
The Ōgo were a warrior family based around Ōgo on the southern slopes of Mount Akagi in Kōzuke Province. In 1350 they fought for Ashikaga Takauji against his brother Tadayoshi's supporters at Kasakake, where they were defeated.

The family later lost its position at Ōgo, while one branch moved to Ushigome in Musashi and served the Later Hōjō. By 1559 an Ōgo family member held land at Ushigome; his descendants took the name Ushigome and later served the Tokugawa.
zh:
大胡氏是以上野国赤城山南麓大胡一带为据点的武家。1350年，他们在笠懸野为足利尊氏对抗其弟直义的支持者，结果战败。

大胡氏后来失去了在大胡的地位，一支迁往武藏国牛込，成为后北条氏的家臣。到1559年，一名大胡族人已在牛込持有土地；其后裔改称牛込氏，后来仕于德川氏。

en:
The Ogasawara were a warrior family descended from the Kai Minamoto, named after their home in Kai Province. They served as governors of Awa in the Kamakura period and Shinano under the Muromachi shogunate.

Ogasawara Nagatoki fought Takeda Harunobu's invasion of Shinano, but was defeated at Shiojiritoge in 1548 and lost his base at Hayashi Castle in 1550. Ogasawara branches later became hereditary daimyo of five domains, including Kokura, under the Tokugawa shogunate.
zh:
小笠原氏是出自甲斐源氏的武家，以甲斐国的小笠原为家名。镰仓时代，他们担任阿波守护；室町幕府时期，又担任信浓守护。

小笠原长时抵抗武田晴信入侵信浓，却于1548年在盐尻峠战败，并于1550年失去根据地林城。此后，小笠原氏的各支在德川幕府治下世袭小仓等五藩的藩主。

en:
The Oguni were a warrior family of Echigo Province, descended from Minamoto no Yoriyuki. Oguni Masamitsu held Tenjinyama Castle for the Southern Court, but lost Shimazaki Castle to Ashikaga forces in 1336.

Oguni Yorihisa later served Uesugi Kenshin in campaigns including Kawanakajima. After Kenshin's death the family split between rival Uesugi heirs; the victor, Kagekatsu, installed Ōkuni Saneyori as its head, and his successors served the Yonezawa domain.
zh:
小国氏是越后国的武家，出自源赖行。小国政光以天神山城为据点支持南朝，1336年却在足利军的进攻下失去了岛崎城。

后来小国赖久侍奉上杉谦信，参加了川中岛等战役。谦信死后，小国一族分属上杉氏两位继承人的阵营；获胜的景胜任命大国实赖继承家督，他的后继者在米泽藩任职。

en:
Ohkwee Ówîngeh is a Tewa pueblo of the Tanoan-speaking Pueblo peoples, standing on the Rio Grande in present-day northern New Mexico. It was founded around 1200, during the Pueblo III period, by Tewa groups whose traditions trace a migration from valleys farther north.

In 1598 Juan de Oñate's expedition was received at the pueblo, which he renamed San Juan de los Caballeros and made the first Spanish capital of New Mexico. The seat of government moved to Santa Fe in 1610.

Po'pay, a Tewa religious leader born here, was among the elders flogged and imprisoned in 1675, and in 1680 he organized the Pueblo Revolt that drove the Spanish out of New Mexico for twelve years. Diego de Vargas reconquered the Rio Grande pueblos in 1692, after which the pueblo lived under Spanish and later Mexican rule.
zh:
奥奎‑奥温格是说塔诺语族特瓦语的普韦布洛人的一座村镇，位于今新墨西哥州北部的里奥格兰德河畔。它约建于1200年的普韦布洛第三时期，建村的特瓦群体口传自己来自更北边的河谷。

1598年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特的远征队在此受到接待，他将村镇改名为圣胡安·德·洛斯·卡瓦列罗斯，定为新墨西哥的第一个西班牙首府；1610年治所迁往圣菲。

出生于此的特瓦宗教领袖波·依是1675年遭鞭笞监禁的普韦布洛长老之一，1680年他组织普韦布洛起义，把西班牙人逐出新墨西哥达十二年。1692年迭戈·德·巴尔加斯重新征服里奥格兰德诸普韦布洛，此后圣胡安普韦布洛先后处于西班牙和墨西哥统治之下。

en:
The Ōhira were local lords based at Hasuike Castle in Takaoka district, Tosa. Their ancestor Kuninobu came from Sanuki and took the Ōhira name; the family ruled around Takaoka and Usa during the Muromachi period.

In 1467 the Ōhira helped the court noble Ichijō Norifusa reach Tosa from Sakai during the Ōnin War. His descendants established themselves in western Tosa, and the Tosa Ichijō destroyed the Ōhira in 1566.
zh:
大平氏是土佐国高冈郡的地方领主，以莲池城为据点。其祖国信从赞岐迁来，以大平为氏；室町时代，大平氏统治高冈至宇佐一带。

1467年应仁之乱期间，大平氏协助公家一条教房从堺来到土佐。教房的后裔在土佐西部立足，土佐一条氏于1566年灭亡了大平氏。

en:
The Ōida were a branch of the Satomi based at Ōida in Echigo Province. In 1333 Ōida Tsunetaka and his son Ujitsune joined Nitta Yoshisada in the attack on Kamakura.

After Yoshisada's death, Ujitsune protected his son Yoshimune and fought in Shinano and the Hokuriku region. The family later served the Uesugi, but in 1590 Ōida Kagekuni was ordered to commit suicide; a relative continued the family name as a retainer of Yonezawa.
zh:
大井田氏是里见氏的支族，以越后国大井田为根据地。1333年，大井田经隆和儿子氏经跟随新田义贞进攻镰仓。

义贞死后，氏经保护其子义宗，在信浓和北陆各地作战。此后大井田氏侍奉上杉氏，但大井田景国于1590年被命令自尽；一名亲族继承了家名，在米泽藩为家臣。

en:
Oriel is the anglicised form of Airgíalla, once a confederation of nine small kingdoms across central Ulster, said in legend to have been founded by the Three Collas after they wrested the country from the Ulaid.

From the eighth century it fell under the domination of the Cenél nEógain and the O'Neills, reaching its medieval height in the twelfth century under King Donnchad Ua Cerbaill. The Anglo-Norman invasion stripped away its eastern lands in Louth, leaving a reduced kingdom in what is now County Monaghan, ruled from 1243 by the MacMahons.

Wedged between the expanding Tudor state and Tyrone's O'Neills, Rossa Boy MacMahon surrendered the lordship to the crown in 1585, when it was shired as County Monaghan and divided into five baronies. The MacMahons joined the Irish rebellion of 1641, and after defeat their lands passed to Protestant settlers.
zh:
奥里尔是Airgíalla的英语化名称，曾是横跨阿尔斯特中部、由九个小王国组成的联盟，传说由“三科拉”从乌拉德人手中夺地后建立。

8世纪起，联盟受制于康尼尔·欧文和奥尼尔家族，12世纪在唐查德·乌阿·塞拜尔王治下达到鼎盛。盎格鲁-诺曼入侵削去它在劳斯的东部疆土，残存王国退守今莫纳亨郡一带，1243年起由麦克马洪家族统治。

由于夹在扩张中的都铎政权与蒂龙奥尼尔家族之间，罗萨·博伊·麦克马洪于1585年向王室交土再封，领地被划为莫纳亨郡，分成五个男爵区。1641年麦克马洪家族参加爱尔兰起事，失败后土地尽归新教定居者。

en:
The Oirats were a western Mongol confederation whose ancestral lands lay around the Altai. After the Yuan dynasty fell, they distinguished themselves from the eastern Mongols as the Four Oirats. Esen became their leading ruler in 1438 and united Mongolia under his influence.

In 1449 Esen defeated a Ming army at Tumu and captured the emperor Yingzong, whom he released the following year. He proclaimed himself Great Khan in 1453 but was killed after a revolt in 1455.
zh:
瓦剌是西部蒙古诸部组成的联盟，祖地在阿尔泰一带。元朝灭亡后，他们以四瓦剌自称，与东部蒙古人相区别。1438年也先成为瓦剌的主要统治者，并在其影响下统一蒙古。

1449年也先在土木堡击败明军，俘获明英宗，次年将其释放。1453年他自称大汗，1455年在叛乱后被杀。

en:
The Ojibwe were an Anishinaabe people of the Great Lakes, allied with the Odawa and Potawatomi in the Council of Three Fires. French Jesuit records mentioned them in 1640 near the outlet of Lake Superior. Trade with the French brought firearms, and Ojibwe communities expanded westward and southward around the lakes.

After fighting alongside France in the Seven Years' War, Ojibwe warriors supported Britain in the War of 1812. In 1807 Ojibwe and other nations signed the Treaty of Detroit, ceding land in southeastern Michigan and northern Ohio to the United States.
zh:
奥吉布瓦人是五大湖地区的阿尼希纳贝人，与渥达瓦人和波塔瓦托米人结成三火理事会。1640年的法国耶稣会记载在苏必利尔湖出口附近提到了他们。与法国人的贸易带来了火器，奥吉布瓦人的聚居地向湖区西部和南部扩展。

奥吉布瓦人在七年战争中与法国并肩作战，随后在1812年战争中支持英国。1807年，奥吉布瓦人和其他族群签订《底特律条约》，将密歇根东南部和俄亥俄北部的土地割让给美国。

en:
Oke-Ila, fully Oke-Ila Orangun, is an ancient Igbomina-Yoruba city-state in north-eastern Yorubaland and the sister kingdom of Ila Orangun. Both grew out of the old kingdom of Ila Yara, founded according to legend by Fagbamila, called Orangun, a son of Oduduwa.

In the late 1400s a quarrel between the brother-princes Apakiimo and Arutu Oluokun split the kingdom. Arutu's followers left to found Ila-Magbon and later Ila Orangun, while Apakiimo, the legitimate Orangun, led his faction east to Igbohun, the later site of Oke-Ila.

A segment of the neighbouring Isedo royalty joined them and took the title of Obala, next in rank to the Orangun and regent during interregnums. Ringed by quartzite ridges and gorges, Oke-Ila kept its Igbomina dialect and its Elewe ancestor-masquerade tradition, and both kingdoms kept the Orangun royal title.
zh:
奥凯伊拉全称为奥凯伊拉奥朗甘，是约鲁巴兰东北部古老的伊博米纳约鲁巴城邦，与伊拉奥朗贡为姊妹王国。两者都源自古伊拉雅拉王国——相传该国由奥杜杜瓦之子法格巴米拉（人称奥兰甘）建立。

15世纪末，阿帕基莫与阿鲁图·奥卢奥昆两位王子相争，王国分裂：阿鲁图一派出走，先建伊拉马格邦，后发展为伊拉奥朗贡；正统奥兰甘阿帕基莫则率本支东迁伊格博洪，即后来奥凯伊拉的所在。

邻近伊塞多王族的一支随同迁徙，获封“奥巴拉”头衔，地位仅次于奥兰甘，王位空悬时担任摄政。王国四周环绕石英岩山脊与峡谷，保留伊博米纳方言和埃莱韦祖先假面舞传统，它与伊拉两国都沿用奥兰甘王号。

en:
The Ōsaki were a branch of the Shiba family who ruled the Ōsaki district of Mutsu. Their ancestor Shiba Iekane went north as an Ashikaga commander during the fourteenth-century wars between the Northern and Southern Courts, and his descendants held authority over the region.

Ōsaki Yoshitaka became head of the family around 1567 and fought the neighboring Kasai. In 1590 Toyotomi Hideyoshi deprived Yoshitaka of his lands during the settlement of northern Japan.
zh:
大崎氏是统治陆奥大崎地方的斯波氏支族。其祖斯波家兼在14世纪南北朝战争期间以足利氏将领的身份北上，其后代掌握了当地的权力。

大崎义隆约于1567年继任家督，并与邻近的葛西氏交战。1590年丰臣秀吉整顿东北地区时，剥夺了义隆的领地。

en:
The Ōkura, also called the Hita, were local lords of part of Hita district in Bungo Province, Kyushu. Their base was Hita Castle, also known as Ōkura Castle. In 1444 a succession struggle led to the murder of Ōkura Nagakane; his successor Nagayoshi was later killed in exile, ending the Ōkura Hita line.

The family was restored through an adopted heir from the Ōtomo. After that Hita line also died out in the sixteenth century, eight local elders governed the district under Ōtomo authority.
zh:
大藏氏又称日田氏，是九州丰后国日田郡部分地区的地方领主。他们以日田城为据点，此城也叫大藏城。1444年的继承之争中，大藏永包遭到谋杀；继任者永好后来在流亡地被杀，大藏日田氏的宗支就此断绝。

家族通过从大友氏收养继承人而得以复兴。这支日田氏也在16世纪断绝后，日田由大友氏权力下的八名地方长老治理。

en:
The County of Oldenburg was a Holy Roman Empire territory on the lower Weser, centred on Oldenburg, first mentioned in 1108 as Aldenburg. Its counts traced their line to Saxon leader Widukind and held a modest core overshadowed by Hanseatic Bremen, until thirteenth-century wars won them northern Frisian lands.

In 1448 Count Christian was elected King of Denmark and soon Norway and Sweden, and Oldenburg passed to his brothers; in 1460 it passed to Gerhard and became independent of Denmark. Anton I introduced the Reformation and reunited Delmenhorst in 1547; Anton Günther, ruling from 1603, kept the lands out of the Thirty Years' War by armed neutrality.

On his heirless death in 1667 the main line ended and Oldenburg was ruled from Copenhagen until the 1773 Treaty of Tsarskoye Selo transferred it to Holstein-Gottorp; in 1774 it became a duchy.
zh:
奥尔登堡伯国是神圣罗马帝国威悉河下游的邦国，以奥尔登堡为中心，1108年首见记载，称阿尔登堡。伯爵自称世系上溯萨克森领袖维杜金德，核心领地不大，长期处在不来梅的阴影下，13世纪经战争夺取北方弗里斯兰土地。

1448年伯爵克里斯蒂安当选丹麦国王，不久兼领挪威和瑞典，奥尔登堡传给诸弟；1460年格哈德继位，领地脱离丹麦独立。安东一世推行宗教改革，1547年重新合并代尔门霍斯特。1603年继位的安东·京特尔以武装中立使领地免于三十年战争。

1667年他无嗣而终，主支绝嗣，奥尔登堡改由哥本哈根管理；1773年依《沙皇村条约》转给荷尔斯泰因-戈托普支系，1774年升为公国。

en:
Oman in 1337 was the kingdom of the Nabhanids, hereditary kings of the Azdi Arab Banu Nabhan, who took power in 1154 after the Seljuk Turks were expelled. From their fortified capitals at Nizwa and Bahla they ruled the interior, the elected Ibadi imams being reduced to a largely symbolic role.

The Nabhanids grew rich on the overland frankincense trade from Sohar through the Yabrin oasis, though the coast often slipped to the Kingdom of Hormuz, with which they kept a working accord.

From the fifteenth century the Ibadi imamate regained strength: the imam Muhammad ibn Ismail deposed the Nabhanid ruler Suleiman bin Mudhafar around 1500, and in 1507 the Portuguese seized Muscat and spread along the coast. The Nabhanids held out in Bahla until 1624, when Nasir bin Murshid of the Ya'Aruba founded a new imamate and ended their rule.
zh:
1337年的阿曼是纳卜汉王朝的王国。纳卜汉人属艾兹德阿拉伯人的巴努·纳卜汉部落，1154年塞尔柱突厥人被逐出后掌权。他们以奈兹瓦和巴赫莱等设防都城统治内陆，选举产生的伊巴德派伊玛目大体沦为象征性角色。

纳卜汉人靠陆上乳香贸易致富，商队从苏哈尔经叶卜林绿洲外运；沿海地带常落入霍尔木兹王国之手，纳卜汉国王与其协作。

15世纪起伊巴德伊玛目势力复兴：1500年前后，伊玛目穆罕默德·伊本·伊斯梅尔废黜纳卜汉君主苏莱曼·本·穆扎法尔；1507年葡萄牙人攻占马斯喀特并沿海岸扩张。纳卜汉人退守巴赫莱，直到1624年雅鲁巴家族的纳西尔·本·穆尔希德建立新伊玛目政权，王朝统治告终。

en: The Omaguaca inhabited the Humahuaca ravine in what is now northern Argentina. Around the 12th century they built Tilcara, a fortified administrative and military center. In the late 15th century Tupac Inca Yupanqui conquered the ravine, and the Incas used Tilcara to secure nearby metal supplies. Spanish arrival in 1536 ended Inca rule there.
zh: 奥马瓦卡人居住在今阿根廷北部的乌马瓦卡山谷。约12世纪，他们建造了蒂尔卡拉要塞，将其作为行政和军事中心。15世纪末，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基征服山谷，印加人利用蒂尔卡拉保障附近的金属供应。1536年西班牙人的到来结束了印加在当地的统治。

en:
Ometepec, Yucuvui in Mixtec, its name meaning at the two hills in Mixtec and Nahuatl, was an Amuzgo town in the Yacuyagua mountains. The older Amuzgo dominion, centred on Xochistlahuaca, was subjugated by the Mixtecs around 1100 and paid tribute for some three centuries as part of their province of Ayacastla.

The Aztecs conquered Ayacastla in 1457 but never held it directly or completely; Amuzgo revolts in 1494 and 1504 to 1507 were put down by force, and Ometepec became the seat of an Aztec province whose cotton, gold and cacao flowed to Tenochtitlan.

Pedro de Alvarado subjugated the region for Spain in 1522, and war, disease and forced labour so shattered the people that colonial writers counted the Amuzgos among the few native ethnicities to survive. In 1818 the old province's capital was moved from Igualapa to Ometepec.
zh:
奥梅特佩克米斯特克语称尤库武伊，其名在米斯特克语、纳瓦特尔语中均意为“两山之间”，是亚库亚瓜山区的阿穆斯戈人城镇。古阿穆斯戈领地以索奇斯特拉瓦卡为都，约1100年为米斯特克人征服，此后约三百年作为阿亚卡斯特拉省纳贡。

阿兹特克人1457年征服阿亚卡斯特拉，但未能直接、完全地控制；阿穆斯戈人1494年及1504—1507年的起义均遭镇压，奥梅特佩克成为阿兹特克省治所，棉花、黄金和可可运往特诺奇蒂特兰。

1522年佩德罗·德阿尔瓦拉多为西班牙征服此地，战争、疾病和苦役使人口锐减，殖民作家把阿穆斯戈人列为大崩溃后幸存的少数族群；1818年旧省首府从伊瓜拉帕迁至奥梅特佩克。

en:
The Ondo Kingdom is a forest Yoruba state south-east of Ife, with its capital at Ode Ondo. Its founder was the princess Pupupu, driven from Ile-Ife around the early 1500s for bearing twins, then seen as an ill omen; she led her followers south to Ile-Oluji, and her line went on to rule Ondo, where she is remembered as the first Osemawe, the title of its kings.

Her son Airo seized power in a palace coup, built the royal palace and organised the state around four ruling houses which supplied the Osemawe in turn. Unusually, Ondo governed through strong chiefs' councils, including a women's council beside the men's, with six high chiefs under the king.

It stayed independent through Oyo's dominance, but in the nineteenth century the Atlantic slave trade and the Yoruba wars brought repeated coups, wars and three changes of capital.
zh:
翁多王国是伊费东南森林地带的约鲁巴政权，首都为奥德翁多。开国者是公主普普普：约在16世纪初，她因生下双胞胎（当时被视为凶兆）而被逐出伊莱-伊费，率部众南下抵达伊莱奥卢吉，她的后裔后来统治翁多，她本人被尊为第一代“奥塞马韦”，这是国王沿用的王号。

她的儿子艾罗后来通过宫廷政变掌权，修建王宫，并把国家围绕四个王族编组，奥塞马韦由四族轮流选出。翁多的治理在当地颇不寻常：依靠强势的酋长会议，设有与男性会议并立的女性会议，国王之下有六位大酋长。

它在奥约称霸的年代始终保持独立，但到19世纪，大西洋奴隶贸易和约鲁巴战乱带来接连不断的政变与战争，首都也三度迁移。

en: The Onghniaahra were an Iroquoian group of the Neutral Confederacy who lived on the Niagara Peninsula. Their name has been linked to that of the Niagara River, though its origin is disputed. The Neutral Confederacy dispersed after Haudenosaunee attacks in 1651 during the Beaver Wars.
zh: 翁尼亚拉是中立联盟的一个易洛魁语族群，生活在尼亚加拉半岛。他们的名字与尼亚加拉河的名称有关，但河名的来源仍有争议。海狸战争期间，豪德诺索尼人在1651年发动袭击，中立联盟随之瓦解。

en: The Onojutta, also called the Juniata, were an Iroquoian-speaking people living along the Juniata River and its tributaries in present-day Pennsylvania. By 1648 they had become forced auxiliaries of the more powerful Susquehannock. They may have been partly absorbed by the Susquehannock and dispersed with them from the Susquehanna valley.
zh: 奥诺朱塔人又称朱尼亚塔人，是居住在今宾夕法尼亚州朱尼亚塔河及其支流沿岸的易洛魁语族人群。到1648年，他们被迫为势力更强的萨斯奎汉诺克人充当辅助部众。他们可能部分融入了萨斯奎汉诺克人，并随其一同被逐出萨斯奎汉纳河谷。

en:
The Onondowa'ga, or Great Hill People, are the Seneca, westernmost of the five founding Haudenosaunee nations and Keepers of the Western Door. Their palisaded towns, including Ganondagan, lay south of Lake Ontario. By the seventeenth century the Seneca were the league's most populous nation.

After entering the fur trade first with the Dutch and then the English, they led the confederacy against the Wendat, who surrendered in 1648, and then defeated the Neutrals, Erie and Susquehannock. In 1687 French governor Denonville destroyed Ganondagan, after which the Seneca anchored the English alliance.

Most Seneca fought for the crown in the American Revolution, and Sullivan's 1779 campaign burned their villages. The nation rebuilt on reservations confirmed by the treaties of Fort Stanwix in 1784, Canandaigua in 1794 and Big Tree in 1797. The prophet Handsome Lake, Longhouse code author, died at Onondaga in 1815, his followers keeping the Longhouse religion alive on the reservations.
zh:
奥农多瓦加意为“大山丘之人”，即塞内卡人，霍迪诺肖尼五创始族中最西的一族，号称“西门守护者”。其栅栏村镇包括加农达甘，分布在安大略湖以南，17世纪为联盟人口最多一族。

塞内卡人先与荷兰人、后与英国人贸易毛皮，率联盟进攻温达特人，1648年迫降，又击败中立族、伊利人和萨斯奎哈诺克人。1687年法国总督德农维尔摧毁加农达甘，此后塞内卡人成为联盟对英同盟支柱。

独立战争中多数塞内卡人助英王作战，1779年沙利文远征焚毁村庄，后在保留地重建，土地经1784年斯坦威克斯堡、1794年卡南代瓜和1797年大树条约确认。先知“英俊湖”为长屋法典创立者，1815年在奥农达加去世，信徒在保留地维系长屋信仰。

en:
The Ononda'gega', or People of the Hills, are the Onondaga, the central one of the five founding Haudenosaunee nations. Their towns stood by the lake and valley of their name in New York. As Keepers of the Fire they tended the eternal flame, and the grand council met at Onondaga, seat of Haudenosaunee government.

Oral tradition makes them the last to accept the Great Peace: the chief Tadodaho's cruelty was healed by the Great Peacemaker, Hiawatha and Jigonhsasee, dated by a remembered eclipse to around 1142. Nine clans under clan mothers were matrilineal.

Officially neutral at the Revolution's outbreak, the Onondaga turned against the Americans after their main village was attacked in 1779, and Sullivan's expedition ravaged their country. Many followed Joseph Brant to British lands on the Grand River; those who remained had their homeland rights recognized in the 1794 Treaty of Canandaigua.
zh:
奥农达格加意为“山丘之人”，即奥农达人，霍迪诺肖尼五个创始族中居中的一族。其村镇分布在纽约州中部以族名命名的湖泊与谷地一带。作为“火焰守护者”，他们守护联盟长明火，大议会在奥农达加召开，为霍迪诺肖尼政府所在地。

口传传统称他们最后接受“大和平”：酋长塔多达霍的残暴被和平使者、海华沙和吉贡萨塞治愈，后人凭记忆中的日食把此事定在约1142年。九个氏族由氏族母主领导，按母系传承。

独立战争爆发时奥农达人名义中立，1779年主村遭美军攻击后转而反美，沙利文远征随即蹂躏其家园。许多人随约瑟夫·布兰特前往英王授予的格兰德河土地，留下的人在1794年卡南代瓜条约中获故土权利承认。

en:
The Oiniwars, also called the Sugauna dynasty, were Maithil Brahmin kings who ruled the Mithila plain of northern Bihar from 1325 to 1526. The family's founder Nath Thakur served the last Karnat rajas and held the village of Oini, from which the clan took its name. His son Kameshwar Thakur, once chief priest at the Karnat court, inherited the throne when that kingdom collapsed in 1324 and still reigned in 1337.

Twenty-one rulers followed, shifting their capital from town to town and patronising roads, forts, temples and tanks. Their court made Mithila a literary land: the poet Vidyapati, born around 1352, served seven kings and two queens and wrote the Kirtilata for King Kirtisimha, while Sivasimha's gold coins and Bhairavasimha's silver coins carried the rulers' names. The latter were struck around 1489.

The dynasty ended when its last king Laxminath Singh Deva was murdered by Nusrat Shah of Bengal. Thirty years of clan fighting followed before the Maithil Brahmins of Raj Darbhanga took over.
zh:
乌尼瓦尔王朝又称苏高纳王朝，是1325至1526年间统治比哈尔北部弥萨罗平原的迈蒂利婆罗门王系。家族始祖纳特·他俱罗曾效力卡尔纳特末代诸王，受封奥伊尼村，部族以此得名。其子卡梅什瓦尔·他俱罗本是卡尔纳特宫廷首席祭司，1324年该王国崩溃后继承王位，1337年仍在位。

其后共有二十一代统治者，都城屡迁，沿途资助道路、要塞、神庙和水池的修建。宫廷使弥萨罗成为文翰之邦：约1352年出生的诗人维德亚帕蒂侍奉七位国王和两位王后，为基尔蒂辛哈王写下《基尔蒂拉塔》；湿婆辛哈的金币和约1489年铸造的拜罗沃辛哈银币上镌有王名。

末代国王拉克希米纳特·辛哈·提婆被孟加拉的努斯拉特沙阿杀害，王朝告终。此后诸部族混战三十年，终由达尔彭加的迈蒂利婆罗门家族接掌。

en:
The Onyota'aka, People of the Standing Stone, are the Oneida, one of the five founding Haudenosaunee nations. Their homeland lay around Oneida Lake in New York, between the Mohawk and Onondaga, where they farmed from the fourteenth century in bark longhouse towns. Their name comes from a legend of them vanishing among standing stones in a forest clearing.

French raiders and the Dutch arms trade at New Amsterdam drew them into the seventeenth-century fur wars. When the Revolution split the confederacy, the Oneida alone mostly sided with the rebels, partly through the missionary Samuel Kirkland, among them since 1764; about fifty warriors fought at Oriskany in 1777.

Chief Skenandoa kept the nation American, but postwar land cessions confirmed by the 1784 Fort Stanwix and 1794 Canandaigua treaties reduced their territory, and in the 1820s and 1830s many migrated to Wisconsin or joined communities in Ontario.
zh:
奥尼奥塔阿卡意为“立石之人”，通称奥奈达人，霍迪诺肖尼五创始族之一。家园在纽约州奥奈达湖一带，东接莫霍克、西连奥农达，14世纪起务农，住树皮长屋村镇。族名来自传说：追兵入林间空地时，全族消失在林立石头之间。

法国人的袭击和新阿姆斯特丹的荷兰武器贸易将其卷入17世纪毛皮战争。独立战争使联盟分裂，唯独奥奈达人多站在革命者一边，部分因1764年起住在他们中间的传教士柯克兰；1777年约五十名战士参加奥里斯卡尼战役。

酋长斯肯南多率族亲美，但战后土地割让经1784年斯坦威克斯堡、1794年卡南代瓜两条约确认，领地日缩；19世纪20至30年代许多奥奈达人西迁威斯康星或加入安大略的同族社区。

en: The O'ob, or Lower Pima, were communities of the Sierra Madre Occidental and the Sonora and Yaqui river regions in northern Mexico. Jesuit missionaries converted them to Christianity during the Spanish colonial period.
zh: 奥奥布人又称下皮马人，分布在墨西哥北部的西马德雷山脉及索诺拉河、亚基河流域。西班牙殖民时期，耶稣会传教士使他们皈依基督教。

en: The Oowekyala were the Wuikinuxv people of Rivers Inlet and Owikeno Lake on the central coast of what is now British Columbia. Their territory extended from the inlet's mouth to the headwaters of the lake, and their Northern Wakashan language was closely related to Heiltsuk.
zh: 奥维基亚拉是乌伊基努赫夫人，居住在今不列颠哥伦比亚中部海岸的里弗斯湾和奥维基诺湖一带。他们的领地从海湾入口延伸至湖泊上游，所说的北瓦卡什语与海尔楚克语关系密切。

en:
The Duchy of Opole, centred on Opole in Upper Silesia, was one of the Piast Silesian duchies. It first appeared in 1172 for Duke Jarosław; it merged in 1202 with Racibórz into the united Duchy of Opole and Racibórz, and when it split in 1281 Opole re-emerged under Piast rule.

In 1327 its rulers paid homage to Bohemia's John the Blind, and in 1337 Bolko II held Opole as a Bohemian fief. Repeated partitions shrank the duchy until Duke Jan II the Good reunited Opole with Racibórz in 1521. When Jan died heirless in 1532 the duchy reverted to the Bohemian Crown, which enfeoffed George of Brandenburg-Ansbach.

The Polish Vasas held it in fee from 1645 to 1666 before it returned to the Habsburgs, and the 1742 Treaty of Berlin gave it to Prussia after the First Silesian War.
zh:
奥波莱公国是皮亚斯特王朝的西里西亚公国，都于上西里西亚奥波莱。1172年首封雅罗斯瓦夫公爵，1202年与拉齐布日合并为奥波莱-拉齐布日联合公国；1281年联合公国分裂，奥波莱在皮亚斯特公爵治下独立。

1327年向波希米亚王“盲人”约翰臣服，1337年博尔科二世以波希米亚封臣领有奥波莱。屡次分家使公国日缩，直到扬二世“善人”1521年重新统一两地。扬1532年无嗣而终，公国归波希米亚王冠，转封勃兰登堡-安斯巴赫格奥尔格。

1645至1666年波兰瓦萨王朝持为封邑，后归哈布斯堡；1742年第一次西里西亚战争后，《柏林条约》把奥波莱划给普鲁士。

en:
The Duchy of Opava was ruled not by a Piast but by an illegitimate branch of the Bohemian Přemyslids. Before 1269 Ottokar II of Bohemia carved Opava from Moravia as an appanage for his natural son Nicholas I. Bohemia redeemed it in 1311 and made it a duchy in 1318 under Nicholas II, the Přemyslid duke of 1337.

By marrying Anna, sister of Leszek of Racibórz, he inherited Racibórz on Leszek's heirless death in 1336, ruling both duchies from 1337. His sons later separated them; partitions shrank Opava until 1462, when its Přemyslids sold their shares to George of Poděbrady.

After Poděbrady, Hungarian and Cieszyn rule, the Bohemian crown reclaimed it, and in 1614 Emperor Matthias enfeoffed Karl I of Liechtenstein. The 1742 Treaty of Breslau split it after the First Silesian War, part to Prussia and Opava to Austrian Silesia.
zh:
奥帕瓦统治者不属皮亚斯特家族，而是波希米亚普热米斯尔王朝私生子支系。1269年前奥托卡二世把奥帕瓦从摩拉维亚划出，封给私生子尼古拉斯一世。1311年波希米亚国王约翰将其赎回，1318年升为公国，尼古拉斯二世即1337年公爵。

他娶拉齐布日莱谢克公爵之姐安娜，1336年莱谢克无嗣而终，遂继承拉齐布日，1337年起兼治两地。他的儿子们后来将两地分开，屡次分家使奥帕瓦日缩，1462年份额卖给波杰布拉德的伊日。

后历经波杰布拉德、匈牙利、切申统治，波希米亚王冠收回之；1614年马蒂亚斯皇帝封给列支敦士登的卡尔一世。1742年第一次西里西亚战争后，《布雷斯劳条约》瓜分之，部分归普鲁士，奥帕瓦属奥地利西里西亚。

en:
Orange was a small feudal state in Provence, north of Avignon on the Rhône's east bank and ringed by the papal Comtat Venaissin. A county existing since Carolingian times passed to the lords of Baux, independent after the Kingdom of Burgundy broke up after 1033. In 1163 Emperor Frederick Barbarossa raised it to a sovereign principality within the Holy Roman Empire.

In 1337 the prince was Raymond IV des Baux, whose son Raymond V died in 1393 as the line's last male; the heiress Mary then carried Orange to the House of Chalon.

In 1544 the principality passed to the young William the Silent of Nassau, whose House of Orange made it a Huguenot stronghold in the Wars of Religion. Louis XIV's troops seized it in 1672 and again in 1682, and the 1713 Treaty of Utrecht ceded it to France.
zh:
奥朗日是普罗旺斯的小封建邦国，地处阿维尼翁以北、罗讷河东岸，四周被教皇的沃奈桑伯爵领地环绕。伯国加洛林时代便已存在，后转入博家族之手；1033年勃艮第王国解体后，博家族在此独立统治。1163年皇帝红胡子腓特烈将其升格为神圣罗马帝国的主权亲王国。

1337年在位的是雷蒙德四世·德·博，其子雷蒙德五世1393年去世，为家族最后一名男性继承人；女继承人玛丽把奥朗日带入沙隆家族。

1544年亲王国经继承转入拿骚的沉默者威廉之手，奥兰治家族在宗教战争中把这里变成胡格诺派据点。路易十四的军队1672年、1682年两度攻占，1713年《乌得勒支条约》最终将其割让给法兰西。

en: The Oroch were a Tungusic-speaking people of the lower Amur region and the rivers of the coast to its south. Their language was closely related to that of the neighboring Udege.
zh: 奥罗奇人是黑龙江下游及其以南沿海河流一带的通古斯语族人群。他们的语言与邻近的兀狄哈人的语言关系密切。

en:
Ormond was the principal lordship of the Butler family, Hiberno-Normans whose surname came from the hereditary office of Chief Butler of Ireland, first held by Theobald Walter under Prince John around 1185. The earldom was created in 1328 for James Butler, whose lands covered most of Tipperary and Kilkenny.

The fifth earl became Earl of Wiltshire in England in 1449 but was attainted in 1461; his brother John recovered Ormond in 1476. When the seventh earl died heirless in 1515, a succession dispute let Henry VIII grant the title to Thomas Boleyn, Anne Boleyn's father, in 1528, before Piers Butler recovered it for the family in 1538.

The family peaked under another James Butler, made Marquess of Ormonde in 1642 and Duke of Ormonde in 1660, who led the royalist cause in Ireland through the seventeenth-century wars.
zh:
奥蒙德是巴特勒家族的核心领地。该爱尔兰诺曼家族姓氏源自世袭爱尔兰首席司酒官之职，最早由西奥博尔德·沃尔特于1185年前后在约翰王子麾下担任。1328年詹姆斯·巴特勒受封伯爵，领地囊括蒂珀雷里和基尔肯尼大部。

第五代伯爵1449年在英格兰受封威尔特郡伯爵，1461年被剥夺公权，其弟约翰1476年恢复奥蒙德头衔。第七代伯爵1515年无嗣而终，继承之争使亨利八世1528年把头衔转封给安妮·博林之父托马斯·博林，1538年皮尔斯·巴特勒恢复家族爵位。

家族在另一位詹姆斯·巴特勒治下鼎盛：1642年封奥蒙德侯爵、1660年封奥蒙德公爵，17世纪战乱中统领爱尔兰保王派。

en:
Oreshek was a Novgorod border principality centered on a fortress on Orekhovy Island, where the Neva leaves Lake Ladoga on the trade route from Novgorod to the Baltic. The wooden fort was raised in 1323 by Grand Prince Yury of Moscow on Novgorod's behalf, and the same year it hosted the peace treaty with Sweden that first fixed a border between the Orthodox and Catholic worlds.

In 1333 Novgorod entrusted its north-western marches to the Lithuanian Gediminid prince Narimantas, whose son Alexander ruled the autonomous principality of Oreshek, so the Neva forts remained under Gediminid authority in 1337.

King Magnus IV of Sweden stormed the fort in 1348 during his crusade, but Novgorod retook it in 1351 and Archbishop Vasily Kalika rebuilt it in stone the next year. For centuries Oreshek remained a key stronghold disputed between Rus' and Sweden.
zh:
奥列舍克是诺夫哥罗德边境封邑，核心是涅瓦河出拉多加湖处奥列霍维岛上的要塞，扼守诺夫哥罗德通往波罗的海的商路。木制要塞1323年由莫斯科大公尤里代表诺夫哥罗德修建，同年在此签署对瑞典和约，首次划定东正教与天主教世界的边界。

1333年诺夫哥罗德把西北边地托付给立陶宛格迪米纳斯家族王公纳里曼塔斯，其子亚历山大统治自治的奥列舍克公国，1337年涅瓦河沿线要塞仍在该家族掌控之下。

1348年瑞典国王马格努斯四世在十字军行动中攻陷要塞，诺夫哥罗德1351年将其收复，大主教瓦西里·卡利卡次年重建为石造要塞。此后数百年间，奥列舍克始终是罗斯与瑞典反复争夺的关键据点。

en:
Orissa, the old kingdom of Kalinga on the Bay of Bengal, was ruled in 1337 by the Eastern Ganga dynasty from their capital at Kataka, modern Cuttack. The Gangas had risen in the fifth century and moved their court to Kataka in 1135 under Anantavarman Chodaganga, who began the great Jagannath temple at Puri; his successors completed it and Narasimhadeva I built the Sun Temple at Konark after carrying the Ganga arms into Bengal in 1245, the first Orissan king to take the title Gajapati. In 1337 the throne belonged to Narasimha Deva III, whose rajas along the Andhra and Orissan coast held their lands as his feudatories. His son Bhanu Deva III had to buy off the invasion of Firuz Shah Tughlaq between 1353 and 1358, and the dynasty ended when the minister Kapilendra Deva usurped the crown in 1435 and founded the Suryavamsi Gajapati empire, which by 1457 stretched from the Ganga to Bidar and patronised the Odia poet Sarala Das.

Gajapati power faded under Prataparudra Deva, pressed by Bengal and by Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara, and coups between 1541 and 1559 ended with Mukunda Deva, whose kingdom fell to the Bengal sultan Sulaiman Khan Karrani and his general Kalapahad in 1568. Orissa then passed under Mughal governors until Maratha bargi raids from 1742 forced its cession to Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur in 1751, and the British took Cuttack and the province in 1803 during the Second Anglo-Maratha War.
zh:
奥里萨古称羯陵伽，是孟加拉湾畔的王国，1337年由东恒伽王朝以卡塔克（今库塔克）为都进行统治。恒伽人5世纪兴起，阿南塔跋摩·朱达恒伽于1135年迁都卡塔克，并动工修建普里的贾格纳特大庙；后继诸王将其完成，那罗辛哈提婆一世还在1245年挥师攻入孟加拉后修建了科纳克太阳神庙，他也是首位采用伽阇波蒂称号的奥里萨国王。1337年在位的是那罗辛哈·提婆三世，安得拉与奥里萨沿海的罗阇们作为封臣为他守土。其子巴努·提婆三世在1353至1358年间被迫纳贡，才打发走菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克的入侵；1435年，大臣卡皮伦德拉·提婆篡位，建立苏利耶万希·伽阇波蒂帝国，到1457年疆域北起恒河、南抵比达尔，并庇护了奥里亚诗人娑罗罗·达斯，东恒伽王朝至此终结。

伽阇波蒂的国势在波罗多波鲁陀罗·提婆治下转衰，一面受孟加拉逼迫，一面遭毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚打击；1541至1559年间接连政变，最后上位的穆昆达·提婆在1568年被孟加拉苏丹苏莱曼汗·卡拉尼及其大将卡拉帕哈德攻灭。奥里萨随后由莫卧儿总督管辖，1742年起马拉塔骑兵（巴尔吉）连年劫掠，1751年被迫割让给那格浦尔的拉戈吉一世·邦斯勒；1803年第二次英国—马拉塔战争中，英军攻占库塔克，取得全省。

en:
Orkney and Shetland, the Norse sagas' Northern Isles, were Pictish until Viking settlers displaced them from the late eighth century. The ninth-century earldom made them a raiding base against Scotland and the Irish Sea; from about 1100 its jarls did homage to Norway. Christianity came in 995; the 1116 murder of Earl Magnus Erlendsson gave the islands their patron saint and Kirkwall's St Magnus Cathedral.

The Norse line ended in 1231; the jarldom passed to Gaelic lords, islanders keeping Norn. In 1290 Margaret, Maid of Norway, died here bound for the Scottish throne, sparking the succession crisis behind the Wars of Independence. In 1337 the jarl was Malise; the Sinclairs took the earldom in 1379.

In 1468 Christian I of Norway pledged the islands as security for his daughter's dowry to James III; the sum unpaid, Scotland annexed Orkney in 1472, ending six centuries of Norse rule.
zh:
奥克尼与设得兰是萨迦中的北部群岛，本为皮克特之地，8世纪末起被维京定居者取代。9世纪的伯爵领以群岛为劫掠苏格兰与爱尔兰海的基地，约1100年起雅尔向挪威称臣。995年群岛皈依基督教；1116年雅尔马格努斯遇害，为群岛带来主保圣人和柯克沃尔圣马格努斯大教堂。

诺斯世系1231年断绝，雅尔之位转封盖尔贵族，岛民仍说诺恩语。1290年挪威少女玛格丽特赴苏继位途中病逝于此，引发独立战争继承危机。1337年雅尔为马利兹，1379年伯爵领归辛克莱家族。

1468年挪威王克里斯蒂安一世把群岛作为女儿嫁妆抵押给詹姆斯三世，抵押款未付，苏格兰1472年吞并奥克尼，六百年诺斯统治告终。

en:
Orleans was a French royal duchy centred on the city of Orleans. Philip VI raised the county to a duchy for his son Philip in 1344; it returned to the crown when Philip died without a legitimate heir in 1375.

Charles VI recreated the duchy for his brother Louis in 1392. Louis struggled with John the Fearless of Burgundy for influence over France and was murdered on John's orders in 1407. The duchy returned to the crown when Louis's grandson became King Louis XII in 1498.
zh:
奥尔良是以奥尔良城为中心的法国王室公国。1344年，腓力六世将奥尔良伯国升为公国，封给儿子腓力；1375年腓力去世，没有合法继承人，公国归还王室。

1392年，查理六世重新设立公国，封给弟弟路易。路易与勃艮第的无畏的约翰争夺对法国的影响力，1407年被约翰下令刺杀。1498年，路易的孙子即位为路易十二，公国再次归于王室。

en:
Hormuz was founded in the eleventh century by Muhammad Diramku, an Arab chief from Oman, who built a port on the Persian mainland near Minab as a Seljuk tributary. It grew into one of the great emporia of the Indian Ocean, levying tolls on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and controlling ports on both Persian and Arabian shores.

Around 1300, worn down by raids, its rulers moved their capital to the island of Jarun, thereafter called Hormuz, where merchants accumulated legendary wealth. In 1337 it still dominated the sea routes linking Persia, India and Arabia, with tributary towns along the Fars and Makran coasts.

The Portuguese stormed Hormuz in 1507 and made it a permanent client state in 1515, running Gulf shipping through their cartaz licensing system. Portuguese rule ended in 1622, when Shah Abbas of the Safavids, helped by the English East India Company, seized the island and trade shifted to Bandar Abbas.
zh:
霍尔木兹于11世纪由阿曼阿拉伯首领穆罕默德·迪拉姆库建立，他在今米纳布附近的波斯大陆沿海营建港口，向塞尔柱苏丹称臣。它成为印度洋最大商埠之一，向通过霍尔木兹海峡的船只征收通行税，控制波斯与阿拉伯两岸的港口。

约1300年，因屡遭劫掠，统治者迁都贾伦岛，该岛此后称霍尔木兹岛，商人在此积聚传说般的财富。1337年，它仍掌控连接波斯、印度和阿拉伯的海路，法尔斯和莫克兰沿岸城镇向它纳贡。

葡萄牙人1507年攻破霍尔木兹，1515年把它变为永久附庸，以特许状制度管理海湾航运。1622年，萨非王朝阿拔斯沙阿在英国东印度公司协助下攻占该岛，葡萄牙统治结束，贸易转往阿巴斯港。

en:
The Oromo were Cushitic-speaking pastoral peoples of southern Ethiopia and northern Kenya, organized through the gadaa system, in which leaders served eight-year terms. From about 1530, Oromo groups expanded into central and eastern Ethiopia as war weakened both the Ethiopian Empire and the Adal Sultanate.

They settled in new territories and incorporated other peoples. Oromo kingdoms later emerged in the Gibe region.
zh:
奥罗莫是生活在埃塞俄比亚南部和肯尼亚北部、使用库施特语族语言的游牧民族，以加达制度组织社会，领袖任期为八年。约1530年起，战争削弱了埃塞俄比亚帝国和阿达尔苏丹国，奥罗莫各部向埃塞俄比亚中部和东部扩张。

他们在新领地定居并吸收其他族群。后来奥罗莫人在吉贝地区建立了多个王国。

en: The Oroqen were Tungusic-speaking hunters whose ancestors lived north of the Amur. In the seventeenth century, Russian incursions prompted some to move toward the Greater and Lesser Khingan ranges.
zh: 鄂伦春人是通古斯语族的狩猎人群，其先民居住在黑龙江以北。17世纪俄国入侵后，一部分人迁往大、小兴安岭一带。

en:
The County of Ortenburg took its name from Hortenburc castle, first mentioned in 1091 on Mt. Goldeck in Carinthia. When the rival Counts of Lurn died out in 1135 the Ortenburgs inherited their estates down the Drava to Villach, and in 1191 founded the Spittl hospital by the Lieser, around which grew Spittal an der Drau.

Around 1330 Count Meinhard absorbed the Sternberg estates between the Ossiach and Wörth lakes; in the fourteenth century the Ortenburgs settled German colonists on their Gottschee lands, founding the town now called Kočevje. Balancing the Carinthian dukes and Habsburgs, they had backed Rudolf of Habsburg in 1306 and won crown confirmation of their immediate rights.

The line ended with childless Count Frederick III in 1418, the lands passing to Hermann II of Cilli; when the Cilli died out in 1456 the Habsburgs took Ortenburg, and in 1524 Archduke Ferdinand granted it to treasurer Gabriel von Salamanca.
zh:
奥尔滕堡得名于1091年首见记载的霍滕堡城堡，在克恩滕戈尔代克山坡。1135年卢恩伯爵绝嗣，奥尔滕堡家族继承其沿德劳河至菲拉赫的地产；1191年在利泽尔河畔建Spittl济贫院，德劳河畔施皮塔尔由此发展而来。

约1330年迈因哈德兼并奥西阿赫湖与沃尔特湖之间的施特恩贝格地产；14世纪家族在戈切领地安置德国殖民者，建成今科切维镇。奥尔滕堡家族在克恩滕公爵与哈布斯堡之间周旋，1306年支持哈布斯堡的鲁道夫，直属地位获王室确认。

1418年末代伯爵弗雷德里克三世无嗣而终，领地传采列的赫尔曼二世；1456年采列家族绝嗣，哈布斯堡接管奥尔滕堡，1524年斐迪南大公将其赐给司库加布里埃尔·冯·萨拉曼卡。

en: Osheaga was a fortified St. Lawrence Iroquoian village near Mount Royal in present-day Montreal, also known as Hochelaga. Jacques Cartier visited it on 3 October 1535 and named the nearby mountain. By around 1600 the St. Lawrence Iroquoians had disappeared from the valley; the cause remains uncertain.
zh: 奥谢阿加又称奥什拉加，是圣劳伦斯易洛魁人在今蒙特利尔皇家山附近的一座设防村落。雅克·卡蒂埃于1535年10月3日到访，并为附近的山命名。到1600年前后，圣劳伦斯易洛魁人已从河谷消失，原因尚不确定。

en:
The Osaakiiwaki, or Sauk, were an Algonquian people whose historical territory lay near Green Bay. After conflicts with New France and other peoples, they and their Meskwaki allies lived along the Mississippi in the eighteenth century.

The disputed Treaty of St. Louis ceded land east of the Mississippi to the United States in 1804. In 1832 the Sauk leader Black Hawk crossed back into Illinois with Sauk, Meskwaki and Kickapoo followers; American forces defeated them in the ensuing Black Hawk War.
zh:
奥萨基瓦基人又称索克人，是居住在格林湾附近的阿尔冈昆语族民族。与新法兰西及其他族群发生冲突后，他们和梅斯夸基盟友于18世纪生活在密西西比河沿岸。

1804年，有争议的《圣路易斯条约》将密西西比河以东的土地割让给美国。1832年，索克领袖黑鹰率索克、梅斯夸基和基卡普追随者渡河返回伊利诺伊，随后在黑鹰战争中被美军击败。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Osnabrück was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in Westphalia, named after its cathedral city. Charlemagne erected the diocese in 772, the oldest see founded for the Christianization of the conquered Saxons; the bishops won full temporal rule in the thirteenth century after struggles with the Counts of Tecklenburg, who renounced their claims in 1236.

In 1337 the bishop was Godfrey of Arnsberg, and the small state often defended itself against the neighbouring bishops of Minden and Münster. The Reformation split its people, and the 1648 Peace of Westphalia left the city bi-confessional, with Catholic and Protestant bishops alternating.

Dissolved in the German Mediatisation of 1803, it was given to the Electorate of Hanover, and after Prussian, Westphalian and French rule returned to Hanover in 1814.
zh:
奥斯纳布吕克采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国在威斯特伐利亚的教会邦国，以主教座堂城市得名。查理曼772年设立该主教区，是为使被征服的萨克森人皈依而建的最古老教区；13世纪主教们与泰克伦堡伯爵争斗后取得完整世俗统治权，伯爵1236年放弃权利要求。

1337年在任的是阿恩斯贝格的戈弗雷，这个小邦时常抵御邻邦明登和明斯特主教的侵逼。宗教改革使居民分裂为两派，1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》规定该城实行双信仰制，主教由天主教徒和新教徒轮流担任。

1803年德意志采邑调解中采邑主教区被解散，划归汉诺威选侯国；此后历经普鲁士、威斯特伐利亚和法国统治，1814年重回汉诺威。

en:
Ossory, Irish Osraige, was a Gaelic Irish kingdom in the valley of the River Nore, roughly the later County Kilkenny and the country around it. Tradition traced its ruling Dal Birn dynasty to a first-century founder, and in 859 King Cerball mac Dunlainge won it formal independence from Munster. By the late tenth century the rulers had taken the surname Mac Giolla Phadraig, later anglicised as Fitzpatrick.

The Norman invasion of 1169 broke the old kingdom: William Marshal built Kilkenny Castle and drove the Mac Giolla Phadraigs north into Upper Ossory's hills. In 1337 the chief still ruled this northern remnant as a Gaelic lordship.
