The Butler earls of Ormond administered Kilkenny, where the Statutes of Kilkenny were passed in 1367. Upper Ossory stayed independent until Henry VIII, when it was surrendered and regranted as an English barony.
zh:
奥索里，爱尔兰语称奥斯赖盖，是盖尔爱尔兰王国，位于诺尔河流域，大致相当于后来的基尔肯尼郡一带。相传统治的达尔·比尔恩王朝始祖可追溯到1世纪；859年国王塞尔巴尔·麦克·邓林格使王国脱离芒斯特独立。10世纪末统治者采用麦克吉尔·帕特里克为姓，后英化为菲茨帕特里克。

1169年诺曼入侵瓦解旧王国：威廉·马歇尔修建基尔肯尼城堡，把麦克吉尔·帕特里克家族赶到北方上奥索里山区。1337年酋长仍以盖尔领主身份统治这块残余领地。

奥蒙德巴特勒伯爵管辖基尔肯尼，1367年在那里颁布《基尔肯尼法令》；上奥索里一直独立，直至亨利八世在位时以“投降与再封”改为英格兰式男爵领。

en:
The Duchy of Oświęcim, known in German as Auschwitz, lay on Lesser Polish lands east of the Biała River. It was split from Cieszyn in 1315 for Władysław, son of Duke Mieszko I. His heir Jan I the Scholastic, reigning in 1337, had paid homage to King John of Bohemia in 1327, so Oświęcim entered the age as a Bohemian vassal despite its Lesser Polish ties.

Repeated partitions weakened the duchy, and in 1445 Zator and Toszek were carved from its lands. The last duke, Jan IV, declared himself a vassal of the Polish king Casimir IV Jagiellon in 1454 and in 1457 sold the duchy to the Polish Crown for three million Prague groschen.

The Sejm of 1564 incorporated Oświęcim into the Kraków Voivodeship, and in the First Partition of 1772 the lands passed to the Habsburg monarchy as part of Galicia.
zh:
奥斯威辛公国（德语称奥施维茨）位于比亚瓦河以东的小波兰土地上。它于1315年从切申公国分出，交给公爵梅什科一世之子瓦迪斯瓦夫。其继承人“学者”扬一世在1337年在位，曾于1327年向波希米亚国王约翰行臣服礼，因此尽管与小波兰联系紧密，奥斯威辛在这一年代仍是波希米亚的附庸。

不断分家削弱了公国，1445年扎托尔和托谢克又从其领地中划出。末代公爵扬四世于1454年宣布成为波兰国王卡齐米尔四世·雅盖隆的封臣，并在1457年以三百万布拉格格罗申把公国卖给波兰王冠。

1564年议会把奥斯威辛并入克拉科夫省；1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，这片土地作为加利西亚的一部分转归哈布斯堡君主国。

en:
Otatitlan was a small river town on the lower Papaloapan, on the border between Veracruz and Oaxaca. Its Nahuatl name means place of the otates, the Mexican weeping bamboo, given by Aztec traders when they first reached the area. Before the Spanish conquest its people were Popoluca, and from pre-Hispanic times into the colonial period the settlement served as an indigenous trading post on the river routes of the Gulf lowlands.

Jesuit missionaries later founded the mission of San Ignacio Otatitlan, and the town was formally refounded under Viceroy Diego Fernandez de Cordoba and dedicated to Saint Andrew, which is why colonial records often call it San Andres Otatitlan. It gained municipality status in 1831.
zh:
奥塔蒂特兰是帕帕洛阿潘河下游的河畔小镇，位于韦拉克鲁斯与瓦哈卡的交界地带。其纳瓦特尔语名字意为“奥塔特竹之地”，奥塔特竹即墨西哥垂枝竹，由最初抵达此地的阿兹特克商人所起。西班牙征服之前，这里的居民是波波卢卡人；从先西班牙时期到殖民时代，该聚落一直是海湾低地河运路线上的原住民商站。

后来耶稣会传教士建立了圣伊格纳西奥·奥塔蒂特兰传道站，城镇又在总督迭戈·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦任内正式重建并献给使徒圣安德烈，因此殖民文献常称它为圣安德烈斯·奥塔蒂特兰。1831年，它获得市镇地位。

en:
The Otchigin horde descended from the appanage of Temüge, youngest brother of Genghis Khan, whose title otchigin marked him as guardian of the family hearth. At the 1206 coronation he and his mother Hoelun received the largest share of lands and people among the brothers. While other princes campaigned far afield, Temüge ruled the Mongol heartland, with pastures from the Greater Khingan to the Khalkha, and under Ögedei pushed into Liaodong and beyond the Khingan.

After Ögedei's death in 1241 he tried to seize the throne, but the regent Töregene held him off; after Güyük's election in 1246 he was executed. His descendants kept the appanage: his great-great-grandson Nayan, a Nestorian Christian ruling Jurchen lands from Kwang-ning, rebelled against Kublai in 1287 and was put to death, as Marco Polo recorded.

In 1337 the house still grazed around Taizhou in Songnen under Borjigin princes. After the Yuan collapse of 1368 its people were folded into the Ming Three Guards of 1389.
zh:
斡惕赤斤汗国源于成吉思汗幼弟铁木哥的投下封地，斡赤斤称号意为守护灶火的幼子。1206年蒙古建国时，他与母亲诃额仑分得诸弟中最多的土地和属民。其他王公远征时，铁木哥留守蒙古本土，牧地从大兴安岭延伸到哈拉哈河，窝阔台时期又把势力扩张到辽东和大兴安岭以东。

1241年窝阔台死后，他企图夺取汗位，被摄政乃马真后阻止；1246年贵由即位后他被处死。后裔仍保有东北封地：玄孙乃颜是景教徒，以广宁为中心统治女真之地，1287年起兵反叛忽必烈，兵败被杀，马可·波罗曾记此事。

1337年，该家族仍由孛儿只斤王公统领，在松嫩泰州一带游牧；1368年元朝灭亡后，其部众于1389年被编入明朝兀良哈三卫。

en:
The Ōtomo were a Kyūshū warrior family whose leaders governed Bungo and Buzen for generations. They helped resist the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281 and supported Ashikaga Takauji in the wars of the 1330s.

Under Ōtomo Sōrin, the family extended its power across much of Kyūshū. Sōrin met the Jesuit Francis Xavier in 1551 and was baptized in 1578, the year Ōtomo forces suffered a major defeat at Mimikawa. Facing the Shimazu, he appealed to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, whose 1587 campaign restored the family's lands.
zh:
大友氏是九州武家，家督世代担任丰后和丰前的守护。他们参与抵御1274年和1281年的蒙古入侵，并在1330年代的战争中支持足利尊氏。

大友宗麟统治时期，家族势力扩展到九州大部。宗麟于1551年会见耶稣会传教士方济各·沙勿略，并在1578年受洗；同年大友军在耳川遭遇惨败。面对岛津氏的进攻，宗麟向丰臣秀吉求援，秀吉于1587年出兵，恢复了大友氏的领地。

en:
Xaltocan was an Otomi city-state on an island of the same-named lake in the northern Valley of Mexico. The Xaltocameca were counted among the Chichimec tribes, and its island position made it easy to fortify and supported chinampa gardens with a grain surplus. Through much of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it fought a long rivalry with the neighbouring Nahua city of Cuauhtitlan, at first with the upper hand.

Around 1395 Cuauhtitlan called in Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco and the Mexica of Tenochtitlan; the allies stormed Xaltocan and drove out its Otomi population, who fled to Metztitlan, Tlaxcala and Otumba. The island was then resettled by Nahuatl speakers.

After the fall of Azcapotzalco Xaltocan became a tribute-paying subject city of the Aztec empire, sending woven blankets to Tenochtitlan. In 1521 Hernán Cortés's army sacked and burned it.
zh:
夏尔托坎是一座奥托米人的城邦，建在墨西哥谷地北部同名湖泊中的岛屿上。其居民夏尔托卡梅卡人被视为奇奇梅克诸部之一；岛屿地势既便于设防，也支撑起出产余粮的奇南帕园圃。13至14世纪的大部分时间里，它与邻近的纳瓦城邦库奥蒂特兰长期交战，起初还占据上风。

约1395年，库奥蒂特兰请来阿斯卡波察尔科的特索索莫克和特诺奇蒂特兰的墨西加人助阵，联军攻陷夏尔托坎并驱逐奥托米居民，后者逃往梅斯蒂特兰、特拉斯卡拉和奥通巴。此后该岛改由讲纳瓦特尔语的人居住。

阿斯卡波察尔科倒台后，夏尔托坎成为阿兹特克帝国纳贡的臣属城邦，向特诺奇蒂特兰进献织毯。1521年，埃尔南·科尔特斯的军队洗劫并焚毁了夏尔托坎。

en:
Wagadugu is the principal Mossi kingdom on the upper Volta, whose Mogho Naaba, or King of All the World, leads the Mossi kings. The town may have been founded about 1050 by Soninke Wangara traders from Ghana, and its name means home of the Wagu. Mossi horsemen from Tenkodogo seized it in the fourteenth century; legend credits Oubri, grandson of Ouédraogo and traditional founder of the dynasty, with its capture.

Around 1170, under Komdimie, Yatenga broke away, while Wagadugu ruled the rest through governors called Dimas. The Mossi kept their ancestral rites and scourged the Muslim empires to their north, raiding Walata and even Timbuktu in the fifteenth century. Askia Muhammad's 1497 holy war defeated them but could not shake their religion.

After Songhai fell to the Moroccans in 1591 Wagadugu was fully independent. In the eighteenth century it grew rich on regional trade and held off the jihad states Massina and Sokoto; the capital's first mosque came in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
瓦加杜古是沃尔特河上游首要的莫西王国，君主号莫戈·纳巴，意为“天下之王”，位列莫西诸王之首。此城可能约1050年由加纳来的索宁克万加拉商人建立，城名意为“瓦古之人的家园”。14世纪滕科多戈的莫西骑兵夺取该地，传说归功于韦德拉奥果之孙乌布里，他也被视为王朝开创者。

约1170年孔迪米耶在位时亚滕加省分裂，瓦加杜古通过名为迪马的总督统治其余地区。莫西人恪守祖先祭祀，成北方穆斯林帝国的祸患，15世纪劫掠瓦拉塔，甚至攻入廷巴克图。1497年阿斯基亚·穆罕默德的圣战击败他们，却未能动摇其旧教。

1591年桑海亡于摩洛哥后瓦加杜古完全自主。18世纪它靠区域贸易致富，抵住马西纳、索科托等圣战国家，都城第一座清真寺19世纪初才建成。

en:
The Ōuchi were a warrior family based at Yamaguchi in Suō Province. They supported the Ashikaga during the fourteenth-century civil wars and built a domain that at its height encompassed six provinces, with trade links to Ming China and Joseon Korea.

Ōuchi Yoshitaka secured Aki by 1541 but failed to take Toda Castle in Izumo in 1542—1543. In 1551 his retainer Sue Harukata rebelled and forced him to kill himself; the Mōri subsequently eclipsed the Ōuchi.
zh:
大内氏是以周防国山口为根据地的武家。他们在14世纪的南北朝战争中支持足利氏，建立的领国鼎盛时包括六国，并与明朝和朝鲜进行贸易。

大内义隆于1541年前控制安艺，却在1542—1543年未能攻下出云的月山富田城。1551年，家臣陶晴贤叛乱，迫使义隆自尽；此后毛利氏取代了大内氏的地位。

en: The Ovimbundu formed several small kingdoms on the Bié Plateau of central Angola, including Bailundo. Their communities farmed and raised livestock, and their rulers developed caravan trade after the Portuguese established a foothold at Benguela in the 16th century. Caravans carried goods between Benguela and peoples farther east, including the Chokwe, exchanging commodities such as ivory and wax.
zh: 奥文本杜人在安哥拉中部的比耶高原建立了多个小王国，拜伦多是其中之一。这些社群从事农耕和畜牧；16世纪葡萄牙人在本格拉建立据点后，各国统治者发展了商队贸易。商队往来于本格拉和东方的乔奎等族群之间，交换象牙、蜂蜡等货物。

en:
Owo lies at the southern edge of the Yoruba Hills, roughly halfway between Ile-Ife and Benin City. Its oral tradition traces the town to migrants from Ile-Ife led by sons of the deity Oduduwa, and archaeology confirms close ties with Ife culture from an early date.

Between 1400 and 1600 it was the capital of an independent Yoruba city-state whose king, the Olowo, built the sprawling Aghofen palace with around a hundred courtyards. On the frontier with the powerful Edo kingdom of Benin, Owo preserved a large measure of independence although it sometimes paid tribute.

The courts exchanged styles and craftsmen: Owo's ivory carvers were prized at Benin, which in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries imported Owo carvings and recruited its artisans into the royal workshops. Owo developed a hybrid tradition, blending Ife naturalism with Benin courtly motifs, and remained a self-governing Yoruba kingdom through the Oyo empire's rise and decline.
zh:
奥沃位于约鲁巴丘陵南缘，大致地处伊费与贝宁城之间。当地口传传统称，建城者是从伊费迁出、由神祇奥杜杜瓦之子率领的移民，考古发现也证实它很早就与伊费文化联系紧密。

1400至1600年间，这里是独立约鲁巴城邦的首都，国王称“奥洛沃”，修建了占地广阔、拥有约百处庭院的阿戈芬王宫。奥沃毗邻强大的贝宁埃多王国，虽有时纳贡，但基本保持了独立。

两国宫廷交流风格与工匠：奥沃的象牙雕刻在贝宁备受推崇，17至18世纪贝宁进口奥沃雕刻品并招募当地工匠进入王室作坊。奥沃由此形成融合伊费写实传统与贝宁宫廷纹样的混合艺术风格，并在奥约帝国兴衰的整个时期里始终是自治的约鲁巴王国。

en: Oxtlipan was a small Huastec, or Téenek, town of the inland Huasteca, in the mountain fringe between the Gulf lowlands and the Otomi stronghold of Metztitlan. Like the other fragmented Huastec city-states, it was drawn into the Aztec tributary empire during the fifteenth-century campaigns of Moctezuma I and Ahuitzotl while keeping its own local rulers.
zh: 奥斯特利潘是瓦斯特卡内陆的特内克人小镇，地处墨西哥湾低地与奥托米人重镇梅茨蒂特兰之间的山缘地带。与其他各自分立的瓦斯特克城邦一样，它在15世纪莫克特苏马一世和阿维索特尔的征战中被纳入阿兹特克纳贡体系，但仍保留本地首领。

en:
The Oyama were a warrior family based in Shimotsuke Province, where Masamitsu settled at Oyama around 1150. In 1333 Oyama Hidetomo joined Nitta Yoshisada's attack on the Kamakura shogunate.

Oyama Yoshimasa became governor of Shimotsuke, but his struggle with the Utsunomiya culminated in the killing of Utsunomiya Mototsuna in 1380. The Kamakura authorities sent an army against him; after renewed resistance, Yoshimasa killed himself in 1382.
zh:
小山氏是以下野国为根据地的武家，政光于1150年左右迁居小山。1333年，小山秀朝追随新田义贞进攻镰仓幕府。

小山义政担任下野守护，却在与宇都宫氏的争斗中于1380年杀死宇都宫基纲。镰仓府随即发兵讨伐；义政再次起兵抵抗后，于1382年自尽。

en:
Oyo grew into the largest Yoruba state from its capital at Oyo-Ile. Tradition places its founding around 1300 under Oranmiyan, its first Alaafin, and remembers his son Shango, later worshipped as the god of thunder. By the end of the 1300s it was a formidable inland power, but around 1535 the Nupe sacked the capital and exiled the dynasty to Borgu for eighty years.

It returned rebuilt on cavalry and stronger central government, recovering lost lands and conquering nearly all of Yorubaland. In the 1600s it became a cavalry empire living on tribute and trans-Saharan trade, and repeated wars forced Dahomey to pay tribute in 1748.

Dependence on the Atlantic slave trade and factional strife weakened it. The general Afonja seceded with Ilorin in 1817 and joined the Sokoto jihad in 1823, Dahomey ended tribute the same year, and Ilorin forces destroyed Oyo-Ile in 1835; the court then withdrew to Ago d'Oyo.
zh:
奥约从都城奥约伊莱起步，成长为最大的约鲁巴人国家。按约鲁巴传说，它约在1300年由奥兰米扬建立，他成为第一位阿拉芬；其子尚戈后来被尊为雷神。到14世纪末，奥约已是内陆强国，但1535年前后努佩人洗劫都城，迫使王朝流亡博尔古达八十年。

复辟后的奥约以骑兵和更强的中央政府重建国家，收复失地并征服了几乎整个约鲁巴兰。17世纪，它成为靠朝贡和跨撒哈拉贸易支撑的骑兵帝国，经反复交战，终于在1748年迫使达荷美纳贡。

对大西洋奴隶贸易的依赖和党争削弱了国家。将领阿方贾于1817年据伊洛林独立，1823年投靠索科托圣战，达荷美也在同年摆脱藩属地位；1835年伊洛林军队摧毁奥约伊莱，王廷迁至阿戈多约。

en:
Ozuluama was a Huastec town on the coastal plain of the Huasteca Alta, beside the Tamiahua Lagoon in what is now northern Veracruz.

Its name began as a Huastec phrase combining the words for jaguar and fig tree, meaning jaguar over a fig tree, and after the Aztec conquest it was translated into Nahuatl as ocelotl-amatl, the form that gradually shortened into Ozuluama.

Like the other Huastec city-states it was defeated by the armies of Moctezuma I around 1450 and thereafter paid tribute while keeping its local rulers, and local tradition also credited the Texcocan poet-king Nezahualcoyotl with campaigning in these parts. When the Spanish overran the Huasteca between 1519 and the 1530s the town became a colonial settlement, its prehispanic past preserved in the nearby ruins of Cebadilla.
zh:
奥苏卢阿马是上瓦斯特卡沿海平原的瓦斯特克城镇，坐落于今韦拉克鲁斯北部的塔米亚瓦潟湖畔。

其名字本是瓦斯特克语，由意为美洲豹和榕树的两个词组成，含义为“榕树上的美洲豹”；阿兹特克征服后被译作纳瓦特尔语的奥塞洛特尔-阿马特，后逐渐音变为奥苏卢阿马。

与其他瓦斯特克城邦一样，它在1450年前后被莫克特苏马一世的军队击败，此后向阿兹特克纳贡但保留本地首领，当地传说还把这一带的征战归于特斯科科的诗人国王内萨瓦尔科约特尔。1519至1530年代西班牙人攻灭瓦斯特卡诸邦后，该城成为殖民聚落，其史前往事留存于附近的塞瓦迪亚遗址。

en:
Oztoman, also recorded as Oztuma, was a Mexica frontier stronghold in the Cohuixca country of the Tierra Caliente, the rugged country between the Valley of Mexico and the Purépecha kingdom. Moctezuma I campaigned through the district between 1440 and 1469, subduing Oztuma together with Ixcateopan, Taxco and neighbouring towns, and the Mexica then built a garrison of five forts to watch the Purépecha border and hold down the rebellious Chontal communities.

For decades the forts faced the Purépecha garrison at Cutzamala across a war-ravaged frontier, until Purépecha warriors stormed them in 1520, an episode described in the sixteenth-century Relación de Oztuma.
zh:
奥斯托曼又记作奥斯图马，是阿兹特克人在特拉卡连特地区科维克斯卡地带的边防要塞，地处墨西哥谷与普雷佩查王国之间的崎岖山地。1440年至1469年间，蒙特祖马一世出兵这一地区，将奥斯托曼与伊斯卡特奥潘、塔斯科等城镇一并征服；阿兹特克人随后修筑由五座堡垒组成的驻军要塞，既监视普雷佩查边境，也压制当地反叛的琼塔尔人。

此后数十年间，堡垒与驻扎在库察马拉的普雷佩查守军隔饱受战火的边境对峙，1520年普雷佩查武士攻克五堡，此事见于16世纪的《奥斯图马记述》。

en:
Ozumatzin, whose head town survives as San Pedro Ozumacin in the rainy Chinantla hills of northern Oaxaca, was a small polity of the Papaloapan basin whose people spoke a Chinantecan tongue. Local tradition remembered a wide Chinantec kingdom founded around 1100 by a king named Quiana, which later split into rival highland and lowland states.

The Aztecs built a garrison and tribute centre at nearby Tuxtepec around 1455, launched a campaign against the Chinantla in 1479, and the emperor Ahuitzotl completed its conquest in 1488. The Chinantecs then turned against their overlords and joined Hernan Cortes in 1519, fighting with their unusually long lances, though they rose against Spanish rule around 1530.
zh:
奥苏马钦的首镇留存为今瓦哈卡州北部多雨的奇南特拉山区中的圣佩德罗·奥苏马辛，它是帕帕洛阿潘盆地一个讲奇南特克语的小邦。当地传说记得，约1100年一位名叫基亚纳的国王建立了幅员广阔的奇南特克王国，后来分裂为相互对抗的山地和低地诸邦。

阿兹特克人约1455年在附近的图斯特佩克修建驻军和贡税中心，1479年发兵攻打奇南特拉，皇帝阿维索特尔于1488年完成征服。此后奇南特克人转而反对宗主，于1519年投奔埃尔南·科尔特斯，以格外修长的长矛作战，但约1530年又起兵反抗西班牙统治。

en: Pacaca was a Huetar chiefdom in the area of present-day Mora in Costa Rica. In the sixteenth century, Huetar chiefdoms occupied much of the country's central region as Spanish expeditions entered it.
zh: 帕卡卡是位于今哥斯达黎加莫拉一带的韦塔尔酋邦。16世纪西班牙远征军进入哥斯达黎加中部时，韦塔尔人的各个酋邦占据着该地区的大部分土地。

en:
Padua is a Veneto city on the Bacchiglione, west of Venice, a prosperous commune under consuls from 1138. Its university, founded in 1222, made it a centre of learning, and Giotto painted the Scrovegni Chapel frescoes there about 1305. In 1236 Emperor Frederick II imposed the vicar Ezzelino da Romano, whose tyranny ended with his expulsion in 1256.

Wars with Verona opened the age of the signori: Jacopo da Carrara was elected lord in 1318, but the della Scala seized the city in 1328, and Padua was a Scaliger possession in 1337. The Carraresi returned that year and ruled, apart from a brief Visconti interlude, until 1405, when Padua surrendered to Venice.

Padua remained under Venice, with a brief imperial occupation in 1509. Its university gained a botanical garden in 1545 and employed Galileo, and Elena Cornaro Piscopia in 1678 became the first female graduate. Venetian rule ended with the republic's fall in 1797.
zh:
帕多瓦是威尼斯以西、巴奇廖内河畔的威尼托城市，1138年已是执政官治理的富庶市镇。1222年创办的大学使它成为学术中心，乔托约1305年在此完成斯克罗威尼礼拜堂壁画。1236年皇帝腓特烈二世安插代理人埃泽利诺·达·罗马诺，其暴政1256年随他被逐告终。

与维罗纳的战争拉开僭主时代序幕：雅各布·达·卡拉拉于1318年被推举为领主，但1328年德拉·斯卡拉家族入城，1337年帕多瓦仍为斯卡拉家族领地。卡拉拉家族同年返回，除短暂的维斯孔蒂插曲外执政到1405年，随后帕多瓦投降威尼斯。

此后它一直臣属威尼斯，仅1509年被帝国短暂占领。大学1545年建起植物园，伽利略曾在此任教，科尔纳罗·皮斯科皮亚于1678年成为第一位女学位获得者。威尼斯统治随1797年共和国灭亡告终。

en:
Pahang occupies the east-coast basin of the Malay Peninsula. The Book of Song records embassies to Liu Song in 449 and 456 from Pohuang, usually identified with Pahang. It entered the Langkasuka-Kedah mandala, passed under Srivijaya's hegemony by the eighth century, and after Srivijaya's decline joined Ligor's twelve tributaries.

In the fourteenth century it was a rising Hindu-Buddhist power: its maharaja claimed overlordship over the southern peninsula including Temasek, the Nagarakretagama used its name for the whole peninsula, and in 1378 it sent tribute to the Ming emperor. Malacca absorbed it, and late in the fifteenth century the old house ended with Dewa Sura, whose grandson became Muhammad Shah, first sultan of the Old Pahang Sultanate.

After 1511 it fought the Portuguese with Johor, faced the Aceh raids of 1615 and 1617, and in 1623 its sultan took the Johor crown, joining the two realms.
zh:
彭亨位于马来半岛东岸的河流盆地。《宋书》记载婆皇国于449年和456年遣使刘宋朝廷，婆皇通常被比定为彭亨。此后它并入狼牙修—吉打曼荼罗，8世纪受三佛齐霸权控制，三佛齐衰落后又成为洛坤十二属城之一。

14世纪时，彭亨是印度教—佛教的新兴强权：摩诃罗阇宣称对包括淡马锡在内的半岛南端拥有宗主权，《爪哇史颂》以其名泛指整个马来半岛，1378年还携表文向明朝进贡。后来马六甲将其吞并，15世纪后期旧王族末主德瓦·苏拉的外孙被立为苏丹穆罕默德·沙，成为旧彭亨苏丹国首任苏丹。

1511年后，彭亨与柔佛联兵抗击葡萄牙人，1615和1617年两遭亚齐入侵，1623年其苏丹兼领柔佛王位，两国由此合流。

en:
The Rhenish Palatinate, ruled from Heidelberg, comprised Upper Rhine lordships and the Upper Palatinate on the Danube. The office of Count Palatine grew from Lotharingia's royal representative; after the last Ezzonid count died in 1085 it became the hereditary County Palatine of the Rhine. In 1214 Emperor Frederick II enfeoffed a Wittelsbach duke of Bavaria, and the Treaty of Pavia in 1329 restored the lands to the elder Wittelsbach line.

The Golden Bull of 1356 made the Count Palatine a secular prince-elector, and Heidelberg University was founded in 1386. The Palatinate turned Calvinist under Frederick III from 1559, and Frederick V's acceptance of the Bohemian crown in 1619 helped ignite the Thirty Years' War.

French armies wasted Heidelberg in 1689 and 1693; after the Simmern line died out in 1685, the electorate passed to Catholic branches. In 1777 it united with Bavaria, and in 1803 the Rhenish lands were annexed by Baden.
zh:
莱茵普法尔茨以海德堡为中心，由莱茵河上游分散领地和多瑙河畔的上普法尔茨组成。行宫伯爵源于洛塔林吉亚国王代表，1085年末代埃措南伯爵死后成为世袭的莱茵行宫伯爵领。1214年皇帝腓特烈二世把它封给维特尔斯巴赫家族的巴伐利亚公爵，1329年《帕维亚条约》把领地归还维特尔斯巴赫长支。

1356年《金玺诏书》定行宫伯爵为世俗选帝侯，海德堡大学1386年创办。普法尔茨1559年起在腓特烈三世治下改宗加尔文宗，1619年腓特烈五世接受波希米亚王位，成为三十年战争导火索之一。

1689年和1693年法军两度蹂躏海德堡；1685年锡门支系绝嗣后，选侯国转入天主教旁支之手。1777年它与巴伐利亚合并，莱茵领地1803年被巴登吞并。

en:
The Xi'oi were northern Pame people of central Mexico, whose territory stretched along the Sierra Madre. They hunted, traded and lived near settled Nahua, Otomi and Purépecha communities on the Mesoamerican frontier.

Pame and their neighbours resisted the Spanish in 1522 but were defeated. Spanish ranches and Otomi settlements displaced them from parts of the Bajío in the 1530s, while soldiers and Franciscans conquered their more remote Sierra Gorda territory in 1742.
zh:
希奥伊人是墨西哥中部的北部帕梅人，其居地沿马德雷山脉分布。他们狩猎、贸易，并在中美洲文明的边缘与定居的纳瓦人、奥托米人和普雷佩查人相邻而居。

1522年，帕梅人与邻族共同抵抗西班牙人，但遭到击败。16世纪30年代，西班牙牧场和奥托米人定居点使他们失去巴希奥的部分土地；1742年，西班牙士兵与方济各会传教士征服了他们在戈尔达山脉的偏远领地。

en:
Pǔ'ān ruled the southwestern Guizhou plateau around present-day Panzhou. Its people were the Yushi tribe of the Cuan, who submitted to the Mongols in 1257 and were organized as a wanhu office; in 1276 it became the Pu'an route command under Yunnan province, covering parts of present-day Guizhou and Yunnan.

The Ming converted it into Pu'an prefecture in 1383, then into the Pu'an pacification office in 1403 and the department of Pu'an in 1415, now directly under Guizhou. The department moved into the Pu'an Guard city in 1586 and was attached to Anshun prefecture in 1611.

Under the Qing it passed to Nanlong prefecture in 1727, became the independent Pu'an department in 1809, and was reorganized as the Pu'an sub-prefecture in 1811.
zh:
普安统辖今贵州盘州一带的黔西南高原，其地原为爨族于矢部。1257年于矢部归附蒙古，置为万户府；1276年改设普安路总管府，辖地兼跨今贵州、云南，隶云南行省。

明代1383年改置普安府，1403年置普安安抚司，1415年改为普安州，直隶贵州。1586年州治迁入普安卫城，1611年改属安顺府。

清代1727年改隶南笼府，1809年升为普安直隶州，1811年改为普安厅。

en:
The State of the Church was the pope's direct domain in central Italian lands. Founded on the Donation of Pepin in 756, when Lombard lands near Rome passed to Pope Stephen II, it was effectively independent by 1300. From 1305 the popes resided at Avignon; in 1337 Benedict XII ruled from there while Orsini and Colonna fought over Rome.

The tribune Cola di Rienzo briefly seized power in Rome in 1347; Cardinal Albornoz reconquered the papal cities and issued a uniform code in 1357. Gregory XI returned the court to Rome in 1377, and the Western Schism began the next year. Renaissance popes such as Alexander VI and Julius II enlarged the state by war and diplomacy, though Charles V's troops sacked Rome in 1527; Ferrara, Urbino and Castro were reclaimed by 1649, bringing the state to its greatest extent.

France annexed Avignon in 1791 and proclaimed a Roman Republic in 1798, exiling Pius VI. Napoleon absorbed Rome in 1809, and the Congress of Vienna restored the Italian lands to Pius VII in 1815.
zh:
教会国是教宗直接统治的意大利中部领地。它奠基于756年的丕平献土：罗马附近的伦巴第人土地归教宗斯德望二世，1300年已实际独立。1305年起教宗长驻阿维尼翁；1337年本笃十二世在那里治会，奥尔西尼与科隆纳两族争夺罗马。

平民保民官科拉·迪·里恩佐1347年一度在罗马夺权，阿尔沃诺斯枢机重新征服教会城市，1357年颁布统一法典。格列高利十一世1377年迁回罗马，次年西方教会大分裂。亚历山大六世、儒略二世等教宗靠战争与外交扩张，查理五世军队1527年洗劫罗马；费拉拉、乌尔比诺和卡斯特罗至1649年相继收回，疆域达于极盛。

法国1791年吞并阿维尼翁，1798年建罗马共和国，庇护六世流亡。拿破仑1809年吞并罗马，1815年维也纳会议将意大利领地归还庇护七世。

en:
Parma is a Po plain city in Emilia, on the old Roman Via Aemilia. A Roman colony from 183 BC, it became a county seat in 774. A commune emerged around 1140, and as a Ghibelline city it withstood Emperor Frederick II's siege of 1247 and 1248.

It submitted to John of Bohemia in 1331 and fell to the Visconti of Milan in 1341. The Battle of Fornovo in 1495 was fought there, and French garrisons held the city from 1500 to 1521.

After Papal rule, Pope Paul III in 1545 created the Duchy of Parma and Piacenza for his son Pier Luigi Farnese. The Farnese ruled until 1731; after a Spanish interlude the duchy passed in 1748 to the Bourbon-Parma branch, until France annexed it in 1801. The Congress of Vienna in 1815 assigned Parma to Marie Louise.
zh:
帕尔马是艾米利亚波河平原上的城市，地处古罗马艾米利亚大道沿线。公元前183年罗马人在此设立殖民城，774年成为伯国治所。1140年前后形成公社，作为吉伯林派城市，它在1247—1248年顶住了皇帝腓特烈二世的围攻。

它1331年向波希米亚国王约翰臣服，1341年落入米兰的维斯孔蒂家族之手。1495年的福尔诺沃战役就发生在其境内，意大利战争期间法军于1500—1521年驻守该城。

教皇国统治后，1545年教皇保罗三世为其子皮耶尔·路易吉·法尔内塞设立帕尔马和皮亚琴察公国。法尔内塞家族统治到1731年，经过西班牙插曲，公国于1748年转入波旁-帕尔马支系，1801年被法国吞并。1815年维也纳会议把帕尔马划归玛丽·路易丝。

en:
Patras, the greatest barony of the Principality of Achaea, lay on the north-western Peloponnese coast. Founded around 1209 among twelve baronies with twenty-four fiefs, it passed in the mid-thirteenth century to Patras's Latin archbishop, whose thirty-two fiefs made him the principality's strongest vassal.

From 1317 to 1337 Archbishop William Frangipani kept close ties with Venice and acted almost independently of Achaea. When he died in 1337, Angevin troops besieged Patras, but Pope Benedict XII declared it land of the Holy Roman Church and laid the principality under interdict; the regent gave way, and the archbishop ruled it as an effectively independent church domain.

As Ottoman and Albanian raids grew, archbishops sought Venetian protection, and Venice ruled the barony from 1408 to 1413 and briefly in 1418. In 1429-1430 it surrendered to the Byzantine Despotate of the Morea, ending Latin rule.
zh:
帕特雷是亚该亚侯国最大的男爵领，位于伯罗奔尼撒西北海岸。它约1209年作为十二个男爵领之一建立，下辖二十四个封邑，13世纪中叶转入拉丁礼大主教之手；大主教的三十二个封邑使其成为亲王国最强大的封臣。

1317至1337年在位的大主教威廉·弗兰吉帕尼与威尼斯关系密切，几乎不受亚该亚亲王节制。1337年他死后，安茹军队攻城，教皇本笃十二世宣布该城为罗马神圣教会之地并对侯国处以绝罚，摄政被迫让步，大主教随后以事实上独立的教会领主身份治理帕特雷。

奥斯曼和阿尔巴尼亚袭扰加剧后，大主教寻求威尼斯保护，威尼斯1408至1413年及1418年短暂代管该男爵领。1429—1430年它向拜占庭摩里亚专制国投降，拉丁统治告终。

en:
Pavia, Roman Ticinum on the lower Ticino near the Po, was a great royal seat of early medieval Italy. The Ostrogoths made it their capital in 540; after the Lombards took it in 572 it became their kingdom's centre, and from 774 it was capital of the Kingdom of Italy, where emperors were crowned with the Iron Crown at San Michele Maggiore until the eleventh century.

In the twelfth century it became a self-governing commune, Ghibelline and rival of Milan. Independence lasted until 1359, when Milan's Visconti took it after a hard siege. The university was refounded in 1361, and Gian Galeazzo Visconti began the Certosa in 1396.

The 1525 Battle of Pavia ended in the capture of King Francis I of France and opened long Spanish rule; the Austrians held the city from 1706 until the French arrived in 1796.
zh:
帕维亚古称提契努姆，位于提契诺河下游、靠近波河，是中世纪早期意大利的重要王都。东哥特人540年以它为都，572年伦巴第人攻占后成为伦巴第王国中心；774年起为意大利王国都城，直到11世纪，历代皇帝都在圣米凯莱马焦雷教堂戴上铁王冠。

12世纪帕维亚成为自治公社，属吉伯林派并与米兰为敌。独立维持到1359年，才在苦战后被米兰的维斯孔蒂家族征服。大学1361年重建，吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂1396年动工兴建切尔托萨修道院。

1525年帕维亚战役中法王弗朗索瓦一世被俘，开启漫长的西班牙统治；奥地利人1706年夺取该城，一直统治到1796年法军到来。

en:
Pingchadong was one of the small Tujia cave chiefdoms in the middle Wuling mountains, on the lands of present-day Xiushan County in southeastern Chongqing. Its hereditary Yang chiefs traced their line to the Yang rulers of Bozhou; enfeoffed by the Sizhou chiefdom, they led their clansmen north into the Xiushan valleys, and after Sizhou's fall the office passed under the Youyang Pacification Commission, which from 1375 supervised Pingcha and three sister cave offices.

The chiefdom survived into the Qing as the Pingchadong Longship Office. In 1735 the court's gaitu guiliu reforms converted it directly into Xiushan County, and in 1736 the area was folded into the new Youyang Independent Prefecture.
zh:
平茶洞是武陵山脉中段的土家族小型洞官司，其地在今重庆东南部的秀山土家族苗族自治县。世袭长官为杨氏，族源可追溯到播州杨氏；他们受思州土司分封，率族人北迁到秀山一带的河谷，思州灭亡后改属酉阳宣抚司，1375年起平茶与另外三个洞长官司同归酉阳管辖。

入清以后它仍以平茶洞长官司传世。1735年朝廷推行改土归流，直接改平茶洞长官司为秀山县，1736年这片地区并入新置的酉阳直隶州。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/秀山土家族苗族自治县

en:
Pacaha was an Indigenous polity of fortified villages in what is now northeastern Arkansas, named after the chief who ruled it in 1541. Its principal village on the Mississippi is thought to have stood at the Bradley site near present-day Turrell.

Hernando de Soto's expedition encountered Pacaha in 1541 and stayed at the chief's village for about 40 days. Archaeologists commonly associate the province with the Nodena phase of late Mississippian culture.
zh:
帕卡哈是今阿肯色州东北部由设防村落组成的原住民政权，得名于1541年统治当地的酋长。其密西西比河畔的主要村落据信位于今特勒尔附近的布拉德利遗址。

埃尔南多·德索托的探险队于1541年抵达帕卡哈，并在酋长的村落停留了约40天。考古学家通常将这一地区与密西西比文化晚期的诺迪纳阶段联系起来。

en:
The Paka Jaqis, whose name the Spanish wrote as Pacajes, were one of twelve Aymara kingdoms of the Collao altiplano. Their name means eagle men, and emerging around 1100 from the collapse of Tiwanaku, they settled the plains and valleys around the Desaguadero River in present-day western Bolivia, with capital Axawiri, modern Caquiaviri; Tiwanaku, Chuqiyapu and Viacha lay within their lands.

Herders of llamas and alpacas and growers of potatoes and quinoa, they were judged less centrally organized than their Lupaca neighbours but kept alive the constant warfare of the Aymara chiefdoms.

They resisted Cusco longer than most: Inca armies met stubborn resistance from Mayta Capac through several later reigns, and only the tenth Inca, Tupac Yupanqui, subdued them late in the fifteenth century. Under Spanish rule their province became the Corregimiento de Pacajes in 1574, attached to La Paz.
zh:
帕卡贾基斯人——西班牙人后来把这个名字拼写为帕卡赫斯——是科利亚奥高原十二个艾马拉王国之一。族名在本族语言中意为鹰人，约1100年蒂亚瓦纳科国家崩溃后兴起，定居在今玻利维亚西部德萨瓜德罗河周围的平原与河谷，都城设在阿沙维里，即今卡基亚维里；蒂亚瓦纳科、丘基亚普和比亚查都在其境内。

他们放牧骆马和羊驼，种植马铃薯和藜麦，组织程度不如邻邦卢帕卡，却维系着艾马拉诸酋长国之间连绵不断的战事。

帕卡贾基斯人对库斯科的抵抗比多数政权都久：从迈塔·卡帕克时代起历经数位印加君主，印加军队始终遭遇顽强阻击，直到15世纪末第十代印卡图帕克·尤潘基时才将其征服。西班牙人统治后，其地于1574年成为隶属拉巴斯的帕卡赫斯督辖区。

en:
The Penakuk were a loose network of allied Algonquian communities around the upper Merrimack River, including villages at Amoskeag Falls and present-day Concord. In the seventeenth century the sachem Passaconaway dealt with the English colonies while his children's marriages linked his people to the Pawtucket.

Disease and raids weakened the Penakuk, and King Philip's War of 1675–1676 drew in some of their communities despite the neutrality sought by Passaconaway's successor Wonalancet. After the war some captives were enslaved, while others fled toward the Hudson Valley and Quebec.
zh:
佩纳库克是梅里马克河上游松散结盟的阿尔冈昆语族社区，其村落包括阿莫斯基格瀑布和今康科德的聚居地。17世纪，酋长帕萨科纳韦与英国殖民地打交道，其子女的婚姻使他的族人与波塔基特人结盟。

疾病和袭击削弱了佩纳库克人，尽管帕萨科纳韦的继任者沃纳兰塞特力求保持中立，1675—1676年的菲利普王战争仍将他们的一些社区卷入其中。战后，一些俘虏沦为奴隶，另一些人则逃往哈得孙河谷和魁北克。

en:
Parinacocha took its name from the great shallow lake of the Ayacucho highlands, a name combining the Aymara word for flamingo with the Quechua word for lake; the waters lie west of the Sara Sara volcano at more than 3,200 metres.

During the Inca conquests of the 1400s the chiefdom around the lake was absorbed into the empire and became a huamani, or province, counted among the twenty-eight provinces of Kuntisuyu, governed by a local curaca under an Inca apu and settled with colonists brought from other provinces. The ruined Inca village of Inkawasi stands on the lake's north-western shore.
zh:
帕里纳科查得名于阿亚库乔高原上的浅水大湖，湖名由艾马拉语的火烈鸟和克丘亚语的湖泊组合而成，湖面位于萨拉萨拉火山西侧，海拔超过3200米。

15世纪印加扩张期间，湖畔的酋邦被并入帝国，成为一个瓦马尼，即行省，位列孔蒂苏尤的二十八个省之中，由当地酋长库拉卡在印加长官阿普的统辖下治理，境内还安置了从其他省迁来的移民。湖的西北岸留有印加时期的废弃村庄印卡瓦西遗址。

en:
The Pocras, also recorded as Pacora, were a Wari-derived people of the Ayacucho highlands in the south-central Andes, centered on what became Spanish Huamanga. Their Middle Horizon and Late Intermediate culture, dated from roughly 500 to 1000, produced distinctive pottery found at Conchopata, and their language belonged to the Proto-Aymara family.

Closely allied with the Hanan Chancas of Parkos, the Pocras at their height also settled the north-coast valleys of Jayanca and Pacora and joined the Chanca, Wanka and Ankara attack on Cusco.

In the fifteenth century the Inca ruler Pachacútec crushed the Pocra-Chanca army and, after a long and bloody resistance in which the Pocras and their Soras allies were starved into submission, annexed their lands into the provinces of Parkos and Guamanka. Some Pocra elites fled to the jungle, while a small Pocra polity under the administrator Simi Auka survived into colonial times.
zh:
波克拉人又作帕科拉，是中南部安第斯山区阿亚库乔高原的族群，属瓦里文化的一支，中心在后来的西班牙城市瓦曼加。其文化兴盛于约500年至1000年的中段视野期与晚中间期，在孔乔帕塔留下独具特色的陶器，所操语言属原始艾马拉语系。

波克拉人与帕科斯的上昌卡人结成紧密同盟，鼎盛时还移居北岸的哈扬卡和帕科拉河谷，并参与了昌卡、万卡和安卡拉诸部对库斯科的进攻。

15世纪，印加统治者帕查库特克击溃波克拉—昌卡联军；波克拉人与盟友索拉斯人经过长期而惨烈的抵抗，最终因断粮投降，故土被并入帕科斯和瓦曼卡两省。部分波克拉贵族逃往丛林，而长官西米·奥卡的小波克拉政权一直存续到西班牙殖民时代。

en:
The Pocomtuc were an Indigenous people of western Massachusetts, with a fortified settlement at present-day Deerfield in the Connecticut River valley. A war with the Mohawk in 1664 fractured their power. During King Philip's War, Pocomtuc warriors and their allies ambushed an English militia convoy at Bloody Brook in 1675.

After the war, many Pocomtuc fled to Schaghticoke on the Hudson with other refugees. When the Seven Years' War began in 1754, most joined the Abenaki at Saint-François-du-Lac or moved farther west.
zh:
波康塔克人是马萨诸塞西部的原住民，在康涅狄格河谷今迪尔菲尔德设有一处设防聚落。1664年与莫霍克人的战争削弱了他们的力量。菲利普国王战争期间，波康塔克战士及其盟友于1675年在血溪伏击了一支英国民兵运输队。

战后，许多波康塔克人与其他难民逃往哈德逊河畔的斯卡蒂库克。1754年七年战争爆发时，多数人加入圣弗朗索瓦迪拉克的阿贝纳基人，或继续向西迁徙。

en:
Piacenza was a city on the Po in northern Italy and a free commune from 1126. It joined the Lombard League against Frederick Barbarossa and fought at Legnano in 1176. Milan's Visconti ended Alberto Scoto's rule in 1313 and held the city until 1447.

After Sforza and French rule, Piacenza entered the Papal States in 1521. Pope Paul III made it part of a duchy for his son Pier Luigi Farnese in 1545; the Farnese ruled until their male line ended in 1731.
zh:
皮亚琴察是意大利北部波河畔的城市，1126年起成为自由公社。它加入伦巴第联盟对抗腓特烈·巴巴罗萨，并于1176年参加莱尼亚诺战役。米兰的维斯孔蒂家族于1313年结束阿尔贝托·斯科托的统治，占有该城直至1447年。

经过斯福尔扎家族和法国的统治后，皮亚琴察于1521年归入教宗国。1545年教宗保禄三世将它纳入为儿子皮耶尔·路易吉·法尔内塞设立的公国；法尔内塞家族统治至1731年男性支系绝嗣。

en:
Paderborn was an ecclesiastical principality in Westphalia whose diocese was founded in 799 by Pope Leo III. After the Duchy of Saxony fell in 1180 the see passed under the Archbishops of Cologne, but the bishops built up their own territory, and Cologne's defeat at Worringen in 1288 left them effectively sovereign within their Hochstift.

The ruler in 1337 was Bernhard V of Lippe, who issued the first territorial constitution, the Privilegium Bernhardi. Later bishops were often foreigners in all but name: Dietrich of Moers ruled both Paderborn and Cologne, and his 1444 to 1449 feud with Soest devastated the bishopric.

The Reformation made deep inroads around Paderborn, yet Jesuits called in 1580 and the University of Paderborn of 1614 re-established Catholic rule. The principality fell to Prussia in the mediatisation of 1802 and passed to the Kingdom of Westphalia from 1807 to 1813.
zh:
帕德博恩是威斯特伐利亚的教会邦国，其教区由教皇利奥三世于799年设立。1180年萨克森公国解体后，教区宗主权转归科隆大主教，但主教们逐步经营起世俗领地，1288年科隆在沃林根战役战败后，主教在采邑内已形同君主。

1337年在位的是利珀的伯恩哈德五世，他颁布了第一部领地宪法《伯恩哈德特权书》。后来的主教往往遥领此地：默尔斯的迪特里希兼治帕德博恩与科隆，他在1444至1449年与索斯特城的世仇争斗使主教区惨遭破坏。

宗教改革在帕德博恩周边深入传播，但1580年被召来的耶稣会士和1614年创立的帕德博恩大学重建了天主教统治。1802年采邑调解中该邦国并入普鲁士，1807至1813年改属威斯特伐利亚王国。

en: Píngdìng was the native Pingding Chief's Office in the mountain country of central Guizhou, around present-day Majiang. From 1494 it was one of the three chief's offices, with Leping and Maha, placed under the Ming department of Maha, and its hereditary chiefs kept their posts into the Qing.
zh: 平定即平定长官司，是贵州中部山区、今麻江县一带的土著土司。1494年明朝置麻哈州，平定司与乐坪、麻哈二司同为其下辖三长官司，长官世代承袭，延续至清代。

en:
Prudnik, called Neustadt in German, is a small Silesian lordship on the Bohemian border. Its castle was founded in 1255 by Vok of Rosenberg by order of King Ottokar II of Bohemia to guard the trade road from Nysa to Opava, the town growing under the Piast dukes of Opole.

In 1336 John of Luxembourg, king of Bohemia, allowed Bolesław the Elder, Piast duke of Niemodlin, to buy Prudnik. Bolesław had done homage at Opava in 1327, so it entered 1337 as a Bohemian fief held by a Piast.

His descendants held it until the early fifteenth century, when it was combined with neighbouring Głogówek into the Duchy of Głogówek and Prudnik, which suffered heavily in the Hussite invasion of 1428. The duchy kept its identity until 1562, after which Prudnik shared the fate of Austrian Silesia and passed to Prussia in 1742.
zh:
普鲁德尼克（德语称诺伊施塔特）是波希米亚边境上的西里西亚小领地。1255年，罗森贝格的沃克奉波希米亚国王奥托卡二世之命修建城堡，扼守尼斯到奥帕瓦的商道，城镇随后在奥波莱的皮亚斯特公爵治下发展起来。

1336年，波希米亚国王卢森堡的约翰准许涅莫德林的皮亚斯特公爵博莱斯瓦夫“长者”买下普鲁德尼克。博莱斯瓦夫已于1327年在奥帕瓦行过臣服礼，因此它在1337年以波希米亚封邑、皮亚斯特家族领有的身份出现。

他的后代保有该地至15世纪初，随后它与邻近的格沃古韦克合并为格沃古韦克和普鲁德尼克公国，并在1428年胡斯派入侵中遭到严重破坏。该公国保持独立身份至1562年，此后普鲁德尼克随奥地利治下的西里西亚同命运，于1742年转归普鲁士。

en:
Pǔdìng grew out of the Puli tribe around Anshun in central Guizhou. The Mongols set up a wanhu office there in 1257, converted it into the Puding prefecture in 1278 and then into the Puding route in 1303; in 1351 the Anshun department and Puding county were carved from its lands.

Its female chieftain Shi'er submitted to the Ming together with the Shuixi ruler Aicui in 1371. The Puding native prefecture was confirmed in 1372, reorganized as a military-civilian prefecture in 1382, then dissolved in 1383 when Anshun became a department directly under Yunnan.

After Guizhou province was created in 1413 the lands passed to Guizhou; Anshun was placed directly under it in 1438 and promoted to a military-civilian prefecture in 1602. The county of Puding was restored in 1672, before the administration was renamed Anshun prefecture in 1687.
zh:
普定源于贵州中部安顺一带的普里部。蒙古于1257年在其地设普定万户府，1278年改置普定府，1303年改为普定路，1351年又分置安顺州和普定县。

1371年，普定女总管适尔与水西土司霭翠等归附明朝。1372年明廷置普定土府，1382年改置军民府，1383年府废，安顺州改为直隶云南的州。

1413年贵州设布政使司，1438年安顺州直隶贵州，1602年升为安顺军民府。1672年复置普定县，1687年改称安顺府。

en:
The Kingdom of Cochin, formally Perumpadappu Swaroopam, arose in central Kerala in the early twelfth century after the collapse of the Later Chera, whose feudatory it had been. It held court at Kodungallur before moving its capital to Kochi in 1341, when a flood wrecked the old seat.

Repeated attacks by the Zamorin of Kozhikode had shrunk it to its smallest extent by the late fifteenth century. In 1500 Raja Unni Goda Varma welcomed the Portuguese commander Cabral and allied against the Zamorin, and Cochin remained a Portuguese protectorate from 1503 to 1663.

Vasco da Gama was buried at Cochin in 1524. The Dutch East India Company took over in 1663 and the British in 1795. Hyder Ali of Mysore made it a tributary in 1766, and under the treaty of 1809 it became a princely state under British paramountcy.
zh:
科钦王国正式名称为佩鲁姆帕杜斯瓦鲁帕姆，12世纪初兴起于喀拉拉中部，本是后期哲罗诸王的附庸，哲罗崩溃后获得独立。王室最初驻跸科敦加卢尔，1341年洪水摧毁旧都后迁都科钦。

科泽科德扎莫林连番进攻，到15世纪末领土已缩至最小。1500年罗阇温尼·戈达·瓦尔马迎接葡萄牙统帅卡布拉尔，结盟对付扎莫林，1503至1663年间科钦是葡萄牙的保护国。

瓦斯科·达伽马于1524年下葬科钦。1663年荷兰东印度公司接手，1795年又换成英国人。1766年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里迫使科钦纳贡称臣，根据1809年的条约，它成为英国宗主权下的土邦。

en:
Perugia, the Etruscan Perusia and one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League, stands on an Umbrian ridge. It passed under the popes in the ninth century, but by the eleventh its commune ran its affairs, warring with its neighbours, and Emperor Henry VI recognised its consular government in 1186.

A Guelph city, Perugia rejected papal sovereignty: it fought Pope Urban V in 1369, accepted a papal legate the next year and expelled him in 1375. The condottiere Biordo Michelotti became its first lord in 1393, and Braccio da Montone ruled from 1416 to 1424.

The Baglioni held the city from 1438, their patronage drawing Raphael, until their feuds ended in the Red Wedding of 1500. In 1540 Pope Paul III's troops sacked Perugia and built the Rocca Paolina, absorbing it into the Papal States until French troops arrived in 1797.
zh:
佩鲁贾古称佩鲁西亚，是伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一，雄踞翁布里亚的山脊。9世纪它转入教皇治下，到11世纪公社已自行管理政务，不断与邻近城邦交战，皇帝亨利六世于1186年承认其执政官政府。

作为圭尔夫派城市，佩鲁贾拒绝教皇主权：1369年与教皇乌尔班五世开战，次年接受教皇使节，又于1375年将其驱逐。佣兵队长比尔多·米凯洛蒂于1393年成为第一位城市领主，布拉乔·达·蒙托内在1416—1424年间统治该城。

巴廖尼自1438年起掌控佩鲁贾，其赞助吸引了拉斐尔等艺术家，直到仇杀酿成1500年的红色婚礼惨案。1540年教皇保罗三世的军队洗劫城市，修建保利纳堡垒，将其并入教皇国，直至1797年法军到来。

en:
Hanthawaddy was the Mon-speaking polity of lower Burma. From the collapse of the Pagan empire the local chief Wareru seized Martaban in 1285, declared independence in 1287 and united the Mon provinces by about 1296. His Wareru Dhammathat law code outlived him. A nominal Sukhothai vassal, it won independence in 1330 when Binnya E Law, its 1337 ruler, repelled a Siamese invasion. Binnya U moved the court to Pegu, its permanent capital.

Razadarit unified the Mon provinces and held off Ava in the Forty Years' War of 1385 to 1424. The next century was its golden age: Shin Sawbu, Dhammazedi and others grew rich on Indian Ocean trade and made Pegu a Theravada reform centre.

Tabinshwehti of Toungoo overran the delta and Pegu in 1538 and 1539 and took Martaban in 1541; Bayinnaung crushed a Mon revival in 1552. The Mon rose in 1740, sacked Ava in 1752 and ended Toungoo rule, but Alaungpaya of Konbaung destroyed Pegu in 1757, ending Mon rule.
zh:
汉达瓦底是下缅甸的孟人政权。蒲甘帝国崩溃之际，地方首领伐丽流1285年夺取马达班，1287年宣布独立，约1296年统一孟人三省。他的《伐丽流法典》流传久远。它初为素可泰名义附庸，1330年1337年的统治者频耶埃劳击退暹罗，获完全独立。频耶宇时迁都勃固，成为固定国都。

亚扎底律统一孟人诸省，在1385至1424年的四十年战争中挡住阿瓦。此后一个世纪是黄金时代，信修浮、达摩悉提等人靠印度洋贸易致富，使勃固成为上座部佛教改革中心。

东吁的德彬瑞蒂1538、1539年攻占三角洲与勃固，1541年陷马达班；勃印曩1552年镇压孟人复国。1740年孟人再起义，1752年攻陷阿瓦、灭东吁王朝，贡榜的雍籍牙1757年攻破勃固，孟人统治终结。

en:
Pemba, the Green Island of Arab geographers, is the northern major island of the Zanzibar Archipelago, separated from the Tanzanian mainland by the Pemba Channel. Bantu farmers had settled there by the seventh century, and on the western Ras Mkumbuu peninsula rose a stone city now identified, plausibly but not certainly, with Qanbalu, the Muslim port described by al-Masudi around 900.

Its mosque was long the largest in sub-Saharan Africa. By the mid-thirteenth century the geographer Yaqut al-Hamawi reported two independent sultans sharing the island, and in the fifteenth century Pemba was a vassal island-state of Kilwa. Portuguese rule from about 1503 brought decline to the old towns, and Ras Mkumbuu was abandoned during the sixteenth century.

After the Omani conquest of 1698 settlements revived, and from the late eighteenth century Pemba turned increasingly to plantation agriculture, exporting sugar and later cloves under Zanzibari overlords.
zh:
奔巴在阿拉伯地理学家笔下称‘绿岛’，是桑给巴尔群岛两座主岛中偏北的一座，与坦桑尼亚大陆隔着奔巴海峡。7世纪时班图农民已在此定居；西部姆昆比角半岛上兴起一座石城，今人很有把握但尚未完全确定地将它比定为马苏迪约在900年记述的穆斯林商港坎巴卢。

城中清真寺曾长期是撒哈拉以南非洲最大的同类建筑。13世纪中叶，地理学家雅库特·哈马维已记载岛上两位苏丹各自独立、分地而治；15世纪时奔巴是基卢瓦的附庸岛国。约1503年起葡萄牙人的统治使旧城衰落，姆昆比角在16世纪被废弃。

1698年阿曼征服之后聚落重新兴旺，18世纪末起奔巴日益转向种植园农业，在桑给巴尔统治者治下出口蔗糖，后来又广种丁香。

en:
The Penobscot were a Wabanaki people whose homeland lay along the Penobscot River in what is now Maine. In the sixteenth century they traded furs with Europeans for goods including metal tools and weapons.

Allied with New France, the Penobscot fought New England colonists in Dummer's War of 1722–1725. They again sided with France during the Seven Years' War; after the French defeat at Quebec in 1759 they lost their principal European ally, while settlers continued to encroach on their lands.
zh:
佩诺布斯科特人属于瓦巴纳基诸民族，故地位于今缅因州的佩诺布斯科特河沿岸。16世纪，他们用毛皮向欧洲人换取金属工具和武器等货物。

佩诺布斯科特人与新法兰西结盟，在1722—1725年的杜默战争中对抗新英格兰殖民者。七年战争期间他们再次站在法国一边；1759年法国在魁北克战败后，他们失去了主要的欧洲盟友，殖民者继续侵占他们的土地。

en:
The Peewareewa, known as the Peoria, were an Illinois Confederation people who lived east of the Mississippi and north of the Ohio River. Jacques Marquette and Louis Jolliet encountered them in 1673, and they traded with French colonists in Illinois Country.

After France ceded the lands east of the Mississippi to Britain in 1763, Peoria people moved into Missouri. They ceded Illinois lands to the United States in 1818 and Missouri lands in 1832, receiving land near the Osage River in Kansas.
zh:
佩瓦雷瓦人又称皮奥里亚人，是伊利诺伊联盟的一个族群，居住在密西西比河以东、俄亥俄河以北。雅克·马凯特和路易·若利埃于1673年遇见了他们；他们与伊利诺伊地区的法国殖民者进行贸易。

1763年法国将密西西比河以东土地割让给英国后，佩瓦雷瓦人迁入密苏里。他们于1818年向美国割让伊利诺伊土地，1832年又割让密苏里土地，换取堪萨斯奥塞奇河附近的土地。

en: The Pepikokia were a division of the Miami peoples of the Great Lakes region. They remained a separate tribe until 1742 and later became part of the Wea, who lived along the Wabash River in present-day Indiana.
zh: 佩皮科基亚人是五大湖地区迈阿密人的一个支系。他们作为独立部族延续到1742年，后来并入居住在今印第安纳州沃巴什河沿岸的韦阿人。

en:
The County of Périgord took its name from the Petrocorii, the Gaulish tribe that held it against Roman conquest. Its pagus became a fief of the Duchy of Aquitaine, centred on Périgueux, and from the tenth century its counts came from the house of Charroux, later called Talleyrand.

In 1337 the count was Roger-Bernard, who ruled from Périgueux as a vassal of the French crown. Périgord became one of the chief battlegrounds of the Hundred Years' War.

The last Talleyrand counts were dispossessed by Charles VI in 1398 and 1399, and in 1400 the county was re-granted to Louis I, Duke of Orléans. It passed through Châtillon and Albret to Henry of Bourbon, who inherited it in 1572 and became King Henry IV in 1589; with the death of his sister Catherine in 1604 it merged into the royal domain.
zh:
佩里戈尔伯国得名于高卢部族佩特罗科里人，该部族曾据守当地抵抗罗马征服。其故土后来成为阿基坦公国的封地，以佩里格为中心；10世纪起伯爵出自沙鲁家族，即后来的塔列朗家族。

1337年在位的罗热—贝尔纳以法兰西国王封臣的身份从佩里格统治伯国。百年战争期间，佩里戈尔是英法两军反复争夺的主要战场之一。

末代塔列朗伯爵先后于1398年和1399年被查理六世剥夺领地，1400年伯国改封给奥尔良公爵路易一世。此后它历经沙蒂永和阿尔布雷两家族，1572年传给波旁的亨利，此人于1589年即位为国王亨利四世；1604年其妹卡特琳去世后，佩里戈尔并入王室领地。

en:
Pesaro is an Adriatic port in the Marche, founded by the Romans as Pisaurum in 184 BC on the Via Flaminia. The Ostrogoth king Vitigis destroyed it in 539 during the Gothic War; rebuilt under Byzantine rule, it joined the Pentapolis of the Exarchate of Ravenna and later passed to the Papal States.

During the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries the Malatesta of Rimini built up a lordship in Romagna and the Marche, and Malatesta II Guastafamiglia became lord of Pesaro in 1326. In 1445 the last Malatesta sold the city, and it passed to the Sforza, who held it until 1512.

From 1513 the Della Rovere dukes of Urbino made Pesaro the capital of their duchy, building new walls and palaces. When the Della Rovere line died out in 1631, the duchy reverted to the Papal States, where Pesaro remained.
zh:
佩萨罗是马尔凯地区的亚得里亚海港口，公元前184年罗马人沿弗拉米尼亚大道在此建立皮萨乌鲁姆。哥特战争期间，东哥特国王维蒂吉斯于539年摧毁该城；拜占庭统治时期它得到重建，加入拉文纳总督区的五城同盟，后来转入教皇国。

14至15世纪，里米尼的马拉泰斯塔家族在罗马涅、马尔凯建立领地，马拉泰斯塔二世·瓜斯塔法米利亚于1326年成为佩萨罗领主。1445年末代马拉泰斯塔领主卖掉城市，佩萨罗转入斯福尔扎家族之手，一直统治到1512年。

1513年起，乌尔比诺公爵德拉·罗韦雷家族把佩萨罗定为公国都城，修筑新城墙、广建宫殿。1631年德拉·罗韦雷家族绝嗣，公国回归教皇国，佩萨罗受其管辖。

en: Píngbà was a native chieftain's seat in the Puli tribal lands of central Guizhou, present-day Pingba in Anshun. In the early Yuan it belonged to the Puding route, and under the Ming it was absorbed into the guard system as a military post ruling five battalions; the Qing later made it the county of Anping.
zh: 平坝是贵州中部普里部地上的土著土司治所，即今安顺市平坝区。元初其地属普定路，明代被纳入卫所体制，设统辖五个千户所的军事机构，清代改置为安平县。

en:
Pugal is a desert fort-town in the arid Jangladesh country of northern Rajasthan, between Jaisalmer and the Bhatner frontier. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries it was the seat of a small Bhati Rajput chiefdom, one of the Bhati holdings scattered across the western marches.

Its best-documented ruler is Rao Kelana, also called Kelhana, a disinherited son of Rao Kehar of Jaisalmer, who secured the fort of Pugal in 1414 by marrying the Sodhi widow of its previous chief. From Pugal he raided as far as Dera Ghazi Khan, where he defeated the Baloch, and at his death in 1430 held nine forts.

His sons kept Pugal for a generation, but later in the fifteenth century Rao Bika's Rathore conquest of Jangladesh absorbed the chiefdom into the new kingdom of Bikaner.
zh:
布格尔是拉贾斯坦北部干旱的禅伽罗德什地区的一座沙漠堡垒城镇，地处斋沙默尔与巴特尼尔边境之间。14至15世纪，这里是巴蒂拉杰普特人的一个小首领政权，属散布在西部边陲的巴蒂领地之一。

其最可考的统治者是拉奥·凯拉纳，又名凯尔哈纳，本是斋沙默尔君主凯哈尔被剥夺继承权的儿子，1414年通过迎娶前任首领的索迪遗孀取得布格尔堡。他以布格尔为据点四处出击，兵锋远至德拉加齐汗，在那里击败俾路支人，到1430年去世时已据有九座堡垒。

他的儿子们据守布格尔一代人，到15世纪后期，拉奥·比卡率拉托尔人征服禅伽罗德什，这个小邦被并入新兴的比卡内尔王国。

en:
Pagarruyung was a Minangkabau kingdom in the highlands of western Sumatra. In 1347 Adityawarman proclaimed himself king of Malayapura; his inscriptions place his rule near Pagarruyung, and he is associated with the rise of its royal dynasty and the Sumatran gold trade.

Islam spread through the region from the sixteenth century. Pagarruyung acknowledged Acehnese sovereignty in the early seventeenth century and rebelled in 1665; the Padri War in the early nineteenth century brought the kingdom's collapse and Dutch control.
zh:
帕迦鲁荣是苏门答腊西部高地的米南加保人王国。1347年，阿底提耶跋摩自称摩罗瑜补罗之王；他的铭文表明其统治中心靠近帕迦鲁荣，他也与当地王朝的兴起及苏门答腊黄金贸易有关。

16世纪起，伊斯兰教在这一地区传播。帕迦鲁荣在17世纪初承认亚齐的宗主权，并于1665年反叛；19世纪初的帕德里战争导致王国覆灭，荷兰人取得了控制权。

en:
Caboloan, also called Binalatongan, was a pre-colonial Pangasinan polity on the Agno River delta in western Luzon, its chief town Binalatongan holding more than two thousand houses. Its name means the place of the bolo bamboo, and it traded bamboo, beeswax and forest produce to the coast for salt and Chinese goods.

Its people worshipped the war god Apolaki alongside the anito spirits and were feared as mangangayaw raiders. Local legend remembers a king named Ari Kasikis, though the name rests only on much later census records.

Juan de Salcedo overran the Pangasinan coast in 1572, and after the Chinese pirate Limahong tried to found a kingdom there in 1574 and 1575, the Spaniards pushed inland. In 1611 the creation of the province of Pangasinan absorbed Caboloan, and the district later rose in the revolt of Andres Malong in 1660.
zh:
邦阿西楠又称比纳拉托岸，是吕宋西部阿格诺河三角洲上的前殖民邦阿西楠政权，首镇比纳拉托岸有两千多户人家。其国名意为“博罗竹丛生之地”，居民把竹子、蜂蜡和山林物产运到海边，换取食盐和中国货物。

他们信奉战神阿波拉基和阿尼托神灵，以从事猎头劫掠的曼加加尧武士闻名。当地传说有国王阿里·卡西基斯，但这个名字仅见于晚得多的人口普查记录。

1572年胡安·德·萨尔塞多横扫邦阿西楠沿海；1574至1575年华人海盗林凤试图在此自立王国，西班牙人随即深入内陆。1611年邦阿西楠省设立，邦阿西楠政权被彻底并入，此地后来又爆发1660年安德烈斯·马隆起义。

en:
The Picunche were Mapudungun-speaking farming communities in central Chile, between the Choapa and Itata rivers. Their crops included maize and potatoes, and their homes were built of adobe with thatched roofs. At the end of the 15th century, southern Picunche groups known as the Promaucae resisted Inca expansion; later chronicles describe their confrontation at the Maule River.

Under Spanish colonial rule, Picunche villagers gradually moved to nearby estates. There they mixed with Indigenous people brought from Araucanía, Chiloé and Cuyo, and eventually lost their separate identity.
zh:
皮昆切是智利中部乔阿帕河与伊塔塔河之间说马普切语的农耕社群。他们种植玉米和马铃薯，用土坯和茅草建造房屋。15世纪末，被称为普罗毛卡埃人的南部皮昆切群体抵抗印加扩张；后来的编年史记载了他们在马乌莱河的交战。

在西班牙殖民统治下，皮昆切村民逐渐迁往附近庄园。他们在那里与从阿劳卡尼亚、奇洛埃和库约带来的原住民通婚融合，最终失去了独立的族群认同。

en:
Phayao, also called Phukamyao, was a Tai mueang of the upper Ing and Yom river basins in northern Thailand, centred on twin walled towns. According to the Phayao Chronicle it was refounded by Khun Chomtham, a younger son of the ruler of Ngoenyang, who restored the abandoned city and reunited its chiefdoms.

Its golden age came under Ngammueang, who took the throne in 1258, the first of its rulers attested outside the chronicles. He joined Mangrai of Ngoenyang and Ramkhamhaeng of Sukhothai in the Three Kings alliance, and in 1296 attended the founding of Mangrai's new capital at Chiang Mai.

The end came in 1338, when Khamfu of Chiang Saen and the Nan ruler Phaya Phanong sacked Phayao's two capitals and drove out King Khamlue. Khamfu then annexed the city to Lan Na, while the eastern towns went to Nan.
zh:
帕尧又称普卡尧，是泰人的一个勐，位于泰国北部英河与永河上游流域，以两座双子城为中心。据《帕尧编年史》记载，恩央国王的一个年幼儿子宗坦重修废城、统一周边各部，重建了这个邦国。

1258年即位的昂孟开创了帕尧的黄金时代，他也是首位见诸编年史之外史料的帕尧君主。他与恩央的孟莱、素可泰的兰甘亨结成三王同盟，并于1296年出席孟莱新都清迈的奠基典礼。

1338年帕尧走到尽头：清盛的坎富与难王帕亚帕农联手洗劫帕尧两城，赶走国王坎鲁；坎富随即将帕尧并入兰纳，东部城镇则划归难国。

en:
The Piankeshaw were a Miami people who lived along the Wabash River in what are now Indiana and Illinois. Their villages included a settlement near Vincennes, and they were closely allied with the neighboring Wea.

During the American Revolution the Piankeshaw generally sided with the Americans, but in 1786 settlers from Vincennes attacked a nearby village along the Embarras River. Some Piankeshaw left for Terre Haute or Kaskaskia; in 1818 their chief Chekommia signed a treaty selling rights to much of their land to the United States.
zh:
皮安克肖人是迈阿密人的一个支系，居住在今印第安纳州和伊利诺伊州的沃巴什河沿岸。他们的村庄包括万森附近的一处聚落，并与邻近的韦阿人结成紧密联盟。

美国独立战争期间，皮安克肖人大体站在美国人一边，但1786年万森的定居者袭击了安巴拉河沿岸附近的村庄。一些皮安克肖人离开，前往特雷霍特或卡斯卡斯基亚；1818年，首领切科米亚签约，将他们大部分土地的权利出售给美国。

en: Picardy was a historical region of northern France whose medieval towns included Amiens, Arras and Abbeville, rather than a single principality. During the Hundred Years' War it was a centre of the Jacquerie revolt in 1358, and the 1435 Congress of Arras brought French, English and Burgundian representatives to the region.
zh: 皮卡第是法国北部的历史地区，中世纪的城镇包括亚眠、阿拉斯和阿布维尔，并非一个统一的公国。百年战争期间，皮卡第是1358年扎克雷起义的中心；1435年的阿拉斯会议则使法国、英格兰和勃艮第的代表来到这一地区。

en:
The Lordship of Piedmont, at the foot of the Alps around Turin and Pinerolo, was the Italian holding of the House of Savoy, governed by its Savoy-Achaia branch. It came to the counts of Savoy in 1046.

In 1337 its lord was James of Savoy-Achaia, a vassal of his cousin the Count of Savoy. He backed the Angevins of Naples against the Marquess of Montferrat and, after the defeat at Gamenario in 1345, retook Chieri in 1347 with Amadeus VI of Savoy's army. A later quarrel with the count saw him captured and his lands confiscated, though they were restored in 1362.

The last lord, Louis, founded the University of Turin in 1405 and died childless in 1418. The branch became extinct and Piedmont reverted to the ducal line of Savoy, whose dukes moved their capital to Turin in 1563.
zh:
皮埃蒙特领地位于阿尔卑斯山脚下，以都灵和皮内罗洛为中心，是萨伏依家族在意大利一侧的领地，由萨伏依-阿哈亚支系统治。它于1046年归入萨伏依伯爵名下。

1337年在位的领主是詹姆斯·萨伏依-阿哈亚，臣属于堂亲萨伏依伯爵。他支持那不勒斯安茹家族对抗蒙费拉侯爵，1345年加梅纳里奥之败后，于1347年借萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥六世的军队收复基耶里。后来他与伯爵反目，被俘、领地被没收，1362年才恢复。

末代领主路德维科于1405年创办都灵大学，1418年无子而终。支系绝嗣，皮埃蒙特回归萨伏依公爵主支，公爵们后来在1563年把都城迁到都灵。

en:
The Pinagua were a chiefdom of the Cusco valley, remembered through the chronicles of the early Inca wars. Closely bound to the Ayarmaca, they took shape around the thirteenth century from the wreckage of the Wari culture; Spanish documents name them together, and one chronicle calls the Pinagua half of the Ayarmaca state.

Their lands lay east and southeast of Cusco around the Lucre lake, with their chief seat at the Wari centre of Pikillaqta, a walled settlement occupied from about 550 and abandoned around 1100.

When Inca Roca overthrew the Hurin Cusco dynasty around 1350, the Pinagua sinchi Huaman Tupac rose with the Muyna for independence, but was defeated in the first battle and disappeared, and Inca Roca later conquered Pinagua outright. The Pinagua rebelled once more under Viracocha Inca and were crushed, after which their lands passed into the Inca state.
zh:
皮纳瓜是库斯科河谷的一个酋长国，因早期印卡战争的记载而被人记住。它与阿亚尔马卡关系密切，约在13世纪从瓦里文化的废墟上形成；西班牙文献将二者相提并论，一部编年史更称皮纳瓜人占了阿亚尔马卡政权的一半。

其领地在库斯科以东和东南，环绕卢克雷湖，治所设在瓦里中心皮基拉克塔，这座有城墙的聚落约从550年起有人居住，1100年前后被废弃。

约1350年印卡·罗卡推翻下库斯科王朝时，皮纳瓜首领瓦曼·图帕克与穆伊纳人一道起兵谋求独立，却一战即败、不知所终，印卡·罗卡随后彻底征服皮纳瓜。维拉科查·印卡在位时皮纳瓜人再次反叛，被镇压后领地从此并入印卡国家。

en:
The Pijao were Indigenous peoples of the upper Magdalena valley and the central Andes in present-day Colombia. At the Spanish arrival, their chiefdoms formed separate groupings in the lowlands and the mountains rather than a centralized state.

The Pijao wars against Spanish rule lasted around eighty years. In 1608 Juan de Borja campaigned against them, accompanied by the chronicler Pedro Simón; the long conquest killed many Pijao men and brought conversion to Catholicism.
zh:
皮豪是今哥伦比亚马格达莱纳河上游河谷和安第斯山中部的原住民诸族。西班牙人到来时，他们的酋邦分别组成低地和山区的联合体，并未形成中央集权国家。

皮豪反抗西班牙统治的战争持续了约80年。1608年，胡安·德·博尔哈率军征讨皮豪，编年史家佩德罗·西蒙随行；漫长的征服使许多皮豪男子丧生，也带来了天主教的传播。

en:
The Akimel O'odham, or River People, lived in villages along the Gila and Salt rivers in what is now Arizona. They farmed with irrigation canals, hunted and gathered, and traded with neighboring peoples.

The Jesuit Eusebio Kino visited their villages in 1694. In 1751 Pima communities rose against Spanish colonial forces after decades of encroachment on their lands and autonomy.
zh:
阿基梅尔奥德汉人即“河流之民”，生活在今亚利桑那州希拉河和索尔特河沿岸的村落中。他们利用运河灌溉农田，也从事狩猎、采集和与邻族的贸易。

1694年，耶稣会士尤西比奥·基诺访问了他们的村落。西班牙殖民者数十年来侵占土地和削弱自治后，皮马人的聚落于1751年起兵反抗殖民军队。

en:
The Pinya kingdom ruled central Burma from the Kyaukse granary between 1313 and 1365, claiming succession from the fallen Pagan empire. It grew from the Myinsaing regency of three former Pagan commanders; in 1313 the youngest, Thihathu, crowned himself at newly built Pinya, with the old Pagan queen Pwa Saw performing the ceremony.

Division began almost at once: his eldest son Saw Yun took northern Sagaing, winning autonomy in 1315 to 1317 and full independence in 1325. The rump state was torn by rivalry between Thihathu's sons Uzana I and Kyawswa I, while southern vassals Toungoo and Prome were practically independent.

Central authority revived briefly under Kyawswa I from 1344, but Shan Maw raids in 1358 to 1359 and 1362 to 1363 devastated the countryside and let Toungoo break away. In 1364 Maw troops sacked both Pinya and Sagaing, and Thado Minbya of Sagaing seized the ruined capitals and founded the Ava kingdom in 1365.
zh:
彬牙王国1313至1365年间以粮仓皎施的彬牙城为都，统治缅甸中部，自称覆灭蒲甘王国的法理继承者。它由敏象三位蒲甘旧将的摄政演变而来：1313年最年轻的底哈都在新建的彬牙城加冕，蒲甘寡后菩娑亲自主持仪式。

建国伊始分裂随之而来：底哈都长子苏云占据北方实皆省，1315—1317年间取得自治，1325年正式独立。残存王国又陷入底哈都之子乌兹那与觉苏瓦一世的争斗，南方附庸东吁和卑谬形同独立。

1344年起觉苏瓦一世一度重振中央权威，但掸人麓川于1358—1359年、1362—1363年两度入寇，蹂躏乡野，东吁趁机脱离。1364年麓川军队洗劫实皆和彬牙，实皆的德多明帕耶夺取残破都城，1365年建立阿瓦王国。

en:
Piombino was a small coastal lordship in Tuscany, including part of Elba. In 1399 Gherardo Appiani sold Pisa to the Visconti of Milan but retained Piombino and other territories for his family. Cesare Borgia occupied the lordship from 1501 to 1503, and the Appiani were restored again by treaty in 1557 after Medici occupation.

Emperor Rudolf II raised Piombino to a principality in 1594. It was merged into the Napoleonic Principality of Lucca and Piombino in 1805 and absorbed by the Grand Duchy of Tuscany in 1815.
zh:
皮翁比诺是托斯卡纳沿海的一个小领主国，领土包括厄尔巴岛的一部分。1399年，盖拉尔多·阿皮亚尼将比萨卖给米兰的维斯孔蒂家族，却为自己的家族保留了皮翁比诺等地。1501—1503年切萨雷·博尔贾占领领主国；美第奇家族占领后，阿皮亚尼家族又依据1557年的条约复位。

1594年皇帝鲁道夫二世将皮翁比诺升为亲王国。1805年它并入拿破仑设立的卢卡和皮翁比诺亲王国，1815年又归入托斯卡纳大公国。

en:
The Republic of Pisa was one of four great maritime republics of medieval Italy, its fleet dominating the Tyrrhenian Sea. Pisan ships helped take Sardinia from the Saracens in 1016 and conquered Corsica in 1051-1052, and in 1092 Pope Urban II recognised its supremacy over both islands.

A steadfast Ghibelline power, Pisa defeated Florence at Montecatini in 1315. Its rivalry with Genoa ended in catastrophe at the Battle of Meloria in 1284, after which it renounced Corsica and sold its Sardinia share in 1299, and the Aragonese conquest of Sardinia from 1323 stripped away more of its empire.

In 1399 the signore Gherardo Appiani sold the city to Gian Galeazzo Visconti, and in 1406 Florentine mercenaries occupied and annexed it to Florence. When Charles VIII of France entered Italy in 1494 the Pisans briefly restored a Second Republic before Florentine rule returned.
zh:
比萨共和国是中世纪意大利四大海上共和国之一，舰队曾称雄第勒尼安海。比萨舰船于1016年协助从撒拉森人手中夺取撒丁岛，1051—1052年征服科西嘉岛，1092年教皇乌尔班二世承认其对两岛的宗主权。

作为坚定的吉伯林派势力，比萨于1315年在蒙特卡蒂尼击败佛罗伦萨。它与热那亚的争霸在1284年的梅洛里亚海战中以惨败告终，随后放弃科西嘉，又于1299年卖掉在撒丁岛的份额，1323年起阿拉贡人对撒丁岛的征服进一步剥蚀了它的海外领地。

1399年领主盖拉尔多·阿皮亚尼把城市卖给吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂，1406年佛罗伦萨佣兵占领并将其并入佛罗伦萨。1494年法王查理八世入侵意大利时，比萨人曾短暂重建第二共和国，但佛罗伦萨的统治很快恢复。

en: Pudjananti is the game's name for an early Kaili polity on Donggala Bay in north-western Celebes, later divided among the small kingdoms of Palu, Banawa, Parigi and Moutong. In Kaili tradition this was the Tomanuru age, when villages were ruled by aristocratic madika said to descend from heavenly beings.
zh: 普占纳提是游戏对苏拉威西西北海岸栋加拉湾一带早期凯里人政权的称呼，其地后来分属帕卢、巴纳瓦、帕里吉、莫通等小王国。在凯里人的传统史述中，这属于托玛努鲁时代，村落由相传为天神后裔的贵族玛迪卡治理。

en:
Passokkorang was a Mandarese kingdom that dominated the Mandar region of western Sulawesi by force of arms from at least the thirteenth century, its power centred on the lower Mandar River around the later site of Balanipa.

In the mid-fifteenth century its king's arbitrary rule and his push for a coastal trade route drove the riverside villages to band together in the Appeq Banua Kayyang alliance. Unable to resist alone, the allies called in Gowa, whose commander I Manyambungi broke Passokkorang's attacks; in 1511 the victorious alliance re-founded itself as the kingdom of Balanipa with I Manyambungi as its first king.

The Mandar lands later entered the seven-estuary Pitu Baqbana Binanga alliance and, like the other Mandarese states, adopted Islam in the early seventeenth century.
zh:
帕索科朗是西苏拉威西曼达地区的曼达里人王国，至迟从13世纪起便以武力称雄，势力中心在曼达河下游、后来巴拉尼帕所在的地方。

15世纪中叶，其君主统治专横，又向海岸扩张以开辟海上商路，迫使河畔村落结成阿佩克·巴努阿·卡扬联盟。联盟独力难支，向戈瓦求援，戈瓦将领伊·曼扬邦吉率军击退帕索科朗的攻势；1511年获胜的联盟改组为巴拉尼帕王国，由伊·曼扬邦吉出任第一代国王。

此后曼达地区加入由七个河口王国组成的联盟，并与其他曼达里邦国一样在17世纪初改宗伊斯兰教。

en:
The Pekowi were one of five divisions of the Shawnee, whose ritual leaders traditionally came from this band. In 1745 their chief Peter Chartier led about 400 Pekowi from Pennsylvania to Lower Shawneetown and then to Kentucky, where they founded Eskippakithiki.

Pekowi warriors fought for the French at Fort Necessity in 1754. In 1780 George Rogers Clark's Kentucky militia drove the Shawnee from the village of Piqua on Ohio's Mad River and burned it.
zh:
佩科维是肖尼人的五个支系之一，肖尼人的仪式领袖传统上出自这一支系。1745年，首领彼得·沙蒂埃率约400名佩科维人从宾夕法尼亚迁至下肖尼镇，随后前往肯塔基，建立了埃斯基帕基西基村。

1754年，佩科维战士在必需堡之战中为法国作战。1780年，乔治·罗杰斯·克拉克率肯塔基民兵将肖尼人逐出俄亥俄地区马德河畔的皮夸村，并将村庄焚毁。

en:
Pal Lahara was one of the Garhjat states, small hill chiefdoms in the forested highlands of inland Orissa, with its seat at the town of Pal Lahara. Tradition held that its founder Santosh Pal was chosen as ruler by the local Sabara tribe, and research likewise traces the ruling family to Sabara clan headmen; the cobra on the state emblem came from these tribal founding myths.

Firm records begin only in 1778 with the death of chief Muni Pal, by which time Pal Lahara was a feudatory of the neighbouring Keonjhar state, its chiefs ruling as zamindars over a largely tribal population.
zh:
帕尔拉哈拉是迦尔贾德土邦之一，这类小山邦散布在奥里萨内陆林木茂密的高地上，治所就在帕尔拉哈拉城。相传其始祖桑托什·帕尔由当地萨巴拉部落推举为首领，后世考证也倾向于认为统治家族出自萨巴拉各部头人；邦徽上的眼镜蛇便来自这些部落起源神话。

可靠记载要到1778年首领穆尼·帕尔去世时才出现，彼时帕尔拉哈拉已是邻近克翁贾尔邦的附庸，其首领以柴明达尔身份统治着以部落民为主的人口。

en:
Palembang, on the Musi in southern Sumatra, was capital of Srivijaya, which controlled Malacca Strait trade from the seventh to thirteenth century. The Kedukan Bukit inscription of 682 marks the kingdom's foundation; Chinese pilgrim Yijing in 671 found over a thousand Buddhist monks. Mataram sacked the city in 990 before repulse in 1006, Chola raids weakening Srivijaya until its territories broke into small kingdoms.

In the fourteenth century it was under Majapahit overlordship, and Prince Parameswara fled a Javanese attack and later founded Malacca. Pirates held the estuary until Zheng He's fleet destroyed Chen Zuyi's fleet in 1407 and installed Shi Jinqing as ruler; the Ming called it Jiugang.

After Demak fell, Geding Suro founded a Muslim dynasty in Palembang. The Dutch East India Company opened a post in 1619, took a pepper monopoly in 1642 and burned the city in 1659, when the sultanate was proclaimed. The Grand Mosque was built in 1738 to 1748; after British and Dutch intervention the sultanate ended in 1825 and Palembang became the seat of a Dutch residency.
zh:
巴邻旁位于南苏门答腊穆西河畔，是海上帝国室利佛逝的都城，室利佛逝于7至13世纪控制马六甲海峡贸易。682年哥杜干布吉铭文记载其奠基，671年中国求法僧义净见到千余佛教僧侣。990年马打兰洗劫该城，1006年被击退，朱罗袭击又削弱室利佛逝，其领地终分裂为小邦。

14世纪它处于满者伯夷宗主权下，王子拜里米苏拉避爪哇进攻出逃，后建立马六甲。海盗盘踞河口，直到1407年郑和舰队歼灭陈祖义的船队、任命施进卿为首领，明朝称此地为旧港。

淡目陷落后，基·格德·英·苏罗在巴邻旁建立穆斯林王朝。荷兰东印度公司1619年设商馆，1642年取得胡椒专卖权，1659年焚城，同年巴邻旁苏丹国成立。大清真寺建于1738至1748年；经英国与荷兰干涉，苏丹国1825年终结，巴邻旁成为荷兰驻扎官辖区首府。

en:
Poland-Lithuania united the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania under the Union of Lublin in 1569. The two had shared a ruler since the marriage of Jadwiga and Jogaila following the 1385 agreement at Krewo. The new commonwealth had an elected monarch and a shared parliament, while Lithuania retained its own laws and institutions.

The Warsaw Confederation of 1573 guaranteed religious peace among the nobility. In 1791 the commonwealth adopted a constitution to reform its government, but Russia, Prussia and Austria partitioned its lands; the final partition in 1795 ended the state.
zh:
波兰‑立陶宛依据1569年的卢布林联合，将波兰王国与立陶宛大公国合为一体。1385年克雷沃协议后，雅德维加与约盖拉成婚，两国开始共戴一位君主。新联邦由选举产生的君主和共同议会统治，立陶宛则保留了自己的法律和机构。

1573年的华沙联盟保障了贵族之间的宗教和平。1791年联邦通过宪法改革政府，但俄国、普鲁士和奥地利瓜分了它的土地；1795年的最后一次瓜分结束了这个国家。

en:
The Pale was the east-coast strip of Ireland where English law held, ruled from Dublin Castle in the name of the King of England, titled Lord of Ireland. English rule began with the Anglo-Norman invasion of 1169 and Henry II's 1171 campaign; in 1177 his son John became Lord of Ireland; the Lordship peaked around 1300 after its Parliament first met in 1297.

The fourteenth century broke it: the Bruce invasion of 1315 to 1318 and the Black Death left the crown unable to control the barons, who adopted Irish language, law and marriage alliances. The 1366 Statutes of Kilkenny forbade these customs but could not be enforced.

By the mid-fifteenth century direct rule was confined to four shires around Dublin. Trenches were dug from 1454; the name English Pale, from Latin palus, a stake, first appears in Lord Deputy Poynings's 1494 statute. The earls of Kildare ran the lordship from 1470 until the Silken Thomas revolt of 1534 to 1535 opened the Tudor conquest; in 1542 the lordship became the Kingdom of Ireland.
zh:
帕莱是爱尔兰东海岸英格兰法律生效的狭长地带，由都柏林城堡奉英王之名治理，国王兼领爱尔兰领主头衔。英格兰人的统治始于1169年盎格鲁-诺曼入侵和1171年亨利二世亲征；1177年其子约翰成为爱尔兰领主，议会1297年首开，领地1300年前后达于极盛。

14世纪权势崩解：1315—1318年布鲁斯入侵和黑死病使王室无力约束男爵，后者改用爱尔兰语言、法律并与盖尔人联姻。1366年《基尔肯尼法令》禁此习俗，却难推行。

15世纪中叶直辖地只剩都柏林周围四郡。1454年起开挖壕沟，帕莱之名源自拉丁文帕卢斯，意为栅栏，最早见于副总督波伊宁斯1494年法令。基尔代尔伯爵1470年起掌管爱尔兰领地，1534—1535年绸衣托马斯叛乱为都铎征服开路，1542年领地改为爱尔兰王国。

en:
The Duchy of Płock was one of the small Piast duchies carved out of Mazovia during the medieval fragmentation of Poland, with its capital at Płock on the Vistula, seat of a bishopric founded in 1075.

When Duke Boleslaus II of Masovia died in 1313, his son Wenceslaus received Płock and ruled until 1336, followed by his own son Bolesław III, who died without heirs in 1351. The land then passed to Trojden I's son Siemowit III, who reunited most of Mazovia and in 1351 accepted the suzerainty of the Polish king.

In the partition of 1381 Płock went to Siemowit IV, and it was reorganized as the Płock Voivodeship in 1495. With the extinction of the Masovian Piasts in 1526, all Mazovia, including Płock, was incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland.
zh:
普沃茨克公国是中世纪波兰分裂时期从马佐夫舍分割出来的皮亚斯特小公国之一，首府是维斯瓦河畔的普沃茨克，当地主教区设于1075年。

1313年马佐夫舍公爵博莱斯瓦夫二世去世后，其子瓦茨拉夫分得普沃茨克，统治到1336年，之后由其子博莱斯瓦夫三世继位，后者于1351年无嗣而终。领地随后转入特罗伊登一世之子谢莫维特三世手中，他重新统一了马佐夫舍的大部分土地，并于1351年接受波兰国王的宗主权。

1381年再次分封时，普沃茨克归谢莫维特四世所有，该地于1495年改组为普沃茨克省。1526年马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族绝嗣，包括普沃茨克在内的整个马佐夫舍并入波兰王国。

en: Pulilu was a prehispanic Tagalog barangay on what is now Polillo off eastern Luzon, recorded in the Chinese gazetteer Zhu Fan Zhi of 1225 as a dependency of Sandao and of Ma-i on Mindoro. Its warlike people traded chiefly in rare red and blue corals taken from the sharp reefs around their islands.
zh: 普利禄是殖民以前的他加禄巴朗盖，位于今吕宋东岸外海的波利略，1225年的中国地志《诸蕃志》记载它臣属于三岛，并通过三岛归属民都洛的麻逸，当地民风强悍，以开采岛边锋利礁丛中的稀有红珊瑚与蓝琅玕为主要贸易。

en:
Plauen was the lordship of the Vogts of Plauen, imperial ministers named after their castle above the White Elster. They first appear as Vogts of Plauen in 1236, and in 1278 Count Conrad of Everstein granted the town and the surrounding Dobna Gau to his brother-in-law Henry I.

His two sons split the house: the elder, Henry the Bohemian, kept Plauen, while Henry the Russian founded the Reuss line; in 1306 the lines divided the inheritance. In 1337 the Plauen line was headed by Henry III the Tall. Pressured by the Meissen margraves and Bohemian kings, the house accepted Bohemian suzerainty in 1327.

In the Vogtland War of 1354-1357 the vogts lost most of their lands to Charles IV and the Wettin margraves. The elder Plauen line died out in 1572 and its estates fell to the Reuss; the Vogtland kept the name of its one-time advocate-lords.
zh:
普劳恩是普劳恩福格特（即地方护法官）家族的领地，该家族出身帝国陪臣，因在福格特兰白埃尔斯特河畔的城堡而得名。该家族1236年首次以普劳恩福格特的名号见于文献，1278年埃弗施泰因伯爵康拉德将城镇和周围的多布瑙高移交给他的姻亲亨利一世。

亨利一世的两个儿子分家：长子“波希米亚人”亨利二世保有普劳恩，次子“罗斯人”亨利开创了罗伊斯家族先系，1306年两支正式分割遗产。1337年普劳恩支系的家长是“高个子”亨利三世；在迈森藩侯和波希米亚国王的夹击下，该家族于1327年接受波希米亚宗主权。

1354年至1357年的福格特兰战争中，福格特们把大部分领地输给了查理四世和韦廷家族的藩侯。普劳恩长支1572年绝嗣，产业落入罗伊斯家族之手；福格特兰地名仍保留着昔日护法官领主的印记。

en:
Palitana was a Gohil Rajput chiefdom beneath the Shatrunjaya hills in southern Saurashtra, Gujarat, its ruling line tracing to Shahji, son of the Gohil ancestor Sejakji who settled there around 1194.

Above the town rose the sacred Shatrunjaya hill, where the first Jain tirthankara Adinatha was said to have meditated and where generations of Jain patrons carved more than nine hundred marble temples from the eleventh century onward, making the chiefdom guardian of one of Jainism's holiest pilgrimages. In 1337 a Gohil thakur still held the small fort and its surrounding villages.

In 1656 Mughal prince Murad Baksh, son of Shah Jahan and governor of Gujarat on his behalf, granted the town to Jain banker Shantidas Jhaveri, and in 1730 the care of the temples passed to the Anandji Kalyanji Trust. As a Kathiawar principality it paid tribute to the Gaekwar of Baroda and the Nawab of Junagadh.
zh:
巴利塔纳是戈希尔拉杰普特人的酋邦，坐落在古吉拉特萨乌拉施特拉南部的沙特伦贾亚群山之下，统治家族自称是1194年前后迁入此地的戈希尔先祖塞贾吉之子沙吉的后裔。

城镇背后矗立着神圣的沙特伦贾亚山，相传耆那教第一位祖师阿底那特曾在山上禅修；从11世纪起，历代耆那教施主在山上雕造了九百多座大理石神庙，使这个小邦成为耆那教最神圣的朝圣地之一。1337年时，一位戈希尔塔库尔仍据守着这座小堡和周围村庄。

1656年，沙贾汗之子、出镇古吉拉特的穆拉德·巴克什把巴利塔纳封给耆那教银行家尚蒂达斯·贾韦里；1730年，神庙的管理权移交阿南德吉·卡尔扬吉信托会。作为卡提阿瓦小邦，它向巴罗达的盖克瓦尔和朱纳格特的纳瓦布纳贡。

en:
Pelym was a Mansi tribal principality in western Siberia, encompassing the Pelym, Sosva and Lozva river basins. In 1481 Prince Asyka raided Great Perm, but a Muscovite expedition defeated his forces on the Pelym River in 1483.

His son Yumshan accepted Moscow's overlordship in 1485, though Pelym later escaped its control. In 1593 Russian forces defeated the principality and killed Prince Ablegirim, establishing a fort at Pelym.
zh:
佩雷姆是西西伯利亚的曼西人部族公国，涵盖佩雷姆河、索西瓦河和洛兹瓦河流域。1481年阿瑟卡公爵袭击大彼尔姆，但莫斯科远征军于1483年在佩雷姆河击败了他的军队。

他的儿子尤姆尚于1485年接受莫斯科宗主权，佩雷姆后来又摆脱了其控制。1593年俄军击败该公国，杀死阿布列吉里姆公爵，并在佩雷姆建立要塞。

en:
Pembroke was a powerful marcher lordship on Wales's frontier. Arnulf of Montgomery raised its first castle in 1093 in the Norman invasion, and castellan Gerald de Windsor held it through a major Welsh siege.

In 1138 Stephen granted the lordship to Gilbert de Clare, whose son Richard, known as Strongbow, used it as his base for the invasion of Ireland. In 1189 Richard I gave it to William Marshal with Isabel de Clare's hand; Marshal rebuilt it in stone and became Earl of Pembroke.

From 1247 the de Valence held Pembroke, which served Edward I as a base in his conquest of Wales. The lordship reverted to the Crown in 1389, was granted to Jasper Tudor in 1452, and in 1457 the future Henry VII was born in the castle. Pembroke's southern hundreds, settled by Flemish and English colonists, became Little England beyond Wales.
zh:
彭布罗克是威尔士边境有权势的边区领。1093年诺曼入侵期间，蒙哥马利的阿努尔夫修建首座城堡，城主杰拉德·德·温莎据城抵御了威尔士人的大规模围攻。

1138年，斯蒂芬将这块领地授予吉尔伯特·德·克莱尔，其子人称“强弓”的理查以此为基地远征爱尔兰。1189年，理查一世把它连同伊莎贝尔·德·克莱尔赐给威廉·马歇尔；马歇尔以石材重建城堡，受封彭布罗克伯爵。

1247年起瓦朗斯家族统治此地，彭布罗克在爱德华一世征服威尔士时充当军事基地。领地1389年收归王室，1452年封给贾斯珀·都铎，1457年未来的亨利七世生于此堡。彭布罗克南部诸百户区由佛兰德斯和英格兰移民定居，成为“威尔士之外的小英格兰”。

en: The Pamlico were an Algonquian-speaking people on the Pamlico River in present-day North Carolina. English colonists recorded them in 1585–1586, and a smallpox epidemic devastated them in 1696. By 1710 they occupied a single small village; in 1711 they joined Tuscarora allies in attacks on colonial settlements.
zh: 帕姆利科人是居住在今北卡罗来纳州帕姆利科河沿岸的阿尔冈昆语族人群。英格兰殖民者在1585—1586年记载了他们，1696年的天花疫情使他们遭受重创。到1710年，他们只剩一个小村落；1711年，他们加入塔斯卡罗拉人的联盟，袭击殖民者的定居点。

en: The Pemon are a Cariban-speaking Indigenous people of the Gran Sabana and neighboring parts of present-day Venezuela, Brazil and Guyana. Their principal groups include the Arekuna, Kamarakoto and Taurepang.
zh: 佩蒙是大萨瓦纳及其周边地区的加勒比语族原住民，分布在今委内瑞拉、巴西和圭亚那境内。其主要群体包括阿雷库纳、卡马拉科托和陶雷庞。

en:
Pomesania takes its name from the Pomesanians, the westernmost pagan Old Prussian clan between the Vistula and the Elbląg rivers. During the Prussian Crusade the Teutonic Knights crossed the Vistula in 1231, founded Marienwerder in 1233 and subdued the clan within a few years.

In 1243 the papal legate William of Modena created the Bishopric of Pomesania, one of four dioceses in conquered Prussia. Its chapter sat in the fortified cathedral of Marienwerder, and from the 1280s the canons had to join the Teutonic Order, so the bishop's temporal lands never became a prince-bishopric and were administered as part of Teutonic Prussia.

In 1454 the bishop and canons joined the Prussian Confederation and submitted to Casimir IV of Poland, confirmed by the Second Peace of Thorn in 1466. The Reformation brought Lutheran bishops from 1523, and in 1587 the diocese was secularized into Ducal Prussia.
zh:
波美萨尼亚得名于波美萨尼亚人——信奉异教的古普鲁士最西的一支，居住在维斯瓦河与埃尔布隆格河之间。普鲁士十字军期间，条顿骑士团于1231年渡过维斯瓦河，1233年建立马林韦德，数年内便征服了该部族。

1243年，教皇特使摩德纳的威廉设立波美萨尼亚主教区，作为被征服普鲁士四个教区之一。主教座堂参议会驻于马林韦德的设防大教堂；从13世纪80年代起，参事会成员须加入条顿骑士团，因此主教的世俗领地始终没有发展为采邑主教区，而是作为条顿普鲁士的一部分管理。

1454年，主教与参议会加入普鲁士邦联，向波兰的卡齐米日四世臣服，1466年第二次托伦和约确认了这一安排。宗教改革后1523年起主教改宗路德宗，1587年教区被世俗化，并入普鲁士公国。

en:
Punia was the chieftaincy of the Punia or Poonia, a Jat clan settled in Jangladesh, the rough and dry country of northern Rajasthan, whose stronghold was Sidhmukh.

From the tenth century onwards the Jat clans of this region, among them the Poonia, held their lands under their own chiefs and customary law, while Bhati Rajputs dominated the country farther to the north and west. These small clan states kept their independence for centuries.

In the second half of the fifteenth century Rao Bika, a younger son of the Rathore ruler of Jodhpur, led his followers into Jangladesh, defeated the Jat clans and founded Bikaner State in 1465; the Punia chieftains then accepted Rathore suzerainty and their territory became part of the new kingdom around Bikaner.
zh:
普尼亚是同名氏族的酋长领地。该氏族属于贾特人，定居在拉贾斯坦北部干旱崎岖的禅伽罗德什，据点是悉陀目佉。

从10世纪起，这一地区的贾特诸氏族（普尼亚即在其中）在各自酋长和习惯法治理下保有土地，而北面和西面则由巴蒂拉杰普特人称雄。这些氏族小邦独立存续了数百年。

15世纪下半叶，焦特布尔拉托尔统治者的幼子拉奥·比卡率众进入禅伽罗德什，击败贾特诸氏族，于1465年建立比卡内尔土邦，普尼亚酋长遂接受拉托尔宗主权，领地并入这个以比卡内尔为中心的新王国。

en:
Poonch is a small river valley west of the Kashmir plain, shut between the Pir Panjal range and the Jhelum. Kalhana's Rajatarangini calls it Paranotsa, and the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang recorded it in the seventh century.

Around 850 it emerged as a sovereign state under Raja Nar, and its raja Trilochanpal withstood Mahmud of Ghazni in 1020: the invader could not take the fort of Lohara and so failed to enter Kashmir.

From 1475 the Kashmiri general Malik Tazi Bhat campaigned through the hills and made Poonch a tributary state of the Kashmir Sultanate, its local rulers keeping limited autonomy in return for tribute and troops. The Mughal conquest of Kashmir in 1586 transferred that overlordship to Delhi, and in 1819 Maharaja Ranjit Singh seized Poonch and granted it as a jagir to his Dogra minister Dhyan Singh.
zh:
蓬奇是克什米尔平原以西的小河谷，夹在皮尔潘贾尔山脉与杰赫勒姆河之间。卡尔哈纳的《王河》称其为帕兰诺察，7世纪的中国求法僧玄奘也曾记录此地。

约850年，它在罗阇纳尔治下成为独立政权；1020年，罗阇特里洛钦帕尔抵御伽色尼的马哈茂德，入侵者攻不下洛哈拉要塞，因而未能进入克什米尔。

从1475年起，克什米尔将领马利克·塔齐·巴特转战山区，使蓬奇成为克什米尔苏丹国的附庸，当地统治者以贡赋和出兵换取有限自治。1586年莫卧儿征服克什米尔，宗主权随之转入德里手中；1819年，大君兰吉特·辛格夺取蓬奇，将它作为采邑封给多格拉出身的大臣迪扬·辛格。

en:
Pannai was a Buddhist kingdom that flourished from the eleventh to the fourteenth century in the valleys of the Panai and Barumun rivers on the east coast of North Sumatra, facing the Strait of Malacca. It was a small principality within the Srivijayan mandala and later a vassal of the Dharmasraya kingdom.

A Tamil inscription records its sacking around 1025 by Rajendra Chola I during a Chola navy raid on Srivijaya's subject ports. Upstream at Padanglawas stand sixteen Vajrayana brick temples, including the well-preserved Bahal temple, and Armenian trading accounts name Pannai as a source of high-quality camphor.

After Singhasari's Pamalayu expedition drew Dharmasraya and its vassals into the Javanese orbit, a Majapahit naval campaign of 1339 secured Pannai, and the Nagarakretagama of 1365 still lists it among the Majapahit Sumatran vassals, after which the kingdom disappears from the records.
zh:
潘奈是11至14世纪兴盛于北苏门答腊东海岸巴奈河与巴鲁蒙河流域、面向马六甲海峡的佛教王国。它是室利佛逝圈中的小邦，后来又臣属于达摩室利耶王国。

泰米尔铭文记载，约1025年朱罗海军远征室利佛逝属港时，拉金德拉·朱罗一世曾洗劫潘奈。上游的巴东拉瓦斯保存着十六座金刚乘砖寺，其中包括保存较好的巴哈尔寺；亚美尼亚商人的行记则把潘奈列为优质樟脑的产地。

信诃沙里的帕马拉尤远征把达摩室利耶及其属邦拉入爪哇势力范围后，满者伯夷1339年的海上远征取得潘奈，1365年的《爪哇史颂》仍把它列为满者伯夷的苏门答腊属国，此后这个王国便从记载中消失。

en:
Pinsk stands in the Polesian marshes at the meeting of the Pina and Pripyat rivers, the chief town of a small principality first mentioned by Nestor the Chronicler in 1097. In the high Middle Ages it passed between the rulers of Kiev, Turov and Volhynia, and was sacked during the Mongol invasion of 1240.

Lithuanian dukes then took the town, which became a fief of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania by about 1320 and was governed by Gediminid princes.

Its local princely line died out in 1521, after which Pinsk became a royal town and was granted in 1523 to Queen Bona Sforza, under whom it prospered; a Tatar raid was beaten off nearby in 1527 by Hetman Konstanty Ostrogski. It received Magdeburg rights from King Stephen Báthory in 1581. Later Cossack wars brought repeated sack and massacre.
zh:
平斯克位于波利西亚沼泽地带、皮纳河与普里皮亚季河交汇处，是一个小公国的首府，1097年由编年史作者涅斯托尔首次记载。中世纪盛期，它在基辅、图罗夫和沃伦的统治者之间几度易手，1240年在蒙古入侵中被洗劫。

此后立陶宛王公夺取该城，约1320年它成为立陶宛大公国的封邑，由格季米纳斯家族的王公统治。

1521年当地王公世系绝嗣，平斯克成为王家城市，1523年被赐给王后博娜·斯福尔扎，在她治下趋于繁荣；1527年一支鞑靼人来犯，在城郊被盖特曼康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗格斯基击败。1581年斯特凡·巴托里国王授予其马格德堡权利。后来的哥萨克战争使它屡遭劫掠和屠杀。

en: The Arosaguntacook are associated with the Androscoggin, an Eastern Abenaki people who lived along the Androscoggin River in present-day Maine and New Hampshire. Their main village stood near present-day Lewiston. They fought in King Philip's War in 1675, and in 1725 joined the Pequawket in moving to the Connecticut River. Later, Androscoggin families moved north to Saint-François-du-Lac in Quebec.
zh: 阿罗萨贡塔库克与安德罗斯科金人相关，后者是居住在今缅因州和新罕布什尔州安德罗斯科金河沿岸的东阿贝纳基人，主要村落位于今刘易斯顿附近。他们于1675年参加了菲利普国王战争，1725年与佩夸基特人一同迁往康涅狄格河。此后，安德罗斯科金人的一些家族北迁至魁北克的圣弗朗索瓦迪拉克。

en:
Poitou was a county of western France with its seat at Poitiers. Its counts also ruled Aquitaine from the tenth century, and through Eleanor of Aquitaine's second marriage the county passed to the kings of England in 1154. Philip II of France conquered it in 1205.

Poitou became a battleground in the Hundred Years' War. King John II of France was captured at Poitiers in 1356, and the Treaty of Brétigny followed in 1360; the county was finally merged with the French crown in 1416.
zh:
普瓦图是法国西部的伯国，治所位于普瓦捷。10世纪起，普瓦图伯爵也统治阿基坦；1154年，伯国通过阿基坦的埃莉诺的第二次婚姻转归英格兰诸王。法国国王腓力二世于1205年征服普瓦图。

普瓦图成为百年战争的战场。1356年，法国国王约翰二世在普瓦捷被俘，1360年双方缔结《布勒丁尼条约》；1416年，伯国最终并入法国王室领地。

en:
The Principality of Polotsk was an East Slavic state centred on the city of Polotsk on the Western Dvina, in the lands of the Krivichs and first mentioned in the Primary Chronicle in 862. Its Varangian prince Rogvolod was overthrown by Vladimir the Great of Kiev around 980, after which the principality passed to the Rurikid line of Vladimir's son Iziaslav.

Under Bryachislav and his son Vseslav, who ruled from 1044 to 1101, Polotsk acted as a largely autonomous rival to Kiev, but after Vseslav's death it split into smaller principalities. Hard pressed by German crusaders in Livonia and by the rising Lithuanians, Polotsk received Lithuanian princes from the mid-thirteenth century.

It was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania early in the fourteenth century, and in 1337 its prince was Narimantas, a son of Gediminas.
zh:
波洛茨克公国是以东斯拉夫城市波洛茨克为中心的国家，该城位于西德维纳河畔、克里维奇人的土地上，在862年的《往年纪事》中首次被提及。10世纪80年代前后，基辅的弗拉基米尔大帝推翻了瓦良格王公罗格沃洛德，公国此后归入弗拉基米尔之子伊贾斯拉夫一系的留里克家族。

在布里亚奇斯拉夫及其子弗谢斯拉夫（1044—1101年在位）治下，波洛茨克高度自治，长期与基辅分庭抗礼；弗谢斯拉夫死后公国分裂为若干小公国。在利沃尼亚的德意志十字军和崛起的立陶宛双重压力下，波洛茨克自13世纪中叶起由立陶宛王公统治。

它在14世纪初并入立陶宛大公国，1337年统治这里的是格季米纳斯之子纳里曼塔斯。

en:
Poland, ruled from Kraków, was reunited by Władysław Łokietek, crowned in 1320 after nearly two centuries of Piast fragmentation. In 1337 his son Casimir III, last Piast king, reigned, bringing legal reform, wider Jewish privileges, Kraków University in 1364 and Red Ruthenia. He died without a male heir in 1370.

The crown passed to Angevin Hungary and then, via the 1385 Union of Krewo, to Lithuanian grand duke Jogaila, baptized Władysław II and founder of the Jagiellonian dynasty. The Polish-Lithuanian union defeated the Teutonic Order at Grunwald in 1410 and gained Royal Prussia at Thorn in 1466. The 1569 Union of Lublin fused the two states into the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, an elective monarchy whose 1573 Warsaw Confederation guaranteed religious toleration.

Wars such as the Swedish Deluge of the 1650s weakened it before three partitions in 1772, 1793 and 1795 divided it among Russia, Prussia and Austria. Napoleon sponsored the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807; after the 1815 Congress of Vienna the Polish core became Congress Poland, in personal union with Russia.
zh:
波兰都克拉科夫，皮亚斯特分裂近两世纪后由瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃凯泰克重新统一，他于1320年加冕。1337年其子、末代皮亚斯特国王卡齐米日三世在位，推行法律改革、扩大犹太特权、兼并红鲁塞尼亚，1364年办克拉科夫大学，1370年去世时没有男性继承人。

王位先传匈牙利安茹家族，1385年克雷沃联合后传给立陶宛大公雅盖沃，受洗名瓦迪斯瓦夫二世，开创雅盖隆王朝。1410年格伦瓦德败条顿骑士团，1466年托伦和约得王家普鲁士。1569年卢布林联合成波兰立陶宛联邦，行选举君主制，1573年华沙联盟保证宗教宽容。

17世纪50年代瑞典大洪水等战争削弱联邦，1772、1793、1795年三次瓜分给俄普奥。拿破仑1807年扶植华沙公国，1815年维也纳会议后波兰核心变为俄共主议会波兰。

en:
The Duchy of Pomerania lay on the southern Baltic coast and grew from the lands of the Slavic duke Wartislaw I. His Griffin descendants repeatedly divided their territories, which included Rügen after 1325; the duchy was united again from 1478 to 1531.

Bogislaw XIV reunited Pomerania in 1625, but imperial troops entered his lands during the Thirty Years' War in 1627. He died without a male heir in 1637, and the Peace of Westphalia divided Pomerania between Sweden and Brandenburg in 1648.
zh:
波美拉尼亚公国位于波罗的海南岸，源自斯拉夫公爵瓦尔季斯瓦夫一世的领地。他的格里芬家族后裔屡次分割领土，其领地在1325年后包括吕根岛；公国在1478年至1531年间再次统一。
