波吉斯瓦夫十四世于1625年重新统一波美拉尼亚，但三十年战争期间的1627年，帝国军队进入他的领地。他于1637年去世，没有男性继承人；1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》将波美拉尼亚分给瑞典和勃兰登堡。

en: Pontus was a kingdom on the southern Black Sea coast of northern Anatolia, founded by Mithridates I in 281 BC and conquered by Rome in 63 BC. In the same region, the later Empire of Trebizond survived until the Ottoman conquest of 1461.
zh: 本都是安纳托利亚北部黑海南岸的王国，由米特里达梯一世于公元前281年建立，公元前63年被罗马征服。此后同一地区的特拉比松帝国延续至1461年，最终被奥斯曼征服。

en:
Powo, also called Poyul, was a quasi-independent kingdom in the forested gorges of southeastern Tibet, centered on Kanam in present-day Bomê County. Its Kanam Gyalpo rulers claimed descent from Drigum Tsenpo, one of the earliest Yarlung kings, and the kingdom took formal shape in the thirteenth century.

Ringed by mountains and feared for its warrior population, Powo stayed largely outside the control of Lhasa and guarded the roads to the hidden land of Pemako, protecting pilgrims from the hill tribes to the south. In 1717 a Dzungar army burned the royal palace at Kanam, after which the Kashag imposed dzong governors and corvée in the lower valleys.

When the king died without an heir in 1821 local chiefs divided the land, and after a revolt in 1835 Qing troops confirmed a new Kanam Depa the following year.
zh:
波窝一称波域，是西藏东南部森林峡谷中的半独立王国，统治中心在今波密县的噶朗村。其君主称噶朗第巴，自称是雅砻早期赞普止贡赞普的后裔，13世纪波窝形成正式王国。

凭借群山阻隔和强悍的民风，波窝长期游离于拉萨政权的控制之外，并守护着通往隐秘圣地白马岗的道路，护卫朝圣者免受南方山地部落的侵扰。1717年准噶尔军队焚毁噶朗府邸，此后噶厦在下游峡谷设宗，征收赋税、摊派乌拉差役。

1821年土王病死无嗣，属下土官各据一方；1835年发生叛乱，清廷于次年发兵平定，并册封新的噶朗第巴。

en:
Portugal grew from a county of León, first held by Vímara Peres in the late ninth century, later by Burgundian knight Henry. His son Afonso Henriques won São Mamede in 1128, took the royal title in 1139 and won León's recognition at Zamora in 1143 and the pope's in 1179. Algarve fell in 1249, Lisbon becoming capital in 1255.

A Castilian claim of 1383 fell at Aljubarrota, placing John of Aviz on the throne; the House of Aviz sealed the long English alliance at Windsor in 1386. The capture of Ceuta in 1415 began the overseas empire: under Henry the Navigator and his successors, Dias rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488, da Gama reached India in 1498 and Cabral claimed Brazil in 1500; Goa, Malacca and Macau followed.

Sebastian's death at Alcácer Quibir in 1578 brought the Spanish union of 1580, which lasted until the Braganza restoration under John IV in 1640 and the Restoration War ending in 1668.
zh:
葡萄牙原为莱昂王国伯国，9世纪末维马拉·佩雷斯首任，后传勃艮第骑士亨利。其子阿方索·恩里克斯1128年圣马梅德获胜，1139年称王，1143年《萨莫拉条约》获莱昂承认，1179年获教皇认可。1249年阿尔加维陷，1255年里斯本为都。

1383年卡斯蒂利亚的王位要求败于阿尔茹巴罗塔，阿维斯的若昂即位，开阿维斯王朝，1386年《温莎条约》立英格兰长期同盟。1415年取休达开海外帝国：航海家恩里克与其后继者推动下，迪亚士1488年绕好望角，达伽马1498年抵印度，卡布拉尔1500年宣布占有巴西，果阿、马六甲、澳门继之。

1578年塞巴斯蒂安战死阿尔卡塞尔·基比尔，引来1580年西葡合并，1640年布拉干萨的若昂四世复国，复国战争至1668年。

en:
Powis was the marcher lordship that grew out of southern Powys, or Powys Wenwynwyn, one of the last Welsh principalities. Its seat at Welshpool was unusual among Welsh castles in having been founded by a Welsh prince, Gruffydd ap Gwenwynwyn, an ally of Edward I; the principality was abolished by the Parliament of Shrewsbury in 1283, and his son Owen became the first Lord of Powis.

When Owen's male line failed, his heiress Hawys the Hardy married the knight John Charlton in 1309, who built up Powis Castle. In June 1337 Edward III made Charlton Chief Justiciar of Ireland. His descendants held the lordship until 1421, when it passed through an heiress to the Grey family.

The Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 to 1542 folded the lordship into Montgomeryshire. The Herberts later bought Powis Castle.
zh:
波伊斯是由南波伊斯（又称波伊斯温温温）演化而来的边境领主领，后者是最后存续的威尔士小邦之一。其威尔士浦治所颇为特殊，城堡由爱德华一世的盟友、威尔士亲王格鲁菲德·阿普·格温温温所筑；1283年什鲁斯伯里议会废除了该亲王国，格鲁菲德之子欧文成为第一代波伊斯勋爵。

欧文男嗣断绝后，女继承人“刚毅者”哈维斯于1309年嫁给骑士约翰·查尔顿，查尔顿扩建了波伊斯城堡。1337年6月，爱德华三世任命他为爱尔兰首席司法官。其后裔一直领有该领主领到1421年，后经女继承人转入格雷家族。

1535至1542年的《威尔士法案》把领主领并入蒙哥马利郡。赫伯特家族后来买下波伊斯城堡。

en:
The Potiguara are an indigenous people of northeastern Brazil, associated with the coast of Paraíba and Rio Grande do Norte. Their name has been interpreted as meaning shrimp-eaters.

During the Dutch invasion of Brazil, indigenous people fought on both sides. The Potiguara leader Antônio Filipe Camarão commanded an indigenous regiment for Portugal from 1630 and led the right flank at the first battle of Guararapes in 1648; he died later that year.
zh:
波蒂瓜拉是巴西东北部的原住民，与帕拉伊巴和北里奥格兰德的海岸地区相关。他们的名称被解释为“食虾者”。

荷兰入侵巴西期间，原住民在双方军队中作战。波蒂瓜拉首领安东尼奥·菲利佩·卡马朗自1630年起率领原住民部队为葡萄牙作战，并在1648年第一次瓜拉拉佩斯战役中指挥右翼；他于同年去世。

en: The Ppanka, or Ponca, were a Dhegiha-speaking people who lived near the confluence of the Niobrara and Missouri rivers. Around 1700 they built the fortified village of Nanza in present-day Nebraska. A smallpox epidemic devastated the Ponca after a trading post was established there in 1789; in 1824 Lakota attackers killed most of their leaders.
zh: 潘卡人是讲德吉哈语的族群，居住在奈厄布拉拉河与密苏里河汇合处附近。约1700年，他们在今内布拉斯加州修建了设防村庄南扎。1789年当地建立贸易站后，一场天花疫情重创潘卡人；1824年，拉科塔袭击者杀死了他们的大多数首领。

en:
Papantla was a Totonac town in the northern Veracruz lowlands, in the heart of the region called Totonacapan. It was founded around the year 1200 by Totonac groups, some displaced southward by Chichimec raiders and others drifting in from the fallen Classic city of El Tajín, and in the pre-Hispanic period it belonged to the league of Totonacapan towns headed by Tuzapan.

Its Nahuatl name means the place of the papanes, a kind of crow, and the surrounding forests were already famed for vanilla, which grows wild there. The armies of Moctezuma II conquered Papantla and attached it to the Aztec tributary province of Tochpan.

After the Spanish conquest it was refounded and became the administrative seat of the whole Totonacapan region, while vanilla gathered in its woods became one of New Spain's most prized exports to Europe.
zh:
帕潘特兰是韦拉克鲁斯北部低地的托托纳克城镇，地处托托纳卡潘地区的核心。它约于1200年由托托纳克各部建立：其中一些人是受奇奇梅克人袭扰而南迁至此，另一些则来自已经衰亡的古典期名城埃尔塔欣；在前西班牙时代，它属于以图萨潘为首的托托纳卡潘城镇联盟。

其纳瓦特尔语名字意为“帕潘鸟（一种乌鸦）之地”，周围森林自古盛产天然香草。莫克特苏马二世的军队征服帕潘特兰后，将其并入阿兹特克帝国的托奇潘纳贡省。

西班牙征服后此地得以重建，成为西班牙人管辖整个托托纳卡潘地区的治所，当地出产的香草也成为新西班牙输往欧洲的珍贵货物之一。

en:
The Passamaquoddy were an Algonquian-speaking people of Passamaquoddy Bay and the St. Croix River, in present-day Maine and New Brunswick. They hunted inland in winter and gathered on the coast and islands in summer to harvest fish and shellfish.

In 1604 Samuel de Champlain established a French post on St. Croix Island in Passamaquoddy territory. The Passamaquoddy became part of the Wabanaki Confederacy, and from the nineteenth century European settlers repeatedly displaced them from their lands.
zh:
帕萨马科迪人说阿尔冈昆语，居住在今缅因州和新不伦瑞克的帕萨马科迪湾及圣克罗伊河一带。他们冬季在内陆狩猎，夏季聚居于海岸和岛屿，捕捞鱼类与贝类。

1604年，萨缪尔·德·尚普兰在帕萨马科迪人的领地内，于圣克罗伊岛建立法国据点。帕萨马科迪人后来成为瓦巴纳基联盟的成员；从19世纪起，欧洲移民屡次将他们逐出故地。

en:
The Pequot were an Indigenous people of Connecticut who came to dominate much of the region before the English colonies expanded there. The Mohegan separated from them and became rivals. In the Pequot War of 1636–1638, English colonists and their Narragansett and Mohegan allies defeated the Pequot; at Mystic, they burned a fortified village and killed its inhabitants.

The Treaty of Hartford in 1638 attempted to suppress Pequot identity, and survivors were dispersed or enslaved. Pequot communities later received reservations at Mashantucket in 1666 and the Pawcatuck River in 1683.
zh:
佩科特人是康涅狄格的原住民，在英国殖民地向当地扩张前曾控制该地区的广大土地。莫希根人从他们当中分出，成为对手。1636—1638年的佩科特战争中，英国殖民者及其纳拉甘西特和莫希根盟友击败佩科特人；在米斯蒂克，他们焚毁了一座设防村落并杀害居民。

1638年的《哈特福德条约》试图抹除佩科特人的身份，幸存者四散或沦为奴隶。此后佩科特社群分别于1666年和1683年在马尚塔基特及波卡塔克河畔获得保留地。

en:
Prato is a Tuscan town north of Florence, on the river Bisenzio. It grew from tenth-century villages united under the Alberti family, who held the imperial title of Counts of Prato and harnessed the river to drive fulling mills for the wool trade.

After the troops of Matilde of Canossa besieged the town in 1107, the Alberti withdrew and Prato developed as a free commune, reaching some fifteen thousand inhabitants within two centuries on the strength of its textile industry and the pilgrimage cult of the Holy Belt relic. In 1313, to check the expansion of Florence, the commune placed itself under Robert of Anjou, King of Naples, whose lordship still held in 1337.

On 23 February 1351 Queen Joanna I of Naples sold Prato to Florence for 17,500 gold florins. Its separate political life thus ended.
zh:
普拉托是托斯卡纳的城镇，位于佛罗伦萨以北的比森齐奥河畔。它由10世纪的若干村落合并而成，统于阿尔贝蒂家族之下；该家族保有皇帝册封的普拉托伯爵头衔，并利用河水驱动缩绒机发展羊毛业。

1107年卡诺莎的玛蒂尔达的军队围城后，阿尔贝蒂家族撤走，普拉托发展为自由公社，凭借纺织业和圣腰带圣物的朝圣崇拜，在两百年内人口达到约一万五千。1313年，为抵御佛罗伦萨的扩张，公社主动归附那不勒斯国王安茹的罗伯特，1337年时仍在其统治之下。

1351年2月23日，那不勒斯女王乔万娜一世以17500金弗罗林的价格把普拉托卖给佛罗伦萨。它的独立政治生涯就此结束。

en:
The County of Perche was a wooded frontier land between Normandy and Maine, centred on the Huisne valley, with Bellême as its historical capital. The rival houses of Talvas and Rotrou fought over it until Rotrou III seized Bellême in 1114 and took the title count of Perche in 1126.

The Rotrou counts won fame on crusade, Rotrou IV dying at the siege of Acre in 1191; when the last of the line, William II, bishop of Châlons, died in 1226, Perche reverted to the crown, which carved the county of Alençon out of its lands. In 1286 it went to Charles of Valois, whose son Charles II held both lands, ruling them in 1337 before falling at Crécy in 1346.

English partisans plundered it during the Hundred Years' War, and when the last Valois duke of Alençon died childless in 1525, Perche returned to the royal domain.
zh:
佩尔什伯国是诺曼底与曼恩之间一片森林密布的边地，以于讷河谷为中心，贝莱姆是它的历史首府。塔尔瓦和罗特鲁两大家族长期争夺此地，直到罗特鲁三世于1114年吞并贝莱姆，并在1126年采用佩尔什伯爵的称号。

罗特鲁家族的伯爵在十字军中声名远播，罗特鲁四世1191年死于阿卡围城战；末代领主沙隆主教纪尧姆二世于1226年死去，佩尔什重归王室，王室从其土地划出阿朗松伯国。1286年，佩尔什被封给瓦卢瓦的查理，其子查理二世兼领两地，1337年时正由他统治，后于1346年战死克雷西。

百年战争中英格兰盟军洗劫伯国；末代瓦卢瓦系阿朗松公爵于1525年无嗣而终，佩尔什此后收归王室领地。

en:
The Principality of Pronsk was an appanage of the Principality of Ryazan, centered on the fortified town of Pronsk, which existed from the twelfth to the fifteenth century. It passed repeatedly between rival branches of the Ryazan line of the Rurik dynasty, and its princes often pursued their own diplomacy: in 1427 Prince Ivan Vladimirovich of Pronsk entered Lithuanian service.

After long friction with Ryazan, the appanage was reabsorbed in 1483 during the regency of Anna of Ryazan, acting with the agreement of her brother Ivan III of Moscow. Early in the sixteenth century the surviving Pronsk princes transferred into Muscovite service, and their lands were absorbed into the Russian state.
zh:
普龙斯克公国是梁赞公国的封邑，以要塞城镇普龙斯克为中心，存在于12至15世纪。它在留里克王朝梁赞支系的不同分支之间几经易手，其王公也常自行开展外交：1427年普龙斯克王公伊凡·弗拉基米罗维奇转入立陶宛服役。

在与梁赞长期摩擦之后，1483年梁赞的安娜摄政期间，经其兄莫斯科的伊凡三世同意，该封邑被梁赞重新吞并。16世纪初，尚存的普龙斯克王公转入莫斯科服役，他们的领地也被并入俄罗斯国家。

en:
Perm, known in the chronicles as Great Perm, was the land of the Komi peoples along the upper Kama River, stretching from the Pechora to the western slopes of the Urals, with its chief market town at Cherdyn. The Novgorod chronicle first names the Kama Permians in 1324, and Novgorod long claimed their fur tribute though its hold was loose; Arab geographers and Norse sagas of Bjarmaland had earlier heard of this wealthy forest land.

In 1337 local Komi princes still ruled, keeping their ancestral beliefs while juggling Novgorodian, Tatar and Muscovite pressure. Christianity first reached the related Vychegda Komi through Stephen of Perm, who created an alphabet for their language and became bishop at Ust-Vym in the 1380s, but Great Perm itself stayed pagan for another century, and Bishop Pitirim was killed by raiding Mansi in 1455.

Moscow appointed its own prince at Cherdyn in 1451 and took over Novgorod's claims in 1471. It fully absorbed the principality in 1505.
zh:
彼尔姆在史书中称大彼尔姆，是科米诸族在卡马河上游的土地，北起伯朝拉河，东抵乌拉尔山西坡，中心集镇是切尔登。诺夫哥罗德编年史1324年首次提到卡马河的彼尔姆人，诺夫哥罗德长期索取毛皮贡赋而控制松散；阿拉伯地理学者和讲述比亚尔马兰的北欧萨迦更早听闻这片富庶林地。

1337年它仍由本地科米王公统治，居民坚守祖传信仰，在诺夫哥罗德、鞑靼和莫斯科之间周旋。基督教最先传入亲缘相近的维切格达科米人：彼尔姆的斯捷潘为其语言创制文字，14世纪80年代成为乌斯季维姆主教，但大彼尔姆本地又过一个世纪仍未皈依，1455年主教皮季里姆在曼西人袭掠中被杀。

1451年莫斯科向切尔登派出自己的王公，1471年接管诺夫哥罗德的权利。1505年公国被正式吞并。

en:
Provence was the Mediterranean fief between the Rhône, Alps and sea, its court at Aix, wealth in Marseille. Once Roman Provincia and then Burgundian, it became an imperial fief in 1032; Count William the Liberator drove Fraxinetum's Saracens out at Tourtour in 973. In 1112 the heiress Douce I married Ramon Berenguer III of Barcelona, opening Catalan rule, as Marseille and Arles traded with Pisa and Genoa.

In 1246 the last Catalan countess Beatrice married Charles of Anjou, the French king's brother, so in 1337 Robert the Wise of Naples held Provence. His descendant Joanna I adopted Louis of Anjou in 1380; her death two years later sparked the Union of Aix war, when Nice and the eastern valleys submitted to Savoy in 1388.

The second Angevin line ended with the art-loving Good King René in 1480; his nephew Charles bequeathed Provence to Louis XI in 1481, and union with the crown became definitive in 1486. Its estates and privileges lasted until the 1790 Revolution split it into departments.
zh:
普罗旺斯是罗讷河、阿尔卑斯山与地中海之间的封建领地，朝廷驻艾克斯，财富在马赛。曾为罗马行省、后归勃艮第，1032年成帝国封地；973年解放者威廉伯爵在图尔图尔赶走弗拉克西内图姆撒拉森人。1112年女继承人杜丝一世嫁巴塞罗那的拉蒙·贝伦格尔三世，开加泰罗尼亚统治，马赛、阿尔勒与比萨、热那亚通商。

1246年末代加泰罗尼亚女伯爵贝阿特丽切嫁法王胞弟安茹的查理，1337年那不勒斯贤王罗伯特领其地。其后裔乔万娜一世1380年收养安茹的路易，两年后去世引发艾克斯联盟战争，尼斯与东部山谷1388年归附萨伏依。

第二个安茹支系终结于热爱艺术的贤王勒内1480年之死；其侄查理1481年把伯国遗赠路易十一，1486年永久并入王冠。等级会议与特权延至1790年革命划省。

en:
Mandore, the ancient Mandavyapura north of Jodhpur, was the seat of a Pratihara dynasty from the sixth century. The Pratiharas ruled the surrounding Marwar country until their kingdom was absorbed into the Pratihara empire of Kannauj in the ninth century.

When it broke apart, a surviving branch retained Mandore as a Rajput chiefdom through the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries under Delhi Sultanate pressure. To win an ally against the Tughluqs, its raja married his daughter to the Rathore chief Rao Chunda and in 1395 gave the fortress of Mandore itself as her dowry, and the Pratihara line was absorbed into the Rathore state.

Mandore served as the Rathore capital until Rana Kumbha of Mewar seized it in 1438; Rao Jodha recovered it only in 1453. Six years later he built nearby the Mehrangarh fort and founded Jodhpur, leaving Mandore as Marwar's royal cremation ground.
zh:
曼多尔古称曼达维亚普拉，在今焦特布尔以北，6世纪起便是波罗提诃罗王朝的治所。波罗提诃罗人统治周围的马尔瓦尔地区，9世纪其王国并入卡瑙杰的波罗提诃罗帝国。

帝国瓦解后，其一支作为拉杰普特首领政权据守曼多尔，熬过13至14世纪，始终承受着德里苏丹国的重压。为结交盟友对抗图格鲁克王朝，当地罗阇把女儿嫁给拉托尔首领拉奥·琼达，1395年更以曼多尔堡本身作为嫁妆，波罗提诃罗世系就此并入拉托尔政权。

曼多尔随后成为拉托尔人的都城，1438年被梅瓦尔的拉纳·昆巴夺取，拉奥·乔达直到1453年才将其收复。六年后他在附近修建梅兰加尔堡、兴建焦特布尔，曼多尔成为马尔瓦尔君主的王家火葬地。

en:
Prussia emerged from the Teutonic Order's lands on the Baltic. In 1525 Grand Master Albert adopted Lutheranism and secularized the order's remaining Prussian territory as a duchy, held from the Polish crown and governed from Königsberg.

The Hohenzollern electors of Brandenburg inherited the duchy in 1618 and secured sovereignty over it in 1657. In 1701 Frederick I crowned himself King in Prussia; Berlin became the capital of a kingdom that grew into a European power under Frederick the Great, who fought Austria and its allies in the Seven Years' War of 1756–1763.
zh:
普鲁士兴起于条顿骑士团在波罗的海沿岸的领地。1525年，大团长阿尔布雷希特改信路德宗，将骑士团在普鲁士剩余的领土世俗化为公国，以柯尼斯堡为中心，受封于波兰王室。

勃兰登堡的霍亨索伦家族选帝侯于1618年继承公国，并于1657年取得其主权。1701年腓特烈一世自加冕为在普鲁士的国王；柏林成为王国首都。腓特烈大帝在位时，普鲁士成为欧洲强国，并在1756—1763年的七年战争中与奥地利及其盟友交战。

en:
The Peruzzi were a Florentine banking and merchant family. By the 1330s their company had fifteen branches stretching from London to the Middle East, trading in goods including grain and lending to clients such as Edward III of England.

The Peruzzi consortium collapsed in 1343 and was bankrupt by 1345, amid wars and disruption to trade that also affected the Bardi. The family nevertheless retained wealth and standing in Florence after the bank's failure.
zh:
佩鲁齐是佛罗伦萨的银行家和商人家族。到14世纪30年代，家族公司拥有15处分支，从伦敦延伸到中东；公司经营粮食等货物，也向英格兰国王爱德华三世等客户放贷。

佩鲁齐财团于1343年垮台，到1345年破产；当时的战争和贸易中断也影响了巴尔迪家族。银行倒闭后，佩鲁齐家族仍在佛罗伦萨保有财富和地位。

en:
Pasai, also called Samudera Pasai, was a Muslim sultanate on the north coast of Sumatra, its port near Lhokseumawe. Merah Silu founded it in 1267, converted to Islam and took the name Malik ul Salih; his 1297 tomb is among the earliest evidence of Islam in the Indonesian archipelago.

One of the region's first Muslim kingdoms, it grew rich after Srivijaya's collapse drew Indian Ocean merchants to the Bay of Sumatra, its hinterland supplying pepper from the early fifteenth century. In 1345 Ibn Battuta stayed as the sultan's guest and found a Shafi'i ruler at the easternmost land of Islam.

By the late fourteenth century it was a wealthy commercial centre, though Majapahit sacked it mid-century and Malacca soon overtook it. The Portuguese seized it in 1521 and left in 1524, whereupon Ali Mughayat Syah of Aceh annexed it.
zh:
八昔又称苏木都剌·八昔，是苏门答腊北岸的穆斯林苏丹国，港近洛克司马威。它建于1267年，建立者梅拉·西鲁改宗后改名马利克·萨利赫；其1297年的墓碑是伊斯兰教传入印尼群岛最早的物证之一。

它是当地最早的穆斯林王国之一，室利佛逝崩溃后，印度洋商人转向苏门答腊湾，八昔逐渐致富，腹地从15世纪初开始出产胡椒。1345年伊本·白图泰作为苏丹客人在此停留，见到沙斐仪派统治者，当时这里是伊斯兰世界最东端的土地。

14世纪末它已是富庶的商业中心，但世纪中叶曾遭满者伯夷洗劫，贸易地位随后被马六甲超过。1521年葡萄牙人攻占该港，1524年撤军，亚齐的阿里·穆哈亚特·沙随即将它并入亚齐苏丹国。

en: The Piscataway were an Algonquian-speaking people whose settlements lay along the north bank of the Potomac in present-day southern Maryland. By 1600 their authority extended over some Patuxent River villages. In 1640 the Jesuit Andrew White translated a Catholic catechism into their language; colonial violence and population decline later scattered Piscataway communities.
zh: 皮斯卡塔韦人是阿尔冈昆语族人群，其聚落分布在今马里兰州南部的波托马克河北岸。到1600年，他们的势力延及帕塔克森特河沿岸的一些村落。1640年，耶稣会士安德鲁·怀特将天主教教理问答译成皮斯卡塔韦语；此后殖民暴力和人口下降使皮斯卡塔韦社群流散。

en:
Pskov, formally styled Lord Pskov, was a merchant city-state on the Velikaya River near the Livonian frontier, governing itself through a popular assembly, the veche. Long a self-ruling borough of Novgorod with dependent towns such as Izborsk, it won fame defending Rus' against the Livonian Order, above all under Prince Daumantas, whose victory at Rakvere in 1268 opened a long period of autonomy.

In 1327 the city gave sanctuary to exiled Prince Alexander Mikhailovich of Tver and made him its prince; he still ruled in 1337, when he left for the Golden Horde to seek his old throne. The Treaty of Bolotovo in 1348 ended Novgorod's rights over Pskov and confirmed its independence, and its Pskov Judicial Charter became a foundation of later Russian law.

Hard pressed by the Teutonic and Livonian knights, the republic accepted Moscow's suzerainty from 1399 and was finally annexed by Vasily III in 1510.
zh:
普斯科夫正式称呼“普斯科夫老爷”，是韦利卡亚河畔、邻近立窝尼亚边境的商业城邦，通过市民大会“韦切”自治。它长期是诺夫哥罗德治下的自治城镇，拥有伊兹博尔斯克等附属城镇；在抵御立窝尼亚骑士团的战争中声望日隆，尤以道曼塔斯王公为著——1268年他在拉克韦雷取胜，开启长期自治。

1327年普斯科夫收留流亡的特维尔王公亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇并奉为本城王公，1337年他仍在任，随后前往金帐汗国谋求恢复旧位。1348年《博洛托沃条约》终结诺夫哥罗德对普斯科夫的权利，确认其独立；《普斯科夫审判宪章》后为俄国法律基石之一。

在条顿与立窝尼亚骑士压力下，共和国自1399年起接受莫斯科宗主权，1510年被瓦西里三世吞并。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Passau was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire seated at the meeting of the Danube, Inn and Ilz rivers, on the site of the Roman colony of Batavis. Saint Boniface erected the diocese in 739. In 999 Bishop Christian received from Emperor Otto III rights of market, coinage and jurisdiction, and the bishops thereafter ruled as princes of the Empire.

A townspeople's rising in 1298 won a charter, yet Passau never became a free city and remained under its bishop. In 1320 Pope John XXII appointed Albert of Saxony, an Askanier, to the see; he still ruled in 1337.

During the Reformation Bishop Ernest of Bavaria kept the Bavarian part Catholic while Lutheranism spread in Austrian lands, and the Peace of Passau was concluded there in 1552. In 1803 the prince-bishopric was secularized and the city of Passau fell to Bavaria.
zh:
帕绍采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，治所位于多瑙河、因河与伊尔茨河汇流处、罗马殖民地巴塔维斯的旧址上。教区由圣波尼法爵于739年建立。999年主教克里斯蒂安从皇帝奥托三世手中取得市场、铸币和司法等权利，此后主教以帝国亲王身份统治。

1298年市民起义，换来一份特许状，但帕绍始终没有成为自由市，仍受主教管辖。1320年教宗约翰二十二世任命阿斯坎尼家族萨克森的阿尔贝特为主教，1337年仍由他在任。

宗教改革时期，主教巴伐利亚的恩斯特使巴伐利亚部分保持天主教，路德宗却在奥地利领地传播；1552年在此缔结《帕绍条约》。1803年采邑主教区被世俗化，帕绍城划归巴伐利亚。

en:
Pistoia, the Roman Pistoria on the Via Cassia, was the place where the conspirator Catiline was killed in 62 BC; from the fifth century it was a bishopric, and under the Lombards it was a privileged royal city. Its great age began in 1177, when it proclaimed itself a free commune.

A Ghibelline town, it was conquered by Guelph Florence in 1254 and then torn by the feuds of Black and White Guelphs, so violent that Dante placed the Pistoian Vanni Fucci among the thieves of his Inferno.

Early in the fourteenth century the former abbot Ormanno Tedici made himself lord of the city, but his nephew Filippo sold Pistoia to Castruccio Castracani of Lucca. Florentine rule then returned. It was made permanent in 1530 when Florence formally annexed the town.
zh:
皮斯托亚即古罗马的皮斯托里亚，地处卡西亚大道旁，叛乱者喀提林于公元前62年在此附近被杀；5世纪起它成为主教座所在地，伦巴第时代又是享有特权的王城。它的鼎盛时代始于1177年，当时它宣布成为自由市镇。

作为吉伯林派城市，它在1254年被归尔夫派的佛罗伦萨征服，此后又被归尔夫派黑党与白党的仇杀撕裂，争斗之烈使但丁在《地狱篇》里把皮斯托亚人万尼·符契置于窃贼之中。

14世纪初，还俗修道院长奥尔马诺·泰迪奇自立为城市之主，但他的侄子菲利波把皮斯托亚卖给了卢卡的卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼。佛罗伦萨的统治随后恢复。1530年佛罗伦萨正式吞并该城，统治成为永久性的。

en:
Simmern was a small Hunsrück lordship on the old army road from Bingen to Trier, first recorded in 1072. It passed to the raugraves, who received it as a Trier fief between 1323 and 1330, making it a Trier vassal in 1337. Emperor Louis the Bavarian granted town rights in 1330 with Archbishop Baldwin's support.

Before the fourteenth century ended it passed to the Wittelsbach counts palatine, and the 1410 partition made it the Palatinate-Simmern residence. Duke John II (1509–1557) kept a humanist court and introduced the Reformation; his line inherited the Electoral Palatinate at Heidelberg in 1559.

French troops sacked and burned Simmern on 17 September 1689 during the Nine Years' War, leaving only the church of Saint Stephen and a few towers standing. Rebuilt as a modest Palatine seat, it was annexed by revolutionary France in the 1790s and assigned to Prussia at the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh:
锡门是洪斯吕克山区小领地，在宾根到特里尔的古道上，1072年首见记载，后归劳伯爵；1323至1330年间他们从特里尔大主教区受封锡门，1337年它是特里尔的附庸。1330年经大主教巴尔杜因支持，皇帝路德维希授予它城市权。

14世纪结束前它转入维特尔斯巴赫家族行宫伯爵之手，1410年分封后成为普法尔茨—锡门支系驻地。约翰二世公爵（1509—1557）开人文宫廷、推行宗教改革，该支系1559年又继承海德堡的普法尔茨选侯之位。

1689年9月17日法军在九年战争中洗劫并焚毁锡门，只有圣斯蒂芬教堂和几座塔楼幸存。重建后它只是普通的普法尔茨驻地，18世纪90年代被革命法国吞并，1815年维也纳会议划归普鲁士。

en:
Phetchaburi, whose Sanskrit name means city of diamonds, sits at the northern neck of the Malay Peninsula between the Gulf of Thailand and the Tenasserim hills. In the Dvaravati period it was a seaport on the India–China trade route, until the town was abandoned around the eleventh century.

It was refounded in the twelfth century as Phrip Phri by a prince who came south from the Sukhothai region, and an inscription of about 1204 shows its ruler sending trade missions to China. The town then became a vassal of the rising kingdom of Sukhothai, and it lay on the overland route by which monks travelled between Sukhothai and Sri Lanka to bring back Theravada scriptures.

In 1351 Phetchaburi was incorporated into the new kingdom of Ayutthaya, which kept it as a fortified frontier town on the road to the southern peninsula.
zh:
碧武里，其梵语名字意为钻石之城，坐落在马来半岛北段、泰国湾与丹那沙林山地之间。陀罗钵地时期，它是印度—中国商路上的一处海港，约在11世纪随陀罗钵地文明衰落而被废弃。

12世纪，一位来自素可泰地区的王子南下重建该城，称披里披里；约1204年的一块碑铭显示，当地统治者曾向中国派遣贸易使团。此后该城沦为兴起中的素可泰王国的附庸，又地处素可泰与锡兰之间的陆上通道，僧侣沿这条路线往返，请回上座部佛教经典。

1351年，碧武里被并入新生的阿瑜陀耶王国，后者把它经营为通往南部半岛要道上的设防边镇。

en:
Pate was a Swahili sultanate on the largest island of the Lamu Archipelago off Kenya. The Pate Chronicle holds that the town was re-founded in 1203 by the Nabhani family, Omani Arabs whose dynasty still ruled there in 1337 and claimed kinship with the Nabhani kings of Oman. Archaeological finds show the port tied into Indian Ocean trade by the tenth century.

It rose to prominence in the fourteenth century, vying with Lamu for mastery of the archipelago. The eighteenth century was its golden age: merchants built decorated stone houses, weavers and goldsmiths were famed along the coast, and the royal Yunga palace produced the Utendi wa Tambuka, an early Swahili poem.

Constant wars with its neighbours wore it down, and its bid to subjugate Lamu ended in catastrophe at the Battle of Shela in 1813, when its army and Mombasan allies were almost annihilated.
zh:
帕泰是斯瓦希里人的苏丹国，位于肯尼亚近海拉穆群岛的最大岛屿上。《帕泰编年史》称，来自阿曼的阿拉伯纳巴哈尼家族于1203年重建该城；其王朝到1337年仍在此统治，并自称与阿曼的纳巴哈尼诸王同源。考古发现表明，这座港口10世纪已接入印度洋贸易。

14世纪它声名鹊起，与拉穆争夺群岛主导权。18世纪是它的黄金时代：商人建起装饰精美的石宅，织工和金匠闻名海岸，王室的永加宫殿还诞生了早期斯瓦希里语诗歌《乌滕迪·瓦·坦布卡》。

此后与邻邦连绵的战争耗尽了国力，它征服拉穆的企图在1813年谢拉之战中惨败，帕泰与蒙巴萨盟友的军队几乎全军覆没。

en:
The County of Pitigliano was a small lordship perched on a tufa cliff in southern Tuscany, on the edge of the Sienese Maremma. The site was settled in Etruscan times and is first mentioned in 1061; in the early thirteenth century it belonged to the Aldobrandeschi and became the capital of their county before passing to the Orsini in 1293.

The Orsini were one of Rome's great baronial families and leaders of the Guelph faction, and in 1337 the county was held by Count Guido Orsini. Orsini rule brought a century and a half of intermittent wars with neighbouring Siena, until a settlement of 1455 recognised Pitigliano as a county under Sienese sovereignty.

It later followed Siena into the Grand Duchy of Tuscany, and in 1604 Count Giovanni Antonio Orsini ceded the fief to Grand Duke Ferdinando I de' Medici.
zh:
皮蒂利亚诺伯国是托斯卡纳南部、锡耶纳马雷马边缘一座凝灰岩悬崖上的小领地。此地在伊特鲁里亚时代已有居民，最早见于1061年的文献；13世纪初它属阿尔多布兰代斯基家族，并成为其伯国的都城，1293年转入奥尔西尼家族之手。

奥尔西尼是罗马的大男爵家族之一，为圭尔夫派首领，1337年统治伯国的是圭多·奥尔西尼伯爵。其统治带来了与邻邦锡耶纳长达一个半世纪、时断时续的战争，直到1455年双方达成协议，承认皮蒂利亚诺为伯国，但置于锡耶纳宗主权之下。

它后来随锡耶纳并入托斯卡纳大公国，1604年乔瓦尼·安东尼奥·奥尔西尼伯爵把采邑让给美第奇家族的大公费迪南多一世。

en: Puctlan was a small Nahua polity of the Papaloapan lowlands in central Veracruz, holding the nearby settlement of Nopiloa, whose ancient ceremonial centre belonged to the Classic Veracruz culture. By the fifteenth century the district had been conquered by the Aztecs, and its towns were paying tribute to the Mexica at the Spanish arrival.
zh: 普克特兰是韦拉克鲁斯中部帕帕洛阿潘低地的一个纳瓦小邦，领有附近的诺皮洛阿聚落，那里古老的祭祀中心属于古韦拉克鲁斯文化。到15世纪，这一地区已被阿兹特克征服，西班牙人到来时，当地各镇都在向墨西加纳贡。

en:
Patna, with its early seat at Patnagarh, was the principal Chauhan Rajput kingdom of western Orissa, in the country watered by the Mahanadi. In the early fourteenth century it lay under the loose suzerainty of the Eastern Ganga kings, whose administrator ruled through eight local Gauntia chiefs.

Court chronicles trace the Chauhans to refugees of the Chauhan line of Garh Sambhar near Mainpuri, who fled south after their chief fell fighting Firuz Shah Tughlaq. In 1360 Ramai Deva, then twenty years old, overthrew the eight Gauntias with the backing of the common people and made himself raja, marrying a niece of the Ganga king Bhanu Deva III and building the Patneswari temple at Patnagarh.

His descendants ruled for centuries, cadet branches founding kingdoms such as Sambalpur and Sonepur; in the eighteenth century the Patna rajas became tributaries of the Marathas of Nagpur before passing under British protection.
zh:
巴特那早期以帕特纳加尔为治所，是西奥里萨最主要的乔赫拉杰普特王国，地处默哈讷迪河流域。14世纪初它处在东恒伽诸王松散的宗主权下，由恒伽派驻的官员通过八名地方高恩提亚首领治理。

宫廷史诗把乔汉家族的来历追溯到迈恩布尔附近桑巴尔加尔的乔汉王族：其首领在与菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克作战阵亡后，余部南下。1360年，年方二十的拉马伊·提婆在平民支持下推翻八名高恩提亚自立为王，又娶恒伽王巴努·提婆三世的侄女，并在帕特纳加尔修建帕特内斯瓦里神庙。

他的后裔统治数百年，还分出支系建立了萨姆巴尔普尔、索内普尔等王国；18世纪，巴特那诸王成为那格浦尔马拉塔人的纳贡者，后来又转入英国保护之下。

en:
Pantepec, whose Nahuatl name combines the words for banner and hill, was a small highland polity in the Sierra Norte of Puebla, its main town known as Kachikin in the Totonac tongue. The hill country was first settled by Otomí villagers and later by Totonacs from El Tajín.

In 1120 the Toltec ruler Huemac made Xicotepec, its sister settlement, a señorío; Chichimec tribes held it until Metlaltoyuca retook it in 1162, and around 1325 the Acolhua leader Tlachotla conquered the district and attached it to his lordship.

From 1432 the territory paid tribute in bird feathers to Texcoco, where Nezahualcóyotl installed Quetzalpatzin as its lord. Spaniards occupied it in 1533, and Augustinian friars founded the mission town of San José de Xicotepec two years later.
zh:
潘特佩克的纳瓦特尔语名字由“旗帜”和“山”两个词组成，是普埃布拉北部山区的高地小邦，主要城镇在托托纳克语中叫作卡奇金。这片山地先有奥托米村民定居，后来又有从埃尔塔欣迁来的托托纳克人。

1120年，托尔特克首领韦马克把姊妹聚落希科特佩克变为领地；奇奇梅克诸部占据该地，直到1162年被梅特拉尔托尤卡夺回；约1325年，阿科卢阿首领特拉乔特拉征服该地区，将其并入自己的领地。

1432年起，此地以鸟羽向特斯科科纳贡，内萨瓦尔科约特尔任命克察尔帕辛为领主。1533年西班牙人占领该地，两年后奥古斯丁会修士建立传教城镇圣何塞·德·希科特佩克。

en:
The Pitahwarita were one of the southern bands of the Pawnee, whose villages stood near the rivers of present-day Nebraska. In an account of a late eighteenth-century conflict, they joined the Chaui and Kitkehaki against the Skidi Pawnee.

Around 1830, during a battle against the Cheyenne, a Pitahwarita warrior captured the Cheyenne Sacred Arrows. The Cheyenne then stopped fighting and returned home.
zh:
皮塔瓦里塔人是波尼族的南部分支之一，村落位于今天内布拉斯加州的河流附近。一则关于18世纪末冲突的记述说，他们与乔伊人、基特凯哈基人联手对抗斯基迪波尼人。

约1830年，在与夏延人的一场战斗中，一名皮塔瓦里塔战士夺取了夏延人的神圣之箭。夏延人随即停止战斗，返回自己的领地。

en: Pingtouzheke was a Miao zhangguansi in the Wuluo hills of northeastern Guizhou, within the Yuan-era Sizhou chiefdom. In 1413 the Ming placed it under the new Wuluo Prefecture with three neighbouring offices; when that prefecture was abolished in 1438, it was transferred to Tongren Prefecture, its lands lying around present-day Wuluo in Songtao County.
zh: 平头著可是贵州东北部乌罗山区的苗族长官司，元代属思州土司地界。1413年明朝设置乌罗府，平头著可与乌罗、答意、治古共四个长官司归其管辖；1438年乌罗府废，平头著可改隶铜仁府，辖地当今松桃县乌罗镇一带。

en:
Pua, also called Mueang Pua or the Nan state, was the Tai polity of the upper Nan River valley in present-day Nan province in northern Thailand. The Nan Chronicle traces it to Phukha, whose younger son Khun Fong founded Mueang Pua to rule the local Kao people.

In 1263 Phayao, finding Pua ruled by the queen mother Khamphin alone, stormed and held it for half a century. Her exiled son Phanong returned and was crowned in 1313, restoring independence; in 1338 he joined Khamfu of Chiang Saen in sacking Phayao, after which Pua absorbed its eastern towns. In 1368 the capital moved south to Nan.

Linked to Sukhothai, which repeatedly restored its kings, Pua was conquered by Tilokkaraj of Lan Na in 1449 after an artillery bombardment, becoming a vassal before full annexation in 1461. Its Bo Mang salt wells made it a prized Lan Na possession.
zh:
磨又称勐磨或难国，是泰人在上难河流域建立的政权，位于今泰国北部难府一带。据《难编年史》记载，始祖普卡的幼子坤丰建勐磨，统治当地的卡奥人。

1263年，帕尧王国趁磨由老王后坎芬主政之机攻陷此城，统治达半个世纪。坎芬流亡的儿子帕农重返故土，于1313年加冕，恢复独立；1338年他与清盛的坎富合兵洗劫帕尧，磨随后吞并其东部城镇。1368年，统治者把都城南迁至难城。

磨与素可泰关系密切，素可泰曾多次助其复位；1449年兰纳的滴洛拉以火炮攻城，磨沦为附庸，1461年被彻底兼并。境内博芒的盐井使这里成为兰纳最看重的领地之一。

en:
The Puben people inhabited the valley around present-day Popayán in southwestern Colombia. They farmed, made pottery and worked gold into ornaments; the nearby Cajibío people recognized the authority of the chief Pubén.

Spanish expeditions met resistance near Popayán in 1535, and the city was founded after the local people were subdued in 1537. In 1541 the conquistador Juan de Ampudia was killed in battle against Puben resistance on his way back to Popayán.
zh:
普本人居住在今哥伦比亚西南部波帕扬周边的河谷。他们从事农耕，制作陶器和黄金饰物；附近的卡希比奥人承认普本酋长的权威。

1535年，西班牙远征队在波帕扬附近遭遇抵抗；当地人被征服后，波帕扬城于1537年建立。1541年，征服者胡安·德·安普迪亚在返回波帕扬途中与普本抵抗者交战，被杀身亡。

en: The Pueblo peoples lived in farming communities across the American Southwest, including the Rio Grande valley. In 1680 Pueblo communities rose against Spanish rule in New Mexico and expelled the colonists, who returned twelve years later.
zh: 普韦布洛人生活在北美西南部的农耕村社中，包括格兰德河谷一带。1680年，普韦布洛各村社起义反抗西班牙在新墨西哥的统治，驱逐了殖民者；西班牙人于12年后返回。

en:
Ngāpuhi is a Māori iwi of New Zealand's Northland, centred on Hokianga, the Bay of Islands and Whangārei. Its chief Hongi Hika emerged as a war leader after Ngāpuhi were defeated by Ngāti Whātua at Moremonui in 1808.

Hongi encouraged European settlement and cultivated ties with missionaries to acquire muskets. In the early 19th-century Musket Wars, he used these weapons in campaigns across northern New Zealand; he was wounded at Hokianga in 1827 and died at Whangaroa in 1828.
zh:
雅普依是新西兰北地的毛利部族，主要分布在霍基昂加、岛屿湾和旺阿雷。1808年雅普依在莫雷莫努伊被雅提法图阿击败后，首领洪伊·希卡成为部族的军事领袖。

洪伊鼓励欧洲人定居，并与传教士建立关系以获取火枪。19世纪初的火枪战争中，他用这些武器在新西兰北部各地征战；1827年他在霍基昂加受伤，1828年在旺阿罗阿去世。

en:
Pukamuru, also called Bracamoros, was a name applied to Indigenous groups in the Amazonian river valleys of present-day southern Ecuador and northern Peru. An Inca army failed to occupy the area around 1520, according to the chronicler Pedro Cieza de León.

Spanish expeditions followed in the 1530s, and from 1549 the inhabitants were assigned to Spanish encomiendas. Forced labor and disease sharply reduced their numbers by 1606.
zh:
普卡穆鲁又称布拉卡莫罗斯，是今厄瓜多尔南部和秘鲁北部亚马孙河流域多个原住民群体的名称。据编年史作者佩德罗·谢萨·德·莱昂记载，一支印加军队约于1520年试图占领该地区，但未能成功。

西班牙探险队于16世纪30年代进入当地，从1549年起居民被划入西班牙人的监护征赋区。到1606年，强迫劳动和疾病使当地人口大幅减少。

en:
Punjab became the center of a Sikh kingdom under Ranjit Singh, who captured Lahore in 1799 and was crowned there in 1801. He united the Sikh misls, the regional warrior confederacies, and made Lahore his capital.

By 1813 Ranjit Singh had annexed the remaining misls; his forces took Multan from Afghan rule in 1818 and later conquered Kashmir and Peshawar. He modernized his army with new training, weapons and artillery, while his government included Sikhs, Muslims and Hindus.
zh:
旁遮普在兰季德·辛格治下成为锡克王国的中心；他于1799年夺取拉合尔，1801年在那里加冕。他统一了当地的锡克武装联盟，即米斯尔，并以拉合尔为都。

到1813年，兰季德·辛格已兼并其余米斯尔；他的军队于1818年从阿富汗人手中夺取木尔坦，后来又征服克什米尔和白沙瓦。他以新式训练、武器和火炮改造军队，政府中则有锡克教徒、穆斯林和印度教徒任职。

en:
Purang was a Himalayan kingdom centered on Purang in western Tibet, in the valleys south of Mount Kailash. After the Tibetan Empire's ninth-century collapse, the royal scion Kyide Nyimagon fled to Ngari and founded a kingdom around 925 that his sons divided into Maryul, Guge and Purang; Purang became separate from Guge in 1072 and kept close ties with the Yatse polity to the south.

In 1252 and 1253 Mangyul Gungthang, backed by the Sakyapa order, defeated Purang and Yatse, after which Purang accepted Mongol-Yuan overlordship. Towards the end of the fourteenth century the Purang-Yatse polity collapsed and was absorbed by Guge.

When Ladakh conquered Guge in 1630 Purang passed under Ladakhi rule, until a Ganden Podrang army retook Ngari in the 1680s and brought Purang under the administration of central Tibet.
zh:
布让是西藏西部、冈仁波齐峰以南山谷中的喜马拉雅小王国，以布让为中心。9世纪吐蕃帝国崩溃后，王室后裔吉德尼玛衮逃往阿里，约在925年建立政权；他死后诸子把王国分为麻域、古格和布让三部，布让于1072年独立于古格，并与南方的亚泽政权关系密切。

1252—1253年，萨迦派支持的芒隅贡塘王国击败布让与亚泽，布让随后接受蒙古元朝的宗主权。14世纪末，布让—亚泽政权瓦解，被古格吞并。

1630年拉达克征服古格，布让转归拉达克统治；17世纪80年代，甘丹颇章的军队收复阿里，布让纳入西藏地方政府的管辖。

en:
The Puruhá peoples inhabited the Andean highlands of present-day Ecuador, especially Chimborazo. Their local chiefs governed their own communities and met in a common assembly over matters affecting them all.

The Incas took over the region in the 15th century, introducing Quechua. After the Spanish conquest, disease caused heavy population losses; by the 18th century few speakers of Puruhá remained.
zh:
普鲁哈诸族居住在今厄瓜多尔的安第斯高地，尤其是钦博拉索地区。各地酋长分别统治自己的社群，遇到共同事务时则举行大会商议。

15世纪印加人占领这一地区，带来了克丘亚语。西班牙征服后，疾病造成大量人口死亡；到18世纪，会说普鲁哈语的人已所剩无几。

en:
Powys was a Welsh kingdom that emerged after Roman rule, encompassing the Severn valley and lands east of the Cambrian Mountains. In 1160, after Madog ap Maredudd died, it split into northern and southern principalities.

The northern branch, Powys Fadog, ruled from Dinas Brân. Its prince Madog II submitted to England in 1277, and his castle was burned before English troops could capture it; he died fighting alongside Llywelyn ap Gruffudd later that year.
zh:
波伊斯是罗马统治结束后出现的威尔士王国，领土包括塞文河谷和坎布里亚山脉以东的地区。1160年马多格·阿普·马雷迪德去世后，王国分裂为南北两个公国。

北部的波伊斯法多格以迪纳斯布兰为统治中心。1277年，其亲王马多格二世向英格兰臣服；英军攻占城堡之前，守军已将其焚毁。同年晚些时候，马多格与卢埃林·阿普·格里菲德并肩作战时阵亡。

en:
Píngyuè was a Miao chieftaincy in the hills of central Guizhou, seated at the town of present-day Fuquan. In 1283 the Yuan court organized it as the Pingyue military and civilian chief's office, one of the native posts created after pacifying the Nine Streams and Eighteen Caves.

The Ming reached it in 1381 and replaced native rule with guard posts: a defense battalion in 1381, the Pingyue Guard in 1383, and a military-civilian guard command in 1385.

After the suppression of the Bozhou rebellion in 1600, the Pingyue military and civilian prefecture was set up in 1601 on former Bozhou lands, ruling two guards, one department and two chief's offices under Guizhou. In 1798 the Qing court abolished the prefecture and replaced it with the independent department of Pingyue.
zh:
平越是贵州中部山区的苗人土司，治所在今福泉市一带。1283年，元朝将其编为平越军民长官司，是平定九溪十八洞后设立的土职之一。

1381年明军进入此地，朝廷逐步以卫所取代土官：当年设守御千户所，1383年置平越卫，1385年升为军民指挥使司。

1600年播州之乱平定后，1601年于卫城置平越军民府，隶贵州布政司，以播州旧地益之，领二卫、一州、二长官司。1798年，清朝裁府改置平越直隶州。

en:
Pereyaslavl-Zalessky was a Rus' principality centred on the town beside Lake Pleshcheyevo. Founded by Yuri of Vladimir in 1152, the town became a princely seat in 1175; in 1302 its childless prince Ivan died and Moscow inherited it.

Mongol attacks repeatedly devastated Pereyaslavl into the early fifteenth century, and Polish forces damaged it in 1611–1612. In 1688–1693 Peter the Great built his small flotilla on Lake Pleshcheyevo.
zh:
佩列斯拉夫尔‑扎列斯基是罗斯的一个公国，以普列谢耶沃湖畔的城镇为中心。弗拉基米尔的尤里于1152年建立此城，1175年它成为公国治所；1302年伊凡公爵去世且无子嗣，莫斯科继承了这片领地。

蒙古军队多次劫掠佩列斯拉夫尔，直至15世纪初；1611—1612年，波兰军队又使城市遭到破坏。1688—1693年，彼得大帝在普列谢耶沃湖上建造了他的小型舰队。

en:
The Q'anjob'al are a Maya people of the Sierra de los Cuchumatanes in Huehuetenango, western Guatemala, whose highland towns include Jolom Konob, the present-day Santa Eulalia, Tz'uluma' or San Pedro Soloma, and Yich K'ox or Juan Ixcoy.

Their own traditions relate a migration from the lowlands of Chiapas into the mountains, where sacred sites and archaeological remains show long pre-Columbian settlement. They speak the Q'anjob'al language and lived in autonomous mountain communities with their own agricultural and ritual calendars.

After Gonzalo de Alvarado took the Mam capital of Zaculeu in 1525, Spanish expeditions pushed into the Cuchumatanes, but the rugged highlands made submission gradual and many families withdrew into remoter valleys rather than accept colonial towns, tribute and missionary rule. Q'anjob'al speech and custom nevertheless survived the upheaval of the conquest.
zh:
坎霍瓦尔人是玛雅人的一支，聚居于危地马拉西部韦韦特南戈省的库丘马塔内斯山脉，霍洛姆科诺布（今圣埃乌拉利亚）、察乌鲁马（圣佩德罗索洛马）和伊奇科什（胡安伊斯科伊）都是其山城。

据本族口传，他们从恰帕斯低地迁入这片高地，境内的圣地与考古遗迹证明其在前哥伦布时代早已定居。他们讲坎霍瓦尔语，以自治村社为单位生活，保有自己的农事与祭祀历法。

1525年贡萨洛·德·阿尔瓦拉多攻占曼姆人的都城萨库莱乌后，西班牙远征军深入库丘马坦山区，但险峻地形令征服进程缓慢，许多家族退入更深的山谷，拒绝接受殖民集镇、贡赋和传教统治。历经动荡，坎霍瓦尔的语言与习俗仍在群山中延续。

en:
The Qara Qoyunlu were a Turkoman confederation whose ruling Baharlu family held lands north of Lake Van and around Mosul. About 1375 they became vassals of the Jalayirids, before Qara Yusuf secured their independence.

Driven into exile by Timur in 1400, Qara Yusuf returned after his death and defeated the Timurids at Nakhchivan in 1406 and Sardrud in 1408. The dynasty ruled Azerbaijan and much of western Iran until its rival, the Aq Qoyunlu, overthrew it in 1468.
zh:
黑羊是一个土库曼部落联盟，其统治家族巴哈鲁人在凡湖以北和摩苏尔周边拥有领地。约1375年，黑羊成为札剌亦儿王朝的附庸，后来卡拉·优素福取得了独立。

1400年，帖木儿迫使卡拉·优素福流亡；帖木儿死后，他返回故地，于1406年在纳希切万、1408年在萨德鲁德击败帖木儿王朝。黑羊统治阿塞拜疆和伊朗西部大片地区，直到1468年被对手白羊王朝推翻。

en:
The Qasar horde was the ulus of Jochi Qasar, Genghis Khan's full brother, nicknamed Deft Qasar for his mastery of the bow. As a boy he and Temujin killed their half-brother Behter; after defeat at Khalakhaljid Sands in 1203 he gathered followers in the forests and helped lure the Keraites to destruction.

Genghis allotted him pastures west of the Greater Khingan between the Ergune and Hailar, a smaller ulus than Temüge's; his house later gained estates in Shandong and Jiangxi. His descendants kept an eastern identity: after the Yuan collapse they formed the Fuyu Guard of the 1389 Ming Three Guards along the Nen and Onon, later the Khorchin Mongols.

Their Adai Khan challenged the Four Oirats until he was killed in 1438, and the tribe fought beside Dayan Khan at Dalan Terqin in 1510. In 1624 the Khorchin became the first Mongol tribe to submit to Nurhaci and the rising Qing, whose emperors took Khorchin Borjigin brides, among them Empress Xiaozhuangwen.
zh:
合撒儿汗国是拙赤·合撒儿的兀鲁思。合撒儿是成吉思汗同母弟，因善射号称神箭合撒儿。少年时他与铁木真合力杀死异母弟别克帖儿；1203年合兰真沙陀战败后，他率部众藏入森林，又协助诱歼克烈部。

成吉思汗把大兴安岭以西、额尔古纳河与海拉尔河之间的牧场封给他，其兀鲁思小于铁木哥的封地，后来家族又在山东、江西得到食邑。合撒儿后裔保持东部蒙古身份：元朝灭亡后，他们组成1389年明朝兀良哈三卫中的福余卫，游牧于嫩江与斡难河流域，后发展为科尔沁部。

其阿台汗曾与卫拉特四部抗衡，1438年被杀；该部1510年在达兰·特勤之战中追随达延汗。1624年科尔沁成为第一个归附努尔哈赤与崛起清朝的蒙古部落，清朝皇帝多娶科尔沁孛儿只斤氏女子为后妃，孝庄文皇后即其一。

en: The Quimbaya were Indigenous communities in the Cauca valley of present-day Colombia, organized under local chiefs. Their goldsmiths worked gold and copper into ornaments and vessels, many placed in graves. Quimbaya communities resisted Spanish rule after the conquest reached the region in the 16th century.
zh: 金巴亚是今哥伦比亚考卡河谷的原住民社群，由地方酋长统领。金巴亚工匠以金和铜制作饰品与器皿，许多作品被放入墓葬。16世纪西班牙人征服这一地区后，金巴亚社群曾抵抗其统治。

en:
Qocho, also called Kara-Khoja or Gaochang, was the Uyghur kingdom of the Turpan oasis, founded in 843 by Uyghurs fleeing the Kirghiz destruction of their khaganate. In 866 Pugu Jun took the title idiqut and ruled from winter and summer capitals at Qocho and Beshbalik. The kingdom became a settled Buddhist state whose Bezeklik cave temples preserved its paintings and scriptures, and it paid homage in turn to the Liao dynasty and the Qara Khitai.

In 1209 the idiqut Baurchuk Art Tekin killed the Qara Khitai overseer and submitted to Genghis Khan, after which Uyghur scribes and administrators became the backbone of the Mongol bureaucracy.

Qocho remained a Mongol vassal, aligned with the Yuan against the Chagatai khans, until Chagatai power reached the oases in the fourteenth century and the idiqut's court migrated east into Yuan territory. The last Buddhist Uyghurs of Qocho and Turpan were forcibly converted by the Chagatai khan Khizr Khoja, who campaigned there between 1389 and 1399.
zh:
高昌又称哈拉和卓，是吐鲁番绿洲上的回鹘王国，843年由躲避黠戛斯进攻、从崩溃的回鹘汗国逃来的部众建立。866年仆固俊称亦都护，以高昌为冬都、别失八里为夏都。王国转为定居的佛教国家，柏孜克里克千佛洞保存了它的绘画与经卷，并先后向辽朝和西辽称臣。

1209年，亦都护巴而术·阿而忒·的斤袭杀西辽监国，归降成吉思汗，回鹘书吏和行政人才此后成为蒙古帝国的官僚支柱。

高昌作为蒙古附庸，长期联合元朝对抗察合台诸汗；14世纪察合台势力抵达绿洲后，亦都护朝廷东迁元朝境内。1389—1399年，察合台汗黑的儿火者进军此地，高昌与吐鲁番最后的佛教徒回鹘人被强迫改宗。

en:
The Q'eqchi' were a Maya people whose settlements were concentrated in the highlands of Verapaz, in present-day Guatemala. In 1537 the Dominican friar Bartolomé de las Casas began a campaign to convert the peoples of Verapaz through preaching rather than military conquest.

In 1543 the colonial town of Cobán was founded to resettle Q'eqchi' communities. After a Spanish friar was killed in 1555, the Q'eqchi' leader Juan Matalbatz led a punitive expedition and brought captives back to the Cobán area.
zh:
凯克奇是玛雅人的一支，聚居在今危地马拉的韦拉帕斯高地。1537年，多明我会修士巴托洛梅·德拉斯卡萨斯开始通过传教而非军事征服，使韦拉帕斯各族改宗。

1543年，殖民城镇科万建立，用于安置被迁来的凯克奇人。1555年一名西班牙修士遇害后，凯克奇领袖胡安·马塔尔巴茨率领惩罚性远征，将俘虏带回科万地区。

en: Quigualtam was a Plaquemine culture polity near the Mississippi River, whose chief and principal settlement bore the same name. In 1542–1543, after Hernando de Soto died on the river, his expedition exchanged messages with Quigualtam and fought its warriors in a three-day canoe battle. The Spaniards never visited the chief or his settlement.
zh: 奎瓜尔塔姆是密西西比河附近的普拉克明文化政体，其酋长和主要聚落也叫这个名字。1542—1543年，埃尔南多·德·索托在河畔去世后，他的远征队与奎瓜尔塔姆互通消息，并与其战士在独木舟上交战三天。西班牙人从未拜访这位酋长或他的聚落。

en: Qiongshui was a small Kam tusi chiefdom in eastern Guizhou under the Tian clan of Sizhou. A Qiongshui county had been set up under the Song in 1107, and the Ming reorganized it as the Qiongshui zhangguansi; its seat lies in present-day Sansui County in Qiandongnan.
zh: 邛水是贵州东部的小型侗族土司，隶属思州田氏。其地宋代于1107年设置邛水县，明代改置邛水长官司，治所当今黔东南苗族侗族自治州三穗县一带。

en:
Qahtan is one of the great southern Arab tribal confederations, made up of three main tribes, the Sanhan, the Junb and the Rufaida, and spread across the Asir highlands, the Yemeni borderlands, the Tihama coast and parts of the Najd, its branches including villagers and camel-nomads.

Arab genealogists identify the Qahtan with the southern Arabs, traditionally counted as the original Arabs of Yemen and Hadhramaut, and the name appears on ancient South Arabian inscriptions. It traces its roots to the Kingdom of Kinda and came to prominence under the Umayyad caliphs of 661 to 750, when the blood feud between the southern Yaman tribes and the northern Qays began, a rivalry that flared in Arabian politics for centuries.

Later a section of the Sanhan, the Jahadir, migrated into the Najd and for a while ranked among its powerful tribes before withdrawing to the southern homelands around Tathlith.
zh:
盖哈坦是南方阿拉伯最庞大的部落联盟之一，由桑汉、朱恩布和鲁费达三大部落组成，分布在阿西尔高原、也门边境、帖哈麦沿海及内志部分地区，支系中既有定居村民，也有骆驼游牧民。

阿拉伯谱系学家把盖哈坦视为南方阿拉伯人的代表，传统上认为他们是也门和哈德拉毛的原住民阿拉伯人，其名还见于古代南阿拉伯铭文。联盟根源可追溯到肯德王国时代，在661年至750年的倭马亚哈里发时期崭露头角：当时南方也门诸部与北方盖斯诸部爆发大规模血仇，在此后数百年的阿拉伯政治中反复点燃。

后来桑汉人的一支贾哈德尔人迁入内志，一度跻身当地强部，最终又退回泰斯利特一带的南方故土。

en:
Quiahuiztlan was a fortified Totonac city on the Gulf coast of central Veracruz, raised on the Cerro de los Metates near later Villa Rica. Its Nahuatl name means the place where rain abounds.

After lowland Totonac cities were abandoned, their people withdrew to hilltops, and Quiahuiztlan was laid out with terraces and a ballcourt, serving as a town of as many as fifteen thousand people, fortress and walled cemetery. It was twice subjugated by invaders from the central highlands: the Toltecs around 800, and again by the Aztecs in the early fifteenth century, who imposed the cults of Tlaloc and Huitzilopochtli.

In 1519 Cortés founded Villa Rica de la Vera Cruz below, and at Quiahuiztlan the Spanish sealed an alliance with some thirty Totonac towns opening the way to the conquest of the Aztec Empire. It was abandoned during the conquest and never resettled.
zh:
基亚维斯特兰是韦拉克鲁斯中部湾岸的托托纳克人设防城市，建在梅塔特山高地上，邻近后来的比利亚里卡，纳瓦特尔语名字意为“雨水丰沛之地”。

低地城市被废弃后，居民退守山顶；基亚维斯特兰以台地和球场布局，兼具城镇、要塞和有墙墓地三重功能，居民多达一万五千。它两度被来自中部高原的入侵者征服：先是约800年的托尔特克人，再是15世纪初的阿兹特克人，强制推行特拉洛克与维齐洛波奇特利崇拜。

1519年，科尔特斯在山下海滨建立比利亚里卡·德·拉·韦拉克鲁斯，并在此与约三十个托托纳克城镇缔盟，为征服阿兹特克帝国打开道路。该城在征服期间被废弃，再未恢复人烟。

en: Quiegoqui was a small Mixtec polity centred on Coatlan, in the forested Sierra Sur of Oaxaca on Tututepec's northern frontier. Coatlan was counted among the many towns reduced to tribute by Eight Deer Jaguar Claw, and in the fifteenth century it held out against Tututepec with Aztec military support.
zh: 基耶戈基是以夸特兰为中心的纽萨维小邦，地处瓦哈卡南部林木茂密的山区，位于图图特佩克的北部边境。夸特兰曾被列入鹿八日虎爪征服的纳贡城镇，15世纪时又靠着阿兹特克的军事支持抵御图图特佩克。

en:
The Quimes were a Diaguita people of the Andean valleys of present-day Tucumán in northwestern Argentina. They resisted Inca expansion in the fifteenth century and later fought Spanish colonization during the Calchaquí Wars.

After their defeat in 1665, the Spanish forced the Quimes to march to a settlement near Buenos Aires; many died on the journey. The settlement was abandoned by 1810, and the present city of Quilmes grew near its site.
zh:
基尔梅斯是迪亚吉塔人的一支，居住在今阿根廷西北部图库曼的安第斯山麓河谷。他们在15世纪抵抗印加扩张，后来在查尔查奇战争中对抗西班牙殖民。

1665年战败后，西班牙人迫使基尔梅斯人徒步迁往布宜诺斯艾利斯附近的定居点，许多人死于途中。到1810年，定居点已被废弃，今基尔梅斯市在其附近兴起。

en:
Qujing is a region in eastern Yunnan centred on Nanning on the upper Nanpan River, where the roads from Sichuan and Guizhou enter the province. The Han first placed a county here in 109 BC, and after Zhuge Liang's southern campaign of 225 it became the seat of the Laixiang commandant and the political centre of Nanzhong.

For more than five centuries it was the heartland of the Cuan clan, until Nanzhao overthrew them in 748; under the Dali kingdom the area was organised as Shicheng Commandery, ruling over a dozen local tribes including the Moma.

The Mongols made it Qujing Route, and the Ming and Qing kept Qujing Prefecture with Nanning County as its seat. Ming armies entered Yunnan through Qujing in 1381, after which hereditary tribal chieftains, or tusi, governed the surrounding peoples alongside the prefectural officials.
zh:
曲靖在云南东部，以南盘江上游的南宁城为中心，是四川、贵州入滇的门户。公元前109年汉朝在此设味县；225年诸葛亮南征后，这里成为庲降都督治所，是南中的政治中心。

此后五百多年间，曲靖是爨氏家族的腹地，直到748年南诏攻灭爨氏；大理国时设石城郡，统领磨弥等十余个部落。

元朝改设曲靖路，明、清两代沿置曲靖府，以南宁县为府治。1381年明军经曲靖攻入云南，此后世袭酋长即土司，与流官知府一同治理周边各族。

en:
Quauhquechollan, whose Nahuatl name means the place of eagles and spoonbills, was a Nahua altepetl in the Atlixco valley south of the volcanoes, on the site of Huaquechula in Puebla. Xicalanca and Chichimec groups founded the first settlement around 1110, and Nahua settlers refounded it about 1200.

Caught between the rival powers of the central Mexican highlands, it saw heavy fighting between Tlaxcalteca and Mexica forces in the early sixteenth century, and a son of the Aztec ruler Moctezuma II was killed there. It lay on the Spanish line of march against Tenochtitlan and was granted in encomienda to Jorge de Alvarado in 1524.

Quauhquechollan warriors joined Alvarado's campaign of 1527 to 1529 into Guatemala, and their painters recorded the expedition on the Lienzo de Quauhquechollan, one of the earliest surviving maps of Guatemala and a rare Nahua pictorial account of conquest beyond Mexico.
zh:
夸乌克奇奥兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为鹰与玫瑰琵鹭之地，是火山带以南阿特利斯科谷地的纳瓦人城邦，即今普埃布拉州瓦克丘拉镇的前身。最早聚落约1110年由希卡兰卡人和奇奇梅克人建立，约1200年纳瓦移民又重建。

夹在墨西哥高原诸强之间，16世纪初这里曾是特拉斯卡拉人与墨西加人激战的战场，阿兹特克君主蒙特苏马二世一子战死于此。该城在西班牙人进攻特诺奇蒂特兰的行军路线上，1524年封给豪尔赫·德·阿尔瓦拉多作为委托监护地。

其战士随后参加阿尔瓦拉多1527至1529年远征危地马拉，画师把这段经历绘成《夸乌克奇奥兰布画》，是现存最早的危地马拉地图之一，也是少见的纳瓦人视角记述墨西哥以外征服活动的图画文献。

en:
Quelimane is a Swahili trading town on the Mozambique coast, set on the Rio dos Bons Sinais near the mouths of the Zambezi. Muslim merchants linked to the Kilwa Sultanate made it one of the oldest settlements of the region, and oral tradition numbers it among the coast towns founded by Kilwa refugees late in the fifteenth century. Vasco da Gama reached its river in 1498, and a permanent Portuguese presence began in 1544.

Under Portuguese oversight the port developed into a market of the Indian Ocean slave trade, drawing captives and ivory from the Zambezi hinterland, and in the 1760s the settlement was formally chartered as a Portuguese town, its commerce long reserved to Portuguese merchants alone.
zh:
克利马内是莫桑比克沿海的斯瓦希里贸易城镇，坐落在赞比西河口附近的良兆河畔。与基尔瓦苏丹国有关的穆斯林商人把它建成当地最古老的聚落之一，口述传统还把它列为15世纪末基尔瓦流亡者建立的沿海城镇之一。达伽马1498年抵达这里的河口，葡萄牙人的永久驻点始于1544年。

在葡萄牙人监管下，这个港口发展为印度洋奴隶贸易的市场，从赞比西内陆掠取人口和象牙；1760年代，该聚落被正式特许为葡萄牙城镇，贸易长期只向葡萄牙商人开放。

en:
The Quasmigdo, also known as the Bidai, lived in eastern Texas around Bedias Creek and the Trinity River. Spanish explorers recorded them near the Hasinai in 1691.

They allied with the Akokisa and in the 1750s were served by a Spanish mission on the Trinity. Epidemics in 1776–77 cut their numbers sharply, and survivors joined neighbouring peoples including the Akokisa and Koasati.
zh:
夸斯米格多人又称比代人，居住在今得克萨斯州东部的比代亚斯溪和特里尼蒂河一带。1691年，西班牙探险者记载他们住在哈西奈人附近。

他们与阿科基萨人结盟，18世纪50年代特里尼蒂河上的一座西班牙传教站为两族服务。1776—1777年的疫病使他们人口锐减，幸存者加入了阿科基萨人和科阿萨蒂人等邻族。

en:
Qom lies on a plain south of Tehran on the Qom River, a Sasanian stronghold of the Anahita cult. Arab forces under Abu Musa al-Ashaari raided it in 644, and Ashaari Arab families from Kufa settled among Persian villagers.

The decisive event was the death in 816 or 817 of Fatima Masumeh, sister of the eighth Imam Ali al-Rida, whose tomb became a shrine from 869 and drew sayyids and Shia scholars; a Friday mosque rose on a fire temple site in 878, and under Buyid rule from 951 Qom was Twelver Shia with a Sunni minority.

The Mongols destroyed it in 1224, and though it revived modestly under the Ilkhans, Timur sacked it late in the fourteenth century. Under the Safavids Qom became by 1503 a leading Shia theology and pilgrimage centre; in 1793 it passed to the Qajars, and Fath Ali Shah rebuilt the shrine.
zh:
库姆在德黑兰以南平原，临库姆河，萨珊时代为阿娜希塔崇拜要地。644年阿布·穆萨·阿沙里率阿拉伯军袭取此地，后来来自库法的阿沙里阿拉伯家族定居波斯村落。

816或817年，第八代伊玛目阿里·里达之妹法蒂玛·马苏梅去世，成为库姆的转折：陵墓自869年起扩建为圣陵，吸引圣裔与什叶派学者云集；878年聚礼清真寺在祆教神庙旧址建成，951年白益王朝统治时，库姆已成十二伊玛目派城市，逊尼派为少数。

1224年蒙古军摧毁该城；伊儿汗国时期略有恢复，14世纪末帖木儿再洗劫此城。萨非王朝时，到1503年已成为什叶派神学与朝圣首要中心；1793年转归卡扎尔王朝，法特赫-阿里沙重修圣陵。

en: Qhara Qhara refers to an Indigenous people of the Bolivian highlands, associated with the Charcas and Potosí regions. The nearby Charcas region came under Inca rule before the Spanish founded La Plata in 1538.
zh: 卡拉卡拉指玻利维亚高地的原住民族，与查尔卡斯和波托西地区有关。附近的查尔卡斯地区在西班牙人于1538年建立拉普拉塔之前已处于印加统治之下。

en:
Quiripi was the language of the Quinnipiac and neighboring peoples of southwestern Connecticut and central Long Island. The Quinnipiac lived along the river bearing their name, with a principal village at present-day New Haven.

In 1638 English settlers established a small reservation for them nearby; in 1658 the minister Abraham Pierson translated a catechism into Quiripi. Some Quinnipiac left the reservation for Farmington in 1768.
zh:
奎里皮语是康涅狄格西南部和长岛中部的昆尼帕人及邻近族群使用的语言。昆尼帕人沿同名河流居住，主要村落位于今纽黑文。

1638年，英国殖民者在附近为他们设立了一处小保留地；1658年，牧师亚伯拉罕·皮尔森将一部教理问答译成奎里皮语。1768年，部分昆尼帕人离开保留地前往法明顿。

en: The Kingdom of Qata, also called Qita'a, was one of the six Beja kingdoms recorded by the Arab historian al-Yaqubi in the ninth century. It held a stretch of the Red Sea coast around the gulf of Zula, near the ruins of the old Aksumite port of Adulis, and was later absorbed into the Balaw kingdom.
zh: 咖塔王国又称基塔阿，是阿拉伯史学家雅库比在9世纪记载的六个贝贾王国之一，据有祖拉湾一带的红海海岸，邻近阿克苏姆古港阿杜利斯的遗址，后来被并入巴劳王国。

en:
Quito was the homeland of the Quitu, an indigenous people who settled in the valleys around the Pichincha volcanoes in present-day Ecuador. They traded with the Yumbo to the northwest, acquiring prized Spondylus shells from the Pacific coast.

Around 1470 Topa Inca Yupanqui conquered the Quitu. They later joined the Cayambi and Caranqui in a revolt against Huayna Capac, which the Inca suppressed. The Spanish conquered Quito in 1534.
zh:
基多是基多人的故地，他们定居在今厄瓜多尔皮钦查火山周围的山谷中。他们与西北方的雍博人贸易，获得来自太平洋海岸的珍贵海菊蛤贝壳。

约1470年，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基征服了基多人。此后他们与卡扬贝人、卡兰基人一道反抗瓦伊纳·卡帕克，但起义遭印加人镇压。1534年，西班牙人征服了基多。

en: Quitor was a Likanantay settlement overlooking the San Pedro valley in the Atacama Desert of present-day Chile, protected by a stone fortress. The Spanish arrived in the region in 1536 and brought it under their control in 1557.
zh: 基多尔是利卡南泰人的聚落，位于今智利阿塔卡马沙漠中俯瞰圣佩德罗河谷的地方，有石堡保护。西班牙人于1536年抵达这一地区，并在1557年将其置于统治之下。

en:
Cuauhtemallan is a Nahuatl name meaning the place of many trees, which the Mexica and Spanish Tlaxcalan and Cholultec auxiliaries gave first to the Kaqchikel capital Iximche and then to the whole central valley and Pacific slope.

Nahua-speaking Pipil enclaves dotted the country, above all Itzcuintlan, the present-day Escuintla, and their settlements were interspersed with Poqomam Maya villages. The Nahua communities descended from migrants who left central Mexico in the Nahua diaspora of the tenth to twelfth centuries and lived by cacao, cotton and indigo farming and long-distance trade.

When Pedro de Alvarado marched up the Pacific coast in 1524 with Tlaxcalan allies, the Nahuatl names fixed themselves on the map; after the highland kingdoms fell and the Kaqchikel rebellion was put down in 1530, Cuauhtemallan became the Spanish province and city of Guatemala, which gave the later republic its name.
zh:
奎特马兰是纳瓦特尔语，意为“多树之地”，墨西加人及随西班牙人出征的特拉斯卡拉和乔卢拉附庸用它称呼卡克奇克尔人的都城伊希姆切，后泛指中部谷地与太平洋坡地。

纳瓦语皮皮尔人聚落散布此地，最著名的是伊茨昆特兰，即今埃斯昆特拉，与波科马姆玛雅人的村落交错。这些纳瓦社群是10至12世纪纳瓦人大迁徙中离开墨西哥中部的移民后裔，靠可可、棉花、靛蓝种植和长途贸易为生。

1524年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多率特拉斯卡拉盟友沿太平洋海岸北上，纳瓦特尔地名就此固定于地图；高地诸王国陷落后，卡克奇克尔人起义1530年被镇压，奎特马兰成为西班牙治下的危地马拉省与危地马拉城，后来的共和国也由此得名。

en:
Gera lies in the White Elster valley of the Vogtland, named after the imperial vogts who ruled it. First documented in 995, it was granted by Otto III to Quedlinburg Abbey in 999, and from 1209 the abbess gave protectorship to the Vogts of Weida, later the House of Reuss. First called a town in 1237, it was fortified in the thirteenth century.

The abbess remained formal sovereign until 1358, when overlordship passed to the Wettins, and Gera was nearly destroyed in the Saxon Fratricidal War of 1450. The Wettins imposed the Reformation in 1533, but after the Schmalkaldic War of 1546 the territory passed nominally to the Bohemian Crown under effective Reuss rule.

In 1673 the Reussians were raised to imperial counts, and Gera became their residence; cloth-makers fleeing the Spanish Netherlands had already made it a textile town, and in 1806 Napoleon made it his headquarters before Jena.
zh:
格拉在福格特兰白埃尔斯特河谷，“福格特兰”得名于当地的帝国摄政官。最早见于995年文献，999年奥托三世将它封给奎德林堡修道院；1209年起女院长将保护权委托给魏达福格特家族，即后来罗伊斯家族。格拉1237年首称城镇，13世纪筑城。

女院长为名义宗主至1358年，宗主权转给韦廷藩侯；1450年格拉在萨克森兄弟阋墙战争中几乎被毁。1533年韦廷家族推行宗教改革，1546年施马尔卡尔登战争后领地名义上转归波希米亚王冠，由罗伊斯家族实际统治。

1673年罗伊斯家族升帝国伯爵，格拉为驻地；此前逃避西属尼德兰动乱的织工已使它成为纺织城镇，1806年耶拿战役前夕，拿破仑以格拉为大本营。

en:
The Qulla, or Colla, was the largest Aymara chiefdom on the Collao plateau after Tiwanaku collapsed around 1000. Its capital was Hatunqulla near Puno on Lake Titicaca; archaeology shows hilltop forts, or pukaras, rather than a centralized monarchy. Aymara, Puquina and Uru communities lived under its rule, and the kingdom kept Tiwanaku rites, including the chullpa tombs of Sillustani.

Around 1400 the Colla warred with the Lupaca, but the Inca Viracocha secretly backed the Lupaca king Cari and the Colla were beaten at Paucarcolla. Mid-century the Colla king Chuchi Capac faced Pachacuti, who defeated him and received the Colla lords' submission at Hatunqulla; three later revolts were crushed by Amaru Yupanqui and Tupac Yupanqui, the latter also expelling Puquina and Uru groups from the Island of the Sun.

The Incas named their whole south-eastern quarter Qullasuyu after the Colla, and in 1538 a Colla and Spanish alliance defeated the Lupaca at the Desaguadero.
zh:
库尧（又译科利亚）是蒂亚瓦纳科约1000年崩溃后科利亚奥高原最大的艾马拉酋长国。都城哈通库利亚临的的喀喀湖近普诺，考古发现境内多山头堡垒普卡拉，并非集权君主国；艾马拉、普基纳、乌鲁族群在其治下，王国保留蒂亚瓦纳科礼仪，含锡卢斯塔尼丘尔帕墓塔。

约1400年库尧与卢皮哈基交战，印卡王维拉科查暗助卢皮哈基王卡里，库尧战败于保卡科拉。15世纪中期库尧王楚奇·卡帕克迎战帕查库特克，兵败后领主在哈通库利亚臣服；后三次起义被阿马鲁·尤潘基、图帕克·尤潘基镇压，图帕克将普基纳、乌鲁群体逐出太阳岛。

印卡东南行政区科利亚苏尤得名于库尧；1538年库尧联西班牙在德萨瓜德罗河击败卢皮哈基人。

en:
The Qara'unas, also called the Negüderi, were Mongol garrison troops who settled in Afghanistan. From the 1230s they were stationed near the Indian frontier as tamachi soldiers, and in 1262 an influx of Jochid troops fleeing the Ilkhanate under the general Negudar gave the group its identity. They wintered around Ghazna and summered in Ghur and Garchistan, and Marco Polo described them as a mixed people of Mongol, Turk and Indian blood.

After the Chagatai Khanate fractured in the 1340s, Qara'una emirs such as Qazaghan and his son Abdullah became the masters of the western khanate, ruling through puppet khans. The Suldus and Barlas revolted in 1359, and after the Moghul invasions Qara'una leader Husayn, Qazaghan's grandson, shared power with Timur until Timur overthrew and killed him at Balkh in 1370.

Timur fully subjugated the group in the 1380s, and Qara'una horsemen thereafter made up a large part of his armies. According to Babur, some still spoke Mongolian in the mountains around Ghazni in the late fifteenth century.
zh:
哈剌兀纳思人又称捏古迭儿人，是定居在阿富汗的蒙古戍军。13世纪30年代起，他们作为探马赤军驻扎在印度边境一带；1262年，金帐汗国将领捏古答儿率部众逃入阿富汗、脱离伊利汗国，奠定了这个群体的雏形。他们在哥疾宁一带过冬，在古耳和噶尔吉斯坦度夏，马可·波罗称他们是混杂了蒙古、突厥和印度血统的人群。

14世纪40年代察合台汗国分裂后，哈剌兀纳思异密加兹罕及其子阿卜杜拉成为汗国西部的实际主宰，通过傀儡发号施令。1359年速勒都思和巴鲁剌思贵族起兵反抗，加上蒙兀儿人入侵，加兹罕之孙、哈剌兀纳思首领忽辛与帖木儿共掌河中，最终于1370年在巴尔赫被帖木儿推翻杀死。

帖木儿在14世纪80年代完全征服该部，哈剌兀纳思骑兵此后构成其军队的重要部分。据巴布尔记载，直到15世纪末，哥疾宁山区仍有部分人说蒙古语。

en: Quizquiz was an Indigenous polity on the eastern side of the Mississippi River, ruled by a chief of the same name. In 1541 Hernando de Soto's expedition surprised its town, seized women and encountered the chief at his mound-top dwelling. The chiefdoms recorded by the expedition had disappeared by the late seventeenth century.
zh: 基斯基斯是密西西比河东岸的原住民政体，由一位同名酋长统治。1541年埃尔南多·德·索托的远征队突袭其城镇，掳走妇女，并在土丘上的居所遇见了酋长。到17世纪末，远征队记载的酋邦已不复存在。

en:
Qingyuan was the chief administrative centre of the Zhuang lands along the Longjiang in northern Guangxi, with its seat at Yishan, the present-day Yizhou district of Hechi. In 1265 the Southern Song elevated Yizhou to Qingyuan Prefecture because it had been the princely estate of the future Emperor Duzong. Under the Yuan it became first an appeasement commission and then Qingyuan Route, reorganised in 1297 as the Qingyuan-Nandan military-civilian appeasement commission, which supervised the native chieftaincies of the surrounding valleys.

The Ming restored it as a prefecture, and under the Qing its jurisdiction reached the present-day Nandan, Donglan, Fengshan, Tian'e and Xincheng counties, governing a network of Zhuang tusi beneath the prefectural city.
zh:
庆远是广西北部龙江流域壮族地区的行政中心，治所在宜山县，即今河池市宜州区。1265年，因宜州曾是宋度宗登基前的潜邸，南宋升置庆远府。元代先设安抚司，后改庆远路，1297年又改为庆远南丹军民安抚司，统辖周围溪洞的土著首领。

明代复置为府，清代辖境扩大到今南丹、东兰、凤山、天峨、忻城等县地，府城之下管辖着一批壮族土司。

en:
The Republic of Ragusa was an aristocratic maritime republic centered on Dalmatian Dubrovnik, governed by a patrician council. A seventh-century refuge from Epidaurum, it passed centuries under Byzantine, Norman and Venetian rule before the Fourth Crusade gave it to Venice in 1205. As a Venetian tributary it kept much of its government, and in 1333 bought Pelješac and Ston from Stefan Dušan of Serbia, securing salt pans that became a chief revenue.

The 1358 Treaty of Zadar transferred homage to the Hungarian crown and left Ragusa effectively independent. From 1458 it paid tribute to the Ottoman sultan while ruling itself, its merchants winning tax exemptions and Black Sea access, carrying Balkan silver, salt and grain across the Mediterranean.

New routes and the great earthquake of 1667 sapped its wealth. Napoleon occupied Dubrovnik in 1806 and abolished the republic in 1808, and the 1815 Congress of Vienna assigned its territory to Austria.
zh:
拉古萨是达尔马提亚沿岸杜布罗夫尼克的贵族海洋共和国，贵族议会治理。源自7世纪埃皮达鲁姆难民的避难所，在拜占庭、诺曼、威尼斯间易手，1205年第四次十字军后归威尼斯。作为威尼斯纳贡城邦，它保留大部分自治政府，1333年从塞尔维亚的斯特凡·杜尚手中购得佩列沙茨和斯通，控制后来成为主要财源之一的盐田。

1358年《扎达尔条约》将臣属关系转归匈牙利，拉古萨获得实质独立。1458年起向奥斯曼苏丹纳贡但继续自治，商人获免税权与黑海通航权，将巴尔干白银、食盐和粮食运销地中海。

新商路与1667年大地震耗弱其财富。拿破仑1806年占杜布罗夫尼克，1808年废共和国，1815年维也纳会议将其领土划归奥地利。

en:
Rano was the southernmost of the seven Hausa states, the Hausa Bakwai, lying in the farm country south of Kano in northern Nigeria; its settlement reaches back to the 500s, one of the oldest towns in Hausaland.

Hausa tradition names Zamna Kogi, a descendant of Bayajidda, as its founder, and ranks Rano with Kano as a king of indigo, for its weavers and dyers supplied cloth across the Hausa markets. Three dynasties followed on its stool: the Kwararrafawa, the Habe and finally the Fulani.

Its independence was short-lived: between 1349 and 1385 Yaji I of Kano conquered Rano and held it for two years, and although the town kept its own rulers afterward it never recovered its sovereignty, passing under Kano's shadow and, after the Fulani jihad of the early 1800s, into the Kano Emirate of the Sokoto Caliphate.
zh:
拉诺是豪萨七城邦（豪萨·巴克瓦伊）中位置最南的一个，位于今尼日利亚北部卡诺以南的农区；其聚落史可追溯到6世纪，是豪萨兰最古老的城镇之一。

豪萨传说称英雄巴亚吉达的后裔扎姆纳·科吉是它的建立者，并把拉诺与卡诺同列为“靛蓝之王”，因为当地织工和染匠供应的布匹行销豪萨各市场。它的王位先后经历夸拉拉法瓦、哈贝和富拉尼三个王朝。

拉诺的独立并不长久：1349至1385年间，卡诺的亚吉一世攻克拉诺并占领两年，此后该城虽保留自己的统治者，却再未恢复主权；19世纪初富拉尼圣战之后，它被并入索科托哈里发国的卡诺埃米尔国。

en: Te Rapuwai was an early Māori iwi remembered in the traditions of New Zealand's South Island, including the Otago Peninsula. By the time Ngāti Māmoe crossed to the South Island around the 16th century, Te Rapuwai and other early iwi were grouped together as Waitaha.
zh: 特拉普怀是新西兰南岛传统记忆中的早期毛利部族，活动范围包括奥塔哥半岛。约在16世纪雅提马莫埃渡往南岛时，特拉普怀和其他早期部族已被统称为怀塔哈。

en:
The Rarámuri lived across Chihuahua in northern Mexico and withdrew into the Sierra Madre Occidental after Spanish colonizers arrived in the 16th century. The discovery of the Parral mines in 1631 brought more Spanish settlers, missionaries and raids for mine labor.

In 1648 Rarámuri fighters gathered at Fariagic and destroyed the mission of San Francisco de Borja. Tepóraca later led resistance in the highlands and was executed by the Spanish in 1690; another war from 1696 to 1698 ended in defeat.
zh:
拉拉穆里人原本分布在墨西哥北部的奇瓦瓦地区，16世纪西班牙殖民者到来后退入西马德雷山脉。1631年帕拉尔矿山被发现，更多西班牙移民和传教士随之而来，掳掠矿工的行动也愈发频繁。

1648年，拉拉穆里战士在法里亚希克集结，摧毁了圣弗朗西斯科·德博尔哈传教站。特波拉卡后来在高地领导抵抗，于1690年被西班牙人处决；1696—1698年的另一场战争以失败告终。

en:
Ravenna, a Romagna lagoon city, was the Western Roman capital in its last century, then of Odoacer and Theodoric's Ostrogothic kingdom after 493. Belisarius took it for Byzantium in 540, housing the Exarchate of Italy until the Lombards captured it in 751; Pepin's Donation of 756 handed the former exarchate to the papacy.

Contested between empire and papacy, it passed in 1275 to Guido Novello da Polenta, who drove out the Traversari and founded a hereditary lordship under papal suzerainty. The exiled Florentine poet Dante died there in 1321. The last Da Polenta, Ostasio III, fell to Venice in 1441 under the Treaty of Cremona.

Venetian rule ended in 1509, when the War of the League of Cambrai returned it to the papacy; the French sacked it after the 1512 battle. Venice briefly reoccupied it from 1527 to 1529. A papal city until French annexation in 1796, it was restored to the papacy in 1814.
zh:
拉文纳是罗马涅潟湖城市，西罗马帝国末年的首都，493年后成为奥多亚克和狄奥多里克东哥特王国都城。540年贝利撒留替拜占庭夺取该城，为意大利总督区治所，751年伦巴第人攻占；756年丕平献土将原总督区交予教皇。

帝国与教皇争夺中，1275年圭多·诺韦洛·达·波伦塔驱逐特拉韦尔萨里家族，在教皇宗主权下建世袭领主治。流亡的佛罗伦萨诗人但丁1321年在此去世。末代领主奥斯塔西奥三世1441年依《克雷莫纳条约》被威尼斯推翻。

威尼斯统治至1509年，康布雷同盟战争令拉文纳回归教皇国；1512年法军拉文纳战役后洗劫该城。威尼斯于1527年短暂重占，1529年退出。此后为教皇城市，1796年法国吞并，1814年重归教皇。

en:
The Duchy of Rawa was a Masovian Piast duchy centered on Rawa, east of Łęczyca. It was created in the partition of 1313, when the sons of Duke Boleslaus II divided Mazovia and Siemowit II, the Piast ruler shown in 1337, took Rawa. He died without heirs in 1345, and his lands were absorbed by his nephew Siemowit III, who reunited most of Mazovia and placed it under Polish suzerainty in 1351.

When Masovia was divided again in 1381, Rawa fell to Siemowit IV together with Płock. The territory became the Rawa Voivodeship in 1495, and after the last Masovian Piast duke died in 1526 it passed, with the rest of Mazovia, directly to the Kingdom of Poland.
zh:
拉瓦公国是马佐夫舍皮亚斯特家族的公国，以文奇察以东的拉瓦为中心。1313年公爵博莱斯瓦夫二世的诸子瓜分马佐夫舍，1337年在任的皮亚斯特统治者谢莫维特二世分得拉瓦，公国由此建立。他于1345年无嗣而终，领地被侄子谢莫维特三世兼并；后者重新统一了马佐夫舍的大部分土地，并于1351年接受波兰的宗主权。

1381年马佐夫舍再度分封，拉瓦与普沃茨克一同归谢莫维特四世所有。1495年该地改组为拉瓦省，1526年末代马佐夫舍皮亚斯特公爵去世后，它与马佐夫舍其余地区一起直接并入波兰王国。

en:
The County of Rietberg was a tiny state of the Holy Roman Empire on the upper Ems in Westphalia, wedged between the prince-bishoprics of Paderborn and Münster. A castle on the site is recorded from the eleventh century and the place itself around 1100 as Rietbike, and from 1237 Rietberg ranked as an immediate imperial county. Small as it was, it kept its own laws, militia and coinage, striking its own money until the seventeenth century.

In 1699 the heiress Maria Ernestine of East Frisia married Count Maximilian Ulrich von Kaunitz, carrying Rietberg to the Moravian Kaunitz family, who styled themselves Kaunitz-Rietberg and later rose to princely rank.

The county survived until 1807, when it was mediatised to the Kingdom of Westphalia; after that kingdom collapsed in 1813, Rietberg passed to Prussia and was incorporated into the Province of Westphalia.
zh:
里特贝格伯国是神圣罗马帝国小邦，位于威斯特伐利亚的埃姆斯河上游，夹在帕德博恩和明斯特两个采邑主教区之间。当地城堡在11世纪已有记载，居民点约1100年以里特拜克之名首见文献；1237年起成为直属帝国的伯国。它幅员虽小，却保有自己的法律、民兵和铸币权，直到17世纪仍在铸造钱币。

1699年，女继承人东弗里斯兰的玛丽亚·埃内斯蒂娜与考尼茨伯爵马克西米利安·乌尔里希成婚，里特贝格随之转入摩拉维亚的考尼茨家族，该家族改称考尼茨-里特贝格，后晋升诸侯。

伯国存续到1807年，被裁并入威斯特伐利亚王国；1813年该王国瓦解后，里特贝格归属普鲁士，并入威斯特伐利亚省。

en:
The Duchy of Racibórz, with its capital at Racibórz in Upper Silesia, was formed in 1172 as Mieszko I Tanglefoot's share of Silesian inheritance. Enlarged in 1177, it joined Opole in 1202 to form the Duchy of Opole and Racibórz, until the 1281 partition recreated it as a separate Piast duchy.

Duke Leszek paid homage to King John of Bohemia in 1327, making Racibórz a Bohemian fief. When Leszek died heirless in 1336, John granted it to his brother-in-law Nicholas II of Opava, who from 1337 ruled Racibórz and Opava in personal union. Separated again in 1377, Racibórz remained with the Opava Přemyslids until Duke Jan II the Good merged it with Opole in 1521.

On Jan's death in 1532 the duchy reverted to the Bohemian, now Habsburg, Crown and was pledged to the Hohenzollerns of Brandenburg-Ansbach; the Treaty of Breslau assigned it to Prussia in 1742.
zh:
拉齐布日是上西里西亚公国，都拉齐布日，1172年西里西亚分遗产时成为梅什科一世“缠足者”份额。1177年获邻近土地扩大，1202年与奥波莱合并为奥波莱-拉齐布日公国，1281年分家后重为独立皮亚斯特公国。

1327年公爵莱谢克向波希米亚王约翰行臣服礼，拉齐布日成为波希米亚封邑。1336年莱谢克无嗣而终，约翰将公国封给姻亲奥帕瓦的尼古拉斯二世，尼古拉斯二世自1337年起以共主邦联兼治两地。1377年两地再分，拉齐布日仍属奥帕瓦的普热米斯尔家族，1521年扬二世“善人”公爵将其再并入奥波莱。

1532年扬去世后，公国收归哈布斯堡的波希米亚王冠，抵押给安斯巴赫霍亨索伦家族；1742年《布雷斯劳条约》划归普鲁士。

en:
The viscounty of Rochechouart was a Limousin lordship, its castle keep rising above the town. Its lords traced their line to Foucher, viscount of Limoges in 876, and to Aymeric I around 990. Aymeric IV joined the First Crusade, and Aymeric VI built the present castle around 1200.

In 1337 the viscount was John I. He charged at the Battle of Crécy in 1346 and was killed at Poitiers in 1356 defending John II. His successors kept the castle a centre of resistance to the English, one fighting beside Joan of Arc.

The family later rebuilt the castle, and in the seventeenth century Françoise-Athénaïs de Rochechouart, Madame de Montespan, became the most powerful mistress of Louis XIV. During the Terror the viscountess was guillotined in Paris in 1794, though the line survived and a Rochechouart general governed Paris after 1814.
zh:
罗什舒阿尔子爵领是利穆赞的一处封邑，城堡主楼高踞镇上。家族自称源自876年的利摩日子爵富尔谢与约990年的艾梅里一世。艾梅里四世参加第一次十字军东征，艾梅里六世约1200年修建现存城堡。

1337年在位者为子爵让一世。他1346年战于克雷西，1356年在普瓦捷护卫约翰二世战死。后继者据城堡抵抗英格兰人，其中有人追随圣女贞德。

后来家族重修城堡；17世纪，家族之女、蒙特斯庞侯爵夫人弗朗索瓦丝-阿泰纳伊斯成为路易十四最有权势的宠妃。恐怖统治时期，子爵夫人1794年在巴黎被处断头刑，血脉仍延续，1814年后一位罗什舒阿尔将军出任巴黎总督。

en:
Recherla was the country of the Recherla Nayakas, a Telugu warrior dynasty also called the Padmanayaka Velamas. In 1337 they were led by Singama Nayaka, a former commander of the Kakatiya king Prataparudra, from their base at Anumagallu. After Singama was killed attacking Jallipalli fort around 1358, his sons Anapota and Maada Nayaka avenged him, then joined the Bahmani sultan against the Musunuri Nayakas: at Bhimavaram in 1368 they killed Kapaya Nayaka and made themselves masters of Telangana.

Anapota built the fort of Rachakonda around 1360 and moved his capital there, while Maada held a second seat at Devarakonda. Long rivalry with the Reddy kings followed.

After switching from the Bahmani to the Vijayanagara alliance the Recherlas shared in the victory of Pangal in 1419. Bahmani armies took Rachakonda around 1435 and Devarakonda in 1475, extinguishing the kingdom, whose surviving chiefs entered Vijayanagara service.
zh:
隶契罗是隶契罗·纳亚卡人的国家，这个泰卢固武士王朝又称帕德马纳亚卡·韦拉马。1337年时，他们由曾在卡卡提亚国王普拉塔帕鲁德拉麾下任统兵官的辛伽玛·纳亚卡率领，据点在阿努马加卢。约1358年辛伽玛攻打贾利帕利要塞时被杀，其子阿纳波塔与马达·纳亚卡起兵复仇，随后联合巴赫曼尼苏丹对抗穆苏努里·纳亚卡人，于1368年在比姆瓦拉姆击杀卡帕亚·纳亚卡，成为特伦甘纳的主人。

约1360年阿纳波塔修筑拉查孔达要塞并迁都于此，马达则以代瓦拉孔达为另一治所。他们与雷迪诸王长期争雄。

从巴赫曼尼阵营转投毗奢耶那伽罗后，隶契罗人于1419年分享了潘加尔之战的胜利。巴赫曼尼军队约在1435年攻陷拉查孔达，1475年又拿下代瓦拉孔达，王国就此灭亡，幸存的首领转投毗奢耶那伽罗效力。

en:
Riedesel was the lordship of the Riedesels, an ancient Hessian knightly family first documented around 1226 and long vassals of the Landgraves of Hesse.

Their rise began in 1428, when the lords of Eisenbach died out and Hermann II, called the Golden Knight, took over their offices around Lauterbach. His son married the last lord's daughter, securing the castles of Eisenbach and Lauterbach. Hermann IV introduced the Reformation in 1527, and after Fulda seized Lauterbach in 1548 the family retook the town in 1552.

The Riedesels were raised to barons in 1680, and a treaty of 1684 with Fulda recognised them as independent lords of Lauterbach. The state lasted until 1806, when it was mediatised into the Grand Duchy of Hesse. The family's most famous member was the general Friedrich Adolph Riedesel, who led Brunswick troops in British service during the American war.
zh:
里德泽尔是里德泽尔骑士家族的领主地。该家族约1226年首见文献，世代为黑森领地伯爵的封臣。

家族崛起始于1428年：艾森巴赫领主绝嗣，号称金骑士的赫尔曼二世接手他们在劳特巴赫一带的职务。他的儿子娶末代领主之女，保住艾森巴赫和劳特巴赫等城堡。赫尔曼四世于1527年引入宗教改革；1548年富尔达占领劳特巴赫，家族于1552年夺回该城。

里德泽尔家族于1680年晋升男爵，1684年与富尔达签订的条约承认他们为劳特巴赫的独立领主。小邦存续到1806年，被裁并进黑森大公国。家族最出名的成员是弗里德里希·阿道夫·里德泽尔将军，他曾在美国独立战争中率领为英国效力的不伦瑞克军队。

en:
The Reddi kingdom grew out of the collapse of Kakatiya power in the Telugu country. When Delhi armies took Warangal and carried off the Kakatiya raja Pratapa Rudra in 1323, Tughluq rule over the coast proved too weak to hold, and local warrior lineages seized their chance. Prolaya Vema Reddy, from a family of Kakatiya commanders and village headmen, founded his own kingdom at Addanki around 1325.

His successor Anavota Reddy moved the court to the hill fort of Kondavidu, and at its height the realm stretched from Cuttack to Kanchi, with a junior branch established at Rajahmundry in 1395. The Reddi kings were builders and patrons: they repaired the temple of Srisailam, raised the Narasimha temple at Ahobilam and fortified Kondapalli and Kondavidu against the Recherla Velamas and their Bahmani allies.

The end came in the fifteenth century: Vijayanagara took Kondavidu in 1424, and the Gajapatis of Orissa conquered Rajahmundry around 1448, closing the hundred-year history of the Reddi kingdom.
zh:
罗底王国是在泰卢固地区卡卡提亚政权崩溃的乱局中崛起的。1323年德里军队攻陷瓦朗加尔、掳走卡卡提亚罗阇波罗陀波·鲁陀罗，图格鲁克王朝对沿海的统治无力维持，各地武士家族趁机而起。波罗罗耶·吠摩·罗底出身卡卡提亚军事统帅和村落首领家族，约于1325年在阿登吉自建王国。

继承者阿那伏多·罗底把朝廷迁往山城孔达维杜；极盛时疆域自卡塔克延伸至建志，1395年又在拉杰蒙德里分出一支旁系。罗底诸王大兴土木、广施护持：修葺斯里赛勒姆神庙，建成阿霍比勒的那罗辛哈神庙，并修建孔达帕利和孔达维杜等堡垒，以抵御雷切尔拉的吠罗摩首领及其巴赫马尼盟友。

15世纪王国走向终结：毗阇耶那伽罗于1424年夺取孔达维杜，奥里萨的伽阇波蒂又在约1448年征服拉杰蒙德里，罗底王国百年之运就此结束。

en:
Regensburg stands on the northernmost bend of the Danube, on the site of Castra Regina, a Roman fortress built around 179. From the early sixth century it was the seat of the Agilolfing dukes and capital of Bavaria until the thirteenth century, and Saint Boniface re-established its bishopric in 739.

The Stone Bridge, finished around 1146, linked trade routes of northern Europe with Venice and opened the city's golden age. In 1245 Regensburg became a Free Imperial City; it fell to the Duchy of Bavaria in 1486 before the emperor restored independence ten years later.

The Jewish community was expelled in 1519, and the city adopted the Reformation in 1542. From 1663 to 1806 it hosted the Perpetual Diet, the Empire's permanent assembly; in 1803 it passed to the Principality of Regensburg and in 1810 to the Kingdom of Bavaria.
zh:
雷根斯堡位于多瑙河最北的河湾处，城址是约179年罗马人修建的卡斯特拉-雷吉纳要塞。6世纪初起，它是阿吉洛尔芬公爵的驻地，13世纪前一直是巴伐利亚的都城；739年圣波尼法爵重建当地主教区。

约1146年落成的石桥连接北欧商路与威尼斯，开启了城市的商贸黄金时代。1245年雷根斯堡成为帝国自由城市，1486年一度并入巴伐利亚公国，十年后皇帝恢复其独立。

1519年，城内犹太社区被驱逐；1542年城市接受宗教改革。1663年至1806年，神圣罗马帝国的永久帝国议会在此召开；1803年雷根斯堡并入雷根斯堡侯国，1810年转归巴伐利亚王国。

en:
The County of Rethel was a feudal lordship in the Ardennes, seated at Rethel. The town first belonged to the Abbey of Saint-Remi of Reims, until one of its advocati, Manasses I, founded the comital House of Rethel. Count Hugh I sent a son to the Latin East: Baldwin of Rethel reigned in Jerusalem as King Baldwin II from 1118 to 1131.

When Hugh IV died in 1285 leaving only a daughter, Joan, the county passed through her marriage to Louis of Nevers. Their son Louis I held Rethel with Flanders and Nevers in 1337, before he was killed at Crécy in 1346.

Rethel was raised to a peerage of France in 1481 and to a duchy in 1581. In 1659 the last Gonzaga duke sold it to Cardinal Mazarin; it became the Duchy of Mazarin until the Revolution of 1789.
zh:
勒泰勒伯国是阿登地区的封建小领地，治所在勒泰勒。该城本属兰斯的圣雷米修道院，后来世俗代理人之一马纳塞斯一世开创勒泰勒伯爵家族。伯爵于格一世把一个儿子送往拉丁东方：勒泰勒的鲍德温于1118年登上耶路撒冷王位，称鲍德温二世，统治到1131年。

1285年于格四世去世，只留下女儿让娜，伯国随她的婚姻转入讷韦尔的路易之手。他们的儿子路易一世在1337年同时领有勒泰勒、佛兰德和讷韦尔，1346年战死于克雷西。

勒泰勒于1481年被列为法兰西贵族爵位，1581年升为公国。1659年末代贡扎加公爵把它卖给枢机主教马萨林，改称马萨林公国，直到1789年大革命将其废除。

en:
Reggio was a city and commune on the Via Aemilia in northern Italy. Its citizens expelled Azzo d'Este in 1306 and established a republic, which ended when Cardinal Bertrando del Poggetto annexed the city to the Papal States in 1326. After Gonzaga and Visconti rule, Reggio returned to the Este in 1409.

In 1452 Emperor Frederick III made Borso d'Este duke of Modena and Reggio. Reggio expelled its ducal garrison in 1796 and hosted the proclamation of the Cispadane Republic in 1797; it returned to Austria-Este rule in 1815.
zh:
雷焦是意大利北部艾米利亚大道上的城市和公社。1306年市民驱逐阿佐·德斯特，建立共和国；1326年枢机贝特朗·迪·波热托将该城并入教宗国，共和国随之结束。经过贡扎加和维斯孔蒂家族统治后，雷焦于1409年重归埃斯特家族。

1452年，皇帝腓特烈三世册封博尔索·德斯特为摩德纳和雷焦公爵。1796年雷焦驱逐公爵的驻军，1797年奇斯帕达纳共和国在此宣告成立；1815年雷焦重归奥地利-埃斯特家族统治。

en:
Rongmei, in the mountains straddling Hefeng and Wufeng in western Hubei, grew into the mightiest of the Tujia tusi. Its Tian clan first held office under the Yuan in 1310 and was confirmed as the Rongmei pacification commission under the Ming in 1371.

Through fifteen generations and twenty-three chiefs it expanded across eastern Enshi and into Wufeng and the Hunan border, swallowing four pacification offices and appointing chiefs to twenty-seven local offices without imperial sanction. The Yongzheng emperor called Rongmei the richest and strongest of the tusi of Hubei and Sichuan.

It became the test case for gaitu guiliu: when the Qing moved to replace native rule in 1735, Rongmei alone took up arms, and its defeat emptied much of its Hefeng heartland. The old territory became Hefeng subprefecture under Yichang, ending four centuries of Tian rule.
zh:
容美位于鄂西山地，地跨鹤峰、五峰一带，后来发展为最强大的土家族土司。田氏1310年已在元朝治下任职，1371年被明朝确认为容美宣抚司。

田氏历十五代、二十三位土司，势力从恩施东部扩张到五峰和湖南边界，先后吞并四个安抚司，还不经朝廷册封自行分封二十七个长官司。雍正帝称容美为楚蜀各土司中最富强者。

它也成为改土归流的突破口：1735年清朝改行流官时，容美是唯一举兵反抗的土司，战败后鹤峰一带人口锐减。旧地被设为隶属宜昌府的鹤峰州，田氏四百年的统治就此结束。

en: Rongshan was one of the six zhangguansi held by the Bozhou chiefdom, in the hill country east of Bozhou's Zunyi heartland. When the Ming crushed the Bozhou rebellion in 1600 and replaced native rule with officials, Rongshan's lands were reorganized into Meitan County under the new Pingyue Prefecture.
zh: 容山是播州土司下辖的六个长官司之一，地处播州治所遵义以东的山区。1600年明朝平定播州之乱、推行改土归流后，容山故地被划为湄潭县，归新设置的平越府管辖。

en: Rangitāne is a Māori iwi whose territory includes Manawatū, Horowhenua, Wairarapa and Marlborough. The iwi traces its formation to an expedition led by Whātonga of the Māhia Peninsula; in Heretaunga, Rangitāne were among the groups displaced by Taraia of Ngāti Kahungunu.
zh: 朗吉塔尼是毛利部族，其领地包括马纳瓦图、霍罗费努阿、怀拉拉帕和马尔堡。部族的形成可追溯至马希亚半岛首领法通加率领的一支队伍；在赫雷陶恩加，朗吉塔尼是被雅提卡胡伍努的塔赖亚驱逐的群体之一。

en:
The County of Rieneck was a lordship of Lower Franconia in the Spessart hills. Its original comital family died out with Count Gerhard I in 1108, and through an heiress the lands passed to the counts of Loon, who took the Rieneck name and from 1168 kept their court at Burg Rieneck.

In 1333 Emperor Louis IV granted the county town privileges for its support in his struggle for the crown, yet in the same year the male comital line failed and the Bishopric of Würzburg laid claim to the lordship. Long feuds with the sees of Würzburg and Mainz followed.

The Reformation came in 1544, and when the last count, Philip III, died in 1559 the Archbishopric of Mainz took over and ruled from Lohr. Rieneck was mediatized in 1806 and awarded to Bavaria by the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh:
里内克伯国是下法兰克尼亚施佩萨特山区的领地。原伯爵家族于1108年随格拉德一世去世而绝嗣，土地经女继承人转入洛翁伯爵家族，后者改用里内克之姓，1168年起以里内克城堡为治所。

1333年，皇帝路易四世为酬谢该家族在王位之争中的支持，授予其城市特权；但同年伯爵男系断绝，维尔茨堡主教区对领地提出要求。此后里内克与维尔茨堡、美因茨两个主教区长期争执。

1544年宗教改革传入；1559年末代伯爵菲利普三世去世，美因茨大主教区接管领地，从洛尔治理。里内克1806年被调解削权，1815年维也纳会议上划归巴伐利亚。

en:
Riga stands at the Daugava's mouth on the Baltic. In 1201 Bishop Albert of Livonia moved his see there and fortified the town, which became the main German trading gateway on the eastern Baltic. Its merchants won self-government in 1221 and joined the Hanseatic League in 1282.

It then spent two centuries defending its autonomy against the Archbishop of Riga and the Livonian Order. War with the Order ended in defeat in 1330, when the knights built a castle inside the city, and Riga stayed under Order influence.

It embraced the Reformation in 1522, and after the Livonian Order's collapse in 1561 it became a free imperial city. The 1581 treaty placed it under the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, Sweden conquered it in 1621, and in 1710 Peter the Great's armies took it, a transfer confirmed by the Treaty of Nystad in 1721.
zh:
里加位于波罗的海道加瓦河河口。1201年，利沃尼亚主教阿尔伯特将主教座迁此并筑城，这里成为德意志商人在波罗的海东岸的首要贸易门户。商人1221年获得自治权，1282年加入汉萨同盟。

此后两百年间，里加不断对抗里加大主教和利沃尼亚骑士团以维护自治。它与骑士团的战争以1330年失败告终，骑士团在城内修建城堡，里加此后长期处于骑士团的影响之下。

1522年里加接受宗教改革；1561年利沃尼亚骑士团崩溃后，它成为自由帝国城市。1581年的条约将其划归波兰立陶宛联邦，1621年瑞典将其征服，1710年彼得大帝的军队攻占里加，1721年尼斯塔德条约确认这一归属。

en:
Rimini, Roman Ariminum, founded in 268 BC, preserves the Arch of Augustus.
