In the thirteenth century the Malatesta family rose to power: Malatesta da Verucchio became podestà in 1239 and sole signore in 1295, and his heirs built a lordship spanning the Romagna and the Marche from Rimini. Malatesta II ruled it in 1337.

Its most celebrated lord was Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta, who rebuilt the Tempio Malatestiano with Leon Battista Alberti and raised the Castel Sismondo. Wars with Pope Pius II left him only Rimini in 1463.

In 1500 Pandolfo IV lost the city to Cesare Borgia; Venice held it from 1503 to 1509, before Pope Julius II incorporated it into the Papal States. A last Malatesta attempt in 1527 and 1528 failed, ending Malatesta rule, and Rimini remained a papal legation until Napoleonic troops arrived in 1797.
zh:
里米尼古称阿里米努姆，公元前268年罗马人在此建殖民城，现存奥古斯都拱门。13世纪马拉泰斯塔家族崛起：马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥1239年任行政长官，1295年自立领主，后代以里米尼为中心建立横跨罗马涅与马尔凯的领地。1337年马拉泰斯塔二世在位。

最著名的领主西吉斯蒙多·潘多尔福聘莱昂·巴蒂斯塔·阿尔贝蒂重建马拉泰斯塔神殿，又建西斯蒙多城堡；后与教皇庇护二世开战，1463年仅剩里米尼。

1500年潘多尔福四世失城于切萨雷·博尔贾；威尼斯1503—1509年占城，后由教皇尤利乌斯二世并入教皇国。1527—1528年家族最后一次复辟失败，统治终结；里米尼为教皇使节辖区，1797年拿破仑军队始至。

en:
Rajpipla, whose old capital Nandod was the ancient Nandipuri, was the chief town of Lata country between the Mahi and the Narmada. From the fifth to eighth centuries Nandipuri was the seat of the Gurjaras of Lata; a Bhil population later gave the place its name, remembering a chief who held court beneath a pipal tree.

Around 1340 a Gohil Rajput line, kin to the Guhilas of Mewar, established itself at Rajpipla and built a principality in the hills east of Bharuch.

The rajas of Rajpipla long kept their independence: after Delhi's governors reduced the rest of the province by the 1390s, Rajpipla and Junagadh alone withheld tribute, until Tatar Khan marched in 1403 and humbled the chief of Nandod. The Gohils later weathered the sultans of Ahmedabad and submitted to Akbar, before Maratha Gaekwads occupied Rajpipla in 1815 and the British made it a protectorate in 1821.
zh:
拉杰毕普拉的旧都南多德古称南迪普里，是默希河与讷尔默达河之间拉塔地区的首邑。5至8世纪，南迪普里是拉塔瞿折罗人的治所；后来比尔人给这里起了名字，纪念一位在菩提树下听政的首领。

约1340年，与梅瓦尔古希拉人同源的戈希拉拉杰普特支系在拉杰毕普拉立足，在巴鲁奇以东的山地建立小邦。

拉杰毕普拉诸王长期保持独立：14世纪90年代德里总督压服全省大部分地区后，唯有拉杰毕普拉与朱纳格德拒不纳贡，直到1403年塔塔尔汗进军，逼降南多德首领。戈希尔人后来熬过艾哈迈达巴德诸苏丹并臣服阿克巴，1815年马拉塔盖克瓦德人占领该邦，1821年成为英国保护邦。

en: Rajputana was a region of northwestern India containing Rajput kingdoms such as Mewar and Marwar. By 1818 its rulers had made treaties accepting British protection against the Marathas and Pindaris.
zh: 拉杰普塔纳是印度西北部的地区，包括梅瓦尔和马尔瓦尔等拉杰普特王国。到1818年，当地统治者已缔结条约，接受英国保护以抵御马拉塔人和品达里人。

en:
Rajouri, the ancient Rajapuri, is a hill kingdom in the Pir Panjal range west of the Kashmir valley. Its rajas came of the Jarral Rajput clan; their first, Prithvi Pal, held it from 1033 and guarded the mountain passes against the raids of Mahmud of Ghazni.

In 1475 the Kashmiri general Malik Tazi Bhat conquered Rajouri for the Sultan of Kashmir. The Jarral rajas kept their throne as tributaries.

After Akbar annexed Kashmir in 1586 the Mughals took the rajas under protection and granted them the title Mirza. The hill state held out against the Sikh attacks of 1810 and 1812, but in 1813 Gulab Singh of Jammu defeated Raja Aghar Khan and attached it to Ranjit Singh's Sikh Empire.
zh:
拉久里古称罗阇普里，是克什米尔谷地以西皮尔潘贾尔山脉中的山邦。其罗阇出自贾拉尔拉杰普特氏族，首位首领普里特维·帕尔1033年起统治该邦，曾扼守山口抵御伽色尼的马哈茂德袭掠。

1475年，克什米尔将领马利克·塔齐·巴特为克什米尔苏丹征服拉久里，贾拉尔罗阇作为附庸保留王位。

1586年阿克巴吞并克什米尔后，莫卧儿将罗阇置于庇护之下，授予米尔扎称号。该山邦击退1810年和1812年锡克人的进攻，但1813年查谟的古拉布·辛格击败罗阇阿加尔汗，将拉久里并入兰吉特·辛格的锡克帝国。

en:
The Rokkaku were a branch of the Sasaki family who held the governorship of Ōmi and built their power in the south of the province. Rokkaku Yoshikata ruled from Kannonji Castle after inheriting the family in 1552. In 1558 he mediated peace between Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiteru and Miyoshi Nagayoshi, allowing the shogun to return to Kyoto.

In 1560 Yoshikata suffered a serious defeat at Norada against Azai Nagamasa of northern Ōmi. The Rokkaku lost their grip on their domain in 1568.
zh:
六角氏是佐佐木氏的支流，担任近江守护，在近江南部建立势力。六角义贤于1552年继承家督，以观音寺城为居城。1558年，他调停将军足利义辉与三好长庆的和议，使将军得以返回京都。

1560年，义贤在野良田之战中被北近江的浅井长政击败。1568年，六角氏失去了对领国的控制。

en:
The Rankali were the Rankaliyya, a Kurdish tribe of the mountains of Hamadan, neighbours of the Kalaliyya. The Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari, writing in the 1340s, counted two thousand men, brave and resourceful, under Jamal al-Din Balan, who ruled Kangavar and its districts on the road to Kermanshah.

The Kermanshah plain, with Bisotun and the Holeylan hills, had long been Hasanwayhid and Annazid country before the Mongols sacked it in 1257; Kermanshah later passed to the Kalhor.
zh:
兰卡利即兰卡利亚部，是哈马丹山区的库尔德部落，与卡拉利亚部为邻。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，该部有两千人，勇敢而多谋，由贾马勒丁·巴兰统领；他统治坎加瓦尔及其周边，地处通往克尔曼沙阿的路上。

克尔曼沙阿平原连同比索通和霍莱兰山地，长期是哈桑韦赫王朝与安纳兹王朝的核心地带，1257年遭蒙古人洗劫，后来克尔曼沙阿落入卡尔霍尔人之手。

en:
The Raksels are a Rajput clan of the Yaduvanshi line who held the forested plateau of Palamu, south of Bihar, in the centuries before the Mughals. Their rajas built the old fort on the Auranga River, later a ruin amid the Betla jungles.

When Akbar's commander Man Singh marched into Palamu in 1574 the Raksels submitted, but after Akbar's death they drove out the Mughal garrison in 1605 and later refused the Patna subedar's tribute demands, drawing three imperial expeditions.

Palamu was lost when the Chero chief Bhagwant Rai rebelled while his Raksel overlord, also named Man Singh, was away in Surguja; the raja withdrew east with his clan and founded the Raksel state of Surguja, with its capital at Ambikapur. As Surguja rajas the Raksels became overlords of several small states, and in 1818 Surguja became a British protectorate.
zh:
拉克塞尔人是雅度系拉杰普特部族，在莫卧儿时代之前数百年据有比哈尔以南丛林密布的伯拉穆高原。其首领在奥兰加河畔修建旧要塞，后来只剩贝特拉丛林中的残垣。

1574年阿克巴的将领曼·辛格进军伯拉穆，拉克塞尔人一度臣服；阿克巴死后他们于1605年驱逐莫卧儿驻军，后来又拒绝巴特那省督索求的贡赋，招致三次帝国征讨。

伯拉穆最终失守：哲卢首领巴格万特·拉伊趁其宗主、与阿克巴将领同名的拉克塞尔首领曼·辛格前往苏尔古贾之机起兵；这位首领率部东撤，建立以安比卡布尔为都的苏尔古贾土邦。作为苏尔古贾王公，拉克塞尔人成为数个小邦的宗主，1818年苏尔古贾成为英国保护土邦。

en: Romania refers to lands inhabited by Romanians, including Wallachia, Moldavia and Transylvania. In 1600 Michael the Brave briefly ruled all three, although his union fell apart within a year.
zh: 罗马尼亚指罗马尼亚人居住的土地，包括瓦拉几亚、摩尔达维亚和特兰西瓦尼亚。1600年勇敢的米哈伊曾短暂统治三地，但这一联合不到一年便瓦解了。

en:
Rende was the country of the Rende tribe, one of the Wuman Yi tribes of the Dali Kingdom in northeastern Yunnan. The Yuan organized it as Rende Prefecture under hereditary Yi headmen.

In 1383 the Ming raised it to the Rende Military and Civilian Prefecture and soon renamed it the Xundian Military and Civilian Prefecture, confirming a local Yi woman, Sha Chen, as native prefect in 1384. In 1390 a military garrison was planted inside her territory at Mumiguan.

The chieftain line ended in the Chenghua reign, when the court carried out gaitu guiliu, replaced the tusi with appointed officials and made it Xundian Prefecture; the seat was moved below Mount Fengwu in 1528. In 1669 the Qing demoted it to Xundian Department under Qujing Prefecture.
zh:
仁德在大理国时期是乌蛮彝族仁德部的居地，地处云南东北部。元朝置仁德府，由世袭彝族首领治理。

1383年明朝升为仁德军民府，旋即改称寻甸军民府，1384年准彝族女土官沙琛袭任土知府；1390年又在其境内木密关驻军屯守。

成化年间土司世系终结，朝廷推行改土归流，废土官、派流官，定名寻甸府，1528年将治所迁到凤梧山下。1669年清朝将其降为曲靖府属下的寻甸州。

en:
The Rong holding in the hills of southern Sichuan was the heartland of the Bo people, an ancient people of the upper Yangtze remembered for their hanging coffins, hollowed from single logs, and their bronze drums. Their Lingxiao stronghold on Bowang Mountain, the last south Chinese holdout against the Mongols, fell in 1288.

In 1285 the Yuan court organized the district as Rongzhou, administered through the Mahu circuit. The Ming reduced Rongzhou to Rong County in 1371.

War returned in 1573, when imperial armies besieged Lingxiao; the Bo were killed or assimilated and vanished from written records. Rong County was renamed Xingwen the next year, a name celebrating civil order.
zh:
戎地位于川南山地，是僰人的核心居地。僰人是长江上游的古老民族，以整木凿成的悬棺和铜鼓闻名。他们在博望山的凌霄城是华南抵抗蒙古人的最后据点，1288年陷落。

1285年元朝将这一地区设为戎州，通过马湖路管辖。1371年明朝把戎州降为戎县。

1573年战火再起，官军围攻凌霄城，僰人或被杀或被同化，此后从文字记载中消失。次年戎县改名兴文，取偃武修文之意。

en: Ranekouh takes its name from the Ranekouh district in the hills of eastern Gilan, between the Caspian shore and the Alborz range, with its seat at the nearby port of Langarud. In the fourteenth century this countryside formed part of Bia-pish, the eastern Gilani polity ruled from Lahijan by local Alid sayyids and later by the Kar-Kiya dynasty.
zh: 拉内库赫得名于吉兰东部、夹在里海海岸与厄尔布尔士山脉之间的拉内库赫山区，治所设在附近的港口兰加鲁德。14世纪时，这一带属比亚皮什的一部分，即由拉希詹的阿里德圣裔、后来的卡尔基亚王朝统治的东吉兰政权。

en:
The Ranpur chiefdom was a small Jethwa Rajput domain in the Jhalavad region of Saurashtra. The Jethwas entered Saurashtra from Sindh and Kutch around the ninth century, founded Morvi as their capital, and held much of western Kathiawar by the time of Mahmud of Ghazni.

They lost Morvi to Qutb-ud-din Aibak in 1193 and later fixed their capital at Ghumli, which Rana Shiyaji restored as their seat in 1220. In 1313 Bamaniyaji Jadeja, son of Jam Unaji Jadeja of Sindh, sacked the city and drove out Rana Bhanji Jethwa, who moved his court to Ranpur.

The Jethwas kept this much-reduced territory for generations, later shifting to Chhaya and then in 1685 to the port of Porbandar, where their rana line continued into the nineteenth century.
zh:
兰普尔是萨乌拉施特拉恰拉瓦尔地区的杰特瓦拉杰普特小邦。杰特瓦人约9世纪从信德和卡奇进入萨乌拉施特拉，建莫尔维为都，到伽色尼的马哈茂德时代已据有卡提阿瓦西部大片土地。

1193年莫尔维被库特布丁·艾伊拜克攻占，他们后来定都古姆利，拉纳·希亚吉1220年再次以此为都。1313年信德的贾姆·乌纳吉·阇提奢之子巴曼尼亚吉攻陷该城，赶走拉纳·班吉·杰特瓦，后者把宫廷迁到兰普尔。

杰特瓦人守着这片大为缩小的领地延续多代，后来迁往查亚，又于1685年迁往港口博尔本德尔，其拉纳世系在那里延续到19世纪。

en: The Roman Empire ruled the Mediterranean world from Rome and later Constantinople, reaching its greatest extent under Trajan. Its eastern continuation survived the western empire's fall in 476, but lost Constantinople to the Ottomans in 1453.
zh: 罗马帝国先后以罗马和君士坦丁堡为中心统治地中海世界，在图拉真统治时期达到最大疆域。东罗马帝国在西罗马于476年灭亡后延续下来，但于1453年将君士坦丁堡失给奥斯曼人。

en:
Ross was the highland province north of the Moray Firth, ruled from Dingwall by its mormaers who also led Clan Ross. In the 1220s Fearchar MacTaggart was made earl after crushing a rebellion for Alexander II; he founded Fearn Abbey and began the O'Beolan line.

Earl Hugh died fighting for David II at Halidon Hill in 1333, and his son William returned from Norway to succeed him in 1336. In 1339 he helped take Perth from the English, but in 1346 he killed his vassal and withdrew before Neville's Cross. He died in 1372, the last O'Beolan earl.

David II had forced William's daughter Euphemia to marry Walter Leslie, and the earldom passed through the Leslies to the Stewart dukes. In 1411 Donald of the Isles invaded Ross and fought Harlaw; the MacDonald lords held it until it was forfeited in 1476.
zh:
罗斯是马里湾以北的高地省份，以丁沃尔为治所，由兼领罗斯氏族的莫马尔统治。13世纪20年代，费尔查尔·麦克塔加特因替亚历山大二世平叛受封伯爵，修建费恩修道院，开创奥贝兰世系。

1333年伯爵休在哈利顿山为大卫二世战死，其子威廉1336年从挪威返回承袭爵位。1339年他协助夺取珀斯，1346年他杀死附庸，在内维尔十字之战前撤兵。他1372年去世，是奥贝兰家族最后一位伯爵。

大卫二世此前已迫使威廉之女尤菲米娅嫁给沃尔特·莱斯利，伯爵领后经莱斯利家族转入斯图尔特公爵一系。1411年群岛领主唐纳德入侵罗斯，爆发哈洛战役；麦克唐纳领主据有该地，直到1476年被没收。

en:
Rothenburg takes its name from the red castle built above the Tauber around 1070 by the counts of Comburg-Rothenburg, whose line died out in 1116, the lands passing to the Hohenstaufen. The town below was founded in 1170, and in 1274 Rudolf of Habsburg made it a free imperial city.

Its rabbi Meir ben Baruch was one of the leading Jewish jurists before the Rintfleisch pogrom destroyed the community in 1298. Pilgrimage and three annual fairs made it one of the Empire's twenty largest cities by the fourteenth century, though an earthquake shattered the old castle in 1356.

It joined the Peasants' War in 1525 and was punished by Casimir of Kulmbach; the council introduced the Reformation only in 1544. In 1631 Tilly's army stormed the town, plague followed in 1634, and Rothenburg never regained its wealth. It passed to Bavaria in 1803.
zh:
罗滕堡得名于约1070年孔堡-罗滕堡伯爵在陶伯河高处修建的红色城堡；该家族1116年绝嗣，领地转入霍亨斯陶芬家族。山下城市建于1170年，1274年哈布斯堡的鲁道夫将它立为自由帝国城市。

当地拉比梅厄·本·巴鲁赫是重要的犹太教法学家之一，1298年林特弗莱希屠杀摧毁了犹太社区。朝圣和每年三次的集市使罗滕堡在14世纪跻身帝国二十大城市之列，1356年一场地震摧毁旧城堡。

1525年城市投身农民战争，遭库尔姆巴赫的卡齐米日报复；市议会直到1544年才引入宗教改革。1631年梯利的军队攻陷城市，1634年瘟疫接踵而至，罗滕堡再未恢复昔日富庶，1803年划归巴伐利亚。

en:
The County of Roucy was a lay peerage of Champagne in the Aisne valley north-west of Reims. Its first castle rose in 948, when Louis IV gave the land to his ally Renaud of Roucy; his son Gislebert first styled himself count of Roucy.

After the male lines of Roucy and Montdidier failed, heiress Eustachie married Robert of Pierrepont in 1204, bringing the county to the Pierrepont family. John V of Pierrepont held it in 1337 and fell fighting for France at Crécy in 1346; his grandson John VI was killed at Agincourt in 1415.

In 1370 Isabelle of Pierrepont sold Roucy to Louis of Anjou, but her uncle Simon recovered it after a twenty-year lawsuit in Paris. In 1415 heiress Jeanne of Pierrepont carried it by marriage to the Sarrebruck family, and it passed in 1525 to the Roye family and later to the La Rochefoucauld, keeping its peerage until the Revolution.
zh:
鲁西伯国是香槟的世俗贵族领地，据有兰斯西北的埃纳河谷。948年，路易四世把土地封给盟友雷诺·德·鲁西，第一座城堡由此修建；其子吉尔贝尔第一个自称鲁西伯爵。

鲁西和蒙迪迪耶家族男嗣断绝后，女继承人厄斯塔谢于1204年嫁给皮埃尔蓬的罗贝尔，伯国转入皮埃尔蓬家族。约翰五世1337年在位，1346年在克雷西为法兰西战死；其孙约翰六世1415年殒命阿金库尔。

1370年伊莎贝尔把鲁西卖给安茹的路易，其叔父西蒙在巴黎打了二十年官司终夺回伯国。1415年女继承人让娜经婚姻把伯国带入萨尔布吕肯家族，1525年转入鲁瓦家族，后归拉罗什富科家族，贵族领地地位保持到大革命。

en:
The Rappahannock were an Algonquian-speaking people of the river valley that bears their name in Virginia. In 1607 they had thirteen villages and a principal town at Topahanocke. English settlement forced them from the southern bank in the 1650s, and their leader Taweeren was killed in a dispute with colonists in 1654.

By 1669 they had moved to the headwaters of the Mattaponi. They joined Cockacoeske's renewed Powhatan confederacy in 1677 but withdrew the following year; in 1684 Virginia ordered them to merge with the Portobago.
zh:
拉帕汉诺克人是弗吉尼亚州拉帕汉诺克河谷的阿尔冈昆语族人群。1607年，他们拥有13个村落，主要聚落位于托帕汉诺克。17世纪50年代，英格兰殖民者的定居迫使他们离开南岸；1654年，首领塔韦伦在与殖民者的冲突中被杀。

到1669年，他们迁至马塔波尼河源头。1677年，他们加入科卡科斯克重建的波瓦坦联盟，次年又退出；1684年，弗吉尼亚殖民政府命令他们与波托巴戈人合并。

en:
Barru, called Berru in Bugis, was a small Bugis kingdom on the Makassar Strait coast of South Sulawesi, one of four small states in the Barru area. Lontara tradition traces it to La Sarewo, who cleared forest for rice fields and was enthroned beside the aju Berru tree that gave the realm its name.

In 1337 the throne belonged to its second ruler, Petta Cakkeawo, and under the fourth king the realm was split into an inland half, Berru Riaja, and a coastal half, Berru Rilau.

Islam reached Barru from neighbouring Tanete, and in 1606 its twelfth ruler became the first of the line to adopt the faith. The dynasty survived the Makassar wars and kept its own line of rulers, which in 1836 passed to Tenripadang Sultan Aisyah, a princess of Gowa.
zh:
巴鲁布吉语称贝鲁，是南苏拉威西望加锡海峡沿岸的布吉人小王国，为巴鲁地区四小邦之一。据布吉隆塔拉文献传说，开国君主拉萨雷沃开垦丛林为稻田，在赐予国名的贝鲁树旁登位。

1337年在位的是第二代君主佩塔·查凯奥；第四代君主在位时，王国分为山居的贝鲁里亚贾和临海的贝鲁里劳两部分。

伊斯兰教经邻邦塔内特传入，1606年第十二代君主成为家族中第一位穆斯林。王朝熬过历次望加锡战争，维持自己的君统，1836年王位传给出身戈瓦的公主滕里帕当·苏丹·艾莎。

en:
Rasht is the chief city of the Gilan lowlands near the Caspian coast, first mentioned in Umayyad records in 682. In the fourteenth century it was a market town of Bia-pas, the western half of Gilan ruled by the Sunni Eshaqvand dynasty from nearby Fuman.

Rasht grew rich on the silk trade through the port of Bandar-e Anzali. In 1572 Jamshid Soltan moved the Bia-pas capital from Fuman to Rasht, which became the seat of Gilan's governors after Shah Abbas I abolished the local dynasties in 1592.

Cossack raiders under Stenka Razin sacked it in 1669, an earthquake levelled much of the city in 1714, and Russian troops held it from 1722 to 1732.
zh:
拉什特是里海沿岸吉兰低地的首要城市，682年倭马亚文献中已有记载。14世纪时，它是吉兰西半部比亚帕斯的集镇，受定都富曼的逊尼派埃沙克万德王朝统治。

拉什特借安扎里港转运的生丝贸易致富。1572年贾姆希德苏丹把比亚帕斯都城从富曼迁到拉什特；1592年阿拔斯一世废除地方王朝后，它成为吉兰总督驻地。

1669年斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克袭掠该城，1714年地震摧毁大片城区，1722—1732年俄军占领拉什特。

en:
The Principality of Rostov was a Rus' appanage principality centered on Rostov Veliky, on Lake Nero northeast of Moscow. First recorded in 862 and one of the oldest towns of northeast Rus', Rostov had headed the Rostov-Suzdal land before Yuri Dolgorukiy moved his seat to Suzdal in 1125. In 1207 it became a principality for Konstantin, eldest son of Vsevolod the Big Nest, with holdings in Beloozero, Uglich and Yaroslavl, split among his sons after 1218.

In 1238 the Mongols overran Rostov, and Prince Vasilko was killed after the Battle of the Sit River. The city joined the anti-Tatar rising of 1262, yet its princes kept close Golden Horde ties. In 1328 the principality was divided between two princely lines, one half passing to Ivan I of Moscow by 1332.

Moscow-backed princes took control in the 1360s. A Moscow governor sat in Rostov from 1433, and in 1474 Ivan III bought the remaining half from its last princes.
zh:
罗斯托夫公国是以莫斯科东北方涅罗湖畔的大罗斯托夫为中心的罗斯封邑公国。大罗斯托夫862年即见记载，是东北罗斯最古老的城市之一，曾是罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔领地的中心，1125年尤里·多尔戈鲁基把治所迁往苏兹达尔。1207年，弗谢沃洛德（大窝）的长子康斯坦丁受封罗斯托夫，领地还包括别洛奥泽罗、乌格利奇和雅罗斯拉夫尔等地，1218年后这些土地被他的儿子们瓜分。

1238年蒙古人攻陷罗斯托夫，王公瓦西里科在锡季河战役后遇害。1262年该城参加反抗鞑靼人的起义，但此后罗斯托夫王公与金帐汗国关系密切。1328年公国被两支王族一分为二，其中一半到1332年已落入莫斯科的伊凡一世之手。

14世纪60年代，得到莫斯科支持的王公完全掌权；1433年起罗斯托夫由莫斯科总督治理，1474年伊凡三世从末代王公手中买下剩余的一半。

en:
The Lordship of Rostock arose from the partition of Mecklenburg in 1227, with its seat at the Baltic port of Rostock. Its last prince, Nicholas I, sought Danish protection against neighboring Mecklenburg rulers, but Denmark gained effective control.

Henry II of Mecklenburg took Rostock in 1312 and received it as a Danish hereditary fief in 1323, ending the independent lordship. The city, a member of the Hanseatic League from 1251, founded its university in 1419. The dukes of Mecklenburg enforced their authority over the city at the end of the fifteenth century.
zh:
罗斯托克领国在1227年梅克伦堡分割时产生，以波罗的海港口罗斯托克为治所。末代领主尼古拉一世为抵御邻近的梅克伦堡诸侯而寻求丹麦保护，丹麦却因此取得了实际控制权。

梅克伦堡的亨利二世于1312年夺取罗斯托克，1323年获封为丹麦的世袭采邑，独立领国随之消失。罗斯托克城自1251年起是汉萨同盟成员，1419年创办大学。15世纪末，梅克伦堡公爵加强了对这座城市的统治。

en:
Ritzebüttel was a small lordship on the Lower Elbe near its mouth on the North Sea coast, held by the Lappe family as a fief of the Dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg. Around 1340 the Lappes built the brick residential tower at the core of Ritzebüttel Castle, guarding the entrance to the Lower Elbe; the strongpoint also commanded a winter harbour.

Disputes with the Hanseatic city of Hamburg led to a siege in 1393, and on 31 July 1394 the castle and its lands passed from the Lappes to Hamburg, which ruled it through its own bailiffs for centuries.
zh:
里策比特尔是北海沿岸、下易北河近入海口处的小领地，由拉佩家族作为萨克森-劳恩堡公爵的封邑持有。约1340年，拉佩家族修建砖砌居住塔楼，作为里策比特尔城堡的核心，扼守下易北河入口，要塞还控制一处冬季港口。

与汉萨城市汉堡的争端引发1393年围攻，1394年7月31日城堡及领地从拉佩家族转入汉堡之手，此后数百年汉堡由自己的行政官治理该地。

en:
The Ratnapura kingdom was the eastern branch of the Kalachuris, also called Haihaya, rulers of old Chedi. Around 1000 Kalinga-raja, a younger son of the Tripuri house, conquered Dakshina Kosala from the Somavamshi kings and fixed his capital at Tummana; his grandson Ratna-deva I founded Ratnapura.

Jajalla-deva I made the branch effectively independent and in 1114 invaded the Chindaka Naga lands and captured their king Somesvara, while Ratna-deva II formally threw off Tripuri rule and drove back an invasion by Anantavarman Chodaganga of the Eastern Gangas. The last well-attested early king, Pratapa-malla, ruled in the early thirteenth century; inscriptions then fall silent until Vahara, recorded in 1494 and 1513.

Ringed by steep hills, the country was spared the Muslim invasions of northern India in the thirteenth to sixteenth centuries, and in the late fourteenth century the house split into Ratanpur and Raipur branches. The later rajas held out until 1740, when they accepted the suzerainty of the Maratha Bhonsles of Nagpur; the Bhonsles annexed the kingdom after Mohan Singh died about 1758.
zh:
拉特纳普勒王国是迦罗朱利人的东支，该家族自称诃伊诃耶，本是古老车底国的统治者。约1000年，特里普里迦罗朱利王室的幼子卡林伽拉杰从索马万什诸王手中征服南拘萨罗，定都图马纳；其孙拉特那·德瓦一世兴建拉特纳普拉。

贾贾拉·德瓦一世使该支实际独立，1114年攻入钦达卡那伽人的土地，俘获其王索梅斯瓦拉；拉特那·德瓦二世正式摆脱特里普里的宗主权，击退东恒伽王阿南塔瓦尔曼·乔达恒伽的入侵。早期最后一位有确凿记载的君主普拉塔帕·马拉在13世纪初在位，此后碑铭长期空白，直到1494和1513年有铭文存世的瓦哈拉时期。

由于四周被陡峭山岭环绕，这片国土避开了13至16世纪席卷北印的穆斯林入侵；14世纪末，家族分裂为拉坦布尔和赖布尔两支。后期诸拉贾坚持到1740年，接受那格浦尔马拉塔邦斯勒家族的宗主权，邦斯勒家族在莫汉·辛格约1758年去世后兼并了这个王国。

en:
Ngāti Ruanui were a Māori iwi of southern Taranaki on New Zealand's North Island. They traced their descent from Ruanui, whose maternal grandfather Turi settled beside the Pātea River.

In 1816 Ngāpuhi warriors armed with muskets invaded their lands from the north. Further attacks by Ngāti Toa, Ngāti Whātua and Waikato tribes brought captivity and displacement to Ngāti Ruanui during the Musket Wars.
zh:
雅提卢阿努依是新西兰北岛南塔拉纳基地区的毛利部族。族人追溯祖先至卢阿努依，其外祖父图里曾在帕泰阿河畔定居。

1816年，持火枪的恩加普希战士从北方入侵其土地。火枪战争期间，恩加蒂托阿、恩加蒂法图阿和怀卡托各部的进一步进攻，使雅提卢阿努依族人遭到俘虏和流离失所。

en:
Ruppin was the lordship, later styled a county, of the counts of Lindow-Ruppin around Lake Ruppin in Brandenburg. Once Slavic Zamzizi land, it passed under German rule after the Wendish Crusade of 1147. Around 1214 Count Gebhard of Arnstein, great-grandson of Albert the Bear, acquired it as a probably immediate fief and founded the Lindow-Ruppin line; he built Castle Ruppin and Neuruppin, which received town rights in 1256.

From the late thirteenth century the lords styled themselves counts. In 1337 Count Ulrich II ruled; his father Ulrich I had died in 1316, and he held the county until 1356.

The counts' territory grew, though the lordship fell under the overlordship of Brandenburg's margraves. When Count Wichmann died heirless in 1524, Elector Joachim I annexed Ruppin. A kinsman's suit then failed in 1562.
zh:
鲁平是林多-鲁平伯爵家族的领地，后也称伯国，位于勃兰登堡鲁平湖一带。此地原属斯拉夫人扎姆齐齐部落，1147年文德十字军后转入德意志统治。约1214年，大熊阿尔布雷希特的曾孙、阿恩施泰因伯爵格布哈特取得此地，受封很可能直属帝国的领地，开创林多-鲁平支系；他修筑鲁平城堡、兴建新鲁平，后者于1256年获得城市权。

13世纪末起，领主自称伯爵；1337年乌尔里希二世在位，其父乌尔里希一世卒于1316年，他统治到1356年去世。

领地虽有扩张，却已处于勃兰登堡藩侯宗主权之下。1524年伯爵维希曼无嗣而终，选侯约阿希姆一世吞并鲁平；亲属提起的诉讼于1562年被驳回。

en:
Russia emerged from the expansion of Moscow, whose grand prince Ivan III built a centralized state in the late fifteenth century. His grandson Ivan IV was crowned tsar in 1547. Russian rule expanded across Siberia, while dynastic upheaval brought the Romanovs to the throne in 1613.

Peter the Great reformed the state and, after victory over Sweden in the Great Northern War, proclaimed the Russian Empire in 1721. He moved the capital from Moscow to Saint Petersburg. Catherine II expanded the empire further during her reign from 1762 to 1796, and Alexander I helped defeat Napoleon in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
俄罗斯兴起于莫斯科的扩张，莫斯科大公伊凡三世在15世纪末建立了中央集权国家。他的孙子伊凡四世于1547年加冕为沙皇。俄罗斯的统治扩展到西伯利亚，王朝动荡则使罗曼诺夫家族于1613年登上王位。

彼得大帝改革国家，在大北方战争中战胜瑞典后，于1721年宣布建立俄罗斯帝国。他将首都从莫斯科迁至圣彼得堡。叶卡捷琳娜二世在1762—1796年统治期间进一步扩张帝国，亚历山大一世则在19世纪初协助击败拿破仑。

en:
Rutul was the chief village of the Rutuls, a Northeast Caucasian people of the upper Samur river basin in southern Dagestan, whose ancestors had belonged to the tribal union of Caucasian Albania. Their villages formed a free society, the Rutul Magal, a federation of rural communities led by a hereditary bek who had to convene the popular assembly for important affairs.

In 1536 the Rutuls attacked the Safavid stronghold of Akhty, and in 1542 they struck it again with the backing of the Quba Khanate; by the later sixteenth century, under the bek Gazibek, the federation corresponded on equal terms with the Ottoman sultan and the Safavid shah.

In the seventeenth century it absorbed Tsakhur villages and ranked among the largest free societies of Dagestan, until the Russian Empire gained the region under the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813.
zh:
鲁图尔是鲁图尔人最主要的村镇。鲁图尔人是达吉斯坦南部萨穆尔河上游的东北高加索民族，先民曾臣属高加索阿尔巴尼亚的部落联盟。他们的村落组成自由公社鲁图尔马加尔，由世袭的伯克领导，遇有大事则须召集民众大会。

1536年，鲁图尔人进攻萨法维王朝在南达吉斯坦的据点阿赫特，1542年又在库巴汗国支持下再度出击；16世纪后期伯克加齐别克当政时，这个联盟已能与奥斯曼苏丹和萨法维沙阿平等往来。

17世纪，它兼并察胡尔人的村庄，跻身达吉斯坦最大的自由公社之列，直到1813年《古利斯坦条约》将该地区并入俄罗斯帝国。

en:
Ravensburg lies at a ford of the Schussen on the old road between the Danube and Lake Constance. It grew beneath a castle of the Welfs, their ancestral seat from the eleventh century, and was first documented in 1088. On the extinction of the Hohenstaufen it fell to the Empire, and in 1276 Emperor Rudolf I made it a Free Imperial City.

Its merchant families, led by the Humpis, founded the Great Ravensburg Trading Society around 1380, which dealt in linen, spices and wine until its collapse in 1530. After the Reformation, Ravensburg became one of four paritetic imperial cities, dividing offices equally between Catholics and Protestants, confirmed by the Peace of Westphalia in 1648.

The Thirty Years' War emptied and impoverished the town. The mediatisation of 1803 assigned it to Bavaria, and it passed to Württemberg in 1810.
zh:
拉芬斯堡位于舒森河渡口，扼守多瑙河与博登湖之间的古道。11世纪韦尔夫家族在镇旁修建城堡，作为祖传居所；城镇最早于1088年见于记载。霍亨斯陶芬家族绝嗣后，拉芬斯堡收归帝国，1276年皇帝鲁道夫一世将其立为帝国自由城市。

以洪皮斯家族为首的商人世家约于1380年组建拉芬斯堡大贸易公司，经营亚麻、香料和葡萄酒，直到1530年倒闭。宗教改革后，拉芬斯堡成为四个实行两教平分制的帝国城市之一，公职由天主教徒和新教徒均分，1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》确认此制。

三十年战争使人口锐减、城市凋敝；1803年陪臣化时划给巴伐利亚，1810年转归符腾堡。

en:
The County of Ravensberg was an East Westphalian territory at the foot of the Teutoburg Forest. Around 1100 the counts of Calvelage built Ravensberg Castle there; Count Otto I made it his seat about 1140 as count of Ravensberg. Partition in 1226 and the sale of northern estates in 1252 confined them to East Westphalia.

In 1337 Count Bernard ruled, the last of his line; on his death in 1346 the county passed through his heiress Margaret to Gerhard of Jülich. It was joined first with Berg, then with Jülich-Berg, and in 1521 with the Jülich-Cleves-Berg duchies; by 1600 its people were entirely Lutheran.

When that dynasty died out in 1609, the 1614 Treaty of Xanten assigned Ravensberg to Brandenburg. From 1719 it formed Minden-Ravensberg, while Bielefeld grew rich on linen; the county passed to Westphalia in 1807 and back to Prussia in 1813.
zh:
拉芬斯贝格伯国是条顿堡林山脚下的东威斯特伐利亚领地。1100年前后卡尔费拉格家族建拉芬斯贝格城堡；奥托一世约1140年迁此，改称拉芬斯贝格伯爵。1226年分家、1252年出售北方领地后，收缩到东威斯特伐利亚。

1337年贝尔纳德在位，为家族最后男嗣；1346年去世后，伯国经女继承人玛格丽特归于利希格哈德。此后先与贝格联合，再并入于利希-贝格，1521年并入于利希-克莱沃-贝格；1600年居民尽改路德宗。

王朝1609年绝嗣，1614年《克桑滕条约》把它划归勃兰登堡。1719年设明登-拉芬斯贝格，比勒费尔德以亚麻贸易致富；1807年并入威斯特伐利亚，1813年复归普鲁士。

en:
The Kingdom of Rwanda grew from a chiefdom centered on Gasabo hill near Lake Muhazi. Between the 14th and 16th centuries its rulers gradually brought neighboring chiefdoms under their authority, absorbing central Rwanda during the 16th century.

Tradition recalls King Ruganzu II Ndoli taking refuge in Karagwe before returning to Rwanda. He became known as a warrior king, and some historians regard him as the founder of the later kingdom.
zh:
卢旺达王国由穆哈齐湖附近、以加萨博山丘为中心的酋邦发展而来。14至16世纪，其统治者逐渐将邻近酋邦纳入治下，并于16世纪吞并了卢旺达中部地区。

传说国王鲁甘祖二世·恩多利曾在卡拉圭避难，后来返回卢旺达。他以勇武的国王闻名，一些历史学家将他视为后来王国的奠基者。

en:
The Principality of Ryazan, later a grand principality, was the easternmost Russian principality and kept its formal independence longest. It emerged by 1129, when Yaroslav Sviatoslavich split the Murom-Ryazan land from Chernigov. Its first capital was sacked and destroyed in the Mongol invasion of December 1237, the first Rus' city to fall to Batu Khan; remembered as Old Ryazan, it gave way as the seat to Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, later Ryazan.

In 1337 Prince Ivan II Korotopol held the throne. Prince Daniel of Moscow had seized the city in 1301, and Ryazan thereafter balanced between Moscow, the Golden Horde and Lithuania: Prince Oleg II was defeated by Muscovites in 1371 and stood aside at Kulikovo in 1380.

A long feud with appanage Pronsk ended when Ryazan annexed it in 1483. In 1520 Vasili III imprisoned the last Ryazan prince, Ivan Ivanovich, and in 1521 the principality was incorporated into Muscovy.
zh:
梁赞公国后称大公国，是罗斯诸公国中位置最东、正式独立最久的一个。1129年前后，雅罗斯拉夫·斯维亚托斯拉维奇率穆罗姆-梁赞领地脱离切尔尼戈夫。1237年12月蒙古入侵，旧都遭洗劫，成为拔都汗攻陷的第一座罗斯城市，称旧梁赞；都城北迁佩列亚斯拉夫尔-梁赞斯基，后沿用梁赞之名。

1337年伊凡二世·科罗托波尔在位。早在1301年莫斯科王公丹尼尔攻占该城，此后梁赞周旋于莫斯科、金帐汗国与立陶宛之间：王公奥列格二世1371年被莫斯科人击败，1380年库里科沃之战按兵不动。

与封邑普龙斯克的长期争斗以梁赞1483年兼并普龙斯克告终。1520年瓦西里三世囚禁末代王公伊凡·伊凡诺维奇，1521年梁赞公国并入莫斯科国。

en:
The Principality of Rylsk was a small Rurikovich appanage in the Seim region, centered on Rylsk, a Siverian town first chronicled in 1152. Its first prince, Svyatoslav Olgovich, fought the Cumans in 1183 and was captured in the defeat of 1185 told in The Tale of Igor's Campaign.

Mongols stormed the town around 1240 and killed two princes later in that decade. In the 1280s Prince Oleg resisted a Horde tax collector; Nogai's Tatars ravaged the Seim lands and Oleg died in a princely feud. In the 1350s and 1360s Rylsk passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania; Prince Fyodor Patrikeevich died in its service at the Vorskla in 1399.

In 1454 Casimir IV granted Rylsk to fugitive Ivan Shemyakin. His son Vasily submitted to Ivan III in 1500; in 1523 Vasily was arrested and his appanage abolished.
zh:
雷利斯克公国是谢伊姆河流域的留里克小封邑，以谢韦里亚城镇雷利斯克为中心，1152年最早见于编年史。首任王公斯维亚托斯拉夫·奥利戈维奇1183年出征波洛伏齐人，1185年兵败被俘，事见《伊戈尔远征记》。

1240年前后蒙古人猛攻该城，那十年间两位王公被杀。13世纪80年代，王公奥列格抗拒汗国征税官，那海的鞑靼人洗劫谢伊姆，奥列格随后死于内讧。14世纪50至60年代雷利斯克并入立陶宛大公国；雷利斯克王公费奥多尔·帕特里克耶维奇1399年为立陶宛战死沃尔斯克拉河。

1454年卡齐米日四世将雷利斯克封给流亡的伊凡·舍米亚金；子瓦西里1500年归顺伊凡三世，1523年被捕，封邑撤销。

en:
The Ryūkyū Kingdom was an island kingdom ruled from Shuri on Okinawa. Traditionally, its founder Shō Hashi is credited with defeating Hokuzan in 1416 and Nanzan in 1429, ending the division of Okinawa among three rival polities. By 1430 he was the island's sole tributary to Ming China.

Ryūkyū became a link in maritime trade between East and Southeast Asia and expanded into the Amami and Sakishima islands. In 1609 an invasion by Japan's Satsuma domain made the kingdom its vassal, while Ryūkyū continued its tributary relationship with China.
zh:
琉球王国是以冲绳岛首里为中心的岛国。按照传统记载，开国君主尚巴志于1416年击败北山、1429年击败南山，结束了冲绳三山鼎立的局面。到1430年，他已成为岛上唯一向明朝朝贡的君主。

琉球成为东亚与东南亚海上贸易网络的枢纽，并向奄美和先岛诸岛扩张。1609年，日本萨摩藩入侵琉球，使王国成为其附庸；琉球同时继续向中国朝贡。

en:
Ratzeburg was a prince-bishopric of the Holy Roman Empire, its island cathedral town among Mecklenburg's western lakes. A first diocese carved out of the Oldenburg see around 1060 by Archbishop Adalbert of Bremen perished in the Obodrite rising of 1066, when the monk Ansverus was stoned to death.

The see was re-founded in 1154 under Duke Henry the Lion, who installed the Premonstratensian Evermod as bishop; Hadrian IV confirmed it in 1158, and its Romanesque cathedral rose from 1170. When the old comital line died out, the bishops acquired its advocacies, and from about 1230 they sat as imperial princes over the Hochstift, which joined the Lower Saxon Circle in 1500.

In 1337 Bishop Volrad von dem Dorne held the see, occupying it until his death in 1355. The Reformation ended the Catholic diocese: the chapter turned Protestant, and the secularised bishopric was suppressed in 1554.
zh:
拉策堡是神圣罗马帝国的主教采邑，座堂城镇为梅克伦堡西端湖间岛城。最早教区约1060年由不来梅大主教阿达尔贝特自奥尔登堡教区划出，1066年在奥博特里特人起义中覆灭，修士安斯韦鲁斯被乱石砸死。

1154年狮子亨利重建教区，任命普雷蒙特雷修会的埃弗莫德为主教，哈德良四世1158年批准，罗马式主教座堂1170年起兴建。旧伯爵家族绝嗣后，主教取得其代管权，约1230年起以帝国诸侯统治该采邑，1500年加入下萨克森行政圈。

1337年福尔拉德·冯·德姆·多恩主教在位，任职到1355年去世。宗教改革终结了这个天主教教区：圣职团改宗新教，世俗化的主教区1554年正式撤销。

en:
The Principality of Rzhev was a small Rus' appanage around the uppermost Volga town of Rzhev, whose fortress and trade route made it contested by rival Rus' powers and Lithuania. First chronicled in 1216, it passed from the Toropets branch of the Smolensk dynasty late in the thirteenth century to the Fominsky princes.

In 1314 its prince Fyodor Yuryevich served the Moscow prince Yuri Danilovich in Novgorod; the next year Grand Prince Mikhail of Tver captured him and confiscated the appanage, after which Rzhev fell to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. The town changed hands repeatedly: Algirdas of Lithuania seized it in 1356, Moscow retook it in 1358 and 1368, and it passed back and forth until the time of Dmitry Donskoy.

In the fifteenth century Serpukhov princes, Dmitry Shemyaka and Tver princes held it in turn, and in 1521, its line extinct, it was incorporated into Moscow.
zh:
勒热夫公国是以伏尔加河最上游城镇勒热夫为中心的罗斯小封邑。要塞扼守商路，长期遭罗斯诸强与立陶宛争夺。它1216年首见编年史，原属斯摩棱斯克王朝托罗佩茨支系，13世纪末转入福明斯克王公之手。

1314年王公费奥多尔·尤里耶维奇随莫斯科王公尤里·丹尼洛维奇出征诺夫哥罗德；次年特维尔大公米哈伊尔将他俘获并没收封邑，勒热夫此后归入立陶宛大公国。该城反复易手：立陶宛的阿尔吉尔达斯1356年攻占，莫斯科1358年、1368年两度夺回，到德米特里·顿斯科伊时代才渐稳定。

15世纪，谢尔普霍夫王公、德米特里·舍米亚卡和特维尔王公先后领有该地；1521年支系绝嗣，并入莫斯科。

en:
The County of Saarbrücken, on the Saar in Upper Lorraine, began around 1080, when Henry IV enfeoffed Count Siegbert of the Saargau; in 1118 Siegbert's son Frederick first took the count's title. About 1183 partition hived off the Palatinate lands as the County of Zweibrücken.

Simon III joined the Fifth Crusade, and when he left no son the county passed through his daughters; the second, Mathilda, married Simon of Commercy in 1271, bringing the Broyes-Commercy dynasty that ruled in 1337 under John I.

John II was captured with King John of France at Poitiers in 1356 and held in England until 1360; on his death in 1381 the line failed, and his daughter's marriage to a Nassau-Weilburg count carried it to the House of Nassau. Repeatedly divided, it was occupied by French troops in 1793 and annexed in 1797.
zh:
萨尔布吕肯伯国位于上洛林萨尔河畔，始于1080年前后，亨利四世把当地地产封给萨尔高伯爵西格贝特；1118年其子腓特烈首次自称萨尔布吕肯伯爵。约1183年分家，普法尔茨领地划出另立茨魏布吕肯伯国。

西蒙三世参加过第五次十字军，因无子而由女儿们继承伯国；次女玛蒂尔德1271年嫁给科梅尔西的西蒙，布罗瓦—科梅尔西王朝由此入主，1337年在位的约翰一世即出自该家族。

约翰二世1356年在普瓦捷与法王约翰一同被俘，囚于英格兰至1360年；1381年去世后男系断绝，女儿嫁与拿骚—魏尔堡伯爵，萨尔布吕肯转入拿骚家族。此后几经分割，1793年被法军占领，1797年被吞并。

en:
Sausenberg was a lordship in the far south-west of the Holy Roman Empire, in the Markgräflerland between Freiburg and Basel, with its seat above Kandern. The land first belonged to the Benedictine abbey of St Blaise, until the counts of Hachberg bought it in 1232 and built Sausenburg Castle.

In 1306 the Hachberg inheritance was divided and the ruling branch took the title of margraves of Hachberg-Sausenberg, a cadet line of the house of Baden and Zähringen. In 1316 the margraves inherited the nearby lordship of Rötteln and moved their residence there, and in 1444 they added Badenweiler; the three lands formed the Markgräflerland.

The last margrave, Philip, died without sons in 1503, and Sausenberg passed by inheritance to Christopher I of Baden. Sausenburg Castle was destroyed by French troops in 1678 during the Franco-Dutch War.
zh:
绍森贝格是神圣罗马帝国西南端的一块领地，地处弗赖堡与巴塞尔之间的马克格雷夫勒兰，治所在坎德恩上方。这片土地原属圣布拉辛的本笃会修道院，1232年被哈赫贝格伯爵购得并修建绍森堡。

1306年哈赫贝格分家，统治支系称哈赫贝格-绍森贝格藩侯，是巴登及策林根家族的旁支。1316年藩侯家族继承邻近的勒特伦领地并迁居那里，1444年又取得巴登韦勒，三块领地合为马克格雷夫勒兰。

末代藩侯菲利普1503年无子而终，绍森贝格随继承归于巴登藩侯克里斯托夫一世。绍森堡则在1678年法荷战争中被法军摧毁。

en:
The Sagaing kingdom was a small Upper Burmese state of 1315 to 1365, ruled by a junior Myinsaing branch from its capital on the Irrawaddy opposite later Ava. Its territory covered the Mu valley, and it began as the northern province of Pinya.

In 1315 Prince Saw Yun, son of King Thihathu, left the Pinya court and fought his father to a standstill, winning autonomy by 1317; after Thihathu's death Sagaing formally seceded in 1325. Its survival owed much to Pinya's divisions, though its own court was dominated by chief minister Nanda Pakyan, who manipulated weak kings from the mid-1330s to the 1350s.

Sagaing bore the brunt of Maw Shan invasions from 1356 to 1364, and in 1364 Maw troops sacked the city and then Pinya. Saw Yun's grandson Thado Minbya seized both ruined capitals and in 1365 founded Ava.
zh:
实皆王国是1315至1365年间存在于上缅甸的小邦，由敏象王朝旁支统治，都城在伊洛瓦底江畔，与后来的阿瓦隔河相望。领有穆河谷，最初是彬牙的北方省份。

1315年，底哈都王之子苏云王子离开彬牙宫廷，举兵与父王对抗，至1317年取得自治；底哈都死后，实皆1325年正式独立。它能立国，很大程度上靠彬牙自身的分裂，而实皆宫廷也由首相南达巴坚把持，1330年代中期至1350年代连立数位弱主。

1356至1364年，崛起的掸人政权麓川屡次入侵，实皆首当其冲；1364年麓川军队洗劫实皆，继而攻陷彬牙。苏云之孙德多明帕耶随即夺取两座残破都城，1365年建立阿瓦王国。

en: The Sakha were Turkic-speaking communities of the Lena River region in northeastern Siberia. In 1632 the Cossack Pyotr Beketov founded Yakutsk on the Lena; two years later Sakha fighters defeated Ivan Galkin's Cossack detachment and besieged the fort. The Russian authorities established the Yakut voivodeship in 1638.
zh: 萨哈人是西伯利亚东北部勒拿河流域讲突厥语的族群。1632年哥萨克彼得·别克托夫在勒拿河畔建立雅库茨克；两年后萨哈人击败伊万·加尔金的哥萨克部队，围攻这座堡垒。1638年俄国当局设立雅库茨克总督区。

en:
The Marquisate of Saluzzo was a small Piedmontese state wedged between the Alps and the Po. In 1142 Manfred I became its first marquis on the partition of the mark of Susa; his del Vasto dynasty held it until 1548, repeatedly clashing with Savoy's counts.

The fifteenth century was its golden age: Ludovico I stayed neutral and mediated between the Italian powers, while Ludovico II drove the Buco di Viso tunnel through Monte Viso to open a safe road to the Dauphiné and Provence. He withstood a Savoyard siege in 1486 with French help, yielded in 1487, returning in 1490.

Succession quarrels after his death weakened it, and in 1548 France deposed its last marquis Gabriele and annexed Saluzzo. Savoyard troops occupied it in 1588, and the 1601 Treaty of Lyon confirmed its transfer to Savoy. Boccaccio set his Griselda tale there.
zh:
萨卢佐侯国是夹在阿尔卑斯山与波河之间的皮埃蒙特小邦。1142年曼弗雷德一世在苏萨边区分封时成为初代侯爵，德尔·瓦斯托王朝统治到1548年，不断与萨伏依伯爵冲突。

15世纪是萨卢佐的黄金时代：卢多维科一世保持中立，在意大利诸强间调停；卢多维科二世开凿穿过蒙维索山的维索隧道，打通通往多菲内和普罗旺斯的安全商道。他靠法国援助于1486年顶住萨伏依围攻，1487年屈服，1490年复辟。

他死后的继承纷争削弱了国势，1548年法国废黜末代侯爵加布里埃莱并吞并萨卢佐。1588年萨伏依军队占领，1601年《里昂条约》确认划归萨伏依。薄伽丘的格里塞尔达故事即以该侯国为背景。

en:
The Samoan islands were among the earliest homes of Polynesian culture: Lapita pottery dates settlers to around 1500–900 BCE, and the Tui Manuʻa, Polynesia's oldest chiefly title, led a maritime confederacy reaching toward Fiji and Tonga.

As it waned, the Tuʻi Tonga Empire ruled Savaiʻi, Upolu and Tutuila for some four centuries after about 950, leaving Manuʻa untouched as sacred land. Tradition dates the revolt to about 1250, when the brothers Tuna, Fata and Savea drove out the Tuʻi Tonga Talakaifaiki; Savea took the paramount title Malietoa, from the fleeing king's praise mālie toa.

Warrior queen Nafanua and her niece Salamasina shaped the faʻamatai, a decentralized system of family and village chiefs. Jacob Roggeveen sighted the islands in 1722 and Bougainville named them the Navigator Islands in 1768; contact stayed thin until 1830, when John Williams landed and Malietoa Vainuʻupo opened Samoa to Christianity.
zh:
萨摩亚诸岛是波利尼西亚文化最早摇篮之一：拉皮塔陶器显示定居者约公元前1500至前900年抵达；波利尼西亚最古老的酋长头衔图伊马努阿统领海上邦联，势力远及斐济、汤加。

该势力衰落后，图伊汤加帝国约950年起统治萨瓦伊、乌波卢和图图伊拉约四百年，唯马努阿作为圣地未遭占领。相传约1250年，图纳、法塔、萨韦亚三兄弟起义，赶走图伊汤加塔拉凯法伊基；萨韦亚采用最高头衔马列托亚，名出败退国王之赞。

武士女王纳法努阿和侄女萨拉马西娜奠定法阿马泰，即家族与村落酋长分权制。罗赫芬1722年望见群岛，布干维尔1768年命名为航海家群岛，接触不多；1830年约翰·威廉斯登岛，马列托亚·瓦伊努乌波接纳基督教。

en:
The County of Sancerre was a small fief in Upper Berry, centred on a fortified hilltown above the Loire. In 1152 it went to Stephen, younger son of the count of Champagne, whose Blois cadet branch ruled it as counts. Stephen granted the Customs of Lorris in 1155, among the Capetian kingdom's most liberal charters, and in 1190 he was among the first French lords to abolish serfdom on his lands.

In 1337 Count Louis II, born around 1305, had succeeded his father John II in 1326; he fell fighting the English at Crécy in 1346. His younger son Louis of Sancerre became constable of France.

The county twice repelled English assaults during the Hundred Years' War, endured an eight-month siege as a Huguenot stronghold in 1572 and 1573, and was sold in 1637 to Henry II of Bourbon, prince of Condé.
zh:
桑塞尔伯国是上贝里的小封地，以卢瓦尔河畔一座设防山城为中心。1152年香槟伯爵幼子艾蒂安受封于此，其布卢瓦家族旁支世代承袭伯爵。艾蒂安1155年颁赐《洛里斯惯例》，是卡佩王国最开明的城市特许状之一；1190年他又成为法国最早在领地废除农奴制的领主之一。

1337年在位的路易二世约生于1305年，1326年继承父亲让二世；1346年他在克雷西战役中与英军作战时阵亡。其幼子桑塞尔的路易后来官至法兰西统帅。

百年战争中桑塞尔两次击退英军；宗教战争期间作为胡格诺据点，在1572—1573年坚守八个月围攻，1637年伯国卖给孔代亲王亨利二世·德·波旁。

en:
The Lordship of Salona was a Crusader state in central Greece, centred on fortress-town Salona, present-day Amfissa. In 1205 Boniface of Montferrat, King of Thessalonica, appointed Thomas I d'Autremencourt its first lord. After brief occupation by Epirus around 1210 to 1212, it became a vassal of Achaea and then of Athens.

The last French lord, Thomas III, fell at the Cephissus in 1311; after the Catalan Company's victory the fief passed in 1318 to Alfonso Fadrique, as Count of Salona. In 1337 Alfonso Fadrique still ruled, within the Catalan Duchy of Neopatras.

Navarrese troops overran it in 1380, and under the unpopular regent Helena Kantakouzene the townsmen opened their gates to Bayezid I in 1394. The Despotate of the Morea sold Salona to the Knights Hospitaller in 1404, but the Ottomans conquered it for good in 1410.
zh:
萨洛纳领地是希腊中部的十字军国家，中心为要塞萨洛纳，今安菲萨。1205年萨洛尼卡国王蒙费拉托的博尼法乔任命托马斯一世·德·奥特勒芒古为首任领主。1210—1212年前后遭伊庇鲁斯短暂占领后，先后成为亚该亚侯国和雅典公国附庸。

末代法领托马斯三世1311年战死凯菲索斯河；加泰罗尼亚佣兵团胜后，封邑1318年归阿方索·法德里克，称萨洛纳伯爵。1337年阿方索·法德里克仍在任，隶于加泰罗尼亚新帕特拉斯公国。

1380年纳瓦拉军攻占；不得人心的摄政海伦娜·坎塔库泽娜任内，居民1394年向巴耶济德一世开城。摩里亚1404年把萨洛纳卖给医院骑士团，奥斯曼1410年永久征服之。

en:
The Kingdom of Sardinia was an island realm whose capital was Cagliari. In 1297 Pope Boniface VIII granted Sardinia and Corsica to James II of Aragon, whose successors began conquering Sardinia in 1324. The last rival claim on the island was purchased in 1420, and Sardinia later became part of the Spanish monarchy.

After the War of the Spanish Succession reshaped Italy, the island passed to Victor Amadeus II of Savoy in 1720. His dynasty ruled it alongside Piedmont from Turin; Napoleon later occupied the mainland possessions, but the Congress of Vienna restored them and added Liguria in 1815.
zh:
撒丁王国是以卡利亚里为首府的岛屿王国。1297年教皇博尼法斯八世将撒丁和科西嘉封给阿拉贡的海梅二世，其继承者从1324年起征服撒丁岛。1420年，岛上最后一个与之竞争的权利主张被买断，撒丁后来成为西班牙君主国的一部分。

西班牙王位继承战争重塑意大利的版图后，撒丁岛于1720年转交萨伏伊的维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世。他的王朝从都灵统治撒丁和皮埃蒙特；拿破仑后来占领其大陆领地，但维也纳会议于1815年将其归还并增添了利古里亚。

en: The Sauzas were a Chichimeca people of Guachichil origin who lived in northern Guanajuato and southern San Luis Potosí, in present-day Mexico. They belonged to the Guamare alliance, which faced Spanish expansion in the sixteenth century.
zh: 绍萨是源自瓜奇奇尔人的奇奇梅克族群，居住在今墨西哥瓜纳华托北部和圣路易斯波托西南部。他们属于瓜马尔联盟，该联盟在16世纪面临西班牙人的扩张。

en:
Savoy grew from the Alpine fiefs of Humbert the White-Handed, raised to count in 1003 by Rudolph III of Burgundy. In 1046 his son Otto married Adelaide, heiress of Turin's march, joining the Piedmontese lowlands to mountain lands; Thomas I took Chambéry in 1220, Count Aymon's capital in 1337.

Amadeus VII acquired Nice and a Mediterranean outlet in 1388, and Amadeus VIII became duke in 1416. French troops occupied Savoy in 1536 and held Turin until the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559; Emmanuel Philibert moved the capital to Turin in 1562.

The Treaty of Lyon added Saluzzo in 1601. Victor Amadeus II took Sicily in 1713 and exchanged it for Sardinia in 1720, creating the Kingdom of Sardinia. France annexed Savoy in 1792, and the Congress of Vienna restored its Alpine lands in 1814 and 1815.
zh:
萨伏依源自白手翁贝托的阿尔卑斯封地，1003年鲁道夫三世封他为伯爵。1046年其子奥托娶图林边区女继承人阿德莱德，连皮埃蒙特低地与山区领地为一体；1220年托马索一世取尚贝里，1337年伯爵海莫治尚贝里。

1388年阿梅迪奥七世取得尼斯，获地中海出口；阿梅迪奥八世1416年升为公爵。法军1536年占公国、据都灵，至1559年《卡托-康布雷西和约》；埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托1562年迁都都灵。

1601年《里昂条约》增萨卢佐。维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世1713年获西西里王国，1720年换撒丁岛建撒丁王国。1792年法国吞并萨伏依，维也纳会议1814—1815年恢复阿尔卑斯领地。

en:
Saarwerden was a mediate fief of the Holy Roman Empire in Lorraine, straddling the Saar around Bockenheim. Created in 1111 when Lord Friedrich detached his lands from Metz's bishopric, it saw him build a castle on Roman bath ruins and found Wörschweiler Abbey in 1130.

The family's most famous son, Frederick III, Cologne archbishop from 1370 to 1414, briefly held the county on his childless brother Henry II's death in 1397 before passing it to his stepbrother, the Count of Moers. When that line died out, Johann Ludwig of Nassau-Saarbrücken inherited through his wife Countess Katharina in 1527.

Count Adolf introduced the Reformation in 1556 and settled French Calvinist refugees in the Seven Gallic Villages. Seized by Lorraine in the Thirty Years' War and restored to Nassau by the Peace of Westphalia, it became an imperial enclave when France annexed Lorraine in 1766, until French occupation in 1793.
zh:
萨尔韦尔登伯国是神圣罗马帝国在洛林的非直属封邑，横跨萨尔河，治所博肯海姆。1111年领主腓特烈把领地从梅斯主教区划出建国；他在罗马浴场废墟建城堡，1130年创办沃尔施韦勒修道院。

家族最著名者腓特烈三世，1370至1414年任科隆大主教；1397年无嗣弟亨利二世死后，他短暂掌管伯国，再交同母异父的弟弟默尔斯伯爵。该支系绝嗣后，拿骚-萨尔布吕肯的约翰·路德维希1527年凭妻子卡塔琳娜女伯爵继承领地。

阿道夫伯爵1556年推行宗教改革，安置法语加尔文宗难民，建成七个高卢村庄。伯国三十年战争中被洛林夺取，《威斯特伐利亚和约》还拿骚；1766年法国并洛林后沦为帝国飞地，1793年法军占领。

en:
Saxony was an electorate of the Holy Roman Empire, with its later capital at Dresden. In 1423 Emperor Sigismund granted the Saxon electorate to Frederick of Meissen, joining its title to the Wettin lands.

The Treaty of Leipzig divided those lands in 1485: Ernest retained the electoral title and Wittenberg, while his brother Albert took Meissen and ruled from Dresden. After the Schmalkaldic War, Albert's descendant Maurice gained Wittenberg and the electorate in 1547. The electorate became a kingdom in 1806.
zh:
萨克森是神圣罗马帝国的选侯国，后以德累斯顿为首都。1423年，皇帝西吉斯蒙德将萨克森选侯国授予迈森的腓特烈，使这一头衔与韦廷家族的领地结合。

1485年的《莱比锡条约》分割了韦廷领地：恩斯特保留选侯头衔和维滕贝格，弟弟阿尔布雷希特取得迈森并在德累斯顿统治。施马尔卡尔登战争后，阿尔布雷希特的后裔莫里茨于1547年获得维滕贝格和选侯头衔。1806年，选侯国升为王国。

en:
Sayollan, a Nahuatl name meaning the place where flies abound, was the polity centred on Sayula in the salt-lake country of southern Xalisco, in modern Jalisco. Together with Tapalpa it formed the señorío ruled by the cacique Cuantoma, who paid tribute to the king of Colima.

When the Purépecha cazonci invaded in 1480 to seize the region's saltpeter workings, the long Saltpeter War began. Cuantoma fought as an ally of Colima, was defeated at Acatlán, but struck back to win a victory at Zacoalco with Xaliscan troops led by the Tepic lord Moz.

Cuantoma died in 1502, after which Sayula became a vassal lordship of the Purépecha Empire, and in 1519 it passed into the orbit of the Kingdom of Xalisco on the eve of the Spanish arrival.
zh:
萨约兰的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“苍蝇繁盛之地”，是以萨尤拉为中心的小邦，地处今哈利斯科州南部的盐湖地带。它与塔帕尔帕共同组成首领宽托马统治的领地，向科利马国王纳贡。

1480年，普雷佩查的卡松奇为夺取当地的硝石矿而出兵，漫长的硝石战争就此爆发。宽托马作为科利马的盟友参战，在阿卡特兰战败，但又依靠特皮克首领莫斯率领的哈利斯科军队，在萨科阿尔科赢得一场胜利。

宽托马于1502年去世，萨尤拉随后沦为普雷佩查帝国的附庸领地，1519年又在西班牙人到来前夕转入哈利斯科王国的势力范围。

en:
The Shiba were a branch of the Ashikaga family based in Mutsu. After supporting Ashikaga Takauji against Emperor Go-Daigo in 1335, Shiba Takatsune received the governorships of Echizen and Wakasa. His son Yoshimasa served as the shogun's deputy from 1379 to 1397.

A succession dispute in the family helped provoke the Ōnin War in 1467, and the Shiba lost Echizen to the Asakura in the 1470s. In Owari, Shiba Yoshimune became a figurehead under the Oda and was killed in 1554.
zh:
斯波氏是以陆奥为根据地的足利氏分支。1335年斯波高经支持足利尊氏对抗后醍醐天皇，后来获得越前和若狭的守护之职。其子义将于1379—1397年担任将军的管领。

家族内部的继承争端促成了1467年爆发的应仁之乱，斯波氏在15世纪70年代将越前失于朝仓氏。在尾张，斯波义统沦为织田氏操纵的傀儡，并于1554年被杀。

en:
Santubong was a trading kingdom at the mouth of the Sarawak River on the north-west Borneo coast, beneath the mountain that still bears its name. Excavations show a busy port from the seventh to the fourteenth century, where Chinese ceramics, Hindu images and some forty thousand tonnes of iron slag reveal workshops feeding the China trade.

A local chronicle, the Hikayat Datuk Merpati, traces its rulers to Datuk Merpati, said to have come from Java, and his son Merpati Jepang. When Majapahit expanded into Borneo around 1350, Santubong's trade withered and the port was abandoned, its people moving inland to Gedong and the Sadong River; the Nagarakretagama of 1365 records the area as Sawaku.

By 1530 Portuguese mapmakers knew the bay as Cerava, one of the five great ports of Borneo, as it passed under the widening sway of Brunei.
zh:
山都望是婆罗洲西北海岸砂拉越河口的贸易王国，背倚同名山峰。考古发掘显示，7至14世纪这里是繁忙港口，出土的中国瓷器、印度教造像和约四万吨铁渣，表明当地有服务对华贸易的手工业。

地方编年史《拿督·梅尔帕蒂传》把其统治者追溯到据说来自爪哇的拿督·梅尔帕蒂及其子梅尔帕蒂·日邦。约1350年满者伯夷势力进入婆罗洲后，山都望的贸易衰落、港口废弃，居民迁往内陆的格东和沙东河一带；1365年的《爪哇史颂》把这一地区记作沙瓦库。

到1530年，葡萄牙制图师已把这个海湾称作塞拉瓦，列为婆罗洲五大港之一，其时它正落入日益扩张的文莱势力范围。

en:
The Balliol regime was the Scottish kingship claimed by Edward Balliol, son of John Balliol, King of Scots from 1292 until his abdication under English pressure in 1296. After Robert the Bruce died in 1329, leaving the child David II on the throne, Edward Balliol invaded in 1332 with the Disinherited, nobles dispossessed of Scottish lands. He defeated the regent at Dupplin Moor and was crowned at Scone, but a surprise attack at Annan drove him out.

Restored with Edward III's open help, he took Berwick after Halidon Hill in 1333, and by the 1334 Treaty of Newcastle ceded Lothian to England and did homage to Edward III. Lieutenant Strathbogie's defeat at Culblean in 1335 ruined his cause, and by 1338 he held little beyond English-garrisoned strongholds; in 1337 his court sat at Perth.

After David II's capture at Neville's Cross in 1346, Balliol returned and held part of Galloway until 1355. In 1356 he surrendered his claim to Edward III for a pension of two thousand pounds a year, and died childless in 1364.
zh:
巴利奥尔政权是爱德华·巴里奥所主张的苏格兰王权。爱德华是约翰·巴里奥之子，后者1292年即位为苏格兰国王，1296年在英格兰压力下退位。罗伯特·布鲁斯1329年去世后幼子大卫二世继位，1332年爱德华·巴里奥联合被没收苏格兰领地的“被剥夺者”贵族入侵，在杜普林沼地击败摄政，于斯昆加冕，却在安嫩遭突袭后被逐。

他在爱德华三世公开支持下复位，1333年哈利顿山之战后取得贝里克，又依1334年的《纽卡斯尔条约》割让洛锡安并向爱德华三世称臣。1335年部将斯特拉斯博吉在科尔布伦战败，巴里奥的事业由此瓦解，到1338年只剩英格兰驻军把守的据点；1337年时他的朝廷仍设在珀斯。

1346年大卫二世在内维尔十字之战被俘后，巴里奥重返苏格兰，占据加洛韦的一部分直到1355年。1356年他以每年两千英镑年金为代价，把王位主张让给爱德华三世，1364年无嗣而终。

en:
Selimbau was a Hindu river kingdom on the upper Kapuas in what is now Kapuas Hulu Regency of West Kalimantan. Local tradition remembers it first as the kingdom of Pelembang, founded by Sri Paduka Maharaja Bindu Mahkota, and calls it the oldest Hindu kingdom in West Kalimantan, with a fully ranked court and a line of twenty-five rulers descending from its founder's queen, Ratu Sri Batara.

In 1337 it was one of several Hindu principalities strung along the upper Kapuas, among them the neighbouring kingdom of Silat. Its rulers eventually converted to Islam, and in 1823 Selimbau contracted its first treaty with the Dutch.

By that time its war parties had carried its power from the upper Silat to the headwaters of the Kapuas and north towards the Sarawak border.
zh:
塞林包是卡普阿斯河上游的印度教河域王国，位于今西加里曼丹省上卡普阿斯县境内。当地传说它最初称珀莱邦王国，由斯里·帕杜卡·摩诃罗阇·宾杜·马科塔建立，被视为西加里曼丹最古老的印度教王国，朝仪等级完备，自王后拉图·斯里·巴塔拉以下传了二十五代统治者。

1337年时，它是卡普阿斯河上游一连串印度教小邦之一，邻邦中有锡拉特王国。统治者最终改宗伊斯兰教，并于1823年与荷兰人订立第一份条约。

此时其武力已从锡拉特河上游扩张到卡普阿斯河源头，北抵砂拉越边界一带。

en:
The Subay are an Adnanite Arab tribe of the Najd, belonging to the Hawazin and Mudar line and tracing their descent to the Banu Amir ibn Sa'sa'a, which dominated central Arabia in the medieval period.

Long accustomed to both desert and town life, the tribe has a nomadic section whose original grazing grounds lay around Ranyah and Kurmah on the Najd-Asir border, and which later roamed the central Najd around Riyadh alongside their kinsmen the Suhool, with one group pushing north to found the town of Rumah. Its settled clans have lived in towns of central Arabia for centuries and make up much of their traditional population.

In the 1600s a Subay dynasty, the Al Sulaim, ruled the trading town of Unaizah in al-Qasem. The tribe also marched with the Al Saud: after the Ottoman invasion of 1818 it pressed into the weakening Bani Khalid's desert lands, and in 1830 Subay and Saudi forces fought the battle that ended Bani Khalid rule in al-Hasa.
zh:
苏拜是内志的阿德南系阿拉伯部落，属哈瓦津与穆达尔支脉，血统上溯到巴努·阿米尔·本·萨阿萨，该部落群中世纪称雄阿拉伯中部。

他们久已习惯沙漠与城镇两种生活：游牧支系最初的牧地在内志与阿西尔交界的拉尼亚和库尔迈一带，后来与亲族苏胡尔人一起游牧于利雅得周围的内志腹地，其中一支更向北开拓，建立了鲁迈镇；定居支系则数百年来散居阿拉伯中部各城镇，在当地传统定居人口中占很大比例。

17世纪，苏拜出身的阿勒·苏莱姆王朝统治着盖西姆的商贸名城欧奈宰。苏拜还随沙特家族征战：1818年奥斯曼入侵后，他们乘巴尼·哈立德衰落之机进入其沙漠领地；1830年，苏拜与沙特的联军在决战中终结了巴尼·哈立德在哈萨的统治。

en:
Sabzevār was an ancient city of western Khorasan. Its Azarbarzin fire temple dated to the first millennium BC. In 1337 it was held for the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür by the local ruler 'Ala' al-Din Muhammad, whose harsh taxation provoked a revolt.

The landowner 'Abd al-Razzaq killed his tax official and seized Sabzevār in 1337, founding the Sarbadar state, a blend of Shi'i dervishes and secular amirs. The Sarbadars made the city their capital, fought the Kartids of Herat, and for decades balanced between Togha Temür and independence; their leader Yahya Karawi murdered him in 1353.

The long reign of 'Ali Mu'ayyad ended with submission to Timur in 1381, after which Sabzevār supplied troops to the Timurid armies, though the Sarbadars slowly faded after Timur's death. Under the Safavids the province was lost to the Uzbeks and reconquered around 1600.
zh:
萨卜泽瓦尔是呼罗珊西部的古城。境内的阿扎尔巴尔津火庙可追溯到公元前1000年。1337年，本地统治者阿劳丁·穆罕默德替伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿镇守，横征暴敛激起叛乱。

地主阿卜杜勒·拉扎克杀死税官，于1337年攻占萨卜泽瓦尔，建立什叶派托钵僧与世俗埃米尔组成的萨尔巴达尔政权。萨尔巴达尔人以该城为都，与赫拉特卡尔提德王朝交战，数十年来在臣服与自立之间周旋；首领叶海亚·卡拉维于1353年袭杀脱合帖木儿。

阿里·穆阿亚德的统治以1381年归顺帖木儿告终，萨卜泽瓦尔为帖木儿军队提供兵源，萨尔巴达尔人则在帖木儿死后逐渐式微。萨法维时期，该省一度被乌兹别克人夺去，约1600年被收复。

en: Scandinavia was the northern European region of Denmark, Norway and Sweden. The Kalmar Union brought their crowns together in 1397, but Sweden left in 1523 and the kingdoms retained separate laws.
zh: 斯堪的纳维亚是北欧的丹麦、挪威和瑞典所在的地区。1397年，卡尔马联盟将三国王冠置于同一君主之下，但各国保留了自己的法律，瑞典于1523年退出联盟。

en:
The County of Schauenburg, known after about 1485 as Schaumburg, was a state of the Holy Roman Empire on the Weser in Lower Saxony. It took its name from Schauenburg Castle near Rinteln. In 1110 Duke Lothair of Saxony enfeoffed Adolf I with Holstein and Stormarn, including Hamburg, and the House of Schauenburg thereafter ruled both its Weser homeland and the Holstein counties through several partitioned lines.

The lordship was raised to a county in 1295 and passed to the Holstein-Pinneberg line, which held it in 1337 under Count Adolf VII. Its counts added the County of Sternberg in 1377.

The Reformation was introduced in 1559, Count Ernst moved the residence from Stadthagen to Bückeburg, and in 1619 the county was raised to a principality. When Otto V died childless in 1640 the house became extinct and the land was divided chiefly between Hesse-Kassel and the counts of Lippe.
zh:
绍恩堡伯国（约1485年后改称绍姆堡）是神圣罗马帝国的邦国，位于下萨克森州的威悉河畔，得名于林特尔恩附近的绍恩堡城堡。1110年，萨克森公爵洛泰尔将荷尔斯泰因和施托尔曼（含汉堡）封给阿道夫一世，绍恩堡家族此后通过几条分家支脉同时统治威悉河本土与荷尔斯泰因诸伯国。

1295年领地升格为伯国，转入荷尔斯泰因-平讷贝格支系手中，1337年由阿道夫七世统治，1377年又取得施特恩贝格伯国。

1559年伯国推行宗教改革，恩斯特伯爵将府邸从施塔特哈根迁至比克堡，1619年伯国升为侯国。1640年奥托五世无嗣而终，家族绝嗣，领地主要被黑森-卡塞尔与利珀伯爵瓜分。

en:
The Duchy of Ścinawa was a Silesian Piast principality on the middle Oder, centered on the town of Ścinawa, which was first documented in 1202.

In 1317 John, a younger son of Duke Henry III, received Ścinawa as his own duchy. In 1329 he paid homage to King John the Blind of Bohemia, and his lands became a Bohemian fief. Dogged by debts, John sold the duchy piecemeal: in 1337 his brothers bought the whole territory while leaving him life rule, and in 1358 half of Ścinawa went to Bolko II of Świdnica. After John's death around 1365 the rest passed to Henry V of Żagań.

The Świdnica half was annexed by Emperor Charles IV after 1368. When the last Silesian Piast, George William, died in 1675, Ścinawa reverted to the Habsburgs, passing to Prussia in 1742.
zh:
希齐纳瓦公国是奥得河中游的西里西亚皮雅斯特家族公国，以最早见于1202年的希齐纳瓦城为中心。

1317年，公爵亨利三世的幼子约翰分得希齐纳瓦，自成公国。1329年，他向波希米亚国王“盲人约翰”行臣服礼，领地成为波希米亚采邑。约翰债务缠身，将公国一块块出卖：1337年他的兄弟们买下全部领地，只留给他终身统治权；1358年半个希齐纳瓦归希维德尼察的博尔科二世；约1365年约翰死后，其余部分归扎甘的亨利五世。

希维德尼察那一半在1368年后被皇帝查理四世吞并。1675年西里西亚皮雅斯特家族末代成员格奥尔格·威廉去世后，领地归于哈布斯堡家族，1742年转归普鲁士。

en:
Saint-Claude grew up around Condat Abbey, founded in the 420s by the monks Romanus and Lupicinus. Its fourth abbot, Eugendus, rebuilt the house in stone and turned it into an ecclesiastical principality ruling the surrounding mountains, and the settlement was long known as Saint-Oyend after him.

The abbey held directly of the Holy Roman Emperor, independent of the Counts of Burgundy, and by the late twelfth century it governed more than a hundred churches. Pilgrims venerated the intact body of Saint Claudius, its twelfth abbot, who died around 699, and from the thirteenth century his cult gave the place the name Saint-Claude. In 1337 the abbot still ruled the principality in Franche-Comté.

A reform was carried out after 1445, but later commendatory abbots turned the house into an aristocratic chapter; its lands were finally secularised in 1742, when the bishopric of Saint-Claude was created.
zh:
圣克洛德围绕孔达修道院兴起。这座修道院于5世纪20年代由修士罗曼努斯和卢皮奇努斯创建，第四任院长欧根迪乌斯用石头重建修道院，把它变成统治周围山区的教会诸侯国，聚居地也长期以他的名字称作圣奥扬。

修道院直属于神圣罗马帝国皇帝，不受勃艮第伯爵管辖，到12世纪末已下辖一百多座教堂。朝圣者敬拜第十二任院长圣克洛德的完好遗体，他约卒于699年；从13世纪起，对他的崇拜使此地得名圣克洛德。1337年，院长仍统治弗朗什-孔泰的这个诸侯国。

1445年以后修道院推行改革，但后来的领薪院长把修院变成贵族修士团，其领地最终于1742年被世俗化，圣克洛德主教区也在同年设立。

en:
The Kingdom of Scotland traces its birth to 843, when Kenneth MacAlpin united Dál Riata's Scots and the Picts as Alba. David I remodelled the crown; the 1266 Treaty of Perth brought the Hebrides from Norway.

When Edward I invaded in 1296, William Wallace resisted, Robert the Bruce won Bannockburn in 1314, and the 1320 Declaration of Arbroath preceded English recognition of independence in 1328. In 1337 the child king David II is exiled in France and Edward Balliol, backed by Edward III, presses his claim; returning, David was captured at Neville's Cross in 1346 and ransomed in 1357.

In 1371 David's nephew Robert II, first Stewart king, took the throne; his line took Orkney in 1472, lost Berwick in 1482, and lost James IV and nobles at Flodden in 1513. The 1560 Reformation created the Presbyterian Kirk and engulfed Mary, Queen of Scots. Her son James VI inherited the English throne in 1603, uniting the crowns; in 1707 the Scottish parliament voted itself out of existence in the Acts of Union, creating Great Britain.
zh:
苏格兰王国的起点通常定在843年，肯尼思·麦卡尔平把达尔里阿达的苏格兰人与皮克特人统一为阿尔巴。戴维一世改造王权，1266年《珀斯条约》使赫布里底群岛从挪威转入苏格兰。

1296年爱德华一世入侵，威廉·华莱士起兵抵抗，罗伯特·布鲁斯1314年赢得班诺克本之战，1320年《阿布罗斯宣言》之后，英格兰于1328年承认苏格兰独立。1337年幼主戴维二世正流亡法国，爱德华·巴利奥尔在爱德华三世支持下争位；戴维回国后于1346年在内维尔十字之战被俘，1357年获赎获释。

1371年戴维的外甥罗伯特二世即位，即斯图亚特王朝初代君主；该王朝1472年取得奥克尼，1482年丢掉贝里克，1513年詹姆斯四世与大批贵族战死于弗洛登。1560年宗教改革建立长老会国教会，苏格兰女王玛丽被卷入其中。她的儿子詹姆斯六世1603年继承英格兰王位，两王冠合一；1707年苏格兰议会通过《联合法令》自行解散，组成大不列颠。

en:
The Chiefdom of Shuidong, ruled by the Song clan, was one of the Four Great Native Chiefdoms of Guizhou. In 975 the Song court recognized Song Jingyang as hereditary ruler after he seized Manzhou from the Yi, and in 1303 the chiefdom submitted to the Yuan dynasty and entered the tusi system. The Ming confirmed Song rule in 1371.

During the Ming conquest of Yunnan the regent Liu Shuzhen travelled to Nanjing and secured the recall of the general Ma Ye in 1384. When Guizhou province was created in 1413, the Shuidong seat of Guizhou City became its capital. A Miao rising in 1513 drove out the chief Song Ran and began a long decline.

In 1623 Song Wanhua joined the She-An Rebellion and was executed, and after his son Song Siyin was put down in 1630, the Ming annexed Shuidong.
zh:
水东土司由宋氏世袭，位列贵州四大土司之一。975年，宋景阳从彝人手中夺取蛮州，被宋朝确认为世袭统治者；1303年水东归附元朝，纳入土司制度。明朝于1371年承认宋氏统治。

明军攻取云南期间，摄政刘淑贞亲赴南京，于1384年促使朝廷召回将领马晔。1413年贵州设省，水东治所贵州城被定为省会。1513年苗民起事，首领宋然败逃，水东由此走向衰落。

1623年宋万化参加奢安之乱，兵败被处死；其子宋嗣殷继续抵抗，于1630年被平定，水东随即被明朝吞并。

en:
Sidenreng was a Bugis kingdom in the fertile rice plains west of the lakes of central South Sulawesi. Bugis Lontara chronicles date its founding to around 1300, shortly after the rise of Bone, and its people farmed wet rice; the Portuguese Manuel Pinto, visiting in the 1540s, found the country rich in rice.

In the sixteenth century Sidenreng joined the Ajatappareng confederation, whose rulers swore to be one house divided into five parts. As Gowa expanded, Sidenreng chose submission over ruin and fought as its ally rather than resist.

When the rulers of Gowa adopted Islam in 1605 and made war on the remaining Bugis states, Sidenreng, the last surviving Ajatappareng principality, was annexed in 1609, and its trade later passed under the Dutch East India Company's monopoly after the Makassar War of 1666 to 1669.
zh:
锡登伦是南苏拉威西中部湖群以西肥沃稻作平原上的布吉人王国。布吉人的隆塔拉编年史把建国时间系于1300年前后，仅略晚于波尼的兴起；居民种植水稻，1540年代到访的葡萄牙人曼努埃尔·平托曾记下此地稻米丰饶。

16世纪，锡登伦加入阿贾塔帕朗联盟，统治者立誓同为一屋、分为五部。随着戈瓦扩张，锡登伦放弃抵抗，转而作为戈瓦的盟友出战。

1605年戈瓦统治者改宗伊斯兰教并对其余布吉邦国开战，锡登伦作为阿贾塔帕朗仅存的邦国于1609年被吞并；1666至1669年的望加锡战争后，它的贸易又落入荷兰东印度公司的垄断之下。

en:
The Duchy of Sieradz, centered on the town of Sieradz in central Poland, was created in 1263 when the Duchy of Łęczyca was divided among the Masovian line of the Piast dynasty. Its first notable duke was Leszek II the Black, who also held Kraków.

In 1299 Władysław Łokietek had to cede the land to King Wenceslaus II of Bohemia. After the Přemyslid dynasty died out in 1306, Sieradz returned to the Polish kingdom as a vassal duchy.

In 1337 it was held by the Piast prince Przemysł of Inowrocław; when he died without heirs in 1339, Casimir III the Great incorporated the territory directly into the Lands of the Polish Crown, where it became the Sieradz Voivodeship and was thereafter known as Sieradz Land rather than a duchy.
zh:
谢拉兹公国以波兰中部的谢拉兹镇为中心，1263年皮亚斯特王朝马佐夫舍支系瓜分文奇察公国时产生。其早期著名公爵是同时领有克拉科夫的黑色者莱谢克二世。

1299年瓦迪斯瓦夫·沃凯泰克被迫将此地割让给波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫二世。1306年普热米斯尔王朝绝嗣后，谢拉兹作为附庸公国重归波兰王国。

1337年统治它的是皮亚斯特王公、伊诺弗罗茨瓦夫的普热梅斯乌；他于1339年无嗣而终后，卡齐米日三世将这片领地直接并入波兰王冠领地，改制为谢拉兹省，此后便以“谢拉兹之地”而非公国的名称存在。

en: The Sedang are a North Bahnaric-speaking people of the northern Central Highlands of present-day Vietnam, including Kon Tum. Sedang warriors and elephants fought alongside other highland groups for the Tây Sơn dynasty in the late eighteenth century.
zh: 色当人讲北巴拿语支的语言，居住在今越南西原北部的昆嵩等地。18世纪末，色当战士和战象与其他高地族群一道，为西山朝作战。

en:
The Sena were Bantu-speaking communities of the Zambezi valley, between the Shona and the Nyanja-Chewa. Swahili Muslim traders used Sena on the river as an outpost for exchanging Indian Ocean goods for gold.

In 1531 the Portuguese trader Vicente Pegado founded a fair at Sena, which grew into a trading and missionary centre. Portuguese estates used African labour in the valley, while the eighteenth-century slave trade brought further violence to its inhabitants.
zh:
塞纳人是赞比西河谷说班图语的群体，居住在绍纳人与尼扬贾—切瓦人之间。斯瓦希里穆斯林商人以河畔的塞纳为贸易据点，用印度洋商品交换黄金。

1531年，葡萄牙商人维森特·佩加多在塞纳设立集市，后来这里发展为贸易和传教中心。葡萄牙人在河谷的庄园使用非洲劳工，18世纪的奴隶贸易又给当地居民带来了更多暴力。

en:
The medieval Kingdom of Serbia was the Nemanjić dynasty's creation. Stefan Nemanja united Serbia from 1166; his son Stefan the First-Crowned took the royal title in 1217 and Stefan's brother Sava secured an autocephalous Orthodox Church in 1219. Stefan Dečanski shattered Bulgaria at Velbazhd in 1330, and in 1331 his son Stefan Dušan seized the throne; in 1337 he held Prizren and Kosovo.

Dušan's campaigns carried Serbia from the Danube to the Gulf of Corinth. In 1346 he was crowned emperor at Skopje and raised his archbishopric to a patriarchate; his law code of 1349 and 1354 crowned the empire's brief golden age. After Dušan died in 1355 the realm fragmented; the nobility fell to Ottomans at Marica in 1371, Lazar's Kosovo stand of 1389 ended independent Serbia, and annexation followed in 1459.

In 1804 the Slaughter of the Knezes sparked Karađorđe's uprising; after its collapse Miloš Obrenović led a second uprising in 1815, the sultan recognized hereditary princes in 1830 and 1833, with a constitution in 1835.
zh:
中世纪塞尔维亚王国由内马尼奇王朝缔造。斯特凡·内马尼亚自1166年起统一塞尔维亚，其子“首位加冕者”斯特凡1217年取得王号，斯特凡的弟弟萨瓦1219年争取到东正教会自治。斯特凡·德钱斯基1330年在维尔巴日德击溃保加利亚，1331年其子斯特凡·杜尚废父夺位，1337年时他领有普里兹伦与科索沃。

杜尚的征战使塞尔维亚疆域北起多瑙河、南抵科林斯湾。1346年他在斯科普里加冕为帝，将大主教区升格为牧首区；1349和1354年颁布的《杜尚法典》标志黄金时代的顶峰。杜尚1355年去世后帝国瓦解，贵族1371年在马里查败于奥斯曼人，拉扎尔公爵1389年在科索沃的抵抗失败，独立终结，1459年塞尔维亚被吞并。

1804年“屠杀诸侯”事件激起卡拉乔尔杰领导的起义；失败后米洛什·奥布雷诺维奇1815年发动第二次起义，苏丹在1830和1833年承认诸侯世袭，1835年又立宪法。

en:
The Kingdom of Seville was a territorial jurisdiction of the Crown of Castile in southwestern Iberia, centred on Seville. The city had been the capital of a Muslim taifa before Castile conquered it in 1248.

In the sixteenth century Seville prospered as the gateway to Spanish transatlantic trade, administered by the Casa de Contratación. That institution moved to Cádiz in 1717, and the kingdom was abolished in Spain's territorial division of 1833.
zh:
塞维利亚王国是卡斯蒂利亚王冠在伊比利亚半岛西南部的一处领地，以塞维利亚城为中心。该城曾是穆斯林泰法的首都，1248年被卡斯蒂利亚征服。

16世纪的塞维利亚作为西班牙跨大西洋贸易的门户而繁荣，贸易由贸易院管理。贸易院于1717年迁往加的斯，塞维利亚王国则在1833年西班牙进行领土区划时被废除。

en:
Sofala was the southernmost of the great Swahili city-states, on a marshy estuary of the Mozambique coast. It began in the tenth century as a trading post of Mogadishu merchants, who guarded its secret because the Buzi River led inland to the goldfields of the Mwenemutapa kingdom.

In the 1180s the sultan of Kilwa took the town, and its gold revenues financed Kilwa's empire. Sofala paid tribute to the Mwenemutapa king and remained the dominant port south of Kilwa.

In 1502 the sheikh Isuf signed a treaty with the Portuguese. Pêro de Anaia built Fort São Caetano beside the town in 1505, but fever gutted the garrison and shifting sandbanks made the harbor unsafe for deep-draught ships. After seizing Mozambique Island in 1507 the Portuguese moved their base there, and as the old goldfields were exhausted Sofala sank into insignificance, its ruins eventually swallowed by the estuary.
zh:
索法拉是斯瓦希里大城邦中位置最南的一个，坐落在莫桑比克海岸多沼泽的河口。它在10世纪由摩加迪沙商人开辟为贸易站；商人对其保密，因为溯布济河而上可抵达莫诺莫塔帕王国的金矿区。

12世纪80年代，基卢瓦苏丹夺取该城，索法拉的黄金收入支撑了基卢瓦商业帝国。索法拉仍向莫诺莫塔帕国王纳贡，始终是基卢瓦以南最显赫的港口。

1502年，谢赫伊素福与葡萄牙人签订条约。1505年，佩罗·德·阿纳亚在城旁修建圣卡埃塔诺堡，但热病使驻军大批死亡，游移的沙洲也让深吃水船只难以停靠。1507年葡萄牙人夺取莫桑比克岛后将基地北迁，加上旧金矿日渐枯竭，索法拉沦为无足轻重的小据点，城址最终被河口海水吞没。

en:
Strasbourg, the Roman Argentoratum on the Ill near its confluence with the Rhine, was the scene of the bilingual Oaths of Strasbourg between Charles the Bald and Louis the German in 842. In 1262 the citizens defeated the bishop's army at the Battle of Hausbergen and made Strasbourg a Free Imperial City, governed by its council.

A guild revolution in 1332 broke the patrician monopoly and gave the craft guilds the office of Ammeister, so that in 1337 it was among the richest self-ruling cities of the empire, its great sandstone cathedral rising above the rooftops. In 1349 the city's two thousand Jews were burned alive in the Black Death pogrom.

Strasbourg later became a cradle of printing and embraced the Reformation, producing the first printed newspaper in 1605. Louis XIV's armies annexed the city without a siege in 1681.
zh:
斯特拉斯堡位于伊尔河汇入莱茵河处附近，古罗马时称阿让托拉图姆，842年秃头查理和日耳曼人路易在此互换双语的《斯特拉斯堡誓言》。1262年市民在豪斯贝根战役中击败主教军队，使斯特拉斯堡成为帝国自由市，由市议会治理。

1332年的行会革命打破贵族世家垄断，手工业行会取得行业总管要职，1337年时它已是帝国最富庶的自治城市之一，宏大的砂岩大教堂仍在兴建之中。1349年，该城两千名犹太人在黑死病迫害中被集体活活烧死。

后来斯特拉斯堡成为印刷业摇篮，皈依宗教改革，1605年印出第一份印刷报纸。1681年路易十四的军队未经围攻便吞并该城。

en:
Esfarāyen, in earlier centuries called Isfarāyīn, is a town at the gateway to the northern mountains of Khorasan. Already a seat of religious learning, it produced the Shafi'i theologian Abu Ishaq al-Isfarayini, who taught in Nishapur at the turn of the eleventh century.

With the break-up of the Ilkhanate the town, held by the local Qushji family, was drawn into the wars of the Khurasan princes. Shaykh 'Ali Qushji, governor of Khurasan for the Il-Khanid claimant Togha Temür, was the strongest man in eastern Iran until July 1337, when he was captured and executed by Arghun Shah of the Jauni Kurban tribe.

Esfarāyen remained a prize of the wars between Astarabad, the Sarbadars and the Jauni Kurban, and in 1381 Timur sacked the town after Amir Vali refused to pay him homage, bringing it within the Timurid order of Khurasan.
zh:
埃斯法拉延旧称伊斯法拉因，是呼罗珊北部山口要冲的一座城镇。这里早就是宗教学术中心，曾走出沙斐仪派神学家阿布·伊斯哈格·伊斯法拉伊尼，他在11世纪初于内沙布尔讲学。

伊儿汗国瓦解后，这座由本地库什吉家族把持的城镇卷入呼罗珊诸王公的混战。库什吉家的谢赫·阿里·库什吉是伊儿汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿帐下的呼罗珊长官，也是伊朗东部最有权势的人物，直到1337年7月被札兀尼·库尔班部落的阿儿浑沙擒杀。

此后埃斯法拉延一直是阿斯塔拉巴德、萨尔巴达尔人和札兀尼·库尔班反复争夺的猎物；1381年，因阿米尔·瓦利拒绝向帖木儿称臣，帖木儿洗劫了该城，把它纳入帖木儿治下的呼罗珊秩序。

en:
The Sagae were a branch of the Ōe family who ruled Sagae estate in Dewa Province. Ōe Chikahiro withdrew there after supporting the defeated imperial side in the Jōkyū War of 1221. His descendants backed the Southern Court, but after defeat at the Urushikawa in 1368, Ōe Toki'uji made peace with the Ashikaga in 1373.

The family took the Sagae name and established Sagae Castle as its seat. In 1584 Mogami Yoshiaki attacked the castle; Sagae Takamoto killed himself, ending the main line's rule.
zh:
寒河江氏是统治出羽国寒河江庄的大江氏分支。大江亲广在1221年承久之乱中支持战败的朝廷一方，此后退居寒河江。其后代支持南朝，但在1368年漆川之战中败北后，大江时氏于1373年与足利氏讲和。

这一家族改称寒河江氏，以寒河江城为居城。1584年最上义光进攻该城，寒河江高基自尽，宗家的统治随之终结。

en:
Sanghana was the name Arab geographers gave to the low-lying region around the mouth of the Senegal River, which may even have given the river its name. Around 800 it was counted among the states of the lower Senegal alongside Takrur and Silla, and by the Almoravid age its coastlands were held by the Godala, a Sanhaja Berber people who worked the salt deposits of Awlil and ran a coastal caravan route linking the river mouth to southern Morocco.

Godala caravans carried Awlil salt along the north bank of the Senegal and traded with their neighbour Takrur. In the fourteenth century the country formed the westernmost march of the Mali Empire, whose mansa it served as a vassal.
zh:
桑哈纳是阿拉伯地理学家对塞内加尔河河口一带低洼地区的称呼，塞内加尔河的名字甚至可能就源于此。约800年，它与塔克鲁尔、锡拉并列为塞内加尔河下游的诸国之一；到穆拉比特时代，其沿海地带由戈达拉人占据。戈达拉人属桑哈贾柏柏尔人，开采奥利勒的盐层，经营着连接河口与摩洛哥南部的沿海商路。

戈达拉人的商队沿塞内加尔河北岸贩运奥利勒食盐，与邻国塔克鲁尔贸易。14世纪时，此地是马里帝国最西端的边地，作为附庸为曼萨效力。

en:
The Grey League was an alliance of communities and lords in the Alpine valleys of the Vorder and Hinter Rhine. In 1395 the abbot of Disentis, two barons and local delegates pledged an eternal alliance at Ilanz to curb feuds and protect trade.

Its rules protected roads, allowed free trade and required disputes to be brought before courts. In 1471 the Grey League joined the League of God's House and the League of the Ten Jurisdictions in the Three Leagues, an associate of the Swiss Confederacy.
zh:
灰色同盟是阿尔卑斯山前莱茵河与后莱茵河流域的社群和领主组成的联盟。1395年，迪森蒂斯修道院院长、两位男爵和地方代表在伊兰茨缔结永久同盟，以遏止私斗并保护贸易。

同盟的规约保护道路安全、允许自由贸易，并要求将争端交由法庭裁决。1471年，灰色同盟与神所同盟、十辖区同盟组成三同盟，成为瑞士邦联的盟友。

en:
Sonargaon, the ancient Suvarnagrama or golden hamlet, was a river port on the old course of the Brahmaputra in eastern Bengal. The Hindu Deva king Dasharathadeva moved his capital there from Bikrampur in the mid-thirteenth century, and from the 1270s Sufi Abu Tawwama made it a center of Persian learning with his khanqah and madrasa.

Early in the fourteenth century Delhi governor Shamsuddin Firoz Shah conquered central Bengal and opened a Sonargaon mint; in 1337 Governor Bahram Khan held it for Delhi. On his death in 1338 his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah made himself independent sultan, conquered Chittagong in 1340, and fought the rival cities of Lakhnauti and Satgaon; Ibn Battuta visited his court.

Sonargaon later became a Bengal Sultanate capital under Ghiyasuddin Azam Shah, wealthy on muslin weaving. When the sultanate collapsed, Isa Khan led the Baro-Bhuyan confederacy of landlords against the Mughals from Sonargaon, until his son Musa Khan's defeat in 1610, when the town became a Mughal district overshadowed by Dhaka.
zh:
索纳尔冈，古称苏瓦尔纳格拉马，意为金村，是孟加拉东部布拉马普特拉河故道上的河港。13世纪中叶，印度教提婆王朝的达沙拉塔提婆王把都城从比克拉姆普尔迁到这里；从13世纪70年代起，苏菲学者阿布·塔瓦马在此设立道堂和经学院，使它成为波斯学术的中心。

14世纪初，德里苏丹国总督沙姆斯丁·菲罗兹沙征服孟加拉中部，在索纳尔冈开设造币厂；1337年这座城由总督巴赫拉姆汗替德里镇守。1338年巴赫拉姆汗去世，他的持甲官法赫鲁丁·穆巴拉克沙自立为独立苏丹，1340年征服吉大港，并与拉克瑙蒂、萨特冈两城邦争雄，伊本·白图泰曾到访他的宫廷。

后来它在吉亚斯丁·阿扎姆沙在位时成为孟加拉苏丹国的都城，靠薄纱织造致富。苏丹国瓦解后，伊萨·汗以索纳尔冈为据点，率领地主联盟“十二布伊扬”抵抗莫卧儿人，直到其子穆萨汗1610年战败，该城成为莫卧儿孟加拉的一个县，被新都达卡盖过风头。

en:
The Sagara were a warrior family based at Hitoyoshi in Higo Province. Their branches fought on opposing sides in the wars of the Northern and Southern Courts; in 1448 Sagara Nagatsugu defeated the rival branch and unified Kuma district.

The family expanded across southern Higo but submitted to the Shimazu in 1581. During Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign they retained Hitoyoshi, and after changing sides in the 1600 Sekigahara campaign they kept their lands under the Tokugawa, ruling Hitoyoshi domain throughout the Edo period.
zh:
相良氏是以肥后国人吉为据点的武家。南北朝战争中，家族各支分别为不同的朝廷作战；1448年相良长续击败敌对的一支，统一球磨郡。

相良氏向肥后南部扩张，却在1581年臣服于岛津氏。丰臣秀吉平定九州时，相良氏保住人吉，又在1600年关原之战期间转变立场，得以在德川政权下保有领地，整个江户时代都统治着人吉藩。

en: Shangsi was a small Zhuang tusi subprefecture in the hills south of Nanning, at the northern foot of the Shiwandashan range in present-day Fangchenggang, Guangxi. Under the Yuan and early Ming it was attached to the Siming native prefecture; the Ming court briefly abolished it, restored the subprefecture under Siming in 1388, and transferred it to Nanning Prefecture in 1505.
zh: 上思是南宁以南、十万大山北麓的一个壮族小土州，辖地在今广西防城港境内，境内群山起伏，是思明黄氏土官下辖的寨堡之地。元及明初辖于思明路、思明府，明初一度废置，1388年复置仍属思明，1505年改隶南宁府。

en:
Siguntur lies in the Minangkabau highlands of western Sumatra, on the upper Batanghari River at Dharmasraya, the capital of Buddhist Bhumi Malayu, where the Mauli dynasty inherited much of Srivijaya's authority after the Chola raid of 1025. In 1275 King Kertanagara of Singhasari launched the Pamalayu expedition, and in 1286 sent the Amoghapasa statue, recorded in an inscription naming King Tribhuwanaraja Mauli Warmadewa.

His grandson Adityawarman, once a senior minister of Majapahit, returned to rule Malayapura from 1347 to 1375 as a tantric Buddhist king who controlled the highland gold trade and founded the Pagaruyung dynasty. Local tradition traces a small kingdom there to 1250 and claims Mauli descent, counting Adityawarman among its rulers before the highland states passed under Pagaruyung.

The court later turned to Islam, its first Muslim ruler reigning from 1575, while the old Siguntur dialect remained close to Minangkabau.
zh:
西昆图尔地处西苏门答腊米南加保高地，位于巴唐哈里河上游的旧王都达摩室利耶一带，那里曾为佛教马来王国“马来之地”都城；1025年朱罗人突袭后，毛利王朝继承了室利佛逝的大部分权威。1275年，信诃沙里国王格尔达纳卡拉发动帕马拉尤远征，1286年又送来阿莫伽巴沙神像，铭文记载了此事，并提到国王特里布瓦纳拉贾·毛利·瓦马德瓦。

他的外孙阿迪蒂亚瓦尔曼曾任满者伯夷重臣，1347至1375年回到马来普拉统治，作为密教国王掌控高地黄金贸易，开创巴加鲁永王朝。当地传说称小王国始于1250年，自称出自毛利世系，将其列为统治者，后高地各邦归入巴加鲁永宗主权。

宫廷后改宗伊斯兰教，第一位穆斯林统治者于1575年即位，西昆图尔方言仍近于米南加保语。

en:
Sanggau was a Dayak river state on the lower Kapuas in western Borneo, its early Hindu polity centred on Mengkiang up the Sekayam tributary, said in local tradition to have been founded by the noblewoman Putri Daranante.

In 1380 the Muslim preacher Abang Abdurrahman, schooled in Banten, married the daughter of Sanggau's Temenggung Raden Satry, succeeded him and took the title sultan, turning the old Hindu state into an Islamic one.

His son-in-law Sultan Awaluddin founded a new town at Kantu on the main Kapuas shipping lane, moved the court there from Mengkiang and built the stone mosque; Sanggau became the gateway between the upriver states of Sekadau and Sintang and downstream ports such as Mempawah and Sambas. Around 1400 the expansion of Brunei under Awang Alak Betatar reached the Kapuas and brought Sanggau under Bruneian overlordship.
zh:
桑高是婆罗洲西部卡普阿斯河下游的达雅克河居国家，早期的印度教政权以塞卡扬支流上游的孟姜为中心，当地传说它由贵族女子普特里·达拉南特建立。

1380年，曾在万丹求学的穆斯林传道者阿邦·阿卜杜勒拉赫曼娶了天猛公拉登·萨特里的女儿，继而继任并采用苏丹头衔，把这个印度教古国改为伊斯兰政权。

他的女婿苏丹阿瓦卢丁在卡普阿斯主航道旁的坎图建立新城，把王庭从孟姜迁来，并修建了石造清真寺；桑高由此成为贸易枢纽，上游连通塞卡道、新当等邦，下游衔接孟加影、三发等港。约1400年，阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔治下的文莱扩张到卡普阿斯河流域，桑高被纳入文莱的宗主权之下。

en:
Sangzhi was a Tujia native chieftaincy, or tusi, in the Wuling mountains of northwestern Huguang, on the lands of present-day Sangzhi County in northwestern Hunan. The Song court set up the Sangzhi Pacification Commission in the eleventh century during the reign of Emperor Renzong, naming it after its seat at Sangzhiping; the hereditary Xiang chiefs held the office through the Yuan, Ming and Qing dynasties.

The last chieftain, Xiang Guodong, waged bloody feuds with the neighboring Rongmei, Yongshun and Maogang chiefdoms. The Qing court confiscated his seal in 1726 and carried out gaitu guiliu in 1728, replacing native rule with ordinary provincial administration. Sangzhi County was established on the chieftaincy's territory in 1729, and Xiang was resettled in Henan.
zh:
桑植是湖广西北部武陵山区的土家族土司，其地在今湖南西北部的桑植县。11世纪宋仁宗推行土司制度时设桑植宣抚司，因司治位于桑植坪而得名，向氏土官世代承袭，历经元、明、清三代。

末代宣慰使向国栋与容美、永顺、茅冈等土司连年仇杀，朝廷于1726年追缴其印信，1728年实行改土归流，1729年以其地置桑植县，向国栋被安置到河南。

en:
The Shan States were Tai principalities in the hills of northern and eastern Burma, each ruled by a saopha. After the fall of Pagan in 1287, Shan rulers expanded their power; Möng Mao destroyed Sagaing and Pinya in 1364.

Ming campaigns broke Möng Mao's power in the 1440s, and its rulers withdrew to Möng Yang. In 1527 a confederation led from Möng Yang captured Ava, but the Toungoo dynasty conquered the Burmese Shan States in 1557, leaving their chiefs considerable local autonomy.
zh:
掸族诸邦是缅甸北部和东部山地的傣人诸侯国，各由一位召法统治。1287年蒲甘王朝覆亡后，掸族统治者扩张势力；麓川于1364年灭亡实皆和彬牙两国。

明朝在15世纪40年代的征讨削弱了麓川，其统治者退往孟养。1527年，以孟养为首的联盟攻占阿瓦；1557年东吁王朝征服缅甸的掸邦，但各邦首领仍保有相当大的地方自治权。

en:
The Shabankara were an Iranian tribal people of southeastern Fars, deported there by the Buyid ruler 'Adud al-Dawla in the tenth century and organized into herder-warrior clans. Their Ramanid chiefs, known as the Fadlawayhids after their founder Fadluya, seized power in Fars in 1062 before being broken by the Seljuks, who executed Fadluya in 1071.

After the Seljuk collapse the tribe restored its rule from its capital Ij, and under the Ilkhans governed the province of Shabankara centered on Darabjird. Hulegu destroyed Ij in 1260, yet the chiefs survived as local rulers.

In 1337 the chief was Ardashir, who claimed descent from the Sasanian kings. His refusal to obey the Muzaffarids proved fatal: in 1355 Mubariz al-Din Muhammad defeated Ardashir and annexed the Shabankara lands, though remnants of tribal power may have lingered in the district until 1424.
zh:
沙班卡拉是法尔斯东南部的伊朗部落族群，10世纪被布韦希人阿杜德·道莱迁此，由游牧武士氏族组成。其拉马尼支的法德勒瓦希德家族得名于开创者法德卢亚，于1062年夺取法尔斯政权，但随后被塞尔柱人击溃，法德卢亚于1071年被处死。

塞尔柱帝国瓦解后，该部落以伊杰为都恢复统治，伊儿汗时期领有以达拉卜吉尔德为中心的沙班卡拉省；1260年旭烈兀摧毁伊杰，但诸首领仍为地方统治者。

1337年首领阿尔达希尔自称萨珊诸王后裔。他拒绝服从穆扎法尔王朝，终致灭亡：1355年穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德击败阿尔达希尔并吞并沙班卡拉领地，不过残余的部落势力可能在当地一直延续到1424年。

en:
Shanglin was a Zhuang tusi in the upper Youjiang valley of north-western Guangxi, covering present-day Tianlin and Xilin counties. The Northern Song court created it as the Shanglin dong in 1053, after Di Qing's armies suppressed the rebellion of Nong Zhigao, and under the Yuan it was attached to the Lai'an Route of the Liangjiang circuit.

In 1409 the Ming enfeoffed Cen Zicheng, a son of the Sicheng chief Cen Shanzhong, as hereditary head, and the dong was reorganised as the Shanglin Chief's Office, thereafter ruled by a branch of the Cen clan.
zh:
上林是广西西北部右江上游的壮族世袭土司，辖境在今田林县、西林县一带。北宋皇祐五年（1053年），朝廷在狄青平定侬智高起兵后废如赖县、设置上林峒，元代划归两江道来安路管辖。

明永乐七年（1409年），泗城州土官岑善忠之子岑子成袭任长官，上林峒改为上林长官司，此后由岑氏一支世袭统治。

en:
The Sahnish, also called the Arikara, lived in fortified farming villages along the Missouri River in the northern Great Plains. Their language suggests a separation from the Skidi Pawnee around the fifteenth century. The smallpox epidemic of 1780–1782 reduced their Missouri River villages from 32 to two.

In 1823 the Sahnish attacked William Henry Ashley's fur traders near the Grand River. An American force and Sioux allies besieged their fortified villages, but the inhabitants escaped; Sahnish chiefs made peace with the United States in 1825.
zh:
萨尼什人又称阿里卡拉人，居住在北部大平原密苏里河沿岸设防的农耕村落中。他们的语言表明，他们约在15世纪与斯基里波尼人分离。1780—1782年的天花疫情使他们在密苏里河沿岸的村落从32个减少到2个。

1823年，萨尼什人在格兰德河附近袭击了威廉·亨利·阿什利的毛皮商队。美军和苏族盟军围攻他们的设防村落，居民却逃脱了；萨尼什酋长于1825年与美国讲和。

en: The Shilin are the Donghai Jurchen group of the settlement called Tulazi, which stood on Amur Bay facing the Suifen estuary. In the first month of 1617 Nurhaci sent the officer Muhalian with a thousand men to subdue the Donghai Hurha tribes, and Tulazi passed with the rest of the coast under Later Jin rule, completing the unification of the Donghai Jurchens.
zh: 施林是聚居于土拉子的东海女真群体，土拉子位于阿穆尔湾畔、与绥芬河口隔海相望。1617年正月，努尔哈赤派穆哈连率兵一千征讨东海虎尔哈各部，土拉子随整片地区归入后金版图，东海女真至此基本统一。

en:
The Shijō were a court noble family descended from the northern Fujiwara. Their name came from the Kyoto residence of Fujiwara no Takasue at Shijō Ōmiya in the late Heian period.

Shijō Takasuke served Emperor Go-Daigo and joined him at Yoshino in 1336. A leading Southern Court official, he was killed fighting Ashikaga forces during a retreat from Otokoyama in 1352; his son Takatoshi continued to serve the Southern Court.
zh:
四条家是出自藤原北家的公卿家族，家名来自平安时代后期藤原隆季在京都四条大宫的宅邸。

四条隆资侍奉后醍醐天皇，1336年在吉野与天皇会合。他是南朝重臣，1352年从男山撤退时与足利军交战身亡；其子隆俊继续为南朝效力。

en:
Sharkha was a predominantly Muslim province in southern Ethiopia, bordered by Hadiya, Dawaro and Bale. In the 14th century Emperor Amda Seyon raided the livestock-rich province and captured its governor Yusuf, whom he accused of cooperating with Dawaro against him.

In 1531 Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi sent raiders into Sharkha, which later came under an Adal governor. Emperor Sarsa Dengel marched through the region in 1577; Sharkha seems to have disappeared as a political unit by the 17th century.
zh:
沙尔卡是埃塞俄比亚南部一个以穆斯林为主的省份，与哈迪亚、达瓦罗和巴莱相邻。14世纪皇帝安达·塞永袭击了这个牲畜丰饶的省份，俘虏总督优素福，指控他与达瓦罗合谋对抗皇帝。

1531年伊玛目艾哈迈德·本·易卜拉欣·加齐派军袭击沙尔卡，该地后来由阿达尔的总督治理。皇帝萨尔萨·登格尔于1577年行经此地；到17世纪，沙尔卡作为政治单位似乎已消失。

en:
Holstein lay between the Elbe and Eider rivers, under counts of the House of Schauenburg from 1111. Their lands were divided among several branches; by 1390 the Rendsburg line had inherited all but Holstein-Pinneberg.
