In 1460 the estates chose Christian I of Denmark as count, and Emperor Frederick III raised Holstein to a duchy in 1474.

The duchy was partitioned among branches of the Oldenburg dynasty in 1544. In 1773 the Gottorp lands passed to the Danish king, reuniting Holstein; it joined the German Confederation in 1815.
zh:
荷尔斯泰因位于易北河与艾德河之间，自1111年起由绍恩堡家族的伯爵统治。家族领地曾分属多个支系；到1390年，伦茨堡支系继承了除荷尔斯泰因-平讷贝格外的各支领地。1460年，等级代表推选丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世为伯爵；1474年，皇帝腓特烈三世将荷尔斯泰因升为公国。

1544年，公国由奥尔登堡王朝的各支系瓜分。1773年，戈托普领地转交丹麦国王，荷尔斯泰因重新统一；1815年它加入德意志邦联。

en:
The Shammar were a great Qahtanite tribal confederation of northern Najd, descended from the Tayy, who had migrated north from Yemen in 115 and taken the twin mountains of Aja and Salma, later called Jabal Shammar.

For centuries they lived as camel-herders and horse-breeders around the wells of Ha'il, and the tribe's early fame rested on Hatim al-Ta'i, the sixth-century Christian chieftain whose generosity made him a hero of the Arabian Nights.

It was in the fourteenth century, as the old name of Tayy gave way to Shammar, that the confederation first appears under that name in written sources. Rivalry with the Anizah over the desert wells ran through these centuries, and in the seventeenth century a large section migrated north into Iraq as far as Mosul, while those who remained kept Ha'il as their seat.
zh:
舍迈尔是内志北部的盖哈坦部落大联盟，源出泰伊人。泰伊人于115年从也门北迁，夺取阿贾、塞尔马两座山，此山后来改称贾巴勒·舍迈尔。

他们世代在哈伊勒的水井周围游牧，牧骆驼、养骏马；部落早年的声名来自6世纪的基督徒酋长哈提姆·塔伊，他的慷慨使他成为《一千零一夜》里的名人。

14世纪，泰伊的旧名逐渐为舍迈尔取代，这个联盟首次以舍迈尔之名见诸文献。他们与阿尼扎人争夺沙漠水井的长期对抗贯穿数个世纪；17世纪，一大支舍迈尔人北迁伊拉克，远至摩苏尔，留在阿拉伯的人则继续以哈伊勒为中心。

en:
The Shōni were a Kyūshū warrior family descended from the Mutō branch of the Fujiwara, taking their name from an office in the Dazaifu government. They helped defend Japan against the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281 and later allied with Ashikaga Takauji during the Northern and Southern Courts wars.

Repeated defeats by the Ōuchi cost the Shōni territory. After his father died in an Ōuchi attack in 1536, Shōni Fuyuhisa restored the family in 1540, but was defeated by Ryūzōji Takanobu and killed himself in 1559.
zh:
少贰氏是九州武家，出自藤原氏的武藤支系，家名来自大宰府的官职。少贰氏参与抵御1274年和1281年的蒙古入侵，后来在南北朝战争中与足利尊氏结盟。

少贰氏屡次败于大内氏，领土逐渐缩小。1536年父亲在大内氏的进攻中身亡后，少贰冬尚于1540年重兴家族，但在1559年被龙造寺隆信击败并自杀。

en:
The Shō were a warrior family from Musashi that became local lords in Bitchū Province. Their ancestor Ienaga received Kusakabe estate after capturing Taira no Shigehira at the battle of Ichi-no-Tani in 1184.

In 1533 Shō Tamesuke allied with the Amago and took Matsuyama Castle, becoming a leading power in Bitchū. Mōri forces captured Matsuyama in 1572 and installed Mimura Motochika there, displacing the Shō as the province's dominant family.
zh:
庄氏是来自武藏国的武家，后来成为备中国的地方领主。其祖家长于1184年一之谷之战中俘虏平重衡，获赐草壁庄。

1533年庄为资与尼子氏结盟，攻取松山城，成为备中有力的领主。毛利军于1572年夺取松山城，任命三村元亲为城主，庄氏失去了在该国的优势地位。

en:
The Sahib Ataids were a short-lived Turkmen beylik centered on Karahisar-ı Sâhib, founded by the sons of Fakhr al-Din Ali, known as Sâhib Ata, the grand vizier who dominated the Seljuk sultanate of Rûm after 1277. Restored to favour under the Ilkhanid overlords in 1275, he secured Afyon as a domain for his sons Hüseyin and Hasan.

Both brothers fell in 1277 at the Battle of Değirmençayı fighting the Karamanid Bey, after which Hasan's son Şemseddin Mehmed ruled until his death in battle against the Germiyanids in 1287.

His son Nusreddin Ahmed, the reigning bey in 1337, fled before the Ilkhanid governor Timurtash's campaign, but Timurtash abandoned his siege of Karahisar and escaped to Egypt in 1327. Ahmed returned and accepted Germiyanid suzerainty, and when he died around 1341 the beylik was peacefully absorbed by the Germiyanids.
zh:
萨希布—阿塔是以萨希布—卡拉希萨尔为中心的短命突厥蛮贝伊国，由1277年后权倾罗姆塞尔柱朝堂的大维齐尔法赫尔丁·阿里（人称萨希布·阿塔）之子建立。1275年他在伊利汗国宗主下复宠，为儿子侯赛因和哈桑谋得阿菲永封地。

1277年兄弟二人在代伊尔门恰伊战役中迎战卡拉曼贝伊，双双战死；哈桑之子谢姆塞丁·穆罕默德继位，1287年与格尔米扬作战时身亡。

其子努斯雷丁·艾哈迈德是1337年在位的贝伊，曾为躲避伊利汗国总督帖木儿塔什的征讨而出逃；但帖木儿塔什于1327年解卡拉希萨尔之围、逃奔埃及，艾哈迈德归国并承认格尔米扬宗主权。约1341年他去世后，贝伊国被格尔米扬平稳吞并。

en: The Saharan were a Jat clan of the dry Jangladesh country, now northern Rajasthan, holding the tract around Churu under their own chiefs in the fourteenth century. When Rao Bika conquered Jangladesh in the fifteenth century, the clan accepted the suzerainty of Bikaner.
zh: 撒哈拉是贾特人的一支氏族，14世纪在今拉贾斯坦北部干燥的禅伽罗德什地区由本族首领割据，治所设在久鲁一带。15世纪拉奥·比卡征服禅伽罗德什后，该族接受了比卡内尔的宗主权。

en:
Sondershausen was the Thuringian seat of a branch of the Counts of Hohnstein, a Harz noble house whose county took its name from Hohnstein Castle, first mentioned in 1130 and held by the Counts of Ilfeld from 1182.

The Hohnsteins built up a compact territory between the Wipper and the Upper Harz, while a separate Sondershausen line branched off in 1289 and pushed south into Thuringia, with a further partition following in 1315. In 1337 the Sondershausen lands were ruled by Count Henry of Hohnstein.

The line did not long outlast him: in 1356 the Hohnstein-Sondershausen branch died out in the male line and its inheritance passed to the Counts of Schwarzburg. The parent Hohnstein house survived in the Harz until the death of Count Ernst VII in 1593, when its remaining counties were divided among rival claimants.
zh:
松德斯豪森是霍恩施泰因伯爵家族一支在图林根的治所。霍恩施泰因伯国得名于1130年首见记载的霍恩施泰因城堡，1182年起由伊尔费尔德伯爵持有。

霍恩施泰因家族在维珀河与上哈茨之间经营出一片完整领地；1289年松德斯豪森支系独立出来并向南深入图林根，1315年又经历一次分家。1337年统治松德斯豪森领地的是霍恩施泰因伯爵亨利。

这一支在他身后不久便断绝：1356年霍恩施泰因-松德斯豪森支系男嗣绝嗣，遗产由施瓦茨堡伯爵继承。母家则在哈茨延续到1593年伯爵恩斯特七世去世，残存伯国由各继承人均分。

en:
Siam was the name used abroad for the Thai kingdom centred on Ayutthaya in the Chao Phraya valley. Founded in 1351, Ayutthaya became a tributary of Toungoo Burma in 1569 and regained its independence in 1584. Under King Narai, a Siamese embassy visited Louis XIV's court in 1686.

Burmese armies destroyed Ayutthaya in 1767. Taksin established a new capital at Thonburi and reunited Siam; in 1782 Chao Phraya Chakri deposed him and founded a new kingdom based at Bangkok.
zh:
暹罗是外国对以湄南河流域阿瑜陀耶为中心的泰人王国所用的名称。阿瑜陀耶王国建于1351年，1569年臣服于缅甸东吁王朝，1584年重获独立。纳莱王在位时，暹罗使团于1686年访问了路易十四的宫廷。

缅甸军队于1767年摧毁阿瑜陀耶。郑信在吞武里建立新都，重新统一暹罗；1782年昭披耶却克里废黜郑信，建立以曼谷为中心的新王国。

en:
The Sibe were a Tungusic-speaking people of northeastern Asia who became subjects of the Khorchin Mongols. In 1593 Nurhaci defeated a coalition that included Sibe warriors, and in 1692 the Khorchin gave the Sibe to the Kangxi Emperor.

The Qing enrolled them in the Eight Banners and stationed them at Qiqihar and other northeastern towns. In 1764 the Qianlong Emperor ordered Sibe moved west to the Ili valley, where they served the Qing frontier.
zh:
锡伯人是东北亚的通古斯语族人群，曾归属于科尔沁蒙古。1593年，努尔哈赤击败了包括锡伯人在内的联军；1692年，科尔沁将锡伯人交给康熙帝。

清朝将他们编入八旗，驻防齐齐哈尔等东北城镇。1764年，乾隆帝下令将锡伯人西迁伊犁河谷，为清朝戍边。

en:
The Kingdom of Sicily, ruled from Palermo, was founded on Christmas Day 1130, when the Norman count Roger II had himself crowned over the island his family had taken from its Muslim rulers. After the Norman and Hohenstaufen lines, including the emperor Frederick II, the French Angevins took the throne, and their harsh rule provoked the Sicilian Vespers of 1282. The islanders called in Peter III of Aragon, and the kingdom split: the Angevins kept the mainland half, later called the Kingdom of Naples, while the island became an Aragonese realm, confirmed to Frederick III by the Peace of Caltabellotta in 1302. Frederick strengthened the Sicilian parliament through the Constitutiones regales and was still reigning when 1337 opened, though he died that June and was succeeded by his son Peter II.

The island crown stayed with an Aragonese cadet line until the Compromise of Caspe of 1412 attached Sicily permanently to the Crown of Aragon; Alfonso V reunited it with Naples in 1442. Under the united Spanish monarchy it became a viceroyalty, and its Jews were expelled under the edict of 1492, the last of them leaving by early 1493. After the War of the Spanish Succession it passed to the House of Savoy, which in 1720 exchanged it with Austria for Sardinia; a Bourbon line later ruled it from Naples, and in 1816 it was merged into the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.
zh:
西西里王国以巴勒莫为都，1130年圣诞节，诺曼伯爵鲁杰罗二世加冕为王，建立了这个王国——他的家族此前从穆斯林统治者手中夺取了西西里岛。历经诺曼王朝和霍亨斯陶芬王朝（包括皇帝腓特烈二世）之后，法国安茹家族登上王位，其苛政激起1282年的西西里晚祷起义。岛民请来阿拉贡的佩德罗三世，王国就此分裂：安茹家族保住半岛部分，即后来的那不勒斯王国，海岛则成为阿拉贡支系统治的国度，1302年的《卡尔塔贝洛塔和约》正式确认腓特烈三世的王位。腓特烈通过《王室宪章》加强了西西里议会的权力，1337年开局时他仍在位，但于当年6月去世，由其子佩德罗二世继位。

海岛王位在阿拉贡支系中传承，直到1412年的《卡斯佩妥协方案》把西西里永久并入阿拉贡联合王国，1442年阿方索五世又将它与那不勒斯重新合并。在统一的西班牙君主制下，西西里成为总督辖区，岛上的犹太人则依1492年的驱逐敕令，在1492至1493年间被逐出。西班牙王位继承战争后，该岛转归萨伏依家族，1720年萨伏依又用它向奥地利换取撒丁岛；后来波旁家族的一支从那不勒斯统治西西里，1816年它被并入两西西里王国。

en:
The Republic of Siena was a city-state of southern Tuscany, traditionally founded in 1125 when the commune deposed its bishop, and declared full independence in 1167. Wealth came from banking and wool, and its Ghibelline politics set it against Guelph Florence. In 1260 the Sienese, backed by King Manfred of Sicily, crushed the Florentine army at Montaperti.

From 1287 the government of the Nine presided over a golden age: the cathedral was completed, the Palazzo Pubblico rose on the Campo, and Ambrogio Lorenzetti painted his Allegory of Good Government there. In 1337 the Nine still ruled, but the Black Death of 1348 shattered the economy and the regime fell in 1355.

After decades of strife, Pandolfo Petrucci made himself signore. The revived republic fought Florence before surrendering on 21 April 1555, when Siena was absorbed into the Medici Duchy of Florence.
zh:
锡耶纳共和国是托斯卡纳南部城邦，传统上以1125年公社废主教建国，1167年宣布脱离主教控制。财富来自银行与羊毛贸易，属吉伯林派，与圭尔夫派佛罗伦萨为敌。1260年，锡耶纳人得西西里国王曼弗雷德支持，于蒙塔佩尔蒂战役击溃佛罗伦萨军队。

1287年起，“九人政权”开启黄金时代：大教堂竣工，田野广场建市政宫，安布罗焦·洛伦泽蒂在宫内绘成《好政府的寓言》。1337年九人政权仍执政，但1348年黑死病重创城市经济，政权于1355年倒台。

数十年纷争之后，潘多尔福·佩特鲁奇成为城市实际领主。恢复后的共和国与佛罗伦萨交战，1555年4月21日投降，锡耶纳并入美第奇的佛罗伦萨公国。

en:
Siang was a trading kingdom on the west coast of South Sulawesi, its royal centre at Sengkae near a river mouth. It flourished from roughly the tenth century on forest and sea products and, later, wet rice.

Its port drew merchants from across the archipelago after the fall of Malacca in 1511, and Portuguese visitors found it at the height of its power. Manuel Pinto estimated around 1545 that the capital held some forty thousand people, while local tradition and Portuguese accounts remembered Gowa and Talloq as once having been its vassals.

Siang's primacy did not outlast the rise of Gowa and its better-sited port of Somba Opu. From the mid-sixteenth century its trade and influence drained away, and by the end of the century it had ceased to be known as an independent power, lingering as a subject land under Gowa's hegemony.
zh:
锡昂是南苏拉威西西海岸的贸易王国，王都设在河口附近的森卡埃。它约从10世纪起兴盛，靠林产、海产和后来的水田稻米致富。

1511年马六甲沦陷后，其港口吸引了群岛各地的商人，葡萄牙访客见到的正是它的鼎盛期。曼努埃尔·平托在1545年前后估计王都约有四万人口；当地传说和葡萄牙人的记述都记得，戈瓦和塔洛曾是它的附庸。

锡昂的霸主地位没能熬过戈瓦的崛起，后者的松巴奥普港位置更为优越。从16世纪中叶起，它的贸易和影响不断流失，到该世纪末已不再作为独立政权见于记载，只作为戈瓦霸权下的臣属之地残存。

en:
The Sihanaka lived around Lake Alaotra in northeastern Madagascar, where rice growing and trade supported fortified villages. By the mid-seventeenth century they supplied enslaved people to traders serving the Mascarene plantations; around 1700 they traded rice and cattle with the Betsimisaraka.

In the eighteenth century the Sihanaka were vassals of Boina and unsuccessfully fought to regain independence. Around 1800 the armies of Andrianampoinimerina conquered their territory for Imerina, bringing an influx of Merina settlers.
zh:
西哈纳卡人居住在马达加斯加东北部的阿劳特拉湖周围，靠种稻和贸易维持设防村落。到17世纪中叶，他们向为马斯克林群岛种植园供货的商人提供奴隶；约1700年，他们与贝齐米萨拉卡人交换稻米和牛。

18世纪西哈纳卡人臣属于博伊纳，曾为重获独立而战，但未能成功。约1800年，安德里亚南普伊奈梅里纳的军队为伊默里纳征服了他们的领地，随后大批梅里纳人迁入。

en:
The Skiri, or Skidi, were the northernmost Pawnee band, living along the Platte and Loup rivers in present-day Nebraska. Their villages were distinct from the southern Pawnee bands, and their speech was more closely related to neither southern dialect than those dialects were to each other.

In 1724 Skiri representatives joined a peace council with Frenchmen and several neighboring peoples. Around 1752 they made peace with the Comanche, Wichita and the main Pawnee groups; by the 1770s some had moved toward Texas and allied with the Taovaya and other peoples.
zh:
斯基里是波尼人最北方的部族，居住在今内布拉斯加州的普拉特河和卢普河沿岸。斯基里的村落与南方波尼部族分开，其方言与南方各方言的差异也大于后者之间的差异。

1724年，斯基里代表与法国人及几个邻近族群参加了和谈。约1752年，他们与科曼奇人、威奇托人和波尼人的主要部族讲和；到18世纪70年代，部分斯基里人迁向得克萨斯，与陶瓦亚人等族群结盟。

en: The Shilluk kingdom lay along the White Nile in what is now South Sudan and southern Sudan, with its royal residence at Fashoda. Tradition attributes its foundation to Nyikang, probably in the late fifteenth century, and traces its sacred kings to him. The kingdom reached its height around 1800 as the Funj Sultanate to the north declined.
zh: 希卢克王国位于白尼罗河沿岸的今南苏丹和苏丹南部，王室驻地在法绍达。传统认为王国由尼坎建立，时间可能是15世纪后半叶；神圣的王族世系也追溯到他。约1800年，北方的丰吉苏丹国衰落，希卢克王国则达到鼎盛。

en:
The Duchy of Silesia was a Piast principality centered on Wrocław, created by the partition of Poland in 1138. A division between the ruling brothers in 1172 began its fragmentation into smaller duchies.

Most Silesian duchies came under Bohemian suzerainty in 1327, and Poland renounced its claims in 1335. In the eighteenth century Frederick II of Prussia fought Maria Theresa of Austria for the region; the first Silesian War ended in 1742 with most of Silesia ceded to Prussia.
zh:
西里西亚公国是以弗罗茨瓦夫为中心的皮亚斯特领地，形成于1138年波兰的分裂。1172年统治者兄弟分割领地，开启了公国分裂为众多小公国的过程。

大多数西里西亚公国于1327年归于波希米亚宗主权下，波兰于1335年放弃了对西里西亚的主张。18世纪，普鲁士的腓特烈二世与奥地利的玛丽亚·特蕾莎争夺这一地区；第一次西里西亚战争于1742年结束，西里西亚大部割让给普鲁士。

en: The Sirin are the Wozhe Jurchen group of the Shili, or Xilin, river valley on the forested Primorye coast; under the Yuan they were administered through the Shilin thousand-household office set up for Wozhe hunters. They rose against the Yuan in 1343 and again in 1346, when gyrfalcon tribute demands drove the Wozhe and Shuidada to revolt.
zh: 西林是活动在失里（又译细林）河流域、滨海森林地带的兀者女真群体，元朝曾在细林河设失邻千户所管辖他们。1343年辽阳兀者野人起兵反元，1346年因捕海东青的繁重摊派，兀者野人与水达达再次反元。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Sion was a church state of the Holy Roman Empire ruling the upper Rhône valley, the Valais, from the city of Sion. Its see was founded in Roman times; Saint Theodore founded the Abbey of Saint-Maurice, and in 589 the seat was moved to Sion. Around 999 the last king of Upper Burgundy granted the County of Valais to Bishop Hugo, uniting spiritual and temporal rule.

The Seven Tithings of Upper Valais rose against the bishops, burned Tourbillon Castle in 1417 and took civil jurisdiction by the Treaty of Naters in 1446. The Valais rejected the Reformation, but in 1634 the bishop ceded temporal power to the Republic of the Seven Tithings.

The French invasion of 1798 ended the old order; after the Rhodanic Republic and French annexation, the Valais joined Switzerland as a canton in 1814.
zh:
锡永采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，以锡永城为中心统治罗讷河上游的瓦莱谷地。它的教区始建于罗马时代，圣狄奥多勒创立圣莫里斯修道院，589年主教驻地迁至锡永。约999年，上勃艮第末代国王把瓦莱伯国封给主教雨果，教权与世俗权力合一。

上瓦莱的七个十户区起而反抗主教，1417年焚毁陶鲁比永城堡，1446年通过《纳特斯条约》取得民事司法权。瓦莱拒绝宗教改革，但1634年主教把世俗权力让给十户区共和国。

1798年法军入侵终结旧秩序，历经罗达尼亚共和国和法国兼并后，瓦莱于1814年作为一个州加入瑞士。

en:
The Duchy of Siewierz was a small Silesian Piast principality centered on the town of Siewierz, first mentioned in 1125 and granted city rights in 1276. In 1177 Casimir II of Poland gave it with the Duchy of Bytom to Mieszko IV, and after the Mongols burned the town in 1241 it was rebuilt under the Bytom Piasts.

In 1337 Duke Władysław of Bytom sold Siewierz to Casimir I of Cieszyn, and in 1443 Wenceslaus I of Cieszyn sold the duchy for six thousand Prague groschen to Zbigniew Oleśnicki, bishop of Kraków. The Kraków bishops then ruled Siewierz as an ecclesiastical principality with its own laws, treasury and army.

The Great Sejm incorporated it into the Polish Crown in 1790, Prussia took it in the Third Partition of 1795, and in 1815 it passed to Russian-ruled Congress Poland.
zh:
谢维日公国是西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的小公国，以谢维日城为中心；该城1125年首见记载，1276年获得城市权。1177年，波兰的卡齐米日二世把谢维日连同比托姆公国封给梅什科四世；1241年蒙古人焚毁该城，后在比托姆皮雅斯特支系治下重建。

1337年，比托姆公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫把谢维日卖给切申的卡齐米尔一世。1443年，切申公爵瓦茨瓦夫一世以六千布拉格格罗申将其卖给克拉科夫主教兹比格涅夫·奥莱希尼茨基；此后克拉科夫主教将谢维日作为教会公国统治，自有法律、国库和军队。

1790年大议会将其并入波兰王国，1795年第三次瓜分时被普鲁士夺取，1815年转入俄国统治的波兰会议王国。

en:
The Sakalava formed kingdoms along western Madagascar under the Maroseranana dynasty. After 1610 Andriandahifotsy extended his power north of the Mangoky River, using weapons acquired through the slave trade; his sons pushed farther north toward Mahajanga.

Menabe became a leading Sakalava kingdom, and Sakalava rule reached its greatest extent between 1730 and 1760 under Andrianinevenarivo. In the early nineteenth century the Merina kingdom expanded against the western polities.
zh:
萨卡拉瓦人在马达加斯加西部沿海建立了由马鲁塞拉纳王朝统治的王国。1610年后，安德里安达希富齐利用奴隶贸易换来的武器，将势力扩展到芒古基河以北；他的儿子们继续向北推进至马哈赞加一带。

梅纳贝成为主要的萨卡拉瓦王国，安德里亚尼内韦纳里武统治下的萨卡拉瓦势力在1730年至1760年间达到最大范围。19世纪初，梅里纳王国向西部诸政权扩张。

en:
The Scanian lands comprise the provinces of Scania, Halland and Blekinge, fertile Danish territories east of the Sound, whose provincial thing was one of three assemblies electing Danish kings and whose Scanian Law, written around 1200, is the oldest surviving Nordic provincial law. Lund, their capital, became an archbishop's seat in 1104 and long housed Scandinavia's primatial see.

A tax revolt in the 1180s was put down by Valdemar I and Absalon. In 1332 the Danish crown, having pledged the provinces to Holstein's counts, let them pass to Magnus Eriksson of Sweden; in 1337 they are thus a Swedish fief with a Danish-speaking population.

Valdemar IV Atterdag reconquered Scania in 1360, and it stayed Danish for three centuries until the 1658 Treaty of Roskilde ceded the Scanian provinces to Sweden. Danish attempts to win them back, including the Scanian War of 1675 to 1679, failed; Sweden then pressed assimilation through its law and worship and founded Lund University in 1666.
zh:
斯堪尼亚之地由斯堪尼亚、哈兰和布莱金厄诸省组成，是厄勒海峡以东富庶的丹麦土地；其省议事会是选举丹麦国王的三大议事会之一，约1200年成文的斯堪尼亚法则是现存最古老的北欧地方法。首府隆德1104年成为大主教驻地，长期是斯堪的纳维亚的首席主教区。

1180年代的抗税起义被瓦尔德马一世和阿布萨隆镇压。1332年，丹麦王室已把这些省份抵押给荷尔斯泰因伯爵，任其转入瑞典的马格努斯·埃里克松之手，因此1337年它们是瑞典领有、居民却说丹麦语的封地。

瓦尔德马四世·阿道戴1360年重新征服斯堪尼亚，此后三百年它一直属于丹麦，直到1658年《罗斯基勒条约》将斯堪尼亚诸省割让给瑞典。丹麦的收复努力（包括1675至1679年的斯堪尼亚战争）均告失败；瑞典随后以本国法律和礼拜推行同化，并于1666年创办隆德大学。

en:
Shaki is a city of the southern Caucasus foothills in the historical province of Shirvan, on the road between the Caspian and the Georgian lands. It took its name from the Iranian Saka nomads of the seventh century BC and became one of the chief cities of Caucasian Albania. The Arab conquest of 654 brought Islam.

In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries it belonged to the Shirvanshahs until a local clan seized power in the 1330s and ruled an independent Shaki after the collapse of the Ilkhanate. Timur stormed it in 1392; from 1444 a hereditary Muslim dynasty ruled until the Safavids ended it in 1551.

In 1743 Haji Chelebi founded the independent Shaki Khanate, whose silk wealth and palace of 1762 made the city famous. The treaties of Kyurekchay in 1805 and Gulistan in 1813 delivered it to Russia, and the khanate was abolished in 1819.
zh:
沙基是南高加索山麓的城邑，在里海与格鲁吉亚之间的商路上，属希尔凡地区。城名来自公元前7世纪占据此地的伊朗语萨卡游牧人，后成为高加索阿尔巴尼亚的主要城市之一。654年阿拉伯人征服后伊斯兰教传入。

13至14世纪它臣属于希尔万沙，14世纪30年代本地部族夺权，在伊儿汗国崩溃后统治着独立的沙基。1392年帖木儿攻破该城；1444年起，一个穆斯林世袭王朝在此统治，直到1551年被萨法维王朝终结。

1743年哈吉·切莱比建立独立的沙基汗国，丝绸之利与1762年的汗宫使其闻名。1805年的《库雷克恰伊条约》和1813年的《古利斯坦条约》把沙基交给俄罗斯，汗国于1819年被废除。

en:
Sikkim, known as Drenjong or rice valley in Tibetan sources and as Zhe Mengxiong in Qing records, is the small Himalayan kingdom between Nepal, Bhutan and Tibet. Its earliest known inhabitants were Lepcha pastoralists, and tradition holds that Padmasambhava blessed the land in the eighth century. In the seventh century it was part of the Tibetan Empire, whose ninth-century collapse left its valleys as independent tribes.

The monarchy was founded in 1642, when Phuntsog Namgyal, a Bhutia noble, was consecrated first Chogyal by three lamas at Yuksom. His Namgyal dynasty ruled as a Tibetan protectorate, and in 1670 the capital moved from Yuksom to Rabdentse.

From the mid-eighteenth century Gorkha Nepal and Bhutan overran much of it; the Nepalese sack of Rabdentse in 1788 drew in a Qing army, and the 1817 Treaty of Titalia tied Sikkim to British India.
zh:
锡金在藏文文献中称登疆，意为稻米之谷，清代典籍称哲孟雄，是夹在尼泊尔、不丹和西藏之间的喜马拉雅小邦。当地最早的居民是雷布查牧民；相传8世纪莲花生为此地加持。7世纪时它是吐蕃的一部分，吐蕃9世纪崩溃后，各山谷成为独立部落。

君主制迟至1642年才建立，菩提亚贵族蓬楚格·纳穆加尔在域松被三位喇嘛拥立为第一代却嘉，他的纳穆加尔王朝作为西藏的藩属立国，1670年首都从域松迁往拉布登策。

18世纪中叶起，廓尔喀尼泊尔和不丹大举入侵，1788年廓尔喀军攻陷拉布登策，引来清军；1817年的《蒂塔利亚条约》把锡金与英属印度绑在一起。

en: The S'Klallam were Coast Salish communities along the northern Olympic Peninsula and across the Strait of Juan de Fuca on Vancouver Island. Their coastal villages traded and intermarried with neighbouring peoples, and potlatches marked social standing. Robert Gray reached Clallam Bay in 1789, and George Vancouver met the S'Klallam in 1792.
zh: 斯克勒拉姆人是居住在奥林匹克半岛北部，以及胡安·德富卡海峡对岸温哥华岛上的海岸萨利什社群。他们的海岸村落与邻族通商、通婚，并通过赠礼宴彰显社会地位。罗伯特·格雷于1789年抵达克勒勒姆湾，乔治·温哥华于1792年与斯克勒拉姆人相遇。

en:
Suakin is a coral-built port on a sheltered Red Sea inlet in the Beja country. Al-Hamdani knew it as a Beja settlement in the tenth century, and after the port of Badi was abandoned it grew into a major emporium, its merchants linking India, the Hijaz and the African interior and carrying Mecca pilgrims.

A Mamluk army drove out its ruler in 1264, and in 1317 the town submitted to Cairo's sultans. Ibn Battuta in 1332 found it ruled by the sharif Zayd ibn Abi Numayy, son of a Meccan sharif; as Mamluk power waned the Hedareb took the town. After Aydhab was destroyed in 1426, Suakin became the foremost port of the north-east African coast.

The Ottomans occupied it in the 1550s and made it the seat of the Habesh pashalik. The Cape route had begun Suakin's long decline, and by the early nineteenth century much of the coral city lay in ruins.
zh:
萨瓦金是贝贾人之地红海海岸隐蔽海湾内的珊瑚石港口。哈姆达尼在10世纪已知它是贝贾聚落；巴迪港废弃后，它成为重要商埠，商人往来于印度、汉志与非洲内陆之间，并运送麦加朝圣者。

1264年马穆鲁克军队赶走其统治者，1317年该城臣服开罗的苏丹。伊本·白图泰1332年到访时，统治者是麦加谢里夫之子扎伊德·伊本·阿比·努马伊；马穆鲁克势力衰落后，哈达里巴人夺取该城。1426年阿伊扎布被毁，萨瓦金成为东北非沿海首屈一指的港口。

1550年代奥斯曼人占领萨瓦金，设为哈贝什帕夏辖区驻地。绕好望角航路开启萨瓦金漫长的衰落，到19世纪初，这座珊瑚古城大半沦为废墟。

en:
Sokoto was a Sunni caliphate in West Africa founded by the Fulani scholar Usman dan Fodio. After the ruler of Gobir attempted to kill him, Usman and his followers moved to Gudu in 1804 and began a jihad against the Hausa rulers.

By 1808 his forces controlled Hausaland and neighbouring states. The caliphate joined many emirates under the authority of the commander of the faithful; Usman later passed practical leadership to his son Muhammad Bello.
zh:
索科托是西非的逊尼派哈里发国，由富拉尼学者奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥建立。戈比尔统治者企图杀害他后，奥斯曼与追随者于1804年迁往古杜，开始对豪萨统治者发动圣战。

到1808年，他的军队控制了豪萨地区和周边诸邦。哈里发国将许多埃米尔国联合在信士的长官权威之下；奥斯曼后来把实际领导权交给儿子穆罕默德·贝洛。

en:
The Skarùre, also known as the Tuscarora, were an Iroquoian people living along the Roanoke, Neuse, Tar and Pamlico rivers in the Carolinas. In 1711 the southern Tuscarora under Chief Hancock and their allies attacked encroaching settlers; the northern group under Tom Blunt initially stayed out of the war.

After their defeat, most Tuscarora gradually migrated north to Pennsylvania and New York. In 1722 they were accepted as the sixth nation of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, with the Oneida as their sponsors.
zh:
斯卡鲁雷人也称塔斯卡洛拉人，是居住在卡罗来纳地区罗阿诺克河、纽斯河、塔尔河和帕姆利科河沿岸的易洛魁语族族群。1711年，汉考克酋长领导的南部塔斯卡洛拉人及其盟友袭击侵占土地的殖民者；汤姆·布伦特领导的北部群体起初没有参战。

战败后，大多数塔斯卡洛拉人陆续北迁至宾夕法尼亚和纽约。1722年，在奥奈达人支持下，他们成为豪德诺索尼联盟的第六个民族。

en:
Suket was a Sen-ruled hill state in the Sutlej valley of the Punjab Hills, its rajas keeping their seat at Pangna. Tradition traces the line to Bira Sen, a son of the Sena dynasty of Bengal, and its rulers long warred with neighbour Kullu, which Raja Bikram Sen at last forced to pay tribute; under Raja Madan Sen the smaller surrounding states also submitted, making his reign Suket's golden age.

When the Mughals reached the hills in Raja Udai Sen's day, Suket submitted and was left to itself on payment of tribute. In 1527 Ajbar Sen founded the separate state of Mandi, which grew into Suket's equal and neighbour.

Suket kept its autonomy through the Gurkha incursions of 1803 to 1815 and the following Sikh supremacy, as Raja Bikram Sen II played the greater powers against one another.
zh:
苏盖德是旁遮普山区萨特莱杰河谷中由森王朝统治的山邦，罗阇以庞格纳为治所。按传统说法，王统可追溯到孟加拉犀那王朝王子维拉·森；历代罗阇长期与邻邦库鲁交战，最终比克拉姆·森迫使库鲁纳贡，到马丹·森时周围小邦也纷纷臣服，他的时代成为苏盖德的黄金时代。

莫卧儿势力在乌代·森时进入山区，苏盖德称臣纳贡，内政得以照旧。1527年阿杰巴尔·森另建曼迪邦，后来发展成与苏盖德并立的邻邦。

1803至1815年廓尔喀人入侵，随后锡克人势力笼罩山区，罗阇比克拉姆·森二世周旋于列强之间，使苏盖德保住自治地位。

en:
Starodub-on-the-Klyazma was the seat of one of the smallest Russian principalities, a town on the Klyazma River in the Opolye district, not far from modern Kovrov. Settlers named it after Starodub in Severia, and in 1238, during the Mongol invasion, Prince Ivan, the youngest son of Vsevolod III of Vladimir, made the town his seat.

For more than a century his descendants, the Starodub branch of the Rurikids, held this tiny appanage between two expanding neighbours, Moscow and Nizhny Novgorod. In the 1370s Dmitry Donskoy annexed it, and the princely family moved into Muscovite service, giving rise to such boyar houses as the Gagarins, Khilkovs, Romodanovskys and Pozharskys.

The old town was burned to the ground by a Polish raiding party under Lisowski in 1609 and was never rebuilt; the village of Klyazminsky Gorodok now marks its site.
zh:
克利亚济马河畔斯塔罗杜布是罗斯最小的公国之一的都城，位于奥波利耶地区克利亚济马河畔，邻近科夫罗夫。移民以故乡谢维里亚的斯塔罗杜布为它命名；1238年蒙古入侵期间，弗拉基米尔大公弗谢沃洛德三世的幼子伊凡以该城为治所。

一个多世纪里，他的后裔留里克王朝斯塔罗杜布支系，在莫斯科与下诺夫哥罗德两个强邻之间保有这块小封邑。14世纪70年代德米特里·顿斯科伊将其兼并，斯塔罗杜布家族转入莫斯科服役，衍生出加加林、希尔科夫、罗莫达诺夫斯基、波扎尔斯基等波雅尔家族。

1609年旧城被利索夫斯基率领的波兰袭掠部队焚毁，再未重建，克利亚济明斯基戈罗多克村就坐落在其遗址上。

en: Silat was a small Dayak river polity on the upper Kapuas in what is now Kapuas Hulu Regency of West Kalimantan. Local tradition names it as a neighbour of the stronger kingdom of Selimbau, which came to dominate the upper-Kapuas chieftaincies in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.
zh: 锡拉特是卡普阿斯河上游的达雅克河域小邦，位于今天印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省上卡普阿斯县境内。地方传说把它记作较强的塞林包王国的邻邦，17至18世纪上卡普阿斯的小酋长邦相继受塞林包支配。

en:
The Suldus were a Darligin Mongol tribe who in the twelfth century lived attached to the Tayichiud and helped Genghis Khan against them. Sorgan-Shira, one of the khan's nine companions, was a Suldus, and his son Chilaun became one of the Four Stewards. Chilaun's descendants rose as the Chobanids, of Ilkhanid commander Chupan, who in 1327 was named chief commander of all the Mongol khanates and whose line later ruled Iranian Azerbaijan.

Suldus mingghans were among the eight thousand households given to Chagatai, and after the conquests settled in Transoxiana and northern Afghanistan, around Balkh and the upper Oxus.

When the Chagatai Khanate disintegrated, the Suldus amir Buyan joined Hajji Beg of the Barlas in a 1359 revolt against Qara'una rule, overthrew Abdullah ibn Qazaghan and briefly shaped events in Transoxiana before Tughlugh Timur of Moghulistan executed him in 1362. Other Suldus groups moved west into Azerbaijan and Iran, while a branch survives among the Hazaras as the Dai Chopan.
zh:
速勒都思是迭儿列勤蒙古的一支，12世纪时依附泰赤乌部，后来在成吉思汗与泰赤乌的战争中倒戈相助。成吉思汗九位同伴之一的锁儿罕失剌就出自该部，其子赤老温是“四杰”之一。赤老温的后裔发展为出班家族，伊利汗国名将出班1327年被册封为诸蒙古汗国的总指挥官，其后人还一度在伊朗阿塞拜疆建立政权。

速勒都思千户是封给察合台的八千属民之一，西征后定居河中与阿富汗北部，游牧于巴尔赫和阿姆河上游一带。

察合台汗国瓦解时，速勒都思异密巴颜联合巴鲁剌思的哈吉·伯克于1359年反抗哈剌兀纳思人的统治，推翻合扎罕之子阿卜杜拉，一度左右河中政局，最终1362年被蒙兀儿斯坦的图黑鲁·帖木儿处死。另有速勒都思支系西迁阿塞拜疆和伊朗，还有一支以“戴出班”之名留存于哈扎拉人之中。

en:
The Republic of Salé was a corsair city-state at the mouth of Morocco's Bou Regreg river. Moriscos from Hornachos in Spain settled there around the time of Philip III's expulsion decrees of 1609, and corsairs sailed from the river into the Atlantic and Mediterranean.

In 1627 the Hornacheros expelled the sultan's governor and established a virtually independent republic. After clashes in 1630, they shared its ruling council with other Andalusian Moriscos; Salé was later incorporated into Alaouite Morocco.
zh:
塞拉共和国是摩洛哥布雷格雷格河口的海盗城邦。西班牙国王腓力三世于1609年下令驱逐摩里斯科人，来自奥尔纳乔斯的摩里斯科人前后迁居此地，私掠船从河口驶向大西洋和地中海。

1627年，奥尔纳乔斯人驱逐了苏丹的总督，建立了实际上独立的共和国。1630年发生冲突后，他们与其他安达卢西亚摩里斯科人共同掌握议事会；塞拉后来并入阿拉维派统治下的摩洛哥。

en:
The Sabuli were the Siyuliyya, a Kurdish tribe that the Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari, writing in the 1340s, placed in the Shahrazur country between Shahrazur and Bashna. He counted two thousand men and praised their courage and fierce pride.

The tribe was split into two sections, one under Turak, son of Izz al-Din Mahmud, and the other under the emir Dawud, known as Dawud Badran.
zh:
萨布利即西尤利亚部。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，这个库尔德部落住在谢赫雷祖尔地区，位于谢赫雷祖尔与巴什纳之间，有两千人，勇敢而有血性。

部落分为两支，一支由伊兹丁·马哈茂德之子图拉克统领，另一支由埃米尔达乌德统领，人称达乌德·巴德兰。

en:
The Selkup people lived in western Siberia's Ob basin. In the sixteenth century, Selkup and Ket tribes formed the Piebald Horde in the Narym and Tom basins, east of the Siberian Khanate. Princes Vonya and Kichey resisted Moscow and sought an alliance with Khan Kuchum.

Russia subdued the confederation after building a fort at Narym in the 1590s. In 1610 Vonya's son Taybokhta entered the tsar's service while retaining authority over the upper Narym principality.
zh:
塞尔库普人居住在西西伯利亚的鄂毕河流域。16世纪，塞尔库普人与凯特人的部落在西伯利亚汗国以东的纳雷姆河和托木河流域组成花斑部落联盟。冯尼亚和基切伊两位首领抵抗莫斯科，并寻求与库楚姆汗结盟。

俄国在16世纪90年代于纳雷姆修筑堡垒后，征服了这一联盟。1610年，冯尼亚之子泰博赫塔进入沙皇的军役，同时保留对上纳雷姆公国的统治权。

en: Shabalula, at present-day Sígsig in southern Ecuador, was a major Cañari center. Gualaceo belonged to a Cañari diarchy associated with Shabalula and Hatun Cañar. The Inca conquered the Cañari in the early 16th century; after the Spanish arrived, the Cañari chief Llivicura guided them to Gualaceo, where they established a mining camp in 1534.
zh: 沙巴卢拉位于今厄瓜多尔南部的锡格锡格，是佳纳利人的重要中心。瓜拉塞奥属于与沙巴卢拉和哈通卡尼亚尔相关的佳纳利双中心政体。16世纪初印加征服了佳纳利人；西班牙人到来后，佳纳利酋长利维库拉引领他们前往瓜拉塞奥，西班牙人于1534年在那里建立采矿营地。

en:
The County of Salm in the Vosges, later called Upper Salm, was the mountain lordship of the House of Salm, whose ancestor Hermann of Salm was elected anti-king against Henry IV in 1081. In 1163 its lands were split: the Ardennes estates became Lower Salm and the Vosges estates around Salm Castle became Upper Salm.

Hemmed in by the Prince-Bishopric of Strasbourg and the Duchy of Lorraine, the county was partitioned: Salm-Blankenburg split off in 1246 and Salm-Badenweiler in 1431.

In 1475 half of Upper Salm passed to the Wild- and Rhinegraves, who became counts of Salm and were raised to princely rank in 1623; the other half fell to the dukes of Lorraine in 1600. The surviving line formed the Principality of Salm-Salm in 1751, before French Revolutionary troops annexed the Vosges lands in 1793.
zh:
孚日山区的萨尔姆伯国后称上萨尔姆，是萨尔姆家族的山地领地，家族先祖赫尔曼·冯·萨尔姆曾于1081年被推举为对立国王，与亨利四世分庭抗礼。1163年家族领地一分为二：阿登的产业成为下萨尔姆，围绕萨尔姆城堡的孚日产业成为上萨尔姆。

伯国北邻斯特拉斯堡采邑主教区、南接洛林公国，疆域一再分割：1246年分出萨尔姆-布兰肯堡，1431年分出萨尔姆-巴登韦勒。

1475年，上萨尔姆的一半由荒野-莱茵伯爵继承，他们承袭萨尔姆伯爵头衔，1623年晋升诸侯；另一半于1600年落入洛林公爵之手。存续支系于1751年组成萨尔姆-萨尔姆侯国，1793年其孚日领地被法国革命军吞并。

en:
Carbury, in Irish Cairbre Drom Cliabh, was a Gaelic túath of Lower Connacht along the coast beneath Benbulbin, with the harbour town of Sligo as its seat. It took its name from the early king Cairbre mac Néill and was also called Cairbre na Catha, Carbury of the Battles; Saint Colmcille founded the monastery of Drumcliff there in 575.

From the later twelfth century its lords were the Ó Conchobhair Sligigh, or O'Conor Sligo, a junior branch of the kings of Connacht. As a frontier saor-túath it paid no tribute, and amid the Burke Civil War of the 1330s its chiefs extended their power across Lower Connacht.

In later times the O'Conors struggled to hold back the O'Donnells of Tyrconnell, and their independence ended with the collapse of the Gaelic order after the Nine Years' War in 1603.
zh:
卡伯里，爱尔兰语称凯尔布雷·德罗姆克利夫，是下康诺特的盖尔图阿特，位于本布尔本山麓海岸，以港口城镇斯莱戈为治所。其名取自早期国王凯尔布雷·麦克·尼尔，又称凯尔布雷·纳卡塔，意为百战卡伯里；575年圣科伦基尔在此创立鼓崖修道院。

12世纪后期起，其领主是奥康诺·斯莱戈家族，即康诺特诸王的旁支。作为边境免贡图阿特它无须纳贡，趁14世纪30年代伯克内战之机，首领们把势力扩张到整个下康诺特。

后来奥康诺家族苦苦抵挡蒂龙奈尔的奥唐奈家族，其独立地位最终在1603年九年战争结束、盖尔秩序崩溃时告终。

en: Slovakia is the Central European region inhabited by Slovaks, whose lands became part of the Kingdom of Hungary after the collapse of Great Moravia. Following the Ottoman wars of the sixteenth century, much of the region remained in Habsburg-ruled Hungary.
zh: 斯洛伐克是斯洛伐克人居住的中欧地区；大摩拉维亚瓦解后，这片土地成为匈牙利王国的一部分。16世纪奥斯曼战争之后，该地区大部仍属于哈布斯堡家族统治的匈牙利。

en:
Selaparang, also called the Kingdom of Lombok, was the Sasak kingdom of Lombok island, its court at Selaparang in the east. The fourteenth-century Javanese poem Negarakertagama described Lombok as split between two native realms, and tradition calls this early Hindu-influenced phase Hindu Selaparang.

Islam spread among the Sasak from the fifteenth century, and under Prabu Rangkesari the united kingdom reached its height. Its navy repelled two invasions by the Balinese kingdom of Gelgel in 1616 and 1624, the court moved inland from its silting bay, and its sway crossed the sea to western Sumbawa.

It drove off Dutch East India Company attacks in 1667 and 1668 but lost western Sumbawa, and around 1692 it fell to a Karangasem expedition from Bali after a noble turned against his king. From 1740 Karangasem and its local allies partitioned the island, Balinese lords ruling the Selaparang lands.
zh:
沙拉巴朗又称龙目王国，是龙目岛上的萨萨克人王国，王廷在岛东部的沙拉巴朗。14世纪爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》已记龙目为两个本土政权分治之岛，传统说法把这个受印度教影响的早期阶段称为印度教沙拉巴朗。

15世纪起伊斯兰教在萨萨克人中传播，普拉布·朗克萨里在位时统一的王国进入鼎盛：水师于1616年和1624年两次击退巴厘格尔格尔王国的入侵，王廷从淤塞的海湾内迁，势力跨海达松巴哇西部。

舰队1667、1668年击退荷兰东印度公司进攻，但失去西松巴哇；约1692年，一名贵族叛主后，王国被巴厘卡朗阿森远征军灭掉。1740年起卡朗阿森与其当地盟友瓜分龙目，沙拉巴朗故地后由巴厘贵族统治。

en:
Solothurn, on the Aare at the foot of the Jura, grew from the Roman station of Salodurum, first mentioned in 219 and fortified in the fourth century. In the Early Middle Ages it passed from Lotharingia to Burgundy, and in 1033, when Burgundy joined the Holy Roman Empire, it became an imperial town.

The dukes of Zähringen acquired it in 1127, and after their line died out in 1218 it became a free imperial city. The guilds won a share of power during the fourteenth century, and an alliance with Bern in 1295 drew Solothurn into the Swiss Confederation.

It fought the Habsburgs at Sempach in 1386, enlarged its territory in the fifteenth century, and became a full member of the Confederation in 1481. From 1530 to 1792 the city housed the French embassy to the Swiss Confederation.
zh:
索洛图恩位于阿勒河畔、侏罗山脚下，前身是罗马驿站萨洛杜鲁姆，219年首见记载，4世纪筑有防御工事。中世纪早期它先后归属洛塔林吉亚和勃艮第王国；1033年勃艮第并入神圣罗马帝国后，它成为帝国城市。

1127年它转入策林根公爵之手，1218年策林格家族绝嗣，它成为帝国自由城市。14世纪行会争取到参政权，1295年与伯尔尼结盟把索洛图恩带入瑞士邦联。

1386年它在森帕赫战役中对哈布斯堡作战，15世纪扩大疆域，1481年成为邦联正式成员。1530年至1792年，法国驻瑞士邦联的大使馆设在该城。

en:
The Duchy of Schleswig, also called South Jutland, covered the neck of Jutland between the Eider and the Danish heartland. A Danish fief rather than an imperial state, it guarded the North Sea-Baltic crossing from Viking Hedeby and the Danevirke wall. From the mid-thirteenth century King Abel's line held it.

In 1326 Duke Valdemar V was placed on the Danish throne under a Holstein regency, while the Constitutio Valdemariana ruled that Schleswig and Denmark could never share a ruler. He abdicated in 1329 and ruled the duchy again as a Danish vassal. When the Abel line ended in 1375, the duchy passed in 1386 to the Schauenburg counts of Holstein-Rendsburg.

The 1460 assembly of Ribe joined Schleswig and Holstein under Christian I, never to be divided. Later partitions split the duchy between the Danish crown and the Gottorp dukes, whose share Denmark absorbed after the Great Northern War and the 1773 settlement.
zh:
石勒苏益格公国又称南日德兰，雄踞日德兰半岛咽喉，在艾德河与丹麦本土之间。它是丹麦封臣而非帝国邦国，自维京时的海泽比与丹麦边墙起，扼守北海与波罗的海通道。13世纪中叶起，阿贝尔王的后裔世袭该公国。

1326年瓦尔德马五世在荷尔斯泰因摄政下登丹麦王位，《瓦尔德马宪章》规定石勒苏益格与丹麦不得同归一人。他于1329年退位，重新以丹麦封臣身份统治公国。阿贝尔一系1375年断绝，公国1386年封给荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡的绍恩堡伯爵。

1460年里伯会议把石勒苏益格与荷尔斯泰因交给克里斯蒂安一世，约定永不分割。后来分封使公国由丹麦王室与戈托普公爵分治，后者领地在大北方战争后及1773年安排中由丹麦收并。

en:
The Prince-Archbishopric of Salzburg was a Holy Roman Empire church state, ruled from Roman Iuvavum, now Salzburg. Boniface founded the archdiocese in 739; from the late thirteenth century its archbishops won imperial immediacy. Eberhard II of Regensberg became an imperial prince in 1213, and in 1337 its ruler was Frederick III of Leibnitz, elected in 1315.

The Black Death came in 1347; Jews were accused of well-poisoning and bitterly persecuted. Archbishop Matthäus Lang brought in Saxon miners whose Protestant books helped spark peasant uprisings in the 1520s. Wolf Dietrich von Raitenau offered Protestants conversion or exile and rebuilt the cathedral, while Paris von Lodron kept the state neutral through the Thirty Years' War.

In 1731 Leopold Anton von Firmian expelled over twenty thousand Protestants, most settling in Prussia. Salzburg's last prince-archbishop, Hieronymus von Colloredo, Mozart's patron, lost temporal power at the 1803 secularization; the territory passed to Austria in 1805 and Bavaria in 1809, and the archdiocese returned without temporal rule in 1818.
zh:
萨尔茨堡采邑大主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，统治中心是古罗马城镇尤瓦武姆的旧址，即后来的萨尔茨堡。总教区由圣波尼法爵于739年建立；13世纪末起，大主教取得帝国直辖地位。1213年埃伯哈德二世受封帝国亲王；1337年在任的是1315年当选的弗里德里希三世·冯·莱布尼茨。

1347年黑死病传入，犹太人被指控投毒，遭到残酷迫害。大主教马特乌斯·朗引入萨克森矿工，他们的新教书籍助长了16世纪20年代的农民起义。沃尔夫·迪特里希·冯·赖特瑙要求新教徒要么改宗要么流亡，并重修主教座堂；帕里斯·冯·洛德龙则使萨尔茨堡在三十年战争中保持中立。

1731年利奥波德·安东·冯·菲尔米安驱逐两万多名新教徒，多数移居普鲁士。末任采邑大主教、莫扎特的庇护者科洛雷多在1803年世俗化中失去世俗权力；领地1805年归奥地利、1809年归巴伐利亚，总教区1818年恢复，已无世俗统治权。

en:
The Samma domains were the rising power of fourteenth-century Sindh, built by the Samma, a Muslim Sindhi tribe whose chiefs took the title jam, meaning sultan. They had long been one of the Indus valley's two great landholding groups, with the Soomras, and in 1333 Ibn Battuta found them revolting under Jam Tamachi. They overthrew the Soomras soon after 1335, and when Delhi's Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq died on campaign in Sindh in 1351, Jam Unar made the dynasty fully independent; Firuz Shah Tughluq's 1365 and 1367 expeditions reimposed tribute briefly.

Their early stronghold was the ancient Indus city of Sehwan, the old Sindomana stormed by Muhammad bin Qasim in 711, before the court settled at Samanagar, later Thatta.

The sultanate's golden age was under Jam Nizamuddin II (1461 to 1508), who made Thatta a textile market and endowed the Makli necropolis; his vizier Darya Khan defeated an Arghun invasion near Sibi. A succession war after Nizamuddin's death let Shah Beg Arghun overthrow the last jam at Fatehpur in 1519.
zh:
萨姆玛是14世纪信德兴起的强权，由穆斯林信德部落萨姆玛人建立，其首领采用意为苏丹的称号贾姆。他们与苏姆拉人长期并称印度河流域两大土地集团，1333年伊本·白图泰已见到他们在贾姆·塔马奇率领下公开反叛。1335年后不久他们推翻苏姆拉人，1351年德里苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克在征信德途中身亡，贾姆·乌纳尔遂使王朝完全独立；菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克1365和1367年的远征只短暂恢复贡赋。

他们早期的重镇是塞赫万，即711年被穆罕默德·本·卡西姆攻陷的古城辛多马纳，后来宫廷定于萨马纳加尔，也就是后来的特达。

贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世在位的1461至1508年是苏丹国的黄金时代，特达成为纺织品市场，马克利墓地也在此时营建；他的维齐尔达尔亚汗在锡比附近击败阿尔浑人的入侵。尼扎姆丁死后爆发继承战争，沙阿·贝格·阿尔浑乘机于1519年在法塔赫布尔推翻末代贾姆。

en:
Sambas was an old Dayak state on the north-west coast of Borneo, on the Sambas River near the South China Sea. Local tradition traces it to the seventh-century kingdom of Sanujuh of the Bakati Dayak, and it is named among the tributary lands in the Nagarakretagama of 1365, where it appears as part of the Tanjungnegara province conquered for Majapahit; in the fourteenth century its rulers were vassals of Tanjungpura.

On the shipping lane between China, Champa and Java, it drew Chinese traders, with a permanent Chinese settlement from 1407. In the early sixteenth century it passed under the influence of Demak and later paid tribute to Banjar.

The old Hindu dynasty ended in the seventeenth century, when the Brunei prince Tengah married into the local royal house and his son founded the Muslim Sultanate of Sambas in 1675.
zh:
三发是婆罗洲西北海岸、三发河沿岸的古老达雅克国家，濒临南海。当地传统把它追溯到7世纪巴卡提达雅克人的萨努朱王国；1365年的《爪哇史颂》把三发列为满者伯夷征服的丹戎尼加拉省诸朝贡地之一，14世纪时它的统治者是丹戎布拉的附庸。

三发地处中国、占城与爪哇之间的航线，吸引中国商人，1407年已有华人定居点。16世纪初它受淡目影响，后来向班贾尔纳贡。

旧的印度教王朝在17世纪终结：文莱王子登加入赘当地王室，他的儿子于1675年创立伊斯兰化的三发苏丹国。

en:
Samland is the Sambia Peninsula on the Baltic coast, home of the Sambians, a pagan Old Prussian tribe whose amber trade made their land the richest and most densely populated part of Prussia. The Teutonic Knights subdued them only in 1254 and 1255, in a campaign joined by King Ottokar II of Bohemia, after whom the new fortress of Königsberg was named.

The Diocese of Samland was created in 1243 by a papal legate as one of four Prussian bishoprics, with its cathedral chapter at Königsberg from 1285. It was tightly bound to the Teutonic Order, and its territory briefly passed to Poland in 1454 before returning to the Order as a Polish fief.

Its bishop introduced the Reformation in 1523; after secular Ducal Prussia was created in 1525 the Lutheran bishopric gradually faded, and the Catholic see was dissolved in 1821.
zh:
萨姆兰即波罗的海沿岸的桑比亚半岛，居民是信奉异教的古普鲁士部族萨姆比亚人；琥珀贸易使这里成为普鲁士最富庶、人口最稠密的地区。条顿骑士团1254至1255年才征服他们，波希米亚国王奥托卡二世参加了这场战役，新建的柯尼斯堡要塞即以他命名。

萨姆兰教区1243年由教皇特使设立，是普鲁士四个主教区之一，1285年起参议会设于柯尼斯堡。它与条顿骑士团关系紧密，其领地1454年一度并入波兰，后又作为波兰采邑重归骑士团。

1523年主教引入宗教改革；1525年世俗普鲁士公国建立后，路德宗主教区渐趋消亡，天主教教区1821年正式撤销。

en:
The Principality of Samtskhe, ruled from Akhaltsikhe, covered mountainous southern Georgia, including Javakheti and old Tao-Klarjeti. Its Jaqeli lords submitted to the Mongols in 1238, but Sargis I Jaqeli seceded from the Georgian crown in 1266 and placed himself directly under the Ilkhans, independent from 1268. In 1334 King George V brought Samtskhe back under royal authority and made the Jaqeli atabeg title hereditary, after which the state was called Samtskhe-Saatabago.

Timur's armies sacked Akhaltsikhe in campaigns of 1386 to 1403, and Kara Koyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu raiders struck Samtskhe through the fifteenth century. Qvarqvare II defeated King George VIII of Georgia near Lake Paravani in 1465 and broke away from Georgia for good.

As Ottomans and Safavids closed in, Imereti's King Bagrat III captured Qvarqvare III at Murjakheti in 1535 and annexed the principality, but an Ottoman victory at Sokhoista in 1545 reduced it to vassalage. The Jaqelis adopted Islam after 1578 and ruled as hereditary pashas of Akhaltsikhe until the Russian conquest of 1829.
zh:
萨姆茨赫公国以阿哈尔齐赫为统治中心，疆域覆盖格鲁吉亚南部山区，包括贾瓦赫季和古老的陶-克拉尔杰季。贾凯利家族1238年臣服蒙古，但萨尔吉斯一世1266年脱离格鲁吉亚王权、直接归附伊儿汗国，1268年起独立。1334年吉奥尔基五世重新确立宗主权，把阿塔贝格头衔定为贾凯利家族世袭，该国此后称萨姆茨赫-萨塔巴戈。

1386—1403年帖木儿大军接连来犯，阿哈尔齐赫遭洗劫；整个15世纪，黑羊王朝与白羊王朝又频频入侵。1465年克瓦克瓦雷二世在帕拉瓦尼湖附近击败格鲁吉亚国王吉奥尔基八世，彻底脱离格鲁吉亚。

奥斯曼与萨法维东西夹击之下，伊梅列季国王巴格拉特三世1535年在穆尔贾赫季生擒克瓦克瓦雷三世并吞并公国，但奥斯曼1545年在索霍伊斯塔获胜，萨姆茨赫沦为附庸。1578年后贾凯利家族改宗伊斯兰教，以阿哈尔齐赫世袭帕夏身份统治，直到1829年被俄国征服。

en:
Siming was a Zhuang tusi holding in the far south of Guangxi, centered on the Mingjiang valley at Ningming on the border with Annam. A Siming prefecture existed there under the Tang and Song as a jimi office, its hereditary chiefs drawn from the Huang clan of the Zuo River region.

Under the Yuan it became Siming Route, and in 1369 the Ming reorganized it as Siming Prefecture. Its frontier position cost it territory: in 1426 the Xiping and Lu subprefectures were absorbed by Annam, and Shangsi was detached to Nanning Prefecture in 1505.

In 1588 the prefecture's own Siming Subprefecture was transferred to neighboring Taiping, and the Upper Shixi stockade followed in 1610. Under the Qing the remaining lands were divided into the Si and Ningming subprefectures, with Siming Subprefecture restored to the prefecture in 1727.
zh:
思明是广西极南的壮族土司辖地，以明江流域宁明一带为中心，与安南接壤。唐宋时期这里设有羁縻性质的思明州，世袭土官出自左江黄氏。

元代升为思明路，1369年明朝改设思明府。地处边境使它不断失地：1426年西平州和禄州被安南吞并，1505年上思州改属南宁府。

1588年府辖思明州划归邻近的太平府，上石西州也于1610年改隶太平府。清代余下辖地分为思州和宁明州，思明州于1727年复归思明府。

en: Sápmi was the traditional homeland of the Sámi across northern Fennoscandia and the Kola Peninsula. Sámi communities lived by hunting, fishing and trade, while Sweden's province of Lapland was divided in 1809 when Finland passed to Russia.
zh: 萨普米是萨米人的传统家园，横跨芬诺斯堪的亚北部和科拉半岛。萨米人以狩猎、捕鱼和贸易为生；1809年芬兰转归俄国时，瑞典的拉普兰省也被分割。

en:
Sanmalan was a precolonial state on the Zamboanga peninsula of Mindanao, standing on the ancestral lands of the Subanon people, with its capital probably at the site of Zamboanga City.

Chinese annals call it Sanmalan and record that its ruler Rajah Chulan sent the envoy Ali Bakti to the imperial court in 1011 with aromatics, ivory, glassware, refined sugar and rose-water, goods that point to trade links reaching Western Asia.

By the time Zhao Rugua compiled the Zhufan Zhi in 1225, the same port, now named Shahuagong, had changed character: its people put to sea as raiders, bound their captives and sold them as slaves to Java. In the centuries before the Spanish arrival Sanmalan passed under the protection of the Sultanate of Sulu, and the Spaniards in turn took the semi-independent polity under their own protectorate.
zh:
三马兰是棉兰老岛三宝颜半岛上的前殖民政权，地处苏巴农人的祖居之地，都城可能就在三宝颜市一带。

中国史籍称其为三麻蘭，记载其王朱兰罗阇于1011年派使臣阿里·巴克蒂入朝，贡品中有香料、象牙、玻璃器、白糖和玫瑰水，这些货物显示其贸易网络远及西亚。

到1225年赵汝适编撰《诸蕃志》时，这个港口已改称沙华公，性质也为之一变：居民出海劫掠，把俘虏捆绑后卖到爪哇为奴。在西班牙人到来之前的几个世纪里，三马兰沦为苏禄苏丹国的保护国，西班牙人抵达后又把这个半独立政权置于自己的保护之下。

en:
Shilimian corresponds to the Ming Shilimian Guard, established near present Hulin on the lower Ussuri in the early fifteenth century as one of the guards of the Nurgan commission, alongside the Yima River Guard upstream. The country had been counted as Sushen land in antiquity and was long the home of Tungusic fishing and hunting peoples, ancestors of the Hezhen. Its Hūrga chiefs held the guard as a hereditary tributary post, trading furs to the Ming while ruling their own river villages.

With Nurhaci's campaigns against the Wild Jurchens from 1596 to 1625, Shilimian was absorbed into the rising Later Jin state, and its people were in time registered in the Manchu banners.
zh:
失里绵对应明代的失里绵卫。15世纪初，明朝在今虎林一带的乌苏里江下游设该卫，隶属奴儿干都司，与上游的亦麻河卫等共同扼守乌苏里江一线。其地上古属肃慎之地，长期是通古斯系渔猎民族的家园，即赫哲人的先民所居。虎尔哈酋长以卫职世袭朝贡，向明朝贸易毛皮，同时自治其河畔村寨。

1596—1625年努尔哈赤征讨野人女真，失里绵被崛起的后金吞并，部众后来被编入满洲八旗。

en:
The Principality of Smolensk commanded the upper Dnieper and trade roads linking Novgorod and Polotsk with Kiev, in the old lands of the Krivichs. It became an independent Rurikid principality in 1125 under Rostislav Mstislavich, whose descendants took the grand prince title, ruling Smolensk with Bryansk and Vyazma as appanages, gaining their own bishop in 1136.

The Mongol age brought Lithuanian raids under Mindaugas and dependence on Vladimir's grand princes, and from about 1339 Smolensk was pulled between Lithuania, Moscow and the Golden Horde: Algirdas captured the city in 1356 and again in 1359, yet its army fought beside Moscow at Kulikovo in 1380. After Prince Sviatoslav fell to the Lithuanians at the Vikhra River in 1386, Vytautas annexed Smolensk in 1404.

Reorganized as the Smolensk Voivodeship in 1508, Smolensk fell to Moscow's Vasili III in 1514, was seized by the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1611, and ceded to Russia by the 1667 Treaty of Andrusovo.
zh:
斯摩棱斯克公国扼守第聂伯河上游，控制连接诺夫哥罗德、波洛茨克与基辅的商路，地处古代克里维奇人的故土。1125年它在罗斯季斯拉夫·姆斯季斯拉维奇治下成为独立的留里克公国，其后代自称大公，以斯摩棱斯克为本城，领有布良斯克、维亚济马等封邑，并于1136年设立自己的主教。

蒙古时代，明道加斯率领立陶宛人屡次来犯，公国又沦为弗拉基米尔大公们的附庸；约1339年起，斯摩棱斯克被立陶宛、莫斯科和金帐汗国三方拉扯：阿尔吉尔达斯于1356年、1359年两度攻占该城，但斯摩棱斯克军队仍在1380年与莫斯科并肩参加库里科沃之战。1386年王公斯维亚托斯拉夫在维赫拉河之战中死于立陶宛人之手，1404年维陶塔斯吞并斯摩棱斯克。

1508年斯摩棱斯克被改组为斯摩棱斯克省，1514年城池落入莫斯科的瓦西里三世之手，1611年又被波兰立陶宛联邦夺取，最终依1667年的《安德鲁索沃条约》割让给俄罗斯。

en:
Simsir, also written Simsim in the Persian Zafarnama, was a medieval kingdom of the Nakh peoples, ancestors of the Chechens and Ingush, in mountain gorges reaching the edge of the Kumyk plain. Founded around the middle of the twelfth century, it had rulers who became tributaries of the Golden Horde in the fourteenth century while long remaining Christian.

Its best-known prince Gayur-khan served the khan as envoy to the Rus cities; when the Horde collapsed into civil war he defeated Mamai in 1362 and made Simsir independent. He then backed Tokhtamysh, whose Nakh vanguard fought Timur at the Battle of the Terek in 1395.

Timur's revenge campaign that year destroyed Simsir, drove its people into the mountains and ended the kingdom. The survivors gave up princely rule for the free clan councils of the teips, and their mountain country later became Chechnya.
zh:
西姆西尔在波斯《武功记》中又写作西姆西姆，是纳赫人的中世纪王国，纳赫人即车臣人和印古什人的先民，疆域据有高山峡谷，延伸到库梅克平原边缘。它约在12世纪中叶形成，14世纪其君主向金帐汗国称臣纳贡，但长期仍信奉基督教。

最著名的王公加尤尔汗曾作为金帐使者出使罗斯诸城；金帐陷入内战后，他于1362年击败马迈，使西姆西尔独立。他随后支持脱脱迷失，纳赫士兵作为前锋参加了1395年的捷列克河之战。

同年帖木儿兴兵报复，攻灭西姆西尔，把居民逼入深山，王国终结。幸存者放弃王公统治，改行自由的氏族议事会泰普制度，山国后来便是车臣。

en:
The Sambuvarayar were Tamil chieftains of the Vanniyar community who rose under the imperial Cholas. Edirili Chola Sambhuvaraya served the Chola emperors in the late twelfth century, governing northern Tondai Nadu from the hill capital of Padaividu. Their title Nalayiravan recalled the four thousand soldiers kept for their overlords.

As Chola, Pandya and Hoysala power crumbled in the early fourteenth century, the family turned its fief into an independent kingdom covering Kanchipuram, Vellore and Gingee. Venrumankonda dated records in his own regnal year from 1322, and Rajanarayana, the ruler of 1337, did the same.

He first allied with Harihara I of Vijayanagara against the Madurai Sultanate, but Vijayanagara's southward expansion left no room for a vassal kingdom, and he was later killed by Bukka Raya I, after which the Sambuvarayar lands were absorbed into the Vijayanagara Empire.
zh:
三补缚罗耶尔是瓦尼雅尔社群的泰米尔酋长，在朱罗帝国治下兴起。12世纪末伊迪里利·朱罗·三补缚罗耶臣事朱罗皇帝，以山城波多毗都为中心管辖通代纳德北半部。他们的头衔那莱伊罗梵意为四千人，指其为宗主供养的四千士卒。

14世纪初朱罗、潘地亚和曷萨拉势力相继崩塌，这个家族把封地变成独立王国，疆域涵盖建志补罗、韦洛尔和京吉一带：温鲁曼孔达自1322年起以自己的年号发布文书，1337年在位的罗阇那罗延·三补缚罗耶也同样行事。

他起初与毗奢耶那伽罗的诃利诃罗一世结盟对抗马杜赖苏丹国，但毗奢耶那伽罗的南扩不容附庸王国并存，他后来被布卡·罗耶一世杀死，土地随之并入毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。

en:
The Shimazu were a warrior family based in Satsuma in southern Kyushu. Their founder Tadahisa became governor of Satsuma and went there in 1196, extending his power into Hyuga and Osumi.

In 1578 Shimazu Yoshihiro and his brothers defeated the Otomo at Mimigawa, but the family submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587. After the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600 the Shimazu retained Satsuma, and in 1609 Tadatsune invaded the Ryukyu Kingdom, placing it under Shimazu control.
zh:
岛津氏是以九州南部萨摩为根据地的武家。其始祖忠久出任萨摩守护，1196年前往当地，并将势力扩展到日向和大隅。

1578年岛津义弘与兄弟在耳川击败大友氏，但岛津家于1587年归降丰臣秀吉。1600年关原之战后，岛津氏保住了萨摩；1609年岛津忠恒入侵琉球王国，使其受岛津氏控制。

en: Sancaha was a Haixi Jurchen polity seated at Boduna, where the Nen river meets the Songhua on the Songnen plain. Early Ming records organized the same ground as the Sanchahe Guard, named for the river junction; under the Qing a relay station was set up at Boduna and a brick city, called Xincheng, was built to its south.
zh: 三察哈是以伯都讷为中心的海西女真政权，地当松嫩平原上嫩江与松花江交汇处。明初同一地带曾设三岔河卫，以河口的三岔河得名；清代在此设伯都讷站，又在其南另建砖城，称新城。

en:
The lower Indus kingdom that kept the name Sindh in 1337 was the last domain of the Soomra dynasty, a Muslim house that rose in the eleventh century amid the Habbarid emirate's collapse. The Soomras held lower Sindh, some rulers attached to Isma'ili Shia Islam; Arab writers called them Qarmatians, and letters between them and the Fatimid caliph survive.

The ruler Shimuddin Chamisar submitted to Delhi's Sultan Iltutmish; a Soomra branch founded Umarkot fort, which the clan recovered from Sodha Rajputs in 1330. Their rule ended soon after 1335, when the Samma overthrew them; the last Soomra fled to Muhammad bin Tughluq, whose restoration attempt ended with the sultan's death in Sindh in 1351.

The lands then passed through Samma, Arghun and Tarkhan hands; the fugitive Mughal Humayun sheltered at Umarkot in 1542, where Akbar was born, and Mughal armies annexed lower Sindh between 1591 and 1593. Mughal rule gave way to the Kalhoras in 1701 and then to the Talpurs in 1783.
zh:
1337年仍以信德为名的印度河下游王国，是11世纪乘哈巴里埃米尔国崩溃而兴起的本地穆斯林王朝苏姆拉的最后领地。苏姆拉人据有下信德，部分统治者信奉伊斯玛仪派，阿拉伯作者称他们为卡尔马特派，他们与法蒂玛哈里发之间仍有信函存世。

国王希姆丁·查米萨尔曾向德里苏丹伊勒杜迷失称臣；苏姆拉的一个分支修建沙漠要塞欧迈尔果德，苏姆拉人于1330年从索达拉杰普特人手中夺回该城。1335年后不久萨姆玛部落推翻了他们，末代苏姆拉君主投奔穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克，后者助其复位的远征以1351年苏丹本人死于信德告终。

此后这片土地先后落入萨姆玛、阿尔浑和塔尔汗之手；1542年流亡的莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍在欧迈尔果德得到庇护，阿克巴即出生于此，1591至1593年莫卧儿军队兼并下信德。1701年莫卧儿统治被卡尔霍拉王朝取代，1783年又转入塔尔普尔王朝之手。

en:
Singapura was a Malay Hindu-Buddhist kingdom on Temasek, at the southern tip of the Malay Peninsula. According to the Malay Annals, the Palembang prince Sang Nila Utama landed in 1299 and renamed it Singapura, Sanskrit for lion city, building his fortified capital on a hill above the Singapore River.

Its harbour commanded the Strait of Malacca trade route, and it soon traded with India, Yuan China and the Malay Archipelago. In the 1330s the Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan described a walled town and a pirates' settlement. A Siamese fleet of seventy junks besieged Singapura but withdrew when Chinese ships appeared.

From 1350 Majapahit demanded submission, and in 1398 a Javanese fleet sacked the fort after a courtier betrayed the gates. The last ruler, Parameswara, fled to the peninsula and founded the Malacca Sultanate around 1400; Temasek then sank into obscurity.
zh:
新加坡是马来半岛南端淡马锡岛的印度教—佛教马来人王国。据《马来纪年》记载，巨港王子桑·尼拉·乌他玛于1299年登岛，将岛名改为新加坡——梵语意为狮子城——并在新加坡河旁的山丘上筑起坚固国都。

它的港口扼守马六甲海峡商路，不久便与印度、中国元朝和马来群岛通商。14世纪30年代，中国旅人汪大渊记述岛上有筑城而居的城镇和海盗盘踞的据点。暹罗一支七十艘帆船的舰队来攻，因中国船只抵达而撤围。

1350年起满者伯夷要求称臣，1398年爪哇舰队在叛臣开门献城后攻陷堡垒。末代君主拜里米苏拉逃到半岛，约于1400年建立马六甲苏丹国，淡马锡此后湮没无闻。

en:
Songpan, the old Songzhou, is a high plateau garrison country at the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau in northwestern Sichuan. The Tang founded Songzhou there in 618 as their frontier gate facing the Tibetan Empire, whose king Songtsen Gampo attacked through it before receiving Princess Wencheng in 641.

Under the Song, three Pan prefectures were set up after Tibetan tribes submitted in 1104, and the Yuan brought the area into the Songpan-Weimao tribal pacification office after 1283. In 1379 the Ming built the Songzhou and Panzhou guards and merged them into the Songpan Guard, whose walled seat commanded the tea-for-horse routes linking Sichuan with Gansu, Qinghai and Tibet.

Restive Tibetan tribes were largely left under friendly lamas and local chiefs. Qing garrison command followed. In 1731 Songpan became a subprefecture, raised to an independent subprefecture in 1760.
zh:
松潘即古松州，是四川西北、青藏高原东缘的高原军镇。618年唐朝置松州，作为面对吐蕃王国的边关，吐蕃赞普松赞干布曾由此叩关，随后于641年迎娶文成公主。

宋代在1104年因吐蕃部落归附而置上、中、下三潘州；元代1283年以后将其纳入松潘叠宕威茂等处军民安抚司管辖。1379年明朝筑松州卫、潘州卫，后合并为松潘卫，卫城扼守四川与甘肃、青海、西藏之间的茶马商道。

桀骜的藏族部落大多交给亲明的喇嘛和当地头人治理。清代设松潘镇总兵驻守。1731年改置松潘厅，1760年升为松潘直隶厅。

en:
Sentispac was a native kingdom of the Pacific coastal plain of Nayarit in western Mexico, whose jurisdiction reached the hill settlement of Ixcatán while the coastal town of Ayutuxpan paid it tribute; the ceremonial centre of Coamiles, with its stone-faced platforms and more than 150 carved glyphs, served the region's ritual life.

Its Huichol and Cora neighbours traded and warred across the same river valleys, and the mountain kingdom of Xécora remained a threat on its inland flank.

Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's army crossed the territory in 1530 and subdued it in 1531, folding it into the province of Nueva Galicia. Long after the conquest the frontier stayed restless: in the early eighteenth century the Cora leader Tonati raided Sentispac itself, before his stronghold in the Sierra del Nayar fell in 1722.
zh:
森蒂斯帕克是墨西哥西部纳亚里特太平洋沿海平原的原住民王国，势力及于山区聚落伊克斯卡坦，沿海城镇阿尤图什潘则向它纳贡；科阿米莱斯仪式中心拥有石面台基和150多处石刻，服务于这一地区的宗教生活。

它与维乔尔人、科拉人邻邦在相同的河谷间贸易交战，山区的谢科拉王国始终是其内陆方向的威胁。

1530年，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的军队穿过其领土，1531年将它征服，并入新加利西亚省。征服之后边地仍不平静：18世纪初，科拉人首领托纳蒂一度劫掠森蒂斯帕克，他在纳亚尔山区的据点最终于1722年陷落。

en:
Shewa was a Muslim sultanate in the Ethiopian region, ruled by the Makhzumi dynasty and connected to the trade routes of Zeila. Its chronicle records the conversion of the Gbbh people to Islam in 1108.

In 1285 a ruler of Ifat deposed the kings of Shewa, bringing its districts under the Walashma dynasty. By the mid-14th century Islam had spread among communities north of the Awash, including the Argobba and Werji.
zh:
绍阿是埃塞俄比亚地区的穆斯林苏丹国，由马赫祖米王朝统治，与泽拉的商路相连。绍阿编年史记载，格巴人于1108年改信伊斯兰教。

1285年伊法特统治者废黜绍阿诸王，使其各地区归于瓦拉什马王朝。到14世纪中叶，伊斯兰教已在阿瓦什河以北的阿尔戈巴人和韦尔吉人等群体中传播。

en:
The Sobaipuri were an O'odham people of southern Arizona and northern Sonora, with farming villages along the Santa Cruz and San Pedro rivers. Archaeological sites show their presence on both rivers in the fourteenth century.

In 1691 village leaders invited the Jesuit Eusebio Kino to Tumacácori, where a mission was established. The Sobaipuri later allied with Europeans and fought some of their former indigenous neighbors.
zh:
索拜普里人是亚利桑那南部和索诺拉北部的奥德汉族群，在圣克鲁斯河与圣佩德罗河沿岸拥有农业村落。考古遗址表明，他们在14世纪已居住于这两条河流沿岸。

1691年，村落首领邀请耶稣会士尤西比奥·基诺来到图马卡科里，当地随后建立了传教区。索拜普里人后来与欧洲人结盟，与一些过去的原住民邻居交战。

en:
The Sohri were the Kurdish tribal polity of the Sohran, later known as the Soran, whose mountain stronghold was Rawanduz above the Erbil plain. Rawanduz, whose name means fortress of the Rawand, was founded in the tenth century by the Rawadid family, leaders of the Hadhbani Kurds.

According to the Sharafnama, the Sohran took their name from the red rocks of their homeland, the Kurdish sohr rendering the Persian for red, and the emirate probably took shape between the 1330s and the 1430s. The Sohran expanded after the battle of Chaldiran in 1514, seizing the country between Erbil and Kirkuk.

In 1535 the Ottoman sultan Suleiman ordered the killing of their Erbil ruler Izz al-Din Shir and gave the city to a Yazidi chief. The emirate was revived from Rawanduz in 1816. It fell to the Ottomans in 1836.
zh:
索赫里是索赫兰（后称索兰）库尔德人的部落政权，山寨设在埃尔比勒平原上方的拉万杜兹。拉万杜兹意为拉万人的堡垒，10世纪由哈兹班尼库尔德人的望族拉瓦德家族建城。

据《谢拉夫纳玛》记载，索赫兰得名于家乡的红色岩石，库尔德语把波斯语的“红”读作 sohr；学者估计这个酋长国大约形成于1330年代至1430年代之间。1514年查尔迪兰战役后，索赫兰向外扩张，夺取了埃尔比勒与基尔库克之间的土地。

1535年奥斯曼苏丹苏莱曼下令处死其驻埃尔比勒的统治者伊兹丁·希尔，把该城交给一位雅兹迪首领。1816年，酋长国以拉万杜兹为中心再度兴起。1836年，它被奥斯曼人攻灭。

en: Somalia refers to the lands of the Somali people in the Horn of Africa. Among their states was the Ajuran Sultanate, which rose to dominance in the Banaadir interior in the late fourteenth century.
zh: 索马里指非洲之角索马里人居住的土地。当地的政权包括阿朱兰苏丹国，它在14世纪末成为巴纳迪尔内陆的主导力量。

en:
The Mazipskoiak, or Missisquoi, were a Western Abenaki people of Lake Champlain's northern and eastern shores, in present-day Quebec and Vermont. By the seventeenth century, Abenaki from around the lake had gathered at the village of Missisquoi in northern Vermont.

During the American Revolutionary War, the Missisquoi withdrew from contested areas and later joined other Abenaki at Saint Francis, or Odanak. In 1805 the British Crown granted land near Durham in Quebec to Abenaki refugees from the war.
zh:
马齐普斯科亚克又称密西斯奎人，是西阿贝纳基人的一支，生活在尚普兰湖北岸和东岸，即今魁北克与佛蒙特一带。到17世纪，湖区各地的阿贝纳基人已聚集在佛蒙特北部的密西斯奎村。

美国独立战争期间，密西斯奎人撤离了冲突地区，后来在圣弗朗索瓦，即奥达纳克，与其他阿贝纳基人汇合。1805年，英国王室将魁北克达勒姆附近的土地授予这场战争中的阿贝纳基难民。

en:
The Sōma were a warrior family who held the northern Hamadōri coast of Mutsu. Sōma Morotsune received lands there after joining Minamoto no Yoritomo's campaign against the northern Fujiwara in 1189; his descendants supported the Northern Court in the fourteenth century.

Pressed by Date Masamune, Sōma Yoshitane submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi. After the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600 the family briefly lost its lands, but Yoshitane's son Toshitane became lord of Sōma Nakamura in 1602; the clan rebuilt Nakamura Castle in 1611.
zh:
相马氏是占据陆奥滨通北部海岸的武家。相马师常参加源赖朝于1189年讨伐奥州藤原氏的战役后，在当地获得领地；其后代在14世纪支持北朝。

相马义胤受到伊达政宗的逼迫，遂归顺丰臣秀吉。1600年关原之战后，相马家一度失去领地，但义胤之子利胤于1602年成为相马中村藩主；家族于1611年重建中村城。

en:
The Songhai began as fishing, hunting and farming peoples along the great bend of the Niger, joined before the tenth century by horse-riding Songhai speakers; their chiefs made Gao a trading kingdom in gold, salt and ivory, ruled first by the Za kings of the Tarikh al-Sudan.

Around 1300 Mali captured Gao, and for over a century the Songhai kings ruled as Malian vassals; Ibn Battuta passed through a rich city in 1353. After Mansa Suleyman's death in 1360 tore Mali apart, Gao slipped away, independent by the 1390s.

Sonni Ali (from 1464) built the Songhai empire, taking Timbuktu in 1468 and starving Djenné into surrender after a long siege; his general Askia Muhammad seized the throne in 1493. Askia the Great centralized government, promoted learning at Timbuktu's Sankore Mosque and made a gold-laden Mecca pilgrimage, before his sons deposed him in 1528. Askia Daoud's revival ended at his death in 1583, and in 1591 a firearm-armed Moroccan army destroyed the Songhai host at Tondibi and swept the empire away.
zh:
桑海人最初是尼日尔河大河湾一带渔猎农耕族群的结合体，10世纪前与骑马的桑海语部族融合；其首领把加奥建成经营黄金、食盐和象牙的贸易王国，最早的统治者是《塔里克·苏丹》记载的扎王朝诸王。

约1300年马里攻陷加奥，此后一个多世纪桑海诸王作为马里附庸统治，伊本·白图泰1353年路过时见到一座富庶的城市。1360年曼萨·苏莱曼去世后马里陷入内乱，加奥逐渐脱离，到14世纪90年代完全独立。

1464年即位的桑尼·阿里建立桑海帝国，1468年夺取廷巴克图，又经长期围困迫使杰内投降；将领阿斯基亚·穆罕默德1493年篡位，即阿斯基亚大帝。他加强中央集权，在廷巴克图桑科雷清真寺扶持学术，带满载黄金的队伍赴麦加朝觐，1528年被儿子们废黜。阿斯基亚·达乌德的中兴随他1583年去世而终结，1591年装备火器的摩洛哥军队在通迪比击溃桑海大军，帝国覆灭。

en: The Suhtai were a Plains people closely related to the Tsitsistas, with whom they formed the Cheyenne. Their speech and customs differed slightly from those of the Tsitsistas, and they carried the Sacred Buffalo Hat, a Cheyenne sacred bundle. They travelled with the Tsitsistas and merged with them after 1832; Cheyenne bands sent chiefs to the Council of Forty-four.
zh: 苏泰奥是大平原上的一个族群，与关系密切的齐齐斯塔斯人共同构成夏安人。他们的语言和习俗与齐齐斯塔斯人略有不同，并携带夏安人的神圣物品之一——神圣野牛帽。他们与齐齐斯塔斯人同行，1832年后与之合并；夏安各部族的首领在四十四人议事会中拥有席位。

en:
Lusatia, later called Lower Lusatia, lay along the Spree, settled by the West Slavic Lusici. Saxon margrave Gero subdued them in the 960s, and after Polish rule under Bolesław I it was reconquered in 1031 and made the March of Lusatia. In 1136 it passed to the Wettin house, which held it until the Ascanians bought it in 1303.

Ascanian extinction split the march: southern towns went to the Piast Duchy of Jawor in 1319, the north to the Wittelsbachs in 1324. In 1337 Margrave Louis V the Brandenburger, eldest son of Emperor Louis IV, held it as a Brandenburg fief from Cottbus.

In 1367 Elector Otto V sold his rights to Emperor Charles IV, who joined all of Lower Lusatia to the Bohemian Crown. As a Bohemian crown land it turned Protestant and passed to Saxony by the 1635 Peace of Prague. The 1815 Congress of Vienna assigned it to Prussia.
zh:
卢萨蒂亚后称下卢萨蒂亚，地处施普雷河畔，居民为西斯拉夫卢西奇人。10世纪60年代萨克森藩侯格罗征服卢西奇人；后经波兰的波列斯瓦夫一世统治，1031年被夺回，置为卢萨蒂亚边疆区。1136年转入韦廷家族之手，1303年被阿斯坎尼家族买下。

阿斯坎尼家族绝嗣后边疆区分裂：1319年南部城镇归皮亚斯特家族的亚沃尔公国，1324年北部归维特尔斯巴赫家族。1337年，皇帝路易四世的长子、藩侯路易五世（绰号“勃兰登堡人”）在科特布斯领有这块勃兰登堡封邑。

1367年选侯奥托五世把权利卖给皇帝查理四世，后者将整个下卢萨蒂亚并入波希米亚王冠领地。此后它改宗新教，1635年依《布拉格和约》转归萨克森。1815年维也纳会议将它划归普鲁士。

en: Sus was a region of southern Morocco whose tribes chose Muhammad al-Qa'im as their leader in 1510 against the Portuguese on the coast. His Saadi family went on to take Marrakesh and establish rule over most of Morocco.
zh: 苏斯是摩洛哥南部的一个地区，当地部族于1510年推举穆罕默德·卡伊姆为首领，抵抗占据海岸的葡萄牙人。他所属的萨阿德家族后来夺取马拉喀什，并统治了摩洛哥大部分地区。

en:
The Sotho lived in a number of chiefdoms on the southern African plateau. By the seventeenth century their clans formed loosely connected kingdoms in what is now South Africa's Free State and neighbouring regions.

Amid wars and migrations in the 1820s, Moshoeshoe I gathered Sotho clans and refugees under his protection. He established a stronghold at Butha-Buthe in 1822 and later moved to Thaba Bosiu, laying the foundations of the kingdom that became Lesotho.
zh:
索托人在南部非洲高原上建立了多个酋长国。到17世纪，他们的氏族已在今南非自由邦及邻近地区形成联系松散的诸王国。

在19世纪20年代的战争与迁徙中，莫舒舒一世将索托氏族和逃难者聚集在自己的保护之下。他于1822年在布塔布泰建立据点，后来迁至塔巴博休，为日后的莱索托王国奠定基础。

en:
The Sō were lords of Tsushima Island, where they rose as deputies of the Shōni clan in the Kamakura period. Sō Sukekuni died fighting the Mongol invasion in 1274, and Sō Sumishige became governor of Tsushima in 1395.

Toyotomi Hideyoshi confirmed the family's possession of Tsushima in 1587. Sō Yoshitoshi led troops against Busan in the invasion of Korea in 1592; after the war, the Tokugawa shogunate entrusted the family with negotiations and trade with Joseon. The Sō continued to rule the Tsushima-Fuchū domain throughout the Edo period.
zh:
宗氏是对马岛的领主，在镰仓时代作为少贰氏的代理人崛起。1274年宗助国抵抗蒙古军入侵时战死，1395年宗澄茂成为对马守护。

1587年，丰臣秀吉确认宗氏对对马的领有。宗义智于1592年侵朝战争中率军进攻釜山；战后德川幕府委托宗氏与朝鲜交涉并进行贸易。整个江户时代，宗氏继续统治对马府中藩。

en:
Soyo was a province of the Kingdom of Kongo at the mouth of the Congo River. Its lord was baptized in 1491, and its port of Mpinda became a centre of the trade in enslaved people, ivory and copper.

Soyo became independent in the seventeenth century and intervened in Kongo's civil war, placing Afonso II on the throne in 1666. In 1670 its forces, supported by Ngoyo and supplied by the Dutch, defeated a Portuguese invasion at Kitombo.
zh:
索约是刚果王国在刚果河口的一个省。当地领主于1491年受洗，其港口姆平达成为奴隶、象牙和铜的贸易中心。

索约于17世纪独立，并介入刚果内战，于1666年扶植阿方索二世登上王位。1670年，索约军队在恩戈约的支援和荷兰人的军需供应下，于基通博击败了入侵的葡萄牙军队。

en:
Spain grew from the union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon through the marriage of Isabella I and Ferdinand II in 1469. Their conquest of Granada in 1492 ended the last Muslim rule in Iberia; that year Columbus also sailed across the Atlantic under their patronage.

Under the Habsburgs from 1516, the Spanish monarchy ruled territories in Europe and a vast overseas empire. The death of Charles II in 1700 led to the War of the Spanish Succession and the accession of the Bourbon Philip V. Following the Napoleonic invasion, wars of independence in Spanish America cost Spain most of its mainland American possessions by the 1820s.
zh:
西班牙源于卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝尔一世与阿拉贡国王斐迪南二世1469年的婚姻所缔结的两国王冠联盟。1492年，他们征服格拉纳达，结束了伊比利亚最后的穆斯林统治；同年，哥伦布在他们资助下横渡大西洋。

自1516年起，哈布斯堡王朝的西班牙君主统治着欧洲领地和广阔的海外帝国。1700年卡洛斯二世去世引发西班牙王位继承战争，波旁王朝的腓力五世登上王位。拿破仑入侵之后，西属美洲的独立战争使西班牙到19世纪20年代失去了美洲大陆上的大部分属地。

en:
Spremberg was a small lordship built around a walled town and castle on a Spree island in Lower Lusatia; its Sorbian name Grodk means little castle. The town and castle first appear in a 1301 charter, when Landgrave Dietrich the Younger of Thuringia sold them to Magdeburg's archbishop. The lordship's first recorded holders were a junior Wettin line from Landsberg, who took their name from the seat; in 1337 the county was still Wettin.

In 1349 the lordship passed to the counts of Schwarzburg-Wachsenburg, from whom Emperor Charles IV bought the castle in 1360. Charles IV's son John of Görlitz pledged Spremberg to Otto of Kittlitz in 1395, and a Lusatian governor bought the lordship in 1497.

After further sales to the Kittlitz and Redern families, it fell to Saxon dukes in 1680 and to Electoral Saxony in 1738, before passing to Prussia with Lower Lusatia in 1815.
zh:
施普伦贝格是下卢萨蒂亚的一处小领地，核心是施普雷河岛上的设防城镇与城堡；它的索布语名格罗德基意为小城堡。二者首见于1301年契约：图林根领地伯爵“年轻者”迪特里希将它们卖给马格德堡大主教。最早有载的持有者是韦廷家族兰茨贝格支系，以治所为姓；1337年仍属韦廷家族。

1349年领地转给施瓦茨堡-瓦克森堡伯爵，1360年皇帝查理四世买下其城堡。查理四世之子格尔利茨的约翰1395年将施普伦贝格抵押给奥托·冯·基特利茨，1497年一位下卢萨蒂亚长官购得这块领地。

此后几经转卖，先后属基特利茨、雷德尔恩家族，1680年落入萨克森公爵之手，1738年归萨克森选侯国，1815年随下卢萨蒂亚并入普鲁士。

en:
Shiping is a basin town on the southern Yunnan road leading toward Lin'an. The place first appears in 752 as the Stone Flat settlement under Nanzhao's Tonghai Commandery, which the Dali kingdom reorganised as Xiushan Commandery.

In 1270 the Mongols made it Shiping Department, attached at first to the Abo Ten-Thousand-Household and later to Lin'an Route. When Ming armies took Yunnan in 1382 the department was renamed and attached to Lin'an Prefecture, soon acquiring its present written name Shiping, under which the Qing kept it.

In 1810 five neighbouring native chieftaincies, among them Wazha and Luokong, were placed under the department's jurisdiction. Long known as a town of scholars, Shiping produced more than a hundred metropolitan graduates during the Ming and Qing.
zh:
石屏是滇南通往临安道路上的坝子城邑。752年其地始称石坪邑，隶属于南诏通海郡，到大理国时又改属秀山郡。

1270年元朝置石坪州，先隶秀山郡阿僰万户，后改属临安路。1382年明军攻取云南，该州先被改名为石平州，不久又定名石屏州，划归临安府管辖，清代也沿用这一建制。

1810年，包括瓦渣、落恐在内的五个相邻土司的辖区划归石屏州管辖。石屏历来以文教兴盛闻名，明清两代一共出了上百名进士，素有文献名邦之称。

en:
Spoleto was the seat of a Lombard duchy in central Italy, founded under Faroald I during the conquests of the late sixth century. The duchy passed under Frankish overlordship in 774 and was gradually absorbed by the Papal States around the beginning of the thirteenth century.

In 1364 Cardinal Albornoz ended Perugian control over Spoleto and ordered a fortress built above the city. Lucrezia Borgia governed from the fortress in 1499. After French rule under Napoleon, Spoleto returned to the Papal States in 1814.
zh:
斯波莱托是意大利中部一个伦巴第公国的治所，公国由法罗阿尔德一世在6世纪末的征服中建立。774年公国转受法兰克人宗主统治，13世纪初前后逐渐被教宗国吞并。

1364年，枢机阿尔博诺斯结束了佩鲁贾对斯波莱托的控制，并下令在城上修筑堡垒。1499年卢克雷齐娅·博尔贾从堡垒治理此地。拿破仑时期的法国统治结束后，斯波莱托于1814年重归教宗国。

en:
Suphanburi, older Suphannabhum, was a Thai mueang on the Tha Chin river, west of the Chao Phraya plain. Its moated town grew from Dvaravati settlements; tradition makes it heir to abandoned U Thong port, whose merchants moved upriver in the eleventh century. By the thirteenth century it was a Sukhothai vassal whose kilns exported jars across the gulf.

In the fourteenth century it was one of four rival towns; its lord Khun Luang Pha Ngua helped U Thong found Ayutthaya in 1351. Pha Ngua seized the throne in 1370 as King Borommarachathirat I and founded the Suphannaphum dynasty; after 1388 his line briefly lost and regained the crown.

The principality merged into Ayutthaya in 1438. It later faced Burmese invasions, most famously the 1593 elephant duel at Nong Sarai, where Naresuan slew the Burmese crown prince, restoring Siamese independence.
zh:
素攀武里古称素攀那蓬，是他金河畔的泰人城邦，位于昭披耶河平原以西。它的环城城邑由陀罗钵地时期的聚落发展而来；按传统，它继承了废弃商港乌通，乌通商人在11世纪溯河迁居于此。到13世纪，它成为素可泰的属邦，窑场烧制的陶罐远销暹罗湾各地。

14世纪它是四大角逐城邦之一，领主坤銮帕娘与乌通联手，于1351年共建阿瑜陀耶王国。1370年帕娘夺取阿瑜陀耶王位，称波隆摩罗阇一世，开创素攀那蓬王朝；1388年后王统一度失而复得。

旧邦于1438年并入阿瑜陀耶。此后它屡遭缅甸入侵，最著名的一役是1593年农沙拉莱象战：纳黎萱在阵中斩杀缅甸王储，恢复了暹罗的独立。

en:
The County of Sponheim was an immediate Holy Roman Empire territory between the Rhine, Moselle and Nahe around the Hunsrück, where the Rhenish line of the House of Sponheim is documented from the eleventh century. Around 1225, after Count Gottfried III died on the Fifth Crusade, his sons split it into the Upper County at Starkenburg and the Lower County at Kreuznach.

The two lines feuded with Mainz and Trier and dotted their hills with some twenty-one castles. In 1337 Kreuznach was held by Count John II of the Sponheim-Kreuznach line. The Kreuznach line died out in 1417 and the Starkenburg line in 1437, after which female-line heirs from Baden and the Palatinate ruled as a condominium.

The Reformation reached Sponheim in 1557, and the Thirty Years' War brought heavy fighting; after the Napoleonic Wars most of the territory passed to Prussia, while the Birkenfeld lands went to Oldenburg.
zh:
施蓬海姆伯国是神圣罗马帝国的帝国直辖领地，地处莱茵河、摩泽尔河与纳厄河之间的洪斯吕克山区，施蓬海姆家族的莱茵支11世纪已见记载。约1225年，伯爵戈特弗里德三世死于第五次十字军东征后，儿子们把领地分为上伯国（治施塔肯堡）和下伯国（治克罗伊茨纳赫）。

两支长期与美因茨、特里尔选侯国结仇交战，在山区修筑约二十一座城堡。1337年下伯国由施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫支的伯爵约翰二世统治。克罗伊茨纳赫支1417年绝嗣，施塔肯堡支1437年男嗣断绝，此后巴登和普法尔茨的女系继承人以共治方式领有。

1557年宗教改革传入伯国，三十年战争期间战事惨烈；拿破仑战争后大部分领土划归普鲁士，比肯费尔德一带并入奥尔登堡。

en:
Spira is the Prince-Bishopric of Speyer, an ecclesiastical state on the Upper Rhine whose bishops held royal lands in the Speyergau from the seventh century. Emperor Henry IV granted them the whole county in 1086. The Romanesque cathedral at Speyer, begun in 1030 and consecrated in 1061, was among the greatest churches of the Holy Roman Empire.

When Speyer became a Free Imperial City in 1294, the bishops governed scattered enclaves on both Rhine banks from residences outside the city; in 1337 the see was held by Bishop Gerhard von Ehrenberg. The episcopal residence moved to Udenheim, later called Philippsburg, in 1371 and to Bruchsal in 1723.

French armies repeatedly seized Philippsburg and the left-bank lands during the Thirty Years' War and the wars of Louis XIV, and the bishopric was secularised in 1803, its right-bank territories passing to Baden.
zh:
斯皮拉即施派尔主教区，是上莱茵的教会邦国。施派尔主教自7世纪起领有施派尔高的王室地产，1086年皇帝亨利四世把整个伯国封给主教区。1030年动工、1061年祝圣的施派尔罗马式大教堂，是神圣罗马帝国最宏伟的主教座堂之一。

1294年施派尔城成为帝国自由城市后，主教们在城外府邸统治莱茵河两岸由飞地拼成的零散领地；1337年在任的是格哈德·冯·埃伦贝格主教。主教驻地1371年迁到乌登海姆，即后来的菲利普斯堡，1723年再迁布鲁赫萨尔。

三十年战争和路易十四时代的战争中，法军多次攻占菲利普斯堡和左岸领地；1803年主教区被世俗化，右岸领土并入巴登。

en: The Squamish were a Coast Salish people whose territory extended from Burrard Inlet up Howe Sound and the Squamish River in British Columbia. Disease devastated much of their population in the 1770s, before recorded encounters with José María Narváez and George Vancouver in 1791–1792. Vancouver's expedition surveyed the coast from the Strait of Juan de Fuca in 1792.
zh: 斯阔米什人是海岸萨利什民族，领地从不列颠哥伦比亚的布勒内湾沿豪湾和斯阔米什河向北延伸。1770年代，疫病使他们的人口大减；1791—1792年，何塞·玛丽亚·纳瓦埃斯和乔治·温哥华与他们相遇，留下了记载。温哥华的探险队于1792年从胡安·德富卡海峡出发测绘海岸。

en:
Sora was the land of the Soras, highlanders of the Ayacucho region in the cold puna above the Pampas river, grouped into the two halves of Soras and Chalcos. They spoke Ayacucho Quechua, kept llama and vicuña herds around the snow peak of Ccarhuarazo, their principal wak'a, and built their chief settlement at Hatun Soras.

After the Wari state fell, the Soras emerged as warriors, never subdued by the neighbouring Chanka with whom they were almost always at war; they sided with the Incas, and under Pachacuti, who ruled from 1438 to 1471, their territory was incorporated into the Tawantinsuyo.

Hatun Soras then housed an aclla house with five hundred chosen women dedicated to the sun, and its curacas were present at Cajamarca in 1532 when Pizarro seized the Inca emperor; the town became the wealthy encomienda of Pizarro's companion Melchor Palomino.
zh:
索拉是索拉斯人的土地，这是一支高原民族，住在阿亚库乔地区潘帕斯河上游寒冷的普纳草原，分为索拉斯和查尔科斯两个部分。他们讲阿亚库乔克丘亚语，在圣山卡尔瓦拉索雪峰周围放牧羊驼和骆马，雪峰就是他们最重要的瓦卡；主城建于大索拉。

瓦里国家衰落后，索拉斯人以善战著称，从未被邻近的昌卡人征服，双方几乎战事不断；他们与印加人结盟，在1438年至1471年在位的帕查库特克治下被并入塔万廷苏尤。

大索拉随后设有甄选贞女馆，五百名入选女子专事奉祀太阳神；1532年皮萨罗在卡哈马卡擒获印加君主时，索拉斯人的酋长也在场，这座城镇后来成为皮萨罗同伴梅尔乔·帕洛米诺的富庶委托监护地。

en:
The Sarbadars, whose name means head on the gallows, were a Shi'i state in western Khurasan, centered on Sabzavar after the Ilkhanate's collapse. It began in 1337 as revolt against the taxation of Togha Temür's governor: 'Abd al-Razzaq killed an official, defeated forces sent against him, and took Sabzavar that summer, giving government a republican rather than dynastic form.

Power was shared between secular amirs and a Shi'i dervish order founded by Sheikh Khalifa and Hasan Juri, whose followers awaited the Twelfth Imam. The Sarbadars fought Togha Temür and his allies, losing at Zava in 1342 after Hasan Juri was killed, and murdered Togha Temür in his camp in 1353, removing the last serious Ilkhanid claimant.

Frequent coups followed until the long reign of Khwaja 'Ali-yi Mu'ayyad, who made Shi'ism the state creed. Beset by rivals, he submitted to Timur in 1381; the Sarbadars kept their administration, served Timur and faded after Timur's death.
zh:
萨尔毕道朗，其名意为“绞架上的头颅”，是伊儿汗国崩溃后以西呼罗珊萨卜泽瓦尔为中心的什叶派政权。1337年初它起义反抗脱合帖木儿总督的苛税：阿卜杜勒-拉扎克杀官、击败围剿军队，当年夏天攻占萨卜泽瓦尔，建立共和而非王朝式的政权。

世俗埃米尔与期待第十二代伊玛目的什叶派德尔维希教团分权，教团由谢赫哈利法和哈桑·朱里创立。萨尔毕道朗人与脱合帖木儿一方交战，1342年哈桑·朱里被杀后败于扎瓦战役，1353年又在营帐中刺杀脱合帖木儿，除掉了伊儿汗位最后的有力争夺者。

政变不断，直到霍贾·阿里-伊·穆阿亚德长期执政并立什叶派为国教。群雄围攻下，他1381年向帖木儿臣服；萨尔毕道朗人保留行政机构、效命帖木儿，在帖木儿死后逐渐湮没无闻。

en:
Soroca stands on the Dniester at one of its few reliable fords, on the old road linking the Carpathian lands with the Black Sea steppe; its name is the East Slavic word for a magpie. The district was Golden Horde pasture until Moldavia reached the river in the later fourteenth century, and the town grew around the fortress Prince Ștefan the Great built in 1499 to guard the crossing. The fortress was the northernmost of Moldavia's stronghold chain.

Between 1543 and 1546 Petru Rareș replaced the wooden fort with a circular stone citadel of five bastions. Sobieski's Poles held it against the Ottomans during the Great Turkish War.

The fortress played a key part in Peter the Great's Prut campaign of 1711, and Russian troops sacked it in the war of 1735 to 1739. A Jewish community first documented in 1653 made Soroca one of the region's older Jewish settlements.
zh:
索罗卡位于德涅斯特河畔一处少有的常年可涉渡口，扼守连接喀尔巴阡地区与黑海草原的古道；其名称来自东斯拉夫语的“喜鹊”一词。14世纪后期摩尔达维亚进抵德涅斯特河之前，这一带是金帐汗国牧场；城镇围绕1499年什特凡大公为守卫渡口所建的要塞发展，这座要塞是摩尔达维亚要塞链最北端。

1543至1546年，佩特鲁·拉雷什把木堡改建为有五座棱堡的石砌圆形城堡。大土耳其战争期间，索别斯基率领的波兰军曾在此抵御奥斯曼人。

1711年彼得大帝普鲁特河战役中这座要塞发挥关键作用；1735至1739年的战争里，俄军洗劫了它。犹太社群最早见于1653年记载，使索罗卡成为该地区较早的犹太人定居点之一。

en:
Sarangarh was a small hill state in the Chhattisgarh country, ruled by a Raj Gond dynasty whose clan emblem was the turtle. Its rulers traced their origin to a Gond war band that, according to tradition, migrated from Bhandara in the first century and carved out a chiefdom in the forests east of the plains.

Sarangarh began as a dependency of the Kalachuri kingdom of Ratanpur and later became one of the eighteen Garhjat feudatory states attached to Sambalpur, whose kings valued it for the troops it supplied in their campaigns. It remained a Gond tributary chiefdom until 1818, when it came under British protection.
zh:
萨兰加尔是切蒂斯格尔地区的小山邦，由拉杰贡德王朝统治，家族徽记是一只龟。其统治者把家世追溯到一支贡德武士队伍：相传他们于1世纪从班达拉迁出，在平原以东的丛林中开辟出这块领地。

萨兰加尔起初是拉坦普尔卡拉楚里王国的附庸，后来成为附属于萨姆巴尔普尔的十八个迦尔贾德土邦之一，因能在战事中出兵助战而深受萨姆巴尔普尔诸王看重。它一直保持贡德附庸首领的地位，直到1818年接受英国保护。

en:
Sarikol was a Pamir mountain kingdom centered on the stone fortress of Tashkurgan, a Turkic name meaning stone fortress, which Chinese writers called Shitoucheng. In Han times the valley held the Kingdom of Puli, recorded in the Book of Han; later travellers knew it as Qiepantuo. Xuanzang passed through around 649 on his way from Badakhshan to Khotan.

Caravan routes converged on its capital, guarding the Oxus road to southern Turkestan's oases. Tang troops broke Qiepantuo in the Kaiyuan era of 713 to 741 and planted the Congling garrison there; under the Song it passed from Khotan to the Kara-Khanid Khanate.

From the thirteenth century it passed through the Mongol Empire, the Chagatai and Eastern Chagatai khanates and the Yarkent Khanate before the Qing conquest. The Yuan Tashkurgan Fort and a neighbouring fire temple's ruins marked the old royal center.
zh:
萨雷阔勒是帕米尔高原的山间王国，中心在石头城塔什库尔干——突厥语意为石头城，汉文古籍称石头城。汉代这条谷地有《汉书》所载的蒲犁国，后来旅行者以朅盘陀之名知其地。约649年，玄奘从巴达赫尚前往于阗时途经此地。

商路汇聚于其都城，扼守乌浒水通往南疆绿洲的道路。713—741年的唐开元年间，唐军攻破朅盘陀，就地设置葱岭守捉；宋代它自于阗转入喀喇汗国之手。

13世纪起，它先后归入蒙古帝国、察合台汗国、东察合台汗国和叶尔羌汗国，最终被清朝征服。元代塔什库尔干大石堡与堡旁的祆祠废墟，仍标示着旧日王都。
sources: https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/塔什库尔干塔吉克自治县

en:
Nahan was a Rajput hill kingdom in the southern Himalayas, the strongest of the Punjab Hill States and later better known as Sirmur State. Soba Rawal founded a principality there in 1095, ruling as raja Subans Prakash. After a flood of the Giri River destroyed the old capital of Sirmaur-Tal in 1195, a Bhati Rajput line from Jaisalmer seized the disordered country and ruled it thereafter.

Raja Karm Prakash founded Nahan city in 1621 as his capital. His successors aided Mughal campaigns against Garhwal and were rewarded with fresh lands, and in 1685 Mat Prakash gave refuge to the tenth Sikh guru Gobind Singh and let him fortify Paonta.

During the Gurkha wars the dynasty was briefly driven from its throne and returned under British protection, so that Nahan entered the British Indian order as Sirmur State.
zh:
那罕是喜马拉雅山南麓的拉杰普特山地王国，是旁遮普山地土邦中最强的一个，后来多以锡尔穆尔土邦之名为人所知。1095年索巴·拉瓦尔在此建立城邦，以拉贾·苏班斯·普拉卡什之名统治。1195年吉里河洪水冲毁旧都锡尔穆尔-塔尔，来自杰伊瑟尔梅尔的巴蒂氏族拉杰普特人趁乱征服该国，从此在此统治。

1621年拉贾·卡尔马·普拉卡什兴建那罕城并定为新都。其后诸王协助莫卧儿对加瓦尔的战事，以此换取新领地；1685年马特·普拉卡什收留锡克教第十代古鲁戈宾德·辛格，允许他在保恩塔筑垒。

廓尔喀战争期间王朝一度被逐下王位，后在英国保护下复位，那罕遂以锡尔穆尔土邦的身份纳入英属印度体系。

en:
Sardinia-Piedmont was the composite monarchy of the House of Savoy, governed from Turin while Cagliari remained the island's capital. Victor Amadeus II gained Sicily in 1713 after the War of the Spanish Succession, but exchanged it for Sardinia in 1720, joining the island to his mainland possessions.

Napoleon occupied the mainland domains, forcing the Sardinian king to reside on the island. The Congress of Vienna restored the mainland lands in 1815 and added Liguria, formerly part of the Republic of Genoa.
zh:
撒丁—皮埃蒙特是萨伏伊王朝的复合君主国，政府设于都灵，卡利亚里仍是岛上的首府。维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世在西班牙王位继承战争后于1713年获得西西里，1720年却将其换成撒丁，将岛屿与大陆领地联合起来。

拿破仑占领大陆领地，迫使撒丁国王迁居岛上。1815年维也纳会议归还了大陆领地，又加入原属热那亚共和国的利古里亚。

en:
The Saruhanids were a Turkmen beylik in western Anatolia's Gediz valley, with Manisa as its capital. Founder Saruhan Bey began as an emir in Seljuk and Germiyanid service, fighting local Byzantine holdings, and captured Manisa in 1313 as his seat. His reign, still running in 1337, lasted until 1346, during which the beylik became an Aegean naval power.

Allied with the Aydınids, it helped capture Smyrna and raided by sea. Saruhan's successors kept the principality; the Great Mosque of Manisa, built in 1374 with a large central dome, later inspired Ottoman imperial mosques.

It sided with the Karamanids against Bayezid I and was conquered in 1390. Timur restored it after 1402, but Mehmed I captured and killed the restored ruler Hızır Şah in 1410, and after the last prince died in 1412 its lands became the Ottoman Sanjak of Saruhan, where princes were later groomed for the throne.
zh:
