萨鲁汗是安纳托利亚西部盖迪兹河流域的突厥蛮贝伊国，以马尼萨为都。开国者萨鲁汗贝伊原为塞尔柱和格尔米扬麾下的埃米尔，奉命攻打拜占庭据点，1313年攻克马尼萨定都。他的统治1337年仍在延续，至1346年告终，其间贝伊国成长为爱琴海海上强国。

它与艾登贝伊国结盟，协助夺取士麦那，屡从海上出击。萨鲁汗的后继者维系侯国；1374年所建马尼萨大清真寺以巨大中央穹顶著称，后来启发奥斯曼皇家清真寺。

它因依附卡拉曼对抗巴耶济德一世，1390年被征服；1402年后帖木儿将它恢复，穆罕默德一世1410年擒杀复位的统治者赫泽尔沙阿，末代王公1412年死后，其地成为奥斯曼萨鲁汗桑贾克，后来成为奥斯曼王子历练继位的封地。

en:
The Kingdom of Shirvan was the eastern Caucasus realm of the Shirvanshahs, who ruled from Shamakhi and Baku between 861 and 1538. Its first line, the Yazidids, were Arab-born and later Persianized, known from the twelfth century as the Kasranids. Their court became a centre of Persian letters patronising poets Khaqani and Nizami Ganjavi, and Akhsitan I moved his court from Shamakhi to Baku around 1190.

After a century of Mongol and Ilkhanid suzerainty, the Ilkhanate's collapse in 1335 let Kasranid ruler Kayqubad I, reigning in 1337, restore autonomy, though successors had to acknowledge the Jalayirids. The Kasranid line ended with Hushang's murder in 1382, and Ibrahim I of the Darbandid branch began a new line as Timur's vassal.

The fifteenth-century reigns of Khalilullah I and Farrukh Yasar brought peace and the Palace of the Shirvanshahs at Baku. Farrukh Yasar was defeated and killed by the Safavid Ismail I in 1500; the shahs survived as Safavid vassals until Shah Tahmasp I made Shirvan a province in 1538.
zh:
希尔凡王国是高加索东部希尔凡沙赫的国度，861—1538年间历代国王以沙马基和巴库为都。第一支统治家族叶齐德家族出身阿拉伯，后来波斯化，12世纪起称科斯兰家族。其宫廷是波斯文学中心，庇护诗人哈加尼和尼扎米·甘伽维，阿赫西坦一世约在1190年将王宫从沙马基迁往巴库。

臣属蒙古与伊儿汗国一个世纪后，1335年伊儿汗国崩溃，1337年在位的科斯兰家族国王凯库巴德一世恢复自治，但后继者仍不得不承认札剌亦儿王朝的宗主权。1382年胡尚格被杀，科斯兰王统断绝，德尔本德支系的易卜拉欣一世作为帖木儿的附庸开启新朝。

15世纪哈利卢拉一世与法鲁赫·亚萨尔的统治带来和平，巴库的希尔凡沙赫宫殿即建于此时。1500年法鲁赫·亚萨尔被萨法维的伊斯玛仪一世击败身亡，希尔凡沙赫作为萨法维附庸延续到1538年，塔赫马斯普一世将希尔凡改为行省。

en:
Ssangseong was a Yuan prefecture in northeastern Korea, set up at Hwaju in 1258 after Möngke Khan's campaigns against Goryeo. Attached to the Kaiyuan circuit of the Liaoyang province, it was governed hereditarily by the Cho family, Goryeo men who had submitted to the Mongols, and served together with the neighboring Dongnyeong Prefecture as a bridgehead of Yuan control over the northern Korean lands.

In 1337 its superintendent was Cho Rim. As the Yuan weakened, King Gongmin of Goryeo made its recovery the core of his northern policy.

In 1356 his general Yu In-u took the prefecture, while the local Mongol-appointed commander Yi Chach'un came over to Goryeo with his young son Yi Sŏnggye, the future founder of the Joseon dynasty. After nearly a century of Yuan rule, the territory reverted to Goryeo.
zh:
双城是元朝设在朝鲜半岛东北部的行政机构，1258年蒙哥汗征讨高丽后设于和州（今朝鲜咸镜南道金野郡一带），隶属于辽阳行省开元路，由归降蒙古的高丽人赵氏家族世袭管领，与邻近的东宁府同为元朝控制高丽北部的据点。

1337年时任总管为赵琳。元朝衰落之际，高丽恭愍王把收复双城作为北伐的核心。

1356年将领柳仁雨攻克总管府，元朝任命的当地千户李子春携年幼的儿子李成桂归降高丽，李成桂后来正是朝鲜王朝的开国君主。历经近百年的元朝统治后，这片土地重归高丽。

en:
Suksuhu was a Jurchen river tribe in the Jianzhou region of northeastern China. Nurhaci, born in 1559, belonged to its Gioro clan and grew up in the household of the Ming general Li Chengliang at Fushun.

After his father and grandfather were killed in 1582, Nurhaci expanded his power among the Jianzhou Jurchens. He united Jurchen tribes, organized the Eight Banners and founded the Later Jin, laying the foundations for the Qing dynasty.
zh:
苏克素护是中国东北建州地区的一个女真河部。1559年出生的努尔哈赤属于该部的觉罗氏，曾在抚顺的明朝将领李成梁家中长大。

父亲和祖父于1582年遇害后，努尔哈赤在建州女真中扩张势力。他统一女真诸部，组织八旗并建立后金，为清朝奠定了基础。

en:
Străşineţ is the Romanian-style name of Storozhynets, chief town of the wooded upper Siret valley where Moldavia meets Bukovina at the Carpathian foothills. The oldest centre in the district is Siret, where the Teutonic Knights raised a fortress between 1211 and 1225, only for the Mongols to destroy it in 1241.

First documented in 1339, Siret became the first capital of the independent Principality of Moldavia after Bogdan I crossed the mountains, until Prince Petru moved the court to Suceava in 1388. Storozhynets itself began as a loggers' settlement and is first mentioned in 1448.

Nearby Putna, founded by Ștefan the Great in 1466 and consecrated in 1470, became the princely necropolis of Moldavia and holds the voivode's tomb. In 1775 the whole upper Siret country passed with Bukovina to the Habsburg monarchy.
zh:
斯托罗日涅茨罗马尼亚语名 Storojineț，是锡雷特河上游林木区的首要城镇，地处喀尔巴阡山麓摩尔达维亚与布科维纳交界。区内最古老的中心锡雷特，1211至1225年间条顿骑士团在此修建要塞，1241年被蒙古人摧毁。

锡雷特最早见于1339年文献，博格丹一世翻山建国后成为独立摩尔达维亚公国首个首都，直到1388年佩特鲁大公把宫廷迁往苏恰瓦。斯托罗日涅茨本是伐木者定居点，1448年首见记载。

附近的普特纳修道院由什特凡大公1466年兴建、1470年祝圣，后为摩尔达维亚王室陵寝，大公即葬于此。1775年，整个锡雷特河上游地区随布科维纳并入哈布斯堡君主国。

en:
The Principality of Slutsk, on the Sluch in the old Dregovich lands, grew from a Turov appanage: a Rus' chronicle records the town in 1116, and around 1160 Volodimer Mstislavich became its first resident prince, beginning the separate principality.

It passed to the Turov Rurikids, came under Galicia-Volhynia with the other Turov lands, then joined Lithuania in 1320. In 1395 Vytautas granted Slutsk to Vladimir Olgerdovich, whose Olelkovich descendants made it a political and cultural centre; it won Magdeburg rights in 1441 and kept its princes longer than any other Lithuanian appanage, until the family died out and the Radziwiłłs inherited it.

From the seventeenth century its weavers were famed across the Commonwealth for luxury kontusz sashes called Slutsk belts. In 1778 it became a county seat of the Nowogródek Voivodeship, and in 1793 the Second Partition assigned it to Russia.
zh:
斯卢茨克公国在斯卢奇河畔、古德列戈维奇人土地上，原是图罗夫封邑：罗斯编年史1116年已有这座城镇的记载，约1160年弗拉基米尔·姆斯季斯拉维奇成为首位驻跸王公，公国由此开端。

它后归留里克家族图罗夫一系，随图罗夫其他土地属加利奇—沃伦，1320年加入立陶宛。1395年维陶塔斯封斯卢茨克给弗拉基米尔·奥尔格多维奇，奥列尔科维奇后裔把它经营成政治文化中心；1441年获马格德堡权利，它保留自家王公的时间久于立陶宛其他封邑，至该家族绝嗣，拉济维乌家族继之。

17世纪起当地织工的豪华康图什绶带闻名联邦，称斯卢茨克绶带。1778年为新格鲁多克省县治，1793年第二次瓜分归俄罗斯。

en:
Sansepolcro grew as a commune around a monastery on the upper Tiber, first recorded in 1012. In the thirteenth century it passed between regional rulers, including the Tarlati of Arezzo, before coming under papal control.

Pope Urban V granted the town to the Malatesta family in 1367. Florence took control in the fifteenth century, an era when its victory over Milan at nearby Anghiari in 1440 secured Florentine dominance in central Italy; Pope Leo X later raised Sansepolcro to the rank of a city.
zh:
圣塞波尔克罗是台伯河上游的一座自治市，围绕一座首次见于1012年记载的修道院发展起来。13世纪，它先后落入阿雷佐的塔尔拉蒂家族等地区统治者手中，随后归教皇控制。

1367年，教皇乌尔班五世将该城赐给马拉泰斯塔家族。佛罗伦萨于15世纪取得该城，并在1440年于附近的安吉亚里击败米兰，巩固了其在意大利中部的优势；教皇良十世后来将圣塞波尔克罗升为城市。

en:
The Daikakuji line of Japan's imperial house established the Southern Court at Yoshino in opposition to the Northern Court at Kyoto. Its name came from Daikakuji, the residence of the retired Emperor Go-Uda.

Go-Uda's son Go-Daigo helped overthrow the Kamakura shogunate in 1333 and began the Kenmu Restoration. Driven from Kyoto by Ashikaga Takauji in 1336, he established a rival court at Yoshino; the southern line gave up its claim in 1392.
zh:
日本皇室的大觉寺统在吉野建立南朝，与京都的北朝对立。大觉寺统得名于退位后的后宇多天皇所居的大觉寺。

后宇多之子后醍醐天皇于1333年协助推翻镰仓幕府，开始建武新政。1336年足利尊氏将他逐出京都，他便在吉野建立与北朝对立的朝廷；南朝一系于1392年放弃皇位主张。

en:
Stadacona was a St. Lawrence Iroquoian village near present-day Quebec City. Its chief Donnacona met Jacques Cartier in 1534, and two of his sons accompanied the French explorer across the Atlantic. Cartier returned in 1535; during the winter, villagers taught his scurvy-stricken crew to prepare a healing broth.

In 1536 Cartier seized Donnacona and other villagers and took them to France, where the chief died. The village was later abandoned; its precise site remains unknown.
zh:
斯塔达科纳是今魁北克市附近的一座圣劳伦斯易洛魁人村落。1534年，酋长多纳科纳与雅克·卡蒂埃会面，他的两个儿子随这位法国探险家横渡大西洋。卡蒂埃于1535年返回，当年冬天村民教患坏血病的船员熬制药汤。

1536年，卡蒂埃掳走多纳科纳和其他村民，将他们带到法国，酋长死在那里。村落后来被废弃，确切位置已不可考。

en:
The Duchy of Stettin was the westernmost of the Griffin-ruled partition duchies of Pomerania, with its capital at Stettin on the Oder. Its dukes, descendants of Prince Wartislaw I, were Christianized by Otto of Bamberg and held their lands as fiefs of the Holy Roman Empire from 1227. Stettin first became a separate duchy in 1160 and, after reunification in 1264, was created again under Otto I in 1295.

In 1337 Otto I still ruled, caught between Brandenburg's claims and the rival Wolgast line; his son Barnim III succeeded him in 1344. The two lines reunited in 1478 under Duke Bogislaw X, and the duchy adopted the Reformation in 1534.

When the last Griffin, Bogislaw XIV, died in 1637 during the Thirty Years' War, the dynasty ended. The 1648 Peace of Westphalia divided Pomerania between Sweden and Brandenburg-Prussia; Stettin passed to Prussia in 1720 after the Great Northern War.
zh:
斯德丁公国是格里芬家族统治的波美拉尼亚诸分藩公国中最西边的一个，以奥得河畔的斯德丁为都。公爵是王公瓦季斯瓦夫一世的后裔，经班贝格的奥托传教皈依基督教，自1227年起为神圣罗马帝国藩属。斯德丁于1160年首次成为独立公国，1264年重新统一后，于1295年在奥托一世治下再度设立。

1337年奥托一世仍在位，周旋于勃兰登堡的领主权要求与沃尔加斯特旁支之间，其子巴尼姆三世于1344年继位。两系于1478年在波吉斯瓦夫十世治下重新合并，1534年公国接受宗教改革。

1637年末代格里芬公爵波吉斯瓦夫十四世在三十年战争期间去世，家族绝嗣。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将波美拉尼亚分给瑞典与勃兰登堡—普鲁士，斯德丁在大北方战争后的1720年并入普鲁士。

en:
St. Gallen grew from the hermitage of the Irish monk Gallus, who settled on the site around 612, and the Benedictine abbey Saint Othmar founded there in 719. Under Carolingian patronage it became a famous centre of learning with a library of manuscripts. In 1207 King Philip made its abbot a prince of the Empire, making it a princely abbey with its own territory.

The adjoining town slipped from the abbot's grasp, buying its liberty in 1415 and becoming fully free in 1457. His Appenzell estates revolted in 1401 and defeated his allies at Stoss in 1405.

The town turned Protestant in 1524, leaving the abbey a Catholic enclave allied to the Swiss Confederation. Swiss troops pillaged it during the Toggenburg War of 1712 and carried much of the library to Zürich and Bern. The abbot's secular power ended in 1798 and the monastery dissolved in 1805.
zh:
圣加仑起源于爱尔兰修士加卢斯约612年在此建立的隐修所，719年圣奥特马尔又在此创建本笃会修道院。在加洛林王朝庇护下，它成为欧洲著名的学术中心，拥有一座手抄本图书馆。1207年国王菲利普封院长为帝国亲王，圣加仑由此成为拥有领地的亲王修道院。

毗邻的城镇逐渐脱离院长掌握：1415年城市赎得自由，1457年彻底摆脱院长管辖。院长名下的阿彭策尔地产自1401年起兵反叛，1405年在施托斯击败院长的盟军。

1524年城市改宗新教，修道院成为与瑞士邦联结盟的天主教飞地。1712年托根堡战争中，瑞士军队洗劫修院，把大量藏书运往苏黎世和伯尔尼。院长的世俗权力于1798年终结，修道院于1805年解散。

en:
The Satake were a samurai family based in Hitachi Province, where they served as hereditary governors under the Ashikaga shogunate. In 1590 Satake Yoshinobu submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi during the siege of Odawara and secured recognition of his lands in Hitachi.

Yoshinobu largely remained neutral during the Sekigahara campaign in 1600. Tokugawa Ieyasu reduced his domain and ordered the family to leave Hitachi for Kubota in Dewa in 1602; the Satake ruled Kubota during the Edo period.
zh:
佐竹氏是以常陆国为根据地的武士家族，在足利幕府治下世袭当地守护。1590年小田原之战期间，佐竹义宣臣服于丰臣秀吉，其在常陆的领地得到承认。

1600年关原之战期间，义宣大体保持中立。德川家康削减了他的领地，并于1602年命佐竹氏从常陆迁往出羽的久保田；佐竹氏在江户时代统治久保田藩。

en:
Saptagram, colloquially Satgaon, was a great river port on the Saraswati in southern Bengal, sometimes the capital of the region. Its name means seven villages, having grown from Bansberia and six neighbouring villages. It rose from the ninth and tenth centuries as the older port of Tamralipta silted up, a leading mart under the Pala and Sena kings; after the Muslim conquest it became an administrative centre, and the fourteenth to sixteenth centuries were its golden age.

In 1337 it was held for Delhi by the governor Izz al-Din Yahya, whose officer Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah seized the city on his death in 1338 and used it as the base from which he united Bengal.

In 1565 Maharaja Rudranarayan of Bhurshut took Saptagram from the Pathans, who won it back in 1592, but by then the Saraswati was silting and trade moved to Hooghly and later Calcutta, leaving the old port deserted.
zh:
萨普塔格拉姆俗称萨特冈，是南孟加拉萨拉斯瓦蒂河畔的大型河港，曾几度成为这一地区的都城。城名意为七个村庄，由班斯贝里亚等七座村落发展而成。9至10世纪，随着更古老的港口耽摩栗底因淤塞衰落，它逐渐兴起，在波罗王朝和犀那王朝治下已是首屈一指的商埠；穆斯林征服后成为行政中心，14至16世纪是其黄金时代。

1337年，德里派驻的总督伊兹丁·叶海亚镇守此地，1338年叶海亚死后，其部将沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙夺取该城，并以它为基地统一了孟加拉。

1565年，布尔舒特的摩诃罗阇鲁德拉纳拉扬从帕坦人手中夺得萨普塔格拉姆，帕坦人又于1592年将其收复；但此时萨拉斯瓦蒂河日渐淤塞，贸易转向胡格利、继而转向加尔各答，这座古港终遭废弃。

en:
The County of Saint-Pol, centred on Saint-Pol-sur-Ternoise, covered the Ternois between Artois and Picardy as a tenth-century fief of Flanders' counts. From the mid-eleventh century Campdavaine counts took the cross, and when the line failed, an heiress's marriage carried it to Châtillon in 1205.

Guy IV of Châtillon escaped the French rout at the Golden Spurs in 1302; his son John ruled from 1317 to 1344, in 1337 a vassal of Artois. His granddaughter Mathilde married into Luxembourg-Ligny, carrying Saint-Pol to Luxembourg. Its most famous holder, Louis of Luxembourg, constable of France, played France and Burgundy against each other until Charles the Bold gave him to Louis XI, who beheaded him in 1475.

The 1493 Treaty of Senlis transferred the county to the Empire; Charles V destroyed the capital in 1537. It was annexed to Artois in 1787 and to the department of Pas-de-Calais in 1790.
zh:
圣波勒伯国以泰努瓦斯河畔圣波勒为中心，据有阿图瓦与皮卡第之间的泰努瓦地区，10世纪起为佛兰德斯伯爵的封土。11世纪中叶起，康达韦纳家族的伯爵先后参加十字军；该家族绝嗣后，一位女继承人的婚姻使圣波勒于1205年转入沙蒂永家族。

沙蒂永的居伊四世在1302年金马刺战役的溃败中脱身，其子约翰1317年至1344年统治伯国，1337年时为阿图瓦附庸。约翰的孙女玛蒂尔德嫁给卢森堡-利尼家族，圣波勒由此转入卢森堡家族。其最著名的领主、法兰西王室统帅路易·德·卢森堡在法兰西与勃艮第之间周旋，最终被大胆的查理交给路易十一，1475年遭斩首。

1493年《桑利斯条约》把伯国划给神圣罗马帝国，1537年查理五世摧毁其首府。圣波勒于1787年并入阿图瓦，1790年划入加来海峡省。

en:
The Santara, or Bhairarasa, dynasty was a Jain ruling house of the Karnataka coast and the Malenadu hills, with capitals at Karkala and Kalasa. Its founder is said to have been Jinadatta Raya, a Jain prince from Mathura who migrated south to Humcha with an idol of the goddess Padmavati and built its temples.

By the twelfth century it had split into Kalasa and Hosagunda branches, which later settled at Keravashe and Karkala; its Karkala rajas were long feudatories of the Alupas and then Vijayanagara. They made Karkala a Jain city: King Veera Pandya raised the forty-two-foot monolith of Bahubali on its rock in 1432 and added the Brahmadeva pillar in 1436; later rulers built the Chaturmukha Basadi in 1586.

Invasions by the Nayakas of Keladi and then Hyder Ali ended the dynasty; Tipu Sultan annexed Karkala before it passed to the British.
zh:
桑塔拉王朝又称拜拉拉萨王朝，是卡纳塔克沿海与马莱纳杜山区的耆那教统治家族，以卡尔卡拉和卡拉萨为都城。传说始祖是来自马图拉的耆那教王子金达塔·拉亚，他携女神帕德玛瓦蒂的神像南迁至洪查，并修建当地寺院。

12世纪时家族分为卡拉萨与霍萨贡达两支，后来分别定居凯拉瓦谢和卡尔卡拉；卡尔卡拉的罗阇长期为阿楼波的附庸，此后又臣属毗奢耶那伽罗。他们的统治使卡尔卡拉成为耆那教名城：国王维拉·潘迪亚于1432年在山岩上立起四十二英尺高的巴霍巴利独石像，1436年又添立梵天柱；后来的统治者于1586年建成四面寺。

凯拉迪的纳亚克诸邦入侵，继之以海德尔·阿里的进攻，王朝灭亡，卡尔卡拉被提普苏丹吞并，其后又转入英国之手。

en:
The Principality of Starodub was a Rurikovich appanage of the Severian land, centered on the fortress of Starodub south of Bryansk, one of the older towns of the Chernihiv country. The town is first mentioned in 1080 in Vladimir Monomakh's Instruction, and in 1096 Monomakh besieged it for thirty-three days while Oleg of Chernihiv held out inside.

It became a separate appanage in the mid-twelfth century during the breakup of the Olgovichi domains, and from the second half of the thirteenth century obeyed the princes of Bryansk; the Mongols had sacked Starodub earlier in that century.

After Lithuania took Bryansk in 1356, the town passed with Trubchevsk to Dmitry Olgerdovich of the Gediminids and remained a Lithuanian appanage until Ivan III's victory at Vedrosha brought it to Moscow in 1503. The principality was dissolved in 1517.
zh:
斯塔罗杜布公国是谢韦里亚土地上的留里克王朝封邑，以布良斯克以南的要塞斯塔罗杜布为中心。该城是切尔尼戈夫地区最古老的城镇之一，最早在1080年见于《莫诺马赫家训》，1096年莫诺马赫为征讨困守城中的切尔尼戈夫的奥列格，围城达三十三天。

12世纪中叶奥利戈维奇家族领地分裂时，它成为独立封邑，13世纪下半叶起听命于布良斯克王公；13世纪上半叶蒙古人曾洗劫斯塔罗杜布。

1356年立陶宛夺取布良斯克后，该城与特鲁布切夫斯克一同转归格迪米纳斯家族的德米特里·奥尔格多维奇，作为立陶宛封邑延续，直到伊凡三世在韦德罗沙取胜后于1503年把它并入莫斯科。1517年公国被撤销。

en:
The Suetsugu were local lords descended from the Sasaki of Izumo Province. Suetsugu Tanekiyo took his name from his lands at Suetsugu, where the family held a castle on Kamedayama.

Suetsugu Tadasada fought the Mōri under the Amago at Yoshida-Kōriyama in 1540. His descendant Sadataka died fighting for the restoration of the Amago in 1570, and the Mōri took Suetsugu Castle in 1571; Matsue Castle was later built on the site.
zh:
末次氏是出云国佐佐木氏的支流，为当地领主。末次胤清以领地末次为姓，家族在龟田山拥有城池。

1540年末次忠定在吉田郡山城之战中追随尼子氏对抗毛利氏。他的后人贞隆于1570年为复兴尼子氏战死，毛利氏于1571年攻下末次城；后来松江城在旧址上建起。

en:
The Princely Abbey of Stavelot-Malmedy was an ecclesiastical principality of the Holy Roman Empire, ruled by the Benedictine abbot of a double monastery Saint Remaclus founded around 650 at Stavelot and Malmedy. From 962 the abbey held imperial status. Abbot Poppo rebuilt it in the eleventh century; under Wibald in the twelfth it became a Mosan art centre, producing the Stavelot Bible and enamel Stavelot Triptych.

Decline followed: from the fourteenth century emperors placed it under the counts of Luxembourg's protection, and in 1337 Prince-Abbot Winrich de Pomerio ruled. It never joined the Spanish or Austrian Netherlands, but its neutrality gave little protection: Louis XIV's troops under Catinat burned both towns to the ground in 1689.

French revolutionary armies extinguished it in 1793–1795, folding its lands into the département of Ourthe; the 1815 Congress of Vienna divided them between the Netherlands and Prussia.
zh:
斯塔沃洛—马尔梅迪修道侯国是神圣罗马帝国的教会邦国，由一座约650年圣雷马克卢斯创建的本笃会双联修道院院长统治，两处修院在斯塔沃洛与马尔梅迪。962年起修道院取得帝国修道院地位。11世纪波普院长任内重修修院，12世纪维巴尔德院长时期它成为默兹艺术中心，留下《斯塔沃洛圣经》和珐琅制的斯塔沃洛三联画。

此后长期衰落：14世纪起皇帝把它置于卢森堡伯爵的保护之下，1337年在位的是修道侯温里希·德·波梅里奥。它虽从未并入西班牙或奥属尼德兰，中立却没能保全它：1689年路易十四的将领卡蒂纳率军把两座城镇夷为平地。

1793至1795年法国革命军消灭了这个修道侯国，土地并入乌尔特省；1815年维也纳会议把它分给尼德兰和普鲁士。

en: The Sisithunwan were a band of the Eastern Dakota, or Santee, associated with the Wahpetunwan. Before the seventeenth century, the Santee lived around Lake Superior; wars with the Ojibwe in the eighteenth century pushed them into southern Minnesota.
zh: 锡西屯万是东达科他人，即桑蒂人的一个支系，与瓦佩图万人关系密切。17世纪以前桑蒂人居住在苏必利尔湖一带；18世纪与奥吉布瓦人的战争迫使他们迁往明尼苏达南部。

en:
Styria was a duchy of the Holy Roman Empire centred on Graz, in present-day Austria and Slovenia. Raised from a march in 1180, it passed to the Austrian Babenbergs in 1192 and to the Habsburgs after their victory over Ottokar II of Bohemia in 1278.

The Treaty of Neuberg in 1379 gave Styria to Leopold III's branch of the Habsburgs, who ruled Inner Austria from Graz. A later Inner Austrian branch made Graz a centre of the Counter-Reformation; Ferdinand II expelled Protestants before inheriting the other Habsburg lands in 1619. Styria entered the Austrian Empire in 1804.
zh:
施蒂里亚是神圣罗马帝国的公国，以格拉茨为中心，位于今奥地利和斯洛文尼亚境内。它在1180年由边区升为公国，1192年传给奥地利的巴本堡家族；1278年哈布斯堡家族击败波希米亚的奥托卡二世后取得了它。

1379年的《诺伊贝格条约》将施蒂里亚分给哈布斯堡家族的利奥波德三世一支，该支从格拉茨统治内奥地利。后来另一支内奥地利的哈布斯堡家族使格拉茨成为反宗教改革中心；斐迪南二世驱逐了新教徒，并于1619年继承其他哈布斯堡领地。施蒂里亚于1804年成为奥地利帝国的一部分。

en:
The Duchy of Strzelce was an Upper Silesian Piast principality named from the old Polish word for a hunter or archer. It emerged in 1323, when Albert, a son of Bolko I of Opole, took Strzelce as an independent duchy. Albert granted urban privileges in 1326, became a Bohemian vassal in 1327, and was buried at the Cistercian monastery he endowed at Jemielnica.

His marriage produced only a daughter, so when he died around 1375 Strzelce passed to his nephew Bolko III, and in 1382 to Bolko's sons under Władysław Opolczyk. It stayed with the Opole Piasts until Jan II the Good died childless in 1532, when it reverted to the Bohemian Crown and passed to the Hohenzollern margraves of Brandenburg-Ansbach.

The Polish Vasas held it from 1645 to 1666, then it returned to the Habsburgs until Prussia annexed it in 1742.
zh:
斯切尔采公国是上西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的公国，得名自古波兰语中“猎人、弓箭手”一词。1323年，奥波莱的博尔科一世之子阿尔贝分得斯切尔采，建立独立公国。阿尔贝于1326年授予城市特权，1327年成为波希米亚封臣，并安葬在他资助的耶梅尔尼察西多会修道院。

他的婚姻只留下一个女儿，约1375年他去世后，斯切尔采传给侄子博尔科三世，1382年又传给博尔科的诸子，由瓦迪斯瓦夫·奥波尔奇克监护。此后公国依附奥波莱皮雅斯特支系，直到1532年扬二世（“善人”）无嗣而终，领地收归波希米亚王冠，转封勃兰登堡-安斯巴赫的霍亨索伦家族。

1645至1666年由波兰瓦萨王朝持有，之后复归哈布斯堡家族，1742年并入普鲁士。

en: The Sucuru were an indigenous people of the headwaters of the Paraíba River in northeastern Brazil, related to the Xukuru of Pernambuco. During the colonial conquest, fighting and disease devastated their communities, and survivors were assimilated into the surrounding population.
zh: 苏库鲁是巴西东北部帕拉伊巴河源头地区的原住民，与伯南布哥的舒库鲁人有亲缘关系。殖民征服期间，战争和疾病重创了他们的社群，幸存者被周围人口同化。

en:
The Sue were a branch of the Ōuchi family and hereditary retainers in Suō and Nagato. They took their name from Sue village in Suō; by the fifteenth century they held the deputy governorship of Suō and lands at Tomita.

Sue Harukata overthrew his lord Ōuchi Yoshitaka in 1551 and installed Ōuchi Yoshinaga as head of the house. In 1555 Mōri Motonari defeated Harukata at Itsukushima, where Harukata died, breaking the Sue family's power.
zh:
陶氏是大内氏的支族，世代在周防和长门侍奉大内氏。家族因周防的陶村得名，到15世纪已担任周防守护代，并在富田拥有领地。

1551年，陶晴贤推翻主君大内义隆，拥立大内义长为家主。1555年，毛利元就在严岛击败陶晴贤，晴贤死于此役，陶氏势力随之瓦解。

en: Suifun was a small Jurchen polity in the basin of the Suifen River, whose Manchu name means awl and which flows east into the Sea of Japan through present-day southeastern Heilongjiang and Primorsky Krai. Its chiefs held nominal posts under Mongol and Chinese overlords until Nurhaci absorbed the Jurchen tribes into his Later Jin.
zh: 绥芬是绥芬河流域的一个女真小邦；绥芬河的满语名字意为锥子，向东流经今黑龙江省东南部与滨海边疆区注入日本海。其首领在蒙古和中原王朝名下担任名义官职，最终被努尔哈赤建立的后金兼并。

en:
Sukhothai, the first independent Thai kingdom, began as a Khmer-style trade town under the suzerainty of Lavo. In 1238 the Tai leader Bang Klang Hao revolted, took the regnal name Si Inthrathit and founded the Phra Ruang dynasty, ruling from the walled city of Sukhothai on the upper Chao Phraya.

Its golden age came under Ram Khamhaeng, who reigned from 1279 to 1298: he is credited with devising the Thai script, patronising Sinhalese Theravada Buddhism, sending embassies to Yuan China and fostering sangkhalok ceramic exports, while his loose mandala stretched from the Shan hills to the Malay peninsula. After his death power ebbed; in 1337 Ngua Nam Thum reigned amid shrinking tributary networks.

The rise of Ayutthaya, founded in 1351, proved decisive: Sukhothai fought losing wars and became its tributary between 1365 and 1378. When its last king died in 1438 the old kingdom was absorbed as an Ayutthayan province, though its nobles later supplied rulers through the Sukhothai dynasty.
zh:
素可泰是第一个独立的泰人王国，其都城本是罗斛治下、受高棉影响的商业城镇。1238年，泰人首领坤邦克览滔起兵独立，取王号室利膺陀罗铁，开创帕銮王朝，统治昭披耶河上游的素可泰城。

兰甘亨在位的1279年至1298年是王国的黄金时代：相传他创制泰文字母，尊崇锡兰系上座部佛教，向元朝派遣使节，推动宋加洛陶瓷外销；他那松散的属邦网络从掸邦高原延伸到马来半岛。兰甘亨死后国势日衰，1337年威南童在位时朝贡网络不断收缩。

1351年阿瑜陀耶建国后，素可泰连战连败，于1365年至1378年间沦为其藩属。1438年末代国王去世，旧王国被收编为阿瑜陀耶的一个行省，不过素可泰贵族世家后来仍通过素可泰王朝影响阿瑜陀耶宫廷。

en:
Lupah Sug, Sulu's old name before its sultanate, was a loose fourteenth-century polity of Tausug banwa communities, centred on the Indianised Hindu principality of Maimbung whose rajahs bore the title Sipad. Its Buranun, or mountain-dwellers, were joined by Tagimaha, Baklaya and Bajau, while Muslim Tuan Masha'ikha reached Jolo in 1280, founded an Islamic community and was buried at Bud Dato in 1310.

The Chinese Nanhai zhi records Brunei's overlordship in the 1300s, and Hayam Wuruk of Majapahit invaded in 1365; the Sulus threw off the rule in 1369 and sacked Brunei, carrying off two sacred pearls. By 1417 Chinese annals record three Sulu kingdoms under their own kings.

Islam spread: Karim ul-Makhdum built the Philippines' first mosque on Simunul in 1380, Rajah Baguinda Ali married nobility in 1390, and Sharif ul-Hashim founded Sulu's sultanate at Buansa in 1405.
zh:
卢帕苏格是苏禄建立苏丹国以前的旧称。14世纪时，它是陶苏格人班瓦社群组成的松散政权，核心是印度化的马因邦印度教小邦，其拉惹使用斯帕德称号。当地居民布拉农意为山民，后来塔吉马哈、巴克拉亚、巴瑶等族群陆续迁入；穆斯林端·马沙伊卡于1280年抵达霍洛，建立穆斯林社群，1310年葬于布达多。

中国《南海志》记载14世纪汶莱对苏禄拥有宗主权，满者伯夷的哈奄·武禄于1365年入侵；1369年苏禄人挣脱统治并洗劫渤泥，夺走两颗圣珠，到1417年中国史籍已记载苏禄有三个王国，各有国王。

伊斯兰教随后传播：1380年卡里姆·乌尔-马克杜姆在锡穆努尔建起菲律宾第一座清真寺，1390年拉惹·巴金达·阿里与当地贵族联姻，1405年谢里夫·乌尔-哈希姆在布安萨建立苏禄苏丹国。

en:
The Sunda Kingdom was the Hindu state of the Sundanese in western Java, from pepper ports Banten and Sunda Kelapa to inland capital Kawali, with a second royal seat at Pakuan Pajajaran. The Kebon Kopi inscription of 932 is its earliest dated record.

As Majapahit rose, Gajah Mada named Sunda among the targets of his 1336 Palapa oath. In 1357 the Sunda king Prabu Maharaja and his whole court were killed at Bubat, trapped over Princess Dyah Pitaloka's proposed marriage to Hayam Wuruk, shattering relations between the kingdoms.

Niskala Wastu Kancana, ruling from 1371, ringed Kawali with walls and moats during a long peace; Sunda's golden age came under Sri Baduga Maharaja, known as Prabu Siliwangi (1482 to 1521). His successor Surawisesa sought Portuguese aid against the Cirebon and Demak sultanates, signing a treaty at Malacca in 1522 for a fort at Sunda Kelapa, but no aid came and the port fell in 1527. Banten broke away as an Islamic sultanate under Hasanuddin and extinguished Sunda's last court in 1579.
zh:
巽他王国是巽他人在爪哇西部建立的印度教政权，疆域从万丹和巽他格拉巴等胡椒港口延伸到内陆都城卡瓦利，另一处王廷设在巴库安·帕查查兰。932年的克邦科皮铭文是该国最早的纪年记载。

满者伯夷崛起后，加查·马达在1336年的帕拉帕誓言中把巽他列为征服目标。1357年，巽他国王普拉布·摩诃罗阇携满朝文武在公主迪亚·皮塔洛卡与哈奄·武禄的联姻事宜上落入圈套，集体遇害于布巴特原野，两国关系彻底破裂。

1371年即位的尼斯卡拉·瓦斯图·坎卡纳为卡瓦利修筑城墙壕沟，治下长期和平；黄金时代在人称普拉布·锡利旺吉的斯里·巴杜加·摩诃罗阇在位时到来，即1482至1521年。后继者苏拉维塞萨为对抗井里汶和淡目苏丹国，于1522年在满剌加与葡萄牙人订约，准许在巽他格拉巴筑堡，但援军始终未到，港口于1527年失守。万丹随后在哈桑丁治下独立为伊斯兰苏丹国，1579年灭掉巽他最后的王廷。

en:
The Sura polity was one of the Aymara lordships that took shape on the Collao altiplano after Tiwanaku collapsed around 1000. The land Spanish chroniclers called the country of the Soras lay east of Lake Uru Uru and next to the Carangas, reaching into Oruro, Cochabamba and northern Potosí. Like other lake kingdoms, it was a confederation of ayllus under mallku lords, whose people spoke Aymara and buried their elites in stone chullpa towers.

The Inca conquest of the Collao, completed by about 1477, ended its independence; the Soras centre of Paria became an administrative capital of the Inca Collasuyo, and communities were resettled under the mitmaq system.
zh:
苏拉是艾马拉诸领地之一，这类领主邦在1000年前后蒂亚瓦纳科瓦解后兴起于科劳高原。西班牙编年史家所称的索拉斯人之地位于乌鲁乌鲁湖以东，与卡兰加斯人为邻，势力延伸到奥鲁罗、科恰班巴和波托西北部。和其他湖畔王国一样，它是马尔库酋长统领的艾柳联盟，居民讲艾马拉语，把贵族安葬在石砌的楚尔帕塔中。

印加人征服科劳，约1477年完成，苏拉的独立告终；索拉斯人的中心帕里亚成为印加科利亚苏尤的行政都城，当地社区也被米特马克制度重新安置。

en:
The Sutayids were a Mongol dynasty, probably of the Sunud tribe, founded by Emir Sutay, a commander of the Ilkhan Ghazan. Posted to Diyar Bakr in 1312 and then briefly to Ahlat, Sutay returned to Amid in 1319 and ruled from the Jazira to Erzurum, serving successive Ilkhans until his death in 1332.

Though Mongol by origin, the family was Sunni and Hanafi and spoke Turkish, and its Kurdish tribal vassals made Diyar Bakr a patchwork of lordships. Sutay's son Hajji Taghay inherited in 1332 and reigned in 1337; aligned with the Jalayirids and often at war with the Oirats, he was murdered in 1343 by his nephew Ibrahimshah, who seized the throne with Chupanid backing.

Ibrahimshah switched sides among rival Mongol factions until defeat near Lake Van and his death in 1350, after which the dynasty unravelled: Mosul was lost, the last princes were killed by their own officers, and surviving Sutayids migrated to Eretnid lands, known there as the Barambays.
zh:
速台（速台勒）是一个蒙古王朝，可能出自苏努德部落，始祖埃米尔速台是伊利汗合赞的将领。1312年他被派往迪亚巴克尔，短暂出镇阿赫拉特后于1319年回到阿米德，统治南起杰济拉、北至埃尔祖鲁姆的广阔地带，先后侍奉数代伊利汗，直到1332年去世。

该家族源出蒙古，却信奉逊尼派哈乃斐教法，并已通用突厥语；治下库尔德部落附庸众多，使迪亚巴克尔形成林立的封君格局。速台之子哈吉·塔盖1332年继位，1337年仍在位；他依附札剌亦儿人，常与卫拉特人交战，1343年被得到楚邦家族支持的侄子易卜拉欣沙阿弑杀篡位。

易卜拉欣沙阿在蒙古诸派系间反复倒戈，最终在凡湖附近战败，1350年死去，王朝随之瓦解：摩苏尔失守，末代王公被属下军官杀害，幸存的速台人迁往埃尔特纳领土，在那里被称为巴兰姆拜人。

en:
The Suwa were lords of Suwa district in Shinano and hereditary high priests of the upper shrine of Suwa. In 1335 Suwa Yorishige and his son supported Hōjō Tokiyuki's rebellion and died after its defeat; their house was subsequently rebuilt.

Another Suwa Yorishige inherited the family in 1539 but surrendered to Takeda Harunobu in 1542 and took his own life. After the fall of the Takeda, Suwa Yoritada recovered the ancestral lands. In the Edo period a Suwa branch ruled the Takashima domain, while a separate line retained the shrine office.
zh:
诹访氏是信浓国诹访郡的领主，世袭诹访大社上社的大祝神职。1335年，诹访赖重父子拥立北条时行起兵，兵败身亡；其家后来得到重建。

另一位诹访赖重于1539年继承家督，1542年向武田晴信投降后自尽。武田氏灭亡后，诹访赖忠收复旧领。江户时代，诹访氏一支统治高岛藩，另一支继续世袭神职。

en: Sosva was a principality in western Siberia, named among the neighbors of Lyapin. The princes of Koda raided its territory from the east along the Ob.
zh: 索西瓦是西西伯利亚的一个公国，利亚平公国曾与它贸易。鄂毕河畔的科达诸公曾从东面袭扰索西瓦的土地。

en:
Medieval Slavonia was a territory of the Hungarian and Croatian crowns governed by a ban. From 1225 its ban was a separate office from that of Croatia and Dalmatia, but the two offices were joined in 1476.

After the Treaty of Karlowitz transferred Ottoman lands to the Habsburgs in 1699, a Kingdom of Slavonia was formed from the recovered territory. Initially governed jointly by civil and military authorities, it received full civil administration in 1745 and was included administratively in Croatia and Hungary.
zh:
中世纪的斯拉沃尼亚是匈牙利和克罗地亚王权下由总督治理的领地。自1225年起，斯拉沃尼亚总督与克罗地亚及达尔马提亚总督分设，两个职位于1476年合并。

1699年的《卡尔洛维茨条约》将奥斯曼领地割让给哈布斯堡王朝后，收复的土地组成了斯拉沃尼亚王国。王国最初由文官和军方共同治理，1745年改为全面的文官行政，并在行政上被纳入克罗地亚和匈牙利。

en: Savolax was a historical region of eastern Finland and the homeland of the Savonians. Under Swedish rule, Erik Axelsson Tott founded Olavinlinna Castle there in 1475; Russia acquired the castle and surrounding region in 1743.
zh: 萨沃拉克斯是芬兰东部的历史地区，也是萨沃尼亚人的故乡。瑞典统治时期，埃里克·阿克塞尔松·托特于1475年在当地建立奥拉维城堡；1743年，俄国获得了城堡及周边地区。

en: Swabia was a region of southwestern Germany once ruled by a duchy that ended with the execution of Conradin in 1268. In 1488 its cities, princes and knights joined the Swabian League, a military alliance dissolved in 1534.
zh: 施瓦本位于德意志西南部，原有的公国随康拉丁于1268年被处决而终结。1488年，当地城市、诸侯和骑士参加了施瓦本同盟；这一军事联盟于1534年解散。

en:
Saxe-Wittenberg was an Ascanian duchy centered on Wittenberg, carved from Saxony after Emperor Barbarossa deposed Henry the Lion in 1180. Bernard of Ballenstedt took the Saxon ducal title, and his descendants held scattered Elbe lands around Wittenberg plus Lauenburg. In a partition before 1296 Albert II founded the separate Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg, his nephews taking Saxe-Lauenburg.

His son Rudolf I ruled from 1298, disputing the Saxon vote. After claiming Brandenburg unsuccessfully when its Ascanian margraves died out in 1319, Rudolf allied with the Luxembourgs and backed Charles IV, whose 1356 Golden Bull gave his line exclusive Saxon electoral dignity. Saxe-Wittenberg thus became the Electorate of Saxony.

When its Ascanian line died out in 1422, King Sigismund enfeoffed Wettin margrave Frederick IV of Meissen, who merged Wittenberg with his Meissen lands. The former duchy became the electoral district known as the Kurkreis, assigned to the Ernestine line in the 1485 partition of Leipzig.
zh:
萨克森-维滕贝格公国是阿斯坎尼家族以维滕贝格为中心的公国，1180年皇帝巴巴罗萨废黜狮子亨利后，从古萨克森部落公国划出。巴伦施泰特的伯恩哈德获得萨克森公爵头衔，后人保有维滕贝格一带分散的领地及劳恩堡。1296年前的分家中，阿尔伯特二世另建萨克森-维滕贝格公国，其侄子们得到萨克森-劳恩堡。

其子鲁道夫一世自1298年执政，争夺萨克森选侯票。1319年阿斯坎尼藩侯绝嗣，鲁道夫争夺勃兰登堡未果，便与卢森堡家族结盟并支持查理四世；查理四世1356年金玺诏书授予其支系萨克森选侯独占权，萨克森-维滕贝格由此成为萨克森选侯国。

1422年该支阿斯坎尼家族绝嗣，国王西吉斯蒙德把选侯国封给韦廷家族的迈森藩侯腓特烈四世，后者将维滕贝格并入迈森领地。旧公国成为选侯区，1485年莱比锡分割将其划给恩斯特支系。

en:
The Duchy of Świdnica was a Silesian Piast principality centered on Świdnica, a walled trading town of the Duchy of Wrocław by the late thirteenth century. From 1291 it was the core of the Świdnica-Jawor line of Bolko I the Strict, and in 1337 Bolko II the Small, the last independent Piast duke in Silesia, ruled it.

While other Silesian dukes accepted Bohemian overlordship under the 1335 Treaty of Trentschin, Bolko kept it autonomous and enlarged it with Jawor, Lusatia and shares of Brzeg and Głogów. He died without heirs in 1368, his widow Agnes holding the lands until 1392, when Wenceslaus IV of Bohemia incorporated them into the Bohemian Crown.

Świdnica withstood a Hussite siege in 1429, passed to the Habsburgs with Bohemia's crown in 1526, suffered in the Thirty Years' War, and passed to Prussia in 1742.
zh:
希维德尼察公国是西里西亚皮雅斯特家族的公国，以希维德尼察为中心；到13世纪末，该城已是弗罗茨瓦夫公国境内有城墙的贸易重镇。1291年起，它成为博尔科一世（“严厉者”）开创的希维德尼察—亚沃尔支系的核心。1337年在位的是博尔科二世（“小个子”），西里西亚最后一位独立的皮雅斯特公爵。

当其他西里西亚公爵根据1335年《特伦钦条约》接受波希米亚宗主权时，博尔科仍保住自治，并陆续取得亚沃尔、卢萨蒂亚以及布热格和格沃古夫的部分土地。他1368年无嗣而终，遗孀阿格尼丝执掌领地至1392年；此后波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫四世将其并入波希米亚王冠领地。

1429年希维德尼察顶住胡斯派围攻，1526年随波希米亚王冠转入哈布斯堡家族，三十年战争中损失惨重，1742年被普鲁士吞并。

en:
The Swedish kingdom grew from the lands of the Svear and Götar, united under a Christian crown in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries; Stockholm was founded around 1252, and crusades tied Finland to it. In 1319 Magnus Eriksson inherited Sweden and Norway, joining them in a personal union. His reign brought the first Novgorod treaty at Nöteborg in 1323, the end of thralldom in 1335 and a common law code around 1350.

Weakened by noble opposition and plague, Sweden joined Queen Margaret's Kalmar Union with Denmark and Norway in 1397. Revolts against Danish rule culminated in the Stockholm Bloodbath of 1520 and Gustav Vasa's election as king in 1523; he broke with Rome and made the crown hereditary in a centralized Lutheran state.

Seventeenth-century rulers Gustavus Adolphus and his successors made Sweden a Baltic empire and intervened in the Thirty Years' War. The 1700 to 1721 Great Northern War ended its dominance, and the 1808 to 1809 Finnish War cost it Finland. In 1814 war with Denmark forced Norway into personal union with Sweden.
zh:
瑞典王国起源于斯韦尔人和约特人的土地，于12至13世纪统一在同一个基督教王权之下；斯德哥尔摩约于1252年建城，历次十字军又使芬兰依附于瑞典。1319年，马格努斯·埃里克松同时继承瑞典与挪威王位，两国形成共主邦联。他在位期间，1323年与诺夫哥罗德签订《内特堡和约》，1335年废除奴隶制，约1350年颁布通行全国的法典。

由于贵族反对和瘟疫削弱王权，瑞典于1397年在玛格丽特女王主导下加入与丹麦、挪威组成的卡尔马联盟。反抗丹麦统治的起义最终酿成1520年的斯德哥尔摩惨案，古斯塔夫·瓦萨于1523年被推举为国王；他与罗马决裂，确立世袭王权，建立中央集权的路德宗国家。

17世纪，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫及其继承人把瑞典打造成波罗的海帝国，投身三十年战争。1700至1721年的大北方战争终结了这一霸权，1808至1809年的芬兰战争又使瑞典失去芬兰。1814年瑞典通过对丹麦的短促战争迫使挪威与瑞典结成共主邦联。

en:
Schwäbisch Hall lies in the Kocher valley, where brine springs supported salt working from Celtic times. First documented in 1063, it passed to the Hohenstaufen, and under Emperor Frederick I housed an imperial mint whose silver pennies, the Haller or Heller, spread across Germany.

Hall held town rights by 1204, and in 1280 King Rudolph I confirmed its freedom from local lords, making it a Free Imperial City; Emperor Louis IV gave it a council constitution in 1340. Salt, coinage and trade made it wealthy.

The reformer Johannes Brenz became its pastor in 1522 and made Hall an early Lutheran city. Ruined by exactions and plague during the Thirty Years' War, it never regained its prosperity and was annexed by Württemberg in 1802.
zh:
施瓦本哈尔位于科赫尔河谷，当地盐泉从凯尔特人时代起就支撑着煮盐业。它最早见于1063年的文献，后转入霍亨斯陶芬家族手中；在皇帝腓特烈一世治下，这里设有帝国铸币厂，所铸银便士称哈勒或赫勒，遍及德意志。

1204年哈尔已享有城市权，1280年国王鲁道夫一世确认它不受地方贵族管辖，成为帝国自由城市；1340年皇帝路易四世又授予它议会宪章。盐业、铸币和贸易令它富庶。

1522年，改革者约翰内斯·布伦茨出任当地牧师，使哈尔很早便皈依路德宗。三十年战争期间，沉重摊派和瘟疫使它破败，繁荣再未恢复，1802年被符腾堡吞并。

en:
Switzerland grew from alliances among communities in the central Alps into a confederation of rural and urban cantons. Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden sealed a charter in 1291; by the mid-fourteenth century the alliance included Zürich and Bern. Victory in the Swabian War of 1499 left the Confederacy effectively independent, and its separation from the Holy Roman Empire was recognised in 1648.

France invaded in 1798 and replaced the old Confederacy with the Helvetic Republic. Napoleon's Act of Mediation restored a confederation in 1803, and the Congress of Vienna recognised Swiss neutrality in 1815, when Valais, Neuchâtel and Geneva joined as cantons.
zh:
瑞士由阿尔卑斯山中部各地的盟约发展为城乡各州组成的邦联。乌里、施维茨和下瓦尔登于1291年签订盟约；到14世纪中叶，苏黎世和伯尔尼也加入了联盟。1499年施瓦本战争的胜利使邦联事实上独立，1648年瑞士脱离神圣罗马帝国得到承认。

1798年法国入侵，以赫尔维蒂共和国取代了旧邦联。拿破仑的《调停法案》于1803年恢复邦联；1815年维也纳会议承认瑞士的中立地位，瓦莱、纳沙泰尔和日内瓦也在这一年加入成为州。

en:
The County of Schwerin was a small imperial fief in the Mecklenburg lake district, centred on the former Obotrite stronghold of Schwerin. In 1160 Henry the Lion, Duke of Saxony, defeated the Obotrite prince Niklot and took its Slavic castle; in 1161 he enfeoffed his follower Gunzelin von Hagen as first count. The Mecklenburg bishopric moved to Schwerin in 1162, making it an ecclesiastical centre too.

The comital House of Schwerin held the county through the thirteenth and early fourteenth centuries; Count Henry III ruled from 1307 until his death in 1344.

His grandnephew Otto I was the last count, and the 1368 Treaty of Plüschow sold Schwerin to Albert II of Mecklenburg for 20,000 silver marks. The lands merged into the Duchy of Mecklenburg in 1471.
zh:
什未林伯国是神圣罗马帝国在梅克伦堡湖区的一块小采邑，中心是昔日奥博特里特人的要塞什未林。1160年，萨克森公爵狮子亨利击败奥博特里特王公尼克洛特，夺取当地斯拉夫城堡；1161年他把土地封给追随者贡策林·冯·哈根，是为第一代伯爵。1162年梅克伦堡主教区迁至什未林，使它也成为教会中心。

什未林家族在13世纪和14世纪初保有伯国，伯爵亨利三世于1307年至1344年在位。

他的侄孙奥托一世是末代伯爵，1368年依据《普吕绍条约》，什未林以两万银马克卖给梅克伦堡的阿尔布雷希特二世，这片土地于1471年并入梅克伦堡公国。

en:
Swat was the Muslim sultanate of the Swat, Buner, Panjkora and Malakand valleys below the Hindu Kush, a region known in antiquity as the Buddhist land of Oddiyana. The medieval sultanate, centred on Manglawar, was the strongest of the Dardic-speaking hill states, reaching from the Bajaur hills to the Hazara border, and some accounts derive the Shah Mir dynasty of Kashmir from its ruling line.

Its last notable sultan, Awes Jahangiri, was overwhelmed between 1510 and 1518, when the Yusufzai Pashtuns under Malik Ahmad Khan conquered the valleys at about the time Babur was seizing the Delhi sultanate.

The old Dardic population was pushed into the Kohistan, where Torwali and Gawri communities kept their languages, while Yusufzai clans divided the lowlands and turned Swat into a tribal country. They repeatedly beat off Mughal and later Durrani armies and kept the valleys independent of the plains empires through the rest of the period.
zh:
斯瓦特是兴都库什山脚下斯瓦特、布内尔、潘杰科拉和马拉坎德等谷地的穆斯林苏丹国，这一带古称佛教圣地乌仗那。中世纪的斯瓦特苏丹国以芒拉瓦尔为中心，是说达尔德语的山地诸国中最强的一个，势力从巴焦尔丘陵延伸到哈扎拉边境；有些说法还把克什米尔的沙·米尔王朝追溯到它的统治家族。

末代著名苏丹阿韦斯·贾汉吉里在1510年至1518年间败亡：优素福扎伊普什图人在马利克·艾哈迈德汗率领下征服各谷地，时间大约与巴布尔夺取德里苏丹国同时。

旧有的达尔德居民被逐入科希斯坦山区，托尔瓦利人和高里人在那里保住了自己的语言；优素福扎伊各氏族则瓜分低地，把斯瓦特变成一个部落之乡。此后他们屡次击退莫卧儿以及后来杜兰尼人的军队，使各谷地始终不受平原帝国的统治。

en:
The County of Schwarzburg was a Thuringian state of the Holy Roman Empire ruled from Arnstadt by an old noble house. Schwarzburg Castle was first mentioned in 1071, and around 1123 Count Sizzo III of Käfernburg rebuilt it and styled himself Count of Schwarzburg; he founded Georgenthal Abbey and joined Emperor Barbarossa's 1157 Polish campaign.

His grandsons divided the inheritance in 1197, and later generations split it repeatedly. Its most renowned count was Günther XXI, elected German king in 1349 only to renounce the crown within months and die soon after.

Count Günther the Rich reunited the family lands in 1538, but they split again after 1583; the 1599 Treaty of Stadtilm confirmed the Schwarzburg-Sondershausen and Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt lines, both raised to principalities in 1697.
zh:
施瓦茨堡伯国是神圣罗马帝国在图林根的邦国，以阿恩施塔特为治所，由古老的贵族世家统治。施瓦茨堡城堡最早见于1071年记载，约1123年克费尔恩堡伯爵西佐三世重建城堡并自称施瓦茨堡伯爵；他创立格奥尔根塔尔修道院，还参加了皇帝巴巴罗萨1157年的波兰战役。

他的孙辈于1197年瓜分遗产，此后历代一再分裂。最有名的伯爵是京特二十一 世，1349年被选为德意志国王，却在数月内放弃王位，不久死去。

1538年“富人”京特伯爵重新统一家族领地，但1583年后再度分裂；1599年《施塔蒂尔姆条约》确认分为施瓦茨堡-松德斯豪森与施瓦茨堡-鲁多尔施塔特两支，两支均于1697年升为侯国。

en:
Shuixi, Mu'ege in Yi, was Guizhou's greatest Yi chiefdom, ruling west of the Yachi River. Tradition derives its rulers from the Mo clan; around 300 chief Moweng founded Mu'ege at Dafang, held by his descendants for nearly sixty generations. Under the Song it was called the Luo ghost kingdom; after the Mongol conquest of 1279 it became a tusi, and from 1373 its chiefs held the Guizhou Pacification Commissioner title; it was among four great chiefdoms.

Ming official Ma Hua had regent She Xiang flogged to goad a Yi revolt, but she appealed to the Hongwu Emperor and was honoured as the Lady of Virtue and Obedience.

Shuixi helped suppress the Bozhou rising in 1600, yet regent An Bangyan led it into the She-An rebellion of 1621. In 1664 Wu Sangui executed chief An Kun for rebelling against the Qing; when the last chief An Shengzu died heirless in 1698, Shuixi passed under regular officials.
zh:
水西，彝语称慕俄格，是贵州最大的彝族土司政权，世居鸭池河以西。据彝文典籍，其统治者出自默支，约300年首领莫翁在大方建立慕俄格，子孙相传五十八代。宋代称罗氏鬼国；1279年蒙古征服后成为土司，1373年起首领世任贵州宣慰使，水西列名四大土司。

明朝官员马晔鞭笞摄政奢香以激反彝族，奢香却向洪武帝申诉，受封顺德夫人。

1600年水西助平播州之乱，摄政安邦彦却于1621年率部卷入奢安之乱。1664年吴三桂处死反清的安坤；末代首领安胜祖1698年无嗣而终，水西改由流官治理。

en:
Samogitia was a territory in western Lithuania, ruled by local nobles before becoming dependent on the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in the thirteenth century. Its people resisted the Teutonic Order even as Lithuanian rulers ceded the territory to the knights in 1382, 1398 and 1404.

Samogitian revolts broke out in 1401 and 1409. The Treaty of Melno returned Samogitia to Lithuania in 1422, and in 1441 Grand Duke Casimir granted its nobles the right to elect their own starosta. The duchy survived within the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth until its final partition in 1795.
zh:
萨莫吉蒂亚位于立陶宛西部，原由当地贵族统治，13世纪成为立陶宛大公国的属地。立陶宛统治者曾在1382年、1398年和1404年将这片土地割让给条顿骑士团，但萨莫吉蒂亚人继续抵抗骑士团。

萨莫吉蒂亚分别在1401年和1409年爆发起义。1422年的《梅尔诺条约》将萨莫吉蒂亚归还立陶宛，1441年大公卡齐米日准许当地贵族选举自己的长官。萨莫吉蒂亚公国作为波兰立陶宛联邦的一部分延续至1795年联邦遭到最后一次瓜分。

en:
Speyer was one of Germany's oldest cities, founded as a Roman military camp on the Rhine in 10 BC and the seat of a bishop from 346. Rebuilt after the fall of Rome, it became a favored residence of the Salian emperors: Conrad II began the great cathedral in 1030, and eight emperors and kings were later buried beneath it. Henry IV set out from Speyer on his journey to Canossa in 1076. Its Jewish community, founded in 1084, made the city one of the leading ShUM centers of medieval Ashkenazi learning, though Bishop John had to shelter its members during the Rhineland massacres of 1096; the community was annihilated in the pogrom of 1349.

In 1294 the bishop surrendered most of his rights and Speyer became a Free Imperial City, which from 1527 housed the Empire's supreme court, the Reichskammergericht. The diets of 1526 and 1529 made its name synonymous with the Reformation: the first granted interim toleration to Lutheran worship, and the second drew the Protestation at Speyer that gave the Protestant movement its name. French troops took the city in 1635 and all but destroyed it in 1689, after which the supreme court removed to Wetzlar. Speyer remained under French rule from 1792 to 1814, and in 1816 became the administrative capital of the Bavarian Palatinate.
zh:
施派尔是德意志最古老的城市之一，公元前10年罗马人在莱茵河畔建立军营，346年起成为主教驻地。罗马陷落后城市重建，成为萨利安王朝皇帝钟爱的居所：1030年康拉德二世动工兴建宏伟的大教堂，后来有八位皇帝和国王安葬于堂下。1076年，亨利四世正是从施派尔启程前往卡诺莎。当地犹太社区建于1084年，使该城成为中世纪阿什肯纳兹学术中心“舒姆”诸城之一；1096年莱茵兰大屠杀时，主教约翰不得不把犹太人藏进主教宫保护，而1349年的屠杀终使这个社区覆灭。

1294年，主教让出大部分权利，施派尔成为帝国自由城市，1527年起帝国最高法院帝国枢密法院设于此地。1526年和1529年的两次帝国议会使它的名字与宗教改革连在一起：第一次议会暂时准许路德宗礼拜，第二次则催生了赋予新教运动名称的“施派尔抗议书”。1635年法军占领该城，1689年又几乎将其摧毁，帝国枢密法院此后迁往韦茨拉尔。1792至1814年施派尔处于法国统治之下，1816年成为巴伐利亚普法尔茨的行政首府。

en:
Shěnyáng was the Liaodong fief of the King of Shen, a Yuan title created in 1307 to govern the many Goryeo settlers who had crossed into the Liaoyang region. From 1308 the title was held by Goryeo's own king Chungseon, who in 1314 transferred it to his kinsman Wang Ko, a grandson of King Chungnyeol married to a Mongol princess.

From his seat at Shenyang, Wang Ko became the chief rival claimant to the Goryeo throne, using the Yuan court to have King Chungsuk interned in 1321 and pressing his claim again in 1339 and 1340, each time without success; after Chunghye's arrest in 1343 he briefly acted as king, then died in 1345.

In 1354 his grandson Toghtua Bukha succeeded as King of Shen, refused an offer of the Goryeo crown in 1356, and was the last holder of the title, dying in 1388 as the Ming dynasty absorbed Liaodong.
zh:
沈阳是元朝瀋王的辽东封地。瀋王一职设于1307年，用来管治迁入辽阳、沈阳一带的大量高丽移民。1308年起该封号由高丽国王忠宣王兼任，1314年忠宣王又把它转授给亲属王暠，即忠烈王之孙、娶蒙古公主为妻的延安君。

王暠以沈阳为据点，成为高丽王位的主要觊觎者：他借元朝朝廷之手在1321年拘禁忠肃王，又于1339年和1340年两度争位，均告失败；1343年忠惠王被逮捕后他曾短暂权署国王，1345年死去。

1354年，其孙脱脱不花嗣为瀋王，1356年拒绝了高丽王位的推举，1388年去世时成为这一封号的最后一代，其时辽东正被明朝逐步吞并。

en:
The County of Sayn was a small immediate territory of the Holy Roman Empire in the Westerwald, seated at Sayn Castle with lands around Altenkirchen. A first county emerged in 1139; Count Henry II was accused of satanic rites by the Inquisitor Conrad of Marburg in 1233, but acquitted by bishops at Mainz, and Conrad was murdered on his journey back to Thuringia.

When Henry died without heirs in 1246 the county passed to the House of Sponheim, and a partition in 1283 created the second County of Sayn, often under several co-reigning counts. In 1337 Count John III held it from Altenkirchen.

The line endured until 1608, when it fell to the Counts of Sayn-Wittgenstein-Sayn; a disputed succession brought brief annexation by the Archbishop of Cologne, and in 1648 the lands split into the Altenkirchen and Hachenburg lines.
zh:
赛恩伯国是神圣罗马帝国在韦斯特林山的一块小型直辖领地，以赛恩堡为祖居，领地在阿尔滕基兴一带。第一个伯国出现于1139年；1233年伯爵亨利二世被审判官康拉德·冯·马尔堡指控举行撒旦仪式，却在美因茨被判无罪，康拉德在返回图林根途中被杀。

1246年亨利无嗣而终，伯国转入施蓬海姆家族；1283年分家产生第二个赛恩伯国，此后常由数名伯爵共治。1337年伯爵约翰三世以阿尔滕基兴为治所。

该支延续到1608年，由赛恩-维特根施泰因-赛恩伯爵家族继承；一次继承纠纷引来科隆大主教短暂吞并，1648年领地分为阿尔滕基兴与哈亨堡两支。

en:
Syunik is the southernmost mountain province of historical Armenia, centred on Kapan, Goris and Tatev monastery. Ruled from antiquity by the Siunia dynasty, its independent kingdom was overrun by the Seljuk Turks in 1166.

Under the Georgian crown the Orbelians returned: early in the thirteenth century Liparit III Orbelian was made viceroy of Syunik, which became a hereditary principality. They submitted to the Mongols in 1236 and kept their estates through diplomacy; Bishop Stepanos Orbelian wrote his History of Syunik in 1297. Burtel Orbelian held it in 1337.

Timur's invasion of 1385 broke the principality's power: Prince Smbat Orbelian was dragged captive to Samarkand and forced to accept Islam, and in 1437 the last Orbelian holdings were sold to Tatev monastery. Orbelian meliks survived under Kara Koyunlu, Safavid and Ottoman rule, and the region passed to Russia by the treaties of Gulistan in 1813 and Turkmenchay in 1828.
zh:
休尼克是历史上亚美尼亚最南端的山地区域，以卡潘、戈里斯和塔特夫修道院为中心。它自古由休尼王朝统治，1166年独立王国被塞尔柱突厥人攻灭。

格鲁吉亚王室治下，奥尔别良家族重返此地：13世纪初利帕里特三世·奥尔别良被任命为休尼克总督，这里成为世袭公国。奥尔别良家族1236年归顺蒙古，凭外交保住领地；主教斯捷潘诺斯·奥尔别良于1297年写成《休尼克史》。1337年布尔特尔·奥尔别良统治公国。

1385年帖木儿的入侵摧毁了公国的实力：斯姆巴特·奥尔别良王公被押往撒马尔罕，被迫改宗伊斯兰教；1437年奥尔别良家族最后的领地被卖给塔特夫修道院。奥尔别良梅利克小贵族在黑羊王朝、萨法维和奥斯曼统治下延续，最终俄罗斯凭1813年古利斯坦条约和1828年土库曼恰伊条约取得此地。

en:
The Saqiyya were a Kurdish tribe of the country of Karajin and Daquq, which the Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari, writing in the 1340s, counted at more than seven hundred men under the emir Shuja al-Din Babakr, a defender of his faith.

Their Kirkuk corridor, with Daquq, Chamchamal, Tuz Khurma and Altun Kupri, had been Annazid Kurdish land before the Seljuks and the Ilkhans, and later passed to the Soran and Baban emirates.
zh:
萨基亚是卡拉金和达古格一带的库尔德部落。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，该部有七百余人，埃米尔舒贾丁·巴伯克尔“捍卫自己的宗教”。

他们所在的基尔库克走廊，包括达古格、恰姆恰马勒、图兹胡尔马和阿勒通库普里，曾是安纳兹库尔德人的土地，后历经塞尔柱与伊儿汗国统治，后来先后落入索兰和巴班埃米尔国之手。

en:
Schwyz is an Alpine valley canton between Lake Lucerne and Lake Zürich, settled by Alemannic tribes from the seventh century and first named in documents in 972.

On 1 August 1291 Schwyz, Uri and Unterwalden swore the Eternal Alliance that began the Swiss Confederacy. A border quarrel with Einsiedeln Abbey drew a Habsburg invasion, and in 1315 the Schwyz militia ambushed Duke Leopold of Austria's knights at Morgarten. By 1320 the name Schwyz was applied to the whole confederation, and the Swiss flag derives from the Schwyz banner.

Schwyz later absorbed Einsiedeln, Küssnacht and the March district. It kept the old faith, and its men helped defeat and kill Huldrych Zwingli at Kappel in 1531. In 1798 Alois von Reding led the Forest Cantons against the French, but Schwyz surrendered and merged into the Helvetic Waldstätten canton until the Act of Mediation restored it in 1803.
zh:
施维茨是卢塞恩湖与苏黎世湖之间的阿尔卑斯山谷州，7世纪起由阿勒曼尼部落定居，972年首次在文献中得名。

1291年8月1日，施维茨、乌利和翁特瓦尔登的居民立下永久同盟，开启了瑞士同盟。与艾恩西德尔恩修道院的边界争端引来哈布斯堡入侵，1315年施维茨民兵在莫尔加滕伏击奥地利公爵利奥波德的骑士。到1320年，施维茨的名字已被用来称呼整个同盟，瑞士国旗也源自施维茨战旗。

施维茨后来兼并艾恩西德尔恩、屈斯纳赫特和马尔希地区。它坚守旧信仰，1531年其部众参与在卡佩尔击败并杀死慈运理。1798年阿洛伊斯·冯·雷丁率领森林州抵抗法军，施维茨投降，被并入海尔维第的森林州，直到1803年《调解法令》恢复其地位。

en:
Shizong is hill country on the border between eastern Yunnan and Guizhou. In early Tang years a chief named Shizong settled his followers at Ninongdian, which took his name; under the Dali kingdom the Shizong were counted among the thirty-seven eastern tribes whose leaders joined the Shicheng alliance of 971.

Tribal chiefs ruled on through successive dynasties, first as a Mongol thousand-household and in 1290 as Shizong Subprefecture. Under the Ming and early Qing it was part of Guangxi Prefecture, and from 1731 an assistant subprefect was stationed at Qiubei to govern the remoter hills. In 1770 the subprefecture became Shizong County.
zh:
师宗是云南东部与贵州交界一带的山区。唐初，部落首领师宗率部聚居匿弄甸，此地便以他的名字命名；大理国时，师宗部是滇东三十七部之一，其首领参加了971年的石城会盟。

此后历代均由部酋统治，先在蒙古治下编为千户，又于1290年改设师宗州。明代至清初隶属广西府，1731年起州同分驻丘北，管辖远僻山区；1770年改设为师宗县。

en:
Sizhou was the oldest and easternmost of Guizhou's four tusi, ruled by the hereditary Tian clan in the upper Wu valley. Tradition dates its rule from 582, when Tian Zongxian was sent to govern Qianzhong. The Tang set up Sizhou in 630 at Wuchuan.

After the Mongol conquest chief Tian Jingxian submitted in 1277; the Yuan made his domain a pacification commission and in 1281 a xuanwei commission. In 1362 the reigning chief Tian Renhou pledged loyalty to Zhu Yuanzhang, but two years later his uncle Tian Mao'an seized Zhenyuan and Sinan for the rival Ming Yuzhen, splitting the Tian domain into Sizhou and Sinan, which waged feuds.

In 1411 chief Tian Chen attacked Sinan over sand pits; Ming troops captured him in 1412 and beheaded him in 1413. Both chiefdoms were abolished in a gaitu guiliu, their lands divided into eight prefectures under the new province of Guizhou.
zh:
思州是贵州四大土司中历史最久、位置最东的一个，由田氏世袭，统辖乌江上游山区。相传田氏统治始于582年田宗显出任黔中刺史；唐代于630年置思州，治所务川。

蒙古征服后，首领田景贤于1277年归顺，朝廷先置安抚司，1281年升为宣慰司。1362年时任宣慰使田仁厚向朱元璋效忠，两年后其堂叔田茂安夺占镇远、思南，投靠明玉珍，田氏领地就此分裂为思州、思南两司，彼此仇杀。

1411年思州首领田琛为争夺沙坑攻打思南，明军1412年擒获田琛，次年将其处斩。思州、思南两司随即改土归流，辖地划为八个府，纳入新设立的贵州省。

en: Shezi, also called the Annam unit in Yuan records, was a tribal holding of Lin'an Route around present-day Mengzi and Wenshan. In 1382 the Ming merged it with the Jiaohua and Wangnong units into the Jiaohua Three Units Chief's Office under Lin'an Prefecture; after a revolt in 1665, the Qing ended native rule and set up Kaihua Prefecture in 1667.
zh: 舍资在元代记载中又称安南部，是临安路下辖的部族辖地，位于今蒙自、文山一带。1382年，明初把它与教化三部、王弄部合并为教化三部长官司，隶属临安府；1665年当地土官起兵反清，朝廷遂于1667年改土归流，就地设置开化府。

en:
Suzdal, on the Kamenka River north of Vladimir, is one of northeast Rus's oldest towns, first recorded in 1024 and fortified by 1096. Under Yury Dolgoruky it became capital of the Rostov-Suzdal principality in 1125; his son Andrey Bogolyubsky moved the seat to Vladimir in 1157 and built up the grand principality of Vladimir-Suzdal.

After the Mongol invasion Suzdal re-emerged in 1238 as capital of an appanage principality under a Rurikid line. Its prince in 1337, Konstantin Vasilyevich, joined Suzdal with Nizhny Novgorod in 1341 to form the Grand Principality of Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal, moving his capital to Nizhny Novgorod in 1350.

Vasily I of Moscow annexed the grand principality in 1392, and Suzdal passed under Muscovite rule. The Tatars sacked it again in 1445, and in the sixteenth century Vasily III and Ivan IV rebuilt its churches and monasteries, making it a major religious centre.
zh:
苏兹达尔位于弗拉基米尔以北的卡缅卡河畔，是东北罗斯最古老的城镇之一，1024年首见记载，1096年已筑工事。1125年尤里·多尔戈鲁基以它为罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔公国都城；其子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基于1157年迁都弗拉基米尔，逐步建成弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔大公国。

蒙古入侵后，苏兹达尔于1238年重新成为封邑公国都城，由留里克王朝支系统治。1337年在位的康斯坦丁·瓦西里耶维奇于1341年把苏兹达尔与下诺夫哥罗德联合为下诺夫哥罗德-苏兹达尔大公国，1350年迁都下诺夫哥罗德。

1392年莫斯科的瓦西里一世兼并该公国。1445年鞑靼人再次洗劫此城，16世纪瓦西里三世和伊凡四世重建教堂与修道院，使它成为重要宗教中心。

en:
Shizhu, east of Chongqing on the Hubei border, was a Tujia tusi holding in the gorges above the Yangtze. A pacification office existed there under the Song, the early Yuan made it the Shizhu military-civilian prefecture named after the Shitong and Zhupu passes, and the Ming confirmed the Ma clan as hereditary commissioners.

In 1595 Ma Qiancheng married the Zhongzhou woman Qin Liangyu, trained in letters and arms, and four years later they campaigned at Bozhou, she leading five hundred troops. When Ma Qiancheng died in prison in 1613, Qin Liangyu succeeded as commissioner, the only woman among the Twenty-Four Histories' generals.

Her White Cavalry fought the Later Jin and held Shizhu against Zhang Xianzhong's rebels; she settled roughly a hundred thousand refugees before dying in 1648. In 1761 the Qing replaced the tusi with a directly administered subprefecture.
zh:
石柱位于重庆以东、与湖北交界的长江上游峡谷中，是土家马氏世袭的土司之地。宋代已设石砫安抚司，元初改置石砫军民府，因石潼关、砫蒲关而得名；明代确认马氏为世袭宣慰使。

1595年马千乘娶忠州女子秦良玉为妻，秦良玉文武兼修；四年后夫妇参加播州之役，她领兵五百助战。1613年马千乘死于狱中，秦良玉袭职宣抚使，是二十四史中唯一列名将相之列的女性。

她率白杆兵抗击后金，又在石柱抵御张献忠叛军，安置约十万难民，1648年去世。1761年清朝改土归流，将石砫改为直隶厅，土司统治结束。

en: Tlalpan, whose Nahuatl name means place on the earth, was a small Nahua polity in the highlands of the Xalisco region of western Mexico, part of the Aztatlán cultural world of modern Nayarit and Jalisco. In the early 1530s it was overrun by the campaigns of Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán and incorporated into the Spanish province of Nueva Galicia.
zh: 特拉尔潘在纳瓦特尔语中意为大地之上，是墨西哥西部哈利斯科山区的纳瓦人小邦，属遍及今纳亚里特和哈利斯科的阿兹塔特兰文化圈。16世纪30年代初，它被努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的西征吞并，并入西班牙的新加利西亚省。

en: The Tahue were farming communities of central Sinaloa, between the Piaxtla and Mocorito rivers. They grew maize, beans, squash and cotton, and made cotton cloth. In 1531 the Spanish conquered the Culiacán region and founded San Miguel there, incorporating the territory into Nueva Galicia.
zh: 塔惠人是锡那罗亚中部皮亚斯特拉河与莫科里托河之间的农业群体。他们种植玉米、豆类、南瓜和棉花，并用棉花织布。1531年，西班牙人征服库利亚坎地区，在当地建立圣米格尔，将这一地区并入新加利西亚。

en:
Tairona was a network of Chibcha-speaking chiefdoms across the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta on Colombia's Caribbean coast, linked by trade between fishing villages and mountain stone towns. Its classic phase began around the tenth century; the terraced Teyuna, later called Ciudad Perdida, was founded on the Buritaca River by about 800 and grew into a political and craft center of thousands.

Each chiefdom had its own cacique; towns had stone platforms, paved roads and circular plazas. The Spanish founded coastal Santa Marta in 1525, opening decades of intermittent war: a 1551 expedition under Pedro de Ursúa perished at the Paso de Origua, and the Tairona repeatedly burned Santa Marta and traded with French and English corsairs.

Between 1599 and 1600 Governor Juan Guiral Velón crushed the last uprisings; survivors withdrew into the Sierra, their traditions kept by the Kogi and others.
zh:
泰罗纳是散布在哥伦比亚加勒比海岸圣玛尔塔雪山上的一批奇布查语酋长邦，靠沿海渔村与高山石城的贸易连成一体。它的古典期约始于10世纪；建在布里塔卡河畔的台地城特尤纳（后来被称为迷城）约在800年已经兴起，发展成数千人的政治与手工业中心。

各邦由自己的酋长统治，城镇有石台、铺道和圆形广场。1525年西班牙人在沿海建立圣玛尔塔，开启数十年的断续战争：1551年佩德罗·德·乌尔苏阿的讨伐队在奥里瓜隘口被歼灭，泰罗纳人还几度焚毁圣玛尔塔，并与法国和英国海盗通商。

1599至1600年，省长胡安·吉拉尔·贝隆镇压了最后的起义；幸存者退入雪山，科吉人等民族延续了他们的传统。

en:
The Daijō were a warrior family of Hitachi Province. The earlier Taki head family lost its position in 1193, when Minamoto no Yoritomo appointed the related Yoshida Sukemoto as Daijō, a provincial office; his descendants based themselves at Mito Castle.

Daijō Takamoto fought for the Southern Court before submitting to its opponents in 1338. The family lost Mito in 1419 and fell back on Fuchū. In 1590 Satake Yoshishige captured Fuchū Castle, and Daijō Kiyomoto killed himself.
zh:
大掾氏是常陆国的武家。此前的多气宗家于1193年失势，源赖朝任命其同族吉田资幹担任常陆大掾一职；资幹的后裔以水户城为据点。

大掾高幹曾为南朝作战，1338年向其对手投降。大掾氏于1419年失去水户，退守府中；1590年佐竹义重攻陷府中城，大掾清幹自尽。

en:
The Tanala kingdoms lay in the forests of southeastern Madagascar. In the seventeenth century the Zafirambo clan moved inland from the coast and eventually united communities in the Sandrananta and Manambondro valleys under its rule.

Under King Andriamatahetany the kingdom reached its greatest extent in the mid-18th century, before splitting into two. After prolonged fighting the Tanala conquered the Antemoro coast near the end of the century; in the 19th century the northern Tanala submitted to Imerina, while the southern Ikongo remained independent.
zh:
塔纳拉诸王国位于马达加斯加东南部的森林中。17世纪，扎菲兰布宗族从海岸迁入内陆，最终将桑德拉南塔和马南布德罗河谷的村社统一于其统治之下。

18世纪中叶，王国在安德里亚马塔赫塔尼国王治下达到最大疆域，随后分裂为两个王国。经过长期交战，塔纳拉人在18世纪末征服了安泰莫罗海岸；19世纪，北方塔纳拉人臣服于伊默里纳，南方的伊孔古人则保持独立。

en:
The Tama were an indigenous people of the Caguán river basin in present-day Colombia. They cultivated crops in clearings and resisted Spanish incursions into the upper Magdalena and Caguán regions.

In the early seventeenth century many Tama were forced to work in encomiendas around Timaná, and colonial authorities permitted their enslavement for cattle estates. Tama joined Andaquí and Mocoa people in a general uprising in the Putumayo and Caquetá regions in 1721.
zh:
塔马人是今哥伦比亚卡瓜恩河流域的原住民。他们在开垦的土地上种植作物，抵抗西班牙人侵入马格达莱纳河上游和卡瓜恩地区。

17世纪初，许多塔马人被迫在蒂马纳周边的监护采邑中劳动，殖民当局还允许牧场主奴役他们。1721年，塔马人与安达基人、莫科亚人参加了普图马约和卡克塔地区的总起义。

en: The Tani peoples included the Adi, Apatani, Galo, Mising, Nyishi and Tagin, living across the eastern Himalayas and Assam. Their traditions named Abotani as an ancestor and associated him with the cultivation of rice.
zh: 珞巴所指的塔尼诸族包括阿迪、阿帕塔尼、加洛、米辛、尼西和塔金等，分布在喜马拉雅山东部和阿萨姆。各族传说奉阿博塔尼为祖先，并将水稻种植与他联系起来。

en:
Iałopháybo, meaning at the red willows in Northern Tiwa, is the indigenous name of Taos Pueblo north of Santa Fe. Its people settled the valley around 900, raised adobe house-blocks before 1100 and enlarged them later; by the 1540s it was the most populous Pueblo city-state, with younger Tiwa pueblos springing from it.

Each autumn a fair linked Rio Grande farmers with Great Plains bison hunters, exchanging maize and turquoise for hides. Coronado's men reached it in 1540; a Franciscan church rose around 1620, but the Taos killed its priest and destroyed it in 1660.

It became headquarters of the 1680 Pueblo Revolt, which expelled the Spaniards from New Mexico and made it a Pueblo republic capital. De Vargas reconquered it in the 1690s, but it kept its Tiwa language and Plains gateway, trading and intermarrying with the Comanche through the eighteenth century.
zh:
亚洛法伊博是北蒂瓦语，意为“红柳之地”，即圣菲以北的陶斯普韦布洛。居民约900年迁入，1100年前建起土坯楼群，此后又扩建；到16世纪40年代，它是人口最多的普韦布洛城邦，较年轻的蒂瓦普韦布洛从这里分出。

每年秋收后举办集市，连通格兰德河农耕者与大平原猎野牛的部族，以玉米和绿松石交换兽皮。1540年科罗纳多部抵达；1620年前后方济各会建教堂，1660年陶斯人杀死神父、捣毁教堂。

它成为1680年普韦布洛起义的中枢，把西班牙人逐出新墨西哥，成为普韦布洛共和国首都。17世纪90年代巴尔加斯重新征服此地，但它保住蒂瓦语和大平原门户地位，18世纪与科曼奇人贸易通婚。

en:
The Purépecha kingdom was centered on Tzintzuntzan, a city on Lake Pátzcuaro in the Michoacán highlands, its ruler bearing the title Irecha. According to the Relación de Michoacán, founder Tariácuri began uniting the lake communities around 1300 and installed his sons Hiripan and Tangáxuan I as lords of Ihuatzio and Tzintzuntzan; by his death around 1350 his Wakúsïcha, or eagle, lineage controlled every major lake center.

Hiripan pushed toward Lake Cuitzeo, and later kings built a tributary state reaching the Balsas River and, under Tzitzipandáquare in 1460, Zacatula on the Pacific. The Purépecha were the Aztec Empire's western rival: Axayacatl's invasion of the 1470s was beaten back, and the frontier was fortified against Ahuitzotl after 1480. Unlike other Mesoamerican peoples they worked copper and bronze into tools and weapons.

When Cristóbal de Olid arrived in 1522, King Tangáxuan II submitted without battle, but in 1530 Nuño de Guzmán had him executed, and in 1543 the kingdom became the Spanish governorship of Michoacán.
zh:
普雷佩查王国以米却肯高地帕茨夸罗湖畔的钦聪灿城为中心，君主称伊雷查。据《米却肯纪事》记载，开国君主塔里亚库里约在1300年前后开始统一湖盆诸社群，封两个儿子伊里潘和坦加苏安一世分别统治伊瓦奇奥和钦聪灿；到他约1350年去世时，他的“鹰”世系瓦库谢查已控制湖畔所有重镇。

伊里潘随后向奎采奥湖方向扩张，后继诸王建立起朝贡国家，势力抵达巴尔萨斯河，并在齐齐潘达夸雷治下的1460年推进到太平洋沿岸的萨卡图拉。普雷佩查是阿兹特克帝国在西方的劲敌：1470年代阿沙亚卡特尔的入侵被击退，1480年后又在边境筑垒抵御阿维特索特尔。与其他中美洲民族不同，普雷佩查人能用铜和青铜制造工具和武器。

1522年克里斯托瓦尔·德奥利德率军到来，国王坦加苏安二世不战称臣，却在1530年被努尼奥·德古斯曼处决，1543年王国沦为西班牙的米却肯辖区。

en:
Tashan was a Haixi Jurchen polity of the Hulan and Songhua river country, the forest-steppe corridor where southward-moving Weji groups became the Hulun.

Under the Ming its clans were registered as the Tashan Guard and later the Tashan Left Guard, whose commander Keshina belonged to the Nara lineage. After Keshina was killed by his own people, his son Wangji Wailan led the clan south to the Hada river near Kaiyuan and founded the Hada tribe, while another branch of the same lineage built the Ula state on the upper Songhua.

Worn by succession wars after Chief Wan died in 1582, Hada fell to Nurhaci in 1599 and was formally annexed in 1601; Ula fell to the Jianzhou in 1613.
zh:
塔山是活动在呼兰河与松花江一带的海西女真政权，地处南迁兀者人形成扈伦的森林草原通道。

明代当地氏族被编为塔山卫，后分置塔山左卫，左卫都督克什纳出自那拉氏。克什纳被族人杀害后，其子王忠率部南下开原以北的哈达河，建立哈达部；同族的另一支则在松花江上游建立乌拉国。

1582年首领王台死后，哈达陷于继承权内讧，努尔哈赤1599年攻占哈达城，1601年正式吞并；乌拉则于1613年被建州攻灭。

en:
Touat was a Saharan oasis chain in central Algeria, running south from Gourara, whose chief town Timimoun lies on the Sijilmasa-Niger road. Its Berber villagers are mainly Zenata, and in the early Middle Ages they paid tribute to the Ibadi Rustamids before the Fatimids built a fortress there in 958.

At the northern end of the Tanezrouft crossing, the oases lived by trans-Saharan trade: caravans from Timbuktu and Gao passed through on their way to Tlemcen, carrying gold, slaves and dates. Ibn Battuta visited Bouda in 1353; Ibn Khaldun called Tamentit the region's richest mart.

About 1490 al-Maghili incited the destruction of Tamentit's synagogue and the expulsion of its Jews. The oases beat off Saadian attacks, but between 1583 and 1588 Ahmad al-Mansur made them tributary to Morocco; the Alawite rulers of Tafilalt reasserted that suzerainty in 1645 and 1652, and Moulay Ismail ruled through qaids until 1796, when governors withdrew and notables took over.
zh:
图瓦特是阿尔及利亚中部撒哈拉的绿洲，从古拉拉地区向南延伸，古拉拉首邑提米蒙位于西吉勒马萨通往尼日尔河的古道。柏柏尔村民多为泽纳塔人，中世纪早期向伊巴德派罗斯图姆王朝纳贡，958年法蒂玛王朝在此修建要塞。

诸绿洲地处塔内兹鲁夫特商路北端，靠跨撒哈拉贸易为生：廷巴克图、加奥商队经此前往特莱姆森，贩运黄金、奴隶和椰枣。伊本·白图泰1353年到访布达，伊本·赫勒敦称塔曼提特是最富商镇。

约1490年马吉利煽动捣毁塔曼提特犹太会堂，驱逐当地犹太人。诸绿洲击退萨阿德王朝进攻，但1583至1588年艾哈迈德·曼苏尔迫使它们向摩洛哥称臣；塔菲拉勒的阿拉维统治者于1645年和1652年重申宗主权，穆莱·伊斯梅尔派卡伊德治理，1796年总督被撤回，显贵接管事务。

en: Tavastland was a historical region of southern Finland, known in Finnish as Häme. Under Swedish rule, Häme Castle became an administrative centre; the region passed to Russia with Finland in 1809.
zh: 塔瓦斯特兰是芬兰南部的历史地区，芬兰语称海梅。瑞典统治时期，海梅城堡成为行政中心；1809年，该地区随芬兰转归俄国。

en:
Taximaroa was a Purépecha frontier town in northeastern Michoacán and the province of the Purépecha Empire closest to the Aztec Empire, which called it Tlaximaloyan, the place of carpenters. Otomis had settled the district long before the Purépecha conquered it in 1401.

Its position made it a battlefield: in 1479 the Aztec ruler Axayacatl burned it at the head of twenty-four thousand warriors before being driven out, and Moctezuma II's invasion of 1495 also ended in defeat. When Cristóbal de Olid led the first Spanish entry into Purépecha lands in 1522, he took Taximaroa and had the first Mass in Purépecha territory celebrated there.
zh:
塔希马罗阿是米却肯东北部的普雷佩查边境城镇，也是普雷佩查帝国最靠近阿兹特克帝国的省份，阿兹特克人称它特拉希马洛扬，意为“木匠之地”。奥托米人很早定居于此，1401年普雷佩查人征服该地。

边境位置使它屡成战场：1479年阿兹特克君主阿沙亚卡特尔率两万四千战士焚毁此城，仍被击退；1495年蒙特祖马二世入侵也告失败。1522年克里斯托瓦尔·德奥利德首次进入普雷佩查领土，攻占塔希马罗阿，并在此举行普雷佩查土地上的第一场弥撒。

en:
Taozhou was the Tibetan frontier command on the Tao River in southern Gansu, around present-day Lintan. Under the Tang it was a border prefecture, but the Tibetan Empire overran it in the eighth century; it later passed to the Gusiluo regime before falling to the Mongols.

In 1379 the Ming raised the old Taozhou battalion to the Taozhou Guard, with its walled seat at Xincheng, and opened a tea-and-horse office there, making it a main gateway for trade with the Tibetan plateau.

The guard's strongest native house was the Choni Yang tusi: its chief Xierdi submitted in 1404 and was made hereditary chiliarch in 1418, and in 1509 the fifth chief Wangxiu visited court and received the imperial surname Yang; by 1712 the family had organized its subject tribes into forty-eight banners. In 1748 the Qing replaced the guard with Taozhou Subprefecture under an assistant prefect.
zh:
洮州是甘肃南部洮河流域的藏族边防重镇，在今临潭县一带。唐代这里是边州，8世纪被吐蕃王国攻占，后隶属唃厮啰政权，最终归入蒙古。

1379年明朝将洮州千户所升为洮州卫，卫城筑在新城，并开设茶马司，使洮州成为通往青藏高原的主要贸易门户之一。

卫下最强的土官是卓尼杨土司：先祖些儿地1404年内附，1418年被授世袭正千户，1509年第五代土司旺秀入朝获赐杨姓；到1712年已将属下藏族部落编为四十八旗。1748年清廷改洮州卫为洮州厅，设抚番同知。

en:
Tabasaran was the highland country of the Tabasarans, a Lezgic people of southern Dagestan, first named as an independent people in seventh-century Armenian sources and called Tabarstan by Arab historians.

In 722 the Arab commander Jarrah ravaged it while campaigning against the Khazars, and over the eighth century the caliphate imposed Islam, installing a ruler, Muhammad Ma'sum, alongside a qadi; in time it split into a north under beks descended from the qadi and a south ruled by the ma'sums.

From the fifteenth century these lords built a strong principality on the road between Derbent and Shirvan, later governed jointly by a Ghazi and a Ma'sum, which could field five hundred cavalry. It kept its independence through the Persian-Ottoman rivalry until the Russian conquest of the Caucasus in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
塔巴萨兰是塔巴萨兰人的山国，塔巴萨兰人是达吉斯坦南部的列兹金语民族，7世纪亚美尼亚文献首次把他们记作独立民族，阿拉伯史家称其地为塔巴尔斯坦。

722年阿拉伯统帅贾拉赫在征讨可萨人途中洗劫此地，8世纪哈里发朝廷推行伊斯兰教，设统治者穆罕默德·马苏姆与一名卡迪共治；后来该地一分为二，北方由卡迪后裔的伯克统治，南方归马苏姆后裔。

从15世纪起，这些首领在杰尔宾特与希尔万之间的商道上建立强大公国，后来由加齐和马苏姆两位首领共同治理，可出动五百骑兵。它在波斯与奥斯曼的长期争夺中保持独立，直到19世纪初俄罗斯征服高加索。

en:
The Tocobaga chiefdom lay at the northern end of Old Tampa Bay in Florida, with its principal town probably at the Safety Harbor site. In 1567 Pedro Menéndez de Avilés negotiated peace between its chief and the Calusa and left a Spanish garrison; by January 1568 the soldiers were dead and the town deserted.

A Spanish expedition killed the Tocobaga chief in 1612. Disease and raids reduced the people, and a small group still lived near San Marcos in the 1720s and 1730s.
zh:
托科巴加酋邦位于佛罗里达老坦帕湾北端，主城很可能就是塞夫蒂港遗址。1567年佩德罗·梅嫩德斯·德阿维莱斯促成其酋长与卡卢萨人议和，并留下西班牙驻军；到1568年1月，士兵已全部死亡，城镇也已荒废。

1612年，一支西班牙远征队杀死了托科巴加酋长。疾病和掳掠使人口锐减，18世纪20至30年代仍有一小群人居住在圣马科斯附近。

en: The Tumbuka are a Bantu-speaking people whose homeland stretches from Lake Malawi to the Luangwa valley. Oral traditions trace their departure from the Luba kingdom to the early fifteenth century; related groups were later brought together in the Nkhamanga kingdom.
zh: 通布卡人是讲班图语的族群，故地从马拉维湖延伸到卢安瓜河谷。口述传统称他们在15世纪初离开卢巴王国，此后相关族群在恩卡曼加王国统治下联合起来。

en:
Tabary was a Mansi principality near the mouth of the Tabary, a tributary of the Tavda in western Siberia. Its capital was Tabarinsky Gorodok, and its rulers were chosen by local nobles. In the late sixteenth century it was subordinate to Pelym, itself dependent on the Siberian Khanate.

After Pelym's defeat in 1594, Tabary accepted Russian rule. Bocha Murza was elected prince in 1598, and local princes and nobles remained in office into the 1630s.
zh:
塔巴里是西西伯利亚塔巴里河河口附近的曼西人公国，塔巴里河是塔夫达河的支流。其首府为塔巴林斯基城，统治者由当地贵族推选。16世纪末，塔巴里隶属佩雷姆，而佩雷姆又依附于西伯利亚汗国。

1594年佩雷姆战败后，塔巴里承认俄国统治。博恰穆尔扎于1598年当选为公，当地诸公和贵族到17世纪30年代仍在任。

en:
Tepecoacuilco, a Nahuatl name usually glossed as 'on the hill of the painted snakes', was a town of northern Guerrero in the Mezcala river basin. Chontal farmers had settled the area in the first millennium, and in the eleventh century Nahua-Coixca invaders overran them and founded the lordship of Coixcatlalpan, whose chief towns included Taxco and Iguala.

Mexica armies first raided under Itzcoatl in 1435, and a fortress rose there in 1438; after Moctezuma I's campaigns the town became seat of a large tributary province reaching from Iguala to Oztoma, with an Aztec garrison. According to the Codex Mendoza, it and thirteen neighbouring towns delivered cotton mantles, copper axes, jade, honey and copal on fixed rotations.

After the fall of Tenochtitlan, Gonzalo de Sandoval took the town in 1529, and Augustinian friars began evangelization there in 1533.
zh:
特佩科阿奎尔科的纳瓦特尔语名字通常解释为“彩蛇之山”，是梅斯卡拉河流域、格雷罗州北部的城镇。公元一千纪琼塔尔农人已在此定居；11世纪纳瓦-科伊克斯卡人攻入，建立科伊克斯卡特拉尔潘邦，塔斯科、伊瓜拉等是其主要城镇。

1435年伊斯科阿特尔治下的阿兹特克军队首次攻略，1438年在此修筑堡垒；蒙特祖马一世远征之后，该城成为庞大贡税省的治所，辖区从伊瓜拉延伸到奥斯托曼，并驻有阿兹特克守军。据《门多萨手抄本》记载，它与周围十三个城镇按固定周期缴纳棉披风、铜斧、玉石、蜂蜜和柯巴脂。

特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔1529年攻占此城，1533年奥斯定会修士开始在此传教。

en:
Tlachco, meaning 'place of the ballgame' in Nahuatl, was a mountain town whose old site survives as Taxco El Viejo in northern Guerrero. Its people included Matlatzinca, Chontal and Tlahuica communities, some resettled from Cuauhnáhuac by the Aztec tlatoani Ahuitzotl.

Aztec armies had raided the region since Itzcoatl's reign, and in 1445 an imperial governor took residence there; according to the Codex Mendoza, the district paid tribute in honey, gourd bowls, incense and woven mantles. A Spanish party sent by Cortés found silver near the old village in 1521, and a mining camp founded at nearby Tetelcingo in 1528 grew into the silver town of Taxco.
zh:
特拉奇科在纳瓦特尔语中意为“球赛之地”，旧城遗址在今格雷罗州北部的塔斯科旧村。居民包括马特拉辛卡人、琼塔尔人和特拉维卡人，其中一部分是阿兹特克特拉托阿尼阿维特索特尔从夸乌纳瓦克迁来的。

阿兹特克军队自伊斯科阿特尔时代起攻略这一地区，1445年帝国总督入驻；据《门多萨手抄本》记载，当地以蜂蜜、葫芦碗、熏香和织披风纳贡。1521年科尔特斯派出的小队在旧村附近发现银矿，1528年在邻近的特特尔辛科设立采矿营地，后来发展为银城塔斯科。

en:
The County of Tecklenburg was a Westphalian state of the Holy Roman Empire in the Teutoburg Forest's western foothills, seated at Tecklenburg hill castle. It emerged in the twelfth century; its comital line died out in 1262, Bentheim held it until the Schwerin counts took over in 1328, the dynasty of its 1337 ruler, Count Nicholas.

In 1365 the Schwerin counts added Rheda, but in 1400 lost Cloppenburg and Friesoythe to Münster's Prince-Bishopric. Count Conrad, first Westphalian ruler to introduce the Reformation, joined the Schmalkaldic League; after its defeat Charles V forced the cession forming the County of Lingen. In 1557 Tecklenburg passed to the Bentheim-Tecklenburg line, which made it Calvinist in 1588.

A succession dispute ended with Prussia buying it in 1707, confirmed by treaty in 1730. After French and Bergian Napoleonic rule, the Congress of Vienna returned it to Prussia in 1816.
zh:
泰克伦堡伯国是神圣罗马帝国在威斯特伐利亚的邦国，地处条顿堡林山西麓，治所在泰克伦堡山城。伯国出现于12世纪；伯爵家族1262年绝嗣后，本特海姆占据此地，1328年什未林家族接手，1337年在位的尼古劳斯伯爵出自该家族。

1365年什未林伯爵取得雷达，1400年克洛彭堡和弗赖索伊特被明斯特采邑主教区夺走。康拉德伯爵是威斯特伐利亚第一位推行宗教改革的统治者，加入施马尔卡尔登同盟；同盟战败后查理五世迫使割地，由此形成林根伯国。1557年泰克伦堡传给本特海姆-泰克伦堡支系，1588年在此推行加尔文宗。

继承纠纷以普鲁士1707年购得伯国、1730年订约确认告终。拿破仑时代经贝格和法国统治后，维也纳会议1816年将它归还普鲁士。

en:
Tlacopan, also called Tacuba, was a Tepanec city-state on the western shore of Lake Texcoco, originally subject to the nearby power of Azcapotzalco. Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco installed his son as its tlatoani.

When Tepanec rule collapsed in 1428, Tlacopan joined Tenochtitlan and Texcoco in the Triple Alliance from which the Aztec empire grew. Its ruler Totoquihuaztli I is counted among the three founders, yet Tlacopan remained the junior partner, receiving only a fifth of the tribute from joint campaigns.

It kept its own dynasty through the next century of Aztec expansion. Its last tlatoani, Tetlepanquetzal, fought beside Tenochtitlan against Hernán Cortés, was captured when the city fell in 1521 and was executed by the Spaniards in 1525.
zh:
特拉科潘又称塔库巴，是特斯科科湖西岸的特帕内克城邦，起初臣属于邻近强国阿斯卡波察尔科。阿斯卡波察尔科的特索索莫克立其子为当地特拉托阿尼。

1428年特帕内克霸权崩溃时，特拉科潘与特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科结成三国同盟，阿兹特克帝国由此发展起来。君主托托基瓦斯特利一世被视为同盟三位缔造者之一，但特拉科潘始终是弱势一方，联合征战的贡赋只能分得五分之一。

此后一个世纪的阿兹特克扩张中，该城保留了自己的王朝。末代特拉托阿尼特特莱潘克察尔随特诺奇蒂特兰抗击科尔特斯，1521年城破被俘，1525年被西班牙人处死。

en:
Ndisi Nuu, meaning Good View in Mixtec, was the highland Mixtec city-state better known by its Nahuatl name Tlachquiauhco, the later Tlaxiaco, a name evoking rain falling on a ballcourt. It ranked among the principal Mixteca Alta kingdoms, with Tilantongo, Chalcatongo and Achiutla, and its rulers, recorded in Mixtec codices, may have been linked by blood to the dynasty of Tilantongo.

At least thirty-one towns obeyed it, its large market drew traders from the region, and local wares included cochineal dye, timber and cotton cloth; it fought long wars with Mitlatongo and coastal Tututepec.

In 1511 or 1512 Moctezuma II's armies conquered the city, which became seat of an Aztec tributary province paying gold dust, cochineal, quetzal feathers and warrior costumes.
zh:
恩迪西努在纽萨维语中意为“好视野”，是高地纽萨维人的城邦，更广为人知的是纳瓦特尔语名字特拉奇基亚乌科（即后来的特拉希亚科），名字意象是雨落在球场上。它与蒂兰通戈、查尔卡通戈和阿奇特拉等并列为米斯特卡高地主要王国；纽萨维手抄本记载的历代君主可能与蒂兰通戈王朝有血缘关系。

至少31座城镇臣属于它，城中大集市吸引各地商人，土产有胭脂虫染料、木材和棉布；它还与米特拉通戈和沿海强权图图特佩克长期交战。

1511或1512年，莫克特苏马二世的军队攻克该城，它成为阿兹特克纳贡省份的治所，贡物包括金砂、胭脂虫、格查尔鸟羽和武士战袍。

en:
Tlapacoyan was a small Totonac town of the Sierra Norte de Puebla, bearing a Nahuatl name that refers to a crumbling mountain summit. Its people were a mix of Totonacs and Nahuas, and the cotton grown on its hills fed local markets and merchants, together with honey.

In the 1440s the armies of Moctezuma I conquered it and folded it into an Aztec tributary province that also contained Zacatlan; the province owed Tenochtitlan clothing and warrior costumes, and possibly labor service in Texcoco.
zh:
特拉帕科扬是普埃布拉北部山区的托托纳克小镇，纳瓦特尔语名称意为“峰顶崩落之地”。居民由托托纳克人和纳瓦人混合而成，山中出产的棉花连同蜂蜜供养当地市场和商人。

1440年代蒙特苏马一世的军队征服此地，把它并入还包括萨卡特兰的阿兹特克纳贡省；该省须向特诺奇蒂特兰缴纳布匹和武士服饰，还可能要在特斯科科服劳役。

en:
Tanade was the kingdom of the Tanade, one of the oldest Darod Somali branches, on the arid Horn tip around Cape Guardafui, its ports Alula and Qandala facing the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean. The coast had been famous since antiquity for frankincense, white gum and salt; in this poor steppe country cloth, not coin, served as money.

Somali tradition preserves a long Tanade king list, beginning with Aw Maki and counting a King Dirir among the earliest, names echoed by Dirir Maki and his Maki dynasty in 1337, when Tanade stood within Ifat's tributary orbit.

Early sixteenth-century Portuguese found a local lord at Guardafui ruling a land subject to Adal. The kingdom broke down in 1775 after heavy internal fighting, and in following decades its coast became the heartland of the rising Majeerteen Sultanate, which made Alula its capital.
zh:
塔纳德是达鲁德索马里人最古老支系之一塔纳德人的王国，位于非洲之角尖端瓜达富伊角一带的干旱地带，阿卢拉、甘达拉等港口面向亚丁湾与印度洋。这片海岸自古以乳香、白色树胶和盐闻名；土地贫瘠，当地不铸钱币，以布匹充当货币。

索马里传统保留着一长串塔纳德国王世系，始祖奥·马基，早期诸王中有迪里尔王——这与1337年在位的迪里尔·马基及其马基王朝名号相呼应，当时塔纳德处在伊法特的朝贡势力圈内。

16世纪初葡萄牙人仍记载瓜达富伊有一位臣属阿达尔的本地首领。王国在1775年惨烈内战后瓦解，此后数十年其海岸成为崛起的马杰尔廷苏丹国核心地带，阿卢拉被定为主都。

en:
The Tidung kingdom, also remembered as the kingdom of Tarakan, united the Tidung people of north-eastern Borneo from its seat on Tarakan Island. Tidung oral history begins with the drowned river settlement of Menjelutung on the Sesayap, whose king Benayuk perished in a great storm early in the eleventh century; a descendant, Yamus, then led the survivors to Binalatung on Tarakan.

A long line of rajas followed, ruling from villages that shifted along the coast and rivers, and under Raja Bengawan their sway reached from Tanjung Mangkaliat in the south as far as Kudat in Sabah. The Nagarakretagama of 1365 names Tirem, identified with Tidung, among the lands conquered for Majapahit by Gajah Mada, and the Hikayat Banjar later lists Tarakan as a tributary of Banjar.

Bengawan is remembered as the first of its rulers to embrace Islam, and in 1800 the Tidung lands broke from Berau to form their own sultanate beside Bulungan.
zh:
缇洞王国又称打拉根王国，以打拉根岛为中心，统合了婆罗洲东北部的缇洞人。缇洞口述史始于塞萨亚普河畔被水淹没的门遮鲁通聚落：11世纪初的一场大风暴中，国王贝纳尤克与聚落一同沉没；他的后裔亚穆斯率幸存者迁至打拉根的比纳拉通。

此后王统绵延，王庭在沿海与河流间不断迁移；在本加万王治下，势力南起丹戎芒卡利亚特，北抵沙巴的古达。1365年的《爪哇史颂》把提棱（即缇洞）列入加查·马达为满者伯夷征服的诸地，后来的《马辰编年史》也把打拉根列为班贾尔的朝贡地。

本加万被认为是王统中第一位信奉伊斯兰教的统治者；1800年，缇洞地区脱离布劳，与布隆岸各自建立苏丹国。

en:
The Tacettinids were a Turkmen beylik of the Çepni tribe in northern Anatolia, founded by Emir Taceddin Bey and ruled from Niksar in the Tokat region over the Canik country of Bafra, the Kelkit valley and Çarşamba along the Black Sea coast.

Taceddin began as a local commander under the Seljuk sultanate of Rum, then gathered a following and made himself independent as Ilkhanid authority collapsed; the beylik is conventionally dated from 1346.

As a marcher state it guarded the frontier against the Christian lords of the Canik and helped Turkify the region, while Taceddin spent much of his reign fighting Kadi Burhan al-Din, ruler of Sivas, and the neighboring Hacıemir principality. The dynasty acknowledged first the Eretnids and then Burhan al-Din as overlords, submitted to the Ottomans after 1393, and was fully annexed in 1425.
zh:
塔杰迪尼是安纳托利亚北部切普尼部落的土库曼贝伊国，由埃米尔塔杰丁贝伊创建，以托卡特地区的尼克萨尔为都，领有黑海沿岸巴夫拉、凯尔基特河谷和恰尔尚巴一带的贾尼克地区。

塔杰丁本是罗姆苏丹国治下的地方将领，伊儿汗国权威瓦解后聚众自立，贝伊国传统上以1346年为建国之年。

作为边疆政权，它拱卫面向贾尼克基督徒领主的边境，推动当地突厥化；塔杰丁一生大多在与锡瓦斯统治者卡迪·布尔汉丁和邻邦哈吉埃米尔贝伊国交战。王朝先后奉埃雷特纳王朝和布尔汉丁为宗主，1393年后归附奥斯曼，1425年被完全吞并。

en:
Tondo was a Tagalog and Kapampangan bayan, or polity, on the northern bank of the Pasig River delta on Luzon, one of the Philippines' oldest documented settlements. It appears as early as 900 in the Laguna Copperplate Inscription, the archipelago's oldest surviving written document. With Maynila across the delta, it controlled Chinese goods flowing through Manila Bay and grew wealthy on trade with Ming China, Brunei and Majapahit, which also brought Hindu and Buddhist influence.

Datus led its barangays under a paramount chief called a lakan, from the hereditary maginoo nobility. When Miguel López de Legazpi arrived in 1571, the reigning lakan Lakandula came to terms with the Spaniards, while Tarik Sulayman's resistance was crushed at Bangkusay Channel that June.

Tondo lost its independence, and in 1587 and 1588 its nobles, led by Agustín de Legazpi and Magat Salamat, plotted the failed Tondo Conspiracy against colonial rule.
zh:
汤都是吕宋帕西格河三角洲北岸的他加禄与邦板牙人城邦（当地称巴扬），也是菲律宾最早有文字记载的定居点之一。菲律宾现存最古老文献、900年的《拉古纳铜版铭文》已提到它。汤都与三角洲对岸的马尼拉共同控制中国货物经马尼拉湾的流通，靠与明朝中国、文莱和满者伯夷的贸易致富，印度教与佛教影响随之传入。

各巴朗盖由达图治理，众达图拥戴出身世袭马吉努贵族阶层的最高首领拉坎。1571年米格尔·洛佩斯·德·黎牙实比到来时，在位的拉坎·杜拉与西班牙人妥协，塔里克·苏莱曼的抵抗于同年6月在邦库赛海峡之战中被击溃。

汤都丧失独立；1587至1588年，阿古斯丁·德·黎牙实比与马加特·萨拉马特率当地贵族策划反抗殖民统治的汤都阴谋，最终失败。

en:
Tetela was a mountain town of the Sierra Norte de Puebla, its Nahuatl name meaning the place of many hills. It was founded in 1219 by four Chichimeca clans from the west, whose leaders set up ruling lines lasting until the Spanish conquest; the town was governed by a tlatoani, and although Nahuatl was its main language, Totonac was also spoken around it.

Its people worshipped Huitzilopochtli and fought flower wars against Zacatlan and Tlaxcala. Tetela entered the Aztec Empire through diplomacy rather than conquest and became seat of a strategic province, sending war captives to Tenochtitlan in exchange for Mexica arms.

Gold washed at La Canada later earned Tetela the name Tetela del Oro. Cortes crossed the nearby mountains in 1519, and from 1528 the Franciscan Andres de Olmos evangelized the district.
zh:
特特拉是普埃布拉北部山区的山城，纳瓦特尔语名称意为“众山丘之地”。1219年四支自西方迁来的奇奇梅克部族在此建城，首领开创的统治世系延续到西班牙征服；城邦由特拉托阿尼治理，以纳瓦特尔语为主，周边也通行托托纳克语。

居民崇拜维齐洛波奇特利，与萨卡特兰和特拉斯卡拉进行荣冠战争。特特拉通过外交而非武力并入阿兹特克帝国，成为战略省份的治所，把战俘送往特诺奇蒂特兰换取墨西卡武器。

拉卡尼亚达出产的黄金后来为特特拉赢得“金特特拉”之名。1519年科尔特斯穿过附近山地，1528年起方济各会修士安德烈斯·德·奥尔莫斯在这一带传教。

en: The Tegüima were an Opatan people of central and northeastern Sonora, whose name meant “river people”. Their communities included Banámichi and Bacoachi, and they spoke a language closely related to Eudeve. Jesuits established a mission in Opata territory in 1628; in 1702 the missionary Natal Lombardo published a grammar of the Tegüima language.
zh: 特圭马人是索诺拉中部和东北部的奥帕塔族群，其名称意为“河流之民”。他们的聚落包括巴纳米奇和巴科阿奇，所说语言与尤德韦语关系密切。1628年耶稣会士在奥帕塔地区建立传教区；1702年传教士纳塔尔·隆巴多出版了特圭马语语法书。

en:
The Beylik of Teke was a Turkmen frontier principality on Anatolia's Mediterranean coast, with its capital at Antalya on the peninsula named after it. It grew from the Hamidid dynasty: when brothers Yunus and Dündar split their family lands, Yunus took the coast around Antalya and Korkuteli and founded the Teke line in 1321.

In 1324 the Ilkhanid governor Timurtaş subdued the beylik and granted Antalya to Yunus's son Mahmud, and when Ibn Battuta visited in 1333 he found Yunus's second son Hızır ruling a wealthy port with Christian and Jewish merchants in walled quarters. Hızır's nephew Mehmed succeeded him in 1372, followed by Osman Çelebi.

Bayezid I annexed Teke in 1391, but Timur restored Osman after winning in 1402, and the Ottomans retook the beylik for good in 1423. The Yivli Minare, built under the dynasty, marks Antalya's skyline.
zh:
泰凯是安纳托利亚地中海沿岸的土库曼边疆贝伊国，都城安塔利亚所在的半岛也以泰凯为名。它出自哈米德王朝：尤努斯与丁达尔兄弟瓜分家族领地时，尤努斯取得安塔利亚和科尔库泰利海岸，1321年开创泰凯一系。

1324年伊儿汗国总督帖木儿塔什征服该贝伊国，把安塔利亚封给尤努斯之子马哈茂德。1333年伊本·白图泰到访时，尤努斯的次子赫泽尔统治着富庶港口，基督徒与犹太商人住在有城墙的街区。1372年赫泽尔之侄穆罕默德继位，此后传给奥斯曼·切莱比。

1391年巴耶济德一世吞并泰凯，帖木儿1402年获胜后恢复奥斯曼的君位，1423年奥斯曼人再度并吞，泰凯永久并入帝国。王朝时期修建的伊夫利尖塔是安塔利亚的地标。

en:
The kingdom centred on Tlaltenango was an independent state of the Caxcanes, a sedentary Chichimeca people of Uto-Aztecan speech in the southern valleys of Zacatecas.
