Settled as early as the ninth century, perhaps as an outpost of the La Quemada polity, Tlaltenango won its independence in the tenth century when La Quemada was besieged and burned, though it later suffered raids from the neighbouring Caxcan kingdom of Xochipillan.

Its government was a diarchy: a cihuatzin, or queen, held laws, diplomacy and the economy, while a tlatoani commanded the army, and the war leader answered to her.

At the end of 1530 Nuño de Guzmán's armies stormed the valley and added it to Nueva Galicia, and when the Mixtón War of 1541 failed, the Caxcan population collapsed; the Spaniards built a new Tlaltenango upon the ruins of the old.
zh:
以特拉尔特南戈为中心的王国是卡什坎人的独立政权。卡什坎人是操犹他—阿兹特克语族语言的定居奇奇梅克族群，占据今萨卡特卡斯州南部河谷。特拉尔特南戈至迟在9世纪已有聚落，可能是拉凯马达政权的据点；10世纪拉凯马达被围焚后它赢得独立，后来却屡遭邻邦索奇皮尔兰的卡什坎王国攻掠。

它实行双首长制：女性君主西瓦钦掌管法律、外交和财政，特拉托阿尼统帅军队，军事首领须听命于女王。

1530年底，努尼奥·德·古斯曼的军队攻入河谷，将其并入新加利西亚；1541年米斯特翁战争失败后卡什坎人口锐减，西班牙人在旧城废墟上建起新的特拉尔特南戈。

en:
The Temirgoy, counted among the twelve great Circassian tribes, held the lands between the Belaya and Laba rivers and north to the Kuban, around present-day Maykop. They are thought to have moved from the Black Sea coast to the western Caucasus in the fourteenth century, and princely rule took shape under the Boletoqo house between the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries.

Observers counted them among the strongest and wealthiest Circassian tribes: society was stratified between princes, nobles and commoners, their wealth resting on cattle breeding and grains such as millet. Like other Circassians they were Byzantine-rite Christians before gradually adopting Islam.

In the early nineteenth century the Russian conquest of Circassia scattered the tribe: many Temirgoy took refuge in the Ottoman Empire, while the rest were settled in Adygea's villages, and their dialect became the basis of the literary Adyghe language.
zh:
铁米尔戈伊人是切尔克斯十二大部之一，领有别拉亚河与拉巴河之间、北抵库班河的土地，即今迈科普一带。一般认为他们14世纪从黑海沿岸迁到西高加索；15至16世纪博列托科家族建立起公族统治。

观察家视其为最强盛富庶的切尔克斯部落之一：社会分王公、贵族、平民等级，财富靠畜牧和粟等谷物。和其他切尔克斯人一样，他们原是拜占庭礼基督徒，后来逐渐改宗伊斯兰教。

19世纪初俄罗斯征服切尔克斯，部落流散：许多人避入奥斯曼帝国，余者被安置在阿迪格各村，其方言成为阿迪格书面语的基础。

en:
Tenkodogo, whose name means ancient land, was the oldest of the Mossi kingdoms in the upper Volta region, in southeastern Burkina Faso. Mossi oral tradition traces it to the horseman Ouédraogo, son of the Dagbamba princess Yennenga and a Mandé hunter, who is said to have built the town around 1100 after conquering the local peoples.

On his death his son Zoungrana kept Tenkodogo while two other sons founded further Mossi lines, and a younger branch grew into the powerful kingdom of Ouagadougou. Tenkodogo remained an independent kingdom ruled by its own naba, linked to the other Mossi states by dynasty and ritual rather than empire.

It raided and traded across the Sahel and kept its own Mossi beliefs even as Islam spread among nearby cities, still ruling itself when European colonial armies reached the Volta basin.
zh:
滕科多戈意为“古老的土地”，是沃尔特河上游诸莫西王国中最古老的一个，位于今布基纳法索东南部。莫西口传传统把它追溯到骑手韦德拉奥果：他是达格邦巴公主延嫩加与一名曼德猎人之子，据说在征服当地族群后于1100年前后建城。

韦德拉奥果死后，儿子宗格拉纳留在滕科多戈，另外两个儿子另建莫西支系，更年轻的支系后来发展成强大的瓦加杜古王国。滕科多戈始终由自己的纳巴统治，与其他莫西国家靠王朝和礼仪而非帝国体制相连。

它在萨赫勒从事劫掠和贸易，在伊斯兰教于周边城市传播时保留莫西本土信仰；欧洲殖民军队抵达沃尔特河流域时，它仍保持自治。

en:
Teotitlan, whose Nahuatl name means Among the Houses of the God and which later ages called Teotitlan del Camino, was an altepetl and religious centre at the gateway of the Oaxaca Canada, where the road runs on to Tehuacan and central Mexico. Nahuatl-speaking Nonoalca lived in the town while Mazatec and Popoloca peoples filled the surrounding hills.

It was ruled by three priest-lords, who served gods such as Cihuacoatl, and its priests were famed for their strict abstinence; the town kept the eighteen Aztec yearly festivals and a new fire rite every four years.

In the later fifteenth century it revolted against the tlatoani Axayacatl and was brutally reconquered, yet a Spanish relación of 1581 remembered it as an independent republic of more than a thousand people, allied to Moctezuma and paying no tribute.
zh:
特奥蒂特兰的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“在神的屋宇之间”，后世称路上的特奥蒂特兰，是瓦哈卡卡尼亚达门户处的阿尔特佩特尔和宗教中心，道路由此通往特瓦坎和墨西哥中部。城中住着说纳瓦特尔语的诺诺阿尔卡人，周围山地是马萨特克人和波波洛卡人。

它由三位祭司君主统治，供奉西瓦科亚特尔等神祇，祭司以严苛的禁欲戒律闻名；全城过阿兹特克的十八个年度节庆，每四年举行一次新火仪式。

15世纪后期它起兵反抗特拉托阿尼阿克萨亚卡特尔，遭到残酷再征服；但1581年的一份西班牙调查报告仍把它记为上千人的独立共和国，是莫克特苏马的盟友而不纳贡。

en:
Tepanecapan was the land of the Tepanecs, a Nahuatl-speaking people who entered the Valley of Mexico in the late twelfth or early thirteenth century and settled on the western shore of Lake Texcoco. Under their tlatoani Acolnahuacatl they seized the town of Azcapotzalco, which became the seat of their dominion.

From the later fourteenth century Tezozomoc raised Azcapotzalco to the height of its power: its armies overran most of the Valley of Mexico, and in 1419 Tepanec forces defeated and killed Ixtlilxochitl I of Texcoco and placed a client prince on that throne.

When Tezozomoc died in 1426, his son Maxtla seized power, but his wars with Tenochtitlan and the exiled Acolhua princes united his enemies. In 1428 the Triple Alliance of Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan destroyed Azcapotzalco and ended Tepanec supremacy; the surviving Tepanec cities, led by Tlacopan, became partners and later subjects of the Aztec empire.
zh:
特帕内卡潘是特帕内克人的土地。特帕内克人是一支讲纳瓦特尔语的族群，12世纪末或13世纪初进入墨西哥谷地，在特斯科科湖西岸定居，后在特拉托阿尼阿科尔纳瓦卡特率领下夺取阿斯卡波察尔科，以此为统治中心。

14世纪后期起，特索索莫克把阿斯卡波察尔科带上权势顶峰：军队攻占墨西哥谷地大部；1419年，特帕内克军队击败并杀死特斯科科的伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世，扶植附庸王子登上该国王位。

1426年特索索莫克去世，其子马斯特拉夺权，他与特诺奇蒂特兰及流亡阿科尔瓦贵族的战争却把敌人联合到一起。1428年，特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科和特拉科潘组成的三国同盟摧毁阿斯卡波察尔科，终结特帕内克霸权；以特拉科潘为首的残存城邦成为同盟成员，后来沦为阿兹特克帝国的臣属。

en:
Ternate, originally the Kingdom of Gapi, was traditionally founded in 1257 by Momole Cico on the clove-rich island of Ternate and grew into one of the four kingdoms of Maluku. Its cloves drew foreign traders, and its spice-trade rivalry with neighbouring Tidore dominated Moluccan politics. In 1337 its ruler still bore the old title Kolano; the royal family converted to Islam under King Marhum in the later fifteenth century, and Sultan Zainal Abidin took the title Sultan.

The Portuguese built a fort there from 1522, but after murdering Sultan Hairun they were expelled by Sultan Baabullah in 1575 after a five-year siege, opening a golden age when Ternate's sway reached Ambon and the Papuan islands.

Spain seized the fort in 1606 and the Dutch built their own in 1607; after Sultan Sibori Amsterdam's failed war against the Dutch, the 1683 treaty reduced Ternate to a vassal.
zh:
特尔纳特原名加皮王国，相传1257年由莫莫莱·奇科在盛产丁香的特尔纳特岛上建立，后成为摩鹿加四大王国之一。丁香吸引了外国商人，它与邻国蒂多雷围绕香料贸易的争斗成为摩鹿加政治的主线。1337年时君主仍使用古老的科拉诺称号；15世纪后期马尔洪王在位时王室改宗伊斯兰教，扎因·阿比丁苏丹以苏丹称号取代科拉诺。

葡萄牙人1522年起在岛上修建堡垒；海仑苏丹被葡人谋杀后，巴布拉苏丹经五年围困于1575年将葡人驱逐，开启黄金时代，势力远达安汶和巴布亚诸岛等地。

1606年西班牙人夺取堡垒，荷兰人则于1607年另筑新堡；西博里苏丹对荷战争失败后，1683年的条约使特尔纳特沦为附庸。

en:
The Duchy of Cieszyn was the south-easternmost of the Silesian duchies, centred on Upper Silesian Cieszyn. It was carved from the Duchy of Opole and Racibórz in 1281; from 1290 the first Piast duke Mieszko settled the Beskid foothills with German immigrants and granted town rights to Cieszyn.

In 1315 its eastern lands broke away as a separate duchy, leaving Casimir I the west; swearing homage to King John of Bohemia in 1327, he made Cieszyn an autonomous Bohemian fief, Casimir still reigning in 1337. The Cieszyn Piasts proved a durable line, surviving the Hussite Wars and the Reformation.

The line ended with Duchess Elizabeth Lucretia's death in 1653, and Cieszyn reverted to the Habsburg Crown. In 1722 Charles VI granted it to the Dukes of Lorraine, and unlike most of Silesia it stayed Habsburg after the Peace of Breslau in 1742.
zh:
切申公国是西里西亚诸公国中位置最靠东南的一个，以上西里西亚的切申为中心，1281年从奥波莱-拉齐布日公国分割而来。1290年起，首任皮亚斯特公爵梅什科引入德意志移民开垦贝斯基德山麓，并授予切申城市权。

1315年东部土地分裂出去另立公国，西部留给卡齐米尔一世；他于1327年向波希米亚国王约翰宣誓效忠，使切申成为自治的波希米亚封邑，1337年仍在位。切申的皮亚斯特支系是西里西亚最长久的支系之一，挺过了胡斯战争和宗教改革。

1653年女公爵伊丽莎白·卢克蕾蒂娅去世，这支家族终结，切申收归哈布斯堡王冠。1722年查理六世把它封给洛林公爵；1742年《布雷斯劳和约》签订后，与西里西亚大部不同，切申仍留在哈布斯堡版图内。

en:
Tétouan was a city-state in northern Morocco near the Strait of Gibraltar. The Marinid sultan Abu Thabit fortified it in 1305, but Castilian forces destroyed it in 1399 in retaliation for piracy.

In the late fifteenth century Ali al-Mandri, a refugee from Granada, rebuilt and fortified Tétouan. Muslims and Jews from Andalusia settled there, and the city became a centre of Andalusian culture in Morocco.
zh:
得土安是摩洛哥北部靠近直布罗陀海峡的一座城邦。马林王朝苏丹阿布·塔比特于1305年加固了这座城市，但卡斯蒂利亚军队于1399年为报复海盗活动而将其摧毁。

15世纪末，来自格拉纳达的流亡者阿里·曼德里重建并加固了得土安。安达卢西亚的穆斯林和犹太人在此定居，使这座城市成为摩洛哥的安达卢西亚文化中心。

en:
The Teutonic Order began as a German hospital brotherhood of the Third Crusade, reorganized as a military order around 1198. After Acre fell it turned to the Baltic, where the 1226 Golden Bull of Rimini charged it with conquering and converting Old Prussians. From the 1230s it built a monastic state around brick castles, and in 1237 absorbed the Livonian Brothers of the Sword, gaining a branch governing Livonia.

The 1308 to 1309 purchase of Pomerelia with Danzig pushed its frontier to the Vistula, Marienburg becoming its capital. In 1337, under Grand Master Dietrich von Altenburg, it was at its height. Lithuania's 1386 conversion ended its crusading purpose, and in 1410 a Polish-Lithuanian army shattered its forces at Grunwald.

The Thirteen Years' War of 1454 to 1466 ended with the Second Peace of Thorn: western Prussia passed to the Polish crown and the rest its fief. In 1525 Grand Master Albert secularized the remainder as the Lutheran Duchy of Prussia, the Livonian branch dissolving in 1561 to 1562.
zh:
条顿骑士团起源于第三次十字军东征中的德意志医护兄弟会，约1198年改组为军事修会。阿卡陷落后，它转向波罗的海，1226年的《里米尼金玺诏书》责成它征服并归化古普鲁士人。从1230年代起，它沿砖砌城堡建立起修道国家；1237年兼并宝剑骑士团，获得统治利沃尼亚的分支。

1308至1309年购得波美雷利亚和但泽后，边境推到维斯瓦河，马林堡成为其都城。1337年大团长迪特里希·冯·阿尔滕堡治下，骑士团正值鼎盛。1386年立陶宛皈依，使其圣战名义告终；1410年波兰—立陶宛联军在格林瓦尔德击溃其军队。

1454至1466年的十三年战争以《第二次托伦和约》告终，西普鲁士归入波兰，余下领土成为其封地。1525年，大团长阿尔布雷希特把残余领地世俗化为路德宗普鲁士公国，利沃尼亚分支于1561至1562年解散。

en:
Teypana was a Piro pueblo on the west bank of the Rio Grande near present-day Socorro, New Mexico. The Piros were a Tanoan-speaking Pueblo people, probably descended from the Mogollon and Ancestral Pueblo cultures, who irrigated the narrow green valley of the Rio Grande and lived in multi-storey adobe towns.

Teypana entered written history in 1598, when an advance party of Juan de Oñate's colonists, emerging half-starved from the desert, were given food and water there and named the place Socorro, Spanish for aid, a name later transferred to the neighbouring pueblo of Pilabó and then to the Spanish town.

In the seventeenth century disease and Apache raids emptied much of the Piro country, and by the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 the survivors were too few to join the rising; many accompanied the retreating Spaniards south to El Paso del Norte, and Teypana was never reoccupied.
zh:
泰帕纳是皮罗人的一座普韦布洛，坐落在格兰德河西岸，靠近今新墨西哥州索科罗。皮罗人是讲塔诺语的普韦布洛族群，一般认为是莫戈永文化和古普韦布洛人的后裔，他们引水灌溉格兰德河狭长的绿洲谷地，居住在多层土坯镇城中。

泰帕纳见于史载是在1598年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特的先遣队奄奄一息地走出沙漠，在此得到饮食接济，便将此地命名为索科罗（西班牙语意为救助），这个名字后来转用于邻镇皮拉博，又成为西班牙城镇的名称。

17世纪里，疫病和阿帕奇人的袭扰使皮罗地区人口凋零，到1680年普韦布洛起义时，幸存者已少得无力参与；许多人随败退的西班牙人南撤到埃尔帕索德尔诺特，泰帕纳再无人居住。

en: Tirafka, probably the same as Tiraqqa in the Arabic chronicles, was a trading town on the middle Niger between Timbuktu and Gao, in the Wangara country. In the tenth and eleventh centuries it was an unwalled market where caravans from Ghana and Tadmekka met, until Timbuktu overshadowed it in the thirteenth century.
zh: 提拉夫卡很可能就是阿拉伯史籍中的提腊卡，是尼日尔河中游、廷巴克图与加奥之间的一座商镇，地属万加拉人之地。10至11世纪，它是一座没有城墙的市场，加纳与塔得迈卡的商队在此交会，13世纪后其地位被廷巴克图取代。

en:
Tafilalt is an oasis region along the River Ziz on the Sahara's northern edge in south-eastern Morocco, whose chief town was Sijilmasa, northern terminus of the trans-Saharan caravan road. Sufrite Kharijites founded the town in the mid-eighth century under the Midrar dynasty, which broke with the Abbasids as early as 771 and grew rich on gold carried north from Ghana and the Sudan; Sudanese gold was minted into coin.

Its rulers changed with the Berber empires: the Almoravids took it in 1055, the Almohads in 1146, and the rising Marinids in 1255. In 1337 it was held by a Marinid prince as a vassal appanage of Fez, and Ibn Battuta paused there in 1352 before crossing the desert to the Mali Empire.

The medieval city never recovered from its last prince's fall and Marinid decline; by the early sixteenth century Leo Africanus found it abandoned among its walls, and although rebuilt under Sultan Moulay Ismail, Aït Atta tribesmen sacked it in 1818.
zh:
塔菲拉勒特是摩洛哥东南部撒哈拉北缘、沿济兹河展开的绿洲地区，主城锡吉勒马萨是撒哈拉商道的北方终点。8世纪中叶，苏夫里派哈瓦利吉人在米德拉尔王朝治下建城，771年就脱离阿拔斯哈里发独立，靠加纳和苏丹北运的黄金致富，苏丹黄金在城内铸成钱币。

随着柏柏尔诸帝国更迭，它的主人几经变换：穆拉比特王朝1055年取城，穆瓦希德王朝1146年继之，崛起的马林人1255年攻占。1337年，它由马林家族的一位王公作为非斯的附庸封地统治；1352年伊本·白图泰穿越沙漠前往马里帝国之前曾在此驻足。

中世纪旧城在末代王公覆灭和马林王朝衰乱后再未恢复，16世纪初莱奥·阿非利加努斯见到它时已是城墙环绕的弃城；后来虽在苏丹穆莱·伊斯梅尔治下重建，1818年遭艾特阿塔部落洗劫。

en:
The County of Toggenburg was the lordship of an imperial-noble family named after their castle Alt-Toggenburg near Kirchberg in St. Gallen. A baronial house is documented from 1044; around 1200 the Diethelms inherited neighbouring lordships and became counts in 1209. They founded towns such as Wil and religious houses such as Rüti Abbey, while a Count Frederick won fame as a minnesinger in the Manesse manuscript.

In 1337 Count Diethelm V held the county. His brother Frederick, a Zurich canon, married Kunigunde of Vaz and with her inherited the Vaz estates in Raetia, among them Davos, making the Toggenburgs a great house between the Swiss Confederation and the Habsburgs.

The male line ended in 1436 with Count Frederick VII's death at Feldkirch; the disputed partition, largely to the lords of Raron, triggered the Old Zurich War, and in 1443 confederate troops desecrated the family tombs in Rüti Abbey.
zh:
吐根堡伯国是帝国贵族世家的领地，得名于祖堡老吐根堡，在今瑞士圣加仑州基希贝格附近。该家族1044年已有男爵家世记载，1200年前后迪特黑尔姆们继承若干邻近领地，1209年起称伯爵。他们兴建维尔等城镇和吕蒂修道院，一位弗里德里希伯爵还以恋歌诗人载入《马内塞手抄本》。

1337年在位的是迪特黑尔姆五世伯爵。其弟弗里德里希本是苏黎世法政牧师，娶冯·瓦茨的库妮贡德，继承瓦茨家族在雷蒂亚的产业，包括达沃斯，吐根堡家族由此跻身瑞士邦联与哈布斯堡之间的大封建家族。

1436年末代伯爵弗里德里希七世卒于费尔德基希，男系断绝；遗产主要归拉龙领主，分配争议引发旧苏黎世战争，1443年邦联军队破坏了吕蒂修道院的家族陵墓。

en:
Tireragh, in Irish the land of the Uí Fiachrach by the River Moy, was a Gaelic territory on the Atlantic coast of northwest Connacht, now Tireragh barony in County Sligo. Its rulers were the O'Dowds, descended from the early kings of Connacht and once a notable maritime power ringed by castles.

They checked the Anglo-Norman advance into Connacht, and in 1354 Sen-Bhrian O'Dowd drove the Norman settlers out of Tireragh for a time. The clan's hereditary historians, the MacFirbises, compiled the Great Book of Lecan between 1397 and 1418, preserving the ritual of inaugurating each O'Dowd taoiseach.

By the late sixteenth century the O'Dowds were clients of the O'Connors of Sligo; they fought with Hugh Roe O'Donnell in the Nine Years' War, lost most of their lands after the defeat of 1603, and the Cromwellian reconquest ended the lordship.
zh:
蒂勒拉的爱尔兰语意为“莫伊河畔乌伊·菲阿赫拉赫人的土地”，是康诺特西北大西洋沿岸的盖尔人领地，相当于今斯莱戈郡的蒂勒拉男爵区。统治者奥多德家族的祖先是早期的康诺特国王，曾是颇有名声的海上力量，在领地周围广建城堡。

他们抵挡住盎格鲁-诺曼人对康诺特的推进，1354年森-布里安·奥多德还一度把诺曼定居者赶出蒂勒拉。家族的世袭史官麦克菲尔比西家族于1397至1418年间编成《莱肯大全》，记录历代奥多德首领的继位仪式。

到16世纪末，奥多德家族已沦为斯莱戈奥康纳家族的附庸；九年战争中他们随休·罗·奥唐奈作战，1603年战败后丧失大部分领地，克伦威尔征服后领主政权彻底终结。

en:
Tongren was a native longship office at the eastern gateway of Guizhou, in the Wuling mountains where the Jin River leaves the hills, at present-day Tongren. Under the Yuan it was established as a barbarian military-civil longship office, named after a cliff bearing bronze statues of Confucian, Laozi and the Buddha; early Hongwu-era documents replaced the character for man with that for benevolence, giving the name Tongren.

The office first answered to the Sinan Xuanwei Commission of the Tian clan. In 1413 the Ming set up Tongren Prefecture with its seat in the same walled town, leaving the native chiefs ruling alongside the prefect, and in 1438 it absorbed most of the dissolved Wuluo Prefecture.

In 1598 the Wanli court abolished the longship office and replaced it with Tongren County, an early gaitu guiliu on the Guizhou frontier.
zh:
铜仁是贵州东大门武陵山区的长官司，地处锦江出山处，其地在今铜仁。元代置蛮夷军民长官司，“铜人”得名于一处崖壁上的儒、释、道三教铜像，明初洪武年间把“人”改作“仁”，始称铜仁。

铜仁长官司最初隶属田氏思南宣慰司。1413年明朝设铜仁府，府治与长官司同城，土官与流官并存；1438年乌罗府废，其大部辖地并入铜仁府。

1598年万历朝廷废铜仁长官司，改置铜仁县，是贵州边疆较早的改土归流之一。

en:
The Togashi were a warrior family based in Kaga Province, with a residence at Nonoichi. Togashi Takaie became governor in 1335, and after a period of Shiba control the family regained the governorship in 1414.

In 1488 an uprising of Honganji followers and local warriors besieged Togashi Masachika at Takao Castle and destroyed him. The rebels installed Togashi Yasutaka as a nominal governor, but the family's power continued to decline.
zh:
富㭴氏是以加贺国为根据地的武家，在野野市设有宅邸。富㭴高家于1335年出任守护；经过斯波氏掌权的一段时期后，富㭴氏于1414年重新取得守护职。

1488年，本愿寺门徒与地方武士发动一揆，在高尾城围灭富㭴政亲。起事者拥立富㭴泰高为名义上的守护，但富㭴氏的势力继续衰落。

en:
Touggourt, whose Berber name means the gate, is an oasis town in the Oued Righ valley of the Algerian Sahara, held in Islamic times by Berber groups such as the Banu Ifran and the Righa, a branch of the Zenata confederation. Long a dependency of the governors of Biskra and then the Hafsid sultans of Tunis, it withheld tribute whenever central power weakened; the Hafsid sultan had to subdue the town twice, in 1449 and 1465.

In 1414 the Banu Djellab dynasty founded the Sultanate of Tuggurt and brought the neighbouring oases under its rule, growing rich by diverting pilgrim and trans-Saharan caravan traffic from Ouargla.

In 1552 Salah Raïs, beylerbey of Algiers, took the town with artillery, and the Banu Djellab became Algiers' tributaries. During the eighteenth century Touggourt passed in and out of the hands of Biskra's Arab chiefs while still owing tribute to Algiers.
zh:
图古尔特的柏柏尔语名称意为“门户”，是阿尔及利亚撒哈拉韦德里格河谷的绿洲城镇，伊斯兰时期由巴努伊夫伦等柏柏尔部族和泽纳塔联盟的支系里加人占据。它长期是比斯克拉统治者的属地，后来听命于突尼斯的哈夫斯王朝苏丹，每逢中央权力衰弱便拒绝纳贡，哈夫斯苏丹曾在1449年和1465年两度出兵将其征服。

1414年，贝尼杰拉卜王朝建立图古尔特苏丹国，把周围诸绿洲纳入统治，并通过把朝圣者与跨撒哈拉商队从瓦尔格拉吸引过来而致富。

1552年，阿尔及尔贝勒贝伊萨拉赫·赖斯以火炮攻陷该城，贝尼杰拉卜家族从此向阿尔及尔摄政国称臣纳贡。18世纪里，图古尔特几度落入比斯克拉阿拉伯酋长之手，同时仍向阿尔及尔纳贡。

en: The Tegüis were an Opatan group in Sonora, associated with towns including Opodepe, Terapa and Cucurpe. Opatan communities in the region included independent agricultural towns before Spanish missions were established in the seventeenth century.
zh: 特圭斯人是索诺拉的奥帕塔族群之一，与奥波德佩、特拉帕和库库尔佩等城镇有关。17世纪西班牙传教区建立之前，该地区的奥帕塔人拥有独立的农业城镇。

en:
Tangya was a Tujia tusi in the mountains of western Hubei, ruled by the Qin clan from their walled capital above the Tangya River. The house began in 1346, at the end of the Yuan, when its founder was named pacification commissioner, and went on to hold some six hundred square kilometres through sixteen generations, never moving its seat.

The capital was laid out in three nested wards, an outer city, an inner city and a palace compound, against the slope of Xuanwu Mountain.

Tangya survived the Ming-Qing transition as a hereditary native chiefdom, but in 1735 the Yongzheng court's gaitu guiliu campaign abolished the office along with the other tusi of western Hubei, and the city was abandoned to the hills.
zh:
唐崖是鄂西山地的土家族土司，由覃氏世袭统治，治所位于唐崖河畔的土司城。它始于1346年元朝末年，始祖受封安抚司，此后管辖约六百平方公里的土地，传位十六代，司城始终没有迁移。

这座城背靠玄武山，自外而内分为外城、内城和宫城三重。

唐崖在明清易代之后仍保持世袭土司地位，但到1735年，雍正朝推行改土归流，唐崖与鄂西其他土司一同被废除，司城也就此废弃于山野之间。

en:
Truhendingen was the county of a Swabian-Franconian noble family, documented in the early twelfth century as free lords and counts from 1264. They took their name from Altentrüdingen, near present-day Wassertrüdingen, and as advocates of Eichstätt Abbey they cleared forests along the Hahnenkamm ridge and secured them with castles.

Their rise came in 1248, when Frederick of Truhendingen inherited through his wife Margaret of Merania the Franconian lands of the extinct counts of Andechs-Meranien, including the Giechburg and the market town of Scheßlitz, Bamberg fiefs. The bishops of Bamberg contested the inheritance, and the fiefs were repeatedly pledged before being sold to the bishopric in 1390.

A family member, Frederick of Truhendingen, was prince-bishop of Bamberg from 1363 to 1366. After 1390 the counts served other lords, and the dynasty died out at the end of the fifteenth century.
zh:
特鲁亨丁根是施瓦本-法兰克尼亚贵族家族的伯爵领，该家族12世纪初已见诸记载，本为自由贵族，1264年起称伯爵。其名得自阿尔滕特吕丁根（在今瓦瑟特吕丁根附近）。作为艾希施泰特修道院的守护，他们垦殖哈嫩卡姆山脊一带的林地，并以城堡固守。

家族的崛起在1248年：特鲁亨丁根的腓特烈凭借妻子梅拉尼亚的玛格丽特，继承绝嗣的安德克斯-梅拉尼亚伯爵家族在法兰克尼亚的领地，包括班贝格采邑吉希堡和集镇谢斯利茨。班贝格主教对遗产提出争夺，采邑几经质押，最终于1390年被卖给主教区。

家族成员腓特烈于1363至1366年任班贝格采邑主教。1390年之后，伯爵们转而为其他领主效力，家族于15世纪末绝嗣。

en: The Kingdom of Thessalonica was a Crusader state in northern Greece, founded by Boniface of Montferrat after the Fourth Crusade in 1204. Its capital Thessalonica fell to Theodore Komnenos Doukas of Epirus in 1224, ending the kingdom.
zh: 帖撒罗尼迦王国是希腊北部的十字军国家，由蒙费拉托的博尼法斯在1204年第四次十字军东征后建立。1224年，伊庇鲁斯的狄奥多尔·科穆宁·杜卡斯攻占首都帖撒罗尼迦，王国随之灭亡。

en: The Tahami were Indigenous communities in eastern Antioquia, in present-day Colombia, between the Magdalena and the Porce and Nechí rivers. Their clans and tribes were led by chiefs and joined together for common defense. Spanish incursions in the later 16th century brought conquest and settlement to Tahami territory as Europeans sought gold and river routes.
zh: 塔哈米是今哥伦比亚安蒂奥基亚东部的原住民社群，居住在马格达莱纳河与波尔塞河、内奇河之间。各氏族和部落由酋长统领，也会联合起来共同防御。16世纪后半叶，欧洲人为寻找黄金和河道进入塔哈米地区，带来了征服和殖民定居。

en:
Thomond, meaning North Munster, was the Gaelic kingdom of the Dál gCais in the lower Shannon region, corresponding chiefly to present-day County Clare, seated at Ennis and the great castle of Bunratty. Its kings, the Ó Briain, traced their line to Brian Boru, the High King of Ireland killed at Clontarf in 1014. The kingdom was formed in 1118, when Munster was partitioned between O'Briens of the north and the Mac Cárthaigh of the south.

Anglo-Norman colonists, above all the de Clare family at Bunratty, pressed hard, but in 1318 the O'Briens and their allies killed Richard de Clare at the Battle of Dysert O'Dea and restored Thomond to full independence.

It lasted until the Tudor reconquest: Murrough O'Brien surrendered his kingship and in 1543 accepted the English titles Earl of Thomond and Baron Inchiquin under the surrender and regrant policy.
zh:
托蒙德意为北芒斯特，是达尔·凯斯人在香农河下游建立的盖尔王国，疆域大体相当于今克莱尔郡，以恩尼斯和雄伟的本拉提城堡为统治中心。其国王奥布赖恩家族把世系追溯到1014年在克朗塔夫战死的爱尔兰至高王布莱恩·博鲁。王国形成于1118年，当时芒斯特被一分为二，北部归奥布赖恩家族，南部归麦卡锡家族。

盎格鲁-诺曼殖民者，尤其是盘踞本拉提的德·克莱尔家族，曾步步紧逼；1318年，奥布赖恩家族及其盟友在迪塞特奥代战役中击杀理查德·德·克莱尔，使托蒙德恢复完全独立。

王国延续到都铎再征服时期：默罗·奥布赖恩交出本土王位，于1543年依“投降再封”政策接受托蒙德伯爵和英奇昆男爵的英格兰封爵。

en:
Thopia was the domain of a powerful late-medieval Albanian feudal family, seated at Krujë in central Albania between the Mati and Shkumbin rivers. The family first appears in an Angevin document of 1274, serving the Catholic Angevin kings of Albania; Tanusio Thopia is recorded as Count of Mat in 1338, when the family held its lands as an Angevin vassal, having converted from Orthodoxy to Catholicism.

Karl Thopia brought the family's rise, ruling independent domains from 1358, seizing Durrës from the Angevins in 1368 and, with Ottoman aid, crushing Balša II at the Battle of Savra in 1385. When Karl died in 1388 his son Gjergj inherited Durrës but surrendered it to Venice in 1392.

A later Tanush Thopia served as a commander under Skanderbeg and held the Krujë garrison during the second Ottoman siege of the fortress in 1466.
zh:
托皮亚是中世纪晚期阿尔巴尼亚一个有权势的封建家族的领地，以阿尔巴尼亚中部、马蒂河与什昆宾河之间的克鲁亚为中心。该家族最早见于1274年的安茹文书，臣事天主教的安茹阿尔巴尼亚王国；塔努西奥·托皮亚1338年受封马蒂伯爵，当时家族已从东正教改宗天主教，作为安茹王权的附庸领有其地。

家族的鼎盛由卡尔·托皮亚缔造：他从1358年起统治独立领地，1368年从安茹家族手中夺取都拉斯，1385年又借奥斯曼援军在萨夫拉之战击溃巴尔沙二世。卡尔于1388年去世后，其子乔治继承都拉斯，却在1392年将城献给威尼斯共和国。

后世的塔努什·托皮亚投身斯坎德培麾下担任将领，在1466年奥斯曼军队第二次围攻克鲁亚时镇守这座要塞。

en:
Thessaly was a region of central Greece ruled by the Doukas family until John II died without an heir in 1318. His lands fragmented, with local magnates taking the northwest and the Catalans occupying the south around Neopatras.

By 1348 the Serbian ruler Stephen Dušan had conquered Thessaly and Epirus. After Dušan died in 1355, his half-brother Simeon Uroš proclaimed himself emperor and ruled a separate state centered on Thessaly and Epirus until his death in 1370.
zh:
色萨利位于希腊中部，曾由杜卡斯家族统治，直到约翰二世于1318年去世且没有留下继承人。他的领地随之分裂，地方贵族控制西北部，加泰罗尼亚人则占领了南部尼奥帕特拉斯一带。

到1348年，塞尔维亚统治者斯特凡·杜尚已征服色萨利和伊庇鲁斯。杜尚于1355年去世后，他的异母弟西蒙·乌罗什自称皇帝，统治以色萨利和伊庇鲁斯为中心的独立政权，直至1370年去世。

en:
Tehuantepec, on the Pacific side of the isthmus that bears its name, was already a key node on the trade route linking central Mexico with Central America when the Zapotec kingdom of Zaachila expanded into the area under King Cosijoeza from 1487, displacing the native Huave and turning the town into a second Zapotec capital.

Its great fortified city of Guiengola, ringed with walls, trenches and temples, withstood a seven-month siege by the Aztec ruler Ahuitzotl in the 1490s, and the war ended when Cosijoeza married Ahuitzotl's daughter.

Their son Cosijopii, the last Zapotec sovereign, allied with Pedro de Alvarado, was baptized Juan Cortes Sicasibi and made the isthmus the centre of his domains, building the Dominican convent of Santo Domingo between 1543 and 1555. Under Spanish rule Tehuantepec remained the principal city of the Isthmus Zapotecs.
zh:
特万特佩克位于同名地峡的太平洋一侧，本是连接墨西哥中部与中美洲贸易路线上的要冲。1487年起，萨波特克人的扎奇拉王国在君主科西霍埃萨率领下扩张到这一带，排挤土著瓦维人，把该城变成萨波特克人的第二都城。

其坚固山城吉恩戈拉城墙、壕沟与神庙环绕，在15世纪90年代顶住阿兹特克君主阿维措特尔长达七个月的围攻，战争最终以科西霍埃萨迎娶阿维措特尔之女收场。

他们的儿子科西霍皮是末代萨波特克君主，与佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多结盟，受洗取名胡安·科尔特斯·西卡西比，以地峡为统治中心，于1543至1555年修建圣多明各修道院。西班牙统治下，特万特佩克始终是地峡萨波特克人的首要城市。

en:
Thuringia, the basin south of the Harz between the Saale and Werra, was an early medieval stem duchy until absorbed into Saxony in 908. From the twelfth century it re-emerged as the Landgraviate of Thuringia, built up by Louis the Springer, whose Wartburg became his Ludovingian heirs' seat. Under the Ludovingians it became a centre of court culture, and Saint Elizabeth of Hungary married Landgrave Louis IV in 1221.

When the last Ludovingian, Henry Raspe, died in 1247, the Thuringian Succession War ended in 1264 with Henry III of Meissen taking the landgraviate, while Hesse split off. Thuringia remained a Wettin title, held in 1337 by Frederick II of Meissen in union.

In 1521 Martin Luther found refuge at the Wartburg, where he translated the New Testament into German, and Thuringia became a heartland of the Reformation.
zh:
图林根位于哈茨山以南、萨勒河与韦拉河之间的盆地，本是中世纪早期的部落公国，908年被并入萨克森。12世纪起它以领地伯爵领的面貌重新出现，由路易·德·施普林格经营，他修建的瓦尔特堡成为路德温家族后裔的居所。路德温家族治下，图林根成为德意志宫廷文化的中心，1221年匈牙利的圣伊丽莎白嫁给伯爵路易四世。

末代路德温领主亨利·拉斯佩1247年去世后爆发图林根继承战争，1264年迈森藩侯、韦廷家的亨利三世取得领地伯爵领，黑森的领地则分裂出去另立黑森。此后图林根成为韦廷家族的头衔，1337年由迈森藩侯腓特烈二世以共主方式领有。

1521年马丁·路德在瓦尔特堡避难，在此把《新约》译成德语，图林根由此成为宗教改革的核心地区。

en:
Tibet in 1337 was the theocratic regime of the Sakya lamas, named for the monastery founded in 1073 by Khon Konchog Gyalpo and ruled by his Khon family. Mongol armies entered Tibet in 1240 and 1244, and Sakya Pandita's negotiations made his school the intermediary of Mongol rule; his nephew Phagpa became the religious teacher of Kublai Khan, who incorporated Tibet into his Yuan dynasty around 1270 under a priest-patron order.

The Sakya lama, as Imperial Preceptor, stood at the head of Tibet, while a dpon-chen handled temporal affairs. The ruler in 1337 was Namkha Lekpa Gyaltsen, born in 1305 and guoshi from 1325, whose dethronement in 1341 opened the final collapse of Sakya power.

As Yuan authority faded, the Phagmodru lord Changchub Gyaltsen overran the Sakya estates between 1354 and 1358, founding an autonomous Kagyu kingdom at Nêdong. The Phagmodrupa gave way to Tsangpa kings and then, in 1642, to the Fifth Dalai Lama's Ganden Phodrang, installed by the Khoshut Güshi Khan.
zh:
1337年的吐蕃是萨迦喇嘛主持的神权政权，名称源于1073年昆·贡却杰布创建的萨迦寺，法座由昆氏家族世代承袭。蒙古军队曾于1240年和1244年进入吐蕃，萨迦班智达通过谈判使萨迦派成为蒙古统治的中介；其侄八思巴成为忽必烈的宗教导师，约1270年起吐蕃被纳入元朝，结成施主与上师相依的政教关系。

萨迦喇嘛受封帝师，位列国家之首，日常政务由本钦处理。1337年在位的是生于1305年、1325年受封国师的囊卡来巴，他于1341年被废，萨迦霸权随之走向终结。

随着元朝衰落，帕木竹巴的领主绛曲坚赞在1354年至1358年间攻占萨迦诸领地，在乃东建立噶举派自治王国。帕木竹巴之后让位于藏巴汗，最终在1642年被和硕特固始汗扶植的五世达赖喇嘛甘丹颇章政权取代。

en:
Tidore was a clove-growing kingdom on the island of the same name, one of the four Maluku kingdoms and persistent rival of neighbouring Ternate. Local tradition dates its first king Sahjati to 1081, though that date is uncorroborated. In 1337 the old kolano order still held, and Islam became state religion only under its ninth ruler Jamaluddin, in the late fifteenth century.

It built a loose suzerainty over the Raja Ampat islands and western Papua while holding southern Halmahera. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries its sultans countered Ternate and the Dutch by allying with Spain, which kept forts on Tidore until 1663; the VOC contract of 1667 still left the kingdom among the most independent Moluccan kingdoms.

The 1780 contract reduced it to vassalage, whereupon Prince Nuku led a long anti-Dutch revolt, seizing Tidore in 1797 with British help and reviving fallen Jailolo; the Dutch returned after his 1805 death.
zh:
蒂多雷是同名岛屿上的丁香王国，为摩鹿加四大王国之一，也是邻国特尔纳特的长期对手。当地传首任国王萨哈贾蒂即位于1081年，唯此年代并无旁证。1337年古老的科拉诺秩序仍在，伊斯兰教迟至15世纪后期第九代君主贾马鲁丁在位时才成为国教。

蒂多雷在拉贾·安帕特群岛和西巴布亚建立松散的宗主权，并控制哈马黑拉岛南部。16至17世纪，历代苏丹与西班牙结盟抗衡特尔纳特和荷兰，西班牙人在岛上保有堡垒至1663年；1667年与荷兰东印度公司的合约仍使它位列摩鹿加最独立的王国之一。

1780年的合约将其降为附庸，王子努库率众长期反荷起义，1797年在英国帮助下攻占蒂多雷，恢复已亡的贾伊洛洛；1805年他去世后荷兰恢复统治。

en:
The Timurid Empire was founded by Timur, a ruler of the Barlas tribe who gained control of Transoxiana in 1370 and made Samarkand his capital. His campaigns extended his power across Iran and beyond, reaching Delhi and defeating the Ottoman sultan at Ankara in 1402.

After Timur’s death in 1405, his descendants contested the empire. Under Shahrukh and his son Ulugh Beg, Herat and Samarkand became centers of scholarship and art. The Uzbeks under Shaybani Khan took the remaining major Timurid cities by 1507.

The Timurid prince Babur, driven from Central Asia, established himself at Kabul and conquered the Delhi Sultanate in 1526, founding the Mughal Empire.
zh:
帖木儿帝国由巴鲁剌思部的帖木儿建立。他于1370年控制河中地区，以撒马尔罕为都，随后征服伊朗等地，远征德里，并于1402年在安卡拉击败奥斯曼苏丹。

帖木儿于1405年去世后，他的后裔争夺帝国。沙哈鲁及其子兀鲁伯统治时期，赫拉特和撒马尔罕成为学术与艺术中心；到1507年，昔班尼汗率领的乌兹别克人夺取了帖木儿诸王剩余的主要城市。

帖木儿后裔巴布尔被逐出中亚后，在喀布尔立足，1526年征服德里苏丹国，建立了莫卧儿帝国。

en:
The Tionontate, known to the French as the Petun, were an Iroquoian confederacy south of Georgian Bay in present-day Ontario. Closely related to the Wendat, they lived in eight or nine villages in the early seventeenth century. Epidemics struck between 1634 and 1640, followed by Haudenosaunee attacks during the Beaver Wars.

Surviving Tionontate joined Wendat and Wenro refugees, eventually forming the Wyandot people. They settled at Michilimackinac in 1671 and moved to the Detroit area in 1701.
zh:
提奥农塔特是今安大略省乔治亚湾以南的易洛魁语族联盟，法国人称他们为佩顿人。他们与温达特人关系密切，17世纪初生活在八九个村落中。1634—1640年间，流行病袭击了他们；此后海狸战争中的豪德诺索尼人又发动了进攻。

幸存的提奥农塔特人与温达特及温罗难民汇合，最终形成了怀安多特人。他们于1671年定居密西利麦基纳克，1701年迁往底特律地区。

en:
Tyrol grew around Tyrol Castle, guarding the Brenner and Reschen passes. Its counts, first documented about 1140 as bailiffs of the Bishopric of Trent, built a lordship overshadowing their episcopal overlords.

When Duke Henry of Carinthia died in 1335, his daughter Margaret, nicknamed Maultasch, held Tyrol against claimants. In 1341 she shut her first husband John Henry of Luxembourg out of Tyrol Castle, and in 1342 married Louis V of Brandenburg without a divorce, earning excommunication from the pope. After Louis died in 1361 and her son Meinhard III in 1363, she bequeathed Tyrol to Rudolf IV of Habsburg, confirmed by the 1369 Peace of Schärding.

Frederick IV made Innsbruck capital in 1420. The 1805 Peace of Pressburg gave Tyrol to Bavaria; Andreas Hofer's 1809 rising failed, and he was executed at Mantua in 1810, before the 1814 Congress of Vienna returned it to Austria.
zh:
蒂罗尔伯国兴起于蒂罗尔城堡，扼守布伦纳山口和雷申山口。当地伯爵约1140年起见诸记载，身为特伦托主教区的监护官，逐步建立起压倒教会领主的统治。

1335年克恩滕公爵亨利去世后，女儿玛格丽特（绰号“毛尔塔施”）击退觊觎者保住蒂罗尔。1341年她把第一任丈夫卢森堡的约翰·海因里希拒于蒂罗尔城堡之外，1342年未离婚即改嫁勃兰登堡的路易五世，因此被教宗开除教籍。路易1361年去世、儿子迈因哈德三世1363年又亡，玛格丽特遂把蒂罗尔遗赠给哈布斯堡公爵鲁道夫四世，1369年的《谢尔丁和约》确认这一移交。

弗里德里希四世于1420年将首府迁至因斯布鲁克。1805年《普雷斯堡和约》把蒂罗尔割让巴伐利亚；安德烈亚斯·霍弗1809年的起义失败，1810年在曼图亚被处死，1814年维也纳会议使蒂罗尔重归奥地利。

en:
Tanjungpura was a Malay kingdom on the south-western coast of Borneo, facing the Java Sea, its coast stretching from Tanjung Dato to Tanjung Sambar. Tradition counts it one of Borneo's three great mandalas, with Brunei and Banjarmasin; Singhasari knew it as Bakulapura, from the tanjung tree that later yielded its name.

The Nagarakretagama of 1365 lists it among the Bornean states brought into Majapahit's orbit by Gajah Mada and Hayam Wuruk, and a Javanese princess ruled as Bhre Tanjungpura from 1429 to 1464. Around 1400 Raja Baparung founded the Sukadana line, and after Karang Tunjung took the throne in 1431 the court moved its capital to Sukadana under Panembahan Karang Tanjung (1487 to 1504), the kingdom then called Sukadana.

Islam reached the court in 1550 under Panembahan Giri Kesuma, after which Queen Ratu Sukadana ruled; the Dutch first arrived at Sukadana in 1604, Mataram attacking the region in 1622. The Sukadana line was reorganized as the Matan Sultanate in 1665.
zh:
丹戎武罗是婆罗洲西南海岸、面向爪哇海的马来人王国，海岸从丹戎拿督延伸至丹戎桑巴。传说它与文莱、马辰并称婆罗洲三大势力圈；信诃沙里时期称巴库拉普拉，得名于丹戎树，后来演变为丹戎武罗。

1365年的《爪哇史颂》把它列为加查·马达和哈奄·武禄纳入满者伯夷势力范围的婆罗洲邦国之一，一位爪哇公主于1429至1464年以“丹戎武罗亲王”之衔统治该地。约1400年，拉惹·巴帕隆开创巫律述世系；1431年卡朗·通珠即位后，宫廷在1487至1504年在位的帕南巴汉·卡朗·丹戎治下迁都巫律述，王国此后改称巫律述。

1550年，帕南巴汉·吉里·克苏马皈依伊斯兰教，其后由女王巫律述王后执政；荷兰人于1604年初抵巫律述，马打兰又在1622年来攻。巫律述世系最终于1665年改组为马坦苏丹国。

en:
The Takeda were a samurai family based in Kai Province, descended from the Minamoto. Branches held the governorships of Kai, Aki and Wakasa before the Sengoku period.

Takeda Shingen took control of the family from his father and expanded from Kai. His campaigns against Uesugi Kenshin included the battles of Kawanakajima, beginning in 1553. After Shingen died in 1573, his son Katsuyori inherited the domain; the Takeda were destroyed in 1582.
zh:
武田氏是以甲斐国为根据地的武士家族，出自源氏。战国时代以前，武田氏的不同支系担任过甲斐、安艺和若狭的守护。

武田信玄从父亲手中掌握家督后，从甲斐向外扩张。他与上杉谦信交战，其中包括1553年开始的川中岛之战。信玄于1573年去世后，其子胜赖继承领国；武田氏于1582年灭亡。

en:
The Bateke were a Bantu people of central Africa, among whom the eastern Teke formed the Tio Kingdom around the fourteenth century. Its capital lay on the Mbe plains, and Pool Malebo was its commercial centre.

In 1491 the king of Kongo sought Portuguese help against the Tio, and warfare continued in the sixteenth century. During the eighteenth century, sacred boxes called nkobi strengthened regional lords; in the early nineteenth century King Opontaba seized them, provoking a conflict with northern lords.
zh:
巴太凯是中非的班图人，其中东部太凯人约在14世纪建立了蒂奥王国。王国的都城位于姆贝平原，商业中心则在马莱博湖。

1491年，刚果国王请求葡萄牙人协助对抗蒂奥，两国在16世纪继续交战。18世纪，称作恩科比的圣盒增强了地方领主的权力；19世纪初，国王奥蓬塔巴夺取这些圣盒，引发了与北方领主的冲突。

en:
The Toki were a samurai family descended from the Minamoto and based in Mino Province, where they served as governors. Toki Yasuyuki also governed Owari and Ise; when Shōgun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu tried to take Owari, Yasuyuki resisted in a war from 1389 to 1391.

Toki Yorinari built Ōkuwa Castle in Mino, but Saitō Dōsan drove him from the province in 1542. A later branch served Tokugawa Ieyasu, and its descendants ruled Numata in Kōzuke from 1742.
zh:
土岐氏是出自源氏的武士家族，以美浓国为根据地并担任当地守护。土岐康行还统辖尾张和伊势；将军足利义满试图夺取尾张时，康行于1389—1391年间举兵抵抗。

土岐赖艺在美浓修建大桑城，但于1542年被斋藤道三逐出该国。土岐氏的另一支后来侍奉德川家康，其后代从1742年起统治上野国的沼田藩。

en:
The Takashima were a branch of the Sasaki family from Takashima district in western Ōmi. Their founder Takashima Takanobu built Shimizuyama Castle in 1235, and his descendants held it for generations.

The family served the Ashikaga shoguns during the Muromachi period and later came under the Rokkaku alongside other Takashima branches. Shimizuyama Castle is thought to have fallen during Oda Nobunaga's campaign in Takashima in 1572; the family declined with the fall of the Rokkaku.
zh:
高岛氏是近江西部高岛郡的佐佐木氏支族。始祖高岛高信于1235年修建清水山城，子孙世代据守此城。

高岛氏在室町时代效力于足利将军家，后来与其他高岛支族一起归属六角氏。清水山城据认为在1572年织田信长进攻高岛郡时陷落；高岛氏随六角氏灭亡而衰落。

en:
The Tokunō were a branch of the Kōno clan based at Tokunō estate in Kuwamura district, Iyo Province. In 1333 Tokunō Michitsuna joined other Kōno kinsmen in rising for Emperor Go-Daigo and helped take Fuchū Castle from the shogunate's governor.

Michitsuna later fought for the Southern Court under Nitta Yoshisada. Besieged at Kanegasaki Castle in Echizen, he died there in 1337.
zh:
得能氏是河野氏的一支，本贯在伊予国桑村郡得能庄。1333年得能通纲与河野一族的其他成员响应后醍醐天皇，攻下幕府守护的府中城。

此后通纲追随新田义贞为南朝作战，在越前金崎城遭到围攻，于1337年战死。

en:
The Takō were a branch of the Utsunomiya family who held Takō Castle in Shimotsuke Province. Takō Munetomo established the family and built the castle in 1248; its position guarded the southern approaches to Utsunomiya Castle.

During the sixteenth century Takō Nagatomo and his descendants defended their castle against the Uesugi and Hōjō. The family lost its position when its Utsunomiya overlords were dispossessed in 1597; some members later served the Matsudaira of Imabari.
zh:
多功氏是宇都宫氏的分支，领有下野国的多功城。多功宗朝于1248年创立家族并筑城，其位置扼守宇都宫城的南方门户。

16世纪，多功长朝及其后裔守城抵御上杉氏和北条氏。1597年主家宇都宫氏被剥夺领地后，多功氏也失去了地位；部分族人后来仕于今治的松平氏。

en:
Takrur was the first great Muslim kingdom of the Senegal valley, rooted around Futa Toro. A state perhaps existed there from the first Christian centuries, ruled first by Dya'ogo blacksmith-kings, then by the Manna dynasty after Wagadu Soninke conquered it in the ninth or tenth century. Arab writers first mention it in the ninth century; in 1035 King War Jabi introduced Sharia law, his court the Sahel's first to adopt Islamic orthodoxy.

His son Lebi allied with the Almoravids, and Takruri cavalry are said to have fought at Sagrajas in 1086. On routes from the Awlil salt coast to the Bambuk goldfields, Takrur grew rich on salt, gold and cotton cloth. Thirteenth-century crisis let Mali conquer Takrur around 1286 and rule through farba governors; in 1337 it was a Malian vassal.

As Mali weakened, Jolof overran it in the fifteenth century, and in 1521 the Fulbe Koli Tengella founded the Denanke dynasty, holding it until the Fouta Revolution of 1776.
zh:
塔克鲁尔是塞内加尔河流域第一个强盛的穆斯林王国，根基在富塔托洛一带的河中游。早在公元后的最初几个世纪，这里可能已有国家，最初由迪亚奥戈的铁匠王统治；9或10世纪，来自瓦加杜的索宁克氏族征服该地，建立曼纳王朝。阿拉伯作家9世纪首次提到它，1035年国王瓦尔·贾比颁行沙里亚法，使他的朝廷成为萨赫勒第一个接受正统伊斯兰教的政权。

其子莱比与穆拉比特王朝结盟，据说塔克鲁尔骑兵参加了1086年的萨拉卡战役。靠着奥利勒盐海岸至邦布金矿的商路，塔克鲁尔以食盐、黄金和棉布致富。13世纪的内乱使马里约1286年征服塔克鲁尔，派法尔巴总督治理，1337年时它是马里的附庸。

马里衰落后，卓洛夫于15世纪吞并该地；1521年，富尔贝人科利·滕盖拉建立德南克王朝，统治河谷直到1776年的富塔革命。

en:
The Taneks, or Biloxi, were a Siouan-speaking people living near the Gulf of Mexico and the Pascagoula River when they encountered the French in 1699. An epidemic had recently devastated their villages, and the survivors gradually moved west from Mississippi.

By the mid-eighteenth century the Biloxi had settled in central Louisiana. In 1806 their villages stood on the Red River and Lake Avoyelles, and some families later moved to Texas.
zh:
塔内克斯又称比洛克西人，是讲苏语的民族。1699年他们与法国人相遇时，居住在墨西哥湾和帕斯卡古拉河附近；此前一场疫病重创了他们的村落，幸存者逐渐从密西西比向西迁徙。

到18世纪中叶，比洛克西人已在路易斯安那中部定居。1806年，他们在红河和阿沃耶尔湖畔建有村落，后来一些家庭又迁往得克萨斯。

en:
The Kingdom of Thekkumkur, meaning the southern regency, covered the country between the Meenachil and Pamba rivers. It was formed in 1103, when the old chiefdom of Vempolinad split after the collapse of the Chera kingdom, its northern half becoming Vadakkumkur.

The Ilaya Raja of Vempolinad founded the Edathil dynasty, whose kings all bore the name Manikandan. The first capital was at Vennimala and Manikandapuram, where King Iravi Manikandan built the Krishna temple in 1152, and a ruler around 1337 appears in the Tiruvalla copper plates. Early in the fifteenth century the court moved to Changanassery and later to Thaliyanthanapuram.

The last king, Aditya Varman Manikandan, joined Ambalapuzha and Vadakkumkur against Travancore. His capital fell to Marthanda Varma's general Ramayyan Dalawa, he fled to the Zamorin of Kozhikode, and Thekkumkur was annexed to Travancore in 1753.
zh:
特昆库尔意为南方摄政之地，据有米纳奇尔河与潘巴河之间的国土。1103年哲罗王国崩溃后，旧邦温波林纳德一分为二，北部成为瓦达昆库尔。

温波林的小王子开创埃达蒂尔王朝，历代君主都以摩尼建多为名。初都文尼马拉和马尼坎达普兰，国王伊拉维·摩尼建多于1152年在那里修建克里希纳神庙，1337年前后的君主见于蒂鲁瓦拉铜盘铭文。15世纪初朝廷迁至昌加纳塞里，后来又移驻塔利扬塔纳普兰。

末代国王阿迪蒂亚·瓦尔马·摩尼建多联合安巴拉普扎和瓦达昆库尔对抗特拉凡哥尔。都城被马尔坦达·瓦尔马的名将拉马扬·达拉瓦攻陷，他逃往科泽科德投奔扎莫林，特昆库尔于1753年并入特拉凡哥尔。

en:
Tixtla was a hill town of central Guerrero whose Nahuatl name means place of maize dough, from the word textli. It was one of the towns of Coixcatlalpan, the multiethnic Coixca country where Nahuatl speakers lived alongside Tlapanec and Chontal communities from about 1250 onward.

The Coixca towns long resisted Aztec expansion before accepting the domination of Tenochtitlan, and the region passed to the Spanish conquerors in the early 1520s, when the nearby garrison of Chilapa fell in 1522.
zh:
蒂斯特拉是格雷罗中部的山城，纳瓦特尔语名字源自“特斯特利”一词，意为玉米面团之地。它是科伊什卡特尔潘的城镇之一；科伊什卡特尔潘是多族杂处的科伊克斯卡人地区，约1250年起，讲纳瓦特尔语的居民便与特拉帕内克、琼塔尔人的聚落比邻而居。

科伊克斯卡诸镇长期抵抗阿兹特克扩张，最终才接受特诺奇蒂特兰的统治；16世纪20年代初，随着附近的奇拉帕驻军于1522年陷落，这一地区落入西班牙征服者之手。

en:
Tlemcen was the kingdom of the Zayyanids, a Zenata Berber dynasty ruling the central Maghreb from Tlemcen, Algeria. On the Almohads' collapse, Yaghmurasen Ibn Zyan made it independent around 1236, merging Agadir and Tagrart into a capital whose markets linked the coastal road with trans-Saharan caravans, gold arriving through Sijilmasa and Taghaza while Genoese merchants kept a funduk there.

An eight-year Marinid siege ended in 1307, and under Abu Tashufin I (1318 to 1337) Tlemcen had perhaps 40,000 inhabitants and its Tashfiniya Madrasa. In 1337 Abu Tashufin fell defending the city against Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan, and Tlemcen remained under Marinid occupation, with one interruption, until 1359. Abu Hammu II's long reign from 1359 to 1389 brought a revival, but in the fifteenth century the kingdom became an intermittent vassal of the Hafsids, Marinids and Aragon.

Spain took Oran in 1509 and campaigned against Tlemcen in 1543; by 1551 the Ottomans of Algiers held the city, the last Zayyanid sultan fleeing to Spanish Oran.
zh:
特莱姆森王国是宰扬王朝的国家，这个泽纳塔柏柏尔人王朝以阿尔及利亚的特莱姆森城为中心统治中马格里布。穆瓦希德王朝崩溃之际，亚格穆拉森·伊本·齐扬约1236年建国独立，把阿加迪尔和塔格拉尔特合并为新都；市场连接马格里布沿海大道与撒哈拉商队，黄金经锡吉勒马萨和塔加扎运来，热那亚商人还设有商馆。

马林人长达八年的围攻于1307年结束；在1318至1337年在位的阿布·塔舒芬一世治下，特莱姆森约有四万居民，塔什菲尼娅宗教学校闻名遐迩。1337年，阿布·塔舒芬在抵御马林苏丹阿布·哈桑的攻城战中阵亡，特莱姆森除一次短暂中断外被马林人占领到1359年。1359至1389年阿布·哈穆二世的长期统治带来中兴，但15世纪后，日益缩小的王国断断续续沦为哈夫斯王朝、马林王朝和阿拉贡的附庸。

1509年西班牙夺取奥兰，1543年又进兵特莱姆森；到1551年，阿尔及尔的奥斯曼人占领该城，末代宰扬苏丹逃入西属奥兰。

en:
The Tlingit were Indigenous peoples of southeastern Alaska and the Alexander Archipelago, organized in matrilineal clans. Coastal groups controlled mountain passes and traded with communities in the Yukon interior.

In 1802 Tlingit warriors destroyed the Russian trading post on Baranof Island. Two years later, the Kiks.ádi clan fought Russian-American Company forces and the Russian navy at the Battle of Sitka, before leaving their fortified position.
zh:
特林吉特是阿拉斯加东南部和亚历山大群岛的原住民，以母系氏族组织社会。沿海各部控制通往山区的隘口，与育空内陆的群体进行贸易。

1802年特林吉特战士摧毁了巴拉诺夫岛上的俄国贸易站。两年后，基克斯阿迪氏族在锡特卡之战中与俄美公司军队和俄国海军交战，随后撤离了他们的设防据点。

en:
Tetellan, whose name survives in the village of Tetela del Río, was a Cuitlatec-speaking town of the Balsas river basin, the country the Nahuas called Cuitlatecapan. The Relaciones geográficas of 1579 name it with Ajuchitlán among places where Cuitlatec was still spoken.

In the late Postclassic these hill towns lay between the Purépecha and Aztec empires, which subdued most Cuitlatec communities. After the Spanish conquest, nearby mines opened at the end of the sixteenth century, and the district was for a time organized as the Jurisdiction of Tetela.
zh:
特特兰是巴尔萨斯河流域的奎特拉特克语城镇，纳瓦人把这片土地称为奎特拉特卡潘，它的名字保留在特特拉德里奥村。1579年的《地理关系》调查把它与阿胡奇特兰并列为仍通行奎特拉特克语的地方。

后古典期晚期，这些山城夹在普雷佩查帝国与阿兹特克帝国之间，两强征服了大部分奎特拉特克社群。西班牙征服后，16世纪末附近一带开出矿场，该辖区曾一度改称特特拉辖区。

en: Tulam was one of the small chiefdoms of medieval western Gilan, centred on the Caspian harbour of Bandar-e Anzali on the edge of the Talish country. Its ruler Rikabzen ambushed and killed the Ilkhanid general Kutlushah in 1307 during Öljaitü's Gilan campaign, fighting alongside the men of Rasht and Shaft, yet the Mongols won only nominal overlordship and Tulam stayed in local Gilaki hands.
zh: 图勒姆是中世纪西吉兰的小酋长国之一，以塔利什地区边缘、里海岸边的安扎利港为中心。1307年，其首领里卡布曾在完者都征讨吉兰的战役中，联合拉什特和沙夫特的人马伏击并击杀伊利汗国将领忽都鲁沙，但蒙古人只换来名义上的宗主权，图勒姆仍由吉兰本地统治者掌握。

en:
The Tallan were related peoples of the coastal plains of northwestern Peru, where they farmed and fished. Narihualá, south of Piura, was an important Tallan centre with a sanctuary dedicated to Walac.

The Chimú brought the Tallan under their rule, followed by the Inca around 1470. In 1532 Francisco Pizarro founded San Miguel de Nueva Castilla at the Tallan settlement of Tangarará.
zh:
塔阳是秘鲁西北部沿海平原上的一组亲缘族群，以农耕和捕鱼为生。皮乌拉以南的纳里瓦拉是塔阳人的重要中心，那里有一座供奉瓦拉克神的圣所。

奇穆人先将塔阳人纳入统治，印加人随后于约1470年征服了他们。1532年，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在塔阳人的坦加拉拉聚落建立新卡斯蒂利亚的圣米格尔城。

en:
Teloloapan, a Nahuatl name meaning round stone on the water, was a principal Chontal town in northern Guerrero; Chontal means foreigners in Nahuatl, and their language vanished without being properly recorded. Its hereditary ruler bore the title tletecutli, and the Relaciones geográficas note that one quarter still spoke an unknown tongue called Ixcuca in the sixteenth century.

The Aztec Empire conquered the Chontal country, probably under Moctezuma I, and Teloloapan joined Oztuma and other towns in revolting at Ahuitzotl's coronation in 1486. The reconquest killed or captured over forty-four thousand people by Aztec reckoning, and the old fortresses were rebuilt to guard the frontier against the Purépecha.

Nahua migrants then made the town largely Nahua by the contact period. It long remained strategic: Vicente Guerrero took it in 1818, and the Embrace of Acatempan, sealing independent Mexico, occurred in its municipality in 1821.
zh:
特洛洛瓦潘的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“水上圆石”，是格雷罗北部的琼塔尔重镇；琼塔尔在纳瓦特尔语中意为外乡人，其语言已消失，也没有完整记录。其世袭君主称特莱特库特利，《地理记述》载16世纪时城中仍有一个街区讲除此之外无人知晓的伊克斯库卡语。

琼塔尔约在蒙特祖马一世时期被阿兹特克征服。1486年阿维索特尔加冕时，特洛洛瓦潘与奥斯图马等城镇一同反叛；再征服据阿兹特克人估计造成四万四千多人被杀或被俘，旧要塞被改建为对普雷佩查人的边境防线。

此后纳瓦移民大量迁入，到接触时期这座城镇已基本纳瓦化。很久以后它仍是战略要地：维森特·格雷罗1818年克此城，1821年促成墨西哥独立的“阿卡特潘拥抱”亦在其辖下村镇发生。

en:
Tlapan was the principal city of the Tlapanec, or Me'phaa, people of the Guerrero mountains, and Tlapanec itself is Nahuatl for inhabitant of Tlapan. In the fourteenth century the region was ruled from the kingdom of Tlachinollan, attested in the Codex Azoyú and governed by Mixtec and Tlapanec-Nahua lineages. From 1349 it expanded across much of the Montaña, leaving conquered towns their own rulers as tribute-paying vassals, until it became the largest indigenous polity centred in Guerrero.

A first Mexica invasion struck under Tizoc, and in 1486 a joint campaign under Ahuitzotl, Nezahualpilli of Texcoco and Chimalpopoca of Tlacopan ended its independence.

Tlachinollan was renamed Tlapan, garrisoned, and made the capital of an Aztec tributary province, sending gold, garments and cacao vessels to Tenochtitlan. After the Spanish conquest Augustinian friars evangelised the town, which became colonial Tlapa.
zh:
特拉潘是格雷罗山区特拉帕内克人（自称梅法人）的首要城市，特拉帕内克在纳瓦特尔语中意为特拉潘居民。14世纪属特拉奇诺扬王国，《阿索尤手抄本》载，由米斯特克与特拉帕内克-纳瓦双系统治者共治。1349年起王国扩张到山地大区大部，被征服城镇保留自己的首领、纳贡称臣，王国成为有史以来以格雷罗为中心的最大原住民政权。

墨西加人在蒂索克在位时首次入侵，1486年阿维索特尔与特斯科科的内萨瓦尔皮利、特拉科潘的奇马尔波波卡联军终结其独立。

特拉奇诺扬改名特拉潘并驻军，成为阿兹特克贡赋省省会，向特诺奇蒂特兰输送黄金、衣装和可可容器。西班牙征服后奥古斯丁会在此传教，城镇成为殖民时期的特拉帕镇。

en:
Tlatlauquitepec was a town of the Sierra Norte de Puebla whose Nahuatl name means the hill that colors, after the forested Cerro Cabezon overlooking it. Totonacs first held the region, until Nahua groups overran it in the late twelfth century; it grew into a senorio whose lord collected tribute from surrounding villages every eighty days for the Mexica.

Under Moctezuma I or his Texcocan ally Nezahualcoyotl, it became an Aztec tributary province, sending cloth, warrior costumes and liquidambar resin to Tenochtitlan.

The lordship submitted to the Spanish in 1524 and was granted as an encomienda, and Franciscans from Tlaxcala founded the convent of Santa Maria de la Asuncion in 1531, one of the first waystation convents in the Americas; in 1535 it became a Spanish corregimiento.
zh:
特拉劳基特佩克是普埃布拉北部山区的城镇，纳瓦特尔语名称意为“染色之山”，得名于林木覆盖的卡韦松山。这一带最早为托托纳克人所有，12世纪末被纳瓦部族攻占；后来发展为领地，领主每八十天向周围村庄征赋，转交墨西卡人。

在蒙特苏马一世或其特斯科科盟友内萨瓦尔科约特尔手中，它成为阿兹特克的纳贡省，向特诺奇蒂特兰输送布匹、武士服饰和枫香脂。

1524年该领地向西班牙人投降并被封为监护领地，来自特拉斯卡拉的方济各会修士于1531年建起圣母升天修道院，这是美洲最早的中途修道院之一；1535年它成为西班牙人治理的行政区。

en:
Tlacotlalpan was a river port on the lower Papaloapan in Veracruz. Founded in the twelfth century, it belonged to the Totonac world, and by the fifteenth century it was head town of subject settlements including Atlizintla, later Alvarado.

The emperor Axayacatl subjugated Tlacotlalpan to the Aztec empire around 1475, campaigning against Tochpan, and gave it its Nahuatl name, between the waters, for the Papaloapan branches around it. In 1518 Pedro de Alvarado sailed up the river, the first Spanish contact in the region.

After the fall of Tenochtitlan, the town was granted in encomienda to Alonso Romero; a corregimiento was set up in 1541 and later became an alcaldia mayor. Early in the seventeenth century the viceroy tried to resettle its people at Cosamaloapan, but they resisted. Floods in 1714 and a great fire in 1788 repeatedly reshaped the town.
zh:
特拉科特拉尔潘是韦拉克鲁斯帕帕洛阿潘河下游的河港。12世纪建城，原属托托纳克人；15世纪成为诸从属聚落的首镇，包括后来改称阿尔瓦拉多的阿特利钦特拉。

阿萨亚卡特尔征讨托奇潘时，于1475年前后迫使特拉科特拉尔潘臣属阿兹特克，并赐纳瓦特尔语名众水之间，因帕帕洛阿潘河支流环绕而得名。1518年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多溯河而上，是西班牙人首次接触此地。

特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，此地被封为阿隆索·罗梅罗的监护征赋地；1541年设督办区，后改市长辖区。17世纪初总督欲将居民迁往科萨马洛阿潘，因印第安人抵制而罢。1714年洪水与1788年大火一再重塑这座城镇。

en:
Taliwang was a Sumbawan, or Samawa, coastal kingdom on the western shore of Sumbawa in the Lesser Sunda Islands, its centre at the port now called Taliwang. Its early rulers are remembered as vassals of the Javanese Majapahit Empire, and the dynasty later claimed descent from Banjarmasin princes in Borneo and married into the royal houses of Selaparang and Sumbawa.

In the early seventeenth century Taliwang lay under the overlordship of the Makassar kingdom of Gowa, whose elite troops crushed its rebellion in 1621.

Taliwang then took its place with Seran and Jereweh as one of three vassal states bound to the Sumbawa Sultanate. Its datu kept their court through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, their fortunes tied to the sultan's family.
zh:
塔利旺是小巽他群岛松巴哇岛西海岸的松巴哇（萨马瓦）滨海王国，中心在今名塔利旺的港口。早期君主被记为爪哇满者伯夷帝国的附庸，后来的王朝自称出自婆罗洲马辰的王公世系，并与沙拉巴朗、松巴哇的王室通婚。

17世纪初，塔利旺处在望加锡戈瓦王国的宗主权之下，1621年它反抗戈瓦的叛乱被戈瓦精兵镇压。

此后它与塞兰、杰雷韦并为三个附庸邦，臣属松巴哇苏丹国。达图在17、18世纪维持王廷，命运与松巴哇苏丹家族相连。

en:
Tlaxcallan, meaning the place of maize tortillas in Nahuatl, was a Nahua state in central Mexico's valley of Tlaxcala. The Tlaxcalteca settled there in the Late Postclassic after expulsion from the valley of Mexico, and their settlements grew into a confederation of four city-states, ruled by a council of nobles as a republic, not a king.

By the fifteenth century the confederation was entirely surrounded by the lands of the Aztec Triple Alliance, which waged periodic flower wars against it to take sacrificial captives and imposed a trade embargo, yet never conquered it.

When Cortes arrived in 1519 the Tlaxcalteca first fought the Spaniards and then became their most important native allies: thousands of warriors joined the 1521 siege of Tenochtitlan and later campaigns as far as Guatemala. In return Tlaxcala kept its lands and a privileged, largely self-governing status under Spanish rule.
zh:
特拉斯卡兰在纳瓦特尔语中意为玉米饼之地，是墨西哥中部特拉斯卡拉谷地的纳瓦人政权。特拉斯卡拉人在后古典时代晚期被逐出墨西哥谷地后东迁，其聚落发展成四个城邦组成的联盟，由贵族议事会共和治理，不立单一国王。

到15世纪，联盟已被阿兹特克三国同盟的领土完全包围；同盟周期性发动荣冠战争以掳获祭祀人牲，并实施贸易封锁，却始终未能征服它。

1519年科尔特斯到来后，特拉斯卡拉人先与西班牙人交战，随后成为其最重要的原住民盟友：数千战士参加1521年对特诺奇蒂特兰的围攻，又随西班牙人转战远至危地马拉。作为回报，特拉斯卡兰在西班牙统治下保住土地，享有特权和相当程度的自治。

en:
Tlapacoya, whose Nahuatl name means the place where washing is done, stood on the eastern shore of former Lake Chalco, at the foot of the Tlapacoya volcano. It was already ancient: a Preclassic regional centre of the Tlatilco culture, producing characteristic figurines between 1500 and 300 BCE and Olmec-style incised bowls, and it hosted the earliest known water cult in the Valley of Mexico before declining around 200 CE.

In the Late Postclassic Nahua groups, Chalca, Acolhua and Cuitlahuaca, resettled the shore and gave it its present name. The lake district was then drawn into Chalco-Mexica wars.

Moctezuma I conquered Chalco around 1465, and Pedro de Alvarado reached the area in 1519, after which the settlement was attached to the colonial district of Chalco.
zh:
特拉帕科亚的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“浣洗之地”，位于古查尔科湖东岸、特拉帕科亚火山脚下。这片聚落历史古老：前古典期它是特拉蒂尔科文化的区域中心，公元前1500年至前300年间出产特色陶俑和奥尔梅克风格刻纹陶盆，还拥有墨西哥谷地已知最早的水神崇拜，约公元200年衰落。

后古典期晚期，查尔卡人、阿科卢阿人和奎特拉瓦卡人等纳瓦部族重新定居湖岸，今地名即由他们所取。此后湖区卷入查尔卡与墨西卡之战。

蒙特苏马一世约于1465年征服查尔科；1519年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多抵达此地，殖民时期该聚落划归查尔科辖区。

en:
Tlalcozauhtitlan was a town of northeastern Guerrero, close to the ancient centre of Teopantecuanitlán in the Balsas basin, where Nahua, Chontal and Mixtec worlds met. A sixteenth-century report lists it with Iguala and other towns of the little-known Tuxtec tongue, and the district was bilingual in Chontal and Nahuatl, the language of its elite.

Moctezuma I subjugated it together with Tlachco in 1458, and under Aztec rule it became the head of a tribute province recorded on folio 10v of the Matrícula de Tributos.
zh:
特拉尔科萨乌蒂特兰是格雷罗东北边境的城镇，紧邻巴尔萨斯盆地的古代中心特奥潘特库阿尼特兰，地处纳瓦、琼塔尔与米斯特克世界交汇处。16世纪的一份报告把它与伊瓜拉等城镇并列为鲜为人知的图斯特克语城镇，当地兼通琼塔尔语和纳瓦语，纳瓦语是精英阶层的语言。

蒙特祖马一世于1458年将它与特拉奇科一并征服；阿兹特克统治时期，它成为一个贡税省的治所，《贡税册》第10页背面记有其名。

en:
Timbuktu, north of the Niger River, grew from a seasonal settlement into a Saharan trading city. Gold and salt enriched the city under Mali, while its scholars and book trade made Sankore a centre of Islamic learning.

Tuareg rulers took Timbuktu in the first half of the fifteenth century, before Sonni Ali incorporated it into Songhai in 1468. A Moroccan army defeated Songhai in 1591 and made the city its capital; the resulting Arma ruling class became virtually independent of Morocco after 1612.
zh:
廷巴克图位于尼日尔河以北，从季节性聚落发展为撒哈拉贸易城市。马里统治时期，黄金和食盐贸易使城市富裕，学者与书籍贸易则使桑科雷成为伊斯兰学术中心。

15世纪上半叶，图阿雷格人夺取廷巴克图；1468年，逊尼·阿里将其并入桑海。1591年摩洛哥军队击败桑海，以廷巴克图为首府；此后形成的阿尔马统治集团在1612年后事实上脱离摩洛哥独立。

en:
The Timucua were speakers of related dialects in northern Florida and southeastern Georgia, divided among numerous chiefdoms rather than a single state. In 1539 Hernando de Soto's expedition crossed their territory, seized village food stores and killed Timucua who resisted.

Disease and slave raids devastated the chiefdoms in the following centuries. When Britain took Florida in 1763, the few remaining Timucua speakers left with Spanish colonists and mission Indians for Cuba.
zh:
蒂穆夸人居住在佛罗里达北部和佐治亚东南部，说着彼此相近的方言，分属众多酋邦，并非一个统一国家。1539年埃尔南多·德索托的远征队穿过他们的领地，夺取村庄储粮，杀害了抵抗的蒂穆夸人。

此后几个世纪，疾病和奴隶掳掠重创了这些酋邦。1763年英国接管佛罗里达时，剩下的少数蒂穆夸语使用者随西班牙殖民者和传教区印第安人迁往古巴。

en:
The Tsuchimochi were local lords of northern Hyūga Province in Kyushu, with prominent branches at Agata and Takarabe. In 1336 members of the family fought for Ashikaga Takauji near Kyoto. The Takarabe branch declined after defeat by the Itō at Konamigawa in 1457.

The Agata branch held Matsuo Castle under Tsuchimochi Chikashige, who first submitted to the Ōtomo and later leaned towards the Shimazu. In 1578 Ōtomo Sōrin attacked Matsuo and destroyed the Agata line; other Tsuchimochi families survived as Shimazu retainers.
zh:
土持氏是九州日向国北部的地方领主，主要分支位于县和财部。1336年，家族成员在京都附近为足利尊氏作战。1457年，财部分支在小浪川败于伊东氏，此后衰落。

县土持氏的土持亲成以松尾城为据点，先臣属于大友氏，后来转向岛津氏。1578年大友宗麟进攻松尾城，灭亡了县土持氏；其他土持家族则作为岛津氏家臣延续下来。

en: The Temikaming were an Algonquin community around Lake Timiskaming on the Ottawa River. In 1720 French traders founded Fort Témiscamingue on the site of an earlier Algonquin encampment on the lake's eastern shore.
zh: 蒂米斯卡明人是渥太华河上蒂米斯卡明湖一带的阿尔冈昆群体。1720年，法国商人在湖东岸一处旧阿尔冈昆营地建立了蒂米斯卡明格堡。

en:
Tsimishia encompassed Tsimshian communities on the lower Skeena River and the coast of what is now British Columbia. They spent winters around Prince Rupert Harbour and Metlakatla, returning to the Skeena for the salmon season.

In 1834 the Hudson's Bay Company established Fort Simpson at Lax Kw'alaams on Gispaxlo'ots territory. Chiefs of nine Tsimshian tribes gathered nearby to trade, and the fort's first factor married a daughter of the Gispaxlo'ots chief Ligeex.
zh:
齐米夏涵盖今不列颠哥伦比亚的斯基纳河下游和沿海的钦西安人聚落。他们在鲁珀特王子港和梅特拉卡特拉附近过冬，到鲑鱼季节便返回斯基纳河。

1834年哈德逊湾公司在吉斯帕赫洛茨人的拉赫夸拉姆斯建立辛普森堡。九个钦西安部族的首领为贸易聚集在附近，贸易站的首任主管迎娶了吉斯帕赫洛茨首领利吉克斯的女儿。

en:
Tadmekka, whose ruins lie by Essouk village in the Adrar des Ifoghas, northeast of Timbuktu, was a great caravan town of the southern Sahara. Between the ninth and fifteenth centuries it was the entrepôt where caravans prepared for or recovered from the desert crossing, the last mart before the Sudan.

Ibn Hawqal mentioned it before 988, and al-Bakri in 1068 described a wealthy town of veiled Muslim Berbers, its name said to mean Mecca-like. Its traders kept ties with Ibadi cities such as Tahert until the Almoravids brought Maliki Sunnism around 1084.

In the fourteenth century it joined the Mali Empire's Saharan network under its mansa, but after Mali's mid-century succession crises eastern dependencies broke away, and a Malian army besieged it in vain in the 1370s or 1380s. As routes shifted to Timbuktu, it declined in the fifteenth century and was abandoned.
zh:
塔得迈卡遗址在廷巴克图东北、伊福拉斯山中埃苏克村旁，是撒哈拉南部大商镇之一。9至15世纪，它是商队准备或休整沙漠穿越的集散地，也是进入苏丹前最后的市场。

伊本·豪盖勒在988年之前已提到它，巴克里1068年记述其为富有城镇，居民为戴面纱的穆斯林柏柏尔人，据说城名意为“小麦加”。其商人与塔赫特等伊巴德派城市保持联系，直到约1084年穆拉比特王朝传入马立克派逊尼教义。

14世纪它并入马里帝国的撒哈拉贸易网络，尊曼萨为宗主；马里在世纪中期的继承危机后，东部属邦脱离，1370或1380年代马里军队围攻该城不克。随着商路改向廷巴克图，塔得迈卡15世纪衰落，终成废墟。

en: The Tamauliteco were an Indigenous group recorded southwest of the western Tamaulipa mountains in northeastern Mexico. In the eighteenth century the region formed part of the Spanish province of Nuevo Santander.
zh: 塔毛利特科人是墨西哥东北部西塔毛利帕山脉西南一带有记载的原住民族群。18世纪，这一地区属于西班牙的新桑坦德省。

en:
Tamna was the island kingdom of Jeju, off the southern tip of Korea. Legend traces its rulers to three divine ancestors of the Go, Yang and Bu clans emerging from the Samseonghyeol caves; historically the Go clan ruled the west as star-lords and the Moon clan the east as princes.

From the fifth century it paid tribute to Baekje and Silla, submitted to Goryeo in 938, and was annexed in 1105, though its lords kept autonomy. In 1271 anti-Mongol Sambyeolcho rebels made it their last stronghold, and after their 1273 defeat the Yuan installed a military governor and turned much of Jeju into horse pastures lasting until 1356.

The last star-lord, Go Bong-rye, surrendered his title to the Joseon dynasty in 1402; the native lords' titles were abolished, ending Tamna's self-rule.
zh:
耽罗是朝鲜半岛南端济州岛上的海岛王国。传说其统治者出自三姓穴的三位神人始祖高、良、夫三氏；历史上高氏以星主之位统辖西部，文氏以王子之位统辖东部。

耽罗自5世纪起先后向百济和新罗称臣，938年归附高丽，1105年被吞并，但地方首领仍保留自治。1271年抗蒙的三别抄军以该岛为最后据点，1273年败亡后元朝设军事长官，把济州大片土地辟为养马场，延续到1356年。

1402年末代星主高凤礼向朝鲜王朝交出封号，土著首领封号一并废除，耽罗自治至此终结。

en:
The Tamura were a warrior family of Mutsu, associated with the Tamura estate and later with Miharu. During the wars of the Northern and Southern Courts, the Tamura estate was contested; Utsumine Castle, a stronghold of the Tamura estate lords, fell in 1353.

Tamura Kiyoaki married his daughter Megohime to Date Masamune and obtained Date support against the Ashina and Satake. His death in 1586 sparked a succession dispute. Toyotomi Hideyoshi dispossessed the family in his settlement of Ōshū, but a Tamura house was later restored as a branch of the Date lords of Sendai.
zh:
田村氏是陆奥国的武士家族，与田村庄及后来的三春有着密切联系。南北朝战争中，田村庄成为争夺之地；田村庄司家的据点宇津峰城于1353年陷落。

田村清显将女儿爱姬嫁给伊达政宗，获得伊达氏支援，以对抗芦名氏和佐竹氏。他于1586年去世后，继承问题引发争端。丰臣秀吉整顿奥州时剥夺了田村氏的领地，但田村家后来作为仙台伊达家的分支得以复兴。

en:
Temascaltepec, whose Nahuatl name combines the words for steam bath and hill, was a town in the southern highlands of the Toluca Valley beneath the Nevado de Toluca. Its people were Nahuas, Matlatzincas and Mazahuas, and it may at first have depended on the neighbouring polity of Texcaltitlán.

The Aztec emperor Axayacatl conquered it in the 1470s and made it seat of a strategic frontier province whose garrisons faced the Purépecha across the Tierra Caliente to the west.
zh:
特马斯卡尔特佩克的纳瓦特尔语名字由“蒸汽浴室”和“山”两个词组成，是托卢卡谷南部高地、托卢卡雪山脚下的城镇。居民有纳瓦人、马特拉辛卡人和马萨瓦人，它最初可能是邻近特克斯卡尔蒂特兰邦的属城。

15世纪70年代，阿兹特克皇帝阿萨亚卡特尔将其征服，设为战略边境省治所，当地驻军向西越过特拉卡连特地区与普雷佩查对峙。

en:
Tomatlán, a Nahuatl name meaning place of tomatoes, was a coastal chiefdom on the Pacific shore of Jalisco. A sixteenth-century relación of Villa Purificación records a distinct Tomatec language among its villages, which belonged to the province of Los Coronados de El Tuito.

Francisco Cortés de San Buenaventura entered Tomatlán on Holy Monday 1525, was received by its cacique, and annexed the coast to the Spanish domain. The region rose in the great revolt of 1541, and Pedro de Alvarado marched twice from Manzanillo to subdue it.

From 1533 to 1574 it was held as an encomienda by Juan Fernández de Híjar, seated at Villa de Purificación.
zh:
托马特兰是纳瓦特尔语地名，意为番茄之地，是哈利斯科太平洋沿岸的城邦。16世纪的《普里菲卡西翁镇纪事》记载，当地村庄使用独特的托马特克语，这一带属于埃尔图伊托的加冕者省。

1525年圣周一，弗朗西斯科·科尔特斯·德·圣布埃纳文图拉进入托马特兰，受到当地酋长接待，海岸就此并入西班牙版图。1541年大起义中该地区起兵，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多两次从曼萨尼约出兵才将其镇压。

1533—1574年，它作为委托监护地封给驻节普里菲卡西翁镇的胡安·费尔南德斯·德·伊哈尔。

en:
The Tamarowa were an Illinois Confederation people who lived near the confluence of the Mississippi, Missouri and Illinois rivers. Their village near Cahokia had about 600 lodges in 1682; a Catholic mission founded nearby in 1689 attracted Cahokia people to settle among them.

In 1703 the Tamarowa joined the Kaskaskia at the mouth of the Kaskaskia River. Disease and warfare reduced their numbers, and in 1803 the United States recognized the surviving Tamarowa as members of the Kaskaskia.
zh:
塔马罗瓦人是伊利诺伊联盟的一个族群，居住在密西西比河、密苏里河和伊利诺伊河交汇地带。1682年，他们在卡霍基亚附近的村庄约有600座住屋；1689年附近建立的天主教传教站吸引卡霍基亚人迁来与他们同住。

1703年，塔马罗瓦人在卡斯卡斯基亚河口与卡斯卡斯基亚人合流。疾病和战争使他们人数减少，1803年美国将幸存的塔马罗瓦人认定为卡斯卡斯基亚人的成员。

en: The Tonga were a Bantu people of southern Zambia and northern Zimbabwe. They were related to the Batoka of the same region, but distinct from the Tonga of Malawi.
zh: 通加人是生活在赞比亚南部和津巴布韦北部的班图人。他们与同一地区的巴托卡人有亲缘关系，但不同于马拉维的通加人。

en:
Tenochtitlan was the Mexica altepetl on an island in Lake Texcoco, traditionally founded in 1325, when wandering Mexica saw the promised eagle on a cactus under chief Tenoch. They enlarged it with chinampas, living as clients and mercenaries of Azcapotzalco.

On Tenoch's death between 1350 and 1375 the elders made Acamapichtli, grandson of Culhuacan's ruler, their first tlatoani, founding a dynasty that made Tenochtitlan tributary to Azcapotzalco. In 1428 Itzcoatl joined Nezahualcoyotl of Tetzcoco and Tlacopan to overthrow Azcapotzalco, forming the Triple Alliance Tenochtitlan soon dominated. Wars of conquest followed under Moctezuma I and later rulers; Tlatelolco was absorbed in 1473, and Ahuitzotl rebuilt the capital grandly after a flood between 1486 and 1502, making it the largest city of the pre-Columbian Americas.

Cortés entered in 1519, and after a long siege the city fell in August 1521; the Spaniards built Mexico City on its ruins.
zh:
特诺奇蒂特兰是墨西加城邦，在特斯科科湖中的岛上。相传1325年墨西加流民随首领特诺奇见仙人掌雄鹰建城。他们以奇南帕填扩沼泽岛，是阿斯卡波察尔科的附庸和雇佣兵。

1350至1375年特诺奇死，长老立库尔瓦坎统治者外孙阿卡马皮奇特利为首位特拉托阿尼，其开创的王朝使特诺奇蒂特兰成为阿斯卡波察尔科的朝贡者。1428年伊兹科阿特尔联特斯科科的内萨瓦尔科约特尔与特拉科潘推翻阿斯卡波察尔科，结三方同盟，特诺奇蒂特兰很快居于主导。后蒙特祖马一世等征战，1473年并特拉特洛尔科；1486至1502年间水灾后阿维特索特尔大修都城，使它成为前哥伦布美洲最大城市。

1519年科尔特斯入城，久围后1521年8月城陷，西班牙人于废墟建墨西哥城。

en: The Tandroy inhabited arid Androy in southern Madagascar, where zebu herding was central to their livelihood. By the early eighteenth century the Zafimanara dynasty ruled a confederation between the Menarandra and Mandrare rivers. Severe flooding around 1790 weakened its rulers, who fled to the Manombo plateau; the Tandroy remained outside the Merina kingdom.
zh: 坦德罗伊人居住在马达加斯加南部干旱的安德罗伊地区，以饲养瘤牛为主要生计。到18世纪初，扎菲马纳拉王朝统治着梅纳兰德拉河与曼德拉雷河之间的联盟。约1790年的严重洪水削弱了统治者，他们逃往马南布高原；坦德罗伊地区始终没有并入梅里纳王国。

en:
Toungoo, classical Pali name Ketumadi, began in 1279 as a fortified frontier post in the upper Sittaung valley, founded in Pagan's last years. After Pagan's 1287 collapse it passed to Myinsaing and then Pinya, whose hold on the distant south was loose.

In 1325 the commoner hunter Kayin Ba assassinated the governor and seized power; nominally Pinya's vassal, he ruled as a sovereign until 1342 and made it a regional power. During Maw Shan raids in 1358 it revolted and held out until 1367, accepting loose Ava overlordship. Governors preserved autonomy by playing Ava against Hanthawaddy, until Ava crushed revolt in 1470 and installed a general.

The general's grandson Mingyi Nyo became governor in 1485 and declared independence in 1510, founding the Toungoo kingdom from which Tabinshwehti and Bayinnaung built Southeast Asia's largest sixteenth-century empire; the capital moved to Pegu in 1539.
zh:
东吁巴利语古名吉都马迪，1279年作为锡当河上游边塞城堡而建，时值蒲甘帝国末年。1287年蒲甘崩溃后先后隶属敏象和彬牙，宗主对南方远城控制很弱。

1325年平民猎人迦因拔刺杀总督夺权；名义为彬牙附庸，实则以君主自居至1342年，把小据点经营成一方强权。1358年麓川掸人入寇，东吁再叛，独立至1367年接受阿瓦的松散宗主权。历代总督在阿瓦与汉达瓦底间周旋，1470年阿瓦平叛并任命将领为总督。

将领之孙明基纽1485年继任总督，1510年宣布独立，建东吁王国；德彬瑞梯、勃印曩据此建16世纪东南亚最大帝国，1539年迁都勃固。

en:
Tainui is a confederation of Māori iwi in the central North Island, including Waikato, Ngāti Maniapoto, Ngāti Raukawa and Hauraki. They trace their ancestry to the crew of the Tainui canoe, commanded by Hoturoa and said to have landed at Kāwhia.

According to the Tainui historian Pei Te Hurinui Jones, Tainui people entered Waikato around 1400, bringing kūmara plants. By the end of the 17th century, after the siege of Pōhatu-roa, they had conquered much of the Waikato region.
zh:
泰努伊是新西兰北岛中部的毛利部族联盟，包括怀卡托、雅提马尼亚波托、雅提劳卡瓦和豪拉基。各部族追溯祖源至霍图罗阿率领的泰努伊独木舟船员，相传这艘舟在卡菲亚登陆。

泰努伊历史学家佩伊·特胡里努伊·琼斯称，泰努伊人约于1400年进入怀卡托，带来了甘薯。到17世纪末，经过波哈图罗阿围攻战后，他们征服了怀卡托地区的大部分土地。

en:
The Pandyas were one of three crowned dynasties of ancient Tamilakam, ruling from Madurai since before Ashoka and reaching a last golden age in the thirteenth century, when Jatavarman Sundara Pandyan I carried its arms into Telugu country, Kerala and northern Sri Lanka.

Disaster came with a succession war among the sons of Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I and the Khalji invasion of 1310-1311, when Malik Kafur sacked Madurai; further raids, the loss of Sri Lanka and the rise of Ma'bar sultans drove them from their ancient capital.

In 1337 under Vira Pandya the line still held southern districts around Tenkasi, Tirunelveli and Kayal port. Tenkasi, whose name means South Kashi, became the dynasty's last capital: its kings were crowned in Parakrama Pandya's Kasi Viswanathar temple, at times tributaries of Vijayanagara, and the last known Pandyan king, Kolakonda, was killed around 1650.
zh:
潘地亚是古泰米尔三大“冠冕王朝”之一，早在阿育王之前便以马杜赖为都，13世纪入最后黄金时代：阇陀伐摩·孙陀罗·潘地亚一世兵锋推至泰卢固、喀拉拉和斯里兰卡北部。

马拉瓦尔曼·俱罗塞迦罗·潘地亚一世死后诸子争位，逢1310—1311年卡尔吉入侵，马利克·卡富尔洗劫马杜赖；其后劫掠、斯里兰卡丧失和马巴尔苏丹国兴起，把潘地亚人赶出古都。

1337年毗罗潘地亚仍保有滕卡西、蒂鲁内尔维利、卡亚尔港等南方县区。意为“南迦尸”的滕卡西成为王朝最后都城：诸王在波罗迦罗摩·潘地亚建的卡西维斯瓦纳塔尔神庙加冕，有时向毗奢耶那伽罗纳贡；已知末代潘地亚王俱罗贡陀约1650年被杀。

en:
Tonallan, whose Nahuatl name means where the sun rises, was a dominion of the central Jalisco highlands, ruled from Tonalá, east of modern Guadalajara. A Zapotec foundation that later absorbed Toltec and Nahua migrants as well as Tecuexe groups, it became a pottery centre whose gods included the war deity Nayart, and by the early sixteenth century it led a string of tribute towns from Tlaquepaque to Tlaxomulco.

In 1510 it beat off a Purépecha invasion in the Salitre War, but in 1530 Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán arrived at its gates. It was then ruled by a woman, Cihualpilli Tzapotzinco, who favoured submission; when three thousand subjects attacked the Spaniards anyway, they were defeated on 25 March 1530.

She was baptized Juana Bautista, and Tonalá became Santiago de Tonalá, the principal town of Nueva Galicia until Guadalajara overshadowed it.
zh:
托纳兰纳瓦特尔语意为日出之地，是哈利斯科中部高地的政权，以今瓜达拉哈拉以东的托纳拉为统治中心。本为萨波特克定居点，后来吸收托尔特克人、纳瓦移民和特奎谢人，成为制陶中心，神祇包括战神纳雅尔特。16世纪初它统领从特拉凯帕克到特拉霍穆尔科的一串纳贡城镇。

1510年它在萨利特雷战争中击退普雷佩查人入侵；1530年努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼兵临城下。执政的女首领西瓦尔皮利·察波钦科倾向臣服，三千名部众仍出击西班牙人，于1530年3月25日被击败。

她受洗取名胡安娜·包蒂斯塔；托纳拉更名圣地亚哥·德·托纳拉，成新加利西亚首要城镇，直到瓜达拉哈拉兴建后被取代。

en:
Tano is the Spanish name for the southern branch of the Tewa, whose own term tʰáánu tééwa means the down-country people, and whose homeland was the Galisteo Basin, called T'han-u-ge in their language. From the fourteenth to the early fifteenth century their adobe pueblos were trade centres on the route between the Rio Grande and the Great Plains, handling Cerrillos turquoise and irrigated maize.

Juan de Oñate imposed missions and encomiendas after 1598; colonial exactions drove the Tano into the Pueblo Revolt of 1680, when the Spaniards were driven out of New Mexico.

They never returned to the basin: after the reconquest under Diego de Vargas the surviving Tano dispersed, some merging into Keres pueblos such as Santo Domingo, others trekking west to the Hopi First Mesa, where they built Hano, the Tewa Village of the Hopi-Tewa.
zh:
塔诺是西班牙人对特瓦人南支的称呼，其自称意为“下方之地的人”，故土在加利斯泰奥盆地，本族语称之为塔努格。14世纪到15世纪初，他们的土坯普韦布洛是格兰德河与大平原之间商路上的贸易中心，经销塞里略斯绿松石和灌溉玉米。

1598年后奥尼亚特强加传教与委托监护制，殖民盘剥把塔诺人推入1680年的普韦布洛起义，西班牙人被逐出新墨西哥。

塔诺人再没回到这片盆地：迭戈·德·巴尔加斯重新征服后，幸存者四散，一部分并入圣多明各等凯雷斯普韦布洛，另一部分西走霍皮人第一台地，建起哈诺（即特瓦村），后人即霍皮-特瓦人。

en:
Magua was a Taíno chiefdom in the fertile northern interior of Hispaniola, ruled by Guarionex when Europeans arrived in 1492. Spanish tribute demands began in 1494, and Guarionex joined a challenge to Spanish rule in 1497, only to be captured and later released.

Guarionex eventually fled north, where the Spaniards seized him again. In 1502 he drowned when the ship carrying him in chains to Spain sank in a storm.
zh:
马瓜是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛北部内陆沃土上的泰诺酋长国，1492年欧洲人抵达时由瓜里奥内克斯统治。西班牙人从1494年开始索取沉重贡赋，瓜里奥内克斯于1497年参与反抗西班牙统治，却被俘后又获释放。

瓜里奥内克斯最终逃往岛屿北部，再次被西班牙人抓获。1502年，押送他前往西班牙的船只在风暴中沉没，他也葬身海底。

en: Tianping was a Tujia native post in the Wuling hills of present-day Shimen County, Hunan, enrolled under the Ming as the Tianping thousand-household garrison under the Huguang military command, until the Qing gaitu guiliu replaced the Wuling tusi with appointed officials.
zh: 添平是武陵山区的土家族土职，辖地在今湖南省石门县一带，明代编为隶属湖广都指挥使司的添平千户所，清代改土归流后被流官机构取代。

en:
Tianquan was a Gyalrong tusi chiefdom in the mountains west of Yazhou, guarding the road from the thirty-six Fan tribes into the Chinese lowlands. Tradition places its origins in 882, when Tang officers Gao Boxi and Yang Duan garrisoned the valley; in the Five Dynasties their heirs were enfeoffed by the Later Shu, the Gao ruling from Shiyang and the Yang from Diaomen.

Under the Song and Yuan both lines kept their investitures. After their submission to the Ming in 1371, the two offices were merged in 1373 into the Tianquan Six-Tribes Pacification Office, with the Gao as principal and Yang as vice tusi.

A Gao revolt was crushed in 1521, and the chiefs later rejected Zhang Xianzhong's seal. They submitted to the Qing in 1652, but in 1729 the chiefdom was abolished and replaced by the Tianquan Department.
zh:
天全是雅州以西山区的嘉绒土司，扼守三十六番各部进入汉地的要道。其渊源相传始于882年：唐朝军官高卜锡、杨端奉命镇守此地，五代时他们的后人接受后蜀册封，高氏建署于始阳，杨氏建署于碉门。

宋元两代两姓都保有册封。1371年两姓归附明朝，1373年两司合并为天全六番招讨司，以高氏为正土司、杨氏为副土司。

1521年高氏起兵反明被平定，后来张献忠颁赐金印也被两姓拒绝。两姓1652年归附清朝；1729年朝廷改土归流，以其地设天全州，土司遂废。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Trent was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire covering the Adige valley around Trento, with bishops recorded from the synod of Aquileia in 381. Emperor Conrad II erected it as a prince-bishopric in 1027, for loyal bishops to guard the Alpine roads into Italy.

Bishop Federico Wanga's reforms of 1207 to 1218 included the oldest Alpine mining statute, issued in 1208. Emperor Frederick II deposed the bishops in 1236, and the Counts of Tyrol reduced them to subjection; fourteenth-century imperial quarrels then brought raids and temporary Bavarian annexation.

After Tyrol passed to the Habsburgs in 1363, Austrian influence grew until the bishopric became in effect an Austrian dependency. Bernardo Clesio restored its standing and hosted the Council of Trent of 1545 to 1563, and in 1803 the old principality was secularised into Habsburg Tyrol.
zh:
特伦托采邑主教区是神圣罗马帝国的教会诸侯国，领有特伦托一带的阿迪杰河谷，早在381年阿奎莱亚宗教会议上就有当地主教的记录。1027年皇帝康拉德二世将它设立为采邑主教区，让效忠皇帝的主教把守通往意大利的阿尔卑斯山道。

1207年至1218年，主教费代里科·万加整顿国政，于1208年颁布阿尔卑斯地区最古老的矿业法令。1236年皇帝腓特烈二世废黜主教，蒂罗尔伯爵们迫使主教区臣服；14世纪皇帝相争，又带来劫掠和巴伐利亚的短暂吞并。

1363年蒂罗尔归入哈布斯堡家族后，奥地利的影响日深，主教区实际上沦为奥地利的附庸。贝尔纳多·克莱西奥重振主教区的地位，并在此举办1545年至1563年的特伦托会议；这个古老诸侯国最终于1803年被世俗化，并入哈布斯堡的蒂罗尔。

en:
The chiefdom of Tenamaxtlán was a Nahua polity in the Sierra de Amula, now in Jalisco, among the Cuyuteco-speaking peoples of Mixtlán. Its ruler governed Atengo, Ayutla and other towns, and the Coca chiefdom of Cocollán numbered it among its tributary communities. The old town first stood on the Mesa de las Tablas, later moving to the Ayutepec and Bonete hills.

Spanish forces overran the region in 1524 and 1525; in 1538 they gathered indigenous families into a new town, Santiago de Tenamaxtlán, on the present site. In 1613 the governor Bartolomé de Jiménez was succeeded by his son Diego, and the Franciscan church of Santiago was begun that year.
zh:
特纳马斯特兰邦是今哈利斯科州阿穆拉山区的纳瓦人政权，地处米斯特兰的库尤特科语人群之中。君长统辖阿滕戈、阿尤特拉等村镇，科卡人的科科兰邦也把它列为纳贡村镇之一。旧城最初位于梅萨德拉斯塔布拉斯，后来迁至阿尤特佩克山与博内特山。

1524—1525年西班牙军队征服此地；1538年西班牙人把土著家庭集中到现址，建立圣地亚哥·特纳马斯特兰镇。1613年，总督巴托洛梅·德·希门尼斯传位给儿子迭戈，方济各会的圣地亚哥教堂也在同年动工。

en:
Tianzhou was the most powerful Zhuang native chieftaincy of the Youjiang basin in western Guangxi. Under the Tang it was first a regular, then a loose-reign prefecture; the Yuan made it Tianzhou Route, and the early Ming made it a prefecture governed by the hereditary Cen clan, enriched by trade.

In 1499 a succession dispute brought years of war with the rival Cen of Si'en. Cen Meng raided the valleys until an eighty-thousand-strong Ming army moved against him in 1526; betrayed by his father-in-law, he took poison, and in 1528 Tianzhou was demoted to a native department.

Its most famous ruler was Wa Shi, Cen Meng's widow, who in 1554 led some six thousand Zhuang wolf troops against wokou in coastal Jiangsu and Zhejiang, fighting at Wangjiangjing the next year and earning rank. The Cen chief Cen Yidong founded the Huacheng Academy in 1755 and killed himself after being surrounded in the 1789 Vietnam campaign.
zh:
田州是广西西部右江流域最强大的壮族土司。唐代已置田州，后降为羁縻州；元代改为田州路，明初改为田州府，由岑氏世袭知府，岑氏凭贸易致富。

1499年一场夺位内乱把田州拖入与思恩岑氏的多年混战。岑猛称雄左右江、四处攻掠，1526年明军八万人进讨，他被岳父出卖，饮毒自尽；1528年田州由府降为土州。

田州最著名的统治者是岑猛之妻瓦氏夫人，1554年她率狼兵六千余人开赴江浙抵御倭寇，次年在王江泾力战，因功受封。岑氏土官岑宜栋1755年创办化成书院，1789年从征安南时被围自缢。

en: Toa was an Indigenous community associated with the chiefdoms of present-day Georgia. Its people may have joined the Lower Yamasee towns after Westo slave raids broke up neighboring chiefdoms in the 1660s.
zh: 托亚是与今佐治亚州诸酋邦有关的原住民聚落。韦斯托人在17世纪60年代发动掳奴袭击，使附近酋邦瓦解后，托亚人可能加入了下亚马西诸聚落。

en: Todo was a Jurchen tribal polity centered on Lefu on the upper Songhua River, in the forested country that Ming writers called the Haixi, or western, Jurchen lands. Like other Songhua Jurchen groups, its clan chiefs paid tribute to the Ming emperors and were enrolled as hereditary guard commanders before the wars of Nurhaci.
zh: 托多是以松花江上流的勒富为中心的女真部族政权，地处明朝文献所称海西女真的林海之地。与松花江流域的其他女真群体一样，其首领向明朝纳贡，被授为世袭卫所军官，直到努尔哈赤起兵兼并诸部。

en:
The Tuʻi Tonga Empire was a maritime hegemony built from Tongatapu. The first Tuʻi Tonga, ʻAhoʻeitu, began expanding beyond Tonga around 950, and under Momo and Tuʻitātui it peaked between 1200 and 1500: tributary chiefdoms including Samoa sent the ʻinasi first-fruits to Muʻa in double-hulled canoes.

Samoan revolts expelled the Tongans in the thirteenth or fourteenth century, and after Takalaua's assassination at Muʻa in 1535 power was divided, creating the Tuʻi Haʻatakalaua to rule daily and leaving the Tuʻi Tonga a sacred figurehead. A third line, the Tuʻi Kanokupolu (1610), gradually took real power.

Sustained European contact began with Cook's visits of 1773 to 1777; he saw the ʻinasi ceremony and named Tonga the Friendly Isles. Missionaries came from 1797, with mass conversion in the 1820s; a Tuʻi Kanokupolu's murder in 1799 opened a civil war lasting into the 1830s.
zh:
图伊汤加帝国是依托汤加塔布建立的海上霸权。首位图伊汤加阿霍埃图约于950年开始向汤加之外扩张；在莫莫和图伊塔图伊治下，帝国于1200至1500年达到鼎盛，包括萨摩亚在内的附庸酋长国以双体独木舟把首批收获的贡品伊纳西送到姆阿。

13或14世纪，萨摩亚人的起义把汤加人逐出萨摩亚；1535年塔卡拉瓦在姆阿遇刺后，权力被分割，设图伊哈塔卡拉瓦处理政务，图伊汤加成为神圣的精神领袖。1610年设立的第三条王统图伊卡诺库珀鲁逐渐掌握实权。

持续的欧洲接触始于库克1773至1777年的访问，他观看了伊纳西仪式，并把汤加称为友谊群岛。传教士1797年起到来，1820年代岛民大批改宗；1799年一位图伊卡诺库珀鲁遇刺，内战延续到1830年代。

en:
Tochtepec, the hill of rabbits in Nahuatl, was the leading town of a lowland province on the Papaloapan River, whose waters carried trade from the Chinantec and Mixtec country to the Gulf of Mexico. Its first settlers were Popoluca speakers, but by the conquest a Nahuatl dialect served as the common language, and Aztec pochteca made it their regional trading base.

Aztec armies under Moctezuma I opened the conquest, and Axayacatl campaigned through Tochtepec in 1475, after which the district became a tributary province with its own garrison and Mexica governor, sending cacao, rubber, cochineal, feathers and gold to court. Pedro de Alvarado sailed into the Papaloapan in 1518, and Gonzalo de Sandoval took the province for the Spaniards in 1521.
zh:
托奇特佩克在纳瓦特尔语中意为“兔子山”，是帕帕洛阿潘河上一个低地省份的首要城镇；这条大河构成商路，把奇南特卡人和米斯特克人地区的贸易送往墨西哥湾。最早的居民是波波卢卡人，到征服时代，一种纳瓦特尔方言已成地区通用语，阿兹特克的波奇特卡商人把该城作为区域贸易据点。

蒙特苏马一世麾下的阿兹特克军队首先开启对这一带的征服，阿萨亚卡特尔1475年进军托奇特佩克；此后该地成为纳贡省，设有驻军和墨西卡长官，向朝廷输送可可、橡胶、胭脂虫、羽毛和黄金。1518年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多驶入帕帕洛阿潘河，1521年贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔替西班牙人夺取该省。

en: The Tojolabal were a Maya people whose territory lay around Comitán in Chiapas, in present-day Mexico. In 1528 Pedro de Portocarrero founded San Cristóbal de los Llanos in the Comitán valley and brought several Tojolabal settlements under Spanish rule. The town became a base for Spanish expansion toward the Ocosingo valley.
zh: 托霍拉瓦尔是玛雅人的一支，居住在今墨西哥恰帕斯的科米坦一带。1528年，佩德罗·德波托卡雷罗在科米坦谷地建立圣克里斯托瓦尔德洛斯亚诺斯，使几个托霍拉瓦尔聚落处于西班牙统治之下。这座城镇成为西班牙人向奥科辛戈谷地扩张的基地。

en: The Kingdom of Toledo was a realm of the Crown of Castile in central Iberia, centred on Toledo. Alfonso VI of León captured the city from its Muslim rulers in 1085, incorporating the taifa into his domains. Toledo later lost political influence to Madrid, while the kingdom's territory became known as New Castile; it was abolished in 1833.
zh: 托莱多王国是卡斯蒂利亚王冠在伊比利亚半岛中部的一个王国，以托莱多城为中心。莱昂国王阿方索六世于1085年从穆斯林统治者手中攻占托莱多，将这个泰法纳入自己的领地。托莱多后来失去政治中心地位，马德里取而代之；王国的领土逐渐被称为新卡斯蒂利亚，王国本身于1833年被废除。

en:
The County of Tonnerre was a fief of northern Burgundy, centred on Tonnerre. It grew from an eighth-century pagus held of Langres's bishops, its first attested dynasty ruling from the mid-tenth century. When the local line died out, Ermengarde's marriage to William I of Nevers took it to the house of Nevers for a century and a half; its counts coined money until 1315.

The Chalon family held Tonnerre and Auxerre until John IV sold Auxerre to the crown in 1370. His grandson Louis II lost the county in 1414 after opposing John the Fearless, and Philip the Good granted it to Arthur de Richemont; the Treaty of Arras returned it to the Chalons in 1435.

With the male line extinct, it passed through a sister's marriage to Olivier de Husson. A 1572 ducal grant was never registered, so Tonnerre remained a county until the Revolution of 1789.
zh:
托内尔伯国是勃艮第北部的封建领地，以托内尔城为中心。它源于8世纪从属于朗格勒主教的帕格，首个可确考的伯爵家族自10世纪中叶起统治此地。本地家族绝嗣后，埃尔芒加德嫁给讷韦尔的纪尧姆一世，伯国转入讷韦尔家族之手达一个半世纪，其伯爵自铸钱币直到1315年。

14世纪沙隆家族同时领有托内尔与欧塞尔，约翰四世1370年把欧塞尔卖给法兰西王室，只保留托内尔。他的孙子路易二世与无畏的约翰作对，1414年被没收伯国，好人菲利普将它封给阿蒂尔·德·里什蒙；1435年《阿拉斯条约》把它归还沙隆家族。

此时男嗣已绝，伯国经一位姐妹的婚姻传给奥利维耶·德·于松。1572年升格公国的特许状从未登记，托内尔因此始终是伯国，一直延续到1789年大革命。

en:
The Tohono O'odham were desert communities whose lands stretched across the Sonoran Desert, from the Gila River toward the Gulf of California. They moved between winter villages near mountain water sources and summer settlements where they diverted seasonal rains onto their fields.

From the late 17th century they faced raids by Apache groups. Spanish settlement brought growing pressure on O'odham land and autonomy, and in 1751 the O'odham rose against colonial rule.
zh:
托霍诺奥德汉人是索诺兰沙漠中的部落群体，其土地从希拉河延伸到加利福尼亚湾一带。他们在山中水源附近的冬季村落与夏季聚落之间迁徙，并将季节性雨水引入田地。

17世纪末起，他们面临阿帕奇人的袭击。西班牙人的定居不断挤压奥德汉人的土地与自治权，1751年奥德汉人起兵反抗殖民统治。

en:
The Toquegua were an Indigenous people of the Caribbean coast of present-day Guatemala and Honduras. In the sixteenth century they traded cacao and quetzal feathers and hosted Yucatec Maya in their communities.
