In 1604 the leaders of Xocolo and Amatique, backed by the threat of Spanish force, persuaded 190 Toquegua to settle on the Amatique coast. By 1699 high mortality and intermarriage with the Amatique had ended their existence as a separate people.
zh:
托克瓜是今危地马拉和洪都拉斯加勒比海沿岸的原住民。16世纪，他们经营可可和绿咬鹃羽毛贸易，尤卡坦玛雅人也住在他们的聚落中。

1604年，肖科洛和阿马蒂克的领袖以西班牙武力为威胁，劝说190名托克瓜人在阿马蒂克海岸定居。到1699年，高死亡率和与阿马蒂克人的通婚使托克瓜人不再作为独立族群存在。

en:
Torres, also called Logudoro, was a medieval judicate in northwestern Sardinia. Its rulers grew autonomous as Byzantine control weakened, and moved their capital from Porto Torres to Ardara and later Sassari.

Adelasia inherited Torres in 1236 and acknowledged papal overlordship the following year. She died childless in 1259, ending the judicate; the Genoese Doria and Malaspina families and the rulers of Arborea took its lands, while Sassari became an autonomous city.
zh:
托雷斯又称洛古多罗，是撒丁岛西北部的中世纪法官国。随着拜占庭控制力减弱，当地统治者逐渐自主，并将都城从托雷斯港迁至阿尔达拉，后来又迁到萨萨里。

阿德拉西亚于1236年继承托雷斯，次年承认教皇的宗主权。她于1259年无嗣去世，法官国随之终结；热那亚的多里亚和马拉斯皮纳家族及阿尔博雷亚的统治者瓜分了其领土，萨萨里则成为自治城市。

en:
The Toshima were warrior lords of southern Musashi Province, originating in Toshima district. They lost their lands after a revolt against the Kamakura authorities in 1368, but recovered Shakujii in 1395 and made it their base.

In 1476 Toshima Yasutsune joined Nagao Kageharu's revolt against the Uesugi. Ōta Dōkan defeated the Toshima at Ekodahara in 1477 and took Shakujii Castle; after further defeat in 1478, Yasutsune disappeared and the main family fell.
zh:
丰岛氏是武藏国南部的武家领主，发源于丰岛郡。1368年，他们反抗镰仓政权失败后失去领地，1395年收回石神井并以此为据点。

1476年，丰岛泰经加入长尾景春反抗上杉氏的行动。1477年，太田道灌在江古田原击败丰岛军并攻取石神井城；1478年再次战败后，泰经下落不明，丰岛宗家灭亡。

en:
Cempoala, whose Nahuatl name means the Place of Twenty Waters, was the foremost Totonac city of the Postclassic period, on the Veracruz coastal plain near the Actopan's mouth. Settled from at least the early Common Era, it was reshaped when Toltec pressure drove Totonac groups coastward between 1000 and 1150; it held perhaps twenty-five to thirty thousand people and headed some fifty towns. Its aqueducts watered the fields, and its shell-lime temples and palaces impressed the first Spaniards.

Moctezuma I's Aztec armies conquered it in the mid-fifteenth century, imposing tribute including people for sacrifice and enslavement. In 1519 its tlatoani Xicomecoatl, called the Fat Chief by the Spanish, welcomed Cortés, and the Totonac league allied with the Spanish and marched on Tenochtitlan.

Under colonial rule the people were resettled and put to sugar cultivation; the matlazahuatl epidemic of 1575 to 1577 emptied the city, and survivors moved to Xalapa.
zh:
塞姆波阿拉的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“二十水之地”，是后古典期最重要的托托纳克城市，坐落在韦拉克鲁斯沿海平原、阿克托潘河口附近。早在公元最初几百年这里已有聚落，1000至1150年间托尔特克人进逼，托托纳克人退向海岸，城市由此重塑，人口可能有两万五千至三万，统领约五十座城镇。城中渡槽灌溉田地，贝壳灰泥饰面的神庙与宫殿令最早见到它的西班牙人惊叹。

15世纪中叶，莫克特苏马一世麾下的阿兹特克军队攻陷该城，课以重赋，索取人口用于献祭和奴役。1519年，城主希科梅科阿特尔（西班牙人称“胖酋长”）迎接科尔特斯，托托纳克联盟随即与西班牙人结盟，进军特诺奇蒂特兰。

殖民统治下，居民被强制迁置、驱往甘蔗田劳作；1575至1577年的马特拉萨瓦特尔瘟疫使全城人口死散殆尽，幸存者迁往哈拉帕。

en:
The County of Toulouse was a southern French principality centred on the city of Toulouse. Its counts descended from Frankish appointees and had gained independence by the end of the ninth century.

Pope Innocent III launched the Albigensian Crusade in 1209 against Catharism in the region, and the counts recovered many lands during revolts from 1215. The Treaty of Paris in 1229 subjected Toulouse to the French crown; the county remained under its counts until 1271.
zh:
图卢兹伯国是以图卢兹城为中心的法国南部领地。其伯爵出自法兰克人任命的官员，到9世纪末已取得独立。

1209年，教皇英诺森三世发动阿尔比十字军，讨伐该地区的卡特里派；从1215年起，图卢兹伯爵在一系列起义中收复了许多土地。1229年的《巴黎条约》使图卢兹臣服于法国王室，但伯爵仍统治伯国直至1271年。

en: Tovata was a Fijian chiefly confederacy associated with Cakaudrove, Bua, Macuata and Lau. In Cakaudrove, the Tui Cakau ruled an independent chiefly domain.
zh: 托瓦塔是斐济的一个酋长联盟，与卡考德罗韦、姆安布阿、马夸塔和劳群岛有关。卡考德罗韦的图伊萨考曾独立统治当地的酋长领地。

en:
The Ton were a Jurchen group of the lower Songhua valley, named after the Tun River, now the Tangwang River of Heilongjiang. Their walled west-bank seat had been the Punnuli city of the Liao-era Five Nations and a Jin moungan post, and under the Yuan it became the Taowen military-civilian myriarchy, one of five under the Kaiyuan circuit of Liaoyang province.

In 1337 its hereditary commanders still held Yuan titles. In 1388 the Ming contacted the three Ilan Tumen tribes, the Taowen, Huligai and Odoli, who later migrated to the Tumen River and formed the core of the Jianzhou Jurchens. The old Taowen city became the Ming Chengtaowen Guard, and under the Qing it was the Burha settlement.
zh:
屯人是松花江下游的女真部族，因屯河（今汤旺河）得名，活动在今黑龙江省境内。他们在汤旺河西岸的城址，辽代为五国部盆奴里国故城，金代为屯河猛安驻地；元代成为桃温军民万户府，是松花江下游五个万户府之一，隶属辽阳行省开元路。

1337年其世袭长官仍接受元朝封号。1388年，明朝与依兰一带的桃温、胡里改、斡朵里三姓部落取得联系，这些部落后来南迁图们江，构成建州女真的核心。桃温故城明代为成讨温卫驻地，清代称布尔和噶珊。

en:
The Tōyama were a warrior family of eastern Mino, named for Tōyama estate in Ena district. Tōyama Kagetomo inherited the estate from Katō Kagekado and built Iwamura Castle, the seat of the senior branch.

In the late sixteenth century the struggle between the Oda and Takeda destroyed the Iwamura branch and several others. Branches serving the Tokugawa fought for the eastern army at Sekigahara in 1600; Tōyama Tomomasa became lord of the Naegi domain under the Edo shogunate.
zh:
远山氏是美浓东部的武家，得名于惠那郡的远山庄。远山景朝从加藤景廉手中继承庄园，并修建了宗家居城岩村城。

16世纪后期，织田氏与武田氏的争斗导致岩村远山氏及其他几个支系灭亡。效力德川氏的支系在1600年关原之战中加入东军；远山友政在江户幕府治下成为苗木藩主。

en:
Toztlan is the sixteenth-century spelling of Tuxtla, a Nahuatl name meaning place of the rabbit, borne by towns of the volcanic Sierra de los Tuxtlas on the southern Veracruz coast. The district was ancient Olmec country: Hueyapan, the later Tres Zapotes, with its colossal stone heads, lay close by.

In the fifteenth century the Aztec empire conquered the area, and the Codex Mendoza records Toztlan with its own topoglyph as a tributary of the Triple Alliance; Mexica garrisons watched the coast against foreign ships.

The Spanish villa of Tuxtla was founded in 1525, and in 1529 the crown granted it, with over twenty other towns, to Hernan Cortes as part of the Marquisate of the Valley of Oaxaca. A royal report of 1580 lists six dependent estancias around Tuxtla, still the head of a large colonial district.
zh:
托斯特兰是图斯特拉在16世纪文献中的拼写，这个纳瓦特尔语名字意为“兔子之地”，指韦拉克鲁斯南部海岸火山地带图斯特拉山区的诸城镇。这一带是古老的奥尔梅克故地：后来的特雷斯萨波特斯，即旧称韦亚潘，就在附近，巨型石首像出土于此。

15世纪，阿兹特克帝国征服该地区，《门多萨手抄本》用专属地形符号把托斯特兰记为三方同盟的纳贡地；墨西加驻军在海岸瞭望，防备外来船只。

1525年西班牙人建立图斯特拉城镇；1529年，王室把它连同另外二十多座城镇授予埃尔南·科尔特斯，纳入瓦哈卡谷地侯爵领地。1580年的王室报告记载，图斯特拉周围有六个从属庄园站，它仍是一个大区的首镇。

en:
The Tupinamba were Tupi-speaking peoples of Brazil's Atlantic coast, including communities around Bahia and between Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. They initially helped the Portuguese enslave other Indigenous peoples, but later faced enslavement themselves.

In the 16th century, Tupinamba chiefs including Cunhambebe and Aimberê joined the Tamoio confederation against the Portuguese, receiving French support around Guanabara Bay. In 1565 Estácio de Sá founded Rio de Janeiro as a base for operations against the French and their Indigenous allies; Portuguese forces eventually expelled the French and devastated the Tamoio.
zh:
图皮南巴是巴西大西洋沿岸说图皮语的族群，包括巴伊亚一带以及里约热内卢与圣保罗之间的社群。他们起初帮助葡萄牙人奴役其他原住民，后来自己也面临被奴役的命运。

16世纪，包括库尼扬贝贝和艾姆贝雷在内的图皮南巴首领加入塔莫约联盟，反抗葡萄牙人，并在瓜纳巴拉湾一带得到法国人支持。1565年埃斯塔西奥·德萨建立里约热内卢，作为进攻法国人及其原住民盟友的基地；葡萄牙军队最终驱逐了法国人，重创塔莫约人。

en:
The Tepecan were an Indigenous people of Azqueltán on the Bolaños River in what is now Jalisco, Mexico. Their language belonged to the Uto-Aztecan family and was closely related to Southern Tepehuán.

According to one account, Tepehuán migrants settled the canyon in the thirteenth or fourteenth century. Spaniards arrived in the area in 1534, and in the eighteenth century Spanish and Tlaxcalan colonists took over Tepehuán lands outside the canyon.
zh:
特佩坎人是墨西哥今哈利斯科州博拉尼奥斯河畔阿斯克尔坦的原住民。他们的语言属于犹他-阿兹特克语系，与南特佩瓦语关系密切。

一种记载认为，特佩瓦移民在13或14世纪定居于这片峡谷。西班牙人于1534年抵达这一地区，18世纪西班牙和特拉斯卡拉殖民者占据了峡谷外的特佩瓦土地。

en:
Taiping was a native chieftaincy network of the Zuo River valley in southwestern Guangxi, its seat at Chongshan by the Annamese frontier. Under the Song the Huang clan and other Zhuang headmen ruled it as jimi prefectures, and a Taiping garrison fell to Annamese raiders in the Song-Dai Viet war of 1075 to 1077.

The Yuan made it Taiping Route, one of two Left River routes of the Liangjiang pacification office, leaving hereditary chiefs under the tusi system. In 1369 the Ming renamed it Taiping Prefecture, later supervising seventeen native subprefectures and three counties, Guangxi's densest cluster of Zhuang tusi.

The Qing kept the prefecture but reduced native rule: in 1725 Longzhou was split into two native inspectorates, the lower one passing to circulating officials two years later, while Siming and Jiangzhou were reduced to ordinary native subprefectures attached to Taiping in the 1730s.
zh:
太平是广西西南左江流域的土司网络，治所崇善紧邻安南边境。宋代黄氏等壮族首领以羁縻州管治这里，1075至1077年宋朝与交趾交战期间，太平寨曾被交趾军队攻陷。

元朝将这一地区设为太平路，是两江道宣慰司下辖的左江路份之一，世袭土官在土司制度下留任。1369年明朝改太平路为太平府，后来领有十七个土州和三个县，是广西土司最密集的地区。

清朝保留太平府建制，却逐步削夺土官权力：1725年龙州被分为两个土巡检司，两年后下龙司改土归流；1730年代，邻近的思明、江州被降为隶属太平府的土州。

en:
The Tepehuan were Indigenous peoples of the Sierra Madre Occidental, with a heartland in the Guadiana Valley of Durango. Their lands extended into southern Chihuahua and neighboring regions by the time of the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire.

In 1616 the Tepehuan rose against Spanish rule in New Spain. The rebellion was crushed by 1620, with heavy loss of life on both sides.
zh:
特佩万人是西马德雷山脉的原住民，其中心地带位于杜兰戈的瓜迪亚纳谷地。西班牙征服阿兹特克帝国时，他们的土地已延伸至奇瓦瓦南部及邻近地区。

1616年，特佩万人在新西班牙起兵反抗西班牙统治。起义到1620年被镇压，双方死伤惨重。

en: Teposcocula was a Mixtec city-state of the Mixteca Alta in the mountains of Oaxaca, with its capital at Yucundaa, the site now called Pueblo Viejo de Teposcolula. After the Spanish take-over of the Mixteca in 1521 its people were resettled in the new towns of Teposcolula nearby and the old capital was abandoned.
zh: 特波斯科库拉是瓦哈卡山区上米斯特卡的米斯特克人城邦，都城尤昆达即今特波斯科卢拉旧城（普埃布洛维霍）遗址。1521年米斯特卡被西班牙人接管后，居民被迁往附近新建的特波斯科卢拉城镇，旧都就此废弃。

en:
Tecpatitlan was one of the independent señoríos of the Tecuexe, a Chichimeca people of Uto-Aztecan speech who farmed the river valleys of Los Altos in what is now Jalisco. Its Nahuatl name means place of flint or hard stone, and the Spanish later built the town of Tepatitlán on the same site.

Together with Mitic and Acatic it belonged to a loose network of rival chiefdoms whose fighters were feared across the region; tradition recorded that the migrating Mexica avoided a battle when they reached Tecpatitlan. To its south lay the Coca kingdom of Coinan.

Nuño de Guzmán's army passed through in 1530 during the conquest of Nueva Galicia, and in 1541 the town joined the Caxcan-led Mixtón War against the Spanish, a rising crushed by Viceroy Antonio de Mendoza.
zh:
特克帕蒂特兰是特库埃克人的独立小邦之一。特库埃克人属奇奇梅克系、操犹他—阿兹特克语族语言，在今哈利斯科州阿尔托斯高原的河谷务农。它的纳瓦特尔语名称意为燧石或硬石之地，西班牙人后来在同一地点建起特帕蒂特兰城。

它与米蒂克、阿卡蒂克等同属一批相互争战的酋邦，其武士之名远播四方；相传迁徙途中的墨西加人抵达特克帕蒂特兰时都避而不战。它的南面是科卡人的科伊南王国。

1530年，努尼奥·德·古斯曼的军队在征服新加利西亚途中经过这里；1541年，当地人加入卡什坎人领导的米斯特翁战争反抗西班牙人，最终被总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨镇压。

en:
The Tupiniquim were a Tupi people whose territory extended along the Brazilian coast south of Salvador. At Porto Seguro in April 1500, they were among the first Indigenous peoples to meet the Portuguese.

Tibiriçá, a Tupiniquim chief of Piratininga and an ally of the Portuguese and Jesuits, helped establish São Paulo in 1554. In 1562 he defended the settlement against an attack led by his nephew Jaguaranho; Tibiriçá died later that year during an epidemic.
zh:
图皮尼金是图皮人的一支，其领地沿巴西海岸从萨尔瓦多向南延伸。1500年4月，他们在塞古鲁港成为最早与葡萄牙人相遇的原住民之一。

皮拉蒂宁加的图皮尼金首领蒂比里萨与葡萄牙人及耶稣会结盟，于1554年协助建立圣保罗。1562年，他保卫定居点击退侄子雅瓜拉尼奥率领的进攻；同年晚些时候，蒂比里萨死于一场疫病。

en:
The Principality of Toropets was a small Rurikid appanage around the upper Western Dvina, on the border of Smolensk, Novgorod and Lithuania. The town, first recorded in 1074, was the second town of the princes of Smolensk until about 1167, when Mstislav the Brave received it and made it the seat of his own line.

In the thirteenth century it was a buffer against Lithuanian expansion: Prince Davyd fell against the Lithuanians in 1225 or 1226, and Alexander Nevsky married there in 1239. Lithuanian pressure nevertheless grew, and by the fourteenth century Toropets was a vassal of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, which annexed it in 1355.

It remained Lithuanian until the war ending in 1503, when Ivan III took it after the Battle of Vedrosha; in the early seventeenth century Polish armies sacked it during the Time of Troubles.
zh:
托罗佩茨公国是留里克家族的一个小封邑，地处西德维纳河上游，夹在斯摩棱斯克、诺夫哥罗德和立陶宛之间。托罗佩茨城最早见于1074年的记载，本是斯摩棱斯克王公的第二重镇；约1167年，“勇敢者”姆斯季斯拉夫受封此城，此城自此成为独立王公支系的驻地。

13世纪时，它是抵御立陶宛扩张的缓冲：1225或1226年，达维德王公在与立陶宛人作战时阵亡，1239年亚历山大·涅夫斯基在此成婚。立陶宛的压力日甚，到14世纪托罗佩茨已成为立陶宛大公国的附庸，1355年被正式吞并。

它一直属立陶宛所有，直到1503年战争结束，伊凡三世在维德罗沙战役后取得托罗佩茨；17世纪初动乱时代，这座城市又遭波兰军队洗劫。

en: Tecpantepec was a Cuitlatec town on the Costa Grande of the Pacific coast, in what is now Guerrero, Mexico, counted among the subject towns of Mexcaltepec, the leading Cuitlatec polity of the late Postclassic period.
zh: 特克潘特佩克是太平洋岸科斯塔格兰德地区（今墨西哥格雷罗州）的一座奎特拉特克人城镇，在后古典期晚期是奎特拉特克人主要政权梅斯卡尔特佩克的属镇之一。

en:
The señorío of Tepexic was a Popoloca state centered on the hilltop city of Tepexi el Viejo, in the dry southern highlands of what is now Puebla. The Popoloca were Otomanguean-speaking farmers of the Tehuacán Valley who, after the fall of Tula, lived in small rival kingdoms such as Tepexi and Cuthá.

Tepexi el Viejo had been occupied since the Classic period, when Thin Orange pottery linked it to Teotihuacan, and grew into a leading Popoloca capital of the Postclassic. As the Mexica Triple Alliance pressed eastward in the fifteenth century, Tepexic kept its freedom through marriage ties with the dynasty of Tenochtitlan, until Tlatelolco armies invaded in 1503 and defeated its lord Tlachquiáhuitl.

It then paid tribute until the Spanish campaigns of the 1520s, when the Lienzo de Tlaxcala depicts its submission to Cortés.
zh:
特佩西克是波波洛卡人的城邦，以今普埃布拉州南部干旱高原上的特佩希古城为中心。波波洛卡人是说奥托-曼格语系语言的农人，聚居在特瓦坎谷地，图拉陷落后分裂为特佩希、库塔等相互竞争的小邦。

特佩希古城早在古典期便有人居住，出土的薄橙陶把它与特奥蒂瓦坎联系起来；后古典期时，它发展为波波洛卡人的重要都城之一。15世纪墨西加三方同盟向东扩张，特佩西克靠着与特诺奇蒂特兰王朝的联姻维持独立，直到1503年特拉特洛尔科军队入侵，击败其君主特拉奇基亚维特尔。

此后它纳贡称臣，16世纪20年代西班牙人进军时，《特拉斯卡拉画布》描绘了它向科尔特斯投降的场景。

en:
Tepeyacac, later hispanized as Tepeaca, was a Nahua altepetl in the dry highlands east of the Valley of Mexico, its name meaning “at the ridge of the hills”. Its dynasty traced Chichimec descent, three related tlatoque governed, and Camaxtli, war god of the eastern Nahuas, was its patron; Acatzingo, probably with Tecamachalco and Quecholac, were subject towns.

With Huejotzingo and Tlaxcala it fought the ritual xochiyaoyotl, or “flower wars”, until Moctezuma I overran the region in the mid-fifteenth century; it then became a tribute-collection centre whose market was required to supply luxury goods.

An ally of Tenochtitlan, it attacked a Spanish party after the Mexica uprising of 1520; Cortés marched in reprisal with about five hundred Castilians and forty thousand Tlaxcalan allies, stormed it in August 1520 and founded Segura de la Frontera on the site, one of central Mexico's first Spanish municipalities.
zh:
特佩亚卡后西班牙化名为特佩阿卡，是墨西哥谷地以东干旱高地上的纳瓦人城邦，名字意为“在山脊之上”。统治家族自称奇奇梅克后裔，由三位有亲缘关系的特拉托阿尼共治，守护神是东部纳瓦人的战争之神卡马斯特利；阿卡钦戈以及可能还有特卡马查尔科、克乔拉科都是它的属镇。

它与韦霍钦戈、特拉斯卡拉一起参加仪式性的“花之战”，直到15世纪中叶蒙特祖马一世征服这一地区；此后它成为阿兹特克的贡赋征集中心，市场须供应奢侈品。

西班牙人到来时，它是特诺奇蒂特兰的盟友，1520年墨西加人起义后袭击了一支西班牙队伍；科尔特斯为报复率约五百卡斯蒂利亚人和四万特拉斯卡拉盟军出征，1520年8月攻陷此城，在原址建塞古拉-德拉弗龙特拉镇，为墨西哥中部最早的西班牙市镇之一。

en: Transylvania was a region of the Hungarian crown inhabited by Hungarians, Saxons, Székelys and Romanians. After the division of Hungary, the eastern Hungarian realm gave rise to the Principality of Transylvania under the Treaty of Speyer in 1570.
zh: 特兰西瓦尼亚是匈牙利王冠领地的一部分，居民包括匈牙利人、萨克森人、塞凯伊人和罗马尼亚人。匈牙利分裂后，东匈牙利政权依照1570年的《施派尔条约》演变为特兰西瓦尼亚公国。

en:
The Principality of Trubchevsk was a Rurikovich appanage centered on Trubchevsk. It first appears in 1185 as an appanage of Novgorod-Seversk; its first prince, Vsevolod Svyatoslavich, nicknamed Bui-Tur, is a hero of The Tale of Igor's Campaign, leading Trubchevsk's army against the Cumans that year.

After the Mongol invasion it passed under Bryansk's princes but kept its own rulers, still Bryansk vassals in 1337. After Lithuania seized Bryansk in 1356, it went to Dmitry Olgerdovich of the Gediminids, ancestor of the Trubetskoy family. In the Russo-Lithuanian war of 1500–1503 the Trubetskoy princes went over to Ivan III with their lands.

Ivan the Terrible abolished it in 1566, during the Livonian War. Ceded to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1609, it was reconquered in 1654 by Alexey Trubetskoy and briefly restored to him in 1660 as a private appanage, the century's only such grant.
zh:
特鲁布切夫斯克公国是以特鲁布切夫斯克为中心的留里克王朝封邑。它最早于1185年作为诺夫哥罗德-谢韦尔斯基公国的封邑出现；首任王公弗谢沃洛德·斯维亚托斯拉维奇绰号“野牛”，是《伊戈尔远征记》歌颂的英雄之一，当年率军队与波洛伏齐人作战。

蒙古入侵后，它并入布良斯克公国但保留本地王公世系，1337年时仍是布良斯克附庸。1356年立陶宛攻占布良斯克后，它被封给格迪米纳斯家族的德米特里·奥尔格多维奇，即特鲁别茨科伊家族始祖。1500—1503年俄立战争期间，特鲁别茨科伊家族带着领地转投伊凡三世。

1566年伊凡雷帝在利沃尼亚战争中废除该公国。1609年它被割让给波兰立陶宛联邦，1654年由阿列克谢·特鲁别茨科伊重新征服，1660年作为私邑短暂归还给他，是17世纪唯一一次此类封赐。

en: Tariaca was an indigenous chiefdom in the Tierra Adentro region of present-day Costa Rica. In 1615 its chief Antonio Carebe led an uprising against Spanish abuses. The region saw another revolt in 1709 under Pablo Presbere of Suinse, and Spanish authority there effectively collapsed after a punitive expedition in 1710.
zh: 塔里亚卡是今哥斯达黎加内陆地区的一个原住民酋邦。1615年，酋长安东尼奥·卡雷韦率众起义，反抗西班牙人的虐待。1709年，苏因塞酋长巴勃罗·普雷斯贝雷在这一地区发动另一次起义；1710年的惩罚远征过后，西班牙在当地的统治实际上崩溃了。

en:
The Empire of Trebizond was the longest-lived of the three Byzantine successor states born after the Fourth Crusade. In April 1204 Alexios Komnenos and his brother David, grandsons of the emperor Andronikos I, seized Trebizond on the Pontic coast with soldiers supplied by Queen Tamar of Georgia, and Alexios ruled as the first of the Grand Comneni. The empire held a narrow Black Sea strip backed by the Pontic mountains, briefly reaching into the Crimea and Paphlagonia, and after the Mongols sacked Baghdad in 1258 the western trade of the Silk Road moved north to its harbours; Marco Polo sailed home through Trebizond in 1295. Emperor John II dropped the claim to Constantinople in 1282, restyling himself emperor of the East, the Iberians and Perateia.

The long reign of Alexios II ended in 1330, and the empire then slid into civil war between the pro-Byzantine Scholaroi and the native Amytzantarantes, with only the eight-year rule of Basil Komnenos offering respite; Turkish raids, the Genoese seizure of Kerasus and the Black Death of 1347 and 1348 brought it low until Alexios III restored order from 1349 and made his court a centre of trade and art, marrying Trapezuntine princesses to neighbouring Turkish dynasts. That marriage diplomacy long shielded the empire, above all through Theodora, wed to the Aq Qoyunlu Uzun Hasan, but Mehmed II isolated Trebizond, marched over the Pontic mountains and forced the last emperor, David, to surrender in August 1461, eight years after Constantinople fell.
zh:
特拉比松帝国是第四次十字军东征后诞生的三个拜占庭继承国中存续最久的一个。1204年4月，皇帝安德洛尼卡一世的孙子阿莱克修斯·科穆宁与弟弟大卫，在格鲁吉亚塔玛尔女王提供的军队支持下攻占本都海岸的特拉比松城，阿莱克修斯成为“大科穆宁”家族的第一位皇帝。帝国据有本都山脉庇护下一条狭窄的黑海沿岸地带，势力一度伸入克里米亚和帕夫拉戈尼亚；1258年蒙古人洗劫巴格达后，丝绸之路的西端贸易北移到它的港口，马可·波罗于1295年取道特拉比松返回欧洲。1282年，皇帝约翰二世放弃对君士坦丁堡的要求，改号为东方、伊比利亚与佩拉提亚皇帝。

阿莱克修斯二世的长期统治于1330年结束，帝国随即陷入亲拜占庭的斯库拉罗伊派与本土阿米特赞塔兰泰斯派之间的内战，只有巴西尔·科穆宁八年的统治带来短暂安定；突厥人的袭扰、热那亚人夺取凯拉苏斯以及1347至1348年的黑死病使国势沉沦，直到阿莱克修斯三世于1349年重整秩序，把宫廷建成贸易与艺术中心，并把特拉比松公主嫁给邻近的突厥君主。这种联姻外交长期庇护着帝国，其中最重要的是嫁给白羊王朝乌尊·哈桑的狄奥多拉，但穆罕默德二世最终孤立特拉比松，率军翻越本都山脉，迫使末代皇帝大卫于1461年8月出降，此时距君士坦丁堡陷落已有八年。

en:
Taraf, earlier called Tungachal, was a territory in the Sylhet region, ruled from Rajpur and later Laskarpur. Early Hindu rajas sat between Gour and Twipra, until Gour's Govinda set Achak Narayan over it in the later thirteenth century.

After Shah Jalal conquered Sylhet in 1303, Syed Nasiruddin of Lakhnauti marched on it in 1304 with twelve saints, camping at Laskarpur and driving Achak Narayan out. Renamed Taraf, it passed to his Syed descendants.

Taraf became a seat of Islamic learning, where a proverb boasted of letters in every house; Syed Israil wrote what was counted as the first book by a Sylhet author in 1534. Syeds held it until Twipra seized it. Islam Khan I's Mughal forces stormed the Taraf fort in the early 1600s and joined the territory to Sylhet's Sarkar, though the Syeds remained zamindars; one won the Chowdhury title in 1770 and joined the anti-British rising in 1799.
zh:
塔拉夫旧称通加查尔，是锡尔赫特地区的领地，先后以拉杰布尔和拉斯卡尔布尔为治所。早期罗阇夹在高尔和特里普拉之间，13世纪后期高尔的戈文达派阿查克·纳拉扬统治此地。

1303年沙阿·贾拉勒征服锡尔赫特后，拉克瑙提统帅赛义德·纳西鲁丁1304年带十二位圣徒进军此地，在拉斯卡尔布尔扎营，逐走阿查克·纳拉扬。此地改称塔拉夫，交由纳西鲁丁的赛义德后裔统治。

赛义德家族治下，塔拉夫成为伊斯兰学术之地，当地谚语称家家有文字；赛义德·伊斯拉伊尔1534年写成一部书，被视为锡尔赫特作家的第一部作品。赛义德家族统治到特里普拉夺取该地。17世纪初伊斯兰汗一世的莫卧儿军队攻陷塔拉夫堡垒，将该地并入锡尔赫特萨尔卡尔，赛义德家族仍以包税地主身份留居；一人1770年获乔杜里头衔，参加1799年反英起义。

en: The Tuareg were Berber-speaking pastoralists organized in confederations across the Sahara. Around 1405, Tuareg groups in the Aïr Mountains founded the Sultanate of Agadez to mediate disputes between their clans.
zh: 图阿雷格人是生活在撒哈拉、使用柏柏尔语的牧民，分属多个联盟。约1405年，艾尔山区的图阿雷格部族建立阿加德兹苏丹国，以调解各氏族之间的争端。

en:
The Torghut were among the Four Oirats of the western Mongols; their nobles claimed descent from Toghrul, ruler of the Keraites, and the name is said to mean guardsman, perhaps from the kheshig. In 1337 they were a small horde on Dzungaria's Altay pastures.

They emerge as a distinct group in the mid-sixteenth century, and about 1630 tayishi Kho Orluk led the bulk west to the Volga, where they displaced the Nogai Horde and founded the Kalmyk Khanate, which became a Russian protectorate and lost its autonomy in 1724.

Russian harshness drove most, under Ubashi Khan, east in January 1771; beset by raids, cold and starvation, only some eighty-five thousand reached Dzungaria, where the Qing settled them. The approximately seventy thousand west of the unfrozen Volga stayed as Kalmyks, their khanate abolished by Catherine; Torghut archers served Kutuzov against Napoleon in 1812.
zh:
土尔扈特是西部蒙古卫拉特四部之一，其贵族自称源出克烈部首领脱斡邻勒，部名据说意为护卫，可能与怯薛有关。1337年时它还是准噶尔阿尔泰山牧场的一个小部落。

土尔扈特作为独立瓦剌部落最早见于16世纪中叶；约1630年，首领和鄂尔勒克率主力西迁伏尔加河，驱逐诺盖汗国，建立卡尔梅克汗国，后来成为俄国保护国，1724年丧失自治权。

俄国苛政迫使部众在渥巴锡汗率领下于1771年1月大举东归；一路上屡遭袭扰，又受饥寒之苦，最终只有约八万五千人抵达准噶尔，被清朝安置。留在未封冻的伏尔加河西岸的约七万人便是卡尔梅克人，叶卡捷琳娜随即废除卡尔梅克汗国；土尔扈特弓箭手1812年还随库图佐夫与拿破仑作战。

en:
The Electorate of Trier was the ecclesiastical principality of the archbishop of Trier, one of the three clerical prince-electors of the Holy Roman Empire and arch-chancellor for the kingdom of Burgundy-Arles. The see went back to the Roman city of Augusta Treverorum and became an archbishopric under Charlemagne, with Metz, Toul and Verdun as suffragans. Immunity grants in 772 and 898, followed by full rights over the city and district of Trier around 900, turned the archbishops into territorial lords holding lands along the Moselle from Trier to the Rhine at Koblenz.

The archbishop ruling in 1337 was Baldwin of Luxembourg, elected in 1307 at the age of twenty-two. Brother of Emperor Henry VII, he reformed the archiepiscopal administration, preserved its archives, built the Baldwin Bridge at Koblenz and for a time also administered Mainz, Worms and Speyer. A university was founded at Trier in 1473, and the Reichstag of 1512 settled the structure of the Imperial Circles there. The territory was badly scarred by the witch trials of 1581 to 1593 and by repeated French occupations from the Thirty Years' War onward; the destruction of 1688 and 1689 left the city without walls and only about two and a half thousand people. The electors had meanwhile moved their residence to Ehrenbreitstein near Koblenz. French Republican troops took Trier in 1794, the left-bank lands were annexed in 1801, and the surviving territory was secularized and granted to Nassau-Weilburg in 1803.
zh:
特里尔选侯国是特里尔大主教的教会领地，大主教是神圣罗马帝国三位教会选帝侯之一，并兼任勃艮第-阿尔勒王国的大首相。主教区的历史可追溯到罗马城市奥古斯塔·特雷维洛伦，查理曼时代升为大主教区，下辖梅斯、图勒和凡尔登三个主教区。772年和898年的免税豁免特权，加上900年前后取得特里尔城及周边地区的完整治权，使大主教成为割据一方的领土领主，领有沿摩泽尔河从特里尔到莱茵河畔科布伦茨的土地。

1337年在位的大主教是卢森堡的鲍德温，他于1307年年仅二十二岁时当选。作为皇帝亨利七世之弟，他改革了大主教区的行政、保存了教区档案，在科布伦茨修建鲍德温桥，并曾兼管美因茨、沃尔姆斯和施派尔三个主教区。1473年特里尔大学创立，1512年的帝国议会在当地确定了帝国行政圈的框架。1581至1593年的猎巫审判使领地深受创痛；自三十年战争起，法军又一再占领此地，1688至1689年的破坏使特里尔城墙尽毁，居民只剩约两千五百人。此时选帝侯早已把居所迁到科布伦茨附近的埃伦布赖特施泰因。1794年法兰西共和国军队攻占特里尔，1801年莱茵河左岸土地被法国吞并，残存领地于1803年被世俗化，划归拿骚-威尔堡。

en:
The Shamkhalate of Tarki was a Kumyk state in the eastern North Caucasus, ruled from Caspian Tarki by a prince titled shamkhal, who also styled himself Vali of Dagestan. It held the mountain fastness of Gazi-Kumukh; at its height its vassals stretched from the Caspian to Kabarda.

In the fifteenth century the shamkhal headed a loose highland alliance, and under Chopan-shamkhal in the sixteenth his power peaked: his sister married Iran's Shah Tahmasp I, and his raids reached Shirvan and Georgia.

Rivalry with Russia began with the Terki fortress in 1588, though Kumyks destroyed a Russian army at Karaman in 1605. The shamkhalate entered the Ottoman Empire in the 1580s, split into Kumyk fiefdoms in the early seventeenth century, was briefly abolished after Peter the Great's Persian campaign and restored in 1734. The Treaty of Gulistan confirmed Russia's annexation in 1813; uprisings followed in 1823 and 1831.
zh:
塔尔基沙姆哈尔国是北高加索东部的库梅克人国家，由拥有“沙姆哈尔”头衔的王公统治，都于里海沿岸的塔尔基，沙姆哈尔还自称达吉斯坦瓦利。它据有山中要塞加齐库穆赫，鼎盛时附庸从里海延伸到卡巴尔达。

15世纪沙姆哈尔统领松散的山区联盟，16世纪乔潘沙姆哈尔在位时势力达到顶峰：其姐妹嫁给伊朗沙赫塔赫马斯普一世，兵锋远及希尔凡和格鲁吉亚。

1588年俄国修建捷尔基要塞，双方就此长期对抗，库梅克人1605年在卡拉曼歼灭一支俄军。1580年代它并入奥斯曼帝国，17世纪初分裂为库梅克领地，彼得大帝波斯远征后一度被废，1734年恢复。1813年《古利斯坦条约》确认俄国吞并，1823年和1831年先后爆发反俄起义。

en:
The barony of Turn represents the Bernese Oberland estates of the Freiherren von Turn, a mighty Valais noble house. Probably descended from Dauphiné's La Tour-du-Pin barons, it settled in the Valais in the twelfth century as vassals of St. Maurice Abbey; Wilhelm I built the Gestelnburg around 1170.

As Sion's guardians, the von Turn controlled much of the Rhône valley in the thirteenth century; Johann I's marriage to Elisabeth of Wädenswil brought him Frutigen, Mülenen and the Lauterbrunnen valley, held in 1337 by his son Peter III.

Peter then warred on the pro-Savoyard bishop Guichard Tavelli, and in 1375 Anton von Turn had the bishop murdered; driven from the Valais, Anton saw the Gestelnburg destroyed in 1384 and sold the Lauterbrunnen estates to Interlaken Abbey in 1395 and Frutigen to Bern in 1400. The line died out with Anton in 1405.
zh:
图恩男爵领代表图恩男爵（冯·图恩）家族在伯尔尼高地的产业，该家族是瓦莱望族。他们可能出身多菲内的拉图尔迪潘男爵家族，12世纪作为圣莫里斯修道院的封臣定居瓦莱；威廉一世约1170年修建格斯特尔恩堡。

作为锡永的守护者，图恩家族13世纪控制罗讷河谷的大片土地；约翰一世娶韦德尼斯维尔的伊丽莎白为妻，得到弗鲁蒂根、米莱嫩和劳特布伦嫩山谷，1337年由其子彼得三世领有。

此后彼得与亲萨伏依主教吉沙尔·塔韦利交战，1375年安东·冯·图恩派人刺杀主教；被逐出瓦莱后，安东眼见格斯特尔恩堡于1384年被毁，又在1395年把劳特布伦嫩产业卖给因特拉肯修道院，1400年把弗鲁蒂根卖给伯尔尼。1405年安东去世，家族绝嗣。

en:
Travunija was a South Slavic principality centered on Trebinje, in the region later known as Herzegovina. It passed through several noble families under medieval Serbian rule, including the Vojinović family during the Nemanjić dynasty.

After Nikola Altomanović was defeated in 1373, his lands were divided among neighboring rulers. Trebinje came under the Bosnian crown and was held by the Pavlović and later the Kosača family; Ottoman forces conquered the remaining Kosača lands in 1481.
zh:
特拉武尼亚是一个以特雷比涅为中心的南斯拉夫公国，位于后来称为黑塞哥维那的地区。中世纪塞尔维亚统治时期，这片土地先后由多个贵族家族掌管，尼曼雅王朝时期的沃伊诺维奇家族便是其中之一。

1373年尼古拉·阿尔托马诺维奇战败后，他的领地被邻近的统治者瓜分。特雷比涅归属波斯尼亚王室，先由帕夫洛维奇家族、后由科萨查家族掌管；1481年奥斯曼军队征服了科萨查家族剩余的领地。

en:
Tripoli began as the Phoenician city of Oea and became the chief city of Roman Tripolitania. The Arabs took it in the 640s, and after Fatimid, Almohad and Hafsid rule it passed in 1324 to the Banu Thabit, Berber amirs who ruled an effectively independent city-state in the name of Tunis, rich from Mediterranean trade.

The Genoese sacked Tripoli in 1354 and sold it to the Banu Makki of Gabès, but the exiled Banu Thabit retook the city in 1369 with chartered Christian ships. Hafsid armies returned and extinguished the dynasty in 1401, restoring direct rule.

Spain conquered Tripoli in 1510, handing it to the Knights of St John, until the Ottoman commander Turgut Reis took it in 1551. It became a Barbary corsair base, and from 1711 the Karamanli dynasty ruled a virtually independent pashalik until direct Ottoman rule returned in 1835.
zh:
的黎波里最初是腓尼基人建立的奥亚城，后来成为罗马的黎波里塔尼亚三城之首。7世纪40年代阿拉伯人夺取该城，历经法蒂玛、穆瓦希德和哈夫斯王朝统治后，于1324年落入巴努萨比特家族之手；这些柏柏尔埃米尔以突尼斯名义治理一座靠地中海贸易致富、实际独立的城邦。

1354年热那亚人洗劫的黎波里，把它卖给加贝斯的巴努马基家族；流亡的萨比特家族租用基督徒船只，于1369年收复该城。哈夫斯大军卷土重来，于1401年终结该王朝，恢复直接统治。

1510年西班牙征服的黎波里，交给圣约翰骑士团，1551年奥斯曼将领图尔古特·雷斯将其攻取。此后它成为柏柏尔海盗基地，1711年起卡拉曼利王朝以近乎独立的帕夏领统治该地，直到1835年奥斯曼恢复直接统治。

en:
The Principality of Tarusa was a minor Russian state centered on the town of Tarusa on the Oka River and one of the Upper Oka Principalities. It arose around 1246, when Yury Mikhailovich, a son of Prince Mikhail of Chernigov, received Tarusa as his appanage. His descendants later divided it into smaller holdings such as Obolensk.

From the 1350s the Tarusa princes leaned on Moscow, and in 1392 the principality was annexed by the Grand Principality of Moscow. Its princely lines then entered Muscovite service, and Tarusa was later among the fortified border towns Ivan III bequeathed to his son Vasily in 1503.
zh:
塔鲁萨公国是以奥卡河畔塔鲁萨城为中心的罗斯小邦，属于上奥卡公国群之一。它约形成于1246年，切尔尼戈夫王公米哈伊尔之子尤里·米哈伊洛维奇分得塔鲁萨作为世袭领地，其后裔后来把它分割成奥博连斯克等更小的封邑。

14世纪50年代起，塔鲁萨诸王公倚重莫斯科，1392年公国被莫斯科大公国兼并。各支王公随后转入莫斯科服役，塔鲁萨后来也跻身1503年伊凡三世留给其子瓦西里的边境要塞城镇之列。

en: The Taontaenrat were a Wendat nation in the region between Georgian Bay and Lake Simcoe, in present-day Ontario. They joined the Wendat confederacy around 1610. During the Beaver Wars, the Haudenosaunee defeated and dispersed the Wendat, whose survivors fled to other peoples or were adopted by their enemies.
zh: 陶安泰恩拉特是温达特联盟的一个部族，居住在今安大略省乔治亚湾与锡姆科湖之间的地区。他们约于1610年加入温达特联盟。在海狸战争中，豪德诺索尼人击败并驱散了温达特人，幸存者逃往其他族群或被敌人收养。

en:
Treviso was a commune north of Venice that gained independence after the Peace of Constance in 1183. Gherardo da Camino took power in 1283, beginning a period of rule by his family, before Verona's Scaligeri seized the city in 1329.

Treviso submitted to Venice in 1339, but passed to Austria in 1381 and to the Carrara lords of Padua in 1384. Venice recovered it in 1388 and fortified it; French troops took the city in 1797, and it later passed to Austria.
zh:
特雷维索是威尼斯以北的一座自治市，在1183年《康斯坦茨和约》后获得独立。盖拉尔多·达卡米诺于1283年掌权，开启了家族统治；1329年，维罗纳的斯卡利杰里家族夺取了该城。

特雷维索于1339年归附威尼斯，但在1381年转交奥地利，1384年又落入帕多瓦的卡拉拉家族手中。威尼斯于1388年收复并加固该城；法国军队于1797年占领特雷维索，此后它转归奥地利。

en:
Tyrconnell, in Irish Tír Chonaill, was the Gaelic kingdom of the Cenél Conaill, a Northern Uí Néill people descended from Conall Gulban. Once part of the overkingdom of Ailech, it emerged as a kingdom in the twelfth century under the O'Donnell clan, whose power centred on Donegal Castle in County Donegal.

The O'Donnells were often at war with the rival O'Neills of Tyrone to the east, defeating them in 1522 and 1567, and Manus O'Donnell took part in the crown's surrender and regrant settlement in 1541.

In the Nine Years' War of 1593 to 1603 Red Hugh O'Donnell stood beside Hugh O'Neill until the defeat at Kinsale in 1601. His brother Rory became Earl of Tyrconnell in 1603, but joined the Flight of the Earls in 1607, and his title was attainted in 1614; the kingdom was then planted under the Plantation of Ulster.
zh:
蒂康奈尔的爱尔兰语作Tír Chonaill，是北尼尔支系康尼尔·康纳尔人的盖尔王国，自认是科纳尔·古尔班的后裔。它原属阿莱赫大王权，12世纪分离为独立王国，由奥唐奈家族统治，权力中心在多尼戈尔郡的多尼戈尔城堡。

奥唐奈家族大半历史在与东邻蒂龙的奥尼尔家族交战，于1522年和1567年两度击败对方；马努斯·奥唐奈还于1541年参与王室的“交土再封”。

1593至1603年的九年战争中，“红休”奥唐奈与休·奥尼尔并肩作战，直到1601年金塞尔之役战败。其弟罗里于1603年受封蒂康奈尔伯爵，却在1607年参与“伯爵出逃”，爵位于1614年被剥夺，王国随后在阿尔斯特殖民中被瓜分安置。

en: The Tsamosa represent Southwestern Coast Salish communities in present-day Washington, including the Upper and Lower Chehalis along the Chehalis River. Their villages were independent, and the Upper Chehalis maintained prairies by annual burning. In 1792 Robert Gray visited the Lower Chehalis at Grays Harbor. An 1830 malaria epidemic devastated the lower Columbia region and reshaped neighbouring communities.
zh: 萨莫萨指今华盛顿州境内的西南海岸萨利什社群，包括奇黑利斯河沿岸的上、下奇黑利斯人。他们的村落各自独立，上奇黑利斯人每年放火维护草地。1792年罗伯特·格雷在格雷斯港拜访了下奇黑利斯人。1830年的疟疾流行重创哥伦比亚河下游地区，改变了邻近社群的构成。

en:
Tesechoacan was a river town on the stream of the same name, a tributary of the Papaloapan in southern Veracruz. In pre-Hispanic times it was one of the subject towns of the senorio of Guaspaltepec, and so shared its fate: already under Mexica rule when the Spaniards came, it was conquered in Gonzalo de Sandoval's 1522 campaign and then distributed in encomienda.

In 1742 San Miguel Tesechoacan was still a self-governing republica de indios, though its indigenous families had mostly withdrawn after quarrels with the mulato and black settlers there; the remaining community traded cotton for cochineal with Villa Alta in Oaxaca. It became a municipality in 1831.
zh:
特塞乔阿坎是同名河畔的城镇，临韦拉克鲁斯南部帕帕洛阿潘河的一条支流。先西班牙时期，它是瓜斯帕尔特佩克领主邦的属镇之一，与该邦同命运：西班牙人到来时它已处在墨西加统治之下，1522年贡萨洛·德·桑多瓦尔征战时将它征服，随后被纳入监护征赋制。

1742年，圣米格尔·特塞乔阿坎仍是自治的印第安人共和国，但当地印第安人家族已因与定居于此的穆拉托人和黑人家庭冲突而大多迁出，留下的社群用棉花向瓦哈卡的比亚阿尔塔换取胭脂虫红。1831年，它成为市镇。

en: The Tsonga were Bantu-speaking communities of southern Mozambique and neighbouring parts of southern Africa. Among the groups identified in the region between 1500 and 1650 were the Mpfumo, Valenga and Vacopi, each with its own leaders.
zh: 聪加人是莫桑比克南部及南部非洲邻近地区说班图语的群体。1500—1650年间，这一地区有姆普富莫、瓦伦加和瓦乔皮等群体，各有自己的首领。

en:
The Tsakho, or Zagunao tusi, were a hereditary Gyalrong chieftaincy and one of the eighteen Gyalrong chiefdoms, holding valleys in present-day Sichuan with its seat at Zagunao. In 1407 its headman Apiao submitted to the Ming and was named pacification commissioner over the old Weizhou border forts.

The rising Muping tusi invaded and partly occupied its lands in 1449, but Tsakho recovered its full territory by 1469. During the Ming-Qing transition the chieftains Sangjipeng and his son Liang'erji expanded: by 1683 they had swallowed several smaller chiefdoms and, through marriage ties to other tusi, ruled a thousand-li stretch with over ten thousand households, making it the strongest Gyalrong chiefdom.

The Qing court split off the Somang tusi in 1721 and the Choktse and Tangpa tusi in 1748. In 1752 the chieftain Cangwang revolted and attacked Somang and Choktse, was captured and executed, and the court replaced native rule with military colonies and created Zagu Subprefecture.
zh:
杂谷（又称杂谷脑）土司是世袭的嘉绒人土司，为嘉绒十八土司之一，辖今四川一带河谷，治所在杂谷脑。1407年头人阿漂归附明朝，授安抚司，命其抚辑旧维州诸寨。

1449年崛起的穆坪土司大举入侵，占据部分土地，杂谷于1469年恢复旧疆。明清交替之际，土司桑吉朋、良尔吉父子持续扩张，到1683年已攻灭数个小土司，又与邻近诸司联姻，辖地绵延一千里、有百姓一万余户，成为嘉绒最强的土司。

清廷转而分而治之，1721年分置梭磨土司，1748年又分置卓克基、党坝二司。1752年土司苍旺起兵反叛、攻打梭磨和卓克基，被擒杀，清廷随即改土归屯，设杂谷厅。

en:
Tenasserim is the long coastal salient on the western side of the Malay Peninsula, where Mon-speaking ports face the Andaman Sea. Chinese records knew the area as Tun Sun, while the north belonged to the Mon kingdom of Thaton until King Anawrahta folded the coast into the Pagan Empire after 1057.

When Bagan fell in 1287, Tenasserim passed to the Siamese kingdom of Sukhothai, whose vassal it remained in 1337, and then to Ayutthaya. The Siamese founded the walled port of Tenasserim in 1383, and together with Tavoy and Mergui it handled Ayutthaya's Indian Ocean trade.

Bayinnaung of Toungoo conquered the coast in 1564, and although Ayutthaya retook the south by 1599, King Anaukpetlun recovered the northern half in 1614. The Konbaung kings seized the coastline between 1760 and 1765, and the Treaty of Yandabo transferred it to the British in 1826.
zh:
丹那沙林是马来半岛西侧一条狭长的滨海地带，孟人港口面向安达曼海。中国史籍称这一带为顿逊，北部原属孟人的直通王国，1057年以后阿奴律陀王把整条海岸纳入蒲甘帝国。

1287年蒲甘灭亡后，丹那沙林转入暹罗的素可泰王国之手，1337年时仍是它的藩属，之后又归阿瑜陀耶。暹罗人于1383年筑起有城墙的丹那沙林港，它与土瓦、丹老一起承担阿瑜陀耶的印度洋贸易。

1564年东吁的勃印曩征服这条海岸，阿瑜陀耶虽在1599年前收复南段，阿瑙白龙王又于1614年夺回北半段。1760至1765年间贡榜王朝夺取整条海岸线，1826年《杨达波条约》把它割让给英国。

en:
Tsenacommacah was the homeland of Native peoples in the Tidewater region of Virginia, including the Powhatan Confederacy. When English settlers founded Jamestown in 1607, the Powhatan were led by Wahunsunacawh.

Three wars followed between the colonists and the confederacy, ending in 1646 with the capture and death of Opechancanough. The Treaty of Middle Plantation in 1677 established reservations after Bacon's Rebellion.
zh:
塞纳科马克是弗吉尼亚潮汐地区原住民的家园，其中包括波瓦坦联盟。1607年英国殖民者建立詹姆斯敦时，波瓦坦人由瓦亨苏纳科领导。

殖民者与联盟随后爆发三次战争，至1646年奥佩昌卡诺被俘身亡时结束。培根起义后，1677年的《中种植园条约》设立了保留地。

en: The Tsoyaha, also called Yuchi, lived in the eastern Tennessee valley in the sixteenth century and later moved south toward Muscogee communities. In 1714 Cherokee warriors destroyed their town of Chestowee; Yuchi also joined the war against South Carolina in 1715. In the 1830s the United States forcibly relocated remaining Yuchi bands alongside the Muscogee to Indian Territory.
zh: 佐亚哈人又称尤奇人，16世纪住在田纳西河东部流域，后来南迁至马斯科吉人聚居地附近。1714年，切罗基战士摧毁了他们的切斯托维镇；1715年，尤奇人也参加了反对南卡罗来纳殖民地的战争。19世纪30年代，美国将剩余的尤奇人部众与马斯科吉人一起强制迁往印第安领地。

en:
Tuf Shur Tia, the Green Reed Place in Southern Tiwa, is the indigenous name of the pueblo the Spaniards called Sandía, after the watermelon-red glow of its mountains at sunset. Its people had lived on this Rio Grande bend near present-day Albuquerque since the fourteenth century, when the country held over twenty pueblos.

Coronado's expedition reached it around 1540, and after 1610 Franciscans built the mission of San Francisco, whose tribute demands and forced labour in church building and mines turned the pueblo against colonial rule.

Tuf Shur Tia joined the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 led by Popé, and its people took refuge among the Hopi; the governor burned the already abandoned village. Four hundred and forty-one survivors returned and resettled in 1742, and in 1762 the governor had the pueblo rebuilt as a buffer against raiders; the community preserved its Southern Tiwa speech and ceremonies.
zh:
图夫舒尔蒂亚是南蒂瓦语“绿芦之地”，即西班牙人所称的桑迪亚普韦布洛——他们见附近山峦落日下呈西瓜红色，便以“西瓜”名之。蒂瓦人14世纪起居住在格兰德河河湾，即今阿尔伯克基附近，当时这一带有二十多座普韦布洛。

1540年前后科罗纳多远征队抵达，1610年后方济各会修士建起圣弗朗西斯科传教站；贡赋勒索以及建教堂、下矿井的苦役，使这座普韦布洛与殖民当局为敌。

图夫舒尔蒂亚参加了1680年波佩领导的普韦布洛起义，居民逃往霍皮人处避难，总督焚毁了已撤空的村镇。1742年四百四十一名幸存者返乡重新定居，1762年总督下令重建此镇，作为抵御袭扰的屏障，重建后的社区保存了南蒂瓦语和传统仪式。

en: The Tsawi were a southern band of the Pawnee, whose earth-lodge villages stood near the Loup, Republican and South Platte rivers in present-day Nebraska and Kansas. The Tsawi generally held the leading political position among the Pawnee bands, though each band governed its own affairs.
zh: 察维是波尼人的南方部族，波尼人的土屋村落分布在今内布拉斯加州和堪萨斯州的卢普河、里帕布利肯河及南普拉特河附近。察维通常在波尼各部中居于政治上的主导地位，但各部各自处理事务。

en:
Teutila was a small Popoloca-speaking polity in the lower Papaloapan valley, in present-day northern Oaxaca, ruling the neighbouring towns of Ixcatlan and Oxitlan. The Popoloca were Oto-Manguean farmers of the hill country, dismissed by Nahuatl speakers as speakers of a barbarous tongue.

Mexica armies campaigned through the region from 1456, planting garrisons and tribute collectors, so that Teutila's lands were drawn into the Aztec tribute system. The expeditions of Hernan Cortes reached the area in 1521, followed by encomiendas and the colonial tribute regime.
zh:
特乌蒂拉是帕帕洛阿潘河下游一个讲波波洛卡语的小邦，地处今瓦哈卡州北部，统辖邻近的伊斯卡特兰和奥希特兰两镇。波波洛卡人属奥托-曼格语系，在山区务农，讲纳瓦特尔语的人曾把他们的语言当作蛮语。

1456年起墨西加军队攻入这一地区，设置驻军和贡税官吏，特乌蒂拉的土地被纳入阿兹特克的朝贡体系。1521年埃尔南·科尔特斯的远征队到达此地，随后监护征赋制和殖民地贡税制度相继建立。

en:
Tamtoc, whose Huastec name means place of the water clouds, was a great Huastec city on the Tampaón River in the heart of the Huasteca. Founded around 600 BC, it was rebuilt on a new plan between 600 and 900 and entered its greatest age from 900 onward, growing to some 210 hectares and becoming the leading centre of the Huastec world.

Its sculptors carved sandstone stelae and statues from Sierra de Tanchipa quarries, and the prominence of women among its burials and figurines suggests they held high rank in the city. Around 1350 Tamtoc lost its regional hegemony and was abandoned, so that when Spanish forces overran the Huasteca after 1519 only ruins remained.
zh:
塔姆托克在瓦斯特克语中意为水云之地，是瓦斯特卡腹地坦帕翁河畔的一座瓦斯特克大城。它约建于公元前600年，600—900年间按新规划重建，900年以后进入鼎盛期，面积约210公顷，成为瓦斯特克世界首屈一指的中心。

工匠从坦奇帕山采石场取来砂岩雕成石像与石碑，墓葬和陶俑中女性占突出地位，说明女性在城中地位很高。约1350年塔姆托克失去地区霸权并遭废弃，1519年以后西班牙军队征服瓦斯特卡时，只剩废墟尚存。

en:
Trieste, the Roman Tergeste, was a small Adriatic port whose medieval commune prospered on maritime trade. In 788 it submitted to Charlemagne, and by the thirteenth century it had become a trade rival of Venice, which occupied the city from 1283 to 1287. In 1337 Trieste still governed itself as a free commune under its consuls.

Venice made war again in 1368 and held the city until 1372; after the Peace of Turin of 1381 renounced Venetian claims, its leading citizens petitioned the Habsburg duke and submitted voluntarily in 1382.

Trieste kept broad autonomy under the Habsburgs but suffered Frederick III's sack of 1468 and 1469, remembered as the Destruction of Trieste, and a brief Venetian occupation in 1508. Its fortunes revived when Charles VI made it a free port in 1719, opening prosperous decades as Austria's main harbour.
zh:
的里雅斯特古称特尔格斯泰，是亚得里亚海畔的小港口，中世纪公社靠海上贸易致富。788年它臣服查理曼，到13世纪成为威尼斯的贸易竞争者，威尼斯曾在1283年至1287年占领该城。1337年，的里雅斯特仍由执政官以自由公社形式自治。

1368年威尼斯再度开战，城市被占领至1372年；1381年《都灵和约》使威尼斯放弃主权要求后，城中显贵向哈布斯堡公爵请愿，于1382年签署自愿臣服协议。

的里雅斯特在哈布斯堡治下保留广泛自治权，但1468年至1469年遭腓特烈三世洗劫，史称“的里雅斯特之毁”，1508年又被威尼斯短暂占领。1719年查理六世将它辟为自由港，城市由此复兴，成为奥地利的主要港口。

en:
The Tutelo were a Siouan-speaking people of the uplands of Virginia and West Virginia. Pressed by English settlers and the Haudenosaunee, they joined related peoples including the Saponi and lived near Fort Christanna after 1714.

The Tutelo moved north in the 1730s and were adopted by the Cayuga in 1753. After the Sullivan expedition destroyed their village of Coreorgonel in 1779, they followed their Cayuga relatives to Canada.
zh:
图特洛是弗吉尼亚和西弗吉尼亚高地上讲苏语的民族。受到英国殖民者和易洛魁联盟的压力，他们与萨波尼等近缘族群联合，1714年后住在克里斯塔纳堡附近。

图特洛人在1730年代北迁，1753年被卡尤加人接纳。1779年沙利文远征军摧毁他们的科雷奥戈内尔村后，他们随卡尤加亲族迁往加拿大。

en:
Tortona, the Roman colony of Dertona founded around 123 BC, was one of the chief military stations of the western Po valley. An early bishopric grew up there, and bishops ruled the city until the ninth century. In 1090 Tortona became a free commune.

The commune took the Guelph side in the struggles of Lombardy: Frederick Barbarossa captured it after a siege in 1155 and razed the city to the ground. Rebuilt, it never fully escaped its stronger neighbours, and from 1260 it passed between local lords and adventurers. In 1337 it still kept its communal institutions, but in 1347 the Visconti of Milan incorporated it into the Duchy of Milan, under which it remained until 1735.

In the War of the Polish Succession the King of Sardinia occupied Tortona, and the title Count of Tortona was added to those of the House of Savoy.
zh:
托尔托纳古称德尔托纳，约公元前123年建为罗马殖民地，是波河平原西部最重要的军事据点之一。城中很早就设立主教区，9世纪以前一直由主教统治，1090年成为自由公社。

公社在伦巴第纷争中站在圭尔夫派一边，1155年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨围攻后攻陷该城，将其夷为平地。重建后的托尔托纳始终无法完全摆脱强邻觊觎，1260年起相继受制于一系列地方领主和冒险家。1337年它仍保留公社制度，但1347年米兰的维斯孔蒂家族把它并入米兰公国，此后一直隶属米兰直到1735年。

波兰王位继承战争期间，撒丁国王占领托尔托纳，“托尔托纳伯爵”也成为萨伏依家族的头衔之一。

en: The Totorame inhabited the coast and valleys of southern Sinaloa and northern Nayarit, with a principal lordship at Chiametlan, now Chametla. They farmed maize, beans and chili peppers, fished and traded salt with neighboring peoples.
zh: 托托拉梅人居住在锡那罗亚南部和纳亚里特北部的海岸与河谷，主要领地位于奇亚梅特兰，即今恰梅特拉。他们种植玉米、豆类和辣椒，以捕鱼为生，并与邻人交换食盐。

en:
The Tsitsistas were an Algonquian-speaking people of the Great Plains and a principal component of the Cheyenne. From villages in Minnesota they moved west to the Missouri and adopted horses, introducing them to Lakota bands around 1730.

The Cheyenne Council of Forty-four brought together chiefs from ten bands. Around 1811 the Cheyenne allied with the Arapaho, and after 1832 the Tsitsistas merged with the closely related Suhtai.
zh:
齐齐斯塔斯是大平原上讲阿尔冈昆语的族群，也是夏安人的主要组成部分。他们从明尼苏达的村落西迁至密苏里河，并开始使用马匹，约1730年又将马匹传给拉科塔部族。

夏安人的四十四人议事会汇集了十个部族的首领。约1811年，夏安人与阿拉帕霍人结盟；1832年后，齐齐斯塔斯与关系密切的苏泰奥人合并。

en: The Tatuy were Indigenous communities of the Mérida Andes in present-day Venezuela, with a settlement on the plateau later occupied by the city of Mérida. The Spanish expedition of Juan Rodríguez Suárez encountered them in 1558. After the Spanish founded Mérida, colonial authorities reorganized Indigenous settlements to control labor, production and religious life.
zh: 塔图伊是今委内瑞拉梅里达安第斯山地区的原住民社群，曾在后来梅里达城所在的高原上建立聚落。1558年，胡安·罗德里格斯·苏亚雷斯率领的西班牙远征队与他们接触。西班牙人建立梅里达后，殖民当局重新编排原住民聚落，以控制劳动力、生产和宗教生活。

en:
Acolhuacan was the polity of the Acolhua people, whose capital Tetzcoco was an altepetl on the eastern shore of Lake Texcoco, probably founded by Chichimecs in the twelfth century. Around 1337 the Acolhua, with Tepanec help, drove the Chichimecs out and made it the capital under Quinatzin (r. 1298–1357), replacing Coatlinchan.

In 1418 Tezozomoc of Azcapotzalco dethroned Tetzcoco's ruler Ixtlilxochitl I, but Ixtlilxochitl's son Nezahualcoyotl allied with the Mexica and in 1428 defeated the usurper Maxtla. Tetzcoco then joined Tenochtitlan and Tlacopan in the Triple Alliance, receiving two fifths of the tribute and ranking second only to Tenochtitlan.

Nezahualcoyotl, a poet, made his court a centre of learning famed for its library. In 1520 Cortés occupied the city and killed its ruler Cacamatzin, and from Tetzcoco he launched the 1521 siege that destroyed Tenochtitlan.
zh:
阿科尔瓦坎是阿科尔瓦人的政权，都城特斯科科位于同名湖东岸，12世纪时大概由奇奇梅克人建立。约1337年，阿科尔瓦人在特帕内克人帮助下将奇奇梅克人逐出特斯科科，取科阿特林昌而代之，在基纳钦（1298—1357年在位）治下定都。

1418年阿斯卡波察尔科的特索索莫克废黜特斯科科君主伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世，后者之子内萨瓦尔科约特尔联合墨西加人，于1428年击败篡位者马克斯特拉。特斯科科随即与特诺奇蒂特兰、特拉科潘结成三方同盟，分得五分之二的贡赋，地位仅次于特诺奇蒂特兰。

诗人内萨瓦尔科约特尔把宫廷变成学术中心，以藏书馆闻名。1520年科尔特斯占领该城并杀死君主卡卡马辛，随后以此为基地，于1521年围城摧毁特诺奇蒂特兰。

en: The Tula were a people of western Arkansas, possibly living in the valleys of the Ouachita Mountains. In 1541 Hernando de Soto's expedition entered their territory and fought several clashes with them; his secretary Rodrigo Ranjel described them as formidable fighters. The Tula may later have joined other Caddo groups.
zh: 图利亚人是今阿肯色州西部的族群，可能居住在沃希托山脉的河谷中。1541年，埃尔南多·德·索托的探险队进入他们的领地，双方多次交战；索托的秘书罗德里戈·兰赫尔称他们善于作战。图利亚人后来可能融入了其他卡多族群。

en:
Tübingen was the seat of the counts palatine of Swabia, a dynasty established at Hohentübingen Castle, first mentioned in 1078. From 1146 Count Hugo V styled himself count palatine, rewarded for his services to the first Staufer king, Conrad III. As the emperor's representative in Swabia he held minting rights, and the Tübingen pfennig was struck from 1185.

The family was a great founder of monasteries, among them Bebenhausen in 1183. Repeated partitions and lavish piety gradually ruined the counts, and their lines at Horb, Böblingen and Asberg died out one by one.

Debt dogged the family, and in 1342 Emperor Louis the Bavarian ordered Count Gottfried to make restitution, forcing him to sell the town and castle of Tübingen to Count Ulrich III of Württemberg for 20,000 gold hellers. Lesser branches survived as minor lords until the seventeenth century.
zh:
蒂宾根是施瓦本行宫伯爵的治所，家族盘踞霍亨蒂宾根堡，该堡最早见于1078年记载。1146年起胡戈五世自称行宫伯爵，这是他效力首位施陶芬国王康拉德三世所得的封赏；作为皇帝在施瓦本公国的代表，他拥有铸币权，蒂宾根芬尼银币从1185年开始铸造。

该家族热衷于兴建修道院，1183年的贝本豪森修道院便出自其手。不断分家加上慷慨的宗教施舍使伯爵们日渐穷困，霍尔布、伯布林根和阿斯贝格各支相继绝嗣。

债务始终缠绕这个家族，1342年皇帝巴伐利亚人路易下令戈特弗里德伯爵赔偿，他被迫以两万金赫勒把蒂宾根城和城堡卖给符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希三世。余下支系作为小领主延续到17世纪。

en:
Tuckabutchee was an Upper Creek town on the Tallapoosa River in present-day Alabama and one of the four mother towns of the Muscogee Confederacy. It was home to Big Warrior, a principal Creek chief.

In 1811 Tecumseh and Tenskwatawa addressed Creek leaders in the town square, seeking support against American expansion. During the Creek War in 1813, Red Stick rebels besieged Tuckabutchee; warriors from Cusseta came to its aid. The war ended in 1814 with the Treaty of Fort Jackson and a vast Muscogee land cession.
zh:
塔卡巴奇是今亚拉巴马州塔拉普萨河畔的上游克里克城镇，也是马斯科吉联盟的四座母城之一。克里克主要酋长大勇士居住于此。

1811年，特库姆塞和滕斯克瓦塔瓦在城镇广场向克里克首领演说，寻求支持以抵抗美国扩张。1813年克里克战争期间，红棍派叛军围攻塔卡巴奇，卡西塔的战士前来援助。战争于1814年以《杰克逊堡条约》结束，马斯科吉人割让了大片土地。

en:
The Tujia lived in the Wuling Mountains at the junction of Hunan, Hubei, Guizhou and Chongqing. Hereditary Tujia chieftains governed local territories under the Ming dynasty, supplying soldiers for campaigns including the defense against coastal raiders in the sixteenth century.

The Qing court replaced many hereditary chiefs with appointed officials in a policy known as gaituguiliu. Most Tujia areas came under direct administration between 1728 and 1735.
zh:
土家人居住在湖南、湖北、贵州和重庆交界的武陵山区。明代土家世袭土司统治地方，并为朝廷提供兵员，包括在16世纪参与抵御沿海倭寇。

清廷推行改土归流，以委任官员取代许多世袭土司。1728—1735年间，大部分土家地区转入朝廷直接管辖。

en:
Toul stands on the Moselle in Lorraine, on the site of the Gallic town of Tullum Leucorum. Its bishopric was founded in the mid-fourth century as a suffragan of Trier, and from 925 Toul formed part of the Holy Roman Empire; in 1048 the bishop's lands became an imperial state and the city a free imperial city.

The see was one of the three Lotharingian bishoprics, with Metz and Verdun, and became a centre of church reform. Bishop Brun of Toul was elected Pope Leo IX in 1049. Bishop Konrad Probus, appointed in 1278, surrendered the episcopal advocacy to the dukes of Lorraine, while the city freed itself from episcopal rule and the bishops withdrew to their stronghold at Liverdun.

In 1552 King Henry II of France occupied Toul with Metz and Verdun, recognised by the Empire only in the Peace of Westphalia of 1648; the old diocese was suppressed in 1802.
zh:
图勒位于洛林的摩泽尔河畔，所在之地古称高卢城镇图卢姆-勒乌科鲁姆。当地教区4世纪中叶创立，隶属特里尔教省，925年起图勒成为神圣罗马帝国的一部分；1048年主教领地成为帝国邦国，图勒城本城则成为帝国自由市。

图勒教区与梅斯、凡尔登并称洛林三主教区，并成为教会改革的中心，图勒主教布鲁恩于1049年当选教皇利奥九世。1278年获任命的主教康拉德·普罗布斯把主教护领权让给洛林公爵，城市也摆脱主教统治，主教们退居其据点利韦尔丹。

1552年法国国王亨利二世出兵占领图勒以及梅斯、凡尔登，帝国直到1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》才承认这一损失，古老教区于1802年被撤销。

en:
The Tunisia of 1337 was the Hafsid Sultanate, a Sunni Berber dynasty ruling Ifriqiya, the eastern Maghreb, from Tunis. Its founder Abu Zakariya Yahya, an Almohad governor, declared himself independent in 1229; successors took the caliphal title and made Tunis a haven for Andalusi refugees, full of madrasas and birthplace of Ibn Khaldun.

The dynasty split into a Tunis branch and a western branch ruling from Béjaïa and Constantine, until Abu Yahya Abu Bakr II (1318 to 1346) reunited the realm. His 1346 death opened a crisis as Morocco's Marinid sultans overran it and briefly held Tunis. Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II restored unity in 1370, and the fifteenth century was the Hafsid apogee: Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II annexed Tripoli in 1401 and Algiers in 1410, and Abu Amr Uthman won suzerainty over neighbouring dynasties.

Caught between Spain and the Ottomans, the Hafsids became Spanish tributaries after Charles V took Tunis in 1535; the Ottomans took it in 1574, carrying the last Hafsid caliph to Constantinople.
zh:
1337年的突尼斯是哈夫斯苏丹国，这个柏柏尔裔逊尼派王朝以突尼斯城为都统治易弗里基叶。开国君主阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚本是穆瓦希德的行省总督，1229年宣布独立；后继者自称哈里发，把突尼斯城建成安达卢斯难民的庇护所，宗教学校林立，伊本·赫勒敦便出生于此。

王朝后来分裂为突尼斯支系与据贝贾亚、君士坦丁而治的西部支系，直到阿布·叶海亚·阿布·贝克尔二世（1318—1346年在位）重新统一全国。他1346年去世后陷入危机，摩洛哥马林人乘虚入侵，一度占领突尼斯城。阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世1370年恢复统一，15世纪成为哈夫斯鼎盛期：阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世1401年吞并的黎波里、1410年吞并阿尔及尔，阿布·阿慕尔·奥斯曼使邻近王朝承认其宗主权。

哈夫斯王朝夹在西班牙与奥斯曼之间，1535年查理五世夺取突尼斯城后沦为西班牙附庸；1574年奥斯曼人攻克该城，末代哈夫斯哈里发被押往君士坦丁堡。

en: Tupiza was a settlement on the Inca road in the southern Bolivian Andes. Diego de Almagro's expedition to Chile regrouped there from late 1535 until January 1536 before continuing south.
zh: 图皮萨是玻利维亚南部安第斯山区印加道路上的一处聚落。迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗远征智利的队伍从1535年末至1536年1月在此集结，然后继续南下。

en:
The Ottoman state began as one of the Turkmen beyliks that succeeded the Seljuk sultanate of Rum, founded around 1299 by Osman of the Kayı clan on the Byzantine frontier of northwestern Anatolia. His son Orhan captured Bursa in 1326 and made it the Ottoman capital, and within a generation Turkish rule had crossed into the Balkans. Murad I crushed the Serbs at Kosovo in 1389 and was killed on the field; Bayezid I defeated the crusaders at Nicopolis in 1396 but was taken prisoner by Timur at Ankara in 1402, opening an eleven-year civil war from which Mehmed I reunited the state. Mehmed II ended the Byzantine Empire by storming Constantinople in 1453, Selim I conquered the Mamluk lands including Egypt in 1517 and assumed the caliphate, and Suleiman, ruling from 1520 to 1566, took Belgrade, won at Mohács in 1526 and besieged Vienna in 1529.

The failed second siege of Vienna in 1683 and the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699 opened an age of territorial retreat, confirmed against Russia by the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774. The Serbian revolution of 1804 and the Greek revolt of 1821 carried Balkan nationalism into the empire's European provinces, while the French seized Algiers in 1830. In 1826 Mahmud II destroyed the reactionary Janissary corps in the Auspicious Incident and began rebuilding the army on European lines, only to face the revolt of Muhammad Ali of Egypt, whose forces advanced as far as Kütahya in 1833.
zh:
奥斯曼国家起家于继承罗姆苏丹国的土库曼贝伊国之一，约1299年由卡耶氏族的奥斯曼在安纳托利亚西北部的拜占庭边境建立。他的儿子奥尔汗于1326年攻占布尔萨并定为都城，不到一代人的时间，突厥人的统治便进入巴尔干。穆拉德一世1389年在科索沃击溃塞尔维亚人并战死沙场；巴耶济德一世1396年在尼科波利斯击败十字军，却在1402年的安卡拉战役中被帖木儿俘虏，引发长达十一年的内战，最终由穆罕默德一世重新统一国家。穆罕默德二世于1453年攻陷君士坦丁堡，终结拜占庭帝国；塞利姆一世1517年征服包括埃及在内的马穆鲁克领地并承袭哈里发之位；1520至1566年在位的苏莱曼攻占贝尔格莱德，1526年赢得莫哈奇战役，1529年围攻维也纳。

1683年第二次维也纳围城失败，1699年的《卡尔洛维茨条约》开启领土收缩的时代，1774年的《库楚克—凯纳尔卡条约》又确认了对俄罗斯的失利。1804年的塞尔维亚革命和1821年的希腊起义把巴尔干民族主义带进帝国的欧洲行省，法国则于1830年夺取阿尔及尔。1826年马哈茂德二世在“吉祥事件”中剿灭守旧的禁卫军，开始按欧洲模式重建军队，却又面临埃及的穆罕默德·阿里叛乱，其军队在1833年推进到屈塔希亚。

en:
The Grand Duchy of Tuscany was an Italian state ruled from Florence. Cosimo I de' Medici, Duke of Florence, conquered Siena in 1555 and brought nearly all Tuscany under his control. Pope Pius V made him grand duke in 1569.

The Medici ruled until their senior line died out in 1737, when Francis Stephen of Lorraine succeeded them. Napoleon later gave Tuscany to the Bourbon-Parma dynasty as the Kingdom of Etruria in 1801 and then annexed it to France; the grand duchy was restored in 1814.
zh:
托斯卡纳大公国是以佛罗伦萨为中心的意大利国家。佛罗伦萨公爵科西莫一世·德·美第奇于1555年征服锡耶纳，将托斯卡纳几乎全境纳入统治。教皇庇护五世于1569年封他为大公。

美第奇家族统治至其长支于1737年绝嗣，洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡继承了大公国。拿破仑后来于1801年将托斯卡纳交给波旁－帕尔马王朝，建立伊特鲁里亚王国，随后又将其并入法国；大公国于1814年复立。

en: Tototepec, bird hill in Nahuatl, was a Huastec, or Teenek, town in the Sierra de Tenango of the Huasteca highlands, in present-day northeastern Hidalgo. It fell with the rest of the Huasteca to Moctezuma I's Aztec armies around 1450, keeping local rule under tribute, and Augustinian friars built a mission church there after the Spanish conquest, completed in 1620.
zh: 托托特佩克在纳瓦特尔语中意为鸟山，是瓦斯特卡高地特南戈山脉中的一座瓦斯特克，即特内切，城镇，位于今伊达尔戈州东北部。约1450年，它与整个瓦斯特卡地区一同被蒙特苏马一世的阿兹特克军队征服，在纳贡条件下保留地方统治；西班牙征服后，奥斯定会修士在此修建传教教堂，于1620年竣工。

en:
The Principality of Turov grew up in the lands of the Dregovich tribe around the town of Turov, said to have been founded by the Varangian prince Tur and first mentioned in 980. Vladimir the Great gave it to his sons, and the Council of Liubech of 1097 turned Turov into a hereditary patrimony of its own Rurikid line.

In 1162 its prince broke free of Kiev, but the principality soon fragmented, with Pinsk going its own way, and its men fought at the Kalka River in 1223. Early in the thirteenth century Turov fell under the sway of the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, and its princes then turned to Lithuania.

The principality joined the Grand Duchy of Lithuania peacefully early in the fourteenth century, though Turov remained under Rurikid princes. Its lands were later distributed among the Grand Duchy's voivodeships.
zh:
图罗夫公国兴起于德列戈维奇人的土地，以图罗夫城为中心；相传该城由瓦良格王公图尔建立，980年首次见于记载。弗拉基米尔大帝曾把它封给儿子们，1097年柳别奇会议使图罗夫成为留里克家族一支的世袭产业。

1162年它脱离基辅独立，但公国很快四分五裂，平斯克另立门户，1223年图罗夫军队还参加了迦勒迦河之战。13世纪初图罗夫沦为加利奇—沃伦王国的附庸，其王公转而投靠立陶宛。

公国于14世纪初和平并入立陶宛大公国，而图罗夫本地仍由留里克家族的王公统治，其土地后来被分划入大公国诸省。

en:
Tozantlan, on the site of the present-day town of Tuzantla, was a pre-Columbian settlement in the eastern uplands of Michoacán. Its Nahuatl name means place where gophers abound, while the Purépecha called it Cusaro or Ocumo, a word meaning Otomi.

Nahuas inhabited the area until the Purépecha Empire absorbed it in the expansion that began under Tariácuri around 1300, after which it lay on the empire's eastern march.
zh:
托赞特兰位于今图桑特拉镇一带，是米却肯东部山地的前哥伦布时期聚落。它的纳瓦特尔语名字意为“囊鼠众多之地”，普雷佩查人则称之为库萨罗或奥库莫，后一个词意为“奥托米”。

纳瓦人曾居住于此，后来在约1300年塔里亚库里开启的普雷佩查扩张中被帝国吞并，成为其东部边陲的一部分。

en: Tuva was the homeland of Turkic-speaking peoples in the upper Yenisei region. Conquered by Jochi's Mongols in 1207, it remained under Mongol rulers until it submitted to the Qing in the eighteenth century.
zh: 图瓦是叶尼塞河上游地区突厥语族人群的家园。1207年术赤率蒙古军征服图瓦，此后当地由蒙古诸统治者控制，直至18世纪归附清朝。

en:
The Principality of Tver was a Rus' principality on the upper Volga, with its capital at Tver, whose rulers rivaled Moscow for leadership of the northeast Rus' lands in the fourteenth century. Carved out of the Pereyaslavl-Zalessky principality, it passed in 1246 to Yaroslav Yaroslavich, whose descendants ruled it until 1485. Refugees fleeing the Mongol raids swelled its population, and its river trade and the building of the Transfiguration Cathedral made it one of the wealthiest Rus' cities. Its prince Mikhail became grand prince of Vladimir in 1305, but the Golden Horde khan Özbeg favored Moscow: Mikhail was executed at the Horde in 1318, his son Dmitry in 1326, and Prince Aleksandr Mikhailovich and his son in 1339. The anti-Tatar uprising of 1327 ended with Tver burned and its people decimated, and the title of grand prince of Vladimir passed to Ivan I of Moscow.

Tver nevertheless kept the contest alive. Mikhail II was the last Tver prince to hold the grand princely patent, in 1371, and a Muscovite siege in 1375 forced him to recognize Dmitry Donskoy as his elder brother; Tver sent no troops to Kulikovo in 1380 and later leaned on Lithuania, allying with Vytautas in 1427. As Moscow gained the upper hand, Ivan III imposed unequal treaties, and when Mikhail III turned to Lithuania for help, Ivan's army conquered Tver in 1485 and annexed the principality, granting it to his son Ivan the Young.
zh:
特维尔公国是伏尔加河上游的罗斯公国，都城在特维尔，14世纪时曾与莫斯科争夺东北罗斯的领导权。它从佩列亚斯拉夫尔-扎列斯基公国分出，1246年归于雅罗斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇，其后裔一直统治到1485年。蒙古劫掠带来的难民充实了它的人口，河运贸易和显圣容大教堂的兴建使它成为罗斯最富庶的城市之一。王公米哈伊尔于1305年成为弗拉基米尔大公，但金帐汗月即别转而支持莫斯科：米哈伊尔于1318年在金帐汗国被处死，其子德米特里于1326年遇害，王公亚历山大·米哈伊洛维奇父子又于1339年被处决。1327年的反鞑靼起义以特维尔被焚、人口锐减告终，弗拉基米尔大公的称号转入莫斯科的伊凡一世之手。

特维尔仍未放弃争夺。米哈伊尔·亚历山德罗维奇于1371年成为最后一位领有大公诰命的特维尔王公，1375年莫斯科军队围城，迫使他承认德米特里·顿斯科伊为兄长；1380年特维尔没有派兵参加库利科沃战役，此后转而依靠立陶宛，于1427年与维陶塔斯结盟。随着莫斯科占据上风，伊凡三世强迫它签订不平等条约；当米哈伊尔·鲍里索维奇向立陶宛求援时，伊凡三世的军队于1485年攻占特维尔，吞并公国，并把它封给儿子小伊凡。

en:
Tavas was a small Turkmen beylik on the fertile Tavas plain in ancient Caria, around the fortress of Tabae south of the Menderes river. It emerged after the Seljuk defeat at Köse Dağ in 1243 loosened Rum's hold on the interior, its lords ruling first from Horasanlı and Hırka and then from Tavas itself.

In the fourteenth century the beylik was held by İlyas Bey, the ruler in 1337, among people noted for devotion to the Mevlevi order, and its position between stronger neighbouring beyliks made it a natural pawn. When Denizli passed to the Germiyanids, Tavas was attached to the Menteşeids in 1365, and the region was absorbed into the Ottoman Empire under Murad II in 1424.
zh:
塔瓦斯是古卡里亚地区塔瓦斯平原上的突厥蛮小贝伊国，地当门德雷斯河以南的塔巴埃要塞。1243年克谢山战败后罗姆对内陆的控制松弛，塔瓦贝伊国就此兴起，其首领先以霍拉萨勒村和赫尔卡村为治所，后来移治塔瓦斯。

14世纪时贝伊国由1337年在位的伊利亚斯贝伊统治，当地居民以虔信梅夫拉维教团著称；它夹在诸强邻贝伊国之间，自然成为受人摆布的棋子。代尼兹利落入格尔米扬之手后，塔瓦斯于1365年被并入门泰谢，整个地区又在1424年被穆拉德二世治下的奥斯曼帝国吞并。

en:
The Taovaya were a Wichita people from Kansas who moved south in the eighteenth century. In the 1720s they began establishing villages on both sides of the Red River, in what are now Oklahoma and Texas.

A French-brokered peace with the Comanche in 1746 helped make their villages trading centers for horses, crops and French goods. In 1759 Taovaya and other Wichita warriors, supported by Comanche allies, defeated a Spanish attack on the Red River villages and captured two cannon.
zh:
陶瓦亚人是来自堪萨斯的威奇托族群，在18世纪向南迁移。1720年代，他们开始在红河两岸建村，地点位于今天的俄克拉何马州和得克萨斯州。

1746年，在法国人斡旋下，他们与科曼奇人议和，村落随之成为马匹、农作物和法国货物的贸易中心。1759年，陶瓦亚人和其他威奇托战士在科曼奇盟友支援下击退了西班牙人对红河村落的进攻，缴获两门火炮。

en: The Tswana lived in several chiefdoms in what are now Botswana and South Africa. Kaditshwene, a Hurutshe trade and metalworking centre, was founded near iron and copper deposits in the late fifteenth century. By 1824 the Ngwaketse under Makaba II were a major regional power, keeping cattle in protected desert areas and raiding neighbouring chiefdoms.
zh: 茨瓦纳人在南部非洲内陆建立了多个酋长国，分布在今博茨瓦纳和南非境内。15世纪末，胡鲁策人的贸易和金属加工中心卡迪茨韦内建于铁矿和铜矿附近。到1824年，马卡巴二世统治下的恩瓜凯策已成为当地一支重要势力，他们在受保护的沙漠地带放牧牛群，并袭击邻近酋长国。

en:
Twipra, anglicized as Tipperah, was the hill kingdom of the Tripuri people in north-eastern India. Its Bengali court chronicle, the Rajmala, composed under Dharma Manikya in the fifteenth century, claims the kings descended from the Lunar Dynasty, and its royal cult of fourteen deities blended Hindu and tribal worship. In the eighth century rulers moved the capital east along the Surma to the country around Kailashahar.

Firm history begins early in the fifteenth century, when the Tripuri chief Maha Manikya founded the Manikya dynasty after a victory over Bengal; Ratna Manikya then established the capital at Rangamati on the Gomati River. Under Dhanya Manikya and Vijaya Manikya II, Twipra reached its greatest extent, stretching from the Garo Hills to the Bay of Bengal.

Mughal pressure early in the seventeenth century cost it its plains, though the hill kings stayed independent, and in 1761 Twipra entered British protection as the self-governing state of Hill Tippera.
zh:
特里普拉（又译蒂佩拉）是特里普拉人在印度东北部特里普拉地区建立的山地王国。15世纪达尔马·曼尼克亚在位时用孟加拉语编成的宫廷编年史《拉杰马拉》，声称诸王出自月种王朝；王室的十四神崇拜长期融合印度教与部落信仰。8世纪时统治者把都城沿苏尔马河东迁至凯拉萨哈尔一带。

可靠的历史始于15世纪初，特里普拉首领摩诃·曼尼克亚击败孟加拉后开创曼尼克亚王朝，其后拉特纳·曼尼克亚在戈马蒂河畔的兰加马蒂定都。达尼亚·曼尼克亚和毗阇耶·曼尼克亚二世治下特里普拉达到极盛，疆域北起加罗丘陵、南抵孟加拉湾。

17世纪初莫卧儿的压力使王国丧失平原领地，但山地诸王保住了独立；1761年特里普拉以自治的山地蒂佩拉之名接受英国保护。

en:
The Tawakoni were a Wichita-related people who lived in villages in present-day Oklahoma and Texas. In 1719 the French explorer La Harpe visited a Tawakoni village and negotiated peace with them and neighbouring peoples.

Conflict with the Osage drove them south into Texas, where they allied with the Waco. In 1835 the Tawakoni signed a treaty with the United States at Camp Holmes.
zh:
塔瓦科尼人与威奇托人关系密切，居住在今俄克拉何马州和得克萨斯州的村落中。1719年，法国探险家拉阿尔普访问了一个塔瓦科尼村庄，并与他们及邻近族群议和。

与奥塞奇人的冲突迫使他们南迁至得克萨斯，在那里与韦科人结盟。1835年，塔瓦科尼人在霍姆斯营地与美国签订条约。

en: The Twana were nine Coast Salish groups living along Hood Canal in western Puget Sound, among them the Skokomish. They moved between seasonal settlements, using plank houses in winter and fishing for salmon. Maritime fur traders probably reached the Twana around 1788 in search of sea otter pelts; by 1792 the local sea otter population was nearly depleted.
zh: 特瓦纳人是居住在普吉特海湾西部胡德运河沿岸的九个海岸萨利什群体，其中包括斯科科米什人。他们随季节迁居，冬季住在木板屋中，并捕捞鲑鱼。海上毛皮商人大约于1788年为寻找海獭皮抵达特瓦纳人的地区；到1792年，当地海獭已接近绝迹。

en:
The Kingdom of the Two Sicilies joined Sicily and southern mainland Italy under the Bourbon dynasty, with its capital at Naples. The name recalled the division of the medieval Kingdom of Sicily after the Sicilian Vespers of 1282: both the island and the mainland kingdoms retained the Sicilian royal title.

Ferdinand ruled Naples and Sicily from 1759, but lost Naples to French invasion in 1806 and regained it in 1815. In 1816 he merged the two kingdoms as Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies. After revolution in 1820, Austrian forces restored his authority and he suppressed the liberals and Carbonari.
zh:
两西西里王国由波旁王朝统治，合并了西西里岛和意大利南部大陆，以那不勒斯为首都。这个名字源于1282年西西里晚祷事件后中世纪西西里王国的分裂：岛上和大陆的王国都保留了西西里王号。

费迪南多自1759年起统治那不勒斯和西西里，1806年因法国入侵失去那不勒斯，1815年收复。1816年他将两国合并，成为两西西里国王费迪南多一世。1820年革命后，奥地利军队恢复了他的权力，他镇压了自由派和烧炭党人。

en:
Tixi was a small native longship office in the wooded hills of eastern Guizhou, among the stream valleys west of Tongren. Under the Yuan it was counted among the longship offices belonging to the great Sizhou Xuanwei Commission of the Tian clan.

When the Ming dismantled Sizhou in 1413, Tixi was assigned, together with four sister offices, to the new Tongren Prefecture. Its mountain streams bore gold, and the Ming ran a gold-washing bureau at Taipingxi inside the chieftaincy's territory.
zh:
提溪是贵州东部山区的小型长官司，地处铜仁以西的溪洞之间。元代它是思州田氏宣慰司属下的长官司之一。

1413年明朝拆分思州后，提溪与另外四司一起划归新置的铜仁府管辖。其境内溪涧产金，明代在太平溪设有金场局，淘采沙金。

en:
Tuxpan, called Tochpan in Nahuatl, or place of rabbits, was a Huastec town on the Gulf coast of Mexico near the mouth of its namesake river. Its coast made it a trading centre: a market held every twenty days drew merchants from the Valley of Mexico and Tulancingo, dealing in cedar wood, chicle, fish and tortoises.

Around 1450 the armies of Moctezuma I defeated the Huastecs, and Tochpan became seat of an Aztec tributary province including Papantla, sending clothing, jade and featherwork to Tenochtitlan. It kept substantial self-rule until the Spanish overran the Huasteca between 1519 and the 1530s, after which many people were shipped to the Caribbean as slaves.
zh:
图斯潘在纳瓦特尔语中称托奇潘，意为兔子之地，是墨西哥湾沿岸、同名河流入海口附近的瓦斯特克城镇。凭借沿海位置，它成为贸易中心，每二十天一次的集市吸引墨西哥谷地和图兰辛戈的商人，交易雪松木、奇克莱树脂、鱼和龟。

约1450年蒙特祖马一世的军队击败瓦斯特克人，托奇潘成为阿兹特克一个纳贡行省的治所，该行省还包括帕潘特拉，向特诺奇蒂特兰输送衣物、玉石和羽毛制品。1519年至16世纪30年代西班牙人征服瓦斯特卡之前，该镇保留相当大的自治权；征服之后许多居民被当作奴隶运往加勒比地区。

en:
Tyrone, in Irish Tír Eoghain, the land of Eoghan, was the leading Gaelic kingdom of Ulster, homeland of the Cenél nEógain. A sub-kingdom of Ailech from the fifth century, it supplied thirteen high kings of Ireland. When Ailech split in the twelfth century, Tyrone passed first to the Mac Lochlainns and then to the O'Neills, who destroyed Mac Lochlainn power in 1241 and reigned from Dungannon.

The Norman Earldom of Ulster checked them for a time, but its collapse in 1333 let the O'Neills overrun eastern Ulster. The main line under Aodh Reamhar and his son Niall Mór made Tyrone the strongest power in the north.

Conn Bacagh O'Neill was made Earl of Tyrone in 1542, and Hugh O'Neill's Nine Years' War ended in surrender in 1603. His flight with the other Ulster earls in 1607, the Flight of the Earls, was followed by forfeiture of the title and the Plantation of Ulster.
zh:
蒂龙，爱尔兰语称蒂尔欧文，意为“欧文之地”，是阿尔斯特最强大的盖尔王国，也是欧文部族的故土。它5世纪起为阿利奇的附庸小国，曾出过十三位爱尔兰至高王。12世纪阿利奇分裂后，蒂龙先归麦克洛克林家族，后落入奥尼尔家族；后者于1241年摧毁麦克洛克林势力，以邓甘嫩为都进行统治。

诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯爵领曾一度压制奥尼尔氏，但1333年伯爵领崩溃，奥尼尔氏趁机席卷阿尔斯特东部。主支在奥埃德·雷瓦尔及其子尼尔·莫尔率领下，使蒂龙成为北方最强势力。

康恩·巴卡·奥尼尔1542年受封蒂龙伯爵，休·奥尼尔的九年战争于1603年以投降告终。1607年他与阿尔斯特众伯爵出逃，史称“伯爵出逃”，头衔随后被没收，阿尔斯特种植园随之展开。

en:
The Kingdom of Taytay was a precolonial monarchy on the northern coast of Palawan, whose ruler was said to be attended wherever he went by ten scribes.

In 1521 the surviving crew of Ferdinand Magellan, fleeing the Battle of Mactan, held the king of Taytay and his consort hostage to extort supplies before sailing on to the Moluccas, an episode recorded by the chronicler Antonio Pigafetta. Spanish rule came only in 1623, when the town was formally founded.

The Augustinian Recollects built the stone fortress of Fuerza Santa Isabel de la Paragua between 1667 and 1738 to fend off raids by the war fleets of the Muslim polities of the south, and in 1818 Taytay became capital of the province of Calamianes, covering the whole of Palawan.
zh:
泰泰王国是巴拉望岛北部海岸的前殖民时代王国，据说君主无论走到哪里都有十名书吏随行。

1521年，费迪南德·麦哲伦的残部在逃离麦克坦战役后，扣下泰泰国王及其王后勒索补给，随后才驶往摩鹿加群岛，随队编年史家安东尼奥·皮加费塔记录了此事。西班牙人的统治迟至1623年才到来，泰泰镇在这一年正式建立。

奥斯定会重整派修士于1667年至1738年修筑石砌要塞圣伊莎贝尔堡，以抵御南方穆斯林政权战船的袭掠；1818年，泰泰成为辖有整个巴拉望岛的卡拉米安内斯省首府。

en:
Tollantzinco, meaning the place behind the reeds in Nahuatl, stands in the fertile valley of present-day Tulancingo in Hidalgo, whose great twenty-day market drew Otomi, Tepehua and Totonac traders. A Toltec city had been founded there as early as 645 BCE and was abandoned with the fall of Tula, after which Chichimeca groups under the leader Xolotl refounded it around 1120.

In 1324 the ruler Quinatzin made Tollantzinco the head of a province, but war with Texcoco ended in defeat, and early in the fifteenth century the Acolhua of Texcoco conquered the city. In 1431 Itzcoatl and Nezahualcoyotl reorganized it as an Aztec tributary center.

During the Spanish war the local prince Ixtlilxochitl raised an army here to join Hernan Cortes against Tenochtitlan, and the valley passed under Spanish rule in 1525.
zh:
图拉钦科在纳瓦特尔语中意为芦苇后方之地，位于今伊达尔戈州肥沃的图兰辛戈谷地，当地每二十天一次的大集市吸引着奥托米、特佩瓦和托托纳克商人。早在公元前645年，托尔特克人便在此建城，图拉衰落后该城遭到废弃；约1120年，首领索洛特尔率领奇奇梅卡人重建此城。

1324年，统治者基纳钦把图拉钦科改组为一省之首，但它与特斯科科的战争以失败告终，15世纪初特斯科科的阿科瓦人征服了该城；1431年，伊兹科阿特尔与内萨瓦尔科约特尔又将其整顿为阿兹特克的朝贡中心。

西班牙人交战期间，当地王子伊斯特利尔索奇特尔在此起兵，加入埃尔南·科尔特斯一方攻打特诺奇蒂特兰，整个谷地于1525年归入西班牙统治。

en:
The Tzeltal, who call themselves Winik Atel, are a Maya people of the central Chiapas highlands and close kin of the Tzotzil, from whose language theirs began to separate around 1200. Their ancestors entered Chiapas in the early centuries of the Common Era, and on the eve of the Spanish arrival their society was divided into nobles, commoners and slaves and split among as many as forty-five autonomous hill polities.

In 1527 Pedro de Portocarrero founded San Cristóbal de los Llanos; within a year the Ocosingo valley and the upper Grijalva basin had submitted, and the province of Chiapa was organized in 1528.

Crushing tribute and labour demands drove the Tzeltal to abandon their towns and take to the wilds, and encomiendas then bound them to Spanish estates. In the mid-sixteenth century Bartolomé de las Casas founded the mission town of Quechula.
zh:
策尔塔尔人自称维尼卡特尔，是恰帕斯中部高地的玛雅民族，与索西人是近亲，两种语言约在1200年前后分化。他们的祖先在公元最初几个世纪进入恰帕斯；西班牙人到来前夕，其社会分为贵族、平民和奴隶，分裂为多达45个自治的山头小邦。

1527年，佩德罗·德·波托卡雷罗建立圣克里斯托瓦尔·德·洛斯亚诺斯，不出一年，奥科辛戈谷地和格里哈尔瓦河上游便告臣服，恰帕省于1528年设立。

沉重的贡赋与劳役逼得策尔塔尔人弃城逃入荒野，监护征赋制又把他们束缚在西班牙人的地产上。16世纪中叶，巴托洛梅·德·拉斯卡萨斯建立了传教城镇克丘拉。

en:
Tziuhcoac, rendered Cicoaque in later Spanish documents, was a Huastec town in the hill country of the inland Huasteca, between Tuxpan and the Otomi stronghold of Metztitlan.

The Huastec polities had paid tribute to the Aztec Empire since the campaigns of Moctezuma I around 1450, but they kept their own rulers and repeatedly rose in revolt. Ahuitzotl stormed Tziuhcoac in 1486 and carried off a great many captives, who were sacrificed at the rededication of the Great Temple of Tenochtitlan in 1487.

After the Spanish conquest the town appears as Cicoaque among the Tuxpan estates granted to Hernán Cortés with his title of Marqués del Valle in 1529.
zh:
齐乌科阿克在后世西班牙文献中又拼作西科阿克，是瓦斯特卡内陆山区的瓦斯特克城镇，地处图斯潘与奥托米人重镇梅茨蒂特兰之间。

自1450年前后莫克特苏马一世出征以来，瓦斯特克诸邦虽向阿兹特克帝国纳贡，却保留自己的首领并屡次起兵反抗。1486年，阿维索特尔攻陷齐乌科阿克，掳走大批俘虏，这些人在1487年特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙的落成献祭中被处死。

西班牙征服后，该城又以西科阿克之名，列入1529年随瓦哈卡谷地侯爵头衔封授给埃尔南·科尔特斯的图斯潘属地清单。

en:
Tzitacuaro, the nucleus of the later city of Zitácuaro, was a highland settlement in far eastern Michoacán, its name taken from the Mazahua language. Otomis and Mazahuas founded a village there perhaps as early as the twelfth century, and around the middle of the fourteenth century Mazahuas led by a chief named Yquingari conquered the region.

By the Spanish arrival it stood on the frontier between the Purépecha kingdom and the Aztec Empire, and its people fought on the Aztec side in the failed defense of Tenochtitlan in 1521.
zh:
茨塔夸罗是后来锡塔夸罗城的雏形，位于米却肯最东部的高地，名字取自马萨瓦语。奥托米人和马萨瓦人可能早在12世纪便在此建村，约14世纪中叶，首领伊金加里率领马萨瓦人征服了这一地区。

西班牙人到来时，它地处普雷佩查王国与阿兹特克帝国之间的边境，1521年当地居民还站在阿兹特克一方，参加了特诺奇蒂特兰失败的保卫战。

en:
Teozacoalco, Chiyo Cahnu in Mixtec, meaning Great Altar, was a highland Mixtec city-state in the Nochixtlan valley of the Mixteca Alta. Its ruling dynasty, recorded in the pictorial Codex Bodley, made it one of the principal kingdoms of the highland Mixtecs, alongside Tilantongo, Chalcatongo, Tlaxiaco and Achiutla.

Its fortunes were often joined to those of Tilantongo, with the two courts at times sharing a single king. The kingdom was overwhelmed by Aztec expansion under Moctezuma II, who reigned from 1502 to 1520: he conquered it and made it the seat of a tributary province that stretched southwest as far as Zenzontepec.

An Aztec garrison was installed in the city, which supplied the soldiers with maize, beans, chia and cotton, while the province paid tribute in greenstone, feathers and woven mantas.
zh:
特奥萨科阿尔科的纽萨维语名为奇约卡努，意为“大祭坛”，是米斯特卡高地诺奇斯特兰谷地的高地纽萨维城邦。它的统治王朝载于图画手抄本《博德利手抄本》，使它与蒂兰通戈、查尔卡通戈、特拉希亚科和阿奇特拉并列，成为高地纽萨维人的主要王国之一。

它的国运常与蒂兰通戈相连，两国王廷有时共奉一位君主。这个王国在1502—1520年在位的莫克特苏马二世治下被阿兹特克的扩张吞并：他征服此地后，将它设为一个纳贡省份的治所，辖区向西南延伸至森森特佩克。

城中驻扎了阿兹特克守军，由当地供应玉米、豆类、奇亚籽和棉花，全省则以绿石、羽毛和织毯纳贡。

en:
Tamazollan was the Nahuatl name for the polity centred on Tlamazolan, the place of toads, a settlement in the warm lowlands of southern Xalisco on the site of modern Tamazula in Jalisco.

Its people were a mixture of the region's older village populations with Nahuatl-speaking settlers and Purépecha newcomers, and at the time of the Spanish arrival its lord Calizendo ruled scattered hamlets along the river rather than a single compact town.

In 1521 Calizendo joined the rulers of Tuxpan and Zapotlán in an alliance with the Spaniards against Tzome, king of Colima; the district then became the Provinces of Ávalos, and Franciscan friars began its evangelization in 1524, founding a convent and hospital there by 1561.
zh:
塔马索兰是纳瓦特尔语地名，指以特拉马索兰（意为“蟾蜍之地”）为中心的小邦，坐落在哈利斯科南部温暖的低地，即后来墨西哥哈利斯科州塔马苏拉的所在地。

其居民由当地古老村社人口与纳瓦特尔语移民、普雷佩查新来者混合而成；西班牙人到来时，首领卡利森多统治的是沿河散布的村落，而不是一座集中的城镇。

1521年，卡利森多与图斯潘、萨波特兰的首领一同同西班牙人结盟，对抗科利马国王索梅；此后该地区成为阿瓦洛斯诸省，方济各会修士于1524年开始传教，并在1561年前建起了修道院与医院。

en:
Tetzapotitlan was a Huastec town of the northern Veracruz Huasteca, its Nahuatl name meaning a place among the zapote trees; scholarship links the toponym to the prehispanic city now studied at Castillo de Teayo, which was once also called Tzapotlan.

Axayacatl's armies overran the Aztec tributary province of Tochpan with its twelve head towns in 1480, and after Ahuitzotl pushed on to take the rebel town of Tziucohuac in 1486, he stationed a permanent Mexica garrison at Tetzapotitlan in 1488 to keep the conquered Huastec polities under control. The town thus became one of the anchor garrisons securing the Aztec Empire's north-eastern frontier.
zh:
特察波蒂特兰是韦拉克鲁斯北部瓦斯特卡地区的瓦斯特克城镇，纳瓦特尔语名字意为“萨波特果树之地”；学界将这一地名与今特阿约城堡遗址所研究的史前古城联系起来，该城旧名察波特兰。

1480年，阿克萨亚卡特尔的大军攻占阿兹特克的托奇潘纳贡省及其十二座首镇；1486年阿维索特尔进一步攻克反叛的齐乌科阿克后，于1488年在特察波蒂特兰常驻墨西加戍军，以压制被征服的瓦斯特克诸邦，该城由此成为镇守阿兹特克帝国东北边疆的据点之一。

en:
The Tz'utujil are a Maya people of the southern shore of Lake Atitlán in the Sololá highlands of Guatemala, whose name comes from the title of one of their two paramount lords.

Their ancestors claimed to have come from Tollan, the Toltec capital, and they built their capital Chiaa on the fortified hill of Chuitinamit, where the supreme lord, the Ahtz'iquinahay, and his nobles ran cacao plantations. In the fifteenth century the K'iche' king K'iq'ab checked their expansion, and they remained under the K'iche' shadow until the Spanish came.

In 1524 Pedro de Alvarado, with Kaqchikel allies, routed them near Panajachel and seized the lake. Franciscan friars soon moved the capital from the hill to Santiago Atitlán and built a monastery, while introduced diseases and mine labour cut the population from 72,000 in 1520 to about 5,600 by 1550.
zh:
楚图希尔人是危地马拉索洛拉高地阿蒂特兰湖南岸的玛雅民族，其族名来自两位至高首领之一的头衔。

他们自称祖先来自古代托尔特克人的都城图兰，并在设防的楚伊蒂纳米特山丘上建立都城奇亚；至高首领阿奇基纳哈伊和贵族们经营可可种植园。15世纪，基切国王基卡布遏制了他们的扩张，楚图希尔人自此处在基切人的阴影之下，直到西班牙人到来。

1524年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多在卡克奇克尔盟友协助下，于帕纳哈切尔附近将其击溃，夺取湖泊控制权。方济各会修士很快把都城从山丘迁至圣地亚哥阿蒂特兰并修建修道院；外来疾病和矿场劳役使人口从1520年的7.2万锐减到1550年的约5600人。

en:
The Tozawa were warrior lords who established themselves in the Senboku region of Dewa Province and later made Kakunodate their base. They fought the Andō and Onodera families for control of the region; in 1590 Tozawa Moriyasu joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign but died of illness there.

His son Masamori sided with Tokugawa Ieyasu in the struggle of 1600 and was transferred to Hitachi Province. In 1622, after the Mogami were dispossessed, he received the Shinjō domain in Dewa, where his descendants continued to rule through the Edo period.
zh:
户泽氏是立足于出羽国仙北地区的武家领主，后来以角馆为据点。他们与安东氏、小野寺氏争夺当地；1590年户泽盛安参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，却在阵中病逝。

其子政盛在1600年的争战中支持德川家康，随后被转封到常陆国。1622年最上氏被削封后，政盛受封出羽国新庄藩，其后代在江户时代继续统治该藩。

en:
Tzapotzingo was one of the small señoríos of the coastal plain of Nayarit in western Mexico, in the country of the Huichol peoples. The region was swept through by Nuño Beltrán de Guzmán's expedition from 1529 and folded into the Spanish province of Nueva Galicia, whose encomiendas drove the native communities to revolt.

In 1540 Pentécatl, lord of Tzapotzingo, attended the ceremony in the Huasamota valley that heralded the great uprising known as the Mixtón War; he and his neighbours joined the Caxcanes against the Spaniards until viceroy Antonio de Mendoza crushed the rebellion in 1542.
zh:
察波钦戈是墨西哥西部纳亚里特沿海平原上的小酋邦之一，地处维乔尔人活动的地域。1529年起，努尼奥·贝尔特兰·德·古斯曼的远征军横扫这一地区，将其并入西班牙的新加利西亚省，监护制下的奴役迫使当地原住民起而反抗。

1540年，察波钦戈的首领彭特卡特尔参加了在瓦萨莫塔谷地举行的仪式，那场仪式宣告了米斯通战争大起义的开始；他率部与卡克斯坎人联手抗击西班牙人，直到1542年总督安东尼奥·德·门多萨将起义镇压。

en:
Cuauhteopan, recorded in colonial codices as Quiauhteopan, was a Nahua town in the mountains of eastern Guerrero southwest of Olinalá, on the edge of Mixtec country. Its conquest was claimed both by Moctezuma I of Tenochtitlan and by Nezahualcóyotl of Texcoco, and the town was finally subdued during the Guerrero campaign of 1458.

Under Aztec rule it became the seat of one of the small tribute provinces grouped on folio 10v of the Matrícula de Tributos, which every six months delivered eighty copper axes and forty copper bells to the imperial treasury.
zh:
夸乌特奥潘在殖民抄本中记作基尧特奥潘，是格雷罗州东部山区、奥利纳拉西南方的纳瓦人城镇，地处米斯特克地区边缘。特诺奇蒂特兰的蒙特祖马一世和特斯科科的内萨瓦尔科约特尔都声称征服了它，该城最终在1458年的格雷罗战事中被平定。

阿兹特克统治时期，它成为《贡税册》第10页背面几个小型贡税省之一的治所，每六个月向帝国府库缴纳八十把铜斧和四十只铜铃。

en:
Uaymil, also called Bakhalal, was one of the sixteen Maya kuchkabals that took shape after the wars which destroyed Mayapan between 1441 and 1461. It covered the swampy Caribbean lowlands of what is now southern Quintana Roo and took in the whole of Bacalar Lagoon.

Its name is said to mean the opossum, and although large, the province was sparsely peopled because so much of it was marsh. Its chief town, Bakhalal on the lagoon, was a canoe port linked to the traders of Sian Ka'an and Chetumal Bay.

In 1531 Alonso de Ávila, acting for Francisco de Montejo, became the first Spaniard to cross the province, marching from Cochuah. The southern districts held out until the Pacheco entrada, which in 1544 incorporated the whole coast from Bacalar to Chetumal into Spanish Yucatán.
zh:
瓦伊米尔又名巴卡拉尔，是1441—1461年毁灭玛雅潘的战争后形成的十六个玛雅城邦之一。它占据今金塔纳罗奥南部多沼泽的加勒比低地，整个巴卡拉尔湖都在其境内。

据说其名意为“负鼠”。该邦幅员虽广，却因沼泽遍布而人烟稀少。湖畔重镇巴卡拉尔是独木舟贸易港口，与锡安卡安和切图马尔湾的商人相通。

1531年，阿隆索·德·阿维拉奉弗朗西斯科·德·蒙特霍之命，从科丘阿出发横穿该邦，成为第一个进入此地的西班牙人。南部地区一直坚持到帕切科征伐，1544年从巴卡拉尔到切图马尔的整个海岸被并入西班牙治下的尤卡坦。

en: Buha was the homeland of the Ha people east of Lake Tanganyika, in present-day northwestern Tanzania. The region contained several small kingdoms, whose Tutsi rulers prospered in the 18th century. In the early 19th century the expanding kingdom of Burundi annexed substantial parts of Buha.
zh: 布哈是哈人的故地，位于坦噶尼喀湖以东、今坦桑尼亚西北部。这片地区有数个小王国，其图西统治者在18世纪兴盛。19世纪初，扩张中的布隆迪王国吞并了布哈的大片土地。

en:
Überlingen lies on the northern shore of Lake Constance in Swabia, on the site first recorded in 770 as Iburinga. An earlier seventh-century settlement, Gunzoburg, had been the seat of the Alemannic duke Gunzo.

Under the Hohenstaufen it prospered on the lake trade, and by the end of the fourteenth century it held the status of a free imperial city. In 1525, during the German Peasants' War, its troops helped Georg Truchsess von Waldburg relieve Radolfzell.

It stayed Catholic and withstood the Thirty Years' War: Swedish and Saxon armies besieged it in 1632 and 1634 but failed to take it, a deliverance still commemorated by the annual Sweden Procession. French troops occupied it in 1643 before an imperial army retook it the next year. The Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803 ended its self-government and assigned it to the Grand Duchy of Baden.
zh:
于伯林根位于施瓦本的博登湖北岸，770年首见记载，时称伊布林加。更早的7世纪聚落贡佐堡曾是阿勒曼尼公爵贡佐的驻地。

霍亨施陶芬时期，它凭湖上贸易兴盛，到14世纪末已取得帝国自由市地位。1525年德意志农民战争期间，它出兵协助格奥尔格·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡解拉多尔夫采尔之围。

该城坚守天主教，在三十年战争中顶住了围攻：瑞典和萨克森军队于1632年和1634年两度围城均告失败，此后每年举行瑞典人游行以纪念这次解围。1643年法军一度占领，次年帝国军队将其收复。1803年的《帝国代表重要决议》终结了它的自治，把它划归巴登大公国。

en:
The Duchy of Upper Bavaria, ruled from Munich, was created by the first Wittelsbach partition of 1255, assigned to Louis II.
