In 1337 his son Louis IV, called the Bavarian, held it; he had ruled since 1294 and been elected King of the Romans in 1314 in a double election; he settled the claim by defeating his Habsburg rival Frederick the Fair at Mühldorf in 1322 and was crowned Holy Roman Emperor in Rome in 1328, defying Pope John XXII's excommunication.

From Munich he also held Brandenburg and the Electoral Palatinate, and when the last Lower Bavarian duke died childless in 1340 he inherited that duchy, reuniting all of Bavaria. His death in 1347 left the inheritance to his many sons, who split it afresh in 1349.

The 1392 partition carved Bavaria-Munich and Bavaria-Ingolstadt out of the old Upper Bavarian lands. Rival Wittelsbach lines contended for Munich and the Alpine borderlands until all of Bavaria was reunited in 1505.
zh:
上巴伐利亚公国以慕尼黑为治所，产生于1255年维特尔斯巴赫家族的第一次分邦，归路易二世统辖。1337年在位的是其子路易四世，人称巴伐利亚人路易；他自1294年起执政，1314年在有争议的双重选举中当选罗马人的国王，1322年在米尔多夫战役中击败哈布斯堡家族的对手美男子腓特烈，又于1328年在罗马加冕为神圣罗马皇帝，与将他绝罚的教皇约翰二十二世对抗。

他以慕尼黑为中心还领有勃兰登堡和莱茵普法尔茨；1340年末代下巴伐利亚公爵无嗣而亡，他又继承该公国，重新统一整个巴伐利亚。1347年路易去世后，众多儿子于1349年再度瓜分遗产。

1392年的分邦又在旧上巴伐利亚土地上划出巴伐利亚-慕尼黑和巴伐利亚-因戈尔施塔特两个公国。维特尔斯巴赫的对立支系为争夺慕尼黑和阿尔卑斯边境争斗不休，直到1505年整个巴伐利亚才重新统一。

en: The Udege were Tungusic-speaking hunters and fishers living along tributaries of the Amur and Ussuri. In 1263 the Mongols established a post at Nurgan and compelled the Udege and Nivkh to submit.
zh: 兀狄哈人是居住在黑龙江和乌苏里江支流沿岸、以狩猎和捕鱼为生的通古斯语族人群。1263年，蒙古人在奴儿干设立据点，迫使兀狄哈人和尼夫赫人归附。

en:
The Ueno were a branch of the Ashikaga family originating at Ueno estate in Mikawa Province. Ueno Yorikane followed Ashikaga Takauji to Kyushu in 1336 and became governor of Iwami, where he fought Southern Court forces.

Later generations served the Ashikaga shoguns in Kyoto. In 1509 Ueno Nobutaka went to Bitchū to secure it for Shogun Yoshitane, establishing relatives in local castles. One branch held Tsuneyama Castle until Mōri forces destroyed it in 1575.
zh:
上野氏是足利氏的支族，发源于三河国的上野庄。上野赖兼于1336年追随足利尊氏前往九州，后来担任石见守护，在当地与南朝军交战。

上野氏后代在京都侍奉足利将军。1509年，上野信孝前往备中，为将军义稙巩固该地，并将族人安置在当地诸城。其一支据有常山城，直至1575年被毛利军攻灭。

en:
The Uesugi rose from a Kyoto court family to become hereditary Kantō deputies under the Ashikaga shoguns. Their Yamanouchi and Ōgigayatsu branches competed for power in eastern Japan, but the latter fell to the Later Hōjō.

Uesugi Norimasa fled to Echigo and passed the family leadership to Nagao Kagetora, later known as Uesugi Kenshin. Kenshin fought Takeda Shingen at Kawanakajima, while his adopted son Kagekatsu lost much of his Aizu domain after the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600 and was transferred to Yonezawa.
zh:
上杉氏原是京都的公家，后来在足利将军治下世袭关东管领。山内和扇谷两支在日本东部争夺势力，扇谷上杉氏最终为后北条氏所灭。

上杉宪政逃往越后，将家督传给长尾景虎，也就是后来的上杉谦信。谦信在川中岛与武田信玄交战；他的养子景胜在1600年关原之战后失去大部分会津领地，被转封米泽。

en:
Hohenlohe is the county of the House of Hohenlohe, whose ancestor Conrad of Weikersheim appears in 1153. The family took its name from Hohlach Castle, first styling itself von Hohenloch in 1178, and held lands between the Kocher and Tauber rivers.

Two family members became Teutonic Grand Masters in the thirteenth century, and in 1230 the house split into the Hohenlohe and Brauneck lines. During the Interregnum its knights fought for the Bishop of Würzburg at the Battle of Kitzingen and won Uffenheim. In 1337 Count Louis held the lordship; Uffenheim was sold to the Ansbach Hohenzollerns in 1378, the Brauneck line dying out in 1390. Frederick III raised the lordship to an imperial county in 1450.

After 1551 the family divided into the Lutheran Neuenstein and Waldenburg branches, the latter returning to Catholicism in 1667. Both lines became princes in the eighteenth century, and in 1806 their principalities were mediatized to Bavaria and Württemberg.
zh:
霍恩洛厄是霍恩洛厄家族的伯国，先祖魏克斯海姆的康拉德最早见于1153年文献。家族得名于霍拉赫城堡，1178年首次以“冯·霍恩洛厄”为姓，在科赫尔河与陶伯河之间经营领地。

13世纪家族中有两人出任条顿骑士团大团长；1230年家族分为霍恩洛厄与布劳内克两支。大空位时期，家族骑士在基青根战役中为维尔茨堡主教作战，赢得乌芬海姆。1337年路易伯爵执掌领主权，乌芬海姆于1378年被卖给安斯巴赫的霍亨索伦家族，布劳内克支于1390年绝嗣。1450年腓特烈三世将领主领地升格为帝国伯国。

1551年后家族分裂为信奉路德宗的诺恩施泰因支与瓦尔登堡支，后者于1667年重归天主教。两支在18世纪相继取得诸侯等级，1806年其侯国被分别并入巴伐利亚和符腾堡。

en:
The Ughanids represent the autonomous non-Muslim Mongol tribes that grazed the uplands around Sirjan in the Kerman province, known to Persian sources as the Avgani and Jormai.

The Il-Khan Abaqa, who reigned from 1265 to 1282, granted these tribes autonomy in their Kerman pastures, and in 1337 they still kept their old Mongol ways and Tengrist beliefs amid the Muslim Persian population around them.

After the Muzaffarid Mubariz al-Din Muhammad conquered Kerman in 1340, he bound the tribal chieftains to his new dynasty by marriage: his son Shah Shoja wed the daughter of one of their chiefs, and the tribes remained important Muzaffarid allies in the region's wars.
zh:
乌格罕对应在克尔曼省锡尔詹一带高地游牧的自治非穆斯林蒙古部落，波斯史料称之为阿夫加尼部与焦尔马伊部。

1265至1282年在位的伊儿汗阿八哈授予这些部落对克尔曼牧场的自治权；1337年时，在周围穆斯林波斯人的环绕中，他们仍保持着蒙古旧俗和腾格里信仰。

1340年穆扎法尔王朝的穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德征服克尔曼后，通过联姻把这些部落酋长绑定在新王朝上：他的儿子沙阿·舒贾娶了其中一位酋长的女儿，这些部落也在此后的地区战争中始终是穆扎法尔王朝的重要盟友。

en:
Uglich is a Volga town first recorded in 1148 as Ugliche Pole, its name from the river's sharp bend. From 1218 it was the seat of a small Rurikid principality, but in 1328 its princes sold their rights to Ivan I Kalita of Moscow, so by 1337 it was a Muscovite appanage and frontier stronghold, repeatedly burned in raids by Lithuanians, Tatars and Tver.

In 1462 Ivan III granted it to his brother Andrey Bolshoy, under whom it gained its first stone buildings, including the red-brick prince's palace of 1481.

Later the town passed to Yury, brother of Ivan the Terrible, and its craftsmen built the wooden fortress shipped down the Volga for the siege of Kazan in 1552. Uglich is most famous for the death of the young Tsarevich Dmitry in 1591, extinguishing the Rurikid line and helping trigger the Time of Troubles.
zh:
乌格利奇是伏尔加河畔的城镇，最早以“乌格利奇原野”之名见于1148年的记载，城名得自伏尔加河的急转弯。1218年起这里是留里克小公国的驻地，但1328年当地王公把权利卖给莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔，因此1337年时它已是莫斯科的封邑和边境要塞，曾多次在立陶宛人、鞑靼人和特维尔军队的袭扰中被焚。

1462年伊凡三世把它封给弟弟安德烈·博利绍伊，第一批石造建筑由此出现，包括1481年完工的红砖王公宫。

后来此地归伊凡雷帝的弟弟尤里所有，当地工匠为1552年的喀山之役建造了沿伏尔加河运往前线的木制要塞。乌格利奇最著名的事件是1591年幼储君德米特里在此身亡，留里克血脉就此断绝，成为混乱时期的导火索之一。

en:
Ungwana, known in older records as Hoja, was a walled Swahili trading town near the mouth of the Tana River, on the bay that still bears its name on the northern Kenyan coast.

Founded around the middle of the tenth century, it grew behind a stone circuit wall into an eighteen-hectare city of mosques, a market square and coral-stone houses, one perhaps a ruler's palace, and it has been suggested as the capital of the little-known kingdom of Ozi. Its wells supplied the town with fresh water, and imported Chinese and Islamic pottery found in its ruins shows trade across the Indian Ocean, while local wares found inland show exchanges with hinterland communities.

A Portuguese fleet sacked Ungwana in 1505 during its campaign along the Swahili Coast. The town never fully recovered and was abandoned in the early seventeenth century.
zh:
翁瓜纳在较早的记载中称霍贾，是一座有城墙的斯瓦希里贸易城镇，位于肯尼亚北部海岸塔纳河河口附近，濒临同名的翁瓜纳湾。

它约建于10世纪中叶，在石砌城墙内发展为一座占地18公顷的城市，内有清真寺、市场和珊瑚石住宅，其中一座可能是统治者的宫殿；还有学者认为它就是少有人知的奥济王国的都城。城中水井提供淡水，废墟里出土的中国和伊斯兰陶器表明它参与了印度洋贸易，而在内陆发现的本地陶器则说明它与腹地社群也有往来。

1505年，一支葡萄牙舰队在斯瓦希里海岸的征战中洗劫了翁瓜纳。该城再未完全恢复，于17世纪初被废弃。

en: The Ugaxpah, or Quapaw, were a Dhegiha-speaking people whose villages lay near the confluence of the Arkansas and Mississippi rivers. In 1686 Henri de Tonti established Arkansas Post near the Quapaw village of Osotouy to trade with them. The United States forcibly removed the Quapaw from Arkansas in 1834.
zh: 乌加克斯帕人又称夸保人，说德吉哈语，村落位于阿肯色河与密西西比河交汇处附近。1686年，亨利·德·通蒂在夸保人的奥索图伊村附近建立阿肯色贸易站，与当地人交易。1834年，美国将夸保人从阿肯色强制迁走。

en:
The Ujjainiyas are a Rajput clan of the Bhojpur country, holding lower Ganga lands around Buxar. An offshoot of the Parmar Rajputs, their bardic tradition traces them to the Paramara kings of Ujjain and ruler Bhoja.

In the fourteenth century, under Hunkar Singh, they entered western Bihar and fought a long war with the Cheros, driven south into Palamu after battles said to cost them more than twenty thousand men. They later clashed for over a century with the Jaunpur Sultanate.

Gajpati Sahi, placed on the Bhojpur throne with Sher Shah Suri's help in 1534, fought at Surajgarha and Chausa, receiving Rohtas. Narayan Mal made peace with the Mughals in 1607, but a family feud let the Mughals sack Bhojpur and bring it under direct rule in 1699. In 1709 Horil Singh founded the house of Dumraon, surviving into British times as a zamindari.
zh:
乌贾伊尼亚人是博杰普尔地区的拉杰普特部族，占据伯格萨尔一带的恒河下游土地。他们是帕马尔拉杰普特的支系，其吟游传统自称源自乌贾因的帕拉马拉诸王，可追溯到波阇。

14世纪，他们在洪卡尔·辛格率领下进入比哈尔西部，与哲卢人长期交战；据说哲卢人战死逾两万，最终被逐往南方的伯拉穆。此后他们又与江布尔苏丹国交锋百余年。

1534年，加杰帕蒂·萨希在舍尔沙·苏尔帮助下登上博杰普尔之位，参加苏拉杰加尔哈和乔萨之战，受封罗赫达斯。1607年纳拉扬·马尔与莫卧儿廷议和，但家族内讧给了莫卧儿人可乘之机，博杰普尔于1699年遭洗劫，被纳入直接统治。1709年霍里尔·辛格建立杜姆拉翁政权，在英国统治时期以柴明达尔领地存续。

en: Ruthenia was a Latin name for the lands of Rus', including the East Slavic territories around Kyiv. In 1199 Roman united Galicia and Volhynia in a kingdom later known as Ruthenia; Poland conquered Galicia in 1349, while Volhynia passed to Lithuania.
zh: 鲁塞尼亚是罗斯土地的拉丁文名称，包括基辅周边的东斯拉夫地区。1199年罗曼统一加利西亚与沃伦，其国家后来称为鲁塞尼亚王国；1349年波兰征服加利西亚，沃伦则归于立陶宛。

en:
Ula was a Jurchen polity on the Sungari River, ruled by a branch of the Nara clan from 1561. Its beile Buyan fortified a settlement on the river, and his grandson Bujantai joined an alliance against Nurhaci. Captured at Mount Gure in 1593, Bujantai was released and became beile after his brother Mantai's death.

Despite marriage ties with Nurhaci, war resumed in 1607. Nurhaci defeated Ula in 1613, and Bujantai fled to Yehe; his people were incorporated into the Eight Banners.
zh:
乌拉是松花江流域的女真部国，自1561年起由那拉氏的一支统治。贝勒布延在江边修筑城寨，其孙布占泰参加了反对努尔哈赤的联盟。布占泰于1593年在古勒山被俘，获释后在兄长满泰死后继任贝勒。

尽管双方有姻亲关系，乌拉与努尔哈赤仍于1607年重启战事。1613年努尔哈赤击败乌拉，布占泰逃往叶赫，乌拉部众被编入八旗。

en: The Ulch were Tungusic-speaking communities of the lower Amur, living in small villages and relying on salmon fishing. Russian accounts first mentioned the Ulch in the seventeenth century.
zh: 乌尔奇人是黑龙江下游的通古斯语族人群，居住在小村落中，以捕捞鲑鱼为主要生计。俄国人的记载在17世纪首次提到乌尔奇人。

en:
Ulm stands on the upper Danube below the Swabian Jura, first mentioned in 854, when Louis the German held court at the royal palace of Hulma. Emperor Frederick Barbarossa made it an imperial city in 1181, and it grew into a centre of trade and crafts on the routes to Italy.

The Great Swear Letter of 1397 gave the city an early constitution, and in 1377 citizens began the vast Ulm Minster at their own expense. The fifteenth and sixteenth centuries were its golden age, built on fine textile exports, and the city adopted the Reformation in 1530.

The shift of trade routes and the Thirty Years' War began a decline. Ulm lost its imperial status to Bavaria in 1803, and in 1805 Napoleon surrounded General Mack's Austrian army in the Battle of Ulm; in 1810 it passed to the Kingdom of Württemberg.
zh:
乌尔姆位于施瓦本汝拉山下的多瑙河上游，最早见于854年的记载，当时日耳曼人路易正在胡尔马王宫驻跸。1181年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将它立为帝国城市，它成长为通往意大利商路上的工商业重镇。

1397年的《大宣誓书》赋予城市一部早期宪法，1377年市民自费动工兴建宏伟的乌尔姆大教堂。15至16世纪是乌尔姆的黄金时代，靠优质纺织品外销兴盛，1530年城市接受宗教改革。

商路转移和三十年战争开启了衰落。1803年乌尔姆失去帝国直辖地位，划归巴伐利亚；1805年拿破仑在此以乌尔姆战役包围马克将军的奥军；1810年城市转属符腾堡王国。

en:
The Earldom of Ulster was the foremost Anglo-Norman lordship in northern Ireland. The Norman knight John de Courcy invaded the Gaelic kingdom of Ulaid in 1177 and was made earl palatine by Henry II in 1181; his conquests covered most of Antrim and Down.

In 1263 the earldom passed to Walter de Burgh, under whose family it became a wealthy, largely peaceful province. Edward Bruce of Scotland sacked much of it and besieged Carrickfergus in 1315, a blow from which it never fully recovered.

In 1333 the third earl, William Donn de Burgh, was murdered by his own men, leaving his thirteen-month-old daughter Elizabeth as sole heir; her claim later passed to the English crown through marriage to Lionel of Antwerp, son of Edward III. The title reverted to the Crown in 1461, when the earldom had shrunk to a few coastal enclaves.
zh:
阿尔斯特伯爵领是爱尔兰北部最重要的盎格鲁—诺曼领地。诺曼骑士约翰·德·库西于1177年入侵盖尔人的乌拉德王国，1181年被亨利二世封为宫伯，征服地大致覆盖安特里姆和唐一带。

1263年伯爵领转入沃尔特·德·伯格之手，在其家族治下成为富庶而大体安定的省份。1315年，苏格兰的爱德华·布鲁斯蹂躏伯爵领大部并围攻卡里克弗格斯，伯爵领自此一蹶不振。

1333年，第三代伯爵威廉·唐·德·伯格被部下杀害，只留下十三个月大的女儿伊丽莎白作为唯一继承人；她后来嫁给爱德华三世之子安特卫普的莱昂内尔，继承权随之转入英格兰王室。1461年头衔收归王室，此时伯爵领已萎缩为几处沿海飞地。

en:
Umasuyus, the water quarter, was the eastern shore of the Lake Titicaca basin in the Aymara-speaking Qullaw, named from the Aymara word uma, water, in contrast to the fire quarter Urcosuyu on the western shore.

After Tiwanaku collapsed around 1000 its lands broke into rival lordships, among them Azángaro, Asillo, Ayaviri and Pacasa, whose capital was Achacachi; between 1300 and 1450 their wars drove each group into hilltop forts called pukaras. Like the other lake kingdoms the Umasuyu lords held discontinuous colonies in the warmer Pacific and Amazon valleys, a vertical archipelago of settlements.

The Inca emperor Pachacuti opened the Collao campaign in the mid-fifteenth century, defeating the Colla Capac at Ayaviri and Pucara, and after fresh revolts Túpac Yupanqui subdued the remaining independent chiefdoms and placed the eastern lake shore under an administration centered on La Paz.
zh:
乌马苏尤斯意为水区，是艾马拉语区科利亚奥境内的的喀喀湖流域东岸，其名来自艾马拉语的水，与湖西岸火区乌尔科苏尤相对。

1000年前后蒂亚瓦纳科崩溃后，这一带分裂为相互争战的酋长国，包括阿桑加罗、阿西约、阿亚维里和以阿查卡奇为都的帕卡萨等；1300至1450年间各部纷纷退守名为普卡拉的山顶堡垒。与其他湖畔王国一样，乌马苏尤的首领们在太平洋沿岸和亚马孙温暖河谷保有互不相连的殖民地，成垂直群岛式体系。

15世纪中叶，印加皇帝帕查库特克发动科利亚奥战役，在阿亚维里和普卡拉击败科利亚卡帕克；后经多次反叛，图帕克·尤潘基最终征服其余独立酋长国，湖东岸交由以拉巴斯为中心的机构管辖。

en:
Owill, in Irish Umhaill, was a Gaelic seafaring lordship around Clew Bay in western Connacht. By the twelfth century its rulers were the Uí Máille, or O'Malleys, who kept shore castles, lived by trading and fishing, and charged black rent even from English fishermen.

Long autonomous under the high king of Connacht, it later became a vassal of the Mac William Íochtar Burkes. Its most famous ruler was Gráinne Ní Mháille, better known as Grace O'Malley, the pirate queen, who inherited the chiefship about the mid-sixteenth century and commanded the clan's fleet.

In 1576 she accepted the crown's surrender and regrant terms, and in 1593 sailed to Greenwich to petition Elizabeth I for her captured sons and brother. On her death about 1603 the lordship passed to her son Tibbot na Long, and the old Gaelic order faded under the Tudor conquest.
zh:
奥维尔，爱尔兰语称乌维尔，是康诺特西部克鲁湾畔的盖尔航海领地。12世纪时，统治者已是奥马利家族（爱尔兰语称伊·马利）；他们沿海岸修筑城堡，以贸易和渔业为生，甚至向英格兰渔民收取黑租。

乌维尔长期在康诺特至高王治下自治，后来成为下麦克威廉伯克家族的附庸。最著名的统治者是格蕾丝·奥马利（爱尔兰语名格拉涅·尼·马利），人称海盗女王，约在16世纪中叶继承首领之位，统辖家族船队。

1576年她接受王室“投降再封”条件，1593年亲赴格林尼治向伊丽莎白一世请愿，要求释放被俘的儿子和弟弟。约1603年她去世后，领地传给儿子蒂博特·“纳朗”，古老的盖尔秩序也在都铎征服中走向终结。

en: The Umoho, or Omaha, were a Dhegiha-speaking people who reached the upper Missouri basin by the late seventeenth century. Around 1775 they established the Big Village in present-day Nebraska, where Chief Blackbird controlled trade along the Missouri. A smallpox epidemic killed Blackbird and about a third of the Omaha in 1800.
zh: 乌莫霍人又称奥马哈人，是讲德吉哈语的族群，17世纪末已抵达密苏里河上游流域。约1775年，他们在今内布拉斯加州建立大村，黑鸟酋长在那里控制密苏里河沿岸的贸易。1800年一场天花疫情夺去了黑鸟和约三分之一奥马哈人的生命。

en: The Wënami were an Unami-speaking group of the Lenape, whose homeland encompassed the Delaware valley and parts of present-day New Jersey and Pennsylvania. William Penn met the Lenape in 1682; his heirs claimed a vast tract under the Walking Purchase of 1737. Settlement and the American Revolutionary War pushed many Lenape north and west in the late eighteenth century.
zh: 乌纳米人是讲乌纳米语的莱纳佩人群体，故地包括特拉华河谷以及今新泽西和宾夕法尼亚的部分地区。威廉·佩恩于1682年与莱纳佩人相遇，但他的继承人后来通过1737年的步行购地宣称拥有大片土地。18世纪后期，欧洲人的定居和美国独立战争使许多莱纳佩人向北、向西迁徙。

en: The W'nalātchtko were Unami-speaking Lenape communities associated with the Lehigh Valley and west-central New Jersey. A seventeenth-century vocabulary recorded words from the Sankhikan band, whose members were enemies of the Munsee-speaking Manhattan people.
zh: 乌纳拉奇戈人是与利哈伊河谷及新泽西中西部相关的讲乌纳米语的莱纳佩社群。17世纪的一份词汇记录收录了桑基坎部落的词语，该部落与讲蒙西语的曼哈顿人为敌。

en: The Unnō were a warrior family based in the Unnō estate of Chiisagata district in Shinano Province. Their struggle with the Murakami family over eastern Shinano erupted into the Unnō Disturbance in 1468. In 1541 Takeda Nobutora and his allies invaded Chiisagata, fighting Unnō Munetsuna and other local lords at the Battle of Unnodaira.
zh: 海野氏是以信浓国小县郡海野庄为根据地的武家。海野氏与村上氏争夺信浓东部，双方的冲突在1468年引发海野大乱。1541年，武田信虎及其盟友进攻小县郡，在海野平之战中与海野栋纲等当地领主交战。

en:
Urbino was a Montefeltro lordship in the Marche of central Italy. The family became imperial vicars under Frederick Barbarossa and counts in 1226 under Frederick II, leading the Ghibelline party of the Marche against the Malatesta of Rimini. In 1337 its lord was Nolfo da Montefeltro, who had recovered the town after his father Federico I's murder.

In 1443 Pope Eugene IV raised the county into a duchy; under Federico III, duke from 1474, Urbino became one of the most brilliant Renaissance courts, famed for its Ducal Palace and patronage of artists including Raphael.

Cesare Borgia briefly seized the duchy in 1502 and 1503, and when Guidobaldo died in 1508 the Montefeltro line ended and the duchy passed to the della Rovere. When the last della Rovere duke died without an heir in 1631, Urbino was annexed by the Papal States.
zh:
乌尔比诺是蒙泰费尔特罗家族在意大利中部马尔凯的领地。该家族在巴巴罗萨时期成为帝国代理官，1226年被腓特烈二世封为伯爵，统领马尔凯吉伯林派，与里米尼的马拉泰斯塔相争。1337年在位的诺尔福·达·蒙泰费尔特罗，在父亲费德里科一世遇刺后重夺该城。

1443年教皇尤金四世升伯国为公国；费德里科三世1474年继位后，乌尔比诺成为文艺复兴最辉煌的宫廷之一，以公爵宫和对拉斐尔等艺术家的赞助闻名。

切萨雷·博尔贾1502年至1503年曾短暂夺取公国；1508年圭多巴尔多去世后蒙泰费尔特罗家族绝嗣，公国转入德拉·罗韦雷家族。1631年末代德拉·罗韦雷公爵无嗣而终，乌尔比诺被教皇国吞并。

en:
The Urin Chanka were the lower half of the Chanka people, settled around Andahuaylas in the Apurímac highlands, where their capital Huaman Karpa, the house of the falcon, stood by Lake Anori on the Pampas River near the sanctuary of Sondor.

Founded according to tradition by Ancovilca, they were above all farming folk, growing Andean crops in several altitude zones and herding llamas and alpacas, and the mummy of the early leader Uscovilca was long venerated at Huaman Karpa.

Unlike their Hanan kinsmen, the Urin Chanka did not march on Cusco but submitted peacefully to the Incas after the Battle of Yawarpampa in 1438, keeping their local lords under imperial governors. They were later drawn into the Inca civil war on the side of Huáscar, and after the Spanish invasion served the short-lived Cusco government of Túpac Hualpa.
zh:
乌林·昌卡是昌卡人的下半部，定居在阿普里马克高原的安达韦拉斯一带，都城瓦曼卡尔帕意为隼之屋，坐落在潘帕斯河畔的阿诺里湖畔，邻近松多尔圣地。

相传他们由安科维尔卡建立，以农耕为本，在不同海拔地带种植安第斯作物，放牧大羊驼和羊驼，早期首领乌斯科维尔卡的木乃伊长期在瓦曼卡尔帕受供奉。

与哈南亲族不同，乌林·昌卡没有进军库斯科，而是在1438年亚瓦尔潘帕战役后和平归顺印加，在帝国总督之下保留了本地首领。他们后来被卷入印加内战，支持瓦斯卡尔，西班牙入侵后又为图帕克·瓦尔帕短命的库斯科政权效力。

en:
Uri is the Reuss valley between Lake Lucerne and the St Gotthard Pass; the legendary William Tell and the Rütli meadow belong to its tradition. Settled by Alemanni from the seventh century, the valley was granted to Zürich's Fraumünster Abbey by Louis the German in 853 and passed briefly to the Habsburgs in 1218.

The opening of the St Gotthard Pass in 1230 brought wealth, and Henry VII granted Uri imperial immediacy in 1231. With Schwyz and Unterwalden it formed the Eternal Alliance of 1291, fought at Morgarten in 1315 and helped defeat the Habsburgs at Sempach in 1386. It annexed Urseren in 1410 and, with Obwalden, seized Leventina from Milan in 1403; Marignano checked expansion in 1515.

Uri rejected the Reformation and stayed Catholic. In 1798 it was merged into the Helvetic canton of Waldstätten, until the Act of Mediation restored it in 1803.
zh:
乌利是卢塞恩湖与圣哥达山口之间的罗伊斯河谷州，传说中的威廉·退尔和吕特利草地都属其传统。7世纪起阿勒曼尼人来此定居，853年日耳曼人路易把谷地赐给苏黎世的弗劳明斯特修道院，1218年一度转入哈布斯堡之手。

1230年圣哥达山口开通带来贸易之利，1231年亨利七世授予乌利帝国直辖地位。它与施维茨、翁特瓦尔登结成1291年永久同盟，参加1315年莫尔加滕之战，1386年又在森帕赫协助击败哈布斯堡。它于1410年兼并乌尔塞伦，1403年与上瓦尔登从米兰夺取莱文蒂纳；1515年马里尼亚诺之战终结了扩张。

乌利拒绝宗教改革，坚持天主教。1798年被并入海尔维第的森林州，1803年《调解法令》恢复其地位。

en: Uryangkhad was a name used by Jurchens who migrated from Ilantumen in northeastern China to Korea in the fourteenth century. The name reflected the influence of the Uriankhai on the people of Ilantumen.
zh: 兀良哈是14世纪从中国东北依兰图门迁入朝鲜的女真人使用过的名称，反映了兀良哈人对依兰图门居民的影响。

en:
The United States of America arose from thirteen British colonies on the Atlantic coast of North America. Disputes over taxation and representation helped provoke the American Revolution, and fighting began at Lexington and Concord in 1775. The Continental Congress issued the Declaration of Independence in 1776; George Washington's army, aided by France, went on to defeat Britain.

The Articles of Confederation were ratified in 1781, but their restrictions on central power made government difficult. The Constitution replaced them in 1789, establishing a federal republic. The United States then expanded westward through purchase, settlement and conquest of European and Indigenous lands.
zh:
美利坚合众国兴起于北美大西洋沿岸的13个英国殖民地。税收和代表权争议促成了美利坚革命，1775年莱克星顿和康科德爆发战斗。大陆会议于1776年发表《独立宣言》；乔治·华盛顿指挥的军队在法国援助下最终击败英国。

《邦联条例》于1781年获得批准，但它对中央权力的限制使治理困难。1789年宪法取代了条例，建立了联邦共和国。此后美利坚通过购买、移民定居以及征服欧洲人和原住民的土地向西扩张。

en:
The Ussuri polity gathered the Hurka Jurchen bands living along the Ussuri and its right-bank tributaries, with its seat at Alchan on the river of that name, a tributary of the Bikin in present-day Primorsky Krai. Hunter-fishers of the densely forested country east of the Songhua, they were counted by Ming officials among the Wild Jurchens.

After 1403 the Yongle Emperor's officers enrolled these riverine tribes in a string of guards under the Nurgan Regional Military Commission, founded on the lower Amur in 1409 and abandoned in 1435.

Qing records later classed the Ussuri groups with the Hurka and Warka of the Donghai Jurchens, and Nurhaci's Jianzhou campaigns between 1596 and 1625 brought most of them under Later Jin rule, while some clans stayed outside the banners and became the Udege and Nanai peoples.
zh:
乌苏里政权统辖乌苏里江及其右岸支流一带的虎尔哈女真部落，治所阿尔钦位于同名河畔，这条河是今俄罗斯滨海边疆区比金河的右岸支流。这些山林渔猎部落位于松花江以东的密林地带，被明朝官员归入野人女真。

1403年以后，永乐帝的使者把沿河各部落编入一连串卫所，隶属1409年设于黑龙江下游、1435年撤销的奴儿干都指挥使司。

清代文献后来把乌苏里各部分入东海女真的虎尔哈与瓦尔喀；1596—1625年间努尔哈赤的建州用兵使大部分部落臣服于后金，也有一些氏族未被编入八旗，发展为乌德盖人与那乃人。

en:
The Otaibah are one of the largest Arab tribes, concentrated in Najd and Hejaz and descended from the pre-Islamic Hawazin of Qays Aylan.

When most Hawazin clans dispersed to the Levant, Egypt and beyond in the early Islamic centuries, those who remained coalesced under the descendants of Otaibah ibn Guzayah, from whom the tribe takes its name. Their earliest dated appearance in the records is violent: in 1470 the Sharif of Mecca, Muhammad ibn Barakat, attacked them in the eastern Ta'if, their highland heartland.

In the 1700s they overtook Mutayr and Qahtan to become the largest tribe of central Najd, and in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries the Sharifs of Mecca and the Saudi and Rashidi dynasties courted their camelry. In 1816, after the Egyptians broke the first Wahhabi state, Ibrahim Pasha won the Otaibah and several Anazzah clans to his campaign against Abdullah bin Saud.
zh:
乌泰巴是阿拉伯半岛最大的部落之一，聚居于内志和汉志，血统溯及伊斯兰兴起前盖斯·艾兰族群的哈瓦津部。

伊斯兰早期，哈瓦津各氏族大多流散到黎凡特、埃及等地，留下的人集结在乌泰巴·本·古扎亚的后裔周围，部落由此得名。史书所载其最早有确切日期的登场充满硝烟：1470年，麦加谢里夫穆罕默德·本·巴拉卡特在塔伊夫东部进攻乌泰巴，这片高地是其世代核心。

18世纪他们取代穆塔伊尔和盖哈坦，成为内志中部最大部落；18世纪末至19世纪初，麦加谢里夫家族以及沙特、拉希德两王朝都拉拢其骆驼骑兵。1816年埃军击灭首个瓦哈比国家后，易卜拉欣帕夏争取乌泰巴和数个阿纳扎氏族加入对阿卜杜拉·本·沙特的战事。

en:
The Utsunomiya were a warrior family based at Utsunomiya in Shimotsuke Province. During the fourteenth-century civil wars, Utsunomiya Kimitsuna supported the Southern Court while his son Ujitsuna joined the Ashikaga.

In the early sixteenth century Naritsuna expanded the family's power in northern Kantō, defeating the Satake in 1516. Utsunomiya Kunitsuna joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi's campaign against Odawara in 1590 and retained his lands, but Hideyoshi dispossessed him in 1597.
zh:
宇都宫氏是以下野国宇都宫为根据地的武家。14世纪南北朝战争中，宇都宫公纲支持南朝，其子氏纲则加入足利氏一方。

16世纪初，宇都宫成纲扩大了家族在北关东的势力，并于1516年击败佐竹氏。宇都宫国纲于1590年参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，保住领地，却在1597年被秀吉没收领地。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Utrecht was an ecclesiastical state governing the northern Low Countries. Its roots go back to 695, when Saint Willibrord settled at Utrecht as bishop of the Frisians. In 1024 the bishops became princes of the empire, and their secular lands were divided into the Nedersticht and the larger Oversticht.

Episcopal authority was weak: the Drenthers annihilated a bishop's army at Ane in 1227, killing Bishop Otto of Lippe, while Floris V of Holland annexed the lands around Amsterdam around 1270. In 1337 Jan van Diest, imposed by Holland and Guelders, held the see; his debts let them dictate a partition treaty in 1331, thwarted only by local resistance.

Burgundy claimed protection in 1439, and in 1528 the last prince-bishop, Henry of Bavaria, surrendered temporal power to Charles V, who divided the lands into Utrecht, Overijssel and Drenthe.
zh:
乌得勒支采邑主教区是统治低地北部的教会邦国。源头可追溯到695年，圣威利布罗德被祝圣为弗里斯兰人的主教，驻节乌得勒支。1024年主教擢升为帝国诸侯，世俗领地分为下辖区和范围更大的上辖区。

主教的地方权威相当薄弱：1227年德伦特人在阿内之战中歼灭主教军队，主教利珀的奥托阵亡；荷兰伯爵弗洛里斯五世约1270年吞并阿姆斯特丹一带。1337年在位的约翰·范·迪斯特由荷兰和海尔德扶植；他债台高筑，两国1331年操纵瓜分条约，全靠当地抵抗才未得逞。

1439年勃艮第宣称拥有保护权；1528年末代采邑主教巴伐利亚的亨利把世俗权力交给查理五世，旧地划为乌得勒支、上艾瑟尔和德伦特。

en:
The Kingdom of Valencia was a realm of the Crown of Aragon on the eastern coast of Iberia, established after the conquest of Valencia in 1238. Its own charters, the Furs, gave it institutions and considerable self-government under the Aragonese kings.

In 1519 the armed guilds of Valencia began the Revolt of the Brotherhoods against Charles I's government; the rebels also forcibly converted Muslims before their defeat. After the War of the Spanish Succession, Philip V abolished Valencia's laws and institutions in 1707 through the Nueva Planta decrees.
zh:
巴伦西亚王国位于伊比利亚半岛东岸，是阿拉贡王冠属下的一个王国，建立于1238年巴伦西亚被征服之后。它拥有自己的《巴伦西亚法典》，在阿拉贡国王治下享有相当程度的自治。

1519年，巴伦西亚武装行会发动兄弟会起义，反抗查理一世的政府；起义者还在失败前强迫穆斯林改宗。西班牙王位继承战争后，腓力五世于1707年通过《新政令》废除了巴伦西亚的法律和机构。

en: In Malagasy oral traditions, the Vazimba were early inhabitants of Madagascar and had local rulers in the central highlands. In the sixteenth century Andriamanelo fought the surrounding Vazimba communities, compelling them to submit or flee.
zh: 马达加斯加口述传统中的瓦赞巴人是岛上的早期居民，在中央高地有各地的统治者。16世纪，安德里亚马内卢攻打周边瓦赞巴社群，迫使他们臣服或逃离。

en:
The Land of Valkenburg was a lordship of the Holy Roman Empire east of the Maas around Maastricht. Oud-Valkenburg was first named in 1041; around 1075 a hill castle above the Geul became the lords' seat, and the lordship passed by marriage to the house of Heinsberg in 1118.

It warred repeatedly with neighbours such as Jülich, Guelders and Liège, and its castle was besieged after Worringen in 1288. In 1337 its lord was Dirk IV. The male line ended in 1352; after a dispute the lordship was sold to Jülich in 1355, raised to a county in 1357 and sold in 1364 to Duke Wenceslaus of Brabant.

It then became one of Brabant's three Lands of Overmaas; the 1661 Partage Treaty split it between Spain and the Dutch Republic, and in 1795 France united both halves, ending it.
zh:
法尔肯堡是神圣罗马帝国封邑，在马斯河以东、马斯特里赫特一带。奥德法尔肯堡1041年首见记载；约1075年赫尔河畔高地上修建的城堡成为历代领主治所，1118年领地经联姻转入海因斯贝格家族。

它反复同于利希、海尔德、列日等强邻交战，1288年沃林根战役后城堡遭围攻。1337年在位的是迪尔克四世。1352年男系断绝，纠纷之后领地1355年卖给于利希公爵，1357年升格为伯国，1364年转卖给布拉班特公爵文策尔。

它从此成为布拉班特的马斯河外三领地之一；1661年分割条约把它分给西班牙与联省共和国，1795年法国统一南北两部，建制就此终结。

en:
The Principality of Vitebsk was a Ruthenian appanage centred on the river port of Vitebsk, whose trade ran down the Western Dvina to Riga. It was created in 1101, when the sons of Vseslav of Polotsk divided his lands and Vitebsk fell to Sviatoslav Vseslavich.

In 1129 the prince of Kiev, Mstislav, captured the Polotsk dynasty and sent them into exile in Constantinople, but Sviatoslav's son Vasilko returned in 1132 to reclaim his town, and his line kept Vitebsk through long contests with Smolensk and Polotsk. Its last prince, Jaroslav Vasilkovich, died without male heirs in 1320, and his daughter Maria's marriage to the Lithuanian grand duke Algirdas carried Vitebsk into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, where Algirdas ruled it in person.

The appanage kept its own administration until 1393, and in 1508 its lands, together with Orsha, Drutsk and Mogilev, formed the Vitebsk Voivodeship.
zh:
维捷布斯克公国是以河港维捷布斯克为中心的鲁塞尼亚封邑，贸易沿西德维纳河直通里加。1101年波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫的诸子瓜分父土，维捷布斯克归斯维亚托斯拉夫·弗谢斯拉维奇，公国由此建立。

1129年基辅王公姆斯季斯拉夫俘获波洛茨克王朝全家，流放至君士坦丁堡，但斯维亚托斯拉夫之子瓦西里科于1132年返回夺回本城，其家族在同斯摩棱斯克和波洛茨克的长期争夺中保有维捷布斯克。末代王公雅罗斯拉夫·瓦西里科维奇于1320年去世，没有男嗣，他的女儿玛丽亚嫁给立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯，维捷布斯克随之并入立陶宛大公国，由阿尔吉尔达斯亲自统治。

该封邑保留自己的行政机构直到1393年，1508年其土地连同奥尔沙、德鲁茨克和莫吉廖夫组成维捷布斯克省。

en:
Vadakkumkur, meaning the northern regency, was a Hindu principality in the Kerala backwaters whose rajas kept their court at Karikkode. It took shape around 1102, when the old region of Vempolinad split in two after the collapse of the Chera Kulasekhara kingdom: the southern half became Thekkumkur and the northern half Vadakkumkur, which entered the orbit of Cochin as its vassal.

In 1600 it defeated and absorbed the neighbouring chiefdom of Keezhmalainadu. After the Portuguese established themselves at Cochin, quarrels over the pepper trade led to war, and the Vadakkumkur raja was killed fighting Cochin and its Portuguese allies; his dynasty afterwards divided into the Mattathil and Kadanadu branches.

In 1750 Marthanda Varma of Travancore overran the principality, his commander Ramayyan destroyed Karikkode, and Vadakkumkur was incorporated into Travancore.
zh:
瓦达库姆库尔意为“北方摄政之邦”，是喀拉拉回水地带的印度教小邦，罗阇们以卡里科德为宫廷所在地。1102年前后，切拉·库拉谢卡拉王国解体后，旧地温波利纳德一分为二：南半成为特库姆库尔，北半成为瓦达库姆库尔，后者作为科钦的附庸进入其势力范围。

1600年，它攻灭并吞并了邻近的基兹马拉纳德酋长国。葡萄牙人在科钦立足后，双方因胡椒贸易争执开战，瓦达库姆库尔罗阇在与科钦及其葡萄牙盟友的作战中阵亡，其家族此后分为马塔蒂尔和卡达纳德两支。

1750年，特拉凡哥尔的玛尔坦达·瓦尔马攻入该邦，将领拉马扬摧毁卡里科德，瓦达库姆库尔被并入特拉凡哥尔。

en:
The County of Vendôme was a fief on the Loir in north-central France, formed from the Frankish pagus vindocinensis. Its first known counts were the Bouchardides, beginning with Bouchard the Venerable, a follower of Hugh Capet who balanced between Blois and Anjou; Angevin influence dominated until the early thirteenth century, when the county passed to the House of Montoire.

In 1337 its count was Bouchard VI, who had sold his minting rights to Philip V in 1320 and fixed his border with Blois in 1329. He died in 1354, succeeded by his son John VI; when the last Montoire heiress Catherine married John of Bourbon-La Marche, the county passed to a junior Bourbon branch in 1372.

Raised to a duchy-peerage in 1515, Vendôme entered the royal domain in 1589 when its duke became King Henry IV.
zh:
旺多姆伯国是法兰西北部卢瓦河畔的封地，由法兰克时期的行政区“旺多辛”发展而来。已知最早的伯爵出自布沙尔家族，始祖“可敬者”布沙尔一世是于格·卡佩的亲信，在布卢瓦与安茹之间周旋；后来安茹势力长期主导，13世纪初蒙图瓦尔家族接管。

1337年在位的是布沙尔六世，他1320年把铸币权卖给腓力五世，1329年又以条约划定与布卢瓦的边界。1354年他去世，其子让六世继位；蒙图瓦尔家族末代女继承人卡特琳嫁给波旁-拉马什的让，伯国遂于1372年转入波旁家族的一支。

1515年旺多姆被升为公爵兼贵族领地，1589年其公爵以亨利四世的身份登上法国王位，旺多姆随之并入王室领地。

en:
Verdun, the Roman Virodunum on the Meuse in Lorraine, was the seat of a fourth-century bishopric in the province of Trier. Merovingian King Childebert II endowed Bishop Agericus with Moselle estates, and under the Ottonian emperors the see rose to secular power: in 997 Otto III granted its bishops the title of Count.

The count's rights were at first exercised by life-counts of the Ardennes family, whose quarrels with the bishops long troubled the principality. French influence grew steadily, and from 1331 the king of France rather than the emperor controlled episcopal appointments. Plague and warfare depopulated the diocese in the fourteenth century.

In 1552 Henry II annexed Verdun with Toul and Metz, recognised by the Empire in the Peace of Westphalia of 1648. The bishopric then formed part of the French province of the Three Bishoprics until secularised in the Revolution.
zh:
凡尔登位于洛林的默兹河畔，罗马时代称维罗杜努姆，4世纪起设有教区，隶属特里尔教省。墨洛温国王希尔德贝尔特二世曾把摩泽尔沿岸地产赐给阿格里库斯主教；奥托诸帝治下教区取得世俗权力，997年奥托三世授予主教及其继任者伯爵头衔。

伯爵之权起初由阿登家族的终身伯爵行使，他们与主教长期争斗。法国影响不断加深，从1331年起主教人选改由法国国王而非皇帝掌控。14世纪的瘟疫和战争使教区人口锐减。

1552年亨利二世把凡尔登连同图勒、梅斯一并吞并，帝国在1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约》中予以承认。此后主教区成为法国三主教区行省的一部分，直到法国大革命期间被世俗化。

en:
Vayots Dzor, meaning the valley of sorrows in Armenian, was a mountainous canton of historic Syunik along the upper Arpa River. In the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries the Orbelian princes of Syunik and their Proshian vassals held it. Noravank monastery was raised in the thirteenth century, and Orbelian's caravanserai of 1332 served Silk Road merchants.

The valley's greatest renown came from the University of Gladzor, founded around 1280 by Nerses of Mush; with around 350 students, it taught theology, philosophy and illuminated manuscripts until closing in 1340.

Timur's 1385 invasion broke Orbelian power, and from the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries the valley was repeatedly fought over by Turkmen and Iranian armies. Under Persian rule the valley became part of the Nakhichevan Khanate and was known as Daralagyaz, until the Treaty of Turkmenchay transferred it to Russia in 1828.
zh:
瓦约茨佐尔在亚美尼亚语中意为“悲叹之谷”，是休尼克山区、阿尔帕河上游的州。13至14世纪，奥尔贝利扬王公及其封臣普罗什扬家族统治此地。诺拉旺克修道院建于13世纪，奥尔贝利扬商队驿站建于1332年，服务丝绸之路商队。

山谷最负盛名的是格拉佐尔大学：约1280年由穆什的涅尔谢斯创办，曾有约350名学生，讲授神学、哲学和泥金手抄本技艺，1340年关闭。

1385年帖木儿入侵摧毁奥尔贝利扬家族权势；15至17世纪，山谷屡遭土库曼和伊朗军队争夺。波斯统治时期并入纳希切万汗国，改称达拉拉格亚兹，直到1828年《土库曼恰伊条约》把它割让给俄国。

en:
The Venda kingdom lay in the Soutpansberg region south of the Limpopo River. Venda traditions associate its capital Dzata with the chief Thohoyandou, after whose disappearance the kingdom fragmented into independent chiefdoms.

Archaeological dating places Dzata's construction shortly after 1700 and its abandonment some 50 to 60 years later. Dutch records from 1730 describe a stone-walled settlement visited by a traveller in the kingdom of Thovhele.
zh:
文达王国位于林波波河以南的绍特潘斯堡地区。文达人的传统将首都扎塔与酋长托霍扬杜联系在一起，相传他失踪后，王国分裂为各自独立的酋邦。

考古测年显示，扎塔建于1700年后不久，约50至60年后被废弃。1730年的荷兰记录描述了一名旅人在托韦莱王国见到的石墙聚落。

en:
The County of Veldenz, a Hunsrück and Moselle principality, originated in 1112, when its first counts split from the wildgraves of Kyrburg. That line ended with Count Gerlach V in 1260; his daughter Agnes married Heinrich of Geroldseck, bringing the county to the Veldenz-Geroldseck house, still ruling from Thallichtenberg in 1337.

When Frederick III died without a male heir, his daughter Anna brought Veldenz in 1444 to Stephen, Count Palatine of Simmern-Zweibrücken, and into the Wittelsbach orbit. By the 1543 Marburg Contract Count Wolfgang of Zweibrücken granted Veldenz to his uncle Rupert.

This line ended in 1694 when Leopold Ludwig died without legitimate children, and the war-ravaged county reverted to Zweibrücken before passing to the Electoral Palatinate in 1733. French rule from 1801 swept away the old county, and the 1815 Congress of Vienna split its lands between Prussia and Bavaria.
zh:
费尔登茨伯国在洪斯吕克山与摩泽尔河一带，1112年从基尔堡荒野伯爵家族分立。第一系1260年随格拉赫五世去世终结，其女阿格尼丝嫁与杰拉尔德塞克的海因里希，伯国转入费尔登茨杰拉尔德塞克家族，1337年治所在塔尔利希滕贝格。

弗里德里希三世无男嗣，其女安娜1444年把伯国带给锡门—茨韦布吕肯行宫伯爵斯特凡，费尔登茨由此落入维特尔斯巴赫家族势力范围。依据1543年《马尔堡契约》，茨韦布吕肯伯爵沃尔夫冈把费尔登茨封给叔父鲁普雷希特。

该支1694年随利奥波德·路德维希无合法子嗣而终，残破的伯国复归茨韦布吕肯，1733年转入普法尔茨选侯国。1801年法国统治取消旧伯国，1815年维也纳会议将土地分给普鲁士与巴伐利亚。

en:
The Republic of Venice was a maritime republic in its lagoon, traditionally founded in 697 under an elected doge. Between the ninth and eleventh centuries its fleets controlled the Adriatic; the 1109 conquest of Dalmatia gave the doge the title of Doge of Venice, Dalmatia and Croatia. Enrico Dandolo led the Fourth Crusade fleet that sacked Constantinople in 1204, securing independence, Crete and eastern ports.

Rivalry with Genoa led to the War of Chioggia, ended by the 1381 Treaty of Turin; Venice expanded on the mainland, taking Padua in 1405 into the Domini di Terraferma. Its doge in 1337 was Francesco Dandolo, and the gold ducat of 1284 was already the Mediterranean's standard coin.

Cambrai League forces beat Venice at Agnadello in 1509, Ottoman wars stripping its eastern empire: Cyprus fell in 1570 despite victory at Lepanto in 1571, and the War of Candia cost it Crete. In 1797 Napoleon occupied the lagoon, Doge Ludovico Manin abdicated, and Campo Formio divided the republic between France and Austria.
zh:
威尼斯共和国是建立在威尼斯潟湖群岛上的海洋共和国，传统上认为建于697年，总督由选举产生。9至11世纪，其舰队控制亚得里亚海；1109年征服达尔马提亚后，总督获得威尼斯、达尔马提亚与克罗地亚总督的头衔。恩里科·丹多洛率舰队参加第四次十字军东征，1204年洗劫君士坦丁堡，威尼斯由此独立，获得克里特和一连串东方商港。

与热那亚的争霸引发基奥贾战争，1381年《都灵和约》后威尼斯转向大陆扩张，1405年取得帕多瓦，纳入“大陆领土”。1337年在位的总督是弗朗切斯科·丹多洛，1284年起铸造的金杜卡特已是地中海的标准货币。

1509年康布雷同盟在阿尼亚代洛击败威尼斯，此后对奥斯曼的战争逐步剥去其东方领地：1571年勒班陀海战取胜仍挡不住塞浦路斯1570年陷落，干地亚战争又使它失去克里特。1797年拿破仑占领潟湖，总督卢多维科·马宁退位，《坎波福尔米奥和约》将共和国瓜分给法国和奥地利。

en:
Verona was the signoria of the della Scala family, the Scaligeri, who ruled the city and much of the Veneto mainland from 1262, when Mastino I della Scala made himself capitano del popolo and made the commune's office hereditary in his family. Its greatest prince was Cangrande I, lord from 1308, a warrior and patron of Dante, Petrarch and Giotto who added Vicenza, Padua in 1328 and Treviso in 1329 to his domains.

In 1337 the ruler was his nephew Mastino II, the richest prince in Italy of his generation. His power alarmed the peninsula: Venice, Florence, the Visconti, the Este and the Gonzaga formed a league against him, and after a three-year war the Scaliger state was reduced to Verona and Vicenza.

Later rule was marked by tyranny and fratricide, and in 1387 Gian Galeazzo Visconti of Milan drove out Antonio della Scala, ending Scaliger rule. A brief restoration in 1404 ended with the lord's death ten days later, and in 1405 Verona passed to the Republic of Venice.
zh:
维罗纳是斯卡拉家族的领主政权。1262年马斯蒂诺一世自立为人民队长，将公社官职改为家族世袭，统治维罗纳及威尼托大陆大片土地。最杰出的君主坎格兰德一世1308年继位，能征善战，也是但丁、彼特拉克和乔托的庇护人，先后取得维琴察、1328年的帕多瓦和1329年的特雷维索。

1337年在位的是他的侄子马斯蒂诺二世，当时意大利最富有的君主。其强盛令半岛各国恐惧，威尼斯、佛罗伦萨、维斯孔蒂、埃斯特和贡扎加结成反斯卡拉同盟，经过三年战争，斯卡拉家族的领地只剩维罗纳和维琴察。

此后的统治残暴且骨肉相残。1387年，米兰的吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂赶走安东尼奥·德拉·斯卡拉，斯卡拉家族的统治告终。1404年短暂复辟，复辟者十天后即死去，1405年维罗纳并入威尼斯共和国。

en: The Vezo are coastal fishing communities of southwestern Madagascar, living between Intampolo and Morondava. They fish from dugout canoes and traditionally exchange fish with the inland Masikoro and Mikea.
zh: 威祖是马达加斯加西南沿海的渔民群体，居住在因坦普卢与穆龙达瓦之间。他们乘独木舟捕鱼，传统上与内陆的马西库鲁人和米凯亚人交换鱼获。

en:
Vidin was a Bulgarian realm centered on the Danube fortress of the same name. Ivan Sratsimir, son of Tsar Ivan Alexander, proclaimed himself emperor there in 1356 after his half-brother was chosen as heir to the Bulgarian throne.

Hungarian forces occupied his lands, but were driven out with his father's help. After Ivan Alexander died in 1371, Sratsimir broke with Tarnovo; following the crusaders' defeat at Nicopolis in 1396, the Ottomans seized Vidin and imprisoned him.
zh:
维丁是一个以多瑙河畔同名要塞为中心的保加利亚政权。沙皇伊凡·亚历山大的儿子伊凡·斯拉齐米尔在异母弟被选为保加利亚王位继承人后，于1356年在此自称皇帝。

匈牙利军队曾占领他的领地，但在他父亲的帮助下被逐出。1371年伊凡·亚历山大去世后，斯拉齐米尔与特尔诺沃断绝关系；1396年十字军在尼科波利斯战败后，奥斯曼人夺取维丁并囚禁了他。

en:
The Vijayanagara Empire was founded in 1336 by the brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I of the Sangama dynasty, after Delhi Sultanate armies overran the Deccan kingdoms. Its capital on the Tungabhadra, whose name means City of Victory and whose ruins survive at Hampi, became the heart of Hindu resistance against the north.

Harihara I consolidated the lands south of the river; under Bukka Raya I the court entered the fortified city, and around 1371 his son destroyed the Madurai sultanate and annexed the Tamil country.

Krishnadevaraya of the Tuluva line, ruling from 1509 to 1529, brought the empire to its peak, defeating the Deccan sultans and Orissa's Gajapatis and drawing tribute from most of southern India; his age raised temple cities and drew Portuguese horse traders to its markets. In 1565 Deccan sultanate armies destroyed the imperial army at Talikota, killed the regent Rama Raya and sacked the capital. The Aravidu kept a rump state until 1646.
zh:
毗奢耶那伽罗帝国由桑迦摩王朝的哈里哈拉一世与布卡·拉亚一世兄弟于1336年建立，此前德里苏丹国军队攻灭了德干诸王国。都城位于栋格珀德拉河畔，其名意为胜利之城，遗址留存于亨比，是印度教世界抵御北方的核心。

哈里哈拉一世整合大河以南的土地；布卡·拉亚一世时朝廷迁入设防新都，约1371年其子攻灭马杜赖苏丹国，吞并泰米尔地区。

图卢瓦王朝的克里希纳德瓦拉亚于1509至1529年在位，把帝国推向鼎盛，连败德干诸苏丹与奥里萨的伽贾帕提王朝，南印度大部称臣纳贡，其间广建神庙城市，葡萄牙马匹商人云集市场。1565年，德干诸苏丹联军在塔利科塔歼灭帝国大军，杀摄政罗摩·拉亚并洗劫都城。阿拉维杜王朝保有残余政权，直至1646年消亡。

en:
The Vili were a Kongo people of the Atlantic coast who became the dominant political group in the Kingdom of Loango, north of the Congo River. Loango emerged by the sixteenth century, with its capital at Bwali, and traded copper and cloth with Europeans.

The English traveller Andrew Battel recorded around 1610 that an earlier king, Njimbe, had ruled there. After King Buatu died in 1787, the succession became uncertain.
zh:
维利人是大西洋沿岸的刚果人支系，在刚果河以北的卢安果王国成为占主导地位的政治群体。卢安果至迟在16世纪兴起，以布瓦利为都，同欧洲人交易铜和布匹。

英国旅行者安德鲁·巴特尔约在1610年记述，早先的国王恩津贝曾在那里统治。1787年国王布阿图去世后，王位继承变得不明朗。

en:
Vicenza was a commune on the Bacchiglione in northern Italy. After Emperor Frederick II sacked it in 1237, it fell under Ezzelino III; its republican councils were restored after his death, but Paduan protection became domination.

In 1311 Vicenza submitted to Verona's Scaligeri, whose lord Cangrande fought to retain it. Venice took control in 1404; the city remained Venetian until the republic fell in 1797, and passed to Austria after 1814.
zh:
维琴察是意大利北部巴基廖内河畔的一座自治市。皇帝腓特烈二世于1237年洗劫该城后，它落入埃切利诺三世手中；他死后共和议会得以恢复，但帕多瓦的保护逐渐变成了统治。

1311年，维琴察归附维罗纳的斯卡利杰里家族，其领主坎格兰德曾为保住该城而作战。威尼斯于1404年取得维琴察，该城一直属于威尼斯，直到共和国于1797年灭亡；1814年后它转归奥地利。

en:
Valluvanad, or the Arangottu Swaroopam, was a medieval chiefdom of north-central Kerala, ruled from Angadipuram by the Vellattiri rajas, who bore the title Valluvakonathiri. Under the Chera kings it was already a leading chiefdom: its lord Rayiran Chathan witnessed the Jewish Copper Plates around 1000, and the Valluvanad Six Hundred militia protected markets far beyond its borders.

When the Chera kingdom dissolved in the early twelfth century Valluvanad became independent and inherited the sacred duty of guarding the Mamankam festival at Tirunavaya. The rising Zamorins of Kozhikode seized Tirunavaya and neighbouring lands, took over the Mamankam rite and executed the Vellattiri's minister; generations of Chaver suicide warriors were sent to challenge the Zamorin at the festival.

Mysorean armies overran the country later in the eighteenth century, and in 1793 the British East India Company deposed the raja and turned Valluvanad into the Walluvanad taluk.
zh:
瓦卢瓦纳德又称阿兰戈图斯瓦鲁帕姆，是喀拉拉中北部的中世纪酋长国，以安加迪普兰为治所，统治者称韦拉蒂里罗阇，头衔为瓦卢瓦科纳蒂里。哲罗诸王时代它已是大酋长国之一：首领拉伊兰·查坦在约1000年的犹太铜盘上列名见证，瓦卢瓦纳德的六百人民兵还在境外保护市集。

12世纪初哲罗王国解体后，瓦卢瓦纳德独立，并继承了在蒂鲁纳瓦亚马曼卡姆节护法的圣职。崛起的科泽科德扎莫林夺取蒂鲁纳瓦亚及邻近土地，篡走马曼卡姆仪式主持权，处死韦拉蒂里的大臣；一代又一代查维尔死士被派往节庆现场刺杀扎莫林。

18世纪后期迈索尔军队攻占该国，1793年英国东印度公司废黜罗阇，把瓦卢瓦纳德改为瓦卢瓦纳德县。

en:
The County of Valentinois covered the lower Rhône lands around Valence, the Roman Valentia, usually together with the neighbouring Diois around Die. As an imperial fief it passed in the twelfth century to the house of Poitiers-Valentinois, named after a local castle and unrelated to the city of Poitiers.

In 1337 the count was Aymar V, vassal of the Dauphin Humbert II of Viennois, with whom he settled a long homage dispute at Chabeuil in 1338. His successors served the Dauphiné: Aymar VI was its governor from 1349 and rector of the Comtat Venaissin.

When the last male heir, Louis II, died in 1419, his testament made the Dauphin Charles, son of Charles VI, his successor, and Valentinois was absorbed into the Dauphiné and the royal domain. In 1498 Louis XII revived the title as a duchy for Cesare Borgia.
zh:
瓦朗蒂努瓦伯国据有罗讷河下游、瓦朗斯（罗马时代的瓦伦蒂亚）周围的土地，通常与邻近迪城一带的迪瓦合并统治。作为帝国封地，它12世纪转入普瓦捷—瓦朗蒂努瓦家族；该家族得名于当地一座城堡，与普瓦捷城并无关系。

1337年在位的艾马尔五世是维埃纳多菲内藩王安贝尔二世的封臣，1338年在沙伯伊与藩王了结旷日持久的臣服之争。他的继任者效力于多菲内：艾马尔六世1349年出任多菲内总督，还担任过沃奈桑伯爵领地的摄政。

末代男嗣路易二世1419年去世，遗嘱指定查理六世之子、王太子查理为继承人，瓦朗蒂努瓦随之并入多菲内和王室领地。1498年路易十二把该头衔重立为公国，封给切萨雷·波吉亚。

en:
The Grand Principality of Vladimir, also called Vladimir-Suzdal, was the leading power of northeast Rus'. It grew out of the Rostov-Suzdal lands: Yury Dolgoruky moved his seat to Suzdal in 1125 and founded or fortified towns including Moscow, first mentioned in 1147. His son Andrey Bogolyubsky transferred the capital to Vladimir and sacked Kiev in 1169, while Vsevolod the Big Nest made the grand prince overlord of the other princes.

The Mongol invasion of 1237 to 1238 devastated the land and killed Grand Prince Yury II, after which the princes held their title as nominees of the khan.

By 1300 the grand principality had split into more than a dozen appanages, and Moscow and Tver fought over its throne. From 1331 the prince of Moscow held the grand principality almost continuously; in 1337 the grand prince was Ivan I Kalita of Moscow, and in 1389 the two titles were united for good.
zh:
弗拉基米尔大公国又称弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔大公国，是东北罗斯的头号强权。它起于罗斯托夫-苏兹达尔之地：尤里·多尔戈鲁基1125年把驻节地迁到苏兹达尔，兴建或加固的城镇包括最早见于1147年记载的莫斯科。其子安德烈·博戈柳布斯基迁都弗拉基米尔，1169年洗劫基辅；“大窝”弗谢沃洛德三世则让大公成为罗斯诸王公的宗主。

1237—1238年蒙古入侵蹂躏这片土地，大公尤里二世战死，此后大公之位须由汗册封。

1300年前后，大公国已分裂成十余个封邑，莫斯科与特维尔为争夺大公之位长期角力。1331年起莫斯科王公几乎一直兼任弗拉基米尔大公，1337年在位的是莫斯科的伊凡一世·卡利塔，1389年两个权位正式合一。

en:
Valois was a French county centred on Crépy-en-Valois in the Oise valley. It formed part of a chain of fiefs that defended Paris against Viking raids. King Philip III's son Charles held Valois as an appanage, and his descendants took its name.

Charles died in 1325, and his son became King Philip VI of France in 1328. The House of Valois ruled France until 1589, while Valois itself continued to be granted to members of the royal family.
zh:
瓦卢瓦是法国北部瓦兹河谷的伯国，以克雷皮昂瓦卢瓦为中心，曾是抵御维京人袭击巴黎的一连串封地之一。国王腓力三世之子查理获封瓦卢瓦，他的后裔以此为家族名。

查理于1325年去世，其子在1328年成为法国国王腓力六世。瓦卢瓦王朝统治法国至1589年，而瓦卢瓦领地继续被授予王室成员。

en:
Volterra is a walled hill town in the Tuscan interior, the Etruscan Velathri, one of the twelve cities of the Etruscan League, and later the Roman municipium of Volaterrae. A bishopric from the fifth century, it was ruled by its bishops from the ninth and tenth centuries until Bishop Galgano Pannocchieschi was murdered at the cathedral doors in 1170, opening the way to a free commune.

Around 1300 the city was torn by Guelph and Ghibelline feuds between the Belforti and Allegretti families. In 1340 the Allegretti were driven out and Ottaviano Belforti made himself signore; his son Bocchino was beheaded in 1361 for trying to sell the city to Pisa, and Volterra fell under Florentine control.

A revolt led by Giusto Landini briefly restored independence in 1429 before he was murdered, and in 1472, during the war over the alum mines, Florentine troops sacked the town.
zh:
沃尔泰拉是托斯卡纳内陆有城墙的山城，古称维拉特里，是伊特鲁里亚联盟十二城之一，后为罗马的沃拉特雷自治市。它5世纪起为主教驻地，9至10世纪起由主教统治；1170年主教加尔加诺·潘诺基耶斯基在大教堂门口被杀，为自由公社开辟了道路。

1300年前后，城市陷入圭尔夫派与吉伯林派的仇杀，贝尔福尔蒂与阿莱格雷蒂两家族彼此相争。1340年阿莱格雷蒂家族被逐，奥塔维亚诺·贝尔福尔蒂自立为领主；其子博基诺因企图把城市卖给比萨，1361年被斩首，沃尔泰拉随即落入佛罗伦萨控制。

1429年朱斯托·兰迪尼领导的起义一度恢复独立，但他很快遇害；1472年围绕明矾矿的战争中，佛罗伦萨军队洗劫该城。

en:
Vunda was a small Kongo kingdom within the confederation of Mpemba, which from the thirteenth century held the country between the Loze River and the Congo. Vunda ruled lesser units of its own, among them Mpangala.

As the Kingdom of Kongo arose in the fourteenth century, Mpemba was absorbed into it, and the lord of Vunda, bearing the title Ne Vunda, became one of the great officers of the Kongo court.

The most famous holder of the title, Antonio Emanuele Ne Vunda, was sent to Europe by King Álvaro II in 1604 as ambassador to the papacy. Travelling by way of Brazil and Spain, he reached Rome only on 3 January 1608 and died of illness two days later, the first African ambassador ever received by the Holy See; he was buried in the basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore.
zh:
温达是姆彭巴邦联境内的刚果语小王国；姆彭巴邦联自13世纪起据有洛泽河至刚果河之间的土地，温达还统辖着姆潘加拉等更小的单元。

14世纪刚果王国兴起后，姆彭巴被并入刚果，温达领主带着内温达的头衔，成为刚果王廷的重臣之一。

最著名的一任内温达是安东尼奥·埃马努埃莱·内温达，他于1604年受国王阿尔瓦罗二世派遣，作为使节出使罗马教廷。他经巴西和西班牙辗转前行，直到1608年1月3日才抵达罗马，两天后即病逝；他是教廷接待的第一位非洲使节，葬于圣母大殿。

en:
Venad was a medieval principality at India's south-western tip, ruled from the spice port of Kollam. It began under Chera rule as a chiefly territory and became independent under the Kulasekhara dynasty in the early twelfth century. As Chera power faded, it came under Pandya suzerainty, and when the Pandyas collapsed in the early fourteenth century its ruler Ravi Varma Kulasekhara carried arms into the Tamil country.

Kollam had been a great Indian Ocean emporium since the ninth century, known to Marco Polo and Arab and Chinese merchants, whose trade gave the Venad rulers wealth and their own coinage. In the sixteenth century the rajas acknowledged Vijayanagara overlordship and later paid tribute to Madurai's Nayaks while the realm split into branches.

The English East India Company opened a Vizhinjam factory in 1664 and built Fort Anjengo in 1695. Under Marthanda Varma it became the centralised kingdom of Travancore.
zh:
吠那住是印度西南端的中世纪小邦，以香料港奎隆为统治中心。它最初是哲罗诸王治下的酋长领地，12世纪初在库拉谢卡拉王朝治下成为独立政权。哲罗衰落后它转受潘地亚宗主权约束；14世纪初潘地亚崩溃时，君主拉维·瓦尔马·库拉谢卡拉挥师攻入泰米尔地区。

奎隆自9世纪起就是印度洋大商港，马可·波罗以及阿拉伯、中国商人都曾到访，贸易为吠那住统治者带来财富和自铸钱币的权力。16世纪罗阇们承认毗奢耶那伽罗的霸权，后来又向马杜赖的纳亚克纳贡，国土则分裂为若干旁支。

英国东印度公司于1664年在维津贾姆设立商馆，1695年建成安金戈堡垒。马尔坦达·瓦尔马后来把吠那住改造为中央集权的特拉凡哥尔王国。

en:
The viscounty of Ventadour was a small Limousin lordship in the Corrèze hills, ruled from the eleventh-century Château de Ventadour, with political centres at Égletons and Ussel. Its court won fame in the twelfth century, when Viscount Eble III patronised the troubadour Bernart de Ventadorn, possibly a baker's son at the castle, who became the leading poet-composer of the troubadour age before following Eleanor of Aquitaine to the English court.

In 1337 it was still held by the House of Ventadour as a vassal of the French crown. It was raised to a county in 1350 and to a duchy-peerage in 1578.

The native line ended in 1472, when the heiress married Louis de Lévis; the lands and title passed through the Rohan family to the princes of Condé, while the old castle was sold and dismantled after the Revolution.
zh:
旺塔杜尔子爵领是利穆赞科雷兹山区的小封邑，以11世纪建成的旺塔杜尔城堡为统治中心，政务中心在埃格勒通和于塞勒。12世纪时它的宫廷声名远播：子爵埃布尔三世庇护了游吟诗人贝尔纳·德·旺塔杜尔——他可能是城堡面包师的儿子，后来成为游吟诗人时代最有影响的诗人兼作曲家，最终随阿基坦的埃莉诺前往英格兰宫廷。

1337年，子爵领仍由旺塔杜尔家族以法兰西王室封臣的身份领有。它于1350年升为伯爵领，1578年升为公爵兼法兰西贵族院成员。

1472年本土家族绝嗣，女继承人嫁给路易·德·莱维斯；领地和头衔后来经罗昂家族传到孔代亲王手中，古老的城堡则在法国大革命后被出售拆毁。

en:
Vohemar is a Swahili trading port on the northeast coast of Madagascar, likely founded around the thirteenth century. Its Islamized Rasikajy merchants mixed with the local Antankarana people and buried their dead in a necropolis outside the town whose soapstone vessels, Chinese porcelain and beads record a busy Indian Ocean trade.

After the older port of Mahilaka was abandoned, Vohemar became one of the island's leading commercial towns in the fifteenth century. The Arab navigator Ibn Majid knew it as Bimaruh, and Portuguese sailors called it Bemaro from 1514.

In 1526 it was named Reis Bimar after its sultan Bimar, and Diogo de Couto in 1557 described Bimaro as a haven where navigators of many origins put in. The name Vohémar only came into general use in the seventeenth century.
zh:
武海马尔是马达加斯加东北海岸的斯瓦希里贸易港，大约在13世纪建城。信奉伊斯兰教的拉西卡吉商人与当地的安坦卡拉纳人融合，他们在城外墓地留下的皂石器皿、中国瓷器和珠子，见证了繁忙的印度洋贸易。

更早的港口马哈伊拉卡被废弃后，武海马尔在15世纪成为岛上主要的商业城镇之一。阿拉伯航海家伊本·马吉德称它为比马鲁，1514年起葡萄牙水手称之为贝马罗。

1526年它以苏丹比马尔之名得名赖斯·比马尔，1557年迪奥戈·德·科托又把比马罗描述成各地航海者停靠的港湾。武海马尔这一名称到17世纪才通行。

en:
Volhynia, the country around Volodymyr and Lutsk in the western borderlands of Kievan Rus, was already a Rus' principality in the late tenth century. In 1170 Roman Mstislavich inherited Volhynia, and in 1199 he added Halych, founding the united Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia. After the Mongol invasion of 1239 to 1241 its princes became Golden Horde tributaries but kept their Rurikid dynasty.

In 1337 Yuri II Boleslav, a Piast prince from Masovia, ruled Volhynia together with Halych; after he was poisoned by his boyars in 1340, the Galicia-Volhynia Wars ended the united kingdom, and between 1352 and 1366 Poland and Lithuania divided Volhynia between them.

The Lithuanian share became a province of the Grand Duchy in 1452, and after the 1569 Union of Lublin all of Volhynia became the Volhynian Voivodeship of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In the Third Partition of 1795 it passed to the Russian Empire as the Volhynian Governorate.
zh:
沃里尼亚位于基辅罗斯西部边陲，领有沃洛德米尔和卢茨克一带，10世纪末已是罗斯公国。1170年罗曼·姆斯季斯拉维奇继承沃里尼亚，1199年又取得哈利奇，建立统一的加利西亚-沃里尼亚王国。1239年至1241年蒙古入侵后，王公成为金帐汗国附庸，仍保留留里克王朝。

1337年，来自马佐夫舍的皮亚斯特王公尤里二世·博莱斯瓦夫兼领沃里尼亚与哈利奇；1340年他被波雅尔毒杀后，加利西亚-沃里尼亚战争终结了统一王国，1352年至1366年间，波兰与立陶宛瓜分了沃里尼亚。

立陶宛所得部分于1452年成为大公国的一省；1569年卢布林联合后，整个沃里尼亚成为波兰立陶宛联邦的沃里尼亚省。1795年第三次瓜分中，它作为沃里尼亚省并入俄罗斯帝国。

en:
Vercelli was a commune on the Sesia between Turin and Milan, independent from 1120. Rival factions contested it until the city submitted to Milan's Visconti in 1334; Bishop Giovanni Fieschi expelled them in 1373, but they recovered it.

After further fighting, Vercelli passed from Montferrat to Savoy in 1427. French and Spanish armies captured it repeatedly in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, and in 1821 the city rose in support of a constitution.
zh:
韦尔切利是都灵与米兰之间、塞西亚河畔的一座自治市，自1120年起独立。敌对派系争夺该城，直到它于1334年归附米兰的维斯孔蒂家族；1373年，主教乔瓦尼·菲耶斯基将他们逐出，但他们随后收复了该城。

经过进一步争夺，韦尔切利于1427年从蒙费拉托转归萨伏依。法国和西班牙军队在16至17世纪多次攻占该城；1821年，城中爆发了支持宪法的起义。

en:
The Prince-Bishopric of Verden was an ecclesiastical state of the Holy Roman Empire in Lower Saxony, ruled from Verden on the Aller. The diocese was founded around 800 under the archbishopric of Mainz, and when the Duchy of Saxony was broken up in 1180 the bishop's lands gained imperial immediacy. In 1195 Bishop Rudolph I built Rotenburg castle on the Wümme, later the episcopal residence.

Bishops were elected by the cathedral chapter, several also holding the neighbouring Archbishopric of Bremen in personal union. Lutheran teaching spread from 1558 and a Protestant ordinance followed in 1568; during the Thirty Years' War the Edict of Restitution briefly restored the Catholic Francis of Wartenberg from 1630 to 1634.

The Peace of Westphalia dissolved the see in 1648; its lands became the Swedish-ruled Principality of Verden, governed with Bremen until its dissolution in 1712.
zh:
费尔登主教侯国是神圣罗马帝国在下萨克森的教会邦国，以阿勒尔河畔的费尔登为中心。其教区约于800年设立，隶属美因茨大主教区；1180年萨克森公国被肢解时，主教领地成为帝国直辖邦国。1195年，主教鲁道夫一世在维默河畔修建罗滕堡城堡，后来成为主教驻地。

主教由大教堂参事会选举产生，有数位主教还以君合关系兼任邻近的不来梅大主教。1558年起路德宗传播，1568年颁布新教规程；三十年战争中，依据《归还敕令》，天主教徒弗朗茨·冯·瓦滕贝格于1630至1634年短暂恢复主教之位。

1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》废除主教区，领地成为瑞典统治的费尔登侯国，与不来梅合并治理，1712年侯国终结。

en:
Vientiane, whose Lao name means the walled city of sandalwood, began as Chantaburi, one of the Mon city-states on the middle Mekong from the eighth century, where Theravada Buddhism spread. By the twelfth century it was in the Khmer orbit: a Vietnamese inscription records its 1135 raid on Nghe An as a Zhenla vassal, and in 1171 its ruler invaded the Tai kingdom of Ngoenyang and was defeated.

In 1354 Fa Ngum incorporated it into his Lan Xang kingdom, and in 1563 Setthathirath moved his capital there to escape Burmese pressure, building the stupa Pha That Luang three years later. When Lan Xang split in 1707 Vientiane became a kingdom of its own; after Burmese suzerainty in 1765 to 1779 it passed to Siamese overlordship; in 1779 the city was sacked and the Emerald Buddha carried away.

Anouvong's rebellion of 1826 to 1827 ended in catastrophe: Siamese armies burned the city, deported its people and extinguished the kingdom, leaving the city in ruins until French rule.
zh:
万象的佬语意为檀木城墙之城，前身是8世纪起湄公河中游的孟人城邦占塔武里，上座部佛教传到这里。12世纪时它进入高棉势力范围：一方越南碑铭记载，1135年万象作为真腊附庸入侵越南义安；1171年其君主进攻泰人的恩央王国，结果兵败。

1354年法昂将该城纳入新建的澜沧王国。1563年塞塔提腊王为躲避缅甸兵锋迁都于此，三年后修建大塔銮。1707年澜沧分裂，万象成为独立王国都城；1765年至1779年臣服缅甸，其后受暹罗宗主权支配，1779年城被攻破，玉佛被掳走。

1826年至1827年阿努冯王起兵反暹，酿成惨祸：暹罗军队将万象夷为平地、迁走人口，王国灭亡，城址直到法国殖民时期才得以重建。

en:
The Barony of Vaud was the great Savoyard appanage between lakes Geneva and Neuchâtel. Savoy gained a foothold at Moudon in 1207, and Peter of Savoy, called the Little Charlemagne, brought most of the pays de Vaud under his rule after 1234; in 1286 it was settled on his descendants as a fief of the Count of Savoy.

Administered from Morges through ten castellanies, its fertile lands yielded more revenue than the neighbouring County of Geneva. In 1337 the baron was Louis II, a veteran of campaigns in Italy and the Hundred Years' War who became regent of Savoy in 1343.

After his death it passed to his daughter Catherine, and in 1359 the Count of Savoy bought it back, ending its semi-independent existence. It remained Savoyard until Bern overran it during the Reformation in 1536.
zh:
沃男爵国是萨伏依家族最大的封邑，位于日内瓦湖与纳沙泰尔湖之间。萨伏依伯爵于1207年率先在穆东取得立足点，绰号“小查理曼”的萨伏依的彼得在1234年以后把沃地区的大部分纳入治下，1286年正式封给其后代，作为向萨伏依伯爵效忠的采邑。

男爵国以莫尔日为行政中心，下辖十个城堡辖区，湖滨沃土收入比邻近日内瓦伯国丰厚。1337年在位的男爵是路易二世，他曾在意大利和百年战争的战场上征战，1343年出任萨伏依伯国摄政。

他死后男爵国传给女儿凯瑟琳，1359年萨伏依伯爵将其购回，这个半独立政权就此终结。此后该地一直属萨伏依，直到1536年宗教改革期间被伯尔尼州攻占。

en:
Vungu, also written Bungu, was a Kongo-speaking kingdom of the Mayombe forest coast, between the present-day Republic of the Congo and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the thirteenth century it stood at the head of a coastal confederation with Ngoyo and Kakongo west of the Congo River.

Kongo tradition remembered it as the dynasty's original home: its rulers were said to have crossed the Congo and imposed their authority on Mpemba Kasi, and around 1390 Nimi a Nzima of Vungu married the heiress of Mbata, founding the Kingdom of Kongo.

Vungu long remained a separate realm, first named in a surviving document in a letter of King Afonso I of Kongo in 1535; the Jesuit Mateus Cardoso recorded its founding role in royal traditions in 1624. In the 1620s the Jaga, driven out of Kongo, moved north with Loango's backing and occupied Vungu.
zh:
温古又译本古，是刚果河以西马永贝森林沿海的刚果语王国，地在今刚果（布）与刚果（金）之间。13世纪它统领与恩戈约、卡刚果组成的沿海邦联。

刚果宫廷传统视其为刚果王朝发源地：据说温古的统治者渡过刚果河，把势力扩展到姆彭巴·卡锡，约1390年温古的尼米·阿·恩齐马与姆巴塔的女继承人联姻，由此诞生刚果王国。

温古长期保持独立政权，现存文献中最早的记载见于刚果国王阿方索一世1535年的书信，耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡多索1624年又将其开国角色写入王室传说。17世纪20年代，被逐出刚果的贾加人得卢安果支持北迁，占领温古。

en:
The Principality of Vyazma was a Rus' appanage of the Smolensk land, centered on the fortified town of Vyazma, halfway between Smolensk and Mozhaysk. The town first appears in the chronicles in 1230, and in 1239 became a separate principality for Andrey Vladimirovich Dolgoruky, a son of the grand prince of Kiev; his descendants, a junior branch of the Smolensk Rurikids, held it in the fourteenth century and grew prosperous on trade with Narva.

In 1300 its prince Andrey Mikhailovich defeated the Smolensk princes Roman and Aleksandr near Dorogobuzh. As Lithuania pressed eastward, Vyazma was absorbed into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1403, though its princes kept their appanage for a time.

In 1494 a Muscovite army under Daniil Shchenya took the town, and a peace treaty confirmed it as a Moscow possession, where the Vyazemsky princes entered service.
zh:
维亚济马公国是斯摩棱斯克领地分出的罗斯封邑，中心在要塞城镇维亚济马，地处斯摩棱斯克与莫扎伊斯克之间。1230年首见编年史，1239年成为基辅大公之子安德烈·弗拉基米罗维奇（长手）的独立公国；他的后裔是斯摩棱斯克留里克王朝的幼支，在14世纪领有此地，并靠与纳尔瓦的贸易致富。

1300年，维亚济马公安德烈·米哈伊洛维奇在多罗戈布日附近击败斯摩棱斯克王公罗曼和亚历山大。随着立陶宛势力东进，维亚济马于1403年被并入立陶宛大公国，不过当地王公一度保留封邑权利。

1494年，丹尼尔·谢尼亚率领莫斯科军队攻占该城，和约确认它归属莫斯科，维亚泽姆斯基王公们随后入朝供职。

en:
Vyatka was a remote commonwealth of Russian settlers in the Vyatka River basin, beyond the Volga in the forests toward the Urals. From the twelfth century Novgorodian and Vladimir-Suzdal colonists settled among the native Permian and Udmurt population, their chief town being Khlynov, later renamed Vyatka. Cut off by forests and rivers, the settlers ran their own affairs through a popular assembly and only intermittently acknowledged outside overlords.

Vyatka's river pirates, the ushkuyniki, were feared: in 1374 a Vyatka band raided Sarai, capital of the Golden Horde. Around 1383 Nizhny Novgorod made the land a dependency, and Tatar expeditions soon imposed tribute too.

In 1402 Vasily I of Moscow granted Vyatka to his brother Yury, but it backed Moscow's enemies in the civil wars and raided Tatar and Russian lands, sacking Sarai again in 1471. In 1489 Ivan III ended its autonomy by force, deporting its notables and absorbing the republic into Muscovy.
zh:
维亚特卡是维亚特卡河流域的偏远移民共同体，位于伏尔加河以东、通往乌拉尔山的森林地带。12世纪起，诺夫哥罗德和弗拉基米尔-苏兹达尔的移民迁入本地彼尔姆人和乌德穆尔特人中间，中心城镇是赫雷诺夫，后来改称维亚特卡。因森林河流阻隔，移民通过市民大会管理自己的事务，对外间宗主仅时断时续地承认。

他们的河盗乌什库伊尼克令人畏惧：1374年维亚特卡队伍曾袭掠金帐汗国都城萨莱。约1383年下诺夫哥罗德将其收为附庸，鞑靼远征军很快也来征赋。

1402年莫斯科的瓦西里一世把维亚特卡封给弟弟尤里，但它在内战中屡次支持莫斯科的敌人，又劫掠鞑靼和罗斯土地，1471年再度洗劫萨莱。1489年伊凡三世以武力终结其自治，流放显贵，将共和国并入莫斯科。

en:
Wadai was a sultanate east of Lake Chad, founded in 1635 when Abd al-Karim rallied the Maba and other groups against the Tunjur rulers. He established his capital at Wara and made Islam the state religion. Wadai paid tribute to Darfur until Sultan Yaqub Arus refused it late in the 17th century and defeated a Darfurian attack.

Under Muhammad Sabun, Wadai conquered Baguirmi in 1805 and profited from a new caravan route to Benghazi. After Sabun's death, disputed succession brought a succession of sultans in the 1820s and early 1830s.
zh:
瓦达伊是乍得湖以东的苏丹国，1635年阿卜杜勒·卡里姆联合马巴人等族群推翻通朱尔统治者后建立。他定都瓦拉，并将伊斯兰教定为国教。瓦达伊向达尔富尔纳贡，直到17世纪末苏丹雅各布·阿鲁斯拒绝纳贡并击败达尔富尔的进攻。

穆罕默德·萨本统治时期，瓦达伊于1805年征服巴吉尔米，并从通往班加西的新商队路线中获利。萨本去世后，继位争端使瓦达伊在19世纪20年代至30年代初接连更换苏丹。

en:
The Waga were local lords of Waga district in Mutsu Province, with their main line based at Futago Castle. In 1401 Waga Tokiyoshi received recognition of his authority over the family and the district. A family dispute in 1435 drew in the Nanbu and neighboring clans and cost the Waga outlying lands.

Toyotomi Hideyoshi confiscated their domain in 1590 after they failed to attend his Odawara campaign. With Date support, Waga Tadachika rose against the Nanbu in 1600, but failed to take Hanamaki Castle; his stronghold at Iwasaki fell in 1601.
zh:
和贺氏是陆奥国和贺郡的地方领主，宗家以二子城为据点。1401年，和贺时义对族人和全郡的支配权得到承认。1435年的家族纠纷引来南部氏及邻近氏族介入，使和贺氏失去了外围领地。

1590年，和贺氏因未参加小田原征伐，被丰臣秀吉没收领地。1600年，和贺忠亲在伊达氏支持下起兵反抗南部氏，却未能攻下花卷城；他的据点岩崎城于1601年陷落。

en: Waitaha was a collection of early Māori groups in New Zealand's South Island. From the sixteenth century, Ngāti Māmoe and then Ngāi Tahu absorbed much of Waitaha through conquest and marriage.
zh: 怀塔哈是新西兰南岛早期毛利人群体的集合。自16世纪起，雅提马莫埃人和后来的纳塔胡人通过征服和通婚，将许多怀塔哈人纳入其部族。

en:
Wallachia was the Romanian Orthodox principality between the Southern Carpathians and the Lower Danube, called by its people the Romanian Land. It grew from a union of smaller Romanian polities in the thirteenth century; legend credits Radu Negru with leading settlers across the Carpathians in 1290. Its first documented prince, Basarab I, ruled from Câmpulung and, after refusing tribute to Charles I of Hungary, destroyed the Hungarian army at Posada in 1330 and founded an independent principality under the House of Basarab, still ruling in 1337.

Mircea the Elder defeated the Ottomans at Rovine in 1395 and briefly held Dobruja, but in 1417 Wallachia accepted Ottoman suzerainty, which Vlad the Impaler challenged until defeat at the Night Attack of Târgoviște in 1462. Michael the Brave briefly united Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldavia in 1600.

Phanariot princes ruled after 1715 until Tudor Vladimirescu's 1821 rising; the 1829 Treaty of Adrianople placed Wallachia under Russian supervision and restored its Danube ports.
zh:
瓦拉几亚是南喀尔巴阡山与多瑙河下游间的罗马尼亚东正教公国，国人自称罗马尼亚之地。由13世纪若干罗马尼亚小政权合并，传说黑拉杜1290年率众翻山建邦。首位有载君主巴萨拉布一世驻肯普隆格，拒绝向匈牙利的查理一世纳贡，1330年波萨达一战灭匈军，建巴萨拉布家族独立公国，1337年该家族仍执政。

米尔恰一世1395年罗维内击败奥斯曼人，一度占多布罗加；1417年瓦拉几亚接受奥斯曼宗主权，穿刺公弗拉德三世一再反抗，至1462年特尔戈维什泰夜袭兵败。1600年勇敢的米哈伊短暂统一瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔达维亚。

1715年起法纳尔王公执政，至1821年弗拉迪米雷斯库起义；1829年《阿德里安堡条约》令公国受俄国监督，收回多瑙河港。

en:
The Wanka formed a polity in the Mantaro Valley of central Peru, cultivating maize and root crops and herding llamas. In the 15th century Pachacuti conquered them after fierce fighting and incorporated their lands into the Inca Empire.

The Wanka supplied soldiers for Inca campaigns in Quito. During the Spanish conquest of Peru they allied with the invaders against the Incas, providing men and supplies.
zh:
万卡人在秘鲁中部曼塔罗河谷建立了政权，种植玉米和块根作物，饲养美洲驼。15世纪，帕查库特克经过激战征服了万卡人，将其土地并入印加帝国。

万卡人为印加征讨基多提供士兵。在西班牙征服秘鲁期间，万卡人转而与入侵者结盟对抗印加，提供人力和补给。

en:
Warsangali denotes the Somali Muslim polity of the Maakhir coast, the Gulf of Aden shore beneath the Cal-Madow mountains, where the clan herded camels and harvested frankincense around ports such as Las Khorey.

In the fourteenth century competing militarized garaads, or lords, ruled the lands; in 1337 the coast lay within the Ifat Sultanate's tributary sphere. Maakhir garaads sent contingents to imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi's sixteenth-century holy wars.

The scattered lordships were welded into a hereditary state only in 1613, when Garaad Abdulle Mahmud I made Durduri his capital. It grew rich on the frankincense and gum trade, held nine fortified ports and built ships at Las Khorey, its court seat. In 1764 the rulers took the title of sultan; into the early nineteenth century Las Khorey's towers and harbour made it among the busiest towns on the northern Somali coast.
zh:
瓦桑加利是马赫海岸的索马里穆斯林政权，地处卡尔马多山脉脚下的亚丁湾沿岸，部族围绕拉斯霍雷等港口放牧骆驼、采集乳香。

14世纪，彼此竞争的军事化“加拉德”（首领）分治其地；1337年海岸处在伊法特苏丹国的朝贡圈内。16世纪伊玛目艾哈迈德·加齐的圣战中，马赫的加拉德们还派兵参战。

分散的领主权直到1613年才整合为一个世袭国家：加拉德阿卜杜勒·马哈茂德一世以杜尔杜里为都。它靠乳香、树胶贸易致富，控制九座设防港，在拉斯霍雷自建商船，那里后来成为宫廷所在。1764年统治者改“加拉德”称号为“苏丹”；到19世纪初，拉斯霍雷凭借塔楼与港湾仍是索马里北岸最繁忙的城镇之一。

en: The Wa inhabited mountainous country between the Salween and Mekong rivers, in present-day Myanmar and Yunnan. Shan traditions place Wa communities around Kengtung before their displacement around 1229 and their defeat by King Mangrai. By the eighteenth century, the Wa area had separated from Dai tribal military control under Qing rule in China.
zh: 佤人居住在萨尔温江与湄公河之间的山区，分布于今缅甸和云南境内。掸人的传统记载佤人曾居于景栋一带，约1229年被逐出，后来又被孟莱王击败。到18世纪中国清朝统治时期，佤地已脱离傣族部落的军事控制。

en:
Würzburg was Franconia's greatest ecclesiastical principality on the Main. Boniface founded the diocese in 741; bishops absorbed surrounding counties in the tenth and eleventh centuries. Frederick I's Golden Privilege of 1168 raised their lands to duchy rank. From the fifteenth century they styled themselves Dukes in Franconia and ruled from Marienberg. In 1337 Otto II von Wolfskeel held the see. Of a Franconian ministerialis family, he became bishop in 1333.

Later history was violent: in the Peasants' War of 1525 over ten thousand rebels and citizens died in its territory. Bishop Julius Echter led the Counter-Reformation from 1573, founding the University of Würzburg in 1582 while witch trials gathered pace, peaking in the 1620s.

Ravaged in the Thirty Years' War, it briefly became a Duchy of Franconia in 1633 under Bernard of Saxe-Weimar. Secularized to Bavaria in 1803, it became the Grand Duchy of Würzburg under Napoleonic patronage in 1806, returning to Bavaria in 1814.
zh:
维尔茨堡主教区是法兰克尼亚最大教会邦国，跨美因河。741年波尼法修创立教区；10至11世纪主教吞并周边伯国，1168年腓特烈一世《黄金自由状》将领地升为公国，15世纪起主教自封法兰克尼亚公爵，坐镇马林贝格。1337年奥托二世·冯·沃尔夫斯基尔任主教，出身法兰克尼亚家臣，1333年即位。

1525年农民战争中，境内一万多名起义者和市民丧生；主教尤利乌斯·埃希特1573年起推行反宗教改革，1582年创办维尔茨堡大学，猎巫17世纪20年代最盛。

三十年战争中遭蹂躏，1633年短暂成为萨克森-魏玛的伯恩哈德之法兰克尼亚公国。1803年世俗化归巴伐利亚，1806年在拿破仑庇护下成为大公国，1814年复归巴伐利亚。

en:
The Wachi were local lords based at Nantenyama Castle in Kisa, Bingo province. Wachi Toyosato joined Mōri Motonari against the Takahashi in 1529, while his son Masaharu served the Yamana lords of Bingo.

Masaharu fought alongside the Mōri at Itsukushima in 1555 and came increasingly under their influence. In 1563 Mōri Takamoto died suddenly after visiting Masaharu, an episode that later became entangled in suspicions over his death.
zh:
和智氏是备后国吉舍的地方领主，以南天山城为据点。1529年，和智丰乡随毛利元就讨伐高桥氏；其子诚春则在备后守护山名氏麾下效力。

1555年，诚春在严岛之战中与毛利军并肩作战，此后逐渐受到毛利氏控制。1563年，毛利隆元在拜访诚春后突然去世，这件事后来引发了对其死因的猜疑。

en: The Waccamaw were an Indigenous people living along the Waccamaw and Pee Dee rivers in the Carolinas. They joined the Yamasee War against English colonists in 1715 and fought South Carolina again in 1720, when colonists killed or captured 60 Waccamaw. By 1755, South Carolina had encouraged Waccamaw and other neighboring peoples to join the Catawba.
zh: 沃卡莫人是居住在卡罗来纳地区沃卡莫河与皮迪河沿岸的原住民。他们于1715年加入反抗英国殖民者的亚马西战争，1720年又与南卡罗来纳殖民地交战，60名沃卡莫人被殖民者杀害或俘虏。到1755年，南卡罗来纳当局已劝说沃卡莫人和其他邻近族群加入卡托巴人。

en:
Waldberg represents the County of Waldburg in Upper Swabia, the estate of the House of Waldburg, whose twelfth-century castle crowns a hill above the town of Waldburg. The family rose as stewards of the Hohenstaufen: Eberhard von Tanne-Waldburg served Emperor Frederick II and guarded the imperial regalia at Waldburg from 1220 to 1225.

The house later split into many comital lines. Georg Truchsess von Waldburg, captain of the Swabian League, crushed the peasant armies at Böblingen in 1525, while Gebhard Truchsess von Waldburg, as Elector of Cologne, touched off the Cologne War in 1583 by marrying and embracing Protestantism.

The Waldburgs were raised to imperial counts in 1628. The family's lines kept their estates and titles through the mediatisation of 1806.
zh:
瓦尔德贝格对应上施瓦本的瓦尔德堡伯国，是瓦尔德堡家族的领地；家族12世纪的城堡雄踞在瓦尔德堡镇的山丘之上。该家族以担任霍亨斯陶芬家族的宫廷总管而起家：埃伯哈德·冯·塔讷-瓦尔德堡侍奉皇帝腓特烈二世，1220至1225年在瓦尔德堡保管帝国皇权信物。

后来家族分成众多伯爵支系。施瓦本同盟军队统帅格奥尔格·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡于1525年在伯布林根击溃农民军；格布哈特·特鲁赫泽斯·冯·瓦尔德堡身为科隆选侯，因结婚并皈依新教而在1583年引发科隆战争。

瓦尔德堡家族于1628年升为帝国伯爵。各支系在1806年的陪臣化中保住了产业和头衔。

en:
Waldeck grew from a small lordship in northern Hesse around Waldeck Castle on the Eder, attested in 1120. Its rulers were a Schwalenberg branch: in 1180 Volkwin II married the Waldeck heiress, took the castle's name and built a territory administered from Korbach. Originally a Mainz fief, it gained imperial immediacy in the fourteenth century and recognition as an imperial fief in 1379.

Count Henry IV ruled in 1337, reigning from 1305 to 1344. After Henry VI's death in 1397 the family split into Landau and Waldeck lines, whose debts later pushed them under Hessian landgrave overlordship.

The family divided again in 1486 into Wildungen and Eisenberg branches, which adopted Lutheranism in 1526 and 1529; reunited in 1692, it had inherited Pyrmont in 1626 and moved to Arolsen in 1655. Waldeck was raised to a principality in 1712, outlived the Holy Roman Empire and joined the German Confederation in 1815.
zh:
瓦尔代克伯国起于黑森北部的小领地，核心为埃德尔河畔1120年首载的瓦尔代克城堡。统治家族为施瓦伦贝格支系：1180年福尔克温二世娶瓦尔代克女继承人，以城堡为氏，以科尔巴赫为中心整合领地。原是美因茨封地，14世纪取得帝国直辖，1379年承认为帝国封地。

1337年亨利四世在位（1305—1344）。1397年亨利六世死后，家族分为兰道、瓦尔代克两支，债务后来迫使他们接受黑森领地伯爵的宗主权。

1486年再分为维尔东根、艾森贝格两支，分别于1526年和1529年改宗路德宗；1692年重归统一，1626年继承皮尔蒙特伯国，1655年迁阿罗尔森。1712年升亲王国，国祚长过神圣罗马帝国，1815年入德意志邦联。

en:
Wuding was the country of the Luowu, a Wuman Yi tribe already a tribal division under the Dali Kingdom in the twelfth century. After the Mongol conquest of Dali the Yuan set up the Luowu tribal command in 1257 and the Wuding Route in 1276, ruling through hereditary Yi chieftains under the tusi system.

In 1382 the Ming made it the Wuding Military and Civilian Prefecture under hereditary Yi prefects. Repeated succession conflicts opened the way to reform: the seat moved to Shizishan in 1569, and in 1607 an appointed official replaced the native prefect and Wuding became a regular prefecture.

As Ming rule collapsed the tusi Wu Bikui rebelled in 1645, seizing several cities and alarming Yunnan before Ming troops defeated and captured him that September. In 1770 the Qing reduced Wuding to an independent department under the provincial government.
zh:
武定是彝族罗婺部的居地，早在12世纪大理国时期就以部落建制存在。蒙古攻灭大理后，元朝于1257年立罗婺万户府，1276年改设武定路，通过世袭彝族首领按土司制度治理当地彝民。

1382年明朝改设武定军民府，以当地彝族土官世袭知府。土官家族接连发生承袭纷争，朝廷借机推行改革：1569年治所迁往狮子山，1607年废土知府、改派流官，成为正式的武定府。

明末天下大乱，土司吾必奎于1645年起兵反叛，连下数城、全滇震动，当年九月即被明军击败俘获。1770年清朝将武定府降为隶属省府的直隶州。

en:
The Waayaahtanwa, or Wea, were a Miami–Illinois-speaking people of western Indiana, closely related to the Miami. First recorded in 1673, they later established villages along the Wabash River, including Ouiatenon near present-day Lafayette. A French fort there supported trade with the Wea and Kickapoo.

In 1763 the Wea joined Pontiac's war against the British. During the American Revolution they initially remained neutral, then fought alongside the Miami and British; in 1820 they were forced to move to Missouri and Arkansas.
zh:
威亚坦瓦人又称威亚人，是印第安纳西部讲迈阿密—伊利诺伊语的族群，与迈阿密人关系密切。1673年他们首次见于文字记载，后来在沃巴什河沿岸建立村落，包括今拉斐特附近的威阿特农。法国人在当地修筑的堡垒促进了与威亚人和基卡普人的贸易。

1763年威亚人参加了庞蒂亚克反英战争。美国独立战争期间，他们最初保持中立，后来与迈阿密人和英国人并肩作战；1820年，他们被迫迁往密苏里和阿肯色。

en:
Weißenburg stands on the Franconian Jura south of Nuremberg, on the site of Biriciana, a Roman frontier fort whose surviving baths mark the edge of the old town. Its name first appears in a charter of 867, and under the Franks the place served as a royal residence, linked by legend to Charlemagne and his unfinished Fossa Carolina canal.

In 1296 it won the status of a Free Imperial City and for five centuries governed itself as a small imperial city of Franconia, its council meeting in the Gothic town hall completed in 1476.

At the Reformation it followed Nuremberg onto the Protestant side and suffered heavily in the wars of religion before its ancient rights were restored in the final peace settlement. Like other free cities, it lost its independence in 1802 and passed to Bavaria in 1806.
zh:
魏森堡位于纽伦堡以南的弗兰肯汝拉山区，城建在罗马边境要塞比里基亚纳的旧址上，残存的罗马浴场仍横亘在老城边缘。其名最早见于867年的特许状；法兰克时代这里是王室驻地，传说与查理曼及其未完工的卡罗莱纳运河有关。

1296年它取得帝国自由城市地位，此后五个世纪作为法兰克尼亚的小城之一自治，市议会在1476年落成的哥特式市政厅议事。

宗教改革时它效法纽伦堡加入新教阵营，在随后的宗教战争中损失惨重，古老权利直到最终和约签订才得以恢复。与其他自由城市一样，魏森堡于1802年失去独立，1806年并入巴伐利亚王国。

en:
Weji takes its name from the Tungusic word weji, meaning forest, long used in Chinese records for the forest Tungusic peoples of the lower Songhua and Amur. Under the Yuan they belonged, with the Gilimi, to the Water Tatar circuit, and late-Yuan annals note Weji uprisings in 1343, 1346 and 1347.

After the Ming founding, chiefs Xiyangha and Suoshiha led their people south into the Hulan river basin, where they became known as the Hulun, whom the Ming called the Haixi Jurchens and enrolled in the Wuzhe Guard.

Groups that stayed behind on the Amur were counted among the Wild Jurchens, whose Woji tribe was subdued by Nurhaci's Jianzhou in campaigns between 1596 and 1625. The Weji polity had its seat at Hailun on the Tongken river, inside the resettled Hulan basin.
zh:
窝集得名于通古斯语中意为森林的weji，长期是汉文史料对松花江、黑龙江下游森林通古斯人的统称。元代他们与吉里迷同属水达达路，元末的1343年、1346年、1347年都有吾者野人反叛的记载。

明朝建立后，首领西阳哈、锁失哈率部南下呼兰河流域，被周边民族称为扈伦，明朝称之为海西女真，编入兀者卫。

留居黑龙江中下游的群体则被归入野人女真，其窝集部在1596—1625年的连年征讨中被努尔哈赤的建州女真征服。窝集政权都城海伦位于通肯河畔，地处南迁部众经营的呼兰河流域。

en:
The Weken were a Jurchen group of the Woken River valley, a right-bank tributary of the Songhua that joins the main river at Yilan, where the Yuan posted its lower-Songhua myriarchies. The river's name derives from the Jurchen and Manchu word wehe, meaning stone. In 1337 the Woken clans lived under Yuan overlordship like their neighbours around Yilan.

In 1408 the Ming established the Ouhanhe Guard over the Woken basin east of Yilan, giving its chieftains hereditary guard titles through the Nurgan system under which the region's Jurchens sent tribute to Beijing.
zh:
倭肯是活动在倭肯河流域的女真部落，倭肯河是松花江右岸支流，在依兰汇入松花江，依兰正是元朝设置松花江下游诸万户府之地。河名来自女真语和满语的wehe，意为石头。1337年，倭肯各氏族与依兰附近的邻部一样臣属于元朝。

1408年，明朝在依兰以东的倭肯河流域设立呕罕河卫，授予当地首领世袭卫职，使其经由奴儿干卫所体系向北京朝贡。

en:
The County of Werdenberg was a Swabian state of the Holy Roman Empire on either side of the Alpine Rhine, centred on Werdenberg Castle above Grabs and holding Bludenz. Its counts descended from Hugo II of Tübingen, husband of the last count of Bregenz's heiress; split from Montfort in 1230, the lands were divided again in 1260 into Werdenberg and Sargans lines.

In 1337 Albert I of Werdenberg-Heiligenberg held it; his feud with Montfort-Feldkirch let the Habsburgs gain a foothold in the Vorarlberg. His grandsons split the inheritance between 1377 and 1387 into the Werdenberg, Rheineck, Bludenz and Heiligenberg branches. The Vaduz branch died out in 1406 and its lands passed to the barons of Brandis.

The Werdenberg feud with the von Zimmern family helped provoke the Swabian League in 1488. The county was pledged in 1402 and bought by Lucerne in 1485, then sold to Glarus in 1517 and joined St. Gallen in 1803.
zh:
韦尔登贝格是神圣罗马帝国的施瓦本伯国，地跨阿尔卑斯莱茵河两岸，以格拉布斯的韦尔登贝格城堡为中心，领有布鲁登茨。伯爵出自蒂宾根胡戈二世，后者娶了末代布雷根茨伯爵的女继承人；领地1230年从蒙特福特分出，1260年再分韦尔登贝格、萨尔甘斯两支。

1337年阿尔布雷希特一世（韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格）在位，与蒙特福特-费尔德基希的纷争使哈布斯堡在福拉尔贝格立足。其孙1377—1387年间分遗产为韦尔登贝格、莱茵埃克、布鲁登茨和海利根贝格四支。瓦杜兹支1406年绝嗣，领地归布兰迪斯。

韦尔登贝格与齐默恩家族的世仇促成1488年施瓦本同盟。伯国1402年被抵押，1485年卢塞恩购得，1517年卖与格拉鲁斯，1803年并入圣加仑。

en:
The Kingdom of Westphalia was a French client state created in Germany in 1807 for Napoleon's brother Jérôme Bonaparte. Although named for Westphalia, it occupied mostly lands farther east. Its constitution introduced a French-style administration, and in 1808 it granted Jews equal rights.

Napoleon's demands for taxes and soldiers strained the kingdom, and few of its men returned from the invasion of Russia in 1812. Allied armies overran it in 1813, ending Jérôme's reign.
zh:
威斯特伐利亚王国是1807年在德意志建立的法国附庸国，由拿破仑的弟弟热罗姆·波拿巴统治。王国虽以威斯特伐利亚命名，领土却大多位于更东边。其宪法引入了法国式行政制度，1808年又赋予犹太人平等权利。

拿破仑征收税款和征召士兵，使王国不堪重负；参加1812年入侵俄国的士兵很少生还。1813年反法同盟军攻占王国，结束了热罗姆的统治。

en:
Waigeo was an island kingdom in the Raja Ampat archipelago, northwest of New Guinea. The Portuguese navigator Jorge de Menezes reached the islands in 1526.

In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, Waigeo's ruler Gurabesi and his descendants had close ties with the Sultanate of Tidore; his descendants became Ma'ya rulers on other islands. Local chiefs adopted Islam during this period, and Raja Ampat came to be regarded as part of Tidore.
zh:
卫古是新几内亚西北方拉贾安帕特群岛上的一个岛屿王国。葡萄牙航海家若热·德·梅内塞斯于1526年抵达群岛。

16至17世纪，卫古统治者古拉贝西及其后裔与蒂多雷苏丹国关系密切；他的后裔成为其他岛屿的马亚统治者。这一时期当地首领皈依伊斯兰教，拉贾安帕特也被视为蒂多雷的一部分。

en:
Wanggiya was one of the five Jianzhou Jurchen tribes north of the Yalu River in northeastern China. By the mid-sixteenth century the Jianzhou formed a confederation distinct from the Haixi Jurchens.

In 1588 Nurhaci brought Wanggiya and the Donggo tribe together as he consolidated the Jianzhou. His subsequent unification of Jurchen groups laid the foundations of the Later Jin and Qing dynasties.
zh:
完颜是中国东北鸭绿江以北的建州女真五部之一。到16世纪中叶，建州诸部形成了与海西女真分立的联盟。

1588年，努尔哈赤在整合建州诸部时将完颜和栋鄂部联合起来。他此后统一女真各部，为后金和清朝奠定了基础。

en:
The County of Wernigerode grew up at the northern foot of the Harz around Wernigerode Castle, first recorded in 1213, where comital rulers appear from 1121. As Eastphalian magnates they held estates from the Oker to the Grosses Bruch and long rivalled the counts of Regenstein.

Threatened by the Welf dukes of Brunswick, they surrendered imperial immediacy in 1268 and became vassals of the Ascanian margraves of Brandenburg, and from 1381 of Magdeburg's archbishops. In 1337 its ruler was Conrad IV (1325-1370), who in 1343 added former Regenstein lands.

The native comital line ended with Henry IV in 1429, when the inheritance passed to his Stolberg cousins. The Stolberg counts ruled it in personal union for two centuries; the Stolberg-Wernigerode line moved into the restored castle in 1710, and the county joined the Prussian Province of Saxony in 1815.
zh:
韦尼格罗德伯国兴起于哈茨山北麓，核心是1213年首载的韦尼格罗德城堡，当地伯爵世系从1121年起出现。作为东法伦大贵族，他们的地产从奥克河延伸至大布鲁赫低地，长期与雷根施泰因伯爵争雄。

迫于韦尔夫家族不伦瑞克公爵的威胁，他们1268年放弃帝国直辖地位，成为勃兰登堡阿斯坎尼藩侯的附庸，1381年起改臣马格德堡大主教。1337年在位的是康拉德四世（1325—1370年），他1343年取得原属雷根施泰因的土地。

本地伯爵世系随亨利四世1429年去世而断绝，遗产传给施托尔贝格堂亲。施托尔贝格伯爵遂以共主邦联统治两百年；施托尔贝格—韦尼格罗德支系1710年迁入重修的城堡，伯国1815年并入普鲁士萨克森省。

en:
Wehali was a traditional kingdom on the southern coast of central Timor, centered on Laran village, its South Tetun-speaking people following a matrilineal order. Among Timor's realms it held ritual seniority: its paramount, the Maromak Oan ('son of God'), kept a regent titled Liurai.

Oral tradition called Wehali the first land to emerge from the waters; when Antonio Pigafetta of the Magellan expedition visited in 1522, Wewiku-Wehali was already the island's leading power, and seventeenth-century accounts called its ruler an emperor receiving tribute from all the island's kings.

It kept friendly ties with Muslim Makassar until Portuguese attacks in 1642 and 1665 curbed its power and drew it into the Portuguese sphere. After the Battle of Penfui in 1749 it tilted to the Dutch East India Company; in 1756 the Liurai signed a treaty with Dutch envoy Paravicini, claiming overlordship over dozens of Timorese kingdoms, after which Wehali vacillated between the two colonial powers.
zh:
韦哈勒是帝汶岛中南部沿海的传统王国，以拉兰村为中心，居民属南德顿语区，实行母系制度。在帝汶众小邦中，韦哈勒居于礼仪上的宗主地位：君主马罗马克·奥安意为“神之子”，由称柳赖的摄政辅佐。

口传传统称韦哈勒是从洪水中最先露出的土地；1522年麦哲伦船队的皮加费塔到访时，韦威库—韦哈勒已是岛上首屈一指的强权，17世纪的记载称其君主为皇帝，全岛诸王都向他纳贡。

它本与穆斯林望加锡交好，1642年和1665年葡萄牙人的两次进攻削弱其力量，将其纳入葡萄牙势力范围。1749年彭富伊战役后，韦哈勒转向荷兰东印度公司，1756年柳赖与荷使帕拉维奇尼签约，宣称对数十个帝汶小邦拥有宗主权，此后在两个殖民强国间摇摆。

en:
The County of Wied was a Holy Roman Empire territory in the Westerwald, named after the river Wied and held as a Count Palatine fief. Its first lord Metfried appears in 1129, and his son Arnold of Wied became archbishop of Cologne and chancellor under Conrad III.
