Ancestors came from the Niger-Benue confluence before the 1000s and built walled Tado on the Mono River, which between the 1400s and 1600s led a loose confederacy under kings titled Anyigbãfio.

Around 1600 three princely brothers divided Aja lands: Kokpon kept Great Ardra, or Allada, Do-Aklin founded Abomey, whose settlers blended with the Gedevi to become the Fon of Dahomey, and Te-Agbanlin set up Little Ardra, the future Porto-Novo.

In 1724 Dahomey overran Allada and sold some eight thousand Aja captives across the Atlantic, among them forebears of Toussaint Louverture.
zh:
阿詹人（通译阿贾人，又称阿德贾）是贝宁西南和多哥东南沿海说克瓦语支格贝语的民族，聚居塔多、阿拉达、维达等城镇，被埃维人和丰人视为母族，西非伏都信仰也渊源于其仪式。祖先11世纪前从尼日尔河与贝努埃河汇流处西迁，在莫诺河畔建起筑墙的塔多；15至17世纪塔多领导松散联盟，君主称阿尼格巴菲奥。

约1600年三位王族兄弟瓜分阿贾之地：科克蓬保有大阿尔德拉（阿拉达），多-阿克兰兴建阿波美，定居者与格德维人融合，成为达荷美的丰人；特-阿格兰林建立小阿尔德拉，即后来的波多诺伏。

1724年达荷美攻陷阿拉达，将约八千名阿贾战俘卖过大西洋，图桑·卢维杜尔的先人便在其中。

en:
The Ajie are Kanak clans of the central east coast of Grande Terre in New Caledonia, whose Ajië language, also called Houailou after its main district, is spoken around Houaïlou and Kouaoua. Ajië names the Wailic group of southern New Caledonian languages, all descended from Austronesian speech Lapita navigators brought around 1100 BC.

Ajie valleys were dense with clan lands, where taro irrigation and lagoon fishing sustained rival chiefdoms: warriors carried polished serpentinite axes, and villages gathered for pilou ceremonies of stamping bamboo and ancestor song beneath the carved rooftop spear of the chief's house.

The first European known to reach these waters, James Cook, sighted Grande Terre in 1774; French and British ships came fitfully after Lapérouse vanished in the Pacific in 1788. By the 1830s the Ajie coast remained outside colonial reach, its clans governing themselves by custom and exchange.
zh:
阿杰人是新喀里多尼亚格朗德特尔岛中东部沿海的卡纳克氏族，其阿杰语又称瓦伊卢语，得名于主要地区，通行瓦伊卢、夸瓦一带。阿杰语命名了新喀里多尼亚南部语言的瓦伊卢语组，诸语均源自约公元前1100年拉皮塔航海者带来的南岛语。

阿杰山谷遍布氏族土地，芋头灌溉和潟湖渔业供养彼此竞争的酋邦：武士手持打磨的蛇纹石斧，村民聚在酋长大屋雕刻屋顶矛饰之下，跳起跺踩竹竿、吟唱祖先的皮卢仪式舞。

已知最早抵达这片海域的欧洲人詹姆斯·库克1774年望见格朗德特尔岛；拉彼鲁兹1788年在太平洋失踪后，英法船只仅零星到访。到19世纪30年代，阿杰沿海仍未落入殖民势力之手，各氏族依习俗和交换规则自治。

en:
The Akinaa, or Kainai, called Blood, are one of the three Niitsitapi nations of the Blackfoot Confederacy, speaking an Algonquian Blackfoot dialect. Their name Akáínaa means many chiefs; their Plains Cree neighbours called them the blood-stained people, whence comes Blood.

Nomadic bison hunters of the northern Great Plains, the Kainai used dog travois until they adopted horses around 1730, becoming among the plains' most powerful mounted peoples. In summer the bands gathered for the Okan sun dance and buffalo drives over jumps such as Head-Smashed-In; winter scattered them to wooded valleys.

With guns obtained through Cree and Assiniboine middlemen, they pushed the Shoshone and Arapaho off the northwestern plains; by the 1780s the confederacy ranged from the North Saskatchewan to the Missouri. The fur trade brought smallpox in 1837 by steamboat: some six thousand Niitsitapi died, ending their plains dominance.
zh:
阿基纳人又称凯奈人或“血部落”，是黑脚联盟三大尼齐塔皮民族之一，操阿尔冈昆语系黑脚语方言。其名阿凯纳意为“众多首领”，邻族平原克里人称他们为“染血之人”，“血部落”由此得名。

凯奈人是北部大平原追逐野牛的游牧民族：约1730年获得马匹前靠狗拉特拉沃伊雪橇搬运，此后成为草原上最强大的骑马民族之一。夏天各群体聚集举行奥坎太阳舞，在“撞头崖”等野牛跳崖处围猎；冬天分散到林木河谷。

手持克里人和阿西尼博因人转手的火器，他们把肖肖尼人和阿拉帕霍人逐出西北部平原；到18世纪80年代，联盟势力范围从北萨斯喀彻温河延伸到密苏里河。随毛皮贸易而来的汽船在1837年带来天花，约六千名尼齐塔皮人丧生，平原优势就此终结。

en:
The Akan are Kwa-speaking Tano peoples of the forest and coast of Ghana and Ivory Coast, among them the Bono, Asante and Fante, sharing matrilineal abusua clans and chiefly stools. Asantemanso and like towns were occupied from the ninth century; the early Bono state at Bono Manso sent gold and kola through Begho to Middle Niger Wangara merchants.

From the late 1400s Portuguese, then Dutch and English ships bought Akan gold on the coast, drawing forest states into Atlantic trade; after 1650 firearms reshaped inland politics as Denkyira and Akwamu fought over gold routes.

Around 1695 Osei Tutu and priest Okomfo Anokye united the Kumasi towns under the Golden Stool and in 1701 overthrew Denkyira, opening the Asante empire's way to the sea; Asante armies took Bono in 1722-1723 and dominated the hinterland, while Fante towns formed a coastal confederacy at Mankessim against them. The Asante checked British expansion at Nsamankow in 1824, killing Governor MacCarthy, but were beaten at Katamanso in 1826.
zh:
阿坎人是加纳、科特迪瓦森林与沿海说塔诺诸语的克瓦族群，支系有博诺、阿散蒂、芳蒂等，按母系氏族组织社会，以凳子象征酋权。阿桑特曼索等城镇9世纪已有人居，博诺国以博诺曼索为都，黄金、柯拉果经贝戈卖给尼日尔河中游旺加拉商人。

15世纪末起葡萄牙、随后荷兰和英国商船到沿海收购阿坎黄金，把森林政权卷入大西洋贸易；1650年后火器改变内陆格局，登基拉、阿夸穆为黄金商路交战。

约1695年奥塞·图图得祭司奥科姆福·阿诺基辅佐，以金凳子统一库马西诸城，1701年攻灭登基拉，为阿散蒂帝国打开出海通道；阿散蒂军队1722—1723年征服博诺、称霸内陆，芳蒂诸城在曼克西姆结成沿海联盟抗衡。1824年阿散蒂在恩萨曼科遏制英国扩张，击杀总督麦卡锡，1826年在卡塔曼索战败。

en:
The Akei are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the southwestern coast of Espiritu Santo in Vanuatu, centred on the village of Tasiriki, whose name means small water. Their speech bears several local names, and neighbouring varieties shade into one another along a dialect chain whose ends are no longer mutually intelligible. The Akei share Santo's Lapita past, the island having been settled by Austronesian navigators some three thousand years ago.

Europeans first reached Santo with Queirós's Spanish expedition in 1606; Bougainville followed in 1768 and James Cook in 1774, after which the islands appeared on European maps as the New Hebrides.
zh:
阿凯伊人是瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛西南沿海的美拉尼西亚人，以塔西里基村为中心；塔西里基在他们的话中意为“小水”。他们的语言有一串地方别名，邻近各话沿方言链渐次过渡，链条两端已经不能互通。阿凯伊人承袭着岛上的拉皮塔文化渊源：约三千年前，南岛语系航海者便已定居该岛。

1606年，基罗斯率领的西班牙探险队首次让欧洲人来到该岛；布干维尔于1768年、库克于1774年先后来访，此后这片群岛在欧洲地图上被标作新赫布里底群岛。

en:
The Xerente, who call themselves Akwê, the people, are a Central Jê people of the Brazilian interior, on the right bank of the Tocantins river. Their oral tradition tells of a coastal home and a migration through the north-eastern sertão; with the Xavante, Xakriabá and Krahô they form part of the Acuén cluster, split by warfare.

Their villages traditionally lay in a semicircle, and society was divided into exogamous moieties named after the sun, Doí, and the moon, Wahirê. Jesuit missionaries and inland bandeiras reached them in the 1600s.

After gold was found in neighbouring Goiás in the 1700s, the Portuguese crown gathered them into supervised settlements; the Capuchin mission of Teresa Cristina, founded in the 1800s, grew into Tocantínia. The Xavante broke away and migrated west to Mato Grosso, leaving the Xerente in possession of the Tocantins lands.
zh:
谢伦特人自称阿克韦，意为“人”，是巴西内陆的中部热语族族群，住在托坎廷斯河右岸。口传历史称祖先居于海滨，后穿过东北部腹地迁徙；谢伦特人与沙万特人、沙克里亚巴人和克拉霍人同属阿昆族群，因征战四分五裂。

他们的村庄传统上呈半圆形排列，社会分为族外婚的两大半偶族，分别以太阳多伊和月亮瓦伊雷命名。17世纪，耶稣会传教士和被称为“旗队”的内陆探险队抵达他们那里。

18世纪邻近的戈亚斯发现黄金后，葡萄牙王室把他们集中到受监管的村落；19世纪嘉布遣会建立的特雷莎·克里斯蒂娜传教站，后来发展成托坎蒂尼亚。沙万特人分道西迁马托格罗索，谢伦特人留居托坎廷斯故土。

en:
The Albaamo, better known as the Alabama or Alibamu, are a Muskogean people of the Southeastern Woodlands whose towns lay on the upper Alabama River within the Muscogee Creek Confederacy, and whose language is closest to Koasati.

Hernando de Soto's expedition crossed their country in 1540, and in the eighteenth century the French built a fort at what became Mobile. Their towns followed the Creek division into red towns for warfare and white towns for peace.

After the French ceded the Gulf coast to Britain following the Seven Years' War, British settlement and pressure from the Choctaw made the Alabama among the first Creek peoples to leave: they drifted west through Louisiana, and in 1805 nearly a thousand Alabama reached the Big Thicket of eastern Texas, where by 1820 they held three main towns beside their Coushatta allies.
zh:
阿拉巴莫人（又称阿拉巴马或阿里巴穆）是东南林地的马斯科吉语族族群，村镇分布在阿拉巴马河上游，属马斯科吉克里克联盟，语言与科阿萨蒂语最接近。

1540年埃尔南多·德·索托的探险队经过其地，18世纪法国人在后来发展为莫比尔的地方修筑堡垒。他们的城镇沿用克里克人的红白之分：红镇主战，白镇主和。

七年战争后法国把湾岸割让给英国，英国移民涌入，加上乔克托人的压力，阿拉巴莫人成为最早迁离的克里克族群之一：他们西走路易斯安那，1805年近千名阿拉巴莫人抵达东得克萨斯的大灌丛，到1820年已在盟友科阿萨蒂人的村镇旁建起三座主要城镇。

en:
The Alans were an Iranian-speaking Sarmatian people who dominated the Pontic-Caspian steppe from the first century. Fourth-century Hunnic attacks split them: one branch rode west with the Vandals as far as North Africa, while others settled the Caucasus foothills.

In the late ninth century they threw off Khazar rule and built Alania, with its capital at Maghas; early tenth-century Byzantine missionaries converted them to Eastern Orthodoxy. Alania grew rich on the Darial trade, and in 1187 Georgia's Queen Tamar married an Alan prince.

Early in the thirteenth century it fragmented into clans; in 1239 to 1240 the Mongols stormed Maghas and carried off thousands of horsemen as imperial guards as far as China, while another band fled to Hungary. In 1337 Alan communities still held the Caucasus foothills, but Timur's 1395 invasion broke their lowland power and drove survivors into gorges, where they became the Ossetians.
zh:
阿兰人是说伊朗语的萨尔马提亚族群，1世纪起称雄于黑海至里海的草原。4世纪匈人的冲击使他们分裂：一支随汪达尔人西迁，远至北非；高加索的阿兰人则定居山麓。

9世纪末，他们摆脱可萨统治，建立以马加斯为都的阿兰王国；10世纪初，拜占庭传教士使他们皈依东正教。王国凭借达里亚尔商路致富，1187年格鲁吉亚塔玛尔女王嫁给一位阿兰王子。

13世纪初王国分裂为若干氏族，1239至1240年蒙古人攻陷马加斯，把数千骑兵掳去充当皇帝侍卫，远至中国，另有一支逃到匈牙利。1337年，阿兰人的社群仍据有高加索山麓，但1395年帖木儿的入侵摧毁了他们在低地的力量，幸存者退入深山峡谷，后来演变为奥塞梯人。

en:
The Alawites, historically commonly called Nusayris, are an Arabic-speaking ethnoreligious community of the Syrian coastal mountains, centered on Latakia and Tartus. Their creed grew from the ninth-century ghulat Shia teaching of Ibn Nusayr and was organized in Aleppo under Hamdanid rule after 947 by the missionary al-Khasibi; it venerates Ali as a divine incarnation, teaches reincarnation, and reserves its wine-centered rites to initiated men.

Crusaders entering Syria in 1097 killed many Alawites but later tolerated and even recruited them, while fourteenth-century Mamluk rulers pressed the mountain villages to accept Islam's outward observances. Ottoman conquest brought the massacre of the Telal at Aleppo in 1517, after which survivors withdrew into the coast ranges, where repeated revolts kept their autonomy alive.

In the eighteenth century some Alawite chiefs served as Ottoman tax farmers, and in 1834 and 1835 the community rose against the Egyptian occupation of Syria.
zh:
阿拉维人在历史上常被称为努赛里人，是讲阿拉伯语的宗教族群，聚居于叙利亚沿海山地，以拉塔基亚和塔尔图斯为中心。其教义出自9世纪伊本·努赛尔的什叶派极端支派，947年后由传教士哈西比在哈姆丹王朝治下的阿勒颇整理成形；教义尊阿里为神的化身，相信灵魂转世，以酒为核心的仪式只对受戒男子开放。

1097年十字军进入叙利亚时曾大量杀害阿拉维人，后来加以容忍甚至招入军中；14世纪的马穆鲁克统治者强迫山村接受伊斯兰教的外在仪轨。奥斯曼征服带来1517年阿勒颇的“特拉勒屠杀”，幸存者退入沿海群山，凭一次次起义维系自治。

18世纪一些阿拉维酋长出任包税人；1834至1835年，该族群又起兵反抗埃及对叙利亚的占领。

en:
The Albanians are a Balkan people whose language forms its own Indo-European branch, widely held to descend from the ancient Illyrians' speech; the name Albanoi appears in second-century records, and Byzantine chroniclers place Albanians around Krujë and Durrës by the eleventh century. The Shkumbin River divides them into northern Ghegs and southern Tosks.

In 1190 Progon founded the Principality of Arbanon at Krujë, and the Angevins organized a Kingdom of Albania in 1272. Fourteenth-century native families ruled shifting principalities until the Ottomans took Krujë in 1415.

In 1444 the nobles united at Lezhë under Gjergj Kastrioti Skanderbeg, who held off the Ottomans until his death in 1468. Under Ottoman rule many converted to Islam from the seventeenth century; Albanians supplied over forty grand viziers. Around 1800 semi-independent pashaliks emerged, Ioannina ruled by Ali Pasha until 1822.
zh:
阿尔巴尼亚人是巴尔干民族，其语言在印欧语系中自成一支，普遍认为源自古伊利里亚语；“阿尔巴诺伊”之名2世纪已有记载，拜占庭编年史记载他们11世纪时在克鲁亚和都拉斯一带。什昆宾河把他们分为北部的盖格人和南部的托斯克人。

1190年，普罗贡在克鲁亚建立阿尔巴农公国，1272年安茹家族又组建阿尔巴尼亚王国。14世纪，本土家族治理着不断易手的小邦，直到1415年奥斯曼人攻下克鲁亚。

1444年，众贵族在莱什联合，拥戴斯坎德培（乔治·卡斯特里奥蒂）为首，他抵抗奥斯曼人直至1468年去世。奥斯曼统治下，许多阿尔巴尼亚人从17世纪起改宗伊斯兰教，出任大维齐尔者逾四十人。1800年前后，半独立的帕夏领地兴起，约阿尼纳由阿里帕夏统治到1822年。

en: The Vakarel were an Evenki band of the Aldan, a long right tributary of the Lena, where they hunted elk and wild reindeer through the eastern Stanovoy taiga. In 1639 the Cossack Ivan Moskvitin ascended the Aldan on his way to the Sea of Okhotsk, opening the river to Russian fur traders and tribute collectors.
zh: 阿尔丹人是活动在阿尔丹河流域的鄂温克游猎群，在斯塔诺夫山脉东麓的林海中猎取驼鹿和野鹿；阿尔丹河是勒拿河的长大右支流。1639年，哥萨克伊万·莫斯克维京沿阿尔丹河而上前往鄂霍次克海，这条水道从此向俄国毛皮商和征税官敞开。

en:
The Snchicu'umshcn, now commonly called the Coeur d'Alene or Skitswish, are an Interior Salish people of the lake district at the heart of the Idaho panhandle, whose villages stood along the Coeur d'Alene river and the shores of lake Coeur d'Alene. They lived by fishing, hunting and gathering camas on a seasonal round, wintering in clustered semi-subterranean earth lodges, and their language belongs to the Interior branch of Salishan.

Their first recorded encounter with Europeans was in 1793, and the name Cœur d'Alêne, French for 'heart of an awl', was first written down by the Lewis and Clark expedition in 1805; from 1810 North West Company traders Alexander Henry and David Thompson travelled and traded through their country.
zh:
斯尼奇乌姆什恩人通常称科达伦人，又名斯基特维什，是内陆萨利什人的一支，家园在爱达荷州狭地中心的湖区，村落分布在科达伦河沿岸和科达伦湖畔。他们按季节迁徙，以捕鱼、狩猎和采集卡马夏为生，冬季聚居在半地穴式土屋中，语言属萨利什语的内陆分支。

他们与欧洲人有记载的首次接触是在1793年；法文名称科尔达伦意为‘锥子之心’，最早由1805年的刘易斯与克拉克探险队记录下来；1810年起，西北公司的商人亚历山大·亨利和戴维·汤普森进入他们的土地旅行和贸易。

en:
The Algerian are the Arabic-speaking, largely Arabized people of the central Maghreb, settled in the cities and high plains around Constantine, Sétif and Hodna. Islam and Arabic came with the Umayyad conquests of the seventh and eighth centuries, but the countryside kept its Amazigh speech until the Fatimids loosed the Bedouin Banu Hilal and Banu Sulaym on the Zirids; their rout of Sanhaja cavalry at Haydaran in 1052 opened the interior to Bedouin camps and carried Hilalian Arabic across the plateau, fusing Arab tribesmen with Arabized Berbers.

Rule passed through Almoravids and Almohads to the Zayyanid kingdom of Tlemcen, founded in 1235; its fourteenth-century court under Abu Hammu Musa II hosted Ibn Khaldun. The Ottomans took Tlemcen in 1551.

Spain seized Oran in 1509, and the Barbarossa brothers built Algiers into an Ottoman corsair regency from 1516; after a janissary coup in 1659 it became a republic of deys, recovering Oran in 1792 before the 1830 French invasion ended it.
zh:
阿尔及尔人是中马格里布操阿拉伯语、以阿拉伯化居民为主体的族群，聚居君士坦丁、塞提夫与霍德纳一带城市高原。7至8世纪倭马亚征服带来伊斯兰教和阿拉伯语，乡间长期仍用阿马齐格语；法蒂玛王朝放巴努希拉尔、巴努苏莱姆等贝都因部东侵齐尔王朝，1052年海达兰一战击溃桑哈贾骑兵，内陆向贝都因营帐敞开，希拉勒阿拉伯语传布高原，阿拉伯部落与阿拉伯化柏柏尔人渐融。

中马格里布历经穆拉比特、穆瓦希德王朝，1235年扎扬王朝建特莱姆森王国；14世纪阿布·哈穆·穆萨二世时伊本·赫勒敦寓居其宫廷，1551年特莱姆森入奥斯曼。

西班牙1509年夺奥兰，巴巴罗萨兄弟1516年起把阿尔及尔建成奥斯曼海盗摄政领；1659年禁卫军政变后成德伊共和国，1792年收回奥兰，1830年法国入侵终结摄政。

en: The Alor are a Papuan people of the Alor Archipelago at the eastern end of the Lesser Sunda chain, occupying the rugged western coast of Alor Island, northern Pantar and the small island of Pura. They speak Papuan languages of the Alor–Pantar family and organize society into patrilineal clans called hieta, farming subsistence crops and cutting sandalwood for trade.
zh: 亚罗人是小巽他群岛东端阿洛群岛的巴布亚语族群，分布在阿洛岛崎岖的西海岸、潘塔尔岛北部和小岛普拉。他们操巴布亚语系阿洛—潘塔尔语族的语言，按名为希埃塔的父系氏族组织社会，种植自给作物并采伐檀香木贸易。

en:
The Alsea are a Native American people of the central Oregon coast, whose villages lined the Alsea River and the shores of Alsea Bay; their neighbours the Yaquina shared their speech and, in origin tradition, belonged to one people. The name Alsea was given by their Tillamook and Coos neighbours.

Their language, Alsea or Yakonan, was close to Yaquina; the two may be dialects of one tongue. It is usually placed in the Coast Oregon Penutian group, though some linguists treat it as an isolate. An ethnographic estimate put Yakonan speakers at about six thousand in 1780.

The Alsea hunted seals and sea lions, took salmon in the estuaries and dug camas roots; they wove baskets and grass raincoats and shaped infants' foreheads by gentle pressure in the cradleboard. Shamans worked to secure good salmon runs, and the dead lay in canoes on points jutting into the estuaries.
zh:
阿尔西厄人是俄勒冈中部海岸的原住民，村庄沿阿尔西河和阿尔西湾两岸分布；邻族亚奎纳人讲相近的语言，在起源传说中本就属于同一个民族。“阿尔西厄”之名来自蒂拉穆克人和库斯人的称呼。

他们的语言阿尔西语又称雅科南语，与亚奎纳语极为接近，二者可能只是同一语言的不同方言；通常归入佩努蒂语系的俄勒冈海岸语组，也有语言学家将其视为孤立语言。一项民族学估计认为，1780年讲雅科南语的人口约有六千。

阿尔西厄人捕猎海豹和海狮，在河口湾捕捞鲑鱼、挖掘卡马夏根；他们编织篮筐和草制雨衣，还在婴儿摇篮中轻压其头部以改变前额形状。萨满负责祈保鲑鱼丰收，死者则被安放在独木舟里，置于伸入河口湾的岬角上。

en:
The Alyutor are a Chukotko-Kamchatkan people of the narrow neck of northeastern Kamchatka, the Olyutor and Karaga coasts facing the Bering Sea. Long counted as a Koryak branch and speaking a tongue close to Koryak, they call themselves Alutal'u.

They built riverside villages on high ground, living from reindeer, salmon and seals in octagonal earth houses shared by several families.

Cossacks imposed the fur tribute on them in 1697, and armed resistance culminated in the uprising of 1751, after which their numbers fell sharply and Chukchi raids took their herds. Their late-eighteenth-century isolation let them escape the worst smallpox and keep their coastal way of life.
zh:
阿柳托尔人属楚科奇—堪察加语族，居住在堪察加东北部的狭窄地峡，即面向白令海的奥柳托尔与卡拉加海岸。他们长期被算作科里亚克人的一支，说与科里亚克语相近的语言，自称阿卢塔卢。

村落建在河边高地上，住几户人家合居的八角土屋，以驯鹿、鲑鱼和海豹为生。

1697年哥萨克向他们强征毛皮税，武装反抗最终酿成1751年的起义，起义被镇压后人口大减，楚科奇人又来袭掠走鹿群。18世纪末他们地处偏远，几乎未受天花大流行波及，沿海的传统生计也得以保存。

en: The Amaimon are a Papuan people of the hinterland behind Madang on the north coast of Papua New Guinea, centred on the village of Amaimon in the Transgogol country of Madang Province. They speak a language of the Madang branch of the Trans-New Guinea family.
zh: 阿迈蒙人是巴布亚新几内亚北海岸马当后方腹地的巴布亚族群，以马当省特兰斯戈戈尔地区的阿迈蒙村为中心。他们说跨新几内亚语系马当语支的一种语言。

en:
The Amurdak, also written Amarak or Ngamarak, are an Indigenous Australian people of the Cobourg Peninsula in the Northern Territory, keepers of the coastal country and hinterland around the eastern shore of Van Diemen Gulf. Their traditional lands ran over about 2,300 square kilometres, from Murgenella and Cooper creeks in the north to the East Alligator River in the south.

Their language, also called Wardadjbak, belonged to the Iwaidja family and had two dialects, Urrik and Didjurra. In Cobourg Peninsula Dreamtime lore they descend from the children the founding woman Imberombera left at Mamul near Cooper Creek, whom she told to speak Amurdak and to gather the edible bulb murarowa.
zh:
阿马拉克人又拼作阿穆尔达克或恩加马拉克，是北领地科堡半岛的澳大利亚原住民，守护着范迪门湾东岸的沿海与内陆地带。他们的传统领地约2300平方公里，北起穆尔杰内拉溪与库珀溪，南抵东阿利盖特河。

他们的语言又称瓦尔达贾克语，属伊瓦伊贾语系，有乌里克和迪朱拉两种方言。在科堡半岛的梦幻时代传说中，始祖女因贝龙贝拉在库珀溪附近的马穆尔留下子女，命他们说阿马拉克语、采食名叫穆拉罗瓦的可食球茎，阿马拉克人便是这些子女的后裔。

en:
The Ambae are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people who garden the slopes of Ambae, Vanuatu's largest active volcano, a rugged basalt island in the north of the archipelago long known to Europeans as Aoba or Lepers' Island.

The island has no permanent rivers and its only natural standing water lies in crater lakes near the summit, so villages draw on wells and stored rainwater while tending large gardens and managed forests above the coastal coconut groves. Their western language, also called Duidui, has its principal dialect at Nduindui, while kinfolk on the north, east and south speak the distinct East Ambae tongue.

The ships of Queirós's Spanish expedition first recorded a sighting of Ambae in the spring of 1606; Bougainville sailed through the group in 1768 and James Cook in 1774.
zh:
奥巴人是在奥巴岛坡地上耕作园圃的美拉尼西亚人，操大洋洲语。奥巴岛位于瓦努阿图北部，是瓦努阿图体积最大的活火山，海岸多嶙峋的黑色玄武岩，欧洲人旧称奥巴岛或麻风岛。

岛上没有常年河流，唯一的天然积水是山顶的火山口湖，村民便靠水井和蓄存雨水生活，在沿海椰林上方经营大片园圃和人工林木。他们的西部语言又称杜伊杜伊语，主方言在恩杜因杜伊；岛的北、东、南部同族则使用与之不同的东奥巴语。

1606年春，基罗斯的西班牙探险队首次有记载地望见奥巴岛；布干维尔和库克又分别于1768年和1774年航经这片群岛。

en:
The Ambrym are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of Ambrym, a triangular volcanic island near the centre of the Vanuatu archipelago, dominated by a vast desert-like caldera whose two craters hold some of the few persistent lava lakes in the world. Villages cling to the three forested corners of the island, and in the north the people speak North Ambrym, whose two dialects survive from five or six earlier varieties merged as communities moved down to the coast.

Their island entered European records through James Cook, who sailed past in 1774 and is traditionally credited with naming it Ambrym, although his expedition never actually landed.
zh:
安布里姆人是安布里姆岛上的美拉尼西亚人，操大洋洲语。安布里姆是瓦努阿图群岛中部一座三角形火山岛，岛心是巨大而荒凉的破火山口，口内两个火山坑拥有世界上少见的常年熔岩湖，村落则散布在岛屿三个林木繁茂的角上。北部居民使用北安布里姆语，两种方言由早先的五六种方言随居民迁往海岸合并而来。

该岛进入欧洲人的记载与詹姆斯·库克有关：他于1774年航经此地，相传岛名便出自库克，不过其探险队其实并未登陆。

en:
The Ambundu, or Mbundu, are a matrilineal Bantu people of the high plateau north of Angola's Kwanza River, around Luanda, whose ancestors arrived chiefly between the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries. They speak Kimbundu, and their leading kingdom was Ndongo, whose ruler bore the title Ngola, from which Angola takes its name.

When Ndongo challenged Kongo's monopoly on Portuguese trade, war ended in a Bakongo defeat in 1556 and Ndongo's independence; a later alliance with Matamba against Portugal was crushed in 1614. Queen Njinga, an Ngola's daughter, withdrew to Matamba and built it into the region's strongest state and slave exporter.

Ambundu captives made up a large share of the Atlantic slave trade, and Mbundu were among the first Africans landed in Virginia in 1619. Portuguese armies subdued Matamba in 1836, though highland control remained weak for decades.
zh:
安本杜人又称姆本杜人，是按母系传承的班图人，住在安哥拉宽扎河以北的高原上，以罗安达一带为中心，先民主要在13至16世纪间迁来。他们讲金本杜语，主导的王国是恩东戈，君主称号为“恩戈拉”，安哥拉国名即由此而来。

恩东戈挑战刚果王国对葡萄牙贸易的垄断，战争以1556年巴刚果人战败、恩东戈独立告终；后来它与马坦巴结盟对抗葡萄牙，又在1614年被击溃。恩戈拉之女恩津加女王退据马坦巴，把它经营成当地最强的国家和奴隶出口国。

安本杜俘虏在大西洋奴隶贸易中占很大份额，1619年运抵弗吉尼亚的第一批非洲人中就有姆本杜人。1836年葡萄牙军队征服马坦巴，但此后数十年间对高原的控制仍然薄弱。

en:
The Amdowas are the Tibetans of Amdo, the northeastern Tibetan plateau. Their valleys entered the Tibetan Empire in the seventh century; the Tibetan kingdom Tsongkha ruled from 997 to 1104. The Mongol conquest of the 1240s opened the priest-patron bond between khans and lamas.

By 1337 Yuan garrisons were already crumbling and Mongol fiefs around Kokonor lacked leaders; a rising in 1347 shook eastern Tibet. The Ming held little beyond the Hezhou and Xining garrisons, while Tsongkhapa, founder of the Gelug order, marked Amdo's religious life: Kumbum rose in 1583 and Labrang in 1709.

After Güshi Khan's wars of the 1630s and 1640s, Kokonor stayed under Mongol rule until the Qing drove out the Dzungars; in the 1720s the Yongzheng Emperor folded Amdo into a new Xining administration, leaving headmen and monasteries to manage local affairs under imperial commissions. Speaking a conservative, tone-free Tibetan, the Amdowas long felt themselves apart from the Tibetans of Lhasa.
zh:
安多人是安多地区的藏人，地处青藏高原东北缘。其河谷在7世纪并入吐蕃帝国，帝国崩溃后，吐蕃裔的唃厮啰政权于997至1104年统治此地，13世纪40年代蒙古征服安多，开启了蒙古汗王与西藏喇嘛之间的供施关系。

1337年时元朝的戍军已经摇摇欲坠，青海一带的蒙古封地无主；1347年东部藏地有大范围起事。明朝实际控制的不过河州、西宁等卫所；格鲁派创始人宗喀巴为安多留下深远的宗教印记，塔尔寺于1583年兴建，拉卜楞寺于1709年落成。

固始汗在17世纪30至40年代征战后，青海地区仍由蒙古人统治，直到清朝逐走准噶尔；雍正皇帝在18世纪20年代把安多纳入新设的西宁府管辖，头人和大寺院凭朝廷敕命管理地方事务。安多人说保守而无声调的安多方言，长期自认与拉萨的藏人有别。

en:
The Amhara are the Amharic-speaking Orthodox Christians of the central and northern Ethiopian highlands around Lake Tana. They took shape as Aksumite-descended Christians settled the highlands and absorbed the Cushitic Agaw; Amharic served court and government for more than seven centuries.

First named in twelfth-century records, the Amhara rose to power when Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe in 1270 and founded the Solomonic line. In 1337 the warrior-emperor Amda Seyon I ruled from mobile highland camps, extending Christian rule over lowland Muslim states; his successors built the first fixed capital at Debre Birhan in 1456.

The Adal invasion of 1529 to 1543 under Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi devastated the highlands until Emperor Galawdewos, with Portuguese help, won the war and rebuilt the state. From 1636 Gondar became the permanent capital, opening a period of castles and church art, before the eighteenth-century Zemene Mesafint, an age of rival lords reducing emperors to figureheads.
zh:
阿姆哈拉人是埃塞俄比亚中部和北部高原塔纳湖周边说阿姆哈拉语的东正教徒。他们是阿克苏姆后裔的基督徒迁入高原、同化库希特语族阿高人后形成的；阿姆哈拉语作为宫廷和行政用语沿用了七百多年。

阿姆哈拉之名12世纪已有记载，1270年叶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝、建立所罗门皇朝后，他们掌握帝国权力。1337年在位的是武功赫赫的阿姆达·塞约恩一世，他以流动的高原营帐为都，把基督教势力扩展到低地的穆斯林诸邦；后继者于1456年在德布雷伯尔汉建起第一座固定都城。

1529至1543年，阿达尔在艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐率领下入侵，重创高原，最终加拉德沃斯皇帝在葡萄牙援助下取胜并重建国家。1636年起，贡德尔成为固定都城，开启了以城堡和教堂艺术闻名的贡德尔时期；到18世纪，国家进入“王子时代”，群雄并起，皇帝沦为傀儡。

en: The Ç'amkoe are San foragers who speak ǂʼAmkoe, a Kxʼa language of south-eastern Botswana with three dialects, Nǃaqriaxe, ǂHoan and Sasi. Classed with the ǃKung Juu languages, it joins Taa and Gǀui at the core of the Kalahari Basin sprachbund. Most communities have shifted to neighbouring tongues such as Gǀui, Kgalagadi and Tswana.
zh: 阿姆科伊人是讲阿姆科伊语的桑人狩猎采集者，该语言属科语系，通行于博茨瓦纳东南部，分为恩库阿里亚赫、霍安、萨西三种方言。它与孔人的朱语合属科语系，并和塔语、格维语构成卡拉哈里盆地语言联盟的核心。多数社群已转用邻近的格维语、卡拉加迪语和茨瓦纳语。

en:
The Amuzgos are an Oto-Manguean people of the Yacuyagua mountains on the Guerrero-Oaxaca border, around Xochistlahuaca and Ometepec, whose speech belongs to the Mixtec branch and whose names include Tzjon Noan, people of the thread.

They once held the Costa Chica down to the Pacific, but Mixtec expansion drove them into the highlands: around 1100 their capital Xochistlahuaca was subjugated, and for three centuries they paid tribute in cotton, cloth and gold as part of the Mixtec province of Ayacastla. The Aztecs took Ayacastla in 1457 but never mastered the Amuzgo country, and revolts in 1494 and 1504 to 1507 were put down by force.

Pedro de Alvarado's men conquered the region in 1522; war, disease and overwork cut Xochistlahuaca's people from some 20,000 to 200 by 1582, and survivors retreated into the Sierra Madre del Sur, where their backstrap-loom textiles and language survived the colonial centuries.
zh:
阿穆斯戈人是格雷罗州与瓦哈卡州交界亚库亚瓜山区的奥托-曼格族群，聚居于索奇斯特拉瓦卡和奥梅特佩克；其语言属米斯特克语支，自称之一为特宗诺安，意为织线之民。

他们曾据有小海岸直到太平洋的地带，米斯特克人的扩张把他们逼进高地：约1100年首府索奇斯特拉瓦卡被征服，此后三百年间作为米斯特克人阿亚卡斯特拉省的一部分，以棉花、布匹和黄金纳贡。阿兹特克人于1457年夺取阿亚卡斯特拉，却始终未能真正控制阿穆斯戈山区，1494年和1504至1507年的起义都被武力镇压。

1522年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多的军队征服此地；战乱、疫病和劳役使索奇斯特拉瓦卡人口从约两万人锐减到1582年的两百人，幸存者退入南马德雷山脉深处，其腰带织机纺织传统和语言则延续过整个殖民时代。

en: The Anambé are a Tupi-Guarani people of the lower Tocantins, living in the river delta and the Cairari River country of Pará, where they kept to forest villages before sustained contact with Brazilian settlers began in the nineteenth century.
zh: 阿南贝人是托坎廷斯河下游的图皮-瓜拉尼族群，住在帕拉州的河口三角洲和凯拉里河流域，在19世纪与巴西定居者建立持续接触之前，一直以林中村落居民的身份生活。

en:
The Anauls were a Yukaghir tribal group who lived along the upper Anadyr River in the far northeast of Siberia and spoke the Chuvan, or coastal, variant of Yukaghir. Unlike nomadic reindeer groups, they were settled river fishermen and hunters; their name derives from a Chukchi word meaning the people living on the Enmyvaam.

They had a reputation as the most warlike of the Yukaghir clans, yet their settled camps made them an easy target for Russian fur collectors.

Fighting began in 1649 when Dezhnev's detachment reached the Anadyr, and in 1650 the chief Kogyunya's men killed nine Russian traders before Dezhnev stormed their fortified camp. Rivalry with neighboring groups, epidemics and Tsarist tribute policy scattered and reduced the Anauls, and they disappeared as a distinct people in the colonial period.
zh:
阿瑙尔斯人是尤卡吉尔人的一个部落群体，住在西伯利亚极东北部的阿纳德尔河上游，说尤卡吉尔语的丘万（沿海）变体。与游牧养鹿群体不同，他们是定居河畔的渔猎部落，族名出自楚科奇语，意为“住在恩米瓦阿姆河上的人”。

他们在尤卡吉尔各部中以好战著称，但定居的营地反而使他们容易成为俄国毛皮税征收者的目标。

1649年杰日尼奥夫的队伍抵达阿纳德尔，双方开战；1650年酋长科古尼亚的部下杀死九名俄国商人，杰日尼奥夫随即强攻其堡寨。此后部族仇杀、疫病和沙皇的贡赋政策使阿瑙尔斯人不断流散衰减，最终在殖民时代作为独立群体消亡。

en:
The Anccara, also written Angaraes or Ankaras, were Quechua-speaking people of the cold highlands around Huancavelica in the central Peruvian sierra, whose señorío took shape in the Late Intermediate Period. The region was later drawn into the Wari cultural sphere; as an independent nation the Anccara kept up alliances and border wars with the Yauyos, Wanka and other neighbours.

With the Chanca they joined the Chanca confederation that marched on Cusco and was shattered by the young Pachacuti; in the 1460s his Inca armies brought the Anccara lands into the Tawantinsuyu, deporting part of the population as mitimaes.

After the Spanish conquest their territory was attached from the 1540s to the repartimiento of Huamanga, and the Huancavelica mercury mines transformed the region: Lircay was founded in 1572 as a mining center, and in 1612 the Anccara corregimiento was divided between Castrovirreyna and Huancavelica.
zh:
安加赖人又译安加赖斯或安卡拉人，是秘鲁中部山区万卡韦利卡一带寒冷高原上讲克丘亚语的族群，领主政权在晚中间期成型。该地区后来被纳入瓦里文化圈；作为独立民族，安加赖人与亚维尤、万卡等邻族时战时和。

他们与昌卡人共同加入昌卡联盟，进军库斯科，却被年轻的帕查库特克击溃；15世纪60年代，他的印加军队吞并安加赖土地，把一部分居民作为米蒂马伊人迁走。

西班牙征服后，他们的土地从16世纪40年代起划归瓦曼加委托监护区；万卡韦利卡汞矿改变了整个地区，1572年利尔凯建城，成为矿业中心，1612年旧安加赖督辖区又被拆分给卡斯特罗维雷纳和万卡韦利卡。

en:
The Hisatsinom, Hopi for ancient people, is the Pueblo name for the Ancestral Puebloans, centered on the Colorado Plateau's Four Corners country. Their tradition took shape around the twelfth century BCE; from about 700 to 1130 rainfall supported a tenfold population rise.

In Chaco Canyon they raised fifteen great houses of dressed sandstone, some with 700 rooms; Mesa Verde preserves cliff dwellings under canyon overhangs. Maize, beans and squash watered by check dams fed towns joined by hundreds of miles of roads.

A fifty-year drought from 1130 emptied Chaco Canyon, and twelfth- and thirteenth-century droughts and pressure from incoming groups drove villagers out of the Four Corners. By the fourteenth century the great houses and cliff dwellings stood abandoned; the people migrated into Rio Grande and Arizona Pueblo villages, among them the Hopi, who remember the builders as the Hisatsinom.
zh:
“希萨齐农”是霍皮语“古人”的意思，是普韦布洛后裔对古代普韦布洛人的称呼，核心区在科罗拉多高原的四角落地区。这一传统约形成于公元前12世纪；约700年至1130年间，降雨使人口增长约十倍。

他们在查科峡谷用修整过的砂岩建起十五座大屋，有的含七百个房间；梅萨维德留存着悬崖凹壁下的崖居。依靠谷坊灌溉的玉米、豆类与南瓜，供养着由数百英里道路相连的城镇。

1130年开始的五十年大旱使查科峡谷沦为空谷；12至13世纪，连年干旱加上外来族群迁入的压力，把村民逼出四角落地区。到14世纪，大屋和崖居已全部荒废；人们迁徙到里奥格兰德河和亚利桑那的普韦布洛村落，霍皮人便是其中之一，仍把这些建造者称作希萨齐农。

en:
The Andalusi are Arabic-speaking Muslims of southern Iberia, heirs of al-Andalus, born of the 711 Muslim conquest. From Arab and Berber settlers and Iberian converts, the Muladíes, an Andalusi identity in Andalusi Arabic emerged by the 1200s, its cities shared with Mozarabic Christians and Jews.

Their world had known the Umayyad caliphate of Córdoba, whose tenth-century scholars led Europe in astronomy, medicine and philosophy; the taifa kingdoms after its 1031 fall; and the Almoravids and Almohads. As Christian kingdoms pressed south, Nasrid emir Ibn al-Ahmar founded the Emirate of Granada in 1238, the peninsula's last Muslim state, which paid Castile tribute and adorned its capital with the Alhambra.

In 1337 the emirate still held Granada, Málaga and Almería, but the city of Granada fell to the Catholic Monarchs in 1492. Castile outlawed Islam in 1502; the Moriscos, forced converts, rose in the Alpujarras in 1568 and were crushed and dispersed, and between 1609 and 1614 the crown expelled tens of thousands, most finding refuge in Morocco and Ottoman lands.
zh:
安达卢斯人是伊比利亚南部讲阿拉伯语的穆斯林，为711年征服所生安达卢斯文明继承者。阿拉伯、柏柏尔定居者与本地改宗的穆拉迪人融合，13世纪形成共同认同，操安达卢斯阿拉伯语，与莫扎拉布基督徒、犹太人共居。

先辈历经科尔多瓦倭马亚哈里发国，10世纪学者在天文、医学、哲学领先欧洲；1031年哈里发国亡后泰法并立，又历穆拉比特、穆瓦希德王朝。基督教诸国南下，纳扎里埃米尔伊本·艾哈迈尔1238年建格拉纳达王国，为半岛最后穆斯林政权，向卡斯蒂利亚纳贡，建阿尔罕布拉宫。

1337年格拉纳达王国仍据格拉纳达、马拉加、阿尔梅里亚，1492年格拉纳达城陷天主教双王之手。1502年卡斯蒂利亚禁伊斯兰教；被迫改宗的摩里斯科人1568年阿尔普哈拉斯起义被镇压并打散迁居，1609至1614年王室驱逐数万人，多避难摩洛哥、奥斯曼。

en:
The Andamanese are the Negrito hunter-gatherers of the Andaman Islands in the Bay of Bengal, comprising the Great Andamanese, Jarawa, Onge and Sentinelese, each speaking mutually unintelligible languages. They settled the islands at the end of the last ice age, more than twenty thousand years ago, and lived in near-total isolation, meeting outsiders with arrows.

The Chola king Rajendra I seized the chain as a naval base against Srivijaya, and an inscription of 1050 names it Ma-Nakkavaram. Marco Polo's travels of 1294 repeated sailors' tales of dog-headed cannibals, so in 1337 the Andamanese remained known to outsiders only through rumour.

Their seclusion ended in 1789, when the Bengal Presidency built a penal settlement at Port Blair. Disease ravaged the islanders, the post was abandoned in 1796, and in 1824 its harbour served a British fleet in the First Anglo-Burmese War.
zh:
安达曼人是孟加拉湾安达曼群岛的尼格利陀狩猎采集者，分为大安达曼人、加洛瓦人、翁格人和森蒂纳尔人，各说互不相通的语言。他们在上一个冰河时代末期、两万多年前便定居群岛，此后几乎与外界完全隔绝，以箭矢迎接外来者。

朱罗国王拉金德拉一世曾夺取这条岛链，作为进攻室利佛逝的海军基地，1050年的碑铭将其记为“大纳卡瓦拉姆”。1294年马可·波罗的行记转述海员有关狗头食人族的传说，因此在1337年，安达曼人仍是外界只凭传闻知晓的民族。

这种封闭状态在1789年终结：英属孟加拉管辖区在布莱尔港建立流放地，疾病使岛民人口锐减，该据点于1796年放弃，1824年其港湾又为第一次英缅战争中的英国舰队充当集结地。

en:
The Andaquí, also called Aguanunga or Churuba, are an indigenous people of the forested eastern foothills of the Colombian Andes, settled in the upper Caquetá basin and the Fragua and Suaza valleys.

They were among the Upper Magdalena nations drawn into the great rising of 1536 led by the cacica Gaitana against the Spanish, though conquistador texts first name them only in the late sixteenth century. In 1637 they and the Pijao attacked the conquistador Francisco Dias, an incident entered in the town records of Timaná. Their resistance ran on into the next century: the 1721 rebellion united the Andakí, Tama and Mocoa peoples against the colonial advance.

Their language, recorded in a word list compiled in 1788, was later classed as Chibchan by linguists following Paul Rivet, though other scholars treat it as an isolate.
zh:
安达基人又称阿瓜农加人或丘鲁巴人，是哥伦比亚安第斯山脉东麓林区的原住民，聚居于卡克塔河上游及弗拉瓜、苏阿萨谷地。

1536年女酋长盖塔娜领导反抗西班牙人的大起义时，马格达莱纳河上游诸部纷纷响应，安达基人也在其中，但征服者的文书直到16世纪末才首次提到他们。1637年，他们与皮豪人联手袭击征服者弗朗西斯科·迪亚斯，此事被记入蒂马纳的市政档案。他们的抵抗延续到下一个世纪：1721年的起义把安达基、塔马、莫科阿诸部联合起来，共同抗击殖民扩张。

他们的语言在1788年编纂的一份词汇表中留有记录，后世语言学家承袭保罗·里韦的观点将其归入奇布查语系，但也有学者认为它是一门孤立语言。

en:
The Anejom are the people of Aneityum, the southernmost inhabited island of Vanuatu. Their language of the same name is the island's only indigenous tongue, a Southern Vanuatu branch of the Oceanic group. Aneityum was settled around 874 BC by voyagers from Tanna, who first kept to coastal hillsides and later moved into the valleys.

Traditionally the island was ruled by chiefs called natimarid over chiefdoms named neclau; oral history tells of two original chiefdoms splitting into seven, then into fifty or sixty districts. The first European ship, the sandalwood brig Alpha, arrived in 1830, and the trade and epidemics that followed sharply reduced the Aneityumese population.
zh:
阿内霍姆人是瓦努阿图最南端有人居住的岛屿阿内蒂乌姆岛的居民，其同名语言是岛上唯一的本土语言，属大洋洲语族南瓦努阿图语支。阿内蒂乌姆岛约在公元前874年由来自塔纳岛的航海者定居，他们最初居住在沿海坡地，后来迁入谷地。

传统上岛上由称纳蒂马里德的酋长统治众多名为内克劳的酋邦；口传史称最初的两个酋邦分裂为七个，再分成五六十个区域。1830年，第一艘欧洲船，即做檀香木生意的双桅帆船阿尔法号抵达，随后的贸易和疫病使阿内蒂乌姆人口锐减。

en:
Angevin is the traditional langue d'oïl of Anjou in western France, spoken from the Loire around Angers and Saumur into Maine, where it coexists with related Mayennois speech. With Sarthois and southern Norman it forms the eastern Armorican group of the langues d'oïl, and in the ninth and tenth centuries helped shape Gallo beyond the Breton march.

The land was the Roman civitas of the Andecavi, descended from the Gaulish Andes, Angers staying its capital through the Frankish county and duchy. The counts of the tenth and eleventh centuries, the Fulks, built Anjou into a major principality, and Count Geoffrey Plantagenet's marriage to Empress Matilda carried its inheritance to the English throne; Angevin words entered English through the Plantagenet court's Anglo-Norman.

The dialect produced little written literature: Anjou joined the French royal domain early in the thirteenth century, Parisian Francien the language of letters. In 1360 the county became the Duchy of Anjou, a royal appanage until absorbed into the crown lands in 1482; it remained a province until 1790, then the core of Maine-et-Loire.
zh:
安茹语是法国西部安茹的传统奥依语，通行昂热、索米尔一带卢瓦尔河谷，延伸到相邻曼恩伯国，与马耶讷语并存。它与萨尔特语、南诺曼语构成奥依语的东阿莫里卡语组，9至10世纪影响布列塔尼边地之外的加洛语。

这片土地原是高卢安德斯人的罗马城邦安德卡维，昂热在法兰克伯国和后来公国时期一直是首府。10至11世纪的富尔克家族伯爵把安茹经营成大诸侯领地，若弗鲁瓦·金雀花伯爵与玛蒂尔达皇后的婚姻使安茹继承权登上英格兰王位；安茹词汇借金雀花宫廷的盎格鲁-诺曼语进入英语。

该方言少有书面文学，因安茹13世纪初并入法国王室领地，巴黎法兰西语成为书面语言。1360年伯国升为安茹公国，作为王室亲王封邑至1482年并入王田，后为行省延续到1790年，成为曼恩-卢瓦尔省的核心。

en: The Anggamudi, also written Angkamuthi, are an Aboriginal people of the western Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose country lay north of Port Musgrave around Duyfken Point, Mapoon and the Ducie River mouth. Their speech was the Angkamuthi dialect of Uradhi, a Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family, and Dutch explorers skirmished with local people nearby in 1623.
zh: 安加穆迪人是昆士兰约克角半岛西部的原住民，领地位于马斯格雷夫港以北、杜伊夫肯角、马普恩和杜西河河口一带。他们的语言是乌拉迪语的安加穆迪方言，属帕马-牛雅语系的帕马语组；1623年荷兰探险者曾在附近与当地人发生冲突。

en:
The Anglo-Irish are the English-descended settler community of Ireland, whose roots lie in the Anglo-Norman invasion of 1169–1171 and the Lordship of Ireland created for Henry II’s son John in 1177. Many settler families Gaelicised so thoroughly that medieval commentators called them more Irish than the Irish themselves.

Edward Bruce’s Scottish invasion of 1315–1318, famine and the Black Death of the 1340s shrank the colony, and the Statutes of Kilkenny of 1366 vainly forbade settlers from using the Irish language and Irish customs. By the fifteenth century English rule scarcely reached beyond the Pale around Dublin.

The Tudor plantations and the Cromwellian conquest of the seventeenth century remade the community into a largely Anglican landowning class, the Protestant Ascendancy, whose position was anchored by the Act of Union of 1801.
zh:
盎格鲁-爱尔兰人是爱尔兰岛上英格兰裔定居者群体，源头是1169—1171年的盎格鲁-诺曼人入侵，以及1177年为亨利二世之子约翰设立的爱尔兰领地。许多定居者家族彻底盖尔化，以至于中世纪评论者称他们比爱尔兰人还要爱尔兰。

1315—1318年爱德华·布鲁斯的苏格兰入侵、饥荒和14世纪40年代的黑死病使殖民地萎缩，1366年的《基尔肯尼法令》禁止定居者使用爱尔兰语、遵从爱尔兰习俗，却收效甚微。到15世纪，英格兰的实际统治几乎只剩都柏林周围的“佩尔”地区。

都铎王朝的种植园运动和17世纪克伦威尔的征服，把这个群体重塑为以圣公会信徒为主的地主阶层，即“新教优势”阶层，其地位又由1801年的《联合法令》固定下来。

en: The Angoram are a Papuan people of the lower Sepik River in East Sepik Province. Their language, also called Pondo and known to its own speakers as Kanda, stands as its own branch of the Lower Sepik family, and the speech of Maramba village counts as one of its dialects.
zh: 安戈拉姆人是东塞皮克省塞皮克河下游的巴布亚族群。他们的语言又称庞多语，使用者自己称之为坎达语，在下塞皮克语族中自成一支，马兰巴村的话是它的一种方言。

en:
The Angrians are the people of Angria, the middle-Weser country around Minden and one of four Old Saxon subdivisions between Westphalia and Eastphalia. Their name descends from the Angrivarii, a Germanic tribe recorded by Tacitus that joined Arminius against Rome at the Teutoburg Forest in the year 9.

Absorbed into the Saxon confederation, they faced Charlemagne in the Saxon Wars, their commanders making peace near Bückeburg in 775; Minden became a bishop's see in 803, anchoring local Christianization. When Frederick I deposed Henry the Lion in 1180 and split Saxony under the Gelnhausen Charter, Angria passed to Bernhard of Anhalt, after which its old name fell out of use.

In the thirteenth century the middle Weser lands formed the core of the County of Hoya, inherited in 1582 by Brunswick-Lüneburg; old Angria lived on as a Low German region divided among the Empire's bishoprics, counties and duchies. In 1815 Prussia revived the title Duke of Angria among its royal styles.
zh:
安格里亚人是安格里亚居民，地当威悉河中游明登一带，为古萨克森四大分区之一，在威斯特伐利亚与伊斯特伐利亚之间。其名源出塔西佗所载日耳曼部落安格里瓦里人，曾于公元9年随阿米尼乌斯在条顿堡森林与罗马人作战。

并入萨克森联盟后，他们在萨克森战争中与查理大帝为敌，首领775年在比克堡附近议和；803年明登设主教区，为本地基督教化支点。1180年腓特烈一世废狮子亨利，凭《格尔恩豪森特许状》分萨克森，安格里亚封给安哈尔特的伯恩哈德，旧名此后逐渐废弃。

13世纪威悉河中游土地为霍亚伯国核心，1582年由不伦瑞克-吕讷堡家族继承，古安格里亚为讲低地德语地区，分属神圣罗马帝国治下主教区、伯国和公国。1815年普鲁士在王号中恢复安格里亚公爵旧称。

en: The Anguthimri are an Aboriginal people of the western Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose country ran from the Mission River mouth north to the Pennefather River and west to Duyfken Point near Weipa. They spoke a Paman language of the Pama-Nyungan family, in related dialects used by the Tjungundji and Yupungathi; Dutch explorers landed at that river in 1623.
zh: 安古西姆里人是昆士兰约克角半岛西部的原住民，其领地自米申河口向北延伸至彭尼法瑟河，西抵杜伊夫肯角，邻近韦帕。他们使用帕马-牛雅语系下帕马语组的一种语言，琼贡吉人和尤庞加蒂人等邻近群体也使用其亲属方言；1623年荷兰探险者曾在彭尼法瑟河登陆。

en:
The Antaifasy, whose name means people of the sands, are a fishing and farming Malagasy people of the south-eastern coast around Farafangana, in a homeland called Ifasy between Antaimoro country and Isaka.

Their uncertain early history is dominated by a long feud with the neighbouring Antaimoro: from the 1680s skirmishes ran through the eighteenth century, and after a period of Antaimoro overlordship King Maseba freed them again. In the eighteenth century they grew wealthy on coastal commerce, and King Ifara monopolized trade with European ships until he controlled all traffic on the Manampatra river.

Their society stayed split into three clans under their own kings and strict moral codes. In 1827 the armies of Imerina reduced the Antaifasy to vassals; resistance continued in the forests, though many were carried off to Antananarivo as slaves. They laid their dead in kibory funeral houses hidden in sacred forest.
zh:
安泰法西人族名意为“沙民”，是马尔加什人的一支，以渔耕为生，住在东南沿海法拉凡加纳一带；他们的传统家园叫伊法西，地处安泰莫罗之地与伊萨卡之间。

他们的早期历史已不可考，主线是一场长期世仇：从17世纪80年代起，他们与邻近的安泰莫罗人冲突不断，战斗贯穿18世纪；在被安泰莫罗人统治一段时期后，国王马塞巴重新赢得独立。18世纪他们靠沿海贸易致富，国王伊法拉垄断了与欧洲商船的交易，进而控制马南帕特拉河上的全部航运。

社会分为三个氏族，各有国王，并受严苛的道德规范约束。1827年，伊默里纳的军队将安泰法西人降为附庸；他们在丛林中坚持抵抗，但仍有许多人被掳为奴隶带往塔那那利佛。他们将遗体安放在圣林深处的基博里墓屋里。

en:
The Antaisaka are a Malagasy people of the south-eastern coast south of Farafangana, named for the inland province of Isaka. Their kings came of the Zarabehava, a Sakalava royal line that crossed from the west coast between 1620 and 1650 to settle at Nosipandra.

Oral history names the founder Andriamandresy, born Repila: passed over for the succession after a violent quarrel in which he wounded his uncle, he was exiled and led his followers eastward to found a kingdom. By the early 1700s the Antaisaka realm ranked among Madagascar's four largest kingdoms.

From 1820 the armies of Imerina invaded the coast, killing captured men and enslaving women and children, and the kingdom lost its independence piece by piece. Their life was governed by strict marriage taboos, and twins were considered fady. Corpses were dried for two or three years before being carried through a special door to the kibory house in a sacred forest.
zh:
安泰萨卡人是马尔加什人的一支，住在东南海岸法拉凡加纳以南，族名取自内陆省份伊萨卡。他们的国王出自扎拉贝哈瓦谱系，属萨卡拉瓦王族，于1620至1650年间从西海岸渡海东来，定居在努西潘德拉。

口传史称始祖为安德里曼德雷西，原名雷皮拉；他在激烈冲突中伤了舅父，继承权旁落，被放逐后带着部众东去另建王国。到18世纪初，安泰萨卡已是马达加斯加四大王国之一。

1820年起，伊默里纳的军队入侵海岸，处死被俘男子，将妇女儿童掳为奴隶，王国一步步丧失独立。他们的生活受严苛的婚姻禁忌约束，双胞胎被视为不祥之物。死者遗体要风干两三年，再从专用门抬出，送往圣林中的基博里墓屋。

en:
The Antambahoaka are a Malagasy people of the south-eastern coast around Mananjary, whose village of Masindrano grew into that town. They share their origins with the Antaimoro, who trace themselves to an Arab migrant, Raminia, said to have come from Mecca between the 900s and the 1100s.

In the 1400s the Antaimoro leader Ravalarivo broke away to found Masindrano, and the community took its name from his later title Ratiambahoaka. Their later history is largely unrecorded: they lived in villages under mpanjaka kings, and the noble clans kept the sorabe art of writing Malagasy in Arabic script.

Their festival was the Sambatra, held every seven years: boys born since the previous one were circumcised together and received into their paternal clans as sons of Raminia, with processions to the Mananjary river mouth. They kept fady taboos and Islamic traces such as refusing pork to their chiefs.
zh:
安坦巴华卡人是马达加斯加东南沿海、马南扎里一带的族群，他们最早的村落马辛德拉诺后来发展为马南扎里城。他们与安泰莫罗人同源，后者自称是阿拉伯移民拉米尼亚的后裔，相传拉米尼亚于10至12世纪从麦加迁来。

15世纪，安泰莫罗首领拉瓦拉里武分出自立，建立马辛德拉诺，族名便得自他后来的称号“拉蒂安巴胡阿卡”。此后他们的历史鲜有记载，一直是一群村落，由小国王统治；贵族氏族掌握着用阿拉伯字母拼写马尔加什语的苏拉贝文书技艺。

他们生活中的头等大事是每隔七年举行的桑巴特拉节：节间为上次节庆以来出生的男孩集体施行割礼，承认他们作为拉米尼亚子孙加入父系氏族，同时游行至马南扎里河口。他们恪守种种禁忌，还保留着首领禁食猪肉等伊斯兰遗俗。

en:
The Antankarana hold the northern tip of Madagascar around the bay of Antsiranana; their name means the people of the tsingy, after the crags and caves of the Ankarana massif. They began as the Zafin'i'fotsy, a Sakalava branch that lost a sixteenth-century succession quarrel and migrated north beyond Sakalava power.

Their first king, Kozobe, ruled from 1614, but late in the century Sakalava armies under Andriamandisoarivo overran most of the country. In 1692 Andriantsirotso founded the kingdom and led his people into the Ankarana rocks; with soldiers from his kinsman Raholo, he drove the Sakalava back after three years.

As Imerina expanded in the early nineteenth century, Merina governors reduced King Tsialana I to vassalage. His son Tsimiaro I rose in 1835 and fought until 1837, when reprisals drove him and his people into the Ankarana caves. The Antankarana lived by fishing and herding.
zh:
安坦卡拉纳人住在马达加斯加最北端、安齐拉纳纳湾一带，族名意为“石林之人”，取自安卡拉纳山地的峰丛与洞穴。他们本是萨卡拉瓦的一支，称扎菲尼富齐，16世纪在继承权之争中失败，便向北迁到萨卡拉瓦势力之外。

第一代国王科佐贝1614年即位，但17世纪末，安德里阿曼迪苏阿里沃率萨卡拉瓦大军攻陷了大部分国土。1692年，安德里安齐罗措建立王国，率众退入安卡拉纳石林，又靠亲戚拉胡卢借出的军队，三年后击退萨卡拉瓦人。

19世纪初伊默里纳扩张，梅里纳长官迫使齐阿拉纳一世沦为附庸。其子齐米亚罗一世于1835年起兵，坚持到1837年，梅里纳人的报复把他和族人逼进安卡拉纳的岩洞。安坦卡拉纳人以渔牧为生。

en:
The Antanosy, whose name means people of the island, are a Malagasy people of Anosy in south-eastern Madagascar, around Fort Dauphin harbour. Ironworking reached them in the thirteenth century with Indian Ocean trade, and Chinese celadon circulated until the fifteenth, when the Efaho valley was divided among fortified chiefdoms.

Tradition brings the Zafiraminia clan to Anosy in the fourteenth century; by the mid-seventeenth century they ruled from Fanjahira. In 1613 a Portuguese landing met King Andriantsiambany and five hundred warriors, and French governors at Fort Dauphin burned villages and enslaved thousands before a rising in 1674 forced the garrison out.

The Antanosy then traded under their own chiefs until the nineteenth century. In 1817 Jean Rene, governor of Toamasina and son of a French settler and an Antanosy mother, swore a blood oath with Radama I of Imerina; in 1825 a Merina army under Ramananolona took Fort Dauphin, ending Antanosy independence.
zh:
安塔诺西人族名意为“岛民”，是马尔加什人的一支，住在马达加斯加东南部的阿诺西地区，以多凡堡港为中心。13世纪，冶铁术随印度洋贸易传入，中国青瓷在此流通至15世纪；当时埃法霍河谷已分成若干设防的酋邦。

相传扎菲拉米尼亚氏族于14世纪迁入阿诺西，到17世纪中叶已在凡贾希拉建都。1613年葡萄牙人登陆时，安德里安粲巴尼国王和五百名武士出面迎接；多凡堡的法国历任总督焚毁村庄，奴役数千人，1674年的起义迫使守军撤离。

此后安塔诺西人在各自酋长治下继续贸易，直到19世纪。1817年，法国定居者与安塔诺西女子所生的图阿马西纳长官让·勒内与伊默里纳的拉达马一世歃血为盟；1825年，拉马纳努卢纳率梅里纳军队攻占多凡堡，安塔诺西人的独立终结。

en:
The Anuak are a Luo Nilotic people of the Upper Nile, living in the riverine lowlands of the Baro and Gilo rivers, in Gambela in western Ethiopia and across the border in South Sudan.

Their traditions trace a common origin with the Shilluk and other Luo peoples in the Gezira, between the Blue and White Niles; between the 1100s and the 1400s their ancestors moved south and east under environmental pressure and warfare, into the lowlands where they made their home.

Unlike the cattle-focused peoples around them, the Anuak grew sorghum on the riverbanks alongside herding, fishing and hunting, and their villages were governed by headmen the villagers could depose. Their religion centred on a supreme spirit, Jwøk, and on holy trees in certain villages.
zh:
阿努亚克人是上尼罗河地区的卢奥支系尼罗特人，散居在巴罗河、吉洛河沿岸的低地，即埃塞俄比亚西部的甘贝拉地区及边境另一侧的南苏丹。

他们的传说把自己与希卢克人等卢奥诸族的共同发源地追溯到青尼罗河与白尼罗河之间的杰济拉；12至15世纪，先民因环境压力和战乱向南、向东迁徙，进入此后世代居住的低地。

与周围以牧牛为生的族群不同，阿努亚克人在河畔种植高粱，兼营畜牧、渔猎；他们的村庄由可被村民废黜的头人主持。信仰以至高神乔克和部分村庄里的圣树为核心。

en: The Aondironon were one of the Iroquoian-speaking tribes named within the Neutral Confederacy, or Attawandaron, of southwestern Ontario, the western neighbours of the Wendat. Their confederacy was broken up by Haudenosaunee attacks in 1651, and the surviving Aondironon were absorbed into other Iroquoian nations.
zh: 阿昂迪罗农人是今安大略省西南部中立联盟（阿塔万达龙）名下的一支易洛魁语部族，也是温达特人的西邻。1651年，易洛魁联盟的进攻瓦解了中立联盟，幸存的阿昂迪罗农人被并入其他易洛魁语民族。

en:
The Aónikenk, or Southern Tehuelche, are the people of the eastern Patagonian steppe, from the Chubut River to the Strait of Magellan; their autonym means people of the south, and their Tshoneka language belongs to the Chonan family.

Before horses they were foot nomads, moving in bands of fifty to a hundred with guanaco herds between lowland and plateau, hunting with bolas; the Cueva de las Manos paintings are attributed to their remote ancestors. Magellan's expedition wintered among them at San Julian Bay in 1520, and Pigafetta's tales of their stature made Patagonian giants a European legend.

Horses, known from about 1570, turned them into mounted nomads ranging widely and living on guanaco and rhea. From the eighteenth century Mapuche influence, the Araucanization, spread ponchos and Mapuche speech across the steppe; early nineteenth-century bands fought the Pehuenche and followed chiefs such as the female leader Maria la Grande.
zh:
奥尼肯克人即南支特维尔切人，栖居在东巴塔哥尼亚草原上，范围从丘布特河向南直到麦哲伦海峡；他们的自称意为南方之人，所说的聪内卡语属乔南语系。

在获得马匹之前，他们是徒步游群，以五十至一百人为一队，随原驼群在低地与高原之间迁徙，用流星锤狩猎；平图拉斯河手洞的岩画被认为出自他们远古祖先之手。1520年麦哲伦的探险队在圣胡利安湾过冬时与他们相处，随队的皮加费塔记述了他们的高大身材，巴塔哥尼亚巨人的传说由此风靡欧洲。

约1570年起接触到的马匹把他们变成骑马游群，纵横南北，主食转为原驼和美洲鸵鸟。从18世纪起，马普切人的影响即阿劳卡化把篷乔和马普切语带上草原；19世纪初的奥尼肯克群体曾与佩文切人交战，并拥戴过大玛丽亚这样的女性酋长。

en:
The Apalachee were a Muskogean-speaking people of the Florida Panhandle, settled between the Aucilla and Ochlockonee rivers around Apalachee Bay. Their Fort Walton culture, heir to Mississippian mound-building, was organized into chiefdoms with temple mounds; the capital of Anhaica lay near Tallahassee.

Hernando de Soto wintered at Anhaica in 1539 and 1540 against stubborn resistance; Apalachee arrows were said to pierce double mail. From about 1600 Franciscan missions converted many Apalachee, and San Luis de Talimali became western capital of Spanish Florida in 1656. A revolt in 1647 was followed by forced labour and growing slave raids out of Carolina.

In 1704 James Moore and about a thousand Creek allies destroyed the missions in the Apalachee massacre, carrying off or enslaving over two thousand people, and the province was abandoned. Survivors scattered to Carolina, Pensacola and Mobile, and the Apalachee language died out by the end of the eighteenth century.
zh:
阿巴拉契人是佛罗里达狭长地带操马斯科吉语族语言的族群，聚居于阿巴拉契湾附近的奥西拉河与奥克洛科尼河之间。他们的沃尔顿文化上承密西西比台庙文化，社会为酋长国，以神庙土丘为中心，都城安海卡在塔拉哈西附近。

1539至1540年埃尔南多·德·索托在安海卡过冬，遭到顽强抵抗，据说阿巴拉契人的箭能穿透两层锁子甲。约1600年起，方济各会传教站使许多阿巴拉契人皈依天主教，圣路易斯·德·塔利马利于1656年成为西属佛罗里达的西部首府。1647年起义后，阿巴拉契人被迫劳役，来自卡罗来纳的奴隶掳掠也日益猖獗。

1704年，詹姆斯·穆尔率约一千名克里克盟军在阿巴拉契大屠杀中摧毁各传教站，掳走或奴役两千多人，整个省份就此废弃。幸存者流散到卡罗来纳、彭萨科拉和莫比尔一带，阿巴拉契语也在18世纪末消亡。

en:
The Apiaka are a Tupi-Guarani people of northern Mato Grosso whose language took in elements of the Lingua Geral. Their name is said to derive from a Tupi word for man, though their leaders trace it to a wasp that avenges attacks with a painful sting.

They farmed communal fields of manioc and maize and lived in villages around a large thatched communal house with cotton hammocks. Records begin in 1791, with a possible European encounter as early as 1747; in 1812 one settlement held about five hundred people, half of them warriors.

After harvest the Apiaka launched war expeditions of two or three hundred warriors against neighbours such as the Nambicuara, fighting to avenge old quarrels rather than for plunder, and ceremonially ate captured enemies. A chief marked rank with a feather diadem and a belt strung with human teeth.
zh:
阿皮亚卡人是马托格罗索北部的图皮-瓜拉尼族群，其图皮-瓜拉尼语吸收了“通用语”的成分。据说族名来自图皮语中表示“人”的词，但他们的首领认为族名源自一种黄蜂：它会以剧痛的蜇刺报复攻击。

他们集体耕作园圃，种植木薯、玉米，村落围绕一座茅草公共长屋而建，屋内挂着棉布吊床。现存最早的文字记载始于1791年，而他们与欧洲人相遇可能早至1747年；1812年时，一处村落有约五百人，其中一半是战士。

每次收获之后，阿皮亚卡人会出动两三百名战士，攻打南比夸拉等邻族，征战不为劫掠，而为旧怨复仇，并仪式性地吞食俘虏。酋长以羽毛冠和串着人牙的腰带彰显身份。

en:
The Apma are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the mountainous centre of Pentecost island in Vanuatu, whose speech, also called Abma or Central Raga, stands between the North Vanuatu and Central Vanuatu language groups.

They live in garden villages where taro is the staple and pigs serve as wealth and as ceremonial payment in marriage and compensation. Society is ordered by grade-taking, rank rising through the ritual slaughter of valued pigs, and Pentecost's famous land diving belongs to the same complex: each year men hurl themselves from wooden towers twenty to thirty metres high with vines on their ankles, an offering to secure the yam harvest and mark manhood.

Spanish ships first sighted Pentecost in April 1606, and Louis Antoine de Bougainville reached it on the day of Pentecost in 1768 and gave the island its name.
zh:
阿普玛人是瓦努阿图彭特科斯特岛中部山区的美拉尼西亚人，操大洋洲语；他们的语言又称阿布玛语或中拉加语，介于北瓦努阿图语群与中瓦努阿图语群之间。

他们居住在耕作园圃的村落里，以芋头为主食，猪既是财富，也是婚嫁聘礼和赔偿仪式上的支付手段。社会等级靠“晋阶”维系，即通过仪式性宰杀贵重的猪来提升身份；彭特科斯特岛著名的陆地跳跃便属于同一仪典体系：每年都有男子脚踝缠上藤蔓，从二三十米高的木塔纵身跃下，以此祈求山药丰收并标志成年。

1606年4月，西班牙船只首次望见彭特科斯特岛；1768年布干维尔在圣灵降临节当天抵达并以此为岛命名。

en:
The Tapirapé, who call themselves Apyãwa, are a Tupi-Guarani people of the lower Araguaia river around Bananal Island. Their traditions and language point to descent from the coastal Tupinambá, bands of whom are thought to have fled inland after the European arrival of the 1500s and settled in this forest.

They lived by slash-and-burn horticulture, hunting and fishing: each large loghouse, home to four or five families linked through the mother's line, kept its own garden, while the oval village centred on the takana, a men's house shared by six Bird Societies that organized collective hunts and clearings and danced masked when spirits visited.

Shamans entered tobacco trances to heal and bless the hunt, and an annual gift-giving ceremony, sealed with manioc beer, redistributed wealth between households. Deep in the interior, the Tapirapé had no sustained dealings with colonial society through this period.
zh:
塔皮拉佩人自称阿皮亚瓦，是阿拉瓜亚河下游使用图皮-瓜拉尼语族语言的族群，住在班纳纳尔岛一带。他们的语言和传统表明，其祖先是巴西沿海的图皮南巴人；一般认为，16世纪欧洲人到来后，部分图皮南巴人逃入内陆，在这片林地定居下来。

他们以刀耕火种的园艺、狩猎和捕鱼为生：每座大型长屋住有四五户按母系相联的家庭，各有自己的园地；椭圆形的村庄以男子会所塔卡纳为中心，六个鸟社共用这一会所，负责组织集体狩猎和开荒，并在神灵降临时戴面具起舞。

萨满靠烟草进入出神状态，为人治病、为狩猎祈福；每年的赠礼仪式上人们痛饮木薯酒，借此在各户之间重新分配财物。由于深居内陆，这一时期塔皮拉佩人始终未与殖民社会发生持续往来。

en:
The Aragonese are the people of the middle Ebro and its Pyrenean headwaters, heirs of the county of Jaca, which became a kingdom when Ramiro I received Aragon after Sancho III of Navarre died in 1035. In the Reconquista his successors moved the capital to Huesca in 1096 and to Zaragoza in 1118.

The marriage of Queen Petronilla with the Barcelona count Ramon Berenguer IV in 1150 created the Crown of Aragon, under which Aragonese forces built a Mediterranean empire. The Navarro-Aragonese Romance of the Ebro spread into the reconquered lowlands; Hospitaller grand master Juan Fernández de Heredia translated Greek works into Aragonese.

Ferdinand of Antequera took the throne in 1412, and after the union with Castile in 1479 Castilian displaced Aragonese into the Pyrenean valleys; the Nueva Planta decrees of 1707 abolished the Corts and banned Aragonese in schools.
zh:
阿拉贡人生活在埃布罗河中游及其比利牛斯山源头一带，其前身是哈卡伯爵领。1035年纳瓦拉的桑乔三世去世，拉米罗一世分得阿拉贡，阿拉贡由此成为王国。在收复失地运动中，都城于1096年迁至韦斯卡，1118年再迁至萨拉戈萨。

1150年，女王佩特罗尼利亚与巴塞罗那伯爵拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世联姻，建立阿拉贡联合王国；阿拉贡军力随后缔造了地中海霸业。埃布罗流域的纳瓦拉-阿拉贡罗曼语也随收复的土地向南传播，医院骑士团大团长胡安·费尔南德斯·德·埃雷迪亚曾把多部希腊著作译成阿拉贡语。

1412年，安特克拉的费尔南多登上阿拉贡王位；1479年与卡斯蒂利亚联合后，卡斯蒂利亚语逐渐取代阿拉贡语，后者退入比利牛斯山谷。1707年的《新基本法令》废除了阿拉贡议会，并禁止学校使用阿拉贡语。

en: The Arandai are a Papuan people of the southern shore of the Bird's Head Peninsula along the Berau Gulf, occupying the Aranday, Kamundan and Weriagar districts of Bintuni Regency. Their speech forms a three-member dialect cluster of Kemberano, Dombano and Kokoda, belonging to the South Bird's Head branch of the Trans-New Guinea family.
zh: 阿兰代人是鸟头半岛南岸贝劳湾沿岸的巴布亚族群，居于宾图尼县的阿兰代、卡蒙丹和韦里亚加尔三区。他们的话属跨新几内亚语系南鸟头语支，由肯贝拉诺、东巴诺和科科达三种近亲方言组成一个方言群。

en:
The Arawak of the Guianas, who call themselves Lokono, are the mainland branch of a widely spread language family of the Americas. Arawakan tongues probably formed in the Orinoco valley and spread along the rivers and coasts of northern South America, carrying manioc agriculture, pottery and raised fields.

The Lokono settled the shorelands from the Orinoco delta to the Amazon, while related peoples reached the Caribbean and became the Taíno Columbus met in 1492. Unlike the islanders, they kept Spain at arm's length through the sixteenth century.

In the seventeenth century Dutch and English traders arrived, founding posts such as Essequibo in 1616, and the Lokono built a profitable exchange of cassava, fish and canoes, allying at first with Spain against the Kalina, or Caribs. Their riverside villages joined the colonial Guianas, where Lokono communities kept their language and customs under Dutch and later British rule.
zh:
圭亚那的阿拉瓦克人自称洛科诺人，是美洲一个分布广阔的语系在大陆上的支系。阿拉瓦克诸语言大概形成于奥里诺科河谷，随后沿南美北部的河流与海岸传播，带来了木薯农业、制陶和台田。

洛科诺人定居在奥里诺科三角洲到亚马逊河之间的滨海地带；亲缘的群体则进入加勒比海，成为哥伦布1492年遇到的泰诺人。与岛上的亲属不同，他们在整个16世纪都让西班牙人无法近身。

17世纪荷兰和英国商人到来，建立了1616年的埃塞奎博等商站，洛科诺人以木薯、鱼和独木舟开展有利可图的交换，并一度与西班牙结盟，对抗卡利纳人（即加勒比人）。他们的河畔村落由此融入殖民时代的圭亚那，洛科诺社群在荷兰和英国的统治下保留了自己的语言和习俗。

en:
The Arendaronon, or Arendaenronnon, “people of the lying rock,” were the Rock nation of the Wendat Confederacy in southern Ontario, joining the older Bear and Cord alliance around 1590.

Their chief village was Cahiague, near Lake Simcoe, which grew into the largest settlement in Wendake and may have held as many as four thousand people at the time of French contact. They were sedentary farmers of maize, beans and squash, living in bark-covered longhouses behind timber palisades and trading furs with Algonquian neighbours and the French.

When the Dutch-armed Haudenosaunee overran Wendake in 1648 and 1649, the Arendaronon shared the general ruin: survivors were absorbed into Haudenosaunee communities, fled to the French on the St. Lawrence, or joined the Tionontati in a fusion that produced the Wyandot.
zh:
阿伦达罗农人意为“卧岩之人”，是安大略省南部温达特联盟中的岩族，约在1590年加入此前已结成同盟的熊族与绳族。

他们的主要村寨卡希亚格坐落于锡姆科湖畔，后来发展为温达克最大的定居点，在与法国人接触时人口可能多达四千。他们是定居农耕者，种植玉米、菜豆和南瓜，住在木栅栏内的树皮长屋中，并与邻近的阿尔冈昆人及法国人进行毛皮贸易。

1648—1649年，得到荷兰火器的易洛魁联盟攻陷温达克，阿伦达罗农人随之溃散：幸存者或被并入易洛魁人的社群，或逃往圣劳伦斯河畔的法国人那里，也有人加入提奥农塔特人，融合成怀安多特人。

en:
Armenians are natives of the highlands around Ararat and Van; Tigran the Great's kingdom stretched from the Caucasus to the Levant. Arsacid kings made Armenia the first state to adopt Christianity around 301, and Mesrop Mashtots gave the language an alphabet in 405, opening a golden age of religious and historical writing.

After Arab, Seljuk and Mongol upheavals the Bagratid kingdom revived statehood from 885; its 1045 fall and the 1064 Seljuk advance drove migrants to Cilicia, where Rubenid princes built a new Armenian state about 1080. Crowned a kingdom in 1198, it allied with Crusaders and Mongols, prospered at Ayas and fell to Mamluks in 1375.

The homeland passed to Turkmen confederations, then between Ottoman and Safavid empires, whose Amasya and Zuhab treaties of 1555 and 1639 split it for centuries. Armenians formed an Ottoman millet from 1461; Shah Abbas I resettled merchants at New Julfa in 1604, Armenians trading to India. Russo-Persian war ended with the 1828 Treaty of Turkmenchay, the provinces around Yerevan and Sevan passing from Iran to the Russian Empire.
zh:
亚美尼亚人是阿拉拉特山、凡湖一带高原的原住民，提格兰大帝时版图自高加索延至黎凡特。阿尔沙克王朝约301年使亚美尼亚首立基督教国，405年马什托茨为亚美尼亚语创制字母，开宗教与历史写作黄金时代。

历经阿拉伯、塞尔柱、蒙古冲击，巴格拉提德王朝885年复国；1045年亡国、1064年塞尔柱推进，亚美尼亚人徙奇里乞亚，鲁本家族约1080年建国，1198年加冕为王国，与十字军、蒙古结盟，凭阿亚斯致富，1375年亡于马穆鲁克。

故地归土库曼联盟，后在奥斯曼与萨法波斯间易手，1555年阿马西亚、1639年祖哈布两约分割其地数百年。1461年亚美尼亚人在奥斯曼帝国被单列为米利特，1604年阿拔斯一世迁商人至新朱尔法，商团远及印度。1828年《土库曼恰伊条约》结束俄波战争，埃里温、塞凡周边省份由伊朗并入俄罗斯帝国。

en:
The Aromanians are an Eastern Romance people of the southern Balkans, often called Vlachs in medieval and Ottoman sources. Like Romanian, their language descends from the Vulgar Latin of Romanized Paleo-Balkan peoples and keeps a Romance vocabulary beneath Greek, Slavic and Turkish loans.

They traditionally kept flocks in the mountains of northern Greece and Albania, moving seasonally between highland pastures and markets. Eleventh-century Byzantine writings first place Vlach shepherds in Thessaly; later sources name Great Vlachia near Meteora.

Under the Ottomans they were Orthodox of the Rum millet, and many urban families grew wealthy and Hellenized. Their mountain city of Moscopole, in south-eastern Albania, became an eighteenth-century commercial centre with the Ottoman Balkans' first printing press outside Constantinople, until raids in 1769 and destruction by Ali Pasha of Ioannina in 1788 scattered its people.
zh:
阿罗马尼亚人是巴尔干南部的东罗曼语民族，在中世纪和奥斯曼文献中常被称为弗拉赫人。他们的语言与罗马尼亚语一样，源自古巴尔干罗马化居民的通俗拉丁语，尽管借入希腊语、斯拉夫语和土耳其语词汇，核心词汇仍以罗曼语为主。

他们传统上在希腊北部和阿尔巴尼亚的山区放牧，随季节在高山牧场与集市之间迁徙。11世纪的拜占庭著作首次记载了色萨利的弗拉赫牧人，后来的文献又提到迈泰奥拉附近的“大弗拉希亚”。

奥斯曼统治时期，他们作为东正教徒被归入鲁姆米利特，许多城市家庭在致富的同时被希腊化。阿尔巴尼亚东南部的山城莫斯科普尔在18世纪成为商业中心，拥有君士坦丁堡之外奥斯曼巴尔干的第一家印刷所；但1769年的劫掠和1788年约阿尼纳的阿里帕夏将其摧毁，居民流散。

en: The Arop are the people of four small islands in the Siassi chain, in the Vitiaz Strait between New Guinea's Huon Peninsula and New Britain. They speak Arop-Lokep, an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family, rather than a Papuan language.
zh: 阿罗普人居住在维蒂亚兹海峡西亚西群岛的四座小岛上，海峡位于新几内亚休恩半岛与新不列颠岛之间。他们使用阿罗普-洛凯普语，这是南岛语系的一种大洋洲语言，而非巴布亚语言。

en: The Arosi are a Melanesian people of western Makira, formerly called San Cristobal, the easternmost large island of the Solomon Islands, living chiefly west of the Wango River and speaking Arosi, a Southeast Solomonic language. A Spanish expedition under Álvaro de Mendaña made the first recorded European landfall on the island in 1568 and noted only a handful of Arosi words.
zh: 阿罗西人是美拉尼西亚族群，居住在所罗门群岛最东边的大岛马基拉岛（旧称圣克里斯托瓦尔岛）西部，主要聚居于万戈河以西，操东南所罗门语支的阿罗西语。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙探险队首次有记载地登上该岛，当时只记下了寥寥几个阿罗西语词汇。

en:
Arpitan, traditionally known to philologists as Franco-Provençal, is a Gallo-Romance language standing apart from the langues d'oïl of northern France and the Occitan of the south. It is the speech of the Western Alps: the Lyonnais around Lyon, the Dauphiné along the Rhône, the southern Jura, the Duchy of Savoy about Chambéry, and beyond the mountains the Romand lands of western Switzerland and the Aosta Valley of Italy.

Its deep dialectal fragmentation, into Savoyard, Lyonnais and many other local patois, reflects a history of mountain valleys and divided rule: the French crown held Lyon and the Dauphiné, the House of Savoy built its rising state around Chambéry, and the Swiss confederates governed the Romand cities. The language first appears in manuscripts of the twelfth century.

An edict of 1539, confirmed by the Savoyard parliament in 1540, installed French as the language of law and the courts, and French administration and schooling gradually reduced Arpitan to the domestic speech of isolated villages.
zh:
阿尔皮坦语在语言学界传统上称为法兰克-普罗旺斯语，是一种高卢-罗曼语，既不同于法国北部的奥依语，也不同于南方的奥克语，自成一支。它通行于阿尔卑斯山西段：里昂所在的里昂奈、罗讷河畔的多菲内、汝拉南部、以尚贝里为中心的萨伏依公国，以及山那边的瑞士西部罗曼地区和意大利的奥斯塔山谷。

它的方言极度分化，分为萨伏依话、里昂话等众多乡土话，反映出山谷阻隔、政权分治的历史：法国王室领有里昂和多菲内，萨伏依家族以尚贝里为中心经营崛起的国家，瑞士邦联统治着罗曼诸城。该语言最早见于12世纪的手抄本。

1539年的一项敕令——1540年经萨伏依议会确认——把法语确立为法律和法庭用语，此后随着法国行政和学校教育的扩张，阿尔皮坦语逐渐萎缩为偏僻村庄里的家用语言。

en:
The Aru are indigenous islanders of the Aru archipelago in southeast Maluku, some ninety-five low-lying islands in the Arafura Sea south of New Guinea, of mixed Austronesian and Papuan descent. Their egalitarian society grouped lineage clans into two ritual alliances, Ursia and Urlima, and they were long tied to Banda trade networks.

Islam took root in the west in the mid-seventeenth century. Portuguese and Spanish navigators sighted Aru from the 1520s, and in 1623 the Dutch East India Company contracted west-coast villages into trade in pearls, birds of paradise and slaves; a Dutch fort rose on Wokam in 1659.

Resentment of VOC monopolies fed the Maluku rebellion of Tidore prince Nuku: in 1787 Ujir's Muslims killed the Dutch garrison and made Nuku's brother Jou Mangofa their king, until Banda troops crushed the rising in 1791. Dutch influence returned only in 1824.
zh:
阿鲁人是马鲁古东南部阿鲁群岛的原住民。群岛由约95个低平岛屿组成，横亘在新几内亚以南的阿拉弗拉海上，居民兼有南岛与巴布亚血统。他们的社会崇尚平等，血缘氏族分属乌尔西亚和乌利马两个仪式联盟；群岛很早就与班达贸易网相连。

17世纪中叶，伊斯兰教在群岛西部扎根。葡萄牙和西班牙航海家在16世纪20年代先后望见阿鲁群岛；1623年荷兰东印度公司与西海岸村庄签约，把群岛拖入珍珠、极乐鸟和奴隶的贸易，并于1659年在沃坎修筑小堡。

对公司垄断的不满汇入蒂多雷王子努库的马鲁古起义：1787年乌吉尔岛的穆斯林消灭荷兰驻军，拥立努库之弟乔·曼戈法为王，起义直到1791年才被班达军队镇压。荷兰的影响到1824年才重新确立。

en: The Aruá are a Tupian-speaking Indigenous people of the southern Amazon in Brazil, established along the Guaporé River in southern Rondônia, where they hold the Rio Branco and Rio Guaporé indigenous lands. Their speech forms its own language within the Mondé branch of the Tupian family.
zh: 阿鲁阿人是巴西南部亚马孙地区操图皮语的原住民，定居在隆多尼亚州南部瓜波雷河一带，领有里奥布兰科和里奥瓜波雷原住民地。他们的语言在图皮语系的蒙代语支中自成一支。

en: The Aruamu, also known as the Mikarew, are a Papuan people of the lower Ramu River in Madang Province, centred on Mikarew village in the Yawar area. Their language belongs to the Ramu family, a group of some thirty closely related languages spread across the Sepik-Ramu basin of northern Papua New Guinea.
zh: 阿鲁阿穆人又称米卡鲁人，是马当省拉穆河下游的巴布亚族群，以亚瓦尔地区的米卡鲁村为中心。他们的语言属拉穆语族；该语族包含约三十种亲属语言，分布在巴布亚新几内亚北部的塞皮克-拉穆盆地。

en:
The Ashalaho, also known as the Mountain Crow, were the largest of the four historic bands of the Crow, who call themselves Apsáalooke. Their name means 'Many Lodges'.

Tradition holds that they split from the Awatixa Hidatsa and were the first Crow group to travel west: their leader No Intestines followed a vision and led his band on a long migration in search of sacred tobacco before settling on the upper Yellowstone River.

They lived in the Rocky Mountain foothills along the Wyoming-Montana border, around the Big Horn and Absaroka ranges. Like the other Crow bands they had left the Hidatsa earth-lodge villages on the Upper Missouri in the late seventeenth century, became mounted bison hunters after horses reached the northern Plains around 1730, and through the eighteenth century dominated the Yellowstone valley while resisting the Lakota and Cheyenne.
zh:
阿沙拉霍人又称山地克劳人，是克劳人（自称阿普萨卢克）四个历史群体中最大的一支。其名意为‘多屋之人’。

相传他们从希达察人的阿瓦蒂克萨分支分出，是最早西迁的克劳群体：首领‘无肠’受异象指引，率部长途迁徙寻找圣烟草，最终定居黄石河上游。

他们活动于怀俄明与蒙大拿交界的落基山山麓，以大角山和阿布萨罗卡岭为中心。与其他克劳群体一样，他们在17世纪末离开密苏里河上游的希达察土屋村落，约1730年马匹传入北部平原后转为骑马猎牛，18世纪间称雄黄石河流域，并抵御拉科塔人和夏延人的进逼。

en:
The Ashenika are an Arawak-speaking people of Peru's central jungle, close kin of the Asháninka with whom they share the Selva Central. Their communities lie mainly in the Ucayali and Pasco departments, including the Gran Pajonal plateau. Their language, Ashéninka, belongs to the Campa branch of the Arawak family and forms one end of the Ashéninka-Asháninka dialect continuum.

Before the colonial period they kept trade networks with the peoples of the highlands. Franciscan friars first entered their territory in 1635, baptising villagers and introducing iron tools, but missionary interference and epidemics provoked repeated revolts.

The great uprising led by Juan Santos Atahualpa in 1742 drove the friars from the Gran Pajonal and restored the Ashenika's control over their own lands for generations.
zh:
阿舍尼卡人是秘鲁中部雨林的阿拉瓦克语族群，与阿沙宁卡人关系密切，同在中央雨林区活动，社区主要分布在乌卡亚利和帕斯科大区，包括格兰帕霍纳尔高原。他们的阿舍尼卡语属阿拉瓦克语系坎帕语支，与阿沙宁卡语构成一条方言连续体。

殖民时代之前，他们已与山区民族保持贸易网络。1635年，方济各会修士首次进入其地界，为村民施洗并传入铁器；但传教士的干预和疫病引发了反复起义。

1742年胡安·桑托斯·阿塔瓦尔帕领导的大起义将修士逐出格兰帕霍纳尔，使阿舍尼卡人在以后好几代人里重新掌握了自己的土地。

en:
The Ashkenazim are the Jewish diaspora community that took shape in medieval Germany and northern France; rabbis of the time applied the biblical name Ashkenaz to Germany, and the name later covered the Jews of both lands. From the tenth century their communities consolidated in Rhineland cities and Troyes, where the commentator Rashi laid the foundations of Ashkenazi religious learning in the eleventh century.

The First Crusade brought the Rhineland massacres of 1096, and later crusader and Black Death pogroms drove a steady eastward migration, encouraged by Poland's Casimir III. By the sixteenth century most Ashkenazim lived in the Kingdom of Poland and its eastern neighbours.

Their vernacular was Yiddish, a Middle High German tongue written in Hebrew letters. In the eighteenth century Hasidism arose among them in Poland-Lithuania while the Haskalah, or Jewish Enlightenment, spread from Germany, after which emancipation and nineteenth-century pogroms drove many westward and overseas.
zh:
阿什肯纳兹犹太人是在中世纪德意志和法兰西北部形成的流散犹太社群：当时的拉比把《圣经》中的亚述基纳兹一名用于德意志，后来此名兼指两地犹太人。10世纪起，他们的社群在莱茵兰城市和特鲁瓦定型，11世纪释经家拉什在特鲁瓦奠定了阿什肯纳兹经学的基础。

第一次十字军东征引发1096年的莱茵兰屠杀，此后十字军时期和黑死病期间的历次屠犹迫使他们持续东迁，波兰国王卡齐米日三世的招揽更推动了这一潮流。到16世纪，多数阿什肯纳兹犹太人已住在波兰王国及其东邻诸国。

他们的日常语言是意第绪语，即一种用希伯来字母拼写的中古高地德语。18世纪，哈西德派在波兰立陶宛兴起，而哈斯卡拉（犹太启蒙运动）从德意志传播开来；此后的解放浪潮和19世纪屠犹又促使许多犹太人西迁远渡重洋。

en:
The Ashshipite, 'the Black Lodges', are better known as the River Crow, self-styled Binnéessiippeele, 'those who live amongst the river banks'. They were one of four historic bands of the Crow, or Apsáalooke, a Siouan-speaking Plains people related to the Hidatsa.

Tradition holds that they split from the Hidatsa proper after a quarrel over a bison stomach, which earned the Crow nation the Hidatsa nickname 'those who pout over tripe'.

Leaving the Hidatsa earth-lodge villages of the Upper Missouri in the late seventeenth century, they settled along the Yellowstone and Musselshell rivers and the Big Horn and Powder valleys, later called the Powder River Country. After horses reached the northern Plains around 1730 they became mounted bison hunters, and through the eighteenth century they shared in Crow dominance of the Yellowstone country while warring against the westward Lakota and Cheyenne.
zh:
阿什希皮特人意为‘黑屋之人’，更通行的称呼是河畔克劳人，自称宾内西佩莱，意为‘居于河岸者’。他们是克劳人（自称阿普萨卢克）四个历史群体之一，与希达察人同源。

相传他们因一具野牛肚的争执与希达察本部分道扬镳，希达察人因此把全体克劳人戏称为‘为牛肚怄气的人’。

17世纪末，他们离开密苏里河上游希达察人的土屋村落，沿黄石河、马瑟尔谢尔河以及大角河、粉河河谷而居，这一带后来被称为粉河地区。约1730年马匹传入北部平原后，他们转为骑马猎牛；整个18世纪，他们与其他克劳群体一同称雄黄石河流域，并不断与西迁的拉科塔人和夏延人交战。

en:
Asinikawithini, the Asinikaw Īthiniwak or Rocky Cree, are a Cree people of the boreal forest east and west of the lower Nelson River, in northern Manitoba and Saskatchewan. Their name means people of the rocky land, and they once spoke a distinctive r-dialect of Cree before shifting toward the Woodland Cree th-dialect.

They lived by hunting caribou and moose, fishing, and snaring snowshoe hares, moving between birch-bark wigwams in the southern woods and caribou-hide lodges farther north.

After the Hudson's Bay Company opened posts on the bay from 1670 onward, the Rocky Cree became middlemen between the coastal traders and inland nations, and trade guns let them push west and north alongside other Cree groups during the eighteenth century. Their bands are the forerunners of later Cree nations centered on Nelson House and Lac La Ronge.
zh:
阿西尼卡维西尼人自称 Asinikaw Īthiniwak，又称岩石克里人，是居住在纳尔逊河下游东西两侧北方森林中的克里人支系，地处马尼托巴北部和萨斯喀彻温。他们的名字意为“岩石之地的人”，原本使用克里语中独特的 r 方言，后来逐渐改用林地克里人的 th 方言。

他们以猎捕驯鹿和驼鹿、捕鱼、套捕白靴兔为生，南部林地住桦皮棚屋，更北的地方则住驯鹿皮锥形帐篷。

1670年哈德逊湾公司在哈得逊湾设立商站后，岩石克里人成为海湾商人和内陆部族之间的中间人，并借贸易获得火枪，在18世纪与其他克里人支系一起向西、向北扩张。他们的各个群体，是后来以纳尔逊豪斯、拉龙日湖为中心的诸克里族的前身。

en:
The Asmat are a cluster of related peoples on the mangrove and tidal-swamp coast of southwestern New Guinea, along the Arafura Sea in South Papua, Indonesia. Its twelve or so sub-groups share Asmat-family languages of the Trans–New Guinea phylum and a warrior culture.

They live on sago starch, fish, crustaceans and forest game, building stilted houses over flooded ground and tall tree houses inland; ancestor veneration lies at the heart of their life: carved bisj poles honour the dead, while headhunting raids and boys' initiation rituals bound villages in cycles of revenge.

Outside contact came late. In 1770 Captain James Cook's Endeavour met Asmat warriors on the shore and withdrew, and in 1826 Dutch explorer Kolff likewise retreated from a hostile reception; though the Dutch had claimed western New Guinea in 1793, they did not penetrate the Asmat region until the early twentieth century.
zh:
阿斯马特人是新几内亚岛西南岸、阿拉弗拉海沿岸红树林与潮汐沼泽地带的一组相近族群，地处印度尼西亚南巴布亚省。阿斯马特是约十二个支系的统称，各支系说泛新几内亚语系下彼此相近的阿斯马特语族语言，并共享战士文化。

他们以西谷椰淀粉、鱼、甲壳类和林猎为食，在易涝的土地上建造高脚屋，内陆则搭建高耸的树屋。祖先崇拜是其生活的核心：雕刻的比斯柱用以敬奉死者，猎首袭击和男子成丁仪式使村落处在复仇循环之中。

外界接触来得很晚：1770年詹姆斯·库克船长的奋进号在岸边遇到一队阿斯马特战士后撤离，1826年荷兰探险者科尔夫也在敌意的迎接下退走；荷兰人虽于1793年宣称占有新几内亚西部，直到20世纪初才真正深入阿斯马特地区。

en:
The Astrakhani are the Tatar Muslims of the lower Volga, of the Volga delta on the Caspian Sea. Their country was the Golden Horde's heartland, whose capital Sarai stood nearby, and after the Horde's collapse they became the population of its rump state, the Khanate of Astrakhan, founded in the 1460s by Mahmud bin Küchük, a descendant of Jochi, Genghis Khan's grandson.

Ruled from Xacitarxan, it lived on transit trade between Muscovy, Kazan, Crimea and Central Asia and on the Volga's busiest slave market. Crimea briefly occupied Astrakhan in 1523 and again in 1549.

After the fall of Kazan, Russian armies descended the Volga: Khan Yamghurchi fled in 1554, and in 1556 tsarist troops occupied Astrakhan and destroyed its slave market. The town was rebuilt twelve kilometres downstream in 1558; an Ottoman attempt to retake it failed in 1569. From the seventeenth century the Astrakhani mingled with Volga Tatars and neighbouring Nogai herders.
zh:
阿斯特拉罕人是伏尔加河下游的鞑靼穆斯林，住在里海之滨的伏尔加河三角洲地带。这里曾是金帐汗国的心脏地带，都城撒莱就在附近；金帐汗国崩溃后，他们成为其残余政权阿斯特拉罕汗国的臣民，汗国由成吉思汗之孙术赤的后裔马哈茂德·本·库楚克于15世纪60年代建立。

汗国以哈只塔儿罕为都，靠莫斯科、喀山、克里米亚与中亚之间的转口贸易，以及伏尔加河上最繁忙的奴隶市场为生。克里米亚曾于1523年和1549年两度短暂占领阿斯特拉罕。

喀山陷落后，俄军沿伏尔加河而下：汗王雅姆古尔赤于1554年出逃，1556年沙皇军队占领阿斯特拉罕并摧毁奴隶市场。1558年城市向下游迁移12公里重建；1569年奥斯曼人试图夺回该城，未能成功。17世纪起，阿斯特拉罕人越来越多地与伏尔加鞑靼人和邻近的诺盖游牧民相互融合。

en:
The Atacame were a coastal people of the rainy Pacific lowlands of Esmeraldas Province in Ecuador, whose chief settlement of Atacames, on the river of the same name, was the largest town of the shore when Bartolomé Ruiz reconnoitred it in 1526.

They shared their culture and isolated Atacame tongue, also called Esmeraldeño, with neighbouring Esmeraldas groups. Unlike the highland peoples they were never subdued by the Incas and met the Spaniards as independent villagers. Francisco Pizarro passed along their coast in 1531, and in 1560 Juan de Olmos founded the Spanish town of Atacames there; a first chapel followed in 1577, and an epidemic of 1589 emptied many villages.

Colonial rule brought sharp depopulation: by 1740 the town held only about twenty-four families, while the Atacame language steadily gave way to Spanish.
zh:
阿塔卡梅人是太平洋沿岸多雨低地的居民，地在厄瓜多尔埃斯梅拉达斯省；其主要聚落阿塔卡梅斯坐落于同名河畔，1526年巴托洛梅·鲁伊斯勘察时，它是这一带海岸最大的村镇。

他们与邻近的埃斯梅拉尔达人同文同种，使用孤立的阿塔卡梅语（又称埃斯梅拉尔达语）。与高原各族不同，他们从未被印加征服，西班牙人初到时仍是独立村民。1531年弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗经过这段海岸，1560年胡安·德·奥尔莫斯在土著原址建立西班牙式城镇阿塔卡梅斯，1577年建起第一座小教堂，1589年的一场疫病使许多村落荒废。

殖民时代人口锐减，到1740年全镇只剩约二十四户，阿塔卡梅语也不断让位于西班牙语。

en:
The Ishak, or Atakapa, are an Indigenous people of the Gulf coast of Louisiana and Texas, speaking a language isolate. Ishak means the people in their own tongue, while Atakapa is a Choctaw or Mobilian label meaning eater of human flesh. Their bands ranged from Texas's Trinity to Louisiana's Vermilion, wintering inland and moving to the coast in summer.

They fished from canoes, speared flounder by torchlight and hunted alligator and deer. Narváez expedition survivors, including Cabeza de Vaca, washed up among them in 1528. La Salle's 1685 colony drew Spanish and French expeditions there.

In 1760 French buyers acquired the Vermilion lands, whose band the Opelousa soon broke; in 1771 female leader Quitachoulabenak headed about 500 near Lafayette. After the 1803 Louisiana Purchase, epidemics and land loss thinned them, and in 1805 Indian agent John Sibley counted only about fifty fighting men among the Louisiana bands.
zh:
伊沙克人外界多称阿塔卡帕人，是路易斯安那和得克萨斯墨西哥湾沿岸的原住民，所说的阿塔卡帕语是一门孤立语。“伊沙克”在本族语中意为“人民”；“阿塔卡帕”是乔克托语或莫比尔行话对他们的称呼，意为“食人肉者”。支派分布于得克萨斯特里尼蒂河至路易斯安那弗米利恩河之间的流域，冬天在内地栖身，夏天迁往海岸。

他们乘独木舟捕鱼，举火把叉捕比目鱼，猎捕短吻鳄和鹿。1528年纳瓦埃斯远征队幸存者（包括卡韦萨·德·巴卡）漂流至此。1685年拉萨尔的法国殖民地把法西探险队引到这里。

1760年法国人买下弗米利恩一带土地，该支派旋被奥佩卢萨人击散；1771年，女首领基塔丘拉贝纳克在拉斐特附近统众约五百人。1803年路易斯安那购地后，疫病与失地使村落凋敝，1805年印第安事务官约翰·西布利统计，路易斯安那各支派战士仅剩约五十人。

en:
The Ataronchronon, whose name means “people of the bog,” were the fifth group of the Wendat Confederacy of southern Ontario, in the marshy country on Georgian Bay's southeastern fringe. French observers were unsure whether they held full nation status; they may have been only a division of the dominant Attignawantan, or Bear nation.

They shared the settled Iroquoian life of other Wendat: palisaded towns of bark longhouses, matrilineal clans, and fields of maize, beans and squash worked by women.

When Dutch-armed Haudenosaunee destroyed Wendake in the Beaver Wars of 1648 and 1649, the Ataronchronon dispersed with the Bear people, survivors joining Haudenosaunee communities, the French-protected Wendat settlement near Quebec, or the Wyandot around the Tionontati.
zh:
阿塔龙克罗农人的名字意为“沼泽之人”，是安大略省南部温达特联盟所辖的第五个群体，居住在乔治亚湾东南边缘的沼泽地带。法国观察者不确定他们是否拥有完整民族地位，认为他们可能只是势力最大的阿蒂格纳万坦（熊族）的分支。

他们和其他温达特人一样过着易洛魁式的定居生活：住在树皮长屋组成的栅栏城镇中，行母系氏族制，由妇女耕作玉米、菜豆和南瓜。

1648年至1649年海狸战争中，得到荷兰火器的易洛魁联盟摧毁温达克，阿塔龙克罗农人与熊族一同离散，幸存者或并入易洛魁社群，或加入魁北克附近受法国保护的温达特定居点，或随提奥农塔特人融入怀安多特人。

en:
The Atavillos, also written Atauillo, were a highland people of the Lima region whose territory covered the Canta and Huaral provinces, with communities also on the Bombon plateau near Cerro de Pasco and around Jauja.

They were one of many chiefdoms of the central Andes overrun by Inca general Capac Yupanqui during Pachacutec's northern campaigns, and their land entered the empire as the Chinchaysuyu province of Atawillu.

Francisco Pizarro's men entered their valleys in 1533 and 1534, and the people were later grouped into the reduction of San Agustin, whose lands Viceroy Toledo formally recognized in 1570. Pizarro himself was sometimes styled the Marquis of the Atavillos, though the crown never granted that title.
zh:
阿塔维约斯人又拼作阿陶约，是利马大区的高原族群，领地相当于坎塔省和瓦拉尔省一带，在帕斯科山附近的邦邦高原和豪哈周边也有他们的聚落。

他们是安第斯中部众多酋长国之一，在印加君主帕查库特克的北方征战中被印加将领卡帕克·尤潘基的大军席卷，故土作为阿塔维尤省并入印加帝国的钦查苏尤。

1533和1534年，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗的部下先后进入他们的山谷，后来他们被编入圣阿古斯丁归化村，其土地于1570年得到托莱多总督的正式承认。皮萨罗本人曾被戏称为“阿塔维约斯人的侯爵”，不过王室从未授予过这一头衔。

en:
The Atchakangouen, also called the Greater Miami or Crane Band after their leading clan, were the largest band of the Miami, an Algonquian-speaking Great Lakes people. Their principal village was Kekionga, at the meeting of the Saint Joseph, Saint Marys and Maumee on the site of Fort Wayne, Indiana; it was the Miami confederacy's capital, and the French built a post and fort there in 1704.

Displaced west to Wisconsin during the Beaver Wars, the band retook its Indiana and Ohio homelands around the turn of the eighteenth century with French firearms.

War chief Little Turtle belonged to this division and led the Western Confederacy to St. Clair's Defeat in 1791, then made peace after Fallen Timbers and the Treaty of Greenville in 1794 and 1795. By the early nineteenth century the name Miami had come to mean the Atchakangouen above all, as American settlement and debt-driven treaties stripped its lands around Kekionga.
zh:
阿查坎古恩人以其首领氏族得名鹤部，也称大迈阿密，是五大湖阿尔冈昆语民族迈阿密最大的一支。主村基基翁加在印第安纳州韦恩堡的圣约瑟夫河、圣玛丽斯河与莫米河交汇处，是迈阿密联盟的首府；法国人于1704年在此设立商馆和要塞。

海狸战争期间他们西逃至威斯康星，18世纪初靠法国火器夺回印第安纳与俄亥俄故土。

军事首领小海龟就出自这一分支，他率西部联盟在1791年取得圣克莱尔惨败之战，又在1794年福伦廷伯斯战役失利、1795年签订《格林维尔条约》后接受和平。到19世纪初，迈阿密一名已主要用来指阿查坎古恩人，而美国定居者进逼和债务条约逐渐剥夺了该分支在基基翁加周围的土地。

en:
The Atikamekw, self-styled Nehirowisiw, meaning people in balance with nature, are Algonquian speakers of the boreal forest north of the Saint Lawrence River. Their homeland Nitaskinan, our land, is the upper Saint-Maurice valley in Quebec, where they gathered in summer at places such as Wemotaci and dispersed into winter camps in bark lodges called piskokan.

They hunted, fished and trapped; women raised corn and boiled maple sap into syrup. French documents first name them in the early seventeenth century as the Atikamegouékhi, five or six hundred strong; they soon traded furs for French metal goods. Peaceful, they shared the country with the Innu, Cree and Algonquin, but beaver-trade rivalry drew them into war with the Mohawk.

Smallpox around 1670 to 1680 devastated them; Mohawk raids killed many survivors; early in the eighteenth century a people called Tête-de-Boule by the French reappeared there, likely Atikamekw remnants regrouped with nomadic families.
zh:
阿提卡梅克人自称“内希罗维西乌”，意为与自然保持平衡的人，是圣劳伦斯河以北的北方针叶林中操阿尔冈昆语的族群。家园“尼塔斯基南”意为“我们的土地”，在魁北克的圣莫里斯河上游谷地；群队夏天在韦莫塔西等地聚会，冬天分散为小营地，住在名为“皮斯科坎”的树皮棚屋里。

他们打猎、捕鱼、设陷阱，妇女种植玉米，把枫树汁熬成糖浆。法国文献17世纪初首次称他们为“阿提卡梅古埃基”，时有五六百人，很快以毛皮交换法国金属器具。他们性情平和，与伊努人、克里人和阿尔冈金人共享这片土地，但海狸贸易的争夺把他们拖入与莫霍克人的战争。

约1670至1680年的天花重创其群队，莫霍克人的袭击又杀死许多幸存者；18世纪初，一支法人称为“圆头人”的族群重现于此，很可能是阿提卡梅克残余与游猎家族重新组合。

en:
The Atikum, also called Huamuê or Uamué, are an Indigenous people of the Serra do Umã in the Pernambuco sertão, near Carnaubeira da Penha, known to colonial records as the Umãs.

Documents of 1801 show the Umãs settled with other tribes in an official aldeia in these hills; they remained until 1819, when repeated conflicts drove them out, and in 1825 dispersed across the backlands, some taking refuge in the Serra Negra.
