The Romblomanon people are the Visayan-speaking indigenous inhabitants of the Romblon island group, lying between Luzon and Panay. Their Romblomanon language, close to Hiligaynon, prevails on Romblon and Sibuyan islands, and most also speak Hiligaynon through trade with nearby Capiz and Aklan.

The islands were first settled by Negritos from Panay and Mangyans from Mindoro, and ancient wooden coffins kept in the caves of Banton attest to a developed pre-colonial culture. Spanish explorers reached Romblon in 1569, and the islands were governed from Arevalo in Panay until 1716, when they passed to the province of Capiz. Under Spanish friars the islanders became mostly Roman Catholic.
zh:
朗布隆人是朗布隆群岛上说米沙鄢语的原住民，该群岛位于吕宋与班乃之间。朗布隆语与希利盖农语相近，通行于朗布隆岛和锡布延岛；因与邻近的卡皮斯和阿克兰贸易，多数人也会说希利盖农语。

这些岛屿最早的居民是来自班乃的尼格利陀人和来自民都洛的芒扬人，班顿岛洞穴中保存的古代木棺证明这里在殖民时代之前已有发达的文化。西班牙探险者于1569年抵达朗布隆，群岛先由班乃的阿雷瓦洛管辖，1716年改归卡皮斯省。在西班牙修道士影响下，岛民大多皈依罗马天主教。

en: The Roon are an Austronesian-speaking people of Roon Island, the largest island off the northern tip of the Wandammen Peninsula, which reaches into southern Cenderawasih Bay from the Bird's Neck of New Guinea. They live in six villages on the island and speak Roon, a Cenderawasih Bay Austronesian language known only from short word lists.
zh: 隆人是南岛语族岛民，聚居隆岛——该岛是万达门半岛北端外岛群中最大的一座，半岛从新几内亚的鸟颈地峡伸入极乐鸟湾南部。他们分居岛上六村，使用的隆语属南岛语系极乐鸟湾语支，仅有简短词表传世。

en:
The Rotenese are the Austronesian people of Rote Island, a dry savanna island southwest of Timor, with communities also on neighbouring Ndao and in West Timor. Their traditions trace them to migrants from Seram in Maluku who reached Rote between the late 1200s and the 1500s, in the Majapahit era, when the first Rotenese rulers are mentioned. They also settled on Timor, farming with slash-and-burn fields and irrigation.

Rotenese is a Southwest Malayo-Polynesian language with many dialects. Their old faith centred on the creator Lamatuan, symbolised by a three-branched pillar, and the horned ti'i langga straw hat remains the mark of Rotenese identity.
zh:
罗地人是罗地岛上的南岛语族群；罗地岛位于帝汶西南，气候干燥、遍布热带草原，邻近的恩道和西帝汶也有罗地人聚居。他们自称源自马鲁古的斯兰岛，于13世纪末至16世纪的满者伯夷时代迁来，罗地统治者的最早记载也出现在这一时期。他们还在帝汶定居，以刀耕火种和灌溉农业为生。

罗地语属西南马来—波利尼西亚语支，分为多种方言。传统信仰以创世神拉马图安为中心，以三杈神柱为象征；顶部带角状凸起的蒂伊朗加草帽，是罗地人身份的标志。

en: The Rotokas are the people of central Bougainville Island in eastern Papua New Guinea, speaking a North Bougainville Papuan language split into Central, Aita and Pipipaia dialects. Its Central dialect has one of the world's smallest sound systems, with only six consonants and no distinct nasals.
zh: 罗托卡斯人居住在巴布亚新几内亚东部布干维尔岛的中部，使用属北布干维尔语族的巴布亚语言罗托卡斯语，下分中部、艾塔和皮皮帕亚方言。其中中部方言拥有世界上最小的音系之一，只有六个辅音，没有独立的鼻音。

en:
The Roviana are an Oceanic people of the New Georgia group in the Solomon Islands, dwelling around the Roviana and Vonavona lagoons. Their Northwest Solomonic language was a widespread trade tongue and later the lingua franca of church work across the western Solomons. Central New Georgia was the cradle of Roviana culture, where a complex of megalithic shrines was built from the thirteenth century.

Between the fifteenth and seventeenth centuries the people moved to offshore islands centred on Nusa Roviana, which grew into a regional seat of power through trade and headhunting raids launched in large war canoes.

From the sixteenth century speakers of neighbouring Kazukuru merged into the Roviana and adopted their speech. In 1789 John Shortland, commanding First Fleet vessels, named the main island New Georgia.
zh:
罗维阿纳人是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛上说大洋洲语的族群，散居在罗维阿纳潟湖与沃纳沃纳潟湖一带。他们的语言属西北所罗门语支，曾是广泛通行的贸易语言，后来又成为所罗门群岛西部教会活动的通用语。新乔治亚岛中部是罗维阿纳文化的摇篮，13世纪起当地兴建了巨石神坛建筑群。

15至17世纪间，罗维阿纳人迁往以努萨罗维阿纳为中心的近海岛礁，凭借贸易和乘坐大战独木舟发动的猎头远征，使那里成为区域权力中心。

从16世纪起，邻近卡祖库鲁语的使用者逐渐并入罗维阿纳人，改用了他们的语言。1789年，约翰·肖特兰率领第一舰队的船只经过此地，将主岛命名为新乔治亚岛。

en:
The Rukwa are Bantu communities of southwestern Tanzania and northern Malawi whose related languages make up Guthrie's Zone M, among them Fipa, Nyakyusa, Safwa, Wanda, Pimbwe and Bungu. On the Ufipa Plateau overlooking Lake Tanganyika, the Fipa built a stratified society of iron-smelting clans: the Milansi dynasty of smiths exchanged iron for cloth before an immigrant Twa clan became the ruling aristocracy.

By the early nineteenth century the chiefdom of Nkansi had a court with a prime minister, a queen mother holding her own estate and elected village headmen. At Ivuna, southeast of Lake Rukwa, Iron Age pottery marks salt workings that traded their produce from before 1200 into the fifteenth century.

East of the plateau, in the wet mountains at the northern end of Lake Malawi, lived the Nyakyusa. Their dialects spread across the border into the Karonga district of Malawi.
zh:
鲁夸人是坦桑尼亚西南部和马拉维北部一批班图社群的统称，他们关系相近的语言构成格思里分区的M区，主要有菲帕语、尼亚库萨语、萨夫瓦语、旺达语、平布韦语和本古语。在俯瞰坦噶尼喀湖的乌菲帕高原，菲帕人建立了冶铁氏族组成的等级社会：米兰齐铁匠王朝用铁器交换织布，后来迁入的特瓦氏族成为统治贵族。

到19世纪初，坎西酋长国的宫廷设有首相、拥有独立地产的王太后和民选村长。鲁夸湖东南的伊武纳出土了铁器时代陶器，那里的盐场从1200年以前一直生产到15世纪。

高原以东、马拉维湖北端湿润的山区住着尼亚库萨人。他们的方言越过边界，传到马拉维的卡龙加县。

en: The Rumu, also recorded as Kairi or Dumu, are a people of the forested river country between the Turama and Kikori rivers in the Gulf Province of southern New Guinea. Their speech is a strongly divergent member of the Turama–Kikorian family of Papuan languages, set apart from the Omati and Ikobi tongues of its neighbours.
zh: 卢穆人又被记作凯里人或杜穆人，住在新几内亚南部海湾省图拉马河与基科里河之间森林密布的河川地带。他们的卢穆语是图拉马-基科里语族中分歧极大的成员，与邻近的奥马蒂语和伊科比语明显有别。

en:
The Runga are a Muslim people of the borderlands where Chad, Sudan and the Central African Republic meet, between the Salamat, Aouk and Kara rivers. They form a composite society split by tongue into Arabic-speaking Runga and the Runga-Aiki who speak Aiki, usually with Arabic as a second language, yet share a single culture.

Their country was organized as the Sultanate of Dar Runga, which by the reign of the Wadai ruler Muhammad Sabun, between 1804 and 1815, had become a Wadai tributary; it also served Darfur as a hunting ground for slaves. The Runga homeland remained a prize of the Wadai-Darfur rivalry until the warlord Rabih az-Zubayr overran it at the end of the nineteenth century.
zh:
龙加人是生活在乍得、苏丹与中非共和国交界地带的穆斯林族群，分布在萨拉马特河、奥克河与卡拉河之间。他们按语言分为讲阿拉伯语的龙加人和讲艾基语的龙加—艾基人，后者通常兼通阿拉伯语，两部分共有同一种文化。

他们的家园曾组成达尔龙加苏丹国；在瓦达伊君主穆罕默德·萨本在位的1804至1815年间，它沦为瓦达伊的附庸国，同时也是达尔富尔的猎奴之地。此后瓦达伊与达尔富尔争夺龙加人的家园，直到19世纪末被军阀拉巴赫·祖拜尔攻灭。

en:
The Rusyns are the East Slavic highlanders of the Eastern Carpathians, around Uzhhorod and Mukachevo, which in 1337 belonged to the Kingdom of Hungary. They grew from waves of Slavic settlers between the eighth and seventeenth centuries, including White Croats and Rus' migrants joined by Vlach shepherds. Their highland groups included the Boykos, Hutsuls and Lemkos.

In 1241 Batu Khan's Mongol army swept through the Veretski Pass, burning villages and emptying the valleys. In 1396 the exiled Lithuanian prince Theodor Koriatovich made Mukachevo his seat, built up its castle and founded an Orthodox monastery, drawing Ruthenian migrants from Podolia.

Under Hungarian rule much of the population later entered the Greek Catholic Church while keeping its Eastern rite and Rusyn speech. By the Partitions of Poland in 1772 the Carpathian lands were under the Habsburg monarchy.
zh:
卢森尼亚人是东喀尔巴阡山的东斯拉夫山民，聚居在乌日霍罗德和穆卡切沃一带，1337年时属匈牙利王国。他们来自8世纪至17世纪间数批斯拉夫移民，包括白克罗地亚人、罗斯人，以及瓦拉几亚牧人，分成博伊科人、胡楚尔人、莱姆科人等山地支系。

1241年拔都的蒙古军经韦列茨基山口涌入，焚毁村庄、使山谷人口一空。1396年，流亡的立陶宛王公费奥多尔·科里亚托维奇以穆卡切沃为据点，修筑城堡、建立东正教修道院，引来波多利亚的鲁塞尼亚人迁入。

匈牙利统治时期，许多居民后来加入希腊礼天主教会，同时保留东方礼仪和卢森尼亚语。1772年波兰瓜分时，喀尔巴阡诸地已处在哈布斯堡君主国治下。

en:
The Rutara peoples, who call themselves the Banyakitara, are a cluster of related Bantu communities of the African Great Lakes region, with mutually intelligible dialects; they include the Banyoro, Batooro and others. Their Proto-Rutara ancestors kept cattle in the Kagera grasslands near Bukoba from about 500, learning pastoralism from Cushitic neighbors.

After 1200 a northern branch expanded into the grasslands of western Uganda, absorbing older Central Sudanic populations and opening the era remembered in oral tradition as the age of the Batembuzi and Bachwezi; the great earthworks at Bigo bya Mugenyi and the salt gardens of Kibiro belong to this early Kitara world.

From it arose the Kingdom of Bunyoro, where the Babiito dynasty took power in the late sixteenth century and led the western lakes for two centuries. Its dominance faded in the late eighteenth century, when Buganda seized Kooki, and in the 1830s Tooro broke away, taking the salt works with it.
zh:
鲁塔拉人自称巴尼亚基塔拉，是非洲大湖地区一群关系密切的班图族群的统称，包括巴尼奥罗人、巴托罗人等，各方言彼此可以互通。他们的原始鲁塔拉先民约在公元500年起在布科巴附近的卡盖拉草原牧牛，从邻近的库希特人那里学会游牧生计。

1200年以后，北支扩张进入乌干达西部草原，同化了当地更古老的中苏丹人，开启了口传传统中巴特姆布齐与巴赫韦齐相继称雄的时代；穆盖尼的比戈大型土筑遗址和基比罗的盐田都属于这个早期基塔拉世界。

布尼奥罗王国由此兴起，巴比托王朝于16世纪末掌权，在此后两个世纪里主导西部湖区。它的霸权在18世纪末衰落，布干达夺走科基，19世纪30年代托罗又分立出去，并带走盐场。

en:
The Ruthenians are the East Slavic heirs of Kievan Rus' in the Dnieper basin and western Rus' lands, whom Latin documents called Rutheni to distinguish them from the Muscovites. After the Mongol sack of Kyiv in 1240, principalities turned to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, whose 1362 Blue Waters victory brought Kyiv and the steppe border under Vilnius; Lithuanian chanceries ran in their written tongue, Ruthenian.

The Union of Lublin of 1569 transferred the Ruthenian lands of Ukraine to the Polish Crown, bringing Polish nobility and Catholic pressure producing the Union of Brest in 1596, when part of the Orthodox hierarchy entered communion with Rome as the Greek Catholic Church. Orthodox resistance centred on the Mohyla Academy, founded in 1632, while runaways swelled the Dnieper Cossack host.

The Cossack uprising of 1648 under Bohdan Khmelnytsky and the Pereyaslav agreement of 1654 drew Muscovy into Ruthenian affairs, and through later partitions the vernaculars matured into the Ukrainian and Belarusian languages.
zh:
鲁塞尼亚人是基辅罗斯在第聂伯河流域及西部罗斯土地上的东斯拉夫继承者，拉丁文献称他们为鲁塞尼人，以区别于北面的莫斯科人。1240年蒙古攻陷基辅之后，这些公国投向立陶宛大公国；1362年蓝水之战后，基辅与草原边地归入维尔纽斯治下，立陶宛官署使用他们的书面语鲁塞尼亚语。

1569年卢布林联合把乌克兰的鲁塞尼亚土地划给波兰王室，随之而来的波兰贵族与天主教压力促成1596年的布列斯特联合：一部分东正教会高层与罗马共融，成为希腊礼天主教会。东正教的抵抗以1632年创办的莫希拉学院为中心，逃亡者不断壮大第聂伯哥萨克队伍。

1648年波格丹·赫梅利尼茨基领导的哥萨克大起义，以及1654年的佩列亚斯拉夫协议，把莫斯科势力引入鲁塞尼亚事务；在后来的历次瓜分中，鲁塞尼亚各方言逐渐发展为乌克兰语和白俄罗斯语。

en:
The Ruvu are Bantu peoples of central and coastal Tanzania whose languages form the Ruvu group of Guthrie's Zone G, including the Gogo of the Dodoma plains, the Luguru of the Eastern Arc mountains, and the Zaramo nearer the sea. Most were matrilineal. The Luguru counted more than fifty exogamous clans in the Uluguru Mountains, where rainmakers such as Kingalu drew clients from across the region without any chief standing above the local lineages.

Through Ugogo and Ukaguru ran the route linking Lake Tanganyika with the Indian Ocean from the eighteenth century; Gogo chiefs levied tolls on Nyamwezi ivory caravans and kept Nyamwezi advisors at their courts.

On the coast the Zaramo took shape in the early 1800s, when the hinterland warrior Pazi drove off Kamba raiders attacking the merchant Shomvi clan and then settled among them as their ruler.
zh:
鲁伏人是坦桑尼亚中部与沿海班图各族的统称，其语言构成格思里G区的鲁伏语组，包括多多马平原的戈戈人、东部弧形山脉的卢古鲁人和近海的扎拉莫人等。他们大多按母系继嗣。乌卢古鲁山里的卢古鲁人有五十多个外婚制氏族，以金加卢为代表的祈雨师吸引各地客户，却没有高于地方世系的首领。

连接坦噶尼喀湖与印度洋的商路穿过乌戈戈和乌卡古鲁，18世纪起商旅往来，戈戈酋长向尼扬韦齐人的象牙商队征收通行税，宫廷里还养着尼扬韦齐顾问。

沿海的扎拉莫人形成于19世纪初：内地武士帕齐击退了攻打经商的肖姆维氏族的坎巴劫掠者，随后定居在他们中间，成为其统治者。

en:
The Banyarwanda are the Bantu people of the mountainous country around Lake Muhazi, united by the Kinyarwanda language and traditionally divided not into separate peoples but into three social categories: the farming Hutu, the cattle-keeping Tutsi and the hunter-gatherer Twa, whose clans cut across all three.

Bantu farmers had cleared these hills by about 1000, and waves of pastoral Tutsi entered from the north between the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. From the fourteenth or fifteenth century the clans coalesced into kingdoms; the Gasabo chiefdom beside Lake Muhazi grew into the Kingdom of Rwanda under its Nyiginya dynasty.

Around 1600 an invasion by the Banyoro drove its kings westward, but Ruganzu Ndori rebuilt the state from Nyanza, and in the seventeenth century his successors subdued outlying Hutu communities. Conquered populations were absorbed as Banyarwanda, and the realm became one of the most centralized monarchies of the Great Lakes, its mwami, or king, ruling through appointed chiefs rather than hereditary lineages.
zh:
巴尼亚卢旺达人是穆哈齐湖周围山国的班图人，以卢旺达语为纽带，传统上不分成不同民族，而是分为务农的胡图人、牧牛的图西人和狩猎采集者特瓦人三个社会类别，氏族成员横跨三类。

约公元1000年，班图农民已在此间丘陵开垦，15至16世纪又有一批批图西牧人从北方迁入。14或15世纪起，诸氏族合并为若干王国；穆哈齐湖畔的加萨博酋长国在尼吉尼亚王朝治下发展为卢旺达王国。

约1600年，巴尼奥罗人的入侵把国王赶到西方，但鲁甘祖·恩多里从尼安扎重建国家，17世纪其继承者又征服外围的胡图社群。被征服者被吸纳为巴尼亚卢旺达人，这个国度成为非洲大湖地区最集权的君主国之一，姆瓦米（国王）通过任命的酋长而非世袭世系实行统治。

en:
The Ryazanians are the East Slavic people of the middle Oka, the south-eastern frontier of Rus' where forest meets steppe. Their land emerged from the Murom-Ryazan inheritance that split from Chernigov by 1129, with fortress towns on the border with the nomadic world.

In December 1237 Batu's armies sacked and annihilated the capital, Old Ryazan, killing most of its princely house; the seat moved north to Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, later Ryazan. Rebuilding under the Golden Horde, the princes balanced between Sarai, Moscow and the steppe. Prince Oleg Ivanovich stood aside from Kulikovo in 1380 as an ally of Mamai, and Ryazan annexed the principality of Pronsk in 1483.

Ryazan was finally absorbed by Vasily III in 1521 when its last prince fled to Lithuania. Its speech belonged to the southern Russian dialect belt, marked by akanye and contact with Turkic neighbours.
zh:
梁赞人是奥卡河中游的东斯拉夫人，这里是罗斯东南边陲、森林与草原相接之地。他们的土地出自穆罗姆—梁赞遗产，1129年从切尔尼戈夫分立，有一系列面向游牧世界的边城。

1237年12月拔都的大军攻陷并屠灭都城旧梁赞，王公家族几乎死绝，都城北迁至佩列亚斯拉夫尔—梁赞斯基，即后来的梁赞城。在金帐汗国治下重建后，梁赞王公在萨莱、莫斯科与草原之间周旋。1380年库利科沃之战时，奥列格·伊万诺维奇作为马迈的盟友按兵不动，1483年梁赞吞并普龙斯克公国。

1521年末代王公逃奔立陶宛，梁赞终被瓦西里三世并入。梁赞方言属于南俄罗斯方言带，以“阿坎耶”弱读和与突厥邻人的接触为特征。

en:
The Ryukyuans are the Japonic-speaking people of the Ryukyu Islands, stretching from Kyushu toward Taiwan, who call themselves Uchinaanchu on Okinawa. Rice cultivation reached the islands in the twelfth century, and society kept strong matriarchal elements, with priestesses called noro tending an ancestor cult.

In the fourteenth century Okinawa was divided among Hokuzan, Chūzan and Nanzan; Chūzan opened tributary relations with Ming China in 1372. Its king Shō Hashi conquered Hokuzan in 1416 and Nanzan in 1429, founding the Ryukyu Kingdom at Shuri. Under Shō Shin, who reigned from 1478 to 1526, the kingdom prospered through maritime trade linking China, Japan and Southeast Asia.

In 1609 Satsuma invaded and carried off the king. The Amami Islands were annexed and Ryukyu survived as a dual vassal, paying tribute to Qing China while answering to Satsuma into the early nineteenth century.
zh:
琉球人是从九州延伸向台湾的琉球群岛上说日本语系语言的族群，在冲绳自称冲绳人。水稻种植12世纪传入群岛，社会保留浓厚的母系色彩，由称“祝女”的女祭司主持祖先信仰。

14世纪，冲绳分裂为北山、中山、南山三个政权；中山于1372年与明朝建立朝贡关系。中山王尚巴志于1416年攻灭北山、1429年攻灭南山，建立以首里为都的琉球王国。1478至1526年尚真王在位时，琉球凭借连接中国、日本与东南亚的海上贸易繁荣。

1609年萨摩藩入侵并掳走国王，奄美群岛被割占。琉球此后以双重臣属的地位存续，一边向清朝朝贡，一边听命于萨摩，直到19世纪初仍是如此。

en: The Saa, or Sa'a, are an Oceanic-speaking people of the southern Solomon Islands, living on Small Malaita off the southern tip of Malaita and on nearby Ulawa. Their language, also called Apae'aa or South Malaita, belongs to the Austronesian family.
zh: 萨阿人是所罗门群岛南部操大洋洲语族语言的族群，居住在马莱塔岛南端外的南马莱塔岛，又称小马莱塔岛，以及附近的乌拉瓦岛。他们的语言又称阿帕埃阿语或南马莱塔语，属南岛语系。

en:
The Saanich, whose name means 'the emerging people', are a Central Coast Salish people of the southern tip of Vancouver Island, the Saanich Peninsula and the neighbouring Gulf and San Juan Islands. They were divided into five independent house groups, each with winter villages and fishing grounds, and spoke a North Straits Salish dialect. Their society distinguished nobles, commoners and slaves, and stone burial cairns were raised around Victoria between about 500 and 1000.

Spanish explorers anchored at Esquimalt Harbour in 1790 and named it Puerto de Cordova, and British ships followed in 1792. From around 1800 musket-armed raiders from the northern coast pressed hard on Saanich villages, pushing the local Salish groups toward shared defensive alliances.
zh:
萨尼奇人是中部沿海萨利什人的一支，族名意为‘新兴之民’，分布在温哥华岛南端、萨尼奇半岛以及邻近的海湾群岛和圣胡安群岛。他们分为五个独立的聚居家族，各有冬村和渔场，所说的是北海峡萨利什语的一种方言。社会分为贵族、平民和奴隶；约500年至1000年间，维多利亚一带留下了石冢墓葬。

1790年西班牙探险船驶入埃斯奎莫尔特港，将其命名为科尔多瓦港，1792年英国船队也来到这里。1800年前后，来自北方海岸、持有火枪的劫掠者频频袭击萨尼奇村落，迫使当地萨利什各部走向共同防御的联盟。

en:
The Sach'a-p-qulla, better known as the Chachapoyas or “Warriors of the Clouds,” were an Andean people of the eastern slopes of the northern Peruvian Andes, centred on the Utcubamba valley. Their culture took shape around AD 800 in cloud forest won by terracing. Its hallmark was the mountaintop citadel of Kuélap, with more than four hundred stone buildings behind walls eighteen metres high.

The Inca Túpac Yupanqui conquered them around 1475, but they rebelled again under Huayna Cápac, killing his governors. The revolt ended when women led by a former concubine of Túpac Yupanqui begged for peace.

In the Inca civil war they backed Huáscar and suffered Atahualpa's revenge, so many welcomed Francisco Pizarro. Spanish troops occupied Chachapoyas in 1547, ending their independence; disease and resettlement cut the region's population by some ninety percent within two centuries.
zh:
查查波亚人又称“云端战士”，是秘鲁北部安第斯山脉东坡的安第斯族群，核心地区在乌特库班巴河谷。他们的文化约在公元800年形成，靠开垦梯田向云林要地。其标志是山顶城堡库埃拉普，十八米高的石墙内有四百多座石砌建筑。

印加君主图帕克·尤潘基约在1475年征服他们，但他们在瓦伊纳·卡帕克时期再度起义，杀死印加总督。一群妇女在图帕克·尤潘基的一位旧妃率领下请求宽恕，叛乱才告平息。

印加内战中，他们支持瓦斯卡尔，遭到阿塔瓦尔帕报复，因此许多人欢迎弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗。1547年西班牙军队占领查查波亚城，他们的独立告终；疾病和强制迁徙使该地区人口在两百年内减少约九成。

en:
The Sahaptin are Plateau peoples speaking dialects of the Sahaptin language, among them the Umatilla, Tenino, Walla Walla, Klickitat, Palus and Wanapum. Their villages lined the Columbia River from the Cascades Rapids eastward and its tributaries in Oregon and Washington. Sahaptin is a Plateau Penutian tongue, and the name was given them by Salishan neighbours.

They had no clans, and their headmen were elected and guided by councils. Semisettled hunter-gatherers, they took salmon and deer, pit-roasted camas bulbs and baked kouse root into cakes. They wintered in long semisubterranean lodges sheathed in rush mats that could hold a hundred people, and raised buffalo-skin tipis on seasonal expeditions.

Lewis and Clark passed through their villages in 1805. The epidemics that followed contact cut their numbers steeply during the first half of the nineteenth century.
zh:
萨哈普廷人是高原上一群说萨哈普廷语各方言的族群，包括乌马蒂拉人、特尼诺人、沃拉沃拉人、克利基塔特人、帕卢斯人和瓦纳普姆人等，村社沿俄勒冈与华盛顿州的哥伦比亚河喀斯喀特急流以东河段及其支流分布。萨哈普廷语属高原佩努蒂语系，“萨哈普廷”是邻近萨利什语族群对他们的称呼。

他们没有氏族，头人由选举产生，靠议事会辅佐。他们半定居，以狩猎采集为生，捕鲑鱼、猎鹿，在坑灶里烤卡马夏百合的球茎，把考斯根烤成饼；冬天住进芦席覆盖的长形半地穴大屋，一屋可容百人，季节性远行时则支起水牛皮帐篷。

1805年，刘易斯与克拉克一行经过他们的村落。接触后随之而来的传染病在19世纪上半叶使人口锐减。

en:
The Sahnish, known to their neighbours as the Arikara or Ree, are a Caddoan-speaking Plains people; Arikara may mean horns, elk people or corn eaters. Linguists place their split from the Skidi Pawnee around the fifteenth century, after which they built fortified earth-lodge villages along the Missouri River in South Dakota. They farmed corn and hunted buffalo and were once estimated at thirty thousand people.

The smallpox epidemic of 1780 to 1782 cut their thirty-two Missouri villages to two and left them open to Sioux raids. The weakened Sahnish drifted north to live near the Mandan and Hidatsa; the Lewis and Clark Expedition met them in 1804.

Their 1823 clash with Ashley's trappers and Colonel Leavenworth's troops became the first United States Indian war west of the Missouri, ending in a peace treaty in 1825.
zh:
萨尼什人在邻族口中称阿里卡拉人或里人，是大平原上说卡多语的族群；阿里卡拉一名可能意为角、麋人或食玉米者。语言学家认为他们约在15世纪从斯基迪波尼人中分出，此后在南达科他州的密苏里河畔建起设防的土屋村落。他们种植玉米、猎捕野牛，人口一度估计有三万。

1780至1782年的天花瘟疫使密苏里河畔的三十二座村落只剩两座，也令他们遭苏人袭扰。衰弱的萨尼什人逐渐北迁，靠近曼丹人和希达察人而居；刘易斯与克拉克远征队于1804年与他们接触。

1823年他们与阿什利的毛皮猎队及利文沃思上校的部队冲突，成为密苏里河以西第一场美国印第安战争，并以1825年的和约收场。

en:
The Sahtú, also called the North Slavey and once known to Europeans as the Hare or Hareskin Indians, are a Dene people of the Northern Athabaskan language family, part of the wider Na-Dene grouping. They take their name from Sahtú, the Great Bear Lake in Canada's Northwest Territories, and call themselves Ɂehdzo Got’ı̨ne, the Trap People. They comprise the Hare Dene, Bear Lake Dene and Mountain Dene.

They lived by hunting caribou and moose, fishing and trapping, moving seasonally between hunting grounds. Their first sustained contact with outsiders came through the fur trade: Alexander Mackenzie descended the river later named after him in 1789.

Fort Good Hope was founded as a trading post in 1805, drawing the Sahtú into the networks of the North West Company and later the Hudson's Bay Company.
zh:
萨赫图人又称北斯拉维人，欧洲人过去称他们为黑尔人或兔皮印第安人，是北阿萨巴斯卡语族的德内族群，属于更大的纳-德内语系。他们的名字得自萨赫图，即加拿大西北领地的大熊湖，自称“埃佐戈廷内”，意为“设陷阱的人”。萨赫图人分为黑尔德内、大熊湖德内和山地德内。

他们以猎捕驯鹿和驼鹿、捕鱼和诱捕猎物为生，随季节在猎场之间迁徙。他们与外来者持续接触始于毛皮贸易：亚历山大·麦肯齐于1789年顺后来以他命名的大河而下。

好望堡于1805年建为贸易站，萨赫图人由此被卷入西北公司以及后来哈德逊湾公司的贸易网络。

en:
Saigoku, the western country, is the old name for western Japan, contrasted with the eastern country of Tōgoku. It first appears in the Nihon Shoki of 676 as Kyushu's Saikaidō provinces, and under the Kamakura shogunate broadened to take in the court-ruled districts around Kyoto. Its core is the Kinai, five provinces forming Japan's historical heart.

Nara held the first permanent capital from 710, when Buddhism and state temples such as Tōdai-ji took root, and in 794 the court moved to Heian-kyō, later Kyoto, imperial seat for over a thousand years, home of The Tale of Genji and the Noh and Kabuki stages.

In 1496 the fortified Ishiyama Hongan-ji temple rose at Osaka; Oda Nobunaga crushed it after a ten-year siege from 1570, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi built Osaka Castle on the site in 1583. After Tokugawa victory in the Siege of Osaka of 1614–1615, Osaka became the shogunate's merchant capital, and its Dōjima Rice Exchange of 1697 pioneered futures trade.
zh:
西国是日本西部诸地的旧称，与“东国”相对。它最早见于676年的《日本书纪》，当时指九州的西海道各国，镰仓幕府时期范围扩大，把京都周围朝廷治下的地区也包括在内。其核心是畿内五国，构成日本历史的心脏地带。

710年起，奈良成为日本第一个永久性都城，佛教和东大寺等国立寺院在此扎根；794年朝廷迁都平安京，即后来的京都，在此后一千多年里一直是天皇所在，《源氏物语》以及京都的能、歌舞伎都诞生于这一地区。

1496年，设防的石山本愿寺在大阪兴起；织田信长从1570年起围攻十年将其摧毁，丰臣秀吉于1583年在原址修筑大阪城。1614—1615年大阪之阵后德川氏确立胜局，大阪成为幕府的商人之都，1697年设立的堂岛米会所开创最早的期货交易。

en:
Saintongeais is a langue d'oïl of the Poitevin–Saintongeais group, spoken along the Atlantic coast of western France in the old provinces of Saintonge, Aunis and Angoumois. Its country takes its name from the Santones, the Gaulish people whose town of Saintes became the first capital of Roman Aquitaine. The speech carries a substrate left by the Limousin Occitan once used there.

In the later Middle Ages Saintonge was a marchland between the Capetian kings and the Plantagenet dukes of Aquitaine; its lords wavered between Paris and Anglo-Aquitaine until Charles VII's armies secured the province for France in 1451.

The seafarer Samuel de Champlain, born near Saintes in 1574, founded Quebec, and settlers from Saintonge carried their speech to Acadia, where it shaped Acadian and later Cajun French. The province was dissolved in 1790 into Charente-Inférieure, while Saintongeais lived on as rural patois.
zh:
圣通日语是奥依语普瓦图-圣通日语支的语言，通行于法国西部大西洋沿岸的旧行省圣通日、欧尼斯和昂古穆瓦。这片土地得名于高卢部落桑托内斯人，他们的城镇桑特曾是罗马阿基坦行省的第一个首府。当地语言还保留着早先通行于此的利穆赞奥克语的底层成分。

中世纪后期，圣通日是卡佩王室与金雀花阿基坦公爵之间的边地，领主们在巴黎和英属阿基坦之间摇摆，直到1451年查理七世的军队将该省并入法国。

1574年生于桑特附近的航海家塞缪尔·德·尚普兰建立了魁北克，圣通日移民把家乡话带到阿卡迪亚，影响了阿卡迪亚法语乃至卡真法语。1790年该行省被撤销，并入下夏朗德省；圣通日语作为乡间土话留存。

en:
The Sakalava are the dominant people of Madagascar's western plain, formed from the mingling of Austronesian seafarers and Bantu farmers. Their first kingdoms took shape around the 1650s, when the Maroserana princes of Fiherenana, possibly heirs of the Zafiraminia clans, exchanged captives for Arab guns.

After 1610 Andriandahifotsy pushed north across the Mangoky River; Menabe became western Madagascar's leading power. Between 1730 and 1760, under King Andrianinevenarivo, the Sakalava realm covered nearly half the island and monopolised the slave trade through Mahajanga.

The kingdom split into northern Boina and southern Menabe, and the wars of the Merina king Radama I broke its power in the 1820s, though neither state was fully annexed. Sakalava life centred on zebu herds and the royal ancestor cult, with Tromba spirit ceremonies.
zh:
萨卡拉瓦人是马达加斯加西部平原的主体民族，由南岛语航海者与班图农民融合而成。最早的王国约形成于17世纪50年代：菲赫雷纳纳的马鲁塞拉纳王公可能是扎菲拉米尼亚氏族的后裔，用掳来的人口交换阿拉伯枪支。

1610年后，安德里安达希富齐北越曼戈基河；梅纳贝成为马达加斯加西部的首要强权。1730至1760年安德里亚尼韦纳里武国王在位时，萨卡拉瓦疆域覆盖全岛近半，通过马哈赞加港垄断奴隶贸易。

王国分裂为北部博伊纳和南部梅纳贝；19世纪20年代，梅里纳国王拉达马一世的战争摧毁萨卡拉瓦霸权，但两国都未被完全吞并。萨卡拉瓦人的生活以瘤牛群和王室祖先崇拜为中心，有特龙巴通灵仪式。

en:
The Sakao are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the northeastern horn of Espiritu Santo in Vanuatu, settled around Port-Olry and Hog Harbour, the two villages giving their names to the dialects of the Sakao tongue. Outsiders named them after the offshore islet of Sakao, which the people themselves call Ladhi.

Although their language is a close cousin of the neighbouring Tolomako, it has undergone drastic sound change, probably within the last thousand years, so that the two peoples can no longer understand one another. Sakao country lay near the route of the first European visitors: Pedro Fernandes de Queirós made the first recorded European landing on Santo in 1606, and Bougainville and Cook returned in 1768 and 1774.
zh:
萨卡奥人是瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛东北角的美拉尼西亚人，聚居于奥尔里港和霍格港，萨卡奥语的两种方言便以这两个村落得名。外来者以近海的萨卡奥小岛称呼他们，而他们自己把该岛称作拉齐。

萨卡奥语虽与邻近的托洛马科语是近亲，但可能在最近一千年内经历了剧烈的语音演变，两族已无法互通。萨卡奥人的家园临近最早一批欧洲访客的航线：1606年佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯首次有记载地登上圣埃斯皮里图岛，布干维尔和库克又于1768年和1774年重访该岛。

en:
The Sakha, known to their neighbours as the Yakuts, are a Turkic people of the middle and lower Lena River in northern Siberia. Their ancestors were pastoralist tribes of the Baikal and upper Yenisei region. Pushed north by Buryat and Mongol expansion from the twelfth century, they settled along the Lena and blended with indigenous Tungusic and Paleo-Siberian hunters.

In the taiga they bred hardy Yakutian horses and cattle. In the 1620s Muscovite Cossacks reached the Lena, built Yakutsk and imposed the yasak fur tribute; Sakha revolts between 1634 and 1642 were crushed, and smallpox and war cut the population by an estimated seventy percent by the 1680s.

By the 1820s nearly all Sakha were formally Russian Orthodox, though they kept many Tengri customs. The region became a major source of furs and later gold for the Russian Empire.
zh:
萨哈人被邻族称为雅库特人，是北西伯利亚勒拿河中下游的突厥语民族。他们的先民是贝加尔湖和叶尼塞河上游的游牧部落。12世纪起因布里亚特和蒙古扩张北迁，沿勒拿河定居，并与当地通古斯、古西伯利亚狩猎族群融合。

他们在泰加林中饲养耐寒的雅库特马和雅库特牛。17世纪20年代，莫斯科的哥萨克进抵勒拿河，修建雅库茨克并征收毛皮税“亚萨克”；1634至1642年间的萨哈起义遭到镇压，加上天花和战乱，到17世纪80年代人口估计减少了七成。

到19世纪20年代，萨哈人几乎都在名义上皈依了俄罗斯东正教，但仍保留大量腾格里信仰习俗。该地区成为俄罗斯帝国重要的毛皮、后来又是黄金产地。

en:
The Adyan are the Even, or Lamut, reindeer clans of the tundra between the lower Lena and the Olenyok. Seventeenth-century Russian records call them the Olenyok Tungus of the Adyan tribe, and between 1639 and 1664 the fort clerks recorded their feuds with the Vanyady, ancestors of the Nganasans, to the west.

They lived as nomadic reindeer herders, hunting wild reindeer and fishing along the Arctic rivers, and the Even speech of their descendants is classed as the Sakkyryr dialect, named after the Sakkyryr River. With the rest of the Evens they came under Russian fur-tribute rule in the seventeenth century and were counted as Orthodox by the nineteenth.
zh:
萨克雷尔人是下勒拿河与奥列尼奥克河之间苔原上的鄂温（拉穆特）养鹿氏族。17世纪的俄国文献把他们记作阿德扬部落的奥列尼奥克通古斯人；1639至1664年间，堡寨文书多次记录他们与西邻瓦尼亚德人（恩加纳桑人的先民）发生冲突。

他们以游牧驯鹿为生，在北极各河沿岸猎取野鹿、捕鱼，其后人的鄂温语被划为萨克雷尔方言，得名于萨克雷尔河。和其他鄂温人一样，他们在17世纪被纳入俄国的毛皮税体系，到19世纪已被算作正教徒。

en:
The Salar are a Turkic Muslim people whose villages line the Yellow River in Qinghai and the Jishishan hills of Gansu. Their tradition traces them to the Oghuz Salur, who in the thirteenth century travelled east from the Samarkand region under the brothers Qaraman and Aqman, carrying a Quran on a white camel.

They mixed with Tibetan, Hui, Han and Mongol neighbours; lore remembers Tibetan women as their first wives. In 1370 their chief Han Bao submitted to the Ming, becoming hereditary centurion while Salar clans kept self-rule.

In the 1670s Afaq Khoja introduced Sufi orders, and in the eighteenth century Ma Laichi's Khufiyya and Ma Mingxin's Jahriyya fought for followers. Their rivalry became the Jahriyya revolt of 1781 under Su Sishisan. Agui crushed it after a three-month siege near Lanzhou, killing perhaps two in five Salars and exiling survivors to Ili.
zh:
撒拉人是信奉伊斯兰教的突厥语民族，村落沿青海的黄河分布，并延伸到甘肃积石山。口述传统将祖先追溯到乌古斯突厥的撒鲁尔部：13世纪，嘎勒莽、阿赫莽兄弟率族人牵着白骆驼、驮着古兰经自撒马尔罕一带东迁。

他们与藏族、回族、汉族和蒙古族杂处通婚，族谱称最早的妻子是藏族女子。1370年首领韩宝归附明朝，被授为世袭百户，撒拉各姓保有自治权。

17世纪70年代，阿帕克霍加将苏菲派传入；18世纪马来迟的虎夫耶与马明心的哲合忍耶两派争夺信徒，最终酿成1781年苏四十三领导的哲合忍耶起义。阿桂在兰州附近围城三月将起义镇压，约四成撒拉人可能死于战乱，幸存者被流放伊犁。

en:
The Saleesh, better known as the Bitterroot Salish or Flathead and calling themselves Selish, are an Interior Salish people of western Montana, whose language gave the entire Salishan family its name.

Their early homeland lay east of the continental divide, but in the 1700s pressure from Plains nations, above all the Blackfeet, together with smallpox, drove them into the Bitterroot Valley. There they crossed the divide once or twice a year to hunt buffalo on the plains and built alliances with plateau tribes to their west.

The expedition of Lewis and Clark met them in the valley in 1805, and by the 1830s Iroquois trappers schooled by Jesuits had settled among them; their accounts moved the Saleesh to send delegations to St. Louis in 1831, 1835 and 1837 asking for priests.
zh:
萨利希人自称塞利什，又称比特鲁特萨利什人或弗拉特黑德人，是蒙大拿州西部的内陆萨利什人，其语言是萨利什语系的得名来源。

他们的早期家园在大陆分水岭以东，18世纪时，平原部族（主要是黑脚人）的压力加上天花，把他们逼入比特鲁特谷。他们每年一两次越过分水岭到平原猎牛，并与西边的高原部落结盟。

1805年，刘易斯与克拉克的探险队在谷中与他们相遇；1830年代，受过耶稣会教育的易洛魁猎户已在他们中间定居，后者的讲述促使萨利希人于1831年、1835年和1837年派人前往圣路易斯，请求派遣神父。

en:
The Salinan are an Indigenous people of the Central Coast of California, whose ancestral lands covered the southern Salinas Valley and the Santa Lucia Range. They lived as hunter-gatherers in small, loosely organized bands, relying on acorns, fish, shellfish and game. Their own name means People of the Oaks, while Salinan was given to them by the Spanish from the Salinas River.

Their language was a linguistic isolate, sometimes tentatively grouped with the Hokan family. The Spanish built the missions of San Antonio de Padua in 1771 and San Miguel Arcángel in 1797 in their territory, around which most Salinan came to live. Their numbers fell steeply under the mission system and the epidemics that accompanied it.
zh:
萨利南人是加利福尼亚中部海岸的原住民，祖居地包括萨利纳斯河谷南部和圣卢西亚山脉。他们以小型松散的游群从事采集狩猎，主食橡子、鱼类、贝类和猎物。他们的自称意为“橡树之人”，“萨利南”则是西班牙人依萨利纳斯河给他们起的名字。

萨利南语是一门孤立语言，也有人尝试把它归入霍坎语系。西班牙人于1771年和1797年先后在他们的土地上建立圣安东尼奥和圣米格尔两座传教站，多数萨利南人后来围绕传教站生活。人口在传教制度和伴随而来的疫病中急剧下降。

en: The Saluan are an Austronesian people of the mountainous interior of Banggai Regency in eastern Central Sulawesi, descended from the Loinang, or mountain people, of the highlands and grouped into the Lingketeng, Loinang and Obo dialect subgroups; their Celebic Saluan language and the tooth-filing rite marking adulthood are central to their tradition.
zh: 萨卢安人是中苏拉威西东部邦盖县山区的南岛语族群，源自高地上被称为“洛伊南”（意为山里人）的居民，下分林格滕、洛伊南和奥博三个方言支系；属西里伯斯语支的萨卢安语和标志成年的锉齿仪式是其传统的重要部分。

en:
The Sama, known as Bajau, are Austronesian seaborne peoples of maritime Southeast Asia, dwelling in houseboats across the Sulu Archipelago and the coasts of Borneo and Sulawesi. They lived from fishing and trade, and their later spread was closely tied to commerce in sea cucumber.

The Magellan expedition's chronicler Antonio Pigafetta described boat-dwelling Sama in 1521 off the Zamboanga Peninsula. Some northern Sulu groups took part in sea raids and the slave trade under Iranun commanders who answered to the Tausug datus of the Sultanate of Sulu.

A Sama settlement at Bajoe in Sulawesi stood under the Sultanate of Bone and was caught up in the Bone Wars of 1824 and 1825, after which most of its people resettled elsewhere on the island. Their Sinama languages were commonly written in Jawi, and their beliefs ranged from Sunni and folk Islam to older sea-spirit worship.
zh:
巴瑶人自称萨马人，是东南亚海岛地区以船为家的南岛语族群体，活动于苏禄群岛、婆罗洲与苏拉威西沿海。他们以捕鱼和贸易为生，其后来的扩散与海参贸易密切相关。

1521年，麦哲伦探险队的记述者皮加费塔在三宝颜半岛外海记载了栖身船上的巴瑶人。苏禄北部的部分群体在伊拉农指挥官麾下参与海上劫掠和奴隶贸易，而指挥官听命于苏禄苏丹国的陶苏格酋长。

苏拉威西的巴瑶港有一处巴瑶人聚落，臣属波尼苏丹国，被卷入1824—1825年的波尼战争，战后多数人迁往岛内其他地方。他们的萨马语常用爪夷文书写，信仰从逊尼派和民间伊斯兰到更古老的海神崇拜不一而足。

en:
The Samaritans are an ethnoreligious community of Samaria in central Palestine, descended from the ancient northern Kingdom of Israel. They recognize only their own Torah and hold Mount Gerizim above Nablus as God's chosen sanctuary, where their temple stood from the fifth century BCE until the Hasmonean king John Hyrcanus destroyed it around 110 BCE.

Revolts against Byzantium in 484 and under Julianus ben Sabar in 529 were crushed, leaving them a small minority. Ninth-century Abbasid persecutions emptied their villages and concentrated survivors in Nablus; from the eleventh century Arabic replaced Aramaic.

The Franks of the First Crusade massacred their coastal communities, and in 1137 a Damascene raid on Nablus carried off five hundred captives. Ottoman repression further shrank their numbers, and by the end of the eighteenth century roughly two hundred remained in Nablus, living by trade and clerking.
zh:
撒玛利亚人是巴勒斯坦中部撒玛利亚的族群，源自古以色列北国遗民。他们只承认本派《托拉》，奉纳布卢斯旁的基利心山为上帝选定的圣所；圣殿自公元前5世纪立于该山，约公元前110年被哈斯蒙尼王朝的约翰·海尔卡努斯拆毁。

484年的反拜占庭起义和529年尤利亚努斯·本·萨巴尔领导的起义先后被镇压，撒玛利亚人沦为少数群体。9世纪阿拔斯王朝的迫害使村落荒废，幸存者聚居纳布卢斯；11世纪起，阿拉伯语取代阿拉米语。

第一次十字军东征时，法兰克人屠杀其沿海社群，1137年大马士革军队袭击纳布卢斯，掳走五百人。奥斯曼时期的压迫使人口进一步萎缩，到18世纪末仅余约两百人，在纳布卢斯靠经商和文书为生。

en:
The Sambal are the original Austronesian inhabitants of Zambales on the mountainous western coast of Luzon, with related communities in Pangasinan. They once lived farther south until Tagalog migration pushed them north, where they displaced the Aeta foragers.

Early Spanish accounts describe a headhunting society of small villages, skilled with poison arrows, short spears and the rectangular kalasag shield. Warriors took heads with the bararao dagger, and their faith centered on the creator Malayari, served by shamans called bayoc.

Under Spanish rule the Sambal were gathered into towns and gradually Christianized. In 1660 the Zambales chieftain Pedro Gumapos led six thousand men in Andres Malong's war, sacking Vigan before he was captured and hanged. They shipped timber to Manila, but Moro pirate raids kept Zambales poor through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh:
三描礼人是吕宋西部多山海岸三描礼士省的原始南岛语系居民，在邦阿西楠还有亲缘社群。他们原本住在更南边，被他加禄人的移民推向北方，又排挤了当地的阿埃塔狩猎采集者。

早期西班牙文献记载了一个猎头社会，村落规模小，善用毒箭、短矛和长方形卡拉萨格盾。战士用巴拉劳匕首割取敌人首级，他们的信仰以造物主马拉亚里为核心，由称巴约克的萨满侍奉。

西班牙统治下，三描礼人被并入城镇并逐渐基督教化。1660年，三描礼酋长佩德罗·古马波斯率六千人加入安德烈斯·马隆的战争，洗劫维甘后被俘并被绞死。他们把木材运往马尼拉，但莫罗海盗的劫掠使三描礼在18世纪和19世纪初一直贫困。

en:
The Samogitians, whose name means the Lowlanders, are the western branch of the Lithuanians, formed in the lowlands of central and western Lithuania as early as the fifth and sixth centuries. They absorbed the southern remnants of the Semigallians and Curonians between the thirteenth and sixteenth centuries.

They stood against the crusading orders, destroying the Brothers of the Sword at Saule in 1236 and crushing the Teutonic and Livonian armies at Durbe in 1260. Vytautas surrendered Samogitia to the Order in 1398, but its people rose in 1401 and 1409, and Samogitian regiments fought at Grunwald in 1410.

The last people in Europe to accept Christianity, they were baptised in 1413; the Treaty of Melno in 1422 settled their border with the Order. The Duchy of Samogitia within Lithuania passed to Russia with the partitions of the late eighteenth century.
zh:
萨莫吉蒂亚人意即低地居民，是立陶宛人的西支，早在5—6世纪就形成于立陶宛中西部的低地。他们在13—16世纪间吸收了塞米加利亚人和库罗尼亚人的南部余部。

他们抵抗十字军骑士团，1236年在索莱歼灭佩剑兄弟会，1260年在杜尔贝击溃条顿与立窝尼亚联军。1398年维陶塔斯将萨莫吉蒂亚割让给骑士团，但当地人于1401年和1409年两度起义，萨莫吉蒂亚部队还参加了1410年的格伦瓦德战役。

他们是欧洲最后接受基督教的族群，1413年才受洗；1422年的《梅尔诺条约》划定了他们与骑士团的边界。立陶宛境内的萨莫吉蒂亚公国在18世纪末随联邦瓜分转入俄国统治。

en:
The Sanavirones, also called Salavinones, were an Indigenous people of central Argentina whose ancestors split from the Tonokote around Salavina in Santiago del Estero. In the fifteenth century, under pressure of growing numbers and prolonged drought, they spread southwest into the Sierras of Córdoba, taking land from the Comechingones.

They farmed with Andean techniques, hunted and fished, and lived in large communal huts of branches and grass. Men fought with the macana, a heavy wooden club. Though never conquered by the Inca, they took in many Quechua words after 1480 through captives held among them.

Spaniards called them Yugitas in the sixteenth century; mixing with settlers began early, and by the eighteenth century the Sanavirones had ceased to exist as a separate people. Their language, once a common tongue in colonial administration, survives only in six or seven recorded words.
zh:
萨纳维龙人又称萨拉维农人，是阿根廷中部的原住民，其先民在圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗的萨拉维纳一带从托诺科特人中分化出来。15世纪时，因人口增长和长期干旱的压力，他们向西南扩张到科尔多瓦山脉，夺取了科梅钦贡人的土地。

他们采用安第斯式农耕技术，兼事狩猎和渔捞，住在树枝和茅草搭成的大型公共棚屋里。男子作战使用沉重的木棒马卡纳。他们虽从未被印加征服，却在1480年后通过族中收容的俘虏吸收了大量克丘亚语词汇。

16世纪西班牙人称他们为胡吉塔人；他们与殖民者的混血开始得很早，到18世纪已不再作为独立民族存在。他们的语言在殖民行政中曾充当通用语，却只留下六七个有记录的词。

en: The Sandawe are a click-speaking people of central Tanzania whose language may be distantly related to the Khoe languages of southern Africa. Descended from ancient hunter-gatherers akin to the Bushmen, they long lived by foraging before adopting millet and sorghum farming from Bantu neighbours, remaining a stateless people of scattered homesteads with rainmaking clans.
zh: 桑达维人是坦桑尼亚中部讲吸气音语言的族群，其语言可能与南部非洲的科伊语有远亲关系。他们是类似布须曼人的古老狩猎采集者后裔，长期以采集狩猎为生，后来从班图邻居那里学会种植粟和高粱，但始终是散居村户、没有国家的社会，由祈雨氏族主持仪式。

en:
The Sangirese, who call themselves Tau Sanger, are the Austronesian people of the Sangihe and Talaud islands between northern Sulawesi and Mindanao, with an ancient offshoot, the Muslim Sangil, settled around Sarangani in the Philippines. Austronesian voyagers reaching the islands in the first millennium BCE merged with earlier inhabitants. The Sangirese trace their descent from Gumansalangi, a cultural hero placed around the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, when their islands answered to the Muslim rulers of Maluku.

In the sixteenth century the Sultanate of Ternate subdued the Sangihe Islands and Portuguese ships reached them. Spanish rule in the seventeenth century left loanwords in the Sangirese language, before Dutch occupation from 1677.

The islanders prospered as middlemen and smugglers, fishing and growing nutmeg. By the early nineteenth century their trading settlements had spread to Sulawesi around Tabukan and to Ternate and Halmahera.
zh:
桑吉尔斯人自称陶桑格尔，是生活在苏拉威西北部与棉兰老之间桑义赫、塔劳群岛上的南岛语族群体；其古老分支、信奉伊斯兰教的桑吉尔人定居在菲律宾的萨兰加尼一带。公元前1千纪，南岛语族航海者与更早的原住民融合。桑吉尔斯人把世系追溯到14—15世纪的文化英雄古曼萨兰吉，当时群岛已臣服于马鲁古的穆斯林统治者。

16世纪，特尔纳特苏丹国征服桑义赫群岛，葡萄牙船只也接踵而至。17世纪的西班牙统治在桑吉尔斯语中留下借词，随后荷兰人于1677年占领群岛。

岛民以中间商和走私为生，兼营渔业与肉豆蔻种植。到19世纪初，他们的贸易聚落已扩散到苏拉威西的塔布坎以及特尔纳特、哈马黑拉等地。

en:
The Sanhaja were one of three great Berber confederations of the Maghreb, whose tribes fell into two worlds. In the western Sahara, veiled nomadic clans such as the Lamtuna roamed between the Draa and Niger, while others settled from the ninth century in the Middle Atlas, the Rif and oases around Sijilmasa, with related Kutama farther east.

The Kutama carried the Fatimids to power, and the Sanhaja Zirid dynasty ruled Ifriqiya until the twelfth century. In the mid-eleventh century the theologian Abdallah ibn Yasin united the desert Sanhaja in the Almoravid movement, which founded Marrakesh around 1070 under Yusuf ibn Tashfin, conquered the western Maghreb and al-Andalus and halted the Castilian advance at Sagrajas in 1086, before falling to the Almohads in 1147.

The settled Sanhaja of the Atlas and Tafilalt oases then passed under Zenata Marinid rule and were gradually Arabized. In the seventeenth century the Char Bouba war left the remaining nomadic Sanhaja subjects of Arab warrior castes.
zh:
桑哈贾是马格里布三大柏柏尔部落联盟之一，其部落分属两个世界：在西撒哈拉，戴面纱的游牧氏族如拉姆图纳人，游徙于德拉河与尼日尔河之间；另一些桑哈贾人自9世纪起定居在中阿特拉斯山、里夫山和锡吉勒马萨周围的绿洲，亲缘相近的库塔马人分布在更东面。

库塔马人曾助法蒂玛家族掌权，桑哈贾人的齐里王朝统治伊弗里基叶直至12世纪。11世纪中叶，神学家阿卜杜拉·伊本·雅辛把沙漠中的桑哈贾诸部联合为穆拉比特运动：优素福·伊本·塔什芬约于1070年兴建马拉喀什，进而征服西马格里布和安达卢斯，在1086年的萨拉卡战役中挡住卡斯蒂利亚的推进，1147年被穆瓦希德人推翻。

此后，阿特拉斯山区和塔菲拉勒特绿洲的定居桑哈贾人转入泽纳塔系马林王朝治下，逐渐阿拉伯化。17世纪撒哈拉的查尔布巴战争后，幸存的游牧桑哈贾人沦为阿拉伯武士阶层的属民。

en:
The Santal are the largest of the Munda-speaking Austroasiatic peoples of eastern India, concentrated on the Chota Nagpur Plateau and adjoining western districts of Bengal. They call themselves Hor Hopon, children of humans; Santal is an outsider's name from the settlement of Saont in Midnapore. Linguistics traces their forebears to migration from Indochina several millennia before the common era, and folklore remembers a slow westward drift from Hihiri onto the plateau.

They lived as clan farmers in villages led by a majhi headman, each with a sacred jaher grove where the bonga spirits, headed by Marang Buru, received seasonal sacrifice. Long absent from written records, they appear in East India Company documents as Soontars in 1795.

After the Bengal famine of 1770 emptied the Jungle Mahals, the Permanent Settlement of 1790 led landlords and the Company to recruit Santals for forest clearing, and after Damin-i-koh was demarcated in 1832 thousands migrated into the Rajmahal Hills as peasants, falling into debt to moneylenders.
zh:
桑塔尔人是印度东部说蒙达语的南亚语系诸族中人数最多的一支，聚居在焦达讷格布尔高原及相邻的孟加拉西部各县。他们自称“霍尔·霍彭”，意为“人类之子”，“桑塔尔”则是外人依米德纳普尔的索恩特村取的他称。语言研究表明，其先民在公元前数千年从印度支那方向迁徙而来，本族口述传统也记得族群自“希希里”缓步西迁，进入焦达讷格布尔高原。

他们以氏族农耕为业，村落由“马吉”村长主持，村边辟有圣林“贾赫尔”，以摩烂迦补卢为首的“邦加”诸神在那里接受季节性牲祭。桑塔尔人长期不见于文字记载，1795年才以“松塔尔”之名出现在东印度公司的档案中。

1770年孟加拉大饥荒使丛林马哈尔一带人口锐减，1790年《永久地税法》推行后，地主和公司招募桑塔尔人垦荒；1832年达明-伊-科划定后，数以千计的桑塔尔人迁入拉杰马哈尔丘陵充当定居佃农，却逐渐欠下债主的债务。

en:
The Sao were the earliest civilization to leave clear traces around Lake Chad, developing in the Chari River basin from older iron-age cultures such as Gajiganna from about the sixth century BCE. They lived in independent walled city-states under a divine ruler who showed himself only behind a screen, while the queen mother and the ruler's senior sister held political weight.

Settled farmers and craftsmen, the Sao worked bronze, copper and iron, leaving terracotta figures and funerary urns. Their city-states reached their height between the ninth and fifteenth centuries, long resisting Kanem and Bornu. Bornu's Kanuri rulers adopted many Sao customs.

Most scholars hold that the Sao ceased to be a separate culture in the 1500s, absorbed into the expanding Bornu Empire and Islam. The Kotoko, Sara, Buduma, Kanembu and Musgum peoples all claim Sao ancestry.
zh:
萨奥人是乍得湖一带最早留下清晰遗迹的文明，约自公元前6世纪起，在沙里河流域由加吉加纳等更古老的铁器时代文化发展而来。他们聚居在独立的城墙城邦里，由神化的统治者君临，其只在屏风后露面，王太后与君主的长姐则掌握着实权。

萨奥人既是定居农民，也是工匠，冶炼青铜、铜和铁，留下了赤陶塑像和骨灰瓮。他们的城邦在9—15世纪达到鼎盛，长期抵抗卡涅姆和博尔努，而博尔努的卡努里统治者也采纳了许多萨奥习俗。

多数学者认为，萨奥作为独立文化在16世纪消亡，被扩张中的博尔努帝国和伊斯兰教同化。科托科人、萨拉人、布杜马人、卡嫩布人和穆斯古姆人都自称是萨奥人的后裔。

en:
The Sámi are the indigenous people of Sápmi, stretching from Norway and Sweden across northern Finland to the Kola Peninsula; their languages form a branch of the Uralic family. Hunting, fishing and later semi-nomadic reindeer herding sustained them. They once lived farther south, trading squirrel furs in Finland until the local Sámi were assimilated by the fourteenth century.

When the Black Death reached northern Norway in 1349 it killed most Norwegian farmers but largely spared the isolated Sámi. They took over abandoned fjord farms and divided into Sea Sámi and migratory Mountain Sámi, some of whom paid taxes to all three crowns of Norway, Sweden and Russia.

After the Reformation rune drums were burned and Sámi faced witch trials in the seventeenth century, though shamanic religion lingered into the eighteenth. Forced labour in the Nasa mine between 1635 and 1659 emptied Pite and Lule Sámi districts.
zh:
萨米人是萨普米地区的原住民，其地从挪威、瑞典横跨芬兰北部，延伸到科拉半岛；萨米语是乌拉尔语系的一个分支。狩猎、捕鱼以及后来的半游牧驯鹿业是他们的生计。他们古时分布更靠南，在芬兰以松鼠毛皮交易，直到当地萨米人在14世纪被同化。

1349年黑死病传到挪威北部，挪威农民死亡过半，与外界隔绝的萨米人受害较轻。他们接手被遗弃的峡湾农庄，分化为海洋萨米人和迁徙的山地萨米人，部分山地萨米人要同时向挪威、瑞典和俄国纳税。

宗教改革后符文鼓被焚毁，17世纪萨米人面临巫术审判，而萨满信仰延续到18世纪。1635—1659年纳萨矿的强迫劳役使皮特和吕勒萨米人的地区人口流失。

en:
The Sara are a cluster of Central Sudanic-speaking peoples with a society of patrilineal clans, who farm the savannas of the middle Chari and Logone rivers in southern Chad and the neighbouring north-west of the Central African Republic. Muslim states to their north called them Kirdi, meaning unbelievers, and counted them among their chief sources of slaves.

From its foundation about 1522 the Sultanate of Bagirmi built its wealth on raiding the peoples south of the Chari for the trans-Saharan slave trade; its court adopted Islam under Mbang Abdullah around 1600, while the Sara kept their ancestral religion.

Bagirmi shook off Bornu overlordship in the eighteenth century but was conquered by Wadai in 1805, when twenty thousand captives were taken at Massenya, and the raiding of Sara villages continued through the 1830s.
zh:
萨拉人是操中苏丹语诸语言的族群联合体，奉行父系氏族制度，在乍得南部沙里河与洛贡河中游以及中非共和国西北部的热带草原上务农。北方的穆斯林政权称他们为基尔迪，意即异教徒，并把他们视作主要的奴隶来源之一。

巴吉尔米苏丹国约于1522年建立，靠劫掠沙里河以南诸族、向跨撒哈拉奴隶贸易供货而致富；约1600年，姆班阿卜杜拉在位时宫廷皈依伊斯兰教，萨拉人却仍保留祖先信仰。

18世纪巴吉尔米摆脱了博尔诺的宗主权，却在1805年被瓦达伊征服，马塞尼亚有两万人被掳为奴；针对萨拉村庄的掠奴行动在整个19世纪30年代仍未停止。

en:
The Sardinians are the indigenous people of Sardinia, whose Bronze Age Nuragic civilization left more than eight thousand stone towers called nuraghes. Rome conquered the island in 238 BC, and after Vandal and Byzantine rule Saracen raids from the ninth century cut it off from Constantinople, allowing four kingdoms, the Judicates of Cagliari, Arborea, Gallura and Torres, to emerge under rulers titled judge.

Their monks and judges kept property registers called condaghes, among the earliest records of the Sardinian tongue. Pisan and Genoese merchants came to dominate the ports, while the Crown of Aragon conquered most of the island as the Kingdom of Sardinia in 1324.

Arborea alone held out under its own judges until 1420; Eleanor of Arborea issued the Carta de Logu, the law code that governed Sardinian life until 1827. Spanish rule lasted until the island passed to the House of Savoy in 1720.
zh:
撒丁人是撒丁岛的原住民，他们的青铜时代努拉吉文明留下了八千多座名为努拉吉的石塔。罗马于公元前238年征服该岛；经过汪达尔和拜占庭统治后，9世纪起萨拉森人的袭扰使岛屿与君士坦丁堡失联，卡利亚里、阿尔博雷亚、加卢拉和托雷斯四个王国即朱迪卡蒂随之兴起，统治者称法官。

修道院和法官们保存的孔达盖财产登记簿是撒丁语最早的记录之一。后来比萨和热那亚商人控制了港口，而阿拉贡联合王国于1324年征服岛上大部，建立撒丁尼亚王国。

唯有阿尔博雷亚在本土法官治下坚持到1420年；阿尔博雷亚的埃莱奥诺拉颁布的《洛古法典》一直有效到1827年。西班牙的统治持续到1720年该岛转交萨伏依家族为止。

en:
The Sarta, better known by their Chinese name Dongxiang, are a Muslim Mongolic people of the loess hills of southern Gansu, centred on the eastern part of old Hezhou prefecture, from which their name, meaning the eastern district, is taken.

Chinese historians trace them to Central Asian soldiers and settlers brought east under the Yuan dynasty of 1271–1368, who kept their Islamic faith and were joined in the 1340s by the missionary Hamzeh. Over time they abandoned their original Central Asian tongue for a Mongolic language.

Their surnames record the mixture of the frontier, drawn from Mongol, Han, Hui and Tibetan stock. Their villages lived by farming potatoes, barley and wheat on the dry uplands and by weaving carpets known across the north-west.
zh:
东乡自称撒尔塔，是甘肃南部黄土丘陵上的穆斯林民族，说蒙古语族语言，核心聚落在古河州东部，“东乡”之名即由此而来。

中国史家认为，他们的先民是1271—1368年元朝统治时期东来的中亚军士和移民，一直保持伊斯兰教信仰，14世纪40年代又有传教士哈木则前来传教。年深日久，他们放弃了原来的中亚语言，改用蒙古语族语言。

他们的姓氏记录着边地民族的交融，兼有蒙古、汉、回、藏各源。村落在干旱高地上种植洋芋、大麦和小麦，并以织毯手艺闻名西北。

en:
The Sasak are the Austronesian people of Lombok in the Lesser Sunda Islands, related to the Balinese and the peoples of Sumbawa. Their name appears in an eleventh-century Balinese inscription and the fourteenth-century Negarakertagama.

The palm-leaf chronicle Babad Lombok recalls how the island's chief kingdom, with its trading capital Pamatan at the foot of Mount Samalas, was destroyed by the eruption of 1257, easing the Balinese conquest in 1284. By the fourteenth century the island was under Majapahit rule; the Balinese kingdom of Gelgel conquered it in the early sixteenth century.

Islam reached Lombok in the fifteenth century and spread among the Sasak from the late 1500s, blending with older animist and Hindu ideas into the Wetu Telu tradition of prayer three times a day. From 1692 the Balinese kingdom of Karangasem ruled many Sasak villagers until the nineteenth century.
zh:
萨萨克人是小巽他群岛龙目岛上的南岛语族群，与巴厘人及松巴哇岛诸民族相近。他们的族名见于11世纪的巴厘碑文和14世纪的《爪哇史颂》。

棕榈叶编年史《龙目纪事》记载，岛上的首要王国以萨马拉斯火山脚下的商贸城市帕马坦为都，却在1257年火山喷发中被毁，为巴厘人于1284年征服龙目铺平了道路。14世纪时龙目处于满者伯夷统治之下，16世纪初巴厘的吉尔吉尔王国征服该岛。

伊斯兰教于15世纪传入龙目，16世纪末起在萨萨克人中传播，并与更早的万物有灵和印度教观念融合，形成每日礼拜三次的韦图图卢传统。从1692年起，巴厘卡朗阿森王国统治众多萨萨克村民直至19世纪。

en:
The Mawé, better known as the Sateré-Mawé, are a Tupian people of the lower Amazon and Tapajós basins. In the 1600s they held wide territories on the Tapajós plateau before colonial pressure and wars with the Munduruku pushed them toward the headwaters of the Andirá, Abacaxis and Urariá rivers.

Sedentary farmers who enriched their fields with terra preta, they domesticated the wild guaraná vine into a cultivated shrub. A Jesuit described their guaraná balls in 1669, and from the early 1700s they traded guaraná sticks and featherwork to the Portuguese along the river routes.

The Jesuits founded the Tupinambarana mission on the edge of their lands in 1669, yet they kept their villages, trade and language. In 1835 they joined the Cabanagem insurgency that swept the Amazon.
zh:
马维人通称萨特雷马维人，是亚马孙河下游与塔帕若斯河流域的图皮语族群。17世纪时他们据有塔帕若斯高原的广阔土地，后来在殖民压力和与蒙杜鲁库人的战争中，逐步退向安迪拉河、阿巴卡希斯河和乌拉里亚河的上游。

他们是定居农人，用印第安黑土培肥田地，并把野生瓜拉纳藤培育成栽培灌木。1669年已有耶稣会士记下他们制作的瓜拉纳球，18世纪初起，他们沿河水商路向葡萄牙人出售瓜拉纳和羽毛制品。

1669年，耶稣会在他们领地边缘建立图皮南巴拉纳传教镇，但他们保住了村落、贸易和本族语言。1835年，他们参加了席卷亚马孙的卡巴纳任起义。

en: The Sauzas, also called Sanzas, were a small Chichimeca people of northern Guanajuato and southern San Luis Potosí. Of Guachichil origin, they were members of the Guamare confederation and influenced Guamare culture before disappearing as a separate group in the colonial period.
zh: 绍萨人又称桑萨人，是活动在瓜纳华托州北部和圣路易斯波托西州南部的一支奇奇梅克小族。他们源出夸奇奇特尔人，加入了瓜马尔联盟，并对瓜马尔文化有过重要影响，殖民时期作为独立群体消亡。

en:
The Savonians are the Finnish tribal subgroup of the historical province of Savonia in the forested east of Finland. They descend from Tavastian and Karelian peasants who entered the wilderness during the Middle Ages in search of land for slash-and-burn farming, mixing with the older Sámi population.

The Treaty of Nöteborg in 1323, the first written mention of Savonia, assigned it to Sweden rather than Novgorod, tying it to the Finnish language and the Lutheran church. A distinct Savonian identity had formed by about 1700.

In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the Swedish crown encouraged Savonian settlement of the central Finnish forests. Many migrated into central Sweden and eastern Norway, becoming known as the Forest Finns. Savonians and Karelians were also the first Finns to use hereditary surnames, often marked by the diminutive ending nen.
zh:
萨沃尼亚人是芬兰东部林区历史省份萨沃尼亚的芬兰部族分支。他们是中世纪为寻找刀耕火种的土地而进入荒野的塔瓦斯蒂亚农民和卡累利阿农民的后裔，并与当地更古老的萨米人融合。

1323年的《内特堡和约》首次以文字提到萨沃尼亚，将其划归瑞典而非诺夫哥罗德，使它与芬兰语和路德宗联系在一起。到1700年前后，独立的萨沃尼亚认同已经形成。

16—17世纪，瑞典王室鼓励萨沃尼亚人开垦芬兰中部森林。许多人迁往瑞典中部和挪威东部，被称为森林芬兰人。萨沃尼亚人和卡累利阿人还是芬兰最早使用世袭姓氏的人群，姓氏常带指小词尾宁（nen）。

en:
Sawokli, recorded by the Spanish as Sabacola, was a Hitchiti-speaking tribal town on the lower Chattahoochee River in Georgia, and one of the towns of the Apalachicola Province. Its material culture grew out of the Lamar culture that developed along the river between about 1300 and 1400.

Franciscan friars visited from 1679, and the mission town of San Carlos de Sabacola existed by 1686, disappearing from Spanish records after 1690. Shortly after 1690 Sawokli moved with the other Apalachicola towns to Ochese Creek in central Georgia, where English traders called them the Ochese Creek Indians.

After the Yamasee War of 1715 the towns returned to the Chattahoochee and formed the Lower Towns of the Muscogee, or Creek, Confederacy, of which Sawokli long remained a member.
zh:
萨沃克利在西班牙文献中记作萨巴科拉，是佐治亚州查特胡奇河下游一座讲希奇蒂语的部落城镇，属阿巴拉契科拉省诸城之一，其物质文化源于约1300—1400年间在该河沿岸发展起来的拉马尔文化。

方济各会修士从1679年起到此传教，到1686年这里已有圣卡洛斯·德·萨巴科拉传教站，1690年后再未见于西班牙记载。1690年后不久，萨沃克利随阿巴拉契科拉诸城迁往佐治亚中部的奥切斯溪一带，英国商人把他们称为奥切斯溪印第安人。

1715年雅马西战争后，诸城迁回查特胡奇河，组成马斯科吉（克里克）联盟的下城，萨沃克利长期是其中一员。

en:
The Saxons are the people of Thuringia and Upper Saxony, heirs to the Old Saxons of northern Germany and the medieval eastward colonization. The Old Saxons held the lands between the Ems and the Elbe until Charlemagne subdued them in the long Saxon Wars of 772 to 804, forced their conversion and made their country a Frankish stem duchy.

From about 1100 the Ostsiedlung carried settlers from Saxony, Franconia and Thuringia into the Margraviate of Meissen between the Elbe and Saale, formerly Polabian Slav country; their mixed speech hardened into the Upper Saxon koiné, linked to Thuringian dialects.

In the later Middle Ages Meissen chancery Saxon became the administrative language of the Electorate of Saxony after 1423, and Martin Luther's Bible translation of the 1520s and 1530s in this Central German idiom made it a chief foundation of standard German. Saxon speech carried Leipzig elite prestige until the Electorate's decline after the Seven Years' War of 1756 to 1763.
zh:
萨克森人是图林根与上萨克森地区的居民，同时继承了北德老萨克森人与中世纪东向殖民两段历史。老萨克森人原居埃姆斯河与易北河之间，直到查理曼在772至804年漫长的萨克森战争中将其征服，强迫他们改宗，并把这片土地变为法兰克的部族公国。

约1100年起的东向殖民，把来自萨克森、法兰克和图林根的定居者带到易北河与萨勒河之间、原属波拉布斯拉夫人的迈森藩侯国；他们混杂的方言逐渐定型为上萨克森共同语，与图林根方言关系密切。

中世纪后期，迈森的公文萨克森语成为1423年以后萨克森选侯国的行政语言；马丁·路德在16世纪20至30年代用这种中部德语翻译圣经，使它成为标准德语的主要基础之一。萨克森话凭借莱比锡精英的声望风行，直到萨克森选侯国在1756至1763年七年战争后衰落。

en:
The Sclavenes take their name from the Sclaveni, early Slavic tribes that crossed the Danube from the sixth century and settled across the Balkans, some reaching the Peloponnese. In southern Greek lands two communities kept a distinct identity into the late Middle Ages: the Melingoi on the slopes of Mount Taygetus and the Ezeritai of the Helos marshes in Laconia.

Constantine VII records them paying tribute and revolting in the tenth century. Under Byzantine and then Frankish rule they became Christians and gradually Hellenized, while keeping their Slavic speech in the hills as late as the fifteenth century.

In the 1330s founders' inscriptions in Laconian churches still name a tzaousios of the Melingoi, and both the Principality of Achaea and the Despotate of the Morea recruited their pastoralist highlanders as soldiers. Kindred Slavic-speaking pockets also survived in Epirus and Macedonia.
zh:
斯克拉维尼人的名称来自斯克拉维尼人，即6世纪起渡过多瑙河、遍布巴尔干的早期斯拉夫部落，其中一些抵达伯罗奔尼撒半岛。在希腊南部，两个社群把独特身份保持到了中世纪后期：泰格托斯山坡的梅利吉人，以及拉科尼亚赫洛斯沼泽地带的埃泽里泰人。

君士坦丁七世记载他们在10世纪缴纳贡赋并发动过叛乱。在拜占庭及后来法兰克人的统治下，他们皈依基督教并逐渐希腊化，但山地居民的斯拉夫语一直留存到15世纪。

14世纪30年代，拉科尼亚教堂的施主铭文仍提到梅利吉人的察乌西奥斯军官，亚该亚侯国和摩里亚专制国都征募这些放牧的山民当兵。类似的斯拉夫语飞地也残存在伊庇鲁斯和马其顿。

en:
The Scots of the Lowlands are the Germanic-speaking people of southern and eastern Scotland, distinct from the Gaelic Highlanders. The Angles of Northumbria and the Britons of Strathclyde were absorbed into the medieval Kingdom of Alba alongside its Pictish and Gaelic core.

Under David I's twelfth-century Davidian Revolution, Norman nobles, feudal law and chartered burghs shaped Lowland society. Northern English speech, first called Inglis and later Scottis, became the language of parliament and towns. The Wars of Independence against England, led by William Wallace and Robert the Bruce, culminated at Bannockburn in 1314.

In 1560 John Knox's Reformation made Presbyterian Calvinism the faith of Lowland Scotland. The crowns were united under James VI in 1603, and the parliamentary union of 1707 opened England's empire and markets to Scottish merchants. The eighteenth century brought the Scottish Enlightenment of Hume and Adam Smith and rapid industrial change.
zh:
低地苏格兰人是苏格兰南部、东部讲日耳曼语族语言的族群，与讲盖尔语的高地人不同。诺森布里亚的盎格鲁人与斯特拉斯克莱德的布立吞人被吸入中世纪阿尔巴王国，与皮克特和盖尔核心融合。

12世纪大卫一世的大卫革命把诺曼贵族、封建法和特许自治镇带进低地社会。北英格兰方言先称Inglis、后称Scottis，成为议会和城镇的语言。反抗英格兰的独立战争由威廉·华莱士和罗伯特·布鲁斯领导，以1314年班诺克本之捷告终。

1560年，约翰·诺克斯领导的宗教改革使长老宗加尔文派成为低地的信仰。1603年詹姆斯六世身兼两国王位，1707年的议会联合向苏格兰商人打开了英格兰的帝国与市场。18世纪迎来休谟和亚当·斯密的苏格兰启蒙运动及剧烈工业化。

en:
The Sedang, who call themselves Hdang and were recorded as Xo Dang by the Vietnamese, are a Mon-Khmer people of the northern Central Highlands, living mainly around Kon Tum with offshoots in southern Laos and north-eastern Cambodia. They speak a North Bahnaric language.

From the 1100s their lands were squeezed in wars with the Chams, Lao and Siamese; by the 1500s Thai and Lao expansion had pushed them into the mountains above the Mekong, where they built stilted longhouses and communal halls and kept the gong-and-buffalo rituals of the highlands. Reputedly the most warlike of the plateau peoples, their warriors and war elephants fought alongside Bahnar and Jarai tribes in the Tay Son armies that rose in 1771.
zh:
色当人自称赫当，越南称之为色当，是中央高地北部的孟高棉语民族，主要聚居于昆嵩一带，在老挝南部和柬埔寨东北部也有支系。他们说北巴拿语支的语言。

从12世纪起，他们的土地在与占人、老挝人和暹罗人的战争中不断被压缩，到16世纪，泰人和老挝人的扩张把他们逼回湄公河上游的山地。他们在那里建起干栏长屋和集会公所，保留着高地敲锣、宰牛献祭的仪式。色当人被认为是高原上最好战的民族，1771年西山起义爆发后，他们的战士和战象曾与巴拿人、嘉莱人部落并肩为西山军效力。

en:
The Tse'khene, better known as the Sekani, are an Athabaskan-speaking Dene people of northern British Columbia, whose lands cover the Finlay and Parsnip river drainages. Their name, joined to Dene for people, means people on the rocks. Their culture resembled that of the neighbouring Dunneza, from whom they had probably diverged by the eighteenth century; late in that century the expanding Plains Cree drove them westward.

They lived mainly by hunting big game, supplemented by berries and river fish, cremated their dead, and were said to practise polyandry before conversion to Catholicism.

Simon Fraser of the North West Company built Trout Lake Fort, later Fort McLeod, on McLeod Lake in 1805, though sustained direct contact with the Sekani dated only to the 1820s, when company posts drew them into the fur trade.
zh:
塞卡尼人自称特克赫内人，是说阿萨巴斯卡语的德内族群一支，生活在不列颠哥伦比亚省北部，领地位于芬利河与帕斯尼普河流域。其族名加上意为“人”的德内，即“岩石上的人”。他们的文化与邻近的杜内扎人接近，两者大概到18世纪已经分化；18世纪后期，西进的平原克里人把他们逼向更西的地方。

塞卡尼人主要靠猎取大型野兽为生，辅以浆果和河鱼；他们实行火葬，据说在皈依天主教之前还有一妻多夫的习俗。

1805年，西北公司的西蒙·弗雷泽在麦克劳德湖建起鳟鱼湖堡，即后来的麦克劳德堡，但塞卡尼人与外界持续的直接接触要到1820年代，随着公司商站把他们卷入毛皮贸易才展开。

en:
The Selk'nam, also called the Ona, were nomadic hunters of Isla Grande de Tierra del Fuego, having crossed from the Patagonian mainland over the Strait of Magellan in remote prehistory. They shared the island with the Manek'enk and the canoe-going Yahgan.

Organized in small bands without chiefs, they hunted guanacos with bows, arrows and bolas and kept Fuegian dogs for the chase and for warmth. Their Chonan language was close to Tehuelche, and the long Hain initiation tested boys through masked spirits and rites of courage.

European contact was fleeting and mostly violent: a Dutch fleet under Olivier van Noort killed some forty Selk'nam in 1599, and James Cook found glass-tipped arrows among them in 1769, gifts from Bougainville's earlier voyage. The Selk'nam remained beyond regular European reach through the early nineteenth century.
zh:
塞尔克南人又称奥纳人，是大火地岛的游牧猎人，远古时期从巴塔哥尼亚大陆越过麦哲伦海峡来到岛上。他们与马内肯克人和操舟为生的雅甘人共居此岛。

他们结成没有首领的小群体，用弓、箭和流星锤猎取原驼，还驯养火地犬协助狩猎和取暖。他们的语言属乔南语系，与特维尔切语相近；漫长的哈因成年礼让男孩在戴面具的精灵和勇气考验中完成成人仪式。

他们与欧洲人的接触短暂而多带暴力：1599年奥利维尔·范·诺尔特率领的荷兰船队杀死约四十名塞尔克南人；1769年詹姆斯·库克发现他们的箭镞上嵌着玻璃，那是布干维尔早前航行留下的礼物。直到19世纪初，塞尔克南人仍游离于欧洲人的常规势力范围之外。

en:
The Selkup are a Samoyedic people of western Siberia, formed in the middle Ob basin from the meeting of native Yeniseian hunters with Samoyedic groups moving north from the Sayan Mountains early in the first millennium. They lived by fishing, hunting and reindeer herding along the Ob and its tributaries around Tomsk, travelling the rivers in dugout canoes.

In the thirteenth century they came under Mongol overlordship, and after Russian Cossacks reached the region around 1628 they were subjugated and rose in unsuccessful revolts.

During the seventeenth century part of the Selkup migrated north to the Taz and Turukhan rivers, while Russian settlers of the eighteenth century encroached on their hunting grounds and the state pressed conversion to Orthodox Christianity, though older beliefs and customs survived.
zh:
塞尔库普人是西西伯利亚的萨莫耶德民族，公元第一个千年早期，沿萨彦岭北迁的萨莫耶德人与鄂毕河中游的土著叶尼塞猎人融合，逐渐形成了这个群体。他们在托木斯克一带的鄂毕河及其支流沿岸以渔猎和驯鹿放牧为生，乘坐独木舟往来河上。

13世纪他们落入蒙古人统治之下；约1628年俄罗斯哥萨克抵达并征服该地，塞尔库普人多次起义均告失败。

17世纪，一部分塞尔库普人北迁到塔兹河与图鲁汉河流域；18世纪俄罗斯移民不断侵占猎场，官府又强推东正教归化，但古老的信仰与习俗仍得以延续。

en: The Shyelogon, or Sologon, were an Evenki, or Tungus, rod first recorded in the 1630s, when cossacks under Ivan Galkin took hostages from the Sologon and neighbouring clans along the Vilyuy. Sologon clans ranged through the north-western Yakutian taiga towards the Anabar, living by elk hunting and reindeer herding in the mobile Tungus manner.
zh: 谢洛贡人（又译索洛贡）是鄂温克（通古斯）氏族，最早见于17世纪30年代的记录：伊万·加尔金麾下的哥萨克在维柳伊河向索洛贡及邻近氏族扣押人质。索洛贡各氏族在雅库特西北部的泰加林里游猎，远达阿纳巴尔河一带，按通古斯人的流动方式以猎驼鹿和牧养驯鹿为生。

en:
The Semnanis are a Caspian Iranian people living on the arid northern fringe of the central plateau, in the old region of Qumis around Semnan, Damghan and Sorkheh. Their ancestors moved inland from the southern Caspian shore and intermarried with plateau tribes. Their Semnani tongues form a Northwestern Iranian group close to Gilaki and Zaza, preserving features of ancient Median.

Their land held Hecatompylos, a capital of the Parthian Empire by 200 BC, whose ruins near Damghan were abandoned after the great earthquake of 856. For roughly a thousand years the Semnanis have watered desert alluvial fans with stone channels and underground aqueducts, dividing snowmelt through a splitter channel known as the Parö under a registrar called the engarnevis.
zh:
塞姆南人是居住在中央高原北缘干旱地带的里海伊朗语族群，活动于塞姆南、达姆甘和索尔赫一带的古库米斯地区。他们的祖先从里海南岸迁入内陆，与高原部落通婚。塞姆南诸语属于伊朗语族西北支，与吉兰语和扎扎语相近，并保留了古代米底语的特征。

当地曾有赫卡通皮洛斯城，公元前200年已是帕提亚帝国的都城，遗址在达姆甘附近，856年大地震后被废弃。约一千年来，塞姆南人依靠石砌渠道和地下暗渠引雪山融水浇灌荒漠冲积扇，通过名为帕罗的分水渠分流，由称作恩加尔内维斯的水吏登记调度。

en: The Sempan are an indigenous people of the coastal and riverine country of Mimika Regency in Central Papua, Western New Guinea, dwelling between the Minajerwi and Otakwa rivers within what is now Lorentz National Park. They speak Sempan, a language of the Asmat group, and are often conflated with their neighbours the Kamoro, whose settlements adjoin theirs.
zh: 森潘人是新几内亚岛西部中巴布亚省米米卡县沿海与河网地带的原住民，住在米纳杰尔维河与奥塔夸河之间，其地今属洛伦茨国家公园。他们说属阿斯马特语群的森潘语，常被与相邻而居的卡莫罗人混为一谈。

en:
The Sena are the Bantu people of the middle Zambezi valley, in the Sofala and Zambezia lowlands of Mozambique, between the Shona to the south and the Nyanja-Chewa peoples to the north. They were middlemen in the river's gold and ivory traffic when the Portuguese reached the coast after 1498; in 1514 Antonio Fernandez reported rich goldfields in their country.

From the 1530s Portuguese traders, missionaries and garrisons settled along the river. The fair founded by Vicente Pegado in 1531 on a Muslim village grew into the town of Sena, from which the people later took their name.

After Francisco Barreto's expedition of 1569 to 1575 the Portuguese controlled the valley's mines and trade. Ivory exports boomed in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, and by 1800 the slave trade had carried more than fifty thousand captives out of Mozambique.
zh:
塞纳人是赞比西河中游的班图人，住在莫桑比克索法拉省和赞比西亚省的低地，南接绍纳人，北邻尼扬贾-切瓦各族。葡萄牙人1498年以后到达海岸时，塞纳人已是这条河黄金与象牙贸易的中间人；1514年，安东尼奥·费尔南德斯报告说他们的乡土蕴藏丰富金矿。

16世纪30年代起，葡萄牙商人、传教士和驻军沿河立足。维森特·佩加杜1531年在一个穆斯林村庄设立的集市发展成塞纳镇，这支族群后来便因该镇得名。

1569—1575年弗朗西斯科·巴雷托远征之后，葡萄牙人控制了河谷的矿山与贸易。17—18世纪象牙出口兴盛，到1800年奴隶贸易已把五万多名俘虏运出莫桑比克。

en:
The Senufo are an ethnolinguistic cluster of some thirty related Gur dialects, spread across northern Ivory Coast, southeastern Mali and western Burkina Faso. Korhogo was linked to them as early as the thirteenth century; around the fourteenth century the rise of Kong as a Bambara trade station set off migrations, and the Senufo group coalesced in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries.

They are farming peoples, many matrilineal, whose villages kept the Poro initiation society and the Sandogo order of women diviners, and whose masks and figures honor the Ancient Mother Maleeo.

Around 1650 the Muslim Dioula Traoré clan founded the Kénédougou Kingdom, whose Senufo kings used the Mandé title of faama; in the eighteenth century it became an extension of the Kong Empire and won back independence by 1825. Their lands were raided for slaves and supplied captives to merchants.
zh:
塞努福人是由约三十种相近的古尔语支方言联结的族群语言群体，分布在科特迪瓦北部、马里东南部和布基纳法索西部。早在13世纪，科霍戈城就与塞努福人有关；约14世纪，孔格作为班巴拉贸易站兴起，引发迁徙，塞努福人群体在15—16世纪融合成型。

他们以农耕为生，许多支系实行母系继承，村落里保留波洛成年会社和女性占卜者的桑多戈教团，其面具和雕刻供奉“古老母亲”马莱奥。

约1650年，信奉伊斯兰教的迪乌拉人特拉奥雷氏族在他们中间建立凯内杜古王国，塞努福国王以曼德头衔“法马”统治；18世纪王国沦为孔格帝国的附庸，到1825年重新独立。塞努福地区既遭人猎奴，也向商人供应奴隶。

en:
The Sephardim are the Jews of Iberia, whose name comes from Sepharad, the Hebrew word for Iberia; around 1337 their communities filled the cities of Christian Spain and Portugal. Jewish settlement began in Roman times, and after Visigothic persecutions the communities entered a golden age under Muslim rule in Al-Andalus, where scholars made Córdoba a centre of Jewish learning.

Their position worsened under the Almoravids and Almohads and during the Reconquista, and the anti-Jewish riots of 1391 in Castile and Aragon brought massacre and mass conversion. The Alhambra Decree of 1492 expelled the Jews of Spain, and a Portuguese edict followed in 1496.

The exiles carried their Old Spanish speech, which became Judaeo-Spanish or Ladino, to Ottoman cities, the Maghreb, where the Haketia variety took shape, and Italian ports and Amsterdam.
zh:
塞法迪犹太人是伊比利亚半岛的犹太人，名称来自希伯来语中对伊比利亚的称呼“塞法拉德”；1337年前后，他们的社群遍布基督教西班牙和葡萄牙城市。犹太人罗马时代已定居当地，西哥特人迫害后，在穆斯林统治的安达卢斯进入黄金时代，学者使科尔多瓦成为犹太学术中心。

穆拉比特、穆瓦希德王朝和收复失地运动期间，他们的处境恶化，1391年卡斯蒂利亚和阿拉贡的反犹骚乱造成屠杀和大规模改宗。1492年《阿罕布拉法令》将犹太人逐出西班牙，1496年葡萄牙颁布类似敕令。

流亡者带着古西班牙语出走，后来演变为犹太-西班牙语即拉迪诺语；他们前往奥斯曼城市、马格里布（形成哈凯提亚变体）、意大利港口和阿姆斯特丹。

en:
The Seramese are the indigenous peoples of Seram, the largest island of the Moluccas, honoured across central Maluku as Nusa Ina, the Mother Island.

Interior groups such as the Alune and Wemale lived from sago and shifting cultivation, spoke Nunusaku languages, and traced their descent through two traditional leagues, the Patasiwa and Patalima, whose origins are told in the Hainuwele coconut-girl myth. In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries Seram lay in the sphere of Ternate, often ruled through its vassal Buru.

Portuguese explorers mapped its southern coast in 1512; Dutch trading posts opened in the early seventeenth century and the island came under nominal Dutch rule around 1650. Tidore held suzerainty over eastern Seram from 1700 to 1768, and in the 1780s the island became the main base of Prince Nuku of Tidore's rebellion against the Dutch.
zh:
塞兰人是斯兰岛原住民的统称。斯兰岛是摩鹿加群岛最大的岛屿，中马鲁古各族尊称它为“母亲之岛”努萨·伊纳。

岛上的阿卢内、韦马莱等内陆族群以西米和游耕为生，操努努萨库语群的语言，传统上分为帕塔西瓦与帕塔利马两大盟系，其由来载于海奴韦莱“椰子姑娘”的创世神话中。15至16世纪，斯兰岛处于特尔纳特苏丹国的势力范围，常由其附庸布鲁代为管辖。

1512年葡萄牙航海者测绘了岛屿南海岸；17世纪初荷兰人开设商站，约1650年起对全岛行使名义统治。1700至1768年，蒂多雷苏丹国领有岛东的宗主权；18世纪80年代，斯兰岛又成为蒂多雷努库亲王反荷起义的主要基地。

en:
The Serbs are a South Slavic people who settled the central Balkans in the sixth and seventh centuries, building early principalities in Ras and other lands. The Nemanjić dynasty, founded by Stefan Nemanja in 1166, united Serb lands: Stefan the First-Crowned took the royal title in 1217, and Saint Sava secured an autocephalous Serbian Orthodox Church in 1219, giving the Serbs a lasting faith and hierarchy.

In 1337 the young Stefan Dušan had just inherited the kingdom, and his Byzantine conquests made him Emperor of the Serbs and Greeks in 1346, ruling from Skopje an empire from the Danube to the Gulf of Corinth. The empire fragmented after his death; defeat at Kosovo in 1389 and the fall of Smederevo in 1459 brought the Serb lands under Ottoman rule.

The Patriarchate of Peć kept Serbian consciousness alive through the Ottoman centuries, and failed uprisings in 1689 and 1737 triggered the Great Migrations into Habsburg lands. Uprisings in 1804 and 1815 reopened the path to an autonomous principality, recognized within the Ottoman Empire in 1830.
zh:
塞尔维亚人是南斯拉夫民族，6至7世纪定居巴尔干中部，在拉斯等地建立早期公国。1166年斯特凡·尼曼雅开创的尼曼雅王朝统一了塞尔维亚诸地：1217年斯特凡·首加冕称王，1219年圣萨瓦争取到自主的塞尔维亚正教会，使塞尔维亚人拥有持久的信仰与教阶。

1337年，年轻的斯特凡·杜尚刚继承王位，他对拜占庭的征服使其于1346年在斯科普里加冕为“塞尔维亚人和希腊人的皇帝”，帝国版图从多瑙河延伸至科林斯湾。杜尚死后帝国走向分裂；1389年科索沃之战失利、1459年斯梅代雷沃陷落，塞尔维亚土地沦入奥斯曼统治。

佩奇塞尔维亚牧首区在整个奥斯曼时期维系着民族意识，1689年和1737年起义失败引发塞尔维亚人大迁徙，大批人进入哈布斯堡领地。1804年和1815年的两次起义重新打开通往自治的道路，1830年塞尔维亚公国在奥斯曼帝国内获得承认。

en:
The Serer are one of the oldest peoples of Senegambia, farming the lands of Sine, Saloum and Baol in Senegal. Their traditions trace them to the Senegal River valley in Futa Tooro, from which they began moving south in the 1000s after War Jabi, king of Takrur, imposed Islamic law and persecuted subjects who kept the old beliefs.

Their early villages were led by lamans, priestly landowners, and later by the Wagadou, a maternal dynasty of Soninke origin. In 1335 the Mandinka leader Maysa Wali, fleeing the troubles of Kaabu, took refuge among them and founded the Guelowar line of the kings of Sine, whose kingdom stood beside the sister kingdom of Saloum.

Serer society combined matrilineal and patrilineal inheritance and kept its ancestral religion, centred on the supreme being Roog and the Pangool spirits, through the jihads and Atlantic slave trade of the following centuries.
zh:
塞雷尔人是塞内冈比亚最古老的民族之一，在塞内加尔的锡内、萨卢姆和巴奥勒地区务农。按其传统，他们的祖地在富塔托罗的塞内加尔河谷；11世纪，塔克鲁尔国王瓦尔·贾比推行伊斯兰教法、迫害坚持旧信仰的臣民，塞雷尔人由此开始南迁。

他们早期的村庄由身兼祭司的地主拉曼治理，其后又有源自索宁克人的母系王朝瓦加杜。1335年，曼丁哥首领梅萨·瓦利为躲避卡布的战乱逃来，被塞雷尔人接纳，开创了锡内国王的盖洛瓦尔世系；锡内王国与姊妹王国萨卢姆并立。

塞雷尔社会并行母系与父系两套继承制，并在此后数百年的圣战和大西洋奴隶贸易中，保留着以至高神罗格和潘古尔神灵为中心的传统信仰。

en:
The Comcaac, whom the Spanish called Seri, are the nomadic sea-and-desert people of the Sonora coast on the Gulf of California. Their homeland took in Tiburon Island, known to them as Tahejoc, and San Esteban Island.

They moved in six patrilineal bands without agriculture or fixed towns, living from fishing, hunting and wild harvest. Their language, cmiique iitom, has no proven relative.

A Spanish slaving raid in the 1660s killed most of one band and carried off its children, opening a long era of warfare in which the Comcaac held out longer than any other Sonoran people. Jesuits failed to settle or convert them, and mid-eighteenth-century military expeditions never fully conquered them, though they were gradually driven onto a fraction of their lands.
zh:
科姆卡克人被西班牙人称为塞里人，是加利福尼亚湾索诺拉海岸游荡的海洋与沙漠民族，故乡包括他们称作塔赫约茨的蒂布龙岛和圣埃斯特万岛。

他们分为六个父系游群，没有农业，也没有固定城镇，靠捕鱼、狩猎和野生采集为生。他们的语言克米克伊伊托姆与任何语言都没有确证的亲缘关系。

17世纪60年代，一支西班牙奴隶捕掠队杀死一个游群的大部分成人，掳走儿童，开启了漫长的战争年代；科姆卡克人比索诺拉任何其他民族都坚持得更久。耶稣会士没能让他们定居或改宗，18世纪中叶的军事远征也从未彻底征服他们，尽管他们被逐渐压缩到故土的一角。

en:
The Sere are a small people of the Western Bahr el Ghazal region in South Sudan, speaking an Ubangian tongue of the Sere-Ndogo group; their old country, called Ndedegumbva, lay between the Boku and Kere rivers. Their oral traditions are dominated by the Azande conquests, for the Azande were welded into a conquering power by the Vungara and Bandia dynasties in the first half of the 1700s.

The Zande king Ikpiro overran the Sere, burning their hill refuges and killing or enslaving much of the population. Many stayed as Zande subjects, while refugees fled north and settled by the Pongo river.

Later wars with the chief Karamalla split the community, some following the Zande king Tombura and others Karamalla, leaving the Sere scattered under outside rule.
zh:
塞鲁人是南苏丹西加扎勒河地区的小族群，操乌班吉语系塞鲁-恩多戈语支的语言；他们的故土名叫恩德德贡巴，位于博库河与凯雷河之间。其口述传统中最核心的记忆是阿赞德人的征服：阿赞德人在18世纪上半叶由温加拉和班迪亚两大家族整合为扩张强权。

赞德国王伊克皮罗攻灭塞鲁人，焚烧他们藏身的山寨，大量人口被杀或被掳为奴。许多人留下做了赞德属民，难民则向北逃到蓬戈河畔落脚。

后来与首领卡拉马拉的战争又使这个群体分裂，一部分追随赞德国王通布拉，另一部分随卡拉马拉而去，塞鲁人就此散居在外族统治下。

en:
The Seuta are Bantu peoples of northeastern Tanzania, between the Pangani and Wami rivers, speaking closely related languages. Their traditions remember a bow-armed hero called Seuta, who led the ancestors of the Zigula south. The Zigula count themselves the parent stock of the Shambaa and Bondei; the Ngulu are said to be Zigula who took refuge in the hills from raiders.

The Zigula lived in palisaded towns, grouped around matrilineal clans under chiefs called zumbe, who came to power by raiding; none ruled all the Zigula.

In the first half of the 1700s a Zigula-born hunter, Mbegha, fled into the Usambara Mountains, united the Shambaa as their king and founded the Kilindi dynasty. His son Bughe built the hilltop capital at Vuga, and the Lion Kings grew powerful on the caravan trade passing up the Pangani valley.
zh:
塞乌塔人是坦桑尼亚东北部潘加尼河与瓦米河之间一群班图人的统称，他们的语言关系密切。他们的口传传统记得一位持弓的英雄塞乌塔，曾率领齐古拉人的先民南迁；齐古拉人自视为香巴人和邦代人的母族，恩古卢人据说则是为躲避劫掠而逃入山区的齐古拉人。

齐古拉人住在树栅环绕的镇子里，以母系氏族为核心，首领是靠劫掠起家的“尊贝”，没有谁能统辖全体齐古拉人。

18世纪上半叶，出身齐古拉的猎人姆贝加逃入乌桑巴拉山区，把香巴人统一在自己王权之下，开创基林迪王朝。他的儿子布盖在山顶修建都城武加，诸位“狮王”借着沿潘加尼河谷往来的商队贸易日益强盛。

en:
The Severians were an East Slavic tribal confederation of the lower Desna and Seym, stronghold Chernihiv, the black city of the forests. They paid squirrel and beaver tribute to Khazars until Oleg of Novgorod brought them into Kievan Rus' around 884; they joined the 907 campaign against Constantinople. Absorbed into Chernigov principality, the tribe vanishes from chronicles after 1024, but its name lived on in Severia, land of timber fortresses.

Its best-known appanage was Novgorod-Seversk, whose Prince Igor led the ill-fated 1185 campaign against the Cumans told in The Tale of Igor's Campaign. The Mongol storms of the thirteenth century were followed by Lithuanian rule, until the Muscovite-Lithuanian war of 1500 to 1503 gave Chernihiv and other towns to Ivan III.

Severia was the first region to rally to the False Dmitry in 1604, passed to the Polish Crown under the Deulino truce of 1618 and returned to Muscovy under the Andrusovo truce of 1667, its southern reaches guarded by Cossacks and fortified lines; from the sixteenth century workshops developed a Severian icon-painting school.
zh:
谢韦里亚人是早期东斯拉夫部落联盟，活动在杰斯纳河下游及谢伊姆河流域，据点是林中之城切尔尼戈夫。他们原本向可萨人缴纳松鼠皮和河狸皮贡赋，约884年诺夫哥罗德的奥列格将其并入基辅罗斯，他们还参加了907年远征君士坦丁堡的战事。被切尔尼戈夫公国吸纳后，这个部落在1024年以后便从编年史中消失，但名字留在谢韦里亚这片扼守草原通道、遍布木堡的土地上。

其最有名的封邑是诺夫哥罗德—谢韦尔斯基，1185年伊戈尔王公征讨波洛伏齐人兵败的故事，因《伊戈尔远征记》而流传。13世纪蒙古征服后这里改归立陶宛统治，1500至1503年的莫斯科—立陶宛战争把切尔尼戈夫等城划给伊凡三世。

谢韦里亚1604年最先响应伪德米特里，1618年依杰乌利诺停战划归波兰，1667年安德鲁索沃停战又复归莫斯科，南境由哥萨克和堡垒防线戍守；16世纪起，当地作坊发展出谢韦尔圣像画派。

en:
The Shastan peoples are a cluster of four closely related Hokan-speaking groups, the Shasta proper, Konomihu, Okwanuchu and New River Shasta, scattered through the Klamath Mountains of northern California and southern Oregon. The Shasta proper called themselves Kahosadi, plain speakers, and were divided into bands named after their waterways.

Their villages held only one or two families beside a stream, and they lived on salmon, deer taken in forests kept open by controlled burning, and acorns and roots gathered in season. The name Shasta was not their own but reached print through the Hudson's Bay Company trader Peter Skene Ogden, who in the 1820s became the first Euro-American to record it, in spellings such as Sastise and Sasty.
zh:
沙斯塔人是四个近亲群体的合称，包括沙斯塔本支、科诺米胡人、奥夸努丘人和新河沙斯塔人，都说霍坎大语系的语言，散布在加利福尼亚北部与俄勒冈南部的克拉马斯山区。沙斯塔本支自称卡霍萨迪，意为“说话平实的人”，又按水系分成若干支派。

他们的村落只有一两户人家，依溪涧而建；食物靠鲑鱼、在受控烧荒保持疏朗的森林里猎鹿，以及应季采集的橡子和根茎。“沙斯塔”这个名字并非他们的自称，而是经哈德逊湾公司商人彼得·斯肯·奥格登的记录流传开来：19世纪20年代，他成为第一个记下这个名字的欧美人，当时拼作萨斯蒂斯、萨斯蒂等形式。

en:
The She, who call themselves Shanke, or mountain guests, are an indigenous people of the south-eastern hills, concentrated in Fujian and Zhejiang. Their traditions point to Phoenix Mountain in Chaozhou as their birthplace. Northern migrants from the Qin dynasty onward pushed them from the Guangdong coast into the mountains, where they farmed by slash-and-burn and boiled salt from coastal pools.

By the Tang dynasty of 618–907 they held the border country of Fujian, Guangdong and Jiangxi and rose in risings that passed into Fujianese fiction. The name She-min, meaning the slash-and-burn people, first appears in late Southern Song records of the thirteenth century, when She salt producers on Lantau Island sailed against Canton in revolt.

During the Ming and Qing after 1368 they moved from northern Fujian into the mountains of southern Zhejiang and the lower Yangtze, pressed by Hakka settlers.
zh:
畲人自称山客，世居中国东南丘陵，以福建、浙江最为集中。他们的传说以潮州凤凰山为发源地。秦代以后北方移民南下，把他们从广东沿海挤入山区，靠刀耕火种为生，并在沿海煮盐。

到618—907年的唐代，他们活动在闽粤赣交界地带，曾掀起动乱，成为闽南小说的题材。“畲民”之称最早见于13世纪南宋末年的史书，“畲”即刀耕火种之意；当时大屿山的畲族盐民曾驾船攻打广州起事。

1368年以后的明清时期，他们受客家移民挤压，从闽北陆续迁入浙南山地和长江下游山区。

en:
The Shekhawati are the people of semi-arid north-eastern Rajasthan around Jhunjhunu, a country the epics counted within the ancient Matsya kingdom and whose speech is a Rajasthani dialect. Early medieval rulers were first Gaur and then Chauhan Rajputs, until the Chauhan lord Karamchand accepted Islam under Firuz Shah Tughluq as Kaimkhan, and his Kaimkhani descendants took the local towns.

In the fifteenth century the Kachwaha chieftain Rao Shekha built an independent state around Amarsar and gave the region its name, the garden of Shekha; his Shekhawat kinsmen took the Kaimkhani towns in 1445 and parcelled the country into thirty-three thikanas. Under Akbar, Raja Raisal and his sons rose high in Mughal service with confirmed estates.

Between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries Marwari merchants and Shekhawat lords covered the towns with painted havelis, temples and stepwells, turning Shekhawati into one of the richest fresco landscapes of India, while its chiefs remained the leading thakurs of the Jaipur raj.
zh:
沙卡瓦蒂人是拉贾斯坦东北部半干旱地区琼丘努一带的居民；史诗把这片土地归入古代摩差国，他们的方言是拉贾斯坦语的一支。中世纪早期，此地先后由高尔和乔汉两族拉其普特人统治，后来乔汉领主卡拉姆昌德在菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克治下皈依伊斯兰教，改名凯姆汗，其凯姆卡尼后裔占据了当地城镇。

15世纪，卡奇瓦哈部首领拉奥·谢卡在阿马尔萨尔周围建立独立政权，地区也因他得名“谢卡的花园”；他的沙卡瓦特族人于1445年攻取凯姆卡尼人的城镇，把国土分成三十三处提卡纳。阿克巴时期，拉贾·赖萨尔父子在莫卧儿军中身居高位，领地得到确认。

17至19世纪间，马尔瓦尔商人与沙卡瓦特王公在各城镇广建绘满壁画的哈维利宅邸、神庙和阶梯井，使沙卡瓦蒂成为印度壁画最密集的地区之一，而其首领始终是斋普尔邦最显贵的塔库尔。

en:
The Sherbro are an indigenous people of the Sierra Leone coast, centered on Sherbro Island and the creeks of Bonthe and Moyamba, where they live by fishing and coastal trade. They speak Sherbro, a Mel language, and in pre-colonial times were one of the dominant peoples of the coast.

Portuguese ships first reached them in the fifteenth century, and by the 1620s English factors were buying goods in the Sherbro Country; Sherbro chiefly families intermarried with Europeans, producing some of the region's leading ruling houses. In the eighteenth century the Sherbro grew powerful in the slave trade, hiring Mende parties inland to supply captives.

After Freetown was founded in 1792, the western Sherbro intermarried with liberated African settlers who became the Krio, while the eastern Sherbro drew close to the Mende and adopted much of their language and custom.
zh:
歇尔布罗人是塞拉利昂沿海的原住民，以歇尔布罗岛以及邦特、莫扬巴一带的河口水网为中心，靠捕鱼和沿海贸易为生。他们讲梅尔语支的歇尔布罗语，在前殖民时代是沿海最有势力的族群之一。

15世纪葡萄牙船只最先来到他们这里，到17世纪20年代，英国商馆代理已在歇尔布罗地区收购货物；歇尔布罗的酋长家族与欧洲人通婚，催生了当地几个显赫的统治世家。18世纪，歇尔布罗人靠奴隶贸易变得强盛，雇佣曼迪人深入内陆掳掠奴隶。

1792年弗里敦建立后，西部的歇尔布罗人与后来形成克里奥尔人的获释非洲定居者通婚，东部的歇尔布罗人则与曼迪人接近，大量采用了后者的语言和习俗。

en:
The Sherpa are a Tibetan people of the high Himalaya, centred on the Khumbu and Solu valleys of eastern Nepal beneath Mount Everest. Their name joins the Tibetan words shar, meaning east, and pa, meaning people, and recalls an origin in Kham in eastern Tibet.

Oral history derives them from four clans who left Kham in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, travelled through Ü and Tsang and crossed into the Himalayan valleys; those clans later split into more than twenty groups. By the 1400s the Khumbu Sherpa managed their own affairs within the emerging Nepali state.

They speak Sherpa, a southern Tibeto-Burman language coloured by Khams Tibetan dialects, and follow Tibetan Buddhism, maintaining monasteries called gompas above their villages alongside older Bon traditions.
zh:
夏尔巴人是喜马拉雅高山地带的藏族支系，聚居于尼泊尔东部珠穆朗玛峰脚下的昆布与索卢河谷。其名称由藏语意为“东”的“夏尔”和意为“人”的“巴”组成，提示他们起源于西藏东部的康区。

口传史称夏尔巴人源自四个氏族，他们在13至14世纪离开康区，经卫藏翻越山口进入喜马拉雅河谷，日后分化为二十多个氏族。到15世纪，昆布的夏尔巴人已在新兴的尼泊尔国家内自理事务。

他们讲夏尔巴语，这是一种带有康巴方言色彩的藏缅语南部语言，信奉藏传佛教，在村落上方建有名为“贡巴”的寺院，同时保留着较古老的苯教传统。

en:
The Shi, plural Bashi and singular Mushi, are a Bantu people of the South Kivu highlands, occupying the Mitumba mountain country called Bushi around Bukavu, between Lake Kivu and the equatorial forest. They speak Mashi, a Central Bantu language that served as a lingua franca across neighboring chiefdoms.
