佐亚哈人即尤奇人，16世纪时据有田纳西河东部河谷。其自称意为“太阳之子”，欧洲殖民者称他们为乌奇或尤奇。1541年，埃尔南多·德索托听说他们是与奇斯卡人结盟的强大部族。

17世纪末以后，切罗基人的扩张和疫病迫使他们南迁。1714年，切罗基人在卡罗来纳贸易商挑唆下摧毁了田纳西的切斯托维；查特胡奇河畔的大镇尤奇镇在1778年博得威廉·巴特拉的赞叹。他们向南部殖民地贩卖鹿皮和被俘为奴的人，但战争与疫病使人口锐减。

美国独立战争后，他们依附克里克联盟。许多人在1813—1814年的克里克战争中加入红棍派作战，并在19世纪30年代随克里克人一同被迁到密西西比河以西。

en:
The Tsuu'tina, long known to Europeans as the Sarcee from the Blackfoot name Saahsi, are the only Athabaskan-speaking people of the northern plains. Their Na-Dene tongue is related to those of the northern Dene, Navajo and Apache. Their name means the many people or the beaver people, and oral history remembers them as a branch of the Dane-zaa of the Peace and Athabasca country who moved south onto the plains in the early eighteenth century.

They kept the boreal-edge way of life, hunting moose and caribou in winter and gathering on the prairie for summer bison drives, living in tipis and divided into five independent bands.

In the 1810s the explorer David Thompson found them in the Beaver Hills near Edmonton alongside the Cree. Warfare with the Cree later pushed them south, where they joined the Blackfoot Confederacy and adopted much of their allies' plains culture.
zh:
楚特伊纳人在欧洲文献中长期被称为萨尔西人，得名于黑脚语的Saahsi。他们是北部草原上唯一讲阿萨巴斯卡语的民族，其纳-德内语与北方德内诸语、纳瓦霍语和阿帕切语同源。其族名意为“众人”或“海狸人”，口述传统称他们本是皮斯河、阿萨巴斯卡地区达内扎人的一支，18世纪初南迁进入大平原。

他们保留着针叶林边缘的生活方式：冬季猎驼鹿和驯鹿，夏天到草原集体围猎野牛，住锥形帐篷，分为五个独立群体。

19世纪10年代，探险家大卫·汤普森发现他们与克里人一同住在埃德蒙顿附近的海狸山。后来与克里人的交战把他们推向南方，他们遂加入黑脚联盟，大量接受了盟友的草原文化。

en:
The Tswana, who call themselves Batswana and speak Setswana, are a Sotho-Tswana Bantu people of the southern African interior. Their cattle-keeping ancestors are estimated to have entered around 600 CE. The Toutswe chiefdom traded ivory, gold and rhinoceros horn along the Limpopo route for Asian beads until its decline around 1300.

Tswana chiefdoms, merafe, were ruled by dikgosi through councils and customary law. Kaditshwene, founded by the Bahurutshe in the late 1400s, had around ten thousand people by the early nineteenth century. Records in 1824 show the Bangwaketse under Makaba II as the dominant power. The difaqane drove armed migrants into Tswana lands, sacking settlements and prompting stronger centralized chiefdoms.

Europeans arrived then. Missionary Robert Moffat opened the Kuruman station in 1824, printing a Setswana spelling book and catechism in 1826 and the first Scripture passages in 1830.
zh:
茨瓦纳人自称巴茨瓦纳，说塞茨瓦纳语，是南部非洲内陆索托-茨瓦纳系班图人。据估计，牧牛的祖先约在公元600年进入该地。措茨韦酋邦沿林波波河商路用象牙、黄金和犀牛角换亚洲珠子，约1300年衰落。

酋邦称“梅拉费”，首领称“迪科西”，依靠议事会和习惯法治理。巴胡鲁策人15世纪末建起卡迪特什韦内，19世纪初约有一万人。1824年记载显示，马卡巴二世治下的邦瓦凯策人是强权。迪法卡内大乱将武装流民推入茨瓦纳土地，聚居点遭洗劫，酋邦趋于集权。

欧洲人到来。1824年传教士罗伯特·莫法特开设库鲁曼传道站，1826年印塞茨瓦纳语拼字课本和教理问答，1830年出版最早经文片段。

en:
The Tuamotus, who call themselves Pa'umotu, are the Polynesian people of the Tuamotu Archipelago, nearly eighty atolls scattered across the South Pacific east of Tahiti. Settlers from the Society Islands reached these coral islands around the twelfth century and built marae ceremonial platforms of coral blocks on Rangiroa, Manihi and Mataiva. Their old religion venerated the creator Kiho.

They lived by fishing, coconut and breadfruit cultivation and pandanus weaving on islands whose only fresh water came from rain. Their Pa'umotu tongue, close to Tahitian, split into seven dialect areas as families moved between atolls.

Ferdinand Magellan made the first European sighting in 1521, and Queirós, Roggeveen, Cook and Kotzebue followed between 1606 and 1815. These visits did not alter a society that remained within the orbit of Tahiti's Pōmare dynasty, whose influence drew Pa'umotu toward the Tahitian language.
zh:
土阿莫土人自称保莫图人，是土阿莫土群岛的波利尼西亚居民；近八十座环礁散布在塔希提以东的南太平洋上。约12世纪，来自社会群岛的移民登上这些珊瑚岛，在朗吉罗阿、马尼希和马塔伊瓦用珊瑚石块修筑祭坛。他们的古老信仰崇奉创世神基霍。

岛民以捕鱼、种植椰子和面包果、编织露兜为生，岛上淡水全靠雨水。他们的保莫图语与塔希提语相近，因家族在环礁间迁徙而分化为七个方言区。

1521年麦哲伦最先望见这片群岛，1606—1815年间基罗斯、罗赫芬、库克和科策布又先后来访。这些访问没有改变当地社会，土阿莫土仍处于塔希提波马雷王朝的势力范围，塔希提语的影响也随之渗入保莫图语。

en:
The Tuareg are Berber-speaking nomadic pastoralists of the central Sahara, whose men wear the indigo tagelmust. They call themselves Kel Tamasheq, speakers of Tamasheq, written in Tifinagh. Their ancestors include the Garamantes and, by tradition, followers of queen Tin Hinan, whose fourth- or fifth-century tomb stands at Abalessa. Arab geographers knew them as veiled camel herders dominating trans-Saharan routes.

Confederations were led by an amenokal and elders. In the Aïr, Tuareg clans founded the Sultanate of Agadez around 1405 to mediate between feuding drum-groups; Agadez, built from 1413, became a hub linking the Hausa kingdoms with North Africa.

Songhai conquered the sultanate around 1500; it regained independence after the Moroccan destruction of Songhai in 1591. It declined in the seventeenth century as routes withered. In the eighteenth century new Tuareg confederacies pushed south into the Aïr, and the Kel Owey displaced the Kel Geres.
zh:
图阿雷格人是撒哈拉中部操柏柏尔语的游牧牧民，男子戴靛蓝色头巾“塔格尔穆斯特”。他们自称凯尔·塔马舍克，即塔马舍克语使用者，用提芬纳赫字母书写。先民包括加拉曼特人和传说中女王廷·希南的追随者，其4—5世纪陵墓在阿巴莱萨。阿拉伯地理学家称他们为蒙面的骆驼牧人，控制跨撒哈拉商路。

联盟由阿门努卡尔和长老统领。艾尔诸部约于1405年建立阿加德兹苏丹国，仲裁战鼓联盟纷争；1413年起兴建的阿加德兹城成为连接豪萨诸王国与北非的枢纽。

苏丹国约1500年被桑海征服，1591年摩洛哥击灭桑海后复独立，17世纪随商路衰落。18世纪新的图阿雷格联盟南下艾尔，凯尔奥韦人逐走凯尔盖雷斯人。

en:
The Tǔbái are the Yue-speaking Han people of the Xun River basin in central Guangxi, around the former Xunzhou prefecture. Their vernacular, Tǔbáihuà, is classed among the Goulou dialects of Yue, closely related to the Pinghua of southern Guangxi.

Under the Tang, Xunzhou was revived with its seat at Guiping in 633, and in 1368 the Ming made it a prefecture. Through much of the Ming the steep Great Vine Gorge upstream was a stronghold of Yao and Zhuang rebels. Their uprisings were crushed in campaigns led by Han Yong in 1465, Wang Shouren in 1528 and Cai Jing in 1539.

Under the Qing the Wuxuan district was added to the prefecture during the Yongzheng reign, and Guiping became the busiest river port of eastern Guangxi after Wuzhou, carrying goods towards Guangdong.
zh:
土白人是广西中部浔江流域讲粤语的汉族民系，聚居于旧时浔州府一带。他们的口语俗称土白话，属粤语勾漏片，与桂南平话关系密切。

唐代633年浔州复置，治所定在桂平；1368年明朝改浔州为府。明代的大部分时间里，上游险峻的大藤峡是瑶、壮起义者的根据地。1465年韩雍、1528年王守仁、1539年蔡经先后征讨，将起事平定。

清代雍正年间，武宣一带划入浔州府；桂平成为广西东部仅次于梧州的商埠，货物由此运往广东。

en:
The Tubalars, who call themselves tuba kizhi or forest people, are a Northern Altaian Turkic people living along the Biya and Lake Teletskoye. They formed from Turkic clans merging with taiga natives during the age of Yenisei Kyrgyz dominance.

When the Mongols conquered the Altai in the thirteenth century, the Tubalars withdrew into the forest and were gradually made to pay tribute in squirrel and sable skins. In the seventeenth century they were tributaries of the Altyn Khans and then the Dzungars, while resisting Russian Cossacks until their defeat in 1627 to 1629; many paid sables to the tsar and iron kettles and tripods to the Dzungars.

Organized in hereditary seok clans, they became Russian subjects in the first quarter of the eighteenth century. They hunted in the taiga, later gathered cedar nuts, venerated the cedar as sacred, and kept shamanic practices alongside Russian Orthodoxy.
zh:
图巴拉尔人自称“图巴基日”，意为林中之人，是北阿尔泰系的突厥语民族，住在比亚河沿岸和捷列茨科耶湖畔。他们是在叶尼塞黠戛斯称雄时期，由突厥氏族与泰加林土著融合而成。

13世纪蒙古征服阿尔泰时，图巴拉尔人退入森林，后来逐渐被征收松鼠皮和紫貂皮。17世纪他们先是阿勒坦汗、后是准噶尔的贡民，同时抵抗俄国哥萨克，直到1627—1629年战败；许多人向沙皇交紫貂皮，又向准噶尔交铁锅和铁三脚架。

他们按世袭的“塞奥克”氏族组织，18世纪第一个二十五年成为俄国臣民。他们在泰加林狩猎，后来兼采雪松籽，把雪松奉为神树，在俄罗斯东正教之外仍保留萨满习俗。

en:
Tuckabatchee was a Muscogee tribal town on the Tallapoosa River in Alabama, one of the four mother towns of the Muscogee Creek confederacy and part of the Upper Creeks. It stood from at least 1690 until after 1835. The town was remembered as the first hearth of the sacred busk fire that opened the Green Corn Ceremony.

In 1811 the Shawnee leaders Tecumseh and Tenskwatawa addressed Creek leaders in its square, urging resistance to American expansion. It was home to Big Warrior, one of the two principal Creek chiefs until his death in 1826.

During the Creek War of 1813 Red Stick rebels drove out the chiefs and destroyed Tuckabatchee. Its people were escorted to safety at Coweta by warriors from Cusseta and Coweta; the town was rebuilt and lasted until the removals west after 1835.
zh:
塔卡巴契是阿拉巴马州塔拉普萨河畔的马斯科吉部族城镇，也是马斯科吉克里克联盟四大母镇之一，属上克里克一支。它至迟从1690年起存续到1835年以后。传说这里是青玉米节开场时点燃的圣布斯克圣火最早的火源。

1811年，肖尼族领袖特库姆塞与滕斯夸塔瓦在镇广场向克里克首领演说，号召抵抗美国人的扩张。这里也是大勇士的居所，他在1826年去世前是克里克两大首席酋长之一。

1813年克里克战争期间，红棍派叛军赶走首领、摧毁塔卡巴契。居民由卡西塔和考维塔的武士护送到考维塔避难；村镇后来重建，一直存续到1835年之后族人西迁之时。

en: The Tugochar were an Evenki-speaking Tungus clan group of the Tompo and upper Aldan taiga in eastern Yakutia, around the Khandyga river. After the founding of Yakutsk in 1632, cossack parties brought the Tungus rods of the Aldan basin under the fur tribute, or yasak; they lived as mobile elk hunters and reindeer herders in skin and birch-bark tents.
zh: 图戈恰尔人是说鄂温克语的通古斯氏族群体，活动在雅库特东部通波河与阿尔丹河上游、汉德加河一带的泰加林。1632年雅库茨克堡建立后，哥萨克逐步向阿尔丹河流域的通古斯氏族征收毛皮贡赋牙萨克；他们住兽皮和桦树皮帐篷，作为流动的猎驼鹿人和驯鹿牧民生活。

en:
The Tujia, endonym Bizika meaning 'native dwellers', are people of the Wuling Mountains where Hunan, Hubei, Guizhou and Sichuan meet. Their Chinese name means 'local families', and many scholars trace their roots to the ancient Ba people, whose kingdom Qin swallowed in 316 BCE.

The name Tujia appears in records from the fourteenth century, when hereditary tusi chieftains ruled them under loose imperial oversight. In 1337 their lands ran from the hills of northwestern Hunan to Youyang in eastern Sichuan, home of the Yongshun Peng chieftains, whose seat Laosicheng dated from 1135 to 1724. Under the Ming the chieftains reached their height, famed for troops sent against the coastal wokou raiders in the sixteenth century.

The Qing imposed direct rule in 1728–1735, abolishing the chiefdoms and imposing Chinese customs. Their language is often treated as an isolate within Sino-Tibetan, while Tujia culture found expression in the Baishou dance and the xilankapu brocade once delivered as tribute.
zh:
土家人自称毕兹卡，意为“本地人”，世居湖南、湖北、贵州、四川四省交界的武陵山区。汉文里的“土家”意为当地人家；不少学者把族源上溯到古代巴人，巴国于公元前316年被秦国吞并。

“土家”一名从14世纪起见于史籍，当时由世袭土司在朝廷的松散羁縻下治理。1337年时，其疆土从湘西北山地延伸到川东酉阳，永顺彭氏土司以老司城为治所，自1135年直至1724年。明代是土家土司的鼎盛期，16世纪他们奉调抗击沿海倭寇。

清代在1728—1735年实行改土归流，废除土司、推行汉地风俗。土家语在汉藏语系中常被视为孤立语言，而土家文化集中体现在摆手舞和曾作为贡品的西兰卡普织锦之中。

en:
The Dukun-deka were the Tukudeka, the Mountain Sheepeaters of the Shoshone, named for the bighorn sheep they hunted across the high country; duku meant both bighorn ram and meat in Shoshone. Their homeland ran from the Sawtooth Range and upper Salmon River of Idaho into southern Montana and the Yellowstone plateaus of north-western Wyoming. Speaking Central Numic Shoshone, they moved in small fluid bands and intermarried with the Lemhi and other Shoshone.

The first Europeans entered their mountains in 1824. When the trapper Osborne Russell met a band in Yellowstone in 1834 he found neatly dressed people with pack-dogs, obsidian-tipped arrows, horn bows and fine sheep and elk skins ready to trade for axes, kettles and ammunition.
zh:
杜昆德卡人即图库德卡人，是肖肖尼人的“山地食羊者”支群，因在高山地带猎取大角羊而得名；在肖肖尼语里，“杜库”兼指大角公羊和肉。他们的家园从爱达荷的索图斯山脉和萨尔蒙河上游延伸到蒙大拿南部以及怀俄明西北的黄石高原。他们说中努米克语支的肖肖尼语，以松散的小群迁徙，与莱姆哈伊等肖肖尼支群通婚。

欧洲人最早在1824年进入他们的山区。1834年，猎人奥斯本·拉塞尔在黄石遇到其中一群，发现他们衣着齐整，带着驮狗、黑曜石箭头、兽角弓和上好的羊皮、鹿皮，愿意用这些交换斧头、铁锅和弹药。

en:
The Tula were a Caddoan people of western Arkansas, whose homeland probably lay along the upper Arkansas, Ouachita and Little Missouri rivers and in the northern Ouachita Mountains. They are known almost entirely from the chronicles of Hernando de Soto's expedition, which entered their territory near Fort Smith in September 1541 and fought several sharp battles with them; the Spanish described them as the finest warriors they had met in North America.

The chroniclers noted facial tattooing, cranial deformation and long spears. Probably the first Caddo band to meet Europeans, the Tula later disappeared from the records and are thought to have merged into the Kadohadacho, whose descendants belong to the Caddo Nation of Oklahoma.
zh:
图利亚人是阿肯色州西部的卡多语族群，故土可能位于阿肯色河、沃希托河和小密苏里河上游及沃希托山脉北麓一带。后世对他们的了解几乎全部来自埃尔南多·德·索托远征队的记载：1541年9月，远征队在史密斯堡附近进入图利亚人的地盘，并与他们数次激战，西班牙人称之为在北美遇到过的最强战士。

编年史家记下了他们面部刺青、颅骨变形和使用长矛的习俗。图利亚人很可能是最早接触欧洲人的卡多人支系，此后便从记载中消失，一般认为他们并入了卡多哈达乔人，其后裔是俄克拉荷马州卡多族的组成部分。

en:
The Tulumni were the southernmost Yokuts tribes, living around Buena Vista and Kern Lakes in the Tulare Basin, where the Kern River ended in marshes and shallow lakes. Their villages included Tulamni, Hometwoli and Tuhohi, and they spoke the Buena Vista dialects of the Yokuts language; Hometwoli means Southerners.

Lake fishing, waterfowl, roots and acorns sustained their permanent villages. They traded and intermarried with Chumash groups to the south, and the Emigdiano speech of San Emigdio mixed Barbareno Chumash with Buena Vista Yokuts words.

Spanish soldiers first passed through their country in 1772, and inland missions after 1800 drew off villagers as laborers. In 1833 a malaria epidemic spread through the Tulare basin sweat houses and emptied whole villages, leaving the lake peoples much reduced.
zh:
图卢姆尼人是约库特人最南边的一支，住在图莱里盆地的布埃纳维斯塔湖与克恩湖一带，克恩河在那里注入沼泽和浅水湖群。他们的村落包括图拉姆尼、霍姆特沃利和图霍希，讲约库特语的布埃纳维斯塔各方言；霍姆特沃利意为“南方人”。

湖畔渔捞、水禽、块根和橡子供养着他们的定居村落。他们与南方的丘马什诸部贸易通婚，圣埃米迪奥的埃米迪亚诺话在巴尔巴雷诺丘马什语中混入了布埃纳维斯塔约库特语词汇。

1772年，西班牙士兵首次经过他们的地界；1800年后，内陆传教站掳走村民充当劳力。1833年，一场疟疾沿图莱里盆地的汗房蔓延，整村死散，湖畔诸部人口大为凋零。

en:
The Tuluva are a Dravidian people of Tulu Nadu, the coastal strip between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea. Their country is named in the Sangam Tamil anthologies as one of the twelve regions of ancient Tamilakam.

From about the fifth to the fourteenth century the Alupa dynasty ruled from Mangalore and Barkur, first independently and later as loose feudatories of the Kadambas, Chalukyas, Hoysalas and Vijayanagara. Under Vijayanagara the country grew wealthy on Arabian Sea trade, and this coast produced the Tuluva dynasty that later sat on the Vijayanagara throne.

After the empire's fall the Keladi Nayakas of Ikkeri took over, and refugees arrived from Portuguese Goa. Hyder Ali conquered the region in the later eighteenth century; after Tipu Sultan's defeat in 1799 it passed to the British. Tulu society kept matrilineal Aliyasantana inheritance, Yakshagana theatre and the spirit ceremony of Bhuta Kola.
zh:
图卢人是图卢纳德的达罗毗荼语族群，聚居在西高止山与阿拉伯海之间的沿海地带。桑伽姆时代的泰米尔诗集把此地列为古代泰米拉卡姆十二个地区之一。

约5至14世纪，阿卢帕王朝以门格洛尔和巴尔库尔为中心统治，起初独立，后来成为卡丹巴、遮娄其、曷萨拉和毗奢耶那伽罗等王朝名义上的附庸。毗奢耶那伽罗治下，该地凭阿拉伯海贸易致富，这一带还走出了日后登上毗奢耶那伽罗帝位的图卢瓦王朝。

帝国衰落后，伊凯里的凯拉迪纳亚克接管此地，难民从葡属果阿迁入。18世纪后期海德尔·阿里征服该地区，1799年提普苏丹败亡后它转入英国之手。图卢社会保留母系继承的阿里亚桑塔纳制度、夜叉伽纳纳戏剧和布塔·科拉祭灵仪式。

en:
The name Tumaco recalls the Tumaco-La Tolita culture, a pre-Columbian archaeological tradition of the Pacific coast from Esmeraldas in Ecuador to Buenaventura in Colombia. Its roots lay in the Chorrera culture: La Tolita island was settled by 600 BC, and by 350 BC a distinctive Tumaco-La Tolita style had emerged.

Its people built earthen mounds called tolas, made fine ceramics, and worked gold; they were also the first craftsmen known to have worked platinum. After a florescence of some seven centuries the tradition changed with the El Morro phase from AD 350, La Tolita was abandoned around AD 400, and between 500 and 700 the coastal settlements were gradually depopulated.

The language of these ancient coast-dwellers is unknown. By 1337 their former lands were held by later peoples of the Colombian Pacific, whose descendants the Spanish later encountered on the same shores.
zh:
图马科这个名字对应图马科-拉托利塔文化，这是太平洋沿岸的前哥伦布时期考古学文化，范围从厄瓜多尔的埃斯梅拉达斯延伸到哥伦比亚的布埃纳文图拉。它源于乔雷拉文化：拉托利塔岛在公元前600年已有人居住，到公元前350年形成了独特的图马科-拉托利塔风格。

其先民修筑名为托拉的土墩，制作精美陶器，加工黄金，也是已知最早加工白金的工匠。繁荣约七百年后，这一传统在公元350年起的埃尔莫罗阶段发生转变，拉托利塔岛约在公元400年被废弃，500年至700年间沿海聚落逐渐人烟稀少。

这些古代沿海居民的语言已无从考证。到1337年，他们的故地已由哥伦比亚太平洋沿岸的后来族群占据，西班牙人后来在同一片海岸遇到的是这些族群的后裔。

en:
The Tumbalalá are an Indigenous people of the Pambú sertão, the dry backlands along the Bahia bank of the São Francisco River. They trace their origins to the old mission settlement of Pambú near Rodelas, and are historically linked to the Kariri and Procá peoples.

From the seventeenth century Portuguese cattle ranches and river-island missions transformed the region. The Capuchin Martin de Nantes, whose mission account was printed in 1706, served the Dzubukuá Kariri of the Pambú island mission. In 1749 the river islands still held ten missions, including Nossa Senhora da Conceição on Pambú island.

The Tumbalalá came to speak Portuguese, preserving only ritual words from the old Cariri tongue. That language belonged neither to the Jê nor to the Tupi family.
zh:
通巴拉拉人是圣弗朗西斯科河巴伊亚一侧干旱腹地潘布塞尔陶的原住民。他们的渊源可追溯到罗德拉斯附近的古老传教村潘布，历史上与卡里里人、普罗卡人相关。

17世纪起，葡萄牙人的牧场和河岛传教站改变了这一地区。嘉布遣会修士南特的马丁曾在潘布岛传教站为祖布库阿分支的卡里里人服务，他的传教记录于1706年刊印。1749年，河岛上仍有十座传教站，潘布岛上的圣母无原罪站便是其中之一。

通巴拉拉人后来使用葡萄牙语，只在仪式用语中保留古卡里里语的词汇。这门语言既非热语也非图皮语。

en:
The Tumbuka were a Bantu people of the plateau between northern Lake Malawi and the Luangwa valley. Oral tradition traces them to the Luba kingdom farther west, from which they migrated in the early fifteenth century; they settled in small, loosely organised communities of finger-millet farmers and goat herders.

They spoke Chitumbuka, a Bantu language with many dialects. From the mid-eighteenth century ivory traders from Unyamwezi, financed by merchants of Kilwa and Zanzibar, crossed Lake Malawi in search of tusks.

One such trader, remembered as Mlowoka, settled in the Nkhamanga area around 1775, and his successors built the Chikulamayembe kingship, conventionally dated to about 1805, which drew the scattered Tumbuka clans into a single kingdom. By the 1830s pressure from coastal Swahili traders was weakening the new dynasty.
zh:
通布卡人是班图人的一支，生活在马拉维湖北端与卢安瓜河谷之间的高原上。口传史称他们来自更西边的卢巴王国，15世纪初东迁至此，以组织松散的小型村社定居，种植穇子、放牧山羊。

他们操奇通布卡语，属班图语系，方言众多。18世纪中叶，受基尔瓦和桑给巴尔商人资助、来自乌尼亚姆韦齐的象牙商渡过马拉维湖收购象牙。

一位名叫姆洛沃卡的商人约在1775年定居恩卡曼加一带，他的后继者建立了约始于1805年的奇库拉马延贝王统，把分散的通布卡诸氏族纳入同一个王国。到19世纪30年代，沿海斯瓦希里商人的压力已使这个新王朝走向衰落。

en:
The Tümed were a Mongol people of the southern steppe. Their forebears, the Khori-Tumed, lived west of Lake Baikal until Genghis Khan conquered them in 1207 and resettled part south of the Gobi. They re-emerged in the mid-fifteenth century, and under Dayan Khan and his successors formed the right wing of the eastern Mongols, grouped as the twelve Tümed.

Altan Khan (1507–1582) raided the Ming frontier. In 1578 Altan met the monk Sonam Gyatso and the Tümed embraced Tibetan Buddhism, the first Mongol tribe to do so; the title Dalai Lama was born from that alliance. In the early seventeenth century they submitted to the rising Qing and were later organized into the Josutu League.
zh:
土默特是南部草原的蒙古部众。其先民豁里—土默特原居贝加尔湖以西，1207年成吉思汗将其征服后，把一部分部众南迁到大漠以南。15世纪中叶，土默特作为有名号的部落重新出现；在达延汗及其后继者治下，它构成东蒙古右翼，组成“十二土默特”联盟。

俺答汗（1507—1582年）屡掠明朝边地。1578年俺答汗与高僧索南嘉措会面，土默特由此皈依藏传佛教，成为最早改宗的蒙古部落，“达赖喇嘛”的称号也源自这次结盟。17世纪初，土默特归附清朝，后来被编入卓索图盟。

en:
The Yoron, better known as the Tunica, were a farming and trading people of the middle Mississippi valley whose language, Luhchi Yoroni, was a language isolate. In 1541 Hernando de Soto found their province of Quizquiz, a land of palisaded towns and maize fields.

Epidemics and Quapaw pressure later drove them to the Yazoo mouth, where a French mission was founded around 1700 and they prospered in trade. Chickasaw slave raiders seized perhaps two thousand of their people, and in 1706 the Tunica moved to the Red River mouth. They sheltered Natchez refugees, who attacked them in 1731; the Tunica then moved to Trudeau Landing, whose graves yielded European trade goods.

They moved to Pointe Coupee in 1764 and joined the Spanish capture of Baton Rouge in 1779. In the 1790s they settled around Marksville, absorbing the Ofo, Avoyel and Biloxi peoples.
zh:
约伦人（即图尼卡人）是密西西比河中游的农耕贸易族群，他们的卢赫奇约罗尼语是一种孤立语言。1541年，埃尔南多·德·索托发现了他们的基斯基斯省，那里遍布设栅城镇和玉米田。

后来疫病和夸保人的压力把他们驱到亚祖河口，约1700年法国人在那里设立传教站，图尼卡人则靠贸易致富。奇克索奴隶贩子可能掳走了他们约两千人，1706年他们迁到雷德河口。1731年，遭他们收留的纳奇兹难民突袭，他们便迁往特鲁多兰丁，当地墓葬出土了欧洲商货。

1764年他们迁往普安特库佩，1779年又随西班牙军攻克巴吞鲁日。18世纪90年代，他们在马克斯维尔一带定居，吸收了奥福人、阿沃耶尔人和比洛克西人。

en:
The Tunisian are the Arabic-speaking, largely Arabized people of Ifriqiya in the northeastern Maghreb around Tunis, whose speech has a Berber, Latin and Neo-Punic substratum beneath Hilalian Arabic. The Arabs founded Kairouan in 670, and Ifriqiya became the seat of the Aghlabids and then of the Fatimid caliphs at Mahdia; when the Zirids renounced Cairo, the Fatimids loosed the Banu Hilal, whose Haydaran victory in 1052 broke the old order, spreading Bedouin Arabic.

Under the Almohads Tunis became the provincial capital, and in 1229 Abu Zakariya Yahya founded the Hafsid kingdom there, which welcomed Andalusi refugees, built the Maghreb's first madrasas and patronized the Zaytuna. Ibn Khaldun, born in Tunis in 1332, wrote the Muqaddimah in this milieu.

The Ottomans took Tunis in 1574, and after deys and Muradid beys, Husayn ibn Ali founded the Husainid beylik in 1705, keeping its own army and currency under loose Ottoman suzerainty.
zh:
突尼斯人是伊非里基亚操阿拉伯语、以阿拉伯化居民为主体的族群，聚居突尼斯一带；方言以希拉勒阿拉伯语为主体，底层留有柏柏尔语、拉丁语和新布匿语痕迹。670年阿拉伯人建凯鲁万，伊非里基亚先后成为艾格莱卜王朝、马赫迪耶法蒂玛哈里发的核心；齐尔王朝背弃开罗后，法蒂玛放出巴努希拉尔部，1052年海达兰一战瓦解旧秩序，贝都因阿拉伯语传开。

穆瓦希德时期突尼斯成为行省首府；1229年阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚建立哈夫斯王国，接纳安达卢西亚难民，兴建马格里布最早的经学院，扶持宰图纳学术。1332年生于突尼斯的伊本·赫勒敦写成《历史绪论》。

1574年奥斯曼攻占突尼斯；历经德伊与穆拉德贝伊统治，侯赛因·伊本·阿里1705年建侯赛因贝伊政权，在奥斯曼的松散宗主权下保有军队和货币。

en:
The Tunjur, or Tungur, were a Sunni Muslim people of eastern Chad and western Sudan. Their origins are disputed: their own traditions claim Arab descent, while the archaeologist Claude Rilly traces them to Christian Nubia, deriving their name from Tungul, the old name of Dongola.

In the 1200s they peacefully took power from the Daju in Darfur and Wadai; their capital at Ain Farah has yielded Christian iconography. In the 1500s an Arab group overthrew them and founded the Keira dynasty of Darfur; the last Tunjur ruler, Shau Dorshid, was driven out by his own people, and the survivors merged into the Fur.

Around 1650 Abd-el-Kerim of the Bargo expelled the Tunjur from Wadai, and they migrated westward, adopting the Maliki school of Sunni Islam. Their own Tunjur language became extinct, replaced by Chadian Arabic, Fur and Bari.
zh:
通朱尔人（又作图古尔人）是乍得东部和苏丹西部的逊尼派穆斯林族群。其来源众说纷纭：本族口述传统自称阿拉伯后裔，考古学家克洛德·里利则认为他们出自基督教努比亚，并把族名上溯到栋古拉的旧称通古勒。

13世纪，他们在达尔富尔和瓦达伊和平取代达朱人，其都城艾因法拉遗址曾出土基督教圣像。16世纪，一个阿拉伯集团推翻他们，建立达尔富尔的凯拉王朝；末代通朱尔统治者绍·多尔希德被本族人驱逐，余部逐渐融入富尔人。

约1650年，巴尔戈人的阿卜杜勒-克里姆把通朱尔人逐出瓦达伊，他们向西迁徙，改奉逊尼派伊斯兰教的马立克学派。本族的通朱尔语后来消亡，改操乍得阿拉伯语、富尔语或巴里语。

en:
The Túnxī culture is the heart of old Huizhou, the mountain pocket of southern Anhui around Tunxi, Xiuning and Yixian, reaching Wuyuan across the Jiangxi border. The Song renamed She Prefecture Huizhou in 1211, and its six counties kept their bounds for roughly eight hundred years.

Isolated by the terrain, each township developed its own form of Huizhou speech, variously assigned to Wu, Gan or a branch of Chinese of its own. The Tunxi variety represents its Xiu-Yi subgroup.

Poor farmland pushed the natives into trade. From the Ming onward Huizhou merchants dealt in salt, tea, ink and books across the Yangtze valley, while publishing houses and Hui opera troupes flourished at home; in the eighteenth century those troupes traveled to the capital and helped shape Peking opera. The merchants' wealth left the white-walled, horse-head-gabled mansions and memorial archways of Yixian.
zh:
屯溪文化是古徽州的核心，地处皖南山坳，以屯溪、休宁、黟县为中心，并越过省界连到江西婺源。1211年宋代改歙州为徽州，下辖六县，辖境在此后约八百年间基本未变。

重山阻隔使各乡镇的方言差别极大，学者或将徽语归入吴语、赣语，或单列为汉语的一支。屯溪话是徽语休黟片的代表。

山多田少，本地人出外经商。从明代起，徽商在长江流域经营盐业、茶叶、徽墨和刻书，家乡的书坊和徽班也因之兴盛；18世纪徽班北上进京，日后参与催生了京剧。徽商的财富留下了黟县粉墙马头墙的宅第和牌坊。

en:
The Tupinambá were the leading Tupi-Guarani people of the Brazilian coast, where perhaps a hundred thousand lived in the sixteenth century. Their forebears had spread along the coast in the Tupi migrations of roughly 700 to 1200, displacing or absorbing older non-Tupi peoples.

They lived in stockaded villages, farmed manioc and sweet potato, and waged ritual war in which captured enemies were honorably killed and eaten. These customs inspired Montaigne's essay Of Cannibals.

After 1500 they first traded and raided alongside the Portuguese, but slaving and their French alliance in Guanabara drew them into war. The Tamoio confederation led by Cunhambebe was broken by the Jesuit-brokered peace of Iperoig, and the Portuguese destroyed the Guanabara and Cabo Frio villages in the later sixteenth century. Their Old Tupi language lived on as the Nheengatu lingua geral of the Amazon interior.
zh:
图皮南巴人是巴西沿海最主要的图皮—瓜拉尼族群，16世纪人口可能达十万。其先民在约700—1200年的图皮人大迁徙中沿海岸扩散，驱逐或同化了更早的非图皮居民。

他们居住在木栅村落里，种植木薯和甘薯，并进行仪式性战争：被俘的敌人会被体面地处死并食用。蒙田据此写成随笔《论食人部落》。

1500年以后，他们起初与葡萄牙人联手贸易和劫掠，但奴隶掳掠以及他们在瓜纳巴拉与法国人结盟，使他们卷入战争。库尼亚姆贝贝领导的塔莫约联盟被耶稣会斡旋的伊佩罗伊格和约瓦解，葡萄牙人又在16世纪后半叶摧毁了瓜纳巴拉和卡布弗里乌的村落。他们的古图皮语则作为亚马逊内陆的通用语恩加图语延续下来。

en:
The Tupiniquim are a Tupi-Guarani people whose name means the neighboring Tupi, kin and rivals of the Tupinambá along the Brazilian shore. In the sixteenth century the name covered two groups, one in southern Bahia and another around the Santos lowlands and São Paulo plateau.

They were among the first Brazilians to meet Europeans, encountering the Portuguese fleet at Porto Seguro in April 1500 and choosing alliance. Tupiniquim warriors and porters backed the colonization of Santos and Bertioga and stood beside the Jesuit Manuel da Nóbrega at the founding of São Paulo in 1554. Smallpox and other epidemics in mission villages such as Aldeia Nova and Reis Magos sharply reduced their numbers.

In 1610 a Jesuit secured them a royal land grant, surveyed in 1760 around Nova Almeida. There a community of three thousand kept Tupiniquim identity alive into the early nineteenth century.
zh:
图皮尼金人是图皮—瓜拉尼语族群，族名意为“旁边的图皮人”，是图皮南巴人在巴西海岸的亲族与对手。16世纪时，这个名字涵盖两个群体：一支在巴伊亚南部，另一支在桑托斯低地和圣保罗高原一带。

他们是最早接触欧洲人的巴西原住民之一，1500年4月在塞古鲁港遇到葡萄牙船队，选择与之结盟。图皮尼金战士和挑夫支持了桑托斯与贝尔蒂奥加的殖民，又在1554年随耶稣会士曼努埃尔·达·诺布雷加参与建立圣保罗城。阿尔德亚诺瓦、雷斯马戈斯等传教村中的天花等疫病使他们人口锐减。

1610年，一位耶稣会士为他们争取到王室份地，1760年才在新阿尔梅达一带完成丈量。当地三千居民使图皮尼金人的认同延续到19世纪初。

en:
The Turkana were an Eastern Nilotic people of the arid basin around Lake Turkana in north-western Kenya, where they lived as semi-nomadic camel and zebu cattle herders, calling themselves ŋiTurkana and their country Turkan.

They belonged to the Ateker cluster of related peoples and entered the basin from the north before breaking away in conflicts with their kin. By the 1600s they and their allies occupied the whole basin, organised in two great divisions, the Ngimonia and Ngichuuro.

Pushing east they met the Rendille and Boran, and the Samburu, whom they called the Kor; by the end of the eighteenth century demographic pressure and drought were driving them into the highland pastures held by the Siger. Diviners known as ngimurok guided a society that styled itself the people of the grey bull.
zh:
图尔卡纳人是东尼罗河语族群，住在肯尼亚西北部图尔卡纳湖周围的干旱盆地，以半游牧方式放养骆驼和瘤牛，自称恩伊图尔卡纳，称自己的土地为图尔坎。

他们属于阿特克尔亲缘群，从北方进入盆地，后在与同族的冲突中独立出来。到17世纪，他们及其盟友已占满整个盆地，社会分为恩吉莫尼亚和恩吉丘罗两大支。

东进途中，他们遇到伦迪尔人、博兰人以及被他们称为科尔的桑布鲁人；到18世纪末，人口压力和干旱又驱使他们进入西格尔人占据的高地草场。名为恩吉穆罗克的占卜师辅佐着这个自称为灰牛之民的社会。

en:
The Turks of Anatolia speak an Oghuz Turkic language and are mostly Sunni Muslims, with a large Alevi minority. Turkic settlers from Central Asia entered with the Seljuk Turks, whose victory at Manzikert in 1071 opened Anatolia to migration. The Sultanate of Rum, founded in 1077, ruled from Konya until the Mongol victory at Köse Dağ in 1243 made it a vassal.

As Ilkhanid power faded after about 1277, Turkish lords founded competing beyliks across western and central Anatolia, among them Karaman and the small Ottoman beylik near Söğüt. While related Turkoman tribes stayed nomadic, settled Turks farmed, traded and worked crafts.

The Ottoman line expanded under Osman I and Orhan, who took Bursa in 1326 and crossed into Europe in 1354; Mehmed II took Constantinople in 1453, and under Suleiman the Magnificent the Ottoman Empire stretched into Hungary, Iraq and North Africa. The failed 1683 siege of Vienna and the 1699 Treaty of Karlowitz began a long contraction of the Turkish-speaking world back toward Anatolia.
zh:
安纳托利亚土耳其人说乌古斯突厥语，多属逊尼派，也有众多阿列维派。中亚突厥移民随塞尔柱人而来，1071年曼齐刻尔特一战击败拜占庭，打开迁入安纳托利亚的大门。1077年建立的鲁姆苏丹国以科尼亚为都，1243年克塞山一战被蒙古击败、沦为附庸。

1277年前后伊尔汗国衰退后，土耳其王公在安纳托利亚中西部建起卡拉曼和瑟于特附近的奥斯曼等贝伊国。同族突厥蛮部落仍过游牧生活，定居的土耳其人则务农、经商、做工。

奥斯曼一支在奥斯曼一世和奥尔汗治下扩张，1326年取布尔萨，1354年跨入欧洲；穆罕默德二世1453年攻克君士坦丁堡，苏莱曼大帝在位时帝国版图伸入匈牙利、伊拉克和北非。1683年维也纳围城失败与1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》开启土耳其语世界退回安纳托利亚的收缩。

en:
The Turkmens are the Oghuz Turkic people of the southeastern Caspian shore and the Khorasan steppe. Known as Oghuz, they took the name Turkmen by the Middle Ages, and the Bayandur and Afshar tribes gave rise to the Aq Qoyunlu and later the Afsharid dynasties.

While many Oghuz moved west with the Seljuks, those around the Aral and Caspian seas kept a semi-nomadic life. They adopted Islam between the twelfth and fourteenth centuries, largely through Sufi orders, often keeping older steppe customs. Around 1337 their clans grazed flocks from Gorgan to the Western Khorasan pastures around Bojnurd.

Their semi-nomadic structure let them weather the Mongol era, but Timur's campaigns later swept the region. After his death their lands were contested by the Safavids and Uzbek khanates; the Afshar Turkmen Nader Shah seized the Persian throne in the eighteenth century.
zh:
土库曼人是生活在里海东南岸与呼罗珊草原的乌古斯突厥人。他们原称乌古斯，到中世纪已改用土库曼之名，巴扬杜尔和阿夫沙尔部落后来分别建立白羊王朝和阿夫沙尔王朝。

许多乌古斯人随塞尔柱人西迁，留在咸海、里海一带的部落则保持半游牧生活。他们在12至14世纪间主要经苏菲派之手改宗伊斯兰教，又常保留草原旧俗。1337年前后，他们的牧场从戈尔甘延伸到博季努尔德一带的西呼罗珊草地。

半游牧的社会组织使他们熬过了蒙古时代，但其后帖木儿的征战席卷该地。帖木儿死后，他们的土地又被萨法维王朝与乌兹别克汗国争夺，而阿夫沙尔部的土库曼人纳迪尔沙在18世纪登上波斯王位。

en:
Turkoman, or Turkmen, was the medieval name for the Muslim Oghuz Turks. From the tenth century Islamic writers used it for Oghuz converts to Islam, as against the Tengrist Turks of the steppe; by the thirteenth century the Oghuz had adopted it themselves. Their ancestors formed the Oghuz Yabgu confederation between the Aral and Caspian, and in the eleventh century tribes such as the Qınıq followed the Seljuks westward. After Manzikert in 1071 they spread across Anatolia, Azerbaijan, Syria and Iraq, where military settlements guarded the new frontier.

Unlike settled Turkish townspeople, many Turkoman clans kept a semi-nomadic pastoral life, organized in tribes such as the Kayı and Afshar, speaking Old Anatolian Turkish. In 1337 they ranged from the Konya plains to the Pontic coast and Antioch, manpower for the Anatolian beyliks.

Later in the fourteenth century the Qara Qoyunlu and Aq Qoyunlu federations built empires over eastern Anatolia, Azerbaijan and Persia, while those absorbed by the Ottomans gradually came to be called Ottomans rather than Turkomans.
zh:
突厥蛮（又译土库曼）是中世纪对穆斯林乌古斯突厥人的称呼。10世纪起伊斯兰作家以此称改宗伊斯兰的乌古斯人，区别于草原信腾格里的突厥人；13世纪乌古斯人自己也采用此名。先祖在咸海、里海之间建乌古斯叶护国，11世纪克讷克等部随塞尔柱人西迁。1071年曼齐刻尔特取胜后，他们散布安纳托利亚、阿塞拜疆、叙利亚和伊拉克，以军屯驻守新边境。

与定居的土耳其人不同，许多突厥蛮氏族仍过半游牧生活，按卡耶、阿夫沙尔等部落组织，使用古安纳托利亚土耳其语。1337年前后活动范围从科尼亚平原到本都海岸和安条克，为各贝伊国提供兵源。

14世纪后期，黑羊、白羊两支突厥蛮联盟在东安纳托利亚、阿塞拜疆和波斯建国；并入奥斯曼者逐渐改称奥斯曼人，不再以突厥蛮为名。

en:
The Turrbal were an Aboriginal Australian people whose traditional lands covered the Brisbane area, which they called Meanjin. Their speech, counted either as a language in its own right or as a dialect of Yuggera, belongs to the Durubalic branch of the Pama-Nyungan family; the name Turrbal itself is said to mean those who say turr or dhur for a bora ring.

They lived by hunting, fishing and gathering, digging yams and swamp fern and harvesting palm shoots. Every three years they travelled into neighbouring Wakka Wakka country for the Bunya feast. In 1824 the explorer John Oxley sighted them on the voyage that founded the Moreton Bay penal settlement, the first European settlement on their land.
zh:
图尔巴尔人是澳大利亚原住民，传统领地位于布里斯班一带，他们称该地为米安金。其语言或被视为独立语言，或被视为尤格拉语的方言，属于帕马-牛雅语系的杜鲁巴利克语支；图尔巴尔一名据说意为“把博拉环称作图尔或杜尔的人”。

他们以狩猎、捕鱼和采集为生，采挖山药和沼泽蕨根、摘取棕榈嫩芽。每隔三年，他们会前往相邻的瓦卡瓦卡人地区参加布尼亚盛宴。1824年，探险家约翰·奥克斯利在建立摩顿湾流放地的航行中见到他们，摩顿湾流放地成为他们土地上第一个欧洲人定居点。

en:
The Tuscans are the people of Tuscany in central Italy, dwelling in the Arno valley and hills around Florence, Siena and Pisa. Their country was Etruria, whose Etruscan city-states flourished from the seventh century BC before Rome absorbed it by the first century BC. Etruscan left a substrate in Tuscan, an Italo-Dalmatian language whose varieties Dante classified in De vulgari eloquentia.

After the Lombards' duchy of Tuscia at Lucca, rival communes grew rich on the Via Francigena, Pisa as a port, Siena and Lucca as banking centres, Florence above them. Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio made Florentine Italy's prestige literary language, later carried on by Machiavelli. From 1434 the Medici ruled Florence under republican forms until its 1530 dukedom, absorbed Siena in 1555 and became grand dukes in 1569.

The Medici died out in 1737, and Lorraine dukes inherited the grand duchy, keeping it through the Napoleonic Kingdom of Etruria and the French annexation of 1808–1814, while Lucca remained a separate republic.
zh:
托斯卡纳人是意大利中部托斯卡纳居民，聚居阿尔诺河谷及佛罗伦萨、锡耶纳、比萨周围的丘陵。其地古称伊特鲁里亚，城邦公元前7世纪兴盛，至前1世纪并入罗马。伊特鲁里亚语在托斯卡纳语留底层；该语属意大利-达尔马提亚语支，但丁《论俗语》已录其变体。

伦巴第人在卢卡设图西亚公国后，诸公社沿法兰克人朝圣之路致富：比萨为港口，锡耶纳、卢卡营银行业，佛罗伦萨凌驾诸城。但丁、彼特拉克、薄伽丘使佛罗伦萨方言成为意大利文学语言，后由马基雅维利继承。美第奇1434年起以共和形式统治佛罗伦萨，1530年称公爵，1555年吞锡耶纳，1569年称大公。

美第奇1737年绝嗣，洛林公爵继承大公国，历经拿破仑伊特鲁里亚王国与1808—1814年法国吞并而保有其地，卢卡为独立共和国。

en:
The Tutelo, who called themselves Yesah, 'the people', were a Siouan-speaking nation of the Virginia and West Virginia uplands. Their tradition traced them to Ohio and the Fort Ancient culture, from which they moved east centuries before colonization.

During the later Beaver Wars, around 1670, the Haudenosaunee overran their homeland; the Batts and Fallam expedition found Totero Town near Salem in 1671. The Tutelo then took shelter successively with the Occaneechi and the Saponi, merging into the Nahyssan. They moved to the Yadkin headwaters in 1701 and Fort Christanna after 1714, then north to Shamokin after the 1722 Treaty of Albany ended Haudenosaunee attacks.

In 1753 the Cayuga adopted them, and they built Coreorgonel beside Cayuga Lake. Sullivan's expedition destroyed the village in 1779, and survivors followed the Cayuga to the Six Nations reserve on the Grand River, where intermarriage absorbed them.
zh:
图特洛人自称‘耶萨’，意为‘人民’，是弗吉尼亚和西弗吉尼亚高地操苏语的民族。他们的传说把族源追溯到俄亥俄的古堡文化，称先祖在殖民时代之前数百年东迁。

海狸战争后期的1670年前后，易洛魁联盟攻占其故土；1671年巴茨与法拉姆探险队在塞勒姆附近发现图特洛镇。此后图特洛人先后投靠奥卡尼奇人与萨波尼人，合并为纳希桑群体。他们1701年辗转到亚德金河源头，1714年后驻于克里斯安娜堡，又在1722年《奥尔巴尼条约》结束易洛魁人的攻击后北迁沙莫金。

1753年卡尤加人收养他们，他们遂在卡尤加湖畔建起科雷奥戈内尔村。1779年沙利文远征摧毁该村，幸存者随卡尤加人迁往格兰德河的六族保留地，因通婚而被同化。

en:
The Tututni were a group of Athabascan-speaking Native American peoples of southwestern Oregon, the principal of the Lower Rogue River tribes. Their villages stood along the Rogue River and its tributaries on the Pacific coast, between the Coquille River to the north and the Chetco to the south.

Their Lower Rogue River language, also called Tututni, belongs to the Oregon Athabascan branch of the Na-Dené family, with a distinct dialect for each band. British, Spanish and American ships began exploring their coast in the late eighteenth century.

In the spring of 1792 Tututni villagers met the expedition of Captain George Vancouver; merchants soon followed to buy sea otter pelts. The same contact era brought smallpox, measles and other new diseases, which carried off between three-quarters and nine-tenths of many Oregon coastal populations.
zh:
图图特尼人是俄勒冈州西南部讲阿萨巴斯卡语的一群原住民，是罗格河下游诸部中最主要的一支。他们的村庄散布在太平洋沿岸罗格河及其支流一带，北起科基尔河，南至切特科河。

他们的罗格河下游语言又称图图特尼语，属于纳-德内语系的俄勒冈阿萨巴斯卡语支，每个分支各有自己的方言。18世纪末，英国、西班牙和美国的船只开始勘探这段海岸。

1792年春，图图特尼村民见到了乔治·温哥华船长的探险队，商人随后前来收购海獭皮。同一接触时代也带来了天花、麻疹等新疫病，俄勒冈沿岸许多群体因此损失了四分之三乃至九成的人口。

en:
The Tuvaluans are the Polynesian people of nine low coral atolls and reef islands in the western Pacific, eight inhabited in pre-contact times, giving Tuvalu its name of eight standing together. Their ancestors spread from Samoa, with Nanumea recalling founders from Tonga. Canoes kept up regular traffic with Samoa and Tonga, whose Tuʻi Tonga empire drew Tuvalu into its sphere in the thirteenth century.

Their creation story tells of the Eel and the Flounder, who shaped the flat atolls and coconut palms. The first European to sight the islands was Álvaro de Mendaña, who passed Nui on 16 January 1568 and charted it as Isla de Jesús.

After Arent de Peyster named Funafuti Ellice's Island in 1819, the group became known to Europeans as the Ellice Islands. American whalers began calling from 1821.
zh:
图瓦卢人是散居在西太平洋九座低矮珊瑚环礁和礁岛上的波利尼西亚人，其中八座在欧洲人到来之前已有人居住，图瓦卢之名即意为八岛并立。他们的祖先从萨摩亚扩散而来，纳努梅阿则传说始祖来自汤加。独木舟与萨摩亚、汤加往来不绝，13世纪时图瓦卢被纳入汤加的图伊汤加帝国势力范围。

他们的创世神话讲述鳗鱼与比目鱼造出平坦环礁和椰子树的故事。最早望见群岛的欧洲人是阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚，他于1568年1月16日经过努伊，将其标为耶稣岛。

1819年，阿伦特·德派斯特把富纳富提命名为埃利斯岛，此后整个岛群被欧洲人称作埃利斯群岛。美国捕鲸船从1821年起开始来访。

en:
The Tuvans are a Siberian Turkic people of the upper Yenisei and the Sayan Mountains, in the land that takes its name from them, Tuva. Chinese chronicles trace their ancestors to the Dingling and the Dubo of the eastern Sayan. In 1207 Jochi's Mongol armies brought them under Mongol suzerainty, and they were later reckoned among the Uriankhai peoples.

In 1538 Dayan Khan crushed a Uriankhai revolt and dissolved their tumen, after which the Tuvan clans fell mostly to the northern Khalkha. Tuva passed under Dzungar and then Qing rule, administered as Tannu Uriankhai.

Traditionally semi-nomadic herders of reindeer, sheep and yaks living in yurts and birch-bark tents, the Tuvans kept their Turkic speech and shamanic rites, and in the eighteenth century adopted Tibetan Buddhism through Mongol contact without abandoning the old ways.
zh:
图瓦人是叶尼塞河上游、萨彦岭一带的西伯利亚突厥语民族，所居之地因他们得名图瓦。中国史籍把他们的先民上溯到丁零和东萨彦岭的都波。1207年，术赤率领的蒙古大军确立了对图瓦的宗主权，后来图瓦人被归入兀良哈诸部。

1538年达延汗镇压兀良哈反叛并解散其万户，图瓦诸部大多归附北喀尔喀。图瓦先归准噶尔、后入清朝版图，被编为唐努乌梁海。

图瓦人传统上是放养驯鹿、绵羊和牦牛的半游牧民，住毡帐和桦树皮帐篷，保留着突厥语和萨满仪式；18世纪时，他们在蒙古人影响下改奉藏传佛教，但旧有的信仰并未消失。

en:
The Great Lakes Twa, plural Batwa, are a pygmy hunter-gatherer people and the oldest surviving population of the African Great Lakes, scattered across Rwanda, Burundi, Uganda and the eastern Congo. For centuries they lived as semi-nomadic forest hunter-gatherers in small egalitarian bands that stored no surplus, and unlike most other pygmy peoples made pottery for their farming neighbors.

From at least the 1300s they came under agricultural peoples: Bantu-speaking Hutu are held to have entered between the 1000s and 1300s and subjugated them, and in the 1400s pastoral Tutsi overlords built the three-order society of the Rwanda kingdom.

They nevertheless kept a distinct place at court, serving Tutsi kings as entertainers and executioners; some held sub-chief titles, one clan was ennobled, and their forest lore and supposed shamanic power made them both admired and feared. They speak the Bantu languages of their neighbors, among them Rwanda and Rundi.
zh:
大湖地区特瓦人（复数称巴特瓦）是俾格米狩猎采集族群，也是非洲大湖地区现存最古老的居民，散居卢旺达、布隆迪、乌干达和刚果民主共和国东部。多少个世纪里，他们以半游牧的森林狩猎采集为生，结成平等、不积余粮的小群；与大多数其他俾格米人不同，还为邻近农耕村民制陶。

至少从14世纪起，特瓦人受农耕民族支配：一般认为说班图语的胡图人11至14世纪进入该地区，征服当地特瓦人；15世纪游牧的图西霸主建立起卢旺达王国的三级社会。

但特瓦人在宫廷保有独特位置：为图西国王充当艺人、行刑人，有人出任副酋长，一个氏族受封贵族；他们的森林植物知识和被信以为真的萨满神力，使他们既受钦佩又令人生畏。他们使用邻族的班图语言，包括卢旺达语和隆迪语。

en:
The Twana are a group of nine related Coast Salish peoples living along the forested shores of Hood Canal in western Puget Sound, whose Central Coast Salish language is a close relative of Lushootseed.

Like other Coast Salish they spent the winters in permanent plank-house villages and dispersed to summer camps for the salmon runs. Rank was displayed through the potlatch, where sponsors gave away blankets, dentalia, canoes and even slaves, and shamans cured illness by recovering lost souls.

Maritime fur traders seeking sea otter pelts made the first European contact around 1788, and the sea otter had been nearly hunted out by 1792, after which Hood Canal saw almost no outsiders for roughly thirty years. The epidemics that swept the Puget Sound region nevertheless reached the Twana, thinning their villages before the treaty period began.
zh:
特瓦纳是九个彼此亲缘的海岸萨利什族群的合称，住在皮吉特湾西部林木茂密的胡德运河沿岸；他们的语言属于中部海岸萨利什语，与卢舒特西德语近亲。

和其他海岸萨利什人一样，他们冬天住在固定木板房村落里，夏天则分散到营地赶鲑鱼汛。地位通过散财宴展示，主办人在宴会上分发毛毯、角贝、独木舟甚至奴隶，萨满则通过找回失落的灵魂来治病。

约1788年，搜寻海獭皮的海上毛皮商人首次与他们接触，到1792年海獭已近乎被捕绝，此后约三十年间胡德运河几乎再无外人到来。但席卷皮吉特湾地区的疫病同样波及特瓦纳人，在条约时代开始之前就削弱了他们的村落。

en: The Txapakura are the Chapacuran-speaking peoples of the Guaporé and Mamoré basins on the Brazil-Bolivia border, whose principal surviving groups are the Wariʼ, whose name means we, people, the Oro Win, Torá and Moré. They were semi-nomadic riverside villagers who moved every few years, grew maize in swiddens on terra preta soils and built a separate men's house.
zh: 查帕库拉人是巴西与玻利维亚边境瓜波雷河、马莫雷河流域使用查帕库拉语族诸语言的族群总称，现存主要支系有瓦里人（其族名意为我们、人）、奥罗温人、托拉人和莫雷人。他们是半游牧的河畔村民，每隔数年便迁居一次，在黑土上用游耕方式种植玉米，并在村中另建男子屋。

en:
The Tzeltal, who call themselves Winik Atel, are a Maya people of the Chiapas highlands in southern Mexico. Their speech forms, together with Tzotzil, the Tzeltalan branch of the Mayan language family, and the two languages began to diverge around 1200.

They descend from the builders of the Classic Maya cities, and after the lowland kingdoms collapsed their pre-Hispanic society was divided among as many as forty-five autonomous political units.

Spanish soldiers and missionaries reached Chiapas between 1524 and 1545, and through most of the colonial era Tzeltal villages were forced to supply labour for mines, mills and haciendas. The people lived by maize farming and textile work in self-governing communities, blending Catholic rites with native beliefs and shamanic healing. In 1824 Chiapas separated from Guatemala and joined the new Mexican republic, while highland families kept their language and customary authorities.
zh:
维尼卡特尔人（学界通称泽套人）是墨西哥南部恰帕斯高地的玛雅民族。他们所说的泽套语与索西语共同构成玛雅语系的采尔塔尔语支，两种语言约在1200年前后分化。

他们是古典期玛雅诸城建造者的后裔，低地王国衰落后，其前殖民社会分裂为多达四十五个自治单位。

1524—1545年间，西班牙军队和传教士进入恰帕斯，殖民时代的大部分时间里，泽套人的村落都被迫为矿山、作坊和大庄园提供劳役。他们在自治村务农种玉米、纺织为生，将天主教仪式与本土信仰和萨满医术糅合在一起。1824年恰帕斯脱离危地马拉，加入新生的墨西哥共和国，高地家族则保留了自己的语言和传统权威。

en:
The Sotz'leb, better known as the Tzotzil, are a Maya people of the central Chiapas highlands, whose principal towns include Zinacantán and Chamula. Their name derives from sotz', the bat, and they call their language Bats'i k'op, the true language. Together with the Tzeltal, their ancestors entered Chiapas between 100 BCE and 300 CE.

On the eve of the conquest their society formed at least seven small polities, exporting quetzal feathers and amber to Aztec Tenochtitlán and trading salt from the wells of Ixtapa. In 1522 the lord of Zinacantán submitted to the Spaniards and helped Luis Marín subdue neighboring tribes, while Chamula resisted and was abandoned.

Disease, forced resettlement and encomienda vassalage greatly reduced their numbers. Colonial labour exactions provoked revolts in 1528 and 1712, and in 1824 their highlands passed with Chiapas from Guatemala to Mexico.
zh:
索茨莱布人（通称索西人）是恰帕斯中部高地的玛雅民族，主要城镇有锡纳坎坦和查穆拉。其族名源自“蝙蝠”，他们又把自己的语言称为“真正的语言”。他们与泽套人的先民在公元前100年至公元300年间进入恰帕斯。

征服前夕，其社会分成至少七个小政权，向阿兹特克的特诺奇蒂特兰出口格查尔鸟羽和琥珀，并贩运伊斯塔帕盐井的食盐。1522年锡纳坎坦领主向西班牙人归顺，并协助路易斯·马林征服邻族，查穆拉人抵抗后弃城而去。

疫病、强制迁徙和监护征赋制下的封臣地位使人口大减。殖民时代的劳役压榨引发了1528年和1712年的起义，1824年他们所在的高地随恰帕斯从危地马拉划归墨西哥。

en:
The Tz'utujil are a Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands, holding the southern shore of Lake Atitlán and cacao-growing lowlands in Suchitepéquez. According to the Popol Vuh their ancestors came from the mythic city of Tollan around the dawn of the thirteenth century, and they built their capital Chiaa on the hill of Chuitinamit, ruled by a lord bearing the title Ahtz'iquinahay.

In the fifteenth century the K'iche' king K'iq'ab crushed their attempts to expand westward. Pedro de Alvarado invaded in 1523 with Kaqchikel allies and defeated them near Panajachel in 1524; the Ahtz'iquinahay, baptized Pedro, submitted and founded the new town of Santiago Atitlán.

Franciscans moved the people down from the old hill capital and set up cofradías from 1533, while introduced diseases and gold mining cut the population from some 72,000 in 1520 to little more than 5,000 by 1550.
zh:
楚图希尔人是危地马拉高地的玛雅族群，据有阿蒂特兰湖南岸和苏奇特佩克斯种植可可的低地。据《波波尔·乌》记载，其先民约在13世纪初从神话之城图兰迁来，在楚伊蒂纳米特山上建起都城奇亚，统治者号称阿齐基纳哈伊。

15世纪，基切国王基亚布以武力粉碎了他们向西扩张的企图。1523年佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多联合卡克奇克尔人入侵，1524年在帕纳哈切尔附近击败他们；受洗取名佩德罗的阿齐基纳哈伊臣服，另建新城圣地亚哥阿蒂特兰。

方济各会修士把居民从山上的旧都迁下，自1533年起设立兄弟会组织；与此同时，传入的疫病和淘金劳役使人口从1520年约七万二千锐减到1550年的五千出头。

en:
Uakambalelté is the name the Vilela people gave themselves, meaning those who speak Waqha, their native language. By the fifteenth century they ranged over the north of Tucumán and Santiago del Estero and the east of Salta. They were nomadic hunters and gatherers who took peccary, carob pods and wild honey.

The Spanish conquest of Tucumán pushed them east into the Gran Chaco, where they lived in a number of subgroups. During the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries the horse-riding Guaycuru peoples expanded across the Chaco and drove them still farther east toward the Paraná River.

The Jesuits, whose missions included San José de las Petacas founded in 1735 and two further foundations of 1763, worked in their lands until the expulsion of the order in 1767 and 1768.
zh:
瓦坎巴莱尔特是比莱拉人的自称，意为“说瓦卡语的人”。到15世纪时，他们活动在图库曼和圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗以北以及萨尔塔东部一带。瓦坎巴莱尔特人是游牧的狩猎采集者，猎取西貒，采集角豆荚和野蜂蜜。

西班牙人征服图库曼后，他们向东退入大查科，分成若干支系生活。17—18世纪，学会骑马的瓜伊库鲁诸部在查科扩张，又把他们进一步向东逼向巴拉那河。

耶稣会在他们的土地上建立了多处传教区，包括1735年建立的圣何塞-德拉什佩塔卡斯以及1763年建立的另外两处，直到1767—1768年耶稣会被驱逐为止。

en: The Goragir were an Evenki band of the Uchami, a left tributary of the Lower Tunguska, whose camps around Nidym and Tutonchany later lay in the Ilimpiyskiy district. They were nomadic reindeer herders and sable hunters of the far northern taiga, counted as Tungus tribute payers after Cossacks reached the Yenisei in the early seventeenth century.
zh: 乌恰米人是乌恰米河流域的鄂温克游猎群，在尼德姆、图图恩恰内一带的营地后来属于伊利姆皮耶区；乌恰米河是下通古斯河的左支流。他们是极北林区的驯鹿牧民和紫貂猎手，17世纪初哥萨克抵达叶尼塞河后，被列为缴纳毛皮贡的通古斯部落之一。

en:
The Udege are a Tungusic forest people of the Sikhote-Alin mountains and the right-bank tributaries of the Ussuri and Amur, whose self-name means “people of the forest”. Ming writers counted them among the Wild Jurchen under the name Wudiha. They lived in clans led by elected elders, hunting elk and sable, fishing and gathering ginseng; their animism centred on kinship with the bear and the Ussuri tiger, on shamans and on air burial.

In 1343 the Wozhe wild people of the Liaoyang region rose against the Yuan, and in 1346 they rebelled again together with the Shui Dada when officials pressed them for gyrfalcons.

In the early 1600s Nurhaci campaigned against the Woji forest bands and brought them into the nascent Qing order, under which they tendered a sable tribute every two years in exchange for court gifts.
zh:
乌德盖是锡霍特山脉和乌苏里江、黑龙江右岸支流一带的通古斯语森林民族，自称意为“林中人”。明代把他们归入野人女真，称兀狄哈。他们以氏族为单位游猎，由推举的长老统领，猎马鹿和紫貂，兼事捕鱼和采参，信仰萨满教与万物有灵，崇拜熊和乌苏里虎，并实行风葬。

1343年，辽阳的兀者野人起兵反元；1346年又因官府强索海东青，兀者野人与水达达再度反叛。

17世纪初，努尔哈赤征讨窝集人，把这些森林部落纳入兴起中的清朝秩序，此后他们每两年向朝廷贡貂，换取朝廷的回赐。

en:
The Udmurts are a Permian people of the Uralic family, the autochthonous forest dwellers of the middle Kama and Vyatka basins, whose name odo-mort means meadow people and whom Russian sources long called Votyaks. Their line runs from the Iron Age Ananyino culture through the Pyanobor and Azelino cultures.

Their southern kin paid tribute to the Volga Bulgars and served the governors of the Golden Horde. Moscow's annexation of Vyatka in 1489 brought the northern Udmurts under its rule, and after the fall of Kazan in 1552 the southern Udmurts were enrolled as yasak tribute-payers.

Clan-organised, they lived as semi-nomadic hunters and riverside farmers, served by a pagan priesthood of the sky god Inmar and hearth spirit Voršud in sacred groves. Under the Vyatka governorate from 1796, they kept their grove rites even after Orthodox feast days entered their calendar.
zh:
乌德穆尔特人是乌拉尔语系彼尔姆语支的民族，世居卡马河与维亚特卡河中游的林地，族名“乌德穆尔特”意为“草地之人”，俄罗斯文献旧称沃佳克人。他们的谱系从铁器时代的阿南因诺文化，经皮亚诺博尔文化、阿泽利诺文化延续而来。

南部的乌德穆尔特人向伏尔加保加尔人纳贡，后来又为金帐汗国的总督效力。1489年莫斯科吞并维亚特卡，北部乌德穆尔特人随之入俄；1552年喀山陷落后，南部乌德穆尔特人被登记为缴纳牙萨克的贡民。

乌德穆尔特人以氏族为组织，过着半游猎与河畔农耕生活，异教祭司在圣林中侍奉天神因马尔和家灶守护神沃尔舒德。1796年起全境隶属维亚特卡省，东正教节庆进入他们的历法之后，圣林仪式仍得以保留。

en: The Ughele are an Oceanic-speaking people of Rendova, a volcanic island in the New Georgia group of the Solomon Islands, occupying its northern tip. Their language, also called Ugele, has no internal dialect divisions and is one of the Oceanic tongues of the western Solomons.
zh: 乌格勒人是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛的火山岛伦多瓦岛北部上说大洋洲语的族群。他们的语言又称乌盖莱语，内部没有方言分化，是所罗门群岛西部的大洋洲语言之一。

en:
The Uitoto, also called Witoto or Murui-Muinane, are an Amazonian people whose original homeland lay in the middle Caquetá River basin and the rainforest stretching toward the Putumayo. They were once a constellation of more than thirty tribes and around a hundred villages, grouped into the western Murui, the eastern Muinane, who were largely absorbed into the Murui, and the Meneca of the Putumayo.

Society followed the father's line, and several families shared a communal longhouse, the maloca. Men gathered there to take mambe, a powder of coca leaf and yarumo ash, while great maguare drums carried messages between settlements through the forest.

Their language belongs to the Bora-Huitoto family. Their first fleeting contacts with Europeans came in the early 1600s, and outside intrusion remained sporadic through the rest of the colonial period.
zh:
乌伊托托人又称维托托人或穆鲁伊-穆伊纳内人，是亚马孙地区的原住民，故地在卡克塔河中游流域及向普图马约河延伸的雨林。他们曾是由三十多个部落、上百个村落组成的族群联合体，主要分为西部的穆鲁伊人、东部多被穆鲁伊人吸纳的穆伊纳内人，以及普图马约河畔的梅内卡人。

社会按父系血缘组织，数个家庭共居在名为马洛卡的公社长屋中。男子聚在长屋里吸用曼贝，即古柯叶与亚鲁莫木灰磨成的粉末；巨大的马瓜雷鼓能在森林中的村落之间传递信息。

他们的语言属于博拉-维托托语系。17世纪初，他们与欧洲人有了最初的短暂接触，而在整个殖民时代余下的时间里，外界的渗入始终时断时续。

en:
The Arara, who call themselves Ukarãgmã, “people of the red macaw”, are a Cariban-speaking people of the Brazilian interior, holding the forests along the Iriri river near where it joins the Xingu. They lived as nomadic hunter-gatherers, moving through the forest in small bands but gathering in large communal houses; they hunted and fished and planted manioc, sweet potatoes, bananas and pineapples in forest clearings.

Feared as warriors who kept war trophies, they also intermarried with neighbouring tribes, and for rituals they painted their bodies with black designs drawn from genipapo fruit. As Portuguese settlement spread along the lower Amazon in the 1600s and 1700s, they remained upriver beyond colonial reach.
zh:
阿拉拉人自称乌卡朗芒，意为“红金刚鹦鹉之民”，是巴西内陆使用加勒比语族语言的族群，居住在伊里里河汇入欣古河一带的森林中。他们以游猎采集为生，小群体在林中迁徙，聚会时则住进大型公共屋舍；人们狩猎捕鱼，还在林间空地种植木薯、甘薯、香蕉和菠萝。

阿拉拉人以善战和保存战利品闻名，也常与邻近部落通婚；举行仪式时，他们用吉尼帕波果汁制成的黑色颜料在身上绘出图案。17至18世纪，葡萄牙人的定居点沿亚马逊下游扩展，阿拉拉人仍居于上游林地，处在殖民势力范围之外。

en:
The Ulch, who call themselves nani, are a fishing people of the lower Amur valley, settled in small villages on the river's right bank; their Ulch language belongs to the Nanai branch of Tungusic, and Chinese accounts classed them as the Hezhen group that did not shave the front of the head.

Their ancestry reaches back to the ancient coastal population of Northeast Asia. Their economy rested on salmon, dried in strips for winter, supplemented by sable hunting and by catching seals and sea lions.

They wintered in log-frame houses and moved into bark-covered summer huts when the fishing season began. Russian explorers first recorded the Ulch in the 1600s, after which their sable furs entered the Russian fur trade.
zh:
乌尔奇人自称“那尼”，是黑龙江下游以捕鱼为生的定居民族，村落散布在干流右岸；乌尔奇语属通古斯语系赫哲语支，汉文记载把他们视作赫哲的一支，即不剃发的黑斤。

他们的先民可追溯到东北亚沿海古老的土著人群。他们以鲑鱼为主，捕来的鱼切成条风干储存过冬，兼猎紫貂、捕海豹和海狮。

冬天他们住木构架住房，渔季来临时搬进树皮覆盖的棚屋。俄国人在17世纪首次记载到乌尔奇人，此后他们的紫貂皮也进入了俄国的毛皮贸易。

en:
The Ulwa are the southernmost of the Misumalpan-speaking peoples grouped under the name Mayangna, or Sumu, living along the rivers of eastern Nicaragua, above all around the Río Grande de Matagalpa. The name ulwa first appears in a Spanish document of 1586.

When the English reached the Mosquito Coast in the 1630s, the Ulwa and their Mayangna kin held much of the coast and its interior. Firearms traded to the Miskito then turned the balance of power: Miskito raiding parties carried off Ulwa captives for sale in Jamaica and forced a retreat upriver, while coastal survivors paid tribute to the Miskito king crowned by the English in 1660.

Through the eighteenth century the Ulwa kept to remote river basins, living by shifting cultivation, hunting and fishing, as their language came under growing pressure from Miskito.
zh:
乌尔瓦人是归入马扬格纳（又称苏莫）名下的米苏马尔潘语各族中位置最南的一支，住在尼加拉瓜东部的河流沿岸，以马塔加尔帕大河一带为中心。乌尔瓦一名最早见于1586年的西班牙文献。

17世纪30年代英国人到达莫斯基托海岸时，乌尔瓦人与马扬格纳亲族占据着海岸和内陆的大片土地。流入米斯基托人手中的火枪改变了力量对比：米斯基托袭掠队掳走乌尔瓦人贩卖到牙买加，迫使他们向河流上游退避，留在沿海的人则要向1660年由英国人加冕的米斯基托国王纳贡。

整个18世纪，乌尔瓦人退守偏远的河流流域，以轮耕、狩猎和渔捞为生，他们的语言也日益受到米斯基托语的挤压。

en: The Umboi are the people of Umboi, a volcanic island of the Siassi Group lying between New Guinea's Huon Peninsula and New Britain across the Vitiaz and Dampier straits. Their language, Kovai, is a Papuan tongue spoken mostly within the island's large caldera, although the island's villages also use several Austronesian languages.
zh: 翁博伊人居住在翁博伊岛上；该岛是西亚西群岛中的一座火山岛，隔维蒂亚兹海峡和丹皮尔海峡与新几内亚的休恩半岛及新不列颠岛相望。他们使用的科瓦伊语是一种巴布亚语言，主要通行于岛上巨大的破火山口内，不过岛上村落也使用几种南岛语系语言。

en:
The Umiida, also written Umida or Umede, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Kimberley region of north Western Australia, living on the coast and islands north of the Warrwa around the Meda River. They spoke a western dialect of Worrorra, one of the Worrorran languages.

A nomadic rafter people, they harvested the maritime resources of the islands off their shore with the neighbouring Djaui and Unggarranggu, sailing rafts built from mangrove timber. The first European ship to reach their coastal waters was the Cygnet, when William Dampier explored the adjoining King Sound in 1688.
zh:
乌米达人（又作乌梅德）是西澳大利亚州北部金伯利地区的澳大利亚原住民，住在梅达河一带、瓦尔瓦人以北的海岸与岛屿上。他们讲沃罗拉语的一种西部方言，属沃罗拉语系。

乌米达人是逐岛而居的游牧筏民，与相邻的焦维人和翁加兰吉人结伴乘坐红树林木材造的木筏，在沿海岛屿上获取海产。第一艘驶入他们近海的欧洲船只是西格尼特号，1688年威廉·丹皮尔乘它考察了毗邻的金湾。

en:
The Umpila are an Aboriginal people of the north-eastern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose traditional country ran along the Coral Sea coast from Temple Bay south towards Princess Charlotte Bay and inland as far as Coen.

They call themselves Umpila pama malngkanichi, people of the sand beach, and belong to the Kawadji family of coastal peoples, living by fishing, reef gathering and seasonal inland foraging.

Their speech is a North Cape York Paman language, split into several dialects and accompanied by a developed sign language. Their society was divided into two exogamous patrilineal moieties, the same two categories being used to classify plants and animals, and strict avoidance rules governed speech with certain in-laws. Captain Cook charted their coast in 1770.
zh:
乌姆皮拉人是昆士兰约克角半岛东北部的原住民，传统领地沿珊瑚海海岸展开，北起坦普尔湾，南至夏洛特公主湾附近，向西深入到科恩一带。

他们自称“乌姆皮拉沙滩人”，属沿海“沙滩人”文化群体，以捕鱼、礁盘采集和按季转往内陆觅食为生。

他们的语言属北约克角帕马语组，分为数种方言，还配有一套发达的手语。社会分为两个外婚制父系半偶族，连动植物也用这两个范畴分类；与某些姻亲说话则有严格的回避规矩。1770年库克船长测绘了这段海岸。

en:
The Unalachtigo were the southernmost and least-recorded division of the Lenape, or Delaware Indians. Their name, a Munsee word often glossed as “people who live down by the water,” was applied to the Unami-speaking bands of west-central and southern New Jersey and the adjacent Lehigh Valley of Pennsylvania, including the Kechemeche of the Cape May peninsula.

Their coastal life leaned on the rivers, bays and ocean: men netted fish and dug clams, hunted deer in the pine woods with fire drives, while women raised maize, beans and squash.

Contact around 1600 was peaceful at first, but disease, land pressure and absorption into colonial settlements shrank the communities fast; the Kechemeche ceased to exist as a separate people by 1735. The survivors shared the general Lenape fate of the Walking Purchase of 1737 and the Treaty of Easton of 1758, before westward removals ultimately carried Lenape families to Oklahoma and Ontario.
zh:
乌纳拉奇戈人是莱纳佩人（特拉华人）三支中位置最南、记载最少的一支。其名称来自蒙西语，常被解释为“临水而居的人”，用来指新泽西西中部和南部及邻近的宾州利哈伊河谷一带说乌纳米语的各群体，包括开普梅半岛上的凯克梅切人。

滨海生活使他们高度依赖河流、海湾和海洋：男子撒网捕鱼、挖蛤，在松林里用火围猎鹿；妇女种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。

1600年前后与欧洲人初次接触时还算和平，但疫病、土地压力和被殖民社群同化使这些群体迅速萎缩，到1735年凯克梅切人已不再作为独立群体存在。幸存者经历了莱纳佩人共同的命运：1737年的“步行购地”和1758年的《伊斯顿条约》，随后西迁，最终有莱纳佩家庭被带到俄克拉荷马和安大略。

en:
The Unangax̂ — the Unangan of the eastern dialects, commonly called Aleuts — are the Indigenous people of the Aleutian island chain, and this grouping covers the Fox Island communities centred on Unalaska. They hunted seals, sea lions and whales from the covered kayaks called iqyax and wintered in semi-subterranean houses known as ulax.

The Russian fur trader Stepan Glotov reached Unalaska in 1759, and harsh tribute demands provoked an uprising between 1763 and 1766 in which the Aleuts destroyed four Russian ships; a permanent Russian post nevertheless opened in 1774 and later passed to the Russian-American Company.

The Orthodox priest Ivan Veniaminov built the Church of the Holy Ascension in 1825 and devised the first writing system for Unangam Tunuu, the Aleut language, while epidemic disease in the later 1830s sharply reduced the population of the island.
zh:
乌南甘人即东部方言的乌南甘人，通称阿留申人，是阿留申群岛链的原住民，这一文化涵盖以乌纳拉斯卡为中心的福克斯群岛诸社区。他们乘坐称为“伊基亚克斯”的覆盖式皮艇捕猎海豹、海狮和鲸鱼，冬天住在半地穴式的“乌拉克斯”房屋里。

俄国毛皮商人斯捷潘·格洛托夫于1759年抵达乌纳拉斯卡，沉重的贡赋激起了1763—1766年的起义，阿留申人摧毁了四艘俄国船；但俄国人仍于1774年开设常设商站，后来并入俄美公司。

东正教神父伊凡·韦尼阿米诺夫于1825年建起圣升天教堂，并为阿留申语乌南甘话创制了第一套文字；19世纪30年代后期的瘟疫则使岛上人口锐减。

en:
The Unaligmiut, or Unalirmiut, are the Central Alaskan Yup'ik people of Norton Sound, whose villages included Unalakleet and St. Michael on the south shore and Elim and Golovin on the north, and who spoke the Unaliq subdialect of Yup'ik. Their country was a meeting ground of Yup'ik, Iñupiaq and interior Athabaskan peoples, for Unalakleet, at the end of the portage route linking the sound with the Yukon River, had long been a major trade fair between coast and interior.

In 1833 the Russian-American Company founded Redoubt St. Michael as a post for trade with the local Yup'ik. Later in the 1830s it added another post at Unalakleet, drawing the Unaligmiut into the Russian fur trade.
zh:
乌纳利格缪特人（又作乌纳利尔缪特人）是诺顿湾一带的中阿拉斯加尤皮克人，村庄包括南岸的尤纳拉克利特和圣迈克尔，以及北岸的埃利姆与戈洛文，使用尤皮克语的乌纳利克次方言。他们的家园是尤皮克人、因纽皮亚特人与内陆阿萨巴斯卡人交汇之地：尤纳拉克利特位于连接诺顿湾与育空河的搬运路线一端，早就是沿海与内陆之间重要的贸易集市。

1833年，俄美公司建立圣迈克尔堡，作为与当地尤皮克人贸易的据点。19世纪30年代后期又在尤纳拉克利特增设贸易站，把乌纳利格缪特人卷入了俄国的毛皮贸易。

en:
The Unami were the southern and largest of the three main divisions of the Lenape, or Delaware Indians, occupying the lower Delaware valley. Like all Lenape they were organized into matrilineal Wolf, Turtle and Turkey clans, grew maize, beans and squash and made wampum from coastal shells.

Dutch and Swedish traders reached them in the seventeenth century, and in 1682 William Penn made his treaty of friendship with the Lenape at Shackamaxon. The fraudulent Walking Purchase of 1737 drove the river Lenape from their homeland, and the Treaty of Easton in 1758 pushed them west into the Ohio Country.

There they settled in Moravian mission towns such as Gnadenhutten, where Pennsylvania militia massacred nearly a hundred Christian Lenape in 1782. Subsequent treaties carried the Unami bands to Kansas and finally Oklahoma.
zh:
乌纳米人是莱纳佩人（又称特拉华人）三大分支中偏南、人数最多的一支，占据特拉华河下游地区。和全体莱纳佩人一样，他们按母系分为狼、龟、火鸡三大氏族，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，用海贝制作贝珠。

17世纪荷兰和瑞典商人先后来到这里，1682年威廉·佩恩在沙卡马克森与莱纳佩人缔结了友好条约。1737年欺诈性的“步行购地”把河畔的莱纳佩人赶出家园；1758年的《伊斯顿条约》又迫使他们西迁进入俄亥俄地区。

他们在那里定居于格纳登胡滕等摩拉维亚传教镇，1782年宾州民兵在格纳登胡滕屠杀了近百名信奉基督教的莱纳佩人。此后的一系列条约把乌纳米各支迁到堪萨斯，最终到达俄克拉荷马。

en:
The Unggarranggu, also recorded as Unggarangi or Ongkarango, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Kimberley region of Western Australia. Together with the Yawijibaya they are the traditional owners of the Buccaneer Archipelago, the two groups being known together as the Mayala.

Although based on the mainland coast, they were a seafaring people on close terms with the maritime Umiida, sailing rafts lashed from mangrove wood out to islands such as Wilima. Their language belonged to the Worrorran family. The first European vessel in the neighbouring waters was the Cygnet, in which William Dampier explored King Sound in 1688.
zh:
翁加兰吉人（又记作翁加兰戈）是西澳大利亚州金伯利地区的澳大利亚原住民。他们与亚维吉巴亚人同为巴卡尼尔群岛的传统主人，两个群体合称马亚拉。

他们虽以大陆海岸为根基，却擅长航海，与以海为生的乌米达人关系密切，会乘坐用红树林木材扎成的木筏远航到威利马岛等地。他们的语言属于沃罗拉语系。最早驶入附近水域的欧洲船只是西格尼特号，1688年威廉·丹皮尔乘它考察了金湾。

en:
The Uni are the Kakataibo, known in older records as Cashibo or Carapache, a Panoan forest people of the Peruvian Amazon who call themselves Uni. They live back from the Ucayali on the Aguaytía and other rivers, having apparently been pushed away from the main river banks by Shipibo and Conibo neighbours; their Kakataibo language belongs to the Western Panoan family.

They kept fiercely to themselves, raiding neighbouring peoples for women and blocking navigation of the Aguaytía. They joined the rebellion of Juan Santos Atahualpa in 1744 and helped destroy the missions, and when friars approached again in 1757 they killed one and chased the rest away, preserving their isolation until the end of the century and long after.
zh:
乌尼人即卡卡塔伊博人，旧文献多称卡希博人或卡拉帕切人，是秘鲁亚马孙地区的帕诺语林居民族，自称乌尼。他们远离乌卡亚利河干流，住在阿瓜伊蒂亚河等河流一带，大概是被希皮博人和科尼博人挤出了大河岸边；其卡卡塔伊博语属西帕诺语族。

他们长期紧闭门户，常袭击邻族掳掠妇女，并封锁阿瓜伊蒂亚河的航道。1744年，他们加入胡安·桑托斯·阿塔瓦尔帕的起义，参与捣毁传教站；1757年修士再度前来时，他们杀死一人、逐走其余众人，从而把孤立状态保持到18世纪末乃至更久。

en:
Upper Egyptians, or Sa'idis, are the people of the narrow Nile valley south of the delta, the region called in Arabic Ṣaʿīd Miṣr and studded with old river towns such as Asyut and Qena. Under Islamic rule the valley formed a province separate from Lower Egypt, administered from Fustat through the governor's deputies.

Its speech is Sa'idi Arabic, a group of related Upper Egyptian varieties of Egyptian Arabic, and Arabicization proceeded more slowly here than in the delta: Coptic long remained a living language in the valley and was still spoken by peasant women in the seventeenth century. In the eleventh century Hilalian pastoralists drifted west from the Sa'id into Libya and as far as Tunis.

Under Mamluk and then Ottoman rule the remote valley served as a refuge and power base for rival Mamluk beys, as when Abu-l-Dhahab occupied Asyut in 1772 and Ibrahim and Murad Bey retreated there in 1786 ahead of an Ottoman army.
zh:
上埃及人或称赛义迪人，生活在三角洲以南狭窄的尼罗河谷地。这一地区阿拉伯语称萨伊德·米斯尔，沿河分布着艾斯尤特、基纳等古城。伊斯兰统治时期，河谷是与下埃及分立的省份，由埃及总督派驻副手从富斯塔特遥控管理。

他们讲赛义迪阿拉伯语，即埃及阿拉伯语的一组上埃及方言；这里的阿拉伯化比三角洲缓慢，科普特语在河谷长期作为活语言存在，直到17世纪仍有农妇使用。11世纪，希拉勒游牧民从萨伊德向西迁徙，进入利比亚，远至突尼斯。

马穆鲁克及后来的奥斯曼统治时期，偏远的河谷是失势马穆鲁克贝伊的退路和权力基地：1772年阿布·扎哈布攻占艾斯尤特，1786年易卜拉欣贝伊与穆拉德贝伊又在奥斯曼大军压境时退避于此。

en:
The Upper Palatine people inhabit the wooded hill country around Amberg, where Northern Bavarian dialects are spoken. In the High Middle Ages this was the Bavarian March of the Nordgau, colonized along the Naab river against the Slavs and Bohemians.

From the mid-1200s the Wittelsbachs held most of the region as part of the County Palatine of the Rhine. The Treaty of Pavia of 1329 split their inheritance: the western lands became the Lower Palatinate, while the eastern territory took the name Upper Palatinate.

Elector Palatine Frederick V's failed bid for the Bohemian crown in 1619 and 1620 cost him these lands, which the Emperor granted to the Duke of Bavaria. The Peace of Westphalia in 1648 left the Upper Palatinate with Bavaria. The free imperial city of Regensburg was added in 1806, and in 1837 King Ludwig I renamed the Regen district the Upper Palatinate.
zh:
上普法尔茨人居住在安贝格周围的丘陵林地，讲北巴伐利亚方言。中世纪盛期，这里是巴伐利亚的诺德高边区，沿纳布河向斯拉夫人和波希米亚方向殖民开发。

13世纪中叶起，维特尔斯巴赫家族把这片土地的大部分作为莱茵普法尔茨伯国的一部分统治。1329年《帕维亚条约》分割其遗产：西部领地成为下普法尔茨，东部领地则得名上普法尔茨。

1619—1620年，普法尔茨选帝侯腓特烈五世争夺波希米亚王冠失败，丢掉了这些土地；皇帝把它们授予巴伐利亚公爵。1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将上普法尔茨留给巴伐利亚。自由帝国城市雷根斯堡于1806年并入，1837年国王路德维希一世将雷根县改名上普法尔茨。

en:
The Uru are an ancient lacustrine people of the Collao plateau, scattered across the lakes and rivers of what is now Bolivia and Peru, from Lake Titicaca and the Desaguadero to Lakes Poopó and Coipasa. Calling themselves men of the water, they believed they owned the lake; the name uru was given by their Aymara neighbours.

They fished and hunted birds, built movable floating islands and reed boats from totora reeds, and kept fields and llama herds beyond the reed beds.

Older than Aymara and Quechua polities, they were subdued by the Inca Empire, which taxed them and often reduced them to servitude. Under Inca and later Spanish pressure most groups abandoned the Uru tongue for Aymara by the early sixteenth century; only the Chipaya language survived. From 1722 the Uru of Lake Poopó waged a long legal and territorial struggle against neighbouring Aymara communities.
zh:
乌鲁人是科利亚奥高原古老的水上族群，散布在今玻利维亚和秘鲁的湖泊河流之间，从的的喀喀湖、德萨瓜德罗河到波波湖和科伊帕萨湖。他们自称“水之人”，相信自己拥有湖泊，“乌鲁”是艾马拉邻居对他们的称呼。

他们捕鱼猎鸟，用托托拉芦苇建造可移动的浮岛和船，也在苇荡之外耕种、放牧羊驼。

乌鲁人的历史比艾马拉和克丘亚政权更古老，后来被印加帝国征服，承担赋税，还常被降为奴仆。在印加及后来西班牙的压力下，多数支派到16世纪初已放弃乌鲁语改用艾马拉语，只有奇帕亚语留存下来。从1722年起，波波湖的乌鲁人与邻近的艾马拉社群展开了长期的法律和领地之争。

en:
Ü-Tsang is the cultural heartland of Tibet, uniting Ü around Lhasa and the Yarlung valley with Tsang around Shigatse and Gyantse. The Yarlung kings ruled these valleys from about 127 BCE and built the Tibetan Empire of the seventh to ninth centuries, whose court made Buddhism the faith of the land.

After the empire's collapse the region fragmented, and from the thirteenth century the Sakya lamas governed it as clients of the Yuan emperors. Sakya power was fading in 1337, and in 1354 the Phagmodrupa dynasty seized the region, followed in Tsang by the Rinpungpa and Tsangpa.

The Mongol Güshi Khan defeated the Tsang king and in 1642 made the fifth Dalai Lama head of the Ganden Phodrang government, which raised the Potala Palace in Lhasa. Qing armies entered in 1720, beginning nearly two centuries of imperial supervision over the Dalai Lama's government.
zh:
卫藏是西藏的文化核心，由拉萨和雅砻河谷所在的卫，与日喀则、江孜所在的藏合并而成。雅砻赞普约自公元前127年起统治这些谷地，并在7至9世纪建成吐蕃帝国，使佛教成为当地的信仰。

帝国崩溃后卫藏陷入分裂，13世纪起，萨迦派法王作为元朝皇帝的代理人执掌藏政。1337年时萨迦的权势已近尾声，1354年帕木竹巴王朝取而代之，此后藏地又先后出现仁蚌巴和藏巴汗政权。

蒙古和硕特部的固始汗攻灭藏巴汗后，于1642年拥立五世达赖喇嘛为甘丹颇章政权之首，该政权在拉萨兴建布达拉宫。1720年清军入藏，开始了对达赖政府近两百年的监护。

en:
The Uutaalnganu, also called the Night Island Kawadji or sandbeach people, are an Aboriginal group of the north-eastern Cape York Peninsula in Queensland, whose home was Night Island and the coastal strip facing it. They spoke Yankonyu, a dialect of the Umpila cluster within the North Cape York Paman languages, and were linked by marriage to the mainland Barungguan clans.

They were seafarers who built double-outrigger wooden canoes for long voyages to outlying reefs, where they hunted dugong and turtles and gathered the eggs of turtles and sea birds. Captain Cook charted these waters in 1770, but the Night Island people remained beyond direct colonial reach until long after the period closed.
zh:
乌塔恩加努人又称夜岛“沙滩人”，是昆士兰约克角半岛东北部的原住民群体，家园在夜岛及其对面的海岸地带。他们使用扬科纽语，即北约克角帕马语组中乌姆皮拉方言群的一种方言，并与大陆的巴伦关氏族通婚。

他们是航海者，会制造双舷外支架木舟，远航到外海礁盘，捕猎儒艮和海龟，捡拾海龟蛋与海鸟蛋。1770年库克船长测绘了这片海域，但直到本时期结束很久以后，夜岛居民仍未受到殖民势力的直接控制。

en:
The U'wa, known to outsiders as the Tunebo, are a Chibchan-speaking people of northeastern Colombia, centred on the Sierra Nevada del Cocuy. Their name means 'the people', and neighbouring peoples call them 'the people who speak well'; their tongue belongs to the Magdalenic branch of the Chibchan family.

In early times they may have numbered as many as 20,000, organised into traditionally eight matrilineal clans. Clans moved seasonally between highland and lowland zones, traded pineapples to the Muisca and exchanged surpluses at ceremonial sites marked by standing stones. Werjaya elders and kareka healers led each clan, and myths and customs passed chiefly through song.

When Spanish expeditions began entering the eastern Andes in the 1530s, the rugged remoteness of the Cocuy kept large parts of their homeland closed to outsiders. This helped the clans preserve their language and ritual life.
zh:
乌瓦人被外界称为图内博人，是说奇布查语的族群，居住在哥伦比亚东北部，以科奎雪山为中心。乌瓦意为“人”，邻族称他们为“善于言辞的人”；他们的语言属于奇布查语系的马格达莱纳语支。

早期乌瓦人可能多达两万，传统上分为八个母系氏族。氏族随季节在高低海拔间迁徙，把菠萝贩运给穆伊斯卡人，并在立有石柱的仪式场所交换盈余。每个氏族由韦尔哈亚长老和卡雷卡医者主持事务，神话与习俗主要靠歌谣传承。

16世纪30年代西班牙远征队开始进入安第斯山东麓时，科奎山区偏远险峻，大片祖地仍与外界隔绝。这使各氏族得以保存自己的语言和仪式。

en:
The Uyghurs are the settled Turkic people of the Tarim and Turpan oases, heirs to a name borne by the Uyghur Khaganate that ruled Mongolia from 744 to 840. After the Kirghiz overthrew it, a branch built the Kingdom of Qocho and turned from Manichaeism to Buddhism.

The Muslim Karakhanids took Buddhist Khotan in the early eleventh century. In 1337 Turpan remained largely Buddhist, while Kashgar and the west had long been Islamic. The Chagatai khanate split in the 1340s, making these lands part of Moghulistan. Tughluq Temür's conversion opened the spread of Islam; by the early sixteenth century Turpan was largely Muslim and the old name faded.

Sufi Khoja factions dominated the basin from the seventeenth century, followed by the Dzungars and the Qing conquest of 1759. The Ush rising of 1765 showed the weight of imperial rule.
zh:
维吾尔人是塔里木与吐鲁番各绿洲的定居突厥民族，其族名属于744至840年称雄蒙古高原的回鹘汗国。汗国被黠戛斯攻灭后，一支回鹘人建立高昌回鹘王国，由摩尼教改奉佛教。

穆斯林的喀喇汗国在11世纪初攻灭佛教古国于阗。1337年时吐鲁番一带仍以佛教为主，而喀什噶尔等西部绿洲早已伊斯兰化。14世纪40年代察合台汗国分裂，这里成为蒙兀儿斯坦的一部分。秃黑鲁·帖木儿汗改宗伊斯兰教，开启伊斯兰化；到16世纪初吐鲁番也基本成为穆斯林地区，回鹘旧名逐渐湮没。

17世纪起，苏菲派的和卓各派把持盆地政局，随后是准噶尔人和1759年的清朝征服。1765年的乌什起义显示出帝国统治的严酷。

en:
The Uzbeks began as Kipchak-speaking nomads of the eastern Golden Horde, roaming the Desht-i Kipchaq and Zhetysu pastures along the Chu River. The name spread after Khan Ozbeg converted the Golden Horde to Islam in the early fourteenth century. In 1337 these clans pastured in what is now central and eastern Kazakhstan, later counted as the ninety-two Uzbek tribes.

Early in the fifteenth century Abu'l-Khayr Khan united them into the Uzbek Khanate, taking Urganj in 1431. After his death, dissident clans became the Kazakhs, while his grandson Muhammad Shaybani led loyal tribes south. Shaybani invaded Transoxiana in 1501, taking Samarkand in 1505 and Herat in 1507, and founded the Khanate of Bukhara.

The conquerors gradually adopted the Karluk Chagatai tongue of the settled towns and merged with their inhabitants, forging the Uzbek people of Bukhara, Khiva and, from the early eighteenth century, Kokand.
zh:
乌兹别克人最初是金帐汗国东部的钦察语游牧民，游走于钦察草原和楚河沿岸的七河牧场。14世纪初乌兹别克汗使金帐汗国改宗伊斯兰教后，此名流传开来。1337年，这些氏族在今哈萨克斯坦中东部放牧，后来被归为九十二个部落。

15世纪初，阿布海尔汗把他们统一为乌兹别克汗国，1431年占领乌尔根奇。他死后，出走的氏族形成哈萨克人，其孙穆罕默德·昔班尼则率忠于他的部落南下。昔班尼于1501年入侵河中，1505年攻下撒马尔罕、1507年攻下赫拉特，建立布哈拉汗国。

征服者逐渐改用城镇的葛逻禄语支察合台语，与居民融合，形成布哈拉、希瓦及18世纪初浩罕的乌兹别克民族。

en:
The Vadul-Alais are the tundra Yukaghirs of the East Siberian seaboard. Vadul, meaning the strong or mighty ones, is their old self-name. The Alais, or Alazei, lived in the Alazeya River basin between the Indigirka and the Kolyma; at Russian contact they numbered about five hundred and eighty in eight clans, some hunting on foot and others herding reindeer.

They held in their folklore that they descended from the hero Idilvey, who could outrun a wild reindeer and leap across rivers. By 1649 a Cossack fort stood on the Alazeya; that year Yukaghir hostages escaped and killed its men. The rising was crushed and the clans made to pay fur tribute. Tribute, warfare and epidemics drove the tribe into decline.
zh:
瓦杜尔‑阿莱斯人是东西伯利亚沿海苔原上的尤卡吉尔人。“瓦杜尔”意为强壮有力者，是他们古老的自称。阿莱斯人又称阿拉泽伊人，居于因迪吉尔卡河与科雷马河之间的阿拉泽亚河流域；俄国人到来时，他们约有580人，分八个氏族，一部分徒步游猎，一部分放牧驯鹿。

民间传说称他们是英雄伊迪尔韦的后代，据说他跑得比野鹿还快，还能一跃跨过河流。到1649年，哥萨克已在阿拉泽亚河上建起堡寨，这一年被扣作人质的尤卡吉尔人逃脱并杀死守军，起义随即被镇压，各氏族被迫缴纳毛皮贡赋。贡赋、战争和疫病使部落走向衰落。

en:
The Vaghua are an Austronesian-speaking people of Choiseul, known to its inhabitants as Lauru, the largest island of Choiseul Province in the Solomon Islands. Their language, also called Tavula, is closely related to neighbouring Varisi.

The island was first recorded by Europeans in April 1568, when the brigantine Santiago of Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish expedition, commanded by Pedro Ortega Valencia, charted it as San Marcos. The French explorer Louis Antoine de Bougainville named the island in 1768, in honour of the French foreign minister, the duc de Choiseul.
zh:
瓦格瓦人是所罗门群岛舒瓦瑟尔省最大岛屿舒瓦瑟尔岛（当地称劳鲁）上说南岛语的族群。他们的语言又称塔武拉语，与邻近的瓦里西语关系密切。

1568年4月，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙探险队所辖双桅船“圣地亚哥号”在佩德罗·奥尔特加·巴伦西亚指挥下首次记录下这座岛屿，将其标为圣马科斯岛。1768年，法国探险家路易·安托万·德·布干维尔以法国外交大臣舒瓦瑟尔公爵的名字为该岛命名。

en:
The Valpei are an Oceanic-speaking Melanesian people of the northern tip of Espiritu Santo, the largest island of Vanuatu, where their closely related Valpei and Hukua varieties are remembered together under the name Valpei-Hukua. Like other Ni-Vanuatu, they trace their ancestry to the Austronesian Lapita navigators who settled the archipelago roughly three thousand years ago.

In May 1606 the Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Queirós anchored in Big Bay on the island's northern coast, the first recorded European landing in Vanuatu, and clashed with local villagers before sailing away. No other Europeans returned to Santo until Louis Antoine de Bougainville in 1768 and James Cook in 1774, who gave the archipelago the name New Hebrides.
zh:
瓦尔佩人是瓦努阿图最大岛屿圣埃斯皮里图岛最北端的美拉尼西亚人，操大洋洲语，其关系密切的瓦尔佩话与胡库阿话常被合称为瓦尔佩-胡库阿。与其他瓦努阿图人一样，他们的祖先可追溯到约三千年前定居这片群岛的南岛语系拉皮塔文化航海者。

1606年5月，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯率领的西班牙探险队停泊在该岛北海岸的大湾，这是欧洲人有记载首次登陆瓦努阿图，途中还与当地村民发生冲突，随后驶离。此后直到1768年路易·安托万·德·布干维尔、1774年詹姆斯·库克先后到来，欧洲人才重返该岛；库克将这片群岛命名为新赫布里底群岛。

en:
The Vangunu are an Oceanic people of Vangunu, a volcanic island at the southern end of the New Georgia group in the Solomon Islands, most of its coast ringed by Marovo Lagoon. Their language is closely related to Marovo, spoken on the island's northern shore, and most Vangunu speakers command both tongues.

The islanders live from subsistence gardens and fishing. Vangunu was among the islands charted in 1568 by the brigantine built for Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish settlement on Santa Isabel, whose cruises under Pedro Ortega Valencia and Hernando Enríquez first mapped the central Solomons for Europeans.
zh:
万古努人是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛南端火山岛万古努岛上说大洋洲语的族群，岛屿大部分海岸被马罗沃潟湖环绕。他们的语言与岛北部通行的马罗沃语关系密切，多数万古努语使用者两种语言都会说。

岛民以园圃自给农业和捕鱼为生。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚在圣伊莎贝尔岛的西班牙定居点建造的双桅船出航测绘，万古努岛正是佩德罗·奥尔特加·巴伦西亚和埃尔南多·恩里克斯等人标定的岛屿之一，欧洲人由此首次绘出所罗门群岛中部的海图。

en: The Vargagaits are an Evenki clan band of the taiga east of the Yenisei, around the Yeruda, Teya and Chirimba rivers in what is now the Severo-Yeniseysky district of Krasnoyarsk Krai. They were nomadic reindeer herders and hunters whose clans fell under Cossack yasak collection when Russian power reached the Yenisei taiga in the 1600s.
zh: 瓦尔加盖茨人是叶尼塞河以东泰加林的鄂温克氏族游群，活动在今克拉斯诺亚尔斯克边疆区北叶尼塞区的叶鲁达河、捷亚河和奇林巴河一带。他们以游牧养鹿和狩猎为生，17世纪俄国势力到达叶尼塞泰加林后，其氏族被纳入哥萨克的雅萨克征收体系。

en:
The Vazimba are remembered in Malagasy oral tradition as the first inhabitants of Madagascar, Austronesian settlers who reached the island from the Indonesian archipelago between roughly 350 BCE and 500 CE. They cleared highland forests by slash-and-burn farming, growing bananas, tubers and ginger, and tradition holds that they knew neither metallurgy nor rice cultivation.

By the eighth century they had absorbed or displaced earlier settlers and called themselves tompontany, masters of the soil; their highland villages and kingdoms were often ruled by queens.

From the fourteenth century the expanding Merina kingdoms pressed on their lands. The rulers Andriamanelo, Ralambo and Andrianjaka drove them out of the highlands between the sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries. The last independent communities were destroyed or absorbed into Merina society.
zh:
瓦赞巴人在马尔加什口传传统中被视为马达加斯加岛最早的居民，是约公元前350年至公元500年间从印度尼西亚群岛渡海而来的南岛语系定居者。他们用刀耕火种开辟高地森林，种植香蕉、块茎和姜；按传统说法，他们既不懂冶金，也不会种稻。

到8世纪，他们已同化或驱逐了更早的定居者，自称“土地之主”；他们在高地的村落和王国常由女王统治。

14世纪起，不断扩张的梅里纳诸王国进逼其土地。16世纪至17世纪初，安德里亚马内洛、拉兰博和安德里安贾卡等君主把他们逐出高地。最后的独立社群或被消灭，或并入梅里纳社会。

en:
The Vedda, who call themselves Wanniyalaeto, are the indigenous forest people of Sri Lanka and probably its oldest inhabitants, predating the Indo-Aryan settlers from whom the Sinhalese descend. Their name comes from a Tamil word meaning hunter.

In the interior they kept their old ways around Bintenne and Dambana, while the Anuradhapura and Coast Veddas drew closer to their Sinhalese and Tamil neighbours.

Their tongue, built on a language isolate of unknown origin, became a stable creole through contact with Sinhala by the 1200s. Most Vedda came to speak Sinhala, keeping their own tongue for hunting calls and religious chants; their traditional religion was polytheistic, overlaid among interior groups by Buddhism. Assimilation steadily narrowed the communities preserving the old life.
zh:
维达人自称万尼亚莱托，是斯里兰卡的土著森林居民，也很可能是岛上最古老的居民，早于后来僧伽罗人所源出的印度—雅利安定居者。族名来自泰米尔语，意思是猎人。

内陆维达人在宾特纳和丹巴纳一带保持古老生活方式，阿努拉德普勒和海岸维达人则与邻近的僧伽罗人、泰米尔人日益接近。

他们本族语言的底层是系属不明的孤立语言，在与僧伽罗语接触中演变，到13世纪已形成稳定的克里奥尔语。后来多数维达人改说僧伽罗语，本族语只在狩猎呼号和宗教吟唱中保留；传统信仰为多神教，内陆群体又在其上叠加了佛教。同化不断压缩着保留古老生活方式的社群。

en:
The Venda, or Vhavenda, are a Bantu people of the mountainous country along the Limpopo, on either side of the present-day border between South Africa and Zimbabwe. Their roots reach back to the Kingdom of Mapungubwe, whose hilltop capital flourished between about 1220 and 1300 as a center of metalworking and long-distance trade before it was abandoned as the climate dried and power shifted north to Great Zimbabwe.

The Venda formed from the Vhangona, earlier inhabitants of the Soutpansberg, and Karanga-Rozvi clans moving in from Zimbabwe; their language took shape from around 1400 through contact with Sotho-Tswana and Kalanga neighbors.

In the Soutpansberg they built the royal kraal of Dzata under the legendary chief Thoho-ya-Ndou, and the stone settlements of Thulamela and Dzata carried on the Mapungubwe tradition of hilltop towns.
zh:
文达人又称瓦文达人，是林波波河沿岸山区的班图人，生活在今南非与津巴布韦边界两侧。他们的渊源可追溯到马蓬古布韦王国：其山顶都城约在1220—1300年间兴盛，是金属加工和长途贸易的中心，后来因气候干旱而被废弃，权力北移至大津巴布韦。

文达人由索特潘斯山区较早的居民万戈纳人，与从津巴布韦迁入的卡兰加-罗兹维诸氏族融合而成；他们的语言约从1400年起，在与索托-茨瓦纳人和卡兰加人的接触中定型。

在索特潘斯山区，他们在传说中的酋长托霍亚恩杜率领下建立了王家村寨扎塔，图拉梅拉和扎塔等石建聚落延续了马蓬古布韦营建山城的传统。

en:
Venetian culture belongs to the Veneto people of north-eastern Italy, centred on lagoon Venice. Their Venetian language grew from local Vulgar Latin, first attested in the thirteenth century; linguists debate whether it is Gallo-Italic or its own Dalmatian Romance group.

In 1337 Venice was the dominant Adriatic maritime republic, ruled by its doge and Great Council, its merchants linking Europe with the Byzantine and Islamic east. After the War of Chioggia with Genoa, it conquered a mainland empire, taking Treviso, Padua and Verona by the early fifteenth century. Venetian was a Mediterranean trade lingua franca with its own theatre, from Ruzante's peasant comedies to the eighteenth-century Goldoni, while Tuscan became the language of formal writing.

The League of Cambrai defeated Venice at Agnadello in 1509, and Ottoman wars cost it Cyprus, Crete and Aegean possessions. In 1797 Napoleon abolished the republic, ceding the Veneto to Austria by the Treaty of Campo Formio; after a decade in the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy, it returned to Habsburg rule in 1815 as part of Lombardy-Venetia.
zh:
威尼斯文化属于意大利东北部威尼托居民，以潟湖之城威尼斯为中心。威尼斯语源于当地通俗拉丁语，13世纪始见记载；它属高卢-意大利语支还是自成达尔马提亚罗曼语，学界仍有争论。

1337年，威尼斯是亚得里亚海首要海上共和国，总督与大议会治国，商人连通欧洲与拜占庭、伊斯兰东方。与热那亚的基奥贾战争后共和国征服陆上领地，15世纪初取得特雷维索、帕多瓦、维罗纳。威尼斯语曾是地中海贸易通用语，戏剧自鲁赞特的农民喜剧至18世纪戈尔多尼；托斯卡纳语则成为正式书面语。

1509年康布雷同盟在阿尼亚代洛击败威尼斯，奥斯曼战争又使它失塞浦路斯、克里特和爱琴海领地。1797年拿破仑灭共和国，依《坎波福尔米奥条约》割威尼托予奥地利；在拿破仑的意大利王国统治十年后，1815年作为伦巴第-威尼托的一部分重归哈布斯堡。

en:
The Vepsians are a Baltic Finnic people of the lake country between Lake Ladoga, Lake Onega and Lake Beloye. The Gothic writer Jordanes may name them in the sixth century. The Russian Primary Chronicle calls them the ves, the first inhabitants of Beloozero, who paid tribute to the Varangians in 859.

Farming, fur hunting and river trade on the Volga route sustained them. From the twelfth century most Vepsian lands belonged to Novgorod; groups crossing the Svir merged into the Karelians. After Moscow annexed Novgorod in 1478 the rest became state peasants, gradually assimilated by Slavic settlers.

In the early eighteenth century northern Vepsians were assigned to the Olonets ironworks and others to the Lodeynoye Pole shipyard. In 1824 the ethnographer Sjögren traced their identity back to the ves of the chronicles.
zh:
韦普斯人是波罗的芬兰人的一支，故乡在拉多加湖、奥涅加湖与别洛耶湖之间。哥特作家约尔达尼斯在6世纪的记载可能已提到他们。罗斯《往年纪事》称他们为维斯人，说白湖的最早居民就是他们，859年他们曾向瓦良格人纳贡。

农耕、毛皮捕猎和伏尔加商路的河运贸易养育了他们。12世纪起大部分韦普斯土地归属诺夫哥罗德，越过斯维里河的支系融入卡累利阿人。1478年莫斯科兼并诺夫哥罗德后，其余人成为国有农民，逐渐被斯拉夫移民同化。

18世纪初，北部韦普斯人被划归奥洛涅茨冶金厂做工，另一些人被派往洛杰伊诺耶波列造船厂。1824年，民族学家舍格伦把他们与编年史中的维斯人对应起来。
