en: The Vezo are the fishing people of Madagascar's western and southwestern coast, living along the shore between Toliara and Morondava; their name means those who live from the sea. They speak a Malagasy dialect of Malayo-Polynesian origin and define themselves by a maritime way of life rather than descent, sailing pirogues and trading fish with inland neighbours such as Masikoro.
zh: 威祖人是马达加斯加西部和西南沿海的渔民，分布在图利亚拉与穆龙达瓦之间的海岸，族名意为靠海为生的人。他们讲源于马来-波利尼西亚语系的马尔加什语方言，以海上生计而非血统界定身份，驾驶独木舟出海捕鱼，并用渔获与马希科洛人等内陆邻居交易。

en:
The Vietnamese, or Kinh, are Vietic people of the Red River Delta, whose Đông Sơn ancestors, the Lạc Việt, formed Văn Lang under legendary Hùng kings. Millennium-long Chinese rule began with the Han conquest of 111 BCE, bringing Confucian learning, Chinese administration and Sinitic vocabulary, though the vernacular tongue survived. Ngô Quyền restored independence in 938, defeating a Chinese fleet on the Bạch Đằng; Đinh Bộ Lĩnh founded Đại Việt in 968, capital Thăng Long under the Lý and Trần; the Trần repelled three Mongol invasions by 1337.

Ming China reconquered it in 1407, but Lê Lợi expelled them in 1427, and Lê Thánh Tông crushed Champa in 1471.

From the sixteenth century it split between the northern Trịnh and southern Nguyễn, who pushed settlement south in the Nam Tiến; missionaries came and Alexandre de Rhodes printed the romanized quốc ngữ in 1651. The Tây Sơn uprising briefly reunited it before Gia Long founded the Nguyễn dynasty at Huế in 1802.
zh:
越南人又称京人，是红河三角洲的越族语民族，其东山文化先民骆越人在传说中的雄王治下组成文郎。公元前111年汉朝征服开始千年北属，带来儒家学问、中式官制和汉语词汇，本土越语则始终存续。938年吴权在白藤江击败中国舰队恢复独立，968年丁部领建大越国，李朝、陈朝以升龙为都，到1337年陈朝已三次击退蒙古入侵。

1407年明朝重新征服越南，1427年被黎利逐出；黎圣宗1471年攻灭占婆。

16世纪起国家分裂为北方郑氏与南方阮氏，阮氏推动移民沿海南下“南进”；传教士到来，亚历山大·德·罗德1651年印行拉丁化国语字。西山起义曾短暂统一全国，嘉隆1802年在顺化建立阮朝。

en:
The Vili are a Bantu people and a branch of the Kongo, settled on the Atlantic coast from southwestern Gabon to Cabinda, around Loango and the Kouilou estuary. With other peoples they formed the core of the Kingdom of Loango, which broke away from Kongo in the sixteenth century; tradition names King Njimbe as its founder.

At its height in the seventeenth century Loango exported copper and cloth, while the Vili, organised in matrilineal clans, became its dominant political group and expressed their spirituality through carved nkisi nail fetishes.

Vili brokers dominated trade with European ships, first in ivory and copper and later in slaves, enriching a small elite but unbalancing society. After King Buatu died in 1787 the succession faltered and the kingdom fragmented into rival chiefdoms.
zh:
维利人是班图人的一支、刚果人的分支，聚居在从加蓬西南部到卡宾达的大西洋沿岸，以罗安果和奎卢河口为中心。他们与其他族群共同构成罗安果王国的核心；该王国于16世纪脱离刚果王国独立，传说中由恩吉姆贝建立。

17世纪罗安果处于鼎盛期，输出铜和布匹，按母系氏族组织的维利人成为王国的主导政治集团，并以“恩基西”钉子神像雕刻表达信仰。

维利中间商把持了与欧洲商船的贸易，先是象牙和铜，后来转为奴隶，少数精英致富而社会结构失衡。1787年布阿图国王去世后继承混乱，王国分裂为彼此竞争的酋长领地。

en:
The Vitimske are the Evenki, or Tungus, bands of the Vitim Plateau, the upper Vitim basin in present-day northeastern Buryatia and Zabaykalsky Krai. They spoke Vitim Evenki dialects of the Northern Tungusic branch and lived as nomadic taiga hunters who kept reindeer for riding and transport and pitched conical birch-bark tents.

Russian Cossacks first entered their country in 1639, when Maksim Perfilyev sailed up the Vitim to the mouth of the Tsipa; forts such as Barguzin soon imposed the fur tribute, or yasak, on the local clans and took hostages to ensure payment. Tribute demands and the spread of Russian settlement gradually pushed Vitim hunting groups deeper into the eastern taiga over the following two centuries.
zh:
维季姆人是活动在维季姆高原的鄂温克（通古斯）游猎群体，家园在维季姆河上游流域，位于今布里亚特东北部与外贝加尔边疆区境内。他们说鄂温克语北通古斯语支的维季姆方言，在泰加林中过游猎生活，饲养驯鹿用于骑乘和运输，住桦树皮搭成的锥形帐篷。

1639年，哥萨克马克西姆·佩尔菲利耶夫沿维季姆河上溯至齐帕河口，俄国人首次进入这一地区；不久巴尔古津堡便向当地氏族征收毛皮税，并扣押人质以保证完税。在此后两个世纪里，赋税压力和俄国移民的扩张，迫使维季姆游猎群体不断向东部泰加林深处迁移。

en:
The Alpine culture speaks the eastern branch of Vivaro-Alpine, an Occitan dialect traditionally called gavot from Gap to Briançon. These valleys made up the High Dauphiné. From the 1040s they belonged to the counts of Albon, whose dolphin emblem gave the Dauphiné its name.

The charter granted to Briançon in 1244 was enlarged in 1343 into the Republic of the Escartons, a league of five valleys that kept its privileges until 1789. In 1349 the last dauphin, Humbert II, sold the Dauphiné to the future Charles V of France; thereafter the French king's eldest son bore the title of Dauphin.

The Treaty of Utrecht in 1713 shifted the transalpine valleys of the Briançonnais to Savoy. Briançon, fortified by Vauban, withstood a three-month Allied siege in 1815. French gradually displaced gavot from administration and trade, though gavot long remained the language of mountain villages.
zh:
阿尔卑斯文化使用维瓦赖-阿尔卑斯语的东部方支，属于奥克语方言，在加普到布里扬松一带传统上称为“加沃话”。这些山谷构成上多菲内。11世纪40年代起，山区归属阿尔邦伯爵，其纹章上的海豚图案是“多菲内”一名的由来。

1244年授予布里扬松的特许状于1343年扩充为埃斯卡顿共和国，由五个山谷结盟而成，其特权一直维持到1789年。1349年，末代多菲内藩侯安贝尔二世把多菲内卖给未来的法王查理五世，此后法国王太子便享有“多菲内”的头衔。

1713年《乌得勒支条约》把布里扬松地区的山外山谷划给萨伏依。沃邦加固的布里扬松在1815年顶住了反法同盟三个月的围攻。法语逐渐在行政和贸易中取代加沃话，但加沃话长期仍是山乡村庄的语言。

en:
The Volhynians were the East Slavic people of Volhynia, between the Western Bug and the Pripyat. The Primary Chronicle places the Dulebes, Buzhans and Volhynians there, and in 988 Vladimir the Great founded Volodymyr, which became the capital of the Rurikid Principality of Volhynia.

In 1199 Prince Roman the Great joined Volhynia with Halych to form the Kingdom of Galicia-Volhynia, which survived Mongol raids and succession wars until its collapse around 1340. Poland and Lithuania divided the region between 1352 and 1366. After the Union of Lublin in 1569 it became the Volhynian Voivodeship of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth.

At the First Partition of 1772 the Belz district passed to Austria, and the Third Partition of 1795 handed the rest to the Russian Empire, which dissolved the local Uniate Church and made the country a Russian governorate.
zh:
沃里尼亚人是沃里尼亚的东斯拉夫人，居于西布格河与普里皮亚季河之间。《古史纪年》记载当地有杜列比人、布然人和沃里尼亚人等部落；988年弗拉基米尔大帝兴建沃洛德米尔城，后来成为留里克王朝沃里尼亚公国的都城。

1199年罗曼大公将沃里尼亚与哈利奇合并，组成加利西亚-沃里尼亚王国，挺过蒙古入侵和继承战争后约于1340年瓦解。1352—1366年，波兰与立陶宛瓜分该地区。1569年卢布林联合后，它成为波兰立陶宛联邦的沃里尼亚省。

1772年第一次瓜分时，贝尔兹划归奥地利，1795年第三次瓜分后其余部分归入俄罗斯帝国，当地合并派教会被取缔，土地改为俄国的一个省。

en:
The Votians are a Finnic people of Ingria, between the Gulf of Finland and Lake Peipus, considered its oldest known inhabitants and probably descended from Iron Age farmers.

Medieval Russian chronicles call them the Voď and group them with Finnic neighbours as Chudes. In 1069 they joined a raid on Novgorod, but later became part of the Novgorod Republic, whose Vodskaya division took its name from them.

When Moscow absorbed Novgorod in the 1470s, many Votians were deported. From 1534 Orthodox missionaries sent by Archbishop Macarius destroyed their pagan shrines and gradually converted them. Sweden ruled Ingria for most of the seventeenth century; the Votians kept their Orthodox faith and Votic tongue, and their villages around Koporye and the Soikino peninsula remained the heart of Votia.
zh:
瓦佳人是英格里亚的芬兰语支民族，居住在芬兰湾与楚德湖之间，被视为当地已知最古老的居民，先民可能是铁器时代的农人。

中世纪罗斯编年史称他们为沃德人，并把他们与邻近的芬兰语支族群统称丘德人。1069年，他们参与袭击诺夫哥罗德，后来并入诺夫哥罗德共和国，共和国的沃季行政区即因他们得名。

15世纪70年代莫斯科吞并诺夫哥罗德后，大批瓦佳人被驱逐。1534年起，大主教马卡里派遣的东正教传教士捣毁他们的异教神龛，逐步使其改宗。17世纪的大部分时间里英格里亚归瑞典统治；瓦佳人保留了东正教信仰和瓦佳语，科波里耶与索伊基诺半岛一带的村庄仍是瓦佳兰的核心。

en:
The Wa are an Austroasiatic people of the hills between the Mekong and the Salween, spanning Yunnan and the Shan country of Burma. Chinese records trace them to a branch of the ancient Hundred Pu; their autonyms Wa, Ba Raog and A Wa mean mountain people.

They farmed rice, beans and poppies, kept buffalo for sacrifice, and honoured spirits through wooden drums and offerings, once taking heads to fertilise the rice fields.

The Wa of Kengtung were displaced around 1229 and later defeated by King Mangrai of Lan Na, after which many fell under Shan rule. Wa close to the Dai took up Theravada Buddhism, while remote hill villages kept their animist rites. Their Palaungic language had no traditional script, and literate Wa wrote in Chinese or Shan characters.
zh:
佤是南亚语系民族，聚居在湄公河与萨尔温江之间、地跨云南与缅甸掸邦的山地。汉文记载把他们追溯为古“百濮”的一支；自称“佤”“巴饶克”“阿佤”都有“住在山上的人”之意。

佤人种植水稻、豆类和罂粟，养水牛用于祭祀，通过木鼓和献祭崇拜神灵，曾以猎人头祈求稻田丰收。

1229年前后，景栋的佤人被逐，后来又败于兰纳的孟莱王，许多人自此沦为掸族的属民。与傣族邻近的佤人接受了南传上座部佛教，深山村寨则保留万物有灵仪式。他们的佤德昂语支语言本无文字，识字者多用汉字或掸文书写。

en:
The Waanyi, also spelt Wanyi or Wanji, are an Aboriginal people of the well-watered limestone and sandstone country south of the Gulf of Carpentaria, straddling the border of the Northern Territory and Queensland and including parts of the Gregory River. Norman Tindale estimated their territory at about 25,000 square kilometres, from the upper Nicholson River and Spring and Lawn Hill creeks east to the Barkly River and Bannockburn, west to Old Benmara and south-west to Mount Morgan.

They lay south of the Gunindiri and Garrwa, west of the Injilarija and Nguburinji and east of the Wambaya and Wakaya. Their language forms the southern branch of the Garrwan family, distinct from the surrounding Barkly and Mirndi tongues.
zh:
瓦安伊人又拼作瓦尼或万吉，是卡奔塔利亚湾以南水源充沛的石灰岩与砂岩地区的原住民，地跨北领地与昆士兰边界，格雷戈里河的一部分也在其地域内。诺曼·廷代尔估计其领地约2.5万平方公里，东起尼科尔森河上游及斯普林溪、朗希尔溪，向东延伸至巴克利河与班诺克本，西抵旧本马拉，西南达摩根山。

他们位于古宁迪里人和加拉瓦人以南、因吉拉贾人和恩古布林吉人以西、万巴亚人和瓦卡亚人以东。他们的语言属加拉万语系的南支，与周围的巴克利诸语和米尔恩迪诸语不同。

en:
The Waashiw, better known as the Washoe, are the ancient people of Lake Tahoe on the California-Nevada border, their autonym meaning people from here. They have occupied the eastern Sierra and adjoining Great Basin for at least six thousand years. Their language is a surviving isolate sometimes assigned to the Hokan family, suggesting they held the country before the Numic tribes arrived.

Four regional bands followed a seasonal round: summer fishing for whitefish at Tahoe, autumn gathering pine nuts in the eastern hills, and winter in sheltered valley camps with stores of dried fish and game.

The Kings Beach culture that arose around the lake about 500 marks their early archaeological tradition. Spanish explorers may have met them in the early nineteenth century, but no European presence disturbed their round before 1837.
zh:
瓦肖人是加利福尼亚与内华达边界塔霍湖畔的古老居民，其自称意为“本地人”。他们在内华达山脉东麓及相邻的大盆地居住了至少六千年。瓦肖语是幸存的孤立语言，有时被暂归霍坎语系，这表明努米克诸族到来之前他们或许便已据有此地。

四个区域群体遵循季节轮转：夏天在塔霍湖捕白鱼，秋天到东山采松子，冬天躲进避风的谷地营地，靠鱼干和猎获过冬。

约500年在湖畔兴起的金斯滩文化，是他们早期的考古传统。19世纪初或许有西班牙探险者与他们相遇，但直到1837年，还没有欧洲人的势力扰动他们的轮转。

en:
The Waccamaw were a Siouan people of the Carolina coast, whose villages lined the Waccamaw and Pee Dee rivers. Their name, recorded as Guacaya by the kidnapped interpreter Francisco de Chicora in the 1520s, is of unknown meaning. Their language went unrecorded, though it is thought to have belonged to the Catawban family.

Farming towns had stood in their country since the Mississippian period. Disease and settlement cut their numbers sharply: the Carolina census of 1715 counted only 610 Waccamaw.

They joined the Yamasee War of 1715 against the colonists, and a conflict in 1720 left sixty more dead or captured. In 1755, pressed by Cherokee and Natchez raids, the survivors joined the Cheraw and Pedee in being adopted into King Hagler's Catawba nation.
zh:
沃卡莫人是卡罗来纳沿海的苏语民族，村落分布在沃卡莫河与皮迪河沿岸。16世纪20年代，被掳走的翻译奇科拉的弗朗西斯科把其族名记为瓜卡亚，含义已不可考。他们的语言没有留下记录，一般认为属于卡托巴语族。

早在密西西比文化时期，他们的土地上就已有农耕城镇。 疫病和殖民扩张使人口锐减：1715年卡罗来纳人口普查只统计到610名沃卡莫人。

他们加入1715年的亚马西战争对抗殖民者，1720年的一场冲突又使六十人被杀或被俘。1755年，在切罗基人和纳奇兹人的袭扰下，幸存者与切罗人、皮迪人一起被黑格勒王的卡托巴人收养。

en:
The Wahgochtatta are the Otoe under the name they took after splitting from the Missouria; both peoples, with the Iowa and Ho-Chunk, once formed a Chiwere-speaking nation around the Great Lakes. It moved southwest before European contact, parting from the Ho-Chunk near Green Bay. After their chiefs quarreled, the Otoe separated from the Missouria on the Missouri, calling themselves Waghtochtatta.

Around 1760 they occupied earth-lodge villages on the Platte River, where in 1804 the Lewis and Clark Expedition held its first council with a Plains tribe, at the place later called Council Bluff. They hunted buffalo on horseback and grew maize, beans and squash.

Their first land cession to the United States came in 1830, and treaties of 1833 and 1836 stripped away most of their Missouri and Iowa country.
zh:
瓦戈奇塔塔人是奥托人与纽阿奇人分道后使用的自称；他们与纽阿奇人、巴荷杰人、霍查克人原本是五大湖一带说奇维雷语的共同体。欧洲人到来之前，该群体向西南迁徙，在格林贝附近与霍查克人分开。两群酋长发生争执后，奥托人在密苏里河与纽阿奇人分开，改称瓦戈奇塔塔。

约1760年，他们在普拉特河一带居住土屋村落，1804年刘易斯与克拉克远征队在此与他们举行了同平原部落的第一次议事会，该地后来得名康瑟尔布拉夫斯。他们骑马猎捕野牛，也种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。

1830年他们首次向美国割地，1833年和1836年又签订条约，交出在密苏里和艾奥瓦的大部分土地。

en:
The Wagiman are an Aboriginal people of the Northern Territory, whose traditional country stretched for hundreds of square kilometres through the Mid-Daly Basin and across the Daly River, around Pine Creek. Their neighbours included the Waray, Kunwinjku, Jawoyn, Wardaman, Jaminjung, Murrinh-Patha and Malak-Malak.

Their language, once loosely grouped with the Gunwinyguan tongues of Arnhem Land but reclassified as an isolate, is noted for its complex verbal morphology and a rare part of speech called the coverb, and was said to sound rougher than the Marrithiyel speech of the country downstream.
zh:
瓦吉曼人是澳大利亚北领地的原住民，传统地域穿过中戴利盆地，跨过戴利河，方圆达数百平方公里，以派恩克里克一带为中心。他们的邻族包括瓦雷人、贡温古人、贾沃因人、瓦达曼人、贾明荣人、马林-帕塔人和马拉克-马拉克人。

他们的语言曾被粗略归入阿纳姆地的贡温古语群，后改定为孤立语言；它有复杂的动词形态和一种罕见的词类“副动词”，据说其语音比下游马里蒂耶尔人的话听起来更生硬。

en:
The Wahpekhute are one of the four bands of the Eastern Dakota, the Santee of the Sioux Seven Council Fires; their name means Leaf Archers, or Shooters Among the Trees. The most nomadic of the Santee, they formed the alliance's Upper Council with the Mdewakanton.

Before the seventeenth century they hunted and gathered wild rice around Lake Superior and in the Wisconsin woods, but wars with the musket-armed Ojibwe drove them southwest to southern Minnesota by the late eighteenth century.

They entered the fur trade, moving their village to Alexander Faribault's post in 1834. War with the Sauk and Meskwaki cost some hundred and seventy Wahpekhute lives between 1815 and 1825 and killed their chief Shakeska in 1822; his son Tasagi succeeded him as game grew scarce and dependence on traders deepened.
zh:
瓦佩库特人是东达科他四族之一，属苏族“七议团”中的桑蒂人，族名意为“树叶弓箭手”或“树丛中的射手”。他们是桑蒂人中最逐猎物而居的一支，与布德韦坎通万人共同组成联盟的上议事会。

17世纪以前，他们在苏必利尔湖周边和威斯康星林地狩猎、采集野稻，但与持有火枪的奥吉布瓦人交战，被迫向西南迁徙，至18世纪末定居明尼苏达南部。

他们卷入毛皮贸易，1834年把村落迁到亚历山大·法里博的贸易站附近。1815—1825年间，与索克人和梅斯克瓦基人的战争使约一百七十名瓦佩库特人丧生，酋长沙克斯卡于1822年战死，其子塔萨吉继任；此时猎物日渐稀少，他们对贸易商的依赖也日益加深。

en:
The Whapetunwan, or Wahpeton, are one of the four Eastern Dakota bands of the Santee within the Sioux Seven Council Fires, and their name means Leaf Village. They were the constant allies of the Sisseton, with whom they shared villages and councils and who were later grouped with them as the Upper Sioux.

In the seventeenth century they lived in the forests southwest of Lake Superior, gathering wild rice, spearing fish from canoes and hunting woodland game, until the musket-armed Ojibwe and the long Dakota-Ojibwe War drove them toward the prairies of southern Minnesota.

In April 1806 their chiefs joined those of the Sisseton and Mdewakanton, five hundred warriors in all, in a council with the American officer Zebulon Pike at the mouth of the Minnesota River.
zh:
瓦佩图万人（即瓦佩顿人）是东达科他四族之一，属苏族“七议团”中的桑蒂人，族名意为“树叶村”。他们始终与锡西屯万人结盟，村落与议事会都合在一起，后来二者被统称为上苏族。

17世纪时，他们住在苏必利尔湖西南的森林里，采集野稻、乘独木舟叉鱼、猎捕林中之物，直到手持火枪的奥吉布瓦人和漫长的达科他—奥吉布瓦战争把他们赶向明尼苏达南部的草原。

1806年4月，他们的酋长与锡西屯万、布德韦坎通万的酋长汇合，共五百名战士，在明尼苏达河河口会见美国军官泽布伦·派克。

en: The Waima are a coastal people of Central Province in southeastern New Guinea, settled around Yule Island and the Kairuku coast northwest of Port Moresby. Their speech, with its three close dialects of Waima, Roro and Paitana, is an Oceanic Austronesian language of the West Central Papuan Tip group rather than a Papuan language.
zh: 瓦伊玛人是新几内亚东南部中央省的沿海族群，聚居在莫尔兹比港西北方的尤尔岛和凯鲁库海岸一带。他们的语言含瓦伊玛、罗罗、派塔纳三个极近的方言，属南岛语系大洋洲语族中西巴布亚尖端语支，并不是巴布亚语。

en: The Waiwai are a Carib-speaking forest people of the remote headwaters between the Essequibo in Guyana and the Mapuera in northern Brazil, formed from the fusion of several small Carib groups. Hunters and slash-and-burn farmers famous for their dogs and their hammock weaving, they stayed beyond colonial observation until an explorer reached their villages in 1837.
zh: 怀怀人是加勒比语森林族群，生活在圭亚那埃塞奎博河与巴西北部马普埃拉河之间偏远的河源地带，由数个小型加勒比群体融合而成。他们从事狩猎和刀耕火种农业，以良犬和吊床编织闻名；直到1837年才有探险者抵达他们的村落，此前始终处于殖民视野之外。

en: The Wajuru, also recorded as Ajuru or Wayurú, are a Tupian people of north-western Rondônia near the Bolivian border, whose Wayoró language belongs to the Tupari branch. They were formerly divided into three subgroups, the Stone people, the Agouti people and the Forest people, each with a speech variety, in the forests between the Guaporé headwaters and the frontier.
zh: 瓦朱鲁人又记作阿朱鲁人或瓦尤鲁人，是朗多尼亚州西北部、靠近玻利维亚边境的图皮语族群，所用瓦约罗语属图帕里语支。他们原分三支：岩石人、刺鼠人和森林人，各有自己的语言变体，散居在瓜波雷河源头与边境之间的丛林中。

en:
The Wakaya are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, whose traditional territory of some 39,000 square kilometres lay north-east and east of Tennant Creek, bordered by the Alyawarre, Kaytetye and Warlpiri. They gathered purslane seeds and threshed them inside stone circles to draw out their oily nutrients.

Their language, Wagaya, belonged to the Warluwarric (Ngarna) subgroup of the Pama-Nyungan family and had eastern and western dialects; frontier violence later drove many Wakaya from their country together with the Alyawarre.
zh:
瓦卡亚人是北领地的澳大利亚原住民，约3.9万平方公里的传统领地位于滕南特克里克东北和以东，与阿利亚瓦尔人、凯蒂切人和瓦尔皮里人相邻。他们采集马齿苋籽，在石圈中脱粒，取其含油的养分。

他们的瓦加雅语属帕马‑牛雅语系的瓦尔卢瓦里克（纳尔纳）语支，分东、西两种方言；后来的边疆暴力迫使许多瓦卡亚人与阿利亚瓦尔人一起逃离故土。

en:
The Wallachians are the Romanian-speaking Vlachs of the plain between the southern Carpathians and the Danube, where the Principality of Wallachia grew. In 1330 Basarab I defeated Hungarian king Charles I's army at Posada, throwing off Hungarian overlordship and founding the House of Basarab.

Vlad III the Impaler defied Mehmed II with a night attack at Târgoviște in 1462. From the 1520s the principality became an Ottoman tributary, though Michael the Brave broke with the Porte in 1593 and briefly united Wallachia, Transylvania and Moldavia in 1600.

Constantin Brâncoveanu's reign brought the Brâncovenesc architectural style and ended with his execution in 1714. The Ottomans then imposed Phanariote princes, whose rule ended with Tudor Vladimirescu's rising in 1821. After the Treaty of Adrianople in 1829 Russian-administered reform opened a period of urban growth, with Bucharest overtaking Târgoviște.
zh:
瓦拉几亚人是南喀尔巴阡山与多瑙河之间的罗马尼亚语弗拉赫人，公国在此兴起。1330年巴萨拉布一世在波萨达击败匈牙利国王查理一世，摆脱宗主权，开创巴萨拉布王朝。

穿刺公弗拉德三世抗拒穆罕默德二世，1462年夜袭特尔戈维什泰。从16世纪20年代起，公国沦为奥斯曼的附庸，但勇敢者米哈伊于1593年起兵反土，并在1600年短暂统一瓦拉几亚、特兰西瓦尼亚和摩尔多瓦。

布兰科韦亚努时期形成了同名建筑风格，他于1714年被处死。奥斯曼人随后任命法纳尔王公，1821年弗拉迪米雷斯库起义终结了其统治。1829年《阿德里安堡条约》后，俄国主导改革促进城市发展，布加勒斯特超过特尔戈维什泰。

en:
Walloon is the langue d'oïl of the southern Low Countries, spoken along the Meuse and Sambre around Liège and Namur. Its speakers descend from the Gallo-Romans of Gallia Belgica, whom Germanic neighbours called the Walha. The Sequence of Saint Eulalia of around 880 shows features of this region.

Walloon's growth was shaped by the Principality of Liège, whose bishop Notker received the county of Huy in 980 and founded an ecclesiastical state that lasted eight hundred years. Namur, Limbourg and Hainaut passed to the Burgundian dukes and then to the Spanish and Austrian Habsburgs.

Walloon written literature appeared in the sixteenth century, but after French annexation in 1795 the language retreated to home and workshop. After 1815 the land belonged to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands, breaking away in the Belgian Revolution of 1830.
zh:
瓦隆语是低地国家南部的奥依语，通行于列日、那慕尔一带的默兹河和桑布尔河沿岸。说这种语言的人是贝尔吉卡高卢行省的高卢-罗马人后裔，日耳曼邻人称之为“瓦尔哈”。约880年写成的《圣欧拉利亚颂》带有这一地区的语言特征。

瓦隆语的成长受到列日公国影响：980年列日主教诺特克获得于伊伯国，建立起延续八百年的教会国家。那慕尔、林堡和埃诺则转入勃艮第公爵之手，此后又历经西班牙和奥地利哈布斯堡家族统治。

瓦隆语书面文学在16世纪出现，但1795年法国吞并此地后，本土语言退居家庭和作坊。1815年后，这片土地并入尼德兰联合王国，又在1830年比利时革命中脱离出来。

en: The Wamesa are an Austronesian people of the neck of the Bird's Head Peninsula, around Wondama Bay and Bintuni Bay in West Papua. Their language, often called Wandamen, is a South Halmahera-West New Guinea language that served as a coastal lingua franca before Papuan Malay spread.
zh: 瓦梅萨人是南岛语族族群，散居鸟头半岛颈部的温达马湾和宾图尼湾沿岸。他们的语言旧称万达门语，属南岛语系南哈马黑拉-西新几内亚语群，在巴布亚马来语扩散之前曾是沿海通用语。

en:
The Wampanoag, or Wôpanâak, are the Algonquian people of southeastern New England; their name means people of the dawn. They moved between fishing stations and fields where women grew maize, beans and squash, and descent and property passed through the maternal line.

The epidemic of 1616 to 1619 killed as many as nine in ten, leaving Patuxet village empty when the Pilgrims founded Plymouth in 1620. The Patuxet captive Tisquantum, known as Squanto, and the sachem Massasoit helped the settlers survive, an alliance remembered through the harvest feast of 1621.

Peace ended under Massasoit's son Metacom, called King Philip, whose war of 1675 to 1676 killed forty percent of the surviving Wampanoag and ended with hundreds sold into slavery. John Eliot printed a Bible in their Wôpanâak dialect in 1663; the dialect gradually fell out of daily use after the American Revolution.
zh:
万帕诺亚格人（自称沃帕纳克人）是新英格兰东南部的阿尔冈昆语民族，族名意为“黎明之人”。他们往来渔场和田地，妇女种植玉米、菜豆和南瓜，世系与财产沿母系传承。

1616—1619年的疫病使多达九成人口丧生，1620年清教徒建立普利茅斯时，帕图克塞特村已死散一空。曾被掳走的帕图克塞特人蒂斯匡特姆（即斯匡托）和酋长马萨索伊特帮助移民渡过难关，双方的盟约因1621年的丰收宴而为后世所铭记。

和平在马萨索伊特之子梅塔科姆（即菲利普国王）时终结，1675—1676年的战争使幸存的万帕诺亚格人再减四成，数百人被卖为奴。约翰·埃利奥特曾在1663年用沃帕纳克方言印制圣经，该方言在美国独立战争后逐渐退出日常。

en:
The Wampar are an Austronesian-speaking people of the Markham Valley in Morobe Province, in the Bird's Tail of New Guinea. Their speech, Wampar or Dzob Wampar, is a Lower Markham language of the Huon Gulf group, spoken in villages across the Wampar plains inland from the gulf.

Unusually for Western Oceanic languages, which are otherwise confined to the coast, the Markham languages were carried into the interior valleys, where the Wampar and their relatives live in close contact with Trans–New Guinea peoples of the surrounding mountains.
zh:
万帕尔人是新几内亚“鸟尾”莫罗贝省马卡姆河谷的南岛语族群。他们的语言万帕尔语（自称佐布万帕尔语）属休恩湾语群的下马卡姆语族，通行于休恩湾内陆万帕尔平原的村落。

西部大洋洲诸语通常只分布在沿海，马卡姆诸语却深入内陆河谷，万帕尔人和亲属族群因此与周围山区说跨新几内亚语言的族群长期密切往来。

en: The Wangan, also called the Babbinburra, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Isaac Region in central Queensland, close neighbours of the Yagalingu people of the Belyando River headwaters.
zh: 旺加人又称巴宾布拉，是昆士兰中部艾萨克地区的澳大利亚原住民，与贝利安多河源头的亚加林古人比邻而居。

en:
The Huanca or Wanka are a Quechua people of the Mantaro valley in the central Peruvian highlands, named for the Quechua word for the stone monoliths typical of the region.

Their late pre-Inca history included small farming villages in the Wanka I phase of 1000 to 1350 and fortified hilltop towns in Wanka II from 1350 to 1460. By the fifteenth century the valley was shared among five chiefdoms. Around 1460 the army of Túpac Yupanqui incorporated them into Tawantinsuyu, with an administrative centre at Hatun Xauxa.

During the Inca civil war the Huanca stayed loyal to Cusco and suffered Atahualpist reprisals. On Pizarro's arrival they joined the Spaniards, helping defeat the Atahualpist general Quizquiz and later serving the viceroyalty; over five hundred Huanca fighters marched against the rebel Girón in 1553. Their local kuraka dynasties survived under Spanish rule into the independence era.
zh:
万卡人（又称胡安卡）是秘鲁中部高原曼塔罗河谷的克丘亚民族，名称源自克丘亚语中当地常见的巨石碑“万卡”。

其前印卡晚期历史包括1000—1350年农耕小村遍布的万卡一期，以及1350—1460年设防山顶城镇兴起的万卡二期。到15世纪，河谷由五个酋邦分据。约1460年，图帕克·尤潘基率军把诸酋邦并入塔万廷苏尤，以哈通豪哈为行政中心。

印卡内战中万卡人效忠库斯科，遭阿塔瓦尔帕一派报复。皮萨罗到来时他们倒向西班牙，助其击败阿塔瓦尔帕派将领基斯基斯，此后继续为总督辖区效力；1553年有五百多名万卡战士出征反叛的希龙。他们的土著酋长世家在西班牙统治下一直延续到独立时代。

en:
The Wajãpi, also recorded as Oiampi or Oyampi, are a Tupi-Guarani people of the lower Amazon and the Guiana frontier. They lived by slash-and-burn fields of cassava, sweet potato, yam and banana, supplemented by hunting and fishing.

Portuguese records of 1690 describe their migration from the lower Xingu to the Jari River and north into the forests between the Amazon and the Oyapock.

They fought French colonists, and a Jesuit mission founded on the Oyapock in 1738 brought disease and depopulation. When the Jesuits withdrew in 1763 the survivors scattered into the interior and deliberately isolated themselves; they numbered about six thousand in 1770. Only after 1820 did some northern groups renew contact with French officials and Maroon communities, while most villages kept their distance. They also exchanged cotton thread, hunting dogs and feather crowns for metal tools through the Wayana trade network.
zh:
瓦扬皮人又被记作奥扬皮人，是亚马逊河下游与圭亚那边境的图皮—瓜拉尼语族群。他们以刀耕火种种植木薯、甘薯、山药和香蕉，辅以狩猎和捕鱼。

1690年的葡萄牙文献记载他们从下兴古河迁至雅里河，再向北进入亚马逊河与奥亚波克河之间的森林。

他们与法国殖民者交战，1738年在奥亚波克河畔设立的耶稣会传教站带来疫病，造成人口锐减。1763年耶稣会士撤离后，幸存者散入内陆并主动与世隔绝，1770年时约有六千人。1820年以后，北部的一些群体才重新与法国官员和马龙人社区接触，多数村落仍保持距离。他们还通过瓦亚纳人的贸易网，以棉线、猎犬和羽冠换取金属工具。

en:
The Wapishana, also written Wapichan or Wapixana, are an Arawak-speaking people of the grasslands around Mount Roraima, sharing the Rupununi and Rio Branco savannahs with the Macushi and Pemon. Their tongue is the only Arawakan language of the region, amid Cariban-speaking neighbours.

Traditionally they lived by cassava farming, grating and toasting the root into flat bread, as well as hunting and fishing, and made pottery and woven cotton hammocks.

Their first indirect contact with Europeans came in 1498, when Columbus's third voyage reached the South American coast and goods began to move through Indigenous trade networks. From the seventeenth century Portuguese slave raiders pushed up the Branco River, and by the late 1700s Wapishana villagers were settled and put to work around the Portuguese fort on the river.
zh:
瓦皮沙纳人（又拼作瓦皮昌、瓦皮夏纳）是罗赖马山一带草原上的阿拉瓦克语族群，在鲁普努尼和布朗库河稀树草原上与马库希人、佩蒙人相邻而居。他们的语言是该地区唯一的阿拉瓦克语，四周是说加勒比语的邻族。

他们传统上以木薯种植为生，把木薯磨碎后烤成薄饼，同时狩猎、捕鱼，并制陶和编织棉布吊床。

1498年哥伦布第三次航行抵达南美海岸，是他们与欧洲人的第一次间接接触，货物随即通过原住民的贸易网流转。17世纪起，葡萄牙奴隶贩子沿布朗库河向上游掳掠人口，到18世纪末，瓦皮沙纳村民已被安置到河畔的葡萄牙要塞附近服役。

en:
The Wappo, who call themselves Micewal, are a Yukian-speaking people of northern California, whose villages stood in Napa Valley, Alexander Valley, the Russian River valley and on Clear Lake.

They split from their distant kin the Yuki at least five centuries ago, and their language took in strong influence from the unrelated Pomo speech. Living in small bands without centralized chiefs, they built houses of branches, leaves and mud and wove baskets tight enough to hold water.

With Spanish and Mexican settlement in Alta California, the Clear Lake Wappo were drawn into the mission system, which recorded at least 550 baptisms, while the Napa bands resisted General Vallejo's soldiers. Their resistance earned them the Spanish word for brave, from which the name Wappo derives; fighting ended with a peace treaty in 1836.
zh:
米塞瓦尔人是加利福尼亚北部讲尤基语系语言的族群，村落分布在纳帕谷、亚历山大谷、俄罗斯河谷以及克利尔湖畔。

他们与远亲尤基人至少在五个世纪前分化；其语言与波莫语没有亲缘关系，却深受后者影响。 他们没有统一首领，以小群活动，用树枝、树叶和泥盖房，编织的篮子细密到可以盛水。

随着西班牙和墨西哥在上加利福尼亚建立殖民，克利尔湖的米塞瓦尔人被卷入传教体系，传教记录中至少有五百五十人受洗；纳帕的各支则抵抗巴列霍将军的军队。他们的抵抗为自己赢得了西班牙语中意为“勇敢者”的称号，“瓦波”一名即由此而来；战事于1836年双方签订和约后结束。

en:
The Warao, whose name means the boat people, are the riverine inhabitants of the Orinoco Delta in eastern Venezuela. Their tradition holds that they were driven into its channels and marshes as refugees from more warlike tribes.

They travelled by dugout canoe between stilted houses raised above the floodwaters, fishing, catching crabs and harvesting the moriche palm; their isolated language belongs to no known family.

Columbus sighted the delta coast in 1498 and Alonso de Ojeda explored the river mouth in 1499; the stilt villages he saw helped inspire the name Venezuela, or little Venice. The wetlands long shielded the Warao from conquest. Their first mission was founded in 1682, but repeated Spanish and English attempts to settle them in towns during the eighteenth century pushed many toward Suriname.
zh:
瓦劳人的名字意为“船上的人”，是委内瑞拉东部奥里诺科三角洲依水而居的族群。据他们自己的传说，祖先为躲避更好战的部落，作为难民退入这片河汊与沼泽组成的水网。

他们乘独木舟往来于高悬洪水之上的桩上房屋之间，捕鱼、捉蟹、采集莫里切棕榈；孤立的瓦劳语不属于任何已知语系。

1498年哥伦布望见三角洲海岸，1499年阿隆索·德·奥赫达探查河口，他所见的桩上村落促成了“委内瑞拉”（意为小威尼斯）这一名称。水网长期庇护瓦劳人免遭征服。1682年，他们中间建起第一座传教站，但18世纪西班牙和英国当局一再试图把他们迁入城镇，反而促使许多人迁往苏里南。

en:
The Waray people are a Visayan ethnolinguistic group of the Eastern Visayas, occupying most of Samar, northern Leyte and Biliran. Their Waray language is also called Lineyte-Samarnon. They descend from Iron Age Austronesian seafarers who built trading societies in contact with Chinese, Bornean and Malay merchants.

In 1521 they became the first Filipinos encountered by Europeans, when Ferdinand Magellan's expedition met fishermen near Suluan Island, as recorded by Antonio Pigafetta. Jesuit missionaries reached Leyte in 1595 and within a decade had gathered much of the population into Catholic mission villages. The Spanish called these tattooed islanders Pintados, meaning the painted ones, and Bisaya; their martial reputation survives in the saying that a Waray never retreats from a fight.
zh:
瓦瑞人是米沙鄢族群的一支，分布在东米沙鄢的萨马岛大部、莱特岛北部和比利兰岛。他们的瓦瑞语又称莱特-萨马尔农语。他们是铁器时代航海南岛移民的后裔，建立起与中国、婆罗洲和马来商人往来的贸易社会。

1521年，他们成为欧洲人最早接触到的菲律宾人：斐迪南·麦哲伦的船队在苏卢安岛附近遇到渔民，此事由安东尼奥·皮加费塔记录下来。1595年耶稣会传教士抵达莱特，十年内便把大部分居民编入天主教传教村落。西班牙人把这些有文身习俗的岛民称作“平塔多斯”，意为文身者，又称他们为比沙亚人；他们尚武的名声见于“瓦瑞人打仗绝不后退”的谚语。

en:
The Wardaman are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Northern Territory, whose traditional country ran from the upper Flora River west to the Victoria River Depot and south to Jasper Gorge. They speak Wardaman, a non-Pama-Nyungan language related to those of their neighbours the Dagoman and Yangman.

The Wardaman are known for their sandstone rock art, distinguishing buwarraja designs made by dreamtime beings, some at least 5,000 years old, from bulawula works made by people; the Yiwarlarlay site holds the giant images of the Lightning Brothers of dreamtime legend.

European contact, shared with the Dagoman and Yangman, was violent from the outset, and as their tribal lands were turned into pastoral leases Wardaman men took up cattle-droving while women worked as station hands.
zh:
瓦达曼人是北领地的澳大利亚原住民，传统领地从弗洛拉河上游向西延伸至维多利亚河驿站，南抵贾斯珀峡谷。他们使用非帕马-牛雅语的瓦达曼语，与邻族达戈曼人和阳曼人的语言相近。

瓦达曼人以砂岩岩画闻名，把创世神灵在梦创时代留下的布瓦拉贾图案（部分至少有5000年历史）与人制作的布拉乌拉作品区分开来；伊瓦拉莱遗址保留着梦创传说中“闪电兄弟”的巨型画像。

他们与达戈曼人、阳曼人一样，最初与欧洲人的接触充满暴力；随着部落领地变为牧场租地，瓦达曼男子转而赶牛，女子则在牧场帮工。

en:
The Wargamaygani, or Warrgamay, were the Aboriginal people of Halifax Bay in northern Queensland, holding about fifty miles of coastline and, by one estimate, six hundred square miles of country. Their language, Warrgamay, was a Dyirbalic Pama-Nyungan tongue with three dialects: Wargamaygan on the lower Herbert River, Biyay at the river mouth, and Hinchinbrook Biyay along the coast and on Hinchinbrook Island.

Clans such as the Ikelbara, Mungulbara and Karabara made up the people. Initiation used tooth avulsion, scarification and nose-bone piercing rather than circumcision, polygamy was common, and a widow was married to her dead husband's brother.
zh:
瓦加梅甘人又称瓦尔加梅人，是昆士兰北部哈利法克斯湾的原住民，占据约五十英里海岸线，据估计领有六百平方英里土地。瓦尔加梅语属帕马-牛雅语系迪尔巴利语支，分三种方言：赫伯特河下游的瓦加梅甘方言、河口的比亚伊方言，以及沿海和欣钦布鲁克岛上的欣钦布鲁克比亚伊方言。

他们由伊克尔巴拉、蒙古尔巴拉、卡拉巴拉等氏族组成。成年礼不行割礼，而采用拔牙、刻痕和穿鼻戴骨的仪式，一夫多妻普遍，寡妇须嫁给亡夫的兄弟。

en:
The Wari, or Huari, are the people of the Middle Horizon civilization of that name, its capital on a high plateau north-east of Ayacucho. From about 500 to 1000 the Wari state spread across the south-central Andes and Peruvian coast, planting centres such as Jincamocco around 600 and Cerro Baúl, and drawing the oracle city of Pachacamac and the old Moche lands into its orbit.

Its governors built white-plastered fieldstone compounds and D-shaped temples, extended terrace agriculture and maize farming into provinces, strung roads between centres, and held power through feasts, camelid offerings and worship of the Staff God, whose image later fed into Inca religion.

Centuries of drought began to undo the state around 800: by 1000 the capital was largely abandoned, its doorways deliberately sealed, and rival groups fought over its ruins as the Late Intermediate Period began. Small descendant communities lived on among the old cities, and Wari roads and terraces were later taken up by the Inca.
zh:
瓦里人创造了安第斯中期视野的同名文明，都城在阿亚库乔东北的高原上，约500年至1000年间兴盛于安第斯山脉中南部和秘鲁沿海一带。瓦里国家广建行政治理中心，如600年前后的钦卡莫科和塞罗巴乌尔，并把神谕之城帕查卡马克以及莫切故地纳入势力范围。

统治者用刷白灰的毛石围墙和D形神庙治理地方，把梯田农业和玉米耕作推广到外省，以道路连接各中心，靠宴饮、羊驼献祭和对杖神的崇拜维系统治，杖神形象后来融入印加宗教。

数百年干旱从800年前后开始侵蚀这个国家：到1000年，都城大半废弃，门洞被有意封死，敌对群体在废墟间争战，晚中间期由此开端。少数后裔仍住在古城之中，而瓦里人的道路和梯田后来为印加人所承袭。

en:
The Warluwarrai, known in the records as Waluwara or Walugara, are an Aboriginal people of the Georgina River country in western Queensland, taking their name from their Warluwarra language, a member of the Ngarna or Warluwaric branch of Pama-Nyungan. Norman Tindale assigned them about 18,000 square kilometres along the Georgina, from Roxborough Downs north to Carandotta and Urandangi and south-west to Pituri Creek.

They were formed of several hordes, among them the Didjadidja at Roxborough, the Kapula at Carandotta and the Panggara on Moonah Creek. Their initiation life centred on the Miki ceremony, whose rites included subincision. Variant names include Walukara, Warluwara and Paringgara, meaning creek dwellers.
zh:
瓦鲁瓦拉人在文献中又称瓦鲁瓦拉人或瓦卢加拉人，是昆士兰西部佐治那河流域的原住民，族名来自他们的瓦鲁瓦拉语，该语言属帕马-牛雅语的恩加尔纳（瓦鲁瓦里克）语支。诺曼·廷代尔划定其沿佐治那河的领地约1.8万平方公里，从罗克斯伯勒当斯向北至卡兰多塔和乌兰丹吉，西南达皮图里溪。

他们由若干游群组成，已知的有罗克斯伯勒的迪贾迪贾、卡兰多塔的卡普拉和莫纳溪的潘加拉。成年礼以米基仪式为核心，仪式中包含下切礼。异名还有瓦卢卡拉、瓦鲁瓦拉和意为“溪居者”的帕林加拉。

en:
The Warnindilyakwan were the Aboriginal people of Groote Eylandt and the neighbouring Bickerton and Woodah Islands in the Gulf of Carpentaria. The name properly denoted one clan of the south-eastern Dilyakburra peninsula; the fourteen clans of the archipelago were also known as the Anindilyakwa. Their language, Anindilyakwa, was unrelated to the Pama-Nyungan family and had an unusually complex grammar.

Long before Europeans arrived, Macassan traders from Sulawesi sailed to the islands each monsoon, exchanging goods for trepang, beeswax, ironwood and pearls bound for the Chinese market. In 1803 Matthew Flinders encountered sixty Macassan praus under the chief Pobasso nearby; Macassan words for tobacco, cloth and alcohol, and the tamarind tree, entered island life through these voyages.
zh:
瓦宁迪利亚夸人是卡奔塔利亚湾格鲁特岛及邻近的比克顿岛、伍达岛上的原住民。该名称本指东南部迪利亚布拉半岛的一个氏族，群岛上的十四个氏族也统称为阿宁迪利亚夸人。他们使用的阿宁迪利亚夸语不属于帕马—牛雅语系，语法格外复杂。

早在欧洲人到来之前，苏拉威西的望加锡商人每年季风时节航行到这些岛屿，用货物换取销往中国市场的海参、蜂蜡、铁木和珍珠。1803年，马修·弗林德斯在附近遇到望加锡首领波巴索率领的六十艘帆船；望加锡语中烟草、布匹和酒的词汇以及罗望子树，都随着这些航行进入岛上的生活。

en:
The Waropen were an Austronesian-speaking coastal people of the eastern shore of Cenderawasih Bay in northern New Guinea, with the Ambumi or Waruri branch extending west into Wondama Bay. Their language was closely related to the Austronesian languages of nearby Yapen Island.

Their tradition derives the name Waropen from a word meaning people of the interior: the ancestors are said to have come down from Mount Tonater at Wamusopedai and spread along the coast in three branches, Ambumi, Kai and Ronari.

Society was built on clans called da, gathered into villages called nu; in wartime and slave-raiding expeditions the clans united under a leader titled Sera, the foremost of whom bore the title Serabawah. The first recorded European encounter came on 30 May 1705, when the Dutch explorer Jacob Weyland reached a settlement he recorded as Erropang.
zh:
瓦罗彭人是新几内亚岛北部极乐鸟湾东岸的南岛语系滨海族群，安布米支系又称瓦鲁里人，西至温达马湾。他们的语言与邻近亚彭岛上的南岛语关系密切。

按他们自己的传说，“瓦罗彭”意为“来自内陆的人”：先祖从瓦穆索佩代的托纳特山顺流下到海岸，分成安布米、卡伊和罗纳里三支扩散。

社会以名为“达”的氏族为单位，若干氏族组成名为“努”的村落；遇战事或掳奴远征，各氏族便联合起来，拥戴一位称塞拉的首领，其中资历最高者称塞拉巴瓦。1705年5月30日，荷兰探险家雅各布·韦兰抵达一处他记作埃罗庞的定居点，这是现存最早的欧洲人接触记录。

en:
The Warpe, or Huarpes, were the Indigenous people of the Cuyo region east of the Andes. From the fifth century they lived in settled villages, farming corn, beans, squash and quinoa between the Jachal and Diamante rivers. The lagoons of Guanacache were one of their heartlands. They spoke two related languages, Allentiac and Millcayac, of which only fragmentary records survive.

They were never fully absorbed into the Inca Empire, though after about 1480 Inca influence brought llama herding and Quechua into their culture. After the Spanish conquest, encomenderos moved large numbers of Warpe across the Andes to work in Chile, while the communities left around Guanacache were gradually assimilated or merged with other displaced groups during the colonial centuries.
zh:
瓦尔佩人是安第斯山脉以东库约地区的原住民。从5世纪起，他们定居村落，在哈查尔河与迪亚曼特河之间种植玉米、菜豆、南瓜和藜麦。瓜纳卡切潟湖一带是他们的核心区域之一。他们讲两种亲属语言——阿伦蒂亚克语和米尔卡亚克语，只留下零散的记录。

他们从未被完全并入印加帝国，但约1480年以后，印加影响带来了养驼业和克丘亚语。西班牙征服后，委托监护主把大量瓦尔佩人迁过安第斯山到智利做工，留在瓜纳卡切周边的群体则在殖民时代逐渐被同化，或与其他流离的族群融合。

en:
The Warumungu, also spelt Warramunga, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the central Northern Territory, whose country centred on Tennant Creek, on the western edge of the Barkly Tableland. Permanent waterholes along the creek drew them together in drought years. Their language was a Pama-Nyungan tongue close to Warlpiri, and alongside spoken words the Warumungu maintained a highly developed sign language.

European explorers who first encountered them in the late nineteenth century described a flourishing people. The telegraph station, pastoral runs and later gold mines at Tennant Creek brought dispossession and frontier violence, and the Warumungu were progressively pushed from their ancestral grounds.
zh:
瓦拉蒙加人是北领地中部的澳大利亚原住民，领地以巴克利台地西缘的滕南特克里克为中心。旱年时人们会汇聚到溪边常年不涸的水潭。他们的语言属帕马‑牛雅语系，与瓦尔皮里语相近；除口语外，瓦拉蒙加人还保有一套高度发达的手语。

19世纪末最早接触他们的欧洲探险家曾记述这是一个繁盛的族群。滕南特克里克建起电报站、牧场和后来的金矿后，他们遭到剥夺和边疆暴力，逐渐被赶出祖先的土地。

en:
The Warrwa, also spelt Warwa, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the Kimberley region of Western Australia. Their country, estimated at roughly 9,800 square kilometres, followed the eastern shore of King Sound and reached inland to the upper Logue River; they also lived around Derby and north of Meda. Their speech was an eastern Nyulnyulan language so close to Nyikina that it was often classified as a Nyikina dialect.

Before European contact the Nyikina pushed down the Fitzroy River and split the Warrwa clans into a western ‘little Warrwa’ and an eastern ‘big Warrwa’ around Derby and Meda. The first European to explore their coast was William Dampier, who entered King Sound aboard the Cygnet in 1688.
zh:
瓦尔瓦人是西澳大利亚州金伯利地区的澳大利亚原住民。其领地据估算约9800平方公里，沿金湾东岸延伸，内陆直抵洛格河上游；他们还活动在德比一带和梅达以北。瓦尔瓦语是纽尔纽尔语系东部的语言，与尼基纳语极为接近，常被归为尼基纳语的方言。

欧洲人到来之前，尼基纳人沿菲茨罗伊河向下游推进，把瓦尔瓦诸氏族切成两部分：西部的‘小瓦尔瓦’和德比、梅达一带东部的‘大瓦尔瓦’。最早考察他们海岸的欧洲人是威廉·丹皮尔，他于1688年乘‘西格尼特号’驶入金湾。

en:
The Wata-deka were the Watatikka, the Ryegrass Seed Eaters of the Western Shoshone, whose winter home was Ruby Valley in north-eastern Nevada. Their country adjoined those of related Western Shoshone bands, including the Tipatikka or Pinenut Eaters and the Kuyatikka or Bitterroot Eaters.

Numic-speaking foragers entered the Great Basin around the fourteenth century, and by 1500 Shoshone speakers occupied most of Nevada. Like other Western Shoshone bands they took their name from their staple food, moved in small family groups between seasonal camps, and harvested pine nuts in the autumn mountains, returning to the same winter villages year after year.
zh:
瓦塔德卡人即瓦塔蒂卡人，意为“食黑麦草籽者”，属西部休休尼人，冬季聚居在内华达东北部的鲁比瓦利。与他们相邻的西部休休尼部族包括蒂帕蒂卡人（食松子者）和库亚蒂卡人（食苦根者）。

说努米克语的采集狩猎者约在14世纪进入大盆地，到1500年前后，说休休尼语的部族已占据内华达大部。与其他西部休休尼部族一样，他们以主食得名，以小家庭为单位在季节性营地间迁徙，秋天进山采收松子，年复一年回到同一处冬村。

en:
The Wathaurongi were the Wadawurrung, a nation of the Kulin alliance whose territory centred on Corio Bay and Geelong, taking in the Bellarine Peninsula and running inland toward Ballarat. Twenty-five clans spoke a Kulinic language of the Pama-Nyungan family.

In December 1803 the escaped convict William Buckley came among them from the abandoned Sullivan Bay settlement. The band took him for the resurrected leader Murrangurk, adopted him and in time made him a headman; he lived with them for thirty-two years until he returned to the Europeans in 1835.

That year squatters began pouring into the Geelong district, and Wadawurrung resistance, chiefly raids on sheep, was met with reprisal killings. When the headman Woolmudgin was killed in 1836, his case collapsed in court because Aboriginal people were barred from giving evidence.
zh:
瓦绍隆人即瓦达伍伦人，属库林族群联盟，领地以科里奥湾和吉朗为中心，涵盖贝拉林半岛，并向内陆延伸到巴拉瑞特一带。他们分为二十五个氏族，所说的语言属帕马-牛雅语系的库林语支。

1803年12月，从沙利文湾流放地逃出的犯人威廉·巴克利来到他们中间。族人以为他是死而复生的首领穆兰古克，收留了他，后来还立他为首领；巴克利与他们共同生活了三十二年，直到1835年才回到欧洲人当中。

同年，牧地占用者开始涌入吉朗地区，瓦绍隆人以袭击羊群为主的抵抗招来报复性屠杀。1836年首领伍尔马金被杀，案子却因原住民无权出庭作证而在法庭上不了了之。

en:
The Watjarri, also spelt Wajarri or Wadjarri, were an Aboriginal people of the Murchison country in the Mid West of Western Australia. Their traditional lands covered an estimated 91,000 square kilometres, reaching the hills around the upper Lyons and Gascoyne rivers in the north and the Roderick and upper Sanford rivers in the south.

Their language belonged to the Kartu branch of the Pama-Nyungan family, and their word Yamatji, originally meaning a Watjarri person, later became the name for all Aboriginal people of the Murchison region. When the Swan River Colony was founded far to the south in 1829 this dry inland country remained beyond the colonial frontier, and pastoral leases only spread into it in the later nineteenth century.
zh:
瓦贾里人是西澳大利亚中西部默奇森地区的原住民。他们的传统领地约9.1万平方公里，北至莱昂斯河和加斯科因河上游一带的山地，南达罗德里克河与桑福德河上游。

他们的语言属帕马-牛雅语系的卡尔图语支；“亚马吉”本指瓦贾里人，后来成为整个默奇森地区原住民的统称。1829年天鹅河殖民地在遥远的南方建立时，这片干旱的内陆仍在殖民边疆之外，直到19世纪后期牧地租约才延伸进来。

en:
The Waunana, also called Wounaan, Chanco or Noanamá, were one of the two peoples of the Chocó, alongside the Emberá. They spoke Woun Meu, one of the Chocoan languages, and their homeland was the lower San Juan River and the rainy Pacific lowlands of western Colombia. They practiced shifting agriculture, fishing and basketry woven from werregue palm.

Descent was matrilineal and polygamy traditional; extended families lived in circular thatched tambos raised on stilts against floods, guided in matters of health and the spirits by jaibaná shamans. From the late 1700s Spanish pressure pushed Waunana groups, together with the Emberá, across the Darién into Panama, where they settled the river valleys of the Darién Gap.
zh:
瓦乌纳纳人又称沃南人、昌科人或诺阿纳马人，与恩贝拉人并为乔科人的两大支系。他们使用乔科语族的沃恩梅乌语，故土在哥伦比亚西部的圣胡安河下游和多雨的太平洋低地。他们从事轮耕农业和渔捞，并用韦雷格棕榈编织篮筐。

他们按母系继嗣，传统上实行多妻制；大家族住在高脚的圆形茅草屋坦博里，以躲避洪水，健康和通灵之事则由海巴纳萨满主持。18世纪末，西班牙人的压迫迫使瓦乌纳纳人与恩贝拉人一起穿过达连地峡迁入巴拿马，在达连隘口的河谷中定居。

en:
The Waveroo, also written Waywurru, were one of the principal groups of the Pallanganmiddang people of north-eastern Victoria, whose country took in the upper Murray lands around the Ovens and King rivers, Wangaratta and Mount Buffalo. Their language, Pallanganmiddang, formed together with Dhudhuroa the Upper Murray group of Pama-Nyungan.

The Waveroo adopted the Kulin system of eaglehawk and crow moieties inherited through the father, and their clans intermarried with nearby Kulin groups. The Hume and Hovell expedition crossed their country in 1824, and Major Thomas Mitchell's favourable report of 1836 opened the way for pastoral squatters who soon occupied the river flats.
zh:
瓦弗鲁人又译韦武鲁人，是维多利亚州东北部帕兰甘米唐人的主要支系之一，其领地包括欧文斯河与金河流域、旺加拉塔和布法罗山一带的墨累河上游土地。帕兰甘米唐语与杜杜罗阿语共同构成帕马-尼永加语系的上墨累语组。

瓦弗鲁人采用了库林人的鹰氏与鸦氏半族制度，半族身份沿父系继承，氏族与邻近的库林族群互通婚姻。1824年休姆与霍维尔探险队穿过他们的土地，1836年托马斯·米切尔少校的有利考察报告为牧场主敞开大门，河畔平地很快被占据。

en:
Waxiang was the speech of the Waxiang people of the Wuling mountains in north-western Hunan, centred on Yuanling and reaching Dayong and neighbouring counties. Although most Waxiang speakers were counted among the Miao, their language was a divergent branch of Chinese, preserving Old Chinese initials lost almost everywhere else; its name meant roughly rural speech, with the first character used only for its sound.

These valleys were the old Qin and Han commanderies of Qianzhong and Wuling on the edge of the Chinese world. Through the Yuan and the Ming after 1368 they remained under native tusi chieftains until the Qing replaced them with imperial officials.
zh:
瓦乡是湘西武陵山区瓦乡人的语言，以沅陵为中心，延伸到大庸及相邻县份。瓦乡人虽多被划入苗族，但瓦乡话是汉语中一支分化的方言，保留了别处几乎消失的上古汉语声母；其名称大意是乡野之话，首字仅为记音。

这些山谷地处华夏边缘，曾是秦、汉黔中郡、武陵郡的旧地。元代以及1368年建立的明代，这里长期由土著土司统辖，直到清代改土归流，才由朝廷流官治理。

en:
The Wayuu, also called Guajiro, were an Arawakan-speaking people of the arid Guajira Peninsula on the Caribbean coast, between Colombia and Venezuela. Organized into matrilineal clans, they lived in scattered rancherías, herded goats, fished and gathered, and were known for their woven mochila bags.

They were never subdued by the Spanish: the two sides remained in a more or less permanent state of war, marked by repeated rebellions. The Wayuu adopted horses and firearms, obtaining guns from English and Dutch smugglers in exchange for pearls and brazilwood.

The great Guajira rebellion of 1769 began after Spaniards seized Wayuu to build the fortifications of Cartagena; at its height some twenty thousand warriors took nearly every settlement in the region and burned them. Spanish reinforcements ended the rising, but the Wayuu kept their autonomy and their arms through the rest of the colonial period.
zh:
瓦尤人又称瓜希罗人，是加勒比海岸干旱的瓜希拉半岛上的阿拉瓦克语族群，分布在哥伦比亚与委内瑞拉交界一带。他们按母系氏族组织，散居在牧场村落里，放牧山羊、渔猎采集，以编织的莫奇拉挎包闻名。

西班牙人从未征服他们：双方几乎长期处于战争状态，多次爆发起义。瓦尤人学会了使用马匹和火器，用珍珠和巴西红木向英国、荷兰走私商换取枪支。

1769年的瓜希拉大起义，起因是西班牙人抓捕瓦尤人去修建卡塔赫纳防御工事；起义高潮时约两万名战士攻占并焚毁了地区内几乎所有定居点。西班牙援军最终平息了起义，瓦尤人在殖民时代余下的时间里仍保住了自治和武装。

en:
The Wea were a Miami-Illinois-speaking people of western Indiana, counted either as a subtribe of the Miami or as their close kin. Their autonym Waayaahtanwa comes from waayaahtanonki, the place of the whirlpool, the village where French writers first recorded them in 1673.

In the early eighteenth century they settled the middle Wabash Valley, with their chief town of Ouiatenon near Lafayette; the French built Fort Ouiatenon there to trade with them and the Kickapoo, and the related Pepikokia band merged into them in 1742. The Wea joined Pontiac's War against the British in 1763 and later fought beside the Miami in the Revolutionary War and subsequent frontier conflicts.

Under United States removal policy they were forced across the Mississippi into Missouri and Arkansas in 1820. The surviving Wea merged with the Kaskaskia, Piankeshaw and Peoria into the Confederated Peoria.
zh:
威亚人是居于印第安纳西部、操迈阿密—伊利诺伊语的族群，被视为迈阿密人的分支或近亲。他们的自称瓦亚坦瓦源自瓦亚塔农基，意为漩涡之地，那是1673年法国文献首次记载他们时所在的村庄。

18世纪初，他们定居在沃巴什河中游，主村维亚特农靠近拉斐特；法国人在当地修建维亚特农堡，与他们和基卡普人贸易，同族的佩皮科基亚队伍也于1742年并入威亚人。威亚人于1763年参加庞蒂亚克反英战争，后来又在独立战争及此后的边疆冲突中与迈阿密人并肩作战。

在美国的迁徙政策下，他们于1820年被强行安置到密西西比河以西的密苏里和阿肯色。幸存的威亚人最终与卡斯坎卡汉人、皮安克肖人和皮奥里亚人合并为皮奥里亚联盟。

en:
The Welsh, who call themselves Cymry, are the Brittonic people of mountainous western Britain, heirs of Iron Age tribes whose Common Brittonic speech became Old Welsh. After the Roman withdrawal they formed competing kingdoms, including Gwynedd, bound by the law codified under Hywel Dda and a bardic tradition.

Gruffudd ap Llywelyn briefly united the country before his death in 1063. Edward I destroyed Gwynedd in 1282, killing Llywelyn ap Gruffudd and building castles; Owain Glyndŵr's rising from 1400 briefly won a Welsh parliament and church but collapsed within a decade.

The Tudors' Laws in Wales Acts of 1535 and 1542 ended the legal distinction between Wales and England, yet William Morgan's Welsh Bible of 1588 preserved Cymraeg as a literary and congregational language. The eighteenth-century Methodist revival and eisteddfod shaped Welsh life, while coal and iron drew people into the southern industrial valleys.
zh:
威尔士人自称Cymry，是不列颠西部山区的布立吞人后裔，承自铁器时代部落，其通用布立吞语演变成了古威尔士语。罗马撤离后，他们形成格温内思等相互争胜的王国，以海韦尔·达编定的法律和吟游传统维系共同认同。

格鲁菲德·阿普·卢埃林曾在1063年去世前短暂统一威尔士。爱德华一世于1282年攻灭格温内思，击杀卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲德并广建城堡；欧文·格兰道尔于1400年发动的起义一度争得威尔士自己的议会和教会，却在十年内失败。

都铎王朝通过1535和1542年的《威尔士法案》取消威尔士与英格兰的法律差异，但1588年威廉·摩根的威尔士语圣经保住了威尔士语作为文学和教会语言的地位。18世纪循道宗复兴和艾斯特德福德诗会影响了威尔士生活，煤铁热潮则把乡村人口吸进南部的工业山谷。

en:
The Wemba-Wemba, also written Wamba-Wamba, were an Aboriginal people of the Murray and its tributaries in north-western Victoria and the adjoining Riverina and Mallee country of New South Wales. Their Kulin language belonged to the Pama-Nyungan family; its name followed the common Murray basin pattern of reduplicating the word for no, wemba, and Barababaraba was among its dialects while Nari Nari may have been another.

Their religious life centred on the Dreaming, which they called yemurraki. When Moravian missionaries settled at Gannawarra station to learn the language, the Wemba-Wemba deliberately switched tongues to keep matters secret. The explorer Thomas Mitchell crossed their territory in 1836, and his reports of well-watered grazing plains soon drew squatters in his wake.
zh:
温巴温巴人又译万巴万巴人，是墨累河及其支流一带的澳大利亚原住民，地跨维多利亚州西北部与新南威尔士州相邻的里弗赖纳和马利地区。他们的语言属帕马-尼永加语系的库林语族；其名字遵循墨累河流域常见的重叠构词，由意为“不”的温巴一词重叠而成。巴拉巴话是它的方言之一，纳里纳里话可能也是。

他们的宗教生活以称为耶穆拉基的梦创时代信仰为核心。摩拉维亚传教士在加纳瓦拉牧场站学习这种语言时，温巴温巴人便故意换用别的语言，以守住秘密。1836年，探险家托马斯·米切尔穿过他们的领地，他对水草丰美牧原的记述很快引来了牧场主。

en:
The Wenrohronon, or Wenro, were an Iroquoian people of western New York, south of Lake Ontario between the Niagara and Genesee rivers. They lived in longhouse villages under matrilineal clans and farmed maize, beans and squash.

Their name has been read as 'people at the place of the floating scum', a reference to the oil springs in their country, the first recorded petroleum source in what became the United States.

Long shielded by the Neutral Confederacy against Seneca raids, they lost that protection in 1638 during the Beaver Wars, and more than six hundred refugees fled through Neutral country to the Wendat village of Ossossané on Nottawasaga Bay. When the Haudenosaunee shattered the Wendat and Petun in 1648 and 1649, the surviving Wenro fled with them and were absorbed into the people who became the Wyandot.
zh:
温罗赫农人（简称温罗人）是纽约州西部的易洛魁语民族，领地位于安大略湖以南、尼亚加拉河与杰纳西河之间。他们住在长屋村落中，按母系氏族组织生活，种植玉米、豆类和南瓜。

其族名被解释为‘浮渣之地的人’，得名于境内的油泉——那是后来的美国境内最早见于记载的石油来源。

海狸战争期间，长期庇护他们、抵御塞内卡人袭扰的中立联盟于1638年撤回保护，六百多名温罗难民穿过中立族领地，逃到诺塔瓦萨加湾的休伦人村落奥索萨内。1648—1649年易洛魁联盟击溃休伦人和佩顿人后，幸存的温罗人随之一同逃亡，最终并入后来形成的怀恩多特人之中。

en:
The Wergaian were the Wergaia, also called Maligundidj, the people of the mallee eucalypt bushland in north-western Victoria. Their country took in the Wimmera River and a chain of lakes, and their language was a Wemba-Wemba dialect in the Kulinic branch of Pama-Nyungan. Some twenty clans shared the country under a matrilineal order of black and white cockatoo moieties whose relations determined marriage.

The Boorong clan on Lake Tyrrell observed the stars. The rising of Arcturus signalled the harvest of wood-ant larvae, while the setting of Vega marked the season for malleefowl eggs.

Smallpox from the First Fleet of 1788 spread down the Murray ahead of any European, the elders naming it thinba micka. When Thomas Mitchell crossed their lakes in 1836 he became the first white man most Wergaia had seen, his reports soon drawing sheep stations behind him.
zh:
韦尔盖亚人即韦尔盖亚族群，又称马利贡迪吉，意为“马利桉灌丛之地的人”，居住在维多利亚州西北部。领地涵盖威默拉河和一串湖泊，语言属帕马—牛雅语系库林语支，是韦姆巴—韦姆巴语的一种方言。约二十个氏族在母系制度下共享土地，社会分为黑、白凤头鹦鹉两个偶族，其关系决定通婚规则。

蒂勒尔湖畔的布龙氏族观测星象。大角星升起意味着可以采挖木蚁幼虫，织女星落下标志着眼斑冢雉的蛋可以捡拾。

1788年第一舰队带来的天花先于任何欧洲人顺墨累河传来，长者称之为“辛巴·米卡”。1836年托马斯·米切尔穿过他们的湖群，成为多数韦尔盖亚人见到的第一个白人，他发表的游记很快把牧羊站引到了这里。

en:
The Weskarini, also called Wàwàckeciriniwak, the people of the deer, and known to the French as La Petite Nation, were an Algonquian people of the lower Ottawa valley. Their hunting grounds lay north of the Ottawa River, around the Lièvre, Rouge and Petite-Nation rivers, and they traded with the Wyandot.

Samuel de Champlain met them on the Ottawa in 1613, and French missionaries later recorded a Christian community under chief Charles Pachirini near Trois-Rivières. In the Beaver Wars, Iroquois raids scattered the Algonquian bands of the Ottawa valley, and Weskarini fighting strength was largely destroyed in 1654.

Survivors had already begun drifting east, and by the later seventeenth century the Weskarini ceased to appear as a separate political people. Their descendants merged into other Algonquin communities of the St Lawrence and Ottawa valleys.
zh:
韦斯卡里尼人又称瓦瓦克奇里尼瓦克，意为“鹿之民”，法国人称他们为“小民族”，是渥太华河下游谷地的阿尔冈昆族群。他们的猎场位于渥太华河北岸的列夫尔河、鲁日河和小民族河一带，并与怀安多特人贸易。

塞缪尔·德·尚普兰在1613年于渥太华河与他们相遇，法国传教士后来记载了首领夏尔·帕奇里尼在三河镇附近带领的基督徒社群。海狸战争中，易洛魁人的袭扰打散了渥太华河谷的阿尔冈昆群体，韦斯卡里尼人的武装力量在1654年基本被摧毁。

幸存者此前已开始向东流散，到17世纪后期，韦斯卡里尼人不再作为独立的政治群体出现。其后裔融入了圣劳伦斯河与渥太华河谷的其他阿尔冈昆社群。

en:
The Western Abenaki are the Algonquian bands west of the Penobscot, spread across the Connecticut and Merrimack valleys: the Cowasuck, Missisquoi and Sokoki, together with the Pennacook confederacy whose chief villages stood at Amoskeag Falls and Pennacook.

Under the Pennacook sachem Passaconaway they made peace with the English of Massachusetts, but epidemics, Mohawk raids and King Philip's War broke their villages; some captives were enslaved, while refugees fled to the Hudson valley and then north. From about 1669 Abenaki families crossed into New France, where the governor granted them the seigneuries that became the Odanak and Wôlinak reserves.

From Quebec the Western Abenaki raided the New England frontier alongside the French in Queen Anne's War, striking Deerfield in 1704, and fought through Father Le Loutre's War and the French and Indian War. Pennacook descendants were absorbed into Odanak.
zh:
西阿贝纳基人是佩诺布斯科特以西的阿尔冈昆语各部，分布在康涅狄格和梅里马克河谷，包括科瓦萨克、密西斯阔伊、索科基人及彭纳库科联盟，后者主村位于阿莫斯基格瀑布和彭纳库科。

彭纳库科首领帕萨科纳韦带领他们同马萨诸塞英国人讲和，但疫病、莫霍克袭扰和菲利普国王战争摧毁村落：一些俘虏沦为奴隶，难民逃往哈得孙河谷，再北上。约从1669年起，阿贝纳基家庭进入新法兰西，获总督授地，后来成为奥达纳克和沃利纳克保留地。

安妮女王战争中，西阿贝纳基人从魁北克与法国人联手袭掠新英格兰，1704年进攻迪尔菲尔德，并在勒卢特尔神父战争和法国—印第安人战争期间作战。彭纳库科后裔融入奥达纳克社群。

en:
The Western Kru are the Kru-speaking peoples of the coast around the Cavally River, from southeastern Liberia to southwestern Ivory Coast, including the Klao, Grebo, Bassa and We. They reached the sea between the thirteenth and fifteenth centuries, partly to escape Manding slave raids; Bassa oral history dates their arrival between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries.

They lived in decentralized villages without kings, governed through the Poro and Sande bush schools; Grebo clans were led by a high priest called the Bodio. The Pepper Coast forests largely shielded them from enslavement, and men marked their foreheads with indigo tattoos as freemen.

From the 1790s Krumen, as the Grebo were called on the Ivorian shore, signed on as free sailors aboard European ships. The Bassa kept a pictographic script, and in 1827 American colonists settled among the Glebo at Cape Palmas.
zh:
西克鲁诸族是利比里亚东南到科特迪瓦西南、卡瓦利河一带沿海讲克鲁语的人群，包括克劳、格雷博、巴萨和韦人。他们于13至15世纪抵达海边，部分原因是躲避曼丁小邦的猎奴袭击；巴萨人的口传历史则把本族到达海岸的时间定在11至14世纪。

他们生活在没有国王的分权村社里，靠波洛会和桑德会的丛林学校维系秩序，格雷博各氏族由名为博迪奥的大祭司统领。胡椒海岸的密林使他们大体免遭奴役，男子在额头纹上靛蓝标记，以示自由人之身。

从18世纪90年代起，克鲁门人，即科特迪瓦一侧的格雷博人，以自由水手身份受雇于欧洲船只。巴萨人曾拥有一套象形文字；1827年，美国殖民团体在帕尔马斯角的格莱博人中间定居。

en:
Western Pomeranian Low German country covers the Baltic coast from Lübeck to the Oder, with lagoons and islands such as Rügen. Early in the twelfth century Slavic tribes held it: Obotrites in Mecklenburg, Lutici and Rani farther east; the Danes destroyed the Rani temple at Arkona in 1168. Henry the Lion's conquests, Otto of Bamberg's missions and the Ostsiedlung turned the region German: native princes kept thrones but took German speech and customs, while Rostock, Wismar and Stralsund took Lübeck law, joined the Hanseatic League and grew rich on herring, beer and Baltic trade.

The Griffins ruled the often-partitioned Duchy of Pomerania, absorbing Danish Rügen in 1325, Mecklenburg apart under its Obotrite dynasty. The Reformation made coastal cities Lutheran.

The Griffin line died out in 1637 during the Thirty Years' War, and Sweden and Brandenburg partitioned the duchy; Swedish Pomerania passed to Sweden until the Great Northern War and the 1815 Congress of Vienna, when the western coast joined the Prussian Province of Pomerania, apart from the Mecklenburg grand duchies.
zh:
西波美拉尼亚低地德语家园涵盖吕贝克至奥得河口的波罗的海海岸，多潟湖与吕根等岛屿。12世纪初仍为斯拉夫部族占据：梅克伦堡奥博特人及更东的卢蒂奇人、拉尼人，拉尼人的阿科纳神庙1168年为丹麦人所毁。狮子亨利的征服、班贝格的奥托传教与东向移民运动促其德意志化：本地王公保爵位而改用德语德俗，罗斯托克、维斯马、施特拉尔松德获吕贝克法、入汉萨同盟，靠鲱鱼、啤酒与波罗的海贸易致富。

格里芬家族统治屡遭分割的波美拉尼亚公国，1325年并入丹麦吕根；梅克伦堡则在奥博特王朝治下自立。宗教改革使沿海城市归信路德宗。

1637年格里芬家族于三十年战争中绝嗣，瑞典与勃兰登堡瓜分公国；瑞典属波美拉尼亚归瑞典王冠，直到大北方战争和1815年维也纳会议，整个西海岸并入普鲁士波美拉尼亚省，唯梅克伦堡大公国留在省外。

en:
Westphalians are a Low German people between the Rhine and Weser. In Roman times they belonged to the Saxon confederation; the AD 9 Teutoburg Forest battle was near Osnabrück. The 772–804 Saxon Wars broke Widukind's resistance, planted the bishoprics of Münster and Osnabrück and made Westphalia one of four Saxon duchy districts.

After Barbarossa deposed Henry the Lion in 1180, the Duchy of Westphalia went to Cologne archbishops, the rest into prince-bishoprics, Lippe and lordships of the Lower Rhenish–Westphalian Circle; Münster and Soest grew rich as Hanseatic cities. The Reformation split it between Catholics and Lutherans, and in 1534–1535 Anabaptists seized Münster, setting up a communal kingdom until the prince-bishop stormed it.

Westphalia suffered in the Thirty Years' War but gave its name to the 1648 Peace of Westphalia, signed at Münster and Osnabrück, its sovereign-state principle called Westphalian sovereignty. Napoleon made a short-lived Kingdom of Westphalia in 1807–1813; in 1815 the region joined the Prussian Province of Westphalia.
zh:
威斯特伐利亚人是莱茵河与威悉河之间的低地德语居民。罗马时属萨克森联盟，公元9年条顿堡森林之战近奥斯纳布吕克。772—804年萨克森战争败维杜金德，置明斯特、奥斯纳布吕克主教区，威斯特伐利亚成为萨克森公国四大区之一。

1180年巴巴罗萨废狮子亨利，公国归科隆大主教，余部分裂为主教区、利珀伯国等下莱茵-威斯特伐利亚圈小领地，明斯特、苏斯特等汉萨城致富。宗教改革分其为天主教与路德宗，1534—1535年再洗礼派夺明斯特建公社王国，为主教攻破。

威斯特伐利亚在三十年战争中惨遭兵燹，却使1648年在明斯特、奥斯纳布吕克签署的威斯特伐利亚和约以其得名，和约的主权国家原则称威斯特伐利亚主权。拿破仑1807—1813年设短命的威斯特伐利亚王国，1815年该地区并入普鲁士的威斯特伐利亚省。

en: The Wetarese are the Austronesian islanders of the Barat Daya chain between Timor and the Banda Sea, on Wetar, Leti, Babar and Damar, whose Timoric tongues, including the four Wetarese varieties of Wetar, are kin to Galoli of Timor. Sago farmers, fishers and traders who venerated ancestors through yene statues, they later stood within the Dutch colonial sphere in Maluku.
zh: 韦塔雷斯人是散居韦塔、勒蒂、巴巴和达马尔等西南马鲁古岛屿的南岛语族群，地处帝汶与班达海之间，其帝汶语支语言与帝汶的加洛利语相近，仅韦塔本岛就有四种差异明显的变体。他们以种植西谷、捕鱼和经商为生，用耶内小木像供奉祖先，后来处于荷兰在马鲁古的殖民势力范围内。

en:
The Wet'suwet'en are a branch of the Dakelh, or Carrier, people, living along the Bulkley River and around Burns and François lakes in British Columbia. Their endonym means people of the Bulkley River, and they speak Witsuwit'en, an Athabaskan language. Their kungax oral history recalls the ancestral cedar village of Dizkle, abandoned after an omen of disaster.

Society is ordered into five matrilineal clans divided among thirteen house groups under hereditary house chiefs, acting through the feast system. The canyon village of Witset shows roughly five and a half thousand years of habitation, its salmon fishery disrupted when a rockslide blocked the runs and people resettled at Hagwilget.

In 1822 the Hudson's Bay Company founded the Babine Establishment on Babine Lake, trading leather and salmon with the Wet'suwet'en and Babine. The post was moved and renamed Fort Babine in 1836.
zh:
韦苏韦滕人是达凯尔（卡里尔）人的一支，居住在不列颠哥伦比亚省的巴尔克利河沿岸以及伯恩斯湖、弗朗索瓦湖一带。其自称意为巴尔克利河人，使用阿萨巴斯卡语系的韦苏韦滕语。他们的口述史昆加克斯记载，祖先建有雪松木屋村落迪兹克尔，后因灾难征兆而废弃。

社会按母系划分为五个氏族，下分十三个家族屋群，由世袭屋群酋长通过夸富宴体系治理。峡谷渔村维特塞特已有约五千五百年的居住史，一次岩崩阻断鲑鱼洄游后，居民迁往哈格威尔盖特。

1822年，哈德逊湾公司在巴宾湖设立巴宾贸易站，与韦苏韦滕人和巴宾人交换皮革和鲑鱼。1836年贸易站迁址并改称巴宾堡。

en:
The Wichí, whose name means people, were long known as Mataco, a name now considered insulting. They belong to the Chaco Central and Chaco Austral, chiefly along the Bermejo and Pilcomayo rivers, with the Weenhayek branch in Bolivia. Fishermen, hunters and gatherers, they had largely settled in riverside villages by the sixteenth century, when invading Ava Guaraní pushed some bands north and south-east.

The first Spanish record of them dates to 1609. In 1632 they joined the Toba in destroying Santiago de Guadalcázar, and a Jesuit reduction attempted on the Bermejo in 1635 failed.

Jesuits founded the San Ignacio mission for Toba and Mataco in 1756, while Franciscans opened Nuestra Señora de las Angustias de Zenta in 1779; it dwindled after San Ramón de la Nueva Orán was founded nearby in 1794.
zh:
韦奇人的名字意为“人”，外界长期称他们为马塔科人，这一称呼后来被视为蔑称。他们分布在中查科和南查科，主要在贝尔梅霍河与皮科马约河沿岸，温哈耶克一支则在玻利维亚。他们以渔猎和采集为生，到16世纪已基本定居于河畔村落；当时阿瓦瓜拉尼人入侵，迫使部分支群北迁和向东南移动。

西班牙人对他们最早的记载是1609年。1632年他们联合托巴人摧毁了圣地亚哥-德瓜达尔卡萨尔；1635年耶稣会在贝尔梅霍河尝试建立归化区，未能成功。

1756年耶稣会为托巴人和马塔科人创办圣伊格纳西奥传教站，方济各会于1779年开设森塔的痛苦圣母传教站，1794年附近建起圣拉蒙-德拉努埃瓦奥兰后，该站日趋衰落。

en:
The Wik are closely related Aboriginal peoples of the western Cape York Peninsula in northern Queensland, occupying coastal floodplains and forested inland country. They speak Paman languages within the Pama-Nyungan family, in which wik means speech; the Wik-Mungkan, whose language means roughly speech of eating, were the largest branch.

Traditionally they were organized into some thirty patrilineal clans, each holding its own country and one or more totems, called pulwaiya or old forebears. The totems' places of origin served as ritual sites where the dead were believed to return.

The clans lived by hunting, fishing and gathering on the seasonally flooded plains. Dutch ships charted the Gulf of Carpentaria shoreline in 1623 without founding any settlement, and for the two centuries that followed the Wik country remained beyond the effective reach of Europeans.
zh:
维克人是昆士兰北部约克角半岛西部关系密切的原住民支系，分布在沿海洪泛平原和内陆林地。他们使用帕马-牛雅语系下帕马语组的语言，“维克”意为“话语”；最大的支系是维克蒙坎人，其语言名称大意是“与吃有关的话”。

传统上他们分为约三十个父系氏族，各有自己的领地和一个或多个图腾，图腾被称为“普尔瓦亚”，意为“古老的祖先”。图腾发源处是举行仪式的圣地，人们相信死者灵魂也会归去那里。

各氏族在季节性泛滥的平原上狩猎、捕鱼和采集。1623年荷兰船只测绘了卡奔塔利亚湾的海岸线，但没有建立定居点；此后近两个世纪里，维克人的土地始终处于欧洲人势力的有效范围之外。

en:
The Willetpoose grouping covers the allied peoples of the Walla Walla valley, at the meeting of the Walla Walla, Snake and Columbia rivers. The Walla Walla's Sahaptin name Walúulapam means people of the Walula region and is often translated as many waters; their three bands fished salmon, dug roots and hunted.

Beside them lived the Cayuse, or Liksiyu, a seminomadic people speaking a language isolate. They bred the hardy Cayuse pony, travelled to the Great Plains to trade and raid, and made weaker bands at The Dalles fishery pay tribute in salmon.

Lewis and Clark met Walla Walla chief Yellepit in 1805 and 1806, leaving a peace medal. The North West Company built Fort Nez Perces at the Walla Walla River mouth in 1818, and in 1835 missionary Samuel Parker scouted Cayuse and Nez Perce villages for a mission.
zh:
维勒普斯涵盖沃拉沃拉河谷中关系紧密的诸族，其地位于沃拉沃拉河、蛇河与哥伦比亚河交汇处。沃拉沃拉人的萨哈普廷语名字瓦卢拉帕姆意为“瓦卢拉地区之民”，族名常被解释为“众水”；三个群体捕捞鲑鱼、挖掘块根和狩猎。

邻近的卡尤塞人自称利克西尤，是讲孤立语言的半游牧民族。他们培育耐劳的卡尤塞小马，远赴大平原贸易和劫掠，还迫使达尔斯渔场的弱小部落以鲑鱼纳贡。

1805年和1806年，刘易斯与克拉克两度会见沃拉沃拉酋长耶勒皮特，留下一枚和平勋章。1818年西北公司在沃拉沃拉河口修建内兹珀斯堡，1835年传教士塞缪尔·帕克到卡尤塞人和内兹珀斯人的村落考察，为建立传教站选址。

en:
The Williche, or Huilliche, are the southernmost mainland branch of the Mapuche, whose Mapudungun name means people of the south. Their country, Futahuillimapu, ran from below Valdivia to the mainland shores opposite Chiloé, while Cunco kin held the north of the island. They farmed potatoes, maize and beans, raised the camelid chilihueque and fished from three-plank dalca boats.

The Spaniards founded Valdivia, Osorno and Castro between 1552 and 1567, but the Curalaba disaster of 1598 drew the Williche into the Mapuche rising and every Spanish city in their territory except Castro was destroyed. The islanders rose with the Dutch corsair Baltazar de Cordes in 1600 and against the encomenderos in 1712; mainland Williche fought a battle on the Bueno River in 1759.

Tomás de Figueroa's expedition of 1792 broke their resistance, and the Parliament of Las Canoas of 1793 opened Futahuillimapu to Spanish haciendas and the refounding of Osorno.
zh:
维利切人是马普切人最靠南的大陆支系，名字在马普敦贡语中意为南方之人。他们的故土称富塔维利马普，从瓦尔迪维亚以南的诸河延伸到奇洛埃岛对岸的大陆海岸，同族昆科人则占据岛的北部。他们种植马铃薯、玉米和菜豆，饲养名为奇利韦克的骆驼科家畜，乘三块木板拼成的达尔卡船捕鱼。

1552—1567年，西班牙人建起瓦尔迪维亚、奥索尔诺和卡斯特罗；1598年库拉拉巴惨败后，维利切人加入马普切起义，境内除卡斯特罗外的西班牙城市全部被毁。岛民于1600年联合荷兰海盗巴尔塔萨·德·科尔德斯起事，1712年反抗委托监护主；大陆维利切人于1759年参加布埃诺河之战。

1792年托马斯·德·菲格罗阿远征击碎抵抗，1793年拉斯卡诺阿斯议会向西班牙大庄园开放富塔维利马普，奥索尔诺随之重建。

en:
The Wintuan, or Northern Wintun, were the northern branch of the Wintun peoples of the Sacramento Valley. Their country covered the western side of the upper valley from the river to the Coast Range, with the Winnemem band holding the McCloud River and calling themselves the Middle Water people; the volcanic Lassen Peak bore their name Amblu Kai, the Mountain Ripped Apart.

In eight or more small bands they lived in semi-permanent riverside villages, netting salmon and steelhead, gathering acorns and manzanita berries, weaving baskets and using earth lodges as sweat houses for ritual purification.

The first recorded outsiders were the trappers of Jedediah Smith in 1826 and Peter Skene Ogden in 1827. The malaria epidemic of 1830 to 1833 carried off an estimated three quarters of the native population of the upper and central Sacramento Valley.
zh:
温图人（又称北温顿人）是萨克拉门托谷地温顿诸族的北支。他们的地盘覆盖谷地北部西侧，从大河直到海岸山脉；温内梅姆群体据有麦克劳德河，自称“中水之人”，火山拉森峰在他们口中名为阿姆布鲁凯，意为“撕裂之山”。

他们分成八个或更多小群体，住在河畔半定居的村落里，捕捞鲑鱼和硬头鳟，采集橡子与熊果，编织篮器，并以土屋作汗房举行净化仪式。

有记录的最早外来者是1826年杰迪代亚·史密斯和1827年彼得·斯基恩·奥格登的猎人群。1830—1833年的疟疾估计夺去了萨克拉门托谷地北部和中部四分之三原住民的生命。

en: The Wipi, also called Gidra, are a Papuan people of the plains between the Fly River and the Torres Strait in Western Province, Papua New Guinea, around the Oriomo and Binaturi rivers, with Wipim the chief of their fourteen villages. Their language, also named Oriomo, belongs to the Eastern Trans-Fly family with Gizrra, Bine and Meriam Mir.
zh: 威皮人又称吉德拉人，是巴布亚新几内亚西部省弗莱河与托雷斯海峡之间平原上的巴布亚人，住在奥里莫河和比纳图里河一带，维皮姆是其十四个主要村落中最大的一个。他们的语言又名奥里莫语，与吉兹拉语、比内语和梅里亚姆米尔语同属东跨弗莱语系。

en:
The Wiradjuri are the largest Aboriginal people of New South Wales, organised in hunting and gathering clans west of the Blue Mountains, in the land of the three rivers: the Wambuul or Macquarie, the Kalare or Lachlan, and the Murrumbidgee. Their name is said to join wiray, their word for no, with a suffix meaning having.

In 1813 Blaxland, Lawson and Wentworth crossed the Blue Mountains; Bathurst was founded on Wiradjuri land. In 1822 settler George Suttor befriended the warrior Windradyne, called Saturday by the British.

Under Governor Thomas Brisbane land grants swallowed hunting grounds and brought famine, and in 1824 the Wiradjuri rose in the Bathurst War. Brisbane proclaimed martial law and the resistance was broken; Windradyne made peace at Parramatta that year. Corroborees continued around Mudgee as survivors settled on the edges of the pastoral economy.
zh:
威拉朱里人是新南威尔士最大的原住民族群，以狩猎采集的氏族为单位，分布在蓝山以西。他们称土地为“三河之地”，即旺布尔河（麦夸里河）、卡拉雷河（拉克伦河）与马兰比吉河。据说族名由意为“不”的“威雷”和表示“拥有”的后缀构成。

1813年，布莱克兰、劳森和温特沃思穿越蓝山，巴瑟斯特镇建在威拉朱里人的土地上。1822年移民乔治·萨托与勇士温拉丁（英国人叫他“星期六”）结为朋友。

总督托马斯·布里斯班治下，授地潮吞噬猎场、引发饥荒，威拉朱里人于1824年起事，展开巴瑟斯特战争。布里斯班宣布戒严，抵抗被镇压，温拉丁当年前往帕拉马塔议和。此后马奇仍有歌舞集会，幸存者在牧业经济边缘安顿。

en:
The Wirangu are an Aboriginal people of the far west coast of South Australia. Their traditional country ran along the coast between the Head of Bight and Streaky Bay and stretched inland as far north as Ooldea.

Their language belongs to the Thura-Yura branch of the Pama-Nyungan family, and early ethnographers noted that the Wirangu, Banggarla and Nawu were much the same people in speech and custom. Wirangu mythology tells of a great mother snake pursued across the land by the two Wati Kutjara men; where the wounded serpent rested, red, yellow and white ochre deposits formed, the red ochre being her blood.

Even before European settlement the southward-moving Kokatha had driven them from part of their country, and when the colony of South Australia was proclaimed in 1836 the Wirangu were already partly displaced.
zh:
威朗古人是南澳大利亚遥远西海岸的原住民。他们的传统领地沿大澳大利亚湾湾头与斯特里基湾之间的海岸分布，并向内陆北延至乌尔迪一带。

他们的语言属于帕马-牛雅语系的图拉-尤拉语支，早期民族志学者注意到，威朗古人、邦加拉人和纳乌人在语言和习俗上几乎如同一族。威朗古神话讲述一条母蛇大神被瓦蒂·库贾拉两兄弟追逐的故事：受伤的大蛇停歇之处形成了红、黄、白三色赭石矿，红赭石便是它流出的鲜血。

早在欧洲人定居之前，南迁的科科塔人已把他们逐出部分领地；1836年南澳大利亚殖民地宣告成立时，威朗古人已部分流离失所。

en:
The Wiyimpih-deka are the Wiyimpihtikka, the Buffalo Berry Eaters of the Western Shoshone, whose range centred on Big Smoky Valley in central Nevada, between the Toiyabe and Toquima ranges. Their country adjoined that of the Tsaiduka, the Tule Eaters of Railroad Valley. Numic-speaking foragers had spread through the Great Basin by the fourteenth century, and by 1500 Shoshone bands held most of Nevada.

The Wiyimpihtikka lived by the Desert Culture round: winter villages near water, summer family camps for rabbits, pronghorn and grass seeds, and autumn pinyon-nut harvests in the mountains. They used tightly woven baskets for winnowing and carrying but had no permanent fields or settled towns.
zh:
维因皮德卡人即维因皮赫蒂卡人，意为“食水牛果者”，属西部休休尼人，活动中心在内华达中部、托伊亚比岭与托奎马岭之间的大斯莫基谷。他们的领地与铁路谷的采杜卡人（食藨草者）相接。说努米克语的采集狩猎者到14世纪已遍及大盆地，到1500年休休尼诸部已占据内华达大部。

维因皮赫蒂卡人过着沙漠文化生活：临水而居的冬村，夏季猎兔和叉角羚、采集草籽的家庭营地，秋天进山采收松子。他们用编织紧密的篮子扬谷盛物，却没有固定的农田或城镇。

en:
The Wiyot, who call themselves Ku'wil, the people, are an Algic-speaking people of the Humboldt Bay coast of northwestern California, close kin in language and custom to the Yurok. Their homeland ran from the Mad River through Humboldt Bay to the lower Eel River, a country of redwood forest behind sandy dunes and tidal marsh.

Dialect and geography made three divisions: the Mad River, Humboldt Bay and Eel River Wiyot. Each year they held World Renewal ceremonies, centered on the island village of Tuluwat, to begin the new year.

Spanish missions never extended beyond San Francisco Bay, and although Russian sea-otter traders reached the coast in 1806 they did not stay, so the Wiyot remained among the most isolated peoples of California through the early nineteenth century.
zh:
维约特人自称库尔，意为“人”，是加利福尼亚西北部洪堡湾沿岸讲阿尔吉克语的族群，语言和习俗都与尤罗克人相近。他们的故土从马德河经洪堡湾延伸到伊尔河下游，内陆是红杉林，岸边则是沙丘和潮汐沼泽。

按方言和地理分为马德河、洪堡湾和伊尔河三支。他们每年在图卢瓦特岛村举行世界更新仪式，以此开启新的一年。

西班牙传教站始终没有越过旧金山湾，俄国海獭商人虽于1806年抵达海岸却未能立足，因此到19世纪初，维约特人仍是加利福尼亚最与世隔绝的族群之一。

en: The Wogamusin are an Upper Sepik people of western East Sepik Province, living in a handful of villages on the Wogamush and upper Sepik rivers east of the Iwam. Together with Chenapian, their language forms the small Wogamus branch within the Sepik family.
zh: 沃加穆辛人是东塞皮克省西部的上塞皮克族群，住在伊瓦姆人以东、沃加穆什河与塞皮克河上游沿岸的数个村落里。他们的语言与切纳皮安语共同构成塞皮克语族下小小的沃加穆斯分支。

en:
The Wolastoqiyik, people of the shining river, are the Algonquian people of the Saint John River and its tributaries in New Brunswick, Maine and Quebec; Europeans called them Maliseet, a Mi'kmaq exonym. Their kin the Passamaquoddy held Passamaquoddy Bay and the St. Croix River; the two nations shared a language and belonged to the Wabanaki Confederacy.

They lived in palisaded villages, moving between summer fishing grounds and winter hunting camps; their chief village was later at Meductic. French traders built a fur-trade alliance and Jesuit missions drew converts, while wars with the Haudenosaunee and Innu ran through the seventeenth century.

In colonial wars the Wolastoqiyik and Passamaquoddy fought beside the French against New England, then signed the same Peace and Friendship Treaties as the Mi'kmaq between 1725 and 1779. In 1776 a Passamaquoddy delegation also made a treaty with the new United States.
zh:
沃拉斯托基维克人意为“闪光之河的人民”，是新不伦瑞克、缅因和魁北克圣约翰河及其支流一带的阿尔冈昆语族群；欧洲人用米克马克语他称“马利西特”称呼他们。近亲帕萨马阔迪人占据帕萨马阔迪湾和圣克鲁瓦河沿岸，两族共用语言，同属瓦巴纳基联盟。

他们住在栅栏村落里，往返夏季渔场与冬季猎营，后来主村设在梅达克蒂克。法国商人同他们建立毛皮贸易同盟，耶稣会传教站吸收信徒；17世纪他们与易洛魁联盟、因努人交战不断。

殖民战争时期，两族与法国并肩对新英格兰作战，随后在1725—1779年间同米克马克人一样签订一系列《和平友好条约》。1776年，帕萨马阔迪代表团还与新生的美国缔结条约。

en:
The Wolof are the largest people of Senegambia, settled across western Senegal and the lower Gambia valley, speaking a West Atlantic language and growing millet under hereditary chiefs. One tradition holds that their ancestors arrived as the Ghana Empire collapsed in the late 1000s, and by the 1200s had pushed the Serer southward.

Their states, including Jolof, Cayor, Baol and Waalo, were Mali vassals and won independence around 1360 amid a Mali succession dispute. United under the burba of Jolof, the empire dominated trade between the Senegal and Gambia rivers. In the 1450s the Venetian traveller Cadamosto found Muslim clerics counselling rulers who had not themselves adopted Islam.

The empire broke up after the battle of Danki in 1549, leaving Jolof a reduced kingdom ringed by independent states. Rivalries among these states were sharpened by slave raiding and, in the 1700s, reformist jihads.
zh:
沃洛夫人是塞内冈比亚最大的民族，定居在塞内加尔西部和冈比亚河下游谷地，说西非大西洋语支的语言，在世袭酋长治下种植粟米。一种说法认为，他们的祖先在11世纪末加纳帝国崩溃时迁入，到13世纪已把塞雷尔人赶往南方。

诸邦包括乔洛夫、卡约尔、巴奥勒和瓦洛，原为马里附庸，约1360年趁马里王位继承之争独立。在乔洛夫的布尔巴统合下，帝国掌控塞内加尔河与冈比亚河之间的贸易。15世纪50年代，威尼斯旅行家卡达莫斯托看到，统治者身边已有穆斯林学者担任顾问，但本人尚未皈依。

1549年丹基战役后帝国解体，乔洛夫沦为小王国，周围环绕独立诸邦。奴隶劫掠和18世纪的改革派圣战加剧了邦国间的纷争。

en:
The Worimi are an Aboriginal Australian people of the New South Wales coast, their country running from the Hunter River estuary north to Forster and inland to the Williams River, with Port Stephens at its heart. They spoke Gathang, whose dialects were shared with the neighbouring Biripi, Gringai and Awabakal.

In 1790 four escaped convicts who landed at Port Stephens were welcomed as ancestors returned from the sea, given wives and lived with the Worimi for five years. Governor Macquarie exchanged food with them in 1811, but from about 1815 violent red-cedar gangs poisoned relations, and John Oxley met armed resistance on his journey through the Myall Lakes in 1818.

In 1826 the Australian Agricultural Company planted a settlement at Port Stephens under Robert Dawson. It opened farms at Stroud and Gloucester, drawing the Worimi into the colonial economy.
zh:
沃里米人是澳大利亚新南威尔士州海岸的原住民，领地以斯提芬港为中心，南起亨特河口，北至福斯特，西抵威廉斯河。他们使用加桑语，其方言与邻近的比里皮、格林盖、阿瓦巴卡尔等群体共用。

1790年，四名逃犯在斯提芬港登岸，被当作从海上归来的祖先接纳，还娶妻成家，与沃里米人共同生活了五年。1811年麦觉理总督到访并与他们交换食物，但约1815年起，凶暴的红椿木伐木帮恶化了双方关系，约翰·奥克斯利1818年穿越迈奥尔湖时遭遇了武装抵抗。

1826年，澳大利亚农业公司在罗伯特·道森主持下于斯提芬港建立定居点。公司在斯特劳德和格洛斯特开辟农场，把沃里米人卷入了殖民经济。

en:
The Wurla, also written Worla, are an Aboriginal people of the Kimberley in Western Australia, whose grounds covered the northern side of the Wunaamin Miliwundi Range, east of the Isdell Range, reaching the headwaters of the Hann and upper Fitzroy rivers. They were organised into clans, among them the Wardia around Ellenbrae.

Their south-eastern push down the Chapman and Durack rivers to Karunjie cut the traditional country between the Ngarinjin and the Gija. The Ngarinjin called them Waringari, while the Miriwung name Oladjau covered several groups speaking varieties of Ngarinyin, and linguists have counted their speech among the Ngarinyin dialects.
zh:
沃拉人又拼作乌尔拉，是西澳大利亚金伯利地区的原住民，传统领地位于乌纳明·米利温迪岭北坡、艾斯德尔岭以东，延至汉恩河与菲茨罗伊河上游的源头地带。他们分为多个氏族，其中包括住在埃伦布雷一带的瓦迪亚氏族。

他们向东南沿查普曼河和杜拉克河推进到卡伦吉，切断了纳林金人与基亚人传统领地之间的联系。纳林金人称他们为瓦林加里，米里温人则用奥拉焦一名统称讲多种纳林金语变体的族群；语言学家也把他们的话算作纳林金语的方言之一。

en:
Wú culture is the core of the Wu-speaking world, covering the Lake Tai cities of Suzhou, Songjiang and Jiaxing in canal-laced Jiangnan. Its name recalls the Spring and Autumn State of Wu, its capital Gusu near modern Suzhou; under King Helü, it became one of five hegemon states before Yue conquered it in 473 BC.

Han settlement deepened after fourth-century upheavals, as northern refugees crossed the Yangtze and old Jiangdong speech took shape; a second wave followed the Song court's 1127 move to Lin'an, adding a northern literary layer.

In the Yuan and Ming, Suzhou became a center of commerce, silk, printing and pingtan, while Songjiang cotton cloth clothed much of China. The Suzhou variety long served as the prestige dialect of all Wu, celebrated for its soft, lilting sound and the saying of tender Wu speech. In 1337 the region was already among the Yuan empire's richest, most densely populated regions, its market towns flourishing through the Ming and Qing.
zh:
吴文化是吴语世界的核心，覆盖苏州、松江、嘉兴等太湖沿岸城市，即河网密布的江南腹地。其名来自春秋吴国：都城姑苏在今苏州一带，吴王阖闾一度称霸诸侯，跻身春秋五霸，公元前473年被越国攻灭。

4世纪北方大乱，流民渡江南下，古老的江东方言逐渐成形；1127年宋廷迁居临安，又带来第二波北方移民，给当地语言加上北方文读层。

元明时期苏州成为商业、丝织、刻书和评弹中心，松江棉布行销全国。苏州话长期充当吴语权威方言，以软糯婉转著称，素有吴侬软语之说。1337年这里已是元朝最富庶、人口最稠密的地区之一，市镇商贸网络在明清继续繁荣。

en:
The Wúchuān are the Yue people of the lower Jian River, where it enters the South China Sea on the eastern flank of the Leizhou Peninsula in south-western Guangdong. Their dialect, nicknamed Wuchuan bone, forms with Huazhou speech the Wu-Hua branch of Yue, the product of the long Hanization of local Baiyue peoples under the Gaozhou and Luozhou administrations from the Northern and Southern dynasties onward.

The Sui created the county in 598 in place of Pingding, naming it after the Wuchuan river, later called the Jian. The Ming placed it under Gaozhou prefecture in 1377, an arrangement the Qing retained.

Wuchuan kept piaose tableaux, clay sculpture and deity-centred nianli festivals; Lin Zhaotang, born in 1786, became one of the few Guangdong scholars to take the zhuangyuan, the top rank in the imperial examination.
zh:
吴川人是鉴江下游、濒临南海的粤语人群，地处广东西南、雷州半岛东翼。他们的方言俗称吴川骨，与化州话合称粤语吴化片，是南北朝以来高州、罗州历代官署推动当地百越土著逐渐汉化的产物。

598年隋朝废平定县置吴川县，以吴川水，即后来的鉴江，得名。明朝于1377年将其划归高州府，清代沿袭不变。

吴川有飘色、泥塑和以地方神祇为中心的年例节庆；1786年出生的林召棠后来高中状元，是广东为数不多的科举鼎甲人物。

en:
The Wulgurukaban, whose name means canoe people after the wulgurru bark canoe, are a seafaring Aboriginal grouping of the coast and islands around Townsville in north-eastern Queensland, holding roughly a thousand square miles of mainland shore, Magnetic Island, the Palm Islands and adjoining waters. Local estate groups spoke dialects of the Wulguru language, an eastern Pama-Nyungan tongue without noun classes.

In eight-foot bark canoes they netted fish, took turtles and dugong with turtle-shell hooks, gathered trepang and travelled between islands across open water, leaving shell middens and stone fish traps along the coast. In 1770 James Cook, sailing the Endeavour through these waters, saw them paddling such canoes between the mainland and Magnetic Island at low tide.
zh:
伍尔古鲁卡巴人是昆士兰东北部汤斯维尔一带沿海与岛屿的航海原住民群体，领有约一千平方英里的大陆海岸、马格内蒂克岛、棕榈群岛及相邻海域。他们的名字意为“独木舟人”，得名于当地的“伍尔古鲁”树皮独木舟。各地方群体讲伍尔古鲁语的方言，这种帕马-牛雅语东部语言没有名词性范畴。

他们乘坐八尺长的树皮独木舟撒网捕鱼，用玳瑁壳做的鱼钩捕捉海龟和儒艮，采集海参，并在开阔水面上往返各岛，沿岸留下贝丘和石砌鱼栅。1770年，詹姆斯·库克驾“努力号”经过这片水域时，看见他们在退潮时划着这种独木舟往来于大陆与马格内蒂克岛之间。

en: The Wumbu, also called Wumvu or Bawoumbou, are a Bantu people of southeastern Gabon, settled in the Haut-Ogooué region around Franceville and in Ngounié province to the south. Their language, Wumbvu, belongs to the Tsogo group of Bantu languages, which is why the game lists them as Tsogo speakers.
zh: 文布人又称 Wumvu 或 Bawoumbou，是加蓬东南部的一支班图人，定居在弗朗斯维尔一带的上奥果韦省和南方的恩古涅省。他们的语言温布武语属于班图语的措戈语组，这也是游戏把他们标为措戈语使用者的原因。

en:
The Wunambal, also known as Wunambal Gaambera, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the northern Kimberley in Western Australia, whose country — their Uunguu — surrounds York Sound and runs north from Brunswick Bay to the Admiralty Gulf and the Osborne Islands, covering roughly 9,800 square kilometres. Norman Tindale judged them perhaps the most venturesome of Australian Aboriginal peoples: partly from Makassan visitors they learnt to build rafts able to ride tides of up to twelve metres, and the Laiau and Wardana bands sailed out to reefs and islets in the Cassini and Montalivet archipelagoes. With the Worrorra and Ngarinyin they form the Wanjina Wunggurr cultural bloc, whose law and dreamtime mythology centre on the Wanjina and Wunggurr spirits.

In September 1820 Phillip Parker King, on his third Australian voyage, beached HMS Mermaid for repairs at Careening Bay on Coronation Island and stayed eighteen days. His crew met no Wunambal, but King noted bark shelters on the beach, more substantial buildings on the hill above and the remnants of sago palm nuts eaten along the coast, and he had the carpenter carve Mermaid 1820 into an ancient boab tree.
zh:
武南布尔人（又称武南布尔·甘贝雷）是西澳大利亚州北部金伯利的澳大利亚原住民，他们的领地——自称温古——环绕约克湾，从布伦瑞克湾向北延伸到阿德默勒尔蒂湾和奥斯本群岛，面积约9800平方公里。诺曼·廷代尔认为他们或许是最富冒险精神的澳大利亚原住民：他们部分地从望加锡来客那里学会了建造能扛住12米大潮的木筏，拉尧和瓦尔达纳两个群体常远航到卡西尼群岛、蒙塔尔维特群岛一带的礁岩和小岛。他们与沃罗拉人、恩加里宁人共同组成旺吉纳·温古尔文化圈，其律法和梦时代神话以旺吉纳与温古尔两类神灵为核心。

1820年9月，菲利普·帕克·金在第三次澳大利亚考察途中，把‘美人鱼号’拖到加冕岛的卡雷宁湾修理，停留了18天。船员没有遇到武南布尔人，但金在日记里记下了海滩上的树皮棚屋、山丘上更结实的房舍，以及沿海居民食用西谷椰子后留下的果核残迹；他还让船匠在一棵古老的猴面包树上刻下‘美人鱼号1820’的字样。

en: The Wunumaran are the Wanamara, an Aboriginal Australian people of north-western Queensland whose lands covered the Flinders River country, taking in Richmond and Kynuna; the Quippen-bura near Richmond may have been their northern horde. They spoke Wanamarra, also called Maykulan, one of the Mayi languages of the Pama-Nyungan family, closely linked to neighbouring Ngawun speech.
