After the conquest of 1521 the Otomi helped colonize the Bajío, while the Guamar and their neighbours fought the Spanish in the Chichimeca War of 1550—1590. Many Chorotega were enslaved.
zh:
奥托帕梅族群包括欧托-曼格语系的诸民族，主体是墨西哥中部高原的奥托-帕梅人：奥托米人、托卢卡谷地的马特拉钦卡人、帕梅人，以及巴希奥一带瓜马尔等奇奇梅克诸部。更远处的欧托-曼格语民族还有约800年南迁到尼加拉瓜的乔罗特加人、恰帕斯人和特拉帕内克人。

奥托米人在墨西哥谷地丧失土地，墨西加人1475年在阿萨亚卡特尔率领下攻取了马特拉钦卡人的山谷。1521年西班牙征服之后，奥托米人参与殖民巴希奥；瓜马尔人及其邻族则在1550—1590年的奇奇梅克战争中与西班牙人作战。许多乔罗特加人被掳为奴。

en:
The Paiute group here is the Mono, or Monachi, who lived in the central Sierra Nevada, on its eastern slope and around the Mono Basin. They are often labelled Northern Paiute, but they are a separate Numic people. Their name comes from a Yokuts word for ‘fly people’, because Mono Lake gave them fly larvae to eat and trade.

The Eastern Mono of the Owens Valley dug irrigation ditches along the Owens River and could store food, while the Western Mono kept to the mountains west of the crest.
zh:
这里的派尤特族群指莫诺人，即莫纳奇人，他们居住在内华达山脉中部、东麓和莫诺盆地一带。他们常被称为北派尤特人，其实是另一支努米克人。“莫诺”之名来自约库特人的称呼，意为“蝇人”，因为莫诺湖出产的蝇类幼虫既是他们的食物，也是交换的货物。

欧文斯谷的东莫诺人沿欧文斯河开渠灌溉，能够储存粮食；西莫诺人则留在山脊以西的山地。

en:
The Pama-Nyungan group includes the Noongari of the southwest, the Wiradjurin of central New South Wales and the Gumbaynggirr of the east coast. The family takes its name from pama, the northeastern word for man, and nyungar, the southwestern one.

Some 300 Pama-Nyungan languages were spoken when Europeans arrived. The Dutch navigator Willem Janszoon landed on Cape York in 1606, James Cook charted the east coast in 1770, and the First Fleet reached Botany Bay in 1788.
zh:
帕马-牛雅文化组包括西南的农阿人、新南威尔士中部的威拉朱里人和东海岸的冈比恩格尔人。语系的名字取自东北部的“帕马”和西南部的“牛雅”，两者都是“人”的意思。

欧洲人到来时，帕马-牛雅诸语有约300种。荷兰航海家威廉·扬松于1606年在约克角登陆，詹姆斯·库克于1770年测绘了东海岸，第一舰队于1788年抵达植物学湾。

official_raw.en: The Pama-Nyungan peoples inhabit the vast majority of the Australian continent, speaking languages of the Pama-Nyungan family which covers roughly eighty percent of Australia's land area. Despite the enormous diversity within this family, these peoples share broad cultural patterns including complex kinship systems, the Dreaming cosmology, and hunter-gatherer subsistence.
official_raw.zh: 帕马‑牛雅族群居住于澳大利亚大陆的绝大部分地区，使用帕马‑牛雅语系的语言，该语系覆盖了澳大利亚大约百分之八十的土地面积。尽管该语系内部存在巨大差异，这些民族共享广泛的文化模式，包括复杂的亲属制度、梦创神话宇宙观以及狩猎采集生计方式。

en:
The Panche, also called the Tolima, were a warlike people of the western slopes of the Eastern Andes, between the Muisca plateau and the Magdalena River in present-day Colombia. At the conquest they numbered about 30,000, in a loose confederation of independent chiefdoms.

They raided the Muisca to the east with clubs and poisoned arrows. In 1538 they were routed at Tocarema by the Spaniards of Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada, who fought alongside Muisca rivals under Sagipa. Resistance went on until Hernán Venegas Carrillo subdued the chiefdoms, and disease and colonial settlement then greatly reduced the survivors.
zh:
潘切人又称托利马人，是今天哥伦比亚境内东安第斯山西坡的好战民族，居于穆伊斯卡高原与马格达莱纳河之间。西班牙征服时他们约有3万人，由彼此独立的酋长国松散联合而成。

他们用棍棒和毒箭袭击东边的穆伊斯卡人。1538年，他们在托卡雷马被贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德·克萨达的西班牙人击溃，穆伊斯卡的萨吉帕率军与西班牙人并肩作战。抵抗又持续了一段时间，直到埃尔南·贝内加斯·卡里略平定各酋长国，疾病和殖民定居随后使幸存者大为减少。

en:
The Pano group includes peoples of the southwestern Amazon in eastern Peru, northern Bolivia and western Brazil: the Uni, known as Cashibo or Kakataibo, the Pacahuara and the Kaxarari, who speak Panoan languages, together with the Tacanan-speaking Ese Ejja and Tacana. The two language families may be related.

The Tacana met Inca expansion on the Beni River, and Franciscans entered their country around 1680 and founded missions after 1731. The Uni joined the rebellion of Juan Santos Atahualpa in 1744 and helped destroy the missions; in 1757 they killed a friar and drove off the rest.
zh:
帕诺族群包括亚马孙西南部的诸族，分布在秘鲁东部、玻利维亚北部和巴西西部：说帕诺语族语言的乌尼人（即卡希博人或卡卡塔伊博人）、帕卡瓦拉人和卡沙拉里人，以及说塔卡纳语族语言的埃塞哈人和塔卡纳人。这两个语族可能有亲缘关系。

塔卡纳人在贝尼河一带遇到了印加人的扩张；约1680年方济各会修士进入其地，1731年之后建立传教村。乌尼人1744年加入胡安·桑托斯·阿塔瓦尔帕的起义，参与捣毁传教站；1757年他们杀死一名修士，赶走了其余的人。

en:
The Panzaleo group covers the highland peoples of Ecuador around Quito and Latacunga, among them the Quitu, Guayacundo, Chimbus and Hambatus. Their pre-Inca language, Panzaleo, gave way to Kichwa in the seventeenth century.

The Quitu, who founded Quito, held the valleys beneath the Pichincha volcanoes, which they held sacred. Around 1470 Topa Inca Yupanqui conquered them, and they rose against Huayna Capac with the Cayambis and Caranquis. The Spaniards took Quito in 1534.
zh:
潘萨莱奥族群涵盖厄瓜多尔高地基多和拉塔昆加一带的诸族，包括基图人、瓜亚昆多人、钦巴斯人和汉巴图斯人。他们的前印加语言潘萨莱奥语，到17世纪让位于基奇瓦语。

基图人建立了基多城，居住在皮钦查火山脚下的山谷中，视这些山为圣山。约1470年，托帕·印加·尤潘基征服了他们；他们后来与卡扬比人、卡兰基人一起起兵反抗瓦伊纳·卡帕克。1534年，西班牙人攻占基多。

en:
The Papuan peoples include those of the Bismarck Archipelago as well as New Guinea. Their roughly 800 languages fall into perhaps sixty small families with unclear relationships, and Papuan is only a geographical label for languages that are not Austronesian. Their ancestors developed one of the earliest agricultures, leaving ancient irrigation systems in the highlands.

Europeans first sighted the island in the 1520s, when Jorge de Menezes named it ilhas dos Papuas, and Íñigo Ortiz de Retes named it New Guinea in 1545. In the west the Sultans of Tidore claimed the coast, while the highland interior remained unknown to Europeans.
zh:
巴布亚族群包括新几内亚和俾斯麦群岛的原住民。他们的约800种语言分属大约六十个关系不明的小语系，“巴布亚语”只是对非南岛语系语言的地理归类。他们的祖先发展出最早的农业之一，高地上留有古代灌溉系统。

欧洲人在16世纪20年代首次望见该岛，豪尔赫·德·梅内塞斯称之为“巴布亚诸岛”；1545年，伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德雷特斯把它命名为新几内亚。在西部，蒂多雷苏丹宣称拥有海岸地区，而内陆高地一直不为欧洲人所知。

official_raw.en: The Papuan peoples are the indigenous inhabitants of New Guinea and neighboring islands, speaking hundreds of languages from diverse and largely unrelated language families collectively known as Papuan. Their remarkable linguistic and cultural diversity reflects thousands of years of isolated development across the island's rugged terrain.
official_raw.zh: 巴布亚民族由新几内亚及周边岛屿的众多原住民族群构成，使用数百种语言，这些语言分属多个不同且基本互不关联的语系，统称为“巴布亚诸语言”。其语言与文化的显著多样性，反映了数千年来在岛屿崎岖地势中相对隔绝的发展历程。

en:
The Penutian group rests on a hypothesis, first proposed in the early twentieth century, that linked the languages of the Miwok, Ohlone, Yokuts and Maidu of California, the Chinook of the lower Columbia and the Nimiipuu, or Nez Perce, of the interior. The wider unity is unproven.

They lived by fishing, gathering and hunting, from acorns in California to Columbia salmon. The Chinook traded between coast and interior, and Chinook Jargon grew from their speech. The Nimiipuu bred Appaloosa horses and met Lewis and Clark in 1805. Spanish missions from 1769 uprooted the Californian peoples, and mission rule ended in 1834.
zh:
佩努蒂族群基于20世纪初提出的一种假说，这一假说把加利福尼亚的米沃克人、奥洛内人、约库特人和迈杜人，哥伦比亚河下游的奇努克人，以及内陆的尼米普人（即内兹佩尔塞人）的语言联系在一起。这种更大范围的统一性尚未得到证实。

他们靠渔猎和采集为生，从加利福尼亚的橡子到哥伦比亚河的鲑鱼。奇努克人在沿海与内陆之间做贸易，奇努克行话就源自他们的语言。尼米普人培育阿帕卢萨马，1805年遇到了刘易斯和克拉克。1769年起西班牙传教站使加利福尼亚诸族流离失所，传教站统治于1834年结束。

en:
The Permic group includes the Komi, who lived in the Vychegda, Pechora and Kama basins, the Udmurts of the Kama and Vyatka country, and the small Besermyan people, probably Tatars absorbed by the Udmurts. From the twelfth century traders from Novgorod came north for furs, and Komi dukes united Great Perm around the stronghold of Cherdyn.

In 1372 the missionary Stephen of Perm devised a Komi alphabet. The duke of Perm was baptised in 1470, Moscow seized Cherdyn in 1472, and in 1505 a Russian governor replaced the last duke; Russian settlers began moving in.
zh:
彼尔姆文化组包括居住在维切格达河、伯朝拉河和卡马河流域的科米人，卡马河与维亚特卡河一带的乌德穆尔特人，以及人数很少的贝谢尔曼人，后者大概是被乌德穆尔特人同化的鞑靼人。12世纪起，诺夫哥罗德的商人北上收购毛皮，科米的公爵们以切尔登要塞为中心统一了大彼尔姆。

1372年，传教士彼尔姆的斯蒂芬创制了科米字母。彼尔姆公爵于1470年受洗，莫斯科于1472年夺取切尔登，1505年俄罗斯总督取代了末代公爵，俄罗斯移民开始迁入。

official_raw.en: The Permic peoples of the Ural Mountains region speak languages of the Permic branch of the Uralic family, closely related to Finnish and Estonian. The Komi and Udmurt peoples have long inhabited the forests between the Volga and the Urals, trading furs with their Slavic and Tatar neighbors.
official_raw.zh: 乌拉尔山脉地区的彼尔姆民族使用乌拉尔语系彼尔姆语支的语言，与芬兰语和爱沙尼亚语关系密切。科米人与乌德穆尔特人长期居住在伏尔加河与乌拉尔山之间的森林地带，与他们的斯拉夫与鞑靼邻居进行毛皮贸易。

en:
The Pijao were a federation of allied chiefdoms in the central Colombian Andes, spread along the Central Cordillera and the upper valleys of the Magdalena and Cauca rivers. They never formed a centralised state. Their priests, called mohanes, led animist rites centred on rivers and mountains.

The Pijao fought the Spaniards over control of the Magdalena, Cauca and Saldaña rivers in wars that lasted some eighty years. Between 1605 and 1615 Juan de Borja y Armendia led pacification campaigns, founding Natagaima in 1606 to settle the survivors. War, conversion to Catholicism and mixing with settlers broke the federation.
zh:
皮豪人是哥伦比亚安第斯山中部由结盟酋长国组成的联合体，分布在中科迪勒拉山脉以及马格达莱纳河和考卡河的上游谷地。他们从未形成集权国家。他们的祭司称为莫哈内斯，主持以河流和山岳为中心的万物有灵仪式。

为争夺马格达莱纳河、考卡河和萨尔达尼亚河的控制权，皮豪人与西班牙人作战，战争持续了大约八十年。1605年至1615年间，胡安·德·博尔哈·阿门迪亚率军平定，并在1606年建立纳塔盖马安置幸存者。战争、改信天主教和与移民混居瓦解了这个联合体。

en:
The Polish group includes the Poles of Lesser Poland, Greater Poland, Mazovia and Silesia, and the Kashubians of the Baltic coast. Poland had been reunited as a kingdom in 1320, and in 1337 Casimir III the Great was on the throne. He expanded into Galicia and founded a university at Kraków in 1364.

His death in 1370 ended the Piast dynasty. Jogaila of Lithuania married Queen Jadwiga in 1386 and founded the Jagiellonian dynasty, and in 1410 the joint army defeated the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald. The Union of Lublin created the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth in 1569. Partitions among Russia, Prussia and Austria in 1772, 1793 and 1795 ended it.
zh:
波兰文化组包括小波兰、大波兰、马佐夫舍和西里西亚的波兰人，以及波罗的海沿岸的卡舒比人。波兰于1320年重新统一为王国，1337年在位的是卡齐米日三世大王。他向东扩张到加利西亚，并于1364年在克拉科夫创办大学。

1370年他去世，皮雅斯特王朝绝嗣。立陶宛的约盖拉于1386年与雅德维加女王结婚，创立了雅盖隆王朝；1410年联军在格伦瓦尔德击败了条顿骑士团。1569年的《卢布林联合》建立了波兰—立陶宛共和国。俄国、普鲁士和奥地利在1772年、1793年和1795年的三次瓜分终结了这个国家。

official_raw.en: Divided among several countries after the fall of the last Polish State, the Polish people share a common western Slavic heritage and a strong Catholic Faith.
official_raw.zh: 在最后一个波兰国家灭亡后，波兰人被分离在不同国家下，他们拥有共同的西斯拉夫传承和强烈的天主教信仰。

en:
The Polynesian group spans the Polynesian Triangle: the Native Hawaiians, Māori of Aotearoa, Samoans, Tahitians, Tongans and the people of Rapa Nui, or Easter Island. Their ancestors were Austronesian seafarers of Island Southeast Asia who read stars, currents, clouds and birds to cross the ocean.

Their canoes settled islands as far apart as Hawaii, Rapa Nui and New Zealand, and in the eighteenth century New Zealand held the largest Polynesian population, about 110,000. Tonga's chiefs extended their influence across nearby islands. The islands first met Europeans late: James Cook reached New Zealand in 1769 and Hawaii in 1778, and Kamehameha I united the Hawaiian islands by 1810.
zh:
波利尼西亚文化组遍布波利尼西亚三角区：夏威夷原住民、新西兰的毛利人、萨摩亚人、塔希提人、汤加人，以及拉帕努伊（复活节岛）的居民。他们的祖先是来自东南亚岛屿的南岛海洋民族，靠观察星辰、洋流、云和飞鸟渡过大洋。

他们的独木舟把相隔遥远的夏威夷、拉帕努伊和新西兰都变成了定居地，18世纪新西兰的波利尼西亚人口最多，约有11万。汤加的首领们把影响扩展到邻近岛屿。这些岛屿与欧洲人相遇较晚：詹姆斯·库克于1769年到达新西兰，1778年到达夏威夷，卡美哈梅哈一世在1810年前统一了夏威夷群岛。

official_raw.en: The people of Polynesia have always been seafarers, expanding all the many islands in the Pacific over the centuries. Despite being isolated from each other, the many groups living there still can trace their common cultural heritage and linguistic similarities.
official_raw.zh: 海洋民族波利尼西亚人几个世纪以来一直在太平洋的众多岛屿上扩张。尽管彼此隔绝，但生活在岛上的众多族群仍可以追溯到共同的文化传承和语言共通之处。

en:
The Powhatan group includes the Eastern Algonquian peoples of the Chesapeake tidewater, among them the Powhatan, Rappahannock, Nansemond and Accawmacke. Their language, Virginia Algonquian, was never written down and is known mainly from word lists made by John Smith and William Strachey.

The paramount chief Wahunsenacawh, called Powhatan by the English, built a confederacy of more than thirty tribes, and he ruled from Werowocomoco when Jamestown was founded in 1607. After his death in 1618 his brother Opechancanough led risings in 1622 and 1644. The treaty of 1646 dissolved the confederacy, and in 1677 the survivors became tributaries on small reservations.
zh:
波瓦坦族群包括切萨皮克湾沿岸低地的东阿尔冈昆人，包括波瓦坦人、拉帕汉诺克人、南塞蒙德人和阿卡瓦马基人。他们的语言称弗吉尼亚阿尔冈昆语，从未形成文字，主要靠约翰·史密斯和威廉·斯特雷奇留下的词表为人所知。

最高首领瓦胡森纳卡瓦（英国人称他波瓦坦）建立了包括三十多个部落的联盟，1607年詹姆斯敦建立时，他坐镇韦罗科莫科。1618年他去世后，其弟奥佩昌卡诺于1622年和1644年发动起义。1646年的条约解散了这个联盟，1677年幸存者成为小块保留地上的纳贡者。

en:
The Pueblo group includes the Tanoan, Keres, Zuni and Hopi, along with the Hohokam and Hualapai of the Arizona deserts. The Ancestral Puebloans of the Four Corners region lived in pit houses, great pueblos and cliff dwellings and built kivas, round chambers used for ceremonies.

The Spanish gave the Pueblo peoples the name pueblo, meaning village, when they met multistorey towns of adobe and stone in New Mexico, where Spanish colonization began in 1598. Pueblo nations kept their agriculture, clans and religion, combining them with Christianity. In 1680 they rose in the Pueblo Revolt and drove the Spanish out of New Mexico, which Spain reconquered in 1692.
zh:
普韦布洛文化组包括塔诺人、凯雷斯人、祖尼人和霍皮人，以及亚利桑那沙漠中的霍霍坎人和瓦拉佩人。四角地区的先民普韦布洛人住过竖穴屋、大型村落和崖居，并修建用于仪式的圆形房间基瓦。

西班牙人在新墨西哥遇见了用土坯和石头建成的多层城镇，便称普韦布洛人为“普韦布洛”，意为村庄；西班牙在新墨西哥的殖民始于1598年。普韦布洛各族保持着农耕、氏族和自己的宗教，又将它们与基督教结合起来。1680年他们发动普韦布洛起义，把西班牙人赶出新墨西哥，西班牙于1692年重新征服了那里。

official_raw.en: Hailing from the fractured Ancestral Puebloans, the Pueblo people have since diverged into differing tribes across $shiewhibak_area$. Through the harsh lands of $shiewhibak_area$, the Pueblo people have grown resilient, and constructed sophisticated Adobe structures and irrigation systems.
official_raw.zh: 普韦布洛人源自分化前的古普韦布洛族群，后在$shiewhibak_area$地区逐渐演化为多个独立部落。面对这片严酷的土地，他们锤炼出非凡的韧性，不仅创造出精妙的土坯建筑技艺，更发展出$shiewhibak_area$完善的灌溉系统。

en:
The Pukina group includes the Chiribaya of the Peruvian coast, and the Charka and Yampara of the valleys of Chuquisaca in Bolivia. Puquina, often linked to the builders of Tiwanaku, survives mainly in a ritual book printed in 1607 by the Franciscan Luis Jerónimo de Oré.

The Chiribaya, fishermen and maize farmers of the Osmore valley, flourished until about 1360. Inca armies of Túpac Yupanqui conquered the Charka in the late fifteenth century. In 1538 Consara, the principal lord of the Charcas, told Hernando Pizarro's Spaniards of the region's mines, and La Plata was founded on Charka land the same year.
zh:
普基纳族群包括秘鲁沿海的奇里巴亚人，以及玻利维亚丘基萨卡河谷的查克拉人和扬帕拉人。普基纳语常被认为与蒂瓦纳库的建造者有关，主要靠方济各会修士路易斯·赫罗尼莫·德·奥雷1607年印行的一本礼仪手册保存下来。

奇里巴亚人是奥斯莫尔河谷的渔民和玉米农，兴盛到约1360年。15世纪后期，图帕克·尤潘基的印加军队征服了查克拉人。1538年，查尔卡斯地区的首领孔萨拉向埃尔南多·皮萨罗的西班牙人介绍了当地的矿藏；同年，拉普拉塔城在查克拉人的土地上建立。

en:
The Pume, called Yaruro by the Spanish, are a people of the Venezuelan llanos west of the Orinoco. They call themselves Pume, meaning real human, and speak a language isolate that Filippo Gilii found to be unrelated to other known tongues in 1782.

The River Pume keep manioc gardens in fixed villages, while the Savanna Pume hunt and gather, moving between seasonal camps. Missions and ranches stayed thin on their grasslands, so most bands kept their language and mobile way of life through the colonial centuries.
zh:
普梅人被西班牙人称为亚鲁罗人，居住在委内瑞拉奥里诺科河以西的平原上。他们自称普梅，意为“真正的人”，所说的语言是一种孤立语言，1782年菲利波·吉利发现它与已知的其他语言都没有亲缘关系。

河岸普梅人在固定的村落里种植木薯，草原普梅人则在季节性营地之间迁移，靠狩猎和采集为生。传教站和牧场在他们的草原上始终稀疏，因此大多数群体在整个殖民时期保住了自己的语言和游动的生活方式。

en:
The Purepecha were the people of the Michoacan highlands in western Mexico, farmers and fishermen of the Patzcuaro basin whom the Spanish called Tarascans. Their language is an isolate unrelated to Nahuatl. Around 1300 the chief Tariacuri began uniting the lakeside communities, and by his death about 1350 his lineage held the whole basin.

Later kings made Tzintzuntzan the capital of a tributary kingdom, and the realm reached the Pacific by 1460. It beat back an Aztec invasion in the 1470s. Tangaxuan II submitted to Spain in 1525, but Nuno de Guzman had him executed in 1530. The bishop Vasco de Quiroga then founded hospital towns for the Purepecha.
zh:
普雷佩查人是墨西哥西部米却肯高地的居民，是帕茨夸罗湖盆地的农人和渔民，西班牙人称之为塔拉斯科人。他们的语言是一种孤立语言，与纳瓦特尔语没有亲缘关系。约1300年，首领塔里亚库里开始联合湖畔诸社群，到他约1350年去世时，其家系已掌握整个湖盆。

后来的国王以辛特松桑为都城，建立起纳贡王国，到1460年国土已抵太平洋。15世纪70年代，它击退了阿兹特克的入侵。1525年，坦加克森二世向西班牙称臣，但努尼奥·德·古斯曼于1530年将他处死。随后，主教瓦斯科·德·基罗加为普雷佩查人创建了医院村。

en:
The Pyrenean group includes the Gascons, Basques and Aragonese. Basque is unrelated to the Romance speech around it, and the Basques long kept their own laws, called fueros, in remote valleys. The Aragonese held the southern slopes in the Kingdom of Aragon.

Between them lay the Kingdom of Navarre, a Basque-led realm astride the passes. Ferdinand of Aragon conquered Upper Navarre in 1512, while the northern part stayed independent and passed to the French crown with Henry IV in 1589. The English held Gascony as part of Aquitaine until 1453, when it fell to France after the Battle of Castillon.
zh:
比利牛斯文化组包括加斯科涅人、巴斯克人和阿拉贡人。巴斯克语与周围的罗曼语毫无亲缘，巴斯克人在偏远的山谷里长期保有自己的法律，称为福埃罗。阿拉贡人在阿拉贡王国中占据南麓。

两者之间是纳瓦拉王国，一个由巴斯克人主导、横跨隘口的王国。阿拉贡的斐迪南于1512年征服上纳瓦拉，北部仍保持独立，1589年随亨利四世归入法国王室。英格兰人把加斯科涅作为阿基坦的一部分一直占有到1453年，卡斯蒂永战役后它归属法国。

official_raw.en: Born of the Pyrenees Mountains that separates southern France from Iberia, the Pyrenean people share a bond forged by the shared hardships and unique societal innovations of remote life in rough borderlands.
official_raw.zh: 比利牛斯山脉横亘于法兰西南部与伊比利亚半岛之间，孕育了各个独特的比利牛斯山民民族。这些边陲之地的居民在艰苦环境中形成了紧密纽带，并创造出适应偏远生活的独特社会形态。

en:
The Quechuan group includes the Wanka, Chanka, Chincha and the Inka of Cusco. Quechua probably spread before the Incas, possibly with the Wari state, whose cities dominated the Peruvian highlands between about 500 and 1000.

In 1337 the Inka were a small chiefdom at Cusco. After Prince Cusi Yupanqui broke the Chanka siege in 1438 and took the name Pachacuti, they built Tawantinsuyu, which reached from Quito to central Chile. Pizarro's men seized Atahualpa in 1532, and Manco Inca's rump state at Vilcabamba fell in 1572. Quechua remained the common tongue of the Andes.
zh:
克丘亚族群包括万卡人、昌卡人、钦查人和库斯科的印卡人。克丘亚语大概在印加人之前就已传播，可能随瓦里国家扩散，瓦里的城市在约500年至1000年间主宰着秘鲁高原。

1337年，印卡人还只是库斯科的一个小酋邦。1438年，王子库西·尤潘基击破昌卡人对库斯科的围攻，取名帕查库提，随后建立了从基多延伸到智利中部的塔万廷苏尤。1532年皮萨罗的人俘获阿塔瓦尔帕，曼科·印卡在比尔卡班巴的余部于1572年覆亡。克丘亚语仍是安第斯山区的通用语。

en:
The Quingnam group includes the Chimú of the northern Peruvian coast with the Tallan, the Cañari and the Puruhá. Quingnam itself was the official language of Chimor, the kingdom that arose around 900 and ruled from the adobe city of Chan Chan.

Chimor conquered Lambayeque around 1375 and overran the Tallan. Around 1470 the Incas under Topa Inca Yupanqui took Chimor, and they later subdued the Cañari and Puruhá of highland Ecuador; the Cañari, who backed Huáscar in the Inca civil war, were punished by Atahualpa. The Spaniards arrived in 1532, and Quingnam was extinct by 1763.
zh:
金南族群包括秘鲁北部沿海的奇穆人与塔阳人、佳纳利人和普鲁哈人。金南语本身是奇穆王国的官方语言，该王国约900年兴起，都城是土坯建成的昌昌城。

奇穆约1375年征服兰巴耶克，并压服塔阳人。约1470年，托帕·印加·尤潘基率印加人攻取奇穆，后来又制服了厄瓜多尔高地的佳纳利人和普鲁哈人；佳纳利人在印加内战中支持瓦斯卡尔，遭到阿塔瓦尔帕的惩罚。1532年西班牙人到来，金南语到1763年已经消亡。

en:
The Romansh of Graubünden, the Ladins of the Dolomites and the Friulians are often grouped together by linguists as speakers of related languages. Romansh was once spoken far north into Glarus and St. Gallen, but German spread through the Rhine valley, and Chur turned German after a fire in 1465.

Gian Travers wrote the first surviving Romansh work in 1527. The Ladins lived under the Tyrolean counts and the bishops of Brixen. Friuli was ruled by the Patriarch of Aquileia until Venice annexed it in 1420.
zh:
格劳宾登的罗曼什人、多洛米蒂山区的拉定人和弗留利人，常被语言学家归为一组，视为说相关语言的民族。罗曼什语曾远及北面的格拉鲁斯和圣加伦，后来德语沿莱茵河谷扩展，库尔在1465年的一场大火后转用德语。

1527年，吉安·特拉弗斯写下现存最早的罗曼什语作品。拉定人处在蒂罗尔伯爵和布里克森主教治下。弗留利由阿奎莱亚牧首统治，直到1420年被威尼斯吞并。

official_raw.en: The $rhaetian_group$ people are an ethnolinguistic group composed of three primary Alpine communities: the Romansh, Ladins, and Friulians. While they do not share a single political entity, they are unified by their descent from a common Vulgar Latin substrate mixed with ancient Rhaetian and Celtic influences.
official_raw.zh: $rhaetian_group$民族是一个由罗曼什人、拉定人和弗留利人这三个主要阿尔卑斯社群组成的语言文化共同体。尽管他们并不属于同一政治实体，但由于其语言均源自融合了古雷蒂亚语与凯尔特语元素的通俗拉丁语底层，因而形成了文化上的统一性。

en:
The Dom, Lom and Rom share a westward migration, probably in waves, dated to around 1000 CE, through the Ghaznavid and Byzantine worlds. The Rom reached Europe through the Balkans in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, the Dom settled in the Middle East, and the Lom in the Caucasus.

Medieval Europeans took the newcomers for travellers from Egypt, which gave rise to the name Gypsies. In Wallachia and Moldavia, which arose in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, many Rom were enslaved by boyars, Orthodox monasteries and the state, and worked as smiths and farm labourers.
zh:
多姆人、洛姆人和罗姆人共同经历了一次西迁，可能分几波进行，学者认为发生在1000年前后，途经伽色尼和拜占庭的世界。罗姆人在13至14世纪经巴尔干进入欧洲，多姆人定居中东，洛姆人则在高加索。

中世纪的欧洲人把这些新来者当作来自埃及的旅人，因而有了“吉卜赛人”之名。在13至14世纪建立的瓦拉几亚和摩尔达维亚，许多罗姆人被波雅尔、东正教修道院和国家奴役，从事铁匠和农业劳动。

official_raw.en: The Indic Diaspora encompasses nomadic communities originating in North West India, who have migrated across various regions including the Middle East and Europe. These groups, while retaining elements of their Indian heritage, have adapted to diverse cultures and environments.
official_raw.zh: 离散印度侨民由发源于印度西北部的游牧社群构成，该族群已迁徙至中东、欧洲等多个区域。这些族群在保留其印度文化源流核心要素的同时，完成了对多元文化与生存环境的适应性调适。

en:
The Romanian group includes the Wallachians, Moldavians and Transylvanians north of the Danube, together with the Aromanians of the Balkans and the Istro-Romanians. Wallachia consolidated as a principality by 1330, when Basarab I defeated the Kingdom of Hungary at Posada, and Moldavia emerged around 1359.

Wallachia had to accept Ottoman suzerainty in 1417, and Moldavia later did the same, but Stephen the Great held the Ottomans off from 1457 to 1504. Michael the Brave briefly united Wallachia, Moldavia and Transylvania in 1600. Transylvania lay under the Hungarian crown and later became a principality.
zh:
罗马尼亚文化组包括多瑙河以北的瓦拉几亚人、摩尔达维亚人和特兰西瓦尼亚人，以及巴尔干的阿罗马尼亚人和伊斯特拉—罗马尼亚人。瓦拉几亚在1330年前后巩固为公国，当年巴萨拉布一世在波萨达击败匈牙利王国，摩尔达维亚约在1359年出现。

瓦拉几亚于1417年被迫接受奥斯曼宗主权，摩尔达维亚后来也是如此，但斯特凡大公在1457年至1504年间挡住了奥斯曼人。勇敢的米哈伊于1600年短暂地统一了瓦拉几亚、摩尔达维亚和特兰西瓦尼亚。特兰西瓦尼亚本属匈牙利王室，后来成为公国。

official_raw.en: The $romanian_group$ people, descendants of ancient Dacians and Romans, mostly inhabit the regions of Wallachia, Moldova, and Transylvania, but also across the Balkans. They boast a unique Romance variant surrounded by Slavic languages. They are celebrated for their resilience, and a love for folklore that reflects in their music, traditions, and celebrations.
official_raw.zh: 作为达契亚人与罗马人的后裔，$romanian_group$人主要聚居在瓦拉几亚、摩尔多瓦和特兰西瓦尼亚地区，同时散居于整个巴尔干半岛。尽管被斯拉夫语民族所包围，这些族群却始终保持着鲜明的罗曼语文化特征。他们以坚韧的民族性格闻名于世，将对民间传说的热爱融入了音乐艺术、传统习俗与节庆活动之中。

en:
The East Slavic group includes the Muscovites, Novgorodians, Smolenskians, Ruthenians and others. In 988 Grand Prince Vladimir took Orthodox Christianity from Byzantium.

The Mongols conquered Rus' in 1237–1240, and the Golden Horde ruled through Moscow's princes. Lithuania took the western lands, and Poland took Halych. Moscow defeated the Horde at Kulikovo in 1380, annexed Novgorod in 1478 and ended Mongol rule in 1480 under Ivan III. Ivan IV became tsar in 1547, the Romanovs followed in 1613, and Peter I declared the Russian Empire in 1721.
zh:
东斯拉夫文化组包括莫斯科人、诺夫哥罗德人、斯摩棱斯克人、鲁塞尼亚人等。988年，大公弗拉基米尔从拜占庭接受东正教。

蒙古人在1237—1240年征服罗斯，金帐汗国通过莫斯科诸公统治北方。立陶宛占据了西部的土地，波兰则取得哈利奇。莫斯科于1380年在库利科沃击败金帐汗国，1478年吞并诺夫哥罗德，1480年伊凡三世终结了蒙古的统治。伊凡四世于1547年称沙皇，1613年罗曼诺夫王朝随之而来，彼得一世于1721年宣布成立俄罗斯帝国。

official_raw.en: The Rus' people trace their origins to the Varangians, Scandinavian seafarers and warriors who settled in the Russian region around the 9th century. Over time, the Rus' underwent a process of cultural fusion, blending Slavic traditions with Scandinavian influences. Proximity to the Byzantine Empire promoted cultural and economic exchanges, contributing to their unique culture with a diverse mix of art, architecture, and language.
official_raw.zh: 罗斯人的源头可追溯至9世纪定居于罗斯地区的瓦良格人——来自斯堪的纳维亚的水手和战士。随着时间推移，各个罗斯民族将斯拉夫传统与北欧影响结合起来，逐渐实现了文化融合。作为拜占庭帝国的远邻，他们通过与希腊世界的文化交流和经济往来，最终形成了独特的文明风貌，在艺术、建筑和语言等领域都呈现出多元融合的鲜明特征。

en:
The Salishan group spans the Pacific Northwest, from the Strait of Georgia and Puget Sound inland to Idaho and Montana: the Coast Salish such as the Lushootseed and Halkomelem, the Tillamook and Tsamosan of the outer coast, and the Interior Salish such as the Secwepemc and the Saleesh.

Coastal peoples lived in cedar-plank longhouses, fished salmon and gave away wealth at the potlatch. The first smallpox epidemic came in the 1680s, long before sustained contact. George Vancouver surveyed the coast in 1792 and Lewis and Clark met the Saleesh in 1805. Forts such as Vancouver, Langley and Nisqually drew them into the Hudson's Bay Company trade.
zh:
萨利什族群分布在太平洋西北地区，从乔治亚海峡和普吉特湾一直延伸到爱达荷和蒙大拿：沿海的海岸萨利什人，如卢舒特西德人和哈尔科梅勒姆人；外海岸的蒂拉穆克人和察莫萨人；以及内陆的塞克维佩姆克人和萨利希人等内陆萨利什人。

沿海居民住在雪松木板的长屋里，捕捞鲑鱼，并在夸富宴上散财。第一场天花疫情发生在1680年代，远早于持续接触。1792年乔治·温哥华勘测海岸，1805年刘易斯和克拉克遇到了萨利希人。温哥华堡、朗利堡和尼斯夸利堡等据点把他们卷入哈德逊湾公司的贸易网。

en:
The Samoyedic group includes the Nenets, Enets, Nganasans and Selkups of northwestern Siberia, called Samoyeds by the Russians. The Nenets, the most numerous, include the Tundra Nenets of the far north and the Forest Nenets, and the Selkups arose in the middle Ob basin.

The Selkups came under Mongol sway in the thirteenth century. Around 1628 the Russians conquered their lands and subjugated them, and an uprising against Russian rule was gunned down. In the seventeenth century some Selkups moved north to the Taz River.
zh:
萨莫耶德文化组包括西伯利亚西北部的涅涅茨人、埃涅茨人、恩加纳桑人和塞尔库普人，俄罗斯人称他们为萨莫耶德人。人数最多的涅涅茨人分为远北的苔原涅涅茨人和森林涅涅茨人，塞尔库普人则形成于鄂毕河中游。

塞尔库普人在13世纪受蒙古人控制。1628年前后俄罗斯人征服并奴役了他们的土地，一次反抗俄罗斯统治的起义被枪杀镇压。17世纪，一些塞尔库普人迁往北方的塔兹河。

en:
The Scandinavian group includes the peoples of Denmark, Sweden and Norway and their offshoots in Iceland, Gotland and the Northern Isles, together with the Finns, who lived under Swedish rule. In the Viking Age their seafarers raided, traded and settled across Europe, and were the first Europeans to reach North America. Over the following centuries the region was Christianized.

In 1397 Queen Margaret I of Denmark joined Denmark, Sweden and Norway, with Iceland and the Northern Isles, in the Kalmar Union, partly to counter the Hanseatic League. Sweden left it in 1523 under Gustav Vasa, while Denmark and Norway stayed united until 1814. In the seventeenth century Sweden rose to be an empire.
zh:
斯堪的纳维亚文化组包括丹麦、瑞典和挪威的居民，以及他们在冰岛、哥得兰和北方诸岛的分支，还有处于瑞典统治下的芬兰人。维京时代，他们的航海者在欧洲各地劫掠、通商和定居，并成为最早抵达北美的欧洲人。此后几个世纪里，这一地区逐渐基督教化。

1397年，丹麦女王玛格丽特一世把丹麦、瑞典和挪威连同冰岛、北方诸岛合为卡尔马联盟，部分用意是抵御汉萨同盟。瑞典在1523年随古斯塔夫·瓦萨脱离联盟，丹麦与挪威则一直联合到1814年。17世纪，瑞典崛起为帝国。

official_raw.en: Scandinavia is home to a diverse array of peoples, shaped by a rich history of migration, trade, and cultural exchange. The different realms have developed unique identities while maintaining a sense of shared heritage. Renowned for their seafaring skills and vibrant trading networks, the Scandinavians are known for their prowess in seamanship and governance.
official_raw.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚半岛孕育了多元的民族群体，其形成深受迁徙、贸易与文化交融的历史影响。半岛各王国在保持共同文化传承的同时，也发展出独特的身份认同。以卓越航海技艺与繁荣贸易网络著称的斯堪的纳维亚人，素以精湛的航海技术与治理能力闻名于世。

en:
The Picts and the Gaels founded the Kingdom of Alba in the ninth century, and over the next two centuries the Cumbrians of Strathclyde and the Angles of Northumbria came under its rule. Norman nobles settled in the Lowlands in the twelfth century, the Norse-Gaels of the Western Isles were absorbed in the thirteenth, and the Norse of the Northern Isles in the fifteenth.

Scotland defeated the English at Bannockburn in 1314 and had its independence recognized in 1328. The crowns of Scotland and England were united in 1603, and the kingdoms merged in 1707.
zh:
皮克特人和盖尔人在9世纪建立了阿尔巴王国，此后两个世纪里，斯特拉斯克莱德的坎布里亚人和诺森布里亚的盎格鲁人先后归入其统治。12世纪，诺曼贵族迁入低地；13世纪，西部诸岛的诺斯-盖尔人并入；15世纪，北方诸岛的诺斯人也并入。

苏格兰1314年在班诺克本击败英格兰人，1328年独立获得承认。1603年苏格兰与英格兰共戴一君，1707年两国合并。

official_raw.en: The northern reaches of Britain have long been home to many peoples of diverse backgrounds; the native Picts and Cumbrians abandoned their old ways when they became absorbed into kingships of foreign Gaelic, Anglo-Saxon, and Viking origin. But in times of trial, they still unite against outsiders and become one people: the Scottish.
official_raw.zh: 不列颠群岛北部的居民向来背景多元。土著皮克特人和坎布里亚人在被盖尔人、盎格鲁‑撒克逊人和维京人等异族吸纳入王权后­，放弃了旧有生活方式。但当面临考验时，他们仍然会团结起来对抗外来者，并发展成了一个民族：苏格兰人。

en:
The Seeptsa are the Cholon, as the Spanish called them, rainforest people of the left bank of the Huallaga on the eastern slope of the Peruvian Andes. Their Seeptsa language, with the related Hibito, formed a small family. They lived by slash-and-burn farming, hunting and fishing, and traded feathers, wax and honey to the highland Hibito.

Franciscans contacted them and founded mission villages in 1676. In the eighteenth century the friar Pedro de la Mata wrote a Seeptsa grammar. Quechua and Spanish then displaced the language along the Huallaga.
zh:
塞普尔察人即西班牙人所称的乔隆人，是秘鲁安第斯山东坡瓦亚加河左岸的雨林居民。他们的塞普察语与相关的希比托语构成一个小语系。他们以刀耕火种、狩猎和捕鱼为生，把羽毛、蜂蜡和蜂蜜卖给高地的希比托人。

1676年方济各会修士与他们接触并建立传教村。18世纪，修士佩德罗·德拉马塔编写了塞普察语语法。此后，克丘亚语和西班牙语取代了瓦亚加河沿岸的这种语言。

en:
The Shan group includes the Tai peoples of the hills east of the Irrawaddy. The Shan call themselves Tai.

According to Tai chronicles the first major Shan state was founded at Möng Kawng in 1215, followed by Möng Nai in 1223. When the Mongols overran Pagan in 1287 the Shan states gained ground, and Möng Mao ended the kingdoms of Sagaing and Pinya in 1364. The Shan were too divided to resist their larger neighbors: the Ming conquered Yunnan in the 1380s, and the Burmese kingdoms to the south later absorbed them.
zh:
掸文化组包括伊洛瓦底江以东山地的傣泰各族。掸人自称“泰”。

据傣泰编年史，第一个重要的掸邦于1215年建于勐广，1223年又有勐乃。1287年蒙古人攻破蒲甘后，掸邦势力壮大，勐卯在1364年灭亡了实皆和彬牙两个王国。但掸人过于分散，无力抵抗更大的邻国：明朝在1380年代征服云南，南面的缅甸王国后来也将其吞并。

official_raw.en: Although originally an exonym from the Burmese language to refer to a variety of different Tai peoples migrated to the area, and also a cognate of Siam, it has allowed these various Tai groups to develop a shared identity.
official_raw.zh: 尽管这个称谓最初源自缅甸语，用于指代迁移到当地的各个傣泰族群，并且与“暹”一词同源。但它最终演变成一个被这些不同族群的傣泰民族共同认同的身份标识。

en:
The Shawnee group includes the Central Algonquian peoples of the Ohio Valley and the Great Lakes: the five divisions of the Shawnee, including the Kispoko, Pekowi and Chalahgawtha, with the related Meskwaki, or Fox, and the Sauk. Their homeland probably lay in southern Ohio, where some link the Shawnee to the Fort Ancient culture.

The Iroquois of the Beaver Wars drove the Shawnee out of Ohio, and they scattered across the Upper South and Pennsylvania in the seventeenth century. The Meskwaki fought France in the Fox Wars of 1701—1742, and a French army killed hundreds in 1730. The Shawnee fought to hold their land until Tecumseh's War of 1810—1813, and removal west began in the 1830s.
zh:
肖尼族群包括俄亥俄河谷和五大湖一带的中部阿尔冈昆人：包括基斯波科、佩科维和查拉高萨在内的肖尼五个分支，以及语言相近的梅斯夸基人（福克斯人）和索克人。他们的故乡大概在俄亥俄南部，有人把肖尼人与那里的古堡文化联系起来。

海狸战争中，易洛魁人把肖尼人赶出俄亥俄，他们在17世纪分散到南部高地和宾夕法尼亚。梅斯夸基人在1701—1742年的福克斯战争中与法国交战，1730年一支法军杀死了数百人。肖尼人为保住土地而战，直到1810—1813年的特库姆塞战争，19世纪30年代西迁开始。

en:
The Shona group includes the Shona themselves, the Kalanga and the Venda. Venda tradition links its first kings to the kingdom of Mapungubwe, which declined around 1300 as power moved north to Great Zimbabwe. From the eleventh century the Karanga formed kingdoms on the plateau, and Great Zimbabwe, the largest stone structure of precolonial southern Africa, became their capital in the thirteenth century.

Butua was ruled by the Torwa dynasty, and the Mutapa Empire reached the Mozambique coast, exporting gold to Swahili, Arab and East Asian traders. Succession wars let the Portuguese gain ground in the 1500s, and in the 1830s the Ndebele destroyed the weakened Rozvi Empire.
zh:
绍纳文化组包括绍纳人、卡兰加人和文达人。文达人的传统把最早的国王同马蓬古布韦王国联系起来，该国约1300年衰落，权力北移到大津巴布韦。11世纪起，卡朗加人在高原上建立诸王国，大津巴布韦是前殖民时期南部非洲最大的石构建筑，13世纪成为他们的都城。

布图阿由托尔瓦王朝统治，穆塔帕帝国则扩展到莫桑比克海岸，向斯瓦希里、阿拉伯和东亚商人出口黄金。继承战争使葡萄牙人在16世纪乘机立足，19世纪30年代恩德贝莱人摧毁了已经衰弱的罗兹维帝国。

official_raw.en: The Shona-speaking peoples of the Zimbabwe plateau and the Limpopo valley built one of Africa's most remarkable pre-colonial civilizations, centered on the great stone enclosures of Great Zimbabwe and its successor states. Their control of the gold trade routes to the Indian Ocean coast made them a commercial power whose wealth reached as far as China and Persia.
official_raw.zh: 津巴布韦高原与林波波河谷使用绍纳语的民族，以大津巴布韦及其后继诸国的巨大石建围场为中心，建立了非洲最非凡的殖民前文明之一。他们对通往印度洋海岸的黄金贸易路线的控制，使其成为一个商业强国，其财富远达中国与波斯。

en:
The Shoshoni group spans the Great Basin: the Western Shoshoni, the Kusiutta, or Goshute, of western Utah, the Bannock of the Snake River plains and the Numu bands of western Nevada. Their ancestors were Proto-Numic speakers who spread out of the southern Sierra Nevada.

Families lived in small bands that gathered pine nuts each autumn and joined communal rabbit and pronghorn drives. Horses reached the region by 1730, and some eastern bands took to mounted bison hunting and split off as the Bannock. The Comanche, who stayed Shoshoni until about 1700, left for the southern plains.
zh:
肖肖尼族群遍布大盆地：内华达西部的肖肖尼人西支和努穆诸部，犹他西部的库西乌塔人（戈休特人），以及蛇河平原的班诺克人。他们的祖先是从内华达山脉南部向外扩散的原始努米克语使用者。

他们以小游群生活，每年秋季采集松子，并参加集体围猎野兔和叉角羚。马匹在1730年前传到这一地区，东部一些游群转向骑马猎野牛，分离出班诺克人。科曼奇人在约1700年前一直是肖肖尼人的一支，后来迁往南部平原。

en:
The Sihni are the Itonama of the Bolivian Amazon, who live in the seasonally flooded savannas of the Beni lowlands along the Itonomas River. Their language, sihnipadara, meaning our language, is an isolate with no proven relatives.

They lived by slash-and-burn farming, fishing and hunting in small communities led by village councils, and honoured a high god called Dijnamu. In 1704 the missionary Lorenzo Legarda counted twenty-six Itonama communities of some six thousand people. Mission towns such as Magdalena then gathered them into Christian parish life.
zh:
西尼人即玻利维亚亚马孙的伊托纳马人，居住在贝尼低地季节性泛滥的草原上，沿伊托诺马斯河分布。他们的语言自称西尼帕达拉，意为“我们的语言”，是一种没有已证实亲属的孤立语言。

他们以刀耕火种、捕鱼和狩猎为生，社群很小，由村议会主持事务，崇敬名为迪南穆的至高神。1704年，传教士洛伦索·莱加尔达统计出二十六个伊托纳马社群，约六千人。此后马格达莱纳等传教镇把他们纳入基督教堂区生活。

en:
The Siksika group includes the Siksika, whose name means black foot, the Piikani and the Akinaa, the Blackfoot peoples of the northwestern Great Plains. Their dialects of Siksika, an Algonquian language, belong to the nations of the Blackfoot Confederacy.

Their ancestors were woodland people of the upper Great Lakes who drifted west onto the plains after about 1200 and hunted bison on foot, driving the herds over jumps. They had horses by the early 1700s and became mounted raiders who gathered each summer for the Okan, or Sun Dance. Their chief enemies were the Cree and Assiniboine. Smallpox devastated every Blackfoot nation in 1837.
zh:
西克西卡族群包括西克西卡人（名称意为“黑脚”）、皮卡尼人和阿基纳人，即大平原西北部的黑脚诸族。他们说的西克西卡语是一种阿尔冈昆语，各方言分属黑脚联盟的诸部。

他们的祖先是五大湖上游的林地居民，1200年前后起向西迁入平原，徒步猎野牛，把牛群驱赶过悬崖。18世纪初他们有了马匹，成为骑马的袭击者，每年夏天聚集举行奥坎，即太阳舞。他们的主要敌人是克里人和阿西尼博因人。1837年的天花重创了黑脚诸族。

en:
The Sinu, or Zenu, were the farming people of the Sinu and San Jorge river valleys and the Gulf of Morrosquillo in northern Colombia. Their civilization drained seasonally flooded savanna with a network of canals and raised terraces, and its goldsmiths packed the graves of chiefs with gold.

That gold drew the conquistadors, and between 1510 and 1535 warfare and epidemics broke the Zenu chiefdoms. In 1773 the Spanish crown set aside the reserve of San Andres de Sotavento for them. The Zenu language had died out by the early 1800s.
zh:
锡努人又称塞努人，是哥伦比亚北部锡努河与圣豪尔赫河谷地以及莫罗斯基略湾沿岸的农耕民族。他们的文明用运河和高台田排干季节性泛滥的草原，金匠把大量黄金放入酋长的墓中。

这些黄金引来了征服者，1510年至1535年间，战争和疫病摧毁了塞努诸酋长国。1773年，西班牙王室为他们划出圣安德烈斯-德索塔文托保留地。塞努语到19世纪初已经消亡。

en:
The Skarureh group includes two Iroquoian peoples of the southern Atlantic coastal plain: the Skarureh, called Tuscarora by the English, of North Carolina, and the Nottoway, who call themselves Cheroenhaka, of Virginia. The Skarureh name means hemp gatherers, and their matrilineal clans formed a confederacy of three tribes.

The Tuscarora War of 1711—1715 ended with the storming of Fort Neoheroka, and most survivors drifted north. In 1722 the Oneida sponsored their admission as the sixth nation of the Haudenosaunee. The Nottoway signed the Treaty of Middle Plantation in 1680, became tributaries of Virginia and lost their lands to settlers.
zh:
斯卡鲁雷族群包括大西洋沿岸南部平原上两个说易洛魁语的民族：北卡罗来纳的斯卡鲁雷人（英国人称塔斯卡洛拉人）和弗吉尼亚的诺托韦人（自称切罗恩哈卡）。斯卡鲁雷之名意为“采麻人”，他们的母系氏族组成了三个部落的联盟。

1711—1715年的塔斯卡洛拉战争以新赫罗卡堡被攻陷告终，大部分幸存者向北迁徙。1722年，奥奈达人推荐他们成为豪德诺索尼联盟的第六个成员。诺托韦人在1680年签署《中间种植园条约》，成为弗吉尼亚的纳贡者，土地逐渐被移民夺走。

en:
Slavic peoples appear in Byzantine records as the Sclaveni and Antes in the early sixth century, and by the seventh Slavs held much of Central, Eastern and Southeastern Europe. By the twelfth century the East Slavs lived in Kievan Rus', the West Slavs in Bohemia, Moravia and Poland, and the South Slavs in Bulgaria, Serbia, Croatia and Bosnia.

In 1237 the Mongols began their conquest of the Rus' principalities, and Moscow later rose to lead the northeast. In the Balkans the Ottomans overran Serbia and Bosnia in the fifteenth century, and the Czech lands passed to the Habsburgs in 1526.
zh:
斯拉夫诸族在6世纪初以斯克拉维尼人和安特人之名见于拜占庭记载，到7世纪，斯拉夫人已占有中欧、东欧和东南欧的大片土地。到12世纪，东斯拉夫人居于基辅罗斯，西斯拉夫人居于波希米亚、摩拉维亚和波兰，南斯拉夫人居于保加利亚、塞尔维亚、克罗地亚和波斯尼亚。

1237年，蒙古人开始征服罗斯诸公国，后来莫斯科崛起，成为东北罗斯的领袖。在巴尔干，奥斯曼人于15世纪攻占塞尔维亚和波斯尼亚；捷克诸地则在1526年归入哈布斯堡。

official_raw.en: The Slavic peoples, originating on the upper areas of the Vistula and Dnieper rivers in the times of the Roman Empire, expanded over centuries to occupy much of Eastern Europe. Despite being separated into different branches and forming many different states and kingdoms, their shared cultural ancestry remains.
official_raw.zh: 斯拉夫人在罗马帝国时期起源于维斯瓦河和第聂伯河上游地区，几个世纪以来不断扩张，占领了大半个东欧。尽管分离出了不同分支并建立了众多不同的国家，但他们拥有共同的文化祖先。

en:
The Sotho-Tswana group includes the Sotho, Tswana and Lozi. Their ancestors reached Botswana and the highveld about AD 200—500, and by the fifteenth century they were spreading across the southern Transvaal and forming new chiefdoms. They kept totem clans and lived in round huts with conical thatched roofs.

Tswana chiefdoms were ruled by dikgosi with advisory councils and built large towns: Kweneng, a settlement of the fifteenth to nineteenth centuries, and Kaditshwene, the cultural capital of the Bahurutshe, with some 10,000 people. The Lozi kingdom arose in the seventeenth century on the Zambezi floodplain, and about 1830 the Sotho Makololo under Sebetwane invaded and conquered it.
zh:
索托-茨瓦纳文化组包括索托人、茨瓦纳人和洛齐人。他们的祖先约在公元200至500年间到达博茨瓦纳和高草原，到15世纪已散布在特兰斯瓦南部，并形成新的酋邦。他们保持图腾氏族，住带锥形茅草顶的圆屋。

茨瓦纳酋邦由迪克戈西统治，设有咨议会，建有大型城镇：克韦嫩是15至19世纪的聚居地，卡迪茨韦内是巴胡鲁策人的文化中心，人口约一万。洛齐王国17世纪在赞比西河泛滥平原上兴起，1830年前后源自索托的马科洛洛人在塞贝通的率领下入侵并征服了它。

official_raw.en: The Sotho-Tswana peoples of the southern African highveld speak the closely related Sotho and Tswana languages and share a common heritage of nucleated village life, cattle-based wealth, and sophisticated iron-working traditions. Their large towns on the dry plateau interior were among the most populous settlements in pre-colonial southern Africa.
official_raw.zh: 南部非洲高草原的索托‑茨瓦纳民族使用关系紧密的索托语和茨瓦纳语，共享着聚居村落生活、以牛为基础的财富以及精湛的冶铁工艺传统等共同遗产。他们在干旱高原内陆上的大型城镇，是前殖民时期南部非洲人口最多的聚居点之一。

en:
The South Slavic group includes the Slavs of the eastern Alps and the Balkan Peninsula: the Bulgarians, Serbs, Croats, Slovenes and Bosnians, among others. Late Roman writers first mention them in the sixth century as the Sclaveni, who crossed the Danube into the Byzantine provinces. Each people then formed its own realm.

In 1346 Stefan Dušan was crowned emperor of the Serbs and Greeks, and in 1377 Tvrtko I became king of Bosnia. After the Ottoman victory at Kosovo in 1389, Bulgaria fell in 1396, Serbia in 1459 and Bosnia in 1463. The Slovenes lived under the Habsburgs, and Croatia accepted a Habsburg king in 1527.
zh:
南斯拉夫文化组包括东阿尔卑斯山和巴尔干半岛的斯拉夫人：保加利亚人、塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人、斯洛文尼亚人和波斯尼亚人等。晚期罗马作家在6世纪首次提到他们，称其为斯克拉维尼人，当时他们渡过多瑙河进入拜占庭诸行省。此后各族分别建国。

1346年，斯特凡·杜尚加冕为塞尔维亚人和希腊人的皇帝；1377年，特瓦尔特科一世成为波斯尼亚国王。1389年奥斯曼人在科索沃获胜之后，保加利亚于1396年陷落，塞尔维亚于1459年陷落，波斯尼亚于1463年陷落。斯洛文尼亚人处于哈布斯堡统治之下，克罗地亚则在1527年接受了哈布斯堡的国王。

official_raw.en: The Southern Slavs are a diverse group, including several peoples in the Balkan Peninsula. These people share a Slavic heritage and their linguistic roots but have developed distinct cultures over centuries.
official_raw.zh: 南斯拉夫是一个多元的族群，包括巴尔干半岛的数个民族。这些民族拥有共同的斯拉夫传承和语言根源，但经过几个世纪的发展已经成为了不同的文化。

en:
The Steppe group stretches from the Mongolian plateau to the Crimea and the Volga. Temüjin, proclaimed Genghis Khan in 1206, united the nomadic tribes of Mongolia, and his heirs built the largest contiguous empire in history. Its northwestern part became the Golden Horde.

After the Great Troubles of 1359 to 1381, Timur's invasion of 1396 broke the Horde into smaller khanates. Moscow threw off the Tatar yoke at the Ugra River in 1480, and the Great Horde disintegrated in 1502, leaving Kazan, Astrakhan, Crimea and the Nogai. In the east the Mongols held the plateau as the Northern Yuan after the Ming drove them from China in 1368.
zh:
草原族群东起蒙古高原，西至克里米亚和伏尔加河流域。铁木真于1206年被推为成吉思汗，统一了蒙古的游牧部落，他的后裔建立了史上最大的连续帝国。其西北部成为金帐汗国。

1359年至1381年的大动荡之后，1396年帖木儿入侵，把金帐汗国打成若干小汗国。1480年，莫斯科在乌格拉河对峙中摆脱了鞑靼桎梏；1502年大帐汗国瓦解，留下了喀山、阿斯特拉罕、克里米亚和诺盖。在东方，1368年明朝把蒙古人赶出中国后，他们以北元的名义据有高原。

official_raw.en: The $steppe_group$ is formed by various cultures belonging to the $mongolian_group$ and $tatar_group$ that live in the steppes of Eurasia.
official_raw.zh: $steppe_group$由生活在欧亚大草原上的各种$mongolian_group$和$tatar_group$文化组成。

en:
The Swiss group includes the German-speaking High Alemannic, French-speaking Arpitan, the Romansh of the eastern valleys and the Franc-Comtois of the Jura borderland. Their languages differ, but a shared political history united them.

The Old Swiss Confederacy formed at the end of the thirteenth century from a core in central Switzerland and had added Zurich and Bern by the mid-fourteenth century, joining rural and urban communes of the Holy Roman Empire. Victories in the Burgundy Wars of the 1470s made it a military power, and after the Swabian War of 1499 it was independent in practice. It had thirteen cantons by 1513, and the Reformation then divided them by faith.
zh:
瑞士文化组包括说德语的高地阿勒曼尼人、说法语的阿尔皮坦人、东部山谷的罗曼什人，以及汝拉边境的弗朗什孔泰人。他们的语言各不相同，却由共同的政治历史联结在一起。

旧瑞士联邦于13世纪末以瑞士中部为核心形成，到14世纪中叶已加入苏黎世和伯尔尼，把乡村与城市的自治体结合起来。1470年代勃艮第战争中的胜利使联邦成为一支军事力量，1499年施瓦本战争之后它实际上已经独立。到1513年联邦已有十三个州，宗教改革又使各州因信仰而分裂。

official_raw.en: The Swiss are the people who call the Swiss Plateau and the Alps their home. Due to their geographical position, the Swiss group is not exclusively Germanic as French and Italian cultures are part of Switzerland.
official_raw.zh: 由于其地理位置，生活在瑞士高原和阿尔卑斯山的瑞士人并不完全是德意志人，因为法兰西和意大利文化在瑞士同时存在。

en:
The Ta Arawakan peoples spread from the Amazon and Orinoco basins across northern South America to the Guianas, Colombia and the Caribbean. They include the Taino of the islands, the Lokono of the Guianas and the Wayuu of the Guajira, and in the interior the Yanesha, Matsigenka and Moxo.

The Taino lived under hereditary caciques and worshipped spirit images called zemis. In 1492 they were the first Americans Columbus met, and the encomienda and epidemics shattered them; the cacique Enriquillo's revolt ran from 1519 to 1533. The Lokono kept Spain at arm's length and traded with the Dutch and English, who founded Essequibo in 1616.
zh:
阿拉瓦克诸族从亚马孙和奥里诺科流域扩散到南美洲北部、圭亚那、哥伦比亚和加勒比海。其中有岛上的泰诺人、圭亚那的洛科诺人（阿拉瓦克人）、瓜希拉的瓦尤人，内陆则有亚内沙人、马齐根卡人和莫霍人。

泰诺人由世袭的卡西克统治，崇拜称为泽米的神灵像。1492年他们成为哥伦布遇到的第一批美洲人，监护征赋制和疫病摧毁了他们；卡西克恩里基略的起义持续于1519年至1533年。洛科诺人对西班牙保持距离，与荷兰人和英国人通商，荷兰人1616年建立了埃塞奎博。

en:
The Takic group includes the Tongva of the Los Angeles Basin, the Taaqtam, or Serrano, and the Cahuilla of southern California. Takic speakers moved south from a desert homeland in the western Mojave into coastal California, and held the Southern Channel Islands and the inland deserts and mountains.

Juan Rodriguez Cabrillo met coastal Takic speakers in 1542. Sustained contact began after 1769, when Spanish missions such as San Gabriel, founded in 1771, were planted in their lands. Resettlement, forced labour and epidemics shattered the mission peoples, who rose in revolts such as Toypurina's in 1785 and the Serrano and Cahuilla rising of 1812. Secularization in the 1830s left most survivors landless.
zh:
塔基克族群包括南加利福尼亚的通瓦人、塔克坦人（即塞拉诺人）和卡维拉人，通瓦人分布在洛杉矶盆地。塔基克语使用者从莫哈维沙漠西部的故乡南下进入加利福尼亚沿海，据有南部海峡群岛以及内陆的沙漠和山地。

1542年，胡安·罗德里格斯·卡布里略遇到了沿海的塔基克语居民。1769年之后，圣加百列等西班牙传教站（1771年建立）设在他们的土地上，持续接触由此开始。强制迁居、强制劳动和疫病摧毁了传教站里的居民；他们发动了1785年托伊普里娜起义和1812年塞拉诺人与卡维拉人的起义。1830年代的传教站世俗化使大多数幸存者失去了土地。

en:
The Tanoan group joins the Pueblo peoples of New Mexico, who speak Tiwa, Tewa and Towa, and the Kiowa of the Great Plains. The Pueblos live in farming towns along the Rio Grande and its tributaries.

Coronado's expedition fought the Tiwa pueblos in the Tiguex War of 1540, and Juan de Oñate founded the first Spanish colony in 1598. In 1680 the Pueblos rose under Popé and drove the Spaniards out of New Mexico. The Kiowa came from western Montana, moved south into the Colorado Rockies in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, and reached the Southern Plains by the early nineteenth, hunting bison from horseback.
zh:
塔诺族群包括新墨西哥的普韦布洛诸民族，说蒂瓦语、特瓦语和托瓦语，以及大平原上的基奥瓦人。普韦布洛人住在格兰德河及其支流沿岸的农耕城镇。

1540年，科罗纳多的远征军在蒂瓜克斯战争中攻打蒂瓦人的普韦布洛；1598年，胡安·德·奥尼亚特建立了第一个西班牙殖民地。1680年，普韦布洛人在波佩领导下起义，把西班牙人赶出了新墨西哥。基奥瓦人原居蒙大拿西部，17至18世纪南迁进入科罗拉多的落基山，19世纪初到达南部平原，在那里骑马猎捕野牛。

en:
The Tarairiu were a nation of the Brazilian northeast, called Tapuya by the coastal peoples. Their language survives only in a few word lists and is unclassified. They lived in the dry backlands between the Assu and Apodi rivers, in about two dozen groups, among them the Jandui and the Caninde.

They moved with the seasons of the rivers, came down to the coast for the cashew harvest, and hunted with spear-throwers and clubs while also growing maize and manioc. Albert Eckhout painted a Tarairiu warrior for the Dutch. In the seventeenth century they fought beside the Dutch against the Portuguese, who campaigned against them between about 1630 and 1730.
zh:
塔拉伊留人是巴西东北部的一个民族，沿海居民称他们为塔普亚人。他们的语言只留下少量词表，无法归类。他们住在阿苏河与阿波迪河之间干旱的内陆，分成约二十来个群体，如让杜伊人和卡尼恩代人。

他们随河流的涨落迁移，腰果成熟时下到海岸，用投矛器和棍棒狩猎，也种玉米和木薯。阿尔贝特·艾克霍特为荷兰人画过一名塔拉伊留战士。17世纪，他们与荷兰人并肩对抗葡萄牙人，葡萄牙人在1630年至1730年前后持续对他们用兵。

en:
The Tatar group spans the Volga, the Crimea and the Pontic steppe. The name Tatar first belonged to a steppe confederation that Genghis Khan absorbed into the Mongol Empire, and it later became the name for the populations of the Golden Horde. They speak Kipchak Turkic languages.

As the Golden Horde broke up, the khanates of Kazan, Crimea and Astrakhan emerged in the fifteenth century. The Crimean khans became Ottoman vassals in 1475 and burned Moscow in 1571. Ivan IV of Russia conquered Kazan in 1552 and Astrakhan in 1556, and Russia annexed the Crimea in 1783.
zh:
鞑靼文化组分布在伏尔加河流域、克里米亚和黑海草原。鞑靼最初是一个草原部落联盟的名称，被成吉思汗并入蒙古帝国，后来成为金帐汗国境内居民的通称。他们说钦察突厥语族的语言。

金帐汗国解体之际，喀山、克里米亚和阿斯特拉罕三个汗国在15世纪相继出现。克里米亚汗在1475年成为奥斯曼的附庸，并在1571年焚烧了莫斯科。俄国的伊凡四世于1552年征服喀山，1556年征服阿斯特拉罕，俄国又在1783年吞并克里米亚。

official_raw.en: The origin of the Tatar people can be traced to Turkic and Mongol ethnic groups of Central Asia and is broadly used to refer to nomadic tribes, such as the Volga and Crimean Tatars. Each subgroup has its own distinct history, language variations, and cultural traditions, and are mostly connected by Islam, reflecting the influence of Islamic cultures in the regions they inhabit.
official_raw.zh: 鞑靼人的起源可以追溯到中亚的突厥和蒙古族群，被广泛用来指代伏尔加河和克里米亚鞑靼人等游牧部落。每一个子族群都拥有自己独特的历史、语言和文化传统，并主要通过伊斯兰教联系在一起，体现了伊斯兰文化在他们居住的区域的影响力。

en:
The Tayrona were a network of chiefdoms in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, on the Caribbean coast of what is now Colombia by the tenth and eleventh centuries. Their towns stood on stone terraces linked by paved roads, and Ciudad Perdida, founded about 800 on the Buritaca River, may have held several thousand people. They farmed maize and cassava and cast gold in tumbaga, an alloy of gold, silver and copper.

The name seems to come from Tairo, a chiefdom on the northern slope, which the Spaniards extended to the whole region. Early contacts were tolerated, but conflict grew, and by about 1600 some of the people withdrew to the higher mountains.
zh:
泰罗纳人是圣玛尔塔内华达山区的一组酋邦，位于今哥伦比亚的加勒比海岸，至10、11世纪已自成传统。城镇建在石砌台地上，以铺石道路相连；约800年建于布里塔卡河畔的迷城可能住过数千人。他们种植玉米和木薯，用坦巴加合金（金、银、铜的合金）铸造金饰。

泰罗纳这个名称似乎出自北坡的一个酋邦泰罗，西班牙人把它扩大用于整个地区。最初的接触尚能相安，16世纪冲突加剧，约1600年前后，一部分人退入更高的山区。

en:
The Thai group gathers the Tai-speaking peoples, who are scattered across southern China and mainland Southeast Asia and are identified chiefly by their language: the Zhuang, Dai, Lao and Thai among them. In 1238 Si Inthrathit revolted against the Khmer and founded the Sukhothai Kingdom.

Under Ram Khamhaeng (1279–1298) it reached its greatest extent, and he is credited with introducing Theravada Buddhism and the first Thai script. Sukhothai declined afterwards: the neighboring kingdom of Ayutthaya invaded it in 1349 and annexed it in 1438.
zh:
泰文化组汇集了说傣泰语的各族，他们散居在中国南方和中南半岛，主要靠语言辨识，其中有壮族、傣族、佬族和泰族。1238年，西·因陀罗提起兵反抗高棉人，建立素可泰王国。

兰甘亨在位期间（1279—1298）素可泰疆域最广，据说是他引入了上座部佛教和最初的泰文。此后素可泰衰落，邻近的阿瑜陀耶王国于1349年入侵，并在1438年将其吞并。

official_raw.en: Since their origins in the Southern parts of China to their migrations and subsequent establishing in the Chao Phraya valley, the original Tai peoples have developed a unique identity, merging their original traditions with influences from Mon and Khmer peoples.
official_raw.zh: 原初的泰人起源于中国南方，后来迁徙到昭披耶河谷定居，发展出了独特的身份认同，将其原始传统与孟人和高棉人的影响融为一体。

en:
The Tibetan group stretches from Kham and Amdo in the east to Ladakh in the west and Bhutan in the south. Its peoples speak Tibetic languages, are thought to descend from the ancient Qiang, and follow Tibetan Buddhism or the native Bon faith.

In the seventh century Songtsen Gampo founded the Tibetan Empire, which reached Chang'an. After its collapse the region was divided among monasteries and noble houses. The Sakya school ruled under the Yuan from the thirteenth century, and Changchub Gyaltsen's Phagmodrupa dynasty replaced it in 1354. In 1642 Güshi Khan placed the Fifth Dalai Lama of the Gelug school at the head of Tibet.
zh:
藏文化组东起康区和安多，西至拉达克，南及不丹。组内各族说藏语支语言，一般认为是古代羌人的后裔，信奉藏传佛教或本土的苯教。

7世纪，松赞干布建立吐蕃，鼎盛时势力远及长安。吐蕃瓦解后，各地由寺院和贵族分治。萨迦派在13世纪起于元朝治下执掌藏地，1354年被绛曲坚赞的帕木竹巴政权取代。1642年，固始汗扶立格鲁派的五世达赖喇嘛执掌西藏。

official_raw.en: As residents of the high plateaus of Tibet and the Himalayas Mountains, the Tibetan people are used to extreme climates and terrain.
official_raw.zh: 生活在青藏高原与喜马拉雅山区的藏族人民，早已适应了这里严酷的气候与险峻的地形。

en:
The Tibeto-Burman group gathers the speakers of the non-Chinese languages of the Sino-Tibetan family, reaching from the Himalayas through northeastern India and Burma to southwestern China. The largest members are the Burmese, the Tibetan Ü-Tsang and Amdowa, the Yi, the Karen and the Newars of Kathmandu. Tibetan and Burmese literary traditions date from the seventh and twelfth centuries.

The Pagan Kingdom, which had united the Irrawaddy valley, fell to the Mongols in 1287. In Tibet, the Sakya lamas ruled under Mongol patronage, and in 1642 the Gelug school's Dalai Lama became ruler with the backing of Gushi Khan. The Tangut state of Western Xia, home of the Mi-Niah, was destroyed by the Mongols in 1227.
zh:
藏缅文化组汇集了汉藏语系中汉语以外诸语言的使用者，分布从喜马拉雅山区经印度东北部和缅甸，直到中国西南。其中最大的有缅甸人、卫藏和安多等藏人、彝人、克伦人，以及加德满都谷地的尼瓦尔人。藏语和缅甸语的文字传统分别始于7世纪和12世纪。

统一了伊洛瓦底江流域的蒲甘王朝于1287年亡于蒙古人。在西藏，萨迦派喇嘛在蒙古人的扶持下执政，1642年格鲁派的达赖喇嘛在固始汗的支持下成为统治者。党项人建立的西夏则于1227年被蒙古人灭亡。

official_raw.en: Migrations from the Tibetan plateau during the earlier historic periods brought these peoples to several places, including India. Their development has been unequal, though, with some groups developing advanced and complex societies, while others have remained rather tribal.
official_raw.zh: 在历史早期，这些族群从青藏高原迁徙而来，逐渐分布到包括印度在内的多个地区。然而，这些族群的发展轨迹并不一致：有些形成了高度发达的社会体系，而另一些则长期维持着相对原始的部落生存方式。

en:
The Timoto are the Andean farming people of western Venezuela, usually grouped with the neighbouring Cuica as the Timoto-Cuica. They lived in the mountain valleys of the Chama and Motatan rivers, in what are now Merida, Trujillo and Tachira, and their language was related to that of the Muisca of Colombia.

They built irrigated terraces on the hillsides and grew maize, potatoes and beans, lived in permanent stone-and-wood villages with water tanks, and traded cotton, salt and cacao. They left fine pottery but no large monuments. Venezuelan historians report that in 1549 the Timoto and Cuica joined against the Spanish at Escuque and drove them back to El Tocuyo.
zh:
蒂莫托人是委内瑞拉西部安第斯山区的农耕民族，通常与邻近的奎卡人合称蒂莫托-奎卡人。他们住在查马河与莫塔坦河的山谷中，大致在后来的梅里达、特鲁希略和塔奇拉一带，语言与哥伦比亚的穆伊斯卡人相近。

他们在山坡上修筑灌溉梯田，种植玉米、土豆和豆类，住在带蓄水池的石木结构常住村落里，并交易棉花、盐和可可。他们留下了精美的陶器，却没有大型纪念建筑。据委内瑞拉史家记述，1549年蒂莫托人和奎卡人联合起来，在埃斯库克抵抗西班牙人，把对方赶回了埃尔托库约。

en:
The Timucua were the largest native people of northeast and north-central Florida and southeast Georgia, about 35 chiefdoms speaking dialects of one language and never united under a single ruler. The group also covers the Calusa of the southwest coast, who built a powerful realm on fishing from their town of Calos, and the Tocobaga around Tampa Bay.

French Huguenots founded Fort Caroline among the Saturiwa in 1564, and the Spanish founded St. Augustine in 1565 and planted missions in the Timucua towns. Disease cut the Timucua from about 200,000 to 50,000 by 1595 and to about 1,000 by 1700; in 1703 James Moore of Carolina led slave raids that killed and enslaved hundreds more.
zh:
蒂穆夸人是佛罗里达东北部、中北部和佐治亚东南部最大的原住民，约有35个酋邦，说同一种语言的不同方言，从未统一在一个首领之下。这一组还包括西南海岸的卡卢萨人，他们以渔业为基础，在卡洛斯城建立了强大的政权；以及坦帕湾一带的托科巴加人。

1564年，法国胡格诺教徒在萨图里瓦人中建立卡罗琳堡；1565年西班牙人建立圣奥古斯丁，并在蒂穆夸人的城镇设立传教站。疫病使蒂穆夸人口到1595年从约20万降至5万，1700年只剩约一千人；1703年，卡罗来纳的詹姆斯·摩尔率队劫掠奴隶，又杀死并掳走数百人。

en:
The Totozoquean group brings together peoples of southern Mexico whose languages are proposed to share an origin: the Totonac of Veracruz, the Zoque of Chiapas, the Mixe of Oaxaca, and the Ikoot, or Huave, of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec, whose language may be a close relative. Some scholars link the Mixe-Zoque speakers to the Olmec, though the claim is disputed.

From the mid-fifteenth century the Totonac of Totonacapan faced Aztec incursions and rebelled often. Cempoala was the first native city Hernán Cortés reached on his march to Tenochtitlan in 1519. Luis Marín began the conquest of the Zoque lands in 1523, and the Zoque were parcelled out to settlers, but the Mixe held their mountains against Spanish attack.
zh:
托托索克族群汇集了墨西哥南部几支语言被认为同出一源的民族：韦拉克鲁斯的托托纳克人、恰帕斯的索克人、瓦哈卡的米赫人，以及特万特佩克地峡的伊科奥特人（即休亚韦人，其语言可能是近亲）。一些学者把说米赫-索克语的人与奥尔梅克人联系起来，但这一说法有争议。

15世纪中叶起，托托纳卡潘的托托纳克人遭阿兹特克人进攻，叛乱不断。1519年，森波阿拉是埃尔南·科尔特斯进军特诺奇蒂特兰途中最先抵达的原住民城邦。1523年，路易斯·马林开始征服索克人的土地，索克人被分配给殖民者；米赫人则守住了山区，抵住了西班牙人的进攻。

en: The Truka are an indigenous people of northeastern Brazil, living on the islands of the Assunção archipelago in the São Francisco River, at Cabrobó in Pernambuco. Their original language is extinct and was never recorded.
zh: 特鲁卡人是巴西东北部的原住民，居住在伯南布哥州卡布罗博的圣弗朗西斯科河中，阿松桑群岛的岛屿上。他们原来的语言已经消亡，也没有留下记录。

en:
The Cheyenne were an Algonquian-speaking people of the Great Plains, formed of two closely related tribes, the Tsitsistas and the Suhtai, who spoke slightly different dialects. In the seventeenth century they lived between the Mississippi and Mille Lacs Lake in Minnesota, gathering wild rice and hunting bison.

The Assiniboine and later the Lakota pushed them west, and they reached the Missouri River in 1676. There they lived beside the Mandan, Hidatsa and Arikara and adopted much of their way of life. About 1730 they introduced the horse to the Lakota. By 1776 the Lakota had taken much of their land near the Black Hills; around 1811 the Cheyenne allied with the Arapaho and spread over the central Plains.
zh:
夏延人是大平原上说阿尔衮琴语的民族，由两个关系密切的部落构成，即齐齐斯塔斯人和苏泰人，两者口音略有差异。17世纪他们住在密西西比河与明尼苏达米勒拉克斯湖之间，采集野生稻并猎捕野牛。

在阿西尼博因人和后来的拉科他人的压迫下，他们向西迁移，1676年到达密苏里河。他们在那里与曼丹人、希达察人和阿里卡拉人为邻，吸收了对方生活方式的许多内容。约1730年，他们把马引介给拉科他人。到1776年，拉科他人夺取了他们靠近黑山的大片土地；1811年前后，夏延人与阿拉帕霍人结盟，并扩展到中部平原各地。

en:
The Tshon group takes its name from the Chonan languages of Patagonia and Tierra del Fuego, whose name comes from the Selk'nam word for man. It covers the Tehuelche, or Aonikenk, of the Patagonian steppe, the Selk'nam of northeastern Tierra del Fuego, the Teushen, and the Gununa Kune and Querandi of the Pampas.

Ferdinand Magellan's men met the Tehuelche at San Julian in 1520 and called them Patagones. In 1536 the Querandi routed a Spanish force sent from Pedro de Mendoza's new Buenos Aires with their bolas, and after the Spaniards abandoned their livestock they took to horses. Olivier van Noort's Dutch fleet fought the Selk'nam in the Strait of Magellan in 1599, leaving about forty dead.
zh:
聪族群得名于巴塔哥尼亚和火地岛的聪语系，该名称来自塞尔克南语中的“人”。它包括巴塔哥尼亚草原上的特维尔切人（又称奥尼肯克人）、火地岛东北部的塞尔克南人、特乌申人，以及潘帕斯草原上的古纳库内人和基兰迪人。

1520年，麦哲伦的船员在圣胡利安遇见特维尔切人，称他们为巴塔贡人。1536年，基兰迪人用投石索击溃了佩德罗·德·门多萨新建的布宜诺斯艾利斯派出的西班牙军队；西班牙人丢弃牲畜后，他们学会了骑马。1599年，奥利维尔·范诺尔特率领的荷兰舰队在麦哲伦海峡与塞尔克南人交战，约四十人死亡。

en:
The Tsimshian, whose name means Inside the Skeena River, are a people of the Pacific Northwest Coast, living along the lower Skeena River and the coast of what is now northern British Columbia. By oral history some once lived far up the Skeena and moved to the coast after disasters, founding Kitkatla, while the Nisga'a and Gitxsan stayed inland.

They wintered around Prince Rupert Harbour, where people had lived for some 5,000 years, and returned to the Skeena when the salmon ran. Their society was matrilineal, with clans and hereditary chiefs, and rank was confirmed at potlatch feasts. Europeans probably first reached them in 1787, and in 1834 the Hudson's Bay Company moved its fort to Lax Kw'alaams.
zh:
钦西安人的名称意为“斯基纳河之内”，是太平洋西北海岸的民族，住在斯基纳河下游和今不列颠哥伦比亚北部的海岸。据口述历史，其中一部分人原先住在斯基纳河上游很远的地方，灾祸之后迁到海岸，建立了基特卡特拉；尼斯加人和吉克桑人则留在内陆。

他们冬天住在鲁珀特王子港周围的村落，那里的人类居住史已有约5000年；鲑鱼洄游时，他们回到斯基纳河上的夏季村落。社会实行母系制，设氏族和世袭酋长，地位在夸富宴上得到确认。欧洲人大约在1787年首次到达，1834年哈德逊湾公司把堡垒迁到拉克夸拉姆斯。

en:
The Tucanoan group gathers peoples of the northwestern Amazon who speak languages of the Tucanoan family. It includes the Karapana of Colombia and Brazil, the Siona of the Putumayo and the Ecuador border, and the Tama of the Orteguaza River, whose language died out.

They were swidden farmers who grew manioc in forest clearings and also hunted, fished and foraged. The Siona descend from the people the Spaniards called Encabellados, for their long hair. Jesuits first visited them in 1599 and gathered them into mission villages through the eighteenth century, but the reductions failed and the Jesuits were expelled.
zh:
图卡诺族群汇集了亚马孙西北部说图卡诺语系语言的民族，包括哥伦比亚与巴西的卡拉帕纳人、普图马约河和厄瓜多尔边界一带的西奥纳人，以及住在奥尔特瓜萨河一带、语言已经消亡的塔马人。

他们是刀耕火种的农民，在林中空地种木薯，也狩猎、捕鱼和采集。西奥纳人是西班牙人称为恩卡贝亚多斯（长发人）的那些人的后裔。耶稣会士1599年首次造访他们，18世纪间把他们聚集到传教村，但这些传教区没有成功，耶稣会士后来也被驱逐。

en:
The Tungusic homeland is thought to lie near the Amur River in northeastern Manchuria, and from there the Evenks spread across Siberia. The Jurchens of the south also farmed, and Amur peoples such as the Udege and Ulch took on Chinese customs.

The Jurchens founded the Jin dynasty in 1115, took northern China in 1127, and were overthrown by the Mongols in 1234. Under the Ming they were classed as Jianzhou, Haixi and Yeren Jurchens. In the early seventeenth century Nurhaci united most of them under the Eight Banners, and in 1635 Hong Taiji renamed them Manchus.
zh:
通古斯人的故地一般认为在满洲东北部的黑龙江一带，鄂温克人由此扩散到整个西伯利亚。南部的女真人也从事农耕，兀狄哈、乌尔奇等黑龙江沿岸的民族则接受了中国的习俗。

女真人于1115年建立金朝，1127年夺取华北，1234年被蒙古人灭亡。明朝时他们被分为建州、海西和野人三部。17世纪初，努尔哈赤把大部分女真人统一在八旗之下；1635年，皇太极将其改称满洲。

official_raw.en: Distributed through most of Manchuria and Eastern Siberia, the $tungusic_group$ peoples have traditionally lived from hunting and trading. Adapted to the harsh climates of their native lands, these groups have usually organized in clannic structures.
official_raw.zh: $tungusic_group$民族分布于满洲及西伯利亚东部大部分地区，传统上以狩猎与贸易为生。这些群体适应了故土的严酷环境，通常以氏族结构作为社会组织形式。

en:
The Tupi group covers the many peoples who speak Tupi-Guarani languages, spread over eastern Brazil and the Paraguay basin: the Tupinamba, Tupiniquim, Potiguara and Tabajara of the Atlantic coast, and the Guarani of the Parana and Paraguay rivers. The coastal Tupi were the peoples the Portuguese met first, and Old Tupi became a lingua franca between Europeans and natives, with catechisms, poems and plays.

André Thevet in 1572, Jean de Léry in 1578 and Hans Staden described the Tupinamba, including their cannibalism, and these accounts influenced Montaigne's essay on cannibals. In 1537 Gonzalo de Mendoza founded Asunción among the Guarani; Jesuits reached Paraná in 1585 and in 1608 were authorised to convert the tribes of Guayrá.
zh:
图皮族群包括说图皮-瓜拉尼诸语的众多民族，分布在巴西东部和巴拉圭河流域：大西洋沿岸的图皮南巴人、图皮尼金人、波蒂瓜拉人和塔巴雅拉人，以及巴拉那河与巴拉圭河一带的瓜拉尼人。沿海的图皮人就是葡萄牙人最先遇到的居民；古图皮语后来成为欧洲人与原住民之间的通用语，留下了教理问答、诗歌和戏剧。

1572年的安德烈·泰韦、1578年的让·德·莱里和汉斯·施塔登都描写过图皮南巴人，包括他们的食人习俗，这些记述影响了蒙田论食人族的文章。1537年，贡萨洛·德·门多萨在瓜拉尼人中建立亚松森；1585年耶稣会士抵达巴拉那，1608年获准在瓜伊拉诸部中传教。

en:
The Proto-Turkic ancestors of the Turkic peoples probably lived in the Altai-Sayan region, Mongolia or Tuva, and were later nomadic herders. The name Turk was first used for the Göktürks, who are named in inscriptions of the sixth century, and the Orkhon inscriptions of 735 are the oldest Turkic texts.

Seljuk Turks entered Anatolia after Manzikert in 1071, and the Ottomans rose there from about 1300 and took Constantinople in 1453. In the steppe, Turkic-speaking peoples made up much of the Golden Horde. The Sakha lived far to the north in Siberia.
zh:
突厥人的祖先，即原始突厥语的使用者，很可能生活在阿尔泰—萨彦岭、蒙古或图瓦一带，后来转为游牧。“突厥”一名最先用于6世纪碑铭中提到的阿史那突厥，735年的鄂尔浑碑铭是现存最早的突厥文字。

塞尔柱突厥人在1071年曼齐克特战役后进入安纳托利亚，奥斯曼人约从1300年起在那里崛起，并在1453年攻占君士坦丁堡。在草原上，说突厥语的各族构成了金帐汗国的主体。萨哈人则远居西伯利亚北部。

official_raw.en: The Turkic peoples have come a long way since they originated centuries ago in the steppes of Asia. Having expanded to cover territories from the Black Sea to the Mongolian Steppes and down into Persia, they have interacted with many other cultures and peoples, and have diverged themselves into many different groups, but the shared Turkic identity remains.
official_raw.zh: 突厥人自几个世纪以前兴起于亚洲大草原以来已经走过了漫漫长路。他们的土地从黑海到蒙古草原再到波斯，与许多其他文化和族群有了交流，并分化为众多不同的族群，不过仍保留着共同的突厥身份。

en:
The Tutelo group gathers the Native peoples of the Virginia and Carolina piedmont, the Kanawha Valley and the upper Ohio, most of whom spoke Siouan languages. The Tutelo and Monacan lived above the Fall Line in Virginia; the Moneton, whose name means Big Water, in the Kanawha Valley; and the Ofo, or Mosopelea, had villages near the upper Ohio River.

Under pressure from English settlers and the Haudenosaunee, the Tutelo and related nations joined together as the Nahyssan in the late seventeenth century. The Ofo, driven by Haudenosaunee attacks, moved south to the lower Mississippi and settled in Louisiana among the Tunica and Biloxi. By 1740 the Tutelo had left their homeland, and the Cayuga adopted them in 1753.
zh:
图特洛族群汇集了弗吉尼亚和卡罗来纳山麓、卡诺瓦河谷以及俄亥俄河上游的原住民，其中多数说苏语系语言。图特洛人和莫纳坎人住在弗吉尼亚的瀑布线以西；莫内顿人的名称意为“大水”，住在卡诺瓦河谷；奥夫人（又称莫索佩莱亚人）在俄亥俄河上游一带有村落。

17世纪后期，在英国殖民者和易洛魁人的压力下，图特洛人与相关各族联合，合称纳伊辛人。奥夫人受易洛魁人攻击，南迁到密西西比河下游，在路易斯安那与图尼卡人和比洛克西人同住。1740年，图特洛人已离开家园；1753年，他们被卡尤加人收养。

en: The Txapakura are the peoples of the Chapacuran language family, once spread along the Blanco, Guaporé and Mamoré rivers of northern Bolivia and Rondônia in Brazil. Their languages include Chapacura, Moré and Wari'.
zh: 查帕库拉人是查帕库拉语系的各民族，曾分布在玻利维亚北部的布兰科河、瓜波雷河、马莫雷河一带和巴西的隆多尼亚。语言包括查帕库拉语、莫雷语和瓦里语。

en:
The Uru, who spoke Uchumataqu, were fishermen and reed gatherers of the high Andean lakes: Lake Titicaca, Lake Poopó and the Desaguadero River. They called themselves Lupihaques, sons of the Sun, and held that they owned the lake and its water. On Titicaca they lived on floating islands made of totora reed, which could be moved if a threat arose.

The Uru traded and intermarried with the Aymara on the mainland and gradually gave up their own language for Aymara. After the Inca conquest they paid tribute and were often enslaved. A conflict between the Uru and the Aymara arose from 1722.
zh:
乌鲁人说乌丘马塔库语，是安第斯高原湖泊的渔民和采芦者，分布在的的喀喀湖、波波湖和德萨瓜德罗河一带。他们自称卢皮哈克斯，意为“太阳之子”，认为湖和湖水属于自己。在的的喀喀湖上，他们住在用托托拉芦苇扎成的浮岛上，遇到威胁时浮岛可以移走。

乌鲁人与岸上的艾马拉人通商通婚，逐渐放弃了自己的语言而改说艾马拉语。印加人征服后，他们要缴纳贡赋，也常被沦为奴隶。从1722年起，乌鲁人与艾马拉人之间发生了冲突。

en:
The Volta-Niger group includes the Yoruba, Edo, Igbo, Ijaw, Nupe and Igala of southern Nigeria. Ife, the Yoruba holy city, produced naturalistic bronze heads between 1200 and 1400, and the Oyo Empire later became the leading Yoruba power.

In Benin the Edo Oba Ewuare enlarged his kingdom from 1440, and the Portuguese reached it in 1485. The Igbo lived in village assemblies under the ritual authority of the priest-kings of Nri, while the Ijaw fished and traded in the Niger Delta. The Oyo Empire broke up under civil strife and Fulani pressure in the 1820s and 1830s, and its capital Oyo-Ile fell in 1835.
zh:
沃尔特-尼日尔文化组包括尼日利亚南部的约鲁巴人、埃多人、伊博人、伊乔人、努佩人和伊加拉人。约鲁巴圣城伊费在1200至1400年间出产写实风格的青铜头像，后来奥约帝国成为约鲁巴人的头号强国。

在贝宁，埃多人的奥巴埃瓦雷自1440年起扩大王国，葡萄牙人于1485年抵达。伊博人以乡村会议自治，奉恩里祭司王为宗教权威；伊乔人则在尼日尔河三角洲捕鱼和贸易。奥约帝国在19世纪20至30年代因内乱和富拉尼人的压力而瓦解，都城奥约伊莱于1835年陷落。

official_raw.en: The Volta-Niger peoples of the Nigerian region speak languages of the Volta-Niger branch of Niger-Congo and include some of the most populous and politically sophisticated societies in West Africa. The Yoruba city-states, the Igbo village republics, and the Benin Kingdom are among the most accomplished polities on the continent.
official_raw.zh: 尼日利亚地区的沃尔特‑尼日尔民族使用尼日尔‑刚果语系沃尔特-尼日尔语支的语言，包括西非人口最多、政治组织最为复杂的一些社会。约鲁巴城邦、伊格博乡村共和国以及贝宁王国是非洲大陆上成就最高的政体之列。

en:
The Wakashan group joins the Northwest Coast peoples of Vancouver Island, the central British Columbia coast and Cape Flattery in Washington. The Nootka, or Nuu-chah-nulth, and the Makah hunted whales on the open coast, while the Kwakiutl, or Kwakwaka'wakw, lived in a society of nobles, commoners and slaves, whose rank was displayed at potlatch feasts. The Heiltsuk and Haisla lived farther north.

James Cook anchored at Yuquot in 1778, opening the maritime fur trade, and the rivalry between Spain and Britain over Nootka Sound led to the Nootka Crisis of about 1790. The Nuu-chah-nulth chief Maquinna captured the American ship Boston in 1803. Disease killed more than nine in ten Nuu-chah-nulth between first contact and 1830.
zh:
瓦卡什族群汇集了西北海岸的民族，分布在温哥华岛、不列颠哥伦比亚中部海岸和华盛顿州的弗拉特里角。努特卡人（努查努尔特人）和马卡人在外海岸猎捕鲸鱼；夸扣特尔人（夸夸嘉夸人）的社会分贵族、平民和奴隶，等级在夸富宴上展示；海尔楚克人和海斯拉人住在更北的地方。

1778年詹姆斯·库克在尤库特停泊，开启了海上皮毛贸易；西班牙与英国争夺努特卡湾，引发约1790年的努特卡危机。1803年，努查努尔特首领马奎纳夺取了美国商船波士顿号。从最初接触到1830年，九成以上的努查努尔特人死于疫病。

en:
The Waqha group takes its name from the Vilela, who call themselves Uakambalelte, those who speak Waqha. It also covers two neighbours, the Tonokote of Santiago del Estero and the Sanaviron of Córdoba. The Vilela hunted and gathered in northern Tucumán and Santiago del Estero, while the Tonokote were sedentary farmers.

The Inca Empire occupied northwestern Argentina by about 1480 and took in part of the Tonokote. The Sanaviron, a branch of the Tonokote, spread southwest into the Córdoba hills and were largely absorbed into the colonial population in the eighteenth century. After the Spanish conquest of Tucumán the Vilela moved east into the Chaco, where Jesuits founded three missions on their lands between 1735 and 1763.
zh:
瓦卡族群得名于比莱拉人，他们自称瓦坎巴莱尔特，意为“说瓦卡语的人”。这一组还包括两个近邻：圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗的托诺科特人和科尔多瓦的萨纳维龙人。比莱拉人在图库曼北部和圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗北部狩猎采集，托诺科特人则过定居的农耕生活。

约1480年，印加帝国占领了阿根廷西北部，并纳入了一部分托诺科特人。萨纳维龙人是托诺科特人的一支，向西南扩展进入科尔多瓦山地，18世纪大体融入了殖民地居民。西班牙人征服图库曼后，比莱拉人东迁进入查科；1735年至1763年间，耶稣会在他们的土地上建立了三处传教站。

en:
The Warao, whose name means the boat people, live in the Orinoco Delta of northeastern Venezuela, where hundreds of streams and marshes make the canoe the main way to travel. Their houses stood on stilts above the water, and their food came mostly from the delta: fish, crabs in season, and the moriche palm, with some basic horticulture by about 1500.

Soon after Columbus reached the Orinoco delta, Alonso de Ojeda sailed up the river and saw the stilted Warao huts. Their resemblance to the water-houses of Sinamaica is said to have given Venezuela, little Venice, its name.
zh:
瓦劳人的名称意为“船民”，住在委内瑞拉东北部的奥里诺科河三角洲，那里溪流沼泽交错，独木舟是主要的交通工具。他们的房屋建在水面上的高脚桩上，食物主要取自三角洲：鱼、应季的螃蟹和莫里切棕榈，到1500年前后已有基本的园艺种植。

哥伦布到达奥里诺科河三角洲不久，阿隆索·德·奥赫达溯河而上，看到了瓦劳人的高脚屋。据说它们与锡纳马伊卡的水上房屋相似，使委内瑞拉（“小威尼斯”）得名。

en:
The Warpe, or Huarpe, were the farming people of the Cuyo region of central Argentina, at the foot of the Andes. They had lived in permanent villages of 50 to 100 people since the fifth century and grew maize, beans, squash and quinoa. By the fifteenth century their lands ran from the Jáchal River in the north to the Diamante River in the south, and they spoke the related Allentiac and Millcayac.

They were never fully part of the Inca Empire, but after about 1480 they adopted Inca llama herding and the Quechua language. Under Spanish rule, Chilean encomenderos who held grants in Cuyo took Huarpe workers across the Andes to Chile and hired them out to other Spaniards.
zh:
瓦尔佩人是阿根廷中部库约地区、安第斯山麓的农耕民族。自5世纪起，他们住在50至100人的固定村落里，种植玉米、豆类、南瓜和藜麦。到15世纪，他们的土地北起哈查尔河，南至迪亚曼特河，说相近的阿连蒂亚克语和米尔卡亚克语。

他们从未完全并入印加帝国，但1480年前后以后采用了印加人放牧美洲驼的做法和克丘亚语。西班牙统治下，在库约持有监护征赋制授地的智利监护主，把瓦尔佩人带过安第斯山运到智利，雇给没有授地的其他西班牙人。

en:
The Wendat, called Huron by the French, were an Iroquoian-speaking confederacy of four nations living in Wendake, between Georgian Bay and Lake Simcoe in what is now Ontario. Their palisaded longhouse villages held some 20,000 to 40,000 people. Their relatives the Tionontati, the French Petun or Tobacco, lived to the southwest.

Samuel de Champlain met them in 1615, and Atironta of the Arendarhonon had allied with the French at Quebec in 1609. From 1634 to 1640 measles and smallpox devastated them. Supplied with Dutch firearms, the Haudenosaunee began large attacks in 1647 and destroyed Wendake in 1649, scattering them. The refugees fled west to the Odawa and settled near Detroit around 1701 as the Wyandot.
zh:
温达特人是说易洛魁语的四部落联盟，法国人称之为休伦人，住在温达克，即今安大略省乔治亚湾与辛科湖之间。他们的村落有木栅围护，建有长屋，居民共约2万至4万人。他们的亲族提奥农塔特人，即法国人所称的彼特恩（意为“烟草”人），住在西南方。

1609年，阿伦达罗农部的阿蒂龙塔在魁北克与法国人结盟；1615年，塞缪尔·德·尚普兰与他们会面。1634年至1640年，麻疹和天花重创了他们。1647年，易洛魁人在荷兰火器的供应下发动大规模进攻，1649年摧毁温达克，温达特人与彼特恩人四散。难民西逃到奥达瓦人那里，1701年前后在底特律附近定居，成为怀恩多特人。

en:
The West African group includes the Mandinka, Songhai, Mossi, Hausa and Kanembu. Trade in gold and salt linked their lands to North Africa.

The Ghana Empire gave way to the Mali Empire in the thirteenth century, and its ruler Mansa Musa made a pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324. Songhai replaced Mali as the dominant power in the fifteenth century and fell to a Moroccan army in 1591. Portuguese traders reached the coast in the fifteenth century, opening the Atlantic slave trade.
zh:
西非文化组包括曼丁戈人、桑海人、莫西人、豪萨人和加奈姆布人。黄金和盐的贸易把他们的地区与北非联系起来。

加纳帝国之后，马里帝国在13世纪兴起，其君主曼萨·穆萨于1324年前往麦加朝圣。桑海在15世纪取代马里成为主导势力，并在1591年败于摩洛哥军队。葡萄牙商人在15世纪抵达沿海，开启了大西洋奴隶贸易。

official_raw.en: Despite being very diverse in terms of culture, language, and even religion, the people living in West Africa and the Sahel, all have a shared set of traits and characteristics, fueled by centuries of interactions among themselves. The relatively difficult-to-traverse terrains of the Sahara desert to the north and the forest and jungles to the south have promoted a more horizontal contact between peoples, creating this shared identity.
official_raw.zh: 尽管在文化、语言乃至宗教信仰方面存在显著差异，但西非与萨赫勒地区的人们却因几个世纪以来的密切互动，孕育出一系列共同的特质。这种独特身份认同的形成，得益于北部的撒哈拉沙漠与南部的茂密丛林所形成的天然屏障——这些相对封闭的地形反而促使当地居民展开了更为频繁的横向交流。

en:
The Xinka are a non-Maya people of the Pacific plain and highlands of southeastern Guatemala, in what is now Santa Rosa and Jutiapa. Their languages have no known relatives, though they borrowed many words from Mayan, and they may have lived there before the Maya and the Pipil arrived.

In 1524 Pedro de Alvarado crossed their country with 250 Spanish infantry and some 6,000 native allies, and took their chief city, Atiquipaque, near Taxisco, after fierce hand-to-hand fighting. The Xinka then paid tribute in cacao, cotton, salt and vanilla, and many were enslaved and made to join the conquest of El Salvador. After 1575 their culture and language declined rapidly as people were shipped to other regions.
zh:
辛卡人是危地马拉东南部太平洋平原和高地上的非玛雅民族，居住在后来的圣罗莎和胡蒂亚帕一带。他们的语言没有已知的亲属，虽然借用了许多玛雅语词汇；他们可能比玛雅人和皮皮尔人更早住在这里。

1524年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多率领250名西班牙步兵和约6000名原住民盟军穿过辛卡人的土地，经过激烈的白刃战，攻占了他们最重要的城市阿蒂基帕克，位置大致在塔克西科一带。此后辛卡人以可可、棉花、盐和香草纳贡，许多人被沦为奴隶，被迫参加征服萨尔瓦多的战事。1575年以后，随着人口被送往他处，他们的文化和语言迅速衰落。

en:
The Yaghan, also called Yamana, lived on the islands south of Tierra del Fuego along the Beagle Channel and around Cape Horn, the southernmost people in the world. They were nomads who moved between islands by canoe: the men hunted sea lions, the women dived for shellfish, and they also ate stranded whale meat, berries and mushrooms.

They lived in several local groups, such as the Wakimaala on both shores of the Beagle Channel. Their language was unrelated to those of the neighbouring Chono and Kawesqar canoe peoples, though they shared a similar way of life. Sailors in the early nineteenth century called them Fuegians, a name credited to James Weddell in 1822.
zh:
雅甘人又称亚马纳人，住在火地岛以南沿比格尔海峡和合恩角一带的岛屿上，是世界上最靠南的民族。他们是乘独木舟在岛屿之间迁移的游猎民：男子猎海狮，女子潜水采贝，也吃搁浅的鲸肉、浆果和蘑菇。

他们分成若干地方群体，如分布在比格尔海峡两岸的瓦基马拉人。他们的语言与邻近的乔诺人和卡韦斯卡尔人这两个乘舟民族完全不同，但生活方式相近。19世纪初，水手们称他们为火地人，这个名称据说是詹姆斯·韦德尔在1822年起的。

en:
The Yukaghir group gathers the Siberian hunting peoples who speak Yukaghir languages, centered on the basin of the Kolyma River. When Russians arrived in the 1600s, the Yukaghir tribes held land from the Lena to the mouth of the Anadyr, and included the Chuvans and the sedentary Anauls. They are thought to descend from the Neolithic Ymyyakhtakh culture.

They lived by following deer, moose, wild sheep and sable, and by fishing, and kept reindeer mostly for transport. Their dwelling was the conical chum. Their languages, Tundra and Kolyma Yukaghir, are of unknown origin. Epidemics, wars and Russian rule thinned their numbers, and many were absorbed by the Yakuts, Evens and Russians.
zh:
尤卡吉尔文化组汇集了说尤卡吉尔语的西伯利亚狩猎民族，中心在科累马河流域。17世纪俄国人到来时，尤卡吉尔诸部占据着从勒拿河到阿纳德尔河口的土地，其中有楚万人和定居的阿瑙尔人。一般认为他们是新石器时代伊米亚赫塔赫文化的后裔。

他们追逐驯鹿、驼鹿、野羊和紫貂，兼事捕鱼，饲养的驯鹿主要用于运输，住的是锥形的帐篷“楚姆”。他们的语言包括苔原尤卡吉尔语和科累马尤卡吉尔语，来源不明。疫病、战争和俄国统治使其人口减少，许多人被雅库特人、埃文人和俄罗斯人同化。

en:
The Yuki were a people of northern California, traditionally divided into three groups: the Ukomno'om, or Valley People, the Huchnom, or those outside the valley, and the Coast Yuki, or Ocean People. Their country took in Round Valley and much of what is now northern Mendocino and Lake counties.

They lived in conical houses of bark, grass and pine needles, with a large dance house, and kept to their own language, which stood apart from those of their neighbours. Their beliefs centred on Taikomol, the one who travels by himself, assisted by Coyote, and on mountain beings who could heal or sicken. Kroeber estimated that about 3,000 Yuki lived in 1770.
zh:
尤基人是加利福尼亚北部的民族，传统上分为三支：乌科姆诺奥姆人（山谷人）、胡奇诺姆人（谷外人）和沿海尤基人（海岸人）。他们的地域包括朗德谷和后来的门多西诺县北部、莱克县的大部分。

他们住在用树皮、草和松针搭成的圆锥形房屋里，还建有大型舞屋，使用自己的语言，与周围邻族的语言不同。他们的信仰以独行者泰科莫尔和他的助手郊狼为中心，也相信山中能治病也能致病的神灵。据克罗伯估计，1770年约有3000名尤基人。

en:
The Yupik group gathers the Eskimo and Aleut peoples of southwestern and southern Alaska, closely related to the Inuit. The Central Alaskan Yup'ik live on the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta and along Bristol Bay, with fish camps in summer and villages in winter; the Alutiiq, or Sugpiaq, live on Prince William Sound and the Kodiak Archipelago; and the Unangax, or Aleuts, live along the Aleutian Islands, numbering perhaps 25,000 before European contact.

Russian occupation of the Alutiiq country began in 1784, after Grigory Shelikhov's men killed hundreds of Sugpiat at Refuge Rock. By the early 1800s Kodiak held more than sixty Alutiiq villages. In the 1820s the Russian-American Company moved Aleut families to the Commander and Pribilof Islands.
zh:
尤皮克族群汇集了阿拉斯加西南部和南部的爱斯基摩人与阿留申人，他们与因纽特人关系密切。中阿拉斯加尤皮克人住在育空-库斯科奎姆三角洲和布里斯托尔湾沿岸，夏季住渔营、冬季住村落；阿卢蒂克人（又称苏格皮亚克人）住在威廉王子湾和科迪亚克群岛；乌南甘人（即阿留申人）沿阿留申群岛分布，在欧洲人到来之前约有2.5万人。

1784年，格里戈里·谢利霍夫的手下在避难岩屠杀了数百名苏格皮亚特人，俄国人随后占据阿卢蒂克人的土地。19世纪初，科迪亚克有六十多个阿卢蒂克村落。19世纪20年代，俄美公司把阿留申人家庭迁到科曼多尔群岛和普里比洛夫群岛。

en:
The Yuto-Nahua group gathers the peoples of the Uto-Aztecan language family in northern and western Mexico and the American Southwest: the Cuachichil, Zacatec and Caxcan of the central plateau, the Tepehuan, Yaqui and Raramuri of the northwest, and the Hopi of Arizona.

The Caxcan rose against the Spanish in the Mixton War of 1540 to 1542, and the Chichimeca War of 1550 to 1600 was the longest and costliest Spanish campaign on this frontier. The Yaqui, met by Diego de Guzmán in 1533, numbered some 30,000 in 80 villages and beat the Spanish in 1608. The Tepehuan rose in 1616 and were crushed by 1620.
zh:
犹他-纳瓦族群汇集了墨西哥北部和西部以及美国西南部说犹他-阿兹特克语系语言的民族：中部高原的夸奇奇特尔人、萨卡特卡人和卡什坎人，西北部的特佩万人、亚基人和拉拉穆里人，以及亚利桑那的霍皮人。

卡什坎人在1540年至1542年的米克斯顿战争中起兵反抗西班牙人；1550年至1600年的奇奇梅克战争，是西班牙人在这条边疆上打得最久、花费最大的一场战事。1533年迭戈·德·古斯曼遇到的亚基人约有3万人，分住80个村落，1608年击败了西班牙人。特佩万人在1616年起事，到1620年被镇压。

en:
The Zamuco group joins the Ayoreo and the Ishir, or Chamacoco, peoples of the Gran Chaco who speak Zamucoan languages, a small family of the northeastern Chaco in Paraguay and Bolivia. The Ayoreo lived between the Paraguay, Pilcomayo, Parapeti and Grande rivers, nomadic hunter-gatherers across both countries. The Ishir lived in Paraguay, the Ebytoso along the Paraguay River and the Tomaraho in the forests.

The Jesuits made the first contact with the Ayoreo when they founded the San Ignacio Zamuco mission in the 1720s to convert them to Catholicism. The mission was abandoned in the 1740s, and the Ayoreo were then left alone for a long time.
zh:
萨穆科族群包括阿约雷奥人和伊希尔人（即查马科科人），都是大查科地区说萨穆科诸语的民族；这个小语系分布在巴拉圭和玻利维亚的查科东北部。阿约雷奥人住在巴拉圭河、皮尔科马约河、帕拉佩蒂河和格兰德河之间，是跨两国游荡的狩猎采集者。伊希尔人住在巴拉圭，其中埃比托索人沿巴拉圭河居住，托马拉霍人住在森林里。

耶稣会士在18世纪20年代创建圣伊格纳西奥-萨穆科传教站，借此首次接触阿约雷奥人，试图使他们皈依天主教。传教站在18世纪40年代废弃，此后阿约雷奥人被长期放任不管。

en:
The Zuni are a Pueblo people of western New Mexico, descended from the Mogollon and Ancestral Pueblo cultures and living by irrigated farming. Their language is an isolate with no known relationship to any other Native American language.

In 1539 the Spanish expedition of Fray Marcos de Niza sent the slave Estevanico ahead, and the Zuni killed him as a spy. Before the Pueblo Revolt of 1680 they lived in six villages, and in the revolt they took refuge atop the mesa of Dowa Yalanne until 1692. Of their three Spanish missions only Halona was rebuilt after the reconquest, and by the late eighteenth century the Spanish had given up hope of dominating them.
zh:
祖尼人是新墨西哥西部的普韦布洛民族，源出莫戈永文化和祖先普韦布洛文化，以灌溉农业为生。他们的语言是孤立语言，与其他美洲原住民语言都没有已知的亲缘关系。

1539年，马科斯·德·尼萨修士的西班牙远征队先派奴隶埃斯特万尼科前行，祖尼人把他当作间谍杀死了。1680年普韦布洛起义之前，他们住在六个村落里；起义期间，他们到多瓦亚兰内台地顶上避难，直到1692年。他们的三处西班牙传教站中只有哈洛纳在重新征服后得到重建；到18世纪晚期，西班牙人已不再指望控制他们。

en:
The Banu Kanz were a semi-nomadic Muslim dynasty of Arab Banu Hanifa stock, mixed through marriage with the Beja Hadariba, dominating the frontier between Upper Egypt and Nubia from the tenth to fifteenth century. In 1006 their chief captured a rebel for the Fatimid caliph al-Hakim, who rewarded him with the hereditary title Kanz al-Dawla, Treasure of the State, giving the house its name.

In 1174 the Kanz al-Dawla Ibn al-Mutawwaj rose against Saladin in a failed bid to restore the Fatimids. In 1317 the Mamluk sultan imposed Barshanbu as king of Makuria, but the Kanz al-Dawla, nephew of the deposed King Karanbas, seized the crown and held it despite two Mamluk expeditions, the last in 1324.

The Kanz al-Dawla surrendered to Mamluk power in 1365. Sultan Barquq sent the Hawwara against them, and by the early fifteenth century the Hawwara had supplanted the Banu Kanz on the frontier.
zh:
巴努·坎兹是半游牧的穆斯林王朝，出身阿拉伯巴努·哈尼发部落，与贝贾人的哈达里巴部通婚融合，10世纪至15世纪称雄于上埃及与努比亚之间的边地。1006年，其首领替法蒂玛哈里发哈基姆擒获一名叛乱者，获赐可世袭的头衔坎兹·道拉，意为“国之宝库”，家族由此得名。

1174年，坎兹·道拉伊本·穆塔瓦吉起兵反对萨拉丁，企图复辟法蒂玛王朝，最终失败。1317年马穆鲁克苏丹把巴尔尚布扶上马库里亚王位，被废国王卡兰巴斯的侄子、时任坎兹·道拉却夺取王冠，并顶住两次马穆鲁克远征，最后一次在1324年。

坎兹·道拉于1365年向马穆鲁克投降。苏丹巴尔库克随后派豪瓦拉人对付他们，到15世纪初，豪瓦拉已取代巴努·坎兹成为边地之主。

en:
The House of Aberffraw takes its name from its royal court at Aberffraw on Anglesey. It was founded around 826 when Merfyn Frych, a ruler from the Isle of Man with a claim through his mother, seized Gwynedd; his son Rhodri Mawr built a Welsh hegemony.
