Restored after the Norman incursions by Gruffudd ap Cynan in 1098, the house reached its height under Llywelyn the Great and his grandson Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, recognised as Prince of Wales in 1267. Edward I's conquest ended its power: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd was killed in battle in 1282 and his brother Dafydd was executed at Shrewsbury in 1283, the last native prince to rule Gwynedd.

The family's claim lived on through exiled descendants, above all Owain Lawgoch, who campaigned against the English from France until his assassination in 1378.
zh:
阿伯弗劳家族的名字来自其在安格尔西岛上的王庭阿伯弗劳。约826年，出身马恩岛、凭借母系血统拥有继承权的梅尔芬·弗里奇夺取圭内斯，开创该王朝；其子罗德里大帝建立起对威尔士的霸权。

1098年，格鲁菲兹·阿普·南南在诺曼人入侵后恢复国势，家族在卢埃林大帝及其孙卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲兹治下达到鼎盛，后者于1267年被承认为威尔士亲王。爱德华一世的征服终结了家族统治：卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲兹于1282年战死，其弟大卫于1283年在什鲁斯伯里被处死，成为最后一位统治圭内斯的本土亲王。

家族的继承权由流亡后裔延续，其中著名的欧文·劳戈赫以法国为基地进攻英格兰，直到1378年遇刺身亡。

en:
The Abulafia are a Sephardic Jewish family whose Arabic-derived name, Abu l-Afiyya, took its medieval Spanish form under Muslim rule in Al-Andalus. From around 1200 the family supplied leaders to the Jewish community of Toledo and Castile.

Its most famous member was Samuel ben Meir Ha-Levi Abulafia, born around 1320, who rose at the court of Pedro I of Castile to royal treasurer and judge. He backed the king against Henry of Trastámara and built the Synagogue of El Tránsito in Toledo between 1355 and 1357, with Hebrew and Arabic inscriptions. Accused of embezzlement, he was imprisoned and tortured in 1360 and died in Seville the same year.

When the Catholic Monarchs issued the Alhambra Decree in 1492, the unconverted Abulafias left Spain like other Sephardim, resettling chiefly in the Ottoman Empire and Italy.
zh:
阿布拉菲亚是塞法迪犹太人家族，其姓氏源自阿拉伯语“阿布·阿菲亚”，在穆斯林统治安达卢斯时期演化为中世纪西班牙语形式。约1200年起，该家族不断出掌托莱多和卡斯蒂利亚的犹太社群。

最著名的成员是约1320年出生的撒母耳·本·迈尔·哈列维·阿布拉菲亚，他在卡斯蒂利亚国王佩德罗一世的宫廷升任王室司库兼法官。他支持国王对抗特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，于1355—1357年在托莱多修建埃尔·特兰西托犹太会堂，建筑上有希伯来语与阿拉伯语铭文。1360年他被控侵吞公款，遭囚禁拷打，同年死于塞维利亚。

1492年天主教双王颁布《阿兰布拉宫法令》后，未改宗的阿布拉菲亚家族与其他塞法迪人一样离开西班牙，主要迁居奥斯曼帝国和意大利。

en:
The Acciaioli were a Florentine noble and banking house whose line runs back to the twelfth century, when family legend brings them from Brescia to Florence as Guelph refugees from Frederick Barbarossa. In the thirteenth century they built a bank with branches from Greece to Western Europe, and its collapse in 1345 redirected their ambitions. Niccolò Acciaioli, sent to Naples in 1331, became Grand Seneschal of the kingdom and count of Melfi, amassed estates in the Morea and Corinth, and patronised Petrarch and Boccaccio.

In Greece the family reached for a crown: Nerio I Acciaioli seized Athens in 1388 and ruled the Duchy of Athens, which his house, after a brief Venetian interlude, held again from 1402 until the Ottoman conquest extinguished the last duke, Francesco II, in 1460.

In Florence, Bishop Angelo Acciaioli briefly governed the city after the fall of Gauthier de Brienne in 1343, and later Acciaioli allied first with the Albizzi and then with the Medici.
zh:
阿恰约利家族是佛罗伦萨的贵族与银行世家，世系可追溯到12世纪；据传先祖作为圭尔夫派信徒，为躲避腓特烈·巴巴罗萨而从布雷西亚逃到佛罗伦萨。13世纪他们创办的银行分行遍布希腊到西欧，1345年银行倒闭反而促使家族另谋出路。1331年被派往那不勒斯的尼科洛·阿恰约利后来官至王国大总管，受封梅尔菲伯爵，在摩里亚和科林斯广置领地，还庇护彼特拉克与薄伽丘。

在希腊，家族更进一步问鼎王座：内里奥一世于1388年夺取雅典，成为雅典公爵；其间虽有威尼斯人短暂入主，家族仍从1402年起重掌公国，直到奥斯曼人征服希腊，末代公爵弗朗切斯科二世于1460年败亡。

在佛罗伦萨本土，主教安杰洛·阿恰约利曾在1343年戈蒂埃·德·布里安倒台后短暂执政；后世族人先后与阿尔比齐和美第奇家族结盟。

en:
The Adhémar were a noble house of the Valentinois on the lower Rhône, whose castles included Grignan, Montélimar and La Garde. Their first famous son was Adhémar de Monteil, bishop of Le Puy, whom Pope Urban II named apostolic legate of the First Crusade: he fought at Dorylaeum and carried the Holy Lance during the breakout at Antioch, before dying of illness in 1098.

The family later supplied many clerics. Aymar Adhémar de Monteil de La Garde, son of Hugues, lord of Montélimar, became bishop of Metz in 1327; he feuded with the dukes of Lorraine, built the fortress of Château-Salins and stood with Metz when Count Eberhard II of Württemberg besieged it in 1350.

He made peace with Lorraine in 1358 and died at Metz in 1361. The line continued through a female branch as the Castellane-Adhémar, counts of Grignan, into the seventeenth century.
zh:
阿代马尔家族是罗讷河下游瓦朗蒂努瓦的贵族世家，城堡包括格里尼昂、蒙特利马尔和拉加尔德。家族最早的名人是勒皮主教阿代马尔·德蒙泰伊，教宗乌尔班二世任命他为第一次十字军的宗座使节：他在多里莱乌姆作战，在安条克突围时高举圣枪，最终于1098年病逝。

这个家族后来出过许多教士。蒙特利马尔领主于格之子艾马尔·阿代马尔·德蒙泰伊·德拉加尔格于1327年出任梅斯主教；他与洛林公爵争斗，修建萨兰堡要塞，1350年符腾堡伯爵埃伯哈德二世围攻梅斯时与城市并肩作战。

他于1358年与洛林和解，1361年在梅斯去世。家族后来通过女支延续为卡斯泰拉讷-阿代马尔家族，即格里尼昂伯爵，一直延续到17世纪。

en:
The Adorno were a patrician house of Genoa, first documented in 1186; trade along the Ligurian Riviera gave them their wealth. After the Boccanegra they led the Ghibelline popular faction and, with their rivals the Fregoso, dominated the age of the popular doges from 1339 to 1527.

Gabriele Adorno became the first doge of the house in 1363. His rule saw commercial treaties with Cyprus, Aragon and Portugal and stronger Genoese bases in the Crimea before a tax revolt drove him out in 1370. His kinsman Antoniotto I held the dogate four times between 1378 and 1396, and other Adorno doges followed.

The last was Antoniotto II, doge from 1522 to 1527. When Andrea Doria reformed the Genoese constitution in 1528, the Adorno and Fregoso were shut out of power and absorbed into the Pinelli albergo, ending their rivalry over the republic.
zh:
阿多尔诺家族是热那亚贵族世家，最早见于1186年的文书；他们沿利古里亚海岸积累财富。继博卡内格拉家族之后，他们领导吉伯林派平民阵营，与世仇弗雷戈索家族主导了1339—1527年的平民总督时代。

加布里埃莱·阿多尔诺于1363年成为家族第一位总督，任内与塞浦路斯、阿拉贡和葡萄牙缔结商约，强化热那亚在克里米亚的据点，最终在1370年因抗税暴动被逐。其族人安东尼奥托一世随后在1378—1396年间四度出任总督，此后还有其他阿多尔诺族人登位。

最后一位是1522—1527年任总督的安东尼奥托二世。1528年安德烈亚·多里亚改组热那亚政体时，阿多尔诺与弗雷戈索两族被排除出权力层，并入皮内利家族会馆，两族对共和国的争夺就此落幕。

en:
The Ahom dynasty was founded in 1228 by Sukaphaa, a Tai prince of Mong Mao, who crossed the Patkai hills into the Brahmaputra Valley and made Charaideo his capital in 1253. His descendants built a wet-rice kingdom on the upper Brahmaputra, absorbing Kamarupa lands and settlers into a state.

Under Suhungmung in the sixteenth century the kingdom reached its greatest expansion and the elite began converting to Hinduism. The dynasty repelled Mughal invasions: Mir Jumla sacked Garhgaon in 1662, but the Ahoms won at Saraighat in 1671 and fixed their western frontier at the Manas River after Itakhuli in 1682.

Gadadhar Singha founded the Tungkhungia branch, which ruled until the Moamoria rebellion shattered central authority after 1769. Burmese armies intervened from 1817, and the Treaty of Yandabo in 1826 handed Assam to the British East India Company, ending Ahom rule.
zh:
阿洪姆王朝由勐卯的傣族王子苏卡法于1228年开创。他越过帕特凯山脉进入布拉马普特拉河谷，于1253年定都查莱碉。其继承者在河流上游建立水稻农业王国，逐步吞并迦摩缕波旧地，将迁入者纳入国家。

16世纪苏洪蒙在位时王国版图达到极盛，统治精英也开始改宗印度教。王朝击退莫卧儿帝国的入侵：1662年米尔·朱姆拉攻陷加尔冈，1671年阿洪姆人在萨拉伊加特战役中取胜，1682年伊塔库利战役后西部边界定在玛纳斯河。

加达达尔·辛哈建立通昆吉亚支系，统治到1769年后摩亚马里亚叛乱使中央权威崩溃为止。1817年起缅甸军队入侵，1826年《杨达波条约》将阿萨姆割让给英国东印度公司，阿洪姆统治告终。

en:
The Aisu, also written Aiso in old records, were a medieval seafaring warrior clan of the Kii and Ise region; their genealogy was claimed from the Takeda line of the Seiwa Genji. They are said to have led a naval force in the Mongol Kōan campaign of 1281. The Ise branch held Gokasho Castle and, under the sway of the Kitabatake, joined trade missions to Ming China from 1451.

The clan's famed Aisu Hisatada, known as Ikōsai (1452-1538), founded the Kage-ryū school of swordsmanship after martial pilgrimage, traditionally including a voyage to Ming China. The swordsman Kamiizumi Nobutsuna was counted among his disciples.

His son Munemichi inherited the school and entered the service of Satake Yoshishige. After the destruction of the Kitabatake the Aisu also served the Satake and adopted the surname Hirasawa. When the Satake were transferred to Dewa after the Battle of Sekigahara in 1600, the Kage-ryū head house moved north with them.
zh:
爱洲氏（古记录中亦写作“爱曾”）是中世纪活跃于纪伊、伊势一带的海上豪族，谱系传为清和源氏武田氏之后。据说他们在1281年弘安之役中曾率领水军参战。伊势爱洲氏以五所城为本据，在北畠氏影响下自1451年起参与遣明贸易。

家族最著名的人物是爱洲久忠，号移香斋（1452—1538年），他历经诸国武者修行，据传还曾渡海前往明朝，最终开创剑术流派阴流。剑圣上泉信纲相传即其弟子。

久忠之子宗通继承流派，出仕佐竹义重。北畠氏灭亡后，爱洲一族也投奔佐竹氏并改姓平泽。1600年关原之战后佐竹氏被移封出羽，阴流本家随之迁往北方。

en:
The Akamatsu were a warrior clan of Harima Province, claiming Murakami Genji descent, who rose in the early fourteenth century. Their founder Norimura answered Prince Morinaga's call in 1331. He later backed Ashikaga Takauji, and his defence of Shirahata Castle pinned down Nitta Yoshisada's army, helping decide the Battle of Minatogawa in 1336. The house grew into shugo lords of Harima, Bizen and Mimasaka.

In 1441 Akamatsu Mitsusuke murdered Shogun Ashikaga Yoshinori at his own banquet; Yamana Sozen's army overran Harima and Mitsusuke killed himself. The house revived after its retainers recovered the imperial jewel from Southern Court partisans in 1457, and Masanori regained the three provinces through service in the Onin War.

Later invasions and the rise of Oda Nobunaga left the Akamatsu a minor family; their daimyo line ended on the losing side at Sekigahara in 1600.
zh:
赤松氏是播磨国的武家豪族，自称村上源氏后裔，在14世纪初发迹。始祖则村于1331年响应护良亲王举兵；后来他投靠足利尊氏，凭白旗城拖住新田义贞的大军，为1336年凑川之战立功。赤松家后来成为领有播磨、备前、美作三国的守护大名。

1441年，赤松满佑在自家宴席上刺杀将军足利义教，山名宗全率军攻灭播磨，满佑自尽。1457年赤松遗臣从南朝夺回神玺，家名得以复兴，政则在应仁之乱中效力，重新拿回三国守护之职。

此后入侵和织田信长的崛起使赤松家沦为小族，其大名世系最终在1600年关原之战因站错阵营而断绝。

en:
The Akana of Izumo were a branch of the Sawa clan of Iwami, who claimed descent from the Heian scholar Miyoshi no Kiyoyuki. Sawa Sanetsura's second son Tsunetsura became steward of Akana manor during the Nanboku-chō wars; the line took the place-name as its surname in Sawa Hiroyuki's time.

In 1518 the Akana swore allegiance to Amago Tsunehisa, while the Sawa chose the Ōuchi. In 1542 Ōuchi Yoshitaka besieged Akana Castle; the head Mitsukiyo held it for two months with Amago help before falling, whereupon his father Hisakiyo surrendered.

Mitsukiyo's third son Morikiyo became head and surrendered to Mōri Motonari in 1562. The Akana served the Mōri and the Kikkawa, fighting in Korea, until Motoyoshi took the surname Nakagawa in 1599; the family lived on as Chōshū retainers.
zh:
出云赤穴氏是石见国人佐波氏的分家，佐波氏自称是平安时代汉学者三善清行的后裔。南北朝时期，佐波实连的次男常连就任赤穴庄地头，到佐波弘行时取地名为姓。

1518年赤穴氏向尼子经久宣誓效忠，主家佐波氏却跟随大内氏。1542年大内义隆围攻赤穴城，当主光清得尼子援兵坚守两月后战死，其父久清开城投降。

光清的三子盛清继任家督，于1562年向毛利元就投降。此后赤穴氏作为毛利家臣跟随吉川氏转战，并参加朝鲜之役；1599年元奇改姓中川，后人以长州藩士身份延续。

en:
The Aki were local lords who ruled Aki district in eastern Tosa on Shikoku. Tradition makes them descendants of Soga no Akae, exiled to Tosa after backing Prince Ōtomo in the Jinshin War of 672. The Tale of the Heike names the Aki district chief Saneyasu, whose son Sanemitsu drowned at Dannoura in 1185.

The clan grew strong under the Hosokawa, governors of Tosa. After losses in the Ōnin War it recovered to rank among the seven great houses of Tosa, called Aki of the five thousand kan. Under Aki Kunitora it married into the Ichijō house and reached its height.

Kunitora's raids on Chōsokabe Motochika opened a feud. In 1569 the Aki army was crushed at Yaryūgawa, retainers opened Aki Castle to the enemy, and Kunitora killed himself; the clan was destroyed and its lands granted to Motochika's brother Kōsokabe Chikayasu.
zh:
安艺氏是统治四国土佐东部安艺郡的国人领主。传说其祖先是在672年壬申之乱中追随大友皇子、兵败后被流放土佐的苏我赤兄。《平家物语》提到安艺郡大领实康，其子实光在1185年坛之浦之战中投海而死。

安艺氏在土佐守护细川氏麾下势力壮大，应仁之乱受挫后再度复兴，跻身土佐七雄，号称安艺五千贯。到安艺国虎时，家族与土佐一条氏联姻，达到全盛。

国虎入侵长宗我部元亲的领地，两家结怨。1569年安艺军在矢流川合战中惨败，家臣内应打开安艺城，国虎自尽，安艺氏灭亡，旧领被封给元亲之弟香宗我部亲泰。

en:
The Akizuki were a warrior house of Chikuzen province in northern Kyushu, seated at Akizuki. Their original surname was Ōkura; they took the name Harada after Ōkura no Haruzane received an estate for helping suppress the Fujiwara no Sumitomo revolt. Harada Taneo settled at Akizuki around 1203 and took that name.

After the Kamakura collapse they fought Ashikaga Takauji at Tatarahama for the imperial court. In 1557 the lord Fumitaka turned to the Mōri and was killed with his heir by an Ōtomo army; his second son Tanezane restored the house under Mōri protection and allied with the Shimazu.

In 1587 Tanezane submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, surrendering his lands for Takanabe in Hyūga. After Akizuki Tanenaga changed to the eastern side at Sekigahara in 1600, the family survived as daimyo of Takanabe.
zh:
秋月氏是九州北部筑前国的武家，本据在秋月。本姓大藏，先祖大藏春实因平定藤原纯友之乱有功受封原田，家族遂称原田氏。原田种雄约于1203年入居秋月并改姓秋月。

镰仓幕府灭亡后，秋月氏在多多良滨属宫方，迎战足利尊氏。1557年当主文种倒向毛利氏，与嫡子一同被大友军攻杀；次子种实在毛利氏庇护下复兴家族，后又联合岛津氏。

1587年种实向丰臣秀吉投降，献出本领，移封日向高锅。1600年关原之战时秋月种长倒向东军，家族此后以高锅藩主的身份延续。

en: The Al-Abed were the local ruling family of Gafsa, the chief oasis town of the Djerid in southwestern Ifriqiya. In the Middle Ages the Djerid oases grew rich on trans-Saharan caravan trade and often stood apart under Ibadi leaders, so that under loose Hafsid overlordship a local house such as the Al-Abed could hold the town largely autonomously.
zh: 阿贝德家族是伊夫里奇亚西南部杰里德地区首要绿洲城镇加夫萨的地方统治家族。中世纪时，杰里德诸绿洲靠撒哈拉商队贸易致富，常在伊巴德派领袖治下自成一体；在哈夫斯王朝松散的宗主权下，阿贝德这样的地方家族得以高度自治地掌管该城。

en:
The Al 'Ali were a Bedouin ruling house of the Banu Rabi'ah, a junior line of the Al Fadl, descended from Ali ibn Haditha. They held the Ghouta oasis around Damascus, with their seat at Qutayfa. Under the later Ayyubids Ali and his son Abu Bakr held the office of amir al-arab, commander of the Bedouin.

When the Mamluks took Syria in 1260, the office passed to their Al Fadl kinsman Isa ibn Muhanna; Abu Bakr's brother Zamil revolted, was defeated and imprisoned in Cairo, while Abu Bakr's son Muhammad briefly held the emirate in the early 1290s.

Driven from the Hauran by the rival Al Mira in the mid-thirteenth century and overshadowed by their Al Fadl cousins, the Al Ali remained a power of the Damascus countryside. A fifteenth-century estimate credited them with two thousand horsemen.
zh:
阿里家族是贝都因统治家族，属于巴努·拉比阿，是法德勒部落的支系，为阿里·伊本·哈迪塞的后裔。他们占据大马士革的古塔绿洲，驻地在库泰法。阿尤布王朝末期，阿里与其子阿布·伯克尔先后担任统辖贝都因人的阿拉伯人异密。

1260年马穆鲁克人夺取叙利亚后，该职转入法德勒支族人伊萨·伊本·穆汉纳之手，阿布·伯克尔之弟扎米勒反叛，战败后被囚于开罗；阿布·伯克尔之子穆罕默德则在13世纪90年代初短暂接管异密公署。

13世纪中叶，敌对的米拉部把他们赶出哈夫兰，法德勒本支的势力也盖过了他们，但阿里家族仍是大马士革乡郊的一大势力。15世纪的一份估算称他们能出动两千骑兵。

en:
The Āl Faḍl were the leading Bedouin dynasty of the Syrian Desert, a branch of the Banu Rabiʿah of the Banu Tayy. Their forebear Faḍl ibn Rabiʿah was recorded as an emir by 1107, and the family rose by supplying cavalry against the Crusaders.

The Ayyubids gave them the office of amir al-ʿarab, commander of northern Syria's Bedouin tribes. After the Mamluk conquest in 1260, Isa ibn Muhanna made it hereditary; he led the tribal right wing against the Ilkhanate at the Second Battle of Homs in 1281. His sons kept the office through much of the fourteenth century.

Weakened by feuds, the Āl Faḍl kept their emirate under the Ottomans. In the mid-sixteenth century their leading house merged with the Mawali and became Al Abu Risha, while a rival branch retained the name in the Beqaa Valley.
zh:
法德勒家族是叙利亚沙漠首屈一指的贝都因王朝，出自巴努·塔伊的巴努·拉比厄支系。先祖法德勒·伊本·拉比厄在1107年已见载为埃米尔，家族因提供骑兵抗击十字军而兴起。

阿尤布王朝授予他们阿拉伯埃米尔一职，统帅北叙利亚的贝都因部落。1260年马穆鲁克征服后，伊萨·伊本·穆罕纳使该职位世袭；1281年第二次霍姆斯战役中，他率部落骑兵组成右翼迎战伊儿汗国。他的儿子在14世纪大部分时间里世袭此职。

家族因内斗衰落，奥斯曼人仍保留其世袭埃米尔之位。16世纪中叶，其主支并入马瓦利部落，改称阿布·里沙家族，另一支竞争者则在贝卡谷地沿用法德勒之名。

en:
The Al Mira were a Bedouin dynasty of the Hauran in southern Syria, a branch of the Banu Rabi'ah of the Tayy. Their ancestor Mira and his brother Fadl served the Damascus atabegs against the Crusaders.

After the Mamluk conquest, the emir Ahmad ibn Hajji made his tribe kings of the Bedouin of the Hauran and Transjordan, driving out the Al Fadl. Baybars allowed them virtual independence from the amir al-arab, and a decree of 1333 charged their emir with guarding the frontier and Hajj routes.

Around 1389 Anqa ibn Shati joined a revolt against Sultan Barquq and was killed by the Assassins soon after. During Timur's invasion of 1400 to 1401 the tribe seized the Hauran harvest, provoking a Mamluk raid. After the Ottomans conquered Syria in 1516, the rising Sardiyya eclipsed them in the Hauran.
zh:
米拉家族是南叙利亚哈夫兰的贝都因王朝，属塔伊部的巴努·拉比阿支系。先祖米拉与兄弟法德勒曾为大马士革的阿塔贝格效力，抗击十字军。

马穆鲁克征服后，异密艾哈迈德·伊本·哈吉使本族成为哈夫兰和外约旦的贝都因诸王，逐出法德勒部。拜伯尔斯准许米拉部几乎不受阿拉伯人异密节制；1333年的敕令规定其异密须守卫边境和朝觐道路。

约1389年，安盖·伊本·沙提加入反对苏丹巴尔库克的叛乱，不久被阿萨辛派杀死。1400—1401年帖木儿入侵期间，该部夺取哈夫兰的粮收，招致马穆鲁克突袭。1516年奥斯曼人征服叙利亚后，兴起的萨尔迪耶部落在哈夫兰盖过了米拉部。

en:
The degli Albizzi were a Florentine patrician house that came from Arezzo in the twelfth century and made its fortune in wool, finance and land. In the faction fights of the 1360s they led the patricians against the Ricci.

After the Ciompi revolt, Maso degli Albizzi emerged in 1382 as head of an oligarchy that ruled Florence for half a century. He rolled back the Ciompi reforms and organised the conquest of Pisa in 1406. His son Rinaldo secured the banishment of Cosimo de' Medici in 1433, but was himself exiled when Cosimo returned in 1434. Rinaldo's brother Luca sided with the Medici and stayed in Florence. The family later included Giovanna degli Albizzi Tornabuoni, portrayed by Ghirlandaio.
zh:
德利·阿尔比齐家族是12世纪从阿雷佐迁入佛罗伦萨的贵族世家，靠羊毛、放贷和地产发家。14世纪60年代的党派斗争中，他们率领贵族派对抗里奇家族。

梳毛工起义后，马索·德利·阿尔比齐于1382年成为寡头政权的首脑，这一政权统治佛罗伦萨达半个世纪。他废除了梳毛工时代的改革，并策划了1406年对比萨的征服。其子里纳尔多于1433年放逐科西莫·德·美第奇，但1434年科西莫归来后，他自己反被流放。里纳尔多之弟卢卡站在美第奇一边，留在佛罗伦萨。后世族人还有被吉兰达约绘入画中的乔瓦娜·德利·阿尔比齐·托尔纳博尼。

en:
The House of Albon, also called the Guigonides after the many counts named Guigues, was a great feudal family of the county of Vienne in the Dauphiné, first recorded at Albon in the tenth century and raised to comital rank in the eleventh. From their castle of Albon they built a compact principality between the Rhône and the Alps, and Count Guigues IV, who died in 1142, bore the nickname Dauphin, the Dolphin, which became the title Dauphin of Viennois for his successors and gave the region its later name.

The senior line ended in 1228 with Béatrice of Albon, whose marriage carried the dauphinate to the Capetian dukes of Burgundy. A younger branch ruled the county of Forez and survived until 1372.

The last Burgundian dauphin, Humbert II, under financial pressure sold the Dauphiné to Philip VI of Valois by the treaty of Romans in 1349, after which the title passed to the eldest sons of France's kings.
zh:
阿尔邦家族又名吉格家族，因多位伯爵取名吉格而得名，是多菲内维埃纳伯国的大封建家族，10世纪已见于阿尔邦镇的记载，11世纪取得伯爵头衔。他们以阿尔邦城堡为中心，在罗讷河与阿尔卑斯山之间建起一片紧凑的领地；1142年去世的吉格四世绰号“海豚”，这个绰号后来固定为继承人“维埃努瓦多菲纳”的头衔，该地区也由此得名多菲内。

长支于1228年因阿尔邦的贝阿特丽斯而绝嗣，她的婚姻把多菲纳领地并入卡佩系的勃艮第公爵一系。旁支统治福雷伯国，延续到1372年。

末代勃艮第系多菲纳安贝尔二世因财政困窘，于1349年依《罗芒条约》把多菲内卖给瓦卢瓦的腓力六世，此后这一头衔由法国国王的长子世代承袭。

en:
The Álvarez de Albornoz were a Castilian hidalgo family from the mountains of Cuenca, holders of the lordship of Albornoz. The fourth lord Garci married into the Carrillo family, and their son Gil was born around the end of 1302.

Gil became Archbishop of Toledo in 1338 and fought the Marinid invasion at Río Salado in 1340. Made a cardinal in 1350, he entered papal service. From 1353 Pope Innocent VI sent him to Italy, where his campaigns reconquered most of the Papal States and his Constitutiones Sanctae Matris Ecclesiae regulated their government until 1816.

He founded the College of Saint Clement at Bologna in 1364 and died in 1367. The family lordship passed to later generations, while its fame in this age rested almost entirely on the cardinal.
zh:
阿尔瓦雷斯·德·阿尔沃诺斯是卡斯蒂利亚昆卡山区的伊达尔戈贵族家族，世袭阿尔沃诺斯领主权。第四代领主加尔西与卡里略家族联姻，儿子希尔于1302年底前后出生。

希尔于1338年出任托莱多大主教，1340年在萨拉多河抗击马林王朝入侵。1350年他升任枢机主教，转入教廷任职。1353年起，教宗英诺森六世派他前往意大利，他征战收复教皇国的大部分领土，其《圣母教会宪章》规范行政，沿用到1816年。

1364年他在博洛尼亚创办圣克莱门特学院，1367年去世。家族领主之位由后代承袭，这个时代的名望则几乎全系于这位枢机。

en:
The House of d'Albret took its name from the lordship of Albret in the Landes of Gascony, where it was established in the ninth century. Vassals of English Aquitaine, the family supported the English cause at the start of the Hundred Years' War before transferring its allegiance to France.

Arnaud Amanieu, Lord of Albret, helped the French reconquer Guienne, and his son Charles was killed commanding the French army at Agincourt in 1415. In 1470 the family inherited Périgord and Limoges. Alain the Great's son John became King of Navarre in 1484 by marrying Queen Catherine of Foix, but the Spanish invasion of 1512 left them only Lower Navarre.

Jeanne d'Albret, Queen of Navarre and the last of the line, married Anthony of Bourbon and was the mother of Henry IV, who carried the Albret inheritance into the French crown.
zh:
德·阿尔布雷家族得名于加斯科涅朗德的阿尔布雷领地，早在9世纪便已定居于此。家族是英属阿基坦的封臣，百年战争之初支持英格兰，随后转而效忠法兰西。

阿尔布雷领主阿尔诺·阿马尼厄协助法军收复吉耶讷，其子夏尔于1415年在阿金库尔指挥法军时战死。1470年家族继承佩里戈尔和利摩日。“伟人”阿兰之子让于1484年娶纳瓦拉女王富瓦的卡特琳，成为国王；1512年西班牙入侵后，家族只保住下纳瓦拉。

末代成员纳瓦拉女王让娜·德·阿尔布雷嫁给波旁的安托万，生下亨利四世，阿尔布雷的遗产随之并入法兰西王冠。

en:
The Alidosi were a noble family of Romagna from the Santerno valley, who built their power around Imola. In the thirteenth century they backed the Guelphs against the Ghibellines, and Lippo I Alidosi held Imola as de facto lord from 1278.

In 1341 Pope Benedict XII enfeoffed Lippo II Alidosi with the city as pontifical vicar, beginning a formal signoria. The family lost Imola in 1424 when Filippo Maria Visconti of Milan seized it, and withdrew to the Apennine lordship of Castel del Rio.

The family's most famous later member, Cardinal Francesco Alidosi, councillor of Pope Julius II, was accused of treason and murdered in 1511 by the Duke of Urbino's men. The Alidosi held Castel del Rio until 1638, when Pope Urban VIII drove them out.
zh:
阿利多西家族是罗马涅的贵族世家，发源于萨泰尔诺河谷，以伊莫拉城为中心建立势力。13世纪圭尔夫派与吉伯林派争斗时，他们支持圭尔夫派，利波一世从1278年起成为伊莫拉的实际领主。

1341年，教宗本笃十二世将伊莫拉作为教宗代理人封地授予利波二世，正式开启家族的领主统治。1424年，米兰的菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂攻占伊莫拉，家族退入亚平宁山区的卡斯特尔德尔里奥领地。

家族后来最著名的成员是枢机主教弗朗切斯科·阿利多西，他是教宗儒略二世的谋臣，被控叛国后于1511年被乌尔比诺公爵的随从杀死。家族据守卡斯特尔德尔里奥直到1638年，最终被教宗乌尔班八世逐走。

en:
The Almohad dynasty, also called the Mu'minids, ruled a Berber caliphate from Marrakesh. It grew out of the preaching of Ibn Tumart, a Masmuda Berber recognized as the Mahdi around 1121, who built his base at Tinmel in the Atlas Mountains. After his death his follower Abd al-Mu'min took power in 1130, overthrew the Almoravids and captured Marrakesh in 1147, founding the caliphal line.

By 1159 the Almohads held the Maghreb, and by about 1172 they ruled Muslim Iberia from Seville. Their court raised monuments including the Giralda of Seville.

Defeat at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 broke their power in Spain, while the Marinids advanced in the Maghreb. Reduced to Marrakesh, the last caliph Idris al-Wathiq was killed when the Marinids stormed the city in 1269, ending the dynasty.
zh:
穆瓦希德王朝又称穆米宁王朝，是定都马拉喀什的柏柏尔哈里发政权。它源于马斯穆达柏柏尔人伊本·图马特的传教：他约于1121年被奉为马赫迪，在阿特拉斯山区廷梅尔建立据点。他死后，弟子阿卜杜勒·慕敏于1130年掌权，推翻穆拉比特王朝并于1147年攻占马拉喀什，开创哈里发世系。

1159年穆瓦希德人已控制马格里布，约1172年以塞维利亚为中心统治穆斯林伊比利亚。其朝廷留下塞维利亚吉拉达塔等建筑。

1212年拉斯纳瓦斯·德·托洛萨之战的惨败动摇了他们在西班牙的统治，马林王朝则在马格里布进逼。末代哈里发伊德里斯·瓦西格退守马拉喀什，1269年马林王朝破城时被杀，王朝终结。

en:
The House of Alsace, also called the House of Châtenois, was an Ardennes branch centred on Metz and the Moselle valley. In 1048 Emperor Henry III granted Upper Lorraine to Adalbert of Metz and then his brother Gerard, whose descendants held it until Duke Charles II died in 1431.

A younger son of the ducal house, Thierry of Alsace, won the County of Flanders in 1128; a Second Crusade veteran, he died in 1168. His sons Philip and Matthew, the latter marrying the Countess of Boulogne, extended the family's power to the North Sea, his daughter Margaret's marriage carrying Flanders to the counts of Hainaut in 1194.

The Vaudémont cadet branch recovered the duchy in 1473 and ruled until 1737, and the House of Guise became a leading force in the French Wars of Religion. The last duke, Francis of Lorraine, married Maria Theresa of Austria in 1736, founding the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, which supplied Holy Roman emperors until 1806.
zh:
阿尔萨斯家族又名沙特努瓦家族，是阿登家族支系，以梅斯和摩泽尔河谷为中心。1048年，皇帝亨利三世把上洛林公国先封给梅斯的阿达尔贝特，又转封其弟热拉尔，热拉尔的后代保有公国，直到1431年查理二世公爵去世。

家族幼支的阿尔萨斯的蒂埃里于1128年取得佛兰德斯伯国；他参加过第二次十字军东征，1168年去世。他的儿子腓力和马修——后者娶了布洛涅女伯爵——把家族势力延伸到北海，女儿玛格丽特的婚姻则在1194年把佛兰德斯带入埃诺伯爵一系。

洛林的沃代蒙旁支于1473年收复公国并统治到1737年，吉斯家族一支则在法国宗教战争中领导天主教阵营。末代公爵洛林的弗朗茨于1736年迎娶奥地利的玛丽亚·特蕾西亚，开创哈布斯堡-洛林家族，世代出任神圣罗马帝国皇帝，直到1806年帝国解体。

en:
The lords of Altenburg were a Thuringian ministerialis family holding the imperial burgraviate of Altenburg in the Pleissnerland, which Emperor Frederick II had pledged to the Wettin margraves of Meissen in 1243. Burgrave Dietrich II died in 1303 and was succeeded by his son Albrecht IV, who died without male heirs in 1329.

Another son, Dietrich von Altenburg, had entered the Teutonic Order in 1307. He became Grand Marshal in 1331, led the Order's war against Poland, and was elected Grand Master in 1335.

He rebuilt the order's castles and completed the Chapel of Saint Anne and the first permanent bridge over the Nogat at Marienburg. He died at Thorn in 1341 while negotiating with Poland and was the first grand master buried in the chapel, the last of his family line.
zh:
阿尔滕堡领主是图林根的侍臣家族，世袭普莱斯纳兰的阿尔滕堡帝国城堡伯爵；皇帝腓特烈二世于1243年把普莱斯纳兰抵押给迈森的韦廷藩侯。城堡伯爵迪特里希二世卒于1303年，其子阿尔布雷希特四世继位，1329年无男性子嗣而亡。

另一个儿子迪特里希·冯·阿尔滕堡于1307年加入条顿骑士团，1331年升任大元帅，指挥骑士团对波兰的战争，1335年当选大团长。

他大修骑士团城堡，在马林堡建成圣安娜礼拜堂和诺加特河上第一座固定桥梁。1341年他在与波兰谈判期间卒于托伦，成为第一位葬入该礼拜堂的大团长，也是家族最后一人。

en:
The Andō were a warrior house of northern Japan who claimed descent from the Heian rebel Abe no Sadatō. From the early Kamakura period an Andō head handled Ezo affairs in Tsugaru; by the late thirteenth century the clan served the Hōjō as Ezo deputies, overseeing trade with the Ainu.

A family feud and an Ezo uprising known as the War of the Andō weakened the house, which split into the Hiyama and Minato branches. In the sixteenth century Andō Chikasue reunited them and took the surname Akita, from Akita Port and the hereditary title Akita jō-no-suke.

His son Sanesue won the Minato succession quarrel in 1587 but had his lands cut back by Toyotomi Hideyoshi. Under the Tokugawa the family moved to Miharu in Mutsu, remaining tozama daimyō through the Edo period.
zh:
安东氏是日本北部的武家，自称是平安时代叛将安倍贞任的后裔。镰仓初期，安东家首领在津轻负责虾夷事务；13世纪末，他们为北条氏出任虾夷沙汰代官，统辖与阿伊努人的贸易。

家族内讧和虾夷武装起义安藤氏之乱使家业中衰，一族分裂为檜山和凑两家。16世纪，安东爱季合并两家，以秋田港及世袭的秋田城介官职改姓秋田。

其子实季在1587年的继承纷争凑骚动中胜出，封地却被丰臣秀吉削减。德川幕府时期，秋田家转封陆奥三春，作为外样大名延续于江户时代。

en:
The Anenokōji were a Kyoto court-noble house of the Fujiwara Hokke, named for the avenue where Fujiwara no Naritoki built his residence in the tenth century. In the 1330s Anenokōji Ietsuna of a cadet branch became governor of Hida; his descendants kept the office before splitting into three houses.

The Hida disturbance of 1411 brought a shogunate army against them. In the Sengoku age the Miki family absorbed the clan and took its name in 1560, ruling Hida until Kanamori Nagachika overran the province in 1585.

A separate senior court-noble line had died out in the early Muromachi period and was revived in 1613 by Ano Saneaki's son Kinkage. It made court precedent its hereditary calling, and in 1760 an imperial order joined its genealogy to the older line.
zh:
姊小路家是藤原北家的京都公家，得名于藤原济时在10世纪营建宅邸的姊小路。14世纪30年代，支族姊小路家纲出任飞驒国司，后代世袭此职，后来分裂为三家。

1411年飞驒之乱招来幕府军讨伐。战国时代，三木氏同化该族，于1560年改用姊小路之姓，统治飞驒，直到1585年金森长近攻灭该国。

另有嫡流公家一支在室町初期断绝，1613年由阿野实显之子公景再兴，以研究朝廷典章为家业。1760年天皇下令将这一支的系谱与古老的一支合并。

en:
The Capetian House of Anjou, or Anjou-Sicily, was a Capetian cadet branch founded by Charles, youngest son of Louis VIII. Enfeoffed with Anjou and Maine in 1246, he married Provence's heiress and, with papal backing, defeated Manfred of Hohenstaufen at Benevento in 1266 and took Sicily, confirming it at Tagliacozzo in 1268. The 1267 Treaty of Viterbo opened his way into the Balkans; in 1272 he proclaimed himself King of Albania around Durazzo.

The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 drove him from Sicily to Naples. A younger line secured Hungary, where Charles Robert was crowned as Charles I in 1301 and his son Louis inherited Poland in 1370. In 1337 Robert the Wise ruled Naples and Charles I Hungary.

Later decades saw Andrew of Hungary's 1345 murder and Queen Joanna I's Hungarian wars. The Durazzo branch produced Charles III, king of Naples and Hungary, then Joanna II, whose 1435 death ended the senior line. Naples passed to Rene of Valois-Anjou and in 1442 to Alfonso V of Aragon.
zh:
安茹-西西里王朝是法国卡佩王室支系，由路易八世的幼子安茹的查理一世创立。他1246年受封安茹和曼恩，又娶普罗旺斯女继承人；在教宗支持下，1266年在贝内文托击败霍亨斯陶芬家族的曼弗雷迪，夺取西西里王国，1268年塔利亚科佐之战后巩固征服。1267年《维泰博条约》打开巴尔干门户，1272年他在都拉佐一带自立为阿尔巴尼亚国王。

1282年西西里晚祷使他被逐出西西里本岛，退居那不勒斯王国。家族一支在匈牙利立足：卡洛·罗贝托1301年加冕为匈牙利国王卡罗伊一世，其子拉约什一世1370年继承波兰王位。1337年智者罗贝托治那不勒斯，卡罗伊一世治匈牙利。

此后1345年匈牙利的安德烈遇害，乔万娜一世又与匈牙利诸王交战。都拉佐支系出了身兼两国王位的卡洛三世和乔万娜二世；乔万娜二世1435年去世，长支断绝。那不勒斯先由瓦卢瓦-安茹的勒内继承，1442年落入阿拉贡国王阿方索五世之手。

en:
The Ano were a court-noble house of Kyoto, a junior branch of the Shigenoi family within the Northern Fujiwara Kan'in line. Their founder Fujiwara no Kinsuke married the heiress of Ano Zenjō, lord of the Ano manor in Suruga; the manor's name became the family name.

The house rose through the imperial bedchamber: its fifth head served Emperor Go-Daigo, and his sister Renshi became the emperor's consort and mother of Emperor Go-Murakami. The family was bound to the Southern Court through the Nanboku-chō split. After the courts reunited in 1392, it kept a middle rank until successive early deaths left it without an heir and the line lapsed for about half a century.

Saneaki, a grandson of the last lord, revived the house and in 1612 reached Provisional Major Counselor. The family passed the Edo period with court music and ceremonial lore as its hereditary arts.
zh:
阿野家是京都的公家，属藤原北家闲院流滋野井家的庶流。始祖藤原公佐娶骏河国阿野庄领主阿野全成的女儿，阿野庄成为家名的由来。

阿野家靠后宫因缘发迹：第五代当主出仕后醍醐天皇，妹妹廉子入侍天皇并生下后村上天皇，家族在南北朝分裂时代效忠南朝。1392年南北朝合一后，他们保持中等公家的地位，直到当主接连早逝、无嗣，家门中断约半世纪。

末代当主之孙实显复兴家名，于1612年升至权大纳言。江户时代，阿野家以宫廷音乐与有职故实为家业。

en:
The degli Antelminelli were a Ghibelline noble family of Lucca. Their greatest figure was Castruccio Castracani, exiled with his family by the Black Guelphs in 1300. He became a condottiero under the Pisan lord Uguccione della Faggiuola, fighting at Lucca in 1314 and Montecatini in 1315.

After Uguccione turned on him, a Lucchese revolt freed him, and in 1316 he was elected lifelong consul of Lucca. Made imperial vicar by Frederick of Austria in 1320, he crushed the Florentines at Altopascio in 1325, was named duke of Lucca and other cities, and took Pisa in 1327. His death in 1328 ruined his young heirs, and the family lost control of Lucca but survived there.

In 1596 its members were tried for treason; Alessandro Antelminelli escaped to London, lived as Amerigo Salvetti and served as Tuscan envoy.
zh:
德利·安泰尔米内利是卢卡的吉伯林派贵族世家。家族最杰出的人物卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼于1300年随家人被黑党圭尔夫派放逐，后来成为比萨领主乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉麾下的雇佣军队长，参加了1314年卢卡和1315年蒙特卡蒂尼的战斗。

乌古乔内与他反目后，卢卡民众起事使他获释；1316年，他当选卢卡终身执政官。1320年他被奥地利的腓特烈任命为帝国代理人，1325年在阿尔托帕肖大败佛罗伦萨人，受封卢卡等地的公爵，1327年拿下比萨。他于1328年去世，年幼的继承人失势，家族失去对卢卡的控制，但仍在城中存续。

1596年家族成员被控叛国，亚历山德罗·安泰尔米内利逃往伦敦，化名阿梅里戈·萨尔韦蒂，后来出任托斯卡纳使节。

en:
The Apokaukos family is attested in Byzantine service from the tenth to the fifteenth century. Its earliest known member was Basil Apokaukos, strategos of the Peloponnese around 990. Its greatest figure, Alexios Apokaukos, rose from a humble Bithynian background through the fiscal bureaucracy to become imperial chamberlain in 1321 and commander of the navy under Andronikos III in 1341.

Once the protégé of John Kantakouzenos, Alexios joined the regency faction when the civil war began in 1341 and became urban prefect of Constantinople. In June 1345 he was lynched by political prisoners while inspecting a new prison, and the family's influence collapsed with the regency's cause.

George Apokaukos was still recorded as archon at Constantinople in 1403. After the city fell to the Ottomans in 1453 Demetrios Kyritzes Apokaukos entered the service of Sultan Mehmed II.
zh:
阿波卡夫科斯家族有记载的拜占庭仕途从10世纪延续到15世纪。已知最早的成员是约990年任伯罗奔尼撒将军的瓦西里·阿波卡夫科斯。家族最显赫的人物阿历克塞·阿波卡夫科斯出身比提尼亚寒门，从财税官僚一路升迁，1321年任宫内大臣，1341年在安德洛尼卡三世治下成为海军大都督。

阿历克塞本是约翰·坎塔库齐诺斯的门生，1341年内战爆发时却转投摄政阵营，出任君士坦丁堡市长。1345年6月，他在视察一座新监狱时被政治犯私刑处死，家族势力也随摄政阵营的失势衰落。

1403年仍有一位乔治·阿波卡夫科斯在君士坦丁堡任执政官。1453年城市落入奥斯曼之手后，季米特里奥斯·基里齐斯·阿波卡夫科斯转投苏丹穆罕默德二世麾下。

en:
This branch of the Roman Orsini family built its fortunes on the Ionian Islands and in Epirus. Around 1195 Matthew Orsini succeeded the Sicilian admiral Margaritus of Brindisi as count of Cephalonia and Zakynthos; his descendant John I married an Epirote princess and gained Leukas as her dowry.

In 1318 Nicholas Orsini murdered his uncle Thomas Komnenos Doukas, seized southern Epirus, adopted Orthodoxy and received the Byzantine title of despot. His brother John II killed him in 1323 and lost Cephalonia in 1324, but ruled Epirus until his death, probably by poison, in 1335.

John II's son Nikephoros II inherited amid a regency, but Emperor Andronikos III ended Epirote independence in 1337 and 1338. Nikephoros briefly recovered his inheritance between 1356 and 1359, when he fell fighting the Albanians at Achelous. The island county passed to the Tocco family in 1357.
zh:
这支罗马奥尔西尼家族的支系在伊奥尼亚群岛和伊庇鲁斯起家。1195年前后，马泰奥·奥尔西尼继西西里海军将领布林迪西的马加里托之后成为凯法利尼亚和扎金索斯伯爵；后人乔瓦尼一世娶伊庇鲁斯公主，以嫁妆得到莱夫卡达岛。

1318年，尼科洛·奥尔西尼杀死舅父托马斯·科穆宁·杜卡斯，夺取南伊庇鲁斯，皈依东正教并接受拜占庭的专制公封号。他于1323年被弟弟乔瓦尼二世所杀，后者于1324年失去凯法利尼亚，但仍统治伊庇鲁斯，直到1335年疑似被毒杀。

乔瓦尼二世之子尼基弗鲁斯二世在摄政中继位，但皇帝安德洛尼卡三世于1337—1338年攻灭伊庇鲁斯的独立地位。尼基弗鲁斯在1356—1359年短暂恢复祖业，最终于1359年在阿刻罗俄斯河与阿尔巴尼亚人作战时阵亡。群岛伯国于1357年转归托科家族。

en:
The Arghunids were the family of the Mongol amirs Arghun Aqa, his son Nawrūz and his grandson Arghun Shah, who led the Ja'un-i Qurban, a Mongol military tribe in Khorasan. After the Ilkhanate collapsed in 1335, Arghun Shah became the chief supporter and commander of the claimant Togha Temür, ruling from Nishapur over Tus, Mashhad and the Atak frontier.

In 1337 he crushed the Jalayirid-backed governor Muhammad Mulai, but the Sarbadars seized Nishapur in 1340 and forced him back to Tus. Arghun Shah died in 1345 or 1346; his son Muhammad Beg abandoned Togha Temür and allied with the Sarbadars. The tribe later submitted to Timur around 1381 and joined the failed revolt of Hajji Beg at Tus in 1389.
zh:
阿儿浑家族是蒙古异密阿儿浑·阿合、其子捏兀鲁思及其孙阿儿浑沙的家族，阿儿浑沙统领着呼罗珊的蒙古军事部落乔尼·库尔班。1335年伊利汗国瓦解后，阿儿浑沙成为汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的主要支持者和军队统帅，以内沙布尔为中心统治图斯、马什哈德和阿塔克边境地带。

1337年，他击败了札剌亦儿人扶植的长官穆罕默德·穆莱；但萨尔巴达尔人于1340年夺取内沙布尔，把他逼回图斯。阿儿浑沙死于1345或1346年，其子穆罕默德·别吉背弃脱合帖木儿，转而与萨尔巴达尔人结盟。该部落后来于约1381年臣服帖木儿，并在1389年参与了哈吉·别吉在图斯发动的失败叛乱。

en:
The Arianiti were an Albanian noble family whose lands covered the Shkumbin valley and the Via Egnatia in central Albania. Alexius Arianiti, the first securely attested medieval member, swore allegiance to Charles I of Naples in 1274. From the fourteenth century the family also used the surname Komneni.

The family's greatest figure, Gjergj Arianiti, won victories over Ottoman armies from 1430, and his kin joined the League of Lezhe in 1444. The family left in 1450, but Skanderbeg married Gjergj's daughter Donika in 1451. Another daughter, Angelina, married the Serbian despot Stefan Brankovic and was later venerated as a saint.

As the Ottomans closed in, some Arianiti converted to Islam and entered Ottoman service, while the sons of Gjergj's Italian marriage withdrew to Italy. The male line died out in the mid-sixteenth century.
zh:
阿里亚尼蒂是阿尔巴尼亚的贵族世家，领地覆盖阿尔巴尼亚中部的什昆宾河谷与埃格纳提亚大道。中世纪第一位确凿可考的成员阿历克塞·阿里亚尼蒂于1274年向那不勒斯的查理一世宣誓效忠。14世纪起，家族还兼用科穆宁这一姓氏。

家族最杰出的人物乔治·阿里亚尼蒂从1430年起多次击败奥斯曼军队，族人于1444年加入莱什联盟。1450年家族退出联盟，但斯坎德培在1451年娶乔治之女多妮卡为妻。另一女安格琳娜嫁给塞尔维亚专制公斯特凡·布兰科维奇，后来被尊为圣徒。

随着奥斯曼人逼近，一部分族人改宗伊斯兰教、进入奥斯曼体系，乔治与意大利妻子所生的儿子们则退往意大利。男系于16世纪中叶断绝。

en:
The Arima of Hizen were a warrior house from the Arima estate in Hizen province on Kyushu. Tradition derives them from Fujiwara no Sumitomo, but they were more probably descendants of the Taira stewards of the Fujitsu estate. Arima Tsunezumi received the estate's jitō office in the early thirteenth century and took its name.

His descendant Harunobu became a Christian daimyo. In 1582 he joined Ōtomo Sōrin and Ōmura Sumitada in sending the Tenshō embassy to Europe; he later submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587 and kept lands around Hinoe Castle.

Harunobu kept his lands after Sekigahara but was exiled and executed in the Okamoto Daihachi affair of 1612. His son Naozumi inherited the domain; the family later moved to Maruoka in 1695, ruling there through the Edo period.
zh:
肥前有马氏是兴起于九州肥前国有马庄的武家。家传自称出自藤原纯友，实际更可能是藤津庄庄司平氏的后人。13世纪初有马经澄受任有马庄地头，遂以有马为姓。

后裔有马晴信成为吉利支丹大名。1582年他与大友宗麟、大村纯忠共同派出天正遣欧使节；1587年向丰臣秀吉称臣，保住日野江城一带的领地。

关原之战后晴信的封地得到安堵，却在1612年的冈本大八事件中被流放并处死。其子直纯继承遗领；家族后来于1695年移封丸冈，统治当地直至江户时代结束。

en:
The counts of Armagnac were a Gascon house at Auch between the Adour and Garonne. The county was carved from Fezensac in 960, and after the 1229 Treaty of Meaux it was Gascony's strongest fief. John I, ruling from 1319 to 1373, enlarged it by marriage and purchase, adding Rodez and Carlat.

Ceded to England with Aquitaine by the 1360 Treaty of Brétigny, Armagnac found the Black Prince's taxes unbearable, and in 1369 its count submitted to Charles V. Bernard VII, who died in 1418, married his daughter to the Duke of Orléans and led the royal party against the Burgundians; the faction came to be called the Armagnacs. Civil war lasted until 1435, and his veterans fought as mercenaries in the Armagnac War in Switzerland in 1444.

John V resisted Louis XI and was killed at the siege of Lectoure in 1473; on the last count's death in 1497 the house lost its lands, joined by Henry IV to the royal domain in 1607.
zh:
阿马尼亚克伯爵是加斯科涅的伯爵世家，驻于阿杜尔河与加龙河之间的欧什。伯国960年从费藏萨克分出，1229年《莫城条约》后成为加斯科涅最强大的封邑。1319至1373年在位的让一世通过联姻和购买扩充家产，并入罗德兹、卡尔拉两个伯国。

1360年《布雷蒂尼条约》把阿马尼亚克随阿基坦割让给英格兰，黑太子的重税令人难以忍受，伯爵遂于1369年转投查理五世。1418年去世的贝尔纳七世把女儿嫁给奥尔良公爵，率王党对抗勃艮第派，整个王党因此被称为“阿马尼亚克派”。内战打到1435年，他麾下老兵以雇佣兵身份参加1444年入侵瑞士的“阿马尼亚克战争”。

让五世对抗路易十一，1473年在勒克图尔围城战中被杀；1497年末代伯爵死后家族失去领地，亨利四世于1607年把阿马尼亚克并入王室领地。

en:
The Counts of Arnsberg grew out of the Counts of Werl, who moved their seat to a castle above the Ruhr at Arnsberg around 1080. When the old Werl line died out in the twelfth century, the county passed through the heiress Jutta to Godfrey I of the House of Cuyk.

Hemmed in by Mark and Cologne, his successors lost Rietberg to a kinsman in 1237 and cleared forests and founded towns in the Sauerland. In 1337 Count William ruled, followed by his son Godfrey IV, while a younger son of the house, Godfrey of Arnsberg, served as Bishop of Osnabrück from 1321 to 1349.

As Godfrey IV remained childless, he sold the county to the Archdiocese of Cologne in 1368; its lands became the core of the Cologne Duchy of Westphalia, and the Arnsberg eagle entered Westphalia's arms.
zh:
阿恩斯贝格伯爵家族源自韦尔尔伯爵，后者在1080年前后把驻地迁到鲁尔河畔阿恩斯贝格的城堡。12世纪韦尔尔老系断绝后，伯国经女继承人尤塔转入屈克家族的戈特弗里德一世手中。

在马克和科隆的夹逼下，后继者于1237年把里特贝格割给宗亲，转而在绍尔兰垦荒建城。1337年在位的是威廉伯爵，之后由其子戈特弗里德四世继位；家族幼子戈特弗里德·冯·阿恩斯贝格则在1321—1349年任奥斯纳布吕克主教。

戈特弗里德四世无嗣，于1368年把伯国卖给科隆大主教区，其领地成为科隆治下威斯特伐利亚公国的核心，阿恩斯贝格之鹰也被收入威斯特伐利亚的纹章。

en:
The Capetian House of Artois began in 1237, when Louis VIII of France gave Artois to his son Robert. Robert I died at Mansurah during the Seventh Crusade. His son Robert II was killed at the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302.

The succession passed to his daughter Mahaut against the claim of her nephew Robert III, convicted of forging his father's will and exiled in 1332. Robert took refuge with Edward III of England and urged his claim to the French throne, helping bring on the Hundred Years' War. Philip VI cited Edward's protection of Robert when he confiscated Guyenne in 1337.

Robert died of wounds after the retreat from Vannes in 1342. Artois passed through Mahaut's heiresses to the dukes of Burgundy in 1384 and was ceded to France by the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659.
zh:
卡佩系的阿图瓦家族始于1237年：法兰西国王路易八世把阿图瓦赐给儿子罗贝尔。罗贝尔一世在第七次十字军东征中在曼苏拉战死，其子罗贝尔二世于1302年在金马刺战役中阵亡。

爵位传给其女马奥，她的侄子罗贝尔三世主张继承权失败，又因伪造父亲遗嘱获罪，于1332年被流放。罗贝尔投奔英格兰国王爱德华三世，怂恿他争夺法国王位，成为百年战争的诱因之一。腓力六世1337年没收吉耶讷时，给出的理由正是爱德华收留罗贝尔。

罗贝尔1342年从瓦讷撤退后因伤死去。阿图瓦经马奥的女继承人于1384年转入勃艮第公爵之手，依1659年的《比利牛斯条约》割让给法兰西。

en:
The Artuqids were a Turkoman dynasty of the Oghuz Döger tribe, named after Artuk Bey, a Seljuk general who governed Jerusalem from 1086 until his death in 1091. Expelled from Jerusalem by the Fatimids in 1098, his sons Sökmen and Ilghazi carved out principalities in Upper Mesopotamia and northern Syria, ruling from Hasankeyf, Harput, Mardin and at times Aleppo.

Ilghazi crushed the Principality of Antioch at the Battle of Ager Sanguinis in 1119. The Hasankeyf and Harput lines fell to the Ayyubids and the Seljuks of Rum in the thirteenth century, but the Mardin branch endured as a vassal of the Ayyubids, Ilkhanids, Timurids and Qara Qoyunlu.

In 1337 the Mardin ruler was as-Salih Mahmud, who reigned from 1312 to 1364. The line ended when the Qara Qoyunlu seized Mardin in 1409 and deposed the last Artuqid bey, Ahmad.
zh:
阿图克王朝是出自乌古斯突厥德格尔部的土库曼王朝，得名于塞尔柱将领阿尔图克贝伊，他1086年起出任耶路撒冷总督，1091年去世。他的儿子索克曼和伊尔加齐1098年被法蒂玛王朝逐出耶路撒冷后，在上美索不达米亚和叙利亚北部建立割据政权，先后以哈桑凯伊夫、哈尔普特、马尔丁为都，并一度统治阿勒颇。

伊尔加齐于1119年在萨尔马达之战中大破安条克公国。哈桑凯伊夫和哈尔普特两支于13世纪先后被阿尤布王朝和罗姆塞尔柱人攻灭，马尔丁支系则存续下来，相继臣服于阿尤布王朝、伊儿汗国、帖木儿王朝和黑羊王朝。

1337年在位的是1312—1364年统治马尔丁的萨利赫·马哈茂德。1409年黑羊王朝攻占马尔丁，废黜末代贝伊艾哈迈德，王朝遂告终结。

en:
The Aryacakravarti dynasty ruled the Jaffna Kingdom on the Jaffna Peninsula in northern Sri Lanka from the thirteenth to the seventeenth century. The family first appears in records between 1277 and 1283 through a military leader in Pandyan service, who raided western Sri Lanka and carried off the Buddha's tooth relic from the Sinhalese capital of Yapahuwa; the dynasty's court chronicles claimed descent from Tamil Brahmins of the Rameswaram temple.

Jaffna became a Pandyan feudatory in 1258 and gained independence early in the fourteenth century, when Malik Kafur overthrew the Pandyas of Madurai. Around 1450 the Kotte kingdom under Parakramabahu VI conquered Jaffna, which recovered its freedom in 1467.

After the Portuguese reached Sri Lanka in 1505 the kings alternated between war and treaties. The last ruler, Cankili II, was defeated in 1617 and the kingdom was annexed in 1619, ending the dynasty.
zh:
阿梨耶遮迦罗跋帝王朝在13至17世纪统治斯里兰卡北部贾夫纳半岛上的贾夫纳王国。该家族最早见于1277—1283年的记载，当时一位同名将领在潘地亚军中效力，劫掠斯里兰卡西部，并从僧伽罗都城亚帕胡瓦夺走佛牙舍利；其宫廷编年史自称出身于拉梅斯沃勒姆神庙的泰米尔婆罗门。

贾夫纳于1258年成为潘地亚的附庸，14世纪初马利克·卡富尔推翻马杜赖的潘地亚统治者后获得独立。约1450年，科提王国在波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世治下攻占贾夫纳，1467年当地恢复独立。

1505年葡萄牙人来到斯里兰卡后，诸王在交战与订约之间周旋。末代君主桑吉利二世于1617年战败，王国在1619年被吞并，王朝告终。

en:
The Asakura were a samurai clan whose home was Asakura in Tajima Province, where in the late Heian period Kusakabe Munetaka first took the Asakura name. A branch entered Echizen in the Nanboku-chō wars, serving the Shiba and becoming one of their deputy-governor houses.

In the Ōnin War the seventh head Asakura Toshikage switched from the western to the eastern camp in 1471, overcame the rival Kai family, united Echizen and built Ichijōdani Castle; his seventeen-article house code made him the first Sengoku daimyō of the line. The Asakura then ruled Echizen and campaigned into neighbouring provinces.

The eleventh head Yoshikage sheltered the fugitive shōgun Ashikaga Yoshiaki but refused to march on Kyoto. His wars with Oda Nobunaga alongside the Azai ended in defeat at Anegawa in 1570 and the burning of Ichijōdani in 1573, when Yoshikage killed himself. A branch served the Tokugawa as hatamoto.
zh:
朝仓氏是但马国朝仓地方的武家，平安末期日下部宗高始称朝仓氏。南北朝时代，支流进入越前，出仕斯波氏，成为其守护代家族之一。

第七代当主朝仓孝景在应仁之乱中于1471年由西军转投东军，击败争权的甲斐氏，平定越前，修筑一乘谷城，并颁布分国法《朝仓敏景十七条》，成为朝仓家的初代战国大名。此后朝仓氏统治越前，还屡次出兵邻国。

第十一代当主义景收留了流亡的将军足利义昭，却不肯奉其上洛。他与浅井氏联手对抗织田信长，最终在1570年姊川之战中战败，1573年一乘谷城被焚毁、义景自尽。一支以江户幕府旗本身份存续。

en:
The Asayama were a warrior house based at the Asayama estate in Kandori district, Izumo Province, tracing their lineage to the early Heian period and claiming Otomo descent, later bearing the court-granted surname Katsube. A Kamakura head already appears in documents from shogunal prince Hisaaki and regent Hojo Sadatoki, and Katsube Masatsuna helped fund the rebuilding of Izumo Taisha in 1242 and was appointed its guards officer, emon-no-jo.

Asayama Kagetsura served Ashikaga Takauji in the Nanboku-cho wars and was rewarded with stewardships in Hoki and Izumo; his son Yoshikage received more Izumo estates from Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiakira after kinsmen died in battle. Through Muromachi times the house combined court guard titles with Izumo landholding, until Asayama Toshitsuna became a retainer of Amago Tsunehisa in the early sixteenth century.

With the family's home district wasted by the Sengoku wars, Oda Nobunaga in the 1580s settled them in Yamashiro Province near Kyoto; in 1601 Asayama Yukitsuna became a northern guard of Emperor Go-Yozei, and from 1612 the house served the Kujo nobility as hereditary stewards.
zh:
朝山氏是以出云国神门郡朝山乡为据点的武家，谱系可追溯到平安时代早期，自称出自大伴氏，后来受赐胜部姓。镰仓时代当主已见于将军久明亲王和执权北条贞时的奉书；1242年，胜部昌纲为出云大社营造出资，被任命为右卫门尉。

南北朝时，朝山景连出仕足利尊氏，凭战功受封伯耆、出云两国地头职；其子义景在族人战死后，又从将军足利义诠处得到出云国内多处领地。室町时代该家兼具朝廷武官头衔与出云领地，16世纪初朝山利纲成为尼子经久的家臣。

由于故乡在战国兵乱中荒废，织田信长于16世纪80年代将其安置到京都附近的山城国；1601年朝山幸纲成为后阳成天皇的北面武士，1612年起世代担任公卿九条家的家司。

en:
The Asen dynasty founded the Second Bulgarian Empire at Tarnovo, ruling it from 1185 to 1280. Brothers Peter and Ivan Asen I revolted over Byzantine taxes in 1185, restoring Bulgarian independence. Ivan Asen was murdered in 1196 and Peter in 1197, leaving youngest brother Kaloyan on the throne.

A papal legate crowned Kaloyan in 1204, and in 1205 he captured Latin emperor Baldwin I at Adrianople before dying in 1207. After Boril, Ivan Asen II returned in 1218, blinded his rival and brought Bulgaria to its height: his 1230 victory over Theodore Komnenos Doukas at Klokotnitsa opened Macedonia and Thrace, the patriarchate restored in 1235. His 1241 death began a long decline.

In 1280 Ivan Asen III fled Ivaylo's revolt for Constantinople, where he had married Irene Palaiologina, Michael VIII's daughter. Descendants became a leading Byzantine house: Andronikos Asen governed the Morea from 1316, Irene Asanina was empress to John VI Kantakouzenos from 1347, branches carrying the name to Theodoro and Moldavia.
zh:
阿森王朝以特尔诺沃为都建立第二保加利亚帝国，统治于1185至1280年间。1185年，彼得和伊凡·阿森一世兄弟起义反抗拜占庭加税，重建保加利亚独立。伊凡·阿森1196年遇害，彼得1197年遇刺，幼弟卡洛扬遂登位。

1204年教皇使节为卡洛扬加冕；1205年他在阿德里安堡生擒拉丁皇帝鲍德温一世，1207年死去。博里尔之后，伊凡·阿森二世1218年回国，刺瞎对手，把保加利亚推向鼎盛：1230年在克洛科特尼察击败塞奥多雷·科穆宁·杜卡斯，马其顿和色雷斯尽入版图，1235年牧首区恢复。他1241年去世后国势长期衰落。

1280年伊凡·阿森三世为躲避伊瓦伊洛起义逃往君士坦丁堡，他此前已娶米哈伊尔八世之女伊琳娜·巴列奥略。后代成为拜占庭一流望族：安德洛尼卡·阿森1316年起治理摩里亚，伊琳娜·阿萨尼娜1347年成为约翰六世·坎塔库齐诺斯的皇后，另有支系把阿森之名带到狄奥多罗、摩尔达维亚等地。

en:
The Ashikaga, a Seiwa Genji Minamoto branch, took their name from their Ashikaga manor in Shimotsuke Province, where Minamoto no Yoshiyasu settled in the 1100s; his son Yoshikane married Hojo Tokimasa's daughter, becoming a leading Kamakura vassal. When the main Minamoto line died out, they claimed its headship.

In 1333 Ashikaga Takauji helped Emperor Go-Daigo overthrow the Hojo regime, but by 1336 turned against the Kenmu Restoration, set up a Northern Court in Kyoto and took the shogunal title. The Northern and Southern Courts war ended in 1392 with the Southern Court submitting to Shogun Yoshimitsu. Yoshimitsu built the Flower Palace in Muromachi, Kyoto, giving the shogunate its other name; Zen culture and licensed Ming trade flourished under him.

Branch houses included the Hosokawa, Imagawa and Hatakeyama; a rival Kamakura branch, the Kanto kubo, fell in 1439. The 1467 Onin War shattered shogunal authority and opened the Sengoku age; in 1573 Oda Nobunaga drove out the last shogun Yoshiaki, ending Ashikaga rule.
zh:
足利氏出自源氏清和源氏，因12世纪源义康定居下野国足利庄而得姓；其子义兼迎娶北条时政之女，成为镰仓幕府有力御家人。源氏嫡流断绝后，足利氏以源氏首领自居。

1333年足利尊氏协助后醍醐天皇推翻北条政权，1336年便背弃建武新政，在京都另立北朝并就任征夷大将军，南北朝动乱直至1392年南朝向将军义满投降。义满在京都室町街营建花之御所，室町幕府由此得名，治下禅宗文化兴盛，对明勘合贸易繁荣。

足利氏分出细川、今川、畠山等名门支流，盘踞镰仓的关东公方一系则于1439年被攻灭。1467年应仁之乱摧毁幕府权威，揭开战国时代；1573年织田信长驱逐末代将军义昭，足利统治告终。

en:
The Ashina were a Taira-descended warrior house sprung from the Miura clan of Sagami, taking their name from Ashina in Miura district, where their castle stood. The Aizu line began when Miura Yoshiaki's seventh son Sawara Yoshitsura received Aizu for his part in the Ōshū campaign of 1189; his grandson Mitsumori first took the name Ashina.

The clan peaked under Ashina Moriuji, but his death in 1580 opened a succession crisis: his adopted heir Moritaka was murdered in 1584, the infant Kameōmaru died two years later, and the house adopted Ashina Yoshihiro, son of the Satake lord Yoshishige.

In 1589 Date Masamune crushed Yoshihiro at the Battle of Suriagehara and overran Aizu. Yoshihiro fled to Hitachi and became a Satake retainer; his line ended with the child Sentsurumaru, while the retainer branch Hariu revived the Ashina surname in 1676.
zh:
芦名氏是出自相模国三浦氏的平氏流武家，得名于三浦郡的芦名，芦名城即建于此。会津一支源于1189年的奥州合战，三浦义明的第七子佐原义连因功受封会津，其孙光盛始称芦名。

当主芦名盛氏时家族达到鼎盛，但盛氏1580年去世后继嗣危机接踵而来：养子盛隆1584年遇刺，幼主龟若丸两年后夭折，最后迎立佐竹义重之子芦名义广。

1589年，伊达政宗在摺上原之战中大破义广、吞并会津。义广逃往常陆，后来成为佐竹家臣；其嫡流随幼主千鹤丸夭折而断绝，家臣针生氏一支则于1676年恢复芦名旧姓。

en: The Asil are named after Khajeh Asil al-Din, one of the independent emirs who ruled Qom in the fourteenth century after the collapse of the Ilkhanate; his tomb in the city's Green Dome Garden is dated 1359 and stands beside that of Khajeh Ali Safi of the same ruling house, dated 1389. The game presents the family as Qom's dynasty.
zh: 阿西尔家族得名于火者阿西尔丁，他是伊儿汗国崩溃后14世纪割据库姆的独立异密之一；其位于库姆绿穹顶花园的陵墓建于1359年，旁边是同一家族的火者阿里·萨菲之墓（1389年）。游戏将该家族处理为库姆的本地王朝。

en:
The Ascanians, or House of Anhalt, began as Ballenstedt counts in the Harz, documented from 1036; their names derive from Aschersleben, Latinized Ascania, and Anhalt Castle. The house's great figure, Albert the Bear, was duke of Saxony from 1138 to 1142 and first Brandenburg margrave from 1150, leading German colonization of the former Slavic Nordmark.

After Henry the Lion fell, the 1180 Gelnhausen charter gave the eastern remnant of Saxony to Albert's son Bernhard. The 1212 and 1296 divisions split off Anhalt and divided Saxony into Wittenberg and Lauenburg. Wittenberg gained hereditary electoral dignity in the 1356 Golden Bull, but died out in 1422, Electoral Saxony passing to Wettins; the Brandenburg line ended in 1320 with Henry the Child, Emperor Louis IV granting the mark to his son.

The Lauenburg line fell to the Welfs in 1689. From 1252 Anhalt spawned principalities such as Bernburg and Dessau, rulers taking ducal rank in 1806 and 1807. In 1337 Ascanian electors, dukes and princes held lands from the Elbe to the Harz.
zh:
阿斯坎尼家族又称安哈尔特家族，最初是哈茨山的巴伦施泰特伯爵，1036年已有文献可考；家族两个名称分别来自阿舍斯莱本（拉丁化为阿斯坎尼亚）和安哈尔特城堡。家族最显赫的人物是“熊”阿尔布雷希特：1138至1142年任萨克森公爵，1150年成为首任勃兰登堡藩侯，推动德意志人向昔日斯拉夫人的北方马克殖民。

狮子亨利倒台后，1180年盖尔恩豪森诏书把萨克森东部残余封给阿尔布雷希特之子伯恩哈德。1212年和1296年两次分家分出安哈尔特，并把萨克森分为维滕堡、劳恩堡两支。维滕堡凭1356年金玺诏书获世袭选帝侯地位，1422年绝嗣，选帝侯萨克森落入韦廷家族；勃兰登堡支系1320年因“孩童”亨利之死断绝，皇帝路德维希四世把藩侯领地封给亲生儿子。

劳恩堡支系延续到1689年，转入韦尔夫家族。安哈尔特祖产1252年起一再分封，繁衍出贝恩堡、德绍等小邦，统治者1806和1807年晋升公爵。1337年，家族的选帝侯、公爵和诸侯仍在易北河到哈茨山之间领有众多封地。

en:
The Aso were a warrior and shrine family of Higo Province, hereditarily holding the office of high priest of Aso Shrine. They traced their line to the ancient Aso provincial governors and to Takeiwatatsumi no Mikoto, a grandson of the legendary Emperor Jimmu. The first verifiable head, Korenobu, built a warrior band around the Aso valley by the early twelfth century.

In the Nanboku-cho wars the Aso fought for the Southern Court: Koretoki joined the 1333 attack on the Rokuhara deputies and the clan was defeated with the Kikuchi at Tatara-hama in 1336. Rival Southern and Northern Court high-priest lines divided the house until 1484.

When the Shimazu overran Higo in 1585 the Aso domain collapsed and the infant head Koremitsu fled into the mountains. Toyotomi Hideyoshi later restored the family only as shrine priests, and under the Tokugawa it survived as a shrine house.
zh:
阿苏氏是肥后国的武家兼社家，世代担任阿苏神社大宫司。其家系自称上承古代的阿苏国造，更远可追溯到传说中神武天皇之孙健磐龙命。首位可考证的当主惟宣在12世纪初已在阿苏一带结成武士团。

南北朝战乱中阿苏氏效忠南朝：惟时参加了1333年攻打六波罗探题的行动，1336年又随菊池氏在多多良滨战败。此后家族分裂为南朝、北朝两派大宫司，直到1484年才重新统一。

1585年岛津军攻入肥后，阿苏领国崩溃，年幼的当主惟光逃入深山。丰臣秀吉后来只恢复其神社宫司地位，江户时代阿苏氏以社家身份存续。

en:
The Asonuma were a branch of the Fujiwara-descended Ashikaga house of Shimotsuke Province, founded by Hirotsuna, who took his name from the Asonuma estate. During the Genpei War they followed Minamoto no Yoritomo, and Hirotsuna became a Kamakura gokenin.

His service in the Oshu campaign of 1189 won him the stewardship of the Tono estate in Mutsu, inherited by his younger son Chikatsuna, who built Yokota Castle. The Shimotsuke main line eventually became retainers of the Sano clan. In 1334 the Tono head Tomotsuna had his holdings confirmed by the Southern Court general Kitabatake Akiie.

In 1590 the Tono head Hirosato was reduced to vassal status under the Nanbu for failing to appear at Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign. In 1600 kinsmen revolted while his heir Hironaga was away and drove him out, extinguishing the Tono main line; a branch in Aki Province lived on as retainers.
zh:
阿曾沼氏是下野国藤姓足利氏的分流，始祖为广纲，他以阿曾沼领地为苗字。源平合战时阿曾沼氏追随源赖朝，广纲成为镰仓御家人。

1189年奥州合战的军功使他受封陆奥远野保的地头职，由次子亲纲继承，亲纲修筑横田城。留在下野的嫡流最终沦为佐野氏家臣。1334年远野当主朝纲的领地得到南朝将领北畠显家的安堵。

1590年远野当主广乡因未参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，被降为南部氏家臣。1600年继承人广长出征时，留守一族叛乱，将他驱逐，远野嫡流就此断绝；安芸国的分流则作为家臣存续。

en:
The Aspenäs family was a high noble house of Östergötland, named by later historians after its seat at Aspenäs and documented from the thirteenth century. Its earliest known ancestor Filip married Cecilia Knutsdotter of the House of Bjelbo, daughter of the Swedish jarl Knut Birgersson, which gave the family royal blood through the female line.

Filip's sons Johan and Birger Filipsson joined the third Folkung uprising of 1278 to 1280 against King Magnus Ladulås and were beheaded at the Great Square in Stockholm in 1280 after its defeat. Later generations served as knights, lawspeakers and members of the council of the realm, and the line ended with Erik Laurensson, who was buried in 1445.
zh:
阿斯彭奈斯家族是东约特兰的高级贵族世家，后世史家以阿斯彭奈斯庄园为它命名，可考历史始于13世纪。已知始祖菲利普娶瑞典雅尔克努特·比耶松之女、比耶尔博家族的塞西莉亚·克努茨多塔为妻，家族由此通过母系获得王室血统。

菲利普之子约翰·菲利普松和比耶尔·菲利普松参加了1278—1280年反对国王马格努斯·拉杜洛斯的第三次福尔孔叛乱，失败后于1280年在斯德哥尔摩大广场被斩首。其后裔历任骑士、法律发言人和国政会议成员，家族最终随着1445年下葬的埃里克·劳伦松而绝嗣。

en:
The House of Astarac was a Gascon lineage descended from the old Gascon dukes. Around 920 Duke Garcia II divided his lands among his sons; the youngest, Arnold Nonnat, received the new county of Astarac, hills between Armagnac and Comminges.

Its counts joined the Holy Land Crusade as early as 1099 and leaned to the Cathar cause in the thirteenth century, but the county never matched neighbouring Armagnac, and the family married only within the lesser Gascon nobility. Founded as a bastide in 1280, Mirande became its capital in 1297. In 1337 the line still ruled from Mirande, styling itself count by the grace of God until 1442.

The dynasty lasted into the sixteenth century: Count John IV died in 1511 leaving only daughters, the county passing through his heiress Marthe to her husband Gaston III of Foix-Candale. Foix-Candale later carried it into the Nogaret de La Valette family, the crown selling it to Roquelaure. A younger branch, Montlezun and Pardiac lords, survived until 1677.
zh:
阿斯塔拉克家族是加斯科涅的封建世系，出自古老的加斯科涅公爵。约920年，加西亚二世公爵把土地分给诸子，幼子阿诺德（人称“非降生者”）得到新设的阿斯塔拉克伯国，即夹在阿马尼亚克、科曼日等地之间的丘陵地带。

其伯爵1099年便参加前往圣地的十字军，13世纪又倾向清洁派，但伯国始终未能比肩邻国阿马尼亚克，联姻也只限于加斯科涅小贵族。米朗德新城1280年建立，1297年成为伯国首府。1337年家族仍以米朗德为中心统治，直到1442年都自称“蒙神恩的伯爵”。

王朝延续到16世纪：伯爵让四世1511年去世，只留下女儿，伯国经女继承人玛尔特转给丈夫富瓦-康达尔的加斯东三世。富瓦-康达尔家族后来把它带入诺加雷·德·拉瓦莱特家族，最后王室将其卖给罗克洛尔家族。旁支蒙特勒赞-帕尔迪亚克一支延续到1677年。

en:
The Audleys were a marcher family named after Audley in Staffordshire, where their ancestor Adam de Alditheley held land in the twelfth century. Henry de Audley founded the Cistercian abbey at Hulton in 1223 and made Heleigh Castle the family seat while commanding royal castles on the Welsh border.

His descendants acquired the lordship of Kemes by marriage, and Nicholas Audley of Heleigh became the first Baron Audley in 1313. His son James married a daughter of Roger Mortimer, Earl of March, and died in 1386. When James's son Nicholas died without issue in 1391, the title fell into abeyance and passed to the Tuchet family in 1408.

A younger branch rose with Hugh Audley of Stratton Audley, created Earl of Gloucester in 1337. The earldom died with him in 1347 and his heiress married into the Staffords.
zh:
奥德利家族是边境领主世家，得名于斯塔福德郡的奥德利，其先祖亚当·德·阿尔迪瑟利12世纪时在当地持有领地。亨利·德·奥德利于1223年创立西多会的霍尔顿修道院，把黑利城堡作为家族主宅，同时统辖威尔士边境的王家城堡。

他的后代通过联姻取得凯梅斯领地，黑利的尼古拉斯·奥德利于1313年成为第一代奥德利男爵。其子詹姆斯娶马奇伯爵罗杰·莫蒂默之女为妻，1386年去世。詹姆斯之子尼古拉斯于1391年无嗣而终，爵位进入搁置状态，1408年转入塔切特家族。

旁支的斯特拉顿奥德利的休·奥德利于1337年受封格洛斯特伯爵。该伯爵爵号随他1347年去世而废止，其女继承人嫁入斯塔福德家族。

en:
The Auvergne counts emerged in the later tenth century as Carolingian authority in Aquitaine faded, holding lands around Clermont and Riom hereditarily from about 980. Around 1155 William VIII the Old seized most of it from nephew William VII, splitting off the Auvergne dauphinate.

The main line kept the county, and Robert V inherited Boulogne on the Channel in the thirteenth century. In 1332 the inheritance fell to the child countess Joan I, who in 1350 married King John II as his second wife and became queen consort. On her 1360 death both lands passed briefly to her son Philip of Rouvres, duke of Burgundy, then to Joan's uncle John I and his descendants.

Last of the line, Mary I, died in 1437; her son Bertrand V of La Tour became the first La Tour d'Auvergne count, the duchy having gone to the Bourbons in 1434. On the La Tour line's failure in 1531, the county passed to Catherine de' Medici, then the royal domain.
zh:
奥弗涅伯爵家族兴起于10世纪后期，时加洛林在阿基坦的权威衰落，约980年起世袭领有克莱蒙、里永一带丘陵伯国。约1155年，纪尧姆八世（“老者”）从侄子纪尧姆七世手中夺走伯国大部，政变使奥弗涅多菲内分立为单独领地。

主支保住伯爵之位，13世纪罗贝尔五世还继承了海峡沿岸的布洛涅伯国。1332年传给年幼女伯爵让娜一世，她1350年成为法王让二世的第二任妻子，即法国王后。1360年她去世后，奥弗涅和布洛涅先由其子勃艮第公爵菲利普·德·鲁夫尔短暂继承，随后转到她的叔父让一世及其后代手中。

末代传人玛丽一世1437年去世，儿子拉图尔的贝特朗五世以拉图尔·德·奥弗涅家族开国伯爵身份接管伯国，奥弗涅公爵领地1434年已归波旁家族。拉图尔一系1531年绝嗣，伯国传给卡特琳·德·美第奇，后来并入法国王室领地。

en:
The House of Avesnes took its name from Avesnes-sur-Helpe in northern France and rose through the inheritance of Hainaut. In 1212 Bouchard d'Avesnes married Margaret II, countess of Flanders and Hainaut; the disputed marriage pitted his children against the Dampierre children of her second marriage in the long Flanders-Hainaut succession war.

Louis IX's 1246 arbitration gave Flanders to the Dampierres and Hainaut to the Avesnes; John I of Avesnes made good his claim at West-Capelle in 1253, keeping Valenciennes as his seat. By the early fourteenth century the family also held Holland and Zeeland.

In 1337 William II succeeded his father as count of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland; his sister Philippa was Edward III of England's queen, and he fought for England in France, taking part in the 1339 siege of Cambrai, granting Rotterdam its city rights in 1340 and capturing Utrecht in 1345. Later that year he fell fighting the Frisians at Warns, childless. His sister Margaret, wife of Emperor Louis IV, inherited the three counties, ending the Avesnes line.
zh:
阿韦讷家族得名于法国北部的埃尔普河畔阿韦讷，靠继承埃诺伯国崛起。1212年布沙尔·德阿韦讷娶佛兰德斯与埃诺女伯爵玛格丽特二世；这段婚姻效力长期有争议，使其子女与她第二次婚姻所生的当皮埃尔子女陷入漫长的佛兰德斯-埃诺继承战争。

1246年法王路易九世仲裁，把佛兰德斯判给当皮埃尔家族、埃诺判给阿韦讷家族；1253年阿韦讷的约翰一世在西卡佩勒之战获胜，巩固权利，以瓦朗谢讷为主要驻地。14世纪初家族又领有荷兰和泽兰。

1337年威廉二世继承父位，成为埃诺、荷兰、泽兰伯爵；姐姐菲莉帕是英王爱德华三世王后，他站在英格兰一方在法作战，1339年参加康布雷围城战，1340年授予鹿特丹城市权，1345年攻占乌得勒支。同年晚些时候，他在瓦恩斯战役中与弗里斯兰人作战阵亡，无子女。姐姐玛格丽特——皇帝路易四世之妻——继承三个伯国，阿韦讷世系终结。

en:
The Ayarmaca were a highland chiefdom that emerged from the ruins of the Wari culture around the thirteenth century north and northwest of Cusco. With the neighboring Pinagua they formed a confederated lordship feared by the small Inca polity of Cusco.

The early Incas Sinchi Roca and Lloque Yupanqui fought long wars against them, and the death of the Ayarmaca warlord Tocay Capac in battle gave Cusco breathing room. The confederacy recovered and later sealed a marriage alliance with Capac Yupanqui, while another warlord, Tokay Qhapaq, carried off the child who would rule as Yawar Waqaq, whose name recalls the tears of blood he wept in captivity.

The Ayarmacas joined the revolts against Viracocha Inca and later sided with the Chanka against Cusco; their final rebellion in the 1460s was crushed by Pachacuti, who incorporated their lands into the Inca Empire.
zh:
阿亚尔马卡是13世纪前后从瓦里文化废墟上兴起的山地酋邦，位于库斯科以北和西北。它与邻近的皮纳瓜结成联盟式领主政权，令库斯科弱小的印卡城邦深感畏惧。

早期印卡君主辛奇·罗卡和略克·尤潘基长期同它交战，阿亚尔马卡战将托卡伊·卡帕克战死之后，库斯科才获得喘息之机。该联盟后来恢复元气，与卡帕克·尤潘基联姻修好；另一位战将托凯·卡帕克曾劫走后来成为君主的亚瓦尔·瓦卡克，后者的名字正源于他被掳时泣血的传说。

阿亚尔马卡人后来参加了反抗维拉科查·印卡的叛乱，又在昌卡来犯时站在库斯科的敌人一边；15世纪60年代他们最后一次起义被帕查库特克镇压，土地被并入印加帝国。

en:
The Ayasho were the royal house of the Hunza valley, known in Burushaski as Ayeshé, meaning heavenly or heaven-born, a name that reflects the Burusho tradition that their rulers' authority came from the sky.

Burushaski-speaking and later Nizari Ismaili in faith, they took the title Thum, later Mir, and traced their line to the legendary Persian prince Azar Jamshid; tradition holds that Shah Khan, called Ayasho I, founded the house in 874 after the earlier Girkis dynasty.

Hunza remained an independent mountain principality for more than nine centuries under the Ayasho, its seat at Baltit above the valley capital. In the sixteenth century Ayasho II married Shah Khatun, a princess of Skardu, and artisans sent by her father rebuilt Baltit Fort in Tibetan-influenced form.
zh:
阿亚朔家族是罕萨河谷的王室，布鲁夏斯基语称Ayeshé，意为“天上的”或“天生者”，反映了布鲁绍人认为其统治权来自上天的传统。

该家族以布鲁夏斯基语为母语，后来信奉尼扎尔伊斯玛仪派，君主称图姆（后称米尔），并把世系追溯到传说中的波斯王子阿扎尔·贾姆希德。相传沙阿汗（阿亚朔一世）在更早的吉尔基斯王朝之后于874年创立该家族。

在阿亚朔家族治下，罕萨作为山地小邦独立了九百多年，王庭设在河谷都城上方的巴尔蒂特。16世纪，阿亚朔二世迎娶斯卡都的公主沙阿·哈通，女方之父派来工匠，将巴尔蒂特堡重建成带有藏式风格的样貌。

en:
The Aydinids were a Turkoman dynasty on the Aegean coast of Anatolia, initially a vassal of the Germiyanids. Aydin's son Mehmed Bey seized Ephesus in 1304 and made himself independent emir around 1308, ruling from Ayasuluk.

The long siege of Smyrna ended in 1329 under his son Umur, who turned the city into a base for fleets that raided the Aegean. Umur allied with Byzantine emperor John VI Kantakouzenos in the civil war of 1341 to 1347. His piracy provoked the Smyrniote crusades: a Latin coalition took Smyrna in 1348 and Umur was killed in the fighting.

The beylik survived but was absorbed by the Ottomans in 1390. Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402 briefly restored the dynasty, yet the last bey, Junayd, was defeated and put to death by Sultan Murad II in 1426.
zh:
艾登王朝是安纳托利亚爱琴海沿岸的土库曼贝伊国，最初臣属于盖尔米扬王朝。艾登之子穆罕默德贝伊于1304年攻占以弗所，约1308年自立为埃米尔，以阿亚苏鲁克为都。

他的儿子乌穆尔于1329年结束对士麦那的长期围攻，并把该城建成海军基地，舰队劫掠爱琴海。乌穆尔在1341—1347年的拜占庭内战中结盟皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯。他的海盗行径招致士麦那十字军：拉丁联军于1348年攻克士麦那，乌穆尔战死。

贝伊国延续下来，但1390年被奥斯曼帝国吞并。1402年帖木儿在安卡拉获胜后王朝一度复国，但末代贝伊朱奈德于1426年被苏丹穆拉德二世击败并处死。

en:
The Ayyubids were a Sunni dynasty founded by Saladin, who abolished the Fatimid Caliphate in 1171 and built a sultanate from Egypt to Upper Mesopotamia, overwhelming the Crusader states after his victory at Hattin in 1187. After his death in 1193 the realm fragmented among his kin; the Mamluks seized Egypt in 1250 and the Mongols took the last Syrian principalities in 1260.

In 1232 Saladin's family had received Hasankeyf on the Tigris, whose meliks ruled what they called the last remnant of the Ayyubid state. As Ilkhanid vassals they saw their city prosper again, with madrasas, caravanserais and a great bridge. In 1337 the melik was al-Adil Shahab ad-Din, who ruled from 1328 to 1349.

The emirate later submitted to Timur, was occupied by Aq Qoyunlu and briefly by the Safavids, and was dissolved by the Ottomans in 1524.
zh:
阿尤布王朝是逊尼派王朝，由萨拉丁创立。他于1171年废除法蒂玛哈里发国，建立起从埃及延伸到上美索不达米亚的苏丹国，并在1187年哈丁战役获胜后横扫十字军国家。萨拉丁1193年去世后，王国被宗亲瓜分，埃及于1250年被马穆鲁克夺取，叙利亚的残余领地也在1260年亡于蒙古人。

早在1232年萨拉丁家族便受封底格里斯河畔的哈桑凯伊夫，那里的梅利克们统治着自视为阿尤布国家最后孑遗的领地。他们作为伊儿汗国藩属，见证城市再度繁荣，出现了经学院、商队驿站和大桥。1337年在位的是1328—1349年执政的阿迪勒·谢哈卜丁。

此后埃米尔国臣服帖木儿，被白羊王朝占领，又一度落入萨法维王朝之手，最终于1524年被奥斯曼帝国解散。

en:
The Bachwezi were remembered in Great Lakes oral traditions as a dynasty of the legendary Empire of Kitara, west of Lake Victoria. Tradition traced the line to the hunter Isimbwa and the founder Karubumbi, with capitals at Mubende and then Bigo bya Mugenyi, whose ditches and banks have been dated to roughly 1300 to 1500.

The Bachwezi were said to be master blacksmiths and cattle lords; their best-remembered kings were Ndahura, who vanished on a southern campaign, and Wamara, the last of the line. Under Wamara the dynasty lost the loyalty of its people and, according to legend, abandoned Kitara, making way for the Luo-speaking Babiito clan who founded Bunyoro.

Historians treat the Bachwezi as a local Bantu aristocracy, and the Rutara peoples still venerate them as ancestor spirits. Bunyoro, Buganda and neighboring kingdoms long claimed their legacy to legitimize their rule.
zh:
巴契韦齐在大湖地区的口传传统中是传说中的基塔拉帝国王朝，地在维多利亚湖以西。传说其世系可上溯到猎人伊辛布瓦和开创者卡鲁邦比，都城先在穆本德，后迁比戈比亚穆根尼；后者的壕沟与土墙经考古测定约建于1300—1500年间。

相传巴契韦齐人精于冶铁、役使牛群，最著名的国王是在南征中失踪的恩达乌拉，以及末代君王瓦马拉。瓦马拉在位时丧失人心，传说中巴契韦齐最终弃基塔拉而去，取而代之的是讲卢奥语的巴比托氏族，后者建立了布尼奥罗。

史学界认为巴契韦齐是本地班图贵族，鲁塔拉诸族将其当作祖灵敬奉。布尼奥罗、布干达等周边王国长期自称继承其遗产，以此论证自身统治的合法性。

en:
The margraves of Baden were the Swabian line of the House of Zähringen. The Zähringer Berthold's grandson Herman II built Hohenbaden castle above the thermal springs of Baden and took the title margrave of Baden in 1112. Loyal servants of the Hohenstaufen, the margraves spread their lands from the Breisgau across the Rhine into Alsace.

Repeated partitions created several lines until Bernard I reunited the inheritance in 1391 and the acquisition of Lahr and Mahlberg in 1442 linked its northern and southern halves. The Reformation split the house into Catholic Baden-Baden and Protestant Baden-Durlach, formally divided in 1535.

The Thirty Years' War and the wars of Louis XIV ravaged both; Louis William, the Turkish Louis, commanded imperial armies against the Ottomans and France. In 1771 Charles Frederick of Baden-Durlach inherited Baden-Baden and reunited the lands, becoming prince-elector in 1803 and grand duke in 1806.
zh:
巴登藩侯家族是策林根家族留在施瓦本的支系。策林根的贝托尔德之孙赫尔曼二世在巴登温泉上方修建霍亨巴登城堡，并于1112年采用巴登藩侯头衔。历代藩侯作为霍亨斯陶芬的忠仆，把领地从布赖斯高扩至莱茵河对岸的阿尔萨斯。

家族一再分家，直到伯恩哈德一世于1391年重新统一遗产，1442年取得拉尔和马尔贝格，把领地南北两段连成一体。宗教改革使家族分裂为信奉天主教的巴登-巴登和信奉新教的巴登-杜拉赫，1535年正式分治。

三十年战争和路易十四的战争使两支饱受蹂躏；土耳其人路易即路德维希·威廉统率帝国军队对抗奥斯曼与法国。1771年巴登-杜拉赫的卡尔·弗里德里希继承巴登-巴登，统合领地，并于1803年成为选侯，1806年成为大公。

en:
The Baduspanids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled Ruyan, later Rustamdar, in Tabaristan. In 665 Baduspan I, son of Gil Gavbara, was enfeoffed with Ruyan, founding a line that held the region for 933 years. After the Dabuyid fall in 760, the Baduspanids kept their highland autonomy as tributary princes, and their title of ustandar gave Rustamdar its name.

They weathered a Bavandid occupation between 1190 and 1209 and, in the fourteenth century, ruled from Kojur under Jalal al-Dawla Iskandar, who was on the throne in 1337. The Mar'ashis overran Rustamdar in 1381 and held it until Timur's conquest of Mazandaran in 1393; Kayumarth I restored the realm in 1405.

On his death in 1453 the kingdom split into the Kojur and Nur branches, which ruled separately until the Safavid shah Abbas the Great deposed both, extinguishing the dynasty in 1598.
zh:
巴杜斯潘王朝是塔巴里斯坦的伊朗人王朝，统治鲁彦，即后来的鲁斯塔姆达尔。665年，吉尔·伽夫巴拉之子巴杜斯潘一世受封鲁彦，开创的家族统治此地长达933年。760年达布依王朝灭亡后，家族以纳贡王公身份保住山区自治，其乌斯坦达尔称号演变成鲁斯塔姆达尔这个地名。

他们挺过1190—1209年巴万德王朝的占领，14世纪时以科朱尔为都，1337年在位的是贾拉勒·道莱·伊斯坎达尔。1381年马拉什人攻占鲁斯塔姆达尔，统治到1393年帖木儿征服马赞达兰；卡尤马尔斯一世于1405年复国。

他1453年死后，王国分裂为科朱尔和努尔两支，各自为政，直到萨法维沙阿拔斯大帝将两支废黜，王朝于1598年灭亡。

en:
The Baghelas were a Rajput clan of Solanki, or Chalukya, stock, whose name survives in Baghelkhand, east of Bundelkhand. They traced their line to Vyaghra Dev, a kinsman of the Vaghela rulers of Gujarat, who took the fort of Marpha; his son Karan Deo married a Kalachuri princess and received Bandhogarh as her dowry, making it their capital.

The chief Sohag Deo founded Sohagpur, and the clan enlarged its holdings for two centuries. In 1498 and 1499 Sikandar Lodi failed to storm Bandhogarh. Veer Singh Deo rode with Rana Sanga against Babur at Khanwa in 1527, and the court of Ramchandra Singh kept the musician Tansen and the wit Birbal before they joined Akbar.

After an eight-month siege Akbar's forces took and dismantled Bandhogarh in 1597. In 1618 Vikramaditya Deo founded Rewa and moved the capital there; Rewa accepted British protection by treaty in 1812.
zh:
婆稽罗是出身索兰基（即遮娄其）世系的拉杰普特氏族，本德尔肯德以东的巴格尔坎德地区便因他们得名。其世系可追溯到古吉拉特瓦盖拉王朝统治者的同族维亚格拉·迪奥，他夺取马尔法要塞；其子卡兰·迪奥娶卡拉丘里公主为妻，得到班达迦要塞作为嫁妆，并以此为都。

首领索哈格·迪奥建立索哈格布尔，氏族此后两百年间扩张领地。1498—1499年西坎达尔·洛迪围攻班达迦不克。维尔·辛格·迪奥于1527年随拉纳·桑伽在汗瓦迎战巴布尔；罗摩旃陀罗·辛格的宫廷曾聚集乐师坦森和智者比尔巴尔，二人后来投奔阿克巴。

1597年阿克巴的军队经过八个月围攻，攻占并拆毁班达迦。1618年维克拉马迪亚·迪奥建立雷瓦城并迁都于此；1812年雷瓦订约接受英国保护。

en:
The Bagrationi were the royal dynasty of Georgia from the early Middle Ages until the Russian conquest, and one of the oldest Christian ruling houses in Europe. Most scholars derive them from the Armenian Bagratuni family. The Georgian branch gained the Principality of Iberia in the late eighth century: Ashot I became its presiding prince in 813, Adarnase restored the Georgian kingship in 888, and Bagrat III united the Georgian lands into one kingdom early in the eleventh century. Under David IV the Builder, who retook Tbilisi from the Muslims in 1122, and Queen Tamar the Great (1184–1213), Georgia became the leading power of the Christian East, its empire reaching from the North Caucasus into northern Iran.

The Khwarezmian raid of 1225 and the Mongol invasion of 1236 ended that golden age, though George V the Brilliant, reigning in 1337, briefly restored the kingdom's strength. Timur's eight campaigns between 1386 and 1403 and the pressure of the Kara Koyunlu and Ak Koyunlu shattered its unity, and by 1491 the Bagrationi ruled three rival kingdoms, Kartli, Kakheti and Imereti, under Ottoman and Safavid suzerainty, with several kings converting to Islam. Erekle II reunited Kartli and Kakheti in 1762 and placed himself under Russian protection by the Treaty of Georgievsk of 1783, but Russia stood aside when the Qajar shah Agha Mohammad Khan sacked Tbilisi in 1795. Tsar Alexander I deposed the dynasty and annexed Kartli-Kakheti in 1801, and Imereti followed in 1810, when Solomon II was driven into exile.
zh:
巴格拉季奥尼王朝是中世纪早期至俄国征服期间统治格鲁吉亚的王室，也是欧洲最古老的基督教统治家族之一，多数学者认为它出自亚美尼亚的巴格拉提德家族。格鲁吉亚支系于8世纪末取得伊比利亚公国：阿绍特一世在813年成为其首席王公，阿达尔纳塞于888年恢复格鲁吉亚王权，巴格拉特三世则在11世纪初将格鲁吉亚诸地统一为一个王国。在1122年从穆斯林手中收复第比利斯的建国者大卫四世，以及塔马尔女王（1184—1213年在位）治下，格鲁吉亚成为基督教东方的头等强国，疆域从北高加索一直延伸到伊朗北部。

1225年花剌子模人的袭击和1236年蒙古人的入侵终结了这个黄金时代，不过1337年在位的吉奥尔基五世（勇敢者）曾短暂重振国力。帖木儿在1386至1403年间的八次远征，加上黑羊王朝与白羊王朝的挤压，摧毁了国家的统一；到1491年，巴格拉季奥尼家族只能在奥斯曼与萨法维波斯的宗主权下分治卡特利、卡赫蒂和伊梅雷蒂三个敌对王国，不少君主还改宗伊斯兰教。伊拉克略二世于1762年重新统一卡特利和卡赫蒂，并通过1783年的《格奥尔吉耶夫斯克条约》接受俄国保护；但1795年卡扎尔王朝的阿迦·穆罕默德汗洗劫第比利斯时，俄国并未出手。1801年沙皇亚历山大一世废黜该王朝、吞并卡特利—卡赫蒂，1810年伊梅雷蒂也遭吞并，所罗门二世被迫流亡。

en:
The Bahriyya, or Bahri Mamluks, were the first Mamluk dynasty to rule Egypt and Syria from Cairo, holding power from 1250 to 1382. Mostly Kipchak Turks bought as slave soldiers and manumitted, they took their name, meaning ‘of the river’, from their barracks on Roda Island in the Nile.

In 1250 they murdered Turanshah, heir of the Ayyubid sultan as-Salih Ayyub, and seized the sultanate, and in 1260 Qutuz and Baybars shattered the Mongols at Ain Jalut. Baybars installed a puppet Abbasid caliph in Cairo in 1261 and took Antioch in 1268; Qalawun recaptured Tripoli in 1289 and his son Khalil took Acre in 1291.

The Qalawunid line dominated, including al-Nasir Muhammad, sultan in 1337, whose reign ended in 1341. The Black Death of 1349 and succession crises weakened the regime. In 1382 the Circassian emir Barquq deposed the last Bahri sultan, Hajji II, establishing the Burji order after his return to power in 1390.
zh:
伯海里马穆鲁克是第一个以开罗为都、统治埃及和叙利亚的马穆鲁克王朝，掌权于1250—1382年。其成员多为购入后获释的钦察突厥奴隶兵；“伯海里”意为“河上的”，得名于尼罗河罗达岛军营。

1250年他们刺杀阿尤布苏丹萨利赫·阿尤布的继承人突兰沙，夺取苏丹位；1260年古突兹与拜巴尔在阿音札鲁特击溃蒙古军。拜巴尔1261年在开罗扶立阿拔斯傀儡哈里发，1268年夺取安条克；嘉拉温1289年收复的黎波里，其子哈利勒1291年攻克阿卡。

嘉拉温一支占主导，1337年在位的纳西尔·穆罕默德统治至1341年。1349年的黑死病和继承危机削弱政权，1382年切尔克斯埃米尔巴尔库克废黜末代苏丹哈吉二世，1390年重新掌权后确立布尔吉统治。

en:
The rulers known in Balinese tradition as the dynasty of Bali were the native Hindu-Buddhist kings of the island, whose line is traced to Sri Kesari Warmadewa and the Belanjong pillar of 914. By the early fourteenth century their court stood at Bedulu, where Sri Astasura Ratna Bumi Banten, the last independent Balinese king, reigned from about 1332.

During the Majapahit invasion of 1342 to 1343, troops under Gajah Mada and Arya Damar took Bedulu after seven months of fighting and ended native rule. Majapahit installed the vassal Kepakisan dynasty, whose first king was crowned at Samprangan in 1352.

In the late fourteenth or fifteenth century the court moved east to Gelgel, which under Dalem Baturenggong in the sixteenth century drew Lombok, western Sumbawa and Blambangan into its orbit. After 1651 Gelgel fragmented, and a new seat at Klungkung founded in 1686 presided over nine rival Balinese kingdoms.
zh:
巴厘王朝是巴厘传统中本土印度教—佛教诸王的统称，其世系可追溯到914年立贝兰琼石柱的斯里·克萨里·瓦尔马德瓦。14世纪初，王廷设在贝杜卢，末代独立国王斯里·阿斯塔苏拉·拉特那·布米·班滕约于1332年即位。

1342—1343年满者伯夷大将加查·马达与阿里亚·达玛尔率军来攻，历经七个月战事攻陷贝杜卢，本土王统告终。满者伯夷随后扶植附庸的克帕基桑王朝，初代国王于1352年在桑普拉岸登基。

14世纪末至15世纪，王廷东迁格尔格尔，16世纪达伦·巴图伦贡在位时，龙目、西松巴哇和布兰邦甘进入其势力范围。1651年后格尔格尔分裂，1686年新建的克隆孔王廷统辖九个相互争战的巴厘小王国。

en:
The Balliols, originally de Bailleul, came from Bailleul in Picardy and held English estates. John, fifth Baron Balliol, founded Balliol College in Oxford. His marriage to Dervorguilla of Galloway, a descendant of David, Earl of Huntingdon, gave the family its claim to the Scottish crown.

Their son John Balliol was chosen King of Scots in 1292 under Edward I's arbitration. His alliance with France brought an English invasion; he abdicated in 1296 and died in French exile in 1314, mocked as Toom Tabard, the empty coat.

His son Edward won at Dupplin Moor and was crowned at Scone in 1332. Backed by Edward III, he won Halidon Hill in 1333 and ceded Lothian, but defeat at Culblean in 1335 broke his cause. In 1356 he surrendered his claim for an English pension; he died childless in 1364.
zh:
巴利奥尔家族原名德·巴约勒，出自皮卡第的巴约勒村，在英格兰领有地产。第五代男爵约翰创办了牛津大学巴利奥尔学院，他与亨廷登伯爵大卫的后裔、加洛韦的德沃尔吉拉联姻，使家族取得苏格兰王位继承权。

他们的儿子约翰·巴利奥尔于1292年在爱德华一世仲裁下被立为苏格兰国王。他与法国结盟，招致英军入侵，1296年退位，1314年流亡法国时去世，被讥为“空外套”图姆·塔巴德。

其子爱德华于1332年在达普林沼泽获胜并于斯昆加冕。他在爱德华三世支持下于1333年赢得哈利顿山之战，割让洛锡安，但1335年卡尔布林之败使其事业瓦解。1356年他放弃王位主张以换取英格兰年金，1364年无嗣而终。

en:
Bantaeng was a small kingdom on the south coast of Sulawesi's southern peninsula. In 1254 seven local rulers, each bearing the title Kare, merged their domains under Mula Tau, titled To Toa; after the palace moved from Onto to Karatuang its rulers took the title Karaeng.

Under the name Bantayan it appears in the Javanese court poem Negarakertagama of 1364 among the lands claimed by Majapahit. Its harbor traded local rice for Chinese ceramics, and the kingdom kept marriage ties with the Bugis kingdom of Bone. It later joined Gowa peacefully and adopted Islam after Gowa did. In 1666 a Dutch fleet under Cornelis Speelman burned the boats gathered in its harbor during the Makassar War.
zh:
班塔恩是苏拉威西南半岛南岸的一个小王国。1254年，七位各称“卡雷”的地方统治者合并领地，尊称号为“多多阿”的穆拉·陶为首领；王宫从翁托迁至卡拉图昂后，君主改称“卡朗”。

1364年的爪哇宫廷史诗《爪哇史颂》以“班塔延”之名把它列入满者伯夷声称拥有的土地。其港口以当地稻米交换中国瓷器，王国并与布吉斯人的波尼王国保持联姻。它后来和平并入戈瓦，在戈瓦之后皈依伊斯兰教。1666年望加锡战争期间，科尔内利斯·斯皮尔曼率领的荷兰舰队烧毁了聚集在其港口的船只。

en:
The Baranzi stand for the lineage of Bukuku and his daughter Nyinamwiru in the oral traditions of Kitara, the legendary Chwezi state of the Great Lakes region. Bukuku, a commoner of the Iru order, was deputy to Isaza, last king of the Tembuzi dynasty, and proclaimed himself ruler after Isaza was carried off into the underworld.

The county chiefs refused to follow a common-born king and rebelled. Bukuku was eventually killed in a quarrel over cattle by his grandson Karubumbi, also called Ndahura, who then founded the Chwezi dynasty. Nyinamwiru is remembered as the mother of Ndahura, the first Chwezi king, and Baranzi is also the name of one of the oldest clans of Bunyoro and Buluuli.
zh:
巴兰齐代表大湖地区传说中的基塔拉（奇韦齐国家）口述传统里布库库与其女尼纳姆维鲁一系。布库库出身伊鲁阶层平民，是滕布齐王朝末代国王伊萨扎的副手，伊萨扎被带入冥界后自立为王。

各地酋长不肯臣服于平民出身的君主，纷纷反叛。布库库最终在争牛纠纷中被外孙卡鲁班比（又名恩达胡拉）所杀，后者随后开创奇韦齐王朝。尼纳姆维鲁被认为是奇韦齐初代国王恩达胡拉的生母，巴兰齐也是布尼奥罗和布鲁利最古老的氏族之一。

en:
The House of Barcelona descended from Wilfred the Hairy, count of Barcelona from 878, whose heirs built the county into the leading Catalan power. In 1137 Count Ramon Berenguer IV married Petronilla, heiress of Aragon, their son Alfonso II becoming first king of the united Crown of Aragon in 1162.

Under James the Conqueror it took Mallorca in 1229 and Valencia in 1238; a cadet kingdom of Mallorca lasted until Peter IV reunited it in the 1340s. The Sicilian Vespers of 1282 carried Peter III to Sicily, where a younger branch ruled until 1409, while the family's Occitan claims in Provence had passed to the Angevins in 1246. In 1337 Peter IV ruled a Mediterranean power whose fleets and Catalan Company brought Athens under the family's cadets.

The main line ended with Martin the Humanist in 1410. After an interregnum, the 1412 Compromise of Caspe gave the crown to Ferdinand of Antequera of the Castilian House of Trastámara, though Barcelona's Urgell branch contested it.
zh:
巴塞罗那家族源自878年任巴塞罗那伯爵的“多毛者”威尔弗雷德，后人将巴塞罗那伯国建成加泰罗尼亚首强。1137年拉蒙·贝伦格尔四世娶阿拉贡嗣女佩特罗尼拉，子阿方索二世1162年为阿拉贡联合王国首任国王。

“征服者”海梅一世时，家族1229年取马略卡、1238年取巴伦西亚，马略卡支系王国14世纪40年代为佩德罗四世合并。1282年西西里晚祷后佩德罗三世入主西西里，幼支统治至1409年；家族在普罗旺斯的领地1246年归安茹家族。1337年佩德罗四世在位，阿拉贡已成地中海强国，舰队与加泰罗尼亚佣兵团将雅典公国纳入支系。

1410年“人文主义者”马丁去世，主支断绝。空位期后，1412年卡斯佩妥协立卡斯蒂利亚特拉斯塔马拉家族安特克拉的费尔南多，乌尔赫尔支系则反对。

en:
The Bardi were a noble and banking family of Florence, whose rank was documented as early as 1164, when Emperor Frederick Barbarossa enfeoffed Count Alberto with the county of Vernio. From 1215 they took the Guelph side in faction wars, fighting at Montaperti in 1260 and at Campaldino in 1289, the latter alongside Dante.

Their power rested on the Compagnia dei Bardi, whose bills of exchange made them one of Europe's chief bankers by the 1320s. In 1338 the house was at its height, but it had lent Edward III some 900,000 gold florins for the Hundred Years' War, and his default in 1345 brought the bank down.

The family survived as merchants and patrons of the Franciscans, whose Bardi Chapel in Santa Croce was frescoed by Giotto. Contessina de' Bardi married Cosimo de' Medici around 1415; he restored the family to Florentine public life when he took power in 1434.
zh:
巴尔迪是佛罗伦萨的贵族兼银行世家，其贵族身份最早可考于1164年，当时皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将韦尔尼奥伯国封给阿尔贝托伯爵。1215年起他们支持圭尔夫派，族人参加1260年的蒙塔佩尔蒂之战，1289年在坎帕尔迪诺之战中与但丁并肩作战。

家族权势来自巴尔迪银行公司，凭借汇票业务，到14世纪20年代它已成为欧洲主要银行之一。1338年前后家族正值鼎盛，却为百年战争借给爱德华三世约九十万金弗罗林；1345年国王违约，银行随之破产。

此后家族仍经商并赞助方济各会，圣十字教堂的巴尔迪礼拜堂由乔托绘制壁画。1415年前后孔泰西娜·德·巴尔迪嫁给科西莫·德·美第奇，1434年科西莫掌权后恢复了家族在佛罗伦萨的公共地位。

en:
Barru, called Berru in the Bugis language, was a small kingdom on the west coast of South Sulawesi. According to its royal chronicle, La Sarewo cleared the sago-palm forest of La Rumpia for rice fields and was installed as first king on the stone of Batu Allantireng; the kingdom took its name from the aju berru tree beside it.

His successor Petta Cakkeawo ruled from 1336, and under the fourth king, Matinro ri Daun Lesang, the realm split into inland Berru Riaja and coastal Berru Rilau. Islam reached Barru through neighboring Tanete: after 1606 the twelfth king, Mattinro ri Dua Jenna, became its first Muslim ruler, and the teaching center at Pancana helped spread the faith to nearby kingdoms.
zh:
巴鲁在布吉斯语中称“贝鲁”，是南苏拉威西西海岸的一个小王国。据王室编年史，拉·萨雷沃开垦拉·伦皮亚的西谷椰林为稻田，在阿兰蒂伦石上被拥立为首任国王，国名取自石旁的贝鲁树。

继任者佩塔·查克阿沃于1336年即位；第四代国王马廷罗·里·道恩·莱桑在位时，王国分为内陆的贝鲁·里亚贾和沿海的贝鲁·里劳。伊斯兰教经邻国塔内特传入，1606年后第十二代国王马廷罗·里·杜阿·珍纳成为首位穆斯林君主，潘查纳的教学中心推动信仰传播到周边小邦。

en: This house stands for Angelo, son of Bartolomeo of Rieti, who served as podestà of Ascoli Piceno in 1337. The podestà headed the commune's government, and in those years the office was usually held by men from other towns of central Italy, among them Perugia, Gubbio and Tolentino.
zh: 这个家族指的是列蒂人巴尔托洛梅奥之子安杰洛，他在1337年担任阿斯科利皮切诺的执政官。执政官是城市公社政府的首脑，那些年这一职位多由中意大利其他城市的人担任，如佩鲁贾、古比奥和托伦蒂诺。

en:
The House of Basarab founded the Principality of Wallachia north of the Danube, taking its name from its first prince, Basarab I. Of disputed Vlach or Cuman origin, Basarab is first documented in 1324 as a voivode holding Wallachia as a vassal of Charles I of Hungary.

He broke with Hungary in 1325 and seized the Banate of Severin. In the Battle of Posada in 1330 his archers ambushed an invading Hungarian army in a Carpathian pass, nearly destroying it and securing Wallachia's independence. Basarab ruled until 1351–1352 and was followed by his son Nicholas Alexander.

The throne was elective among the family's male members. After Alexandru I Aldea's death in 1436 the dynasty split into the rival Dănești and Drăculești branches, the latter producing Vlad III the Impaler. Bessarabia preserves the dynasty's name.
zh:
巴萨拉布王朝在多瑙河北岸建立瓦拉几亚亲王国，得名于首任亲王巴萨拉布一世。巴萨拉布的瓦拉几亚或库曼族源存在争议；1324年他以沃伊沃德身份统治瓦拉几亚，是匈牙利国王查理一世的封臣。
