1325年他叛离匈牙利，夺取塞维林巴纳特。1330年的波萨达战役中，他的弓箭手在喀尔巴阡山隘口几乎全歼入侵的匈牙利军队，瓦拉几亚由此独立。巴萨拉布统治到1351—1352年，死后由儿子尼古拉·亚历山大继位。

家族男嗣均可经选举登位；1436年亚历山德鲁一世·阿尔代亚死后，王朝分裂为对立的达内什特与德勒库莱什特两支，后者出了穿刺公弗拉德三世。比萨拉比亚地区的名称来自这个王朝。

en:
The House of des Baux was a great lineage of medieval Provence, named after the cliff fortress of Les Baux, where the first castle was built in the tenth century; bau means cliff in Occitan. Its lords claimed descent from Balthazar, one of the Biblical Magi, and bore a silver sixteen-pointed star as their arms.

In the twelfth century they fought the counts of Barcelona in the Baussenque Wars, claiming Provence through a female heir in vain. The house split into three branches: the elder line kept Les Baux; the Berre branch settled in Angevin Naples, where its del Balzo line held Taranto; the youngest inherited Orange, made a principality in 1163. All three flourished in 1337.

Marie des Baux, last of the Orange line, brought the principality by marriage to Chalon-Arlay in 1386. The elder line ended with Alix des Baux in 1427, the barony annexed to Provence, and the Italian branch died out with Antoinette in 1538.
zh:
德斯·博家族是中世纪普罗旺斯显赫的封建世系之一，得名于悬崖要塞莱博，10世纪时那里建起第一座城堡，“博”在奥克语中意为悬崖。家族领主自称圣经三王之一巴尔塔扎尔的后裔，纹章为一枚银色十六角星。

12世纪，家族通过女性继承人主张普罗旺斯继承权，与巴塞罗那伯爵进行博桑克战争，最终落败。此后家族分为三支：长支保有莱博；贝尔支定居安茹治下的那不勒斯，其德尔巴尔佐一支领有塔兰托亲王国；幼支继承奥兰治，奥兰治于1163年升格为亲王国。1337年三支俱在。

奥兰治支末代玛丽·德斯·博于1386年随婚姻把亲王国带入沙隆-阿尔莱家族。长支1427年随阿丽克斯·德斯·博而绝，男爵领并入普罗旺斯伯国；意大利支1538年随安托瓦内特去世而绝嗣。

en:
The Bavandids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled the mountains of Tabaristan along the southern Caspian shore from 651 to 1349. They claimed descent from Bav, a supposed grandson of the Sasanian prince Kawus who was said to have fled the Arab conquest; their kings styled themselves ispahbadh and kept Sasanian-style coronation rites.

Their rule fell into three branches: the Kayusiyya of 665–1006, overthrown by the Ziyarid Qabus; the Ispahbadhiyya of 1073–1210, who ruled from Sari as vassals of the Seljuqs and then the Khwarezmshahs; and the Kinakhwariyya, restored in 1237 after the Mongol invasions, who governed as Ilkhanid vassals.

In 1337 the throne at Amol belonged to Hasan II, the last mainline king. In 1349 he was killed by Kiya Afrasiyab, head of a Bavandid cadet branch, who seized the realm and ended the dynasty's rule.
zh:
巴万德王朝是伊朗人的王朝，651—1349年统治里海南岸塔巴里斯坦的山区。他们自称出自巴甫，据说他是萨珊王子卡乌斯的孙子，在阿拉伯征服时逃到此地；其君主号称“伊斯帕巴德”，保留萨珊式加冕礼。

王朝分为三支：665—1006年的卡宇斯亚支被齐亚尔王朝的卡布斯推翻；1073—1210年的伊斯帕巴德支以萨里为都，先后做塞尔柱人和花剌子模沙的附庸；基纳赫瓦里亚支于蒙古入侵后的1237年复国，作为伊儿汗国的藩属治国。

1337年阿莫勒的王座属于末代嫡系君主哈桑二世。1349年他被巴万德旁支首领基亚·阿弗拉西亚布所杀，后者篡夺国家，王朝统治就此终结。

en:
The Beaumonts of this line were a branch of the House of Brienne, descended from John of Brienne, King of Jerusalem. In France they held the viscounty of Beaumont in Maine, and later married into the viscounts of Ventadour.

The English branch began when Louis of Brienne married Agnes de Beaumont, heiress of the viscounty; their younger son Henry de Beaumont entered Edward I's service in 1297. Summoned as the first Baron Beaumont in 1309, he married Alice Comyn, heiress of Buchan, and became Earl of Buchan jure uxoris.

As one of the Disinherited, he was the chief organizer of Edward Balliol's bid for the Scottish crown, planning the 1332 invasion that won Dupplin Moor and attending Balliol's coronation at Scone. His brother Lewis was Bishop of Durham from 1317 to 1333. Henry died on Edward III's Flemish campaign in 1340; his son John never pressed the lost Buchan claim, while the French line kept the Beaumont viscounty in Maine.
zh:
这一支博蒙家族出自布列讷家族，祖先可溯至耶路撒冷国王布列讷的约翰。在法国，他们世袭曼恩的博蒙子爵领，后与旺塔杜尔子爵家族联姻。

英格兰支系始于布列讷的路易娶博蒙子爵领女继承人阿涅丝·德·博蒙；幼子亨利·德博蒙特1297年投入爱德华一世麾下。1309年他成为第一代博蒙男爵，又娶巴肯女继承人艾丽斯·科明，凭妻权受封巴肯伯爵。

作为“被剥夺者”的一员，他是爱德华·巴利奥尔争夺苏格兰王位的主要策划者，组织1332年入侵，赢得达普林沼泽之战，并出席巴利奥尔在斯昆的加冕礼。其兄弟路易1317至1333年任达勒姆主教。1340年亨利于爱德华三世的佛兰德战事中去世，其子约翰再未坚持已失去的巴肯主张，法国支系则保有曼恩的博蒙子爵领。

en:
The Beccaria were a noble house of Pavia, documented among its consular aristocracy in the twelfth century and leaders of its Ghibelline faction. Murro Beccaria, captain of the people, died in 1259; his grandson Manfredo became the family's first effective lord of Pavia, until the rival Guelph Langosco drove him out around 1300; Matteo Visconti restored him in 1315.

Musso Beccaria recovered the signoria and died in 1341; his son Castellino, styled a prince of the city, kept a veiled lordship that left communal institutions formally intact. In 1357 a rising led by the friar Bussolari expelled the family; after the Visconti siege of 1359 they returned as clients of Galeazzo II.

After Gian Galeazzo Visconti's death in 1402, a bid to regain power failed; Filippo Maria Visconti executed two Beccaria in 1415 and 1418. The house then lived on its fiefs, law chairs and condottieri service; its most famous son was the Enlightenment jurist Cesare Beccaria.
zh:
贝卡里亚是帕维亚贵族世家，12世纪已名列执政官贵族，并为吉伯林派首领。家族的人民领袖穆罗1259年去世；其孙曼弗雷多成为家族中首个实际统治帕维亚的人，约1300年被圭尔夫派兰戈斯科家族赶走，1315年由马泰奥·维斯孔蒂复位。

穆索·贝卡里亚重取领主之位，1341年去世；子卡斯泰利诺称城市“亲王”，实行保留公社机构外壳的隐性统治。1357年修士布索拉里领导起事，逐出家族；1359年维斯孔蒂围城后，家族作为加莱亚佐二世的附庸重返帕维亚。

1402年吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂死后，家族夺权失败，菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂于1415、1418年处死两名成员。此后家族靠封地、法学教职和雇佣军立足，最著名的后裔是启蒙法学家切萨雷·贝卡里亚。

en:
The Belegno, sometimes spelled Bellegno, were a Venetian patrician family counted among the old houses of the lagoon. Tradition held that they came from Bergamo and settled at Rialto, where they built the church of San Bartolomeo, first dedicated to Saint Demetrius.

They were confirmed in the patriciate at the lockout of the Great Council in 1297, with a collateral branch admitted in 1311. During the Tiepolo conspiracy of 1310, ducal councillor Filippo Belegno persuaded Bajamonte Tiepolo to lay down his arms at the last moment.

Giusto Antonio Belegno later commanded the Venetian armada at the unsuccessful Battle of Ragusa in 1617 and was relieved of command. The house died out around 1698, or perhaps in the middle of the eighteenth century with Paolo Antonio Belegno.
zh:
贝莱尼奥家族（亦拼作贝莱格诺）是威尼斯贵族，位列潟湖的“旧家”门第。相传他们发源于贝加莫，迁居里亚尔托后修建了圣巴尔多禄茂教堂，该堂最初供奉圣德米特里。

1297年大议会封闭时，家族被确认保有贵族资格，一支旁系于1311年获准入籍。1310年蒂耶波洛阴谋期间，公爵顾问菲利波·贝莱尼奥在最后关头说服巴亚蒙特·蒂耶波洛放下武器。

后来朱斯托·安东尼奥·贝莱尼奥于1617年统率威尼斯舰队参加拉古萨海战，战败后被解除指挥权。家族约于1698年绝嗣，也有说法认为延续到18世纪中叶，末代传人是保罗·安东尼奥·贝莱尼奥。

en:
The Belforti were an old noble family of the Volterra region in Tuscany, perhaps named after the castle of Belforte. They rose as vassals and bankers of the bishops of Volterra, whose temporal rights Frederick Barbarossa confirmed in 1164; in 1214 Belforte di Buonafidanza lent the bishop large sums, and the family's support for the bishop against the communal podesta repeatedly earned it exile and restoration.

Turning Guelph, they gained the upper hand in the city's faction strife, helping expel the Ghibelline bishop in 1286 and fighting with Florence at Campaldino in 1289. Ranieri Belforti became bishop in 1301 and advanced his kin, above all his brother Ottaviano, who seized the signoria in 1340. Ottaviano's sons Roberto and Bocchino succeeded him, while another, Filippo, held the bishopric from 1348 to 1358, at the family's height.

In 1361 Bocchino Belforti tried to sell the city to Pisa: the Volterrans rose and beheaded him in the Piazza dei Priori, after which the family was banished and never recovered its standing.
zh:
贝尔福蒂是托斯卡纳沃尔泰拉一带的古老贵族，姓氏可能来自贝尔福泰城堡。家族起初为沃尔泰拉主教的封臣和债主：主教的世俗权力1164年由腓特烈·巴巴罗萨确认，1214年贝尔福泰·迪·博纳菲丹扎向主教放出大额贷款；家族因屡次支持主教对抗公社行政官，几度被逐又回城。

转投圭尔夫派后，家族在党争中占上风，1286年参与驱逐吉伯林派主教，1289年随佛罗伦萨战于坎帕尔迪诺。拉涅利·贝尔福蒂1301年任主教，任内提拔亲族，尤力推其弟奥塔维亚诺；后者1340年夺取沃尔泰拉领主之位。奥塔维亚诺的儿子罗伯托和博基诺相继继任，另一子菲利波1348至1358年任主教，家族势力达于顶峰。

1361年博基诺·贝尔福蒂企图把城市卖给比萨，民众起事，将他斩于普廖里广场，家族随后被放逐，再未恢复旧观。

en:
The Berlaer lords, properly Berthout van Berlaer, were a branch of the Berthout family, a wealthy noble house of Mechelen which held many lordships in Brabant, including Berlaar near Antwerp, their original seat. In 1314 Jan II Berthout van Berlaer received Helmond and Keerbergen in fief from the Duke of Brabant, and in 1325 he began the stone keep that grew into Helmond Castle.

His son Lodewijk III and grandson Walraven succeeded him as lords of Helmond and Keerbergen, while Walraven's son Jan III ruled from 1361 to 1425. The Berlaer branch held Helmond until 1433, when it passed to the Cortenbach family, while the Berlaar line near Antwerp survived until 1505.
zh:
贝拉尔领主的全称是贝尔特豪特·范·贝拉尔，是梅赫伦显贵贝尔特豪特家族的支系；该家族在布拉班特领有大批领地，包括安特卫普附近的祖宅贝尔拉尔。1314年，扬二世·贝尔特豪特·范·贝拉尔从布拉班特公爵手中受封海尔蒙德和基尔贝亨；1325年他动工修建石砌主楼，后来发展为海尔蒙德城堡。

其子路德维克三世、其孙瓦尔拉芬相继担任海尔蒙德和基尔贝亨领主，瓦尔拉芬之子扬三世的统治从1361年延续到1425年。贝拉尔支系统治海尔蒙德至1433年，领地随后转入科滕巴赫家族，安特卫普附近的贝尔拉尔本支则延续到1505年。

en:
The Bhanjas were one of Odisha's oldest chiefly lines, emerging in the Khinjali and Khijjinga mandalas as feudatories of the Bhauma-Kara kings. Two Bhanja princesses occupied that throne in the tenth century. The Khinjali branch was centred on Dhritipura, modern Boudh.

In the fourteenth century a childless Brahmin chieftain of Baudh adopted a Bhanja nephew of the raja of Keonjhar, who ruled as Ananga Deva and founded the Baudh line. In 1498 the Daspalla appanage of a younger son broke away from Baudh. Other branches held Mayurbhanj, Keonjhar and Ghumusar, where the poet-king Upendra Bhanja made his court a centre of Odia letters.

The Bhanja states served the Eastern Gangas and the Gajapati Empire before passing under British paramountcy. Ghumusar was annexed in 1835 after the Ghumusar rebellion of 1835–36, while Mayurbhanj and Keonjhar survived as princely states.
zh:
班吉家族是奥里萨最古老的首领世系之一，兴起于钦贾利和基钦加曼达罗，最初做鲍摩-卡拉诸王的附庸。10世纪，两位班吉公主登上鲍摩-卡拉王位。钦贾利一支以陀里提普拉（今包特）为中心。

14世纪，包特一位无嗣的婆罗门首领收养了凯翁贾尔罗阇的班吉族外甥，后者取名阿南伽·提婆，开创包特世系。1498年幼支的达斯帕拉封地从包特独立。此外还有马尤尔班杰、凯翁贾尔、古穆萨尔等分支，古穆萨尔的诗人国王乌彭德拉·班贾使宫廷成为奥里亚文学中心。

班吉诸邦先后臣属于东恒伽与加贾帕蒂帝国，后来处于英国宗主权下。古穆萨尔在1835—1836年起义后于1835年被吞并，马尤尔班杰和凯翁贾尔则作为土邦延续下来。

en:
The Bhatis were a Yaduvanshi Rajput clan whose traditions place their origin at Mathura, from which their ancestor Rao Bhati led them west after losing their homeland. They settled at Bhatner, then spread through Punjab and the Thar desert, ruling a chain of forts.

In 1156 Rawal Jaisal moved his capital from Lodhruva to the new desert stronghold of Jaisalmer, which became the clan's lasting kingdom. Around 1299 Alauddin Khalji of Delhi besieged Jaisalmer after a Bhati raid on his treasure caravan; the women perished in jauhar and the warriors fell fighting, though surviving Bhatis later retook the fort.

The Bhatis later came to terms with the Mughals: Rawal Lunakaran gave a daughter in marriage to Akbar, and Mughal oversight lasted until 1762. In 1818 Maharawal Mulraj accepted a British subsidiary alliance, preserving the Jaisalmer throne under protection.
zh:
婆提是亚达瓦世系的拉杰普特氏族，传说其发源地在马图拉；先祖拉奥·婆提在失去故土后率族人西迁。他们在巴特内尔落脚，随后散布到旁遮普和塔尔沙漠，统治一连串要塞。

1156年，拉瓦尔·贾萨尔把都城从洛德鲁瓦迁往新建沙漠重镇杰伊瑟尔梅尔，那里成为该氏族长久的王国。约1299年，因婆提人劫掠财宝商队，德里的阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉围攻杰伊瑟尔梅尔；妇女行乔哈尔礼自焚，武士战死，但幸存的婆提人后来收复要塞。

婆提人后来与莫卧儿人妥协：拉瓦尔·卢纳卡兰把女儿嫁给阿克巴，莫卧儿的控制持续到1762年。1818年，摩诃拉瓦尔·穆尔拉吉接受英国的辅助同盟，杰伊瑟尔梅尔王位受英国保护。

en:
The Bhattis, also called Bhatis, were a Rajput clan of the Lunar lineage who claimed the Yadava descent of their ancestor Rao Bhati, a king remembered from the third century. Driven out of Mathura, the clan moved west into the Lakhi Jungle, where Rao Bhati's son Bhupat raised Bhatner fort in 295; the fort gave the surrounding country its name of Bhattiana.

The Bhatner Bhattis held the fort on the Delhi-Multan road. In 1398 Timur's army attacked, and the Bhatti rai Dul Chand resisted with Rajput and Muslim tribesmen fighting side by side until the fort was stormed, sacked and burned.

The clan rebuilt its power until Rao Jet Singh of Bikaner seized the fort in 1527. The Rathores of Bikaner took it again in 1805 and renamed it Hanumangarh, though Bhatti chiefs and villages remained across Punjab and Sindh.
zh:
婆帝人（又译巴蒂）是属月亮世系的拉杰普特部族，自称雅达瓦后裔，始祖为传说中的3世纪君王拉奥·巴蒂。该族被逐出马图拉后西迁至拉基丛林；295年拉奥·巴蒂之子布帕特修筑巴蒂尔堡，周围地区也因此得名巴蒂亚纳。

婆帝人据守德里至木尔坦路上的巴蒂尔堡。1398年帖木儿大军进攻，婆帝罗阇杜尔·昌德率拉杰普特与穆斯林部众并肩抵抗，最终堡垒被攻陷、洗劫并焚毁。

此后该族重振势力，直到1527年比卡内尔的拉杰特·辛格夺取堡垒。1805年比卡内尔的拉托尔人再度攻占该堡，改名哈努曼加尔，不过婆帝首领与村落仍遍布旁遮普和信德。

en:
The Bissetts were a Norman family brought to Scotland in the train of King William the Lion after his release in 1174. In 1242 Walter Byset, lord of Aboyne, murdered the Earl of Atholl after a tournament at Haddington, burned the house to hide the deed, and fled with his nephew John to Ireland.

In Ulster the family became lords of the Glens of Antrim, and became a Gaelicised Anglo-Norman lineage. Its chiefs adopted the Irish style Mac Eoin Bissett, meaning descendant of John Byset. They also held Rathlin Island, where they sheltered Robert the Bruce at Rathlin Castle in 1306; the English dispossessed them of the island.

Late in the fourteenth century Margery Byset married John Mór MacDonnell of the Scottish Isles. The MacDonnells claimed the Glens through that marriage, later establishing their lordship of Antrim.
zh:
比塞特家族出身诺曼，1174年后随获释的苏格兰国王威廉一世北上。1242年阿博因领主沃尔特·比塞在哈丁顿的比武大会后杀死阿索尔伯爵，纵火灭迹，与侄子约翰逃往爱尔兰。

在阿尔斯特，家族成为安特里姆峡谷的领主，成为盖尔化的盎格鲁—诺曼家族。族长改用盖尔式称谓麦克·欧因·比塞特，意为“约翰·比塞特之后”。他们还据有拉斯林岛，1306年曾在岛上的拉斯林城堡庇护罗伯特·布鲁斯，因此被英格兰人剥夺了该岛。

14世纪末，玛杰里·比塞嫁给苏格兰群岛的约翰·莫尔·麦克唐奈。麦克唐奈家族凭这段婚姻宣称对峡谷的权利，后来建立安特里姆领地。

en:
The House of Bjelbo took its name from its manor at Bjälbo in Östergötland and supplied Sweden's jarls and bishops of Linköping. Folke the Fat became the first known Swedish jarl around 1100; the family held the office until its abolition in 1266.

Birger Jarl's son Valdemar was elected king in 1250 when Eric XI died without an heir, but his brother Magnus Ladulås deposed him in 1275. The house ruled Sweden until 1364, when Magnus Eriksson was driven out by Albert of Mecklenburg, and through Magnus it also held Norway from 1319 to 1387.

Olaf, king of Denmark and Norway, was its last reigning monarch when he died in 1387. The last male of the line followed within a few years. Euphemia of Sweden was an ancestress of the Oldenburg kings, while Gustav Vasa descended from an illegitimate branch.
zh:
比耶尔博家族得名于东约特兰的比耶尔博庄园，世代出任瑞典雅尔和林雪平主教。约1100年，胖子福尔克成为已知最早的瑞典雅尔，家族把持此职直至1266年雅尔头衔废除。

1250年埃里克十一世无嗣而终，摄政伯爵比尔耶尔之子瓦尔德玛被推举为国王，却在1275年被弟弟马格努斯·拉杜洛斯废黜。家族统治瑞典直至1364年，马格努斯·埃里克松被梅克伦堡的阿尔伯特赶走；凭借马格努斯的血统，家族又在1319—1387年统治挪威。

丹麦与挪威国王奥拉夫四世于1387年去世，是家族最后的在位君主。末代男嗣也在数年后死去。瑞典的尤菲米娅是奥尔登堡诸王的先祖，古斯塔夫·瓦萨出自庶支。

en:
The House of Blois grew from Theobald the Elder, viscount of Tours and Blois in the early tenth century. His descendants stacked up the counties of Blois and Chartres, and from the eleventh century added Troyes and Meaux, the core of Champagne.

Stephen of Blois, William the Conqueror's grandson on his mother's side, seized the English crown in 1135 and held it until 1154. Count Theobald IV of Champagne inherited Navarre in 1234 as King Theobald I; the Blois-Navarre line ruled until Queen Joan I died in 1305, when Navarre and Champagne passed to her husband, Philip IV of France. The Blois-Chartres branch had already died out in 1249, leaving Blois to the Chatillon family.

By 1337 only the counts of Sancerre survived, their hilltop county twice repelling English attacks in the Hundred Years' War even though the Black Prince wasted the country around it. This last line ended with Countess Margaret of Sancerre in 1419, leaving the whole house extinct.
zh:
布卢瓦家族源自10世纪初先后任图尔和布卢瓦子爵的老蒂博。其后代陆续取得布卢瓦、沙特尔等伯国，11世纪起又加上特鲁瓦、莫城，构成香槟伯国的核心。

征服者威廉的外孙布卢瓦的艾蒂安1135年夺得英格兰王位，统治到1154年。香槟伯爵蒂博四世1234年以蒂博一世之名继承纳瓦拉，布卢瓦-纳瓦拉支系统治至1305年女王让娜一世去世，纳瓦拉和香槟随其夫法王腓力四世转入卡佩家族。布卢瓦-沙特尔支系1249年绝嗣，布卢瓦改属沙蒂永家族。

到1337年，唯有桑塞尔伯爵支系尚存；百年战争中，这座山顶伯国两次击退英格兰进攻，尽管黑太子蹂躏了周围乡野。最后一支随桑塞尔女伯爵玛格丽特1419年去世而终结，整个布卢瓦家族绝嗣。

en:
The Boccanegra were a leading noble family of Genoa, champions of the Ghibelline and popular party against the old mercantile patriciate. Guglielmo Boccanegra became captain of the people and virtual ruler in 1257, and in 1260 commissioned the Palazzo San Giorgio, the future seat of Genoese government.

His nephew Simone was elected the republic's first doge for life in 1339. He excluded the aristocracy from office, but conspiracies forced him to resign in 1345. After Genoa submitted to Giovanni Visconti of Milan in 1353, an anti-Visconti rising in 1356 brought Simone to rally commoners at San Siro and be restored as doge.

He died after a banquet in 1363, widely believed poisoned. Other kinsmen made careers at sea: Egidio served Castile as admiral and won off Algeciras in 1344, while his son Ambrosio commanded the Castilian fleet at La Rochelle in 1372.
zh:
博卡内格拉是热那亚的名门世家，作为吉伯林派和平民党的领袖，对抗老牌商业贵族。古列尔莫·博卡内格拉于1257年出任人民领袖，成为实际统治者，1260年主持修建后来的政权所在地圣乔治宫。

他的侄子西蒙于1339年当选首任终身总督。他把旧贵族逐出政府，但阴谋迫使他于1345年辞职。1353年热那亚臣服于米兰的乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂，1356年起义时西蒙在圣西罗号召平民，复任总督。

1363年他在一次宴会后暴毙，普遍认为他被毒杀。家族其他成员在海上建功：埃吉迪奥任卡斯蒂利亚海军上将，1344年在阿尔赫西拉斯外海取胜；其子安布罗焦于1372年率卡斯蒂利亚舰队参加拉罗谢尔海战。

en:
The Bohtan were the ruling family of the Kurdish principality centered on Jazirat ibn Umar, or Cizre, on the Tigris. The Sharafnama traces the dynasty, known as the Azizan, to the Bokhti chief Sulaiman Khalid and his son Abdulaziz; in the fourteenth century the family followed Yezidism before converting to Sunni Islam.

In 1336 or 1337 the Bohtan seized Cizre with the help of the Ayyubid emir of Hisn Kayfa, who married a daughter to the emir Izz al-Din in the hope of controlling the town. The Bohtan kept their independence and repelled a Hisn Kayfa attack in 1385. The eighth ruler, Izz al-Din Abdal, submitted to Timur at Mardin in 1394.

At its height the emirate stretched from Diyarbakır to Van and from Zakho to Sinjar. After the Ottoman victory at Çaldiran in 1514 it was recognized as a hereditary Kurdish principality.
zh:
博赫丹家族统治库尔德酋长国，以底格里斯河畔的贾齐拉特·伊本·奥马尔，即吉兹雷为中心。《谢里夫纳马》把阿齐赞王朝追溯到博赫提首领苏莱曼·哈立德及其子阿卜杜勒阿齐兹；14世纪时家族信奉雅兹迪教，后来改宗逊尼派伊斯兰教。

1336或1337年，博赫丹人借哈桑凯夫阿尤布埃米尔之力夺取吉兹雷，后者把女儿嫁给埃米尔伊兹丁，企图控制该城。博赫丹保持了独立，并在1385年击退哈桑凯夫的来攻。第八代统治者伊兹丁·阿卜达勒于1394年在马尔丁向帖木儿称臣。

极盛时酋长国疆域从迪亚巴克尔延伸到凡城，从扎霍延伸到辛贾尔。1514年恰尔德兰战役奥斯曼获胜后，它被承认为世袭的库尔德酋长国。

en:
The de Bohun were a Norman family founded by Humphrey with the Beard, who held Bohon on the Cotentin Peninsula and settled in England after the Conquest. Henry de Bohun became the first Earl of Hereford and Constable of England in 1199. The family held lands in the Welsh Marches and took the swan as its heraldic badge.

The fourth earl was one of the Ordainers who curbed Edward II and married Edward I's daughter Elizabeth of Rhuddlan in 1302; he was killed leading the rebel charge at Boroughbridge in 1322. His daughter Eleanor married James Butler, first Earl of Ormonde.

The last male heir, the seventh earl Humphrey, joined the sack of Alexandria in 1365 and died in 1373 leaving only daughters. The estates passed through his daughters Eleanor to Thomas of Woodstock and Mary to the future Henry IV.
zh:
博洪家族是诺曼人家族，始祖留有胡须的汉弗莱在科唐坦半岛领有博洪，诺曼征服后定居英格兰。亨利·德·博洪于1199年成为第一代赫里福德伯爵和英格兰统帅。家族在威尔士边疆拥有领地，以天鹅为纹章徽记。

第四代伯爵是约束爱德华二世的贵族改革派成员，1302年娶爱德华一世之女里兹兰的伊丽莎白，1322年在巴勒布里奇率叛军冲锋时战死。他的女儿埃莉诺嫁给第一代奥蒙德伯爵詹姆斯·巴特勒。

末代男嗣、第七代伯爵汉弗莱参加1365年洗劫亚历山大港之役，1373年去世时只留下女儿。遗产由他的女儿埃莉诺带给伍德斯托克的托马斯，由玛丽带给后来的亨利四世。

en:
The Bolaang dynasty ruled the Mongondow people of northern Celebes. Mongondow tradition holds that in the thirteenth century local chiefs, or bogani, met in a bakid assembly and united their clans into a maritime polity called Bolaang, meaning sea. They chose Mokodoludut of Molantud as their first paramount chief, or punu; king lists place his reign from 1280 to 1376.

His successors moved the court between the Mongondow plateau and coastal settlements. After a power vacuum in the late sixteenth century, the chief Tadohe restored the state. His son Datu Loloda Mokoagow succeeded in 1670 and built Bola'ang into a power reaching Manado.

A Dutch-backed border agreement with the Minahasan federation in 1694 stripped away the eastern lands. In the eighteenth century contracts with the Dutch East India Company shrank the realm further, after which it was called Bolaang Mongondow.
zh:
博朗王朝统治苏拉威西北部的蒙贡杜人。蒙贡杜传统称，13世纪各地首领博加尼举行巴基德大会，把氏族联合为名为博朗的海上政权，博朗意为海。他们推举莫兰图部的莫科多卢杜特为首任最高首领普努；王表把他的统治系于1280—1376年。

后继者在蒙贡杜高原与沿海据点之间迁徙王廷。16世纪末出现权力真空后，首领塔多赫重振国政；其子达图·洛洛达·莫科阿戈于1670年继位，把博朗建成势力远及万鸦老的强权。

1694年，在荷兰支持下，米纳哈萨部落联盟与其划界，博朗丧失东部疆土。18世纪又因与荷兰东印度公司的条约不断萎缩，此后改称博朗-蒙贡杜。

en:
The Bolkiah are the royal house of Brunei, the Malay sultanate on the northern coast of Borneo. Tradition traces the line to Awang Alak Betatar, the local ruler who embraced Islam and became the first sultan, Muhammad Shah, in the later fourteenth century, together with his brother Awang Semaun.

The dynasty took its name from Sultan Bolkiah, who reigned from 1485 to 1524 during Brunei's golden age. He brought in Javanese blacksmiths to cast cannon, and Brunei's sway reached the coasts of Borneo, the Sulu Archipelago and Manila, whose rajahs married into the house. In 1521 Pigafetta's surviving Magellan expedition visited Brunei.

From the later seventeenth century succession quarrels, the rise of Sulu and piracy eroded the sultanate into a loose cluster of riverine territories. By the 1830s open revolt had broken out in the Bau region.
zh:
博尔基亚家族是婆罗洲北岸马来苏丹国文莱的王室。按传统说法，其世系可追溯到14世纪后期皈依伊斯兰教、成为首任苏丹穆罕默德·沙的本地统治者阿旺·阿拉克·贝塔塔尔，以及他的兄弟阿旺·塞马温。

王朝得名于苏丹博尔基亚，他于1485—1524年统治文莱，期间是文莱的黄金时代。他引入爪哇工匠铸造火炮，文莱势力遍及婆罗洲沿海，并远及苏禄群岛和马尼拉，马尼拉的拉惹与王室联姻。1521年皮加费塔所在的麦哲伦船队幸存者到访文莱。

17世纪后期起，王位纷争、苏禄的崛起和海盗活动使苏丹国逐渐瓦解为松散的河川领地集合。到19世纪30年代，巴乌地区爆发了公开叛乱。

en:
Bone was the leading Bugis kingdom of the southern peninsula of Sulawesi, centered on Watampone. Tradition credits ManurungngE Rimatajang with founding the line around 1330, and its rulers bore the title Arumpone. It grew under early fifteenth-century rulers such as La Umasa, and in the early sixteenth century fought Luwu for the Cenrana River mouth, a trade outlet.

In 1582 it joined Wajo and Soppeng in the Tellumpocco'e alliance, the Three Summits, to check Gowa and Tallo, but a Gowa invasion in 1611 forced Bone to accept Islam. Its greatest ruler, Arung Palakka, La Tenritatta, allied with the Dutch admiral Cornelis Speelman; the fall of Makassar in 1669 made Bone the overlord of South Sulawesi.

It kept that standing until the British interlude of 1814 and the Dutch return in 1816. Dutch attempts to make it a vassal met armed resistance in 1824.
zh:
波尼是苏拉威西南半岛首屈一指的布吉人王国，以瓦坦波尼为中心。相传曼努隆格·里马塔姜于1330年前后开创王统，君主称号为“阿伦波内”。15世纪初，在拉·乌马萨等君主治下，它发展壮大；16世纪初，它为争夺贸易出口琴拉纳河口与卢武交战。

1582年，波尼与瓦佐、索彭结成“三峰”同盟，以遏制戈瓦和塔洛的崛起，但1611年戈瓦入侵，迫使波尼接受伊斯兰教。波尼最伟大的君主阿隆·帕拉卡（拉·滕里塔塔）与荷兰海军将领科尔内利斯·斯皮尔曼结盟；1669年望加锡陷落后，波尼成为南苏拉威西的宗主。

这一地位一直维持到1814年英国短暂接管和1816年荷兰卷土重来。此后荷兰企图将它降为附庸，1824年遭到武力抵抗。

en:
The Borcke were an old Pomeranian noble family of Wendish origin. Their presumed ancestor Bork was killed between 1170 and 1187 in Duke Bogislaw I's wars against Brandenburg; his grandson Borko II was burgrave of Kolberg until 1255 and lord of Lobis in 1271. The personal name Borko became a family name, first used by Nikolaus Borko in 1297.

Their Farther Pomeranian estates formed a lordship known as the Borcke Circle until 1817, where the family exercised full jurisdiction. Heinrich Borcke, the black knight, added Falkenberg in 1479 and bought Pansin Castle in 1493. The family refused homage to the Griffin dukes for their ancestral lands until 1567.

Sidonia von Borcke was beheaded at Stettin after a witch trial in 1620. Adrian Bernhard von Borcke became a Prussian field marshal and minister under Frederick William I, receiving a comital patent in 1740.
zh:
博尔克家族是波美拉尼亚的古老贵族，出身文德人。传说中的先祖博克在1170至1187年间波美拉尼亚公爵博吉斯瓦夫一世对勃兰登堡的战争中战死；其孙博尔科二世至1255年担任科尔贝格城堡伯爵，1271年为洛比斯领主。人名博尔科后来成为家族姓氏，1297年尼古拉·博尔科首次这样使用。

家族在远波美拉尼亚的领地构成辖区，1817年以前称博尔克区，家族在区内行使全部司法权。绰号“黑骑士”的海因里希·博尔克于1479年取得法尔肯贝格，1493年买下潘辛城堡。家族拒绝为祖传土地向格里芬公爵行臣服礼，一直坚持到1567年。

西多妮娅·冯·博尔克于1620年在斯德丁遭女巫审判后被斩首。阿德里安·伯恩哈德·冯·博尔克在腓特烈·威廉一世麾下官至普鲁士陆军元帅兼大臣，并于1740年获封伯爵。

en:
The Borjigin were the Mongols' imperial clan, descended from the legendary Alan Gua. Her descendant Khabul Khan built a Mongol confederation about 1131; his great-grandson Temüjin united the steppe and became Genghis Khan in 1206.

Genghis and his sons built the largest continuous land empire, and after 1259 his heirs divided it into appanages: the great khans and then Kublai's Yuan dynasty in China, the Golden Horde on the Volga, and the Chagatai khanate. In 1368 the Ming drove the last Yuan emperor beyond the Great Wall, but the house continued as the Northern Yuan. Oirat strongmen usurped the khanate briefly in the 1450s, before Dayan Khan restored Borjigid supremacy from 1480 to 1517, dividing the steppe among his sons.

Borjigid princes ruled Kazan and Crimea until Russian conquests from the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries, while Babur, the Mughal founder, claimed Chinggisid blood through his mother. The senior line ended with Ligden Khan, who died fighting the Qing in 1634, the Khalkha khanates submitting in 1691.
zh:
孛儿只斤是蒙古帝裔氏族，传说可追溯至阿兰豁阿。后人合不勒汗约1131年聚合蒙古诸部，曾孙铁木真统一草原，1206年即大汗位，称成吉思汗。

成吉思汗及其子孙建立史上疆域最辽阔的连续陆上帝国，1259年后后裔按支系瓜分：忽必烈一系的大汗及元朝统治中国，另有伏尔加河的金帐汗国和察合台汗国。1368年明朝将末代元帝逐过长城，家族以北元在蒙古高原延续。15世纪50年代卫拉特权臣一度篡夺汗位，达延汗1480—1517年恢复孛儿只斤霸权，将草原分封诸子。

孛儿只斤王公还统治喀山和克里米亚，直至16至18世纪被俄罗斯征服；莫卧儿建立者巴布尔也通过母系自称有成吉思汗血统。大汗嫡系1634年林丹汗抗清败死而终，喀尔喀诸汗国1691年归附清朝。

en:
The House of Bourbon was a cadet branch of the Capetian kings of France. In 1272 Robert, count of Clermont and son of Saint Louis IX, married Beatrice, heiress of Bourbon. Their son Louis I became duke of Bourbon in 1327 and was a leading prince in 1337.

His descendants served the Valois: Peter I fell at Poitiers in 1356 and John I was captured at Agincourt in 1415. Duke Charles III died at the sack of Rome in 1527, ending the senior line. The Vendome branch became the senior line, and its head inherited the crown as Henry IV in 1589.

Louis XVI was executed in 1793; the Bourbons were restored in 1815 and expelled in 1830, succeeded by Orléans. Louis XIV's grandson became Philip V of Spain in 1700; the Treaty of Utrecht separated the crowns in 1713. Spanish Bourbons took Naples and Sicily in 1734 and Parma in 1748.
zh:
波旁是卡佩支系。1272年，圣路易九世之子、克莱蒙伯爵罗贝尔娶波旁女继承人贝亚特丽丝。其子路易一世于1327年成为波旁公爵，1337年已是大诸侯。

其后代为瓦卢瓦王朝效力：皮埃尔一世于1356年战死普瓦捷，让一世于1415年在阿金库尔被俘。公爵长支于1527年终结，夏尔三世在罗马之劫中被杀。旺代姆支系随即成为长支，其族长于1589年以亨利四世的身份继承王位。

路易十六于1793年被处死；波旁王朝1815年复辟，1830年被赶下台，由奥尔良支系继承。路易十四的一个孙辈于1700年成为西班牙国王腓力五世；1713年的《乌得勒支条约》分开西法两顶王冠，西班牙波旁家族又于1734年取得那不勒斯和西西里，1748年取得帕尔马。

en: Bowontehu was a kingdom around Manado Bay on the northern tip of Sulawesi, recorded as the predecessor of the Kingdom of Manado and dated from about 1500 to 1670. Its successor realm held the islands of Bunaken and Lembeh and the neighboring coast, hosted Portuguese and Spanish traders, and converted to Catholicism in the seventeenth century.
zh: 博翁特胡是苏拉威西北端万鸦老湾一带的王国，史料记载它是万鸦老王国的前身，约存在于1500年至1670年。后继的万鸦老王国领有布纳肯、伦贝等岛屿和附近海岸，接待葡萄牙与西班牙商人，并于17世纪皈依天主教。

en:
The Brancaleoni were a noble family of the Marche, in the upper valley of the Metauro, who held the lordship of Massa Trabaria and the county of Mercatello sul Metauro. On the death of Bartolomeo Brancaleoni, lord of Massa Trabaria, in 1424 his daughters Gentile and Piera inherited his domains, while effective power passed to Guidantonio da Montefeltro, Count of Urbino, as papal vicar.

After Piera died, Gentile became sole heiress and in 1437 married Guidantonio's son Federico da Montefeltro, who took possession of the Brancaleoni lands by right of his wife.

Pope Eugene IV confirmed him as vicar and count in 1443, and when Federico became Duke of Urbino in 1444 the Brancaleoni castles, about eighteen in all, were merged into the Duchy of Urbino. Gentile died without surviving children in 1457, and the family's independent rule came to an end.
zh:
布兰卡莱奥尼家族是马尔凯地区梅陶罗河上游的贵族，领有马萨特腊巴里亚领地和梅陶罗河畔梅尔卡泰洛伯国。1424年马萨特腊巴里亚领主巴尔托洛梅奥·布兰卡莱奥尼去世后，女儿真蒂莱和皮耶拉继承领地，实际权力则落入以教皇代理人身份执政的乌尔比诺伯爵圭达托尼奥·达·蒙泰费尔特罗之手。

皮耶拉死后，真蒂莱成为唯一继承人，1437年嫁给圭达托尼奥之子费德里科·达·蒙泰费尔特罗，后者凭妻权接管布兰卡莱奥尼的土地。

1443年教皇尤金四世任命他为代理人并封伯爵；1444年费德里科成为乌尔比诺公爵，布兰卡莱奥尼家族约十八座城堡并入乌尔比诺公国。真蒂莱于1457年去世，未留下存活子嗣，家族的独立统治就此终结。

en:
The Bruces were a Lowland Scottish house of Norman origin, named from Brix in Normandy; Robert de Brus followed David I to England in 1106 and received Annandale in Scotland. The fourth lord's marriage to Isobel of Huntingdon, William the Lion's niece, gave the family a crown claim, and the fifth lord was a leading claimant in the Great Cause of 1290, though Edward I awarded the throne to John Balliol.

Robert the Bruce revived the claim: after killing John Comyn he was crowned in 1306, defeated Edward II at Bannockburn in 1314, and won recognition of Scottish independence in the 1328 Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton, dying the next year at Dunfermline.

His son David II inherited young, went into French exile after Halidon Hill in 1333, and spent eleven years captive in England after Neville's Cross in 1346. When David died childless in 1371, the house's last male, the crown passed through Robert's daughter Marjorie to Robert II's Stewarts.
zh:
布鲁斯是诺曼出身的苏格兰低地贵族，姓氏源自诺曼底布里克瑟；1106年罗伯特·德·布鲁斯随大卫一世来到英格兰，受封苏格兰安南代尔。第四代领主娶狮子王威廉的侄女亨廷顿的伊莎贝尔，家族由此获得王位继承权；第五代领主在1290年大业之争中是主要争位者，但爱德华一世把王位判给约翰·巴里奥。

罗伯特·布鲁斯重启争夺：杀死政敌约翰·科明后于1306年加冕为王，1314年在班诺克本击败爱德华二世，1328年《爱丁堡—北安普顿条约》承认苏格兰独立，次年于邓弗姆林去世。

其子大卫二世幼年继位，1333年哈利顿山战败后流亡法国，1346年内维尔十字兵败后被英格兰囚禁十一年。1371年大卫无嗣而终，男嗣断绝，王位经罗伯特之女玛乔丽传给罗伯特二世的斯图亚特家族。

en:
This was the royal line of the kabakas, the kings of Buganda, known as the Kintu or Abalasangeye dynasty. Its founder Kato Kintu united the clans around the north-western shore of Lake Victoria in the late 1200s and set up his capital at Nnono. His son Chwa succeeded him as Chwa I.

Chwa's son Kalemeera was driven into Bunyoro, and Kalemeera's son Kimera returned to reign as the third kabaka. From a small polity in Busiro, Buganda survived a Bunyoro invasion in the 1500s and expanded as Bunyoro-Kitara declined.

During the 1600s and 1700s it conquered Buddu, parts of Busoga and Karagwe, and made Kooki a tributary. Appointed military chiefs bound the conquered lands together, and by the early 1800s the kabaka ruled the strongest and most centralised kingdom of the Great Lakes, served by fleets of war canoes on Lake Victoria.
zh:
这是布干达国王“卡巴卡”的王统，称为金图王朝（阿巴拉桑杰王朝）。开创者卡托·金图于13世纪末统一维多利亚湖西北岸的氏族，建都诺诺。其子恰瓦继位为恰瓦一世。

恰瓦之子卡莱梅拉被逐入布尼奥罗，卡莱梅拉之子基梅拉后来回国成为第三代卡巴卡。布干达从布西罗的小型政权起家，16世纪击退布尼奥罗的入侵，随后趁布尼奥罗-基塔拉衰落而扩张。

17至18世纪间，布干达征服布杜、布索加和卡拉圭的部分地区，并使科基成为属国。被征服土地由任命的军事首领治理，国家因此日益整合；到19世纪初，卡巴卡已是大湖地区最强大、集权程度最高的统治者，在维多利亚湖上拥有战船队。

en:
The Bulduqani were a Kurdish dynasty, of Zaza speech, who ruled the Principality of Eğil north of Diyarbakır for some eight centuries. The line was founded by Pir Mansur, a Sufi leader who took Eğil around 1049 with the backing of the local Mirdesan tribe; his grandson Pir Bedir was killed in the Seljuk siege of 1087, and the posthumously born Emir Bulduk, from whom the dynasty took its name, was raised by the tribe.

In the fifteenth century the Bulduqani married into the Aq Qoyunlu, as Dawlatshah's daughter wed Uzun Hasan, even though Dawlatshah's son Isa fought against him at the Battle on the Tigris in 1457.

The Safavids later seized the principality and lost it to the Ottoman sultan Selim I, under whom Eğil became a self-governing Kurdish emirate, exempt from the ordinary timar fief system.
zh:
布尔杜卡尼是操扎扎其语的库尔德王朝，在迪亚巴克尔以北的埃伊尔酋长国统治了约八百年。家族始祖皮儿·曼苏尔是苏菲首领，约1049年借当地米尔迪桑部落之力取得埃伊尔；其孙皮儿·贝迪尔在1087年塞尔柱人的围攻中被杀，遗腹子埃米尔·布尔杜克由部落抚养成人，王朝之名即由他而来。

15世纪时布尔杜卡尼家族与白羊王朝联姻，道拉特沙之女嫁给乌尊·哈桑，而道拉特沙之子伊萨却在1457年底格里斯河战役中与乌尊·哈桑为敌。

此后酋长国一度被萨法维波斯夺取，又落入奥斯曼苏丹塞利姆一世之手，埃伊尔由此成为自治的库尔德埃米尔国，享有不纳入普通蒂玛封地制度的特权。

en:
The Bundelas were a Rajput clan that gave its name to Bundelkhand in central India. Their traditions trace their rise to 1288, when Sohanpal of Mahoni joined Panwar leader Panpal to defeat Naga, ruler of Kurar, and seize Garh Kundar, the clan's first stronghold.

In 1531 Rudra Pratap Singh founded Orchha and moved his capital there. Orchha became the parent kingdom: Madhukar Shah submitted to Akbar and ceded lands in 1577 and 1588, while Vir Singh Deo brought the state to its zenith in 1605–1627, building the Jahangir Mahal. Cadet branches founded Datia in 1626 and Panna in 1657.

The Panna raja Chhatrasal, reigning from 1675 to 1731, revolted against Mughal rule and left one third of his kingdom to the Maratha Peshwa Baji Rao. Orchha escaped full Maratha subjugation and concluded an alliance with the British in 1812.
zh:
班德拉是拉杰普特氏族，中印度的本德尔肯德地区因他们而得名。据其传说，1288年马霍尼首领索汉帕尔联合潘瓦尔首领潘帕尔，击败昆达尔统治者纳加，夺取加尔昆达尔要塞，那里成为氏族最早的据点。

1531年，鲁德拉·普拉塔普·辛格建立奥拉奇哈，并迁都于此。奥拉奇哈成为班德拉诸邦的母邦：马杜卡尔·沙阿向阿克巴臣服，于1577和1588年割让土地；维尔·辛格·迪奥在1605至1627年间把国家推向鼎盛，修建了贾汉吉尔宫。支系于1626年建立达蒂亚，1657年建立潘纳。

潘纳君主查特拉萨尔（1675—1731年在位）起兵反抗莫卧儿统治，把三分之一领地留给马拉塔佩什瓦巴吉拉奥。奥拉奇哈未被马拉塔人彻底征服，并于1812年与英国结盟。

en:
The Burghersh family were English soldiers and royal servants raised to the peerage when Robert de Burghersh became Baron Burghersh in 1303. As constable of Dover Castle and warden of the Cinque Ports he guarded the crossing to France, offices his sons inherited. His son Henry became Bishop of Lincoln and joined Queen Isabella's invasion of 1326 that overthrew Edward II.

The title was recreated in 1330 for another son, Bartholomew the elder, who held Dover and the Cinque Ports for Edward III.

His son Bartholomew the younger fought at Crécy in 1346 and the siege of Calais in 1347, and was among the first Knights of the Garter in 1348. The barony passed through the Despenser and Beauchamp families and fell into abeyance in 1449; a new creation in 1624 carried it to the Earls of Westmorland.
zh:
伯格斯家族是英格兰的军人与王室仆从家族，罗伯特·德·伯格斯于1303年受封伯格斯男爵，家族由此跻身贵族。他担任多佛尔城堡总管和五港同盟长官，扼守通往法国的渡口，两个职务后来由他的儿子们继承。其子亨利成为林肯主教，参与了伊莎贝拉王后1326年推翻爱德华二世的入侵行动。

1330年，男爵头衔为另一个儿子老巴塞洛缪重新创设，他为爱德华三世镇守多佛尔和五港。

其子小巴塞洛缪参加了1346年的克雷西战役和1347年的加来围城战，1348年成为首批嘉德骑士之一。男爵头衔后经勒德斯潘塞和比彻姆家族传承，于1449年进入搁置状态；1624年的新册封把它转入威斯特摩兰伯爵一系。

en:
The Castilian House of Burgundy was a cadet line of the House of Ivrea, founded when Raymond of Burgundy joined Alfonso VI's court around 1087, married his heiress Urraca and received Galicia. Their son Alfonso VII inherited León and Castile in 1126, but on his death in 1157 the realms split between his sons, until Ferdinand III reunited them and added Córdoba in 1236 and Seville in 1248 to the reconquered south.

His marriage to Joan, heiress of Aumale, planted a junior line in northern France as counts of Aumale. Alfonso X the Wise, king from 1252, compiled the Siete Partidas but left a disputed succession.

In 1337 Alfonso XI ruled; he routed the Marinids at the Río Salado in 1340 and took Algeciras in 1344. His son Peter I, called the Cruel, was killed at Montiel in 1369 in the Castilian Civil War by his illegitimate half-brother, who ruled as Henry II and founded the Trastámara line, of the same Burgundian stock.
zh:
卡斯蒂利亚勃艮第王朝是伊夫雷亚王朝支系：勃艮第的雷蒙约1087年入阿方索六世宫廷，娶女继承人乌拉卡，受封加利西亚。子阿方索七世1126年继承莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚，1157年死后王国分给诸子；费尔南多三世重新统一，再征服中1236年取科尔多瓦、1248年取塞维利亚。

费尔南多娶欧玛勒女继承人让娜，使一支幼支在法国北部世袭欧玛勒伯爵。1252年继位的“智者”阿方索十世主持编纂《七章法典》，却留下继承争端。

1337年阿方索十一世在位，他1340年在萨拉多河大败马林王朝，1344年攻占阿尔赫西拉斯。其子“暴君”佩德罗一世在1369年卡斯蒂利亚内战中为私生子兄长所杀，死于蒙铁尔，后者即位为恩里克二世，开创同属勃艮第血脉的特拉斯塔马拉王朝。

en:
This House of Burgundy was a Capetian cadet branch, founded when Robert I, younger son of Robert II the Pious, received the Duchy of Burgundy from his brother Henry I in 1032 and ruled from Dijon. Its dukes joined the crusades and planted branches across the west: Robert I's younger grandson Henry became count of Portugal in 1093, and his son Afonso Henriques founded the Portuguese kingdom in 1139, a Burgundian line ruling Lisbon until 1383.

In 1337 Odo IV ruled; through his wife Joan III he held the Free County of Burgundy and Artois from 1330 and commanded Philip VI's armies in the opening wars with England, fighting at Cassel in 1328.

His grandson Philip of Rouvres gathered the family's many lands but died childless in 1361, probably of plague. The duchy reverted to the French crown, and in 1363 King John II gave it to his son Philip the Bold, opening the Valois House of Burgundy.
zh:
这个勃艮第家族是卡佩诸王的支系：“虔诚者”罗贝尔二世的幼子罗贝尔一世1032年从兄长亨利一世手中受封勃艮第公国，以第戎为治所。历代公爵随十字军东征，把支系播撒到西方：幼孙亨利1093年成为葡萄牙伯爵，其子阿方索·恩里克斯1139年建立葡萄牙王国，这条勃艮第世系统治里斯本至1383年。

1337年在位的是厄德四世，他通过妻子让娜三世自1330年起领有勃艮第自由伯国和阿图瓦，在英法战争初期为腓力六世统兵，参加1328年卡塞尔之战。

其孙菲利普·德·鲁夫尔集家族众多领地于一身，1361年无子而亡，很可能死于瘟疫。公国随即收归法国王室，1363年国王让二世封给亲子“勇敢者”菲利普，开启瓦卢瓦-勃艮第支系。

en:
The Portuguese House of Burgundy was founded by Henry of Burgundy, who received Portugal from Alfonso VI of León and married his daughter Teresa in 1096. Their son Afonso Henriques defeated his mother's party at São Mamede in 1128 and became king after Ourique in 1139; the pope recognized the kingdom in 1179.

Afonso III completed the reconquest by taking the Algarve in 1249. Denis I made Portuguese the language of the courts, founded the university that settled at Coimbra and fixed the Castilian frontier in 1297. Afonso IV ruled in 1337 and sent his army alongside Castile at the Río Salado in 1340.

Ferdinand I died in 1383 leaving his heiress Beatrice, wife of John I of Castile. The ensuing interregnum and fear of annexation ended at Aljubarrota in 1385, placing the illegitimate Aviz line of John I on the throne.
zh:
葡萄牙勃艮第王朝由勃艮第的亨利开创，他于1096年从莱昂国王阿方索六世手中受封葡萄牙，并娶其女特蕾莎。他们的儿子阿方索·恩里克斯于1128年在圣马梅德击败母亲一党，1139年奥里基战役后自立为王，教宗于1179年承认王国。

阿方索三世于1249年夺取阿尔加维，完成再征服。迪尼什一世确立葡萄牙语为法庭语言，创办后来落户科英布拉的大学，并于1297年划定与卡斯蒂利亚的边界。1337年阿方索四世在位，后来于1340年派军与卡斯蒂利亚并肩作战于萨拉多河。

1383年费尔南多一世去世，留下嫁给卡斯蒂利亚国王胡安一世的女继承人比阿特丽丝。随之而来的空位期和被吞并的危机在1385年的阿尔茹巴罗塔战役中了结，私生子出身的若昂一世率阿维什支系登上王位。

en:
The Butlers were a Hiberno-Norman family descended from Theobald Walter, Chief Butler of Ireland around 1185. Their name came from that hereditary office, and their arms bore three cups. Theobald received lands in eastern Munster; his descendant James became Earl of Ormond in 1328, and Kilkenny Castle became their principal seat.

The earls upheld English rule in Ireland. The fifth earl, a Lancastrian, was executed after the Yorkist victory at Towton in 1461; his brother recovered the title in 1476. Piers Butler was pressured into surrendering it to Thomas Boleyn in 1528 but recovered it in 1538.

James Butler, first Duke of Ormonde, led the royalists in the Irish Confederate Wars and twice served as Lord Lieutenant. His grandson, the second duke, was attainted as a Jacobite in 1715 and died in exile; the main line dwindled while junior branches kept many titles.
zh:
巴特勒家族是定居爱尔兰的诺曼贵族，始祖西奥博尔德·沃尔特约在1185年出任爱尔兰首席侍酒。家族姓氏来自世袭掌酒官职务，纹章上绘有三只酒杯。西奥博尔德受封芒斯特东部的土地，后裔詹姆斯于1328年受封奥蒙德伯爵，基尔肯尼城堡成为家族的主要宅邸。

历代伯爵是英格兰统治爱尔兰的支柱。第五代伯爵是兰开斯特派，1461年约克派在陶顿取胜后被处决；其弟于1476年恢复头衔。皮尔斯·巴特勒于1528年被迫把伯爵头衔让给托马斯·博林，1538年又予恢复。

第一代奥蒙德公爵詹姆斯·巴特勒在爱尔兰联盟战争期间领导保王派，并两度出任爱尔兰总督。其孙第二代公爵因参与詹姆斯党活动于1715年被定罪，流亡异乡，主支由此衰落，旁支仍保有大量头衔。

en:
The Buzen Nagano were local lords of Buzen in northern Kyushu, based at Nagano. Family records name their founder as Taira no Yasumori, who came as governor in 1157, built a castle at Nagano and took its name. Thirteen generations ruled for nearly four hundred and thirty years.

In the Sengoku period the clan was driven from its lands to Umagatake Castle in the wars between the Ōtomo and the Mōri. After the Ōtomo defeat at Mimi-gawa in 1578 it joined Akizuki Tanezane and Takahashi Mototane in asserting independence. It later submitted to Kuroda Yoshitaka, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi lodged at Umagatake in 1587.

With Buzen granted to the Kuroda, the Nagano scattered as retainers of Kobayakawa Takakage, Tachibana Muneshige and Katō Kiyomasa. Some branches ended in the Osaka campaigns; others survived as ascetics of Hiko-san or sake brewers in Kokura.
zh:
丰前长野氏是九州北部丰前国的国人领主，本据在长野。据其家传，始祖平康盛于1157年以丰前国司身份下向当地，在长野筑城并以地名为姓。家族在此统治近四百三十年，传了十三代。

战国时代，长野氏在大友氏与毛利氏的战乱中被迫离开本领，移往马岳城。1578年大友氏在耳川之战惨败后，长野氏与秋月种实、高桥元种联手自立。后来长野氏归降黑田孝高，丰臣秀吉于1587年驻跸马岳城。

丰前被封给黑田氏后，长野氏一族四散，分别成为小早川隆景、立花宗茂和加藤清正的家臣。有的支族在大坂之阵中覆灭，也有人在英彦山成为修验者，或在小仓以酿酒为业。

en:
The de' Cabanni were a courtier family of Angevin Naples, founded by Raimondo de' Cabanni, a black African slave boy sold to the royal kitchens' provost. The provost freed and baptized him, gave him his name and made him his heir. Raimondo rose at King Robert's court, marrying Philippa of Catania, governess of the royal children, in 1305.

He became seneschal of the royal hospice and acquired Minervino and Mottola. In 1334 he was buried with royal honours in Santa Chiara. His sons Carlo and Perrotto became chamberlains, while Roberto became count of Eboli and grand seneschal.

In 1345 Roberto, his mother Philippa and his niece Sancia were accused of murdering Andrew, husband of Queen Joanna I. They were tortured; Philippa died in prison and Roberto was executed, while Carlo's son Raimondello was declared innocent in 1346. Boccaccio made their ruin the subject of the last chapter of his Fates of Illustrious Men.
zh:
德·卡巴尼家族是安茹王朝那不勒斯的廷臣家族，创始人拉伊蒙多原是一名黑人奴隶少年，被卖给王室厨房总管。总管释放并为他施洗，让他承袭自己的名字和产业。拉伊蒙多在罗贝托国王的宫廷中发迹，1305年娶王室子女的女傅、卡塔尼亚的菲利帕为妻。

他升任宫廷内侍长，并取得米内尔维诺、莫托拉等封地。1334年他去世时，以王室规格葬入圣基亚拉教堂。其子卡洛和佩罗托都做过侍从长，罗贝托则受封埃博利伯爵、任王国大内侍长。

1345年，罗贝托、其母菲利帕和侄女桑恰被控谋杀女王乔万娜一世的丈夫安德烈亚。三人受刑，菲利帕死于狱中，罗贝托被处决，卡洛之子拉伊蒙代洛于1346年获判无罪。薄伽丘把家族的倾覆写进《名人的命运》最后一章。

en:
The Gaetani, or Caetani, were a baronial family of the Papal States who traced their origin to the city of Gaeta. Two became pope: Gelasius II in 1118 and Boniface VIII in 1294. Boniface enriched his kinsmen with the fiefs of Sermoneta and Bassiano.

The Aquila branch took shape in 1297 when Giordano Roffredo Caetani married Giovanna dell'Aquila, heiress of the counts of Fondi, adding that county to the family's lands. Onorato I Caetani, count of Fondi from 1348, backed the Avignon antipopes during the Western Schism and was excommunicated; he died in 1400 after a failed assault on Rome.

Feuds with the Colonna troubled the Roman Campagna for generations. In 1500 Pope Alexander VI confiscated the Caetani fiefs for his daughter Lucrezia Borgia, though the family later recovered them.
zh:
加埃塔尼（卡埃塔尼）是教皇国的男爵世家，族源可追溯到加埃塔城。家族有两人当选教皇：1118年的格拉修二世和1294年的博义八世。博义八世把塞尔莫内塔、巴萨诺等封邑赏给族人。

阿奎拉支系形成于1297年，焦尔达诺·罗弗雷多·加埃塔尼娶丰迪伯爵的女继承人乔万娜·德拉奎拉，丰迪伯国随之并入家族产业。奥诺拉托一世·加埃塔尼自1348年起任丰迪伯爵，西方教会大分裂期间支持阿维尼翁的对立教宗，因此被绝罚，1400年攻打罗马失败后死去。

加埃塔尼与科隆纳家族的世仇搅动罗马坎帕尼亚数代。1500年教皇亚历山大六世没收其封邑赐给女儿卢克雷齐娅·博尔贾，但家族后来收回这些土地。

en:
The Campbells were a Highland clan around Loch Awe in Argyll. Their name appears in 1263; marriage to the O'Duine heiress brought Loch Awe, and the clan was first known as Clan O'Duine. Their chief Cailean Mór was killed in 1296, and later chiefs bore the style MacCailean Mór. His son Neil backed Robert the Bruce, fought at Bannockburn in 1314 and married the king's sister Mary.

Created Lord Campbell in 1445 and Earl of Argyll in 1457, the Campbells rivaled the MacDonalds after the fall of the Lords of the Isles in 1493. The eighth earl led the Covenanters, was defeated in 1645 and executed in 1661; his son was beheaded in 1685 after Argyll's Rising.

Campbell soldiers led the Glencoe massacre of the MacDonalds in 1692, and the family became Dukes of Argyll in 1701. They fought for the government at Culloden in 1746.
zh:
坎贝尔家族是高地氏族，势力围绕阿盖尔的洛赫奥湖建立。坎贝尔一名见于1263年；家族通过与奥杜因家族的女继承人联姻取得洛赫奥，最初称奥杜因氏族。族长卡兰·莫尔于1296年被杀，此后族长沿用麦卡兰·莫尔的称号。其子尼尔追随罗伯特·布鲁斯，参加1314年班诺克本战役并娶国王之妹玛丽为妻。

坎贝尔家族于1445年受封勋爵，1457年受封阿盖尔伯爵。1493年群岛领主势力覆灭后，家族开始与麦克唐纳家族争斗。第八代伯爵领导誓约派，1645年战败，1661年被处死；其子于1685年阿盖尔起事后被斩首。

1692年，坎贝尔士兵主导了对麦克唐纳家族的格伦科屠杀；1701年家族晋封阿盖尔公爵。1746年他们站在政府一方参加卡洛登战役。

en:
The Candarids were an Oghuz Turkish dynasty of the Kayı branch who ruled Paphlagonia on the Black Sea from 1291 to 1461, with capitals at Kastamonu and Sinop. The founder, Şemseddin Yaman Candar, received Eflani from the Seljuk sultan Mesud II after rescuing him from Mongol captivity.

His son Süleyman conquered Kastamonu, Safranbolu and Sinop, ruling as an Ilkhanate vassal until Abu Sa'id died in 1335. In 1337 Süleyman still reigned, though his sons Ibrahim and Ali were rivals for the succession. Bayezid I took Kastamonu in 1391, but after Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402 the dynasty recovered its lands under İsfendiyar Bey, from whom it is also called the Isfendiyar line.

The Candarids remained semi-independent Ottoman vassals until Mehmed the Conqueror captured Sinop and annexed the beylik in 1461. Its last rulers entered Ottoman service as provincial governors.
zh:
詹达尔王朝出自乌古斯突厥卡伊部，1291至1461年间统治黑海沿岸的帕夫拉戈尼亚，先后以卡斯塔莫努和锡诺普为都。开国君主沙姆塞丁·亚曼·詹达尔将塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世从蒙古人手中救出，获封埃夫拉尼。

其子苏莱曼征服卡斯塔莫努、萨夫兰博卢和锡诺普，作为伊儿汗国藩属统治，直到1335年不赛因去世。1337年苏莱曼仍在位，但其子易卜拉欣和阿里已在争夺继承权。巴耶济德一世于1391年攻占卡斯塔莫努，1402年帖木儿在安卡拉取胜后，王朝在伊斯凡迪亚尔贝伊治下复国，因此也称伊斯凡迪亚尔王朝。

詹达尔人以半独立藩属的身份周旋，直到征服者穆罕默德于1461年攻陷锡诺普、吞并贝伊国。末代统治者转入奥斯曼麾下出任地方总督。

en:
The Kavanaghs are the senior surviving line of the Uí Ceinnselaig, the Gaelic dynasty that supplied the kings of Leinster. Their surname was first taken by Domhnall Caomhánach, son of Diarmait Mac Murchada, the king of Leinster who was deposed in 1167 and called in English help under Strongbow, opening the Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland.

Fostered at the monastery of St Caomhán, Domhnall bore the nickname Caomhánach, meaning of Caomhán, and ruled as king of Leinster from 1171 to 1175.

While the English crown held the coastal towns around Dublin, his descendants kept an independent Gaelic lordship in the Leinster interior and went on styling themselves kings of Leinster. Art mac Art MacMurrough-Kavanagh was the most formidable of these later kings, and Cahir Mac Art Kavanagh remained a major Leinster magnate on the eve of the Tudor conquest.
zh:
卡瓦纳家族是盖尔人的乌伊·琴塞拉伊格王朝留存的主支，曾产生伦斯特诸王。家族姓氏始于多姆纳尔·卡瓦纳，他的父亲、伦斯特国王迪尔梅德·麦克穆尔查达于1167年被废后向“强弓”率领的英格兰势力求援，开启了盎格鲁-诺曼人对爱尔兰的入侵。

多姆纳尔在圣卡万修道院寄养，得到绰号“卡瓦纳”，意为“属于卡万的”，他于1171—1175年出任伦斯特国王。

英格兰王室控制都柏林沿海城镇后，他的后裔仍在伦斯特内地保有独立领地，继续自称伦斯特国王。其中最强势的是阿尔特·麦克阿尔特·麦克穆罗-卡瓦纳；卡希尔·麦克阿尔特·卡瓦纳则是都铎征服前夕的重要豪强。

en:
The direct House of Capet ruled France from Paris. Its founder Hugh Capet, an Ile-de-France lord, was elected king in 987 after the last Carolingian died, and made the crown hereditary by crowning his son in his lifetime. Early kings held little beyond Ile-de-France, but Philip II Augustus, from 1180, broke the Plantagenet grip on western France, triumphed at Bouvines in 1214 and enlarged the royal domain.

Louis IX, later Saint Louis, built royal justice machinery and died on crusade at Tunis in 1270. Philip IV the Fair quarrelled with the papacy, called the Estates-General in 1302 and suppressed the Knights Templar.

His three sons died without male heirs, and when Charles IV died in 1328 lawyers invoked the Salic law to bar Edward III of England, whose claim came through a woman, giving the crown to Philip VI of Valois and opening the Hundred Years' War. Hugh Capet's blood carried on through cadet branches including Valois, Anjou and Bourbon.
zh:
卡佩直系王朝在巴黎统治法国。创立者于格·卡佩本是法兰西岛大贵族，987年末代加洛林国王死后被推举为王，他生前即让儿子加冕，把选举变为世袭。早期卡佩国王实际只控制法兰西岛一带，但1180年在位的腓力二世·奥古斯都打破金雀花家族对法国西部的控制，1214年布汶获胜，王室领地大幅扩张。

后来封圣的路易九世建立王室司法体系，1270年在十字军途中死于突尼斯；“美男子”腓力四世与教宗相争，1302年召开三级会议，并镇压圣殿骑士团。

他的三个儿子都无男嗣而终；1328年查理四世去世后，法学家援引萨利克法，排除经女性一脉争位的英王爱德华三世，把王冠交给瓦卢瓦堂亲腓力六世，百年战争由此开端。于格·卡佩的血脉仍通过瓦卢瓦、安茹、波旁等支系延续。

en:
The dalle Carceri were Veronese nobles whose members served as podestà of Verona and Mantua in the twelfth century before joining the Fourth Crusade to Greece. In 1205 Euboea, called Negroponte by the Venetians, was granted to three Veronese barons, who split it into three triarchies. By 1209 Ravano dalle Carceri was sole lord and put the island under Venetian protection; after he died in 1216 his heirs partitioned the triarchies, and the family supplied most of Negroponte's rulers for the next two centuries.

The hexarch Carintana dalle Carceri's death in 1255 sparked the War of the Euboeote Succession against Achaea's prince. In Italy the family's fortunes collapsed when members were convicted of murder in 1277 and banished from Verona.

In Greece the line continued: Giovanni ruled Negroponte from 1340 to 1359, and Niccolò III was Duke of the Archipelago and island lord until his death in 1383. As last triarch he left his territories to Venice, which held Euboea until the Ottoman conquest of Chalkis in 1470.
zh:
达莱·卡尔切里是维罗纳贵族，12世纪多人出任维罗纳和曼托瓦的执政官，后随第四次十字军前往希腊。1205年，威尼斯人所称内格罗蓬特即埃维亚岛封给三位维罗纳男爵，划为三个三头领地。1209年拉瓦诺·达莱·卡尔切里成为全岛之主，把岛屿置于威尼斯保护下；1216年他死后继承人瓜分三头领地，此后近两世纪内格罗蓬特统治者多出自该家族。

1255年六分领主卡林塔娜·达莱·卡尔切里之死引发对亚该亚的埃维亚继承战争。意大利本土，成员1277年因谋杀获罪，被逐维罗纳而失势。

希腊一支延续：乔万尼1340至1359年统治内格罗蓬特，尼古拉三世身兼群岛公爵和岛屿领主，直至1383年去世。作为末代三头领主，他把领地留给威尼斯；威尼斯统治埃维亚至1470年奥斯曼攻陷哈尔基斯。

en:
The da Carrara, or Carraresi, were Lombard nobles from near Padua, where Luitolfo founded Carrara abbey in 1027. Loyal to the emperors and enriched by Paduan estates, they rose with the commune: Jacopo I the Great made himself lord of Padua in 1318. After Verona's Scaligeri took the city, Marsilio da Carrara ousted them in 1338 and restored family rule.

Under Francesco il Vecchio they reached their height, taking Verona and other Veneto cities and controlling much of the region. A noted patron of letters, he was close to Petrarch, who retired to its Arquà fief and left him a Giotto Virgin.

In 1388 Milan and Venice forced Francesco il Vecchio to abdicate; he died a Visconti prisoner at Monza in 1393. His son Francesco Novello recovered Padua for a time, but the Venetians annexed the city in 1405, and in 1406 Francesco Novello and his sons were strangled in a Venetian prison. Bishop Stefano alone escaped to Rome, where he died in 1448, and the elder line became extinct.
zh:
卡拉拉家族（又称卡拉雷西）是帕多瓦附近的伦巴第贵族，族人卢伊托尔福于1027年建卡拉拉修道院。家族效忠皇帝，凭帕多瓦地产致富，随公社崛起：“大帝”雅各布一世1318年自立为帕多瓦领主。城市一度被维罗纳斯卡拉家族占据，马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉1338年将其驱逐，恢复家族统治。

老弗朗切斯科时家族达于鼎盛，取维罗纳等威尼托诸城，控制地区大部。他又是著名文学赞助人，与彼特拉克交厚；彼特拉克晚年退隐家族封地阿尔夸，还把乔托所绘圣母像遗赠给他。

1388年米兰与威尼斯联手迫使老弗朗切斯科退位，他1393年作为维斯孔蒂的囚徒死于蒙扎。其子小弗朗切斯科一度收复帕多瓦，威尼斯1405年吞并该城；1406年小弗朗切斯科和诸子在威尼斯狱中被缢死，只有主教斯德望逃到罗马，1448年死于当地，家族长支就此绝嗣。

en:
The del Carretto were a noble house of Liguria and Piedmont, descended through the Aleramici from Boniface del Vasto. His son Henry, called il Guercio, held the march of Savona in the twelfth century and served Frederick Barbarossa as envoy at the Peace of Constance. The family lost sovereignty over the city of Savona in the wars of the communes but held Finale, fighting on the imperial Ghibelline side against Genoa and the Lombard League.

Henry's sons Otto and Henry divided their inheritance around 1185; their descendants held fiefs in Liguria and Piedmont. Otto del Carretto became podestà of Genoa and patronized troubadours. Ilaria del Carretto, wife of Paolo Guinigi of Lucca, had her tomb carved by Jacopo della Quercia, and Fabrizio became Grand Master of the Knights Hospitaller in 1513.

Finale remained directly subject to the empire until 1602, when it passed to Philip III of Spain. The family's independence in Liguria ended.
zh:
德尔·卡雷托家族是利古里亚和皮埃蒙特的古老贵族，属阿莱拉米奇一系，先祖为博尼法乔·德尔·瓦斯托。其子绰号“斜眼”的恩里科于12世纪领有萨沃纳边区，作为腓特烈一世的使节参与《康斯坦茨和约》谈判。公社战争中家族失去对萨沃纳城的主权，却守住菲纳莱，站在吉伯林派一边同热那亚和伦巴第同盟作战。

1185年前后，恩里科二子奥托内和恩里科瓜分家业，后裔在利古里亚和皮埃蒙特有封邑。奥托内·德尔·卡雷托任热那亚执政官并资助行吟诗人。卢卡的保罗·圭尼吉之妻伊拉莉亚，其陵墓由雅各布·德拉·奎尔恰雕刻；法布里齐奥于1513年任医院骑士团大团长。

菲纳莱一直保有帝国直辖地位，直到1602年并入西班牙国王腓力三世的版图。家族在利古里亚的独立权势就此终结。

en:
The Casali were a Tuscan noble family attested from 1217 around Cortona, where their castles guarded roads between the upper Tiber and the Valdichiana. Guglielmino Casali became podestà of Arezzo in 1307 and later imperial vicar in Cortona.

In 1325 Ranieri II Casali became lord of Cortona and Pierle, founding a signoria lasting over eighty years. His son Bartolomeo succeeded in 1351 and was confirmed as imperial vicar by Charles IV in 1355. The family persuaded Pope John XXII to raise Cortona to a bishopric in 1325 and built the Palazzo Casali.

In 1407 Aloigi Battista Casali murdered his uncle Francesco, who had governed since 1400; two years later Aloigi was overthrown and forced to surrender Cortona to King Ladislaus of Naples, who passed it to Florence. Part of the family settled in Bologna, later producing diplomats including Gregorio Casali, Henry VIII's ambassador at the Holy See.
zh:
卡萨利家族是托斯卡纳的贵族，1217年已见载于科尔托纳周围山区，其城堡扼守台伯河上游与瓦尔迪基亚纳之间的通路。古列尔米诺·卡萨利于1307年出任阿雷佐执政官，后来又任科尔托纳的帝国代理人。

1325年，拉涅利二世·卡萨利自立为科尔托纳和皮耶尔莱的领主，开创延续八十余年的领主政权。其子巴尔托洛梅奥于1351年继位，1355年被查理四世确认为帝国代理人。家族还于1325年促成教皇约翰二十二世把科尔托纳升为主教区，并修建了卡萨利宫。

1407年，阿洛伊吉·巴蒂斯塔·卡萨利谋杀了自1400年起执政的叔父弗朗切斯科；两年后阿洛伊吉被推翻，被迫把科尔托纳交给那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳，后者又将该城转手佛罗伦萨。部分族人随后定居博洛尼亚，后世出了外交家格雷戈里奥·卡萨利，他曾任亨利八世派驻教廷的大使。

en:
The Castelbarco were a noble house of medieval Trent, recorded in the twelfth century as the bishops' vassals. Briano Castelbarco seized Avio and Lizzana, settling the family in the Vallagarina. His son Azzone allied with Ezzelino III da Romano after Frederick II suspended the bishopric in 1236.

Guglielmo da Castelbarco, lord from 1265, began Sant'Anastasia in Verona, hosted Dante and held Bergamo for Henry VII in 1310. He died without direct heirs in 1320, and his nephews divided his lands. At its height in the mid-fourteenth century, the family's domain reached the gates of Verona and Vicenza and west to Lake Garda.

In 1411 Azzone of Avio bequeathed his fiefs to Venice, which destroyed Lizzana, Albano and Nomesino in 1441. After Agnadello in 1509 the valley passed under Austrian rule; only the Gresta branch survived, moving to Milan in the late seventeenth century.
zh:
卡斯泰尔巴科是中世纪特伦托贵族，12世纪见载为主教封臣。布里亚诺夺取阿维奥和利扎纳，将家族安顿在瓦拉加里纳。其子阿佐内在1236年腓特烈二世暂时取缔主教区后与埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺结盟。

1265年继位的古列尔莫·达·卡斯泰尔巴科在维罗纳发起修建圣阿纳斯塔西娅教堂，款待但丁，1310年替亨利七世镇守贝加莫。他于1320年无直系继承人而终，领地由诸侄瓜分。14世纪中叶鼎盛时家族疆域延伸到维罗纳和维琴察城下，西抵加尔达湖。

1411年，阿维奥的阿佐内把封地遗赠给威尼斯，威尼斯于1441年拆毁利扎纳、阿尔巴诺和诺梅西诺诸堡。1509年阿尼亚代洛战役后，瓦拉加里纳转入奥地利统治，只有格雷斯塔支系幸存，于17世纪末迁往米兰。

en:
The Castracani degli Antelminelli, better known as the Antelminelli, were a Ghibelline noble family of Lucca. Exiled by the Black Guelphs in 1300, Castruccio Castracani made his name as a condottiero, serving Uguccione della Faggiuola of Pisa from 1313. He helped take Lucca in 1314 and win at Montecatini in 1315, and was elected lifelong lord of Lucca in 1316 after being freed from Uguccione's prison.

Named imperial vicar in 1320, Castruccio crushed the Florentines at Altopascio in 1325 and became duke of Lucca, Pistoia, Volterra and Luni. He took Pisa in 1327 but died suddenly in 1328, and the family's dominance collapsed.

In 1596 most Antelminelli were imprisoned or executed on a charge of conspiring with Tuscany. Alessandro Antelminelli escaped to London and served Tuscany as Amerigo Salvetti. Machiavelli wrote a biography of Castruccio.
zh:
卡斯特拉卡尼·德利·安泰尔米内利家族（常简称安泰尔米内利）是卢卡的吉伯林派贵族。1300年被黑圭尔夫派放逐后，卡斯特鲁乔·卡斯特拉卡尼以雇佣军队长成名，1313年起效力于比萨的乌古乔内·德拉·法焦拉。他参与1314年攻取卢卡和1315年蒙特卡蒂尼之战，后被人从乌古乔内的监狱救出，于1316年被选为卢卡终身领主。

卡斯特鲁乔于1320年被任命为帝国代理人，1325年在阿尔托帕肖大败佛罗伦萨人，受封卢卡、皮斯托亚、沃尔泰拉和卢尼公爵。他于1327年攻占比萨，1328年暴卒，家族的权势随之倾覆。

1596年，多数安泰尔米内利族人因被控与托斯卡纳密谋而被捕或处死。亚历山德罗·安泰尔米内利逃到伦敦，化名阿梅里戈·萨尔韦蒂为托斯卡纳效力。马基雅维利为卡斯特鲁乔写过传记。

en:
The House of Castro was a great Castilian noble lineage, probably named after Castrojeriz in Burgos. Its first clearly attested member was the twelfth-century count Fernando García de Hita, a vassal of Queen Urraca. After the senior line failed, a branch settled in Galicia, becoming its most powerful nobility and holding Lemos, Trastámara and Sarria.

Pedro Fernández de Castro, called the Warrior, was lord of Monforte de Lemos in the early fourteenth century. His daughter Inés, born in 1320, loved the future Peter I of Portugal, but Afonso IV had her killed at Coimbra in 1355; Peter later had her remains crowned as queen.

The county of Lemos became a hereditary title in the family in 1456 and was raised to the first rank of grandees in 1520. The house died out for lack of heirs, and Lemos passed to the House of Alba.
zh:
卡斯特罗家族是卡斯蒂利亚的大贵族世系，名称可能来自布尔戈斯的卡斯特罗赫里斯。可考的最早成员是12世纪的伯爵费尔南多·加西亚·德·伊塔，他是女王乌拉卡的封臣。长支绝嗣后，一支旁系定居加利西亚，成为当地最有权势的贵族，领有莱莫斯、特拉斯塔马拉和萨里亚。

绰号“战士”的佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·卡斯特罗是14世纪初的蒙福特-德莱莫斯领主。其女伊内斯生于1320年，与后来的葡萄牙国王佩德罗一世相恋，却在1355年被阿方索四世下令杀害于科英布拉，佩德罗后来又将她的遗骸加冕为王后。

1456年起，莱莫斯伯爵成为该家族的世袭头衔，1520年位列第一等大公。家族最终因无嗣而衰，莱莫斯转入阿尔瓦家族之手。

en:
The Counts of Celje, German Cilli, were the most powerful late medieval noble dynasty of present-day Slovenia. They began as lords of Sanneck castle in Lower Styria, first recorded around 1130. Frederick of Sanneck inherited the Celje lands in 1333, and in 1341 Emperor Louis IV raised him to imperial count, taking the title Cilli from Celje Castle.

At the 1396 Battle of Nicopolis, Hermann II saved King Sigismund's life and received Croatian estates; his daughter Barbara married Sigismund in 1405 and became Holy Roman Empress. In 1436 the counts became imperial princes, leading to war with the Habsburgs until an inheritance treaty in 1443.

Ulrich II, regent of Hungary, succeeded John Hunyadi as captain general in 1456 but was murdered in Belgrade that November by Hunyadi's son. The male line died out, and the Habsburgs inherited the Celje domains.
zh:
采利斯基家族（德语称采列伯爵）是今斯洛文尼亚中世纪晚期最有权势的贵族王朝。他们原是下施蒂里亚绍内克堡的领主，约1130年首见记载。绍内克的腓特烈于1333年取得采列领地，1341年被皇帝路易四世升为帝国伯爵，头衔采列得自采列城堡。

1396年尼科波利斯战役中，赫尔曼二世救了国王西吉斯蒙德一命，获封克罗地亚地产；女儿芭芭拉于1405年嫁给西吉斯蒙德，成为神圣罗马帝国皇后。1436年采列伯爵受封帝国亲王，与哈布斯堡开战，直到1443年签订继承条约。

匈牙利摄政乌尔里希二世于1456年继匈雅提出任大将军，同年11月在贝尔格莱德被匈雅提之子派人刺杀。男系断绝，采列领地落入哈布斯堡之手。

en:
The Celsi were a patrician family of Venice, traditionally said to have come from Ravenna, whose name first appears in the documents in 1122. Pietro Celsi commanded galleys in Enrico Dandolo's reconquest of Zara in 1202.

The house usually played only a modest part in Venetian public life, so the election of Lorenzo Celsi as doge in 1361, after he had led Venetian fleets against Genoa, came as a surprise. As doge he crushed the revolt of Saint Titus in Crete, whose leaders had tried to set up an independent state, and he died in office in 1365.

Later Celsi mostly held colonial and provincial posts, though three brothers of the house fought in the campaign that ended at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571. The family line died out with Francesco Maria Celsi in 1789.
zh:
切尔西家族是威尼斯的贵族世家，传统上认为来自拉文纳，其名字最早见于1122年的文献。彼得罗·切尔西于1202年在恩里科·丹多洛收复扎拉的战事中指挥桨帆船舰队。

该家族在公共事务中向来角色有限，因此洛伦佐·切尔西在率舰队与热那亚作战之后于1361年当选总督，出乎许多人意料。任内他镇压了克里特岛首领试图建立独立政权的圣提多起义，并于1365年卒于任上。

此后切尔西家族成员多出任殖民地和外省职务，不过家族的三兄弟参加了1571年勒班陀海战前的战事。1789年，随着弗朗切斯科·马里亚·切尔西去世，家族绝嗣。

en:
The House of la Cerda was the senior cadet line of the Castilian House of Burgundy, founded by Ferdinand de la Cerda, eldest son of Alfonso X. His nickname came from the tuft of hair, a cerda or bristle, on his chest.

Ferdinand died in 1275, and Alfonso X named Ferdinand's son Alfonso heir ahead of Ferdinand's brother Sancho. Sancho revolted and took the crown; the arbitration of Torrellas in 1304 barred Alfonso and his descendants from the throne.

In France, Luis de la Cerda was granted the Canary Islands as Prince of Fortuna by the pope in 1344. His kinsman Charles became Constable of France, but was murdered in 1354 by men of Charles II of Navarre. In Castile its heiress Isabel married the first Count of Medinaceli, and through her the house became the stem of the Dukes of Medinaceli.
zh:
德·拉·塞尔达家族是卡斯蒂利亚勃艮第王室的长支旁系，始祖为阿方索十世的长子费尔南多·德·拉·塞尔达。他因胸口生有一撮硬毛（塞尔达意为鬃毛）而得此绰号。

费尔南多于1275年去世，阿方索十世欲立费尔南多之子阿方索为继承人，排在费尔南多的弟弟桑治之前。桑治起兵夺位，1304年的托雷利亚斯仲裁剥夺了阿方索及其后裔的王位继承权。

在法国，路易斯·德·拉·塞尔达于1344年被教宗封为加那利群岛的福尔图纳亲王。同族夏尔成为法国统帅，却在1354年被纳瓦拉国王夏尔二世的部下刺杀。卡斯蒂利亚支系的女继承人伊莎贝尔嫁给首任梅迪纳塞利伯爵，成为梅迪纳塞利公爵的先祖。

en:
The Ceva were a branch of the Aleramici, the Frankish-descended marquises of Piedmont and Liguria, named after the town of Ceva at the foot of the Apennines. When Bonifacio del Vasto's lands were divided among his sons, Ceva passed to Anselmo, whose son Guglielmo is the first marquis clearly attested in the documents.

Guglielmo I pursued an expansionist policy between the rival communes of Alba and Asti, but after his death the marquisate was split into shares held jointly by his many sons, which weakened it and led to frequent changes of allegiance. In 1257 Alba forced the marquises under its hegemony, and in 1260 they transferred their homage to Charles I of Anjou.

From 1295 they were repeatedly vassals of Asti, and for two centuries the marquisate passed back and forth between the Visconti, the House of Orléans and the dukes of Savoy. In 1531 the Emperor Charles V assigned it definitively to the Duchy of Savoy.
zh:
切瓦家族是阿莱拉米奇家族的支系，后者是源出法兰克人、统治皮埃蒙特和利古里亚的侯爵世家；切瓦得名于亚平宁山麓的切瓦城。博尼法乔·德尔瓦斯托的领地被诸子分割时，切瓦分给安塞尔莫，其子古列尔莫是文献中第一位可考的侯爵。

古列尔莫一世在阿尔巴和阿斯蒂两城邦间推行扩张，但他死后侯国被众多儿子分股共管，国势削弱，盟属频繁改换。1257年阿尔巴迫使切瓦诸侯接受霸权，1260年他们转而向安茹的查理一世效忠。

1295年起他们屡次沦为阿斯蒂附庸，此后两百年侯国在维斯孔蒂、奥尔良和萨伏依公爵之间反复易手。1531年皇帝查理五世将切瓦侯国最终划归萨伏依公国。

en:
The House of Chalon was a Burgundian noble house and cadet branch of the Ivrea line of Burgundy's counts, named after Chalon-sur-Saone, inherited by its founder John the Old from his mother. John, count of Auxonne and Chalon, in 1237 exchanged those lands with Duke Hugh IV of Burgundy for Salins in the Free County, whose salt works made his fortune.

Of his many children, the eldest Hugh married the heiress Adelaide of Merania and became count palatine of Burgundy, while a younger son of his third marriage began the Chalon-Arlay branch at Arlay. In 1337 its branches stretched across the border between France and the Empire.

The Arlay lords proved the most enduring: when John III of Chalon-Arlay married Mary des Baux in 1386, Orange came to the house, and his descendant Rene of Chalon, the last male of the line, left Orange in 1544 to his cousin William of Nassau, future William the Silent, begetting Orange-Nassau.
zh:
沙隆家族是勃艮第贵族世家，为勃艮第伯爵伊夫雷亚世系的支系，得名于创始人“长者”让经母亲继承的索恩河畔沙隆。让身兼欧索讷和沙隆伯爵，1237年把这些土地与勃艮第公爵于格四世交换，取得自由伯国的萨兰领地，当地盐矿为他带来巨额财富。

他的众多子女中，长子于格娶梅拉尼亚女继承人阿代拉伊德，成为勃艮第行宫伯爵；第三次婚姻所生的幼子在阿尔莱开创沙隆-阿尔莱支系。到1337年，家族各支已横跨法兰西与帝国边境。

阿尔莱领主一脉延续最久：1386年沙隆-阿尔莱的让三世娶玛丽·德斯·博，奥兰治亲王国随之归入家族；后裔勒内·德·沙隆作为该支最后男嗣，1544年去世时把奥兰治留给表亲拿骚的威廉，即后来的“沉默者”威廉，奥兰治-拿骚家族由此发端。

en:
The Champa dynasty denotes the restored Varman line that ruled from Vijaya after the Khmer occupation of 1190 to 1220. Prince Angsaraja of Turai-vijaya was crowned there in 1226 as Jaya Paramesvaravarman II and rebuilt irrigation works and the temple of Po Nagar.

Indravarman V faced the 1282 Mongol invasion: he and his son Harijit withdrew into the mountains and wore down Sogetu's army until their withdrawal in 1285. Harijit reigned as Jaya Simhavarman III from 1288 and in 1306 married the Vietnamese princess Huyền Trân, ceding two northern districts to Dai Viet as the bride price.

His son Jaya Simhavarman IV tried to recover them but was defeated in 1312 and died captive in Annam. The Tran installed a puppet governor and Champa's Sanskrit epigraphy fell silent. A later member of the line, Maha Sawa, claimed the throne in 1342 and ruled until 1360, while the dispossessed heir Jamo fled to the Tran court.
zh:
占婆王朝指1190年至1220年高棉占领结束后，在毗阇耶复国的跋摩王统。都来毗阇耶的王子安萨拉阇于1226年在此加冕，称阇耶波罗密首罗跋摩二世，修复水利和波那加神庙。

因陀罗跋摩五世遭遇1282年的蒙古入侵，他与王子诃里吉特退入山区，消耗唆都的大军，直到1285年蒙古人退兵。诃里吉特从1288年起以阇耶僧伽跋摩三世之名在位，1306年迎娶越南玄珍公主，以割让北部两州给大越为聘礼。

他的儿子阇耶僧伽跋摩四世试图收复失地，1312年兵败被俘，死于安南。陈朝随后扶植傀儡长官，占婆的梵文碑铭传统也就此中断。该世系后来的成员茶和布底于1342年夺取王位，统治到1360年；被剥夺继承权的亚莫则逃往陈朝。

en:
The house of Champaner took its name from the fortified town in eastern Gujarat. Local tradition traced the town to a Bhil raja called Champa or to the eighth-century Chavda king Vanraj, who named it after his general Champa. By the fourteenth century the principality was held by Khichi Chauhan Rajputs from Pavagadh fort above the town.

The rajas paid tribute to Ahmedabad while leaning on Malwa against Gujarat. In 1449 Gangadas was driven into Pavagadh by Muhammad Shah II and saved by a Malwa diversion.

Mahmud Begada began a twenty-month siege of Pavagadh in 1483; a Malwa relief attempt failed and the fort fell in November 1484. The last raja, Jai Singh, was executed, his lands annexed to Gujarat, and Mahmud rebuilt the town as his capital Muhammadabad. In 1535 Humayun stormed the same cliffs pursuing Bahadur Shah.
zh:
昌帕内尔家族得名于古吉拉特东部的要塞城镇尚庞。当地传说把建城归于名叫占巴的比尔人罗阇，另一说则归于8世纪的查夫达国王万罗阇，他以部将占巴之名为城命名。到14世纪，基奇·乔诃那拉杰普特人已凭借城镇上方的巴瓦加德堡统治该土邦。

罗阇们夹在古吉拉特和马尔瓦之间，向艾哈迈达巴德纳贡，又依靠马尔瓦对抗古吉拉特。1449年甘加达斯被穆罕默德沙二世逼入巴瓦加德堡，靠马尔瓦出兵牵制才得以保全。

马哈茂德·贝加达于1483年围攻巴瓦加德堡，历时二十个月；马尔瓦救援失败，堡垒于1484年11月陷落。末代罗阇杰·辛格被处死，领地并入古吉拉特，马哈茂德重建城镇为新都穆罕默达巴德。1535年胡马雍追击巴哈杜尔沙时，也攻占了堡垒。

en:
The Champlitte were a knightly house of Franche-Comté, descended from the counts of Champagne of the House of Blois. Their ancestor Odo I, born in 1123 to Count Hugh of Champagne but denied legitimacy, was raised by his Burgundian mother's kin and became lord of Champlitte, near Vesoul.

His sons joined the Fourth Crusade: Odo II died at the siege of Constantinople in 1204, while William of Champlitte conquered the Morea together with Geoffrey of Villehardouin and in 1205 founded the Principality of Achaea as its first Frankish prince.

William died in Apulia in 1209 while returning to France, and his heirs failed to secure the succession, so Achaea passed to the Villehardouin. The family's Burgundian lordship of Champlitte was later inherited by a younger branch of the house of Vergy.
zh:
尚普利特家族是弗朗什-孔泰的骑士世家，为布卢瓦家族香槟伯爵一脉的幼支。始祖厄德一世生于1123年，是香槟伯爵于格之子却不被承认婚生地位，由勃艮第的母族抚养成人，成为沃苏勒附近尚普利特的领主。

他的儿子们参加了第四次十字军东征：厄德二世于1204年死于君士坦丁堡围城战，威廉·德·尚普利特则与若弗鲁瓦·德·维尔阿杜安联手征服摩里亚，于1205年建立亚该亚公国并成为首任法兰克亲王。

威廉于1209年在返回法国途中死于普利亚，继承人未能接掌权位，亚该亚转入维尔阿杜安家族之手。家族在勃艮第的尚普利特领地后来由韦尔吉家族的一支幼支继承。

en:
The Chand dynasty rose in Kumaon after the collapse of the Katyuri kingdom. Tradition calls Som Chand its seventh-century founder, but inscriptions suggest the family held power from around 1019, when a Rajput prince migrated to the hills amid the Ghaznavid invasions and set himself up at Champawat, calling his state Kurmanchal. From there the Chands gradually rose from feudatories to kings.

In 1563 Raja Kalyan Chand moved the capital to Almora. His son Rudra Chand seized Sira, invaded Garhwal and in 1587 travelled to Lahore to offer obedience to Akbar. His son Lakshmi Chand built the Bagnath temple at Bageshwar in 1602.

In 1790 Gorkha armies drove out the last raja, Mahendra Chand. British forces captured Almora in 1815, and the Treaty of Sugauli in 1816 incorporated Kumaon into British India.
zh:
卡秋里王国衰落后，昌德王朝在库马翁兴起。传统说法以7世纪的索姆·昌德为开国者，但铭文显示家族约在1019年开始掌权：一位拉杰普特王子趁伽色尼入侵之乱避入山区，在金巴瓦特立足，定国名为俱尔门遮罗。昌德诸王以此为都，从封臣逐步成为君王。

1563年罗阇卡尔扬·昌德迁都阿尔莫拉。其子鲁陀罗·昌德夺取锡拉、进攻加瓦尔，并于1587年前往拉合尔向阿克巴朝觐。鲁陀罗之子拉克希米·昌德于1602年在巴盖什沃尔修建巴格纳特神庙。

1790年廓尔喀军队赶走末代罗阇马亨德拉·昌德。英军于1815年攻占阿尔莫拉，1816年的《苏高利条约》将库马翁并入英属印度。

en:
The Chanda dynasty was the Gond royal house of Chanda in the Wardha river country of eastern Maharashtra. The Gonds under Kol Bhill overthrew the Mana rulers of Wairagarh, and Bhim Ballal Singh founded the kingdom by 1320, ruling from Sirpur with Manikgarh as his stronghold.

Later kings adopted the title Shah, and Khandkya Ballal Shah, who reigned from 1472, built Ballarpur fort and founded Chandrapur, which later became the dynasty's capital. The kings developed irrigation tanks and the first regular revenue system among the Gond states. Recorded as independent in the Ain-i-Akbari, they later became Mughal feudatories within the Berar Subah.

Maratha power ended the line: Raghoji I Bhonsle of Nagpur forced a treaty in 1749 that took two-thirds of the revenue. In 1751 he defeated the rebellious Nilkanth Shah and imprisoned him in Ballarpur Fort, ending Gond rule at Chanda.
zh:
钱达王朝是冈德人的王室，统治马哈拉施特拉东部瓦尔达河流域。科尔·比尔率冈德人推翻瓦伊拉加尔的马纳统治者，随后比姆·巴拉尔·辛格于1320年前建国，以西尔布尔为都、马尼加尔为要塞。

后来的君主改称“沙阿”，1472年即位的坎德克亚·巴拉尔·沙阿修建巴拉尔布尔要塞，创建钱德拉布尔，后者成为王朝都城。诸王修灌溉蓄水池，建冈德诸国首套正规税制。《阿克巴政典》记载它曾独立，后来成为莫卧儿贝拉尔省的附庸。

马拉塔势力终结王统：那格浦尔的拉戈吉一世·邦斯勒于1749年逼签条约，夺去三分之二赋税。1751年他击败反抗的尼尔坎特·沙阿，将其囚于巴拉尔布尔堡，钱达的冈德统治就此告终。

en:
The Chandel, also written Chandela, were a Rajput clan whose families ruled several kingdoms in northern India; its most celebrated branch were the Chandelas of Jejakabhukti, masters of Bundelkhand from the tenth to the thirteenth century. A younger line founded Kahlur, later called Bilaspur: Raja Bir Chand established it around 697, and Raja Kahal Chand built Kahlur Fort around 900, after which the dynasty was also known as the Kahluria.

Its rajas kept their independence in the Punjab Himalaya, moving their capital to Bilaspur under Dip Chand (r. 1663-1665). Raja Bhim Chand defeated a Mughal army at Nadaun and abdicated in 1692 to live as an ascetic.

His son Ajmer Chand made neighbouring hill states tributary. In 1815 Raja Mahan Chand placed the state under British protection as one of the Simla Hill States.
zh:
钱代尔（又译昌德拉）是拉杰普特氏族，各支在北印度建立过多个王国，最显赫的一支是10至13世纪统治本德尔坎德的杰贾卡布克蒂昌德拉人。另有一支幼支开创了后称比拉斯布尔的贾罗尔邦：罗阇比尔·昌德约于697年立国，罗阇卡哈尔·昌德约在900年修筑贾罗尔堡，王朝此后又称卡劳里亚。

历代罗阇在旁遮普喜马拉雅山区长期保持独立，迪普·昌德（1663—1665年在位）将都城迁至比拉斯布尔。罗阇比姆·昌德在纳道恩战役中击败莫卧儿军队，1692年退位修行。

其子阿杰梅尔·昌德迫使邻近山邦纳贡称臣。1815年罗阇马汉·昌德将本邦置于英国保护之下，成为西姆拉山邦之一。

en:
The Chandelas were a Rajput dynasty who ruled Jejakabhukti, the historic Bundelkhand of central India, from the early ninth to the fourteenth century. Founded by Nannuka around 831 as a small chiefdom centered on Khajuraho, the family began as feudatories of the Gurjara-Pratiharas before Yashovarman made it virtually independent and Dhanga raised it to sovereign power.

Its kings built the Hindu and Jain temples of Khajuraho and forts including Kalinjar and Mahoba. Raids by the Ghaznavids and Ghurids weakened the kingdom; Prithviraj Chauhan sacked Mahoba around 1183, and in 1202 Qutb al-Din Aibak invaded and received the surrender of the last powerful king Paramardi.

Reduced to minor chiefs, the later Chandelas lost ground to the Bundelas and Baghelas; Hammiravarman, ruling from about 1288 to 1311, no longer used the imperial title. A branch kept Kalinjar until its ruler fell fighting Sher Shah Suri in 1545.
zh:
旃提罗是拉杰普特王朝，9世纪初至14世纪统治中印度的杰贾卡布克蒂，即本德尔肯德地区。南努卡约于831年建立以克久拉霍为中心的小首领邦，最初臣属瞿折罗-波罗提诃罗王朝；亚索瓦尔曼使其实际独立，丹加将其提升为主权王国。

国王修建克久拉霍的印度教与耆那教神庙群，以及卡林贾尔和默霍巴等要塞。伽色尼和古尔的入侵削弱王国；约1183年普利色毗罗阇·乔汉洗劫默霍巴，1202年库特布丁·艾伊拜克来攻，强主帕马尔迪投降。

旃提罗人沦为小首领，向班德拉和婆稽罗家族失地；约1288至1311年在位的哈米拉瓦尔曼不再使用帝王头衔。一支据守卡林贾尔，其首领于1545年与舍尔沙·苏尔作战时阵亡。

en:
The Charltons were a Shropshire knightly family holding Charlton near Wellington, who rose through royal service and a Welsh inheritance. John Charlton entered the royal household under Edward I and became a knight and chamberlain to Edward II.

In 1309 he married Hawys Gadarn, heiress of the marcher lordship of Powys; through her he gained Welshpool and built Powis Castle between 1310 and 1315. In 1313 he was summoned to Parliament as the first Baron Charlton, commonly called Lord of Powis.

He joined the Earl of Lancaster's rising against the Despensers in 1321 and was pardoned the next year. In 1337 Edward III made him Chief Justiciar of Ireland, while his brother Thomas became Irish Lord Chancellor. John died in 1353; his line held the barony until the fifth baron's death in 1421, when the title fell into abeyance.
zh:
查尔顿家族是什罗普郡的骑士家族，在惠灵顿附近持有查尔顿，靠王室服役和威尔士遗产联姻发迹。约翰·查尔顿在爱德华一世时进入王室，后来成为爱德华二世的骑士和宫廷总管。

1309年他娶波伊斯领地女继承人哈维斯·加达恩，取得威尔士浦，并在1310年至1315年修建波伊斯城堡。1313年他被召入议会，成为第一代查尔顿男爵，又称波伊斯勋爵。

他于1321年参加兰开斯特伯爵反对勒德斯潘塞父子的起事，次年获赦。1337年爱德华三世任命他为爱尔兰最高司法官，他的兄弟托马斯则出任爱尔兰大法官。约翰于1353年去世；后裔保有爵位，直到1421年第五代男爵去世，爵位进入搁置状态。

en:
The lords of Châteauvillain were a younger branch of the Champenois house of Broyes. Hugh III of Broyes built the castle of Châteauvillain in 1160; his younger son Simon inherited the lordship and took its name.

Jean I, called the Blind, a companion of Saint Louis on the Seventh Crusade, granted the town a charter of liberties in 1286 before abdicating his titles to his son. Simon II of Châteauvillain founded the chartered village of Leffonds around 1285, and was summoned by Philip the Fair to Arras in 1303 for the war against the Flemish revolt.

The lordship was later raised to a county: it was bought in 1620 by Nicolas de L'Hospital and in 1699 by Louis de Bourbon, comte de Toulouse, whose family held it as a duchy-peerage from 1703.
zh:
沙托维兰领主家族是香槟地区布鲁瓦家族的一支幼支。布鲁瓦的于格三世于1160年修建沙托维兰城堡；他的幼子西蒙继承领地并以地名为家族名。

被称为“盲人”的让一世曾随圣路易参加第七次十字军东征，他在1286年向城镇居民颁发自由特许状，后来又把头衔让给儿子。西蒙二世约于1285年创建获得特许状的勒丰村，并在1303年被美男子腓力召到阿拉斯参加镇压佛兰德斯叛乱的战争。

这块领地后来升为伯国，1620年由尼古拉·德·洛皮塔尔买下，1699年转入图卢兹伯爵路易·德·波旁之手，其家族自1703年起以公爵兼法兰西贵族的身份持有它。

en:
The House of Châtillon was one of the great noble houses of medieval France, taking its name from Châtillon-sur-Marne in Champagne, where its ancestors held a castle of the counts of Champagne from the ninth century. Odo of Châtillon became Pope Urban II and preached the First Crusade at Clermont in 1095; Raynald of Châtillon, prince of Antioch, was executed by Saladin after the battle of Hattin in 1187.

Gaucher V of the house became constable of France under Philip the Fair and count of Porcien. Younger branches ruled Saint-Pol, Blois and Penthièvre: Charles of Blois-Châtillon claimed the duchy of Brittany jure uxoris and kindled the Breton War of Succession, falling at Auray in 1364.

The Saint-Pol branch ended in 1360, the Blois branch in 1397 and the Penthièvre branch in 1457; the county of Porcien was sold to the duke of Orléans in 1400.
zh:
沙蒂永是中世纪法兰西名门之一，得名于香槟的马恩河畔沙蒂永，先祖自9世纪起在那里为香槟伯爵镇守城堡。家族出身的厄德·德·沙蒂永后为教宗乌尔班二世，1095年在克莱芒宣讲第一次十字军；雷纳德·德·沙蒂永曾任安条克亲王，1187年哈丁战役后被萨拉丁处死。

家族的戈谢五世在美男子腓力治下任法兰西王室统帅，受封波尔西安伯爵。幼支先后统治圣波勒、布卢瓦和庞蒂耶夫尔：布卢瓦的夏尔凭妻权争夺布列塔尼公爵之位，引发布列塔尼继承战争，1364年战死欧赖。

圣波勒支系1360年绝嗣，布卢瓦支系1397年断绝，庞蒂耶夫尔支系延续至1457年；波尔西安伯国1400年卖给奥尔良公爵。

en:
The Chauhans, whose name is the vernacular form of the Sanskrit Chahamana, were a great Rajput clan. In the Agnivanshi legend, the first Chauhan sprang from the sacrificial fire on Mount Abu to defeat demons. From the seventh century their main line, the Chahamanas of Shakambhari, held the Sambhar lake country and later Ajmer, ruling Rajasthan for some four hundred years.

Their king Prithviraj III and his romance with Sanyogita filled the epic Prithviraj Raso. In 1192 he was defeated and killed by Muhammad of Ghor at the Second Battle of Tarain, and Qutb al-Din Aibak's invasion of 1197 shattered the old kingdom.

Chauhan power lived on: Hammiradeva of Ranthambore defied Alauddin Khalji until his fort fell in 1301, while the Songara held Jalor and the Deoras founded Sirohi in 1311. Chauhan houses later ruled Bundi, Kota, Patna and Sambalpur.
zh:
乔诃那一名源自梵语“查哈马纳”，是拉杰普特大族之一。相传始祖从阿布山祭火中降生，降服群魔。从7世纪起，主支沙坎巴里·查哈马纳人占据桑巴尔湖地区，后据有阿杰梅尔，在拉贾斯坦统治约四百年。

君王普里特维拉杰三世与桑约吉塔的爱情成为史诗《普里特维拉杰·拉索》的内容。1192年他在第二次塔拉因战役中被古尔的穆罕默德击败身亡，顾特卜丁·艾伯克又于1197年入侵，粉碎了旧王国。

乔诃那的势力在分支中延续：兰桑波尔的哈米拉德瓦对抗阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉，直到1301年堡垒陷落；松加拉支系守住贾洛尔，德奥拉支系于1311年建立锡罗希。此后乔诃那诸家在本迪、科塔、帕特纳和桑巴尔布尔立国。

en:
The Chauhans of Jalor were a Songara branch of the Chauhan clan, descended from the Chahamanas of Nadol. Around 1160 Kirtipala, son of the Nadol king Alhana, received twelve villages and made his seat on Sonagiri hill, where Jalore fort stood; his line took its name Songara from that golden rock.

At first feudatories of the Solanki kings of Gujarat, the Jalor Chauhans grew strong under Udayasimha in the early thirteenth century. They made Iltumish of Delhi retreat from Marwar.

Their last great ruler Kanhadadeva defended Jalore against Alauddin Khalji, a feat celebrated in the epic Kanhadade Prabandha. When Delhi's army besieged the fort in 1311, the garrison crowned his son Viramadeva, who died within days; Kanhadadeva fell fighting as the fort was stormed. A kinsman's line survived at Chandravati and Mount Abu, becoming the ruling house of Sirohi.
zh:
贾洛尔的乔诃那人是乔诃那大族的松加拉分支，源自纳多尔的查哈马纳家族。约1160年，纳多尔国王阿尔哈纳之子基尔蒂帕拉受封十二个村庄，在贾洛尔堡所在的索纳吉里山立寨，其支系因这座金色山岩得名“松加拉”。

他们起初是古吉拉特索兰基国王的附庸，13世纪初在乌达亚辛哈治下强盛，让德里的伊勒杜迷失从马尔瓦尔退兵。

末代雄主坎哈达提婆抗击阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉、死守贾洛尔，事迹见于史诗《坎哈达提婆传》。1311年德里军队围城时，守军为其子维拉马提婆加冕，新王数日即亡，坎哈达提婆也在堡垒被攻破时战死。其亲属的支系在钱德拉瓦蒂和阿布山延续，成为锡罗希统治家族。

en:
The Chauhans of Patna were an offshoot of the Chauhan clan, Rajput rulers of the Patna kingdom in the upper Mahanadi valley of Orissa. Their tradition, recorded in the seventeenth-century chronicle Kosalananda Kavyam, brought them from Garh Sambhar: when Raja Vishala Dev was killed fighting a Muslim king, his pregnant queen Jayanti Devi fled south and found shelter with a Brahmin family in Patna.

Her son Ramai Deva grew up among the people. In 1360, aged twenty, he overthrew eight local warlords as the Eastern Ganga empire crumbled and became raja of Patna. He married a niece of the Ganga king Bhanu Deva III and built the Patneswari and Kosaleswara temples.

His descendants spread across western Orissa: Balarama Deva founded Sambalpur, and branches ruled Sonepur, Khariar and Jarasingha. Chauhan houses long dominated the country between the Mahanadi and the Tel.
zh:
帕特纳的乔诃那人是乔诃那大族支系，统治奥里萨默哈讷迪河上游的帕特纳王国。据17世纪编年史《俱萨罗喜诗》记载的传说，他们来自加尔桑巴尔：罗阇毗沙拉·提婆与穆斯林君王交战被杀后，怀孕的王后贾扬蒂·提婆南逃，在帕特纳一个婆罗门家中避难。

她的儿子拉迈·提婆在民间长大。1360年他年方二十，趁东恒伽帝国崩溃，将八位地方豪强推翻，自立为帕特纳罗阇。他娶恒伽国王巴努·提婆三世的侄女为妻，修建帕特斯瓦里神庙与俱萨罗湿婆罗神庙。

他的后裔遍布奥里萨西部：巴拉罗摩·提婆建立桑巴尔布尔，其他支系统治索内布尔、卡里亚尔和贾拉辛哈。乔诃那诸家长期称雄于默哈讷迪河与特尔河之间。

en: The Chauvirey were seigneurs of the Terre de Chauvirey in the county of Burgundy, a fief near Vesoul grouping the villages of Chauvirey-le-Vieil and Chauvirey-le-Châtel. A member of the house built the castle of Chauvirey-le-Châtel in the thirteenth century, and the family's strongholds held out against a French attack in 1475.
zh: 肖维雷家族是勃艮第伯国境内肖维雷领地的领主，这块封地处在沃苏勒附近，领有旧肖维雷与沙泰勒肖维雷等村落。家族成员于13世纪修建了沙泰勒肖维雷城堡，1475年家族要塞还曾抵御法兰西军队的进攻。

en:
The Chiaromonte were a Sicilian noble family of French origin, descended from the Clermont lords of Picardy who came with the Norman count Roger I at the end of the eleventh century. In 1296 Manfredi Chiaramonte received the County of Modica.

His marriage to Isabella Mosca united Modica and Ragusa. Around 1307 the family began its Palermo seat, the Palazzo Chiaramonte, which gave its name to a Sicilian Gothic style. Through the fourteenth century the house led the Latin noble faction against the Catalan party.

Manfredi, count of Modica, was a regent for Queen Maria and in 1391 joined the oath of Castronovo against Martin of Aragon. His son Andrea continued the revolt but was beheaded outside the family palace in 1392. The family survived in minor branches whose male line died out in the eighteenth century.
zh:
基亚罗蒙特家族是源出法国的西西里贵族世家，先祖为皮卡第的克莱蒙领主，11世纪末随诺曼伯爵鲁杰罗一世来到西西里。1296年曼弗雷迪·基亚罗蒙特受封莫迪卡伯国。

他与伊莎贝拉·莫斯卡的婚姻使莫迪卡和拉古萨两个伯国合而为一，约1307年起家族在巴勒莫兴建基亚拉蒙特宫，一种西西里哥特式建筑日后以该家族命名。整个14世纪，该家族率领拉丁贵族派系对抗加泰罗尼亚派。

莫迪卡伯爵曼弗雷迪是女王玛丽亚的摄政之一，1391年参与卡斯特罗诺沃的结盟宣誓，反对阿拉贡的马丁。其子安德烈亚继续叛乱，于1392年在家族宅邸外被斩首。家族仅靠小支系延续，男系于18世纪断绝。

en:
The Chiavelli were a Ghibelline noble family of the Marche, said to be of Norman origin, who returned to Italy from Germany with Ruggiero Chiavello in 1154, in the time of Frederick Barbarossa, and built their power at Fabriano. Long loyal to the Empire, they became lords of the city in 1378; in 1349 Guido Napolitano had already developed the papermaking on which Fabriano's fame rested.

Under their rule the city drew in merchants and artists, including the painter Gentile da Fabriano, while Tommaso Chiavelli issued a new, more modern statute in 1415. Their populist government pleased the artisans and the poor but alienated the wealthy merchants.

That resentment ended in a massacre on Ascension Day 1435, when the men of the house were killed during a service in the cathedral of San Venanzio, Tommaso and his heir Battista among them. The women were spared but exiled, and Fabriano was absorbed into the Papal States.
zh:
基亚韦利是马尔凯的吉伯林派贵族，相传源出诺曼人，1154年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨时代随鲁杰罗·基亚韦洛从德意志返回意大利，在法布里亚诺建立势力。他们长期效忠帝国，1378年成为城市领主；1349年圭多·纳波利塔诺已发展起令法布里亚诺闻名的造纸业。

其治下城市吸引商人与艺术家，画家真蒂莱·达·法布里亚诺即在此时；托马索·基亚韦利于1415年颁布更近代化的新法令。民粹式统治受工匠和平民欢迎，却得罪了富商。

积怨于1435年耶稣升天节演为屠杀：家族男丁在圣维南齐奥大教堂礼拜中遇害，托马索和继承人巴蒂斯塔即在其中。女眷获免但被逐，法布里亚诺并入教宗国。

en:
The Chiba were a gōzoku, or local landed power, and samurai family of the Bōsō Peninsula, descended from the Kanmu branch of the Taira clan. In 1126 Taira no Tsuneshige moved his seat to Inohana in Shimōsa Province, the site of later Chiba Castle, and took the name Chiba.

His son Tsunetane sheltered the fugitive Minamoto no Yoritomo after his defeat by the Taira and advised him to make Kamakura his base, becoming one of the founders of the Kamakura shogunate. Under the shogunate the Chiba head served as hereditary shugo governor of Shimōsa.

In the fourteenth century Emperor Go-Daigo recognized Chiba Sadatane as the leading daimyō of the Kantō region. The family survived the medieval wars as provincial lords of Shimōsa but was ultimately dispossessed by Toyotomi Hideyoshi's conquest of the Kantō in the 1590s.
zh:
千叶氏是房总半岛的豪族与武家，出自桓武天皇一脉的桓武平氏。1126年，平常兼把据点迁往下总国的亥鼻，即后来千叶城的所在地，并取“千叶”为苗字。

其子千叶常胤在源赖朝被平氏击败逃亡时予以庇护，并建议他以镰仓为根据地，成为镰仓幕府的开国功臣之一。幕府时代，千叶当主世袭下总国守护职。

14世纪，后醍醐天皇认可千叶贞胤为关东武家的首领。此后千叶家以下总国领主的身份历经中世战乱，最终在16世纪90年代丰臣秀吉平定关东时被没收领地而衰落。

en:
The Chichimecayotl were the Acolhua royal house of Tetzcoco, whose rulers claimed descent from the Chichimec leader Xolotl. Quinatzin, the first known king of Tetzcoco, transferred the seat of Chichimec power there from Tenayuca; around 1337 the Acolhua made it their capital.
