Their son Sweyn Estridsson, born around 1019, took the Danish throne in 1047 and fathered over twenty children, five of them kings, among them Saint Canute. His descendants kept the Danish crown for three centuries, and the family arms became those of Denmark.

In 1337 the house had ruled Denmark for nearly three centuries; Valdemar IV soon revived its fortunes. His youngest daughter Margaret I, born in 1353, became queen regnant of Denmark, Norway and Sweden and founded the Kalmar Union, joining the Scandinavian crowns for more than a century. On her death in 1412 the line ended and the crown passed to her grandnephew Eric of Pomerania; all later Danish monarchs remained its cognatic descendants.
zh:
埃斯特丽德王朝1047—1412年间为丹麦提供历代国王，还曾有三人统治瑞典、一人统治挪威。王朝得名于八字胡斯文之女、克努特大帝之妹埃斯特丽德·斯文斯达特，她嫁给丹麦伯爵乌尔夫，开创这一王统。

他们的儿子斯文·埃斯特里德森约生于1019年，1047年登上丹麦王位，留下二十多个子女，其中五人后来称王，圣克努特便是其一。此后近三百年，丹麦王冠一直在他的后裔手中传承，家族纹章也演变为丹麦国徽。

1337年这个家族已统治丹麦近三百年，不久瓦尔德马四世重振王权；他的幼女玛格丽特一世生于1353年，后来成为统治丹麦、挪威和瑞典的女王，缔造卡尔马联盟，把斯堪的纳维亚诸王冠合为一体达一个多世纪。1412年玛格丽特去世，王统断绝，王位传给侄孙波美拉尼亚的埃里克；此后丹麦历代君主都是该家族的后裔，只是不再循男系相承。

en:
The free lords and counts of Everstein took their name from castles in the Weser hills near Holzminden, first using it in 1116. Followers of the Hohenstaufen, they built a small lordship and around 1100 led the colonization of the Slavic Dobnagau, which they surrendered to the Vogts of Plauen in 1328.

The house split into branches around 1200. After the Hohenstaufen fell, the dukes of Brunswick forced the sale of Everstein Castle in 1284, and Polle became the seat. In 1322 Adelaide of Everstein-Polle married Ernest I of Brunswick-Grubenhagen; around 1335 the lords surrendered Ohsen.

After the succession feud of 1403 to 1408, the county and Polle Castle passed to the dukes of Brunswick-Lueneburg, and Count Hermann VII, the last male of the line, died in exile. A Pomeranian branch at Naugard, established in 1274, survived until 1663.
zh:
埃弗施泰因的自由领主与伯爵得名于霍尔茨明登附近威悉山地中的城堡，1116年开始以此为号。他们追随霍亨斯陶芬家族，经营出一片小领地；约1100年主导了对斯拉夫人多布纳高的拓殖，1328年将其让给普劳恩福格特。

约1200年家族分支。霍亨斯陶芬家族倒台后，不伦瑞克公爵于1284年强迫他们出售埃弗施泰因城堡，波勒成为家族治所。1322年，埃弗施泰因-波勒的阿德莱德嫁给不伦瑞克-格鲁本哈根公爵恩斯特一世；约1335年家族又交出奥克森。

经过1403—1408年的继承纷争，伯国连同波勒城堡落入不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵之手，末代男嗣赫尔曼七世伯爵死于流放。1274年在波美拉尼亚建立的诺加德支系则延续到1663年。

en:
The Fadlawayhids ruled the Shabankara, an Iranian tribal confederation commonly described as Kurdish, which held eastern Fars from Ij. The Shabankara had been deported from Isfahan and Syria by the Buyid ruler Adud al-Dawla in the tenth century, and claimed descent from the Sasanian king Ardashir I.

The dynasty took its name from Fadluya, also called Fadlawayh, who overthrew the last Buyid ruler of Fars in 1062 before submitting to the Seljuks under Alp Arslan. Revolts ended in his death in captivity, but his family survived under Seljuk atabegs and the Ilkhans. Hulagu destroyed Ij and killed their chief in 1260; another rising failed in 1312.

The last chief Ardashir refused obedience to the Muzaffarids. In 1355 Mubariz al-Din sent his son against him and ended the dynasty's rule, though local Shabankara power may have lingered until 1424.
zh:
法德勒瓦希德王朝是沙班卡拉人的统治家族。沙班卡拉是一个通常被视为库尔德人的伊朗部落联盟，以伊杰为都，据有法尔斯东部。他们在10世纪被白益王朝君主阿杜德·道莱从伊斯法罕和叙利亚迁徙至此，自称是萨珊国王阿尔达希尔一世的后裔。

王朝得名于法德卢叶（又名法德勒瓦希德）：他于1062年推翻白益王朝在法尔斯的末代统治者，随后向阿尔普·阿尔斯兰的塞尔柱人称臣。他屡次反叛，最终死于囚禁，但家族仍依附塞尔柱的阿塔伯格和伊儿汗国存续。1260年旭烈兀摧毁伊杰并杀死其首领，1312年又一次起义失败。

末代首领阿尔达希尔拒绝臣服莫扎法尔王朝。1355年穆巴里兹丁派儿子发兵，终结了该王朝的统治；沙班卡拉人的地方势力可能延续到1424年。

en:
The Frederick or Fadrique family was a Catalan noble house founded by Alfonso Fadrique, the illegitimate eldest son of Frederick II of Sicily. Sent to Greece in 1317 as vicar general of the Catalan Duchy of Athens, he invaded Thessaly after 1318, took Neopatras and the lordship of Salona, and ruled as its first count until his death in 1338.

His sons divided his fiefs, with Peter inheriting Salona and James holding Siderokastron. James's son Louis Fadrique reunited much of the inheritance, served as vicar general of Athens and Neopatras from 1375 to 1381, and married the Byzantine princess Helena Kantakouzene.

When Louis died in 1382 his daughter Maria inherited Salona under her mother's regency, but in 1394 the town opened its gates to Sultan Bayezid I, ending the family's rule. The final Ottoman conquest followed in 1410.
zh:
弗雷德里克家族（史料作法德里克）是加泰罗尼亚贵族世家，开创者阿方索·法德里克是西西里国王腓特烈二世的私生子长子。他于1317年被派往希腊，出任加泰罗尼亚人雅典公国的总代理人，1318年后进军色萨利，夺取新帕特雷和萨洛纳，并以首任萨洛纳伯爵的身份统治到1338年去世。

他的儿子们瓜分封地，彼得继承萨洛纳伯国，詹姆斯据有西德罗卡斯特龙。詹姆斯之子路易·法德里克重新聚拢大部分遗产，于1375—1381年出任雅典与新帕特雷的总代理人，并娶拜占庭公主海伦娜·坎塔库泽娜为妻。

路易于1382年去世后，女儿玛丽亚在母亲摄政下继承萨洛纳，但1394年该城向苏丹巴耶济德一世开城，家族统治就此终结。萨洛纳最终于1410年被奥斯曼人征服。

en:
The Falier were one of the oldest patrician houses of Venice, counted by the fourteenth century among the twelve apostolic noble families. Tradition traced them to tribunician families that moved from Eraclea to the Rialto in the early ninth century; Orso Faletro is recorded as a witness in 912.

The house gave Venice three doges: Vitale Faliero from 1084 to 1096, Ordelafo Faliero from 1102 to 1117, and Marino Faliero, elected on 11 September 1354 at about eighty years old.

Within seven months Marino led a plot to overthrow the republic and make himself prince; the conspiracy was betrayed, and he was beheaded on 17 April 1355. His place among the doges' portraits in the Great Council hall was marked by a black shroud. Branches of the family settled in Venetian Crete under the Greek surname Phalieros.
zh:
法列罗家族是威尼斯最古老的贵族世家之一，到14世纪已位列十二家使徒贵族。相传其先祖属于9世纪初从埃拉克莱亚迁往里亚尔托的护民官家族，912年的文书中已有奥尔索·法莱特罗出面作证。

家族出过三位威尼斯总督：1084—1096年在任的维塔莱·法列罗、1102—1117年在任的奥尔代拉福·法列罗，以及1354年9月11日当选时年约八旬的马里诺·法列罗。

不到七个月，马里诺策划推翻共和、自立为君，阴谋败露后于1355年4月17日被斩首，大议事厅总督肖像序列中他的位置留下一幅黑布。家族的一些支系在威尼斯属克里特定居，改用希腊姓氏法列罗斯。

en:
The Falkensteins were an imperial ministerial dynasty named after Falkenstein Castle in the Palatinate, first recorded with Sigbold in 1135. When the first line died out its lands passed by marriage to the lords of Bolanden. Early in the thirteenth century Philipp IV of Bolanden founded the Bolanden-Falkenstein branch, taking the name Philipp I.

In 1255 he married Isengard, heiress of Hagen-Munzenberg, and in 1258 inherited their estates, shifting the family's centre to the Taunus. They built Neufalkenstein Castle there and held Offenbach, pledged to Frankfurt in 1372. A younger line received the comital title in 1398; Werner III was archbishop of Trier from 1388 to 1418.

The Hessian Falkensteins died out in the male line in 1418, and their Palatinate and Rhenish Hesse lands passed to the counts of Virneburg. The lordship was sold to the Daun-Oberstein family in 1456 and raised to a county in 1518.
zh:
法尔肯施泰因家族是帝国直属家臣世家，得名于普法尔茨的法尔肯施泰因城堡，1135年西格博尔德首次见于记载。长支绝嗣后，领地经联姻转入博兰登领主家族。13世纪初，博兰登的菲利普四世创立博兰登-法尔肯施泰因支，改称菲利普一世。

1255年他娶哈根-明岑贝格伯爵的女继承人伊森加德，1258年继承其产业。家族重心移到陶努斯，修建新法尔肯施泰因城堡，并领有美因河畔奥芬巴赫，1372年将其抵押给法兰克福。家族一支于1398年获伯爵头衔，维尔纳三世于1388—1418年任特里尔大主教。

1418年黑森的法尔肯施泰因男系绝嗣，普法尔茨和莱茵黑森的领地转入菲尔讷堡伯爵之手。1456年领地被卖给道恩-奥伯施泰因家族，1518年升为伯国。

en:
The Fārūmādī were a notable family of Sabzevar in western Khorasan, named after the nearby town of Fārūmād; under the Ilkhans, Khwaja Taher Faryumadi and his son were patrons of the poet Pur-Baha Jami. Their best-known member, 'Ala' al-Din Muhammad Faryumadi, governed Sabzevar, Juvain and part of Nishapur for the Ilkhanid claimant Togha Temür and served as his vizier.

His harsh taxation drove the local landowner 'Abd al-Razzaq to revolt in 1337, the rising that gave birth to the Sarbadar state. 'Ala' al-Din remained Togha Temür's vizier and fought the Sarbadars until he was killed in the khan's defeat near the Atrek river on 29 July 1342.
zh:
法鲁马迪家族是西呼罗珊萨卜泽瓦尔的名门，得名于附近的法鲁马德；伊利汗国时期，长老塔希尔·法鲁马迪父子是诗人普尔·巴哈·贾米的施主。家族中最知名的阿拉丁·穆罕默德·法鲁马迪为伊利汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿镇守萨卜泽瓦尔、朱温及内沙布尔的一部分，并出任维齐尔。

他的苛税迫使当地地主阿卜杜勒·拉扎克于1337年起兵，这场起义造就了萨尔巴达尔政权。阿拉丁继续担任脱合帖木儿的维齐尔并与萨尔巴达尔人作战，最终在1342年7月29日阿特拉克河畔的败战中阵亡。

en:
The Fieschi were an ancient noble house of the Genoese hinterland, made counts of Lavagna by the Emperor Henry II in 1010, holding a semi-independent lordship against Genoa. Leading Guelphs and merchants, they held fiefs and interests in Piedmont, Lombardy and Naples, and their feud with the Doria shaped Genoese politics for centuries.

The family's church summit came when Sinibaldo Fieschi was elected Pope Innocent IV in 1243; he fled Frederick II to France in 1244, returned to Rome only in 1250 and died in 1254. His nephew Ottobuono became Pope Adrian V in 1276, one of three popes that year, and the house is reckoned to have supplied seventy-two cardinals.

Their long contest with Genoa ended in the Fieschi conspiracy of 2 January 1547, when Count Giovanni Luigi Fieschi tried to seize the dogate from Andrea Doria and drowned in the arsenal. Its failure broke their power, though a cadet line continued as the Fieschi Ravaschieri princes of Belmonte.
zh:
菲耶斯基家族是热那亚内陆的古老贵族世家，1010年被皇帝亨利二世册封为拉瓦尼亚伯爵，保有一块对热那亚共和国半独立的领地。作为归尔夫派领袖和商人，他们在皮埃蒙特、伦巴第和那不勒斯王国广置封地与商业利益，与多里亚家族的世仇左右热那亚数百年政局。

家族在教会达到顶峰：西尼巴尔多·菲耶斯基1243年当选教皇英诺森四世，1244年为躲避皇帝腓特烈二世逃往法国，1250年才返回罗马，1254年去世；侄子奥托博诺1276年成为教皇阿德里安五世，是当年三位教皇之一。据统计家族共出七十二位枢机。

家族与热那亚的长期较量终结于1547年1月2日的菲耶斯基阴谋：伯爵乔瓦尼·路易吉·菲耶斯基企图从安德烈亚·多里亚手中夺取总督之位，却在行动中溺死于军火库；事败后家族势力一蹶不振，只有旁支以贝尔蒙特亲王菲耶斯基·拉瓦斯基耶里的名号延续。

en:
This FitzAlan line held the manor of Bedale in Richmondshire, Yorkshire, and claimed descent from Conan II, Duke of Brittany and Earl of Richmond. Its head, Sir Bryan FitzAlan, also held Killerby, where he received a licence to crenellate in 1291.

That year Edward I named him one of the Guardians of Scotland during the succession dispute. From 1295 he was summoned to parliament as Lord FitzAlan. His sons by his first wife died young; by his second wife Maud de Balliol, sister of King John Balliol, he left only daughters.

When Bryan died in 1306 the male line became extinct. Agnes married Sir Gilbert Stapleton and was grandmother of Sir Miles Stapleton, a founder of the Order of the Garter in 1348; Katherine married Sir John de Grey. Bedale passed through the two heiresses to the Stapleton and Grey families.
zh:
这一支菲查伦家族世居约克郡里士满郡的比代尔庄园，自称是布列塔尼公爵兼里士满伯爵柯南二世的后裔。家主布莱恩·菲查伦爵士还领有基勒比，1291年获准在那里修建雉堞。

同年，爱德华一世在苏格兰王位继承争端期间任命他为苏格兰监护官之一。1295年起他以菲查伦勋爵之名受召出席议会。他与元配所生的儿子全部早夭，继室是苏格兰国王约翰·巴利奥尔之妹莫德·德·巴利奥尔，只留下女儿。

1306年布莱恩去世，男系断绝。阿格尼丝嫁给吉尔伯特·斯特普尔顿爵士，是1348年嘉德骑士团创始骑士迈尔斯·斯特普尔顿的祖母；凯瑟琳嫁给约翰·德·格雷爵士。比代尔经两位女继承人转入斯特普尔顿和格雷两家。

en:
The FitzAlans were an Anglo-Norman house descended from Alan fitz Flaad, a Breton knight who came to England with Henry I; they shared ancestry with the royal Stuarts. As Marcher lords they held Oswestry and Clun; marriage to the d'Aubigny heiress brought them Arundel Castle and earldom in 1267.

The ninth earl Edmund stood by Edward II and the Despensers and was executed in 1326, but his son Richard recovered the title in 1331. Richard fought at Sluys in 1340 and commanded at Crécy in 1346.

The next earl, another Richard, joined the Lords Appellant against Richard II and was beheaded in 1397; the family was restored under Henry IV in 1400. Henry FitzAlan, the last male, died in 1580, and Arundel passed through his daughter Mary to the Howard dukes of Norfolk.
zh:
菲查伦家族是盎格鲁-诺曼世家，始祖为随亨利一世来到英格兰的布列塔尼骑士艾伦·菲茨弗拉阿德，与斯图亚特王室同宗。菲查伦家族作为边疆贵族领有奥斯沃斯特里和克伦，通过与多比尼家族女继承人联姻，于1267年取得阿伦德尔城堡和伯爵爵位。

第九代伯爵埃德蒙效忠爱德华二世和德斯潘塞父子，1326年被处决，其子理查德于1331年恢复爵位。理查德于1340年参加斯鲁伊斯海战，1346年指挥克雷西之战。

下代伯爵理查德加入诉追派贵族反对理查二世，1397年被斩首；1400年亨利四世在位时家族恢复爵位。家族最后一名男性继承人亨利·菲查伦于1580年去世，阿伦德尔经其女玛丽转入霍华德家族的诺福克公爵一系。

en:
The FitzGeralds, known in Ireland as the Geraldines, descended from Gerald de Windsor and Nest ferch Rhys, a Welsh princess. Their son Maurice FitzGerald crossed to Ireland with the Anglo-Norman invasion of 1169 and helped take Wexford, Waterford and Dublin.

The family split into two great branches: the Kildare line, created earls of Kildare in 1316, and the Desmond line in Munster, later earls of Desmond. Both grew so deeply Gaelicised that contemporaries called them more Irish than the Irish themselves, and Gerald, third earl of Desmond, composed verse in Irish.

Silken Thomas of Kildare rose in 1534 and was executed in 1537. The Desmond Rebellions of 1569 to 1583 ended with the killing of the fourteenth earl and the Plantation of Munster; the Kildare branch was restored and became dukes of Leinster in 1766.
zh:
菲茨杰拉德家族在爱尔兰被称为杰拉尔丁人，始祖是杰拉德·德·温莎与威尔士公主内斯特·费奇·里斯。他们的儿子莫里斯·菲茨杰拉德参加了1169年盎格鲁-诺曼人对爱尔兰的入侵，参与攻占韦克斯福德、沃特福德和都柏林。

家族分成两支：1316年受封的基尔代尔伯爵支，以及芒斯特的戴斯蒙德支，后为戴斯蒙德伯爵。两支深度盖尔化，时人称其“比爱尔兰人还爱尔兰人”，第三代戴斯蒙德伯爵杰拉德用爱尔兰语写诗。

基尔代尔的“丝绸托马斯”1534年起兵，1537年被处决。1569—1583年的戴斯蒙德叛乱以第十四代伯爵被杀告终，随后开启了芒斯特种植园；基尔代尔一支恢复爵位，于1766年晋为伦斯特公爵。

en:
The Gilpatricks, in Gaelic Mac Giolla Phádraig or son of the devotee of Saint Patrick, were the hereditary kings of Osraige, or Ossory. They sprang from the Dál Birn royal line and took their name from Gilla Patráic mac Donnchada, who ruled from 976 to 996; his son Donnchad, king from 1003, also held Leinster and first bore the name.

The Norman invasion after 1169 broke the kingdom, and William Marshal partitioned most of it among his followers. Upper Ossory survived as an independent Gaelic lordship under the Gilpatricks, with seats such as Cullahill Castle.

In 1537 Brian Mac Giolla Phádraig surrendered to Henry VIII, adopted the surname Fitzpatrick and became Baron Upper Ossory in 1541. The seventh baron was attainted for Jacobite loyalty in 1691; other branches became Barons Gowran and Earls of Upper Ossory in the eighteenth century.
zh:
吉尔帕特里克家族，盖尔语作麦克·吉拉·法德里格，意为圣帕特里克信徒之子，是奥斯里格（即奥索里王国）的世袭王族。他们出自达尔·伯恩王室，姓氏取自976—996年在位的奥索里国王吉拉·帕特里克·麦克·敦查达；其子敦查德1003年继位后还领有伦斯特王位，是第一个使用该姓氏的人。

1169年以后的诺曼入侵瓦解了王国，威廉·马歇尔把大部分土地分封给部下。上奥索里作为独立的盖尔人领地保留下来，仍由吉尔帕特里克家族统治，卡洛希尔城堡是其据点之一。

1537年，布赖恩·麦克·吉拉·法德里格归顺亨利八世，改用菲茨帕特里克为姓，并于1541年受封上奥索里男爵。其后代世袭男爵，直到第七代男爵因效忠詹姆斯党于1691年被剥夺爵位；其他支系在18世纪成为高伦男爵和上奥索里伯爵。

en:
The counts of Foix took their name from the castle of Foix in the northern Pyrenees, held by Roger of Foix in the mid-eleventh century. Roger II joined the First Crusade in 1095, a later count taking the Cathar side in the Albigensian Crusade.

From 1278 the counts were also co-princes of Andorra. In 1290 Roger Bernard III inherited Bearn through his Bearn heiress wife, making them great nobles of southern France and opening a long feud with the Armagnacs.

In 1337 Gaston II ruled from Bearn. His son Gaston III, called Phoebus, was the family's most famous member: he defeated the Armagnacs in 1362 and wrote the hunting treatise Livre de chasse. On his death without legitimate sons in 1391 the county passed to a cadet branch, whose Francis Phoebus became king of Navarre in 1479. His sister Catherine carried the inheritance to the Albret family, then to Henry of Navarre, who as Henry IV of France united Foix to the royal domain in 1607.
zh:
富瓦伯爵得名于比利牛斯山北麓的富瓦城堡，11世纪中叶由罗热·德·富瓦领有。罗热二世1095年参加第一次十字军东征，后来又有伯爵在阿尔比十字军中站在清洁派一边。

自1278年起，富瓦伯爵同时是安道尔的共治亲王。1290年罗热-贝尔纳三世凭借贝阿恩女继承人的妻子继承贝阿恩，使家族成为法兰西南部大贵族，也与阿马尼亚克伯爵结下长期世仇。

1337年加斯东二世在贝阿恩理政；其子加斯东三世绰号“腓比斯”，是家族最负盛名的成员，1362年击败阿马尼亚克人，并著有狩猎专著《狩猎之书》。1391年他无嫡子而终，伯国转入旁支，弗朗索瓦·腓比斯1479年成为纳瓦拉国王。其妹卡特琳把继承权带入阿尔布雷家族，后归纳瓦拉的亨利，他作为法兰西国王亨利四世1607年将富瓦并入王室领地。

en:
The Forzaté were a noble house of Padua, a branch of the Transalgardi who held Montemerlo castle for the bishop before turning to politics. The monk Giordano Forzaté earned the title father of Padua through peacemaking and monastic reforms; he backed Azzo VII d'Este against Ezzelino III da Romano, was arrested when Ezzelino took Padua in 1237, and died in Venetian exile in 1248.

In the fourteenth century the family rose through service to the Carraresi: Alvise Forzaté commanded castles in the Valsugana and fought Venice in the war of 1372 to 1373. After the peace he joined a plot to murder Francesco da Carrara and replace him with Marsilio da Carrara.

Alvise was arrested in 1374 and beheaded with his nephew Philip before the Palazzo della Ragione. His son Aledusio was rehabilitated by Francesco Novello da Carrara in 1392.
zh:
福尔扎泰家族是帕多瓦贵族，属特兰萨尔加迪支系，曾替主教掌管蒙泰梅尔洛城堡，后投身政治。修士焦尔达诺·福尔扎泰因调解、改革修院获称帕多瓦之父；他支持阿佐七世·德斯特对抗埃泽利诺三世·达·罗马诺，1237年埃泽利诺占领帕多瓦后被捕，1248年死于威尼斯流亡地。

14世纪，家族因效力卡拉拉家族崛起：阿尔维塞·福尔扎泰统辖瓦尔苏加纳城堡，在1372—1373年对抗威尼斯。议和后，他密谋刺杀弗朗切斯科·达·卡拉拉，代之以马尔西利奥·达·卡拉拉。

阿尔维塞于1374年被捕，与侄子菲利普在法理宫前被斩首。儿子阿莱杜西奥于1392年被小弗朗切斯科·达·卡拉拉恢复名誉。

en:
The Fregoso, also called Campofregoso, were a Genoese noble house of merchants from Val Polcevera, active in the city's politics from the thirteenth century. Thirteen Fregoso became doge, beginning with Domenico di Campofregoso, who deposed Gabriele Adorno on 13 August 1370 and held the longest consecutive dogeship of the republic.

Paolo di Campofregoso, archbishop of Genoa and a cardinal, seized the dogeship three times from 1462 amid violent feuds with his own kin. Ottaviano Fregoso, raised at the humanist court of Urbino and portrayed in Castiglione's The Book of the Courtier, was the last Fregoso doge; captured by the Spaniards, he died in the prison of Ischia in 1524.

In Andrea Doria's reform of 1528 the house was merged into the alberghi of De Fornari and De Ferrari. Although it revived its name in 1576, it never regained political importance.
zh:
弗雷戈索家族又称坎波弗雷戈索，是出身瓦尔波尔切维拉的热那亚商人贵族，13世纪起活跃于城市政坛。共有十三位家族成员出任总督，第一位是多梅尼科·迪·坎波弗雷戈索，他于1370年8月13日推翻加布里埃莱·阿多尔诺，其任期是共和国历史上最长的连续总督任期。

热那亚大主教兼枢机保罗·迪·坎波弗雷戈索从1462年起在同族人的激烈内讧中三次夺得总督之位。奥塔维亚诺·弗雷戈索在乌尔比诺的人文主义宫廷长大，被写进卡斯蒂廖内的《廷臣论》，是最后一位弗雷戈索总督；他被西班牙人俘虏，1524年死于伊斯基亚的监狱。

1528年安德烈亚·多里亚改革时，家族被并入德福尔纳里和德费拉里两个阿尔贝戈。1576年虽恢复本姓，却再未取得政治地位。

en:
The counts of Freiburg were a branch of the counts of Urach who inherited the Zähringen lands in the Breisgau when the Zähringen dukes died out in 1218. Count Egino V of Urach styled himself count of Freiburg from about 1230 and ruled the city and surrounding Black Forest country.

Under his son Conrad I the inheritance was divided with the princely house of Fürstenberg before 1245. The counts' hold on Freiburg was contested, and in 1368 the city council ransomed the town from their rule, after which it became a Habsburg city in the Austrian Forelands.

Reduced to their estates around Neuenstein castle at Badenweiler, the counts lingered until the last of them, John, bequeathed Badenweiler in 1444 to his Hachberg-Sausenberg nephews, whose union of Rötteln, Sausenberg and Badenweiler created the Markgräflerland.
zh:
弗赖堡伯爵家族是乌拉赫伯爵的支系：1218年策林根公爵绝嗣后，他们继承了策林根家族在布赖斯高的领地。乌拉赫伯爵埃吉诺五世约从1230年起自称弗赖堡伯爵，统治这座城市及周围的黑林山地带。

其子康拉德一世在位时，家族在1245年前与菲尔斯滕贝格诸侯家族分家。伯爵们对弗赖堡城的统治始终不稳，1368年市议会出钱赎身，摆脱伯爵统治，城市从此成为哈布斯堡在前奥地利的城市。

伯爵家族只剩下巴登韦勒的诺因施泰因城堡一带产业，勉强维持；末代伯爵约翰于1444年把巴登韦勒遗赠给外甥哈赫贝格-绍森贝格家族的兄弟，后者将勒特恩、绍森贝格和巴登韦勒合并，形成马克格雷夫勒兰。

en:
The Gabras were a Byzantine aristocratic family from Chaldia, the mountainous region around Trebizond. Theodore Gabras recaptured Trebizond from the Turks in 1075 and ruled Chaldia as a virtually autonomous governor from 1081 until his death in battle in 1098; he was later venerated as a saint.

Constantine Gabras held Chaldia as a quasi-independent prince from about 1126 until Emperor John II Komnenos subdued him in 1140. The family's Crimean branch ruled the Principality of Theodoro, also called Gothia, from its cliff capital of Mangup.

Prince Stephen emigrated to Moscow with his son Gregory in 1391 or 1402; the Russian Khovrin and Golovin families claimed descent from them. The Theodoro Gabrades balanced vassalage to the Golden Horde with rivalry against the Genoese colonies on the coast, until the Ottomans stormed Mangup and extinguished the principality in 1475.
zh:
加夫拉斯是拜占庭的贵族世家，出自特拉布宗周围的山区哈尔迪亚。塞奥多雷·加夫拉斯于1075年从突厥人手中收复特拉布宗，1081年起以近乎自立的总督身份统治哈尔迪亚，直至1098年战死，后来被尊为圣徒。

君士坦丁·加夫拉斯约从1126年起以半独立王公身份统治哈尔迪亚，1140年被皇帝约翰二世·科穆宁平定。家族的克里米亚支系以悬崖上的曼古普为都，统治又称哥提亚的狄奥多罗公国。

王公斯捷潘于1391年或1402年携子格里高利移居莫斯科，俄罗斯的霍夫林和戈洛温家族都自称是他们的后裔。狄奥多罗的加夫拉斯家族一面臣服于金帐汗国，一面与沿海的热那亚殖民地争衡，最终奥斯曼人于1475年攻陷曼古普，公国灭亡。

en:
The Gabrielli were an old feudal house of Gubbio in Umbria, first documented in the tenth century, when Cante Gabrielli received castles in central Italy from Pope Stephen VII; the castle of Luceoli was renamed Cantiano after him. The family combined warfare with church careers: Girolamo Gabrielli led a hundred knights on the First Crusade, and several members were beatified or canonised.

The most famous member was Cante Gabrielli, commander in chief of the Guelph League in central Italy and podestà of Florence, who condemned Dante Alighieri to exile; Dante repaid him in the Divine Comedy by naming the furious devil Rubicante after him.

The Gabrielli ruled their native town: Giovanni Gabrielli held the lordship from 1350 to 1354 and Gabriello Gabrielli was both lord and bishop from 1381 to 1384. After losing Gubbio the self-styled duke Cecciolo failed to reconquer it; the family's branches then served Italian courts and the papacy, which made Gabriele de' Gabrielli a cardinal in 1505.
zh:
加布里埃利家族是翁布里亚古城古比奥的封建贵族，最早见于10世纪文献，当时坎特·加布里埃利从教皇司提反七世手中获赐意大利中部的若干城堡，卢切奥利城堡后以他改名坎蒂亚诺。家族戎马与教会生涯并行：吉罗拉莫·加布里埃利率一百名骑士参加第一次十字军东征，家族中还有数人受宣福或封圣。

最著名的成员是坎特·加布里埃利，他曾任意大利中部归尔夫联盟统帅和佛罗伦萨最高行政官，正是他判处但丁·阿利吉耶里流放；但丁在《神曲》中用他的谐音给狂暴恶魔取名鲁比坎特作为报复。

家族曾统治故乡：乔瓦尼·加布里埃利1350—1354年任古比奥领主，加布里埃洛·加布里埃利1381—1384年身兼领主与主教。失去古比奥后，自称公爵的切乔洛反攻失败，此后各支派效力意大利各宫廷和教廷，加布里埃莱·德·加布里埃利1505年成为枢机。

en:
The Gambacorta or Gambacorti were a merchant noble family of Pisa, traced to the thirteenth-century trader Buonaccorso, called Coscio, who moved from the Pisan countryside into the city and built a fortune trading with Naples and Sardinia. They led the Bergolini faction, which favoured alliance with Florence.

Andrea Gambacorta became head of the Pisan government after the Bergolini victory of 1347. His nephew Francesco succeeded him in 1354 but was deposed and killed in 1355. Pietro Gambacorta brought the family back to power in 1369, but in 1392 Jacopo d'Appiano's conspiracy drove them out and Pietro was executed with his sons.

After Florence conquered Pisa in 1406 the Gambacorta held Bagno di Romagna until 1453, when Gherardo moved the family to Naples and entered the Neapolitan patriciate. That branch died out in 1703. Chiara Gambacorti, a Dominican, was beatified in 1830.
zh:
甘巴科尔塔家族（又作甘巴科尔蒂）是比萨的商人贵族，始祖可追溯到13世纪的商人布翁阿科尔索（人称科肖），他从比萨乡间迁入城内，靠与那不勒斯和撒丁岛经商致富。家族领导主张与佛罗伦萨结盟的贝尔戈利尼派。

安德烈亚·甘巴科尔塔在1347年贝尔戈利尼派获胜后成为比萨政府首脑，侄子弗朗切斯科于1354年继任，却在1355年被废黜杀害。彼得罗·甘巴科尔塔于1369年率家族重新执政，但1392年雅各布·达皮亚诺发动阴谋，家族再度被逐，彼得罗与几个儿子一起被处决。

1406年佛罗伦萨征服比萨后，甘巴科尔塔家族保有罗马涅巴尼奥领地直到1453年，此后盖拉尔多举家迁往那不勒斯，跻身当地贵族。该支派于1703年绝嗣。多明我会修女基亚拉·甘巴科尔蒂于1830年受宣福。

en:
The Garaad were the ruling house of the Muslim kingdom of Hadiya in the Ethiopian highlands south of Shewa, whose sovereigns bore the title Garad. Local tradition traces the dynasty to descendants of Abadir, emir of Harar, who intermarried with the local Sidama people.

Early in the fourteenth century Garad Amano refused tribute to Emperor Amda Seyon I, who invaded and reduced Hadiya to a tributary. During the reign of Zara Yaqob (1434-1468), Garad Mahiko defied the crown, was deposed in favor of his uncle Bamo and killed while fleeing to Adal.

In the 1530s Hadiya's Muslims joined the conquests of Ahmad Gragn. Garad Aze's revolt was crushed under Emperor Sarsa Dengel, but early in the seventeenth century Garad Sidi Mohammed defeated the troops of Susenyos I, and the traveller Remedius Prutky described an independent Hadiya in 1751.
zh:
加拉德王朝是穆斯林政权哈迪亚王国的统治家族，哈迪亚位于绍阿以南的埃塞俄比亚高原，其君主以“加拉德”为号。当地传说称该王朝出自哈勒尔埃米尔阿巴迪尔的后裔，他们与当地锡达马人通婚。

14世纪初，加拉德·阿莫诺拒绝向皇帝阿姆达·塞翁一世纳贡，皇帝发兵入侵，把哈迪亚降为附庸。泽拉·雅各布皇帝在位期间（1434—1468年），加拉德·马希科也抗命，被废后改立其叔父巴莫，他逃往阿达尔途中被杀。

16世纪30年代，哈迪亚穆斯林加入了艾哈迈德·格拉格的征战。加拉德·阿泽的叛乱在萨尔萨·登格尔皇帝时期被镇压，但17世纪初加拉德·西迪·穆罕默德击败了苏塞尼奥斯一世的军队，1751年旅行家普鲁特基仍把哈迪亚记作一个独立王国。

en:
The House of Garen was the hereditary ruling dynasty of the Ajuran Sultanate in southern Somalia. It grew out of the thirteenth-century Garen Kingdom, and as Somali groups moved south the line developed into an Islamic monarchy whose rulers took the title imam and claimed baraka descending from the saint Balad.

From the late 1300s the Garen imams dominated the Banaadir interior for some three centuries. Their empire monopolized the Jubba and Shebelle rivers through dykes, dams and stone wells, earning Ajuran the name of a hydraulic empire, while its armies checked the Oromo and repelled Portuguese raiders at Barawa.

Heavy taxation sparked revolts at the end of the seventeenth century: the Abgaal took Mogadishu and set up the Hiraab Imamate, and the general Ibrahim Adeer founded the Gobroon dynasty. By the early 1700s Garen rule had vanished from Banaadir.
zh:
加伦家族是索马里南部阿朱兰苏丹国的世袭统治王朝。它源自13世纪的加伦王国；随着索马里诸部南迁，这一世系演变为伊斯兰君主制，统治者称伊玛目，并宣称拥有源自圣徒巴拉德的巴拉卡神恩。

14世纪末起，加伦伊玛目在贝纳迪尔内陆称雄约三百年。帝国凭堤坝、水闸和石井垄断朱巴河与谢贝利河，阿朱兰因而被称为水利帝国；其军队抵御奥罗莫人，又在巴拉韦击退葡萄牙劫掠者。

17世纪末，重税激起叛乱：阿布加尔人夺取摩加迪沙，建立希拉卜伊玛目国；将领易卜拉欣·阿迪尔开创戈布伦王朝。到18世纪初，加伦的统治已在贝纳迪尔销声匿迹。

en:
The Gediminids ruled the Grand Duchy of Lithuania from the fourteenth to the sixteenth century and were named after Grand Duke Gediminas, their ancestry later traced to the shadowy duke Skalmantas. Ruling from about 1316 to 1341, Gediminas made Vilnius his capital, absorbed Ruthenian principalities including Kiev and pushed the grand duchy's borders from the Baltic toward the Black Sea, dying a pagan.

His sons Algirdas and Kęstutis and their descendants divided the inheritance, and in 1386 Algirdas' son Jogaila accepted baptism and the Polish crown through the Union of Krewo, founding the Jagiellonian branch. Under Vytautas the Great the dynasty's armies shared the victory over the Teutonic Knights at Grunwald in 1410; Jagiellonian kings later wore the crowns of Poland, Hungary and Bohemia. The line ended with Sigismund II Augustus in 1572, three years after the 1569 Union of Lublin joined Lithuania and Poland in one commonwealth.

Other branches stayed Orthodox and were Ruthenized: the Galitzines and Trubetskoys served Muscovy, the Polonized Czartoryskis remaining magnates of Poland.
zh:
格迪米纳斯王朝是14至16世纪统治立陶宛大公国的王朝，得名于大公格迪米纳斯，后世把其家世追溯到面目模糊的公爵斯卡尔曼塔斯。格迪米纳斯约1316—1341年在位，定维尔纽斯为都城，吞并包括基辅在内的鲁塞尼亚公国，把疆界从波罗的海推进到黑海附近，去世时仍信奉异教。

他的儿子阿尔吉尔达斯、科斯图提斯及其后代分割家业；1386年阿尔吉尔达斯之子雅盖沃通过《克雷沃联合》接受洗礼并登上波兰王位，开创雅盖隆支系。维陶塔斯大帝治下，王朝军队1410年在格伦瓦德战役合力击败条顿骑士团，雅盖隆系君主后来还先后戴上波兰、匈牙利和波希米亚的王冠。1569年《卢布林联合》把立陶宛与波兰合并为共和国，三年后的1572年末代君主齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特去世，主支断绝。

其余支系仍奉东正教并被鲁塞尼亚化，戈利岑、特鲁别茨科伊等家族转投莫斯科公国，波兰化的恰尔托雷斯基家族则位列波兰权贵。

en:
The counts of Geneva, called the Géroldiens by some genealogists after their mid-eleventh-century ancestor Gérold, were a great comital house of the old Kingdom of Burgundy. In 1034 Count Gérold resisted the absorption of Burgundy by Emperor Conrad II, who nevertheless had himself crowned at Geneva.

Rivalry with the bishops of Geneva ended in the treaty of Seyssel of 1124, under which Count Aymon I gave up his temporal claims over the city and kept only the castle of Bourg-de-Four. From 1219 the family's capital was Annecy.

Robert of Geneva was elected pope by the French cardinals in 1378 as the Avignon antipope Clement VII and inherited the county from his brother in 1392. On his death in 1394 the male line was extinct, and in 1401 his heirs sold the county to Amadeus VIII of Savoy.
zh:
日内瓦伯爵家族因11世纪中叶的始祖热罗尔而被一些系谱学者称为热罗尔家族，是旧勃艮第王国的大伯爵世家之一。1034年，伯爵热罗尔曾抵制皇帝康拉德二世吞并勃艮第，但皇帝仍在日内瓦加冕。

家族与日内瓦主教的争斗以1124年的《塞塞尔条约》告终：伯爵艾蒙一世放弃对日内瓦城的世俗权力，只保留布尔格德富尔城堡。从1219年起，家族的首府设在阿讷西。

罗贝尔·德·日内瓦于1378年被法国籍枢机选为对立教宗克莱孟七世，驻跸阿维尼翁，又在1392年继承兄长的伯爵之位。他于1394年去世后男系断绝，1401年其继承人把伯国卖给萨伏依伯爵阿梅迪奥八世。

en:
The Germiyanids were a Turkoman dynasty that ruled western Anatolia from Kütahya from around 1300 to 1429. The Germiyan tribe moved west under Mongol pressure; when the Sultanate of Rum dissolved, Yakub I made the beylik sovereign.

Yakub I ruled in 1337, his court a centre of learning where Persian works were translated into Turkish. His successors included Mehmed and Süleyman; Süleyman married his daughter Devletşah Hatun to the future Bayezid I with a dowry that surrendered much of the realm, including Kütahya.

Yakub II was imprisoned by Bayezid in 1390 but fled to Timur and was restored after the Battle of Ankara in 1402. Having no sons, he bequeathed the beylik to Murad II on his death in 1429, and Germiyan passed peacefully into the Ottoman Empire.
zh:
盖尔米扬王朝是约1300至1429年间以屈塔希亚为都、统治西安纳托利亚的土库曼王朝。盖尔米扬部在蒙古压力下西迁；罗姆苏丹国瓦解时，雅库布一世使贝伊国获得独立。

1337年仍是雅库布一世在位，他的宫廷是学术中心，不少波斯语作品在此被译成土耳其语。后继者有穆罕默德和苏莱曼；苏莱曼将女儿德夫莱特莎哈顿嫁给后来的巴耶济德一世，嫁妆包括屈塔希亚在内的大半国土。

雅库布二世于1390年被巴耶济德囚禁，后逃奔帖木儿，1402年安卡拉战役后复国。他没有儿子，1429年去世时以遗嘱将贝伊国赠予穆拉德二世，盖尔米扬遂和平并入奥斯曼帝国。

en:
The Gerulfings, also called the House of Holland, were the first comital dynasty of the County of Holland and Zeeland, then known as West Frisia. They took their name from Gerulf the Elder, who died after 839 and was said to descend from Radbod, the Frisian king of the early eighth century. Gerolf, count in Frisia, was the father or foster-father of Dirk I, who in 922 received the lands around Egmond from Emperor Charles the Fat, an act regarded as the foundation of the County of Holland. The counts built Egmond Abbey and turned the coastal marshes into a territorial power, while bastard branches such as the Van Brederode and Van Teylingen spread their influence through the Low Countries.

The main line ended with Count John I, the fifteen-year-old son of the murdered Floris V, who died childless at Haarlem in 1299, after which Holland passed to the House of Avesnes of Hainaut. A younger branch survived longer in the County of Bentheim, inherited through Sophia of Rheineck, wife of Count Dirk VI; after a partition in 1277 into Bentheim-Bentheim and Bentheim-Tecklenburg, this branch lasted until 1421, when Bentheim passed through a collateral female line.
zh:
赫吕尔夫家族又称荷兰家族，是荷兰伯国与泽兰伯国（当时称西弗里斯兰）的第一个伯爵王朝。家族得名于839年后去世的老格鲁尔夫，传说他是8世纪初弗里斯兰国王拉德博德的后裔。弗里斯兰伯爵格鲁尔夫是德克一世的生父或养父；922年，德克一世从皇帝胖子查理手中受封埃赫蒙德一带的土地，此事被视为荷兰伯国的开端。历代伯爵兴建埃赫蒙德修道院，把沿海沼泽经营成一方强权，范布雷德罗德、范泰林根等庶支也在低地开枝散叶。

主支终结于伯爵约翰一世：他是遇刺的弗洛里斯五世之子，1299年十五岁时在哈勒姆无嗣而亡，荷兰随后转入埃诺的阿韦讷家族手中。更小的支系则在本特海姆伯国延续得更久——这块领地由伯爵德克六世之妻赖讷克的索菲娅继承而来；1277年该支分裂为本特海姆-本特海姆与本特海姆-泰克伦堡两支，直到1421年绝嗣，本特海姆才经旁系女继承人转手。

en:
The della Gherardesca were a noble family of the Republic of Pisa, of Lombard origin, whose lineage is documented from the eleventh century. Leaders of the Ghibelline party, they held the county of Donoratico and rivalled the Guelph Visconti.

After the partition of Cagliari in 1258 the family took the mining-rich south-west of Sardinia, where Count Ugolino founded Villa di Chiesa around 1272. Ugolino withdrew his squadron at the naval battle of Meloria against Genoa in 1284, a flight later read as treachery.

Archbishop Ruggieri degli Ubaldini seized Ugolino in 1288 and had him starved to death with two sons and two grandsons in the Muda tower in 1289, an episode Dante made famous in the Inferno. The house never recovered its hold on Pisa, but branches endured as landholders in Volterra and Florence.
zh:
德拉·盖拉尔代斯卡家族是比萨共和国的贵族世家，源自伦巴第人，谱系可追溯至11世纪。他们领导吉伯林派，领有多诺拉蒂科伯爵领，并与圭尔夫派的维斯孔蒂家族敌对。

1258年瓜分卡利亚里后，该家族得到撒丁岛矿藏丰富的西南部，乌戈利诺伯爵约于1272年在那里建立基耶萨镇。乌戈利诺在1284年对热那亚的梅洛里亚海战中率部撤退，这一逃走后来被视为叛变。

大主教鲁吉耶里·德利·乌巴尔迪尼于1288年逮捕乌戈利诺，1289年将他与两个儿子、两个孙子关在穆达塔楼中活活饿死，但丁在《地狱篇》中写过这一幕。此后该家族未能恢复对比萨的掌控，但支系作为地主在沃尔泰拉和佛罗伦萨延续。

en:
The Ghisi were a Venetian noble family, said to originate in Padua or Aquileia, who rose as Latin lords in the Aegean after the Fourth Crusade. In 1207 Andrea Ghisi joined Marco Sanudo's conquest of the Cyclades and became lord of Tinos and Mykonos, holding them directly of the Latin Empire.

His brother Geremia seized Andros around 1239; Venice condemned the brothers in 1243 and exiled Andrea before reconciling with him in 1253. Later, George I Ghisi held Chalandritsa in Achaea and fell fighting the Catalan Company at the Cephissus in 1311.

His son Bartholomew II became a triarch of Negroponte and Grand Constable of Achaea; captured in 1320, he was held until 1325 and died in 1341. The island line continued to George III, the last Ghisi lord of Tinos, Mykonos and Negroponte, who died around 1390.
zh:
吉西家族是威尼斯贵族世家，据说源自帕多瓦或阿奎莱亚，在第四次十字军东征后作为拉丁人领主崛起于爱琴海。1207年，安德烈亚·吉西参加马尔科·萨努多征服基克拉泽斯群岛的远征，成为蒂诺斯岛和米科诺斯岛的领主，直接臣属于拉丁帝国。

其弟杰雷米亚于1239年前后夺取安德罗斯岛，威尼斯为此在1243年判罪两兄弟、流放安德烈亚，直到1253年才与他和解。后来乔治一世·吉西在亚该亚领有卡兰德里察，1311年在凯菲索斯河战役中迎战加泰罗尼亚佣兵团时阵亡。

其子巴尔托洛梅奥二世成为内格罗蓬特的三执政官之一兼亚该亚大统帅，1320年被俘，1325年获释，1341年去世。海岛一系传到乔治三世，他是最后一位领有蒂诺斯、米科诺斯和内格罗蓬特的吉西家族成员，约于1390年去世。

en:
The Girkis were Hunza's earlier royal line, remembered in Burusho tradition as the dynasty before the Ayasho. One account recorded by the nineteenth-century British officer John Biddulph says that Girkis and Moghlot were twin sons of Mayroo Khan, the first Muslim thum of Nagar, by a daughter of the Trakhan raja of Gilgit. Because the brothers were hostile from birth, their father divided his state, giving Girkis the northern bank of the river, which became Hunza, and Moghlot the southern bank, which became Nagar.

The Hunza royal chronicle instead calls the founder Sahib Khan, surnamed Girkis, a great-grandson of the legendary Persian prince Azar Jamshid, and dates the succeeding Ayasho house to 874. Later British writers linked the title Girkis with the Kirghiz nomads of the Pamir steppes.
zh:
吉尔基斯是罕萨更早的王世，在布鲁绍传说中是阿亚朔王朝之前的统治家族。19世纪英国军官约翰·比杜尔夫记录的说法称，吉尔基斯与莫格洛特是讷格尔首位穆斯林图姆迈鲁汗与吉尔吉特特剌汗拉杰之女所生的双胞胎；兄弟二人自幼敌对，父亲便将国家一分为二，吉尔基斯得到河北岸，即后来的罕萨，莫格洛特得到河南岸，即后来的讷格尔。

罕萨王室的编年则称开创者为萨希卜汗，别号吉尔基斯，是传说中波斯王子阿扎尔·贾姆希德的曾孙，而继起的阿亚朔家族按传说始于874年。后来的英国学者还把吉尔基斯这个称号与帕米尔草原上的柯尔克孜游牧民联系起来。

en:
The Glabas were a small Byzantine aristocratic family whose standing came almost entirely from Michael Doukas Glabas Tarchaneiotes, born around 1235. A soldier under Michael VIII and Andronikos II, he campaigned against Bulgaria and in 1279 captured Tarnovo to install the exile Ivan Asen III on the throne.

He later fought the Serbs in Macedonia and recovered Dyrrhachion, Kruja and Kanina from the Angevins of Naples between 1284 and 1291. He and his wife Maria restored the Pammakaristos Church in Constantinople, where he was buried after his death around 1305 to 1308.

Their daughters married into the Branas and Angelos houses, and one line became maternal ancestors of Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos. A later kinsman, Isidore Glabas, served as metropolitan of Thessalonica from 1380 and negotiated with the Ottomans after they took the city in 1387, dying in 1396.
zh:
格拉瓦斯是拜占庭的一个小贵族家族，其地位几乎全靠约1235年出生的米海尔·杜卡斯·格拉瓦斯·塔尔哈内奥蒂斯一人奠定。他在米哈伊尔八世和安德洛尼卡二世麾下为将，出征保加利亚，1279年攻克特尔诺沃，把流亡的伊凡·阿森三世扶上王位。

他在马其顿对抗塞尔维亚人，1284—1291年从那不勒斯安茹家族收复都拉齐翁、克鲁亚和卡尼纳。他与妻子玛丽亚重修君士坦丁堡的帕玛卡里斯托斯教堂，他约于1305—1308年去世后葬于该处。

他们的女儿嫁入布拉纳斯和安格洛斯家族，其中一支成为皇帝约翰六世·坎塔库齐诺斯的外祖父母。族人伊西多尔·格拉瓦斯1380年起任塞萨洛尼基都主教，1387年城市陷落后与奥斯曼人谈判，1396年去世。

en:
The House of Gonzaga was an Italian princely family that ruled Mantua from 1328 to 1708, first as captains-general, then margraves and dukes. Already dominant in Mantua from the twelfth century, they overthrew their former allies the Bonacolsi in 1328, when Ludovico I Gonzaga, with Scaliger help from Verona, made himself capitano del popolo and imperial vicar under Louis IV.

In 1433 Gianfrancesco I won the title of Marquis of Mantua from Sigismund, and Federico II became its first duke in 1530; Montferrat followed by marriage in 1531. Cadet branches ruled Nevers in France and Guastalla, and the Gonzaga-Nevers inheritance of Mantua and Montferrat triggered the War of the Mantuan Succession.

Marie Louise Gonzaga was Queen of Poland from 1645 to 1667; two Gonzaga daughters married emperors Ferdinand II and Ferdinand III. Lavish patrons of art and learning, the Gonzaga made the Mantuan court a magnet for Renaissance artists and musicians through Isabella d'Este's collections, until the main line died out and their rule in Mantua ended in 1708.
zh:
贡扎加家族是意大利诸侯世家，1328—1708年统治曼托瓦，身份先后为平民官、侯爵和公爵。家族12世纪起已是曼托瓦望族，1328年在维罗纳斯卡拉家族援助下推翻旧盟友博纳科尔西家族，卢多维科一世自立为平民官，并被皇帝路易四世任命为帝国代理人。

1433年詹弗朗切斯科一世从皇帝西吉斯蒙德手中获得曼托瓦侯爵头衔，费代里科二世1530年成为首任曼托瓦公爵，家族1531年又通过联姻取得蒙费拉托侯爵领。各旁支统治法国的讷韦尔和瓜斯塔拉，贡扎加-讷韦尔一系继承曼托瓦和蒙费拉托还引发曼托瓦爵位继承战争。

玛丽亚·路易莎·贡扎加1645—1667年出任波兰王后，家族还有两位女儿分别嫁给皇帝斐迪南二世和斐迪南三世。贡扎加家族也是慷慨的艺术与学术赞助人：伊莎贝拉·埃斯特的收藏使曼托瓦宫廷汇聚文艺复兴一流艺术家与音乐家，直到主系绝嗣、1708年家族在曼托瓦的统治终结。

en:
The Görz dynasty, known as the Meinhardiner after Count Meinhard I, took its name from Gorizia Castle, where they served the Aquileia patriarchate as advocates and were first called counts of Gorizia in 1117. Probably descended from the Bavarian Siegharding family, they rose under the Hohenstaufen and held Tyrol from 1253.

In 1271 the lands were divided: the senior Gorizia-Tyrol line kept Tyrol, the Albertine line Gorizia and offices in Carinthia. Both fought with Rudolf of Habsburg against Ottokar II of Bohemia at Marchfeld in 1278, and in 1286 the senior line received Carinthia and Carniola. Henry of Gorizia-Tyrol wore the Bohemian crown in 1306 and from 1307 to 1310 by marrying the Přemyslid heiress Anne.

The Tyrol branch died out with his daughter Margaret in 1369, its lands passing to the Habsburgs. The Albertine line lost most of its wider lands after 1335 and withdrew to Gorizia; when its last count, Leonhard, died heirless in 1500, Maximilian I of Habsburg inherited the rest.
zh:
格尔茨家族又称迈因哈德家族，得名于始祖迈因哈德一世伯爵，姓氏来自戈里齐亚城堡：家族成员在那里担任阿奎莱亚牧首区的护法官，1117年首次被称为戈里齐亚伯爵。他们可能源出巴伐利亚的西哈丁家族，在霍亨斯陶芬治下崛起，1253年起又领有蒂罗尔伯国。

1271年家族领地一分为二：戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔长支保有蒂罗尔，阿尔伯特支分得戈里齐亚和在克恩滕的职位。两支都在1278年马希费尔德战役中随哈布斯堡的鲁道夫对抗波希米亚的奥托卡二世，1286年长支受封克恩滕公国和卡尼奥拉边区。戈里齐亚-蒂罗尔的亨利因娶普热米斯尔家族女继承人安妮，1306年及1307—1310年两度戴上波希米亚王冠。

1369年亨利之女玛格丽特去世，蒂罗尔支系断绝，领地落入哈布斯堡之手。阿尔伯特支1335年后丧失大部分外围领地，退缩回戈里齐亚伯国；1500年末代伯爵莱昂哈德无嗣而终，剩余领地由哈布斯堡的马克西米利安一世继承。

en:
The Gotō were a widespread warrior lineage who claimed descent from Fujiwara no Toshihito of the Northern House of the Fujiwara. According to the Sonpi Bunmyaku, his fifth-generation descendant Norimura combined his offices with his Fujiwara surname to style himself Gotō no uchi; his descendants adopted Gotō as their name.

After Motokiyo of the Satō family was adopted into the Gotō house, its heads took Moto as their shared generational character. The Mimasaka Gotō were counted kin of the Harima Gotō, whose Gotō Mototsugu was killed at Dōmyōji in the Osaka Summer Campaign of 1615.

The Takeo Gotō of Hizen began when Gotō Akiaki was made jitō of Tsukasaki after the Earlier Nine Years' War. Its head Ujiaki fought the Mongol invaders in 1281; later the family served the Nabeshima, becoming chief retainers of Saga Domain and receiving the Nabeshima surname in 1699.
zh:
后藤氏是分布很广的武士家族，自称出自藤原北家的藤原利仁。据《尊卑分脉》记载，利仁五世孙则村把自己的官职与本姓藤原合起来，自称“后藤内”，子孙遂以后藤为姓。

佐藤氏的基清入继为养子后，当主便以“基”为通字。美作后藤氏与播磨后藤氏同族；播磨一支的后藤基次在1615年大阪夏之阵的道明寺之战中战死。

肥前的武雄后藤氏始于后藤章明在前九年之役后获任塚崎地头。1281年当主后藤氏明曾与元军作战；家族后来臣事锅岛氏，成为佐贺藩家老，并于1699年获准使用锅岛姓氏。

en:
The Gradenigo were one of the oldest and most powerful Venetian patrician houses, traditionally one of the twelve apostolic families present at the birth of the duchy. Legend traced them to Ravenna or Transylvania by way of Aquileia and the founding of Grado, from which their name was said to derive. They are documented in Venetian politics from the later ninth century.

The family gave the Republic three doges. Pietro Gradenigo, doge from 1289, carried through the Serrata of 1297, confining council membership to a noble caste; on his death in 1311 Venice lay under papal interdict and he was buried in an unmarked grave on Murano. Earlier Marco Gradenigo was podestà of Constantinople when the Byzantines retook it in 1261.

Bartolomeo, a wealthy merchant, was doge from 1339 to 1342; Giovanni was elected in 1355 after Marino Faliero's execution and made peace with Genoa. A branch in Crete joined the revolt of 1363 to 1366, while later Gradenigo became patriarchs of Aquileia and Venice in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries.
zh:
格拉代尼戈家族是威尼斯最古老、最有权势的贵族世家之一，传统上列为共和国初创时的十二使徒家族之一。传说其先祖经阿奎莱亚参与建立格拉多，源头或在拉文纳或在特兰西瓦尼亚，姓氏也被认为得自格拉多；家族自9世纪下半叶已见载于威尼斯政治史。

家族先后出了三位总督。彼得罗1289年出任总督，1297年推动大议会封闭法案，把议席限定在封闭的贵族阶层内部；他1311年去世时威尼斯正受教廷绝罚，葬在穆拉诺的无名墓中。更早的马尔科在1261年拜占庭人收复君士坦丁堡时正任该城执政官。

富商巴尔托洛梅奥1339—1342年出任总督；乔瓦尼在马里诺·法列罗被处决后的1355年当选，与热那亚媾和。定居克里特的支系参加1363—1366年的克里特叛乱，家族后人在17世纪至18世纪初出任阿奎莱亚和威尼斯的宗主教。

en:
The lords of Grandson were a great noble house of the Vaud, named after their castle of Grandson on the Lake of Neuchâtel. Adalbert is styled prince of Grandson Castle in a charter of 1049; around 1130 the family founded the Abbey of Lac de Joux, its burial place.

Otto I de Grandson was a close friend of Edward I of England and fought in his wars. Having no children, Otto made his nephew Peter II his heir; Peter's marriage to Blanche of Savoy-Vaud in 1303 tied the house to the counts of Savoy.

Peter's grandson Oton III, who died in 1397, was a soldier and poet whose fame for chivalry spread through Europe. The senior Vaud line died out in the later fourteenth century and the Grandson-Pesmes branch in the early sixteenth, when Savoy confiscated the remaining lands.
zh:
格朗松领主是沃地区的大贵族世家，得名于他们在纳沙泰尔湖畔的格朗松城堡。1049年的特许状已称阿达尔贝尔特为格朗松城堡的主人；家族约于1130年创建茹湖修道院，那里后来成为家族墓地。

奥托一世·德·格朗松是英王爱德华一世的密友，参加了他的战争。奥托没有子女，立外甥彼得二世为继承人；彼得于1303年娶萨伏依-沃的布朗什，使家族与萨伏依伯爵联姻。

彼得的孙子奥东三世于1397年去世，是骑士精神和诗名传遍欧洲的军人诗人。沃地区的长支于14世纪末断绝，格朗松-佩姆支系也在16世纪初消亡，家族剩余领地被萨伏依没收。

en:
The Greys of Rotherfield traced their Oxfordshire estate to the Norman knight Anchetil de Greye, recorded in the Domesday Book of 1086 as lord of Rotherfield. Their principal seat was Greys Court at Rotherfield Greys, and they later held the barony of Bedale through the marriage of Sir John de Grey to Katherine FitzAlan, co-heiress of Lord FitzAlan.

John de Grey, born in 1300, fought in the Scottish and French wars of Edward III and became Lord Steward of the royal household. Summoned to parliament from 1338, he became the first Baron Grey of Rotherfield and in 1348 was among the founding knights of the Order of the Garter.

His son and grandson succeeded as barons, but when the fourth baron died without issue in 1388 the barony fell dormant, while the Rotherfield lands passed through heiresses to other houses.
zh:
罗瑟菲尔德的格雷家族在牛津郡的产业可追溯到诺曼骑士安克蒂尔·德·格雷，1086年的《末日审判书》已记载他为罗瑟菲尔德领主。家族主宅是罗瑟菲尔德格雷的格雷庄园，后来又通过约翰·德·格雷与菲查伦勋爵共同继承人凯瑟琳·菲查伦的婚姻取得比代尔男爵领。

生于1300年的约翰·德·格雷参加爱德华三世朝的苏格兰和法兰西战争，官至王室总管。他从1338年起受召出席议会，成为第一代罗瑟菲尔德格雷男爵，并于1348年位列嘉德骑士团创始骑士。

其子其孙先后袭封男爵；1388年第四代男爵无嗣而终，男爵爵位就此搁置，罗瑟菲尔德的地产则经女继承人转入其他家族。

en:
The House of Grimaldi descends from Grimaldo Canella, a twelfth-century consul of Genoa whose given name became the family surname. The Grimaldi were one of Genoa's four dominant clans and led its Guelph faction; they were repeatedly exiled and took to piracy during exile.

On 8 January 1297 Francesco Grimaldi, called il Malizia, seized the citadel on the Rock of Monaco disguised as a Franciscan friar; the armed monks on the Monegasque arms recall the trick. His cousin Rainier I held the rock until 1301.

The family bought definitive rights over Monaco from Aragon in 1419. Honoré II took the title of sovereign prince in 1612 and later placed the house under French protection. When the male line died with Antonio I in 1731, his son-in-law Jacques de Matignon adopted the Grimaldi name and arms.
zh:
格里马尔迪家族源自12世纪的热那亚执政官格里马尔多·卡内拉，他的名字后来成了家族姓氏。格里马尔迪是热那亚四大家族之一，领导圭尔夫派，屡次遭流放，期间以海盗为业。

1297年1月8日，绰号“狡猾者”的弗朗索瓦·格里马尔迪乔装成方济各会修士，夺取摩纳哥巨岩上的城堡；摩纳哥国徽上的持剑修士形象记载了这一计谋。其堂弟拉尼埃里一世占据巨岩至1301年。

1419年，家族从阿拉贡王室手中买下摩纳哥的永久权利。奥诺雷二世于1612年改称世袭亲王，后来率家族接受法国庇护。1731年男系随安东尼奥一世去世而断绝，其女婿雅克·德·马提翁改用格里马尔迪的姓氏与纹章。

en:
The counts of Gruyere were a noble house of western Switzerland from the eleventh to the sixteenth century, ruling a county in the upper Sarine valley. Count Wilerius and his family appear as benefactors of Rougemont Priory in 1115; the name Gruyere first appears in 1144, when William II is styled comes de Grueria. Gruyeres Castle is attested from 1244. The house founded Rougemont Priory in 1104 and the Part-Dieu charterhouse in 1307.

Count Rodolphe III did homage to Savoy in 1236 and placed the county under Savoyard suzerainty in 1244, a bond that lasted until 1536. Rodolphe IV added lordships and received a minting right from King Wenceslas in 1396.

The last count, Michel, crushed by debt, fled to Burgundy. In 1554 his Swiss allies declared him bankrupt and Fribourg and Bern divided the County of Gruyere between them.
zh:
格吕耶尔伯爵家族是11至16世纪瑞士西部的贵族世家，统治萨讷河上游伯国。1115年，维莱里乌斯伯爵一家见于鲁日蒙修道院捐赠人的记载；格吕耶尔之名首见于1144年，当时纪尧姆二世被称为格吕耶尔伯爵。格吕耶尔城堡自1244年见于记载。家族于1104年创立鲁日蒙修道院，1307年创立帕尔迪厄会院。

鲁道夫三世于1236年向萨伏依伯爵行臣服礼，1244年将伯国置于萨伏依宗主权下，直至1536年。鲁道夫四世又取得一些领地，并于1396年从文策尔国王手中获得铸币权。

末代伯爵米歇尔负债逃往勃艮第。1554年瑞士盟友宣布其破产，弗里堡与伯尔尼瓜分了格吕耶尔伯国。

en:
The Griffins, or House of Pomerania, were a West Slavic dynasty named after the griffin on their ducal seal, first attested for Casimir II in 1194. Their first historical ruler, Wartislaw I, built a duchy on the southern Baltic coast and died around 1135.

The duchy split in 1295 into Pomerania-Wolgast and Pomerania-Stettin, ruled jointly by several Griffin dukes in 1337. Eric of Pomerania became king of Denmark, Norway and Sweden and head of the Kalmar Union in 1397.

Bogislaw X reunited the duchy in 1478, and the nobility adopted Protestantism at the Treptow diet of 1534. The last duke, Bogislaw XIV, died without heirs in 1637 during the Thirty Years' War, after which Sweden and Brandenburg-Prussia divided Pomerania; the last Griffin, Anna von Croy, died in 1660.
zh:
格里芬家族又称波美拉尼亚家族，是西斯拉夫王朝，得名于公爵纹章上的狮鹫，这一图案最早见于1194年卡齐米日二世的印章。家族第一位可考的统治者瓦季斯瓦夫一世在波罗的海南岸建立公国，约于1135年去世。

1295年公国分裂为波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特和波美拉尼亚-斯德丁，1337年数位格里芬公爵共同统治这些分地。波美拉尼亚的埃里克于1397年成为丹麦、挪威、瑞典三国国王和卡尔马联盟的共主。

博吉斯瓦夫十世于1478年重新统一公国，1534年的特雷普托等级会议上贵族接受了新教。末代公爵博吉斯瓦夫十四世在三十年战争中的1637年无嗣而终，波美拉尼亚随后被瑞典和勃兰登堡-普鲁士瓜分；家族最后一位成员安娜·冯·克罗伊于1660年去世。

en:
The Guarco were a Ghibelline noble family of Genoa, probably originating at Gavi and settled from the twelfth century at Cesino, where watermills and ironworks made them one of the city's richest houses. Their only member to reach the dogeship was Nicolò Guarco, born around 1325 as the son of a merchant.

After embassies to France in 1351 and Portugal in 1371, the popolani leaders made him the seventh doge in 1378. He led Genoa through the War of Chioggia against Venice: Genoese and allied troops took Chioggia in August 1379, but the garrison surrendered in June 1380.

The defeat weakened his rule, and in 1383 Antoniotto Adorno drove him from office. He fled to Finale, was handed back to the Genoese in 1384, and died a prisoner in the castle of Lerici around 1385.
zh:
瓜尔科家族是热那亚的吉伯林派贵族，可能起源于加维，12世纪起定居切西诺，靠水磨坊和炼铁业成为城中最富有的世家之一。家族中唯一登上总督之位的是商人之子尼科洛·瓜尔科，约1325年出生。

他曾于1351年出使法国、1371年出使葡萄牙；1378年，平民派领袖拥立他为第七任总督。他领导热那亚进行对威尼斯的基奥贾战争：1379年8月，热那亚联军攻占基奥贾，但驻军于1380年6月投降。

战败动摇了他的统治，1383年安东尼奥托·阿多尔诺将他赶下总督宝座。他先逃到菲纳莱，1384年被交还给热那亚人，约1385年作为囚徒死于莱里奇城堡。

en:
The Guhila name in Saurashtra belongs to the Gohils, a Suryavanshi Rajput dynasty traced to the Guhilas of Mewar. Driven from Khera by the Rathores, the chief Sejakji migrated into Saurashtra around the turn of the thirteenth century and served the Chudasama rajas of Junagadh; his sons founded the lines that later ruled Palitana and Lathi.

Ranoji, who ruled from 1254 to 1309, founded Ranpur and seized Vala. His son Mokhadaji (1309-1347) conquered Umrala and Ghogha, occupied Piram island in the Gulf of Cambay and lived by piracy until Muhammad bin Tughluq invaded and killed him in 1347.

Restored soon afterwards, the family built up chiefdoms along the eastern Saurashtra coast, afterwards called Gohilwad. Its main seat moved by stages to Sihor and finally to Bhavnagar, founded in 1723.
zh:
萨乌拉施特拉的古希拉一支即戈希尔人，属日族拉杰普特王朝，可追溯到梅瓦尔的古希拉王朝。他们在凯拉被拉托尔人所迫，首领塞贾吉约在13世纪之交迁入萨乌拉施特拉，投效朱纳格尔的珠多娑摩诸王；他的儿子开创了后来统治帕利塔纳和拉提的支系。

1254—1309年在位的拉诺吉建立兰布尔并夺取瓦拉。其子莫克达吉（1309—1347年）征服乌姆拉拉和戈加，占据坎贝湾中的皮拉姆岛，以海盗为业，1347年被穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克发兵攻杀。

家族不久后恢复势力，在萨乌拉施特拉东岸形成一批土邦，这片地方后来称戈希尔瓦德。主都几经迁移，先至西霍尔，最终定于1723年新建的巴夫纳加尔。

en:
The House of Guzmán was a noble dynasty of Castile, named for the village of Guzmán in Burgos where Rodrigo Muñoz de Guzmán held lands in the twelfth century. Its men served the crown in the Reconquest.

Alonso Pérez de Guzmán, called Guzmán the Good, defended Tarifa in 1296 against rebels and Marinid besiegers, throwing down his own dagger when his captive son was threatened rather than surrender. Eleanor de Guzmán, favourite of Alfonso XI and mother of Henry II, was executed in 1351; her sons' feud with Peter I opened the Trastámara civil war.

The senior line became Dukes of Medina Sidonia, while other branches held titles including Marquesses of Toral and, from 1625, Dukes of Medina de las Torres. The senior inheritance passed to the Álvarez de Toledo family in 1779.
zh:
古斯曼家族是卡斯蒂利亚贵族世系，得名于布尔戈斯的古斯曼村，罗德里戈·穆尼奥斯·德·古斯曼在12世纪于此领有封地。家族成员随王权投身再征服运动。

1296年，“好人古斯曼”阿隆索·佩雷斯·德·古斯曼镇守塔里法，抵御叛军和马林王朝的围攻。当敌人以杀死他被俘的儿子相逼时，他把自己的匕首扔下城头，拒绝献城。阿方索十一世宠妃、恩里克二世生母莱昂诺尔·德·古斯曼于1351年被处死，她的儿子们与佩德罗一世的仇怨引发了特拉斯塔马拉内战。

长支后来成为梅迪纳-西多尼亚公爵，其他支系拥有托拉尔侯爵及1625年起的梅迪纳-德拉斯托雷斯公爵等头衔。长支的爵位于1779年转入阿尔瓦雷斯·德·托莱多家族。

en:
The Habsburgs were named after Habsburg Castle, built by Radbot in the 1020s. Staufer clients, they rose with Rudolf's election as King of the Romans in 1273. His Marchfeld victory over Ottokar II in 1278 and the Georgenberg Pact of 1286 won Austria and Styria for his sons, Vienna becoming their seat.

After Rudolf's death in 1291 and Albert I's murder in 1308 the house lost the imperial crown for a time but gained Carinthia and Carniola in 1335. From 1440 the imperial title was effectively hereditary. The 1515 double wedding brought Bohemia and Hungary to Ferdinand I in 1526; Charles V, elected emperor in 1519, ruled Spain, the Low Countries and Austria.

His 1556 abdication split the house into Spanish and Austrian branches: the Spanish line ended in 1700 with Charles II, the Austrian male line with Charles VI in 1740. Maria Theresa's marriage to Francis Stephen of Lorraine founded Habsburg-Lorraine; Francis I took the title of Emperor of Austria in 1804, the Holy Roman Empire dissolving in 1806.
zh:
哈布斯堡家族以哈布斯堡城堡得名：11世纪20年代拉德博特修建此堡。作为施陶芬的追随者，家族在1273年鲁道夫当选罗马人的国王时崛起。1278年他在马希费尔德击败奥托卡二世，又借1286年《格奥尔根贝格协定》为儿子们取得奥地利和施蒂里亚，维也纳成为家族驻地。

1291年鲁道夫去世、1308年阿尔布雷希特一世遇刺后，家族一度失去帝号，但1335年取得克恩滕和卡尼奥拉。从1440年起皇帝头衔实际世袭。1515年双重联姻使斐迪南一世1526年获得波希米亚和匈牙利；1519年当选皇帝的查理五世同时统治西班牙、尼德兰和奥地利。

查理五世1556年退位，家族分为西班牙和奥地利两支：西班牙支1700年随查理二世断绝，奥地利男系随查理六世1740年终结。玛丽亚·特蕾西亚嫁给洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡，开创哈布斯堡-洛林家族；弗朗茨一世1804年自称奥地利皇帝，神圣罗马帝国1806年解体。

en:
The Hacıemiroğulları, also called the Bayramoğulları, were a Turkoman beylik of the Chepni tribe on the Black Sea coast of Canik, known to Byzantine Greeks as the emirate of Chalybia. In 1335 and 1336 the first bey, Bayram, threw off Eretnid overlordship; in 1337 his newly independent realm had its capital near Mesudiye.

Bayram besieged Trebizond unsuccessfully in 1348. His son Hacıemir, after whom the dynasty is named, fought Trebizond before marrying the emperor's daughter Theodora in 1358; allied with Kadı Burhan al-Din, he seized Ordu and moved his capital there in 1380.

Civil war between Hacıemir and his son Süleyman weakened the beylik, though Süleyman took Giresun in 1397. The dynasty accepted Ottoman suzerainty, briefly regained independence after Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402, and was annexed in 1427.
zh:
哈吉埃米罗格鲁王朝又称巴伊拉姆奥格鲁，是黑海沿岸贾尼克地区切普尼部落土库曼人建立的贝伊国，拜占庭希腊人称之为哈吕比亚埃米尔国。1335—1336年，初代贝伊巴伊拉姆摆脱埃雷特纳的宗主权；1337年，这个刚刚独立的国家以梅苏迪耶附近为都。

1348年巴伊拉姆围攻特拉布宗未果。其子哈吉埃米尔是王朝的得名者，与特拉布宗交战后，于1358年迎娶皇帝之女塞奥多拉；他与卡迪·布尔汉丁结盟，1380年攻占奥尔杜并迁都于此。

哈吉埃米尔与儿子苏莱曼之间的内战削弱了贝伊国，不过苏莱曼仍在1397年拿下吉雷松。王朝接受奥斯曼宗主权，1402年帖木儿在安卡拉获胜后曾短暂再度独立，最终于1427年被吞并。

en:
The Hadhur recall the Hadhabani, a Kurdish tribal confederation of the tenth and eleventh centuries whose pastures and strongholds ran from Mosul and Erbil through Shahrazur to Azerbaijan and the Caucasian foothills. Arab geographers record them clashing with the Hamdanids of Mosul as early as 906, after which thousands of families were settled north of Mosul.

The confederation included the Hakamiyya in Erbil and Shahrazur and the Rawadiyya in Azerbaijan. From its clans came the ruling houses of the Shaddadids, the Rawwadids and the Ayyubids; Saladin's family was of Hadhbani Rawadiyya stock.

As the Seljuk and Mongol waves broke over the Jazira the independent Hadhbani principalities were absorbed, though the tribal name and clans lived on in the Shahrazur hills, which passed to the Ardalan at the end of the Mongol era.
zh:
哈杜尔之名可追溯到哈兹巴尼，这是10至11世纪的库尔德部落联盟，牧场与据点从摩苏尔、埃尔比勒经谢赫雷祖尔延伸到阿塞拜疆和高加索山麓。阿拉伯地理学家记载，他们早在906年就与摩苏尔的哈姆丹王朝冲突，战后数千户人家被安置在摩苏尔北部。

联盟支系包括居埃尔比勒和谢赫雷祖尔的哈卡米耶、居阿塞拜疆的拉瓦迪耶。沙达德、拉瓦德和阿尤布王朝都出自联盟诸支，萨拉丁本人的家族即属哈兹巴尼的拉瓦迪耶。

随着塞尔柱和蒙古势力席卷杰济拉，独立的哈兹巴尼政权先后被吞并，但部落名号与族支仍留存于谢赫雷祖尔山区，该地在蒙古时代末期转入阿尔达兰之手。

en:
The Hafsids were a Sunni dynasty of Berber origin that ruled Ifriqiya from Tunis between 1229 and 1574. Abu Hafs, a Masmuda chief and companion of Ibn Tumart, gave the house its name; his descendants were Almohad governors until Abu Zakariya Yahya founded an independent sultanate in 1229.

Under al-Mustansir, who reigned until 1277, Tunis welcomed Andalusi refugees and the first madrasas of the Maghreb were built under Hafsid patronage. The dynasty split between Tunis and western cities; after Marinid invasions and plague, Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II reunited the realm in 1370.

Abu Faris annexed Tripoli in 1401 and Algiers in 1410. Caught between Spain and Ottoman corsairs, the Hafsids became Spanish tributaries after Charles V took Tunis in 1535; the Ottomans conquered it in 1574 and carried off the last caliph Muhammad VI to Constantinople, where he was executed.
zh:
哈夫斯王朝是柏柏尔血统的逊尼派王朝，1229—1574年以突尼斯为都统治伊弗里基叶。王朝得名于马斯穆达首领、伊本·图马尔特的亲信阿布·哈夫斯；其后裔作为穆瓦希德总督治理当地，直到阿布·扎卡里亚·叶海亚于1229年独立建国。

到1277年去世的穆斯坦绥尔在位时，突尼斯接纳了安达卢西亚难民，马格里布最早的伊斯兰学校也在王室资助下建成。王朝后来分裂为突尼斯与西部城市两支，遭马林人入侵和瘟疫打击后，阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世于1370年重新统一全国。

阿布·法里斯于1401年吞并的黎波里，1410年兼并阿尔及尔。王朝夹在西班牙与奥斯曼海盗之间，1535年查理五世攻占突尼斯后沦为西班牙附庸；1574年奥斯曼人攻克该城，末代哈里发穆罕默德六世被押往君士坦丁堡处死。

en:
The Haihayas of Ratnapura were a branch of the Kalachuri dynasty, claiming descent from the ancient Haihaya kings of the Lunar line. Around 1000 Kalingaraja, a prince of the Tripuri Kalachuri house, conquered Dakshina Kosala from the Somavamshis and founded the kingdom, ruling from Tummana; his grandson Ratnadeva I built Ratnapura as its capital.

Long feudatories of the Tripuri dynasty, the branch became effectively independent under Jajalladeva I around 1100. Ratnadeva II formally threw off Tripuri's overlordship and repulsed the Eastern Ganga king Anantavarman Chodaganga. By the late fourteenth century the family had split into Ratanpur and Raipur branches.

Sheltered by forested hills, the kingdom escaped the Muslim conquests of northern India. Its later rajas kept an unbroken court until the Marathas of Nagpur imposed suzerainty in 1740; the last raja Mohan Singh died in 1758 and the kingdom was annexed.
zh:
拉特纳普拉的诃伊诃耶人是卡拉丘里王朝的支系，自称源出月亮世系的古代诃伊诃耶诸王。约1000年，特里普里卡拉丘里王室的卡林加拉贾从索马万希王朝手中夺取南拘萨罗建立王国，定都图马纳；其孙拉特那提婆一世兴建都城拉特纳普拉。

该支系长期作为特里普里王朝的封臣，约1100年贾贾拉提婆一世使其实际独立。拉特那提婆二世正式摆脱特里普里的宗主权，并击退东恒伽国王阿南塔跋摩·朱达恒伽。到14世纪末，家族分裂为拉坦普尔和赖布尔两支。

凭借山林屏障，王国避开了北印度的穆斯林征服，后世拉贾的宫廷绵延不绝，直到1740年那格浦尔的马拉塔人强迫其臣服；1758年末代拉贾莫汉·辛格去世，国家遂被吞并。

en:
The Hakkari were a Kurdish tribal house, known to medieval Arab writers as al-Hakkariyya, who grazed their flocks between the Great Zab and Lake Urmia from at least the tenth century. They gave their name to the emirate centered on Çölemerik, also called Julamerk.

Their chief submitted to Imad al-Din Zengi in 1133, and the Hakkariyya regiment became a major Kurdish corps in Saladin's army, fighting at Acre in 1191. The hereditary emirate is documented from the 1380s under Izz al-Din Shir, who kept his throne by switching allegiance between the Timurids and Qara Qoyunlu until his death in 1423.

After Qara Iskander destroyed his heirs, a descendant, Asad al-Din Zarin Cang, returned from Egypt and rebuilt the principality. On the Ottoman-Safavid frontier, later emirs played the two empires off against each other, while family wars split the emirate into rival fiefs.
zh:
哈卡里是库尔德部落家族，中世纪阿拉伯文献称之为哈卡里亚，至迟10世纪起就在大扎卜河与乌尔米耶湖之间游牧。其名也被用来称呼以彻莱梅里克（又名朱拉梅尔克）为中心的埃米尔国。

其首领于1133年向伊马德丁·赞吉称臣，哈卡里军团成为萨拉丁军队中重要的库尔德武装，参加了1191年的阿卡围城战。世袭的埃米尔国在1380年代伊兹丁·希尔统治时已见记载，他在帖木儿系与黑羊王朝之间反复改换门庭，维系王权至1423年去世。

黑羊的伊斯坎达尔诛戮其继承人后，后裔阿萨德丁·扎林昌从埃及返回重建政权。后世埃米尔在奥斯曼与萨法维之间周旋，家族内战则使埃米尔国分裂为彼此对立的领地。

en:
The counts of Hals took their name from Burg Hals, a castle on the Ilz near Passau. Their ancestor Rotbert appears in documents in 1112 and is credited with building the castle around 1100. Around 1160 Albert of Kamm inherited the lordship through marriage to Liukarde of Hals, and his descendants became counts of Hals.

In 1280 King Rudolf I invested Albert of Hals with the rank of imperial count. The family extended its territory to the Bohemian border, secured the Goldener Steig trade route and acquired Baumgarten in 1338.

The line died out in 1375, and an inheritance dispute ended with Landgrave John of Leuchtenberg receiving the fief. Hals became a town in 1376 and gained minting rights in 1377; the remnants passed to the Aichberg family in 1485 and were sold to the dukes of Bavaria in 1517.
zh:
哈尔斯伯爵得名于帕绍附近伊尔茨河上的哈尔斯城堡。可考的始祖罗特贝特1112年见于主教座堂文书，一般认为他在1100年前后修建了城堡。约1160年，卡姆的阿尔伯特因与哈尔斯的柳克德联姻继承领地，其后裔成为哈尔斯伯爵。

1280年，鲁道夫一世授予哈尔斯的阿尔伯特帝国伯爵衔。家族将领地拓展到波希米亚边境，控制了“黄金小道”商路，1338年取得鲍姆加滕。

1375年该支绝嗣，继承之争以洛伊希滕贝格藩侯约翰受封告终。哈尔斯于1376年升格为城市，1377年获得铸币权；伯国残余部分于1485年归艾希贝格家族，1517年卖给巴伐利亚公爵。

en:
The Hamar Gale were the royal Gerad line of the Warsangali Darod Somalis of the Maakhir coast in northern Somalia. The line is traced to Gerad Abdullahi Dhidhin, founder of the Warsangali polity, whose son Gerad Hassan inherited the leadership in 1311.

Hassan earned the nickname Hamar Gale, meaning the Mogadishu settler, after leaving the northern clan lands for the Benadir coast near Mogadishu; when he died in 1328 the leadership passed to Gerad Ibrahim.

In 1613 a descendant, Garaad Abdulle Mahmud I, united the coastal factions into a centralized Warsangali state with its capital at Durduri, dominating the frankincense and date trade of the Gulf of Aden. His house bore the title Garaad until 1764, when the ruler adopted the style of Sultan while the older title remained in local use.
zh:
哈马尔·加莱家族是北索马里马希尔沿海瓦桑加利达鲁德索马里人的王室杰拉德世系。该世系可追溯到瓦桑加利政权的建立者杰拉德·阿卜杜拉希·迪丁，其子杰拉德·哈桑于1311年继位。

哈桑因离开北方氏族故地、迁居摩加迪沙一带的贝纳迪尔沿海而得绰号“哈马尔·加莱”，意为“摩加迪沙的定居者”；他于1328年去世，首领之位传给杰拉德·易卜拉欣。

1613年，其后人加拉德·阿卜杜勒·马哈茂德一世把沿海各派系联合成集权的瓦桑加利国家，定都杜尔杜里，控制了亚丁湾的乳香和椰枣贸易。其家族一直保有“加拉德”称号，直到1764年统治者改用苏丹尊号，而旧称在民间仍然沿用。

en:
The Hamidids were a Turkic beylik that arose in southwestern Anatolia as the Sultanate of Rum dissolved, holding the lake district around Eğirdir, Isparta and Uluborlu.

The dynasty looked back to Hamid and his son Ilyas, Seljuk frontier lords, and the founder was Dündar Bey, who made the family independent early in the fourteenth century. In 1321 his brother Yunus Bey founded the Beylik of Teke on the Mediterranean coast, with its capital at Antalya.

As Ottoman power grew, the Hamidids sold Akşehir and Beyşehir to Murad I, and Bayezid I extinguished the beylik in 1391, turning its heartland into the Ottoman Sanjak of Hamid. Teke was taken in the same year but restored by Timur after his victory at Ankara in 1402, until the Ottomans re-annexed it in 1423.
zh:
哈米德王朝是罗姆苏丹国瓦解时兴起于安纳托利亚西南部的突厥贝伊国，领有埃伊尔迪尔、厄斯帕尔塔和乌卢博尔卢一带的湖区。

该朝先世为塞尔柱边境领主哈米德及其子伊利亚斯，开国者是敦达尔贝伊，他在14世纪初使家族获得独立。1321年，他的兄弟尤努斯贝伊在地中海岸建立以安塔利亚为都的特克贝伊国。

随着奥斯曼势力壮大，哈米德人将阿克谢希尔和贝伊谢希尔卖给穆拉德一世，巴耶济德一世于1391年攻灭贝伊国，其核心领地被改为奥斯曼的哈米德桑贾克。特克也于同年被吞并，但帖木儿1402年在安卡拉获胜后将其恢复，直到1423年奥斯曼人再度兼并特克。

en:
The Hanan Qusqu, or Upper Cusco, was the second Inca dynasty, drawn from the upper half of the city's dual moiety system. Around 1350 its leader Inca Roca overthrew the Hurin Qusqu branch and became the first Cusco lord to call himself Inca, leaving the Hurin with religious office while the Hanan monopolized secular and military power.

Pachacuti, as Cusi Yupanqui, saved Cusco from the Chanka invasion of 1438 and then built the Tawantinsuyu, the Inca Empire. His son Topa Inca Yupanqui and grandson Huayna Capac extended its rule from Quito to central Chile.

Huayna Capac's death in a smallpox epidemic around 1527 brought a civil war between his sons Huascar and Atahualpa, and the Spanish under Pizarro captured and executed Atahualpa in 1533. A Hanan prince held out in Vilcabamba until 1572, when Tupac Amaru I was executed in Cusco.
zh:
哈南·库斯科意为上库斯科，是印卡第二个王族，出自库斯科城二元氏族体系的上支。约1350年，首领印卡·罗卡推翻乌林·库斯科一支，成为首位自称印卡的库斯科君主，乌林支掌宗教事务，哈南支独揽世俗与军政大权。

帕查库特克原名库西·尤潘基，在1438年昌卡入侵时拯救库斯科，随后建立印加帝国塔万廷苏尤。其子图帕克·印卡·尤潘基和其孙瓦伊纳·卡帕克把帝国疆域从基多推进到智利中部。

约1527年瓦伊纳·卡帕克死于天花，其子瓦斯卡尔与阿塔瓦尔帕爆发内战，皮萨罗率西班牙人于1533年擒杀阿塔瓦尔帕。哈南支的一位王子退守比尔卡班巴，坚持到1572年图帕克·阿马鲁一世在库斯科被处死。

en:
The lords and counts of Hanau were a Wetterau noble house whose lordship was enlarged in 1255 by part of the Hagen-Munzenberg inheritance. Under Ulrich I, ruling from 1281 to about 1306, the family gained a sixth share through his mother, including Babenhausen, and widened its lands in the upper Kinzig valley.

In 1429 Emperor Sigismund raised the lordship to the County of Hanau. Partition in 1458 created the Munzenberg and Babenhausen lines; the latter inherited Lichtenberg in 1473, forming Hanau-Munzenberg and Hanau-Lichtenberg. In 1612 Munzenberg passed to the Lichtenberg line.

After the Thirty Years' War Count Friedrich Casimir founded Germany's first faience factory but nearly bankrupted the county by leasing Guiana in the failed Hanau Indies venture; he was placed under guardianship in 1670. The house died out in 1736; Hanau-Munzenberg passed to Hesse-Kassel and Hanau-Lichtenberg to Hesse-Darmstadt.
zh:
哈瑙领主及后来的伯爵家族是韦特劳地区的贵族世家，1255年因继承部分哈根-明岑贝格领地而版图大增。乌尔里希一世在1281年至约1306年间执政，通过母亲取得遗产的六分之一，包括巴本豪森，并扩张了上金齐希河谷的领地。

1429年，皇帝西吉斯蒙德将领地升为哈瑙伯国。1458年家族分为明岑贝格和巴本豪森两支，后者于1473年继承利希滕贝格领地，形成哈瑙-明岑贝格和哈瑙-利希滕贝格两个伯国。1612年明岑贝格转入利希滕贝格支之手。

三十年战争后，弗里德里希·卡西米尔伯爵创办了德国第一家彩陶工厂，却因租下圭亚那、推行失败的哈瑙印度计划而险些令伯国破产，1670年被置于监护之下。1736年家族绝嗣，哈瑙-明岑贝格归黑森-卡塞尔，哈瑙-利希滕贝格归黑森-达姆施塔特。

en:
Haniji, also read Haneji, founded the kingdom of Hokuzan in northern Okinawa during the Sanzan period. Ryukyu tradition holds that he overthrew the aji of Nakijin, then in 1322 renounced Chūzan's overlordship and styled himself King of Hokuzan, ruling from Nakijin Castle. His name may derive from Haneji, a northern settlement.

He first appears in Ming records in 1383, when he sent a tributary mission after the Ming court ordered the three kings to make peace. Five missions went under his name before his last contact in 1390. On his death around 1395 his son Min succeeded him; because the reign covers nearly seventy years, some scholars suspect the name covers several same-named rulers.

The realm his house founded, the poorest Sanzan kingdom, ended in 1416 when Shō Hashi of Chūzan stormed Nakijin and the last king killed himself.
zh:
怕尼芝（又读羽地）在三山时代的冲绳北部建立北山王国。据琉球本土记载，他攻灭今归仁按司，于1322年脱离中山统辖，自称北山王，在今归仁城统治。其名字可能得名于冲绳北部的羽地。

1383年明朝遣使调停三山争斗，他随即派出朝贡使团，至1390年最后一次见于记载为止，以其名义共派出五次朝贡。约1395年他去世，子珉继位；因其名义上的统治延续近七十年，有学者认为怕尼芝实为数代同名君主的合称。

他所开创的北山是三国中最贫瘠的一国，1416年中山的尚巴志攻破今归仁城，末代国王自杀，北山灭亡。

en: The Hanyang Han were a Goryeo aristocratic clan of Hanyang, present-day Seoul. They branched from the Cheongju Han: their founder Han Won-seo, a sixth-generation descendant of Cheongju founder Han Ran, passed the civil examination under King Chungnyeol (r. 1274—1308), rose to high office and was enfeoffed as Prince of Hanyang, after which his descendants made Hanyang their clan seat.
zh: 汉阳韩氏是以汉阳（今首尔）为本贯的高丽贵族氏族，自清州韩氏分出。其始祖韩元諝是清州韩氏始祖韩兰的六世孙，在忠烈王（1274—1308年在位）时科举及第，历任高官并受封汉阳府院君，后人遂以汉阳为本贯、奉韩元諝为始祖。

en:
The Harichandan Mohapatras were the ruling family of Narsinghpur, a small Garjat chiefdom in the Mahanadi valley of central Odisha. Local legend traces the chiefdom to two Khond chiefs of the thirteenth century, Narsingh and Poro, who were subdued by Dharma Singh.

The family's title Harichandan Mahapatra was conferred by its overlord the Gajapati raja of Puri. No records survive from the Mughal or Maratha periods; its documented line of rulers begins with Mandardhar Harichandan Mahapatra in 1671 and runs through the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh:
哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉家族是讷尔辛格布尔的统治家族，其领地是奥里萨中部默哈讷迪河谷的一个迦贾德小酋邦。当地传说该酋邦源于13世纪的两位孔德人首领纳尔辛格与波罗，后被达尔马·辛格征服。

家族的哈里钱丹·莫哈帕特拉头衔是宗主普里的加贾帕蒂罗阇授予的。莫卧儿与马拉塔时期均无文书传世，可考的首领世系从1671年的曼达尔达尔开始，贯穿18世纪至19世纪初。

en:
The Hasan-Jalalyan were an Armenian princely house that ruled Khachen in historical Artsakh from 1214. Their founder Hasan-Jalal Dawla inherited his father's lands in 1214 and acquired Dizak-Balk through marriage. He founded Gandzasar monastery, built between 1216 and 1238 and consecrated in 1240, later the seat of the Catholicosate of Albania and the family's burial church.

After the Mongol conquest Hasan-Jalal was arrested and executed around 1262, but his son Atabek was confirmed in Khachen and ruled until 1306. His descendants took the surname Hasan-Jalalyan and retained autonomy under successive overlords. In the late sixteenth century cadet branches established three of the Five Melikdoms of Karabakh.

The meliks fought Ottoman and Persian armies and sought Russian aid. The last melik of Khachen, Allahverdi II, died in 1813, after Russia took the region in 1805.
zh:
哈桑‑贾拉良家族是亚美尼亚王公世家，自1214年起统治历史上阿尔察赫地区的哈琴。始祖哈桑‑贾拉勒·道莱于1214年继承父亲的领地，又通过联姻取得迪扎克‑巴尔克。他主持修建甘扎萨尔修道院，工程始于1216年、1238年完工，1240年祝圣，后来成为阿尔巴尼亚卡托利科斯座驻地和家族墓地。

蒙古征服后，哈桑‑贾拉勒被捕，约1262年被处死，其子阿塔贝克仍被确认统治哈琴，在位至1306年。后代以始祖之名为姓，称哈桑‑贾拉良，在历代宗主下保持自治。16世纪末，家族旁支建立了卡拉巴赫五梅利克领中的三个。

梅利克们抗击奥斯曼与波斯军队，并向俄国求援。哈琴末代梅利克阿拉韦尔迪二世于1813年去世，此前俄国已在1805年占领该地区。

en:
The Hasbani house is that of Abd Allah, son of Shihab al-Din Zanki, whom the Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari named in the 1340s as emir of two branches of the Kurdish Hasnaniyya, the Baliyya and the Jakiyya.

The tribe's largest clan followed Isa, son of Shihab al-Din Karati, and its third was led by Ikhtiyar al-Din Umar after his brother Fakhr al-Din.
zh:
哈斯巴尼家族即谢哈卜丁·赞吉之子阿卜杜拉一系。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，他是库尔德哈斯纳尼亚部中巴利亚、贾基亚两支的埃米尔。

该部最大的氏族追随谢哈卜丁·卡拉蒂之子伊萨，第三个氏族先由法赫鲁丁统领，后由其兄弟伊赫蒂亚尔丁·欧麦尔接掌。

en:
The Hastings were an English baronial house seated at Abergavenny on the Welsh march. Henry de Hastings was summoned as Lord Hastings in 1263; his son John inherited the Abergavenny estates in 1273 and was recognized as Baron Hastings in 1290, when he also claimed the crown of Scotland.

John's grandson Laurence was created Earl of Pembroke in 1339 and died in 1348. His son John served Edward III in Aquitaine but was captured by the Castilian fleet at La Rochelle in 1372 and died in 1375 after his ransom was paid.

The last earl, another John, inherited as an infant and was killed in a joust at Woodstock in 1389 at seventeen, leaving no children. The earldom became extinct, while the Barony of Hastings passed to a cousin's line.
zh:
黑斯廷斯家族是英格兰的男爵世家，坐落在威尔士边境的阿伯加文尼。亨利·德·黑斯廷斯于1263年被召为黑斯廷斯勋爵；其子约翰于1273年继承阿伯加文尼地产，1290年被确认为黑斯廷斯男爵，同年还提出对苏格兰王位的主张。

约翰的孙子劳伦斯于1339年受封彭布罗克伯爵，1348年去世。其子约翰在阿基坦为爱德华三世作战，1372年在拉罗谢尔海战中被卡斯蒂利亚舰队俘虏，1375年赎金付清后去世。

末代伯爵也叫约翰，幼年袭爵，1389年在伍德斯托克的比武大会上身亡，年仅十七岁，没有子嗣。彭布罗克伯爵爵号随之废止，黑斯廷斯男爵则转入堂亲一系。

en:
The Hata were the leading house of the Upper Matsuura party, a federation of seafaring warriors on the coast of Hizen in northern Kyushu. They traced their line to the Saga Genji through the Watanabe: Matsuura Mochi settled at Hata and took its name in 1102. The clan grew strong around Kishidake Castle and crossed to Iki Island.

In the Sengoku period a succession quarrel after Hata Sakō's death drew in the Arima, Ryūzōji and Hirado Matsuura. Hata Chikashi, Sakō's adopted heir and maternal grandson, won his seat with Ryūzōji backing between 1564 and 1569, then submitted to Ryūzōji Takanobu; after Takanobu fell in 1584, he moved toward the Shimazu.

Chikashi submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1587, but defied Nabeshima Naoshige's orders during the Korean campaign. In 1593 Hideyoshi confiscated his lands and exiled him to Tsukuba, where he died and the house ended.
zh:
波多氏是九州北部肥前国松浦沿岸上松浦党的首族，松浦党是以水军著称的武士联合体。其谱系经渡边氏追溯到嵯峨源氏：松浦持移居波多，于1102年改称波多持。家族以岸岳城为本据发展壮大，并进兵壹岐岛。

战国时代，波多盛死后爆发继承之争，有马氏、龙造寺氏和平户松浦氏纷纷插手。波多盛的外孙兼养嗣子波多亲在1564—1569年的争斗中靠龙造寺氏支持夺得家督，随后臣服于龙造寺隆信；1584年隆信战死后，他又倒向岛津氏。

1587年波多亲臣服丰臣秀吉，但在朝鲜战役中违抗锅岛直茂的军令。1593年秀吉没收其领地，将他流放筑波，他最终客死当地，波多氏就此灭亡。

en:
The Hatakeyama began as a Taira house of Musashi Province, named for its Hatakeyama estate, but Hatakeyama Shigetada's line was destroyed in the Hojo purge of 1205. Hojo Tokimasa then had Ashikaga Yoshizumi of the Seiwa Genji marry the widow and revive the name, so the later Hatakeyama were Minamoto.

They fought for the Ashikaga shogunate through the Nanboku-cho wars and won hereditary constableships in Yamashiro, Noto and other provinces, becoming one of the three kanrei houses of the Muromachi regime. Around 1450 Masanaga and Yoshinari disputed the succession; the feud helped spark the Onin War of 1467 and cost the clan the kanrei office to the Hosokawa.

In the Sengoku age the branches parted. The Kawachi line remained a leading opponent of Oda Nobunaga, the Noto line at Nanao Castle fell to internal strife in the 1570s, and the Nihonmatsu line in Mutsu, reduced to Ashina vassals, was largely destroyed by Date Masamune after Hitotoribashi in 1586.
zh:
畠山氏原是桓武平氏的一支，以武藏国的畠山乡为苗字，但畠山重忠一脉在1205年遭北条氏讨伐而断绝。北条时政随后安排清和源氏的足利义纯迎娶其遗孀、复兴畠山之名，后来的畠山氏遂属源氏血统。

南北朝时，他们为足利幕府作战，世代受封山城、能登等国守护，成为室町幕府三管领家之一。1450年前后，畠山政长与畠山义就争夺家督而分裂，其争斗成为1467年应仁之乱的导火索之一，管领一职也被细川氏夺去。

战国时代，畠山各支各自沉浮：河内畠山仍是织田信长的主要对手之一；能登畠山据七尾城，在16世纪70年代因内乱失势；陆奥二本松畠山先沦为芦名氏家臣，又在1586年人取桥之战后被伊达政宗基本攻灭。

en:
The Hatta were a warrior house of Hatta in Hitachi Province, springing from the Utsunomiya clan of Shimotsuke. Hatta Tomoie joined Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1180, defeated Shida Yoshihiro in 1183 and became shugo of Hitachi in 1185. In 1193 he brought down his rival Taki Yoshimoto and gained lands in Tsukuba and Niihari.

After Yoritomo's death in 1199 Tomoie joined the Kamakura shogunate's thirteen councillors. He built Oda Castle, and his son Tomoshige took the surname Oda; the house lost the shugo title and part of its lands after backing the Miura in the Hōji Conflict in 1247.

The Oda fought for the Southern Court in the Nanboku-chō war and ranked among eight houses of the Kantō. Pressed by the Satake and Later Hōjō, they lost Oda Castle in 1569, submitted to the Satake in 1583 and were dispossessed after missing the Odawara campaign of 1590.
zh:
八田氏是常陆国八田的武家，出自下野的宇都宫氏。八田知家于1180年投奔源赖朝，1183年击败志田义广，1185年出任常陆守护。1193年，知家扳倒对手多气义干，取得筑波和新治的领地。

1199年赖朝死后，知家位列镰仓幕府十三人合议制。他修筑小田城，其子知重改以小田为姓；1247年宝治合战后，小田氏因支持三浦氏而被剥夺守护职和部分领地。

小田氏在南北朝时代为南朝作战，后来被列为关东八屋形之一。他们在佐竹氏与后北条氏的挤压下，1569年失去小田城，1583年臣服佐竹氏，1590年因未参加小田原征伐而被没收领地。

en:
The Hazaraspids were a Kurdish Sunni dynasty that ruled the Zagros highlands of southwestern Iran, chiefly Greater Luristan, from 1115 to 1424, with their capital at Idaj. Their ancestor Fadlawi migrated from Syria through Adharbayjan to Luristan; the founder Abu Tahir ibn Muhammad, of Shabankara stock, was a commander of the Salghurids before becoming independent as atabeg.

The dynasty was named for his son Malik Hazarasp, whose Persian name means thousand horses and who aided the Khwarezmshah Jalal al-Din against the Mongols. As Ilkhanid vassals the family enlarged its domains: Yusuf Shah I gained Khuzestan and Golpayegan, while Yusuf Shah II seized Shushtar, Hoveizeh and Basra in the 1330s.

Afrasiab I was executed by Ghazan in 1296, and the Muzaffarids briefly occupied Idaj later in the fourteenth century. In 1424 the Timurid Shahrukh overthrew the last atabeg, Ghiyath al-Din, and annexed Greater Luristan.
zh:
哈扎拉斯普王朝是库尔德人的逊尼派王朝，1115—1424年统治伊朗西南部的扎格罗斯山区，核心是大卢尔斯坦，都城在伊达吉。其先祖法德拉维从叙利亚经阿塞拜疆迁至卢尔斯坦；开国君主阿布·塔希尔·本·穆罕默德有沙班卡拉人血统，原是萨尔古尔王朝的将领，后来自立为阿塔伯格。

王朝得名于其子马利克·哈扎拉斯普，其波斯语名字意为“千马”；他曾协助花剌子模沙札兰丁抵抗蒙古人。作为伊儿汗国藩属，家族不断扩张：优素福沙一世取得胡齐斯坦和戈勒派甘；优素福沙二世在14世纪30年代攻占舒什塔尔、霍韦伊泽乃至巴士拉。

阿弗拉西亚布一世于1296年被合赞处死，14世纪后期莫扎法尔王朝曾短暂占领伊达吉。1424年，帖木儿王朝的沙哈鲁推翻末代阿塔伯格吉亚斯丁，吞并大卢尔斯坦。

en:
The Hei were a samurai house of Mutsu Province, holding the Hei district on the Pacific coast around Miyako. Their tradition claimed descent from Minamoto no Tametomo through a son adopted by Sasaki Takatsuna; after the Oshu war of 1189 Yorimoto moved from Kesen to Hei in the 1190s and took its name. Scholars consider the family more likely a branch of the Sasaki.

As Kamakura gokenin they ruled as stewards, and Mitsuyori's inheritance dispute was settled by regent Hojo Takatoki. In 1333 Mitsuyori's son Chikamitsu joined Kitabatake Akiie's Southern Court army, fighting at Teshimagawara and Aonogahara before defeat at Ishizu.

The main line built Takasari Castle and took its name, heading the thirteen Takasari houses and breeding horses prized in Kyoto. Pressed by the Nanbu, they submitted; after Hideyoshi confirmed Nanbu holdings in 1590, they became retainers and served the Morioka Domain.
zh:
闭伊氏是陆奥国的武家，盘踞在宫古一带太平洋沿岸的闭伊郡。家传称始祖是源为朝之子、佐佐木高纲的养子；1189年奥州合战后，赖基在12世纪90年代从气仙移住闭伊，以郡名为姓。学者认为他们更可能是佐佐木一族的支系。

镰仓时代闭伊氏以御家人身份担任地头，光赖的遗产争端曾由执权北条高时裁决。1333年光赖之子亲光投奔南朝的北畠显家，参加丰岛河原、青野原等战役，最终在石津战败。

嫡流后来修筑田锁城并改称田锁氏，统率田锁十三家，所产马匹在京都也备受推崇。在南部氏的攻势下，田锁氏臣服；1590年丰臣秀吉确认南部氏领地后，他们成为南部家臣，在盛冈藩任职。

en:
The Heib, or Banu Hayb, were an Arab Bedouin tribal line of Barqa in eastern Libya. They belonged to the Banu Sulaym confederation, which moved west from Egypt in the Hilalian migration of the eleventh century. Their two main branches were the Shammakh and the Labid, while the chieftaincy over all the Hayb groups rested with the Banu Izzaz, known as the Izza.

In the fourteenth century they were the dominant tribesmen of Barqa under loose Mamluk suzerainty. Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad launched expeditions against them between 1319 and 1325 to enforce payment of the zakat on flocks and harvests, and a commander named Fayid led the Barqa Arabs on the sultan's behalf until his death in 1346.

Later the chieftaincy passed to Arif ibn Amr and then to his son Amr, whom the Egyptian encyclopedist al-Qalqashandi still found holding Barqa early in the fifteenth century.
zh:
海卜部又称巴努·海卜，是利比亚东部巴尔卡的阿拉伯贝都因酋长治系。他们隶属于巴努·苏莱姆联盟，11世纪随希拉尔大迁徙从埃及西来。其下分舍马赫、莱比德两大支，各部酋长权掌握在别称“伊扎”的巴努·伊扎兹家族手中。

14世纪，他们是巴尔卡占主导地位的部族，仅在名义上臣服马穆鲁克。纳西尔·穆罕默德苏丹于1319—1325年多次派兵远征，强迫他们缴纳牲畜和庄稼的天课；首领法伊德代表苏丹统辖巴尔卡阿拉伯人，直到1346年去世。

此后酋长权先后传给阿里夫·伊本·阿姆鲁及其子阿姆鲁，埃及百科学者盖勒盖山迪在15世纪初仍记载阿姆鲁执掌巴尔卡。

en:
The lords of Heinsberg sprang from the House of Wassenberg: in 1082 Goswin, brother of the first count of Guelders, was invested with the lordship around Heinsberg west of the Rhine. Philip of Heinsberg, Archbishop of Cologne from 1167 to 1191, became Duke of Westphalia in 1180, built the Cologne city wall and died during Emperor Henry VI's siege of Naples.

After the male Wassenberg line failed, the heiress Alix married a younger son of the count of Cleves in 1168, and her daughter Agnes carried Heinsberg to the Sponheim family. Theodoric of Heinsberg, son of Godfrey II, inherited Loon and Chiny through his mother in 1336 and held them against the claims of Liege.

His only son died on the Prussian Crusade in 1342. After Theodoric's death in 1361, the disputed inheritance of Loon and Chiny sparked the War of the Loon Succession; Heinsberg later passed to the dukes of Juelich.
zh:
海因斯贝格领主出自瓦森贝格家族：1082年，首任海尔德伯爵之弟戈斯温受封莱茵河以西海因斯贝格一带。海因斯贝格的菲利普于1167—1191年任科隆大主教，1180年成为威斯特伐利亚公爵，主持修建科隆城墙，在皇帝亨利六世围攻那不勒斯时身亡。

瓦森贝格男嗣断绝后，女继承人阿莉克斯于1168年嫁给克莱沃伯爵的幼子，其女阿格妮丝又把海因斯贝格带给施蓬海姆家族。戈特弗里德二世之子迪特里希于1336年通过母亲继承隆和希尼两个伯国，并顶住列日的索取。

他唯一的儿子1342年死于普鲁士十字军。迪特里希1361年去世后，隆与希尼的继承争端引发隆继承战争，海因斯贝格后来则转入于利希公爵之手。

en:
The counts of Henneberg were a Franconian dynasty, probably descended from the Popponid Babenberg family, who built a county between the Thuringian Forest and the Main. Their ancestral seat was the Henneburg, first associated with burgrave Godebold II of Wurzburg in 1096; the family held the burgraviate of Wurzburg from about 1057, losing its rights by 1354. Godebold founded Vessra monastery in 1131, later the dynasty's burial church.

The great division of 1274 formed the Hartenberg, Aschach-Romhild and Schleusingen lines. In 1310 Berthold VII of Henneberg-Schleusingen became a princely count and imperial prince, at various times administering Bohemia and guarding the young Wittelsbach heir.

The Reformation came in 1542. When the last princely count, Georg Ernst, died in 1583, the male line became extinct and the lands passed to the Saxon Wettin dynasty under an inheritance treaty.
zh:
亨讷贝格伯爵是法兰克尼亚的世家，很可能出自波波尼德系的巴本贝格家族，在图林根林山与美因河之间建立伯国。祖堡亨讷堡1096年首次与维尔茨堡城堡伯爵戈德博尔德二世联系在一起；家族约从1057年起世袭维尔茨堡城堡伯爵之职，至1354年丢掉相关权利。戈德博尔德于1131年创立费斯拉修道院，后来成为家族墓地。

1274年大分裂形成哈滕贝格、阿沙赫‑勒姆希尔德和施洛伊辛根三支。1310年，亨讷贝格‑施洛伊辛根的贝希托尔德七世被擢升为尊贵伯爵、帝国诸侯，曾代管波希米亚并监护维特尔斯巴赫幼主。

1542年伯国引入宗教改革。1583年末代尊贵伯爵格奥尔格·恩斯特去世，男系绝嗣，领地根据继承条约转入萨克森韦廷家族。

en:
The House of Hesse descends from the dukes of Brabant of the Reginar family. In 1241 Sophie of Thuringia, daughter of Landgrave Louis IV and Saint Elizabeth of Hungary, married Henry II of Brabant, and when the Ludovingian landgraves died out in 1247 she fought the War of the Thuringian Succession and kept the Hessian lands for her son Henry the Child, who became the first Landgrave of Hesse in 1264.

In 1337 the landgraviate was ruled from Cassel by Henry II the Iron, whose daughter Adelaide married King Casimir III of Poland. Hesse was briefly split into Upper and Lower Hesse and reunited by William II in 1500.

It reached its greatest weight under Philip I the Magnanimous, who adopted Protestantism at the Homberg synod of 1526 and led the Schmalkaldic League against Emperor Charles V. On Philip's death in 1567 his four sons divided the land; the Kassel line became imperial electors in 1803 and the Darmstadt line grand dukes in 1806.
zh:
黑森家族男系出自雷吉纳尔家族的布拉班特公爵一脉。1241年，图林根领地伯爵路易四世与匈牙利的圣伊丽莎白之女索菲嫁给布拉班特的亨利二世；1247年卢多维格家族男系断绝后，索菲在图林根继承战争中力争，为儿子孩童亨利保住黑森土地，亨利于1264年成为首任黑森领地伯爵。

1337年，领地伯爵是驻于卡塞勒的亨利二世“铁人”，他的女儿阿德莱德嫁给波兰国王卡齐米日三世。黑森曾一度分为上黑森和下黑森，1500年由威廉二世重新统一。

家族在“慷慨者”菲利普一世治下达到鼎盛：他在1526年霍姆贝格会议上皈依新教，并领导施马尔卡尔登联盟对抗皇帝查理五世。1567年菲利普去世后，四个儿子瓜分黑森；卡塞尔一支于1803年成为帝国选侯，达姆施塔特一支于1806年成为大公。

en:
The Hethumids, also called the House of Lampron, were the Armenian dynasty that ruled the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia from 1226 to 1341. As barons of Lampron the family had long rivalled the Rubenid kings, until Hethum I married Queen Isabella, daughter of Leo I, and inherited the crown in 1226.

Hethum submitted to the Mongol Empire and travelled to the Great Khan's court, forging an Armeno-Mongol alliance against the Mamluks; it brought decades of campaigning, including the devastating Mamluk victory at Mari in 1266. Under Hethum and his successors Cilician Armenia reached its height, its port of Ayas linking Mediterranean and East Asian trade and its nobility drawing close to the Crusader states.

From the early fourteenth century the kingdom shrank under repeated Mamluk invasions, while the abdications and murders around Hethum II exposed court factionalism. Leo IV, the last Hethumid king, was killed in 1341 and the crown passed to Lusignan cousins from Cyprus; the remnant kingdom finally fell to the Mamluks in 1375.
zh:
海屯米扬王朝又称兰普龙家族，是1226年至1341年间统治奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国的亚美尼亚王朝。该家族本为兰普龙的男爵，长期与鲁本王朝诸王抗衡，直到海屯一世娶鲁本王朝莱翁一世之女伊莎贝拉女王为妻，于1226年继承王位。

海屯一世向蒙古帝国称臣，并亲赴大汗朝廷，建立亚美尼亚与蒙古的同盟，共同对抗埃及的马穆鲁克；同盟带来数十年征战，包括1266年马穆鲁克在马里战役的毁灭性胜利。在海屯一世及其后继者治下，奇里乞亚亚美尼亚达到鼎盛，港口阿亚斯连通地中海与东亚贸易，贵族也与十字军国家日益亲近。

14世纪初起，王国在马穆鲁克反复入侵下不断萎缩，海屯二世几度退位又遇害，暴露宫廷内讧。末代君主莱翁四世于1341年被杀，王位转入塞浦路斯的吕西尼昂家族旁支；残存的王国最终于1375年被马穆鲁克攻灭。

en:
The Hienuki were a warrior clan of northern Japan who held Hienuki district in Mutsu province on the Kitakami river. Their founder was said to have served Minamoto no Yoritomo and received the district after the Oshu campaign of 1189, though the clan first appears in documents in the 1330s.

In the Nanboku-cho wars it backed the Southern Court, then the Shiba, the Northern Court's tandai of Oshu, and suffered Nanbu Masanaga's attacks in 1340 and 1341. In the Waga disturbance of 1435 and 1436 its castles fell and it accepted Nanbu overlordship.

In 1555 the lord Terutoki visited Kyoto, presented gold to Shogun Ashikaga Yoshiteru and received the character ‘teru’ for his name. The last lord Hirotada lost his lands after missing Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign of 1590; he joined the Waga-Hienuki rising of 1591, fled after its defeat and died, while his descendants later served the Date of Sendai.
zh:
稗贯氏是日本东北的武士豪族，领有陆奥国北上川流域的稗贯郡。相传其始祖追随源赖朝，在1189年奥州合战后受封稗贯郡；该族直到14世纪30年代才首次见于文书。

南北朝战乱中，稗贯氏先从南朝，后转投北朝奥州探题斯波氏，1340—1341年遭南部政长攻击。它与南部氏的争斗长期延续：1435—1436年的和贺大乱中，稗贯的城池被攻陷，只得臣服南部。

1555年当主辉时上洛，向将军足利义辉献金并获赐“辉”字。末代当主广忠未参加1590年丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，失去领地；他在1591年参与和贺·稗贯一揆，败逃后死去，后裔相传后来侍奉仙台伊达氏。

en:
The Hindu dynasty took its name from Shaykh 'Ali Hindu, a follower of the Ilkhanid claimant Togha Temür, who appointed him governor of Astarabad on the Caspian coast. When Togha Temür was murdered by the Sarbadars in 1353 and Astarabad was annexed, 'Ali Hindu's son Amir Vali took refuge with the neighboring Jauni Kurban tribe and then used Mazandaran as a base from which to recover the city in 1356.
