He ruled Astarabad and parts of Mazandaran until 1366 and again from about 1374 to 1384, waging repeated wars against the Sarbadars and the Jalayirids and declaring for Shi'ism to win local support. His independent rule ended with the arrival of Timur, who took Astarabad in 1384.
zh:
欣杜家族得名于谢赫·阿里·欣杜，他是伊利汗国汗位争夺者脱合帖木儿的部将，被任命为里海沿岸阿斯塔拉巴德的长官。1353年脱合帖木儿被萨尔巴达尔人杀害、阿斯塔拉巴德遭吞并后，阿里·欣杜之子阿米尔·瓦利先投奔邻近的乔尼·库尔班部落，随后以马赞达兰为基地，于1356年夺回阿斯塔拉巴德。

他统治阿斯塔拉巴德和马赞达兰的部分地区至1366年，又在约1374—1384年间当政，其间屡次与萨尔巴达尔人和札剌亦儿人交战，并宣布皈依什叶派以争取当地支持。1384年帖木儿攻陷阿斯塔拉巴德，他的独立统治告终。

en:
The Aki Hiraga claimed descent from the regent Fujiwara no Yoshifusa of the Northern House. Their founder Matsuba Sukemune served Minamoto no Yoritomo in the Gempei War and received lands in Dewa, Aki, Kazusa and Etchū; his son Koreyasu moved to Hiraka district in Dewa and took Hiraga as the family name. Around 1274 the house moved to its Takaya estate in Aki and built Misonou Castle.

In the Sengoku age the house was caught between the Ōuchi and the Amago. The heir Okisada defected to the Amago and was crushed in 1540 when Mōri Motonari stormed Kashirazaki Castle; in 1551 Motonari destroyed Hiraga Takayasu and installed Shinkurō, renamed Hiraga Hirosuke, as head.

Hirosuke bound the family to the Mōri and became sworn brother to Kobayakawa Takakage. After the Mōri were transferred in 1600, the Hiraga followed with their fief cut to four thousand koku, continuing as retainers of Chōshū.
zh:
安艺平贺氏自称是摄政藤原良房的后裔，属藤原北家。始祖松叶资宗在源平合战中追随源赖朝，受封出羽、安艺、上总、越中等地；其子惟泰移居出羽国平鹿郡，以平贺为姓。1274年前后，一族西迁到安艺国高屋保，修筑御薗宇城。

战国时代，平贺氏夹在大内氏与尼子氏之间。嫡子兴贞倒向尼子，1540年毛利元就攻破头崎城，兴贞兵败；1551年元就攻灭平贺隆保，拥立新九郎继位，即平贺广相。

广相依附毛利氏，与小早川隆景结为义兄弟。1600年毛利氏转封后，平贺氏随行迁移，领地削减为四千石，此后作为长州藩士延续。

en:
The Hishikari were a kokujin warrior family of Hishikari District in northern Ōsumi, taking their name from the valley they ruled. During the Muromachi period they seized Ōguchi Castle, a fortress founded in the twelfth century on the road between Satsuma, Ōsumi and Hyūga, and resisted the expansion of the Shimazu alongside their neighbours the Sagara and Gamō.

In the Tenbun era their head Hishikari Takaaki joined Kedōin Yoshishige and Gamō Norikiyo in revolt against Shimazu Takahisa; the coalition besieged Kajiki Castle in 1554 but was routed when Takahisa's sons stormed Iwatsurugi Castle.

Fighting dragged on until in 1569 the Hishikari were beaten at the Battle of Togamire and Ōguchi became a Shimazu outer stronghold, ending the house's independence with Takaaki as its last ruling head.
zh:
菱刈氏是大隅国北部菱刈郡的国人武家，以所领的谷地为姓。室町时代他们夺取了12世纪修筑、扼守萨摩、大隅、日向三国通道的大口城，联合邻近的相良氏、蒲生氏对抗岛津氏的扩张。

天文年间，当主菱刈隆秋与祁答院良重、蒲生范清一同举兵反叛岛津贵久，联军于1554年围攻加治木城，却因贵久诸子攻陷岩剑城而溃败。

战事持续到1569年，菱刈氏在户神尾之战中被岛津军击败，大口城沦为岛津氏的外城，隆秋成为最后一位统治该谷地的当主，菱刈氏就此失去独立地位。

en:
The counts of Hohenberg were a Swabian comital house seated at Oberhohenberg Castle. They split from the counts of Zollern, ancestors of the Hohenzollerns, in the mid-twelfth century under their founder Burkhard II. Marriages and inheritances carried the house north, and in 1260 the county was split into Rottenburg and Nagold-Wildberg lines.

The family's greatest match was Gertrude, who around 1245 married Count Rudolf of Habsburg and became Queen Anna when he was elected German king in 1273. Her brother Albert II, Rudolf's councillor, founded Rottenburg about 1280 and was a Minnesinger in the Manesse manuscript before falling in battle in 1298.

Repeated partitions drove the counts into debt: from 1363 shares went to Württemberg and the Rhenish Palatinate, and in 1381 Rudolf III sold the whole county to Duke Leopold III of Austria. Rudolf III died in 1389, and the last sideline ended with Count Sigmund in 1486.
zh:
霍恩贝格伯爵是施瓦本的伯爵世家，驻于上霍恩贝格城堡。他们约在12世纪中叶从索伦伯爵（霍亨索伦家族的先祖）分出，始祖为布克哈德二世。家族借联姻和继承向北扩张，1260年伯国分为罗滕堡主支和纳戈尔德-维尔德贝格支。

家族最显赫的联姻是格特鲁德：她约在1245年嫁给哈布斯堡伯爵鲁道夫，1273年鲁道夫当选德意志国王后成为安娜王后。她的兄弟阿尔布雷希特二世是鲁道夫的顾问，约1280年创建罗滕堡城，又是《马内塞手稿》中的爱情诗人，1298年战死。

一再分家使伯爵们债台高筑：1363年起，各份领地陆续卖给符腾堡和莱茵行宫伯爵；1381年，鲁道夫三世把整个伯国卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世。鲁道夫三世于1389年去世，最后的旁支在1486年随伯爵西格蒙德而绝。

en:
The House of Hohenlohe traces its first documented ancestor to Conrad of Weikersheim, recorded in 1153; the name comes from Hohlach Castle, first adopted by the family in 1178. The lords built a lordship on the Hohenlohe Plateau in Franconia, and Heinrich and Gottfried von Hohenlohe became grand masters of the Teutonic Order.

In 1230 the house divided into the Hohenlohe and Brauneck lines, the latter dying out in 1390. Emperor Frederick III raised Kraft V and his brother to imperial counts in 1450; from 1551 the Neuenstein and Waldenburg branches dominated, the first turning Lutheran and the second remaining Catholic.

The Waldenburg line gained princely rank in 1744 and the Neuenstein-Oehringen line in 1764. In 1806 the Confederation of the Rhine mediatized the Hohenlohe lands to Bavaria and Wuerttemberg, while the family kept its estates and several branches survived.
zh:
霍恩洛厄家族可考的始祖是1153年见载的魏克斯海姆领主康拉德；家族之名来自霍拉赫城堡，1178年起被采用。领主们在法兰克尼亚的霍恩洛厄高原经营领地，海因里希和戈特弗里德·冯·霍恩洛厄出任条顿骑士团大团长。

1230年家族分为霍恩洛厄与布劳内克两支，后者于1390年绝嗣。1450年皇帝腓特烈三世将克拉夫特五世兄弟升为帝国伯爵；1551年起，诺因施泰因和瓦尔登堡两支成为主干，前者改宗路德宗，后者保持天主教。

瓦尔登堡支于1744年、诺因施泰因—厄林根支于1764年取得诸侯头衔。1806年莱茵邦联将霍恩洛厄领地并入巴伐利亚和符腾堡，家族保留产业，多个支系延续下来。

en:
The Hohenstaufen, also called the Staufer, were a Swabian noble family named after their castle on Staufen hill. Frederick I, son of Frederick of Büren, was enfeoffed with the Duchy of Swabia by Emperor Henry IV in 1079 and married the emperor's daughter Agnes. In 1138 Conrad III became the first Hohenstaufen king of the Romans.

Frederick I Barbarossa, crowned emperor in 1155, brought the Empire to its greatest medieval extent and died on crusade in 1190. His son Henry VI, emperor from 1191, inherited Sicily through his wife Constance in 1194. Frederick II, crowned in 1220, ruled mainly from Sicily in a long struggle with the papacy.

After Frederick II died in 1250 the house collapsed: Manfred fell at Benevento in 1266 to Charles of Anjou, and Conradin was beheaded at Naples after Tagliacozzo in 1268, ending the direct line. The last captive, Manfred's son Henry, died at Castel dell'Ovo in 1318; by 1337 the dynasty was extinct, though many later ruling houses descended from it through female lines.
zh:
霍恩施陶芬家族又称施陶芬家族，是施瓦本的贵族世家，得名于施陶芬山上的家族城堡。比伦的腓特烈之子腓特烈一世于1079年被皇帝亨利四世封为施瓦本公爵，并娶其女阿格尼丝为妻。1138年，康拉德三世成为家族第一位罗马人的国王。

“红胡子”腓特烈一世1155年加冕为帝，使神圣罗马帝国的疆域在中世纪达到极盛，1190年死于十字军途中。其子亨利六世1191年称帝，1194年凭借妻子科斯坦察继承西西里王国。腓特烈二世1220年加冕，长期在西西里执政，与教宗争斗多年。

他1250年死后家族迅速败落：曼弗雷迪1266年在贝内文托被安茹的查理击杀，年轻的康拉丁1268年在塔利亚科佐之战后被斩首于那不勒斯，直系就此断绝。最后的男嗣、曼弗雷迪之子恩里科1318年囚死于蛋堡，到1337年王朝已不复存在，但许多后世统治家族通过女系承袭其血统。

en:
The Hohenzollern of the Swabian line were Swabian counts named for their castle of Zollern. Their first documented ancestor, Burkhard I, was killed in a feud in 1061; his likely grandson Frederick I appears early in the twelfth century as a powerful Swabian count.

When the lands were divided at the end of that century, the younger line took the Burgraviate of Nuremberg and grew into the Franconian branch, while the elder kept Zollern as the Catholic Swabian branch. A son of Frederick I secured the County of Hohenberg, which the family held until 1486. In 1337 the Swabian branch still ruled its small county from the Zollern hills; Frederick IX, who died in 1379, was the first to call himself Count of Hohenzollern.

Repeated partitions narrowed the line's means, and in 1576 its lands split into Hohenzollern-Hechingen, Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen and a Haigerloch line. The counts were raised to princely rank in 1623, and Haigerloch was absorbed by Sigmaringen in 1767.
zh:
霍亨索伦家族的施瓦本支系是施瓦本的伯爵世家，得名于索伦城堡。家族第一位有确切记载的先祖布克哈德于1061年在一场仇杀中丧命，他可能的孙子腓特烈一世在12世纪初已是有权势的施瓦本伯爵。

12世纪末分家时，幼支取得纽伦堡城堡伯爵领地，发展为法兰克尼亚支系；长支保有索伦，成为始终信奉天主教的施瓦本支系。腓特烈一世的一个儿子取得霍恩贝格伯国，该领地一直保留到1486年。1337年，该支仍在索伦山区统治着小小的伯国，1379年去世的腓特烈九世是第一个自称霍亨索伦伯爵的人。

一再分家使支系国力日衰，1576年领地分为霍亨索伦-黑兴根、霍亨索伦-锡格马林根和海格洛赫三支；1623年家族由伯爵晋升为帝国诸侯，海格洛赫则于1767年并入锡格马林根。

en:
The Franconian Hohenzollern descend from a younger son of the Swabian counts of Zollern who acquired the Burgraviate of Nuremberg around 1192 by marriage; the branch's effective founder was Conrad I, born in 1186. After Nuremberg won independence in 1219, the burgraves built on their castle lands, adding Ansbach in 1331 and Kulmbach in 1340; in 1398 their Franconian territory split into Ansbach and Kulmbach. In 1337 the branch still held the Nuremberg burgraviate, a rising imperial comital house.

In 1411 Burgrave Frederick VI became governor of Brandenburg; at Constance in 1415 King Sigismund enfeoffed him as Elector and Margrave Frederick I, and in 1417 he bought the margraviate outright, his line selling the Nuremberg rights to the city ten years later.

The family turned Protestant in the sixteenth century, and in 1525 Albert of the Ansbach line, last Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights, secularized its state as the Duchy of Prussia. Brandenburg and Prussia joined in personal union in 1618 and became the Kingdom of Prussia in 1701.
zh:
霍亨索伦的法兰克尼亚支系出自施瓦本索伦伯爵家族的幼支，1192年前后通过联姻取得纽伦堡城堡伯爵领地，实际始祖是生于1186年的康拉德一世。纽伦堡城1219年赢得独立后，城堡伯爵以城堡领地为根基，1331年取得安斯巴赫，1340年取得库尔姆巴赫，1398年领地分为安斯巴赫与库尔姆巴赫两支。1337年，该支仍领有纽伦堡城堡伯爵领地，是帝国蒸蒸日上的伯爵家族。

1411年，城堡伯爵腓特烈六世受命治理勃兰登堡；1415年国王西吉斯蒙德在康斯坦茨会议上封他为选帝侯兼藩侯（称腓特烈一世），他1417年彻底买下这片藩侯领地，十年后该支把在纽伦堡的权利卖给这座帝国城市。

家族16世纪改宗新教；1525年，安斯巴赫支系的阿尔布雷希特以条顿骑士团末代大团长身份将骑士团国家世俗化，建立普鲁士公国。两地1618年结成共主邦联，1701年成为普鲁士王国。

en:
The counts of Hohnstein, often spelled Honstein, were a noble house of the southern Harz, first documented in 1154 as the lords of Ilfeld. Their county grew around Hohnstein Castle above Neustadt.

The house split into three lines from 1315: the Sondershausen line died out in 1356 and passed to Schwarzburg, while the remaining branches divided in 1373 into Kelbra-Heringen and Lohra-Klettenberg. The flail war of 1412 wrecked part of their domain and forced sales to Stolberg.

The Lohra-Klettenberg line issued a mining charter at Sankt Andreasberg in 1521. The ruling house became extinct in 1593; after rival claims and long suits, the Peace of Westphalia in 1648 gave the former lands to the Elector of Brandenburg as part of the secularised bishopric of Halberstadt.
zh:
霍恩施泰因伯爵家族当时常拼作Honstein，是哈茨山南麓的贵族世家，1154年首次见于文献，时为伊尔费尔德领主。伯国围绕诺伊施塔特上方的霍恩施泰因城堡发展起来。

家族自1315年起分裂为三支：松德斯豪森支于1356年绝嗣，领地由施瓦茨堡继承；其余两支于1373年分为凯尔布拉-黑林根支和洛拉-克莱滕贝格支。1412年的链枷战争摧毁部分领地，家族被迫向施托尔贝格出售土地。

洛拉-克莱滕贝格支于1521年在圣安德烈亚斯贝格颁布矿业特许状。1593年当权支系绝嗣；长期诉讼后，1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》将原领地作为还俗的哈尔伯施塔特主教区的一部分划归勃兰登堡选帝侯。

en:
The Honma took their name from Honma in Echi village, Aiko district of Sagami, and traced descent to the Ebina line of Musashi's Yokoyama party. In the early Kamakura period Honma no Yoshihisa crossed to Sado as shugodai, made Sawada Castle his seat, and his descendants ruled the island from the thirteenth century, splitting into the Sawada, Kawarada and Hamochi houses.

In 1509 the Honma sheltered the Echigo shugodai Nagao Tamekage and the shugo Uesugi Sadazane after their defeat by Uesugi Akisada. In 1510 the Hamochi and Sawada landed at Teradomari and killed Akisada at Nagamorihara, earning estates in Echigo.

The Kawarada and Hamochi fought as the Sawada declined; their quarrel settled for a time under Uesugi Kenshin and revived after his death in 1578. In 1589 his heir Uesugi Kagekatsu invaded Sado with Toyotomi Hideyoshi's leave and overthrew the clan; some Honma who sided with the Uesugi followed them to Echigo, Aizu and Yonezawa.
zh:
本间氏的苗字来源于相模国爱甲郡依知乡的本间，谱系上出自武藏横山党的海老名氏流。镰仓初期，本间能久作为守护代渡海进入佐渡，以杂太城为本据，其子孙从13世纪起统治佐渡，分出杂太、河原田、羽茂等家。

1509年，越后守护代长尾为景被上杉显定击败，本间氏收留了为景和守护上杉定实。1510年，羽茂、杂太两家从寺泊登陆，在长森原之战中迫使显定败死，获封越后领地。此后河原田家和羽茂家纷争不断，杂太家则逐渐没落。

上杉谦信时代两家争斗一度平息，1578年谦信死后再度激化。1589年，得到丰臣秀吉许可的继承人上杉景胜攻入佐渡，本间氏灭亡；其中投靠上杉方的一支随上杉家迁往越后、会津和米泽。

en: The Honnavara rulers were the local lords of the trading port of Honnavar on the Kanara coast, where the traveller Ibn Battuta met its Muslim sultan Jamaluddin in 1342. The port later passed to the Saluva kings of nearby Gerusoppa and then to the Portuguese, who built a fortress there in the sixteenth century.
zh: 霍纳沃尔家族是卡纳拉海岸贸易港口霍纳瓦尔的地方统治者，1342年旅行家伊本·白图泰在此见到其穆斯林苏丹贾马鲁丁。该港后来归入邻近盖鲁索佩的萨卢瓦诸王，继而落入葡萄牙人之手，后者于16世纪在此修建了要塞。

en:
The lords of Horne took their name from the village of Horn in Limburg. An Engelbert of Horne appears in twelfth-century charters and is regarded as the family's ancestor; kinship with the counts of Loon is suspected but unproven.

William I married the heiress of Altena in 1230, and the family built up lordships across the Meuse. Around 1300 Gerard I held Horne and Altena; his son William IV added Gaasbeek by marriage. Horn castle was the family seat.

In 1450 Emperor Frederick III raised Horn to an imperial county, but the senior line died out in 1540 and the title passed by adoption to the Montmorency family. Philip of Montmorency, count of Horn, was beheaded at Brussels with Lamoral of Egmond in 1568, and the county was handed to the bishop of Liège. A younger line, the princes of Hornes in the Spanish Netherlands, survived until 1826.
zh:
霍恩领主家族得名于林堡的霍恩村。12世纪的契约中出现一位霍恩的恩格尔贝特，被视为家族始祖；后人推测他们与洛恩伯爵有亲缘，但没有证实。

威廉一世于1230年娶阿尔特纳女继承人，家族在默兹河两岸积累起领地。约1300年格拉拉尔一世领有霍恩、阿尔特纳等地，其子威廉四世又凭婚姻获得哈斯贝克；霍恩城堡是家族本据。

1450年，皇帝腓特烈三世将霍恩升格为帝国伯国，但长支在1540年绝嗣，爵位经收养转入蒙莫朗西家族。1568年霍恩伯爵菲利普·德·蒙莫朗西在布鲁塞尔与拉莫拉尔·范·埃格蒙特一同被斩首，伯国被交给列日主教。家族幼支、西属尼德兰的霍恩亲王一支延续到1826年。

en:
The Hosokawa are a samurai clan of Seiwa Genji stock, an Ashikaga branch named for Ashikaga Yoshisue's estate in Mikawa Province. They backed Ashikaga Takauji in the early fourteenth-century wars and became one of the three Muromachi kanrei houses. Yoriyuki held the kanrei post from the 1360s, while kinsmen took constableships in Awa, Tosa and elsewhere.

In 1467 Kanrei Hosokawa Katsumoto's feud with his father-in-law Yamana Sozen over the shogunal succession ignited the Onin War, opening the Sengoku age. His son Masamoto for a time held the capital; his assassination in 1507 split the clan, and the main line was driven from Kyoto when Nobunaga seized the city.

A junior branch under Hosokawa Fujitaka and his son Tadaoki served Nobunaga, Hideyoshi and Ieyasu, and after siding with Ieyasu at Sekigahara in 1600 was enfeoffed at Kumamoto with 540,000 koku. The Kumamoto lords ranked among the wealthiest Edo daimyo: the third lord Tadatoshi employed the swordsman Miyamoto Musashi, and Lord Shigekata's reforms and 1755 domain school restored the finances.
zh:
细川氏是清和源氏足利氏的支流，因始祖足利义季在三河国的领地而取姓。14世纪初的战乱中，细川氏追随足利尊氏，室町幕府时成为三管领家之一。赖之于14世纪60年代出任管领，一族还出任阿波、土佐等国守护。

1467年，管领细川胜元与岳父山名宗全因将军继承问题对立，引爆应仁之乱，战国时代由此开端。胜元之子政元一度独揽京都大权，却在1507年遇刺，细川家随之分裂，宗家在织田信长入京时被逐出京都。

细川藤孝、忠兴父子为首的旁支转而侍奉信长、秀吉与家康；1600年关原之战中站在家康一方，战后受封熊本藩五十四万石。熊本藩主跻身江户最富有的大名之列：三代藩主忠利聘用剑豪宫本武藏，重贤的改革与1755年创设的藩校则扭转了藩财颓势。

en: The Hot, also written Hoth, are a Baloch tribe descending from Hoth Khan, one of the four sons of Jalal Khan, who led the Baloch migration from Persia into Makran and founded the first Baloch confederacy in the twelfth century. The game presents the tribe's chiefs as the ruling house of Kharan in the Makran interior.
zh: 霍特（又译霍斯）是俾路支部落，始祖为贾拉尔·汗之子霍特·汗；贾拉尔·汗于12世纪率领诸部从波斯迁入莫克兰，建立第一个俾路支联盟，四个儿子分衍出几大部落。游戏将该部首领处理为莫克兰内陆哈兰的统治家族。

en:
The Hojo were the de facto rulers of Japan from 1203 to 1333 as hereditary regents, or shikken, of the Kamakura shogunate. Said to descend from a Taira branch in Izu, the family rose through Tokimasa, whose daughter Masako married Minamoto no Yoritomo; after Yoritomo's death he became regent to child shoguns, leaving shogun and court as figureheads.

The second regent Yoshitoki crushed Emperor Go-Toba's Jokyu War rising in 1221; Yasutoki created a council of state in 1225 and issued the first samurai code, the Goseibai Shikimoku, in 1232. The regency weathered the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281, broken by kamikaze typhoons, but the unrewarded defense costs alienated its vassals.

Go-Daigo's revolts of 1324 and 1331 opened its collapse: in 1333 Ashikaga Takauji defected and Nitta Yoshisada stormed Kamakura, where some 870 Hojo under the last regent Takatoki killed themselves at Tosho-ji. His son Tokiyuki briefly retook Kamakura in the 1335 Nakasendai rising and served the Southern Court until beheaded in 1353; the Later Hojo of Odawara were unrelated.
zh:
北条氏在1203年至1333年间以镰仓幕府世袭执权身份实际统治日本。该族据称出自定居伊豆的一支平氏，靠时政崛起：他的女儿政子嫁给源赖朝，赖朝死后他成为幼龄将军的执权，将军与京都朝廷沦为傀儡。

第二代执权义时在1221年承久之乱中击败后鸟羽上皇的倒幕军队；泰时1225年设立评定众，1232年颁布第一部武家法典《御成败式目》。执权政治扛住1274年和1281年两次蒙古来袭，台风被视为“神风”而令舰队覆灭，但无功可赏的防务开销加深了御家人的离心。

后醍醐天皇1324年和1331年的倒幕行动开启政权崩溃：1333年足利尊氏倒戈，新田义贞攻陷镰仓，末代执权高时为首的约870名北条族人在东胜寺集体自尽。其子时行在1335年中先代之乱中一度夺回镰仓，后归顺南朝，1353年被斩；小田原后北条氏则与之并无血缘。

en:
The counts of Hoya were a north German comital family seated at Hoya on the middle Weser. The first documented count, Henry, appeared in 1202 as a vassal of Archbishop Hartwig II of Bremen; his descendants bought up the rival Hodenberg family's Weser estates until 1313. The acquisition of Nienburg in 1215 opened a long quarrel with the bishops of Minden.

In 1345 the brothers Gerhard III and John II divided the county between Hoya and Nienburg lines. The elder line died out in 1497 and the lands were reunited under Count Jobst I at Nienburg.

The Welf dukes of Brunswick-Lüneburg occupied the county in 1512, forcing the counts to accept them as liege lords. When Count Otto VIII died without sons in 1582, Hoya was partitioned among the Calenberg and Lüneburg lines of Brunswick-Lüneburg and Hesse-Kassel.
zh:
霍亚伯爵家族是北德意志的伯爵世家，驻于威悉河中游的霍亚镇。第一位见于记载的伯爵亨利在1202年是不来梅大主教哈特维希二世的封臣，其后人逐步买下敌对的霍登贝格家族在威悉河畔的地产，直到1313年；1215年取得尼恩堡引发了与明登主教的长期冲突。

1345年，格哈德三世与约翰二世兄弟分家，形成霍亚与尼恩堡两支。霍亚长支于1497年绝嗣，领地在尼恩堡的约布斯特一世治下重新统一。

韦尔夫家族的不伦瑞克—吕讷堡公爵于1512年占领伯国，迫使霍亚伯爵承认其为宗主。1582年伯爵奥托八世无子而终，霍亚被不伦瑞克—吕讷堡的卡伦贝格支、吕讷堡支以及黑森—卡塞尔瓜分。

en:
The Hoysalas rose as hill chiefs in the Malnad hills of Karnataka, serving the Western Chalukyas as feudatories around the year 1000. Their name comes from the Kannada legend of Sala, who struck down a tiger to save his Jain guru, the cry hoy sala giving the dynasty its name and the fight its royal emblem.

Vishnuvardhana, reigning from about 1108 to 1152, broke Chalukya tutelage and defeated the Cholas at Talakad in 1116, taking the title Conqueror of Talakad and making Belur and then Dvarasamudra his capital.

Malik Kafur sacked Dvarasamudra in 1311 and Muhammad bin Tughluq's armies sacked it again in 1327. Veera Ballala III fought on from Tiruvannamalai until killed at Madurai in 1343; his lands passed to Harihara I and the Vijayanagara Empire. The Hoysalas left star-shaped soapstone temples at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura.
zh:
曷萨拉人起家于卡纳塔克马尔纳德山区，约1000年前后是西遮娄其封臣。族名来自卡纳达传说：萨拉为救耆那教上师搏杀猛虎，呼喊的“霍伊·萨拉”成为族名，人虎相搏成为王室纹章。

毗湿奴伐弹那约1108—1152年在位，摆脱遮娄其，于1116年在塔莱卡德击败朱罗人，获称“塔莱卡德征服者”，先后以贝卢尔和德瓦拉萨穆德拉为都。

马利克·卡富尔1311年洗劫德瓦拉萨穆德拉，穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克的军队1327年再度破城。维拉·巴拉拉三世据蒂鲁万纳马莱作战，于1343年在马杜赖战死；领地归诃里诃罗一世，融入毗奢耶那伽罗帝国。曷萨拉留下贝卢尔、赫莱比杜和索门纳特普尔的星形滑石神庙。

en:
The Hsenwi dynasty was the saopha ruling house of Hsenwi, called Theinni by the Burmese and Mubang in Chinese records, the largest of the Shan states west of the Salween. Tai Yai chronicles derive the line from two brothers, Khun Lung and Khun Lai, who are said to have come down from heaven in the sixth century and been hailed as kings at Hsenwi; the predecessor polity of Sivirattha was traditionally founded before 650.

Hsenwi entered Chinese records under the Yuan as the Mubang military district and under the Ming as a native pacification office, while its saophas balanced tributary ties between Ava and the Chinese frontier.

In the early seventeenth century the Toungoo kings of Burma absorbed Hsenwi. During the Sino-Burmese war of 1765-1769 the Qing general Ming Rui seized Hsenwi in 1767 and made it his supply base before marching on Ava.
zh:
兴威王朝是兴威的诏法世家；兴威缅语称兴尼，中国史籍作木邦，是萨尔温江以西最大的掸族政权。掸族纪年把王室世系追溯到6世纪从天而降的两兄弟坤龙和坤莱，传说他们在兴威被当地人拥为王；其前身西维拉塔相传在650年以前已经立国。

元代设木邦路军民总管府，明代改置木邦宣慰司，而历代诏法在阿瓦与中国边境之间权衡称臣。

17世纪初，缅甸东吁王朝吞并木邦。1765—1769年清缅战争期间，清将明瑞于1767年攻占兴威，以此为粮草基地，再向阿瓦进军。

en:
The Hso ruled Möng Mao, a great Tai Shan state in the Ruili river valley on the Yunnan-Myanmar frontier. Their Shan prefix Hso was written by the Chinese as the surname Si. Hso Hkan Hpa, called Si Kefa (1294-1369), seized power about 1335 and united neighbouring Tai states.

Four Yuan expeditions against him between 1342 and 1348 failed; in 1355 he accepted the Yuan title of Pingmian Pacification Commissioner. His armies extracted tribute from Assam and in 1364 sacked Sagaing and Pinya, clearing the way for Ava.

Si Lunfa was invested by the Ming after 1382 but repeatedly fought them; after his death they partitioned the kingdom into five tusi. A later ruler, Si Renfa, tried to rebuild the old domains from 1413, provoking the Luchuan-Pingmian campaigns of 1436 to 1449, in which the house was defeated and driven back to Möng Yang.
zh:
思氏是滇缅边境瑞丽江河谷的傣族掸人国家勐卯的统治家族。其掸语冠称在汉文里记作姓思。思翰法（汉名思可法，1294—1369）约于1335年夺权，征服邻近傣邦。

元朝在1342—1348年间四次征讨均告失败，他于1355年接受元朝平缅宣慰使的头衔。其军队向西迫使阿洪姆称臣纳贡，又于1364年攻灭实皆与彬牙两国，为阿瓦王国的兴起腾出了空间。

思伦发于1382年后受明朝册封，却屡与明朝交战，死后明朝将勐卯拆分为五个土司。后继的思任发自1413年起试图恢复旧疆，引发1436—1449年的麓川之役，思氏最终战败，退往孟养。

en:
The Hurin Qusqu, or Lower Cusco, was the first royal dynasty of the Kingdom of Cusco and the senior half of the Inca diarchy. From Inticancha it ruled the city-state in the Cusco valley.

Its legendary founder Manco Capac led ten ayllus into the valley around the start of the thirteenth century. His successors subdued or expelled neighbouring peoples, terraced the valley and fought the Ayarmaca confederacy.

After the ruler Capac Yupanqui died around 1350, allegedly poisoned by his Ayarmaca wife, the rival Hanan Qusqu branch seized power under Inca Roca and killed the Hurin heir Quispe Yupanqui. The two halves then came to terms: the Hanan held secular and military rule as Sapa Inca, while the Hurin kept Inticancha, the royal treasures and the chief religious offices, including perhaps that of Willaq Umu.
zh:
乌林·库斯科意为下库斯科，是库斯科王国的第一个王族，也是印卡双头体制中的长支，以恩蒂坎查为中心统治库斯科河谷的城邦。

传奇始祖曼科·卡帕克在13世纪初率十氏族入据河谷。其继承者征服或驱逐邻族，修筑梯田，并与阿亚尔马卡联盟交战。

约1350年统治者卡帕克·尤潘基去世，据说他被出身阿亚尔马卡的妻子毒杀，敌对的哈南·库斯科一支随即在印卡·罗卡率领下夺权，处死乌林支的继承人基斯佩·尤潘基。两支后来达成妥协：哈南支以萨帕·印卡之尊执掌世俗与军政，乌林支则保留恩蒂坎查、王室财宝以及主要宗教职位，可能包括维利亚克·乌穆。

en:
The House of Ibelin was a noble family of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem, named after Ibelin castle, built by King Fulk in 1141 and entrusted to founder Barisan. Barisan, constable of Jaffa and husband of the heiress of Ramla, earned the castle by his loyalty in Hugh of Jaffa's revolt of 1134.

His youngest son Balian married the dowager queen Maria Comnena and held Nablus, but the family's mainland lordships, including Ibelin itself, fell to Saladin in 1187. Balian's descendants rose to the front rank: John, the Old Lord of Beirut, opposed Emperor Frederick II, and another John, count of Jaffa and Ascalon, was regent of Jerusalem and compiled the Assizes of the High Court.

As the mainland kingdom crumbled, the Ibelins settled in Cyprus, where for two centuries they married into the ruling Lusignan dynasty and filled the highest offices. When Lusignan Cyprus fell in the late fifteenth century, the family lost its lands and its male line ended.
zh:
德·伊贝林家族是十字军耶路撒冷王国的贵族世家，得名于伊贝林城堡。该堡1141年由国王富尔克修建，托付给家族始祖巴里森。巴里森本是骑士，曾任雅法统帅，又娶拉姆拉女继承人，1134年雅法的于格叛乱时他效忠国王，因而受封这座城堡。

他的幼子贝里昂娶太后玛利亚·科穆宁娜为妻，领有纳布卢斯，但包括伊贝林在内的大陆领地在1187年落入萨拉丁之手。贝里昂的后裔跻身十字军贵族最高层：贝鲁特老领主约翰带头抵制皇帝腓特烈二世，另一位雅法和阿斯卡隆伯爵约翰曾任耶路撒冷摄政，并编纂《耶路撒冷法令》。

随着大陆王国节节失守，伊贝林家族迁居塞浦路斯，两百多年间与吕西尼昂王朝联姻、出任要职。15世纪末吕西尼昂的塞浦路斯王国灭亡后，家族失去土地，男系断绝。

en:
The Ii were a Tōtōmi warrior house who claimed Fujiwara Hokke descent and held the Iinoya manor for some five centuries. Ii Hachirō appears in the Hōgen War narrative following Minamoto no Yoshitomo, and the Azuma Kagami lists it among Kamakura gokenin.

In the Nanboku-chō wars the head Ii Yukinao joined the Southern Court, welcomed Prince Muneyoshi to Iinoya Castle, and fought Northern generals until Mitsutake fell in 1340; the house then submitted to the Imagawa of Suruga.

Imagawa service ended bloodily: Naomori fell at Okehazama in 1560, his heir Naochika was murdered by Imagawa Ujizane, and Naomori's daughter Naotora held the chieftaincy through the collapse. Her adopted heir Naomasa fled to Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1575, became one of his Four Heavenly Kings, and received Minowa in 1590 and Sawayama, a hundred and eighty thousand koku, after Sekigahara. His son built Hikone Castle in 1604; the Ii rose to three hundred thousand koku as the premier fudai house and served repeatedly as tairō.
zh:
井伊氏是远江国的武家，自称藤原北家后裔，在井伊谷庄园统治约五百年。《保元物语》中已有追随源义朝的井八郎登场，《吾妻镜》也把井伊氏列为镰仓幕府的有力御家人。

南北朝动乱时，当主井伊行直投身南朝，把宗良亲王迎入井伊谷城，与北朝将领连年交战，直到1340年三岳城陷落，才归降骏河守护今川氏。

侍奉今川氏的结局惨烈：井伊直盛1560年战死于桶狭间，继嗣直亲被今川氏真诛杀，直盛之女直虎在一族凋零中接掌家督。养子井伊直政1575年投奔德川家康，后为德川四天王之一，1590年受封箕轮，关原后又得佐和山十八万石。直政之子1604年修筑彦根城，井伊家最终升至三十万石，位居谱代大名之首，并多次出任大老。

en:
The Ijuin of Satsuma were a Shimazu branch, claiming Ki descent but founded when Toshitada of the Shimazu received the stewardship of Ijuin in Hioki district; his son Hisakane first used the Ijuin name. In the Nanboku-cho wars the fifth head Tadakuni left the Northern Court for the Southern Court and gathered the Shibuya and Hishikari to fight the Shimazu main house.

The sixth head Hisauji helped defeat the Kyushu deputy Imagawa Ryoshun. Later, Hirohisa killed Machida Takahisa at Ichiuji castle, bringing a Shimazu siege and exile to Higo. The junior line's Tadamune became chief councillor of Shimazu Yoshihisa.

After the Shimazu submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, Tadamune won an eighty-thousand-koku fief at Miyakonojo but was killed by Shimazu Tadatsune. His son Tadazane rose in 1599 in the Sho-nai revolt and was destroyed with his family; other Ijuin lines continued as Satsuma samurai.
zh:
萨摩伊集院氏是岛津氏的支流，系图自称纪姓，实际始于岛津一族的俊忠获得日置郡伊集院地头职，其子久兼最早以伊集院为苗字。南北朝时期，第五代忠国由北朝倒向南朝，纠合涩谷一族及菱刈氏与岛津宗家交战。

第六代久氏协助宗家击破九州探题今川了俊。此后熙久在一宇治城杀害町田高久，招致宗家围攻，亡命肥后。庶流则以世袭家臣身份崛起，忠栋成为岛津义久的笔头家老。

岛津降伏丰臣秀吉后，忠栋受封都之城八万石，却被岛津忠恒诛杀。其子忠真在1599年的庄内之乱中起兵，最终与家人一同被灭；其余伊集院支流继续以萨摩藩士身份存续。

en:
The Ikeda were a warrior clan of Kawabe in Settsu, whose ancestors stewarded the Ikeda estates in Settsu and Mino. Around the Genpei War Minamoto no Yasumasa married into the family, which thereafter claimed descent from Minamoto no Yorimitsu.

The Settsu line held Ikeda Castle until Ikeda Tomomasa lost power to Araki Murashige in the 1570s; his line continued as Tokugawa hatamoto. The Mino branch rose under Ikeda Tsuneoki, Oda Nobunaga's milk brother, who held 130,000 koku at Ōgaki in 1583 but fell with his eldest son at Nagakute in 1584.

His second son Terumasa married Tokugawa Ieyasu's daughter and fought on the Tokugawa side at Sekigahara in 1600. He received Himeji with 520,000 koku and built Himeji Castle; his heirs became lords of Okayama, while a junior branch ruled Tottori, both lasting as daimyō into the nineteenth century.
zh:
池田氏是以摄津国川边一带为根基的武家，其先祖在摄津和美浓担任池田庄的庄官。源平合战前后，源泰政入赘池田家，此后一族自称源赖光后裔。

摄津池田氏以池田城为居城，直到16世纪70年代当主池田知正被荒木村重夺去势力，此后以德川旗本存续。美浓一脉则在织田信长的乳兄弟池田恒兴手中崛起，他在1583年领有大垣13万石，却在1584年长久手之战中与长子一同战死。

其次子辉政迎娶德川家康之女，1600年在关原之战中从属德川方。他受封姬路52万石并修筑姬路城；子孙后来领有冈山，分家领有鸟取，两家皆作为大名延续至19世纪。

en:
The Ilyas Shahi were the first independent Sunni Muslim dynasty of the Bengal Sultanate, founded by Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah. He began as an officer under Izz al-Din Yahya, governor of Satgaon; when Yahya died in 1338 he seized Satgaon and declared himself independent of Delhi, and by 1342 he had conquered Lakhnauti and Sonargaon, uniting Bengal into a single sultanate.

His son Sikandar Shah raised the Adina Masjid at Pandua in 1368. The first line ended in 1414 when the Hindu landowner Raja Ganesha seized power, but in 1436 Nasiruddin Mahmud Shah, a descendant of Ilyas Shah, restored the dynasty.

It ruled from Gaur until 1487, when Sultan Jalaluddin Fatih Shah was murdered by his Habshi guard commander and the house gave way to Abyssinian rulers.
zh:
伊利亚斯·沙希王朝是孟加拉苏丹国第一个独立的逊尼派穆斯林王朝，创立者为沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯·沙阿。他早年在萨特冈总督伊兹丁·叶海亚麾下效力；1338年叶海亚去世后，他夺取萨特冈并宣布脱离德里独立，到1342年又征服拉克瑙提和索纳尔冈，把孟加拉统一为一个苏丹国。

其子锡坎达尔·沙阿于1368年在潘杜阿修建阿迪纳清真寺。第一王世系于1414年被印度教徒地主罗阇·伽内什夺权而中断，1436年伊利亚斯·沙阿的后裔纳西尔丁·马哈茂德·沙阿复辟。

王朝以高尔为都延续到1487年，苏丹贾拉鲁丁·法提赫·沙阿被哈比什卫队指挥官杀害，家族随后让位于阿比西尼亚统治者。

en:
The Imagawa were a branch of the Ashikaga, of Seiwa Genji stock. In the thirteenth century Kuniuji, son of Kira Nagauji, received the Imagawa manor in Mikawa and took its name; a saying placed them after the Kira in succession to the shogunal line.

Norikuni fought for Ashikaga Takauji in the Nanboku-chō wars and became Constable of Suruga and Totomi; his descendants kept Suruga. His son Sadayo, known as Ryoshun, became Kyushu Deputy and a linked-verse poet, but lost office under Yoshimitsu.

Ujichika conquered Totomi and issued the Imagawa Kana Mokuroku, an early house law. His son Yoshimoto won the 1536 Hanakura feud and ruled Suruga, Totomi and Mikawa, until Oda Nobunaga defeated and killed him at Okehazama in 1560. Under Ujizane the domain was partitioned by the Takeda and Tokugawa; later Imagawa served the Tokugawa shoguns as ceremonial masters.
zh:
今川氏是清和源氏足利一门的支流。13世纪，吉良长氏之子国氏受封三河国今川庄，以今川为姓；当时有将军家绝嗣则由吉良、今川依次继承的说法。

南北朝战乱中，范国追随足利尊氏，被任命为骏河、远江守护，其后裔世袭骏河。范国之子贞世（法号了俊）出任九州探题，也是一名连歌师，后来在足利义满治下被罢免。

氏亲攻占远江，颁布早期分国法《今川假名目录》。其子义元于1536年花仓之乱后继位，领有骏河、远江、三河，却在1560年桶狭间之战中遭织田信长击败身亡。氏真治下领国被武田与德川瓜分；今川一族后来侍奉德川幕府，担任礼仪官。

en:
The İnanç family, also known as the Beylik of Lâdik after Laodicea on the Lycus, ruled a small Turkmen principality around Denizli in south-western Anatolia from 1261 to 1368. Its founder Mehmed Bey, a frontier chief of Turkmen clans fleeing the Mongol advance, rebelled against the Seljuk sultan of Rûm in 1261 and placed himself under the Ilkhan Hulagu, only to be captured and killed the following year.

His son-in-law Ali Bey attached the beylik to the Seljuks, but was imprisoned after backing the failed Cimri revolt of 1277, whereupon Lâdik fell under the Sahib Ata family.

Around 1310 the Germiyanid ruler Yakup I seized Lâdik and restored Ali's son İnanç Bey, from whom the dynasty takes its name. His successors kept up a much-reduced principality until the Germiyanids annexed it in 1368.
zh:
亦难赤家族又称拉迪克贝伊国，名字源自吕卡努斯河畔的老底嘉，1261年至1368年间在安纳托利亚西南部的代尼兹利一带统治一个小型土库曼公国。开国者穆罕默德贝伊是躲避蒙古兵锋西迁的土库曼部落边疆首领，1261年起兵反抗鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹，转而依附伊儿汗旭烈兀，次年即被擒杀。

其女婿阿里贝伊重新归附塞尔柱人，却因支持1277年失败的吉姆里事变而下狱，拉迪克落入沙希布·阿塔家族之手。

约1310年，格尔米扬君主雅各布一世夺取拉迪克，扶立阿里之子亦难赤贝伊复位，家族也由他得名。后继者勉强维持着版图大缩的公国，最终于1368年被格尔米扬吞并。

en:
The Inawashiro were a warrior house of the Aizu basin in Mutsu province, seated at Inawashiro on the lake of the same name. They sprang from the Sawara branch of the Miura clan: around the mid-thirteenth century Sawara Tsunetsura, elder brother of the Ashina founder Mitsumori, settled at Inawashiro and took its name.

Through the Muromachi and Sengoku ages the house repeatedly warred with its Ashina overlords. When the lord Tsunemoto died without an heir the family adopted Morikiyo from the Ashina house.

His son Morikuni opened secret talks with Date Masamune and defected to him as the Ashina crumbled, fighting at the Battle of Suriagehara in 1589, while his disinherited son Moritane stayed loyal to the Ashina. After Masamune's reshuffle of fiefs following the Odawara campaign, the Inawashiro entered Date service and remained Sendai retainers under the Tokugawa.
zh:
猪苗代氏是以陆奥国会津盆地的猪苗代为本贯的武家，居于同名湖畔，出自三浦氏的佐原分流。13世纪中叶，芦名氏之祖光盛的兄长佐原经连定居猪苗代并以地名为苗字。

从室町到战国，猪苗代氏屡次与宗主芦名氏交战。当主经元无嗣，便从芦名氏迎立盛清为养子。

盛清之子盛国暗中联络伊达政宗，眼见芦名氏衰落便倒向政宗，在1589年摺上原之战中效力；而被废嫡的儿子盛胤仍站在芦名一方。小田原征伐后政宗调整封地，猪苗代氏出仕伊达氏，在江户时代作为仙台藩士存续。

en:
The Indravarman line gathers the last Varman kings of Angkor, the final Khmer rulers named in the temple inscriptions. Indravarman II, the Buddhist son of Jayavarman VII, ruled until 1243 and saw Champa break away while Sukhothai seized western provinces.

Jayavarman VIII, who reigned from 1243 to 1295, turned back to Shaivism, defaced Buddhist images and converted the Bayon into a temple of Shiva; in 1283 he bought peace from a Mongol invasion by paying tribute. His son-in-law Indravarman III seized the throne in 1295, made Theravada Buddhism the state religion, and received the Chinese envoy Zhou Daguan at Angkor between 1296 and 1297.

Indrajayavarman ruled from 1308 to 1327, and Jayavarman IX from 1327 to 1336. Jayavarman IX is the last Angkor king documented on the monuments; later chronicles take up the story with a new, legendary line.
zh:
因陀罗跋摩一系汇集了吴哥最后的几位跋摩王，也就是寺庙碑铭中能见到的末代高棉王统。阇耶跋摩七世的佛教徒儿子因陀罗跋摩二世在位至1243年，任内占婆脱离，素可泰夺取了西部省份。

1243—1295年，阇耶跋摩八世改宗湿婆派，毁坏佛像，把巴戎寺改为湿婆神庙；1283年他向蒙古纳贡求和。1295年，其女婿因陀罗跋摩三世夺位，立上座部佛教为国教；1296—1297年，他在吴哥接见中国使臣周达观。

此后因陀罗阇耶跋摩于1308—1327年在位，阇耶跋摩九世于1327—1336年在位。他是碑铭所载的最后一位吴哥国王，后来的编年史由新的传说王统接续。

en:
The Injuids were an Iranian dynasty that ruled Fars from Shiraz and, at their height, Isfahan in the fourteenth century. Their name came from the injü, the Mongol term for the royal estates: in 1304 the Ilkhan Öljeitü entrusted Sharaf al-Din Mahmud Shah with the administration of the crown lands in Fars.

The family became virtual governors of the province, and after the Ilkhan Abu Sa'id died in 1335 it became independent. Sharaf al-Din's sons fought for Shiraz until Jamal al-Din Abu Ishaq seized it in 1343. In 1351 the dynasty commissioned the Khuda Khane, the Qur'an repository inside the Atigh Jame' Mosque.

Abu Ishaq's rivalry with the Muzaffarids ended: their ruler Mubariz al-Din Muhammad took Shiraz in 1353 and Isfahan in 1357, when Abu Ishaq was executed and the Injuid lands passed to the Muzaffarids, who held them until Timur's conquest forty years later.
zh:
因朱王朝是14世纪以设拉子为中心统治法尔斯、鼎盛时还领有伊斯法罕的伊朗人王朝。其名来自蒙古语对王室地产的称呼“因朱”：1304年，伊儿汗完者都把法尔斯王室领地的管理权交给谢拉夫丁·马哈茂德沙。

该家族逐渐成为法尔斯的实际统治者，1335年伊儿汗不赛因死后自立。马哈茂德沙诸子争夺设拉子，贾马勒丁·阿布·伊沙克于1343年夺城。1351年，该王朝在阿蒂克聚礼清真寺内修建了存放《古兰经》的胡达哈内经阁。

阿布·伊沙克与莫扎法尔王朝争霸：其君主穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德于1353年攻占设拉子，1357年拿下伊斯法罕，阿布·伊沙克被处死，因朱领地落入莫扎法尔王朝之手，直到约四十年后帖木儿征服此地。

en:
The Isa were a warrior family of Isa District in Hitachi Province and the kin from whom the Date clan sprang. In 1189 Isa no Tamemune, eldest son of the local lord Hitachi Nensei, won distinction at the Battle of Ishinazaka on Minamoto no Yoritomo's Ōshū campaign. Nensei received the Date and Shinobu districts in Mutsu and took the name Date, while Tamemune kept the old estate and called himself Isa.

Tamemune is said to have drowned fighting for the Kamakura shogunate in the Uji River during the Jōkyū War of 1221. When the war of the Northern and Southern Courts began, Isa Yukisuke followed Kitabatake Akiie for the Southern Court.

Yukisuke held Isa Castle with nearby garrisons until it fell in 1343. The house lost its lands and disappeared as a power, though families bearing the name later served the Yūki of Shimōsa.
zh:
伊佐氏是居住在常陆国伊佐郡的武家，也是伊达氏的同族本源。1189年，当地领主常陆念西的长子伊佐为宗跟随源赖朝参加奥州合战，在石那坂之战中立下战功。念西受封陆奥的伊达郡与信夫郡，自称伊达氏，而为宗留在本领，称伊佐氏。

1221年承久之乱中，为宗为镰仓幕府作战，相传在宇治川溺亡。南北朝对立开始后，伊佐行资投奔南朝，追随北畠显家。

行资与附近城池互为犄角据守伊佐城，1343年城池陷落。伊佐氏失去领地，就此没落，此后下总结城氏的家臣中仍可见伊佐姓之人。

en:
The Ise were a bureaucratic samurai house who claimed descent from the Kanmu Taira line of Ise. At the end of the Kamakura period Taira no Toshitsugu took the name Ise after his appointment as governor of Ise, and by 1330 Ise Munetsugu was serving the Ashikaga in Kazusa.

In 1379 Ise Sadatsugu became chief administrator of the Muromachi shogunate's Mandokoro, an office his descendants inherited. Ise Sadachika raised shōgun Ashikaga Yoshimasa and dominated politics until his fall in 1466; his recall during the Ōnin War drove Ashikaga Yoshimi into the western camp.

Ise Sadataka was killed in Kyoto in 1562. The Bitchū Ise branch produced Hōjō Sōun, founder of the Later Hōjō. In the Edo period the main line served as hatamoto and became the authoritative house of the Ise school of warrior etiquette under Ise Sadatake.
zh:
伊势氏是执掌实务的武家，自称出自桓武平氏的伊势平氏一脉。镰仓末期，平俊继受任伊势守后始称伊势氏，至迟在1330年，伊势宗继已在上总国效力足利氏。

1379年，伊势贞继出任室町幕府政所执事，此后该职由其家族世袭。伊势贞亲曾担任将军足利义政的养育方，左右幕政，1466年失脚，应仁之乱时又被召回，导致足利义视出奔西军。

1562年伊势贞孝在京都战死。庶流备中伊势氏出了北条早云，为后北条氏之祖。江户时代，宗家以旗本身份侍奉幕府，并由伊势贞丈集其大成，成为武家伊势礼法的权威之家。

en:
The lords of Isenburg, an old noble family of the Middle Rhine, took their name from the castle of Isenburg in the Westerwald, built around 1100 by the brothers Rembold and Gerlach. The house split in 1137 into the Isenburg and Limburg-Covern lines, and thereafter into many branches.

Around 1300 Ludwig of Isenburg married the heiress of Buedingen, and by 1376 his descendants had made good that inheritance; they became imperial counts in 1442. The Lower Isenburg lines died out, the Grenzau branch last in 1664, while the Buedingen line subdivided into several branches.

In 1744 the Birstein line was raised to princely rank, and in 1806 the Confederation of the Rhine united the Isenburg lands into a single Principality of Isenburg. The principality was mediatized after 1815 and divided between Hesse-Darmstadt and Hesse-Kassel in 1816.
zh:
伊森堡是中莱茵古老的贵族世家，得名于韦斯特瓦尔德的伊森堡城堡，约1100年由伦博尔德与格拉赫兄弟修建。家族于1137年分为伊森堡与林堡—科芬两支，此后又衍生众多支系。

约1300年，伊森堡的路德维希娶比丁根的女继承人为妻，到1376年其后代完全取得这份遗产；1442年他们成为帝国伯爵。下伊森堡各支相继绝嗣，最后的格伦藻支于1664年断绝；比丁根支则分出数系。

1744年比尔施泰因支升为诸侯，1806年莱茵邦联将伊森堡诸系领地合并为统一的伊森堡亲王国。1815年后亲王国被陪臣化，1816年由黑森—达姆施塔特和黑森—卡塞尔瓜分。

en:
The Ishidō were a branch of the Ashikaga family of Shimotsuke. Their founder Yorishige, a grandson and adopted son of Ashikaga Yasuuji, took the name Ishidō in the mid-thirteenth century, probably from an estate named for a stone monument.

The clan's prominence came in the Nanboku-chō wars. Yorishige's son Yoshifusa was named supreme commander of Ōshū in 1337. Recalled in 1345, he quarrelled with Shogun Takauji and withdrew to Kamakura to serve Takauji's brother Tadayoshi. In the Kannō Disturbance he and his son Yorifusa fought on Tadayoshi's side; Yorifusa afterwards held out with the Southern Court until he surrendered in 1364 and took holy vows.

Yoshifusa's other son Yoshimoto briefly seized Taga in 1354 before Shiba Iekane drove him out. A later kinsman appears in shogunal service during the Ōei War of 1399, after which the Ishidō vanish from the records.
zh:
石塔氏是下野足利氏的旁支。始祖赖茂是足利泰氏之孙，被泰氏收为养子，13世纪中叶以“石塔”为姓，其地名大概取自当地的石造纪念物。

该族短暂的活跃期在南北朝战乱。赖茂之子义房于1337年被任命为奥州总大将；1345年他被解任，与将军尊氏不和，前往镰仓投奔尊氏之弟直义。观应之乱中，义房与儿子赖房加入直义一方，乱后赖房继续依附南朝抵抗，直到1364年才投降出家。

义房的另一子义基于1354年一度攻占多贺城，很快被斯波家兼夺回。1399年应永之乱时，族中仍有人效力幕府，此后石塔氏便从史料中消失。

en:
The Mutsu Ishikawa were a Seiwa Genji clan. Minamoto no Arimitsu took command after his father Yorito fell at Kuriyagawa, and in 1063 received Ishikawa district; he built Miashi castle and took the district's name. The clan married into the Oshu Fujiwara of Hiraizumi, though a branch backed the Fujiwara against Yoritomo in 1189 and lost its lord.

In 1333 an Ishikawa lord joined Nitta Yoshisada at Inamuragasaki; under Muromachi the clan navigated Oshu's courts and fought in the Yuki war of 1440. They entered the Date orbit in the Sengoku age: in 1563 Harumitsu adopted Date Harumune's son Akimitsu.

In 1590 Akimitsu dared not join Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign for fear of Date Masamune; the Oshu settlement attainted him, granting his lands to Gamo Ujisato, and retainer Mizoi Yoshinobu burned the castle and killed himself. The Ishikawa then served Date, were enfeoffed at Kakuda with twelve thousand koku in 1598 and headed the Date ichimon, reaching twenty-one thousand koku under the Tokugawa.
zh:
陆奥石川氏属清和源氏一族。源有光在父亲赖远战死后统军，1063年以军功受封石川郡，筑三芦城并以地名为苗字，是为该族之始。他们与平泉的奥州藤原氏通婚，但1189年奥州合战时一族有人站在藤原一方对抗源赖朝，当主因此被杀。

1333年，石川氏一位领主加入新田义贞的稻村崎之战；室町时期在奥州各公方之间周旋，1440年参加结城合战。该族战国时进入伊达氏轨道：1563年晴光迎伊达晴宗之子昭光为养子。

1590年昭光因畏惧伊达政宗而未参阵小田原，奥州仕置中被改易，领地划给蒲生氏乡，老臣沟井义信焚城自尽。石川氏此后出仕伊达，1598年受封角田一万二千石，位列伊达家一门首席，江户时代知行增至二万一千石。

en:
The Isshiki were a warrior house of the Seiwa-Genji and a branch of the Ashikaga clan. Their founder Isshiki Kōshin, a son of Ashikaga Yasuuji, took the family name from Isshiki in the Kira manor of Mikawa Province, where the clan held its domain from the late thirteenth century.

In 1336 Isshiki Yoriyuki followed Ashikaga Takauji to Kyushu, falling the next year at the Battle of Inuzukahara against the Southern Court. Under the Muromachi shogunate the Isshiki became the foremost of the four shiki houses eligible to head the Samurai-dokoro, and inherited the military governorships of Wakasa, Mikawa and Tango.

They survived into the Sengoku period as daimyō of Tango, but the invasions of Hosokawa Fujitaka and his son Tadaoki in the 1570s and early 1580s overran the province and ended the main line's rule.
zh:
一色氏是出自清和源氏的武士家族，属于足利氏一门。始祖一色公深为足利泰氏之子，以三河国吉良庄的一色为本贯并取此苗字，13世纪末起在当地建有领地。

1336年，一色赖行跟随足利尊氏转战九州，翌年在犬冢原之战中与南朝军队作战时战死。室町幕府时期，一色家位列“四职”笔头，获得出任侍所长官的资格，并世袭若狭、三河、丹后等国的守护职。

进入战国时代后，他们以丹后大名的身份存续，但在16世纪70至80年代细川藤孝、忠兴父子的侵攻下，丹后被吞并，一色家嫡系的统治就此终结。

en:
The Itō were a branch of the Kudō clan of the Southern House of the Fujiwara, named for the Itō Manor in Izu Province. Kudō Suketsune's men killed Kawazu Sukeyasu in 1176, and Suketsune was himself cut down by Sukeyasu's sons, the Soga brothers, in 1193.

In 1335 Itō Sukemochi moved to Hyūga at Ashikaga Takauji's command, founding the Hyūga Itō. They fought for the Northern Court and spent centuries contesting the province with the Shimazu. The eleventh head Yoshisuke held forty-eight castles around Sadowara, but defeat by Shimazu Yoshihiro at Kizaki in 1572 and an invasion in 1577 drove the clan out.

His son Suketaka guided Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign of 1587 and recovered the family lands, which became the 50,000-koku Obi Domain. The Itō ruled Obi, confirmed by the Tokugawa after Sekigahara, through the Edo period.
zh:
伊东氏是藤原南家工藤氏的支族，得名于伊豆国的伊东庄。工藤祐经派人于1176年射杀河津祐泰，祐经自己则在1193年被祐泰之子曾我兄弟讨杀。

1335年，伊东祐持奉足利尊氏之命南下日向，是为日向伊东氏之祖。他们站在北朝一方作战，此后数百年与岛津氏反复抗争。第十一代当主义佑以佐土原城为中心坐拥四十八座支城，却在1572年木崎原之战中被岛津义弘击败，1577年全族被逐出日向。

义祐之子祐兵在丰臣秀吉的1587年九州平定中担任向导，收复旧领，建立五万石的饫肥藩。关原之战后其领地得到德川家安堵，伊东氏统治饫肥直至幕末。

en:
Ah Itzá, the people of Itzá, denotes the royal lineage of the Itza Maya, whose kings all bore the name or title Kan Ekʼ, meaning serpent star. The Itza traced descent from the Chanes of the Chontal region and migrated through Bacalar into northern Yucatán in the tenth century, when they were associated with Chichen Itza.

Driven from Mayapan by the Xiu Maya around 1441 to 1446, the Itza withdrew to Lake Petén Itzá and built their island capital Nojpetén. There the Aj Kan Ekʼ ruled an independent kingdom while the rest of Maya lands fell to the Spanish.

Hernán Cortés met the Kan Ekʼ in 1525, and Franciscan missions were expelled in the early seventeenth century. The line ended in 1697, when Spanish forces stormed Nojpetén and carried the last Kan Ekʼ prisoner to Guatemala.
zh:
阿·伊察意为“伊察人”，指伊察玛雅的王室世系；历代国王都使用“卡内克”这一名号，意为“蛇星”。伊察人自称是琼塔尔地区查内斯人的后裔，10世纪经巴卡拉尔迁入尤卡坦北部，与奇琴伊察关系密切。

约1441—1446年，伊察人被休人逐出玛雅潘，南撤至佩滕伊察湖，在岛上建起都城诺赫佩滕。阿赫·卡内克在此维持着独立王国，而玛雅其余土地相继落入西班牙人之手。

1525年科尔特斯会见卡内克，17世纪初方济各会的传教活动被驱逐。1697年，西班牙军队攻陷诺赫佩滕，末代卡内克被押往危地马拉，这一王统告终。

en:
The Jadejas were a Rajput clan of Kutch and Saurashtra in Gujarat, descended from the Samma pastoral people of Sindh. Written sources place their emergence in the fourteenth century, when Hindu branches of the Sammas settled in Kutch rather than accept Islam.

Marriages with Sodha Rajput women and the adoption of Rajput customs later secured their Rajput standing. By the middle of the century Jadeja chiefs held lands across Kutch.

The clan's fortunes rose under Khengarji I, whose sister married Sultan Mahmud Begada of Gujarat. The sultan raised him to the title Rao and granted him Morvi in 1538, and in 1540 Khengarji founded the state of Kutch, binding twelve related Jadeja chieftain families to him. Other branches came to rule Nawanagar, Rajkot, Gondal and Dhrol, while the Kutch line remained on its throne into the nineteenth century.
zh:
阇提奢是古吉拉特卡奇和萨乌拉施特拉一带的拉杰普特氏族，源自信德的萨姆玛游牧族群。有文字可考的记载把该氏族的出现定在14世纪：萨姆玛人的印度教分支不愿改宗伊斯兰教，迁居卡奇。

他们通过与索达拉杰普特家族联姻、仿效拉杰普特习俗，逐渐取得拉杰普特身份。到该世纪中叶，阇提奢首领已在卡奇广占领地。

肯加吉一世之妹嫁给古吉拉特苏丹马哈茂德·贝加达，苏丹于1538年封他为拉奥并赐地莫尔维；1540年肯加吉建立卡奇邦，把十二个同族首领家族团结在麾下。其他支系后来统治纳瓦纳加尔、拉杰果德、贡达尔和德罗尔，卡奇一脉的王位则延续到19世纪。

en:
The Jadon, or Jadaun, are a Rajput clan of the Lunar lineage, claiming descent from the god Krishna. Tradition holds that the clan once ruled at Mathura before Muslim pressure pushed it west into Rajasthan. Raja Vijay Pal built the fort of Bayana in 1040, and his successor Timan Pal, ruling from 1093 to 1159, broadened the chiefship.

In 1348 Raja Arjun Pal Dev founded a new capital at Kalyanpuri, the later Karauli, which became the clan's permanent seat. Mahmud Khalji stormed Karauli in 1454, and the rajas withdrew to Untagarh.

Raja Gopaldas recovered the ancestral capital with the favour of the Mughal emperor Akbar. Thereafter the Jadons served the Mughals as local chiefs and in 1817 entered a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company, continuing as princes of Karauli through the early nineteenth century.
zh:
阇豆那（又译贾东）是属月亮世系的拉杰普特部族，自称是神祇黑天的后裔。相传该族曾统治马图拉，后在穆斯林势力压力下西迁拉贾斯坦。罗阇维杰·帕尔于1040年修筑巴亚纳堡；继任者蒂曼·帕尔（1093—1159年在位）扩张了酋长政权。

1348年罗阇阿周那·帕尔·德夫在格扬普里建立新都，即后来的格劳利，此地成为该族的固定根基。马哈茂德·卡尔吉于1454年攻陷格劳利，罗阇们退守温塔加尔。

罗阇戈帕尔达斯借莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴的恩宠收复旧都。此后阇豆那人以地方首领身份效力莫卧儿，又于1817年与英国东印度公司签订附属同盟，在19世纪初继续以格劳利王公的身份存续。

en:
The Jalayirids were a dynasty of the Mongol Jalayir tribe, whose ancestors came west with Hulagu and by the fourteenth century had become largely Turkicized. As the Ilkhanate disintegrated after Abu Sa'id's death in 1335, Hasan Buzurg took Baghdad and the Ilkhanid lands of Iraq and western Iran, ruling at first through puppet Chinggisid khans.

Under his son Shaykh Uways, who reigned from 1356 to 1374, the sultanate reached its peak, controlling Iraq, Azerbaijan and parts of Iran. Its court became a centre of Persianate letters and book painting.

After Uways the dynasty weakened amid succession disputes, and from the 1380s it was battered by Timur and the Qara Qoyunlu. A short-lived restoration in southern Iraq and Khuzistan after Timur's death in 1405 could not save it; the Qara Qoyunlu extinguished the last Jalayirid rulers in 1432.
zh:
札剌亦儿王朝出自蒙古札剌亦儿部，其先祖随旭烈兀西来，到14世纪时已高度突厥化。1335年伊儿汗不赛因死后伊儿汗国瓦解，哈桑·布祖格占据巴格达以及伊儿汗国在伊拉克和伊朗西部的旧地，先以成吉思汗后裔的傀儡汗为号。

其子谢赫·乌韦斯在位期间（1356—1374），王朝达到鼎盛，版图覆盖伊拉克、阿塞拜疆和伊朗部分地区。宫廷也成为波斯文学与细密画的中心。

乌韦斯死后，王朝在继承纷争中日趋衰弱，14世纪80年代起先遭帖木儿征伐，又受到黑羊王朝打击。1405年帖木儿死后，札剌亦儿人曾在伊拉克南部和胡齐斯坦短暂复国，末代势力于1432年被黑羊王朝攻灭。

en:
The Jaqeli were a Georgian princely house, named for their castle of Jaqi. The line ruling Samtskhe began with Ivane-Qvarqvare, enfeoffed by Queen Tamar. Under Sargis I the province seceded from Georgia in 1266 and placed itself under the Mongol Ilkhanate; Sargis had saved Hulagu's life in battle.

In 1334 George V brought Samtskhe back under the crown and granted the Jaqelis the hereditary title of atabeg, so their state became known as Samtskhe-Saatabago. Qvarqvare II defeated King George VIII near Lake Paravani in 1465 and broke away from Georgia.

In 1535 King Bagrat III of Imereti annexed the principality, but after the Ottoman victory at Sokhoista in 1545 Samtskhe became an Ottoman vassal. From 1578 the Jaqeli atabegs converted to Islam and ruled as hereditary pashas of Akhaltsikhe until the Russian conquest of 1829.
zh:
亚克力是格鲁吉亚王公世家，得名于贾基城堡。统治萨姆茨赫的支系始于受塔玛尔女王封赐的伊万涅‑克瓦尔克瓦雷。1266年，萨尔吉斯一世使该省脱离格鲁吉亚，臣属伊儿汗国；他曾在战斗中救过旭烈兀。

1334年，格奥尔基五世收回萨姆茨赫，授予亚克力家世袭阿塔贝格头衔，政权从此称萨姆茨赫‑萨阿塔巴戈。1465年，克瓦尔克瓦雷二世在帕拉瓦尼湖附近击败格奥尔基八世，脱离格鲁吉亚。

1535年，伊梅列季国王巴格拉特三世吞并公国，1545年奥斯曼在索霍伊斯塔获胜后，萨姆茨赫沦为其附庸。1578年起，亚克力阿塔贝格改宗伊斯兰教，以阿哈尔齐赫世袭帕夏身份统治，至1829年俄罗斯征服。

en:
The Jarral were a Rajput clan of the Pir Panjal hills, later counted among the Muslim Rajputs, who claimed descent from the Tomar Rajputs of the lunar lineage. Their rajas ruled Rajouri, the ancient Rajapuri named in Kalhana's Rajatarangini. The first of them, Prithvi Pal, held the Pir Panjal passes against Mahmud of Ghazni's raid of 1021, and his line ruled the principality from 1033.

In 1475 the campaigns of the Kashmiri general Malik Tazi Bhat reduced Rajouri to a tributary of the Kashmir Sultanate, though its rajas kept limited autonomy. Under Mughal rule the Jarral rulers came to terms with the empire and received the title Mirza.

They resisted Sikh expansion, but in 1813 Gulab Singh of Jammu captured Rajouri for Ranjit Singh by defeating Raja Aghar Khan, ending Jarral rule.
zh:
贾拉尔人是皮尔潘贾尔山区的拉杰普特氏族，后世归入穆斯林拉杰普特之列，自称源出月族世系的托马尔拉杰普特。他们的罗阇统治着拉久里，即见于卡尔哈纳《罗阇塔兰吉尼》的古城拉贾普里。最早的首领普里特维·帕尔曾在1021年扼守皮尔潘贾尔山口，抵御加兹尼的马哈茂德的进犯，其家族自1033年起统治这个小邦。

1475年，克什米尔将领马利克·塔齐·巴特的征讨使拉久里沦为克什米尔苏丹国的附庸，但罗阇仍保留有限的自治权。莫卧儿时期，贾拉尔统治者与帝国达成和议，获封“米尔扎”称号。

他们抵抗锡克人的扩张，1813年查谟的古拉卜·辛格击败罗阇阿加尔汗，为兰吉特·辛格夺取拉久里，贾拉尔家族的统治至此终结。

en:
The Jarwanids were an Arab dynasty of the Bani Malik clan that ruled al-Qatif and al-Ahsa in eastern Arabia in the fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries. Their founder Jarwan ibn Nasir al-Maliki, based at al-Qatif, drove out the forces of the Muntafiq chief Saʿid ibn Mughamis and overthrew the Usfurids around 1383, establishing an emirate over the old Bahrain region.

Contemporary writers such as Ibn Battuta and Ibn Hajar called them extreme Rafida. Modern scholars debate whether they were Ismaʿilis or Twelver Shiʿites, though Twelver scholars filled the judgeships and the office of market inspector under their rule, and prayers were said in the mosques according to the Shiʿite formula.

Arabic sources date the emirate to 1392 to 1417. The Jabrids of the Banu Uqayl Bedouin clan deposed and killed its last ruler in al-Qatif and by 1440 had taken over al-Ahsa, Qatif and the Bahrain islands.
zh:
贾尔万王朝是巴尼·马利克部族的阿拉伯人王朝，14世纪至15世纪初统治阿拉伯东部的卡提夫与哈萨绿洲。其奠基人贾尔万·伊本·纳西尔·马利基以卡提夫为据点，击退蒙塔菲格部首领赛义德·伊本·穆加米斯的军队，约1383年推翻乌斯富尔王朝，在旧巴林地区建立埃米尔国。

伊本·白图泰、伊本·哈吉尔等当时的学者称他们为极端的拉斐达派。今人对其属伊斯玛仪派还是十二伊玛目派仍有争论，但其治下担任法官和市场督察的都是十二伊玛目派学者，清真寺也按什叶派仪轨礼拜。

阿拉伯文史料将埃米尔国的存续时间系于1392—1417年。巴努·欧盖勒部落的贝都因人贾布里德王朝在卡提夫废黜并杀死末代统治者，到1440年已夺取哈萨、卡提夫和巴林群岛。

en:
The Jethwa are the oldest Rajput ruling clan of the Saurashtra peninsula, and likely heirs of the Saindhavas, the eighth-century naval kings of Ghumli who styled themselves masters of the western sea. Their own bardic genealogy traces the clan to Jethi-dhwaja of the line of Hanuman, whose image they bore on their arms. Entering from Sindh and Kutch, they founded Morvi around 900 and controlled much of western and northern Kathiawar at the time of Mahmud of Ghazni.

Sangaji defeated the Vaghela chief Virdhavala in 1125 and took the title rana. Driven out of Morvi in 1193, the Jethwas made Ghumli their capital, where they built the twelfth-century Navlakha sun temple and Vikia stepwell.

In 1313 Rana Bhanji, after whom Bhanvad is named, lost Ghumli and moved the seat to Ranpur. Later capitals included Chhaya and finally Porbandar, from 1685.
zh:
杰特瓦是萨乌拉施特拉半岛最古老的拉杰普特统治部族，很可能是8世纪海上王朝赛恩达瓦（都于贡姆利，自称西海之主）的后继。该族自己的世系歌把祖先追溯到哈奴曼一脉的杰提德瓦贾，其纹章也以哈奴曼为记。他们从信德和卡奇进入半岛，约900年建立莫尔维，在加兹尼的马哈茂德时代控制着卡提阿瓦西部和北部的大片土地。

1125年，桑加吉击败瓦盖拉首领维尔达拉，取得拉纳头衔。1193年，杰特瓦人被逐出莫尔维，以贡姆利为都，在那里修建了12世纪的纳夫拉卡太阳神庙和维基阶梯井。

1313年，拉纳·班吉失去贡姆利，迁都兰布尔；班瓦德城即以他的名字命名。此后都址又经查亚等地，最终于1685年迁至波尔班达尔。

en:
The Jhala are a Chandravanshi Rajput clan, also called Makwana after their old dynasty at Karenti in Sindh. In 1090 Harpal Makwana led the clan into northern Gujarat and founded Jhalawad, named for them. The early Jhala rajas served the Chaulukya kings, and Santaldev founded a new capital at Santalpur in 1304.

Ranmalsinhji I, ruling from 1392, was captured by the Rathores and freed by his son Shatrusaldev, who moved the seat to Mandal and three times rebelled against Ahmed Shah I of Gujarat. In 1486 Mahmud Begada sacked the fort of Kuva, the disaster remembered as Kuva-no-Ker, and the capital moved to Halvad two years later.

The Jhala prince Ajajji died fighting for Mewar at Khanwa against Babur in 1527. In 1742 Rai Singh II built Dhrangadhra, from which the state took its later name. Jhala branches also ruled nearby states.
zh:
阇诃罗是月系拉杰普特部族，又称马克瓦纳，得名于信德卡伦蒂的旧王朝。1090年，哈尔帕尔·马克瓦纳率部迁入古吉拉特北部，建立以该族命名的阇诃罗伐德王国。早期王公效力于遮娄其王朝；桑塔尔提婆于1304年建都桑塔尔布尔。

1392年起在位的兰马尔辛吉一世被拉托尔人俘虏，其子沙特鲁萨尔提婆救出他后迁都曼达尔，三次反抗古吉拉特的艾哈迈德沙阿一世。1486年，马哈茂德·贝加达攻陷库瓦要塞，史称库瓦之难；两年后都城迁至哈尔瓦德。

1527年，阇诃罗王子阿贾吉为梅瓦尔战死于对抗巴布尔的坎瓦战役；1742年，拉伊·辛格二世兴建德兰加达，土邦后来以此为名。阇诃罗旁支还统治附近小邦。

en:
The Hanyang Zhao took their clan seat at Hanyang, which Goryeo knew as Namgyeong. Their founder Jo Ji-su was a local lord of Yongjin who held a post at the Goryeo court.

In 1258 his son Jo Hwi mutinied, killed the north-eastern commander Sin Jip-pyeong and surrendered the lands beyond Hwaju to the Mongols. The Yuan made him first superintendent of the new Ssangseong Prefecture, an office held by Hwi and his descendants Yanggi, Rim and Sosaeng over four generations.

In 1356, when King Gongmin broke with the Yuan, Yanggi's son Jo Don, Sosaeng's uncle, turned against the commandery and helped General Yu In-u storm it, restoring the territory north of Cheolnyeong to Goryeo. Kinsmen such as Jo In-ok became founding merit subjects of Joseon after 1392; a later son was the reformist scholar Jo Gwang-jo (1482—1519).
zh:
汉阳赵氏是以汉阳（高丽时称南京）为本贯的氏族。始祖赵之寿出身龙津县的土著士族，在高丽朝中任职。

1258年，其子赵晖起兵攻杀东北面兵马使慎执平，以和州以北之地投降蒙古。元朝任命他为新设双城总管府的首任总管，此后赵晖、赵良琪、赵琳、赵小生祖孙四代相继出任总管。

1356年恭愍王决意摆脱元朝，赵良琪之子、赵小生的叔父赵暾倒戈，配合东北面兵马使柳仁雨攻破双城，高丽由此收复铁岭以北的旧疆。族人赵仁沃等在1392年朝鲜开国时成为开国功臣；该氏族后世人物还有改革派儒臣赵光祖（1482—1519）。

en:
The lords of Joinville were a family of Champagne who held the castle and lordship of Joinville from the eleventh century and served as hereditary seneschals of the counts of Champagne. Their most famous member was John of Joinville, born in 1224.

He joined Louis IX on the Seventh Crusade in 1244, was captured with the king at Al Mansurah in 1250 and helped negotiate the ransom, then spent four years at his side in the Holy Land. He refused to follow Louis on the Tunis crusade of 1270, when the king died outside Tunis.

John testified at the inquest into the king's sanctity in 1282, and wrote his Life of Saint Louis at Queen Jeanne of Navarre's request, completing it in 1309. He died in 1317. The family ruled Joinville until 1365 and became extinct in the following century.
zh:
茹安维尔家族是香槟的贵族，自11世纪起据有茹安维尔城堡和领地，世袭香槟伯爵的宫廷总管一职。家族最有名的成员是生于1224年的让·德·茹安维尔。

1244年他随路易九世参加第七次十字军东征，1250年在曼苏拉与国王一同被俘，参与赎金谈判，此后四年随侍国王留在圣地。1270年他拒绝参加突尼斯十字军，国王死在突尼斯城下。

1282年让在圣德调查中出庭作证；应纳瓦拉王后让娜之请，他撰写《圣路易传》，于1309年成书。让于1317年去世。家族统治茹安维尔至1365年，最终于15世纪绝嗣。

en:
The Joyces, Gaelic Seoighe, were a Hiberno-Norman family in the far west of Connacht. Their surname came from the Old French Josse, drawn from Judoc, a Breton royal saint of the seventh century. One of the first recorded in Ireland was Thomas Joy, who founded a lordship in northern Iar Connacht, holding the barony of Ross between the Cong river and Killary Harbour.

The family became Gaelicised, ruling like an Irish chiefly line over the old Partraige country around Lough Mask and Lough Corrib, which became known as Joyce Country.

A kinsman branch settled in Galway and joined its fourteen merchant tribes: Henry Joyce served as mayor in 1542, and tradition credits the goldsmith Richard Joyce, around 1700, with designing the Claddagh ring.
zh:
乔伊斯家族，盖尔语作肖伊，是康诺特极西之地的诺曼—爱尔兰家族。其姓氏源自古法语若斯，后者又来自7世纪布列塔尼的王族圣人朱多克。最早见于爱尔兰记载的成员之一是托马斯·乔伊，他在西康诺特北部建起领地，据有孔格河与基拉里港之间的罗斯男爵区。

家族后来盖尔化，像爱尔兰酋长家族一样统治马斯克湖与科里布湖周边古老的帕特雷地区，这片地方后来被称为乔伊斯地区。

另有一支亲族定居戈尔韦，跻身该城十四大商人部族之列：亨利·乔伊斯于1542年出任市长；据传统说法，金匠理查德·乔伊丝在1700年前后设计了克拉达戒指。

en:
The lords of Jülich began as counts west of the Rhine, first documented with Gerhard I in 1003; Gerhard III styled himself Count of Jülich from 1081. Count William IV granted Jülich its town charter in 1234, opening a rivalry with the archbishops of Cologne.

Emperor Charles IV raised Count William V to duke in 1356, and the house inherited Guelders in 1393. When Reinald IV died without heirs in 1423, Jülich passed to the Jülich-Berg branch and was united with Berg and Ravensberg.

The last male Jülich duke, William IV, died in 1511, and his daughter Maria carried the lands to the House of La Marck of Cleves, forming the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg in 1521. The Treaty of Xanten in 1614 assigned Jülich to the Palatinate-Neuburg line of the Wittelsbachs; France annexed it in 1794 and Prussia received it in 1815.
zh:
于利希家族起家于莱茵河以西，1003年格哈德一世首次见载，格哈德三世自1081年起自称于利希伯爵。威廉四世伯爵1234年授予于利希城市权，并与科隆大主教长期对抗。

1356年皇帝查理四世升威廉五世为公爵，家族于1393年继承海尔德。1423年赖因哈德四世无嗣而终，于利希转入于利希—贝格支系，与贝格和拉文斯贝格合并。

末代男嗣公爵威廉四世1511年去世，其女玛丽亚把领地带给克莱沃的拉马克家族，1521年组成于利希—克莱沃—贝格联合公国。1614年《克桑滕条约》把于利希判给维特尔斯巴赫家族的普法尔茨—诺伊堡支；1794年法国吞并该地，1815年它被划归普鲁士。

en:
The Kachhwahas were a Rajput clan of Dhundhar in northeastern Rajputana, ruling Amber and later Jaipur. They claim descent from Kusha, son of Rama. Their ancestors are said to have ruled Gwalior. In the eleventh century Dulha Rai received Dausa from the Chauhans and established the Dhundhar kingdom; his successor Kakil seized Amber.

Amber's rise began under Bharmal, who married his daughter to Akbar in 1562 and became a Mughal vassal. His grandson Man Singh I became one of Akbar's foremost Rajput generals. Jai Singh I commanded in the Deccan and extracted the Treaty of Purandar from Shivaji in 1665.

Sawai Jai Singh II reasserted independence in 1708, founded Jaipur in 1727 and built the Jantar Mantar observatories. After his death in 1743, succession wars and Maratha tribute drained the state; in 1818 Jaipur entered a British subsidiary alliance.
zh:
卡奇瓦哈是拉杰普塔纳东北部敦达尔地区的拉杰普特氏族，统治安泊尔及其后的斋普尔。他们自称是罗摩之子俱舍的后裔，据说其祖先曾在瓜廖尔立国。11世纪，杜尔哈·拉伊从乔汉人手中得到道萨，开创敦达尔王国；继任者卡基尔夺取安泊尔。

安泊尔的崛起始于巴尔马尔：1562年他把女儿嫁给阿克巴，成为莫卧儿附庸。其孙曼·辛格一世成为阿克巴麾下最重要的拉杰普特将领之一。贾伊·辛格一世在德干统兵，于1665年迫使希瓦吉签订《普兰达尔条约》。

萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格二世于1708年重振独立，1727年兴建斋普尔，并建造詹塔曼塔天文台。1743年他死后，继承内战和马拉塔贡赋耗尽国力；1818年斋普尔纳入英国的辅助同盟体系。

en:
The Kadambas were an ancient royal family of Karnataka who ruled the northern Deccan and the Konkan from Banavasi. Founded around 345 by Mayurasharma after he defeated the Pallavas of Kanchi, the kingdom reached its peak under Kakusthavarma and was the first native dynasty to use Kannada in administration.

From the mid-sixth century the Kadambas continued as feudatories of the Chalukyas and then the Rashtrakutas, splitting into lesser branches. The Goa branch was set up in 960 by Shashthadeva, a Chalukya feudatory who took Chandrapur from the Shilaharas and ruled from Chandor and then the wealthy port of Gopakapattana.

The Kadambas of Goa built Shiva temples and ran their courts in Sanskrit and Kannada. In the 1320s Khalji general Malik Kafur sacked Gopakapattana, and the line came to an end around 1345.
zh:
卡达姆巴人是卡纳塔克的古老王族，从巴南巴西出发统治北德干和康坎一带。约345年，马尤拉沙尔马击败建志的帕拉瓦人后建国，在卡库斯塔瓦尔马时期达到鼎盛，也是第一个在行政中使用卡纳达语的本地王朝。

6世纪中叶以后，卡达姆巴人作为遮娄其及后来罗湿陀罗拘陀的附庸延续下来，分裂成几个支系。果阿支系由沙斯塔提婆于960年建立，他作为遮娄其的封臣从希拉哈拉人手中夺取昌德拉普尔，先后以昌多尔和富庶港口戈帕卡帕塔纳为都。

果阿的卡达姆巴人修建湿婆神庙，宫廷使用梵语和卡纳达语。14世纪20年代，卡尔吉的将领马利克·卡富尔洗劫戈帕卡帕塔纳，这支王统约于1345年终结。

en:
The Sanuki Kagawa claimed Kanmu Heishi descent and the warrior Kamakura Kagemasa as their ancestor. An earlier branch took its name from Kagawa village in Sagami. After the Nanboku-chō wars the house attached itself to the Hosokawa and entered Sanuki with the Yasutomi, having distinguished itself at Shiramine, and held the office of shugodai for generations.

The Kagawa fought in the Ōnin War and were counted among the Four Heavenly Kings of the Hosokawa. By the Sengoku age they controlled much of western Sanuki from Mitoyo. The last great head Yukikage maneuvered between the Mōri, Oda Nobunaga and Chōsokabe Motochika, taking Nobunaga's character to rename himself Nobukage and adopting Motochika's son Chikakazu as heir. In 1585 Toyotomi Hideyoshi's conquest of Shikoku cost the house its fief.
zh:
赞岐香川氏自称桓武平氏后裔，以武将镰仓权五郎景政为祖先；其早年一支以相模国香川村为姓。南北朝战乱后，香川氏追随细川氏，在白峰合战中立功，与安富氏一同进入赞岐，此后世代担任守护代。

香川氏活跃于应仁之乱，被列为细川四天王之一。到战国时代，他们以三丰为根基，控制赞岐西部大半领地。末代当主香川之景在毛利氏、织田信长与长宗我部元亲之间周旋，接受信长偏讳改名信景，又迎立元亲之子亲和为养子。1585年丰臣秀吉征伐四国，香川氏遭改易，失去领地。

en:
The Kaimana dynasty was the royal house of Sran, later called Kaimana, on the Bomberai Peninsula of western New Guinea. Oral tradition places its foundation in 1309, when the chief Imaga united the villages and tribes of the Pattimunin lands through visits and marriage alliances and took the title Rat Sran Nati Pattimuni, meaning king of Sran. His son Basir Onin moved the court to Borombouw on Adi Island to profit from trade.

Around 1498 the Tidore Sultanate subdued the kingdom during its Hongi expeditions, and it paid tribute in slaves, spices and birds of paradise; the royal family converted to Islam in the 1500s.

In 1808 Nduvin, the Rat Sran IV, moved the capital from Adi Island to E'man, and in 1828 the Dutch built Fort Du Bus nearby at Lobo, drawing the kingdom into the Netherlands-Tidore sphere.
zh:
凯马纳王朝是新几内亚岛西部邦贝赖半岛上斯兰王国（后称凯马纳王国）的王室。据口述传统，酋长伊马加于1309年立国，通过巡访和联姻统一了帕蒂穆宁之地的村落与部落，并采用王号“斯兰之王帕蒂穆尼”。他的儿子巴西尔·奥宁把王庭迁到阿迪岛上的博龙布，以经营贸易。

约1498年，蒂多雷苏丹国在洪吉远征中征服该国，斯兰须以奴隶、香料和极乐鸟纳贡；王室于16世纪改宗伊斯兰教。

1808年，第四任斯兰王恩杜温把都城从阿迪岛迁到埃曼；1828年荷兰人在附近的洛博修建迪比斯要塞，将这个王国纳入荷兰与蒂多雷的势力范围。

en:
The Kajiki were a warrior house of Ōsumi Province in southern Kyushu, named for the Kajiki valley. Their founder was Fujiwara no Tsunehira, third son of the regent Fujiwara no Yoritada, who in the late tenth century married the daughter of the local magnate Ōkura Yoshinaga, settled on his wife's lands and took the place name as his family name. As Kamakura gokenin the clan reached its height helping to repel the Mongol invasions of Japan.

During the Nanboku-chō wars it split into factions backing Ashikaga Takauji and Ashikaga Tadayoshi, and under the Muromachi shogunate it served the Shimazu, shugo lords of Ōsumi.

The family later adopted Mitsuhisa, a son of Shimazu Suehisa, but Mitsuhisa's son Hisahira rebelled and in 1495 raided Chōsa; Shimazu Tadamasa stormed Kajiki Castle the next year, and the Kajiki were removed to Ata in Satsuma.
zh:
加治木氏是九州南部大隅国的武家，得名于加治木谷地。始祖藤原经平是关白藤原赖忠的第三子，10世纪后期入赘当地豪族大藏良长家，在妻方的领地定居，便以地名为家名。镰仓时代加治木氏以御家人身份参加抵御元寇的战斗，家门达到鼎盛。

南北朝战乱中一族分裂，分别追随足利尊氏与足利直义；室町时代归于大隅守护岛津氏麾下。

后来加治木家迎岛津季久之子满久为养子，满久之子久平却举兵反叛，于1495年袭击帖佐，岛津忠昌次年发兵攻破加治木城，加治木氏被移往萨摩的阿多。

en:
The Kakatiyas were a Telugu dynasty that ruled the eastern Deccan from the twelfth to the fourteenth century, with their capital at Orugallu, or Warangal. They claimed sovereignty under Rudradeva in 1163. Ganapati Deva's daughter Rudrama Devi ruled from 1262 and repelled the Yadavas of Devagiri; Marco Polo praised her government. The dynasty built the Thousand Pillar Temple and the forts of Warangal and Golconda.

Delhi's invasions ended the main line: the siege of Warangal in 1310 forced Prataparudra II to pay tribute, and in 1323 Ulugh Khan conquered the kingdom. A branch survived in the east, where Annamadeva, said to be Prataparudra's brother, founded Bastar around 1324 under the goddess Danteshwari. His line later split off Kanker and remained independent until the Maratha advances of the eighteenth century.
zh:
卡卡提亚人是12至14世纪统治东德干的泰卢固王朝，都城在奥鲁加卢，即瓦朗加尔。1163年他们在鲁陀罗提婆治下称王。加纳帕蒂·德瓦之女鲁德拉玛·德维1262年起执政，击退德瓦吉里的雅达瓦人，马可·波罗曾称赞她的治理。王朝留下千柱神庙、瓦朗加尔堡和戈尔孔达堡。

德里的入侵终结了主支王统：1310年瓦朗加尔围城战后，普拉塔帕鲁陀罗二世被迫纳贡，1323年乌鲁格汗攻灭该王国。一支后裔在东部存续，相传为普拉塔帕鲁陀罗之弟的安纳马提婆约于1324年在丹特什瓦里女神的护佑下建立巴斯塔邦。他的后裔后来分出坎凯尔，并保持独立直到18世纪马拉塔人东进。

en:
The Kampili, called the Basnaga kingdom in some Muslim chronicles, were a short-lived Hindu ruling house of the early fourteenth century, holding the Tungabhadra valley around Ballari in northeastern Karnataka.

Their founder Singeya Nayaka III was a commander of the Hoysalas who declared independence around 1280. His son Kampilideva succeeded him in 1300 and resisted repeated northern invasions, ruling from the stronghold that later gave its name to the Kampili region.

In 1327 Muhammad bin Tughluq sent a large army under Malik Zada against him. Kampilideva fell and the court women performed jauhar, mass self-immolation, rather than surrender. The victors stuffed the king's body with straw and sent his head to Delhi as a trophy. The brothers Harihara and Bukka, who had served Kampilideva, were carried off to Delhi after the conquest and returned south to found Vijayanagara in 1336.
zh:
剑毕离王朝在部分穆斯林编年史中被称作巴斯纳伽王国，是14世纪初一个短命的印度教王朝，据有卡纳塔克东北部巴拉里一带的通加巴德拉河谷。

开国者辛吉亚·纳亚卡三世本是曷萨拉的将领，约在1280年宣布独立。其子坎皮利提婆于1300年继位，抵御北方的多次入侵，以后来得名坎皮利地区的要塞为统治中心。

1327年，穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克派马利克·扎达率大军来攻。坎皮利提婆战死，宫廷妇女举行乔哈尔，集体自焚而不肯投降。胜利者把国王遗体填上稻草，将首级送往德里献捷。曾侍奉坎皮利提婆的诃里诃罗与布卡兄弟在城破后被掳往德里，后来重返南方，于1336年建立毗奢耶那伽罗。

en:
The Kaneko were a warrior house of Kanmu Heishi descent, an offshoot of the Murayama party of Musashi. Ienori, grandson of Taira no Yoritō, settled at Kaneko in Iruma and took its name. His son Ietada won distinction in the Hōgen and Heiji wars and became jitō of Nii in Iyo. His great-grandson Hiroie moved there in the thirteenth century and built Kaneko Castle.

During the Nanboku-chō wars the district was contested by the Kōno and Hosokawa, and the Kaneko eventually became Hosokawa vassals. In the Sengoku period Motoie became the district's effective ruler and allied with Chōsokabe Motochika.

In 1585, during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's invasion of Shikoku, Motoie fell fighting Kobayakawa Takakage's Mōri army at Nonoichigahara. Kaneko Castle fell, ending some three hundred and thirty years of Kaneko rule in Nii.
zh:
金子氏是出自桓武平氏的武家，为武藏村山党的支族。平赖任之孙家范移居入间郡金子，以地为姓。其子家忠在保元、平治之乱中建功，成为伊予新居的地头。13世纪，家忠的曾孙广家迁居新居，修筑金子城。

南北朝时期，河野氏与细川氏争夺当地，金子氏最终成为细川氏的属下。战国时代，金子元宅成为当地事实上的支配者，并与长宗我部元亲结盟。

1585年丰臣秀吉征伐四国，元宅在野野市原迎战小早川隆景率领的毛利军，战死阵中。金子城陷落，金子氏在新居约三百三十年的统治就此终结。

en:
The Kangleipak dynasty was the Meitei royal house of Kangleipak, the valley kingdom around Imphal. Meitei tradition traces the line, later called the Ningthouja, to King Nongda Lairen Pakhangba, enthroned at Kangla in the first century; its kings gradually absorbed surrounding clan principalities. They patronised the Sanamahi religion, and King Loiyumba, around the turn of the twelfth century, issued the Loiyumpa Silyel, one of the region's earliest written law codes.

Khagemba (r. 1597-1654) drove back invasions, introduced coinage and settled captured Chinese artisans at Kangla to build bridges and gates. Pamheiba, better known as Gharib Niwaz (r. 1709-1748), enlarged the kingdom and made Hinduism the court faith.

Burmese conquests opened the Seven Years Devastation of 1819-1826, which ended with the Treaty of Yandaboo and the restoration of King Gambhir Singh under British protection.
zh:
刚莱博王朝是刚莱博的梅泰王室，统治英帕尔河谷的王国。梅泰传统把该王统（后称宁托贾王朝）追溯到1世纪在康拉登基的国王农达·莱伦·帕汗巴，历代君王陆续吞并周边部族小邦。王室尊奉萨纳马希信仰；12世纪之交的国王洛伊雍巴颁布《洛伊雍巴法典》，是当地最早的成文法典之一。

卡根巴（1597—1654年在位）击退来犯之敌，推行铸币，并把俘获的中国工匠安置在康拉修桥筑城。帕姆赫巴（号称加里布·尼瓦兹，1709—1748年在位）扩张版图，并把印度教立为宫廷信仰。

1819—1826年缅甸的征服带来七年浩劫，直到《杨达波条约》签订，甘比尔·辛格在英国保护下复国，乱局才告结束。

en:
The Kantakouzenos were a wealthy landowning family of the later Byzantine Empire, probably originating in Asia Minor. First mentioned campaigning against the Cumans in 1094, they held vast estates in the Peloponnese by the Fourth Crusade. Michael became Byzantine governor of the Morea in 1308; his son John became regent after Andronikos III died in 1341.

John fought the civil war of 1341 to 1347 and entered Constantinople as Emperor John VI. He made his son Matthew co-emperor in 1353, but a second civil war ended with his abdication into a monastery in 1354 and Matthew's surrender in 1357.

The family kept the Morea under Manuel from 1349 to 1380 and then Matthew and his son Demetrios, until Theodore I Palaiologos took over in 1383. Theodora married the bey Orhan I, linking the house to the Ottomans.
zh:
坎塔库齐诺斯家族是拜占庭帝国晚期的富有地主世家，可能起源于小亚细亚。家族1094年首次见于征讨库曼人的战事，到第四次十字军时已在伯罗奔尼撒拥有大片地产。米海尔于1308年出任摩里亚的拜占庭总督；他的儿子约翰在1341年安德洛尼卡三世去世后成为摄政。

约翰在1341—1347年的内战后，以皇帝约翰六世的身份进入君士坦丁堡。他于1353年立儿子马修为共治皇帝，但第二次内战以他于1354年退位入修院、马修于1357年投降告终。

家族仍保有摩里亚，曼努埃尔于1349—1380年统治此地，随后由马修及其子季米特里奥斯继任，直到1383年塞奥多雷一世·巴列奥略接管。塞奥多拉嫁给了奥斯曼贝伊奥尔汗一世。

en:
The Karamanids were a powerful Anatolian beylik founded in the mid-thirteenth century by the Turkmen chief Karaman Bey, whose clansmen had fled the Mongol advance from Arran to the Taurus Mountains. They seized Larende, later renamed Karaman. In 1277 Mehmed Bey briefly captured Konya and enthroned the pretender Jimri before being defeated and executed.

The family made Konya its capital as the Sultanate of Rûm collapsed. Mehmed Bey proclaimed Turkish the language of state. The Karamanids became the Ottomans' principal Anatolian rivals, allying with the Mamluks and European powers. Bayezid I reduced them to vassalage in 1398, but Timur restored their lands after Ankara in 1402.

Ottoman campaigns and succession quarrels broke the dynasty, and Bayezid II completed its annexation in 1487. Its mosques and madrasas continued Seljuk architectural traditions.
zh:
卡拉曼王朝是安纳托利亚强大的贝伊国，由土库曼首领卡拉曼贝伊于13世纪中叶建立；他的部众为躲避蒙古人，从阿兰迁至托罗斯山脉。他们夺取拉兰达，后来该城改名卡拉曼。1277年穆罕默德贝伊一度攻占科尼亚，拥立僭称者吉姆里，最终兵败被处死。

鲁姆苏丹国崩溃时，家族以科尼亚为都。穆罕默德贝伊明令以土耳其语为国家语言。卡拉曼人成为奥斯曼在安纳托利亚的主要对手，联合马穆鲁克和欧洲势力。1398年巴耶济德一世将其降为附庸，但1402年安卡拉战役后帖木儿归还了其领地。

奥斯曼征伐与继承纷争使王朝瓦解，1487年巴耶济德二世完成吞并。其清真寺与经院延续了塞尔柱建筑传统。

en:
The Karasids, in Turkish the Karesioğulları, were a Turkoman dynasty that in the early fourteenth century ruled Mysia, around Balıkesir facing the Dardanelles. Its founder Karasi Bey built an independent emirate as Seljuk power faded, and on his death around 1328 the realm was divided between his sons Demir Khan and Yakhshi Khan. Demir's fleet raided Cyzicus and the Thracian shore.

Later rulers such as Ajlan Bey were drawn into Byzantine civil wars, and the dynasty's end is obscured by conflicting legends: after Ajlan's death his son Dursun took refuge with the Ottoman sultan Orhan and guided the Ottoman takeover of the Karasid lands around 1345.

Karasi was the first Anatolian beylik to be absorbed by the Ottomans. The conquest gave the Ottomans a fleet of experienced Aegean sailors and a frontage on the Dardanelles, opening the road into Rumelia.
zh:
卡雷西奥乌拉勒家族（即卡拉斯王朝）是14世纪初统治密细亚的土库曼王朝，领有面向达达尼尔海峡的巴勒克埃西尔一带。开国者卡拉西贝伊趁塞尔柱势力衰落建立独立埃米尔国，约1328年他去世后，国土由其子德米尔汗和叶赫什汗瓜分。德米尔的舰队劫掠基齐库斯和色雷斯海岸。

阿吉兰贝伊等统治者卷入拜占庭内战，而王朝的结局因传说互相矛盾而难详考：阿吉兰死后，其子杜尔孙投奔奥斯曼苏丹奥尔汗，并引导奥斯曼军队约于1345年接管卡拉斯领地。

卡拉斯成为第一个被奥斯曼吞并的安纳托利亚贝伊国。这次吞并让奥斯曼获得舰队和熟悉爱琴海的水手，还取得达达尼尔海峡的出海口，为进军鲁米利亚打开了道路。

en:
The Kart dynasty was a Sunni Muslim family of Tajik origin, related to the Ghurids, that ruled much of Khorasan from Herat. Its founder Shams-uddin Muhammad established its power in 1245 as a vassal of the Mongols. He was poisoned at Abaqa's court in 1278; Fakhr-uddin defeated an Ilkhanid army in 1306 before Herat submitted to Öljeitü.

When the Ilkhanate fragmented after 1335, Mu'izz-uddin Husayn built an independent principality, defeated the Sarbadars at the Battle of Zava in 1342, dropped his tribute and ruled as sultan from 1349. Herat was sacked by the Chagatai amir Qazaghan around 1358, but the dynasty survived.

Herat fell to Timur in 1381. The last ruler Ghiyas-uddin Pir Ali was executed after a revolt in 1383, and the remaining Karts were massacred at a banquet by Timur's son Miran Shah in 1396.
zh:
卡特王朝是与古尔王朝有亲缘关系的塔吉克人逊尼派家族，以赫拉特为都统治呼罗珊大部。开国君主沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德于1245年作为蒙古附庸奠定家族权势。他于1278年在阿八哈宫廷被毒杀；法赫尔丁于1306年击败伊儿汗军队，其后赫拉特向完者都臣服。

1335年伊儿汗国瓦解后，穆仪兹丁·侯赛因建立独立公国，1342年在扎瓦战役击败萨尔巴达尔人，1349年停止纳贡，以苏丹身份统治。约1358年赫拉特遭察合台异密加兹罕洗劫，但王朝延续下来。

1381年赫拉特陷于帖木儿之手。末代君主吉亚斯丁·皮尔·阿里在1383年叛乱后被处死，残余的卡特家族成员于1396年在宴会上被帖木儿之子米兰沙诛杀。

en: The Kartawi took their name from the Kartaw Kurds, called Kartawaye in Syriac sources, a Kurdish tribal group of the hill country west of Lake Van. By 585 the Church of the East had a diocese of Beth Tabyathe and the Kartawaye for them, and the monk David served as their bishop around 686 to 698.
zh: 卡尔塔维之名来自卡尔陶库尔德人，叙利亚语文献称其为卡尔塔瓦叶人，是活动在凡湖以西山区的一支库尔德部落。585年东方教会已为他们设立贝特·塔比亚特与卡尔塔瓦叶教区，修士大卫在686—698年前后曾任该部落的主教。

en:
The Kasai were a warrior house of the Chichibu Taira line, founded by Kasai Kiyoshige, son of Toshima Kiyomoto, whose family held the Kasai shrine-estate in Shimōsa. Kiyoshige and his father joined Minamoto no Yoritomo's rising against the Taira in 1180. After the Northern Fujiwara were destroyed in 1189, Kiyoshige received wide lands in Mutsu and built his seat at Hiyoriyama in Ishinomaki.

The clan moved its headquarters to Teraike and emerged during the Nanboku-chō wars as a major regional power. In the Sengoku age it ruled several districts of central Mutsu.

Kasai Harunobu failed to join Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590 and was attainted. With his death in 1597 the house ceased to be daimyō, though a surviving line later served the Tokugawa as hereditary sewer cleaners of Edo Castle.
zh:
葛西氏是出自秩父平氏的武家，由丰岛清元之子葛西清重开创，家族本据下总国的葛西御厨。清重父子于1180年投奔源赖朝讨伐平氏。1189年奥州藤原氏灭亡后，清重在陆奥获得大片封地，并在石卷的日和山筑城为本据。

家族后来迁往寺池，在南北朝动乱中成为地方强族。战国时代，葛西氏统治陆奥中部数郡。

葛西晴信未参加丰臣秀吉1590年的小田原征伐，被追究改易。1597年晴信死后，葛西氏不再是大名，仅存的一支后来以世袭清扫江户城下水道的身份侍奉德川家。

en: Kāshī, meaning “of Kashan”, is the name given to the local house of Kashan, the oasis town of central Persia whose fine glazed tiles gave the Persian word for a tile, kashi.
zh: 卡希意为“卡尚人”，指中波斯绿洲城市卡尚的本地家族；卡尚出产精美的釉面陶砖，波斯语里的“瓷砖”一词kashi就得名于此。

en:
The Kasranids were the Persianized senior line of the Shirvanshahs, rulers of Shirvan on the western shore of the Caspian. They grew out of the Arab Yazidid family, which had ruled since Haytham ibn Khalid took the title of Shirvanshah in 861. The name came from Kasra, linked to the legendary Kai Khosrow, as the dynasty claimed the heritage of the Sasanian and Kayanian kings.

From Shamakhy they married into Georgia's Bagrationi, absorbed Derbent and survived as vassals or tributaries of successive powers. Their court hosted the Persian poets Nizami Ganjavi and Khaqani. After the earthquake of 1192 Akhsitan I moved the capital to Baku.

The last ruler, Hushang, was raised as a hostage at the Jalayirid court and ruled from 1372 until his subjects killed him in 1382. The crown passed to his cousin Ibrahim I of the Darbandid branch.
zh:
科斯兰王朝是希尔万沙王朝波斯化后的正统支系，统治里海西岸的希尔凡。它源出阿拉伯人的叶齐德家族，该家族自861年海萨姆·本·哈立德采用希尔万沙称号起统治此地。新名号中的科斯拉与传说中的凯霍斯鲁相关，王朝以萨珊和凯扬诸王的继承者自居。

他们以沙马基为都，与格鲁吉亚的巴格拉季奥尼家族联姻，吞并杰尔宾特，并作为历代强权的附庸或纳贡国存续。波斯诗人内扎米·甘贾维和哈卡尼曾在其宫廷效力。1192年地震后，阿赫西坦一世迁都巴库。

末代君主胡尚格自幼在札剌亦儿宫廷充当人质，从1372年统治至1382年被臣民所杀。王位转入其堂兄易卜拉欣一世的杰尔宾特支系。

en:
The Katoch were a Rajput clan whose name meant those within the fort, from the kot or fortress of Nagarkot, also called Kangra. Their main branch ruled Kangra and claimed lunar-dynasty descent, suffixing Chand to their names; branches founded hill states.

In 1333 Raja Prithvi Chand withstood Muhammad bin Tughlaq's invasion, and Akbar's forces besieged Kangra for ten years without taking it, until Jahangir captured the fort in 1610 and reduced the rajas to Mughal vassals. Ghamand Chand recovered the fort after 1751, and his grandson Sansar Chand (r. 1775-1823) made Kangra supreme among the hill states and a patron of the arts.

Hard pressed by a Gurkha-backed revolt in 1805, he called in Ranjit Singh; the Sikh maharaja expelled the Gurkhas but kept the fort and the valley's best lands, leaving the Katoch rajas only the villages around it.
zh:
卡托奇是拉杰普特氏族，名字意为“堡垒中人”，源自讷格尔果德，即冈格拉堡的kot（堡垒）。主支统治冈格拉，自称月族后裔，名字冠以“昌德”；支系另建了山地小邦。

1333年，罗阇普里特维·昌德击退穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克的入侵；阿克巴的军队围攻冈格拉堡十年未能破城，直到1610年贾汉吉尔才拿下堡垒，将罗阇降为莫卧儿附庸。1751年后格曼德·昌德收复堡垒，其孙桑萨尔·昌德（1775—1823年在位）使冈格拉称霸山邦，并成为艺术赞助中心。

1805年，廓尔喀支持的叛乱逼他向兰吉特·辛格求援；锡克大君赶走廓尔喀人，却留下堡垒和河谷最肥沃的土地，卡托奇罗阇只剩周围的村庄。

en:
The Kawano were a warrior clan of Iyo on Shikoku, claiming descent from the Ochi clan and holding Yuzuki Castle from the Muromachi period. During the Genpei War Michinobu Kawano joined Minamoto no Yoritomo and fought the Taira in western Japan. They backed the retired emperor Go-Toba in the Jōkyū War of 1221 and were punished, but recovered when Michiari won fame against the Mongol invasions.

In 1337 the clan head Michimori, sidelined after remaining loyal to the Kamakura shogunate, joined Ashikaga Takauji and became shugo of Iyo. His successor Michitomo died fighting the Hosokawa, with whom the clan made peace in 1386.

Plagued by succession feuds, the Kawano relied on the Murakami navy and the Mōri. Michinao surrendered during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Shikoku campaign in 1585 and died without an heir in 1587, ending the clan's rule.
zh:
河野氏是四国伊予的武士家族，自称出自越智氏，室町时代以后以汤筑城为居城。源平合战时河野通信投奔源赖朝，在西国与平氏作战。1221年承久之乱中河野氏支持后鸟羽上皇，事后受到处分；后来河野通有在元寇之战中成名，家族重振。

1337年的当主河野通盛因忠于镰仓幕府而遭冷遇，随后追随足利尊氏，成为伊予守护。继任的通朝在抵御细川氏时战死，家族直到1386年才与细川氏和解。

河野氏深受内讧困扰，依赖村上水军和毛利氏。1585年丰臣秀吉征伐四国时，河野通直投降，1587年无嗣而终，家族统治就此结束。

en:
The Kawanobe were a warrior house of northern Hitachi, based at Noguchi Castle in Kawanobe-gō. A branch of the Naka, they claimed descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato. Their ancestor Michinao is said to have built the castle around 1090; four generations later, Naka no Sukeaki made Kawanobe his seat and took its name.

In 1335 Kawanobe Sukeshige and his son Jirō fought for the Southern Court, defeated the Hitachi shugo Satake Sadayoshi at Mikanohara, and followed Kitabatake Akiie against Ashikaga Takauji. Tradition says Emperor Go-Daigo granted them the chrysanthemum crest, which they modified into a sixteen-petal chrysanthemum with the character for one.

In 1336 they were crushed at Dokushōhō with the Naka, and most killed themselves. A surviving line later submitted to the Satake and served them through the Sengoku age. After Sekigahara the Satake were transferred to Akita, but the last Kawanobe head stayed as a rōnin in Kuji District.
zh:
川野边氏是常陆北部的武家豪族，势力以川野边乡的野口城为中心。他们属那珂氏一支，自称藤原秀乡的后裔。先祖通直相传于1090年前后修筑野口城，四代之后，那珂资明以川野边为据点，始称川野边氏。

1335年，川野边资镇与儿子次郎为南朝举兵，在瓮之原击败常陆守护佐竹贞义，又随北畠显家与足利尊氏作战。相传后醍醐天皇将菊花纹赐予他们，川野边氏改成十六菊加“一”字作家纹。

1336年，他们与那珂氏一同在独松峰被击败，一族大多自尽。幸存的一支后来归降佐竹氏，整个战国时代均为其家臣。关原之战后佐竹氏被转封秋田，末代川野边当主留在久慈郡做了浪人。

en:
The Kedah dynasty rules one of the oldest polities on the Malay Peninsula, with its heartland in the Bujang Valley. Ancient Kedah Tua grew into a Hindu-Buddhist port within the orbit of Srivijaya.

The Kedah Annals trace the kings to the legendary Merong Mahawangsa and tell how Phra Ong Mahawangsa embraced Islam and became Sultan Mudzaffar Shah, traditionally dated to 1136, though scholars place the conversion nearer the fifteenth century. In 1337 the sixth sultan, Ibrahim Shah, held the throne, having moved his capital to Kota Seputih in 1323.

The dynasty kept its sultanate alive by paying tribute to stronger neighbors, including Malacca and Siam. Siamese armies overran Kedah in 1821 and exiled its sultan; a prince briefly retook Alor Setar in 1831, but Siamese rule continued for years afterward.
zh:
吉打王朝统治着马来半岛最古老的政权之一，以布央谷为核心。古老的吉打陀发展为印度教—佛教商港，处于室利佛逝的势力范围。

《吉打纪年》把历代君王追溯到传奇英雄梅隆·摩诃旺萨，并讲述帕·翁·摩诃旺萨皈依伊斯兰教、改名穆扎法尔沙的故事，传统上系于1136年，但学者认为皈依更可能发生在15世纪。1337年在位的是第六任苏丹易卜拉欣沙，他已于1323年迁都哥打昔布迪。

王朝向马六甲、暹罗等强邻纳贡，维系苏丹国。1821年暹罗大军攻陷吉打，苏丹流亡；1831年虽有王子一度收复亚罗士打，但暹罗统治在此后多年间仍未被推翻。

en:
The Keita dynasty ruled the Mandinka kingdom and later the Mali Empire from Niani on the upper Niger, from the eleventh century into the early seventeenth.

The first documented ruler was Sundiata Keita, who united the Mandinka, defeated Soumaoro Kante of Sosso at Kirina around 1235 and gave the federation the Kouroukan Fouga constitution; from his reign Keita became the ruling clan's name. His great-nephew Mansa Musa's pilgrimage to Mecca in 1324 to 1326 made Mali famous, his gold spending upsetting prices in Egypt.

In 1337 the throne passed to Maghan I and then his uncle Suleyman, whose court Ibn Battuta visited in 1352. Defeat outside Djenne in 1599 broke Mali's power, and after the empire's collapse around 1610 the Keitas withdrew to Kangaba as provincial chiefs.
zh:
凯塔王朝自11世纪至17世纪初，以尼日尔河上游的尼亚尼为中心，统治曼丁戈人的王国及后来的马里帝国。

第一位有文献记载的统治者松迪亚塔·凯塔联合曼丁戈各部，约在1235年的基里纳战役中击败苏苏王国的苏曼古鲁·坎特，并以《库鲁坎·富加》作为联邦根本大法，凯塔从他在位时成为统治家族的族名。他的侄孙曼萨·穆萨于1324至1326年赴麦加朝觐，挥霍黄金扰乱了埃及物价，使马里闻名。

1337年王位传给马汉一世及其叔苏莱曼，伊本·白图泰于1352年访问苏莱曼的宫廷。1599年杰内城外的惨败摧毁了马里的实力；1610年前后帝国瓦解，凯塔家族退回康加巴，成为地方酋长。

en:
The Kengtung dynasty was the saopha house of Kengtung, also called Menggen, the eastern Shan state between the Salween and the Mekong. The line was founded around 1243 by the Tai prince Mang Kun; later tradition presents him and his kinsman Mang Kyin as governors sent by King Mangrai. Before the Tai arrival the country had been Wa land, known in chronicle tradition as Khemarattha.

Its saophas generally sent tribute of gold flowers to the Burmese kings, and in 1405 the Ming enrolled the state as a native tusi office under the name Menggen.

The house kept its autonomy through the wars of the sixteenth to eighteenth centuries: in 1760 rival Qing and Burmese claims over Kengtung helped bring on war, and after a period under Chiang Mai from 1802 the dynasty was restored in 1814 with Burmese aid.
zh:
景栋王朝是萨尔温江与湄公河之间的掸族大邦景栋（又称孟艮）的诏法世家。约1243年，泰族王子芒昆建立这一王统；后世传说他与族人芒京都是芒莱王派来的镇守官。在泰人到来之前，当地居民以佤族为主，纪年传说称其古国为凯玛拉塔。

历代诏法通常向缅甸诸王进献金花为礼；1405年明朝将其封为土司，置孟艮府。

该家族在16至18世纪的战乱中维持自治：1760年清朝与缅甸对景栋归属的争议促成战争，1802年景栋一度被清迈吞并，1814年又在缅甸帮助下恢复旧王朝。

en:
