Bahram Khan, also called Tatar Khan, was a military commander of the Delhi Sultanate and the only holder of this short-lived governor's house. Tradition holds that he was born near Multan and adopted as an infant by Sultan Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq.

He served as governor of Satgaon from 1324 and was appointed governor of Sonargaon in East Bengal in 1328, and the legal compendium Fatwa-i-Tatarkhani was compiled at his initiative. On his death in 1337 his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah seized Sonargaon and declared himself its independent sultan, so the governorship never passed to Bahram Khan's heirs.
zh:
巴赫拉姆汗又名塔塔尔汗，是德里苏丹国的将领，也是这个短命总督家族仅有的掌权者。相传他出生于木尔坦附近，尚在襁褓中便被苏丹吉亚斯丁·图格鲁克收养。

他自1324年起担任萨特冈总督，1328年又被任命为东孟加拉索纳尔冈总督，法学汇编《塔塔尔汗教法意见》即在他主持下编成。1337年他去世后，军械官法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙夺取索纳尔冈，自立为独立苏丹，总督之位因此没有传给巴赫拉姆汗的后人。

en:
Qadar Khan, born Pindar Khilji and also called Bedar Khilji, was a Khalji noble who served Nasiruddin Ibrahim Shah, the tributary ruler of Lakhnauti installed by Delhi after the conquest of Bengal in 1324. Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq later appointed him governor of Lakhnauti at Gaur.

When Bahram Khan of Sonargaon died in 1337 and his armour-bearer Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah declared independence, Qadar Khan defeated him and occupied Sonargaon. His soldiers then quarrelled over the plunder, and Fakhruddin lured them into an ambush in which Qadar Khan was captured and executed. The war minister he left at Lakhnauti, Alauddin Ali Shah, killed the deputy governor and made himself ruler of the city in 1339.
zh:
卡达尔汗本名平达尔·卡尔吉，又作贝达尔·卡尔吉，是卡尔吉贵族，侍奉1324年孟加拉被征服后德里所立的拉克瑙提附庸君主纳西尔丁·易卜拉欣沙。苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克后来任命他为驻高达的拉克瑙提总督。

1337年索纳尔冈的巴赫拉姆汗去世，其军械官法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙宣布独立，卡达尔汗击败他并占领索纳尔冈。随后他的士兵为争夺战利品内讧，法赫尔丁诱使他们中伏，卡达尔汗被俘处死。他留在拉克瑙提的军政官阿拉丁·阿里沙杀死副总督，于1339年自立为该城之主。

en:
The Kherla dynasty took its name from its hill fortress of Kherla in the Satpura range, seat of the earliest kingdom of Gondwana and one of its four ancient Gond realms. An earlier Rajput line held the fort; its ruler Jaitpal was succeeded by Narsingh Rai, the first Gond king of Kherla and the first ruler said to have unified the Gond.

By 1398 Narsingh Rai's power reached west to the hills north of Berar, including the fortress of Gawilghur. Defeated by Firuz Shah of the Bahmani Sultanate, he submitted at Ellichpur, gave his daughter in marriage and ruled on as a Bahmani vassal.

That alliance drew the hostility of Hoshang Shah of Malwa, whose campaigns ended in 1433 with Narsingh Rai slain in battle and Kherla, together with Betul, incorporated into the Malwa Sultanate.
zh:
克尔拉王朝得名于萨德布尔山脉中依山而建的凯尔拉堡，这里是冈瓦纳最早的王国，也是冈瓦纳四大冈德古国之一。更早的拉杰普特世系曾据有此堡，其罗阇贾特帕尔之后，纳尔辛格·拉伊继位，成为凯尔拉第一位冈德人国王，也被认为是最早统一冈德人的君主。

到1398年，纳尔辛格·拉伊的势力向西抵达贝拉尔以北的山地，包括加维尔加尔堡。他被巴赫曼尼苏丹国的菲鲁兹沙击败，在埃利奇布尔投降，嫁女和亲，以巴赫曼尼附庸身份继续统治。

这层盟约招来马尔瓦的霍尚沙进攻，1433年纳尔辛格·拉伊战死，凯尔拉连同贝图尔被并入马尔瓦苏丹国。

en:
The Khön were a Tibetan noble clan seated at Sakya in Tsang, whose members supplied the hereditary head of the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism. Clansmen held office under the Tibetan Empire, and in 1073 Khön Könchok Gyalpo founded Sakya Monastery.

Under the Mongol Yuan dynasty the clan governed Tibet: Drogön Chögyal Phagpa, tutor of Kublai Khan, was named imperial preceptor, and his kinsmen kept the office, ruling through Sakya-appointed administrators. Zangpo Pal, the last strong head, died in 1323; his sons split the inheritance in 1323 and 1324 into four branches, weakening Sakya.

In 1354 Tai Situ Changchub Gyaltsen of Phagmodrupa overthrew the Sakya administration and ended the clan's political power. The Khön retained their monastic leadership and later gave rise to the Ngor and Tshar sub-schools.
zh:
孔氏是世居后藏萨迦的吐蕃贵族家族，藏传佛教萨迦派的历代座主均出自该家族。吐蕃帝国时期，孔氏族人已在朝中任职；1073年，孔·贡却杰布创建萨迦寺。

蒙古元朝时期，孔氏统治西藏：八思巴出任忽必烈汗的帝师，此后帝师一职多由孔氏成员担任，西藏政务由萨迦任命的本钦掌管。1323年最后一位强势座主桑波贝去世，他的儿子们于1323至1324年间分成四个拉章，萨迦的势力由此衰弱。

1354年，帕木竹巴的绛曲坚赞推翻萨迦政权，结束了孔氏的世俗统治。家族仍保有萨迦派座主之位，后来又衍生出俄尔、察尔等支派。

en:
The Khorshidi were a Lur dynasty of the Salburi clan who ruled Little Lorestan from Khorramabad between about 1184 and 1597. Their founder Shoja al-Din Khorshid, from whom the family took its name, inherited the lands of the Turkic lord Husamuddin Shuhli and made himself independent of the caliphal governors.

As atabegs they weathered the Mongol Ilkhanate, but Timur's invasion of 1386 devastated the province: the fortress of Khorramabad was razed and the ruler Izz al-Din deported to Turkestan before being released. The family recovered after Timur's death, and Shah Rostam backed Ismail I when the Safavids rose to power.

Caught between the Safavids and the Ottomans, the last chief Shahverdi twice rebelled against Shah Abbas I, who had him killed at Changuleh in 1597 and partitioned Little Lorestan. A collateral line continued to govern it as Safavid governors.
zh:
霍什迪王朝是出自萨尔布里氏族的卢尔人王朝，约1184年至1597年间以霍拉马巴德为中心统治小卢尔斯坦。始祖舒贾丁·胡尔希德接掌突厥领主侯萨姆丁·舒赫利的领地，摆脱哈里发所派总督而独立，王朝得名于他。

他们以阿塔贝格身份撑过了蒙古伊儿汗国时期，但1386年帖木儿入侵使此地遭兵燹：霍拉马巴德城堡被夷平，首领伊兹丁被流放突厥斯坦，后来才获释。帖木儿死后家族复兴，沙阿·罗斯塔姆在萨法维王朝兴起时支持伊斯玛仪一世。

末代首领沙韦尔迪夹在萨法维与奥斯曼之间，两次反叛阿拔斯一世，于1597年在昌古莱被杀，小卢尔斯坦遭分割。其旁支仍以萨法维总督的身份继续治理此地。

en:
The Kun Lo dynasty was the royal house of Muang Sua, on the site of later Luang Prabang. It traced its line to Khun Lo, the legendary first Lao king, said to have seized Muang Sua and died in 780.

In the fourteenth century Phraya Khamphong ruled Muang Sua. His son Phi Fa was exiled to the Khmer court, where his son Fa Ngum was born around 1316 and raised. With Khmer troops, Fa Ngum conquered the Lao mueangs and in 1353 founded Lan Xang Hom Khao, the Land of a Million Elephants and the White Parasol. He made Theravada Buddhism the state faith and the Phra Bang image the kingdom's palladium.

Driven out in 1372, Fa Ngum was succeeded by his son Samsenethai, who secured Ming recognition in 1402. The house ruled Lan Xang until its partition into Luang Prabang, Vientiane and Champasak in 1707.
zh:
坤洛王朝是老挝城邦勐苏瓦的王室，勐苏瓦位于后来的琅勃拉邦一带。其世系上溯至传说中的第一位老挝王坤洛，相传他夺取勐苏瓦，于780年去世。

14世纪，披耶坎蓬统治勐苏瓦，其子陶披法被逐至高棉宫廷，陶披法之子法昂约于1316年出生并在高棉长大。法昂凭高棉兵马征服诸老挝城邦，于1353年建立澜沧洪考王国，意为百万大象与白伞之地。他把上座部佛教立为国教，以帕邦佛为护国之宝。

1372年法昂被驱逐，其子桑森泰继位，并于1402年得到明朝册封。该家族统治澜沧直至1707年王国分裂为琅勃拉邦、万象和占巴塞三国。

en:
Ah Kʼicheʼ meant a lord of the Kʼicheʼ, the Maya people of the Guatemalan highlands, whose dynasty ruled from fortified capitals. Around 1200 their forefathers came from the Gulf coast with the worship of Tohil, conquered the highland valley and settled at Jakawitz.

They moved to Pismachi, where the rulers Kʼoqaib and Kʼonache built a ritual centre. Around 1400 Qʼuqʼumatz founded Qʼumarkaj; under his son Kʼiqʼab the kingdom subdued the Tzʼutujil and Kaqchikel. A rebellion in 1470 drove the Kaqchikel away to found Iximche, and Kʼiqʼab's death in 1475 began a decline.

After accepting Aztec overlordship in 1510, the Kʼicheʼ fell to Pedro de Alvarado in 1524. The war leader Tecún Umán died at Xelajú, captured lords were burned and Qʼumarkaj was razed; Kʼicheʼ history was preserved in the Popol Vuh.
zh:
阿基切意为基切人的首领。基切人是危地马拉高地的玛雅族群，其王朝以要塞城市为都。约1200年，基切先祖从墨西哥湾沿岸带着托希尔信仰攻入高地山谷，在哈卡维茨定居。

他们随后迁往皮斯马奇，统治者科凯布和科纳切在此建起祭祀中心。约1400年，库库马茨建立库马尔卡赫；其子基卡布在位时，王国征服特苏图希尔和卡克奇克尔。1470年叛乱，卡克奇克尔人出走并建立伊希姆切；1475年基卡布死后，国势衰落。

1510年基切人接受阿兹特克宗主权，1524年败于佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多。军事首领特昆·乌曼战死在谢拉胡，被俘的贵族被烧死，库马尔卡赫被夷为平地；基切人的历史保存在《波波尔·乌》之中。

en:
The Kii, also called the Buzen-Utsunomiya, were a branch of the Utsunomiya of Shimotsuke who became landowners in Kii village of Buzen. The line began when Nakahara Munehusa, second son of the Utsunomiya ancestor Fujiwara no Sōen, took up a steward post there in the Kamakura period. Under Utsunomiya Nobufusa the clan built Kiidani Castle and reached its height.

From the seventh head, Fuyutsuna, in the Nanboku-chō wars the house declined, and served the Ōuchi and then the Ōtomo. Shigefusa Kii joined the Shimazu but submitted after Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign of 1587. Ordered to Iyo, he refused and held Kiidani against Kuroda Yoshitaka and his son Nagamasa, making peace after a starvation siege and giving his daughter Tsuruhime as hostage.

In 1588 Nagamasa murdered Shigefusa at a banquet in Nakatsu Castle; his heir Asafusa was killed and Tsuruhime crucified with thirteen ladies-in-waiting. Former retainers rose again in 1600 but were defeated at Ishigakihara.
zh:
城井氏又称丰前宇都宫氏，是下野宇都宫氏的分流，成为丰前城井乡的领主。镰仓时代，宇都宫始祖藤原宗圆的次子中原宗房以地头身份赴任城井乡，是为家族之始；宇都宮信房修筑城井谷城时，家族达到鼎盛。

南北朝时代第七代当主冬纲以后，家族衰落，先后依附大内氏和大友氏。城井镇房投向岛津氏，1587年丰臣秀吉九州征伐后归顺。受命转封伊予时，他拒绝离开，据守城井谷城对抗黑田孝高、长政父子，最后因兵粮攻议和，以女儿鹤姬为人质。

1588年，长政在中津城酒宴上谋杀镇房，嫡子朝房遇害，鹤姬被处磔刑，与十三名侍女一同死去。1600年城井旧臣再起，又在石垣原之战中败北。

en:
The Kikkawa were a samurai clan tracing descent from the Fujiwara through the Irie and Kudō families. They took their name from Kikkawa in Suruga Province and submitted to Minamoto no Yoritomo under the Kamakura shogunate.

After the Jōkyū War of 1221 the clan became steward of the Ōasa estate in Aki, where the main line settled in 1313. The Kikkawa later served the Ōuchi and the Amago. In 1550 Kikkawa Okitsune was destroyed through a plot by Mōri Motonari, who placed his son Motoharu into the family as heir.

With the Kobayakawa, the Kikkawa became one of the Two Rivers upholding Mōri power. Motoharu led troops in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyūshū campaign; his son Hiroie fought at Ulsan and issued a house code of 188 clauses. Under the Tokugawa the family ruled Iwakuni Domain into the nineteenth century.
zh:
吉川氏是日本武家，自称出自藤原氏，经入江氏、工藤氏一脉相传。一族以骏河国的吉川为姓，并在镰仓幕府时期臣从源赖朝。

1221年承久之乱后，吉川氏被补任为安艺国大朝庄地头，宗家于1313年定居安艺。此后吉川氏先后从属于大内氏和尼子氏。1550年，当主吉川兴经在毛利元就的谋划下遇害，元就之子元春入继吉川家。

吉川氏与小早川氏并称毛利两川，共同辅佐毛利宗家。元春参加丰臣秀吉的九州征伐，其子广家参加蔚山之战，并制定188条家法。江户时代，吉川氏作为岩国藩主家延续至19世纪。

en:
The Kikuchi were a great warrior house of Kyushu, ruling Kikuchi district in Higo Province from the late eleventh century. Founder Noritaka, a Dazaifu official claiming Fujiwara descent, retired there in 1071 and built the castle town from which the family took its name. Its men helped repel the Toi raiders of 1019, and Takefusa won fame against the Mongol landings of 1274 and 1281.

In the Genpei War the sixth head Takanao backed Minamoto no Yoritomo and was executed after Dan-no-ura in 1185. In 1333 Taketoki attacked the Hōjō at Hakata on Emperor Go-Daigo's secret orders, but was betrayed by the Ōtomo and Shōni and beheaded; his sons Takeshige and Takemitsu fought on for the Southern Court, losing at Tatarahama in 1336 but crushing the Shōni at Ōboharu in 1359.

Hard pressed by shogunate general Imagawa Sadayo, the house declined; its Sengoku succession crises ended as the Ōtomo of Bungo absorbed Higo and Ōtomo Sōrin destroyed the last Kikuchi lord in 1554.
zh:
菊池氏是九州的大武士家族，11世纪末起领有肥后国菊池郡。家祖则隆原为大宰府官吏，自称藤原氏后裔，1071年退隐当地并修筑城下町，遂以地名为苗字。族人参与击退1019年的刀伊入寇，菊池武房更在1274年和1281年抵御蒙古登陆的战斗中成为名将。

源平合战时，第六代家督隆直支持源赖朝，1185年坛之浦之战后被处死。1333年，武时奉后醍醐天皇密旨袭击博多的北条氏，却因大友、少贰背叛而被斩首；其子武重、武光继续为南朝奋战，1336年在多多良滨战败，1359年在大保原之战大破少贰军。

在幕府将领今川贞世的压力下，菊池家此后渐衰；战国继嗣纷争中，肥后被丰后的大友氏吞并，大友宗麟于1554年攻灭末代菊池家督。

en:
The Kimotsuki were a warrior house of Osumi Province in southern Kyushu, descended from the Tomo lineage. In the Heian period Tomo no Kaneyuki went to Satsuma as an official; his descendants held office in Kimotsuki district, whose name Kanetoshi adopted as his surname.

The Kimotsuki fought for the Southern Court and later served the Shimazu. In the Sengoku period, the head Kanetsugu allied with the Ito, defeated the Shimazu at Takeharayama and seized Shibushi, but a counter-offensive drove him to suicide in 1566.

His successor Kanesuke was deposed in 1573 by pro-Shimazu retainers and his stepmother Onan. Kanemori was installed in his place and submitted to the Shimazu in 1574; the family's lands were confiscated in 1581, and it continued as Shimazu retainers. Kanemori died at Sekigahara in 1600, while a junior line held Kiire through the Edo period and produced Komatsu Tatewaki.
zh:
肝付氏是九州南部大隅国的武家，本姓伴氏。平安时代，伴兼行赴任萨摩，其后代在肝属郡任职，兼俊取郡名为苗字，称肝付氏。

肝付氏追随南朝作战，后来臣服于岛津氏。战国时代，当主兼续与伊东氏结盟，在竹原山之战击败岛津氏，又夺取志布志，直到1566年在岛津反攻中被迫自尽。

后继的兼亮于1573年被亲岛津派家臣和义母御南废黜。被拥立的兼护于1574年向岛津称臣，1581年领地被没收，家族以岛津家臣身份存续。兼护于1600年关原之战中战死，其庶流在江户时代领有喜入，小松带刀即出自该支流。

en:
The Kira were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house, part of the Seiwa Genji line of the Minamoto descended from Emperor Seiwa. In the Kamakura period a son of Ashikaga Yoshiuji took the name from the Kira estate in Mikawa Province, and a younger son founded the Oshu, later Musashi, Kira line.

Kira Sadayoshi backed Ashikaga Takauji against the Kamakura shogunate's Rokuhara deputies in 1333, and his son Mitsuyoshi held office in the Muromachi shogunate. The Mikawa Kira ranked first among the Ashikaga Gosanke and split into the Saijo and Tojo branches during the Nanboku-cho wars.

The Saijo joined the Mikawa Ikko-ikki rising and were destroyed, while the Tojo and Oshu Kira became hatamoto. Kira Yoshinaka's attack by the Ako ronin in 1703 became the story of Chushingura; surviving Kira houses remained hatamoto into the nineteenth century.
zh:
吉良氏是足利氏的分家，足利氏出自清和天皇后裔清和源氏一脉。镰仓时代，足利义氏之子以三河国吉良庄为苗字，其弟另立奥州吉良家，即后来的武藏吉良家。

吉良贞义支持足利尊氏，在1333年攻打镰仓幕府的六波罗探题，其子满义在室町幕府任职。三河吉良位列足利御三家之首，南北朝时期分为西条与东条两支。

西条吉良参加三河一向一揆后灭亡，东条吉良与奥州吉良则成为旗本。1703年吉良义央遭赤穗浪人袭击，成为《忠臣藏》的故事原型；幸存的吉良各家以旗本身份延续至19世纪。

en:
The rajas of Kishtwar ruled the upper Chenab valley in the Punjab Hills. The twelfth-century chronicler Kalhana knew their fortress-town as Kashthavata in the Rajatarangini; its ruler Uttamaraja visited the court of the Kashmir raja Kalsa (r. 1063-1089).

Around 1664 the Iraqi Sufi Farid-ud-Din Baghdadi settled in Kishtwar and propagated Islam. Under his influence Raja Kirat Singh accepted the faith and took the name Tegh Muhammad Singh, opening the Muslim phase of the Hindu dynasty. In 1821 Gulab Singh of Jammu annexed Kishtwar for the Sikh Empire and carried its raja to Lahore, where he died in prison.
zh:
吉什德瓦尔的罗阇统治着旁遮普山丘的杰纳布河上游谷地。12世纪史学家卡尔哈纳在《罗阇塔兰吉尼》中称这座堡垒城镇为卡什塔瓦塔，其君主乌塔马拉贾曾入朝觐见克什米尔罗阇卡尔萨（1063—1089年在位）。

伊拉克苏菲法里德丁·巴格达迪约于1664年定居吉什德瓦尔并传播伊斯兰教。罗阇基拉特·辛格在其影响下改宗，取名泰格·穆罕默德·辛格，印度教王朝由此进入穆斯林统治时期。1821年，查谟的古拉卜·辛格为锡克帝国吞并吉什德瓦尔，将罗阇押往拉合尔，后者死于狱中。

en:
The Kitabatake were a house of court nobles and warriors descended from the Murakami Genji through the Nakanoin lineage. They took their name from an estate in northern Kyoto where their ancestor Masaie settled. Close to the Daikakuji line of emperors, they rose through Kitabatake Chikafusa, a pillar of Emperor Go-Daigo's Kenmu Restoration.

After the Southern Court withdrew to Yoshino, Chikafusa became its military and political leader and wrote the Jinno Shotoki, arguing its legitimacy. His son Akiie repeatedly marched from Mutsu against the Ashikaga until he was killed in 1338.

A branch ruled southern Ise as provincial governors and became Sengoku daimyo. In 1569 Oda Nobunaga's invasion forced the family to adopt his son Nobukatsu as heir. In 1576 the retired lord Tomonori and much of the clan were assassinated in the Mitsuse Incident, extinguishing the Ise Kitabatake.
zh:
北畠家是兼具公家与武家身份的世家，出身村上源氏中院家的庶流，因先祖雅家迁居京都北部的北畠而得名。北畠家与大觉寺统的天皇关系密切，凭借后醍醐天皇建武新政的支柱北畠亲房崭露头角。

南朝退守吉野后，亲房成为其军事与政治核心，并写下论证南朝正统的《神皇正统记》。其子显家屡次自陆奥南下讨伐足利氏，最终于1338年战死。

一族支系以南伊势为根据地担任国司，演变为战国大名。1569年织田信长入侵，迫使北畠家收其子信雄为养子。1576年隐居的当主具教及大批族人在三濑之变中遭暗杀，伊势北畠氏就此灭亡。

en:
The first comital house of Cleves sprang from the Lower Rhine nobility. Around 1020 Emperor Henry II enfeoffed the brothers Gerhard and Rutger Flamens; Gerhard founded the Guelders line, while Rutger's descendants became counts of Cleves, first styling themselves after Kleve Castle in 1092. Their seat was the Schwanenburg, and later legend traced the family to a swan knight.

The county grew between Cleves and Kalkar; its counts founded the collegiate churches of Wissel and Bedburg. In 1283 Cleves joined the War of the Limburg Succession against Cologne, gaining Zevenaar from Guelders in 1355.

When Count John died without a male heir in 1368, the county passed to his nephew Adolf III of the Marck. From 1391 Cleves and the Marck were ruled in personal union by the House of La Marck, whose head became Duke of Cleves in 1417.
zh:
第一代克莱沃伯爵世家出自下莱茵贵族。约1020年，皇帝亨利二世把领地封给格拉尔德与鲁特格尔·弗拉门斯兄弟，格拉尔德开创海尔德兰一系，鲁特格尔的后裔成为克莱沃伯爵，于1092年首次以克莱沃城堡为号。他们的治所是天鹅堡，后世传说将家族祖先附会为天鹅骑士。

伯国以克莱沃与卡尔卡尔之间的土地为核心扩张，伯爵们建立了维瑟尔和贝德堡修士会。1283年，克莱沃参加林堡继承战争对抗科隆，1355年从海尔德兰取得泽芬纳尔。

1368年伯爵约翰无男嗣而终，伯国传给外甥马克的阿道夫三世。1391年起克莱沃与马克由拉马克家族联合统治，其家主于1417年升为克莱沃公爵。

en:
The Kobayakawa took their name from Kobayakawa gō in Sagami Province, where local lords of that name appeared in the Nara period. The warrior house was founded in the Kamakura period by Kobayakawa Tohira, son of Dohi Sanehira. It gained the stewardship of Numata manor in Aki; sons of the third head Shigehira founded the Numata and Takehara branches.

Mōri Motonari placed his son Takakage into the Numata headship. With the Kikkawa, the house became one of the Two Rivers of the Mōri. Takakage served Toyotomi Hideyoshi as one of the Five Elders and received Chikuzen after the Kyūshū campaign of 1587.

Takakage died in 1597 and was succeeded by Hideaki, Hideyoshi's nephew. At Sekigahara in 1600 Hideaki's switch to the Tokugawa side helped decide the battle, but he died heirless in 1602 and the house was attainted.
zh:
小早川氏得名于相模国小早川乡，奈良时代当地已有同名豪族。武家小早川氏由土肥实平之子远平在镰仓时代开创，获得安艺国沼田庄地头职，第三代当主茂平的儿子后来分出沼田与竹原两支。

毛利元就把儿子隆景送入沼田家继承家督，小早川氏与吉川氏并称毛利两川。隆景辅佐丰臣秀吉，位列五大老，1587年九州征伐后受封筑前国。

隆景于1597年去世，秀吉的外甥秀秋继承家督。1600年关原之战中，秀秋倒戈德川一方，促成胜局，但他在1602年无嗣而终，小早川家遭到除封。

en:
The Komnenos Asen family sprang from the Bulgarian nobility. John Komnenos Asen was a son of Sratsimir, despot of Kran, and Keratsa Petritsa, a descendant of the Asen tsars, and a brother of Tsar Ivan Alexander and Helena, wife of the Serbian ruler Stephen Dušan.

Around 1345, after Dušan's conquest of southern Albania, John was granted the title of despot and put in charge of Valona, Kanina and Berat. He adopted the Byzantine surname Komnenos and married Anna Palaiologina, widow of the Epirote ruler John II Orsini.

After Dušan died in 1355 he ruled Valona as an effectively independent lord, growing rich on Adriatic trade, until he died of the plague in 1363. His likely son Alexander succeeded him and ruled until about 1371; after his death Valona and Kanina passed to Balsha II through marriage.
zh:
科穆宁·阿森家族出身于保加利亚贵族。约翰·科穆宁·阿森是克兰专制公斯拉齐米尔与阿森王朝后裔克拉察·佩特里察之子，也是沙皇伊凡·亚历山大和塞尔维亚统治者斯特凡·杜尚之妻海伦娜的兄弟。

约1345年杜尚征服阿尔巴尼亚南部后，约翰获封专制公，受命管辖发罗拉、卡尼纳和培拉特。他改用拜占庭姓氏科穆宁，娶伊庇鲁斯统治者约翰二世·奥尔西尼的遗孀安娜·巴列奥略为妻。

1355年杜尚死后，他作为事实上独立的领主统治发罗拉，靠亚得里亚海贸易致富，直至1363年死于瘟疫。继位者可能是他的儿子亚历山大，统治到约1371年；亚历山大死后，发罗拉和卡尼纳随婚姻转入巴尔沙二世之手。

en:
The Komnenos were a Byzantine military aristocracy, traditionally traced to Komne village in Thrace; their first known member Manuel Erotikos built estates at Kastamon. Isaac I seized the throne in 1057 but abdicated two years later; the family's great age began when his nephew Alexios I became emperor in 1081 after Manzikert.

Alexios, his son John II and his grandson Manuel I, who reigned until 1180, rebuilt imperial power against Normans and Turks, until Manuel's defeat at Myriokephalon in 1176 checked the recovery. Andronikos I, emperor from 1183, was killed in 1185 and the Angeloi took Constantinople; Isaac Komnenos's Cyprus regime fell to Richard I in 1191.

Before the Fourth Crusade sacked Constantinople in 1204, Alexios and David, grandsons of Andronikos I, founded the Empire of Trebizond on the Black Sea. Its Grand Komnenoi outlasted the other Byzantine successor states: Basil held the throne in 1337, from 1332; the empire fell to Mehmed II after a month's siege in 1461. Last emperor David and his family were executed in 1463.
zh:
科穆宁家族是拜占庭的军事贵族，传统上溯源于色雷斯的科姆内村；已知最早的成员曼努埃尔·厄洛提科斯在卡斯塔莫农积累地产。伊萨克一世1057年夺取皇位，两年后退位；辉煌时代始于侄子阿历克塞一世1081年在曼齐刻尔特惨败后登基。

阿历克塞、其子约翰二世和统治至1180年的孙子曼努埃尔一世重振帝国，抗击诺曼人与突厥人，但1176年曼努埃尔在密列奥塞法隆的失利遏制了复兴。1183年登位的安德洛尼卡一世1185年被杀，安格洛斯家族入主君士坦丁堡；伊萨克·科穆宁在塞浦路斯的割据政权也于1191年被理查一世攻灭。

1204年第四次十字军洗劫君士坦丁堡前夕，安德洛尼卡一世的两个孙子阿历克塞和大卫于黑海之滨建立特拉布宗帝国。其君主自称“大科穆宁”，国祚长于其他拜占庭继承国：1337年在位的是1332年登基的瓦西里，帝国直到1461年才在一月围攻后被穆罕默德二世攻灭。末代皇帝大卫及其家人于1463年被处死。

en:
The Koto were local warrior magnates of Nagato Province, originally surnamed Mononobe; their genealogy claimed seventh-century magnate Mononobe no Moriya, and early head Taketada settled at Tanai in Asa district. In the Genpei War they first fought for the Taira and then changed sides, earning Koto district at Dannoura; on shogunate orders they later campaigned beside the Ouchi against the Mongol landings of 1274 and 1281.

Takezane broke with the Hojo deputy in the Genko War and was rewarded in 1334 with the constableship of Nagato, held by his son Takemura and two successors. The Kannō Disturbance split the house between the courts, and the Ouchi on the Southern side overran Nagato: in 1358 Yoshitake abandoned Shimofuri Castle and lost Chofu, and though Kikuchi Takemitsu's aid won a truce and brief return to Shimofuri, the Koto then vanish from the records, marking the house's presumed end.

In 1362 Ouchi Hiroyo became constable of Nagato, and only the cadet Akiyoshi branch kept the name alive as retainers.
zh:
厚东氏是长门国的在地豪族，本姓物部，系谱自称祖先是7世纪的大连物部守屋；早期当主武忠在棚井筑馆定居。源平合战时，他们先随平氏作战，后倒向源氏，凭坛之浦之战的军功受封厚东郡；1274年和1281年元军来袭时，奉幕府之命与大内氏一同出阵。

元弘之乱时，厚东武实背离长门探题北条氏，1334年受封长门守护，其子武村与两位后继当主连任。观应之扰乱使厚东一家在南北朝之间分裂，站队南朝的大内氏进攻长门：1358年义武放弃霜降城并丢失长府，虽靠菊池武光援救一度议和复位，此后却再无音讯，被视为厚东氏灭亡之时。

1362年，大内弘世就任长门守护，只有庶流秋吉氏作为家臣延续家名。

en:
The Kotromanić were the ruling dynasty of medieval Bosnia. Their first reliably attested member, Prijezda I, was a Hungarian vassal who became Ban of Bosnia around 1250, holding little beyond the valley of the river Bosna.

The family's fortunes rose under Stephen II, who defeated the Dalmatian Šubić family in 1322 and doubled Bosnia's territory from the Sava to the Adriatic coast. His nephew Tvrtko I succeeded in 1353, conquered lands from the Serbian Empire in 1373 and was crowned king of Bosnia and Serbia in 1377, claiming the legacy of the extinct Nemanjić dynasty.

After Tvrtko's death in 1391 the realm weakened. The last sovereign, Stephen Tomašević, briefly ruled as Despot of Serbia in 1459 and as King of Bosnia from 1461 until the Ottoman conquest of 1463 ended the dynasty's rule.
zh:
科特罗马尼奇王朝是中世纪波斯尼亚的统治家族。第一位可确考的成员普里耶兹达一世是匈牙利的附庸，约1250年成为波斯尼亚巴恩，当时其势力几乎不出博斯纳河流域。

家族在斯特凡二世治下发迹：他于1322年击败达尔马提亚的舒比奇家族，把波斯尼亚领土扩大一倍，疆域从萨瓦河一直延伸到亚得里亚海。其侄特维科一世于1353年继位，1373年从塞尔维亚帝国夺取土地，1377年加冕为波斯尼亚兼塞尔维亚国王，宣称继承已绝嗣的内马尼奇王朝遗产。

1391年特维科死后，国家走向衰弱。末代君主斯特凡·托马舍维奇曾于1459年短暂出任塞尔维亚专制公，1461年起任波斯尼亚国王，1463年奥斯曼征服终结了该王朝的政权。

en:
The Kō were a samurai clan of the Ashikaga estate in Shimotsuke, claiming Takashina descent and serving the Ashikaga as hereditary stewards since Kamakura times. Their heyday came under Moronao, Ashikaga Takauji's steward: he sat on the Kenmu board of claims as Takauji's deputy, and under Muromachi he and his brother Moroyasu held highest office, their armies killing Kitabatake Akiie and Kusunoki Masatsura and pressing the Yoshino court to the edge of destruction.

His arrogance pitted him against Takauji's brother Tadayoshi, sparking the Kannō Disturbance of 1350. He briefly ousted Tadayoshi, who then joined the Southern Court and routed him at Uchidehama; after surrendering, the brothers were cut down with most of the clan by Uesugi Yoshinori's men at the Mukō River, and Kanto leader Morofuyu killed himself.

Survivors who sided with Tadayoshi kept the name: Moroari briefly held Kanto Kanrei and Morohide became Constable of Yamashiro and Sado. The Kō later served the Kamakura and Koga Kubō and as shogunal guardsmen, one of them dying beside Ashikaga Yoshiteru in 1565.
zh:
高氏是下野国足利庄的武家，自称源自高阶氏，自镰仓时代起世代任足利氏执事。鼎盛在高师直一代：师直作为尊氏执事，在建武新政中以尊氏代理身份位列杂诉决断所；室町幕府后，他与弟弟师泰占据要职，军队讨杀北畠显家、楠木正行，把吉野南朝逼到崩溃边缘。

师直骄横，与尊氏之弟直义对立，酿成1350年观应之乱。他一度逼直义失势，直义转投南朝反攻，在打出滨将其击溃；师直、师泰投降后在押送途中于武库川被上杉能宪部下杀害，一族大半覆灭，关东师冬也自尽。

直义一方的幸存者延续家名：师有短期出任关东管领，师英历任山城、佐渡守护。此后高氏侍奉镰仓、古河公方，后来还充任将军奉公众，其中一人于1565年随足利义辉战死。

en:
The Kosaka, also written with the characters for Takasaka, were a Shinano warrior house of the Shigeno clan, descended from Sadayuki of the Nezu family; their name came from Kosaka in Saku district. The first head Munekiyo is thought to have become a newly appointed jito after the Jokyu War of 1221; the family acquired its seat at Makinoshima around 1260.

In 1336 the sixth head Shinkaku raised the Southern Court banner at Maki Castle alongside remnants of the Hojo. The rising was put down, though the castle held.

During the Takeda conquest of Shinano Munishige submitted to Takeda Shingen, but was executed at Kaizu Castle in 1561 on suspicion of dealing with the Uesugi, ending the direct line. Kasuga Toratsuna, who married a Kosaka daughter, inherited the name as Kosaka Masanobu. Cadet lines served the Uesugi and Hoshina.
zh:
香坂氏又写作高坂氏，是信浓国滋野一族的武家，祖先是禰津氏的贞行，苗字取自佐久郡的香坂。初代宗清被认为在1221年承久之乱后获封新补地头；家族约1260年得到牧之岛作为根据地。

1336年，六代当主香坂心觉在牧城竖起南朝旗帜举兵，与北条残党相呼应。起事虽被镇压，牧城却未被攻破。

武田氏侵攻信浓时，当主香坂宗重臣服于武田信玄，但1561年因被怀疑私通上杉氏，在海津城被诛，嫡流断绝。娶了香坂氏之女的春日虎纲继承名迹，即高坂昌信。支流则出仕上杉氏和保科氏。

en:
The Kōzai of Sanuki claimed descent from the Northern House of the Fujiwara through the Sanuki Fujiwara. After the Jōkyū War of 1221, Nii Sukemura, a kinsman of their forebear Fujiwara no Sukemitsu, received lands in Kagawa and Aya, built Shōga Castle and took the surname Kōzai.

The house became the greatest kokujin power of eastern Sanuki and served the Hosokawa. In the Ōnin War its head Motosuke fought for Hosokawa Katsumoto and was counted among the Four Heavenly Kings of the Hosokawa. The family split into an upper line in Kyoto and Yamashiro and a lower line in Sanuki.

Under Motosada the lower line commanded the Shiwaku fleet and traded with Korea in 1531. The last head Yoshikiyo surrendered to the Chōsokabe in 1582 and fought against Hideyoshi's Shikoku invasion in 1585, after which he lost his fief.
zh:
赞岐香西氏自称出自藤原北家的赞岐藤原氏。1221年承久之乱后，祖先藤原资光的同族新居资村获封香川郡与阿野郡的土地，修筑胜贺城，并改姓香西。

香西氏发展为赞岐东部最有势力的国人，出仕细川氏。当主香西元资在应仁之乱中效力细川胜元，被列为细川四天王之一。一族后来分为在京都、山城任职的上香西氏和留守赞岐的下香西氏。

下香西氏在香西元定时代拥有塩饱水军，1531年还派船赴朝鲜贸易。末代当主香西佳清于1582年降于长宗我部氏，1585年抵抗丰臣秀吉的四国征伐后失去领地。

en:
The Kubadids were a small Turkmen emirate of the Canik group on Anatolia's Black Sea coast, with their capital at Lâdik. Their founder Tâceddin Altunbaş was a son of the Seljuk sultan Mesud II of Rûm; from about 1318 he ruled independently from Lâdik.

His son Keykubad kept the seat as a vassal of the Kutluşah rulers of Amasya, and Keykubad's son Ali was the first to bear the name Kubadoğlu. The family fought the neighbouring Taceddinoğulları for Samsun, which Ali and his son Cüneyd held with Bafra.

Bayezid I annexed Samsun in 1398 but left the Kubadids as Ottoman vassals. Timur's victory at Ankara in 1402 allowed a brief restoration, but Ottoman reconquest followed; Cüneyd was killed and after Hüseyin Bey's final attempt in 1422 the emirate disappeared. Its surviving line was said to have migrated to the Caucasus.
zh:
库巴德是安纳托利亚黑海沿岸卡尼克诸贝伊国中的一个小型土库曼埃米尔国，以拉迪克为都。开国者塔吉丁·阿尔通巴什是鲁姆塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世之子，约1318年起在拉迪克独立施政。

他的儿子凯库巴德坐守拉迪克，向阿马西亚库特卢沙赫统治者称臣，凯库巴德之子阿里则是第一个冠以库巴德奥卢名号的人。家族与邻邦塔吉丁奥乌拉勒争夺萨姆松，阿里及其子居内伊德领有萨姆松和巴夫拉。

1398年巴耶济德一世吞并萨姆松，但保留库巴德家族为奥斯曼附庸。1402年帖木儿在安卡拉获胜后他们一度复国，随后奥斯曼重新征服该地区，居内伊德被杀；1422年侯赛因贝伊最后一次尝试失败后，埃米尔国终结。据说幸存的族人迁徙到了高加索。

en:
The Kudō were a clan of the Fujiwara southern house, whose name began in the mid-ninth century when Fujiwara no Tamenori, holding the court office of Mokunosuke, was styled Kudō Taifu. His grandson Korekage became governor of Suruga and founded the Suruga Kudō around Abe, while branches spread to Izu and Kai.

The Izu Kudō threw off local houses including the Itō and Kanō; the Itō migrated to Hyūga in the Nanboku-chō period and became Sengoku daimyō, and the Ii of Tōtōmi later claimed Kudō blood. Early fame was violent: Suketsune's murder of Kawazu Sukeyasu provoked the Soga brothers' revenge, a famous early-shogunate vendetta, while Shigemitsu was ancestor of the Kanō family whose painters founded the Kanō school.

A Kai branch served the Takeda: Sukenaga was adopted into the Naitō name as Naitō Masahide, one of Shingen's twenty-four generals, and fell at Nagashino in 1575; surviving Kudō entered Tokugawa service when the Takeda fell in 1582.
zh:
工藤氏出自藤原南家。9世纪中期，藤原为宪任木工助，被称工藤大夫，家名由此而来；其孙维景任骏河守，开创以安倍一带为本据的骏河工藤，支族另有迁往伊豆和甲斐的。

伊豆工藤分出伊藤、狩野等以地名为姓的家族，伊藤氏在南北朝时移居日向，后发展为战国大名；远江井伊氏还自称是工藤氏后裔。工藤家早年声名带着血腥味：工藤祐经杀害河津祐泰，引出曾我兄弟复仇，成为镰仓初期最著名的仇讨之一；工藤茂光则是狩野氏之祖，后人开创日本画的狩野派。

战国时代，甲斐一支工藤出仕武田氏，工藤祐长继承内藤家名、改名内藤昌秀，位列武田信玄二十四将之一，1575年战死于长篠；1582年武田灭亡后，幸存的工藤族人转仕德川氏。

en:
The Kurani were the leading family of the Guran, also called Goran, a Kurdish tribe of the Kermanshah country whose main seats were Dartang and Darneh. Vladimir Minorsky suggested their ancestors came from the Caspian provinces and migrated to the Zagros under the Sasanians.

Medieval Muslim sources knew them as the Juraqan; in 1014 the Guran killed their former ally Badr ibn Hasanwayh. Around 1343 the geographer al-Umari described them as soldiers and peasants at Rawst, led by an amir named Muhammad, and at Dartang.

In 1596 Sharaf Khan Bidlisi counted the Guran among the four main branches of the Kurds, noting that most lived under Kalhur and Ardalan rule. After the Ottoman sultan Murad IV gave Zohab to the Bajilan, the Guran recovered the leadership only in the early nineteenth century under the chiefs of Qaleh Zanjir.
zh:
库拉尼家族是库尔德古兰部落（一译戈兰）的首领家族。古兰部落活动在克尔曼沙阿一带，主要据点是达尔坦格和达尔内。学者米诺尔斯基认为，其先民来自里海沿岸诸省，可能在萨珊王朝时期迁入扎格罗斯山区。

中世纪穆斯林文献称他们为朱拉坎人；1014年古兰人杀死了昔日的盟友巴德尔·本·哈桑韦赫。约1343年，地理学家欧麦里记载古兰人由士兵和农民组成，分别居住在首领穆罕默德治下的拉乌斯特和达尔坦格。

1596年，沙拉夫汗·比特利西在史书中把古兰人列为库尔德人的四大支派之一，并称当时多数古兰人臣属于卡尔胡尔和阿尔达兰。奥斯曼苏丹穆拉德四世把佐哈布封给巴吉兰人后，古兰人直到19世纪初才在加勒津吉尔首领的带领下重新取得主导地位。

en:
The Kusunoki were a warrior clan of Kawachi Province who claimed descent from the Tachibana lineage, although their exact origins remain uncertain. Kusunoki Masashige answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call against the Kamakura shogunate in 1331, holding Akasaka and Chihaya against far larger armies.

After the shogunate fell he served the Kenmu Restoration, but when Ashikaga Takauji turned against the court, Masashige died at Minatogawa in 1336, becoming a celebrated Southern Court loyalist. His sons Masatsura and Masatoki and brother Masasue also died fighting the Ashikaga, while another son, Masanori, survived and mediated between the rival courts.

The family's fortunes sank with the Southern Court, yet Masashige's loyalty was remembered through the military chronicle Taiheiki. In the Sengoku period a self-styled descendant, Kusunoki Masatora, obtained the court's removal of the traitor label from Masashige's name.
zh:
楠木氏是以河内国为根据地的武家豪族，自称出自橘氏，确切谱系则众说纷纭。1331年，楠木正成响应后醍醐天皇讨伐镰仓幕府的号召，凭借赤坂、千早以少抗多。

幕府灭亡后他出仕建武新政，足利尊氏背叛朝廷后，正成于1336年的凑川之战身亡，成为南朝著名忠臣。他的儿子正行、正时和弟弟正季也在与足利氏的作战中战死，另一子正仪幸存，并在两朝之间斡旋议和。

楠木氏的势力随南朝衰落，但正成的忠名借军记物语《太平记》流传。战国时代，自称其后代的楠木正虎奔走于朝廷，为正成洗去了朝敌的污名。

en:
Kutai Kartanegara was the coastal rival and eventual heir of old Martapura, founded around 1300 at Kutai Lama near the mouth of the Mahakam river in eastern Borneo. Its first ruler, Aji Batara Agung Dewa Sakti, and his successor Aji Batara Agung Paduka Nira bore Hindu-Javanese titles. Court legend traced Paduka Nira to the river princess Putri Karang Melenu, remembered in the Erau coronation festival.

The kingdom grew wealthy on the Mahakam river trade. Islam became the official faith in 1575 under Raja Aji Mahkota.

In 1635 its ruler Pangeran Sinum Panji Mendapa sent troops upriver, killed the Martapura maharaja Dermasatia after seven days of fighting, and united the two Kutai realms. The court later moved its capital to Jembayan in 1732 and to Tenggarong in 1782.
zh:
古泰-卡塔内加拉是古老摩多补罗的沿海竞争者，也是其最终继承者，约1300年建于婆罗洲东部马哈坎河河口附近的古泰拉玛。初代君主阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·德瓦·萨克蒂与继任者阿吉·巴塔拉·阿贡·帕杜卡·尼拉使用印度教—爪哇式头衔。宫廷传说把帕杜卡·尼拉的身世追溯到河神公主普特里·卡朗·梅莱努，这一故事保存在埃劳登基庆典中。

王国靠马哈坎河贸易致富。1575年罗阇·阿吉·马科塔在位时定伊斯兰教为国教。

1635年，君主潘格兰·西努姆·潘吉·门达帕发兵溯河而上，激战七天后杀死摩多补罗的摩诃罗阇德尔马萨蒂亚，将两个古泰政权合并。王廷后来于1732年迁都真巴扬，1782年再迁登加龙。

en:
The Martapura kings, known to historians as the dynasty of Kutai Martadipura, ruled the oldest Hindu kingdom attested in the Indonesian archipelago from Muara Kaman on the upper Mahakam river in eastern Borneo. Seven Sanskrit yupa, or sacrificial posts, preserve its early line: the founder Kudungga, his son Asvavarman, and his grandson Mulavarman, who around 400 styled himself lord of kings and recorded gifts of gold and thousands of cattle to brahmin priests.

After Mulavarman the sources fall silent for centuries. The inland kingdom was the older neighbour of Kutai Kartanegara, founded around 1300.

In 1635 Kartanegara attacked upriver and, after seven days of fighting, killed Maharaja Dermasatia and annexed Muara Kaman, merging the realms as Kutai Kartanegara ing Martapura.
zh:
摩多补罗诸王，史家多称古泰·摩罗迪补罗王朝，在婆罗洲东部马哈坎河上游的穆阿拉卡曼建都，统治印度尼西亚群岛可考的最古老印度教王国。七根梵语尤帕祭柱保存了早期世系：开国之君贡东加、其子阿湿瓦瓦尔曼和孙子穆拉瓦尔曼；后者约在400年自称王中之王，碑文记载他向婆罗门祭司施舍黄金和数以千计的牛。

穆拉瓦尔曼之后史料沉寂了许多世纪，这个内陆王国是1300年前后兴起的古泰-卡塔内加拉的古老邻国。

1635年，卡塔内加拉溯河来攻，激战七天后杀死摩诃罗阇德尔马萨蒂亚，吞并穆阿拉卡曼，合并后以古泰-卡塔内加拉·因·摩多补罗为国号。

en:
The Kutsuna were a seafaring warrior house of Iyo Province on Shikoku. From the Heian through the Muromachi period they dominated the Kutsuna archipelago in the Seto Inland Sea, with their base on Kutsuna-jima; the islands under their control were known as the seven Kutsuna islands.

They served the Kamakura shogunate, and in the Jōkyū War of 1221 Kutsuna Kunishige defeated and killed the imperial-side leader Tokunō Michitoshi at the Battle of Mount Takanawa. In 1331 Kutsuna Shigekiyo answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call and campaigned against the Utsunomiya, then followed Nitta Yoshisada against the Ashikaga as far as Ōi Castle in Shinano.

In 1336 he changed sides and served Ashikaga Takauji in Kyoto, Iyo and Aki. His brother Yoshinori, who stayed loyal to the Southern Court, eventually eclipsed him, after which the family faded from the main stage of politics.
zh:
忽那氏是四国伊予国的水军武士家族。从平安时代到室町时代，他们称雄濑户内海的忽那诸岛，以忽那岛为本据，受其控制的岛群被称为忽那七岛。

他们侍奉镰仓幕府，1221年承久之乱中，忽那国重在高绳山之战击败并斩杀朝廷方的得能通俊。1331年，忽那重清响应后醍醐天皇举兵，讨伐宇都宫氏，随后追随新田义贞与足利军作战，远守信浓大井城。

1336年他转投足利尊氏，在京都、伊予、安艺等地效力。他的弟弟义范始终忠于南朝，最终压过了他的声势，忽那氏也随之淡出政治舞台的中心。

en:
The Kyōgoku were a branch of the Sasaki clan and traced their line to the Uda Genji; their name came from the Kyōgoku quarter of Kyoto where the family lived in the Heian period. Sasaki Ujinobu founded the line in the thirteenth century.

Its most famous head, Sasaki Takauji (1306–1373), known by his monastic name Dōyō, abandoned the Hōjō regency to support Ashikaga Takauji against the Kenmu Restoration of 1333, became shugo governor of six provinces, and was also a noted renga poet whose verses entered the imperial anthology Tsukubashū.

Before the Ōnin War of 1467 to 1477 the Kyōgoku held the shugo posts of Ōmi, Hida, Izumo and Oki, but their power collapsed in the succession wars of the late fifteenth century. Under the Tokugawa the house recovered and was classed as a tozama daimyō family, while one branch served the shogunate as kōke.
zh:
京极氏是佐佐木氏的一支，谱系可追溯至宇多源氏；其苗字取自平安时代家族在京都的居所京极。这一支由13世纪的佐佐木氏信开创。

最著名的当主是1306—1373年在世、法名道誉的佐佐木高氏，他背弃北条执权幕府，转投足利尊氏推翻1333年的建武新政，身兼六国守护，同时又是知名的连歌师，作品收入敕撰连歌集《菟玖波集》。

1467—1477年应仁之乱以前，京极家世袭近江、飞驒、出云、隐岐四国守护，但在15世纪后期的继承混战中势力瓦解。德川时代家族复兴，被列为外样大名，另有一支担任高家，效力于江户幕府。

en:
The Lackfi were a noble house of the fourteenth-century Kingdom of Hungary, named after Lack of the Hermán kindred, Count of the Székelys from 1328. His descendants held high office under the Angevin kings.

From their Transylvanian seats around Mediaș the family supplied Voivodes of Transylvania and Counts of the Székelys. Andrew Lackfi took his father's countship in 1343 and led the Székelys across the Carpathians to crush a Tatar army of the Golden Horde in 1345. He served as Viceroy of Naples in 1350–1352 and ruled Transylvania until his death in 1359.

Maria Lackfi was the wife of Prince Nicholas Alexander and mother of Vladislav I Vlaicu. The house's power ended under King Sigismund: Andrew's kinsman Stephen II was killed at the Bloody Sabor of Križevci in 1397, after which the surviving branch retired to its Croatian estates.
zh:
拉克菲是14世纪匈牙利王国的贵族世家，得名于赫尔曼氏族的拉克，他自1328年起任塞凯伊人伯爵。其子嗣在安茹诸王治下担任高官。

家族以梅迪亚什一带的特兰西瓦尼亚领地为根基，多次出任特兰西瓦尼亚沃伊沃德和塞凯伊人伯爵。安德鲁·拉克菲1343年承袭父职，率塞凯伊人越过喀尔巴阡山，于1345年重创金帐汗国的鞑靼大军。他于1350—1352年出任那不勒斯副王，1359年去世前一直统治特兰西瓦尼亚。

玛丽亚·拉克菲嫁给亲王尼古拉·亚历山大，生下弗拉迪斯拉夫一世·弗拉伊库。家族权势在国王西吉斯蒙德治下终结：1397年安德鲁的同族斯蒂芬二世在克里热夫齐血腥议会上被杀，幸存的支系退入克罗地亚的庄园。

en:
The House of Lancaster was a branch of the Plantagenets, begun in 1267 when Henry III created the Earldom of Lancaster for his second son Edmund Crouchback. Edmund's son Thomas became the most powerful baron in England, but was executed in 1322 for rebelling against Edward II.

Thomas's brother Henry and nephew Henry of Grosmont served Edward III, the latter becoming Duke of Lancaster. When Grosmont died without a male heir in 1361, his daughter Blanche brought the inheritance to her husband John of Gaunt, Edward III's son.

Their son Henry Bolingbroke seized the crown in 1399 as Henry IV. The house gave England three kings: Henry IV, Henry V and Henry VI. The male line ended in 1471, when Henry VI's son Edward died at Tewkesbury and Henry was murdered in the Tower during the Wars of the Roses. The claim passed through the Beaufort line to Henry Tudor, founder of the Tudor dynasty.
zh:
兰开斯特家族是金雀花家族的旁支，始于1267年，英格兰国王亨利三世为次子埃德蒙·克罗奇贝克设立兰开斯特伯爵领。埃德蒙之子托马斯成为英格兰最有权势的男爵，却因反叛爱德华二世于1322年被处死。

托马斯之弟亨利和侄子格罗斯蒙特的亨利效忠爱德华三世，后者受封兰开斯特公爵。1361年格罗斯蒙特的亨利无子而终，女儿布朗什把家产带给丈夫、爱德华三世之子冈特的约翰。

他们的儿子亨利·博林布鲁克于1399年夺取王位，即亨利四世。家族为英格兰贡献了亨利四世、亨利五世和亨利六世三位国王。1471年玫瑰战争期间，亨利六世之子爱德华战死蒂克斯伯里，亨利六世在伦敦塔遇害，男嗣断绝。王位主张随后经博福特一系传到都铎王朝开创者亨利·都铎手中。

en:
The Lancia, later spelled Lanza, were a noble house with lands in Piedmont and Sicily, traced to Manfred I, margrave of Busca, an Aleramici dynast first recorded around 1160 whose surname was said to come from the lancifer office under Emperor Frederick Barbarossa.

Its fortunes rested on the Hohenstaufen: Bianca Lancia, raised at Brolo in Sicily, was Frederick II's mistress and possibly deathbed wife, and mother of King Manfred. Her uncle Manfred II was Frederick's imperial vicar in Piedmont and Lombardy, fighting Guelph communes until he changed sides in 1252. Giordano Lancia, marshal of Sicily, led Ghibelline cavalry to victory at Montaperti in 1260, but after Manfred fell at Benevento in 1266 Charles of Anjou captured Giordano, mutilated and beheaded him at Brolo in 1267.

Angevin conquest broke the house's power, though the Sicilian line kept the barony of Longi and revived in the fifteenth century under Blasco Lanza; his heirs became princes of Trabia in 1601 and dukes of Brolo.
zh:
兰恰家族（后来也拼作兰扎）在皮埃蒙特和西西里都领有土地，可追溯到布斯卡侯爵曼弗雷德一世·兰恰。他出身阿勒拉米契家族，1160年前后已有记载，据说姓氏得自在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨麾下担任的持矛官。

家族命运系于霍亨斯陶芬王朝：在西西里布罗洛城堡长大的比安卡·兰恰是皇帝腓特烈二世的情妇，也可能是其临终妻子，生下西西里国王曼弗雷迪。她的叔父曼弗雷德二世作为帝国代理人镇守皮埃蒙特和伦巴第，征讨圭尔夫城市，1252年改换阵营。西西里元帅焦尔达诺·兰恰1260年在蒙塔佩尔蒂率吉伯林骑兵取胜，但1266年曼弗雷迪在贝内文托战死后，焦尔达诺被安茹的查理俘虏，遭残肢并于1267年在布罗洛斩首。

安茹王朝的征服摧毁了家族权势，不过西西里一系保住隆吉男爵领，15世纪起在布拉斯科·兰扎手中复兴，后人1601年成为特拉比亚亲王，并受封布罗洛公爵。

en:
The Lords of Landštejn were one of the five chief branches of the Vítkovci clan of southern Bohemia. Originally seated at Třeboň, they took their name from Landštejn Castle, first recorded in 1231 and acquired by Sezema of Landštejn in the later thirteenth century.

Vítek of Landštejn held the office of supreme chamberlain and helped drive Henry of Carinthia from Prague in 1309. His son Vilém, after a rebellion in 1318, made peace with King John of Bohemia, served as burgrave of Prague from 1351 to 1356, and became a councillor of Charles IV.

Landštejn Castle was sold in 1381. One line settled in Moravia, where it built Nový Světlov; Mikuláš Svitáček of Landštejn became royal marshal in the later fifteenth century. The house became extinct in 1612 with the death of another Vilém, captain of Prague's New Town.
zh:
兰德施泰因领主是波希米亚南部维特科维奇家族五大支系之一。他们原居特热邦，后来得名于兰德施泰因城堡；该城堡最早见于1231年的记载，13世纪后期由谢泽马·德·兰德施泰因取得。

维特克·德·兰德施泰因曾任最高内侍，并在1309年参与把克恩滕的亨利逐出布拉格。其子威廉在1318年叛乱后与波希米亚国王约翰和解，1351—1356年任布拉格城堡长官，成为查理四世的顾问。

兰德施泰因城堡于1381年售出。一支后人定居摩拉维亚，在那里修建了新斯韦特洛夫城堡；15世纪后期，兰德施泰因的米库拉什·斯维塔切克官至王室元帅。1612年，另一位威廉去世，他曾任布拉格新城长官，家族就此绝嗣。

en:
The Lappe were a knightly family of Land Hadeln on the Lower Elbe, formally vassals of the Dukes of Saxe-Lauenburg. They are documented from 1315 to 1419.

In 1324 Duke Eric I of Saxe-Lauenburg pledged the judicial rights of the parishes of Wolde and Groden to Wolderich Lappe for two hundred marks, giving the family a leading position in Hadeln. By 1370 at the latest their seat was the tower of Ritzebüttel, guarding the mouth of the Elbe, where their duties included keeping the river clear of pirates for the merchants of Hamburg.

The relationship with Hamburg soured: the city stormed the tower in 1393, and in 1394 Wolder and Alverich Lappe were forced to sell it and their allodial lands to Hamburg. After 1419 the family can no longer be traced with certainty.
zh:
拉佩家族是下易北河哈德尔恩地区的骑士世家，名义上臣属于萨克森-劳恩堡公爵，文献可考的时间为1315—1419年。

1324年，萨克森-劳恩堡公爵埃里希一世以200马克的代价，把沃尔德和格罗登两个教区的司法权抵押给沃尔德里希·拉佩，使家族在哈德尔恩身居要职。至迟在1370年，他们的驻地是镇守易北河口的里策比特尔塔楼，职责之一是为汉堡商人肃清河上海盗。

后来家族与汉堡反目：汉堡于1393年强攻塔楼，1394年沃尔德和阿尔弗利希·拉佩被迫把塔楼连同自有地一并卖给汉堡。1419年以后，这个家族便再无可靠的踪迹可考。

en:
The House of Lara, named for Lara de los Infantes, Burgos, where Gonzalo Núñez is first documented around 1100, grew into a great magnate lineage of Castile. In the twelfth century Pedro González backed Queen Urraca against Alfonso I of Aragon; Pérez de Lara brothers disputed the regency in Alfonso VIII's minority.

Opposition ran in the family: Nuño González led a noble league against Alfonso X in 1270, Juan Núñez I fled to France after resisting Sancho IV, and Juan Núñez III repeatedly rebelled against Alfonso XI. Younger son Pedro Manrique de Lara inherited the Narbonne viscounty beyond the Pyrenees after 1192, founding a Languedoc branch with kin at Foix and Aragon.

In Castile the family backed Henry of Trastámara, was dispossessed by Peter I, and recovered its lands under Henry II. The senior male line died out mid fourteenth century, its inheritance passing through daughters; the Manrique de Lara cadet branch endured, producing grandees such as the Dukes of Nájera and the fifteenth-century poet Jorge Manrique.
zh:
拉腊家族得名于布尔戈斯的拉腊-德洛斯因凡特斯，贡萨洛·努涅斯约1100年首次见于记载，后成长为中世纪卡斯蒂利亚的大贵族世系。12世纪，佩德罗·冈萨雷斯支持乌拉卡女王对抗阿拉贡的阿方索一世，佩雷斯·德·拉腊兄弟在阿方索八世未成年时争夺摄政。

反叛是家族传统：努尼奥·冈萨雷斯1270年率贵族联盟对抗阿方索十世，胡安·努涅斯一世因反对桑治四世而亡命法国，胡安·努涅斯三世则多次起兵反对阿方索十一世。幼子佩德罗·曼里克·德·拉腊1192年后继承比利牛斯山以北的纳博讷子爵领，开创朗格多克支系，把亲族带到富瓦和阿拉贡。

在卡斯蒂利亚，家族支持特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，被佩德罗一世抄没，恩里克二世时光复。长支男系14世纪中叶断绝，遗产经女儿传承；曼里克·德·拉腊旁支延续，出纳赫拉公爵等西班牙大公和15世纪诗人豪尔赫·曼里克。

en:
The Launggyet dynasty ruled the last Arakanese kingdom of the Le-Mro period, seated at Launggyet in the Kaladan valley from 1251 until its fall to Ava in 1406. It grew rich as a trade link between Bengal and Southeast Asia.

Its greatest king, Min Hti, took the throne as a child around 1279 after the usurper who had murdered his father was killed. Arakanese chronicles credit him with a reign of nearly a century. His armies repelled Shan raids, and he crossed the Arakan Mountains to sack Thayet and founded Ann in 1335.

Min Hti died around 1374 without a legitimate heir. His great-grandson Narameikhla took power in 1404 but was driven into exile in Bengal when Ava seized Launggyet in 1406. Returning with Bengali troops in 1430, he founded Mrauk-U, where Min Hti's line continued.
zh:
隆邑王朝统治莱茂时期最后一个阿拉干人王国，1251年立国，都城在加拉丹河谷的隆邑，1406年为阿瓦所灭。王国凭借连接孟加拉与东南亚的贸易而兴盛。

王朝最著名的国王敏蒂约于1279年幼年登基，此前弑杀其父的僭主已被诛灭。阿拉干纪年称他在位近百年。他的军队击退掸人来犯，敏蒂又翻过阿拉干山脉洗劫德耶谬，并于1335年兴建安城。

敏蒂约于1374年去世，没有嫡子。其曾孙那罗弥迦罗于1404年即位，但1406年阿瓦攻陷隆邑后他被迫流亡孟加拉。1430年他借孟加拉兵复国，建立妙乌城，敏蒂的血脉遂在妙乌延续。

en:
The House of Laval was a baronial family of Maine, named after the town and castle of Laval, where Baron Guy I is recorded early in the eleventh century. By tradition every head took the name Guy.

When the direct line died out in 1211 with Guy VI, his sister Edme had married Matthieu II de Montmorency under a contract requiring her eldest son to keep the Laval name and arms. The Montmorency-Laval branch succeeded and held wide lands in Brittany. It ended in 1412, when the heiress Anne carried the inheritance to the Montfort family by a similar contract.

The Montfort-Laval line lasted until 1547 and the Rieux-Laval branch until Guy XX was killed in Hungary in 1605. The possessions passed to the House of La Tremoille. Gilles de Rais, born Gilles de Montmorency-Laval and a companion-in-arms of Joan of Arc, was executed in 1440.
zh:
拉瓦勒家族是曼恩地区的男爵世家，得名于拉瓦勒镇和城堡，11世纪初已有男爵居伊一世见载。依照传统，家族族长一律取名居伊。

1211年直系随居伊六世去世而断绝，他的姐妹埃德姆此前嫁给马蒂厄二世·德·蒙莫朗西，婚约规定长子须沿用拉瓦勒的姓氏和纹章。蒙莫朗西-拉瓦勒支系由此继统，并在布列塔尼领有大片土地。1412年该支终结，女继承人安妮凭类似的婚约把家产带入蒙福尔家族。

蒙福尔-拉瓦勒支系延续到1547年，里约-拉瓦勒支系则在1605年居伊二十世战死于匈牙利后告终。家族产业转入拉特雷穆瓦耶家族。吉尔·德·雷全名吉尔·德·蒙莫朗西-拉瓦勒，曾是圣女贞德的战友，于1440年被处死。

en:
The Lazarević were a short-lived Serbian royal house that ruled Moravian Serbia and the Serbian Despotate. Its founder Lazar Hrebeljanović married Milica of the collateral Nemanjić line around 1353 and, as the Nemanjić dynasty died out, built up a principality in central Serbia from 1371. In 1389 Lazar led a Balkan coalition against Sultan Murad I at the Battle of Kosovo, where both commanders were killed.

His son Stefan Lazarević ruled first as an Ottoman vassal and then, after receiving the despot's title from Byzantium in 1402, as an independent lord.

Allied with Hungary, he issued the Code of Mines in 1412 to develop the silver mines at Novo Brdo, and won fame as a poet and patron of scholars. Childless, he named his nephew George Branković heir and died in 1427, whereupon the dynasty was succeeded by the Branković.
zh:
拉扎列维奇王朝是一个国祚不长的塞尔维亚王室，统治过摩拉维亚塞尔维亚和塞尔维亚专制公国。开创者拉扎尔·赫雷别利亚诺维奇约1353年娶内马尼奇旁支的米莉察为妻；内马尼奇王朝绝嗣后，他从1371年起在塞尔维亚中部建立起自己的公国。1389年，拉扎尔率巴尔干联军在科索沃战役中迎战苏丹穆拉德一世，两位主帅都战死阵中。

其子斯特凡·拉扎列维奇起初作为奥斯曼附庸统治，1402年从拜占庭获得专制公头衔后成为独立领主。

他与匈牙利结盟，1412年颁布《矿业法典》以开发新布尔多的银矿，同时以诗人和学者庇护人闻名。他没有子嗣，指定外甥久拉德·布兰科维奇为继承人，于1427年去世，王朝随之由布兰科维奇家族接续。

en:
The le Poers, later more commonly called Power, were an Anglo-Norman family whose progenitor came to Ireland with Strongbow and received lands in County Waterford around 1172. Sir Roger le Puher was granted Curraghmore by Henry II in 1177, and it remained the family seat for more than five hundred years.

Arnold le Poer helped defeat Edward Bruce's invasion but was ruined by the Kilkenny witchcraft trials of 1324. His defence of his kinswoman Alice Kyteler led to charges of heresy, and he died a prisoner in Dublin Castle in 1328. His probable younger son Robert rose to be Lord High Treasurer of Ireland.

In 1535 Sir Richard le Poer was created Baron La Poer. The male line failed in 1704, and the heiress Catherine married Sir Marcus Beresford; their descendants became Marquesses of Waterford in 1789 and still hold Curraghmore.
zh:
勒普尔家族后来更常写作Power，是盎格鲁-诺曼世家，先祖随斯特朗博入侵爱尔兰，约1172年受封沃特福德郡的土地。罗杰·勒普尔爵士于1177年从亨利二世手中得到库拉格莫尔庄园，此地作为家族宅邸长达五百多年。

阿诺德·勒普尔曾参与击退爱德华·布鲁斯的入侵，却在1324年的基尔肯尼女巫审判中身败名裂。他因庇护亲族爱丽丝·基特勒而被控异端，1328年死于都柏林城堡的囚所。他可能的幼子罗伯特出任爱尔兰财政大臣。

1535年，理查德·勒普尔爵士受封拉普尔男爵。1704年男嗣断绝，女继承人凯瑟琳嫁给马库斯·贝雷斯福德爵士，其后裔于1789年受封沃特福德侯爵，至今仍保有库拉格莫尔庄园。

en:
The Lehet, also written Leet, d'Alet or Delet, were a magnate lineage of the Kingdom of Navarre, seated around Pamplona. Its first well-documented member, Corberan de Lehet, joined the Catalan Grand Company of Roger de Flor.

He reached Constantinople in 1303 as the company's seneschal and commanded its infantry against the Ottoman Turks in Anatolia. In 1304 he was killed by an arrow at the battle of Tira after taking off his helmet during the pursuit.

His kinsman Juan Corbarán de Lehet became royal standard-bearer of Navarre. After the death of Charles the Fair in 1328 ended the personal union with France and opened a succession crisis, the Navarrese Cortes named him a regent from February 1329 until Queen Joan II and King Philip III took power. He died in 1355.
zh:
莱埃特家族（文献中又拼作Leet、d'Alet、Delet）是纳瓦拉王国的大贵族世系，聚居在潘普洛纳一带。可考的第一位名人科尔贝兰·德·莱埃特加入罗赫尔·德·弗洛尔的加泰罗尼亚大佣兵团。

1303年他以佣兵团总管的身份抵达君士坦丁堡，在安纳托利亚对抗奥斯曼土耳其人的战役中指挥步兵。1304年他在蒂拉之战的追击中因摘下头盔被流矢射中身亡。

他的亲族胡安·科尔巴兰·德·莱埃特后来出任纳瓦拉王室掌旗官。1328年美男子夏尔去世，纳瓦拉与法国的共主联邦终结、王位继承出现危机，纳瓦拉议会任命他为摄政之一，自1329年2月起执政，直到女王胡安娜二世和国王费利佩三世继位。他于1355年去世。

en:
The counts of Leiningen took their name from Leiningen Castle in the Palatinate Forest. Count Emich II is the first securely documented member, appearing as a witness in 1128.

When the old line died out in the male branch between 1212 and 1214, the inheritance passed through Liutgard to her son Frederick II, who took the name and arms and founded the Saarbrücken-Leiningen house. His son Frederick III added the County of Dagsburg in 1241. In 1317 his grandsons divided the house into Leiningen-Dagsburg and Leiningen-Hardenburg.

The Dagsburg branch died out in 1467, its lands passing to the counts of Westerburg. The counts introduced the Reformation in 1569. The Hardenburg branch was raised to princely rank in 1779; after losing its Rhenish lands to France it received the Amorbach abbey estates in 1803 and was mediatized to Baden in 1806.
zh:
莱宁根伯爵得名于普法尔茨森林中的莱宁根城堡。家族第一位可确考的成员是埃米希二世，他于1128年作为见证人出现在文献中。

1212—1214年间老支男系断绝，遗产经莱宁根的柳特加德传给她的儿子弗里德里希二世；后者采用莱宁根的名号与纹章，开创了较年轻的萨尔布吕肯-莱宁根世系。他的儿子弗里德里希三世于1241年取得达格斯堡伯国。1317年，其孙辈把家族分为莱宁根-达格斯堡与莱宁根-哈登堡两支。

达格斯堡支于1467年绝嗣，领地转入韦斯特堡伯爵之手。1569年伯爵们推行宗教改革。哈登堡支于1779年被擢升为侯爵；莱茵河领地被法国夺取后，他们于1803年获阿莫尔巴赫修道院地产作为补偿，1806年被调解并入巴登。

en:
The landgraves of Leuchtenberg were a noble dynasty of the Upper Palatinate, ruling Bavaria's largest secular non-Wittelsbach territory. Gebhard I appears in a charter of 1146; his son Gebhard II became count in 1158, and in 1196 Diepold I inherited the title of landgrave.

Ulrich I, who ruled from 1293 to 1334, acquired Pfreimd, the dynasty's residence after Burg Leuchtenberg was abandoned in 1322; his daughter Kunigunde entered German legend as the White Lady. Under his sons the landgraviate was partitioned, and Johann I and Ulrich II inherited the county of Hals in 1375.

Leopold of Leuchtenberg distinguished himself against the Hussites and saved Karlstein Castle for Emperor Sigismund. The family became imperial princes. The male line ended with Maximilian Adam in 1646; the landgraviate passed to the Wittelsbachs and, in 1705, to the Bavarian electors.
zh:
洛伊希滕贝格藩侯是上普法尔茨贵族，拥有巴伐利亚最大的非维特尔斯巴赫世俗领地。格布哈德一世见于1146年文书；其子格布哈德二世1158年升为伯爵，迪波德一世于1196年承袭藩侯头衔。

乌尔里希一世在位于1293—1334年，取得普弗赖姆德堡；1322年洛伊希滕贝格堡弃用后，此堡成为家族驻地。其女库妮贡德成为传说中“白衣女士”的原型。乌尔里希的儿子们瓜分领地，约翰一世与乌尔里希二世于1375年继承哈尔斯伯国。

利奥波德·冯·洛伊希滕贝格抗击胡斯派时战功卓著，曾为皇帝西吉斯蒙德保住卡尔施泰因堡；家族晋升帝国诸侯。男系于1646年随马克西米利安·亚当去世而断绝，领地归维特尔斯巴赫家族，1705年转入巴伐利亚选侯手中。

en:
Lhachen, meaning great deity, was the title borne by the kings of the first dynasty of Maryul, the Tibetan kingdom later known as Ladakh. After the collapse of the Tibetan Empire, Kyide Nyimagon fled to western Tibet and built a kingdom.

Around 930 his eldest son, Lhachen Palgyigon, inherited the western portion and founded Maryul, with his capital at Shey. The kingdom ran from the Kashmir border in the west to Demchok and Rudok in the east.

The Lhachen kings, whose history is recorded in the Ladakh Chronicles, ruled from Shey for more than five centuries. In 1460 prince Bhagan allied with the people of Leh, dethroned King Lodrö Chokden and his brothers, and took the surname Namgyal, founding a new dynasty that ruled Ladakh for nearly four centuries.
zh:
“拉钦”意为大神，是玛域第一代王朝历代国王的王号；玛域即后来的拉达克。吐蕃帝国崩溃后，吉德尼玛衮逃往西藏西部建立王国。

约930年，长子拉钦·贝吉贡分得西部疆土，以谢伊为都建立玛域，其疆域西起克什米尔边境，东抵德穆绰克和日土。

拉钦诸王的事迹载于《拉达克王统记》，他们在谢伊统治了五百余年。1460年，王子巴甘联合列城民众，废黜国王洛卓确丹及其兄弟，改姓南嘉，建立了此后统治拉达克近四百年的南嘉王朝。

en:
The lords of Lichtenberg were a knightly house of Lower Alsace named after Lichtenberg Castle. Their first securely documented member, Rudolf of Lichtenberg, appears as a canon of Strasbourg in 1203. They built a scattered but powerful lordship around Strasbourg and Hagenau, and controlled tolls and Rhine ferries on the Italy-to-Flanders road.

They secured town rights for Buchsweiler in 1291 and Lichtenberg in 1305. Around 1330 the inheritance was divided between an elder line under John II and a younger line under Louis III.

When the last male lord, James of Lichtenberg, died in 1480, the inheritance fell to his two nieces. Anna married Count Philip I the Elder of Hanau-Babenhausen, founding the County of Hanau-Lichtenberg; Elisabeth married Simon Wecker of Zweibruecken-Bitsch, and when that line died out in 1570 its half also passed to Hanau-Lichtenberg.
zh:
利希滕贝格领主家族是下阿尔萨斯的骑士世家，以利希滕贝格城堡为姓。首位确凿可考的成员鲁道夫于1203年以斯特拉斯堡法政牧师的身份出现。家族在斯特拉斯堡与阿格诺一带建起分散而强盛的领地，控制着意大利通往佛兰德斯大道的关税和莱茵河渡口。

他们于1291年和1305年分别为布克斯维莱尔和利希滕贝格争取到城市权。约1330年，遗产在约翰二世的长支与路易三世的幼支之间分割。

1480年末代男性领主雅各布去世，遗产传给两个侄女。安娜嫁给哈瑙-巴本豪森伯爵菲利普一世（长者），形成哈瑙-利希滕贝格伯国；伊丽莎白嫁给茨魏布吕肯-比奇的西蒙·韦克，该支系1570年绝嗣后，其半数遗产也归入哈瑙-利希滕贝格。

en:
The House of Limburg grew from the counts of Limburg in the Ardennes, a younger line of Ardenne-Luxembourg who held the title of Lower Lotharingia before styling themselves dukes of Limburg. In 1214 Waleran III married Ermesinde, heiress of Luxembourg, opening a branch that became the House of Luxembourg; around 1218 Henry IV married Irmgard, heiress of Berg, which passed to their son Adolf VII.

Duchess Ermengarde died without issue in 1283, and the War of the Limburg Succession ended at Worringen in 1288, where John I of Brabant defeated Guelders and Luxembourg and annexed Limburg. The Berg line became the senior surviving branch, ruling from Düsseldorf through Counts Adolf VIII, William I and, from 1308, Adolf IX.

Their kinswoman Margaret of Berg-Windeck married Otto IV of Ravensberg in 1313. When Adolf IX died childless in 1348, Berg passed through Margaret's daughter to the counts of Jülich, and the male line ended.
zh:
林堡家族源于阿登山区的林堡伯爵，是阿登-卢森堡家族的幼支，曾领有下洛林公爵头衔，后改称林堡公爵。1214年瓦尔拉姆三世娶卢森堡女继承人埃尔梅辛德，开创了卢森堡家族；约1218年亨利四世娶贝格女继承人伊尔姆加德，贝格遂传给他们的儿子阿道夫七世。

1283年女公爵埃尔梅加德无嗣而终，林堡继承战争于1288年在沃林根结束，布拉班特的约翰一世击败海尔德与卢森堡联军，吞并林堡。贝格支系成为仅存的长支，以杜塞尔多夫为治所，先后由阿道夫八世、威廉一世和1308年继位的阿道夫九世统治。

家族成员贝格-温德克的玛格丽特于1313年嫁给拉芬斯贝格的奥托四世。1348年阿道夫九世无嗣而终，贝格经玛格丽特的女儿传给于利希伯爵，家族男系就此断绝。

en:
The counts of Lindow-Ruppin were an imperial free noble house descended from the counts of Arnstein. Around 1214 Gebhard of Arnstein, a great-grandson of Albert the Bear, acquired Ruppin, a former Slavic stronghold, and founded the line; its name combined Ruppin with the Anhalt lordship of Lindau. Gebhard rebuilt the old fort as Alt Ruppin, founded Neuruppin and endowed the Cistercian nunnery of Lindow; his son Gunther I granted Neuruppin its charter in 1256.

In 1317 the house acquired Wusterhausen and in 1319 Gransee, though it gradually accepted Brandenburg's overlordship. Family member Burchard II was bishop of Havelberg from 1348 to 1370.

When Count Wichmann died without male heirs in 1524, the line became extinct and Elector Joachim I of Brandenburg absorbed the lordship as the district of Ruppin, rejecting the relatives' claims before the Imperial Chamber Court in 1562.
zh:
林多‑鲁平伯爵家族是帝国自由贵族，出自阿恩施泰因伯爵的支系。1214年前后，大熊阿尔布雷希特的曾孙、阿恩施泰因伯爵格布哈特取得鲁平领地，成为新支系的始祖；鲁平原是斯拉夫人的据点，家族的双姓把鲁平与安哈尔特的林道领地连在一起。格布哈特将旧堡扩建为旧鲁平，兴建新鲁平，并捐资修建林多西多会女修院；其子金特一世于1256年授予新鲁平市镇特许状。

14世纪，家族于1317年取得武斯特豪森，1319年取得格兰塞，但逐渐接受勃兰登堡藩侯的宗主权。家族成员布尔夏德二世于1348—1370年任哈弗尔贝格主教。

1524年维希曼伯爵无男嗣而终，家族绝嗣，勃兰登堡选帝侯约阿希姆一世将领地收编为鲁平区，并于1562年在帝国宫廷法院驳回了其亲属的继承诉求。

en:
The House of Lippe took its name from the Lippe river in Westphalia, where Bernard I appears in a charter of 1123. In 1173 the Bishop of Paderborn enfeoffed the family with lands around Lemgo and Detmold. Bernard II founded Lippstadt, Westphalia's first high-medieval planned town, in 1185 and acquired Rheda in 1190.

The lordship reached its greatest extent under Simon I (1275-1344), who bought into Schwalenberg and pushed the frontier to the Weser. After his death the lands were partitioned; the feud over Rheda ended with its transfer to Tecklenburg and Lippstadt becoming a condominium with Mark.

Simon V became imperial count in 1528 and introduced the Reformation. In 1613 the house split into Detmold, Brake and Alverdissen lines; the last produced Schaumburg-Lippe in 1643, while Detmold became princes of the Empire in 1789.
zh:
利珀家族得名于威斯特伐利亚的利珀河，1123年伯恩哈德一世出现在文书中。1173年，家族受帕德博恩主教封赐莱姆戈和代特莫尔德一带土地。伯恩哈德二世于1185年建立利普施塔特，这是威斯特伐利亚首座中世纪盛期规划城市；他又在1190年取得雷达。

领地在西蒙一世（1275—1344年在位）时达到极盛，他购入施瓦伦贝格土地，将边界推到威悉河。他死后领地分割，围绕雷达的争执以该城归泰克伦堡、利普施塔特与马克伯国共管告终。

西蒙五世于1528年升为帝国伯爵并推行宗教改革。1613年家族分裂为代特莫尔德、布拉克和阿尔弗迪森三支，后者又在1643年衍生出绍姆堡-利珀支系；代特莫尔德一支则在1789年升为帝国诸侯。

en:
The lords of L'Isle-Jourdain were Gascon vassals of the counts of Toulouse, holding a Save-river lordship west of Toulouse that grew by purchase and conquest from the early eleventh century. The line is traced from Odon Raymond around 1000, and generations of its lords bore the name Jourdain.

Jourdain III married Esclarmonde of Foix in the late twelfth century, and Bernard IV Jourdain, ruling from about 1303 to 1340, married a daughter of the counts of Foix, tying the house to the south's greatest families. In 1337 the family still held the ancestral lordship, which was raised to a county in 1340 under Bertrand I.

The line ran to Jourdain VI, the last count; ruined and heirless, he sold the county in 1404 to the lord of Clermont, later duke of Bourbon, who resold it in 1421 to John IV of Armagnac. With that sale the house came to an end.
zh:
利勒茹尔丹家族是加斯科涅贵族，作为图卢兹伯爵封臣，据守图卢兹以西萨沃河上的领地；自11世纪初起，这块领地靠购买和征战不断扩大。世系可追溯到约1000年的奥东·雷蒙，此后历代领主多取名“茹尔丹”。

12世纪末，茹尔丹三世娶富瓦的埃斯克拉蒙德；约1303年至1340年在位的贝尔纳四世也娶富瓦伯爵之女，与南方最显赫的家族联姻。1337年家族仍保有祖传领地，1340年贝尔特朗一世时领地升为伯国。

伯爵之位最后传到末代伯爵茹尔丹六世；他家财耗尽又无子嗣，1404年把伯国卖给后来成为波旁公爵的克莱蒙领主，后者1421年转售给阿马尼亚克伯爵让四世，利勒茹尔丹家族就此终结。

en:
The lords of Lobdeburg originated with the lords of Auhausen in Swabia, one of whom, Hartmann of Auhausen, moved east in the early twelfth century and built a seat at Lobdeburg near Jena.

On the Slavic frontier east of the Saale they raised an imperial-immediate lordship, reaching Triptis by 1300, and founded or chartered towns including Jena and Kahla, as well as the Leuchtenburg and the monastery of Roda.

The house later split into several lines, including Arnshaugk; the widow Elisabeth of Arnshaugk, born around 1262, married Margrave Albert II of Meissen, carrying that branch's lands into the Wettin family. In the fourteenth century the Lobdeburgs lost their imperial immediacy to the Margraves of Meissen and Landgraves of Thuringia and sold their castles, chiefly to the Counts of Schwarzburg. Their name-bearing line died out in the middle of the fifteenth century.
zh:
洛德堡领主家族出自施瓦本的奥豪森领主，其中哈特曼·冯·奥豪森在12世纪初东迁，在耶拿附近的洛德堡建立驻地。

在萨勒河以东的斯拉夫边境上，他们建立帝国直属领地，到1300年扩展至特里普蒂斯，并建立或特许耶拿、卡拉等城镇，还修建了洛伊希滕堡和罗达修道院。

家族后来分裂为数支，包括阿恩斯豪格克支；约1262年出生的阿恩斯豪格克遗孀伊丽莎白嫁给迈森藩侯阿尔布雷希特二世，把该支土地带入韦廷家族。14世纪，洛德堡家族丧失帝国直辖地位，受制于迈森藩侯和图林根领地伯爵，城堡被陆续变卖，主要落入施瓦茨堡伯爵之手。袭名男系于15世纪中叶断绝。

en:
Loughlin represents the Irish Mac Lochlainn, also Ó Lochlainn, a leading kindred of the Northern Uí Néill, named from Lochlann mac Máelsechnaill, king of Inishowen, who died in 1023. From their peninsula homeland they rose to dominate the north: Domnall Ua Lochlainn held the high kingship of Ireland until his death in 1121, and his grandson Muirchertach Mac Lochlainn was again high king until 1166.

After Muirchertach's death the kindred's supremacy crumbled. In 1235 Domnall Mac Lochlainn seized the kingship of Tír nEógain, but the family was crushed by Brian Ua Néill and the king of Tír Conaill at Caimeirge in 1241, leaving the O'Neills supreme.

The survivors lost Inishowen to the rising Ua Dochartaigh, or O'Doherty, kindred and continued as a minor sept. In 1601 two Mac Lochlainn chieftains were recorded holding small castles in their old homeland around Buncrana.
zh:
洛克林对应爱尔兰的麦克洛克林，又作奥洛克林，是北尼尔后裔中的重要氏族，得名于1023年去世的伊尼什欧文国王洛克兰·麦克梅尔谢奈尔。他们以半岛故土为根基，一度称雄爱尔兰北部：多姆纳尔·乌阿·洛克林担任爱尔兰高王，直到1121年去世；其孙穆尔切塔赫·麦克洛克林在1166年之前同样位居高王。

穆尔切塔赫死后，氏族的霸权迅速瓦解。1235年多姆纳尔·麦克洛克林夺下蒂尔欧文王位，但1241年在卡梅尔格战役中被布莱恩·奥尼尔和蒂尔康诺尔国王联军击溃，奥尼尔家族从此独大。

幸存者把伊尼什欧文故土丢给了崛起的奥多尔蒂氏族，只能作为小支系延续。1601年，仍有两名麦克洛克林酋长在班克拉纳一带的旧领地上保有小型城堡的记载。

en:
The Lohara dynasty took its name from Loharkot in the Pir Panjal range. Didda, daughter of the Lohara Khasa chief Simharja, married King Kshemgupta and ruled Kashmir as regent and queen from 980 to 1003. On her death her nephew Samgramaraja took the throne and founded the line, whose early history is told in Kalhana's Rajatarangini; he repelled Mahmud of Ghazni and backed the Hindu Shahis of Gandhara.

Court corruption and revolts of the damara landowners marked the following centuries. Jayasimha (1128-1155), called the last great Hindu ruler of Kashmir, restored peace and rebuilt destroyed temples.

The throne passed to Simhadeva in 1286 and then to his brother Suhadeva, whose heavy taxation made him hated. The Ladakhi prince Rinchan overthrew him in 1320, converted to Islam as Sadr-ud-Din and founded the Kashmir Sultanate. The remnants of Lohara power ended when Shah Mir seized the throne in 1339.
zh:
卢诃罗王朝得名于比尔本贾尔岭上的山城洛哈尔科特。洛哈尔的哈萨首领辛诃罗阇之女迪达嫁给克什米尔国王克塞姆笈多，自980年起以摄政和女王身份统治克什米尔直至1003年。她死后外甥桑格拉摩罗阇继位，开创卢诃罗王朝，其早期历史载于卡尔哈纳的《王河》；他击退加兹尼的马哈茂德，并支援犍陀罗的印度教沙希王朝。

此后数百年间朝纲腐败，封建领主达马拉叛乱不断。阇耶辛诃（1128—1155年在位）被称为克什米尔最后一位伟大的印度教君主，他恢复和平并重建被毁的神庙。

王位1286年传给辛诃提婆，又落到其弟苏诃提婆手中，后者税役繁重，尽失人心。1320年，拉达克王子林钦推翻苏诃提婆，改宗伊斯兰教、改名萨德尔丁，开创克什米尔苏丹国。1339年沙阿·米尔夺取王位，卢诃罗残余势力终结。

en: Luanuʻu was an early Aliʻi nui, or high chief, of the islands of Kauaʻi and Niʻihau. He is listed among Kauaʻi's independent rulers between the chief Kamahano and Kukona, who reigned from 1350 to 1380 and defeated the invading Hawaiʻi island chief Kalaunuiohua.
zh: 卢亚努乌是考艾岛及邻近尼豪岛的早期高级酋长“阿利伊努伊”之一，在考艾独立统治者列表中排在酋长卡马哈诺与库科纳之间；库科纳于1350—1380年在位，曾击败来犯的夏威夷岛酋长卡劳努伊奥胡阿。

en:
The House of Luna was a great noble lineage of Aragon, rooted in Navarre and named for Luna in Zaragoza, taken from the Muslims in 1092 under Sancho I. The semi-legendary Bacalla de Luna is said to have held its new fortress; the lordship became hereditary in 1343.

The Lunas fought at Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212 and died defending Peter II at Muret. In 1348 they backed Peter IV at Épila, making Lope de Luna the first Count of Luna. María de Luna married King Martin I of Aragon.

Pedro Martínez de Luna became cardinal in 1375 and, during the Western Schism, Avignon pope Benedict XIII. He resisted deposition until his death at Peñíscola in 1423. His kinsman Álvaro de Luna became Constable of Castile and favourite of John II before his execution in 1453.
zh:
卢纳家族是阿拉贡王国最显赫的贵族世系之一，源头可追溯至纳瓦拉，得名于萨拉戈萨的卢纳镇，1092年桑治一世在位时该镇从穆斯林手中收复。半传说中的巴卡利亚·德·卢纳据说镇守了新城堡，卢纳领地于1343年成为世袭领地。

卢纳家族于1212年参加拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨之战，又在米雷为保卫佩德罗二世而战死。1348年他们在埃皮拉之战中支持佩德罗四世，洛佩·德·卢纳凭此成为首任卢纳伯爵。玛丽亚·德·卢纳嫁给阿拉贡国王马丁一世。

佩德罗·马丁内斯·德·卢纳1375年升任枢机主教，西方教会大分裂期间当选阿维尼翁教宗本笃十三世。他顶住逼其退位的努力，直到1423年在佩尼伊斯科拉去世。其亲族阿尔瓦罗·德·卢纳出任卡斯蒂利亚统帅，是胡安二世的宠臣，最终于1453年被处决。

en:
The House of Lusignan began as petty lords of Lusignan castle in Poitou, traced to the early tenth century, and legend made the water-sprite Melusine its foundress. Its French branch became counts of La Marche, and Hugh X's marriage to Isabella of Angouleme added Angouleme in 1220; that line ended with Philip IV's annexation of La Marche in 1314.

A younger branch meanwhile rose in the Latin East: Guy of Lusignan wore the crown of Jerusalem, and in 1192, after the Third Crusade, the family settled on Cyprus, ruling from Nicosia for nearly three centuries. In 1337 a Lusignan still ruled a prosperous island enriched by Famagusta's trade.

By marriage it inherited the Armenian kingdom of Cilicia in the mid-fourteenth century, losing it to the Mamluks in 1375. After capturing King Janus in 1426, the Mamluks made Cyprus a tributary state, and in 1489 the last queen, Catherine Cornaro, was forced to sell the island to Venice, ending the Lusignan royal line.
zh:
吕西尼昂家族原是普瓦图吕西尼昂城堡的小领主，世系可追溯至10世纪初，传说把水精灵梅露辛奉为家族始祖。在法兰西，家族成为拉马什伯爵，于格十世娶昂古莱姆的伊莎贝拉，于1220年添得昂古莱姆伯国；1314年腓力四世吞并拉马什，这支法兰西支系告终。

与此同时，一支幼系在拉丁东方崛起：居伊·德·吕西尼昂曾戴上耶路撒冷王冠，1192年第三次十字军东征后，家族在塞浦路斯立足，以尼科西亚为中心统治该岛近三百年。1337年，吕西尼昂国王仍统治着因法马古斯塔贸易而富庶的塞浦路斯。

14世纪中叶，家族通过联姻继承亚美尼亚的奇里乞亚王国，却于1375年被马穆鲁克人攻灭。1426年马穆鲁克人俘虏国王雅努斯，塞浦路斯沦为纳贡国；末代女王卡特琳娜·科尔纳罗被迫于1489年把岛屿卖给威尼斯，吕西尼昂王统就此终结。

en:
The House of Luxembourg descended from the dukes of Limburg-Arlon; Henry V inherited Luxembourg through his mother Ermesinde in 1247. Henry VII became king of the Romans in 1308 and emperor in 1312, dying in Italy in 1313. His son John the Blind married Elisabeth of Bohemia in 1310, gaining the Bohemian crown, and vassalized Silesia's Piast dukes in 1327-1335.

John's son Charles IV took the imperial throne in 1346, issued the Golden Bull of 1356 and acquired Brandenburg in 1373. His son Wenceslaus was deposed in 1400; Wenceslaus' brother Sigismund recovered the throne, ended the Western Schism in 1417 and became emperor in 1433.

Sigismund died without male heirs in 1437, ending the senior line; his daughter Elisabeth brought the inheritance to her Habsburg husband Albert V of Austria. Luxembourg fell to the Habsburgs in 1443; the last known male, George, died in 1457.
zh:
卢森堡家族出自林堡-阿尔隆公爵世家；1247年，亨利五世通过母亲埃尔梅辛德继承卢森堡伯国。亨利七世于1308年当选罗马人的国王，1312年加冕为皇帝，1313年在意大利去世。他的儿子盲人约翰于1310年迎娶波希米亚的伊丽莎白，取得波希米亚王位，并在1327—1335年间使西里西亚的皮雅斯特公爵臣服。

约翰之子查理四世于1346年登上帝位，1356年颁布金玺诏书，1373年取得勃兰登堡。其子文策尔于1400年被废黜，但文策尔之弟西吉斯蒙德重夺帝位，1417年促成西方教会大分裂结束，1433年加冕为帝。

西吉斯蒙德1437年无子而终，长支断绝，其女伊丽莎白把遗产带给丈夫、哈布斯堡家族的奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特五世。卢森堡伯国于1443年落入哈布斯堡之手，家族已知的最后一名男性格奥尔格于1457年去世。

en:
The Ma'bar dynasty ruled the Madurai Sultanate from the city of Madurai in Tamil country. Its founder Jalaluddin Ahsan Khan, a Muslim noble of northern origin, governed Ma'bar for the Delhi Sultanate until the crises of Muhammad bin Tughluq's reign allowed him to declare independence around 1335.

Eight sultans followed one another in forty-three years amid frequent coups and assassinations. Ghiyasuddin Damghani captured and killed the Hoysala king Veera Ballala III in 1343, and the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta, who married a daughter of Jalaluddin, left an account of the court's cruelty toward its Hindu subjects.

War with the Hoysalas and the rising Vijayanagara Empire wore the sultanate down, and in 1378 Kumara Kampana's Vijayanagara army stormed Madurai and killed the last sultan, Alauddin Sikandar Shah, ending the dynasty and bringing the far south under Vijayanagara rule.
zh:
马巴尔王朝是定都泰米尔地区马杜赖的马杜赖苏丹国的统治家族。开创者贾拉勒丁·阿赫桑汗是出身北印度的穆斯林贵族，原代德里苏丹国镇守马巴尔省，趁穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克统治危机于1335年前后宣布独立。

四十三年间历经八位苏丹，宫廷政变与刺杀层出不穷。吉亚斯丁·达姆哈尼于1343年俘获并处死曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世；摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰曾迎娶贾拉勒丁之女，他在游记中记述了该朝廷对印度教臣民的残暴。

与曷萨拉及崛起的毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的征战耗尽了国力，1378年毗奢耶那伽罗将领库马拉·坎帕纳攻陷马杜赖，杀死末代苏丹阿拉乌丁·西坎达尔沙，王朝灭亡，南印度就此纳入毗奢耶那伽罗版图。

en:
The MacCarthys (Irish Mac Cárthaigh) were a Gaelic Irish dynasty of Munster whose chiefs ruled the kingdom of Desmond across much of Cork and Kerry. They descended from Carthach, a king of the Eóganacht Chaisil who died in 1045; his grandsons adopted Mac Carthaigh as a surname after their father Muireadhach died in 1092.

After the treaty of Glanmire of 1118 split Munster into Desmond and Thomond, Tadhg Mac Carthaigh became the first king of Desmond. Four septs grew up under him, including the Muskerry MacCarthys, whose Blarney Castle was rebuilt in 1446.

Fineen MacCarthy defeated the Geraldines in 1261, and the septs kept resisting Norman and English encroachment for centuries. The kingdom of Desmond was dissolved in 1596, and the Muskerry branch lost its titles after backing James II in the Williamite War, when it was attainted in 1691.
zh:
卡西家族（爱尔兰语 Mac Cárthaigh）是芒斯特的盖尔爱尔兰家族，其首领统治着科克和凯里一带的德斯蒙德王国。家族源自1045年去世的埃奥加纳赫特·卡希尔支国王卡萨克；1092年他的儿子穆里达死后，孙子们以 Mac Carthaigh 为姓。

1118年《格兰米尔条约》把芒斯特分为德斯蒙德与托蒙德，卡西家的泰格成为第一位德斯蒙德国王。家族后来形成四支，其中马斯克里支的布拉尼城堡于1446年重建。

1261年菲尼恩·卡西击败杰拉尔丁家族，此后各支长期抵抗诺曼人与英格兰人的进逼。德斯蒙德王国于1596年被废除；马斯克里支因在威廉王战争中支持詹姆斯二世，于1691年被褫夺爵位。

en:
The Domhnaills, or MacDonalds of Clan Donald, were a Norse-Gaelic kindred of the Hebrides descended from Somerled, killed at Renfrew in 1164. They took their name from his grandson Dòmhnall Mac Raghnuill, who died about 1250. Norse vassals, they passed to the Scottish crown after Largs in 1263 and the Treaty of Perth; Aonghus Óg of Islay fought for Robert the Bruce at Bannockburn in 1314.

His grandson Donald of Islay, Lord of the Isles, claimed Ross by marriage and fought the regent at Harlaw in 1411. The MacDonalds held Ross from 1437 until John of Islay surrendered it in 1475.

James IV forfeited the Lordship of the Isles in 1493; Domhnall Dubh's risings failed by 1545, leaving branches holding of the crown. Glencoe MacDonalds were massacred in their beds in 1692; MacDonalds rose in the Jacobite causes of 1715 and 1745.
zh:
多纳尔家族即麦克唐纳人，属唐纳德氏族，是赫布里底群岛的诺斯—盖尔宗亲，先祖萨默莱德于1164年战死伦弗鲁。氏族得名于其孙、约1250年去世的多姆纳尔·麦克·拉格努伊尔。他们本是挪威封臣，1263年拉格斯战役和《珀斯条约》后转归苏格兰王室；艾莱的安格斯·奥格于1314年在班诺克本为罗伯特·布鲁斯效力。

其孙艾莱的唐纳德身兼群岛之王，凭婚姻主张罗斯的继承权，1411年在哈洛与王室摄政交锋。麦克唐纳家族自1437年起兼领罗斯，直到1475年艾莱的约翰交出领地。

1493年詹姆斯四世没收群岛之王的领地，多姆纳尔·杜夫图谋复辟的起事到1545年全部失败，氏族随之分裂为直接向王室领取特许状的支系。1692年格伦科的麦克唐纳人在睡梦中遭屠杀，麦克唐纳人又参与1715年和1745年的詹姆斯党起事。

en:
The Leods, or MacLeods, were a Norse-Gaelic clan of the Inner Hebrides; Clann Mhic Leòid means sons of Leòd. Tradition makes Leòd a younger son of Olaf the Black, king of Mann, holding Harris and part of Skye and marrying the heiress of Dunvegan's Norse steward. His sons Tormod and Torquil founded branches on Harris and Lewis; Dunvegan Castle became their seat.

MacLeods appeared in a royal charter about 1343, fought at Harlaw in 1411, and lost chief William Dubh at Bloody Bay in 1481. Their feud with Sleat MacDonalds ended in defeat at Coire Na Creiche in 1601; the Mackenzies seized Lewis from the Torcall branch in the early seventeenth century.

Five hundred MacLeods fought as royalists at Worcester in 1651. The clan joined the Jacobite cause in 1715, but in 1745 Dunvegan's chief backed the government while the MacLeods of Raasay fought at Culloden.
zh:
利奥德家族即麦克劳德氏族，是内赫布里底群岛的诺斯—盖尔氏族，盖尔语Clann Mhic Leòid意为利奥德之子。传说利奥德是马恩国王黑脸奥拉夫的幼子，领有哈里斯岛和部分斯凯岛，娶了邓韦根的诺斯总管之女。其子托莫德和托基尔开创哈里斯和刘易斯支系，邓韦根城堡是主城。

麦克劳德人见于约1343年的王室特许状，1411年征战哈洛，1481年族长威廉·杜夫在血湾战役中阵亡。他们与斯利特麦克唐纳家族的世仇以1601年科雷纳克雷克之战的失败告终，17世纪初刘易斯岛又被麦肯齐家族从托基尔支系手中夺走。

1651年有五百名麦克劳德人作为王党参加伍斯特战役。氏族参与了1715年的詹姆斯党起事，而1745年邓韦根族长支持政府，拉塞岛的支系却在卡洛登为詹姆斯党作战。

en:
The MacMahons of Oriel (Irish Mac Mathghamhna, meaning son of the bear) were a Gaelic Irish chiefly family who ruled the kingdom of Airgíalla, anglicised as Oriel, centred on County Monaghan. A sept of Clann Nadsluaigh claiming descent from the Three Collas, they took their surname from Niall Mac Mathghamhna, descended from Mathgamna, lord of Fernmaige. They held the kingship of Oriel from 1243.

Caught between the Tudor crown and the O'Neills of Tír Eoghain, Rossa Buidhe MacMahon surrendered and regranted his lands in 1590, when Oriel became County Monaghan, divided among five baronial families.

The MacMahons joined the Irish rebellion of 1641 under Colla MacMahon; Hugh Oge MacMahon, betrayed after the Dublin Castle plot, escaped the Tower of London in 1644 but was recaptured and beheaded, after which the family's lands passed to Protestant settlers.
zh:
奥里尔的马洪家族（爱尔兰语Mac Mathghamhna，意为“熊之子”）是盖尔爱尔兰首领家族，统治以莫纳亨郡为中心的奥里尔王国（爱尔兰语Airgíalla）。他们属于克兰纳德尔斯卢伊支，自称世系可追溯到三科拉，姓氏得自尼尔·马洪，其先祖是费尔马伊格领主马加纳。马洪家自1243年起掌握奥里尔王权。

在都铎政权与蒂龙·奥尼尔家族的夹攻下，罗萨·布伊德·马洪于1590年投降并重新受封，奥里尔改为莫纳亨郡，分给五个男爵家族。

1641年马洪家族在科拉·马洪率领下参加爱尔兰起义；休·奥格·马洪因都柏林城堡密谋败露被捕，1644年逃出伦敦塔后又被抓获并处决，家族土地随后落入新教定居者之手。

en:
The Hugos were the Mackays, a Highland clan; Clann Mhic Aoidh means sons of Aoidh (Hugh). With roots in Moray, they held Strathnaver. Tradition traced them to Malcolm MacHeth, Earl of Ross, who died about 1168; Iye Mackay, born about 1210, was their first named chief.

They fought for Robert the Bruce at Bannockburn in 1314. Chief Iye Mackay's murder at Dingwall Castle in 1370 opened a feud with the Sutherlands; Iye Roy Mackay fell at Flodden in 1513. In 1626 Donald Mackay led three thousand clansmen to the Thirty Years' War and became the first Lord Reay.

General Hugh Mackay was beaten at Killiecrankie in 1689 and killed at Steenkerque in 1692. The clan fought the Jacobites in 1715 and 1746, capturing the Earl of Cromartie after Littleferry. Reay was sold to the Countess of Sutherland in 1829; the Highland clearances emptied much of Strathnaver.
zh:
雨果家族即麦凯氏族，盖尔语Clann Mhic Aoidh意为艾，即休之子。他们的根脉可溯至马里，领有斯特拉斯纳弗。按氏族传统，其先祖是约1168年去世的罗斯伯爵马尔科姆·麦克赫斯，约1210年出生的艾·麦凯是第一位有名可考的族长。

麦凯人1314年在班诺克本为罗伯特·布鲁斯作战。1370年族长艾·麦凯在丁沃尔城堡遇害，从此与萨瑟兰家族结下长期世仇；1513年族长艾·罗伊·麦凯战死弗洛登。1626年，唐纳德·麦凯率三千族人赴三十年战争，后来成为第一代雷伊勋爵。

休·麦凯将军1689年在基利克兰基战败，1692年死于斯滕凯克之战。氏族在1715年和1746年与詹姆斯党作战，利特尔费里之战后生擒克罗默蒂伯爵。1829年，雷伊地产被卖给萨瑟兰女伯爵，高地清洗使斯特拉斯纳弗大片土地人去地空。

en:
The Anguses, Irish Mac Aonghusa, son of Angus, later Magennis, were a Gaelic kindred of eastern Ulster. From the twelfth century they were chiefs of Iveagh in County Down, based at Rathfriland and inaugurated on Knock Iveagh. Aedh Mor Magennis witnessed Newry Abbey's charter in 1153.

They allied with the Norman Earldom of Ulster until its collapse after 1333, then pushed Iveagh east to Dundrum by the fifteenth century. Henry VIII knighted two chiefs in 1542 under surrender and regrant, yet Art Roe Magennis joined Hugh O'Neill in the Nine Years' War and submitted after Mountjoy ravaged Iveagh.

In 1607-1610 the Crown broke Iveagh into fifteen freeholds. Art Roe became Lord Iveagh in 1623, but the estates passed to English speculators; by 1700 the lordship was shared between the Magennises, McCartans and new planters.
zh:
安格斯家族的盖尔语名为Mac Aonghusa，意为安格斯之子，后英语化为马格尼斯，是阿尔斯特东部的盖尔宗亲。12世纪起他们成为唐郡艾维格的首领，驻于拉斯弗赖兰，在诺克艾维格举行继位仪式。1153年，艾德·莫尔·马格尼斯在纽里修道院的特许状上作证。

他们曾与诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯国结盟，1333年后伯国崩溃，家族于15世纪把艾维格东界推进到邓德拉姆。1542年，两位首领依投降与再封政策被亨利八世封为骑士；但阿尔特·罗伊·马格尼斯后来在九年战争中加入休·奥尼尔一方，爱尔兰总督蒙乔伊蹂躏艾维格后他才投降。

1607—1610年，王室把艾维格拆成十五块自由保有地。阿尔特·罗伊于1623年受封艾维格勋爵，家族地产却落入英格兰投机者之手，到1700年前后，旧领地已由马格尼斯、麦卡坦两族和新来的种植园殖民者瓜分。

en:
The Maguires, Gaelic Mac Uidhir or son of Odhar, ruled Fermanagh in southern Ulster. They supplanted the O'Devine chiefs around 1264; Donn Carrach Maguire, who died in 1302, was the first of the line to rule the whole county. Chiefs were inaugurated on Cuilcagh or at Sciath Gabhra, later Lisnaskea, and held Enniskillen Castle on Lough Erne, where their large fleet policed the lake.

The Maguires remained independent through the later Middle Ages. In the Nine Years' War of 1594-1603 Hugh Maguire joined the Irish rebels, while his kinsman Connor Roe backed the English crown. Submission opened the way to Ulster's Plantation in 1609, which confiscated most of the county.

Bryan Maguire became Baron Maguire of Enniskillen in 1627, but his sons rose in the Confederate wars: the second baron was executed in 1645 and Rory Maguire killed in 1648. Roger Maguire sat in James II's Patriot Parliament in 1689.
zh:
马圭尔家族，盖尔语作麦克·伊尔，意为奥达尔之子，是阿尔斯特南部弗马纳的统治氏族。他们约在1264年取代奥德文家族，卒于1302年的唐·卡拉赫·马圭尔是该世系中第一个统治整个郡的人。族长在库尔卡山或希亚·加乌拉（即后来的利斯纳斯基）就职，坐镇厄恩湖畔的恩尼斯基林城堡，以庞大船队巡弋湖面。

马圭尔家族在中世纪后期保持独立。1594—1603年的九年战争中，休·马圭尔加入爱尔兰叛军，他的族人康纳·罗则支持英格兰王室。随后的降服为1609年阿尔斯特殖民铺平道路，该郡大部分土地被没收。

1627年布赖恩·马圭尔受封恩尼斯基林的马圭尔男爵，但他的儿子们在爱尔兰联盟战争中起兵：第二代男爵于1645年被处死，罗里·马圭尔于1648年战死。罗杰·马圭尔后来出席了1689年詹姆斯二世的爱国者议会。

en:
The Mahdali were the Arab sultans of Kilwa, an island trading city off the Swahili Coast. Their Yemeni founder al-Hasan bin Talut seized power from the Shirazi line in the late thirteenth century and took over Kilwa's gold trade from Sofala.

His grandson al-Hasan ibn Sulaiman, called Abu al-Mawahib, reigned from 1310 to 1333. He minted Kilwa's only known gold coins, reconquered Mafia Island and began the Husuni Kubwa palace and warehouse. Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 and praised his generosity to strangers.

In the fifteenth century the sultanate claimed overlordship from Mozambique to Lamu as a loose confederation of merchant cities. Vasco da Gama extorted tribute in 1502; Francisco de Almeida sacked Kilwa in 1505 and installed a puppet sultan. Port cities broke away, trade fled and Kilwa was largely abandoned, carrying the Mahdali line down with it.
zh:
马赫达利王朝是基卢瓦的阿拉伯苏丹世系，基卢瓦是斯瓦希里海岸的岛上商埠。家族出身也门，始祖哈桑·本·塔卢特于13世纪末从设拉子世系手中夺权，接管基卢瓦对索法拉黄金贸易的控制。

其孙哈桑·伊本·苏莱曼，人称馈赠之父，1310—1333年在位。他铸造了基卢瓦迄今仅见的金币，重新征服马菲亚岛，并动工兴建胡苏尼·库布瓦宫殿与货栈。伊本·白图泰1331年到访，盛赞苏丹对外来客慷慨好施。

15世纪，苏丹国以松散的商业城邦联盟形式，号令所及从莫桑比克直到拉穆。瓦斯科·达伽马1502年强索贡赋，弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达1505年洗劫基卢瓦，扶立傀儡苏丹。诸港城邦独立，商路他移，基卢瓦大半废弃，马赫达利世系也随之没落。

en: The Maki are the royal line of the Tanade, one of the oldest Darod Somali clans, whose kingdom lay around the ancient port of Alula in northeastern Somalia. Clan tradition names Aw Maki as its first king, followed by Dirir and Hobanle, and dates the kingdom's collapse to 1775.
zh: 马基是塔纳代人的王世系。塔纳代是达鲁德索马里人最古老的支系之一，王国位于索马里东北部，以古老港口阿卢拉为中心；氏族口传以阿乌·马基为第一代王，迪里尔、霍班莱继之，并称王国于1775年瓦解。

en:
The Banu Makki were a leading Muslim family of Gabes in Ifriqiya who turned a Hafsid governorship into a dynastic lordship lasting from 1282 to 1394.

As Hafsid power weakened, they secured the appointment of their own kinsmen as governors and built a domain stretching from Gabes to Tripoli and the Jabal Nafusa.

In 1355 they bought Tripoli from the Genoese, who had just seized it from the Banu Thabit, and by the middle of the fourteenth century they also held Sfax, ruling an effectively independent state along the Gulf of Gabes. Their autonomy ended under the Hafsid sultan Abu al-Abbas Ahmad II, who progressively reimposed direct Tunisian rule over the coast; the Banu Makki lost Gabes and disappeared from history when their lands were reabsorbed in 1394.
zh:
马基家族是伊夫里奇亚加贝斯的穆斯林望族，把哈夫斯王朝的总督职位经营成世袭统治，自1282年掌权至1394年。

随着哈夫斯王权衰弱，他们安排同族出任总督，版图从加贝斯延伸到的黎波里和奈富塞山。

1355年，他们从热那亚人手中买下的黎波里，后者刚从萨比特家族手中夺取该城；到14世纪中叶，他们又据有斯法克斯，在加贝斯湾一带建立起事实上独立的政权。哈夫斯苏丹阿布·阿拔斯·艾哈迈德二世逐步在沿海恢复突尼斯的直接统治，结束了他们的自主统治；1394年马基家族失去加贝斯，领地被重新吞并，家族也从历史记载中消失。

en:
The House of Malaspina was a Lombard marquessal house of Obertenghi stock; its ancestor Oberto I became count of Luni in 945 and marquis of the Genoese march in 951. Alberto Malaspina (died 1140) first bore the surname, Italian for bad thorn; his son Obizzo I switched sides in Frederick Barbarossa's wars before joining the Lombard League at Legnano in 1176.

In 1221 the inheritance split into the Spino Secco (dried thorn) and Spino Fiorito (bloomed thorn), dividing the Lunigiana; repeated partition shattered it into small marquisates. The house sheltered the exiled Dante through Moroello and Franceschino Malaspina, earning praise in the eighth canto of Purgatory.

Spinetta Malaspina the Great bought Fosdinovo in 1340; his descendants made it autonomous in 1355 and ruled as imperial vicars until the last marquis renounced his feudal rights under Napoleonic rule in 1797. A related line took Massa in 1441 and soon added Carrara, becoming by marriage the Cybo-Malaspina dukes of Massa and Carrara.
zh:
马拉斯皮纳家族是伦巴第出身的侯爵世家，属奥贝尔滕吉谱系，先祖奥贝托一世于945年成为卢尼伯爵，951年出任热那亚边区侯爵。1140年去世的阿尔贝托·马拉斯皮纳是首个使用该姓氏的人，姓氏在意大利语中意为“恶刺”；其子奥比佐一世在皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的战争中改换立场，最终于1176年在莱尼亚诺加入伦巴第同盟。

1221年，家产分为“枯枝”与“繁花”两支，瓜分卢尼贾纳；此后诸子均分又把领地碎化成众多小侯爵领。家族以收留流亡者闻名：莫罗埃洛和弗兰切斯基诺·马拉斯皮纳曾收留被放逐的但丁，但丁在《炼狱篇》第八章中盛赞该家族。

斯皮内塔·马拉斯皮纳（“大帝”）于1340年买下福斯迪诺沃，其后人于1355年使该侯爵领自治，以帝国代理人身份统治，直到末代侯爵于1797年拿破仑统治下放弃封建权利。另一支于1441年取得马萨，不久又取得卡拉拉，后通过联姻成为马萨和卡拉拉的奇博-马拉斯皮纳公爵。

en:
The House of Malatesta was an Italian dynasty ruling Rimini from 1295 to 1500 and holding Romagna and Marche cities. Progenitor Rodolfo of Carpegna earned the nickname mala testa, or bad head, for fierceness; the family settled in Rimini in the twelfth century, and Malatesta I became podestà in 1239. His son Malatesta da Verucchio turned Guelph in 1248 and expelled the rival Parcitadi in 1295 to rule alone.

In 1285 Giovanni Malatesta murdered his wife Francesca da Polenta and his brother Paolo on finding them together, a scene Dante placed in the Inferno. Later lords held Pesaro and Cesena, where Malatesta Novello built the Malatestiana Library in 1447—1452.

The family's most celebrated member, Sigismondo Pandolfo Malatesta, raised Rimini's Tempio Malatestiano from 1450 while fighting the papacy, but lost most of his lands, keeping Rimini only with Venetian support. Cesare Borgia expelled his grandson Pandolfo in 1500; after failed restoration Rimini passed to the Papal States in 1528, and later branches served as condottieri into the mid-eighteenth century.
zh:
马拉泰斯塔家族是意大利诸侯世家，1295年至1500年统治里米尼，在罗马涅和马尔凯据有一连串城市。始祖卡尔佩尼亚的鲁道夫因凶悍得绰号“恶头”；家族12世纪定居里米尼，马拉泰斯塔一世于1239年出任执政官。其子马拉泰斯塔·达·韦鲁基奥1248年转投圭尔夫派，1295年驱逐政敌帕尔奇塔迪家族，成为唯一统治者。

1285年，乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔撞见妻子弗兰切斯卡·达·波伦塔与弟弟保罗私通，将二人杀死，但丁把这一幕写进《地狱篇》。此后家族领主据有佩萨罗和切塞纳，马拉泰斯塔·诺韦洛于1447—1452年在切塞纳修建马拉泰斯塔图书馆。

家族最著名的成员西吉斯蒙多·潘多尔福·马拉泰斯塔从1450年起在里米尼兴建马拉泰斯塔神庙，同时与教廷交战，却丢掉大部分领地，只靠威尼斯支持保住里米尼。1500年切萨雷·博尔贾驱逐其孙潘多尔福，复辟失败后里米尼于1528年并入教皇国；其余支系继续以佣兵为业，直至18世纪中叶。

en:
The Malla dynasty ruled Nepal Mandala, the Kathmandu Valley and surrounding hills, from 1201 to 1769. Its founder Arimalla first took the Sanskrit title Malla, meaning wrestler.
