The kings made Nepal Bhasa their court language and grew rich on the India-Tibet trade; in 1260 they sent artisans to Tibet, including Araniko, who built the white stupa at Miaoying Temple for Kublai Khan's Yuan court.

In 1337 Jayari Malla ruled a valley shared by competing towns. Jayasthiti Malla reunited it between 1382 and 1395 and issued a law code organising society around caste; under Yaksha Malla, united Malla power reached its height.

After his death the valley split into Kathmandu, Bhaktapur and Patan, whose kings competed in building temples and palaces. Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha took the valley in 1768 and 1769 after the Battle of Kirtipur, ending Malla rule.
zh:
末罗·尼波罗王朝于1201—1769年统治以加德满都谷地为中心的尼波罗曼荼罗。开国的阿里·末罗首先采用意为“角力士”的梵文王号“末罗”。诸王以尼瓦尔语为宫廷语言，凭印度—西藏商路致富；1260年派工匠入藏，其中阿尼哥后来为元朝忽必烈修建妙应寺白塔。

1337年贾亚里·末罗在位时，谷地仍由城镇分据。贾亚斯提提·末罗于1382—1395年统一谷地，颁布法典，按种姓整饬社会；亚克沙·末罗在位时，末罗政权达到鼎盛。

他死后谷地分裂为加德满都、巴克塔普尔和帕坦三国，诸王竞建寺庙和宫殿。廓尔喀国王普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿经基尔蒂普尔战役，于1768—1769年攻占谷地，末罗统治告终。

en:
The Malla kings of Mallabhum, called the Bagdi Rajas, ruled the forests of Rarh from the seventh century. Their founder Adi Malla established a chiefdom around 694; Jagat Malla moved the capital to Bishnupur.

Bir Hambir ruled from 1565 to 1620, fought beside the Mughal general Man Singh against the Afghan rulers of Orissa, and acknowledged Mughal suzerainty by paying tribute. After hearing the Bhagavata from Srinivasa he converted to Vaishnavism, making Bishnupur a centre of Vishnu worship and adding Dev to the royal titles. His successors built terracotta temples; royal patronage produced the Bishnupur Gharana of Hindustani music and a local school of painting.

Maratha raids wasted the kingdom; in 1760 Bishnupur was ceded to the British East India Company and the rajas became zamindars. Madhav Singha Dev led the Chuar and Paik rebellion against the Company between 1788 and 1809.
zh:
末罗浮摩的马拉诸王又称巴格迪罗阇，自7世纪起统治拉尔赫的丛林地带。开国者阿迪·马拉约于694年建立酋长国，贾加特·马拉将都城迁至毗湿奴普尔。

比尔·汉比尔于1565—1620年在位，曾随莫卧儿将领曼·辛格征讨奥里萨的阿富汗政权，并向莫卧儿纳贡。他听斯里尼瓦萨宣讲《薄伽梵往世书》后皈依毗湿奴派，使毗湿奴普尔成为毗湿奴信仰中心，并在王号中加上“提婆”。其后继者兴建赤陶神庙，王室赞助还催生了印度斯坦音乐的毗湿奴普尔乐派和本地画派。

王国遭马拉塔人劫掠凋敝，1760年毗湿奴普尔割让给英国东印度公司，诸王沦为柴明达尔。马达夫·辛哈·提婆在1788—1809年间领导丘阿尔人与派克制服者反抗东印度公司。

en:
The Manfredi were a patrician house of Faenza in Romagna, among its consuls as early as 1050. Francesco I Manfredi became capitano del popolo in 1313 and lord of Faenza and Imola in 1319, although papal reconquests interrupted the family's rule.

The condottiere Astorre I reconquered Faenza from the Este in 1377 and led the Company of the Star. After the Papacy retook the city in 1404 he was executed in its square in 1405. Restored in 1410, the dynasty held Faenza for another century; Galeotto Manfredi was murdered by his wife Francesca Bentivoglio in 1488.

Her son Astorre III inherited, only to be deposed when Cesare Borgia captured Faenza in 1501. He was murdered in Rome in 1502, his body thrown into the Tiber. After Astorre IV's brief restoration in 1503 the city passed to the Papal States.
zh:
曼弗雷迪家族是罗马涅法恩扎的贵族世家，早在1050年就已名列该市执政官。弗朗切斯科一世·曼弗雷迪于1313年出任平民官，1319年成为法恩扎和伊莫拉的领主，但教皇国的收复多次打断家族统治。

佣兵头领阿斯托雷一世于1377年从埃斯特家族手中夺回法恩扎，统领星辰佣兵团。1404年教皇国重新占领该城后，他于1405年在广场被处决。1410年家族复辟，又统治法恩扎近一个世纪；加莱奥托·曼弗雷迪于1488年被妻子弗兰切斯卡·本蒂沃利奥杀害。

她的儿子阿斯托雷三世继位，却在1501年切萨雷·博尔贾攻陷法恩扎后被废黜。他于1502年在罗马遇害，尸体被抛入台伯河。1503年阿斯托雷四世短暂复辟后，法恩扎永久并入教皇国。

en:
The Mangrai dynasty was the royal house of Lan Na, the northern Thai kingdom centered on Chiang Mai. Its founder Mangrai was king of Ngoenyang. He founded Chiang Rai in 1262, conquered Hariphunchai in 1281 and made Chiang Mai his capital in 1296.

After his death in 1311 succession disputes brought six kings in eleven years. In 1337 Phayu held the throne, re-fortifying Chiang Mai and building Wat Phra Singh. Under Kue Na later in the fourteenth century Theravada Buddhism flourished and the Doi Suthep stupa was founded.

Mid-sixteenth-century succession struggles weakened Lan Na: Ayutthaya forced tributary status in 1546, and Bayinnaung's Burmese armies conquered Chiang Mai in 1558. The house ruled as Burmese vassals, with intervals of independence, until Kawila of Lampang drove out the Burmese with Siamese help in 1775 and Lan Na passed under Siamese suzerainty.
zh:
孟莱王朝是以清迈为中心的泰北王国兰纳的王室。开创者孟莱原为恩央城君主，1262年兴建清莱，1281年攻灭哈里奔猜，1296年营建清迈作为都城。

1311年孟莱死后继承混乱，十一年间换了六位君主。1337年在位的帕育重修清迈城防，并修建帕辛寺。14世纪后期桂纳王时期，上座部佛教兴盛，素贴山佛塔也在此时奠基。

16世纪中期的继承纷争使兰纳转衰：1546年被迫向阿瑜陀耶称臣，1558年清迈被勃印曩的缅甸大军攻陷。此后孟莱家族作为缅甸附庸继续统治，间或独立，直到1775年南邦的卡维拉在暹罗协助下驱逐缅甸人，兰纳转归暹罗宗主权之下。

en:
The Manikandans were the royal house of Thekkumkur, a kingdom in southern Kerala between the Meenachil and Pamba rivers, whose rulers all bore Manikandan as part of their regnal name. The state took shape in 1103, when Vempolinad split into Thekkumkur and Vadakkumkur after the decline of the Chera kingdom.

Its first capitals were Vennimala and Manikandapuram, where Iravi Manikandan Varman built the Krishna temple in 1152. Early in the fifteenth century the court moved to Changanassery and later added a fortress-capital at Kottayam.

The line ended with Aditya Varma Manikandan: after he took sides against the expanding Travancore of Marthanda Varma, Ramayyan Dalawa's troops stormed Changanassery in 1749 and Thekkumkur was annexed to Travancore in 1753.
zh:
摩尼建多家族是喀拉拉南部特库姆库尔王国的王室，该王国位于米纳奇尔河与潘巴河之间，历代君主的王号中都带有摩尼建多一名。1103年，温波利纳德在哲罗王国衰落后分裂为特库姆库尔和瓦达库姆库尔，特库姆库尔由此立国。

早期都城为文尼马拉和摩尼建多普兰，伊拉维·摩尼建多·瓦尔马于1152年在那里修建了黑天神庙。15世纪初宫廷迁往昌加纳切里，后来又在科塔亚姆增设设防都城。

王朝末代君主阿底提耶·瓦尔马·摩尼建多与扩张中的特拉凡哥尔为敌，1749年马坦达·瓦尔马的将领拉马扬·达拉瓦率军攻陷昌加纳切里，特库姆库尔于1753年被并入特拉凡哥尔。

en:
The House of Mansfeld was a comital dynasty of the Holy Roman Empire, named after Mansfeld and seated at Eisleben. Henry IV made its lords counts after the Saxon revolt of 1069. In 1229 a lord of Querfurt married the heiress Sophia and took the title; in 1337 the family still held the county.

The family split into the Vorderort, Mittelort and Hinterort branches. The Reformation divided them: Vorderort stayed Catholic while the others backed Luther. Albert VII signed the Augsburg Confession in 1530 and was banned after Mühlberg in 1547. Debt cost the counts their estates and imperial immediacy in 1579.

Ernst von Mansfeld led Protestant armies early in the Thirty Years' War. Mittelort and Hinterort died out in 1602 and 1666, and the last Vorderort male died in 1780; his heiress married a Colloredo, whose house became Colloredo-Mansfeld.
zh:
曼斯费尔德家族是神圣罗马帝国的伯爵世家，得名于曼斯费尔德，祖居艾斯莱本。1069年萨克森叛乱后，亨利四世将其首领封为伯爵。1229年奎尔富特家族的一名领主娶女继承人索菲亚并承袭曼斯费尔德头衔；1337年家族仍领有伯国。

家族分为福尔德奥特、米特尔奥特和欣特奥特三支。宗教改革使各支分裂：福尔德奥特支仍奉天主教，其余各支支持路德。阿尔布雷希特七世于1530年签署《奥格斯堡信纲》，1547年米尔贝格之战后被褫夺公权。债务使伯爵们于1579年丧失领地和帝国直辖地位。

恩斯特·冯·曼斯费尔德在三十年战争初期统率新教军队。米特尔奥特与欣特奥特两支分别于1602年和1666年绝嗣，福尔德奥特支最后一名男丁于1780年去世，其女继承人嫁入科洛雷多家族，该家族改姓科洛雷多-曼斯费尔德。

en:
The Manuel de Villena were a noble house of Castilian royal blood, descended from Infante Manuel, son of Ferdinand III. Don Juan Manuel was born at Escalona in 1282 and inherited Villena and Peñafiel. Among the richest men in Castile, he could strike his own coinage.

His feud with Alfonso XI, whose young queen was Juan Manuel's daughter Constanza, brought intermittent revolt in the 1320s and 1330s. They reconciled in 1340, and he fought beside the king at Río Salado and the siege of Algeciras. He was also a prose writer, known for Count Lucanor, finished around 1335.

His daughter Juana Manuel married Henry of Trastámara and became queen of Castile as the wife of Henry II; Constanza married Peter I of Portugal. The house kept its titles and military employments for centuries after Juan Manuel's death in 1348.
zh:
曼努埃尔·德·比列纳家族是卡斯蒂利亚王室血统的贵族世家，始祖为费尔南多三世之子曼努埃尔亲王。堂胡安·曼努埃尔1282年生于埃斯卡洛纳，继承了比列纳领地和佩尼亚菲耶尔。他是卡斯蒂利亚最富有的人之一，甚至自铸钱币。

他与阿方索十一世长期对立，年轻的王后正是胡安·曼努埃尔的女儿康斯坦萨；14世纪20至30年代间叛乱时断时续。双方于1340年和解，他随国王参加萨拉多河之战和阿尔赫西拉斯之围。他也是散文作家，以约1335年成书的《卢卡诺尔伯爵》闻名。

他的女儿胡安娜·曼努埃尔嫁给特拉斯塔马拉的恩里克，成为恩里克二世的卡斯蒂利亚王后；康斯坦萨嫁给葡萄牙国王佩德罗一世。胡安·曼努埃尔于1348年去世后，家族仍在数百年间保有爵位和军职。

en:
The Marinids were a Zenata Berber dynasty of the Banu Marin, nomads who entered eastern Morocco. Under Abd al-Haqq I the family rose early in the thirteenth century, and after the Almohad collapse of 1212 they overcame their old masters, taking Fez and finally Marrakesh in 1269.

Abu Yusuf Yaqub founded New Fez in 1276 and intervened in Spain for Granada. The adventure ended with defeat at the Río Salado in 1340 and the loss of Algeciras in 1344. Under Abu al-Hasan they took Tlemcen in 1337 and overran Hafsid lands to Tripoli in 1347, briefly uniting most of the Maghreb.

After Abu Inan's strangulation by his vizier in 1358, sultans became ministerial puppets; Marrakesh broke away in 1359 and Portugal seized Ceuta in 1415. The related Wattasids held the regency from 1420, and Abd al-Haqq II's murder in the Fez revolt of 1465 gave them power. Fez under the Marinids was a golden age of Maliki learning, studded with madrasas.
zh:
马林王朝是柏柏尔人泽纳塔联盟的一支，源出贝尼马林游牧部落，后迁入摩洛哥东部。13世纪初，首领阿卜杜勒·哈克一世使家族崛起；1212年穆瓦希德王朝崩溃后，马林人对旧主连年用兵，攻取非斯，最终于1269年拿下马拉喀什。

阿布·优素福·叶尔孤白1276年兴建新非斯，并出兵西班牙支援格拉纳达，但1340年里奥萨拉多战役惨败、1344年阿尔赫西拉斯失守，海外冒险告终。阿布·哈桑治下王朝达到极盛：1337年攻取特莱姆森，1347年席卷哈夫斯人的土地，兵锋远及的黎波里，一度统一马格里布大部。

1358年阿布·伊南被维齐尔缢杀后，苏丹沦为权臣傀儡：马拉喀什1359年脱离，1415年葡萄牙夺取休达。同族的瓦塔斯家族自1420年起把持摄政，1465年阿卜杜勒·哈克二世在非斯暴动中被杀，瓦塔斯家族掌权。马林治下的非斯是马立克派学术的黄金时代，伊斯兰学校林立。

en:
The House of La Marck, or von der Mark, began as a cadet line of the counts of Berg at Altena in Westphalia. Around 1198 Count Frederick of Berg-Altena built Mark Castle on the Ruhr; his son Adolf I founded Hamm in 1226 and made the County of Mark the family's seat. The counts broke free of Cologne by fighting for Brabant at the Battle of Worringen in 1288.

In 1368 Adolf III inherited Cleves and in 1394 united it with the Mark. Under John III the Peaceful the house formed the United Duchies in 1521, and his daughter Anne of Cleves married Henry VIII of England.

After the last duke died in 1609, the Treaty of Xanten assigned the Mark to Brandenburg in 1614. The last male count died in 1773 and the title passed to Arenberg.
zh:
德马克家族又称拉马克家族，原为威斯特伐利亚阿尔特纳的贝格伯爵幼支。约1198年，贝格—阿尔特纳的腓特烈伯爵在鲁尔河畔修建马克城堡；其子阿道夫一世于1226年兴建哈姆城，以马克伯国为家族基业。1288年，伯爵在沃林根战役中协助布拉班特，摆脱了科隆控制。

1368年阿道夫三世继承克莱沃，1394年将其与马克合并。1521年和平者约翰三世治下，家族组成联合公国，他的女儿克莱沃的安娜嫁给英格兰国王亨利八世。

1609年末代公爵去世，依1614年《克桑滕条约》，马克划归勃兰登堡。末代男嗣伯爵1773年去世，头衔转入阿伦贝格家族。

en:
The Mashiko were a warrior house of Haga in Shimotsuke, seated at Saimyōji Castle. They led the Ki-tō in Utsunomiya service and claimed descent from Takenouchi no Sukune. Under Masashige they joined the Ōshū campaign in 1189, earning a Minamoto white banner from Yoritomo.

In the Nanboku-chō war they followed the Utsunomiya on the Northern Court side; Mashiko Kensuke fell at Tō-ji, and Southern Court troops briefly seized their castles in 1339. In 1546 Mashiko Katsumune seized the headship and later befriended Takeda Shingen, receiving a character of his name for his heir; the clan raided Takeda Katsuyori's camp in 1578.

Revolt against the Utsunomiya in the 1580s ended in Mashiko Iemune's defeat and death. After the 1590 settlement of Shimotsuke the survivors are thought to have taken the surname Kataoka; other Mashiko followed the Satake to Akita in 1602.
zh:
益子氏是下野国芳贺郡的武家，以西明寺城为据点，统领宇都宫氏麾下的纪党，自称古代大臣武内宿祢的后裔。益子正重时，一族参加1189年的奥州合战，获源赖朝赐予一面源氏白旗。

南北朝战争中，益子氏随宇都宫氏站在北朝一边，益子显助战死于东寺；1339年南朝军一度攻陷他们的城池。1546年益子胜宗夺取家督，后来结交武田信玄，为嫡子拜领其名字中的一字；1578年族人又袭击武田胜赖的营地。

16世纪80年代，益子氏反叛宇都宫氏，最终益子家宗兵败身亡。1590年下野领地重新划分后，幸存者据说改用片冈姓氏，另有一族随佐竹氏于1602年迁往秋田。

en:
The Masuda were a warrior house of Iwami Province, holding Masuda from the twelfth century to 1600. They traced their line to Fujiwara Kunikane, governor of Iwami. Kanetaka moved the family seat to Masuda and took its name, fighting under Minamoto no Yoshitsune at Ichi-no-Tani in 1184 and Dan-no-ura in 1185.

Kanetsu campaigned in the Ōnin War of 1467 and entertained the painter Sesshū Tōyō, who painted his portrait in gratitude. Long allied with the Ōuchi and pressed by the Amago, the family submitted to the Mōri. Motoyoshi received a character of his name from Mōri Motonari and profited from overseas trade.

On the Toyotomi side at Sekigahara in 1600 though absent from battle, they kept their lands under Tokugawa Ieyasu but chose to follow the dispossessed Mōri to Susa in Nagato, ending four centuries of rule in Masuda.
zh:
益田氏是石见国的武士家族，从12世纪到1600年据有益田。其先祖可追溯到石见守藤原国兼；兼高把本据迁到益田并以此为苗字，在源义经麾下参加了1184年的一之谷之战和1185年的坛之浦之战。

兼尧参加了1467年开启的应仁之乱，还曾接待画僧雪舟等杨，雪舟为答谢其款待而画下他的肖像。益田家长期与大内氏结盟，在尼子氏的压力下臣服毛利氏。元祥获毛利元就赐予名字中的一字，还通过海外贸易获利。

1600年关原之战时他们从属丰臣方但未参战，德川家康虽准许其保留领地，益田家却选择随被改易的毛利氏迁往长门须佐，结束了在益田四百年的统治。

en:
The Mataranga were an Albanian noble family that held the coastland between Durrës and Vlorë. They first appear in a Ragusan document of 1297, and shifted between Angevin and Byzantine overlordship, accepting Philip of Taranto as suzerain when he retook Durrës in 1304.

Paul Mataranga joined an Albanian coalition against King Stephen Milutin of Serbia in 1319, but the family's lands were swallowed by the expanding Serbian Empire before 1343. After the death of Stephen Dušan in 1355, Blasius Mataranga built the short-lived Principality of Mataranga between the Shkumbin and Seman rivers.

He ruled from 1358 to 1367 with the Byzantine title of sevastokrator under the suzerainty of Simeon Uroš and exported grain to Ragusa. In 1367 his principality was partitioned between the Thopia and Muzaka families, ending the house's independent rule.
zh:
马特兰加家族是阿尔巴尼亚贵族世家，据有都拉斯与发罗拉之间的沿海地带。它最早见于1297年的拉古萨文书，此后在安茹王朝与拜占庭之间辗转称臣：1304年塔兰托的菲利普夺回都拉斯时，他们接受其宗主权。

1319年，保罗·马特兰加加入阿尔巴尼亚联盟对抗塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·米卢廷，但家族领地在1343年前被扩张中的塞尔维亚帝国吞并。1355年斯特凡·杜尚死后，布拉修斯·马特兰加在什昆宾河与塞曼河之间建立了短命的马特兰加公国。

他于1358—1367年以西美昂·乌罗什附庸的身份持有拜占庭“至尊者”头衔，并向拉古萨出口粮食。1367年，公国被托皮亚和穆扎卡两大家族瓜分，该家族的独立统治就此结束。

en:
The House of Mathrafal, also called the Lleision or House of Powys, took its name from Mathrafal Castle, seat of the kings of Powys from the ninth century. The family rose in 1063, when Harold and Tostig Godwinson installed Bleddyn ap Cynfyn in north Wales. Driven out of Gwynedd, the house was rebuilt by Maredudd ap Bleddyn, who restored Powys.

The house reached its height under Madog ap Maredudd. After his death in 1160 Powys split into Powys Fadog and Powys Wenwynwyn; Llywelyn the Great destroyed Mathrafal Castle in 1213. The house survived the Edwardian conquest largely intact, exchanging its royal claims for the English lordship of Powys at Shrewsbury in 1283.

Under Edward II the heiress Hawys Gadarn married John Charlton, carrying the southern lordship to an English line. The northern branch produced Owain Glyndŵr, who led the Welsh Revolt against Henry IV in the early fifteenth century.
zh:
马斯拉法尔家族又称莱申家族或波伊斯家族，得名于马斯拉法尔城堡，自9世纪起那里就是波伊斯诸王的驻地。1063年，哈罗德与托斯蒂格·戈德温森拥立布莱丁·阿普·坎芬在北威尔士执政，家族由此崛起。被逐出圭内斯后，马雷杜德·阿普·布莱丁重建家族，恢复波伊斯。

家族在马多格·阿普·马雷杜德治下达到鼎盛。1160年他死后，波伊斯分裂为波伊斯·法多格和波伊斯·温温温，马斯拉法尔城堡于1213年被卢埃林大帝摧毁。家族大体完整地熬过爱德华一世的征服，于1283年在什鲁斯伯里以王权主张换取英格兰式的波伊斯勋爵领地。

爱德华二世在位时，女继承人哈维斯·加达尔恩嫁给英格兰廷臣约翰·查尔顿，南部领地随之转入英格兰支系。北方支系诞生了欧文·格兰道尔，他在15世纪初领导反抗亨利四世的威尔士起义。

en:
The Matsuda of Sagami originated in Ashigara as a leading house of the Hatano, heirs of Fujiwara no Hidesato. Aritsune's father fought Minamoto no Yoritomo at Ishibashiyama in 1180 and held Matsuda Castle before being forced to his death. Aritsune was pardoned and granted the Matsuda estate, from which the family took its name.

Many Matsuda joined Wada Yoshimori's rising in 1213. In 1333 the clan fought with Nitta Yoshisada against the Hojo and later supported the Southern Court. A branch had already moved to Bizen, where Ukita Naoie destroyed it in 1568.

The Sagami line backed Ise Moritoki when he seized Odawara Castle in 1495 and became chief councillors of the Later Hojo. Matsuda Norihide was their foremost councillor during the 1590 Odawara campaign. After the Hojo fall the Matsuda entered Maeda service in Kaga, while a cadet line became Tokugawa hatamoto.
zh:
相模松田氏发迹于足柄地方，是波多野氏一族的惣领家，祖先为藤原秀乡。有常之父在1180年的石桥山之战中与源赖朝为敌，固守松田城后被迫自尽。有常获得赦免并受封松田乡，遂以松田为苗字。

1213年，不少松田族人参加和田义盛的举兵。1333年，松田氏随新田义贞与北条氏作战，后来又站在南朝一方。其一支早已迁往备前国，最终于1568年被宇喜多直家攻灭。

相模宗家在1495年支持伊势盛时夺取小田原城，此后成为后北条氏的家老。松田宪秀在1590年小田原征伐时是北条家的首席重臣。北条氏灭亡后，松田氏出仕加贺前田家，其庶流则成为德川家的旗本。

en:
The Mauli were the Buddhist dynasty of Bhumi Malayu, better known by its later capital Dharmasraya, along the Batanghari river. They emerged after the Chola raid of 1025 broke Srivijayan and Sailendra power. An inscription at Grahi in 1183 names King Trailokyaraja Maulibhusana Warmadewa, while the Padang Roco inscription of 1286 records Maharaja Tribhuwanaraja at Dharmasraya.

The Pamalayu expedition from Singhasari made the kingdom a Javanese ally. Princesses Dara Jingga and Dara Petak were carried to Java; Dara Petak married Raden Wijaya, founder of Majapahit, and bore its second king Jayanegara.

Dara Jingga's son Adityawarman served Majapahit before returning to Sumatra. From about 1347 he ruled at Pagaruyung, controlling the gold trade of central Sumatra; his last known inscription dates to 1375. His son Ananggawarman succeeded him, and this realm is regarded as the seed of the later Minangkabau kingdom.
zh:
茂利王朝崇信佛教，统治巴唐哈里河流域的马来王国，其后期都城达摩室利耶的名字更为人熟知。1025年注辇入侵摧毁了室利佛逝与夏连特拉王朝的势力，茂利王朝随后兴起。1183年格拉希碑文提到国王特莱洛基亚拉贾·毛利布沙纳·瓦马德瓦；1286年的巴东罗科碑文记载了达摩室利耶的摩诃罗阇特里布瓦纳拉贾。

信诃沙里发动的帕玛拉尤远征使该国成为爪哇的盟邦。公主达拉·京加和达拉·佩塔克被带往爪哇；达拉·佩塔克嫁给满者伯夷建立者拉登·韦查耶，生下第二代国王阇耶纳加拉。

达拉·京加之子阿蒂亚瓦曼曾出仕满者伯夷，后来回到苏门答腊。约1347年起他在帕加鲁永统治，控制中苏门答腊的黄金贸易，存世碑文最晚至1375年。其子阿南加瓦尔曼继位，这个政权被视为后来米南加保王国的雏形。

en:
The Mauvoisin were a feudal family of the French royal domain, rooted around Rosny-sur-Seine on the Normandy border. The first known lord, Raoul Mauvoisin, held Rosny and the viscounty of Mantes and died after 1074; his raids into Evreux helped provoke William the Conqueror's campaign of 1087, which ended with the destruction of Mantes.

As vassals of the Capetian kings the family made its name in arms. Pierre fought for Philip Augustus at the Battle of Bouvines and received the lordship of Nonancourt, while Guy IV followed Louis IX to Taillebourg and the disaster of Al Mansurah in 1250.

Its prelates included Samson, archbishop of Reims from 1140 to 1161. In 1337 the family still held castles between the Seine and the Norman frontier; the house became extinct in 1458.
zh:
莫瓦桑家族是法兰西王室领地内的封建贵族，根基在诺曼底边境的塞纳河畔罗尼。可考的首位领主拉乌尔·莫瓦桑据有罗尼和芒特子爵领，卒于1074年之后；他对埃夫勒的袭扰促成征服者威廉于1087年征伐，战事以芒特被毁告终。

莫瓦桑家族作为卡佩诸王的封臣，以武功立身。皮埃尔在布汶战役中为腓力·奥古斯特作战，受赏诺南库尔领地；居伊四世随路易九世征战塔耶堡，1250年亲历曼苏拉之败。

家族教士中有1140—1161年任兰斯大主教的桑松。1337年家族仍保有塞纳河与诺曼底边境之间的城堡，最终于1458年绝嗣。

en:
The Māweke dynasty took its name from a chief of the highest rank who, according to Hawaiian chants, sailed to Oʻahu from Tahiti in the 1000s.

Famed as a kahuna priest and master of magic, Māweke erected a temple to the god Kanaloa on Oʻahu and through his sons Mulielealiʻi and Keaunui became the ancestor of the island's ruling line. Mulielealiʻi's son Kumuhonua was the first known king of Oʻahu.

The dynasty kept the high chieftainship for generations: around 1290 the descendant Nāwele reconquered Oʻahu from a rival cousin, but after the death of the later chief Haka the family was displaced by the House of Maʻilikūkahi. Oʻahu was conquered by Kahekili II of Maui in 1783 and then by Kamehameha I after the Battle of Nuʻuanu in 1795.
zh:
马韦凯王朝得名于一位最高等级的酋长。据夏威夷口诵歌谣，他在11世纪从塔希提渡海来到瓦胡。

马韦凯以祭司“卡胡纳”和精通法术闻名，到瓦胡后为神卡纳洛阿修建了神庙；他的儿子穆列莱阿里伊和凯奥努伊成为瓦胡统治世系的祖先。穆列莱阿里伊之子库穆霍努阿是已知最早的瓦胡国王。

该家族世代保有高级酋长之位：约1290年，后裔纳韦莱从堂亲手中重新征服瓦胡；但在后来的酋长哈卡死后，家族被马伊利库卡希家族取代。瓦胡岛于1783年被毛伊的卡赫基利二世征服，1795年努阿努之战后又落入卡美哈梅哈一世之手。

en:
The Mazenjani were a Kurdish leading family of Erbil in the Ilkhanid period. After the Mongol siege of 1258 and the fall of the citadel in 1259, they chose to serve the new order.

Their chief Mubariz al-Din Kak received a payza, the Mongol decree tablet, authorizing him to collect taxes at Erbil and Aqra, and Ghazan Khan confirmed the vassal standing of such Kurdish houses through documents of safe conduct written in the Uyghur script. The family thus kept its local position while Mongol rule lasted.
zh:
马赞贾尼家族是伊儿汗国时期埃尔比勒的库尔德望族。1258年蒙古军围攻埃尔比勒、城堡于1259年陷落后，他们转而效力新政权。

首领穆巴里兹丁·卡克获得蒙古牌符敕令，获准在埃尔比勒和阿克拉征税，合赞汗又以回鹘文书写的安全文书确认这类库尔德家族的臣属地位。马赞贾尼家族借此在蒙古统治时期保住了在当地的地位。

en:
The House of Mecklenburg, also called the Niklotings, descends from the Polabian Slavs of the Baltic coast, not a German comital family. Niklot, Obotrite prince from about 1131, held Schwerin and the Wendish lands against Saxon attack for nearly thirty years in the Wendish Crusade, until Henry the Lion of Saxony and Valdemar the Great of Denmark killed him at Werle in 1160.

His son Pribislav revolted in 1163, but Henry the Lion restored him in 1167 as first Prince of Mecklenburg, a Christian Saxon vassal; he founded Doberan Abbey in 1171. Under his descendants the Obotrite nobility gradually became Germanized.

A Werle appanage split off in 1235 and lasted to 1436. In 1337 the Niklotings still ruled their Wismar coastal principality as imperial princes; the main line won ducal rank in 1347 and soon split into Mecklenburg-Stargard and Mecklenburg-Schwerin. Duke Albert held the Swedish crown from 1364 to 1389, and partitions in 1701 created the Schwerin and Strelitz duchies.
zh:
梅克伦堡家族又称尼克洛特家族，出自波罗的海沿岸的波拉布斯拉夫人，而非德意志伯爵世家。尼克洛特约从1131年起任奥博特利特联盟王公，领有什未林和文德人的土地，在文德十字军期间对抗萨克森人近三十年，1160年在狮子亨利与瓦尔德马大帝的联合进攻中战死于韦尔勒。

他的儿子普里比斯拉夫1163年起兵反抗，狮子亨利于1167年恢复其地位，立他为第一代梅克伦堡藩侯，成为皈依基督教的萨克森封臣；普里比斯拉夫于1171年修建多贝兰修道院。在他的后裔治下，奥博特利特贵族逐渐德意志化。

韦尔勒封地1235年分出，存续至1436年。1337年，尼克洛特家族仍以帝国藩侯身份统治维斯马一带的滨海领地；主支1347年晋升公爵，不久分出梅克伦堡-斯塔加德与梅克伦堡-什未林两支。阿尔布雷希特于1364至1389年头戴瑞典王冠，1701年的分封又定型梅克伦堡-什未林和梅克伦堡-施特雷利茨两个公国。

en:
The Medici were a Florentine family from Mugello, first recorded in 1230. They grew rich in wool before Giovanni di Bicci de' Medici founded the Medici Bank in 1397, the foundation of their power. Cosimo the Elder became effective ruler of Florence in 1434; his grandson Lorenzo the Magnificent patronised Botticelli and Michelangelo.

The Pazzi conspiracy of 1478 killed Lorenzo's brother Giuliano. The family was driven out after Charles VIII of France invaded in 1494 and returned in 1512. Medici became popes Leo X in 1513 and Clement VII in 1523; Alessandro took the hereditary title Duke of Florence in 1532.

After Alessandro's assassination in 1537, the branch under Cosimo I took over; he became Grand Duke of Tuscany in 1569. The grand dukes ruled until 1737, when Gian Gastone de' Medici died and Tuscany passed to the Habsburg-Lorraine.
zh:
美第奇家族出身佛罗伦萨附近的穆杰洛，最早见于1230年的文书。他们靠羊毛贸易致富，乔瓦尼·迪·比奇·德·美第奇于1397年创办美第奇银行，奠定家族权势。“长者”科西莫于1434年成为佛罗伦萨的实际统治者，其孙“豪华者”洛伦佐资助了波提切利和米开朗琪罗。

1478年的帕齐阴谋杀死了洛伦佐之弟朱利亚诺。1494年法国国王查理八世入侵后，家族被逐出，直到1512年才重返。美第奇家族成员分别于1513年和1523年当选教宗利奥十世和克雷芒七世；1532年亚历山德罗取得世袭的佛罗伦萨公爵头衔。

1537年亚历山德罗遇刺后，科西莫一世领导的旁支接掌权力，他于1569年成为托斯卡纳大公。历任大公统治至1737年，吉安·加斯托内·德·美第奇去世，托斯卡纳转入哈布斯堡-洛林家族之手。

en:
The Medrano were a high-noble lineage of Navarre, their surname of Basque origin meaning growth or prosperity, with houses around Estella and Pamplona. They were among the kingdom's ricoshombres in the early thirteenth century, when Martín López de Medrano served at the battle of Las Navas de Tolosa in 1212.

In the succession crisis of 1328, the death of Charles the Fair severed Navarre's personal union with France. The Navarrese Cortes chose Juan Martínez de Medrano, called the Elder, together with Juan Corbarán de Lehet, as regents to govern until Joan II and her husband Philip of Évreux took the crown.

Through later centuries the family kept its place in Navarrese administration and arms, one branch serving as royal standard-bearers and lords of Azpa. In 1793 a Vélaz de Medrano was created Marquis of Fontellas near Tudela.
zh:
梅德拉诺家族是纳瓦拉的高级贵族世系，姓氏源出巴斯克语，意为“生长、兴旺”，宅邸分布在埃斯特利亚和潘普洛纳。13世纪初，他们已位列纳瓦拉的“里科翁布雷”大贵族；马丁·洛佩斯·德·梅德拉诺曾参加1212年的拉斯纳瓦斯-德托洛萨之战。

1328年的王位继承危机中，美男子夏尔去世，纳瓦拉与法国的共主联邦终结。纳瓦拉议会推举“长者”胡安·马丁内斯·德·梅德拉诺与胡安·科尔巴兰·德·莱埃特同为摄政，主持国政直到胡安娜二世与丈夫埃夫勒的费利佩继位。

此后家族在纳瓦拉从政从军，一支担任王室掌旗官，领有阿斯帕。1793年，贝拉斯·德·梅德拉诺被封为图德拉附近的丰特利亚斯侯爵。

en:
Medri Bahri, meaning Land of the Sea, was a semi-autonomous Christian highland realm north of the Mereb River, with its seat at Debarwa; its governors bore the title Bahr Negash, or king of the sea. Local governors ruled there from at least the twelfth century, and the office drew wealth from caravan routes to the Red Sea ports of Massawa and Hirgigo.

During the Ethiopian-Adal war the highlands were overrun in 1535, while in 1541 the Bahr Negash Yeshaq helped bring a Portuguese expedition to the emperor's aid. Ottoman troops seized Massawa and Debarwa in 1557; Yeshaq twice rebelled with Ottoman backing and was killed in 1578.

From the mid-seventeenth century the governorship became hereditary under the Hab Sellus family, confirmed by Emperor Fasilides around 1663. The family's rival branches disputed the highlands through the Zemene Mesafint era.
zh:
梅德里巴赫里意为“海之地”，是梅雷布河以北的基督教半自治高地政权，治所在德巴尔瓦，统治者称“巴赫里·尼加什”，即海王。至迟12世纪起，此地便由本地总督治理；通往红海港口马萨瓦与希尔吉戈的商路带来了财富。

埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争中，高地于1535年遭到席卷；1541年，巴赫里·尼加什伊沙克协助引来葡萄牙援军。1557年，奥斯曼军队攻占马萨瓦和德巴尔瓦；伊沙克两度勾结奥斯曼人叛乱，1578年被杀。

17世纪中叶起，总督之位在哈布·塞卢斯家族手中世袭，约1663年得到皇帝法西利德斯确认。家族的支派在“王侯时代”里反复争夺高地。

en:
The Meenas are a tribal people of northern and western India who claim descent from the Matsya, the fish incarnation of Vishnu, and once ruled chiefdoms in the country that became Rajasthan. By the thirteenth century their chieftains held the Hadoti hills, where Bundi takes its name from the Meena leader Bunda Meena.

Their rule was broken by expanding Rajput clans: Rao Dewa of the Hada Chauhans took Bundi in 1342 and made it the seat of his Hadoti kingdom, while the Kachhwahas seized Dhundhar. Driven into the forests and hills, the dispossessed Meenas kept up a long armed struggle against the new Rajput states, notably Amber, which eventually made peace with them through a conditional treaty.
zh:
迷那人是印度北部和西部的部落民族，自称是毗湿奴鱼化身摩蹉的后裔，曾在后来形成拉贾斯坦的土地上建立酋长领地。13世纪时，他们的酋长据有哈多蒂山区，本迪城的名字就来自迷那首领本达·迷那。

扩张中的拉杰普特诸氏族终结了他们的统治：哈达·乔汉人的拉奥·德瓦于1342年夺取本迪，将其作为哈多蒂王国的都城；卡奇瓦哈人占领了敦达尔。被逐入山林的迷那人长期武装抵抗新兴的拉杰普特诸邦，其中以安贝尔所受困扰最甚，最终以附条件的议和收场。

en:
Mekongga was a kingdom of the Tolaki people in what is now the Kolaka region on the southeastern arm of Sulawesi. Its name comes from kongga, meaning eagle in the Tolaki language; local legend traces it to a giant eagle killed by Sangia Larumbalangi, the first leader, who united seven hill settlements and took the royal title Bokeo.

The court first sat at Bende and later moved to Wundulako. Mekongga kept close ties with Luwu, whose merchants helped it build an earthen fort in 1676 against coastal raiders.

Mekongga kept its traditional beliefs until 1699, when the eighth ruler, Bokeo Laduma, made Islam the religion of the kingdom with teachers sent from Luwu; he became known as Sangia Nibandera, the king who holds the flag, after a banner given him by Luwu's ruler for service in the war against Suppa.
zh:
梅孔加是托拉基人在苏拉威西东南半岛今科拉卡一带建立的王国。其名来自托拉基语中的“孔加”，意为鹰；当地传说称，首位首领桑吉亚·拉伦巴兰吉杀死一只巨鹰，王国因此得名，他还统一了七处山地聚落，并采用“博凯奥”作为君主称号。

王宫先设在本德，后迁至温杜拉科。梅孔加与卢武关系密切，1676年卢武商人协助它修筑土堡，抵御海上劫掠者。

梅孔加长期保持传统信仰，直到1699年第八位君主博凯奥·拉杜马在卢武派来的导师帮助下立伊斯兰教为国教；他因在对苏帕的战争中效力而获卢武统治者赐旗，此后被称为“持旗之王”桑吉亚·尼班德拉。

en:
The Mello were a knightly family of northern France, first recorded in the later eleventh century as holders of the fief of Mello in the Oise country. Early in the twelfth century Aubri I de Mello married Aelis, heiress of Dammartin, and his branch took the Dammartin name, rising to hold several counties.

Renaud de Dammartin, count of Boulogne, joined the coalition against Philip Augustus and was captured at Bouvines in 1214, ending his life in royal captivity. The Mello line proper stayed closer to the crown: Dreux IV de Mello was made Constable of France after the crusade of 1191 and received Loches and Chatillon-sur-Indre in 1204.

His son Dreux V, baron of Mayenne, died on crusade in Cyprus in 1249. By the fourteenth century only a handful of the name survived, and the male line died out soon afterwards.
zh:
梅洛家族是法兰西北部的骑士世家，最早在11世纪下半叶以梅洛（瓦兹一带）领主的身份见于记载。12世纪初，奥布里一世·德·梅洛娶达马尔坦伯国女继承人阿埃莉斯，这一支便改姓达马尔坦，后来取得多个伯国。

布洛涅伯爵勒诺·德·达马尔坦加入反对腓力·奥古斯都的联军，1214年在布汶战役中被俘，在王室牢狱里度过余生。梅洛本支则更贴近王权：德雷厄四世·德·梅洛在1191年随十字军东征后被任命为法兰西统帅，1204年受封洛什和安德尔河畔沙蒂永。

其子德雷厄五世是马耶讷男爵，1249年随十字军东征时死于塞浦路斯。到14世纪，沿用梅洛之名的族人已寥寥无几，男系不久后断绝。

en:
The Menteşe dynasty founded the earliest Anatolian beylik in ancient Caria, with Milas as its capital. Named after the Turkmen chief Menteşe Bey, it was the first beylik to take to the sea, earning its sailors the name Sea Turks. Under Mesut Bey its fleets briefly seized parts of Rhodes in 1300, and in 1311 a combined Menteşe and Genoese fleet attacked the Hospitallers there. The beylik traded with Venetian Crete, exporting grain, horses and alum through Mağrı.

Weakened by the earthquake of 1389, it submitted to Bayezid I in 1390, was restored by Timur after 1402, accepted Ottoman overlordship in 1414 and was fully annexed in 1426. Its shipyards and seamen supplied roughly two fifths of the fleet that besieged Constantinople in 1453.
zh:
门泰谢家族在古卡利亚建立了最早的安纳托利亚贝伊国，以米拉斯为都。家族得名于土库曼首领门泰谢贝伊，也是第一个走向海洋的贝伊国，其水手赢得了“海上突厥人”的称号。梅苏特贝伊在位时，舰队于1300年一度攻占罗得岛部分地区；1311年门泰谢与热那亚组成联合舰队，进攻岛上的医院骑士团。贝伊国还通过马格勒港与威尼斯治下的克里特贸易，出口谷物、马匹和明矾。

1389年的地震使其元气大伤，1390年它向巴耶济德一世臣服，1402年后被帖木儿恢复，1414年承认奥斯曼宗主权，1426年被彻底吞并。1453年围攻君士坦丁堡的舰队中，约有五分之二来自门泰谢的船厂和水手。

en:
The Migita were a cadet branch of the Ōuchi, the official house of Suō Province whose Tatara ancestors claimed Baekje royal descent. Morinaga, younger brother of Ōuchi Morifusa, was enfeoffed at Migita and founded a separate house; Hirotoshi was the first to call himself Migita. A branch later became the Sue clan.

During the Nanboku-chō wars Migita Hironao followed Ōuchi Yoshihiro and was appointed shugodai of Iwami. After Sue Harukata's coup of 1551 and death at Itsukushima in 1555, Migita Takakage surrendered to Mōri Motonari before Yamaguchi fell.

Takakage adopted Motonari's seventh son Amano Motomasa as his heir, and the line continued as the Migita-Mōri, a kinsman house of the Chōshū daimyō. His own son Yasumasa took the name Misato and served the Mōri.
zh:
右田氏是周防在庁官人大内氏的庶流，大内家的祖先多々良氏自称出自百济王族。大内盛房之弟盛长受封右田，另立一家；弘俊最早以右田为姓。后来一支分出，成为陶氏。

南北朝时代，右田弘直追随大内义弘，被任命为石见守护代。1551年陶晴贤发动政变、1555年在严岛之战中败死后，右田隆量在山口陷落前向毛利元就投降。

隆量迎立元就七男天野元政为养子继承右田家，其后代作为长州大名的同族“右田毛利家”存续；隆量的亲生儿子康政则改姓御乡，出仕毛利家。

en:
The Mihrabanids were a Persian Muslim dynasty, the third indigenous Muslim line to rule Sistan, also called Nimruz, after the Saffarids and the Nasrids. They held the province from 1236 to the mid-sixteenth century, governing from Shahr-i Sistan with the title of malik.

The first malik, Shams al-Din Ali ibn Mas'ud, took power after the Mongol conquest, and the family ruled as largely autonomous vassals of the Ilkhanate, conquering Quhistan by 1289. The collapse of the Ilkhanate left the Mihrabanids independent for nearly half a century, until Timur invaded Sistan in 1383 and devastated the province; the maliks then served the Timurids and the Shaybanids.

The last malik, Sultan Mahmud, acknowledged Safavid suzerainty and introduced Shia practices such as the Shia call to prayer among a mostly Sunni population, before the family handed over Sistan and ended its three centuries of rule around the 1540s.
zh:
米赫拉班王朝是波斯人的穆斯林王朝，也是继萨法尔王朝和纳西尔王朝之后第三个统治锡斯坦（又称尼姆鲁兹）的本地穆斯林家族。他们自1236年起统治该省，直到16世纪中叶，以锡斯坦城为都，君主称马利克。

首任马利克沙姆斯丁·阿里·本·马苏德在蒙古征服后掌权，家族作为伊儿汗国高度自治的藩臣治理地方，并于1289年征服库希斯坦。伊儿汗国崩溃后，米赫拉班人独立了近半个世纪，1383年帖木儿入侵并破坏锡斯坦，独立告终；此后马利克们先后臣服帖木儿王朝和昔班尼王朝。

末代马利克苏丹·马哈茂德承认萨法维王朝的宗主权，在以逊尼派为主的民众中推行什叶派唤礼等做法，随后交出锡斯坦，家族约在16世纪40年代结束了长达三百年的统治。

en:
The Minami were a cadet house of the Kō family, whose original surname was Takashina. Their founder Yorimoto, a son of Kō Shigeuji, established the branch at Maruki in Shimotsuke Province, and the house hereditarily headed the Ashikaga household's administrative office.

Its best-known head was Minami Munetsugu, grandson of Yorimoto and a cousin once removed of Kō no Moronao, the first Muromachi shogunate steward. Munetsugu accompanied Ashikaga Takauji east during the Nakasendai rebellion of 1335 and served the shogunate as constable of Mikawa and, from about 1347, Bitchu.

In the Kannō Disturbance of 1349 to 1352 he took Takauji and Moronao's side against Ashikaga Tadayoshi; after Moronao's murder he issued documents in the steward's authority. He founded the Zen temple Seigen-ji in Ashikaga in 1357 and died in 1371.
zh:
南氏是高氏的庶流，本姓高阶。高重氏之子赖基在下野国丸木乡分家自立，成为南氏之祖；该家世代担任足利氏家政机构的笔头奉行。

最知名的当主是赖基之孙南宗继，他与室町幕府初代执事高师直是又从兄弟。1335年中先代之乱时，宗继随足利尊氏前往东国，此后出仕幕府，担任三河守护，并于1347年前后出任备中守护。

在1349—1352年的观应之扰乱中，他站在尊氏、师直一边，与足利直义为敌；师直被杀后，他以执事的职权发布施行状。1357年，他在足利开建禅寺清源寺，于1371年去世。

en:
The Mitoya were an Izumo kokujin house who claimed Seiwa Genji blood through the Shinano line. After Suwabe Sukenaga fought for the shogunate in 1221 he was made steward of Mitoya, and his descendants took its name.

Around 1332 the head Sukeshige built Tamatsukuri Castle, and in 1337 he served Ashikaga Takauji at the siege of Kanegasaki. The house later served the Yamana, Kyōgoku and came under the influence of the Amago. The Mitoya eventually surrendered to Mōri Motonari; their castle became a Mōri supply base that beat off Amago assaults in 1562 and 1563.

In 1586 Mōri Terumoto exiled the Mitoya head Hisasuke to seize the fief; Hisasuke retired in Kyoto and refused Tokugawa Ieyasu's offer of a post. His son Takasuke served the Mōri and Hosokawa, and Takasuke's son Sukeaki reverted to the Suwabe surname, ending the Mitoya name.
zh:
三刀屋氏是出云国的国人豪族，自称清和源氏满快流信浓源氏的后裔。1221年诹访部助长为幕府方立功，被补任为三刀屋乡地头，子孙以三刀屋为苗字。

1332年前后，当主扶重修筑玉造城；1337年他从属足利尊氏，参加金崎城攻略。此后家族先后从属山名氏、京极氏，受到尼子氏影响，最终归降毛利元就。三刀屋城成为毛利军兵站据点，在1562年和1563年击退尼子军围攻。

1586年，毛利辉元为夺取领地而流放三刀屋当主久扶；久扶隐居京都，拒绝德川家康的出仕邀请。其子孝扶先后效力毛利氏、细川氏，孝扶之子扶明恢复本姓诹访部，三刀屋的苗字就此终结。

en:
The Miura were one of the eight Taira clans of the Kanto, the Bando Hachi Heishi, named for Sagami's Miura peninsula, ruled from the eleventh century. Tametsugu and his son Yoshitsugu, self-styled Miura no suke, made the clan leading provincial officials in eastern Sagami.

Yoshiaki answered Minamoto no Yoritomo's call to arms in 1180, dying defending Kinugasa castle after defeat at Ishibashiyama. His son Yoshizumi became one of Yoritomo's senior councillors and sat on the thirteen-man regency council; the Miura stood at the height of Kamakura politics, kin and rivals to the Hojo regents.

When Yasumura threatened to overshadow the Hojo, regent Tokiyori crushed them in the Hoji war of 1247 and the main line perished. A compliant Sawara side branch revived the name as Hojo housemen and grew into a Sengoku daimyo house, until Hojo Soun took Arai castle in 1516 and lords Yoshiatsu and his son Yoshimoto killed themselves. An Edo branch became daimyo and settled at Katsuyama in 1764.
zh:
三浦氏是坂东八平氏之一，本姓平，11世纪起以相模国三浦半岛为根据地，又称三浦党。为继、义继两代打下基业，义继自称三浦介，成为相模东部有力的在厅官人。

1180年义明响应源赖朝举兵，在石桥山战败后据守衣笠城战死。其子义澄成为赖朝的宿老、十三人合议制成员，三浦氏由此跻身镰仓幕府权力核心，与执权北条氏既是姻亲又是对手。

泰村权势逼近北条，执权北条时赖遂于1247年宝治合战中将其消灭，嫡流覆灭。归顺的旁流佐原氏获准再兴三浦家，以御内人身份存续，这一支即战国大名相模三浦氏；1516年北条早云攻陷新井城，当主义同、义元父子自尽，相模三浦氏灭亡。江户时代另有三浦氏一支位列大名，1764年定封胜山藩。

en:
The Mixcoatl house takes its name from Iztac Mixcoatl, whom Mexica migration lore calls the father of Tenoch, the chief who led the Mexica at the end of their wanderings from Aztlán. Elected by the council of elders, Tenoch guided his people to an island in Lake Texcoco, where they founded Tenochtitlan, named in his honour, in 1325; whether he was a historical leader or a mythologized founder remains disputed.

He died between 1350 and 1375, after which the elders chose Acamapichtli, of Culhua descent through his mother, as the first tlatoani, beginning a royal line that at first made Tenochtitlan tributary to Azcapotzalco.

In 1428 that line, under Itzcoatl, joined Texcoco and Tlacopan in the Triple Alliance that overthrew Azcapotzalco and built the Aztec empire. Its last independent ruler, Cuauhtémoc, fell with the city to Hernán Cortés in 1521.
zh:
米西克亚特尔家族得名于伊斯特阿克·米西克亚特尔，在墨西加人的迁徙传说中，他是特诺奇的父亲。特诺奇是墨西加人从阿兹特兰迁徙末期的首领，由长老议事会选出。他率领族人来到特斯科科湖中的一座岛屿，于1325年建立了以他命名的特诺奇蒂特兰；他究竟是真实首领还是被神化的始祖仍有争论。

他于1350至1375年间去世，长老们随后选出经母亲带有库尔瓦血统的阿卡马皮奇特利为首任特拉托阿尼，开创的王室世系起初让特诺奇蒂特兰臣服于阿斯卡波特萨尔科。

1428年，这一世系的伊茨科阿特尔联合特斯科科和特拉科潘组成三方联盟，推翻阿斯卡波特萨尔科，建立阿兹特克帝国。末代独立统治者夸乌特莫克在1521年随城市一同落入埃尔南·科尔特斯之手。

en:
The Miya were kokujin, local warrior lords, of Bingo Province, traditionally held to descend from the Ononomiya branch of the northern Fujiwara, whose members settled there as priestly families of the Kibitsu Shrine. In the Nanboku-chō wars Miya Kanenobu fought for Ashikaga Takauji and drove Ashikaga Tadafuyu out of Bingo, becoming shugo of neighboring Bitchū by 1364 and holding it until at least 1365.

His kinsman Miya Morishige joined Tadafuyu against the shogunate's governor of Bingo. Their descendants, known as the two Miya houses, entered the Muromachi shogun's direct vassal corps and kept the clan united through the Ōnin War.

In the Sengoku age the Miya served the Amago; their main line died out in 1541, and around 1548 an attack by the Ōuchi brought about their downfall. Branch houses later served the Mōri and the Chōshū domain.
zh:
宫氏是备后国的国人，即地方武士领主，通说认为其出自藤原北家小野宫流，后裔定居备后，世代担任吉备津神社的社家。南北朝动乱中，宫兼信追随足利尊氏，击退攻入备后的足利直冬，于1364年以前被任命为邻近的备中国守护，至少在任至1365年。

同族的宫盛重则站在足利直冬一方，与幕府任命的备后守护交战。兼信与盛重的后裔并称“两宫”，都被编入幕府的奉公众，应仁之乱期间仍维持一族团结。

战国时代，宫氏从属于尼子氏，宗家于1541年绝嗣，约1548年又遭大内氏进攻而没落。庶流后来侍奉毛利氏和长州藩。

en:
The Bingo Miyoshi, distinct from the Miyoshi house of Awa, claimed Fujiwara descent through Fujiwara no Kanenori. In the twelfth century Kanenori moved from Ōmi to Miyoshi in Bingo, and his son Kanemune became the first head of the family, which built Hiebiwayama Castle and grew into a local kokujin power.

At the fall of the Kamakura shogunate the Miyoshi sided with Emperor Go-Daigo and then with Ashikaga Tadafuyu. Their Sengoku head Munetaka fought for the Amago against Mōri Motonari at Yoshida Kōriyama in 1540, then switched to the Ōuchi. In 1553 Munetaka and his son Takasuke submitted to Motonari, and a daughter of the house became his concubine.

After the Sekigahara campaign of 1600 their head Hirotaka refused to follow the Mōri into Chōshū, became a rōnin in Kyoto and was eventually taken into the Hiroshima domain of the Asano.
zh:
备后三吉氏与阿波三好氏同名而异家，自称是藤原兼范的后裔。12世纪时，兼范从近江移居备后国三吉乡，其子兼宗成为初代当主，一族修筑比叡尾山城，成长为当地国人势力。

镰仓幕府灭亡之际，三吉氏拥护后醍醐天皇，其后追随足利直冬。1540年吉田郡山城之战中，战国当主致高站在尼子一方与毛利元就作战，后来转投大内。1553年，致高与儿子隆亮从属毛利元就，族中还有女子成为元就的侧室。

1600年关原之战后，当主广高不愿随毛利氏移封长州，上洛沦为浪人，后来被广岛藩主浅野氏起用。

en:
The Mizawa of Izumo traced their line to Shinano Genji forebears, either the Kiso clan or the Iijima family. In the Jōkyū War of 1221 Iijima Tamemitsu was appointed steward of Mizawa manor. His descendant Tamenaga grew wealthy mining iron sand and working tatara furnaces, and built Mizawa Castle in 1305, after which the family took the Mizawa name.

They served the Yamana and later the Kyōgoku. In the Sengoku age they resisted the Amago: Tamekuni was defeated by Amago Tsunehisa in 1488, and a later head, Tameyuki, died fighting at Yoshida-Kōriyama in 1540. In 1561 the Mizawa submitted to Mōri Motonari, and Tamekiyo held firm against the Amago restoration armies.

In 1589 Tamekiyo's son Tametora was confined by Mōri Terumoto but later released with a fief in Nagato. The house survived the Edo period as senior retainers of the Chōfu domain.
zh:
出云三泽氏出自信浓源氏，谱系或溯至木曾一脉，或溯至饭岛氏。1221年承久之乱中，饭岛为光被补任为三泽庄地头。其后人三泽为长靠开采砂铁、经营踏鞴制铁积蓄实力，于1305年修筑三泽城，此后家族改姓三泽。

三泽氏先从属山名氏，后来改仕京极氏。战国时代，三泽氏与尼子氏对抗：1488年为国败于尼子经久，后来的当主为幸则在1540年吉田郡山城之战中阵亡。1561年三泽氏归降毛利元就，此后为清协助击退尼子再兴军。

1589年，为清之子为虎遭毛利辉元幽禁，后获释并领有长门的领地。三泽氏作为长府藩家老延续到了江户时代。

en:
The Mogami were a cadet branch of the Shiba, kin of the Ashikaga and of Seiwa Genji blood. Their founder Shiba Kaneyori entered the Mogami district of Dewa in the 1350s, built Yamagata Castle and took the name Mogami; in 1368 he defeated Southern Court forces at Urushikawa.

His successors planted cadet houses across the district, but these grew independent. After the Mogami were defeated by Date Tanemune at Hasedō in 1514, Yoshimori retook Hasedō on reaching adulthood. His daughter Yoshihime married Date Terumune and became the mother of Date Masamune.

Under Yoshimori's son Yoshiaki the house reached its height. He submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi in 1590 and held Hasedō Castle against Uesugi Kagekatsu in 1600. After his death in 1614 succession feuds undid the house: it was attainted in 1622, and its descendants became hatamoto in Ōmi.
zh:
最上氏是斯波氏的分家，而斯波氏与足利氏同族、出自清和源氏。初代斯波兼赖在14世纪50年代进入出羽国最上郡，修筑山形城，并以领地为姓；1368年他在漆川之战中击败南朝势力。

其后继者将庶族分派各地，但这些庶族逐渐独立。1514年最上氏在长谷堂败给伊达稙宗，后来最上义守成年后夺回长谷堂。义守之女义姬嫁给伊达辉宗，是伊达政宗的生母。

到义守之子最上义光一代，家族达到鼎盛。他于1590年归顺丰臣秀吉，1600年在长谷堂城抵御上杉景胜。义光1614年去世后继承纷争不断，家族于1622年被改易，子孙成为近江旗本。

en:
The Moghlot were the ruling house of Nagar, the Burusho valley-state on the southern bank of the Hunza river, and took their name from the twin brother of Girkis, eponym of Hunza's older royal line. Burusho tradition makes Moghlot and Girkis sons of Mayroo Khan, the first Muslim thum of Nagar; their father divided his lands between them, and the Moghlot kept the southern bank, which became Nagar.

Nagar emerged as an autonomous state in the 1300s and was ruled by this family under the title thum, later mir. Its people held to Twelver Shi'ism even while neighbouring Hunza was pressed toward Sunnism, and the Moghlot line survived the wars that followed the fall of Trakhan Gilgit around 1810.
zh:
莫格洛特家族是讷格尔的统治世家。讷格尔是罕萨河南岸的布鲁绍人河谷邦国，家族得名于罕萨更早王世同名始祖吉尔基斯的孪生兄弟。布鲁绍传说称，莫格洛特与吉尔基斯是讷格尔首位穆斯林图姆迈鲁汗所生的双胞胎；父亲将土地分给二人，莫格洛特一支保有河南岸，即后来的讷格尔。

讷格尔在14世纪成为自治小邦，该家族以图姆（后称米尔）之号世代统治。居民信奉十二伊玛目派什叶派，即便邻近的罕萨后来被迫转向逊尼派也未改变；特剌汗治下的吉尔吉特约于1810年衰落后，莫格洛特一支又在随之而来的混战中存续下来。

en: The Mulucci were a Guelph family of Macerata in the Marche who held the city's signoria from about 1321 to the mid-fourteenth century before the Da Varano of Camerino overshadowed them. One member, the Franciscan Pietro Mulucci, was bishop of Senigallia from 1323 until his death in 1347.
zh: 穆卢奇是马尔凯马切拉塔的圭尔夫派家族，约1321年起领有该城的领主政权，14世纪中叶后被卡梅里诺的达·瓦拉诺家族盖过；其成员方济各会修士彼得罗·穆卢奇于1323年至1347年去世前任塞尼加利亚主教。

en:
The Momonoi were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house, descended from the Seiwa Genji. In 1225 Ashikaga Yoshikane's son Yoshisuke was appointed steward of Momonoi Manor in Kōzuke, and Yoshisuke's son Yoshitane took Momonoi as his family name.

At the fall of the shogunate in 1333, Momonoi Naotsune and his brother Nobunobu marched with Ashikaga Takauji against the Rokuhara deputies, while a kinsman joined Nitta Yoshisada's assault on Kamakura. During the Nanboku-chō wars the family divided between the Northern and Southern courts.

Naotsune, a famed general and shugo of Etchū, sided with Ashikaga Tadayoshi in the Kannō Disturbance of 1350 to 1352 and remained an enemy of Takauji; his line declined. Other Momonoi served the Muromachi shoguns, and the priest Nichiryū founded Honnō-ji, the temple of the 1582 incident.
zh:
桃井氏是足利氏的庶流，属清和源氏。1225年，足利义兼之子义助出任上野国桃井乡庄司，义助之子义胤遂以桃井为苗字。

1333年镰仓幕府灭亡之际，桃井直常、直信兄弟随足利尊氏攻打六波罗探题，同族一人则加入新田义贞的镰仓攻城军。南北朝动乱中，桃井一族又分属北朝与南朝。

以骁将闻名、官至越中国守护的直常在1350—1352年的观应之扰乱中追随足利直义，此后始终与尊氏为敌，其支流逐渐衰落。另有桃井族人出仕室町幕府，族人日隆则开创了因1582年本能寺之变而闻名的本能寺。

en:
The Montagus, also written Montacute and Latinised de Monte Acuto meaning from the sharp mountain, were founded in Somerset after the Norman Conquest of 1066 by Drogo de Montagud.

The family reached the front rank under William Montagu, the closest companion of Edward III: he helped seize Roger Mortimer in 1330, received the Isle of Man, and was created Earl of Salisbury in 1337.

William died of tournament wounds in 1344. His successors sold the Isle of Man in 1392, and John, the third earl, was executed in 1400 for his part in the Epiphany Rising. Thomas Montagu, fourth earl, died of wounds at the siege of Orleans; his daughter Alice married Richard Neville, who took the Salisbury earldom, and their son was Warwick the Kingmaker. The old male line ended in the Neville inheritance.
zh:
蒙塔古家族又拼作Montacute，拉丁化写法de Monte Acuto意为“来自尖山”。1066年诺曼征服后，德罗戈·德·蒙塔古在萨默塞特开创家业。

威廉·蒙塔古使家族跻身一流贵族：他是爱德华三世最亲密的伙伴，1330年参与抓捕罗杰·莫蒂默，受封马恩岛，1337年受封索尔兹伯里伯爵。

威廉于1344年死于比武受伤。后继者1392年卖掉马恩岛；第三代伯爵约翰因参与主显节起事1400年被处死。第四代伯爵托马斯在奥尔良围城战中伤重而亡；其女艾丽斯嫁给理查德·内维尔，索尔兹伯里伯爵头衔转入内维尔家。他们的儿子是“拥立国王者”沃里克，蒙塔古男系并入内维尔家。

en:
The Montaldo were a Genoese noble family whose origins are placed in the Oltregiogo around Gavi. The judge Paolo Montaldo raised the family's standing; its most prominent figure was his son Leonardo, born in 1319 in the Polcevera valley.

Leonardo served Genoa as consul at Caffa in 1351 and as ambassador to Castile. Two failed attempts to seize power in 1365 and 1366 sent him into exile until 1371. He led the Genoese delegation at the Peace of Turin that ended the War of Chioggia with Venice, and in April 1383 he was elected doge after the fall of Domenico Fregoso.

As doge he freed King James I of Cyprus in exchange for Genoese control of Famagusta and won popularity with fiscal reforms, but died of plague in June 1384. His son Antonio Montaldo later became doge in 1392.
zh:
蒙塔尔多是热那亚的贵族家族，祖籍一般认为在奥尔特雷焦戈的加维一带。法官保罗·蒙塔尔多提升了家族地位；家族最显赫的人物是他1319年生于波尔切韦拉河谷的儿子莱奥纳尔多。

莱奥纳尔多曾于1351年出任热那亚在卡法的领事，还担任过驻卡斯蒂利亚使节。1365年和1366年两次夺权失败后他被迫流亡，直到1371年才获召回。他率领热那亚代表团参加结束与威尼斯的基奥贾战争的都灵和谈，并在1383年4月多梅尼科·弗雷戈索倒台后当选总督。

任内他释放塞浦路斯国王詹姆斯一世，换取热那亚对法马古斯塔的控制，又以财税改革赢得民心，但在1384年6月死于鼠疫。他的儿子安东尼奥·蒙塔尔多后来于1392年出任总督。

en:
The Da Monteverde were a noble family of Fermo in the Marche, descended from the lords of Brunforte, who held fiefs around the city. Its earliest documented head, Fidesmido da Monteverde, was podesta of Fermo around the middle of the thirteenth century.

The family rose with the Ghibelline leader Mercenario da Monteverde, who took up arms in 1318 and in 1323 defeated the Guelphs at the battle of Osimo. In 1331 he seized Fermo by a coup and ruled it as signore, defying Pope Benedict XII's summons to submit to the Church.

In 1340 conspirators ambushed and killed him while he was riding outside the city, and chroniclers remembered him as a tyrant and enemy of the Church. His kinsmen could not sustain the signoria, and the family died out in 1380, its claims passing through the heiress Vannetta.
zh:
达·蒙泰韦尔德是马尔凯地区费尔莫的贵族家族，出身布伦福尔特领主，领有城市周边的封地。家族最早可考的家主菲德斯米多·达·蒙泰韦尔德在13世纪中叶曾任费尔莫行政长官。

家族的崛起依靠吉伯林派首领梅尔切纳里奥·达·蒙泰韦尔德：他于1318年起兵，1323年在奥西莫战役中击败圭尔夫派军队。1331年，他发动政变夺取费尔莫，以领主身份统治，拒绝教宗本笃十二世要求他臣服教会的命令。

1340年，密谋者趁他出城骑马时伏击并杀死了他，编年史家把他记作僭主和教会之敌。他的族人未能维持领主政权，家族于1380年绝嗣，权利经女继承人万内塔转归他人。

en:
The House of Montfaucon was a Franche-Comte noble family named after its castle east of Besancon; its lords are recorded from the mid-eleventh century as vassals of the counts of Burgundy. In 1123—1124 they founded Cistercian Lucelle abbey, and Richard II's marriage to Sophie of Montbeliard let their son Amadeus II inherit the county in 1163.

Amadeus (died 1195) carried the house into the Vaud country, buying half of Orbe from Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1168. After 1227 the Montbeliard and Montfaucon inheritances were split between brothers, and when the Montbeliard line failed, Henry I of the younger branch recovered the county in 1339 by marrying Agnes, its heiress.

Henry's son Stephen, count from 1367, was the last male: his son Henry II fell at Nicopolis in 1396, and when Stephen died in 1397 the lands passed to three granddaughters. Henriette, who took Montbeliard, married Count Eberhard IV of Wurttemberg in 1407, carrying it into the Wurttemberg-Montbeliard line.
zh:
蒙福孔家族是弗朗什-孔泰的贵族世家，得名于贝桑松以东的蒙福孔城堡；11世纪中叶起，其领主作为勃艮第伯爵的封臣见于记载。1123—1124年，家族创立熙笃会吕塞勒修道院；理查二世娶蒙贝利亚尔的索菲，其子阿梅代二世遂于1163年继承蒙贝利亚尔伯国。

卒于1195年的阿梅代把家族势力带入沃地区，1168年从皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨手中购得奥尔布的一半。1227年以后，蒙贝利亚尔与蒙福孔两份遗产由兄弟两支分承；蒙贝利亚尔支系绝嗣后，幼支的亨利于1339年凭借与女继承人阿涅丝的婚姻收回伯国。

亨利之子艾蒂安自1367年起任伯爵，是家族最后一位男嗣：其子亨利二世1396年战死于尼科波利斯，1397年艾蒂安去世后，领地由三个孙女瓜分。继承蒙贝利亚尔的亨利埃特于1407年嫁给符腾堡伯爵埃伯哈德四世，伯国转入符腾堡-蒙贝利亚尔支系之手。

en:
The Montfort-Bregenz were the Bregenz branch of the counts of Montfort, a Swabian dynasty sprung from the counts palatine of Tübingen. Hugo II of Tübingen inherited the former county of Bregenz through his wife Elizabeth, and from about 1170 a younger line ruled it as counts of Montfort-Bregenz on Lake Constance.

This first line died out in 1338; the lands were passed to the Montfort-Tettnang branch, which from 1354 took the name Montfort-Tettnang-Bregenz and split into elder and younger lordships in 1379. Hugo of Montfort, a Minnesang poet and statesman born in 1357, inherited the Styrian counts of Pfannberg's estates through his wife in 1362 and founded a Styrian branch.

Elizabeth of Hochberg, heiress of Count William VII, sold the elder part of Bregenz to the Habsburgs in 1451, and the rest followed in 1523. The Styrian line inherited the Tettnang lands in 1574 and survived until the Montfort house became extinct in 1787.
zh:
蒙特福特‑布雷根茨是蒙特福特伯爵的布雷根茨支系。蒙特福特是源出图宾根行宫伯爵的施瓦本家族。雨果二世通过妻子伊丽莎白继承布雷根茨伯国；约从1170年起，一条幼支以蒙特福特‑布雷根茨伯爵身份统治博登湖沿岸。

该支于1338年绝嗣，领地由泰特南支接续，1354年起称蒙特福特‑泰特南‑布雷根茨，1379年分成年长与年幼两支领地。1357年出生的诗人兼政治家雨果·冯·蒙特福特于1362年通过妻子继承施蒂里亚普凡贝格伯爵产业，开创施蒂里亚支系。

威廉七世伯爵的女继承人霍赫贝格的伊丽莎白于1451年把布雷根茨领地的年长部分卖给哈布斯堡，剩余部分于1523年售出。施蒂里亚支于1574年继承泰特南，延续到1787年家族绝嗣。

en:
The House of Montfort-l'Amaury was an Ile-de-France noble house, a cadet branch of Hainaut's counts. Hugh Capet enfeoffed Guillaume de Montfort; his heirs built Montfort-l'Amaury, named for Amaury I. Simon I married Agnes of Evreux, gaining the county; his daughter Bertrade, wed to Fulk IV, Philip I carried off and married.

Simon III's marriage to Leicester heiress Amicia opened the family's English career. His son Simon IV led the Albigensian Crusade from 1209, became count of Toulouse and fell there in 1218; his son Amaury ceded those claims to Louis VIII in 1224.

The younger Simon, earl of Leicester, married King John's daughter Eleanor and led revolt against Henry III, capturing him at Lewes in 1264 and falling at Evesham in 1265; Montfort-l'Amaury passed to the House of Dreux. The name survived through Yolande, wed to Arthur II of Brittany in 1292: their John of Montfort won the Breton succession at Auray in 1364, his line ruling Brittany until the male line died with Francis II in 1488.
zh:
蒙福尔拉莫里家族是法兰西岛贵族世家，为埃诺伯爵家族的幼支。于格·卡佩封给纪尧姆·德·蒙福尔一处领地，其后人修建蒙福尔拉莫里城堡，以阿莫里一世命名。西蒙一世娶埃夫勒的阿涅丝，得到埃夫勒伯国；女儿贝尔特拉德已嫁富尔克四世，被腓力一世夺走娶为王后。

西蒙三世与莱斯特女继承人阿米西娅的联姻打开家族的英格兰门路。其子西蒙四世1209年起统领阿尔比十字军，成为图卢兹伯爵，1218年在图卢兹城下被杀；西蒙四世之子阿莫里1224年把权益让给路易八世。

小西蒙是莱斯特伯爵，娶约翰王之女埃莉诺，领导反对亨利三世的叛乱，1264年刘易斯战役生擒国王，1265年伊夫舍姆战役兵败被杀，蒙福尔拉莫里落入德勒家族。家名靠约兰德延续：她1292年嫁给布列塔尼公爵阿尔蒂尔二世，其子让·德·蒙福尔1364年在欧赖战役赢得布列塔尼继承战争，后人以公爵身份统治布列塔尼，男系至1488年弗朗索瓦二世终结。

en:
The Montfort-Feldkirch were the Feldkirch branch of the counts of Montfort, a Swabian dynasty descended from the counts palatine of Tübingen. Hugo II of Tübingen, who died in 1182, inherited the old counts of Bregenz's lands through his wife Elizabeth; his son Hugo III styled himself Hugo of Montfort from about 1200 and founded Feldkirch and the Schattenburg castle.

The Schattenburg became the centre of the lordship, joined by Burg Neu-Montfort around 1311. The counts gave their town a city law modelled on Lindau's, and medieval Feldkirch outgrew Bregenz in population and wealth.

A feud involving Count Rudolf III began the line's decline and opened the door to Habsburg influence in Vorarlberg. In 1375 Burgrave Rudolf IV sold the Feldkirch lordship to Duke Leopold III of Austria; by 1390 the territory had passed entirely to the Habsburgs.
zh:
蒙特福特‑费尔德基希家族是施瓦本蒙特福特伯爵的费尔德基希支系，出自图宾根行宫伯爵。1182年去世的图宾根的雨果二世通过妻子伊丽莎白继承老布雷根茨伯爵的领地；其子雨果三世约从1200年起自称蒙特福特的雨果，创建费尔德基希和沙滕堡。

沙滕堡成为领地的中心，约1311年又兴建了新蒙特福特堡。伯爵们以林道法为蓝本给予城市法，使中世纪的费尔德基希在人口和富庶程度上超过布雷根茨。

一场牵涉伯爵鲁道夫三世的私战开启了家族的衰落，也让哈布斯堡势力进入福拉尔贝格。1375年，城堡伯爵鲁道夫四世把费尔德基希领地卖给奥地利公爵利奥波德三世，到1390年这片领土已完全归于哈布斯堡。

en:
The House of Montoire was a noble family of the Loire valley. Its first known ancestor Hubert held Langeais castle as a vassal of Fulk Nerra of Anjou around 1000. About 1073 Hamelin II married Helvise, heiress of Montoire on the Loir, and his descendants took its name.

Pierre II de Montoire married Agnes, daughter of Count Bouchard IV of Vendome. Their son John inherited the county from his uncle around 1218, ruling as John IV and joining Montoire permanently to Vendome. His line ended in 1412 with Countess Catherine.

Catherine had married John I of Bourbon-La Marche, and the inheritance passed to the Bourbon-Vendome branch. The county became a duchy-peerage in 1515; Catherine was an ancestor of Henry IV, who held it before taking the French throne in 1589.
zh:
蒙图瓦尔家族是卢瓦尔河谷的贵族世家。始祖于贝尔在1000年前后以安茹的富尔克·内拉封臣身份镇守朗热城堡。约1073年，阿姆兰二世娶卢瓦河畔蒙图瓦尔领地的女继承人埃尔薇丝，后代便以蒙图瓦尔为姓。

皮埃尔二世·德·蒙图瓦尔娶旺多姆伯爵布沙尔四世之女阿涅丝，其子让在1218年前后从舅父继承伯国，称让四世，蒙图瓦尔从此与旺多姆合为一体。这一支于1412年随女伯爵卡特琳去世而断绝。

卡特琳嫁给波旁-拉马什的让一世，遗产随之转入波旁-旺多姆支系。伯国于1515年升格为公爵领；卡特琳也是亨利四世的祖先，后者在1589年登上法兰西王位之前便领有此地。

en:
The Mōri were a samurai clan. Their founder Mōri Suemitsu (1202–1247), son of Ōe no Hiromoto, took his name from the Mōri estate in Sagami Province. He was made steward in Aki after the Jōkyū War of 1221, joined the Miura against the Hōjō in 1247 and killed himself in defeat. His son Tsunemitsu's line survived.

The Aki line held Yoshida, kept its distance from the Kenmu Restoration of 1333 and followed Ashikaga Takauji. Mōri Motonari (1497–1571) made it a Sengoku daimyō house.

Motonari formed the Two Rivers system through the Kikkawa and Kobayakawa houses, defeated Sue Harukata at Itsukushima in 1555 and overthrew the Amago in 1566. His grandson Terumoto submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi, but as nominal head of the western army at Sekigahara in 1600 lost the eastern provinces and kept only Nagato and Suō, the future Chōshū Domain.
zh:
毛利氏是武士家族。始祖毛利季光（1202—1247）是大江广元之子，因相模国的毛利庄而以毛利为姓。1221年承久之乱后他被任为安艺地头；1247年他联合三浦氏反抗北条氏，兵败自尽，儿子经光一脉存续。

安艺毛利氏领有吉田庄，对1333年的建武新政保持距离，追随足利尊氏。毛利元就（1497—1571）使家族成为战国大名。

元就通过吉川氏与小早川氏建立毛利两川体制，1555年在严岛之战击破陶晴贤，1566年攻灭尼子氏。其孙辉元臣从丰臣秀吉，1600年在关原之战中名义上总领西军，战败后被削去东部领地，仅余长门、周防，即后来的长州藩。

en:
The Morosini were one of the oldest patrician houses of Venice, said to have settled in the lagoon before the tenth century; they crushed their rivals the Caloprini in the late tenth century. They gave the Republic four doges and many generals and admirals. Doge Domenico Morosini, elected in 1148, led Venice's expansion into the Adriatic against Dalmatian corsairs and the cities of Istria.

On the Fourth Crusade the family supplied Domenico and Sebastiano Morosini among the crusader captains, while the monk Tommaso Morosini became the first Latin Patriarch of Constantinople in 1204. Through marriage Tomasina Morosini became queen of Hungary and mother of King Andrew III. Antonio Morosini chronicled the city's affairs in the early fifteenth century in the Morosini Codex.

After a quieter period the family rose again with Francesco Morosini, captain-general in the Morean War against the Ottomans, who conquered the Peloponnese and was elected doge in 1688, the first doge since Enrico Dandolo to lead a great fleet in person.
zh:
莫罗西尼家族是威尼斯最古老的贵族世家之一，据说10世纪以前已定居潟湖，并在10世纪末压垮对手卡洛普里尼家族。家族为共和国贡献了四位总督和大批将领、海军统帅。1148年当选的总督多梅尼科·莫罗西尼领导威尼斯在亚得里亚海扩张，征讨达尔马提亚海盗和伊斯特拉诸城。

第四次十字军东征时，家族的多梅尼科和塞巴斯蒂亚诺·莫罗西尼担任十字军将领，修士托马索·莫罗西尼于1204年成为君士坦丁堡首任拉丁宗主教。通过联姻，托马西娜·莫罗西尼成为匈牙利王后，是国王安德拉什三世的母亲。安东尼奥·莫罗西尼在15世纪初以《莫罗西尼抄本》记录威尼斯大事。

经历一段相对沉寂后，家族因弗朗切斯科·莫罗西尼再度崛起：他在对抗奥斯曼人的摩里亚战争中任海军统帅，征服伯罗奔尼撒，1688年当选总督，是恩里科·丹多洛之后首位亲率大舰队出征的在任总督。

en:
The lords of Moers, first documented as Elger and Theodoric de Murse in 1186, began as vassals of the Archbishops of Cologne on the Lower Rhine. Theodoric I, attested from 1226, is the first known ruling count of the small county around Moers Castle.

Theodoric II fought on the Cologne side at Worringen in 1288, and in 1361 the family secured a declaration from Cleves that Moers was not a Cleves fief. The house reached its highest standing through the church: a younger son, Theodoric of Moers, was Archbishop of Cologne from 1414 to 1463.

The comital line died out in 1578. The county was disputed between Orange-Nassau and Cleves, occupied by Maurice of Orange in 1601, and passed to Brandenburg-Prussia in 1702, which raised it to a principality in 1705.
zh:
莫尔斯家族是下莱茵地区的小邦统治者，1186年以贵族埃尔格和迪特里希·德·穆尔塞的名字首次见于文献，起初是科隆大主教的封臣。1226年起有记载的迪特里希一世是第一位可确考的在位伯爵，领地以默尔斯城堡为中心。

迪特里希二世在1288年的沃林根战役中站在科隆一方作战；1361年家族取得克莱沃的声明，确认默尔斯并非克莱沃的采邑。家族的最高地位来自教会：一位幼子迪特里希·冯·莫尔斯在1414—1463年任科隆大主教。

伯爵男系于1578年断绝，伯国由奥兰治-拿骚与克莱沃争夺，1601年被拿骚的莫里斯占领，1702年并入勃兰登堡-普鲁士，1705年升格为侯国。

en:
The Mortimers were a Norman family named after Mortemer in Normandy. After the Conquest they became marcher lords at Wigmore Castle. In 1301 Roger Mortimer married the heiress Joan de Geneville, gaining Ludlow and lands in the Welsh Marches and Ireland.

Roger led a war against Edward II in 1322, escaped the Tower of London and returned from France with Queen Isabella, his lover. They deposed Edward in 1327. Created Earl of March in 1328, Roger was overthrown by Edward III and hanged in 1330, leaving the house attainted and its heir underage in 1337.

His grandson recovered the earldom. Marriage into Lionel of Antwerp's line made the Mortimers heirs presumptive to Richard II. Their claim passed to the House of York; the direct Mortimer line ended in 1425, and Edward IV won the throne at Towton in 1461.
zh:
莫蒂默家族是诺曼人，得名于诺曼底的莫尔蒂默。诺曼征服后他们以威格莫尔城堡为根基，成为边疆贵族。1301年罗杰迎娶女继承人琼·德·热纳维尔，得到拉德洛及威尔士边疆和爱尔兰领地。

1322年，罗杰率领反对爱德华二世的战争，逃出伦敦塔后，与情人伊莎贝拉王后从法国返回。两人于1327年废黜爱德华。罗杰1328年受封马奇伯爵，1330年被爱德华三世推翻并绞死，1337年家族爵位被夺，继承人年幼。

其孙恢复伯爵爵位。与安特卫普的莱昂内尔一系联姻使家族成为理查二世的推定继承人。继承权转入约克家族；莫蒂默嫡系于1425年断绝，1461年爱德华四世在陶顿获胜登基。

en:
The House of Mowbray was an Anglo-Norman family named after Montbray in Normandy. Its English lands passed through Nigel d'Aubigny to his son Roger. A later William was among the twenty-five barons charged with enforcing Magna Carta in 1215.

A later Roger de Mowbray became the first Lord Mowbray under Edward I. His son John joined Lancaster's revolt and was captured at Boroughbridge and hanged at York in 1322; his marriage to a Braose heiress had brought Gower and Bramber. His son John was held in the Tower until 1327, served Edward III and died of plague in 1361.

Marriage to the Segrave heiress brought the earldom of Nottingham and the earl marshalship. In 1397 Richard II made Thomas Mowbray Duke of Norfolk. The direct line ended with the child Anne in 1481, and the Norfolk inheritance passed to the Howard family.
zh:
莫布雷家族是盎格鲁-诺曼贵族世家，得名于诺曼底的蒙布雷。英格兰领地经奈杰尔·多比尼传给其子罗杰。威廉是1215年监督《大宪章》的二十五名男爵之一。

后来的罗杰·德·莫布雷在爱德华一世治下成为第一代男爵。其子约翰加入兰开斯特伯爵的叛乱，1322年在巴勒布里奇被俘，绞死于约克；他与布劳斯女继承人的婚姻已带来高尔和布兰伯。其子约翰被囚伦敦塔至1327年，后来为爱德华三世效力，1361年染鼠疫而死。

家族与塞格雷夫女继承人联姻，得到诺丁汉伯爵衔与军务伯爵之职。1397年理查二世封托马斯·莫布雷为诺福克公爵。嫡系随年幼的安妮于1481年夭亡而断绝，诺福克遗产转入霍华德家族。

en:
The Muhannids, or Banu Muhanna, were a Husaynid dynasty ruling Medina on and off from about 940 into the sixteenth century. As descendants of Muhammad through Ali and Husayn they professed Twelver Shiʿism. Ubayd Allah ibn Tahir seized power as Abbasid authority crumbled.

The sharifs generally accepted the overlordship of Egypt's rulers. Qasim ibn Muhanna, a confidant of Saladin, held Mecca for three days in 1176. From 1283 the Mamluks tightened their grip and installed a Sunni imam in the Prophet's Mosque. Cairo later claimed the right to appoint Medina's emir; Wudayy ibn Jammaz, head of a rival branch, ruled from 1336 to 1343, and the family was expelled temporarily from 1350 to 1357.

In the fifteenth century Medina was subordinated to the Sharif of Mecca. After the Ottoman conquest of Egypt in 1517, the emirate was absorbed into Ottoman administration of the holy cities.
zh:
穆罕尼德家族又称巴努·穆罕纳，是侯赛因系圣裔王朝，约940年至16世纪断续统治麦地那。他们是穆罕默德经阿里和侯赛因传下的后裔，信奉十二伊玛目派什叶派。阿拔斯政权瓦解时，欧拜杜拉·伊本·塔希尔夺取政权。

麦地那谢里夫通常臣属埃及统治者。萨拉丁亲信卡西姆·伊本·穆罕纳于1176年占据麦加三天。1283年起马穆鲁克加强控制，在先知寺设立逊尼派伊玛目。开罗后来声称有权任命麦地那埃米尔；支系首领伍代伊·伊本·贾马兹于1336—1343年统治麦地那，家族于1350—1357年一度被逐。

15世纪麦地那被置于麦加谢里夫之下。1517年奥斯曼征服埃及后，埃米尔国并入两圣城行政体系。

en:
The Muirs, also spelled Mure, were a knightly family of Ayrshire in southwest Scotland; their surname comes from the Scots word more, meaning moor or fen. The family held Polkelly near Kilmarnock before Sir Gilchrist Mure helped secure Rowallan Castle through his service at the Battle of Largs in 1263.

Sir Adam Mure of Rowallan was the father of Elizabeth Mure. She formed a secular union with Robert Stewart, High Steward of Scotland and the future Robert II, around 1336; after a papal dispensation they remarried in 1349.

She died before 1355, but her sons included Robert III and Robert Stewart, Duke of Albany, and doubts over the validity of her marriage fed later succession disputes. The Muirs went on holding Rowallan for centuries.
zh:
缪尔家族（又拼穆尔）是苏格兰西南部艾尔郡的骑士家族，姓氏源自苏格兰语more，意为荒原或沼泽。家族早先领有基尔马诺克附近的波尔凯利，后来吉尔克里斯特·缪尔爵士在1263年的拉格斯战役中立功，帮助家族取得罗阿伦城堡。

罗阿伦的亚当·缪尔爵士之女是伊丽莎白·缪尔。约1336年，她与苏格兰王室大管家、后来的罗伯特二世罗伯特·斯图尔特缔结世俗婚姻；在取得教皇特许后，两人于1349年重新举行婚礼。

她在1355年前去世，所生诸子包括罗伯特三世和奥尔巴尼公爵罗伯特·斯图尔特，而她婚姻效力的争议后来引发了继承纠纷。缪尔家族此后保有罗阿伦达数百年之久。

en:
The Muknes were a Koli chiefly house ruling Jawhar in the northern Konkan. Their founder Jayabha Mukne, also called Paupera, seized Jawhar fort in 1306. His son Dulbar Rao expanded the chiefship to twenty-two forts. In 1343 Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq recognised him, giving him the name Nem Shah and the hereditary title of Raja; Jawhar began its own calendar era.

A later raja, Deobar Rao, was captured fighting the Bahmani sultan Ahmad Shah, converted to Islam and married the sultan's daughter. After his death Hindu nobles rejected his Muslim son and restored a Hindu cadet line.

Raja Vikram Shah joined Shivaji in the sack of Surat in 1664, but Maratha armies occupied Jawhar in 1742, 1758 and 1761, each time restoring the Muknes for land and tribute. By 1782 the raja held only a small hill territory; the house later came under British paramountcy.
zh:
穆克内家族是科利人的酋长世家，统治北孔卡尼的贾瓦尔。始祖贾亚巴·穆克内又称保佩拉，1306年夺取贾瓦尔堡。其子杜尔巴尔·拉奥将领地扩至22座堡垒。1343年苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克承认其统治，赐名内姆沙并授予世袭罗阇称号；贾瓦尔为此创立纪年。

后来的罗阇德奥巴尔·拉奥与巴赫曼尼苏丹艾哈迈德沙作战时被俘，改宗伊斯兰教并娶苏丹之女。他死后印度教贵族拒绝承认其穆斯林儿子，改立印度教旁支后裔。

罗阇维克拉姆沙曾随希瓦吉参与1664年洗劫苏拉特，马拉塔军队于1742、1758和1761年占领贾瓦尔，以割地加贡为条件归还。1782年罗阇只剩山地小领地，后来归入英国宗主权之下。

en:
The Mulai were the lords of Kuhistan, the mountain country of southern Khorasan whose chief city was Qaen. On the collapse of the Ilkhanate in 1335, 'Abd-Allah b. Mulai joined the princes of eastern Iran in accepting Togha Temür as Ilkhan, and in 1337 he and Arghun Shah withdrew their troops from the western campaign at Bistam.

A kinsman, Muhammad-i Mulai, was appointed governor of Khurasan by the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg, but Togha Temür and Arghun Shah defeated and executed him later that year. 'Abd-Allah remained Togha Temür's ally against the Sarbadars until he was killed, together with the vizier Faryumadi, in the khan's defeat of 29 July 1342.
zh:
穆莱家族是库希斯坦的领主，库希斯坦即南呼罗珊的山地区域，以加延为首府。1335年伊利汗国瓦解时，阿卜杜拉·本·穆莱与东伊朗诸王公一同拥立脱合帖木儿为伊利汗；1337年，他和阿儿浑沙一起在比斯塔姆撤离西征。

他的族人穆罕默德·穆莱被札剌亦儿人哈桑·布祖格任命为呼罗珊长官，但同年被脱合帖木儿和阿儿浑沙击败并处死。阿卜杜拉始终是脱合帖木儿对抗萨尔巴达尔人的盟友，直到1342年7月29日在汗廷的败战中与维齐尔法鲁马迪一同阵亡。

en:
The Munakata were an ancient maritime clan of Chikuzen in northern Kyūshū, also recorded as Munakata no Kimi, ruling the Munakata district and Genkai Sea waters while serving as hereditary priests of Munakata Taisha, shrine of three goddesses. After the 645 Taika reform it headed the shrine's sacred district, and in 979 the court created the daiguji, or chief priest, post for them.

Maritime wealth brought marriage ties with Hakata's Chinese merchants; Kamakura gokenin, the Munakata fought the Mongol invasion of 1281 and won an estate in Hizen. In 1333 they helped overthrow the Chinzei deputy, and from 1336 backed Ashikaga Takauji, fighting at Tatara-hama and holding Iki as shugo.

Through the fifteenth century they balanced between the Ōuchi and Shōni, leaning to the Ōuchi to preserve the clan. Caught in the sixteenth-century wars, the clan's last head, Munakata Ujisada, died of disease in 1587 without an heir, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi confiscated its lands in the Kyūshū campaign.
zh:
宗像氏又作宗形氏、胸形君，是九州北部筑前国的古老海洋豪族，世代奉祀宗像大社的宗像三女神，同时统治宗像地方及玄界滩海域。645年大化改新后，宗像氏掌管神社神郡，979年朝廷设置大宫司职，由其家族世袭。

凭借海上贸易之利，宗像氏与博多的中国商人世代联姻，镰仓时代成为幕府御家人，1281年弘安之役抗击元军，获封肥前的庄园。1333年参与攻灭镇西探题，1336年投效足利尊氏，在多多良滨之战中力战，后任壹岐守护。

15世纪，宗像氏夹在大内氏与少贰氏之间，靠拢大内氏保住家名。16世纪被战乱裹挟，1587年末代当主宗像氏贞病死无嗣，丰臣秀吉在九州平定中没收其领地。

en:
The Senn von Münsingen were a knightly ministerial family of the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries, holding lands around Münsingen in the Aare basin and later near Buchegg and Balmegg. Johannes von Münsingen first used the surname Senn in 1241. The family served the counts of Kyburg and the prince-bishop of Basel and married into neighbouring houses.

Many sons entered the church. Johann was elected Bishop of Basel in 1335 and opened the city council to craftsmen in 1337. In the Aare basin wars the family backed its overlords against Bern and Solothurn, whose troops repeatedly sacked its castles.

Emperor Charles IV made Burkhard a baron in 1360, but the house could not keep its rank. Around 1410 the last heir Elisabeth sold the lordships of Münsingen, Buchegg and Diessenberg to Bern, Solothurn and Thun.
zh:
森·冯·明辛根是13至14世纪的骑士侍从家族，在阿勒河流域的明辛根及后来的布赫埃格、巴尔梅格附近拥有土地。约翰内斯·冯·明辛根于1241年最先使用森这一家姓。家族为基堡伯爵和巴塞尔采邑主教效力，并与邻近家族联姻。

许多子弟投身教会。约翰于1335年当选巴塞尔主教，1337年准许工匠进入市议会。阿勒河流域的战争中，家族支持领主对抗伯尔尼和索洛图恩，城堡屡遭两城军队拆毁。

1360年皇帝查理四世封布克哈德为男爵，但家族未能保住地位。约1410年，末代继承人伊丽莎白把明辛根、布赫埃格和迪森贝格领地分别卖给伯尔尼、索洛图恩和图恩。

en:
The Murrays descend from Freskin, a twelfth-century Flemish knight granted lands in Moray and West Lothian by David I. His descendants took the surname de Moravia, meaning of Moray, which became Murray. The senior branch built Bothwell Castle into one of Scotland's greatest strongholds.

Andrew Moray led the rising of 1297 with William Wallace and was mortally wounded after victory at Stirling Bridge. His posthumous son Sir Andrew Murray (1298-1338) inherited Bothwell, married Robert the Bruce's sister Christina and twice served as Guardian of Scotland during the Second War of Independence, fighting Edward Balliol and the English.

In 1360 Bothwell passed to the Douglases. The chiefship later moved to the Murrays of Tullibardine, who became Earls of Atholl in 1626 and Duke of Atholl in 1703. The family largely backed the Stuart cause in the eighteenth-century Jacobite risings.
zh:
默里家族先祖是12世纪佛兰德斯骑士弗雷斯金，大卫一世封给他马里和西洛锡安的土地。后裔取姓氏de Moravia，意为马里的，后来演变为默里。主支修建的博思韦尔城堡成为苏格兰最坚固的要塞之一。

安德鲁·默里于1297年与威廉·华莱士举兵，在斯特灵桥大捷后伤重而亡。遗腹子安德鲁·默里爵士（1298—1338）继承博思韦尔，娶罗伯特一世之妹克里斯蒂娜，在第二次苏格兰独立战争中两度出任摄政，打击爱德华·巴利奥尔和英格兰势力。

1360年博思韦尔转入道格拉斯家族之手。图利巴丁支系继承族长之位，1626年受封阿索尔伯爵，1703年升公爵。家族在18世纪詹姆斯党起事中大体支持斯图亚特王室。

en: The Muş were the Kurdish lords of the town of Muş in the Taron plain, a small fourteenth-century emirate within the orbit of the Bitlis princes under Kara Koyunlu overlordship. Timur took the town without a battle in 1387, and it later passed to the Aq Qoyunlu, the Safavids and the Ottomans.
zh: 穆什家族是塔隆平原穆什城的库尔德统治者，14世纪时是比特利斯王公势力范围内的一个小埃米尔国，与比特利斯同受黑羊王朝羁縻。1387年帖木儿兵不血刃地拿下该城，此后穆什又相继转入白羊王朝、萨非王朝和奥斯曼帝国之手。

en:
The Mushana Rajput dynasty, of the Chamial clan, ruled the Himalayan state of Chamba in an almost unbroken line from the sixth century. Claiming solar-lineage descent from Ayodhya, its founder Maru settled at Bharmour around 550.

Mushan Varman married the daughter of the raja of Suket and rose to power; legend says he was named for the mice that guarded him as an abandoned baby. Around 920 Sahila Varman moved the capital from Bharmour to Champavati, later called Chamba and said to be named for his daughter.

Ganesa Varman (r. 1512-1559) built Ganeshgarh fortress, and his son Pratap Singh Varman seized Guler in wars with Kangra. Sheltered by its mountains, Chamba largely escaped direct conquest, accepting only nominal Mughal suzerainty under Jahangir.
zh:
穆沙纳拉杰普特王朝属昌米亚尔氏族，自6世纪起以几乎未曾中断的世系统治喜马拉雅山地邦昌巴。家族自称日族后裔、源出阿约提亚，始祖马鲁约于550年定居巴尔毛尔。

穆尚·瓦尔曼迎娶苏凯特罗阇之女而得势；传说他幼年被弃，由鼠群守护，因此得名。约920年，萨希拉·瓦尔曼将都城从巴尔毛尔迁至昌帕瓦蒂，即后来的昌巴，据说城名得自他的女儿。

加内萨·瓦尔曼（1512—1559年在位）修建加内什加尔堡，其子普拉塔普·辛格·瓦尔曼在与冈格拉的战争中夺取古莱尔。凭借群山屏障，昌巴大体免于直接征服，在贾汉吉尔时期仅名义上承认莫卧儿的宗主权。

en:
The Musunuri Nayakas were Telugu warrior chiefs who rose in the lower Godavari country after the fall of the Kakatiya kingdom of Warangal to the Delhi Sultanate. Around 1330 Musunuri Prolaya Nayaka established himself at Rekapalle, near Bhadrachalam, claiming the Kakatiya heritage.

His successor Kapaya Nayaka seized Warangal from the Delhi governor in 1336 and led the Andhra chieftains in expelling Sultanate rule from eastern Telangana. His power was soon worn down by the Bahmani Sultanate: he lost fort after fort, including Golconda.

In 1361 he surrendered the turquoise throne of Warangal to Mohammed Shah I under a treaty. In 1368 the rival Recherla Nayakas killed him in battle at Bhimavaram, and the Musunuri chiefship broke up as its allied Nayakas returned to their own towns.
zh:
穆苏努里·纳亚卡是泰卢固武将首领家族，在瓦朗加尔的卡卡提亚王国亡于德里苏丹国后，于戈达瓦里河下游崛起。约1330年，穆苏努里·普罗拉亚·纳亚卡立足巴德拉查拉姆附近的雷卡帕勒，自称继承卡卡提亚的法统。

继任者卡帕亚·纳亚卡于1336年从德里总督手中夺取瓦朗加尔，率领安得拉诸首领把苏丹国势力赶出特伦甘纳东部。巴赫曼尼苏丹国很快削弱了他的力量，他接连失去包括戈尔孔达在内的多座要塞。

1361年，他依条约把瓦朗加尔的绿松石王座献给穆罕默德·沙一世。1368年，敌对的隶契罗·纳亚卡家族在比马拉姆战役中将他击杀，穆苏努里的首领之邦随之瓦解，结盟的纳亚卡们各回本城。

en:
The Muzaffarids were a Persianized dynasty of Arab descent whose ancestors fled the Mongol invasion of Khorasan for Yazd, where they served the Ilkhans as governors of Maibud. Its founder, Mubariz al-Din Muhammad, overthrew the atabeg of Yazd around 1319, seized Kirman in 1340, and destroyed the rival Injuids to take Shiraz in 1353.

His son Shah Shoja blinded and deposed him in 1358. He ruled until 1384 and made Shiraz a center of Arabic and Persian letters, where the poet Hafez flourished; the family also enlarged the Jameh Mosque of Yazd, completing its tiled dome in 1375.

Fraternal wars between Shah Shoja's sons then weakened the realm. When Timur invaded, Shah Mansur was defeated and beheaded at the Battle of Shiraz in 1393; the remaining Muzaffarid princes were executed soon after, ending the dynasty.
zh:
穆扎法尔王朝是一个已波斯化的阿拉伯裔家族，其祖先在蒙古入侵呼罗珊时逃到亚兹德，为伊尔汗国担任迈布德总督。开创者穆巴里兹丁·穆罕默德约于1319年推翻亚兹德的阿塔伯克，1340年夺取克尔曼，又在1353年攻灭敌对的因朱王朝、拿下设拉子。

他的儿子沙阿·舒贾于1358年将他废黜并刺瞎，统治至1384年，在设拉子倡导阿拉伯语和波斯语文学，诗人哈菲兹即活跃于这一时期；家族还扩建亚兹德聚礼清真寺，于1375年完成瓷砖穹顶。

此后沙阿·舒贾诸子兄弟相争，国势衰弱。帖木儿入侵后，沙阿·曼苏尔在1393年的设拉子之战中战败被斩首，其余穆扎法尔王公不久被处死，王朝就此灭亡。

en:
The Muzaka were an Albanian noble house ruling the Myzeqe lowlands between the Devoll and Vjosë rivers. A family member is recorded as a commander under Byzantine emperor Alexios I Komnenos around 1090.

From the late thirteenth century Andrea I and then Andrea II led the house between Byzantium and the Angevins of Naples. Andrea II became despot in 1335 and defeated a Serbian army near Mount Pelister around 1340. Stefan Dušan overran their lands in 1343-1345, but the family recovered them after his death in 1355 and later took Berat.

After the Battle of Savra in 1385 the Muzaka submitted to the Ottomans, until Theodor Corona Musachi joined Skanderbeg's revolt in 1444. Many later fled to Italy; the last notable exile died at Naples in 1600, while some who remained converted to Islam.
zh:
穆扎卡伊特家族是阿尔巴尼亚贵族，统治德沃尔河与维约萨河之间的穆泽切低地。约1090年，一名成员作为拜占庭皇帝阿莱克修斯一世·科穆宁的统兵官见诸记载。

13世纪末起安德烈一世和二世相继领导家族，在拜占庭与那不勒斯安茹王朝之间周旋。安德烈二世于1335年获封专制公，约1340年在佩利斯特山附近击败塞尔维亚军队。斯特凡·杜尚于1343—1345年攻占其领地，家族在他1355年死后收复故土，后来夺取培拉特。

1385年萨夫拉战役后家族臣服奥斯曼人，1444年特奥多尔·科罗纳·穆扎基加入斯坎德培起义。许多人后来避难意大利，最后的知名流亡者1600年死于那不勒斯，部分留居者改宗伊斯兰教。

en:
The Banu Muzni were the ruling family of the Zab Emirate, a desert-edge state centered on Biskra in eastern Algeria. In the thirteenth century they displaced the Banu Romman at Biskra, imposed their authority on the Bedouin tribes, and with leave from the sultan of Bejaia extended their rule as far as Tozeur.

Early in the fourteenth century they allied with the Zianids of Tlemcen against Hafsid overlordship, but had to resubmit to Tunis in 1329. Their allegiance remained nominal, and Hafsid armies repeatedly besieged Biskra to force its governor to pay tribute.

When the Marinids swept into the central Maghreb in the mid-fourteenth century the Muzni briefly acknowledged their sovereignty before returning to the Hafsid orbit. Ibn Khaldun devoted a chapter to the Banu Muzni as emirs of Biskra, and the emirate fell to a Hafsid reconquest in 1402.
zh:
穆兹尼家族是扎布酋长国的统治家族，这个沙漠边缘政权以阿尔及利亚东部的比斯克拉为中心。13世纪，他们在比斯克拉取代巴努·鲁曼人，压服当地贝都因诸部，又经贝贾亚苏丹许可扩张，势力远达托泽尔。

14世纪初，他们联合特莱姆森的扎扬王朝，试图摆脱哈夫斯宗主权，但1329年被迫重新臣服突尼斯。这种臣服仅存名义，哈夫斯军队多次围攻比斯克拉，逼迫其总督缴纳贡赋。

14世纪中叶马林王朝攻入马格里布中部时，穆兹尼人一度承认马林宗主权，随后又回到哈夫斯势力范围。伊本·赫勒敦曾专门写下一章记述比斯克拉的穆兹尼埃米尔；1402年，酋长国被哈夫斯王朝重新征服。

en:
The Myinsaing dynasty takes its name from the Kyaukse valley town where three brothers, Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu, rose as commanders of the late Pagan kingdom. After the Mongol invasions shattered Pagan power in 1287, the brothers became the real rulers of central Burma, overthrew King Kyawswa in 1297, and drove off a second Mongol invasion in 1300—1301.

Thihathu, the youngest brother, crowned himself king and in 1313 founded a new capital at Pinya, claiming Pagan's legacy, while the chronicles treat Sagaing, built up by his son Saw Yun, as a junior branch of the same house. Pinya was weakened by rivalry between Uzana I and Kyawswa I and by Sagaing's formal secession in 1325.

Kyawswa I's reign of 1344—1350 briefly restored central authority, but raids by the Shan state of Maw sacked both Sagaing and Pinya in 1364. Thado Minbya, a great-grandson of Thihathu, seized the two ruined capitals and founded the Ava kingdom in 1365.
zh:
敏象王朝得名于皎施地区的敏象城，出自蒲甘王国末年的三位将领兄弟——阿散哥也、阿剌者僧加蓝和底哈都。1287年元军入侵瓦解蒲甘之后，兄弟三人成为中缅甸的实际统治者，1297年废黜国王憍苴，又在1300—1301年击退元朝的第二次征讨。

幼弟底哈都自立为王，1313年迁都彬牙、建立彬牙王国，宣称继承蒲甘法统；缅甸编年史把其子苏云经营的实皆视为同一家族的幼支。彬牙长期受乌兹那与觉苏瓦一世争位、以及1325年实皆正式独立的拖累。

觉苏瓦一世在位期间（1344—1350年）一度恢复中央权威，但掸族麓川政权的入侵在1364年接连洗劫实皆和彬牙。底哈都的曾孙德多明帕耶攻取两座残破都城，于1365年建立阿瓦王国。

en:
The Nabahani ruled the Swahili sultanate of Pate in the Lamu Archipelago. According to the Pate Chronicle, the family arrived in 1203 and 1204, when the Arab chief Sulaymān ibn Sulaymān al-Nabahānī married the daughter of the last native Batawiyyūn king and took the throne; the family claimed descent from the Nabhani kings of Oman.

Under their rule Pate grew into a leading trading city of the East African coast, prominent from the 1300s and long rivalling Lamu and Mombasa. By the eighteenth century Pate declined and its sultans took up residence in Lamu.

Around 1812 a succession dispute after the death of Sultan Fumo Madi drew in the Mazrui of Mombasa, and the allied Pate and Mombasa army was crushed by Lamu at the Battle of Shela, after which the coast fell under the domination of Oman.
zh:
纳巴哈尼家族是拉穆群岛斯瓦希里城邦帕泰苏丹国的统治王朝。据《帕泰编年史》记载，该家族于1203—1204年到来：阿拉伯首领苏莱曼·本·苏莱曼·纳巴哈尼娶了本地末代巴塔维温国王之女并夺取王位；家族自称源自阿曼的纳卜汉诸王。

在他们治下，帕泰成长为东非海岸的贸易重镇，14世纪起声名显赫，长期与拉穆、蒙巴萨争雄。到18世纪，帕泰国势衰落，苏丹们迁居拉穆。

1812年前后，苏丹富莫·马迪死后的继承之争引来蒙巴萨的马兹鲁伊家族插手，帕泰与蒙巴萨联军在谢拉之战中被拉穆击溃，此后东非海岸落入阿曼的支配之下。

en:
The Nabhanids, or Banu Nabhan, were an Azdi Arab house that ruled Oman as hereditary kings from 1154 to 1624. Their leader Muhammad al-Fallah rose as Seljuk garrisons withdrew and controlled the interior by 1154, ruling from fortified oases including Nizwa and Bahla. The kings reduced elected Ibadi imams to a largely symbolic office; chronicles record none between 1153 and 1406.

Their wealth rested on the frankincense trade from Dhofar toward Bahrain, Baghdad and Damascus. At Bahla they raised a mud-brick fort complex between the twelfth and fifteenth centuries. They also came to terms with Hormuz, which held much of the coast.

From the fifteenth century the Ibadi imamate regained strength. After the Portuguese seized Muscat in 1507 and overran the coast, the dynasty was left with Bahla. In 1624 Nasir ibn Murshid of the Yaʿrubid dynasty took Oman, ending Nabhani kingship.
zh:
纳卜汉王朝又称巴努·纳卜汉，是艾兹德部落的阿拉伯王室，1154—1624年以世袭国王身份统治阿曼。其首领穆罕默德·法拉赫趁塞尔柱驻军撤离崛起，1154年已控制内陆，以奈兹瓦和巴赫莱等绿洲为都。国王把选出的伊巴德派伊玛目降为近乎象征性的职位；史籍在1153—1406年无伊玛目记载。

财富依托从佐法尔通往巴林、巴格达和大马士革的乳香贸易。他们在巴赫莱修建12至15世纪的土坯堡垒群，与控制大片海岸的霍尔木兹妥协。

15世纪起伊巴德派伊玛目国重新壮大。1507年葡萄牙人攻占马斯喀特并席卷海岸，王朝只剩巴赫莱。1624年雅鲁卜王朝的纳西尔·伊本·穆尔希德接管阿曼，纳卜汉王统告终。

en:
The Naga dynasty of Kalahandi ruled the hills of western Odisha from Junagarh, also called Kalahandinagara. Naga chiefs had ruled parts of the region since the eleventh century; in the twelfth century their realm became the Kamala Mandala, a feudatory province of the Eastern Ganga kings.

Court tradition says Raghunath Sai, a prince of the Naga house of Chota Nagpur, married the last Ganga governor's daughter and took the throne, though historians place the change in the fifteenth century.

The Naga kings were crowned with the participation of the Khond chief, who seated the new raja on his lap. They claimed eighteen hill forts under the goddess Manikeswari. After the fourteenth century they transferred allegiance to the Suryavamsi Gajapatis and ruled independently from 1568. In 1788 the Marathas of Nagpur made Kalahandi a tributary, confirming Raja Purushottama Deo on its throne.
zh:
卡拉汉迪的那加王朝统治奥里萨西部山地，宫廷设在朱纳加尔，又称卡拉汉迪那加拉。那加首领自11世纪起统治当地部分地区；12世纪其领地成为东恒伽诸王的附庸行省卡马拉曼达拉。

宫廷传统称，乔塔那格浦尔那加家族的王子拉古纳特·赛娶末代恒伽总督之女并夺取王位，但史家认为易代发生在15世纪。

那加诸王加冕时，孔德部落首领把新罗阇抱在膝上。他们在女神马尼凯什瓦里的护佑下号称领有十八座山塞。14世纪以后他们转而归附苏利耶万希·伽阇波提王朝，并于1568年起独立统治。1788年，那格浦尔的马拉塔人使卡拉汉迪沦为纳贡之国，同时承认普鲁绍塔马·德奥为罗阇。

en:
The Nagai of Dewa were a gokenin house founded by Tokihiro, second son of Oe no Hiromoto. Tokihiro took his name from Nagai manor in Okitama, and after his elder brother Chikahiro was ruined in the Jokyu War of 1221, the Nagai inherited the main Oe lineage's standing.

They served the Hojo regents as shugo of Bingo and Tango. In the Hoji War of 1247 Yasuhide fought for the Hojo and helped save his Mori kinsmen's stewardships, a service later Mori daimyo remembered. The family built Yonezawa Castle and served as stewards of Nagai manor.

When the shogunate collapsed in 1333, Hirohide and his nephew Takafuyu joined Emperor Go-Daigo and then Ashikaga Takauji. Their long absence let the Date grow stronger: Date Muneto invaded Okitama in 1380, and in 1385 Date Masamune seized Nagai manor, reducing the clan to a minor local house.
zh:
出羽长井氏是镰仓时代的御家人之家，始祖为大江广元次男时广，他以置赐郡长井庄为苗字。1221年承久之乱中，时广之兄亲广没落，长井氏遂继承大江氏惣领的地位。

他们靠拢北条执权，担任备后、丹后两国守护。1247年宝治合战时，泰秀站在北条一方，又出力保全亲族毛利氏的地头职，后来的毛利大名一直感念这份恩义。长井氏修筑米泽城，世代出任长井庄地头。

1333年镰仓幕府灭亡，广秀与侄子举冬转投后醍醐天皇，随后又接近足利尊氏。家族长期不在领地，邻接的伊达氏却日益坐大：1380年伊达宗远侵入置赐，1385年伊达政宗横领长井庄，长井氏由此衰微为地方小族。

en:
The Nagano Kudō were local lords who dominated central Ise Province from the Kamakura period. Originally called Kudō, they took the Nagano name from their lands. During the Nanboku-chō wars they joined the Northern Court against the Kitabatake, the Southern Court governors advancing into Ise.

In 1429 the clan head Mitsufuji fought for the shogunate at Iwatagawa, where Kitabatake Mitsumasa was killed, and the clan received Ichishi District. In the Ōnin War of 1467 the Nagano served in the western army. Squeezed between the Kitabatake and the Rokkaku of Ōmi, the head Fujisada submitted to Kitabatake Tomonori in 1558 and adopted his second son Tomofusa as heir.

Oda Nobunaga later forced the family to adopt his brother Nobukane. After Nagano men helped murder Tomonori in the Mise Incident of 1576, Nobukane reverted to the Oda name, ending Nagano rule. Toyotomi Hideyoshi dispossessed him in 1594 and the clan scattered.
zh:
长野工藤氏是自镰仓时代起称霸伊势国中部的国人领主。本姓工藤，后以领地称长野氏。南北朝时代，南朝方国司北畠氏进入伊势，长野氏加入北朝方与之争战。

1429年，当主长野满藤站在幕府一方参加岩田川之战，北畠满雅败死，家族获封一志郡。1467年爆发的应仁之乱中，长野氏从属西军。家族受北畠氏与近江六角氏挤压，1558年当主长野藤定向北畠具教屈服，收其次子具藤为养子继承家督。

织田信长后来迫使长野氏收其弟信包为养子。1576年三濑之变中，长野氏族人参与刺杀具教，此后信包恢复织田姓氏，长野氏的统治终结。1594年信包被丰臣秀吉改易，长野一族离散。

en:
The Naganuma were a warrior house of Shimotsuke and one of the eight Kanto yakata, tracing Fujiwara descent through the Oyama clan. Their founder Munemasa, second son of Oyama Masamitsu, followed Minamoto no Yoritomo and took his name from Naganuma in Haga district. He distinguished himself in the Jokyu war of 1221 and became shugo of Awaji.

The Nanboku-cho wars split the house when the heir Hidetada withdrew from its home estate to Mutsu. Yoshihide of the Mutsu line served the Kamakura kubo Ashikaga Ujimitsu and recovered Naganuma in 1399. A succession quarrel drew the family into the Eikyo and Yuki wars, and after 1454 the main line was reportedly destroyed or driven out during the Kyotoku war.

A branch served the Koga kubo and took the name Minagawa. Minagawa Hiroteru became an Edo daimyo, though his house died out without an heir.
zh:
长沼氏是下野国的武家，为关东八屋形之一，本姓藤原，出自小山氏一脉。其祖宗政是小山政光次男，追随源赖朝，以芳贺郡长沼为苗字。他在1221年承久之乱中立功，受任淡路守护。

南北朝战乱中，嫡流秀直从本领退往陆奥国，家族由此分裂。陆奥一脉的义秀出仕镰仓公方足利氏满，1399年收复长沼庄。此后的家督之争把家族卷入永享之乱与结城合战；1454年以后的享德之乱中，长沼嫡流据说灭亡或被放逐。

幸存的一支出仕古河公方，改称皆川氏。皆川广照在江户初年位列大名，但其家不久因无嗣而断绝。

en:
