The Nakajima of Owari claimed descent from the Saga Genji line of Minamoto no Toru, son of Emperor Saga. After the Jokyu War in 1221, the family settled in Nakajima village in Owari and took its name. Saemon-no-jo Nobunaga first styled himself Nakajima, and his heirs held Nakajima Castle.

The family remained local lords through the Muromachi period, but declined under pressure from the Shiba and Oda and entered Toyotomi Hideyoshi's service. Its best-known member, Nakajima Ujitane, became one of the Toyotomi house's seven hand-group captains, with over twenty thousand koku.

Ujitane fought in Ishida Mitsunari's army at Sekigahara in 1600 and led two thousand men in the Osaka summer campaign of 1615, taking his life as the castle fell. His descendants became wealthy farmers in Kawachi.
zh:
尾张中岛氏自称是嵯峨天皇之子源融的后裔，属嵯峨源氏。1221年承久之乱后，该族土着于尾张国中岛村，以地名为苗字。中岛左卫门尉宣长最先自称中岛，其后代居守中岛城。

室町时代，中岛氏是当地领主，后受斯波氏、织田氏挤压而衰落，出仕丰臣秀吉。族中最有名的中岛氏种成为丰臣家七手组组头之一，禄高两万余石。

氏种于1600年在关原之战中加入石田三成阵营，1615年大坂夏之阵率两千兵力奋战，城破前夕自尽。其子孙在河内国归农，成为豪农。

en:
Nan Sarunai was the tribal kingdom of the Ma'anyan, a Dayak people of the Barito basin in South Kalimantan. Ma'anyan wadian chants and the Hikayat Banjar remember it as the earliest polity of the Banjar region. Its people, once seafarers with ancient links to the Malagasy of Madagascar, settled inland along the Tabalong river around Amuntai and Tanjung.

From 1309 Raden Japutra Layar built a more centralised state with Javanese-style titles; Raden Neno and Raden Anyan succeeded him.

Majapahit under Hayam Wuruk invaded between 1355 and 1362 and destroyed the kingdom. The victors established the tributary state of Negara Dipa on its ruins, the predecessor of Negara Daha and the Muslim Banjar Sultanate. Nan Sarunai's early history is hard to date because it survives mainly in oral tradition.
zh:
楠沙鲁奈是南加里曼丹巴里托河流域达雅克支系马安延人的部落王国。马安延人的瓦迪安歌谣和《班贾尔故事集》将其视为班贾尔地区最早的政权。马安延人本善航海，与马达加斯加的马尔加什人有远古渊源，后来在塔巴隆河沿岸的阿蒙泰、丹戎一带定居内陆。

拉登·贾普特拉·拉亚尔从1309年起建立更集权的国家，采用爪哇式头衔，其后由拉登·内诺、拉登·安延相继在位。

1355—1362年，哈奄·武禄治下的满者伯夷入侵并攻灭楠沙鲁奈，在其废墟上建立附庸国内加拉·迪帕，后来又演变为内加拉·达哈和伊斯兰化的班贾尔苏丹国。由于史事主要靠口传保存，楠沙鲁奈的早期年代难以确考。

en:
The Nanbu were a Tōhoku samurai clan claiming Seiwa Genji descent from Kai and named for their Nanbu estates. Founder Mitsuyuki joined Minamoto no Yoritomo at Ishibashiyama, and after the Hiraizumi Fujiwara fell in 1189 won vast Nukanobu in Mutsu, his sons holding horse ranches and growing rich on warhorses.

Motoyuki followed Southern Court general Kitabatake Akiie north, built Ne Castle and moved to Mutsu; a rival branch served the Northern Court. Under Harumasa the Nanbu held seven northern Mutsu districts, but power was scattered among rivals. Their vassal Ōura Tamenobu rebelled in 1572, seized Tsugaru and won Hideyoshi's confirmation in 1590, taking the Tsugaru name as hereditary rival.

Nanbu Nobunao submitted to Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 and in 1592 built Morioka castle as his seat. They joined the eastern army at Sekigahara and ruled 100,000-koku Morioka Domain through the Edo period. The old Tsugaru grudge flared in 1821, when a Morioka retainer plotted against the Tsugaru lord.
zh:
南部氏是东北地方的武士家族，自称出自甲斐国的清和源氏，家名来自其在甲斐南部的本领。始祖南部光行在石桥山之战投奔源赖朝，1189年攻灭平泉藤原氏后受封陆奥东北部广大的糠部郡，其子分守牧马城寨，靠供应战马致富。

南部师行随南朝大将北畠显家北上，修筑根城，把本据移到陆奥，另一支南部则效力北朝。到南部晴政时，南部氏领有陆奥北部七郡，但权力分散在互相竞争的分家手中。家臣大浦为信1572年起兵夺取津轻，1590年得到丰臣秀吉承认，改姓津轻，成为累世仇敌。

南部信直1590年在小田原归顺秀吉，1592年修筑盛冈城作为新本据。关原之战中加入东军，江户时代领有十万石盛冈藩。与津轻的旧怨1821年再度爆发，一名盛冈家臣图谋伏击津轻领主。

en:
The Narayan rulers were the middle royal line of the Kamata kingdom, born when Raja Sandhya moved his capital from Kamarupanagara to Kamatapur after 1257. The line began when the minister Pratapdhvaj usurped the throne; on his death his cousin Dharma Narayan seized power, until Pratapdhvaj's son Durlabh Narayan forced a partition that left him Kamatapur and other lands.

Durlabh Narayan patronised the poets Hema Saraswati and Harivara Vipra, whose works, including Hema's Prahlada Charita, count among the earliest written Assamese poems. His successor Indra Narayan was weakened by the invasion of Sikandar Shah of Bengal between 1357 and 1390, after which the Baro-Bhuyan chieftain Arimatta usurped the kingdom, ending this line.
zh:
纳拉扬诸王是迦摩多王国的中间一脉；迦摩多源于1257年之后罗阇桑迪亚把都城从迦摩缕波那揭罗迁到迦摩多城。这一脉始于大臣普拉塔普德瓦杰篡位，他死后堂弟达尔马·纳拉扬夺权，普拉塔普德瓦杰之子杜尔拉布·纳拉扬起兵相争，最终达成分割，保有迦摩多城等地。

杜尔拉布·纳拉扬庇护诗人赫马·萨拉斯瓦蒂和哈里瓦拉·维普拉；赫马的《普拉拉德传》等作品是最早的阿萨姆语诗篇之一。继位的因陀罗·纳拉扬在1357—1390年间遭孟加拉苏丹锡坎达尔沙入侵而衰弱，随后巴罗—布延首领阿里马塔篡位，这一脉终结。

en:
The Naservand were a Gilaki clan who ruled Lahijan and the eastern Gilan region of Bia-pish before the rise of the Kar-Kiya sayyids. Their name points to a link, real or claimed, with the Zaydi imam Nasir al-Din al-Atrush, who died in 917 and brought Zaydi Shi'ism to Bia-pish; the family grew out of the Kutam clans of Ranikuh.

Under Öljaitü the house split into two branches, with Nupasha Naservand ruling Lahijan. His resistance to the Ilkhanid Gilan campaign of 1306 failed, but he submitted and kept his lands as a tributary; after the Mongols sacked the town it was rebuilt around 1328.

The Naservand still held Lahijan in 1337, until the Zaydi sayyid Ali Kiya conquered Bia-pish from 1367 and founded the Kar-Kiya dynasty. The last Naservand resistance was broken by 1390, when Sayyid Hadi Kiya became master of the whole region.
zh:
纳塞尔万德是吉拉克氏族，在卡尔基亚赛义德家族兴起之前统治拉希詹和吉兰东部的比亚皮什。其族名与917年去世的栽德派伊玛目纳绥尔丁·阿特鲁什有真实或自称的渊源，后者把栽德派什叶教带到比亚皮什；该家族出自拉尼库赫的库塔姆诸氏族。

完者都时代家族分为两支，努帕沙·纳塞尔万德领有拉希詹。1306年他抵抗伊儿汗国的吉兰之役失败，随后称臣纳贡、保住领地；城镇遭蒙古人洗劫后，约于1328年重建。

1337年纳塞尔万德仍据有拉希詹，直到栽德派赛义德·阿里·基亚自1367年起征服比亚皮什、建立卡尔基亚王朝。1390年赛义德·哈迪·基亚成为整个地区的主人，纳塞尔万德最后的抵抗也告失败。

en:
The Nasrids, in Arabic Banu Nasr or Banu al-Ahmar, were the last Muslim dynasty to rule in the Iberian Peninsula. Muhammad I Ibn al-Ahmar rose from Ibn Hud's Andalusi forces, made himself emir in 1232 and entered Granada in 1238, founding a Castilian tributary emirate.

For two and a half centuries it balanced Castile and the Marinids of Fez, paying tribute while setting neighbours against each other. In 1337 the throne belonged to Yusuf I, who joined the Marinid invasion broken at Río Salado in 1340 and saw Algeciras fall. The fourteenth century, above all Muhammad V's long second reign, was Granada's golden age: the city became a refuge of Islamic learning and craftsmanship, and the Alhambra took its lasting form.

From the early fifteenth century dynastic coups weakened the emirate as Castile and Aragon united under the Catholic Monarchs. The decade-long Granada War ended when the last sultan, Muhammad XII, called Boabdil, surrendered in 1492, closing more than seven centuries of Muslim rule in al-Andalus.
zh:
奈斯尔家族（阿拉伯语巴努·奈斯尔或巴努·艾哈迈尔）是伊比利亚半岛最后一个穆斯林统治王朝。穆罕默德一世·伊本·艾哈迈尔崛起于伊本·胡德的安达卢斯军中，1232年自立为埃米尔，1238年入主格拉纳达，建立向卡斯蒂利亚纳贡的格拉纳达埃米尔国。

此后两个半世纪，王朝在卡斯蒂利亚与非斯的马林王朝之间周旋，一面纳贡，一面让邻邦互相牵制。1337年在位的是优素福一世，他1340年联合马林王朝入侵，在萨拉多河之战中被击溃，阿尔赫西拉斯失守。14世纪是格拉纳达的黄金时代，尤以穆罕默德五世第二次长期在位为盛：城市成为伊斯兰学术与工艺的庇护所，阿尔罕布拉宫建成宏大规模。

15世纪初起宫廷政变不断，埃米尔国日渐衰弱，卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡则在天主教双王治下联合。十年格拉纳达战争以末代苏丹穆罕默德十二世（博阿夫迪尔）1492年献城告终，安达卢斯七百余年的穆斯林统治就此落幕。

en:
The House of Nassau took its name from Nassau Castle on the Lahn, after the lordship of Laurenburg, held by founder Count Dudo around 1100, was moved there in 1159. As Franconia fragmented after the Hohenstaufen fell, Nassau's lords emerged as imperial counts answerable only to the emperor. Count Henry the Rich, who died in 1251, left two sons whose 1255 partition created the elder Walramian and younger Ottonian branches.

The Walramian line produced Adolf of Nassau, elected King of the Romans in 1292 and killed in battle at Göllheim in 1298. The Ottonian line grew greater in the west: William the Silent inherited Orange in 1544 and led the Dutch revolt against Spain, his descendants serving as hereditary Dutch stadtholders; William III of Orange took the English and Scottish thrones in 1689.

In 1815 the Orange-Nassau line gained the Kingdom of the Netherlands and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, while the Walramian branch united the ancestral lands into the Duchy of Nassau, capital Wiesbaden.
zh:
拿骚家族得名于兰河畔的拿骚城堡：创始人杜多伯爵约1100年领有劳伦堡领地，1159年统治中心迁至拿骚堡。霍亨斯陶芬王朝覆灭后弗兰肯瓦解，拿骚领主崛起为只对皇帝负责的帝国伯爵。1251年去世的“富人”亨利留下两子，1255年分家形成两大支系：长支瓦尔拉姆系与幼支奥托系。

瓦尔拉姆系出了1292年当选罗马人的国王、1298年在格尔海姆战死的拿骚的阿道夫。奥托系在西方成就更大：1544年“沉默者”威廉继承奥兰治亲王之位，领导荷兰反抗西班牙的起义，后代世袭荷兰共和国执政，奥兰治的威廉三世更于1689年登上英格兰和苏格兰王位。

1815年，奥兰治-拿骚系获得尼德兰王国和卢森堡大公国，瓦尔拉姆系则把祖传领地合并为以威斯巴登为首都的拿骚公国。

en:
The Nasu were a warrior clan of Nasu District in Shimotsuke, claiming descent from the northern Fujiwara and formerly called Sudō. Their most famous member, Nasu no Yoichi, shot a fan on a Taira ship from the shore at the Battle of Yashima in 1185, as told in the Heike Monogatari.

The Nasu became Kamakura gokenin and later one of the eight great houses of the Kantō. In the fifteenth century they split into rival Upper and Lower houses; in 1514 Nasu Sukefusa of the Lower house reunited them after the Upper house fell to internal strife.

The clan lost its lands after arriving late for Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590, though a retainer secured the heir five thousand koku. They later became daimyō of Nasu and Karasuyama, but a succession quarrel brought attainder in 1687. The house continued as a 1,000-koku kōtai-yoriai family.
zh:
那须氏是下野国那须郡的武家，自称藤原北家后裔，早先称须藤氏。族中最知名的那须与一于1185年屋岛之战中从岸上射落平氏战船上竖起的扇子，事迹载于《平家物语》。

那须氏成为镰仓幕府御家人，后来跻身关东八屋形。15世纪一族分裂为相互争战的上、下那须氏；1514年上那须氏在内讧中灭亡，下那须的那须资房重新统一一族。

1590年，那须氏在秀吉的小田原征伐中迟参，领地被没收，经家臣求情才为继承人争取到五千石。此后他们成为那须藩、乌山藩大名，却因继承之争于1687年被改易，家名以一千石的交代寄合身份延续。

en: The Nasurid were the local ruling family of Murzuk, an oasis town of the Fezzan south of Tripoli on the Saharan caravan routes. Around 1300 the region was held by Arab Banu Sulaym tribes, and after a Moroccan tribal takeover in 1310 Murzuk became the seat of a small desert sultanate.
zh: 纳苏尔家族是费赞绿洲城镇迈尔祖格的地方统治家族，该镇坐落在的黎波里以南的撒哈拉商路上。1300年前后，费赞由阿拉伯巴努·苏莱姆诸部控制；1310年一支摩洛哥部落夺据迈尔祖格，以此为都建立沙漠小苏丹国。

en:
The Nawa were a warrior family of Hōki Province in western Honshu, whose power rested on the Nawa manor along the Sea of Japan coast.

In 1333, their best-known member, Nawa Nagatoshi, sheltered Emperor Go-Daigo after his escape from the Oki Islands and raised troops at Mount Senjō. He was rewarded with the governorship of Hōki after the Kamakura shogunate fell.

Nagatoshi remained a Southern Court loyalist and was killed in August 1336 leading an attack on the Tō-ji temple in Kyoto, where Ashikaga Takauji had installed Emperor Kōmyō. His descendants lost their Hōki footing and moved to Higo Province in Kyushu, settling in Yatsushiro and later Uto. In the Edo period they served the Tachibana lords of Yanagawa as retainers.
zh:
名和氏是本州西部伯耆国的武士家族，势力根基在日本海沿岸的名和庄。

1333年，后醍醐天皇从隐岐岛逃出，家族最知名的名和长年在船上山迎驾并举兵。镰仓幕府灭亡后，长年受封伯耆守。

长年此后仍忠于南朝，1336年8月在京都率军攻打足利尊氏拥立光明天皇的东寺时战死。其后人失去伯耆的根基，迁至九州肥后国，先后落脚八代和宇土。江户时代，他们作为家臣侍奉柳川藩的立花氏。

en:
The Ndiaye, or Njaay, dynasty ruled Jolof and was founded, according to Wolof and Serer oral tradition, by the legendary Ndiadiane Ndiaye. The epic makes him a man of Futa Toro who travelled down the Senegal River to Waalo, where the village elders chose him as ruler for the fairness of his judgements.

After sixteen years in Waalo he is said to have united the Wolof-speaking lands between the Senegal and Gambia rivers, mostly by consent, into the Jolof Empire. An early vassal of Mali, it became independent in the second half of the fourteenth century. Ndiadiane's son Sare succeeded him, and his descendants bore the title buurba.

After the battle of Danki in 1549 the empire collapsed and its vassal states broke away. Jolof survived as a smaller kingdom under the same dynasty.
zh:
恩迪亚耶（又译恩贾伊）王朝统治乔洛夫，据沃洛夫和谢列尔人的口传传统，由传奇人物恩贾贾恩·恩迪亚耶创立。史诗称他出身富塔托罗，沿塞内加尔河来到瓦洛，当地长老因他断事公正而推举他为首领。

据说他在瓦洛统治十六年后，以和平会盟为主，把塞内加尔河与冈比亚河之间讲沃洛夫语的各邦统一为乔洛夫帝国。该国早年是马里的附庸，14世纪下半叶独立。恩贾贾恩之子萨尔继位，其后代以“布尔巴”为号。

1549年丹基战役后，帝国解体，各附庸邦纷纷独立。乔洛夫降为较小的王国，仍由同一家族统治。

en:
The Nemanjić were the foremost royal house of medieval Serbia, producing twelve monarchs between 1166 and 1371. Founder Stefan Nemanja, Grand Prince of Raška from 1166, expanded the state and fought Byzantium, then abdicated in 1196 to die as the monk Simeon on Mount Athos, restoring Hilandar monastery with his son Saint Sava.

Sava secured an autocephalous Serbian Church in 1219 and issued the Nomocanon, Serbia's first written law code; Nemanja's son Stefan was crowned the first king of Serbia in 1217. Stephen Dečanski, victor over Bulgaria at Velbazhd in 1330, enlarged the realm further.

Under Stephen Dušan, crowned Emperor of the Serbs and Greeks in 1346, the Serbian Church became a patriarchate and Dušan's Code appeared, making Serbia the Balkans' strongest power. Dušan died in 1355, and when his son Uroš the Weak died childless in 1371 the empire broke into rival lordships; the last prince, John Uroš of Thessaly, died around 1423, and Nemanjić blood survived only through female lines.
zh:
内马尼奇王朝是中世纪塞尔维亚最显赫的王室，1166年至1371年间出了十二位君主。开创者斯特凡·尼曼雅自1166年起任拉什卡大茹潘，扩张国力、与拜占庭交战，1196年退位，以修士西梅翁之名在阿索斯山终老，与儿子圣萨瓦重修希兰达尔修道院。

萨瓦于1219年促成塞尔维亚东正教会自主，颁布塞尔维亚第一部成文法典《教会法汇编》；尼曼雅之子斯特凡于1217年加冕为第一代塞尔维亚国王。斯特凡·德昌斯基1330年在维尔巴日德击败保加利亚，继续扩张疆土。

王朝在斯特凡·杜尚治下达到顶峰：他1346年加冕为塞尔维亚人与希腊人的皇帝，将塞尔维亚教会提升为牧首区，颁布《杜尚法典》，使塞尔维亚成为巴尔干最强国家。杜尚死于1355年，其子“弱者”乌罗什1371年无嗣而终，帝国分裂为相互争战的贵族领地；最后一位王公色萨利的约翰·乌罗什约1423年去世，家族血脉只通过女性后裔延续。

en:
The Neu-Kyburg were a Swiss comital house with estates in the Oberaargau. After the old Kyburg male line died out in 1264, Rudolf of Habsburg became guardian of the heiress Anna. Her marriage to Eberhard I of Habsburg-Laufenburg in 1273 established the new county, centred on Burgdorf and Thun.

The family was implicated in the murder of King Albert I in 1308 and held the Landgraviate of Burgundy as a Habsburg fief from 1313. Chronically short of money, the counts sold or pledged rights and towns; Eberhard II murdered his brother Hartmann II at Thun to seize the inheritance.

Rudolf II's failed raid on Solothurn in 1382 sparked the Burgdorf War of 1383 to 1384, after which Bern bought Thun and Burgdorf. The remaining lordships passed to Bern and Solothurn, and the house became extinct when Count Berchtold died in 1417.
zh:
新基堡伯爵家族是瑞士贵族，产业在上阿尔高。旧基堡男系于1264年绝嗣后，哈布斯堡的鲁道夫成为女继承人安娜的监护人。1273年，安娜嫁给哈布斯堡‑劳芬堡的埃伯哈德一世，新伯国由此成立，中心在布格多夫和图恩。

家族卷入1308年刺杀国王阿尔伯特一世的阴谋，从1313年起以哈布斯堡封臣的身份领有勃艮第藩侯领。伯爵们长期财政拮据，不断出售或抵押权利与城镇；埃伯哈德二世在图恩杀死兄长哈特曼二世以夺遗产。

1382年鲁道夫二世袭击索洛图恩失败，引发1383—1384年的布格多夫战争，战后伯尔尼买下图恩和布格多夫。剩余领地落入伯尔尼和索洛图恩之手；1417年贝希托尔德伯爵去世，家族绝嗣。

en:
The House of Neuchâtel ruled the Swiss county of the same name from the twelfth century to 1395. It probably sprang from the lords of Fenis: around 1034 Emperor Conrad II enfeoffed Ulrich I of Fenis with the Neuchâtel lands, centred on the new castle that gave the dynasty its name.

In 1214 Ulrich III and his nephew Berthold granted Neuchâtel a charter modelled on the customs of Besançon. After the Zähringen dukes died out in 1218 the county became immediately subject to the Empire. The counts allied with Fribourg in 1290 and Bern in 1308.

Count Rudolf IV ruled from 1288 to 1343 and was followed by his son Louis I, who died in 1373. The last of the line, Countess Elisabeth, died childless in 1395 and bequeathed the county to her nephew Conrad IV of Freiburg, ending the native dynasty's rule.
zh:
纳沙泰尔家族是12世纪至1395年间统治瑞士同名伯国的伯爵王朝，很可能出自费尼领主家族。约1034年，皇帝康拉德二世把纳沙泰尔一带封给费尼的乌尔里希一世，统治中心是令家族得名的“新城堡”。

1214年，乌尔里希三世与侄子贝托尔德仿效贝桑松习惯法，向纳沙泰尔城颁布特许状。1218年策林根公爵绝嗣后，伯国改为直属于帝国。伯爵们于1290年与弗里堡、1308年与伯尔尼结盟。

鲁道夫四世伯爵于1288—1343年在位，其子路易一世继立，1373年去世。末代伯爵伊莎贝拉无嗣而终，1395年把伯国传给外甥弗赖堡的康拉德四世，本土家族的统治至此结束。

en:
The Nevilles were survivors of the Anglo-Saxon aristocracy: their male line, the FitzMaldreds, kept lands in Durham after the Norman Conquest. Robert FitzMaldred married the heiress Isabel de Neville, bringing her Norman surname and estates to the family, whose seat was Raby Castle.

Ralph Neville became Baron Neville de Raby in 1295, and the house rivalled the Percys in northern England. His son Ralph crushed a Scottish invasion at Neville's Cross in 1346 and captured King David II. Raised to the earldom of Westmorland in 1397, the family included Richard Neville, Earl of Warwick, the Kingmaker, who died at Barnet in 1471.

The Nevilles were central to the Wars of the Roses. Charles Neville, sixth Earl of Westmorland, led the failed northern rising for Mary, Queen of Scots, in 1569 and died in exile in 1601, ending the senior line; the Bergavenny branch continued.
zh:
内维尔家族是盎格鲁-撒克逊贵族中的幸存者：其男系菲茨马尔德雷德在诺曼征服后仍保有达勒姆土地。罗伯特·菲茨马尔德雷德娶女继承人伊莎贝尔·德·内维尔，获得她的诺曼姓氏和地产，以拉比城堡为宅邸。

1295年，拉尔夫·内维尔成为拉比的内维尔男爵，家族在英格兰北部与珀西家族争雄。其子拉尔夫于1346年在内维尔十字战役击溃苏格兰军，俘获国王大卫二世。家族于1397年晋封威斯特摩兰伯爵；“拥立国王者”沃里克伯爵理查德·内维尔于1471年战死巴尼特。

内维尔家族深度卷入玫瑰战争。第六代威斯特摩兰伯爵查尔斯·内维尔于1569年发动拥戴苏格兰女王玛丽的北方起事，失败后于1601年流亡而死，主支断绝；伯加文尼旁支延续。

en:
The Niiro were a cadet house of the Shimazu in Hyūga Province. Tokihisa, fourth son of the Shimazu head Tadamune, became steward of the Niiro estate in Koyu district, took up Takajō Castle and named himself after the holding.

His successors held castles in southern Hyūga and guarded Obi against the Itō, but feuds with Shimazu branches and local lords cost them Shibushi and drove the main line into exile at Sadowara for a time.

A cadet branch fared better: Niiro Tadamoto, born in 1526, became a celebrated general of Shimazu Takahisa and Yoshihisa. He fought in the conquest of Kyūshū, including the victory of Okita Nawate in 1584, and stood beside Shimazu Yoshihiro at Sekigahara in 1600. Under the Satsuma domain, the Niiro continued as ranked retainers, some holding senior posts.
zh:
新纳氏是岛津氏在日向国的分家。岛津当主忠宗的第四子时久被任为儿汤郡新纳院地头，入主高城，以领地为姓。

其后人据有日向南部诸城，曾在饫肥防备伊东氏，但因与岛津分家及周边豪族争斗而丢失志布志，嫡流一度亡命佐土原。

庶流则更显赫：新纳忠元生于1526年，是岛津贵久、义久两代麾下名将，参加平定九州的战役，包括1584年的冲田畷之战，1600年又随岛津义弘出征关原。新纳各家作为萨摩藩的有格藩士延续下来，其中有人还担任要职。

en:
The Nikaido were a bureaucratic warrior house of both Kamakura and Muromachi shogunates, Fujiwara descendants through the Kudo clan. Founder Kudo Yukimasa served Yoritomo as civil official and took the name Nikaido from his mansion beside Eifuku-ji's two-story hall, built in 1192. His son Yukimitsu became shitsuji, chief Mandokoro administrator, a post the house made its own; the family peaked in the mid-thirteenth century.

It split into Shinano and Oki lines staffing top secretariats under the Kamakura, Kenmu and Muromachi regimes, several purged in the 1285 Shimotsuki incident and after 1333. The Kyoto line held the Mandokoro shitsuji post into the sixteenth century.

The family's most famous martial branch began around 1444: Tameuji moved from Kamakura to Sukagawa in Mutsu, seized its castle and became a Sengoku daimyo. Drawn into the Date civil war of 1542 and hard pressed by the Ashina, the Sukagawa Nikaido lost their last castle to Date Masamune in 1589, after his aunt, dowager Anan no Kata, refused to surrender. Another branch settled in Satsuma as Shimazu retainers.
zh:
二阶堂氏是镰仓、室町幕府的官僚武家，本姓藤原，出自藤原南家工藤氏。其祖工藤行政以文官侍奉源赖朝，1192年因宅邸紧邻永福寺两层佛堂，以“二阶堂”为苗字。其子行光出任政所执事，此职后几乎由家族世袭，二阶堂氏于13世纪中叶权势达到顶峰。

一族分成信浓流与隐岐流，在镰仓、建武、室町三朝核心文书机构任职，但多个分支在1285年霜月骚动和1333年后的建武整肃中被清洗。在京都，二阶堂氏担任政所执事直至16世纪。

最著名的武家分支始于1444年前后：为氏从镰仓南下陆奥须贺川，入主须贺川城，成为战国大名。须贺川二阶堂氏卷入1542年伊达天文之乱，又长期受芦名氏压迫；1589年城池被伊达政宗攻陷，此前当主遗孀、政宗伯母阿南之方屡次拒降。另有一支定居萨摩，为岛津氏家臣。

en: The Nikruzi take their name from the Ilkhanid emir Nikruz, whose sons Sultanshah and Qutb al-Din Jahanshah, styled of Kerman, served in the wars over the collapsing Ilkhanate; Sultanshah defected from Arpa Ke'un at the Battle of Jaghatu in 1336 to the Oirat kingmaker Ali Padshah, and the game places the house at Kerman.
zh: 尼克鲁齐家族得名于伊儿汗国异密尼克鲁兹，他的儿子苏丹沙与号称“克尔曼人”的库特卜丁·贾汉沙在伊儿汗国崩溃时的混战中领兵：1336年苏丹沙在贾加图之战中背弃阿尔巴汗，转投卫拉特权臣阿里·帕迪沙，游戏将该家族置于克尔曼。

en:
The Nimi line was the ruling house of Vungu, also called Bungu, a kingdom in the Mayombe forest north of the Congo River. In the thirteenth century Vungu led a confederation including Ngoyo and Kakongo, and Kongo court tradition remembered it as the homeland of the first kings of Kongo.

Nimi a Nzima ruled Mpemba Kasi, and his son Lukeni lua Nimi, born around 1380, crossed the Congo River, displaced the local chief Mwene Kabunga and founded Mbanza Kongo. Taking the title Ntinu, he became the first king of Kongo.

Vungu first appears in writing in a letter of Kongo's King Afonso I in 1535; in the 1620s it was occupied by the Jaga after they were driven out of Kongo and allied with Loango.
zh:
尼米家族是温古（又译本古）的统治王朝，温古是刚果河以北马永贝森林中的王国。13世纪时，温古统领着包括恩戈约和卡孔戈在内的联盟，刚果宫廷传统把它视为刚果开国诸王的故乡。

尼米·阿·恩齐马统治姆潘巴·卡西，他的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米约生于1380年，后来渡过刚果河，逐走当地首领姆韦内·卡本加，建立姆班扎刚果，自称“恩蒂努”，成为刚果第一代国王。

温古最早见于1535年刚果国王阿方索一世的一封信；17世纪20年代，雅加人被逐出刚果后与卢安戈结盟，占领了温古。

en:
The Nitsuki, also read Niki, were a Seiwa Genji family of the Ashikaga line: Kamakura-period Sanekuni, great-grandson of Ashikaga Yoshiyasu, settled at Nitsuki in Mikawa as Nitsuki Taro, while his younger brother Yoshisue took the neighbouring Hosokawa estate and founded the Hosokawa. Both became hereditary Ashikaga retainers; the Nitsuki rose under Takauji's shogunate.

The brothers Yoriaki and Yoshinaga fought for Takauji nationwide, heading the Samurai Dokoro and collecting constableships: Yoriaki became Takauji's steward in 1351, holding it until the shogun's death in 1358; the brothers once governed as many as nine provinces between them.

Their eminence was short-lived. Yoshinaga's high-handed rule set him against fellow generals; after his fall the provinces slipped away, Tajima the last, lost to the Yamana in 1372. The Onin War of 1467—1477 split the family into rival branches and it never recovered; the Iga branch was driven out by the Iga Sokoku Ikki warrior league, lesser lines surviving into the Edo period as Tokugawa and Mori retainers.
zh:
仁木氏是清和源氏足利流的武家：镰仓时代，足利义康的曾孙实国迁居三河国额田郡仁木乡，自称仁木太郎；其弟义季领有相邻的细川乡，成为细川氏之祖。两家同为足利嫡流的谱代被官，仁木氏在足利尊氏创立室町幕府之际发迹。

赖章、义长兄弟为尊氏转战各地，出任侍所头人并兼任多国守护：赖章1351年接任尊氏的执事，直到1358年尊氏去世；兄弟俩最盛时一度同时领有多达九国的守护之职。

荣华短暂，义长因专横与诸将对立而失势，领国接连丧失，最后一国但马于1372年落入山名氏之手。1467—1477年的应仁之乱使其分裂为各投一方的支系，家势一蹶不振；伊贺仁木氏最终被伊贺惣国一揆驱逐，旁系则在江户时代以德川、毛利家臣身份延续。

en:
The Nitta were a Seiwa Genji house of Kozuke Province, named after the manor held by their ancestor Minamoto no Yoshishige. The family held only provincial weight under the Kamakura shogunate after sitting out much of the Genpei War.

Nitta Yoshisada answered Emperor Go-Daigo's call against the Hojo and stormed Kamakura in 1333, driving the regent Takatoki to suicide and ending the shogunate, but defeat by the Ashikaga at the Minatogawa in 1336 forced him into the Hokuriku with two imperial princes. His son Yoshiaki and the princes died at Kanegasaki in 1337; Yoshisada fell at Kuromaru in 1338, traditionally killing himself when trapped under his dead horse.

His remaining sons fought on for the Southern Court, but the Ashikaga destroyed the main line. The Tokugawa shoguns later claimed descent from a Nitta branch, a genealogy most historians doubt.
zh:
新田氏是上野国的清和源氏家族，以祖先源义重所领的新田庄为姓。由于该族在源平合战中大多置身事外，镰仓幕府时期仅为地方豪族。

新田义贞响应后醍醐天皇讨伐北条的号召，于1333年攻破镰仓，迫使执权北条高时自杀，幕府就此灭亡。1336年他在凑川之战败于足利氏，携两位亲王退守北陆。1337年金崎城陷落，其子义显与两位亲王丧生；义贞于1338年在黑丸阵亡，相传他被死马压身时自行了断。

余下诸子继续为南朝奋战，但嫡系被足利氏翦除。后来的德川将军自称出自新田支流，这一世系多被史家视为附会。

en:
The Nogarola were an aristocratic family of Verona, named for their estates at Nogarole Rocca, who served the ruling Scaliger dynasty as soldiers and diplomats. Bailardino Nogarola, born around 1270, was knighted in 1295 and became a trusted councillor of Cangrande I.

Bailardino went as Scaliger ambassador to Emperor Henry VII in Milan in 1311, stood beside Cangrande when Padua was taken in 1328, and arranged the succession of Mastino II and Alberto II at Cangrande's death in 1329. He died in 1340.

In the fifteenth century Leonardo Nogarola and his wife Bianca Borromeo gave their daughters a humanist education. Their daughter Isotta, born in 1418, became the first major female humanist of the Renaissance, famed for her Latin dialogue on the sin of Adam and Eve; her aunt Angela was a Latin poet.
zh:
诺加罗拉是维罗纳贵族，得名于诺加罗莱罗卡的地产，以武将和外交官身份侍奉执政的斯卡利杰家族。拜拉尔迪诺·诺加罗拉约1270年出生，1295年受封骑士，成为坎格兰德一世信赖的谋臣。

拜拉尔迪诺于1311年作为斯卡利杰使节赴米兰觐见皇帝亨利七世，1328年坎格兰德夺取帕多瓦时随侍在侧，1329年坎格兰德去世时安排马斯蒂诺二世与阿尔贝托二世继位。他于1340年去世。

15世纪，莱奥纳尔多·诺加罗拉与妻子比安卡·博罗梅奥让女儿接受人文主义教育。其女伊索塔于1418年出生，成为文艺复兴时期第一位重要的女性人文主义者，以论述亚当与夏娃之罪的拉丁语对话闻名；姑母安杰拉是拉丁语诗人。

en:
The House of Noyers was a feudal dynasty of Burgundy, named after its stronghold on the Serein near Tonnerre. A lord Miles of Noyers witnessed a charter in 1077; the family grew into a great lordship, receiving homage for some eighty fiefs in 1224 while owing vassalage to no one.

Its most famous member was another Miles de Noyers, called the Great, born about 1271. He fought at Courtrai in 1302, became Marshal of France in 1303, and saved the royal oriflamme at Mons-en-Pevele in 1304. He served four kings, bought Joigny for his son in 1338 and died in 1350.

The lordship had accepted the Burgundian duke's suzerainty in 1295. After the last male heir died in 1369 and his sister Jeanne in 1394, the scattered rights were sold to Duchess Margaret of Bavaria in 1419 and 1421.
zh:
努瓦耶家族是勃艮第的封建世家，得名于托内尔附近塞兰河畔的据点。1077年，米隆·德·努瓦耶领主作为特许状见证人出现；家族后来成为大领主，1224年接受约八十个封地的效忠，自身不向任何人承担封臣义务。

家族最著名的成员是另一位米隆·德·努瓦耶，约1271年出生，人称“大人物”。他参加1302年科特赖克战役，1303年成为法兰西元帅，1304年在蒙斯昂佩韦勒战役中护住金焰旗。他历事四任国王，1338年为儿子购得茹瓦尼，1350年去世。

努瓦耶领地于1295年承认勃艮第公爵的宗主权。最后男嗣于1369年去世、其姐让娜于1394年死后，领有权于1419年和1421年卖给巴伐利亚的玛格丽特。

en:
The Nsaku were the ruling line of Mbata, a Bantu kingdom east of Mpemba Kasi along the Kwango River, whose founding ancestor is remembered as Nsaku Ne Vunda.

Around 1375 its chief Nsaku-Lau gave his daughter Lukeni Lua Sange in marriage to Nimi a Nzima of Mpemba Kasi; their son Lukeni lua Nimi became the first king of Kongo. Mbata's army was decisive in the conquest of the plateau kingdom of Mwene Kabunga.

Mbata entered the Kingdom of Kongo as a kingdom within the kingdom: its ruler was not appointed by the Manikongo but succeeded by matrilineal descent from Lukeni Lua Sange, and Mbata princes traditionally led Kongo's diplomacy with neighboring states. After the Kongo court adopted Catholicism and Portuguese customs, Mbata was styled the Duchy of Bambata and kept its privileged standing under the crown of Mbanza Kongo.
zh:
恩萨库家族是姆巴塔的统治世系。姆巴塔是姆潘巴·卡西以东、宽果河沿岸的班图人王国，始祖传说为恩萨库·内·温达。

约1375年，酋长恩萨库·劳把女儿卢凯尼·卢阿·桑格嫁给姆潘巴·卡西的尼米·阿·恩齐马；两人的儿子卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米后来成为刚果的第一代国王。姆巴塔军队在征服高原王国姆韦内·卡本加时起了决定性作用。

姆巴塔以“国中之国”的地位加入刚果王国：其君主不由马尼刚果任命，而是按母系由卢凯尼·卢阿·桑格的后裔继承，姆巴塔王公还按惯例主持刚果与邻国的外交。刚果宫廷接受天主教和葡萄牙习俗后，姆巴塔被称为班巴塔公国，在姆班扎刚果的王权之下保持着特权地位。

en:
Ó Beólláin, or Bolan, was the Gaelic family of the medieval earls, or mormaers, of Ross. Tradition made them hereditary keepers of Applecross monastery. Their first great figure was Fearchar mac an t-Sagairt, meaning son of the priest.

In 1215 Fearchar crushed a revolt in Moray and Ross for Alexander II and presented the rebel leaders' heads to the king. In the 1220s he received the mormaerdom of Ross. His descendants ruled from Dingwall and Tain; Hugh was slain fighting for David II at Halidon Hill in 1333.

The last male earl, William, died in 1372, leaving a daughter, Euphemia. Her marriage to Walter Leslie carried the earldom into the Leslie family; after further disputes Ross passed to the MacDonald lords of the Isles in the fifteenth century.
zh:
博兰即盖尔家族Ó Beólláin，是中世纪罗斯的莫尔马尔，即伯爵世系。相传他们世代掌管阿普尔克罗斯修道院。家族第一位大人物是费查尔·麦克因塔加特，名字意为“神父之子”。

1215年，费查尔替亚历山大二世平定马里和罗斯的叛乱，把叛军首领的首级献给国王。13世纪20年代，他受封罗斯莫尔马尔。其后代以丁沃尔和泰恩为中心统治；休伯爵于1333年在哈利顿山战役中为大卫二世战死。

最后一代男嗣威廉伯爵1372年去世，留下女儿尤菲米娅。她嫁给沃尔特·莱斯利，伯爵领随之转入莱斯利家族；此后几经争夺，罗斯在15世纪落入麦克唐纳家族的群岛领主之手。

en:
The O'Briens, Irish Ó Briain, descend from Brian Boru of the Dál gCais, the Munster king who broke the Uí Néill hold on the high kingship, ruled all Ireland from 1002 and fell winning Clontarf against Dublin's Norsemen and their Leinster allies in 1014. His kin took the name Ua Briain, supplied two more high kings and ruled Munster until the 1118 Treaty of Glanmire split the province and left them Thomond.

The Norman invasion drove them beyond the Shannon, and in 1276 the Crown granted Thomond to Thomas de Clare; the de Clare bid ended in defeat at Dysert O'Dea in 1318, Thomond staying independent for two centuries. Succession ran by tanistry, electing the ablest royal kinsman, which fed long internal feuds.

Last king Murrough O'Brien surrendered to Henry VIII and in 1543 was made Earl of Thomond. A later branch, the Viscounts Clare, followed James II into exile and was attainted in 1691; the earldom was forfeited in 1741.
zh:
布莱恩家族盖尔语名 Ó Briain，英语化姓奥布莱恩，祖先是达尔盖斯部族的布赖恩·博鲁。他打破尼尔家族对爱尔兰最高王位的垄断，1002年成为全爱尔兰的至高王，1014年在克隆塔夫战役击败都柏林诺斯人及其伦斯特盟军，本人战死阵中。后裔以乌·布莱恩为姓，又出过两位至高王，统治芒斯特；1118年《格兰米尔条约》瓜分芒斯特后，他们只剩托蒙德国王头衔。

诺曼入侵把他们逼过香农河，1276年王室把托蒙德封给托马斯·德·克莱尔，但德·克莱尔家族的征服在1318年迪瑟特奥代战役惨败中终结，托蒙德再独立两百年。其继承采用坦尼斯特制，由家族在王室近亲中推选最能干者，长期引发内部仇杀。

末代国王默罗·奥布莱恩向亨利八世投降，1543年受封托蒙德伯爵。旁支克莱尔子爵家族随詹姆斯二世流亡，1691年被剥夺公权，伯爵爵位本身也于1741年被没收。

en:
The O'Cahans (Irish Uí Chatháin, descendants of Cahan) were a powerful sept of the Cenél nEógain of mid-Ulster. They originated in Laggan in eastern Donegal and moved east in the twelfth century, ousting the O'Connors from Keenaght; their lordship of Keenaght and Coleraine became known as O'Cahan's country. The sept first appears on record in 1138.

As vassals of their kinsmen the O'Neills, they inaugurated each new O'Neill chief by casting a shoe over his head. Fifteen O'Cahan chieftains fell fighting the Normans at Drumderg.

Most chiefs fled in the Flight of the Earls in 1607; Donnell Ballagh O'Cahan was captured and died in the Tower of London in 1626, and the lordship was absorbed into the Plantation of Ulster. The harpist Rory Dall O'Cahan may have composed the Londonderry Air as a lament for the fallen sept.
zh:
卡恩家族（爱尔兰语 Uí Chatháin，意为‘卡恩之后’）是阿尔斯特中部岑纳尔·欧文支的强族。他们发祥于多尼戈尔东部的拉根，12世纪东迁，把奥康纳家族逐出基纳特；其领地基纳特与科尔雷恩被称作‘卡恩之地’。该支最早见于1138年的记载。

卡恩家是同族奥尼尔家族的附庸，新任奥尼尔首领即位时，由卡恩家把鞋抛过其头顶。十五位卡恩首领在德拉姆德格死于对诺曼人的战斗。

1607年伯爵出逃时多数首领离开爱尔兰，唐纳尔·巴拉·卡恩被俘，1626年死于伦敦塔，领地并入阿尔斯特种植园。竖琴师罗里·多尔·卡恩或许创作了《伦敦德里小调》，相传此曲是哀悼家族衰败的挽歌。

en: Ó Cearbhaill, anglicised O'Carroll, is a Gaelic Irish surname from the personal name Cearbhall, borne by several distinct septs; the greatest of them ruled the kingdom of Éile, called Ely O'Carroll, on the Offaly and Tipperary border until its last chief surrendered it to the Tudor crown in 1552.
zh: 卡罗尔（爱尔兰语 Ó Cearbhaill）是源自人名 Cearbhall 的盖尔爱尔兰姓氏，历史上有多个互不统属的支系；最显赫的一支统治奥法利与蒂珀雷里交界处的埃莱王国，又称埃利·奥卡罗尔，末代首领于1552年向都铎王室投降。

en:
The O'Conors (Irish Ó Conchobhair) were the royal dynasty of Connacht in western Ireland. They held the kingship of Connacht on and off from 967 and continuously from 1102 until 1475, and gave Ireland two high kings: Tairrdelbach Ua Conchobair and his son Ruaidrí, the last high king. Ruaidrí accepted Norman overlordship under the treaty of Windsor in 1175 while retaining Connacht.

In 1337 the family ruled from its Roscommon heartland, but succession under Brehon law went by election among rival kinsmen, feeding internal feuds. By the late fourteenth century the dynasty had split into two rival lines, the O'Conor Don and the O'Conor Roe.

Feidhlimidh Geangcach, who died in 1474, was the last fully recognised king of Connacht, though An Calbhach O'Conor Don was still inaugurated as king during the fighting of 1643, before the Gaelic order was broken.
zh:
康纳家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Conchobhair）是爱尔兰西部康诺特的王族。他们自967年起断断续续、1102—1475年间连续担任康诺特国王，并出过两位爱尔兰至高王：泰尔德巴赫·康纳，以及他的儿子、末代至高王罗德里。罗德里在1175年的《温莎条约》中接受诺曼人的宗主权，但保住了康诺特。

1337年时家族仍以罗斯康芒一带为根基掌权；不过按布雷亨法，王位由亲族内部竞争推选，常引发内讧。到14世纪末，王朝分裂为唐·康纳与罗·康纳两支相争。

1474年去世的费德利米是最后一位得到普遍承认的康诺特国王；1643年战乱中，卡尔瓦赫·唐·康纳仍被推举为王，之后盖尔秩序瓦解。

en:
The O'Dohertys (Irish Ó Dochartaigh) were a Gaelic Irish clan of the Cenél Conaill, the Northern Uí Néill confederation of Donegal, and kinsmen of the O'Donnells of Tír Conaill. They took their name from Dochartach, who flourished in the tenth century, and were originally chiefs of Cenél Eanna.

In 1337 they were a leading sept among the Donegal clans of Tír Conaill, and early in the fifteenth century they became rulers of the Inishowen peninsula. Sir Cahir O'Doherty, the last Gaelic chief, fought for the English in the Nine Years' War but revolted in 1608, seizing and burning Derry. He was killed at Kilmacrennan the same year, his rising collapsed, and Inishowen was confiscated for the Ulster Plantation.
zh:
多尔蒂家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Dochartaigh）是盖尔爱尔兰宗族，属于多尼戈尔的北方乌伊·尼尔联盟岑纳尔·康奈尔支，与蒂康奈尔的奥唐奈家族同族。他们得名于10世纪活跃的多哈尔塔赫，原为岑纳尔·恩纳的首领。

1337年时，他们是蒂康奈尔境内多尼戈尔诸族中的重要一支，15世纪初成为伊尼什欧文半岛的统治者。末代盖尔首领卡希尔·多尔蒂爵士曾在九年战争中为英格兰作战，却于1608年起兵反叛，攻占并焚毁德里。他同年在基尔麦克伦南战死，叛乱失败，伊尼什欧文被没收并划入阿尔斯特种植园。

en:
The Donalds, Gaelic Ó Dómaill or descendants of Dónal, were known in English as the O'Donnells and were the ruling clan of Tyrconnell, covering most of later County Donegal. They claimed descent from Niall of the Nine Hostages through his son Conall Gulban, whom Saint Patrick was said to have baptised.

From Donegal Castle the chiefs rivalled the O'Neills of Tyrone, defeating them at Knockavoe in 1522 and Farsetmore in 1567. Manus O'Donnell composed a life of Saint Columba.

In the Nine Years' War of 1593 to 1603 Red Hugh O'Donnell and Hugh O'Neill led the Irish confederates until defeat at Kinsale in 1601; Red Hugh died in Spain the next year. His brother Rory became Earl of Tyrconnell in 1603 but joined the Flight of the Earls in 1607. The earldom was attainted in 1614 as the Plantation of Ulster swallowed Tyrconnell.
zh:
唐纳德家族，盖尔语作奥·多奈尔，意为多纳尔的后裔，英语中称奥唐奈家族，是蒂康奈尔王国的统治氏族，领地涵盖后来多尼戈尔郡的大部分。他们自称出自九质王尼尔，先祖是据说由圣帕特里克施洗的尼尔之子科纳尔·古尔班。

族长以多尼戈尔城堡为中心，与蒂龙的奥尼尔家族争霸，先后于1522年在诺卡沃、1567年在法塞特莫尔击败对手。马纳斯·奥唐奈撰写了圣科伦巴的传记。

1593—1603年的九年战争中，红休·奥唐奈与休·奥尼尔率领爱尔兰联军，1601年在金塞尔战败，红休次年死于西班牙。其弟罗里1603年受封蒂康奈尔伯爵，却在1607年参加伯爵出逃。1614年伯爵领被剥夺，蒂康奈尔被阿尔斯特殖民吞并。

en:
The O'Dowds (Irish Ó Dubhda) were a Gaelic Irish clan of north Connacht, descended from the Uí Fiachrach. Their surname, from the ninth-century ancestor Dubda mac Connmhach, was among the oldest recorded in Ireland, the annals noting the death of an Aedh Ua Dubhda in 982.

From the eighth to the fifteenth century they were kings of Uí Fiachrach Muaidhe, the coastal country of Tireragh, and a maritime power in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, with some twenty castles. In 1354 Sen-Bhrian O'Dowd temporarily drove the Anglo-Norman settlers out of Tireragh, and each chief was inaugurated at Carn Amhalghaigh near Killala.

They sponsored the Great Book of Lecan, compiled by the MacFirbis chroniclers between 1397 and 1418, which records their inauguration rite. After the medieval kingdom was absorbed into the Kingdom of Ireland, they continued as lords of Tír Fhiacrach.
zh:
多德家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Dubhda）是康诺特北部的盖尔裔爱尔兰人宗族，出自乌伊·菲阿赫拉赫族群。其姓氏源自9世纪的先祖杜布达·麦克科纳马赫，是爱尔兰有记载的最古老姓氏之一，编年史在982年记下了艾德·奥多德的去世。

8—15世纪，他们担任乌伊·菲阿赫拉赫·穆艾德的国王，统治沿海的蒂雷拉地区，12—13世纪更是海上强权，拥有约二十座城堡。1354年，森·布里安·多德一度把盎格鲁—诺曼定居者逐出蒂雷拉；历代首领都在基拉拉附近的卡恩·阿瓦尔加举行即位仪式。

他们赞助编年史家麦克菲尔比斯家族于1397—1418年编纂的《莱坎大书》，书中保存了多德家的即位仪典。中世纪王国并入爱尔兰王国后，他们仍以蒂雷拉领主的身份存续。

en:
The Falys were the O'Connor Falys, the ruling dynasty of the Gaelic kingdom of Uí Failghe, whose name survives in County Offaly. Tradition traced the kingdom to the legendary king Rus Failge of the early sixth century. From the mid-eleventh century its rulers bore the O'Connor Faly surname, though they were no kin to the O'Connors of Connacht.

Their seat moved from Rathangan to the island fortress of Daingean when the Normans arrived. They long kept their independence, and by the early sixteenth century the men of Meath and Kildare paid them yearly black rent.

Brian O'Connor Faly, lord from about 1520, raided the English Pale for decades before surrendering in 1548; he escaped the Tower of London but died in Dublin Castle in 1560. The Settlement of Laois and Offaly Act of 1556 partitioned the old kingdom, ending the independent lordship.
zh:
法利家族即奥康纳·法利家族，是盖尔王国乌伊法尔格的统治王朝，奥法利郡的名字便来自这个王国。按家族传统，王国可追溯到6世纪初传说中的国王罗斯·法尔盖；11世纪中叶起，其统治者开始使用奥康纳·法利之姓，与康诺特的奥康纳家族并无血缘。

诺曼人到来后，他们把驻地从拉森甘迁到丹甘的岛上要塞，长期保持独立；到16世纪初，米斯和基尔代尔的居民每年都要向他们缴纳贡金。

约1520年继任首领的布莱恩·奥康纳·法利数十年来不断袭掠英格兰人的佩尔地区，1548年投降；他曾从伦敦塔逃脱，最终于1560年死于都柏林城堡。1556年的《莱斯与奥法利安置法令》瓜分了旧王国，独立的首领政权至此终结。

en:
The Farrells, Irish Ó Fearghail, were descendants of Fearghail, whose great-grandfather Angaile gave his name to Annaly in the Irish midlands. They belonged to the Conmaicne peoples, and around 1070 the Ó Fearghail and allied tribes conquered Tethbae, later County Longford, where they ruled as princes of Annaly from Longphoirt, the future Longford.

After the Norman invasion the territory was granted to Hugh de Lacy and an English colony was planted at Granard. English power receded in the fourteenth century: Edward Bruce sacked Granard in 1315 and the O'Farrells re-established control of Annaly.

They kept their Gaelic lordship until Tudor conquest reached the midlands. Annaly was shired as Longford in 1586, and the O'Farrell estates were broken up in the Plantation of Longford of 1620, dispossessing the family of its principality.
zh:
法雷尔家族的爱尔兰姓氏为 Ó Fearghail（奥法雷尔），其先祖费尔加尔的曾祖父安加莱的名字成了爱尔兰中部安纳利领地的名称。他们属于康梅克涅诸族；1070年前后，奥法雷尔联合邻近部落征服了特斯巴，即后来的朗福德郡，并以朗福特尔特即后来的朗福德为据点，统治安纳利。

诺曼入侵后，这片土地被封给休·德·拉西，英格兰人还在格拉纳德建立殖民点。14世纪起英格兰势力衰退：1315年爱德华·布鲁斯洗劫格拉纳德，奥法雷尔家族恢复了对安纳利的控制。

他们保有这块盖尔人领地，直到都铎王朝的征服推进到爱尔兰中部。1586年安纳利被划为朗福德郡；1620年朗福德种植园中，奥法雷尔的地产被分割，家族失去了领地。

en:
The Flahertys, in Irish Ó Flaithbheartaigh, were a Gaelic clan of County Galway in Connacht, a branch of the Uí Briúin Seóla kindred. From the ninth century they ruled Maigh Seóla east of Lough Corrib, but in the 1050s the O'Connors, kings of Connacht, drove them across the lake into Iar Connacht, later known as Connemara, where they reigned as kings.

They governed the nascent town of Galway until the Norman de Burghs, the Clanricarde Burkes, seized it in 1232; its English settlers prayed for deliverance from the ferocious O'Flahertys. Through the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries the clan remained the dominant Gaelic power west of Lough Corrib, effectively independent of Dublin and the Burkes.

The clan's lordship was broken during the Tudor conquest of Connacht. Roderick O'Flaherty (1629-1718), historian and last recognised Lord of Iar Connacht, preserved its genealogies in his writings.
zh:
弗莱厄蒂家族，爱尔兰语作 Ó Flaithbheartaigh，是康诺特戈尔韦郡的盖尔人氏族，属乌伊·布里温·塞奥拉族群。自9世纪起，他们统治科里布湖以东的马格塞奥拉；11世纪50年代，康诺特国王奥康纳家族把他们逐到湖西岸的西康诺特，即后来的康尼马拉，他们在那里称王。

他们曾管辖初建的戈尔韦城，直到诺曼人德·伯格家族，即克兰里卡德的伯克家族，于1232年夺取该城；城里的英格兰移民甚至祈祷从凶猛的弗莱厄蒂人手中得到解救。14—15世纪，他们仍是科里布湖以西最强大的盖尔势力，对都柏林和伯克家族保持实际独立。

在都铎王朝征服康诺特的过程中，其领主统治瓦解。历史学家罗德里克·奥弗莱厄蒂（1629—1718）是最后一位获承认的西康诺特领主，在著作中保存了家族谱系。

en:
The O'Kellys (Irish Ó Ceallaigh) were the chiefly dynasty of Uí Maine, one of the oldest and largest kingdoms of Connacht, stretching across eastern Galway and southern Roscommon. Native genealogies traced them to Maine Mór, founder of the Uí Maine line. They supplied its kings through the medieval centuries, and in 1337 the O'Kelly chief still ruled the subject kingdom.

The Book of Uí Maine, an Irish genealogical codex, was compiled around 1392 to 1394 at the request of Muircertach Ó Ceallaigh, bishop of Clonfert and later archbishop of Tuam, and kept by the clan until 1757.

In 1503 the Clanricarde Burkes sacked O'Kelly castles, and the feud drew Maelsechlainn Ó Cellaigh, king of Uí Maine, into the battle of Knockdoe in 1504.
zh:
凯利家族（爱尔兰语 Ó Ceallaigh）是乌伊梅恩的首领王朝；乌伊梅恩是康诺特最古老、最大的王国之一，版图横跨戈尔韦东部与罗斯康芒南部。按本土谱系，他们是乌伊梅恩王族始祖梅恩·莫尔的后裔，在中世纪长期出任国王，1337年时凯利家的首领仍统治着这个附庸王国。

爱尔兰语谱系典集《乌伊梅恩之书》约于1392—1394年应克洛恩弗特主教、后任蒂厄姆大主教的米尔瑟塔赫·凯利之命编纂，一直由家族保存到1757年。

1503年，克兰里卡德的伯克家族摧毁了凯利家的城堡，这场争端把乌伊梅恩国王梅尔谢赫林·凯利卷入1504年的诺克多战役。

en:
The O'Malleys, Irish Uí Máille, were a seafaring Gaelic clan who by the twelfth century ruled Umhaill around Clew Bay in west County Mayo. Claiming descent from Maille mac Conall, they were once autonomous under the kings of Connacht and later vassals of the Mac William Íochtar Bourkes. They lined their coast with castles, charging black rent even to English fishermen.

Their most famous ruler was Gráinne Ní Mháille, Grace O'Malley, born about 1530, who after her father's death took charge of the family's lands and fleets, raiding and trading along the western seaboard.

In 1576 she submitted under surrender and regrant, and in 1593 she sailed to London and pleaded before Elizabeth I at Greenwich for the release of her two captive sons and her half-brother. She died about 1603, and Umhaill passed to her son Tibbot na Long.
zh:
马利家族的盖尔语名为 Uí Máille，是航海的盖尔宗族，12世纪时已统治梅奥郡西部克鲁湾周围的乌马尔。他们自称是马耶·麦克·康纳尔的后裔，早年在康诺特诸王治下自治，后来成为麦克威廉·约赫塔尔伯克家族的附庸。他们沿海修筑城堡，连英格兰渔民也要缴纳贡金。

家族最著名的首领是约1530年出生的格兰妮·尼·马耶，即格蕾丝·奥马利；父亲去世后，她接掌土地与船队，在西海岸劫掠和贸易。

1576年她按“投降与再封”政策归顺，1593年前往伦敦，在格林尼治向伊丽莎白一世陈情，请求释放被俘的两个儿子和异母弟。她约于1603年去世，乌马尔由其子蒂博特·纳·朗继承。

en:
The O'Molloys, Irish Ó Maolmhuaidh from a word meaning proud chieftain, were a Gaelic Irish kindred of the Southern Uí Néill who ruled Firceall, the Fir Ceall or “men of the churches”, in the south-west of the Kingdom of Meath around Tullamore. As princes of Firceall they patronised its abbeys, including Rahan and Kilcormac.

In the early thirteenth century one of their kindred served as bishop of Ferns. The family held its lands through the later Middle Ages until the English plantations of the 1550s, when Firceall was confiscated and divided into the baronies of Ballycowan, Ballyboy and Eglish.
zh:
莫洛伊家族的盖尔语名为 Ó Maolmhuaidh，名字源自意为“骄傲酋长”的词语。他们是南尼尔支系的盖尔宗亲，统治米斯王国西南端塔拉莫尔一带的费尔塞尔，即盖尔语“教会之人”。费尔塞尔的首领庇护拉汉、基尔科马克等地的修道院。

13世纪初，一位族人出任弗恩斯主教。家族在中世纪后期一直保有领地，到1550年代英格兰人的种植园运动中，费尔塞尔被没收并拆分为巴利考恩、巴利博伊和埃格利什三个男爵领。

en:
The O'Neills, Irish Ó Néill, are the leading dynasty of the Cenél nEógain, the northern branch of the Uí Néill, claiming descent from Niall Glúndub, high king of Ireland, who died in 919; his great-grandson Flaithbertach first bore the Ua Néill surname. They long contested Ailech and Tír Eógain with the Meic Lochlainn, until Caimeirge in 1241 destroyed the rival line and left them supreme in Ulster.

From 1232 their chiefs ruled Tír Eógain from Dungannon, and when the Norman earldom of Ulster collapsed in 1333 the junior Clandeboye branch filled eastern Ulster.

In 1542 the crown recognised the chief as Earl of Tyrone, but Hugh O'Neill led the Nine Years' War against English conquest, submitting in 1603 and fleeing in the Flight of the Earls in 1607, after which his lands passed to the Plantation of Ulster. Dispossessed O'Neills later joined the rebellion of 1641 and served as exiled officers in the Spanish army.
zh:
奥尼尔家族爱尔兰语作 Ó Néill，是尼尔后裔北支岑纳尔·欧文的首族，自称源自919年去世的爱尔兰高王尼尔·格伦杜布；其曾孙弗莱思贝塔克是第一个使用 Ua Néill 姓氏的人。他们与麦克洛克林家族长期争夺艾莱赫和蒂尔欧文的王位，直到1241年卡梅尔格战役歼灭对手的首领层，奥尼尔遂称雄阿尔斯特。

自1232年起，其族长以蒂尔欧文国王身份在邓甘嫩统治；1333年诺曼人的阿尔斯特伯国崩溃后，旁支克兰德博伊奥尼尔趁势控制阿尔斯特东部。

1542年，英格兰王室承认其族长为蒂龙伯爵，但休·奥尼尔发动九年战争抵抗英格兰征服，1603年投降，又在1607年的“伯爵出逃”中流亡欧洲大陆，其领地随后被阿尔斯特种植园吞并。失去土地的奥尼尔人后来参加1641年叛乱，也有人以流亡军官身份在西班牙军队中服役。

en:
The Reillys, Gaelic Ó Raghallaigh or descendants of Raghallach, were the ruling dynasty of East Breifne, the Gaelic kingdom that became County Cavan. They were close kin of the O'Rourkes, once their overlords. Backed by Connacht, the Reillys eclipsed them in the 1230s, and their long war ended in 1256 with the partition of Breifne between the two families.

Their kings were chosen by tanistry and inaugurated on Shantemon Hill above Cavan town. East Breifne minted its own silver coinage, called Reillys, which Dublin outlawed in 1447 and 1456. The chief Maolmordha O'Reilly attended the English crown's parliament in 1541 under surrender and regrant.

In 1579 the kingdom was shired as Cavan. The Reillys joined the rebels in the Nine Years' War, and after defeat in 1603 and attainders by 1607 the lordship was swallowed by the Plantation of Ulster.
zh:
赖利家族，盖尔语作奥·拉莱，意为拉加拉赫的后裔，是东布雷夫讷的统治王朝，这个盖尔王国即后来的卡文郡。他们与曾为其宗主的鲁尔克家族是近亲。13世纪30年代，赖利家族在康诺特支持下压过鲁尔克家族，双方长期战争以1256年两家瓜分布雷夫讷告终。

国王依塔尼斯特里制推选，在卡文镇上方的尚特蒙山就职。东布雷夫讷自行铸造赖利银币，都柏林政府于1447年和1456年立法取缔。1541年族长马尔莫拉·奥莱利出席都柏林议会，接受投降与再封。

1579年王国被划为卡文郡。九年战争中赖利家族加入叛军，1603年战败，随后到1607年爵位被剥夺，领地被阿尔斯特殖民吞并。

en:
The Rourkes, Gaelic Ó Ruairc, were Breifne's royal line and, after 1256, kings of West Breifne, later County Leitrim. King Tighearnán Ó Ruairc was betrayed and killed in talks with the Anglo-Normans in 1172. The battle of Magh Slecht in 1256 split the kingdom: the Rourkes held the west from Dromahair, while the Reillys ruled the east.

West Breifne was shired as Leitrim in 1583. Brian na Múrtha Ó Ruairc rebelled against English terms, fled to Scotland in 1591, and was arrested at Elizabeth I's demand and hanged, drawn and quartered in London.

His son Brian Óg joined the Nine Years' War, swearing loyalty to Spain in 1595. After defeat in 1603 and Sir Tadhg O'Rourke's death in 1605, Tadhg's young sons were declared illegitimate in 1619, clearing the way for the Plantation of Leitrim and the end of the lordship.
zh:
鲁尔克家族，盖尔语作奥鲁尔克，本是布雷夫讷的王统，1256年之后成为西布雷夫讷即后来的利特里姆郡的国王。1172年，其国王蒂尔南·奥鲁尔克在与盎格鲁—诺曼人谈判时遭出卖被杀。1256年马斯莱克特战役后王国分裂：鲁尔克家族以德罗马黑尔为中心据有西部，赖利家族统治东部。

1583年西布雷夫讷被划为利特里姆郡。布赖恩·纳·穆尔塔·奥鲁尔克因反抗英格兰条款而起兵，1591年逃往苏格兰，在伊丽莎白一世要求下被捕，押往伦敦处以绞刑、开膛与车裂。

其子小布赖恩参加九年战争，并于1595年宣誓效忠西班牙。1603年战败、1605年泰格·奥鲁尔克爵士死后，泰格年幼的儿子们于1619年被宣布为私生子，利特里姆殖民由此扫清障碍，领主政权终结。

en:
The Sullivans, Gaelic Ó Súilleabháin, were a Munster clan claiming descent from the Eóganachta kings of Cashel. Driven from Tipperary by the Normans in the 1190s, they settled in Kerry and west Cork. Their branches included the O'Sullivan Beare, seated at Dunboy Castle on Bantry Bay.

With the MacCarthys and O'Donoghues they defeated the Norman FitzGeralds at Caisglin in 1261 and 1262, fixing the Gaelic frontier in the south-west. In 1587 Donal Cam became The O'Sullivan Beare with Dublin's backing.

He joined the Nine Years' War; after the defeat at Kinsale in 1601, his garrison was hanged when Dunboy fell in 1602. That winter he led a thousand soldiers and civilians on a three-hundred-mile march to the O'Rourkes in Leitrim, harried at every step. He went into exile in Spain and was stabbed to death in Madrid in 1618.
zh:
沙利文家族，盖尔语作奥·苏利文，是芒斯特的盖尔氏族，自称出自卡舍尔的欧加纳赫塔王统。12世纪90年代，他们被诺曼人逐出蒂珀雷里，迁居凯里和西科克。家族支系包括以班特里湾畔邓博伊城堡为主堡的贝拉奥沙利文。

1261年和1262年，他们联合麦卡锡、奥多诺霍两大家族在凯斯格林击败诺曼人菲茨杰拉德家族，奠定了西南部的盖尔人边界。1587年，多纳尔·卡姆在都柏林当局支持下成为贝拉的奥沙利文族长。

他参加九年战争；1601年金塞尔战败后，1602年邓博伊陷落，守军被绞死。当年冬天，他率领上千名士兵与平民向利特里姆的鲁尔克家族展开三百英里的行军，一路遭到追击。他流亡西班牙，1618年在马德里遇刺身亡。

en:
The O'Tooles, Irish Ó Tuathail, were a Leinster clan named after Tuathal mac Augaire, king of Leinster, who died in 958; his grandson Doncaon was the first to bear the surname hereditarily. They held southern Kildare until the Anglo-Norman invasion of the twelfth century drove them into the Wicklow mountains around Glendalough, with their power centred on the Glen of Imaal.

Lorcán Ua Tuathail, archbishop of Dublin at the Norman invasion and canonised in 1225, was born a chief's son at Kilkea. From their glens the O'Tooles and their kinsmen the O'Byrnes raided the English Pale around Dublin for nearly four centuries.

By 1500 five great houses acknowledged the O'Toole of Powerscourt as their chief. The sept joined the Confederate Catholics at Kilkenny in 1642, and in the eighteenth century its swordsmen served in the armies of France and Spain.
zh:
图尔家族的盖尔语名为 Ó Tuathail，得名于958年去世的伦斯特国王图阿塔尔·麦克·奥盖雷；他的孙子唐康最早世代使用这一姓氏。他们领有基尔代尔南部，12世纪盎格鲁—诺曼人入侵后被逐入威克洛山区，在格伦达洛一带立足，权力中心在伊马尔谷。

诺曼入侵时的都柏林大主教劳伦斯·奥图尔出生在基尔基尔的酋长之家，于1225年被封圣。此后近四百年里，图尔人与同宗的奥伯恩人一道从山谷出击，袭扰都柏林周边的英格兰佩尔地区。

1500年前后，家族五房共奉鲍尔斯考特的图尔族长为首领。1642年他们加入基尔肯尼的天主教联盟，18世纪族人在法国和西班牙的军队中服役。

en:
The Oda were a Japanese samurai house originating in Oda-no-shō in Echizen, where their founder Taira no Chikazane is said to have been raised by a priest after the Taira defeat at Dannoura in 1185. The Oda served the Shiba and followed them to Owari, becoming hereditary deputy governors.

After the Ōnin War the clan split into rival branches at Iwakura and Kiyosu, while the Shiba became puppets. Oda Nobuhide seized Nagoya Castle in 1538, and his son Nobunaga reunited Owari, subdued rivals and entered Kyoto in 1568, becoming master of central Japan.

In 1582 Nobunaga and his heir Nobutada were killed in the Honnō-ji Incident, and his general Hashiba Hideyoshi, later Toyotomi Hideyoshi, inherited his hegemony. The main line under Oda Hidenobu joined the western army at Sekigahara in 1600 and was dispossessed by Tokugawa Ieyasu; four junior branches kept daimyō rank through the Edo period.
zh:
织田氏是日本武家氏族，发源于越前国织田庄。相传1185年平氏在坛之浦战败后，始祖平亲真被托付给神主抚养。织田氏本是斯波氏的家臣，随斯波氏转封尾张国，世代出任守护代。

应仁之乱后，一族分裂为以岩仓和清洲为据点的两支互相攻伐，斯波氏反被架空。织田信秀于1538年夺取名古屋城，其子信长重新统一尾张，压服对手，于1568年进入京都，成为畿内的霸主。

1582年，信长与嫡子信忠在本能寺之变中遇害，部将羽柴秀吉，即后来的丰臣秀吉，接过了霸业。1600年关原之战中，当主织田秀信加入西军，被德川家康改易；四家旁支在江户时代保有大名地位。

en:
The counts of Oettingen were a Swabian and Franconian noble house, tracing their line to the Sieghardinger counts of the Riesgau documented around 1000, forebears shared with the Hohenstaufen. The family first appears in 1147, when Louis received the county around Nördlingen as a fief; they built Steinsberg castle around 1200.

Between the twelfth and fourteenth centuries they assembled the largest secular territory in east Swabia. In the fourteenth century Irmengard of Oettingen became countess palatine of the Rhine.

Partitions began in 1410 and multiplied the lines, including the Protestant Oettingen-Oettingen, which won princely rank in 1674 but died out in 1731. The Spielberg and Wallerstein branches were raised to principalities in 1734 and 1774; in the mediatisation of 1806 their lands passed to Bavaria and Württemberg while the family kept its titles.
zh:
厄廷根伯爵是施瓦本与法兰克尼亚的贵族世家，世系可追溯到约1000年见于文献的里斯高西哈丁根伯爵，他们与霍亨斯陶芬家族有共同的祖先。家族首次出现于1147年：路易受封讷德林根周围的伯国；约1200年，他们修建了施泰因斯贝格城堡。

12—14世纪间，家族拼起东施瓦本最大的世俗领地。14世纪，厄廷根的伊尔门加德成为莱茵行宫伯爵夫人。

1410年起家族不断分家，其中信奉新教的厄廷根—厄廷根支系于1674年获得诸侯爵位，1731年绝嗣。施皮尔贝格和瓦勒施泰因两支分别于1734年和1774年升为侯国；1806年德意志采邑调解中，其领地并入巴伐利亚和符腾堡，家族保留了头衔。

en:
The Cempoala were the ruling house of the Totonac city of Cempoala on the Gulf coast of Veracruz, whose Nahuatl name means place of twenty waters. Totonac settlers had occupied the plain since the Toltec empire's height between 1000 and 1150; the walled city, with its temples and palaces, may have held 25,000 to 30,000 people at its peak.

In the fifteenth century Moctezuma I conquered the coast, and Cempoala's rulers became Aztec tributaries, sending goods and people for sacrifice and enslavement. In 1519 its tlatoani Xicomecoatl, nicknamed the Fat Chief by the Spaniards, welcomed Hernán Cortés and made the first Spanish-indigenous alliance against the Aztecs at Quiahuiztlan.

Thousands of Cempoalan warriors joined the march inland ending with the fall of Tenochtitlan in 1521. In May 1520 Cempoala was the scene of Cortés's victory over Pánfilo de Narváez.
zh:
森波阿拉家族是韦拉克鲁斯海湾沿岸托托纳克人城市森波阿拉的统治家族，城名在纳瓦语中意为“二十水之地”。托托纳克人在1000—1150年托尔特克帝国鼎盛时期迁居平原，这座有城墙环绕、遍布神庙宫殿的城市极盛时可能有2.5万至3万居民。

15世纪，蒙特祖马一世的军队征服沿海，森波阿拉的统治者沦为阿兹特克附庸，被迫进贡物产和用于献祭、奴役的人口。1519年，其特拉托阿尼希科梅科阿特尔被西班牙人称为“胖酋长”，他迎接埃尔南·科尔特斯，并在基亚维斯特兰缔结西班牙人与土著对抗阿兹特克的第一个同盟。

数以千计的森波阿拉战士加入向内陆的远征，最终在1521年促成特诺奇蒂特兰陷落。1520年5月，科尔特斯在森波阿拉击败了潘菲洛·德·纳瓦埃斯。

en:
The Tlaxcallan were the ruling Nahua house of the Tlaxcalan polity in the Puebla-Tlaxcala valley. Their tradition remembers Culhuatecuhtli Quanex, under whom a Nahua group founded the hilltop city of Tepeticpac Texcallan. His line grew into a coalition of four altepeme, which united during the fourteenth century and shared power instead of crowning a single king.

Ringed by Aztec territory, Tlaxcala was never conquered: from the reign of Moctezuma I (1440-1469) the Triple Alliance fought it in flower wars to take sacrificial captives and imposed a trade embargo.

When Hernán Cortés arrived in 1519 the Tlaxcalans, after fierce fighting, took him as their ally and supplied most of the indigenous troops that besieged and destroyed Tenochtitlan in 1521, earning the polity a privileged allied status under Spanish rule.
zh:
特拉斯卡拉家族是普埃布拉—特拉斯卡拉谷地特拉斯卡拉政权的纳瓦人统治家族。据传，库尔瓦特库特利·夸内克斯率纳瓦人建立了山城特佩蒂克帕克·特克斯卡兰。他的世系后来发展为四个阿尔特佩特利的联盟，14世纪联合后以分权共治代替单一君主。

特拉斯卡拉被阿兹特克领土包围却始终未被征服：从蒙特祖马一世在位期间（1440—1469年）起，三方联盟以荣冠战争与它交战，掳掠献祭俘虏，并实行贸易禁运。

1519年埃尔南·科尔特斯到来后，特拉斯卡拉人在激战后与他结盟，提供了1521年围攻并摧毁特诺奇蒂特兰的大部分土著军队，也为自己在西班牙统治下争得盟友的特权地位。

en:
The Toungoo were the ruling house of the frontier principality of Toungoo on the Sittaung river. The brothers Thawun Gyi and Thawun Nge founded the town in 1279 as Pagan power collapsed. Kayin Ba, an athi commoner, rose from prison officer to mayor; in 1325 he exploited a succession struggle in Pinya, killed the young governor Saw Hnit and ruled like a sovereign.

He repaired irrigation works and kept 150 war elephants, turning Toungoo into a regional power before his death in 1342. The governors broke free of Pinya in 1358. Ava reincorporated Toungoo in 1470, but Mingyi Nyo became governor in 1485 and declared independence in 1510.

His successors Tabinshwehti and Bayinnaung built the First Toungoo Empire. After its collapse the Nyaungyan restoration ruled from Ava until the Mon revolt of 1740 and the fall of Inwa in 1752 ended the dynasty.
zh:
东吁家族是锡当河畔边陲藩镇东吁的统治家族。1279年，在蒲甘王朝衰亡之际，达温基、达温额兄弟建立了东吁城。阿蒂平民加因巴从狱吏升为城主；1325年，他利用彬牙王位之争，处死年幼的总督索奈夺取政权，此后如同独立君主一般统治。

他修缮灌溉工程，保有150头战象，把东吁经营成区域强权，于1342年去世。历代总督在1358年摆脱彬牙独立；1470年东吁被阿瓦重新收服，明吉纽1485年出任总督，1510年宣布独立。

他的继承者德彬瑞蒂和勃印曩建立起第一东吁帝国。帝国崩溃后，良渊王系在阿瓦复辟，直到1740年孟人叛乱、1752年阿瓦陷落，王朝告终。

en:
The Xaltocan were the ruling house of the Otomi city-state of Xaltocan, an island altepetl in the northern Valley of Mexico. Colonial chronicles count the Xaltocameca among the Chichimec tribes that left Aztlán under Quauhtliztac, or White Eagle; the island grew rich on chinampa farming and exacted tribute from neighbouring cities.

In the thirteenth century Xaltocan fought a long war against the Nahua city of Cuauhtitlan, whose ruler Xaltemoctzin and his allies conquered the island around 1395. The Otomi ruling house and its people were driven out, while Nahuatl speakers took over the island.

After the Triple Alliance overthrew Azcapotzalco, Xaltocan became a tributary of Tenochtitlan, paying mainly in woven blankets. In 1521 Hernán Cortés razed the city during the conquest of the Aztec empire.
zh:
夏尔托坎家族是奥托米人城邦夏尔托坎的统治家族，该城邦是墨西哥谷地北部的岛屿阿尔特佩特利。殖民时期史书把夏尔托坎人列入在夸乌特利兹塔克（意为“白鹰”）率领下离开阿兹特兰的奇奇梅克诸部；该岛依靠奇南帕农业致富，并向邻近城邦征收贡赋。

13世纪，夏尔托坎与纳瓦人的夸乌蒂特兰城邦长期交战；约1395年，夸乌蒂特兰统治者夏尔特莫克钦与盟友攻占该岛。奥托米王室与族人被逐，纳瓦语人群随后接管岛屿。

三方联盟推翻阿斯卡波特萨尔科后，夏尔托坎成为特诺奇蒂特兰的贡赋附庸，主要缴纳织物。1521年，埃尔南·科尔特斯在征服阿兹特克帝国期间将该城夷为平地。

en: The Yucucui were the ruling house of a Mixtec hilltop polity in the Mixteca Alta of Oaxaca: yucu means hill in Mixtec and Cerro Yucucui lies in the Coixtlahuaca region. Mixtec lordly families intermarried with their Zapotec neighbours, explaining a member of the house holding power at Zaachila, the last Zapotec capital, before its Aztec conquest in 1495.
zh: 尤库库伊家族是瓦哈卡米斯特卡高地一个小米斯特克山顶城邦的统治家族：米斯特克语里 yucu 意为“山”，尤库库伊山地处科伊斯特拉瓦卡一带。米斯特克贵族家族常与邻近的萨波特克人通婚，这解释了该家族成员何以在萨波特克人的末代首都萨奇拉掌权，萨奇拉于1495年被阿兹特克征服。

en:
The Ogamo were the oldest-established clan of Hōki Province, tracing their ancestor to Ogamo-nushi, honoured with that title by Emperor Tenji. From Ogamo township of Kume District they served as provincial-office officials and held Iwakura Castle.

In the Genpei War the head Ogamo Suke Motoyasu fought for the Taira, but Minamoto no Yoritomo confirmed his standing in 1192. In 1333 the Ogamo were said to have brought three hundred horsemen to Emperor Go-Daigo at Mount Senjō, though the family appears to have split when Nawa Nagatoshi forced Ogamo Motoyuki's castle to surrender.

Under the Muromachi shogunate they served the Yamana and fought in the Kakitsu Incident of 1441. The clan later lost Iwakura to Amago Tsunehisa, served the Amago and Mōri, and recovered it after the Amago collapsed. In 1600 the Nanjo were dispossessed after Sekigahara, and the Ogamo were ruined and scattered.
zh:
小鸭氏是伯耆国历史最悠久的一族，家谱称其始祖是获天智天皇赐号的“小鸭主”。家族出身久米郡小鸭乡，担任国衙在厅官人，以岩仓城为居城。

源平合战中，当主小鸭介基保站在平氏一方，但源赖朝于1192年保全了他在国内的地位。1333年后醍醐天皇在船上山举兵时，相传小鸭氏率三百骑参战；但名和长年迫使小鸭元之所在的城池投降，一族内部应已发生分裂。

室町时代，小鸭氏从属山名氏，参加1441年的嘉吉之乱。此后尼子经久攻陷岩仓城，小鸭氏先后从属尼子氏、毛利氏，尼子灭亡后才夺回城池。1600年南条氏在关原之战后遭改易，小鸭氏也随之没落，族人逃散。

en:
The Ogasawara were a Seiwa Genji family who traced their line to Takeda Yoshikiyo; his great-grandson Nagakiyo was the first to take the Ogasawara name, and his descendants built up holdings across most of Shinano Province. The clan served as shugo governors of Shinano through the Kamakura and Muromachi periods.

Ogasawara Sadamune joined Nitta Yoshisada in overthrowing the Hōjō at Kamakura in the fourteenth century and later became a general under Ashikaga Takauji. The family founded the Ogasawara-ryū, whose schools of archery, horsemanship and ceremony helped codify warrior etiquette.

After the Sengoku upheavals Ogasawara Hidemasa entered Tokugawa Ieyasu's service in 1590 and recovered the clan seat at Fukashi Castle, later called Matsumoto. Under the Tokugawa the Ogasawara ranked as fudai daimyō, with the senior branch ruling Kokura Domain in Buzen from 1632.
zh:
小笠原氏属清和源氏，谱系上溯至武田义清；义清的曾孙长清第一个以小笠原为苗字，其后代经营的领地逐渐覆盖信浓国大部。镰仓和室町时代，小笠原家担任信浓国守护。

14世纪，小笠原贞宗随新田义贞攻克镰仓、推翻北条氏，后来又成为足利尊氏麾下的将领。家族开创的小笠原流以弓术、马术与礼仪之学推动武家礼法的体系化。

战国动乱后，小笠原秀政于1590年出仕德川家康，并收复家族据点深志城，即后来的松本城。德川时代小笠原氏位列谱代大名，宗家自1632年起领有丰前国小仓藩。

en:
The Oguni were an Echigo warrior house of Settsu Genji stock, tracing their line to Minamoto no Yoriyuki. His grandson Yoritsura became steward of the Oguni estate in Kariwa district and took its name; he marched with Hōjō Tomotoki in the Jōkyū War of 1221.

During the Nanboku-chō wars Oguni Masamitsu held Tenjinyama Castle for the Southern Court, built Kanbaratsu Castle in 1335 and the next year defended Shimazaki Castle against Ashikaga generals until it fell. The house served Uesugi Kenshin, but the Otate War of 1578 split it between the Kagekatsu and Kagetora factions.

Victory left Uesugi Kagekatsu master of the clan: he imposed Naoe Kanetsugu's brother Higuchi Yoshichi as its adopted head, who took the surname Ōkuni. Under that name the house survived as senior retainers of the Yonezawa domain.
zh:
小国氏是越后国的武家，出自摄津源氏，始祖为源赖行。赖行之孙赖连出任刈羽郡小国村地头，遂以小国为姓；1221年承久之乱时，他参加了北条朝时的讨伐军。

南北朝动乱中，小国政光据天神山城为南朝效力，1335年修筑蒲原津城，次年又固守岛崎城，抵御足利方将领，直到城池陷落。小国氏侍奉上杉谦信，但1578年的御馆之乱使家族分裂为景胜派与景虎派。

取胜的上杉景胜成为家族的主宰，强令直江兼续之弟樋口与七入继，改姓大国。大国家此后作为米泽藩的重臣延续下来。

en:
The Ohmućević were a Serbian noble family of the fourteenth century, whose most famous member was the feudal lord Hrelja. First recorded in the 1320s as a Serbian commander in a Byzantine civil war, Hrelja built a domain around Štip and Strumica in Macedonia while serving Serbian kings, including Stephen Dušan. In 1334 and 1335 he rebuilt the church of the Rila Monastery and erected the stone Hrelja's Tower.

By the late 1330s he ruled from Strumica as a semi-independent autocrat, formally acknowledging Byzantine suzerainty; he later backed John VI Kantakouzenos, who granted him Melnik and the title of protosebastos. Having again submitted to Dušan, Hrelja died at the Rila Monastery in 1342, shortly after taking monastic vows.

The family's later descendant Petar Ohmućević, who died in 1599, became an admiral in the Spanish navy and commissioned the Ohmućević Armorial to document his claimed Illyrian ancestry.
zh:
奥赫穆切维奇是14世纪的塞尔维亚贵族家族，最著名的成员是封建领主赫雷利亚。他最早在14世纪20年代作为拜占庭内战中的塞尔维亚军队指挥官见于记载；效力包括斯特凡·杜尚在内的塞尔维亚国王期间，他在马其顿的什蒂普和斯特鲁米察建立领地。1334—1335年，他重修里拉修道院教堂，并建起石造的赫雷利亚塔。

到14世纪30年代末，他以斯特鲁米察为首府，半独立地统治，名义上承认拜占庭宗主权；后来支持约翰六世·坎塔库泽努斯，获封梅尔尼克和首席至尊者头衔。他再度臣服杜尚后，于1342年在里拉修道院去世，死前刚出家。

后裔佩塔尔·奥赫穆切维奇死于1599年，曾任西班牙海军上将，并委托编纂《奥赫穆切维奇纹章集》，记述其自称的伊利里亚世系。

en:
The House of Oldenburg takes its name from Oldenburg Castle on the Hunte in Westphalia. Its first historical ancestor, Huno of Rustringen, founded Rastede monastery in 1059; Count Elimar I is documented from 1091. Vassals of the Saxon dukes, the counts became imperial princes when Emperor Frederick I dismembered Saxony in 1189.

In 1423 Theodoric of Oldenburg married Hedwig of Holstein, heiress of Scandinavian royal blood. Their son Christian was elected King of Denmark in 1448, Norway in 1450 and Sweden in 1457, ruling the Kalmar Union. He left the county to his brother Gerhard; the comital line ended in 1667, after which Denmark ruled Oldenburg.

The Holstein-Gottorp branch, founded in 1544, supplied Swedish kings from 1751 and the Russian tsar Peter III in 1762. Denmark ceded Oldenburg to it in 1773; Oldenburg became a duchy in 1774 and a grand duchy in 1815.
zh:
奥尔登堡家族得名于威斯特伐利亚洪特河畔的奥尔登堡城堡。可考的始祖鲁斯特林根的胡诺于1059年创办拉施泰德修道院，伯爵埃利马尔一世在1091年已见载。家族本是萨克森公爵的封臣，1189年皇帝腓特烈一世拆解萨克森公国时升为帝国诸侯。

1423年迪特里希娶具有斯堪的纳维亚王室血统的荷尔斯泰因的海德薇希为妻，其子克里斯蒂安于1448年当选丹麦国王，1450年获挪威王位，1457年又获瑞典王位，统治卡尔马联盟。他把伯国交给弟弟格哈德；伯爵嫡系于1667年断绝，此后丹麦统治奥尔登堡。

1544年分出的荷尔斯泰因—戈托尔普支自1751年起出任瑞典国王，其成员于1762年成为俄国沙皇彼得三世。丹麦于1773年把奥尔登堡交给该支，1774年升为公国，1815年升为大公国。

en:
The Oba were a Sagami warrior house of the Kanmu Heishi Kamakura line, kin of Kamakura Kagemasa. Kagemasa opened the Oba mikuriya, an Ise Shrine manor, formally established in 1116; his kin inherited its stewardship and took the name Oba.

The family served Minamoto no Yoriyoshi and Yoshiie, then followed Minamoto no Yoshitomo, fighting under him in 1156. In 1180 the brothers Oba Kagechika and Kageyoshi split: Kagechika pursued Minamoto no Yoritomo for the Taira and was executed, while Kageyoshi joined Yoritomo and his line survived as Kamakura gokenin.

The clan was weakened in the Wada conflict of 1213 and the Hoji conflict of 1247, and Oba power largely disappeared from the Kanto. A branch led by Oba Kagetsura was posted to Bingo in 1213 and survived until Sengoku times; other Oba served the Ouchi and Mori and continued as Choshu retainers.
zh:
大庭氏是相模国的武家，出自桓武平氏镰仓氏流，与镰仓景正同族。景正开发伊势神宫庄园大庭御厨，于1116年正式立庄；其族人继承庄园职务，遂以大庭为苗字。

大庭氏先侍奉源赖义、源义家，后来从属源义朝，1156年随他参战。1180年大庭景亲、景义兄弟分道扬镳：景亲为平氏追讨源赖朝，后来被处死；景义投奔赖朝，他的一脉以镰仓御家人的身份存续下来。

1213年的和田合战和1247年的宝治合战使大庭氏受创，其关东势力几乎消失。1213年，大庭景连一支被派往备后，延续至战国时代；另有族人出仕大内氏、毛利氏，后代作为长州藩士存续。

en:
The Ōgimachisanjō were a Kyoto court-noble house, a branch of the Sanjō family of the Northern Fujiwara Kan'in line. Its founder Kin'uji was a son of Sanjō Sanefusa; his mansion fronted Ōgimachi-Tōin street, giving the line its name.

The house rose under Kinhide, whose daughter Hideko entered Emperor Kōgon's harem and bore Emperors Sukō and Go-Kōgon. Kinhide and his next two heirs reached the Inner Minister's post, settling the family's minister-house standing. Kinhide and his father Sanemi kept diaries of the late Kamakura and Nanboku-chō decades.

The tenth head Sanemasa, whose sister married Shogun Ashikaga Yoshinori, was wounded resisting the assassins who killed him in the Kakitsu Incident of 1441. In the Edo period the house lived on 200 koku and produced no minister; its 23rd head Kinkazu was stripped of office and confined for life in the Hōreki Incident.
zh:
正亲町三条家是京都公家，为藤原北家闲院流三条家的庶流。始祖公氏是三条实房之子，因宅邸面临正亲町东洞院大路，家族遂称正亲町三条。

公秀时家门跃升：其女秀子入侍光严天皇，生下崇光、后光严两位天皇。公秀及其后两代都官至内大臣，大臣家的家格由此确立。公秀与其父实躬的日记记载了镰仓末至南北朝时代的事迹。

第十代实雅之妹嫁给将军足利义教，1441年嘉吉之乱时，实雅抵抗刺杀义教的凶手并受伤。江户时代该家领有200石，再未出过大臣；第二十三代公积在宝历事件中被罢官并判永久蛰居。

en:
The Ōgo were a warrior house of Kōzuke, seated at Ōgo Castle below Mount Akagi. They claimed descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato through the Fujiwara-surnamed Ashikaga clan, and began when Ashikaga Shigetoshi, a son of Ashikaga Nariyuki, styled himself Ōgo Tarō.

The Heiji Monogatari records the family fighting in the Heiji Disturbance; they joined Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1180, and Ōgo Sanehide served in Minamoto no Noriyori's Kyushu campaign of 1185. They became Kamakura gokenin, and the heads Takayoshi and his son Sanehide were devout Pure Land followers who put questions to Hōnen by letter.

In 1350 the clan was defeated at Kasagake-no fighting for Ashikaga Takauji. The clan had backed the Kamakura side in the Genkō War; its main line was dispossessed and died out during the Nanboku-chō wars. The name appeared in a 1561 roll of Uesugi Kenshin's followers; Ōgo Shigeyuki's descendants took the surname Ushigome and became Tokugawa hatamoto after 1590.
zh:
大胡氏是上野国赤城山南麓的武家，居城为大胡城。他们自称是藤原秀乡的后裔，属藤姓足利氏的旁支，始祖为足利成行的庶子重俊，由他首称大胡太郎。

《平治物语》记载大胡氏参加平治之乱；1180年他们投奔源赖朝，1185年大胡实秀随源范赖出征九州。家族后来成为镰仓御家人，当主隆义、实秀父子笃信净土宗，曾与法然书信问法。

1350年，大胡氏在笠悬野随足利尊氏一方作战，兵败。他们曾在元弘之乱中站在镰仓幕府一边，所领被没收，嫡流在南北朝战乱中灭亡。1561年上杉谦信麾下仍可见大胡氏之名；大胡重行的后人改姓牛込，1590年后成为德川旗本。

en:
The Ōhira were a warrior house of Tosa on Shikoku, based at Hasuike Castle. They claimed descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato through Kondo Kunihira, who was rewarded with the governorship of Sanuki for service in the Genpei War; Kunihira's son Kuninobu moved to Tosa, took the name Ōhira and held Hasuike as jitō.

In the Muromachi period the Ōhira governed Tosa as deputy governors for the Hosokawa and grew rich on trade between Usa and Sakai. In 1467 they hosted the regent Ichijō Norifusa when he fled to Tosa.

In 1508 they joined the Motoyama in overthrowing Chōsokabe Kanetsugu, but as the Hosokawa split, Ōhira influence waned. They lost Hasuike Castle to the Ichijō in 1546, and in 1566, caught between the Ichijō and the Motoyama, the last lord Kunioki killed himself at Tonami and the Tosa Ōhira came to an end.
zh:
大平氏是以四国土佐莲池城为据点的豪族，自称是藤原秀乡的后裔。其先祖近藤国平在源平合战中立功，被任为赞岐守护；国平之子国信移居土佐，改称大平氏，以地头身份领有莲池。

室町时代，大平氏代细川氏出任土佐守护代，凭借宇佐与堺之间的贸易致富。1467年，他们接待了下向土佐的关白一条教房。

1508年，大平氏联合本山氏攻杀长宗我部兼序，但随着细川氏分裂，大平氏的势力日渐衰弱。1546年莲池城被一条氏攻陷，1566年又遭一条氏与本山氏夹击，末代当主国兴在户波村自尽，土佐大平氏就此灭亡。

en:
The Ōida were an Echigo branch of the Satomi clan, a Nitta house of Minamoto descent. Satomi Yoshinari's descendants held the Ōida estate in Uonuma district and took its name.

As leaders of the Echigo Nitta league they answered Nitta Yoshisada's rising. Ōida Tsunetaka brought two thousand horsemen to the army that took Kamakura, while his son Ujitsune raised twenty thousand men to relieve Yoshisada after the defeat at Minatogawa, until news of Yoshisada's death in 1338 dissolved the force.

An Ashikaga army then stormed Ōida Castle, and the house sank to small local landholders. In the Sengoku age it served the Ueda Nagao and then Uesugi Kagekatsu, whose childhood guardian came from the family. In 1590 Kagekatsu ordered its head Kagekuni to disembowel himself. The main line ended, the name passing to a kinsman who served the Yonezawa domain.
zh:
大井田氏是里见氏在越后的分支，而里见氏出自源氏流的新田氏。里见义成的后裔领有鱼沼郡的大井田乡，家族由此得名。

越后新田党的首领大井田氏响应新田义贞举兵。大井田经隆率两千骑参加攻克镰仓的战役；其子氏经在凑川之战败后募兵两万准备救援义贞，直到1338年义贞战死的消息传来，军队才告瓦解。

此后足利大军猛攻大井田城，家族沦为小土豪。战国时代，大井田氏靠拢上田长尾氏，继而侍奉上杉景胜，景胜幼年的守役出自该族。1590年景胜命令当主景国切腹，嫡流就此断绝，家名由亲族继承，作为米泽藩士延续。

en:
The Ōkura of Bungo were a warrior house of Hita district on Kyushu who claimed descent from the immigrant Ōkura clan of the Yamatonoaya. Replacing the Kusakabe as district chiefs, they ruled the basin for some four hundred years from the late eleventh century and became gokenin after backing the Minamoto.

Their most famous son was Ōkura no Nagasue, born in 1056, a sumo champion who appeared ten times unbeaten in the court sumo festivals of Kyoto. He was enshrined at Hita Shrine as a god of wrestling.

In 1444 a succession feud ended in the lord Nagakane's murder by a retainer and the extinction of the original line. An adopted heir from the Ōtomo revived the house as the Ōtomo-Hita, but that line died out in 1548, after which eight elders of Ōkura stock governed Hita under the Ōtomo.
zh:
丰后大藏氏是九州丰后国日田郡的地方武家，自称出自渡来氏族东汉氏大藏氏。他们取代日下部氏出任郡司，从11世纪末起统治日田盆地约四百年，因支援源氏而成为御家人。

其家最有名的人物是生于1056年的大藏永季，他是相扑名手，曾十次参加京都的相扑节会且未尝败绩。他被日田神社奉为相扑之神。

1444年家督之争中，当主永包被家臣刺杀，旧族嫡流断绝。后来从大友氏迎来养子再兴，称大友日田氏，但这一脉也于1548年断嗣，此后由旧大藏氏一族的八名郡老在大友氏治下管理日田。

en:
The Ōsaki were daimyō of Mutsu's five Ōsaki districts, descended from the Shiba and Seiwa Genji. Their founder Shiba Iekane was sent north as Ōshū kanrei; from the fifth head Mitsuaki, the family took its name from its lands along the Eai and Naruse rivers.

In early Muromachi times they held authority over Mutsu and Dewa, but rival governors and Southern Court resistance confined their rule to the Ōsaki country. In 1400 the head Akimochi was killed after his plot against the Kamakura government was exposed.

In the Sengoku age Yoshinao put down a vassal revolt with Date Tanemune's aid and became a Date dependent. His son Yoshitaka defeated Date Masamune in 1588 but submitted after the Ashina fell in 1589. Yoshitaka's lands were confiscated in 1590, and a rising of old retainers could not restore the house.
zh:
大崎氏是统治陆奥大崎五郡的大名，出身斯波氏，属清和源氏。始祖斯波家兼被任为奥州管领，奉命前往东北；到第五代满诠时，家族因江合川、成濑川一带的领地而称大崎氏。

室町初期，大崎氏权威遍及陆奥、出羽，但管领之间的争斗和南朝抵抗使其实际统治只限于大崎地方。1400年当主诠持谋叛镰仓府的计划败露，被杀。

战国时代，大崎义直靠伊达稙宗平定家臣叛乱，反受伊达氏节制。其子义隆于1588年击败伊达政宗，但1589年芦名氏灭亡后向政宗称臣。1590年义隆的领地被没收，遗臣发动的一揆也未能使家族复兴。

en:
The Ōsato house took its name from Ōzato, a district and castle in southern Okinawa. Its best-remembered ruler appeared in Chinese records as Shōsatto, likely the same name as the place. Ryukyu tradition made the family descendants of a son of King Eiso of Chūzan, enfeoffed as aji of Shimasoe-Ōzato.

After 1314 Tamagusuku failed to hold his lords together, and the Lord of Ōzato withdrew south and founded Nanzan, the smallest of the Sanzan realms. Shōsatto sent his first tributary mission to the Ming court in 1380 and was invested as King of Nanzan with a gilded silver seal in 1385.

In 1392 the Sashiki aji Shō Hashi stormed Shimasoe-Ōzato and the court moved to Shimajiri-Ōzato. Four years later a coalition led by Shōsatto's uncle Ōeishi overthrew him; Nanzan passed to rival lines until Shō Hashi annexed it in 1429.
zh:
大里家得名于冲绳南部的大里地区及其城堡。其最可考的统治者在中国史籍中称承察度，这个名字很可能是地名大里的另一种读音。据琉球传说，该家是中山英祖王之子的后裔，受封为岛添大里按司。

1314年后宗主玉城无法约束各地按司，大里领主南走，建立了三山之中最小的南山王国。承察度于1380年首次向明朝派出朝贡使团，1385年受封南山王并获赐镀金银印。

1392年佐敷按司尚巴志攻占岛添大里城，朝廷迁往岛尻大里城。四年后，承察度的叔父汪英紫联合各方将他推翻，南山王位此后转入别系，直到1429年尚巴志吞并南山。

en:
The Ōtomo were a samurai house that arose in Ōtomo village of Sagami Province, taking their name from that territory. They claimed Seiwa Genji descent, though a Fujiwara origin is likelier. Founder Yoshinao became shugo of Bungo and Buzen, and his descendants helped defend Kyūshū against the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281.

In 1333 the sixth head Sadamune joined the Shōni in destroying the Chinzei tandai at Dazaifu. The Ōtomo fought for Ashikaga Takauji and became shugo daimyō. In the Sengoku period the head Ōtomo Sōrin protected Jesuits, was baptized, and made Funai a center of Nanban culture with Japan's first Western-style hospital.

Defeats at Imayama in 1570 and Mimigawa in 1578 broke the clan's vassal network, and Shimazu armies burned Funai in 1586. Sōrin sought Toyotomi Hideyoshi's aid; his heir Yoshimune was dispossessed in 1593. His attempted restoration ended in defeat in 1600, though descendants survived as hatamoto.
zh:
大友氏是兴起于相模国大友乡的武士家族，家名来自这块领地。其家谱自称出自清和源氏，但更可能源于藤原氏。始祖能直被任为丰后、丰前守护，子孙参与组织了1274年和1281年九州抵御元寇的战事。

1333年第六代当主贞宗与少贰氏联手攻灭大宰府的镇西探题。大友氏此后为足利尊氏作战，成为有力的守护大名。战国时代，当主大友宗麟庇护耶稣会传教士并自身受洗，使府内成为南蛮文化中心，还建起日本第一所西式医院。

1570年今山之战和1578年耳川之战失利后，家臣网络瓦解，1586年岛津军焚毁府内。宗麟向丰臣秀吉求援；其继承人义统于1593年被没收领地，1600年恢复旧领的尝试也以失败告终，后裔则以旗本身份存续。

en:
The Ōuchi were a warrior house of western Japan, ruling from Yamaguchi in Suō Province from the fourteenth to the sixteenth century. Their genealogies claimed descent from Prince Imseong of Paekche, said to have settled in Japan in the seventh century. They rose as shogunate vassals and backed Ashikaga Takauji in the Nanboku-chō wars, holding six provinces at their height.

Their power rested on overseas commerce with Joseon Korea and Ming China. They ran trading missions in 1540 and 1549 and briefly hosted the Jesuit Francis Xavier in 1551. Yamaguchi became a cultural capital; Ōuchi Masahiro invited the painter Sesshū Tōyō in 1486.

The Ōuchi fought the Hosokawa at Ningbo in 1523. In 1551 the vassal Sue Harukata forced Ōuchi Yoshitaka to kill himself and installed a puppet; Mōri Motonari defeated Sue in 1555, and the last Ōuchi lord committed suicide in 1557.
zh:
大内氏是日本西部的武家，14至16世纪以周防国山口为据点。其家谱自称是7世纪移居日本的百济王族琳圣太子的后裔。家族作为幕府家臣崛起，南北朝时支持足利尊氏，最盛时领有六国。

其权力建立在与朝鲜王朝、明朝的海外贸易之上。他们经营1540年和1549年的遣明船，1551年短暂接待耶稣会士方济各·沙勿略。富庶的山口成为文化之都，大内政弘于1486年邀请画僧雪舟等杨前来。

1523年大内家与细川氏在宁波发生冲突。1551年家臣陶晴贤迫使大内义隆自尽，另立傀儡；1555年毛利元就击败陶晴贤，末代大内家督于1557年自杀。

en:
The Orbelian were Armenian nobles whose princes ruled Syunik from the late twelfth century. At the Georgian court they held the hereditary office of commander-in-chief and took their name from Orbeti fortress. After Ivane Orbeli backed a failed rebellion in 1177, he was killed and the survivors driven into Armenia.

Queen Tamar pardoned them; Liparit III became viceroy of Syunik, Vayots Dzor and Gegharkunik. In 1236 the princes submitted to the Mongols, keeping their lands by joining their campaigns. In 1337 Syunik was held by Burtel Orbelian, ancestor of the Burtelian branch.

The Turkmen and Timurid invasion of 1385 broke the house: Prince Smbat was besieged in Vorotnaberd and carried to Samarkand, where he was forced to convert to Islam. After Sofyan's defeat in 1437, his descendant Rustam sold the Syunik estates to Tatev monastery and withdrew to Lori.
zh:
俄耳柏洛斯是亚美尼亚贵族世家，自12世纪末起其王公统治休尼克。家族在格鲁吉亚宫廷发迹，世袭全军统帅之职，族名得自奥尔贝蒂城堡。1177年伊万涅·奥尔贝利参与叛乱，失败后被杀，幸存族人被逐入亚美尼亚。

塔玛尔女王赦免了他们，利帕里特三世被任命为休尼克、瓦约茨佐尔和格加尔库尼克的总督。1236年诸王公向蒙古人臣服，以随军出征保住领地。1337年休尼克由布尔特尔·俄耳柏洛斯掌握，他是布尔特尔旁支的始祖。

1385年土库曼人与帖木儿的入侵使家族败亡：王公斯姆巴特被围于沃罗特纳贝尔德，掳往撒马尔罕并被迫改宗伊斯兰教。1437年索菲扬战败后，其后裔鲁斯塔姆把休尼克的领地卖给塔捷夫修道院，退居洛里。

en:
The Ordelaffi, possibly originating near Treviso and first documented in 1170, became the leading Ghibelline family of Romagna and lords of Forli. Scarpetta Ordelaffi founded the family signoria: in 1302 he warred on Florence with the White Guelph exiles led by Dante Alighieri, and in 1303 he drove the Calboli out of Forli before seizing Bertinoro.

During Cardinal Albornoz's papal reconquest, Francesco II lost Faenza, Cesena and Bertinoro in 1357 and was expelled from Forli. Sinibaldo I recovered the city in 1376 but was poisoned by his nephew Pino I.

After Teobaldo II died in 1425 Forli reverted to the Church. Antonio Ordelaffi restored the signoria in 1433, but Pope Sixtus IV later granted the city to Girolamo Riario. Antonio Maria Ordelaffi briefly recovered Forli in 1503 after the Borgia fell, but died without male heirs in 1504, ending the line.
zh:
奥尔德拉菲家族可能起源于特雷维索一带，最早见于1170年的文书，后来成为罗马涅的吉伯林派首领和弗利领主。斯卡尔佩塔·奥尔德拉菲开创家族的领主政权：1302年他与但丁·阿利吉耶里率领的流亡白党圭尔夫派进攻佛罗伦萨，1303年把卡尔博利家族逐出弗利，随后夺取贝尔蒂诺罗。

枢机主教阿尔沃诺斯代表教宗收复罗马涅时，弗朗切斯科二世于1357年失去法恩扎、切塞纳和贝尔蒂诺罗，并被逐出弗利。西尼巴尔多一世于1376年收复该城，却被外甥皮诺一世毒杀。

1425年泰奥巴尔多二世去世后弗利重归教会。安东尼奥·奥尔德拉菲于1433年恢复领主统治，教宗西克斯图斯四世后来把城市封给吉罗拉莫·里亚里奥。1503年博尔贾家族倒台后，安东尼奥·马里亚·奥尔德拉菲一度收复弗利，但他于1504年去世且无男嗣，家族绝嗣。

en:
The Orsini of Pitigliano were the Tuscan branch of the Roman Orsini family, tracing descent from Gentile Orsini, a son of Matteo Rosso the Great. In 1293 Romano Orsini married Anastasia de Montfort, heiress of the Aldobrandeschi counts of Sovana, and acquired the signoria of Pitigliano.

Guido Orsini, the first count to style himself from the town, died after 1348; his heirs fought roughly 150 years of intermittent wars with Siena, accepting its suzerainty in 1455. The branch's most famous son was Niccolò di Pitigliano, a condottiero who became captain-general of the Venetian army and commanded it at the defeat of Agnadello in 1509 during the War of the League of Cambrai.

In the following century the county slipped into the orbit of the Grand Duchy of Tuscany. In 1604 Giannantonio Orsini sold Pitigliano to Grand Duke Ferdinando I de' Medici; the line became extinct in 1640.
zh:
皮蒂利亚诺的奥尔西尼家族是罗马奥尔西尼家族在托斯卡纳的支系，先祖是“伟人”马泰奥·罗索·奥尔西尼之子真蒂莱。1293年，罗马诺·奥尔西尼娶了索瓦纳伯爵阿尔多布兰德斯基家族的女继承人阿纳斯塔西娅·德·蒙特福特，取得皮蒂利亚诺的领主权。

首位以该城为号的伯爵圭多·奥尔西尼于1348年之后去世，其继承人与锡耶纳断续交战约一百五十年，1455年接受其宗主权。最有名的成员尼科洛·迪·皮蒂利亚诺是雇佣兵首领，出任威尼斯军队统帅，在1509年康布雷同盟战争中的阿尼亚代洛战败时指挥威尼斯军。

此后伯国逐渐被托斯卡纳大公国纳入势力范围。1604年詹南托尼奥·奥尔西尼把皮蒂利亚诺卖给大公斐迪南一世·德·美第奇，该支系于1640年绝嗣。

en:
The Orsini were a great princely house of medieval and Renaissance Rome, claiming descent from Ursus, count of Tivoli in the ninth century. They rose through the Church: Giacinto Bobone Orsini became Pope Celestine III in 1191 and enriched nephews with fiefs, while Matteo Rosso Orsini the Great, as Senator of Rome, defeated imperial troops in 1241 and made himself Rome's effective lord, expelling the Colonna. His many sons founded its several branches.

Pope Nicholas III reigned from 1277 and carried nepotism to new heights; in all the Orsini produced five popes and thirty-four cardinals. Guelph leaders, they feuded for centuries with the Ghibelline Colonna, until a 1511 papal bull ended the violence and marriage reconciled them in 1571.

Clarice Orsini married Lorenzo de' Medici in 1469, linking the family to Florence. The Bracciano line won the ducal title in 1560 under Paolo Giordano I Orsini, a Lepanto veteran of 1571; the family's last pope, Benedict XIII, reigned in 1724—1730.
zh:
奥尔西尼家族是中世纪和文艺复兴时期罗马的显赫王公世家，自称源于9世纪的蒂沃利伯爵乌尔苏斯。家族借教会发迹：贾钦托·博博内·奥尔西尼1191年当选教宗切莱斯廷三世，把封地赐给侄儿；“大帝”马泰奥·罗索·奥尔西尼以罗马元老身份1241年击败帝国军队，成为罗马实际主人，逐走宿敌科隆纳家族。他的众多儿子开创了家族的数个支系。

家族另一位教宗尼古拉三世1277年登位，把任用亲族推向新的高峰；奥尔西尼前后共出五位教宗和三十四位枢机主教。作为圭尔夫派贵族首领，他们与吉伯林派的科隆纳家族争斗数百年，直到1511年教宗下诏制止暴力，两家于1571年联姻和解。

家族联姻延伸到佛罗伦萨：克拉丽切·奥尔西尼1469年嫁给洛伦佐·德·美第奇。布拉恰诺支系在保罗·焦尔达诺一世时于1560年取得公爵头衔，他还参加1571年勒班陀海战；家族最后一位教宗本笃十三世于1724—1730年在位。

en:
The Orsini of Monterotondo were a Roman baronial branch of the Orsini family, founded by Rinaldo, a son of Matteo Rosso the Great, after the family bought Monterotondo from the Capocci in the twelfth century. On the Via Salaria north of Rome, the town was a strategic stronghold in the city's defense.

Rinaldo's son Napoleone became a cardinal in 1288 and remained a leading figure of the Curia until his death at Avignon in 1342. Orso Orsini was killed fighting for the king of Naples at the Battle of Zagonara in 1424; his son Giacomo served the Papal States, Naples and Florence in turn.

Giacomo's daughter Clarice married Lorenzo de' Medici of Florence in 1469. Cardinal Giovanni Battista Orsini was strangled in 1503 after the failed plot against Cesare Borgia. The branch declined from the late sixteenth century and its last heirs sold Monterotondo to the Barberini in 1641.
zh:
蒙特罗通多的奥尔西尼家族是罗马奥尔西尼家族的贵族支系，由伟人马泰奥·罗索之子里纳尔多开创。家族于12世纪从卡波奇家族手中买下蒙特罗通多要塞；该城扼守罗马以北的萨拉里亚大道，是拱卫罗马的战略要地。

里纳尔多之子纳波莱奥内于1288年受任枢机，长期是罗马教廷的核心人物，1342年死于阿维尼翁。奥尔索·奥尔西尼于1424年在扎戈纳拉战役中为那不勒斯国王作战身亡，其子贾科莫先后为教皇国、那不勒斯和佛罗伦萨效力。

贾科莫之女克拉丽切于1469年嫁给佛罗伦萨的洛伦佐·德·美第奇。枢机乔瓦尼·巴蒂斯塔·奥尔西尼在反对切萨雷·博尔贾的密谋败露后，于1503年被缢死。该支系自16世纪末走向衰落，最后的继承人于1641年把蒙特罗通多卖给巴尔贝里尼家族。

en:
The House of Osman ruled the Ottoman state for over six centuries and claimed descent from the Kayı branch of the Oghuz Turks. Ertuğrul, its earliest historically known figure, settled at Söğüt on the Byzantine frontier; his son Osman I, whose name gave rise to Ottoman, founded the beylik around 1299. Osman and Orhan took Bursa in 1326 and crossed into the Balkans, and Murad I's Kosovo victory in 1389 made the Ottomans a Balkan power.

Timur ended Bayezid I's run of victories and captured him at Ankara in 1402; Mehmed I closed the Interregnum. Mehmed II took Constantinople in 1453; Selim I's Mamluk conquests of 1516—1517 added Egypt, Mecca, Medina and the caliph title. Under Suleiman the Magnificent, victor of Mohács and besieger of Vienna, the empire ranked among the strongest powers, with a mature law code.

The failed 1683 Vienna siege and 1699 Treaty of Karlowitz opened a long retreat before Austria and Russia. Mahmud II broke the Janissary corps in 1826 and was pressing centralizing reforms in 1837.
zh:
奥斯曼家族统治奥斯曼国家六百余年，自称出自乌古斯突厥的卡耶部。家族最早可考的人物埃尔图鲁尔率部落落脚于拜占庭边境的瑟于特，其子奥斯曼一世（奥斯曼一名即由他而来）约于1299年创立贝伊国。奥斯曼与奥尔汗父子于1326年攻克布尔萨，渡海进入巴尔干；1389年穆拉德一世科索沃告捷，使奥斯曼成为巴尔干强权。

巴耶济德一世的连胜势头在1402年被帖木儿终结，他兵败安卡拉被俘，随后的空位期由穆罕默德一世敉平。穆罕默德二世于1453年攻陷君士坦丁堡，塞利姆一世于1516—1517年征服马穆鲁克苏丹国，取得埃及、麦加和麦地那，苏丹兼称哈里发。苏莱曼大帝先胜莫哈奇、再围维也纳，治下帝国跻身世界最强之列，法典成熟。

1683年维也纳之围失败和1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》开启了对奥地利和俄罗斯的漫长退却期。马哈茂德二世于1826年铲除耶尼切里军团，至1837年仍在推行中央集权改革。

en:
The Oyama were a provincial gōzoku house of Shimotsuke, claiming descent from the tenth-century warrior Fujiwara no Hidesato through the Ōta family. Around 1150 Oyama Masamitsu settled at Oyama Manor and took its name; his wife was the wet nurse of Minamoto no Yoritomo. His son Tomomasa fought in the Ōshū campaign of 1189 and became shugo governor of Shimotsuke and Harima.

Ranked among the great Kantō houses, the Oyama suffered disasters. In the Genkō War of 1333 Sadatomo was killed, and his successor Hidetomo switched to Nitta Yoshisada's army in the attack on Kamakura. A later rising by Oyama Yoshimasa was crushed by Ashikaga Ujimitsu, and the name continued through an adopted heir from the Yūki.

During the Sengoku wars the Later Hōjō overran Gion Castle in 1576, ending the Oyama as territorial lords. Their descendants later served the Mito Tokugawa as retainers.
zh:
小山氏是下野国的地方豪族，自称经太田氏出自10世纪武将藤原秀乡。约1150年，小山政光移居小山庄并以此为苗字；他的妻子是源赖朝的乳母。政光之子朝政参加了1189年的奥州合战，后来出任下野、播磨两国守护。
