小山氏位列关东大族，却屡遭劫难。1333年元弘之乱中贞朝战死，继任的秀朝倒戈加入新田义贞的镰仓攻略军。后来小山义政的叛乱被足利氏满镇压，家门靠结城家的养子继承。

战国乱世中，后北条氏于1576年攻陷祇园城，小山氏作为领主的历史就此终结。其后人成为水户德川家的家臣。

en:
The Pagan dynasty ruled from the city of Pagan on the middle Irrawaddy, a ninth-century settlement of Burmese ancestors fortified by King Pyinbya in 849. Anawrahta conquered the Mon kingdom of Thaton in 1057, unified the Irrawaddy valley, made Theravada Buddhism the royal faith and gave Burmese its own script.

Kyansittha built the Ananda Temple, and under Narapatisithu the empire reached its zenith: over ten thousand Buddhist temples rose around Pagan, and Burmese displaced Pyu and Mon as the court's written language. Endless donations of tax-free land to the sangha drained the crown.

Under Narathihapate, Mongol invasions from 1277 broke the empire; he fled and was murdered at Prome in 1287. Kyawswa, enthroned in 1289, fell to the Myinsaing brothers in 1297; later rulers held only Pagan's district as puppets of Pinya and then Ava. The last ruler, Uzana II, died around 1369; Pagan princesses married into neighbouring courts, and his nephew Swa Saw Ke of Ava carried the line's blood into the Ava royal house.
zh:
蒲甘王朝以伊洛瓦底江中游的蒲甘城为都，源于9世纪缅人先民的聚落，国王频耶于849年修筑蒲甘城。王朝崛起于阿奴律陀：他于1057年攻灭孟人直通王国，统一伊洛瓦底江流域，把上座部佛教立为王家信仰，并创制缅文。

江喜陀修建阿难陀寺，那罗波帝悉都时期国力达于极盛，蒲甘建起上万座佛寺，缅文取代骠文、孟文成为宫廷书面语。然而，向僧团大量捐献免税土地，逐渐掏空王权。

那罗梯诃波帝时，元朝自1277年入侵，帝国瓦解，国王出逃，1287年在卑谬被杀。1289年即位的憍苴1297年被敏象三兄弟废黜，此后王统仅保有蒲甘周边，先后附庸于彬牙和阿瓦。末代王吾者那约1369年去世，蒲甘公主多嫁入邻邦，其外甥、阿瓦国王斯伐修寄把蒲甘血脉带入阿瓦王室。

en:
The Palaiologos were the last and longest-ruling dynasty of the Byzantine Empire. It traces to Nikephoros Palaiologos, an Anatolian commander of the later eleventh century; its members intermarried with the Komnenoi and fled to the Empire of Nicaea after the Fourth Crusade took Constantinople in 1204.

Michael VIII seized power in 1259 and retook Constantinople from the Latin Empire in 1261, founding the dynasty's imperial line. Civil wars, the Black Death and the Ottoman advance shrank the empire, which by 1380 amounted to little more than Constantinople and a few exclaves. A cadet branch inherited the Italian March of Montferrat in 1305 and ruled there until 1533.

Despite the decline, the age saw the Palaiologian Renaissance in art and letters, as migrating Byzantine scholars helped fuel the Italian Renaissance. By the early fifteenth century the emperors were effectively Ottoman clients. The last, Constantine XI, died defending Constantinople against Mehmed the Conqueror in 1453, and the Morea principality fell to the Ottomans in 1460.
zh:
巴列奥略王朝是拜占庭帝国最后一个、也是统治时间最长的王朝。家族最早可追溯到11世纪后期在安纳托利亚任统兵官的尼基弗鲁斯·巴列奥略，其成员与科穆宁家族通婚，1204年第四次十字军攻占君士坦丁堡后逃往尼西亚帝国。

米哈伊尔八世1259年夺取政权，1261年从拉丁帝国手中收复君士坦丁堡，开创皇统。连绵内战、黑死病和奥斯曼人的推进使帝国不断萎缩，到1380年只剩君士坦丁堡和几处飞地。家族的一支旁系于1305年继承意大利的蒙费拉托藩侯国，统治到1533年。

国运衰微之际，艺术与文学上仍出现巴列奥略文艺复兴，西迁的拜占庭学者推动了意大利文艺复兴。15世纪初，皇帝实际上已是奥斯曼人的附庸。末代皇帝君士坦丁十一世1453年抵御征服者穆罕默德二世、战死君士坦丁堡城下，摩里亚领地也于1460年落入奥斯曼之手。

en:
The Pallavicini, first called Pelavicino, are an Italian noble house descended from the Frankish Obertenghi; founder Oberto il Pelavicino lived from about 1080 to 1148. His sons founded the Lombard and Genoese branches, and the house became a great Po valley feudatory.

Oberto Pallavicino, born in 1197, served Emperor Frederick II as a Ghibelline captain, subduing Parma, Piacenza and other Po valley cities after 1250, then turned Guelph and helped defeat Ezzelino at Cassano. Another branch joined the Fourth Crusade: in 1204 Guy Pallavicini received the Marquisate of Bodonitsa in Greece, charged with guarding Thermopylae. His heirs held it until the margravine Guglielma died in 1358, when it passed to her Zorzi sons; the Turks took it in 1414.

In the fifteenth century Rolando Pallavicino, called the Magnificent, built the Stato Pallavicino around Busseto in western Emilia, which his descendants ruled for centuries. Later kinsmen served as Genoese doges, Church cardinals and Venetian generals, and one branch entered Habsburg service and settled in Hungary.
zh:
帕拉维奇尼家族旧称佩拉维奇诺，是源出法兰克奥贝滕吉家族的古老意大利贵族，始祖奥贝托·伊尔·佩拉维奇诺约生活于1080至1148年间。他的儿子们开创伦巴第支和热那亚支，家族成为波河流域最大的封建诸侯之一。

1197年出生的奥贝托·帕拉维奇诺作为吉伯林派将领效力于皇帝腓特烈二世，1250年后相继降服帕尔马、皮亚琴察等波河城市，后来倒向归尔夫派，在卡萨诺协助击败埃泽利诺。另一支参加第四次十字军：1204年圭多·帕拉维奇尼受封希腊的博多尼察侯国，镇守温泉关；后裔统治该地，直到女侯爵古列尔玛1358年去世，政权转入她的佐尔齐儿子之手，1414年侯国被土耳其人攻灭。

15世纪，绰号伟人的罗兰多·帕拉维奇诺在艾米利亚西部以布塞托为中心建立帕拉维奇诺国，后代统治数百年。更晚的族人中出过热那亚总督、教会枢机和威尼斯将领，另有一支转入哈布斯堡王朝效力，定居匈牙利。

en:
The Pandyas were one of the three ancient crowned kingdoms of the Tamil country, ruling from Madurai from at least the third century BCE. After a long eclipse under the Kalabhras the dynasty revived in the sixth century under Kadungon.

Jatavarman Sundara Pandya I, crowned around 1251, carried Pandya arms to Nellore, Kerala and northern Sri Lanka. Maravarman Kulasekhara I defeated a Hoysala-Chola alliance in 1279 and seized the Buddha's Tooth Relic on Ceylon. After his death, his sons Sundara Pandya and Vira Pandya fought a civil war; Sundara called in the Delhi Khaljis, whose general Malik Kafur sacked the Tamil south in 1311.

In 1335 the governor of Ma'bar founded the independent Madurai Sultanate, seizing Madurai. The surviving Pandyas withdrew to Tenkasi, ruling at times as tributaries until the last known king perished around the middle of the seventeenth century.
zh:
潘地亚是泰米尔地区三大古老王权之一，至迟自公元前3世纪起便以马杜赖为都。在迦罗波罗人治下长期沉寂后，王朝于6世纪由卡东贡复兴。

约1251年即位的贾塔瓦尔曼·桑达拉·潘地亚一世挥师北抵内洛尔，攻入喀拉拉并征服斯里兰卡北部。马拉瓦尔曼·库拉塞卡拉一世于1279年击败曷萨拉与朱罗联军，又在锡兰夺走佛牙舍利。他死后，儿子桑达拉·潘地亚与维拉·潘地亚爆发内战，桑达拉向德里卡尔吉王朝求援，将领马利克·卡富尔遂于1311年洗劫泰米尔南部。

1335年马巴尔总督自立为马杜赖苏丹国，夺取马杜赖。残存的潘地亚王族南退滕卡西，时而向外称臣纳贡，已知的最后一位王约在17世纪中叶败亡。

en:
The Panwar, or Parmar, dynasty of Garhwal traced itself to Kanak Pal, a prince of Malwa, who in 823 married the daughter of Bhanu Pratap of Chandpur Garhi and inherited his Himalayan fortress. His descendants spent centuries subduing the fifty-two hill fortresses, the garhs, that gave Garhwal its name.

Around 1337 the family ruled only one chiefdom, but in 1358 Ajay Pal united the region. After Mahipat Shah's death in 1631 his widow Rani Karnavati ruled as regent and in 1640 repulsed a Mughal army under Najabat Khan, earning the nickname Nakti Rani for the noses she had cut off.

Gorkha armies from Nepal overran the kingdom in 1803. After the Anglo-Nepalese War the Treaty of Sugauli of 1816 split Garhwal, leaving the eastern half to the British while the heir Sudarshan Shah kept the west as Tehri Garhwal.
zh:
加瓦尔的般婆罗王朝（又译帕拉马尔）奉马尔瓦王子卡纳克·帕尔为始祖：他于823年娶金德布尔加希统治者巴努·普拉塔普之女，继承了其喜马拉雅堡垒。后裔耗时数世纪征服五十二座山间堡垒——“加尔”，加瓦尔之名即由此而来。

1337年前后该家族还只统治一个小酋长领地，1358年阿贾伊·帕尔统一整个地区。1631年马赫帕特·沙阿去世后，王后卡尔纳瓦蒂临朝称制，于1640年击退纳贾巴特汗率领的莫卧儿军队，因割下来犯者鼻子而得“割鼻王后”的绰号。

1803年尼泊尔的廓尔喀大军攻陷王国。英尼战争后，1816年的《苏高利条约》将加瓦尔一分为二，东半部归英国，继承人苏达尔尚·沙阿保留西部，建立台里·加瓦尔土邦。

en:
The Paramaras were a Rajput dynasty that ruled Malwa in central India from the tenth century, first as Rashtrakuta feudatories and then as sovereign kings. Around 972 Siyaka sacked the Rashtrakuta capital Manyakheta, and his successors ruled from Dhara. King Bhoja's empire stretched from Chittor to the Konkan and his court became a centre of Sanskrit learning, poetry and temple building.

Wars drained the kingdom, and later kings shifted their capital to Mandu. In 1305 the last Paramara king, Mahalakadeva, was killed by the army of Alauddin Khalji of Delhi, ending the Malwa line.

Paramara chiefships survived beyond the old kingdom. Chokrana of Junaraj, the old Rajpipla in eastern Gujarat, traced his descent from the Paramaras of Ujjain. He left no heir and his nephew Samarsinhji, renamed Arjunsinhji, of the Gohil clan, succeeded him; later Rajpipla rulers counted themselves Gohils.
zh:
波罗摩罗人是10世纪起统治中印度摩腊婆的拉杰普特王朝，起初是罗湿陀罗拘陀的附庸，后来称王自立。约972年西亚卡洗劫罗湿陀罗拘陀都城曼尼亚凯塔，其后继者以达尔为都。国王波贾的帝国北起吉多尔、南抵康坎，宫廷成为梵语学术、诗歌和神庙建筑的中心。

连年战争耗尽了国力，后期君主把都城迁到曼杜。1305年末代君主摩诃罗迦提婆被德里的阿劳丁·卡尔吉军队击杀，摩腊婆王统就此终结。

旧王国之外仍有波罗摩罗首领存续，东古吉特拉特拉杰皮普拉旧地朱纳杰的乔克拉纳自称出自乌贾因的波罗摩罗后裔。他没有继承人，外甥戈希尔族的萨马尔辛吉（改名阿周那辛吉）继立，后来的拉杰皮普拉统治者以戈希尔为族姓。

en:
The lords of Parsberg were a Bavarian noble family named after Burg Parsberg in the Upper Palatinate; the castle was first documented in 1205. The family first appears in a charter of 1224, when Hainricus de Bartisperc witnessed a deed at Regensburg.

After Bavaria's partition in 1255 the Parsbergs entered the inner circle of the dukes of Upper Bavaria, serving as ministeriales for two generations. Heinrich of Parsberg was imperial Schultheiss of Neumarkt in 1278 and the following years, while Konrad became cathedral dean of Regensburg and a councilor of Duke Rudolf I.

Friedrich of Parsberg was bishop of Regensburg from 1437 to 1449, and after 1443 Werner followed King Christopher of Bavaria to Denmark and founded a Danish branch. Haug served the emperor against the Turks at Vienna in 1529 and died in battle in 1554. The Bavarian male line died out in 1730.
zh:
帕尔斯贝格家族是巴伐利亚贵族，得名于上普法尔茨的帕尔斯贝格堡，堡垒1205年首见文书。家族最早见于1224年契约：海因里库斯·德·巴蒂斯佩克在雷根斯堡作证。

1255年巴伐利亚分家后，家族进入上巴伐利亚公爵的核心圈子，连续两代出任其家臣。海因里希·冯·帕尔斯贝格于1278年及此后数年担任帝国在诺伊马克特的地方长官；康拉德·冯·帕尔斯贝格官至雷根斯堡主教座堂主任司铎，担任公爵鲁道夫一世的顾问。

弗里德里希·冯·帕尔斯贝格于1437—1449年任雷根斯堡主教；1443年后，维尔纳随巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗国王前往丹麦，开创丹麦支系。豪格1529年在维也纳为皇帝抗击土耳其人，于1554年战死。巴伐利亚男系于1730年绝嗣。

en:
The Pasai sultans ruled Samudera Pasai, a Muslim harbour kingdom on Sumatra's northern coast and one of the archipelago's earliest Islamic states. According to the Hikayat Raja-raja Pasai, Merah Silu founded it in 1267 and took the name Malik ul Salih on converting; his Arabic-inscribed tomb, dated 1297, is among Indonesia's oldest Muslim monuments.

After Srivijaya's decline, Pasai grew rich on its hinterland's gold, forest produce and later pepper, becoming an emporium where Arab, Indian and Malay merchants met. Ibn Battuta stayed there in 1345 as the guest of Sultan al-Malik al-Zahir, noting it as the easternmost land of Islam.

Majapahit troops sacked the town in the fourteenth century, and from the 1400s trade drifted to Malacca. The Portuguese seized Pasai in 1521 but abandoned it in 1524, when Ali Mughayat Syah, the first sultan of Aceh, annexed the territory.
zh:
八昔王朝统治苏门答腊北岸的穆斯林港口王国苏木都剌-八昔，是群岛上最早的伊斯兰政权之一。据《八昔列王纪》，梅拉·西卢于1267年建国，改宗后取名马利克·萨利赫；其1297年的阿拉伯文墓碑是印度尼西亚最早的穆斯林遗迹之一。

室利佛逝衰落之后，八昔凭借腹地的黄金、林产和后来的胡椒致富，成为阿拉伯、印度与马来商人汇聚的商港。1345年伊本·白图泰作为苏丹马利克·查希尔的客人在此停留，称这里是伊斯兰世界最东的疆土。

14世纪满者伯夷军队洗劫该城，15世纪后商路逐渐转向马六甲。葡萄牙人于1521年攻占八昔，1524年撤守，亚齐初代苏丹阿里·穆加亚特·沙随即吞并其地。

en:
The Pepoli were a Guelph banking aristocracy of Bologna, recorded from the late eleventh century. Their bank made them one of Italy's richest families, and the money changers' coin-counting chessboard became their coat of arms. As Guelph leaders they helped drive the Ghibellines from Bologna in 1274, and Romeo Pepoli ruled the city for a time before dying in exile in 1321.

His son Taddeo, a doctor of law, returned and in August 1337 seized Bologna with armed men and was elected its lord; Pope Benedict XII named him papal vicar for three years. Taddeo ruled until 1347, built the Palazzo Pepoli Vecchio and married his kin into the Este of Ferrara and other houses.

After Taddeo's death Bologna slipped to the Visconti of Milan; Cardinal Gil de Albornoz restored it to the Papal States in 1360, but the Pepoli never regained power. They remained great landowners, built the Palazzo Pepoli Campogrande in 1653 and settled a feudal branch at Trapani; Castiglione dei Pepoli still bears their name.
zh:
佩波利家族是博洛尼亚的归尔夫派银行贵族，自11世纪后期起便有在该城活动的记载。其钱庄使家族跻身意大利最富有的家族之列，钱币兑换商清点硬币的棋盘也成了家族纹章。作为归尔夫派领袖，他们1274年协助把吉伯林派逐出博洛尼亚，罗密欧·佩波利曾一度统治该城，后遭驱逐，1321年死于流亡。

他的儿子、法学博士塔代奥强势归来：1337年8月率兵接管博洛尼亚并被推举为领主，教皇本笃十二世任命他为任期三年的教皇代理人。塔代奥执政至1347年，修建家族府邸老佩波利宫，并将族中女儿嫁给费拉拉埃斯特家族等。

他死后博洛尼亚落入米兰的维斯孔蒂家族之手，尽管枢机吉尔·德·阿尔沃诺斯1360年使该城重归教皇国，佩波利家族却再未恢复城邦权力。此后他们仍是大地主，1653年兴建佩波利坎波格兰德宫，还有一支在特拉帕尼获封封建领地；佩波利堡镇名即得自该家族。

en:
The Peralta were a Catalan-Aragonese noble house transplanted to Sicily after the Vespers, taking their name from the baroness Aldonza Fernandez de Peralta, whose son Raimondo kept her surname. Raimondo fought in the Aragonese conquest of Sardinia at the siege of Castel di Castro in 1323 and served as captain-general of the island before fighting the Angevins in 1326.

Grand admiral of Aragon from 1335, he guarded Sardinia against Genoa and foiled an Angevin landing at Palermo. In 1338 King Peter II invested him with fiefs in western Sicily; in 1347 he invaded Naples and negotiated peace with Queen Joanna I.

He died at Palermo in 1349. His son Guglielmo became one of the vicars governing the kingdom during Queen Maria's regency and kept the family's privileges when Martin of Aragon landed in 1392.
zh:
佩拉尔塔家族是西西里晚祷之后迁居西西里的加泰罗尼亚-阿拉贡贵族世家，族名取自女男爵阿尔东萨·费尔南德斯·德·佩拉尔塔，她的儿子拉伊蒙多沿用了母姓。拉伊蒙多参加阿拉贡征服撒丁的战争，于1323年围攻卡斯特尔迪卡斯特罗，并出任该岛总兵；1326年他对抗安茹人。

1335年他成为阿拉贡的海军大帅，防卫撒丁、抵御热那亚，还挫败了安茹军队在巴勒莫的登陆。1338年，国王彼得二世把西西里西部封地封给他；1347年他攻入那不勒斯，与女王乔万娜一世谈判媾和。

他于1349年死于巴勒莫。其子古列尔莫在女王玛丽亚摄政期间成为主持国政的摄政官之一，并在1392年阿拉贡的马丁登陆时保住了家族特权。

en:
The House of Percy was the most powerful noble family of medieval northern England. Its ancestor William de Percy crossed to England soon after 1066. When the male line failed in the twelfth century, the heiress Agnes de Percy married Joscelin of Louvain, who kept the Percy surname.

In 1309 Henry de Percy bought Alnwick Castle, which became the family seat. In 1377 another Henry Percy was created Earl of Northumberland; he and his son Harry Hotspur helped Henry IV seize the crown, then rebelled. Hotspur fell at Shrewsbury in 1403 and the earl was killed in 1408.

The Percys' feud with the Nevilles helped open the Wars of the Roses. The eleventh earl died without male heirs in 1670; through his heiress Elizabeth Seymour, Sir Hugh Smithson took the Percy name and became Duke of Northumberland in 1766.
zh:
珀西家族是中世纪英格兰北部最有权势的贵族世家。其先祖威廉·德·珀西于1066年后不久渡海来到英格兰。12世纪男系断绝后，女继承人阿格尼丝·德·珀西嫁给鲁汶的乔斯兰，后者沿用了珀西姓氏。

1309年，亨利·德·珀西买下阿尼克城堡，城堡成为家族驻地。1377年，另一位亨利·珀西受封诺森伯兰伯爵；他与儿子“热刺”哈里帮助亨利四世夺取王位，随后起兵反叛。热刺于1403年战死什鲁斯伯里，伯爵本人也在1408年被杀。

珀西家族与内维尔家族的世仇促成了玫瑰战争的爆发。第十一代伯爵于1670年无男嗣而终；通过女继承人伊丽莎白·西摩，休·史密森爵士改用珀西姓氏，并于1766年受封诺森伯兰公爵。

en:
The counts of Perigord, seated at Perigueux, traced their title to 845, when King Pepin I of Aquitaine made Emenon its count. The House of Charroux, later called Talleyrand, took the county in 975 under Boso the Elder, who also held neighbouring La Marche. Through the eleventh and twelfth centuries the house alternately held and divided Perigord and La Marche.

Helie de Talleyrand-Perigord, born at Perigueux in 1301, became a leading cardinal of the Avignon papacy, as Cardinal-Bishop of Albano and dean of the Sacred College, and negotiated between the French and English crowns in the early Hundred Years' War before his death in 1364.

Back in Perigord, Count Archambaud V was deposed in 1398 and his son Archambaud VI in 1399, and in 1400 the crown regranted it to Louis I of Orleans, ending over four centuries of the house's rule. The Talleyrand-Perigord branch kept the name, its head created Duke of Perigord in 1816.
zh:
佩里戈尔伯爵以佩里格为治所，头衔可追溯到845年：阿基坦国王丕平一世把这片地区封给权贵埃默农为伯国。本条目所指的沙鲁家族（后改称塔列朗）于975年由长者博松取得伯国，他还兼领邻近的拉马什伯国。11至12世纪，其后代时而兼领、时而分治佩里戈尔与拉马什。

14世纪，家族深度卷入阿维尼翁教廷。1301年生于佩里格的埃利·德·塔列朗-佩里戈尔成为教廷核心枢机，历任阿尔巴诺枢机主教和枢机团首席，在百年战争初期奔走于法兰西与英格兰两王室之间斡旋，1364年去世。

在佩里戈尔本土，阿尔尚博五世1398年被废，其子阿尔尚博六世1399年被废，1400年王室把伯国重新封给奥尔良的路易一世，家族四百多年的统治就此终结。塔列朗-佩里戈尔支系延续了名号，族长于1816年被封为佩里戈尔公爵。

en:
The Phayao dynasty ruled the Tai mueang of Phayao, also called Phukamyao, in the northern Thai highlands from around the eleventh century to 1338. Its founding king, Khun Chomtham, was a younger son of the ruler of Ngoenyang, placed on the vacant throne of the old Phukamyao polity.

Ngammueang, who reigned from 1258, conquered Pua, the capital of Nan, in 1263, and later swore a three-kings alliance on the Ing river with Mangrai of Ngoenyang and Ram Khamhaeng of Sukhothai. He attended the founding of Chiang Mai in 1296 and joined in crowning Mangrai king of Lanna.

Phayao lost Pua in 1320 when the old Nan ruling house was restored under Phaya Phanong. The last kings were Khamdaeng and his son Khamlue. In 1338 Khamfu of Chiang Saen and Phanong of Nan sacked Phayao's twin capitals and drove out Khamlue, after which Khamfu annexed Phayao to Lanna.
zh:
帕尧王朝（其国亦称普甘尧）约自11世纪起统治泰北高原的泰人城邦帕尧，直至1338年亡国。开国之君坤·宗坦是恩央统治者的幼子，被送往普甘尧旧地继承空悬的王位。

昂孟于1258年即位，1263年攻克难地的都城磨府，后来又在英河畔与恩央的芒莱、素可泰的兰甘亨结成三王同盟。1296年他出席清迈建城典礼，参与拥戴芒莱为兰纳之王。

1320年，难地旧王室在帕亚·帕农率领下复国，帕尧失去磨府。末代两王为坎登与其子坎吕。1338年，清盛的坎福联合难地的帕农洗劫帕尧的双城，赶走坎吕；坎福随即将帕尧并入兰纳。

en:
The Phra Ruang dynasty ruled Sukhothai, traditionally counted as the first Thai kingdom. In 1238 Bang Klang Hao revolted against the Khmer-backed rulers of Lavo and, taking the name Si Inthrathit, founded the kingdom and dynasty. Phra Ruang was a title borne by its kings.

Its greatest king was Ram Khamhaeng the Great, who reigned from 1279 to 1298: tradition credits him with establishing Theravada Buddhism and devising the Thai script, while ties with Yuan China brought the sangkhalok ceramic industry to Sukhothai. In 1337 the throne was held by Ngua Nam Thum, but Sukhothai had passed its peak.

In 1349, under Li Thai, Sukhothai was invaded by the rising Ayutthaya Kingdom and became its tributary. In 1438, after the death of Borommapan, Ayutthaya annexed it, though Sukhothai nobles kept influence at its court for centuries.
zh:
帕銮王朝统治着传统上被视为首个泰人王国的素可泰。1238年，邦坤邦揽豪起兵反抗高棉人控制的罗涡，登基后取王号室利·膺沙罗铁，开创王朝。“帕銮”是诸王共用的称号。

最伟大的君主是兰甘亨大帝（1279—1298年在位）：传统认为他确立了上座部佛教、创制泰文字母，而与元朝中国的往来也把宋加洛制瓷业引入素可泰。1337年在位的是威南吞，但此时素可泰已过鼎盛期。

1349年，立泰王在位时素可泰遭新兴的阿瑜陀耶入侵，沦为其属国。1438年波罗玛盘死后，阿瑜陀耶吞并了素可泰，不过素可泰贵族在其宫廷仍保持了数百年的影响力。

en:
Phraek Si Racha was a town on the Noi River, whose Mon name means the town at a confluence. Settled since Dvaravati times, it was recorded in Chinese annals as Duō Miè, which sent tribute in 661; many scholars identify it with Chên Li Fu, whose embassies reached Song China in 1200, 1202 and 1205.

Thai chronicles say its last independent ruler Anuraja lost the town to Tambralinga around 1167, while princes of his line fled north. One, Suryaraja, was the grandfather of Sukhothai's founder Si Inthrathit. The Ram Khamhaeng Inscription later lists Phraek Si Racha among Sukhothai's vassals, and by the fourteenth century it had passed into the orbit of Lavo and then Ayutthaya.

Ayutthaya's founder Ramathibodi I kept his brother as ruler, titled Phra Si Rachathirat. Tradition traces the king's maternal ancestry to the Phraek Si Racha ruling house.
zh:
普列·西·拉查是诺伊河畔的河口水镇，其孟语名称意为“汇流处之城”。当地在堕罗钵底时代已有聚落，中国史籍记载的多蔑国曾于661年遣使朝贡；不少学者认为它就是1200、1202、1205年遣使宋朝的真里富。

泰国编年史称，末代独立君主阿奴罗阇约在1167年失去城池，被单马令攻占，同族王子北逃。其中的苏利耶罗阇是素可泰开创者室利·膺沙罗铁的祖父。兰甘亨碑铭后来把普列·西·拉查列为素可泰属邦，14世纪它又转入罗涡及阿瑜陀耶的势力范围。

阿瑜陀耶开创者拉玛铁菩提一世让自己的兄弟以“西·拉查铁拉”之号镇守此地。传统认为国王的母系血统出自普列·西·拉查的古老王族。

en:
The Phukha dynasty founded the Tai state of Nan in the upper Nan River valley, taking its name from Phukha, who established it around the thirteenth century at Mueang Yang. According to the Nan Chronicle, his elder son Khun Nun went to rule around Luang Prabang, while his younger son Khun Fong founded Mueang Pua.

Phukha's grandson Kaokluean united the two seats, but in 1263 Ngammueang of Phayao seized Pua while it was held by the queen Khamphin. Her son Phanong grew up under Phayao overlordship and in 1313 restored an independent Nan as Phaya Phanong.

Phakong succeeded to the Nan throne in 1361 and in 1368 moved the capital from drought-stricken Pua to Wiang Nan. Nan kept its independence until Lan Na conquered it in 1449.
zh:
普卡王朝是难河上游泰人城邦难国的开国王室，得名于13世纪前后在孟扬建国的普卡。据《难城纪年》，他的长子坤·农前往琅勃拉邦一带统治，幼子坤·丰则建立磨府。

普卡之孙高伦一度兼领两处，但1263年帕尧的昂孟趁王后坎品留守之机攻陷磨府。坎品之子帕农在帕尧统治下长大，于1313年以帕亚·帕农之名恢复难国独立。

帕恭于1361年继位，1368年因旱灾把都城从磨府迁往渊南。难国保持独立，直至1449年被兰纳征服。

en:
The Piasts were the first historical ruling dynasty of Poland, named in later tradition after the semi-legendary Piast the Wheelwright. From Gniezno, Mieszko I united the Polan lands and accepted Christianity in 966, and his son Bolesław I the Brave was crowned the first king in 1025.

Unity did not last: Bolesław III Wrymouth's 1138 testament split Poland among his sons, and Piast dukes partitioned it for nearly two centuries while Silesian lines gradually became Bohemian vassals. Władysław I the Elbow-high was crowned in 1320 after reuniting the kingdom; his son Casimir III the Great ruled from 1333, strengthened it with towns and laws, dying without a male heir in 1370. The crown passed to his sister's son, the Angevin Louis I of Hungary.

Piast rule nevertheless continued locally: Masovian dukes lasted until 1526, and Silesian Piasts held Legnica, Brzeg and other duchies until the last ruling duke, George William, died in 1675; the final male and female heirs died in 1679 and 1707.
zh:
皮亚斯特王朝是波兰第一个有史可考的统治王朝，后世以半传说的车轮匠皮亚斯特为之命名。梅什科一世以格涅兹诺为据点统一波兰诸部，966年接受基督教，其子勇敢者博莱斯瓦夫一世1025年加冕为第一位国王。

统一未能持久：1138年歪嘴博莱斯瓦夫三世的遗嘱把波兰分给诸子，此后近两百年诸公爵割据相争，西里西亚各支逐渐沦为波希米亚封臣。矮子瓦迪斯瓦夫一世1320年加冕，波兰重归一统；其子卡齐米日三世大王1333年继位，广建城镇、修订法律，1370年无男嗣而终，王位传予妹妹之子、匈牙利安茹家族的拉约什一世。

皮亚斯特的统治在地方上仍有延续：马佐夫舍公爵支系维持到1526年，西里西亚皮亚斯特各支保有莱格尼察、布热格等公国，末代执政公爵格奥尔格·威廉1675年在莱格尼察去世，家族最后的男女嗣分别于1679年和1707年离世。

en:
The House of Pierrepont took its name from its lordship in the Ile-de-France and was founded in the twelfth century, perhaps by Hugh de Montfelix, said to be a natural son of Count Theobald the Great of Champagne. In 1204 Robert I de Pierrepont wed Eustachie, heiress of Roucy, and ruled the county in her name.

His successors held Roucy through the thirteenth century. John IV was killed at Mons-en-Pevele in 1304 and John V at Crecy in 1346; John V also inherited Braine, thereafter joined to Roucy.

In 1370 countess Isabelle sold Roucy to Louis of Anjou, but her uncle Simon de Pierrepont asserted his line's right to buy it back and won a twenty-year lawsuit before the Parlement of Paris. The last count, John VI, fell at Agincourt in 1415. After his death the county passed to the House of Sarrebruck.
zh:
皮埃尔蓬家族以其在法兰西岛的领地得名，发源于12世纪，始祖可能是于格·德·蒙费利克斯，传为香槟伯爵蒂博大帝的私生子。1204年，罗贝尔一世·德·皮埃尔蓬娶鲁西伯国女继承人厄斯塔谢为妻，遂以妻子的名义统治鲁西。

其后整个13世纪，家族世代领有鲁西。让四世于1304年战死在蒙斯昂佩韦勒，让五世于1346年战死在克雷西；让五世还继承了布赖讷伯国，此后与鲁西合而为一。

1370年，女伯爵伊莎贝尔把鲁西卖给安茹的路易，她的叔父西蒙·德·皮埃尔蓬依据本支的回购权向巴黎高等法院申诉，诉讼长达二十年，最终胜诉。末代伯爵让六世于1415年在阿让库尔阵亡。他死后鲁西伯国转入萨尔布吕肯家族之手。

en:
The Pili line, or Hale o Pili, was the royal house of Hawaiʻi. Its founder Pilikaʻaiea, known as Pili, was said to have come from Upolu in Samoa or Uporu in Tahiti at the call of the high priest Paʻao, and was credited with bringing new skills in agriculture and fishing.

His descendants succeeded one another as Aliʻi nui of Hawaiʻi, including the warrior Kalaunuiohua, who in the 1300s conquered chiefs on Maui, Molokaʻi and Oʻahu before being captured by the king of Kauaʻi in the War of Kawelewele.

In the late 1400s the chief Līloa kept his royal compound in Waipiʻo Valley, and from his son ʻUmi-a-Līloa and the later rulers of the house every monarch of the eventual Kingdom of Hawaiʻi, including Kamehameha I, claimed descent.
zh:
皮利世系又称“皮利家族”，是夏威夷岛的王室。始祖皮利卡艾埃亚简称皮利，相传来自萨摩亚的乌波卢或塔希提的乌波鲁，应大祭司帕奥之召来到夏威夷，并被认为带来了农耕和渔业的新技术。

他的后裔世代出任夏威夷岛的高级酋长“阿利伊努伊”，其中14世纪的卡劳努伊奥胡阿接连击败毛伊、莫洛凯和瓦胡的酋长，却在卡韦莱韦莱战争中被考艾国王俘虏。

15世纪后期，酋长利洛阿在怀皮奥谷建立王庭，他的儿子乌米-阿-利洛阿及家族后来的统治者，被日后夏威夷王国的所有君主，包括卡美哈梅哈一世，奉为祖先。

en:
The Plantagenets came from the French county of Anjou, named from Count Geoffrey V, who wore a yellow broom sprig, planta genista, in his hat, nicknamed Plantagenet. Geoffrey married Henry I's heiress, Empress Matilda, in 1128, conquered Normandy in 1144, and their son Henry inherited the English crown in 1154 as Henry II.

Henry and his sons Richard I and John, often called the Angevins, ruled from the Scottish border to the Pyrenees, but John lost Normandy and Anjou and had to accept Magna Carta in 1215. Edward I conquered Wales in 1283. Under Edward III, who ruled in 1337, Middle English became the language of government and his French claim opened the Hundred Years' War.

After Richard II's 1399 deposition, the crown passed between Lancaster and York, their rivalry the Wars of the Roses. Richard III died at Bosworth Field in 1485, ending the dynasty; victor Henry VII married Elizabeth of York and founded the Tudor line, every later English monarch carrying Plantagenet blood.
zh:
金雀花家族发源于法国安茹伯国，得名于安茹伯爵若弗鲁瓦五世：他帽上常别一枝黄色金雀花（拉丁名planta genista），故得金雀花绰号。1128年若弗鲁瓦娶英格兰国王亨利一世的女继承人玛蒂尔达，1144年征服诺曼底，他们的儿子亨利于1154年继承英格兰王位，即亨利二世。

亨利及其子理查一世和约翰常被合称安茹诸王，疆域从苏格兰边境延伸到比利牛斯山；但约翰丢掉诺曼底和安茹，1215年被迫接受《大宪章》。爱德华一世1283年征服威尔士；1337年在位的爱德华三世治下，中古英语成为行政语言，他对法国王位的主张点燃了百年战争。

1399年理查二世被废后，王位在兰开斯特、约克两旁支间流转，争斗演变为玫瑰战争。1485年理查三世在博斯沃思原野战役战死，王朝告终；胜利者亨利七世娶约克的伊丽莎白，开创都铎一脉，此后每位英格兰君主都流着金雀花的血。

en:
The Vogts of Plauen were a house named after their castle at Plauen, branching off from the Vogts of Weida. From 1236 the family appears in documents as the Vogts of Plauen. In 1278 Count Conrad of Everstein granted the town of Plauen to his brother-in-law Heinrich I.

Heinrich I of Plauen's sons split the house: Heinrich the Bohemian founded the senior line, while Heinrich the Russian founded the junior line, which took the name Reuss in 1307. In 1327 the Plauen line accepted Bohemian overlordship, and in the Vogtland War of 1354 to 1357 it lost most of its territory to Emperor Charles IV and the Wettin margraves.

Heinrich von Plauen the Elder defended Marienburg after Grunwald in 1410 and led the Teutonic Order until 1413. The senior line died out in 1572; its lands passed to the Reuss.
zh:
普劳恩福格特家族以普劳恩的城堡得名，是魏达福格特家族的支系。1236年起，该家族在文书中称普劳恩福格特。1278年埃弗施泰因伯爵康拉德把普劳恩城移交给妹夫海因里希一世。

海因里希一世的儿子分裂了家族：“波希米亚人”海因里希开创长支，“俄罗斯人”海因里希开创幼支，该支于1307年改用罗伊斯为姓。1327年普劳恩支系接受波希米亚的宗主权，又在1354—1357年的福格特兰战争中把大半领地输给皇帝查理四世和韦廷藩侯。

老海因里希·冯·普劳恩在1410年格伦瓦德战后坚守马林堡，1410—1413年统领条顿骑士团。长支于1572年绝嗣，领地归于罗伊斯。

en:
The House of Poitiers, known as Poitiers-Valentinois, was a twelfth-century feudal line of the Valentinois around Valence on the Rhone, unrelated to the greater counts of Poitiers in Poitou. Guillaume de Poitiers was recognised as count of Valentinois by the count of Toulouse in 1163 and by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa in 1178, his son Aymar II receiving the county of Diois in 1189; Aymar's marriage extended the house into the Vivarais across the Rhone.

For two and a half centuries the counts held Valentinois and Diois together, until Louis II de Poitiers, dying without legitimate heirs in 1419, bequeathed both counties to the dauphin Charles, the future Charles VII, on condition they remain joined to the Dauphine.

Junior branches carried the name onward: the seigneurs de Saint-Vallier, whose most famous daughter was Diane de Poitiers, mistress of Henry II, ended in the male line in 1547, while the barons of Vadans, settled in Champagne and the Franche-Comte, survived until 1715.
zh:
普瓦捷家族（称普瓦捷-瓦朗蒂努瓦家族）是12世纪起立足瓦朗蒂努瓦（罗讷河畔瓦朗斯一带）的封建贵族世系，与普瓦图更显赫的普瓦捷伯爵并无关系。1163年纪尧姆·德·普瓦捷被图卢兹伯爵承认为瓦朗蒂努瓦伯爵，1178年又获皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨承认；其子艾马尔二世1189年取得迪瓦伯国，他的婚姻又把家族势力扩展到罗讷河对岸的维瓦赖。

此后两个半世纪，历代伯爵兼领瓦朗蒂努瓦和迪瓦，直到路易二世·德·普瓦捷1419年去世而无合法子嗣，遗嘱把两个伯国留给王太子夏尔（即后来的查理七世），条件是两地永远并于多菲内。

各幼支延续了家族名号：圣瓦利耶领主一支1547年男系断绝，其最出名的女儿是亨利二世的宠妃普瓦捷的迪亚娜；定居香槟和弗朗什-孔泰的瓦当男爵支延续到1715年。

en:
The da Polenta, or Polentani, were a Romagnol noble house named after the Castle of Polenta near Bertinoro, who became lords of Ravenna in the thirteenth century. Their first strongman Guido I's daughter Francesca married Giovanni Malatesta around 1275 to seal a family peace; surprised with Giovanni's brother Paolo, she was murdered by her husband between 1283 and 1286 and became a soul in Dante's Inferno.

Their kinsman Guido Novello sheltered the exiled Dante in Ravenna in 1321, where the poet died that year; Guido was overthrown in 1322. Ostasio I held Cervia and Ravenna until his death in 1346, and his descendants kept the signoria through fraternal coups.

The last of the line, Ostasio III, intrigued with Milan against Venice. The Venetians annexed Ravenna in 1441 and confined him to a monastery, where he died in 1447.
zh:
德·波伦塔家族又称波伦塔尼，是罗马涅的贵族世家，族名得自贝尔蒂诺罗附近的波伦塔堡，13世纪在拉文纳自立为领主。家族首位强人圭多一世的女儿弗朗切丝卡约在1275年嫁给乔瓦尼·马拉泰斯塔以巩固两家和约；她与丈夫之弟保罗私通被捉住，于1283—1286年间被丈夫杀死，成为但丁《神曲·地狱篇》中的亡魂。

族人圭多·诺韦洛于1321年在拉文纳收留流亡的但丁，诗人同年在此去世，圭多则在1322年被推翻。此后奥斯塔西奥一世占据切尔维亚和拉文纳直至1346年去世，其继承人在兄弟阋墙中维持着领主权。

末代领主奥斯塔西奥三世勾结米兰对抗威尼斯。威尼斯人于1441年吞并拉文纳，将他关入修道院，他于1447年死在那里。

en:
The Polotsk dynasty was the princely line that ruled the medieval Principality of Polotsk, a trading power on the Western Dvina. Descended from Iziaslav of Polotsk, son of Vladimir the Great, this senior Rurikid branch kept its distance from Kiev and reached its golden age under Vseslav, who reigned from 1044 to 1101 and built the Cathedral of Saint Sophia.

After Vseslav's death the principality fragmented into lesser appanages, weakened by wars with neighboring Rus' princes and the German crusaders in Livonia. Polotsk became a Lithuanian vassal in 1240 and was fully incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1307.

Jewna is said in the later Bychowiec Chronicle to be a daughter of a prince of Polotsk and the Orthodox wife of Grand Duke Gediminas, though modern historians doubt whether she existed at all.
zh:
波洛茨克王朝是中世纪波洛茨克公国的统治家族，这个公国是西德维纳河畔的贸易强国。该支系是留里克家族的长支，出自弗拉基米尔大公之子伊贾斯拉夫，长期与基辅保持距离，在1044—1101年在位的弗谢斯拉夫治下进入黄金时代，圣索菲亚大教堂即建于此时。

弗谢斯拉夫死后，公国分裂为小封邑，又在与邻近罗斯王公和利沃尼亚德意志十字军的战争中日益衰弱。波洛茨克于1240年成为立陶宛附庸，1307年被完全并入立陶宛大公国。

晚出的《贝霍维茨编年史》说耶夫娜是波洛茨克某位王公之女、大公格迪米纳斯的东正教妻子，但后世学者对她是否真实存在颇有疑问。

en:
The House of Pons was a knightly family of Saintonge and Guyenne, nicknamed the kings of Guyenne, whose proven descent begins with Renaud, lord of Pons, attested in 1224. Its rise into the Auvergne came by marriage: in 1290 Geoffroy de Pons wed Isabelle of Rodez, viscountess of Carlat, and their son Renaud IV ruled the viscounty.

During the Hundred Years' War Renaud briefly placed his lands under English protection in 1340, then returned to the French banner by 1345 and died in 1356. His son Renaud V was killed that year at Maupertuis. Renaud VI first sided with the English, but English freebooters held Carlat from 1369 to 1388.

After Jean of Armagnac reconquered Carlat, Renaud sold it to Duke Jean I of Berry in 1392, ending the family's Auvergne rule. The senior Saintonge branch kept the Pons name alive.
zh:
庞斯家族是圣通日和吉耶讷的骑士世家，绰号“吉耶讷之王”，可考世系从1224年在世的庞斯领主勒诺开始。家族向奥弗涅的扩张靠婚姻：1290年，若弗鲁瓦·德·庞斯娶卡拉女子爵、罗德兹的伊莎贝尔；他们的儿子勒诺四世统治该子爵领。

百年战争中，勒诺于1340年一度把领地置于英格兰保护之下，1345年前回到法兰西旗帜下，1356年去世。其子勒诺五世同年在莫佩尔蒂战役中阵亡。勒诺六世起初投靠英格兰，英格兰雇佣兵却从1369年起占据卡拉，直到1388年。

阿马尼亚克的让收复卡拉后，勒诺于1392年把它卖给贝里公爵让一世，家族在奥弗涅的统治就此结束。圣通日的长支仍延续着庞斯之名。

en:
The Pratiharas of Mandore were an early Rajput dynasty of Marwar in Rajasthan, taking their name from the Sanskrit word pratihara, door-keeper, from a claim that their ancestor Lakshmana, brother of Rama, had guarded Rama's door. Their inscriptions trace the line to Harichandra, whose four sons captured Mandavyapura, or Mandore, around the sixth century.

Related to the imperial Gurjara-Pratiharas of Kannauj, the family became their feudatories. Kakkuka, known from an inscription of 861, is the last recorded ruler of the early line, which was absorbed into the imperial domains.

When that empire broke under Ghaznavid raids, a junior branch kept Mandore until the fourteenth century. In 1395, pressed by the Tughlaqs of Delhi, it married its princess to the Rathore chief Rao Chunda and gave him Mandore and a thousand villages as dowry, merging into the Rathore state of Jodhpur.
zh:
曼多尔的波罗提诃罗是拉贾斯坦马尔瓦尔地区的早期拉杰普特王朝，族名来自梵语，意为守门人：他们自称先祖是罗摩之弟罗什曼那，曾为罗摩守门。据其铭文，世系可追溯到哈里旃陀罗，他的四个儿子约在6世纪夺取曼达维亚普拉，即曼多尔。

该家族与卡瑙杰的瞿折罗-波罗提诃罗帝国同源，后来成为其封臣。861年铭文所载的卡库卡是早期世系最后一位有记录的统治者，其后家族并入帝国领地。

帝国在伽色尼入侵下瓦解后，一支旁系据守曼多尔直至14世纪。1395年，迫于德里图格鲁克王朝的压力，这支波罗提诃罗人把公主嫁给拉托尔首领拉奥·琼达，并以曼多尔和上千座村庄为嫁妆，家族由此融入崛起的焦特布尔拉托尔政权。

en:
The Přemyslids were the native dynasty of Bohemia, named after the legendary ploughman Přemysl, husband of the prophetess Libuše. Their first documented duke, Bořivoj I, ruled around Prague from the 860s and accepted Christianity. Ottokar I made the royal title hereditary in 1198.

At their peak under Ottokar II, the Iron and Golden King, the Přemyslids reached the Adriatic, until he fell against Rudolf of Habsburg at Marchfeld in 1278. The murder of Wenceslaus III in 1306 ended the royal line, and the Bohemian crown passed to the House of Luxembourg.

A cadet line survived: Nicholas I, a natural son of Ottokar II, had received Opava in 1269, and his descendants ruled Opava and, from 1337, Racibórz. This branch ended with Duke Valentin's death in 1521, when its lands reverted to the Bohemian Crown, held by the Habsburgs from 1526.
zh:
普热米斯尔王朝是波希米亚本土的统治家族，得名于传说中的农夫普热米斯尔，即女先知莉布丝的丈夫。有文献可考的第一位公爵博日沃伊一世自9世纪60年代起统治布拉格附近并皈依基督教。1198年奥托卡一世使王位世袭。

王朝在“铁金国王”奥托卡二世治下达到鼎盛，疆域直抵亚得里亚海；1278年他在马希费尔德战役中败死于哈布斯堡的鲁道夫之手。1306年瓦茨拉夫三世遇刺，王室主支断绝，波希米亚王位落入卢森堡家族。

一支旁系延续下来：奥托卡二世的私生子尼古拉一世于1269年受封奥帕瓦，其后裔统治奥帕瓦，并从1337年起兼领拉齐布日。1521年公爵瓦伦丁去世，支系告终，领地收归波希米亚王冠，1526年起随波希米亚归于哈布斯堡家族。

en:
The Pugal line was a Bhati Rajput chiefly house holding the desert fort of Pugal, in the Jangladesh region of Rajasthan. The Bhati clan, whose main kingdom was Jaisalmer, had incorporated Pugal into its dominions by the twelfth century.

Its best-known ruler, Rao Kelana, also called Kelhana, was a disinherited elder son of Rao Kehar of Jaisalmer. He seized Pugal in 1414 and built a chiefship that at his death around 1430 controlled nine forts, including Derawar and Bhatner. He also joined the alliance that killed Rao Chunda of Marwar at Nagaur. Later in the fifteenth century Rao Shekha of Pugal resisted the rise of Rao Bika, founder of neighbouring Bikaner. The Pugal lands were eventually absorbed into Bikaner.
zh:
普加尔家族是巴蒂拉杰普特人的一支首领世系，据守拉贾斯坦禅伽罗德什地区的沙漠要塞普加尔。以贾沙梅尔为主国的巴蒂氏族早在12世纪已将普加尔纳入版图。

其最著名的统治者拉奥·凯拉纳（又称凯尔哈纳）本是贾沙梅尔的拉奥·凯哈尔被废黜继承权的长子。他于1414年夺取普加尔建立首领之邦，到约1430年去世时已领有包括德拉瓦尔和巴特纳尔在内的九座要塞。他还参与了在纳高尔击杀马尔瓦尔的拉奥·琼达的同盟。15世纪后期，普加尔的拉奥·谢卡抵抗了邻邦比卡内尔的建立者拉奥·比卡的崛起。普加尔之地最终被并入比卡内尔。

en:
The Purang kings of the fourteenth century belonged to the Malla house of the Khasa, or Yatse, kingdom, founded by Nagaraja in the eleventh century with its capital at Sinja. Tibetan chronicles derive the Yatse line from a son of the old royal house of Purang; the family gradually Indianised and took the surname Malla.

Its kings left inscriptions across the region, including Ashok Challa at Bodhgaya in 1255 and 1278 and Ripu Malla on the Ashokan pillar at Lumbini in 1312. Under Punya Malla, recorded of Purang royalty between 1336 and 1339, and his successor Prithvi Malla, the empire reached its height, taking in Guge, Purang and much of western Nepal.

Tibetan sources call Prithvi Malla the last great king of the line; after Abhaya Malla the kingdom fragmented, and in 1378 a resurgent Guge absorbed Purang.
zh:
14世纪统治布让的国王出自卡萨（又称亚泽）王国的末罗家族。该国由纳加拉杰于11世纪建立，都城设在辛贾。藏文史籍称亚泽王统源于布让旧王族的一位王子，家族逐渐印度化后以“马拉”为姓。

历代国王在各地留下碑文，包括阿肖克·查拉1255年和1278年在菩提伽耶所立之碑，以及里普·马拉1312年留在蓝毗尼阿育王石柱上的题记。普尼亚·马拉（1336—1339年间在位，史称出自布让王族）及其继承者普里特维·马拉在位时国力达到顶峰，版图囊括古格、布让和尼泊尔西部大片土地。

藏文史料称普里特维·马拉为该世系最后一位强大的国王；阿巴亚·马拉之后王国解体，1378年复兴的古格吞并了布让。

en:
The Eastern Gangas, also called the Purba Gangas, were a Hindu dynasty that ruled Kalinga from the late fifth century to 1434. Probably an offshoot of the Western Gangas of Karnataka, they moved their capital from Dantapura to Kalinganagara and finally Kataka, and made Odia the court language.

The imperial line began with Anantavarman Chodaganga, who reigned from about 1077 to 1150, united Kalinga and built the Jagannath temple at Puri. Narasimhadeva I carried Ganga arms to Lakhnawati in 1245 and raised the Sun Temple at Konark, taking the title Gajapati.

After Firuz Shah Tughlaq's invasions of 1353 to 1358 the kings paid tribute to Delhi. In 1434 the last ruler Bhanudeva IV was set aside by his minister Kapilendra, who founded the Suryavamsha dynasty; a Ganga branch continued to hold Paralakhemundi for centuries afterward.
zh:
普尔巴‑恒伽即东恒伽王朝，是5世纪末至1434年统治羯陵伽的印度教王朝。它可能是卡纳塔克西恒伽王朝的支系，都城先后从丹塔普拉迁至羯陵伽纳加拉，最后定都卡塔卡，并以奥里亚语为宫廷语言。

帝国世系始于阿南泰伐摩·朱达恒伽提婆（约1077—1150年在位），他统一羯陵伽，修建了普里的贾格纳特神庙。纳罗新哈提婆一世于1245年挥师攻入拉克瑙提，又修建科纳克太阳神庙，并采用加贾帕蒂王号。

1353—1358年菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克入侵后，国王向德里纳贡。1434年末代君主巴哈奴提婆四世被大臣卡皮伦德拉取代，后者建立太阳王朝，而恒伽的一支后裔此后仍长期保有巴拉赫蒙迪。

en:
The Qatadids, or Banu Qatadah, were Mecca's Hasanid sharifian dynasty from 1201 into the twentieth century. Founder Qatadah ibn Idris, a Zaydi Shiʿite sharif from Yanbu, seized Mecca around 1200 and won Ayyubid recognition; in 1220 or 1221 his son Hasan strangled and succeeded him.

His line governed Mecca and the Hejaz, guarding the Hajj routes under loose Ayyubid overlordship and then the Mamluks, who set rival princes against one another. In the late Mamluk or early Ottoman period the family adopted Sunni Islam's Shafiʿi rite. In 1517 Sharif Barakat acknowledged the Ottoman sultan as caliph and was confirmed in office.

In 1803 Wahhabi raiders from Najd deposed Emir Ghalib and occupied the holy cities. Egyptian forces under Muhammad Ali retook Medina in 1812 and Mecca in 1813, restoring the Qatadid emirate under Ottoman suzerainty.
zh:
卡塔迪德家族又称巴努·卡塔达，是哈桑系圣裔（谢里夫）王朝，自1201年起世袭麦加埃米尔，一直延续到20世纪。始祖卡塔达·伊本·伊德里斯是出身延布河谷的宰德派什叶派谢里夫，约1200年夺取麦加并得到阿尤布王朝承认，1220年或1221年被儿子哈桑缢杀，哈桑随即继位。

他的后裔治理麦加与汉志，护卫朝觐道路，起初松散臣属阿尤布王朝，后来归马穆鲁克统辖；马穆鲁克扶植相互争位的王公。马穆鲁克晚期或奥斯曼早期，该家族改宗逊尼派沙斐仪派。1517年谢里夫巴拉卡特承认奥斯曼苏丹为哈里发并获确认职位。

1803年，来自内志的瓦哈比派废黜埃米尔加里卜、占据两圣城。穆罕默德·阿里麾下的埃及军队于1812年夺回麦地那、1813年夺回麦加，在奥斯曼宗主权下恢复了卡塔迪德埃米尔国。

en:
The lords of Querfurt were imperial free nobles named after their castle at Querfurt, west of Merseburg in the Saale valley. The first documented member, Bruno of Querfurt, became a monk and missionary bishop. He was killed with eighteen companions while preaching to the Old Prussians in 1009 and remembered as the Second Apostle of the Prussians.

The Querfurts held the burgraviate of Magdeburg for centuries. Conrad of Querfurt, son of Burgrave Burchard II, became imperial chancellor and bishop and joined the Crusade of 1197. A younger branch inherited the County of Mansfeld in 1229, while the houses of Schraplau and Vitzenburg sprang from the same stock.

In 1337 the main line still held Querfurt and its surrounding lands. It died with Bruno XI in 1496, when the territory passed to the archbishopric of Magdeburg as the Amt of Querfurt.
zh:
奎尔富特领主家族是帝国自由贵族，得名于萨勒河谷梅泽堡以西的奎尔富特城堡。有文献可考的第一位成员奎尔富特的布鲁诺成为修士和传教主教，1009年向古普鲁士人布道时与十八名同伴一同被杀，后世称他为普鲁士人的第二使徒。

奎尔富特家族世袭马格德堡城堡伯爵之职达数百年。城堡伯爵布尔夏德二世之子康拉德·冯·奎尔富特曾任帝国宰相和主教，并参加1197年十字军。家族的一支于1229年继承曼斯费尔德伯国，施拉普劳和维岑堡的领主家族也同出此源。

1337年，主支仍领有奎尔富特及其周边土地。1496年布鲁诺十一世去世，主支绝嗣，领地并入马格德堡大主教区，成为奎尔富特辖区。

en:
The Qushji were the family of Shaykh 'Ali b. 'Ali Qushji, governor of Khurasan for the Ilkhanate, seated at Esfarayen. When Ilkhan Abu Sa'id died in 1335, Shaykh 'Ali led efforts to persuade the princes of eastern Iran to accept Togha Temür, a descendant of Genghis Khan's brother Qasar, as Ilkhan.

He directed the khan's government and tax policies, which made him unpopular with the local amirs. In the spring of 1337 he accompanied Togha Temür on an expedition to western Iran, but Arghun Shah of the Ja'un-i Qurban and the lord of Kuhistan withdrew at Bistam.

After the Jalayirid Hasan Buzurg defeated the army near Soltaniyeh, Arghun Shah seized Shaykh 'Ali during the retreat and executed him in July 1337, sending his head to the victor.
zh:
库什吉家族是谢赫·阿里·本·阿里·库什吉的家族，他任伊利汗国呼罗珊长官，驻节埃斯法拉延。1335年伊利汗不赛因死后，谢赫·阿里牵头劝说东伊朗诸王公接受成吉思汗之弟合撒儿的后裔脱合帖木儿为伊利汗。

他主持汗廷政务和财税政策，招来地方异密的怨恨。1337年春，他随脱合帖木儿西征伊朗西部，乔尼·库尔班的阿儿浑沙和库希斯坦领主却在比斯塔姆撤军。

大军在苏丹尼耶附近被札剌亦儿人哈桑·布祖格击败后，阿儿浑沙在撤退途中擒获谢赫·阿里，于1337年7月将他处死，并把首级送给胜利者。

en: The Qutlugh take their name from the Mongol emir Esen Qutlugh, a commander under the Ilkhans Ghazan and Öljaitü. His son Mahmud, an emir in Iraq-i Ajam, deserted Arpa Ke'un at the Battle of Jaghatu in 1336 and backed the pretender Togha Temür until the Jalayirids eliminated his faction around 1337; the game places the house at Hamadan.
zh: 忽都鲁家族得名于蒙古异密也先·忽都鲁，他是伊儿汗国合赞汗与完者都麾下的将领。其子马哈茂德是阿贾姆伊拉克的异密，1336年在贾加图之战中背弃阿尔巴汗，转而支持觊觎汗位的脱合帖木儿，约1337年被札剌亦儿人消灭；游戏将这一家族置于哈马丹。

en:
The Rais were the ruling house of Chitral between the old pre-Islamic order and the rise of the Kator mehtars. Tradition says the line began in 1320, when Shah Nadir Rais, said to have come from Turkestan and perhaps belonging to the Trakhan dynasty of Gilgit, conquered the Hindu Kush valley and displaced the Kalasha rulers.

Nine Rais chiefs are listed; the eighth, Shah Nasir, was followed by his son Shah Mahmud Rais, whose unpopular rule gave the Kator leader Mohtaram Shah his opening. Shah Mahmud's defeat by Mohtaram's son Sangin Ali II in 1660 ended the Rais period and set the Kator dynasty on Chitral's throne for the following centuries.
zh:
赖莎家族是吉德拉尔前伊斯兰秩序与卡托尔梅赫塔崛起之间的统治家族。据当地编年史记载，该世系始于1320年：沙·纳迪尔·赖莎据说来自突厥斯坦，可能出身吉尔吉特的特拉汗王朝，他征服兴都库什山谷地，取代了卡拉沙统治者。

赖莎氏共有九位首领，第八位沙·纳西尔之后由其子沙·马哈茂德·赖莎继位，他的统治不得人心，给了卡托尔领袖穆赫塔拉姆·沙可乘之机。1660年，穆赫塔拉姆之子桑金·阿里二世击败沙·马哈茂德，赖莎时期结束，卡托尔王朝登上吉德拉尔的王座，并延续了此后数百年。

en:
The Rajasa dynasty ruled eastern Java's Hindu-Buddhist kingdoms of Singhasari and Majapahit from the thirteenth to the early sixteenth century. Ken Arok, also called Sri Ranggah Rajasa, founded Singhasari in 1222. His descendant Kertanegara defied Kublai Khan's tribute demands but was killed by the rebel Jayakatwang before the Mongol expedition of 1293. Kertanegara's son-in-law Raden Wijaya used Mongol troops to destroy Jayakatwang, then drove them out, founded Majapahit and was crowned in 1293.

The throne passed through Jayanegara to Queen Tribhuwana, who in 1336 made Gajah Mada her chief minister. His Palapa oath launched conquests including Bali in 1342-1343; under her son Hayam Wuruk (r. 1350-1389), Majapahit became an empire of 98 tributaries, celebrated in the 1365 poem Nagarakretagama.

Succession wars after Hayam Wuruk's death in 1389, especially the Regreg conflict of 1405-1406, weakened control over vassals. Islam spread along Java's north coast, and Majapahit fell to Demak in 1527.
zh:
罗阇沙王朝在13世纪至16世纪初统治东爪哇的印度教—佛教王国信诃沙里与满者伯夷。肯·阿罗克（又名斯里·朗加·罗阇沙）于1222年建立信诃沙里。其后裔克尔塔纳加腊拒绝忽必烈的朝贡要求，却在1293年蒙古远征前被叛将贾亚卡旺杀害。克尔塔纳加腊的女婿罗登·韦查耶借蒙古军消灭贾亚卡旺，随即击退元军，建立满者伯夷，于1293年加冕。

王位经贾亚涅加拉传至女王特里布婆那，她于1336年任命加查·马达为宰相。他以帕拉帕誓言开启系列征服，1342—1343年攻占巴厘。到女王之子哈亚姆·乌鲁克（1350—1389年在位）时代，满者伯夷成为统有98个朝贡国的帝国，1365年的史诗《爪哇史颂》记载了这一盛世。

1389年哈亚姆·乌鲁克死后，王位继承战争，尤其是1405—1406年的雷格雷格内战，削弱了王朝对附庸的控制。伊斯兰教在爪哇北海岸扩散，满者伯夷于1527年被淡目国攻灭。

en:
The Raj Gonds were the Gond chiefly houses of central India who adopted Rajput-style kingship and built kingdoms in the forested Gondwana highlands. Muslim chronicles first notice Gond rajas in the fourteenth century. From the 1400s four principal states emerged, including Garha-Mandla, whose king Jadurai displaced the Kalachuri rulers.

Garha-Mandla peaked under Sangram Shah, who held fifty-two hill forts, and later under Rani Durgavati, a Chandela princess who defeated an invasion by Baz Bahadur of Malwa. In 1564 the Mughal emperor Akbar sent Asaf Khan against Garha; Durgavati died fighting at Narrai, and the kingdom became a Mughal feudatory before recovering partial independence under Hridayshah.

At Deogarh-Nagpur, ruler Bakht Buland Shah converted to Islam and founded Nagpur in 1702. Maratha expansion ended Gond independence: Garha-Mandla was made tributary in 1742 and annexed in 1781, and the last Gond kingdoms fell to the Nagpur Bhonsles.
zh:
拉杰·冈德人是中印度的冈德首领家族，采用拉杰普特王制，在森林覆盖的冈瓦纳高地建立王国。穆斯林编年史在14世纪首次提到冈德罗阇，15世纪以后形成四个主要政权，其中加尔哈-曼德拉的国王贾杜莱取代了当地的卡拉楚里统治者。

加尔哈-曼德拉在桑格拉姆·沙阿时达到鼎盛，据有五十二座山塞；后来的昌德拉公主杜尔加瓦蒂王后击败了摩腊婆的巴兹·巴哈杜尔的入侵。1564年，莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴派阿萨夫汗攻打加尔哈，杜尔加瓦蒂在纳赖战死，王国成为莫卧儿附庸，后在赫里代沙阿治下恢复部分独立。

德奥加尔-那格浦尔的君主巴克特·布兰德·沙阿改宗伊斯兰教，1702年建那格浦尔城。马拉塔扩张终结了冈德独立：加尔哈-曼德拉于1742年沦为附庸、1781年被吞并，最后的冈德王国落入那格浦尔的邦斯勒家族之手。

en:
The Randolphs took their surname from Randulf or Ranulf, whose son served as Chamberlain of Scotland. Thomas Randolph (c. 1285-1332) was Robert the Bruce's nephew and comrade-in-arms. Captured early in the independence war, he rejoined Bruce, took Edinburgh Castle in a night escalade in 1314, and fought at Bannockburn that year.

Bruce made him first Earl of Moray. He signed the Declaration of Arbroath in 1320 and ruled as regent for the child David II from 1329 until his death in 1332. His heir and son Thomas was killed at Dupplin Moor, and his second son John fell in 1346 without a male heir, so the earldom reverted to the crown.

Thomas Randolph's daughter Black Agnes held Dunbar Castle against an English siege for five months in 1338. In 1372 Robert II recreated the earldom for Thomas's grandson John Dunbar, through his daughter Isabel.
zh:
伦道夫家族的姓氏来自伦杜尔夫（Ranulf），其子曾任苏格兰宫廷总管。托马斯·伦道夫（约1285—1332）是罗伯特一世的外甥和战友。独立战争初期他被俘，后来重返布鲁斯阵营，1314年夜袭夺取爱丁堡城堡，同年又参加班诺克本战役。

布鲁斯封他为第一代马里伯爵。他签署了1320年《阿布罗斯宣言》，1329年起出任幼主大卫二世的摄政，直至1332年去世。其继承人、长子托马斯战死于杜普林沼泽，次子约翰于1346年战死，没有男嗣，伯爵领被王室收回。

托马斯·伦道夫的女儿人称“黑阿格尼丝”，1338年坚守邓巴城堡，抵抗英格兰围城达五个月。1372年，罗伯特二世将马里伯爵领重新封给托马斯之女伊莎贝尔的外孙约翰·邓巴。

en: The Rankali house is that of Jamal al-Din Balan, chief of the Rankaliyya Kurds in the mountains of Hamadan. The Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari, writing in the 1340s, called the tribe the band of Jamal al-Din Balan and said that he ruled the country of Kangavar and the districts around it, on the road from Hamadan to Kermanshah.
zh: 兰卡利家族即贾马勒丁·巴兰一系，他是哈马丹山区兰卡利亚库尔德人的首领。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代称这个部落为“贾马勒丁·巴兰的人马”，说他统治坎加瓦尔及周边地区。坎加瓦尔位于从哈马丹通往克尔曼沙阿的路上。

en:
The Rasulids were a Sunni dynasty that ruled Yemen from 1229 to 1454 from Zabid and Taʿizz. The family probably came from the Oghuz Turkic Mendjik tribe, though its genealogists claimed descent from the Ghassanid Arabs; its name derives from an Abbasid-era ancestor nicknamed Rasul, meaning messenger. Founder Umar ibn Ali was an Ayyubid officer left in charge of Yemen in 1229; in 1235 he received Abbasid recognition and reigned as Sultan al-Mansur Umar.

His successors grew wealthy on Aden trade, customs and palm cultivation, and for a time controlled Mecca. Sultan al-Mujahid Ali (1322-1363) reformed the land tax; later sultans included al-Afdal Abbas, who compiled a scientific and agricultural encyclopedia, and al-Ashraf Ismaʿil, who wrote a history of Yemen.

A Ming fleet visited in 1418–1419. Tribal unrest and succession strife weakened the regime, and in 1454 the Tahirids seized Aden and ended Rasulid rule.
zh:
拉苏尔王朝是逊尼派王朝，1229年至1454年以宰比德和塔伊兹为都统治也门。该家族很可能出身乌古斯突厥人的门吉克部，自家谱学家则自称源于加桑阿拉伯人；其名称得自阿拔斯时代一位绰号拉苏尔（意为使者）的先祖。开创者欧麦尔·伊本·阿里是阿尤布王朝将领，1229年受命执掌也门，1235年获阿拔斯哈里发册封，称曼苏尔·欧麦尔苏丹。

后继者凭借经亚丁港的贸易、关税和棕榈种植致富，一度还控制麦加。苏丹穆贾希德·阿里（1322—1363年在位）改革土地税；后来的苏丹阿夫达勒·阿拔斯编纂科学与农业百科，阿什拉夫·伊斯玛仪撰写也门通史。

1418—1419年，明朝船队到访其宫廷。部落骚动与继承纷争削弱了政权，1454年塔希尔王朝攻占亚丁，拉苏尔王朝灭亡。

en:
The Rathores are a Rajput dynasty of the Suryavamshi tradition whose bardic genealogies trace them to the Gahadavalas of Kannauj; the historical line begins with Rao Siha, who established the first Rathore chiefdom in the Pali country of Marwar in the thirteenth century and died in 1273. Rao Chunda gained Mandore as a Pratihara bride's dowry around 1400 and made it the clan capital, but after Rao Ranmal was assassinated in 1438 the Sisodias of Mewar annexed Marwar. Rao Jodha recovered it in 1453 and founded Jodhpur, while his sons carved out Bikaner in 1465 and Merta in 1462, and Rao Maldeo, reigning from 1532 to 1562, made Marwar the strongest power in Rajputana.

Under the Mughals the Rathores shifted between enmity and alliance: Chandrasen Rathore resisted Akbar for nearly twenty years, until Uday Singh accepted Mughal suzerainty in 1583, and Aurangzeb's reign brought a thirty-year revolt in which Durgadas Rathore defended the Jodhpur line. A junior branch under Rao Sonag had already founded Idar in Gujarat in 1257, and Rao Anand Singh reconquered it in 1729. Jodhpur itself came under British protection by treaty in 1818, the leading state among the many Rathore principalities of Rajasthan.
zh:
罗怙罗是奉太阳世系传统的拉杰普特王朝，吟游世系把先祖追溯到曲女城的加哈达瓦拉家族；可考的世系始于罗阇·西哈，他于13世纪在马尔瓦尔的巴利地区建立第一个罗怙罗酋邦，1273年去世。约1400年，罗阇·琼达以普罗蒂诃罗新娘的嫁妆取得曼多尔，并将其定为家族都城；1438年罗阇·兰马尔遇刺后，梅瓦尔的西索迪亚人吞并了马尔瓦尔。1453年罗阇·乔达收复故土，修建焦特布尔城，他的儿子们又于1465年开拓比卡内尔、1462年开拓梅尔塔；到罗阇·马尔德奥在位时（1532—1562），马尔瓦尔已成为拉杰普塔纳最强的政权。

莫卧儿时期，罗怙罗人在敌对与结盟之间反复：昌德拉森·罗怙罗抵抗阿克巴近二十年，1583年乌代·辛格终于接受莫卧儿宗主权；奥朗则布时代又爆发三十年起义，杜尔加达斯·罗怙罗在此期间保全了焦特布尔世系。旁支罗阇·索纳格早在1257年就在古吉拉特建立伊德尔，1729年罗阇·阿南德·辛格将其收复。焦特布尔本家则于1818年通过条约接受英国保护，成为拉贾斯坦众多罗怙罗土邦中为首的一个。

en:
The Counts of Ravensberg, of the House of Calvelage-Ravensberg, ruled a county in eastern Westphalia at the foot of the Teutoburg Forest, first attested in the twelfth century. Their original seat was Ravensberg Castle; around 1240 to 1250 Otto III built Sparrenberg Castle above Bielefeld and moved there.

Otto III's daughter Adelaide married Landgrave Otto I of Hesse in 1297, and his son Otto IV's daughter Hedwig wed Duke William II of Brunswick-Lüneburg. Otto IV died in 1328 leaving only daughters; his brother Bernard ruled until his death without issue in 1346.

The county passed to Gerhard VI of Jülich, husband of Otto IV's daughter Margaret, and was united with Berg in 1348. The Treaty of Xanten awarded Ravensberg to Brandenburg in 1614, which administered it with Minden until the county's dissolution in 1807.
zh:
拉芬斯贝格伯爵出自卡尔费拉格-拉芬斯贝格家族，统治条顿堡林山脚下东威斯特伐利亚的伯国，伯国12世纪始见记载。家族原居拉芬斯贝格堡，约1240—1250年，奥托三世在比勒费尔德上方修建施帕伦贝格堡并迁居于此。

奥托三世之女阿德莱德于1297年嫁给黑森藩侯奥托一世，其子奥托四世的女儿黑德维希嫁给不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公爵威廉二世。奥托四世于1328年去世，只留下女儿，其弟贝尔纳德继位，1346年无嗣而终。

伯国传给奥托四世之女玛格丽特的丈夫于利希的格哈德六世，1348年与贝格合并。1614年的《克桑滕条约》把拉芬斯贝格划给勃兰登堡，此后与明登合组行政区，1807年解散。

en:
The Recherla Nayakas, also called the Padmanayaka Velamas, were a Telugu warrior dynasty that dominated Telangana from the late fourteenth century, based at Rachakonda and Devarakonda. Their chiefs Anapota and Maada Nayaka had served the Kakatiyas before allying with the Bahmani Sultanate.

In 1368 they defeated and killed Kapaya Nayaka of the Musunuri line at Bhimavaram and took Warangal. At first Bahmani clients and rivals of the Reddy chiefs of coastal Andhra, the Recherlas switched sides to Vijayanagara after the Reddys split, and in 1419 shared in victory over the Bahmanis at Pangal Fort.

The sultanate retaliated in the 1420s, capturing Warangal and Rachakonda by 1435 and ending Recherla power. The surviving Recherla chiefs sank into scattered local lordships across Telangana.
zh:
隶契罗·纳亚卡人又称帕德马纳亚卡·韦拉马人，是14世纪后期称霸特伦甘纳的泰卢固武将王朝，以拉彻孔达和德瓦拉孔达为根基。其首领阿纳波塔和马达·纳亚卡曾效力卡卡提亚王朝，后与巴赫曼尼苏丹国结盟。

1368年，他们在比马拉姆击败并击杀穆苏努里一系的卡帕亚·纳亚卡，控制了瓦朗加尔。隶契罗人起初是巴赫曼尼的附庸，与沿海安得拉的雷迪首领相争；雷迪一族分裂后转投维查耶纳伽尔，并于1419年在潘加尔堡之役中联手击败巴赫曼尼。

苏丹国在15世纪20年代反攻，到1435年连克瓦朗加尔和拉彻孔达，隶契罗的霸权终结。幸存的首领沦为散布特伦甘纳各地的小领主。

en:
The Reddi dynasty ruled coastal and central Andhra from 1325 to 1448, rising out of the collapse of the Kakatiya kingdom. Its founder Prolaya Vema Reddi made Addanki his capital after Warangal fell to the Delhi Sultanate in 1323. His successor Anavota Reddi moved the court to the hill fort of Kondavidu, and a junior branch was planted at Rajahmundry in 1395.

The kings were noted fort-builders and patrons of Hinduism. Prolaya Vema repaired the Srisailam temple, built the Narasimha temple at Ahobilam and is credited with 108 Shiva temples. In 1424 the Vijayanagara Empire annexed Kondavidu, and around 1448 the Gajapatis of Orissa took Rajahmundry, ending the dynasty's independent rule.
zh:
罗底王朝在1325—1448年间统治安得拉沿海与中部地区，在卡卡提亚王国崩溃后崛起。1323年瓦朗加尔被德里苏丹国攻陷后，开创者普罗拉亚·韦马·罗底以阿登吉为都；继任者阿纳沃塔·罗底把宫廷迁到山城孔达维杜，1395年又在拉贾蒙德里分出支系。

罗底诸王以修筑山堡和护持印度教著称。普罗拉亚·韦马修缮了斯里赛勒姆神庙，修建了阿霍比勒姆的人狮神庙，相传还建有108座湿婆神庙。1424年毗奢耶那伽罗帝国吞并孔达维杜，约1448年奥里萨的加贾帕蒂王朝攻占拉贾蒙德里，罗底王朝的独立统治至此终结。

en:
The Saxon comital House of Regenstein took its name from Regenstein Castle north of Blankenburg on the edge of the Harz. Its progenitor Count Poppo I of Blankenburg was first documented as a count in 1128 in the service of Duke Lothair of Supplinburg. Poppo's son Conrad first styled himself Count of Regenstein in 1162, while another son, Siegfried, kept Blankenburg.

Early in the fourteenth century the family acquired Heimburg Castle. In 1343 the Regenstein-Heimburg line reunited the Regenstein and Blankenburg lands under Count Albert II, who had feuded with the Bishops of Halberstadt and Abbesses of Quedlinburg since the 1330s and was murdered on the orders of Bishop Albert II of Halberstadt.

In the fifteenth century the family moved its seat to Blankenburg and abandoned Regenstein to ruin. It adopted Protestantism in 1539 and died out with Count John Ernest in 1599, when the county reverted to the Prince-Bishopric of Halberstadt.
zh:
萨克森伯爵世家雷根施泰因得名于哈茨山边缘、布兰肯堡以北的雷根施泰因城堡。其始祖布兰肯堡伯爵波波一世于1128年首次以伯爵身份见诸文献，效力于苏普林堡的洛泰尔公爵。波波的儿子康拉德于1162年率先自称雷根施泰因伯爵，另一个儿子西格弗里德则保有布兰肯堡。

14世纪初家族取得海姆堡城堡。1343年雷根施泰因—海姆堡支系在阿尔伯特二世治下重新统一雷根施泰因与布兰肯堡领地；阿尔伯特二世自14世纪30年代起与哈尔伯施塔特主教和奎德林堡女修道院长争斗，最终奉哈尔伯施塔特主教阿尔伯特二世之命被刺杀。

15世纪，家族把驻地迁往布兰肯堡，任雷根施泰因城堡倾颓。1539年家族改宗新教，1599年伯爵约翰·恩斯特去世，家族绝嗣，伯国复归哈尔伯施塔特主教区。

en:
The Reginarids were magnates of Lower Lotharingia in the Carolingian and Ottonian centuries, named for the Leitname Reginar. Their likely ancestor Gilbert held the Maasgau in 841; Reginar I held Lorraine as duke until 916, and after long strife with the Conradines Reginar III was dispossessed in 958. Two brothers from exile founded the Hainaut and Louvain lines.

The Louvain line, counts of Brussels from 1003, rose steadily: Godfrey I became Duke of Lower Lorraine in 1106, and Henry I the first Duke of Brabant in 1183 or 1184. John I the Victorious won Worringen in 1288 and added Limburg to Brabant. Adeliza, a Louvain daughter, married Henry I of England; a half-brother of Duke Henry III founded Hesse in 1264.

The Brabant male line ended in 1355 with John III; his heiress Joanna married Wenceslaus of Luxembourg, carrying Brabant to the Luxembourgs and, in 1383, to Valois Burgundy. In 1337 the Reginarid duke held court at Brussels and Louvain.
zh:
雷吉纳尔家族是加洛林、奥托时代下洛林的大贵族，族名雷吉纳尔世代沿用。先祖可能是841年领有马斯高的吉尔贝尔；雷吉纳尔一世任洛林公爵至916年。家族与康拉丁家族长期争夺洛塔林吉亚，958年雷吉纳尔三世被剥夺领地。流放归来的两兄弟开创埃诺、鲁汶两支系。

鲁汶支系1003年起兼领布鲁塞尔伯国：戈德弗鲁瓦一世1106年任下洛林公爵，亨利一世1183或1184年成为初代布拉班特公爵。胜利者约翰一世1288年沃林根战役获胜，把林堡并入布拉班特。鲁汶伯爵家的女儿阿德利扎嫁给英格兰国王亨利一世，亨利三世的异母弟1264年开创黑森家族。

1355年约翰三世去世，布拉班特男系断绝，女继承人约翰娜嫁卢森堡的文策尔一世，布拉班特先归卢森堡家族，1383年转入瓦卢瓦系勃艮第公爵。1337年，雷吉纳尔家族的公爵仍在布鲁塞尔和鲁汶理政。

en:
The Riedesel were a Hessian knightly family, documented from the early thirteenth century and serving the landgraves of Hesse. Lacking hereditary lands, they lived from fiefs and offices, and adopted Lutheranism after their overlords.

Hermann II Riedesel of the Melsungen line, adviser to Landgrave Louis, lived from 1407 to 1463. He acquired Eisenbach Castle and the hereditary office of Erbmarschall of Hesse, giving the house a landed base as the Riedesel zu Eisenbach. Most lines died out in the male line or sank into the peasantry by the early seventeenth century.

In 1680 the emperor raised five male members of the house to barons. General Frederick Adolph Riedesel, who lived from 1738 to 1800, led a Brunswick regiment in British service during the American Revolutionary War. The family lost its feudal rents and jurisdiction in the Napoleonic upheaval.
zh:
里德泽尔家族是黑森骑士世家，13世纪初起见于文书，主要为黑森领地伯爵效力。他们没有世袭领地，靠受封的土地与官职为生，并追随宗主皈依路德宗。

梅尔松根支系的赫尔曼二世·里德泽尔（1407—1463）是领地伯爵路易的顾问。他取得艾森巴赫城堡和黑森世袭大司马一职，为家族奠定地产根基，此后称艾森巴赫的里德泽尔。到17世纪初，多数支系要么男系绝嗣，要么沦为农民。

1680年皇帝册封家族五位男性成员为男爵。弗里德里希·阿道夫·里德泽尔将军（1738—1800）在美国独立战争中率领一支不伦瑞克军团为英国作战。拿破仑时代的动荡中，家族丧失了封建租赋与司法权。

en:
The Franconian counts of Rieneck descended from the counts of Loon. Ludwig I styled himself count of Rieneck in 1156; the family built Burg Rieneck around 1170. Marriages around 1200 and in 1243 nearly doubled the county, but Mainz defeated them in the western Spessart by 1271.

Lohr am Main became the county's chief town in 1295 and gained town rights in 1333. That year Count Ludwig V died after naming his daughter Udelhilt his heiress against a treaty with Hanau; the dispute drew in Mainz and Würzburg and cost the county much land.

A later partition divided the county into northern and southern halves; the southern half was lost in 1502. The Reformation reached Rieneck in 1544; Count Philip III's death in 1559 ended the male line, with the fiefs reverting to Mainz and Würzburg and Hanau inheriting the name and arms.
zh:
里内克伯爵是法兰克尼亚的贵族世家，祖先为洛恩伯爵。洛恩的路德维希一世于1156年自称里内克伯爵，家族约1170年修建里内克堡。约1200年和1243年的联姻使伯国领土几乎翻倍，但他们与美因茨争夺西施佩萨特，到1271年落败。

美因河畔洛尔于1295年成为伯国首邑，1333年获城市法。同年路德维希伯爵五世去世，他不顾与哈瑙的条约而指定女儿乌德尔希尔特为继承人，随即引发美因茨、维尔茨堡均卷入的继承纠纷，伯国丧失大片土地。

后来伯国分作南北两半，南半于1502年丧失。1544年宗教改革传入里内克，1559年菲利普伯爵三世去世，男系绝嗣，封地归还美因茨和维尔茨堡，名号与纹章由哈瑙继承。

en:
The Roger de Beaufort were a feudal family of the Limousin, lords of Maumont near Tulle, whose fortune was made by the Church. Pierre Roger, born in 1291, became Archbishop of Rouen and pope as Clement VI in 1342. During the Black Death of 1348 to 1350, he granted remission of sins to plague victims and condemned pogroms against Jews.

Clement made his brother Guillaume vicomte de Beaufort and in 1348 made his nephew Pierre Roger de Beaufort a cardinal. Elected Gregory XI in 1370, the nephew returned the papal court to Rome in 1377; his death in 1378 opened the Western Schism, healed at Constance in 1418.

Another nephew, Guillaume III Roger de Beaufort, received the vicomte of Turenne as a wedding gift in 1350. He served Queen Joanna of Naples in 1351 and ruled the Comtat Venaissin as papal rector from 1376.
zh:
罗歇·德·博福尔家族是利穆赞的封建世家，为蒂勒附近莫蒙的领主，家族依靠教会腾达。皮埃尔·罗歇生于1291年，出任鲁昂大主教，1342年当选教宗，称克雷芒六世。1348—1350年黑死病肆虐期间，他为死于瘟疫者颁赐罪罚赦免，并谴责针对犹太人的屠杀。

克雷芒把兄弟纪尧姆封为博福尔子爵，又在1348年将侄子皮埃尔·罗歇·德·博福尔擢升为枢机。这位侄子于1370年当选教宗，称格列高利十一世；1377年他把教廷迁回罗马，1378年去世后爆发西方教会大分裂，直到1418年康斯坦茨宗教会议才告弥合。

另一个侄子纪尧姆三世·罗歇·德·博福尔于1350年获赐蒂雷讷子爵领作为结婚礼物。他1351年效力于那不勒斯女王乔万娜，1376年起以教宗区长官的身份治理沃奈桑伯爵领地。

en:
The Rokkaku were a samurai clan of southern Ōmi Province, descended from the Sasaki clan of the Uda Genji line. In the thirteenth century Sasaki Yasutsuna took the name Rokkaku from his residence near the Rokkaku-dō hall in Kyoto, and his line kept the post of shugo of Ōmi.

When the Kamakura shogunate fell in 1333 clan head Rokkaku Tokinobu backed the Rokuhara deputies before surrendering. The family later joined Ashikaga Takauji and the Northern Court, ruling Ōmi from Kannonji Castle under the Muromachi shogunate.

The Ōnin War of 1467 to 1477 began its decline, though Rokkaku Sadayori and Yoshikata strengthened domain rule, opened a free market in 1549 and issued the house code Rokkaku-shi shikimoku in 1567. Oda Nobunaga defeated the clan in 1568 and Shibata Katsuie crushed its remaining forces in 1570; its descendants served the Tokugawa as kōke.
zh:
六角氏是以近江国南部为根基的武家，出自宇多源氏佐佐木氏。13世纪，佐佐木泰纲以京都六角堂附近的屋敷为名，改称六角氏，其家族世代保有近江守护之职。

1333年镰仓幕府灭亡时，当主六角时信站在六波罗探题一方，战败后归降。此后六角氏追随足利尊氏和北朝，在室町幕府下以观音寺城为居城统治近江。

1467—1477年的应仁之乱后六角氏走向衰落，不过六角定赖、义贤仍整顿领国，1549年开设自由市场，并于1567年颁布分国法《六角氏式目》。1568年织田信长击败六角氏，1570年柴田胜家攻灭其残余势力；其子孙以高家身份侍奉德川幕府。

en:
The Rosenbergs were the mightiest noble house of southern Bohemia and a branch of the Vítkovci clan. Around 1250 they settled at Rožmberk Castle and soon after built Český Krumlov, their seat for three centuries; their arms bore a red five-petalled rose on silver.

Jindřich III led the League of Lords against King Wenceslaus IV, while his son Oldřich II backed Emperor Sigismund during the Hussite Wars. Oldřich's daughter Perchta inspired the family's White Lady legend.

Under William of Rosenberg, High Treasurer and High Burgrave of Bohemia, the house reached its last peak: he rebuilt Český Krumlov as a Renaissance residence and commanded the Bohemian army against the Ottomans in 1566. After his death in 1592, his brother Peter Vok was forced to sell Krumlov to Emperor Rudolf II in 1601 and died at Třeboň in 1611, the last of his line.
zh:
罗森贝格家族是波希米亚南部最显赫的贵族世家，出自维特科维奇家族支系。约1250年，家族定居罗日姆贝克城堡，不久又修建捷克克鲁姆洛夫城堡，作为此后三百年的驻地；其纹章是银底红色五瓣玫瑰。

因德日赫三世率领贵族联盟对抗国王瓦茨拉夫四世，他的儿子奥尔德日赫二世在胡斯战争中支持皇帝西吉斯蒙德。奥尔德日赫的女儿佩尔赫塔是家族“白衣夫人”传说的原型。

身兼波希米亚最高财政官和最高城堡长官的罗森贝格的威廉治下，家族最后一次鼎盛：他把捷克克鲁姆洛夫改建为文艺复兴式府邸，并于1566年统率波希米亚军队对抗奥斯曼人。1592年威廉去世后，其弟彼得·沃克被迫于1601年把克鲁姆洛夫卖给皇帝鲁道夫二世，1611年死于特热邦，家族绝嗣。

en:
The de' Rossi were nobles of the Parma Apennines, first documented in 1323, whose rise rested on church and signoria. Ugolino Rossi became bishop of Parma in 1324 and built estates around Berceto; John of Bohemia named his brothers counts there in 1331.

His brother Rolando de' Rossi, born around 1285, ruled Parma as signore from 1328; after submitting it to the Bohemian king in 1331 he joined the future Charles IV on missions, but in 1335 Parma surrendered to the Scaligers and the Rossi were exiled. Rolando ended as a condottiero for Venice and Florence, dying at Padua in 1345.

From 1346, under Visconti rule, the family rebuilt from castles and from 1376 feuded for over a century with the Pallavicini. Its glory came with Pier Maria II de' Rossi, the Magnificent, who defeated the Venetians at Casalmaggiore in 1448 and built Torrechiara for his mistress Bianca Pellegrini. A Milanese league stormed his lands in 1482; he died at Torrechiara, the family's ascendancy broken.
zh:
德·罗西家族是帕尔马亚平宁山区的贵族世家，1323年首次见载，崛起靠教会职位与城邦政权。乌戈利诺·罗西1324年出任帕尔马主教，在贝尔切托一带积累山地产业，1331年波希米亚国王约翰又封他的兄弟为贝尔切托伯爵。

乌戈利诺的兄弟罗兰多·德·罗西约1285年出生，1328年起成为帕尔马事实上的领主；1331年他把城市献给波希米亚国王，随后陪同后来的查理四世出使，但1335年帕尔马向斯卡利杰家族投降，罗西家族遭放逐。罗兰多晚年成为威尼斯和佛罗伦萨的雇佣兵首领，1345年死于帕多瓦。

1346年维斯孔蒂家族统治该地区后，罗西家族以山地城堡重振势力，1376年起与帕拉维奇尼家族缠斗一个多世纪。家族鼎盛人物是绰号伟人的皮尔·马里亚二世·德·罗西，1448年在卡萨马焦雷击败威尼斯人，又为情妇比安卡·佩莱格里尼修建托雷基亚拉城堡。1482年米兰联军攻陷其领地，他死于托雷基亚拉，家族上升势头终结。

en:
The Roderick dynasty, known to history as the Rurikids, ruled Kievan Rus' and its successor principalities. Tradition, via the Primary Chronicle, traces it to Varangian prince Rurik at Novgorod in 862; his kinsman Oleg seized Kyiv in 882, and the line of Igor and Sviatoslav built a Baltic-to-Black-Sea state. Under Vladimir the Great the Rus' adopted Orthodox Christianity in 988; Yaroslav the Wise issued the first law code, and his 1054 death opened princely rivalry.

The 1097 Council of Liubech confirmed the split into rival branches. Mongol invasions of 1237—1240 sacked Kyiv and made the princes Horde vassals.

In 1337 scattered lines held Turov, Smolensk and other towns, while the northeastern future belonged to Moscow's Daniilovichi: Alexander Nevsky's son Daniel founded it, Ivan I Kalita made Moscow the Horde's tax-gatherer, Ivan III threw off Tatar overlordship in 1480, and Ivan IV became the first tsar in 1547. Feodor I's death in 1598 ended the dynasty and opened the Time of Troubles, which closed with the Romanov accession in 1613.
zh:
罗德里克王朝即史称的留里克王朝，是基辅罗斯及后继诸公国的统治家族。按《往年纪事》的传统说法，瓦良格王公留里克862年在诺夫哥罗德立足；亲属奥列格882年攻占基辅，伊戈尔和斯维亚托斯拉夫一系建立起北起波罗的海、南至黑海的国家。弗拉基米尔一世治下罗斯988年皈依东正教，智者雅罗斯拉夫颁布首部法典，1054年他死后王公纷争时代随之开始。

1097年柳别奇会议确认分疆而治，形成诸多支脉。1237—1240年蒙古入侵洗劫基辅，诸王公沦为金帐汗国封臣。

1337年，图罗夫、斯摩棱斯克等地仍由众多支系统治，东北的未来属于莫斯科达尼洛维奇系：亚历山大·涅夫斯基之子丹尼尔开创该系，伊凡一世·卡利塔使莫斯科成为汗庭倚重的征税者，伊凡三世1480年摆脱鞑靼宗主权，伊凡四世1547年加冕为第一位沙皇。1598年费奥多尔一世去世，王朝终结，随之而来的混乱时代至1613年罗曼诺夫登基方告结束。

en:
The Rusconi, also called Rusca or Ruschi, were a noble house of Como, attested from the tenth century, who led the city's Ghibelline faction against the Guelph Vitani. In 1276 Loterio Rusca was acclaimed Lord of the People, exiled the bishop and defeated Ottone Visconti, securing several lordships and counties by the peace of Lomazzo.

The family peaked under Franchino I, who crushed the Vitani in 1313 and ruled Como for some twenty years. In 1335 Azzone Visconti annexed Como, and in 1340 Luchino and Giovanni Visconti took Bellinzona after a long siege, leaving the Rusconi as their officials and feudatories.

After the Visconti crisis of 1402 Franchino II failed to revive the signoria and retreated to Lugano. The family exchanged its claims on Como for Locarno, which the Swiss Confederation took in 1513, leaving only Luino.
zh:
鲁斯科尼家族又称鲁斯卡或鲁斯基，是科莫的贵族世家，10世纪即有记载，领导吉伯林派与归尔夫派维塔尼家族相争。1276年，洛泰里奥·鲁斯卡被拥戴为“平民之主”，驱逐主教，又击退奥托内·维斯孔蒂，凭洛马佐和约取得多处领地。

弗兰基诺一世于1313年打垮维塔尼家族，统治科莫约二十年。1335年阿佐内·维斯孔蒂吞并科莫，1340年卢基诺与乔瓦尼·维斯孔蒂经长期围攻夺取贝林佐纳，鲁斯科尼沦为其属臣和官吏。

1402年维斯孔蒂政权陷入危机后，弗兰基诺二世试图重建领主权，失败后退守卢加诺。家族以放弃对科莫的权利换取洛迦诺，1513年瑞士邦联夺走洛迦诺，他们只剩卢伊诺。

en:
The Ruzagi, also called Rojaki or Rusaki, were the Kurdish tribal confederation that supplied the princes of Bitlis, a fortress town in the Armenian highlands. Their principality was established by the late twelfth century.

In the fourteenth century its emirs were vassals of the Kara Koyunlu; the emir submitted to Timur in 1394. The Aq Qoyunlu needed three sieges in the 1470s to take Bitlis and held it from 1467 to 1495, after which the Motikan retook the town.

The Ruzagi backed the Ottoman sultan Selim I and were rewarded with the title of Noble Khans, but in 1531 the Ottomans overran the emirate. In 1578 Murad III invested Sharaf al-Din Bitlisi as emir. The Ottomans ended its autonomy in 1655 and merged the emirate into the Van eyalet.
zh:
鲁扎吉人（又译罗贾基、鲁萨基）是一个库尔德部落联盟，世代出长比特利斯的埃米尔，比特利斯是亚美尼亚高地上的要塞城镇。他们的埃米尔国在12世纪末建立。

14世纪时，其埃米尔是黑羊王朝的附庸；1394年埃米尔向帖木儿臣服。白羊王朝在15世纪70年代连围三次才拿下比特利斯，统治时间为1467—1495年，此后莫蒂坎人收复该城。

鲁扎吉人支持奥斯曼苏丹塞利姆一世，受封为“高贵的汗”，但1531年奥斯曼征服埃米尔国。1578年，穆拉德三世册封沙拉夫丁·比特利西为埃米尔。1655年奥斯曼终结其自治地位，把埃米尔国并入凡城行省。

en:
The Sabuli house is that of Turak, son of Izz al-Din Mahmud, who led one of the two sections of the Siyuliyya Kurds of the Shahrazur country.

The Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari, writing in the 1340s, named the other section after its emir Dawud, known as Dawud Badran, and praised the tribe's two thousand men for their courage and fierce pride.
zh:
萨布利家族即伊兹丁·马哈茂德之子图拉克一系，他统领谢赫雷祖尔的西尤利亚库尔德人两支中的一支。

马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，另一支以其埃米尔达乌德为名，人称达乌德·巴德兰；他还称赞这个部落的两千人勇敢而有血性。

en:
The Sagae were a branch of the Oe clan and took their name from the Sagae estate in Dewa province. Oe no Hiromoto, first head of the Kamakura shogunate's Mandokoro, received the estate's jito post for the Oshu campaign of 1189; his son Chikahiro inherited it and retired there after the failed Jokyu rising of 1221.

In 1333 the clan fought for the Southern Court. Motomasa was killed in 1359 in war against the Shiba; in 1368 the disaster of Urushigawa cost sixty-one clansmen their lives. Peace in 1373 surrendered the northern half of the estate to Shiba Kaneyori, and the head took the name Sagae and built Sagae castle.

After their castle fell in 1574 they leaned on the Date, until Mogami Yoshiaki overran them in 1584 and the last lord Takamoto took his own life. Survivors served the Mogami and other daimyo.
zh:
寒河江氏出自大江氏，以出羽国的寒河江庄为名。镰仓幕府初代政所别当大江广元在1189年奥州合战后得到寒河江庄的地头职；其子亲广继承该庄，1221年承久之乱失败后归隐于此。

1333年，他们为南朝而战。元政在与斯波氏的交战中于1359年战死；1368年漆川之战惨败，一族六十一人阵亡。1373年议和后，寒河江庄北部划归斯波兼赖，当主开始自称“寒河江”，经营寒河江城。

1574年城池陷落后，他们转而依附伊达，1584年终被最上义光攻灭，末代当主高基自尽。遗族此后出仕最上氏，后来又转仕其他大名。

en:
The Sagara were a samurai house of Fujiwara descent through the Kudo lineage, named after the Sagara manor in Totomi Province. In 1193 the head Yorikage moved to Taragi in Higo, and in 1205 his son Nagayori became steward of Hitoyoshi, beginning the family's long rule in southern Higo.

They fought for the Kamakura shogunate in the Jokyu War of 1221, which their plum blossom crest is said to commemorate. During the Nanboku-cho wars the clan split between Taragi and Hitoyoshi; Sadayori's Hitoyoshi branch prevailed, and in 1448 Nagatsugu united Kuma, Yatsushiro and Ashikita.

Haruhiro issued the Sagara house laws in 1555. Pressed by the Shimazu, the Sagara submitted in 1581, and after Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign their holdings were reduced to Hitoyoshi, which they ruled throughout the Edo period.
zh:
相良氏出自藤原氏的工藤氏，因祖居远江国相良庄而得苗字。1193年当主赖景前往肥后多良木庄，1205年其子长赖被补任为人吉庄地头，开启家族在肥后南部的长期统治。

1221年承久之乱中他们为镰仓幕府作战，传说梅花家纹即为纪念此战而采用。南北朝内乱时家族分裂为多良木与人吉两支，人吉的定赖一系占了上风；1448年长续统一球磨、八代、苇北三郡。

晴广于1555年颁布《相良氏法度》。在岛津氏压力下，相良氏于1581年臣服；丰臣秀吉九州征伐后，领地被削减到人吉一地，江户时代相良氏历任人吉藩藩主。

en:
The Sahib Ataids were a short-lived beylik of central Anatolia founded by the sons of Fakhr al-Din Ali, better known as Sâhib Ata, grand vizier of the Seljuk Sultanate of Rûm. Released from Ilkhanid imprisonment in 1275, Sâhib Ata secured Afyonkarahisar as an estate for his sons Taceddin Hüseyin and Nusreddin Hasan, who ruled it jointly.

Both were killed in 1277 at the Battle of Değirmençay fighting the Karamanid Mehmed Bey and his puppet claimant Jimri. The line passed to Hasan's grandson Şemseddin Mehmed and then to Nusreddin Ahmed, who took refuge with the Germiyanids when the Ilkhanid governor Timurtaş moved against the frontier beys.

After Timurtaş fled to Egypt in 1327 Ahmed returned to rule as a Germiyanid vassal. On his death around 1341 the beylik was absorbed by the Germiyanids. Sâhib Ata left mosques and madrasas from Konya to Sivas.
zh:
沙希布·阿塔家族在安纳托利亚中部建立了短命的贝伊国，创建者是鲁姆塞尔柱大维齐尔法赫尔丁·阿里（通称沙希布·阿塔）的儿子们。1275年沙希布·阿塔获释后，为儿子塔吉丁·侯赛因和努斯雷丁·哈桑求得阿夫永卡拉希萨尔为封地，由兄弟共治。

1277年，两人在代伊尔门恰伊战役中迎战卡拉曼的穆罕默德贝伊及其傀儡吉姆里，双双战死，家业先后传给哈桑之孙沙姆斯丁·穆罕默德和努斯雷丁·艾哈迈德。伊儿汗国总督帖木儿塔什出兵征讨边疆贝伊时，艾哈迈德投奔格尔米扬。

1327年帖木儿塔什逃往埃及后，艾哈迈德返乡，以格尔米扬附庸的身份统治。他约于1341年去世后，贝伊国被格尔米扬吞并。沙希布·阿塔在科尼亚和锡瓦斯等地留下了清真寺与经院。

en:
The House of Salm was a Lotharingian noble family, possibly descended from Count Palatine Wigeric and the House of Ardenne–Luxembourg. Giselbert left Salm to his younger son Hermann, elected German anti-king against Henry IV in 1081. In 1163 Henry II kept Upper Salm in the Vosges, while his sister Elizabeth and her husband Frederick II of Vianden founded Lower Salm in the Ardennes.

Lower Salm died out in 1416 and passed to the Lords of Reifferscheid. The Rhinegraves inherited half of Upper Salm in 1475; the rest of Upper Salm went to Lorraine in 1600. The Rhinegraves took the Salm name and became imperial princes in 1623. Nicholas of Salm commanded the defence of Vienna against the Ottomans in 1529.

In 1803 the princes received former Münster lands around Borken and Anholt. Their principality was annexed by France in 1810 and mediatised to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
萨尔姆家族是洛塔林吉亚的贵族世家，可能出自洛塔林吉亚行宫伯爵维格里希与阿登—卢森堡家族。吉塞尔贝特把萨尔姆伯国传给幼子赫尔曼，后者于1081年被推举为对立国王，与亨利四世抗衡。1163年，亨利二世保有孚日山脉中的上萨尔姆，其妹伊丽莎白与丈夫维安登伯爵腓特烈二世在阿登开创下萨尔姆支系。

下萨尔姆支系于1416年绝嗣，领地由赖弗沙伊德领主继承。莱茵伯爵于1475年继承上萨尔姆的一半，上萨尔姆的其余部分于1600年归洛林。莱茵伯爵沿用萨尔姆之名，1623年升为帝国亲王。尼古拉·冯·萨尔姆于1529年指挥维也纳抵御奥斯曼人。

1803年诸亲王获得明斯特在博尔肯和安霍尔特一带的旧地。其亲王国于1810年被法国吞并，1815年被陪隶给普鲁士。

en:
The Sambuvarayas were Tamil chieftains of the Vanniyar community who held Tondai Nadu around Kanchipuram, with their hill capital at Padaiveedu. Under the imperial Cholas they governed Oyma Nadu as vassals. As Chola, Pandya and Hoysala power crumbled in the early fourteenth century, the family struck out on its own: Venrumankonda Sambuvaraya in 1322 and Rajanarayana Sambuvaraya in 1337 dated their inscriptions by their own regnal years.

Rajanarayana allied with the first Vijayanagara kings against the Madurai Sultanate. Around 1350 Vijayanagara armies defeated him and reinstated him as a tributary. After his death about 1362 Kumara Kampana annexed Tondai Nadu, storming the fortress of Rajagambhiranmalai above Padaiveedu and slaying the last Sambuvaraya ruler.
zh:
三补缚罗耶尔是万尼耶尔社群的泰米尔首领家族，占据甘吉布勒姆一带的通代纳德，以山城波多毗都为都。朱罗帝国时期，他们作为附庸治理奥伊马纳德。14世纪初朱罗、潘地亚和曷萨拉相继瓦解，该家族自立：文鲁曼孔达·三补缚罗耶于1322年、拉贾纳拉亚纳·三补缚罗耶于1337年开始用自己的王号纪年。

拉贾纳拉亚纳曾与毗奢耶那伽罗初代君主结盟，共战马杜赖苏丹国。约1350年，毗奢耶那伽罗军队击败他，将他降为纳贡附庸。约1362年他死后，库马拉·坎帕纳吞并通代纳德，攻破波多毗都上方的罗阇甘比兰马莱堡垒，杀死末代三补缚罗耶尔首领。

en:
The Samma dynasty ruled Sindh from Samanagar, later Thatta. The Sammas were a pastoral Sindhi tribe counted among the Jats, whose chiefs converted to Islam. The traveller Ibn Battuta witnessed their revolt under Jam Tamachi in 1333; after overthrowing the Soomra, the Samma chief Jam Unar founded an independent sultanate in 1351. Its rulers took the title Jam, meaning king, and claimed descent from the legendary Jamshid.

Firuz Shah Tughlaq's campaigns in 1365 and 1367 briefly forced them under Delhi. The sultanate regained independence and reached its height under Jam Nizamuddin II, known as Jam Nindho, who reigned from 1461 to 1508. His vizier Darya Khan defeated an Arghun invasion near Sibi, and the Makli necropolis at Thatta took shape.

A succession war followed Nizamuddin's death. In 1519 Shah Beg Arghun defeated the last Jam, Feruz, at Fatehpur and replaced Samma rule with his dynasty.
zh:
萨姆玛王朝统治信德，都城在萨马纳加尔，即后来的特达。萨姆玛人本是信德的游牧部落，被归入贾特人一类，其首领后来改宗伊斯兰教。旅行家伊本·白图泰在1333年亲眼见到他们在贾姆·塔马奇率领下反叛；推翻苏姆拉统治后，萨姆玛首领贾姆·乌纳尔于1351年建立独立苏丹国。其君主使用意为“王”的贾姆头衔，并自称传说中贾姆希德的后裔。

1365和1367年菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克的征讨一度迫使他们臣服德里。苏丹国后来恢复独立，在贾姆·尼扎姆丁二世（绰号贾姆·宁多，1461—1508年在位）时达到鼎盛。他的维齐尔达里亚汗在锡比附近击败阿尔衮人的入侵，特达的马克利墓葬群也在此时成形。

尼扎姆丁死后爆发继承战争。1519年沙贝格·阿尔浑在法塔赫布尔击败末代贾姆菲鲁兹，以阿尔衮王朝取代了萨姆玛王朝。

en:
The Sangama was the first dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire, named after Bhavana Sangama, a chieftain claiming Yadava descent whose sons Harihara I and Bukka Raya I founded the empire in 1336. Muhammad bin Tughluq carried the brothers to Delhi in 1327 and forced them to convert to Islam; sent south, they broke away, returned to Hinduism under Vidyaranya and built their City of Victory on the Tungabhadra.

Harihara I absorbed the Hoysala lands after Veera Ballala III's death in 1343. Bukka Raya I fought the Bahmani Sultanate for the Raichur Doab while declaring equal protection for Hindus, Jains, Christians and Muslims.

Under Deva Raya II from 1424 to 1446, the empire reached its height, stretching from Ceylon to Gulbarga, and its court was rich in Kannada and Telugu poetry. In 1485 the general Saluva Narasimha deposed the last Sangama king, Praudha Raya, opening the Saluva dynasty.
zh:
桑迦摩王朝是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的首个王朝，得名于巴瓦纳·桑迦摩，一位自称亚达瓦后裔的酋长，其子诃里诃罗一世与布卡·拉惹一世于1336年建立帝国。1327年兄弟二人被穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克掳往德里并被迫改宗伊斯兰教；后来他们被派回南方，随即脱离德里，在维迪亚兰雅引导下重归印度教，在通加巴德拉河畔建起“胜利之城”。

1343年曷萨拉国王维拉·巴拉拉三世死后，诃里诃罗一世吞并其疆土。布卡·拉惹一世为争夺赖丘尔河间地与巴赫曼尼苏丹国交战，同时宣布对印度教徒、耆那教徒、基督徒和穆斯林一体保护。

1424—1446年德瓦·拉亚二世在位时王朝达到鼎盛，版图从锡兰延伸至古尔伯加，宫廷的卡纳达语与泰卢固语诗歌盛极一时。1485年将领萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈废黜末代桑迦摩国王普劳达·拉亚，开启萨卢瓦王朝。

en:
The Sanudo were a Venetian noble family, recorded from the eleventh century, whose most famous branch ruled Aegean islands. After the Fourth Crusade, Marco I Sanudo, nephew of Doge Enrico Dandolo, conquered Naxos with eight galleys in 1207 and subdued most of the Cyclades, founding the Duchy of the Archipelago.

His descendants ruled as vassals of the Latin Empire, the princes of Achaea and the Angevin kings of Naples, losing smaller islands to Byzantine reconquest in the late 1200s. The direct line ended with Duchess Florence in 1371; her successor was overthrown in 1383 by Francesco I Crispo, whose family held the duchy until the Ottoman conquest.

Other branches remained in Venice, producing the geographer and crusading publicist Marino Sanudo Torsello and Marino Sanudo the Younger, whose diaries record Venetian history around 1500.
zh:
萨努多是11世纪已有记载的威尼斯贵族家族，其一支统治爱琴海岛屿。第四次十字军东征后，总督恩里科·丹多洛的外甥马可一世·萨努多于1207年率八艘桨帆船攻克纳克索斯，征服基克拉泽斯群岛大部，建立群岛公国。

其后裔先后臣属拉丁帝国、亚该亚亲王和安茹王朝的那不勒斯国王；13世纪末拜占庭反攻，公国丧失不少小岛。女公爵佛罗伦萨于1371年去世，嫡系断绝；继业者于1383年被弗朗切斯科一世·克里斯波推翻，克里斯波家族统治公国直到奥斯曼征服。

其他支系留在威尼斯，出了地理学家、十字军宣传者马里诺·萨努多·托尔塞洛，以及以日记记载1500年前后威尼斯历史的“小马里诺·萨努多”。

en: The Saqiyya house is that of Shuja al-Din Babakr, emir of the Saqiyya Kurds of Daquq near Kirkuk. The Mamluk scholar Ibn Fadlallah al-Umari, writing in the 1340s, described him as a defender of his faith who fought for his own party, at the head of a tribe of more than seven hundred men.
zh: 萨基亚家族即舒贾丁·巴伯克尔一系，他是基尔库克附近达古格一带萨基亚库尔德人的埃米尔。马穆鲁克学者伊本·法德拉拉·欧麦里在1340年代记载，他“捍卫自己的宗教，为本派而战”，统领一个七百余人的部落。

en:
The Saruhanids were a Turkmen beylik of western Anatolia around Manisa. Its founder Saruhan Bey, an emir of uncertain Oghuz or Kipchak origin who served the Seljuk sultans, was sent against Byzantine Manisa. He weathered the Alan mercenaries of the emperor's son Michael and the Catalan Company before taking the city in 1313 and making it his capital.

Saruhan built a fleet, raided the Aegean with the Aydınids and joined Umur Bey's expeditions to Thrace. His son Süleyman died there in 1345, and Saruhan followed the next year. His successors İlyas Bey and İshak Bey maintained the principality.

After the Battle of Kosovo in 1389 the Saruhanids sided with the Karamanids against the Ottomans, and Bayezid I overran the beylik in 1390. Timur restored it after the Battle of Ankara in 1402, but Mehmed I extinguished the line in 1412 and made Saruhan an Ottoman province.
zh:
萨鲁汗奥乌拉勒家族是西安纳托利亚马尼萨一带的土库曼贝伊国。开国者萨鲁汗贝伊的族源尚无定论，有乌古斯或钦察两种说法；他曾效力塞尔柱苏丹，受命进攻拜占庭城市马尼萨。他顶住了皇帝之子米海尔的阿兰佣兵和加泰罗尼亚佣兵团，最终于1313年攻克该城并定为都城。

萨鲁汗建立舰队，与艾登人一道袭掠爱琴海，还随乌穆尔贝伊远征色雷斯。其子苏莱曼于1345年死在那里，萨鲁汗也在次年去世。后继的伊利亚斯贝伊和伊沙克贝伊维持着公国。

1389年科索沃战役后，萨鲁汗人站在卡拉曼一边对抗奥斯曼，巴耶济德一世于1390年攻灭该贝伊国。1402年安卡拉战役后帖木儿将其复国，但穆罕默德一世在1412年终结了该世系，把萨鲁汗改为奥斯曼行省。

en:
The Satake were a samurai clan of Hitachi Province who claimed descent from the Minamoto: their founder Satake Masayoshi was a grandson of Minamoto no Yoshimitsu and settled at Satake village. During the Genpei War his son Takayoshi backed the Taira, so the clan was crushed by Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1180 and readmitted to his service nine years later under Takayoshi's son Hideyoshi.

The Satake heads served as hereditary shugo of Hitachi. During the Sengoku wars Yoshishige, nicknamed Oni Yoshishige for his ferocity, checked the Later Hōjō at Numajiri.

His son Yoshinobu submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 and was confirmed as lord of most of Hitachi. Having sided with the Western Army at Sekigahara in 1600, the clan was transferred in 1602 to the smaller Kubota Domain in Dewa, where it ruled throughout the Edo period.
zh:
佐竹氏是常陆国的武家，自称源氏后裔：始祖佐竹昌义是源义光之孙，定居于佐竹乡。源平合战时，昌义之子隆义站在平氏一方，1180年被源赖朝击败，直到九年后隆义之子秀义才获赦免，成为赖朝的御家人。

佐竹当主世袭常陆国守护。战国时代，以勇猛著称、绰号“鬼义重”的佐竹义重在沼尻阻击后北条氏。

其子义宣于1590年小田原征伐时归顺丰臣秀吉，获封常陆国大部分领地。1600年关原之战中佐竹加入西军，1602年被转封到出羽国领地较小的久保田藩，此后整个江户时代皆统治该地。

en:
The House of Savoy was founded around 1003 in the Alpine county of Sabaudia, then part of the Kingdom of Burgundy, by Humbert I, called Biancamano. Its rise began when Humbert's son Otto married Adelaide, heiress of Turin and Susa, in the mid-eleventh century, bringing Turin and western Piedmont to the family. From Chambéry and Chillon the counts held the key Alpine passes and enlarged their lands.

Count Aymon ruled in 1337, and in 1416 Amadeus VIII was made Duke of Savoy by the Holy Roman Emperor. French armies overran most of the duchy in 1536, but Emmanuel Philibert, serving the Habsburgs, won Saint-Quentin in 1557 and recovered his lands under the Peace of Cateau-Cambrésis in 1559, moving the capital from Chambéry to Turin in 1563.

Victor Amadeus II gained the Kingdom of Sicily in 1713 and exchanged it in 1720 for the Kingdom of Sardinia, ruling thereafter as Piedmont-Sardinia, to which Genoa was added in 1815.
zh:
萨伏依王朝于1003年前后由绰号白手的亨伯特一世在阿尔卑斯山区的萨包迪亚伯国创立，当时这里属勃艮第王国。家族崛起得益于联姻：11世纪中叶亨伯特之子奥托娶都灵与苏萨女继承人阿德莱德，把都灵和皮埃蒙特西部纳入版图。历代伯爵以尚贝里、希永城堡为据点控制阿尔卑斯关键山口，逐步扩张。

1337年在位的是艾蒙伯爵；1416年阿梅迪奥八世被神圣罗马帝国皇帝册封为萨伏依公爵。1536年法军占领公国大部，但效力哈布斯堡的埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托1557年取得圣康坦战役胜利，1559年依《卡托-康布雷西和约》收复故土，1563年把首都从尚贝里迁至都灵。

维托里奥·阿梅迪奥二世1713年获得西西里王国，1720年以西西里换取撒丁王国，此后以皮埃蒙特-撒丁王国名义统治，1815年热那亚并入其领地。

en:
The Sayfawa were the royal line of Kanem–Bornu around Lake Chad, ruling as mai from the eleventh to the nineteenth century. The royal chronicle, the girgam, began the line with the twelfth mai, Hummay; later tradition traced it to the Himyarite prince Sayf ibn Dhi Yazan.

Under Dunama II Dibalemi, who reigned from about 1221 to 1259, Kanem reached its height. He built a cavalry force, controlled the Fezzan and trans-Saharan trade, and drew the empire deeper into Islam. Wars with the Bilala drove the court into Bornu, where Ali I Gaji founded Ngazargamu; Idris III Katagarmabe later reconquered Kanem.

Idris Alooma, reigning from 1571 to 1603, made Bornu a power through firearms, mosques and Islamic law. The Fula jihads broke the empire in the early nineteenth century; the last mai was overthrown, leaving power to the al-Kanemi family.
zh:
赛法瓦王朝是乍得湖流域加涅姆-博尔努帝国的王室，自11世纪统治至19世纪，历代君主称“麦”。据王室编年史《吉尔加姆》记载，该世系始于第十二代麦胡马伊；后世传说又把其谱系接到希木叶尔王子塞夫·伊本·迪·雅赞身上。

在约1221—1259年在位的杜纳马二世·迪巴拉米治下，加涅姆达到鼎盛。他组建骑兵，控制费赞及跨撒哈拉商路，并推动帝国进一步伊斯兰化。与比拉拉人的战争迫使朝廷迁往博尔努；阿里一世·加吉在那里兴建纳札加姆，后来伊德里斯三世·卡塔加马贝又收复了加涅姆。

1571—1603年在位的伊德里斯·阿劳马凭借火器、清真寺和伊斯兰教法，使博尔努成为强国。19世纪初的富拉尼圣战摧毁了帝国，末代麦被废，权力落入卡内米家族手中。

en:
The first counts of Sayn, named after Sayn Castle near Bendorf, appear in documents from 1139 and built up estates across the Westerwald and Lower Rhine. In 1233 Count Henry was accused of devil-worship by the inquisitor Conrad of Marburg before bishops at Mainz acquitted him; Conrad was killed on his journey back to Thuringia.

When Henry died without male heirs in 1246, the county passed through his sister Adelheid to the Sponheim family. Her grandson Gottfried I founded the second house in 1266. In 1294 his sons divided the lands between Sayn-Sayn and Sayn-Homburg, the latter inheriting Wittgenstein and calling itself Sayn-Wittgenstein from 1361.

A feud with Katzenelnbogen ravaged the county in 1462, and around 1560 the counts introduced the Reformation. Sayn-Sayn died out in 1608 and its inheritance passed to Sayn-Wittgenstein; after the Thirty Years' War the county split into Sayn-Altenkirchen and Sayn-Hachenburg.
zh:
第一代塞恩伯爵得名于本多夫附近的塞恩城堡，1139年起见于文献，逐步在韦斯特林山和下莱茵积聚领地。1233年，亨利伯爵被宗教裁判官康拉德·冯·马尔堡指控崇拜魔鬼，美因茨的主教判他无罪，康拉德则在返回图林根途中被杀。
