1246年亨利无男嗣而终，伯国经其姐阿德尔海德转入施蓬海姆家族。她的孙子戈特弗里德一世于1266年开创第二个塞恩伯爵世家。1294年他的儿子们将领地分为塞恩-塞恩和塞恩-洪堡两支，后者继承维特根施泰因，自1361年起改称塞恩-维特根施泰因。

1462年伯国遭卡岑埃尔恩博根家族的仇杀兵祸，约1560年伯爵们推行宗教改革。1608年塞恩-塞恩支绝嗣，遗产落入塞恩-维特根施泰因之手；三十年战争后伯国又分为塞恩-阿尔滕基兴与塞恩-哈亨堡。

en:
The della Scala, the Scaligeri, ruled Verona as signori from 1259, when Mastino I turned his podestà office into family rule, until 1387. Cangrande I, ruling from 1308, was its greatest prince: a Ghibelline soldier who added Vicenza, Padua and Treviso and patronised Dante, Petrarch and Giotto.

His nephew Mastino II bought Parma and Lucca and made Verona for a time northern Italy's strongest power, until a rival league defeated him in 1337—1340, leaving him only Verona and Vicenza. Later feuds were fratricidal: Cansignorio murdered Cangrande II in 1359, and Antonio killed his brother before Gian Galeazzo Visconti drove him from Verona in 1387.

Guglielmo della Scala's brief 1404 restoration ended with his death after ten days, and Verona passed to Venice in 1405. The family's Gothic tombs still stand beside Santa Maria Antica in Verona, while two celebrated humanist scholars, Julius Caesar and Joseph Justus Scaliger, claimed, probably falsely, to descend from the house.
zh:
德拉·斯卡拉家族（拉丁文献称斯卡拉杰里）自1259年起任维罗纳领主，马斯蒂诺一世把市政长官之职变成世袭僭主统治，直到1387年覆亡。1308年起执政的坎格兰德一世是家族最杰出的君主：吉伯林派军事领袖，先后将维琴察、帕多瓦和特雷维索并入斯卡拉领地，并庇护但丁、彼特拉克和乔托。

其侄马斯蒂诺二世买下帕尔马和卢卡，一度使维罗纳成为北意大利最强势力，但诸邦联盟在1337—1340年的战争中将其击败，领地被削回维罗纳和维琴察。后期家族内讧、兄弟相残：坎西尼奥里奥1359年谋害坎格兰德二世，安东尼奥又杀死亲弟，1387年被吉安·加莱亚佐·维斯孔蒂逐走。

1404年古列尔莫一度复辟，却在十天后死去，维罗纳1405年并入威尼斯共和国。家族在维罗纳古圣玛丽亚教堂旁留下一组哥特式陵墓；著名人文主义学者尤利乌斯·凯撒·斯卡利杰和约瑟夫·尤斯图斯·斯卡利杰自称出自该家族，但这一血缘说法并不可靠。

en:
The House of Scarponnois was a Lotharingian noble dynasty named after the Scarponnois, its homeland in what is now the French department of Meurthe-et-Moselle; its branches ruled the counties of Ferrette, Lutzelbourg and Montbeliard and the County, later Duchy, of Bar. The first attested member was Richwin, count in the Scarponnois, who married Hildegard of Egisheim, sister of Pope Leo IX. His son Louis of Mousson, castellan of Montbeliard, Altkirch and Ferrette, married Sophia of Bar in 1038 and inherited Bar, Amance and Sarreguemines, making his house one of the greatest in Lotharingia. Louis's son Dietrich I married the heiress of Montbeliard, and a partition between his three sons split the lands into Ferrette under Frederick I, Bar under Rainald I and Montbeliard under Dietrich II; the Montbeliard line died out in 1148 and passed to the House of Montfaucon.

The Ferrette branch ended when Count Ulrich III died without sons in March 1324. His daughter Joanna, countess in her own right, married Duke Albert II of Austria in Vienna on 26 March 1324 and carried the Sundgau lands, including Belfort, to the Habsburgs; she died in 1351 and her sister Ursula in 1367. The Bar branch, raised to a duchy in 1354, lost its duke Edward and other princes at Agincourt in 1415; Cardinal Louis of Bar then transferred the duchy to Rene of Anjou by the Treaty of Saint-Mihiel in 1419, and with the death of Johanna of Marle in 1462 the entire dynasty became extinct.
zh:
斯卡波努瓦家族是洛塔林吉亚的贵族王朝，得名于其故乡斯卡波努瓦（在今法国默尔特-摩泽尔省境内），家族各支先后统治费雷特、吕策尔堡、蒙贝利亚尔等伯爵国以及后来升为公国的巴尔伯国。可考的最早成员是斯卡波努瓦伯爵里希温，他娶了教宗利奥九世的姊妹埃吉斯海姆的希尔德加德。其子穆松的路易担任蒙贝利亚尔、阿尔特基什和费雷特的城主，1038年娶巴尔的索菲娅为妻并继承巴尔、阿芒斯和萨尔格米讷，使家族跻身洛塔林吉亚最显赫的门第之列。路易之子迪特里希一世娶蒙贝利亚尔女继承人为妻，后来他的三个儿子分家：腓特烈一世得费雷特，雷纳德一世得巴尔，迪特里希二世得蒙贝利亚尔；蒙贝利亚尔支系于1148年绝嗣，领地转入蒙福孔家族。

费雷特支系终结于1324年3月：伯爵乌尔里希三世无子而终，其女约翰娜以女继承人身份成为费雷特有爵女，1324年3月26日在维也纳嫁给奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特二世，把包括贝尔福在内的松德高领地带入哈布斯堡家族；她于1351年去世，其妹乌尔苏拉逝于1367年。巴尔支系于1354年升为公国，1415年公爵爱德华等宗族王公在阿金库尔战役中阵亡；枢机主教巴尔的路易遂于1419年依《圣米耶勒条约》把公国传给安茹的勒内。1462年马尔勒的约翰娜去世，整个王朝最终绝嗣。

en:
The Schauenburg were named for Schauenburg Castle on the Weser, built or enlarged by Adolf I around 1100. In 1110 Duke Lothair of Saxony enfeoffed him with Holstein and Stormarn, including Hamburg, making the family dominant between the Elbe and Denmark. Adolf II rebuilt Segeberg's Siegesburg, founded Lübeck in 1143 and settled colonists in Slavic lands.

Adolf III lost Holstein at Stellau in 1201; Adolf IV recovered it at Bornhöved in 1227 and took the title count of Holstein. The house split from 1261; several counts ruled in 1337 while the ancestral county stayed with Pinneberg. Gerhard III of Rendsburg defeated Christopher II in 1326, set his nephew Waldemar III on the Danish throne and was regent until killed in 1340; his line held Schleswig from 1375.

The Rendsburg line died out in 1459; in 1460 the nobility elected Christian I of Denmark. The Pinneberg line introduced the Reformation in 1559 and ended with childless Otto V in 1640; Schaumburg passed to Hesse-Cassel and its neighbours.
zh:
绍恩堡家族得名于威悉河上的绍恩堡城堡，约1100年由阿道夫一世修建或扩建。1110年萨克森公爵洛塔尔把荷尔斯泰因和施托尔曼（含汉堡）封给阿道夫一世，家族成为易北河与丹麦边境之间的头号势力。阿道夫二世重修塞格贝格的胜利堡，1143年建立吕贝克，并招徕移民开垦斯拉夫人的土地。

阿道夫三世1201年施特劳战败丢掉荷尔斯泰因，阿道夫四世1227年博恩赫沃德一战将其收复，称荷尔斯泰因伯爵。1261年起家族分裂为数支，1337年数位伯爵同时在位，祖传伯国随平讷贝格传承。伦茨堡的格哈德三世1326年击败丹麦国王克里斯托弗二世，扶外甥瓦尔德马尔三世登丹麦王位，以摄政统治丹麦，1340年被杀；其支系1375年起领有石勒苏益格。

1459年伦茨堡一支绝嗣，荷尔斯泰因贵族1460年推举丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世。平讷贝格一支1559年推行宗教改革，1640年奥托五世无嗣而终，伯国被黑森-卡塞尔等邻邦瓜分。

en:
The lords of Schlüsselberg were a high-noble Franconian family who from 1219 took the name of Burg Schlüsselberg near Waischenfeld. Eberhard I had the castle built after 1216 on the border of the Bamberg bishopric to secure the road from Waischenfeld to Pottenstein. His house assembled a lordship in the Franconian Jura, rivaling the prince-bishops of Bamberg.

Eberhard II founded Schlüsselau Abbey in 1280 with his son Conrad I. Another son, Ulrich, was elected bishop of Bamberg in 1318 though never installed and became bishop of Brixen in 1322.

Conrad II brought the family's territory to its height and founded Schlüsselfeld in 1336. He was mortally wounded at the siege of Burg Neideck in 1347, and the male line died out. The Treaty of Iphofen in 1349 divided the lands among the victors, with the chief shares going to the Nuremberg burgraves and the bishopric of Bamberg.
zh:
施吕塞尔贝格领主是法兰克尼亚的高级贵族，1219年起以魏申费尔德附近的施吕塞尔贝格堡为家族名。埃伯哈德一世于1216年后在班贝格主教区边境修建该堡，以护卫魏申费尔德至波滕施泰因的道路。家族在弗兰肯汝拉山区建起领地，成为班贝格亲王主教的竞争对手。

埃伯哈德二世于1280年与儿子康拉德一世共同创立施吕瑟尔奥修道院。另一个儿子乌尔里希1318年被选为班贝格主教但未获就任，1322年改任布里克森主教。

康拉德二世把家族领地扩张到极盛，并于1336年创建施吕瑟尔费尔德城。1347年他在围攻奈德克堡时受致命伤，男系随之绝嗣。1349年的《伊普霍芬条约》把领地分给战胜方，主要份额归纽伦堡城堡伯爵和班贝格主教区。

en:
The lords of Schönburg were a noble house of southwestern Saxony, first documented in 1130 with Ulricus de Schunenberg. Around 1170 they built a castle at Glauchau as an imperial fief and acquired the town in 1256; it remained the seat of their Glauchau line.

They later acquired Waldenburg in 1378, Hartenstein in 1406 and Penig and Wechselburg in 1543, holding lands across Saxony, Bohemia and Thuringia under direct imperial jurisdiction. The lordship split into Upper and Lower Schönburg in 1569, and in 1700 the house became imperial counts.

From 1740 Saxony took the estates under its guardianship and integrated them into its judicial structure. The Waldenburg and Hartenstein branches became princely houses in 1790; mediatised to Saxony in 1803 and 1806, the family received two seats in the Upper House of Saxony in 1831.
zh:
舍恩堡领主是萨克森西南部的贵族世家，1130年以乌尔里库斯·德·顺嫩贝格之名见诸文献。约1170年，他们在格劳豪修建帝国采邑城堡，1256年取得该城；格劳豪此后成为同名支系驻地。

家族于1378年取得瓦尔登堡、1406年取得哈滕施泰因、1543年取得佩尼希和韦克瑟尔堡，领地横跨萨克森、波希米亚和图林根，直属帝国司法管辖。1569年领地分为上、下舍恩堡，1700年家族升为帝国伯爵。

1740年起，萨克森对领地实行监护并将其纳入司法体系。1790年瓦尔登堡和哈滕施泰因两支升为亲王家族；1803和1806年家族被陪隶给萨克森，1831年在萨克森上院获得两个席位。

en:
The House of Schwarzburg was a high noble family of Thuringia, named after Schwarzburg Castle in the Schwarza valley, first recorded in 1071. Its first reliably documented member was Count Sizzo III of Kafernburg, who founded Georgenthal Abbey around 1142 and accompanied Emperor Frederick Barbarossa on his Polish campaign of 1157.

In 1197 Henry II and Gunther III divided the lands, and Schwarzburg Castle and Blankenburg became the family seat. Gunther XXI was elected German king in 1349, only to renounce the crown and die soon afterwards. Repeated partitions followed until Gunther XL the Rich reunited the family lands in 1538.

The Treaty of Stadtilm in 1599 fixed the Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt and Schwarzburg-Sondershausen lines. Sondershausen became a principality in 1697 and Rudolstadt in 1711. Both escaped mediatisation in 1806, joined the Confederation of the Rhine and entered the German Confederation in 1815.
zh:
施瓦茨堡家族是图林根的高级贵族世家，得名于施瓦察河谷中的施瓦茨堡城堡，该城堡1071年始见文献。家族第一位可确考的成员是凯弗恩堡伯爵西佐三世，他约于1142年创建格奥尔根塔尔修道院，并在1157年随皇帝腓特烈一世（巴巴罗萨）出征波兰。

1197年，亨利二世与金特三世瓜分领地，施瓦茨堡城堡和布兰肯堡成为家族驻地。金特二十一世于1349年被推举为德意志国王，却放弃王位，不久便去世。此后领地屡经分割，直到1538年金特四十世（富豪）重新统一家族土地。

1599年的《施塔特伊尔姆条约》确定了施瓦茨堡-鲁多尔施塔特和施瓦茨堡-松德斯豪森两支。松德斯豪森支于1697年升为侯国，鲁多尔施塔特支则于1711年升为侯国。两国都躲过了1806年的吞并，加入莱茵联邦，又于1815年加入德意志邦联。

en:
The counts of Schwerin originated in the Saxon conquest of Wendish lands beyond the Elbe. After Henry the Lion defeated the Obotrite prince Niklot and took Schwerin in 1160, he enfeoffed Gunzelin von Hagen, first documented as count in 1161. Wittenburg and Boizenburg were added as Danish fiefs in 1203, but King Valdemar II of Denmark expelled the counts in 1208 and ruled until they did homage in 1214.

In 1223 Count Henry the Black abducted Valdemar and his son from Lyoe. He defeated the Danish army at Moelln in 1225 and recovered the county by the Treaty of Bardowick; after Bornhoeved in 1227 it became a Saxon fief again.

A younger son, Nicholas, inherited Tecklenburg in 1328. The elder line died out in 1344 and the Wittenburg branch lost its male heirs in 1357; the county was sold to Mecklenburg, formalized by the Treaty of Plueschow in 1368.
zh:
什未林伯爵家族起源于萨克森人对易北河以外文德人土地的征服。1160年狮子亨利击败奥博特人王公尼克洛特、攻占什未林后，把此地封给贡策林·冯·哈根，后者于1161年首次以伯爵身份见于文献。1203年维滕堡与博伊岑堡作为丹麦封地并入，但丹麦国王瓦尔德马二世于1208年驱逐伯爵、统治伯国，直到1214年伯爵们宣誓效忠。

1223年黑人亨利伯爵在吕岛绑架瓦尔德马父子。他于1225年在默尔恩击败丹麦援军，并凭《巴尔多维克条约》收回伯国；1227年博恩赫沃德之战后，什未林重新成为萨克森封地。

家族的一位幼子尼古拉斯于1328年入继泰克伦堡伯国。1344年长支断绝，1357年维滕堡支又失去男嗣，伯国被出售给梅克伦堡，1368年的《普吕绍条约》正式确认了转让。

en:
Selimbau was the leading river kingdom of the upper Kapuas basin in West Kalimantan. Remembered locally as the oldest Hindu kingdom in the region with a fully formed court, it was first called Pelembang and founded by Bindu Mahkota, also known as Abang Bindu Mahkota, whose seat lay about two kilometres from the later town of Selimbau. Its rulers passed through twenty-five generations, beginning as Hindu rajas and later converting to Islam, and ranked above smaller neighbouring Malay chiefdoms.

In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Selimbau traded and fought along the Kapuas within the influence of the Sambas Sultanate, its power reaching upriver toward the Sarawak border. The Dutch recognised Selimbau's primacy over the upper Kapuas chiefdoms in an 1823 treaty.
zh:
塞林包是西加里曼丹上卡普阿斯河流域首屈一指的河畔王国，当地传统称它是当地最古老、建制完备的印度教王国。该国初名佩莱邦，由宾杜·马科塔（又称阿邦·宾杜·马科塔）创建，王址距后来的塞林包镇约两公里。其王统传了二十五代，初为印度教罗阇，后改宗伊斯兰教，地位高于邻近的马来小邦。

17—18世纪，塞林包在卡普阿斯河沿线征战贸易，处于三发苏丹国的势力影响之下，势力溯河延伸至砂拉越边界。1823年，荷兰殖民政府与塞林包缔约，承认它在上卡普阿斯诸小邦中的宗主地位。

en:
Al-e Saljuq, the House of Seljuq, took its name from Seljuk, a Turkic clan leader whose followers converted to Islam around the tenth century. A branch of the family founded the Sultanate of Rum after the Seljuk victory at Manzikert in 1071 and fixed its capital at Konya; under Kayqubad I in the early thirteenth century it was the leading power of Anatolia, lining the trade roads with caravanserais, mosques and medreses.

The Mongol victory at Köse Dağ in 1243 reduced the Rum sultans to Ilkhanid vassals, and Turkmen commanders carved independent beyliks out of their realm.

Kayqubad III was executed by the Ilkhan in 1302, and the last sultan, Mesud II, was murdered in 1308, bringing the Anatolian line of the house to an end; Konya and the other Seljuk lands were then divided among successor principalities.
zh:
塞尔柱家族得名于10世纪前后率部皈依伊斯兰教的突厥首领塞尔柱。1071年曼齐刻尔特战役获胜后，家族支系建立罗姆苏丹国并定都科尼亚；13世纪初凯库巴德一世在位时，它是安纳托利亚首屈一指的强国，商路沿线广建商队驿站、清真寺和经学院。

1243年克塞山败于蒙古后，罗姆苏丹沦为伊儿汗国的附庸，突厥首领们在其境内割据出独立的贝伊国。

凯库巴德三世于1302年被伊儿汗处死，末代苏丹梅苏德二世又在1308年遇害，家族在安纳托利亚的统绪就此断绝，科尼亚等塞尔柱故地随后被后继贝伊国瓜分。

en:
The Sen house supplied the rajas of the Punjab Hill state of Suket, with its capital at Pangna. Tradition traces the line to Bira Sen, said to descend from the Sena dynasty of Bengal, and every ruler took the surname Sen.

Suket's early centuries were spent in hill warfare, above all against neighbouring Kullu; Raja Bikram Sen forced Kullu to pay tribute, and Raja Madan Sen's reign was remembered as a golden age, when smaller neighbouring principalities submitted.

Under Raja Udai Sen, Suket acknowledged Mughal overlordship and paid tribute rather than accepting direct rule. The diplomacy of Raja Bikram Sen II carried the state through the Gurkha invasion of 1803 to 1815 and the following years of Sikh dominance with its ruling house intact.
zh:
森氏是旁遮普山丘邦苏凯特的罗阇世系，王都设在彭格纳。按传统说法，其世系可追溯到维拉·森，据称出自孟加拉的犀那王朝，历代统治者都以“森”为姓。

苏凯特早年不断卷入山地战事，尤以同邻国库鲁的战争为甚；罗阇比克拉姆·森迫使库鲁纳贡，罗阇马登·森在位时被视为黄金时代，邻近小邦纷纷臣服。

罗阇乌代·森时期，苏凯特承认莫卧儿宗主权，以纳贡换取免于被直接统治。罗阇比克拉姆·森二世凭借外交手腕，使本邦熬过1803—1815年的廓尔喀入侵和随后的锡克称霸岁月，统治家族得以保全。

en:
The Serra Bas, also called the De Serra-Bas or House of Bas, ruled the Judicate of Arborea, a Sardinian judge-kingdom with its capital at Oristano. The line emerged from the House of Cervera after the Treaty of Oristano of 1192, and judges such as Marianus II reunited the realm and briefly held most of Sardinia.

Hugh II allied with Aragon in the 1320s, but his son Marianus IV turned against the Aragonese and conquered almost the whole island. After Hugh III died without heirs in 1383, Marianus's daughter Eleanor became regent for her young sons, upheld the revolt and gave Arborea the Carta de Logu.

The dynasty's fortunes collapsed after the Aragonese victory at Sanluri in 1409 and the fall of Oristano in 1410. Alfonso V of Aragon bought out the rival Narbonne claim in 1420, opening the way to the conquest of Sardinia.
zh:
塞拉巴斯家族（又称德·塞拉-巴斯或巴斯家族）统治阿尔博雷阿，后者是撒丁岛的法官王国，以奥里斯塔诺为都。该支系出自塞尔维拉家族，在1192年《奥里斯塔诺条约》后掌权；马里亚诺二世等法官重新统一王国，一度据有撒丁岛大部。

乌戈二世在14世纪20年代与阿拉贡结盟，但其子马里亚诺四世转而反抗阿拉贡，几乎征服全岛。1383年乌戈三世无嗣而终后，马里亚诺之女埃莱奥诺拉代幼子摄政，坚持抵抗，并颁布《卡尔塔·德·洛古》法典。

1409年阿拉贡在圣卢里战役取胜，1410年奥里斯塔诺陷落，家族国运随之崩溃。1420年阿拉贡的阿方索五世买下纳博讷家族的继承权，为征服撒丁岛铺平了道路。

en:
The Shah house of Sonargaon was the Mubarak Shahi dynasty, founded by Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah, a Bengali Muslim from Noakhali who served Bahram Khan, the Delhi governor of Sonargaon. When Bahram Khan died in 1337, Fakhruddin seized the city and declared himself an independent sultan.

He defeated and executed Qadar Khan, governor of Lakhnauti, and took Comilla, Noakhali and Sylhet. In 1340 he became the first Muslim ruler to conquer Chittagong, Bengal's chief port. Ibn Battuta visited Sonargaon in 1346 and praised him for welcoming strangers and Sufis.

Fakhruddin died in 1349 and was succeeded by Ikhtiyaruddin Ghazi Shah, probably his son, who ruled until 1352. Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah then conquered Sonargaon and united Bengal under the Bengal Sultanate.
zh:
索纳尔冈的沙家族即穆巴拉克沙希王朝，开创者法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙是出身诺阿卡利的孟加拉穆斯林，曾侍奉德里任命的索纳尔冈总督巴赫拉姆汗。1337年巴赫拉姆汗死后，法赫尔丁夺取该城，自立为独立苏丹。

他击败并处死拉克瑙提总督卡达尔汗，随后攻取库米拉、诺阿卡利和锡尔赫特。1340年，他成为第一位征服孟加拉主要港口吉大港的穆斯林统治者。伊本·白图泰1346年到访索纳尔冈时，称赞他善待外来者和苏菲修士。

法赫尔丁于1349年去世，由很可能是其子的伊赫提亚鲁丁·加齐沙继位，后者统治到1352年。沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯沙随后攻克索纳尔冈，孟加拉统一于孟加拉苏丹国。

en:
The Shah gauda line was the short-lived sultanate of Alauddin Ali Shah, born Ali Mubarak into a Turco-Persian Muslim noble family. He moved to Bengal, where he became army administrator of Qadar Khan, the Delhi governor of Lakhnauti. When Qadar Khan was killed fighting Fakhruddin Mubarak Shah of Sonargaon, Ali Shah murdered the deputy governor left behind and, around 1339, made himself independent ruler of Lakhnauti.

Bengal was now split three ways, between Ali Shah at Gaur, Fakhruddin at Sonargaon and Shamsuddin Ilyas Shah at Satgaon. Ali Shah moved his capital from Lakhnauti to Hazrat Pandua.

In 1342 he was defeated and killed in battle against Ilyas Shah. Ilyas Shah went on to unite the whole of Bengal under the Bengal Sultanate.
zh:
沙·高达一脉是阿拉丁·阿里沙建立的短命苏丹国；他本名阿里·穆巴拉克，出身突厥—波斯风格的穆斯林贵族家庭。他前往孟加拉，担任德里任命的拉克瑙提总督卡达尔汗的军政官。卡达尔汗在与索纳尔冈的法赫尔丁·穆巴拉克沙交战中被杀后，阿里沙杀死留守的副总督，于1339年前后自立为拉克瑙提的独立君主。

此时孟加拉三分：阿里沙据高达，法赫尔丁据索纳尔冈，沙姆斯丁·伊利亚斯沙据萨特冈。阿里沙把首都从拉克瑙提迁往哈兹拉特·潘杜阿。

1342年他在与伊利亚斯沙的会战中兵败身亡。伊利亚斯沙随后统一整个孟加拉，建立孟加拉苏丹国。

en:
The Shah taraf house descended from Syed Nasiruddin, a Sufi and soldier born in Baghdad into a Syed family that claimed descent from the Twelve Imams. After the Mongols sacked Baghdad in 1258 he migrated to Delhi and then Bengal, joined the Suhrawardiyya order, and became army commander of the Sultan of Lakhnauti.

In 1303 he led troops alongside Shah Jalal in the conquest of Sylhet, overthrowing the Hindu raja Gour Govinda. In 1304 he took neighbouring Tungachal without a fight, renamed it Taraf and became its governor.

Buried at Murarband, where his tomb became a shrine, he left hereditary rulers who made Taraf a centre of Islamic learning. The Twipra kingdom later conquered it, followed by Khwaja Usman and the Mughals.
zh:
沙·塔拉夫家族出自赛义德·纳西尔丁；他是苏菲修士兼军人，生于巴格达的赛义德家族，自称是十二伊玛目的后裔。1258年蒙古人洗劫巴格达后，他先迁居德里，再转往孟加拉，加入苏赫拉瓦迪耶教团，后来成为拉克瑙提苏丹的军队统帅。

1303年，他与沙阿·贾拉勒并肩率军征服锡尔赫特，推翻印度教罗阇古尔·戈文达。1304年，他兵不血刃地攻取邻近的图恩加查尔，将其改名塔拉夫并出任总督。

他葬在穆拉尔班德，陵墓后来成为圣祠；其后人世代统治塔拉夫，把这里建成伊斯兰学术中心。塔拉夫后来被特维普拉王国征服，之后又先后落入赫瓦贾·乌斯曼和莫卧儿人之手。

en:
The Shiba were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house and traced their descent from the Seiwa-Genji, the Minamoto line of Emperor Seiwa. At the end of the thirteenth century Shiba Ieuji, son of Ashikaga Yasuuji, took the Shiba name, and the family held lands in Mutsu Province while inheriting the governorship of Owari.

Shiba Takatsune sided with Ashikaga Takauji against Emperor Go-Daigo in 1335 and was rewarded with the shugo governorships of Echizen and Wakasa when the Ashikaga shogunate was founded. His son Yoshimasa became kanrei, deputy to the shogun, in 1379.

Succession disputes weakened the house, and its feud with rivals helped spark the Ōnin War of 1467 to 1477, during which the Asakura seized Echizen. Reduced to figureheads in Owari, the last Shiba lord Yoshimune was killed by Oda Nobutomo in 1554, and the clan effectively ended with Yoshikane's death in 1572.
zh:
斯波氏是足利家的支流，自称出自清和天皇一脉的清和源氏。13世纪末，足利泰氏之子斯波家氏取斯波为苗字，家族在陆奥国拥有领地，同时世袭尾张国守护职。

1335年，斯波高经在对抗后醍醐天皇的战事中追随足利尊氏，室町幕府建立后受封越前、若狭两国守护。其子义将在1379年出任管领，即幕府将军的副手。

家族陷入继承纷争，与诸家的争斗成为1467—1477年应仁之乱的诱因之一，越前也在此期间被朝仓氏夺取。斯波家在尾张沦为傀儡，末代当主斯波义统于1554年被织田信友杀害，至1572年斯波义银死后，斯波氏实质上灭亡。

en:
The Shijō were a court noble house of Kyoto of the Northern Fujiwara. They took shape in the late Heian period around Fujiwara no Akisue; the house name came from the Shijō-Ōmiya mansion of his descendant Takasue.

Their hereditary craft was carving and serving at court banquets, known as the Shijō school, said to begin when Ienari displayed his skill with a carp before Emperor Sutoku in 1140. In the Nanboku-chō wars Takasuke died fighting for the Southern Court at Yawata. His son Takatoshi briefly seized Kyoto in 1353 and fell in battle in 1373.

The main line died out in 1567 and was revived in 1575 by a son of the Reizei house. After years of disfavour in Sakai he was pardoned in 1601 through Tokugawa Ieyasu, and the Shijō served the court through the Edo period.
zh:
四条家是京都的公家贵族，出自藤原北家。家族形成于平安后期，家祖为藤原显季；家名来自其后人隆季在四条大宫的宅邸。

四条家的家业是在宫廷飨宴上操刀切鱼的四条流料理，据说始于1140年家成在崇德天皇御前料理鲤鱼。南北朝战乱中，隆资为南朝战死于八幡之战，其子隆俊于1353年一度攻入京都，1373年亦战死。

嫡系于1567年断绝，1575年由冷泉家出身的子弟再兴家门。他长期获罪蛰居堺，1601年经德川家康奏请获赦；四条家在江户时代继续侍奉朝廷。

en:
The Shimazu were the warrior lords of southern Kyūshū. Their founder Tadahisa, said to be a son of Minamoto no Yoritomo though probably of Koremune descent, became steward of the Shimazu estate in 1185 and shugo of Satsuma, Ōsumi and Hyūga.

In 1333 the fifth head, Sadahisa, joined Emperor Go-Daigo's attack on the Chinzei tandai and later fought for Ashikaga Takauji. His division of the inheritance created rival lines, until the clan head Takahisa reunited Satsuma and Ōsumi. His son Yoshihisa nearly conquered Kyūshū, defeating the Ryūzōji in 1584; the Shimazu deployed disciplined arquebus volleys.

Toyotomi Hideyoshi checked them in 1587, but they surrendered in time to keep Satsuma, Ōsumi and part of Hyūga. After Sekigahara in 1600 they retained their domains as the Satsuma han, and in 1609 Tadatsune invaded the Ryūkyū Kingdom and made it a vassal.
zh:
岛津氏是南九州的武士霸主。始祖忠久传为源赖朝之子，但更可能出自惟宗氏；1185年他被任为岛津庄地头，以及萨摩、大隅、日向三国守护。

1333年，第五代当主贞久参加后醍醐天皇讨伐镇西探题的战事，后来又为足利尊氏作战。他分配领地后形成两支对立的家族，直到当主贵久重新统一萨摩、大隅。其子义久几乎平定九州，1584年击败龙造寺氏；岛津军以严整的铁炮齐射见长。

1587年岛津军在丰臣秀吉的九州征伐中受挫，但他们及时投降，得以保住萨摩、大隅和日向的一部分。1600年关原之战后，岛津氏保全领地，成为萨摩藩；1609年忠恒出兵琉球，使琉球王国沦为附庸。

en:
The Shishman were a medieval Bulgarian dynasty of Cuman origin, descended from Shishman, a boyar who held Vidin as a despot from perhaps the 1270s. He acknowledged Golden Horde suzerainty in 1291 and, after an unsuccessful war against Serbia the next year, ruled Vidin as a Serbian vassal.

His son Michael Shishman, despot of Vidin, was elected tsar by the Bulgarian nobility in 1323 and ruled as Michael Asen III. His wars against Byzantium and Serbia ended in defeat at the Battle of Velbazhd in 1330, where he was mortally wounded.

His son Ivan Stephen held the throne only until 1331, when the nobility raised up Ivan Alexander, whose Sratsimir house descended from the Shishmanids through the female line; Michael's half-brother Belaur meanwhile kept Vidin as its despot.
zh:
希什曼王朝是中世纪保加利亚的库曼裔王朝，先祖希什曼是一名波雅尔贵族，可能从13世纪70年代起就以专制公身份据守维丁。他于1291年承认金帐汗国的宗主权，次年对塞尔维亚作战失利后，又作为塞尔维亚的附庸统治维丁。

其子米哈伊尔·希什曼本是维丁专制公，1323年被保加利亚贵族推举为沙皇，称米哈伊尔·阿森三世。他与拜占庭和塞尔维亚连年开战，最终在1330年的维尔巴日德战役中兵败重伤而死。

他的儿子伊凡·斯特凡在位仅到1331年，贵族便拥立伊凡·亚历山大即位，后者出身的斯拉齐米尔家族正是希什曼家族的女性后裔；与此同时，米哈伊尔的异母弟贝劳尔仍以专制公身份保有维丁。

en:
The Shō began as a warrior band of Musashi Province and a leading house of the Kodama party. Kodama Iehiro settled at Kurisaki and took the name Shō. His son Ienaga captured Taira no Shigehira at Ichinotani in 1184 and received the Kusakabe manor in Bitchū, where the main line moved and built Sarukake Castle.

Under the Nanboku-chō disorders the Bitchū Shō grew stronger under Hosokawa command. Shō Motosuke fought on the Hosokawa side in the Ōnin War, then raised the Bitchū War of 1491 and was defeated the next year.

In the Sengoku age Shō Tamesuke allied with the Amago in 1533, took Matsuyama Castle and held half of Bitchū. The Shō submitted to Ukita Naoie in 1568, helped the Mōri destroy the Mimura in 1574 to 1575, and finally left the stage when Shō Katsusuke fell fighting the Ukita.
zh:
庄氏原是武藏国的武士团，属于儿玉党的核心氏族。儿玉家弘定居栗崎，改称庄氏。其子家长于1184年在一之谷之战生擒平重衡，获赐备中国草壁庄，宗家迁往备中并修筑猿挂城。

南北朝动乱中，备中庄氏在细川氏麾下扩张势力。庄元资在应仁之乱中从属细川方，1491年又挑起备中大战，次年被镇压。

战国时代，庄为资于1533年与尼子氏结盟，夺取松山城，领有备中半国。庄氏于1568年向宇喜多直家投降，1574—1575年配合毛利氏攻灭三村氏，当主庄胜资最终在与宇喜多氏交战中战死，庄氏从此退出历史舞台。

en:
The Shōni were a warrior house of northern Kyūshū, centered on Chikuzen and Hizen, who sprang from the Mutō family and claimed descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato. Their name began as a title in the Dazaifu government, held by Mutō Sukeyori; from his son Sukeyoshi onward Shōni became the family name.

Sukeyoshi and his sons led the defense of Dazaifu during the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281. In 1333 Sadatsune Shōni joined Emperor Go-Daigo's war against the Kamakura shogunate. In 1336 his son Yorihisa welcomed Ashikaga Takauji to Kyūshū; Sadatsune was killed by the Kikuchi, whom Yorihisa defeated at Tatarahama.

Defeat in 1359 cost the Shōni Dazaifu, and Ōuchi invasions weakened the clan. In 1559 Ryūzōji Takanobu stormed Seifukuji Castle and forced Shōni Fuyuhisa to take his own life; a last revival attempt collapsed in 1572.
zh:
少贰氏是北九州筑前、肥前一带的武士家族，出自武藤氏，自称藤原秀乡后裔。“少贰”原是大宰府的官职名，武藤资赖曾任此职，从其子资能一代起成为固定姓氏。

1274年和1281年元寇来犯时，资能带领诸子在大宰府指挥防御。1333年，贞经参加后醍醐天皇的讨幕运动。1336年其子赖尚迎接逃奔九州的足利尊氏；贞经被菊池氏杀害，赖尚则在多々良滨击败菊池军。

1359年少贰氏战败，失去大宰府，此后大内氏的侵攻削弱了家族。1559年龙造寺隆信攻破势福寺城，迫使少贰冬尚自尽，最后一次复兴尝试也于1572年失败。

en: Silat was a small Malay river kingdom in the upper Kapuas basin of West Kalimantan, at present-day Silat Hilir, over which neighbouring Selimbau claimed primacy. Tradition traces its first polity, Jempulin Panjang, to the legendary Babai Becingah, and says Islam came up the Sambas river under its first Muslim ruler, Sultan Acit.
zh: 锡拉特是西加里曼丹上卡普阿斯河流域的马来河畔小邦，在今下锡拉特一带，邻邦塞林包对其宣称宗主权。当地传统把最早的政权珍普林·潘姜追溯到传说始祖巴拜·贝钦加，并称伊斯兰教沿三发河传入，由初代穆斯林君主苏丹·阿奇特引入。

en:
The Singapura dynasty ruled the small Malay trading kingdom of that name on Temasek, the future Singapore. According to the Malay Annals, its founder Sang Nila Utama, a prince of the Palembang royal house of Srivijaya, landed around 1299 and named his settlement Singapura, Sanskrit for lion city.

The chronicle counts five kings, including Sang Nila Utama, who still reigned in 1337, and Sri Wikrama Wira, whose port beat off a Siamese siege fleet in 1349. The kingdom grew rich on trade linking the archipelago, India and Yuan China, but a Majapahit expedition sacked the city around 1398.

The last king, Iskandar Shah, commonly identified with Parameswara, fled to the Malay Peninsula and founded the Malacca Sultanate around 1400. Much of the story is legendary, but archaeology and the Chinese traveler Wang Dayuan's account confirm a thriving fourteenth-century port.
zh:
辛诃补罗王朝统治淡马锡岛上同名的马来人小贸易王国，其地即后来的新加坡。据《马来纪年》记载，开国君主桑·尼拉·乌他马是室利佛逝巨港王室的王子，约1299年登岛，将聚落命名为辛诃补罗，梵语意为“狮城”。

该书记载王朝共有五王，其中桑·尼拉·乌他马在1337年仍在位，斯里·毗羯罗·毗罗的港城于1349年击退暹罗围城舰队。王国靠连接群岛、印度与元朝中国的贸易致富，约1398年被满者伯夷大军攻陷。

末代君主伊斯干达沙通常被认为是拜里米苏拉，他逃往马来半岛，约1400年建立马六甲苏丹国。这段历史多有传说成分，但考古发现和中国旅行家汪大渊的记载证实，14世纪当地确有繁盛港城。

en:
The name Singhanavati comes from the semi-legendary founder of the Yonok Kingdom, an early Tai polity centered on what is now Chiang Saen on the Kok River. Chronicle tradition makes Singhanavati a prince who led his people south from the upper Mekong and founded his capital there in the seventh century BCE; the kingdom is said to have fallen to earthquake and vassal revolt, its people dispersing into successor states such as Ngoenyang.

Later Thai traditions connect southern branches of this northern lineage with the ruling houses of the Chao Phraya basin. In that genealogical tradition the name is attached to the princes of Lavo, Suphanburi and Ayodhya in the fourteenth century.

Among them were Prince Uthong, who unified the Lopburi and Suphan Buri power centers and founded the Ayutthaya Kingdom in 1351 as Ramathibodi I, and Boromracha, whose Suphanburi line contested the Ayutthaya throne.
zh:
辛哈纳瓦蒂之名来自半传说性质的永诺王国创建者。永诺是泰人早期政权，以谷河流域今清盛一带为中心。按编年史传统，辛哈纳瓦蒂是一位王子，率部众从湄公河上游南迁，在当地建都，传说时代可上溯到公元前7世纪；据说王国最终因地震与属邦叛乱而亡，部众散入恩央等后继政权。

后世泰国传统把这条北方世系的南支与昭披耶河流域的王族联系起来。按照这种谱系说法，14世纪罗涡、素攀武里和阿约陀耶的诸侯都被归入该世系。

其中包括乌通亲王——他整合了华富里与素攀武里两大势力，于1351年开创阿瑜陀耶王国，即拉玛铁菩提一世；还有波罗玛拉查，他的素攀武里一系争夺阿瑜陀耶王位。

en:
The House of Siri Sanga Bo was a Sinhalese dynasty that ruled much of Sri Lanka from the 1220s to the 1590s. Its founder, Vijayabahu III, a descendant of King Sirisangabo, resisted Kalinga Magha and recovered the Buddha's tooth relic, around which Buddhist kingship was restored.

After a Pandyan army carried the tooth relic from Yapahuwa in the 1270s, Parakramabahu III secured its return. Later kings ruled from Gampola and Kotte, where Parakramabahu VI, reigning from 1412, conquered Jaffna in 1450 and for the last time united the island under one Sinhalese crown.

The Kotte kingdom split in the Vijayaba Kollaya of 1521, and Dharmapala ceded it to the Portuguese in 1597. The dynasty's last ruler, Rajasinha I of Sitawaka, died in 1592 without an heir, and his kingdom was sacked by the king of Kandy and the Portuguese.
zh:
西里桑加博是僧伽罗王朝，在13世纪20年代至16世纪90年代统治斯里兰卡大部。开创者维阇耶巴忽三世是国王尸利僧伽菩提的后裔，他抵御羯陵伽的摩伽，迎回佛牙舍利，围绕舍利重建佛教王权。

13世纪70年代潘地亚军队从亚帕胡瓦劫走佛牙舍利后，波罗迦罗摩巴忽三世争取到舍利归还。后裔在甘波罗和科提立国：1412年即位的波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世于1450年征服贾夫纳，最后一次将全岛统一在僧伽罗王权之下。

1521年的维阇耶巴忽之变使科提王国分裂，达摩波罗于1597年把王国让给葡萄牙。王朝末代君主、悉多伐伽的罗阇辛伽一世于1592年去世且无嗣，其王国被康提国王与葡萄牙人洗劫。

en:
The Sisodias are a Solar Rajput clan offshoot of Mewar's Guhila dynasty, named for Sisoda, settled by Rahapa, son of twelfth-century Guhila king Ranasimha. When Alauddin Khalji of Delhi stormed Chittorgarh in 1303, the Guhila line nearly perished in the last stand and jauhar; in 1326 Rana Hammir of the Sisodia branch retook and rebuilt Mewar, founding maharanas ruling it five centuries.

Successors warred with neighbouring sultans. Rana Kumbha (from 1433) raised Chittor's Tower of Victory; Rana Sanga made Mewar the leading Rajput power before falling to Babur at Khanua in 1527. Chittor fell to Bahadur Shah in 1535 and Akbar in 1568, and Udai Singh II moved the capital to Udaipur.

Udai Singh's son Pratap fought the Mughals from the hills, losing Haldighati in 1576 but recovering much of Mewar. The Sisodias were the last Rajput dynasty to submit to the Mughals, in 1615, and alone among the great Rajput houses never gave daughters to the imperial harem; Shivaji's Bhonsles and the Rana ministers of Nepal claimed Sisodia descent.
zh:
斯苏提阿是太阳世系的拉杰普特部族，梅瓦尔古希罗王朝分支，得名于12世纪古希罗国王拉纳辛哈之子罗诃波建立的西索达。1303年德里苏丹阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉攻陷奇托尔加尔，古希罗本支在死战与妇女自焚中近乎覆灭；1326年分支的拉纳·哈米尔收复并重建梅瓦尔，开创统治当地五百年的摩诃罗那世系。

后继者不断与邻邦苏丹交战：1433年即位的昆巴在奇托尔建胜利塔纪功，拉纳·桑伽把梅瓦尔推上拉杰普特诸邦之首，1527年在卡努阿战役败于巴布尔。奇托尔1535年被巴哈杜尔沙攻占、1568年落入阿克巴之手，乌代·辛格二世随即迁都乌代布尔。

乌代·辛格之子普拉塔普退入山区继续抗莫卧儿，1576年哈尔迪加蒂失利，终收复梅瓦尔大部。斯苏提阿是最后臣服莫卧儿的拉杰普特王朝，迟至1615年称臣，且在拉杰普特诸大族中独不将女儿送入皇室后宫；希瓦吉的邦斯莱家族与尼泊尔的拉纳首相家族都自称源出斯苏提阿。

en: Siyara was a fortified coastal settlement on the northern Somali shore east of Berbera, named for the Somali custom of pilgrimage to a local saint's tomb. Around 1415 the Walashma prince Sabr ad-Din II, returning from Yemeni exile, made it his first base for rebuilding the Sultanate of Adal.
zh: 西亚拉是索马里北部沿海、柏培拉以东的设防聚落，得名于索马里人朝谒当地圣徒墓地的习俗。约1415年，瓦什玛家族的萨卜尔·丁二世从也门流亡归来，以此为重建阿达尔苏丹国的最初据点。

en:
The Smilets were a short-lived imperial house of the Second Bulgarian Empire, founded by the nobleman Smilets, whose family held estates between the Balkan Mountains and Sredna Gora. In 1292 he took the throne at Tarnovo with the backing of Nogai Khan; his reign marked the height of Tatar overlordship over Bulgaria.

He married a Byzantine princess of the Palaiologos family, and around 1297 married their daughter Theodora to the Serbian king Stephen Dečanski; Theodora and Stephen's son was the future emperor Stephen Dušan. Smilets died in 1298 amid the invasion of the Mongol prince Chaka, and his young son Ivan II succeeded under his mother's regency.

Chaka seized Tarnovo in 1299 and the family fled into exile. Ivan II died as a monk in Byzantium before 1330, ending the male line; his sister Marina lived until 1355.
zh:
斯米莱茨王朝是第二保加利亚帝国一个国祚短促的皇室，开创者贵族斯米莱茨的家族在巴尔干山脉与斯雷德纳戈拉山之间拥有地产。1292年，他在那海汗支持下登上特尔诺沃的王位，他的统治时期是鞑靼人对保加利亚宗主权的顶峰。

他娶了巴列奥略家族的拜占庭公主，约1297年又将女儿特奥多拉嫁给塞尔维亚国王斯特凡·德昌斯基，特奥多拉与斯特凡的儿子就是后来的皇帝斯特凡·杜尚。1298年斯米莱茨在蒙古宗王恰卡入侵期间死去，幼子伊凡二世在母亲摄政下继位。

恰卡于1299年攻占特尔诺沃，全家被迫流亡。伊凡二世在1330年以前以修士身份客死拜占庭，男系就此断绝；他的姐妹马林娜活到1355年。

en:
The Sohri were the ruling house of the Soran emirate, also called Sohran, a Kurdish principality whose later capital was Rawanduz. According to the Sharafnama, the house descended from Kelos, an Arab of Baghdad who settled among the Kurds of Ewan.

According to the Sharafnama, the house's name came from Seng-Surh, people of the red rocks, shortened through the Kurdish word sohr into Sohran. Modern scholarship places the emirate's foundation between the 1330s and 1430s.

Around the battle of Chaldiran in 1514 the Soran seized land between Erbil and Kirkuk. In 1535 Sultan Suleiman had their ruler of Erbil, Izzeddin Sher, put to death and gave the city to Mir Husein Beg Dasini; Mir Seyfeddin of Soran later won back much of the old territory. From 1816 Emir Muhammad revived the emirate at Rawanduz, building cannon foundries and a large tribal army.
zh:
索赫里家族是索兰（又称索赫兰）埃米尔国的统治家族，这个库尔德政权后以拉万杜兹为都。据《沙拉夫纪》记载，家族出自迁居埃万库尔德人中的巴格达阿拉伯人凯洛斯。

据《沙拉夫纪》记载，家族名称来自“森格-苏尔赫”，意为红岩之人，库尔德语“苏赫尔”经简写演变为索赫兰。学界考证埃米尔国建于14世纪30年代至15世纪30年代之间。

1514年恰尔德兰战役前后，索兰人夺取了埃尔比勒与基尔库克之间的土地。1535年苏丹苏莱曼处死他们在埃尔比勒的统治者伊泽丁·谢尔，把该城封给米尔·侯赛因·贝格·达西尼，索兰的米尔·赛夫丁后来收复大部分旧地。1816年起，埃米尔穆罕默德以拉万杜兹为中心复兴埃米尔国，开设铸炮厂，建部落军队。

en:
The Solomonic dynasty ruled the Christian Ethiopian highlands from 1270, when the Shewan noble Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe kings. Its legitimacy rested on the claim in the Kebra Nagast that the line descended from Menelik I, son of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, and had restored the kingship of Aksum.

Amda Seyon I, who reigned from 1314 to 1344, broke the sultanates of Ifat and Adal in 1332. Zara Yaqob, reigning from 1434 to 1468, centralized government, founded Debre Birhan as a capital and built churches.

In the 1530s the Adal imam Ahmed Gran overran most of the empire until his defeat and death in 1543 with Portuguese aid; Oromo migrations then eroded the south. Emperor Fasilides founded Gondar in 1636, but after the 1760s the emperors became puppets of regional lords in the era of princes.
zh:
所罗门王朝自1270年起统治基督教的埃塞俄比亚高原：这一年，绍阿贵族耶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝诸王。其合法性来自《众王荣耀》的说法：该世系出自所罗门王与示巴女王之子孟尼利克一世，因而只是恢复了阿克苏姆王统。

1314—1344年在位的安达·塞永一世于1332年击溃伊法特和阿达尔苏丹国。1434—1468年在位的扎拉·雅各布集权，定都德布雷·伯汉，兴建教堂。

16世纪30年代，阿达尔伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰攻占帝国大半国土，1543年在葡萄牙援助下被击败身亡；随后奥罗莫人的迁徙蚕食南方。皇帝法西利德斯于1636年兴建贡德尔，但18世纪60年代以后，诸王纷争时代的皇帝沦为地方豪强的傀儡。

en:
The Soranzo were a Venetian patrician family, one of the twenty-four case vecchie that claimed descent from the ancient tribunes of the lagoon. Family legend derived them from the Roman gens Superantia, said to have fled Altino for Burano in 456.

Giovanni Soranzo, an admiral who raided the Genoese colony of Caffa in 1296, was elected Doge in 1312 and ruled until his death in 1328. The family financed the church of San Samuele and the facade of Santa Giustina in Venice.

At the Battle of Lepanto in 1571 Benedetto Soranzo commanded a galley and, mortally wounded with his crew wiped out, set fire to his ship rather than surrender. The San Trovaso branch died out in 1771, while the San Gregorio branch kept its Venetian palaces until the Republic fell in 1797.
zh:
索兰佐家族是威尼斯的贵族世家，属于自称源出潟湖古代保民官的二十四家旧世家之一。据家族传说，其先祖是罗马的苏佩兰提亚氏族，456年从阿尔蒂诺逃到布拉诺。

海军将领乔瓦尼·索兰佐曾于1296年攻袭热那亚殖民地卡法，1312年当选总督，执政至1328年去世。家族出资修建威尼斯的圣萨穆埃莱教堂和圣朱斯蒂娜教堂立面。

1571年勒班陀海战中，贝内代托·索兰佐指挥一艘桨帆船，在船员死伤殆尽、本人重伤之际纵火焚船，拒不投降。圣特罗瓦索支系于1771年绝嗣，圣格雷戈里奥支系则保有威尼斯宅邸，直到1797年共和国灭亡。

en:
The So were the lords of Tsushima Island, most likely an offshoot of the Koremune family of Dazaifu officials, although their genealogy claimed descent from the Taira. In 1246 Sō Shigehisa crushed the Abiru clan and received the stewardship; in the first Mongol invasion of 1274 Sukekuni died fighting at Sasuura.

As deputies of the Shoni, the So extended their hold during the Nanboku-cho wars and moved their seat to Tsushima around 1408. They secured the hereditary shugo post and broke with the Shoni in the 1440s.

Tsushima produced little rice, so the clan relied on trade and diplomacy with Joseon Korea. They endured the Oei invasion of 1419 and the Three Ports riots of 1510; though they joined the Western Army at Sekigahara in 1600, Tokugawa Ieyasu spared them for their Korean connections. After the 1609 Kiyu agreement they monopolised shogunal diplomacy with Joseon.
zh:
宗氏统治对马岛，一般认为出自大宰府官人惟宗氏的支流，但家谱自称平氏后裔。1246年宗重尚讨平对马阿比留氏，受封地头职；1274年助国在佐须浦迎战蒙古军，战死沙场。

作为少弐氏的地头代，宗氏在南北朝战乱中扩张势力，约1408年把本据迁至对马。他们获得守护的世袭地位，并在15世纪40年代与少弐氏斩断主从关系。

对马稻米匮乏，宗氏依靠对朝鲜的贸易与外交。他们经历了1419年应永外寇和1510年三浦之乱；1600年关原之战中宗氏加入西军，德川家康却因其对朝渠道而不予追究。1609年己酉约条后，宗氏垄断幕府对朝鲜的外交。

en:
The Sōma were a samurai house of Taira descent through the Chiba clan, named after the Sōma shrine-estate in northern Shimōsa. Their founder Sōma Morotsune served Minamoto no Yoritomo and joined the conquest of the Northern Fujiwara in 1189, receiving three southern Mutsu districts.

In the Nanboku-chō wars the Sōma held to the Northern Court. In the Sengoku age their domain lay between the Satake and the Date; Date Masamune invaded thirty times, and Sōma Yoshitane submitted to Toyotomi Hideyoshi at the Odawara siege of 1590.

After Sekigahara the Tokugawa government named Sōma Toshitane daimyō of the Sōma Nakamura Domain. He moved his seat to Nakamura Castle, laid out a castle town on the Kyoto model and patronised Sōma ware; his descendants kept the domain through the Edo period.
zh:
相马氏是经由千叶氏分出的平氏后裔武家，得名于下总国北部的相马御厨。始祖相马师常侍奉源赖朝，1189年随军攻灭奥州藤原氏，受封陆奥国南部三郡。

南北朝动乱中，相马氏效忠北朝。战国时代，其领地夹在佐竹氏与伊达氏之间，伊达政宗曾三十次入侵；相马义胤于1590年小田原围城时向丰臣秀吉臣服。

关原之战后，德川幕府封相马利胤为相马中村藩大名。他把本据迁到中村城，仿照京都规划城下町，并扶持相马烧；其子孙在江户时代一直保有该藩。

en:
The Spinola were one of Genoa's greatest noble houses, with wealth from trade, finance and land. First recorded with Guido Spinola, Genoese consul in 1102, the family peaked in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries beside their allies and rivals the Doria.

In 1262 Oberto Spinola and Oberto Doria overthrew the captain of the people Guglielmo Boccanegra and took joint power; Oberto Spinola defeated Venice at sea in 1266 and helped exile the Fieschi and Grimaldi in 1270. His son Corrado commanded fleets against Pisa and was captain of the people until 1301; Galeotto Spinola held the office in 1335 and helped throw off Robert of Naples' overlordship.

The family remained central to Genoese politics for centuries, producing eleven doges, while Francesco Spinola led the 1435 revolt that ended Visconti rule over the city. Its most celebrated later member, Ambrogio Spinola, was a Genoese banker who became Captain-General of the Spanish Army of Flanders and took Breda in 1625, one of the most famous sieges of the Eighty Years' War.
zh:
斯皮诺拉家族是热那亚共和国最显赫的贵族世家之一，财富来自贸易、金融和地产。家族最早见于记载的是1102年任热那亚执政官的圭多·斯皮诺拉；13至14世纪，家族与盟友兼对手多里亚家族一同达到权力顶峰。

1262年奥贝托·斯皮诺拉与奥贝托·多里亚联手推翻人民首领古列尔莫·博卡内格拉，共同执政；1266年奥贝托·斯皮诺拉率舰队击败威尼斯，1270年参与流放菲耶斯基和格里马尔迪两家族。其子科拉多在对比萨战争中指挥舰队，出任人民首领至1301年；加莱奥托1335年出任同一职务，协助热那亚摆脱那不勒斯国王罗贝托的宗主权。

此后数百年家族始终处于热那亚政治核心，共出十一位总督；1435年弗朗切斯科领导起义，终结维斯孔蒂对热那亚的统治。后期最著名者是安布罗西奥·斯皮诺拉，这位热那亚银行家出任西班牙佛兰德斯军队总司令，1625年攻克布雷达，那场围城是八十年战争中最著名的战役之一。

en:
The Sponheims, or Spanheims, were a Rhenish Franconian noble house named after Sponheim Castle in the Hunsrück. Siegfried I inherited estates in Carinthia by marriage, and his grandson Henry became Duke of Carinthia in 1122; his line ruled until 1269.

The Rhenish branch kept the County of Sponheim. Before 1237 the sons of Count Gottfried III divided it: Johann I took the rear county around Starkenburg and acquired Sayn in 1247, while Simon I formed the front county on the Nahe, seated at the Kauzenburg above Kreuznach.

The Rhenish ruling male line died out in 1437. The margraves of Baden and the counts palatine of Simmern-Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld inherited the county as a condominium, which lasted until French revolutionary armies annexed the lands west of the Rhine.
zh:
施蓬海姆家族（又译施潘海姆）是莱茵法兰克尼亚的贵族世家，得名于洪斯吕克山区的施蓬海姆城堡。西格弗里德一世通过婚姻继承克恩滕领地，其孙亨利于1122年成为克恩滕公爵，这支后裔统治到1269年。

留在莱茵的支系统治施蓬海姆伯国。1237年之前，伯爵戈特弗里德三世的儿子们瓜分伯国：约翰一世取得以施塔肯堡为中心的后伯国，1247年又获得塞恩；西蒙一世在纳厄河畔建立前伯国，以克罗伊茨纳赫上方的考岑堡为治所。

莱茵支系的执政男系于1437年断绝。巴登藩侯与锡门-茨魏布吕肯-比肯费尔德行宫伯爵共管伯国，直到法国革命军吞并莱茵河西岸土地为止。

en:
The House of Sratsimir was a medieval Bulgarian noble house whose founder, the despot Sratsimir, held Lovech and married Keratsa Petritsa of the Asen dynasty. Their son Ivan Alexander seized the throne at Tarnovo in 1331, making the house the last ruling dynasty of the Second Bulgarian Empire.

After Ivan Alexander's death in 1371 his son Ivan Shishman ruled at Tarnovo while another son, Ivan Sratsimir, kept the separate empire of Vidin. Ottoman conquest ended both, with Tarnovo falling in 1393 and Vidin in 1422, when Constantine II of Vidin died as the last Bulgarian emperor.

The exile Fruzhin fought the Ottomans as a Hungarian count, and his descendants were recorded in Hungary into the sixteenth century. Later Bulgarian rebels, including leaders of the uprisings of 1598 and 1686, claimed descent from the house.
zh:
斯拉齐米尔家族是中世纪保加利亚的贵族世家，始祖斯拉齐米尔为洛维奇的专制君主，娶了阿森王朝成员克拉察·佩特里察。他们的儿子伊凡·亚历山大于1331年夺取特尔诺沃的皇位，家族由此成为第二保加利亚帝国的最后一个统治王朝。

1371年伊凡·亚历山大去世后，儿子伊凡·希什曼统治特尔诺沃，另一个儿子伊凡·斯拉齐米尔则割据维丁。奥斯曼人的征服先后终结了两支政权：特尔诺沃于1393年陷落，维丁于1422年失守，维丁的君士坦丁二世去世，成为末代保加利亚皇帝。

流亡者弗鲁任以匈牙利伯爵的身份抗击奥斯曼人，其后人在匈牙利的记载延续到16世纪。后来1598年和1686年起义的保加利亚领袖也自称出自该家族。

en:
The Stapletons were a knightly family of Yorkshire whose fortunes rose through marriage. Sir Gilbert de Stapleton, who died in 1321, married Agnes, elder daughter and co-heiress of Bryan FitzAlan of Bedale, bringing the Bedale and Cotherstone estates into his family.

His eldest son, Sir Miles Stapleton of Bedale, was a companion in arms of Edward III. He served at the siege of Tournai in 1340, fought in the War of Breton Succession and probably at Calais in 1347, and was among the founding Knights of the Garter in 1348.

Miles marched with Henry of Lancaster in 1356 and joined a Prussian crusade in 1363 before dying in 1364, perhaps of wounds received at Auray. His marriage to the Ingham heiress Joan brought lands in Norfolk; the family continued at Bedale and Ingham for three generations before the estates were split among co-heiresses.
zh:
斯特普尔顿家族是约克郡的骑士世家，靠联姻发迹。1321年去世的吉尔伯特·德·斯特普尔顿爵士娶了比代尔的布莱恩·菲查伦的长女兼共同继承人阿格尼丝，比代尔和科瑟斯通的地产由此归入家族。

吉尔伯特的长子、比代尔的迈尔斯·斯特普尔顿爵士是爱德华三世的战友。他于1340年参加图尔奈围城战，随后投身布列塔尼继承战争，1347年可能还参加了加来围城战，并于1348年成为嘉德骑士团创始骑士之一。

迈尔斯于1356年随兰开斯特的亨利行军，1363年参加普鲁士十字军，1364年去世，或因欧赖战役所受的伤而死。他娶英厄姆女继承人琼为妻，在诺福克获得领地；家族在比代尔和英厄姆又延续了三代，之后地产由几位女继承人分割。

en:
The free lords of Steinfurt took their name from the stone ford across the Aa in Westphalia, which they controlled before 1129, levying toll on the trade road to Münster. Rudolf II of Steinfurt, first attested in 1155, built the moated castle of Burgsteinfurt, the family seat.

A long feud with the lords of Ascheberg ended when that house died out in 1206, leaving Steinfurt to dominate the region. The family's younger sons rose in the church, and with the cathedral provost Bernhard they founded the Hospitaller commandery of Steinfurt.

A charter of 1338 calls the settlement below the castle their town. The male line ran out in 1421, and the heiress brought the lordship to her husband Everwin of Götterswick; from his second marriage descended the house of Bentheim-Steinfurt, which raised Steinfurt to a county in 1495.
zh:
施泰因富特的自由领主家族得名于威斯特伐利亚阿河上的石滩渡口：1129年以前，他们就控制了这处通往明斯特的商道渡口并征收过路费。鲁道夫二世于1155年首次见于文献，他修建了环水的施泰因富特堡，作为家族居所。

家族与阿舍贝格领主长期争斗，后者于1206年绝嗣，施泰因富特就此独大一方。家族幼子在教会中腾达，家族与总铎伯恩哈德创立了施泰因富特的圣约翰医院骑士团辖区。

1338年的特许状已把城堡下的聚落称为他们的城镇。1421年男系断绝，女继承人把领地带给丈夫埃弗温·冯·格特斯维克；本特海姆-施泰因富特家族出自其第二次婚姻，并于1495年将施泰因富特升格为伯国。

en:
The House of Stenkil is the modern name for the dynasty that ruled Sweden from about 1060 to the 1120s, taking its name from its first king. Stenkil came from Västergötland, married a daughter of King Emund the Old, and inherited the throne when the old royal line died out around 1060.

A devout Christian who tolerated pagan worship, he died around 1066 after a brief war with Norway. His death was followed by civil war between rival claimants named Eric, but his sons Halsten and Inge the Elder both held the kingship, and Halsten's sons Philip and Inge the Younger ruled after them.

With the death of Inge the Younger around 1125, the male line came to an end. The dynasty's daughters married into rival houses, so that nearly every Swedish king of the twelfth century, including the later House of Erik, could claim Stenkil blood.
zh:
斯滕希尔王朝是史家对约1060年至12世纪20年代统治瑞典的王朝的称呼，得名于开创者斯滕希尔。斯滕希尔出身西约塔兰，娶国王老埃蒙德之女为妻，在旧王室约1060年绝嗣后继承王位。

他是虔诚的基督徒，却仍容忍异教崇拜，在与挪威的一场短暂战争后于约1066年去世。他死后，两位名叫埃里克的争夺者爆发内战，但他的儿子哈尔斯滕和老英格先后登位，哈尔斯滕之子菲利普和小英格又相继为王。

约1125年小英格去世后，家族男嗣断绝。家族的女儿们嫁入各对立家族，因此12世纪几乎每位瑞典国王，包括后来的埃里克王朝，都能追溯到斯滕希尔的血脉。

en:
The Steno, called Sten in Venetian, were a Venetian patrician house among the Case Nuove, admitted to the ruling class at the closing of the Great Council in 1297. Tradition claimed an origin in Altino, but the house never attained great wealth or power.

Michele Steno, born around 1331, had a wild youth and was nearly condemned for scurrilous inscriptions against Doge Marino Faliero, yet became an administrator and diplomat. In 1400, after a deadlocked election, he was chosen as Doge as a compromise candidate.

His reign saw Venice defeat Francesco da Carrara of Padua in the War of Padua and annex the city, laying the foundations of the mainland dominion. Michele Steno died on 26 December 1413 and was buried in the basilica of San Giovanni e Paolo; with no heirs, the house became extinct.
zh:
斯泰诺家族（威尼斯方言称Sten）是威尼斯贵族世家，属于1297年大议会封闭时被纳入统治阶层的“新世家”之一。传说其先祖来自阿尔蒂诺，但家族从未积累起显赫的财富与权势。

约1331年出生的米凯莱·斯泰诺年轻时放浪不羁，曾因题写侮辱总督马里诺·法列罗的文字而险些被定罪，后来成为行政官和外交官。1400年总督选举陷入僵局，他作为折中人选当选总督。

他任内威尼斯在帕多瓦战争中击败帕多瓦领主弗朗切斯科·达·卡拉拉并吞并该城，奠定了大陆领地的基础。米凯莱·斯泰诺于1413年12月26日去世，葬于圣乔瓦尼与保罗大教堂；他没有留下继承人，家族也随之绝嗣。

en:
The House of Stuart, originally Stewart, took its name from the office of High Steward of Scotland. Its ancestor Walter fitz Alan followed David I north in the twelfth century and was made hereditary steward, with lands in Renfrewshire.

The sixth steward, Walter Stewart, married Marjorie Bruce, daughter of Robert I. When David II died without an heir in 1371 their son became Robert II, the first Stewart king. Mary, Queen of Scots, adopted the French spelling Stuart; in 1603 her son James VI of Scotland inherited the English and Irish thrones as James I, uniting the crowns.

Charles I was executed in 1649, but the dynasty returned in 1660. James II was deposed in 1688, and after Mary II and Anne the crown passed to Hanover in 1714. Stuart heirs kept their claim alive through the Jacobite risings of 1715 and 1745.
zh:
斯图亚特王朝（旧拼斯图尔特）的家族名来自苏格兰王室大管家一职。其先祖沃尔特·菲茨艾伦于12世纪随大卫一世北上，受封世袭管家之职，在伦弗鲁郡领有土地。

第六任管家沃尔特·斯图尔特娶了罗伯特一世之女玛乔丽·布鲁斯。1371年大卫二世无嗣而终，他们的儿子以罗伯特二世之名继承王位，成为第一代斯图亚特国王。苏格兰女王玛丽采用法语拼法斯图亚特；1603年其子苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世以詹姆斯一世之名继承英格兰和爱尔兰王位，实现王位联合。

查理一世于1649年被处死，王朝在1660年复辟。詹姆斯二世于1688年被废，玛丽二世和安妮相继在位后，1714年王位转入汉诺威家族。斯图亚特继承人通过1715年和1745年的詹姆斯党起事延续王位主张。

en:
The Stratfords were a landed family of Stratford-on-Avon in Warwickshire whose fortune came through the Church. John de Stratford was born around 1275, studied civil law at Oxford, and became Bishop of Winchester in 1323.

He joined Queen Isabella's party against Edward II, helped draw up the charges that forced the king's abdication in 1327, and under Edward III served three times as Lord Chancellor before being appointed Archbishop of Canterbury in 1333.

His quarrel with Edward III in 1340, when he resisted the king's attempt to punish him outside parliament, helped establish that peers should be judged only in full parliament; he died in 1348 and was buried at Canterbury. His brother Robert became Bishop of Chichester and also Chancellor of England, and a nephew, Ralph, became Bishop of London.
zh:
斯特拉特福家族是沃里克郡埃文河畔斯特拉特福的乡绅世家，靠教会门路发迹。约翰·德·斯特拉特福约生于1275年，在牛津攻读民法，1323年出任温切斯特主教。

他加入伊莎贝拉王后反对爱德华二世的阵营，参与起草迫使国王于1327年退位的罪状，又在爱德华三世麾下三度出任御前大臣，1333年受任坎特伯雷大主教。

1340年他与爱德华三世发生冲突，拒绝国王绕开议会惩治自己，推动确立了贵族只能在全体议会中受审的原则；他于1348年去世，葬在坎特伯雷。其弟罗伯特后来成为奇切斯特主教并同样出任御前大臣，外甥拉尔夫则当上伦敦主教。

en:
The Strathbogies were a semi-Normanized Gaelic family from Fife, named for their lands at Strathbogie in Aberdeenshire. John de Strathbogie married Ada, Countess of Atholl, and their son David became Earl of Atholl in 1264.

The ninth earl, John, was captured fighting for Scotland at Dunbar in 1296, then joined Robert the Bruce's rising and died in English reprisals after the 1306 coronation. His son David sided with England, and the earldom was forfeited in 1314.

David III became a chief lieutenant of Edward Balliol and won restoration under his brief kingship, but was killed at Culblean in 1335. His son David IV kept the claim until his death in 1369 without ruling Atholl, which passed first to the Campbells and later to the Stewarts.
zh:
斯特拉斯博吉家族是半诺曼化的盖尔人家族，源自法夫，得名于其在阿伯丁郡斯特拉斯博吉的领地。约翰·德·斯特拉斯博吉娶了阿索尔女伯爵阿达，他们的儿子大卫于1264年成为阿索尔伯爵。

第九代伯爵约翰1296年在邓巴为苏格兰作战时被俘，后来加入罗伯特·布鲁斯的起事，在1306年加冕礼后的英格兰报复中丧命。其子大卫倒向英格兰，伯爵领于1314年被剥夺。

大卫三世成为爱德华·巴利奥尔的主要副手，在巴利奥尔短暂称王期间恢复地位，却于1335年在卡尔布林战役中阵亡。其子大卫四世保有爵位主张直到1369年去世，却从未统治阿索尔；领地先归坎贝尔家族，后来转入斯图亚特家族之手。

en:
The Strathearns were the native Gaelic mormaers, later earls, of Strathearn in southern Perthshire, first attested around 1115. Malise I led the men of Strathearn under David I at the Battle of the Standard in 1138.

Malise V succeeded his father in 1329 and inherited the Norwegian jarldom of Orkney, including Caithness. He commanded a Scottish division against Edward Balliol at Halidon Hill in 1333, after which Balliol forfeited his earldom and granted it to John de Warenne.

Malise never recovered Strathearn: David II regranted it to Maurice de Moravia in 1344. The Gaelic line ended with Malise, who died around 1357 leaving only daughters. Through his daughter Isabella, who married William St Clair, the Orkney inheritance passed to the Sinclair family; Isabella and William's son Henry became jarl in 1379.
zh:
斯特拉森家族是珀斯郡南部斯特拉森地区本土的盖尔人莫尔马尔，即后来的伯爵，最早见于1115年前后的记载。1138年，马拉斯一世在大卫一世麾下率斯特拉森人参加斯坦达德战役。

1329年，马拉斯五世继承父位，又继承了挪威的奥克尼雅尔领地，其中包括凯斯内斯。1333年，他在哈利顿山战役中指挥苏格兰军队的一个师对抗爱德华·巴利奥尔，巴利奥尔随后没收其伯爵领并转封给约翰·德·瓦伦。

马拉斯始终未能夺回斯特拉森：1344年大卫二世将该领改封给莫里斯·德·莫里亚。盖尔世系到马拉斯时断绝，他约于1357年去世，只留下女儿。其女伊莎贝拉嫁给威廉·圣克莱尔，奥克尼的继承权由此转入辛克莱家族；伊莎贝拉与威廉之子亨利于1379年成为雅尔。

en:
The Šubić were one of the Twelve noble tribes of medieval Croatia, documented from the twelfth century and holding Bribir in inland Dalmatia. In 1251 King Béla IV of Hungary confirmed Bribir as a hereditary fief.

Under Paul I Šubić, Ban of Croatia from 1275 and Lord of Bosnia from 1299, the house dominated Croatian affairs. Paul ruled most Dalmatian coastal cities, minted coin and in 1300 escorted the Angevin claimant Charles Robert from Split to the Hungarian throne. His son Mladen II was overthrown at Bliska in 1322, and the crown curbed Šubić power.

In 1347 King Louis I granted Zrin to Gregory and George Šubić, founding the Zrinski line, which later led Croatian resistance to the Ottomans. Bribir was overrun by the Turks in 1520, scattering the remaining branches into Slavonia and Hungary.
zh:
舒比奇家族是中世纪克罗地亚十二贵族部落之一，12世纪已有记载，领有达尔马提亚内陆的布里比尔。1251年匈牙利国王贝拉四世将布里比尔确认为其世袭领地。

保罗一世自1275年起出任克罗地亚班，1299年起兼领波斯尼亚，家族在他治下主导克罗地亚事务。保罗控制了达尔马提亚多数沿海城市，自铸钱币，并于1300年护送安茹家族的查理·罗伯特从斯普利特前往匈牙利登位。其子姆拉登二世于1322年在布利斯卡被推翻，家族权势受到王权压制。

1347年国王拉约什一世将兹林封给格列高利和乔治·舒比奇，开创的兹林斯基支系后来领导克罗地亚人抵抗奥斯曼。布里比尔于1520年被土耳其人攻陷，残余各支四散迁入斯拉沃尼亚和匈牙利。

en:
The Sue were a cadet line of the Ōuchi house of Suō, whose ancestors, the immigrant Tatara clan, claimed descent from King Seong of Baekje. Ōuchi Morinaga took the name Migita, and his descendant Hirokata settled at Sue village in Yoshiki district and took the name Sue.

The family rose as hereditary senior retainers of the Ōuchi. Sue Hironaga became shugodai of Nagato in 1401, and under Morimasa the family also gained the post in Suō in 1432. Sue Hirofusa followed Ōuchi Masahiro to the Ōnin War and fell at Shōkoku-ji in Kyoto in 1468.

Takafusa, later called Harukata, turned against his lord Ōuchi Yoshitaka and drove him to suicide in the Tainei-ji incident of 1551, ruling through a puppet lord. Mōri Motonari defeated him at Itsukushima in 1555; Harukata killed himself and his main line perished, though cadet branches survived as Mōri retainers.
zh:
陶氏是周防大内氏的傍流，其祖先多々良氏是自称百济圣王后裔的渡来氏族。大内盛长另称右田氏，其裔孙弘贤居住在吉敷郡陶村，遂以陶为姓。

陶氏成为大内家的谱代重臣。1401年陶弘长出任长门守护代，1432年陶盛政又出任周防守护代。应仁之乱中，陶弘房随大内政弘上洛，1468年战死于京都相国寺之战。

陶隆房后改名晴贤，1551年背叛主君大内义隆，迫使他在大宁寺自尽，随后拥立傀儡大内家主。1555年毛利元就在严岛之战击败晴贤，晴贤自尽，嫡流覆灭，旁流则作为毛利家臣留存。

en:
The Suetsugu were an Izumo kokujin house of the Uda Genji, branching from the Tomita line of the Sasaki clan. Their founder Tanekiyo held the Suetsugu lands from the mid-thirteenth century and took his surname from them; the place-name came from the ancient Sue-tsuku shrine on Kamedayama.

Tanekiyo's sons marched to Kyushu for coastal defence during the Mongol invasion of 1281. In 1333 the clansman Sataka helped Emperor Go-Daigo return from exile, while Takamune fought for the Northern Court under Ashikaga Takauji.

Around 1478 Suetsugu Castle passed to Amago Tsunehisa and the Suetsugu became Amago retainers. Sadataka fell in 1570 trying to restore the Amago; the Mōri took the castle in 1571. In 1607 Horio Yoshiharu built Matsue Castle on the site; surviving Suetsugu lost their surname, later settling at Yonago and recovering it.
zh:
末次氏是出云国的国人豪族，出自宇多源氏佐佐木氏流下的富田氏一脉。始祖胤清在13世纪中叶领有末次之地，遂以地名为姓；地名源于龟田山上的须卫都久社。

胤清之子在1281年蒙古袭来时出阵九州，承担海边警护。1333年，族人佐隆为流放的后醍醐天皇回京效力，隆宗则在足利尊氏麾下为北朝作战。

1478年前后末次城落入尼子经久之手，末次氏转为尼子家臣。定隆于1570年为复兴尼子氏奋战而死，毛利氏于1571年攻落末次城。1607年堀尾吉晴在旧址修筑松江城，幸存族人被剥夺姓氏，后来移居米子，恢复末次旧姓。

en:
The lords of Sully held the feudal barony of Sully-sur-Loire on the upper Loire from around the year 1000. The first recorded baron was Archambaud, whose line ended in an heiress, Agnes. In 1104 she married William the Simple of Blois, a grandson of William the Conqueror, who ruled Sully by right of his wife. Their son Eudes Archambaud continued the de Sully line.

Later barons served the Capetian crown on campaign: Henry II died in the Angevin conquest of Sicily in 1269, and Henry III died on the invasion of Aragon in 1285.

The heiress Marie de Sully married Guy VI de La Trémoille at the end of the fourteenth century, carrying the barony into the La Trémoille family, who sold it in 1606 to Maximilien de Béthune, made Duke of Sully.
zh:
叙利家族自公元1000年前后起统治卢瓦尔河上游的卢瓦尔河畔叙利封建男爵领。最早见于记载的男爵是阿尔尚博，其世系留下女继承人阿格尼丝。1104年，她嫁给征服者威廉的外孙、布洛瓦的“老实人”威廉；威廉以妻权统治叙利，他们的儿子厄德·阿尔尚博一脉延续为德·叙利家族。

此后的男爵追随卡佩王室出征：亨利二世于1269年在安茹家族征服西西里之役中战死，亨利三世则于1285年在入侵阿拉贡时丧命。

14世纪末，女继承人玛丽·德·叙利嫁给居伊六世·德·拉特雷穆瓦耶，男爵领随之转入拉特雷穆瓦耶家族；1606年该家族又把它卖给被封为叙利公爵的马西米连·德·贝蒂讷。

en:
The Sunda dynasty ruled the Hindu Sunda Kingdom of western Java from at least the tenth century until 1579, its court moving between Kawali and Pakuan Pajajaran. In the fourteenth century Prabu Ajigunawisesa held court at Kawali, and Sunda was named among the targets of Gajah Mada's Palapa oath of 1336.

The 1357 Battle of Bubat destroyed a Sunda royal party at the Majapahit capital, killing King Prabu Maharaja and the princess Dyah Pitaloka. Niskala Wastu Kancana rebuilt Kawali's walls, and Sri Baduga Maharaja's reign from 1482 to 1521, remembered as the age of Prabu Siliwangi, was a golden age of pepper wealth at Pakuan Pajajaran.

As Islam spread along the coast, Cirebon broke away in 1482 and Sunda Kalapa fell in 1527. Banten sacked the capital in the 1550s and extinguished the kingdom in 1579; the surviving court retired to Sumedang Larang.
zh:
巽他王朝统治西爪哇的印度教巽他王国，至少自10世纪延续至1579年，王廷在卡瓦利与帕库安·巴查查兰之间迁徙。14世纪时，普拉布·阿吉古纳维塞沙在卡瓦利理政，巽他也被列入加查·马达1336年帕拉帕誓言的征服目标。

1357年的布巴特事件中，巽他王室一行在满者伯夷都城遭难，国王普拉布·摩诃罗阇与公主迪亚·皮塔洛卡殒命。此后尼斯卡拉·瓦斯图·坎察纳重修卡瓦利城防；斯里·巴杜加·摩诃罗阇1482—1521年的统治即传说中的普拉布·西里旺义时代，是王国的黄金期，帕库安·巴查查兰凭胡椒贸易富庶一时。

随着伊斯兰教沿海岸传播，井里汶于1482年独立，巽他格拉巴于1527年陷落。万丹在16世纪50年代洗劫都城，并于1579年攻灭王国，残余王室退守苏梅当·拉朗。

en:
The Suphannaphum dynasty took its name from Suphannaphum, the city of gold, a polity of the lower Chao Phraya valley. It grew from an older Dvaravati-era center whose rulers sent embassies to Song China in the twelfth century, and was among the polities whose merger formed Ayutthaya in 1351.

Its ruler Khun Luang Pa-ngua, brother-in-law of Ramathibodi I, seized the throne as Borommarachathirat I in 1370, defeating the rival Uthong line based at Lopburi. His son Thong Lan was deposed in 1388, but Intharacha of Suphannaphum retook the throne in 1408.

The house then ruled Ayutthaya through the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. Its kings included Borommatrailokkanat, who strengthened central administration and fought Lan Na; succession crises after King Chaiya's death in 1546 ended the house's unbroken hold on power.
zh:
素攀那蓬王朝得名于昭披耶河下游的城邦素攀那蓬，意为“金城”。它由堕罗钵底时代的中心发展而来，统治者在12世纪向中国宋朝遣使；1351年它与其他政权合并，形成阿瑜陀耶王国。

素攀那蓬的统治者坤銮帕乌是拉玛铁菩提一世的姻亲，1370年夺取王位，称波罗玛拉查铁拉一世，压倒了以华富里为根基的乌通世系。他的儿子通兰1388年被废，但素攀那蓬的膺陀罗阇于1408年夺回王位。

此后素攀那蓬系君王在15至16世纪统治阿瑜陀耶。其中波隆摩戴莱洛迦纳强化中央集权，与兰纳交战；1546年猜耶王死后的继承危机终结了家族对王位的连续掌控。

en:
The Sutayids were a Mongol dynasty of the post-Ilkhanate era, founded by Emir Sutay, a commander of Ilkhan Ghazan and son-in-law of Hulagu's son Möngke Temür. From the early fourteenth century the family held Diyar Bakr, with Amid as its chief city.

Sutay died in 1332 and his son Hajji Taghay inherited his lands. He quarrelled with the Oirats and leaned on the Jalayirids, until his nephew Ibrahimshah killed him in 1343 with Chupanid backing. Ibrahimshah died in 1350, and the family's holdings around Mosul were lost; Pir Muhammad briefly recovered Mosul but was murdered in 1351.

The surviving Sutayids took refuge with the Eretnids in Anatolia, where they were known as the Barambays. Diyar Bakr passed to other Mongol and Turkmen lords.
zh:
速台家族是伊儿汗国解体后兴起的蒙古王朝，始祖速台是伊儿汗合赞麾下的埃米尔，也是旭烈兀之子蒙哥帖木儿的女婿。14世纪初起，家族以阿米德为首府领有迪亚巴克尔地区。

速台于1332年去世，其子哈吉·塔盖继承领地。他与卫拉特人相争并借重札剌亦儿王朝，1343年被得到出班系支持的侄子易卜拉欣沙所杀。易卜拉欣沙1350年死后，家族丧失摩苏尔一带的领地；皮尔·穆罕默德一度夺回摩苏尔，却于1351年被杀。

残存的速台族人投奔安纳托利亚的埃尔坦纳王朝，改称巴兰姆拜。迪亚巴克尔转入其他蒙古与土库曼首领之手。

en:
The Sutherlands of the far north of Scotland traced their line to Freskin, a Flemish knight settled by David I. His grandson Hugh de Moravia received lands in Sutherland, and Hugh's son William became the first Earl of Sutherland; the family had taken the territorial surname by the fifteenth century.

The third earl fought at Bannockburn in 1314, and Earl Kenneth was killed at Halidon Hill in 1333. His son William was captured alongside David II at Neville's Cross in 1346 and killed in a feud with the Mackays in 1370.

In 1517 Countess Elizabeth Sutherland married Adam Gordon, and the earldom passed to the Gordon line. The Sutherlands backed the Hanoverian government in the Jacobite risings of 1715 and 1745, helping defeat the rebels at Littleferry in 1746.
zh:
萨瑟兰家族世居苏格兰极北之地，先祖可追溯到大卫一世安置的佛兰德斯骑士弗雷斯金。其孙休·德·莫拉维亚受封萨瑟兰的土地，休之子威廉成为第一代萨瑟兰伯爵；家族到15世纪已改用取自领地的姓氏。

第三代伯爵参加了1314年的班诺克本战役，伯爵肯尼思于1333年战死在哈利顿山。其子威廉于1346年与大卫二世一同在内维尔十字被俘，1370年在与麦凯家族的世仇中被杀。

1517年，女伯爵伊丽莎白·萨瑟兰嫁给亚当·戈登，伯爵领转入戈登一系。萨瑟兰人在1715年和1745年的詹姆斯党起事中支持汉诺威政府，并于1746年在利特尔费里协助击败叛军。

en:
The Suwa were the priest-lords of the Suwa basin in Shinano, hereditary chief priests of the Upper Shrine of Suwa Taisha. They combined religious authority as the living vessel of Suwa Daimyojin with secular rule over Suwa district.

In 1335 the chief priest Yorishige and his son Tokitsugu raised the Hojo heir Tokiyuki in the Nakasendai war and briefly seized Kamakura, but were defeated and killed by Ashikaga Takauji. Tokitsugu's son Yoritsugu rebuilt the house. After the Onin war the Suwa crushed the rival Kanasashi of the Lower Shrine and united the basin.

Their independence ended in 1542 when Takeda Shingen had the lord Yorishige murdered and absorbed Suwa. In 1582 Yoritada restored the house; after Sekigahara his son Yorimizu became lord of Takashima, while a separated branch carried on the chief priesthood.
zh:
诹访氏是信浓国诹访盆地的领主，世代担任诹访大社上社的大祝。他们既以诹访大明神依代的身份掌握宗教权威，也统治诹访郡。

1335年，大祝赖重与其子时继拥立北条遗孤时行，在中先代之乱中一度占领镰仓，终被足利尊氏击败身死。时继之子赖嗣重整家势。应仁之乱后，诹访氏攻灭下社的金刺氏，一统盆地。

1542年武田信玄谋杀当主赖重，吞并诹访，其独立地位随之终结。1582年赖忠再兴本家；关原之战后其子赖水受封高岛藩，分出的支流则承袭大祝之职。

en:
The Suwaydid were the Kurdish beys of the Emirate of Bingol, also called the Suveydi principality, around Capakcur in the Armenian highlands. Kurdish tribes settled there in the Ayyubid period founded the beylik in the 1240s.

Sharaf Khan Bidlisi recorded a legend that its emirs descended from the Barmakids and had ruled since the days of Harun al-Rashid. As vassals of the Mongols, the Kara Koyunlu and the Aq Qoyunlu, the Suwaydid kept their lands.

Early in the sixteenth century the Safavids captured Capakcur, but Emir Abdal Bey held Hancuk against them. After his death in 1510 his son Isfahan Bey succeeded him; following the battle of Chaldiran in 1514 the emirs became Ottoman vassals. The inheritance later split into Genc and Bingol, which fell under the Palu emirate in the early seventeenth century.
zh:
苏韦德家族是宾格尔埃米尔国（又称苏韦迪酋长国）的库尔德贝伊家族，领地围绕亚美尼亚高地的恰帕克丘尔。13世纪40年代，阿尤布王朝时期迁入当地的库尔德部落建立了贝伊国。

沙拉夫汗·比特利西记载了一则传说，称其埃米尔出自巴尔马克家族，早在哈伦·拉希德时代便已统治此地。苏韦德人先后臣属于蒙古人、黑羊王朝和白羊王朝，保住了领地。

16世纪初，萨非王朝攻占恰帕克丘尔，但埃米尔阿卜达尔贝伊死守汉丘克要塞。1510年他去世后，其子伊斯法罕贝伊继位，1514年恰尔德兰战役后埃米尔们转为奥斯曼的附庸。后来领地分成根奇和宾格尔，在17世纪初落入帕鲁埃米尔国的控制。

en:
The House of Sverre was the Norwegian royal dynasty founded by Sverre Sigurdsson, a priest from the Faroe Islands who claimed to be an illegitimate son of King Sigurd II. He took command of the rebel Birkebeiner party in 1177 and made himself sole king after the Battle of Fimreite in 1184, though his quarrel with the Church ended in excommunication in 1194 and a new round of civil war.

Under his grandson Haakon IV the civil wars ended and Norway reached the height of its medieval power. The male line ran out with Haakon V in 1319, when the crown passed to his daughter Ingeborg's son Magnus VII of the House of Bjelbo.

Through Ingeborg the Sverre blood entered the House of Oldenburg, reaching Christian I, king of Denmark from 1448 and of Norway from 1450.
zh:
斯韦勒家族是挪威的王室王朝，开创者斯韦雷·西居尔松本是法罗群岛的神父，自称国王西居尔二世的私生子。他于1177年接掌叛乱的桦皮鞋党，1184年在菲姆雷泰战役后成为唯一的国王，但与教会的冲突使他在1194年被绝罚，并引发新一轮内战。

到他的孙子哈康四世在位时，内战终告结束，挪威王国达到中世纪权势的顶峰。1319年哈康五世去世，男嗣断绝，王位传给其女英格堡之子、比耶尔博家族的马格努斯七世。

斯韦勒的血脉通过英格堡流入奥尔登堡家族，传到1448年就任丹麦国王、1450年又成为挪威国王的克里斯蒂安一世身上。

en:
The Synadenos family, named after Synada in Phrygia, was a Byzantine aristocratic house whose name appears on seals as early as the ninth or tenth century. Its first known member, Philetos Synadenos, served as judge of Tarsus around the year 1000.

In the Empire of Nicaea the house opposed the Laskaris and reached its peak under the Palaiologoi. John Synadenos married Theodora Palaiologina, niece of Michael VIII; the couple founded the convent of Bebaia Elpis and left an illustrated typikon portraying the family.

Their son Theodore supported Andronikos III in the civil war of 1321 to 1328 and later governed Epirus, where rebels held him captive from 1338 to 1340. In the civil war of 1341 to 1347 the Zealots of Thessalonica drove him out of the city, and he died under house arrest in Constantinople around 1346.
zh:
西纳齐诺斯家族得名于弗里吉亚的叙纳达，是拜占庭的贵族世家，其姓氏在9至10世纪的印章上已经出现。已知最早的成员费莱托斯约在1000年任塔尔苏斯法官。

尼西亚帝国时期，该家族属于反对拉斯卡里斯王朝的贵族阵营；帕里奥洛格斯朝时家族达到鼎盛。约翰·西纳齐诺斯娶米哈伊尔八世的侄女狄奥多拉为妻，夫妇创立了贝维亚·埃尔皮斯修道院，留下一部绘有家族成员肖像的彩绘仪轨。

其子狄奥多尔支持安德罗尼卡三世参与1321至1328年内战，后来出任伊庇鲁斯总督，1338至1340年被起事者囚禁。1341至1347年内战中，他被塞萨洛尼基的狂热党逐出该城，约1346年在君士坦丁堡的软禁中去世。

en:
The Tacettinoğulları, or Beylik of Taceddin, was a Turkmen principality of northern Anatolia among the Beyliks of Canik. Its founder Taceddin established himself at Niksar in the mid-fourteenth century as Seljuk and Ilkhanid authority faded.

In 1378 he married Eudokia, daughter of the Trapezuntine emperor Alexios III; he fell in battle near Ordu in 1386. His son Mahmud accepted Kadı Burhaneddin's overlordship while secretly favoring Bayezid I, and after 1398 submitted to the Ottomans.

Mahmud kept his lands through Timur's invasion of 1402 and the Ottoman Interregnum, but backing the rebel Küçük Mustafa cost him his life in 1423, when his own soldiers killed him. His two sons held on around Samsun and Çarşamba for a few years until the beylik was absorbed by the Ottomans around 1428.
zh:
塔杰丁奥卢又称塔杰丁贝伊国，是安纳托利亚北部的土库曼小邦，属于贾尼克诸贝伊国之一。随着塞尔柱与伊儿汗权威的瓦解，始祖塔杰丁于14世纪中期以尼克萨尔为中心立国。

1378年他娶特拉布宗皇帝阿莱克修斯三世之女埃夫多基娅为妻，1386年在奥尔杜一带阵亡。其子马哈茂德接受卡迪·布尔汉丁的宗主权，同时暗中偏袒巴耶济德一世，1398年后归顺奥斯曼。

1402年帖木儿入侵和奥斯曼空位期里马哈茂德保住了领地，却因支持叛乱的小穆斯塔法，于1423年被自己的士兵所杀。他的两个儿子在萨姆松和恰尔尚巴一带又支撑数年，约1428年贝伊国被奥斯曼吞并。

en:
The Ibn Tafrājin were an Almohad sheikhly family of Hafsid Ifriqiya, remembered above all for Abu Muhammad Abd Allah ibn Tafrājin, the power behind the Hafsid throne in Tunis in the mid-fourteenth century. He became chief chamberlain in 1343, steering the court toward the Marinids, who had become its neighbours after conquering Tlemcen in 1337.

When a succession murder brought chaos in 1346 and 1347, he welcomed the invasion of the Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan and then, after the Marinids withdrew, emerged as the most influential of the Almohad sheikhs.

In December 1349 he placed al-Fadl Ahmad II on the throne, deposed him the next year and ruled in the name of the young sultan Abu Ishaq Ibrahim until his own death in 1364.
zh:
伊本·塔夫拉金是哈夫斯治下伊弗里基叶的穆瓦希德谢赫家族，最著名的成员是阿布·穆罕默德·阿卜杜拉·伊本·塔夫拉金，14世纪中期突尼斯哈夫斯王座背后的实权人物。他于1343年成为首席侍从长，推动宫廷亲近马林人；后者1337年征服特莱姆森后已成为哈夫斯的邻居。

1346至1347年继位谋杀引发乱局，他迎入马林苏丹阿布·哈桑的入侵；马林人撤退后，他成为穆瓦希德谢赫中最有权势者。

1349年12月他拥立法德勒·艾哈迈德二世，次年又将其废黜，以年轻的苏丹阿布·易司哈格·易卜拉欣的名义执政，直到1364年去世。

en:
The Takashima were a samurai house of Ōmi Province, descended from the Uda Genji line of the Sasaki clan. Their founder Takashima Takanobu, a younger son of Sasaki Nobutsuna, took his name from Takashima District and held Shimizuyama Castle. His son Yasunobu served the Kamakura shogunate as a gokenin.

In the Shimotsuki Disturbance of 1285 another of Takanobu's sons, Yoritsuna, fought for Taira no Yoritsuna and received the Kutsukidani valley, from which his son began the Kutsuki clan. The main line, descended from Yasunobu's heir Yasuuji, held the governorship of Etchū hereditarily and was called the Sasaki-Etchū house.

In the Muromachi period the Takashima served as the Ashikaga shōguns' direct troops and monopolised the guard posts of the twelve barriers of northern Ōmi. In the Sengoku age they came under the Rokkaku and declined when the Rokkaku were destroyed.
zh:
高岛氏是近江国的武家，出自宇多源氏佐佐木氏一脉。始祖佐佐木信纲次男高岛高信以近江高岛郡为姓，居城为清水山城；其子泰信作为御家人效力镰仓幕府。

1285年霜月骚动中，高信另一子赖纲站在平赖纲一方，分得朽木谷，其子自此称朽木氏。泰信的继承人泰氏继承本家，其一脉世袭越中守一职，也被称作佐佐木越中氏。

室町时代，高岛氏成为足利将军的直属部队，并独占北近江十二关的关守之职。进入战国时代，高岛氏沦为六角氏的属下，六角氏灭亡后随之没落。

en:
The Takeda were a Seiwa Genji clan of Kai, tracing to Minamoto no Yoshimitsu, whose son Yoshikiyo took the Takeda name from a Hitachi estate before the family settled in Kai. They backed Yoritomo in the Genpei War; Nobumitsu's Ichinotani service in 1184 earned him Kai's constableship, and his Jokyu War part in 1221 added Aki. From these came the Kai main line and several cadet houses.

Nobutora united Kai but was deposed in 1541 by his son Harunobu, the future Takeda Shingen. Shingen built a cavalry-famed army, seized Shinano, and fought rival Uesugi Kenshin in the five Kawanakajima battles from 1553, the bloodiest in 1561.

After routing Tokugawa Ieyasu at Mikatagahara in 1573 Shingen died of illness on campaign; heir Katsuyori was crushed by Oda Nobunaga's muskets at Nagashino in 1575, and the clan fell in Nobunaga's 1582 invasion of Kai, Katsuyori killing himself at Tenmokuzan. Survivors and cadet lines served the Tokugawa shogunate, some as daimyo and others in the ceremonial High Families.
zh:
武田氏是以甲斐国为根基的清和源氏武家，始祖可追溯到源义光，其子义清因受封常陆国武田乡而取此姓，后来一族定居甲斐。源平合战中他们支持源赖朝，信光在1184年一之谷之战立功，被任为甲斐守护，又因1221年承久之乱的战功兼任安艺守护。由此发展出甲斐宗家与若干旁支。

战国时代信虎统一甲斐，却在1541年被儿子晴信放逐；晴信即武田信玄，他打造以骑兵著称的精锐军队，攻取信浓，与宿敌上杉谦信自1553年起五次会战川中岛，以1561年一战最为惨烈。

1573年信玄在三方原大破德川家康后病逝军中，继承人胜赖1575年在长筱之战被织田信长的铁炮兵击溃；1582年信长攻入甲斐，胜赖在天目山自尽，武田宗家灭亡。幸存族人及旁支后来侍奉德川幕府，有的成为大名，有的位列执掌礼仪的高家。

en:
The Takō, also written Takō 多劫, were a cadet branch of the Utsunomiya clan of Shimotsuke. They began in 1248, when Takō Munetomo, seventh son of Utsunomiya Yoritsuna, built Takō Castle in Kawachi District and took his surname from the place; the castle remained the family seat for three hundred and fifty years.

In 1558 their lord Nagatomo held Takō Castle against Uesugi Kenshin, killing the Sano commander Toyotsuna during the siege. The castle also weathered attacks by Hōjō Ujimasa in 1572 and 1584.

In 1590 Takō troops served as Utsunomiya Kunitsuna's deputies in Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign. When the Utsunomiya were attainted in 1597 the Takō lost their lands, and some later entered the service of the Matsudaira of Imabari.
zh:
多功氏（亦作多劫氏）是下野宇都宫氏的旁支。1248年，宇都宫赖纲的第七子多功宗朝在河内郡修筑多功城并以地名为姓，此城此后三百五十年间一直是多功氏的居城。

1558年，多功长朝死守多功城，抵御上杉谦信的军队，还击毙了敌将佐野丰纲。1572年和1584年，城池又两次顶住北条氏政的进攻。

1590年丰臣秀吉发动小田原征伐时，多功氏作为宇都宫国纲的名代从军。1597年宇都宫氏被改易，多功氏也失去领地，部分族人后来出仕今治藩的松平氏。

en:
The Taku were a local warrior house of Hizen province in northern Kyushu, descended from the Tsukui clan and settled in the Taku basin. Around 1193 Taku Munenao built Kajimine Castle, also called Taku Castle, on the summit of Mount Kajimine, and it remained the family seat for more than three hundred and fifty years.

In the mid-sixteenth century the Taku joined Arima, Ōmura and other Hizen chiefs resisting the rise of the Ryūzōji. In 1544 Ryūzōji Chikaie took Kajimine and drove out Taku Munetoki, although Arima help restored the family the next year.

Ryūzōji Takanobu and his brother Naganobu seized the castle again in 1562, driving the Taku to Suko, and Taku Munetoshi's resistance was broken in 1563. The old Taku house then ended, and Naganobu's descendants, known as the later Taku, took over the district.
zh:
多久氏是九州北部肥前国的地方武家，出自津久井氏，定居在多久盆地。约1193年多久宗直在梶峰山顶修筑梶峰城，又名多久城，此后三百五十多年间一直是多久氏的居城。

16世纪中叶，多久氏与有马氏、大村氏等肥前诸将联合，对抗崛起的龙造寺氏。1544年龙造寺周家攻陷梶峰城，多久宗时出逃，翌年靠有马氏支援才得以复归。

1562年龙造寺隆信、长信兄弟再度攻陷城池，多久氏退往须古，1563年多久宗利也被击败。前多久氏就此终结，接管该地区的长信一脉被称为后多久氏。

en:
The Talbots were a gentry family established on the Welsh march in Herefordshire and Gloucestershire since the twelfth century, when Henry II granted them lands there. They claimed kinship with the Welsh princes through Gwenllian, daughter of Rhys Mechyll of the House of Dinefwr, whose arms the family assumed.

Gilbert Talbot became the first Baron Talbot by writ in 1331. His son Richard, the second baron, married Elizabeth Comyn, heiress to estates including Goodrich Castle; as one of the disinherited lords he joined Edward Balliol's invasions of Scotland during the Second War of Scottish Independence.

The Talbots reached their greatest eminence in the fifteenth century, when John Talbot, a commander in the Hundred Years' War, was created Earl of Shrewsbury in 1442. The earls of Shrewsbury became the senior line of the family.
zh:
塔尔博特家族是12世纪起在威尔士边境的赫里福德郡和格洛斯特郡立足的乡绅家族，领地由亨利二世册封。他们声称通过迪内弗尔家族的里斯·梅希尔之女格温利安与威尔士王公有血缘，并沿用了她家族的纹章。

吉尔伯特·塔尔博特于1331年凭议会召集状成为第一代塔尔博特男爵。其子、第二代男爵理查德娶了女继承人伊丽莎白·科明，得到包括古德里奇城堡在内的地产；作为被剥夺继承权的贵族之一，他在第二次苏格兰独立战争中追随爱德华·巴利奥尔入侵苏格兰。

塔尔博特家族在15世纪达到鼎盛，百年战争将领约翰·塔尔博特于1442年受封什鲁斯伯里伯爵。什鲁斯伯里伯爵一脉由此成为家族主支。

en:
The Tamura were a warrior clan of Tamura district in southern Mutsu who claimed descent from the early Heian general Sakanoue no Tamuramaro. The Tamura shoji house held the district from the Kamakura period, fought for the Southern Court and was destroyed after its rising in 1396.

Leadership passed to the Miharu Tamura, who built Miharu castle from 1504 and held nearly a hundred thousand koku. Takaakira submitted to the Date after defeat in 1541, and Kiyoaki married his daughter Megohime to Date Masamune to secure the clan's survival.

Kiyoaki died without a male heir in 1586, and in the 1590 Oshu settlement the Tamura were attainted for missing the Odawara campaign. The house was revived in 1652 when a son of Date Tadamune was enfeoffed at Iwanuma as Tamura Muneyoshi; his line moved to Ichinoseki and continued as a Sendai branch daimyo.
zh:
田村氏是陆奥国南部田村郡的武家，据称是平安时代初期武将坂上田村麻吕的后裔。镰仓以来，担任庄司的田村家领有田村庄，南北朝时站在南朝一方，1396年发动田村庄司之乱后被攻灭。

此后三春田村氏取而代之，1504年起营建三春城，领有近十万石。隆显于1541年战败后臣服伊达氏；清显把女儿爱姬嫁给伊达政宗以换取家族存续。

1586年清显去世且无男嗣，1590年奥州仕置以未参阵小田原为由将田村氏改易。田村家在1652年再兴：伊达忠宗之子分领岩沼，改称田村宗良，其后移封一关，作为仙台藩的分家大名存续。

en:
The Tanwar, better known as the Tomar, were a Rajput clan whose chiefs once ruled Delhi and built the fort of Lal Kot. In 1064 a branch led by Jhetpal, younger brother of the Tomar raja Anangpal II, founded the hill state of Dhameri between the Ravi and Beas rivers; after garrisoning Pathankot the family took the name Pathania.

In 1337 its rajas still held this principality, the later Nurpur kingdom. The state reached its height under Raja Basu Dev between 1580 and 1613 and was then drawn into the Mughal orbit.

In 1620 Raja Jagat Singh renamed Dhameri as Nurpur to honour Jahangir and Nur Jahan. The kingdom shook off Mughal suzerainty during Nader Shah's invasion of 1739, but in 1815 Ranjit Singh of the Sikh Empire annexed it.
zh:
坦瓦尔人通常称托马尔，是一个拉杰普特部族，其首领曾统治德里并修建拉尔科特堡垒。1064年，托马尔罗阇阿南格帕尔二世之弟杰特帕尔率一支族人在拉维河与比亚斯河之间建立达姆里山邦；家族因驻守帕坦科特而以帕塔尼亚为氏。

1337年，该家族的罗阇仍统治着这个小邦，也就是后来的努尔布尔王国。1580年至1613年罗阇巴苏·德夫在位时国势最盛，随后被纳入莫卧儿轨道。

1620年，罗阇贾格特·辛格为向贾汉吉尔和努尔·贾汉致敬，将达姆里改名为努尔布尔。1739年纳迪尔沙入侵期间，努尔布尔王国摆脱了莫卧儿宗主权，但1815年锡克帝国的兰吉特·辛格吞并了这个王国。

en:
The Banu Talis were a Hawwara Berber dynasty who ruled the emirate of Bani Walid in the Tripolitanian interior. Their founder, the Kairouan scholar Sheikh Ahmad ibn Talis, arrived in the Wadi Bani Walid in 1228, either fleeing a dispute in Kairouan or sent by the Hafsids.

Local Hawwara Berbers and Hilali Arabs gathered around him. He built the Ibn Talis Palace, dug three to four hundred wells and founded zawiyas, and Bani Walid flourished through trade, agriculture and pottery.

The emirate repelled a Spanish attack on Masalata in 1510, but the Ottomans proved too strong. The last prince, Ali II, resisted for twenty-six years until an Ottoman army of ten thousand, backed by local tribes, stormed Qasr Bin Talis in 1603, burned Bani Walid and killed most of the ruling family, ending the emirate.
zh:
泰利斯家族是胡瓦拉柏柏尔人的王朝，在的黎波里塔尼亚内陆统治拜尼沃利德酋长国。始祖凯鲁万学者谢赫艾哈迈德·伊本·塔利斯于1228年来到拜尼沃利德干河，一说因凯鲁万的纷争而出逃，一说受哈夫斯王朝委派。

当地的胡瓦拉柏柏尔人与希拉尔阿拉伯人纷纷投附。他修建伊本·塔利斯宫，开凿三四百口水井，广建扎维叶道堂，拜尼沃利德凭借贸易、农业和制陶业兴盛起来。

1510年，酋长国击退了西班牙人对姆塞拉塔的进攻，却终究不敌奥斯曼人。末代君主阿里二世抵抗了二十六年，1603年奥斯曼一万大军在当地部落支持下攻陷本·塔利斯堡，焚毁拜尼沃利德，屠戮统治家族大半，酋长国灭亡。

en:
The Tenochcatl were the ruling line of the Mexica, or Tenochca, who built Tenochtitlan on an island in Lake Texcoco in 1325. Their name remembers Tenoch, who led the Mexica south from Aztlán and after whom the city was named, though sources disagree on whether he was a historical ruler or a later myth.

After his death the elders elected Acamapichtli, son of the Mexica leader Opochtli Iztahuatzin and the Culhua princess Atotoztli. He ruled from about 1375 as the first tlatoani, his city then a tributary of the Tepanec power Azcapotzalco.

His later successor Itzcoatl forged the Triple Alliance with Tetzcoco and Tlacopan in 1427 and 1428, shaking off that overlordship, and the Tenochca tlatoque went on to lead the Aztec Empire. The line ended in the Spanish siege and destruction of Tenochtitlan in 1521, with the last dynastic tlatoani Cuauhtémoc put to death a few years later.
zh:
特诺奇卡特尔是墨西加人（又称特诺奇人）的统治世系；1325年，这支人在特斯科科湖的一座岛上建起特诺奇蒂特兰。他们的名字来自特诺奇：他率领墨西加人从阿兹特兰南下，城市也以他命名，但史料对他究竟是真实首领还是后世神话人物说法不一。

他死后，长老选出墨西加首领奥波奇特利·伊斯塔瓦钦与科尔瓦公主阿托托斯特利之子阿卡马皮奇特利。他约1375年成为首任特拉托阿尼，当时这座岛城还是特帕内克强权阿斯卡波察尔科的附庸。

后继者伊茨科特尔于1427至1428年与特斯科科、特拉科潘结成三方联盟，摆脱宗主权，特诺奇的特拉托阿尼们进而领导阿兹特克帝国。1521年西班牙人围城并摧毁特诺奇蒂特兰，这一世系告终，末代王朝特拉托阿尼夸乌特莫克数年后被处死。

en:
The Tepanecatl were the royal house of the Tepanecs, whose capital Azcapotzalco became the dominant power of the Valley of Mexico. Acolnahuacatl, ruling from 1283 to 1343, moved the seat to Azcapotzalco and allowed the Mexica to found Tenochtitlan on Tepanec land in return for tribute and military service.

His son Tezozomoc, born around 1320 and ruling from the 1360s to 1426, made the Tepanec Empire the valley's hegemon. He held Tenochtitlan as a tributary and seized Texcoco after killing its king Ixtlilxochitl I in 1419.

His death in 1426 opened a succession war between his sons Tayatzin and Maxtla. Two years later the Mexica of Itzcoatl and the exiled Texcocan prince Nezahualcoyotl, joined by Tlacopan, stormed Azcapotzalco and ended Tepanec supremacy in the campaign that created the Triple Alliance.
zh:
特帕内卡特尔家族是特帕内克人的王室，其都城阿斯卡波察尔科崛起为墨西哥谷地的霸主。阿科尔纳瓦卡尔1283年至1343年在位，把统治中心迁到阿斯卡波察尔科，并允许墨西加人在特帕内克土地上建立特诺奇蒂特兰，条件是纳贡和服兵役。

他的儿子特索索莫克约生于1320年，14世纪60年代起统治至1426年，把特帕内克帝国建成谷地霸权。他令特诺奇蒂特兰纳贡，又在1419年杀死特斯科科国王伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世后吞并该城。

1426年他去世后，两个儿子塔亚钦和马斯特拉爆发继位之争。两年后，伊茨科特尔率领的墨西加人与流亡的特斯科科王子内萨瓦尔科约特尔联合特拉科潘攻陷阿斯卡波察尔科，终结特帕内克霸权，这场战事也催生了三方联盟。

en:
The Ternate dynasty ruled the clove island of Ternate in the Moluccas, originally as the Kingdom of Gapi. The island's four villages were led by clan chiefs called Momole; tradition says that in 1257 they elected Momole Cico as their first king, with the regnal name Baab Mashur Malamo, and the rulers later took the title Kolano. Clove sales to Arab, Malay and Chinese merchants made Ternate and its rival Tidore the wealthiest polities of eastern Indonesia, though much of their wealth was spent warring with each other. King Marhum became the first Muslim ruler in the 1460s, and his son Zainal Abidin enacted Islamic law and replaced the royal title with Sultan around 1486.

The Portuguese, brought to the island by Sultan Bayan Sirrullah in 1512, built a fort but fell out with the court; after they murdered Sultan Hairun, a five-year siege ended with their expulsion in 1575 under Sultan Baabullah, whose reign carried Ternate's influence to Sulawesi, Ambon, Timor and the southern Philippines. Spain seized the island in 1606 and the Dutch built their own fort there in 1607, dividing the Moluccas between them. Sultan Sibori Amsterdam's war against the Dutch ended in defeat and a vassal treaty in 1683; a British occupation of 1810 gave way to Dutch rule again in 1817, and in 1824 Ternate became the capital of a Dutch residency spanning Halmahera and the New Guinea coast.
zh:
特尔纳特王朝统治着摩鹿加群岛中盛产丁香的特尔纳特岛，政权初名加皮王国。岛上原有四个由称“莫莫莱”的氏族首领统领的村落；相传1257年，他们推举莫莫莱·奇科为第一位国王，王号巴阿卜·马舒尔·马拉莫，后来的君主改称“科拉诺”。丁香销往阿拉伯、马来和中国商人，使特尔纳特与其劲敌蒂多雷成为印尼东部最富庶的政权，不过大量财富都耗在彼此攻伐上。15世纪60年代，国王马尔胡姆成为首位穆斯林君主，他的儿子扎伊纳尔·阿比丁颁行伊斯兰教法，并于1486年前后把君主称号改为苏丹。

1512年，苏丹巴彦·西鲁拉把葡萄牙人引上岛屿，葡人修筑堡垒，却与宫廷反目；葡人杀害苏丹海鲁恩后，特尔纳特人围攻五年，于1575年在苏丹巴布拉治下将其逐出，巴布拉在位时特尔纳特的势力远达苏拉威西、安汶、帝汶和菲律宾南部。1606年西班牙夺取该岛，1607年荷兰人又在岛上筑堡，摩鹿加由此被两国瓜分。苏丹锡博里·阿姆斯特丹对荷开战失败，于1683年签订附庸条约；1810年英国一度占领，1817年恢复荷兰统治，1824年特尔纳特成为荷兰驻扎区的首府，辖地涵盖哈马黑拉和新几内亚海岸。

en:
The House of Terter was a Bulgarian royal house of Cuman origin, descended from the Terteroba clan of the Cuman-Kipchak confederation. The clan settled in Bulgaria after 1241. George seized the Bulgarian throne as George Terter I in 1280.

When George stepped down in 1292 the country fell under the Golden Horde, which imposed puppet rulers until George's son Theodore Svetoslav overthrew the Mongol-backed Chaka in 1300 and restored the dynasty. Theodore Svetoslav retook northeastern fortresses, curbed separatist nobles and executed the patriarch Joachim III, leaving a stable, enlarged realm to his son George Terter II.

George's early death in 1323 ended the line on the throne, and the crown passed to the Shishman dynasty of Vidin. Through marriage the Terterids entered Balkan politics: Anna became queen of Stefan Uroš II Milutin of Serbia.
zh:
捷尔捷尔家族是出身库曼人的保加利亚王室，先祖属于库曼—钦察联盟的捷尔捷罗巴氏族，在1241年之后定居保加利亚。格奥尔基于1280年登上保加利亚皇位，称格奥尔基·捷尔捷尔一世。

1292年他退位后，保加利亚落入金帐汗国的控制，接连被扶立傀儡君主，直到格奥尔基之子托多尔·斯维托斯拉夫于1300年推翻蒙古人支持的查卡，恢复家族统治。斯维托斯拉夫收复东北要塞，镇压割据贵族，处死牧首约阿希姆三世，把稳定且版图扩大的国家留给儿子格奥尔基二世。

格奥尔基二世于1323年早逝，家族皇统断绝，皇位转入维丁的希什曼王朝。通过联姻，捷尔捷尔家族卷入巴尔干政局：安娜嫁给塞尔维亚的斯特凡·乌罗什二世·米卢廷为后。

en:
The Banu Thabit, also called the Banu Ammar, were a Berber dynasty of the Huwwara confederation who ruled Tripoli in the fourteenth century. Their founder Thabit ibn Ammar seized the city around 1324 but was murdered within months; his son Muhammad took command in 1326 or 1327 and governed almost independently of Tunis until he was assassinated around 1348.

Muhammad's son Thabit lost the city to a Genoese expedition in 1354 or 1355 and was killed soon after. The surviving family fled to Alexandria, prospered as merchants, and used their fortune to return and retake Tripoli in 1369 or 1370 under Abu Bakr.

His nephew Ali then ruled until the Hafsid sultan Abu Faris Abd al-Aziz II arrested him and reconquered the city in 1401, ending the dynasty and bringing Tripoli back under direct Tunisian rule.
zh:
萨比特家族又称阿马尔家族，是出自胡瓦拉部落联盟的柏柏尔人王朝，在14世纪统治的黎波里。始祖萨比特·伊本·阿马尔约于1324年夺取该城，但几个月后即遇刺；其子穆罕默德于1326或1327年接掌城市，几乎独立于突尼斯，直到约1348年被暗杀。

穆罕默德之子萨比特在1354或1355年被热那亚远征军夺去城市，不久被杀。幸存的族人逃到亚历山大经商致富，用积攒的财富在阿布·伯克尔率领下于1369或1370年反攻收复的黎波里。

阿布·伯克尔之后由侄子阿里继位，哈夫斯苏丹阿布·法里斯·阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹二世将阿里逮捕，并于1401年重新攻占该城，萨比特王朝灭亡，的黎波里重新归入突尼斯的直接统治。

en: The Thakial, or Thakyal, were the Rajput clan ruling the Bhimber hills of the western Punjab Himalaya before 1400. Their last king, Raja Sripat, gave his daughter in marriage to Chib Chand, a Katoch prince of Kangra, who inherited the Thakial lands and founded the Chib dynasty of Chibhal.
zh: 塔基亚尔是1400年以前统治旁遮普喜马拉雅西段比姆伯尔山区的拉杰普特氏族。末代罗阇斯里帕特将女儿嫁给冈格拉卡托奇家族的王子契布·昌德，后者继承其领地，建立了契巴尔的契布王朝。

en:
The Thakur family were Srotriya Maithil Brahmins of Mithila, better known as the Oiniwar or Sugauna dynasty. The scholar Nath Thakur served the Karnat kings and was granted Oini, from which the house took its name. When the Karnat kingdom collapsed under the Delhi invasion of 1324, its former chief priest Kameshwar Thakur succeeded to the rule of Mithila in 1325.

The dynasty moved its court between villages of the Darbhanga country and patronised Maithili letters; the poet Vidyapati served seven of its kings and two queens and composed his Kirtilata for King Kirtisimha.
