The last ruler, Laxminath Singh Deva, was assassinated by Nusrat Shah of Bengal, and in 1526 Oiniwar rule gave way to decades of strife from which the Raj Darbhanga house emerged.
zh:
他俱罗家族是弥萨罗的什罗蒂亚迈蒂利婆罗门，世称奥伊尼瓦尔王朝，又称苏高纳王朝。学者纳特·塔库尔曾侍奉卡尔纳特诸王，受封奥伊尼村，家族由此得名。1324年卡尔纳特王国在德里的入侵下崩溃，曾任其首席祭司的卡姆什瓦尔·塔库尔于1325年继掌弥萨罗。

该王朝在达尔彭加一带数次迁都，并扶持迈蒂利文学；诗人维迪亚帕蒂曾侍奉七王二后，并为国王基尔蒂辛哈创作《基尔蒂拉塔》。

末代君主拉克希米纳特·辛格·提婆被孟加拉的努斯拉特沙刺杀，1526年奥伊尼瓦尔的统治结束，弥萨罗陷入数十年纷争，最终由达尔彭加王室取而代之。

en:
The Theemuge, also called the Homa or Lunar dynasty, was the first house to rule the whole Maldives. Its early king Koimala, enthroned around 1117, reclaimed the northern atolls from Indian invaders. In 1153 the last Buddhist king, Dhovemi, accepted Islam and ruled as Sultan Muhammad al-Adil, after which the line became known as the Theemuge dynasty.

In 1337 Sultan Omar I ruled. His son Ahmed Shihabuddine was deposed and killed in 1347 by his sister Khadijah, the first sultana of the dynasty, whom Ibn Battuta found reigning in Malé in the 1340s. Twice deposed and restored, she ruled for nearly thirty years until 1379.

Her half-sister Raadhafathi succeeded her, but the house was running out of heirs. Around 1388 Hassan I of the Hilaalee family overthrew Sultan Uthman Rasgefaan, ending Theemuge rule and opening the Hilaalee dynasty.
zh:
提穆格王朝又称霍马或月王朝，是第一个统治整个马尔代夫的家族。早期国王科伊马拉约于1117年即位，从印度入侵者手中收复北部环礁。1153年，末代佛教国王多维米皈依伊斯兰教，以苏丹穆罕默德·阿迪勒之名统治，王统此后改称提穆格王朝。

1337年在位的是苏丹奥马尔一世。其子艾哈迈德·希哈布丁于1347年被妹妹赫蒂彻废黜杀害，赫蒂彻成为王朝第一位女苏丹；伊本·白图泰14世纪40年代造访马累时，正是她在位之时。她曾两度被废黜又两度复位，前后统治近三十年，直至1379年。

继她而立的是异母妹拉达法蒂，但王室子嗣凋零。约1388年希拉利家族的哈桑一世推翻苏丹奥斯曼·拉斯格凡，提穆格统治告终，希拉利王朝开启。

en:
The Thopia were an Albanian feudal family, first attested among the nobles who made pact with Charles I of Anjou in 1274. As Angevin vassals they rose as counts of Mat, and by 1340 held much of the country between the Mati and Shkumbin rivers.

A legend marks their link to Naples: Andrea Thopia abducted Hélène, an illegitimate daughter of King Robert of Naples, and the two were executed, leaving the sons Karl and George. Karl ruled central Albanian domains from 1358, seized Durrës in 1368 and defeated Balša II at Savra in 1385 with Ottoman help, at the price of Ottoman overlordship. He founded the church of Saint Jovan Vladimir near Elbasan in 1381.

His son Gjergj lost Durrës to Venice in 1392, but the house served Skanderbeg. Skanderbeg's commander Tanush Thopia held Krujë during its second siege.
zh:
托皮亚家族是阿尔巴尼亚的封建家族，最早见于1274年与安茹的查理缔约的贵族名单。作为安茹的封臣，他们起家为马蒂伯爵，到1340年已控制马蒂河与什昆宾河之间的大片土地。

家族与那不勒斯的联系带着一段传奇：安德烈·托皮亚劫走那不勒斯国王罗伯特的私生女埃莱娜，两人被处死，留下卡尔和乔治两个儿子。卡尔1358年起统治阿尔巴尼亚中部领地，1368年夺取都拉斯，1385年借奥斯曼之力在萨夫拉击败巴尔沙二世，代价是接受奥斯曼宗主权。他于1381年在爱尔巴桑附近修建圣约万·弗拉基米尔教堂。

其子格奥尔基于1392年把都拉斯丢给威尼斯，但家族存续下来，侍奉斯坎德培。斯坎德培的将领塔努什·托皮亚在第二次克鲁亚保卫战中统领守军。

en:
The viscounts of Thouars emerged in the late ninth century as officers of the count of Poitou, governing the Thouarsais of northern Aquitaine from Thouars castle. Probably sprung from Poitiers landowners, they grew rich on abbey patronage and Bressuire estates; Poitevin custom let the viscounty pass from brother to brother rather than directly from father to son.

Aimery IV of Thouars crossed the Channel with William the Conqueror and fought at Hastings in 1066. From 1150 to 1230 the family steered between the Capetian kings and the Plantagenets. Its most famous branch entered Brittany when Guy of Thouars married Duchess Constance in 1199, ruling jure uxoris and then regent for his daughter Alix in 1203—1206.

In the Hundred Years' War Thouars was seized by the Black Prince and later retaken for France by Bertrand du Guesclin. The line ended with a viscountess dying in 1397; the viscounty passed to Amboise and then the La Trémoille, who made it a duchy in 1563.
zh:
图阿尔子爵家族出现于9世纪末，最初是普瓦捷伯爵的属官，以图阿尔城堡为中心治理阿基坦北部的图阿尔地区。他们可能出身普瓦捷附近的地主，靠捐赠修道院和经营布勒叙伊尔等地的地产致富；普瓦图习俗允许子爵领在兄弟间依次相传，而非直接父传子。

艾梅里四世随征服者威廉渡过海峡，参加1066年黑斯廷斯战役。1150年至1230年间，家族周旋于卡佩法王与金雀花王朝之间。最显赫的支系进入布列塔尼政坛：居伊·德·图阿尔1199年娶女公爵康斯坦丝，以妻权成为公爵，1203—1206年为女儿阿历克斯摄政。

百年战争期间，图阿尔城先被黑太子攻占，后由贝特朗·杜·盖克兰替法王收复。1397年末代女子爵去世，嫡系断绝，子爵领先后转入昂布瓦斯家族和拉特雷穆瓦耶家族，后者1563年将其升格为公爵领。

en:
The Togashi were a military house of Kaga Province who claimed descent from Fujiwara no Toshihito. They held the hereditary post of Kaga-no-suke; Togashi Yasuie, the barrier keeper portrayed in the Noh play Ataka and the kabuki Kanjinchō, is also considered a member of the clan.

In the Kamakura period they served under the Rokuhara deputies in Kyoto. Togashi Takaie was named shugo of Kaga in 1335, though the post passed to the Shiba until Mitsunari recovered half the province in 1414 and his kinsman Mitsuharu reunited it.

The house's rule ended in 1488, when Togashi Masachika was overthrown at Takao Castle by the Kaga Ikkō-ikki, a league of warrior-monks and peasants. Later heads were kept as figureheads or died in battle: Harusada was killed by the ikki in 1570 for allying with Oda Nobunaga, and Yasutoshi fell in battle in 1574; his survivors served the conquerors of Kaga as minor retainers.
zh:
富㭴氏是加贺国的武家，自称出自藤原利仁。家族世袭加贺介一职；能剧《安宅》与歌舞伎《劝进帐》中把守关隘的富㭴泰家，便被认为出自该族。

镰仓时代，富㭴家在京都侍奉六波罗探题。1335年，富㭴高家就任加贺守护，但守护职后来被斯波氏夺去，直到1414年满成夺回加贺半国，同族满春又将其合并。

1488年，富㭴政亲在高尾城被加贺一向一揆攻灭，这个由僧兵与农民组成的盟约势力结束了富㭴家的统治。此后的当主或被奉为名义守护，或在战火中殒命：晴贞因与织田信长结盟于1570年被一揆诛杀，泰俊于1574年战死，其遗族作为小家臣侍奉征服加贺的新主。

en:
The Toki were a warrior house claiming descent from Minamoto no Yorimitsu and the Seiwa Genji. In the twelfth century his descendant Minamoto no Mitsunobu was installed at Toki in Mino Province, and his line took the place as its family name.

Toki Yorisada campaigned with Ashikaga Takauji against the Southern Court, and from the Muromachi period the clan ruled Mino as shugo governors. Toki Yasuyuki held Mino, Owari and Ise and fought the shōgun Ashikaga Yoshimitsu for two years from 1389 when the latter tried to take Owari.

The main line's power was broken in the Mino civil wars of 1542, when Toki Yorinari was driven out by Saitō Dōsan. A surviving branch served Tokugawa Ieyasu and was enfeoffed in 1590 as a small-domain daimyō with 10,000 koku, settling at Numata in Kōzuke in 1742.
zh:
土岐氏是自称出自源赖光、属清和源氏一脉的武家。12世纪，赖光的后裔源光信被安置于美浓国土岐庄，其后人便以土岐为苗字。

土岐赖贞追随足利尊氏与南朝作战，室町时代以后，土岐家以守护身份统治美浓国。土岐康行身兼美浓、尾张、伊势三国守护，1389年因将军足利义满企图收回尾张而与之交战两年。

1542年美浓内战，土岐赖艺被斋藤道三击败驱逐，宗家势力就此终结。存续的一支侍奉德川家康，1590年受封一万石成为小藩大名，于1742年定居上野国沼田藩。

en:
The Tokunō were a branch of the Kōno clan of Iyo Province on Shikoku. They took their name from Tokunō manor, held by the descendants of Kōno Michitoshi, who fought on the imperial side in the Jōkyū War of 1221 and was killed at Mount Takanawa. In the Kamakura period the family built Tsuneishi Castle as its seat, and Tokunō Michizumi fought the Mongol invaders in 1274.

During the Genkō War of 1333 Tokunō Michitsuna raised troops for Emperor Go-Daigo and, with other Kōno branches, defeated the Nagato tandai's army in Iyo, briefly winning the Kōno headship.

When the Kenmu Restoration collapsed he joined the Southern Court under Nitta Yoshisada and was killed in the siege of Kanagasaki Castle in 1337. A cadet line later settled in Etchū and served the Maeda lords of Kaga as village officers in the Edo period.
zh:
得能氏是四国伊予国河野氏的支流。河野通俊在1221年承久之乱中站在朝廷一方，战死于高绳山；他的子孙领有得能庄，遂以得能为苗字。镰仓时代，得能家修筑常石城作为本据，得能通纯参加了1274年抵御蒙古入侵的战役。

1333年元弘之乱时，得能通纲举兵响应后醍醐天皇，与河野家其他分家联手在伊予击败长门探题的军队，并一度取得河野家督之位。

建武新政崩溃后，他追随新田义贞加入南朝，1337年在金崎城的围攻中战死。其一支庶流后来定居越中国，江户时代作为村役人侍奉加贺藩主前田氏。

en:
The Tomaras of Gwalior were a Rajput dynasty of central India. They claimed descent from the Lunar line and kinship with the Tomaras of Delhi, but began as Tughlaq feudatories holding Aisah. In 1394 their chief Virasimha received Gwalior and seized the fort from its governor, founding the dynasty.

His successors fought to keep their independence. Manasimha, better known as Man Singh Tomar, bought off Bahlul Lodi with tribute and weathered Sikandar Lodi's campaigns of 1501 to 1508, ambushing the retreating army near Jatwar. A patron of music and building, Man Singh raised the Man Mandir palace inside Gwalior Fort.

His son Vikramaditya surrendered the fort to Ibrahim Lodi in 1523, accepting Shamsabad instead. He died fighting for Ibrahim Lodi against Babur at Panipat in 1526, and Tomara rule in Gwalior came to an end.
zh:
瓜廖尔的都摩罗是中印度的拉杰普特王朝。他们自称属月亮世系，与德里都摩罗人同族，起家时是图格鲁克王朝治下领有艾萨的封臣。1394年，首领维拉辛哈受封瓜廖尔，从长官手中夺取要塞，王朝由此建立。

其后诸王为保住独立屡次征战。曼·辛格·托马尔（即曼纳西姆哈）以贡金买下巴鲁尔·洛迪，在1501—1508年顶住西坎达尔·洛迪的进攻，并在贾特瓦尔附近伏击撤军。曼·辛格提倡音乐、兴土木，在瓜廖尔要塞内修建了曼曼迪尔宫。

其子维克拉马迪亚于1523年向易卜拉欣·洛迪交出要塞，改领沙姆萨巴德。1526年他在帕尼帕特为易卜拉欣·洛迪迎战巴布尔时战死，都摩罗在瓜廖尔的统治至此终结。

en:
The Toyama of Mino traced their origin to Kato Kagekado, a retainer of Minamoto no Yoritomo rewarded with Toyama manor in Ena district around the 1190s. His eldest son Kagetomo took its name and first appeared in records in 1221, when he executed the court noble Ichijo no Nobuyoshi at Iwamura after the Jokyu War.

From Iwamura Castle the family spread into seven houses, ranking with the Toki in eastern Mino. Some of its men served the Ashikaga shoguns directly as hokoshu, and Kagefusa fought for the Ashikaga at Minatogawa in 1336.

The Toyama submitted to Takeda Shingen in 1554–1556, and Oda Nobunaga married his adopted daughter Lady Otsuya to Kagetō of Iwamura. The main houses of Iwamura, Iibama, Yasuki and Akeshō were destroyed in the Oda-Takeda struggle. The Akechi, Kushiwara and Naegi branches joined Tokugawa Ieyasu at Sekigahara in 1600; the Naegi became daimyo and later viscounts.
zh:
美浓远山氏的祖先是源赖朝的重臣加藤景廉，他在12世纪90年代前后受封惠那郡的远山庄。长子景朝以地名为苗字，其名首见于1221年，当时他在承久之乱后于岩村处决了公卿一条信能。

远山氏以岩村城为本据，分为七家，与土岐氏并称美浓东部的名门。族中有人出任将军家的奉公众，1336年景房在凑川之战中为足利方作战。

远山氏在1554—1556年臣服武田信玄，织田信长把养女阿艳嫁给岩村城主景任。后来岩村、饭羽间、安木、明照等宗家支族在织田与武田的争夺中灭亡。明知、串原、苗木三家转投德川家康，1600年参加关原之战；苗木远山氏成为大名，后来受封子爵。

en:
The Toshima were a warrior house of southern Musashi, belonging to the Taira-surnamed Chichibu clan. In 1023 Chichibu Takesune received Toshima district and Kasai, and his line took the name Toshima.

In 1180 Kiyomoto and his son Kiyoshige joined Minamoto no Yoritomo and became Kamakura gokenin; Kiyoshige founded the Kasai clan. In 1333 some clansmen died with the Hōjō at Rokuhara, while others fought under Nitta Yoshisada at Bubaigawara. The Toshima joined the Heiikki league, whose revolt was crushed by the Uesugi in 1368; their lands were confiscated and they later moved to Shakujii Castle.

In 1477 the clan head Yasutsune backed Nagao Kageharu's rebellion and was defeated by Ōta Dōkan. Shakujii and Hiratsuka castles fell by 1478, and Yasutsune vanished, ending the main line. Descendants served the Later Hōjō and the Tokugawa.
zh:
丰岛氏是南武藏的武家，属于平姓秩父氏一族。1023年秩父武常受封丰岛郡和葛西之地，其后代遂以丰岛为苗字。

1180年，清元、清重父子投奔源赖朝，成为镰仓御家人；清重开创葛西氏。1333年，一族有人随北条氏在六波罗自刃，也有人在分倍河原随新田义贞作战。丰岛氏加入平一揆，1368年上杉氏镇压其叛乱，没收丰岛氏的领地；丰岛氏后来迁至石神井城。

1477年，当主泰经呼应长尾景春之乱，被太田道灌击败。至1478年石神井城和平塚城相继陷落，泰经下落不明，本宗灭亡。后人出仕后北条氏和德川氏。

en:
The To were a cadet branch of the Chiba clan, of Kanmu Heishi descent. Their ancestor Taneyori, sixth son of Chiba Tsunetane, took his name from Higashi manor in Shimosa. In 1180 he persuaded his father to join Minamoto no Yoritomo and helped destroy the Taira-appointed deputy of Shimosa.

Early heads were known as poets: Shigetane won the confidence of Shogun Minamoto no Sanetomo, and Taneyuki served four shoguns through verse and calligraphy. A branch settled at Shinowaki Castle in Gujo, Mino. Its ninth head Tsuneyori recovered the castle from Saito Myochin through poetry in 1469 and delivered the secret Kokin denju lectures to the poet Sogi in 1471.

In 1559 the head Jokei was slain by his son-in-law Endo Morikazu, who inherited the estates. The Endo became lords of Gujo domain; their last lord reverted to the To name and became a viscount.
zh:
东氏是千叶氏的庶流，出自桓武平氏。祖先胤赖是千叶常胤的第六子，以所领下总国东庄为苗字。1180年，他劝父亲归附源赖朝，并参与袭杀平氏任命的下总目代。

早期当主多以歌人闻名：重胤深得将军源实朝信任，胤行凭和歌与文笔出仕四位将军。一支后来移居美浓国郡上，以篠胁城为本据。九代当主常缘于1469年凭和歌交谊从斋藤妙椿手中要回城池，1471年向连歌大师宗祇讲授古今传授。

1559年，当主常庆被女婿远藤盛数攻灭，远藤氏继承领地，后来成为郡上藩主；末代藩主恢复东姓，受封子爵。

en:
The de La Tour du Pin were barons of the castle of La Tour-du-Pin in the Viennois, an Alpine lordship of the Kingdom of Burgundy. In 1273 Humbert I wed Anne, daughter and heiress of Guigues VII, dauphin of Viennois, and ruled the Dauphiné jure uxoris.

His son John II and grandson Guigues VIII kept the title; Guigues defeated the Savoyards at Varey in 1325 and was killed besieging a Savoyard castle in 1333. He was succeeded by his brother Humbert II, the last dauphin of the local line, whose only son died in childhood.

Childless and short of money, Humbert sold the Dauphiné to the French crown in 1349 and entered the Dominican Order. From that sale the heir apparent of France took the title dauphin, and the Dauphiné became a royal appanage.
zh:
拉图尔迪潘家族是维埃努瓦拉图尔迪潘城堡的男爵，而维埃努瓦原属勃艮第王国的阿尔卑斯领地。1273年，亨伯特一世娶维埃纳多菲内吉格七世的女儿兼女继承人安妮为妻，以妻权统治多菲内。

其子让二世和孙子吉格八世相继保有头衔；吉格八世于1325年在瓦雷击败萨伏依人，1333年在围攻萨伏依城堡时阵亡。继位的是其弟亨伯特二世，即本地世系的最后一位多菲内，他的独子幼年夭折。

亨伯特无嗣，又苦于财政拮据，于1349年把多菲内卖给法国王室，自己加入多明我会。此后法国王储拥有多菲内头衔，多菲内也成为王室的亲王封地。

en:
The Tozawa were a warrior house of the Ou region, holding estates around Semboku and Kakunodate. Their genealogy claimed descent from Taira no Tadamasa: his grandson Hidemori is said to have submitted to Minamoto no Yoritomo in 1185 and taken the Tozawa name. Historians consider them more probably a local house, perhaps of Emishi stock.

Driven by Nanbu pressure, Kanemori moved to Dewa in 1206 and built Kadoya Castle in 1228. The Tozawa backed the Southern Court, sending troops under Gensei for Kitabatake Akinobu's campaign in 1341, before turning to the Northern Court in 1356.

They joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590. Tozawa Masamori sided with the Tokugawa at Sekigahara, but was reduced to forty thousand koku at Matsuoka. In 1622 the clan became lords of Shinjo Domain, which it ruled until the Meiji Restoration, later receiving a viscountcy.
zh:
户泽氏是奥羽地方的武家，盘踞在仙北和角馆一带。家谱自称出自平忠正一脉，说其孙衡盛于1185年臣服源赖朝，取户泽为苗字；史家则认为他们更可能是当地豪族，或有虾夷血统。

兼盛因南部氏的攻势于1206年迁往出羽，1228年修筑门屋城。南北朝时期户泽氏效忠南朝，1341年玄盛发兵参加北畠显信的战役，户泽氏于1356年转仕北朝。

1590年户泽氏参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐。户泽政盛在关原之战中支持德川氏，却被减封至松冈四万石。1622年一族成为新庄藩主，世袭至明治维新，后来受封子爵。

en:
The Trakhan dynasty ruled Gilgit in the upper Indus for about five centuries until around 1810. Local tradition makes its founders heirs of the Shahreis: the Persian adventurer Azur Jamshid is said to have overthrown Shri Badat, married his daughter Nur Bakht Khatun, and fathered Garg, the first ruler to take the title raja.

The dynasty was named after Raja Trakhan, who reigned around the turn of the fourteenth century, and the line was Muslim for most of its history. Under Raja Torra Khan, who ruled from 1421 to 1475, the Trakhan name became fixed; his stepbrother Shah Rais Khan seized Chitral, founding the rival Raisiya line.

The seventeenth-century queen Dadi Jawari was remembered for her irrigation canals. The last raja, Abbas, died around 1810, after which Gilgit was fought over by the rulers of Yasin, Punial and Nagar.
zh:
特剌汗王朝统治印度河上游的吉尔吉特约五个世纪，约于1810年终结。当地传说把其始祖接在沙赫雷伊斯家族之后：波斯冒险家阿祖尔·贾姆希德推翻施里·巴达特，娶其女努尔·巴赫特·哈通，生下的加尔格是首位采用拉杰头衔的统治者。

王朝得名于14世纪前后在位的拉杰特剌汗，其家族在历史上大部分时间都是穆斯林。1421—1475年在位的拉杰托拉汗时代，特剌汗之名固定下来；他的异母兄弟沙阿·拉伊斯汗夺取吉德拉尔，另立敌对的拉伊斯支系。

后期统治者包括17世纪的女王达迪·贾瓦里，以修建灌溉水渠闻名。末代拉杰阿巴斯约于1810年去世，此后吉尔吉特被亚辛、布尼亚尔和讷格尔的统治者争夺。

en:
The Trần ruled Đại Việt from Thăng Long between 1225 and 1400. Descended from a fishing family of Fujian origin settled in the Red River Delta, the clan rose through marriage with the Lý imperial house; in 1225 Trần Thủ Độ arranged for the child empress Lý Chiêu Hoàng to cede the throne to his nephew Trần Cảnh, who became Trần Thái Tông.

The dynasty repelled three invasions by the Mongols, destroying the Yuan fleet at Bạch Đằng in 1288. The first chữ Nôm literature appeared, and improved gunpowder helped the Trần push south and reduce Champa to vassalage.

In 1337 Trần Hiến Tông held the throne, but later reigns faced succession crises and Cham counterattacks. In 1400 Hồ Quý Ly forced the last Trần emperor to abdicate; Later Trần resistance against the Ming occupation that began in 1407 ended in 1413.
zh:
陈朝（1225—1400年）以升龙为都，统治大越。陈氏先祖是从福建迁居红河三角洲的捕鱼家族，靠与李朝皇室联姻而跻身朝堂；1225年，陈守度安排年幼的女帝李昭皇禅位给侄子陈煚，是为陈太宗。

陈朝三次击退蒙古入侵，1288年在白藤江之战中歼灭元朝水师。最早的字喃文学在此时出现，改良的火药武器也帮助陈朝南征，迫使占城称臣。

1337年在位的是陈宪宗，此后陈朝陷入继承危机与占城反攻。1400年胡季犛逼迫末代陈帝退位；明朝于1407年占领安南后，后陈朝起兵抵抗，至1413年覆灭。

en:
Trâsâk Ph'aem was the first Khmer sovereign known only from the Cambodian Royal Chronicles, whose legendary line follows the end of temple inscriptions after Jayavarman IX around 1340. The chronicles call him Chay, a gardener whose sweet cucumbers earned him the title Neay Trasac Paem.

Entrusted with the king's spear to guard his crops, he mortally wounded the monarch during a nightly test of his vigilance. The dying king absolved him, and a white elephant chose the gardener as successor. Taking the royal name Ang Chey, he married the late king's daughter Candravati and withdrew to Banteay Samré after purging hostile lords.

His sons Nippean Bat, who ruled from 1340 to 1346, and Sithean Reachea succeeded him; under Nippean Bat the Thai vassals revolted and broke away. The chronicles present this house as the root of all later Cambodian royalty.
zh:
陀罗索迦·跋摩是第一位只见于柬埔寨王家编年史的高棉君主；约1340年阇耶跋摩九世之后，寺庙碑铭中断，传说王统便由此接上。编年史称他名叫猜，是一位园丁，因种得一手好瓜而得到甜瓜师傅尼亚·特拉萨·帕埃姆的称号。

国王把长矛交他看守瓜园，一夜亲自试探他的警觉，反被他刺成重伤。国王临终赦免了他，白象选中了这位园丁继位。他取王名安谢，娶先王之女占达拉瓦蒂，在清洗敌对贵族后退居班迭萨雷。

他的儿子尼佩安·巴特（1340—1346年在位）和西坦·列查先后继位；尼佩安·巴特在位时，暹罗附庸起兵反叛，脱离帝国。编年史将这一家族视为后世柬埔寨王室的共同源头。

en:
The House of Trastámara was a Castilian dynasty, an illegitimate cadet line of the House of Burgundy. It took its name from the County of Trastámara, the land beyond the Tambre river, held by its founder Henry before he took the crown.

During the Castilian Civil War of 1351–1369, Henry, a bastard son of Alfonso XI, fought his half-brother Peter I; after defeat at Nájera in 1367, he returned with French and Aragonese support and killed Peter in 1369, reigning as Henry II. In 1412 the Compromise of Caspe placed the Trastámara prince Ferdinand of Antequera on the throne of Aragon.

Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon, second cousins of the same house, married in 1469, joining the crowns in a dynastic union. Their reign saw the Inquisition, Granada's fall in 1492 and the decree expelling Jews. The crowns passed to their grandson Charles V, the first Habsburg king of Spain.
zh:
特拉斯塔马拉家族是卡斯蒂利亚王室勃艮第家族的私生子旁支，得名于始祖恩里克称王前领有的特拉斯塔马拉伯爵领，意为塔姆布雷河彼岸之地。

1351—1369年卡斯蒂利亚内战中，阿方索十一世的私生子恩里克与异母兄佩德罗一世交战。1367年他在纳赫拉战败，随后借法国和阿拉贡之力卷土重来，于1369年杀死佩德罗，即位为恩里克二世。1412年的卡斯佩妥协方案将特拉斯塔马拉的安特克拉的费尔南多扶上阿拉贡王位。

1469年，同一家族的堂兄妹卡斯蒂利亚女王伊莎贝拉一世与阿拉贡国王费尔南多二世成婚，两国形成王朝联合。他们治下设立宗教裁判所，1492年攻灭格拉纳达，并颁布驱逐犹太人的诏书。王冠传给外孙查理五世，西班牙的第一位哈布斯堡国王。

en:
The de Trie were a knightly family of the Vexin, taking their name from Trie-en-Vexin and descending from a younger line of the viscounts of Chaumont-en-Vexin. Galon II was constable in 1085 and Hugues I served as constable of France under Louis VI.

Jean I, lord of Trie and Mouchy, married Alix of Dammartin, sister of the count of Boulogne. Their son Mathieu inherited the County of Dammartin in 1262, and his descendants held it through the fourteenth century; Jean I of Dammartin fell at Courtrai in 1302, and the line ended with the countess Blanche around 1400.

Renaud de Trie and his son Mathieu III were both marshals of France, Mathieu commanding Tournai in the early Hundred Years' War. Guillaume became archbishop of Reims and crowned Philip VI in 1328.
zh:
德·特里家族是韦克桑地区的骑士家族，得名于韦克桑的特里，出自肖蒙昂韦克桑子爵的幼支。加隆二世于1085年出任统帅，于格一世在路易六世时期担任法国统帅。

特里与穆希领主让一世迎娶布洛涅伯爵之妹阿历克斯·德·达马尔坦。他们的儿子马蒂厄于1262年继承达马尔坦伯国，其后代一直保有伯爵位至14世纪；达马尔坦伯爵让一世于1302年在科特赖克战役中阵亡，伯爵一脉约在1400年随着女伯爵布朗什而终结。

雷诺·德·特里及其子马蒂厄三世都官至法国元帅，后者在百年战争初年指挥图尔奈守军。纪尧姆成为兰斯大主教，并于1328年为腓力六世加冕。

en:
The Tsuchimochi were a warrior house of northern Hyūga on Kyushu, with chief branches at Agata and Takarabe. They are thought to have split from the Tabe clan and served the Usa Hachiman shrine, rising as stewards of its estates and chiefs of Usuki district.

Under Nobutsuna the clan held seven seats, known as the Seven Heads of Tsuchimochi. In 1197 its members held jitō posts across Hyūga. In 1336 several fought for Ashikaga Takauji in Kyoto and received estates, establishing the Agata main line; members later served the Shimazu as deputy governors.

In 1457 the Itō took ten castles, including Takarabe. The Agata house, caught between the Ōtomo and Shimazu, was destroyed in 1578 when Ōtomo Sōrin stormed Matsuo Castle and killed its lord Chikashige.
zh:
土持氏是九州日向国北部的武家，主要有县土持氏和财部土持氏两支。一般认为它从田部氏分出，最初是宇佐八幡宫的社人，凭借担任宇佐宫领地的弁济使和臼杵郡司扩张势力。

当主宣纲在位时一族据有七处，号称土持七头。1197年的文书记有族人在日向各地的地头职。1336年数名族人在京都随足利尊氏作战，战后受封领地，县土持宗家就此成立；后来族人还在岛津氏手下出任守护代。

1457年伊东氏夺走财部城等十座城池。宗家在大友氏与岛津氏之间周旋，最终于1578年被大友宗麟攻破松尾城，当主亲成败死。

en:
The counts palatine of Tübingen began as counts of Nagold in Swabia, first documented in the tenth century. They held Hohentübingen castle by at least 1078, when King Henry IV besieged it during the Investiture Controversy.

Hugo V won the title of count palatine in 1146 for service to Conrad III, becoming the emperor's chief representative in Swabia, with rights of justice, tolls and minting. His son Hugo II married the heiress of Bregenz, while a younger son, Hugo of Montfort, founded the Montfort dynasty, from which the counts of Werdenberg branched off. Debts to Bebenhausen abbey eroded the family's power, and in 1342 Gottfried III was forced to sell Tübingen to Count Ulrich III of Württemberg for twenty thousand gold hellers.

The cadet lines expired one by one: Tübingen-Lichteneck in 1664 and Herrenberg in 1677. The Montfort line lasted until 1787.
zh:
蒂宾根行宫伯爵家族原是施瓦本的纳戈尔德伯爵，10世纪已有文献可考。至迟在1078年已据有霍亨蒂宾根城堡，那年国王亨利四世在叙任权斗争中曾围攻此堡。

1146年，胡戈五世因效力康拉德三世而获行宫伯爵头衔，成为皇帝在施瓦本的首席代表，掌司法、关税和铸币之权。其子胡戈二世娶布雷根茨女继承人，幼子蒙特福特的胡戈则开创蒙特福特王朝，韦尔登贝格伯爵后来从该支分出。对贝本豪森修道院的债务侵蚀了家族实力，1342年戈特弗里德三世被迫以两万金赫勒把蒂宾根城卖给符腾堡伯爵乌尔里希三世。

各支系相继绝嗣：蒂宾根-利希特内克支于1664年告终，黑伦贝格支于1677年绝嗣。蒙特福特支延续到1787年。

en:
The Tudors began as a Welsh ministerial family on Anglesey, descended from Ednyfed Fychan, who served as seneschal of Gwynedd under Llywelyn the Great and died in 1246. His son Goronwy founded the line at Penmynydd, and Goronwy's grandson Tudur Hen submitted to Edward I after the conquest of Wales.

In the early fifteenth century several sons backed Owain Glyndŵr's revolt; Rhys ap Tudur was executed in 1412 and the estates forfeited. Owen Tudor of a younger branch secretly married Catherine of Valois, widow of Henry V. Their son Edmund married Margaret Beaufort, and their grandson Henry defeated Richard III at Bosworth in 1485, becoming Henry VII and marrying Elizabeth of York.

The five Tudor sovereigns ruled through the English Reformation and the union of England and Wales. The childless Elizabeth I died in 1603, leaving the throne to the Scottish Stuarts.
zh:
都铎家族本是安格尔西岛上的威尔士士宦世家，先祖埃德尼费德·费汉曾在卢埃林大帝麾下担任圭内斯宫廷总管，1246年去世。其子戈龙维开创彭迈尼德一系，戈龙维之孙都铎·亨在威尔士被征服后归顺爱德华一世。

15世纪初，家族的几个儿子支持欧文·格兰道尔起兵；里斯·阿普·都铎于1412年被处死，家产被没收。幼支的欧文·都铎秘密娶了亨利五世的遗孀瓦卢瓦的凯瑟琳。两人的儿子埃德蒙娶玛格丽特·博福特，孙子亨利于1485年在博斯沃思击败理查三世，以亨利七世之名登基，并迎娶约克的伊丽莎白。

五位都铎君主治下经历了英格兰宗教改革和英格兰与威尔士的合并。无嗣的伊丽莎白一世于1603年去世，王位传给苏格兰的斯图亚特家族。

en:
The Tughlaqs were the third dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, ruling from 1320 to 1414. Its founder Ghazi Malik overthrew Khusro Khan and took the throne as Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, building Tughlaqabad before his suspicious death in 1325.

His son Muhammad bin Tughluq, who reigned until 1351, pushed the sultanate to its greatest extent in 1330–1335. His forced move of the capital to Daulatabad, failed token currency and taxes drove provinces into revolt. The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta served him as a judge and recorded his punishments and the famine beginning in 1335.

His nephew Firuz Shah, reigning from 1351 to 1388, built irrigation canals but also expanded slavery and taxed Brahmins. After his death civil wars followed, and Timur sacked Delhi in 1398. In 1414 Khizr Khan entered the city and founded the Sayyid dynasty.
zh:
图格鲁克王朝是德里苏丹国的第三个王朝，统治时间为1320—1414年。开国者加齐·马立克推翻库斯鲁汗，以吉亚斯·丁·图格鲁克之名登基，修建图格鲁克巴德，1325年蹊跷死去。

其子穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克统治至1351年，1330—1335年间把苏丹国版图推到极盛。他强令都城迁往道拉塔巴德，发行失败的代币，加上横征暴敛，导致各省反叛。摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰曾在他手下任法官，记述了其酷刑和1335年开始的饥荒。

其侄菲鲁兹沙于1351—1388年在位，开凿灌溉运河，也扩充奴隶、向婆罗门征税。他死后爆发内战，1398年帖木儿攻陷德里。1414年希兹尔汗入城，开创赛义德王朝。

en:
The lords of Turn were a noble family of the Valais, with Bernese Oberland estates. Possibly descended from a cadet line of the de la Tour family of the Dauphiné, they appear as vassals of Saint-Maurice Abbey. Around 1170 Wilhelm I and his brother Amadeus, Bishop of Sion, are the first documented members, and Wilhelm built or enlarged Gestelnburg as the family seat.

Backed by Savoy, they fought the Bishops of Sion for mastery of the Valais; Peter of Turn was defeated with the Savoyards at Leuk in 1296 and had to grant rights to the valley communes.

In 1375 Anton von Turn's followers murdered Bishop Witschard Tavelli, whereupon the communes rose and Anton fled to Savoy, which bought his Valais estates. In 1400 he sold Frutigen to Bern, and died in exile in 1405, the last of his line.
zh:
图恩领主是瓦莱州的贵族家族，领地延伸到伯尔尼高地。他们可能源自多菲内德拉图尔家族旁支，作为圣莫里斯修道院的封臣出现。约1170年，威廉一世与其兄锡永主教阿马迪厄斯是最早见诸文献的成员，威廉修建或扩建盖斯特尔恩堡，作为家族祖居。

在萨伏依伯爵支持下，他们与锡永主教争夺瓦莱；1296年，彼得·冯·图恩与萨伏依联军在勒克战役中战败，被迫向谷地公社让渡权利。

1375年，安东·冯·图恩的部下刺杀主教维查德·塔韦利，各公社随即起事，安东逃往萨伏依，萨伏依伯爵买下了他在瓦莱的产业。1400年，他把弗鲁蒂根领地卖给伯尔尼，1405年死于流亡中，家族就此绝嗣。

en:
The Uanacaze, also known as the Uacúsecha or Vacúxecha, meaning eagles, were the royal clan of the Purépecha kingdom in the Michoacán highlands. Their half-legendary early lords are recorded in the Relación de Michoacán.

Pauacume ruled as lord of Pátzcuaro, and his son Tariácuri, dreaming a command from the sun god Curicaueri, allied the lakeside cities and from about 1300 built the communities of Lake Pátzcuaro into one state. On Tariácuri's death his kin divided the chief towns while keeping his conquests together. His successors the cazonci centralized tribute and pushed the borders to the Pacific at Zacatula by 1460.

They fortified their eastern frontier against the Aztec Empire, whose westward expansion they repeatedly blocked. The last cazonci Tangáxuan II submitted to the Spaniards in 1530.
zh:
瓦纳卡泽家族又称瓦库塞查或瓦库谢查，意为“鹰”，是米却肯高地普雷佩查王国的王室氏族。其半传说性质的早期首领记载于《米却肯纪事》。

保阿库梅曾任帕茨夸罗首领，其子塔里亚库里梦见太阳神库里考埃里的训谕，联合湖畔诸城，约从1300年起把帕茨夸罗湖周围的社群整合为一个国家。塔里亚库里死后，亲族瓜分重镇，却维持了他的征服成果。后继的卡松奇建立贡赋体系，到1460年把疆界推进到萨卡图拉的太平洋沿岸。

他们在东部边境修筑要塞，屡次挡住阿兹特克帝国向西的扩张。末代卡松奇坦加克苏安二世于1530年向西班牙人投降。

en:
The Udan stand for the idiquts of Qocho, who ruled the Uyghur kingdom of the Turpan basin and traced their lineage to Qutlugh of the Ediz clan. After the Kirghiz overthrew the Uyghur Khaganate, refugees founded Qocho in 843. In 866 Pugu Jun adopted the title idiqut, meaning lord of fortune, ruling from Qocho and Beshbalik.

The idiquts were vassals of the Qara Khitai from 1128 until Barchuk Art Tegin killed the Khitan magistrate in 1209 and submitted to Genghis Khan, who treated him as a fifth son. Mongol princesses married into the family for nearly a century.

Under the Yuan, Nolen Tekin became Prince of Gaochang in 1308, but war with the Chagatai Khanate wrecked the country. Ürüg Temür is attested as idiqut between 1335 and 1353 and was followed by Ching Temür, the last known ruler; the kingdom had ceased to exist by the 1370s.
zh:
兀单指的是高昌回鹘的亦都护家族，他们统治吐鲁番盆地的回鹘王国，王统可追溯至阿跌部的骨咄禄。黠戛斯攻灭回鹘汗国后，回鹘残部于843年建立高昌。866年仆固俊采用意为“幸福之主”的亦都护称号，在高昌和别失八里理政。

1128年起亦都护是西辽附庸，1209年巴而术·阿而忒·的斤袭杀西辽少监，归降成吉思汗，被视为第五子。此后近百年间，蒙古公主不断嫁入亦都护家族。

元朝时期纽林的斤于1308年受封高昌王，但与察合台汗国的战争使国家残破。月鲁帖木儿于1335—1353年间有任亦都护的记载，其后的占帖木儿是已知最后一位统治者；到14世纪70年代，高昌王国已不复存在。

en:
The Ueno of Mikawa were a cadet branch of the Ashikaga house, founded by Ueno Yoshibumi, son of Ashikaga Yasuuji. Yoshibumi took his name from the Ueno estate in Mikawa. His grandson Yorikane followed Ashikaga Takauji against the Kamakura shogunate, retreated to Kyushu, and fought the Kikuchi in 1336; he later became constable of Iwami and campaigned for the Northern Court.

Though the house held constable posts, none became hereditary, and its main line served the Ashikaga shoguns in Kyoto. In 1509 Ueno Nobutaka went to Bitchu to secure the restored Shogun Ashikaga Yoshitane's position, founding a branch.

One line at Bitchu Matsuyama Castle was destroyed by Sho Arisuke in 1533, while Ueno Takatomo, who held Joyama Castle in Bizen and backed the Mimura against the Mori, was overrun by Kobayakawa Takakage in 1575. A further branch served the Otomo in Bungo.
zh:
三河上野氏是足利氏的庶流，始祖上野义弁是足利泰氏之子，以三河国上野庄为苗字。其孙上野赖兼追随足利尊氏反抗镰仓幕府，退往九州，1336年征讨菊池氏，后来受任石见国守护，为北朝作战。

上野氏虽历任守护，却未能世袭，宗家留在京都，侍奉足利将军。1509年，上野信孝被派往备中国，为复职的将军足利义稙巩固地盘，开创一支。

驻守备中松山城的一脉于1533年被庄为资攻灭；居于备前常山城的上野隆德支持三村氏与毛利氏对抗，1575年被小早川隆景攻灭。另有一支在丰后担任大友氏的家臣。

en:
The Uesugi claim descent from the ninth-century Fujiwara minister Fujiwara no Yoshikado. At the close of the 1200s his descendant Kanjuju Shigefusa received the Uesugi manor in Tango and took its name; his daughter Kiyoko mothered Ashikaga Takauji, tying the family to Muromachi rule.

Through the 1300s and 1400s Uesugi heads served as provincial governors and Kanto kanrei, the shogun's eastern deputies, and in 1449 drove out their lord Ashikaga Shigeuji to dominate the Kanto. The clan split into the Yamanouchi, Ogigayatsu and Inukake branches, which fought a quarter-century of infighting ending around 1477 with the Inukake line extinct; the Later Hojo eroded their hold, taking Kawagoe in 1537 and slaying the last Ogigayatsu head in 1545.

Yamanouchi lord Norimasa adopted retainer Nagao Kagetora, who became Uesugi Kenshin (1530—1578), a celebrated Sengoku general famed for rivalling Takeda Shingen. His heir Kagekatsu backed the losing side at Sekigahara in 1600 and was moved to remote Yonezawa, where the family ruled as outer daimyo through the Edo period, praised for Harunori's reforms after the 1750s famines.
zh:
上杉氏自称出自9世纪藤原氏大臣藤原良门一脉。13世纪末后人劝修寺重房受领丹后国上杉庄，遂以领地为姓；其女清子是足利尊氏生母，家族由此与室町幕府结缘。

14至15世纪，上杉氏世代任守护和关东管领，1449年驱逐主君足利成氏，成为关东最有势力的家族。后分裂为山内、扇谷、犬悬三支，攻伐约二十五年，1477年前后犬悬一脉绝嗣。16世纪后北条氏蚕食其领地，1537年夺河越，1545年攻杀扇谷末代当主。

山内当主宪政收家臣长尾景虎为养子，景虎改名上杉谦信（1530—1578），为战国名将，以对抗武田信玄著称。继承人景胜在1600年关原之战中站错阵营，被转封偏远的米泽藩，作为外样大名延续至江户时代，18世纪50年代饥荒后凭上杉治宪改革赢得称赏。

en:
The sultans of medieval Mogadishu, the leading Muslim city-state on the Benadir coast of southern Somalia, belonged to its first known ruling house, the Fakhr al-Din dynasty, founded when Abu Bakr ibn Fakhr al-Din made himself sultan in the mid-thirteenth century; his brother Omar ad-Din is said to have settled in Harar.

When Ibn Battuta visited in 1331 the city was ruled by Sultan Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh Umar, who spoke the Maqdishi tongue and Arabic. Mogadishu dominated the regional gold trade, minted its own coinage and exported finely woven toob benadir cloth, while Ming treasure fleets called there under Zheng He.

The Portuguese raider Joao de Sepulveda bombarded the city in 1542 and extorted a peace treaty, but the sultanate kept its independence until the late sixteenth or early seventeenth century, when the Fakhr al-Din line was replaced by the Muzaffarid dynasty.
zh:
中世纪的摩加迪沙是索马里南部贝纳迪尔海岸首屈一指的穆斯林城邦，其苏丹出自当地已知的第一个统治家族法赫尔·丁王朝。阿布·伯克尔·伊本·法赫尔·丁于13世纪中叶自立为苏丹，开创此系，传说他的兄弟欧麦尔·丁则迁居哈拉尔。

1331年伊本·白图泰到访时，在位的是苏丹阿布·伯克尔·伊本·谢赫·欧麦尔，他通晓摩加迪沙方言与阿拉伯语。摩加迪沙把持区域黄金贸易、自铸钱币，出口精织的贝纳迪尔布料，郑和率领的明朝船队也曾到访。

1542年葡萄牙人若昂·德·塞普尔韦达炮轰该城，逼其签订和约；但苏丹国保持独立，直到16世纪末或17世纪初，法赫尔·丁世系被穆扎法尔王朝取代。

en:
The Unno were a warrior house at Unno manor in Shinano, claiming descent from the Shigeno clan. With the Nezu and Mochizuki they were known as the three Shigeno families, and styled themselves the Shigeno main line. Unno Yukichika and his son served Minamoto no Yoshinaka and fell in battle; his surviving third son Yukiuji served Minamoto no Yoritomo and ranked among the four great bowmen of the Kanto.

In 1335 Unno Yukiyasu joined Hojo Tokiyuki's attempt to retake Kamakura. The clan sided with the Southern Court, and Yukiyasu was killed in 1352 at Kotesashigahara alongside Prince Munenaga.

Rivalry with the Murakami turned against the Unno: Mochiyuki fell in 1467 and the family lost the Shioda estates. In 1541 a coalition overwhelmed them at Unno-daira; the clan head fled and the main line ended. Sanada Yukitaka, who had married into the family, claimed its succession.
zh:
海野氏是以信浓国海野庄为本贯的武家，自称滋野氏后裔，与根津氏、望月氏并称滋野三家，并以滋野氏嫡流自居。海野幸亲父子担任源义仲的侍大将，双双战死；幸存的三子海野幸氏出仕源赖朝，名列弓马四天王。

1335年海野幸康随北条时行反攻镰仓，此后海野氏投奔南朝。1352年幸康随宗良亲王在小手指原战死。

与村上氏的对抗逐渐压倒了海野氏：1467年海野持幸战死，盐田庄被夺。1541年联军在海野平大破海野氏，当主出逃，宗家断绝。入赘海野家的真田幸隆后来继承其名迹。

en:
The Urgell were the last comital dynasty of the Catalan County of Urgell, a younger branch of the House of Barcelona ruling from Balaguer. In 1314, Ermengol X, the last count of the Cabrera line, left the county to his niece Teresa d'Entença, wife of the future Alfonso IV of Aragon. Their son James inherited Urgell in 1336, and the county passed to his son Peter II in 1347 and his grandson James II in 1408.

On the death of King Martin of Aragon without an heir in 1410, James II was one of six claimants to the crown, but the Compromise of Caspe in 1412 elected Ferdinand of Antequera instead. James refused the verdict and rose in arms.

Besieged in Balaguer, James surrendered in October 1413. The county was annexed to Aragon, and he died a prisoner at Xàtiva in 1433, the last legitimate male of the House of Barcelona.
zh:
乌赫利家族是加泰罗尼亚乌赫利伯国的末代伯爵王朝，属巴塞罗那家族的幼支，以巴拉格尔为统治中心。1314年卡布雷拉世系的末代伯爵埃门戈尔十世把伯国留给侄女特蕾莎·德恩滕萨；特蕾莎嫁给后来的阿拉贡国王阿方索四世。他们的儿子海梅于1336年继承乌赫利，伯国又于1347年传给其子佩德罗二世，1408年再传其孙海梅二世。

1410年阿拉贡国王马丁一世无嗣而终，海梅二世是六位王位竞争者之一，但1412年的卡斯佩妥协方案推选安特克拉的费尔南多。海梅拒绝决议起兵反叛。

海梅被围于巴拉格尔，1413年10月投降。伯国随即并入阿拉贡，海梅被囚禁，1433年死于哈蒂瓦，他也是巴塞罗那家族最后一位合法男嗣。

en: The Urtsun take their name from the Urtsun valley in southern Chitral, home to Kalash (Kalasha) communities that once held the valleys south of Chitral town. Local Kalash chiefs governed the valley and kept its old animist religion while Muslim rule took hold in Chitral from the 1300s, with the Rais and later the Katur dynasties building the state of Chitral around them.
zh: 乌尔岑家族得名于吉德拉尔南部的乌尔孙河谷，当地居民属于曾据有吉德拉尔城以南各河谷的卡拉什（卡拉沙）社群。14世纪起穆斯林统治在吉德拉尔确立，拉伊斯王朝及后来的卡图尔王朝在其周边建立起吉德拉尔政权，而这些卡拉什河谷仍由本地首领治理，并长期保留旧有的万物有灵信仰。

en:
The Utsunomiya were the chief house of Shimotsuke, a Fujiwara Hokke line whose ancestor Fujiwara no Sōen became head of Futarasan Shrine at Utsunomiya. The third head Tomotsuna, first to bear the name, fought in the 1189 Ōshū campaign. His grandson Yoritsuna took Buddhist orders after a shogunate purge and patronised a poetic circle; Fujiwara no Teika is said to have chosen the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu at its request.

In 1333 Kintsuna marched against Kusunoki Masashige with a dozen or so riders, and Masashige withdrew without a fight, awed by the Utsunomiya name; Kintsuna served the Kenmu government while his son sided with Ashikaga Takauji, dividing the family between the courts. In the Sengoku age Shigetsuna crushed the Ashina and routed a Satake coalition, and his grandson Hirotsuna led the northern Kantō league holding the Later Hōjō in check.

The last head Kunitsuna joined Toyotomi Hideyoshi at Odawara in 1590 and received the Toyotomi surname, but was attainted and exiled to Bizen in 1597; his descendants became Mito retainers.
zh:
宇都宫氏是下野国的名门，出自藤原北家。始祖藤原宗圆是宇都宫二荒山神社的座主。第三代当主朝纲首称宇都宫之姓，参加了1189年的奥州合战。其孙赖纲受幕府政争牵连出家，扶持宇都宫歌坛，据传藤原定家应歌坛之请选定《小仓百人一首》。

1333年，公纲率十余骑讨伐楠木正成，正成慑于宇都宫武名不战而退；公纲随后出仕建武新政，其子却转投足利尊氏，一族在南北朝中南北两分。战国时代，成纲击破芦名氏、大败佐竹联军，其孙广纲率领北关东联盟牵制后北条氏的扩张。

末代当主国纲1590年参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐，蒙赐丰臣姓氏，却在1597年被改易、流放备前国，子孙最后沦为水户藩藩士。

en:
The House of Valois was a Capetian branch, descended from Charles, Count of Valois, son of Philip III. When the direct line died with Charles IV in 1328, Charles of Valois's son became Philip VI under a rule excluding women and heirs through women, barring Edward III.

Edward's claim opened the Hundred Years' War in 1337. The Valois suffered defeats at Crécy in 1346 and Poitiers in 1356, where John II was captured. The Treaty of Troyes in 1420 nearly disinherited the dynasty, but Charles VII, inspired by Joan of Arc, expelled the English by 1453.

Louis XI defeated Charles the Bold of the Burgundian branch in 1477; Charles VIII and his successors launched the Italian Wars from 1494. Francis I and Henry II ruled in an age of Habsburg rivalry, followed by the French Wars of Religion. Henry III's assassination in 1589 ended the line, passing the throne to Bourbon Henry IV.
zh:
瓦卢瓦王朝是卡佩王朝的支系，始祖为腓力三世之子瓦卢瓦伯爵夏尔。1328年卡佩嫡系在查理四世身后绝嗣，夏尔之子依据排斥女性及女性后裔的继承规则登基，是为腓力六世，英王爱德华三世的继承权主张被排除。

爱德华的争位主张在1337年引发百年战争。瓦卢瓦诸王在1346年克雷西战役和1356年普瓦捷战役中惨败，约翰二世被俘。1420年的《特鲁瓦条约》几乎剥夺了瓦卢瓦的继承权，但查理七世在圣女贞德鼓舞下，到1453年将英军逐出法国。

路易十一于1477年击败勃艮第支系的大胆查理；从1494年起，夏尔八世及其后继者发动意大利战争。弗朗索瓦一世和亨利二世时期与哈布斯堡争霸，随后法国陷入宗教战争。1589年亨利三世遇刺，瓦卢瓦男系断绝，王位转入波旁家族的亨利四世之手。

en:
The Vassallo-Paleologo are known from the genealogy of a Sicilian and Maltese noble family rather than from Byzantine records. By its account Riccardo Vassallo, who lived from about 1278 to 1329 and advised the emperors Andronikos II and Michael IX, was made a count palatine in 1320 and married Anna Zaccaria, of the Genoese lords of Chios.

His son Giovanni, who lived from about 1312 to 1395, married Francesca Sanudo of the dukes of Naxos. The family tradition has their descendants settle in Sicily in 1436 and on Malta in 1622, still bearing the comital title.
zh:
巴萨洛-巴列奥略家族见于一个西西里和马耳他贵族家族的谱系，而非拜占庭的记载。据该谱系，里卡多·巴萨洛约生于1278年、卒于1329年，曾任皇帝安德洛尼卡二世和米海尔九世的顾问，1320年受封宫廷伯爵，娶了统治希俄斯的热那亚扎卡里亚家族的安娜。

其子乔瓦尼约生于1312年、卒于1395年，娶纳克索斯公爵家族的弗朗切斯卡·萨努多。按家族传统，其后人于1436年定居西西里，1622年迁居马耳他，一直保有伯爵头衔。

en:
The House of Venier was a patrician family of the Republic of Venice, first recorded in the eleventh century and probably seated at Chioggia before moving to the Rialto. After the Fourth Crusade a branch ruled the Greek islands of Cerigo and Paros, while a Cretan branch joined the island's revolts against Venetian rule.

The Venier entered the Venetian patriciate in the fourteenth century and gave the republic three doges: Antonio, Francesco and Sebastiano, an admiral of the Venetian fleet at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571 and doge from 1577 until his death in 1578.

Cecilia Venier-Baffo, daughter of the lord of Paros, was carried to the Ottoman court and became Nurbanu Sultan, wife of Selim II and mother of Murad III. The family built the Palazzo Venier dei Leoni on the Grand Canal.
zh:
韦涅尔家族是威尼斯共和国的贵族世家，11世纪始见记载，早年可能世居基奥贾，后迁至里亚尔托。第四次十字军东征后，家族一支统治了希腊的基西拉岛和帕罗斯岛，克里特支系则参与了岛上反抗威尼斯统治的起义。

韦涅尔家族于14世纪跻身威尼斯贵族行列，先后出了三位总督：安东尼奥、弗朗切斯科和塞巴斯蒂亚诺。塞巴斯蒂亚诺曾在1571年勒班陀战役中指挥威尼斯舰队，1577年出任总督，1578年去世。

帕罗斯领主之女切奇利娅·韦涅尔-巴福被掳入奥斯曼宫廷，成为努尔巴努苏丹，即塞利姆二世的王后、穆拉德三世的生母。家族在大运河畔修建了韦涅尔·德莱奥尼宫。

en:
The counts of Vianden held the castle above the Our river in the Ardennes and ranked among the mightiest regional lords from the twelfth to the fourteenth century. A count named Bertolph is first attested around 1090, probably sprung from the advocates of Prüm abbey.

The family reached its peak under Henry I, who in 1216 married Margaret, marchioness of Namur and daughter of the Latin emperor Peter II. In 1264 Vianden became a vassal of the counts of Luxembourg.

When Henry II died in 1337 the male line was nearly spent, and after a brief succession the county passed through his daughter Maria to her husband Simon III of Sponheim-Kreuznach, who ruled it jure uxoris from 1348. Through later marriages the inheritance flowed into the House of Orange-Nassau.
zh:
菲安登伯爵家族盘踞在阿登山区乌尔河畔的菲安登城堡，12至14世纪间是当地最有权势的领主之一。约1090年的文献首次提到一位名叫贝尔托夫的伯爵，其家族可能出自普吕姆修道院的代官。

家族在亨利一世时达到鼎盛：他于1216年娶那慕尔女侯爵玛格丽特为妻，后者是拉丁皇帝皮埃尔二世的女儿。1264年菲安登成为卢森堡伯爵的封臣。

1337年亨利二世去世，男丁几近断绝；经过短暂继承，伯国通过他的女儿玛丽亚转到其丈夫施蓬海姆-克罗伊茨纳赫的西蒙三世手中，西蒙自1348年起凭妻权统治。遗产后来经联姻流入奥兰治-拿骚家族。

en:
The Vijaya line was the restored Cham dynasty that reigned from Vijaya after the Tran occupation of 1312. Its founder Jaya Ananda was installed as a vassal vice-king in 1318 and repelled Tran Minh Tong's army in 1326, restoring Champa's independence.

After his death in 1336, his brother-in-law Maha Sawa fought the legitimate heir Jamo, who fled to the Tran court in 1342 and died after a failed restoration expedition in 1353. Po Binasuor, king from 1360 to 1390, united the Cham lands and sacked the Vietnamese capital Thang Long four times, in 1371, twice in 1377 and again in 1383, after King Tran Due Tong died assaulting Vijaya.

Ho Quy Ly checked him in 1380 and 1382. In 1390 Po Binasuor was killed by a firearm volley on his royal barge; his sons defected to Dai Viet and the restored kingdom's power collapsed.
zh:
毗阇耶世系是1312年陈朝占领后，以毗阇耶城为都复国的占婆王朝。开创者制阿难1318年被立为附庸副王，1326年击退陈明宗的军队，使占婆重获独立。

1336年他去世后，妻弟茶和布底与合法继承人亚莫争夺王位，亚莫于1342年逃奔陈朝，1353年复辟失败后客死异乡。1360—1390年在位的制蓬峩统一占人诸地，四次攻陷越南都城升龙：1371年一次、1377年两次、1383年一次；此前陈睿宗攻打毗阇耶兵败身亡。

胡季犛于1380年和1382年挡住他的兵锋。1390年制蓬峩的御舟遭火绳枪齐射，他中枪战死，儿子们投奔大越，复国占婆的国势随之崩塌。

en:
The Vilaragut were a Catalan noble house of the Penedès whose knights served Aragon by land and sea. In 1286 Berenguer de Vilaragut, an admiral of Sicily, took twenty galleys to blockade Brindisi for three days and raided Corfu.

His daughter Violante married James III of Majorca in 1347; after his death at Llucmajor in 1349, Peter IV of Aragon took her prisoner. Freed, she married Otto IV of Brunswick in 1353.

A younger branch settled in Sicily, where Ramon de Vilaragut married Diana Visconti and their son Anthony was born in 1336. Anthony commanded galleys defending Sicily against Naples and received Tripi. In 1388 John I granted him the Valencian baronies of Dosaigües and Alaquàs; at his death in 1400 he held one of the greatest estates in Valencia.
zh:
维拉拉古特是出身佩内德斯的加泰罗尼亚贵族世家，族中骑士为阿拉贡征战海陆。1286年西西里海军将领贝伦格尔·德·维拉拉古特率二十艘桨帆船封锁布林迪西三日，洗劫科孚岛。

其女比奥兰特于1347年嫁给马略卡国王海梅三世；1349年海梅在柳克马约尔兵败身死，她被阿拉贡国王佩德罗四世俘获，获释后于1353年改嫁不伦瑞克的奥托四世。

家族的一支定居西西里：拉蒙·德·维拉拉古特娶迪亚娜·维斯孔蒂为妻，其子安东尼1336年生于岛上。安东尼曾率桨帆船抵御那不勒斯诸王，受封特里皮；1388年胡安一世赐他瓦伦西亚的多赛格斯与阿拉卡斯男爵领，到1400年去世时，他已拥有瓦伦西亚最庞大的地产之一。

en:
The Villani were an old merchant family of Florence, enrolled among the greater guilds of the city. Its most famous son, Giovanni Villani, born around 1280, joined the Arte di Calimala in 1300; he served the Peruzzi bank across Italy, France and Flanders, later became a director of the Buonaccorsi company, and was chosen a prior of Florence.

After attending the jubilee in Rome in 1300 he began the Nuova Cronica, a year-by-year chronicle of Florence rich in economic and statistical detail. The collapse of the Buonaccorsi firm brought him imprisonment in 1346, and he died of the Black Death in 1348.

His brother Matteo, the Buonaccorsi representative in Naples, added eleven more books before dying of plague in 1363, and Matteo's son Filippo briefly carried the work on.
zh:
维拉尼家族是佛罗伦萨的老牌商人世家，名列城中的大行会。家族最著名的成员乔瓦尼·维拉尼约生于1280年，1300年加入卡利马拉行会；他曾为佩鲁齐银行奔走于意大利、法国和佛兰德之间，后来成为博纳科尔西公司的主管，并出任佛罗伦萨执政官。

1300年他在罗马参加禧年庆典后动笔撰写《新编年史》，逐年记述佛罗伦萨史，书中保留了大量经济与统计细节。博纳科尔西公司倒闭后，他于1346年入狱，1348年死于黑死病。

弟弟马泰奥曾任博纳科尔西公司驻那不勒斯代表，为《新编年史》续写了十一卷，1363年同样死于瘟疫；马泰奥之子菲利波又短暂续修了这部史书。

en:
The de Villeneuve were a knightly noble house of Provence, where their ancestor Giraud de Villeneuve was enfeoffed with Les Arcs, Trans and Esclans in 1201. The house split into several branches, including the barons des Arcs.

Hélion de Villeneuve was born around 1270 to the seigneur des Arcs and was the brother of Saint Roseline of Villeneuve. A Hospitaller of the langue of Provence, he became the first prior of Provence in 1317 and was elected grand master in 1319, after the forced resignation of Foulques de Villaret.

From Rhodes he reorganised the order's finances following its absorption of Templar property and led it until his death on the island in 1346. The des Arcs line was raised to the marquisate of Trans in 1505, traditionally counted as the first marquisate created in France.
zh:
德·维尔纳夫是普罗旺斯的骑士贵族世家，先祖吉罗·德·维尔纳夫于1201年受封莱萨尔克、特朗和埃斯克朗等地。家族后来分为数支，包括莱萨尔克男爵支。

埃利翁·德·维尔纳夫约1270年生于莱萨尔克领主之家，是圣女罗斯琳·德·维尔纳夫的兄弟。他是医院骑士团普罗旺斯语区的骑士，1317年成为首任普罗旺斯修道长，又在1319年富尔克·德·维拉雷被迫辞职后当选大团长。

他在罗得岛主持骑士团接收圣殿骑士团财产后的财务整顿，领导骑士团至1346年在岛上去世。莱萨尔克一支于1505年被封为特朗侯爵，传统上被视为法国设立的第一个侯爵领地。

en:
The Visconti were a Lombard noble family of Milan, first documented in 1075 when Ariprando Visconti and his son Ottone signed legal acts in the city; their hereditary title of viscount gave the house its name. The archbishop Ottone Visconti, appointed in 1262, wrested Milan from the rival Della Torre family in 1277 and founded the family's lordship. Teobaldo Visconti had already been elected pope as Gregory X in 1271. Under Azzone, lord from 1329 to 1339, the Visconti took Cremona and Brescia, won the Battle of Parabiago in 1339, and called Giotto to decorate their palace in Milan. Archbishop Giovanni added Bologna in 1350 and Genoa in 1353, while Bernabo and Galeazzo II married their many children into the royal houses of Europe and built the great castle of Pavia.

In 1385 Gian Galeazzo deposed his uncle Bernabo and united all Visconti lands; he bought the title of Duke of Milan from King Wenceslaus IV in 1395, conquered Verona, Padua, Pisa and Siena, began the Milan Cathedral in 1386 and founded the Certosa of Pavia, before dying in 1402. His daughter Valentina married Louis of Orleans in 1389, carrying a claim to Milan to the French royal house. With the death of Filippo Maria in 1447 the male line ended; the short-lived Ambrosian Republic followed, and Filippo Maria's son-in-law Francesco Sforza founded a new ducal dynasty.
zh:
维斯孔蒂家族是米兰的伦巴第贵族世家，1075年阿里普兰多·维斯孔蒂与儿子奥托内在米兰签署法律文书，是该家族最早的记载；其世袭的子爵头衔即家族姓氏的由来。1262年就任米兰大主教的奥托内于1277年从宿敌德拉·托雷家族手中夺取米兰，奠定了家族的统治。此前特奥巴尔多·维斯孔蒂已在1271年当选教宗，称格列高利十世。1329至1339年在位的阿佐内统治时期，维斯孔蒂家族攻取克雷莫纳和布雷西亚，1339年赢得帕拉比亚戈战役，还请乔托来米兰装饰宫邸。大主教乔瓦尼于1350年取得博洛尼亚，1353年接受热那亚的统治权；贝尔纳博与加莱亚佐二世则通过众多子女的婚姻与欧洲各王室联姻，并修建了宏伟的帕维亚城堡。

1385年，吉安·加莱亚佐废黜叔父贝尔纳博，统一了家族全部领地；1395年他从波希米亚国王文策尔四世那里购得米兰公爵头衔，又先后征服维罗纳、帕多瓦、比萨和锡耶纳，1386年动工兴建米兰大教堂，还创建了帕维亚加尔都西会修道院，1402年去世。其女瓦伦蒂娜于1389年嫁给奥尔良的路易，把对米兰的继承权带入法国王室。1447年菲利波·马里亚去世，男系绝嗣；此后出现了短暂的安布罗西亚共和国，最终由他的女婿弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎建立了新的公爵王朝。

en:
The Visconti di Gallura were a Pisan noble branch, separate from the Visconti of Milan, who rose in the service of the commune of Pisa. Alberto held the title of patrician, and his son Eldizio was consul in 1184 and 1185; Eldizio's sons Lamberto and Ubaldo each served a term as podesta. In 1207 Lamberto married Elena, heiress of Barisone II of Gallura, and so made himself ruler of the northeastern corner of Sardinia, with his capital at Civita in the Giudicato of Gallura; in 1215 the brothers also imposed their hegemony on the southern Giudicato of Cagliari. A Pisan faction war ended with their defeat near Massa in 1213, after which their role in Pisa declined.

The Gallura line ran through Lambert, Ubaldo, John and Nino. Nino, grandson of Ugolino della Gherardesca, was driven from Pisa in 1288 and died in Sardinia in 1296; Dante placed his hanged chaplain Gomita in the eighth circle of the Inferno. Nino's daughter Joanna inherited the title and married Rizzardo da Camino, but on her death in 1308 the dynasty became extinct and Gallura passed to the Aragonese.
zh:
维斯孔蒂·迪·加卢拉是比萨的贵族支系，与米兰的维斯孔蒂家族同源而独立，靠效力比萨城邦起家。阿尔贝托拥有贵族头衔，其子埃尔迪齐奥于1184至1185年任执政官；埃尔迪齐奥的儿子兰贝托和乌巴尔多都曾出任公社长官。1207年，兰贝托娶加卢拉的巴里松二世的女继承人埃莱娜为妻，由此成为撒丁岛东北部加卢拉法官国的统治者，以奇维塔为都；1215年兄弟二人又把势力扩展到南部的卡利亚里法官国。1213年比萨派系战争中他们在马萨附近战败，此后在比萨的势力大减。

加卢拉一系先后由兰贝托、乌巴尔多、约翰和尼诺相继统治。尼诺是乌戈利诺·德拉·盖拉尔德斯卡的外孙，1288年被逐出比萨，1296年死于撒丁；但丁在《神曲·地狱篇》第八圈里收容了他下令绞死的教士戈米塔。尼诺之女乔万娜继承头衔，嫁给里扎尔多·达·卡米诺；1308年乔万娜去世后支系绝嗣，加卢拉随后转入阿拉贡人之手。

en:
The Vitzthums were a Thuringian ministerial family, named for the office of vicedominus they held for the archbishops of Mainz. They first appear in 1123 with Dietrich de Abbolde at Apolda. By the mid-twelfth century they ran the archiepiscopal administration from Erfurt, with Apolda Castle as their seat.

They acquired Eckstedt in 1249 and split into the Apolda, Eckstadt and Rossla lines. Around 1300 they were the archbishops' stattholders in Erfurt; in 1342 the archbishop bought back the vicedominus office, but the title survived as their name.

The Apolda line, which included Berthold Vitzthum around 1300, held the castle as a Wettin fief and remained lords until 1631. The Rossla branch became notorious as robber barons in the fifteenth century, with Apel nicknamed the fire-master of Thuringia, while the Eckstadt line became counts and supplied Saxony with generals and statesmen.
zh:
菲茨图姆家族是图林根家臣世家，族名来自他们替美因茨大主教担任的副主官一职。1123年文献首次提到在阿波尔达效力的迪特里希·德·阿博尔德。到12世纪中叶，家族从埃尔福特替大主教管理政务，以阿波尔达城堡为驻地。

1249年家族取得埃克施泰特，随后分为阿波尔达、埃克施泰特和罗斯拉三支。1300年前后家族出任大主教在埃尔福特的总督；1342年大主教赎回副主官职务，但头衔作为姓氏保留下来。

约1300年在籍的贝特霍尔德·菲茨图姆所属的阿波尔达支，以韦廷家族封臣身份保有城堡，直到1631年仍是当地领主。罗斯拉支在15世纪以强盗骑士闻名，阿佩尔被称为图林根的纵火头目；埃克施泰特支升为伯爵，为萨克森出将入相。

en:
The von Diest were a noble house of Brabant, named after their seat at Diest, where Otto von Diest was recorded around 1099. They became lords of Diest and burgraves of Antwerp. Arnold I helped found Averbode Abbey in 1135, and Arnold III gave land to the Teutonic Order in 1229.

Arnold V fought at Worringen in 1288 and held Diest and the Antwerp burgraviate. Although a cleric, his son Johann inherited the family lands and became Bishop of Utrecht in 1322. Heinrich received the Antwerp burgraviate as a fief in 1363, while Wilhelm ruled as Prince-Bishop of Strasbourg from 1393 to 1439.

Thomas fought at Roosebeke in 1382 and acquired Sichem. The direct line ended with Johanna in 1472; through marriage the inheritance passed to the counts of Nassau, reaching Nassau-Diez in 1708.
zh:
冯·迪斯特是布拉班特贵族世家，得名于家族所在地迪斯特，约1099年已有奥托·冯·迪斯特的记载。家族后来成为迪斯特领主和安特卫普城堡伯。阿诺尔德一世于1135年参与创立阿弗博德修道院，阿诺尔德三世于1229年向条顿骑士团捐赠地产。

阿诺尔德五世参加1288年的沃林根战役，身兼迪斯特领主与安特卫普城堡伯。其子约翰虽是教士，却继承家产，于1322年出任乌得勒支主教。海因里希于1363年受封安特卫普城堡伯，威廉于1393—1439年任斯特拉斯堡采邑主教。

托马斯参加1382年的罗斯贝克之战并取得锡赫姆。直系于1472年随约翰娜之死而断绝，遗产经联姻转入拿骚伯爵家族，1708年归于拿骚-迪茨支系。

en:
The von Geroldseck were a Swabian noble house of the Ortenau, documented in the 1080s and settled in the Black Forest from 1139. Their wealth came from silver mining; they founded monasteries and served as protectors of the Bishop of Strasbourg.

Walter built the family castle between 1240 and 1250 and became Bishop of Strasbourg in 1260, but was defeated at Hausbergen in 1262, after which the city became a free imperial city. In 1270 his brother Heinrich married Agnes, heiress of Veldenz, founding its second comital dynasty. The house split into Upper and Lower lines in 1277 and again in the early 1300s, when the Veldenz branch became independent.

The Lower Line died out in 1426. The Palatinate stormed Castle Geroldseck in 1486; the last baron Jacob died in 1634, leaving an heiress whose claims were overtaken when the Kronberg family took the lordship in 1635.
zh:
冯·杰拉尔德塞克是奥尔特瑙地区的施瓦本贵族世家，11世纪80年代首见记载，1139年起定居黑林山区。家族财富来自银矿开采，捐建修道院，世代担任斯特拉斯堡主教的护教长官。

瓦尔特于1240—1250年间修建家族城堡，1260年出任斯特拉斯堡主教，却在1262年的豪斯贝根之战中败北，斯特拉斯堡从此成为帝国自由城市。1270年其弟海因里希娶费尔登茨女继承人阿格尼丝，开创当地第二个伯爵王朝。家族1277年分为上、下两支，14世纪初再度分裂，费尔登茨支系独立。

下支于1426年绝嗣。1486年普法尔茨军队攻陷杰拉尔德塞克城堡；末代男爵雅各布1634年去世，留下女继承人，克龙贝格家族1635年接管领地，她的继承权落空。

en:
The counts of Beichlingen were a Thuringian comital family seated at Beichlingen Castle, ruling a county in north-eastern Thuringia under the landgraves of Thuringia. Debt eroded their power: they sold Heringen Castle around 1330 and pledged pieces of the ancestral county. Decline accelerated after the Saxon Brotherly War broke out in 1446.

In 1448 counts Gunther and Hans pledged castles and villages to their kinsmen Botho of Stolberg and Henry of Schwarzburg for 22,000 Rhenish guilders. After Gunther's death in 1454 the lands passed to the two houses in 1457, forming the joint lordship of Frohndorf; Schwarzburg sold its share in 1468.

In 1519 Count Adam sold the remnant of the county and castle to Hans von Werthern, completing the county's dissolution into the Electorate of Saxony.
zh:
拜希林根伯爵家族驻于拜希林根城堡，统治图林根东北部的伯国，宗主权属于图林根领地伯爵。债务不断侵蚀家族势力：他们约在1330年卖掉黑林根城堡，后来又质押祖传伯国的土地。1446年萨克森兄弟战争爆发后，衰败进一步加速。

1448年京特伯爵与汉斯伯爵以22000莱茵古尔登把城堡和村庄质押给亲戚施托尔贝格的博托与施瓦茨堡的亨利。1454年京特去世后，这些地产于1457年转入两家，组成弗罗恩多夫共治领地；1468年施瓦茨堡售出自己的份额。

1519年亚当伯爵把残存的伯国和城堡卖给汉斯·冯·韦尔特恩，伯国彻底解体，并入萨克森选侯国。

en:
The Colditz were a Saxon noble family of ministerial origin, named after Colditz Castle on the Mulde, raised to an imperial estate by Frederick Barbarossa in 1158. They served the emperors and the Wettin margraves of Meissen as knights and officials.

Withego II was Bishop of Meissen from 1312 to 1342, buying Nossen in 1335 and acquiring Liebethal in 1336. Thimo II, an official of Emperor Charles IV, inherited Graupen in northern Bohemia in 1341, while Thimo VIII acquired Eilenburg in 1378 and the pledge of Pirna in 1379.

The family's Saxon seat passed to the Wettins in 1404. A Bohemian branch held Graupen until 1557, when Thimo V sold it to the lords of Schoenburg; that line is said to have died out after 1620.
zh:
科尔迪茨家族是萨克森贵族，出身家臣阶层，以穆尔德河畔的科尔迪茨城堡为姓；1158年皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨将城堡升格为帝国直辖领地。家族为皇帝和韦廷家族的迈森藩侯担任骑士与官员。

维特戈二世于1312—1342年任迈森主教，1335年购入诺森，1336年取得利贝塔尔。皇帝查理四世的官员蒂莫二世于1341年继承波希米亚北部的格劳彭；蒂莫八世于1378年取得艾伦堡，1379年取得皮尔纳的质押权。

家族在萨克森的本家领地于1404年落入韦廷家族之手。波希米亚支系保有格劳彭至1557年，蒂莫五世当年将它卖给舍恩堡领主；该支系据说在1620年之后绝嗣。

en:
The counts of Gleichen were a Thuringian noble house first documented in 1089 as counts of Tonna and seated at Graefentonna. In 1130 the archbishops of Mainz enfeoffed them with Gleichen Castle near Gotha, which gave the family its name and its County of Gleichen.

As Mainz Vogts over Erfurt from 1120 to 1290 and the archbishopric's dominant feudatories in the Eichsfeld, they were Mainz's chief agents in central Thuringia until they sold their Eichsfeld estates back to the archbishopric in 1294. In 1342 they became Vogts of Hersfeld Abbey over Ohrdruf, where they built a compact lordship, and in 1590 they moved their court there and built Ehrenstein Castle.

They also held fiefs of the margraves of Meissen and in 1583 inherited the immediate counties of Pyrmont and Spiegelberg. The comital line died out in 1631. A younger line, the barons von Gleichen attested from 1418, outlived it and in 1732 inherited the Greifenstein estates of the extinct lords of Russwurm.
zh:
格莱兴伯爵家族是图林根的贵族世家，1089年以托纳伯爵身份首见文献，驻格雷芬托纳。1130年美因茨大主教把哥达附近的格莱兴城堡封给他们，家族的姓氏与格莱兴伯国便由此而来。

1120—1290年他们担任美因茨在爱尔福特的地方官，又是大主教区在艾希斯费尔德的首要封臣和美因茨在中图林根最重要的代理人，直到1294年把艾希斯费尔德地产卖回给大主教区。1342年他们成为黑尔斯费尔德修道院在奥尔德鲁夫的地方官，在当地经营成紧凑领地，1590年又把府邸迁至奥尔德鲁夫，并修建埃伦施泰因城堡。

他们还持有迈森藩侯的封地，1583年继承了帝国直辖的皮尔蒙特与施皮格尔贝格伯国。伯爵主支于1631年绝嗣。1418年始见的幼支格莱兴男爵延续更久，1732年继承绝嗣的鲁斯武姆家族的格赖芬施泰因产业。

en:
The lords and counts of Manderscheid were a powerful noble house of the Eifel, with their early seat at the moated castle of Oberkail. A Blankenheim line is documented from 1112; its lands were raised to a county in 1380 and passed to them through an heiress in 1406.

In 1457 Emperor Frederick III made Dietrich III an imperial count. His estates, divided in 1488, went after his death in 1498 to three sons who founded the Blankenheim-Gerolstein, Kail and Schleiden lines. Schleiden ended in 1647 and Kail in 1742; Blankenheim inherited the other branches but ended with Countess Augusta in 1780.

Her husband Count Philip Christian von Sternberg took the name Sternberg-Manderscheid. Compensated with the abbey lands of Schussenried and Weissenau in 1803, the house was mediatized in 1806.
zh:
曼德沙伊德的领主与伯爵家族是艾费尔地区的强大贵族世家，早期驻于上凯尔的水堡。布兰肯海姆支系1112年已有记载，其领地1380年升为伯国，1406年经女继承人转入曼德沙伊德家族。

1457年皇帝腓特烈三世册封迪特里希三世为帝国伯爵。家产在1488年分割，他于1498年去世后，三个儿子分别开创布兰肯海姆-盖罗尔施泰因、凯尔和施莱登支系。施莱登支系于1647年绝嗣，凯尔支系于1742年绝嗣；布兰肯海姆支系继承其他支系产业，却在1780年随女伯爵奥古斯塔之死而终结。

她的丈夫菲利普·克里斯蒂安·冯·施特恩贝格伯爵改姓施特恩贝格-曼德沙伊德。家族1803年获赐舒森里德与魏森瑙修道院领地作为补偿，1806年被陪臣化。

en:
The counts of Rietberg ruled an imperial county on the upper Ems in Westphalia, between Paderborn and Muenster. Centred on the castle above Rietberg, it emerged as an independent county in 1237, with its own militia, laws and coinage. In 1456 Count Conrad V had to surrender immediacy and hold it as a fief of the landgraves of Hesse for 600 Rhenish guilders.

The Reformation was introduced in 1535 under Otto III, but the county was later re-Catholicized. The male line ended when John II died in prison in Cologne in 1562; his daughters were enfeoffed in 1565, and Walburgis married Enno III of East Frisia in 1581, carrying Rietberg to his house.

The East Frisian house's Rietberg line failed in 1690. In 1699 heiress Maria Ernestine married Maximilian Ulrich von Kaunitz, founding Kaunitz-Rietberg. Mediatized to Westphalia in 1807, the county passed to Prussia in 1815.
zh:
里特贝格伯爵家族统治威斯特伐利亚上埃姆斯河畔的帝国伯国，位于帕德博恩与明斯特之间。领地以里特贝格城上方的城堡为中心，1237年成为独立伯国，拥有自己的民兵、法律和铸币。1456年康拉德五世被迫放弃直辖地位，以600莱茵古尔登的代价把伯国改为黑森领地伯爵的封地。

1535年奥托三世在位时引入宗教改革，但伯国后来重新天主教化。1562年约翰二世死于科隆监狱，男系断绝；他的女儿们于1565年受封，瓦尔布吉斯于1581年嫁给东弗里斯兰的恩诺三世，把里特贝格带入其家族。

东弗里斯兰家族的里特贝格支系于1690年绝嗣。1699年女继承人玛丽亚·埃内斯蒂娜嫁给马克西米利安·乌尔里希·冯·考尼茨，开创考尼茨-里特贝格家族。伯国1807年被陪臣化给威斯特伐利亚王国，1815年转归普鲁士。

en:
The counts of Toggenburg ruled Toggenburg in canton St. Gallen and neighbouring lands from the thirteenth to the fifteenth century. An older baronial line was named after Alt-Toggenburg Castle, destroyed in 1085 in a feud with the abbot of St. Gallen and given to the abbey by Count Diethelm in 1226. The comital house is attested under Diethelm I, who inherited local lordships around 1200 and took the title of count in 1209.

The early counts contended with St. Gallen Abbey, the bishops of Constance and the counts of Kyburg; family strife saw one Diethelm kill his brother Rudolf in 1226.

The last count, Frederick VII, died in 1436 without male heirs, and the disputed inheritance triggered the Old Zurich War. Fourteen family members rested in the Toggenburg vault at Ruti Abbey until confederate troops desecrated the monastery in 1443.
zh:
吐根堡伯爵家族在13至15世纪统治圣加仑州的吐根堡及周边土地。更早的男爵支系以老吐根堡城堡得名，该城堡1085年在与圣加仑修道院长的仇杀中被毁，1226年由迪特赫尔姆伯爵赠给修道院。伯爵世家自迪特赫尔姆一世起有记载，他约在1200年继承数个地方领地，并于1209年使用伯爵头衔。

早期伯爵与圣加仑修道院、康斯坦茨主教和基堡伯爵争雄，家族内讧中，一位迪特赫尔姆于1226年杀死了亲兄弟鲁道夫。

末代伯爵弗里德里希七世于1436年去世，没有男性继承人，有争议的继承权引发旧苏黎世战争。十四名族人葬于吕蒂修道院的吐根堡墓室，1443年邦联军队劫掠修道院时，墓室遭到破坏。

en:
The counts of Wernigerode were a comital house in the Harzgau at the foot of the Harz, seated at Wernigerode Castle, recorded in 1213. Their first documented member, Count Albert I, came from Haimar and appears under the Wernigerode title in a charter of 1121. The family rivalled the counts of Regenstein.

Pressed by the Welf dukes of Brunswick, they lost imperial immediacy in 1268 and became vassals of the margraves of Brandenburg, then the archbishops of Magdeburg from 1381. In 1343 they added former Regenstein lands as fiefs of Halberstadt. The male line ended with Henry IV in 1429, and a settlement of 1417 passed the county to Stolberg.

Stolberg ruled it in personal union for two centuries. The Stolberg-Wernigerode line, formed in 1710, restored the castle, accepted Prussian overlordship in 1714 and was mediatized; the county entered Prussian Saxony in 1815.
zh:
韦尼格罗德伯爵家族是哈茨山北麓哈茨高地区的伯爵世家，驻于韦尼格罗德城堡，城堡1213年首见记载。家族可考的始祖阿尔布雷希特一世出身海马尔，1121年首次在文书中以韦尼格罗德伯爵的头衔出现。家族与雷根施泰因伯爵家族争雄。

迫于不伦瑞克韦尔夫公爵的压力，家族于1268年丧失帝国直辖地位，成为勃兰登堡藩侯的封臣，1381年改封马格德堡大主教；1343年他们以哈尔伯施塔特封臣身份取得原属雷根施泰因的领地。1429年亨利四世去世，男系绝嗣，伯国按1417年的继承协议转给施托尔贝格家族。

施托尔贝格伯爵以共主形式统治此地两百年。1710年分出的施托尔贝格-韦尼格罗德支系重修城堡，1714年承认普鲁士宗主权，最终遭陪臣化，伯国于1815年并入普鲁士萨克森省。

en:
The Wachi were kokujin lords of Bingo Province, holding Nantenzan Castle at Kisa and claiming descent from Fujiwara no Hidesato. Their forebear Hirasawa Sanekata followed Minamoto no Yoritomo and received an estate in Bingo in 1192; his son Sanetaka was already suppressing coastal pirates in 1211.

In the Nanboku-chō wars the Wachi resisted the Muromachi bakufu and served Ashikaga Tadafuyu, before Morozane joined Ashikaga Yoshiakira in 1367. With other Hirasawa descendants they formed the Hirasawa bands, dealing collectively with the Yamana and other Bingo lords. In the Sengoku age they shifted to Amago Tsunehisa and then Mōri Motonari.

The ninth head Masaharu entertained Mōri Takamoto in 1563 shortly before Takamoto's sudden death. Suspected of poisoning, Masaharu was confined on Itsukushima in 1568, entered the shrine's main hall and was killed there early in 1569. His son was spared, and the Wachi continued as Mōri retainers.
zh:
和智氏是备后国的国人领主，本据吉舎的南天山城，自称出自藤原秀乡一脉。其祖先广泽实方追随源赖朝，于1192年受封备后领地；其子实高在1211年已负责镇压沿海海盗。

南北朝动乱中，和智氏对抗室町幕府，一度投入足利直冬麾下，1367年和智师实转仕足利义诠。和智等广泽氏后裔组成广泽众，共同应对山名氏和其他备后豪强。进入战国，他们先后依附尼子经久和毛利元就。

第九代当主和智诚春于1563年设宴款待毛利隆元，隆元不久暴毙。诚春被疑下毒，1568年被监禁于严岛，逃入神社本殿，1569年初被讨杀。其子获赦，和智氏此后作为毛利家臣延续下去。

en:
The Waga were a kokujin house of Waga district in Mutsu Province. Their reliable genealogy derives them from the Nakajo line; Narisue's son Yoshiyuki moved to Waga around 1220, becoming steward of half the district and taking its name.

During the Nanboku-cho wars the family split between the courts. In 1401 Tokiyoshi was recognised as superintendent over the whole district; a succession feud became the Waga disturbance of 1435 to 1436, drawing in a thirty-thousand-strong Nanbu army and costing the family its outlying lands.

Dispossessed after missing Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign in 1590, the Waga rose unsuccessfully that autumn, and their district passed to the Nanbu in 1591. The Iwasaki rising of 1600 to 1601, launched with Date backing, also failed; its leader Tadachika took his own life after Iwasaki Castle fell.
zh:
和贺氏是陆奥国和贺郡的国人豪族，较可靠的家系出自中条氏。成季之子义行在承久年间下向和贺郡，成为半郡地头，并取郡名为苗字。

南北朝战乱中，一族分属南北两朝。1401年，当主时义的全郡支配权得到承认；1435—1436年家督纷争演变为和贺之乱，南部氏率近三万大军介入，和贺氏丧失了飞地。

1590年，和贺氏因未参加丰臣秀吉的小田原征伐而被没收领地，当年秋天起事失败，次年和贺郡转交南部氏。1600—1601年，伊达氏支持的岩崎一揆也告失败；岩崎城陷落后，首领忠亲自尽。

en:
The Wakes were a warrior family of Lincolnshire, with estates in Cumberland; Baldwin Wake and his son John, first Baron Wake of Liddell in 1295, were soldiers. John's son Thomas inherited as a child and was ward first to Piers Gaveston, then to Henry, Earl of Lancaster, whose daughter Blanche he married before 1317.

He joined Queen Isabella's rising against Edward II in 1326 and sat on Edward III's early council, but fell out with Isabella and Roger Mortimer and fled to France in 1330, returning after their fall. He governed the Channel Islands and backed Edward Balliol's invasion of Scotland.

Thomas died childless in 1349 and was buried at the priory he had founded at Haltemprice in Yorkshire; his lands passed through his sister Margaret to the earls of Kent and then the Holland family, and the barony fell into abeyance in 1408.
zh:
韦克家族是林肯郡的军人世家，在坎伯兰也有领地；鲍德温·韦克和他的儿子约翰都以善战闻名，约翰在1295年受封第一代利德尔的韦克男爵。约翰之子托马斯幼年袭爵，先由皮尔斯·加韦斯顿、后由兰开斯特伯爵亨利监护，并在1317年之前娶亨利之女布朗什为妻。

1326年他参加伊莎贝拉王后反对爱德华二世的起事，进入爱德华三世的早期议会，但与伊莎贝拉和罗杰·莫蒂默决裂，1330年逃往法国，直到二人倒台才回国。他出任海峡群岛总督，支持爱德华·巴里奥入侵苏格兰。

托马斯于1349年无子而终，葬在他于约克郡霍尔特姆普赖斯创建的修道院；领地经姐姐玛格丽特转入肯特伯爵一系，后又归于霍兰家族，男爵爵位则在1408年处于悬置状态。

en:
The Wākea dynasty represents the Aliʻi nui, the high chiefs of Molokaʻi, who like the rulers of the other Hawaiian islands claimed descent from Wākea, the sky father of Hawaiian religion.

With the earth mother Papahānaumoku, Wākea was held to have fathered the islands and the whole aliʻi nobility. The remembered early chiefs included Kamauaua, Keʻoloʻewa and the female rulers Kapau-a-Nuʻakea and Hualani.

Molokaʻi carried little weight in the wars between the islands, and its court mattered chiefly through marriage alliances and the fame of its kahuna priests and sorcery. From the late 1600s it was repeatedly raided by stronger neighbours, and in the later 1700s it was absorbed by the Maui kingdom of Kahekili II before the unification of the islands under Kamehameha I.
zh:
瓦凯亚王朝即莫洛凯岛的高级酋长阿利伊努伊世系。与夏威夷其他岛屿的统治者一样，莫洛凯酋长自称源自夏威夷宗教中的天神瓦凯亚。

相传瓦凯亚与大地之母帕帕哈瑙莫库生育了诸岛和整个阿利伊贵族阶层。流传下来的早期酋长包括卡马瓦阿、凯奥洛埃瓦，以及女性统治者卡保-阿-努阿凯亚和华拉尼。

莫洛凯在诸岛的争雄中无足轻重，其王室主要靠联姻以及祭司卡胡纳的巫术名望维持影响。17世纪末起，它屡遭强邻进攻，到18世纪后期被卡赫基利二世的毛伊王国吞并，此后诸岛又在卡美哈梅哈一世治下统一。

en:
The Walashma were a Muslim dynasty of the Horn of Africa that ruled Ifat and later Adal. They rose in eastern Shewa in the thirteenth century, annexing the Makhzumi Sultanate in 1278; in 1288 Wali Asma conquered Hubat and Adal.

Their contest with the Christian Solomonic emperors began in 1332, when Haqq ad-Din I was killed fighting Amda Seyon I. In 1403 the last Ifat sultan, Sa'ad ad-Din II, was killed at Zeila; his sons fled to Yemen and returned in 1415, when Sabr ad-Din III founded Adal with its seat at Dakkar and later Harar.

By the late fifteenth century power was passing to emirs and imams. The imam Ahmed Gran conquered most of Abyssinia in the 1530s before his death in 1543; in 1577 the court moved to Aussa, the sultanate became an imamate and the Walashma line ended.
zh:
瓦拉什马王朝是非洲之角的穆斯林王朝，先后统治伊法特和阿达尔。它于13世纪在绍阿东部崛起，1278年吞并马赫祖米苏丹国；1288年瓦利·阿斯马征服胡巴特和阿达尔。

它与基督教所罗门王朝皇帝的较量始于1332年，哈格丁一世在与安达·塞永一世作战时被杀。1403年，末代伊法特苏丹萨阿德丁二世在泽拉遇害；他的儿子们逃往也门，1415年返回，萨巴尔·阿德丁三世建立阿达尔苏丹国，先后以达卡尔和哈勒尔为都。

到15世纪末，实权渐渐落入埃米尔和伊玛目手中。16世纪30年代，伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰攻占阿比西尼亚大半国土，于1543年败亡；1577年朝廷迁往奥萨，苏丹国改组为伊玛目国，瓦拉什马世系就此终结。

en:
The counts of Waldeck sprang from the counts of Schwalenberg. In 1180 Volkwin II of Schwalenberg gained Waldeck Castle in northern Hesse by marrying Luitgard, the Waldeck heiress; his branch took the castle's name and assembled a small lordship around it.

Originally a fief of the archbishopric of Mainz, the county won imperial immediacy in 1349. After Count Henry VI died in 1397 the family split into the Landau and Waldeck lines, which came under Hessian overlordship in 1431 and 1438. A further partition in 1486 produced the Waldeck-Wildungen and Waldeck-Eisenberg branches, whose counts adopted Lutheranism in 1526 and 1529.

The inheritance of Pyrmont in 1626 gave the family its double name. The residence moved to Arolsen in 1655, the lines were reunited in 1692, and princely rank followed in 1712.
zh:
瓦尔代克伯爵家族出自施瓦伦贝格伯爵世家。1180年，施瓦伦贝格的福尔克温二世娶瓦尔代克女继承人卢特加德，得到北黑森的瓦尔代克城堡；他的支系以城堡为姓，在周围建立了一块小领地。

伯国本是美因茨大主教区的封地，1349年取得帝国直辖地位。1397年伯爵亨利六世去世后，家族分为兰道和瓦尔代克两支，分别于1431年和1438年沦为黑森的附庸。1486年再度分家，产生瓦尔代克-维尔东根与瓦尔代克-艾森贝格两支，两支伯爵先后在1526年和1529年改宗路德宗。

1626年家族继承皮尔蒙特伯国，从此冠以双姓。1655年居所迁至阿罗尔森，1692年各支重新统一，1712年家族获得诸侯爵位。

en:
The Wang were the royal house of Goryeo, founded in 918 when Wang Geon, a lord of Songak, overthrew Gung Ye of Taebong and took the throne as King Taejo. He absorbed Silla and conquered Later Baekje, uniting the Later Three Kingdoms, and his descendants ruled from Kaesong for 474 years.

From 1170 to 1270 the kings were puppets of the Goryeo military regime; after its fall the house chose vassalage to the Mongols. Under the Yuan dynasty the kings married Borjigin princesses, and King Chungseon was enfeoffed as Prince of Shenyang.

King Gongmin restored Goryeo's independence in 1356, but after the Wihwado Retreat of 1388 General Yi Seong-gye seized power and founded the Joseon dynasty in 1392. From 1392 to 1413 more than a hundred royal Wangs were killed or exiled, and survivors hid under other surnames.
zh:
王氏是高丽的王室。918年，松岳豪族王建推翻泰封的弓裔，登基为王，是为太祖；他随后吞并新罗、攻灭后百济，统一后三国，其子孙在开城统治了474年。

1170年至1270年间，国王沦为武人政权的傀儡；武人政权倒台后，王室转而臣事蒙古。元朝时高丽国王迎娶孛儿只斤氏公主，忠宣王受封沈阳王。

1356年，恭愍王恢复高丽独立，但1388年威化岛回军后，大将李成桂掌握实权，并于1392年建立朝鲜王朝。1392年至1413年间，一百余名王族被杀或被流放，幸存者隐姓或改姓。

en:
The de Warennes took their name from Varenne in Normandy and came to England with the Conquest. William de Warenne, a kinsman of William the Conqueror, fought at Hastings in 1066 and was created Earl of Surrey in 1088. When the direct male line failed in the twelfth century, its heiress Isabel married Hamelin, an illegitimate half-brother of Henry II, whose children took the Warenne name.

John de Warenne, the sixth earl, was a commander in the Scottish wars, and his daughter Isabel married King John Balliol of Scotland. The seventh and last earl, John, helped capture Piers Gaveston and campaigned in Scotland as guardian of Edward Balliol, who named him Earl of Strathearn in name only.

He died without legitimate issue in 1347. The Warenne inheritance passed through his sister Alice to her son Richard FitzAlan, Earl of Arundel.
zh:
德·瓦伦家族以诺曼底的瓦伦村得名，随诺曼征服来到英格兰。威廉·德·瓦伦是征服者威廉的亲族，1066年参战黑斯廷斯，1088年受封萨里伯爵。12世纪直系男丁断绝后，女继承人伊莎贝尔嫁给亨利二世的异母私生兄弟哈姆林，其子女改用瓦伦姓氏。

第六代伯爵约翰·德·瓦伦是苏格兰战争的统帅，其女伊莎贝尔嫁给苏格兰国王约翰·巴利奥尔。第七代、也是末代伯爵约翰参与擒获皮尔斯·加维斯顿；他作为爱德华·巴利奥尔的监护人出征苏格兰，被巴利奥尔名义上封为斯特拉森伯爵。

1347年他去世时无合法子嗣。瓦伦家产经其妹爱丽丝传给其子阿伦德尔伯爵理查德·菲茨艾伦。

en:
The Wareru dynasty ruled Hanthawaddy, the Mon kingdom of lower Burma, from Martaban and later Pegu. Its founder Wareru, born Ma Gadu near Thaton, seized the governorship of Martaban in 1285 and declared independence with Sukhothai's backing in 1287. He and Pegu warlord Tarabya defeated a Pagan invasion in 1295 and 1296; Wareru then removed his ally, united the Mon provinces and won Yuan recognition in 1298.

Wareru was assassinated in 1307, but the legal code he commissioned shaped Burmese and Siamese law for centuries. The kingdom became fully independent in 1330 when Binnya E Law took power; Razadarit, ruling from 1384 to 1421, unified the Mon lands and held off Ava in the Forty Years' War.

Hanthawaddy grew rich on Indian Ocean trade and became a center of Theravada Buddhism, until Taungoo conquered Pegu in 1539 and Martaban in 1541. A Mon restoration in 1740 revived the kingdom before Alaungpaya destroyed Pegu in 1757.
zh:
伐丽流王朝统治下缅甸的孟人王国汉达瓦底，先后以马达班和勃固为都。开国君主伐丽流本名马都，生于直通附近，1285年夺取马达班总督之位，并在素可泰支持下于1287年宣布独立。1295—1296年他与勃固军阀多罗跋联手击溃蒲甘大军，随后除掉盟友，统一孟人诸省，1298年获得元朝承认。

伐丽流于1307年遇刺，但他下令编纂的法典影响缅甸和暹罗法律达数百年。1330年频耶埃劳登位，汉达瓦底完全独立；1384—1421年在位的罗娑陀利统一孟人诸地，在四十年战争中抵挡住阿瓦。

汉达瓦底靠印度洋贸易富甲一方，成为上座部佛教重镇，直到东吁于1539年攻陷勃固、1541年攻陷马达班。1740年孟人一度复兴王国，但1757年雍笈牙焚毁勃固，复兴政权告终。

en:
The Washizu were a cadet branch of the Ouchi of Suo, who claimed descent from a prince of Baekje. Ouchi Morifusa's son Moriyasu received Washizu manor in Tsuno and took its name. His son Chikamori died without an heir, and Chikamori's daughter Zen'ei adopted Nagahiro from the Ouchi main line.

Nagahiro was made constable of Suo after the fall of the Kamakura shogunate in 1333 and kept the post under the Muromachi shogunate. He rivalled the Ouchi head until the succession feuds of the Kannō Disturbance ended with the Washizu submitting to the main house in 1354.

Washizu Hirotada built Dainei-ji in 1410 and was appointed deputy constable of Nagato in 1432. Ouchi Norihiro turned on him, and in 1448 the family was overthrown and Hirotada killed; the Washizu lived on as retainers of the Ouchi and later the Mori.
zh:
鹫头氏是周防大内氏的庶流，大内家自称是百济国王子的后裔。大内盛房之子盛保领有都浓郡鹫头庄，遂以鹫头为苗字。盛保之子亲盛死后无嗣，亲盛之女禅惠尼从大内宗家迎养长弘为后继。

1333年镰仓幕府灭亡后，长弘出任周防守护，室町幕府成立后他仍保住此职。他与大内宗家当主对立，观应之扰乱中的继嗣纷争最终以1354年鹫头氏臣服大内本家告终。

鹫头弘忠于1410年创建大宁寺，1432年出任长门守护代。大内教弘随后对他翻脸，1448年攻灭鹫头氏，弘忠战死；其家族此后以大内氏、后来的毛利氏家臣身分延续。

en:
The House of Wassenberg was a Lower Rhineland dynasty seated at Wassenberg and first documented in the eleventh century. Its earliest known ancestors were the brothers Gerard and Rutger, from whom the counts of Guelders and Cleves respectively descended. In 1096 Gerard IV became Count of Guelders, and his successor married the heiress of Zutphen.

Guelders expanded along the Meuse, Rhine and IJssel until defeat at Worringen in 1288 checked its ambitions. In 1339 Reginald II became Duke of Guelders, but his sons Reginald III and Edward fought, Edward imprisoning his brother; both died without male heirs.

In 1371 Edward's daughters and their husbands contended for the duchy, which passed through Maria of Guelders to the House of Jülich. The Cleves branch ended with Count John in 1368, when Cleves fell to the House of the Marck.
zh:
瓦森贝格家族是下莱茵的世家，以瓦森贝格为驻地，11世纪起见于文献。可考的始祖是格拉尔德与鲁特格尔兄弟，海尔德兰和克莱沃伯爵分别出自两人的后裔。1096年格拉尔德四世成为海尔德兰伯爵，其继任者娶聚特芬女继承人为妻。

海尔德兰沿默兹河、莱茵河与艾瑟尔河扩张，直到1288年沃林根战役失利才收敛野心。1339年雷金纳德二世升为海尔德兰公爵，但他的儿子雷金纳德三世与爱德华兄弟阋墙，爱德华囚禁了兄长，两人都没有男嗣。

1371年，爱德华的女儿们及其夫君争夺公国，最终经海尔德兰的玛利亚之手转入于利希家族。克莱沃支在1368年伯爵约翰死后终结，克莱沃落入马克家族之手。

en:
The House of Wedel was a German noble family from Stormarn in Holstein. Its line ran back to a monastery vogt named Heinrich, documented at Ottenbüttel in 1149, and three brothers called Heinricus, Hasso and Reimbernus de Wedele appeared as witnesses in a charter of 1212.

In 1306 a family member was captured after the second battle of Uetersen and broken on the wheel. The house spread into three branches, and in 1328 Emperor Louis IV enfeoffed the lords of Wedel with castles in the Brandenburg Neumark, tying its fortunes to the Margraviate of Brandenburg.

Later members included Lupold von Wedel, a travel writer and mercenary leader, and Gustav Wilhelm von Wedel, a Danish general who received the Norwegian countship of Jarlsberg in 1684. An East Frisian branch built the Evenburg and inherited Schloss Gödens by marriage in 1746.
zh:
魏德尔家族是来自荷尔斯泰因施托尔曼的德意志贵族世家。其世系可追溯到1149年在奥滕比特尔见诸文献的修道院护域官海因里希；1212年，海因里库斯、哈索和赖因贝努斯·德·魏德尔三兄弟在一份特许状中以见证人身份出现。

1306年，家族一名成员在第二次乌特森之战后被俘，遭车裂处死。该家族分为三支，1328年皇帝路易四世把勃兰登堡新马克的城堡封给魏德尔领主，使其命运与勃兰登堡藩侯国连在一起。

后来的家族成员有旅行作家兼雇佣兵首领卢波尔德·冯·魏德尔，以及1684年获封挪威亚尔斯贝格伯爵领的丹麦将领古斯塔夫·威廉·冯·魏德尔。东弗里斯兰支系修建埃文堡，并于1746年通过联姻继承格登斯宫。

en:
The Welfs began as a Franconian clan kin to the Carolingians. When the elder male line ended with Duke Welf III of Carinthia in 1055, his estates passed to his nephew Welf IV of Este, who became Duke of Bavaria in 1070 and founded the Welf-Este house. The family backed the papacy in the Investiture Controversy, so the pope's Italian partisans took the name Guelphs from them.

Under Henry the Lion, Duke of Saxony from 1142 and Bavaria again from 1156, the house reached its medieval height: he founded Munich and made Brunswick his capital, but his breach with Frederick Barbarossa cost him both duchies in 1180. His son Otto IV, the only Welf emperor, was crowned in 1209 and ruined at Bouvines in 1214.

In 1235 Otto the Child received the Duchy of Brunswick-Lüneburg, split in 1269 into Brunswick and Lüneburg lines whose branches still ruled Saxon principalities in 1337. A Hanover branch gained the electoral dignity in 1692 and the British throne with George I in 1714.
zh:
韦尔夫家族是与加洛林王室有亲缘的法兰克尼亚氏族。1055年克恩顿公爵韦尔夫三世去世，老支男系断绝，遗产传给外甥、埃斯特家的韦尔夫四世；他1070年成为巴伐利亚公爵，开创韦尔夫-埃斯特支系。家族在叙任权斗争中支持教宗，意大利教宗党由此得名归尔甫派。

狮子亨利1142年起任萨克森公爵、1156年又收复巴伐利亚，家族势力达到中世纪顶峰：他兴建慕尼黑，立不伦瑞克为都城，后与腓特烈·巴巴罗萨反目，1180年被剥夺两个公国。其子奥托四世是家族唯一登上帝位者，1209年加冕，1214年布汶战败后一蹶不振。

1235年孩童奥托受封不伦瑞克-吕讷堡公国，1269年分为不伦瑞克和吕讷堡两支，其支系1337年仍统治萨克森各邦。汉诺威幼支1692年获选帝侯尊位，1714年乔治一世登上英国王位。

en:
The counts of Werdenberg were a Swabian noble house sprung from the counts of Montfort and the counts palatine of Tübingen. Hugo II of Tübingen had married the heiress of the last count of Bregenz and brought the family lands along the Alpine Rhine. In 1230 the Montfort inheritance was partitioned and the Werdenberg line took its name from Werdenberg castle above the Rhine.

Rudolf I's sons split the territory again, founding Werdenberg-Heiligenberg and Werdenberg-Sargans in 1260; a further division followed in 1308. The Vaduz line expired in 1406 and Vaduz passed to the barons of Brandis.

The Werdenberg feud with the von Zimmern family and other neighbours escalated in 1488, helping push Emperor Frederick III and Maximilian I toward the Swabian League and the Imperial Reforms. The last influential branch, Werdenberg-Heiligenberg-Sigmaringen-Trochtelfingen, died out in 1534.
zh:
韦尔登贝格伯爵是施瓦本贵族世家，出自蒙特福特伯爵，往上可溯至蒂宾根行宫伯爵。蒂宾根的胡戈二世娶了末代布雷根茨伯爵的女继承人，为家族带来阿尔卑斯莱茵河沿岸的土地。1230年蒙特福特遗产分家，韦尔登贝格一支以莱茵河畔的韦尔登贝格城堡得名。

鲁道夫一世的儿子们再度瓜分领地，于1260年形成韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格和韦尔登贝格-萨尔甘斯两支，1308年又再分家。瓦杜兹支于1406年绝嗣，瓦杜兹转入布兰迪斯男爵之手。

家族与齐默恩家族及邻邦的韦尔登贝格世仇在1488年激化，促使皇帝腓特烈三世和马克西米利安一世推动组建施瓦本联盟、开展帝国改革。最后一个有影响力的支系韦尔登贝格-海利根贝格-锡格马林根-特罗希特尔芬根于1534年绝嗣。

en:
The House of Wettin was a dynasty of the Holy Roman Empire, named after Wettin Castle on the Saale, acquired around 1000. In 1089 Emperor Henry IV invested the family with the March of Meissen.

The Wettins inherited Thuringia in 1263 and in 1423 were enfeoffed with Saxe-Wittenberg and the Saxon electoral dignity. In 1485 the Treaty of Leipzig divided the family into the Ernestine and Albertine lines. The Ernestines kept the electorate until 1547 and led the early Reformation, with Elector Frederick the Wise protecting Martin Luther at Wittenberg.

After the Schmalkaldic War the electorate passed to the Albertines, who became kings of Saxony in 1806 and supplied two kings of Poland between 1697 and 1763. The Ernestines retained Thuringian duchies; their Saxe-Coburg line produced Leopold I, elected king of the Belgians in 1831.
zh:
韦廷家族是神圣罗马帝国的王朝，得名于约1000年获得的萨勒河畔韦廷城堡。1089年皇帝亨利四世把迈森马克封给该家族。

1263年韦廷家族继承图林根，1423年受封萨克森—维滕贝格并取得萨克森选侯资格。1485年的《莱比锡条约》把家族分为恩斯特系和阿尔布雷希特系。恩斯特系保有选侯位至1547年，并在宗教改革早期站在新教一边：选侯“智者”腓特烈把马丁·路德保护在维滕贝格。

施马尔卡尔登战争后选侯位转入阿尔布雷希特系之手，该支于1806年成为萨克森国王，还在1697至1763年间出过两位波兰国王。恩斯特系保有图林根的公国，其萨克森—科堡支系的利奥波德一世于1831年当选比利时国王。

en:
The lords of Wiltz, later counts, were one of the oldest noble families of Luxembourg, seated above the Wiltz river in the Ardennes. Walther of Wiltz fought for the duke of Brabant at the Battle of Worringen in 1288. In the thirteenth century the family built a fortified castle on a rocky spur above the town.

Godart of Wiltz renewed the town's charters of liberties in 1437. The title of baron came in 1536, and John V styled himself count and began the Renaissance castle in 1631. From 1656 the comital line called itself de Custine; its last count fled the French revolutionary army in 1793 and died in exile at Bamberg in 1799.
zh:
维尔茨领主家族后来成为伯爵，是卢森堡最古老的贵族世家之一，盘踞在阿登山区维尔茨河畔。瓦尔特·德·维尔茨在1288年随布拉班特公爵参加沃林根战役。13世纪时，家族在镇上方的岩石岬角修建了坚固城堡。

戈达尔·德·维尔茨于1437年重新颁发了城镇的自由特许状。1536年家族获得男爵头衔；约翰五世自称伯爵，并于1631年动工修建文艺复兴式城堡。1656年起，伯爵支系改姓德·屈斯蒂纳；末代伯爵在1793年逃避法国革命军出走，1799年流亡死于班贝格。

en:
The Wittelsbachs descend from the Counts of Scheyern, who moved to Wittelsbach Castle in 1119 and took their name from it. Otto, son of Count Palatine Otto IV, received Bavaria in 1180 after Henry the Lion's fall, and Louis I added the Rhenish Palatinate by marriage in 1214.

Under Louis IV, elected emperor in 1328, the house gathered Brandenburg, Tyrol, Holland and Hainaut, while the Treaty of Pavia in 1329 separated the Palatinate branch. After Louis died in 1347 his sons divided Bavaria; Tyrol was ceded to the Habsburgs in 1369 and Brandenburg returned to the Luxembourgs in 1373.

Bavaria was reunited in 1505, and its Catholic dukes led the German Counter-Reformation, Maximilian I gaining the electoral hat in 1623. The Palatinate line produced the Bohemian Winter King Frederick V in 1619, and the Palatine princess Sophia of Hanover carried the British succession to her son George I in 1714. In 1806 Bavaria became a kingdom under Maximilian I Joseph.
zh:
维特尔斯巴赫家族出自沙伊恩伯爵世家，1119年迁居维特尔斯巴赫城堡并以此为族名。行宫伯爵奥托四世之子奥托在1180年狮子亨利倒台后受封巴伐利亚，路德维希一世1214年联姻取得莱茵普法尔茨。

路德维希四世1328年当选皇帝，家族取得勃兰登堡、蒂罗尔、荷兰与埃诺；1329年《帕维亚条约》分出普法尔茨支系。他1347年去世后诸子分裂巴伐利亚，蒂罗尔1369年割让哈布斯堡，勃兰登堡1373年归还卢森堡。

巴伐利亚1505年重新统一，天主教公爵领导德意志反宗教改革，马克西米利安一世1623年取得选帝侯头衔。普法尔茨支系出了1619年的波希米亚冬王腓特烈五世，普法尔茨公主汉诺威的索菲娅把英国王位继承权传给儿子乔治一世（1714年）。1806年巴伐利亚在马克西米利安一世·约瑟夫治下成为王国。

en:
The Wittgenstein were a comital dynasty of the Sauerland in north-western Germany, named after Wittgenstein Castle above the Lahn. They descended from Werner I of Battenberg and Wittgenstein, whose line also held the County of Battenberg in Hesse. The family renounced its Battenberg lands in 1296 and kept its seat at Wittgenstein.

In 1337 the county was still ruled by the last generations of the house, whose heiress Adelaide married Count Salentin of Sayn-Homburg of the House of Sponheim in 1345. The inheritance passed to the Sayn line, which took the name Sayn-Wittgenstein, while the old comital family was extinct in the male line by the middle of the fourteenth century.
zh:
维特根斯坦家族是德意志西北部绍尔兰地区的伯爵世家，得名于俯瞰拉恩河的维特根斯坦城堡。其始祖为巴滕贝格与维特根斯坦的维尔纳一世，家族同时领有黑森境内的巴滕贝格伯国；1296年家族放弃巴滕贝格领地，以维特根斯坦为驻地。

1337年时伯国仍由该家族最后几代人统治，继承人阿德莱德于1345年嫁给施蓬海姆家族的塞恩-洪堡伯爵萨伦廷。遗产随后转入塞恩一脉，改称塞恩-维特根施泰因，而伯爵家族到14世纪中叶已男嗣断绝。

en:
The House of Württemberg grew from the lords of Beutelsbach in the Rems valley, first recorded in 1081 and named after Wirtemberg castle above Stuttgart. They ranked as counts from the twelfth century. Ulrich I's marriage in 1251 brought Stuttgart, which became their sole residence after Beutelsbach was ravaged in 1311.

Eberhard I enlarged the domain by almost half despite a royal war of 1310 to 1311. His son Ulrich III bought Vaihingen in 1339 and Tübingen in 1342; Eberhard II and Ulrich IV continued acquiring castles and towns, gaining the mint right in 1374.

The Treaty of Nürtingen split the house in 1442, but Eberhard V reunited its lands through treaties in 1482 and 1492. In 1495 the county became the Duchy of Württemberg; the dynasty later became electors and, in 1806, kings.
zh:
符腾堡家族出身于雷姆斯河谷的博伊特尔斯巴赫领主，1081年首见记载，得名于斯图加特附近的维滕贝格堡，12世纪起取得伯爵身份。乌尔里希一世1251年联姻取得斯图加特；1311年博伊特尔斯巴赫遭洗劫后，斯图加特成为唯一驻地。

埃伯哈德一世尽管在1310—1311年的皇帝战争中受挫，仍把领地扩大了近一半。其子乌尔里希三世于1339年买入法伊欣根，1342年购入图宾根；埃伯哈德二世与乌尔里希四世继续收购城堡与城镇，1374年获得铸币权。

1442年《尼尔廷根条约》使家族分裂，埃伯哈德五世借1482年和1492年的条约重新统一领地。1495年符腾堡伯国升格为公国，家族后来成为选侯，并于1806年称王。

en:
