The Suruga Yabe took their name from Yabe village in Udō District, where they served as local land stewards; they claimed descent from the Fujiwara line of the courtier Tsutsumi no Kanesuke. In 1200 a clansman, Yabe Jūrō Terutane, won merit in the destruction of Kajiwara Kagetoki and was enfeoffed with twenty-one villages in Inaba Province, where he founded the separate Inaba Yabe line, while the original house remained in Suruga.

In the Muromachi period the Suruga Yabe became retainers of the Imagawa lords. Tradition at the Kusanagi Kubizuka Inari shrine records that they supported Oshika Norimitsu in an Imagawa succession struggle and were put down.

Later Yabe Sadanori, a retainer of Imagawa Ujizane, made his home again in Yabe village and took the Yabe name; under his son Sadakiyo the house entered Tokugawa service and became hatamoto.
zh:
骏河矢部氏以有度郡矢部村为苗字之地，世代担任当地地头，自称出自堤中纳言藤原兼辅的藤原氏一流。1200年，族人矢部十郎晖种因追讨梶原景时立功，受封因幡国二十一处村庄，开创因幡矢部氏一脉，本家则留在骏河。

室町时代，骏河矢部氏成为今川氏的被官。草薙首冢稻荷神社流传的说法称，他们在今川家的继承之争中支持小鹿范满，遭到讨伐。

后来今川氏真的家臣矢部定则回到矢部村定居并以矢部为姓，到其子定清一代转仕德川氏，成为旗本。

en:
The Yadavarayas were a Telugu chiefly line who held Chandragiri and Narayanavanam in the hill country around Tirupati. They claimed descent from Yadu and styled themselves Yadavas. Around the year 1000 Immadi Narasimha Yadavaraya built the fort at Chandragiri, and the family's endowments were inscribed on the walls of the Venkateswara temple at Tirumala.

In the mid-1310s the Yadavaraya of Chandragiri joined the Hoysala king Ballala and the chief of Padaividu against the Kakatiya king Prataparudra, only to be defeated by his general Peda Rudra. Rulers such as Sriranganatha Yadavaraya still left inscriptions in the following decades, but Chandragiri passed to the Vijayanagara Empire in 1367 and the line lost its separate rule.
zh:
耶陀婆（耶陀波罗耶）是泰卢固人的首领家族，占据蒂鲁帕蒂一带山区的钱德拉吉里和纳拉耶纳瓦纳姆。他们自称雅度后裔，冠以耶陀婆之名。约1000年，伊马迪·纳拉辛哈·耶陀波罗耶修建了钱德拉吉里城堡，蒂鲁马拉文卡特斯瓦拉神庙墙上留有家族的供奉铭文。

14世纪10年代中期，钱德拉吉里的耶陀波罗耶与曷萨拉国王巴拉拉及波多毗都首领联手，对抗卡卡提亚国王普拉塔帕鲁陀罗，却被其将领佩达·鲁陀罗击败。此后斯里兰加纳塔·耶陀波罗耶等统治者仍留有铭文，但钱德拉吉里于1367年并入毗奢耶那伽罗帝国，家族的独立统治告终。

en:
The Yamaguchi of Musashi were a branch of the Murayama party, one of the seven warrior bands of Musashi, and claimed descent from the Kanmu Heishi line of the Taira. The party's founder Taira no Yorito held Murayama, and his grandson Ietsugu settled at Yamaguchi in Iruma district and took its name; generations of the clan were based at Yamaguchi Castle.

In the Musashi Heiikki uprising of 1368 the Yamaguchi sided with the Kawagoe clan, and their castle fell to Uesugi Noriaki, acting for Ashikaga Ujimitsu. In 1383 Takaharu, backed by the Southern Court, rose again with his grandfather Takazane but was defeated; they set fire to Yamaguchi Castle and took their own lives.

Takatada, Takaharu's son, entered Uesugi service and later served the Later Hojo. After the Hojo fell in 1590 his descendants, including Yamaguchi Daizen, served the Tokugawa.
zh:
武藏山口氏是武藏七党之一村山党的支族，自称出自桓武平氏的平氏流。村山党之祖平赖任领有村山，其孙家继移居入间郡山口，以地名为苗字，此后世代居守山口城。

1368年武藏平一揆中，山口氏站在河越氏一方，山口城被足利氏满麾下的上杉宪显攻陷。1383年，得到南朝支持的山口高治与祖父高实再度举兵，兵败后焚城自尽。

高治之子高忠转仕上杉氏，后又出仕后北条氏。1590年后北条氏灭亡，其后代山口大善等人转投德川氏。

en:
The Yamana were a samurai house of the Seiwa Genji, descended from Minamoto no Yoshishige. Founder Yamana Yoshinori took his name from Yamana village in Kozuke, and his descendants served Minamoto no Yoritomo.

Backing Ashikaga Takauji in the Nanboku-cho wars, they became shugo of eleven provinces at their peak, earning the nickname One-Sixth Lord. The Meitoku Rebellion against Ashikaga Yoshimitsu in 1391 cost them most holdings. Yamana Sozen rebuilt their fortunes, but his feud with Hosokawa Katsumoto ignited the Onin War in 1467, wrecking Kyoto and opening the Sengoku period.

By the late sixteenth century the family held little beyond Inaba, where Yamana Suketoyo developed the Ikuno silver mine and built Arikoyama Castle before defeat in 1580. His successor Toyokuni fought at Sekigahara in 1600 and kept a small domain under Tokugawa Ieyasu; the house survived until the Edo period's end.
zh:
山名氏是清和源氏的武家，谱系可追溯到源义重。始祖山名义范以所领上野国山名乡为苗字，后代侍奉源赖朝。

南北朝时他们追随足利尊氏，鼎盛时担任十一国守护，号称“六分一殿”。1391年山名一族起兵反对足利义满，即明德之乱，兵败后丧失大半领地。山名宗全重振家势，但他与细川胜元的对立引发1467年的应仁之乱，战火焚毁京都，揭开战国时代的序幕。

到16世纪末，其领地只剩因幡国一带，山名祐丰在那里开发生野银山、修筑有子山城，于1580年战败。继任的山名丰国参加1600年的关原之战，后在德川家康治下领有小片藩地，山名家存续到江户时代末期。

en:
The Yamashiro were a warrior family of Hizen Province in northern Kyushu and a branch of the Matsura federation. The line began with Yamashiro Kakoi, sixth son of Matsura Naotsura, who made his base in Kanzaki district.

During the Mongol invasions of the late thirteenth century Yamashiro Kizuna fought beside the Matsura head Sashi Fususa and was killed. After the Kamakura shogunate fell the family took the Northern Court side, and in 1359 Yamashiro Hiroshi fought under Shōni Yorihisa at the Battle of the Chikugo River.

They served the Shōni until that house was destroyed by the Ryūzōji clan with Ōuchi backing. Yamashiro Kiyoshi joined a failed attempt to restore the Shōni. When Toyotomi Hideyoshi conquered Kyushu, Yamashiro Sada had his family lands confirmed, and the house afterwards served the Nabeshima lords of the Saga domain.
zh:
山代氏是九州北部肥前国的武士家族，属于松浦党的一支。其始祖山代围是松浦直的第六子，以神埼郡为本据。

13世纪后期的元寇之乱中，山代阶随松浦党惣领佐志房出战，最终战死。镰仓幕府灭亡后，山代家归属北朝，1359年山代弘在少贰赖尚麾下参加了筑后川之战。

山代氏侍奉少贰氏，直到主家被受大内氏支持的龙造寺氏攻灭。山代清曾参与复兴少贰氏的计划，但未能成功。丰臣秀吉平定九州时，山代贞的本领获得安堵，此后山代氏转仕佐贺藩的锅岛氏。

en:
The Yamato is Japan's imperial house, said by tradition to descend from the sun goddess Amaterasu through the legendary first emperor Jimmu in 660 BC; its earliest broadly historical sovereigns date to the early 500s, around Emperor Keitai and Emperor Kinmei, who took the throne in 539. In the Heian period the emperors reigned under Fujiwara regents and then cloistered retired emperors, while power passed to the Taira, the Minamoto and the Kamakura Hojo regents.

In 1272 Emperor Go-Saga's alternating-succession plan split the family into the rival Daikakuji and Jimyoin lines. Go-Daigo of the Daikakuji overthrew Kamakura in 1333 and briefly ruled directly in the Kenmu Restoration, but Ashikaga Takauji seized Kyoto in 1336 and enthroned a Jimyoin claimant as the Northern Court, while Go-Daigo's Southern Court held out at Yoshino until it submitted in 1392; the present line descends from the Northern emperors.

In the Sengoku wars the court sank into poverty; after 1603 the Tokugawa held it ceremonially subject under the 1615 court laws, its role confined to ritual, genealogy and scholarship.
zh:
大和王朝即日本皇室，宫廷传统称其为天照大神后裔，始祖是传说中公元前660年即位的神武天皇；可考的最早君主在6世纪初，即继体天皇与539年即位的钦明天皇前后。平安时代，天皇先后受制于藤原氏的摄关政治与退位上皇的院政，实权转入平氏、源氏，继而落入镰仓北条执权之手。

1272年后嵯峨天皇的两统迭立方案使皇室分裂为大觉寺统与持明院统两个对立支系。大觉寺统的后醍醐天皇于1333年推翻镰仓幕府，推行建武新政、短暂亲政，但足利尊氏1336年攻陷京都，拥立持明院统的北朝天皇，后醍醐的南朝在吉野坚持到1392年归顺，后世皇室即出自北朝一脉。

战国战乱中朝廷穷困不堪，1603年德川氏开幕后，又依1615年的朝廷法度将皇室置于仪式性的从属地位，其职责限于礼仪、谱系与学问。

en:
The Yoshimi of Musashi were a Seiwa Genji house descended from Minamoto no Noriyori, younger brother of the first Kamakura shōgun Minamoto no Yoritomo. Noriyori held Yoshimi Manor, but was exiled to Izu on suspicion of treason. In the early thirteenth century Yoshimi Tameyori took Yoshimi as his family name and his descendants served the Kamakura shogunate as gokenin.

The senior line was extinguished when Yoshimi Yoshiyo's plot against the Hōjō regents was discovered and he was executed. A separate cadet house, the Iwami Yoshimi, built up power around Tsuwano; they fought for Emperor Go-Daigo in 1333 before joining the Ashikaga, and later passed under the Ōuchi and then the Mōri.

In the early seventeenth century the last head of the Iwami Yoshimi was executed by Mōri Terumoto on suspicion of treason, and the Yoshimi name was discontinued when the adopted heir reverted to the Mōri surname.
zh:
武藏吉见氏属清和源氏，始祖是镰仓幕府初代将军源赖朝的异母弟源范赖。范赖领有吉见庄，后来因涉嫌谋反被流放伊豆。13世纪初，吉见为赖以吉见为苗字，其后代作为御家人侍奉镰仓幕府。

吉见义世反对北条执权的密谋败露被处死，嫡流断绝。另有一支庶流石见吉见氏以津和野为中心扩张势力，1333年以后醍醐天皇一方起兵，后来转投足利氏，先后受大内氏和毛利氏节制。

17世纪初，石见吉见氏末代当主被毛利辉元以谋反嫌疑诛杀，继承家门的养子后来恢复毛利姓，吉见的苗字就此废止。

en:
The Yuasa were a great warrior clan of Kii Province, powerful from the late Heian age through the Nanboku-chō wars. They claimed Fujiwara descent, traditionally from Fujiwara no Hidesato, and held gokenin status under the Kamakura shogunate. The first to bear the place-name as a surname was Yuasa Muneshige, who in the Heiji Disturbance of 1160 aided Taira no Kiyomori returning from a pilgrimage to the Kumano shrines.

Muneshige built the Yuasa-tō, a loose confederation of kinsmen and in-law houses. His maternal grandson, the monk Myōe, founded Kōzan-ji with clan backing and revived the Kegon school.

In the Genkō War of 1331-1333 Yuasa Munefuji fought Kusunoki Masashige at Shimo-Akasaka Castle before submitting to him. During the Nanboku-chō conflict the Yuasa-tō split between the two courts and rapidly declined, the confederation breaking up in the late fourteenth century.
zh:
汤浅氏是纪伊国的大豪族，势力从平安末期一直延续到南北朝时代。其自称藤原氏，相传为藤原秀乡的后裔，镰仓时代拥有御家人身份。最早以汤浅为苗字的是汤浅宗重，1160年平治之乱时，他援助了从熊野三山参诣归来的平清盛。

宗重组建了由同族和姻族构成的松散武士团汤浅党。他的外孙、高僧明惠在一族资助下开创高山寺，中兴华严宗。

1331—1333年元弘之乱中，汤浅宗藤在下赤坂城之战与楠木正成交锋，后归降正成。南北朝时代，汤浅党内部在南朝与北朝之间分裂相争，迅速走向衰落，这个武士团联合在14世纪后期解体。

en:
The Yūki were a Shimōsa warrior house claiming Fujiwara no Hidesato's blood through the Oyama family. Their founder Oyama Tomomitsu, whom family legend calls an unacknowledged son of Minamoto no Yoritomo, joined Yoritomo's rising and was enfeoffed with Yūki district in Shimōsa.

In the Nanboku-chō wars the Shirakawa Yūki served the Southern Court, while the main line followed the Northern Court. Sheltering Ashikaga Mochiuji's orphans brought the shogunate's army down on them in the Yūki War of the 1440s; the house was briefly extinguished, then revived. Masatomo and his son Masakatsu built it into a Sengoku daimyō house, and Masakatsu issued the Yūki family code in 1556.

Lacking an heir, Harutomo adopted Tokugawa Ieyasu's son Hideyasu. After Sekigahara Hideyasu was moved to Echizen and took the Matsudaira name; the Shirakawa branch had already been destroyed by Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
zh:
结城氏是下总国的武家，自称经由小山氏传自藤原秀乡。始祖小山朝光跟随源赖朝举兵，受封下总国结城郡；家传称他是赖朝的落胤。

南北朝动乱时，白河结城氏效忠南朝，本家下总结城氏则追随北朝。由于收留足利持氏的遗孤，15世纪40年代幕府军发动结城合战，家族一度灭亡，之后再兴；政朝与其子政胜把家族建设成战国大名，政胜于1556年颁布《结城氏新法度》。

晴朝因无嗣而收德川家康之子秀康为养子。关原之战后秀康被转封越前并改姓松平；白河一支则早已被丰臣秀吉灭亡。

en:
The Zaccaria were a noble Genoese family whose fortune grew out of the eastward expansion of Genoa. After the Treaty of Nymphaeum in 1261 the Byzantine emperor Michael VIII Palaiologos granted them trading privileges, and from 1275 they held the port of Phocaea, whose alum mines gave them a near monopoly of the alum sold in Flanders; they also ruled the islands of Chios and Samos. Benedetto Zaccaria served as admiral of Genoa, France and Castile, and his grandson Martino married Jacqueline de la Roche, heiress of the dukes of Athens, in 1311, receiving the Moreot baronies of Veligosti and Damala as her dowry; the titular Latin emperor named him king and despot of Asia Minor, and he died at Smyrna in 1345.

Martino's son Centurione I became bailiff of the Principality of Achaea in 1364. His grandson Centurione II inherited the barony of Chalandritsa in 1401 and in 1404 bought from Ladislaus of Naples the title of Prince of Achaea, becoming the last Latin ruler of the Morea outside Byzantine suzerainty. On his death in 1432 his daughter Catherine married Thomas Palaiologos at Mystras in 1430, carrying the family claims into the Byzantine imperial house, while a son, John Asen, briefly revived the principality in 1453.
zh:
撒迦利亚家族是热那亚的贵族世家，随热那亚向东扩张而发迹。1261年《宁费昂条约》后，拜占庭皇帝米海尔八世·帕里奥洛格斯赐予他们通商特权；自1275年起家族领有福西亚港，当地的明矾矿使他们几乎垄断了销往佛兰德的明矾贸易，此外还统治着希俄斯岛和萨摩斯岛。贝内代托·撒迦利亚曾出任热那亚、法国和卡斯蒂利亚的海军统帅；其孙马蒂诺于1311年娶雅典公爵的女继承人雅克琳·德拉罗什为妻，以摩里亚的韦利戈斯蒂和达马拉两个男爵领作嫁妆，拉丁人的名誉皇帝还封他为小亚细亚国王与专制君主，他于1345年死于士麦那。

马蒂诺之子琴图廖内一世于1364年出任亚该亚侯国的摄政。其孙琴图廖内二世于1401年继承哈兰德里察男爵领，1404年又从那不勒斯国王拉迪斯劳手中购得亚该亚亲王头衔，成为摩里亚最后一个不受拜占庭宗主权约束的拉丁人统治者。他1432年去世；其女凯瑟琳已于1430年在米斯特拉斯嫁给托马斯·帕里奥洛格斯，把家族的继承权带入拜占庭皇室，其子约翰·阿森则在1453年短暂重建了亲王国。

en:
The Zakarids, known in Georgia as Mkhargrdzeli, meaning long-armed, were an Armenian noble dynasty that ruled northern Armenia from Ani under Georgian and later Mongol suzerainty. Possibly an offshoot of the Pahlavuni family, they rose as vassals of the Bagrationi: Sargis Zakarian was made governor of Ani in 1161.

His sons Zakare and Ivane became commanders of Queen Tamar, taking Dvin in 1193 and Ani around 1199, which Tamar granted them as a hereditary principality in 1201. They founded monasteries such as Harichavank and Akhtala.

When the Mongols stormed Ani in 1236 they confirmed the Zakarids in their lands as direct Ilkhanid vassals. The family held Ani until around 1360, when the Kara Koyunlu Turkomen seized the city and made it their own capital, ending Zakarid rule.
zh:
扎卡良王朝在格鲁吉亚语中的绰号是姆哈尔格尔泽利，意为“长臂”，是一个亚美尼亚贵族王朝，以阿尼为中心统治亚美尼亚北部，先后臣服格鲁吉亚和蒙古。该家族可能出自帕赫拉武尼家族，后来作为巴格拉季奥尼王朝的封臣崛起：萨尔吉斯·扎卡良于1161年被任命为阿尼总督。

他的儿子扎卡雷和伊万涅成为塔马尔女王麾下的将领，1193年攻取德温，约1199年拿下阿尼，塔马尔于1201年把阿尼作为世袭公国封给他们。他们还修建了哈里昌万克、阿赫塔拉等修道院。

1236年蒙古人攻陷阿尼后，确认扎卡良家族对领地的占有，使其成为伊儿汗国的直属藩臣。该家族保有阿尼直至约1360年，黑羊王朝的土库曼人夺取该城并定为自己的都城，扎卡良的统治就此终结。

en:
The Zayyanids, also called the Abd al-Wadids, were a Berber Zenata dynasty that ruled the Kingdom of Tlemcen in the central Maghreb from 1235 to 1557. As the Almohad Caliphate collapsed, Yaghmurasen Ibn Zyan made Tlemcen independent around 1236.

An eight-year Marinid siege of the city ended in 1307, and Zayyanid power reached a second peak in 1308–1337, until the Marinids occupied Tlemcen from 1337 to 1359. Restored under Abu Hammu II, the kingdom later weakened and passed repeatedly under the suzerainty of the Hafsids, the Marinids and Aragon.

In the early sixteenth century Spain and the Ottoman regency of Algiers fought over the city. The Ottomans took Tlemcen in 1551, and the last sultan Hasan al-Abdallah fled to Spanish Oran, where he died a few years later.
zh:
宰扬王朝又称阿卜杜勒·瓦迪德王朝，是柏柏尔人泽纳塔联盟的一支，1235—1557年统治中马格里布的特莱姆森王国。穆瓦希德哈里发国崩溃之际，亚格穆拉辛·伊本·齐扬约于1236年在特莱姆森独立。

马林人对特莱姆森长达八年的围攻于1307年结束；1308—1337年国力达到第二个高峰，直到1337—1359年特莱姆森被马林人占领。阿布·哈穆二世在位时王国一度复兴，但此后日渐衰弱，多次沦为哈夫斯、马林和阿拉贡的附庸。

16世纪上半叶，西班牙与奥斯曼的阿尔及尔摄政国争夺该城。1551年奥斯曼人占领特莱姆森，末代苏丹哈桑·阿卜杜拉逃到西班牙保护下的奥兰，数年后在那里去世。

en: The Zebari are a large Kurdish tribe of the Bahdinan region in northern Iraq, traditionally holding the lands along the Great Zab river around Akre, Duhok and Amadiya. They appear among the tribes that made up the Bahdinan Kurdish emirate, whose seventeenth-century sources list a Zibari district under its own chief.
zh: 泽巴里人是伊拉克北部巴赫迪南地区的一个库尔德大部落，传统上据有大扎卜河两岸、阿克拉、杜胡克和阿马迪耶一带的土地。在组成巴赫迪南库尔德酋长国的诸部落中便有他们，17世纪的史料还记载其辖区内设有由本族酋长管辖的“兹巴里”区。

en:
The Zeno, also spelled Zen, were one of the oldest patrician houses of Venice, recorded there since the tenth century and already numbering procurators of Saint Mark and sea generals before the closing of the Great Council in 1297; family tradition claimed descent from the Roman Gens Fannia. Reniero Zeno, who had commanded the Venetian fleet against Genoa, was elected doge and reigned from 1253 until his death in 1268. Pietro Zeno died in 1345 as bailo of Negroponte after fighting the Turks at Adramyttion and in the Smyrniote crusades, and a later Pietro ruled the island of Andros for the republic from about 1384 to 1497.

The most famous member was Carlo Zeno, born in 1333. Returning with eighteen galleys on 1 January 1380, he saved Venice at the Battle of Chioggia in June, which broke Genoese pressure on the Adriatic; as captain-general of the sea he won again at Modon in 1403 and overthrew the Carraresi of Padua in 1405, though the Council of Ten later stripped him of office over a treason charge. He died in 1418 and was given a public funeral. The merchants Nicolo and Antonio Zeno left a celebrated, much-disputed account of North Atlantic voyages, while Cardinal Giovanni Battista Zeno died in 1501 and the poet and librettist Apostolo Zeno in 1750.
zh:
泽诺家族（又拼作 Zen）是威尼斯最古老的贵族世家之一，10世纪已见记载，早在1297年大议会闭锁之前就出过圣马可行政长官和海军统帅；家族传说自称源出罗马的法尼娅氏族。雷涅罗·泽诺曾统率威尼斯舰队对热那亚作战，后当选总督，1253年至1268年去世前在任。彼得罗·泽诺曾任内格罗蓬特长官，在阿德拉米蒂翁抗击突厥人并参加士麦那十字军，1345年去世；后来的另一位彼得罗则于1384年至1497年间替共和国统治安德罗斯岛。

家族最著名的成员是生于1333年的卡洛·泽诺。1380年1月1日他率十八艘桨帆船赶回威尼斯，在6月的基奥贾战役中挽救了城邦，此战瓦解了热那亚对亚得里亚海的压制；1403年他以海军统帅身份在莫东再胜热那亚，1405年又推翻帕多瓦的卡拉雷西家族，但后来十人委员会以叛国指控免去了他的职务。他于1418年去世，威尼斯为他举行了公葬。商人尼科洛与安东尼奥·泽诺兄弟留下了著名且争议颇多的北大西洋航行记述，枢机主教乔瓦尼·巴蒂斯塔·泽诺于1501年去世，诗人、剧作家阿波斯托洛·泽诺则逝于1750年。

en:
The Zerzari, also called Zarzariyya, were a Kurdish tribe of the Middle Ages, probably an offshoot of the Hadhbani confederation and among the oldest Kurdish tribes named in Arabic historiography. One of their sons, al-Adil ibn al-Sallar, became vizier of Fatimid Egypt in 1148, and Zerzari cavalry served the Zengids and others before forming a noted unit in the Ayyubid army; tribal emirs fought under Saladin and at the siege of Acre.

Originally from the Erbil region, by the fourteenth century they held a mountain pocket between Rawanduz, the Qandil range and Lake Dukan, with strongholds at Rawanduz and Qala Diza. The geographer al-Umari, who died in 1349, described them as effectively independent of the Ilkhanids and surrounding powers.
zh:
泽尔扎里人又称扎尔扎里耶，是中世纪的库尔德部落，很可能是哈兹巴尼部落联盟的分支，也是阿拉伯史籍中最早被点名的库尔德部落之一。其族人阿迪勒·伊本·萨拉尔于1148年出任法蒂玛王朝埃及的维齐尔；泽尔扎里骑兵曾为赞吉王朝等效命，后来成为阿尤布军队中的知名部队，部落埃米尔曾在萨拉丁麾下和阿卡围城战中征战。

他们最初来自埃尔比勒地区，到14世纪时据有拉万杜兹、坎迪勒山脉与杜坎湖之间的山区，据点设在拉万杜兹和卡拉迪扎。卒于1349年的地理学家欧麦里记载，他们实际上独立于伊儿汗国和周边诸强之外。

en:
The counts of Ziegenhain were a noble dynasty of the Holy Roman Empire, descended from the ninth-century count Gozmar and the counts of Reichenbach. In the twelfth century they built a compact lordship in Lower Hesse from Fulda abbey advocacies, allodial lands and fiefs of Mainz, Fulda and Hersfeld, and from 1144 they took their name from the castle of Ziegenhain raised by Gottfried I, on the site of present-day Schwalmstadt. Count Ludwig I inherited the County of Nidda in 1205, and although the lands were split between two lines from 1258, Johann I reunited them in 1330 after marrying the Nidda heiress Lukardis. In 1331 he backed the townsfolk of Fulda against their abbot and later sold the remaining advocacy rights, keeping only the hereditary marshalship of Fulda.

The dynasty ended with Johann II, called the Strong, who had succeeded in 1401 and died childless on 14 February 1450. Landgrave Ludwig I of Hesse occupied the county as an escheated fief, while the Hohenlohe claimed it through marriage; although Emperor Frederick III enfeoffed the Hohenlohe in 1450, the inheritance dispute ended in 1495 with Hesse keeping Ziegenhain and Nidda after paying nine thousand gulden in compensation, and the title count of Ziegenhain passed into the style of the Hessian landgraves.
zh:
齐根海恩伯爵家族是神圣罗马帝国的贵族王朝，先祖可追溯到9世纪的戈茨马尔伯爵和赖兴巴赫伯爵支系。12世纪时，他们凭借富尔达修道院的摄政管辖权、自主地产以及美因茨、富尔达和赫斯费尔德的封地，在下黑森建起一块连成一体的领地；1144年起，家族以戈特弗里德一世所建的齐根海恩城堡（在今施瓦尔姆施塔特境内）为姓氏。1205年，路德维希一世伯爵继承了尼达伯爵国；1258年起领地在两支间分裂，约翰一世娶尼达女继承人卢卡迪斯后，于1330年重新统一两地。1331年他支持富尔达市民反抗修道院院长，后来卖掉剩余的摄政管辖权，只保留世袭的富尔达元帅一职。

王朝终结于绰号“强者”的约翰二世：他于1401年继位，1450年2月14日去世且无子嗣。黑森领地伯爵路德维希一世以封邑收归为由出兵占领伯爵国，霍恩洛厄家族则通过联姻提出继承要求；尽管皇帝腓特烈三世在1450年把封地授予霍恩洛厄，这场继承纠纷最终于1495年以黑森取胜告终——黑森支付九千古尔登补偿金后留下了齐根海恩与尼达，“齐根海恩伯爵”头衔也并入黑森领地伯爵的称号之中。

en:
The Zorzi, also called Giorgi, were a Venetian noble family whose fortunes were made in the Latin states of Greece. One of their number, Marino Zorzi, a former ambassador to Rome, was elected the fiftieth doge of Venice in August 1311 after the revolt of Bajamonte Tiepolo, but reigned only eleven months and died in July 1312 with a reputation for sanctity.

The family's Greek dominion was the Margraviate of Bodonitsa, a Frankish fief founded in 1204 to guard the pass of Thermopylae, which passed from the Pallavicini to the Cornaro and then, in 1335, to Nicholas I Zorzi. His successor Francis ruled it for nearly forty years. The Ottoman Turks conquered Bodonitsa in 1414 under Nicholas II, and though Nicholas III retained the margravial title, the lands were never recovered. He married his daughter Chiara to Nerio II, Duke of Athens, and she later governed the duchy as regent for her young son Francesco I, carrying Zorzi blood into the last court of Latin Athens.
zh:
佐尔齐家族（又称乔治家族）是威尼斯贵族世家，在希腊的拉丁人诸国中发迹。家族成员马里诺·佐尔齐曾任驻罗马使节，1311年8月巴亚蒙特·蒂耶波洛叛乱后当选威尼斯第五十任总督，但在任仅十一个月，1312年7月便去世，生前已有圣洁之名。

家族在希腊的领地是波多尼察藩侯国。这个法兰克人封邑建于1204年，职责是扼守温泉关，先归帕拉维奇尼家族，再转科尔纳罗家族，1335年落入尼古拉一世·佐尔齐手中；继任的弗朗切斯科统治了近四十年。1414年，奥斯曼突厥人在尼古拉二世在位时攻灭波多尼察，尼古拉三世虽继续使用藩侯头衔，领地却再未收复。他把女儿基娅拉嫁给雅典公爵内里二世，基娅拉后来代幼子弗朗切斯科一世摄政雅典公国，把佐尔齐家族的血脉带入了拉丁人雅典的末代宫廷。

en:
The la Zouches descend from Alan la Zouche, originally Alain de Porhoet, a Breton nobleman who settled in England under Henry II and married the heiress of Ashby in Leicestershire, which took the family's name as Ashby-de-la-Zouch. His grandson Alan was killed in a brawl with the Earl of Surrey's men in Westminster Hall.

A barony of la Zouche of Ashby was created in 1299, though it soon fell into abeyance. The Harringworth branch, barons from 1308, carried the name through the later Middle Ages; its seventh baron was attainted for supporting Richard III in 1485 and later restored.

William of the Leicestershire line became Lord Treasurer and Archbishop of York in 1342. As Warden of the Marches he led a division of the English army that defeated the Scots at Neville's Cross in 1346 and captured David II.
zh:
拉朱什家族的先祖阿兰·拉朱什原名阿兰·德·波尔霍埃特，是布列塔尼贵族，在亨利二世时代定居英格兰，娶了莱斯特郡阿什比的女继承人，该地后来随家族姓氏改称阿什比-德拉朱什。其孙阿兰在威斯敏斯特厅与萨里伯爵随从的斗殴中身亡。

1299年家族受封阿什比的拉朱什男爵，但该爵位不久即转入搁置状态。1308年起受封的哈灵沃思支系延续了家名，其第七代男爵因1485年支持理查三世被定罪，后又恢复爵位。

莱斯特支系的威廉升迁至财政大臣，又于1342年成为约克大主教。作为边境镇守长官，他在1346年的内维尔十字战役中指挥一支英军击败苏格兰人并俘获大卫二世。

en:
The Žovneški, or Lords of Sanneck, were a free noble family seated at Žovnek Castle in the March of Savinja in Lower Styria, first mentioned around 1130.

Ulrich of Sanneck fought beside King Rudolf I at the Battle on the Marchfeld in 1278, and in 1308 he surrendered his lands to the Habsburg dukes to receive them back as a fief, binding the Savinja valley to Styria. Ulrich's second marriage to Catherine of Heunburg enabled their son Frederick to claim the Heunburg inheritance, including Celje Castle, which entered the family's hands in 1333.

In 1341 Emperor Louis IV raised Frederick to imperial count, and the house took its name from Celje as the Counts of Cilli. They later became princes of the Holy Roman Empire until their extinction in 1456, when the Habsburgs inherited their domains.
zh:
若夫内什基家族又称桑内克领主，是以下施蒂里亚萨维尼亚边区的若夫内克城堡为中心的自由贵族，约1130年已有记载。

桑内克的乌尔里希1278年在马希费尔德战役中随国王鲁道夫一世作战，1308年又把领地献给哈布斯堡公爵再以封臣身份领回，使萨维尼亚河谷并入施蒂里亚。乌尔里希与霍伊恩堡的凯瑟琳再婚，他们的儿子腓特烈据此主张霍伊恩堡遗产，包括采列城堡，并于1333年取得。

1341年皇帝路易四世将腓特烈升为帝国伯爵，家族从此以采列为名，称采列伯爵，后来跻身神圣罗马帝国诸侯。1456年家族绝嗣，领地由哈布斯堡家族继承。

en:
The Zraqi were the ruling house of the Kurdish Principality of Zirqan, whose emirs claimed descent from the sheikh Hassan Zerraki. In 1335 his descendant Zeydo seized Boğat Castle near Silvan and founded the principality north of Mardin.

It reached its height under the Aq Qoyunlu, whose sultan Uzun Hasan married a Zirqan emir's daughter in 1483 and entrusted the family with Bitlis; the Safavids overran most of its lands in 1507.

After the battle of Chaldiran in 1514 the Zirqan emirs made their pact with Selim I and ruled as autonomous Ottoman vassals, leaving mosques and other buildings across their districts, including Gürdükan. Gürdükan passed to Bitlis in 1709, and when the dynasty rebelled in 1830 the Ottomans crushed it in 1835 and exiled its family to Edirne.
zh:
兹拉基家族是库尔德人的济尔坎酋长国的统治家族，历代埃米尔自称是谢赫·哈桑·泽拉基的后裔。1335年，其后人扎伊多夺取锡尔万附近的博阿特堡，在马尔丁以北建立酋长国。

酋长国在白羊王朝时期达到鼎盛：1483年白羊苏丹乌尊·哈桑迎娶一位济尔坎埃米尔之女，并把比特利斯交予该家族管辖；1507年萨法维波斯攻陷了它的大部分领土。

1514年恰尔德兰战役后，济尔坎埃米尔与塞利姆一世缔约，作为奥斯曼的自治附庸继续统治，在居尔迪坎等辖区留下了清真寺等建筑。1709年居尔迪坎落入比特利斯之手；1830年该家族起兵反抗，1835年被奥斯曼镇压，族人被流放至埃迪尔内。

en:
The Zrinski were a cadet branch of the Croatian Šubić tribe. In 1347 King Louis I of Hungary exchanged the family's Bribir estates for the castle of Zrin in Slavonia; George, grandson of Ban Paul I Šubić, moved there and became the first to style himself Zrinski, meaning of Zrin.

The house grew into the foremost noble family of Croatia during the Ottoman wars. In 1547 it moved its seat to Čakovec, and Nikola IV Zrinski, Ban of Croatia, died defending Szigetvár against Suleiman the Magnificent in 1566.

Nikola VII Zrinski won fame as a general and a Hungarian poet, while his brother Petar and Petar's wife Katarina led Croatian resistance to Habsburg centralism. Petar Zrinski and Fran Krsto Frankopan were executed for the Zrinski-Frankopan Plot in 1671, and the male line died out before the end of the century.
zh:
兹林斯基家族是克罗地亚舒比奇家族的一个支系。1347年，匈牙利国王拉约什一世用斯拉沃尼亚境内的兹林城堡交换其布里比尔领地；克罗地亚班保罗一世·舒比奇的孙子尤拉伊迁居于此，成为第一个以“兹林的”为号、即兹林斯基的人。

奥斯曼战争时期，这个家族成长为克罗地亚首屈一指的显贵。1547年家族把府邸迁至查科韦茨；克罗地亚班尼古拉四世·兹林斯基于1566年抵御苏莱曼大帝、保卫锡盖特堡时战死。

尼古拉七世以将领和匈牙利语诗人闻名，其弟佩塔尔与佩塔尔的妻子卡塔琳娜领导克罗地亚人反抗哈布斯堡的集权。1671年，佩塔尔·兹林斯基与弗兰·克尔斯托·弗兰科潘因“兹林斯基—弗兰科潘阴谋”被处死，家族男系也在该世纪结束前断绝。

en:
The counts of Zweibrücken were a branch of the House of Saarbrücken, whose water castle at a crossing of the Schwarzbach had been built around 1150. When the Saarbrücken lands were divided between 1182 and 1190, the younger son Henry I received the Zweibrücken estate and founded the comital line.

In 1286 the brothers Eberhard I and Walram I split the county: Eberhard took Lemberg and founded the Zweibrücken-Bitsch line, while Walram kept Zweibrücken and began the Walramide branch. Walram I was followed by Simon and then by Walram II, who reigned until 1366.

The last Walramide count, Eberhard II, being childless, pledged the county to the Wittelsbach counts palatine in 1385; they inherited it on his death in 1394. Joined with the County of Veldenz in 1444, the lands became the nucleus of the Principality of Palatinate Zweibrücken.
zh:
茨魏布吕肯伯爵出自萨尔布吕肯家族，其在施瓦茨巴赫渡口旁的水堡约建于1150年。1182至1190年间萨尔布吕肯领地分割时，幼子亨利一世分得茨魏布吕肯地产，开创了伯爵世系。

1286年，埃伯哈德一世与瓦勒拉姆一世兄弟瓜分伯国：埃伯哈德取得伦贝格领地，开创茨魏布吕肯-比奇支系；瓦勒拉姆保留茨魏布吕肯，建立瓦勒拉姆支系。瓦勒拉姆一世之后是西蒙，接着瓦勒拉姆二世一直统治到1366年。

末代瓦勒拉姆伯爵埃伯哈德二世没有子嗣，遂于1385年把伯国抵押给维特尔斯巴赫家族的行宫伯爵，后者在他1394年死后继承。1444年这片领地与费尔登茨伯国合并，成为普法尔茨-茨魏布吕肯公国的核心。

en: Agwu Nsi is worshipped by the Igbo, whose deities are called arusi. Where Igbo religion was carried to the Americas, he is known as Agwo Nsi.
zh: 阿格乌受伊博人供奉，伊博人称神灵为阿鲁西。伊博宗教传到美洲之后，他又被称为阿格沃·恩西。

official_raw.en: $agwu_nsi_god$ is the god of divination and healing.

en:
Ak Ana, ‘the Holy Mother’, was the primordial creator goddess of the Turkic peoples, known also to the Khanty and Mansi of Siberia. She was the daughter and consort of Kayra. Water was held to have been made before the earth, so she was the earth’s elder sister.

In one creation myth, Kayra flew as a white goose over the endless waters until Ak Ana urged him to create. A sacred duck then brought up silt from the bottom, from which the earth was made.
zh:
白母意为“神圣的母亲”，是突厥人的原初创世女神，西伯利亚的汉特人和曼西人也知道她。她是凯尔拉的女儿和配偶。水被认为早于大地而生，所以她是大地的姐姐。

在一则创世神话里，凯尔拉化作白鹅，飞越无边的水面，白母催促他去创造。神鸭随后从水底衔来淤泥，大地就由此造成。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('ak_ana_god')] is the goddess of water of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

en: Aki Pen is worshipped by the Gonds together with the village mother goddess before any festival begins. Among the Gonds, devotion goes above all to such village and clan deities rather than to the high god Baradeo.
zh: 贡德人在任何节庆开始之前，都要把阿吉宾与村母神一同祭拜。贡德人真正热烈供奉的，主要是这类村神和氏族神，而不是至高神婆罗提乌。

official_raw.en: $aki_pen_god$ is the village guardian of the [ShowReligionAdjective('koyapunem_religion')] pantheon.

en: Akuj is also the supreme being of the Turkana, the semi-nomadic herders of the Lake Turkana region, who hold that he created the world and governs their water, food, livestock and offspring. Diviners called ngimurok relay his wishes and name the animals to be sacrificed.
zh: 阿库吉同样是图尔卡纳湖一带半游牧的图尔卡纳人的至高存在，他们认为他创造了世界，掌管水、食物、牲畜和子嗣。名叫恩吉穆罗克的占卜师传达他的意愿，并指明该献祭哪些牲畜。

official_raw.en: $akuj_god$ is the supreme being of the [ShowLanguageName('lotuko_language')] speaking people.

en: Alwet is counted among the offspring of Nhialic, the Dinka sky god. Nhialic also governs the rains.
zh: 阿尔韦特被算作丁卡人天神尼雅力克的后代。尼雅力克本人也掌管降雨。

official_raw.en: $alwet_god$ is the goddess of the rain of the [ShowReligionAdjective('muonyjang_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Amadioha, whose name means man of the people, is also the Igbo god of justice, among the most popular of Igbo deities. He speaks through thunder and strikes with lightning, made by hurling thunderstones to earth, and avenges the oppressed by striking down their oppressors. His symbol is a white ram, and his main shrine is at Ozuzu.

Those he judges guilty are killed by lightning or by a swarm of bees and left unburied. Oaths are sworn to him.
zh:
阿马迪奥哈的名字意为“人民之人”，也是伊博人的正义之神，是伊博诸神中最受欢迎的之一。他借雷声说话，用闪电打击；闪电由他向大地投下的雷石造成，他击杀压迫者，为受压迫者复仇。他的象征是白公羊，主神龛在奥祖祖。

被他判为有罪的人会被雷劈死，或被蜂群蜇死，尸体不得埋葬。人们向他起誓。

official_raw.en: $amadioha_god$ is the god of thunder and lightning of the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Anansi, or Ananse, takes the form of a spider, which is what his name means, and stands for stories, wisdom and cunning. In tales from southern Ghana he outwits stronger opponents.

In one tale he flew in a cloak of bird feathers to learn the name of a yam for the sky god Nyame, and became Nyame's messenger. The tales crossed to the Americas with the Atlantic slave trade.
zh:
阿南西又作阿南塞，形象是一只蜘蛛，名字就是“蜘蛛”的意思，象征故事、智慧和狡黠。在加纳南部的故事里，他靠机智胜过比他强大的对手。

在一则故事里，他披上鸟的羽毛飞去，为天神尼亚梅探出一个山药的名字，由此成了尼亚梅的信使。这些故事随大西洋奴隶贸易传到美洲。

official_raw.en: $anansi_god$ is a trickster god and folk hero of the [ShowReligionAdjective('akan_religion')] pantheon.
official_raw.zh: $anansi_god$是[ShowReligionAdjective('akan_religion')]中的诡计之神和民间英雄。

en: Andriamahilala and her husband Andriambahomanana had many children and grandchildren. Then the creator Zanahary decided that death was needed and asked what kind of death they wanted; her husband chose to die like the banana plant, which puts forth new shoots as it dies.
zh: 安德里亚玛希拉拉和丈夫安德里亚姆巴霍马纳纳子孙众多。之后创世神扎纳哈里认为需要有死亡，便问他们想要怎样的死法；她的丈夫选择像香蕉树那样死去，香蕉树枯死时会长出新芽。

official_raw.en: $andriamahilala_god$ is the first woman in the [ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')] pantheon, who choose to die and be reborn each month and became linked to the moon.
official_raw.zh: $andriamahilala_god$是[ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')]中的第一个女人，每月都会死亡并重生，因此被与月亮联系在一起。

en: Andriambahomanana and his wife Andriamahilala had many children, and their children had children of their own. Zanahary saw that death was needed and asked what kind of death they wanted. Andriambahomanana chose to die like the banana plant, which puts forth new shoots when it dies; Andriamahilala chose to die like the moon, dying and being reborn every month.
zh: 安德里亚姆巴霍马纳纳和妻子安德里亚玛希拉拉生了许多孩子，孩子们又有了自己的孩子。扎纳哈里见到死亡不可或缺，便问他们想要怎样的死法。安德里亚姆巴霍马纳纳选择像香蕉树那样死去，枯死时会长出新芽；安德里亚玛希拉拉则选择像月亮那样，每个月死去又重生。

official_raw.en: $andriambahomanana_god$ is the first man in the [ShowReligionAdjective('fomba_gasy_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Andrianerinerina figures in one of several competing origin myths of the Merina of Imerina. He came down to Anerinerina, north of Angavokely, to play with the Vazimba, the island's first inhabitants.

They cooked one of his sheep despite a warning, and having eaten the forbidden meat he could not go home. Zanahary let the Vazimba choose between destruction and serving him; they chose to serve, and he sent his daughter Andriamanitra to be the wife of Andrianerinerina.
zh:
安德里亚内里内里纳出现在梅里纳人几种相互竞争的起源神话之一中。他降到安加沃凯利北面的阿内里内里纳，同岛上最早的居民瓦济姆巴人玩耍。

瓦济姆巴人不顾警告，煮了他的一只羊，他吃下禁忌的羊肉后便无法回家。扎纳哈里让瓦济姆巴人在被毁灭和臣服于他之间选择，他们选择臣服，于是扎纳哈里派女儿安德里亚马尼特拉给他做妻子。

official_raw.en: $andrianerinerina_god$ is the son of [ShowGodName('zanahary_god')] and founder of the royal line.

en:
Nyame, also called Onyame or Nyankopon, is worshipped by the Akan of Ghana, and his name is taken to mean the one who knows and sees everything. In some Akan accounts his wife is the earth goddess Asase Ya.

As the creator Odomankoma he made the universe, life and death. Death, personified as Owuo, then killed him, and his spirit passed into Nyankopon. In tales his messenger is the spider Anansi.
zh:
尼亚梅又称奥尼亚梅或尼扬科蓬，受加纳阿肯人崇拜，他的名字被解释为无所不知、无所不见者。在一些阿肯叙述里，他的妻子是大地女神阿萨塞亚。

作为创造者奥多芒科马，他创造了宇宙、生命和死亡。拟人化为奥乌奥的死亡后来杀死了他，他的灵魂随即归入尼扬科蓬。故事里他的信使是蜘蛛阿南西。

official_raw.en: $anyame_god$ is the supreme god and sky father of the [ShowCultureName('akan')] people.

en:
Aphrodite's main Greek cult centres were Cythera, Cyprus, Corinth and Athens, where the Aphrodisia festival was held each year. The Iliad makes her the daughter of Zeus and Dione, while Hesiod has her born from sea foam.

She was married to the smith-god Hephaestus but took Ares as a lover, and was one of the three goddesses whose rivalry led to the Trojan War. The Romans knew her as Venus.
zh:
阿佛洛狄忒在希腊的主要崇拜中心是基西拉、塞浦路斯、科林斯和雅典，雅典每年举行阿佛洛狄忒节。《伊利亚特》说她是宙斯与狄俄涅之女，赫西俄德则说她由海中泡沫而生。

她嫁给了锻造之神赫淮斯托斯，却以阿瑞斯为情人，还是引发特洛伊战争的三位争执女神之一。罗马人称她为维纳斯。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('aphrodite_god')] is the goddess of love, desire, beauty, and social harmony.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('aphrodite_god')]是爱、欲望、美与社会和谐之神。

en:
Ares, son of Zeus and Hera, was one of the twelve Olympians. He stood for the physical valour and courage needed in war, and many Greeks felt ambivalent towards him. His sister Athena governed strategy.

He may have originated in Thrace. In myth he is often humiliated: Hephaestus trapped him in a net with Aphrodite, and in the Trojan War he took the Trojan side and lost. The Romans set Mars, a more dignified figure, beside him.
zh:
阿瑞斯是宙斯与赫拉之子，奥林匹斯十二主神之一。他代表战争所需的血气之勇，许多希腊人对他心情复杂。他的姐姐雅典娜则掌管谋略。

他可能起源于色雷斯。神话里他常被羞辱：赫淮斯托斯用网把他和阿佛洛狄忒困在一起，特洛伊战争中他站在特洛伊一边，结果战败。罗马人把地位更尊崇的马尔斯与他相对应。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('ares_god')] is the god of war in its violent and destructive form.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('ares_god')]司掌战争中暴力和破坏性的一面。

en:
Asase Ya is also a goddess of peace and truth. Her name means Earth born on Thursday; the Fante call her Asase Afua, born on Friday. She is the wife of the sky god Nyankopon and the mother of Bea and Tano.

No temples are dedicated to her. She is worshipped in the fields of the Asante and other Akan with sacrifices, and the Bono are said to be her favoured people. As old Mother Earth she also receives the dead.
zh:
阿萨塞亚还司掌和平与真理。她的名字意为“星期四出生的大地”；芳蒂人称她为阿萨塞阿芙娃，即星期五出生的。她是天神尼扬科蓬的妻子，生下了贝亚和塔诺。

没有神庙专门供奉她。阿散蒂人和其他阿肯人在田间向她献祭，据说博诺人是她最眷顾的人。作为年迈的大地母亲，她还接纳死者。

official_raw.en: $asase_ya_god$ is the goddess of love, fertility and the earth of the [ShowCultureName('akan')] people.
official_raw.zh: $asase_ya_god$是[ShowCultureName('akan')]人的爱情、生育和大地女神。

en:
Asis is the sun god and supreme god of the Kalenjin of Kenya. He lives in the sky, is all-powerful and is held to guarantee what is right.

In the older Kalenjin belief he was only the younger brother of the sky god Tororut and was thought to be angry in the dry season. His worship later superseded it, apparently after contact with Southern Cushitic peoples. In the Nandi creation story, the Sun, married to the moon, went down to earth to prepare the order of the world.
zh:
阿西斯是肯尼亚卡伦津人的太阳神和至高神，居于天上，全能，也是正义的保证者。

在更早的卡伦津信仰里，阿西斯只是天神托罗鲁特的弟弟，被认为在旱季发怒。后来对阿西斯的崇拜取代了旧信仰，似乎是在接触南部库希特人之后。南迪人的创世故事说，太阳与月亮结为夫妻，下到地上安排世间的秩序。

official_raw.en: $asis_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowLanguageName('kalenjin_language')] speaking people.

en:
Athena was the patron goddess of Athens, whose Parthenon on the Acropolis was dedicated to her, and of handicraft. In myth she was born from the forehead of Zeus. She won the city from Poseidon by creating the first olive tree, and her chief festival was the Panathenaia.

She led soldiers into battle as Athena Promachos and helped heroes such as Perseus, Heracles and Odysseus. Since the Renaissance Western artists have made her a symbol of wisdom, learning and freedom.
zh:
雅典娜是雅典的守护神，也是手工艺女神，卫城上的帕特农神庙就是献给她的。神话中她从宙斯的前额诞生。她创造了第一棵橄榄树，从波塞冬手中赢得了这座城市，主要节日是泛雅典娜节。

她作为“冲锋的雅典娜”引领士兵上阵，也帮助过珀尔修斯、赫拉克勒斯和奥德修斯等英雄。文艺复兴以来，西方艺术家把她塑造成智慧、学问和自由的象征。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('athena_god')] is the goddess of wisdom, strategy, and disciplined warfare.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('athena_god')]是智慧、战略和有序作战之神。

en: Ayum is counted among the offspring of Nhialic, the Dinka sky god. She is often described as a force that keeps rain from falling.
zh: 阿尤姆被算作丁卡人天神尼雅力克的后代，常被说成阻止降雨的力量。

official_raw.en: $ayum_god$ is the winds goddess of the [ShowLanguageName('dinka_language')] speaking people.
official_raw.zh: $ayum_god$是丁卡族群信奉的风之女神。

en:
Bai Baianai was also a goddess of hunting, wealth and fertility, worshipped in the Altai and among the Sakha, or Yakut. Her name means ‘rich’ or ‘fertile’, and she was the daughter of Kayra.

Hunters lit fires and prayed to her that their work might pass fruitfully and without accident. Three Baianais are named: Bai Baianai of hunting, Tagh Baianai of forests and Ughu Baianai of fishing. In some places she also protected children and was regarded as a guardian of the lineage.
zh:
白白阿奶还司掌狩猎、财富与丰饶，在阿尔泰和萨哈（雅库特）人中受到崇拜。她的名字意为“富有”或“丰饶”，是凯尔拉的女儿。

猎人点起篝火向她祈祷，希望捕猎顺利、平安无事。传说中有三位白白阿奶：司狩猎的白白阿奶、司森林的塔格·白白阿奶和司捕鱼的乌古·白白阿奶。在一些地方她也保护孩子，被视为血脉的守护者。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('bai_baianai_god')] is the goddess of forests and wildlife of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodName('bai_baianai_god')]是[ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')]人的森林与野生动物女神。

en:
Baradeo, also called Bhagavan, Badadeo or Persa Pen, is worshipped by the Gonds of central India. He oversees the lesser gods, the clan and village deities and the ancestors, but is respected rather than fervently worshipped. Gond tradition identifies him with the ancestor-hero Kupar Lingo, shown as a clean-shaven young prince in a trident-shaped crown, the munshul.

Some Gonds of Seoni hold that Baradeo lives in a saja tree, and shrines to Kupar Lingo stand across Gondwana.
zh:
婆罗提乌受印度中部的贡德人崇拜，又称巴格万、巴达德奥或佩尔萨·彭。他统管众小神，即氏族神、村神和祖先，人们对他是敬重，而不是热烈供奉。贡德传统把他与祖先英雄库帕尔·林戈等同，形象是一位头戴三叉冠“蒙苏尔”、面容光洁的年轻王子。

塞奥尼一带的一些贡德人认为婆罗提乌住在萨贾树里，贡德瓦纳各地还有许多供奉库帕尔·林戈的神龛。

official_raw.en: $baradeo_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowCultureName('gond')] people.

en:
Bathoubwrai, ‘Bathou the Elder’, is unseen, all-knowing and all-powerful, and is worshipped by the Boro of Assam. He is said to have created the five principles of air, fire, earth, water and ether on which the faith is built.

The sijou shrub, a kind of spurge, is his living embodiment. Boro families plant it at the northeast corner of the courtyard, and communities fence it with eighteen pairs of bamboo strips, each pair a pair of minor gods. Offerings are animals, fowls and rice beer.
zh:
巴图布赖意为“长者巴图”，无形可见，无所不知，无所不能，受阿萨姆博罗人崇拜。据说他创造了空气、火、土、水和以太五大元素，这套元素是整个信仰的根基。

西久树是一种大戟属灌木，被视为他的活身。博罗人家把它种在庭院东北角，村社则用十八对竹片把它围起，每一对代表一对小神。供品是牲畜、禽类和米酒。

official_raw.en: $bathoubwrai_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('bathou_religion')] pantheon.

en: Bura Bagh Raja is worshipped by the Boro of Assam. The ethnographer Sidney Endle named him among the prominent household deities, with Bathoubwrai, Mainao and Song Bwrai.
zh: 布拉巴格王受阿萨姆博罗人供奉。民族志学者悉尼·恩德尔把他与巴图布赖、买瑙和宋布赖并列为主要的家宅神。

official_raw.en: $bura_bagh_raja_god$ is a household god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('bathou_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Chinchaycamac was worshipped by the Chincha, a seafaring and trading people of the coastal valley of Chincha in Peru. The Chincha kept a rich and prominent oracle of this name, probably near their capital at La Centinela, where great adobe pyramids stand.

The Chincha believed themselves descended from jaguars and ocelots, and worshipped a feline god. Their kingdom, flourishing from the eleventh century, was absorbed into the Inca empire around 1480.
zh:
钦查卡马克受钦查人崇拜，钦查人是秘鲁海岸钦查河谷的航海和贸易民族。钦查人设有一处同名的神谕所，十分富有，声名卓著，可能就在他们的都城拉森蒂内拉附近，那里有大型的土坯金字塔。

钦查人相信自己是美洲豹和虎猫的后裔，崇拜猫科动物神。他们的王国自11世纪起兴盛，约1480年并入印加帝国。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('chinchaycamac_god')] is the main god of the [ShowCultureName('chincha_culture')] people.

en:
Coatlicue, ‘Skirt of Snakes’, also called Teteoh Innan, ‘Mother of the Gods’, was the Aztec mother goddess and wife of Mixcoatl. Toci, ‘Our Grandmother’, and Cihuacoatl, patron of women who died in childbirth, were seen as aspects of her.

In the myth of Coatepec, near Tula, she became pregnant when a ball of feathers touched her as she swept. Her daughter Coyolxauhqui and four hundred sons plotted to kill her, but Huitzilopochtli leapt from her womb in full armour and routed them.
zh:
科瓦特利奎意为“蛇裙”，又称“诸神之母”特特奥·因南，是阿兹特克的母神，米斯科亚特尔的妻子。托茜（“我们的祖母”）和守护死于产褥的妇女的西瓦科亚特尔，都被视为她的化身。

在图拉附近科阿特佩克的神话里，她扫地时被一团羽毛碰到而怀孕。她的女儿科约尔绍基和四百个儿子密谋杀她，维齐洛波奇特利却全副武装地从她腹中跃出，击溃了他们。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('coatlicue_god')] is the goddess of fertility in the Mesoamerican pantheon.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodName('coatlicue_god')]是美索美洲众神中的丰饶女神。

en: Creation myths tell of many ways in which humanity, the earth or the universe came to be: a world sprouting from a primal seed, a monster slain, or a divine craftsman at work. In Genesis, Elohim makes heaven and earth, the animals and mankind in six days.
zh: 创世神话讲述了人类、大地或宇宙诞生的许多方式：世界从原初的种子里萌发，由杀死太古怪物而成，或出自神圣工匠之手。在《创世记》中，伊洛欣用六天造出天地、动物和人类。

official_raw.en: The $creator_god$ represents the original creation spark that created humanity.
official_raw.zh: $creator_god$代表创世之初点亮人类文明的神圣火花。

en: Death deities, gods or divine beings tied to the afterlife or the underworld, appear in some form in most cultures. In religions centred on a single god, death is usually that god's antagonist; in monotheistic faiths it is often personified by an angel or demon.
zh: 死神是与来世或冥界相联的神或神性存在，大多数文化里都有某种形式的死神。在以单一神为中心的宗教里，死亡通常是那位神的对手；在一神教中，它常被拟人化为天使或魔鬼。

official_raw.en: The $death_god$ represents the invitable equalizer that patiently waits for all.
official_raw.zh: $death_god$象征不可抗拒的终极平等，静候众生。

en: Dharti ayo, also called Chalapachho Devi, is worshipped by the tribal peoples of the Chota Nagpur Plateau as a mother goddess identified with nature. People honour her together with Marang Buru and the village deity.
zh: 陀利底阿瑜又称恰拉帕丘女神，乔塔那格浦尔高原的部族民族把她当作与自然相连的母神来敬拜。人们把她与摩烂迦补卢和村神一同供奉。

official_raw.en: $dharti_ayo_god$ is the goddess of earth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('sarna_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Donyi is a goddess of the Tani peoples of Arunachal, among them the Adi, Galo and Nyishi. Traditionally she was addressed as Mother, paired with the Moon, Polo, as Father.

The two were called on to witness the truth and to punish liars. The Minyong and Padam Adi tell of a creator, Sedi, whose eyes became the Sun and Moon.
zh:
冬尼是阿鲁纳恰尔阿迪人、加洛人、尼西人等塔尼诸族的女神。传统上人们称她为母亲，与月亮波罗，即父亲，相配。

人们请这两位神为真话作证，惩罚说谎的人。敏荣和帕达姆两支阿迪人说，创造者是塞迪，他的双眼变成了日月。

official_raw.en: $donyi_god$ is the goddess of the Sun of the [ShowReligionAdjective('donyi_polo_religion')] pantheon.

en: Doying Bote is named among the gods of the Tani peoples of Arunachal, whose oral faith, later called Donyi-Polo, had no scripture or fixed shrines.
zh: 多英波特是阿鲁纳恰尔塔尼诸族所奉的神灵之一；他们口传的信仰后来被称为冬尼波罗，没有经典，也没有固定的神庙。

en: Some accounts make Du Chie a precursor of Nhialic, others a co-creator alongside him.
zh: 有的说法把杜奇耶当作尼雅力克之前的神，有的说法则认为他与尼雅力克共同创世。

official_raw.en: $du_chie_god$ is a creator god for the [ShowLanguageName('dinka_language')] speaking people.

en: Earth deities are most often goddesses. In Greek myth she is Gaia, matched by Terra in Rome and Prithvi in India, and traced back to an Earth Mother who complemented the Sky Father of Proto-Indo-European religion.
zh: 地神多为女神。希腊神话中是盖亚，对应罗马的特拉和印度的普利提维，可追溯到原始印欧宗教中与天父相配的地母。

official_raw.en: The $earth_god$ represents the fruits of the soil that allow the growth of our people.
official_raw.zh: $earth_god$象征土地的丰饶，滋养万物生生不息。

en:
Among the Ijaw of the Niger Delta, Egbesu is also a spiritual force for combating evil. Its symbols are the leopard, the panther and the lion.

Traditionally the Egbesu force could be used only in defence or to correct an injustice, and only by those in harmony with the universe. Under an Egbesu king, the chief priest who alone could declare war, came high priests called Okparans and foot soldiers called Kulikuliwei. The force was believed to protect fighters from enemy bullets.
zh:
在尼日尔河三角洲的伊乔人中，埃格贝苏也是对抗邪恶的精神力量。它的象征是豹、黑豹和狮子。

按照传统，埃格贝苏的力量只能用于防卫或纠正不义，也只有与宇宙和谐的人才能使用。埃格贝苏王是唯一能宣战的大祭司，其下是称为奥克帕兰的高级祭司和称为库利库利韦的步卒。人们相信这种力量能保护战士不中敌人的子弹。

official_raw.en: $egbesu_god$ is the god of justice of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ijaw_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Erlik, also called Erlik Khan, was ruler of the lower world and judge of the dead, sometimes shown as a bear. He is named in the Orkhon inscriptions. From below he sends death, plague and evil spirits to take human souls.

Altai legends say Erlik and his spirits were cast out of heaven when he claimed divinity. In another tale, recorded by Radlov, he was the first human, who tried to hide soil from the primordial water and was cast out by Kayra.
zh:
尔力克，又称尔力克汗，是下界的主宰和亡者的审判者，有时以熊的形象出现。鄂尔浑碑铭里已经提到他。他从地下送出死亡、瘟疫和恶灵，来夺取人的灵魂。

阿尔泰人的传说说，尔力克自称神明，与他的灵一起被逐出天界。拉德洛夫记录的另一则传说里，他是第一个人类，想从原初之水里藏起泥土，被凯尔拉逐出。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('erlik_god')] is the god of death and the underworld of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

en: Fertility deities may be gods or goddesses tied to sex, pregnancy, childbirth and crops, sometimes directly and sometimes as an abstract symbol. Fertility rites may accompany the worship. In Vietnamese belief twelve goddesses, the Ba Mu, are each responsible for making one part of a child.
zh: 生育神可以是男神或女神，与性、怀孕、分娩和作物相联，有时直接掌管这些事，有时只是抽象的象征，崇拜时可能伴有求子的仪式。越南信仰里的十二位婆姆各自负责塑造孩子的一部分。

official_raw.en: The $fertility_god$ represents the caring and nurturing power of a mother.
official_raw.zh: $fertility_god$象征母性的滋养与生命的绵延。

en: Fire deities are known to many peoples. In Vietnamese tradition Ong Tao is the god of the stove and fire, and a goddess named Ba Hoa is also counted among the fire spirits.
zh: 火神许多民族都有。越南传统中有灶君，即炉灶与火之神，另有名为婆火的女神也被算作火神。

official_raw.en: The $fire_god$ represents the passion of a warm hearth together with the fury of a raging inferno.
official_raw.zh: $fire_god$既象征温暖炉火的庇护，也代表狂暴烈火的毁灭。

en:
Freyja, ‘Lady’, also presided over war and gold. Her seiðr was a magic for seeing and shaping the future. Daughter of Njörðr and twin sister of Freyr, she owned the necklace Brísingamen and drove a chariot drawn by two cats.

She ruled the field Fólkvangr, where she received half of those who died in battle, the other half going to Odin. In Þrymskviða she refused to be given to a giant as a bride, so Thor went in her place.
zh:
弗蕾亚意为“夫人”，也掌管战争和黄金。她的赛兹是一种观察和左右未来的魔法。她是尼奥尔德的女儿，弗雷的孪生姐妹，拥有项链布里辛加曼，乘坐两只猫拉的战车。

她统治福尔克范格，接收一半战死者，另一半归奥丁。在《索列姆之歌》里，她不肯被许给巨人为妻，于是托尔扮作新娘，代她前往。

official_raw.en: $freya_god$ is a member of the Vanir, and worshipped as the Goddess of love, beauty, fertility and seidr.
official_raw.zh: $freya_god$是华纳神族的重要神祇，被尊奉为爱情、美丽、丰饶与魔法之神。

en:
Freyr, ‘Lord’, was also a god of kingship and fair weather, son of Njörðr and twin brother of Freyja. He rode the golden boar Gullinbursti and owned the ship Skíðblaðnir, which always had a fair wind and folded into a pouch.

In his best-known myth he fell in love with the giantess Gerðr and gave away his self-fighting sword to win her; lacking it, he is fated to die to Surtr at Ragnarök. Sweden’s kings were held to descend from him.
zh:
弗雷意为“主人”，也掌管王权和好天气，是尼奥尔德之子，弗蕾亚的孪生兄弟。他骑着金鬃野猪古林布尔斯蒂，拥有总是顺风、又能折叠装进小袋的船斯基德布拉德尼尔。

最有名的神话讲他爱上女巨人格尔德，为了娶她，把能自己作战的剑送了人；没有这把剑，他注定在诸神黄昏时死于苏尔特之手。瑞典诸王被认为是他的后裔。

official_raw.en: $freyr_god$ is a member of the Vanir, and worshipped for good harvest, pleasure and peace.
official_raw.zh: $freyr_god$是华纳神族的重要神祇，因其执掌丰收、欢愉与和平而备受尊崇。

en:
Gaṇeśa is the elephant-headed son of Shiva and Parvati, honoured by every Hindu denomination. Usually shown with four arms and a broken tusk, he is the Lord of Obstacles and the patron of learning and letters. He is invoked first at the start of any rite.

Texts mention him from the first centuries, and the Ganesha Purana and Mudgala Purana, probably composed between 1100 and 1400, make him the supreme being of the Ganapatya tradition.
zh:
犍尼萨是湿婆与帕尔瓦蒂的象头之子，印度教各个教派都敬奉他。他通常有四臂和一枚断牙，是“障碍之主”，也是学问与文字的守护者。任何仪式开始时，都要先向他祈祷。

从公元最初几个世纪起，文献中就已提到他；很可能成书于1100至1400年间的《犍尼萨往世书》和《穆德伽拉往世书》，则把他奉为犍尼萨派的至高存在。

official_raw.en: $ganesha_god$ is a major [god|e] in [ShowReligionName('hindu')], usually represented with an elephant head and revered as a bringer of luck and wisdom.
official_raw.zh: $ganesha_god$是[ShowReligionName('hindu')]中的重要[god|e]，通常以象头形象出现，被视为幸运与智慧的象征。

en:
In Christianity, Judaism and Islam, God is the single, eternal creator of the universe, all-powerful and attentive to individual prayer. All three trace themselves to Abraham and the God of Israel of the Hebrew Bible.

Jews know him by the four-letter name YHWH, which observant Jews do not pronounce, saying Adonai instead. Christians pronounce the name freely as Yahweh or Jehovah. Muslims call him Allah and hold his absolute oneness, tawhid, to be the heart of their faith.
zh:
在基督教、犹太教和伊斯兰教中，神是宇宙唯一永恒的创造者，全能，并垂听个人的祈祷。三教都追溯到亚伯拉罕，以及《希伯来圣经》所描述的以色列之神。

犹太教徒用四个字母的圣名雅威（YHWH）称呼他，虔诚的犹太教徒不念出这个名字，而以阿多奈代替。基督徒则公开念出雅威或耶和华之名。穆斯林称他为安拉，以真主的绝对独一（认主独一，塔希德）为信仰核心。

official_raw.en: A god is a major deity in a specific religion. While some religions may contain many gods and revere them more or less equally, others may focus their faith into a specific one, while others still may deny the existance of other gods besides their own.
official_raw.zh: “神”是特定宗教中的主要神祇。虽然一些宗教可能包含许多神，并且或多或少平等地崇拜它们，但其他宗教可能将信仰集中在特定的一个神身上，而还有一些宗教可能否认除了他们自己信仰的神之外的其他神的存在。

en: Haunu is a figure in ǀXam San mythology. In the story told to children to explain storms, he threw lightning at Kagara and died slowly, thundering, while Kagara slept, thundering too.
zh: 豪努是克萨姆桑人神话中的人物。在这则用来向孩子解释暴风雨的故事里，他向卡加拉投掷闪电，自己在雷鸣中慢慢死去，卡加拉则在雷鸣中睡去。

official_raw.en: $haunu_god$ is a god of lightning and brother-in-law of $kagara_god$.

en:
Hermes, son of Zeus and the Pleiad Maia, was the herald of the Olympian gods. With his winged sandals he moved freely between the mortal and divine worlds, and he guided souls into the afterlife. He also protected heralds, thieves and orators.

He was the divine trickster, as the Homeric Hymn to Hermes tells. His chief symbol was the caduceus, a winged staff entwined with two snakes. The Romans identified him with Mercury, whose name comes from merx, merchandise.
zh:
赫耳墨斯是宙斯与昴宿七姐妹之一迈亚之子。他穿着带翼的凉鞋，在人界与神界之间来去自如，还负责把亡魂引入来世。他也保护传令官、窃贼和演说家。

他又是神圣的骗子，《荷马颂诗·致赫耳墨斯》讲述了他的故事。他的主要象征是双蛇缠绕的带翼权杖。罗马人把他等同于墨丘利，这个名字出自意为“商品”的拉丁语merx。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('hermes_god')] is the messenger of the gods, patron of trade, travel, and cunning.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('hermes_god')]是诸神的信使，贸易、旅行和诡诈的守护者。

en:
Huitzilopochtli, ‘Hummingbird of the South’, was the patron god of the Mexica. He wielded Xiuhcoatl, the fire serpent.

In the myth of Coatepec, he sprang from the womb of the goddess Coatlicue fully armed and slew his sister Coyolxauhqui and four hundred brothers, who became the moon and stars. The sun’s daily struggle against them had to be fed with sacrifices. He mattered little to the Nahuas until the Mexica rose.
zh:
维齐洛波奇特利意为“南方的蜂鸟”，是墨西加人的守护神。他手持火蛇修科亚特尔。

在科阿特佩克的神话里，他从女神科瓦特利奎的腹中全副武装跃出，杀死了姐姐科约尔绍基和四百个兄弟，他们化为月亮和星辰。太阳每日与他们的搏斗，需要以祭品供养。墨西加人崛起之前，他在纳瓦人中并不重要。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('huitzilopochtli_god')] is the solar and war deity of sacrifice for the people of [ShowLocationName('tenochtitlan')].
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodName('huitzilopochtli_god')]是[ShowLocationName('tenochtitlan')]人的太阳、战争和人祭之神。

en:
Hun-Hunahpú, ‘One Hunahpú’, is a figure of K’iche’ Maya myth in the Popol Vuh, father of the Hero Twins Hunahpú and Xbalanqué. He and his brother Vucub-Hunahpú were tricked into the Dark House by the lords of Xibalba, the underworld, and sacrificed.

His head, hung in a tree, turned into a calabash, and its spittle made Xquic, a lord’s daughter, pregnant with the Twins. They beat the lords but could not revive their father. Some scholars identify him with the Classic Maya maize god.
zh:
胡恩‑胡纳赫普意为“一·胡纳赫普”，是基切玛雅《波波尔·乌》中的人物，英雄双子胡纳赫普和什巴兰克的父亲。他和弟弟乌库布‑胡纳赫普被冥界西巴尔巴的诸王骗进黑暗之屋并献祭。

他的头颅挂在树上，变成了葫芦，唾液使一位冥界之王的女儿什基克怀上双子。双子击败了诸王，却无法使父亲复活。有学者认为他就是古典时期玛雅的玉米神。

official_raw.en: $hunhunahpu_god$ is the god of fertility and the ballgame of the [ShowReligionName('mayan')] pantheon.
official_raw.zh: $hunhunahpu_god$是[ShowReligionName('mayan')]中的生育和球类运动之神。

en: Hunntuattatteen is shown as a Cape hyrax and known as the mother of bees. In the eland myth she gave birth to the eland and helped churn its blood to make the first herd.
zh: 洪图亚塔滕的形象为蹄兔，被称为蜜蜂之母。在大角斑羚的神话里，大角斑羚由她生下，她还帮忙搅动羚羊的血，造出第一群大角斑羚。

en:
Huracán, ‘One-Leg’, also called U K’ux Kaj, ‘Heart of Sky’, was also a K’iche’ Maya god of fire, and one of the creator gods who took part in all three attempts to make humankind. He brought the great flood when the second generation of humans angered the gods.

The Popol Vuh says he lived in the windy mists above the floodwaters and called out ‘earth’ until land rose from the sea. His name recalls God K, the Classic Maya lightning god with one serpent leg.
zh:
胡拉坎意为“独腿”，又称“天心”乌·库克斯·卡赫，也是基切玛雅的火神，三次造人尝试中都出场的创世神之一。第二代人类触怒诸神后，他引来了大洪水。

《波波尔·乌》说他住在洪水之上多风的云雾里，一遍遍呼唤“大地”，直到陆地从海里升起。他的名字让人联想到古典时期玛雅的闪电神K神，后者有一条腿是蛇形。

official_raw.en: $huracan_god$ is the god of wind and storms of the [ShowReligionName('mayan')] pantheon.

en:
Ikenga, meaning strength of majesty, is the god of the Igbo of southeastern Nigeria. It embodies a man's endeavour and success, resting on the belief that the power to achieve lies in his right hand, and is held to bring wealth and protection. It is also linked with farming and blacksmithing.

An Ikenga is consecrated by the lineage head before kinsmen, with offerings of yam, cock, wine and kola. The oldest form is two-faced, one face watching the old year and one the new.
zh:
伊肯伽意为“威严之力”，是尼日利亚东南部伊博人的神。它体现一个人的奋斗与成功，信念是成事的力量在人的右手，据说能带来财富和庇护。它还与农耕和铁匠业相关。

伊肯伽要由宗族长在亲属面前举行奉献仪式，供上山药、公鸡、酒和可乐果。最古老的形式是双面的，一张脸看着旧年，一张脸看着新年。

official_raw.en: $ikenga_god$ is the horned god of fortune.

en: Among the Kalenjin, Ilat, or Ilet, is said to dwell in deep pools and waterfalls. The rainbow is his discarded clothing. The Nandi split him into two gods. Ilet ne-mie, the good one, drives danger away with distant rumbling; Ilet ne-ya, the bad one, tries to come down and kill people with nearby thunder.
zh: 在卡伦津人中，伊拉特又作伊莱特，据说住在深潭和瀑布里。彩虹是他丢弃的衣服。南迪人把他分成两位神。善的伊莱特·内米耶用远处的隆隆雷声驱走危险；恶的伊莱特·内亚想下到人间，用近处的炸雷杀人。

official_raw.en: $ilat_god$ is the god of thunder and rain.

en:
Illapa was also the Inca god of lightning and war, ranked among the highest gods of the Andean pantheon. His worship reached across the Andes under local names: Liviac among the Yaros, Pariacaca among the Yauyos, Apocatequil around Cajamarca. When the Inca state expanded, these gods became regional forms of Illapa.

The ruler Pachacuti made him his divine brother, and according to Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa the god gave him a protective idol shaped like a two-headed serpent, possibly an image of the rainbow.
zh:
伊利亚帕也是印加人的闪电与战争之神，是安第斯神谱中地位最高的神之一。他的崇拜以各地的名字遍及安第斯：在亚罗人那里叫利维亚克，在亚乌约人那里叫帕里亚卡卡，在卡哈马卡一带叫阿波卡特基尔。印加国家扩张时，这些神成了伊利亚帕的地方形态。

统治者帕查库提奉他为神圣的兄弟；据佩德罗·萨米恩托·德·甘博亚记载，这位神曾赐给他一尊护身偶像，形如双头蛇，可能是彩虹的象征。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('illapa_god')] is the god of rain and thunder of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

en:
Inti was the patron deity of the Inca state. He is usually said to be a son of Viracocha, and the brother and husband of the moon goddess Mama Quilla. The Inca ruler was held to be his living representative, and the founding ancestor Manco Capac was thought to be his son.

His high priest, the Willaq Umu, ranked second only to the Sapa Inca. The ruler Pachacuti is linked with the rise and spread of the Sun cult.
zh:
因蒂是印加国家的守护神。人们通常说他是维拉科查之子，月亮女神玛玛·基利亚的兄长和丈夫。印加统治者被认为是他在人间的代表，始祖曼科·卡帕克则被认为是他的儿子。

他的大祭司维拉克·乌穆地位仅次于萨帕·印卡。统治者帕查库提与太阳崇拜的兴起和扩张有关。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('inti_god')] is the sun god of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

en: Kagara is a figure in the mythology of the ǀXam San. In a story recorded in the nineteenth century, he came to fetch his sister from her husband Haunu, and the two brothers-in-law threw lightning at each other.
zh: 卡加拉是克萨姆桑人神话中的人物。19世纪记录的一则故事里，他去接回自己的姐姐，姐夫豪努追来，两人互相投掷闪电。

official_raw.en: $kagara_god$ is a god of lightning and brother-in-law of $haunu_god$.

en:
Among the San of southern Africa, Kaggen is often called the Mantis. He can take the form of any animal, most often a praying mantis, but also a bull eland, a louse or a snake. His wife is the Cape hyrax, mother of bees.

In the best known myth, his favourite creature, the eland, was killed by his sons before it was grown. He sprinkled its blood and fat on the ground, and a great herd sprang up for his people to hunt.
zh:
在南部非洲的桑人中，卡根常被称为“螳螂”。他能变成任何动物，最常见的是螳螂，也可以是公大角斑羚、虱子或蛇。他的妻子是蹄兔，也是蜜蜂之母。

最有名的神话讲的是，他最宠爱的大角斑羚在长成之前就被儿子们杀了。他把羚羊的血和脂肪洒在地上，一大群大角斑羚随即出现，供他的族人猎取。

official_raw.en: $kaggen_god$ is the creator and trickster god and folk hero of many african tribes.
official_raw.zh: $kaggen_god$是许多非洲部落的创世神、恶作剧之神和民间英雄。

en:
Kamuy-huci is one of the most important kamuy. Her full name means ‘Rising Fire Sparks Woman’, and she is also called Iresu Kamuy, ‘People Teacher’. She guards the gateway between the world of humans and the world of the kamuy.

Ainu belief holds that the soul of the dead travels to the afterlife through her hearth. Funerals therefore included prayers and offerings to the fire kamuy and verse laments wishing the dead a smooth journey.
zh:
神威媪是最重要的神威之一。她的全名意为“迸射火星之女”，又称“伊雷苏神威”，即“教人之神”。她守卫着人类世界与神威世界之间的门户。

阿伊努人相信，死者的灵魂经由她的火塘前往来世。因此葬礼上要向火神祈祷、献上供品，并吟唱挽歌，祝愿死者一路顺利。

official_raw.en: $kamuy_huci_god$ is the goddess of the hearth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ainu_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Kayra, ‘the merciful king’, is described as both father and mother and lives in the seventeenth layer of heaven. He planted the tree of life, Ulukayın.

Some tellings call him the child of Tengri and the supreme god of the pantheon. In Altai tradition the brothers Ülgen and Erlik were created from him, and in a legend recorded by Radlov he cast the first human from heaven, naming him Erlik.
zh:
凯尔拉意为“仁慈的王”，被描述为既是父亲又是母亲，居于天界第十七层。他种下了生命之树乌鲁卡因。

有的说法称他是长生天之子、诸神之首。在阿尔泰传统里，兄弟于尔根和尔力克由他创造；拉德洛夫记录的一则传说里，他把第一个人逐出天界，称之为尔力克。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('kayra_god')] is the god of creation of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

en: Khuanu is a protective spirit of the Mizo, the hill people of northeast India, named alongside Khuavang as the watcher and keeper of the village, or khua. Some Mizo writers saw the guardian worshipped in Sakhua as this spirit, the source of protection and blessing.
zh: 库阿努是印度东北部山地民族米佐人信奉的守护之灵，与库阿旺并称，被视为村落（库阿）的看守者和保护者。一些米佐学者认为，萨库阿所崇奉的守护者正是这位灵，它是庇护与祝福的来源。

official_raw.en: $khuanu_god$ is the god of nature of the [ShowReligionAdjective('mizo_religion')] pantheon.

en: Kim-un-kamuy means ‘god of the mountains’. In one myth he came from the black shavings of Kotan-kar-kamuy’s fire-making, and the Ainu believed that the bear brought its hide and meat to humans as his gift.
zh: 山熊神威意为“山之神”。一则神话说他由村作神威造火时落下的黑色木屑化成；阿伊努人相信，熊把毛皮和肉送到人间，是他赐给人类的礼物。

official_raw.en: $kim_un_kamuy_god$ is the god of bears and mountains of the [ShowCultureName('ainu_culture')] people.

en: Kine Nane is named among the deities of the Tani peoples of Arunachal, whose rites were led in village or household by shamans called nyibu.
zh: 基内纳内是阿鲁纳恰尔塔尼诸族所奉的神灵之一；塔尼人的仪式由称为尼布的巫师在村里或家中主持。

official_raw.en: $kine_nane_god$ is the goddess of crops and prosperity.

en:
Kotan-kar-kamuy means ‘the deity who makes villages’. The missionary John Batchelor held that every other kamuy answered to him as eternal ruler of the universe, but later scholars doubt this, noting that he is only rarely worshipped.

One myth tells how he tried to make fire as a gift for humankind. A poplar drill failed and turned into evil spirits; an elm succeeded, and from its white shavings came the huntress goddess Hasinaw-uk-kamuy, and from the black the Mountain God, the bear.
zh:
村作神威意为“造村之神”。传教士约翰·巴彻勒认为其他一切神威都要对他负责，他是宇宙永恒的主宰；后来的学者对此存疑，指出人们很少专门祭祀他。

一则神话讲他想造出火，作为礼物送给人类。他先用白杨木钻火，没有成功，木杵变成了恶灵；改用榆木后成功了，白色的木屑化出女猎神哈西瑙乌克神威，黑色的木屑化出山神，也就是熊。

official_raw.en: $kotan_kar_kamuy_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('ainu_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Legba, in Fon Lɛgbà and in Ewe Elegba, is a vodun and the intermediary between god and humans. He may have been taken over from the Yoruba Eshu-Elegba.

He is invoked first at every ceremony. He appears as an old man with a crutch, straw hat and pipe, and the dog is sacred to him. In the Atlantic diaspora he became Papa Legba, identified with Saint Peter.
zh:
雷格巴在丰语中称勒格巴，在埃维语中称埃莱格巴，是一位沃敦，是神与人之间的中介。他可能是从约鲁巴人的埃舒-埃莱格巴那里吸收来的。

每场仪式都先向他祈求。他的形象是拄拐杖、戴草帽、抽烟斗的老人，狗对他是神圣的。在大西洋彼岸的侨民宗教里，他成了爸爸雷格巴，与圣彼得相混同。

official_raw.en: $legba_god$ is a spirit of the crossroads, who grants communication to the spirit world.
official_raw.zh: $legba_god$是世界分隔处的神灵，他赋予人们与灵界沟通的能力。

en:
Lisa is worshipped by the Fon and other Gbe peoples of Dahomey. Lisa and Mawu are children of Nana Buluku and parents of the thunder god Hebioso.

In the myth Lisa was instructed by Mawu to teach humans how to build civilisation. The name is thought to come from Orisanla, another name of the Yoruba Obatala, so the pair may have been borrowed from Yoruba culture.
zh:
莉萨为达荷美的丰人和其他格贝语民族所崇拜。莉萨与玛武是娜娜·布鲁库的孩子，也是雷神赫比奥索的父母。

神话里，莉萨受玛武之命教人们建立文明。这个名字一般认为出自奥里萨恩拉，即约鲁巴人的奥巴塔拉的另一个名字，所以这一对神可能借自约鲁巴文化。

official_raw.en: $lisa_god$ is goddess of the Sun and the creator goddess of all things together with his twin [ShowGodName('mawu_god')].
official_raw.zh: $lisa_god$是太阳女神，与她的双胞胎[ShowGodName('mawu_god')]一起成为万物的创造女神。

en:
Mainao is the daughter of the supreme god Bathoubwrai and, after him, the most important deity of the Boro. She ranks among the prominent household gods.

Her altar stands in the easternmost part of the main house, and Bathou is always worshipped together with her. Worshippers face east, with Mainao on the left of Bathou, and wave the lamp and incense seven times round her.
zh:
买瑙是至高神巴图布赖的女儿，是博罗人仅次于他的重要神灵。她也是主要的家神之一。

她的祭坛设在正屋最东端，祭拜巴图时总要与她一同祭拜。信徒面朝东方，买瑙在巴图的左侧，献灯焚香时要围着她绕转七次。

official_raw.en: $mainao_god$ is the goddess protector of the rice fields of the [ShowCultureName('map_bodo')] people.

en:
Mama Qucha, ‘Mother Sea’, was also the goddess of fish and guardian of sailors and fishermen. In Inca belief she was wife of the creator Wiraqucha, mother of the Sun, Inti, and the Moon, Mama Killa, and one of the four Elemental Mothers.

She was invoked to calm rough waters and bring good fishing, and mattered most to coastal peoples. She dwelt in Hanan Pacha, the world above, and was identified with the rain that waters the fields.
zh:
玛玛·科查意为“海母”，也是鱼类女神，守护水手与渔民。在印加信仰中，她是创世神维拉科查的妻子，太阳神因蒂和月亮女神玛玛·基利亚的母亲，也是四位元素之母之一。

人们祈求她平息风浪、带来渔获，对沿海民族尤其重要。她居于天上界哈南·帕查，并被等同于浇灌田地的雨水。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('mama_cocha')] is the goddess of sea of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

en:
Mama Quilla, Mother Moon, was the older sister and wife of Inti and daughter of Viracocha. She was mother of Manco Capac and Mama Ocllo, the mythical founders of the Inca state, goddess of marriage and the menstrual cycle, and a defender of women. She mattered for the Inca calendar.

She was pictured as a beautiful woman who wept silver tears, and a lunar eclipse meant an animal was attacking her. Her temple in Cusco was served by priestesses.
zh:
玛玛·基利亚意为“月母”，是因蒂的姐姐和妻子，维拉科查之女。她是印加国家神话中的创建者曼科·卡帕克和马马·奥克略之母，是婚姻与月经周期之神，也是妇女的保护者，对印加历法十分重要。

她被想象成一位流着银色眼泪的美丽女子，月食被说成是有野兽在攻击她。她在库斯科的神庙由专门的女祭司侍奉。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('mamaquilla')] is the moon goddess of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

en: Marang Buru, ‘the Great Mountain’, is worshipped by the Santal, Bhumij, Ho and Munda peoples of eastern India. He is regarded as the cause of all causes, and the Santals hold that a hill is itself the deity.
zh: 摩烂迦补卢意为“大山”，受到印度东部桑塔尔人、布米吉人、霍人和蒙达人的崇奉。他被视为万因之因；桑塔尔人认为，有一座山丘本身就是这位神。

official_raw.en: $marang_buru_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('sarna_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Mawu is worshipped by the Fon and other Gbe peoples of Dahomey. Her name means the Unsurpassable One. Mawu and Lisa are children of the primal creator Nana Buluku.

Mawu shaped humans from clay and asked the serpent Aido Hwedo to coil beneath the earth to hold it up. In the eighteenth century, under King Tegbesu, Dahomey raised the pair to creators of the world.
zh:
玛武为达荷美的丰人和其他格贝语民族所崇拜。她的名字意为“无可超越者”。玛武与莉萨是原初创造者娜娜·布鲁库的孩子。

玛武用黏土造人，并请巨蛇艾多·赫韦多盘在大地下方托住大地。18世纪特格贝苏在位期间，达荷美把这对神抬高为世界的创造者。

official_raw.en: $mawu_god$ is god of the Moon and the creator god of all things together with his twin [ShowGodName('lisa_god')].
official_raw.zh: $mawu_god$是月亮之神，也是与他的双胞胎[ShowGodName('lisa_god')]一起创造万物的造物主。

en: Mergen was the son of Kayra and brother of Ülgen, living on the seventh floor of the sky. His name means ‘archer’ in Turkic languages, and in Khalkha ‘wise’ or ‘genius’. He was shown as a young man in a helmet with a bow, riding a white horse, or as a strong bull. White was his colour.
zh: 墨尔根是凯尔拉之子，于尔根的兄弟，住在天界第七层。他的名字在突厥诸语中意为“射手”，在喀尔喀蒙古语里意为“聪明”或“天才”。他的形象是戴着头盔、持弓骑白马的青年，或是一头强壮的公牛。白色是他的颜色。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('mergen_god')] is the god of abundance and wisdom of the [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] people.

en: Mindiss is a pangool of the Serer, an ancestral spirit with goddess-like attributes. Offerings are made in her name at the River Sine.
zh: 门迪丝是塞雷尔人的潘古尔，即祖灵，带有女神的特征。人们在锡内河畔以她的名义献上祭品。

official_raw.en: $mindiss_god$ is the manatee shaped protector of th Fatick Region in the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.
official_raw.zh: $mindiss_god$是[ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')]中法蒂克地区的形似海牛的守护者。

en: Among the Gonds of central India, worship went chiefly to clan and village deities rather than to the high god Baradeo, among them a village mother goddess.
zh: 在印度中部的贡德人中，人们真正祭拜的是氏族和村落的神灵，而不是至高神婆罗提乌，其中就有村母神。

official_raw.en: $nat_awal_god$ is the goddess of fertility of the [ShowCultureName('gond')] people.

en: Nat Awual is worshipped with the guardian Aki Pen before every festival. Where she has no shrine of her own, her abode is a saja tree.
zh: 捺奥斡尔每逢节庆之前都要与守护神阿吉宾一同祭拜。若村里没有她专属的神龛，她的居所就是一棵萨贾树。

official_raw.en: $nat_awual_god$ is the mother goddess of the village of the [ShowCultureName('gond')] people.

en:
Ngai, also called Enkai, is known to the Maasai as both masculine and feminine, and is the creator god of the related Kikuyu, Embu, Meru and Kamba of Kenya and Tanzania. His name is synonymous with rain.

The Maasai place his first dwelling on Ol Doinyo Lengai, the Mountain of God, and their laibon priests preside over sacrifice. In Kikuyu tradition he brought the ancestors Gikuyu and Mumbi together and made Mount Kenya his seat.
zh:
恩加伊又称恩凯，马赛人认为他兼有男性和女性两种属性；肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚相邻的基库尤人、恩布人、梅鲁人和坎巴人也奉他为创世神。他的名字与“雨”同义。

马赛人认为他最初的居所是神山伦盖伊火山，他们的莱邦祭司主持献祭。在基库尤人的传统里，他让始祖基库尤和穆姆比结为夫妇，并以肯尼亚山为居所。

official_raw.en: $ngai_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowCultureName('maasai_culture')] people.

en:
Nhialic is the creator and the god of sky and rain of the Dinka of what is now South Sudan. He is seen as distant from humans.

In the myth of the origin of death, the first humans, Garang and Abuk, were told to pound only a set amount of grain daily. Abuk pounded more, and the grain struck Nhialic in the face. He sent a blue bird to cut the rope joining heaven and earth, and people became mortal.
zh:
尼雅力克是今南苏丹一带丁卡人的创世神，掌管天空和降雨。人们认为他远离人间。

在死亡起源的神话里，最初的人类加朗和阿布克被命令每天只舂一定数量的谷物。阿布克多舂了些，谷粒打中了尼雅力克的脸。他派一只蓝鸟割断连接天地的绳索，人类从此成为必死之身。

official_raw.en: $nhialic_god$ is the main [gods|e] of the [ShowReligionAdjective('muonyjang_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Niparaya is the all-powerful master of heaven and earth in the mythology of the Pericú of Baja California, recorded in fragments in the early 1730s. His wife was Amayicoyondi, and they had three sons.

The first, Quaayayp, made the race of men and was later killed by them. The second was Acaragui, and the third was called Wac or Tuparan, depending on the sect.
zh:
尼帕拉亚是下加利福尼亚佩里库人神话中无所不能的天地主宰，这些神话在18世纪30年代初被零星记录下来。他的妻子叫阿马伊科永迪，两人生有三个儿子。

长子夸亚伊普造出了人类，后来被人类杀死；次子是阿卡拉吉，三子随教派不同叫瓦克或图帕兰。

official_raw.en: $niparaya_god$ is the creator god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('pericu_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Njörðr was also linked to wind, wealth and the fertility of crops. By his unnamed twin sister he was father of Freyr and Freyja. The poem Grímnismál gives him a hall at Nóatún.

After the war between the Æsir and the Vanir he went to the Æsir as a hostage. His marriage to the giantess Skaði was unhappy. His name matches that of Nerthus, a fertility goddess recorded in the first century, and many Scandinavian place names contain it.
zh:
尼奥尔德还与风、财富和作物丰收相关。他与未留下名字的孪生姐妹生下了弗雷和弗蕾亚。《格里姆尼尔之歌》说他在诺阿通有一座殿堂。

阿萨神族与华纳神族交战之后，他去阿萨神族那里作人质。他与女巨人斯卡娣的婚姻并不幸福。他的名字与1世纪记载的丰饶女神内尔图斯相对应，斯堪的纳维亚有许多含有这个名字的地名。

official_raw.en: $njord_god$ is the of the Vanir, father of $freyr_god$ and $freya_god$. He is worshipped in relation to the seafaring and fishing.
official_raw.zh: $njord_god$是华纳神族的海神，亦是$freyr_god$与$freya_god$的父亲。他被尊奉为航海与渔业之神。

en:
Nyambe is the creator of the universe, god of the sun and the source of all life. He is described as all-powerful and all-knowing, and watches over his creation from above.

The name varies from people to people, as Njambe, Nyambi, Nzambi and other forms, while the idea stays much the same. Only the Bakongo are known to have also seen Nzambi as a goddess and Sky Mother.
zh:
尼扬贝是宇宙的创造者、太阳神，也是一切生命的源头。人们说他全能全知，从天上守望着自己的造物。

各族称呼不同，有恩贾贝、尼扬比、恩赞比等形式，观念却大体一致。已知只有刚果人还把恩赞比视为女神和天母。

official_raw.en: $nyambe_god$ is the main [gods|e] and Sky Father for many [ShowLanguageFamilyName('bantu_language_family')] speaking people.
official_raw.zh: $nyambe_god$是众多[ShowLanguageFamilyName('bantu_language_family')]族群信奉的主要[gods|e]和天父。

en:
Obatala, King of White Cloth, also called Orisanla, is the king of the orisha in Yoruba religion. Sent down from heaven on a gold chain with a snail shell of sand, a white hen and a palm nut, he molded the first people from clay.

In some versions he drank palm wine while working and made deformed figures, so on sobering he vowed never to drink again and became protector of the disabled. Ife tradition also remembers him as a mortal founder-king of Ife.
zh:
奥巴塔拉意为“白布之王”，又称奥里萨恩拉，是约鲁巴宗教中诸奥里沙之王。他沿一条金链从天上降下，带着装满沙子的蜗牛壳、一只白母鸡和一颗棕榈果，用黏土捏出了最初的人类。

在某些说法里，他干活时喝了棕榈酒，捏出了残缺的人形，所以清醒后发誓不再饮酒，并成为残障者的保护者。伊费的传统还把他记作伊费的凡人始祖国王。

official_raw.en: $obatala_god$ is the creator on mankind in the [ShowReligionName('isese_religion')] religion.

en:
Odin was a god of wisdom, poetry, war and the dead in Norse and wider Germanic paganism; his name means ‘lord of frenzy’. Husband of Frigg and father of Baldr and Thor, he was shown as an old, one-eyed man with a spear, attended by two ravens.

He received slain warriors in Valhöll and would be killed by the wolf Fenrir at Ragnarök. About 1075 Adam of Bremen saw his statue in the temple at Uppsala.
zh:
奥丁在诺斯和更广泛的日耳曼多神教中掌管智慧、诗歌、战争与亡者；他的名字意为“狂怒之主”。他是弗丽格的丈夫，巴尔德尔和托尔的父亲，形象是手持长矛的独眼老人，身边有两只渡鸦。

阵亡的战士由他迎入瓦尔哈拉，诸神黄昏时他将被巨狼芬里尔杀死。约1075年，不来梅的亚当记载乌普萨拉神庙里有他的神像。

official_raw.en: $odin_god$ is the Lord of the Aesir, who sacrificed one eye for wisdom, and hanged from the World Tree for nine days and nine nights to gain knowledge of the runes.
official_raw.zh: $odin_god$是阿萨神族的众神之父。他为了追求无尽的智慧，不惜献祭一目，更将自己悬挂于世界树九天九夜，终于领悟了卢恩符文的奥秘。

en: Ogbunabali, meaning the one who kills at night, is a traditional Igbo deity. He is said to kill his victims in the night, usually criminals or those who have broken an unspeakable taboo.
zh: 奥古纳巴利意为“夜里杀人者”，是伊博人传统的神灵。据说他在夜里取人性命，受害者通常是罪犯或犯下不可言说的禁忌的人。

official_raw.en: $ogbunabali_god$ is the god of death of the [ShowReligionAdjective('odinala_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Olokun is the orisha of the ocean depths in Yoruba religion, parent of Aje, the orisha of wealth. Worship of Olokun is strongest in the Yoruba and Edo towns of southwestern Nigeria; near the coast the god is male, in the hinterland female. One Ife account makes Olokun the wife of Oduduwa who became the sea after leaving him.

At Lagos the Oniru chief held an annual festival to Olokun to avert flooding, and in Ife the chief priest is the Oba Ijio.
zh:
奥洛昆是约鲁巴宗教中的海洋深处之神，是财富之神阿杰的父母。对奥洛昆的崇拜在尼日利亚西南部的约鲁巴人和埃多人城镇最盛；近海之处奥洛昆为男性，内陆则为女性。伊费有一种说法，奥洛昆是奥杜杜瓦的妻子，离开他之后变成了大海。

在拉各斯，奥尼鲁酋长每年举行盛大的节日祭祀奥洛昆，以防海岸被淹；在伊费，主祭司是奥巴·伊乔。

official_raw.en: $olokun_isese_god$ is the god of water and wealth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('isese_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Olorun is the ruler of the heavens and creator of the universe. His name contracts oni, owner, and orun, heaven. He is also called Olodumare, read as the all-sufficient.

He is remote, with no shrine, image or sacrifice of his own. He is approached through the orisa, the divine beings of whom Obatala is king, who govern and sustain the physical world.
zh:
欧洛伦是天界的统治者和宇宙的创造者。他的名字由表示“拥有者”的奥尼和表示“天界”的奥伦缩合而成。他又称奥洛杜马雷，意思被解释为“无所不足者”。

他疏远，没有自己的神龛、神像和祭品。人们通过奥里沙，也就是神圣的存在来接近他，其中奥巴塔拉是王，奥里沙治理并维系物质世界。

official_raw.en: $olorun_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowReligionAdjective('isese_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Ori, literally head, is the Yoruba concept of a person's spiritual intuition. It is a spark of consciousness set into the human essence, and is often personified as an orisha in its own right.

Whatever a person becomes, or whatever happens in a life, is held to be as destined by Ori, so Ori is worshipped like the orisha. When things go wrong it is consulted and appeased, and a person with a balanced character is aligned with his Ori, his divine self.
zh:
奥里的字面意思是“头”，在约鲁巴人的观念里指一个人的精神直觉。它是嵌入人的本质的一点意识火花，常被拟人化为一位独立的奥里沙。

人最终成为什么样子、一生遇到什么事，都被认为是奥里所注定的，所以人们像崇拜奥里沙一样崇拜奥里。事情不顺时要向它求问并安抚它；品性平衡的人，就与自己的奥里，即神圣的自我相合。

official_raw.en: $ori_god$ is the custodian of fate in the [ShowReligionName('isese_religion')] religion.

en:
Pachamama is the Andean goddess of space, time and life, revered by the peoples of the Andes. Some myths make her the wife of Pachacamac and the mother of Mama Quilla and Inti. She was often worshipped as Mama Allpa, goddess of the earth, the source of people's material and spiritual sustenance.

Her shrines were sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and priests offered her llamas and guinea pigs. After the Spanish conquest, many Indigenous peoples linked the Virgin Mary with her.
zh:
帕查玛玛是安第斯人崇敬的空间、时间与生命女神。一些神话称她是帕查卡马克的妻子，玛玛·基利亚和因蒂的母亲。她常以大地女神“玛玛·阿尔帕”的形象受到崇拜，是人们物质和精神滋养的来源。

她的神龛是神圣的岩石或传说中的树干，祭司向她献上美洲驼和豚鼠。西班牙征服之后，许多原住民把圣母玛利亚与她联系在一起。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('pachamama')] is the Earth Mother of the people of the [ShowRegionName('andes_region')].

en: Paruhang is worshipped by the Rai, a Kirati people of eastern Nepal. He is the husband of the earth goddess Sumnima. He stands for the celestial powers and the order of creation, and for rain and divine protection. The Rai make offerings to him together with Sumnima at the Sakela festival of sowing and harvest.
zh: 帕茹夯受到尼泊尔东部基拉特民族莱人的崇奉。他是大地女神松米玛的丈夫。他代表诸天的力量和创世的秩序，也司掌降雨和神的庇护。在播种和收获时的萨克拉节上，莱人把供品献给他和松米玛。

official_raw.en: $paruhang_god$ is the god of the sky of the [ShowReligionAdjective('kirat_mundhum_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Pathian is revered by the Mizo, the Tibeto-Burman hill people once called the Lushai, in what is now Mizoram. He is thought to dwell in heaven as the kind creator, protector and benefactor of all creation, rewarding the righteous and punishing the wicked.

Mizo writers differ on whether the traditional faith, Sakhua, involves worshipping him. Some see him as its centre, while others hold that it addresses only the Khuavang, the spirit of blessing and protection.
zh:
帕提安受到米佐人的崇奉。米佐人旧称卢塞人，是今米佐拉姆一带的藏缅语山地民族。他被认为居住在天上，是仁慈的创造者，保护并造福万物，赏善罚恶。

米佐学者对传统信仰萨库阿是否包含对他的崇拜意见不一：有人把他看作信仰的中心，也有人认为这一信仰祭祀的只是赐福护佑的库阿旺。

official_raw.en: $pathian_god$ is the supreme god of the [ShowCultureName('zo_culture')] people.

en: Among the Tai peoples, guardian phi watched over particular places, such as temples and the town pillar, the lak mueang, at the heart of each town.
zh: 在泰族诸民族中，守护各处的丕庇佑着寺庙和城镇中心的立柱“拉勐”。

official_raw.en: $phi_earth_god$ is the god of earth of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

en: The Tai peoples honoured many phi alongside the vital forces called khwan and their ancestors, and the old sky gods, the phi thaen, stood above the local spirits.
zh: 泰族诸民族在崇拜称为宽的生命灵气和祖先之外，还供奉许多丕；古老的天神“丕天”位在各地的精灵之上。

official_raw.en: $phi_fire_god$ is the god of all natural powers of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.
official_raw.zh: $phi_fire_god$是[ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')]中掌管一切自然力量的神灵。

en:
Phi of Heaven is known to the Tai as Phi Fa or Phi Thaen, giver of rain and creator god. The Tai call him by the word for sky, thaen, which comes from the Chinese tian. He appears in the stories of Khun Borom.

In the Phi Fa ritual, held for someone recovering from serious illness, a shaman invites him to the altar with khaen music, chanting and an all-night dance, and asks him for healing and protection.
zh:
丕天在泰族中称丕法，司掌降雨，也是创世神。泰人称他为“滕”，意为天，这个词源自汉语的“天”。他出现在昆博隆的传说中。

在为大病初愈者举行的丕法仪式上，巫师以竹笙音乐、吟唱和通宵的舞蹈把他请到祭坛前，求他治愈疾病、护佑平安。

official_raw.en: $phi_heaven_god$ is the god of heavens of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

en: Satsana Phi, the old faith of the Shan, the Dai, the Lao and the Ahom, gave worship to many phi, from the guardians of temples to the old sky gods, the phi thaen.
zh: 丕教是掸人、傣族、佬人和阿洪姆人古老的信仰，供奉的丕众多，从寺庙的守护神灵到古老的天神“丕天”都有。

official_raw.en: $phi_water_god$ is the god of water of the [ShowReligionAdjective('satsana_phi')] pantheon.

en:
Polo is a god of the Tani peoples of Arunachal, among them the Adi, Galo and Nyishi. Traditionally he was addressed as Father, paired with the Sun, Donyi, as Mother.

The two were called on to witness the truth and to punish liars. The Minyong and Padam Adi tell of a creator, Sedi, whose eyes became the Sun and Moon.
zh:
波罗是阿鲁纳恰尔阿迪人、加洛人、尼西人等塔尼诸族的神。传统上人们称他为父亲，与太阳冬尼，即母亲，相配。

人们请这两位神为真话作证，惩罚说谎的人。敏荣和帕达姆两支阿迪人说，创造者是塞迪，他的双眼变成了日月。

official_raw.en: $polo_god$ is the god of the Moon of the [ShowReligionAdjective('donyi_polo_religion')] pantheon.

en:
Poseidon, one of the twelve Olympians, was also the god of storms and horses and the protector of seafarers. When the world was divided by lot among the sons of Cronus, Zeus received the sky, Hades the underworld and Poseidon the sea.

In Bronze Age Pylos and Thebes he was a chief deity, called Earth Shaker. He lost Athens to Athena, and in the Odyssey his anger over the blinding of his son Polyphemus kept Odysseus at sea for ten years.
zh:
波塞冬是奥林匹斯十二主神之一，也是风暴和马之神，航海者的保护者。世界由克洛诺斯的三个儿子抽签瓜分时，宙斯得到天空，哈迪斯得到冥界，波塞冬得到大海。

青铜时代的皮洛斯和底比斯奉他为主神，称他“撼地者”。他在争夺雅典的竞赛中输给了雅典娜；《奥德赛》里，他因儿子波吕斐摩斯被刺瞎而愤怒，使奥德修斯在海上漂泊了十年。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('poseidon_god')] is the god of the sea, earthquakes, and the untamed forces of nature.
official_raw.zh: [ShowGodNameWithNoTooltip('poseidon_god')]是海洋、地震和自然狂野力量之神。

en: Pu Vana, whose name means God in Heaven, is a benevolent spirit of the Mizo, the hill people of northeast India. Traditionally he was counted as the grandfather, and probably the father, of Pathian, the creator, and was worshipped as the god of nature. Scholars compare him to Indra in Hindu belief.
zh: 普·瓦纳意为“天上的神”，是印度东北部山地民族米佐人信奉的仁慈之灵。传统上，他被看作创造者帕提安的祖父，很可能也是其父，并被奉为自然之神。学者把他比作印度教的因陀罗。

official_raw.en: $pu_vana_god$ is the god of thunder and lightning of the [ShowCultureName('zo_culture')] people.

en:
Quetzalcoatl, ‘Feathered Serpent’, was an Aztec god of the planet Venus, crafts and merchants, a creator who helped make humankind, and patron of the priesthood. As wind god he took human form as Ehecatl. Quetzalcoatl was also the title of the two chief priests of the Great Temple of Tenochtitlan.

In the legends of Tollan, the ruler Quetzalcoatl was tricked by his rival Tezcatlipoca and driven into exile. Sixteenth-century Spanish writers conflated the god with that ruler.
zh:
魁札尔·科亚特尔意为“羽蛇”，是阿兹特克的金星、手艺和商人之神，参与创造了人类，也是祭司阶层的守护神。作为风神，他以人形的埃赫卡特尔出现。魁札尔·科亚特尔也是特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙两位大祭司的头衔。

在托兰城的传说里，统治者魁札尔·科亚特尔被对手特斯卡特利波卡欺骗，被迫流亡。16世纪的西班牙作者把这位神与那位统治者混为一谈。

official_raw.en: [ShowGodName('quetzalcoatl_god')] is the god of life, wind and wisdom in the Mesoamerican pantheon.
