Charrua is the name given to a small family of poorly documented tongues of the Plata basin, once heard across Uruguay, the Argentine province of Entre Rios and perhaps parts of Paraguay. Its recorded members are Chana, whose speakers called it Lantek, Mbegua, Guenoa and Charrua itself, carried by semi-nomadic hunter-gatherers who fished the shore in summer and hunted deer and rhea inland with bolas and bows.

The Jesuit Pedro Lozano records that these peoples killed the explorer Juan Diaz de Solis during his voyage of 1515 up the Rio de la Plata. The Charrua and Chana long resisted Spanish settlement.

From the eighteenth century cattle ranching enclosed their hunting grounds and turned famine into a way of life, answered by mounted raids known as malones. The speakers' independent life ended in 1831 with the Massacre of Salsipuedes, when the Uruguayan army destroyed the Charrua camps and dispersed the survivors.
zh:
查鲁亚语是拉普拉塔河流域一个记录稀少的小语系的统称，曾通行于乌拉圭、阿根廷恩特雷里奥斯省以及可能的巴拉圭部分地区。有记录的语言包括查纳语（使用者自称兰特克语）、姆贝瓜语、格诺阿语和查鲁亚语本支，使用者是半游牧狩猎采集族群，夏天到岸边捕鱼，带着投石索和弓箭深入内陆猎鹿和美洲鸵。

耶稣会士佩德罗·洛萨诺记载，1515年航海者胡安·迪亚斯·德·索利斯溯拉普拉塔河而上时死在这些族群手中。查鲁亚人和查纳人长期抵抗西班牙人的拓殖。

18世纪起，牧牛业圈占了他们的猎场，饥荒成为常态，他们便以骑马突袭的马龙还击。1831年，乌拉圭军队制造萨尔西普埃德斯大屠杀，摧毁查鲁亚人的营地并驱散幸存者，语言使用者的独立生活就此结束。

en: Cheke Holo, also called Maringe, A'ara, Holo or Kubonitu, is an Oceanic language spoken on Santa Isabel Island in the Solomon Islands. It shares distinctive phonological traits with the other languages of Santa Isabel, including aspirated stops and voiceless sonorants, while its verbs carry no markers of tense or person.
zh: 切克霍洛语又称马林盖语、阿阿拉语、霍洛语或库博尼图语，是所罗门群岛圣伊莎贝尔岛上通行的一种泛太平洋语系语言。它与圣伊莎贝尔岛的其他语言共有送气塞音、清响音等独特语音特征，动词则没有时态和人称标记。

en:
Cherokee, self-named Tsalagi, is a language of the Southern branch of the Iroquoian family; its speakers' ancestors are thought to have moved from the Great Lakes into the southern Appalachians some three thousand years ago. At European contact it had three dialects. A polysynthetic tongue, Cherokee could convey a whole sentence in a single verb.

Cherokee remained purely oral until around 1809, when Sequoyah, a Cherokee who knew no writing, began devising a script. After first trying word-pictures, he settled on a syllabary of eighty-six characters, and the Cherokee Nation adopted it in 1825.

Within a few years laws, hymns and parts of the Bible appeared in print, literacy among the Cherokees surpassed that of their white neighbours, and from 1828 the bilingual Cherokee Phoenix became the first newspaper published by Native Americans in their own language.
zh:
切罗基语自称察拉吉语，是易洛魁语系南支的语言；一般认为，其先民约在三千年前从五大湖地区迁入阿巴拉契亚山脉南部。欧洲人到来时，它分为三种方言。切罗基语是多式综合语，一个动词就能表达整句话的意思。

切罗基语在1809年前后以前一直没有文字：不识任何文字的切罗基人塞阔雅开始创制书写系统，先尝试图画表意，最终设计出一套86个字符的音节文字，切罗基民族于1825年正式采用。

几年之内，法律、圣诗和《圣经》的部分卷册相继印行，切罗基人的识字率甚至超过了邻近的白人；1828年起，双语的《切罗基凤凰报》出版，成为美洲原住民第一份用本族语言发行的报纸。

en:
Chibchan is the language family of the Isthmo-Colombian world. It reached from Mosquitia in eastern Central America through Costa Rica and Panama into northern Colombia.

The family takes its name from Chibcha, also called Muysccubun, the speech of the Muisca of the Colombian highlands. Reconstructed Proto-Chibchan words for manioc, maize, squash and tobacco show that Proto-Chibchan speakers were horticulturalists who spread across the isthmus in remote prehistory.

After the Spanish conquest the Church made Chibcha a vehicle of evangelization: from 1580 schools were ordered to teach in native languages, in 1606 the clergy was instructed to give religious teaching in Chibcha, and friars such as Bernardo de Lugo compiled its grammars. The Muisca language declined during the eighteenth century, and in 1770 Charles III banned its use.
zh:
奇布查语系是地峡—哥伦比亚文化区的原住民语系，范围从中美洲东部的莫斯基蒂亚经哥斯达黎加、巴拿马延伸到哥伦比亚北部。

语系得名于奇布查语（又称穆伊斯卡语），即哥伦比亚高原穆伊斯卡人的语言。重构出的原始奇布查语词汇中有木薯、玉米、南瓜和烟草，说明原始奇布查语的使用者是农人，在远古史前时代便已扩散到整个地峡。

西班牙征服后，教会把奇布查语当作传教工具：1580年起下令兴办原住民语言学校，1606年又要求教士用奇布查语讲授教义，贝尔纳多·德·卢戈等修士还编写了语法书。穆伊斯卡语在18世纪走向衰落，1770年卡洛斯三世下令禁止使用该语。

en:
Chicham, natively called aent and better known as Jivaroan, is the language of the peoples living along the headwaters of the Marañón River and its tributaries, in northern Peru and the Ecuadorian Oriente. It forms a small family, comprising Shuar, Achuar-Shiwiar, Awajun and Huambisa, while the extinct language of the Palta may also have belonged to it. The name Jivaro probably derives from xivar, the Shuar word for people.

In 1527 the Shuar defeated an Inca army sent by Huayna Capac, and in 1599 they drove the Spanish settlers out of their territory, which kept the language alive in the forest through the colonial era; its speakers combined slash-and-burn gardening with hunting by blowgun and curare-tipped darts.
zh:
奇查姆语母语者自称“阿恩特”，更常见的名称是希瓦罗语，通行于秘鲁北部和厄瓜多尔东方地区马拉尼翁河上游及其支流一带。它构成一个小语系，包括舒阿尔语、阿丘阿尔-希维阿尔语、阿瓦洪语和万比萨语，已消亡的帕尔塔语可能也属于这一语系。“希瓦罗”一名大概来自舒阿尔语中意为“人”的词“希瓦尔”。

1527年，舒阿尔人击败了瓦伊纳·卡帕克派出的印加军队，1599年又把西班牙定居者逐出自己的土地，使这门语言在整个殖民时代得以在丛林中延续；其使用者从事刀耕火种的园圃农业，并用吹箭筒和涂有箭毒的飞镖狩猎。

en:
Chickasaw-Choctaw denotes the Western branch of the Muskogean family, whose two chief languages, Choctaw and Chickasaw, are so close that some linguists treat them as dialects of one tongue. Both peoples recall descending from a single ancestral group, and before European contact the Chickasaw had moved east of the Mississippi into what is now northeastern Mississippi, while the Choctaw settled across Mississippi, Alabama and Louisiana.

Around 1700 a simplified pidgin drawn mainly from Choctaw and Chickasaw, Mobilian Jargon, became the lingua franca of the Gulf coast and lower Mississippi, used by many peoples and absorbing words from French, Spanish and English.

A Roman-based Choctaw orthography was devised under the United States civilization program early in the nineteenth century, and in the 1830s both nations were forced west to Indian Territory, carrying the languages into Oklahoma.
zh:
奇克索—乔克托语指马斯科吉语族的西支，两大语言乔克托语和奇克索语关系极近，部分语言学家把它们视为同一语言的两种方言。两个民族都传说是同一祖先群体的后裔：欧洲人到来之前，奇克索人已东渡密西西比河，定居于今密西西比东北部，乔克托人则分布在密西西比、亚拉巴马和路易斯安那一带。

约1700年前后，一种主要简化自乔克托语和奇克索语的莫比尔混合语成为墨西哥湾沿岸和密西西比河下游的通用语，许多民族都使用它，其中还吸收了法语、西班牙语和英语词汇。

19世纪初，美国的文明计划为乔克托语制定了拉丁字母拼写法；19世纪30年代，两个民族都被强制西迁印第安领地，这两种语言也随之进入俄克拉荷马一带。

en:
Chimbu denotes the Chimbu–Wahgi family of the New Guinea highlands, spoken across the fertile Wahgi Valley and surrounding mountains. Its best-known members are Kuman, the Chimbu language proper, Wahgi, Nii and Melpa, the tongue of the Kawelka and neighbouring tribes around Mount Hagen. Their placement within the Trans–New Guinea phylum is debated, though their pronouns keep the family's dual and plural endings.

The languages use contrastive tone alongside rare lateral consonants; Melpa speakers also count in a binary system and switch to a special pandanus language while gathering karuka nuts.

The densely farmed valleys are among the few places where agriculture arose independently: at Kuk Swamp archaeologists uncovered drainage ditches and taro plots going back to around 7000 BCE, with banana and sugar-cane cultivation established by about 4500 BCE.
zh:
钦布语指新几内亚高地的钦布—瓦吉语族，通行于肥沃的瓦吉河谷及周边山地。主要成员包括钦布本地的库曼语，以及瓦吉语、尼伊语和梅尔帕语，后者是哈根山一带卡维尔卡等部落的语言。它们是否属于跨新几内亚语系尚有争议，但其代词保留了该语系的双数和复数词尾。

诸语言都用对立声调，还配有罕见的边音；梅尔帕人采用二进制计数，采集卡鲁卡坚果时还会改用专门的露兜树语。

这些河谷农垦密集，是少数独立发展出农业的地方之一：考古学者在库克沼泽发现了可追溯至约公元前7000年的排水沟渠和芋头田，到约公元前4500年，当地已有香蕉和甘蔗种植。

en:
Chitimacha, known to its speakers as Sitimaxa, is a language isolate of the Louisiana bayous, spoken by the Chitimacha people of the Atchafalaya Basin west of the lower Mississippi. The name Chitimacha is said to mean people of the Grand River. Its speakers were settled agriculturalists who grew corn, beans and squash in riverside villages and traveled in dugout cypress canoes.

They had lived on the Louisiana coast for some two and a half thousand years when French raiders entered their country in the late seventeenth century; the long war that followed ended with peace in 1718, by which time disease and fighting had sharply reduced their numbers. The language had no native script and was handed down orally.
zh:
奇蒂马查语在本族语中称西蒂马克萨，是路易斯安那河网地带的一门孤立语言，使用者是密西西比河下游以西阿查法拉亚盆地的奇蒂马查人。据说奇蒂马查一名意为大河之民。他们是定居的农耕者，在河畔村落种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，乘柏木挖凿的独木舟出行。

法国劫掠者在17世纪末侵入他们的土地时，奇蒂马查人已在路易斯安那海岸生活了约两千五百年；随之而来的长期战争直到1718年才议和，此时疫病和征战已使他们的人口锐减。奇蒂马查语没有本族文字，依靠口耳相传。

en:
Chiwere, also called Iowa-Otoe-Missouria, is a Siouan-Catawban language of the closely similar Iowa, Otoe and Missouria dialects; its nearest relative is Ho-Chunk, or Winnebago. The Iowa, Otoe, Missouria and Ho-Chunk were once one group in the western Great Lakes, linked to the Oneota culture. From the sixteenth century bands moved south and west, settling as farmers and bison hunters along the Missouri and Platte rivers. The name Chiwere means to speak the home dialect.

The French explorer Jacques Marquette met the Missouria on the Missouri in 1673, but an attack by the Sauk and Meskwaki in 1730 nearly destroyed that tribe, and epidemics left fewer than a hundred by 1829, when the survivors merged with the Otoe.

Missionaries first recorded the language in the 1830s; in 1837 the Iowa were removed to a Kansas-Nebraska reservation, and later treaties gradually pressed its speakers into Indian Territory.
zh:
奇维雷语又称艾奥瓦—奥托—密苏里语，是一门苏—卡托巴语系语言，由艾奥瓦、奥托和密苏里几支高度相近的方言组成，最近的亲属语言是霍昌克语，即温尼贝戈语。艾奥瓦人、奥托人、密苏里人和霍昌克人原是五大湖西部的同一群体，与奥内奥塔文化有关。16世纪起，各支向西南迁徙，在密苏里河与普拉特河沿岸定居，务农兼猎野牛。奇维雷一名的意思是说家乡方言。

1673年，法国探险家雅克·马凯特在密苏里河畔见到密苏里人；但1730年索克人和梅斯克瓦基人的袭击几乎摧毁该族，疫病使其到1829年只剩不足百人，幸存者并入奥托人。

19世纪30年代，传教士首次把这种语言记录成文；1837年艾奥瓦人被迁到堪萨斯—内布拉斯加保留地，此后的条约又把其使用者逐步压入印第安领地。

en:
Choco, or Chocoan, is the small language family of the Pacific lowlands of western Colombia and eastern Panama, centred on the Atrato and San Juan river basins of the Chocó. In 1337 its two living branches were already taking shape: the Emberá continuum of riverine forest villages, whose name ẽberá means person or human being, and Wounaan on the lower waterways. The family has never been convincingly linked to any other.

Spanish entradas of the 1500s found the flooded, densely forested coast hard to hold, and Emberá groups long kept their autonomy by retreating upriver.

From the late 1700s several Emberá bands moved north into the Darién, clashing with the Guna and pushing them toward the Caribbean shore. Emberá and Wounaan remained everyday community languages through the colonial centuries rather than being replaced by Spanish.
zh:
乔科语（乔科安语）是哥伦比亚西部与巴拿马东部太平洋低地的一个小语系，核心区在乔科省的阿特拉托河与圣胡安河流域。1337年时，它现存的两大支系已具雏形：以河畔林间村落为家、方言连续成片的恩贝拉语，ẽberá意为人；以及分布在下游水道的沃纳安语。乔科语系与其他语系的亲缘关系始终没有得到可靠证明。

16世纪西班牙入侵者发现这片水网密布、丛林幽深的海岸难以控制，恩贝拉人通过向河流上游退却长期保持自治。

18世纪末，又有数支恩贝拉人队伍北迁入达连地区，与古纳人冲突，把后者挤向加勒比海岸。整个殖民时代，恩贝拉语和沃纳安语始终是社群的日常语言，并未被西班牙语取代。

en:
Chokwe, also called Ciokwe or Tshokwe, is a Bantu language of the borderlands where Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Zambia meet, and it serves as a lingua franca across eastern Angola. Its speakers, the Chokwe, trace their chiefs' ancestry to the Lunda migrations of the 1500s, and were one of the twelve clans of the Lunda Empire of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries.

After quarrels over tribute they broke away from the Lunda king, the Mwata Yanvo, and their trade in wax, ivory and other goods made them a prosperous, independent power. The Chokwe farm, hunt and fish to the rhythm of the rainy and dry seasons.
zh:
绍奎语又称乔奎语或特肖克韦语，是一门班图语，通行于安哥拉、刚果（金）和赞比亚三国交界地带，并在东安哥拉充当通用语。绍奎人的酋长世系可追溯到16世纪的隆达人迁徙；在17至18世纪，他们是隆达帝国十二个氏族之一。

后因贡赋争执，他们脱离隆达国王姆瓦塔·扬沃独立，凭借蜂蜡、象牙等贸易成为富庶的强权。绍奎人随雨季和旱季的交替务农、狩猎和捕鱼。

en:
Chono was the language of the nomadic canoe people of the Chiloé, Guaitecas and Chonos archipelagos in southern Chile, hunter-gatherers who were the first identifiable inhabitants of those islands and left many shell middens.

Francisco de Ulloa's expedition met them in 1553, and after a royal decree of 1608 the Spanish of Chiloé turned their southern voyages into slave raids. Jesuits reaching Chiloé in 1609 compiled a grammar and vocabulary, now lost, and missionized groups settled on Guar Island from 1710.

The only surviving text is an eighteenth-century catechism, from which only about twenty words are known with certainty. Chono's classification is unresolved, with parallels to Kawésqar but an unrelated core. After the Spanish depopulation of the archipelagos in the 1740s the Chono merged into the Huilliche and mestizo population, the language disappearing by the early nineteenth century.
zh:
乔诺语是智利南部奇洛埃群岛、瓜伊特卡斯群岛和乔诺斯群岛上的游牧独木舟民族使用的语言；这些渔猎采集者是岛屿最早可辨识的居民，留下了大量贝丘。

1553年，弗朗西斯科·德·乌略亚的探险队接触到他们；1608年西班牙国王颁布法令后，奇洛埃的西班牙人把南下航行变成了掳奴行动。1609年抵达奇洛埃的耶稣会士编写过语法书和词汇表，后来均告散佚；接受传教的乔诺人从1710年起被安置在瓜尔岛。

留存下来的唯一文本是一份18世纪的教理问答，从中能确定的词只有约二十个。乔诺语的谱系没有定论，与卡韦斯卡尔语有相似之处但核心词汇并无亲缘。18世纪40年代西班牙人清空群岛后，乔诺人融入维利切人和混血居民之中，这门语言到19世纪初便不复可闻。

en: Chontal was an extinct, unclassified language spoken in the northern part of what is now the Mexican state of Guerrero during the prehispanic and early colonial periods. In the sixteenth century it was still fairly widely spoken, but Spanish missionaries preached in Nahuatl, the regional lingua franca, and no description of the language survives.
zh: 琼塔尔语是一种已消亡、语系归属不明的语言，前西班牙时代和殖民早期通行于今墨西哥格雷罗州北部。16世纪时仍有相当多的使用者，但西班牙传教士改用当地通用语纳瓦特尔语传教，琼塔尔语没有留下任何语言记录。

en:
Chukotko-Kamchatkan is a small language family of the extreme northeast of Siberia, held together by two distant branches. The Chukotkan branch includes Chukchi and Koryak among others, while the Kamchatkan branch survives only in Itelmen on western Kamchatka. No link to another family has been proven. Its speakers hunted sea mammals on the coast and herded reindeer inland; Chukchi and Koryak share the endonym Luoravetlan, the real people.

Cossacks reached the Kolyma in 1643 and the Anadyr in 1649, founding Anadyrsk. From 1697 Vladimir Atlasov annexed Kamchatka, where Itelmen revolts met mass deportations and forced conversion; by the early 1800s a Russian-Itelmen creole called Kamchadal emerged.

The Chukchi defeated expeditions between 1701 and the 1750s, killing the commander Pavlutsky in 1747. Catherine the Great abandoned Anadyrsk in 1764, switching to tribute and trade fairs. The languages remained oral, carried by song and shamanic tradition.
zh:
楚科奇‑堪察加语是西伯利亚极东北的语系，由两个关系疏远的语支组成。楚科奇语支包括楚科奇语和科里亚克语等，堪察加语支只剩堪察加西部的伊捷尔缅语。它与其他语系的亲缘关系未获证实。使用者沿海猎海兽，内陆牧驯鹿；楚科奇人和科里亚克人共用自称卢奥拉韦特兰，意为真正的人。

哥萨克于1643年抵达科雷马河，1649年抵达阿纳德尔河并建立阿纳德尔堡。1697年起，弗拉基米尔·阿特拉索夫吞并堪察加，伊捷尔缅人的起义遭到大规模驱逐和强制皈依；到19世纪初产生了俄语与伊捷尔缅语混合的堪察达尔克里奥尔语。

楚科奇人在1701年至18世纪50年代击败远征队，1747年击毙俄军指挥官帕夫卢茨基。叶卡捷琳娜大帝于1764年放弃阿纳德尔堡，改用贡赋和贸易集市。这些语言没有文字，靠歌谣和萨满传统相传。

en:
Chumashan is a small language family, with no proven relatives elsewhere, spoken along the central California coast from San Luis Obispo to Malibu, in nearby valleys and on the northern Channel Islands. It may be one of the oldest language families established in California. Six members are recorded, joined by a dialect continuum on the mainland; plank canoes called tomol, adopted in the first millennium, linked the island villages to the coast.

Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo made the first European contact in 1542, but colonization began only in 1772 with Mission San Luis Obispo, followed by other missions, after which the languages came to be known by their names.

Forced resettlement and epidemics shattered the Chumash communities, and in 1824 mission Chumash, joined by Yokuts allies, rose in the largest organized revolt of California's Spanish and Mexican period.
zh:
丘马什语是一个较小的语系，在其他语言中没有已证实的亲属，通行于加利福尼亚中部从圣路易斯奥比斯波到马里布的海岸、附近谷地和北海峡群岛。它可能是加州最古老的本地语系之一。已记录的语言有六种，大陆各方言连成方言连续体；公元第一个千年里出现的木板独木舟托莫尔把岛屿村庄与海岸联系起来。

1542年胡安·罗德里格斯·卡布里略首次与丘马什人接触，但殖民要到1772年圣路易斯奥比斯波传教站建立才开始，随后又有其他传教站，这些语言后来便以传教站的名字为人所知。

强制迁徙和疫病摧毁了丘马什人的社区；1824年，传教站里的丘马什人在约库茨盟友的参与下发动起义，这是加州西班牙和墨西哥统治时期规模最大的有组织反抗。

en:
Church Slavonic is the sacred literary language of the Slavic Eastern Christians, descended from Old Church Slavonic created in the 860s by the brothers Cyril and Methodius for their mission to Great Moravia, where the Gospels and liturgy were translated into Slavic in the new Glagolitic alphabet. Expelled after 885, their disciples carried the tradition to the First Bulgarian Empire; the Preslav and Ohrid schools developed Cyrillic, which became the official script in 893.

By the twelfth century the language had absorbed local vernacular features and split into regional recensions. Printing came early, with the Glagolitic Missale Romanum of 1483 and Cyrillic liturgical books printed in Kraków in 1491.

In Russia the revised Synodal recension of the later seventeenth century served as the high literary language until secular Russian displaced it in the eighteenth century, leaving Church Slavonic to the liturgy.
zh:
教会斯拉夫语是斯拉夫东方基督徒的宗教文学语言，源自古教会斯拉夫语。9世纪60年代，西里尔和美多德兄弟为前往大摩拉维亚传教，以格拉哥里字母把福音书和礼拜典籍译成斯拉夫语。885年传教团被逐后，他们的弟子把这一传统带入第一保加利亚帝国；普雷斯拉夫和奥赫里德两大学派发展出西里尔字母，并于893年成为官方文字。

到12世纪，该语言吸收方言特征，分化为地区校本。1483年印出格拉哥里字母的《罗马弥撒经本》，1491年克拉科夫又印出西里尔字母礼仪书。

在俄罗斯，17世纪后期修订的主教会议校本曾充当高雅文学语言，18世纪世俗俄语兴起后它才退出文坛，只保留在礼拜仪式之中。

en:
Chuukese, formerly also spelled Trukese, is an Austronesian Micronesian language spoken chiefly on the islands of Chuuk Lagoon in the Caroline Islands. It belongs to the Chuukic subgroup, alongside Woleaian and Carolinian. Its speakers descend from Austronesian settlers linked to the Lapita culture, who had established villages on the lagoon's islands by the second and first centuries before Christ; a distinct Chuukese society had taken shape by the fourteenth century.

The Spanish navigator Alvaro de Saavedra made the first recorded European sighting in 1528, and Alonso de Arellano visited the lagoon in 1565. Spain claimed the Carolines, though no real colonial administration reached Chuuk in this era.

The language remained unwritten, passed on orally between generations. It allows word-initial doubled consonants, retained from the common ancestor of the western Micronesian languages while most sister languages lost them.
zh:
楚克语旧称特鲁克语，是南岛语系密克罗尼西亚语族的语言，主要通行于加罗林群岛楚克礁湖的各岛屿。它属于楚克语支，与沃莱艾语、加罗林语等近亲语言同支。楚克人的先民是与拉皮塔文化有关的南岛语移民，在公元前2世纪至前1世纪已在礁湖各岛建立村落；到14世纪，楚克社会已经形成。

1528年，西班牙航海家阿尔瓦罗·德·萨韦德拉首次留下欧洲人望见这些岛屿的记录，1565年阿隆索·德·阿雷利亚诺又到访礁湖。西班牙宣称占有加罗林群岛，但这一时期并没有真正的殖民管理延伸到楚克。

楚克语始终没有文字，靠世代口耳相传。它允许词首出现叠辅音，这一特点继承自西密克罗尼西亚诸语言的共同祖先，而多数姊妹语言后来都失去了它。

en: Ciguayo was the language of the Samaná Peninsula of Hispaniola, in the present-day Dominican Republic, at the time of the Spanish Conquest. Its speakers seem to have predated the agricultural Taíno who occupied most of the island. The tongue was already moribund at contact and died out within a century, remembered only through a few recorded words.
zh: 西瓜约语是西班牙征服时期伊斯帕尼奥拉岛萨马纳半岛（今多米尼加共和国境内）的语言，使用者似乎早于占据岛上大部、从事农业的泰诺人。该语言在欧洲人到来时已濒临消亡，一个世纪内灭绝，仅留下少数有记录的词语。

en:
Circassian is the main branch of the Northwest Caucasian language family, native to Circassia on the north-eastern Black Sea coast and spoken by a people who call themselves Adyghe. It exists in two closely related, mutually intelligible literary standards, Adyghe or West Circassian and Kabardian or East Circassian. Like its relatives it is an ergative language with a large consonant inventory and an elaborate verbal system.

Circassian had no native orthography before the nineteenth century, and Ottoman Turkish served as its literary medium. From the 1820s scholars such as the Kabardian poet Nogma devised Arabic-based alphabets, and in 1830 Nogma and the Russian orientalist Gratsilevsky produced a Cyrillic version, opening the way to writing down the spoken tribal dialects.
zh:
切尔克斯语是西北高加索语系的主要分支，母语区在黑海东北岸的切尔克西亚，使用者自称阿迪格人。它分为关系密切、彼此可互通的两种书面标准：阿迪格语（西切尔克斯语）和卡巴尔达语（东切尔克斯语）。与亲属语言一样，切尔克斯语属作格语言，辅音众多，动词系统繁复。

19世纪以前它没有本族文字，书面场合使用奥斯曼土耳其语。19世纪20年代起，卡巴尔达诗人诺格马等学者设计了以阿拉伯字母为基础的文字，1830年诺格马又与俄国东方学家格拉齐列夫斯基制成西里尔字母版本，为各部落方言的书面化开辟了道路。

en:
Kunza, also called Likanantaí or Atacameño, is the extinct language of the Atacama people, whose self-name Likan Antay underlies the Licanantay label. It was spoken across the Atacama Desert and neighbouring altiplano. A polysynthetic tongue with a decimal number system, it is treated as a language isolate.

Atacameño culture grew in desert oases from about the fifth century, came under Tiwanaku influence, and early in the fifteenth century was conquered by the Inca emperor Topa Inca Yupanqui, who brought the sun cult and Inca administration. Diego de Almagro's Spaniards reached the area in 1536 and it was annexed in 1557.

In the eighteenth century Atacameño fighters such as Tomás Paniri joined the Andean risings of Túpac Amaru II and Túpac Katari. Kunza remained in daily use into the nineteenth century before giving way to Spanish, preserved in wordlists and place names.
zh:
昆萨语又称利坎安泰语或阿塔卡梅尼奥语，是阿塔卡马人的语言，已消亡；阿塔卡马人自称利坎·安泰，利坎安泰一名即由此而来。它曾通行于阿塔卡马沙漠及邻近高原，是采用十进位计数的多式综合语，被视为孤立语言。

阿塔卡梅尼奥文化约从5世纪起在沙漠绿洲发展，曾受蒂亚瓦纳科影响，15世纪初被印加皇帝图帕克·印卡·尤潘基征服，太阳神崇拜和印加行政制度随之传入。1536年阿尔马格罗率领的西班牙人抵达此地，1557年该地区被吞并。

18世纪，托马斯·帕尼里等阿塔卡马战士加入了图帕克·阿马鲁二世和图帕克·卡塔里领导的安第斯起义。昆萨语作为日常语言存续到19世纪，随后被西班牙语取代，主要靠词表和地名保存下来。

en:
Classical Chinese is the literary form of Chinese established around 500 BCE by the classics of Confucius and the Daoist masters. Written in a terse style in which nearly every character stands for an independent word, its grammar was imitated by scholars for millennia as Literary Chinese, the standard medium of government, history, philosophy and poetry across China until the early twentieth century.

From the second century CE it spread to Korea, Japan, Vietnam and the Ryukyu Islands, where it long served as the language of administration, Buddhism and elite learning. The written language kept its ancient grammar while spoken Chinese evolved, so that mastering it required years of formal schooling.
zh:
文言文是以公元前5世纪先秦典籍为典范确立的汉语书面语，特点是一字通常代表一个独立的词，行文简练。此后两千多年间，历代文人模仿其语法写作，形成古文传统，使文言成为中国官方文书、史学、哲学和诗歌的标准载体，直到20世纪初才被白话文取代。

从2世纪起，文言传入朝鲜、日本、越南和琉球，长期充当当地行政、佛教与精英教育的书面语。文言保留古代语法，与不断演变的口语差距日深，须经多年专门教育才能掌握。

en:
Coahuilteco, also called Pakawa, was an indigenous language of southern Texas and northeastern Mexico, spoken by nomadic Coahuilteco bands across Coahuila, Nuevo Leon and Tamaulipas. It is usually treated as a language isolate, since the wider Coahuiltecan family once proposed for many of the region's poorly recorded tongues has never been proven.

After Spanish missionaries founded the mission of San Antonio de Valero at San Antonio in 1718, Coahuilteco served as a lingua franca among the diverse native groups settled there, and the priests learned and recorded it. Most neighboring languages vanished with their peoples between the sixteenth and nineteenth centuries and were never written down.
zh:
科阿韦尔特科语又称帕卡瓦语，曾通行于得克萨斯南部和墨西哥东北部，是游徙于科阿韦拉、新莱昂和塔毛利帕斯一带的科阿韦尔特科游牧群体的语言。它通常被视为孤立语言：学者曾把该地区许多记录稀少的语言归入更大的科阿韦尔特科语系，但这一划分始终未能证实。

1718年西班牙传教士在圣安东尼奥建立巴莱罗传教站后，科阿韦尔特科语成为定居于此的各族原住民的通用语，传教士也学习并记录了它。邻近地区的大多数语言随其族群在16至19世纪间消亡，从未留下记录。

en:
Coptic is the final stage of ancient Egyptian, spoken in Egypt from the third century AD and written in Greek letters supplemented by seven Demotic signs. Sahidic became the literary standard around 325–800, carrying Bible translations and Gnostic codices at Nag Hammadi. Bohairic displaced it as the Coptic Church's liturgical tongue from the ninth century.

After the Arab conquest of the 640s, the caliph Abd al-Malik imposed Arabic as the sole administrative language around 700. Coptic remained village speech until the tenth century, when persecution ordered by the caliph al-Hakim drove it out of schools, streets and homes.

The last known Coptic literary work was composed in the late 1300s; the language survived as a minority spoken tongue into the 1600s, lingering longer in Upper Egyptian hamlets. It lived on in Coptic Orthodox Bohairic liturgy and left a substratum in Egyptian Arabic vocabulary and grammar.
zh:
科普特语是古埃及语的最后阶段，自公元3世纪起通行于埃及，书写采用希腊字母，补上七个世俗体符号。萨伊迪方言约在325—800年间成为文学标准，圣经译本和拿戈玛第的诺斯替教典籍都用它写成。布海拉方言从9世纪起取而代之，成为科普特教会的礼仪用语。

7世纪40年代阿拉伯征服后，哈里发阿卜杜勒‑马立克约700年下令阿拉伯语成为唯一行政语言。直到10世纪，科普特语仍是村庄的日常语言，此后哈里发哈基姆发起迫害，禁止在学校、街道和家中使用科普特语。

已知最后一部科普特语文学作品创作于14世纪末，作为少数人口语的科普特语延续到17世纪，在上埃及村落里留存的时间可能更久。科普特语借正教会的布海拉方言礼仪存续，并在埃及阿拉伯语的词汇和语法里留下底层痕迹。

en:
Corachol, also called Cora-Huichol or Coran, is a branch of the Uto-Aztecan family of west-central Mexico. Its surviving languages are Huichol, spoken by the Wixaritari, and Cora, spoken by the Nayeri. Both stand closest to the Nahuan languages.

The Wixaritari trace their origins to the Guachichil country of San Luis Potosi and took refuge among the Tepecano in the Bolanos Canyon, rising with them against the Spanish in 1592 and 1702. The Cora kept missionaries out of their mountains: a Spanish expedition failed in 1716, and only in 1722 did a large force bring them under colonial rule.

The Mixton War of 1540 to 1542 saw the Caxcanes and their allies try in vain to drive back the Spaniards of Nueva Galicia. The long Chichimeca War followed; the scattered Zacateco, Guachichil and kindred bands left little more than wordlists.
zh:
科拉乔尔语又称科拉-惠乔尔语或科兰语，是墨西哥中西部犹他-阿兹特克语系的一个语支。现存的语言有维萨里塔里人的惠乔尔语，以及纳亚里人的科拉语。两者与纳瓦语支最为接近。

维萨里塔里人自认源自圣路易斯波托西的瓦奇奇尔地区，后来到博拉尼奥斯峡谷的特佩卡诺人中避难，并于1592年和1702年与他们联合反抗西班牙人。科拉人把传教士挡在山外：1716年西班牙远征无功而返，直到1722年大军压境才将其纳入殖民统治。

此前的1540—1542年米克斯顿战争中，卡克斯卡人及其盟友试图把新加利西亚的西班牙人逐走却终归失败。随后又是漫长的奇奇梅卡战争；流散的萨卡特科、瓦奇奇尔等群体只留下了零星的词汇表。

en:
Cree, or Cree–Montagnais–Naskapi, stretches from Labrador and the Gulf of Saint Lawrence through James Bay to Alberta. Its nine western and eastern groups are distinguished chiefly by their different reflexes of one Proto-Algonquian sound.

It grew from a Proto-Algonquian dialect whose speakers left the Great Lakes homeland two and a half to three thousand years ago and split into eastern and western branches around James Bay. A polysynthetic language, Cree folds subject and object into the verb and divides nouns into animate and inanimate genders.

After 1670, Cree families armed through the fur trade expanded west from James Bay across the boreal forest and onto the plains, and long contact with French and Ojibwe speakers gave rise to the mixed languages Michif and Oji-Cree.
zh:
克里语又称克里—蒙塔格奈—纳斯卡皮语，从拉布拉多和圣劳伦斯湾经詹姆斯湾延伸到艾伯塔。它分为东西九支，最显著的区别是对原始阿尔冈昆语同一个音的不同演变。

它源自原始阿尔冈昆语的一种方言，其使用者在两千五百至三千年前离开五大湖故土，在詹姆斯湾一带分成东西两支。克里语是多式综合语，主语和宾语都折进动词之中，名词分有生命与无生命两类。

1670年以后，借助毛皮贸易获得火器的克里人从詹姆斯湾向西扩张，穿过北方针叶林直达平原；长期与法国人和奥吉布瓦人接触，又催生了米奇夫语和奥吉克里语等混合语言。

official_raw.en: A vast collection of Central Algonquian dialects spoken from Newfoundland to Alberta.
official_raw.zh: 从纽芬兰到艾伯塔使用的大量中阿尔冈昆方言的集合。

en:
Cuicas was the language of the Cuica people, one of the two main branches of the Timoto–Cuica complex of the Venezuelan Andes, whose villages ran from Humocaro to Jajó. Whether Cuicas and the closely related Timote speech were one language or two is unsettled; together they had a decimal counting system and no demonstrated link to the surrounding Arawakan, Cariban or Chibchan families.

Its speakers built stone-faced irrigated terraces and permanent villages of stone and timber houses, grew potatoes, ullucos and maize, and traded cacao beans as currency with Arawak and Carib neighbours.

The Cuicas received the Spaniards peaceably, unlike the more warlike Timotes; the foundation of Mérida in 1558 anchored colonial rule in their mountains. Their communities were gradually absorbed into Spanish-speaking society, and the language survived only in remote highland villages, recorded only in fragmentary word lists.
zh:
奎卡斯语是奎卡人的语言。奎卡人是委内瑞拉安第斯山区蒂莫特—奎卡族群的两大支系之一，村落从乌莫卡罗延伸到哈霍。奎卡斯语与亲缘极近的蒂莫特语究竟是一种语言还是两种，仍无定论；两者采用十进位计数，与周围的阿拉瓦克、加勒比、奇布查诸语系都没有经证实的亲缘关系。

他们修筑石砌灌溉梯田和永久性石木房屋村落，种植马铃薯、乌卢库和玉米，还用可可豆当货币，与阿拉瓦克和加勒比邻族贸易。

奎卡人友善地接待了西班牙人，不像更好战的蒂莫特人；1558年梅里达建城，把殖民统治锚定在他们山区的腹地。他们的村社逐渐被吸纳进西班牙语社会，奎卡斯语只在偏远高地村落里留存，记录只有零碎的词表。

en:
Cuitlatec is an extinct language isolate, spoken along the Pacific coast and Balsas river country of Guerrero, a land the Aztecs called Cuitlatecapan. Its Nahuatl name comes from cuitlatl, a vulgar word for excrement; the people called themselves a'nelgai.

They may have been heirs of the Mezcala culture. In the late Postclassic their coastal polity centered on Mexcaltepec, while the Balsas communities fell under the Purepecha Empire and the rest were subdued by Aztec campaigns including Itzcoatl's in the 1430s.

The Cuitlatec grew maize, cacao and cotton and resisted the Spaniards for more than sixty years. Epidemics emptied their towns, and Mexcaltepec was abandoned by 1580. The Relacion de Ajuchitlan of 1579 records place names such as Tithichuc umo, meaning water with flowers, and the priest Martin de Espinosa y Monzon compiled a grammar at Ajuchitlan. Wordlists and grammar sketches preserve the language.
zh:
奎特拉特克语是一门已消亡的孤立语，曾通行于格雷罗的太平洋沿岸和巴尔萨斯河流域，阿兹特克人把那片土地称作奎特拉特卡潘。它的纳瓦特尔语外来名源自 cuitlatl，俗意为粪便，当地人自称 a'nelgai。

他们可能是梅斯卡拉文化的后继者；后古典期晚期，沿海政权以梅斯卡尔特佩克为中心，巴尔萨斯盆地的社群被普雷佩查帝国征服，其余部分在15世纪30年代伊茨科阿特尔等阿兹特克战事中被降服。

奎特拉特克人种植玉米、可可和棉花，对西班牙人的武装抵抗持续了六十多年。瘟疫使城镇空虚，梅斯卡尔特佩克在1580年前遭废弃。1579年的《阿胡奇特兰记述》记下了 Tithichuc umo（意为花之水）等地名，神父马丁·德·埃斯皮诺萨·伊·蒙松还在阿胡奇特兰编写语法。词汇表和语法纲要保存了这门语言。

en:
Culli, also called Ilinga, was the language of the Andean highlands of northern Peru. It was the tongue of at least three pre-Inca polities, including Huamachuco, whose famous oracle of the thunder god Catequil at Namanchugo was later wrecked by Atahualpa and Spanish priests.

The Incas conquered the region around 1470 and installed mitmaq settlers, and in 1553 Augustinian missionaries founded the new town of Huamachuco on the Inca settlement. Poorly recorded, Culli survives mainly in word lists, including an eighteenth-century manuscript compiled by Bishop Martínez Compañón, and in loanwords and place names such as Huamachuco, whose chuco means land. Its wider relationships remain undetermined, and Spanish gradually replaced it.
zh:
库利语亦称伊林加语，曾通行于秘鲁北部的安第斯高原。它至少是三个前印加政权的语言，其中瓦马丘科境内有雷神卡特基尔的著名神谕所纳曼丘戈，后来被阿塔瓦尔帕和西班牙神父捣毁。

印加人约在1470年征服此地，迁入米特马克移民；1553年，奥古斯丁会传教士在印加聚落的基础上建立了新的瓦马丘科城。库利语记录很少，主要靠词汇表留存，其中包括马丁内斯·康帕尼翁主教在18世纪汇编的手稿，另外还残留在借词和地名里，如瓦马丘科一名中的“丘科”意为“土地”。它与其他语言的亲缘关系没有定论，后来逐渐被西班牙语取代。

en:
Itoto Majun, long recorded in Spanish sources as Cumanagoto or Chaima, is a Cariban language of the Venezuelan coast, once heard from the Paria Peninsula westward to the Lake of Valencia. Its speakers called it choto maimuru, the tongue of the people; colonial writers found that peoples with separate names understood one another with only dialectal differences.

The Spanish built missions among them in the seventeenth century: the Province of New Catalonia, founded in 1633 and also called the Province of the Cumanagotos, was merged into New Andalusia in 1654.

Franciscan friars studied the language for preaching, Manuel de Yangües completing a grammar in 1663 and Francisco de Tauste printing his grammar and vocabulary in 1680. The language was long one of the leading Indigenous languages of the Cumaná region.
zh:
库马纳语本名伊托托·马洪，在西班牙文献中又常记作库马纳戈托语或查伊马语，是委内瑞拉沿海的加勒比语族语言，昔日通行于帕里亚半岛向西直到巴伦西亚湖一带。使用者称其语言为乔托·迈穆鲁，意为“人的语言”；殖民时代的记载表明，名称各异的族群彼此能通话，只有方言差别。

17世纪西班牙人在他们中间建立传教区：1633年设立、别称“库马纳戈托省”的新加泰罗尼亚省于1654年并入新安达卢西亚省。

方济各会修士为布道而研习这种语言，曼努埃尔·德·扬格斯于1663年写成语法，弗朗西斯科·德·陶斯特于1680年刊行语法与词汇。这种语言长期是库马纳地区主要的原住民语言之一。

en:
Czechoslovak is the West Slavic dialect continuum of Bohemia, Moravia and Slovakia, flanked by its cousin Sorbian in Lusatia. Its dialects emerged from common West Slavic between the 900s and 1100s, after the Magyar invasion of the 890s broke up the Great Moravian realm.

Czech and Slovak first appear in writing in the 1200s and 1300s; by the late 1300s Czech was used in official documents. The Kralice Bible, printed in Moravia between 1579 and 1593, fixed the model for standard Czech. In 1615 the Bohemian diet tried to make Czech the kingdom's sole official language, only for the defeat of the Bohemian Revolt to open an age of German dominance.

Slovak, long written in Czech forms, received a written standard in the nineteenth century through Ludovit Stur's codification. Sorbian was pressed back by German settlement and official discrimination from the 1200s onward, and Reformation Bible translations gave it literary form.
zh:
捷克斯洛伐克语是波希米亚、摩拉维亚和斯洛伐克的西斯拉夫方言连续体，其近亲还有卢萨蒂亚的索布语。890年代马扎尔人入侵、大摩拉维亚国解体之后，各方言在10—12世纪从共同西斯拉夫语中分化出来。

捷克语和斯洛伐克语最早的书面材料出现在13—14世纪，到14世纪末捷克语已用于官方文书。1579—1593年在摩拉维亚印行的《克拉利采圣经》奠定了标准捷克语的范式。1615年波希米亚议会试图把捷克语定为王国唯一官方语言，但波希米亚起义失败后，德意志语言进入主导时代。

长期借用捷克语书面形式的斯洛伐克语，到19世纪才经卢多维特·什图尔规范，有了自己的书面标准。索布语自13世纪起受到德意志移民和官方歧视的挤压，宗教改革时期的圣经译本赋予了它文学形态。

en:
Dagan, also called the Meneao Range languages, is a small family of the Southeast Papuan branch of the Trans-New Guinea phylum, spoken in the Meneao Range on the Bird's Tail, the southeastern peninsula of New Guinea. These are the easternmost Papuan, or non-Austronesian, languages on the New Guinea mainland.

Its members include Daga, also known as Dimuga, Maiwa, Ginuman and Umanakaina, spoken by mountain villages split between the Milne Bay and Central districts. The kinship between them is loose: Ginuman and Umanakaina share only about a quarter of their vocabulary.

When the Spanish navigator Yñigo Ortiz de Retez coined the name New Guinea in 1545, and when Torres sailed the island's southern waters in 1606, these remote inland valleys remained beyond the reach of the coastal expeditions.
zh:
达甘语又称梅内奥岭诸语言，是跨新几内亚语系东南巴布亚语支下的一个小语族，通行于新几内亚“鸟尾”东南半岛的梅内奥岭山区。它们是新几内亚大陆上位置最靠东的巴布亚诸语言，即非南岛语。

其成员包括又称迪穆加语的达加语、迈瓦语、吉努曼语和乌马纳凯纳语，由米尔恩湾省与中央省分界一带的山村居民使用。各语言之间的亲缘相当松散：吉努曼语和乌马纳凯纳语的词汇重合度只有四分之一左右。

1545年西班牙航海家伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯为新几内亚岛命名时，以及1606年托雷斯驶过该岛南部海域时，这些偏远的内陆山谷都在沿海探险队的足迹之外。

en:
Dagestanian groups the languages of the Nakh-Daghestanian, or Northeast Caucasian, family, native to the eastern Caucasus, from Dagestan, Chechnya and Ingushetia into northern Azerbaijan. Its members include Chechen and Ingush in the Nakh branch and Avar, Dargwa, Lak and Lezgin among the Dagestanian branches. Isolated by highland valleys, they diverged sharply and are noted for elaborate consonants and large case systems.

The earliest written member was Caucasian Albanian, whose fifty-two-letter alphabet was created in the early 400s for the church of Caucasian Albania and whose line survives in Udi. After that tradition died out, Armenian and Georgian served as literary media.

Avar was occasionally written in the Georgian alphabet from the 1300s, and Perso-Arabic ajam glosses appeared from the 1400s. Avar acted as the highlands' lingua franca beside the literary idioms of Lak, Dargwa and Lezgin.
zh:
达吉斯坦语指纳赫—达吉斯坦语系，即东北高加索语系的诸语言，分布于东高加索的达吉斯坦、车臣、印古什直至阿塞拜疆北部。纳赫一支有车臣语和印古什语，达吉斯坦各支则有阿瓦尔语、达尔格瓦语、拉克语和列兹金语。高山峡谷的阻隔使这些语言分化显著，以繁复的辅音和庞大的格系统著称。

该语系最早的书面成员是高加索阿尔巴尼亚语：5世纪初有人为高加索阿尔巴尼亚教会创制了含五十二个字母的文字，其支系遗存于乌迪语。这一传统消亡后，书面场合改用亚美尼亚语和格鲁吉亚语。

14世纪起阿瓦尔语偶有用格鲁吉亚字母拼写者，15世纪起又出现波斯—阿拉伯字母的阿贾姆注释。阿瓦尔语是高地的通用语，与拉克语、达尔格瓦语和列兹金语的书面传统并存。

en:
The Daju languages form a branch of the Eastern Sudanic group within the Nilo-Saharan family, spoken in scattered pockets across Darfur and Kordofan in Sudan and Wadai in Chad. They fall into western and eastern branches.

Daju tradition traces the people to the Nile valley, from which they moved west after the Aksumite sack of Meroe in the fourth century; by the twelfth century a Daju kingdom had arisen in the Marrah Mountains of Darfur. About 1400 the Egyptian writer al-Maqrizi described this kingdom, which he called Taju, as powerful and lying between Kanem and the Nile states.

In the fourteenth century the Tunjur overran the Daju dynasty: the king fled west to Dar Sila in Chad with part of his people, while other groups migrated east into Kordofan, leaving the related languages separated in isolated pockets.
zh:
达朱语是尼罗—撒哈拉语系东苏丹语族的一个分支，分布在苏丹的达尔富尔和科尔多凡以及乍得的瓦达伊一带。它分为西支和东支。

达朱人的传说称其祖先来自尼罗河谷，在4世纪阿克苏姆军队洗劫麦罗埃后西迁；到12世纪，达朱王国在达尔富尔的马拉山脉兴起。1400年前后，埃及作家马克利齐把这个他称为塔朱的王国描述为夹在卡涅姆与尼罗河诸王国之间的强国。

14世纪，通朱尔人攻灭达朱王朝：国王率部分部众西逃乍得的达尔西拉，另一些群体东迁科尔多凡，使这些彼此亲缘的语言分散在孤立地区。

en:
Dakhni, also called Deccani, is an Indo-Aryan language of the Deccan plateau, born from Hindustani speech carried south from Delhi. In 1327 Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq moved his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad; after the Bahmani Sultanate was founded in 1347 the transplanted dialect became the region's lingua franca and took its name from the Deccan.

Persian supplied learned vocabulary, while contact with Marathi, Kannada and Telugu added local words and shaped its sounds. Sufi preachers spread it, and the earliest surviving manuscript, Kadam Rao Padam Rao, was composed around Bidar.

From the early sixteenth century the sultanates of Bijapur and Golconda made Dakhni a literary language: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah wrote secular poetry in it and Ibrahim Adil Shah II composed his Book of the Nine Rasas in Dakhni. This tradition later fed the rise of standard Urdu.
zh:
德干语又称德卡尼语，是德干高原的一支印度—雅利安语言，源自从德里南传的印度斯坦语。1327年，苏丹穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克把首都从德里迁往道拉塔巴德；1347年巴赫曼尼苏丹国建立后，这种方言成为当地的通用语，并按德干之地得名。

波斯语为它提供文雅词汇，与马拉地语、卡纳达语和泰卢固语接触又带来借词并改变了语音。苏菲派教士传播德干语，现存最早的手抄本《卡达姆·拉奥·帕达姆·拉奥》成书于比达尔一带。

16世纪初起，比贾布尔和戈尔康达苏丹国将它培育成文学语言：穆罕默德·库利·库特布沙赫用它写世俗诗歌，易卜拉欣·阿迪勒沙赫二世用德干语写成《九情之书》。这一传统后来滋养了标准乌尔都语的兴起。

en:
Dakota, self-designated Dakhótiyapi, is the eastern member of the Dakota-Lakota continuum within the Siouan-Catawban family, spoken by the Santee and Yankton-Yanktonai divisions of the Seven Council Fires, commonly called the Sioux. It is mutually intelligible with Lakota, while Assiniboine and Stoney form the related Nakota speech. The word Dakota means ally or friend.

Before the seventeenth century the Santee lived around Lake Superior, but wars with the French-armed Ojibwe through the 1700s pushed them west into Minnesota and then onto the Great Plains, where they took up horses and the bison hunt.

Dakota pictographs recorded winter counts, calendars of yearly events painted on hides. John Marsh compiled the first dictionary in 1827, and from 1836 the Pond brothers, Stephen Riggs and Thomas Williamson devised a Latin-based orthography for translating hymns and scripture.
zh:
达科他语自称达科蒂亚皮语，是苏—卡托巴语系达科他—拉科塔语连续体的东部成员，由七堆火联盟（通称苏人）中的桑蒂人和扬克顿—扬克托奈人使用。它与拉科塔语可以互通，阿西尼博因语和斯托尼语则构成相近的纳科塔语。达科他一词意为盟友或朋友。

17世纪以前，桑蒂人住在苏必利尔湖一带；18世纪，与持有法式火枪的奥吉布瓦人的战争把他们向西赶入明尼苏达，继而推进到大平原，他们在那里改用马匹猎捕野牛。

达科他语的图画文字用于在兽皮上绘制逐年记事的冬历。1827年，约翰·马什编成第一部词典；1836年起，庞德兄弟、斯蒂芬·里格斯和托马斯·威廉姆森制定了拉丁字母拼写法，用于翻译赞美诗和经文。

en:
Daly is the name given to the cluster of Indigenous Australian languages spoken around the Daly River and the adjacent coast of the Northern Territory, among them Murrinh-Patha, Marrithiyel and Kungarakany. In 1788, these were the sole languages of the Daly river country.

Classed among the non-Pama–Nyungan languages, they share vocabulary and grammar through long contact rather than proven common descent, and have been treated as one family or as four or five separate families and isolates. Murrinh-Patha, whose name means ‘good language’, is the best documented of the group, with a Latin orthography and intricate verb morphology.
zh:
戴利语是对北领地戴利河及邻近沿海一带原住民诸语言的统称，包括穆林帕塔语、马里蒂耶尔语和昆加拉卡尼语。1788年，它们还是戴利河流域唯一的语言。

它们属于非帕马—恩永甘语言，彼此因长期接触而在词汇和语法上多有共通之处，学者或将其视为一个语族，或拆成四五个独立语族和孤立语言。穆林帕塔语的名字意为“好的语言”，在这组语言中记录最充分，采用拉丁字母书写，动词形态繁复。

en:
The Danao languages form a subgroup of the Central Philippine branch of the Austronesian family, spoken in the lake and river basins of Mindanao in the southern Philippines. Its members are Maranao around Lake Lanao, Maguindanaon in the Cotabato lowlands and the Pulangi basin, and Iranun on the coasts between them.

With the coming of Islam in the early sixteenth century their speakers adopted the Perso-Arabic Jawi script, and Maguindanaon became the language of the Sultanate of Maguindanao, which dominated western Mindanao until Spanish pressure wore it down in the nineteenth century.

Iranun sailors raided the Sulu and Celebes seas in the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries. Under Spanish rule the Latin alphabet gradually displaced Jawi, and the British captain Thomas Forrest published a vocabulary of the Maguindanao tongue in 1779.
zh:
达瑙语是南岛语系菲律宾语支下的一组语言，通行于菲律宾南部棉兰老岛的湖泊与河流流域，包括拉瑙湖一带的马拉瑙语、哥打巴托低地和普兰吉河流域的马京达瑙语，以及两者之间沿海的伊拉农语。

16世纪初伊斯兰教传入后，当地居民改用波斯—阿拉伯字母系统的爪夷文书写，马京达瑙语也成为马京达瑙苏丹国的语言；该苏丹国曾支配棉兰老岛西部，直到19世纪在西班牙人的压力下逐渐衰落。

18至19世纪初，伊拉农水手在苏禄海和苏拉威西海劫掠。西班牙统治时期，拉丁字母逐渐取代爪夷文，英国船长托马斯·福里斯特于1779年出版了一部马京达瑙语词汇表。

en:
Dayak denotes the Land Dayak languages, the Malayo-Polynesian tongues of the Bidayuh or Land Dayaks of north-western Borneo, around Kuching and Serian in southern Sarawak and across the border in West Kalimantan. Their dialects, including Bukar-Sadong, differ so greatly from village to village that Malay has long served as their common language.

The word Dayak comes from Bruneian and Melanau speech, where it meant the interior or upstream people, and Bidayuh itself means inhabitants of the land.

As Brunei built its sultanate from 1368 and stretched its power along the Borneo coasts, the Bidayuh kept to inland river villages, practising rice farming and an animist paddy-spirit religion with harvest rites. The Bukar preserved the custom of laying out their dead on platforms and hanging trees.
zh:
达雅语指陆地达雅语，即婆罗洲西北部比达友人（陆地达雅人）使用的马来—波利尼西亚语言，分布在沙捞越南部的古晋、西连一带，以及边境另一侧的西加里曼丹。它的方言包括布卡尔—萨东语，村与村之间差异很大，马来语长期充当共同语。

达雅一词来自文莱语和梅拉瑙语，意为内陆或上游之人，比达友则意为土地上的居民。

文莱自1368年建立苏丹国并把势力伸展到婆罗洲沿海后，比达友人仍固守内陆河畔村落，种植水稻，信奉以稻灵为核心的万物有灵信仰并举行丰收祭仪。布卡尔人还保留把死者安放在架台和悬树上的葬俗。

en:
Dhegiha is the western Siouan branch comprising Kansa-Osage, Omaha-Ponca and Quapaw; its name means those who dwell here. Around 1600 its speakers still formed one Woodland group in the lower Ohio River valley.

Haudenosaunee pressure in the Beaver Wars drove them west of the Mississippi, where they split into tribes. The Quapaw, or downstream people, settled the mouth of the Arkansas River, where Jacques Marquette met them in 1673; the French rendered their Illini name as Arkansas. Other groups included the Osage on the Missouri and the Omaha.

The Omaha became the first Northern Plains horse people about 1770, and their Big Village, Ton-wa-tonga, dominated the upper Missouri fur trade until smallpox killed about a third of them around 1800, including Chief Blackbird. By then the Osage dominated the country between the Missouri and Red rivers, while the Quapaw were forced out of Arkansas Territory in 1834.
zh:
德吉哈语是苏语族的西部分支，包括坎萨—奥塞奇语、奥马哈—蓬卡语和夸保语；德吉哈一名意为居住于此的人。1600年前后，说这些语言的人还是俄亥俄河下游谷地的一个林地民族群体。

海狸战争中霍德诺索尼人的逼迫把他们赶过密西西比河，分裂为各支。自称下游人的夸保人定居阿肯色河河口，1673年雅克·马凯特在那里见到他们，法国人把伊利尼语对他们的称呼转写成阿肯色。其他各支包括密苏里河畔的奥塞奇人和奥马哈人。

约1770年，奥马哈人成为北部平原最早的骑马民族，其大村庄通瓦通加主导密苏里河上游毛皮贸易，直到约1800年天花夺去约三分之一人口，酋长布莱克伯德也未能幸免。此时奥塞奇人已称霸密苏里河与雷德河之间，而夸保人于1834年被逐出阿肯色领地。

en:
Dinka, called Thuɔŋjäŋ by its speakers, is a Western Nilotic language of the Nilo-Saharan family, spoken along the White Nile and around the Sudd swamps. It is a chain of largely mutually intelligible dialects whose grammar depends on tone and vowel quality; its closest relative is Nuer.

The Dinka once lived in the Gezira under the Nubian kingdom of Alodia, from which the language took Nubian vocabulary. When Alodia crumbled from the thirteenth century they began moving south, and the drift continued from the fifteenth to the eighteenth century after the Funj built their sultanate at Soba in 1504, as Nilotic groups competed for pasture and cattle.

The Egyptian conquest of the Funj realm in 1821 opened the White Nile to traders and slave raiders, bringing the Dinka and their Nuer kinsmen into a harsher frontier on the edge of Egyptian Sudan.
zh:
丁卡语自称通江语（Thuɔŋjäŋ），属尼罗—撒哈拉语系西尼罗特语支，在白尼罗河与苏德沼泽一带使用。它是一条大多可互通的方言链，语法依赖声调和元音音质；最近的亲属是努埃尔语。

丁卡人曾居住在杰济拉，臣属努比亚人的阿洛迪亚王国，丁卡语也因此吸收了努比亚语词汇。13世纪阿洛迪亚崩溃后他们开始南迁，1504年丰吉人在索巴建立苏丹国，此后从15世纪到18世纪迁徙仍在继续，尼罗特诸群体为牧场和牛群彼此竞争。

1821年埃及攻灭丰吉政权，白尼罗河向商队和猎奴者敞开，丁卡人和与他们同源的努埃尔人被推入埃及苏丹边缘更严酷的新边疆。

en:
The Djeragan, or Jarragan, languages are a small non-Pama Nyungan family of the East Kimberley in northern Western Australia, held between Halls Creek and Kununurra, including the Ord River and the Bungle Bungle Range. Their name comes from jarrag, the Gija word for language.

The family comprises three languages in two groups: Gija stands alone, while Miriwoong and Gajirrawoong form the second group, so close that some scholars treat them as one language; a fourth tongue, Doolboong, is too poorly recorded to place with certainty. When Dutch mariners made the first recorded European landing in Australia in 1606, the Djeragan languages were unwritten and sustained by oral tradition.
zh:
杰拉甘诸语言，又称贾拉甘诸语言，是西澳大利亚东部金伯利地区的一个小型非帕马‑尼永加语系，分布在霍尔兹克里克至库努纳拉之间，包括奥德河与邦格尔邦格尔山脉一带。它的名字来自基贾语中表示语言的贾拉格一词。

该语系的三种语言分为两组：基贾语自成一组，米里翁语和加吉拉翁语组成另一组，二者关系极近，有学者视为一种语言；第四种多尔布翁语记录太少，归属尚不能确定。1606年荷兰航海者首次有记载地登陆澳大利亚时，杰拉甘诸语言还没有文字，依靠口耳相传。

en:
The Dogon languages form a small family of about a dozen languages spoken by the Dogon people along the Bandiagara Escarpment south of the Niger bend in central Mali, with some speakers in Burkina Faso. Their place within the proposed Niger-Congo family is uncertain, and they are often treated as an independent branch; the nearby Bangime language is regarded as an isolate.

They are tonal languages with a subject-object-verb word order, and the varieties of the escarpment and the plains are often mutually unintelligible. From around the eleventh century the Dogon withdrew from Muslim-ruled lands into the defensible cliff country, and by the 1400s they had reached the Sanga region; their speech preserves the divisions of these migrant groups.
zh:
多贡语是由十几种语言组成的小语支，由马里中部尼日尔河河湾以南班迪亚加拉悬崖一带的多贡人使用，布基纳法索也有分布。它在尼日尔—刚果语系中的归属尚无定论，常被视为独立语支；邻近的班吉梅语则被归为孤立语言。

多贡诸语为声调语言，语序为主宾动，悬崖区与平原区的方言彼此往往不能互通。约从11世纪起，多贡人为躲避穆斯林政权的统治，退守到易守难攻的悬崖地带，到15世纪已抵达桑加地区，语言也保留了这些移民群体之间的分野。

en:
Drehu, whose speakers call it qene drehu and which was long known to outsiders as Dehu or Lifou, is a Kanak language of the Loyalty Islands subgroup of Oceanic Austronesian, spoken chiefly on Lifou Island east of Grande Terre.

Its ancestors were the Lapita seafarers who carried Proto-Oceanic through Island Melanesia from about 1600 BCE and reached the Loyalty Islands in the course of that expansion. Drehu was traditionally an oral language, and alongside ordinary speech it possessed a separate honorific register called qene miny, reserved for addressing a chief.
zh:
德雷胡语的使用者自称克内德雷胡，外界长期称其为德胡语或利富语；它是南岛语系大洋洲语族洛亚蒂群岛分支的卡纳克语言，主要通行于格朗德特尔岛以东的利富岛。

其祖先是约公元前1600年起把原始大洋洲语传遍美拉尼西亚群岛的拉皮塔航海者，洛亚蒂群岛正是在这场扩张中被抵达的。德雷胡语传统上没有文字，除日常用语外还有一套称为克内米尼的敬语，专门用于对酋长讲话。

en:
Duau is a dialectically diverse Oceanic language of the Papuan Tip cluster, belonging to the Dobu–Duau linkage alongside Dobu, Molima, Bunama and Galeya. It is spoken on Normanby Island, the southernmost of the D'Entrecasteaux Islands off the eastern tip of New Guinea, above all in the island's southeast.

The closely related Dobu speech of nearby Dobu Island serves as a lingua franca across the archipelago, while the islanders farm yams and taro, fish the Solomon Sea, and take part in the kula, the inter-island circuit of ceremonial shell exchange. The D'Entrecasteaux group was first sighted by Europeans in 1792, when the French navigator Bruni d'Entrecasteaux sailed through these waters.
zh:
杜奥语是巴布亚尖端语群的一支大洋语，方言繁多，与多布语、莫利马语、布纳马语和加莱亚语同属多布—杜奥语链。它通行于新几内亚东端外海当特尔卡斯托群岛最南端的诺曼比岛，尤其是该岛东南部。

邻近多布岛上与它亲缘密切的多布语是群岛的通用语；岛民种植山药和芋头，在所罗门海捕鱼，并参与库拉圈——岛际巡回交换礼仪贝壳的贸易网络。欧洲人最早在1792年望见当特尔卡斯托群岛，当时法国航海家布吕尼·当特尔卡斯托乘船驶过这片海域。

en:
East Cushitic is the largest branch of the Cushitic family and, through it, of the Afroasiatic phylum, spread across the Horn of Africa from the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden to the Ethiopian highlands and northern Kenya. It splits into Highland languages and the Lowland group, which includes Oromo and Somali.

In the fourteenth century the Somali-speaking Ifat and Adal sultanates dominated the trade routes between the Ethiopian highlands and the sea. The Ethiopian-Adal war of 1529 to 1543 exhausted both sides, and from about 1530 Oromo pastoralists, organized under their eight-year gadaa cycle, began expanding north, carrying Oromo across much of central Ethiopia.

Somali and Afar turned increasingly to Islam and Arabic letters, while the Highland East Cushitic peoples kept their place within the Christian Ethiopian orbit, their languages alive south of the Blue Nile.
zh:
东库希特语是库希特语族最大的分支，而库希特语族又属亚非语系；它分布在非洲之角，从红海和亚丁湾延伸到埃塞俄比亚高原和肯尼亚北部。它分为高地语支与低地语支，后者包括奥罗莫语和索马里语。

14世纪，讲索马里语的伊法特和阿达尔苏丹国控制着埃塞俄比亚高原与海洋之间的商路。1529—1543年的埃塞俄比亚—阿达尔战争使双方两败俱伤，约1530年起，按八年一轮的加达制度组织起来的奥罗莫牧民向北扩张，把奥罗莫语带到埃塞俄比亚中部大片地区。

索马里人和阿法尔人日益转向伊斯兰教与阿拉伯字母，高地东库希特诸族则留在信奉基督教的埃塞俄比亚势力圈内，其语言在青尼罗河以南延续。

en:
Russian is the North-Eastern branch of East Slavic, descended from the Old East Slavic of Kievan Rus, whose earliest surviving written trace is an inscription on an amphora at Gnezdovo from the middle of the 900s. For centuries writing meant Church Slavonic in Cyrillic.

Novgorod's birch bark letters of the 1000s to 1400s preserve the Old Novgorod dialect in private notes, complaints and the school exercises of the boy Onfim. After Kiev fell to the Mongols in 1240 the language developed on its own, and with the rise of Moscow in the late 1400s the Muscovite dialect became its centre.

Church Slavonic long kept its hold on literature, yielding in the Petrine age, when Peter the Great's reforms in 1708 to 1710 introduced a simplified civil script and opened the way for a standard built on Moscow speech.
zh:
俄语是东斯拉夫语的东北支，源于基辅罗斯的古东斯拉夫语；现存最早的文字痕迹是10世纪中期格涅兹多沃一只陶罐上的铭文。长期以来，书面语是西里尔字母写成的教会斯拉夫语。

诺夫哥罗德11—15世纪的桦皮文献用古诺夫哥罗德方言记下私人便条、诉状和男孩昂菲姆的课业。1240年基辅陷于蒙古人之手后，这门语言独立发展；随着15世纪末莫斯科崛起，莫斯科方言成为其中心。

教会斯拉夫语长期把持文学，直到彼得大帝时代才退让：1708—1710年的改革推出简化的民用字体，为以莫斯科话为基础的书面标准铺平了道路。

en:
Eastern Otomanguean is the eastern grouping of the Oto-Manguean family, a cluster of tonal, verb-first languages whose common ancestor was spoken in southern Mexico more than four thousand years ago, perhaps by the early farming peoples of the Tehuacan Valley.

Its speakers included the Zapotecs, who founded Monte Alban around 500 BCE and carved one of the region's first writing systems, and the Mixtecs, who call themselves Ñuu Savi, the people of the rain, and painted genealogical codices on deerskin. Aztec armies defeated the Mixtecs and Zapotecs in 1458 and built the Huaxyacac fortress in 1486 to enforce tribute; Zapotecs fought at Guiengola until around 1500.

Both peoples submitted to Francisco de Orozco in 1521, and their lands entered the Marquessate of the Valley of Oaxaca held by Cortes. Repeated epidemics reduced the indigenous population by roughly nine tenths within little more than a century.
zh:
东欧托曼格语是欧托-曼格语系的东部语支群，属动词前置的声调语言，其共同母语四千多年前就通行于墨西哥南部，使用者可能是特瓦坎谷地的早期农耕人群。

使用者包括萨波特克人和米斯特克人：前者约在公元前500年兴建阿尔万山，并刻下当地最早的文字体系之一；后者自称“雨民”Ñuu Savi，在鹿皮上绘制谱系抄本。阿兹特克人1458年击败米斯特克人和萨波特克人，1486年修筑瓦克萨卡克堡垒以索贡；萨波特克人在吉恩戈拉抵抗至1500年前后。

两支民族都在1521年向弗朗西斯科·德·奥罗斯科投降，其土地并入科尔特斯名下的瓦哈卡谷地侯爵领地。接连不断的瘟疫在一个多世纪里使土著人口减少了约九成。

en:
Eastern Tasmanian is the name for the Aboriginal languages of Tasmania's central eastern coast and its hinterland, above all Paredarerme, the language of the Oyster Bay and Big River people. After the Bass Strait was flooded about six millennia before the common era, these tongues developed in isolation from the Australian mainland and cannot be shown to be related to other Australian languages.

They survive only in word lists gathered in the 1830s by the government conciliator George Augustus Robinson, including 357 Oyster Bay words and 268 Big River words. British colonisation from 1803, followed by the removals to Wybalenna between 1830 and 1835, dispersed the communities that spoke them.
zh:
东塔斯马尼亚诸语是对塔斯马尼亚中东部沿海及其内陆原住民语言的统称，其中最主要的是帕雷达雷梅语，即牡蛎湾人和大河人的语言。约公元前六千纪巴斯海峡被海水淹没后，这些语言在与澳大利亚大陆隔绝的环境中发展，现有证据无法证明它们与其他澳大利亚语言有亲缘关系。

它们只靠词表存世：政府调停人乔治·奥古斯都·鲁宾逊在1830年代收集了包括357个牡蛎湾词和268个大河词在内的材料。1803年起的英国殖民，以及1830—1835年间向怀巴伦纳的强制迁徙，使说这些语言的社群流散。

en:
The Eleman languages form a small Papuan family spoken around Kerema Bay at the head of the Gulf of Papua on the southern coast of New Guinea. Eleman proper comprises five related languages in two branches: a western branch of Keuru, Opao and Orokolo, and an eastern branch of Toaripi and Tairuma.

Kaki Ae and Purari have at times been linked with Eleman, but much of the resemblance is attributed to borrowing, so their place remains debated. The gulf's coastal villages were the western terminus of the hiri, the Motu trading voyages that carried clay pots from the Port Moresby area to exchange for sago, and an early pidgin form of Motu served as a contact language with Eleman speakers.

The Spanish voyage of Torres passed the approaches to the gulf in 1606, yet the sheltered bay and its swamps were not penetrated by outsiders until long afterward.
zh:
埃勒曼语是新几内亚南海岸的一个巴布亚语小语族，分布在巴布亚湾顶端的凯雷马湾一带。埃勒曼本体包含五种亲缘明确的语言，分两支：西支为克乌鲁语、奥帕奥语和奥罗科洛语，东支为托阿里皮语和泰鲁马语。

卡基艾语和普拉里语都曾被归入埃勒曼语，但许多相似之处被归因于借词，其归属仍有争议。海湾沿岸的村落是希里贸易的西端终点：莫图人的贸易远航把莫尔斯比港一带的陶罐运来交换西谷米，早期的皮钦莫图语也成为与埃勒曼语使用者打交道的接触语言。

1606年托雷斯的西班牙航行经过海湾外海，但这个隐蔽的港湾及其沼泽地带在此后很久都没有外来者深入。

en: Panare, whose speakers call their tongue E'ñapa Woromaipu, is a Cariban language of the Panare people of central Venezuela. They live south of the Orinoco River in Bolívar State, chiefly around the Cuchivero basin, and the name Panare itself is not their own but a Tupí word meaning friend.
zh: 帕纳雷语是委内瑞拉中部帕纳雷人的加勒比语族语言，使用者自称其语言为埃尼亚帕·沃罗迈普。他们居住在奥里诺科河以南的玻利瓦尔州，主要分布在库奇韦罗河流域；“帕纳雷”并非他们的自称，而是一个图皮语词，意为“朋友”。

en:
Old English, the speech of the Angles, Saxons and Jutes who settled in Britain from the fifth century, produced a written literature from Beowulf to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle. Its Norse words came from Danish settlers in the north and east.

After 1066 French became the language of the court and the law, and English, spoken mainly by the common people, absorbed a large Romance vocabulary. By the fourteenth century it was regaining ground: the Pleading in English Act of 1362 admitted it to the law courts, and Geoffrey Chaucer wrote The Canterbury Tales in the London dialect.

William Caxton's press at Westminster, opened in 1476, helped settle a written standard, later shaped by the King James Bible of 1611 and Samuel Johnson's dictionary of 1755.
zh:
古英语是5世纪起移居不列颠的盎格鲁人、撒克逊人和朱特人的语言，留下了从《贝奥武甫》到《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》的书面文学。其中的诺斯语词汇来自北部和东部的丹麦定居者。

1066年后，法语成为宫廷和法律的语言，英语主要在平民口中流传，吸收了大量罗曼语词汇。14世纪英语重新抬头：1362年的《英语诉讼法》准许在法庭使用英语，杰弗里·乔叟用伦敦方言写成《坎特伯雷故事集》。

1476年威廉·卡克斯顿在威斯敏斯特开设印刷所，帮助确立了书面标准；1611年的钦定版圣经和1755年塞缪尔·约翰逊的词典又进一步塑造了它。

official_raw.en: Originating from the Anglo-Saxon dialects brought to Britain by Germanic settlers, English was later influenced by contact with Norse languages due to Viking invasions, leading to significant changes in vocabulary and grammar. Following the Norman conquest, and centuries of rule by continental feudal lords, it became influenced further by French.
official_raw.zh: 英语源于日耳曼定居者带到英国的盎格鲁‑撒克逊方言，后来由于维京人入侵，在与诺斯语接触中受到影响，导致词汇和语法发生了重大变化。诺曼征服后，欧洲大陆的封建领主统治了几个世纪，它又进一步受到法语的影响。

en:
Eo Enana, or Marquesan, is a chain of Polynesian dialects spoken across the Marquesas Islands, which voyagers from western Polynesia settled around the twelfth or thirteenth century. It splits into North Marquesan and South Marquesan; the Tai Pi speech of eastern Nuku Hiva is sometimes counted as a language of its own.

The northern dialects keep the old Polynesian k sound that Tahitian has lost, while the south replaces it with n or a glottal stop and turns the northern h into f. For centuries the language was spoken but not written.

The Spanish navigator Álvaro de Mendaña reached the islands in 1595 and named them after the Marquis of Cañete. William Pascoe Crook, the first Protestant missionary to settle there, lived in the islands from 1797 to 1799, after which Marquesan began to be recorded in the Latin alphabet.
zh:
埃纳纳语即马克萨斯语，是一组波利尼西亚方言，通行于马克萨斯群岛；这些岛屿约在12—13世纪由西波利尼西亚的航海者定居。它分为北马克萨斯语和南马克萨斯语；努库希瓦东部的泰皮话有时被视为独立语言。

北部方言保留了塔希提语已经失去的古波利尼西亚辅音克，南部方言则以恩音或喉塞音替代，并把北部的赫音换成夫音。长期以来它只有口语而无文字。

1595年西班牙航海家阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚抵达群岛，以卡涅特侯爵的封号为群岛命名。1797—1799年，第一位在此定居的新教传教士威廉·帕斯科·克鲁克居住于群岛，此后马克萨斯语开始有了拉丁字母记录。

en:
Ethiopic, or Ethio-Semitic, is the western branch of the South Semitic languages, carried to the Horn of Africa from South Arabia in the first millennium BC and laid over a Cushitic substratum. Ge'ez, the tongue of Aksum, became its literary and liturgical standard.

Amharic, the largest member, was named Lisane Negus, the tongue of the king, and served the Solomonic dynasty restored in 1270 as the language of court, army and trade, written in the fidal abugida adapted from Ge'ez. Harari was the language of the Muslim trading city of Harar, recorded in an Arabic-based script and carried by the merchants and preachers of the Adal sultanate.

Through the wars of the sixteenth century and the Oromo migrations that followed, Amharic held its place as the lingua franca of the Christian empire, while Gurage and Harari communities preserved their own speech.
zh:
埃塞俄比亚语又称埃塞俄比亚闪米特语，是南闪米特语族的西支，于公元前第一千纪从阿拉伯半岛南部传入非洲之角，叠加在库希特语底层之上。阿克苏姆的语言格尔兹语成为其书面和礼拜标准。

成员中最大的阿姆哈拉语号称“国王之语”，是1270年复辟的所罗门王朝宫廷、军队和贸易用语，文字采用由格尔兹字母改造的斐德尔元音拼音文字。哈拉里语是穆斯林商业城市哈勒尔的语言，用阿拉伯字母体系记录，随阿达尔苏丹国的商人和传教士向外传播。

历经16世纪的战争和随后的奥罗莫人迁徙，阿姆哈拉语保持着基督教帝国通用语的地位，古拉格人和哈拉里人也守住了自己的语言。

en:
Evenki, long known in Russian sources as Tungus and in Qing records as Solon, is the largest language of the northern branch of the Tungusic family. Its speakers are reindeer-herding hunters whose ancestors are plausibly sought among the Shiwei peoples of the Greater Khingan; from the Baikal region they spread to the Okhotsk coast and, under Russian pressure, as far as Sakhalin.

When Cossacks reached the Evenki in the 1600s they imposed a fur tribute and took clan hostages, while the horse-breeding Solon of the Amur country were incorporated into the Qing Eight Banners and became renowned as frontier troops; Qing scholars also set down Solon words in the Manchu alphabet.

Evenki is agglutinative with a vocabulary rich in terms for reindeer and the hunt, and remained an unwritten oral language, later recorded in Latin and Cyrillic scripts.
zh:
鄂温克语在俄罗斯旧文献中通称通古斯语，清代记载则称索伦语，是满‑通古斯语族北支中使用最广的语言。操这种语言的鄂温克人牧鹿狩猎，其祖先可能与大兴安岭的室韦诸部有关；他们从贝加尔湖一带向外扩散，足迹直到鄂霍次克海岸，在俄国势力压迫下更有人远徙萨哈林岛。

17世纪哥萨克人接触到鄂温克人后，强征毛皮贡赋并拘押氏族首领为人质；阿穆尔河流域养马的索伦部则被编入清朝八旗，以边地劲旅闻名，清代学者还以满文字母记录索伦语词汇。

鄂温克语是黏着语，关于驯鹿和狩猎的词汇丰富；它长期没有本族文字，靠口耳相传，后来才以拉丁字母和西里尔字母书写。

en: Fas, also called Momu or Bembi, is a Papuan language of Sandaun Province in north-western Papua New Guinea, near the Indonesian border. It names the tiny Fas family, whose only other member is Baibai, sharing about forty per cent of its vocabulary; an older classification placing Fas among the Kwomtari languages is regarded as an error.
zh: 法斯语又称莫穆语或本比语，是巴布亚新几内亚西北部桑道恩省、邻近印度尼西亚边境的一种巴布亚语言。它是极小的法斯语族的命名语言，该语族另一种成员只有拜拜语，两者约有四成词汇同源；过去曾把法斯语归入科姆塔里语族，这一分类后来被视为错误。

en:
Finnic, also called Baltic Finnic, is the westernmost branch of the Uralic family, spoken around the Baltic Sea by the Baltic Finnic peoples. Its two chief languages are Finnish and Estonian.

Proto-Finnic was probably spoken on the coasts of the Gulf of Finland, and its dialects began to separate around AD 150. They absorbed words from older Paleo-Baltic tongues and later from Germanic, Baltic and East Slavic neighbours. A literary form came in the sixteenth century, when Bishop Mikael Agricola created the first comprehensive Finnish orthography from western dialects and began translating the Bible; written Finnic served mainly religion for centuries.

Under Swedish rule Finnish had no official standing, and after Sweden lost Finland in 1809 the Fennoman movement took up its cause, with Elias Lönnrot's Kalevala leading a revival that carried the language into administration and literature.
zh:
芬兰语即芬兰语支，又称波罗的芬兰语支，是乌拉尔语系最西端的一支，由波罗的芬兰各族在波罗的海周边使用。两大语言是芬兰语和爱沙尼亚语。

原始芬兰语大概通行于芬兰湾沿岸，各方言约在公元150年开始分化，其间吸收了更古老的古波罗的语言词汇，后来又受日耳曼语、波罗的语和东斯拉夫语影响。书面形式到16世纪才出现：主教米卡埃尔·阿格里科拉根据西部方言创制了第一套完整的芬兰语正字法并着手翻译圣经；此后数百年间，书面芬兰语主要用于宗教。

在瑞典统治下芬兰语没有官方地位，1809年瑞典失去芬兰后，芬兰民族主义运动接过了它的事业，埃利亚斯·伦罗特的《卡勒瓦拉》引领了一场复兴，把这门语言带入行政与文学领域。

en:
The Formosan languages are the Austronesian tongues of the indigenous peoples of Taiwan. They are not a single family: they are divided into as many as nine primary branches of Austronesian, and Taiwan is widely held to be the original homeland from which the tenth branch, Malayo-Polynesian, spread across the Indian and Pacific Oceans.

Of the roughly two dozen recorded languages, among the largest are Amis, Bunun, Paiwan and Tsou, while Siraya on the southwestern plains served as a regional lingua franca. Several gained a romanized script under Dutch colonial rule from 1624 to 1662, when missionaries compiled word lists and religious texts in Siraya. Long contact with Chinese settlers afterwards pushed many of these languages into decline.
zh:
台湾南岛语是台湾原住民所说的一组南岛语系语言。它们并不构成单一语族，而是被划分为多达九个南岛语系一级分支，学界普遍认为台湾是南岛语系的原乡，第十个分支马来—波利尼西亚语族从这里扩散到印度洋和太平洋诸岛。

已记录的语言约有二十余种，其中使用人口较多的有阿美语、布农语、排湾语和邹语；西南平原的西拉雅语还曾充当区域通用语。1624—1662年荷兰殖民统治期间，几种语言获得了拉丁字母拼写，传教士并用西拉雅语编写词表和宗教文书。此后与汉族移民的长期接触，使其中许多语言逐渐走向衰落。

en:
French grew out of the Vulgar Latin of Roman Gaul, over a Celtic Gaulish substrate that left its mark in liaison and some two hundred rural words. Germanic Franks settled the north from the third century and gave French its name, and a vocabulary of war and lordship; Vikings who took Normandy in the 900s added seafaring terms.

The oïl dialects, named for their word for yes, included Picard, Norman, Walloon and the Francien of Paris. The earliest surviving French text is the Oaths of Strasbourg of 842, and after 1066 Anglo-Norman ruled the courts of England.

In 1337 Francien was still one dialect among many. The Ordinance of Villers-Cotterêts of 1539 made French the sole language of legal documents, and Richelieu founded the Académie française in 1634. By 1789 perhaps half the king's subjects still spoke only a regional patois.
zh:
法语源于罗马高卢的通俗拉丁语，底下是凯尔特语高卢语的底层，它给法语留下了联诵和约两百个乡村生活词汇。3世纪起，日耳曼人的法兰克人定居北方，赋予法语它的名字和大量军事与封建词汇；10世纪占据诺曼底的维京人又添上海事用语。

奥依语诸方言因表示“是”的说法而得名，包括皮卡第语、诺曼语、瓦隆语和巴黎的弗朗西恩语。现存最早的法语文本是842年的《斯特拉斯堡誓言》，1066年后盎格鲁-诺曼语统治了英格兰的宫廷。

1337年时，弗朗西恩语还只是众多方言中的一支。1539年的《维莱科特雷法令》规定法语为法律文书的唯一语言，1634年黎塞留创立法兰西学术院。直到1789年，法王的臣民中或许仍有一半只会说本乡的土话。

official_raw.en: The #italic Langues d'oïl#!, or $french_language$, represent a patchwork of Romance dialects originating in the north of France.
official_raw.zh: #italic 奥伊通俗拉丁语#!，或者说后来的$french_language$，代表了罗曼语在法兰西北部的诸多方言的集合。

en:
Frisian is a group of West Germanic varieties spoken along the southern shore of the North Sea; together with English and Scots it forms the Anglo-Frisian branch. Old Frisian was remarkably close to Old English and survives mostly in legal texts.

In the fourteenth century the Frisian lands enjoyed the so-called Frisian freedom: rural communes without feudal lords elected their own judges and fought repeated wars against the counts of Holland. That autonomy ended when the County of East Frisia was formed in 1464 and Saxon troops occupied western Frisia in 1498, after which Dutch replaced Frisian in government, law and the church.

The poet Gysbert Japiks revived Frisian as a literary medium, and a broader revival around 1820, led by scholars such as Joost Halbertsma, produced a modern written standard.
zh:
弗里西亚语是西日耳曼语的一支，分布在北海南岸；它与英语、苏格兰语同属盎格鲁-弗里西亚语支。古弗里西亚语与古英语极为相近，存世文献多为法律文书。

14世纪的弗里斯兰地区实行所谓“弗里斯兰自由”：没有封建领主的乡村公社自行选举法官，并为抵御荷兰伯爵的扩张屡次开战。1464年东弗里斯兰伯国建立，1498年萨克森军队占领西弗里斯兰，这套自治制度告终；此后荷兰语取代弗里西亚语成为行政、法律和教会用语。

诗人吉斯伯特·亚皮克斯以弗里西亚语创作，复兴了它的文学传统；1820年前后，在约斯特·哈尔伯茨马等学者推动下出现更大规模的复兴，新的书面规范由此形成。

en:
Futuna, more precisely Futuna-Aniwa or West Futunan, is a Polynesian language spoken on Futuna and Aniwa in Vanuatu's Tafea group, amid the Melanesian islands of the southern New Hebrides. It belongs to the Futunic branch of Nuclear Polynesian and descends from voyagers who pushed westward after Proto-Polynesian had taken shape in the Tonga and Samoa region some three thousand years ago; its closest relative is East Futunan of Wallis and Futuna.

James Cook recorded the name Futuna from Tanna islanders during his 1774 visit, though no Europeans are known to have landed there in this period. Futuna had no writing and lived in oral tradition.
zh:
富图纳语更准确的名称是富图纳-阿尼瓦语或西富图纳语，是通行于瓦努阿图塔菲亚地区富图纳岛和阿尼瓦岛的波利尼西亚语言，地处新赫布里底群岛南部的美拉尼西亚岛屿之间。它属于核心波利尼西亚语的富图纳语支，祖先是约三千年前原始波利尼西亚语在汤加和萨摩亚一带形成后向西远航的航海者；与它关系最近的是瓦利斯和富图纳的东富图纳语。

1774年詹姆斯·库克到访时，曾从塔纳岛人口中记下富图纳这个岛名，但这一时期没有欧洲人登岛的记载。富图纳语没有文字，靠口耳相传。

en: Fwâi, also called Poai, is a Kanak language of the North Northern New Caledonian group, spoken in the commune of Hienghène on the northeast coast of Grande Terre, alongside the closely related Pije, Nemi and Jawe languages.
zh: 法伊语又称波阿伊语，属新喀里多尼亚语群北部北支，通行于格朗德特尔岛东北沿海的延根市镇，与关系相近的皮热语、内米语和雅韦语分布在同一地区。

en:
Gaelic's oldest form, Primitive Irish, is first attested in Ogham stone inscriptions from about the fourth century; from the thirteenth to the eighteenth century a shared literary standard called Classical Gaelic served writers in Ireland and Scotland.

Gaelic reached western Scotland with the kingdom of Dal Riata in the sixth century, and the Picts had adopted it by the eleventh century. In Scotland Gaelic retreated to the Highlands and Islands, where the Statutes of Iona of 1609 forced clan chiefs' heirs into English-speaking schools.

In Ireland English conquest and the Treaty of Limerick of 1691 marginalized the language. The Scottish Gaelic New Testament appeared in 1767 and the full Bible in 1801, even as English schooling and emigration steadily shrank the Gaelic-speaking world.
zh:
盖尔语最古老的形态是原始爱尔兰语，最早见于4世纪前后的欧甘文石刻；13—18世纪，一种称为古典盖尔语的共同书面标准服务于爱尔兰和苏格兰两地的写作者。

6世纪，盖尔语随达尔里阿达王国传到苏格兰西部，到11世纪皮克特人已改用这种语言。在苏格兰，盖尔语退居高地和群岛；1609年的《艾奥纳法令》强迫氏族首领的继承人进入英语学校。

在爱尔兰，英格兰的征服和1691年的《利默里克条约》使盖尔语被边缘化。苏格兰盖尔语《新约》于1767年问世，全本《圣经》于1801年出版，但英语教育和移民仍在不断压缩盖尔语的世界。

official_raw.en: $gaelic_language$ (or Goidelic) represents a Celtic family of languages that originated in Ireland, and spread to neighboring islands in the medieval era.
official_raw.zh: $gaelic_language$（或戈伊德尔语）代表了起源于爱尔兰并在中世纪传播到邻近岛屿的凯尔特语族。

en:
Samoan, self-called Gagana Sāmoa, is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken on the Samoan Islands and classed in the Samoic branch alongside Tokelauan and Eastern Polynesian tongues such as Māori, Tahitian and Hawaiian. It is an isolating language whose syllables all end in vowels; a reversed comma marks the glottal stop and a macron marks long vowels.

Samoan is distinctive for its registers, with a colloquial K-style alongside formal literary speech and the gagana faʻaaloalo, a ceremonial chiefly vocabulary used by orator chiefs under the matai title system. It remained a spoken language until missionaries of the London Missionary Society began recording it in the Latin script, distributing an orthography in 1834.
zh:
萨摩亚语是南岛语系波利尼西亚语族的语言，通行于萨摩亚群岛，与托克劳语以及毛利语、塔希提语、夏威夷语等东波利尼西亚语言同属萨摩亚语支。它是孤立语，每个音节都以元音结尾，用倒置逗号标示喉塞音，用长音符号标示长元音。

萨摩亚语的特点是语体分层：口语中有把特读成克的随意体，另有规范的书面体，以及一套用于仪式的“酋长敬语”，由马泰头衔制度下的演说酋长使用。它长期没有文字，直到伦敦会传教士用拉丁字母记录这种语言，并于1834年颁行拼写方案。

en:
Gan is the Sinitic language of the Jiangyou people, spoken chiefly across central and northern Jiangxi and into eastern Hunan, southeastern Hubei, southwestern Anhui and northwestern Fujian, with the Nanchang dialect as its prestige form. Chinese settlement of the Gan valley began with the Qin campaign against the Baiyue after 221 BCE, and in 202 BCE the Han founded Nanchang as the seat of Yuzhang Commandery, whose growing population gave the language its shape under the Han.

When the fourth-century upheaval of the Five Barbarians drove refugees south, Jiangxi served as a staging post and the old Gan speech absorbed northern elements.

From the Five Dynasties period, 907 to 960, emigrants from Jiangxi carried Gan into Hunan, Hubei, Anhui and Fujian. Phonetically it is the closest of the Chinese varieties to Hakka, and like the other Sinitic languages it is written in Chinese characters.
zh:
赣语是江右民系的主要语言，通行于江西中北部，并延伸到湖南东部、湖北东南部、安徽西南部和福建西北部，以南昌话为代表。公元前221年秦征百越之后，中原汉人开始进入赣江流域；公元前202年汉代设南昌为豫章郡治，郡内人口在汉代增长，赣语也在这一时期逐渐成形。

4世纪五胡之乱、北民南迁，江西成为中转之地，古赣语由此吸收了北方方言的成分。

907—960年的五代时期，江西居民陆续迁往湖南、湖北、安徽和福建，带去了赣语。在语音上，赣语是各汉语中与客家话最接近的一支；和其他汉语一样，赣语也使用汉字书写。

en:
Garawa, also called Leearrawa, is the language of the Garrwa people of the southern Gulf of Carpentaria country, whose lands ran from the McArthur River at Borroloola east across the Nicholson River into Queensland. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, the same wider region held the Ganggalida, or Yukulta, of the Gulf coast, the Mingin around Burketown and the Wakaya inland toward Tennant Creek.

Garawa had a heavy eastern dialect called Guninderri and a lighter western one, and with the neighbouring Waanyi it forms the small Garrwan family. Its place within the Pama–Nyungan family is disputed, for its grammar contains unusual forms found in few other Australian languages.
zh:
加拉瓦语又称李阿拉瓦，是卡奔塔利亚湾南部加拉瓦人的语言，其传统地盘从博罗卢拉的麦克阿瑟河向东越过尼科尔森河，伸入昆士兰。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，同一区域还住着海湾沿岸的冈加里达人（即尤库尔塔人）、伯克敦一带的明金人以及内陆往滕南特克里克方向的瓦卡亚人。

加拉瓦语有偏重的东部方言贡宁代里和偏轻的西部方言，它与邻近的瓦尼语共同构成加拉瓦语族。它是否属于帕马—恩永甘语族尚有争议，因为其语法包含在其他澳大利亚语言中罕见的形式。

en:
Ge'ez, or Classical Ethiopic, is the ancient South Semitic language of the Ethiopian and Eritrean highlands, first attested in pre-Christian inscriptions of the early Aksumite period around the fourth century. The conversion of King Ezana in the 300s opened its literary age: the Bible was translated, and the Book of Enoch survives complete nowhere else.

Ge'ez remained the realm's official written language into the 1800s. The fourteenth-century Kebra Nagast told of Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, anchoring the Solomonic dynasty's claim to rule. Around 1450 the Fetha Negest was translated into Ge'ez and became the kingdom's law.

Muslim invasions in the 1500s broke this literary florescence, though Ge'ez remained the liturgical tongue of the Ethiopian and Eritrean Orthodox churches and the Beta Israel. Its fidal abugida lived on as the script of Amharic and Tigrinya.
zh:
格尔兹语又称古典埃塞俄比亚语，是埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚高原的古老南闪米特语言，最早见于4世纪前后阿克苏姆早期的前基督教铭文。埃扎纳国王在4世纪皈依基督教，开启了它的文学时代：圣经被译入，其中《以诺书》的完整文本仅存于格尔兹语。

格尔兹语作为王国的官方书面语一直沿用到19世纪。14世纪的《国王的荣耀》重述所罗门与示巴女王的故事，为所罗门王朝的统治主张提供依据。约1450年译入的《诸王法典》成为王国的法律。

16世纪的穆斯林入侵打断了这一文学繁荣，但格尔兹语仍是埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚正教会以及贝塔以色列人的礼拜用语。它的斐德尔元音拼音文字作为阿姆哈拉语和提格里尼亚语的文字延续下来。

en:
Gela, also called Nggela and formerly Florida, is an Oceanic language of the Southeast Solomonic group, spoken in the Nggela Islands at the centre of the Solomon Islands. Its three dialects are very close, differing mainly in phonology; the language has five vowels and normally stresses the penultimate syllable.

In the later 1800s the Melanesian Mission of the Anglican Church of Melanesia took up Gela, together with Mota of the Banks Islands in Vanuatu, as a language of Christian teaching, and the first Gela translation of the scriptures was printed in those years.
zh:
杰拉语又称恩格拉语，旧称佛罗里达语，是大洋洲语支中东南所罗门语群的语言，通行于所罗门群岛中部的佛罗里达群岛。它的三种方言彼此十分接近，主要差别在语音方面；元音有五个，重音通常落在倒数第二音节。

19世纪后期，美拉尼西亚圣公会的美拉尼西亚传道会采用杰拉语，把它与瓦努阿图班克斯群岛的莫塔语一同作为传教语言，第一部杰拉语圣经译本也在那些年刊印。

en:
Georgian is the principal language of the Kartvelian, or South Caucasian, family, spoken across Georgia and serving as a lingua franca for speakers of its relatives Mingrelian, Laz and Svan. Its written history began after the Christianization of the Kingdom of Iberia in the fourth century, when it replaced Aramaic as the literary language.

The oldest surviving work, Iakob Tsurtaveli's Martyrdom of the Holy Queen Shushanik, dates to the fifth century. Georgian is written in its own alphabet of uncertain origin, whose Mkhedruli form developed alongside the medieval kingdom.

The twelfth-century epic The Knight in the Panther's Skin by Shota Rustaveli became the classic of Middle Georgian. In 1629 the first printed Georgian books appeared in Rome, prepared by Nikoloz Cholokashvili for Catholic missionaries.
zh:
格鲁吉亚语是南高加索语系（卡特维尔语系）最主要的语言，通行于格鲁吉亚各地，也是明格列尔语、拉兹语和斯凡语等亲属语言使用者的通用语。它的书面史始于4世纪伊比利亚王国基督教化之后，当时格鲁吉亚语取代阿拉米语成为文学语言。

传世最古的文学作品雅各布·楚尔塔维利的《圣后舒莎尼克殉道记》属于5世纪。格鲁吉亚语使用来源不明的独特字母，骑士体随中世纪王国的发展而成熟。

12世纪绍塔·鲁斯塔韦利的史诗《虎皮骑士》是中期格鲁吉亚语的经典。1629年，尼科洛兹·乔洛卡什维利在罗马为天主教传教士编印了最早的格鲁吉亚语印刷书籍。

en:
German is the West Germanic dialect continuum of central Europe, split in the Early Middle Ages by the High German consonant shift: the southern dialects that underwent it became High German, while the Low German of the northern plains and Dutch at the Low Franconian western edge did not. Old High German first appears in runic inscriptions of the 500s, then in the Abrogans glossary of the 700s and the Hildebrandslied of the 800s, and Middle High German of about 1050 to 1350 carried courtly epic and Minnesang. To the north Old Saxon grew into Middle Low German, the lingua franca of the Hanseatic League from about 1100 to 1500 around the usage of Lübeck; when the league faded in the 1600s, Low German sank to a local dialect. The High German of medieval Jewish communities meanwhile fused with Hebrew and Aramaic into Yiddish, attested from the 1100s and written in the Hebrew alphabet.

In 1337 no standard German yet existed. Martin Luther's Bible translation, the New Testament of 1522 and the complete Bible of 1534, was based on the Meissen German of Saxony, then the most widely understood form of the language, and carried a common written form across the Protestant lands; a broadly accepted standard emerged only by the mid-1700s, and until about 1800 it remained almost solely a written language that northerners learned like a foreign tongue. In the Habsburg Empire German was the language of towns, trade and government from Prague to Budapest, while Alemannic, Bavarian, Saxon and Low German dialects filled everyday speech.
zh:
德语是中欧的西日耳曼语方言连续体，在中世纪早期被高地德语辅音音变一分为二：经历音变的南部方言成为高地德语，北部平原的低地德语和西端低地法兰克语边缘的荷兰语则没有。高地德语最早见于6世纪的如尼文铭文，随后有8世纪的《阿布罗甘斯》词汇表和9世纪的《希尔德布兰特之歌》；约1050—1350年的中古高地德语承载了宫廷史诗和恋歌。北方的古撒克逊语则演变为中古低地德语，约1100—1500年间以吕贝克用语为基础，成为汉萨同盟的通用语；17世纪汉萨同盟衰落后，低地德语沦为地方土话。在中世纪的神圣罗马帝国，犹太社区的高地德语又与希伯来语和阿拉米语融合成意第绪语，现存最早的记载出现于12世纪，并用希伯来字母书写。

1337年时还不存在标准德语。马丁·路德的圣经译本——1522年的《新约》和1534年的全本圣经——以当时最易被各地听懂的萨克森迈森德语为基础，把一种共同的书面形式带到各个新教地区；广泛接受的标准到18世纪中叶才确立，而直到约1800年，它几乎还只是书面语，北方人要像学外语一样学习它。在哈布斯堡帝国，从布拉格到布达佩斯，德语是城镇、商业和行政的语言，阿勒曼尼、巴伐利亚、萨克森、低地德语等方言则继续充斥着日常口语。

en: Ghari, also called Tangarare, Sughu or West Guadalcanal, is an Oceanic language spoken on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands. Its Vaturanga dialect was used extensively in missionary and liturgical translations, which led the linguist Arthur Capell to describe Ghari as a mission and ecclesiastical language.
zh: 加里语又称坦加拉雷语、苏古语或西瓜达尔卡纳尔语，是所罗门群岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛上通行的一种泛太平洋语系语言。它的瓦图朗加方言被大量用于传教和礼仪翻译，语言学家阿瑟·卡佩尔因此把加里语称为传教与教会语言。

en: Gimbiyu is the language of the Jaminjung and Ngaliwuru peoples of the Victoria River country in the Northern Territory. The two speech forms are closely related and together form the Yirram, or Jaminjungan, branch of the Mirndi family of non-Pama–Nyungan Australian languages, and Ngaliwuru is often treated as a dialect of Jaminjung.
zh: 金比尤语是北领地维多利亚河流域贾明琼人与恩加利乌鲁人的语言。两种话关系密切，共同构成澳大利亚非帕马—恩永甘语言米尔迪语族下的伊拉姆（贾明琼甘）语支，恩加利乌鲁话常被视为贾明琼语的方言。

en: Gogodala is the main language of the Gogodala-Suki family, a small Trans-New Guinea family of the Aramia River and lower Fly floodplain in Papua New Guinea's Western Province; its sister language is Suki. The Gogodala are canoe people divided into eight clans, whose origin story tells of ancestors arriving in great canoes and who once lived in huge communal longhouses.
zh: 戈戈达拉语是戈戈达拉－苏基语族的主要语言。该语族是跨新几内亚语系的一个小语族，位于巴布亚新几内亚西部省阿拉米亚河和弗莱河下游平原，姊妹语言是苏基语。戈戈达拉人是驾独木舟的民族，分为八个氏族，起源故事称祖先乘大独木舟迁来此地，他们曾居住在巨大的公共长屋里。

en:
Gondi, called Koitur by its speakers, is a South-Central Dravidian language of the Gond people, spread across the hill forests of central India. The outsider name Gond may derive from the Dravidian word kond, a hill. From the thirteenth century Gond rajas built the kingdoms of Gondwana: Chanda, traditionally founded in 1200, Deogarh and Garha, whose queen Durgavati died fighting the Mughals in 1564. Muslim writers first mention the Gonds in the fourteenth century.

Gondi exists in many dialects and preserves oral literature of wedding songs and narratives. Lacking a common native script, it has mostly been written in Devanagari or Telugu, though manuscripts in a distinctive Gunjala Gondi hand survive from as early as the mid-eighteenth century.
zh:
贡德语是达罗毗荼语族中南支的语言，使用者自称科伊图尔语，是散布在印度中部山林地带的贡德人的语言。外人对他们的称呼“贡德”可能源自达罗毗荼语的“孔德”，意为山丘。13世纪起，贡德诸王在冈德瓦纳地区建立王国，包括传说建于1200年的昌达、德奥加尔和加尔哈，加尔哈女王杜尔加瓦蒂于1564年抗击莫卧儿军队战死。穆斯林文献首次提到贡德人是在14世纪。

贡德语方言众多，口头文学以婚礼歌和叙事诗为代表。由于没有通行的本族文字，它多用天城体或泰卢固文书写，不过18世纪中叶已出现用独特的贡贾拉贡德文字写成的抄本。

en:
Gorontalo, known to its speakers as Hulontalo, is the major language of the Gorontalo peninsula in northern Sulawesi, spoken by the Gorontalo and Polahi peoples. It belongs to the Gorontalo-Mongondow branch of the Philippine subgroup of Austronesian, and is closest to Mongondow. Its vocabulary carries layers of Malay, Arabic, Portuguese, Dutch and North Halmahera loanwords, reflecting trade links and the spread of Islam.

Before the Portuguese arrival in 1525, Islam had reached the peninsula, which was divided among Muslim states including Gorontalo, Limboto and Suwawa and stood under the influence of the Sultanate of Ternate.

Traditionally a language of oral poetry such as the narrative tanggomo and the rhymed tuja'i, Gorontalo acquired written forms through Islamic missionaries and Dutch colonial officials. A Malay-based creole, Gorontalo Malay, increasingly served as the regional lingua franca.
zh:
哥伦打洛语的使用者自称呼隆塔洛语，是苏拉威西岛北部哥伦打洛半岛的主要语言，由哥伦打洛人和波拉希人使用。它属于南岛语系菲律宾语族的哥伦打洛—蒙贡多语支，与蒙贡多语关系最近。词汇中留有马来语、阿拉伯语、葡萄牙语、荷兰语和北哈马黑拉语言的借词，折射出当地的贸易往来与伊斯兰教传播。

1525年葡萄牙人抵达之前，伊斯兰已在半岛立足，当地分裂为哥伦打洛、林博托、苏瓦瓦等穆斯林政权，并受特尔纳特苏丹国影响。

哥伦打洛语传统上是唐戈莫叙事诗、图贾伊韵诗等口头文学的语言，书写形式要到伊斯兰传教士和荷兰殖民官员到来后才出现。以马来语为基础的克里奥尔语哥伦打洛马来语则日益成为地区通用语。

en:
Gothic is the extinct East Germanic language of the Goths and the earliest Germanic tongue attested in substantial texts. Its principal monuments are sixth-century copies of a Bible translation made in the fourth century by Ulfilas (Wulfila, 311–382), the Arian bishop of a Visigothic community in Moesia.

He devised a Gothic alphabet and rendered most of the New Testament from Greek. The Codex Argenteus preserves much of the four gospels.

Gothic declined after the mid-sixth century, as the Goths lost their kingdoms in Italy and Gaul and the Visigoths of Spain abandoned Arianism in 589; it lingered as a spoken language in the Iberian Peninsula into the eighth century. Crimean Gothic, a related form, was recorded by the Habsburg envoy Ogier Ghiselin de Busbecq in the 1550s and was still reported in use during the eighteenth century.
zh:
哥特语是哥特人使用的、已经消亡的东日耳曼语言，也是有大量文献存世的最古老日耳曼语。它最主要的遗存是6世纪抄本，所抄的是4世纪的一部圣经译本：译者乌尔菲拉（武尔菲拉，311—382年）是默西亚省西哥特社群的阿里乌派主教。

他创制了哥特字母，据希腊文译出《新约》的大部分。《银色圣经抄本》收录了四福音书的大部分。

6世纪中叶以后，随着哥特人在意大利和高卢的王国相继败亡、西班牙的西哥特人于589年放弃阿里乌派，哥特语走向衰落，但在伊比利亚半岛作为口语一直延续到8世纪。它的一支近亲克里米亚哥特语，于16世纪50年代由哈布斯堡使节奥吉尔·格瑟林·德·布斯贝克记录下来，直到18世纪仍有使用的记载。

en:
Greek is the sole living language of the Indo-European Hellenic branch, spoken in the southern Balkans since the third millennium BC. First attested in Mycenaean Greek on Linear B tablets in the fifteenth century BC, it has used an alphabet adapted from Phoenician since the ninth century BC.

After the conquests of Alexander the Great Greek dialects merged into Koine, the common speech of the eastern Mediterranean, used for the New Testament. Koine became the Byzantine Empire's sole administrative language in 620 and grew into the medieval vernacular underlying modern Greek.

Under Ottoman rule Greek remained the language of the Orthodox Church and of merchants. In the early nineteenth century Adamantios Korais devised the archaizing Katharevousa, adopted for official and literary use beside spoken Demotic in the new Greek state.
zh:
希腊语是印欧语系希腊语族仅存的语言，自公元前第3个千年起通行于巴尔干半岛南部。它最早见于公元前15世纪以线形文字B书写的迈锡尼希腊语泥板，公元前9世纪起改用借鉴腓尼基字母的希腊字母。

亚历山大大帝东征之后，希腊语各方言融合为科伊内共通语，成为东地中海的通用语，《新约》即用它写成。科伊内语自620年起成为拜占庭帝国唯一的行政语言，并演变为近代希腊语所本的中世纪口语。

奥斯曼统治时期，希腊语仍是东正教会和商人的语言。19世纪初，阿扎曼蒂奥斯·科拉伊斯创制仿古的书面语“纯正希腊语”，新生的希腊国家将它用于政务与文学，与口语通俗希腊语并行。

en:
Guahibo, also called Sikuani, is the principal language of the Guajiboan family, whose tongues belong to the Indigenous peoples of the Llanos, the Orinoco savanna stretching between eastern Colombia and southwestern Venezuela. It forms a dialect continuum with neighbouring Cuiba, broken when Arawak- and Saliba-speaking peoples settled the riverbanks and later when colonial plantations and towns occupied the same rivers. Guayabero, spoken by the Guayabero people of the forested margins, is the most divergent language of the family.

Long contact with Arawakan languages such as Achagua and Piapoco left borrowed words in Guahibo speech. Through the centuries after 1337 it remained an unwritten language of savanna hunters, fishers and gardeners.
