From the late eighteenth century the Guahibo and their Cuiba kin faced mounting violence from colonists seizing the grasslands, but the language was carried on within the clans.
zh:
瓜希沃语又称西夸尼语，是瓜希博语系最主要的语言，该语系各语言属于亚诺斯草原——横亘哥伦比亚东部与委内瑞拉西南部的奥里诺科稀树草原——的原住民。它与相邻的奎瓦语构成方言连续体，因说阿拉瓦克语和萨利瓦语的民族定居河畔，后来又因殖民者的种植园和城镇占据同样的河流而被打断。林缘地带瓜亚韦罗人所说的瓜亚韦罗语，是整个语系中分歧最大的语言。

与阿查瓜语、皮亚波科语等阿拉瓦克语言的长期接触，给瓜希沃语留下了借词。1337年以后的数百年间，它始终是草原猎人、渔人和园圃农人使用的无文字语言。

从18世纪晚期起，瓜希沃人和他们的奎瓦亲族面对殖民者抢占草地的日益严重的暴力，但语言仍在氏族内部传承。

en:
Guhu Oro, also called the Greater Binanderean family, groups the Papuan languages of the northeastern coast of the Bird's Tail, the southeastern peninsula of New Guinea. It has two branches: the divergent Guhu-Samane of the Waria valley in Morobe Province, and the Oro or Binanderean branch, spoken across Oro Province and including Binandere, Suena, the Orokaiva dialects and Baruga.

The family looks like a comparatively recent expansion from the north, whose inland communities gradually absorbed older Oceanic-speaking settlements on the coast; this contact even imposed subject-object-verb word order on the neighboring Papuan Tip languages.

The Orokaiva were remembered as formidable warriors defending their ridges. In 1545 Yñigo Ortiz de Retez sailed past these northern shores on the voyage that named New Guinea, without entering the mountain valleys behind them.
zh:
古胡奥罗语又称大比南德雷语族，汇集了新几内亚“鸟尾”东南半岛东北海岸的巴布亚诸语言。它分为两支：一支是莫罗贝省瓦里亚河谷中分化最深的古湖—珊曼语；另一支是奥罗省通行的奥罗语，即比南德雷语本支，包括比南德雷语、苏埃纳语、奥罗凯瓦各方言和巴鲁加语。

整个语族看起来是较晚近从北方扩张而来，内陆社群逐渐同化了海岸上更早的大洋洲语聚落；这种接触甚至把主—宾—谓语序强加给了邻近的巴布亚尖端语言。

奥罗凯瓦人以守卫山岭的强悍战士著称。1545年，伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯在为新几内亚命名的航行中驶过这段北部海岸，但没有进入海岸后方的山谷。

en:
Gujarati is the Western Indo-Aryan language of the Gujarat coast, descended from the Gurjar Apabhramsha and from Old Gujarati, the tongue of the Gujjar clans who ruled much of western India around 1200. The Jain monk Hemachandra codified its parent grammar under the Chaulukya king Jayasimha Siddharaja of Patan, and by 1300 a fairly standard literary form had emerged. Jain Rasa narratives survive from 1185, and the Balavabodha of 1355 is among the earliest Gujarati prose.

Gujarati and Rajasthani were then one speech, sometimes called Old Western Rajasthani, and only separated during the 1400s. Under the Gujarat sultans, who ruled from 1391 to 1583, the Bhakti poet Narsinh Mehta wrote mystical verse in the vernacular.

The Middle Gujarati stage ran to about 1800, and its script is a cursive relation of Devanagari that has dropped the horizontal head line.
zh:
古吉拉特语是古吉拉特沿海地区的西印度—雅利安语言，由古吉拉特阿帕布拉姆沙语和老古吉拉特语演变而来，后者是约1200年统治印度西部大片土地的古吉拉特诸部的语言。耆那教修士金月在帕坦的遮娄其国王阇耶辛诃·悉达罗阇在位时编订了其母语的语法，到1300年前后，相当规范的文学语言已经成形。耆那教罗萨体叙事诗的现存作品可追溯到1185年，1355年的《巴拉瓦博达》则是最早的古吉拉特语散文之一。

这一阶段的古吉拉特语与拉贾斯坦语尚未分家，有时合称古西拉贾斯坦语，两者到15世纪才各自独立。在1391—1583年统治的古吉拉特苏丹们治下，虔诚派诗人纳尔辛·默赫塔以方言写作神秘诗篇。

中古吉拉特语阶段延续到1800年前后，其文字是天城文的草书近亲，省去了字母上方的横线。

en:
The Gunwinyguan languages form a proposed non-Pama–Nyungan family spread across Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory. Its core includes Kunwinjku, also called Gunwinggu, spoken in western Arnhem Land around Gunbalanya, as well as Kunbarlang, Jawoyn, Dalabon, Rembarrnga and Ngalakgan. A wider Arnhem, or Macro-Gunwinyguan, grouping adds eastern tongues such as Nunggubuyu, Ngandi and the Anindilyakwa of Groote Eylandt.

Their kinship rests mainly on shared verb morphology. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, Makassan trepang fishermen from Sulawesi were already sailing to the northern coast; their pidgin became a trade lingua franca and left Makassarese loanwords such as balanda, meaning white person, in the Arnhem languages.
zh:
贡温古诸语是拟议中的非帕马—恩永甘语族，分布在北领地阿纳姆地。核心语言包括通行于阿纳姆地西部贡巴兰亚一带的昆温朱语，又名贡温古语，以及昆巴兰语、贾沃因语、达拉邦语、伦巴伦加语和恩加拉甘语。更宽泛的阿纳姆（大贡温古）划分还纳入东部的农古布尤语、恩甘迪语和格鲁特岛的阿宁迪利亚克瓦语。

它们的亲缘关系主要建立在共通的动词形态上。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，来自苏拉威西的望加锡海参渔民已航行到澳大利亚北岸，他们的皮钦语成为贸易通用语，并给阿纳姆诸语留下望加锡语借词，例如意为“白人”的balanda。

en:
Gur, also called Central Gur or Mabia and formerly known as Voltaic after the Volta River, is a Niger–Congo branch spoken across the Sahel and savanna belt, above all in Burkina Faso and the northern parts of Ghana and Togo. Its principal languages include Mòoré, the language of the Mossi, together with Dagbani, Mampruli, Gurunsi and Gurma.

The Mossi built horseman kingdoms on the upper Volta from the eleventh century, ruled from Ouagadougou by the Mogho Naaba; their neighbours the Dagomba and Mamprusi founded states in northern Ghana. Diverse farming peoples were absorbed into Mossi identity in about 1500. Gur societies kept their history largely by oral tradition, though the Mossi also used the Arabic-based Ajami script.
zh:
古尔语又称中古尔语或马比亚语，旧称沃尔特语，得名于沃尔特河，属于尼日尔—刚果语系，通行于萨赫勒和热带草原地带，以布基纳法索以及加纳、多哥的北部最为集中。主要语言包括莫西人使用的莫雷语，以及达邦语、曼普鲁西语、古伦西语和古尔马语。

莫西人自11世纪起在沃尔特河上游建立骑马武士的王国，由莫霍·纳巴在瓦加杜古统治；他们的邻人达贡巴人和曼普鲁西人则在加纳北部建国。约1500年，众多农耕族群融入莫西人的认同之中。古尔社会主要以口传保存历史，不过莫西人也使用以阿拉伯字母为基础的阿贾米文字。

en:
Haida is the language of the Haida people of the Pacific Northwest coast, spoken on the Haida Gwaii archipelago and the nearby Prince of Wales Island in Alaska. Linguists disagree over its classification: some place it in the Na-Dené family, while others treat it as a language isolate. It falls into Northern and Southern dialect groups, distinguished mainly by phonology.

At the time of the first European contact, the Spanish voyage of Juan Pérez in 1772, Haida had perhaps fifteen thousand speakers. Epidemics then emptied whole village areas. In the 1830s a Haida-based trade pidgin, Haida Jargon, served Haida, Tsimshian, Heiltsuk and English speakers along the coast.
zh:
海达语是太平洋西北海岸海达人的语言，通行于海达瓜依群岛以及邻近的阿拉斯加威尔士亲王岛。语言学家对它的归属有争议：有人将其划入纳-德内语系，也有人认为它是一门孤立语言。它分为北部和南部两个方言群，主要差别在语音方面。

1772年西班牙人胡安·佩雷斯的航行首次与欧洲人接触时，说海达语的可能约有一万五千人。此后的瘟疫使整片村落区域人口断绝。19世纪30年代，以海达语为基础的贸易混合语“海达行话”在沿海地区通行，供海达人、钦西安人、海尔楚克人和说英语的人共同使用。

en:
Haliti, self-designated Haliti-Paresi and called Paresi, is a Central Arawakan language of the Paresi–Xingu branch, spoken by the Paresi people on the plateaus of Mato Grosso in western Brazil. In its number system only the first four quantities have distinct words, everything above four being reckoned on a base of five with fingers, toes and other body parts.

The Paresi encountered Portuguese colonists for the first time in 1718, and for more than a century afterward their villages were raided for slaves, the captives set to work as miners in Mato Grosso. The disruption scattered or absorbed several Paresi subgroups, while surviving bands such as the Kozarene kept Haliti alive through traditional beer-brewing, bread-making and other communal customs.
zh:
哈利蒂语使用者自称哈利蒂—帕雷西语，通称帕雷西语，属阿拉瓦克语族中部帕雷西—欣古语支，由巴西西部马托格罗索高原上的帕雷西人使用。它的数词只有前四个数目有独立的词，四以上的数量都以五为基数，借助手指、脚趾等身体部位来计。

1718年，帕雷西人第一次遇到葡萄牙殖民者，此后一百多年间他们的村落不断遭到奴隶劫掠，被俘者被送往马托格罗索当矿工。这场动荡使多个帕雷西分支流散或被同化，而科扎雷内等留存下来的群体则通过传统酿酒、制饼等集体习俗维系着哈利蒂语。

en:
The Halmaheran grouping corresponds to the Raja Ampat–South Halmahera branch of the South Halmahera–West New Guinea subgroup of Austronesian, extending from southeastern Halmahera to the Raja Ampat, or Four Kings, islands off New Guinea's Bird's Head Peninsula. It includes Maba on Halmahera and Ma'ya in Raja Ampat. Contact with Papuan languages left unusual features: Ma'ya has three lexically distinctive tonemes.

Islam arrived in the fifteenth century through contact with the Bacan Sultanate. In the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the kingdoms of Waigeo, Salawati, Sailolof and Misool, bound to Tidore through the Biak-born war leader Gurabesi, formed the Raja Ampat tributary network.

The Portuguese navigator Jorge de Menezes first sighted the islands for Europeans in 1526, and William Dampier charted the strait that bears his name in 1699. The archipelago later passed into the Dutch colonial sphere with Tidore's other Papuan dependencies.
zh:
哈马黑拉语这一划分对应南岛语系南哈马黑拉—西新几内亚语群下的拉贾安帕特—南哈马黑拉语支，分布于哈马黑拉岛东南部至新几内亚鸟头半岛外海的拉贾安帕特（意为四王）群岛。它包括哈马黑拉的马巴语和拉贾安帕特的马亚语。与巴布亚语言的接触赋予这些语言罕见特征：马亚语有三个区别词义的声调。

15世纪，伊斯兰教经与巴占苏丹国的往来传入。16—17世纪，卫吉、萨拉瓦蒂、赛洛洛夫和米苏尔四个王国经出身比亚克的军事首领古拉贝西与蒂多雷结盟，组成拉贾安帕特朝贡网络。

1526年，葡萄牙航海者若热·德·梅内塞斯让欧洲人首次望见这片群岛；1699年，威廉·丹皮尔测绘了以他命名的海峡。此后，该群岛与蒂多雷在巴布亚的其他属地一同进入荷兰殖民势力范围。

en:
Hatam, also spelled Hattam or Atam, is a divergent Papuan language of the eastern Bird's Head Peninsula in West Papua, spoken in the Arfak Mountains and around Manokwari. Its only close relative is Mansim, or Borai; together they form the Hatam–Mansim family, which Malcolm Ross has tentatively assigned to the West Papuan languages on the strength of pronoun parallels. In Hatam the mountain overlooking Manokwari is called Indon or Indonga, the big mountain.

In the fifteenth or early sixteenth century the Biak war leader Gurabesi, in the service of the Tidore sultan Al-Mansur, drew the Bird's Head into Tidore's loose tribute network.

Luís Vaz de Torres's Spanish expedition sailed the New Guinea coast in 1606, while permanent European administration arrived much later, leaving the Arfak highlands under indirect Tidore overlordship through the early nineteenth century.
zh:
哈特姆语又拼Hattam或Atam，是西巴布亚鸟头半岛东部一种差异很大的巴布亚语言，通行于阿尔法克山脉和马诺夸里一带。它唯一的近亲是曼西姆语（又称博赖语），二者组成哈特姆—曼西姆语系；马尔科姆·罗斯根据代词上的相似之处，暂时把该语系划入西巴布亚语系。在哈特姆语里，俯瞰马诺夸里的大山称Indon或Indonga，意为“大山”。

15世纪或16世纪初，比亚克人的军事首领古拉贝西效力于蒂多雷苏丹阿尔—曼苏尔，把鸟头半岛拉入蒂多雷松散的朝贡网络。

1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队沿新几内亚海岸航行；永久性的欧洲人管理要到很久以后才到来，因此整个19世纪早期，阿尔法克高地仍处在蒂多雷的间接宗主权之下。

en:
Haudenosaunee denotes the Northern Iroquoian tongues of the Iroquois Confederacy and its neighbours in the north-eastern woodlands. The five original nations across New York were the Mohawk, Oneida, Onondaga, Cayuga and Seneca; the Tuscarora were admitted as a sixth in 1722. The league was forged before European contact under the Great Law of Peace, and these languages were carried by oral tradition, ceremony and the Grand Council's formal oratory.

During the Beaver Wars of the 1600s the Haudenosaunee defeated and absorbed the Huron, Neutral, Erie and most of the Susquehannock. The latter's speech died in the eighteenth century; a vocabulary taken down by a Swedish missionary in the 1640s is nearly all that survives.

Missionaries gave the surviving confederacy languages Latin-based spellings. The American Revolution split the Six Nations, and many families resettled on the Grand River in Ontario after 1783.
zh:
霍迪诺肖尼语指易洛魁联盟及其东北林地邻族所说的北易洛魁诸语。最初分布在纽约州的五个部族是莫霍克人、奥奈达人、奥农达加人、卡尤加人和塞内卡人；塔斯卡洛拉人于1722年被接纳为第六族。联盟在欧洲人到来之前依照《伟大和平法则》结成，这些语言凭口头传统、仪式和大议会的正式演说延续。

1600年代的河狸战争中，易洛魁人击败并同化了休伦人、中立人、伊利人和大部分萨斯奎汉纳人。后者的语言在18世纪消亡，留存下来的几乎只有一位瑞典传教士在1640年代记下的词表。

后来传教士为留存下来的联盟诸语创制了拉丁字母拼写法。美国独立战争使六族分裂，1783年后许多家庭迁居安大略的格兰德河一带。

en:
Hausa is the chief language of the Chadic branch of the Afroasiatic family and the native tongue of the Hausa of Hausaland, in northern Nigeria and southern Niger. The Hausa Bakwai city-states took shape between the seventh and eleventh centuries; the walls of Kano were begun under Sarki Gijimasu in 1095 and completed in the fourteenth century.

Islam spread through the cities from the fourteenth century, and Kano and Katsina became centres of trans-Saharan commerce. By the early fifteenth century Hausa was being written in an adapted Arabic script called Ajami, which produced the Kano Chronicle and, in the seventeenth century, Abdullahi Suka's Riwayar Nabi Musa, the earliest known Hausa book.

Hausa became a merchants' lingua franca beyond its homeland. In the early nineteenth century Usman dan Fodio led a jihad that made Sokoto the new centre of Hausa Islamic scholarship.
zh:
豪萨语是亚非语系乍得语族最主要的语言，是尼日利亚北部和尼日尔南部豪萨兰地区豪萨人的母语。豪萨七邦等城邦在7—11世纪间形成；卡诺城墙于1095年在萨尔基·吉吉马苏主持下动工，到14世纪建成。

伊斯兰教自14世纪起经由城市传播，卡诺和卡齐纳成为跨撒哈拉贸易中心。到15世纪初，豪萨语已使用经改造的阿拉伯字母阿贾米文字书写，留下了《卡诺编年史》，以及17世纪阿卜杜拉希·苏卡所著、已知最早的豪萨语书籍《先知穆萨传》。

豪萨语成为远超本土的商人通用语。19世纪初，乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥发动圣战，使索科托成为豪萨伊斯兰学术的新中心。

en:
Hebrew is a Canaanite language of the Northwest Semitic group, spoken in antiquity by the Israelites of the Levant. Its oldest written remains, including the Gezer calendar, date to the tenth century BCE, and the Hebrew Bible was composed in Biblical Hebrew, reaching roughly its present form around the Babylonian captivity of 586 BCE; Jews came to call it the holy tongue.

After the Bar Kokhba revolt failed in the second century CE, Aramaic and Greek displaced Hebrew in daily life, but it remained the language of Jewish prayer, rabbinic learning, commerce and poetry. The first dated printed Hebrew book appeared in 1475.

The Samaritans kept their own Hebrew dialect and an alphabet descended from the ancient Paleo-Hebrew script for their liturgy. In the nineteenth century scholars and settlers revived Hebrew as a spoken language.
zh:
希伯来语是闪米特语族西北支的迦南语之一，古时为黎凡特以色列人的语言。现存最古的文字材料包括基色历，可追溯到公元前10世纪；《希伯来圣经》以圣经希伯来语写成，约在公元前586年巴比伦之囚时期基本定型，犹太人称它为“圣语”。

2世纪巴尔·科赫巴起义失败后，希伯来语在日常生活中被阿拉米语和希腊语取代，但仍用于犹太教祈祷、拉比学问、商贸和诗歌。第一本有确切纪年的希伯来语印本书于1475年问世。

撒马利亚人保留了自己的希伯来语方言，并在礼仪中使用源自古代希伯来字母的撒马利亚字母。19世纪，学者和移民推动希伯来语复兴为口语。

en:
Henia-Kamiare, usually called Comechigon after the people who spoke it, was the language of the Comechigon groups of the Argentine hills in Cordoba and San Luis. Its two varieties belonged to the northern Henia and southern Kamiare.

Poorly attested, with only a handful of words recorded with confidence, it is treated as an isolate, although links to the Huarpean languages, to Cacan and to the Sanaviron tongue have all been proposed. The Comechigon lived in half-buried stone houses and farmed the dry valleys, but by the 1690s most had been killed or displaced by Spanish conquistadores.

Colonial administration promoted Quechua brought from Upper Peru instead of the local speech, which then died out, leaving petroglyphs and a trace of its vowel-lengthening habit in the Spanish of Cordoba.
zh:
赫尼亚-卡米亚雷语通常随其使用者被称为科梅钦贡语，通行于阿根廷科尔多瓦和圣路易斯一带的山地。它分两种变体，分属北方的赫尼亚人和南方的卡米亚雷人。

这种语言记录极少，只有少量词语可以确认，学界将其视为孤立语，但也有人提出它与瓦尔佩语、卡坎语或萨纳维龙语有亲缘关系。科梅钦贡人住在半地下的石屋中，在干旱的河谷务农；到17世纪90年代，他们大多已被西班牙征服者杀害或驱离。

殖民当局推广自上秘鲁移入的克丘亚语，本地语言随之消亡，留下岩画，以及科尔多瓦西班牙语中元音拉长的一点痕迹。

en:
Hindustani, or Hindi-Urdu, is the Indo-Aryan lingua franca of the plain of northern India. It grew out of the Middle Indo-Aryan Apabhraṃśa vernaculars of the seventh to thirteenth centuries and took shape under the Delhi Sultanate, when its Prakrit base absorbed Persian, Arabic and Turkic words.

The thirteenth-century poet Amir Khusrau wrote in it and called it Hindavi, the language of Delhi, and Sufi teachers carried it through the subcontinent; in the Deccan it developed a southern branch called Dakhani. The name Urdu came into use around 1780.

It has two literary registers: Hindi, written in Devanagari and drawn toward Sanskrit, and Urdu, written in the Persian Nastaliq hand and steeped in Persian vocabulary. A grammar printed by the East India Company scholar John Gilchrist in 1796 codified it for British administration.
zh:
印度斯坦语又称印地—乌尔都语，是印度北部平原的印度—雅利安通用语。它由7至13世纪的中古印度—雅利安俗语阿帕布拉姆沙发展而来，在德里苏丹国时期成型，俗语词根吸收了波斯语、阿拉伯语和突厥语词汇。

13世纪的诗人阿米尔·胡斯劳用它写作，称之为“欣达维”，即德里的语言；苏菲派导师把它传布到次大陆，在德干发展出名为达卡尼的南支。“乌尔都”一名约1780年出现。

它有两个书面语域：用天城体书写、偏向梵语的印地语，以及用波斯纳斯塔里克体书写、充满波斯语词汇的乌尔都语。1796年，英国东印度公司学者吉尔克里斯特出版语法书，为殖民行政用途规范了这一语言。

en:
Hinóno'eitíít, the Arapaho language, is a Plains Algonquian tongue of the Algic family, grouped with the closely related Gros Ventre speech, Atsina, as dialects of Arapaho-Atsina. Its speakers' ancestors farmed maize in the Red River valley until Ojibwe groups armed by French traders pushed them westward with the early Cheyenne.

They entered the Great Plains before 1700, at first using dog-drawn travois, and after acquiring horses in the early 1700s became nomadic bison hunters. A group that split off became the Gros Ventre, the A'aninin or White Clay people, whose speech kept three consonants lost in Arapaho proper.

On the plains the Arapaho traded meat and hides for corn with the Mandan and Arikara, and around 1811 allied with the Cheyenne, joining them by 1826 in pushing the Kiowa and Comanche south.
zh:
希诺诺埃语即阿拉帕霍语，是阿尔吉克语系的平原阿尔冈昆语言，与关系极近的格罗斯文特语（又称阿齐纳语）同为阿拉帕霍—阿齐纳语的方言。操此语者的先民在雷德河谷种植玉米，后来被取得法国枪械的奥吉布瓦人连同早期夏延人一起向西驱赶。

他们在1700年以前进入大平原，起初以狗拖橇运物，18世纪初获得马匹后转为游牧的野牛猎人。分出去的一支成为格罗斯文特人，即自称“白黏土人”的阿尼宁人，其语言保留了阿拉帕霍语已失去的三个辅音。

在平原上，阿拉帕霍人用兽肉和兽皮向曼丹人和阿里卡拉人换取玉米，并于约1811年与夏延人结盟，到1826年联手将基奥瓦人和科曼奇人挤向南方。

en:
Hlai is the speech of the Li people of Hainan Island and forms a branch of the Kra-Dai family, used in the central and southern mountains in several varieties, together with the ethnically distinct Cun language. Linguists derive its speakers from migrants who crossed the Hainan Strait from the Leizhou Peninsula in prehistoric times; Chinese records called their mainland ancestors Li or Liliao, and the name Li is attested from the Later Tang period of 923 to 937.

On the mainland the Li were united in the sixth century under the hereditary chieftain Lady Xian, but after the eleventh century disappear from continental records, surviving mainly on Hainan. Imperial rule reached the lowlands indirectly under the Song and the whole island under the Qing, who restored administration by 1700.

Confined to the highlands as Han settlers took farmland, the Hlai rose against merchants in 1766. Their language remained spoken, with no writing system.
zh:
黎语是海南岛黎族的语言，自成壮侗语系下的一个语支，通行于岛中部和南部的山区，分为多种方言，还包括族属不同的村语。语言学家认为黎族先民在史前从雷州半岛渡过琼州海峡而来；汉文文献称其大陆先民为俚或俚僚，“黎”这个名称最早见于923—937年的后唐时期。

在大陆上，俚人曾于6世纪在世袭首领冼夫人治下联合起来，但11世纪以后便不见于大陆记载，主要留存于海南。中原王朝在宋代间接治理岛上低地，清代控制全岛，并于1700年重建行政体系。

随着汉族移民占去耕地，黎族被挤压到高地，又在1766年起事反抗外来商人。黎语始终只有口语，没有自己的文字。

en:
Hmong is the largest group within the Hmongic or Miao languages, which together with the Mienic languages form the Hmong–Mien family. Its largely mutually intelligible, tonal and monosyllabic dialects were spoken across the mountains of southern China and carried by migrants into northern Vietnam, Laos and Thailand from the eighteenth century onward.

Chinese records call these peoples Miao: before the Qin unification of 221 BCE the word was a loose label for southern tribes, but from the Tang dynasty of 618 to 907 it referred more clearly to the ancestors of the Hmong.

Linguistic evidence suggests Hmong–Mien speakers have lived in southern China for some 8,000 years. The language took in many Chinese loanwords but had no traditional script; romanized writing systems were devised by missionaries only in the twentieth century.
zh:
苗语是苗瑶语系苗语支中规模最大的一群，与瑶语支共同构成苗瑶语系。它的方言彼此大致可以互通，有声调且以单音节词为主，通行于中国南方山区，并在18世纪以后随移民传入越南北部、老挝和泰国。

中国史书把这些人群泛称为“苗”：公元前221年秦统一以前，“苗”是对南方诸部族的宽泛称呼，到618—907年的唐代，才较明确地指称苗语人群的先民。

语言学证据显示，说苗瑶语的人群在中国南方已生活了约八千年。苗语吸收了大量汉语借词，但传统上没有文字，拉丁字母拼写系统到20世纪才由传教士创制。

en:
Hokan is a proposed language family linking about a dozen small Native American language groups of California, Arizona and Baja California. Its name draws on the word for “two” recurring across them, such as ha'k in Achumawi.

The best-attested branch is Yuman–Cochimí: the Yuman languages of the lower Colorado River and Cochimí of central Baja California, recorded in Jesuit documents of the 1700s, which is thought to have split from the Yuman languages around 1000 BC. Other members include Pomo, Karuk, Shasta and Seri.

Their scattered distribution suggests they once covered the California Central Valley before being separated by later-arriving peoples. The grouping, proposed by Roland Dixon and Alfred Kroeber and expanded by Edward Sapir, remains debated among linguists.
zh:
霍坎语是一个假想语系，用来归组加利福尼亚、亚利桑那和下加利福尼亚的十余个小型美洲原住民语言群体。它的名称取自这些语言中反复出现的“二”一词，例如阿丘马维语的ha'k。

证据最充分的分支是尤曼—科奇米语族：科罗拉多河下游的尤曼诸语言，以及下加利福尼亚中部的科奇米语。后者在18世纪耶稣会文献中已有记录，据信约在公元前1000年与尤曼诸语言分化。其他成员包括波莫语、卡鲁克语、沙斯塔语和塞里语。

它们零散的分布表明，在后来者迁入之前，这些语言可能曾遍布加利福尼亚中央谷地。这一归组由罗兰·狄克逊和阿尔弗雷德·克罗伯提出、爱德华·萨丕尔扩充，在语言学界仍有争议。

en:
Hopi, called Hopílavayi by its speakers, is a Uto-Aztecan language of the Hopi, a Pueblo people of northeastern Arizona. The Hopi descend from the Ancestral Pueblo peoples of the Four Corners region, and villages such as Oraibi, founded before 1100, rank among the oldest continuously inhabited settlements in North America. Hopi is split into four mesa dialects and belongs to the Pueblo linguistic area.

Spaniards first reached the Hopi mesas with the Coronado expedition of the 1540s, and missions were later imposed from New Mexico; the Hopi joined the Pueblo Revolt of 1680, killed their friars and kept their independence thereafter, moving villages to the mesa tops for defence.
zh:
霍皮语（使用者自称Hopílavayi）是亚利桑那东北部普韦布洛人一支霍皮人的语言，属于犹他—阿兹特克语系。霍皮人是四角落地区古普韦布洛人的后裔，奥赖比等村落建于1100年以前，是北美最古老的持续有人居住的定居点之一。霍皮语分为四种台地方言，属于普韦布洛语言联盟。

西班牙人最早在16世纪40年代随科罗纳多远征队抵达霍皮人的台地，后来新墨西哥方面又强行设立传教站；霍皮人参加了1680年的普韦布洛起义，杀死传教士，此后一直保持独立，并把村庄迁到台地顶部以便防守。

en:
Huizhou, or Hui, is the Sinitic speech of the Xin'an River basin, centered on the old Huizhou Prefecture of southern Anhui and spilling into northern Zhejiang and northeastern Jiangxi.

It grew from the Chinese of Central Plains settlers who absorbed the language of the native Shanyue people, and shares its ancient Jiangdong roots with Wu and Min. Its varieties differ from township to township and are often mutually unintelligible.

Under the Ming, 1368 to 1644, and the Qing, Jianghuai speakers settled in the region, while Huizhou merchants grew rich across the empire, above all in Yangzhou, and sponsored operas sung in the home dialect. The speech of She County and later Tunxi served as the local standard, and Hui is written in Chinese characters.
zh:
徽语又称徽州话，是新安江流域的汉语方言，以古徽州府为核心，地跨安徽南部，并伸入浙江北部和江西东北部。

它由中原移民的汉语吸收徽州土著山越的语言而成，与吴语、闽语同源于古代江东方言。徽语内部差异极大，往往隔一个乡就彼此听不懂。

明代（1368—1644年）及清代，江淮官话人口迁入徽语区；徽商在各地致富，尤以扬州为盛，并出资扶持用家乡话演唱的戏曲。旧时以歙县县城话为代表音，后来屯溪话成为徽语的代表，徽语使用汉字书写。

en:
Hungarian is the Ugric tongue of the Uralic family, which split from Mansi and Khanty in the first half of the first millennium BC and drifted west. Contact with Iranian peoples and Oghur Bulgars between the fifth and ninth centuries gave it loanwords.

The Magyars entered the Carpathian Basin in 895, and after Stephen I founded the Christian kingdom in 1000 the old runic alphabet gave way to Latin letters. The Tihany charter of 1055 preserves the first Hungarian phrases, the Funeral Sermon of the 1190s is the earliest complete text, and literature grew after 1300, followed by the Hussite Bible of the 1430s and the first printed Hungarian book in 1533.

Slavic and German words kept entering the language, joined by Turkish ones under Ottoman rule after 1541, and by the seventeenth century Hungarian had nearly its settled form.
zh:
匈牙利语是乌拉尔语系乌戈尔语支的语言，在公元前第一个千年上半叶与曼西语、汉特语分离，向西迁徙。它接触伊朗民族，5—9世纪又受奥古尔保加尔人影响，吸收了借词。

马扎尔人于895年进入喀尔巴阡盆地；1000年伊什特万一世建立基督教王国后，如尼字母让位于拉丁字母。1055年的蒂豪尼特许状保存了最早的匈牙利语词句，12世纪90年代的《葬礼布道与祷文》是最早的完整文本；1300年后文学创作渐丰，15世纪30年代出现胡斯派圣经译本，1533年第一部印本书问世。

斯拉夫语和德语借词持续涌入，1541年起奥斯曼统治时期又添突厥语借词；到17世纪，匈牙利语已大体定型。

en:
Gilbertese, officially te taetae ni Kiribati and also called te taetae n aomata, the language of the people, is an Austronesian language of the Micronesian branch of Oceanic, spoken across the coral atolls of the Gilbert Islands. It splits into northern and southern dialects.

Austronesian seafarers settled the atolls over a long span from around 3000 before Christ, and Samoan arrivals around 1300 added Polynesian words and clans; by the fifteenth century the northern islands lived under chiefs called uea while the south was run by councils of elders, the unimwaane.

European contact began when John Byron chanced on Nikunau in 1765, and Thomas Gilbert and John Marshall passed through in 1788, after whom Adam von Krusenstern named the archipelago the Gilbert Islands in 1820. Through the 1830s Gilbertese remained an entirely oral language.
zh:
基里巴斯语正式名称为“特泰泰·尼·基里巴斯”，又称“特泰泰·纳奥马塔”，意为人民的语言，属于南岛语系大洋洲语族密克罗尼西亚语支，通行于吉尔伯特群岛的珊瑚环礁。它分为北部和南部方言。

南岛语航海者从约公元前3000年起陆续定居环礁，约1300年萨摩亚人迁入，为语言和氏族添入波利尼西亚成分；到15世纪，北部由“乌埃亚”酋长统治，南部由“乌尼姆瓦内”长老议事会管理。

1765年约翰·拜伦偶然抵达尼库瑙；1788年托马斯·吉尔伯特与约翰·马歇尔航经此地，亚当·冯·克鲁森施滕于1820年将其命名为吉尔伯特群岛。直到19世纪30年代，基里巴斯语仍完全是口头语言。

en:
The Ijaw or Ijo languages are a cluster of nine closely related tongues of the Niger Delta, split between Eastern and Western Ijo, with Izon the largest; the varieties are not mutually intelligible.

Their word order and lack of noun classes are unusual for Niger-Congo, leading Joseph Greenberg to treat them as an early branch and some linguists to class Ijoid as an independent family. By the fifteenth century the Ijaw were tied into delta sea routes, and eastern clans such as Bonny, Okrika and Kalabari grew into kingdoms.

Before 1699 Kalabari had become a center of the Atlantic slave trade, exchanging captives from the Igbo interior for European hardware, guns and gunpowder. Under Amachree I, who died around 1800, its trading houses expanded in rivalry with neighboring delta states.
zh:
伊乔语是尼日尔河三角洲一带九种近亲语言的合称，分东伊乔语和西伊乔语两支，其中伊宗语使用最广，各变体之间不能互通。

它的语序和缺少名词分类系统的特点在尼日尔—刚果语系中罕见，因此格林伯格将它视为该语系很早分出的一支，也有语言学家主张伊乔语支是独立语系。到15世纪，伊乔人已接入三角洲的海上商路，邦尼、奥克里卡和卡拉巴利等东部氏族发展为王国。

1699年以前，卡拉巴利已成为大西洋奴隶贸易的集散地，把来自内陆伊博兰的俘虏换成欧洲的金属器具、火枪和火药。在约1800年去世的阿马奇里一世治下，各商号继续扩张，与三角洲邻邦争雄。

en:
Ilocano is an Austronesian language of the Northern Luzon subgroup, native to the narrow coastal plain of northwest Luzon in the Philippines. Its name comes from the native word iluko, meaning people of the bay, and its speakers once called their tongue Samtoy, our language here.

Before the Spanish arrival Ilocanos wrote in baybayin, an Indic-derived syllabary; the Ilocano edition of the Doctrina Cristiana, printed in 1621, was the first Philippine book to mark final consonants with a virama mark.

Under Spanish rule the Latin alphabet and Spanish-based spelling took over, and Ilocano spread as the lingua franca of northern Luzon, used as a second language by the Cordilleran mountain peoples. In the nineteenth century Ilocano migrants settled the Cagayan Valley and parts of Mindanao, carrying the language across the archipelago.
zh:
伊洛卡诺语是南岛语系北吕宋语支的语言，故乡在菲律宾吕宋岛西北沿海的狭长平原。其名称来自本土词汇伊卢科，意为海湾之人，使用者曾把自己的语言称为萨姆托伊，意即我们这里的话。

西班牙人到来之前，伊洛卡诺人使用源自印度文字系统的贝贝因音节文字；1621年印行的伊洛卡诺语版《基督教教义》，是菲律宾第一部用收音符号标记音节尾辅音的书籍。

西班牙统治时期，拉丁字母和以西班牙语为基础的拼写法取而代之，伊洛卡诺语成为北吕宋的通用语，是科迪勒拉山区各族的第二语言。19世纪，伊洛卡诺移民迁入卡加延河谷和棉兰老岛部分地区，把这种语言带到菲律宾各地。

en:
Inuit is the eastern branch of the Eskaleut family, a chain of closely related dialects stretching from Alaska through northern Canada and Labrador to Greenland, with Yupik its nearest relative. It is a polysynthetic, ergative language, building long words from roots and chains of suffixes.

Its early form was carried east by the Thule people, who spread out of Beringia across the Arctic archipelago from the twelfth century and replaced the older Dorset culture; by 1300 they had reached western Greenland, and their descendants arrived in the east as the Norse settlements there disappeared.

The first word lists were made in the 1600s. Paul Egede published the first Greenlandic dictionary in 1750 and the first grammar in 1760, fixing the Latin-script tradition of the Greenlandic variety.
zh:
因纽特语是爱斯基摩—阿留申语系的东支，是一串关系密切的方言，从阿拉斯加经加拿大北部、拉布拉多延伸到格陵兰；最近的亲属是尤皮克语。它是多式综合的作格语言，把词根和一连串后缀拼合成很长的词。

其早期形式由图勒人带向东方：他们12世纪起从白令地区扩散到北极群岛，取代了更早的多塞特文化；1300年他们已抵达格陵兰西部，其后裔又在古斯堪的纳维亚聚落消失之际来到格陵兰东部。

17世纪出现了最早的词汇记录。保罗·埃格德于1750年出版第一部格陵兰语词典，1760年出版第一部语法书，奠定了格陵兰方言的拉丁字母书写传统。

en: Iresim, also spelled Yerisiam, is an Austronesian language of the shoreline of Cenderawasih Bay in Nabire Regency, Central Papua. It forms a small subgroup with its closest relative Yaur, and with Umar more distantly, within the Cenderawasih Bay branch that descends from the ancient seaborne Austronesian settlement of New Guinea's northern coast.
zh: 伊雷辛语又拼耶雷西亚姆语，是中巴布亚省纳比雷县极乐鸟湾沿岸的一种南岛语。它与关系最近的尧尔语组成一个小分支，与乌马尔语关系较远，同属极乐鸟湾语支——该语支源于古代南岛语族群沿海路定居新几内亚北海岸的迁徙。

en:
Iroquoian is the family of indigenous languages of eastern North America: its northern branches include the Six Nations tongues and Huron-Wyandot, while Cherokee forms its southern branch. The languages grouped here are less well-recorded northern branches outside the great confederacies.

Along the St. Lawrence, Laurentian was heard in Stadacona and Hochelaga when Jacques Cartier visited in 1535 and 1536; the Laurentian word canada, meaning village, passed into the name of the country. By the time Champlain arrived in 1608 its people had vanished, likely destroyed or driven off by Mohawk warfare.

Between lakes Ontario and Erie lived the Neutral, with some forty villages, until Haudenosaunee attacks dispersed them in 1651. Their kinsmen the Wenro had fled to the Wendat in 1638; south of Lake Erie the Erie were broken in the mid-1650s and adopted into the Seneca and other nations. These tongues survive in fragmentary missionary word lists.
zh:
易洛魁语是北美东部原住民的语系：北支包括六族诸语和休伦—怀恩多特语，切罗基语构成南支。大联盟之外还有记录较少的北部分支。

在圣劳伦斯河沿岸，雅克·卡蒂亚于1535年和1536年到访时，劳伦斯语通行于斯塔达科纳和霍赫拉加；劳伦斯语中意为“村庄”的“加拿大”一词后来成了国名。到1608年尚普兰到来时，这批人已经消失，多半毁于莫霍克人的战事或被逐走。

安大略湖与伊利湖之间住着中立人，拥有约四十个村落，1651年在易洛魁联盟的攻击下流散。他们的近亲温罗人已于1638年投奔休伦人；伊利湖以南的伊利人在1650年代中期被击溃，部众被塞内卡等族收养。这些语言零散保存在传教士的词表里。

en:
Japanese is the principal language of the Japonic family, whose other living branch is Ryukyuan. Proto-Japonic was carried to the islands by Yayoi settlers from the Korean peninsula around the fourth century BC, displacing the languages of the older Jōmon foragers.

Writing arrived from Baekje with Buddhism in the early fifth century; the early eighth-century Kojiki recorded Old Japanese through man'yōgana, Chinese characters used for their sound. During the Heian period, from 794, Chinese loanwords reshaped its vocabulary and phonology, while scribes simplified cursive characters into hiragana and derived katakana from character fragments.

Late Middle Japanese, between 1185 and 1600, absorbed Portuguese words such as pan and tabako, and Jesuit missionaries described it in grammars such as the Arte da Lingoa de Iapam. From the early seventeenth century the prestige dialect shifted from Kansai toward Edo, seat of the Tokugawa shoguns.
zh:
日语是日琉语族的主要语言，另一现存分支是琉球语。原始日语由弥生时代的定居者在公元前4世纪前后从朝鲜半岛带入列岛，取代了更早的绳文采集者的语言。

文字随佛教于5世纪初从百济传入；8世纪初的《古事记》借助万叶假名，即按读音借用的汉字，记录古日语。794年开始的平安时代，汉语借词改变了日语的词汇和音系；书手又把草书汉字简化为平假名，从汉字偏旁提炼出片假名。

1185—1600年的中世日语后期吸收了葡萄牙语借词，如pan和tabako，耶稣会传教士还编写了《日本大文典》等语法著作。17世纪初以后，权威方言从关西转向德川幕府驻地江户。

en:
Javanese is an Austronesian Malayo-Polynesian language spoken in central and eastern Java. Old Javanese or Kawi appears in the Sukabumi inscription of 804, in letters derived from India's Pallava script. From the 700s to the 1400s Kawi was the literary language of Java's Hindu-Buddhist courts.

Majapahit's founding in 1292 opened the final Kawi phase, which produced the Nagarakretagama of 1365, a eulogy of King Hayam Wuruk preserved on palm leaves in Bali and Lombok after Kawi ceased to be written in Java in the early 1500s. Modern Javanese emerged later that century as Islam took hold on the north coast, and the Arabic-based Pegon script was adopted.

The Mataram Sultanate moved the literary center to the Surakarta and Yogyakarta courts in the 1600s, fixing the written standard and ngoko and krama speech levels. Books were printed from the 1830s, at first in carakan.
zh:
爪哇语是爪哇中东部的南岛语系马来—波利尼西亚语族语言。古爪哇语又称卡维语，见于804年苏卡布米碑铭，文字源出印度帕拉瓦字母。8至15世纪，卡维语是爪哇印度教—佛教宫廷的文学语言。

1292年满者伯夷建国，开启卡维语的最后阶段，1365年赞颂国王哈奄·武禄的《爪哇史颂》作于此时；16世纪初卡维语在爪哇不再用于书写，《爪哇史颂》靠巴厘岛和龙目岛的贝叶抄本保存。16世纪晚些时候，伊斯兰教在北岸扎根，近代爪哇语兴起，采用阿拉伯字母的佩贡体。

17世纪马打兰苏丹国兴起，文学中心转到梭罗和日惹宫廷，奠定书面标准及恩戈科、克拉马两种语体。19世纪30年代起，书籍开始印行，起初使用爪哇字母。

en:
Jin is the Sinitic speech of the Shanxi loess plateau, covering most of Shanxi, central Inner Mongolia and neighboring parts of Hebei, Henan and Shaanxi. It takes its name from Jin, the ancient Spring and Autumn state of these lands. Yang Xiong's Fangyan, compiled in the Western Han, records the northwestern dialects of Zhao and Wei in this region.

Scholars trace its phonology to the northwestern pronunciation of the Tang, 618 to 907, and the Five Dynasties, 907 to 960, a link seen in the Tangut-Chinese wordbook of the Western Xia.

Unlike surrounding Mandarin dialects Jin keeps the entering tone as a distinct glottal-stop category, and builds words with rare prefixes and split-syllable forms. Long treated as a Mandarin branch for its partial mutual intelligibility with them, Jin is written in Chinese characters, with the Taiyuan dialect as its representative.
zh:
晋语是山西黄土高原上的汉语方言，分布于山西大部、内蒙古中部以及河北、河南、陕西邻接山西的边缘地带，名称取自春秋时的古国晋。西汉扬雄的《方言》已记载这一带“赵、魏之西北方言”。

学者认为它的音韵直承唐代（618—907年）和五代（907—960年）的西北方音传统，西夏时期的夏汉对照词书中也能看到这一联系。

与周边官话不同，晋语把入声作为独立调类保留，收喉塞音，并有罕见的词头和分音词构词法。因与邻近官话部分相通，晋语长期被归入官话；它以汉字书写，通常以太原话为代表。

en:
Jirajaran is the extinct language group of the dry hills and valleys of Falcón and Lara in western Venezuela. Its documented members are Jirajara, Ayomán and Gayón, with scarcely recorded neighbours such as Cuiba. The group is treated as a language isolate: evidence is too thin to prove any relationship, and contact with neighbours accounts for part of the shared vocabulary.

Its speakers farmed maize, cotton and yucca; the Gayones of the Tocuyo valley lived in such villages when the Spanish reached them. Juan de Carvajal founded El Tocuyo on their lands in 1545, and the town became capital of Venezuela Province from 1546, anchoring Spanish rule and sugar cultivation in Jirajaran country.

Through the colonial centuries the old tongues retreated before Spanish into fewer villages, recorded by later scholars only in fragmentary word lists rather than connected texts.
zh:
希拉哈拉语是委内瑞拉西部法尔孔和拉腊干旱丘陵河谷地带已消亡的语群。有文献记录的成员包括希拉哈拉语、阿约曼语和加永语，还有记录极少的奎瓦语等邻语。该语群被视为孤立语群：证据太少，无法证实任何亲缘关系，与邻语的接触能解释部分共有词汇。

操此语者种植玉米、棉花和木薯；西班牙人到来时，托库约河谷的加永人正生活在这样的村落里。1545年胡安·德·卡瓦哈尔在他们的土地上建立埃尔托库约，这座城镇从1546年起成为委内瑞拉省首府，将西班牙统治和甘蔗种植带入希拉哈拉地区。

殖民时代，这些语言在西班牙语面前退守到越来越少的村落里，后来的学者只能从零碎词表中记录它们。

en:
Jurchen was the Tungusic language of the Jurchen of eastern Manchuria and the Jin dynasty that ruled northern China in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries; it was the ancestor of Manchu. After founding Jin in 1115, the Jurchen wrote in Khitan script.

In 1119 the chancellor Wanyan Xiyin, on Emperor Aguda's orders, devised the Jurchen large script from Khitan and Chinese models; Emperor Xizong promulgated a small script in 1138, used officially from 1145. From 1164 Emperor Shizong's court translated classics and histories into the script; the Jin Victory Memorial Stele was erected in 1185.

The Mongol destruction of the Jin in 1234 threw the script into decline. Ming eunuch Yishiha erected a Jurchen inscription on the lower Amur in 1413, and Ming bureaus compiled Chinese-Jurchen vocabularies in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. The language evolved into early Manchu; in 1635 Hong Taiji renamed the people and language Manchu.
zh:
女真语是满洲东部女真人及12至13世纪统治中国北方的金朝的满—通古斯语，是满语的祖先。女真人于1115年建立金朝之初，仍借用契丹文书写。

1119年，丞相完颜希尹奉金太祖阿骨打之命，仿照契丹文和汉字创制女真大字；金熙宗于1138年颁行女真小字，1145年开始用于官方文书。1164年起，金世宗朝廷把经典和史书译成女真文；1185年立下《大金得胜陀颂碑》。

1234年蒙古灭金后，女真文衰落。1413年明朝宦官亦失哈在黑龙江下游立下女真文石碑，15至16世纪明朝译馆编纂了汉—女真对照词汇。口语演变为早期满语，1635年皇太极将女真族名和语言改称为满洲。

en:
Kachinic, or Jingpoish, is a cluster of Tibeto-Burman languages in the Sal branch spoken across the Kachin Hills of northern Myanmar and adjoining Yunnan and northeastern India. Its best-known member is Jingpho, the lingua franca of the Kachin confederation and standard language of around sixteen varieties; another is Kado, also called Kadu, spoken in the Chindwin valley.

The Kadu were the dominant people of that valley in the early second millennium until Chin and then Shan migrants moved in. The Jingpho pushed south of the twenty-eighth parallel in recent centuries, one tradition dating their passage through Putao to the 1600s, as the Shan states weakened.

Through the early nineteenth century the languages remained unwritten, carried by oral tradition, and highland dealings with the lowlands went on in Shan or Burmese.
zh:
克钦语又称景颇语支，是藏缅语族萨尔语群下的一群语言，通行于缅甸北部的克钦山区，以及云南和印度东北部的毗邻地带。其中最主要的是景颇语，它是克钦族群联盟的通用语，也是约十六种变体的标准语；另一支是卡杜语，又称卡都语，通行于钦敦江流域。

卡杜人在2千纪初期曾是该谷地的主体族群，直到钦人、其后是掸人相继迁入。景颇人在近几个世纪向南越过北纬二十八度，一说他们于17世纪经葡萄南下，背景是掸人诸邦的衰落。

直到19世纪初，克钦语仍没有文字，靠口耳相传，山民与低地打交道时使用掸语或缅语。

en:
Marshallese, self-called Kajin Majōl and sometimes known as Ebon after one of its atolls, is a Micronesian language of the Eastern Oceanic branch of Austronesian. Austronesian settlers reached these coral atolls as early as the second millennium BC, bringing coconuts, breadfruit and chickens. Their speech evolved into the language of two parallel island chains, with western Rālik and eastern Ratak dialects.

Proto-Micronesian consonants split under the influence of neighbouring vowels into palatalised, velarised and rounded series. The first Europeans were Spaniards: Alonso de Salazar reached Taongi in 1526 and Álvaro de Saavedra visited Ujelang and Enewetak in 1528.

Spanish galleons thereafter avoided the islands. European charts later named them after the British captain John Marshall, who sailed through in 1788.
zh:
马绍尔语自称 Kajin Majōl，有时因埃邦环礁而被称作埃邦语，属于南岛语系东大洋语支的密克罗尼西亚语族。早在公元前第二个千年，南岛语移民就抵达这些珊瑚环礁，带来椰子、面包果和鸡；他们的语言逐渐演化为两条平行岛链上的语言，分为西部拉利克方言和东部拉塔克方言。

原始密克罗尼西亚语的辅音受相邻元音影响发生分化，形成腭化、软腭化和圆唇三套对立。最早到来的欧洲人是西班牙人：阿隆索·德·萨拉查于1526年抵达塔翁吉，阿尔瓦罗·德·萨维德拉于1528年访问乌杰朗和埃尼威托克。

此后西班牙大帆船便绕开群岛。后来欧洲海图以1788年航行至此的英国船长约翰·马绍尔之名为群岛命名。

en:
Kalenjin is the principal Southern Nilotic language of the East African highlands, a close chain of dialects often called Nandi-Markweta or Elgeyo. Its speakers trace a migration from the Nile Valley and the Ethiopian highlands, which gathered pace from the eleventh century as pastoral communities spread through the grasslands of Uganda and western Kenya. Long contact with Cushitic peoples left loanwords connected with cattle and social organization, together with the age-set system and circumcision rites.

In the Kenyan Rift Valley these herders built the Elmenteitan and then the Sirikwa pastoral traditions, with fortified homesteads and stone circles, before Sirikwa communities joined the Nandi, Kipsigis and Pokot polities.

The Laparanat drought of about 1785 and the Aoyate dry period that peaked in the 1830s scattered the older Chemwal and Maliri groups. The ensuing Iloikop wars against the Maasai redrew the pastoral map around 1800.
zh:
卡伦津语是东非高原主要的南尼罗特语言，方言关系紧密，常称南迪—马克韦塔语或埃尔盖约语。其使用者的迁徙可追溯自尼罗河谷和埃塞俄比亚高原：11世纪起迁徙加快，牧人扩散到乌干达和肯尼亚西部草原。与库希特人的长期接触留下了牲畜和社会组织有关的借词，也带来了年龄组制度和割礼习俗。

在肯尼亚裂谷，牧人发展出埃尔门泰塔文化和其后的西里夸畜牧传统，留下设防家园和石圈；西里夸社群后来融入南迪、基普西吉斯和波科特政体。

约1785年的拉帕拉纳特大旱和19世纪30年代达到顶峰的奥亚泰干旱期，使切姆瓦尔人和马里里人离散。随后与马赛人的伊洛伊科普战争在1800年前后重绘了高原牧场版图。

en:
Kam, the language of the Dong people, gives its name to the Kam-Sui branch of the Kra-Dai family. These languages are spoken mainly in eastern Guizhou, western Hunan and northern Guangxi, and their speakers trace their descent to the Bai Yue and Rau peoples, who broke into small chiefdoms after the Yue kingdom collapsed around the first century. Kam splits into a more conservative southern form and a northern form more deeply marked by Chinese; centuries of contact added Chinese words to its vocabulary.

Kam had no traditional script, and speakers borrowed Chinese characters to note down its sounds. Dong history was carried orally in long polyphonic songs sung without instruments.

The Dong appear under their present name in Ming records after 1368, and their mountain valleys saw repeated, unsuccessful risings through the Ming and Qing dynasties.
zh:
侗语是侗族的语言，侗水语支因此得名，属于壮侗语系。这些语言主要通行于贵州东部、湖南西部和广西北部；其先民可追溯到百越和僚人，约在1世纪前后越人的王国解体，当地分裂为众多小酋邦。侗语分为保守的南部方言和受汉语影响更深的北部方言，长期接触使其词汇中增添了汉语借词。

侗语没有传统文字，需要记录时便借用汉字标注读音。本民族的历史靠无伴奏多声部的长篇大歌口头传唱下来。

侗族以此名称见于史籍是1368年明朝建立以后的事，明清两代山谷里爆发过一次次失败的起事。

en:
Kamarupi is the Middle Indo-Aryan speech of ancient Kamarupa, the Brahmaputra valley kingdom that held western Assam from the fifth to the twelfth century. Indo-Aryan settlers carried the language up the Brahmaputra by the fourth or fifth century, where it grew among Tibeto-Burman and Austroasiatic neighbours and took on an Austroasiatic substrate. In the seventh century the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang visited King Bhaskaravarman and found a vernacular distinct from that of Bengal.

A Prakrit of the Magadhi group, it is traced chiefly through provincial forms in the Sanskrit of Kamarupa's copper-plate inscriptions, including the merging of ś and ṣ into s.

Before 1250 it was splitting into proto-Kamta and early Assamese, the parents of later Assamese and Kamatapuri, while its local alphabet became the ancestor of the medieval Assamese scripts.
zh:
迦摩缕波语是古代迦摩缕波国的中古印度—雅利安语；这个王国以布拉马普特拉河谷为中心，5至12世纪间统治阿萨姆西部。印度—雅利安移民在4或5世纪沿布拉马普特拉河把这种语言带到当地，它在藏缅语和南亚语邻居环绕中发展，带上了南亚语底层。7世纪中国高僧玄奘造访国王婆塞羯罗伐摩时，注意到当地俗语与孟加拉一带不同。

它属于摩揭陀俗语群，面貌主要靠迦摩缕波铜版铭文里的梵语俗语特征推知，包括咝音ś和ṣ并入s。

1250年以前，这种语言已分化为原始卡姆塔语和早期阿萨姆语，即后世阿萨姆语与卡玛塔普里诸语的前身，而它的本地字母也成为中世纪阿萨姆诸字体的源头。

en: Kambiwa, also called Cambioá, is an extinct unclassified language once spoken by the Kambiwa people of Pernambuco in north-eastern Brazil. Pressured by colonial settlers, they left their early homes around the Serra Negra, which they kept as a sacred territory, and the language is known only from short word lists showing a couple of Tupi borrowings.
zh: 坎比瓦语又称坎比奥阿语，是巴西东北部伯南布哥州坎比瓦人使用过的一种已消亡的未分类语言。在殖民定居者的压力下，他们离开了内格拉山一带的早期家园，但仍将此山视为圣地；该语言只留下简短词表，其中有个别借自图皮语的词。

en: Kanisian is the language of the Canichana people of the Bolivian Amazon, formerly spoken along the Mamoré and Machupo rivers in the lowlands of the Beni department. No link to any other language has been demonstrated, so it is usually treated as a language isolate.
zh: 卡尼西语是玻利维亚亚马逊地区卡尼西人的语言，曾通行于贝尼省低地的马莫雷河与马丘波河一带。它与其他语言没有可证实的亲缘关系，通常被视为孤立语言。

en:
Kannada is a South Dravidian language, the principal speech of Karnataka in south-western India. Its history falls into Old Kannada from about 450, Middle Kannada from 1200 and Modern Kannada from 1700. Its earliest records include the fifth-century Halmidi inscription, in the Kadamba script from which the Kannada alphabet descends. It was the court language of successive Deccan dynasties, including the Rashtrakutas and Hoysalas.

Old Kannada literature, mostly by Jain court poets, opened with the Kavirajamarga of about 850, a treatise on poetics and grammar, and flourished under the Rashtrakutas. Ranna compiled the first Kannada dictionary in 996.

The grammar Shabdamanidarpana of about 1260 fixed Middle Kannada literary norms, used by the thirteenth-century Shaiva poets Harihara and Raghavanka for hagiographies and devotional verse. Kannada was influenced by Sanskrit and Prakrit and has southern, northern, central and coastal dialects.
zh:
卡纳达语是达罗毗荼语族南支的语言，是印度西南部卡纳塔克邦的主要语言，其历史分为约450年起的古卡纳达语、1200年起的中卡纳达语和1700年起的近代卡纳达语。最早的记录包括5世纪的哈尔米迪石柱铭文，所用的卡丹巴字母是卡纳达文字的源头。它曾是德干高原一连串王朝的宫廷语言，其中包括罗湿陀罗拘陀和曷萨拉两朝。

古卡纳达语文学多出自耆那教宫廷诗人之手，开山之作是约850年的诗学与语法著作《诗王之路》，在罗湿陀罗拘陀朝盛极一时。兰纳于996年编成第一部卡纳达语词典。

约1260年的语法书《词语明镜》确立了中卡纳达语书面语的规范，13世纪的湿婆派诗人哈里哈拉和拉加万卡用它撰写圣徒行传和虔诚诗。卡纳达语受梵语和俗语影响，分为南、北、中、沿海四种方言。

en:
Kapampangan is a Central Luzon language of the Austronesian family, spoken on the central plains of Luzon in the Philippines, chiefly in Pampanga and southern Tarlac. Its name comes from pampang, meaning riverbank, and its speakers honorifically call it Amanung Sisuan, the nurtured language.

Before Spanish colonization it was written in an indigenous syllabic script and was current in the wealthy Kingdom of Tondo on Manila Bay, whose rulers bore the title of lakan.

Under Spanish rule the Latin alphabet took over, and the Augustinian Diego Bergano published an Arte de la lengua Pampanga in 1729 and a Vocabulario in 1732. Maritime trade and Spanish rule left Sanskrit and Spanish loanwords, and the nineteenth century brought a literary flowering around playwrights such as Anselmo Fajardo.
zh:
邦板牙语是南岛语系中吕宋语支的语言，通行于菲律宾吕宋岛中部平原，主要在邦板牙省和打拉省南部。其名称源自意为河岸的邦庞一词，使用者还敬称它为阿马农·西苏安，即哺育之语。

西班牙殖民之前，邦板牙语用本土音节文字书写，通行于马尼拉湾畔富庶的汤都王国，该国统治者称号为拉坎。

西班牙统治时期拉丁字母取而代之，奥古斯丁会士迭戈·贝尔加尼奥于1729年出版《邦板牙语技艺》、1732年出版《邦板牙语词汇》。海上贸易和西班牙统治给它留下了梵语和西班牙语借词，19世纪出现了以剧作家安塞尔莫·法哈多为代表的文学繁荣。

en:
Karenic is a tonal branch of the Sino-Tibetan family spoken by the Karen peoples across southern and southeastern Myanmar and western Thailand. Its chief languages are Sgaw, Pwo and Pa'O, with Karenni and Kayan forming further branches. Karenic puts the object after the verb, an order usually attributed to long contact with Mon and Tai speakers.

Karen oral tradition traces the people to a migration from a river of sand, likely far to the north. By the Konbaung era they were settled in the eastern hills and delta under Burmese rule, the lowland Pwo living among the Mon while Sgaw communities kept to the highlands.

The languages had no script until the early 1830s, when Baptist missionaries, at work among the Karen from 1830, created the Sgaw alphabet from Burmese letters and began translating and printing in the language.
zh:
克伦语是汉藏语系下的一支声调语言，由克伦各族使用，通行于缅甸南部、东南部和泰国西部。它的主要语言是斯高语、波语和巴奥语，克耶语和克延语则构成另外的分支。克伦语采用主语—动词—宾语的语序，一般认为是长期与孟人、傣泰人接触所致。

克伦人的口传记忆把祖先追溯为自一条可能位于遥远北方的“流沙河”迁徙而来。到贡榜时代，他们已定居在缅甸治下的东部山地与三角洲，低地的波人与孟人杂居，斯高人则居于高地。

克伦语原本没有文字，直到19世纪30年代初，自1830年起在克伦人中传教的浸礼会士仿照缅文创制了斯高克伦字母，开始用克伦语翻译和印行书籍。

en:
Karluk is the southeastern branch of the Turkic family, taking its name from the Karluk tribal confederation whose varieties spread across Central Asia from the 5th to the 8th centuries; its chief later descendants are Uzbek and Uyghur.

Its first literary form was Karakhanid, the first Islamic Turkic literary language, written in Arabic script from the 1000s in the Kara-Khanid Khanate and exemplified by Yusuf Khass Hajib's Kutadgu Bilig and Mahmud al-Kashgari's Dīwān Lughāt al-Turk.

From Karakhanid came Khorezmian Turkic, the literary language of the Golden Horde in the 1200s and 1300s, laced with local Oghuz and Kipchak words. It in turn gave way to Chagatai, the shared Turkic literary tongue of the Chagatai, Timurid and Mughal realms, which carried Karluk speech in administration and letters from Kashgar to the Volga.
zh:
葛逻禄语是突厥语族的东南语支，得名于5至8世纪活跃于中亚的葛逻禄部落联盟，其后来的两大后裔是乌兹别克语和维吾尔语。

它最早的文学形式是喀喇汗语，即第一种伊斯兰突厥文学语言，11世纪起在喀喇汗汗国用阿拉伯字母书写，代表作有优素福·哈斯·哈吉甫的《福乐智慧》和马哈茂德·喀什噶里的《突厥语大词典》。

喀喇汗语又演化为花剌子模突厥语，即13至14世纪金帐汗国的文学语言，吸收了当地乌古斯和钦察词汇。花剌子模突厥语随后让位于察合台语，后者成为察合台汗国、帖木儿帝国和莫卧儿帝国通用的突厥文学语言，使葛逻禄语在行政和文书领域从喀什噶尔一直通行到伏尔加河流域。

en:
Kashmiri, called Koshur by its speakers, is the chief language of the Kashmir Valley and the largest member of the Dardic group, a geographical cluster of northwestern Indo-Aryan hill languages across the Hindu Kush. These preserve archaic Old Indo-Aryan features such as three sibilants; the extinct Gandhari language was of the same type.

Kashmiri took shape as it emerged from Apabhramsha Prakrit, and its first literary monuments are the vakhs, short mystical verses of the Shaivite poet Lal Ded, who lived from about 1320 to 1392.

From the 8th century Kashmiri was written in the Sharada script, but from the 14th century Persian served as the court language under the Muslim sultans, enriching Kashmiri vocabulary, and the Perso-Arabic script gradually joined Sharada as a literary hand. Kashmiri has a verb-second word order, unusual for Indo-Aryan.
zh:
克什米尔语的母语者称之为科舒尔语，是克什米尔谷地的主要语言，也是达尔德语支中最大的一支。达尔德诸语是沿兴都库什山分布的印度—雅利安语西北部山地语言群，按地理划分。这些语言保留了三咝音等古印度—雅利安语的古老特征，已消亡的犍陀罗语也属同一类型。

克什米尔语在阿帕布拉姆沙俗语的基础上成形，最早的文学作品是湿婆派女诗人拉尔·德德（约1320—1392年）的短篇神秘诗瓦赫。

它从8世纪起使用沙拉达字母书写，14世纪穆斯林苏丹统治时期波斯语成为宫廷语言，词汇进入克什米尔语，波斯—阿拉伯字体也逐渐与沙拉达字母并行。克什米尔语采用动词第二位语序，这在印度—雅利安诸语中颇为少见。

en:
Katuic is a branch of around fifteen Austroasiatic languages in the middle Mekong region, spoken in Thailand, Laos, Cambodia and the Annamite hills of Vietnam. Its western languages, Kuy and Bru, have the most speakers; smaller branches include the namesake Katu group, judged the most conservative.

The Bru, whose name means people of the woods, hold the Annamite highlands and trace ties to the Khmer kingdom of Angkor at its height between the 800s and the 1200s. The Kuy are regarded as older inhabitants between the Mun River and the Dangrek Mountains; their Tai exonym Suay means tribute-payers.

The elephant Kuy of Surin were famed as catchers and trainers of wild elephants for lowland courts. In this period Katuic remained unwritten, transmitted orally in swidden-farming villages, while writing and religion reached them through the Lao, Thai or Khmer of the plains.
zh:
戈都语是南亚语系的一支，包含约十五种语言，分布在湄公河中游的泰国、老挝、柬埔寨和越南长山山区。西支的归语和布鲁语使用人数最多，其余小支包括得名来源、也被认为最保守的戈都语。

布鲁人其名意为“林中之人”，居于长山高地，其先世可追溯到9世纪至13世纪鼎盛时期的吴哥高棉王国。归人被认为是蒙河与扁担山脉之间更古老的居民，傣泰语称他们为“索伊”，意为纳贡者。

素林的“象夫归人”以捕捉和驯练野象、供应低地宫廷而闻名。这一时期戈都语始终没有文字，靠轮垦村落里的口耳相传，文字与信仰则经平原上的老挝语、泰语或高棉语传入。

en: Kaulong, also called Pasismanua, is an Oceanic Austronesian language of the island of New Britain in Papua New Guinea, spoken by swidden farmers in the southwest hinterlands of Kandrian District in West New Britain Province. Within Oceanic it belongs to the Pasismanua linkage of the Ngero–Vitiaz branch, alongside Aigon, Miu, Karore and Sengseng.
zh: 考隆语又名帕西斯马努阿语，是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛的一种泛太平洋语族南岛语，由西新不列颠省坎德里安区西南部内陆的游耕农人使用。在泛太平洋语族中，它与艾贡语、米乌语、卡罗雷语和森森语同属恩杰罗—维亚茨分支下的帕西斯马努阿语链。

en:
Kavango denotes the cluster of Bantu languages spoken along the Kavango River on the Namibia-Angola border, together with their close Southwest Bantu kin across northern Namibia and southern Angola. The riverine Kavango varieties each belong to one of the five matrilineal Kavango kingdoms, with RuKwangali the most widely used. Their relatives include the Ovambo dialects, the Herero language of the cattle-keeping Ovaherero, and Nyaneka and Umbundu farther into Angola.

Bantu farmers and herders entered this region from the northeast: Ovambo groups began settling near the Angola-Namibia border around the 1300s and pushed farther south during the 1600s. Before the 1800s these peoples kept largely to themselves, untouched by the caravan trade reaching other parts of southern Africa.
zh:
卡万戈语指通行于纳米比亚与安哥拉边境卡万戈河沿岸的一组班图语言，以及它们在纳米比亚北部、安哥拉南部的西南班图近亲。沿河的卡万戈分支分别对应五个母系传承的卡万戈王国，其中鲁克万加利语使用最广。亲属语言包括奥万博诸方言、牧牛的赫雷罗人所说的赫雷罗语，以及更深入安哥拉境内的尼亚内卡语和翁本杜语。

班图农耕者和牧人从东北方进入这一地区：奥万博诸部在1300年前后开始定居于安哥拉与纳米比亚边境一带，1600年代又继续向南推进。在1800年代以前，这些族群大体与世隔绝，未曾受到波及南部非洲其他地区的商队贸易影响。

en:
Kavieng corresponds above all to Tigak, also called Omo, the Oceanic language whose territory takes in the town of Kavieng on Balgai Bay at the northern tip of New Ireland, in the Bismarck Archipelago. Tigak belongs to the Meso-Melanesian linkage of the Oceanic branch of Austronesian, alongside Nalik, Kara and Notsi; inland the isolate Kuot is the island's only non-Austronesian language.

The first Austronesian speakers reached the Bismarcks with the Lapita seafarers roughly three thousand years ago, and their speech developed into the local Oceanic languages. The Dutch navigators Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten made the first recorded European landfall on New Ireland in 1616.

William Dampier established that New Ireland was a separate island in 1700. From 1799 whaling ships began calling regularly for water and provisions, drawing the northern coast into wider Pacific contacts.
zh:
卡维恩语主要对应蒂加克语（又称奥莫语），这是一种大洋洲语言，通行范围包括俾斯麦群岛新爱尔兰岛北端巴尔盖湾畔的卡维恩镇。蒂加克语属于南岛语系大洋洲语族的中美拉尼西亚语链，与纳利克语、卡拉语、诺齐语同属一支，内陆的库奥特语是全岛唯一的非南岛孤立语言。

约三千年前，拉皮塔航海者把最早的南岛语带到俾斯麦群岛，这些语言逐渐演化为当地的大洋洲语。1616年，荷兰航海家雅各布·勒梅尔和威廉·斯考滕完成了有记载以来欧洲人对新爱尔兰岛的首次登陆。

1700年，威廉·丹皮尔确认新爱尔兰岛是一座独立岛屿。1799年起，捕鲸船开始定期靠岸补给淡水和给养，北海岸由此被纳入更广阔的太平洋交往网络。

en:
Kawesqar, also called Alacaluf, is the language of the Kawesqar, a canoe-nomad people of the fjords and channels of western Patagonia, formerly heard from the Gulf of Penas to the waters south of the Strait of Magellan. It is the chief surviving member of the small Alacalufan family, whose northern and southern varieties were known as Aksana and Hekaine.

The language had no writing of its own, and its first recorded vocabulary was compiled in 1698 by the French adventurer Jean de la Guilbaudiere.

From the seventeenth century Jesuits based on Chiloe sailed into the channels to gather the canoe peoples into their missions. In the 1760s a grammar of the speech of the Calen and Taijataf groups was being written at the Cailin mission, only to be lost when the missionary carrying it drowned in the Patagonian channels.
zh:
卡韦斯卡尔语又称阿拉卡卢夫语，是西巴塔哥尼亚峡湾与水道间以独木舟游猎的卡韦斯卡尔人的语言，通行范围曾从佩尼亚斯湾延伸到麦哲伦海峡以南海域。它是阿拉卡卢夫语系中留存下来的主要语言，该语系分北方的阿克萨纳和南方的海凯内两支。

这种语言没有自己的文字，现存最早的词汇表由法国冒险家让·德·拉·吉博迪埃于1698年记录。

17世纪起，驻奇洛埃岛的耶稣会士乘船进入水道，试图把操舟民族迁入传教团。18世纪60年代，凯林传教团曾编写一部卡伦人和塔哈塔费人语言的语法，但携带稿件的传教士在穿行巴塔哥尼亚水道时溺水，书稿也就此遗失。

en: Kayagar is the name given to a small group of closely related Trans–New Guinea languages spoken around the Cook River in what is now South Papua province of Indonesia. Besides Kayagar itself, the group comprises Atohwaim, Tamagario and the Gondu River and Yogo varieties, all recorded only in the twentieth century by missionaries and linguists.
zh: 卡亚加尔语是对一组关系紧密的跨新几内亚语系语言的称呼，通行于今印度尼西亚南巴布亚省库克河一带。除卡亚加尔语本支外，该语群还包括阿托赫瓦伊姆语、塔马加里奥语以及贡杜河语、约戈语等变体，它们都是20世纪才由传教士和语言学者记录下来的。

en:
Kayambi was the pre-Inca language of the Kayambi people of the northern Ecuadorian highlands, around the Cayambe volcano north of Quito. It is known almost only from place names ending in -bi, and like Caranqui it may have belonged to the Barbacoan family, though the evidence is inconclusive.

From about 1500 the Kayambi confederation with the neighbouring Caranqui, led by the Cochasquí ruler Quilago, held out for some twenty years against Huayna Capac before defeat at the lake of Yawarkucha ended its independence. The Incas then settled Quechua-speaking colonists in the region and the Kayambi adopted Kichwa; their old tongue, like Caranqui, is thought to have died out during the eighteenth century.
zh:
卡扬比语是厄瓜多尔北部高原卡扬比人的前印加语言，分布在基多以北的卡扬贝火山一带。它几乎只留下一批以“比”收尾的地名，和卡兰基语一样可能属于巴尔巴科亚语系，但证据并不充分。

约1500年起，卡扬比人与邻近卡兰基人的联盟在科查斯基统治者基拉戈带领下与瓦伊纳·卡帕克抗衡了约二十年，最终在亚瓦尔库查湖畔战败，丧失独立。印加人随后把讲克丘亚语的殖民者迁入此地，卡扬比人改说基奇瓦语；他们的旧语言与卡兰基语一样，一般认为在18世纪间消亡。

en:
Kayanic, more fully the Kayan-Murik languages, is the Malayo-Polynesian group spoken by the upriver Dayak peoples of the Borneo interior: the Kayan dialects, the closely related Bahau and the Murik. Its speakers trace their homeland to the Apo Kayan plateau of North Kalimantan, shared by the Kayan and Kenyah.

Over the centuries they spread into Sarawak as part of the Orang Ulu, or upriver people, and their expansion collided with Iban groups moving in the same period. They lived by shifting upland-rice cultivation, built longhouses, and were feared headhunters whose warriors held feasts of collected heads.

Their smiths traded forged swords and their singers preserved history in the sung Tekna' epics. In the 1600s the Kayan sub-group Uma Apan pushed into eastern Borneo, adopted Islam and gave rise to the Bulungan people and their sultanate.
zh:
卡扬语全称卡扬—穆里克语，是婆罗洲内陆上游达雅各族使用的马来—波利尼西亚语，包括卡扬方言以及关系密切的巴豪语和穆里克语。使用者把祖地追溯到北加里曼丹的阿波卡扬高原，那里由卡扬人与肯雅人共居。

几个世纪里他们迁入沙捞越，成为乌鲁人（上游之人）的一部分，迁徙途中与同期扩张的伊班人发生冲突。他们经营山地稻游耕、居住长屋，是令人畏惧的猎头者，武士举行猎头宴。

铁匠打造的剑用于贸易，歌者则以歌唱史诗《特纳》传承历史。17世纪，卡扬人的乌马阿潘支系深入婆罗洲东部并改宗伊斯兰教，形成布隆岸人和布隆岸苏丹国。

en:
Kei, called Veveu Evav by its speakers, is an Austronesian language of the Kei Islands in the southeastern Moluccas. It belongs to the Kei–Fordata branch of the Kei–Tanimbar group. Kei is the archipelago's lingua franca, used alongside Kur and the Banda speech brought by refugees from the Banda Islands after the Dutch conquest of 1621.

Each island and village has its own dialect; the Kei Kecil dialect carries the most prestige. Customary order rests on rat, or rajas, and Larvul Ngabal, which local tradition traces to princess Dit Sakmas and ancestors said to have come from Bali in the fourteenth-century heyday of Majapahit.

Kei had no indigenous writing tradition; Dutch Catholic missionaries first recorded it in a Roman-based orthography. Kei is often said to derive from the Portuguese word kayos, stone, after the rocky atolls navigators encountered in the sixteenth century.
zh:
凯语在母语者口中称 Veveu Evav，是摩鹿加东南部卡伊群岛的南岛语。它属于凯—塔宁巴尔语群的凯—福尔达塔语支。凯语是群岛的通用语，与库尔语以及1621年荷兰征服班达群岛后难民带来的班达语并存。

每个岛屿和村庄都有自己的方言，其中以小卡伊岛方言声望最高。群岛的传统秩序依靠拉特（即拉者）和习惯法《拉尔武尔·恩加巴尔法》维系；当地传说这部法典出自公主蒂特·萨克马斯和在14世纪满者伯夷强盛时期自巴厘岛迁来的祖先。

凯语没有本土文字传统，荷兰天主教传教士最早用拉丁字母记录了这种语言。“凯”这个名称通常认为源自葡萄牙语 kayos（石头），因16世纪航海者见到的多石环礁而得名。

en:
Kejia, or Hakka, is the language of the Hakka people, the guest families whose name records their northern origins, spread across the hills of northeastern Guangdong, southern Jiangxi and southwestern Fujian. Their ancestors left the Central Plains of Henan and Shaanxi in waves of flight beginning with the collapse of the Western Jin around 311.

Linguists place its phonological formation in the Song, 960 to 1279, when Gan-speaking settlers pushed into the She mountains of western Fujian and absorbed much of the native She population. By the middle Ming it had become a distinct branch, the closest sister of Gan, with a possible Hmong-Mien substrate.

The Meixian dialect of Guangdong serves as its standard, and Hakka is written in Chinese characters. Its speech keeps archaic features lost in Mandarin, above all the checked finals -p, -t and -k.
zh:
客家话是客家民系的母语，“客家”之名记下了他们北人南迁的来历；它主要分布在广东东北部、江西南部和福建西南部的丘陵山区。客家人的祖先原居河南、陕西一带的中原，自311年前后西晋灭亡之际起，几度在战乱中南迁。

学者认为其音韵体系在宋代（960—1279年）成形：当时讲赣语的移民进入闽西畲人的山区，大量畲人转而使用这种语言。到明代中叶，客家话已发展为独立的一支，与赣语关系最近，底层中可能含有苗瑶语成分。

广东梅县话是客家话的代表方言，客家话使用汉字书写。客家话保留了官话已经失去的古音，尤其是-p、-t、-k三套入声韵尾。

en:
Keres, or Keresan, is the language of the seven Keres pueblos of New Mexico and is treated as a language isolate, since attempts to attach it to Hokan–Siouan or other large groupings have not been substantiated. Its dialects fall into Eastern and Western groups, differing enough to be counted as separate languages by some scholars.

Biological evidence and Cochiti oral tradition suggest the Keres entered the Rio Grande drainage from the west in the early 1300s, after the El Morro valley was abandoned. Coronado's lieutenant Hernando de Alvarado visited cliff-top Acoma in 1540.

When Juan de Oñate colonized New Mexico, Acoma rose against the intruders and in 1599 Spanish troops sacked the pueblo in the Acoma Massacre. Missions and saints' names followed, and in 1680 the Keres pueblos joined the Pueblo Revolt.
zh:
凯雷斯语又称凯雷桑语，是新墨西哥七个凯雷斯普韦布洛的语言，被划为孤立语言——把它并入霍坎—苏语等大语系的尝试未能证实。它的方言分为东、西两组，差别显著，有些学者把它们算作两门独立的语言。

体质人类学证据和科奇蒂人的口传表明，凯雷斯人可能在14世纪初埃尔莫罗河谷荒废之后，自西边迁入里奥格兰德河流域。1540年，科罗纳多的副将埃尔南多·德·阿尔瓦拉多造访了崖顶之上的阿科马。

胡安·德·奥尼亚特征服新墨西哥时，阿科马人奋起反抗，1599年西班牙军队在阿科马大屠杀中洗劫了这座普韦布洛。此后传教站和圣徒地名相继而来，1680年各凯雷斯普韦布洛又投身普韦布洛起义。

en:
Khasi is the principal language of the Khasic branch of Austroasiatic, an isolated relative of the Munda tongues, spoken by the Khasi people of the Shillong Plateau in Meghalaya, with smaller communities in Assam and Bangladesh. Its sister speeches include Pnar, War and Lyngngam, and together they form an ancient Austroasiatic enclave in north-eastern India, preserved as Indo-Aryan and Sino-Tibetan languages spread around them.

Khasi makes wide use of prefixes and infixes, places classifiers between numerals and nouns, and divides its nouns into four genders. The Khasi were organized into small matrilineal hill states and long kept their speech without a script; their polities fought British expansion under the leader Tirot Sing in the war of 1829 to 1833.
zh:
卡西语是南亚语系卡西语支的主要语言，与蒙达诸语是远亲，由梅加拉亚邦西隆高原的卡西人使用，阿萨姆邦和孟加拉国也有小型社群。它的姊妹语言包括普纳尔语、瓦尔语和林甘语，共同构成印度东北部一块古老的南亚语飞地，在印度—雅利安语和汉藏语扩张中保留下来。

卡西语大量使用前缀和中缀，数词与名词之间加量词，名词分四个性。卡西人组成若干母系传承的山地小邦，长期没有文字；各邦在领袖蒂罗特·辛格率领下，于1829—1833年的战争中抵抗英国扩张。

en:
Khmer is the principal Austroasiatic language of mainland Southeast Asia, native to the Cambodian plain and also spoken by the Khmer Krom and the Northern Khmer. Unlike Thai, Lao and Vietnamese, it is a non-tonal language, its royal and religious vocabulary steeped in Sanskrit and Pali.

It was first written before the seventh century in an abugida derived from the Pallava letters of southern India; the Thai and Lao scripts later grew out of the Khmer system. Old Khmer and Angkorian speech carried the inscriptions of Chenla and Angkor, and the Khmer Ramayana, the Reamker, was known from a seventh-century inscription, though its surviving poem is sixteenth-century work.

After Angkor's fall in the early 1400s, Middle Khmer absorbed Thai literary loans; Ayutthayan conquests under Naresuan isolated the northern dialects, while in the 1600s a Khmer army retook Stung Treng.
zh:
高棉语是东南亚大陆最主要的南亚语系语言，本土在柬埔寨平原，下高棉人和北高棉人也说这种语言。与泰语、老挝语、越南语不同，高棉语无声调，王室和宗教词汇中有大量梵语和巴利语成分。

早在7世纪以前，高棉人便使用源自南印度帕拉瓦字母的拼音文字，泰文和老挝文后来在高棉文字体系的基础上发展而来。古高棉语和吴哥时期高棉语承载了真腊和吴哥的碑铭；高棉版《罗摩衍那》史诗《林给》在7世纪的碑刻中已有记载，现存诗稿则成于16世纪。

15世纪初吴哥陷落之后，中古高棉语吸收了泰语文学借词；纳黎萱麾下阿瑜陀耶的征服使北方方言与本土隔绝，而17世纪高棉军队收复上丁地区。

en:
Khmu is the chief language of the Khmuic branch of the Austroasiatic family, spoken mainly in the hills of northern Laos and adjoining Vietnam, Thailand and Yunnan. The Khmuic peoples are thought to descend from early settlers of northern Indochina; they once held the lowlands of Laos and northern Thailand until Mon and Khmer empires and then incoming Tai peoples absorbed them or drove them into the mountains.

When Fa Ngum founded the Tai-Lao kingdom of Lan Xang in 1353, the Khmu were swidden farmers known as the Lao Theung. Khmu has no standard variety: its western dialects contrast breathy and tense registers, while eastern dialects keep a three-way contrast of initial consonants. Long unwritten, the language was carried chiefly by oral story-telling.
zh:
克木语是南亚语系克木语支的代表语言，主要通行于老挝北部山区及越南、泰国和云南的毗邻地带。克木族群被认为是印度支那北部早期定居者的后裔，曾居住在老挝和泰国北部的低地，先后被孟人、高棉人的政权和迁入的傣泰人同化或逼入山区。

1353年法昂建立傣族人的澜沧王国时，克木人已从事轮垦农业，被称为“老听人”。克木语没有标准语：西部方言以气声和紧嗓两种音区区别词义，东部方言则保留三套声母对立。克木语长期没有文字，主要靠口述故事传承。

en:
Khoe is the largest of the non-Bantu language families native to southern Africa, marked by click consonants. Its two branches are Khoekhoe and Tshu–Khwe.

Speakers of ancestral Khoe–Kwadi entered what is now Botswana from the north-east about two thousand years ago, keeping sheep and cattle; the south-western branch that retained pastoralism became the Khoekhoe, while groups left in the drying Kalahari turned to hunting and gathering. The Nama spread through Namibia from the sixteenth century, absorbing client peoples such as the Damara.

Portuguese crews met Khoekhoe clans at the Cape, and in 1510 the !Uriǁ'aekua defeated a Portuguese landing party at the Salt River and killed the viceroy Francisco de Almeida. After Dutch settlement, Cape Khoe lost ground to Afrikaans, while in the 1770s clans such as the Orlam Afrikaners began trekking north into Namibia, carrying Nama beyond the Orange River.
zh:
科伊语是南部非洲本土非班图语族中最大的一支，以吸气音为特征。它分为科伊科伊语和丘—科韦语两支。

约两千年前，说原始科伊—夸迪语的族群从东北方向进入今博茨瓦纳，饲养绵羊和牛；保留游牧生活的西南支成为科伊科伊人，留在日益干旱的卡拉哈里的群体则转向狩猎采集。纳马人自16世纪起在纳米比亚扩张，吸纳了达马拉等依附族群。

葡萄牙船员在开普接触科伊科伊诸部；1510年，乌里奎夸人在盐河击败一支葡萄牙登陆队，击杀总督弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达。荷兰人定居后，开普的科伊语逐渐被南非荷兰语排挤；18世纪70年代，奥拉姆·阿非利卡等部族开始向北迁徙进入纳米比亚，把纳马语带到奥兰治河以北。

en:
Kilivila, also called Kiriwina, is an Oceanic language of the Papuan Tip cluster, spoken by the Trobriand islanders of the Trobriand Islands in the Solomon Sea off the eastern tip of New Guinea. It belongs to the Kilivila–Misima linkage, and its several dialects correspond to the different tribes of the main island.

Its speakers are organized in matrilineal clans that hold land in common and take part in the kula, a far-flung circuit of shell exchange carried out in large seagoing canoes. The islands were unknown to Europeans until 1793, when a French expedition charted them and named the group after its officer Denis de Trobriand.
zh:
基利维拉语又称基里维纳语，是泛太平洋语系巴布亚尖端语群的一支大洋语，由新几内亚东端外海所罗门海中特罗布里恩群岛的岛民使用。它属于基利维拉—米西马语链，其多种方言与主岛上不同的部落相对应。

说这种语言的岛民按母系氏族组织、共同占有土地，并参与库拉圈——一种乘坐大型远洋独木舟、在岛屿之间巡回交换贝壳饰品的贸易网络。欧洲人原本不知道这些岛屿，直到1793年一支法国探险队测绘了此地，并以其军官德·特罗布里昂的名字为群岛命名。

en:
The Kipchak or Northwestern Turkic languages descend from the speech of the Kipchak and Cuman nomads who dominated the Pontic-Caspian steppe between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries; their medieval form is recorded in the Codex Cumanicus of 1303.

After the Mongol conquest of Cumania the language became the Turkic speech of the Golden Horde, whose ruler Özbeg Khan adopted Islam during his reign from 1312 to 1341. After Timur's invasion of 1396 the Horde fragmented, and during the fifteenth century its lands passed to successor states including the Crimean Khanate and the Kazakh Khanate, each with its own Kipchak dialect.

The Great Horde collapsed in 1502, the literary Cuman of Hungary died out in the early eighteenth century, and the Crimean Khanate was annexed by Russia in 1783. From these forms descend the Tatar, Bashkir, Kazakh, Kyrgyz and Nogai languages.
zh:
钦察语又称西北突厥语，源自11至13世纪称雄黑海—里海草原的钦察人和库曼游牧民的语言，其中古形态见于1303年的《库曼语汇编》。

蒙古征服库曼尼亚后，这门语言成为金帐汗国的突厥语，月即别汗在1312—1341年在位期间皈依伊斯兰教。1396年帖木儿入侵后，金帐汗国走向瓦解，15世纪时其领土分属克里米亚汗国、哈萨克汗国等继承国，各有自己的钦察方言。

大帐汗国于1502年灭亡，匈牙利的书面库曼语在18世纪初绝迹，克里米亚汗国则于1783年被俄罗斯吞并。鞑靼语、巴什基尔语、哈萨克语、吉尔吉斯语和诺盖语便是由这些形态发展而来。

en:
Kiwaian is a close-knit language family of southern Papua New Guinea, spoken in the deltas of the Fly and Bamu rivers and along the Gulf of Papua, with Kiwai Island and Daru at its heart. Its members differ little enough to read as dialects of one another.

Although their grammar has diverged sharply from neighbouring Trans–New Guinea speech, a stock of shared basic words leads most classifiers to place Kiwaian within that wider family.

The coastal Kiwai were noted seafarers, whose canoes carried their language across the delta and into the Torres Strait, where islanders and Papuan communities had traded for millennia. The first European ships reached those waters in 1606, when the Spanish navigator Luís Vaz de Torres sailed along the southern coast of New Guinea; the strait between New Guinea and Australia was later named after him.
zh:
基万语是巴布亚新几内亚南部一个关系紧密的语族，通行于弗莱河与巴穆河的三角洲及巴布亚湾沿岸，核心地带是基万岛和达鲁。各语言彼此差异很小，可视作方言。

虽然它的语法与邻近的跨新几内亚语言分化明显，但共有的基础词汇使多数分类学者仍把基万语归入跨新几内亚语系。

沿海的基万人以航海著称，独木舟把他们的语言带到三角洲各处和托雷斯海峡，海峡岛民与巴布亚社群之间的贸易已有数千年历史。1606年，西班牙航海家路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯沿新几内亚南海岸航行，欧洲船只首次进入这片水域，新几内亚与澳大利亚之间的海峡后来便以他的名字命名为托雷斯海峡。

en:
Koiari, also called Koiali or Grass Koiari, is a Papuan language of southeastern New Guinea, spoken in the hinterland of Port Moresby and along the Hunter and Musgrave rivers. It belongs to the Koiarian family, a small group within the Southeast Papuan branch of the Trans–New Guinea languages, spread across the Bird's Tail peninsula.

The family divides into a Koiaric branch and a Baraic branch on the Managalas Plateau. Koiari itself has western and eastern dialect groups that differ only in minor points of phonology and vocabulary, and its speakers live interspersed with Motu and Koita villages near the harbour of Port Moresby.

The Spanish explorer Yñigo Ortiz de Retez gave New Guinea its name in 1545, yet for centuries afterward outsiders knew only its coasts, and the Koiari-speaking hinterland remained little affected by the outside world.
zh:
科亚里语又称科亚利语或草原科亚里语，是新几内亚东南部的一种巴布亚语言，通行于莫尔斯比港内陆以及亨特河、马斯格雷夫河一带。它属于科亚里安语族，该语族是跨新几内亚语系东南巴布亚语支下的一个小语族，分布在鸟尾半岛。

科亚里安语族分为科亚里科支和马纳加拉斯高原上的巴赖支。科亚里语本部分为西部和东部两个方言群，只在音系和词汇上有细小差别；其使用者与莫图人和科伊塔人的村落交错而居，邻近莫尔斯比港的港湾。

1545年，西班牙探险家伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯将该岛命名为新几内亚，但此后几个世纪里外来者只了解沿海地带，通行科亚里语的内陆几乎未受外部世界影响。

en: Kol is the language of the Kol people of eastern New Britain in Papua New Guinea, spoken mainly on the southern side of the island in Pomio District of East New Britain Province. It is regarded as a language isolate, though a distant link to the poorly documented Sulka language and the proposed East Papuan grouping has been suggested.
zh: 科尔语是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛东部科尔人的语言，主要通行于该岛南部东新不列颠省的波米奥地区。它被视为孤立语言，尽管有学者猜测它与记录稀少的苏尔卡语及拟议中的东巴布亚语群有远亲关系。

en:
Kolopom is the Trans-New Guinea language family of Kolepom Island, also called Frederik Hendrik Island, a low-lying leaf-shaped island off southern New Guinea separated from the mainland by the narrow Muli Strait. Its languages are Kimaama, Riantana and Ndom, together with the more distant Moraori, while the separate Mombum family of the island's south is not part of it.

Dutch seafarers were the first Europeans to reach it: Willem Janszoon sighted the island from the Duyfken in 1606, and Jan Carstenszoon named its south-western cape Valse Kaap in 1623.

Long charted as part of the New Guinea mainland, Kolepom was proven an island only in 1835, when Dutch survey sloops sailed the strait and named the island after Prince Frederik Hendrik.
zh:
科洛庞语是科洛彭岛上的跨新几内亚语系语族。该岛又称弗雷德里克·亨德里克岛，是新几内亚岛南岸外一座地势低平、形如树叶的岛屿，以狭窄的穆利海峡与主岛相隔。它包括基马马语、里安塔纳语、恩多姆语以及关系较远的莫拉奥里语，岛屿南部独立的蒙布姆语族并不属于它。

荷兰航海者是最早到达这里的欧洲人：1606年，威廉·扬松驾驶“杜伊夫根号”望见这座岛；1623年，扬·卡斯滕斯把岛的西南海角命名为“假角”。

科洛彭岛长期被画成新几内亚主岛的一部分，直到1835年荷兰测量船穿过海峡，才证实它是一座岛屿，并以弗雷德里克·亨德里克亲王之名为岛命名。

en:
Kongo, or Kikongo, is a tonal Bantu language spoken by the Kongo people along the Atlantic coast of Central Africa, across the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of the Congo, Gabon and Angola. It was the language of the Kingdom of Kongo before the Portuguese founded Angola in 1575, and became the first Bantu language written in Latin characters.

A catechism translated by Kongo teachers from São Salvador was printed in 1624 by the Jesuit Mateus Cardoso, and around 1648 the Kongo priest Manuel Robredo compiled a dictionary for Capuchin missionaries.

Because countless enslaved Kongo speakers were carried across the Atlantic, creolized Kikongo survives in the ritual speech of Afro-American religions in Brazil, Cuba and Haiti, and fed languages such as Gullah in North America and Palenquero in Colombia.
zh:
刚果语又称基刚果语，是一门有声调的班图语，由刚果人通行于中非大西洋沿岸，地跨刚果（金）、刚果（布）、加蓬和安哥拉。1575年葡萄牙人建立安哥拉之前，它曾是刚果王国的语言。它也是最早用拉丁字母书写的班图语。

1624年，耶稣会士马特乌斯·卡多佐刊印了由圣萨尔瓦多的刚果籍教师翻译的教理问答；约1648年，刚果籍神父曼努埃尔·罗布雷多为嘉布遣会传教士编纂了一部词典。

由于无数说刚果语的人被掳过大西洋，克里奥尔化的基刚果语留存于巴西、古巴和海地的美洲黑人宗教仪式用语中，并滋养了北美的古拉语和哥伦比亚的帕伦克罗语。

en:
Kordofan is the label for a cluster of language groups spoken in the Nuba Mountains of South Kordofan in Sudan, which may preserve the oldest linguistic stratum of the region. They share a mountain refuge rather than a demonstrated common ancestor, so the name is chiefly geographic; most groups are assigned to Niger-Congo while Kadu is placed in Nilo-Saharan.

In antiquity the rugged mountains lay within the Kingdom of Kush, and in the Middle Ages they formed part of the Nubian kingdom of Alodia.

The Taqali state arose among the Nuba hills between 1750 and 1780 and kept its independence behind its rocky ridges; although the Egyptians conquered the neighboring Kingdom of Sennar in 1821, their invasions of Taqali failed and the hill country kept its own rulers and languages.
zh:
科尔多凡语是对苏丹南科尔多凡州努巴山区一组语言的统称，这片山地可能保存着该地区最古老的语言层次。它们的共同点是同处这片山地避难所，而并非已证实拥有共同祖先，因此这个名称主要是地理性的；多数语群被归入尼日尔—刚果语系，卡杜语则被划入尼罗—撒哈拉语系。

古代这一带属于库施王国，中世纪时是努比亚人阿洛迪亚王国的一部分。

塔卡利邦国于1750—1780年间在努巴群山中兴起，凭借陡峭山脊保持独立；1821年埃及人征服了邻近的森纳尔王国，却屡次进攻塔卡利未果，山地居民保住了自己的统治者和语言。

en:
Korean is the principal language of the Koreanic family, spoken across the Korean Peninsula, with its linguistic homeland plausibly in Manchuria; its speakers expanded into the southern peninsula around 300 BC, blending with earlier Japonic-speaking cultivators. Its recorded form passes from Old Korean, the language of Silla, through the Middle Korean of Goryeo and early Joseon.

Chinese characters reached Korea in the first century BC and long served as the medium of government and formal writing; scholars adapted them to Korean grammar through the idu, hyangchal and gugyeol systems.

In 1446 King Sejong promulgated the Hunminjeongeum, now called Hangul, designed for common people to learn within days. The yangban aristocracy disdained the script as vulgar, yet it spread through popular novels and royal notices. Chinese-character writing dominated official life into the nineteenth century.
zh:
朝鲜语是朝鲜语族的主要语言，通行于朝鲜半岛，其语言原乡可能在满洲；约公元前300年，说原始朝鲜语的人群向南扩展，与更早的日琉语系农耕者融合。有文献可征的朝鲜语经历了新罗时代的古朝鲜语，以及高丽和朝鲜王朝早期的中朝鲜语两个阶段。

汉字在公元前1世纪传入，长期充当行政和正式书写的载体；文人又借吏读、乡札、口诀等方式用汉字记录朝鲜语语法。

1446年，朝鲜世宗颁布《训民正音》，即后世所称的谚文，旨在让平民数日之内学会读写。两班贵族鄙称谚文粗浅，它却借助通俗小说和王室告示传播开来。汉字书写在官方生活中的主导地位一直延续到19世纪。

en:
Kosraean, also spelled Kusaiean, is an Austronesian language of the Micronesian Proper group, where it forms a branch of its own, spoken only on Kosrae, the easternmost of the Carolines. The island was settled no later than the early first millennium, and from about 1250 its rulers were buried in the pyramid tombs of Leluh, a walled town whose noble houses governed a stratified, matrilineal society.

Alvaro de Saavedra made the first recorded European sighting in 1529, and Spain claimed Kosrae from 1668, yet no colonial power actually occupied the island in this period.

The first Europeans to land were the French circumnavigators of La Coquille, led by Louis-Isidore Duperrey, who anchored at Okat in June 1824 and walked across to Lelu. Kosraean remained a purely spoken language, with no written record made before the nineteenth century was well advanced.
zh:
科斯雷语又译库赛语，是南岛语系密克罗尼西亚语支的语言，在其中自成一个分支，仅通行于加罗林群岛最东端的科斯雷岛。这座岛至迟在公元第一个千年初期已有居民；约1250年起，统治者被安葬在莱卢城的金字塔墓葬中，这座城邑由贵族家族治理，社会按母系氏族组织，等级森严。

1529年，阿尔瓦罗·德·萨韦德拉首次留下欧洲人望见该岛的记录，1668年起西班牙宣称拥有科斯雷，但这一时期并没有殖民势力真正占领此岛。

第一批登岛的欧洲人是法国“贝壳号”上的环球航行者，由路易·伊西多尔·迪佩雷率领，1824年6月在奥卡特抛锚，并步行走访了莱卢。科斯雷语始终是纯粹的口语，直到19世纪很晚的时候才有书面记录。

en:
Kra, also called Geyang or Kadai, is the branch of the Kra-Dai family closest to the Kam-Sui languages, scattered from western Guizhou and Guangxi through southeastern Yunnan to northern Vietnam. Most of its dozen or so tongues are heavily intermingled with Zhuang, Bouyei and Chinese.

The Gelao are regarded as indigenous people of Guizhou, descended from the Rau of the ancient kingdom of Yelang, and the Bo of southern Sichuan, famed for their cliffside hanging coffins and bronze drums, may also have spoken a Kra language. The Bo fortress of Lingxiao was the last southern holdout against the Mongols, falling in 1288.

In 1573 Ming armies overran the Bo strongholds in Gong County, after which the people disappear from written records. Kra languages had no traditional script, though Gelao singers around Anshun sometimes used characters derived from Chinese to record folk songs.
zh:
仡央语又称卡岱语，是壮侗语系中与侗水语支最接近的一支，从贵州西部、广西西部经云南东南部一直分布到越南北部。它包含十几种语言，大多与壮语、布依语和汉语深度交错。

仡佬族被视为贵州的土著，先民是古代夜郎国的僚人；以崖壁悬棺和铜鼓闻名的川南僰人，所说的可能也是一种仡央语。僰人的凌霄城是南方抵抗蒙古的最后据点，1288年陷落。

1573年，明军攻占珙县一带的僰人寨堡，僰人从此从文字记载中消失。仡央诸语没有传统文字，不过安顺一带的仡佬歌手有时会用仿照汉字创制的字符记录民歌。

en:
Kru is the cluster of closely related tongues spoken from south-eastern Liberia to western Ivory Coast, divided into Western and Eastern Kru; their resemblance to the Niger-Congo languages is disputed, and some catalogues treat Kru as a family of its own. The name Kru, from the people's own word Klao, was spread by Europeans who long confused it with the English word crew.

The shore facing these speakers was the Pepper Coast visited by Portuguese voyagers for melegueta pepper. Kru oral history records a move from the interior to the sea in the eighteenth century.

From the 1790s Kru men, called Krumen, shipped as free sailors, pilots and interpreters on European and American vessels, their forehead tattoos marking them as freemen; Krumen settlements then grew up in ports from Freetown to the Nigerian coast.
zh:
克鲁语是一批亲属语言的合称，通行于利比里亚东南部至科特迪瓦西部，分为西克鲁和东克鲁两组；它们与尼日尔—刚果语言的亲缘关系仍有争议，一些目录把克鲁语视为独立语系。克鲁一名来自当地人的自称克劳，欧洲人却长期把它和英语里的船员一词混为一谈。

这些人面对的海岸是葡萄牙航海者采购天堂椒的胡椒海岸。克鲁人的口述史称他们在18世纪从内陆迁至海边。

从1790年代起，被称为克鲁水手的克鲁人以自由人身份受雇于欧洲和美洲船只，担任水手、领航员和翻译，他们额头上的刺青标明自己是自由人，克鲁水手的聚居区也随之在从弗里敦到尼日利亚海岸的各港口兴起。

en:
Ktunaxan, also called Kutenai, is the language of the Ktunaxa people, whose bands live along the Kootenay River and around the upper Columbia in the Rocky Mountain region. It is usually treated as a language isolate: attempts to link it to the Salishan languages of neighbouring Plateau peoples, or to wider Macro-Algonquian groupings, have not won acceptance.

The language is agglutinative, marking much of its grammar with prefixes and suffixes on the verb. Beside the spoken language, the Ktunaxa also used a signed form for communication between peoples.

The Ktunaxa language had no writing system of its own, and the Ktunaxa first enter written records around 1793, on a map by the fur-trader Alexander Mackenzie; by the 1830s some bands were blending Christian elements, learned through Iroquois intermediaries, into their ceremonies.
zh:
库特内语是库特内人的语言。库特内人的各个群体沿库特内河与哥伦比亚河上游而居，活动于落基山区。学界通常把它视为孤立语言：曾有人试图把它与邻近高原民族的萨利希语族或更大的阿尔冈昆语群挂钩，都没有获得普遍承认。

库特内语属黏着语，大量语法功能靠动词前后的词缀表达。除口语外，库特内人还使用一套手语，便于与不同民族交流。

库特内语没有本民族文字，库特内人最早见于文字记载是1793年前后毛皮商亚历山大·麦肯齐地图上的标注；到19世纪30年代，部分群体已把经易洛魁中间人接触到的基督教元素融入自己的仪式。

en:
Kuikúro, also called Amonap, is a southern Cariban language of the upper Xingu in the Mato Grosso interior of Brazil, spoken along the Culuene River by the Kuikuro and, with only dialectal differences, the Kalapalo. Nahukuá and Matipú form the rest of this small southern branch.

Its speakers are held to descend from the builders of the earthwork settlements of the Kuhikugu region, whose large palisaded villages with bridges, gates and roads had grown up by around 1400. Those towns were abandoned some four centuries later, perhaps after diseases brought by Europeans reached the basin, and the people regrouped in the river villages of the multi-ethnic Xingu network.
zh:
库伊库罗语又称阿莫纳普语，是巴西内陆马托格罗索州上欣古地区的南部分支加勒比语，沿库卢埃内河通行，库伊库罗人和卡拉帕洛人都讲这种语言，彼此只有方言差别。纳胡夸语和马蒂普语是这个小型南支的另外成员。

一般认为，使用者是库希库古地区土城建造者的后裔：到1400年前后，这里已出现带栅栏、桥梁、寨门和道路的大型村落。这些城镇在约四个世纪后被废弃，可能与欧洲人带来的疾病传入盆地有关，居民重新聚集到欣古多族群网络中的河畔村落。

en:
Kuot, also called Panaras, is a language isolate and the only non-Austronesian, or Papuan, language spoken on New Ireland in the Bismarck Archipelago. It is generally regarded as a surviving relic of the older Papuan-speaking population of the Bismarcks before Austronesian languages spread through the region with the Lapita seafarers around 1500 BCE.

Kuot is spoken in ten villages along the eastern and western coasts of the island's narrow central neck, and it has no major dialect divisions. It is the only Papuan language known to use verb-subject-object word order. Long contact with the surrounding Oceanic languages has left marks in both directions, and linguists attribute certain sound changes in Nalik, Kara, Barok, Madak and Lamasong to Kuot influence.
zh:
库奥特语又称帕纳拉斯语，是一种孤立语言，也是俾斯麦群岛新爱尔兰岛上唯一的非南岛语言，即巴布亚语言。学界普遍认为，它是公元前1500年前后拉皮塔航海者把南岛语言带入这一地区之前，俾斯麦群岛更早的巴布亚语居民留下的孑遗。

库奥特语通行于岛屿狭窄中段东西两岸的十个村落，内部没有大的方言分歧。它是已知唯一使用动词—主语—宾语语序的巴布亚语言。与周边大洋洲语言的长期接触在双方都留下了痕迹，语言学家认为纳利克语、卡拉语、巴罗克语、马达克语和拉马松语中的某些音变正是受库奥特语影响而来。

en:
Kurdish, or Kurdi, is a continuum of Northwestern Iranian languages spoken across Kurdistan, in southeastern Anatolia, northern Iraq, northwestern Iran and northern Syria. The language descends from the Iranian tongues of ancient Media and Parthia.

Kurdish words appear in Arabic scholarly works as early as the ninth century, and the thirteenth-century Yazidi Black Book is among its earliest texts. A literary language emerged from the fifteenth century. In 1787 the Italian missionary Maurizio Garzoni printed the first Kurdish grammar in Rome.

The Battle of Chaldiran in 1514 split Kurdish lands between the Ottoman Empire and Safavid Iran; the Ottomans organised hereditary Kurdish sanjaks under Idris of Bitlis, while Shah Abbas I deported Kurds to Khorasan after the Dimdim rising of the early seventeenth century. The Kurdish emirates kept autonomy until Ottoman centralising reforms of the nineteenth century.
zh:
库尔德语（Kurdi）是一组西北伊朗语言的方言连续体，通行于库尔德斯坦，即安纳托利亚东南部、伊拉克北部、伊朗西北部和叙利亚北部。学者将这种语言追溯到米底和帕提亚的古伊朗语。

9世纪的阿拉伯学术著作已在记录库尔德语词汇，13世纪雅兹迪教的《黑书》则是其最早的文本之一。书面文学语言从15世纪开始形成。1787年，意大利神父毛里齐奥·加尔佐尼在罗马印行了第一部库尔德语语法。

1514年的恰尔德兰战役把库尔德人的家园分割于奥斯曼帝国与萨法维伊朗之间；奥斯曼人在比特利斯的伊德里斯主持下编设世袭库尔德桑贾克，而阿拔斯一世在17世纪初迪姆迪姆起义之后，把库尔德人迁往呼罗珊。库尔德埃米尔国保有地方自治，直到19世纪奥斯曼推行中央集权改革为止。

en:
Kutubuan is a small family of Papuan languages named after Lake Kutubu, an upland lake in the Southern Highlands that drains into the Kikori River. It has two branches whose speakers face each other across the water: East Kutubuan, comprising Foe and Fiwaga, and West Kutubuan, comprising Fasu, Some and Namumi. The branches share little vocabulary, and how closely they are related remains debated; both are placed in the tentative Papuan Gulf grouping.

The Foe live along the southern shore and the Fasu along the northern, fishing and tending gardens on the slopes. Long sealed in the interior, these communities were unknown to Europeans when Yñigo Ortiz de Retez named New Guinea in 1545, and outsiders did not reach the lake until the colonial era.
zh:
库图布安语是巴布亚语言小语族，得名于南部高地省的库图布湖，湖水注入基科里河。它分两支，使用者隔湖相望：东库图布支包括福语和菲瓦加语，西库图布支包括法苏语、索梅语和纳穆米语。两支共有词汇很少，亲缘远近仍有争议，学者把它们归入暂定的巴布亚湾语群。

福人住在湖南岸，法苏人住在湖北岸，在湖中捕鱼，在坡地上经营园圃。这些社群长期封闭在内陆，1545年伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯为新几内亚命名时，欧洲人对它们一无所知，外界直到殖民时代才抵达这座湖。

en:
Kwa, in its narrow New Kwa form, is the proposed Niger-Congo branch covering south-eastern Ivory Coast, southern Ghana and central Togo; its name comes from the word for person shared by many languages.
