Its heart is the Potou-Tano group of the Akan, alongside Ga-Dangme and Gbe, though recent classifications transfer Gbe to the Volta-Niger branch.

The Bono state grew rich carrying gold and kola north through Begho. In 1701 the Asante ruler Osei Tutu, with his adviser Okomfo Anokye and the Golden Stool as the symbol of union, defeated Denkyira and built the Ashanti Empire from Kumasi, overrunning Bono in 1723.

East of the Volta the Gbe peoples formed Allada and, about 1600, Dahomey; King Agaja took Allada in 1724 and Whydah in 1727, and the slave trade carried Gbe speech into Caribbean creoles. Dahomey paid tribute to Oyo until 1827.
zh:
克瓦语（狭义又称新克瓦语）是尼日尔—刚果语系下一个亲缘关系尚无定论的语支，通行于科特迪瓦东南部、加纳南部和多哥中部，名称来自这些语言中普遍表示“人”的词。它的核心是阿坎人的波托—塔诺语组，此外还有加—丹梅语和格贝语群，不过晚近的分类多把格贝语群划入沃尔特—尼日尔语支。

博诺国经贝戈向北贩运黄金和可拉果而致富。1701年，阿散蒂首领奥塞·图图在谋臣奥科姆福·安诺基辅佐下，以金凳子为团结象征击败登基拉，以库马西为都建立阿散蒂帝国，并于1723年攻灭博诺。

沃尔特河以东的格贝人建立了阿拉达王国，又于1600年前后建立达荷美王国；国王阿加贾于1724年攻取阿拉达、1727年攻取维达，奴隶贸易把格贝诸语带进加勒比克里奥尔语。达荷美向奥约纳贡，直到1827年才摆脱这一臣属地位。

en:
Kwaio, also known as Koio, Welakau or Fataia, is an Austronesian language of the Oceanic branch spoken across the mountainous interior of central Malaita in the Solomon Islands. Its speakers, the Kwaio, live in scattered hamlets and farm taro by swidden cultivation. Kwaio society is organised around descent groups and an ancestor religion governed by rules of taboo, called abu, whose language of ritual and sacrifice forms a central part of the tongue.

Although Álvaro de Mendaña's Spanish ships sighted Malaita in 1568, the island's highlands long remained beyond European reach, and the Kwaio had no recorded contact with outsiders during this period. Their language had no writing and was carried by speech, genealogy and oral lore.
zh:
夸约语又称科约语、韦拉考语或法塔亚语，是南岛语系大洋洲语支的语言，通行于所罗门群岛马莱塔岛中部多山的内陆。夸约人居住在分散的村落里，以刀耕火种方式种植芋头。夸约社会以血缘继嗣群和祖先崇拜为核心，受称为阿布的禁忌规则约束，祭祀与献祭用语是该语言的重要组成部分。

1568年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的西班牙船队虽然望见了马莱塔，但岛上高地长期处于欧洲人势力之外，这一时期的夸约人与外界没有留下接触记录。他们的语言没有文字，靠言语、谱系和口传知识传承。

en:
Kwara'ae is the Oceanic language spoken across Malaita, and the largest indigenous vernacular of the Solomon Islands. Its speakers include both the bush people of the interior and the salt-water people of the Langa Langa Lagoon, where feuding drove refugees onto artificial islands raised from coral and sandbars. Lagoon towns such as Laulasi became centres of shell-money manufacture, and priests guarded ancestral skulls in tabu houses.

Kwara'ae oral tradition tells of a founding ancestor who landed first on Guadalcanal and, led by a magical staff, crossed into central Malaita about twenty generations ago, his descendants spreading through the lowlands.

Spanish ships under Álvaro de Mendaña sighted Malaita in 1568, but sustained European contact waited until the chain's rediscovery in the late eighteenth century; Kwara'ae remained an unwritten language of ritual, genealogy and daily speech.
zh:
夸拉埃语是通行于马莱塔岛的大洋洲语言，也是所罗门群岛使用人数最多的本土语言。使用者既包括内陆的丛林居民，也包括兰加兰加潟湖的咸水居民；部落仇杀迫使难民迁往珊瑚和沙洲上堆起的人工岛。劳拉西等潟湖城镇成为贝壳货币的制作中心，祭司在禁忌之屋中守护祖先头骨。

夸拉埃人的口传传统称，始祖最初在瓜达尔卡纳尔登陆，约二十代前受一根魔法手杖指引进入马莱塔中部，后裔随后散布到各低地。

1568年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙船队望见了马莱塔，但持续的欧洲接触要等到18世纪末群岛被重新发现；夸拉埃语始终没有文字，存在于祭祀、谱系和日常言语之中。

en: Kwaza is an unclassified language, best treated as an isolate, spoken by the Kwaza people of southeastern Rondônia in western Brazil, around the São Pedro river amid Aikanã- and Kanoê-speaking neighbours.
zh: 夸扎语是一种未分类语言，通常视为孤立语，由巴西西部朗多尼亚州东南部圣佩德罗河一带的夸扎人使用，周边是说艾卡纳语和卡诺埃语的族群。

en: Kwerbic, or Greater Kwerba, is a family of close to a dozen Papuan languages in the Indonesian half of New Guinea, centred on the Foja Range behind the north-coast town of Sarmi. Its chief language is Kwerba, of scattered Sarmi Regency villages; Isirawa and Kapauri–Sause are among its relatives, and the group is linked with the neighbouring Tor languages.
zh: 奎尔比克语又称大奎尔巴语，是印度尼西亚所属新几内亚地区的一个巴布亚语族，含近十二种语言，中心在北海岸萨尔米城后方的福贾山脉。代表语言是奎尔巴语，通行于萨尔米县分散的村落；伊西拉瓦语、卡保利—索塞语是其较近的亲属，学者还将该语群与邻近的托尔诸语言联系起来。

en: Kwomtari is a Papuan language of the remote inland country near the border of northern Papua New Guinea and Indonesia, giving its name to the small Kwomtari family, whose links to the neighbouring Fas languages remain disputed. Its verb carries subject and object suffixes and marks mood rather than tense, while nouns have no gender or number.
zh: 科姆塔里语是一种巴布亚语言，通行于巴布亚新几内亚北部与印度尼西亚边境附近的偏远内陆，并因它得名于小型的科姆塔里语族；该语族与邻近法斯诸语言是否同源，学界仍有争议。科姆塔里语的动词以词缀标记主语和宾语，屈折变化表示语气而非时态，名词则没有性、数标记。

en:
Kx'a, also called Ju–ǂHoan, is the click-language family of the San hunter-gatherers of the Kalahari and surrounding drylands of southern Africa, uniting the ǃKung, or Juu, dialect continuum with ǂ'Amkoe. Its speakers lived in small foraging bands, and the family had no written tradition.

Its click consonants include dental, alveolar, palatal, lateral and retroflex articulations, together with tone and nasalization; the reconstructed Proto-Juu possessed all five click positions. Kx'a was once grouped with the Tuu and Khoe families under the label Khoisan, but that unity is no longer accepted.

Before the Bantu expansion, click languages of this kind were spread far more widely across southern Africa; as Bantu- and Khoe-speaking herders advanced, Kx'a speech retreated toward the desert, where it remained the unwritten language of isolated foraging bands through the centuries after 1337.
zh:
卡语又称久—霍安语，是南部非洲卡拉哈里及周边干旱地带桑人狩猎采集者的搭嘴音语言，由空语（又称久语）方言群与安科依语共同组成。使用者以小型游群为生，没有文字传统。

它们的搭嘴音分齿、龈、腭、边、卷舌五种发音部位，还有声调和鼻化；据构拟，原始久语具备全部五组搭嘴音。卡语曾与图乌、科依两个语系一并归入“科伊桑”名下，但这一归类后来被推翻。

在班图人扩张之前，这类搭嘴音语言曾广布南部非洲；随着说班图语和科依语的牧人推进，卡语不断向沙漠退缩，1337年以后的数百年间，它始终是散居沙漠的狩猎游群使用的无文字语言。

en: Lamogai is an Austronesian language of the island of New Britain in Papua New Guinea, spoken in parts of West New Britain Province. Within Oceanic it belongs to the Bibling linkage of the Ngero–Vitiaz branch, together with the nearby Mouk-Aria and other Southwest New Britain languages.
zh: 拉莫盖语是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛上的一种南岛语，通行于西新不列颠省的部分地区。在泛太平洋语族中，它与邻近的莫克—阿里亚等新不列颠西南部语言同属恩盖罗—维蒂亚兹分支的比卜林语链。

en:
Lampung is a Lampungic language of the Austronesian family, spoken by the Lampung people of southern Sumatra and neighbouring parts of South Sumatra and Banten. It splits into the coastal Api or Pesisir dialect and the interior Nyo or Abung dialect. Traditionally it is written in the Lampung alphabet, a Rencong abugida descended from the Old Javanese Kawi script.

The region entered written history with Srivijaya: stone inscriptions of about 680 mark the southernmost reach of that maritime empire, and an Old Malay inscription of 997 survives at Hujung Langit, after which Majapahit claimed the area.

From the mid-sixteenth century the pepper-rich coasts passed under the Banten Sultanate, which monopolized the Lampung pepper trade, and in 1752 the Dutch annexed the region. Lampung remained the everyday speech of the river valleys, even as Malay served trade and administration.
zh:
楠榜语是南岛语系楠榜语支的语言，使用者为苏门答腊南部以及邻近的南苏门答腊、万丹部分地区的楠榜人。它分为沿海的阿皮语（又称佩西西尔方言）和内陆的尼奥语（又称阿邦方言）。楠榜语传统上用楠榜字母书写，这是一种源自古爪哇卡威文的伦聪元音附标文字。

该地区随室利佛逝进入信史：约680年的石碑标志着这个海上帝国势力的最南端，997年的古马来语铭文仍存于胡姜朗依，其后满者伯夷曾领有此地。

16世纪中叶起，盛产胡椒的沿海地区归入万丹苏丹国，其君主垄断了楠榜的胡椒贸易；1752年荷兰人吞并该地区。楠榜语始终是河谷居民的日常语言，而马来语则用于贸易和行政。

en:
Even, historically called Lamut after the Yakut word lamu for the Okhotsk Sea, is a Tungusic language and the closest relative of Evenki, from which it split gradually; the two remained barely distinct as late as the 1800s. It is the tongue of nomadic reindeer herders scattered across the far northeast of Siberia, from the Lena to Kamchatka and the Okhotsk coast.

When Russian Cossacks reached the Pacific in the 1600s, its speakers included the Okhotsk reindeer Tungus and the settled Arman group, whose divergent speech stood closer to being a language of its own.

Even is an agglutinative language with a vocabulary rich in terms for herding and seasonal migration, and it stayed purely oral throughout this period. From the 1800s the Evens were counted as Orthodox Christians while keeping older shamanic practices.
zh:
鄂温语旧称拉穆特语，得名于雅库特语中指鄂霍次克海的“拉穆”。它属于满‑通古斯语族，与鄂温克语亲缘最近，二者分化缓慢，直到19世纪仍难以截然分开。使用者是游牧驯鹿牧人，散居在西伯利亚极东北部，从勒拿河一直到堪察加和鄂霍次克海岸。

17世纪俄国哥萨克推进到太平洋时，使用者包括鄂霍次克的驯鹿通古斯人和定居的阿尔曼人，后者差异很大的土语近乎一门独立语言。

鄂温语是黏着语，关于放牧和季节性迁徙的词语丰富；在本时期它始终没有文字，靠口耳相传。19世纪起，鄂温人在名义上被算作东正教徒，同时保留了更早的萨满教习俗。

en:
Laragiya, also called Gulumirrgin, is the language of the Larrakia people, the Saltwater People of the harbour country around present-day Darwin on the north coast of the Northern Territory. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, Larrakia territory stretched south from the harbour toward Coolalinga, bordered by the Wulna and Warrai.

The Larrakia traded and intermarried with the Tiwi, Wadjiginy and Djerimanga, sharing ceremonies and songlines. Long treated as a language isolate, Laragiya has been grouped with Limilngan and Wulna in the proposed Darwin Region family of non-Pama–Nyungan languages.
zh:
拉拉吉亚语又称古卢米尔金语，是拉拉基亚人的语言。拉拉基亚人自称‘咸水人’，居住在北领地北岸今达尔文港一带。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，拉拉基亚人的地盘从港湾向南延伸到库拉林加，与武尔纳人和瓦赖人为邻。

他们与提维人、瓦吉吉尼人、杰里芒加人贸易通婚，共享仪式和歌路。拉拉吉亚语长期被视为孤立语言，后来有学者把它与利米恩甘语、武尔纳语归入拟议中的达尔文地区语族，属非帕马—恩永甘语言。

en:
Latin is an Italic language of the Indo-European family, first spoken by the Latins of Latium around the lower Tiber and carried across the Mediterranean by Rome. Its alphabet was borrowed from the Etruscans, and between about 75 BC and AD 200 Classical Latin took shape, while the Vulgar Latin of soldiers and settlers spread through the provinces.

Between the sixth and ninth centuries Vulgar Latin broke up into the Romance languages, yet written Latin lived on in the Church, law and scholarship. From around 1300 Renaissance humanists such as Petrarch revived classical models.

Neo-Latin carried Erasmus's satires, Thomas More's Utopia and, in 1687, Newton's Principia. Until the end of the seventeenth century most books and nearly all diplomatic documents were in Latin; afterwards vernaculars displaced it, though Ecclesiastical Latin remained the liturgical language of the Catholic Church.
zh:
拉丁语是印欧语系意大利语族的语言，最初由台伯河下游拉丁姆地区的拉丁人使用，随罗马传遍地中海。它的字母借自伊特鲁里亚人，约公元前75年至公元200年间古典拉丁语定型，而士兵与移民口中的通俗拉丁语则通行于各行省。

6—9世纪，通俗拉丁语分化为罗曼诸语，但书面拉丁语延续于教会、法律和学术界。约1300年起，彼特拉克等文艺复兴人文主义者复兴古典范式。

新拉丁语承载了伊拉斯谟的讽刺作品、托马斯·莫尔的《乌托邦》，以及1687年牛顿的《自然哲学的数学原理》。直到17世纪末，大部分书籍和几乎所有外交文书仍用拉丁语写成；此后民族语言取代了它，教会拉丁语继续用于天主教会礼仪。

official_raw.en: One of the most influential languages in human history, Latin was the tongue of Caesar, Virgil, and Cicero, but also that of Luther, Descartes, and Newton. After the fall of the Western Roman Empire and the Germanic migrations, Latin evolved into the [ShowLanguageFamilyName('romance_language_family')] Languages. However, #italic Roma capta ferum victorem cepit#! — vanquished Rome conquered its ferocious conqueror—and Latin would live on as a language of rite, culture and diplomacy for millennia to come.
official_raw.zh: 拉丁语作为人类历史上最具影响力的语言之一，曾是凯撒、维吉尔和西塞罗的语言，也是路德、笛卡尔和牛顿的语言。尽管西罗马帝国灭亡和日耳曼民族迁徙后，拉丁语逐渐分化为[ShowLanguageFamilyName('romance_language_family')]下的多种语言，但正如#italic “被征服的罗马征服了野蛮的征服者”#!所言，拉丁语作为仪式、文化和外交的语言，仍将在未来数千年中持续存在。

en:
Lavongai, also called Tungag after its principal village area, is an Austronesian language spoken on New Hanover Island, known to its people as Lavongai, and neighbouring islets off New Ireland in the Bismarck Archipelago. It keeps singular, dual, trial and plural pronouns, with separate forms showing whether the listener is included, and marks possession by suffixes on nouns. Its dialects fall into a south-coast group and a western and northern group.

The islanders live by subsistence farming and fishing. Lapita seafarers settled the region about three thousand years ago, and Dutch sailors Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten made the first European landfall in the New Ireland chain in 1616.
zh:
拉翁盖语又称通阿格语，得名于岛上的主要聚落区域，是一种南岛语，通行于新汉诺威岛（当地人称之为拉翁盖）以及俾斯麦群岛中新爱尔兰岛外的邻近小岛。它保留了单数、双数、三数和复数代词，区分是否把听话者包括在内，并通过名词后缀表示领属。其方言分为南海岸一支与西部、北部一支。

岛民以自给农业和捕鱼为生。约三千年前拉皮塔航海者在此定居；1616年，荷兰水手雅各布·勒梅尔和威廉·斯考滕首次代表欧洲人在新爱尔兰岛链登陆。

en:
Lega, or Kilega, is a Bantu dialect cluster spoken by the Lega people in the forests and Mitumba mountains east of the Congo River. It splits into two main varieties, Shabunda Lega and Mwenga Lega, which are only partly mutually intelligible, and Gengele, a creole based on the Shabunda variety, is counted among its offshoots.

The Lega began migrating from the White Nile region, in what is now Uganda, to their present lands in the 1500s, conquering the forest peoples they found there. Their society is ordered by the Bwami association, a hierarchy of initiation grades whose moral teaching is expressed through ivory masks and small carved figures.
zh:
莱加语又称基莱加语，是一个班图方言群，由莱加人使用，分布在刚果河以东的森林与米通巴山区。它分为两种主要变体——沙本达莱加语和姆文加莱加语，彼此只能部分互通；以沙本达变体为基础形成的克里奥尔语根盖莱语也被视为它的分支。

莱加人于16世纪从白尼罗河流域（今乌干达一带）迁往现地，征服了沿途遇到的森林族群。他们的社会以布瓦米社团为核心，按入会等级层层排列，道德教化通过象牙面具和小型雕刻形象来传达。

en:
Lenakel, whose speakers call it Netvaar, is a dialect chain of the Austronesian family spoken along the western coast of Tanna in southern Vanuatu. It is one of five indigenous languages on the island, belonging with them to the Southern Vanuatu subgroup, and shades into neighbouring Whitesands and North Tanna through a continuum of dialects.

Tanna was settled around 400 BC by Melanesian seafarers, and its languages developed in isolation until James Cook, drawn by the glow of the Yasur volcano, landed at Port Resolution in August 1774 and gave the island its name, from a local word meaning earth.

From 1804 whaling ships called regularly, and in 1825 the trader Peter Dillon anchored at Port Resolution, opening the era of sandalwood commerce. Lenakel had no script of its own and was transmitted only by speech.
zh:
莱纳克尔语的使用者自称内特瓦尔语，是南瓦努阿图塔纳岛西海岸通行的一种南岛语系方言链。它是岛上五种本土语言之一，与其他四种同属南瓦努阿图语支，并通过连续的方言过渡与邻近的怀特桑兹语、北塔纳语相接。

塔纳岛约在公元前400年由美拉尼西亚航海者定居，岛上语言在隔绝中自行演变，直到1774年8月，詹姆斯·库克被亚苏尔火山的火光吸引，在决心港登陆，并以当地意为土地的词为该岛命名。

1804年起捕鲸船定期到访，1825年商人彼得·狄龙停泊决心港，开启了檀木贸易的时代。莱纳克尔语没有自己的文字，只靠口耳相传。

en:
Lenni-Lenape is the Delawaran group of Eastern Algonquian languages, comprising Unami and Munsee, the tongues of the Lenape or Delaware people, and Mahican, spoken by their Hudson valley kinsmen. Lenni Lenape means the original or genuine people, while Delaware is an English name taken from the river named after Lord De La Warr.

The Lenape homeland covered the Delaware valley, New Jersey, eastern Pennsylvania and the area around New York Bay and the lower Hudson. Settlers crowded in from the early 1600s; the fraudulent Walking Purchase of 1737 stripped the Lenape of land and opened a series of removals through Ohio and beyond.

Moravian missionaries gave the language its first stable Latin orthography and compiled its earliest grammars and dictionaries. In 1782 Pennsylvania militiamen killed ninety-six unarmed Christian Lenape at Gnadenhütten in Ohio, deepening the dispersal of the Delawaran languages.
zh:
莱纳佩语是东阿尔冈昆语族下的特拉华语支，由莱纳佩人（又称特拉华人）的乌纳米语、蒙西语，以及哈德逊河谷亲族所说的莫希干语组成。“伦尼莱纳佩”意为“真正的人”，“特拉华”是英国人的称呼，得名于以德拉沃尔勋爵命名的特拉华河。

莱纳佩人的故土涵盖特拉华河谷、新泽西、宾夕法尼亚东部及纽约湾和哈德逊河下游一带。殖民者从1600年代初起涌入；1737年欺诈性的“步行购地”夺走土地，开启了一连串经俄亥俄向外迁徙的历程。

摩拉维亚传教士为这种语言创制了最早的稳定拉丁字母拼写法，编出第一批语法和词典。1782年，宾夕法尼亚民兵在俄亥俄的格纳登胡滕杀害了九十六名手无寸铁的基督徒莱纳佩人，进一步加剧了特拉华语支诸语的流散。

en:
Lewo, also called Varsu or Laewo, is an Oceanic language of the North and Central Vanuatu group, spoken in eastern Epi, a volcanic island at the northern end of the Shepherd Islands. Its surviving dialects, Tasiko, Lemaroro and Maluba, are the remainder of a much larger number, and many words in the other languages of Epi are said to have originated in Lewo.

Its closest relative is Lamen, with which it shares about four-fifths of its vocabulary. Unusually for an Oceanic language, Lewo marks four grades of spatial deixis: near the speaker, near the hearer, near both, and distant or unknown.

The Shepherd Islands were charted and named by James Cook in 1774. In the nineteenth century Epi suffered severe depopulation, and mission influence drew its inland communities into coastal villages and redrew its linguistic map.
zh:
莱沃语又称瓦尔苏语或拉埃沃语，是北中瓦努阿图语群的一种大洋洲语，通行于谢泼德群岛北端的火山岛埃皮岛东部。现存的塔西科、莱马罗罗和马卢巴三种方言，是过去众多方言的残余；据说埃皮岛其他语言中的许多词汇都源自莱沃语。

与它亲缘最近的是拉门语，两者词汇约有五分之四相通。莱沃语的空间指示分四级，即靠近说话者、靠近听话者、靠近双方以及远处或位置不明，这在大洋洲语中并不常见。

谢泼德群岛由詹姆斯·库克于1774年测绘命名。19世纪埃皮岛人口锐减，传教活动促使内陆社群迁居沿海村庄，重塑了岛上的语言版图。

en:
Limilngan, also called Limil or Manidja, was the language of the Limilngan people of the Top End, spoken in the Darwin hinterland around the Mary River on the western edge of the Kakadu country. When the first British colony in Australia was founded in 1788, its speakers shared the coastal plain south of Darwin with the neighbouring Wulna, whose language of the Adelaide River is its closest relative.

Limilngan and Wulna are placed in the Darwin Region family of non-Pama–Nyungan languages. Limilngan has a three-vowel sound system, and in local dreamtime tradition the creator being Imberombera chanted the language of each country as she walked south from the sea.
zh:
利米恩甘语又称利米尔语或马尼贾语，是顶端地带利米恩甘人的语言，通行于达尔文腹地、卡卡杜西缘的玛丽河一带。1788年英国在澳大利亚建立第一个殖民地时，说这种语言的人与邻族武尔纳人共居达尔文以南的沿海平原，武尔纳语通行于阿德莱德河流域，是它最近的亲属。

利米恩甘语和武尔纳语同属非帕马—恩永甘的达尔文地区语族。利米恩甘语的语音系统只有三个元音；在当地的梦创时代传说中，创世者因贝罗贝拉从海上向南走来，每到一地便诵唱当地该说的语言。

en:
Lotuko, better known as Otuho, is the Bari-language of the Otuho people of the Equatorian hills in South Sudan, with related varieties around the Imatong range. In a wider sense the name stands for the whole Eastern Nilotic spread, whose speakers began to diverge in the first millennium BC from a homeland in Equatoria and drifted south through the dry plains of the Rift Valley as cattle-keeping pastoralists.

The Turkana broke from the Ateker confederation and fought into the Lake Turkana basin, occupying it fully by the 1600s. The Maasai tongue spread through the Kenya and Tanzania grasslands in the eighteenth century amid the Iloikop wars.

The earlier Ongamo, also called Ngasa, reached the plains north of Kilimanjaro in the twelfth century, then lost ground over five centuries to incoming Bantu Chagga farmers, eventually abandoning their language for Chagga.
zh:
洛图科语更常用的名字是奥图霍语，是南苏丹赤道州丘陵地带奥图霍人的巴里语支语言，伊马通山脉一带有近亲方言。在更宽泛的意义上，这个名字代表整个东尼罗特语群，其使用者于公元前第一千纪从赤道州的故土开始分化，作为养牛的牧民沿裂谷干旱平原向南迁徙。

图尔卡纳人脱离阿泰克尔联盟，征战进入图尔卡纳湖盆地，到17世纪已完全占据该地。马赛语在18世纪趁伊洛伊科普战争扩散到肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚草原。

更早南下的翁加莫人（又称恩加萨人）在12世纪抵达乞力马扎罗山以北的平原，随后五百年间在不断迁入的班图系查加农民面前节节后退，最终放弃本族语言改用查加语。

en:
Luba, or Tshiluba, is a Bantu language of the Kasai basin in the south-central Democratic Republic of the Congo, with an eastern dialect spoken by the Luba and a western one by the Lulua.

Its speakers descend from iron-working communities that had settled the lakes and marshes of the Upemba Depression by the 400s, building dams and dikes for fishing and farming and trading copper wire and pottery.

Around 1500 these chiefdoms coalesced into the Kingdom of Luba, whose sacred kings, the Balopwe, ruled alongside a council of elders and whose political model was copied by the neighbouring Lunda. At its height in the eighteenth century the kingdom drew many surrounding peoples into its cultural orbit, while Luba remained unwritten, its histories and moral teachings carried by oral recitation.
zh:
卢巴语又称奇卢巴语，是刚果（金）中南部开赛盆地的一门班图语：东部方言由卢巴人使用，西部方言由卢卢阿人使用。

说这种语言的人继承了铁器时代工匠的传统：早在5世纪，他们的先民已在乌彭巴洼地的湖沼间定居，修筑堤坝和围堰捕鱼耕作，并以铜丝和陶器贸易为生。

约1500年，这些酋邦合并为卢巴王国，神圣国王巴洛普韦与长老会议共同执政，其政体被邻邦隆达人仿效。18世纪王国鼎盛时，众多周边族群被纳入其文化圈；卢巴语没有文字，历史与道德教化全靠口诵传承。

en:
Lule is the extinct language of the Lule people of the Argentine Gran Chaco, whom the Wichí pushed south into Santiago del Estero and Tucumán. Most Lules were nomadic hunter-gatherers who also grew maize, potatoes and quinoa, while settled groups on the Andean edge kept llamas. The plains Lule used Tonocoté as a lingua franca, and the foothill Lules spoke Lule, Tonocoté and Quechua.

Lule is usually grouped with Vilela in the Lule–Vilela family, though some linguists treat them as isolates shaped by contact. Its chief document was printed in 1732 by the Jesuit Antonio Machoni.

Jesuit missions gathered the Lules from 1670; the Miraflores mission, founded in 1715, was sacked in a native rising of 1728, rebuilt in 1752, and abandoned after the Jesuit expulsion of 1768. Lule gave way to Spanish and neighbouring languages.
zh:
卢莱语是阿根廷大查科地区卢莱人的语言，已经消亡。维奇人把卢莱人向南驱赶到圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗和图库曼一带。卢莱人多为游猎采集者，同时种植玉米、马铃薯和藜麦；安第斯山麓的定居群体饲养羊驼。平原卢莱人把托诺科特语当作通用语，山麓卢莱人兼通卢莱语、托诺科特语和克丘亚语。

学界通常把卢莱语与比莱拉语合为卢莱–比莱拉语系，但也有语言学家认为两者各自是孤立语言，相似性来自接触。它最重要的文献由耶稣会士马乔尼于1732年印行。

1670年起，耶稣会传教站开始聚集卢莱人；1715年建立的米拉弗洛雷斯传教站在1728年的原住民起义中被毁，1752年重建，1768年耶稣会被驱逐后遭到废弃。卢莱语最终让位于西班牙语和邻族语言。

en:
Luo, or Lwo, is the western branch of the Nilotic family spoken by related peoples from southern Sudan and western Ethiopia through Uganda and the eastern Congo to Lake Victoria in Kenya, where Dholuo reaches into northern Tanzania. The Luo languages divide into Northern and Southern groups, the southern varieties close enough to be mutually intelligible.

Their speakers began to split from a Nilotic homeland in the Bahr el Ghazal region during the early second millennium, their southward migration hastened by the Muslim conquest of the Sudan. In the mid-1400s the chief Nyikango led his followers north along the Nile to found the Shilluk kingdom.

Other Luo groups moved south to become the Acholi, Alur and Joluo. In the early 1800s these languages were still unwritten, their literature carried by oral tradition.
zh:
卢奥语又称卢沃语，是尼罗特语族的西支，由亲缘族群使用：分布范围从苏丹南部和埃塞俄比亚西部，经乌干达和刚果东部，直到肯尼亚的维多利亚湖沿岸，其中多卢奥语还进入坦桑尼亚北部。卢奥诸语分北、南两组，南部分支各方言相近到可以互通。

使用者在第二个千年的早期从加扎勒河地区的尼罗特故土离散，苏丹的穆斯林征服加速了他们向南迁徙。1400年代中期，酋长尼坎戈率部沿尼罗河北上，建立希卢克王国。

另一些卢奥群体南徙，成为后来的阿乔利人、阿卢尔人和乔卢奥人。直到1800年代初，这些语言仍无文字，文学全凭口耳相传。

en:
Macro-Jê is a South American language family spread mainly across the Brazilian planalto and cerrado and into eastern Bolivia, with the Jê languages at its core. Jê itself divides into northern tongues such as Timbira and Kayapó, central ones such as Xavante, and southern ones led by Kaingang; the inclusion of Bororo, Kariri and Guató in the wider family is still debated.

Its speakers kept the interior savanna and highlands even as Tupi–Guarani peoples occupied the coast, so that when the Portuguese founded São Paulo in 1554 the hinterland still belonged almost entirely to Macro-Jê communities.

Long contact with Tupi–Guarani and later Portuguese brought loanwords. The family is marked by irregular morphology shared with Tupian and Cariban, a small consonant set, a rich vowel inventory and contrastive nasalization.
zh:
热语广义上称大热语系，是南美洲的一个语系，主要分布在巴西高原与塞拉多稀树草原，东抵玻利维亚东部，核心是热语族。热语族分为北支、中支和南支，代表语言有廷比拉语、卡亚波语、沙万特语和坎冈语；博罗罗语、卡里里语、瓜托语是否应归入大热语系，学界仍有争议。

当图皮—瓜拉尼诸族占据海岸时，这些语言的使用者保有内陆稀树草原与高地；1554年葡萄牙人建立圣保罗时，腹地几乎仍全是大热语族群的天下。

与图皮—瓜拉尼语及后来的葡萄牙语长期接触，带来了借词。该语系形态不规则，与图皮语系、加勒比语系有共同之处，辅音数量少、元音丰富，并有鼻化对立。

en:
The Madang or Madang–Adelbert Range languages form a large family within the Trans–New Guinea phylum, spread across Madang Province on Papua New Guinea's north coast, from Astrolabe Bay and Karkar through the forests of the Adelbert Range. Its two principal branches are the Mabuso languages and the Rai Coast languages; the family's internal diversity is so great that its time depth has been compared to that of Austronesian or Indo-European.

Unusually for Trans–New Guinea groups, the inherited pronouns have been replaced, so that evidence for the family rests on shared words such as the reconstructed proto-Madang term for water.

The natural harbour of Astrolabe Bay, around which many villages speaking these languages stand, was first entered by Europeans in 1827, when the French explorer Dumont d'Urville named it after his corvette, the Astrolabe.
zh:
马当诸语又称马当—阿德尔伯特岭诸语，是跨新几内亚语系下的一个大语族，分布在巴布亚新几内亚北海岸的马当省，从阿斯特罗莱布湾和卡尔卡尔岛延伸到阿德尔伯特岭的丛林中。它有马布索诸语和拉伊海岸诸语两大分支，内部分歧极大，分化的时间深度可与南岛语系或印欧语系相比。

与跨新几内亚语系的其他群体不同，它继承自古语的代词已被替换，因此语族的认定主要依靠共有词汇，例如构拟出的原始马当语“水”一词。

许多使用这些语言的村落环绕的天然良港阿斯特罗莱布湾，在1827年迎来首批欧洲人，法国探险家迪蒙·迪维尔以自己的护卫舰星盘号为它命名。

en:
Madurese is the Malayo-Polynesian language of Madura Island off the northeast coast of Java, also spoken across the eastern salient of Java and on Bawean and the Sapudi Islands. It belongs to the Malayo-Sumbawan branch, closer to Malay, Balinese and Sasak than to the Javanese of the neighbouring mainland.

Madurese was long written in the Javanese script, and after the island's Islamization also in the Arabic-based Pegon alphabet, before the Latin alphabet became dominant. It distinguishes three levels of speech, from the most polite register to the speech of close equals.

The dialect of Sumenep in eastern Madura, seat of the island's old courts, serves as the standard. Madura was conquered by Mataram in 1624 and ceded to the Dutch in 1743, yet Madurese remained the common tongue of islanders and their migrant communities.
zh:
马都拉语是爪哇岛东北外海马都拉岛的南岛语，也通行于爪哇东部凸出地带以及巴韦安岛、萨普迪群岛。它属马来—松巴哇语支，与马来语、巴厘语和萨萨克语的亲缘关系近于隔海相望的爪哇语。

马都拉语长期使用爪哇文书写，岛上伊斯兰化之后又出现以阿拉伯字母为基础的佩贡字母，后来拉丁字母渐成主流。它区分三个语体层级，从最庄重的敬语到熟人之间的口语各有不同。

东马都拉的苏民纳方言因旧王庭所在而成为标准语。马都拉于1624年被马打兰苏丹国征服，1743年割让给荷兰人，但马都拉语始终是岛民和各地移民社群的共同语言。

en:
Maewo, more precisely Central Maewo and self-named Sungwadaga, is an Oceanic language of the island of Maewo in northern Vanuatu. It is also known as Peterara, after one of its dialects. The island's name descends from a reconstructed Proto-North-Central Vanuatu form mwaewo, rendered Nwaewo in the local tongues.

Central Maewo occupies the middle of the island, with the related Sungwadia or Marino language to the north and Baetora, or South Maewo, to the south. Europeans first sighted Maewo in the Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandez de Quiros at the end of April 1606; Louis Antoine de Bougainville saw it again in 1768 and gave the island the name Aurora.
zh:
马埃沃语更准确地说是中马埃沃语，本土自称松瓦达加语，是瓦努阿图北部马埃沃岛上的一种大洋洲语，也以其方言之名被称为佩特拉拉语。岛名源自构拟的原始中北瓦努阿图语形式姆瓦埃沃，当地语言中写作恩瓦埃沃。

中马埃沃语分布在岛的中部，北面是亲缘语言松瓦迪亚语（又称马里诺语），南面是巴埃托拉语（又称南马埃沃语）。1606年4月底，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队首次望见马埃沃岛；1768年路易·安托万·德·布干维尔再次见到它，并以“奥罗拉”为该岛命名。

en:
Malagasy is the Austronesian, specifically Barito, language of Madagascar, and the westernmost member of its family: settlers from the Sunda Islands carried its ancestor across the Indian Ocean around the 400s. From about 1000 it absorbed Bantu and Arabic words brought by traders and new settlers, while Malay and Javanese loanwords recall the earliest sea links.

It is a dialect continuum spanning the island, including the Merina speech around Antananarivo. Its first writing was Sorabe, an Arabic-derived alphabet used in the southeast from the 1400s for astrological and magical texts, and in 1658 the Frenchman Etienne de Flacourt printed the first Malagasy dictionary.

In 1823 King Radama I adopted the Latin orthography of the missionary David Jones, under whom the London Missionary Society opened schools. The first Latin-printed Malagasy book, a Bible translation, followed in 1835.
zh:
马尔加什语是马达加斯加岛通行的南岛语系巴里托语族语言，也是该语系分布最西的成员：400年前后，来自巽他群岛的移民把它的祖先带过印度洋。约1000年起，随商人和新移民而来的班图语、阿拉伯语词汇进入该语言，马来语和爪哇语借词则保留着最早的海上联系。

它是遍布全岛的方言连续体，包括塔那那利佛一带的梅里纳方言。它最早的文字是苏拉贝文，源自阿拉伯字母，1400年代起在岛的东南部用于占星和法术文书；1658年，法国人艾蒂安·德·弗拉古出版了第一部马尔加什语词典。

1823年，拉达马一世国王采用传教士戴维·琼斯设计的拉丁拼写法，伦敦传道会随之开办学校。1835年，第一部拉丁字母印刷的马尔加什语书籍，即一部圣经译本，问世。

en:
Malakula serves as an umbrella name for some three dozen closely related Central Vanuatu tongues on Malakula, also spelled Malekula, the second-largest island of Vanuatu. Linguists divide them into northern, eastern and western linkages; a shared trait is the dropping of unstressed syllables, which arose independently in several branches.

Their speakers include the Big Nambas of the north and the Small Nambas of the south-central interior, known for graded pig-killing rituals and, historically, shaping infants' skulls as a mark of rank. Europeans first sighted Malakula during Pedro Fernandez de Quiros's Spanish voyage of 1606, and James Cook visited in 1774, after which British and French settlers and missionaries made it part of the contested New Hebrides.
zh:
马拉库拉语是约三十余种亲缘相近的中瓦努阿图语言的统称，分布在瓦努阿图第二大岛马拉库拉岛（又译马勒库拉岛）上。语言学者把它们分为北部、东部和西部三个连锁群；其共同特征是脱落非重读音节，而且这一变化在多个分支中各自独立发生。

使用者包括北部的大南巴斯人和南部内陆中部的小南巴斯人，以杀猪晋阶仪式闻名，并曾改变婴儿头形以标示身份。1606年佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙航行首次望见马拉库拉岛，1774年詹姆斯·库克到访；此后英国和法国的定居者与传教士相继而来，使该岛成为列强争夺的新赫布里底的一部分。

en:
Malay is an Austronesian language native to the Malay Peninsula and maritime Southeast Asia. The earliest surviving Old Malay text, the Kedukan Bukit inscription of 683, is written in a Pallava-derived Grantha script and heavy with Sanskrit loanwords. Srivijaya carried Old Malay through the ports of the peninsula and archipelago as a traders' lingua franca.

The Terengganu stone of 1303 is the oldest known Jawi inscription, marking Islam's arrival and an influx of Arabic vocabulary. Under the Malacca Sultanate of 1402–1511 Classical Malay became the region's language of trade, letters and Islamic learning. The Portuguese took Malacca in 1511, moving Malay's literary centre to Johor, yet Malay remained a lingua franca as far east as the Moluccas.

The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824 split the Malay world into British and Dutch spheres. Their administrations codified separate Malay and Indonesian standards.
zh:
马来语是南岛语系语言，原产于马来半岛和海岛东南亚。现存最早的古马来语文本是683年的格杜干布吉特铭文，用源于帕拉瓦的格兰塔字母写成，其中已有大量梵语借词。室利佛逝把古马来语带到马来半岛和群岛各港口，成为商人的通用语。

1303年的登嘉楼石碑是已知最古老的爪夷文铭文，标志着伊斯兰教传入和阿拉伯语词汇的涌入。1402—1511年马六甲苏丹国治下，古典马来语成为地区贸易、文学和伊斯兰学术的语言。1511年马六甲落入葡萄牙人之手后，马来语文学中心转移到柔佛，但马来语仍是远至摩鹿加的通用语。

1824年的《英荷条约》把马来世界划分为英国和荷兰两个势力范围。两套行政体系分别规范出马来语与印度尼西亚语标准语。

en:
Malayalam is a Dravidian language spoken by Malayali people on India's southwestern coast, chiefly in Kerala and the Lakshadweep islands. Its name combines mala, mountain, and alam, region. Most scholars derive it from a western coastal dialect of Middle Tamil, which separated between the ninth and thirteenth centuries as the Western Ghats cut Kerala off from the Tamil country and Brahmin settlers added Sanskrit words.

The Quilon Syrian copper plates of about 850 are among its oldest inscriptions, and the Ramacharitam of the late twelfth or early thirteenth century is the first work independent of the Tamil tradition. From the thirteenth century court poetry flourished in Manipravalam, a mixed Tamil-Sanskrit idiom, while the sixteenth-century poet Ezhuthachan fixed the modern literary language.

Its script, Vatteluttu enlarged with Grantha letters, had its own shape by the late thirteenth century, and a Malayalam travel book of 1785 was the first travelogue in an Indian language.
zh:
马拉雅拉姆语是达罗毗荼语族的语言，通行于印度西南沿海的马拉雅拉姆人中，使用者主要在喀拉拉邦和拉克沙群岛；其名由意为山的“马拉”和意为地方的“阿拉姆”合成。多数学者认为，它由中泰米尔语的西部沿海方言发展而来：9至13世纪间，西高止山脉把喀拉拉与泰米尔地区隔开，加之婆罗门定居者带入梵语词汇，它逐渐独立。

约850年的奎隆叙利亚铜板是最古老的铭文之一；12世纪末或13世纪初的《罗摩事迹》是最早脱离泰米尔传统的文学作品。13世纪起，宫廷诗歌以泰米尔语与梵语混合的文体“马尼普拉瓦兰”兴盛；16世纪的诗人埃祖塔昌确立了近代文学语言。

由瓦蒂卢图字母扩充格兰塔字母而成的马拉雅拉姆文在13世纪末定型，1785年成书的一部马拉雅拉姆语游记被视为印度语言中的第一部游记。

en:
Malibú was the language of the Malibú people of the lower Magdalena valley in Colombia, spoken along the river between Tamalameque and Tenerife. It gave its name to the Malibu group of extinct, poorly documented languages; only a handful of words were recorded, and malibú itself is said to have meant cacique, or chief.

Early scholars placed these tongues within the Chibchan family together with Chimila, but later specialists judge that link to rest on no solid evidence, so their classification remains uncertain.

From the early 1500s the riverbank Malibú were among the first peoples encountered by Spanish expeditions entering the Magdalena lowlands, and their speech died out in the colonial period, surviving only in fleeting mentions by 17th-century chroniclers such as Pedro Simón.
zh:
马利布语是哥伦比亚马格达莱纳河下游马利布人的语言，沿河分布在塔马拉梅克到特内里费之间。以它命名的马利布语群已经消亡，记录稀少；后人只记下了零星几个词，据说malibú一词意为“酋长”。

早期学者把这些语言与奇米拉语一并归入奇布查语系，但后来的研究者认为这一联系缺乏确凿依据，其归属仍无定论。

16世纪初，沿河而居的马利布人成为西班牙远征队进入马格达莱纳低地时最早接触到的族群之一，他们的语言在殖民时期消亡，只在17世纪编年史家佩德罗·西蒙等人的简略记述中留下痕迹。

en:
The Maluku grouping represents the Central Maluku languages, a proposed branch of the Central-Eastern Malayo-Polynesian group of Austronesian comprising about fifty tongues on Seram, Buru, Ambon and the Sula Islands. Central Moluccans regard Seram, still called Nusa Ina or Mother Island, as their ancestral homeland.

Buru is first named in a Javanese poem of around 1365, and in the 1400s and 1500s Seram lay within the sphere of the Sultanate of Ternate, often ruled through its vassal on Buru. A Portuguese expedition mapped Seram's southern coast in 1512.

The Dutch Company took Buru in 1658, resettling villages around Kayeli Bay to work its clove plantations, and held nominal sway over Seram from about 1650. Tidore kept suzerain rights in eastern Seram from 1700 to 1768, and Prince Nuku of Tidore made the island a base of his anti-Dutch rebellion in the 1780s.
zh:
马鲁古语这一划分对应中马鲁古诸语，是南岛语系中东部马来—波利尼西亚语群下拟议的一个分支，约有五十种语言，分布在斯兰岛、布鲁岛、安汶岛和苏拉群岛。中马鲁古人把仍称作“努萨伊纳”（意为母岛）的斯兰岛视为祖居之地。

布鲁岛最早见于1365年前后的一首爪哇诗篇；15至16世纪，斯兰岛处在特尔纳特苏丹国的势力范围内，常由其在布鲁岛的附庸代为统治。1512年，葡萄牙远征队测绘了斯兰岛南海岸。

1658年荷兰东印度公司夺取布鲁岛，把许多村庄迁到卡耶利湾周围为丁香种植园劳作，并从1650年前后起对斯兰岛保有名义上的统治。1700至1768年，蒂多雷苏丹国保留着对斯兰岛东部的宗主权；18世纪80年代，蒂多雷的努库王子又以该岛为基地开展反荷起义。

en:
Malvi is an Indo-Aryan language of the Rajasthani group, spoken chiefly on the Malwa plateau of western Madhya Pradesh and adjoining Rajasthan. Together with kindred varieties it forms part of the Western Indo-Aryan continuum that grew out of the early medieval Prakrits; references to a distinct Rajasthani speech go back to the eighth century.

When the Malwa Sultanate was founded in 1401, and again after the region became a Mughal province in 1562, Persian served as the language of court and administration. Malvi remained in towns and villages, absorbing Persian and Arabic loanwords. It has remained largely a language of home, market and oral poetry.

Malvi is written in the Devanagari script. In earlier centuries Rajasthani tongues were commonly recorded in Mahajani, a mercantile script also used for accounts and financial records.
zh:
摩腊婆语是拉贾斯坦语群的一支印度—雅利安语言，主要通行于中央邦西部的摩腊婆高原及邻近的拉贾斯坦地区。它与近亲变体同属西印度—雅利安方言连续体，由中世纪早期的俗语发展而来；早在8世纪，文献中就已提到拉贾斯坦一带有独立的口头语言。

1401年摩腊婆苏丹国建立，1562年该地又成为莫卧儿帝国的一个省，宫廷和行政使用波斯语。摩腊婆语留在城镇与乡村，吸收了波斯语和阿拉伯语借词，并长期主要用于家庭、市集和口传诗歌。

摩腊婆语采用天城文书写。更早的世纪里，拉贾斯坦诸语常用马哈佳尼文记录，那是一种商人记账兼用于文书的书写系统。

en:
Manao is the extinct Arawakan language once spoken by the Manaos along the Rio Negro in western Brazil; in it the people's own name meant mother of the gods, and from them comes the name of the city of Manaus.

The Manaos resisted Portuguese slaving raids and missionary work, attacking the Fort of São José da Barra do Rio Negro and, under their leader Ajuricaba, patrolling the river to stop colonial vessels sailing upstream.

The last major war against them ended in the 1720s, when Ajuricaba was captured and drowned himself on the way to trial at Belém while two thousand of his people were sold into slavery. In 1819 the German botanist von Martius encountered the last recorded Manaos band on the Rio Negro, the final attestation of the people and their tongue.
zh:
马瑙斯语是已经消亡的阿拉瓦克语言，曾由马瑙斯人使用于巴西西部内格罗河沿岸；在这种语言里，马瑙斯人的自称意为“众神之母”，马瑙斯市的名字即来源于他们。

马瑙斯人反抗葡萄牙人的奴隶劫掠和传教活动，进攻圣若泽达巴拉杜里奥内格罗要塞，并在首领阿尤里卡巴率领下巡守河道，阻止殖民船只溯流而上。

18世纪20年代，最后一场大战以失败告终：阿尤里卡巴被俘，在押往贝伦受审途中投河自尽，两千部众被卖为奴。1819年，德国植物学家冯·马蒂乌斯在内格罗河畔见到有记载的最后一群马瑙斯人，这也是该民族及其语言最后的音讯。

en:
Mandarin is native to the North China Plain, its dialects stretching from Yunnan to Heilongjiang. Most have four lexical tones, having lost the final stops of Middle Chinese while often keeping retroflex initials.

The northern speech of the Jurchen Jin and Mongol Yuan, known as Old Mandarin, bore a flourishing vernacular literature of qu songs and drama from the twelfth to fourteenth centuries. The rime dictionaries Menggu Ziyun of 1308 and Zhongyuan Yinyun of 1324 record its sound system.

Because the imperial capitals lay in the Mandarin area, a northern koine served officials and the court from at least the fourteenth century; under the Ming and Qing it was called Guanhua, the language of the officials, which the Jesuit missionaries who learned it in the sixteenth century rendered as Mandarin.
zh:
官话本出于华北平原，方言分布范围从云南直到黑龙江。多数官话方言有四个声调，中古汉语的入声塞音韵尾已经消失，卷舌声母则往往保留。

女真金朝和蒙古元朝时期的北方口语称古官话，12至14世纪间用它写成的曲和杂剧等白话文学十分繁荣。1308年的《蒙古字韵》和1324年的《中原音韵》两部韵书记录了当时的音系。

由于历代帝都多在官话区，至迟14世纪起，一种北方共通语便通行于官场和朝廷；明清两代称之为官话，即官员的语言，16世纪来华学习这种话的耶稣会传教士把它译作曼达林。

official_raw.en: Mandarin is the $chinese_language_family$ language more spread across all China
official_raw.zh: 官话是$chinese_language_family$在中国流通最广的语言

en:
Mande is a family of sixty to seventy-five languages spoken by the Mandé peoples across West Africa. Linguistic reconstruction places the Mande homeland in the southern Sahara, in what is now Mauritania, around 4000 BC; the stone settlements of Dhar Tichitt there are linked to ancestral Mande societies.

Soninke speakers founded the Ghana Empire, or Wagadu, which rose in about 200 and collapsed in the twelfth century, and the Soninke were among the first West Africans to adopt Islam, in about the tenth century. The Manding branch later carried the languages of the Mali and Songhai worlds, with Jula serving merchants on the trans-Saharan trade routes.

Mande has a strong oral tradition, and from the spread of Islam its languages were also written in an adapted Arabic script known as Ajami.
zh:
曼德语是曼德各族使用的语族，含六十至七十五种语言，通行于西非。语言学家推断曼德语的原乡在今毛里塔尼亚境内的撒哈拉南部，时间约在公元前4000年；当地提希特陡崖的石砌聚落被认为与古代曼德社会有关。

说索宁克语的族群建立了加纳帝国，又称瓦加杜，约于200年兴起、12世纪崩溃，索宁克人还在10世纪前后成为最早改宗伊斯兰教的西非族群之一。曼丁支语后来通行于马里和桑海的世界，朱拉语则是跨撒哈拉商路上商人的通用语。

曼德语有深厚的口头传统，而自伊斯兰教传播以来，各语言也用经改造的阿拉伯字母阿贾米文字书写。

en:
Mangareva, self-called te reo magareva, is a Polynesian language of the Marquesic subgroup, spoken in the Gambier Islands, whose largest island bears the same name, and closely related to Marquesan and Hawaiian. Polynesians had settled Mangareva by the twelfth or thirteenth century and traded by canoe with Pitcairn to the east; the fourteenth-century migration from Easter Island left Mangarevan and the Easter Island language sharing much of their vocabulary.

The British captain James Wilson, reaching the islands in the ship Duff in 1797, gave the group its European name after Admiral Gambier. French missionaries who arrived in 1834, aided by a New Zealand Māori interpreter, were the first to write the language, and rendered its glottal stop with the letter h.
zh:
芒阿雷瓦语（自称特雷奥马加雷瓦）是马克萨斯语支的波利尼西亚语言，通行于甘比尔群岛，其中最大的岛屿也叫芒阿雷瓦，与马克萨斯语和夏威夷语亲缘密切。波利尼西亚人在12或13世纪已定居芒阿雷瓦，乘独木舟与东边的皮特凯恩岛贸易；14世纪从复活节岛迁来的移民使芒阿雷瓦语和复活节岛语言共享大量词汇。

1797年英国船长詹姆斯·威尔逊乘达夫号抵达，以海军上将甘比尔的封号为群岛命名。1834年法国传教士在一名新西兰毛利译员协助下到来，最早用文字记录这种语言，并以字母赫拼写它的喉塞音。

en: Manoki, also called Irantxe after its principal dialect and Mỹky after its other surviving dialect, is an indigenous language of the Diamantino and Brasnorte districts of Mato Grosso in western Brazil. It shows no convincing link to any established family and is treated as a language isolate, although contact with Arawak, Tupi, Nambikwara and Chapacuran neighbours has left loanwords.
zh: 马诺基语又称伊兰特谢语，名称来自其主要方言，另一尚存方言为米基语，通行于巴西西部马托格罗索州的迪亚曼蒂努与布拉斯诺特一带。它与任何已知语系都没有令人信服的亲缘关系，被视为孤立语，只是在与阿拉瓦克语、图皮语、楠比夸拉语和查帕库拉语邻族的接触中留下了借词。

en:
Mantion, better known to its own speakers as Sougb or Sogh, is a Papuan language of the eastern Bird's Head Peninsula in West Papua. The name Mantion, also written Manikion, originated as a derogatory exonym used by the seafaring Biak people. Sougb is spoken in the Arfak highlands and the country south and east of Manokwari.

Together with Meyah, Moskona and Irires it forms the East Bird's Head, or Mantion–Meyah, language family. The mountains and coasts where Mantion is spoken were reached from the fifteenth century by the tribute network of the Sultanate of Tidore, expanded through the Biak war leader Gurabesi's alliance with Sultan Al-Mansur.

No European post was planted in this interior in the period, so Mantion society remained under loose Tidore suzerainty and the influence of Biak traders and raiders.
zh:
曼廷语在母语者口中更常称苏格布语（Sougb，亦作Sogh），是西巴布亚鸟头半岛东部的巴布亚语言。“曼廷”又写马尼基翁，原本是擅长航海的比亚克人使用的贬义他称。苏格布语通行于阿尔法克高地以及马诺夸里以南和以东地区。

它与梅亚语、莫斯克纳语和伊里雷斯语共同构成东鸟头语系（又称曼廷—梅亚语系）。从15世纪起，曼廷语所在的山地与海岸被纳入蒂多雷苏丹国的朝贡网络，这一网络借由比亚克军事首领古拉贝西与苏丹阿尔-曼苏尔的联盟而扩张。

这一时期没有欧洲人在内地设立据点，因此曼廷人的社会长期处于蒂多雷松散的宗主权以及比亚克商人和掠奴者的影响之下。

en:
Manubara takes its name from one of the two members of the Manubaran family, a small group of the Southeast Papuan branch of Trans-New Guinea, spoken around Mount Brown in the Bird's Tail, the southeastern peninsula of New Guinea. The family consists of Doromu and Maria, also called Gebi or Manubara. Maria is spoken by villages of the mountainous interior behind the coast that would later hold Port Moresby.

The two share roughly sixty-three per cent of their vocabulary, marking them as related yet distinct tongues shaped by long separation in steep ridge country. The Spanish coastal voyages of 1545 under Yñigo Ortiz de Retez and of 1606 under Torres never reached the Mount Brown valleys.
zh:
马努巴拉语得名于马努巴兰语族两大成员之一的别名；该语族是跨新几内亚语系东南巴布亚语支下的小分支，通行于新几内亚“鸟尾”东南半岛的布朗山一带。语族由多罗穆语和玛丽亚语组成，后者又称格比语或马努巴拉语，使用者住在后来莫尔兹比港所在海岸后方的内陆山区村落。

两者词汇重合度约为百分之六十三，说明它们虽有亲缘关系，却因在陡峭山岭中长期隔绝而各自发展。1545年伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯和1606年托雷斯率领的西班牙沿海航行都没有抵达布朗山的山谷。

en:
Manus is the name given to the Oceanic languages spoken on Manus, the largest island of the Admiralty Islands in northern Papua New Guinea, and on its surrounding islets. About two dozen closely related tongues make up the group, divided into western, intermediate and eastern branches; they form a dialect continuum and share prenasalized trill sounds.

The name Manus, or Moanus, originally belonged to an ethnic group whose coastal villagers built their houses on stilts over the sea. The islanders were seasoned seafarers when the Spanish explorer Álvaro de Saavedra made the first recorded European sighting in 1528, circling the island and meeting natives who came out in canoes armed with bows; he charted it as Urays la Grande.
zh:
马努斯语是对通行于马努斯岛及周围小岛的一组大洋洲语言的称呼，马努斯岛是巴布亚新几内亚北部阿德默勒尔蒂群岛中最大的岛屿。这一语支约有二十多种亲缘很近的语言，分为西、中、东三支，彼此构成方言连续体，并共同拥有鼻化颤音。

马努斯（亦作莫阿努斯）最初是一个族群的名字，其沿海村民习惯把房屋建在海面之上的高脚桩柱上。1528年，西班牙探险家阿尔瓦罗·德·萨阿维德拉首次留下欧洲人发现该岛的记录，他绕岛航行时遇到乘独木舟、携弓箭前来的岛民，可见他们早已是老练的航海者；萨阿维德拉在地图上将其标为乌拉拉大岛。

en:
Te reo Māori is an Eastern Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken in New Zealand. Its speakers descend from voyagers who sailed from eastern Polynesia, the legendary Hawaiki, and settled New Zealand by about 1350; they developed regional dialects and an unwritten culture of genealogical recitation, songs and the haka.

The language had no script until European contact, which began with Captain James Cook in 1769. Between 1817 and 1830 missionaries, Māori chiefs such as Hongi Hika and the linguist Samuel Lee fixed an orthography in the Latin alphabet.

William Colenso printed the first books produced in New Zealand at Paihia in 1833, and his Māori New Testament of 1837 was the first Bible translation into an indigenous language published in the southern hemisphere. Māori then became a language of worship, newspapers and political meetings.
zh:
毛利语是新西兰的东波利尼西亚语言，属于南岛语系。说毛利语的人是东波利尼西亚航海者的后裔，他们从传说中的哈瓦基出发，约在1350年以前定居新西兰；他们发展出地区方言和口述文化，包括家谱吟诵、歌谣和哈卡战舞。

在1769年库克船长到来之前，毛利语没有文字。1817至1830年间，传教士与洪吉·希卡等毛利酋长及语言学家塞缪尔·李合作，用拉丁字母确定了毛利语的拼写规范。

威廉·科伦索于1833年在派希亚印出了新西兰本土最早的书籍，他1837年完成的毛利语《新约》是南半球第一部译成土著语言出版的圣经。毛利语由此成为宗教礼拜、报纸和政治集会使用的语言。

en:
Mapudungun, classified by most specialists as an isolate, was spoken at the Spanish arrival in the mid-sixteenth century by Picunche, Mapuche, Huilliche and Cunco groups, from the Limari and Choapa valleys to the Chiloe archipelago. Its name means speech of the land; the Spanish called it Araucano or the general language of Chile. Its dialects were mutually intelligible.

It had no writing before the Spanish, and the Jesuit Luis de Valdivia published its first grammar in 1606. After the Battle of Curalaba in 1598 and the destruction of the seven Spanish cities south of the Bio Bio, Mapudungun remained the everyday language of the independent Mapuche country.

Mapudungun's use retreated north of the Bio Bio under encomienda labour, disease and mestizaje. Between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries the araucanization of the Pampa and Patagonia carried the language eastward across the Andes among nomadic peoples.
zh:
多数学者把马普敦贡语归为孤立语。16世纪中叶西班牙人到来时，从利马里河谷、乔阿帕河谷到奇洛埃群岛，皮昆切人、马普切人、维利切人和昆科人都使用这种语言。其名称在本族语中意为“土地的言语”，西班牙人则称之为阿劳坎语或“智利通用语”。各方言彼此相通。

马普切人本无文字，耶稣会士路易斯·德·巴尔迪维亚于1606年出版了第一部语法。1598年库拉拉巴战役后，比奥比奥河以南的七座西班牙城市被毁，马普敦贡语始终是独立的马普切土地上的日常语言。

在比奥比奥河以北，由于委托劳役、疫病和混血，马普敦贡语的使用逐渐退缩。17至19世纪间，潘帕斯和巴塔哥尼亚的“阿劳坎化”进程又把这种语言随游牧族群带到安第斯山脉以东。

en:
Marathi is the Indo-Aryan language of Maharashtra on the Deccan, descended through an Apabhraṃśa stage from the Maharashtri Prakrit of ancient India. Its earliest records include a copper plate of 739 at Satara. After 1187 the Yadavas of Devagiri switched their inscriptions from Kannada and Sanskrit to Marathi, and by the fourteenth century it was the region's dominant written language.

Literature blossomed with the Varkari saints: Dnyaneshwar, who died in 1296, made it a philosophical vehicle in his Dnyaneshwari commentary on the Bhagavad Gita, a tradition continued by Eknath in the sixteenth century and Tukaram, who left more than three thousand devotional abhangs in the seventeenth.

From the thirteenth century Marathi was written in Modi for administration and Devanagari for literature. Missionary presses at Serampore issued a Marathi New Testament in 1811 and the first major Marathi-English dictionary in 1831.
zh:
马拉地语是德干高原马哈拉施特拉地区的印度—雅利安语言，由古代印度摩诃剌侘俗语经阿帕布拉姆沙阶段演变而来。最早的记录包括739年在萨塔拉发现的铜版铭文。1187年后，德瓦吉里的亚达瓦王朝在铭文中弃卡纳达语和梵语而改用马拉地语，到14世纪它已成为当地占主导的书面语。

文学随之繁荣：1296年去世的瓦卡里派圣徒迪亚内什瓦尔以马拉地语写成《薄伽梵歌》注疏《迪亚内什瓦里》，使这种语言成为哲学表达的工具；这一传统经16世纪的埃克纳特，延续到17世纪写下三千余首虔诚阿巴恩歌的图卡拉姆。

13世纪起，马拉地语行政上用莫迪字母、文学上用天城体书写。塞兰布尔的传教士印刷所于1811年印出马拉地语《新约》，第一部大型马拉地语—英语词典则在1831年问世。

en:
Mari is the Finno-Ugric speech of the Mari people, used along the Volga, Kama and Vyatka rivers in the Mari lands of eastern Russia. Neighbouring peoples long knew it as Cheremis, a name derived from the Khazar word tsarmis recorded in the tenth century, while Mari is the speakers' own autonym.

The Mari country passed from Volga Bulgaria and the Golden Horde to the Kazan Khanate in 1443, and centuries of Turkic rule left a layer of Tatar and Bulgar loanwords. After Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in 1552 and the Cheremis Wars ended in 1584, the Mari came under Russian rule.

The first written records appeared in the early eighteenth century, mostly Orthodox ecclesiastical works produced amid conversion efforts from about 1700. The first Hill Mari grammar, the Cheremis Grammar, was printed in Kazan in 1837.
zh:
马里语是马里人的芬兰—乌戈尔语言，通行于俄罗斯东部马里人故土的伏尔加河、卡马河和维亚特卡河流域。邻近民族长期称它为切列米斯语，这个名称来自10世纪哈扎尔文献中的察尔米斯一词，而马里是使用者的自称。

马里人的土地先后归属伏尔加保加利亚和金帐汗国，1443年转归喀山汗国，数百年的突厥统治在语言中留下了一层鞑靼语和保加利亚语借词。1552年伊凡雷帝攻占喀山，切列米斯战争于1584年结束后，马里人受俄罗斯统治。

最早的书面记录出现于18世纪初，多为约1700年起传教改宗过程中产生的东正教教会文献。第一部山地马里语语法《切列米斯语法》于1837年在喀山印行。

en:
Marind is the principal language of the Marind-anim people of the southern New Guinea lowlands, spoken around Merauke and the Bian River. Together with Yaqay and a few closely related tongues it forms the Marind-Yaqai family, placed in the Anim branch of the Trans-New Guinea phylum. Its dialects include Southeast Marind, Gawir, Holifoersch and Tugeri, while Bian Marind diverges enough to count as a separate language.

It was the language of a headhunting society whose Tugeri war parties raided neighbouring peoples and the Torres Strait islands, the waterway first traversed by the Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres in 1606. Officials and missionaries first systematically recorded it in the early twentieth century.
zh:
马林德语是新几内亚岛南部低地马林德-阿尼姆人的主要语言，通行于马老奇和比安河一带。它与亚凯语等几种近亲语言共同构成马林德－亚凯语族，归入跨新几内亚语系的阿尼姆语支。方言包括东南马林德语、加维尔语、福利福斯语和图格里语，而比安马林德语差异较大，被视为独立语言。

它的使用者曾以猎头闻名，图格里武士袭扰邻近族群和托雷斯海峡诸岛；这条水道在1606年由路易斯·巴埃斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙远征队首次穿行。这种语言在20世纪初才由官员和传教士系统记录。

en:
The Markham languages form a family of the Huon Gulf group within the Oceanic branch of Austronesian, comprising about a dozen tongues spoken in the Markham and Ramu valleys and the neighbouring lowlands of Madang and Morobe provinces in northern Papua New Guinea. Many Markham languages are spoken far inland, in the mountain valleys of Morobe, where they meet the Trans–New Guinea languages of the highlands.

They divide into a Lower Markham group, including Wampar, Labu and Duwet, and an Upper Markham group headed by Adzera. Centuries of contact with Papuan neighbours have left a heavy imprint on their vocabulary and grammar.

The lower Markham River reaches the sea at Markham Bay on the Huon Gulf, whose coasts were first charted by Europeans in the 1790s, when the French expedition of d'Entrecasteaux sailed these waters.
zh:
马卡姆诸语是南岛语系泛太平洋语支休恩湾语组下的一个语族，包含约十二种语言，通行于巴布亚新几内亚北部马卡姆河谷、拉穆河谷及马当省、莫罗贝省相邻的低地。许多马卡姆语言深入内陆，在莫罗贝的山间谷地与高地的跨新几内亚语言相接。

它们分为下马卡姆和上马卡姆两支：前者包括万帕尔语、拉布语、杜韦特语等，后者以阿泽拉语为首。与巴布亚邻族数百年的接触在词汇和语法上都留下了深刻烙印。

马卡姆河下游在休恩湾的马卡姆湾入海，1790年代当特尔卡斯托率领的法国探险队航行到此，欧洲人才首次测绘这片海岸。

en: Marovo is an Austronesian language of the New Georgia group in the Solomon Islands, spoken on the islands of Marovo Lagoon and on neighbouring New Georgia, Vangunu and Nggatokae. Its sentences follow verb–subject–object order and vowel length is distinctive, while its words for local animals resemble those of the related Roviana language yet remain clearly separate.
zh: 马罗沃语是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛的一种南岛语，通行于马罗沃潟湖诸岛以及邻近的新乔治亚岛、万古努岛和恩加托卡埃岛。它的句子按动词—主语—宾语的顺序排列，元音长短具有辨义作用；当地动物的名称与亲属语言罗维阿纳语相近，却又明显有别。

en: Maskoy, or the Lengua-Mascoy family, is a group of closely related tongues of the Paraguayan Gran Chaco, whose members include Enlhet and Enxet, once counted as the northern and southern dialects of one Lengua language, plus Guana, Sanapana, Angaite and Toba-Maskoy. They were spoken by forest hunter-gatherers and scarcely written down before the late nineteenth century.
zh: 马斯科伊语又称伦瓜-马斯科伊语系，是巴拉圭大查科地区一组亲缘紧密的语言，成员包括恩尔莱特语和恩克塞特语（二者曾被视为同一种伦瓜语的北方、南方方言），以及瓜纳语、萨纳帕纳语、安盖特语和托巴-马斯科伊语。它们原由查科森林中的狩猎采集者使用，在19世纪末以前几乎没有文字记录。

en:
Massachusett is the leading language of the Southern New England branch of Eastern Algonquian, a dialect chain that also covered the Wampanoag. The Pilgrims of the Mayflower met Wampanoag speakers in 1620 and made their peace with the sachem Massasoit the next year.

The Puritan minister John Eliot, who founded the first Indian praying town at Natick in 1651, translated the whole Bible into the Natick dialect. His Indian Bible of 1663 was the first Bible printed in North America and made Massachusett the first native language of the region with a body of written literature.

King Philip's War of 1675 to 1676, led by the Wampanoag sachem Metacom, shattered the praying towns and cost most of the region's peoples their lands; survivors who kept their speech carried it into a long, scattered decline through the eighteenth century.
zh:
马萨诸塞语是东阿尔冈昆语族南新英格兰分支的代表语言，属于一个方言连续体，同一条链上还包括万帕诺亚格人。1620年，五月花号上的移民遇到了说万帕诺亚格方言的人，并在次年与酋长马萨索伊特议和。

清教牧师约翰·艾略特于1651年在内蒂克建起第一座印第安人祈祷镇，并把整部圣经译成内蒂克方言。他的《印第安语圣经》于1663年出版，是北美印制的第一部圣经，也使马萨诸塞语成为当地第一种拥有书面文学的原住民语言。

1675—1676年由万帕诺亚格酋长梅塔卡姆领导的菲利普国王战争摧毁了祈祷镇，使这一地区的族群大多失去土地。保住母语的幸存者带着它，在18世纪漫长而离散的衰落中延续。

en:
Mataco–Guaicuru is a proposed language family of the Gran Chaco, spanning northern Argentina, western Paraguay, south-eastern Bolivia and the Mato Grosso do Sul corner of Brazil, uniting the Mataguayan languages Wichí, Chorote, Nivaclé and Maká with the Guaicuruan group, alongside the Guachi and Payagua isolates. The kinship was argued in detail by Pedro Viegas Barros, and shared words with Arawakan and Tupian neighbours place the proto-language in the upper Paraguay basin.

The two branches lived the Chaco very differently: Guaicuruan bands were nomadic warriors who, after the Spanish founded Asunción in 1537, took up horses and became frontier raiders, while Matacoan villagers settled along the rivers and lived by fishing, gathering and small-scale farming.
zh:
马塔科—瓜伊库鲁语是为大查科草原提出的一个语系，分布跨阿根廷北部、巴拉圭西部、玻利维亚东南部和巴西南马托格罗索一角，把马塔瓜约语支的维奇语、乔罗特语、尼瓦克莱语、马卡语，与瓜伊库鲁语支及瓜奇语、帕亚瓜语两个孤立语合为一家。学者佩德罗·维加斯·巴罗斯详加论证了这一亲缘关系；依据与阿拉瓦克语、图皮语邻语的共有词汇，其祖语被定位于巴拉圭河上游盆地。

两个语支的查科生活方式截然不同：瓜伊库鲁诸部本是游牧武士，1537年西班牙人建立亚松森后改用马匹，成为殖民边疆的袭掠者；马塔科诸村则沿河而居，以渔猎、采集和小规模农耕为生。

en:
Maya denotes the Mayan language family, whose members are spoken across southern Mexico, Guatemala, Belize and neighboring parts of Central America. All descend from Proto-Mayan, placed by reconstruction in the Guatemalan highlands; around 2200 BCE the Huastecan branch split off first, while the remaining languages diversified.

During the Classic period of roughly 250 to 900, scribes wrote a prestigious Ch'olan variety in Maya hieroglyphs, leaving thousands of inscriptions and a handful of bark-paper codices. In 1337 the Yucatán was divided among rival city-states after the fall of Mayapan.

From the 1520s to the 1540s the Spanish conquest brought the peninsula and the Guatemalan highlands under colonial rule. Missionaries then taught the Latin alphabet, and Maya speakers produced colonial literature in their own languages, including the K'iche' Popol Vuh and the Yucatec Books of Chilam Balam.
zh:
玛雅语是对整个玛雅语系的统称，其成员分布在墨西哥南部、危地马拉、伯利兹及中美洲邻近地区。诸语言都源自据构拟起源于危地马拉高地的原始玛雅语：约公元前2200年，瓦斯蒂克语支首先分出，其余语言随后分化。

约250—900年的古典期，书吏用玛雅象形文字书写一种尊贵的乔尔语变体，留下数千处铭文和数部树皮纸抄本。1337年时，尤卡坦在玛雅潘城邦衰落后分裂为彼此争战的城邦。

1520—1540年代，西班牙征服先后使尤卡坦半岛和危地马拉高地沦为殖民地。传教士随后推广拉丁字母，玛雅人用本族语言写出殖民文学，包括基切语的《波波尔·乌》和尤卡坦语的《奇拉姆·巴拉姆之书》。

en:
Maybrat, also called Ayamaru after its principal dialect, is a Papuan language of the central Bird's Head Peninsula in Southwest Papua, spoken most densely around the Ayamaru Lakes. No relationship to any other language has been demonstrated, so it is usually treated as a language isolate.

The name Maybrat combines mai, sound or speech, with Brat, the hill near the village of Semetu, so the word means the speech of Brat.

The Maybrat people live by hunting, fishing and swidden agriculture in scattered homesteads. While the Vogelkop coasts were drawn into the Sultanate of Tidore's tribute network from the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, and Luís Vaz de Torres's Spanish ships passed in 1606, the lake-studded Maybrat interior remained effectively beyond outside rule, its many dialects carried on in small, self-sufficient kin groups.
zh:
梅布拉特语以其主要方言又称阿亚马鲁语，是西南巴布亚鸟头半岛中部的巴布亚语言，使用者最集中于阿亚马鲁湖群周围。它与任何其他语言的亲缘关系都未获证明，因此通常被视为孤立语言。

“梅布拉特”由 mai（声音、言语）和 Brat（塞梅图村附近一座山丘之名）组成，意为“布拉特之言”。

梅布拉特人以狩猎、捕鱼和游耕为生，居住在分散的家户聚落中。尽管从15—16世纪起，鸟头半岛沿海已被纳入蒂多雷苏丹国的朝贡网络，1606年路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙船只也曾从附近经过，但湖泊密布的梅布拉特内地实际上始终处于外来统治之外，众多方言在自给自足的小型血缘群体中代代相传。

en:
Meitei, also called Manipuri, is a Tibeto-Burman language of the Imphal valley in Manipur on the India–Burma border, where it serves as the region's lingua franca; the standard form is the Imphal dialect. With a written tradition stretching back some two thousand years, it is one of the few old literary languages of Tibeto-Burman.

Early works include the ritual coronation song Ougri, possibly older than the Common Era, and the first-century epic Numit Kappa, while King Loiyumba's legal code Loyumba Shinyen was finalized in 1100.

Its own Meitei Mayek alphabet, first attested on sixth-century coins, was used until the Hinduizing king Pamheiba replaced it with the Bengali-Assamese script in the early eighteenth century and fostered Vaishnavite literature such as the Parikshit of 1725. The language remains the sacred liturgical tongue of the indigenous Sanamahi religion.
zh:
梅泰语又称曼尼普尔语，是印缅边境曼尼普尔邦因帕尔河谷的藏缅语族语言，也是当地的通用语，标准形式为因帕尔方言。它的书面传统约有两千年，是藏缅语族中少有的古老文学语言之一。

早期作品包括可能早于公元纪年的加冕仪式歌《乌格里》和1世纪史诗《射日》；国王罗伊尤姆巴的法典《罗伊尤姆巴辛延》于1100年定稿。

梅泰语自有梅泰梅耶克字母，最早见于6世纪钱币，一直沿用到18世纪初；印度教化的国王帕姆海巴改用孟加拉—阿萨姆字母，并扶持毗湿奴派文学，如1725年的《波利克湿多》。梅泰语也是本土萨纳马希宗教的神圣礼仪语言。

en:
Mel is the southern West Atlantic branch of the Niger-Congo family, spoken on the coast and in the hinterland of Guinea-Bissau, Guinea, Sierra Leone and Liberia. Its largest member is Temne of northern Sierra Leone, followed by Kissi; Gola's place in the branch is disputed.

The Temne trace their own origin to the Futa Jallon, and migrations in the fifteenth century, driven by Fulani domination, brought them south to the Kolenté and Rokel rivers; in the mid-sixteenth century the Mande invasion of the Mane overran their country and grafted new kingdoms onto the older chiefdoms.

Portuguese mariners left the first written records: Pereira noted Temne words in memoirs written between 1505 and 1508. In 1787 Temne rulers granted land at Freetown for a settlement of freed slaves, which became a centre of Christian missions and literacy in the region.
zh:
梅尔语是尼日尔—刚果语系西大西洋语支的南部分支，通行于几内亚比绍、几内亚、塞拉利昂和利比里亚的沿海与内陆地区。最大的成员是塞拉利昂北部的滕内语，其次是基西语；戈拉语在该语支中的归属则有争议。

滕内人自称来自富塔贾隆，15世纪在富拉尼人的压力下南迁，抵达科伦泰河与罗克尔河流域；16世纪中期，曼丁哥系的马内人入侵并征服他们的土地，在旧有酋邦之上嫁接出新的王国。

葡萄牙航海者留下了最早的文字记录：佩雷拉在1505—1508年写成的游记中记下了滕内语词汇。1787年，滕内统治者在弗里敦拨出土地安置获释黑奴，这里后来成为基督教传教和当地文字教育的中心。

en:
Mengen is an Oceanic language of the Ngero-Vitiaz linkage, spoken in the Pomio District of eastern New Britain, around Jacquinot Bay and in the inland villages behind it. Its varieties form three divergent dialects: north-coast Maeng, south-coast Poeng, and inland or Bush Mengen, also called Longueinga; some linguists treat Poeng and Maeng as distinct languages.

Long contact along Wide Bay has left Mengen features on Sulka, the non-Austronesian isolate spoken farther along the coast. Mengen descends from the speech of the Austronesian seafarers who settled the New Britain coast around 1500 BCE, the same Oceanic expansion whose related languages run westward through the Vitiaz Strait to the coasts of New Guinea.
zh:
门根语是恩盖罗—维蒂亚兹语链下的一种大洋洲语言，通行于新不列颠岛东部波米奥县的雅克诺湾一带及湾后内陆的村落。它分为三种差异颇大的方言：北海岸的马恩方言、南海岸的波恩方言，以及又称隆恩加的内陆“丛林门根”方言；部分语言学家主张把波恩和马恩视为两门独立的语言。

在宽湾沿岸的长期接触中，门根语的一些特征影响了更远处沿海使用的非南岛孤立语言苏尔卡语。门根语源出公元前1500年前后定居新不列颠海岸的南岛航海者的语言；同一场大洋洲语扩张还把亲缘语言向西穿过勇士号海峡，带到新几内亚岛海岸。

en:
Min is the most internally diverse branch of the Sinitic languages, centered on Fujian and taking its name from the Min River. Fujian was opened to Han settlement only in 110 BCE, when the armies of Emperor Wu destroyed the Minyue state.

Its rugged mountains screened the region from the northern migrations, so Min alone, with the extinct Shu, keeps distinctions of Old Chinese that the rhyme dictionary Qieyun of 601 no longer records, overlaid on a substrate left by the Minyue natives.

The Disaster of Yongjia in 311 brought refugees south. In 893 Wang Chao entered Fujian with an army, and his son Wang Shenzhi founded the Min Kingdom in 909. These waves stacked Han, Six Dynasties and Tang Chang'an layers on the old base, including a literary reading tradition written in Chinese characters.
zh:
闽语是汉语各方言中内部分歧最大的一支，以福建为中心，名称取自闽江。直到公元前110年汉武帝出兵攻灭闽越国，福建才对汉人定居开放。

山岭阻隔使这里较少受到北方移民浪潮影响，因此闽语与已消亡的蜀语一样，保留了601年《切韵》已不再记录的上古汉语特征，其下还叠着闽越土著语言的底层。

311年永嘉之乱驱使北人南迁。893年王潮率军入闽，其子王审知于909年建立闽国。几番移民把汉代、六朝和唐代长安的语言层次叠加在古老底层之上，包括以汉字书写的文读传统。

en: Minanibai is the name-bearing language of the Inland Gulf family of Trans-New Guinea languages, spoken inland of the Gulf of Papua in southern Papua New Guinea, from the Omati River in Gulf Province to the Aramia River further west. Its branch also includes Mubami and the Hoia Hoia varieties, while Ipiko stands apart as the family's other main branch.
zh: 米纳米拜语是内陆海湾语族中同名支系的语言。该语族属跨新几内亚语系，通行于巴布亚新几内亚南部巴布亚湾内陆，从海湾省的奥马蒂河口一直到更西边的阿拉米亚河。米纳米拜支还包括穆巴米语和霍亚霍亚诸变体，而伊皮科语则是该语族另一个差异较大的独立分支。

en:
Misumalpan is a small language family of the Mosquitia lowlands along the Caribbean coast of Nicaragua and Honduras, taking its name from its three branches, Miskito, Sumo and Matagalpa. The Sumo branch comprises Mayangna and Ulwa in the forested river basins, while the Matagalpan languages were spoken in the inland highlands.

The languages drew loanwords from neighbouring Arawak and Carib speakers and, after European contact, from English, Dutch and German traders. From the late 1600s the Miskito, allied with English settlers and buccaneers through the Kingdom of Mosquitia, carried their speech along the coast as a regional lingua franca, and neighbouring Sumo communities gradually shifted to it.
zh:
米苏马尔潘语是莫斯基蒂亚低地的一个小语系，分布在尼加拉瓜和洪都拉斯的加勒比海沿岸，名称取自其三个分支——米斯基托语、苏莫语和马塔加尔帕语。苏莫一支包括林区河流地带的马扬格纳语和乌尔瓦语，马塔加尔帕一支则通行于内陆高原。

这些语言从邻近的阿拉瓦克语和加勒比语，以及欧洲人到来后英语、荷兰语、德语商人的用语中吸收借词。17世纪末起，米斯基托人经莫斯基托王国与英国殖民者和海盗结盟，把米斯基托语带到沿海各地，成为地区通用语，邻近的苏莫族群也逐渐改用该语。

en:
Mon is an Austroasiatic language of the Mon people, spoken chiefly in the lower Irrawaddy valley and along the Tenasserim coast in present-day Myanmar. Old Mon inscriptions from the Mon kingdom of Dvaravati in central Thailand date from the sixth to eighth centuries; Mon writing in lower Burma became the parent of the Burmese alphabet.

Until the twelfth century Mon was the lingua franca of the Irrawaddy valley, even at the Bamar court of Pagan, where King Kyansittha patronized it and the Myazedi inscription of 1112 was carved in Pali, Pyu, Mon and Burmese.

After Pagan fell in 1287 it again served as the court language of the Hanthawaddy kingdom at Pegu; the fall of the restored Hanthawaddy kingdom in 1757 drove many Mon speakers into Siam, and by 1830 most of lower Burma had shifted to Burmese.
zh:
孟语是孟人使用的南亚语系语言，主要通行于今缅甸南部的伊洛瓦底江下游和丹那沙林沿岸。泰国中部孟人古国陀罗钵地留下的古孟文碑铭可追溯至6—8世纪；下缅甸的孟文后来成为缅文字母的母体。

12世纪以前，孟语一直是伊洛瓦底江流域的通用语，连缅人蒲甘王朝的宫廷也使用它：国王江喜陀大力扶持，1112年的妙齐提碑同时以巴利语、骠语、孟语和缅甸语四种文字刻成。

1287年蒲甘灭亡后，孟语再度成为勃固汉达瓦底王国的宫廷语言；1757年后勃固王朝覆灭，大批孟语使用者逃入暹罗，到1830年，下缅甸大部分地区已改用缅甸语。

en:
Mongolian is the principal language of the Mongolic family, native to the Mongolian Plateau and carried across Eurasia by the Mongol conquests. The oldest surviving Mongolian text, the Stele of Yisüngge, was carved around 1224 in the Uyghur-based vertical Mongolian script, which Genghis Khan's empire adopted from the Uyghurs.

The thirteenth and fourteenth centuries also saw the 'Phags-pa script of 1269 and Chinese-character transcriptions in the Secret History of the Mongols. Under the Yuan dynasty Mongolian served as the guoyu, or national language, and after the dynasty fell in 1368 the retreating Mongol courts kept the tradition alive in the steppe.

Between the seventeenth and nineteenth centuries a standardized written form known as Classical Mongolian emerged, used for the translated Kangyur and Tengyur Buddhist canon, historical chronicles and, from 1686, the Soyombo alphabet.
zh:
蒙古语是蒙古语族最主要的语言，原产于蒙古高原，随蒙古征服传播到欧亚大陆各地。现存最早的蒙古语文献是约1224年刻成的《也松格碑》，使用成吉思汗帝国从回鹘人那里采用的竖写回鹘式蒙古文。

13—14世纪还出现了1269年颁行的八思巴文和用汉字音写的《蒙古秘史》。元朝时蒙古语以“国语”之名通行，1368年元朝灭亡后，退回草原的蒙古汗廷延续了这一书面传统。

17—19世纪间，规范化的书面语“古典蒙古语”形成，用于翻译佛经《甘珠尔》《丹珠尔》、撰写史书，并在1686年催生了索永布文字。

en:
Mordvinic is a small subgroup of the Uralic family consisting of two languages, Erzya and Moksha, both spoken in the middle Volga region around Mordovia; they are not mutually intelligible, and the medieval Meshcherian language may have belonged to the same group. The name Erzya first appears in a letter of the Khazar khagan Joseph in 968.

The Mongol conquest of the thirteenth century placed the Mordvins inside the Golden Horde. In the late fourteenth century Moscow seized the western Mordvin lands while the east passed to the Kazan Khanate, and after Kazan fell in 1552 all Mordvins became Russian subjects.

Russian rule brought forced conversion to Christianity, an influx of Russian settlers and serfdom; a joint rebellion of Mordvins, Chuvash and Mari in the seventeenth century was suppressed, after which many Mordvins fled east beyond the Volga.
zh:
莫尔多瓦语是乌拉尔语族的一个小分支，由埃尔齐亚语和莫克沙语两种语言组成，都通行于伏尔加河中游、即后来的莫尔多瓦一带；二者互不相通，中世纪的梅谢拉语可能也属于这一分支。埃尔齐亚之名最早见于968年可萨汗约瑟夫的书信。

13世纪蒙古征服后，莫尔多瓦人被纳入金帐汗国。14世纪末，莫斯科夺取了西部的莫尔多瓦土地，东部则归入喀山汗国；1552年喀山陷落后，所有莫尔多瓦人都成为俄罗斯臣民。

俄罗斯的统治带来了强迫改宗基督教、俄罗斯移民涌入和农奴制；17世纪莫尔多瓦人同楚瓦什人、马里人联合起义，遭到镇压后，许多莫尔多瓦人向东逃过伏尔加河。

en: Moru-Madi is a cluster of closely related languages of the Central Sudanic family, spoken across the borderlands of South Sudan, Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Its members include Moru, Ma'di, Lugbara, Aringa, Keliko and Logo, and the name Ma'di is also used more loosely for several peoples of Uganda's West Nile region.
zh: 莫鲁‑马迪语是中苏丹语族下一群关系紧密的语言，通行于南苏丹、乌干达和刚果（金）的交界地带，成员包括莫鲁语、马迪语、卢格巴拉语、阿林加语、凯利科语和洛戈语等；“马迪”这个名字也被宽泛地用来称呼乌干达西尼罗河地区的若干部族。

en: Moseten, or the Moseten-Chimane dialect continuum, is an isolate of the Bolivian lowlands, spoken along the Beni River by Tsimane and Moseten villagers; its Covendo, Santa Ana and Chimane varieties remain mutually intelligible. Jesuit and Franciscan missionaries evangelized these communities, and its proposed links to the Chon languages, like shared words with Puquina and Yuracare, suggest contact, not proven kinship.
zh: 莫塞滕语又称莫塞滕-奇马内方言连续体，是玻利维亚低地的一种孤立语，由贝尼河沿岸的奇马内人和莫塞滕人使用，科文多、圣安娜和奇马内三种变体彼此仍能相通。耶稣会和方济各会的传教士曾向这些社群传教；至于它与琼语系的亲缘假说，以及它和普基纳语、尤鲁卡雷语共有的词语，都更像是长期接触的结果，而非已证实的同源关系。

en:
Movima is the language of the Movima people of the Llanos de Moxos, the seasonally flooded savanna of the Beni department in Bolivia, where it is spoken in Yacuma Province. It has no proven relatives and is regarded as a language isolate.

From the 1670s Jesuit priests moving out from Santa Cruz de la Sierra gathered the peoples of the region into mission reductions along the Mamoré River, beginning with Loreto and with Trinidad founded in 1686; Movima was among the indigenous languages spoken in these missions, where the Arawakan language Moxo served as the common tongue.
zh:
莫维马语是玻利维亚贝尼省莫霍斯平原上莫维马人的语言，通行于亚库马省一带。莫霍斯平原是一片季节性泛滥的热带草原，而莫维马语没有可证实的亲属语言，被视为孤立语言。

17世纪70年代起，从圣克鲁斯-德拉谢拉出发的耶稣会神父把当地各族群集中到马莫雷河畔的传教镇，最早的是洛雷托，特立尼达传教站建于1686年；莫维马语是这些传教区里使用的原住民语言之一，传教区的通用语则是阿拉瓦克语系的莫霍语。

en:
Mu Ngava, recorded by linguists as Rennellese or Rennell-Bellona, is a Polynesian outlier language spoken on Rennell and Bellona, two small islands south of the main Solomon Islands chain and well outside the Polynesian Triangle.

The islands were first occupied by Lapita peoples, with further waves of settlement around the second century BC and about AD 1000; the population descends from Polynesians who arrived from Uvea, now Wallis Island, before 1400, and oral tradition recalls the voyage of an ancestor named Kaitu'u around that time.

Captain Butler of HMS Walpole became the first European to sight the islands in 1801. The language keeps a five-vowel system, favours open consonant-vowel syllables, and traditionally orders words verb-subject-object, with reduplication used to form plurals and new terms.
zh:
穆恩加瓦语在语言学记录中称伦内尔语或伦内尔—贝罗纳语，是一种波利尼西亚域外点语言，通行于所罗门群岛主岛链以南、远在波利尼西亚三角之外的两座小岛拉纳尔岛和贝罗纳岛。

两岛最早由拉皮塔人定居，公元前2世纪和公元1000年前后又有新的移民潮；居民是1400年以前从乌韦阿（今瓦利斯岛）迁来的波利尼西亚人的后裔，口述传统中保留着始祖凯图大约在那时渡海而来的故事。

1801年，沃尔波尔号的巴特勒船长成为最早望见两岛的欧洲人。穆恩加瓦语保留五个元音，多用辅音加元音的开音节，传统词序为动词—主语—宾语，并靠重叠构成复数和新词。

en:
Muchik, better known as Mochica and in colonial records as Yunga, is the extinct language isolate of the Peruvian north coast, spoken across the desert valleys of Lambayeque and La Libertad that were home to the Moche civilization from about 100 to 800 and to its Sicán or Lambayeque successor between 750 and 1375. Its peculiar lateral sounds struck every Spanish cleric who heard it.

Documentation began early: a manuscript of 1582 preserves Mochica texts, and Fernando de la Carrera Daza printed the Arte de la lengua yunga at Reque in 1644, the only colonial grammar.

Quechua and Spanish spread along the coast under Inca and then Spanish rule, steadily narrowing the language's domain; by the nineteenth century Muchik survived only in a few villages around Chiclayo and Eten, where scholars such as Ernst Middendorf raced to record it.
zh:
穆奇克语常称莫奇卡语，殖民文献中又叫荣加语，是秘鲁北海岸已消亡的孤立语言，通行于兰巴耶克和拉利伯塔德的沙漠河谷——约公元100—800年的莫切文明，以及750—1375年继之而起的西坎（兰巴耶克）文化都分布在这一带。它特殊的边音让每一位听过它的西班牙教士都印象深刻。

它的文献记录开始得很早：1582年的一份手稿保存了穆奇克语文本，费尔南多·德拉卡雷拉于1644年在雷凯印行了唯一一部殖民时期语法《荣加语技艺》。

在印加和西班牙先后统治下，克丘亚语和西班牙语沿海岸传播，穆奇克语的使用范围不断缩小；到19世纪，它只残存在奇克拉约和埃滕附近的几个村庄里，米登多夫等学者赶在最后时刻记录了它。

en:
Mumeng is an Oceanic dialect chain of the South Huon Gulf linkage, part of the Huon Gulf group of Western Oceanic languages, spoken in the mountain villages behind the southern shore of the Huon Gulf in Morobe Province.

Its varieties fall into two clusters, Dambi–Kumalu and Gorakor–Patep–Zenag, whose speakers understand one another only in part, while Kapin may be a more distant member of the same chain.

The neighboring Iwal tongue, the most conservative of the South Huon Gulf languages, preserves old counting on hands and feet up to twenty, called one person. Spanish ships under Yñigo Ortiz de Retez passed this coast in 1545, and the French expedition of 1792 to 1793, in which Jean-Michel Huon de Kermadec served, left his name on the gulf and the peninsula beyond it.
zh:
穆孟语是南休恩湾语链的一支大洋语方言链，属于西大洋语休恩湾语群，通行于莫罗贝省休恩湾南岸后方的山村。

它的变体分为丹比—库马卢与戈拉科尔—帕特普—泽纳格两簇，使用者之间只能部分互通；卡平语可能是这条语链中更远的成员。

邻近的伊瓦尔语是南休恩湾语言中最保守的一支，保留着用手脚数到二十、称为“一个人”的传统计数法。1545年，伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯率领的西班牙船只经过这段海岸；1792—1793年，让—米歇尔·休恩·德·凯尔马德克参加的法国探险队又把他的名字留给了这座海湾和湾外的半岛。

en:
Munda is the western branch of the Austroasiatic family, distantly related to Mon, Khmer and Vietnamese, and is spoken across eastern India, Bangladesh and Nepal. Linguists derive Proto-Munda from South-East Asia: pre-Proto-Munda speakers are thought to have reached the Mahanadi delta on the Odisha coast by sea around 1500 BCE and then to have spread inland up the river system.

The family splits into North Munda, centred on the Chota Nagpur Plateau of Jharkhand, and South Munda in central Odisha; its principal languages include Santali, the largest, Mundari, Ho and Korku.

Head-final and agglutinating, they distinguish inclusive from exclusive first-person plural, lack grammatical gender and make wide use of numeral classifiers. Long the established population of the plateau and adjoining hills, Munda communities came under pressure from expanding Indo-Aryan kingdoms during the first millennium CE and retreated into forested uplands.
zh:
蒙达语是南亚语系的西部语支，与孟语、高棉语、越南语互为远亲，分布在印度东部、孟加拉国和尼泊尔境内。语言学家认为原始蒙达语源自东南亚：其先民约在公元前1500年沿海路抵达奥里萨海岸的默哈讷迪三角洲，随后溯河深入内陆。

蒙达语分为以贾坎德邦焦达讷格布尔高原为中心的北支，以及通行于奥里萨中部的南支；主要语言包括使用人数最多的桑塔利语，还有蒙达里语、霍语和科尔库语等。

这些语言动词居句末、属黏着类型，第一人称复数区分包括式与排除式，没有语法性别，量词使用广泛。蒙达族群本是高原及邻近丘陵的老居民，在公元一千纪间随印度—雅利安诸邦扩张而受压，逐渐退入林区山地。

en:
Bohurá, or Mura proper, was the principal language of the Mura family in Amazonas, Brazil, spoken along the Autaz and Manicoré rivers; its sister varieties were Pirahã on the Maici and the unattested Yahahí. Its speakers called themselves Buhuraen, while their Torá and Matanawi neighbours pronounced the name Murá. The language is agglutinative, uses tone and whistled speech, and has a very small sound inventory.

The Mura first appear in records in 1714 on the lower Madeira. After Portuguese slavers raided them, they opposed the Jesuit missions and colonial penetration through most of the eighteenth century with river ambushes. Around 1768 they moved north beyond the Solimões and ranged between the Madeira, Purus and Autaz, reaching their greatest extent around 1774, when government troops burned dozens of their settlements. Weakened by epidemics and Munduruku pressure, they made peace in 1784. In the early nineteenth century they still numbered tens of thousands, but in the Cabanagem revolt of 1834 to 1836 they joined the rebels and suffered heavy massacres.
zh:
博乌拉语又称穆拉语正本，是巴西亚马孙州穆拉语族的主要语言，通行于奥塔斯河与马尼科雷河沿岸；同族的姊妹方言有麦西河一带的皮拉罕语和已无语言材料存世的亚哈希语。使用者自称布胡伦，邻族托拉人和马塔纳维人则把这个名字读成穆拉。该语言属黏着语，有声调和口哨语，音位数量很少。

穆拉人最早见于1714年的文献，当时居住在马代拉河下游。葡萄牙奴隶贩子掳掠他们之后，他们在18世纪的大部分时间里以河道伏击抵抗耶稣会传教和殖民渗透。1768年前后，他们北迁越过索利蒙伊斯河，活动于马代拉河、普鲁斯河与奥塔斯河之间，约1774年势力达到极盛，招致政府军焚毁数十处聚落。在疫病和蒙杜鲁库人的夹击下，他们于1784年议和。19世纪初其使用者仍数以万计，但在1834至1836年的卡巴纳仁起义中，穆拉人加入叛军一方，遭到惨重屠杀。

en:
Muscogee, also called Creek, is the principal language of the Eastern Muskogean branch, which also includes Hitchiti-Mikasuki, Alabama, Koasati and the now-silent Apalachee. It was historically the language of the Muscogee Creek Confederacy of Alabama and Georgia, heirs of Mississippian mound-building towns such as Moundville, whom Hernando de Soto's expedition met in the 1540s.

The closely related Eastern Muskogean varieties were largely mutually intelligible. Early in the eighteenth century Muscogee speakers moving into Florida merged with Hitchiti-Mikasuki and other groups to form the Seminole.

Divisions over dealing with the United States kindled the Red Stick, or Creek, War of 1813 to 1814; Andrew Jackson's victory and the Treaty of Fort Jackson cost the confederacy twenty-two million acres, and in the 1830s most Muscogee and Seminole were forced beyond the Mississippi to Indian Territory.
zh:
马斯科吉语又称克里克语，是东马斯科吉语支最主要的语言；同一语支还有希奇蒂—米卡苏基语、亚拉巴马语、夸萨蒂语以及已无人使用的阿巴拉契语。历史上，马斯科吉语是亚拉巴马和佐治亚一带马斯科吉克里克联盟的语言，联盟的先民是芒德维尔等密西西比式土丘城镇的建造者，16世纪40年代埃尔南多·德索托的远征队曾与他们相遇。

东马斯科吉语支各近亲方言大体可以互通。18世纪初，迁入佛罗里达的马斯科吉语使用者与希奇蒂—米卡苏基人等群体融合，形成塞米诺尔人。

对美态度的分歧引发1813—1814年的红棍战争（又称克里克战争），安德鲁·杰克逊取胜后订立的《杰克逊堡条约》使联盟丧失2200万英亩土地；19世纪30年代，大部分马斯科吉人和塞米诺尔人被强制迁往密西西比河以西的印第安领地。

en:
Mussau, or Mussau-Emira, is the Oceanic language of Mussau and Emirau, the two principal islands of the St Matthias or Mussau group, the northernmost island chain of the Bismarck Archipelago. Together with the closely related Tenis tongue it forms the St Matthias subgroup, which linguists treat as an independent primary branch within the Oceanic family.

Mussau itself is a hilly island largely covered by primeval rainforest. The archipelago was reached by the Lapita seafarers, the Austronesian potters whose sites stretch from Mussau to Samoa and who are believed to have spoken Proto-Oceanic, the ancestral language from which Mussau descends, during their spread through Island Melanesia between roughly 1600 and 500 BCE.
zh:
穆绍语又称穆绍—埃米劳语，是穆绍岛和埃米劳岛上的大洋洲语言；这两座岛是圣马提亚群岛（亦称穆绍群岛）的主岛，而该群岛是俾斯麦群岛最北端的岛链。它与亲缘很近的特尼斯语共同组成圣马提亚语支，语言学家将其视为大洋洲语系下独立的基本分支。

穆绍岛多山，大部分地表覆盖着原始雨林。约公元前1600年至前500年间，制陶的南岛航海者拉皮塔人到达了这片群岛，其遗址分布范围从穆绍一直延伸到萨摩亚；学界认为拉皮塔人使用原始大洋洲语，那正是穆绍语所源出的祖语。

en:
Mwotlap, once recorded as Motlav, is an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family, belonging to the Torres–Banks linkage of northern Vanuatu. It is at home on Motalava in the Banks Islands, with communities on Ra and Vanua Lava. Volow, formerly spoken in eastern Motalava and long extinct, is sometimes counted as one of its dialects.

Like the other Torres–Banks languages it descends from the speech of the Lapita voyagers, who carried Austronesian languages into Remote Oceania and settled Vanuatu from about 1200 BCE. Centuries of isolation on small islands produced closely related but distinct island languages. Mwotlap was maintained through oral tradition, in genealogies, chants and storytelling, for the islands had no indigenous script.
zh:
莫塔拉瓦语旧称莫特拉夫语，是南岛语系大洋洲语族的语言，属于瓦努阿图北部的托雷斯-班克斯语链。它通行于班克斯群岛的莫塔拉瓦岛，拉岛和瓦努阿拉瓦岛上也有使用者。曾通行于莫塔拉瓦岛东部、早已消亡的沃洛语，有时被视为它的一种方言。

和托雷斯-班克斯的其他语言一样，它源自拉皮塔航海者的语言：这些航海者把南岛语言带进遥远大洋洲，约从公元前1200年起定居瓦努阿图诸岛。小岛之间数百年的隔绝，造就了同源却各不相同的岛屿语言。由于当地没有本土文字，莫塔拉瓦语靠家谱、吟唱和讲故事的口述传统相传。

en:
Myaamia, better known as Miami-Illinois, is a Central Algonquian language of the Algic family, historically spoken across Illinois, Indiana, western Ohio and the upper Mississippi by the Miami, Wea and Piankeshaw and the tribes of the Illinois Confederation.

French missionaries gave it its earliest written form: Claude-Jean Allouez composed prayers and a catechism at Kaskaskia in the late seventeenth century, and Jacques Gravier compiled an Illinois-French dictionary of nearly six hundred pages and twenty thousand entries in the early eighteenth.

Warfare, disease and Anglo-American settlement thinned the Miami peoples after the late 1700s, yet documentation continued: the Miami chief Little Turtle's visit to Philadelphia produced wordlists, one said to have been commissioned by Thomas Jefferson, and a Wea primer for Protestant missionaries was printed in Kansas in 1837.
zh:
麦阿米亚语通称迈阿密—伊利诺伊语，是阿尔吉克语系的一门中阿尔冈昆语言，历史上通行于伊利诺伊、印第安纳、俄亥俄西部和密西西比河上游，使用者包括迈阿密人、韦亚人、皮安凯肖人以及伊利诺伊联盟诸部。

法国传教士最早为它留下文字记录：17世纪末，阿卢埃在卡斯卡斯基亚编写了祈祷文和教理问答；18世纪初，格拉维耶编成一部近600页、收录约2万词条的伊利诺伊语—法语词典。

18世纪末以后，战争、疫病和英裔移民的拓殖使迈阿密诸部人口锐减，但语言记录并未中断：迈阿密首领小乌龟访问费城时促成了几份词汇表，其中一份据说由托马斯·杰斐逊委托编写；1837年，堪萨斯还为新教传教士印行了一部韦亚语入门读本。

en: Naasioi, also called Nasioi or Kieta, is a Papuan language of the South Bougainville family, spoken in the central mountains and on the southeast coast of Kieta District on Bougainville Island, Papua New Guinea. The family is verb-final, unlike the verb-medial Oceanic languages, and contains words of Proto-Oceanic origin; an older scheme placed it in the proposed East Papuan grouping.
zh: 纳西奥伊语又名纳西奥语或基埃塔语，是南布干维尔语系的一种巴布亚语，通行于巴布亚新几内亚布干维尔岛基埃塔区的中部山区和东南海岸。与动词居中的泛太平洋诸语不同，该语系语言动词居句末，并含有原始泛太平洋语来源的借词；较早的分类方案曾把它归入拟议中的东巴布亚语群。

en:
The Na-dené languages are a family of Native North American tongues grouped into two branches: Tlingit on the coast and islands of southeast Alaska, and Eyak-Athabaskan, which comprises Eyak of Alaska's south-central coast and the widespread Athabaskan, or Dene, languages.

Athabaskan speech runs from Alaska and the Yukon through western Canada to Oregon and northern California, with a separate southern cluster, Apachean, in the American Southwest.

These languages are built around complex verbs woven from many prefixes, and several use tone to distinguish words. They were long carried only by oral tradition: the first Tlingit words were recorded by a French expedition in 1786, and Russian Orthodox missionaries later gave Tlingit a Cyrillic alphabet and printed religious works in it.
zh:
纳‑德内语是北美原住民的一个语系，分为两支：一支是通行于阿拉斯加东南部海岸与岛屿的特林吉特语，另一支是埃雅克－阿萨巴斯卡语支，包括阿拉斯加中南部海岸的埃雅克语和分布极广的阿萨巴斯卡诸语言，又称德内诸语言。

阿萨巴斯卡语从阿拉斯加、育空沿加拿大西部一直延伸到俄勒冈和加利福尼亚北部，另有一支南方的阿帕切语群，分布于美国西南部。

这些语言的核心是由大量前缀缀合而成的复杂动词，其中几种还靠声调区别词义。它们长期只靠口耳相传：1786年一支法国考察队首次记下特林吉特语的词汇，后来俄罗斯东正教传教士又为特林吉特语制定了西里尔字母表，并用它刊印宗教书籍。

en:
Nahuatl is the principal language of the Nahuan branch of the Uto-Aztecan family, spoken in central Mexico since at least the seventh century. It was the tongue of the Mexica, the people of the Aztec Empire, and as their power spread the variety of Tenochtitlan became a prestige language across Mesoamerica, recorded in pictorial codices.

After the fall of Tenochtitlan in 1521, Spanish missionaries gave Nahuatl a Latin alphabet, and the literary norm known as Classical Nahuatl produced grammars, chronicles, poetry and administrative records. Andrés de Olmos wrote its first printed grammar, while Bernardino de Sahagún compiled the Florentine Codex with Nahua scribes.

In 1570 Philip II decreed Nahuatl the official language of New Spain, and Horacio Carochi published a grammar in 1645. Words such as chocolate, tomato and coyote passed into Spanish and other languages.
zh:
纳瓦特尔语属犹他-阿兹特克语系纳瓦语支，至迟在7世纪已通行于墨西哥中部，是墨西加人即阿兹特克人的语言。随着阿兹特克势力扩张，特诺奇蒂特兰方言成为中部美洲具有威望的通用语，以图画手抄本记录。

1521年特诺奇蒂特兰陷落后，西班牙传教士为它引入拉丁字母；古典纳瓦特尔语留下了语法书、编年史、诗歌和行政文书。安德烈斯·德·奥尔莫斯写出第一部印行的语法，贝尔纳迪诺·德·萨阿贡则与纳瓦抄写员合作编成《佛罗伦萨手抄本》。

1570年，腓力二世下诏将纳瓦特尔语定为新西班牙的官方语言；1645年，奥拉西奥·卡罗奇出版了语法著作。巧克力、番茄、郊狼等词便经由它进入西班牙语和其他语言。

en:
Nakanamanga, also called North Efate or Nguna, is an Oceanic language of northern Efate and the smaller islands off its coast, including Nguna and parts of Tongoa, Emae and Epi.

The waters and islets of northern Efate were the heartland of the Roi Mata, a chiefly title borne by a dynasty of rulers from the eleventh to the seventeenth century; the last Roi Mata, who lived around 1600, was buried with his retinue on Eretoka island, a site long held sacred. James Cook reached Efate in 1774 aboard HMS Resolution and named it Sandwich Island, after which the area was drawn into British and French rivalry over the New Hebrides.
zh:
纳卡纳芒阿语又称北埃法特语或恩古纳语，是一种大洋洲语，通行于埃法特岛北部及其外海的小岛，包括恩古纳岛和汤戈阿岛、埃马埃岛、埃皮岛的部分地区。

埃法特北部的海域和小岛是洛伊·玛塔酋长的核心领地：从11世纪到17世纪，一个酋长王朝世代承袭洛伊·玛塔头衔；最后一位洛伊·玛塔约生活在1600年，死后与随从一起葬在埃雷托卡岛，该遗址一直被视为圣地。1774年，詹姆斯·库克乘“决心号”抵达埃法特岛，将其命名为桑威奇岛，此后这一地区被卷入英法在新赫布里底的争夺。

en:
Nambikwara is the chief language of the small Nambikwaran family, spoken by the nomadic Nambikwara peoples of the Mato Grosso and Rondônia interior of western Brazil. The family falls into Sabanê, Northern Nambikwara, also called Mamaindê, and Southern Nambikwara, the dialect cluster usually meant by the name alone, whose varieties are not mutually intelligible.

Europeans heard of the people as early as 1671, but sustained contact began only in 1770, when Portuguese gold-seekers cut a road through their lands between Forte Bragança and Vila Bela. The language long remained unwritten. Nambikwara distinguishes three tones, and its verbs carry suffixes for person, number, aspect and tense combined with evidentiality.
zh:
楠比夸拉语是小型的楠比夸拉语系中最主要的语言，由巴西西部马托格罗索与朗多尼亚内陆的游牧楠比夸拉诸族使用。该语系分为萨巴内语、北楠比夸拉语（又称马曼德语）和南楠比夸拉语三支；单称楠比夸拉语时，通常指后者的方言群，其各方言已不能互通。

欧洲人早在1671年便提到这个族群，但持续接触迟至1770年才开始：寻找黄金的葡萄牙人开辟了穿越其土地、连接布拉干萨堡与维拉贝拉的道路。这种语言长期没有文字。楠比夸拉语区分三个声调；动词带有人称、数、体以及时制与言据性相结合的后缀。

en:
