Nanai, called Gold in Russian accounts and Hezhen in China, is the southern Tungusic tongue of the fishing peoples of the middle and lower Amur, the Sungari and the Ussuri. The self-name Nanai means people of the land, while Hezhen began as the self-designation of the lower-Amur bands.

Early in the seventeenth century these Amur peoples resisted Nurhaci but surrendered to Hong Taiji in 1631, after which the Qing imposed the shaved forehead and queue and Manchu words and customs spread among them. French Jesuit surveyors descending the Amur in 1709 found villagers clothed in cured fish skins and called them the Fish-skin Tartars.

Nanai is agglutinative with subject-object-verb order and many dialects along the rivers. Like other Amur languages it had no script of its own in this period, being written in a Cyrillic alphabet only in later times.
zh:
赫哲语在俄罗斯旧记中又称戈尔德语，俄国境内通称那乃语，是满‑通古斯语族南支的语言，通行于阿穆尔河中下游、松花江和乌苏里江一带的渔猎民族中。“那乃”这一自称意为本地人，“赫哲”则原是阿穆尔河下游部落的自称。

17世纪初，阿穆尔河诸部曾抵抗努尔哈赤，1631年归降皇太极；此后清朝强令剃发留辫，满语词汇和满族习俗随之深入。1709年，沿阿穆尔河下行的法国耶稣会测绘人员见到以鞣制鱼皮为衣的村民，称之为鱼皮鞑子。

赫哲语是黏着语，语序为主宾动，沿江分布着多种方言。和阿穆尔河流域的其他语言一样，它在本时期没有本族文字，后来才以西里尔字母书写。

en: The Napuruna, or Quijos of the Napo basin between Ecuador and Peru, once spoke a language remembered as Shillipanu and known only as guttural, bird-imitating speech. Never written down, it was displaced by Quechua spread through Inca trade and Jesuit missions, leaving only traces in later Napo Kichwa; the Quijos revolt of 1578 ended in defeat and mission resettlement.
zh: 纳普鲁纳人即厄瓜多尔与秘鲁边境纳波河流域的基霍斯人，曾有自己的语言，名为希利帕努语，后人只知道它是模仿鸟兽之声的浑厚喉音。它没有文字记录，随着克丘亚语借印加贸易和耶稣会传教扩散而被取代，仅在后来的纳波基奇瓦语中留下少许痕迹；1578年的起义失败后，基霍斯人被重新安置到传教村落。

en:
Natchez is the language, usually treated as an isolate, of the Natchez chiefdom of the lower Mississippi valley, whose ancestors were the mound-building Plaquemine culture.

Some linguists posit a distant link to the Muskogean family, but no wider relationship has won acceptance. Its grammar used active-stative alignment and subject-object-verb order, and storytellers kept a special cannibal-speech register for oral tales.

Closest to Natchez were the Taensa and Avoyel, fellow Plaquemine descendants, while the Yazoo, Koroa and Tiou were neighbours whose speech is barely recorded. French colonists under La Salle met these peoples from 1682, and Antoine-Simon Le Page du Pratz wrote down Natchez words in the early 1700s; after the Natchez revolt of 1729 and the French destruction of the chiefdom in the 1730s, surviving speakers took refuge among the Chickasaw, Creek and Cherokee.
zh:
纳奇兹语通常被视为孤立语言，是密西西比河下游纳奇兹酋邦的语言；纳奇兹人的祖先属于建造土丘的普拉克明文化。

少数学者推测它与穆斯科格语系有远亲关系，但更广泛的亲缘说未获公认。其语法采用主动—静态配列和主宾谓语序，讲述口头故事的人还保留一种专门的食人者话语。

与纳奇兹语最接近的是同出普拉克明文化的塔恩萨语和阿沃耶尔语，而亚祖语、科罗阿语和蒂乌语等邻族的语言几乎没有留下记录。1682年拉萨尔率领的法国殖民者接触这些民族，安托万·西蒙·勒帕热·迪普拉在18世纪初记下了纳奇兹语词汇；1729年纳奇兹人起事，18世纪30年代法国人摧毁其酋邦，幸存的使用者投奔奇克索人、克里克人和切罗基人。

en:
Natugu, formerly called Santa Cruz after its island, is the main Oceanic language of Nendö, the largest of the Santa Cruz Islands in the southeastern Solomons, and the chief member of the Reefs–Santa Cruz group; its name means our language. It shares Nendö with two smaller neighbours, Nalögo and Nanggu.

Its numerals follow a decimal system built around two sets of five, with six to nine formed by adding a suffix to the words for one to four.

The islanders were deep-ocean voyagers, sailing outrigger canoes called tepukei and navigating by wave patterns and the stars. The Spanish explorer Álvaro de Mendaña, the first European to reach them, sighted the islands in 1595, founded a short-lived colony at Graciosa Bay on Nendö, and died there in 1596.
zh:
纳图古语旧称圣克鲁斯语，得名于所在的岛屿，是所罗门群岛东南部圣克鲁斯群岛最大岛嫩多岛的主要语言，属泛太平洋语族的礁岛—圣克鲁斯语支，在该语支中使用最广；它的名字意为“我们的语言”。嫩多岛上还有纳洛戈语和南古语两种较小的语言与它并存。

它的数字采用以两组五为基础的十进制，六至九由一至四加后缀构成。

岛民是远洋航行的能手，驾驶名叫特普凯的舷外浮杆独木舟，凭浪形和星象导航。最早到来的欧洲人是西班牙探险家阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚，他于1595年望见群岛，在嫩多岛的格拉西奥萨湾建立了一个短命殖民地，并于1596年死在那里。

en:
Ndrumbea, also spelled Dubea or Dumbea and called Naa Dubea in the language itself, is a Kanak language of the Extreme Southern New Caledonian group, spoken around Païta near Nouméa. The names of Nouméa and of the neighbouring town of Dumbéa both derive from this language, whose speakers were gradually pushed out of the capital district into surrounding villages.

Like its close relative Numèè, it descends from Proto-Oceanic, brought to New Caledonia by Lapita settlers around 1000 BCE. Ndrumbea is one of the few tonal languages in the Austronesian family, using pitch to distinguish words, and it also preserves a series of consonants unusual among the languages of the region.
zh:
恩德伦贝亚语又拼作杜贝亚语或敦贝亚语，自称纳阿杜贝亚语，属新喀里多尼亚语群极南支，通行于努美阿附近的帕伊塔一带。努美阿和邻近城镇丹贝亚的名字都来自这种语言，而其使用者逐渐被挤出首府地区，迁到周围村庄。

与近亲努梅语一样，它源自拉皮塔定居者约公元前1000年带到新喀里多尼亚的原始大洋洲语。恩德伦贝亚语是南岛语系少有的声调语言，以音高区别词义，还保留了一套在当地语言中不同寻常的辅音。

en:
Duke, known to its own speakers as Dughore or Kolei, is an Oceanic language of Kolombangara island in the New Georgia group of the Solomon Islands; the name Duke is an outsider's exonym.

Oral history records that the north-west, north-east and south-east of the island once had languages of their own, but those communities were annihilated in warfare in the early 1800s and their tongues died with them; only the south-western Dughore people survived, holding out in a chain of hill fortresses.

In the later nineteenth century exchange with Vella Lavella, Simbo and Roviana brought borrowed vocabulary into the language. Duke keeps the Oceanic pronoun series, including dual and trial forms, and marks inalienable possession of body parts and kin with possessive suffixes.
zh:
恩杜克语是所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛科隆班加拉岛上的一种泛太平洋语系语言，使用者自称杜戈雷语或科莱语，恩杜克是外人使用的他称。

口述史传，岛上的西北、东北和东南曾各有本土语言，但那些社群在19世纪初的战争中被消灭，语言也随之消亡，只有西南的杜戈雷人凭借一连串山寨堡垒幸存。

19世纪后期，与维拉拉维拉岛、辛博岛和罗维阿纳地区的往来给恩杜克语带来了一些外来词汇。它保留着泛太平洋语言的代词系列，包括双数和三数形式，并以领属后缀标记身体部位、亲属等不可让渡的领属关系。

en:
Nehan, also called Nissan or Nihan, is an Oceanic Austronesian language of the Green Islands, a small atoll group between New Britain and Bougainville in Papua New Guinea. It is spoken on Nissan and Pinipel, and gives its name to the Nehan–North Bougainville linkage, the branch of the Northwest Solomonic family that also covers the Tinputz, Buka, Bannoni and Mono tongues.

Archaeological finds show that the islanders long kept up a pre-colonial trade with Buka, exchanging pigs, pottery and shell money. British and American whaling vessels began calling at the Green Islands for provisions in 1837, the first on record being the Addison.
zh:
内汉语又名尼桑语或尼汉语，是绿岛群岛的一种泛太平洋语族南岛语；该群岛是巴布亚新几内亚新不列颠岛与布干维尔岛之间的小型环礁群。它通行于尼桑岛和皮尼佩尔岛，并为内汉—北布干维尔语链命名，这条西北所罗门语系的分支还涵盖廷普茨语、布卡语、巴诺尼语和莫诺语。

考古发现表明，岛民很早便与布卡岛保持前殖民时期贸易，交换猪、陶器和贝币。1837年起，英美捕鲸船开始到绿岛群岛补给，有记载的第一艘是艾迪生号。

en:
Nenets is the northernmost language of the Uralic family, belonging to its Samoyedic branch and split into Tundra Nenets and Forest Nenets. Its speakers moved from southern Siberia to the Arctic coast before the twelfth century and came to occupy the tundra from the Kanin Peninsula to the Yenisei River, living by hunting and reindeer herding.

Russian fur traders reached them in the sixteenth century, and in 1601 Mangazeya was founded on the Taz River as a base for collecting tribute. After the sea route was closed in 1619 the town declined and was abandoned in the 1670s, partly after Nenets attacks on its tax collectors.

Large-scale reindeer herding, the economy that came to define tundra life, spread among the Nenets during the eighteenth century, while the language absorbed loans from Komi, Khanty and Russian.
zh:
涅涅茨语是乌拉尔语族分布最靠北的语言，属于萨莫耶德语支，分为冻原涅涅茨语和森林涅涅茨语两种。使用者在12世纪以前从南西伯利亚迁至北冰洋沿岸，占据了从卡宁半岛到叶尼塞河的冻原地带，以狩猎和驯鹿放牧为生。

16世纪，俄罗斯毛皮商人来到他们中间；1601年，塔兹河畔建起曼加泽亚，作为征收贡赋的基地。1619年海上航路被封禁后，该城走向衰落，17世纪70年代终被废弃，部分原因是涅涅茨人袭击了当地的税吏。

18世纪，大规模驯鹿放牧在涅涅茨人中普及，成为冻原生活的标志；与此同时，涅涅茨语也吸收了科米语、汉特语和俄语的借词。

en: Nengone is a Kanak language of the Loyalty Islands subgroup, spoken on Maré Island and the smaller neighbouring island of Tiga in present-day New Caledonia. The word nengone itself refers both to Maré and to the language spoken there, and is popularly connected with a native word meaning to ask or to question.
zh: 嫩贡语是洛亚蒂群岛分支的卡纳克语言，通行于今新喀里多尼亚的马雷岛和邻近较小的提加岛。嫩贡一词既指马雷岛，也指岛上所说的语言，民间词源把它和当地意为询问、提问的词联系起来。

en:
Nepali is the principal Eastern Pahari language of the Northern Indo-Aryan zone, originally the speech of the Khas people and known in its early form as Khas Kura. It grew from the Middle Indo-Aryan vernaculars of the western Himalayas.

Its home was the Sinja valley, heartland of the Khasa Kingdom that flourished between the tenth and fourteenth centuries. The earliest known Nepali inscription, at Dullu in Dailekh, dates to about 981. After the Khasa realm broke up it was carried eastward by Khas migrants into the Gandaki basin.

Its rise began in the sixteenth century under the Kingdom of Gorkha. When Prithvi Narayan Shah unified the hill states into the Kingdom of Nepal in the later eighteenth century, Gorkha speech, as Nepali was then called, became the language of court and administration. It is written in the Devanagari script.
zh:
尼泊尔语是北印度—雅利安语区东帕哈里组最主要的语言，最初是卡斯人的语言，早期形式称“卡斯库拉”。它由喜马拉雅西部的中期印度—雅利安口语发展而来。

其故乡是辛贾谷地，即10—14世纪兴盛的卡萨王国的核心地带；已知最早的尼泊尔语铭文刻于代莱赫的杜卢，年代约在981年。卡萨王国瓦解后，这种语言随卡斯人移民东传至甘达基盆地。

16世纪，尼泊尔语在廓尔喀王国开始兴起。18世纪后期，普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿统一各山地土邦、建立尼泊尔王国，当时被称作廓尔喀话的尼泊尔语随之成为宫廷和行政语言。它使用天城文书写。

en:
Nicobarese is a group of closely related Austroasiatic languages spoken across the Nicobar Islands, in the eastern Indian Ocean northwest of Sumatra. The most widely used is Car, while the Shompen of Great Nicobar's interior speak a closely related lect.

The islands were known to maritime peoples early: the name Nakkavaram appears on a Tamil Chola inscription of 1050, the Persian navigator Abu Zayd al-Sirafi described them in the ninth century, and both Marco Polo's account and Zheng He's charts mark them.

Organized European contact began when the Danish East India Company claimed the islands in 1754 and administered them from Tranquebar as the Frederiksøerne. Malaria wrecked the Moravian mission on Nancowry and forced repeated abandonments between 1784 and 1834, so the islanders and their languages were only lightly touched by outside rule in this period.
zh:
尼科巴语是一组关系密切的南亚语系语言，通行于印度洋东部、苏门答腊西北方的尼科巴群岛。其中使用最广的是卡尔语，大尼科巴岛内陆肖姆彭人的语言则是与它们相近的一支。

群岛很早就为航海民族所知：1050年的泰米尔朱罗铭文已出现“纳卡瓦拉姆”之名，9世纪波斯航海家阿布·扎伊德·西拉菲曾记述这些岛屿，马可·波罗的游记和郑和的海图也都标注过它们。

有组织的欧洲接触始于1754年，丹麦东印度公司宣布占有群岛，以特兰奎巴为管辖地，称其为弗雷德里克群岛。疟疾摧毁了南科里岛上的摩拉维亚传教站，并迫使丹麦人在1784—1834年间数次放弃，因此在这一时期，岛民及其语言受到外来统治的影响还很有限。

en:
Nigerian covers the Volta-Niger branch of Niger-Congo, once classed as the East Kwa languages: Yoruba and Igala of the Yoruboid group, Edo, Igbo, the Nupoid speech of Nupe and Gbari, and Idoma, all tonal tongues of southern Nigeria. Its oldest urban centre was Ile-Ife, a Yoruba city-state by the fifth century BCE whose Ife Empire flourished from 1200 to about 1420 and produced naturalistic brass and terracotta sculpture. In the fifteenth century the warlike Oyo Empire, ruled by the Alaafin from Oyo-Ile, displaced Ife as the leading Yoruba power and made Dahomey its tributary; under Fulani pressure and civil war Oyo collapsed after 1800, and Egba refugees founded Abeokuta in 1830.

Benin's Edo speakers traced their state to the Ogiso kings of Igodomigodo around 900 and to the Ife prince Oranmiyan, who introduced the title Oba; Oba Ewuare, from 1440, enlarged the kingdom and fortified its capital Edo, the Portuguese arrived in 1485, and Oba Esigie repelled an Igala invasion early in the next century while royal casters made the Benin Bronzes. The Igbo lived in republican village assemblies under the priest-kings of Nri, and Igbo-Ukwu has yielded ninth-century bronzes; the Aro Confederacy of Arochukwu later sold Igbo captives to the ships of the Bight of Biafra. On the Niger and Kaduna rivers the Nupe kingdom arose in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries under Tsoede, titled Etsu; its ruler adopted Islam about 1770, and the Sokoto jihad overran it in the 1800s, installing a Fulani dynasty at Bida.
zh:
尼日利亚语涵盖尼日尔—刚果语系的沃尔特—尼日尔语支，旧称东克瓦语，包括约鲁巴语组的约鲁巴语和伊加拉语、埃多语、伊博语、努佩人和格巴里人所讲的努佩语组语言，以及伊多马语，都是通行于尼日利亚南部的声调语言。最古老的城市中心是约鲁巴人的城邦伊莱伊费，早在公元前5世纪已经立国，其伊费帝国在1200年至约1420年间盛极一时，留下了写实风格的黄铜和赤陶雕塑。15世纪，尚武的奥约帝国在阿拉芬统治下以奥约伊莱为都，取代伊费成为约鲁巴首强，并使达荷美称臣；1800年后，在富拉尼人的压力和内战中奥约崩溃，埃加难民于1830年另建阿贝奥库塔。

贝宁讲埃多语的居民把国家源流追溯到约900年伊戈多米戈多的奥吉索诸王，以及引入“奥巴”王号的伊费王子奥兰米扬；1440年即位的奥巴埃瓦雷扩张疆土、设防首都埃多，葡萄牙人于1485年抵达，奥巴埃西吉在16世纪初击退伊加拉人的入侵，宫廷匠师则制作了贝宁青铜器。伊博人以共和式的村落议事会自治，精神上奉恩里的祭司王为权威，伊博乌库还出土了9世纪的青铜器；后来阿罗丘库的阿罗联盟向比亚法拉湾的贩奴船供应伊博俘虏。尼日尔河与卡杜纳河之间的努佩王国于14至15世纪在措埃德治下兴起，他采用埃楚的王号；约1770年努佩统治者改宗伊斯兰教，19世纪初索科托圣战席卷该国，在比达立起富拉尼王朝。

en: Nimboran is a small independent family of Papuan languages spoken west of Lake Sentani, in the Grime and Nawa river country of Jayapura Regency on New Guinea's north coast. Its members include Namblong, also called Nimboran, Mekwei, Kemtuik and Gresi; their reconstructed pronouns set them apart from the neighbouring Trans–New Guinea families.
zh: 宁博兰语是巴布亚诸语言中一个独立的小语族，通行于新几内亚北海岸查亚普拉县、森塔尼湖以西的格里姆河与纳瓦河流域。成员包括又称宁博兰语的南布隆语、梅奎语、肯图伊克语和格雷西语——格雷西语即这一文化所使用的语言；其构拟代词与周边的跨新几内亚语系语言明显不同。

en:
Nimoa, also called Rifao, is an Oceanic Austronesian language spoken on Nimoa and neighbouring islands of the Louisiade Archipelago off the eastern tip of New Guinea. With Sudest, the language of nearby Tagula or Vanatinai Island, it forms the Nimoa–Sudest family of the Kilivila–Misima linkage within the Papuan Tip branch.

Most Papuan Tip languages have adopted the verb-final word order of their Papuan neighbours, but Nimoa, Sudest and the Kilivila island languages keep the older subject–verb–object order typical of Austronesian. The Spanish expedition of Luís Vaez de Torres first sighted Tagula and its neighbours on 14 July 1606, charting them as Tierra de San Buenaventura.
zh:
尼莫阿语又名里福语，是一种泛太平洋语族南岛语，通行于新几内亚东端外海路易西亚德群岛的尼莫阿岛及邻近岛屿。它与邻近塔古拉岛（又称瓦纳蒂奈岛）的苏代斯特语共同组成尼莫阿—苏代斯特语族，隶属巴布亚尖端语支下的基利维拉—米西马语链。

多数巴布亚尖端语言受邻近巴布亚语影响改用动词居末的语序，但尼莫阿语、苏代斯特语和基利维拉诸岛语保留了南岛语典型的主语—动词—宾语旧语序。1606年7月14日，路易斯·巴埃斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队首次望见塔古拉岛及邻近岛屿，将它们绘入地图并命名为圣博纳文图拉之地。

en: Nisa is a Papuan language of the eastern shore of Cenderawasih Bay, once called Geelvink Bay, in the Indonesian province of Papua; Nisa and Anasi are its two dialects. It belongs to the East Geelvink Bay family of about a dozen tongues, whose best-known member is Bauzi, a language of the inland villages reported to make use of whistled speech.
zh: 尼萨语是印度尼西亚巴布亚省极乐鸟湾东岸的一种巴布亚语言，尼萨和阿纳西是它的两种方言。它属于约含十二种语言的东极乐鸟湾语族，其中最知名的是鲍齐语，通行于内陆村落，据记载还使用口哨传话的方式。

en:
Nivkh, long called Gilyak in Russian sources, is the language of the Nivkh fishermen and hunters of the lower Amur, the Amgun basin and northern Sakhalin, and stands as a language isolate, or the small Amuric family on its own.

Its varieties form a dialect continuum along the Amur and Sakhalin coasts whose extremes are not mutually intelligible; no link to any other family has been demonstrated.

The Nivkh have lived on the river and the island for thousands of years, trading with Ainu, Japanese and Chinese neighbors until Russians reached the Amur country in the 1600s. The language is agglutinating with subject-object-verb order and consonant lenition, where one word's final sound changes the next word's opening consonant. It had no script of its own and was carried by oral tradition, only later being written in a modified Cyrillic alphabet.
zh:
尼夫赫语在俄罗斯旧文献中长期被称为吉利亚克语，是黑龙江下游、阿姆贡河流域和萨哈林岛北部以渔猎为生的尼夫赫人的语言，属于语言孤岛，本身即独立的阿穆尔语系。

它的各方言构成一条连续体，分布在阿穆尔河沿岸与萨哈林沿海，两端彼此不能互通；它与任何语系都未能证明亲缘关系。

尼夫赫人在河畔和岛上已生活数千年，与邻近的阿伊努人、日本人和中国人贸易往来，直到17世纪俄罗斯人进入阿穆尔河流域。尼夫赫语是黏着语，语序为主宾动，并有辅音弱化现象：前一个词的尾音会改变后一个词的首辅音。它没有本族文字，靠口传延续，后来才以改良的西里尔字母记录下来。

en:
North Dravidian is the northernmost branch of the Dravidian family and consists of three languages: Brahui, Kurukh and Malto. Brahui is spoken in Balochistan, around Kalat and Quetta, more than fifteen hundred kilometres from the nearest other Dravidian speech, and is commonly regarded as a relic of a Dravidian presence across north-western South Asia before the spread of Indo-Aryan languages, its speakers perhaps holding the region since the second millennium BC.

Much of its vocabulary comes from Balochi, an Iranian language that reached the area only around the year 1000, and Brahui is written in the Arabic script.

Kurukh, the language of the Oraon, and its closest relative Malto are spoken far to the east, on the Chota Nagpur Plateau and adjoining areas. Kurukh is written in Devanagari. All three keep Dravidian grammar beneath large Indo-Aryan and Iranian vocabularies.
zh:
北达罗毗荼语是达罗毗荼语族最靠北的一支，由布拉灰语、库鲁克语和马尔托语三种语言组成。布拉灰语通行于俾路支斯坦的卡拉特、奎达一带，与最近的其他达罗毗荼语相隔逾一千五百公里，通常被视为达罗毗荼语曾遍布南亚西北部、后因印度—雅利安语扩张而退缩的遗存，其使用者可能自公元前两千纪起便留居此地。

它的大量词汇来自伊朗语俾路支语，后者约于1000年进入这一地区；布拉灰语采用阿拉伯字母书写。

库鲁克语是奥拉昂人的语言，与亲缘最近的马尔托语一起通行于东方的焦达讷格布尔高原及其邻近地区。库鲁克语以天城体书写。三种语言都在大量印度—雅利安语和伊朗语词汇之下，保持着达罗毗荼式的语法。

en:
North Ethiopic groups two North Ethio-Semitic tongues: Tigrinya, spoken in the highlands of Tigray and Eritrea, and Tigre, spoken in the Eritrean lowlands and adjoining Sudan. Both are close kin of Ge'ez, the language of writing and worship, while Tigre and early Tigrinya served as everyday speech and long went unwritten.

Tigre may have been the main vernacular of the port of Adulis. One early attestation is a fourteenth-century word list compiled for the Rasulid ruler of Yemen.

Tigrinya, written in Ge'ez script, was the tongue of Orthodox communities under the Ethiopian crown and Medri Bahri, whereas Muslim Tigre speakers commonly used Arabic as their lingua franca. The wars of the Adal sultanate and the Ottoman seizure of Massawa in 1557 bound the coastal Tigre country to the Red Sea Islamic world, while the Tigrinya highlands stayed within the Christian Ethiopian orbit.
zh:
北埃塞俄比亚语有两门北埃塞俄比亚闪米特语言：通行于提格雷和厄立特里亚高原的提格里尼亚语，以及通行于厄立特里亚低地和苏丹邻近地区的提格雷语。二者都是格尔兹语的近亲；格尔兹语是书写和礼拜用语，提格雷语和早期提格里尼亚语则是日常口语，长期没有文字。

提格雷语可能曾是阿杜利斯港的主要土语。早期记录之一，是14世纪为也门拉苏里统治者编纂的词汇表。

提格里尼亚语用格尔兹字母书写，是埃塞俄比亚王权治下和梅德里巴赫里领地内东正教社群的语言；提格雷语的穆斯林使用者通常以阿拉伯语为通用语。阿达尔苏丹国的战争和奥斯曼帝国于1557年夺取马萨瓦，使沿海的提格雷地区并入红海伊斯兰世界，而说提格里尼亚语的高原仍留在基督教埃塞俄比亚的势力范围内。

en:
The Gallo-Italic languages, with Venetian often added to the group, descend from the Vulgar Latin of Cisalpine Gaul, with a Celtic substrate and a Lombardic superstrate left by the Lombard invasions of the sixth century. Gallo-Italic colonies planted after the Norman conquest of Sicily around 1100 survive as language islands in Sicily and Basilicata.

The vernaculars long served local administration, but from the fifteenth century literary Tuscan, championed by humanists such as Pietro Bembo, displaced them from writing, a trend encouraged at the Sforza court of Ludovico il Moro in Milan.

Local literature nonetheless endured: Carlo Maria Maggi standardized Milanese spelling in the seventeenth century and created the stage mask Meneghino, while in Venice Ruzante, Goldoni and Gozzi made Venetian the voice of comedy and the republic made it a Mediterranean lingua franca.
zh:
高卢—意大利语（威尼斯语也常被划入这一群）源自山南高卢的通俗拉丁语，底层是凯尔特语，又带有6世纪伦巴第人入侵留下的伦巴第语上层成分。1100年前后诺曼人征服西西里后迁入的高卢—意大利语移民，在西西里和巴西利卡塔形成语言岛并长期存续。

这些地方语言长期用于当地行政，但从15世纪起，彼得罗·本博等人文主义者推崇的托斯卡纳文学语把它们逐出书面领域，米兰卢多维科·斯福尔扎的宫廷也推动了这一趋势。

地方文学仍然延续：17世纪卡洛·玛丽亚·马吉规范了米兰方言的拼写并创造了舞台面具梅内金；在威尼斯，鲁赞特、哥尔多尼和戈齐让威尼斯语成为喜剧的声音，威尼斯共和国也使它成为地中海的通用语。

official_raw.en: The people in the northern part of the Italian Peninsula speak languages in this group.
official_raw.zh: 意大利半岛北部的人们使用这一群组的语言。

en:
The Nubian languages belong to the Northern Eastern Sudanic branch of the Nilo-Saharan family and are the ancient speech of the middle Nile, spoken in southern Egypt and northern Sudan.

After the conversion of the Nubian kingdoms in the sixth century, Old Nubian became a literary language written in a Coptic-based alphabet; manuscripts and inscriptions survive from the Christian kingdoms of Nobatia, Makuria and Alodia. The Arab conquest of Egypt in 641 opened a frontier regulated for centuries by the Baqt treaty.

After the Christian kingdoms collapsed the Funj made Soba the seat of their sultanate in 1504, under whose rule Arabic and Islam advanced. When Egyptian armies conquered the Funj realm in 1821, Nubian was retreating up the Nile, though Hill Nubian speech still held scattered villages in Kordofan and the Nuba Hills.
zh:
努比亚语属于尼罗—撒哈拉语系北东苏丹语支，是尼罗河中游的古老语言，通行于埃及南部和苏丹北部。

6世纪努比亚诸王国皈依基督教后，古努比亚语成为用科普特字母变体书写的文学语言，手抄本和铭文留存于诺巴提亚、穆库拉和阿洛迪亚三个基督教王国。641年阿拉伯人征服埃及，开启了边境，双方靠《巴克特》条约维系数百年。

基督教王国崩溃后，丰吉人于1504年以索巴为都建立苏丹国，阿拉伯语和伊斯兰教在其治下推进。1821年埃及军队攻灭丰吉政权时，努比亚语已沿尼罗河后退，但山地努比亚语仍守在科尔多凡和努巴山区的零散村落里。

en:
Numèè, also called Kwényi or Kapone, is a Kanak language of the Extreme Southern New Caledonian group, spoken at the southern tip of Grande Terre around Yaté and Mont-Dore and on the offshore Isle of Pines. Its speakers descend from Lapita communities that brought Proto-Oceanic to New Caledonia after 1000 BCE.

Numèè forms a close pair with Ndrumbea, the language of the Nouméa region. Although Numèè has been called the language of Nouméa, the capital's name most likely comes from Ndrumbea, once spoken on the site of the city.
zh:
努梅语又称克维尼语或卡波内语，属新喀里多尼亚语群极南支，通行于格朗德特尔岛南端的亚泰、蒙多尔以及近海的松树岛。其使用者是公元前1000年后把原始大洋洲语带到新喀里多尼亚的拉皮塔社群的后裔。

努梅语与努美阿地区的恩德伦贝亚语是一对近亲。尽管努梅语曾被称作努美阿之语，但首府努美阿的名字更可能来自曾通行于城址之上的恩德伦贝亚语。

en:
Nuuchi-Nuwuwi is the Southern Numic group of the Uto-Aztecan family, carrying the related speech of the Ute, Southern Paiute, Chemehuevi and Kawaiisu across the Great Basin and the Colorado River country.

Its main body is the Colorado River Numic dialect chain: Ute, whose speakers call their tongue núuchi, meaning 'of the people'; Southern Paiute; and Chemehuevi, who call themselves Nüwüvi, 'the people'. Kawaiisu is a separate close relative.

Like the other Numic languages it descends from Proto-Numic, whose homeland linguists place in the southern Sierra Nevada about two thousand years ago; a slow Numic expansion then carried these dialects eastward through the deserts, giving them their historic range by around 1000. Its speakers lived by hunting and gathering in small mobile bands, moving between mountains, river valleys and arid basins.
zh:
努奇努乌语是犹他-阿兹特克语系的南努米克语支，承载着犹特人、南派尤特人、切梅惠维人和卡瓦伊苏人彼此相近的语言，通行于大盆地和科罗拉多河流域。

它的主体是科罗拉多河努米克方言链：犹特人把自己的话称作“努奇”，意为“属于人的”；另有南派尤特方言，以及自称“努武维”、意为“人”的切梅惠维方言；卡瓦伊苏语则是与之相近的独立亲属语言。

与其他努米克语言一样，它源自原始努米克语，语言学家把其原乡定在约两千年前的内华达山脉南部；此后努米克人缓慢扩张，把这些方言向东带过沙漠，到1000年前后形成了历史上的分布范围。说这种语言的族群以狩猎采集为生，分成流动的小群体，辗转于山地、河谷与干旱盆地之间。

en:
Nyamwezi, or Kinyamwezi, is a major Bantu language of west-central Tanzania, spoken across the plateau region called Unyamwezi, around Tabora and Singida. It forms a dialect continuum with Sukuma, its close northern neighbour. The name is Swahili, meaning people of the moon or people of the west, and covers five related groups.

Nyamwezi oral tradition places their arrival on the plateau in the 1600s, where they lived in small chiefdoms and turned from farming and fishing to long-distance caravan trade. By 1800 their caravans carried Katanga copper, ivory, wax and salt to the Swahili coast, and by 1825 Arab and Indian merchants had followed the trade routes inland to Unyamwezi.
zh:
尼亚姆韦齐语又称基尼亚姆韦齐语，是坦桑尼亚中西部的一门主要班图语，通行于乌尼亚姆韦齐高原的塔波拉和辛吉达一带。它与北方近邻苏库马语构成方言连续体。其名称来自斯瓦希里语，意为月亮之人或西方之人，涵盖五个亲缘族群。

按口述传统，尼亚姆韦齐人于17世纪来到这片高原，在众多小酋邦中务农、渔猎，进而从事长途商队贸易。到1800年，他们的商队已把加丹加铜、象牙、蜂蜡和盐运往斯瓦希里海岸；到1825年，阿拉伯和印度商人也沿商路深入乌尼亚姆韦齐。

en:
Nyasa is the name given to the group of Bantu languages spoken around Lake Nyasa and the lower Zambezi: its chief members are Chewa, also called Nyanja, Tumbuka, the Malawian Tonga and the Sena group. Their speakers trace their roots to the Bantu pottery of Katanga dated to the 400s, and Chewa clans began settling the lake shore in the 1200s.

From the early 1400s the Chewa built the Maravi Empire, whose kalonga kings ruled central and southern Malawi on tribute in ivory. In the 1600s, under Kalonga Muzura, it stretched from the Luangwa River to the Zambezi and traded cloth and iron to the Mozambique coast.

After succession disputes fragmented it in the 1700s, its languages kept spreading among farming villagers, and the name Chewa was first written down by the Portuguese officer António Gamitto in 1831.
zh:
尼亚萨语是对尼亚萨湖周边及赞比西河下游一组班图语的称呼，主要成员包括切瓦语（又称尼扬贾语）、通布卡语、马拉维通加语和塞纳语群。说这些语言的人可追溯到4世纪加丹加的班图陶器文化，切瓦诸氏族于13世纪开始在湖岸定居。

自15世纪初起，切瓦人建立马腊韦帝国，卡隆加国王们以象牙为贡赋，统治马拉维中南部。17世纪在卡隆加·穆祖拉治下，帝国疆域从卢安瓜河延伸至赞比西河，并向莫桑比克海岸输出布匹和铁器。

18世纪继承纠纷使帝国瓦解，但这些语言仍在农耕村民中扩散；1831年，葡萄牙军官安东尼奥·加米托首次记录下切瓦这一名称。

en:
Nyâlayu, or Yâlayu, is a Kanak language of the Extreme Northern New Caledonian group, spoken at the northern tip of Grande Terre and on the outlying Belep islands. It descends, with the other Kanak languages, from the Proto-Oceanic of Lapita seafarers who settled New Caledonia around 1000 BCE.

Nyâlayu has two dialects that are not mutually intelligible: Pooc, also called Haat, spoken on the Belep islands north of the main island, and Puma, or Paak, spoken on the northern coast around Poum in the west and Pouébo and Balade in the east.
zh:
涅拉尤语又称亚拉尤语，属新喀里多尼亚语群极北支，通行于格朗德特尔岛北端和外海的贝莱普群岛。它与其他卡纳克语言一样，源自约公元前1000年定居新喀里多尼亚的拉皮塔航海者的原始大洋洲语。

涅拉尤语有两种彼此不能互通的方言：普克语又称哈特语，通行于主岛以北的贝莱普群岛；普马语又称帕克语，通行于北海岸，西起普姆，东至普埃博和巴拉德。

en:
The Nyulnyulan languages are a small non-Pama Nyungan family of the Kimberley coast of northern Western Australia, centered on the Dampier Peninsula north of Broome and its neighboring islands and sounds. They divide into western and eastern branches; the members are so close that several were mutually intelligible.

Bardi, spoken by the sea-oriented Bardi people at the tip of the peninsula and on the offshore islands, is one of the western languages. When European ships first reached Australian waters, beginning with the Dutch landing of 1606, these tongues had no writing and were maintained entirely by oral tradition.
zh:
纽尔纽尔诸语言是西澳大利亚北部金伯利海岸的一个小型非帕马‑牛雅语系，中心在布鲁姆以北的丹皮尔半岛及附近岛屿与海湾。它分为东西两支，各语言关系极近，有几种还能互通。

西支的巴尔迪语由面向海洋的巴尔迪人使用，通行于半岛顶端和外海岛屿。1606年荷兰人首次在澳大利亚登陆，此后欧洲船只陆续到来，而这些语言始终没有文字，全靠口耳相传。

en:
Occitan, or lenga d'òc, is named for òc, its word for yes, which Dante used in De vulgari eloquentia to mark it off from the oïl languages of the north. Its dialects include Limousin, Auvergnat, Languedocien, Provençal and Gascon.

Rooted in the Latin of Gallia Narbonensis of 121 BC, it produced the Boecis poem of around 1000 to 1030, one of Europe's earliest Romance texts, and became the vehicle of the troubadours, whose love poetry made it the first prestigious vernacular literary language of medieval Europe. The Albigensian Crusade of 1209 to 1229 broke the power of the Counts of Toulouse.

From the 1300s Occitan lost status, and the Ordinance of Villers-Cotterêts of 1539 confined official business to French. It remained the everyday speech of the south, but with no place in administration, education or print and no single written standard.
zh:
奥克语（lenga d'òc）得名于表示“是”的òc，但丁在《论俗语》中正是以此把它同北方的奥依语诸语言区分开来。它的方言包括利穆赞方言、奥弗涅方言、朗格多克方言、普罗旺斯方言和加斯科涅方言。

奥克语植根于公元前121年设立的那尔波嫩西斯高卢的拉丁语，约1000—1030年的长诗《博埃提斯》是欧洲最早的罗曼语书面作品之一；它又成为游吟诗人的载体，他们的爱情诗使奥克语成为中世纪欧洲第一种享有盛誉的俗语文学语言。1209—1229年的阿尔比十字军摧毁了图卢兹伯爵的势力。

从14世纪起，奥克语的地位不断下降，1539年的《维莱科特雷法令》又把一切公务限定为法语。它仍是南方的日常语言，只是在行政、教育和印刷中毫无位置，也没有统一的书面标准。

official_raw.en: The Occitano-Romance group of languages originated in the south of France before becoming a common language of merchant ports in the western Mediterranean.
official_raw.zh: 起源于南法，后来成为西地中海商港通用语的奥克‑罗曼语支。

en:
The Oghuric or Bulgar languages are the earliest branch to split from the Turkic family, marked by r where the later Common Turkic languages have z. They were carried by the steppe confederations of the Onogurs, Bulgars and Khazars, and Oghuric served as the lingua franca of the Khazar state.

After Old Great Bulgaria broke up in the seventh century, Bulgars under Asparukh reached the Danube and eventually adopted a Slavic language, while the followers of Kotrag settled the Volga and Kama rivers, built Volga Bulgaria and adopted Islam in 922. The Mongol invasion of 1223 to 1236 destroyed that state and carried its Bulgar language into the Golden Horde.

Volga Bulgar speech lived on in Chuvash, while the extinct Bulgar and the poorly attested Khazar survive only in fragments and loanwords, including early Turkic borrowings in Hungarian.
zh:
乌古尔语又称保加尔语，是最早从突厥语族分离出来的分支，标志性特征是用r对应后世通用突厥语中的z。它曾随奥诺古尔人、保加尔人和可萨人等草原部落联盟传播，并作为可萨汗国的通用语。

7世纪旧大保加利亚解体后，阿斯帕鲁赫率领一支保加尔人远至多瑙河畔，最终改用斯拉夫语；科特拉克的部众则定居伏尔加河与卡马河流域，建立伏尔加保加利亚，并于922年皈依伊斯兰教。1223—1236年的蒙古入侵灭亡了这个国家，保加尔语随之被带入金帐汗国。

伏尔加保加尔语后来以楚瓦什语的形式延续，而已经消亡的保加尔语和记载稀少的可萨语只留下残篇与借词，匈牙利语中的早期突厥语借词即来自乌古尔语。

en:
ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, closest to the Marquesan and Tahitian tongues. Voyagers from the Marquesas settled the Hawaiian archipelago from roughly 300 CE, and later arrivals from the Society Islands and Samoa-Tonga shaped the language as it evolved in isolation. The language has five vowels and eight consonants and was carried in genealogical chants (mele), prayers and oral histories rather than in writing.

Captain James Cook's arrival in 1778 opened the European phase, and the Hawaiian youth ʻŌpūkahaʻia, who reached New England, inspired the American mission whose first company landed in 1820.

The Protestant missionaries devised a Latin-script orthography, adult literacy spread within a generation, and schools multiplied across the islands. The first Hawaiian-language newspapers appeared in 1834, a printed vocabulary followed in 1836 and Adelbert von Chamisso published a grammar of Hawaiian in 1837.
zh:
夏威夷语是南岛语系的波利尼西亚语言，与马克萨斯语和塔希提语最为接近。约从公元300年起，来自马克萨斯群岛的航海者定居夏威夷群岛，其后又有来自社会群岛和萨摩亚-汤加的移民，语言在隔绝中逐渐演变。它有五个元音和八个辅音，靠家谱吟唱（梅莱）、祈祷词和口述历史而非文字传承。

1778年库克船长到来，开启了欧洲接触的阶段；流落到新英格兰的夏威夷青年奥普卡哈伊阿促成了美国传教事业，第一批传教士于1820年登岛。

新教传教士设计了拉丁字母拼写法，成年人的读写能力在一代人之间普及，学校遍布各岛。1834年出现了第一批夏威夷语报纸，1836年印出词汇表，阿德尔贝特·冯·沙米索又于1837年出版了夏威夷语语法。

en:
The Omotic languages are a group of closely related languages spoken mainly in southwestern Ethiopia, around the Omo River, with a few reaching the Blue Nile highlands of southeastern Sudan. They fall into four branches: Damotic, or North Omotic, Dizoid, Mao and the southern Aroid group.

Most linguists treat Omotic as the most divergent branch of the Afroasiatic family, though its unity is disputed and some place Mao and Aroid outside Afroasiatic.

The languages are agglutinative, and many, such as Bench, have complex tonal systems. Some were written in the Ge'ez script, which gained its vocalized form around 330 in the kingdom of Aksum; early nineteenth-century European scholars first described the northern tongues under the name Gonga and classed them with Cushitic.
zh:
奥莫特语是一群亲属语言，主要通行于埃塞俄比亚西南部的奥莫河流域，少数延伸到苏丹东南部的青尼罗河高地。它分为四大分支：达莫特（即北奥莫特）、迪佐伊德、马奥，以及南方的阿罗伊德。

多数学者把奥莫特语视为亚非语系中分化最深的一支，但其内部统一性有争议，也有人把马奥和阿罗伊德排除在亚非语系之外。

这些语言属黏着语，本奇语等多种语言还有复杂的声调系统。其中一些语言用吉兹字母书写，该字母约于330年在阿克苏姆王国发展出元音化形式；19世纪初的欧洲学者最早以“贡加”之名记述北方诸语，并把它们归入库希特语。

en:
Opata, whose speakers called it Teguima, is a Uto-Aztecan language of the inland valleys of northeastern and central Sonora, closely related to Eudeve. From about 1350 to 1550 the Opata lived in independent irrigation statelets of multi-story adobe towns along the rivers.

They fought off Francisco de Ibarra's expedition of 1565, but epidemics broke up the statelets. Jesuits opened the first mission in 1628; the Opata supplied soldiers for Spanish campaigns against the Apache.

They joined the Indian rising of 1740 and rose again in 1820, when three hundred Opata warriors routed a thousand soldiers and destroyed a mining town near Tonichi before their leaders were captured and executed. By the early nineteenth century most Opata were bilingual and Spanish was displacing their tongue, known chiefly through missionary vocabularies and grammars.
zh:
奥帕塔语是犹他-阿兹特克语系的语言，使用者自称特吉马，通行于索诺拉东北部和中部的内陆河谷，与埃乌德韦语关系极近。约1350—1550年间，奥帕塔人沿河生活，以多层土坯城镇组成独立的灌溉小邦。

他们击退了1565年弗朗西斯科·德·伊瓦拉的远征，但瘟疫使各小邦瓦解。1628年耶稣会士建立第一个传教区；奥帕塔人出兵协助西班牙人对阿帕奇人的战事。

1740年他们参加印第安人大起义，1820年又举事，三百名奥帕塔战士击溃一千名士兵并摧毁托尼奇附近的矿业城镇，最终首领被俘处决。进入19世纪时，多数奥帕塔人已通用西班牙语，母语被不断排挤，后世主要靠传教士留下的词汇表和语法书了解这门语言。

en:
Oriomo, or Eastern Trans-Fly, is a small independent family of Papuan languages spoken on the Oriomo Plateau west of the Fly River, in the Western Province of Papua New Guinea. Its members include Meriam, better known as Meriam Mir, the tongue of the eastern Torres Strait islands of Murray, Darnley and Stephens and the only Papuan language spoken on Australian territory.

Mid-twentieth-century classifications placed the family in a Trans-Fly-Bulaka River branch of Trans-New Guinea, but later scholars such as Malcolm Ross and Timothy Usher treated it as an independent lineage.

The island homes of its Meriam speakers lie in the strait first crossed by the Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres in 1606 and sailed by James Cook's Endeavour in 1770, on the voyage that opened eastern Australia to Britain.
zh:
奥里莫语又称东外弗莱语，是一个小型的巴布亚语独立语族，通行于巴布亚新几内亚西部省弗莱河以西的奥里莫高原。其成员包括梅里亚姆语，通称梅里亚姆·米尔语，通行于托雷斯海峡东部的默里岛、达恩利岛和斯蒂芬斯岛，是澳大利亚领土上唯一的巴布亚语言。

20世纪中期的分类把它放在跨新几内亚语系的外弗莱－布拉卡河语支中，但后来的学者如马尔科姆·罗斯和蒂莫西·厄舍把它视为独立语系。

梅里亚姆语使用者居住的岛屿正处在托雷斯海峡上：1606年路易斯·巴埃斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙远征队首次穿过这条海峡，1770年詹姆斯·库克的“奋进号”再经此地，那次航行使英国打开了澳大利亚东部。

en:
Oriya, or Odia, is an Eastern Indo-Aryan language spoken on the Bay of Bengal coast in Odisha, descended from the Magadhi Prakrit through the Odra Prakrit.

Its earliest records are ninth-century inscriptions mixing Odra Prakrit with Sanskrit, and the first full Old Oriya inscription, the Urajam record of the Eastern Ganga kings, is dated 1051. Its curved Odia script developed for writing on palm leaves.

Old Oriya gave way to Middle Oriya from the fourteenth century, the age of the temple chronicles of Puri and of Sarala Das, who retold the Mahabharata in the vernacular; the five poets called the Panchasakha followed with devotional works such as the Odia Bhagabata. By the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries court poets had carried the literary language toward its modern form, while the related Halbi variety served traders farther inland.
zh:
奥里亚语是奥里萨地区、孟加拉湾沿岸的东印度—雅利安语言，由摩揭陀俗语经奥德罗俗语演变而来。

它最早的记录是9世纪混用奥德罗俗语与梵语的铭文，第一篇完整的古奥里亚语铭文是东恒伽诸王留下的乌拉贾姆碑，定于1051年。奥里亚文的字母多弧线，是为了适应在贝叶上书写。

14世纪起古奥里亚语让位于中古奥里亚语，那是普里神庙编年史和用方言重述《摩诃婆罗多》的诗人萨拉拉·达斯的时代；此后被称为“五圣”的五位诗人又写出《奥里亚薄伽梵歌》等虔信作品。到17、18世纪，宫廷诗人已把这种文学语言推向近代形态，而与它亲缘相近的哈拉比话则在更深的内陆充当商人的通用语。

en:
Oto-Pamean is the central Mexican branch of the Oto-Manguean family, a group of tonal languages divided into Otomian, Matlatzincan and Pamean. Its speakers are among the oldest settled peoples of the central plateau: Otomi voices were heard in Teotihuacan and Tula, and around 1100 the Otomi city-state of Xaltocan dominated its neighbors until Mexica expansion made Otomi lands tributary to the Triple Alliance and drove communities eastward.

During the conquest the Otomi of Tlaxcala joined Cortes against the Aztecs. They later led the colonial settling of Queretaro and the Bajio.

The nomadic Pame, who call themselves Xi'oi, and the Jonaz of the Sierra Gorda were swept into the Chichimeca War of 1550 to 1590. The last sierras were reduced by soldiers and Franciscans in 1742, with the missions secularized by 1770.
zh:
奥托帕梅语是欧托-曼格语系在墨西哥中部的语支，属声调语言，下分奥托米、马特拉尔辛卡和帕梅三组。使用者是中部高原最古老的定居民族之一：特奥蒂瓦坎和图拉都有奥托米人，约1100年奥托米城邦哈尔托坎一度称雄邻邦，后来墨西加扩张使奥托米土地向三方同盟纳贡，许多社群东迁。

征服时期，特拉斯卡拉的奥托米人加入科尔特斯一方攻打阿兹特克，后来又主导了克雷塔罗和巴希奥地区的殖民垦殖。

自称希奥伊的游牧帕梅人和戈尔达山的霍纳斯人被卷入1550—1590年的奇奇梅卡战争。最后的山区直到1742年才被军队和方济各会士平定，传教区则在1770年前世俗化。

en:
Pahari, meaning the speech of the mountains, is the Northern Indo-Aryan dialect continuum of the lower Himalayas, running from Nepal through Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh into Jammu.

Scholars divide it into eastern, central and western groups: the central group includes Garhwali and Kumaoni, while the western, often called Himachali, includes Kangri and Dogri. Mountain valleys kept communities apart, so each district developed its own variety, and some western tongues developed tonal contrasts.

These highlands were long ruled by small Rajput hill houses, among them the Katoch rajas of Kangra, whose fort above Nagarkot held out against every attacker until the Mughal army of Jahangir took it in 1622. Pahari languages are written in the Devanagari script and draw on the same Middle Indo-Aryan heritage as the plains languages below them.
zh:
帕哈里语意为“山里人的话”，是喜马拉雅低山区的北印度—雅利安方言连续体，东起尼泊尔，经北阿坎德和喜马偕尔，西至查谟。

学者把它分为东、中、西三组：中段包括加尔瓦利语和库毛尼语，西段又称喜马偕尔诸语，包括坎格拉语和多格拉语。山谷把各个社群彼此隔绝，每个地区都发展出自己的变体，一些西段语言甚至发展出声调对立。

这片高地长期由拉杰普特人的小邦统治，坎格拉的卡托奇王族便是其中之一，他们在纳加尔科特山上的堡垒屡攻不破，直到1622年才被贾汉吉尔的莫卧儿大军攻取。帕哈里诸语以天城文书写，与山脚下平原上的语言同承中期印度—雅利安语的遗产。

en: Pahoturi is a small independent Papuan language family spoken along the Pahoturi River south of the Fly River in Papua New Guinea's Western Province, just west of the Oriomo languages. Its eight varieties, among them Agob, Idi, Ende and Kawam, form a dialect chain, while the Idzuwe variety is no longer spoken.
zh: 帕霍图里语是一个小型的巴布亚语独立语族，通行于巴布亚新几内亚西部省弗莱河以南的帕霍图里河一带，就在奥里莫语分布区以西。它有八种变体，其中包括阿戈布语、伊迪语、恩德语和卡瓦姆语，彼此构成一条方言链，而伊祖韦语变体已经无人使用。

en:
Paicî is a Kanak language of the Austronesian family spoken across the centre of Grande Terre, the main island of New Caledonia. It belongs to the Central Northern group of the Northern New Caledonian languages. Paicî has relatively few consonants but a rich vowel system: ten oral vowels and seven nasal vowels, with distinctions of length and tone.

The language traces its roots to the Lapita voyagers who began raising coastal settlements on New Caledonia around 1100 BC, bringing an Austronesian tongue that diversified into the island's thirty Kanak languages.

James Cook sighted Grande Terre in 1774 and gave it the name New Caledonia, the Comte de Lapérouse surveyed its west coast in 1788, and English whalers charted the Loyalty Islands from 1793, but ships called only rarely for the next half century. Through these centuries Paicî stayed an unwritten language carried by oral custom.
zh:
派西语是新喀里多尼亚主岛格朗德特尔岛中部通行的卡纳克语言，属南岛语系。它属于新喀里多尼亚北部语言的中北语支。派西语的辅音数量较少，元音系统却很丰富：有十个口元音和七个鼻元音，并区分长短和声调。

派西语的源头可追溯到拉皮塔航海者：他们约从公元前1100年起在新喀里多尼亚沿海建立定居点，带来的南岛语后来分化为岛上的三十种卡纳克语言。

1774年詹姆斯·库克望见格朗德特尔岛，将它命名为新喀里多尼亚；1788年拉彼鲁兹伯爵测绘了西海岸；1793年起英国捕鲸人绘制了洛亚蒂群岛的海图，此后约半个世纪里只有很少的船只到访。在这些世纪里，派西语始终是没有文字、依靠口传习俗的语言。

en:
Numu-Monachi groups two closely related languages of the Western Numic branch of the Uto-Aztecan family: Northern Paiute, whose speakers call themselves Numu, and Mono, or Monachi. Northern Paiute bands lived across the arid Great Basin of western Nevada and adjoining regions, while Mono speakers occupied the Mono Basin, the Owens Valley and the southern Sierra Nevada.

Linguists believe Numic-speaking peoples spread outward from a homeland near the southwestern Great Basin during the centuries before European contact, replacing older languages of the basin.

Both tongues are adapted to a mobile desert way of life, with rich vocabularies for local plants, animals and water sources. Outside contacts remained sparse until British and American fur trappers such as Peter Skene Ogden and Jedediah Smith crossed their territories in the 1820s.
zh:
努穆‑莫纳奇语包含犹他‑阿兹特克语系西努米克语支下两种关系很近的语言：北派尤特语（使用者自称努穆）和莫诺语（莫纳奇语）。北派尤特各群体生活在内华达西部干旱的大盆地及邻近地区，莫诺语使用者则分布在莫诺盆地、欧文斯谷和内华达山脉南段。

语言学家认为，在欧洲人到来之前的几个世纪里，说努米克语的族群从大盆地西南的发源地向外扩散，取代了盆地里更早的语言。

这两种语言都适应流动的沙漠生活，拥有丰富的本地动植物和水源词汇。直到19世纪20年代，彼得·斯基恩·奥格登、杰迪代亚·史密斯等英美毛皮猎人进入其领地，外界与他们的接触仍然很少。

en:
Palaungic, or Palaung-Wa, is a group of nearly thirty Austroasiatic languages, among them Wa, Blang, Lawa and Palaung, also called De'ang. They are spoken in scattered mountain pockets across the borderlands of Myanmar, Yunnan, Laos and Thailand, centred on the hills between the Salween and the Mekong known as the Wa corridor.

Their speakers are swidden-farming highlanders; around 1229 the Wa were driven out of Kengtung and were later defeated by King Mangrai of Lan Na as Tai-speaking principalities expanded.

None of these languages had a script of its own, and literate speakers wrote in Chinese characters or in Shan with the Shan script. In the early nineteenth century Palaungic speech survived chiefly in remote highland valleys ringed by Tai and Burmese states.
zh:
佤德昂语又称佤—德昂语，是南亚语系下近三十种语言的统称，包括佤语、布朗语、拉瓦语和德昂语，零散分布在缅甸、云南、老挝与泰国交界的山区，核心是萨尔温江与湄公河之间的“佤走廊”。

说这些语言的是从事轮垦农业的山民；1229年前后，佤人被逐出景栋，其后又在傣语政权扩张中被兰纳国王孟莱击败。

这些语言都没有本族文字，识字者或用汉字，或使用掸语和掸文。到19世纪初，佤德昂语主要存续于偏远的高山谷地，四周环绕着傣族和缅人政权。

en:
Pali is a Middle Indo-Aryan Prakrit, preserved as the sacred language of Theravada Buddhism and the tongue of the Tipitaka canon. It descends from a hybrid of regional Prakrits from around the 200s BCE. Long carried orally, the canon was first committed to writing in Sri Lanka in the first century BCE.

After centuries of decline on the island, the scholar Buddhaghosa revived Pali learning in the 400s with the Visuddhimagga and his commentaries. Pali inscriptions in mainland Southeast Asia may begin as early as the 300s. A renaissance around the Pagan kingdom in the 1000s carried the language through mainland Southeast Asia as dynasties sponsored Theravada monasteries.

Never a vernacular in this period, Pali served as the scholarly and liturgical lingua franca of Theravada lands, written in local scripts such as Burmese, Khmer and Sinhala, and contributed religious and learned loanwords to those languages.
zh:
巴利语是中古印度—雅利安语的一种俗语，作为上座部佛教的圣语和《三藏》经典的语言保存下来。它是约公元前3世纪（前200年前后）几种地方俗语的混合体。经典长期口传，至公元前1世纪才在斯里兰卡首次写成文字。

在岛上经历数百年衰落后，5世纪（400年代）的学者觉音以《清净道论》和他的注疏复兴了巴利语学术。中南半岛的巴利语铭文最早或可上溯至4世纪（300年代）。11世纪（1000年代）起于蒲甘王国一带的巴利语复兴，把这门语言带到整个中南半岛，诸王朝纷纷扶持上座部寺院。

在这一时期，巴利语并不是任何地方的口语，而是上座部佛教地区的学术和宗教礼仪通用语，用缅文、高棉文、僧伽罗文等各地字母书写，并向这些语言注入了宗教和学术借词。

en:
The Pama Nyungan languages form the greatest family of Aboriginal Australia, covering almost the whole continent save pockets of the northern coast. At European arrival about three hundred such languages stretched from Cape York in the northeast to the southwest corner; the family name joins these two extremes, pama being the northeastern word for man and nyunga the southwestern one.

The ancestral tongue, Proto-Pama Nyungan, may have been spoken only about five thousand years ago in the Gulf Plains of northeastern Australia, from where it spread across the continent, replacing or absorbing older languages. All were oral languages, and the first missionary grammars were written down only in the early 1800s.
zh:
帕马‑牛雅诸语言是澳大利亚原住民最大的语系，几乎覆盖整块大陆，只有北部沿海还散布着若干其他语系。欧洲人初到时，约有三百种帕马‑牛雅语言，从东北的约克角一直延伸到大陆西南角；语系名称正是两端的合称：东北话里称人为帕马，西南话里称人为牛雅。

原始帕马‑牛雅语可能迟至约五千年前才在澳大利亚东北部的海湾平原一带使用，随后向外扩散，取代或融合了更古老的语言。这些语言都没有文字，最早的传教士语法书出现于19世纪初。

en:
Panche was the language of the Panche, a warrior people who held the lower slopes of the eastern Magdalena valley in Colombia. They lived in a loose confederation and often fought the highland Muisca to their east; their culture can be traced in the region from about 300, with migrations from the Caribbean coast around 1000.

Their language is almost unattested and remains unclassified, though some propose a Cariban connection. The seventeenth-century friar Pedro Simón recorded that panche meant cruel or murderer in their speech. Spanish forces overran the territory after the founding of the New Kingdom of Granada, and the Panche population collapsed under conquest and disease, taking its language with it.
zh:
潘切语是潘切人的语言。这个善战的族群占据哥伦比亚马格达莱纳河谷东侧的低山坡地，以松散的部落联盟形式生活，常与东面高原上的穆伊斯卡人交战；其文化在当地约可追溯至300年，1000年前后又有来自加勒比海岸的移民迁入。

潘切语几乎没有留下记录，至今未被分类，也有人推测它属于加勒比语系。17世纪的修士佩德罗·西蒙记载，panche在他们的语言中意为“残忍者”或“杀人者”。新格拉纳达王国建立后，西班牙军队征服了这片土地，潘切人口在征服与疫病中急剧减少，语言也随之消亡。

en: Pano denotes the Panoan family, a branch of the Pano–Tacanan stock spoken by indigenous peoples across western Brazil, eastern Peru and northern Bolivia. Its roughly three dozen languages, among them Shipibo-Konibo, Kaxinawá, Yaminawa and Matsés, form a network of closely related dialects and remained unwritten oral languages through the colonial era.
zh: 帕诺语即帕诺语系，是帕诺—塔卡南语系的一支，由巴西西部、秘鲁东部和玻利维亚北部的原住民使用。该语系约有三十余种语言，包括希皮博—科尼博语、卡希纳瓦语、亚米纳瓦语和马塞斯语，彼此方言相近，在殖民时代始终是没有文字的口头语言。

en:
Panzaleo, also called Shillipanu, was a pre-Inca language spoken around Quito and Latacunga in the Ecuadorian highlands by the Quitu people and neighbouring groups before the Spanish conquest. The chronicler Pedro Cieza de León mentioned it in 1553, and words and endings were recorded in the Relaciones geográficas de Indias.

It was poorly documented and died out in the seventeenth century, leaving its classification uncertain. A proposed link to Páez rests on weak evidence and may reflect contact rather than common origin.
zh:
潘萨莱奥语又名希利帕努语，是西班牙征服之前厄瓜多尔高地基多和拉塔昆加一带的前印加语言，由基图人及邻近族群使用。编年史家佩德罗·谢萨·德·莱昂在1553年提到过它，《西印度地理志》记录了其中的一些词汇和词尾。

该语言留存的材料很少，于17世纪消亡，谱系归属没有定论。有人提出它与帕埃斯语有亲缘关系，但证据薄弱，相似之处可能来自语言接触而非共同起源。

en:
Paumotu, called Reo Pa'umotu by its speakers, is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken across the Tuamotu atolls east of Tahiti. The islands were settled from about 1150 by voyagers from the Society Islands, and movement between reefs gave the language seven dialect areas while keeping it close to Tahitian.

Ferdinand Magellan's Pacific crossing in 1521 made the Tuamotus the first Polynesian islands seen by Europeans, but early contacts were fleeting and changed local life little. In pre-Christian tradition the Pa'umotu chanted hymns to Kiho-Tumu, the supreme creator. In the early nineteenth century missionaries based in Tahiti brought the Latin alphabet and Christian loanwords and began translating scripture into Pa'umotu.
zh:
保莫图语的使用者称之为Reo Pa'umotu，是南岛语系的波利尼西亚语言，通行于塔希提以东的土阿莫土环礁。约1150年，来自社会群岛的航海者在岛上定居；岛民往来于各环礁之间，使保莫图语形成七个方言区，同时又与塔希提语十分接近。

1521年麦哲伦横渡太平洋，使土阿莫土成为欧洲人最早见到的波利尼西亚群岛，但早期接触很短暂，对当地生活影响甚微。在皈依基督教之前，保莫图人吟唱赞颂至高创世神基霍-图穆的圣歌。19世纪初，以塔希提为基地的传教士带来了拉丁字母和基督教借词，并着手把圣经译成保莫图语。

en: Pemon is a Cariban language of the Gran Sabana, the open upland of Bolívar State in south-eastern Venezuela, and of the adjoining borderlands of Guyana and the Brazilian state of Roraima. It falls into three main dialects, Arekuna, Kamarakoto and Taurepang, and belongs with Macushi to the Pemongan group of Cariban tongues.
zh: 佩蒙语是加勒比语族语言，通行于委内瑞拉东南部玻利瓦尔州的格兰萨瓦纳草原高地，以及圭亚那和巴西罗赖马州接壤的边境地带。它分为阿雷库纳、卡马拉科托和陶雷潘三大方言，与马库希语同属加勒比语族的佩蒙语支。

en:
Penutian is a long-debated language phylum proposed for Native languages of western North America, from California to British Columbia. The name comes from words for two, pen in the Wintuan, Maiduan and Yokuts languages and uti in Miwok and Costanoan.

In the early twentieth century Roland Dixon and Alfred Kroeber proposed the hypothesis around five California families, and Edward Sapir later expanded it to Oregon and Plateau peoples. The broader unity remains unproven and may partly reflect borrowing between neighbours, though smaller groupings such as Utian and Plateau Penutian rest on firmer evidence.

From the 1770s Spanish missions uprooted the California Penutian peoples and their languages, while Chinookan villages on the lower Columbia became fur-trade hubs where the trade language Chinook Jargon took shape.
zh:
佩努蒂语是一个长期存在争议的语系假说，试图统合北美西部从加利福尼亚到不列颠哥伦比亚的原住民语言。其名称取自“二”的说法：温顿语、迈杜语和约库茨语中的pen，以及米沃克语和科斯塔诺语中的uti。

20世纪初，罗兰·迪克森与阿尔弗雷德·克罗伯以五个加州语系为核心提出假说，爱德华·萨丕尔后来又把它扩展到俄勒冈和高原族群。更广义的亲缘关系未能证实，部分相似处可能只是邻族间的借用，不过乌蒂语支、高原佩努蒂语支等较小分组已有较扎实的证据。

18世纪70年代起，西班牙传教站瓦解了加州佩努蒂各族及其语言；哥伦比亚河下游的奇努克村落则成为毛皮贸易中心，贸易通用语奇努克混合语便在那里形成。

en:
Permic is the Uralic branch spoken west of the Ural Mountains, including Komi and Komi-Permyak in the Vychegda and upper Kama basins and Udmurt on the lower Kama and Vyatka. Like other Uralic tongues they are agglutinative with rich case systems, though they lack vowel harmony.

The name Perm comes from Perem in medieval Russian chronicles, first denoting the forest country and later its non-Russian inhabitants; the region was incorporated into the Russian state in the late fifteenth century.

In 1372 the missionary Stephen of Perm created the Old Permic alphabet, called Abur after its first two letters, blending Cyrillic and Greek forms with native Komi tamga marks. It wrote medieval Komi for the Permian church until the seventeenth century, when Cyrillic displaced it.
zh:
彼尔姆语是乌拉尔语系的一支，通行于乌拉尔山脉以西，包括维切格达河与卡马河上游的科米语、彼尔姆科米语，以及卡马河下游和维亚特卡河流域的乌德穆尔特语。和其他乌拉尔语言一样，它们是黏着语，格的体系繁复，但没有元音和谐。

彼尔姆一名源自俄罗斯中世纪编年史中的佩列姆，最初指森林地带，后来称呼当地的非俄罗斯居民；该地区于15世纪末并入俄罗斯国家。

1372年，传教士彼尔姆的斯蒂芬以西里尔字母、希腊字母和科米本土的塔姆加符号为基础，创制古彼尔姆字母，并按头两个字母称之为阿布尔。它用来为彼尔姆教会书写中世纪科米语，直到17世纪被西里尔字母取代。

en:
Persian, known to its speakers as Farsi, is a Southwestern Iranian language native to Fars in southwestern Iran. Its history has three stages: Old Persian, written in cuneiform under the Achaemenid kings and attested in the Behistun Inscription of 522 BC; Middle Persian of the Sasanian Empire; and New Persian, which arose after the Arab conquest and was written from the ninth century in a Perso-Arabic script.

The Persian revival and Seljuk conquests spread New Persian from Khorasan as a language of administration and letters. Ferdowsi's Shahnameh and the poetry of Rumi, Saadi and Hafez were read from Anatolia to India. Persian became the official language of northern India under the Mughals.

In 1337 it was the lingua franca of the Persianate world. Under the nineteenth-century Qajars the dialect of Tehran became the basis of the standard language.
zh:
波斯语在母语者口中称法尔西语，是伊朗西南部法尔斯地区的西南伊朗语支语言。其历史分为三个阶段：阿契美尼德诸王用楔形文字书写的古波斯语，见于公元前522年的贝希斯敦铭文；萨珊王朝的中古波斯语；以及阿拉伯征服后兴起、9世纪起用波斯—阿拉伯字母书写的新波斯语。

波斯复兴和塞尔柱征服把新波斯语从呼罗珊传播出去，成为行政与文学语言。菲尔多西的《列王纪》和鲁米、萨迪、哈菲兹的诗作，读者遍及安纳托利亚到印度。波斯语在莫卧儿治下成为北印度的官方语言。

1337年时，它已是波斯文化圈的通用语。19世纪恺加王朝时期，德黑兰方言成为标准语的基础。

en:
Pijao was the language of federated chiefdoms in the Colombian Andes, spread across the Central Cordillera and the upper valleys of the Magdalena and Cauca rivers. At the Spanish entrada of the 1530s they were organized in two leagues, one on the upper Magdalena plains and one in the mountain forests.

Their priests, called mohanes, led animist rites centred on rivers and mountain spirits, with idols of gold and wood. The conquistadors met fierce resistance, and the Pijao wars over control of waterways lasted some eighty years into the early seventeenth century, ending in defeat, conversion to Catholicism and mixing with Spanish settlers.

Pijao was only fragmentarily recorded and has never been convincingly assigned to a language family; it died out as surviving communities adopted Spanish.
zh:
皮豪语是皮豪人的语言。皮豪人是哥伦比亚安第斯山区结成联盟的酋邦，分布在中科迪勒拉山脉以及马格达莱纳河与考卡河上游谷地。16世纪30年代西班牙人入侵时，他们分为两个联盟，一个在上马格达莱纳平原，另一个在山林中。

祭司称“莫安”，主持以河流与山神为中心的万物有灵仪式，供奉金质和木质偶像。征服者遭到顽强抵抗，争夺水道的皮豪战争打了约八十年，延续到17世纪初，最终以皮豪人战败、皈依天主教并与西班牙移民融合告终。

皮豪语只留下零星记录，始终无法可靠地归入任何语系；随着幸存社群改用西班牙语，它最终消亡。

en:
Ping, or Pinghua, is the Sinitic speech carried by the earliest Han settlers of Guangxi, along the old route from Hunan, with related varieties in southern Hunan and northern Guangdong. Han migrants entered the region in the first millennium.

The name is traditionally traced to the Pingnan Army that the Northern Song general Di Qing led into Guangxi in the 1050s to crush Nong Zhigao's rebellion; its soldiers settled on the land and their speech became later Pinghua. Long contact with the Zhuang peoples made it a regional lingua franca and brought Zhuang loanwords, including a final particle used in commands.

It has two largely unintelligible branches, Northern Pinghua around Guilin and Southern Pinghua around Nanning. Pinghua is written in Chinese characters.
zh:
平话是广西最早一批汉族定居者带来的汉语，沿自湖南入桂的古道分布，在湘南、粤北也有相近的支系。汉人在第一个千年里陆续迁入这一地区。

平话之名相传来自北宋将领狄青在11世纪50年代南下平定侬智高之叛的平南军，士兵留驻屯垦，他们的话便成为后世的平话。由于长期与壮族相处，平话在部分地区充当通用语，并吸收了壮语借词，包括祈使句的句末语气词。

它分为大致互不相通的两支：桂林一带的桂北平话和南宁一带的桂南平话。平话使用汉字书写。

en:
Pohnpeian is a Micronesian language of the Austronesian family, indigenous to Pohnpei in the Caroline Islands. Its speakers descend from Lapita voyagers who settled the island long before the rise of Nan Madol, the artificial-islet ceremonial town built off Pohnpei's eastern shore from the eighth or ninth century.

Under the Saudeleur rulers, who held power from about 1100 to about 1628, and the decentralized nahnmwarki chiefships that replaced them after Isokelekel's invasion, society was strictly ranked. Pohnpeian preserves this in a high register called Meing, with special vocabulary for people of high rank. Spanish navigators reached the island in 1529 and 1595, but Pohnpeian remained unwritten until Fyodor Litke's Russian expedition recorded a short vocabulary in 1828.
zh:
波纳佩语是南岛语系密克罗尼西亚语族的语言，为加罗林群岛波纳佩岛的本土语言。波纳佩人的先民是拉皮塔航海者，他们早在南马都尔兴起之前就定居此岛；南马都尔是8或9世纪起在波纳佩东岸外修建的人工岛礼仪之城。

约1100年至约1628年绍德雷尔王朝统治此地，伊索克勒克入侵后取而代之的是分权的南姆瓦尔基酋长制，社会等级森严。波纳佩语有一种称为“梅因”的敬语层次，对地位高的人说话要使用专门词汇。西班牙航海家于1529年和1595年到过此岛，但波纳佩语长期没有文字，直到1828年费奥多尔·利特克的俄国考察队才记录下一份简短词汇表。

en:
Pondo is another name for Angoram, called Kanda by its speakers, a Papuan language of the lower Sepik River in northern Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the small Lower Sepik family, once known as Nor–Pondo, whose other branches include Murik and Kopar at the river mouth and the inland Chambri and Karawari–Yimas tongues.

The Pondo languages and Kopar share distinctive first- and second-person pronouns built around the sound p, which set them apart from Murik; some classifiers place the family with the Ramu languages, though this remains disputed.

Pondo villagers live in the Sepik's vast swamp basin, where the river runs straight into the Bismarck Sea without a delta. The Spaniard Yñigo Ortiz de Retez sailed the northern coast and in 1545 named the island New Guinea, though the Sepik waterways stayed hidden from outsiders for centuries afterward.
zh:
庞多语是安戈拉姆语的别称，说这种语言的人自称坎达；它是巴布亚新几内亚北部塞皮克河下游的一种巴布亚语言。它属于规模不大的下塞皮克语族，旧称诺尔—庞多语族；其他分支包括河口的穆里克语和科帕尔语，以及内陆的昌布里语和卡拉瓦里—伊马斯语。

庞多诸语与科帕尔语在第一、第二人称代词中都带有标志性的p音，与穆里克语不同；部分学者把整个语族与拉穆诸语归在一起，但仍有争议。

庞多村落位于塞皮克河广阔的沼泽盆地中，这条河没有三角洲，直接注入俾斯麦海。西班牙人伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯航行于北海岸，于1545年将岛屿命名为新几内亚，而塞皮克河水道在此后数百年间仍不为外界所知。

en:
Portuguese grew out of the Vulgar Latin of Roman settlers who reached western Iberia in the third century BC. After the Germanic invasions of the fifth century the speech of the northwest developed into Galician-Portuguese, famed for lyric songs such as the Cantigas de Santa Maria. Muslim rule from 711 left Arabic words in its vocabulary.

Portugal's kingdom was recognized in 1143, and the common language began to divide into Portuguese and Galician. King Diniz decreed in 1290 that Portuguese should be used in official writing, and the royal chancellery adopted it six years later.

The Cancioneiro Geral of 1516 closed the Old Portuguese period, and Fernão de Oliveira printed the first grammar in 1536. Carried abroad by the age of discovery, Portuguese became a lingua franca of trade and missionary work in Africa, Asia and Brazil.
zh:
葡萄牙语由公元前3世纪进入伊比利亚西部的罗马移民所说的通俗拉丁语发展而来。5世纪日耳曼诸族入侵后，西北部的口语演变为加利西亚—葡萄牙语，以《圣玛利亚之歌》等抒情诗歌闻名。711年开始的穆斯林统治留下了阿拉伯语借词。

葡萄牙王国地位于1143年获得承认后，这门共同语言开始分化为葡萄牙语和加利西亚语。1290年，迪尼什国王下令官方文书使用葡萄牙语，六年后王室文书署正式采用。

1516年的《诗歌总集》标志着古葡萄牙语时期结束，1536年费尔南·德·奥利维拉印行了第一部语法书。随着地理大发现，葡萄牙语传到海外，成为非洲、亚洲和巴西贸易与传教活动的通用语。

en:
Powhatan, also called Virginia Algonquian, is an Eastern Algonquian language of the Algic family, formerly spoken by the Powhatan people of the Virginia tidewater around Chesapeake Bay. It had no writing system and is known almost entirely from two wordlists: John Smith recorded about fifty words between 1607 and 1609, and William Strachey about five hundred in 1610 and 1611.

English settlers who founded Jamestown in 1607 depended on the Powhatan for food and had to learn their language. English borrowed many words from Powhatan, including moccasin, tomahawk, raccoon and persimmon. After the uprising of 1622 and the colonial wars that followed, the Powhatan communities were dispersed, and their language gradually fell out of daily use.
zh:
波瓦坦语又称弗吉尼亚阿尔冈昆语，属阿尔吉克语系的东阿尔冈昆语族，曾是切萨皮克湾畔弗吉尼亚潮汐地带波瓦坦人的语言。波瓦坦语本无文字，后世对它的了解几乎全靠两份词汇表：1607—1609年约翰·史密斯记下约50个词，1610—1611年威廉·斯特雷奇又记下约500个词。

1607年建立詹姆斯敦的英国移民在粮食上依赖波瓦坦人，不得不学习他们的语言。英语从波瓦坦语借入许多词，包括莫卡辛鞋、战斧、浣熊和柿子。1622年波瓦坦人起事及其后的殖民战争驱散了波瓦坦各部，波瓦坦语也逐渐退出日常生活。

en:
Puquina, also spelled Pukina, is an extinct language once spoken around Lake Titicaca in Peru and Bolivia, reaching into northern Chile. It is often linked to the people who built Tiwanaku, and at the Spanish conquest several highland groups, including the Chiribaya, still spoke it.

Its classification remains uncertain; a distant relationship with the Arawakan languages has been suggested but never proven. What is known of the language rests mainly on the Rituale seu Manuale Peruanum, printed in 1607 by the Franciscan Luis Jeronimo de Ore, and scattered glosses.

As Quechua and Spanish spread through the southern Andes, Puquina ceased to be an everyday language in the centuries after the conquest. Much of its vocabulary survives in Kallawaya, the secret mixed language of Bolivian travelling herbalists, which pairs Puquina words with Quechua grammar.
zh:
普基纳语是一种已消亡的语言，曾通行于秘鲁与玻利维亚交界处的的的喀喀湖周边，范围延伸到智利北部。它常被认为与修建蒂亚瓦纳科城的人群有关；西班牙征服时期，包括奇里瓦亚人在内的若干高原族群仍在使用它。

其系属没有定论，有学者推测它与阿拉瓦克语族有远亲关系，但始终缺乏确证。对普基纳语的了解主要依赖方济各会修士奥雷于1607年印行的《秘鲁礼仪手册》和零星词汇注释。

随着克丘亚语和西班牙语在安第斯南部扩散，普基纳语在征服后的几个世纪里不再作为日常语言使用。它的大量词汇保存在卡拉瓦亚语中：这种由玻利维亚游方草药郎中使用的秘密混合语言，以普基纳语词汇配上克丘亚语语法。

en:
Pumé, long known to outsiders as Yaruro, is a language isolate of the Llanos grasslands west of the Orinoco in Venezuela, spoken along the Meta, Apure, Cinaruco and Arauca rivers. The people call themselves Pumé, meaning real human; Yaruro was the name used by neighbours and adopted by Spanish explorers in the sixteenth century, and carries a mocking undertone.

Pumé society splits between river villagers who garden, fish and hunt, and the nomadic Savanna Pumé, who move with the seasons and live by hunting and gathering wild tubers. Missions and ranch settlements remained thin on the floodplains, so most Pumé bands kept their language and mobile way of life throughout the colonial period.

Filippo Salvatore Gilii treated the language as an isolate in 1782, and later linguists have only tentatively suggested distant links to Esmeraldeño or Chocoan.
zh:
普梅语在外界长期被称为雅鲁罗语，是委内瑞拉奥里诺科河以西亚诺斯草原上的孤立语言，通行于梅塔河、阿普雷河、锡纳鲁科河和阿劳卡河沿岸。普梅人自称Pumé，意为“真正的人”；“雅鲁罗”本是邻族对他们的称呼，16世纪的西班牙探险者沿用了这个名字，它带有嘲弄意味。

普梅社会分为沿河而居、务农捕鱼兼狩猎的河居普梅人，以及随季节迁徙、靠狩猎和采集野块茎为生的游牧草原普梅人。传教站和牧场在泛滥平原上长期稀少，因此整个殖民时期大多数普梅人都保住了语言和游居生活方式。

菲利波·萨尔瓦托雷·吉利在1782年已把普梅语视为孤立语言，后来的语言学家也只是谨慎地推测它与埃斯梅拉尔达语或乔科语系有远亲关系。

en:
Punjabi is an Indo-Aryan language of the Punjab, the land of the five eastern tributaries of the Indus, whose name comes from the Persian Panj-ab, or five waters. It grew out of the Prakrits and their Apabhramsha descendants, emerging around the 7th century and stabilizing by the 10th; its earliest surviving writings are compositions of Nath yogis from the 9th century onward.

Muslim rule brought Persian and Arabic vocabulary, and medieval written Punjabi was carried by Sufi poets such as Baba Farid and Bulleh Shah, while Sikh gurus used the related Sant Bhasha in the Guru Granth Sahib; Waris Shah continued the vernacular tradition in the 18th century.

Punjabi was written chiefly in Shahmukhi and Gurmukhi, though Persian remained the language of administration under the Mughals and the Sikh Empire until the East India Company dropped it in 1837.
zh:
旁遮普语是印度—雅利安语支的语言，通行于印度河东部五条支流流经的旁遮普地区，其名来自波斯语，意为五河之地。它由普拉克里特俗语及其后继的阿帕布拉姆沙变体演变而来，约7世纪成形、10世纪定型；现存最早的文字是9世纪以后纳特瑜伽修士的方言诗作。

穆斯林统治带来波斯语和阿拉伯语词汇，中世纪的书面旁遮普语靠巴巴·法里德、布勒·沙阿等苏菲诗人传承，锡克教祖师在《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》中使用相近的圣徒语，18世纪瓦里斯·沙阿延续了方言文学传统。

旁遮普语主要用沙木基字母和古木基文书写，但在莫卧儿帝国和锡克帝国治下，行政语言一直是波斯语，直到1837年英国东印度公司停止以波斯语理政。

en:
Purepecha, called Tarascan in older Spanish sources, is a language isolate spoken in the highlands of Michoacan around Lake Patzcuaro. It was the tongue of the Purepecha Empire, which according to the Relacion de Michoacan took shape around 1300, when the Uacusecha leader Tariacuri united the lakeside communities. His successors expanded the state and fought wars with the Aztec Empire in the fifteenth century.

At the Spanish conquest the ruler Tangaxuan II submitted, but Nuno de Guzman had him executed; bishop Vasco de Quiroga then founded hospital towns such as Santa Fe de la Laguna where Purepecha speakers kept a degree of protection.

Franciscan friars gave the language a Latin alphabet, and Maturino Gilberti printed a grammar in 1558 and a dictionary in 1559, followed by the grammar and dictionary of Juan Bautista de Lagunas in 1574. Colonial records include confessionaries, land titles and chronicles.
zh:
普雷佩查语在较早的西班牙文献中常称塔拉斯科语，是一门孤立语，通行于米却肯州帕茨夸罗湖一带的高地。它是普雷佩查帝国的语言：据《米却肯记述》记载，约1300年，瓦库塞查人的首领塔里亚库里统一了湖畔诸社群。其后继者扩张国家，15世纪与阿兹特克帝国战争不断。

西班牙征服时，统治者坦加胡安二世归顺，但被努尼奥·德·古斯曼处死；主教巴斯科·德基罗加随后建立拉古纳圣菲等医院镇，使说普雷佩查语的居民得到一定庇护。

方济各会修士为它引入拉丁字母，马图里诺·吉尔贝蒂于1558年出版语法、1559年出版词典，胡安·包蒂斯塔·德·拉古纳斯又在1574年推出语法和词典。殖民时期的文献还包括告解手册、地契和编年史。

en: Pyemmairrener, or Northeastern Tasmanian, was an Aboriginal language of northeastern Tasmania, spoken around Cape Portland and Ben Lomond. It is attested only in word lists recorded in the 1830s by George Augustus Robinson and his son Charles, from which later scholars reconstructed the language and its name.
zh: 皮艾梅伦纳语又称东北塔斯马尼亚语，是塔斯马尼亚岛东北角波特兰角和本洛蒙德一带原住民的语言。它仅见于19世纪30年代乔治·奥古斯都·鲁宾逊父子记录的词表，后世学者据此构拟出这种语言及其名称。

en:
Qiangic is a cluster of Sino-Tibetan languages spoken in the mountains of western Sichuan and northern Yunnan, along the eastern edge of the Tibetan plateau. Its members include Qiang, whose speakers call themselves Rma, Gyalrong, Muya, Pumi and, in some classifications, Baima; many linguists also place the extinct Tangut language of Western Xia, 1038 to 1227, here.

Peoples labelled Qiang appear in Shang oracle bones of the second millennium BCE as pastoral tribes on the western frontier, who drifted south-west as Han power expanded. By the Ming dynasty the name belonged to the highland communities of the upper Min River. Qiangic languages have elaborate verb morphology and pronominal systems, and most lack an established written tradition.
zh:
羌语支是汉藏语系的一组语言，通行于青藏高原东缘的四川西部和云南北部山区，成员包括使用者自称尔玛的羌语、嘉绒语、木雅语、普米语，以及在部分分类中归入该支的白马语；许多语言学家还把1038—1227年西夏国已消亡的西夏语列入其中。

被统称为“羌”的人群在公元前两千纪的商代甲骨文中已有记载，他们原是西部边境的游牧部落，随着中原王朝向西扩张而逐渐向西南迁徙。到明代时，“羌”已指岷江上游的高地族群。羌语支语言有复杂的动词形态和代词体系，其中大多数没有成熟的书面传统。

en:
Quechuan, called runa simi or people's language, is a family from central Peru which spread across much of the central Andes long before the Incas, possibly through the expansion of Wari. In 1337 regional varieties were spoken by peoples such as the Wanka and Chanka, while the Incas of Cuzco were still a small chiefdom.

From the 1430s the conquests of Pachacuti and his successors made Quechua the official lingua franca of an empire from Ecuador to central Chile. After the Spanish invasion of the 1530s it remained the common tongue of the Andes: friars used it for evangelization, and Domingo de Santo Tomás printed the first Quechua grammar in 1560.

After the Túpac Amaru II rebellion of 1780, the colonial government banned public use of the language and proscribed Quechua books, and its standing collapsed; the independence era of the early nineteenth century brought a short-lived revival.
zh:
克丘亚语被称为“鲁纳西米”，意为“人的语言”，是一族发源于秘鲁中部的语言，早在印加人崛起之前很久就已扩散到安第斯山脉中部的广大地区，其传播可能与瓦里帝国的扩张有关。1337年时，万卡人、昌卡人等使用不同的地区方言，而库斯科的印加人还只是一个小酋邦。

15世纪30年代起，帕查库特克及其继承者的征服使克丘亚语成为帝国的官方通用语，帝国疆域从厄瓜多尔延伸到智利中部。16世纪30年代西班牙入侵后，克丘亚语仍是安第斯通用语：修道士用它传教，多明戈·德·圣托马斯于1560年出版了第一部克丘亚语语法书。

1780年图帕克·阿马鲁二世起义后，殖民当局禁止公开使用这种语言并查禁克丘亚语书籍，其地位一落千丈；19世纪初的独立时期曾带来短暂的复兴。

en:
Quingnam, also called Chimú or the fisherman's language, was the language of Chimor, a kingdom that arose on the coast of northern Peru around 900 with its adobe capital at Chan Chan. Chimú conquests made Quingnam the official tongue along the coastal valleys, used alongside Mochica in the north and coastal Quechua in the south; reduplicating place names mark the region.

The Incas under Topa Inca Yupanqui absorbed Chimor around 1470, but the language survived into Spanish times. Friars wrote grammars that were lost, leaving little beyond a numeral list, proper names and scattered words; chroniclers complained of Quingnam's obscure, slippery pronunciation.

Epidemics, forced labour and the pull of the Spanish city of Trujillo beside Chan Chan broke the language's transmission, and Quingnam was extinct by 1763. Some scholars group it with Mochica and other tongues in a wider Chimuan family.
zh:
金南语又称奇穆语或“渔人语”，是奇莫尔王国的语言。该王国约于900年在秘鲁北部海岸兴起，以土坯大城昌昌为都。随着奇穆人的征服，金南语成为沿海谷地的官方语言，在北方与莫奇卡语、在南方与沿海克丘亚方言并行使用，当地留有叠词构成的地名。

1470年前后，图帕克·印卡·尤潘基治下的印加人吞并奇莫尔，但金南语存续到西班牙殖民时代。修士们曾写过语法书，却已散佚，除一份数词表、人名地名和零星词汇外所剩无几；编年史家还抱怨金南语发音含混拗口。

疫病、苦役和昌昌旁边西班牙城市特鲁希略的吸引力打断了传承，到1763年金南语已消亡。有些学者把它与莫奇卡语等归入更大的奇穆语族。

en:
Rajasthani is the Western Indo-Aryan language group of Rajasthan and neighboring Malwa, Gujarat and Sindh, embracing Marwari and several other varieties, with a literary standard built chiefly on Marwari. Its roots lie in the Gurjar Apabhramsha, whose grammar was described by the Jain scholar Hemachandra.

A distinct Rajasthani speech is noted in sources from the 700s, although a shared linguistic identity crystallized only in the 1700s. Old Western Rajasthani, also called Dingal, was the medium of Charan bards, who composed heroic couplets and court chronicles; Pingal blended it with the Brij Bhasha used by Krishna poets.

Long written for trade in the Mahajani script, Rajasthani later shifted to Devanagari in India and to a Perso-Arabic hand among merchants settled in Sindh.
zh:
拉贾斯坦语是西印度—雅利安语支下的一组语言，通行于拉贾斯坦及邻近的马尔瓦、古吉拉特和信德，包含马尔瓦里语等多种变体，文学标准语主要以马尔瓦里语为基础。它源自古吉拉特阿帕布拉姆沙语，耆那教学者金月曾为这种俗语编写语法。

8世纪的文献已提到拉贾斯坦一带有独立的语言，但共同的语言认同到18世纪才形成。古西拉贾斯坦语又称丁格尔语，是查兰吟游诗人创作英雄双行诗和宫廷编年史的媒介；平格尔文体则把它与黑天诗人使用的布拉杰语相融合。

拉贾斯坦语长期用马哈詹尼字母记账，后来在印度改用天城文，移居信德的商人则使用波斯—阿拉伯字体。

en:
The Ramu languages are a family of about thirty Papuan tongues spoken along the Ramu River and neighbouring waterways of the Sepik–Ramu basin in northern Papua New Guinea. For millennia its villages drew food, transport and their way of life from the river.

Classifiers commonly join the family with the Lower Sepik languages in a wider Ramu–Lower Sepik grouping. Its branches include the Ottilien family and the lexically divergent Grass languages, of which Banaro shares remarkably few cognates with the rest of Ramu speech.

European ships first reached this coast in 1827, when Dumont d'Urville charted the nearby Astrolabe Bay, while the Ramu villages themselves stayed beyond outside reach for decades longer.
zh:
拉穆诸语是一个包含约三十种巴布亚语言的语族，沿拉穆河及巴布亚新几内亚北部塞皮克—拉穆盆地的邻近水道通行。数千年来，河畔村落的食物、交通和生活都依赖这条河。

分类学者通常把该语族与下塞皮克诸语合并为更大的拉穆—下塞皮克语群。它的分支包括奥托利恩语组和词汇分歧很大的格拉斯诸语，其中巴纳罗语与拉穆其他语言的同源词少得出奇。

欧洲船只最早于1827年抵达这片海岸，迪蒙·迪维尔测绘了附近的阿斯特罗莱布湾，而拉穆河畔的村落与外界隔绝的时间还要再长数十年。

en:
Rapa Nui is an Eastern Polynesian language spoken on Easter Island, the isolated southeastern outpost of Polynesia. The island's first recorded European visitor, the Dutch explorer Jacob Roggeveen, landed on Easter Sunday in 1722.

Its grammar most closely resembles Marquesan, while its sound system is conservative like that of Māori, retaining consonants that related languages have lost. Before European contact the islanders may have recorded the older language in rongorongo, glyphs cut into wooden tablets and mastered by a small literate elite who treated the tablets as sacred. The glyphs are undeciphered, so the older spoken language survives chiefly in chants and oral tradition.
zh:
拉帕努伊语是通行于复活节岛的东波利尼西亚语言，复活节岛是波利尼西亚东南端与世隔绝的前哨。1722年复活节当天，荷兰探险家雅各布·罗赫芬首次有记载地抵达该岛。

拉帕努伊语的语法最接近马克萨斯语，语音却像毛利语一样保守，保留了亲属语言已经丢失的辅音。与欧洲人接触之前，岛民可能曾用朗戈朗格文字记录古老的语言：这套符号刻在木板上，只有少数识字精英能够掌握，木板也被当作圣物。这些符号未能释读，更早期的口语主要保存在吟唱和口传传统之中。

en:
Rawa, also recorded as Erawa or Erewa, is one of the Finisterre languages, a family placed within the Trans–New Guinea phylum and spoken in the rugged Finisterre Range of north-eastern Papua New Guinea. Rawa splits into two dialects, Rawa and Karo, used on opposite sides of the mountains.

Comparative work ties the Finisterre languages to the neighbouring Huon languages: a small closed set of verbs takes pronominal object prefixes, some clearly cognate across the two groups, which linguists take as evidence of common descent. European ships first entered the Huon Gulf and Vitiaz Strait in the 1790s with the French expedition of d'Entrecasteaux, while the high valleys of the Rawa remained far longer untouched by outside contact.
zh:
拉瓦语又记作埃拉瓦语，是菲尼斯特雷语群的语言之一；该语群属跨新几内亚语系，通行于巴布亚新几内亚东北部崎岖的菲尼斯特雷岭。拉瓦语分为拉瓦和卡罗两种方言，分别通行于山脉两侧。

比较研究把菲尼斯特雷诸语与邻近的休恩诸语联系在一起：两语群都有一小类封闭动词带代词性宾语前缀，其中一些前缀明显同源，语言学者视之为共同起源的证据。1790年代，当特尔卡斯托率领的法国探险队首次驾船驶入休恩湾和维蒂亚兹海峡，而拉瓦人所在的高山谷地与外界隔绝的时间则要长得多。

en:
Refaluwasch, meaning people of the deep sea, is both the self-name of the Carolinian people and their language, a Chuukic member of the Micronesian group spoken on Saipan and the other Northern Mariana Islands. It forms part of a dialect continuum reaching back to the Caroline atolls.

For centuries its speakers sailed the sawei tribute route to Yap, until the Spanish conquest of Guam broke the habit; the navigator Luito reopened the sea road by reaching Guam in 1778. On Guam the official Luis de Torres studied the language between 1795 and 1797, leaving the earliest written records.

In 1815 a typhoon ruined the atolls of Elato and Satawal, and their chiefs Nguschul and Aghurubw led about 900 people in 120 canoes to the nearly empty island of Saipan, where they founded the village of Arabwal.
zh:
“雷法卢瓦什”意为深海之民，既是加罗林人的自称，也是他们语言的名字。这种语言属于密克罗尼西亚语族的楚克语支，通行于塞班岛和北马里亚纳群岛其他岛屿。它是一条延伸回加罗林环礁的方言连续体的一部分。

许多世纪里，说这种语言的人沿着“萨维”朝贡航路前往雅浦，直到西班牙征服关岛打断了这一传统；航海家卢伊托于1778年抵达关岛，重新打通海路。1795—1797年，关岛官员路易斯·德·托雷斯研究这种语言，留下了最早的书面记录。

1815年，一场台风摧毁了埃拉托和萨塔瓦尔环礁，两位酋长恩古舒尔和阿格鲁布率领约900人、120条独木舟迁往当时几乎空无一人的塞班岛，在那里建立阿拉伯瓦尔村。

en:
Rejang is the Austronesian language of the Rejang people of south-western Sumatra, spoken on the Barisan slopes of Bengkulu in five dialects from the highlands down to the Pesisir coast. Linguists link it with the Bidayuh languages of Borneo and place it within the Greater North Borneo group, fitting the Rejang tradition that their ancestors crossed the Karimata Strait from Sarawak and followed the Musi and Rawas rivers into the interior.

The language long had no standardized writing. The Brahmic Rejang alphabet, also called Kaganga and kin to the Batak and Lontara scripts, served chiefly for formal High Malay and for ritual texts, medical incantations and poetry, with the earliest surviving examples dating from the mid-1700s.
zh:
拉让语是苏门答腊西南部拉让人的南岛语，通行于明古鲁一带的巴里桑山坡，从高地到沿海的佩西西尔，共有五种方言。语言学家把它和婆罗洲的比达友语联系起来，归入大北婆罗洲语群；这与拉让人的起源传说相吻合：祖先从沙捞越渡卡里马塔海峡，沿穆西河和拉瓦斯河深入内陆。

拉让语长期没有规范文字。婆罗米系的拉让字母又称卡干加文，与巴塔克文、隆塔拉文同源，主要用于正式的高级马来语以及宗教仪式文本、医咒和诗歌，现存最早实物见于18世纪中叶。

en:
Reo Maohi is the Tahitian language, the leading member of the reo Mā'ohi, the Polynesian tongues of French Polynesia, and an Eastern Polynesian language spoken chiefly on the Society Islands. For centuries it was a purely spoken language, carried in oratory, song and the recitations of the traveling arioi society.

Tahitian reshaped its vocabulary through pi'i, the sacred name taboo: words resembling a chief's name were replaced, so that tū for standing gave way to ti'a under King Tū-nui-ē'a-i-te-atua, grandfather of the Pōmare dynasty.

In 1797 Protestant missionaries of the London Missionary Society landed from the ship Duff; Henry Nott, working with King Pōmare II, and John Davies fixed an alphabet of five vowels and nine consonants. Davies printed the first Tahitian book, a spelling book, in 1810, and the translated Bible became a text through which many Polynesians learned to read.
zh:
毛希语即塔希提语，是“毛希诸语”（法属波利尼西亚诸波利尼西亚语言）中最主要的一种，属东波利尼西亚语群，主要通行于社会群岛。它长期只有口语，靠演说、歌唱和云游的阿利奥伊社团的吟诵传承。

塔希提语通过名为“皮伊”的神圣名讳禁忌更新词汇：凡与首领名字相近的词都要替换，例如在波马雷王朝的先世图努伊埃阿国王在位时，表示“站立”的tū就被ti'a取代。

1797年，伦敦传道会的新教传教士乘“达夫号”登岛；亨利·诺特与波马雷二世国王合作，约翰·戴维斯等人确定了由五个元音和九个辅音组成的字母表。戴维斯于1810年印出第一本塔希提语拼字课本，译成塔希提语的圣经后来成为许多波利尼西亚人学习读写的读本。

en:
Romanian is the easternmost of the Romance languages, descended from the Vulgar Latin of the Roman provinces along the lower Danube. After the Roman withdrawal from Dacia in the third century and the Slavic settlement of the Balkans, its spoken forms developed into Common Romanian between the sixth and eighth centuries.

By the tenth century this had split into northern Daco-Romanian and Istro-Romanian, and southern Aromanian and Megleno-Romanian. Slavic speech supplied a large share of its vocabulary and Old Church Slavonic long served religion and the princely chanceries.

Romanian was first written in Cyrillic letters in the later fifteenth century: the Hurmuzaki Psalter was copied around 1500 and Neacșu's letter of 1521 is the oldest precisely dated document. In 1780 the Transylvanian School printed its first grammar in Vienna, opening an age of re-latinization and a standardized literary language.
zh:
罗马尼亚语是罗曼语族最东边的一支，源自多瑙河下游罗马行省的通俗拉丁语。3世纪罗马撤出达契亚、斯拉夫人入居巴尔干之后，这些口语在6—8世纪发展为共同罗马尼亚语。

到10世纪，它分化为北支的达科-罗马尼亚语和伊斯特拉-罗马尼亚语，以及南支的阿罗马尼亚语和梅戈来诺-罗马尼亚语。斯拉夫语为它提供了大量词汇，古教会斯拉夫语则长期用于宗教和王公文书。

罗马尼亚语在15世纪后半叶开始用西里尔字母书写：《胡尔穆扎基诗篇》约抄成于1500年，1521年的《尼亚克舒书信》是现存年代确切的最早文书。1780年，特兰西瓦尼亚学派在维也纳印行第一部罗马尼亚语语法，开启了重新拉丁化和规范文学语言的时代。

en:
Rotokas is a Papuan language of Bougainville Island in Papua New Guinea, and the main member of the Rotokas branch of the North Bougainville family. It is spoken in the centre of the island and splits into Central Rotokas, Aita Rotokas and Pipipaia dialects.

Central Rotokas holds one of the smallest sound systems known, with only six consonants and five vowels and no phonemic nasals, while the Aita dialect keeps nine consonants including nasals. The language is verb-final and is written with a twelve-letter Latin alphabet.

The first settlers of Bougainville reached the island in the Paleolithic past, and Austronesian seafarers arrived in the second millennium BCE. The first European to land was the French explorer Louis Antoine de Bougainville in 1768, after whom the island is named.
zh:
罗托卡斯语是巴布亚新几内亚布干维尔岛的一种巴布亚语，是北布干维尔语系中罗托卡斯语支的主要成员。它通行于岛的中部，分为中部罗托卡斯、艾塔罗托卡斯和皮皮帕亚三种方言。

中部方言的音系是已知最小的音系之一，只有6个辅音和5个元音，没有音位性鼻音；艾塔方言则保留了包括鼻音在内的9个辅音。罗托卡斯语动词居句末，使用一套12个字母的拉丁字母文字。

布干维尔岛在旧石器时代即有人类定居，南岛语航海者在公元前第二个千年抵达。1768年法国探险家路易·安托万·德·布干维尔成为第一个登岛的欧洲人，该岛便以他的姓氏命名。

en:
Rotuman, self-called Fäeag Rotuạm, is an Austronesian language spoken on Rotuma, north of Fiji, whose people were shaped by settlers from Samoa, Tonga and the eastern Polynesian islands, leaving the language heavy with Samoan and Tongan loanwords. In the seventeenth century Tongan forces occupied Rotuma until the islanders overthrew them in a single night of uprising.

The language is known for its metathesis: the final vowel of a word swaps places with the consonant before it, producing umlaut, diphthongs and long and short forms of words. The first confirmed European sighting of the island was by Captain Edward Edwards of HMS Pandora in 1791, while he was searching for the Bounty mutineers.
zh:
罗图马语（自称费亚格罗图姆）是斐济以北罗图马岛上的南岛语。岛上居民融合了来自萨摩亚、汤加和东波利尼西亚诸岛的移民，使这种语言吸纳了大量萨摩亚语和汤加语借词。17世纪汤加军队曾占领罗图马，最终岛民在一夜起义中推翻了占领者。

这种语言的特色是音位交替：词末元音与紧邻在前的辅音换位，由此产生元音变音、双元音以及词的长短两种形式。欧洲人首次有确证地望见该岛是在1791年，当时皇家海军“潘多拉号”的爱德华·爱德华兹船长正在搜寻“邦蒂号”哗变者。

en:
Roviana is an Oceanic language of the Northwest Solomonic branch, spoken around the Roviana and Vonavona lagoons on the north-central coast of New Georgia in the Solomon Islands. Its grammar is marked by syntactic ergativity, and its yes-no questions differ from statements only by a rising intonation.

During the 1800s it was carried along the inter-island trade and raiding routes of the New Georgia group and became a trade language and a regional lingua franca, used in particular for Christian teaching among the neighbouring island communities.
zh:
罗维阿纳语属于泛太平洋语系的西北所罗门语支，通行于所罗门群岛新乔治亚岛中北部沿岸的罗维阿纳潟湖和沃纳沃纳潟湖一带。它的语法以句法作格性为标志，是非问句与陈述句只靠升调区别。

19世纪，它随着新乔治亚群岛的岛际贸易和劫掠路线向外传播，成为贸易语言和地区通用语，尤其用于向邻近岛屿社群宣讲基督教义。

en:
Rufiji-Ruvuma is a group of closely related Bantu languages spoken between the Rufiji and Ruvuma rivers in southern Tanzania, with related varieties reaching northern Mozambique and the southern end of Lake Malawi. It joins the Rufiji or Matandu cluster, including Matumbi and Ndengereko, to the Ruvuma cluster of Yao-Mwera and Makonde, together with Ngindo, Ndendeule and Ngoni.

Matumbi, called Kimatuumbi by its speakers, is heard south of the Rufiji around Kilwa. The Yao tongue was carried west by caravan traders who exchanged ivory and grain for cloth and weapons with Arab and Swahili merchants on the coast; around 1830 Yao groups began settling toward the southern shore of Lake Malawi, taking their language with them.
zh:
鲁菲吉‑鲁武马语是一组关系相近的班图语言，通行于坦桑尼亚南部鲁菲吉河与鲁武马河之间，相近的分支还分布到莫桑比克北部和马拉维湖最南端。它把以马图姆比语、恩登盖雷科语为代表的鲁菲吉（马坦杜）语群，与约奥—姆韦拉语、马孔德语组成的鲁武马语群归在一起，还包括恩金多语、恩登德莱语和恩戈尼语。

马图姆比语的使用者称其语言为基马图姆比语，通行于鲁菲吉河以南的基尔瓦一带。商队商人带着约奥语西去，用象牙和谷物同海岸的阿拉伯、斯瓦希里商人交换布匹和武器；1830年前后，约奥人开始向马拉维湖南岸迁徙，也把语言带到那里。

en: Rukwa denotes the Rukwa group of Bantu languages spoken around Lake Rukwa and the southern end of Lake Tanganyika in southwestern Tanzania, comprising Fipa, Pimbwe, Rungwa, Safwa, Nyakyusa, Nyiha and Mambwe-Lungu among others. The Fipa of the Ufipa plateau built centralised chiefdoms ruled by dynasties of iron-smiths, who traded their iron for woven cloth.
zh: 鲁夸语指鲁夸语群，是通行于坦桑尼亚西南部鲁夸湖周边与坦噶尼喀湖南端的一组班图语，包括菲帕语、平布韦语、隆瓜语、萨富瓦语、尼亚库萨语、尼哈语和曼布韦-伦古语等。乌菲帕高原上的菲帕人建立了集权酋邦，由世代冶铁的王朝统治，以铁器交换织物。

en:
Rumu, also recorded as Rumuwa, Kairi or Dumu, is a Papuan language of the Papuan Gulf lowlands, spoken in the Kikori district around the lower courses of the Kikori, Sirebi and Tiviri rivers, where mangrove forest and freshwater swamp meet the rainforest. It belongs to the Turama–Kikorian family, yet stands apart as a divergent branch, its pronoun forms pointing toward a link with the Trans–New Guinea stock.

The Rumu-speaking villages lie on a river network that carried trade and marriage ties between the gulf and the peoples of the interior. The coast beyond the delta was first seen by Europeans when Torres sailed past in 1606, though the Kikori swamps remained unvisited by outsiders until long afterward.
zh:
卢穆语又记为卢穆瓦语、凯里语或杜穆语，是巴布亚湾低地的一种巴布亚语言，通行于基科里县基科里河、西雷比河和蒂维里河下游一带，那里红树林、淡水沼泽与雨林相接。它属于图拉马-基科里语族，但在语族内部是一条分歧很大的支系，其代词形式显示它与跨新几内亚语系存在联系。

卢穆语村落所在的河网承载着海湾与内陆诸族之间的贸易和联姻往来。1606年托雷斯航行驶过，三角洲外的海岸第一次被欧洲人看见，但基科里沼泽在此后很久仍无外来者涉足。

en:
Ruthenian is the South-Western branch of East Slavic, descended from the Old East Slavic of Kievan Rus and carried after the Mongol sack of Kiev in 1240 through the western Rus lands that fell to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.

From the 1300s the chancery in Vilnius shaped it into the Grand Duchy's official language. All three Statutes of Lithuania, of 1529, 1566 and 1588, were written in it; Francysk Skaryna of Polotsk printed a Bible at Prague between 1517 and 1519.

After the Union of Lublin of 1569, the grand duchy gave up its chancery form of Ruthenian, Chancery Slavonic, for Middle Polish; the nobility Polonised, but the Orthodox peasantry kept the old speech. By the early 1700s it had split into early Belarusian and Ukrainian, both becoming separate standards by the end of the century, while the Carpathian highlands kept their own Rusyn vernacular.
zh:
鲁塞尼亚语是东斯拉夫语的西南支，源于基辅罗斯的古东斯拉夫语；1240年基辅遭蒙古人洗劫后，它在并入立陶宛大公国的西部罗斯诸地继续发展。

14世纪起，维尔纽斯的大公国官署把它打造成立陶宛大公国的官方语言。1529、1566和1588年颁布的三部《立陶宛法令》都以它写成；波洛茨克人法兰斯克·斯卡利纳1517—1519年在布拉格印行圣经。

1569年卢布林联合后，大公国放弃鲁塞尼亚语的公文形式秘书室斯拉夫语、改用中古波兰语；贵族纷纷波兰化，信奉东正教的农民却仍说旧语。到18世纪初，共同口语分化为早期白俄罗斯语和乌克兰语，到18世纪末各自发展为独立的标准语，喀尔巴阡山区则保留了卢森尼亚土语。

en:
Kinyarwanda, the national language of Rwanda, is a Bantu language of the Rwanda-Rundi dialect continuum, spoken also in adjoining parts of Uganda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Tanzania. It is fully mutually intelligible with Kirundi, the national language of Burundi.

Its speakers include the Tutsi, the Hutu and the hunter-gatherer Twa: Hutu farmers settled the hills around the year 1000, cattle-raising Tutsi moved in from the 1400s, and the centralised Rwandan kingdom grew up around the Gasabo hill between the fourteenth and sixteenth centuries. As the court expanded, Kinyarwanda spread with it, carrying royal oral traditions and historical poems recited from memory, since the language had no standard orthography before the colonial era.
zh:
卢旺达语是卢旺达的国语，属班图语的卢旺达-基隆迪方言连续体，也通行于乌干达、刚果（金）和坦桑尼亚的毗邻地区。它与布隆迪国语基隆迪语完全互通。

说这种语言的人包括图西人、胡图人和以狩猎采集为生的特瓦人：胡图农民约在1000年进入丘陵地带务农，牧牛的图西人自15世纪起迁入，而集权的卢旺达王国于14—16世纪在加萨博山一带兴起。随着宫廷扩张，卢旺达语也随之扩散，承载着王室口述传统与靠记诵流传的史诗经篇；在殖民时代之前，这种语言没有统一的文字。

en:
Ryūkyū is the collective name for the indigenous languages of the Ryukyu Islands, stretching from Amami and Okinawa south to Miyako, Yaeyama and Yonaguni; together with Japanese they form the Japonic family.
