Long isolation let their speech diverge from the Old Japanese of the mainland. The six recognized Ryukyuan languages are not mutually intelligible with Japanese or with one another.

Under the Ryukyu Kingdom the Shuri dialect of Okinawa served as the regional standard. The court wrote in kanji and hiragana borrowed from Japan: a royal tomb inscription of 1501 survives, and from 1531 the court compiled the Omoro Sōshi, twenty-two volumes of songs set mostly in hiragana, while Yonaguni kept its own glyphs.

In 1609 the Satsuma Domain of Kyushu conquered the kingdom; official documents then moved toward classical Chinese, though poetry and song continued in the Shuri dialect.
zh:
琉球语是琉球群岛各本土语言的统称，这串岛链从奄美、冲绳向南延至宫古、八重山和与那国；它们与日语同属日琉语族。长期的隔绝使它们与日本本土的古日语分化，公认的六种琉球语彼此之间、与日语之间都不能互通。

琉球国时期，冲绳的首里方言是全区域的通用标准。朝廷借用日本的汉字和平假名书写：1501年的王陵碑文仍存于世，1531年起朝廷又编纂《思草纸》，这部二十二卷的古代歌谣集主要以平假名写成，与那国岛则另有一套自造符号。

1609年，九州的萨摩藩征服琉球国，此后官方文书转向汉文，诗歌与歌谣仍以首里方言创作。

en:
Sa'a, also called South Malaita or Apae'aa, is an Oceanic language of the Austronesian family spoken on Small Malaita, off the southern tip of Malaita, and on nearby Ulawa in the Solomon Islands. Austronesian seafarers settled Malaita between five thousand and thirty-five hundred years ago, and the speech of the south-eastern coast and Ulawa developed in village-based isolation into Sa'a.

The first Europeans to sight Malaita were the Spanish expedition of Álvaro de Mendaña, whose brigantine Santiago recorded the island in April 1568; regular outside contact resumed only after the Solomons were rediscovered in the late eighteenth century. Sa'a had no script of its own and was maintained by oral tradition.
zh:
萨阿语又称南马莱塔语或阿帕埃阿语，是南岛语系的大洋洲语言，通行于所罗门群岛马莱塔岛南端外的南马莱塔岛以及附近的乌拉瓦岛。约五千至三千五百年前，南岛语航海者定居马莱塔，东南沿海与乌拉瓦的语言在以村落为单位的隔绝生活中演变为萨阿语。

1568年4月，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙探险队乘双桅船圣地亚哥号首次望见并记录了马莱塔；直到18世纪末所罗门群岛被重新发现后，定期的外来接触才恢复。萨阿语没有自己的文字，依靠口传传统延续。

en:
Saharan is the game's grouping for Nilo-Saharan vernaculars of the eastern Sahara and Lake Chad belt. The Saharan family includes the Teda and Daza speech of the Toubou, Zaghawa, the Naba tongue of the Bilala, and the Kanuri-Kanembu continuum; the Maban tongues of eastern Chad form a separate but related branch.

Kanembu served the empire of Kanem, founded around 700 at Njimi. Its Sayfawa rulers adopted Islam in the 1000s, and the mai Dunama II Dibalemi controlled the trans-Saharan routes to the Fezzan in the 1200s; Kanembu was later written in Arabic Ajami script.

Around 1380 the Bilala drove the Sayfawa from Njimi, and the court re-established itself in Bornu. Idris Alooma carried Kanem-Bornu to its peak in the late 1500s as court Kanembu merged into Kanuri. The Maba under Abd al-Karim overthrew the Tunjur in 1635 and built the Wadai sultanate around Wara.
zh:
撒哈拉语是游戏对撒哈拉东部与乍得湖地带诸尼罗—撒哈拉语言的归并。撒哈拉语族包括图布人使用的特达语和达扎语、扎加瓦语、比拉勒人的纳巴语，以及卡努里—卡嫩布方言连续体；乍得东部的马巴语族则独立但相近。

卡嫩布语是加涅姆帝国的语言，该国约700年以恩吉米为都建立。赛法瓦王朝的君主们于11世纪皈依伊斯兰教，13世纪的君主杜纳马·迪巴拉米控制了通往费赞的跨撒哈拉商路；卡嫩布语后来用阿拉伯阿贾米字母书写。

约1380年，比拉勒人把赛法瓦王朝逐出恩吉米，王朝宫廷西迁博尔努。伊德里斯·阿卢马在16世纪末把加涅姆—博尔努帝国推向鼎盛，宫廷卡嫩布语也逐渐融入卡努里语。马巴人在阿卜杜勒·卡里姆率领下于1635年推翻通朱尔人，在瓦拉一带建立瓦达伊苏丹国。

en:
Sakao, also called Nkep or Nekep, is an Oceanic language spoken on the northeastern horn of Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu, around Port-Olry and Hog Harbour. Foreigners and linguists named it after the offshore island of Sakao, which its speakers call Ladhi. It has two dialects, the northern Port-Olry dialect and the more conservative southern Hog-Harbour dialect.

Although closely related to Tolomako, Sakao has undergone such drastic sound change, probably within the last thousand years, that the two are mutually unintelligible: Sakao permits unusual consonant clusters and builds long polysynthetic words.

The Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Quiros made the first recorded European landfall on Espiritu Santo in 1606, and Louis de Bougainville and James Cook revisited the island in 1768 and 1774.
zh:
萨卡奥语又称恩凯普语，是瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛东北角、奥尔里港与霍格港一带通行的一种大洋洲语。外来者和语言学者以近海的萨卡奥岛为它命名，而使用者把该岛称作拉齐。它分为北部的奥尔里港方言和较保守的南部霍格港方言。

萨卡奥语与托洛马科语虽为近亲，但可能在最近一千年内经历了剧烈的语音演变，以致两者无法互通：萨卡奥语允许罕见的辅音丛，并能构出很长的多式综合词。

1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队首次有记载地登上圣埃斯皮里图岛，布干维尔和库克又分别于1768年和1774年重访该岛。

en:
Salishan is a family of more than twenty languages spread across the Pacific Northwest, from the coasts of British Columbia, Washington and Oregon inland to Idaho and Montana. It includes Coast Salish, the Tsamosan and Tillamook branches on the outer coast, Nuxalk, and Interior Salish; Salish was originally the self-name of the Bitterroot Salish of Montana.

The languages are known for polysynthesis, agglutinative word-building, ejective consonants and reduplication. Coastal villages such as those of the Fraser estuary go back thousands of years.

Spanish explorers entered the Strait of Georgia in 1791 and George Vancouver surveyed the coast the next year. Fur-trade posts from Fort Vancouver in 1824 to Fort Langley in 1827 and Fort Nisqually in 1833 drew Salish-speaking peoples into the Hudson's Bay Company trade network, even as northern raiders and introduced epidemics struck their communities.
zh:
萨利什语是一个包含二十多种语言的语系，分布于太平洋西北地区，从不列颠哥伦比亚、华盛顿和俄勒冈的海岸一直延伸到爱达荷和蒙大拿内陆。它包括海岸萨利什语支、外海的察莫桑语支和蒂拉穆克语支、努哈尔克语和内陆萨利什语支；“萨利什”本是蒙大拿比特鲁特萨利什人的自称。

这些语言以多式综合、黏着构词、挤喉辅音和重叠构形著称。弗雷泽河口等地的沿海村落已有数千年历史。

1791年西班牙探险者进入乔治亚海峡，次年乔治·温哥华测绘了这片海岸。此后，从1824年的温哥华堡、1827年的兰利堡到1833年的尼斯阔利堡，一连串贸易站把说萨利什语的族群纳入哈德逊湾公司的贸易网络，与此同时，来自北方的袭扰和外来疫病也不断打击他们的社区。

en:
The Sama or Sinama languages form the Sama–Bajaw group of Malayo-Polynesian tongues, spoken by the boat- and shore-dwelling Sama-Bajau of the Sulu Sea. Lexical evidence traces their origin to the Barito region of south-eastern Borneo, making them a sister branch of the Barito languages and Malagasy.

The Sama-Bajau are thought to have taken shape around the Zamboanga Peninsula by about the year 800, and seaborne groups spread to Basilan, Sulu, Borneo and Sulawesi from the tenth century. They traded trepang, pearls and shark fin to China, accepted Islam by the sixteenth century and usually wrote their languages in the Jawi alphabet.

Pigafetta of the Magellan expedition met people who made their dwellings in boats in 1521. Under the Sultanate of Sulu the Banguingui Sama served as crews and raiders alongside the Iranun in the eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries.
zh:
萨马语又称锡纳马语，是马来—波利尼西亚语系下的萨马—巴瑶语支，由苏禄海以船为家或傍海而居的萨马—巴瑶人使用。词汇证据显示它起源于婆罗洲东南部的巴里托地区，是巴里托诸语和马达加斯加语的姊妹分支。

据考订，萨马—巴瑶人约于800年在三宝颜半岛一带形成，10世纪起乘船扩散到巴西兰、苏禄、婆罗洲和苏拉威西。他们向中国出口海参、珍珠和鱼翅，16世纪前皈依伊斯兰教，语言通常用爪夷文书写。

1521年麦哲伦船队的皮加费塔见到以船为屋的人。在苏禄苏丹国治下，18世纪至19世纪初的巴兰吉尼萨马人曾与伊拉农人一道充当水手和劫掠者。

en:
Sámi is the Uralic branch spoken by the indigenous Sámi across Sápmi, in ten or more languages of which Northern Sámi is the largest. Proto-Sámi took shape near the Gulf of Finland in the last millennium before Christ and spread north and west during the Iron Age, reaching central Scandinavia by about AD 500.

The languages fall into western and eastern groups, while more southerly varieties died out under the advance of Finnish and Karelian farming settlement, Kainuu Sámi disappearing in the eighteenth century. Written Sámi began with Protestant missionary work, when the Swedish and Lappish ABC Book appeared in 1638 with prayers and catechism in a regular Sámi form.

Knud Leem published the first grammar in 1748, and in 1832 Rasmus Rask's reasoned Sámi grammar provided the phonemic notation on which the later Northern Sámi orthography was built.
zh:
萨米语是乌拉尔语系的一支，由原住民萨米人通行于萨普米地带，包含十多种语言，其中以北萨米语使用人数最多。原始萨米语在公元前最后一千年形成于芬兰湾附近，铁器时代向北、向西扩散，约在公元500年抵达斯堪的纳维亚中部。

萨米诸语分为东、西两组；更靠南的一些变体在芬兰和卡累利阿农耕聚落的推进下消亡，凯努萨米语便于18世纪消失。萨米语的书写始于新教传教活动：1638年问世的《瑞典与拉普识字课本》以规范的萨米语形式收录了祈祷文和教理问答。

克努德·莱姆于1748年出版了第一部语法书，1832年拉斯穆斯·拉斯克的萨米语法又提出音位记写法，后来的北萨米语正字法即建立在其基础之上。

en:
Sanskrit is the classical Old Indo-Aryan language of South Asia and the sacred tongue of Hinduism, as well as a language of Buddhist and Jain learning. Its oldest layer is Vedic Sanskrit, the language of the Rigveda, whose hymns were composed between 1500 and 1200 BC and preserved by oral tradition.

In the mid-first millennium BC the grammarian Panini codified Classical Sanskrit in his Eight Chapters, after which the language changed little. It had no script of its own, being written in Brahmi and later most often in Devanagari; from the fourth century its inscriptions reached Southeast Asia, where Brahmic letters fathered the Khmer and Javanese scripts.

Long after ceasing to be a mother tongue, Sanskrit remained the link language of religion, scholarship and courts, and the Benares Sanskrit College, founded under British rule in 1791, sustained its traditional teaching.
zh:
梵语是南亚古典的古印度—雅利安语言，是印度教的神圣语言，也用于佛教和耆那教的学问。它最古老的层次是吠陀梵语，即《梨俱吠陀》的语言；其中的颂诗作于公元前1500年至前1200年之间，靠口传传统保存下来。

公元前第一个千年中叶，文法学家波你尼在《八章书》中规范了古典梵语，此后这种语言变化甚微。梵语没有专属文字，先后用婆罗米文和后来最常用的天城文书写；从4世纪起，它的铭文传入东南亚，婆罗米系字母在当地孕育出高棉文和爪哇文。

梵语不再作为母语之后很久，仍是宗教、学术和宫廷的通用语言；1791年英国统治下创办的贝拿勒斯梵文学院，延续着它的传统教学。

en:
Sao is the name given to the language of the Sao civilization, which grew from local Iron Age cultures around Lake Chad and the Chari River in the second millennium BC, taking clear shape in the last centuries before Christ. No Sao inscription or text survives, so the language is known only through its Chadic-speaking descendants.

The Sao lived in walled city-states ruled by divine kings, leaving terracotta figures and funerary urns, and their cities long resisted the empires of Kanem and Bornu.

Between the ninth and fifteenth centuries these states were at their height, but in the sixteenth century Bornu expansion and conversion to Islam ended Sao as a separate culture. The Kotoko, who founded their own kingdom in about 1500 and speak the Lagwan and other Mandage languages, are regarded as the inheritors of the Sao city-states.
zh:
萨奥语是对萨奥文明所用语言的称呼。萨奥文明在公元前第二千纪于乍得湖和沙里河流域由当地铁器时代文化发展而来，在公元前最后几个世纪定型。萨奥语没有铭文或文本传世，只能通过说乍得语的后裔了解。

萨奥人居住在神王统治的城墙城邦里，留下赤陶人像和骨灰瓮，他们的城邦曾长期抵御加涅姆和博尔努帝国。

9—15世纪是这些城邦的鼎盛期，但到16世纪，博尔努的扩张和伊斯兰教的改宗终结了萨奥作为独立文化的存在。科托科人在约1500年建立自己的王国，使用拉格万语等曼达格语，被视为萨奥城邦的继承者。

en:
Scandinavian, or North Germanic, began as Proto-Norse, from which came Old Norse, the common language of the Viking Age. Norse settlers carried it to Iceland and the Faroes around 800 and, as Norn, to Orkney and Shetland.

Medieval speakers still called it the Danish tongue, and it was written in the Latin alphabet in manuscripts holding the Poetic Edda, the Prose Edda and the Icelandic sagas. West and East Norse gradually diverged, giving Norwegian and Icelandic on one side and Danish and Swedish on the other.

The Reformation brought printed Bible translations, while political unions, from the Swedish break with the Kalmar Union in 1523 to the end of Denmark–Norway in 1814, sharpened the separate standards. Norn died out around 1700, while Icelandic kept closest to the ancient tongue.
zh:
斯堪的纳维亚语又称北日耳曼语，最早阶段是原始诺斯语，由此发展出的古诺斯语是维京时代的共同语言。诺斯定居者约在800年把它带到冰岛和法罗群岛，又以诺恩语的形式传到奥克尼和设得兰。

中世纪的使用者仍称之为丹麦舌，当时已用拉丁字母抄写手稿，留下了《诗体埃达》《散文埃达》和冰岛萨迦。西诺斯语与东诺斯语逐渐分化，一侧形成挪威语和冰岛语，另一侧形成丹麦语和瑞典语。

宗教改革带来了印刷的圣经译本，而政治联合——从1523年瑞典退出卡尔马联盟到1814年丹麦—挪威联合解体——又促使各书面标准进一步分化。诺恩语约在1700年消亡，冰岛语则最接近古老的诺斯语。

official_raw.en: During the Viking Age, Old Norse spread across Scandinavia and into other areas like Iceland, the Faroe Islands, and parts of the British Isles. Over time, it evolved into the distinct but related languages we recognize today, each with their own unique characteristics, while still maintaining a common Scandinavian heritage.
official_raw.zh: 在维京时代，古诺斯语遍布斯堪的纳维亚半岛，并传入了冰岛、法罗群岛和不列颠群岛部分地区。随着时间推移，它演变为我们如今认知中的各种不同但相关的语言，每种语言都有自己的特点，同时仍然保留着共同的斯堪的纳维亚传承。

en:
Seeptsa, also written Seeptsá, is the native name of the language better known as Cholón, once spoken by the Cholón people of the Huallaga River valley in northern Peru. Together with the closely related Hibito tongue of the same area it forms the Hibito–Cholón, or Cholonan, family.

Franciscan missionaries were the first to write it down: a seventeenth-century Arte y Vocabulario has been lost, but Pedro de la Mata's eighteenth-century Arte de la Lengua Cholona survives, and Bishop Baltasar Martínez Compañón included a Cholón wordlist in the codex of Peruvian life he compiled between 1782 and 1785.

As mission settlements and the Quechua and Spanish languages advanced up the Huallaga valley in the colonial period, Cholón steadily lost ground, until the faith and daily life of its speakers were carried on in other languages.
zh:
塞普察语是乔隆语的本土自称，曾由秘鲁北部瓦亚加河流域的乔隆人使用。它与同一地区关系密切的希维托语共同构成希维托—乔隆语系，亦称乔隆语族。

最早记录这种语言的是方济各会传教士：17世纪的一部《乔隆语技艺与词汇》已经散佚，18世纪德拉马塔所著的《乔隆语技艺》留存于世，马丁内斯·孔帕尼翁主教在1782—1785年间编纂、记录秘鲁风土的图册中也收录了一份乔隆语词表。

随着殖民时期传教定居点的建立，以及克丘亚语和西班牙语沿瓦亚加河谷推进，乔隆语的使用范围不断缩小，其使用者的信仰与日常生活逐渐改由其他语言承载。

en:
Senegambian, also called the North Atlantic branch of the Niger-Congo family, covers the languages of the western Sahel and Atlantic coast: Wolof around the Senegal river, Serer in the kingdoms of Sine and Saloum, and Fula, whose pastoralist speakers spread from Senegambia east across the Sahel. Unusually for Niger-Congo languages they have no tones.

The Wolof founded the Jolof Empire, at first a vassal of Mali, which became independent about 1360 and dominated the country between the Senegal and Gambia rivers until its defeat at the battle of Danki in 1549.

Fulani jihads built the Islamic states of Futa Bundu, Futa Tooro and Fouta Djallon between 1650 and 1750, while the scholar Usman dan Fodio founded the Sokoto Caliphate in 1803 and wrote more than a hundred works in Fula Ajami, an Arabic-based script.
zh:
塞内冈比亚语又称尼日尔—刚果语系的北大西洋语支，涵盖西非萨赫勒西部与大西洋沿岸的诸语言：塞内加尔河一带的沃洛夫语，锡内、萨卢姆等王国的塞雷尔语，以及随游牧民从塞内冈比亚向东传遍萨赫勒的富拉语。与多数尼日尔—刚果语言不同，它们都没有声调。

沃洛夫人建立的沃洛夫帝国起初是马里帝国的附庸，约1360年获得独立，称雄于塞内加尔河与冈比亚河之间，直到1549年在丹基战役中战败。

1650—1750年间，富拉尼圣战建立了邦杜富塔、富塔托罗和富塔贾隆等伊斯兰国家；学者乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥于1803年建立索科托哈里发国，并用富拉语的阿贾米文字——一种阿拉伯字母体系——写下上百部著作。

en:
Senufo is the Atlantic-Congo branch of some fifteen closely related languages spread across northern Ivory Coast, southern Mali and south-western Burkina Faso, with the isolated Nafaanra tongue in Ghana.

The old town of Korhogo was already a Senufo centre in the thirteenth century, and from the fourteenth century Dyula merchants moving out of the Mali Empire founded trading towns such as Kong on Senufo land. The Senufo took shape as a distinct group in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, and in the north they formed the backbone of the Kénédougou Kingdom around Sikasso.

In 1710 the Dyula leader Seku Watara built the Kong Empire, a loose commercial state whose power ran along the trade routes as far as Sya, taken in 1737; Muslim traders settled in Senufo towns under its rule, though most Senufo kept their ancestral religion.
zh:
塞努福语是大西洋—刚果语系下的一支，包含约十五种亲属语言，分布在科特迪瓦北部、马里南部和布基纳法索西南部，另有孤立的纳法拉语通行于加纳。

古城科霍戈在13世纪已是塞努福人的中心，14世纪起，从马里帝国迁出的朱拉商人在塞努福人的土地上建立了孔格等商业城镇。塞努福人作为一个独特群体形成于15—16世纪，北方的塞努福人构成了以锡卡索为中心的凯内杜古王国的主体。

1710年，朱拉首领塞库·瓦塔拉建立孔格帝国，这个松散的商业国家沿商路扩张，于1737年攻取西亚；在其统治下穆斯林商人定居于塞努福城镇，但多数塞努福人仍保留着本土信仰。

en:
The Sepik or Sepik River languages form a family of about fifty Papuan languages spoken across the Sepik river basin of northern New Guinea, in the grasslands and swamps stretching from the upper reaches to its delta on the Bismarck Sea. The grouping takes its name from the river.

Its best-known members are the Ndu languages, including Iatmul, Abelam and Boiken. Sepik languages tend to simple phonologies with few consonants, and most distinguish masculine and feminine genders on nouns, classifying even inanimate things by shape and size.

After the Portuguese first reached New Guinea in 1526 and the Spanish gave the island its name in 1545, coastal contacts grew, yet the Sepik interior remained beyond outside reach. Its peoples lived in villages along the river and its tributaries, relying on fishing, sago and the exchange networks of the basin.
zh:
塞皮克语又称塞皮克河语，是巴布亚诸语言中的一个语族，约有五十种语言，通行于新几内亚北部的塞皮克河流域——从河流上游延伸到俾斯麦海河口的草原与沼泽地带。该语族因塞皮克河而得名。

其中最著名的是恩杜语支，包括雅特穆尔语、阿贝兰语和博伊肯语。塞皮克诸语言音系通常较为简单，辅音不多；多数语言的名词分阳性、阴性，连无生命事物也按形状和大小归类。

1526年葡萄牙人首次抵达新几内亚，1545年西班牙人将该岛命名为“新几内亚”，沿海接触日渐增多，但塞皮克内陆始终与外界隔绝。各族群沿河及支流而居，以捕鱼、西谷椰和流域内的交换网络为生。

en:
Serbo-Croatian is the western South Slavic language of the western Balkans, spoken across Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Montenegro in a chain of dialects. Early medieval Slavic migrants brought it into the region, and by the ninth or tenth century the speech had divided into Kajkavian, Chakavian and the Shtokavian dialects that later became the prestige form.

Its oldest surviving texts, from the eleventh century, are in the Glagolitic alphabet; medieval writers also used Cyrillic and Latin, the earliest complete Latin-script text being dated 1345. From the fifteenth century the Ottoman conquest uprooted whole populations, and Shtokavian spread with the migrants at the expense of Chakavian and Kajkavian.

In the early nineteenth century Vuk Karadžić rebuilt Serbian Cyrillic on phonemic principles and Ljudevit Gaj devised a matching Croatian Latin alphabet; the name Serbo-Croatian itself was coined by Jacob Grimm in 1824.
zh:
塞尔维亚‑克罗地亚语是西巴尔干的西部南斯拉夫语言，以一连串方言通行于塞尔维亚、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和黑山等地。中世纪早期的斯拉夫移民把它带入这一地区，到9—10世纪，当地口语分化为卡伊卡维、查卡维以及后来成为优势方言的什托方言。

现存最早的文本出自11世纪，用格拉哥里字母写成；中世纪的书写者还使用西里尔字母和拉丁字母，最早的完整拉丁字母文本可定于1345年。15世纪起，奥斯曼征服造成整族整族的人口迁徙，什托方言随移民扩散，挤压了查卡维方言和卡伊卡维方言的空间。

19世纪初，武克·卡拉季奇按音位原则改造了塞尔维亚西里尔字母，留德维特·盖伊则设计出与之对应的克罗地亚拉丁字母；“塞尔维亚‑克罗地亚语”这个名称本身，是雅各布·格林在1824年提出的。

en:
Shawnee, self-designated Saawanwaatoweewe, is a Central Algonquian language of the Algic family, closely related to Mesquakie-Sauk and Kickapoo. Its speakers' precontact homeland probably lay in southern Ohio, where some connect the Shawnee with the Fort Ancient culture that flourished along the Ohio River from about 1000 to 1650.

In the seventeenth century the Shawnee dispersed across Ohio, Illinois, Maryland, Delaware and Pennsylvania, and later scattered again. A polysynthetic language, Shawnee packs much information into its verbs and distinguishes animate from inanimate nouns.

The Shawnee fought a succession of wars to hold their lands, from the French and Indian War of 1754 to Tecumseh's War of 1810 to 1813. Under the Indian Removal Act of 1830 the United States began moving them west of the Mississippi, carrying the language into Missouri and Kansas.
zh:
肖尼语自称萨万瓦托维韦语，是阿尔吉克语系的一门中阿尔冈昆语言，与梅斯克瓦基—索克语和基卡普语关系密切。肖尼人接触欧洲人前的家园大概在俄亥俄南部，有学者把他们与约1000—1650年间兴盛于俄亥俄河沿岸的古堡文化联系起来。

17世纪，肖尼人分散到俄亥俄、伊利诺伊、马里兰、特拉华和宾夕法尼亚各地，后来又再度散居。肖尼语是多式综合语言，大量信息压缩在动词之中，名词分有灵与无灵两类。

为保住故土，肖尼人从1754年的法国—印第安战争到1810—1813年的特库姆塞战争接连参战。1830年《印第安人迁移法》通过后，美国开始把他们迁往密西西比河以西，肖尼语也随之带到密苏里和堪萨斯。

en:
Sosoni-Kusiutta is the Shoshoni speech of the Great Basin, the Central Numic member of the Uto-Aztecan family, heard across Nevada, Utah and Wyoming and up to the Snake River plain of Idaho. Its speakers call it Sosoni' ta̲i̲kwappe, or more generally newe ta̲i̲kwappe, 'the people's language'.

It divides into Western Shoshoni, Gosiute — the Kusiutta bands of western Utah — Northern and Eastern Shoshoni dialects. Its nearest kin are Timbisha and Comanche, whose speakers remained a Shoshoni band until around 1700, when they moved onto the southern plains and their dialect slowly ceased to be mutually intelligible.

All descend from Proto-Numic, whose speakers began spreading out of the southern Sierra Nevada roughly a thousand years earlier. Shoshoni was traditionally an unwritten language, carried in oral narrative and song.
zh:
肖肖尼‑库西乌塔语是大盆地的肖肖尼话，属犹他-阿兹特克语系的中努米克语支，通行于内华达、犹他、怀俄明，北至爱达荷的斯内克河平原。使用者称之为“索索尼·泰夸佩”，更笼统的叫法是“内韦·泰夸佩”，意为“人的语言”。

它分为西肖肖尼、戈休特（即犹他西部的库西乌塔群体）、北肖肖尼和东肖肖尼几种方言。它最近的亲属是廷比沙语和科曼奇语：科曼奇人本是肖肖尼人的一个群体，约1700年迁入南部平原，其方言才渐渐与肖肖尼话互不相通。

这些语言都源自原始努米克语，其使用者约在一千年前开始从内华达山脉南部向外扩散。肖肖尼话传统上没有文字，靠口传叙事和歌谣传承。

en:
Shu, or Ba-Shu Chinese, was the Chinese speech of the Sichuan Basin from the Han dynasty to the Mongol conquest. It was noted as a distinct regional language in the Fangyan, compiled in the Western Han.

One of the earliest branches to split from Old Chinese, it diverged even earlier than Min and, like it, did not descend from Middle Chinese. In 1236 the Mongols sacked Chengdu, and by the final Song defeat of 1279 the basin had been depopulated and the old language's transmission was broken.

Under the Ming and Qing dynasties, settlers from Huguang and other provinces brought the speech that developed into Southwestern Mandarin. Ancient Shu died out, although the Minjiang dialects of southern Sichuan kept part of its vocabulary and phonology.
zh:
蜀语又称巴蜀语，是汉代至蒙古征服期间通行于四川盆地的汉语分支。西汉编成的《方言》已将蜀地口语记为独特的方言。

它是从上古汉语最早分化出的支系之一，与闽语一样不源自中古汉语，且分化时间比闽语更早。1236年蒙古军攻陷成都，到1279年南宋灭亡时，四川盆地人口已大幅减少，蜀语传承遭到重创。

此后明清两代，湖广等地移民带来的方言演变为西南官话。古蜀方言就此绝迹，川西南的岷江话保留了它的部分词汇与音韵特征。

en:
Siar is an Oceanic language of the southern tip of New Ireland, whose speakers call their tongue ep warwar anun dat, meaning 'our language'. It belongs to the Patpatar-Tolai group of the Meso-Melanesian linkage, a cluster of closely related Austronesian speech covering southern New Ireland and nearby islands.

The group includes Patpatar on the east coast, Kandas along the south-western coast, and Tangga on the Tanga and Feni islands, whose varieties are so divergent that their speakers treat them as distinct languages while recalling a common migration. Across Saint George's Channel the same linkage includes Tolai on New Britain.

Siar villagers live by fishing and gardening in a region first settled by Lapita seafarers; European contact began when Dutch explorers charted New Ireland in 1616, and whaling ships were calling along the coast by the 1790s.
zh:
西亚尔语是新爱尔兰岛南端的一种大洋洲语言，使用者把自己的语言称作ep warwar anun dat，意为“我们的语言”。它属于中美拉尼西亚语链下的帕特帕塔尔—托莱语群，这一亲缘相近的南岛语集群分布在新爱尔兰岛南部及附近岛屿。

其中包括东海岸的帕特帕塔尔语、西南沿海的坎达斯语，以及坦加和费尼群岛上的坦加语。坦加语各变体差异很大，使用者视其为不同语言，但仍记得共同的迁徙渊源。隔着圣乔治海峡，同一语链还包括新不列颠岛上的托莱语。

西亚尔人的村落以捕鱼和园圃为生，所在地区最早由拉皮塔航海者定居；欧洲人的接触始于1616年荷兰探险者测绘新爱尔兰岛，到18世纪90年代已有捕鲸船沿岸停靠。

en:
Sie, also called Erromangan or Sye, is the Oceanic language of Erromango, the largest island in the Tafea group of southern Vanuatu, and the principal survivor of the indigenous languages once spoken there. Erromango was first settled around three thousand years ago by Lapita voyagers, whose speech evolved in relative isolation into the island's dialects.

James Cook made the first European landing there in 1774, and from 1804 whalers and, after 1825, sandalwood traders brought regular outside contact; the sandalwood rush of 1830, which included a Hawaiian attempt to seize the island, disrupted village life. Sie had no traditional writing and remained a spoken language throughout this period.
zh:
希耶语又称埃罗芒奥语，是南瓦努阿图塔菲亚地区最大岛屿埃罗芒奥岛的大洋洲语言，也是岛上本土语言中最主要的幸存者。约三千年前，拉皮塔航海者最先定居埃罗芒奥岛，他们的语言在相对隔绝中演变为岛上的各方言。

1774年，詹姆斯·库克首次在岛上登陆；1804年起捕鲸船、1825年起檀木商人相继带来持续的外来接触，1830年的檀木热潮（其中包括夏威夷人夺取该岛的企图）打乱了村落生活。希耶语没有传统文字，在这一时期始终是口语。

en: Sihni, or Itonama, is the language of the Itonama people of the Bolivian Amazon, formerly spoken along the Itonomas River in the Beni lowlands and treated as a language isolate. The Itonama were first reached by Spaniards in the seventeenth century, and its last speakers lived in the town of Magdalena.
zh: 西尼语又称伊托纳马语，是玻利维亚亚马逊地区伊托纳马人的语言，曾通行于贝尼低地的伊托诺马斯河一带，被视为孤立语言。伊托纳马人在17世纪首次与西班牙人接触，该语言最后的使用者住在马格达莱纳镇。

en:
Siksiká, also called Niitsí'powahsin, is the Algonquian language of the Niitsitapi, the Blackfoot peoples of the northwestern Great Plains. It is among the westernmost and most divergent of Algonquian languages, with a polysynthetic grammar in which whole sentences may be folded into a single verb. Its four dialects, Siksiká, Kainai, Northern Piegan and Southern Piegan, belong to the nations of the Blackfoot Confederacy.

The Niitsitapi took to horses acquired from other Plains tribes by the early 1700s, and the language was carried across the grasslands by bison-hunting bands that gathered each summer for the Okan, the Sun Dance. European traders reached them only in the later eighteenth century.
zh:
西克西卡语又称尼齐波瓦辛，是北美大平原西北部黑脚人（尼齐塔皮人）的阿尔冈昆语言。它是分布最西、与其他阿尔冈昆语言差异最大的语言之一，语法为多式综合语，整句话可以糅进一个动词。它分西克西卡、凯奈、北皮埃甘和南皮埃甘四种方言，分属黑脚联盟的各部族。

黑脚人在18世纪初已从其他平原部族那里获得马匹，操西克西卡语的野牛狩猎队伍驰骋草原，每年夏季聚集举行奥坎仪式，即太阳舞。欧洲商人迟至18世纪后期才与他们接触。

en:
Sinaugoro is an Oceanic language of the Central Papuan Tip group, one of the Sinagoro–Keapara languages alongside Hula and Keapara, and a close relative of Motu, the speech of the Port Moresby coast. It is spoken in the coastal villages of the Rigo District, immediately east of the Motu homeland.

The two peoples shared the trading world of the hiri, voyages in which seagoing canoes carried Motu clay pots west to the Gulf of Papua and brought back sago. Over the centuries such contacts turned a simplified form of Motu into the region's trade tongue.

In 1606 the Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres sailed along this southern coast of New Guinea, the first Europeans known to have done so.
zh:
西瑙戈罗语是中巴布亚尖端语组的一支大洋语，与胡拉语、凯阿帕拉语同属西瑙戈罗—凯阿帕拉语群，并与莫尔兹比港沿岸的摩图语是近亲。它通行于里戈区的沿海村落，就在摩图人故乡以东。

两个族群共处希里贸易圈：远洋独木舟载着摩图陶罐向西运往巴布亚湾，再换回西谷椰。数百年间，这类接触使一种简化的摩图语演变成当地的贸易用语。

1606年，西班牙人路易斯·瓦埃斯·德·托雷斯的探险队沿新几内亚南部海岸航行，这是已知欧洲人第一次来到这里。

en:
Sindhi is an Indo-Aryan language spoken along the lower Indus, in the region of Sindh after which it is named; the word itself goes back to the Sanskrit síndhu, the ancient name of the Indus. Like other north Indian languages it descends from Sanskrit through the Prakrits and the later Apabhramsha stage.

After the Arab conquest of Sindh in 712 it became the first Indo-Aryan language in sustained contact with Arabic and Persian, absorbing a large stock of loanwords and adopting the Perso-Arabic script.

Early written literature was sparse: Isma'ili devotional hymns from the eleventh century used a related idiom, while from the late fifteenth century Sufi poets such as Qazi Qadan composed in Sindhi itself, a tradition crowned in the eighteenth century by the mystic verses of Shah Abdul Latif Bhittai.
zh:
信德语是印度—雅利安语支的语言，通行于印度河下游的信德地区，并因此得名；其名称可追溯至梵语中印度河的古称“信度”。与北印度其他语言一样，它由梵语经俗语和后来的阿帕布拉姆沙阶段演变而来。

712年阿拉伯人征服信德后，信德语成为最早长期接触阿拉伯语和波斯语的印度—雅利安语言，吸收了大量借词并采用波斯—阿拉伯字母。

早期书面文献不多：11世纪伊斯玛仪派的虔诚赞美诗使用一种与信德语相近的语体；15世纪末起，加齐·卡丹等苏菲派诗人开始直接以信德语创作，这一传统在18世纪沙阿·阿卜杜勒·拉蒂夫·比塔伊的神秘主义诗篇中达到高峰。

en:
Sinhala is the Indo-Aryan language of the Sinhalese, the majority people of Sri Lanka; with Maldivian of the Maldives it forms the Insular Indo-Aryan group, both descending from the ancient Elu Prakrit. The chronicle Mahavamsa traces them to settlers from eastern India's Kalinga and Magadha, and the earliest records are third-century-BCE rock inscriptions in a Prakrit close to Magadhi. Its history runs through four stages: Elu Prakrit until the fourth century CE, Proto-Sinhala until the eighth, medieval Sinhala until the thirteenth, and the modern stage thereafter. Contact with Tamil speakers and the island's Vedda people left a Dravidian and Vedda substrate. Its closest kin Maldivian, attested on twelfth-century copper plates, has used the Thaana script since the sixteenth century.

More than fifteen hundred verses on the mirror wall at Sigiriya, dated to the eighth through tenth centuries, are the only surviving poetry of the Anuradhapura age; the Kotte court that united the island in 1450 patronized the bird-named sandesha messenger poems of its monk-poets. Its Brahmi-derived abugida, akin to the Grantha script, also serves the liturgical Pali, and its literary and spoken registers differ sharply in a classic case of diglossia. Printing came under the Dutch: a Colombo press of 1734 issued Sinhala gospels, and British-era Bible societies produced fresh translations in 1823 and 1833.
zh:
僧伽罗语是斯里兰卡主体民族僧伽罗人的印度—雅利安语言，与马尔代夫的迪维希语同属岛屿印度—雅利安语群，二者都由古老的僧伽罗俗语（又称埃鲁俗语）演化而来。编年史《大史》把僧伽罗人的源头追溯到来自东印度羯陵伽和摩揭陀的移民；现存最早的记录是公元前3世纪的岩石铭文，所用俗语接近摩揭陀俗语。它的历史分为四个阶段：4世纪以前的僧伽罗俗语、4至8世纪的原始僧伽罗语、8至13世纪的中世纪僧伽罗语，以及13世纪以后的阶段。与泰米尔人及岛上维达人的长期接触，使它带有达罗毗荼语和维达语底层。它最近的亲属迪维希语最早见于12世纪的铜版铭文，16世纪起采用它拿字母。

锡吉里耶镜墙上留存着一千五百多首8至10世纪的题诗，是阿努拉德普勒时代唯一存世的诗歌；1450年统一全岛的科特王朝朝廷供养了一批诗僧，写下以鹦鹉、鹩哥等禽鸟命名的信使诗。僧伽罗语使用源出婆罗米文的元音附标文字，与南印度的格兰塔文相近，也用于书写礼仪语言巴利语；其书面语与口语分歧显著，是双层语言现象的典型。印刷术随荷兰人到来：1734年科伦坡的印刷所印出僧伽罗语福音书，英国统治时期的圣经会又于1823年和1833年推出新译本。

en:
Sintu, also called siNtu or the Southern Bantu languages, is the broad family of Bantu speech covering southeastern Africa, from the Makhuwa coast of northern Mozambique and the Shona lands of the Zimbabwe plateau to the Nguni, Sotho and Tswa-Ronga tongues of South Africa. Its name joins the prefix that marks a language to the common Bantu word for a person, ntu.

Proto-Southern Bantu was spoken sometime after 1000 where South Africa, Botswana, Zimbabwe and Mozambique meet, as farmers spread across the region; Nguni speakers had reached the southeastern coast before the 1500s.

Contact with Khoisan herders and hunters left its mark on the southern languages, above all the click consonants heard in Xhosa and Zulu. These were oral languages until missionaries gave them Roman alphabets: the first printed Xhosa works appeared from the Lovedale press in 1823.
zh:
辛图语又称南班图语支，是班图语之下的一大语群，覆盖非洲东南部：北起莫桑比克北部沿海的马库阿语，经津巴布韦高原的绍纳语，南至南非的恩古尼语、索托语和茨瓦—龙加诸语。它的名字由表示语言的前缀与班图诸语中意为“人”的词根组合而成。

原始南班图语在1000年之后通行于南非、博茨瓦纳、津巴布韦与莫桑比克交界一带，伴随农人扩散开来；1500年代以前，恩古尼人已经抵达东南沿海。

与科伊桑牧人、猎人的接触在南部诸语中留下印记，最突出的便是科萨语和祖鲁语里的吸气辅音。这些语言长期只有口头传统，直到传教士为它们配上拉丁字母：1823年，洛夫代尔印刷所印出了最早的科萨语读物。

en:
Zenu, also called Sinú or Sinúfana, was the language of the Zenú chiefdoms of the Caribbean lowlands of northern South America, spoken in the Sinú and San Jorge river valleys. It is poorly documented and has no surviving written texts.

Before the Spanish conquest it was the dominant tongue of Zenú territory, whose farming towns used canals and raised terraces to manage the annual floods, and whose goldsmiths placed finely worked gold in graves. That funeral gold drew the conquistadors: between 1510 and 1535 the chiefdoms were broken by warfare and epidemic disease, and their tombs were systematically looted.

In 1773 the Spanish crown set aside the reserve of San Andrés de Sotavento for the Zenú, but the language continued to lose ground to Spanish, ceasing to be a living tongue around the opening of the nineteenth century.
zh:
塞努语又称西努语或西努法纳语，是南美北部加勒比低地塞努酋长国的语言，通行于塞努河、圣豪尔赫河流域。它的记录非常稀少，也没有流传下来的书面文本。

在西班牙征服之前，它是塞努土地上占主导地位的语言；那里的农耕村镇靠水渠和高台梯田治理每年的洪水，金匠还把精工制作的金器随死者下葬。正是这些随葬金器引来了征服者：1510—1535年间，各酋长国被战争和瘟疫摧毁，墓葬遭到有组织的盗掘。

1773年西班牙王室为塞努人划出了索塔文托的圣安德烈斯保留地，但塞努语在西班牙语的挤压下不断萎缩，到19世纪初已不再是一种活的语言。

en:
Skarureh, better known as Tuscarora, is the Iroquoian language of the Tuscarora people; together with its close Virginian cousin Nottoway, it forms a peripheral branch of Northern Iroquoian. Its name means the hemp people or the long-shirt people, and before European contact its speakers lived in the coastal plain of North Carolina, farming in matrilineal clans.

Defeat in the Tuscarora War of 1711 to 1713 against British colonists and their native allies broke their power: most surviving Tuscarora drifted north over several generations into Pennsylvania and New York, where in 1722 the Oneida sponsored their admission as the sixth nation of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy.

Their kinsmen the Nottoway remained in Virginia, where their language dwindled; nearly all that was preserved of it comes from a vocabulary taken down in 1820 from an elderly Nottoway woman named Edith Turner.
zh:
斯卡鲁雷语即更广为人知的塔斯卡洛拉语，是塔斯卡洛拉人的易洛魁语言，与它在弗吉尼亚的近亲诺托韦语一起，构成北易洛魁语的一个外围分支。它的名字意为“麻人”或“穿长衣的人”；在欧洲人到来之前，使用者生活在北卡罗来纳沿海平原，以母系氏族农耕为生。

1711—1713年与英国殖民者及其原住民盟友交战的塔斯卡洛拉战争失败后，他们的势力瓦解：幸存的塔斯卡洛拉人在几代人的时间里陆续北迁，进入宾夕法尼亚和纽约，1722年经奥奈达人引荐，被接纳为易洛魁联盟的第六族。

他们的亲族诺托韦人留在弗吉尼亚，其语言日渐凋零，留存下来的材料几乎全部来自1820年从一位名叫伊迪丝·特纳的诺托韦老妇那里采录的词表。

en:
Songhai is the dialect chain of the middle Niger bend, spoken from Gao and Timbuktu downriver to Niamey and the Benin border. Its kinship with the Saharan languages is disputed, some linguists treating it as an independent family.

Before the 900s horse-riding Songhay speakers imposed their speech on peoples of the river; a kingdom at Gao is attested from the 1000s. Conquered by Mali in the late 1200s, Gao broke away as Mali weakened. Under Sonni Ali, the empire seized Timbuktu in 1468 and Djenné in 1475, carrying the language across the Sahel as a trade lingua franca.

Under Askia Muhammad I, a few Songhai poems and letters were written in Arabic script at Timbuktu. Judar Pasha destroyed the empire at Tondibi in 1591; the elite withdrew to Dendi, while Songhai lived on as the everyday and market speech of the Niger bend.
zh:
桑海语是尼日尔河中游河曲一带的方言群，从加奥、廷巴克图沿河南下到尼亚美和贝宁边境都有通行。它与撒哈拉语族的亲缘关系尚有争议，部分语言学家把它视为独立语族。

10世纪之前，骑马的桑海人把自己的语言强加给河畔各族，以加奥为中心的王国在11世纪已见记载。13世纪末加奥被马里征服，马里衰落后重新独立。桑尼·阿里统治下，帝国于1468年夺取廷巴克图、1475年夺取杰内，桑海语随之成为萨赫勒商贸的通用语。

阿斯基亚·穆罕默德一世统治下，廷巴克图留有少量用阿拉伯字母写成的桑海语诗歌和书信。1591年朱达尔·帕夏在汤迪比摧毁帝国；统治精英南撤至登迪，桑海语则作为尼日尔河曲日常与集市的语言延续下来。

en:
South Arabic is the game's name for the Modern South Arabian languages, a branch of South Semitic spoken along the southern edge of Arabia, in Yemen and the Omani coast of Dhofar, rather than a dialect of Arabic itself. Its chief members include Mehri of the Mahra region and Soqotri, confined to the island of Socotra.

Together with the ancient Sabaean tongue and the languages of Ethiopia they form the South Semitic group. These languages were spoken in the peninsula before the spread of Arabic with Islam in the 600s, and long bilingualism with Arabic followed.

They remain mainly spoken languages with oral poetry and little written literature; when written, an adapted Arabic alphabet is used. The tenth-century geographer al-Hamdani described Mehri as a speech far removed from classical Arabic.
zh:
南阿拉伯语是游戏对一组南阿拉伯语言的称呼，它们属于南闪米特语支，通行于阿拉伯半岛南缘的也门以及阿曼佐法尔沿海，并不是阿拉伯语的方言。其主要成员包括迈赫拉地区的迈赫拉语和只在索科特拉岛使用的索科特拉语。

它们与古代赛伯伊语、埃塞俄比亚诸语言同属南闪米特群体。7世纪阿拉伯语随伊斯兰教传播之前，这些语言就已通行于半岛，此后长期与阿拉伯语并用。

它们以口头语言为主，有口传诗歌而书面文学极少，书写时采用经过改造的阿拉伯字母。10世纪的地理学家哈姆达尼曾说迈赫拉语与古典阿拉伯语相距甚远。

en:
The South Cushitic, or Rift, languages form a branch of the Cushitic family surviving mainly in the Great Rift Valley of northern Tanzania. Their speakers descend from agro-pastoralists whose proto-language was home in south-western Ethiopia; they entered northern Tanzania early in the second millennium BC, introducing agriculture and cattle-keeping east of Lake Victoria.

Long contact with Khoisan hunter-gatherers left click-like ejective consonants in several Rift languages. As Bantu and then Nilotic peoples spread, most South Cushitic communities were absorbed; some tongues are known only from loanwords in the Bantu languages that replaced them. The surviving languages include Iraqw, the largest, in the highlands.

Iraqw tradition credits its ancestors with the stone-walled irrigation complex at Engaruka, abandoned around 1700 to 1750 amid pressure from Datog and Maasai herders. The Iraqw then withdrew to the intensive farming country of the Mbulu highlands.
zh:
南库希特语又称裂谷语，是库希特语族的一支，主要保存在坦桑尼亚北部的东非大裂谷一带。其使用者是农牧族群的后裔，原始母语的故乡在埃塞俄比亚西南部；他们在公元前第二千纪早期进入坦桑尼亚北部，把农业和畜牧带到维多利亚湖以东地区。

与科伊桑狩猎采集者长期接触，在几种裂谷语里留下了类似啧音的挤喉辅音。随着班图人、随后是尼罗特人扩散，大多数南库希特社群被同化；有些语言只能从取代它们的班图语借词中觅得踪迹。保存下来的语言包括高原上使用人数最多的伊拉奎语。

伊拉奎人的口述传统把恩加鲁卡的石砌灌溉遗址归功于自己的祖先；在达托加人和马赛牧民的压力下，该遗址约于1700—1750年被废弃。伊拉奎人此后退守姆布卢高原的精耕农业区。

en:
The Italian group, known to scholars as the Italo-Dalmatian languages, also takes in the islands and the vernaculars once spoken on the Dalmatian coast. Its languages descend from Vulgar Latin; the earliest surviving Romance vernacular text, the Placiti Cassinesi of 960 to 963, comes from near Benevento.

Sicilian holds the oldest literary tradition: the Sicilian School of 1230 to 1266, led by Giacomo da Lentini at Emperor Frederick II's Palermo court, forged the first Italian literary language and the sonnet. Primacy passed to Florentine Tuscan with Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio in the fourteenth century. The Renaissance debate favoured Pietro Bembo's Florentine standard and the first Italian dictionary appeared in 1612.

Dalmatian served the merchant republic of Ragusa until the late fifteenth century, then yielded to Venetian and Croatian. Sardinian was used in medieval judicates before Catalan and Castilian gained prestige.
zh:
这组语言即学界所称的意大利—达尔马提亚语支，还包括各岛屿，以及一度通行于达尔马提亚海岸的语言。它们源自通俗拉丁语，现存最早的意大利通俗语文本是960—963年在贝内文托附近写下的法律文书。

西西里语拥有最古老的文学传统：1230—1266年，皇帝腓特烈二世的巴勒莫宫廷中，雅各布·达·伦蒂尼领导的西西里诗派创立了第一种意大利文学语言和十四行诗。14世纪，但丁、彼特拉克和薄伽丘使用佛罗伦萨方言，文学主导权转入托斯卡纳。文艺复兴时期的语言之争采纳了彼得罗·本博主张的佛罗伦萨标准，1612年第一部意大利语词典问世。

达尔马提亚语曾用于拉古萨商业共和国，15世纪末后被威尼斯语和克罗地亚语排挤。撒丁语曾用于中世纪执政官政权，后来的上层语言是加泰罗尼亚语和卡斯蒂利亚语。

official_raw.en: This is the name for the group of languages that cover the mid and southern part of the Italian Peninsula.
official_raw.zh: 这是覆盖意大利半岛中南部的语言群组。

en:
Spanish, also called Castilian after the Kingdom of Castile where it took shape, descends from the Vulgar Latin the Romans brought to the Iberian Peninsula. Its first written traces are Romance glosses added to Latin manuscripts around the tenth and eleventh centuries. As the Reconquista pushed south, Castilian spread with it, absorbing Arabic words from Al-Andalus and features of Mozarabic speech.

In the thirteenth century Alfonso X the Wise made Castilian the language of his Toledo chancery and of works of history and science, creating the first written standard. Antonio de Nebrija presented its first grammar to Queen Isabella in 1492.

Carried across the Atlantic by conquest and settlement, Spanish became the speech of an American empire. Its American varieties draw mainly on Andalusian and Canarian dialects and borrowed indigenous words. The Royal Spanish Academy was founded in 1713.
zh:
西班牙语又称卡斯蒂利亚语，得名于它的诞生地卡斯蒂利亚王国，源出罗马人带到伊比利亚半岛的通俗拉丁语。现存最早的书面痕迹是10至11世纪间加在拉丁文抄本行间的罗曼语批注。随着收复失地运动向南推进，卡斯蒂利亚方言也传播开来，从安达卢斯吸收阿拉伯语词汇，并受到莫扎拉布语的影响。

13世纪，智者阿方索十世把卡斯蒂利亚语用于托莱多的王宫文书以及历史和科学著作，确立了最早的书面规范。1492年，安东尼奥·德·内布里哈向伊莎贝拉女王进呈了第一部西班牙语语法。

随着征服与殖民，西班牙语被带到大西洋彼岸，成为美洲帝国的语言。美洲各变体主要源自安达卢西亚和加那利方言，并借入原住民语言的词汇。1713年西班牙皇家语言学院成立。

en:
Suau, also called Iou, is an Oceanic language of the Papuan Tip cluster, head of the Suauic linkage that also includes Saliba and Buhutu. It is spoken in the coastal villages and small islands of Milne Bay Province at the southeastern tip of New Guinea, and beyond its home villages it serves as a regional lingua franca along the surrounding coasts.

The people of these shores live from fishing, sago and garden plots, and were among the first populations of the island's southeast to meet Europeans: in July 1606 the Spanish expedition of Luis Vaez de Torres surveyed Milne Bay while sailing westward through the strait that bears his name.
zh:
苏奥语又称伊奥乌语，是巴布亚尖端语群的一支大洋语，统领苏奥语链，萨利巴语和布胡图语等也在这一语链中。它通行于新几内亚东南端米尔恩湾省的沿海村落和小岛，并在母语村落之外充当周围海岸的地区通用语。

当地居民以捕鱼、西谷椰和园圃为生，也是新几内亚东南部最早接触欧洲人的族群之一：1606年7月，西班牙人路易斯·瓦埃斯·德·托雷斯的探险队在向西穿过以他的名字命名的海峡时，测绘了米尔恩湾。

en:
The Sumba grouping covers languages once classed as the Bima-Sumba branch of Central Malayo-Polynesian Austronesian. They stretch across the Lesser Sunda Islands, from eastern Sumbawa to Flores, Sumba and Savu, where Hawu may preserve a non-Austronesian substratum. Later linguists split the old branch into Sumba-Hawu and Sumba-Flores groups and treat Bimanese separately.

The Hindu-Buddhist kingdom of Bima on Sumbawa traced its origins to around 709. Around 1515 the Portuguese apothecary Tome Pires listed its cloth, horses and slaves among regional exports. Sumba, whose megalithic burials reach back millennia, was claimed by Majapahit in the 1300s and visited by the Portuguese in 1522.

Bima turned to Islam in 1621 under the influence of the Makassarese kingdom of Gowa and as a sultanate long drew tribute from Manggarai, Sumba, Sawu and parts of Flores. From the 1600s the Dutch East India Company tightened its hold on the region.
zh:
松巴语涵盖旧分类中合称比马—松巴语支的一组中马来—波利尼西亚南岛语言，分布于小巽他群岛，从松巴哇岛东部到弗洛勒斯、松巴和萨武诸岛皆在其中，萨武的哈武语可能保留了非南岛语底层。后世语言学家把旧语支拆成松巴—哈武和松巴—弗洛勒斯两个语群，并把比马语单列。

松巴哇岛上印度教—佛教色彩的比马王国起源可追溯到709年前后。1515年前后，葡萄牙药剂师托梅·皮莱资把当地的布匹、马匹和奴隶列入区域出口货单。松巴岛的巨石墓葬传统延续数千年，14世纪被满者伯夷列为藩属，1522年葡萄牙人到访。

1621年，比马在望加锡戈瓦王国影响下皈依伊斯兰教，成为苏丹国，长期向芒加莱、松巴、萨武及弗洛勒斯部分地区收取贡赋。17世纪起，荷兰东印度公司逐步加强了对这一地区的控制。

en:
Sumuri, also called Sumeri, is a Papuan language spoken on the northern coast of the Bomberai Peninsula in western New Guinea, around Tofoi on Bintuni Bay. Its classification is unsettled: some scholars treat it as an independent branch of the Trans–New Guinea family, while others regard it as a language isolate.

Birds of paradise feathers reached Srivijaya in the seventh century, and the fourteenth-century Javanese poem Nagarakretagama names nearby Onin and Sran as tributaries of Majapahit, the earliest written mention of Papuan places. The Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres sighted the coast in 1606; it later fell within Tidore's sphere, whose hongi fleets raided it for slaves and tribute.

The Dutch built Fort Du Bus in 1828 to formalise their protectorate over Tidore's Papuan dependencies. The post was abandoned in 1835, leaving Sumuri country under loose indirect rule.
zh:
苏穆里语又作苏梅里语，是巴布亚语言，通行于新几内亚西部邦巴赖半岛北海岸、宾图尼湾沿岸的托福伊一带。它的分类尚无定论：一些学者把它列为跨新几内亚语系下独立的一支，另一些学者则视其为孤立语言。

7世纪时，当地的极乐鸟羽毛已远销室利佛逝；14世纪的爪哇史诗《爪哇史颂》把附近的奥宁和斯兰地区列为满者伯夷的朝贡地，这是巴布亚地名最早的文字记载。1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯率领的西班牙探险队望见这段海岸；此后它被纳入蒂多雷势力范围，蒂多雷的洪伊船队常来掠夺奴隶和贡物。

1828年，荷兰人修建杜布斯堡，以正式确立对蒂多雷治下巴布亚属地的保护权。这座据点于1835年废弃，苏穆里地区此后仍处于松散的间接统治之下。

en:
Sundanese is the Malayo-Polynesian language of the Sundanese people, native to western Java in the region called Tatar Sunda or Pasundan. Although surrounded by Javanese, it is classified with the Malayic languages and the Land Dayak and Kayan-Murik groups of Borneo.

From the age of Tarumanagara, whose fifth-century Ciaruteun inscription of King Purnawarman was incised in Pallava script and drew heavily on Sanskrit, it served as the language of Sundanese courts, including the Hindu kingdom of Pajajaran, which lasted from 932 to about 1579. Old Sundanese was used for religious and historical manuscripts.

It was first written in the Old Sundanese script; after the spread of Islam the Arabic-based Pegon alphabet joined it, and in colonial times the Latin alphabet became dominant. Sundanese remained the everyday speech of western Java through the Mataram conquests and the Dutch colonial period.
zh:
巽他语是巽他人的马来—波利尼西亚语，通行于爪哇岛西部称做巽他之地的帕巽丹地区。它虽与爪哇语相邻，分类上却与马来语群以及婆罗洲的陆地达雅、卡扬—穆里克语群相近。

多罗磨时代，5世纪普尔纳瓦尔曼王的查鲁顿碑文以帕拉瓦文刻写，深受梵文影响；此后巽他语是巽他宫廷的语言，包括932年至约1579年存在的印度教王国巴查查兰。古巽他语用于撰写宗教与历史手稿。

它最早以古巽他字母书写，伊斯兰教传入后又出现以阿拉伯字母为基础的佩贡字母，殖民时代拉丁字母成为主流。历经马打兰的征服与荷兰殖民时期，巽他语始终是西爪哇的日常语言。

en:
Swahili, or Kiswahili, is a Bantu language of the Sabaki branch, native to the Swahili people of the East African coast and its islands. Indian Ocean trade with Arab and Persian merchants gave it a large Arabic word-stock; the name itself comes from an Arabic word meaning of the coast.

It grew into a regional lingua franca in trading city-states such as Kilwa, founded in the 800s, whose sultanate dominated the coast from the thirteenth to the fifteenth century and which the traveller Ibn Battuta praised in 1331. Portuguese fleets sacked Kilwa in 1505 and added their own loanwords, yet Swahili continued to spread along caravan routes.

It was written in Arabic script. The epic Utendi wa Tambuka, composed by Bwana Mwengo wa Athman in 1728, is among its earliest surviving literary works.
zh:
斯瓦希里语又称基斯瓦希里语，属班图语的萨巴基语支，母语者为东非沿海及岛屿上的斯瓦希里人。印度洋贸易使它从阿拉伯和波斯商人那里吸收了大量阿拉伯语词汇，其名称本身就来自一个意为海岸的阿拉伯词。

它在基尔瓦等贸易城邦成长为地区通用语：基尔瓦建于9世纪，其苏丹国在13至15世纪称雄沿海，旅行家伊本·白图泰曾于1331年盛赞这座城市。1505年葡萄牙舰队洗劫基尔瓦，并给斯瓦希里语留下借词，但该语言仍沿商路继续传播。

它以阿拉伯字母书写。布瓦纳·姆文戈·瓦·阿斯曼于1728年创作的史诗《坦布卡的故事》是现存最早的斯瓦希里语文学作品之一。

en:
Arawakan, also called Maipurean, is one of the largest and most widely spread language families of the Americas, carried by peoples from the eastern slopes of the Andes across the Amazon basin to the Guianas, Venezuela and Colombia, and as far north as Central America and the Caribbean.

Some 2,500 years ago Arawakan speakers reached the Antilles and the Bahamas, where their Caribbean branch, Ta-Arawak, produced Taíno, the language of Cuba, Hispaniola, Puerto Rico and Jamaica. Mainland languages included Lokono, Wayuu and Caquetio, while inland branches included the Campa languages of the pre-Andean foothills.

The family was first recognized in 1782, when the Italian priest Filippo Gilii showed that the Maipure of the Orinoco and the Moxos of Bolivia were related. Its languages are polysynthetic and head-marking, with elaborate verb morphology built mainly through suffixes.
zh:
阿拉瓦克语又称迈普雷语，是美洲规模最大、分布最广的语族之一：使用者分布于安第斯山脉东坡，横跨亚马孙盆地，直达圭亚那、委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚，北至中美洲和加勒比海。

约2500年前，阿拉瓦克诸语的使用者抵达安的列斯群岛和巴哈马，其加勒比分支塔—阿拉瓦克语衍生出泰诺语，通行于古巴、伊斯帕尼奥拉、波多黎各和牙买加。大陆语言包括洛科诺语、瓦尤语和卡克蒂奥语，内陆分支则包括安第斯山麓的坎帕诸语。

1782年，意大利教士菲利波·吉利最早确认该语族的亲缘关系，证明奥里诺科河的迈普雷语与玻利维亚的莫霍斯语同出一源。这些语言属多式综合语、以词头标注为主，复杂的动词形态主要靠后缀构成。

en:
Tabaristani gathers together the Northwestern Iranian vernaculars of the southern Caspian shore and the Semnan highlands: the Caspian languages, chiefly Gilaki and Mazanderani, also called Tabari, and the Semnani group. The name comes from Tabaristan, the medieval term for the mountain kingdom of Mazandaran, known in antiquity as Tapuria.

In the 900s the geographer al-Muqaddasi noted the distinctive speech of Tabaristan. Under local rulers after the Arab invasion, Mazanderani carried a written literature from the 900s to the 1400s, including the mirror-for-princes work Marzban Nameh and the verse of Amir Pazevari.

These tongues keep archaic Median and Parthian features and share structures with South Caucasian languages. Their literary and administrative use faded after Mazandaran entered the royal administration in the early 1600s, leaving Persian as the language of writing.
zh:
塔巴里斯坦语是对里海南岸与塞姆南高地诸西北伊朗方言的统称，包括以吉拉基语和又称塔巴里语的马赞德兰语为主的里海诸语言，以及塞姆南语群。其名来自塔巴里斯坦，即马赞德兰山区政权在中世纪的称呼，上古时称塔普里亚。

10世纪，地理学家穆卡达西就注意到塔巴里斯坦方言的独特之处。阿拉伯入侵后，在当地统治者治下，马赞德兰语在10至15世纪发展出书面文学，包括王侯镜鉴之书《马尔兹班纳梅》和阿米尔·帕泽瓦里的诗歌。

这些语言保留了古老的米底语和帕提亚语特征，还与南高加索语言共有一些结构。17世纪初马赞德兰被纳入王室行政体系后，它们在文学和行政上的使用日渐衰落，书面领域让位于波斯语。

en:
Tagalog is a Central Philippine language of the Austronesian family, native to the plains around Manila Bay and Laguna de Bay in southern Luzon; its name may mean river dweller, from taga-ilog. Possible Old Tagalog words survive in the tenth-century Laguna Copperplate Inscription, and before Spanish rule Tagalogs wrote in baybayin, a syllabic script.

The first complete printed book in the language, the Doctrina Christiana of 1593, appeared in both baybayin and an early Latin orthography. Spanish missionaries printed its first grammar in 1610 and compiled its first dictionary in 1613.

Three centuries of Spanish rule added a large Romance vocabulary while the Latin alphabet displaced baybayin. The early nineteenth century produced the poet Francisco Balagtas, whose epic Florante at Laura became the cornerstone of Tagalog literature.
zh:
他加禄语是南岛语系菲律宾语支中部语群的语言，故乡在吕宋岛南部马尼拉湾和拉古纳湾周围的平原，其名称可能源自他加伊洛格，意为河边居民。10世纪的拉古纳铜版铭文里保留了可能属于古他加禄语的词汇；西班牙统治之前，他加禄人使用贝贝因音节文字。

1593年印行的《基督教教义》是第一部完整的他加禄语印本书，同时使用贝贝因文字和早期拉丁拼写法。西班牙传教士于1610年印出第一部语法书，1613年编成第一部词典。

三个世纪的西班牙统治带来了大量罗曼语词汇，拉丁字母也取代了贝贝因文字。19世纪初出现了诗人弗朗西斯科·巴拉格达斯，他的史诗《弗罗兰特与劳拉》成为他加禄文学的基石。

en:
Tai is a complex of closely related tonal, analytic languages and dialects of the Kra-Dai family, spoken in an arc from southern China to Laos, Thailand and the Shan hills of Myanmar. Its best-known members are Siamese, or Thai, Lao, Shan and Dai varieties such as Tai Lü and Tai Nüa, which shade into one another as a dialect continuum.

Southwestern Tai speakers moved out of southern China between the eighth and tenth centuries and founded chiefdoms and kingdoms in the Mekong and Chao Phraya valleys. They wrote in Brahmi-derived alphabets adapted from Mon and Khmer models, the earliest Thai inscriptions appearing at Sukhothai around 1292; the Zhuang used Chinese-derived Sawndip characters.

In the Ayutthaya kingdom of 1351 to 1767, Siamese absorbed many Khmer words. Theravada Buddhism carried in Pali and Sanskrit terms shared across the Tai world.
zh:
泰语是壮侗语系下一群关系紧密的声调型分析语言和方言的统称，分布呈弧形，从中国南方延伸到老挝、泰国和缅甸掸邦山区。最知名的成员有暹罗语（即泰国官方泰语）、老挝语、掸语，以及傣仂、傣那等傣语变体，彼此渐次过渡，构成方言连续体。

西南台语人群在8至10世纪间迁出中国南方，在湄公河和湄南河流域建立了诸多酋邦与王国。他们借用源自孟文、高棉文的婆罗米系字母书写，最早的泰文铭文约于1292年出现在素可泰；壮族则使用仿照汉字创制的方块壮字。

1351—1767年的阿瑜陀耶王国时期，暹罗语吸收了大量高棉语词汇。上座部佛教又带来了遍布台语世界的巴利语和梵语借词。

en:
Taíno, also called Island Arawak, is the extinct Arawakan language that by the late 1400s was the common speech of the Greater Antilles and the northern Lesser Antilles, from the Bahamas and Cuba across Hispaniola and Puerto Rico as far as Guadeloupe.

Its Classic dialect, expanding from around 1200, served as the lingua franca of the Indies. Columbus noted in 1492 that islanders traveling by canoe could understand one another throughout the archipelago.

As Spanish conquest advanced the language gave way to Spanish, English and French, but passed many words into European languages, among them canoe, hammock, hurricane, maize, cassava, potato, tobacco and savanna. Place names such as Borinquen, the old name of Puerto Rico, come from the language, and its closest living relative is the Wayuu tongue of the Guajira coast.
zh:
泰诺语又称岛屿阿拉瓦克语，是已经消亡的阿拉瓦克语言，到15世纪后期已是大安的列斯群岛和小安的列斯群岛北部的通用语言，通行范围从巴哈马、古巴横跨伊斯帕尼奥拉和波多黎各，远达瓜德罗普。

其经典方言约1200年起向外扩展，曾是西印度群岛的通用语。1492年哥伦布记载，群岛居民驾独木舟往来各处，彼此都能听懂对方的话。

随着西班牙征服推进，泰诺语逐渐被西班牙语、英语和法语取代，但它先已给欧洲语言留下一批借词，如独木舟、吊床、飓风、玉米、木薯、土豆、烟草和热带草原。波多黎各旧称博林肯等地名即出自该语言；与它亲缘最近的现存语言是瓜希拉海岸的瓦尤语。

en:
Takic is a proposed grouping of closely related languages in the northern branch of the Uto-Aztecan family, formerly spoken across coastal southern California, the Southern Channel Islands and inland through the Mojave Desert, Coachella Valley and Tehachapi Mountains. Its members included Tongva, Serrano, Cahuilla and Luiseño.

Archaeologists reconstruct a Takic expansion from a desert homeland in the western Mojave: Takic speakers moved south into coastal California thousands of years ago and absorbed or displaced older populations.

Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo met coastal Takic speakers in 1542, but sustained contact began after 1769, when Spanish missions such as San Gabriel and San Juan Capistrano were founded in their lands. Forced resettlement, epidemics and forced labour shattered the mission peoples, who rose in rebellions such as that led by the prophetess Toypurina in 1785. Mexico's secularization of the missions in the 1830s left most survivors landless.
zh:
塔基克语是犹他‑阿兹特克语系北支下一组关系相近的语言，其归并仍有争议，曾通行于南加州沿海、南海峡群岛，并深入莫哈韦沙漠、科切拉谷地和特哈查比山区，包括通瓦语、塞拉诺语、卡维拉语和路易塞尼奥语等。

考古学家推测，说塔基克语的人群数千年前从莫哈韦西部的沙漠故土向南迁徙，进入加州沿海，吸收或取代了更早的居民。

1542年胡安·罗德里格斯·卡布里略曾遇到沿海的塔基克语使用者，但持续接触要到1769年以后，西班牙人在他们的土地上建起圣加百列、圣胡安·卡皮斯特拉诺等传教站。强制迁徙、疫病和强制劳役摧毁了传教区的各族群，1785年女先知托伊普里纳领导的起义便是反抗之一。19世纪30年代墨西哥将传教站世俗化后，多数幸存者失去了土地。

en:
Tamambo, also called Malo, is an Oceanic language of Vanuatu, spoken on Malo island and neighboring islets off the southern coast of Espiritu Santo. Malo holds the earliest known Lapita culture settlement in Vanuatu, occupied around 1400 BC, and Tamambo is counted among the most conservative of the Southern Oceanic languages, retaining many features inherited from the speech of those first Austronesian settlers.

It has two dialects: the western dialect, whose form of the island's name gives the language its name Tamambo, and the eastern dialect called Tamapo, which had nearly died out by the twentieth century. Traditionally an unwritten language, Tamambo had no standard orthography.
zh:
塔曼博语又称马洛语，是瓦努阿图的一种大洋洲语，通行于圣埃斯皮里图岛南岸外的马洛岛及附近小岛。马洛岛拥有瓦努阿图已知最早的拉皮塔文化定居点，约公元前1400年便有人类居住；塔曼博语被视为最保守的南大洋洲语言之一，保留了这些最早的南岛定居者语言中的许多特征。

它分为两种方言：西部方言对岛名的读法即“塔曼博”一名的由来，东部方言称塔马波，到20世纪已近乎消亡。塔曼博语传统上没有文字，也没有标准拼写法。

en:
Tamazight, or the Berber languages, is the North African branch of the Afroasiatic family, spoken by the indigenous Amazigh peoples from Morocco to Egypt, with Tuareg varieties deep in the Sahara. Berber speakers spread from the Nile Valley into the Maghreb in the second millennium BC, and their ancestors built Numidia and Mauretania.

From around 600 BC their language was cut into rock and tombstone in the Libyco-Berber alphabet, whose Tuareg descendant, Tifinagh, remained in use among desert nomads. Arab conquests brought Islam and Arabization, yet Berber remained the speech of mountains and desert.

Berber dynasties ruled the Maghreb and al-Andalus, including the Almoravids, Almohads and Marinids; the Marinids held Fez in 1337. After their fall, Arabic gained ground in cities while Tuareg confederations kept Tamazight alive along trans-Saharan trade routes, preserving Tifinagh letters.
zh:
塔马齐格特语即柏柏尔诸语，是亚非语系在北非的一支，由原住民阿马齐格各族使用，分布从摩洛哥延至埃及，图阿雷格各变体更深入撒哈拉。说柏柏尔语的人群在公元前2千纪从尼罗河谷扩散进入马格里布，他们的先民建立了努米底亚和毛里塔尼亚等王国。

约公元前600年起，这种语言以利比亚—柏柏尔字母刻在岩壁和墓碑上，该文字的图阿雷格后裔提非纳文一直为沙漠游牧者所用。阿拉伯征服带来伊斯兰教和阿拉伯化，但柏柏尔语仍是山区和沙漠居民的语言。

柏柏尔人王朝统治马格里布和安达卢斯，包括穆拉比特、穆瓦希德和马林王朝，1337年马林王朝仍以非斯为都。王朝覆灭后，阿拉伯语在城市扩张，图阿雷格诸联盟则在跨撒哈拉商路沿线保住了塔马齐格特语和提非纳文字。

en:
The Upper Tami or Border languages are a small independent family of Papuan languages straddling the border between New Guinea's eastern and western halves, named after the Tami River in the island's far north.

Their three branches are Taikat, to which Awyi belongs; Bewani; and Waris. Unlike their Sepik neighbours, Border languages have no grammatical gender and no dual or plural number on nouns.

In the later 1700s Bewani speakers expanded rapidly out of their hills, setting off chain migrations that split the Kwomtari-speaking country in two, pushed the Fas into the swamps around Utai, and drove other groups down the Pual River until the newcomers were checked by fighting in the Kaure lands. These movements remade the linguistic map of the border country only a few generations before the first colonial patrols reached it.
zh:
上塔米语又称边境语，是巴布亚诸语言中一个独立的小语族，地跨新几内亚东西两部分之间的边境，因岛屿极北部的塔米河得名。

它分为三支：阿维语所属的塔伊卡特支、贝瓦尼支和瓦里斯支。与邻近的塞皮克诸语言不同，边境诸语言的名词没有语法性别，也没有双数、复数变化。

18世纪后期，贝瓦尼语使用者从山地迅速扩张，引发连锁迁徙，把科姆塔里语族群的地盘截成两段，把法斯人赶入乌泰一带的沼泽，又驱使其他族群沿普阿尔河而下，直到入侵者在考雷人土地上的战斗中受阻。这些迁徙重塑了边境地区的语言版图，而距首批殖民巡逻队抵达此地不过几代人的时间。

en:
Tamil is a southern Dravidian language, the mother tongue of the Tamil people of south-eastern India and northern and eastern Sri Lanka. Its Tamil-Brahmi inscriptions go back to about the third century BCE, and the Tolkāppiyam, a treatise on grammar and poetics dating to the late second century BCE, is its earliest surviving long text.

The Sangam academies of the first century BCE to the fifth century CE produced 2,381 poems on love, war and kingship. Old Tamil gave way to Middle Tamil by the eighth century, and the Nannūl grammar of the thirteenth century became the literary norm.

Tamil was the lingua franca of South Indian maritime traders, whose inscriptions were found in Egypt. It diverged from Malayalam in the thirteenth or fourteenth century. In 1578 Portuguese missionaries printed a Tamil prayer book, the first printed Indian-language book.
zh:
泰米尔语是达罗毗荼语族南支的语言，是印度东南部及斯里兰卡北部和东部泰米尔人的母语。泰米尔—婆罗米字母铭文可上溯至公元前3世纪左右，现存最早的长篇典籍是成于公元前2世纪末的语法与诗学著作《托尔卡皮耶姆》。

公元前1世纪至公元5世纪，桑伽姆学园留下了2381首吟咏爱情、战争与君王的诗歌。古泰米尔语在8世纪前演变为中泰米尔语，13世纪问世的语法经典《南努尔》奠定了文学语言的规范。

泰米尔语曾是南印度海商的通用语，在埃及都出土过它的铭文。它迟至13至14世纪才与马拉雅拉姆语分化。1578年，葡萄牙传教士印制了泰米尔语祈祷书，这是第一种付印的印度语言书籍。

en:
The Tanimbar grouping corresponds to the Kei-Tanimbar languages, a small Central Malayo-Polynesian family scattered over the Kei and Tanimbar archipelagos and the north coast of New Guinea's Bomberai Peninsula. Its best-known member is Keiese, self-named Veu Evav, the lingua franca of the Kei islands; the family also includes Fordata, Yamdena and Selaru.

Each island and village has its own dialect, and Dutch Catholic missionaries first wrote Keiese in a Roman-letter alphabet. Kei oral history recalls Balinese aristocrats arriving in the Majapahit era, along with migrants from other islands. Two villages on Kei Besar preserve Banda, brought by refugees from the nutmeg-producing Banda Islands.

Portuguese navigators sighted Tanimbar around 1525 and charted it from the 1560s. The islands later entered the Dutch colonial sphere, exporting trepang, tortoiseshell and copra.
zh:
塔宁巴尔语这一划分对应中马来—波利尼西亚语支的卡伊—塔宁巴尔语群，零散分布在卡伊群岛、塔宁巴尔群岛以及新几内亚邦贝拉伊半岛北岸。其中最主要的是卡伊语，使用者自称韦乌埃瓦夫，是卡伊群岛的通用语；语群还包括福尔达塔语、扬德纳语和塞拉鲁语。

每个岛、每个村庄都有自己的方言，最早用罗马字母记录卡伊语的是荷兰天主教传教士。卡伊人的口述史称，满者伯夷时代有巴厘贵族到来，还有来自其他岛屿的移民。卡伊大岛上的两个村庄保留着班达语，那是肉豆蔻产地班达群岛的难民带来的语言。

1525年前后，葡萄牙航海者望见塔宁巴尔，16世纪60年代起的地图上已标出该群岛。此后这里进入荷兰殖民势力范围，出口海参、玳瑁和椰干。

en:
Tanoan, more fully Kiowa–Tanoan, is the language family of the Pueblo peoples of the Rio Grande valley in New Mexico and the Kiowa of the southern plains. Its Pueblo branches are Tiwa, Tewa and Towa; the related Kiowa's ancestors once lived near the northern Rockies.

Reconstructed vocabulary points to a homeland of hunter-gatherers on the Colorado Plateau, where the speakers gradually took up maize agriculture from the Basketmaker II culture of 50–450.

Proto-Tiwa-Tewa split between 725 and 920, after which the Tiwa moved toward the Rio Grande between 920 and 980. The Towa reached the Rio Puerco valley around 1200 and the Tewa came south from Mesa Verde around 1275, settling the apartment-like pueblo towns that Spanish explorers later encountered.
zh:
塔诺语，全称基奥瓦－塔诺语系，是新墨西哥里奥格兰德河谷普韦布洛诸族与南部平原基奥瓦人的语系。它的普韦布洛分支是蒂瓦语、特瓦语和托瓦语；同源的基奥瓦语使用者的先民曾住在落基山脉北段。

复原的同源词显示，该语系的原乡在科罗拉多高原，先民本是狩猎采集者，在50—450年的篮篮二期文化中逐渐转向玉米农业。

原始蒂瓦－特瓦语于725—920年间分化，蒂瓦人随后在920—980年间迁往里奥格兰德河。托瓦人约在1200年进入里奥普埃尔科河谷，特瓦人约在1275年从梅萨维德南下，建起后来西班牙探险家见到的集合式普韦布洛城镇。

en:
Tarahumaran is a branch of the Uto-Aztecan family of northern Mexico, made up of Tarahumara, the language of the Raramuri of Chihuahua, and Huarijio, spoken in Chihuahua and Sonora. The Raramuri, probably heirs of the Mogollon culture, withdrew into the Sierra Madre Occidental as Spaniards moved in from the late sixteenth century.

Jesuits built the first mission at San Pablo Balleza in the early 1600s. The Tepehuan Revolt of 1616 closed it for years. The Parral silver mines opened in 1631, bringing slave raids and more missions, and prompting Raramuri wars in 1648 and from 1696 to 1698; the war leader Teporaca was executed in 1690.

Never fully conquered, the highland Raramuri kept their language and identity, while lower mission communities merged into the colonial population. After the Jesuit expulsion of 1767, Franciscans took over the missions.
zh:
塔拉乌马拉语是墨西哥北部犹他-阿兹特克语系的一个语支，包括奇瓦瓦拉拉姆里人的塔拉乌马拉语，以及在奇瓦瓦和索诺拉使用的瓦里希奥语。拉姆里人大概是莫戈永文化的后继者，在16世纪末西班牙人进入后退守西马德雷山脉。

耶稣会在17世纪初于圣巴勃罗·巴列萨建立第一个传教区，1616年的特佩华纳起义使传教区关闭多年。1631年帕拉尔银矿开采后，奴隶劫掠和传教区增多，引发拉姆里人1648年和1696—1698年的战争；战事领袖特波拉卡于1690年被处死。

高地的拉姆里人从未被彻底征服，保住了语言和身份，低地传教区的人群则融入殖民社会。1767年耶稣会被驱逐后，传教区转交方济各会。

en:
Tarairiú, whose speakers called themselves Otxukayana, is the extinct and unclassified language of the Tarairiú nation, once heard between the Assú and Apodi rivers in Rio Grande do Norte and across the dry sertão of north-eastern Brazil. It survives only in a few word lists. The nation united more than twenty peoples under paramount chiefs such as Draruk and his son Kanindé.

Dutch visitors in the 1630s, including the painter Albert Eckhout, described and portrayed these Tapuia warriors. Allied with the Dutch against Portuguese rule, the Tarairiú fought frontier wars from 1630 to 1730 over the Assú valley, among the largest indigenous wars in Brazil.

Their seasonal moves followed the floods of the sacred Piranhas-Açu. They combined hunting and honey gathering with maize and cassava farming.
zh:
塔拉伊留语的使用者自称奥特苏卡亚纳人，这种已消亡的语言分类不明，曾通行于北里奥格兰德州阿苏河与阿波迪河之间，以及巴西东北部干旱的塞尔唐高原。该语言仅存几份词表。塔拉伊留民族联盟统合二十余个部族，在大酋长德拉鲁克及其子卡宁德等人领导下活动。

17世纪30年代的荷兰访客，包括画家阿尔伯特·埃克豪特，记述并画下过这些塔普亚战士。塔拉伊留人与荷兰结盟对抗葡萄牙统治，从1630年到1730年在阿苏河流域进行边疆战争，被视为巴西规模最大的原住民战争之一。

他们随圣河皮拉尼亚斯—阿苏河的涨落季节性迁徙，以狩猎、采蜜配合玉米和木薯种植为生。

en:
Tayrona was the Chibchan language of the Arhuacan subgroup spoken by the Tairona chiefdoms of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. It is almost unattested, surviving in little more than a single recorded word, but its lineage continues in the Arhuacan tongues of their descendants.

Tairona society took shape in the tenth and eleventh centuries as a network of farming towns on stone terraces linked by paved roads. The greatest, Teyuna, later called Ciudad Perdida, was founded around 800 on the Buritaca River, with 169 terraces cut into the mountainside. Tairona began as the name of a valley chiefdom; its cognate in Ijka means sons of the jaguar.

The first Spaniards were tolerated, but after 1600 warfare drove much of the population high into the Sierra Nevada. Their descendants kept the related Kogi, Damana and Kankuamo speeches alive while Tayrona dissolved into them.
zh:
泰罗纳语是奇布查语系阿尔瓦科语支的一种语言，通行于圣玛尔塔雪山的泰罗纳诸酋长国。该语言几乎没有留下记录，传世的据报只有一个词，但它的血脉延续在这些酋长国后裔的阿尔瓦科语支语言中。

泰罗纳社会在10至11世纪成形，是由石砌梯田上的农耕城镇以铺路相连的网络。最大的城镇特乌纳后来被称为迷城，约于800年建在布里塔卡河畔，山坡上凿出169级台地。“泰罗纳”最初只是一个河谷酋长国的名字，在伊卡语里，它的同源词意为“美洲豹之子”。

最早到来的西班牙人一度被容忍，但1600年以后战争迫使大量人口退入圣玛尔塔雪山高处。他们的后裔保住了同源的科吉语、达马纳语和坎夸莫语，而泰罗纳语本身则消融在这些语言之中。

en:
Tehit is a Papuan language of the southwestern Bird's Head Peninsula in Southwest Papua, centred around Teminabuan. It belongs to the West Bird's Head family, apparently related to the North Halmahera languages. Long contact with Austronesian tongues gave it an atypical subject-verb-object order and borrowed pronouns and numerals.

These shores and islands were at the heart of the maritime network woven from the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries by the Biak war leader Gurabesi and his Tidore patrons. The sultanate claimed suzerainty over Raja Ampat and the western Vogelkop; Austronesian seafaring terms and trade contacts entered Tehit speech in that era.

The Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres passed the New Guinea coast in 1606. Tehit dialects and clan life continued under the loose overlordship of Tidore and the Raja Ampat rajas.
zh:
特希特语是西南巴布亚鸟头半岛西南部的巴布亚语言，核心区域在特米纳布安一带。它属于西鸟头语系，似乎与北哈马黑拉诸语有亲缘关系。与南岛语言的长期接触使它采用非典型的主—谓—宾语序，并借入代词和数词。

从15至16世纪起，这片海岸和岛屿处于比亚克军事首领古拉贝西及其蒂多雷宗主所编织的海上网络中心。蒂多雷苏丹国对拉贾安帕群岛和鸟头半岛西部宣称宗主权，南岛语的航海术语和贸易接触也在这一时期进入特希特语。

1606年，路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙探险队经过新几内亚海岸。特希特人的方言和氏族生活在蒂多雷与拉贾安帕拉者松散的宗主权下延续下来。

en:
Telugu is the most widely spoken of the Dravidian languages, native to the Andhra coast and Deccan plateau of south-eastern India. Linguists estimate that it split from Proto-Dravidian around 1000 BCE, the first major branch to become distinct.

Telugu words appear in Prakrit inscriptions of the fourth century BCE, while the first long inscription entirely in Telugu dates to 575 CE. Its written form descends from a Brahmi-derived script once shared with Kannada.

Nannayya's Telugu Mahabharata of 1022 fixed a literary idiom enriched by Sanskrit. Telugu served as a court language under the Eastern Chalukyas, Kakatiyas and Vijayanagara Empire, whose rulers patronised a golden age of Telugu poetry; it became a prestige language of high culture and Carnatic music across much of southern India.
zh:
泰卢固语是达罗毗荼语族中使用人口最多的语言，故土在印度东南部的安得拉海岸与德干高原。语言学家估计它在公元前1000年前后从原始达罗毗荼语分化，是最早独立出来的主要分支。

公元前4世纪的俗语铭文里已出现泰卢固词语，而第一篇通体用泰卢固语写成的长铭文则出现于575年。它的文字源自婆罗米字母，曾与卡纳达文共用一套书写系统。

1022年南纳亚的泰卢固语《摩诃婆罗多》确立了大量吸收梵语成分的文学语言。泰卢固语先后充当东遮娄其、卡卡提亚和毗奢耶那伽罗的宫廷语言，在毗奢耶那伽罗诸王扶持下迎来诗歌黄金时代，并成为南印度广大地区精英文化和卡纳提克音乐的声望语言。

en:
Tepiman, also called Piman, is a branch of the Uto-Aztecan family whose languages stretch from southern Arizona along the Sierra Madre Occidental to Durango. Its members include O'odham, O'ob, O'otham and the poorly documented Tepecano. Tepehuan, a Nahuatl name meaning mountain people, covers three groups who call themselves O'dam, Audam and Odami.

These farming peoples of dispersed mountain villages stayed neutral in the Chichimeca War of 1550 to 1590. Jesuits opened missions among them from 1596. Repeated epidemics and forced labor in mines and haciendas fed the Tepehuan Revolt of 1616, led by the messianic Quautlatas with a broken cross as his symbol.

Spanish forces crushed the revolt by 1620 at heavy cost. The surviving Tepiman speakers remained in mission communities and remote valleys of the northwest.
zh:
特皮曼语又称皮曼语，是犹他-阿兹特克语系的一个语支，各语言从亚利桑那南部沿西马德雷山脉延伸到杜兰戈。其成员包括奥奥德姆语、奥奥布语、奥奥塔姆语和记载稀少的特佩卡诺语。“特佩华纳”是纳瓦特尔语名字，意为山里人，其下三个群体自称奥达姆、奥丹和奥达米。

他们是散居山村的农耕民族，在1550—1590年的奇奇梅卡战争中保持中立。耶稣会从1596年起在他们中间传教。接连的瘟疫以及矿山和庄园的劳役催生了1616年的特佩华纳起义，先知式人物夸乌特拉塔斯以断十字架为标志领导起事。

西班牙军队到1620年以惨重代价将起义镇压。幸存的特皮曼语使用者此后生活在传教区村镇和西北部偏远山谷中。

en:
The Ternate grouping unites the North Halmahera languages, the principal Papuan family of the Moluccas, spoken across northern and eastern Halmahera and the surrounding islands. It includes Ternate, Tidore, Tobelo and Galela. Ternate and Tidore are so close that their separation rests mainly on sociopolitical grounds.

These were the languages of the four North Malukan sultanates, whose clove trade made the region wealthy after Islam reached the elite in the late fifteenth century. These languages were written in Jawi from at least that era and had indigenous literary traditions, and Ternate became the lingua franca of North Maluku.

The Portuguese arrived in 1512 and built a fort in 1522, but were expelled in 1575 under Sultan Baabullah. After Spain's withdrawal in 1663, a treaty of 1683 made Ternate a Dutch vassal; Tidore's Prince Nuku led anti-Dutch revolts after 1780.
zh:
特尔纳特语这一划分整合了北哈马黑拉语系，它是马鲁古最主要的巴布亚语系，通行于哈马黑拉岛北部和东部及周围岛屿。其中包括特尔纳特语、蒂多雷语、托贝洛语和加莱拉语。特尔纳特语与蒂多雷语极为接近，两者的分立主要出于社会政治原因。

这些语言曾是北马鲁古四大苏丹国的语言：15世纪末伊斯兰教传入精英阶层后，丁香贸易让这一地区富庶起来。这些语言至迟在那时已有爪夷文书写和本土书面传统；特尔纳特语还成为北马鲁古的通用语。

1512年葡萄牙人到来并于1522年修建城堡，却在1575年被巴布乌拉苏丹治下的当地人驱逐。1663年西班牙人撤出后，1683年的条约使特尔纳特沦为荷兰附庸，蒂多雷的努库王子在1780年后仍领导反荷起义。

en:
Thin Nu Waab, the language of Waab, is the Yapese name for the tongue of the Yap Main Islands in the western Carolines. It is an Austronesian language of the Oceanic branch, though its exact subgroup is disputed, and distinct from the Chuukic languages spoken on Yap's outlying atolls.

Around 950 the village of Gatcheper in Gagil built a maritime tribute network, later called the Yapese Empire, that stretched more than 1,300 kilometres east toward Chuuk and carried Yapese speech and customs across the western Carolines. Yapese navigators sailed to Palau to quarry the great stone disks called rai, towing them home on rafts behind their canoes.

Alvaro de Saavedra sighted Yap in 1528; Spain counted the islands among its Philippine possessions from the seventeenth century. The language remained unwritten in this period and had ejective fricatives.
zh:
“辛努瓦布”意为瓦布的语言，是雅浦人对西加罗林群岛中雅浦主群岛语言的自称。它属于南岛语系大洋洲语族，但确切的语支归属仍有争议，并且与雅浦外围环礁上通行的楚克语支语言不同。

约950年，加吉尔酋邦的加切佩尔村建立起一张海上朝贡网络，后人称之为雅浦帝国，其势力向东朝楚克方向延伸1300多公里，把雅浦语和雅浦风俗带到西加罗林各地。雅浦航海者远航帕劳开采名为“雷伊”的巨型石盘，用木筏拴在独木舟后面拖回故乡。

1528年阿尔瓦罗·德·萨韦德拉望见雅浦；从17世纪起，西班牙把这些岛屿算作其菲律宾领地的一部分。这一时期雅浦语始终没有文字，并有挤喉擦音。

en:
Tibetan is the Tibeto-Burman language of the Tibetan Plateau and the Himalayas, whose varieties descend from Old Tibetan, first written in the seventh century with an Indic-derived script. A reform of 816 under King Sadnalegs fixed the literary standard that became Classical Tibetan, the language of the Buddhist canon translated from Sanskrit and of the Mahavyutpatti lexicon.

After the later diffusion of Buddhism from the tenth to twelfth centuries, the Gelug order built the great monasteries of Ganden, Sera and Drepung. In the seventeenth century the Fifth Dalai Lama, Ngawang Lobsang Gyatso, made Classical Tibetan the language of government, scholarship and liturgy across his realm.

The central and Kham dialects developed tones, while Amdo and Ladakhi speech kept older features; the classical written form remained the shared medium of Tibetan Buddhism.
zh:
藏语是通行于青藏高原和喜马拉雅山区的藏缅语族语言，众多方言都源自7世纪开始用源自印度的文字书写的古藏语。816年，赞普赤德松赞（赛那累）主持的文字规范确立了书面标准，即古典藏语，也是从梵文译出的佛教经典和《翻译名义大集》所用的语言。

10至12世纪佛教后弘期之后，格鲁派建起甘丹寺、色拉寺和哲蚌寺等大寺。17世纪时，五世达赖喇嘛阿旺罗桑嘉措把古典藏语确立为其辖境内行政、学术和宗教仪轨的语言。

卫藏和康方言逐渐发展出声调，安多和拉达克话则保留了古语特征；古典书面藏语始终是藏传佛教共同的媒介。

en:
The Timoric languages are a branch of the Central-Eastern Malayo-Polynesian group of Austronesian, spoken on Timor, neighboring Wetar and, in most classifications, southwest Maluku. They include Uab Meto of west Timor, Tetun and Mambai of the east, and Helong around Kupang. Long contact with Papuan languages has left these tongues with unusual phonology and many borrowed words.

Timor entered regional trade as a source of sandalwood, noted as Ti-wu in the Chinese Zhu Fan Zhi of the 1200s and listed among Majapahit's realms in the Nagarakretagama of the 1300s.

The Portuguese settled in eastern Timor in the late 1500s and the Dutch East India Company took Kupang in the mid-1600s. Their rivalry over sandalwood made Tetun, spread by coastal commerce and Catholic missions, the island's main lingua franca.
zh:
帝汶语是南岛语系中东部马来—波利尼西亚语群的一支，通行于帝汶岛、邻近的韦塔岛以及多数分类方案中的马鲁古西南部诸岛。其中包括西帝汶的乌阿布梅托语、东部的德顿语和曼拜语，以及古邦一带的赫隆语。由于长期与巴布亚语言接触，这些语言语音独特、借词众多。

帝汶以檀香木产地进入区域贸易：13世纪中国的《诸蕃志》以“底勿”之名记载该岛，14世纪的《爪哇史颂》又把它列入满者伯夷的藩属。

16世纪末葡萄牙人在东帝汶定居，17世纪中叶荷兰东印度公司夺取古邦。双方围绕檀香木贸易长期争夺，借助沿海商业和天主教传教活动传播的德顿语，也由此成为岛上最主要的通用语。

en:
Timoto was the highland language of the Timote people, the southern branch of the Timoto–Cuica complex of the Venezuelan Andes, spoken through the Motatán and Chama valleys and the Tatuy plain. Its name has been traced to ti-motɨ, meaning speakers of Mutú; mutú or mukú recurs as a place name and may have meant people, community or village.

Together with Cuicas it formed a decimal-counting language with no proven relation to the surrounding families. Its speakers farmed irrigated stone terraces and grew potatoes and maize. After Mérida was founded on their Tatuy lands in 1558, clashes forced the settlers to move the town within a year.

Under Mérida and its estates the Timote villages were slowly absorbed into Spanish-speaking life. The old speech survived only in highland hamlets and in fragmentary vocabularies collected long after the conquest.
zh:
蒂莫托语是蒂莫特人的高地语言。蒂莫特人是委内瑞拉安第斯山区蒂莫特—奎卡族群的南支，语言通行于莫塔坦河与查马河流域及塔图伊平原。它的名字被追溯为ti-motɨ，意为“说穆图语的人”；“穆图”或“穆库”作为地名反复出现，可能表示人、村社或村庄。

它与奎卡斯语共同构成一种采用十进位计数的语言，与周围语系没有经证实的亲缘关系。使用者耕作石砌灌溉梯田，种植马铃薯和玉米。1558年梅里达在他们的塔图伊土地上建城后，冲突迫使殖民者不到一年就迁移了城址。

在梅里达城及其庄园的统治下，蒂莫特村落慢慢被纳入西班牙语生活。古老的语言只在高地小村和征服很久以后才收集到的零碎词汇中留下痕迹。

en:
Timucua is a language isolate once spoken across northern and central Florida and into southern Georgia, where it was the principal native tongue at the time of Spanish colonization. Its nine or ten dialects differed only slightly and served mainly to mark tribal boundaries.

Nearly everything known of the language comes from Francisco Pareja, a Franciscan missionary who reached St. Augustine in 1595. He devised a writing system and between 1612 and 1628 printed Spanish-Timucua catechisms and the first grammar.

The speech of the Calusa and Tocobaga on the Gulf coast was almost never written down and remains unclassified. In 1763, when Spain ceded Florida to Britain after the Seven Years' War, the last Timucua speakers left with the Spanish missions for Cuba and the language fell silent.
zh:
蒂穆夸语是一门孤立语言，曾通行于佛罗里达北部和中部，并延伸到佐治亚南部，是西班牙殖民时期当地最主要的原住民语言。它的九、十种方言差别很小，主要用来区分部族界限。

关于这种语言的知识几乎全部来自方济各会修士弗朗西斯科·帕雷哈，他于1595年抵达圣奥古斯丁。他为该语创制文字，并在1612—1628年间刊行西班牙语—蒂穆夸语教义问答和第一部语法书。

墨西哥湾沿岸卡卢萨人和托科巴加人的语言几乎没有文字记录，归属仍无定论。1763年七年战争结束后，西班牙将佛罗里达割让给英国，最后一批蒂穆夸语使用者随西班牙传教团前往古巴，这门语言遂告消亡。

en:
Tiri, also recorded as Tinrin, Ciri or Mea, is a Kanak language of the Austronesian family spoken in the west-central part of Grande Terre, the main island of New Caledonia.

It belongs with the extinct Zire tongue to the Zire-Tiri branch of the southern New Caledonian languages and makes extensive use of possessive classifiers. The Kanak languages descend from Lapita voyagers, whose first coastal settlements in New Caledonia appeared around 1100 BC.

James Cook sighted Grande Terre in September 1774 and named it New Caledonia; the Comte de Lapérouse reconnoitred the west coast in 1788, and whalers mapped the Loyalty Islands from 1793. For decades afterwards contacts with the archipelago remained sporadic, and Tiri remained an unwritten language of oral custom throughout this period.
zh:
蒂里语又记为廷林语、奇里语或梅阿语，是新喀里多尼亚主岛格朗德特尔岛中西部通行的卡纳克语言，属南岛语系。

它与已消亡的济雷语共同构成新喀里多尼亚南部语言的济雷—蒂里语支，并大量使用领属分类词。卡纳克诸语言源自拉皮塔航海者，他们约在公元前1100年开始在新喀里多尼亚沿海建立定居点。

1774年9月詹姆斯·库克望见格朗德特尔岛，并将其命名为新喀里多尼亚；1788年拉彼鲁兹伯爵考察了西海岸，1793年起捕鲸人测绘了洛亚蒂群岛。此后数十年间与该群岛的接触仍只是零星发生，在这一时期蒂里语始终是没有文字的口头习俗语言。

en: Tirio is a small family of Trans-New Guinea languages of the lower Fly River region in Papua New Guinea's Western Province. It comprises Tirio, also called Makayam, Bitur, also known as Mutum, Baramu, Were and the speech of Sumogi Island, whose members share about forty per cent of their vocabulary.
zh: 蒂里奥语是跨新几内亚语系的一个小语族，通行于巴布亚新几内亚西部省弗莱河下游地区，包括蒂里奥语（又称马卡扬语）、比图尔语（又称穆图姆语）、巴拉穆语、韦雷语以及苏莫吉岛上的语言，语族内各语言约有四成词汇相同。

en:
Tokelauan is a Polynesian language of the Austronesian family, spoken on the atolls of Atafu, Nukunonu and Fakaofo, and until modern times also on Swains Island, called Olohega in the language itself; Tokelau means north-northeast, or north wind. Its speakers descend from settlers who arrived from the direction of Samoa roughly a thousand years ago, and the atolls may have served as a gateway into eastern Polynesia.

Each atoll governed itself separately under chiefly clans, but all three kept a single language and an oral tradition centred on the god Tui Tokelau. Tokelauan's closest relative is Tuvaluan, with which it is mutually intelligible. It had no traditional written form and was transmitted by word of mouth.

John Byron sighted Atafu in 1765 and named it Duke of York's Island; Edward Edwards found Nukunonu in 1791, and an American whaler sighted Fakaofo in 1835.
zh:
托克劳语是南岛语系波利尼西亚语族的语言，通行于阿塔富、努库诺努和法考福三个环礁，近代以前也通行于本语称作奥洛赫加的斯温斯岛；“托克劳”意为“北东北”或“北风”。说这种语言的人是约一千年前从萨摩亚方向迁来的定居者后裔，托克劳环礁可能还是通往东波利尼西亚的门户。

三个环礁各自在氏族首领治下独立行事，却始终使用同一种语言，共享以神祇图伊托克劳为中心的口传传统。托克劳语最亲近的亲属是图瓦卢语，两者可以互通。托克劳语没有传统文字，靠口耳相传。

1765年约翰·拜伦望见阿塔富并将其命名为约克公爵岛，爱德华·爱德华兹于1791年发现努库诺努，1835年一艘美国捕鲸船又望见了法考福。

en:
Tolomako, also called Bigbay after the Big Bay area of northern Espiritu Santo in Vanuatu, is a conservative Oceanic language and a close sister of the much-changed Sakao language spoken farther along the same coast. Its pronunciation and grammar stay close to what scholars reconstruct for Proto-North-Central Vanuatu: it has a simple consonant-vowel syllable structure and isolating syntax, its personal pronouns distinguish singular, dual, trial and plural, and its verbs mark realis and irrealis mood rather than tense. A closely related variety, Tsureviu, is usually treated as its dialect.

Big Bay entered recorded history in 1606, when the Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Quiros landed there and briefly claimed the island as a great southern continent.
zh:
托洛马科语又称大湾语，得名于瓦努阿图圣埃斯皮里图岛北部的大湾地区，是一种保守的大洋洲语，与同一海岸更远处变化剧烈的萨卡奥语为近亲姐妹语言。它的语音和语法接近学者构拟的原始中北瓦努阿图语：音节结构简单，为辅音加元音的形式，句法属孤立型；人称代词区分单数、双数、三数和复数，动词不标时态，而标现实与非现实语气。与它极相近的楚雷维乌语一般被视为它的方言。

大湾在1606年进入有记载的历史：当年佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的西班牙探险队在此登陆，并一度把该岛当作南方大陆加以宣称。

en:
Tongic is the Polynesian subgroup made up of Tongan, the language of the kingdom of Tonga, and Niuean. Lapita voyagers had carried Tongan's ancestors to Tongatapu by the ninth century BC. By the twelfth century the Tuʻi Tonga chiefs spread Tongan influence across the central Pacific, and settlers of the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries left a deep mark on the language of ʻUvea.

Tongan preserves the old Polynesian glottal stop, written with the turned comma called fakauʻa, and keeps the l sound that most sister languages merged with r. Dutch sailors Willem Schouten and Jacob Le Maire made the first word lists in 1616; Abel Tasman called at Tongatapu in 1643.

Protestant missionaries arrived in 1797 and the Wesleyan minister Walter Lawry in 1822; under their work the language gained a Latin-script missionary alphabet. The future king George Tāufaʻāhau was baptised in 1831.
zh:
汤加语支是波利尼西亚语族的一支，包括汤加王国的汤加语和纽埃语。拉皮塔文化的航海者在公元前9世纪已把汤加语的祖先带到汤加塔布。到12世纪，图伊汤加酋长把汤加语的影响播及中太平洋，15至16世纪的汤加移民又在乌韦阿语中留下深深的印记。

汤加语保留了古波利尼西亚语的喉塞音，用名为法考阿的倒置逗号书写，并保留了边音，而多数姊妹语言里边音与颤音已经合流。1616年荷兰水手威廉·斯豪滕和雅各布·勒梅尔最早编出词汇表，1643年亚伯·塔斯曼抵达汤加塔布。

新教传教士于1797年到来，卫斯理宗牧师沃尔特·劳里于1822年到来；汤加语在他们的工作下有了拉丁字母的传教士拼写体系。未来的国王乔治·陶法阿豪于1831年受洗。

en:
Tonkawa is a language isolate, with no proven relatives, spoken by the Tonkawa people of the southern Great Plains, whose autonym Tickanwatic means the real people. In 1601 the Tonkawa lived in what is now northwestern Oklahoma as a loose set of nomadic bands with some horticulture, and they drifted south into Texas in the late seventeenth century under pressure from the Apache and Wichita; by 1700 they had reached the Red River.

In the 1740s some bands settled at the Spanish San Gabriel missions, and in 1758 Tonkawa warriors joined the native coalition that destroyed the mission of Santa Cruz de San Saba. The language had no native script and was carried entirely by oral tradition.
zh:
通卡瓦语是一门没有已知亲属语言的孤立语言，使用者是南部大平原的通卡瓦人；他们的自称蒂坎瓦蒂克意为真正的人。1601年，通卡瓦人还生活在今天的俄克拉荷马西北部，由若干游徙的氏族群体组成，兼营少量种植；17世纪末在阿帕奇人和威奇托人的压力下向南迁入得克萨斯，到1700年已抵达雷德河。

1740年代，部分群体定居西班牙人的圣加布里埃尔传教站；1758年，通卡瓦战士加入原住民联军，摧毁了圣克鲁斯－德圣萨瓦传教站。通卡瓦语没有本族文字，完全靠口耳相传。

en: The Orya–Tor languages are a family of just over a dozen Papuan languages of Western New Guinea, named after the Tor River on the forested coast east of the Mamberamo. Orya is their closest outside relative; Kwesten, Mander and Bonerif belong to the Tor grouping proper, and older links with the Lakes Plain languages have not held up.
zh: 奥里亚—托尔语是印度尼西亚西新几内亚的一个巴布亚语族，含十余种语言，因流经马姆贝拉莫河以东森林沿海平原的托尔河得名。奥里亚语是该语族最亲近的外部亲属，奎斯滕语、曼德尔语、博内里夫语等则构成托尔语群本体；早年把它与湖平原语挂钩的说法未能成立。

en:
The Torricelli languages are a family of some fifty Papuan tongues named after the Torricelli Mountains of north-western Papua New Guinea, whose ridges run between the Pacific coast and the Sepik River basin. Their speakers have held these hills for several millennia, and migrations of Sepik-speaking peoples later split the family into three geographically separated areas.

Its most populous branch is Arapesh, including Bukiyip, famed for a complex agreement system with eighteen noun classes; the Wapei branch contains Olo. The family has no proven relatives, though shared pronoun endings hint at a link with the Sepik languages. Torricelli speech keeps subject–verb–object order and prepositions, unlike most Papuan families.

The Spaniard Yñigo Ortiz de Retez was the first European to trace the northern coast and named the island New Guinea in 1545, long before the mountain villages were reached by outsiders.
zh:
托里切利诸语是一个约含五十种巴布亚语言的语族，以巴布亚新几内亚西北部的托里切利山脉命名，山岭横亘在太平洋海岸与塞皮克河盆地之间。说这些语言的人已在山中居住数千年，后来塞皮克语族群的迁徙把该语族分隔成三个地理上互不相连的区域。

使用人数最多的分支是阿拉佩什语，其中的布基伊普语以拥有十八个名词类的复杂一致体系著称；瓦佩伊分支则有奥洛语。该语族在外部没有确证的亲属，不过代词共有的后缀暗示它可能与塞皮克语族有关。托里切利诸语与多数巴布亚语族不同，保持主语—动词—宾语语序并使用前置词。

最早沿北海岸航行的欧洲人是西班牙人伊尼戈·奥尔蒂斯·德·雷特斯，他于1545年将这座岛屿命名为新几内亚，而山中小村被外界触及则是很久以后的事。

en:
Totozoquean is a proposed language family of Mesoamerica that joins the Totonacan languages of the Gulf coast and the Mixe–Zoque languages of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec. The grouping remains debated; the Huavean languages of the Oaxaca coast may be its closest relatives.

When the Spanish conquest reached the Gulf coast in 1519, Totonacan languages were spoken along the shore and were occasionally written in the colonial period. Many scholars hold that the Olmecs, who flourished from roughly 1200 to 400 BCE, spoke a Mixe–Zoque language, and the Isthmian or Epi-Olmec script may record an early Zoquean tongue.
zh:
托托索克语是中美洲一个假说性的语系，把墨西哥湾沿岸的托托纳坎语族和特万特佩克地峡的米塞-索克语族联系在一起。这一归类仍有争议；瓦哈卡沿海的瓦维语系可能是它最近的亲属。

1519年西班牙征服波及墨西哥湾沿岸时，托托纳坎诸语言遍布海岸，殖民时代偶尔有书面记录。不少学者认为约公元前1200年至前400年兴盛的奥尔梅克人说的是一种米塞-索克语言，地峡文字（也称后奥尔梅克文字）记录的可能也是早期的索克语。

en: Truka is the presumed, now extinct language of the Truká people of north-eastern Brazil, whose villages occupy the Ilha da Assunção archipelago on the São Francisco river at Cabrobó in Pernambuco. No word lists or texts were recorded, so the language remains unclassified and is known only from the identity of its speakers.
zh: 特鲁卡语是巴西东北部特鲁卡人推定使用过的已消亡语言；特鲁卡人聚居于伯南布哥州卡布罗博市圣弗朗西斯科河上的阿松桑岛群岛。由于没有留下任何词表或文本，该语言无法分类，今人只能凭借使用者的族群身份知道它的存在。

en:
Tsėhesenėstsestotse, the language of the Cheyenne, is a Plains Algonquian tongue of the Algic family, highly polysynthetic and reshaped from Proto-Algonquian by vowel and consonant shifts, as when the ancestral word for man became Cheyenne hetane.

In the mid-seventeenth century its speakers lived between the Mississippi and Mille Lacs Lake in Minnesota, gathering wild rice and hunting bison. Driven west by the Assiniboine and later the Ojibwe and Lakota, they reached the Missouri River in 1676, learned earth-lodge village life from the Mandan and Arikara, and moved into the Black Hills.

Around 1730 they passed horses on to the Lakota, and by the later 1700s had become nomadic bison hunters on the high plains. The language has two varieties, those of the Tsétsêhéstâhese and the Só'taeo'o, who traveled together with slightly different speech and separate sacred bundles.
zh:
