这些高度综合、大量使用后缀的语言与北美其他语系都没有可证实的亲缘关系，语言学家认为它们对应史前最后一批来自亚洲的移民，即图勒人的祖先。

据估算，原始语至少在4000年前已分化为阿留申语支和爱斯基摩语支；尤皮克语与因纽特语约在1000年前分道扬镳，此后因纽特诸部在随后几个世纪里向东扩散到整个北极。

en:
The Germanic languages are a branch of Indo-European, all descended from Proto-Germanic, which was spoken in the Iron Age around the Baltic and North Sea coasts, northern Germany and Scandinavia. From the second century BC Germanic tribes moved south from these homelands, and their speech split into three branches. West Germanic produced English, German, Dutch and Frisian; North Germanic developed from Old Norse; East Germanic included Gothic, Burgundian and Vandalic, whose speakers were assimilated by neighbouring peoples around the seventh century.

The earliest Germanic writing is a name scratched on the Negau helmet around 200 BC, followed by the runic Elder Futhark from roughly 100 AD.

In the fourth century Bishop Ulfilas devised a Gothic alphabet to translate the Bible; Christian monks later used Latin letters to write the other Germanic tongues. Runes remained in everyday use in Scandinavia through the Viking Age.
zh:
日耳曼语族是印欧语系的一支，各语言都源自原始日耳曼语；这种祖语在铁器时代通行于波罗的海与北海沿岸、德意志北部和斯堪的纳维亚。公元前2世纪起，日耳曼部落从这些祖居地南迁，语言也分成三支：西日耳曼语支产生了英语、德语、荷兰语和弗里斯兰语；北日耳曼语支由古诺斯语发展而来；东日耳曼语支包括哥特语、勃艮第语和汪达尔语，其使用者在7世纪前后被邻族同化。

现存最早的日耳曼语文字，是约公元前200年内高头盔上刻的人名，其后是约公元100年出现的如尼文古弗萨克字母。

4世纪时，主教乌尔菲拉创制哥特字母以翻译圣经，基督教修士后来用拉丁字母书写其他日耳曼语言。整个维京时代，如尼文在斯堪的纳维亚仍是日常文字。

en:
The Halhaheran-Guinean group corresponds to the South Halmahera–West New Guinea branch of the Malayo-Polynesian languages, itself part of the Austronesian family. Its roughly 38 languages are strung along the shores and islands of the Halmahera Sea and Cenderawasih Bay in eastern Indonesia, including the South Halmaheran, Biak, Yapen and Waropen languages.

Linguists place the parent language's homeland on the southern shore of Cenderawasih Bay some 3500 years ago, and hold these languages to be among the closest relatives of the Oceanic languages spread across the Pacific.

Many members are known only from short word lists, though Biak, Taba and a few others are well documented; Biak spread across a wide arc of islands from the Schoutens to Raja Ampat, carried by maritime trade networks.
zh:
哈尔哈赫拉‑几内亚语族对应南哈马黑拉—西新几内亚语支，属于南岛语系下的马来—波利尼西亚语族。其约38种语言分布在印尼东部哈马黑拉海和极乐鸟湾的沿岸与岛屿上，包括南哈马黑拉诸语、比亚克语、亚彭语和瓦罗彭语。

语言学家推测，其原始语的故乡约在3500年前的极乐鸟湾南岸，并认为这些语言与遍布太平洋的大洋洲诸语言亲缘最近。

该语支许多语言只有简短词表传世，但比亚克语、塔巴语等少数几种记录较充分；其中比亚克语随海上贸易网络传播，从斯考滕群岛到拉贾安帕特，横跨广阔的岛弧。

en:
The Indic, or Indo-Aryan, languages are the South Asian branch of Indo-Iranian within Indo-European, spoken from Bengal and the Deccan to Sri Lanka. Their oldest stage is Vedic Sanskrit, the language of the Rigveda and other Vedas composed from roughly 1500 BC.

Classical Sanskrit later became the language of religion, science and court literature, while the vernacular Prakrits went their own way. Pali became the language of the Buddhist canon, and the edicts of the emperor Ashoka in the third century BC carried a Prakrit across his empire.

Late Prakrits such as Apabhramsha, current from about 600 to 1400 AD, gave rise to New Indo-Aryan tongues, while Sinhala developed separately on Sri Lanka and Romani was carried to Europe by migrants from India. Under the Delhi sultanates, the Persianised register of Hindustani known as Urdu joined the Sanskritised register that became Hindi.
zh:
印地语族，又称印度-雅利安语族，是印欧语系印度-伊朗语下的南亚分支，通行范围从孟加拉、德干延伸到斯里兰卡。其最古老阶段是吠陀梵语，即约公元前1500年起成书的《梨俱吠陀》等吠陀经典的语言。

古典梵语后来成为宗教、科学和宫廷文学的用语，而俗语各方言则自行演变。巴利语成为佛教三藏的语言，公元前3世纪阿育王的敕令把一种俗语传遍帝国。

约600—1400年间通行的晚期俗语，如阿帕布朗沙语，孕育了新印度-雅利安诸语；僧伽罗语在斯里兰卡单独发展，罗姆语则由出自印度的移民带到欧洲。在德里诸苏丹国治下，印度斯坦语的波斯化变体乌尔都语兴起，与梵文化的印地语同源异流。

en:
The Iranic, or Iranian, languages form the western branch of Indo-Iranian within Indo-European, descended from Proto-Iranian spoken in Central Asia early in the second millennium BC and carried by tribes onto the Iranian Plateau and beyond.

Old Iranian survives in Avestan, the language of the Zoroastrian Avesta, and Old Persian, carved in royal cuneiform on Achaemenid inscriptions such as the Behistun text of Darius I around 500 BC. The Middle Iranian stage produced Middle Persian, language of the Sasanian Empire in Pahlavi script, alongside Parthian, Bactrian and Sogdian.

After the Arab conquest, New Persian emerged in the ninth century in an Arabic-derived alphabet and, under dynasties such as the Samanids, yielded the Shahnameh of Ferdowsi and became the language of administration and letters from Anatolia to India. The eastern branch includes the steppe languages of the Scythians and Alans, whose surviving descendant is Ossetian.
zh:
伊朗语族是印欧语系印度-伊朗语下的西部分支，由约公元前第二个千年通行于中亚的原始伊朗语演化而来，随诸部落迁徙传到伊朗高原及更远的地方。

古伊朗语留存于琐罗亚斯德教经典《阿维斯陀》所用的阿维斯陀语，以及古波斯语；后者以王室楔形文字刻在阿契美尼德王朝的铭文上，如约公元前500年大流士一世的贝希斯敦铭文。中期阶段产生了萨珊帝国的中古波斯语，用巴列维字母书写，同期还有帕提亚语、巴克特里亚语和粟特语。

阿拉伯征服之后，新波斯语于9世纪以阿拉伯字母的变体出现，在萨曼王朝等政权扶持下诞生了菲尔多西的《列王纪》，并成为从安纳托利亚到印度的行政与文学语言。东支包括斯基泰人与阿兰人的草原语言，其存世后裔是奥塞梯语。

en:
The Iroquoian languages are a family of indigenous languages of eastern North America, once spoken from the St. Lawrence Valley and the lower Great Lakes to the southern Appalachians. They are polysynthetic tongues, notable for having almost no labial consonants, and belonged to farming peoples who lived in fortified longhouse towns and grew maize, beans and squash.

The best-known speakers are the Haudenosaunee, or Five Nations, whose Great League of Peace was forged in present-day New York before European contact; the Tuscarora joined them as a sixth nation in 1722.

Their relatives included the Wendat, or Huron, the Neutral, Erie and Susquehannock, most of whom were dispersed or absorbed during the mid-seventeenth-century Beaver Wars. The Cherokee, isolated in the southern Appalachian Mountains, speak the sole major Iroquoian language of the American southeast.
zh:
易洛魁语系是北美东部的原住民语系，分布范围曾从圣劳伦斯河谷、五大湖下游延伸到阿巴拉契亚山脉南部。这些语言属多式综合语，以几乎没有唇音著称；使用者是种植玉米、豆类和南瓜，居住在设防长屋村镇中的农耕族群。

最知名的是易洛魁联盟，即“五族联盟”，其大和平律法在欧洲人到来之前已成形于今纽约州一带；图斯卡罗拉人于1722年加入，成为第六族。

与他们同源的还有休伦人、中立人、伊利人及萨斯奎哈诺克人，其中多数在17世纪中叶的海狸战争中被打散或吞并。偏处阿巴拉契亚山脉南部的切罗基人，则操美国东南部唯一的主要易洛魁语言。

en:
The Japonic or Japanese–Ryukyuan family has two living branches: Japanese, spoken across the main islands of Japan, and the Ryukyuan languages of the Ryukyu island chain to the south.

Most scholars hold that the family was carried to northern Kyushu around 700 to 300 BC by wet-rice farmers of the Yayoi culture arriving from the Korean Peninsula, and that it then spread through the archipelago, displacing the Ainu languages once widespread in northern Honshu. The split between Japanese and Ryukyuan probably predates the seventh century.

Japanese is first recorded in the seventh and eighth centuries, when scribes wrote Old Japanese with Chinese characters in works such as the Man'yōshū. The arrival of Buddhism from the sixth century and the borrowing of Chinese culture in the eighth and ninth centuries brought many Sino-Japanese words into the language.
zh:
日琉语族包含两大现存分支：通行于日本主要岛屿的日语，以及南方琉球群岛上的琉球语。

多数学者认为，公元前700年至前300年间，操原始日琉语的弥生文化稻作农人从朝鲜半岛来到九州北部，随后语族扩散到整个日本列岛，取代了曾广泛通行于本州北部的阿伊努诸语。日语与琉球语的分化大概在7世纪以前已经发生。

日语最早的记录出现在7至8世纪，当时的书手用汉字书写古日语，《万叶集》等作品即其代表。6世纪佛教传入，8至9世纪中国文化输入，使日语吸收了大量汉语词。

en:
The Micronesian languages form a family of about twenty Oceanic languages within the Austronesian family, scattered across the low atolls of the Caroline, Gilbert and Marshall archipelagos in the north-western Pacific. Their ancestors reached the region roughly two thousand years ago, probably settling Kosrae first by way of the Solomon Islands or northern Vanuatu and then spreading westwards.

The family's members include Marshallese, Kiribati, Kosraean, Chuukese, Pohnpeian and Nauruan. The first recorded European encounter in the region was the Magellan expedition, which landed in the Marianas in 1521, when the languages were still carried entirely by oral tradition.
zh:
密克罗尼西亚语族是南岛语系大洋洲语支下的一个语族，约有二十种语言，分布于西北太平洋加罗林群岛、吉尔伯特群岛和马绍尔群岛的低矮环礁上。其先民约两千年前抵达这一海域，可能先沿所罗门群岛或瓦努阿图北部方向的航路定居科斯雷，再向西扩散。

该语族的成员包括马绍尔语、基里巴斯语、科斯雷语、楚克语、波纳佩语和瑙鲁语。有记载的欧洲人与该地区最早接触是1521年麦哲伦探险队在马里亚纳群岛登陆，那时这些语言还完全依靠口耳相传。

en:
The Moluccan family groups the Central Malayo-Polynesian languages of the Banda Sea, spoken on the Lesser Sunda and Maluku islands. Austronesian settlers reached these islands roughly four thousand years ago, and linguists treat the family as a linkage of related branches rather than a single tight unit, its varieties shaped by older Papuan substrates.

The Malukus were the Spice Islands of medieval trade, their nutmeg and cloves drawing Javanese, Malay and Arab merchants; the Old Javanese eulogy Nagarakertagama mentions the region in 1365, and Islam entered with Arab traders in the fourteenth century.

Malay served as the lingua franca of the ports, and the Ternate sultan's letters of the 1520s were written in it, while the Portuguese reached Ambon in 1512 and the Dutch arrived in 1599, drawing the islands into European colonial rivalry.
zh:
摩鹿加语族汇集了班达海一带的中部马来—波利尼西亚语言，通行于小巽他群岛和马鲁古群岛。南岛移民约在四千年前抵达这些岛屿，语言学家把该语族视为由相互关联的语支组成的链接体，而非单一紧密的单元，各语言还受到更早的巴布亚底层影响。

马鲁古是中世纪贸易中的香料群岛，肉豆蔻和丁香引来了爪哇、马来和阿拉伯商人；古爪哇颂诗《爪哇史颂》在1365年已提到这一地区，伊斯兰教也在14世纪随阿拉伯商人传入。

马来语是各港口的通用语，特尔纳特苏丹在16世纪20年代的书信即以马来文写成；葡萄牙人1512年抵达安汶、荷兰人1599年到来后，这些岛屿被卷入欧洲人的殖民争夺。

en:
The Muskogean languages are a family of highly synthetic, agglutinative indigenous tongues of the southeastern United States, comprising Choctaw and Chickasaw in the west and Muscogee, also called Creek, among the eastern languages.

Their speakers were heirs to the Mississippian mound-building tradition, which between 800 and 1600 raised plaza-centred towns such as Etowah and Moundville under maize-farming chiefdoms from the Tennessee River to the Gulf coast. The Hernando de Soto expedition of 1539 to 1543 crossed these densely settled lands.

In later centuries Muscogee-speaking towns drew together into the Creek Confederacy across Alabama and Georgia, while groups moving into Florida after 1767 merged into the Seminole. Along the lower Mississippi and the Gulf shore, the Western Muskogean-based Mobilian Jargon served for centuries as a shared trade language among peoples of many different tongues.
zh:
马斯科吉语族是美国东南部的原住民语系，属于高度综合的黏着语，西支有乔克托语和奇克索语，东支包括穆斯科吉语，又称克里克语。

使用者是密西西比筑丘文化的继承者：800—1600年间，从田纳西河到墨西哥湾沿岸，玉米农耕的酋邦兴建了埃托瓦、芒德维尔等以广场为中心的土丘城镇。1539—1543年，埃尔南多·德·索托的远征队曾穿越这片人口稠密的土地。

此后几个世纪里，操穆斯科吉语的村镇在阿拉巴马和佐治亚联合为克里克联盟；1767年以后迁入佛罗里达的人群则融合形成塞米诺尔人。在密西西比河下游和墨西哥湾沿岸，以西支马斯科吉语为基础的莫比尔行话曾长期充当不同语言族群之间的贸易通用语。

en:
Nilotic is an Eastern Sudanic branch of Nilo-Saharan, spoken from the White Nile basin south into Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania. It divides into Western, Eastern and Southern groups. Proto-Nilotic had taken shape east of the Nile by the third millennium BCE, among pastoral societies such as Kadero.

After Kush collapsed in the fourth and fifth centuries CE, Nilotic speakers moved south from central Sudan between the fifth and eleventh centuries, taking up ironworking. From the thirteenth century eastern groups entered the Kenyan and Tanzanian highlands, building the Sirikwa dairying culture of about 1200 to 1800.

The Shilluk under Nyikang settled the White Nile around 1500 and made Fashoda their capital around 1700, while Luo migrants spread around Lake Victoria and the Dinka kept their transhumant herds in the Sudd marshes. Through these centuries the Nilotic tongues remained unwritten, carried by oral tradition.
zh:
尼罗特语族是尼罗—撒哈拉语系东苏丹语族下的一支，分布范围从白尼罗河流域向南延伸到乌干达、肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚，分为西、东、南三支。早在公元前3000年，尼罗河东岸已形成原始尼罗特语，卡德罗遗址就是其牧人社会的遗存。

4—5世纪库施王国崩溃后，尼罗特语人群在5—11世纪从中苏丹南迁，并掌握了冶铁。13世纪起，东部群体进入肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚高原，形成约1200—1800年以乳牛牧业为特征的锡里克瓦文化。

希卢克人在尼坎格率领下约于1500年定居白尼罗河，1700年前后定都法绍达；卢奥人沿维多利亚湖扩散，丁卡人则赶着随季节迁移的牛群留在萨德沼泽。整个这一时期，尼罗特诸语没有文字，靠口耳相传。

en:
North Volta groups together several Niger-Congo branches spread across the savanna between the upper Volta and Ubangi rivers. The largest is Gur, once called Voltaic after the Volta River, whose leading language is Mòoré, spoken by the Mossi; their kingdoms, chief among them Ouagadougou, took shape from the 1200s and dominated present-day Burkina Faso.

To the west lie the Senufo languages of the Mali-Ivory Coast borderlands, much influenced by neighbouring Mande, while the Kru languages run along the Liberian and Ivorian coast, their membership of Niger-Congo disputed. Eastward the Adamawa languages cover the Adamawa plateau, Bua reaches southern Chad, and the Ubangian family is centred on the Central African Republic, where Sango served the river trade.

Nearly all these tongues remained unwritten vernaculars. Commerce and Islamic learning were carried in Mande languages such as Jula or in Arabic.
zh:
北沃尔特语族归并了尼日尔—刚果语系的若干语支，分布在沃尔特河上游与乌班吉河之间的草原。最大的一支是古尔语，旧称沃尔特语，得名于沃尔特河，代表语言是莫西人说的莫西语；莫西诸王国以瓦加杜古为首，自13世纪起成形，统辖今布基纳法索一带。

西边是马里与科特迪瓦边境的塞努福诸语，深受邻近曼德语的影响；克鲁诸语沿利比里亚和科特迪瓦海岸分布，其是否属于尼日尔—刚果语系尚有争议。向东，阿达马瓦诸语覆盖阿达马瓦高原，布阿语群延伸到乍得南部；乌班吉语族以中非共和国为中心，桑戈语在当地河运贸易中通行。

这些语言几乎都是没有文字的口头语言。商业和伊斯兰学问则靠迪乌拉语等曼德语言或阿拉伯语进行。

en:
Northern Yutonahua is the northern branch of the Uto-Aztecan family, gathering the Numic languages together with Hopi and the Takic group across the western United States. Numic takes its name from a reconstructed word for a person, and its peoples traditionally lived by hunting and gathering across the Great Basin and the Snake and Colorado River country.

Linguists place the Proto-Numic homeland in the southern Sierra Nevada. From there a slow expansion carried related dialects across the basin during the last thousand years.

Hopi belongs instead to the maize-farming Pueblo world of northern Arizona, where the mesa village of Oraibi was founded before 1100, while Takic languages served the coasts and deserts of southern California. By the 1300s these related tongues stretched from the Sierra Nevada to the Rocky Mountains.
zh:
北犹他‑纳瓦语系是犹他-阿兹特克语系的北支，由努米克诸语、霍皮语和塔基克语组构成，通行于美国西部。“努米克”得名于构拟出的“人”一词，其族群传统上以渔猎采集为生，活动于大盆地及斯内克河、科罗拉多河流域。

语言学家把原始努米克语的故地定在内华达山脉南部。过去一千年里，缓慢的扩张从那里把亲属方言带到了整个盆地。

霍皮语属于亚利桑那北部种植玉米的普韦布洛世界，建于1100年以前的台地村庄奥赖比即其聚落；塔基克语言通行于南加利福尼亚的海岸与沙漠。到14世纪，这些亲属语言已从内华达山脉延伸到落基山脉。

en:
The Oceanic languages form the easternmost major branch of the Austronesian family, comprising some 450 tongues spread across Polynesia, Micronesia and Melanesia, from the Bismarck Archipelago to Fiji, Tonga and Samoa.

Their reconstructed ancestor, Proto-Oceanic, was carried by the seafarers of the Lapita culture, who between 1600 and 500 BCE spread out of the Bismarck Archipelago with dentate-stamped pottery and outrigger canoes, reaching Tonga and Samoa by roughly 1000 BCE. Later Polynesian voyagers settled Hawaii, New Zealand and Easter Island in the first millennium of the current era.

Long contact with the Papuan languages of northern New Guinea reshaped Oceanic grammar while leaving its Austronesian vocabulary largely intact, producing the dense linguistic mosaic of the Solomon Sea. European navigators entered this world from the sixteenth century, beginning with the Spanish voyage of Álvaro de Mendaña to the Solomons in 1568.
zh:
泛太平洋语系又称大洋洲语族，是南岛语系最东端的大分支，约有450种语言，分布于波利尼西亚、密克罗尼西亚和美拉尼西亚，从俾斯麦群岛到斐济、汤加和萨摩亚。

拉皮塔文化航海者传播了构拟出的原始大洋洲语：公元前1600—前500年，他们带着齿纹陶器和支腿独木舟驶出俾斯麦群岛，约在公元前1000年抵达汤加和萨摩亚。此后波利尼西亚航海者在公元第一个千年定居夏威夷、新西兰和复活节岛。

同新几内亚北部巴布亚语言长期接触，重塑了大洋洲诸语的语法，南岛语词汇却大体保留，造就了所罗门海语言密布的景象。欧洲航海家16世纪进入这片海域，最早的是1568年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚前往所罗门群岛的西班牙远航。

en:
The Oto-Manguean family is the most diverse indigenous language family of Mesoamerica. Its languages are native to Mexico, though the extinct Manguean branch once reached Nicaragua and Costa Rica. Proto-Oto-Manguean is estimated to have been spoken as early as the fourth millennium BC. The principal branches are Zapotecan and Mixtecan in Oaxaca and Oto-Pamean in central Mexico, led by Otomi.

Uniquely among the language families of the Americas, every Oto-Manguean language is tonal. Zapotec speakers raised Monte Albán around 500 BC and carved some of Mesoamerica's earliest inscriptions, and Mixtec painters later recorded royal genealogies in pictorial codices. By the 1300s Mixtec and Zapotec kingdoms divided the valleys of Oaxaca, while Otomi towns bordered the Nahua-speaking highlands.
zh:
欧托‑曼格语系是中美洲内部分化最深的原住民语系，各语言均为墨西哥本土语言，已消亡的曼格语支还曾远播至尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加。据估，原始欧托‑曼格语早在公元前第四千纪即已通行。主要分支包括瓦哈卡的萨波特克语和米斯特克语，以及墨西哥中部以奥托米语为首的欧托‑帕梅语组。

在美洲各语系中，唯独欧托‑曼格语系的所有成员都是声调语言。说萨波特克语的先民约在公元前500年建起阿尔万山城，留下中美洲最早的一批铭文，米斯特克画师后来则以绘图手抄本记录王族世系。到14世纪，米斯特克与萨波特克诸邦分治瓦哈卡各河谷，奥托米人的城镇则与说纳瓦语的高地相邻。

en:
The Papuan Gulf languages form a proposed family of Papuan languages spoken in the swampy lowlands inland from the Gulf of Papua, in southern Papua New Guinea. Its members are each confined to a river or lake district: Rumu lies near the Kikori and Turama rivers, the Kutubuan group takes its name from Lake Kutubu, and Gogodala is spoken on the Fly and Aramia River floodplains, where dugout canoes traditionally served as the main means of transport.

The Spanish expedition of Luís Vaz de Torres passed through the nearby Torres Strait in 1606. Linguists have assigned the branches to the Trans–New Guinea family or treated them as a distinct Papuan Gulf stock, and their mutual relationship remains debated.
zh:
巴布亚湾语族是学者提出的一个巴布亚诸语言语族，通行于巴布亚新几内亚南部、巴布亚湾内侧的沼泽低地。其成员语言各自局限于河湖地带：鲁穆语分布在基科里河与图拉马河一带，库图布语群以库图布湖得名，戈戈达拉语通行于弗莱河与阿拉米亚河的洪泛平原，当地传统上以独木舟为主要交通工具。

路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯率领的西班牙探险队于1606年穿过附近的托雷斯海峡。学界或将各分支并入跨新几内亚语系，或把它们视为独立的巴布亚湾语族，彼此之间的亲缘关系尚无定论。

en:
The Philippine languages are a Malayo-Polynesian subgroup of the Austronesian family, numbering about 150 and covering the Philippine archipelago and northern Sulawesi. They include Tagalog, the Visayan languages, Ilocano, Bikol, Kapampangan and the Danao languages of Mindanao. Linguists attribute the family's unusual uniformity to the spread of a single ancestral speech that effaced earlier variety.

The oldest surviving document is the Laguna Copperplate Inscription of 900, engraved in the Kawi script in an Old Malay heavy with Sanskrit loanwords. By the sixteenth century the Luzon peoples wrote their languages in Baybayin, a Brahmic abugida, until Spanish rule gradually replaced it with the Latin alphabet.
zh:
菲律宾语族是南岛语系马来—波利尼西亚语族下的一个分支，约有150种语言，通行于菲律宾群岛以及苏拉威西北部。成员包括他加禄语、米沙鄢诸语、伊洛卡诺语、比科尔语、邦板牙语和棉兰老岛的达瑙诸语。语言学家认为这一语族异常统一，是一种原始母语扩散后抹平早先差异的结果。

现存最早的文献是900年的拉古那铜版铭文，用卡威文刻写，所用古马来语中充斥梵语借词。到16世纪，吕宋各民族已用婆罗米系元音附标文字贝贝因字母书写本地语言，西班牙统治后逐渐被拉丁字母取代。

en:
Plains Algonquian is the conventional name for the Algonquian languages of the North American Great Plains, among them Blackfoot, Cheyenne and Arapaho. It is an areal rather than a genetic grouping: their speakers lived near one another, but the languages share no single common ancestor distinct from other Algonquian tongues. They have changed markedly from reconstructed Proto-Algonquian in sounds and vocabulary.

At first European contact in the sixteenth century, the Cheyenne lived as settled villagers in Minnesota. During the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries pressure from neighbouring peoples drove them and the Arapaho west across the Missouri onto the plains.

There they took up nomadic bison hunting and horse culture, the Cheyenne passing horses on to the Lakota around 1730. Farther north and west, the Blackfoot occupied the grasslands of Montana and Alberta.
zh:
平原阿尔冈昆语族是北美大平原上几种阿尔冈昆语的习惯统称，包括黑脚语、夏安语和阿拉帕霍语。这是按地域而非谱系划分的类别：使用者彼此相邻而居，但这些语言并无区别于其他阿尔冈昆语的共同祖先。它们在语音和词汇上都与构拟出的原始阿尔冈昆语差异显著。

16世纪欧洲人初次接触时，夏安人在明尼苏达一带过着定居的村落生活。17至18世纪初，在邻近部族的压力下，夏安人与阿拉帕霍人西渡密苏里河进入大平原。

他们转为游牧猎牛、牧马骑射，夏安人约在1730年把马匹文化传给了拉科塔人。黑脚人则活动在更西北方的蒙大拿与阿尔伯达草原上。

en:
The Polynesian languages form a group within the Oceanic branch of the Austronesian family. Their speakers descend from Lapita navigators who settled the Tonga and Samoa area about three thousand years ago; roughly a millennium of shared development produced Proto-Polynesian, their common ancestor. Polynesian voyagers then scattered across the Pacific, reaching the Society Islands, the Marquesas, the Hawaiian archipelago by about 300 CE, distant Rapa Nui and finally New Zealand, while other groups settled as outliers across the western Pacific. The family divides into the Tongic branch of Tongan and Niuean and the much larger Nuclear Polynesian branch, and its languages still share a common stock of words, including tapu, ariki and kava.

Long transmitted orally through genealogies and chants, the languages were first written by outsiders: after James Cook's recorded arrival in Hawaii in 1778, missionaries landing in 1820 soon gave Hawaiian a Latin alphabet and printed its first books. On Rapa Nui, the indigenous rongorongo glyphs incised on wooden tablets have never been deciphered.
zh:
波利尼西亚语族属于南岛语系大洋洲语支。其使用者是拉皮塔航海者的后裔：约三千年前，拉皮塔人在汤加和萨摩亚一带定居，经过约一千年的共同发展，形成了它们的共同祖先——原始波利尼西亚语。此后波利尼西亚航海者四散于太平洋，约300年时抵达夏威夷群岛，又先后到达社会群岛、马克萨斯群岛、遥远的拉帕努伊，最后到达新西兰；另有一些群体作为域外波利尼西亚人定居在西太平洋各地。该语族分为汤加语、纽埃语所在的汤加语支和规模大得多的核心波利尼西亚语支，各语言仍保有一批同源词，如塔普（禁忌）、阿里基（首领）和卡瓦。

这些语言长期靠族谱与圣歌口耳相传，最早的文字出自外来者之手：1778年詹姆斯·库克有记载地抵达夏威夷后，1820年登陆的传教士很快用拉丁字母为夏威夷语制定拼写规范并印出最初的书籍。在拉帕努伊，刻于木板上的本土朗戈朗戈符号则始终未能破译。

en:
The Romance languages descend from Vulgar Latin, the speech of Roman soldiers, settlers and traders, and form the only surviving Italic branch of Indo-European. Between 350 BC and 150 AD the Roman Empire carried Latin across Western Europe, the Balkans and North Africa; when imperial communications collapsed in the fifth century, dialects drifted apart under Germanic and Slavic influence.

By the early Middle Ages they had become distinct tongues, while Latin remained the written language of church and scholarship. The Council of Tours recognised the vernacular in 813, and the Oaths of Strasbourg of 842 survive as an early French text.

From the tenth century writers such as Dante Alighieri raised Tuscan and other vernaculars into literary languages. Printing later hardened favoured dialects into standards, and from the fifteenth century Spanish, Portuguese and French were carried overseas by colonial empires.
zh:
罗曼语族由罗马士兵、移民和商人所说的俗拉丁语演化而来，是印欧语系意大利语族下唯一留存的分支。公元前350年至公元150年间，罗马帝国的扩张把拉丁语带到西欧、巴尔干和北非；5世纪帝国交通体系崩溃后，各地方言在日耳曼语和斯拉夫语影响下逐渐分化。

到中世纪早期，它们已演变为不同的语言，而拉丁语仍是教会和学术的书面语。813年的图尔会议承认了俗语的地位，842年的《斯特拉斯堡誓言》是存世的早期法语文本。

10世纪起，但丁·阿利吉耶里等作家使托斯卡纳语等俗语升为文学语言。印刷术后来把受青睐的方言固定为标准语，15世纪起，西班牙语、葡萄牙语和法语又随殖民帝国传向海外。

en:
The Saharan languages are a small Nilo-Saharan family of the eastern Sahara, stretching from southern Libya and north-western Sudan through Chad and eastern Niger to north-eastern Nigeria. Its chief members are Kanuri around Lake Chad, the Tebu tongues and Zaghawa.

Kanuri was the language of the Kanem-Bornu empire, founded around 700, which accepted Islam in the eleventh century, peaked under Dunama II in the thirteenth century, and after losing Kanem in the fourteenth century re-established itself in Bornu, peaking again under Idris Alooma in the late 1500s. Kanuri was written in the Arabic-based ajami script.

The Tebu and Zaghawa remained largely nomadic pastoralists whose tongues were seldom written. Songhay, also grouped here, is the language of Gao, Timbuktu and the Songhai empire; its place within Nilo-Saharan is disputed, though some linguists unite it with Saharan as a Songhay-Saharan branch.
zh:
撒哈拉语族是尼罗—撒哈拉语系的小语族，分布在撒哈拉东部，从利比亚南部和苏丹西北部，经乍得、尼日尔东部，直到尼日利亚东北部。主要成员有乍得湖一带的卡努里语、图布人的语言和扎加瓦语。

卡努里语是加涅姆—博尔努帝国的语言：帝国约建于700年，11世纪接受伊斯兰教，13世纪在杜纳马二世治下鼎盛；14世纪失去加涅姆后，在博尔努重建，16世纪末伊德里斯·阿卢马时代再登极盛。卡努里语用阿拉伯字母改造的阿贾米文字书写。

图布人和扎加瓦人多为游牧牧民，语言很少形诸文字。桑海语也归入此处，是加奥、廷巴克图和桑海帝国的语言；它在尼罗—撒哈拉语系中的位置有争议，但也有语言学家将它与撒哈拉诸语合为“桑海—撒哈拉”分支。

en:
The Sal, or Brahmaputran, languages form a Tibeto-Burman branch around the Brahmaputra valley, spoken across northeast India, Bangladesh, northern Myanmar and adjacent Yunnan. They comprise Bodo–Garo, Konyak and the Kachinic branch headed by Jingpho; the group is named after the shared root sal, meaning sun.

Most of these tongues long remained without writing. The exception is Meitei, the language of the Manipur valley, whose Meitei Mayek letters appear on sixth-century coins and whose literature runs from the first-century epic Numit Kappa to the Loyumba Shinyen, a law code finalised in 1100. After king Pamheiba adopted Bengali-Assamese letters in the early 1700s, the old script fell out of use for several generations.
zh:
萨尔语群又称布拉马普特拉语群，是藏缅语族下围绕布拉马普特拉河谷分布的一支，通行于印度东北部、孟加拉国、缅甸北部及毗邻的中国云南。成员包括博多—加罗诸语、科尼亚克诸语和以景颇语为首的景颇语支；语群得名于各支语言里表示“太阳”的共同词根。

这些语言大多长期没有文字，例外是曼尼普尔河谷的梅泰语：梅泰字母已出现在6世纪的钱币上，其文学从1世纪的史诗《努米特卡帕》延续到1100年定稿的法典《洛亚姆巴辛延》。18世纪初，国王帕姆海巴改用孟加拉—阿萨姆字母，梅泰字母随之废弃了数代人。

en:
The Semitic languages form a branch of the Afroasiatic family, native to Western Asia and the Horn of Africa and united by a system of consonantal, usually three-letter, roots. Their earliest written records are Akkadian and Eblaite texts in cuneiform from around 2600 BC.

Aramaic, first attested in the twelfth century BC, became the lingua franca of the Neo-Assyrian Empire in the eighth century BC and kept that role under the Babylonian and Persian empires.

Arabic was carried across the Near East and North Africa by the Arab conquests of the seventh and eighth centuries and became, as the language of the Quran, a literary language of the medieval world. Hebrew and Aramaic remained the scriptural languages of Judaism, Syriac served the eastern churches, and most of these languages used consonantal abjad alphabets.
zh:
闪米特语族是亚非语系的一支，原通行于西亚和非洲之角，以辅音词根，通常为三辅音根构词为共同特征。现存最早的记录，是约公元前2600年用楔形文字写下的阿卡德语和埃布拉语文本。

阿拉姆语最早见于公元前12世纪，公元前8世纪被新亚述帝国采用为通用语，其后的新巴比伦帝国和波斯帝国也沿用不改。

阿拉伯语在7至8世纪随阿拉伯征服传遍近东和北非，并作为《古兰经》的语言成为中世纪的文学语言。希伯来语和阿拉姆语始终是犹太教的经典语言，叙利亚语则服务于东方教会；这些语言大多使用只表辅音的阿布贾字母书写。

en:
The Siouan or Siouan–Catawban family comprises around twenty indigenous languages spread across the North American Great Plains, the Ohio and Mississippi valleys and the southeastern Piedmont. Its Catawban branch, once spoken in the Carolinas, diverged early from the Western Siouan languages, which include Dakota, Chiwere and Dhegiha.

Dhegiha speakers farmed and hunted along the lower Missouri and Mississippi, while Chiwere belonged to the Iowa, Otoe and Missouria. Before the 1600s the Dakota lived as woodland hunters and wild-rice gatherers around Lake Superior.

The long Dakota–Ojibwe war of the 1700s drove them west onto the plains, where horses turned the Lakota into mounted bison hunters. The Tutelo of Virginia and the Crow of Montana show how widely Siouan peoples had scattered by the colonial era.
zh:
苏语系又称苏—卡托巴语系，包含约二十种原住民语言，分布在北美大平原、俄亥俄河谷与密西西比河谷以及东南部皮德蒙特一带。卡托巴语支较早分出，曾通行于南北卡罗来纳；西苏语支包括达科他语、奇韦雷语和德吉哈语。

操德吉哈语的人在密苏里河下游与密西西比河沿岸农耕狩猎，奇韦雷语则属于艾奥瓦人、奥托人和密苏里亚人。17世纪以前，达科他人在苏必利尔湖一带从事林地狩猎和采集野稻。

18世纪漫长的达科他—奥吉布瓦战争把他们推向西部大平原，马匹又使拉科塔人成为骑马猎牛的游牧者。弗吉尼亚的图特洛人和蒙大拿的克劳人，说明殖民时代苏语族群分布之广。

en:
The Slavic languages form a branch of Indo-European, descending from Proto-Slavic. Their earliest reconstructable homeland lay around the Dnipro basin.

From the sixth century Slavic speech spread across Eastern Europe and the Balkans, carried by migrants entering the Eastern Roman Empire; by the seventh century the dialects were separating into West, East and South branches.

The Slavs long wrote in foreign scripts, but in 863 the Byzantine brothers Cyril and Methodius created the Glagolitic alphabet for their mission to Great Moravia and translated the Gospels into Old Church Slavonic, the first Slavic literary language. Driven from Moravia, their pupils carried it to the Bulgarian Empire, where the Cyrillic script was devised at Preslav and made official in 893, becoming the writing system of the Orthodox Slavs and later of Kievan Rus.
zh:
斯拉夫语族是印欧语系的一支，由原始斯拉夫语演化而来。可构拟的最早祖居地在第聂伯河流域。

6世纪起，斯拉夫人向东罗马帝国境内迁徙，斯拉夫语传遍东欧和巴尔干，7世纪时方言逐渐分成西、东、南三支。

斯拉夫人曾长期借外族文字书写，863年，拜占庭修士兄弟西里尔与美多德为出使大摩拉维亚创制格拉哥里字母，并把福音书译成第一种斯拉夫文学语言古教会斯拉夫语。他们的门生被逐出摩拉维亚后把古教会斯拉夫语带入保加利亚帝国，西里尔字母在普雷斯拉夫问世，并于893年成为官方文字，后来成为东正教斯拉夫人以及基辅罗斯的书写系统。

en:
The Solomonic group corresponds to the Southeast Solomonic family, a branch of the Oceanic languages spoken across the eastern Solomon Islands, from Santa Isabel through Guadalcanal and Malaita to Makira. Its twenty-odd languages share the merger of the Proto-Oceanic consonants l and R, and their close similarity points to a relatively recent dispersal.

Austronesian speakers of the Lapita culture reached the archipelago between about 1200 and 800 BCE, mixing with older island populations whose unrelated Central Solomon languages still survive on a few islands. The first European to reach the Solomons was the Spanish navigator Álvaro de Mendaña, who sighted the islands in 1568 and returned in 1595.
zh:
所罗门群岛语族对应东南所罗门语族，是大洋洲语支的一支，通行于所罗门群岛东部，从圣伊莎贝尔岛经瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、马莱塔岛一直延伸到马基拉岛。它的二十余种语言都合并了原始大洋洲语的l与R两个辅音，彼此差异很小，说明分化时间相对较晚。

约公元前1200年至前800年，南岛语系的拉皮塔人抵达这片群岛并与更早的居民融合，后者那些与南岛语无关的中所罗门语言仍在少数岛屿上留存。最早到达所罗门群岛的欧洲人是西班牙航海家阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚，他于1568年望见这些岛屿，并在1595年再度远航至此。

en:
South Semitic is the southernmost Semitic branch, part of Afroasiatic, and comprises eastern and western arms. Old South Arabian was spoken in Yemen's caravan kingdoms and carved in stone in the angular South Arabian alphabet from the beginning of the first millennium BCE; related tongues such as Mehri persisted along the coasts of Mahra, Dhofar and Socotra.

Across the Red Sea, migrants from Arabia carried the western arm into the Horn of Africa around 800 BCE, where it became the Ethio-Semitic group. Its classical language is Ge'ez, first attested in an inscription of about 400 CE at Metera and adopted by the kings of Aksum, who made Christianity their state religion in the mid-fourth century.

The Ge'ez abugida became the script of church and state in the Ethiopian highlands, and later languages such as Amharic and Tigrinya descend from the same stock.
zh:
南闪米特语族是闪米特语族最南边的一支，后者属于亚非语系；南闪米特语族分为东西两支。阿拉伯半岛的古南阿拉伯诸语曾通行于也门的商队王国，自公元前1000年起用棱角分明的南阿拉伯字母刻写在石碑上；与之同源的迈赫拉语等语言长期流传于马赫拉、佐法尔和索科特拉沿海。

约公元前800年，来自阿拉伯半岛的移民渡过红海，把西支带到非洲之角，发展成埃塞俄比亚闪米特语群。其古典语言吉兹语最早见于约400年梅特拉的碑刻，后来被阿克苏姆诸王采用，阿克苏姆又在4世纪中叶定基督教为国教。

吉兹字母成为埃塞俄比亚高原教会与国家的书写系统，后来的阿姆哈拉语、提格雷尼亚语等都出自这一语群。

en:
South Volta groups the Kwa, Volta-Niger and Bantoid branches, the southern core of the Volta-Congo division of the Niger-Congo family. Its languages run from southeastern Ghana through Togo and Benin into southern Nigeria and Cameroon: Kwa carries Akan and Gbe along the Guinea coast, while Volta-Niger includes Yoruba, Igbo and Bini.

Bantoid, centred on the Nigeria-Cameroon border, contains the Bantu languages, whose expansion beginning around 1000 BC carried related speech across most of subequatorial Africa. The South Volta languages are tonal and share elaborate noun-class systems and vowel harmony; by the 1300s they served such powers as Ife, Benin and Oyo.
zh:
南沃尔特语族归并了夸语支、沃尔特-尼日尔语支和班托伊德语支，是尼日尔-刚果语系沃尔特-刚果语支的南部核心。其语言从加纳东南部经多哥、贝宁延伸到尼日利亚南部和喀麦隆：夸语支的阿坎语、格贝语通行于几内亚湾沿岸；沃尔特-尼日尔语支包括约鲁巴语、伊博语和比尼语。

班托伊德语支以尼日利亚与喀麦隆交界为中心，其中的班图诸语从约公元前1000年起向外扩散，把亲属语言带到了撒哈拉以南非洲的大部。南沃尔特诸语都是声调语言，普遍拥有复杂的名词类系统和元音和谐；到14世纪，它们已成为伊费、贝宁、奥约等政权使用的语言。

en:
Southern Yutonahua is the Mexican branch of the Uto-Aztecan family, strung along the Sierra Madre Occidental from Sonora and Chihuahua down to the Valley of Mexico and, through the migrant Nawat tongue, as far as Central America. Its branches include Tepiman, Tarahumaran, Cahitan, Opata, Coracholan and Nahuan, the languages of the Nahuas.

Nahuatl has been spoken in central Mexico since at least the 600s, and by the 1300s the Mexica of Tenochtitlan were carrying their dialect across the highlands as a language of power. These languages are agglutinative, and Nahuatl grew highly polysynthetic, sharing calques and traits with Maya, Mixtec and other neighbours in the Mesoamerican Linguistic Area.

After the Spanish conquest missionaries gave Nahuatl the Latin alphabet, and the Classical Nahuatl of the 1500s produced grammars, poetry and the twelve books of the Florentine Codex.
zh:
南犹他‑纳瓦语系是犹他-阿兹特克语系分布在墨西哥的一支，沿西马德雷山脉从索诺拉、奇瓦瓦延伸到墨西哥谷地，移民带去的纳瓦特语更南抵中美洲。它的分支包括特皮曼、塔拉乌马拉、卡伊塔、奥帕塔、科拉乔尔语组，以及纳瓦人的纳瓦语组。

纳瓦特尔语至迟在7世纪已通行于墨西哥中部；到14世纪，特诺奇蒂特兰的墨西卡人正把自己的方言作为权势语言带上高原。南方诸语多为黏着语，纳瓦特尔语更发展出高度多式综合的形态，并在中美洲语言区域内与玛雅语、米斯特克语等邻语互相借用。

西班牙征服后，传教士为纳瓦特尔语配上拉丁字母，16世纪的古典纳瓦特尔语留下了语法书、诗歌和十二卷本的《佛罗伦萨手抄本》。

en:
The Tai, or Zhuang–Tai, languages form the principal branch of the Kra–Dai family, stretching from Guangxi and Guizhou in southern China to the Shan hills of Myanmar and the kingdoms of Laos and Siam. Comparative linguists derive them from Proto-Kra–Dai, placed in the lower Yangtze valley.

Chinese texts of the first millennium BC called the non-Sinitic peoples of the south the Yue; the Song of the Yue Boatman, transcribed in Chinese characters in 528 BC, is among the earliest records of their speech.

The Zhuang split from the southwestern languages between the second century BC and the sixth century AD, and Southwestern Tai speakers dispersed between the 700s and 900s. The southwestern peoples adopted Brahmi-derived alphabets, with the Thai script appearing in the 1200s, while the Zhuang wrote in Chinese-derived characters known as Sawndip.
zh:
壮傣语族是壮侗语系下最主要的语支，分布从中国南方的广西、贵州，一直延伸到缅甸掸邦山区以及老挝、暹罗两地。比较语言学家把它们追溯到原乡在长江下游的原始壮侗语。

公元前一千纪的汉文文献把南方的非汉语民族称为越人，公元前528年用汉字记音的《越人歌》就是其语言最早的记录之一。

壮语与西南诸语的分化发生在公元前2世纪至公元6世纪之间，西南壮傣语人群则在8至10世纪向外扩散。西南各民族采用源自婆罗米字母的文字，泰文于13世纪出现；壮族则使用仿照汉字创制的方块壮字书写自己的语言。

en:
The Tibetic languages form a branch of Tibeto-Burman within the Sino-Tibetan family, descended from Old Tibetan of the seventh to ninth centuries and comprising about fifty languages across the Tibetan Plateau and the Himalayas. Their closest relatives include the West Himalayish languages, among them Zhangzhung, the speech of the early Bon religion.

Under the Tibetan Empire of the seventh century, King Songtsen Gampo's court commissioned a script, traditionally credited to minister Thonmi Sambhota, who modelled an abugida on the Gupta script of northern India; the earliest annals survive from around 650 and stone inscriptions from the eighth century.

The empire's translation of Buddhist scriptures fixed Classical Tibetan, the shared literary language of Tibetic speakers and Tibetan Buddhism. The spoken tongues diverged into regional forms such as Lhasa, Khams and Amdo Tibetan, some developing tones absent from the classical language.
zh:
藏语族是汉藏语系藏缅语下的一支，由7—9世纪的古藏语演化而来，共包括约五十种语言，分布在青藏高原和喜马拉雅山区。与它关系最近的有西喜马拉雅语群，其中包括早期苯教使用的象雄语。

7世纪吐蕃帝国时期，松赞干布王的宫廷命人创制文字，传统上归功于大臣吞弥·桑布扎：他以北印度的笈多字母为蓝本设计出一套元音附标文字；现存最早的编年史约成于650年，石刻铭文见于8世纪。

吐蕃翻译佛经，固定了古典藏语，使它成为藏语族群和藏传佛教共同的文学语言。口语则分化为拉萨藏语、康巴藏语、安多藏语等地区形式，其中一些发展出古典藏语所没有的声调。

en:
The Trans-Fly languages form a small family of Papuan languages spoken around the lower Fly River of southern New Guinea, on the Oriomo Plateau and along the Paho River. Its two main branches are the Oriomo, or Eastern Trans-Fly, group, whose Meriam speech also extends into the Torres Strait islands, and the Pahoturi group, a chain of about eight closely related village varieties.

The Spanish navigator Luís Vaz de Torres was the first recorded European visitor to the adjacent waters; his expedition sailed through the Torres Strait in 1606. Pahoturi-speaking communities originally lived by hunting and gathering before turning to gardening. Linguists have differed over whether the family belongs to Trans–New Guinea or stands on its own.
zh:
外弗莱语族是一个小型巴布亚诸语言语族，通行于新几内亚岛南部弗莱河下游的奥里奥莫高原和帕霍河沿岸。它主要有两个分支：奥里奥莫语支又称东外弗莱语支，其中的梅里亚姆语还延伸到托雷斯海峡岛屿；帕霍图里语支则由约八种相近的村落方言连成一条方言链。

有记载最早驶入邻近水域的欧洲人是西班牙航海家路易斯·瓦斯·德·托雷斯，他的探险队于1606年驶过托雷斯海峡。帕霍图里语族群原本以狩猎采集为生，后来转为经营园圃。学界对该语族是否属于跨新几内亚语系一直存在分歧。

en:
The Trans-New Guinea family is the great family of Papuan languages, spread across New Guinea and neighbouring islands from the Bomberai Peninsula to the Huon Peninsula, with outliers on Timor, Alor and Pantar. With several hundred languages it may be the world's third-largest family, though its outer membership remains debated while its highland core is well established. Shared verbal object prefixes are the strongest evidence linking them.

Their speakers are heirs to one of the independent origins of agriculture: drainage works and taro cultivation in the Wahgi valley's Kuk Swamp go back some 9000 years, with bananas and sugarcane grown there by 6500 years ago.

Austronesian seafarers settled the coasts roughly 3500 years ago, beginning millennia of contact between the two traditions, and Spanish explorers gave New Guinea its name in 1545.
zh:
跨新几内亚语系是巴布亚诸语言中最大的语系，遍布新几内亚岛及邻近岛屿，西起邦巴赖半岛、东至休恩半岛，边缘成员远及帝汶岛、阿洛岛和潘塔尔岛。它包含数百种语言，可能是世界上语言数量第三多的语系；其高地核心分支已有扎实证据，但外围成员的归属仍有争议。联系这些语言的最强证据是共有的动词宾语前缀。

使用者所在的高地还是农业独立起源地之一：瓦吉谷地库克沼泽的排灌工程和芋头种植可追溯到约9000年前，6500年前当地人已栽培香蕉和甘蔗。

约3500年前，南岛语族航海者定居沿海，开启了两大传统数千年的接触；1545年，西班牙探险者为这座岛屿取了新几内亚之名。

en:
The Tungusic or Manchu-Tungus languages are spoken across eastern Siberia, Manchuria and the Amur basin, and divide into northern and southern branches. Their common ancestor, Proto-Tungusic, is placed in the middle Amur or Lake Khanka region, from which Tungusic speakers spread north into Siberia during the early centuries of the Common Era.

The earliest written member is Jurchen, the language of the Jin dynasty that ruled northern China from 1115 to 1234; in 1119 Wanyan Xiyin devised a Jurchen script modelled on Khitan writing, preserved on stelae such as the victory monument erected in 1185.

In 1599 Nurhaci had a Manchu alphabet adapted from Mongolian script, and in 1635 Hong Taiji renamed Jurchen Manchu, in which the Qing empire kept official records. Other Siberian and Amur tongues long remained unwritten vernaculars of reindeer herders, hunters and fishing peoples.
zh:
满—通古斯语族分布于西伯利亚东部、满洲和阿穆尔河流域，分为南北两支。语言学家多把其共同祖语原始通古斯语的原乡放在阿穆尔河中游或兴凯湖一带，通古斯语人群在公元最初几个世纪由此向北扩散到西伯利亚。

语族最早有文字的是女真语，即1115—1234年统治中国北方的金朝的语言；1119年，完颜希尹参照契丹文字创制女真文字，其面貌保存在1185年所立得胜陀颂碑等碑刻上。

1599年，努尔哈赤命人在蒙古文字母基础上改制成满文；1635年，皇太极下令将女真语改称满语，清朝即以满文书写官方文书。西伯利亚与阿穆尔河其他语言则长期没有文字，是驯鹿牧民、猎人和渔猎民族的口头语言。

en:
The Turkic family comprises more than thirty-five languages spread across Eurasia, grouped into branches of Common Turkic and the separate Oghuric branch, whose only surviving member is Chuvash.

Linguists place their Proto-Turkic homeland in the Mongolia to Sayan-Altay region of inner Asia. During the Turkic expansion of the 500s to 1000s the languages spread across Central Asia as far as the Middle East and southeastern Europe.

The oldest surviving texts are the Orkhon inscriptions of the Göktürks, erected in the 720s and 730s in a runiform Old Turkic script. In the 1070s Mahmud al-Kashgari of the Kara-Khanid Khanate compiled the first comparative dictionary of Turkic speech, while after the conversion to Islam most western and central Turkic peoples came to write their languages in the Arabic script.
zh:
突厥语族包含三十五种以上语言，分布遍及欧亚大陆，分为共同突厥语的各语支和独立的乌古尔语支，后者仅存楚瓦什语一种。

语言学家把原始突厥语的原乡定在亚洲内陆的蒙古至萨彦—阿尔泰一带。在6—11世纪的突厥扩张中，各语言穿过中亚，一直传播到中东和欧洲东南部。

现存最早的文本是古突厥人在720至730年代用如尼式古突厥文刻写的鄂尔浑碑铭。11世纪70年代，喀喇汗国的麻赫穆德·喀什噶里编纂了第一部突厥语比较词典；在改宗伊斯兰教之后，西部和中部的多数突厥民族转而用阿拉伯字母书写自己的语言。

en:
The Uralic languages form a non-Indo-European family native to northern Eurasia, descended from a reconstructed Proto-Uralic whose homeland most likely lay near the Ural Mountains. Its branches stretch from the Baltic and Fennoscandia to the lower Ob and the Arctic tundra, including Finnic, Sámi, Ugric and Samoyedic languages.

The Roman writer Tacitus described a Uralic people, the Fenni, in his Germania of about 98 AD. The Hungarians, an Ugric people who had moved far to the west, founded their Christian kingdom under Stephen I in 1000, when the Latin alphabet displaced the old Hungarian runes.

Fragments of Hungarian survive in the Tihany abbey charter of 1055 and the first continuous text, the Funeral Sermon, dates to the 1190s. The family is typologically marked by agglutinative grammar, vowel harmony and rich systems of grammatical cases.
zh:
乌拉尔语族是通行于北欧亚的非印欧语系语言，由学者构拟的原始乌拉尔语演化而来，其祖乡最可能在乌拉尔山脉附近。各分支从波罗的海和芬诺斯堪的纳维亚延伸到鄂毕河下游和北极苔原，包括芬兰语群、萨米语、乌戈尔语支和萨莫耶德语群。

罗马作家塔西佗在约98年写成的《日耳曼尼亚志》中描述过一个乌拉尔民族芬尼人。匈牙利人是远徙西方的乌戈尔人，1000年在伊什特万一世治下建立基督教王国，拉丁字母随之取代古老的匈牙利如尼文。

1055年的蒂豪尼修道院特许状留存了匈牙利语残片，第一篇完整匈牙利语文本《葬礼布道文》则成于12世纪90年代。整个语族以黏着语法、元音和谐和繁复的格系统为类型特征。

en:
The Vanuatu group represents the Southern Oceanic linkage, a chain of Austronesian languages spread across the Vanuatu archipelago, New Caledonia and the Loyalty Islands. The islands were first settled between about 1100 and 700 BCE by navigators of the Lapita culture, whose speech diversified as it spread from the Banks Islands in the north to Aneityum in the south and onward to New Caledonia. Vanuatu alone holds 138 indigenous languages, the highest linguistic density in the world, with around two dozen each on Espiritu Santo and Malakula; scholars distinguish North-Central Vanuatu, South Vanuatu and New Caledonian branches, and several of the languages show traces of older Papuan substrata.

The first recorded Europeans to arrive were the Spanish expedition of Pedro Fernandes de Queirós, which reached Espiritu Santo in 1606 and claimed the islands for Spain. James Cook followed in 1774, naming the archipelago the New Hebrides and, on the same voyage, giving New Caledonia its European name.
zh:
瓦努阿图语族对应南大洋洲语链，是南岛语系下一条横跨瓦努阿图群岛、新喀里多尼亚和洛亚蒂群岛的语言链条。约公元前1100年至前700年，拉皮塔文化的航海者最早定居这些岛屿，他们的语言随迁徙分化，从北部的班克斯群岛一直扩散到南部的阿内蒂乌姆岛，并远及新喀里多尼亚。仅瓦努阿图就有138种本土语言，语言密度为世界之最，圣埃斯皮里图岛和马拉库拉岛各有二十余种；学者将它们分为北中瓦努阿图、南瓦努阿图和新喀里多尼亚三个分支，部分语言还带有更古老的巴布亚语言底层痕迹。

有记载最早抵达这里的欧洲人是佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯率领的西班牙探险队，他们于1606年到达圣埃斯皮里图岛并宣布群岛归西班牙所有。1774年詹姆斯·库克接踵而至，将这片群岛命名为新赫布里底群岛，并在同一次航行中为新喀里多尼亚起了欧洲式名称。

en:
A ƭat Roog, the way of the Divine, is the traditional religion of the Serer of Senegambia. It centres on Roog, the supreme deity, and on the pangool, ancestral spirits who intercede between the living and the divine and receive libations.

The Serer hold that the souls of the righteous enter Jaaniw and may be reborn, and they recognise neither heaven nor hell. Every family keeps a totem that is both guardian and taboo, for example the antelope for the Joof.

The Serer and the Jola were among the last peoples of the region to accept Islam or Christianity. In the Kingdom of Sine the old faith held out against marabout armies in the 1800s, and after defeats at Naodorou and Ngaye many Serer killed themselves rather than be conquered.
zh:
鲁格至大教，意为“神之道”，是塞内冈比亚地区塞雷尔人的传统宗教。它以至高神鲁格和祖灵潘古尔为中心：潘古尔在生者与神之间代为说情，人们向他们奉上祭酒。

塞雷尔人相信，正直者的灵魂进入贾尼乌，还可能转世，他们既不承认天堂，也不承认地狱。每个家族都有图腾，既是守护者，也是禁忌，例如乔夫家的图腾是羚羊。

塞雷尔人和乔拉人是这一地区最晚接受伊斯兰教或基督教的民族。在锡内王国，旧信仰在19世纪顶住了马拉布特的军队；在瑙多鲁和恩加耶遭遇失败后，许多塞雷尔人宁死也不愿被征服。

en:
Kwaio religion is the traditional ancestor worship of the Kwaio, a people of central Malaita in the Solomon Islands who lived by swidden farming of taro, yams and plantains. The dead were believed to keep the power to intervene in the affairs of the living, and powerful ancestral forces such as La'aka were greatly feared.

Life was ruled by strict taboos, called abu, and any violation had to be redressed with sacrifices. Kwaio oral tradition says that the land was first cleared some twelve to twenty centuries ago. The cleared tracts are marked by shrines, and these shrines established title to the land for the clans descended from the ancestors who made them.
zh:
夸约禁戒信仰是夸约人的传统祖先崇拜；夸约人住在所罗门群岛马莱塔岛中部，以刀耕火种的方式种植芋头、山药和大蕉为生。人们相信死者仍有力量干预生者的事务，像拉阿卡这样强大的祖先力量尤其令人敬畏。

生活受严格的禁忌约束，这种禁忌叫阿布，违犯者必须以献祭补救。夸约口述传统说，这片土地大约在十二至二十个世纪以前开始开垦。开垦过的地块以神龛标记，这些神龛为开垦者的父系后裔氏族确立了土地所有权。

en:
Abwoi was a cult of male ancestral spirits among the peoples of the central Nigerian plateau, such as the Atyap and Bajju. The spirits were held to be ghosts or reincarnations of the dead, and each people told its own story of where the cult began; the Gwong traced theirs to a village called Agabi, probably in the 1800s.

Initiated men kept strict taboos and guarded the cult's secrets from women on pain of death. The Abwoi ranked below the Heavenly Father, Agwaza, but as demigods nearer to the people they healed the sick and were summoned in crises.

At the start of the rains each April they were escorted away for the farming year, and a cry heard afterwards foretold epidemic or drought. Once a year the whole community gathered for common worship.
zh:
阿布沃伊崇拜是尼日利亚中部高原诸族的男性祖灵崇拜，奉行者有阿蒂亚普人和巴朱人等。人们认为这些灵是亡者的鬼魂或转世，各族对崇拜的起源各有一套说法，格翁人把它追溯到一个叫阿加比的村子，时间大概在19世纪。

入会的男子遵守严格的禁忌，不得向妇女泄露崇拜的秘密，违者处死。阿布沃伊的地位在至高的天父阿格瓦扎之下，但作为更贴近人们的半神，它们能治病，危急时受人召请。

每年4月雨季开始时，阿布沃伊被护送离开，让位于农事；此后若再听到它们的哭声，便预示瘟疫或旱灾。全社群每年还要举行一次共同礼拜。

en: Adamawa stands for the traditional beliefs of the many non-Muslim peoples of the Adamawa highlands and the Benue valley south of Lake Chad, a land of great ethnic, linguistic and religious variety, much of which the Fulani emir Modibbo Adama's jihad of 1809 subjected or raided for slaves.
zh: 阿达马瓦信仰指乍得湖以南阿达马瓦高地和贝努埃河谷诸多非穆斯林民族的传统信仰，这片土地在民族、语言和宗教上都极为多样，其中大部分地区在1809年起的富拉尼人莫迪博·阿达马圣战中被征服，或沦为抓捕奴隶的对象。

en: Adat Musi is a religion of the Talaud Islands in northern Sulawesi, taught by Bawangin Panahal at the village of Musi on Salibabu Island. His followers held that he received revelation from God, called Mawu Ruata, through an intermediary named Onto'a.
zh: 穆希教是苏拉威西北部塔劳群岛的一种宗教，由巴旺因·帕纳哈尔在萨利巴布岛的穆希村传授。信徒相信他从称为“马武·鲁阿塔”的神那里，经由名叫翁托阿的使者领受了启示。

en: Adat Pu'un is the traditional animist belief of the Kenyah of the interior of Borneo, who held that after death a person ascends with the ancestors, the tepun, to Alo Malau, the seven heavens. When Christian missionaries arrived, the old practices were revived for a time as the Bungan movement.
zh: 阿达普恩教是婆罗洲内陆肯雅人的传统万物有灵信仰，相信人死后会同祖先“特普恩”一起升入七重天阿洛马劳。基督教传教士到来后，旧有习俗曾一度以“邦安运动”的名义复兴。

en:
The Ainu religion is the animist belief of the Ainu of Hokkaidō, Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands. Everything in nature has a kamuy, a spirit or god. Among the most important are Kamuy-huci, the hearth goddess; Kim-un-kamuy, god of bears and mountains; and Ae-oyna-kamuy, a culture hero who taught the Ainu weaving and carving.

The Ainu have no professional priests; the village chief conducts the rites, which include libations of sake, prayers and offerings of inau, willow sticks with wooden shavings attached. Bears were believed to bring their hide and meat to humans as a gift from the mountain god.

Burials and houses at Ainu settlements of the thirteenth to seventeenth centuries follow these beliefs. After the Matsumae Domain sent an expedition to Sakhalin in 1635, Japanese traders came into closer contact with the Ainu.
zh:
神威信仰是北海道、库页岛和千岛群岛阿伊努人的万物有灵信仰。自然中的一切都有一位神威，即灵或神。其中最重要的有：灶火女神“神威媪”；山熊神威，熊与山之神；以及阿埃奥伊纳神威，一位文化英雄，教会阿伊努人纺织和雕刻。

阿伊努人没有专职祭司，仪式由村长主持，内容包括献酒、祈祷，以及献上附有木花的柳木棒，即伊瑙。人们相信熊是山神赐给人类的礼物，把毛皮和肉送到人间。

13至17世纪阿伊努聚落的墓葬和房屋，都与这些信仰相符。1635年松前藩派出远征队前往库页岛之后，日本商人与阿伊努人的接触日渐密切。

en:
The Ajok religion is the traditional faith of the Otuho, or Lotuko, a Nilotic people of the Imatong mountains in what is now South Sudan. It is a religion of nature and ancestor worship. Its chief god is Ajok, who made humans in his own image. He is kind to those who pray and offer sacrifices, though he can be angered.

Myth explains how death became permanent: Ajok revived a woman's dead child at her prayer, but her husband, enraged, killed the child again, and Ajok swore never to raise an Otuho from death again and left the earth. The Otuho say the spirits of the dead plead with Ajok on behalf of the living when rain falls.
zh:
阿约克崇拜是奥图霍人（又称洛图科人）的传统信仰，奥图霍人是今南苏丹伊马通山区的尼罗特民族。它是一种以自然和祖先崇拜为基础的宗教。最高神是阿约克，他按自己的样子造出人类；对祈祷献祭的人他是仁慈的，但也会发怒。

神话解释了死亡为何成为永久：阿约克应一位妇女的祈求救活了她死去的孩子，她的丈夫却在盛怒之下又杀死了孩子，阿约克发誓不再让任何奥图霍人死而复生，并离开了大地。奥图霍人说，降雨时是亡者的灵魂在替生者向阿约克恳求。

en:
Akom is the traditional religion of the Akan of what is now Ghana, and in 1337 the Bono state, Bonoman, practised it. It is built around a distant creator, Nyame, who made the world with Asase Yaa, Mother Earth, and left the daily work to lesser gods, the abosom.

The abosom are tied to rivers, mountains and forests and are served by priests, the akomfoo, who fall into trance and speak for them. A god is housed in a shrine, a brass pan holding river stones, and honoured with libations. Bono tradition holds that their ancestors emerged from the sacred hole at Amowi, a memory kept alive at the Apɔɔ festival in Takyiman.

The Asante conquered Bono Manso in 1723, and Akom spread widely on slave ships: in Jamaica, the enslaved Akan kept the names of the abosom.
zh:
阿科姆教是今加纳阿肯人的传统宗教，1337年信奉它的有博诺国博诺曼。它以一位遥远的创造者尼亚梅为核心：他和大地之母阿萨塞亚造出世界，把日常的事务交给次一级的神灵阿博松。

阿博松与河流、山岭和森林相联系，由进入出神状态、替神灵说话的祭司阿科姆福侍奉。神灵住在神龛里，神龛是一只铜盘，盛着河石，人们用奠酒敬奉它。博诺人的传说称先民从阿莫维圣洞走出，塔基曼的阿波节纪念着这一传说。

1723年阿散蒂攻陷博诺曼索；随着贩奴船，阿科姆教传到了远方：在牙买加，被奴役的阿肯人保留了阿博松的名字。

en: The Akinhá Ekugu religion is the belief of the Xingu peoples of central Brazil, in which the world was made by two sibling creators. Among the Kamaiurá of the Upper Xingu, the best-recorded pair of brothers is the divine twin heroes Kwat and Yaì, the Sun and the Moon.
zh: 双生创世神话是巴西中部欣古诸族的信仰，认为世界由两位兄弟般的创造者造出。在上欣古的卡马尤拉人当中，记载最清楚的一对兄弟是太阳与月亮，即神圣的孪生英雄夸特与雅伊。

en:
Akuj is the traditional religion of the Turkana, semi-nomadic camel and zebu herders around Lake Turkana. For the Turkana religion and culture are one, and the aim of each day is to win the blessings of life: water, food, livestock and children.

Akuj is the single Supreme Being, who created the world and controls these blessings. Ancestors, the ngipean, are seen as dangerous, and an angered ancestor may possess a family member and demand an animal sacrifice.

The key figures are the diviners, the ngimurok, the most respected of whom receive revelations from Akuj in dreams and say which animal must be sacrificed. Turkana tradition holds that zebu cattle brought them the wealth and power that let them beat other Ateker peoples and, by the end of the eighteenth century, press into the Siger highlands.
zh:
阿库吉教是图尔卡纳人的传统信仰。图尔卡纳人是图尔卡纳湖一带的半游牧民族，放养骆驼和瘤牛。在他们看来，宗教和文化浑然一体，每天的目标是求得生活的福祉：水、食物、牲畜和子嗣。

阿库吉是唯一的至高存在，创造了世界，掌管这些福祉。祖先恩吉佩安被视为危险的力量，发怒的祖先会附在家人身上，要求献祭牲畜。

关键人物是占卜师恩吉穆罗克，其中最受尊敬的在梦中得到阿库吉的启示，指明该献祭哪种牲畜。图尔卡纳人的传统认为，瘤牛带来了财富和势力，使他们战胜了其他阿特克尔人，到18世纪末又进逼西格尔人的高地。

en:
Alan paganism is the old religion of the Alans, the Iranian-speaking people of the north Caucasus, whose descendants are the Ossetians. It is thought to be of Scythian origin, and later accounts show many Christian elements, with the gods often named after saints. The stories of its gods are woven into the sagas of the Narts, semi-divine heroes.

Uastyrdzhi, named for Saint George, was patron of men and travellers and guarantor of oaths; Uacilla, named for Elijah, sent rain, thunder and lightning. The heavenly smith Kurdalægon befriended the Narts. Certain people dreamed their way to Kurys, the meadow of the dead, and returned with seeds of luck.

The Alan kingdom was Christianized in the early tenth century under Byzantine influence. The Mongols invaded in 1239 or 1240, and Timur broke the Alans in about 1395.
zh:
阿兰多神教是阿兰人的古老宗教。阿兰人是北高加索讲伊朗语的民族，他们的后裔是奥塞梯人。一般认为它起源于斯基泰人，后来的记载中有许多基督教成分，神灵往往以圣徒命名。这些神灵的故事交织在半神英雄纳特人的传说里。

瓦斯蒂尔吉以圣乔治命名，是男子和旅人的保护者，也是誓言的保证人；瓦齐拉以先知以利亚命名，掌管雨、雷和闪电。天上的铁匠库尔达拉贡与纳特人为友。有些人能在梦中走到死者的草地库雷斯，带回幸运的种子。

阿兰王国在10世纪初受拜占庭影响而基督教化。蒙古人于1239或1240年入侵，约1395年帖木儿又击溃了阿兰人。

en:
Aluk, from Aluk Todolo, the Way of the Ancestors, is the traditional religion of the Toraja of the highlands of South Sulawesi. They believed that people, buffalo, rice, iron and rain were sent down from the sky.

The creator is Puang Matua, who made eight beings from a jar and gave the first of them, Datu' Laukku, the rules called aluk. His descendant Pong Mula Tau, the first man, came down a ladder to the earth.

The funeral rite Rambu Solo' was central. A dead person who had not yet had the rites was treated as sick, fed and cared for like the living, and the funeral sacrifices to the gods and spirits, of buffalo above all, were made in expectation of a greater gift in return.
zh:
阿鲁克源自“阿鲁克·托多洛”，意为祖先之道，是苏拉威西岛南部高地托拉查人的传统宗教。他们相信人、水牛、稻谷、铁和雨，都是从天上降下来的。

创世者是普昂·马图阿，他用一只陶罐造出八位始祖，并把名为“阿鲁克”的规矩赐给第一位始祖达图·劳库。他的后裔、第一个人彭·穆拉·陶沿着梯子降到人间。

“兰布·索洛”葬礼是仪式的中心。尚未办过丧礼的死者仍被当作病人，像对待活人一样供给饮食、悉心照料；葬礼上向神灵和祖灵献祭，尤其是宰杀水牛，是期望得到更大的回报。

en:
The Andamanese religion is the animism of the indigenous peoples of the Andaman Islands, in which the worship of ancestors holds an important place. Their creator is Pūluga, who gave the first people his commands.

In one version recorded by later ethnographers, a happy time ended when a food taboo was broken by eating the forbidden vegetables in Pūluga's garden. When the people ignored his laws, Pūluga sent a great flood. Only four survived, two men and two women, and they had lost their fire; Pūluga made the plants and animals again but did not give it back.

The British colonial presence on the islands from 1789 brought epidemics of pneumonia, measles and influenza that struck down people with no immunity. Within four years the large Jarawa settlements of south-eastern South Andaman had suffered a massive loss of population.
zh:
安达曼泛灵论是安达曼群岛土著各族的万物有灵信仰，祖先崇拜在其中占有重要位置。他们的创造者是普卢加，他向最初的人类颁下诫命。

据后世民族志学者记录的一个版本，一段幸福的日子因违反饮食禁忌而告终：吃了普卢加园子里不许吃的蔬菜。后来人们不遵守他的法则，普卢加便降下一场大洪水，只有两男两女幸存，他们还丢了火种；普卢加重新造出了植物和动物，却没有把火还回去。

1789年起，英国人在群岛上建立殖民据点，带来肺炎、麻疹和流感的流行，毫无免疫力的岛民成批倒下；不出四年，南安达曼岛东南部人数众多的加洛瓦人聚落就因此人口锐减。

en:
Anglicanism grew out of the Church of England after Henry VIII broke with Rome. Parliament's Act of Supremacy of 1534 made him Supreme Head of the Church. The church kept the bishops and much of the Catholic liturgy, but took its doctrine from the Reformation.

Under Edward VI, Thomas Cranmer wrote the Book of Common Prayer of 1549, the first service book wholly in English. Elizabeth I, who took the title Supreme Governor, restored it in 1559, and the Thirty-nine Articles, adopted in 1571, laid down a moderate Reformed doctrine.

The civil wars of the 1640s overthrew the church; after the Restoration of 1660 Puritan clergy were forced out, and the prayer book of 1662 became its standard. From Jamestown in 1607, English colonists carried Anglican worship overseas.
zh:
圣公宗是亨利八世与罗马决裂后，从英格兰教会发展而来的。1534年，议会通过《至尊法案》，宣布他为教会的最高首脑。教会保留了主教和天主教礼仪的大部分，教义则来自宗教改革。

爱德华六世时，托马斯·克兰麦写成1549年的《公祷书》，这是第一部完全用英语写的礼拜用书。伊丽莎白一世采用“最高管理者”的头衔，于1559年恢复公祷书，1571年通过的《三十九条信纲》确立了温和的改革宗教义。

1640年代的内战推翻了这一教会；1660年王政复辟后，清教徒神职人员被逐出，1662年的公祷书成为教会的标准。1607年起，从弗吉尼亚的詹姆斯敦开始，英国殖民者把圣公宗的礼拜带到了海外。

official_raw.en: $anglican$ is a form of $christian$ in which the head of state is also the Supreme Governor of the Church. Theologically and institutionally, $anglican$ retains many elements of $catholic$ while also being influenced by Reformed Puritans and continental $lutheran_ADJ$ beliefs.
official_raw.zh: $anglican$是$christian$的一种形式，其国家元首同时也是教会的最高领袖。在神学与制度上，$anglican$保留了许多$catholic$的元素，同时也受到改革宗清教徒和欧洲大陆的$lutheran_ADJ$信仰的影响。

en:
Anitism is the native religion of the lowland Philippines, best recorded among the Tagalogs of Luzon, where Spanish missionaries described their spirit worship, pag-aanito, from the 1570s. It rests on Austronesian beliefs, to which Hindu and Buddhist elements were added, probably indirectly, through contact with Srivijaya and Majapahit.

At its head stands Bathala, the creator, who was thought too distant to trouble with daily worship. People instead made offerings to the anito: lesser gods, spirits and the souls of ancestors, called kaluluwa. Feasts to the anito were led by priestesses, the katulunan, who might also stand in for an absent datu. Omen birds, the tigmamanukan, were watched before any journey.

After the Spanish conquest the images were destroyed and the missionaries pressed Christianity on the villages, but many of the rites survived inside Catholic practice.
zh:
阿尼托泛灵论是菲律宾低地的本土信仰，以吕宋的他加禄人记载最详，西班牙传教士自16世纪70年代起便描述了他们敬奉精灵的仪式。它的根基是南岛语族的传统信仰，后来多半是间接经由与室利佛逝和满者伯夷的接触，吸收了印度教和佛教的成分。

其最高神是创世之神巴塔拉，人们认为他太过遥远，不必为日常事务去打扰。人们转而向阿尼托献祭，阿尼托包括位阶较低的诸神、精灵，以及称为卡卢卢瓦的祖先亡魂。祭祀阿尼托的宴会由称为卡图卢南的女祭司主持，达图不在时她还可以代行其职。出行之前要观察被视为征兆的鸟，也就是蒂格马努卡南。

西班牙征服之后，神像被销毁，传教士也向各村强行推广基督教，但许多仪式仍保存在天主教的习俗之中。

en: The Anna religion is the traditional faith of the Kunama, who live between the Gash and Setit rivers on the Eritrean and Ethiopian border. It takes its name from their god Anna, whom the Arab geographer Ibn Hawqal already recorded them worshipping in the tenth century.
zh: 阿拿教是库纳马人的传统信仰，库纳马人生活在今厄立特里亚与埃塞俄比亚边界的加什河与塞蒂特河之间。它以库纳马人的神阿拿命名，10世纪的阿拉伯地理学家伊本·豪卡勒就已记载他们崇拜这位神。

en:
Arat Sabulungan is the traditional belief of the Mentawai of the islands off West Sumatra. The Mentawai are said to have come from Nias in ancient times, and lived apart until they met the Dutch in 1621. The name comes from sabulungan, leaves, which are always used in the rites as a go-between with the spirits.

Everything in nature holds a spirit. Offended or forgotten spirits bring illness and bad luck, so the Mentawai thank them and take no more than they need.

The ancestors are revered, as are Tai Kalelu, god of forest and mountain, and Tai Kamanua, the sky god who gives rain and life. The sikerei, shaman and healer, speaks with the dead and treats the sick. During a punen, a communal period of rest, no one works.
zh:
萨布伦甘教是西苏门答腊外海明打威群岛上明打威人的传统信仰。据说明打威人在远古时代从尼亚斯岛迁来，一直与外界隔绝，直到1621年与荷兰人相遇。教名来自“萨布伦甘”，意为树叶，仪式上总要用树叶作为人与神灵之间的中介。

万物都有灵。受到冒犯或被遗忘的神灵会带来疾病和厄运，所以明打威人对它们心怀感谢，只取所需。

人们敬奉祖先，也敬奉森林和山岳之神泰卡莱卢以及赐予雨水和生命的天神泰卡马努阿。锡克雷是萨满和医者，与死者交谈，为人治病。逢“普嫩”，也就是全社群一起歇工的时期，谁也不干活。

en:
Arosi religion is the traditional belief of the Arosi of western Makira (San Cristobal) in the Solomon Islands. Its chief god was Agunua, also called Hatuibwari, a cosmic serpent and god of the sea, of whom all other gods were held to be aspects. The first coconut of each tree was sacred to him, and he was asked for health and rich harvests.

Each person had two souls: the benevolent aunga, which left at death, and the malignant adaro, which stayed. Adaro ghosts could enter an animal, a tree or a stone, and with the right entreaties they could be commanded to kill or maim the living from afar. Spaniards under Alvaro de Mendana sighted Makira in 1568.
zh:
阿罗西泛灵论是所罗门群岛马基拉岛（圣克里斯托瓦尔岛）西部阿罗西人的传统信仰。它的主神是阿古努阿，又名哈图伊布瓦里，是宇宙之蛇和海神，其他诸神被认为只是他的不同侧面。每棵树上结的第一颗椰子都敬献给他，人们向他祈求健康和丰收。

每个人有两个灵魂：善良的昂加在人死后离去，凶险的阿达罗则留下。阿达罗的亡灵可以附在动物、树木或石头里，只要说对祈求的话，就能命令它们远距离杀害或伤残活人。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙人望见了马基拉岛。

en:
Arútam is the spirit-vision at the centre of the beliefs of the Shuar, the Jivaroan people of the forested foothills of the Andes. They are warriors who defeated an Inca army sent by Huayna Capac in 1527 and drove the Spaniards from their country in 1599.

Traditionally a boy of about eight was taken to a waterfall and given maikua, a datura brew, in the hope of seeing an arútam, a vision sent by an ancestral spirit called wakaní. Touching it brought great strength, and several made a man invincible, though the power could be lost.

The Shuar did not believe in natural death. Unexplained illness was blamed on invisible darts, tsentsak, which shamans called uwishin bought and controlled. A slain enemy's soul, the muísak, was sought in the shrunken head, the tsantsa.
zh:
阿鲁塔姆精神是舒阿人信仰的核心，指一种灵视。舒阿人属希瓦罗语系，居住在安第斯山麓的雨林里，以勇武著称：1527年他们击败了瓦伊纳·卡帕克派来的印加军队，1599年又把西班牙人逐出自己的土地。

传统上，男孩长到八岁左右，会被带到瀑布边，服用曼陀罗制成的迈库亚，希望看见阿鲁塔姆，即祖先灵魂瓦卡尼送来的异象。触到它便得到巨大的力量，拥有数个阿鲁塔姆的人刀枪不入，但这种力量可能失去。

舒阿人不相信自然死亡。凡是无法解释的疾病，都被归咎于看不见的毒镖“岑萨克”，乌维欣萨满买下毒镖并加以驾驭。被杀敌人的灵魂穆伊萨克，则被认为留在缩制的人头“灿萨”之中。

en:
Asis is the traditional religion of the Kalenjin, the Southern Nilotic peoples of the Kenyan Rift Valley, among them the Nandi, Kipsigis and Pokot. It is named for the sun, Asis, the sky-dwelling supreme god, all-powerful and the guarantor of right.

The second great power is Ilat, god of thunder and rain, who lives in deep pools and waterfalls and whose discarded garments are the rainbow. The Nandi split him into a good Ilet ne-mie, whose distant rumbling drives danger away, and a bad Ilet ne-ya, whose crash of near thunder tries to kill people.

The Kalenjin built no temples, since a building would have limited the god. Each section set aside a hilltop, the kaapkoros, where priests called Tisiik led worship, and each home had a prayer tree or altar east of the door.
zh:
阿西斯教是卡伦津人的传统信仰。卡伦津人是肯尼亚大裂谷一带的南尼罗特民族，包括南迪人、基普西吉斯人和波科特人。信仰得名于太阳神阿西斯，他居于天上，是全能的至高神，也是正义的保证者。

第二位大神是掌管雷雨的伊拉特，他住在深潭和瀑布里，被丢弃的衣服就是彩虹。南迪人把他分成两位：善的伊莱特·内米耶，远处的隆隆雷声是在驱走危险；恶的伊莱特·内亚，近处的炸雷是想下到人间杀人。

卡伦津人不盖神庙，认为建筑会限制神的力量。各部落划出一座山头作祭祀之所，称为卡普科罗斯，由名叫蒂西克的祭司主持礼拜；每家屋门东侧有祈祷树或祭坛。

en: The Atakapa religion is the traditional belief of the Atakapa, who called themselves Ishak, an Indigenous people of the Gulf coast of Louisiana and Texas whose language is an isolate. Their bands, among them the Akokisa, Bidai, Calcasieu, Opelousa and Vermilion, ranged from the Trinity River to the Vermilion River.
zh: 阿塔卡帕信仰是阿塔卡帕人的传统信仰。阿塔卡帕人自称伊沙克，是路易斯安那和得克萨斯墨西哥湾沿岸的原住民，语言是孤立语。他们的诸支系包括阿科基萨、比戴、卡尔卡苏、奥佩卢萨和弗米利恩，分布在从特里尼蒂河到弗米利恩河的一带。

en:
Badimo, Sotho-Tswana for ancestors, is the ancestor veneration of the Sotho-Tswana peoples of what are now Botswana, Lesotho and South Africa. Sotho and Tswana are thought to have separated by the fourteenth century, and both kept the veneration of the dead at the centre of religious life.

The Badimo are not simply the dead but the living dead, who dwell in the underworld and punish those who displease them. Each year before the first rains, a delegation took brewed beer and a slaughtered beast to the hills where the Badimo were thought to hide and brought back their expectations.

From 1822 Moshoeshoe I gathered refugees of the difaqane into the Basotho kingdom, while Robert Moffat opened the Kuruman mission among the Tswana in 1824. Christianity did not fully displace the Badimo, which survived beside it.
zh:
巴迪莫在索托-茨瓦纳语中意为祖先，是今博茨瓦纳、莱索托和南非一带的索托-茨瓦纳人的祖灵崇拜。一般认为索托人和茨瓦纳人在14世纪前已经分化，两者都把对死者的敬奉放在宗教生活的中心。

巴迪莫不单指死者，而是“活着的死者”，居住在地下世界，也惩罚惹他们不快的人。每年第一场雨之前，使团带着酿好的啤酒和宰杀的牲畜前往巴迪莫藏身的山丘，带回祖先的期望。

1822年起，莫舒舒一世把逃避迪法卡内战乱的难民聚成巴索托王国；1824年，罗伯特·莫法特在茨瓦纳人中开办库鲁曼传教站。基督教没有完全取代巴迪莫，两者并存下来。

en:
The Bahnar religion is the traditional animism and polytheism of the Bahnar, a Mon-Khmer-speaking people of the Central Highlands of Vietnam, in Gia Lai and Kon Tum, with other groups reaching coastal Binh Dinh and Phu Yen. Their gods are called Yang, and a great festival of thanks to them involves the stabbing of a water buffalo.

The Jolong, one Bahnar branch, keep a new-year feast of the bamboo rat as an act of worship to the gods of nature. The rat replaced the snake as the sacred animal after the villagers noticed that it never lacks roots to eat. Bahnar warriors fought beside Sedang and Jarai troops in the Tay Son armies that rose in 1771.
zh:
巴拿泛灵论是越南中部高原的巴拿人信奉的传统万物有灵与多神信仰。巴拿人说孟-高棉语系的语言，居住在嘉莱和昆嵩两省，也有支系分布到平定、富安等沿海省份。他们把诸神称作扬，向神致谢的大祭要刺杀一头水牛。

巴拿人的支系约隆人把祭祀竹鼠的新年节庆当作大节，借此敬拜自然诸神。竹鼠取代了蛇成为圣物，因为村民发现蛇有时吃不饱，而竹鼠以树根为食，一年到头都不愁没有吃的。1771年西山起义兴起后，巴拿人的战士与色当人、嘉莱人的队伍一同加入西山军作战。

en: The Banda religion is the traditional belief of the Banda people of the savannas of the Central African Republic. Its best-recorded practice is the sacrifice of offerings to ancestral spirits to win a good harvest, and the Banda were also known for carving wooden ritual objects and large animal-shaped slit drums.
zh: 班达泛灵论是中非共和国草原地带班达人的传统信仰。其中记载最清楚的习俗，是向祖灵献祭、祈求庄稼丰收；班达人还以雕刻礼仪用的木器和大型兽形裂缝鼓著称。

en:
Bantu religion is the name for the traditional beliefs of the Bantu-speaking peoples of central, eastern and southern Africa, who form several hundred ethnic groups with shared themes. Traditionally these beliefs were passed on by word of mouth, not in scripture.

Many Bantu peoples believed in a supreme god with a name such as Nyambe or Nzambe and honoured their ancestors, who were thought to speak with the gods. Among the Kongo the creator was Nzambi Ampungu, yet ancestor veneration was the core of belief, and healers called banganga trained to consult the dead.
zh:
班图拜物教是对中非、东非和南非讲班图语各民族传统信仰的统称，这些民族有几百个族群，信仰却有共同的主题。传统上，这些信仰靠口耳相传，而非经典。

许多班图民族相信有一位至上神，名字叫尼扬贝或恩赞比之类，并敬奉祖先，认为祖先能与诸神交谈。在刚果人当中，创造者是恩赞比·安普恩古，但信仰的核心是祖先崇拜，称为“班加加”的医者要经过训练，才能与亡者沟通。

en: Banunut is the name given to the many traditional legends of the Banggai, the people of the Banggai Islands off the east coast of Sulawesi. The islands were already known as Benggawi to the Majapahit poet Prapanca in 1365, and in the early sixteenth century Ternate organised the Banggai kingdom, which is described as an Islamic realm.
zh: 巴奴努是班盖人众多传统传说的统称，班盖人居住在苏拉威西岛东岸外的班盖群岛。1365年满者伯夷诗人普拉潘卡已提到这片岛屿，称之为“本加维”；16世纪初特尔纳特着手组建班盖王国，该王国被称为伊斯兰王国。

en:
Bathouism is the traditional faith of the Boro, or Bodo, people of the Brahmaputra valley in Assam. The name is read as ba, five, and thou, deep, for the five principles of air, fire, earth, water and ether, created by the high god Bathoubwrai, the Elder. His daughter Mainao guards the rice fields.

The god is embodied in the sijou, a spurge shrub planted in the courtyard on an altar fenced with eighteen pairs of bamboo strips, one for each pair of lesser gods. Bathou has no scripture and no temples; its priests are the male douri and female doudini.

After the Koch kingdom rose in 1515, it kept the Duars open to non-Brahmin cultures. Hindu rites spread among the Boro, and some entered the Ekasarana Vaishnava faith, though Bathou held on in many families.
zh:
巴图教是阿萨姆布拉马普特拉河谷博多（又称博罗）人的传统信仰。教名可解作“巴”（五）和“图”（深），指空气、火、土、水、以太五大元素，它们由至高神巴图布赖，即“长者”所造。他的女儿买瑙守护稻田。

神的化身是西久树，一种大戟属灌木，种在庭院里的祭坛上，四周用十八对竹片围起，每对代表一对小神。巴图教既无经典，也无神庙；祭司是男性的杜里和女性的杜迪尼。

1515年科赫王国崛起后，把杜阿尔斯留作对非婆罗门文化开放的地区。印度教仪式在博多人中传开，一部分人加入了埃卡沙拉纳毗湿奴派，不过巴图教在许多家庭里延续了下来。

en: Besavik is the traditional animist belief of the Punan Bah, a people of what is now Sarawak on the island of Borneo. Later the Punan Bah also took up Bungan, a cult religion shared with the Kenyah.
zh: 贝沙威信仰是普南巴人的传统万物有灵信仰，普南巴人居住在婆罗洲岛上今天的沙捞越一带。后来，普南巴人也接受了与肯雅人共有的邦安教。

en:
Bimoism is the indigenous religion of the Yi people of the mountains of Yunnan, Sichuan and Guizhou, named after the bimo, shaman-priests and masters of the Yi scriptures. Only the bimo, who can read the Yi script, perform the rituals linked to death.

The Yi honoured their ancestors and worshipped the gods of fire, water and sky, and also dragons, seen as protectors against the spirits that bring illness. Each person was held to have several souls: one stays to guard the grave and another is reborn into some living form.

Yi legend gives the hero Zhyge Alu, son of a dragon and an eagle, who shot down the extra suns. The Torch Festival, on the 24th day of the sixth lunar month, honours the strong man Atilaba, who burned locusts with pine torches.
zh:
毕摩教是云南、四川、贵州山区彝族的本土宗教，得名于毕摩，即萨满祭司，也是精通彝文经书的人。只有能读彝文的毕摩才能举行与死亡相关的仪式。

彝人敬奉祖先，崇拜火、水和天空之神，也崇拜龙，视龙为抵挡带来疾病的鬼怪的守护者。人们认为每个人有数个灵魂：一个留下守护坟墓，另一个转生为某种活物。

彝族传说里有英雄支格阿鲁，他是龙与鹰之子，射落了多余的太阳。每年农历六月二十四日的火把节，纪念的是用松木火把烧死蝗虫的大力士阿体拉巴。

en:
The Blang, called the Pu in the Yuan period, are a Mon-Khmer people of southern Yunnan who, by later accounts, keep animism, ancestor worship and Theravada Buddhism side by side. Their religious life centres on rice, water, bees, beeswax and the local spirits tied to them.

Most Blang festivals are religious. The rite of the village god is held for three days in the first or sixth lunar month: a chicken is killed, water is dripped around the village and at its centre, and the young men dig for bamboo rats to offer to the god, asking for good weather and safe herds. The most solemn festival is Sangkan, when the sun is welcomed and the Buddha is bathed.
zh:
布朗人元代称蒲人，是滇南的孟高棉语族民族，据后世的记载，万物有灵、祖先崇拜和上座部佛教在他们当中并存。他们的宗教生活格外注重稻米、水、蜜蜂、蜂蜡，以及与它们相关的地方神灵。

布朗人的节日大多与宗教活动有关。祭寨神在农历一月或六月择日举行，为期三天：杀一只鸡，在村寨四周和中心滴水祭祀，青年们去挖竹鼠，用竹鼠肉敬神，祈求风调雨顺、人畜平安。最隆重的是桑衎节，人们迎接太阳，到佛寺浴佛。

en:
Bogomilism arose in the First Bulgarian Empire in the tenth century, founded by the priest Bogomil, probably in Macedonia. It drew on the Paulicians. The Bogomils believed that God made the spiritual world and Satan, his fallen son, the material one, so that the body was the work of the devil; they sought purity through fasting and prayer.

They rejected the church hierarchy, the cross and monasticism, and honoured the Lord's Prayer as the strongest weapon against Satan. The movement helped to give rise to the Cathars of Western Europe.

Bulgaria, Serbia and Byzantium suppressed Bogomilism in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, but it lingered in Hum and Bosnia, where the Hungarians used the charge of heresy to justify crusades. Few traces survived the Ottoman conquest of Bosnia in 1463.
zh:
鲍格米勒派10世纪兴起于第一保加利亚帝国，创始人是神父鲍格米尔，起源地大概在马其顿一带。它受到保罗派的影响。鲍格米勒派信徒相信，上帝创造了精神世界，物质世界则是上帝的堕落之子撒旦所造，因此肉体是魔鬼的作品；他们通过禁食和祈祷来追求洁净。

他们否定教会的等级制度、十字架和修道制度，把主祷文奉为抵御撒旦的最强武器。这一运动也促成了西欧的卡特里派。

保加利亚、塞尔维亚和拜占庭在12、13世纪镇压了鲍格米勒派，但它仍存留在胡姆和波斯尼亚，匈牙利人借异端之名发动十字军。1463年奥斯曼人征服波斯尼亚之后，它几乎没有留下什么痕迹。

official_raw.en: A neo-gnostic and dualist branch of $christian$, $bogomilism$ teaches that existence is divided between a spiritual realm and a material one. Its followers view their bodies as sacred temples and strive for closeness to God through purification rituals. These practices include fasting, dancing, and rejecting material excess to focus on spiritual growth.
official_raw.zh: $bogomilism$是$christian$的一个新诺斯替主义与二元论分支，其教导存在分为灵性领域与物质领域。其信徒将身体视为神圣的殿堂，并通过净化仪式努力接近上帝。这些实践包括禁食、舞蹈以及拒绝物质享受，以专注于灵性成长。

en:
Bön is said to have come from the old kingdom of Zhangzhung. Before Buddhism arrived, priests called bon performed rites for the Yarlung kings. Bonpos trace their faith to the Buddha Tönpa Shenrab, and hold that it was driven underground, its scriptures hidden as termas for later discovery.

The organised tradition known as Yungdrung Bön took shape in the tenth and eleventh centuries, from the same circles of tantric ritualists that produced the Nyingma school. The monk Nyammé Sherab Gyaltsen founded Menri Monastery in 1405 and gave Bön its monastic curriculum. Pushed to the margins by the Buddhist schools, Bön survived chiefly in Kham and Amdo. The Fifth Dalai Lama formally recognised it as a Tibetan religion.
zh:
苯教据说来自古象雄王国。佛教传入以前，被称为“苯”的祭司为雅砻诸王主持仪式。苯教徒把教法追溯到佛陀敦巴辛饶，认为它曾被迫转入地下，经典被当作伏藏埋藏起来，留待后世发掘。

被称为雍仲苯教的有组织的传统在10至11世纪成形，与宁玛派出自同一批密咒仪轨世家。僧人年美·喜绕坚赞于1405年创建曼日寺，为苯教确立了寺院教育的体系。苯教被佛教各派挤向边缘，主要存续在康区和安多。五世达赖喇嘛正式承认苯教为藏人的宗教。

official_raw.en: Emerging from the religious traditions of $tibet_region$ before the arrival of $buddhist$, it became very influenced by $tibetan_buddhism$. It is especially close to the $SECT_NYIGMA_NAME$, but still preserves many pre-$buddhist$ elements. Its teachings focus on Karma and rebirth, and the ways of achieving enlightenment.
official_raw.zh: 苯教起源于$buddhist$传入$tibet_region$地区之前的宗教传统，后来深受$tibetan_buddhism$的影响。它与$SECT_NYIGMA_NAME$尤为接近，但仍保留了许多前$buddhist$时期的元素。其教义专注于业力与轮回，以及实现觉悟的途径。

en:
Bori, also called Maguzanci or Hausa animism, is the traditional religion of the Hausa of West Africa, built on magic and the possession of mediums by spirits. Only part of the Hausa, mostly urban elites, had accepted Islam before the end of the eighteenth century, and the royal courts practised a mixture of the two. Women held powerful advisory roles as Bori priestesses.

Scholars of Islam in the early nineteenth century condemned this mixed faith, and the jihad of Usman dan Fodio around 1800, which founded the Sokoto Caliphate, used it as a reason to overthrow the Hausa sultanates. Bori was partly suppressed, but the possession rituals survived in refuge states such as Konni and Dogondutchi.
zh:
博里，又称马古扎人的宗教或豪萨泛灵论，是西非豪萨人的传统宗教，以魔法和灵附身于灵媒为基础。直到18世纪末，豪萨人中只有一部分，主要是城市精英，接受了伊斯兰教，王廷里实行的是二者的混合。女性作为博里的女祭司，担任有权势的顾问。

19世纪初的穆斯林学者谴责这种混合的信仰，奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥在1800年前后发动的圣战建立了索科托哈里发国，并以此为理由推翻了豪萨诸苏丹国。博里被部分压制，但附身仪式在孔尼和多贡杜奇等避难邦国得以保留。

en:
The Bosnian Church lasted in Bosnia from the thirteenth to the fifteenth century. Nominally Catholic, Bosnia saw its bishopric break with Rome in the first half of the thirteenth century, when the Hungarian-appointed bishop withdrew to Đakovo and the governor and nobles took over the choice of bishop.

Its head was a bishop called the djed, or grandfather. It kept Slavic liturgy. It was long equated with the Bogomils, a link most scholars now doubt.

Hungarian kings repeatedly launched crusades on the pretext of heresy; Pope Nicholas IV sent an Inquisition in 1291. In 1459 King Thomas turned on the church to win papal support against the Turks, and it was dismantled; the Ottomans took Bosnia in 1463.
zh:
波斯尼亚教会存在于13至15世纪的波斯尼亚。波斯尼亚名义上属于天主教，13世纪前期，匈牙利任命的主教退居到贾科沃，总督和贵族改由自己选举主教，主教区就此同罗马决裂。

教会的首领称“祖父”。教会保持斯拉夫语礼拜。人们长期把它等同于鲍格米勒派，大多数学者现在对这一联系持怀疑态度。

匈牙利国王一再以异端为借口发动十字军；1291年教宗尼古拉四世派来了宗教裁判所。1459年，国王托马斯为争取教廷支持以对抗土耳其人，转而迫害该教会，教会被拆散；1463年，奥斯曼人攻占波斯尼亚。

official_raw.en: A breakaway sect of the $catholic_ADJ$ Church, the $bosnian_church$ developed its distinct theology due to prolonged isolation from mainstream Christianity. It focused heavily on apocalyptic themes, embraced mysticism, and retained many archaic practices of early $christian$. These traits led both $catholic_ADJ$ and $orthodox_ADJ$ authorities to denounce it as heretical.
official_raw.zh: $bosnian_church$是$catholic_ADJ$会的分裂教派，由于长期与主流基督教隔离，发展出了独特的神学。它着重于末日主题，拥抱神秘主义，同时保留了许多早期$christian$的古老实践。这些特质导致$catholic_ADJ$会与$orthodox_ADJ$会都将其谴责为异端。

en:
The Bru religion is the traditional animism of the Bru, a Katuic-speaking people whose villages stand mostly along rivers, in the uplands of Quang Binh and Quang Tri in Vietnam, in Savannakhet in Laos and in Sakon Nakhon in Thailand. They honour their ancestors and the spirits of rice and fire, and hold relics and fragments of ancient weapons and household objects sacred. In more traditional villages the headman is also the village spiritual adviser.

Bru oral tales make the hare the cleverest of animals and the tiger the hero. The Ma Coong, a Bru group in Quang Binh, hold a drum-beating festival on the sixteenth day of the first lunar month to welcome the new moon.
zh:
布鲁泛灵论是布鲁人的传统万物有灵信仰。布鲁人说卡图语支的语言，村落多沿河而建，分布在越南的广平、广治两省山地，老挝的沙湾拿吉和泰国的沙功那空。他们敬奉祖先以及稻谷和火的神灵，并把古代武器和日用器物的遗物与残片视为圣物；在较传统的村子里，头人往往同时是全村的精神顾问。

布鲁人的口传故事把野兔写成最聪明的动物，把老虎写成英雄。广平省布鲁人的一支马孔人，在正月十六敲鼓庆祝，迎接新月。

en: The Bua religion is the traditional belief of the Bua-speaking peoples of southern Chad, such as the Bua, the Fanian and the Niellim, who live between the Chari River and the Guéra Massif.
zh: 布阿泛灵论是乍得南部说布阿语支的各族的传统信仰，这些族群包括布阿人、法尼亚人和涅利姆人，居住在沙里河与盖拉山地之间。

en: Buton is the pre-Islamic belief of the Wolio kingdom on Buton Island off southeast Sulawesi, whose small chiefdoms elected Wa Kaa kaa as their first ruler around the fourteenth century. The kingdom later turned to Islam under La Kilaponto.
zh: 布敦泛灵论是东南苏拉威西外海布敦岛上沃里奥王国在伊斯兰教传入前的传统信仰。14世纪前后，诸小邦推选瓦·卡卡为第一位统治者；王国后来在拉·基拉蓬托治下改信伊斯兰教。

en:
Bughli is the old religion of the Dagomba of Dagbon in northern Ghana. Before the descendants of Naa Gbewaa united the Dagomba under one king, each town was led by an earth priest, the tindana, who appeased the earth gods, the lesser gods and the idols. Festivals such as Bugum Chugu, the fire festival that opens the Dagomba lunar year, are traced back to this age.

The Yaa Naa's court moved to Yendi after Gonja attacks, and there Muslim Dyula and Hausa gathered around the king and said protective prayers for him; by 1788 Yendi was said to be larger than Kumasi and Salaga. The tindaamba nevertheless kept their ritual place beside the chiefs.
zh:
布格利崇拜是加纳北部达贡王国达贡巴人的古老宗教。在纳·格贝瓦的后裔把达贡巴人统一在一位国王之下以前，各城镇由土地祭司廷达纳领导，他们安抚地神、诸神和偶像。火节布古姆·丘古是达贡巴历新年的第一个节日，据说可追溯到那个时代。

贡贾人进攻之后，亚·纳的宫廷迁到延迪，穆斯林迪尤拉人和豪萨人聚集在国王周围，为他做护佑祈祷；到1788年，延迪据说比库马西和萨拉加还大。廷达姆巴仍在首领身旁保有祭祀上的地位。

en:
The Cáhita religion is the traditional belief of the Cáhita peoples, the Yaqui, Mayo and Tehueco among them, who farmed the river valleys of Sonora and Sinaloa. Jesuit missionaries recorded them in detail from the seventeenth century and counted five main nations: the Sinaloa, Ocoroni, Zuaque, Mayo and Yaqui.

They worshipped the forces of nature, the wind, the water, the earth, the sun and the sea, and made offerings to them for good harvests and abundant fishing. Above all these forces they believed in something superior that was responsible for all of creation.

Their ceremonies were simple and without elaborate ritual. Healers, who knew the medicinal herbs and treated the sick with strongly religious practices, held great prestige, and the Jesuits called them both sorcerers and political leaders.
zh:
卡希塔信仰是卡希塔诸民族的传统信仰，亚基人、马约人和特韦科人都在其中，他们在索诺拉和锡那罗亚的河谷里务农。耶稣会传教士从17世纪起对他们作了详细记录，数出五个主要部族：锡那罗亚、奥科罗尼、苏亚克、马约和亚基。

他们崇拜风、水、大地、太阳和海洋等自然力量，向它们献祭，祈求丰收和渔获。在这些力量之上，他们相信有一个更高的存在，创造了万物。

他们的仪式简单，没有繁复的礼节。医者通晓草药，用带有浓厚宗教色彩的方法治病，威望很高，耶稣会士既称他们为巫师，也称他们为政治领袖。

en:
Calvinism, or Reformed Christianity, grew out of the Swiss Reformation of Huldrych Zwingli and Heinrich Bullinger. The Frenchman John Calvin published his Institutes of the Christian Religion in 1536 and made Geneva its centre. Worship is kept free of images, Christ is present in the Eucharist spiritually rather than bodily, and congregations are ruled by pastors and elected elders.

Calvinism spread widely after 1550. The Heidelberg Catechism was drawn up in 1563, Queen Jeanne d'Albret of Navarre publicly turned Calvinist in 1560, and the French Huguenots fought the Wars of Religion from 1562 to 1598. The Dutch Reformed Church adopted its standards in 1571, and the Synod of Dort in 1619 condemned the Arminians on predestination.
zh:
加尔文宗又称改革宗，源于乌利希·慈运理和海因里希·布林格在瑞士开创的宗教改革。法国人约翰·加尔文于1536年发表《基督教要义》，并使日内瓦成为这一宗派的中心。崇拜不用圣像；基督在圣餐中是属灵地而非肉身地临在；教会由牧师和选举产生的长老共同治理。

1550年以后，加尔文宗传播甚广。1563年制定了《海德堡教理问答》；1560年，纳瓦拉女王让娜·达尔布雷公开皈依加尔文宗；法国胡格诺派在1562至1598年的宗教战争中作战。荷兰改革宗教会于1571年采纳了信仰标准，1619年的多特会议则在预定论问题上谴责了阿明尼乌派。

official_raw.en: Named after John Calvin, $calvinist$ is a significant branch of Protestantism rooted in the principles of simplicity in worship and the supremacy of the Holy Bible. Its doctrine emphasizes predestination, asserting that God has preordained the destiny of all creation.
official_raw.zh: $calvinist$以约翰·加尔文命名，是新教的重要分支，根植于崇拜简朴与圣经至上的原则。其教义强调预定论，主张上帝已预先决定了所有造物的命运。

en:
Catharism appeared in the Rhineland, northern France, the Languedoc and northern Italy in the twelfth century; its first confirmed report comes from Cologne in 1143. The Cathars, named from the Greek word for the pure, probably drew on the Bogomils of the Balkans.

Souls were reborn until freed. Only the Perfect, who received the consolamentum, were sure of returning to God.

Innocent III proclaimed the Albigensian Crusade in 1208, the crusaders marched in 1209, and by 1244 Catharism was driven underground in the Languedoc. The Inquisition hunted the survivors, who lasted there until about 1325 and in the Italian cities into the fourteenth century.
zh:
清洁派于12世纪出现在莱茵兰、法国北部、朗格多克和意大利北部；最早的确切记载来自1143年的科隆。清洁派之名源自希腊语中表示“纯洁者”的词，他们很可能受到巴尔干鲍格米勒派的影响。

灵魂不断转世，直到获得解脱。只有领受了“安慰礼”的“完人”才确定能回到神的身边。

1208年，英诺森三世宣布发动阿尔比十字军，十字军于1209年出征，到1244年，清洁派在朗格多克已转入地下。宗教裁判所继续追捕幸存者，他们在当地坚持到1325年前后，在意大利城市则延续到14世纪。

official_raw.en: $catharism$ is a dualist movement that believes in the existence of two Gods: a benevolent God of Heaven and a malevolent counterpart. Its adherents follow an ascetic lifestyle, holding that souls are trapped in physical bodies as part of a cosmic struggle. Spiritual purification, achieved through strict discipline, is seen as the only path to salvation.
official_raw.zh: $catharism$是一个二元论宗教派别，相信存在两位神：一位是仁慈的天堂之神，另一位是邪恶的对立神。其追随者过着禁欲生活，认为灵魂被困在肉体中是宇宙斗争的一部分。通过严格纪律实现的灵性净化被视为唯一的救赎之路。

en:
The Pope is the bishop of Rome, and the Catholic Church holds its bishops to be successors of the apostles. In 1337 it was the faith of nearly all Latin Europe.

Worship centres on the Mass, in which consecrated bread and wine become the body and blood of Christ. Its sacraments number seven. The schism of 1054 divided it from the Orthodox Church.

The popes lived at Avignon from 1309 to 1376, and rival claimants split the Church from 1378 until the Council of Constance of 1414–1418. Luther's Ninety-five Theses of 1517 took much of northern Europe out of its obedience; the Council of Trent, 1545–1563, led the Counter-Reformation, and Spanish and Portuguese missionaries carried the faith to the Americas and Asia.
zh:
教宗是罗马主教，天主教会认为主教是使徒的继承者。1337年，几乎整个拉丁欧洲都信奉天主教。

崇拜以弥撒为中心，经祝圣的饼和酒成为基督的身体和血，圣事共有七件。1054年的大分裂使天主教会与东正教会彻底分道扬镳。

1309至1376年，教宗居住在阿维尼翁；从1378年起几位教宗人选并立，教会分裂，直到1414至1418年的康斯坦茨会议才结束。1517年路德发表《九十五条论纲》，北欧大部分地区不再服从罗马；1545至1563年的特伦托会议主导了反宗教改革，西班牙和葡萄牙的传教士则把这一信仰带到美洲和亚洲。

official_raw.en: Rooted in the Nicene Creed, $catholic$ is the largest denomination of $christian$ and is led by the Pope, who serves as the spiritual successor to Saint Peter. The Pope acts as both the head of the Church and a mediator in conflicts among $christian_ADJ$ rulers. Its doctrine and traditions have shaped much of the Western world's religious and cultural history.
official_raw.zh: $catholic$由教宗领导，以尼西亚信经为基础，是$christian$最大的教派，教宗被视为圣伯多禄的宗教继承者。教宗既是教会的领袖，也是$christian_ADJ$统治者之间冲突的调解者。其教义与传统塑造了西方世界的大部分宗教与文化历史。

en:
Cebil was the religion of the Atacameños, who farmed oases and herded llamas in the Atacama desert and highlands of what is now northern Chile, north-western Argentina and southern Bolivia.
