Its heart was the inhaling of cebil, a hallucinogenic snuff laid on carved tablets and drawn in through a tube.

Shamans used it to divine and to reach the gods, and the one who inhaled was thought to take on the power of birds, felines and snakes. The tablets spread under the influence of Tiwanaku between 900 and 1200.

The Atacameños believed in many gods who lived on the volcano Licancabur, and in a life after death. After Topa Inca Yupanqui conquered them in the fifteenth century they adopted the Inca sun cult. Diego de Almagro's Spaniards arrived in 1536.
zh:
塞比尔灵媒信仰是阿塔卡马人的宗教。阿塔卡马人在今智利北部、阿根廷西北部和玻利维亚南部的阿塔卡马沙漠与高地上耕种绿洲、放牧美洲驼。信仰的核心是吸食塞比尔，一种致幻的鼻烟，放在雕刻的小木板上，用吸管吸入。

萨满靠它占卜、接触神灵，吸食者被认为能获得鸟、猫科动物和蛇的力量。这些木板在蒂亚瓦纳科的影响下，于900—1200年间传开。

阿塔卡马人相信有许多神灵居住在利坎卡武尔火山上，也相信死后另有生活。15世纪图帕克·尤潘基征服他们之后，他们接受了印加的太阳崇拜。1536年，迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗率领的西班牙人抵达。

en:
The Changos were a loose group of fishing peoples who lived along the Pacific coast from southern Peru to north-central Chile, in the desert country of Atacama. Highlanders called the coastal fog camanchaca, which gave the Camanchacos their name, and the Spaniards later called them Changos. They hunted sea lions and fished from rafts of sea-lion hide, and their way of life grew out of the old Chinchorro tradition.

Their beliefs are known only in outline. The sea was revered as Mama Cocha, and the dead were buried with their fishing and hunting gear, which suggests a firm belief in a life after death.
zh:
昌戈人是对沿太平洋海岸分布的渔民群体的统称，从秘鲁南部一直到智利中北部的阿塔卡马沙漠沿岸。高地居民把沿海的雾叫作卡马恰卡，他们因此也被称为卡马恰科人，后来西班牙人称之为昌戈人。他们猎捕海狮，乘海狮皮制的筏子捕鱼，生活方式源于古老的钦乔罗传统。

关于他们的信仰，只留下了零星的记载。海被敬奉为海母，死者连同渔猎用具一起下葬，说明他们相信死后还有另一种生活。

en:
The Chanka were a farming people of Andahuaylas and the Ayacucho highlands of Peru, whose chiefdoms formed a loose confederation. Their rulers were two chiefs, the Uscovilca of the Hanan Chanka and the Ancovilca of the Urin Chanka, and the cult of the ancestors gave this religion its name.

The Chanka said they came from two lakes in what is now Huancavelica. Uscovilca was said to be preserved as a mummy that was venerated at the capital Huaman Karpa until Inca times. Warriors carried the mummies of their grandfathers on their shoulders into battle, painted their faces and shrieked as they fought, and their god was a feline.

In 1438 the Chanka attacked Cusco and were defeated by the Inca prince Cusi Yupanqui, who later became Pachacuti. The Hurin Chanka submitted to the Incas.
zh:
昌卡人是居住在秘鲁安达瓦伊拉斯和阿亚库乔高地的农耕民族，他们的酋邦结成松散的联盟。统治者是上昌卡的乌斯科维尔卡和下昌卡的安科维卡两位首领，对祖先的崇拜也由此得名。

昌卡人自称起源于今万卡韦利卡境内的两座湖泊。乌斯科维尔卡据说制成木乃伊保存下来，在都城瓦曼卡尔帕受人崇敬，直到印加时代。战士把祖父们的木乃伊扛在肩上上阵，脸上涂彩，作战时尖声呐喊，他们的神是一种猫科动物。

1438年，昌卡人进攻库斯科，被印加王子库西·尤潘基击败，库西·尤潘基后来成为帕查库特克。下昌卡臣服于印加。

en: Cheke Holo is the traditional belief of the Cheke Holo-speaking people of Santa Isabel, also called Maringe, in the Solomon Islands. Alvaro de Mendana's Spaniards landed on the island in 1568, the first European landing in the archipelago, and built a small boat there to chart the neighbouring seas.
zh: 切克霍洛泛灵论是所罗门群岛圣伊莎贝尔岛上说切克霍洛语（又称马林格语）的居民的传统信仰。1568年，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的西班牙人在这座岛上登陆，这是欧洲人首次在该群岛登陆，他们还在岛上造了一艘小船，用来勘测附近海域。

en:
The Chibcha religion is that of the Muisca, who lived in the central highlands of the Colombian Andes before the Spanish conquest. The supreme being was Chiminigagua, who created light and the Earth but was not worshipped directly; worship went instead to the moon goddess Chía and her husband Sué, the sun god.

The Muisca made offerings at lakes such as Guatavita, and at the Sun Temple of Suamox. Priests performed sacrifices, sometimes of people. In one tale the goddess Huitaca, who taught pleasure, music and dance, rebelled against the culture hero Bochica and was turned into an owl, or into the moon.

After Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada's conquest of the 1530s, the gold-adorned temples fed the legend of El Dorado. The last public ceremony took place at Ubaque on 27 December 1563.
zh:
奇布查宗教是穆伊斯卡人的宗教，穆伊斯卡人在西班牙征服前居住在哥伦比亚安第斯山脉中部的高原上。至高之神是奇米尼加瓜，他创造了光和大地，但并不直接受人崇拜；人们崇拜的是月亮女神奇亚和她的丈夫、太阳神苏埃。

穆伊斯卡人在瓜塔维塔湖等湖泊和苏加穆西的太阳神殿供奉神灵。祭司主持献祭，有时用活人。有一则传说讲，教人享乐、音乐和舞蹈的女神惠塔卡反抗文化英雄包查卡，被变成了猫头鹰，或者变成了月亮。

1530年代贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德·克萨达征服此地后，饰满黄金的神殿催生了黄金国的传说。最后一次公开的宗教仪式于1563年12月27日在乌巴克举行。

en:
The Chichimec religion is the traditional belief of the peoples the Nahua called Chichimeca, the hunters and farmers of the northern highlands, among them the Otomi of Metztitlán. Mixcoatl, the Cloud Serpent, god of the hunt and the Milky Way, was patron of the Chichimecs and the Otomi, and as Camaxtli the central god of Tlaxcala and Huejotzingo. Metztitlán, an Otomi state the Aztecs never conquered, honoured the lunar deity Zäna.

Spanish writers of the late 16th century said the Chichimecs worshipped no idols as their neighbours did, though they made animal sacrifices. The Chichimeca War, begun in 1550, ended in peace treaties and the absorption of the native peoples into New Spain.
zh:
奇奇梅克宗教是纳瓦人称为奇奇梅克的各族群的传统信仰，他们是北部高地的猎人和农民，其中有梅茨蒂特兰的奥托米人。云蛇米斯科亚特尔是狩猎与银河之神，既是奇奇梅克人和奥托米人的守护神，又以卡马什特利之名成为特拉斯卡拉和韦霍钦戈的主神。梅茨蒂特兰是阿兹特克人始终未能征服的奥托米邦国，崇拜月神扎纳。

16世纪后期的西班牙作者说，奇奇梅克人不像邻族那样崇拜偶像，却会用动物献祭。1550年开始的奇奇梅克战争，以和约和土著人口并入新西班牙而告终。

en:
The Chincha were a seafaring and trading people of the Chincha Valley on the coast of Peru, whose kingdom flourished in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. They believed themselves descended from jaguars, which gave them their warlike and domineering nature, and worshipped a jaguar god.

Their chief god was Chinchaycamac, who held a rich oracle near the great adobe pyramids of La Centinela. Their merchants sailing the Pacific revered a star called Chundri, perhaps used for navigation, and the gods were said to have come from an island sanctuary called Urpihuachay, She Who Bears Doves.

The Incas under Pachacuti brought Chincha into their empire peacefully, but its lords kept much of their autonomy. In 1532 the lord of Chincha was carried in a litter to meet Pizarro at Cajamarca, where he was killed.
zh:
钦查人是秘鲁海岸钦查河谷一带的航海和贸易民族，王国在14至15世纪十分兴盛。他们相信自己是美洲豹的后裔，因而好战而强横，崇拜美洲豹神。

主神是钦查卡马克，他的神谕所很富有，设在拉森蒂内拉大型土坯金字塔群附近。在太平洋上航行的商人敬奉一颗叫钦德里的星，可能用来导航；据说诸神来自一座叫乌尔皮瓦查伊的圣岛，意为“生出鸽子的女神”。

印加在帕查库特克治下和平地把钦查纳入帝国，但钦查的领主仍保留了很大的自治权。1532年，钦查领主乘轿前往卡哈马卡会见皮萨罗，并在那里被杀。

en:
Chukchee shamanism is the traditional religion of the Chukchi, the reindeer herders of the inland tundra and the sea-mammal hunters of the coast in far north-eastern Siberia. They hold that every object, living or not, has a spirit, and some of their myths describe a dualistic cosmos.

The Chukchi often lacked formal political structures, yet had a formal hierarchy of the cosmos. A shaman once told the ethnographer Bogoraz that lamps walk about, house walls have voices, and even the shadows form tribes with lands of their own.

Shamans were said to be called by spirits, dreams or omens. In ritual they fell into trances, sometimes helped by hallucinogenic mushrooms, and were believed able to fly, drive out evil spirits and heal. Some took on a woman's dress and role and could even marry men.
zh:
楚科奇萨满教是楚科奇人的传统信仰。楚科奇人分布在西伯利亚东北端，内陆苔原上的驯鹿牧民和沿海的海兽猎人都属于这一族。他们认为一切物体，无论有没有生命，都有精灵；有些神话还反映出二元对立的宇宙观。

楚科奇人往往没有正式的政治组织，却有一套正式的宇宙等级。一位萨满曾对民族志学者博戈拉兹说，灯会走动，房屋的墙壁各有声音，连影子也自成部落，在自己的国度里居住。

人们说，萨满是被精灵、梦境或预兆召唤的。作法时他们陷入昏迷状态，有时借助致幻的蘑菇，据信还能飞行、驱邪和治病。有些萨满改着女装、承担女性的角色，甚至可以与男子成婚。

en:
Chutia religion is the folk religion of the Chutia, the Bodo-Kachari people of the kingdom around Sadiya in upper Assam. They worshipped a primordial male deity, Kundi-Mama, and a primordial female deity, Kechai-khaiti, whose worship was officiated by the priestly section later identified as the Deori.

Its rites were tribal-tantric. In the Deo-kuber ceremony, held in the days of the Chutia kings for the welfare of the state, earthen lamps were lit for Kuber and Kundi, and a pair of ducks was sacrificed to the deities Gira-Girasi. Village deities such as Dangoria were honoured at the trees where they were said to dwell.

From the late fourteenth century inscriptions show the kings turning Vaishnava, and a section of the Chutia accepted Hinduism. After the Ahoms absorbed the kingdom in 1523, those who had not were initiated into Ekasarana in the seventeenth century.
zh:
久蒂亚泛灵论是久蒂亚人的民间信仰。久蒂亚人是博多—卡恰尔族群，在阿萨姆上游萨迪亚一带建有王国。他们崇拜本原男神昆迪—马马和本原女神凯切—凯蒂，女神的祭祀由后来被称为代奥里人的祭司阶层主持。

仪式带有部落密教色彩。在久蒂亚诸王在位时为国家平安举行的德奥—库贝尔仪式上，人们为库贝尔和昆迪点起陶灯，并向吉拉—吉拉西献祭一对鸭子；丹戈里亚等村落之神则在传说中神灵所栖的树下受到祭祀。

14世纪晚期的碑文显示国王已转信毗湿奴派，一部分久蒂亚人也接受了印度教。1523年阿洪人吞并王国后，没有改宗的人在17世纪被引入埃卡萨拉纳派。

en:
The Coahuilteco religion is the traditional belief of the Coahuiltecans, a loose network of hunter-gatherer bands who roamed Coahuila, Tamaulipas and southern Texas. On occasion they gathered in large numbers for all-night dances called mitotes, taking peyote as medicine.

From 1580 Carvajal, governor of Nuevo León, and his men raided the Rio Grande bands for slaves. In 1718 Spain founded Mission San Antonio de Valero, later the Alamo, to evangelize them, and with four more missions it held about 1,200 Coahuiltecans and other Indians at its height. Many fled, smallpox from 1739 cut the population further, and the San Antonio missions were secularized in 1824.
zh:
科阿韦尔特科信仰是科阿韦尔特科人的传统信仰。科阿韦尔特科人是一个松散的狩猎采集群体网络，游走在科阿韦拉、塔毛利帕斯和得克萨斯南部。他们有时大批聚集，举行称作米托特的通宵舞会，一边跳舞，一边服用佩奥特仙人掌作为药物。

1580年起，新莱昂总督卡瓦哈尔及其手下为掠奴袭击格兰德河沿岸的各群体。1718年，西班牙创建圣安东尼奥·德·巴莱罗传教站，即后来的阿拉莫，向他们传教，连同后来的四座传教站，鼎盛时容纳了约1200名科阿韦尔特科人和其他印第安人。逃离的人很多，1739年起的天花又使人口进一步减少，圣安东尼奥的传教站于1824年被世俗化。

en:
The Cwezi religion is the veneration of the Cwezi, a semi-legendary clan said to have been the second ruling dynasty of the empire of Kitara in the African Great Lakes region. The Rutara peoples honour them as ancestor spirits, and tradition says the spirits left their mark on the region's hills and lakes.

Legend names Mubende as their first capital and calls them skilled blacksmiths, and their shrines are linked with iron tools and anvils. Their spirit mediums opposed later royal dynasties, such as the Biito clan of cattle herders.
zh:
契韦齐信仰是对契韦齐的崇奉。契韦齐是半传说性的氏族，据说是非洲大湖地区基塔拉帝国的第二个统治王朝。鲁塔拉各民族把他们当作祖灵敬奉，传说这些灵留印在该地区的山丘和湖泊之上。

传说称穆本德是他们的第一个都城，说他们是技艺高超的铁匠，他们的神龛也与铁器和铁砧相关。契韦齐的灵媒反对后来的各个王朝，比如以畜牧为业的比托氏族。

en: The Degar religion is the traditional animist faith of the Degar, or Montagnards, the Austronesian- and Austroasiatic-speaking highland peoples of Vietnam’s Central Highlands, among them the Jarai, Rade and Bahnar. Ritual buffalo sacrifice was among their customs, and contact with Europeans began in the sixteenth century with Portuguese missionaries.
zh: 德加泛灵论是德加人的传统泛灵信仰。德加人又称高地民族，是越南中部高原上讲南岛语和南亚语的山地民族，包括嘉莱人、埃德人和巴拿人。以水牛献祭是他们的习俗，与欧洲人的接触则始于16世纪的葡萄牙传教士。

en: The Dene are the Athabaskan-speaking peoples of northwestern Canada, from the Mackenzie Valley to the Yukon. The Gwichʼin, one of their nations, tell that their people and the caribou were once a single being, and that animal anchors both their stories and their subsistence.
zh: 德内人是加拿大西北部说阿萨巴斯卡语的诸族群，分布在从麦肯齐河谷到育空的地区。其中的格威奇因人讲述，他们的祖先和驯鹿原本是同一个整体，这种动物既是他们故事的核心，也是生计所系。

en:
Athabaskanism is the traditional animism and shamanism of the Athabaskan peoples of interior Alaska, whom the Tanana, Gwichʼin and others represent. All creatures and some objects were thought to have active spirits, and an animal whose spirit was offended might stay away from the hunters. Strict rules therefore governed how animals were killed and treated; a man who killed a wolf, for example, should apologise to it before touching the body.

The shaman was the central religious figure. He or she guarded against evil spirits, diagnosed illness and restored the sick, and could read a scorched shoulder blade to find game when it was scarce.

A winter potlatch, above all the funeral potlatch, marked the dead man’s departure from the world. Russian Orthodox, Catholic and Anglican missionaries converted the Athabaskans, and shamanic practice was suppressed.
zh:
阿萨巴斯坎萨满教是阿拉斯加内陆阿萨巴斯卡人的传统泛灵论和萨满信仰，塔纳纳人、格威奇因人等都属于这一群体。人们认为万物和部分器物都有活跃的灵魂，动物的灵魂若被冒犯，就会躲开猎人。因此，怎样猎杀和对待动物都有严格的规矩，比如杀死狼的人，应先向它道歉再去碰它的身体。

萨满是核心的宗教人物。他或她抵御恶灵，诊断疾病并使病人康复，在猎物稀少时还能烧灼肩胛骨，据裂纹占卜猎物的方位。

冬季的夸富宴，尤其是葬礼夸富宴，标志着死者离开人世。俄国东正教、天主教和圣公会的传教士使阿萨巴斯卡人改宗，萨满活动受到压制。

en: Among the Tanana Athabaskans of interior Alaska, society was divided into eight or nine matrilineal clans grouped in two exogamous halves, Raven and Sea Gull (or Wolf), and a person had to marry someone from the opposite half.
zh: 阿拉斯加内陆的塔纳纳阿萨巴斯卡人，社会分为八九个母系氏族，归入乌鸦和海鸥（或狼）两个外婚半族，人必须与对方半族的人通婚。

en:
Dimasa religion is the ancient animist and shamanic faith of the Dimasa, the Kachari people of the Dhansiri valley and the Assam hills. A typical village had neither idols nor temples; the earth, air and sky were thought to be filled with unseen spirits called Madai.

Six ancestral gods held authority over the whole country as area gods, and their unstructured shrines, called Daikho, were widely held to number twelve; the name means house of the god. Kechai-khaiti was the tutelary goddess of the Kacharis, with a shrine at Sadiya.

In 1520 King Khorapha struck at Dimapur the first Hindu-style coin of the Brahmaputra valley, naming the goddess Chandi. In the nineteenth century the Dimasa of the Cachar plains turned to Hinduism while the hill Dimasa kept the old faith.
zh:
戴科泛灵论是底马撒人古老的万物有灵和萨满信仰。底马撒人即卡恰尔人，居住在丹西里河谷和阿萨姆山地。典型的底马撒村寨既没有偶像，也没有神庙；人们认为大地、空气和天空中充满看不见的神灵，称为马代。

六位祖先神作为地域神掌管整片国土，他们没有固定建筑的圣所叫戴科，一般认为共有十二处，词义为“神的居所”。凯切—凯蒂是卡恰尔人的守护女神，在萨迪亚有一处神庙。

1520年国王科拉法在迪马布尔铸造了布拉马普特拉河谷第一枚印度教式钱币，上面写有昌迪女神之名。19世纪，卡恰尔平原上的底马撒人改信印度教，山区的底马撒人则保持古老信仰。

en:
Dogon villages cling to the Bandiagara escarpment of Mali, where the people by tradition retreated to escape Islamization, reaching the Sanga region in the 1400s. They hold that a single creator, Amma, made the world, and that the Nommo, twin water spirits shown as human above and serpent below, are ancestral beings.

The dead are honoured with mask dances. Every sixty years the Sigui festival marks the first death of an ancestor, who died in the form of a snake, with a new great mask.

Blacksmiths, said to descend from the first smith, mediate between the living, the ancestors and Amma. Muslim slavers and jihadists treated the Dogon as unbelievers who could be raided, and the cliffs sheltered their villages.
zh:
多贡人的村落依傍马里的邦贾加拉悬崖，传统上认为他们为躲避伊斯兰化而退居于此，15世纪抵达桑加地区。他们认为独一的造物主阿马创造了世界，努莫是一对水灵，上半身如人、下半身似蛇，是祖先般的存在。

人们用面具舞蹈纪念亡者。每隔60年的西吉节，各村都要制作新的大面具，纪念最初那位以蛇形死去的祖先。

铁匠据说是第一位铁匠的后裔，在生者、祖先与阿马之间斡旋。穆斯林奴隶贩子和圣战者把多贡人当作可以劫掠的异教徒，悬崖庇护了他们的村落。

en:
The Xerente, who call themselves Akwê, live on the right bank of the Tocantins River in central Brazil. Their dualist cosmology rests on a creation myth centred on a pair of mythic heroes dwelling in the sun and the moon.

The same pair divides the people. Society is split into two exogamous moieties, the sun moiety Doí and the moon moiety Wahirê, each made up of three or four clans, and a man must marry into the other half. The Xerente laid out their villages in a semicircle. Jesuit missionaries and the bandeirante expeditions of the interior reached them in the 1600s.
zh:
谢伦特人自称阿克韦，居住在巴西中部托坎廷斯河右岸。他们的二元宇宙观以创世神话为基础，神话以一对栖居在太阳和月亮之中的神话英雄为中心。

这一对英雄也把族人一分为二。社会分成两个族外婚的半偶族，太阳半偶族叫多伊，月亮半偶族叫瓦雷，各由三四个氏族组成，男子必须娶另一半的女子。谢伦特人把村庄排成半圆形。17世纪，耶稣会传教士和深入内陆的旗队探险者来到他们那里。

en:
The Nakhi people of northwestern Yunnan, around Lijiang, also call their priests dongba. Their faith is held to descend from the Bön religion of Tibet, and by Nakhi tradition it came to Yunnan with a Bön shaman from eastern Tibet, Dongba Shilo.

Dongba priests perform the rites that propitiate the many gods and spirits of nature, among them sacrifices to Heaven and funerals. At the core of the faith is the belief that humans and nature are two half-brothers born of two mothers and one father. The priests alone kept the pictographic Dongba script.

Lijiang, the Nakhi heartland, submitted to Khubilai Khan in 1253, and from 1382 its hereditary Mu chieftains ruled it under the Ming until the Qing replaced them in 1723. Nakhi temples mix Dongba and Buddhist art.
zh:
云南西北部丽江一带的纳西人，也把自己的祭司称作东巴。据说这一信仰源自西藏的苯教，纳西族传说，一位来自西藏东部的苯教巫师东巴什罗把这套教义带到了云南。

东巴祭司举行各种仪式来安抚自然界的诸多神灵，包括祭天和丧葬。这一信仰的核心，是认为人与自然是同父异母的两兄弟。只有祭司掌握象形的东巴文。

纳西人的中心丽江于1253年归附忽必烈，1382年起由世袭的木氏土司在明朝治下统治，直到1723年清廷取代他们。纳西人的寺庙把东巴艺术与佛教艺术结合。

en:
The Tani peoples of Arunachal, the Adi, Galo, Nyishi, Apatani, Tagin and Mishing, all trace descent from the ancestor Abotani, and the name Donyi-Polo, meaning Sun-Moon, was later given to their animist beliefs. These were a local oral tradition of myths, with no scripture, priestly hierarchy or fixed shrines.

Shamans called nyibu performed the rites in village or household, raising an altar only when needed and taking it down afterwards. Donyi, the Sun, was addressed as Mother and Polo, the Moon, as Father and were called on to witness the truth and punish liars. The Minyong and Padam Adi told of a creator, Sedi, whose eyes became the Sun and Moon; the Galo called him Jimi.
zh:
阿鲁纳恰尔的塔尼诸族，即阿迪人、加洛人、尼西人、阿帕塔尼人、塔金人和米星人，都自称是祖先阿博塔尼的后裔；冬尼波罗意为“日月”，是后来人们给他们的万物有灵信仰起的名字。这些信仰是各地口传的神话，没有经典，没有祭司等级，也没有固定的神庙。

巫师尼布在村里或家中主持仪式，需要时才搭起祭坛，事后拆掉。人们称太阳多尼为母亲，月亮波罗为父亲，请他们为真话作证，惩罚说谎的人。敏荣和帕达姆两支阿迪人说，创造者是塞迪，他的双眼变成了日月；加洛人则称他为吉米。

en:
In the Aboriginal Australian worldview that the Warlpiri call Jukurrpa and English speakers the Dreaming, the land was made and inhabited by ancestral beings, often of heroic size or with supernatural powers. Every place and creature takes its meaning from its origin in the Dreaming, and places such as Uluru hold special potency. The Dreaming is not a distant past but a continuing reality, which the anthropologist William Stanner called everywhen.

A person may own a Dreaming of their country, such as the kangaroo or honey ant, and through it their ancestry runs as one unbroken cycle from which all knowledge comes. The English word Dreamtime renders an Arrernte word that some scholars think is closer to eternal or uncreated.
zh:
澳大利亚原住民的这种世界观，瓦尔皮里人称作朱库尔帕，英语称作梦创时代。在其中，大地由祖先神灵创造并居住过，这些祖先往往身形英雄般高大，或拥有超自然的力量。每个地方、每种生灵的意义，都来自它们在梦创时代的起源，乌鲁鲁等一些地方更有特殊的灵力。梦创不是遥远的过去，而是持续不断的现实，人类学家威廉·斯坦纳把它称作“无时不在”。

一个人可以拥有自己地域的某一种梦创，比如袋鼠梦创或蜜蚁梦创，他的祖先通过它连成一个不断的循环，一切知识都来自这里。英语里的“梦创时代”译自阿伦特语中的一个词，有些学者认为这个词的意思更接近“永恒、未被创造”。

en:
The Druze faith arose in Fatimid Cairo in 1017–1018, when the Ismaili preacher Hamza ibn Ali began to teach a doctrine of the unity of God under the patronage of the caliph al-Hakim. It holds that God deals with the world through emanations, with a Cosmic Mind among them, and that the soul is eternal.

The faith keeps no clergy; only a few initiates are admitted to its secrets, and since 1046 it has been closed to converts. The Druze settled in Mount Lebanon and southern Syria. In 1305 the Mamluks defeated them at Keserwan and forced them to outward Sunni conformity, and Ottoman expeditions such as that of 1585 attacked them.
zh:
德鲁兹派于1017至1018年兴起于法蒂玛王朝治下的开罗，当时伊斯玛仪派传教士哈姆扎·伊本·阿里在哈里发哈基姆的庇护下开始宣讲真主独一的教义。这一信仰认为神通过流溢与世界相联，“宇宙心智”即在其中，灵魂不灭。

这一信仰没有神职人员，只有少数入门者才能知晓其奥秘，自1046年起不再接纳皈依者。德鲁兹人定居在黎巴嫩山和叙利亚南部。1305年，马穆鲁克在凯斯鲁万击败他们，迫使其表面上顺从逊尼派；1585年等奥斯曼人的远征也攻击过他们。

official_raw.en: Although emerging from $ismaili_school$, $druzism_ADJ$ people do not consider themselves $muslim_ADJ$. Besides its obvious influence from $muslim$, it also gets influence from other Abrahamic and non-Abrahamic religions, giving rise to a distinct faith with emphasis on esotericism and the Cosmic Mind which all souls reunite to after many reincarnations.
official_raw.zh: 尽管$druzism_ADJ$起源于$ismaili_school$，但其信徒并不自视为$muslim_ADJ$。除了明显的$muslim$影响外，它还受到其他亚伯拉罕宗教与非亚伯拉罕宗教的影响，形成了一种强调神秘主义与“宇宙心智”的独特信仰，认为所有灵魂在多次转世后将回归其中。

en:
The Lio, the people of the Ende-Lio region in central Flores, say that their first men came down from Mount Lepembusu, and each village was led by chiefs called mosalaki. Above all stood Du'a Ngga'e, the supreme god, to whom offerings were made in the ritual ground called kanga, around a standing stone. Below him were Nitupa'i, the most feared of the spirits, and the ancestors, who had to be honoured.

Each year after the field rite ka po'o the mosalaki and farmers shared a meal to feed the ancestors and ward off pests and disease. From the sixteenth century the spice trade brought Indian and Portuguese influence to Flores, and the Lio later turned mostly to Catholicism and Islam.
zh:
弗洛勒斯岛中部恩德-利奥地区的利奥人说，他们的第一批人从勒彭布苏山降下，每个村寨由称为“莫萨拉基”的首领主持。至高无上的是至高神杜阿·恩加埃，人们在称为“康加”的仪式场地上、围着竖石向他献祭。其下有最令人畏惧的灵体尼图帕伊，以及必须敬奉的祖先。

每年田间仪式“卡波奥”之后，莫萨拉基和农人共进一餐，以供养祖先、驱除虫害和疾病。16世纪起，香料贸易给弗洛勒斯带来印度和葡萄牙的影响，利奥人后来多数转信天主教和伊斯兰教。

en: Ebore belongs to the Gonja, a Guan-speaking people of northern Ghana whose kingdom was founded in 1675 by Sumaila Ndewura Jakpa. Its commoners were animists, while the ruling class and traders were Muslim, and Islam spread among the Gonja in the 1700s.
zh: 埃博里属于加纳北部讲关语的贡贾人，贡贾王国由苏迈拉·恩杜拉·贾克帕于1675年创建。平民多信万物有灵，统治阶层和商人则是穆斯林，18世纪伊斯兰教在贡贾人中传播开来。

en:
The Jola of Senegal and the Gambia recognised a single God, Emit or Ata Emit, the master of the universe, linked to the sky, the rain and the turning year. They honoured charms and sacred precincts without worshipping them, and held that the spirits called Bakin or Eneerti guard families, villages and rice fields, even against conversion to Islam and Christianity.

Funeral rites were essential, for without them a soul could not reach the creator and join the ancestors. Most Jola lived without chiefs, though some, as at Oussouye, had a king who served more as priest than ruler. Some accepted Islam only after the Soninke-Marabout war of the 1800s.
zh:
塞内加尔和冈比亚的乔拉人传统上承认唯一的神埃米泰，又称阿塔·埃米泰，意为宇宙的主人，并把他同天空、雨水和岁时流转联系起来。他们敬重护符和圣域而不加崇拜，又认为名为巴金或埃内尔蒂的灵守护家庭、村庄和稻田，甚至能保护人们不被迫皈依伊斯兰教和基督教。

葬礼不可缺少，因为没有葬礼，灵魂就不能到达造物主身边、与祖先团聚。多数乔拉人社会没有首领，有的地方如乌苏耶则有一位国王，作用更像祭司而不是统治者。有些乔拉人到19世纪索宁凯与马拉布特战争之后才接受伊斯兰教。

en: The Enggano people of Enggano Island, off the southwest coast of Sumatra, were first met by Portuguese explorers in the early 1500s. Their faith combined animism, totemism and the worship of ancestors, and on the island these beliefs survived long after contact.
zh: 苏门答腊西南海岸外恩加诺岛上的恩加诺人，在16世纪初最早遇到了葡萄牙探险家。他们的信仰融合了泛灵论、图腾崇拜和祖先崇拜，在岛上的一些地方，这些信仰在接触之后仍长久延续。

en:
The Erzya are a Mordvinic people of the middle Volga who speak a Uralic language. Their tradition names Nishke, or Nishkepaz, as the originating god.

In Erzya myth the high gods hatched from an egg. Ange Patiai is the mother of the gods, followed by the Sun god Chipaz, who begot Nishkepaz, the earth god Mastoron Kirdi and the wind god Varmanpaz. From Chipaz and the Harvest Mother Norovava came Mastorpaz, lord of the underworld.

The Mordvins fell under the Golden Horde in the thirteenth century, and after Russia took Kazan in 1552 they were all Russian subjects. Russian Orthodoxy converted them by force, notably in the seventeenth century, yet a few villages kept the old faith.
zh:
埃尔齐亚人是伏尔加河中游的莫尔多瓦人的一支，说乌拉尔语系的语言。他们的传统把尼什克，又称尼什克帕兹，奉为创始神。

埃尔齐亚神话里，诸位主神是从一枚蛋中孵化出来的。安盖·帕蒂艾是众神之母，其后是太阳神奇帕兹，他生下了尼什克帕兹、大地神马斯托龙·基尔季和风神瓦尔曼帕兹。奇帕兹与丰收之母诺罗瓦瓦生下冥界之主马斯托尔帕兹。

13世纪，莫尔多瓦人受金帐汗国统治，1552年俄国攻占喀山后，他们全都成了俄国的臣民。俄国东正教以强迫手段使他们改宗，17世纪尤其明显，但仍有少数村庄保留了旧信仰。

en: Eso belongs to the Kabye, mountain farmers of northern Togo. Their young men were initiated into adulthood by a week of seclusion, a pilgrimage over three mountains, the evala wrestling festival and finally circumcision.
zh: 埃索属于多哥北部山地农民卡比耶人。卡比耶青年要经过一周的隔离、翻越三座山的朝圣、埃瓦拉摔跤节，最后是割礼，才算成年。

en:
The Fang, forest farmers and hunters who spread across Rio Muni, northern Gabon and southern Cameroon, know their supreme creator god as Mebege, also called Nzeme. In one Fang tradition he was alone but for a spider, Dibobia, who urged him to make the earth.

Mebege fashioned an egg, which Dibobia set in the sea, and from it hatched three deities: Zame, the firstborn, linked to the sun, his sister Nyingwan, linked to fertility and the moon, and the youngest, Nlona, who stood for evil. Fang religious life centred on reverence for ancestors, whose skulls and bones were kept in wooden boxes guarded by Byeri reliquary figures.
zh:
芳人是务农狩猎的森林居民，分布在赤道几内亚木尼河地区、加蓬北部和喀麦隆南部，他们把至高的创世神称为梅贝格，又称恩泽梅。在芳人的一种说法里，他起初只有一只名叫迪博比亚的蜘蛛作伴，蜘蛛劝他创造大地。

梅贝格造出一枚蛋，由迪博比亚放入海中，孵出三位神：长子扎梅与太阳相关，他的妹妹尼因万与丰产和月亮相关，最小的恩洛纳则象征邪恶。芳人的宗教生活以敬祖为中心，祖先的头骨和骸骨存放在木盒里，由比耶里圣物匣木雕守护。

en:
Fomba Gasy means the Malagasy way, and it has been passed down in oral tales among the peoples of Madagascar. It has no single church.

Its creator is Zanahary, the sky god who gives life and receives the souls of the dead, while the earth god Ratovantany shapes human bodies from clay and takes them back at death. Ancestors are generally a kindly force, but neglected spirits can turn into harmful angatra, so bodies are rewrapped in fresh cloth in the funeral rite of famadihana.

The Merina kings of Imerina claimed blood of the Vazimba, the island's first inhabitants, through Andriamanelo, whose mother Rafohy was a Vazimba queen. His son Ralambo, who ruled from 1575 to 1612, honoured the sampy, royal amulets that protected the realm.
zh:
丰巴加西意为“马达加斯加的习俗”，在马达加斯加各族中靠口传故事代代相传。它没有统一的教会。

创世神是掌管天空的扎纳哈里，他赋予生命，死者的灵魂回到他那里；大地神拉托万塔尼用黏土塑造人的身体，人死后身体又归他所有。祖先通常是庇佑生者的力量，但被怠慢的亡灵会变成作祟的安加特拉，所以人们举行翻尸节，用新布重新包裹先人的遗体。

伊默里纳的梅里纳诸王自称有岛上最早居民瓦济姆巴人的血统：安德里亚马内洛的母亲拉福希是瓦济姆巴女王。他的儿子拉兰博在位于1575—1612年，崇奉保护王国的王室护符桑皮。

en:
The beliefs of the Austronesian peoples of Taiwan were never one system: every people kept its own spirits, gods, symbols and myths. The Paiwan and other southern peoples revered the hundred-pace snake and carved its diamond pattern into their designs.

Among many of the plains peoples only women, called inibs, could speak to the spirit world. The Siraya honoured the ancestral spirit Alid, represented by water jars on household altars. Under Dutch rule from 1624 the inibs were removed from the villages to clear the way for missionaries.

After the Zheng regime of 1662 and the Qing conquest of 1683, Han settlers brought Taoism and Buddhism to the plains, and many Siraya took up Han practices. Their fertility spirit Ali-zu entered the local Han pantheon.
zh:
台湾南岛语诸族的信仰从来不是一个体系：各族有各自的神灵、神明、象征和神话。排湾人和南部其他族群敬奉百步蛇，把它背上的菱形花纹刻在各种图案里。

在许多平原族群里，只有被称为尪姨的女性才能与灵界沟通。西拉雅人敬祖灵阿立，家中祖坛上以水壶为象征。1624年起荷兰人统治台湾南部，为了给传教扫清道路，把尪姨从村子里赶了出去。

1662年郑氏政权建立、1683年清朝取得台湾之后，汉人移民把道教和佛教带到平原，许多西拉雅人采用了汉人的信仰；他们的生育之神阿立祖被纳入当地汉人的神谱。

en: Geno belongs to the Fula herders who had not taken up Islam, which most Fula embraced early and made a mark of their identity. As late as the early 1700s these non-Muslim Fula, called Pulli, still lived in Futa Jallon, where Muslim Fula rose against them and the Jallonke and founded the imamate of Timbo.
zh: 格诺属于尚未皈依伊斯兰教的富拉尼牧民；大多数富拉尼人很早就接受了伊斯兰教，并以此作为族群认同的标志。直到18世纪初，被称为普利的非穆斯林富拉尼人仍生活在富塔贾隆，穆斯林富拉尼人在那里起兵反抗他们和贾隆克人，建立了廷博伊玛目国。

en: Ghari belongs to the Ghari-speaking people of western Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, an island called Isatabu by its own people, which Alvaro de Mendana's Spaniards first charted in 1568. Later, the Vaturanga dialect of Ghari was widely used in missionary and liturgical translations.
zh: 加里属于所罗门群岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛西部说加里语的居民；这座岛本地人称伊萨塔布，1568年首次由阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚的西班牙人绘入海图。后来，加里语的瓦图兰加方言被广泛用于传教和礼拜用的翻译。

en:
The Godala are a Sanhaja Berber tribe of the Atlantic coast of what is now Mauritania, who traded along the lower Senegal. Like other Berber peoples, they inherited an old body of beliefs in which sun and moon were revered, spirits dwelt in caves and springs, and the dead were honoured as ancestors.

By the middle of the eleventh century the Godala were only superficially Muslim and still kept many pagan practices. Their chief brought the preacher Abdallah ibn Yasin to teach them orthodox Sunni Islam, and the Godala joined the Almoravid alliance.

They rebelled against its strict rule more than once, and in 1056 they killed the Lamtuna commander Yahya ibn Umar. By 1337 the old rites survived only as remnants beside Islam.
zh:
戈达拉是桑哈贾柏柏尔人的一支，居住在今毛里塔尼亚的大西洋沿岸，沿塞内加尔河下游贸易。和其他柏柏尔人一样，他们继承了一套古老的信仰：崇拜日月，相信洞穴和泉水中栖居着灵，并把死者当作祖先来敬奉。

11世纪中叶，戈达拉人只是表面上信了伊斯兰教，仍保留许多异教习俗。他们的首领请来传教士阿卜杜拉·本·亚辛，向他们传授正统逊尼派教义，戈达拉人也加入了穆拉比特联盟。

他们不止一次反抗联盟的严格统治，1056年还杀死了拉姆图纳人的统帅叶海亚·本·乌马尔。到1337年，古老的仪式只作为残余存在于伊斯兰教旁边。

en: Goma belongs to the Tobelo of Halmahera, and is marked by shamanism and the cult of spirits. When Tomé Pires wrote his Suma Oriental around 1515, the Jailolo kingdom there was still largely heathen, although its king was already a Muslim.
zh: 戈马属于哈马黑拉岛的托贝洛人，带有萨满教色彩和灵体崇拜。约1515年托梅·皮雷斯写《东方概要》时，当地的贾伊洛洛王国虽然国王已信伊斯兰教，境内仍大体是异教徒。

en: The traditional faith of the Gorontalo people of northern Sulawesi gave way to Islam from about 1525, in the reign of King Amai. The Gorontalo kingdoms became a centre of Islam in the east of the archipelago, and in 1673 Gorontalo came under the Dutch East India Company.
zh: 苏拉威西北部哥伦打洛人的传统信仰，约1525年，在阿迈国王在位期间，随着伊斯兰教传入而逐渐被取代。哥伦打洛诸王国成为群岛东部的伊斯兰教中心之一；1673年，哥伦打洛归入荷兰东印度公司的管辖。

en:
Gos are the spirits of the Vilela, a hunting and gathering people of the Gran Chaco in what is now north-western Argentina. In the fifteenth century the Vilela lived in northern Tucumán and Santiago del Estero and eastern Salta, living on peccary, carob and honey.

After the Spanish conquest of Tucumán they moved east into the Chaco, and later the horse-riding Guaycuru pushed them still nearer the Paraná. Jesuits gathered the Vilela into missions from the 1730s until the order's expulsion in 1767.

In Vilela mythology the gos were the owners of nature. They could harm people, and Jesuit missionaries therefore called them devils, but they could also heal. Traditionally the Vilela shamans cured the sick by invoking the gos in songs whose power made them guarded knowledge.
zh:
戈斯是维莱拉人信奉的诸灵，维莱拉人是今阿根廷西北部大查科地区以狩猎采集为生的民族。15世纪，他们住在今图库曼省北部、圣地亚哥-德尔埃斯特罗省和萨尔塔省东部，以野猪、角豆和蜂蜜为食。

西班牙人征服图库曼之后，他们向东迁入查科；后来骑马的瓜伊库鲁人又把他们进一步挤向巴拉那河一带。耶稣会自18世纪30年代起把维莱拉人聚入传教村，直到1767年耶稣会被驱逐。

在维莱拉人的神话里，戈斯是自然的“主人”。他们能加害于人，耶稣会传教士因此把他们称作魔鬼，但他们也能治病。传统上，维莱拉人的萨满通过歌唱召请戈斯来治病，这些歌的力量极大，被视为不可轻易外传的知识。

en:
Gosain is the spirit worship of the Paharia hill peoples of the Rajmahal Hills, the Sauria and Mal Paharia. The name belongs to a host of local spirits tied to every part of the world around them, male and female. One is the Gomo Gosain of the house pillar, who gives health.

The chief shrine is the Manjhi Than, where the most important male Gosain lives as five black stones and receives sacrifices twice a year. Female Gosain are fed black fowl and pigs at their own shrines. Ancestors are feasted by the village priest and are held to join the sun god Dharmer Gosain once satisfied.

In the later eighteenth century the Mal Paharia fought the East India Company until the pacification of 1778. From the 1830s Santal settlers moved into their hills.
zh:
戈赛因是拉杰马哈尔山区帕哈里亚人，也就是绍里亚帕哈里亚人和马尔帕哈里亚人的神灵崇拜。戈赛因是一大批与周围万物相连的地方神灵的统称，有男有女。其中有房屋立柱上赐人健康的戈莫戈赛因。

最主要的圣所是曼吉坛，最重要的男性戈赛因化身为五块黑石，每年两次接受献祭。女性戈赛因在各自的圣所里享用黑鸡和猪。祖先由村祭司设宴祭祀，据说得到满足后就能与太阳神达尔梅尔戈赛因合一。

18世纪后期，马尔帕哈里亚人与东印度公司作战，直到1778年的“绥靖”。1830年代起，桑塔尔移民进入他们的山区。

en:
Wakanism is the sacred outlook of the Great Plains peoples, taking its name from the Siouan word wakan, ‘holy’. Among the Lakota, Wakan Tanka denoted a group of sacred powers whose ways were hidden from men, and the Omaha, Osage and other Siouan peoples knew it as Wakanda.

The Pawnee, who speak a Caddoan language, show the same star-centred religion in its fullest form. They held that the Morning Star and the Evening Star bore the first woman, and the Moon and the Sun the first man, and they offered the stars maize.

The Skidi Pawnee sacrificed a captive girl to the Morning Star in a rite meant to bring fertile fields. Their chief Knife Chief ransomed captives from it, and in 1817 his kinsman Petalesharo cut a Comanche girl loose from the scaffold.
zh:
瓦卡萨满教是大平原诸民族的神圣观念，得名于苏语族中表示“神圣”的词 wakan。在拉科塔人那里，瓦坎·坦卡指一组行事不为人所知的神圣力量；奥马哈人、奥萨格人等苏语族民族则称之为瓦坎达。

说卡多语族语言的波尼人，把这种以星辰为中心的信仰表现得最完整。他们相信晨星和昏星生下了第一个女人，月亮和太阳生下了第一个男人，并向星辰献上玉米。

斯基迪波尼人曾以被俘的少女祭祀晨星，认为这能使田地丰产。他们的酋长“刀酋长”曾多次赎出被俘者，他的亲属佩塔勒沙罗则在1817年把一名科曼奇少女从祭台上解了下来。

en:
The Guanche religion is the belief system of the native Canarians, best recorded on Tenerife, where the supreme god was Achamán, the Gleaming One. His consort Chaxiraxi, who bears the sky, was later identified with the Virgin of Candelaria, whose image appeared on the beach at Güímar. The creator god was Acorán on Gran Canaria and Abora on La Palma.

The Guanches held that the evil Guayota, appearing as a great shaggy dog, dwelt inside Mount Teide. They revered the sun, Magec, swore oaths by it, and buried the dead with offerings, mummifying them on Tenerife. The beliefs are known only from accounts left by the Christian conquerors of the fifteenth century.
zh:
阿查曼教是加那利群岛土著的信仰体系，以特内里费岛上的记载最为详细，那里的至高神是阿查曼，意为“闪耀者”。他的配偶查希拉希承托着苍穹，后来被与出现在吉马尔海滩的坎德拉里亚圣母像等同。创世神在大加那利岛称阿科兰，在拉帕尔马岛称阿博拉。

关切人相信恶神瓜约塔化作巨大的长毛犬，居住在泰德峰内部。他们崇拜太阳神马赫克，对着太阳发誓，并用供品随葬死者，在特内里费岛上还把遗体制成木乃伊。这些信仰只通过15世纪基督教征服者的记述保存下来。

en: The Guasave, also called the Tamazula, were a coastal people of northwestern Sinaloa who lived among the marshes and estuaries on fish, clams and wild fruit, and spoke a language unlike those of their Sinaloan neighbours. This is the traditional belief of that people.
zh: 瓜萨韦人又称塔马苏拉人，是锡那罗亚西北部的滨海民族，生活在沼泽和河口地带，以鱼、蛤和野果为生，所说的语言与锡那罗亚邻族不同。瓜萨韦信仰就是这个民族的传统信仰。

en:
The traditional religion of the Hani, a Tibeto-Burman people of the Ailao Mountains in southern Yunnan, is polytheist, with nature and soul worship and a special reverence for ancestral spirits. Its priests are of three kinds: those who direct the main celebrations, the beima, who perform exorcisms and magic, and the nima, men or women, who make predictions and give medicinal herbs.

The past is kept in oral literature: a creation myth, the flood story, and the epic of the ancestors who crossed the river, chanted at festivals and sacrifices. Each Hani learns to recite the names of his ancestors from the first Hani family down to himself.
zh:
哈尼人是滇南哀牢山区的藏缅语族民族。他们的传统信仰是多神崇拜，有自然崇拜和灵魂崇拜，对祖先之灵尤为尊崇。祭司分三类：主持大祭的人，行驱邪和法术的贝玛，以及占卜预言、施用草药的尼玛，尼玛男女都可担任。

过去的事靠口传文学保存：有创世神话、洪水故事，还有讲述祖先渡江而来的史诗，庆典和祭祀上要吟唱。每个哈尼人都要学会背诵祖先的名字，从第一个哈尼家庭一直背到自己。

en:
Hellenism is the attempt to revive the worship of the ancient Greek gods. Historians think the old religion had died out by the ninth century. Its first advocate was the late Byzantine philosopher Georgios Gemistos Plethon, who taught in Mystras, in the Despotate of the Morea, and declared in a speech that the Greeks were Hellenes by race and culture.

In his last work, the Nomoi, or Book of Laws, Plethon rejected Christianity for the worship of the Olympian gods, mixed with the wisdom of Zoroaster and the Magi. Zeus stood at the head as the self-father of all things, with the other gods ranked in orders beneath him.

Plethon died in 1452 or 1454. In 1460 the Patriarch Gennadius II, once his pupil, burned the only copy, though Gennadius's letter summarising it survives.
zh:
希腊多神教是复兴古希腊诸神崇拜的尝试。历史学家认为古老的宗教最迟在9世纪已经消亡。最早的倡导者是拜占庭晚期哲学家格弥斯托士·卜列东，他在摩里亚专制公国的米斯特拉讲学，在一次演讲中宣称希腊人在种族和文化上都是希腊人。

卜列东的最后一部著作是《法律书》，书中他否定基督教，主张崇拜奥林匹斯诸神，并融入琐罗亚斯德和祆教祭司的智慧。宙斯居于首位，是万物的自生之父，其他诸神按等级排在他之下。

卜列东死于1452年或1454年。1460年，曾是他学生的君士坦丁堡牧首根纳迪乌斯二世烧毁了仅有的抄本，不过根纳迪乌斯概述该书内容的信保存了下来。

en:
Hinduism has no founder. Believers uphold dharma through ritual and righteous living as taught in the Vedas, and its scriptures include the Upanishads, the Puranas and the epics Ramayana and Mahabharata. It speaks of karma, the cycle of rebirth and liberation from it, called moksha. Vaishnavism centres on Vishnu, Shaivism on Shiva and Shaktism on the Goddess.

In 1337 Hinduism was the religion of many kingdoms, from the Hoysalas of Karnataka to Majapahit in Java. The Delhi Sultanate had raided and annexed Deccan kingdoms, and in 1336 the brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I founded Vijayanagara as a Hindu power in the south. Between about 1250 and 1750 the Bhakti movement of personal devotion to a chosen god grew ever more prominent, though the Portuguese inquisition at Goa in 1560 persecuted Hindus.
zh:
印度教没有创始人。信徒通过仪式和正直的生活来维护正法，其依据是吠陀；经典包括奥义书、往世书以及史诗《罗摩衍那》和《摩诃婆罗多》。它讲究业、轮回，以及从轮回中得到的解脱，称为“莫克沙”。毗湿奴派以毗湿奴为中心，湿婆派以湿婆为中心，性力派以女神为中心。

1337年，从卡纳塔克的曷萨拉到爪哇的满者伯夷，许多王国都信奉印度教。德里苏丹国已经劫掠并吞并了德干的多个王国，1336年，哈里哈拉一世和布卡·拉亚一世兄弟建立了毗奢耶那伽罗，成为南方的印度教强国。大约从1250到1750年，崇奉个人所选之神的虔信运动日益兴盛，而1560年葡萄牙人在果阿设立的宗教裁判所则迫害过印度教徒。

official_raw.en: A collection of different beliefs rather than a unified religion, $hindu$ is often considered the oldest religious tradition in the world. All its beliefs and practices understood as explanations of the $dharmic$, the cosmic order, it stems from the ancient Vedic literature. Being so varied, it also contains a multitude of gods, although not all of them are equally venerated or even recognized by all $hindu_ADJ$ practitioners, depending on their particular beliefs and orientations. The four main branches of $hindu$ are $vaishnavism$, $shaktism$, $shaivism$, and $smartism$.
official_raw.zh: $hindu$并非统一的宗教，而是多种信仰的集合，通常被认为是世界上最古老的宗教传统。其所有信仰与实践被理解为对“正法”（宇宙秩序）的解释，源自古老的吠陀文献。由于其多样性，$hindu_ADJ$包含众多神祇，但并非所有神祇都受到同等崇拜，甚至并非所有$hindu$信徒都认可这些神祇，这取决于他们的具体信仰与取向。印度教的四大主要分支是$vaishnavism$、$shaktism$、$shaivism$和$smartism$。

en:
Kev Dab Qhuas, the way of spirit worship, is the traditional religion of the Hmong, or Miao, of southwestern China. It is animistic, built on reverence for unseen spirits called dab.

In the oral epics of the Qiandong Miao, Mother Butterfly is the ancestral mother: born inside a sacred maple, she laid twelve eggs, from which came the first man, Jang Vang, and the Thunder God. Shamans are chosen by the spirits, not by inheritance, and ride a spirit horse, represented by the shaman's bench, into the spirit world to diagnose and heal.

A household altar to the spirit of good fortune receives rice, chicken and joss paper. Under Ming and Qing rule Miao risings were put down, among them the rising of 1735 against forced assimilation, which ended in 1738.
zh:
章夸教的意思是崇拜神灵之道，是中国西南苗人的传统信仰。它是一种万物有灵的信仰，崇敬看不见的神灵。

黔东苗族的口传史诗里，蝴蝶妈妈是人类的始祖母：她生在一棵神圣的枫树里，产下十二枚蛋，孵出了第一个人姜央和雷神。萨满由神灵选定，不能世袭，骑上象征灵马的法凳，进入灵界诊断和治病。

每家的神坛上供奉福神，祭品有米饭、鸡和纸钱。明清两代，苗人的起义屡遭镇压，其中1735年反对强制同化的起义到1738年才告终。

en:
Hussitism followed Jan Hus, a Czech preacher influenced by John Wycliffe, who held that Scripture stood above Church tradition and that the laity should receive communion in both bread and wine. The Council of Constance burned Hus in 1415, and Bohemia answered with an uprising. The chalice became the emblem of the movement, whose members were called Calixtines or Utraquists.

The moderates set out their programme in the Four Articles of Prague of 1420. The radical Taborites followed Wycliffe further. Under Jan Žižka the Hussites beat back five crusades in 1419–1434.

In 1434 the Utraquists and Catholics crushed the Taborites at Lipany, and the Peace of Kutná Hora in 1485 gave Catholics and Utraquists equal rights in Bohemia. Catholicism was reimposed after the Battle of White Mountain in 1620.
zh:
胡斯派追随捷克传道者扬·胡斯。胡斯受约翰·威克里夫思想影响，主张圣经高于教会传统，俗人也应兼领饼和酒。1415年，康斯坦茨会议把胡斯烧死，波希米亚随即爆发起义。圣杯成为这一运动的标志，其成员因此被称为圣杯派或兼领派。

温和派在1420年的《布拉格四条款》中提出纲领。激进的塔博尔派则更多地追随威克里夫。1419至1434年间，胡斯派在扬·杰式卡率领下击退了五次十字军。

1434年，兼领派与天主教徒在利潘击溃了塔博尔派；1485年的库特纳霍拉和约使天主教徒与兼领派在波希米亚享有平等权利。1620年白山战役后，天主教被重新强加于波希米亚。

official_raw.en: Founded by Jan Hus, the $hussite_ADJ$ Church emerged as a proto-Protestant movement in $BOH$, blending elements of the $BYZ_ADJ$ Rite with the teachings of John Wycliffe. It emphasized communion under both kinds and the importance of scripture over Church tradition.
official_raw.zh: $hussite_ADJ$教会由扬·胡斯创立，是$BOH$地区的一个早期新教运动，融合了$BYZ_ADJ$礼要素与约翰·威克里夫的教义。它强调兼领圣体圣血以及圣经高于教会传统的重要性。

en:
The Ibadis take their name from Abd Allah ibn Ibad of Basra, who around 683 rejected the extremists among the Kharijites and argued that Muslim opponents were guilty of ingratitude, not idolatry, so that believers could live among them. Ibadis hold that the imam is elected by the community and must be deposed if he sins.

Missionaries from Basra carried the school to Oman, North Africa and East Africa. In 1337 the Nabhani kings ruled inland Oman, leaving the elected imamate a largely symbolic role, while in North Africa Ibadis lived on in the Mzab and the Nafusa Mountains. In 1624 the Yaruba imams replaced the Nabhanis and drove the Portuguese from Muscat; the Al Bu Said took over in 1744.
zh:
伊巴德派得名于巴士拉的阿卜杜拉·本·伊巴德，他约在683年拒绝了哈瓦利吉派中极端派的主张，认为穆斯林对手犯的是忘恩之罪而非多神之罪，因而信徒可以与他们共处。伊巴德派认为伊玛目由社群选举产生，若犯罪就必须罢免。

巴士拉的传教士把这一派带到阿曼、北非和东非。1337年，纳卜汉王朝的国王们统治阿曼内陆，选举产生的伊玛目只剩象征性的角色；在北非，伊巴德派信徒仍生活在姆扎卜和奈富塞山。1624年，亚鲁巴伊玛目取代纳卜汉王朝，把葡萄牙人逐出马斯喀特；1744年，阿尔布赛义德家族接掌政权。

en:
Ijaw religion is the traditional belief of the Ijaw, or Izon, fishing peoples of the Niger Delta, who were trading along the coast by the 1400s. Ancestors are venerated, and the Owuamapu, water spirits who share human strengths and faults, hold a central place: people are held to live among them before birth, and prayer keeps the living in their favour.

Divination called Igbadai questions the recently dead about the cause of their death. Each year festivals lasting several days honour the spirits, and masked dancers are thought to be possessed by the spirits they represent. Egbesu, whose totems are the leopard, panther and lion, is revered as a god of justice.
zh:
伊乔人的宗教是尼日尔河三角洲伊乔人（又称伊宗人）渔民的传统信仰，他们在15世纪已沿海岸经商。人们崇敬祖先，水灵奥瓦马普占据核心位置：他们和人一样既有长处也有缺点，传统上认为人在出生以前就生活在水灵之间，祈祷是为了让生者保持水灵的眷顾。

当地有一种叫伊格巴代的占卜，向刚去世的人询问死因。每年都有持续数日的节庆敬奉水灵，戴面具的舞者被认为会被所代表的水灵附体。埃格贝苏以豹、黑豹和狮子为图腾，被奉为正义之神。

en:
Imunu is the name that Papuan peoples traditionally gave to a power that pervades things, including ritual objects. The Papuans are a Melanesian people of at least 240 groups, each with its own language, living mainly on sago, hunting, fishing and small gardens.

In masked ceremonies imunu takes visible form, and the masks mostly show humans or ancestors rather than plants or animals. Ancestors matter in this belief but are not necessarily revered, and placating their spirits is a recurring theme. Fear of sorcery and witchcraft was widespread. Before hunting or war, spirits were called on to advise and protect the men, and gope boards were thought to hold the spirits of powerful warriors or to guard the village.
zh:
伊穆努是巴布亚诸民族传统上对一种力量的称呼，这种力量遍及万物，包括仪式用品。巴布亚人是美拉尼西亚人，至少有240个群体，各有自己的语言，主要靠西米、狩猎、捕鱼和小块园地为生。

在面具仪式中，伊穆努显现出具体的形象，面具大多表现人或祖先，而不是植物或动物。祖先在这种信仰里很重要，却不一定受到崇拜，安抚祖先之灵是反复出现的主题。对妖术和巫术的恐惧也很普遍。出猎或出征之前，人们会请灵来出主意并加以庇佑，戈佩板则被认为附有强大战士的灵魂，或是守护村落。

en:
The Inca elite claimed descent from Inti, who was shown as a golden disk with a face and rays; his temple at Cusco was the Qorikancha, where a field of golden maize stood. Wiraqucha was said to have made humanity on an island in Lake Titicaca and withdrawn.

Alongside Inti the state sacrificed to Illapa of thunder, to the Moon, Mama Killa, and to the Earth, Pachamama. Sacred places and objects called wak’a, mountains above all, lay across the Andes, with festivals such as the Inti Raymi at the June solstice. Dead rulers were mummified and honoured as if alive, until in 1559 the Spaniard Polo de Ondegardo seized them in Cusco.
zh:
印加的统治者自称是因蒂的后裔；因蒂的形象是一个带着面孔和光芒的金盘，他在库斯科的神庙是科里坎查，里面有一块黄金制的玉米田。传说维拉科查在的的喀喀湖的一座岛上造出了人类后隐去。

除因蒂外，国家还祭祀掌管雷电的伊利亚帕、月亮玛玛·基利亚和大地帕查玛玛。安第斯各地分布着称为瓦卡的圣地和圣物，山岳尤其如此，节庆则有6月至日举行的因蒂·赖米节。去世的统治者被制成木乃伊，像活人一样受到供奉，直到1559年西班牙人波洛·德·翁德加多在库斯科把它们收走。

official_raw.en: $inti_god$, together with $viracocha$, are the main gods that guide and protect the people of the $andes_region$
official_raw.zh: $inti_god$和$viracocha$是引导和庇佑$andes_region$人的主要神灵。

en:
Inuit religion is the traditional belief of the Inuit, who hunt along the Arctic and subarctic coasts from Alaska across northern Canada to Greenland. It had no formal clergy or church, and varied a good deal between communities.

Prey animals were treated as beings whose souls had to be propitiated, and taboos around hunting, birth and death kept the spirits content. Many peoples revered Nuliajuk, or Sedna, mistress of the sea animals, who withheld game when taboos were broken; the angakut, shamans who held helper spirits, travelled to her to plead for it.

European ships began meeting Inuit in the northeast of Canada in the sixteenth century, and Christianity spread slowly. In Greenland the angakut kept practising, sometimes in secret, and in 1746 King Christian VI wrote to the Greenlanders to complain of them.
zh:
因纽特泛灵论是因纽特人的传统信仰。因纽特人沿北极和亚北极海岸狩猎，从阿拉斯加经加拿大北部一直到格陵兰。它没有正式的神职人员和教会，各地社群之间差别很大。

猎物被看作灵魂必须安抚的生灵，围绕狩猎、生育和死亡的禁忌则用来让诸灵安心。许多族群敬奉海洋动物的主宰努利亚尤克，即塞德娜；有人触犯禁忌时她会扣住猎物不放，掌握辅助灵的萨满安加库特便要前往她那里求情。

16世纪，欧洲船只开始在加拿大东北部遇到因纽特人，基督教的传播则很缓慢。在格陵兰，安加库特继续活动，有时转入暗中；1746年国王克里斯蒂安六世曾致信格陵兰人，抱怨他们的活动。

en: Ipok is the traditional belief of the Melanau, the river and coast people of central Sarawak, who worshipped spirits called Ipok. Their land was long under Brunei's influence, and the Melanau who later turned to Islam gave up the old rites, though the Kaul festival still recalls them.
zh: 伊波克信仰是沙捞越中部河流与海岸地带的梅拉瑙人的传统信仰，信徒敬奉名为伊波克的灵体。梅拉瑙人的土地长期受文莱影响，后来皈依伊斯兰教的人放弃了旧仪式，但凯奥节仍保留着它们的痕迹。

en:
Orendism takes its name from orenda, a term scholars have used for a power that the Iroquoian peoples were thought to see in people, songs and natural things. It stands here for the traditional religion of the Haudenosaunee, among them the Mohawk, Oneida and Seneca, of the Northeastern Woodlands.

In their creation story the ruler Hawëni:yo’ lets the pregnant Sky Woman fall from a floating island above the clouds. Birds bear her down to the Turtle, on whose back Muskrat’s mud grows into the earth. She dies giving birth to the twins Hahgwehdiyu, the Good Mind, and Sawiskera, the Flint, who fought over the world.

Each village had a storyteller, and tales were not told in summer. In the late 1700s the Seneca prophet Handsome Lake gathered elements of the old religion into his Code.
zh:
奥伦迪图腾崇拜得名于奥伦达，这是学者用来称呼易洛魁诸民族认为存在于人、歌曲和自然物之中的一种力量的术语。这里指的是东北林地豪德诺索尼人的传统信仰，其中有莫霍克人、奥奈达人和塞内卡人。

他们的创世故事里，统治者霍韦尼约让怀孕的天女从云上的浮岛坠下，众鸟把她托到海龟背上，麝鼠带来的泥土在龟背上长成大地。她在生下双生子时死去，双生子是代表善念的哈格韦迪尤和代表恶念的“燧石”索维斯凯拉，二人为这个世界争斗。

每个村子都有说书人，夏天不讲故事。18世纪晚期，塞内卡先知汉德萨姆湖把旧宗教的一些内容收进他的《法典》。

en: The Irritila, or Laguneros, were the peoples of the lagoon country of the Coahuila and Durango border, around the Mayrán lagoon. They were more than a dozen tribes with different languages who communicated in Nahuatl, and the Jesuits were authorized to begin evangelizing them in 1594.
zh: 伊里提拉人又称拉古内罗人，生活在科阿韦拉与杜兰戈交界的湖区，环绕迈兰湖一带。他们由十二个以上说不同语言的部落组成，彼此以纳瓦特尔语交流；1594年，耶稣会获准开始对他们传教。

en:
Isese is the traditional religion of the Yoruba, whose kingdoms of Oyo and Ife lay in what is now southwestern Nigeria. Its creation story tells how the supreme god Olodumare sent the orisha Obatala to make the earth; Oduduwa cast the soil on the primeval waters at Ife, so Ife remained the sacred source of Yoruba kingship.

Below Olodumare stand the orisha and the ancestors, who return as Egungun masquerades. Priests called babalawo consulted Orunmila through Ifa divination, drawing on 256 Odu, collections of verses.

Oyo made Shango, god of thunder and traditionally its third Alaafin, a royal cult. After Ilorin broke away and came under Muslim Fulani leaders, it destroyed Oyo-Ile in 1835. Yoruba captives carried across the Atlantic took the orisha to the Americas, where they became the roots of Candomblé and Santería.
zh:
奥里沙教即约鲁巴人的传统宗教，约鲁巴人的奥约、伊费等王国位于今尼日利亚西南部。创世传说称，至高神奥洛杜马雷派奥里沙（神祇）奥巴塔拉去造大地；奥杜杜瓦把泥土撒在原初的水面上，伊费因此始终是约鲁巴王权的神圣源头。

奥洛杜马雷之下是奥里沙，以及以埃贡贡假面舞会形式回到人间的祖先。名为巴巴拉沃的祭司通过伊法占卜向奥伦米拉求问，所凭借的是256卷奥杜。

奥约把雷神尚戈奉为王室崇拜的对象，传统上他是奥约的第三位阿拉芬。伊洛林脱离奥约、落入穆斯林富拉尼人首领手中后，于1835年摧毁了奥约伊莱。被贩运过大西洋的约鲁巴俘虏把奥里沙信仰带到美洲，成为坎东布雷教和圣特里亚教的根源。

en:
Itaukei religion is the traditional faith of the indigenous Fijians. Its supreme god was Degei, a serpent and the creator of the Fijian world, who judged the newly dead as they passed through the caves of Cibaciba or Drakulu. A few went to the paradise of Burotu; most were thrown into a lake to sink and be rewarded or punished.

Belief was tied to descent from a spiritual ancestor, the vu, and groups who worshipped the same god, the tauvu, were held to share an origin. Families, the tokatoka, formed clans, the mataqali, which formed tribes, the yavusa. The yavusa of one territory made up the vanua under a senior chief, whose spokesmen and advisers were priests, the bete.
zh:
伊陶凯信仰是斐济原住民的传统信仰。它的最高神是德盖，一条蛇，也是斐济世界的创造者；刚死去的人要穿过奇巴奇巴或德拉库卢洞穴，由他审判灵魂。他把少数人送往布罗图乐园，把大多数人扔进一座湖里，让他们沉下去，各自得到奖赏或惩罚。

信仰同灵性祖先“伍”的血统紧紧相连，崇拜同一位神的群体称作陶伍，被认为有共同的起源。家庭托卡托卡组成氏族马塔卡利，氏族又组成部落亚武萨；同一片土地上的亚武萨组成瓦努亚，由最高酋长领导，祭司贝特是酋长的发言人和顾问。

en:
The Jai religion is the traditional belief of the Emberá, a riverside people of the Chocó of western Colombia and Panama, who deal with the jai, the spirits. These include the Wandra, mothers of the animals and plants who live at the river sources. Forest animals are held to be transformed souls of the dead.

The shaman, the jaibaná, is not hereditary but learns from an experienced teacher. By dealings with the jai he keeps up the hunt and the health of the community, and cures illness by driving out malignant spirits.

In myth, Caragabí made the first humans from clay borrowed from Tutruicá, and felled the tree Jenené, from whose root the sea sprang and whose branches are the rivers. In the late 1700s, pressed by the Spanish, many Emberá moved into Darién.
zh:
海瓦纳萨满教是恩贝拉人的传统信仰。恩贝拉人是哥伦比亚西部和巴拿马乔科地区的河岸民族，他们沿河而居，与精灵“海”打交道。这些精灵包括住在河流源头、作为动植物之母的万德拉。林中的动物则被认为是死者灵魂的化身。

萨满称为海瓦纳，不是世袭的，而是跟随有经验的师傅学习。他通过与海的交涉，维持狩猎和社群的健康，并通过驱走恶灵来治病。

神话说，卡拉加比用从图特鲁伊卡那里借来的泥土造出最早的人类，又砍倒了杰内内树，海从树根涌出，树枝则变成河流。18世纪晚期，在西班牙人的逼迫下，许多恩贝拉人迁入达连。

en:
The Jains look to 24 tirthankaras, ford-makers who overcame the cycle of rebirth. The 23rd, Parshvanatha, is dated to about the eighth or seventh century BCE, and the 24th, Mahavira, was a contemporary of the Buddha who rejected the authority of the Vedas. Jain ethics rest on ahimsa, non-violence, anekantavada, the many-sidedness of truth, and aparigraha, non-possession. Because of non-violence Jains avoided farming and war, and many became merchants and bankers.

Under the Delhi Sultanate Alauddin Khalji, who ruled from 1296 to 1316, received Jain sages. Later Mughal emperors such as Akbar made grants to Jain pilgrimage sites, though Akbar also ordered Jain temples at Chittor destroyed in 1567.
zh:
耆那教尊奉二十四位渡津者，即渡过轮回之津的导师。史家认为第二十三位巴湿伐那陀生活在公元前8世纪或7世纪，第二十四位大雄是佛陀的同时代人，否定吠陀的权威。其伦理建立在非暴力、真理多面的“不定论”和不占有三者之上。由于奉行非暴力，耆那教徒避开农耕和战争，许多人成为商人和银行家。

德里苏丹国的阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉（1296—1316年在位）接见过耆那教的圣者。后来的莫卧儿皇帝如阿克巴也给耆那教朝圣地提供捐赠，不过阿克巴在1567年也下令捣毁了奇陶尔的耆那教神庙。

official_raw.en: One of the oldest religions, $jain$ is an Indian $dharmic_ADJ$ religion focusing on attempting self-realization and liberation from the cycle of death and rebirth. It centers in non-violence and asceticism through the teachings of the #italic Tīrthaṅkara#!, the supreme preachers of the $dharma$, and it is divided in the Digambara and Śvetāmbara schools. Digambara, meaning 'sky-clad', is characterized by its rejection to attachment and possession of material goods, and thus its monks do not wear any clothes, and its iconography is more plain. Śvetāmbara, on the other hand, means 'white-clad' due to the white clothes of its monks, and has more equality between male and female monks, in opposition to the more male-oriented Digambara.
official_raw.zh: $jain$是最古老的宗教之一，是一种印度$dharmic_ADJ$宗教，专注于自我实现与解脱生死轮回。它以非暴力与苦行主义为核心，通过#italic 渡津者#!（$dharmic_ADJ$的至高导师）的教义进行修行，并分为天衣派与白衣派。天衣派意为“以天为衣”，其特点是拒绝物质依附与拥有，因此其僧侣不穿衣物，其圣像也更为朴素。白衣派则因其僧侣身着白衣而得名，男女僧侣地位更为平等，与更偏向男性的天衣派形成对比。

en:
The Jama belief belongs to the Jama Coaque culture, which developed on the coast of Manabí in Ecuador between the Coaque and Jama rivers from about 355 BC until 1532. It has no written record and has been pieced together from its pottery by comparison with Mesoamerica and the north coast of Peru.

The cosmos had three levels, the sky, the earth and the underworld. Jama, the chief deity of the earth, has a human body and a reptile face, and is probably an iguana. A bat god of rain and the night sky haunts the underworld waters, and a death god is shown without arms or legs. The moon appears as an opossum.

Priests who were also shamans served as go-betweens and carried out human sacrifice. The dead were buried in jars.
zh:
哈马信仰属于哈马·科阿克文化。该文化约自公元前355年到1532年，发展于厄瓜多尔马纳比海岸的科阿克河与哈马河之间。它没有文字记录，是学者以陶器为依据，对照中美洲和秘鲁北部海岸的文化拼合出来的。

宇宙分为天界、大地和冥界三层。哈马是大地的主神，人身爬行动物面孔，大概是一只鬣蜥。蝙蝠神掌管雨水和夜空，出没在冥界的水中；死神的形象没有手脚。月亮则以负鼠的形象出现。

兼任萨满的祭司是人神之间的中介，执行人祭。死者装入陶罐埋葬。

en:
The Jingpo, a Tibeto-Burman people of the Kachin Hills of northern Myanmar and neighbouring Yunnan, with the Zaiwa as one of their branches, followed an animist religion before Buddhism and Christianity arrived. They held that spirits reside everywhere and that these bring good or bad luck. All living creatures have souls, and rituals protect almost every activity, from planting crops to warfare.

One well-known spirit was Madai. Jingpo legend names Ningguanwa as a first ancestor, a cave-dweller and hunter who beat gongs and drums at his wedding to bring home his wife Burenzaren, the daughter of a dragon king.

The Jingpo and Zaiwa celebrate the great manau dance, in which dancers circle a central post. It is held around the fifteenth day of the first lunar month and again at the new rice harvest.
zh:
景颇人是缅甸北部克钦山区和云南相邻地带的藏缅语族民族，载瓦人是其中的一支。在佛教和基督教传入之前，他们信奉万物有灵的传统宗教：相信灵魂无处不在，会带来吉凶祸福；一切生物都有灵魂，从播种到打仗，几乎每件事都要举行仪式来求得保护。

著名的神灵有马代。景颇传说称宁贯娃是始祖，他住在洞穴里，以狩猎为生，迎娶龙王之女布仁扎仁时敲锣击鼓，把她留在家中。

景颇人和载瓦人举行盛大的目瑙纵歌，舞者绕着中心的柱子起舞。每年正月十五前后和尝新米季节各办一次。

en:
The Jino religion is the traditional faith of the Jino, a Tibeto-Burman people of the Jino Mountains in Xishuangbanna, whom Qing records called the Youle. It centres on nature spirits, with Apie'e honoured as the creator god.

Its myths tell of Mahei and Maniu, a brother and sister who married to renew mankind, and of the ancestress Yaobai, who made heaven and earth and scattered the first tea. At a death the village performed a painted-face dance, the face standing for the ghost that would devour the corpse, and a bamboo-pole dance to drive it off.
zh:
基诺泛灵论是基诺人的传统信仰。基诺人是藏缅语族民族，居住在西双版纳的基诺山，清代文献称之为攸乐人。信仰以崇拜自然神灵为核心，阿匹额额被奉为创世之神。

神话讲述兄妹玛黑和玛妞成婚、繁衍人类，以及女始祖尧白开天辟地、撒下最初的茶种。有人去世时，全寨要跳花脸舞和竹竿舞，花脸代表要吃掉尸体的鬼，竹竿舞用来驱鬼。

en: The Juang religion is the traditional belief of the Juang, an Austroasiatic people found only in the Gonasika hills of Keonjhar in Odisha, whose tradition places their origin at the source of the Baitarani River. Their ritual year is marked by festivals such as Pusha Purnima, Amba Nuakhia, Pirha Puja and Asarhi.
zh: 朱昂泛灵论是朱昂人的传统信仰。朱昂人是南亚语系民族，只分布在奥里萨凯翁贾尔的戈纳西卡丘陵，本族传说把发源地定在拜塔拉尼河源头。他们一年的祭祀节庆有普沙月圆节、芒果尝新节、皮尔哈祭和阿萨尔节等。

en:
Judaism also holds the Oral Torah, recorded in the Mishnah and the Talmud. Rabbis teach and judge by halakha, Jewish law, and worship centres on the synagogue. There is no single hierarchy, only the texts and the scholars who read them, such as Maimonides, whose Mishneh Torah codified the law.

In 1337 Jews lived as a heavily taxed minority in Christian and Muslim lands. After the Black Death of 1348, violence swept Jewish communities from Barcelona to Strasbourg, and many fled east to Poland, where Casimir III gave them protection. Spain expelled its Jews in 1492. At Safed in Ottoman Palestine, Joseph Karo wrote the Shulchan Aruch in 1563, and the messianic movement of Sabbatai Zevi ended with his conversion to Islam in 1666.
zh:
犹太教还有口传妥拉，记录在《密西拿》和《塔木德》中。拉比依据犹太律法“哈拉卡”施教断事，礼拜以会堂为中心。犹太教没有统一的教阶，权威来自经典和解读经典的学者，迈蒙尼德的《密西拿托拉》就系统整理了律法。

1337年，犹太人在基督教和伊斯兰教的国家里是赋税沉重的少数。1348年黑死病之后，从巴塞罗那到斯特拉斯堡的犹太社区都遭到暴力袭击，许多人东迁波兰，卡齐米日三世给予他们保护。1492年，西班牙驱逐了境内的犹太人。在奥斯曼治下巴勒斯坦的采法特，约瑟夫·卡罗于1563年写成《舒尔汉·阿鲁赫》；沙巴泰·泽维的弥赛亚运动则在1666年以他改宗伊斯兰教告终。

official_raw.en: The original Abrahamic faith, $judaism$ adheres to the covenant made between God and Moses. The $judaism_ADJ$ Bible is the Tānāḵ, of which the first five books are known as the Tōrā, serving as the basis of all $judaism_ADJ$ faith and practice.
official_raw.zh: $judaism$是最早的亚伯拉罕宗教，遵循上帝与摩西所立的约。$judaism_ADJ$的圣经是《塔纳赫》，其中前五卷被称为《妥拉》，是所有$judaism_ADJ$信徒信仰与实践的基础。

en:
Jurema is the sacred tradition of the interior peoples of northeastern Brazil, the non-Tupi groups the Portuguese lumped together as Tapuia, who made sacred drinks from parts of the jurema tree. The Kariri and Pankararu, among others, drank it, and their pajés, or shamans, served it at gatherings for religious and healing rites.

The drink, together with tobacco smoke and ritual song, brought on a trance in which the Encantados, the spirit masters, were thought to speak through the shaman. Early European chroniclers noted the drinking of jurema and these spirit-possession rites.

Under colonial rule the cult was driven underground. Hybrid Catholic-indigenous movements called Santidades appeared in the 1500s and 1600s, and into the 1800s to drink jurema was held to be witchcraft; many Indians and caboclos were arrested for attending a jurema gathering.
zh:
茹雷玛信仰是巴西东北部内陆各族的神圣传统。这些人不是图皮人，被葡萄牙人统称为“塔普亚人”，他们用茹雷玛树的部分枝干调制神圣的饮料。基里里人和潘卡拉鲁人等都饮用它，他们的帕热（萨满）在集会上端出这种饮料，用于宗教和治病的仪式。

饮料配合烟草的烟雾和仪式歌唱，会使人进入出神状态，人们相信被称作“恩坎塔多斯”的神灵主人此时借萨满之口说话。早期的欧洲编年史家记下了饮茹雷玛和这类灵附仪式。

殖民统治下，这种信仰转入地下。16至17世纪出现了天主教与本地信仰混合的运动，称为“桑蒂达德”；直到19世纪，饮茹雷玛仍被当作巫术，许多印第安人和卡波克洛人因参加“茹雷玛集会”被捕。

en:
Ka Niam Khasi is the traditional religion of the Khasi, an Austroasiatic hill people of what is now Meghalaya, in northeastern India. It is monotheistic: U Blei Nongthaw, who is one and formless, is the supreme creator of the universe.

Khasi tradition says that the Lord Master first divided humankind into sixteen heavenly families, of which seven, the Hynñiewtrep, were left on earth. A ladder resting on a sacred peak let people pass to heaven, until they were tricked into cutting down a divine tree and lost the way for ever. Every Khasi village traditionally kept a sacred grove to appease the forest spirit.

The Khasis lived in about twenty-five independent states, each ruled by a chief, the syiem. They had no script of their own and handed their religion down by word of mouth.
zh:
卡尼阿姆教是卡西人的传统宗教。卡西人是今印度东北部梅加拉亚邦的南亚语系山地民族。这是一神信仰：至高的创世主乌勃黎·农陀独一无二，没有形体，创造了整个宇宙。

卡西人的传说称，主宰最初把人类分成十六个天上的家族，其中七家，即“海涅乌特雷普”，被留在人间。一架天梯靠在一座圣峰上，人们可以往来天界；后来人们受骗砍倒了一棵神树，从此永远失去了上天的路。传统上，每个卡西村庄都有一片圣林，用来安抚森林之灵。

卡西人生活在约二十五个独立的邦里，各由一位酋长治理，酋长称作“西姆”。他们没有自己的文字，宗教靠口耳相传。

en:
The Kachina religion is the belief of the Pueblo peoples of the American Southwest, the Hopi, Zuni and Keres among them, in kachinas, spirit beings who represent the Pueblo ancestors and the forces of the world. They are not worshipped, but given respect they bring rain, healing, fertility and protection, though they can also cause disease.

To the Hopi the kachinas live on the San Francisco Peaks and visit the villages in the first half of the year; the Powamu ceremony in February marks the bean planting. Masked men take on the spirits in dances, and kachina dolls are carved for children.

After the Spanish brought missions to Pueblo country in the seventeenth century, Diego de Vargas re-entered it in 1692. The Pueblos kept their ceremonies out of Spanish sight behind a veneer of Catholicism.
zh:
克契奈人形信仰是美国西南部普韦布洛各民族，包括霍皮人、祖尼人和凯雷斯人，对克契奈的信仰。克契奈是象征普韦布洛祖先和世间各种力量的灵体，人们并不崇拜他们，但受到尊敬时，他们会带来雨水、治愈、丰产和庇护，也可能带来疾病。

在霍皮人看来，克契奈住在旧金山峰上，上半年来访村庄；2月的波瓦穆仪式标志着豆类播种。蒙面的男子在舞蹈中扮演这些灵体，人们还为孩子们雕刻克契奈木偶。

17世纪西班牙人把传教站建到普韦布洛地区之后，迭戈·德·巴尔加斯于1692年重返。普韦布洛人在天主教的外表之下，把自己的仪式藏在西班牙人的视线之外。

en:
Kaggen is the best-known figure in the traditional religions of the San, the hunter-gatherers of southern Africa. San beliefs are poorly attested; the myths of Kaggen come mainly from the ǀXam.

Kaggen, often called the Mantis, is a creator and a trickster who can take the shape of a praying mantis, an eland bull or a snake. His favourite creature was the eland: when his sons killed it before it was ready to be hunted, he sprinkled its blood and fat to make the herds of wild eland.

The eland is also the commonest power animal in the trance dance, where shamans enter the spirit world. After the Dutch settled at the Cape in 1652, farmers pushed into San lands from the early eighteenth century, and commandos killed or enslaved thousands by the century's end.
zh:
卡根是南部非洲狩猎采集民族桑人传统信仰中最著名的形象。桑人信仰留存下来的材料很少，关于卡根的神话主要出自克萨姆人。

卡根常被称为“螳螂”，既是创造者，也是骗子，能变成螳螂、公大角斑羚或蛇。他最宠爱的生灵是大角斑羚：儿子们在它长成可供猎取之前就把它杀了，他便洒下羚羊的血和脂肪，造出大群野生大角斑羚。

大角斑羚也是出神舞中最常见的助灵动物，萨满借此进入灵界。1652年荷兰人在好望角定居；18世纪初起，农场主进入桑人的土地，到该世纪末，殖民者的民团已经杀死或奴役了数以千计的人。

en:
Kaharingan is the animist religion of the Dayak peoples of southern Borneo, among them the Ngaju. The name comes from the old Dayak word haring, life. Its symbol is the Batang Garing, a tree of life with a hornbill and the sun at the top.

Ancestor spirits and many deities, often under one supreme god, are central. Traditionally the Ngaju held the second funeral, the tiwah, most important: months or years after the burial the bones were placed in a carved tomb, the sandung, and animals were sacrificed so that the soul could travel to the highest heaven. The balian healed the sick by calling back a wandering soul in trance dances.

The Ngaju were more open to outside influence than other Dayaks. After 1835 the Rhenish Mission began to convert them to Christianity.
zh:
卡哈林干信仰是婆罗洲南部达雅克人的万物有灵信仰，信奉者包括恩加朱人。名称来自古达雅克语的“哈林”，意为生命。它的标志是“巴当加林”生命之树，树顶有一只犀鸟和太阳。

祖先之灵和众多神灵居于信仰的中心，往往有一位至高神。传统上，恩加朱人最看重第二次葬礼“蒂瓦”：下葬数月乃至数年后，遗骨被放进雕刻精美的“桑顿”灵屋，并宰杀牲畜，好让灵魂升到最高的天界。“巴里安”萨满则通过入迷的舞蹈召回游离的灵魂，为人治病。

恩加朱人比其他达雅克人更乐于接受外来影响。1835年起，莱茵传教会开始让他们改信基督教。

en:
Kajoor Ri Majel is the traditional belief of the Marshallese of the Ratak and Ralik island chains. It was polytheistic, but one god stood above the rest, called Iageach, a word meaning god, to whom breadfruit, coconut and fish were offered. Before any serious undertaking a man would make an offering in his family's name.

The Marshallese also worshipped spirits, including dead relatives who might possess a family member to give advice, and evil spirits called Anjilik, which caused disease. Cures were sought from the spirits, and diviners read the pattern of thrown pebbles or of knots tied in coconut or pandanus leaf. Spanish sailors first reached the islands, at Taongi, in 1526.
zh:
卡久里‑马绍尔信仰是拉塔克和拉利克两串岛链上马绍尔人的传统信仰。它属于多神信仰，但有一位神高于众神，名叫伊亚盖奇，意思就是“神”，人们向他献上面包果、椰子和鱼。着手任何重大事情之前，人要以全家的名义献上一份供品。

马绍尔人也崇拜灵，其中有可能附在家人身上给予忠告的已故亲人，也有引起疾病的恶灵安吉利克。治病要向灵求助，占卜者从撒在地上的小石子或椰叶、露兜树叶条上所打的结的形状里读出意义。1526年，西班牙水手首次在陶翁伊岛登陆马绍尔群岛。

en:
The Kalge religion is the traditional faith of the Daju, the people who ruled the first recorded state of Darfur from the southern slopes of Jebel Marra. Their high god was Kalge, to whom they built straw shrines, and the sacred mountain of Par-Kalge took its name from him.

The geographer al-Idrisi still described the Daju kingdom as pagan in 1154, but Islam gained ground among them, and Islam is said to have become the religion of most Daju by the fifteenth century. After the Tunjur supplanted their dynasty, Daju groups survived in Dar Sila and elsewhere, many of them Muslims who kept the old customs and came to identify Kalge with Allah.
zh:
卡尔格教是达朱人的传统信仰，达朱人曾在马拉山南麓统治着达尔富尔第一个见诸史籍的国家。他们的至高神叫卡尔格，人们为他修建草编的神龛，圣山帕尔卡尔格山也以他命名。

地理学家伊德里西在1154年仍称达朱王国信奉异教，但伊斯兰教逐渐在他们当中传开，据说到15世纪已成为大多数达朱人的宗教。通朱尔人取代达朱王朝之后，达朱人的一些分支留存在达尔西拉等地，其中许多人是穆斯林，仍保留旧俗，并逐渐把卡尔格等同于安拉。

en:
The worship of Sa Sui centres on the most important deity of the Kam, the Dong of eastern Guizhou, western Hunan and northern Guangxi, a woman ancestor who drives off evil and protects the village. Every traditional village keeps an altar to her, a small walled courtyard near the drum tower.

Legend says she was a girl, Xingni, who led the villagers against a landlord and then against the troops of his official son, until she fell from a cliff in a struggle with the official. When the villagers called her name, echoes answered through the forest.

Around her stand other powers: village-gate and bridge goddesses, land gods, and turtles, snakes and dragons as totems. Kam rebellions broke out under the Ming and Qing, among them Wu Mian's of 1378 and Wu Jinyin's of 1740.
zh:
萨岁崇拜以侗人最重要的神灵为中心。侗人分布在贵州东部、湖南西部和广西北部，萨岁是驱邪护寨的女性祖先。每个传统侗寨都设有她的祭坛，是鼓楼附近一座围墙小院。

据传说，她名叫杏妮，带领乡亲先抗击恶霸地主，后来又抗击地主那做官的儿子带来的官军，最后与那位官员搏斗，双双坠崖。乡亲们呼喊她的名字，林子里到处回响着应答声。

她的周围还有别的神灵：寨门神和桥神、土地神，以及作为图腾的龟、蛇和龙。明清两代侗人屡次起事，其中有1378年吴勉和1740年吴金银的起事。

en:
Kan Khwan is the traditional belief of the Kayan, a Red Karen people of Karenni in Myanmar. In their account the eternal creator god Phu Kabukathin was helped by two creator deities and four messengers, who made heaven, earth, plants, humans and animals.

The earth was at first fluid, and Phu Kabukathin planted a post in the ground; as it grew, the earth firmed into seven layers. That post is the Kan Htein Bo, and seven commandments came with it.

Every year, in March or April, the Kayan raise a new Kan Htein Bo pole of Eugenia wood, the first tree created. The pole carries the sun at its peak, the moon and a ladder to heaven. On the morning it is raised the shaman reads chicken bones to foretell the village's year.
zh:
坎宽神话是卡扬人的传统信仰。卡扬人属红克伦人，居住在缅甸克伦尼邦。在他们的叙述里，永恒的创世神普卡布卡廷由两位创造神和四位使者协助，分别造出天、地、草木、人和兽。

大地起初是流动的，普卡布卡廷在地上栽下一根木桩，木桩长高，大地便凝结成七层。这根木桩就是“坎登波”，七条诫命也随之赐下。

每年3月或4月，卡扬人都要用最先被创造出来的树木——番樱桃属的树木——树立一根新的坎登波柱。柱顶是太阳，往下是月亮和通往天界的梯子。立柱的清晨，萨满要用鸡骨占卜，预言全村这一年的命运。

en:
Kanak religion is the traditional belief of the Kanak, the Melanesian people of New Caledonia, who had no single state or common name for themselves before Europeans came. They worshipped their ancestors at the burial place, at sacred stones and at hearths where sacrifices were offered, and held the sea sacred, with oral laws closing fishing when stocks fell.

Carvings of hawks, ancient gods, serpents and turtles, and the flèche faîtière, a carved roof finial like a small totem pole, expressed their beliefs. Captain James Cook landed in 1774, when some 70,000 Kanak were reported to live on the islands, and named them New Caledonia. Missionaries of the London Missionary Society followed about half a century later.
zh:
卡纳克信仰是新喀里多尼亚的美拉尼西亚人卡纳克人的传统信仰；在欧洲人到来之前，他们既没有统一的国家，也没有统一的自称。他们在墓地、圣石和献祭用的祭火炉旁崇拜祖先，并把大海视为神圣，口头的法则规定鱼类减少时就要封海。

雕成鹰、古代神灵、蛇和海龟的木雕，以及形似小图腾柱的屋顶饰柱，都表达着他们的信仰。1774年詹姆斯·库克船长登岛，据说当时岛上有七万卡纳克人，他把这些岛屿命名为新喀里多尼亚。大约半个世纪后，伦敦传道会的传教士接踵而至。

en:
The Karachay-Balkar religion is the traditional belief of the Karachays and Balkars, the Turkic mountain peoples of the central Caucasus around Mount Elbrus. It never had a fixed canon or an orderly pantheon: it is pieced together from the Nart epic and legends, and scholars find in it Turkic, Alan and common Caucasian layers.

The supreme god was Tejri, the sky god, and thunder was shared among Choppa, Shibilya and Elia. Myth makes the first smith, Debet, a child of Sky and Earth.

Alania's Christian past left its mark in the names of saints: Elia is the prophet Elijah and Totur is Saint Theodore. After Timur broke Alania in about 1395, Islam spread among the highlanders, and most Balkars adopted it in the eighteenth century. Tejri then became a name for the one God.
zh:
卡拉巴尔多神教是卡拉恰伊人和巴尔卡尔人的传统信仰，这两个突厥语山地民族生活在高加索中部的厄尔布鲁士山周围。它从来没有固定的正典，也没有井然有序的神谱：现在是从纳特史诗和传说中拼合起来的，学者在其中分辨出突厥、阿兰和高加索共有的几个层次。

最高神是天神特伊里，雷电之责则由乔帕、希比利亚和埃利亚分担。神话说第一位铁匠德别特是天与地所生。

阿兰王国的基督教过去在圣徒的名字里留下了痕迹：埃利亚就是先知以利亚，托图尔是圣狄奥多尔。约1395年帖木儿摧毁阿兰王国后，伊斯兰教在山民中传开，大多数巴尔卡尔人在18世纪接受了它；特伊里此后成了对唯一真神的称呼。

en: Karama is the ritual sacrifice of animals to ward off evil spirits, a pre-Islamic rite that the Zaghawa herders of the eastern Sahel, between Lake Chad and Darfur, kept after their kings had become at least nominally Muslim in the 1000s.
zh: 卡拉玛是宰牲祭祀、驱避恶灵的仪式，属于前伊斯兰时代的习俗；乍得湖与达尔富尔之间的萨赫勒东部牧民扎加瓦人，在他们的国王于11世纪名义上皈依伊斯兰教之后仍保留着它。

en:
The Karankawa were bands of the Gulf coast of southern Texas, among them the Capoque of Galveston Bay. They did not explain their rites to outsiders: when La Salle's companion Joutel asked about their beliefs, they only pointed at the sky.

Observers saw them stare at the sun as it vanished into the sea and smoke tobacco through the nostrils. A chief was chosen by a trial in which candidates were slashed with sea-fish spines and bound to a pole, which a Spanish friar thought might equally be a puberty rite.

The Capoque nursed Álvar Núñez Cabeza de Vaca and other Narváez survivors on Galveston Island in 1528. A mission, Rosario, was founded among the Karankawa in 1754, but they fled when punished and stayed free of it.
zh:
卡兰卡瓦人是得克萨斯南部墨西哥湾沿岸的诸游群，包括加尔维斯顿湾一带的卡波克人。他们不向外人解释自己的仪式：拉萨尔的同伴茹泰尔询问他们的信仰时，他们只是指了指天空。

旁观者看到他们凝望太阳沉入大海，又用鼻孔吸烟。选拔首领要经过考验：候选人用海鱼的脊刺划出道道伤口，再被绑在柱子上；一位西班牙修士认为这也可能是成年礼。

1528年，卡波克人在加尔维斯顿岛上照料了阿尔瓦·努涅斯·卡韦萨·德巴卡和其他纳瓦埃斯远征队的幸存者。1754年在卡兰卡瓦人当中建起了罗萨里奥传教站，但他们一受惩罚就逃走，始终没有被它束缚。

en:
Karbi religion, known as Aronban, is followed by the Mikir, or Karbi, of the hills of central Assam. It centres on a trinity of gods: Hemphu, the creator and protector; Mukrang, linked with strength and justice; and the goddess Rasinja.

The Karbi honour place spirits called Longri Arnam and household and ancestral spirits called Karhi, and have no temples or idols, offering eggs, chickens and pigs at sacred groves. The Rongker festival, held by the village elders in April before the shifting cultivation begins, asks protection from disease and crop failure.

The Chomangkan, the greatest Karbi ceremony, is a funerary rite held months or years after a death to guide the soul to the land of the ancestors. Ritual singers, the lunsepo, chant the mosera, narrative songs that carry the tribe's migration history.
zh:
米基尔泛灵论称为阿龙班，由阿萨姆中部山地的米基尔人（即卡尔比人）奉行。它以三位神为核心：创造并保护世界的亨普，与力量和公正相关的穆克朗，以及女神拉辛贾。

米基尔人崇敬称为隆里·阿尔楠的地方神灵，以及称为卡尔希的家神和祖灵，没有神庙和偶像，在圣林献上鸡蛋、鸡和猪。龙克尔节由村中长老在每年4月刀耕火种开始之前举行，祈求免除疾病和歉收。

乔曼坎是米基尔人最重要的仪式，这是一种在人去世数月甚至数年后举行的丧仪，用来引导亡魂前往祖先之地。仪式歌手伦塞波吟唱“莫塞拉”叙事歌，传承本族的迁徙历史。

en:
The Karen religion is kept most strongly by the highland Sgaw among the Karen peoples of southern and eastern Burma. It is built on the idea that every person is embodied by thirty-seven spirits. Illness and misfortune come when one of them wanders away, and death comes when all thirty-seven have left the body.

Buddhism reached the Karen through the Mon, who dominated Lower Burma until the middle of the eighteenth century, and was brought to the Pwo-speaking Karen in the late 1700s. Many Sgaw stayed heterodox, joining Buddhist merit-making to strong animist belief, and a kind of pagoda worship called duwae kept animist roots inside Buddhist practice.
zh:
克伦泛灵论在缅甸南部和东部的克伦人中以山地的斯高克伦人保持得最为牢固。它认为每个人身上都有三十七个魂灵。其中一个游离出走，人就会生病遭难；三十七个魂灵全部离开身体，人便死去。

佛教通过孟人传到克伦人中，孟人在18世纪中叶以前一直控制着下缅甸；1700年代后期，佛教又传到说波语的波克伦人中。许多斯高克伦人信奉的是非正统的佛教，把佛教的积功德与浓厚的万物有灵观念结合在一起；一种名为杜维的佛塔崇拜，在佛教的形式里保留着万物有灵的根源。

en:
The Kénos religion belonged to the Selk'nam, who lived on the Isla Grande of Tierra del Fuego and shared their myths with the neighbouring Haush. Its supreme being was Temáukel, who was the only one Selk'nam counted as a true god. Kénos, the first of the mythic ancestors called howenh, was sent down by him to organise the primeval earth and make the beings who shaped it.

Spirits of the underworld, led by the goddess Xalpen and her seven shoorts, were impersonated by men in the great initiation ceremony called Hain, in which boys were frightened by the spirits until they unmasked them. Shaman-like figures were believed able to control the weather.
zh:
科诺斯教属于塞尔克南人，他们生活在火地岛的大岛上，并与邻近的豪什人共有这些神话。最高存在是特毛克尔，塞尔克南人认为只有他才称得上真正的神。科诺斯是称为霍文的神话祖先中的第一位，由特毛克尔派到原初的大地上整顿秩序，创造出塑造大地的各位祖先。

冥界诸灵由女神沙尔彭和她的七位舒尔特统领，在称为海恩的盛大成年礼上由男人扮演，少年们被这些灵吓唬，直到他们揭穿真相。类似萨满的人物据信能够控制天气。

en:
Khabzeism, the religion of the Circassians, centred on the supreme creator Thashkho, the Great God, with lesser deities under him. Souls were rewarded after death by their deeds. Khabzeism is not to be confused with the Khabze, the Circassian code of conduct.

Among them Mezytha ruled the forests and the hunt, Psykhe-Guasha the waters and Sozeresh the crops, whose idol, cut from a branch of seven knots, stood in family barns. On a winter night the hero Sosruqo of the Nart epic was honoured with a feast at which any traveller was welcome in his place.

Worship took place in sacred groves, the kudoshi, where in 1637 the missionary Giovanni Luca described weapons and ram heads hung from the branches. As Islam spread, saints and heroes were reworked into Arab warriors and Islamic legends.
zh:
哈布泽多神教是切尔克斯人的宗教，以至高的创造者特赫沙霍（意为“大神”）为中心，他之下有许多小神。人的灵魂死后依生前的行为受到回报。哈布泽多神教不应与哈布泽相混，哈布泽是切尔克斯人的行为准则。

其中梅济萨掌管森林和狩猎，普瑟赫—瓜莎掌管水域，索泽雷什掌管庄稼，他的偶像用一根有七个节的树枝削成，立在各家的牲口棚里。冬季的一个夜晚，人们设宴纪念纳特史诗中的英雄索斯鲁科，任何过路的旅人都可以代替他入席。

人们在称作库多希的圣林里礼拜。1637年，传教士乔瓦尼·卢卡描述了那里的树枝上挂着的武器和公羊头。随着伊斯兰教的传播，圣者和英雄被改写成阿拉伯勇士和伊斯兰传说。

en: The Kharia are a Munda-speaking people of the forested hills of Jharkhand, Odisha and the Chota Nagpur Plateau. They divide into the Hill, Dhelki and Dudh branches, of whom the Hill Kharia lived by hunting and gathering in the forest.
zh: 卡里亚人是讲蒙达语族语言的民族，分布在贾坎德、奥里萨和乔塔那格浦尔高原的山林地带。他们分为山地、德尔基和杜德三支，其中山地卡里亚靠山林狩猎采集为生。

en:
The Khonds, a Kui-speaking tribal people of the hills of Odisha and the Eastern Ghats, blend totemism, animism, ancestor worship and shamanism, and their worship is aimed above all at the earth, which was held to be the creator and sustainer of the world. The earth deity later came to be addressed as a god, Dharni Deota, with the hunting god Bhatbarsi Deota as his companion.

Each stage of farming and hunting had its rite, among them the Meriah, in which a bought human victim was sacrificed to make the soil fertile. British writers condemned the practice.

Long contact with Odia-speaking Hindus brought Kali and Durga in as forms of Dharani. From 1753 the Khonds of the Ghumsar hills repeatedly rose against the East India Company.
zh:
孔德人是说库伊语的部落民族，居住在奥里萨山地和东高止山。他们的信仰融合了图腾崇拜、万物有灵、祖先崇拜和萨满教，崇拜的对象尤其是大地，被认为是世界的创造者和养育者。后来，大地神被当作男神达尔尼·德奥塔，与他相伴的是狩猎神巴特巴尔西·德奥塔。

农耕与狩猎的每个阶段都有仪式，其中有梅里亚仪式，即用买来的人牲献祭，使土地肥沃。英国作者对这种做法多有谴责。

长期与说奥里亚语的印度教徒接触后，卡莉和杜尔迦被当作达尔尼的化身供奉。1753年起，古姆苏尔山区的孔德人多次起兵反抗东印度公司。

en: The Kilyikhama religion belongs to the Lengua peoples of the Paraguayan Gran Chaco, such as the Enxet, forest hunter-gatherers who lived in small bands west of the Paraguay River.
zh: 基利哈玛萨满教属于巴拉圭大查科的伦瓜诸族（如恩科塞特人），这些森林中的狩猎采集者结成小型群体，生活在巴拉圭河以西。

en:
Kirat Mundhum is followed by the Kirati peoples of the eastern Himalaya, among them the Limbu and Rai, who live from eastern Nepal to Sikkim. Its scripture is the Mundhum, an oral epic first sung by bards and later written down, with the stories of creation, the first human laws and a great flood.

The faith joins nature worship and ancestor reverence with shamanism. The Limbu honour the supreme power Tagera Ningwaphuma, who appears on earth as the mother goddess Yuma Sammang, while the Rai pray to the earth goddess Sumnima. The Sakela festival, danced twice a year at sowing and harvest, thanks Mother Nature and the ancestors.

In the 1770s the Limbu confederation Limbuwan was annexed by Prithvi Narayan Shah of Gorkha. Around then the scholar Te-ongsi Sirijunga revived the Limbu script.
zh:
门顿教为东喜马拉雅的基拉特诸族所奉行，信徒有林布人和莱人等，分布在尼泊尔东部到锡金一带。经典《门顿》原是吟游诗人口耳相传的史诗，后来被记录成书，内容有创世传说、最初的法规和一场大洪水。

这一信仰把自然崇拜、祖先崇拜与萨满教结合在一起。林布人敬奉至高力量塔格拉·宁瓦普马，他在人间化为母神玉玛桑芒；莱人则祈祷大地女神松米玛。萨克拉节每年在播种和收获时各跳舞一次，感谢大自然和祖先。

18世纪70年代，林布人的林布旺联盟被廓尔喀的普利特维·纳拉扬·沙阿并入。同一时期，学者特翁西·西里章加复兴了林布文字。

en:
Kirin Koda is held by the Lamaholot, who live on the islands of Lembata, Solor and Adonara and around Larantuka in eastern Flores. Its supreme being is Lera Wulan Tana Ekan, the creator, and worshippers also honour the spirits of ancestors, who intercede between the living and the highest god.

Rites were held at the megalithic sanctuaries called korke and nubanara. The sign of the supreme being was a wooden post, the rie lima wana, where people asked for blessing, and in certain ceremonies animals were slaughtered and their blood smeared on it.

When the Portuguese arrived, Solor was already held by Muslims, in the Solor Watan Lema league of five Islamic kingdoms. From the sixteenth century Portuguese power brought Catholicism, which came to dominate, while Kirin Koda survived among a minority.
zh:
拘陀吉灵教为拉马霍洛特人所信奉，他们居住在弗洛勒斯岛东部的伦巴塔、索洛尔、阿多纳拉诸岛和拉兰图卡一带。它的最高神是创造者勒拉·乌兰·塔纳·埃坎；信徒也敬奉祖先的灵魂，祖灵在生者与最高神之间居中沟通。

仪式在称为“科尔克”和“努巴纳拉”的巨石圣所里举行。最高神的象征是一根名为“里埃·利马·瓦纳”的木柱，人们站在柱前求福，某些仪式上还要宰杀牲畜，把血涂在柱上。

葡萄牙人到来时，索洛尔已被穆斯林控制，那里有由五个伊斯兰王国组成的“索洛尔五邦联盟”。16世纪起，葡萄牙势力带来了天主教，天主教逐渐占据主导，而拘陀吉灵教只在少数人中保存下来。

en: The Koch of Assam, Meghalaya and northern Bangladesh are nine groups of matrilineal clans, some of which kept the Koch language, who held to non-Hindu customs. They are related to, but distinguished from, the Hindu Koch who founded the Koch kingdom in 1515.
zh: 阿萨姆、梅加拉亚和孟加拉国北部的库奇人分为九个行母系制的氏族群，部分保留了库奇语，沿袭非印度教的习俗，与1515年建立库奇王国的印度教库奇人关系相近，但并非一类。

en:
Before Islam, the people of Ternate lived in kin groups, each led by a leader called a momole, and the old belief of the northern Moluccas was bound up with the rule of the kolano, the king. Traditionally in 1257 the momole of Ternate's four villages elected Momole Cico king of Gapi, with the title Baab Mashur Malamo.

A legend told that the ancestors of the Malukan kings were four sons born to the Arab Jafar Sadik and a heavenly nymph, Nurus Safa, who founded the royal lines of Bacan, Jailolo, Tidore and Ternate.

Islam reached the court in the late fifteenth century. Marhum (1465—1486) was the first king of Ternate to embrace it, and his son Zainal Abidin (1486—1500) enacted Islamic law and replaced the title of kolano with sultan.
zh:
伊斯兰教传入之前，特尔纳特人以亲族集团为单位，各由称为“莫莫莱”的首领统领，北马鲁古的古老信仰与“科拉诺”即国王的统治紧密相连。按传统说法，1257年特尔纳特四个村寨的莫莫莱推举莫莫莱·奇科为加比国王，称号“巴布·马舒尔·马拉莫”。

传说马鲁古诸王的祖先是阿拉伯人贾法尔·萨迪克与天上仙女努鲁斯·萨法所生的四个儿子，他们成了巴坎、贾伊洛洛、蒂多雷和特尔纳特各支王室的始祖。

伊斯兰教在15世纪后期传入宫廷。马尔胡姆（1465—1486）是特尔纳特第一位皈依伊斯兰教的国王，其子扎因·阿比丁（1486—1500）施行伊斯兰教法，并把“科拉诺”的称号改为苏丹。

en:
Važesköm was followed by the Komi peoples, the Zyrians, Permyaks and Yazva Komi. The oldest source is the Life of Stephen of Perm, written soon after his death in 1396, which speaks of many gods and the worship of animals, sacred trees and idols.

In folklore the creator god is Ën; among the Zyrians he is opposed by the evil Omöl, among the Permyaks by Kul. Folklore also gives a person several souls: lovja, the breath, and ort, a double whose sound foretells death.

Stephen of Perm, who toured the Vychegda and Vym rivers from 1376, cut down sacred birches, devised an alphabet and became the first bishop of Perm in 1383. The Vychegda Komi were baptised, but Great Perm stayed pagan for about another century.
zh:
瓦日斯科姆萨满教为科米诸族——济良人、彼尔姆科米人和亚兹瓦科米人——所奉行。最早的来源是斯捷潘1396年去世后不久写成的《彼尔姆的斯捷潘传》，书中提到许多神灵，也提到对动物、圣树和偶像的崇拜。

民间传说中的创世神是约恩；在济良人那里，与他对立的是恶神奥梅尔，在彼尔姆人那里则是库尔。民间传说还说人有几个灵魂：洛维亚是呼吸，奥尔特是人的分身，它的声响预示死亡。

彼尔姆的斯捷潘1376年起走遍维切格达河和维姆河沿岸，砍倒圣桦树，创制了科米文字，并在1383年成为第一任彼尔姆主教。维切格达科米人受了洗，但大彼尔姆又保持了大约一个世纪的异教。

en:
Koyapunem, meaning the way of nature, is followed by the Gonds, who call themselves Koitur and live in the forested hills of central India. Gond tradition credits its code of conduct, the Gondi Punem, to the ancestor-hero Pari Kupar Lingo, who gathered thirty-three disciples.

Above all stands the high god Baradeo, also called Bhagwan, who oversees the lesser gods but receives little fervent devotion. Worship goes to clan and village deities, ancestors and totems, among them the village mother goddess and each clan's own persa pen.

By 1337 the Gonds had founded Chanda, around 1200, and the Garha kingdom followed in the fourteenth century. Contact with Hinduism grew as their courts took Vishnu as patron deity and kings were sometimes cremated by Vedic rites, while the village cults carried on beneath.
zh:
拘耶补念教意为“自然之道”，为贡德人所奉行。贡德人自称科伊托尔，生活在印度中部的森林山地。据贡德传说，行为准则《贡德补念》出自祖先英雄帕里·库帕尔·林戈，他召集了三十三名弟子。

至高神是婆罗提乌，又称巴格万，统管众小神，却很少受到热烈的供奉。人们真正祭拜的是氏族和村落的神灵、祖先与图腾，其中有村母神和每个氏族各自的佩尔萨·彭。

1337年前后，贡德人已在约1200年建立昌达，14世纪又有加尔哈王国。随着宫廷奉毗湿奴为守护神、国王有时依吠陀礼仪火葬，印度教的影响日益加深，而村落里的旧有祭祀仍在延续。

en:
Kundism is followed by the Deori, a Tibeto-Burman people of Sadiya and the upper Brahmaputra valley. It takes its name from Kundi-Mama, the supreme deity, the Old Ones who are the father Kundi-Gira and the mother Kundi-Girasi together.

Their children are Pisa-Dema, also called Baliya-Baba, and the goddess Pisasi, known as Tamreswari or Kechai-khaiti. Worship, animist and ancestral, centres on sacred groves and clan rituals, without idols.

Deori tradition ties the faith to the Chutia kings. The goddess took the form of a huge stone in the Dibang River, and four Chutia men who prayed to her made it light enough to carry to her temple; the king made them priests, forefathers of the four Deori clans. The Burmese invasions of 1817 to 1826 later killed or carried off many Deori.
zh:
昆迪泛灵论为代奥里人所奉行，他们是萨迪亚和布拉马普特拉河上游河谷的藏缅语族民族。信仰以至上神昆迪—马马得名，这位“老者”是父神昆迪—吉拉与母神昆迪—吉拉西的合称。

他们的子女是皮萨—德马（又称巴利亚—巴巴）和女神皮萨西，后者即塔姆雷斯瓦里或凯切—凯蒂。崇拜融合万物有灵与祖先崇拜，以圣林和氏族仪式为中心，不设偶像。

代奥里人的传统把这一信仰与久蒂亚诸王联系在一起。女神化作一块巨石漂在迪邦河中，向她祈祷的四个久蒂亚人使巨石变轻，得以抬进她的神庙；国王任命他们为祭司，他们成了代奥里四个氏族的祖先。1817至1826年的缅甸入侵又使许多代奥里人被杀或被掳。

en:
