Kuru Masaba is the Supreme Being of the Temne of Sierra Leone, whose name joins kuru, God or sky, to a word borrowed from Mandinka meaning the big king. The Temne hold that he cannot be approached directly, only through patrilineal ancestors, to whom sacrifices are made; other spirits, some kindly and some mischievous, are given offerings too.

The Poro, Ragbenle and Bondo secret societies, brought by the Mandé, initiated boys and girls. The Temne, who say they came from Futa Jallon, were conquered by a Mandé army, the Mane, in the mid-1500s. Portuguese accounts of 1505—1508 describe them as worshippers of clay idols; Islam spread among them in the 1700s and 1800s, almost completely in the north.
zh:
库鲁·马萨巴是塞拉利昂滕内人的至高神，名字由库鲁（神或天空）和一个借自曼丁卡语、意为“大王”的词合成。滕内人认为他不能被直接接近，只能通过父系祖先；人们向祖先献祭，对其他或善或恶的灵也献上祭品。

曼德人带来的波罗社、拉格本勒社和邦多社等秘密社团负责少男少女的成年礼。滕内人自称来自富塔贾隆，16世纪中叶被曼德人军队马奈征服。1505—1508年的葡萄牙记载称他们崇拜泥偶；伊斯兰教在18、19世纪间传入，北部几乎全部皈依。

en:
The traditional Lahu religion is polytheistic. The Lahu, a Tibeto-Burman people of the mountains along the Lancang River in southern Yunnan, believed in a great number of spirits, against which they held exorcism rites, and the outcome was checked by reading an egg oracle.

Their creation epic, the Mupa Mipa, whose title means making heaven and earth, runs to seventeen chapters and some 2,300 lines. It was chanted by village singers called pokuo gakuo, and tells how the sky, earth, sun, moon, living things and humankind came to be. Lahu tradition also holds that their ancestors came out of a gourd. Buddhism reached the Lahu in the late seventeenth century and became widespread among them.
zh:
拉祜人的传统信仰是多神崇拜。拉祜人是藏缅语族民族，世居云南南部澜沧江一带的山地，相信有数量极多的鬼神，要靠驱鬼仪式来禳解，成败则用蛋卜来检验。

他们的创世史诗《牡帕密帕》意为“造天造地”，共17个篇章、约2300行，由称为“波阔嘎阔”的歌手在村寨里演唱，讲述天地日月、万物与人类的由来。拉祜人还传说祖先出自葫芦。17世纪晚期佛教传入拉祜人当中，并在各村寨广为流传。

en: Lamatuan is followed by the Rotenese, the people of Rote Island south-west of Timor, and centres on a creator god called Lamatuan or Lamatuak, who was also seen as the one who predestines and blesses and was symbolised by a pillar with three branches.
zh: 拉马图安教为帝汶西南罗地岛上的罗地人所奉行，以名为拉马图安（又作拉马图亚克）的创世神为中心，这位神也被视为决定命运和赐福的存在，其象征是一根三叉的柱子。

en:
Lamoa is the old worship of the god Pue Mpalaburu among the Bare'e people of Central Sulawesi. Its rite, the Molamoa, was a circle dance known as Dero or Modero, held when a village's warriors came home from battle and when the war leaders, the tadulako, returned from headhunting.

The Bare'e taught that skulls taken in this way warded off misfortune such as a failed harvest, and the dance was performed around them in the middle of the ceremonial house, the lobo.

In the days of the Tojo kingdom, in 1770, Lamoa still kept its original form as the mark of the Bare'e. Pilewiti, the first king of Tojo, took over its customs and slowly brought the Bare'e into Islam, and the Dutch East Indies later banned the worship of Pue Mpalaburu.
zh:
拉莫阿教是中苏拉威西巴雷埃人对神“普埃·姆帕拉布鲁”的古老崇拜。它的仪式“莫拉莫阿”是一种圆圈舞，称为“德罗”或“莫德罗”，在村寨战士从战场归来、作战首领“塔杜拉科”猎头归来时举行。

巴雷埃人相信，用这种方式取得的头骨能驱除歉收之类的灾祸，人们就在礼仪屋“洛博”中央围着头骨起舞。

托霍王国时期的1770年，拉莫阿教仍保持着原貌，被视为巴雷埃人的特征。托霍第一代国王皮莱维蒂接管了它的习俗，并逐步使巴雷埃人改信伊斯兰教；后来荷属东印度禁止了对普埃·姆帕拉布鲁的崇拜。

en:
The Lenca religion belonged to the people of central and southeastern Honduras and eastern El Salvador. Little of its mythology survived the Spanish conquest and conversion to Catholicism.

Lying within the Mesoamerican sphere, the Lenca shared many practices with their neighbours, including animal sacrifices offered for good harvests, fair weather or victory in war, and a version of the 365-day calendar. Women were active in Lenca shamanism, and the priestly caste may have included many of them.

Rites were held to thank the goddess Ilangipuca and the maize, and spirits who brought rain, wind and fertility, or who guarded rivers and forests, were honoured. In the guancasco ceremony the Lenca lordships agreed truces at set times of the year. Resistance to the Spanish was led by the Lenca ruler Lempira, who died in 1537.
zh:
伦卡人的宗教属于洪都拉斯中部和东南部以及萨尔瓦多东部的伦卡人。西班牙征服和改信天主教之后，它的神话所存甚少。

伦卡人处在中美洲文化圈内，与邻族有许多共同的习俗，包括为祈求丰收、好天气或战争胜利而举行的动物祭祀，以及一种365天的历法。妇女在伦卡人的萨满活动中十分活跃，祭司阶层中可能有许多女性。

人们举行仪式感谢女神伊兰吉普卡和玉米，也祭祀带来雨水、风和丰产的神灵，以及守护河流和森林的神灵。各伦卡领地每年定期休战，并举行称为关卡斯科的仪式。伦卡人抵抗西班牙人的领袖是伦皮拉，他于1537年去世。

en:
Lezgin paganism is kept by the Lezgins of southern Dagestan and northern Azerbaijan. It begins in darkness, where the creator god made the sky and the earth and then the Red Bull Yaru Yats, on whose horns he set the world, standing on the Great Water.

The universe had three levels. The upper world had seven spheres, with the sun god Rag at the top; the middle world held men, animals and plants; and the underworld held the realm of the dead under the death god Ardav and, deepest, the evil gods led by Sed. A world tree and a rainbow bridge linked them.

Islam may have reached the Lezgins as early as the 700s, but they remained mostly animist until the 1400s, when Persian traders and the Golden Horde strengthened Muslim influence.
zh:
列兹金多神教为达吉斯坦南部和阿塞拜疆北部的列兹金人所奉行。它从黑暗讲起：创世神创造了天和地，然后创造了红牛亚鲁·亚茨，把世界安放在它的角上，而红牛立在大水之上。

宇宙分三层。上界有七重天，太阳神拉格居于最高一重；中界是人、动物和植物的世界；下界是死者的国度，由死神阿尔达夫掌管，最深处是塞德率领的恶神。三界由世界树和一道彩虹桥连接。

伊斯兰教最早可能在8世纪传到列兹金人那里，但他们直到15世纪都主要是万物有灵的信徒，那时波斯商人和金帐汗国加强了穆斯林的影响。

en:
The Lisu, a mountain people of northwestern Yunnan and the Salween valley, hold a simple animism: sacrifices go to the spirits of the mountains, and shamans perform the main rituals. At the top of each village lies a sacred grove where the sky spirit, called the Old Grandfather Spirit in China, is given offerings, and each house keeps an ancestor altar at the back.

The main festival falls at the new year, and new wine is brewed at harvest. The knife-ladder festival of the eighth day of the second lunar month recalls the Lisu soldiers who, under the Ming emperor Zhengtong, climbed ladders of blades and leapt through fire against the Luchuan chieftain.
zh:
傈僳人是滇西北和怒江流域的藏缅语族山地民族。他们的传统信仰是朴素的万物有灵，向山中的神灵献祭，重要仪式由巫师主持。每个村寨的最高处有一片神林，人们在那里向天神献祭，在中国称为老祖神；家家户户的后部设有祖先神位。

最主要的节日在新年，收获时节要酿新酒。农历二月初八的刀杆节，纪念明正统年间征讨麓川土司的战事中，傈僳将士上刀山、跳火海的事迹。

en:
John Wycliffe, the Oxford theologian behind Lollardy, was dismissed from the university for heresy in 1381. His followers, nicknamed Lollards, put Scripture into English as the Wycliffite Bible.

After the Peasants' Revolt of 1381, their protectors fell away. Henry IV enacted the law De heretico comburendo in 1401, and the knight John Oldcastle, convicted in 1413, escaped from the Tower of London and led an uprising that failed.

Driven underground, the Lollards survived as small secret groups. Around 310 Lollards were prosecuted in the diocese of London between 1510 and 1532, and the movement was largely absorbed into English Protestantism during the Reformation.
zh:
罗拉德派背后的约翰·威克里夫是牛津大学的神学家，1381年因异端罪名被逐出大学。他的追随者被讥称为罗拉德派，把圣经译成英语，即威克里夫圣经。

1381年农民起义之后，他们的保护者纷纷离去。1401年亨利四世颁布《焚烧异端法》；骑士约翰·奥尔德卡斯尔1413年被定罪，逃出伦敦塔后发动起义，终告失败。

罗拉德派转入地下，以秘密的小团体延续。1510至1532年间，伦敦教区约有310名罗拉德派信徒受到审判；宗教改革期间，这一运动大多并入了英格兰新教。

official_raw.en: Led by John Wycliffe, $lollardy$ was a reformist movement advocating for universal priesthood and rejecting the necessity of sacraments like baptism and confession for salvation. Its teachings emphasized direct access to God through scripture, which was translated into vernacular languages. This made its theology accessible to the common people and fueled early calls for Church reform.
official_raw.zh: $lollardy$由约翰·威克里夫领导，是一场早期宗教改革运动。它倡导普世祭司职分，并拒绝洗礼与告解等圣事对救赎的必要性。其教义强调通过圣经直接与上帝沟通，圣经被翻译成通俗语言，这使得其神学为普通民众所接受，并推动了早期教会改革的呼声。

en:
Adroa-Adro is followed by the Lugbara of north-western Uganda and the neighbouring parts of Congo and South Sudan. Its supreme being, Adroa, created the first man and woman, the twins Gborogboro and Meme, whom the Lugbara count as their ancestors, and gave their descendants the laws of society.

Adroa has two aspects: a good, remote god of the sky, and Adro, an earthly spirit of the rivers who shows himself to the dying and was traditionally offered child sacrifice. Every man was believed to carry both, and at death each returned to its own realm.
zh:
阿德罗教为乌干达西北部以及刚果和南苏丹邻近地带的伦古巴人所奉行。它的至上神阿德罗阿创造了第一对男女，即孪生的戈博罗戈博罗和梅梅，伦古巴人把他们视为自己的祖先；阿德罗阿还把社会的法则传给了他们的后代。

阿德罗阿有两个方面：一是善的、遥远的天神，一是地上的河中精灵阿德罗，他会向临终的人显形，传统上人们以童祭崇奉他。人们相信每个男人都兼有二者，死后各归各的领域。

en:
The German friar Martin Luther, whose Ninety-five Theses of 1517 attacked abuses such as the sale of indulgences, began the Reformation. Johann Eck first used the name Lutheran as an insult at the Leipzig Debate of 1519.

Lutherans hold that a sinner is justified by grace alone through faith alone. They keep much of the older liturgy and give the Eucharist a central place. Their doctrine was set out in the Augsburg Confession of 1530.

Prussia made Lutheranism its state church in 1525. Gustav Vasa of Sweden took the national church under the crown at the Diet of Västerås of 1527, and Denmark–Norway under Christian III adopted it in 1536. After the Schmalkaldic War of 1547, the Peace of Augsburg of 1555 secured Lutherans legal recognition in the empire.
zh:
德国修士马丁·路德1517年发表的《九十五条论纲》抨击兜售赎罪券等弊端，由此开启了宗教改革。路德宗这一名称是约翰·埃克在1519年的莱比锡辩论中首次用作贬称的。

路德宗认为罪人唯独因恩典、唯独藉信心称义。它保留了旧礼仪的许多内容，并把圣餐放在核心位置。其教义见于1530年的《奥格斯堡信条》。

1525年，普鲁士以路德宗为国教。1527年，瑞典的古斯塔夫·瓦萨在韦斯特罗斯议会上使国家教会归于王权，克里斯蒂安三世治下的丹麦—挪威则在1536年采纳路德宗。1547年施马尔卡尔登战争之后，1555年的《奥格斯堡和约》使路德宗在帝国内取得合法地位。

official_raw.en: Based on Martin Luther's Ninety-five Theses, $lutheran$ began as a call to reform the $catholic_ADJ$ Church but evolved into a distinct Protestant denomination. It teaches that the Old and New Testament scriptures are the sole infallible authority for $christian_ADJ$ doctrine.
official_raw.zh: $lutheran$基于马丁·路德的《九十五条论纲》，最初是对$catholic_ADJ$会改革的呼吁，后来发展为一个独立的新教教派。它教导旧约与新约圣经是$christian_ADJ$教义唯一无误的权威。

en:
The Maasai are Nilotic cattle herders who came south into the Rift Valley of Kenya and northern Tanzania. Their Kikuyu neighbours call their own distant high god Ngai, and also know him as Mwene Nyaga.

The Maasai worship one creator, Enkai, who is both male and female and made the sky, the earth, people and cattle. He shows two faces: Black Enkai, who brings rain and fertility, and Red Enkai, who brings drought and lightning. His first dwelling is Ol Doinyo Lengai, the Mountain of God.

The laibon, priest, diviner and healer, stands between the living and the creator and leads sacrifices. Cattle are held to be Enkai's gift. Their dead were left in the open, because burial was thought to harm the land.
zh:
马赛人是尼罗特语系的牧牛民族，南下进入今肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚北部的大裂谷地带。邻近的基库尤人把自己遥远的至高神称作恩加伊，也称他为尼亚加。

马赛人崇拜唯一的创造者恩加伊，他兼有男性和女性两种属性，创造了天空、大地、人类和牛群。他有两副面孔：黑恩加伊带来雨水和丰产，红恩加伊带来干旱和闪电。他最初的居所是神山伦盖伊火山。

莱邦是祭司、占卜者和医者，居于生者与创造者之间，主持献祭。牛被认为是恩加伊的赐予。他们的死者弃置野外，因为人们认为土葬会伤害土地。

en:
Mahāyāna arose in India around the first century BCE, and translators such as Kumārajīva carried it into China. From China the faith passed to Korea, Vietnam and Japan. Under Goryeo and the Lý dynasty of Vietnam it enjoyed the favour of the court, and Seon, the Korean form of Chan, became a religion of the state; the Trần emperor Trần Nhân Tông founded the Trúc Lâm school of Vietnamese Thiền in the 1290s.

Joseon Korea, founded in 1392, suppressed Buddhism in favour of Neo-Confucianism until monks helped to repel the Japanese invasions of 1592–98. Under the Qing, the court favoured the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism.
zh:
大乘佛教约公元前1世纪兴起于印度，鸠摩罗什等译经师把它带入中国。佛教自中国传入朝鲜半岛、越南和日本。高丽和越南李朝都得到王室的扶持，朝鲜半岛上的禅宗更成为高丽的国家宗教；越南陈朝的陈仁宗在1290年代创立了越南禅宗的竹林派。

1392年建立的朝鲜王朝推崇新儒学而压制佛教，直到僧人在1592—1598年协助抗击日本入侵，压制才告停止。清朝宫廷则支持藏传佛教的格鲁派。

official_raw.en: Called the 'Great Vehicle', Mahāyāna is a branch of $buddhist$ that accepts not only the early $buddhist_ADJ$ text, but also those known as the Mahāyāna $sutra$. It emphasizes the figure of the $bodhisattva$, understanding the $bodhisattva$ path as available to all as a way to achieve Buddhahood. While originally developing in $india$, it saw much of its expansion through $china$ and the Silk Road, and the $chinese_group$ Canon forms now the basis of all $mahayana$.
official_raw.zh: 大乘佛教音译为“摩诃衍那”，是$buddhist$的一个分支，它不仅接受早期$buddhist_ADJ$的经典，还接纳大乘$sutra$。它强调$bodhisattva$的形象，认为$bodhisattva$道是所有人皆可修行的成佛之路。虽然大乘佛教最初在$india$发展，但其主要扩展是通过$china$和丝绸之路实现的，如今汉文大藏经构成了所有$mahayana$的基础。

en:
The Maleiwa religion is followed by the Wayuu of the Guajira Peninsula, on the Caribbean coast of what is now Colombia and Venezuela. Its central figure is Maleiwa, creator of everything and founder of Wayuu society. Pulowi, tied to the wind and the dry seasons, and Juya, a roaming hunter, are a married pair of demigods of life, while Wanülu is the evil spirit of sickness and death.

The dead remained part of Wayuu life. A body was buried with its belongings, and after five years the bones were dug up and reburied in the clan cemetery.

The Spanish never subdued the Wayuu. They destroyed a Capuchin mission in 1701 and burned the church at El Rincón in 1769.
zh:
玛雷瓦教为瓜希拉半岛上的瓦尤人所奉行，该半岛位于今哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉的加勒比海岸。信仰的核心是玛雷瓦，他创造了万物，也是瓦尤人社会的奠基者。普洛威与风和旱季相联系，胡亚是四处游荡的猎人，他们是一对主管生命的半神夫妻；万努鲁则是带来疾病与死亡的恶灵。

亡者仍是瓦尤人生活的一部分。遗体与随身物品一同下葬，五年之后骨骸被挖出，再葬入氏族的墓地。

西班牙人始终未能征服瓦尤人；他们在1701年摧毁了一座嘉布遣会传教所，1769年又在埃尔林孔烧毁了教堂。

en:
The Maleku, whom the Spanish called Guatuso, traditionally tell of a world they call the great house, where nothing happened until the gods came. The first to arrive was He of the Source of the Nharíne; he dreamed of a goddess, and she appeared, followed by the other gods, who chose him to rule.

He created plants, animals and people, and for a time the gods spent their days drinking chocolate. Then the goddess known as She of the Source of the Aóre grew envious of his creation, since she could not create, and pressed for the transformation of the earth. After messengers sent to warn the first people were ignored or speared, the cataclysm wiped out that humanity.

Spanish settlers found the Maleku only around 1750. A lack of permanent missions let their religion survive Catholic efforts.
zh:
瓜图索人（自称马莱库）传统上讲述一个被称作“大屋”的世界，在诸神到来之前什么事也没有发生。最先来到的是“纳里内河源之神”；他梦见一位女神，女神就出现了，随后其他神也陆续到来，并推举他为首领。

他创造了植物、动物和人类，有一阵子，诸神整天聚在一起饮巧克力。后来，“奥雷河源之女神”因为自己不能创造而嫉妒他的作品，不断催促他进行“大地的转变”。他派去警告第一代人类的使者要么被无视，要么被人用长矛刺杀；随后大灾变降临，消灭了那一代人类。

西班牙移民直到1750年前后才发现马莱库人。由于没有常设的传教站，他们的宗教在天主教的传教面前得以延续。

en:
Malesung is followed by the Minahasa of the northern tip of Sulawesi, led by the priests called Tonaas Walian. The Minahasa traced their descent from the first pair, Toar and Lumimuut. Their descendants quarrelled until the tonaas, the leaders, met at a stone called Watu Pinawetengan, where they divided the people into three groups, each with its own language and ritual.

The walian, shamans, were often women. Until well into the nineteenth century the Minahasa lived in rival warrior societies that practised headhunting, which was believed to give the warrior keter, a spirit substance linked to courage and fertility.

Portuguese Franciscans made some converts in the 1560s, and the Minahasa resisted Islam. A treaty with the Dutch East India Company in 1679 began Dutch rule, and the Minahasa later embraced Protestant Christianity.
zh:
马莱宗信仰为苏拉威西岛北端的米纳哈萨人所奉行，由称为“托纳阿斯·瓦利安”的祭司主持。米纳哈萨人把自己的血统追溯到最初的一对男女托阿尔与鲁米穆乌特。他们的后代发生争执，各部首领“托纳阿斯”于是在一块名为皮纳韦腾安的石头旁聚会，把人群分成三个群体，各有自己的语言和仪式。

瓦利安是萨满，常常由女性担任。直到19世纪很久之后，米纳哈萨人仍分成彼此敌对的武士社会，盛行猎头，人们相信猎头能让武士获得“凯特”，那是一种与勇气和生育力相连的精神实质。

1560年代，葡萄牙方济各会传教士使一些人改了宗；米纳哈萨人则抵制伊斯兰教。1679年与荷兰东印度公司的条约开启了荷兰的统治，米纳哈萨人后来多信奉基督新教。

en:
Mandaeism is practised in the marshlands and along the rivers of southern Mesopotamia, with Jewish influences as well. Its followers take their name from manda, knowledge, and are called Sabians by their neighbours. They revere Adam, Seth, Noah and Shem.

Baptism in flowing water, the masbuta, is repeated every Sunday, so every mandi, or temple, stands beside a river. Being identified with the Sabians of the Quran won the community the protection due to People of the Book.

Portuguese Jesuits in 1559 called them Christians of Saint John. In 1831 cholera killed most of the priests of Shushtar, and two surviving acolytes restored the priesthood at Suq al-Shuyukh.
zh:
曼达派流行于美索不达米亚南部的沼泽与河流一带，也带有犹太文化的影响。信徒的名称出自“曼达”（意为知识），邻近的穆斯林称他们为萨比教徒。他们尊奉亚当、塞特、诺亚和闪。

每个星期日，信徒都要在流动的河水中受洗，称为玛斯布塔，所以每座曼迪（神庙）都建在河边。社群因被认同为《古兰经》中的萨比教徒，获得了“有经人”应得的保护。

1559年，葡萄牙耶稣会士称他们为“圣约翰的基督徒”。1831年，霍乱夺走了舒什塔尔大部分祭司的性命，两名幸存的助祭在苏格·舒尤赫重建了祭司制度。

official_raw.en: A gnostic religion considering John the Baptist to be the final prophet, $mandeaism$ also includes $greek_culture$ and $iranian_group$ influences. Although it considers as such some prophets of other Abrahamic religions, it does not consider Abraham, Moses, or Jesus to be $mandeaism_ADJ$ prophets. The God of $mandeaism$ is called $mandeaism_god_name$, meaning 'Great Life', and it represents the creative force of the universe.
official_raw.zh: $mandeaism$是一种诺斯替宗教，认为施洗约翰是最后的先知，同时也包含$greek_culture$与$iranian_group$文化的影响。尽管它承认其他亚伯拉罕宗教的一些先知，但并不认为亚伯拉罕、摩西或耶稣是$mandeaism_ADJ$的先知。$mandeaism$的神被称为“$mandeaism_god_name$”（哈依·拉比），代表宇宙的创造力量。

en:
Mani, the prophet of Manichaeism, was born in 216 near Ctesiphon. The Manichaean community was divided into the Elect, ascetic monks and nuns, and the Hearers who supported them. Manichaeism spread west to Roman North Africa, where Augustine was a Hearer for nine or ten years before turning against it, and east to Central Asia, where the Uyghur khagan Bögü made it the state religion in 763.

By 1337 it survived only in China, where believers sheltered behind Buddhist and Taoist forms and honoured Mani as the Buddha of Light. At Cao'an near Quanzhou a statue of Mani was donated and the temple rebuilt in 1339. The Ming banned it in 1370, and it was soon absorbed into Buddhism and Taoism.
zh:
摩尼教的先知摩尼于216年生在泰西封附近。摩尼教团分为过着禁欲修行生活的男女僧侣“选民”，和供养他们的“听者”。摩尼教向西传入罗马统治下的北非，奥古斯丁曾做过九、十年听者，后来转而反对它；向东传入中亚，回鹘牟羽可汗于763年将它定为国教。

到1337年，它只在中国还有遗存，信徒借佛教和道教的外形自保，把摩尼尊为“光明佛”。泉州附近的草庵里，1339年有人捐造了摩尼像，庙宇也在这一年重建。明朝于1370年禁止摩尼教，不久它就被佛教和道教吸纳。

official_raw.en: $manichaeism$ is an $iranian_group$ religion founded by the prophet Mani in the Sasanian Empire. It has influences by many other religions, including Gnosticism, $zoroastrian$, $christian$, and $buddhist$ among others, but considers Mani to be the final prophet after Zoroaster, Buddha, and Jesus. Its theology is dualistic, describing the universe as a spiritual struggle between light and darkness.
official_raw.zh: $manichaeism$是萨珊帝国时期由先知摩尼创立的一种$iranian_group$宗教，受到诺斯替主义、$zoroastrian$、$christian$与$buddhist$等多种宗教的影响，但认为摩尼是继琐罗亚斯德、佛陀与耶稣之后的最后一位先知。其神学是二元论的，将宇宙描述为光明与黑暗之间的灵性斗争。

en:
The folk religion of the Maonan, the Kam-Sui-speaking people of northwestern Guangxi, is animist and polytheistic, with heavy Taoist influence and many gods and rites from Chinese folk religion. Among its powers are the Kitchen God and the Earth God, who keeps outdoor work peaceful.

Every household keeps a shrine, a wooden plate on the wall bearing the names of the gods and ancestors. The birth goddess, called Wansui Niangniang in Chinese, is asked for children at weddings, and a couple who have had a child thank her with a ritual of twenty-six sacrificial animals.

In the fifth month the Maonan keep the Fenlong festival, when whole villages sacrifice to the gods and ancestors. At a funeral the children buy river water to wash the body, and chicken blood is poured on the grave ground.
zh:
毛南人是广西西北部的侗水语支民族。他们的民间信仰既是万物有灵，也是多神崇拜，受道教影响很深，许多神灵和仪式借自汉族民间信仰。其中有灶神，以及保佑户外劳作平安的土地神。

家家设有神龛，是墙上的一块木板，写着诸神和祖先的名字。生育女神汉语称万岁娘娘，成婚时要向她求子；夫妇有了孩子，要用二十六头牲畜还愿。

五月里毛南人过分龙节，全村人一起祭祀神灵与祖先。办丧事时，孝子要到河边“买水”为亡者洗身，下葬前把鸡血洒在墓地上。

en:
In the Marapu faith of Sumba, the word marapu means the inhabitants of the eternal heaven, Prai Marapu, who are the ancestors of the Sumbanese, and also the spirits of the ancestors and of the universe. The balance of the world is symbolised by the Great Mother Ina Kalada and the Great Father Ama Kalada, the moon and the sun, who bore the first ancestors. The Sumbanese believe seven pairs of men and women came down on a ladder of buffalo horns, and that after death they too climb the ladder.

Wooden figures with human faces, the marapu, stand on stone altars where betel and sacrificial cattle are offered. Funerals can be delayed for years, and when they take place hundreds of men haul stone slabs in the tarik batu rite.
zh:
在松巴岛的玛拉甫信仰中，“玛拉甫”一词既指永恒天界普莱玛拉甫的居民，他们是松巴人的祖先；也指祖先的灵魂和宇宙间的灵。世界的平衡由大母伊娜卡拉达和大父阿马卡拉达象征，也就是月亮和太阳，他们生下了最初的祖先。松巴人相信，七对男女沿着水牛角做成的梯子降到人间，人死之后也会爬上这架梯子。

传统上，人们把有人脸的木像玛拉甫放在石祭坛上，供奉槟榔和祭牛。葬礼可以推迟数年，举行时数百名男子用圆木滚杠拉着石板，这是“拉石”仪式。

en:
Čimarii Jüla is followed by the Mari, a Volga Finnic people. It is henotheistic: most deities are seen as manifestations of the supreme god Kugu Yumo, creator of the laws of the universe. Next to him stands Keremet, the ambiguous lord of the earth and of water, who records human misdeeds and punishes them.

Worship took place in sacred groves or at home, led by a family elder or a kart, a priest. In autumn a goose was sacrificed in thanks for the harvest.

In the sixteenth century their land lay between Russia and the Kazan Khanate, and passed under Russian control in the wars that ended with the fall of Kazan in 1552. The Mari were nominally baptised but kept their old rites, and some fled to Bashkiria to escape baptism.
zh:
奇马里多神教为伏尔加芬兰语民族马里人所奉行。它属于单一主神倾向的多神信仰：多数神灵被视为最高神库古·尤莫的化身，他是宇宙法则的创造者。居于他之下的是克列梅特，这位大地与水之主立场暧昧，会记录人的过错并加以惩罚。

崇拜在圣林或家中进行，由家中长者或祭司卡尔特主持。秋天要献祭一只鹅，感谢收成。

16世纪，他们的土地夹在俄罗斯与喀山汗国之间，在1552年喀山陷落而告终的战争中被置于俄罗斯控制之下。马里人名义上受洗，却保留旧日仪式，一些人逃往巴什基尔以躲避受洗。

en:
The Maya peoples of Yucatán, Chiapas and the Guatemalan highlands kept local cults in every kingdom. Rites at sowing and harvest served the maize, and a 260-day count combined with a 365-day year ordered the ritual calendar.

The K'iche' Popol Vuh tells of creation and of the Hero Twins' descent into Xibalba. Around 1500 pilgrims from many kingdoms came to the great cenote of Chichen Itza and to shrines of the goddess Ix Chel on the islands off Yucatán.

The Spanish conquered the Yucatec kingdoms between 1527 and 1546. In 1562 the Franciscan Diego de Landa burned at Maní, by his own count, twenty-seven books and some five thousand cult images. The Itza held out at Nojpetén until 1697, and the Tzeltal rising of 1712 in Chiapas rallied behind the Virgin Mary.
zh:
尤卡坦、恰帕斯和危地马拉高地的各玛雅民族，在各个王国都有自己的地方崇拜。播种、收获时的祭仪都为玉米而设，260天计数与365天年历相配，安排着仪式历法。

基切人的《波波尔·乌》讲述了创世，以及英雄双子下到西巴尔巴的故事。1500年前后，各王国的朝圣者前往奇琴伊察的大天然井，也前往尤卡坦外海岛屿上的伊希切尔女神圣所。

西班牙人在1527—1546年间征服了尤卡坦诸王国。1562年，方济各会士迭戈·德·兰达在马尼焚毁了按他自己的说法共27部书和约五千件偶像。伊察人在诺赫佩滕坚守到1697年；1712年恰帕斯的泽套人起义，就是以崇拜圣母马利亚为号召。

en:
The Mbori religion is followed by the Azande, the conquering people of the upper Uele river region in Central Africa, who took shape in the first half of the 1700s. It centres on Mbori, an all-powerful god who made the universe but does not act like the God of the Christian missionaries who later came to the Azande.

The Azande traditionally turned to oracles, magic and witchcraft to settle everyday troubles, and the poison oracle, reserved for men, was the most respected of the oracles. Stories of the trickster Ture taught what happened to people who acted rashly.
zh:
姆博里教为阿赞德人所奉行，阿赞德人是中非乌埃莱河上游一带的征服者，18世纪上半叶才形成。它以姆博里为核心，姆博里是全能的神，创造了宇宙，但和后来来到阿赞德人当中的传教士所说的基督教上帝并不相同。

阿赞德人传统上借助神谕、魔法和巫术解决日常的烦恼，其中只准男子使用的毒药神谕最受尊重。特乌雷是诡计之神，关于他的故事教人知道鲁莽行事的后果。

en:
The Tonal religion covers the Mesoamerican peoples outside the Nahua and Maya cults, chiefly the Purépecha of Michoacán and the Mixtecs and Zapotecs of Oaxaca. Each people had its own gods. The Purépecha worshipped Curicaueri, the Great Fire, god of fire and the sun and patron of their ruling Uacúsecha clan, who in a vision sent Tariácuri to unite the Pátzcuaro basin. The Zapotecs honoured Cocijo, god of lightning and rain, and their high priest, the Uija-tao, lived at Mitla, a sanctuary of the dead. The Mixtecs prayed to the rain god Dzahui and kept royal genealogies in painted codices such as the Zouche-Nuttall.

The Mixtecs and Zapotecs submitted to Spain in 1521–1522, and in 1530 the Purépecha king Tangaxuan II was executed. In 1553 the Church ordered the temples of Mitla dismantled.
zh:
托纳利宗教涵盖纳瓦人和玛雅人之外的中美洲诸民族，主要指米却肯的普雷佩查人和瓦哈卡的米斯特克人、萨波特克人。各民族有各自的神。普雷佩查人崇拜“大火”库里卡韦里，他是火神和太阳神，也是统治家族瓦库塞查氏的守护神，据说他在异象中指引塔里亚库里去统一帕茨夸罗湖盆。萨波特克人敬奉闪电和雨神科西霍，他们的大祭司乌伊哈-塔奥住在米特拉，那里是通往亡者世界的圣所。米斯特克人向雨神扎维祈祷，并把王室谱系绘在祖什-纳托尔抄本等彩绘手抄本里。

1521—1522年，米斯特克人和萨波特克人先后臣服西班牙；1530年，普雷佩查国王坦加苏安二世被处死。1553年，教会下令拆毁米特拉的神庙。

en:
Miaphysitism follows the formula of Cyril of Alexandria, the champion of the Council of Ephesus in 431, and rejects the Council of Chalcedon of 451, which spoke of two natures. Most bishops of Alexandria, Antioch and Armenia refused Chalcedon.

The Oriental Orthodox churches that followed them were the Coptic Church of Egypt, the Syriac Orthodox Church and the Armenian Apostolic Church, together with the Ethiopian Church. In 1337 the Ethiopian empire was the greatest Miaphysite power, and the faith was also held in the Armenian kingdom of Cilicia, which fell to the Mamluks in 1375.

The Ethiopian Church held out against Rome. The Jesuits won Emperor Susenyos to Catholicism, but he gave up the throne in 1632 and his son Fasilides restored the old faith and expelled them in 1633.
zh:
基督合性派遵循亚历山大的济利禄的公式，济利禄是431年以弗所会议的主将；它拒绝451年主张两个本性的卡尔西顿会议。亚历山大、安条克和亚美尼亚的多数主教拒绝了卡尔西顿会议。

追随他们的东方正统诸教会有埃及的科普特教会、叙利亚正教会和亚美尼亚使徒教会，还有埃塞俄比亚教会。1337年，埃塞俄比亚帝国是最强大的合性派政权；亚美尼亚的奇里乞亚王国也信奉这一教义，该国于1375年被马穆鲁克灭亡。

埃塞俄比亚教会顶住了罗马的压力。耶稣会士曾使皇帝苏塞尼奥斯皈依天主教，但他于1632年退位，其子法西利达斯恢复了旧信仰，并在1633年驱逐了耶稣会士。

official_raw.en: $miaphysite$ teaches that in the person of Christ, His divine and human natures are united into a single, indivisible nature. This doctrine, rooted in the Council of Ephesus, spread widely across regions like Armenia, Egypt, and Ethiopia. $miaphysite_ADJ$ communities have preserved their unique liturgies and traditions, emphasizing Christ's unity as both God and man.
official_raw.zh: $miaphysite$教导在基督的位格中，其神性与人性结合为一个不可分割的本性。这一教义源自以弗所大公会议，广泛传播于亚美尼亚、埃及和埃塞俄比亚等地区。$miaphysite_ADJ$社区保留了其独特的礼仪与传统，强调基督作为神与人的合一。

en:
The Midewiwin, or Grand Medicine Society, is a religious society of the Anishinaabe peoples, among them the Ojibwe, of the Great Lakes, New England and the Maritimes. Ojibwe tradition ascribes its founding to the culture hero Wenaboozho.

One account tells how the Creator saw that the people he had made suffered sickness and death, and sent the Sun Spirit to earth as a boy who taught them the Sacred Medicine. Initiates rose through degrees by completing the required teachings and ceremonies. The lessons were drawn in pictographs on birch bark scrolls; two scrolls found in Ontario were carbon-dated to about 1560.

Ceremonies were held in the domed, oval Grand Medicine Lodge. The cowry, or miigis, shell was a sacred emblem of the society.
zh:
密得微是五大湖、新英格兰和沿海诸省的阿尼什纳比人的宗教社团，奥吉布瓦人也在其中，又称大医药会。奥吉布瓦人的传统把创立之功归于文化英雄韦纳博佐。

一种说法讲，造物主见他造出的人受病痛和死亡折磨，便差太阳神灵化作男孩来到人间，把神圣的医药传给他们。入会者要完成规定的教导和仪式才能逐级晋升。教义以象形图画画在桦树皮卷轴上；安大略发现的两卷经碳测定约为1560年的遗物。

仪式在圆顶椭圆形的大医药棚里举行。宝贝贝，即米吉斯贝壳，是这个社团的神圣标志。

en:
The Minangkabau of the West Sumatran highlands kept an older animist faith that blended with Buddhism. Their tambo, the traditional histories, say the first Minangkabau landed on Mount Marapi when it was no bigger than an egg.

Every living thing was said to have a vital spirit, the semangat. Illness meant that an evil spirit had caught the semangat, and a shaman, the pawang, was called to appease the spirits. Much of the customary law, adat, drew on these beliefs.

Buddhism was strong in the highlands, and Adityawarman, a Tantric Buddhist, ruled at Pagaruyung from about 1347 to 1375. Islam reached the highlands around the sixteenth century but was weakly practiced until the Padri movement of 1803, whose war against the old customs lasted until 1837.
zh:
苏门答腊西部高地的米南加保人保持着更古老的泛灵信仰，与佛教相融。米南加保人的传统史书《塔博》说，最初的米南加保人在马拉皮火山只有一枚蛋那么大时登陆其上。

据说万物皆有生命之灵“塞芒阿特”。生病意味着邪灵抓住了塞芒阿特，这时要请称为帕旺的巫师安抚精灵。习惯法“阿达特”的许多内容就取材于这些信仰。

佛教曾在高地兴盛，密宗佛教徒阿蒂亚瓦曼约在1347至1375年于帕加鲁永统治。伊斯兰教大约在16世纪传入高地，但直到1803年巴德里运动兴起之前，信徒的礼拜和斋戒一直松懈；这场运动向旧习俗开战，战争持续到1837年。

en:
The Mishmi religion is held by the forest peoples of the Mishmi Hills, along the Dibang and Lohit rivers of Arunachal Pradesh and across the border in southern Tibet. It is best recorded among the Idu, one of four Mishmi peoples with the Digaro, the Miju and the Deng.

The Idu hold that the universe and mankind were created by the supreme deities Ini Mashelo-Zinu and Nani Intaya. They honour the sun and a divine spirit that governs the universe, and worship both kind and malevolent spirits, believing in ghosts, spirit guides and an afterlife. The Idu shaman, the Igu, performs rituals, dances and chants to keep households safe and healthy.
zh:
米什米泛灵论为米什米山区的森林民族所奉行，分布在阿鲁纳恰尔邦的迪邦河和洛希特河流域，以及境外的西藏南部。米什米人分为义都、迪加罗、米久和登四支，其中义都的信仰记载最完整。

义都人认为宇宙和人类是至上神伊尼·马舍洛—济努和纳尼·因塔亚所创造。他们崇敬太阳和主宰宇宙的神灵，既祭祀善灵，也祭祀恶灵，相信有鬼魂、护身灵和来世。义都的萨满称为伊古，用仪式、舞蹈和吟唱来保佑家人平安健康。

en:
Ceremonialism stands for the shared religious imagery and ritual of the Mississippian chiefdoms of the American Southeast and Midwest, which flourished with maize farming between about 1200 and 1650. Scholars call it the Southeastern Ceremonial Complex; its fullest early expression took shape at Cahokia, a city beside the Mississippi that stood from about 1050 to 1350.

The cosmos had three levels. The Upper World held the Thunderers and the Morning Star; the cold Under World held the Underwater Panther and the Corn Mother; humans lived between. The falcon-dressed Birdman, shown dancing with a club on copper and shell, was a warrior’s patron.

Such images marked chiefly office and warfare. As Cahokia and its trade networks collapsed, regional styles drifted apart into the beliefs of the later historic tribes.
zh:
仪俗信仰指美国东南部和中西部的密西西比诸酋邦所共有的宗教图像和仪式，它们大约在1200年至1650年间随玉米农业繁盛。学者称之为东南仪典综合体，其早期最完整的表现形成于卡霍基亚。这座城市位于密西西比河畔，存在于约1050年至1350年之间。

宇宙分为三层。上界住着雷霆之灵和晨星；寒冷的下界住着水下豹和玉米母亲；人类居于中间。身披猎鹰装束、手持棍棒起舞的鸟人，常见于铜片和贝壳饰物，是战士的守护者。

这类图像用来标示酋长的职位和战争。随着卡霍基亚及其贸易网络崩溃，各地风格渐行渐远，演变成后来各个历史部落的信仰。

en:
Mitu is followed on the Kei Islands in southeastern Maluku, where the spirits called mitu can bring happiness or misery. A good or failed harvest, prosperity or disaster, was held to come from their power, so people held small rites in the family and each year a village cleansing, the sob-sob, for the settlement, or ohoi. Mitu could also be harnessed through the magic called suanggi.

Researchers describe the old religion of Kei as a mixture of animism, magic and totemism. Beside it stood the customary law of Larvul Ngabal, handed down from the ancestors, which divided the Kei into two groups, the Ursiu of nine and the Lorlim of five.
zh:
米图泛灵论流行于马鲁古东南部的凯伊群岛，其中称为“米图”的灵体既能带来幸福，也能带来苦难。收成好坏、安康或灾祸，都被认为来自它们的力量，所以人们在家庭里举行小型仪式，每年还要为聚落（奥霍伊）举行集体的“索布索布”清洁仪式。人也可以借助称为“苏昂吉”的巫术驱使米图。

研究者认为凯伊的古老宗教混合了万物有灵、巫术和图腾信仰。与它并行的是祖先传下的习惯法《拉尔武尔·恩加巴尔》，该法把凯伊人分成两个集团：九邦的乌尔西乌和五邦的洛尔利姆。

en:
Sakhua, or Khua worship, is followed by the Mizo, once called the Lushai, the Tibeto-Burman hill peoples of northeast India. Its creation story tells how the goddess Khuazingnu put a pair from every tribe and animal in a cave and sealed it with the boulder Chhinlung; when she lifted the stone, the clans came out until the noisy Ralte pushed out so loudly that she put it back.

Pathian, the kind creator, rewards the righteous and punishes the wicked. Worship is aimed at spirits: the helpful Khuavang on the hilltops and the dangerous ramhuai of caves, springs and big trees.

Priests were called puithiam. The sadawt served a chief, who could appoint or dismiss him, and the bawlpu was called to the sick to name the sacrifice that would appease the spirit.
zh:
萨库阿，又称库阿崇拜，为米佐人所奉行。米佐人旧称卢塞人，是印度东北部的藏缅语山地民族。创世传说讲女神库阿津努把每个部族和每种动物各一对放进山洞，用大石钦隆封住洞口；她搬开石头，各氏族陆续走出，直到吵闹的拉尔泰人喧哗着挤出来，她便把石头又盖了回去。

帕提安是仁慈的创造者，赏善罚恶。信仰的实际对象是各种灵：山顶上乐于助人的库阿旺，以及住在山洞、泉水和大树里的危险的拉姆怀。

祭司统称普伊蒂亚姆。萨多特服务于首领，首领可以任命或罢免他；生病时请来巴乌普，由他指明要用什么祭品去安抚作祟的灵。

en:
Mo is followed by the Zhuang of Guangxi. It grew from older Zhuang beliefs and took on some Buddhist and Taoist doctrines. Its supreme god is Bu Luotuo, the creator and founder of the religion. Everything is held to have a spirit.

Beside Bu Luotuo stands Mu Liujia, the Flower Mother and goddess of birth, who tends a garden where every child is a flower, golden for boys and silver for girls. The priests, called mogong, may marry and need not leave home. Their sacred epic of Bu Luotuo was first passed on orally.

Each family keeps a hall for the ancestors of the last three generations, whom it fears as well as reveres. The dead are buried twice, but those who died by violence are cremated, lest they release evil spirits.
zh:
麽教为广西壮族所奉行。它从壮族先民更古老的信仰发展而来，也吸收了佛教、道教的一些教义。主神是创造者、也是教派创始人的布洛陀。万物皆有灵。

布洛陀身边有姆六甲。姆六甲是花神和生育女神，掌管一座花园，每个孩子都是园中的一朵花，男孩是金花，女孩是银花。神职人员称为麽公，可以娶妻生子，不必出家。他们的圣典《布洛陀》最初靠口耳相传。

每个家庭都设有祖堂，供奉近三代的祖先，对他们既敬又畏。死者要二次葬，但横死的人则要火化，以免放出恶灵。

en:
Shkayism is followed by the Mokshas, a Mordvinic people who speak a Uralic language and live along the Moksha River and the middle Volga. It takes its name from Shkay, the sun, regarded as the chief divinity; the moon, thunder and water were also worshipped.

In their creation myth the great bird Ińe Narmon, called the White Swan, made water first; a duck brought sand from the sea floor, and the bird shaped it into the earth and set the Great Tree upon it. Mastoratia ruled the underworld, while the souls of heroes and warriors travelled to the green isle of Usiya to feast with King Ťušťen over pure mead.

After 1552 the Mokshas were Russian subjects. Russian rule brought forced conversion to Orthodoxy, but pagan elements long survived inside Christian practice.
zh:
萨卡依崇拜为莫克沙人所奉行。莫克沙人是说乌拉尔语系语言的莫尔多瓦人的一支，居住在莫克沙河和伏尔加河中游一带。信仰得名于太阳什凯，它被视为主神；月亮、雷和水也受到崇拜。

在创世神话中，大鸟伊涅·纳尔蒙，又称白天鹅，最先造出水；一只鸭子从海底衔来沙子，大鸟把它塑成大地，并在上面立起大树。马斯托拉蒂亚统治冥界，英雄和战士的灵魂则前往翠绿的乌西亚岛，同图什坚王一起畅饮纯蜜酒。

1552年以后，莫克沙人成了俄国的臣民。俄国的统治带来了强迫改宗东正教，但异教的成分长期保留在基督教习俗之中。

en:
Momolianism is followed by the Kadazan-Dusun, Murut and Rungus peoples of Sabah in northern Borneo. It grew out of the first ancestors' dealings with nature and the spirits at Nunuk Ragang, the legendary ancestral home, and it was woven into the unwritten laws of custom known as adat.

The creator was worshipped as Kinorohingan, and in one telling Kinoingan and his wife Suminundu are the first pair. The knowledge was handed down by priestesses, the bobolian, who healed the sick. Breaking the rules brought plague and famine on the whole community until the chief punished the offender.

When famine threatened, the maiden Huminodun, daughter of Kinoingan and Suminundu, let herself be sacrificed, and her body grew into the food plants that saved her people. The dead went to Nabahu, now Mount Kinabalu.
zh:
摩摩利安教为婆罗洲北部沙巴的卡达山-杜顺人、穆如特人和伦古斯人所奉行。它源于最初的祖先在传说中的祖居地努努克拉冈与自然及神灵打交道的经历，后来融进了被称为“阿达”的不成文习惯法。

创世之神被称为基诺罗欣甘，在一种说法里，基诺英甘和妻子苏米农杜是最初的一对夫妇。这套知识由女祭司“博博利安”代代相传，她们为人治病。若有人触犯禁忌，瘟疫和饥荒就会降到整个社群头上，直到首领惩办了罪人。

饥荒逼近时，基诺英甘与苏米农杜的女儿胡米诺顿自愿献身，她的身体长成了拯救族人的粮食作物。死者前往纳巴胡，即今天的京那巴鲁山。

en: The Monpa, the people of Mon Yul on the southern slopes of the Himalaya around Tawang, kept an older belief of their own alongside Tibetan Buddhism. In the seventeenth century most Monpa turned to the Gelug school under the Bhutanese-trained Merag Lama, and Tawang Monastery became the centre of their life.
zh: 门巴人是居住在喜马拉雅南麓达旺一带门域的民族，他们固有的信仰与藏传佛教长期并存。17世纪，多数门巴人在曾赴不丹受学的梅拉格喇嘛影响下皈依格鲁派，达旺寺成为他们生活的中心。

en:
The Yuracaré are a forest people of the lowlands between Cochabamba and the Beni in Bolivia. Their language is an isolate with no known relatives.

Yuracaré tradition distinguished two kinds of spirits. The first owned the earth and the clay, which was treated with fear: it was not to be urinated on. The mororuma were the owners of the most powerful lightning bolts, and lent that power to Yuracaré shamans to cure illnesses. The dead were buried with their bows and arrows, for they were believed to go to a place underground where game was plentiful.

To resist Spanish expansion the Yuracaré withdrew into isolation. Only from the end of the eighteenth century did they cease to live outside the colonial world.
zh:
尤拉卡雷人是玻利维亚低地的森林民族，住在科恰班巴与贝尼之间。他们所说的语言是没有已知亲属的孤立语。

尤拉卡雷人的传统把灵分成两类。第一类是土地和黏土的主人，人们对黏土心怀敬畏，不能对着它撒尿。莫罗鲁玛则是最强闪电的主人，他们把这份力量借给尤拉卡雷人的萨满，让萨满治病。死者连同弓箭一起下葬，因为人们相信死者会去到地下一处猎物丰富的地方。

为了抵御西班牙人的扩张，尤拉卡雷人退入与世隔绝的深处。直到18世纪末，他们才不再生活在殖民世界之外。

en: Mu Ngava is followed by the Polynesian people of Rennell Island in the Solomon Islands, whose ancestors are said to have come by canoe from 'Uvea. Oral tradition names a medium, Tahasi, who told the first voyagers of another island yet to be found, and recalls turmeric brought from East 'Uvea for ritual dyeing and anointment.
zh: 穆恩加瓦泛灵论为所罗门群岛伦内尔岛上的波利尼西亚居民所奉行，据说他们的祖先乘独木舟从乌韦阿而来。口述传统提到一位名叫塔哈西的灵媒，他告诉最初的航海者前方还有一座尚未发现的岛；传统中也提到从东乌韦阿带来的姜黄，用于仪式性的染色和涂抹。

en:
Muinaisusko, the old faith, was followed by the Baltic Finnic peoples, the Finns, Estonians, Karelians and others, before they were Christianised. Customs differed from region to region and from period to period.

Jumala was another sky god, whose name later came to mean the Christian God. Ahti ruled the sea and its fish, and Tapio the forest and the hunt. The tietäjä, the one who knows, was a shaman who could enter a trance and travel to Tuonela, the land of the dead beneath the earth, ruled by Tuoni.

Christianisation began around the twelfth century. Churches were often built on the old holy places, and sacred trees were cut down, but folk magic and oral tradition lingered in the countryside long afterwards.
zh:
索米多神教为波罗的海芬兰诸民族——芬兰人、爱沙尼亚人、卡累利阿人等——在基督教化之前所奉行。各地、各时期的习俗并不一致。

尤马拉也是天神，名字后来成了基督教上帝的称呼。阿赫提掌管海洋和鱼，塔皮奥掌管森林和狩猎。蒂塔雅意为“知晓者”，是能够入神、前往地下亡者之地图奥内拉的萨满，那里由图奥尼统治。

基督教化大约从12世纪开始。教堂常建在旧圣地上，圣树被砍倒，但民间法术和口头传统在乡间又延续了很久。

official_raw.en: The traditional beliefs of the $finnish_language$ peoples, it contains a multitude of deities, being the most prevalent one the sky and thunder god Ukko. It also contains veneration of the dead and shamanistic practices, while also sharing some features with other nearby religions.
official_raw.zh: 这是$finnish_language$人民的传统信仰，包含众多神祇，其中最普遍的是天神与雷神乌科。它也包含对死者的崇敬与萨满实践，同时与附近其他宗教有一些共同特征。

en:
In the Muisca confederation of the central Colombian Andes, rulers served as both political and religious leaders. The supreme being, Chiminigagua, made light and the Earth, but he was not worshipped directly. Worship went to the moon goddess Chía and her husband Sué, god of the sun. The first Muisca, the chroniclers wrote, came from Lake Iguaque with the mother goddess Bachué, and the teacher Bochica taught them weaving and law.

Priests called ogques led pilgrimages and offerings of gold figures, emeralds and sometimes human lives at holy lakes such as Guatavita and Tota. Ritual use of coca, tobacco and yopo accompanied them.

The Spanish conquest of the 1530s ended the old order, and the last public ceremony was held at Ubaque on 27 December 1563.
zh:
在哥伦比亚安第斯山中部的穆伊斯卡联盟，统治者兼任政治领袖和宗教领袖。至高者奇米尼加瓜创造了光明和大地，但人们并不直接崇拜他，祭拜的对象是月亮女神奇亚和她的丈夫、太阳神苏埃。据编年史家记载，最早的穆伊斯卡人随母神巴丘埃从伊瓜克湖而来，导师包查卡则教他们纺织和法度。

称为奥克的祭司带领朝圣，并在瓜塔维塔湖、托塔湖等圣湖献上金像、祖母绿，有时还有活人。祭仪中还伴有古柯、烟草和约波的使用。

1530年代的西班牙征服终结了旧秩序，最后一次公开仪式于1563年12月27日在乌巴克举行。

en:
The folk religion of the Mulao, a people of northern Guangxi who trace their ancestry to the old Ling and Liao tribes, was traditionally animist and polytheistic, and Han and Zhuang neighbours shaped it. Shamans led the ceremonies; at the dragon boat festival they performed rites to secure the harvest and drive off harmful insects.

The great festival was Yifan, a thanksgiving at which animals were sacrificed. In the third lunar month people honoured Huapo, the goddess of birth, whose garden is said to hold flowers that become children, with pigs and oxen killed before her temple. Buddhist monasteries stood near Luocheng, and in sickness or disaster the Mulao called Taoist masters, usually of the Meishan order.
zh:
仫佬人是广西北部的农耕民族，自称先祖是古代的伶人和僚人。他们的民间信仰传统上是万物有灵的多神崇拜，深受汉族和壮族邻人的影响。仪式由巫师主持；端午节时，巫师举行仪式，保佑庄稼丰收，驱除害虫。

最隆重的是依饭节，这是感恩祈愿的节日，要杀牲祭祀。三月里人们敬拜生育女神花婆，传说她的花园里的花都会变成孩子，人们在她的庙前宰杀猪牛。罗城一带有佛寺，遇到生病和灾害时，仫佬人请道教法师，多请梅山教一派。

en:
The Muong are a highland people of northern Vietnam who share ancient roots with the lowland Vietnamese. Their religion is polytheistic and shares many supernatural beings with Vietnamese folk religion; its main festival is the lunar new year, when the Muong pray to their ancestors.

Every living person is thought to have many souls, and life passes into death in stages. The Muong creation epic traces the first people to a cave in the mountains, from which they spread to the villages; one son, called the king Việt, went down to the plains to build a capital.
zh:
芒人是越南北部的高地民族，与低地的越人有着古老的共同源头。他们的宗教是多神信仰，与越南民间信仰共有许多超自然存在；主要的节日是农历新年，届时芒人向祖先祈祷。

人们认为每个活人都有许多灵魂，从生到死是分阶段完成的。芒人的创世史诗把最初的人追溯到山中的一个洞穴，人们从那里散居到各个村寨；其中一个儿子，称作越王，下到平原建起了都城。

en:
Muonyjang is followed by the Dinka, who herd cattle along the White Nile and across the Bahr el-Ghazal plains. Their ancestors left the Gezira as Christian Alodia crumbled in the thirteenth century.

The supreme being is Nhialic, god of sky and rain, who keeps far from human affairs. In myth he made the first people, Garang and Abuk, and cut the rope joining heaven to earth after Abuk disobeyed him by planting too much grain. Prayers go first to Nhialic, then to clan divinities and ancestral spirits called jok, with a bull or ox sacrificed.

Every Dinka inherits a totem from both parents; it is not worshipped but treated as kin. The Dinka largely ignored or rejected the Islam and Christianity of their neighbours, among them the Funj Sultanate that arose in 1504.
zh:
坚格信仰为丁卡人所奉行，他们沿白尼罗河放牧牛群，分布在加扎勒河一带的平原上。13世纪基督教国家阿洛迪亚瓦解时，他们的先民离开了杰济拉。

至高神是掌管天空和降雨的尼雅力克，他远离人间事务。神话说他造出最初的人类加朗和阿布克；阿布克违背命令多种了谷物，尼雅力克便割断了连接天地的绳索。祈祷先向尼雅力克诉说，再依次呼唤氏族神灵和被称为乔克的祖先之灵，献祭一头公牛或阉牛。

每个丁卡人从父母双方各继承一个图腾，不拜它，而把它当作亲属。丁卡人对邻近的伊斯兰教和基督教大多置之不理或加以拒绝，其中就有1504年兴起的丰吉苏丹国。

en: Musala is the faith of the Nuba Mountains in southern Kordofan, whose religious figure, the kujur, called ta musla in the Kadugli language, was held to be seized by a spirit and led the rites known as sibir.
zh: 穆萨拉教是苏丹南科尔多凡努巴山区的信仰，其宗教人物称为库朱尔，卡杜格利语叫“塔穆斯拉”，人们认为他被神灵附身，主持称为“西比尔”的仪式。

en: Naa-wuni is followed by the Mamprusi of Mamprugu in northern Ghana, a kingdom founded around the 1200s by Naa Gbewaa at Pusiga, where his tomb remains the ancestral home they revere; most Mamprusi began turning to Islam in the 1600s through Dyula merchants.
zh: 纳乌尼信仰为加纳北部曼普鲁古的曼普鲁西人所奉行；曼普鲁古王国约在13世纪由纳·格贝瓦在普西加建立，他的陵墓所在之地是曼普鲁西人崇敬的祖地；多数曼普鲁西人从17世纪起经迪尤拉商人开始转信伊斯兰教。

en:
The Nacuco religion is followed by the Pijao, a loose federation of chiefdoms in the Andes of what is now Tolima, Colombia. The Pijao held the stars, weather, waters, plants and living things to be sacred parts of one divine whole, which human actions could upset. Rituals kept the balance, with offerings that ranged from chicha to human blood, and with idols of gold, clay or wood painted in many colors.

Their priests, the mohanes, fasted before sacred ceremonies, while the tegua cured the sick. The bodies of caciques and mohanes were mummified so that the people could come to worship at them. The Pijao fought the Spanish for generations before they were overcome.
zh:
纳库科信仰为皮豪人所奉行。皮豪人是今哥伦比亚托利马一带安第斯山中松散的酋邦联盟。他们认为星辰、天气、水源、植物和生灵都是同一个神圣整体的组成部分，人的行为会扰乱这个整体。人们靠仪式维持平衡，祭品从奇恰酒到人血不等，还制作涂着各种颜色的金、陶或木制神像。

祭司莫汉在神圣仪式之前要斋戒，称为特瓜的人则负责治病。酋长和莫汉的遗体会被制成木乃伊，让人们前来膜拜。皮豪人与西班牙人交战了许多代，最终才被征服。

en:
The Naga religion is held by the many hill tribes known together as the Naga, who live between Assam, the Manipur valley and the upper Chindwin. They venerated natural elements such as the sun, moon, trees and stones, and believed in a Supreme Being and lesser spirits tied to nature, which they appeased with rituals and sacrifices.

Folk songs and dances belonged to festivals and religious occasions, and headhunting and intertribal raiding were part of the old order. American Baptist missionaries introduced Christianity to the Naga Hills in the mid-nineteenth century, and the British tried in the same century to abolish headhunting; the missionaries opposed the old songs, which they linked with spirit worship, war and immorality.
zh:
那加泛灵论为统称为那加的众多山地部落所奉行，他们分布在阿萨姆、曼尼普尔河谷和亲敦江上游之间。他们敬奉太阳、月亮、树木和石头等自然之物，相信有一位至上神和与自然相连的诸多小神灵，用仪式和牲祭来安抚它们。

民歌和舞蹈属于节庆和宗教场合，猎头和部落间劫掠是旧秩序的一部分。19世纪中叶美国浸礼会传教士把基督教传入那加山区，同一世纪英国人也试图废止猎头；传教士反对旧的歌曲，认为它们与崇拜神灵、战争和不道德有关。

en:
Nahua religion is best known through the Aztecs, who saw the world through teotl, the sacred power that takes form in many gods. Huitzilopochtli was the god of the Mexica and Tlaloc the rain god. Festivals, government and even war were timed by the calendar.

Temples were stepped pyramids buried under a new layer every 52 years. At Tenochtitlan the Great Temple carried twin shrines of Huitzilopochtli and Tlaloc, and the high priests of both bore the title Quetzalcoatl.

Tenochtitlan was founded in 1325; in 1519–1521 Cortés and his Tlaxcaltec allies overthrew the Aztec empire, and in 1524 twelve Franciscans arrived to begin the systematic conversion of the Nahuas. The old beliefs live on in Catholic forms in the cult of the Virgin of Guadalupe and the Day of the Dead.
zh:
纳瓦人的宗教以阿兹特克人最为人所知，他们透过“特奥特尔”这种神圣力量来看待世界，这种力量化为众多神祇。墨西加人的神是维齐洛波奇特利，雨神是特拉洛克。节庆、政务乃至战争都依历法择期。

神庙是层层垒起的金字塔，每隔52年就在外面加盖一层。特诺奇蒂特兰的大神庙上并列着维齐洛波奇特利和特拉洛克的神殿，两位大祭司的头衔都是魁札尔·科亚特尔。

特诺奇蒂特兰建于1325年；1519—1521年，科尔特斯和特拉斯卡拉盟友推翻了阿兹特克帝国，1524年十二名方济各会士抵达，开始系统地使纳瓦人皈依基督教。旧日信仰以天主教的形式留存下来，见于对瓜达卢佩圣母的崇拜和亡灵节。

official_raw.en: The religion of the $nahua_group$, in which the many $nahuatl_god_name$ or gods are organized under the supreme god Ōmeteōtl. Many other gods, like $huitzilopochtli_god$, $tlaloc_god$, or $quetzalcoatl_god$ are commonly adopted as patron of estates or peoples. One of its key practices is that of human sacrifice, performed in honor of the gods and a necessity to keep their favor.
official_raw.zh: 纳瓦特尔宗教是$nahua_group$人的信仰，其众多$nahuatl_god_name$（意为神祇）在至高神奥梅特奥特的统领下组织起来。其他神祇，如$huitzilopochtli_god$、$tlaloc_god$或$quetzalcoatl_god$，常被选为领地或民族的守护神。其关键实践之一是献祭，以向神祇表示敬意并保持他们的眷顾。

en: The Nallagdigua belief is that of the Mocoví, or Moqoit, a Guaycuru people of the Gran Chaco who lived by hunting, fishing and gathering and who pictured the cosmos as divided into layers. Jesuit missionaries founded the San Javier reduction for them in 1743.
zh: 纳拉迪瓜信仰属于大查科地区的瓜伊库鲁人莫科维人（莫科维即莫科伊特人），他们靠狩猎、捕鱼和采集为生，认为宇宙分成若干层。1743年耶稣会传教士为他们建立了圣哈维尔归化区。

en:
Ñamandú, the First, is the supreme being in the cosmology of the Guaraní, kept above all by the Mbyá of Guairá in present-day Paraguay. He is invisible, eternal and all-powerful, and dwells in the Eternal Home; his opposite is Añá, the principle of evil.

Ñamandú engendered himself like a tree, and from his heart came the light that dissolved the darkness. With Karai, lord of fire, and Tupã, ruler of water and thunder, he shaped the earth and the first people. Twin boys, raised by jaguars after their mother died, reached the Eternal Home and became the Sun and the Moon.

In 1610 the Jesuits founded Loreto on the Paranapanema, the first mission of Guayrá. In time the missions gathered more than 100,000 Guaraní.
zh:
尼亚曼杜意为“最初者”，是瓜拉尼人宇宙观里的至高存在，其神话主要由今巴拉圭瓜伊拉地区的姆比亚瓜拉尼人保存。他无形无相，永恒而全能，居住在永恒居所；与他对立的是代表邪恶本原的阿尼亚。

尼亚曼杜像一棵树那样自己生出自己，他的心中放出光芒，驱散了黑暗。他召来火神卡拉伊和掌管水与雷的图帕，一同造出大地和最初的人类。一对孪生男孩，母亲死后由美洲豹抚养，最终进入永恒居所，成为太阳和月亮。

1610年，耶稣会在帕拉纳帕内马河畔建立洛雷托，这是瓜伊拉的第一个传教区。此后各传教区先后聚集了十万以上的瓜拉尼人。

en:
Naoma is the religion of the Tairona, a group of Chibchan chiefdoms of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta on Colombia’s Caribbean coast, who built stone-terraced towns such as Teyuna, called Ciudad Perdida. Little is written of their faith itself.

After the Spanish founded Santa Marta in 1525 the Tairona fought them for decades, and by 1600 the survivors had retreated to the high mountains. Their descendants, the Kogi, Wiwa, Arhuaco and Kankuamo, are believed to have kept much of the old tradition. The Kogi speak of a creator, the Great Mother, whose thoughts, the aluna, came before the world. Their priests, the mamos, are trained from early childhood in isolation.
zh:
纳奥玛教是泰罗纳人的宗教。泰罗纳是哥伦比亚加勒比海岸圣玛尔塔雪山上的一批奇布查语酋长邦，他们建起了特尤纳（后称迷城）等石砌台地城镇。关于他们信仰本身的文字记载很少。

1525年西班牙人建立圣玛尔塔之后，泰罗纳人与他们作战数十年，到1600年幸存者退入高山。他们的后裔科吉人、威瓦人、阿鲁阿科人和坎库阿莫人被认为保留了大量旧传统。科吉人讲述的创世者是大母神，她的思想“阿卢纳”先于世界存在。他们的祭司马莫，从幼年起就要在与世隔绝的环境中接受训练。

en: The Natugu belief belongs to the Natugu-speaking people of Nendo, also called Santa Cruz, in the Solomon Islands. The name of the language means our language.
zh: 纳图古泛灵论属于所罗门群岛嫩德岛（又称圣克鲁斯岛）上说纳图古语的居民。纳图古在当地语言中的意思就是“我们的语言”。

en:
Naurus is the belief of the Manusela and Nuaulu peoples of Seram in the Moluccas, a syncretic faith in which Hindu elements are mixed into the native religion of the island. They are said to have come from the Hindu kingdom of Butuan on Mindanao in the distant past, and the followers call themselves Hindus.

Its deities may include names taken from the Ramayana, Rabie (Rama) and Hainuwele (Hanuman), together with the naga, although Rabie and Hainuwele, the Coconut Girl, are better seen as native mythical figures. The highest god is called Allahatala.
zh:
诺茹派是马鲁古塞兰岛上马努塞拉人和努奥鲁人的信仰，是在岛上本土宗教里混入印度教因素的混合信仰。据说这些因素在遥远的过去来自棉兰老岛上的武端印度教王国，信徒自称印度教徒。

它的神灵可能包括取自《罗摩衍那》的名字，如拉比（罗摩）和海努韦莱（哈奴曼），还有那伽；不过拉比和被称为“椰子少女”的海努韦莱，更应当视为本地神话中的人物。最高神名为安拉塔拉。

en:
Naylamp is the founding hero of the Lambayeque, or Sican, people of Peru’s north coast, known from a Spanish chronicle written in 1586. In the tale he arrived by sea from the south on a raft with his wife and a retinue. He landed on the coast, built a temple called Chot and set up a green jade idol, Yampallec, in his own likeness.

Naylamp founded a dynasty of twelve rulers. At his death his sons said that he had sprouted wings and flown away.

The last king, Fempallec, tried to move the idol, and a thirty-day flood and then drought and famine followed. The priests blamed him and threw him into the sea. The valley broke into small lordships, and the Chimú conquered it in the late fourteenth century.
zh:
纳扬普是秘鲁北部海岸兰巴耶克人，即锡坎人的建国英雄，传说见于1586年写成的一部西班牙编年史。故事里，他从南方乘筏出海而来，随行有妻子和一批随从。他在海岸登陆，建起名为乔特的神庙，供奉一尊与他形貌相同的绿玉神像扬帕列克。

纳扬普建立了一个共十二位统治者的王朝。他死时，儿子们说他长出了翅膀，飞走了。

最后一位国王费姆帕列克想移走神像，随后便有持续30天的洪水，以及干旱和饥荒。祭司们归咎于他，把他投入大海。山谷由此分裂为许多小领地，14世纪晚期奇穆人征服了这里。

en: The Nduke belief belongs to the people of south-western Kolombangara in the New Georgia Islands of the Solomon Islands, who speak the Duke language and call themselves Dughore. Their oral history says the other peoples of the island were destroyed in warfare, probably in the early nineteenth century, while the south-western people survived in hill fortresses.
zh: 恩杜克泛灵论属于所罗门群岛新乔治亚群岛中科隆班加拉岛西南部的居民，他们说杜克语，自称杜格雷。口述历史说，岛上其他民族在战争中被消灭，时间大概在19世纪初，而西南部的人靠修建山地堡垒活了下来。

en:
Nestorianism is the name usually given to the Church of the East. Its namesake Nestorius was Patriarch of Constantinople; after the Council of Ephesus condemned his teaching in 431, the church of the Sasanian Persian empire held to it, and its patriarchs sat at Seleucia-Ctesiphon, later at Baghdad.

Its liturgy was in Aramaic, and it grew under the caliphs. Patriarch Timothy I, who held office from 780 to 823, appointed metropolitans for the Turks of Central Asia, for China and for India.

The church then shrank. Timur's persecutions after 1370 wiped out Christianity in Central Asia, leaving the church in the mountains of Kurdistan and with the Saint Thomas Christians of Malabar. In the seventeenth century its two patriarchal lines broke off their dealings with Rome.
zh:
聂斯脱里派是对东方教会的通称。它的得名者聂斯脱里曾任君士坦丁堡牧首；431年以弗所会议谴责他的主张之后，萨珊波斯的教会仍坚持这一教义，其牧首驻在塞琉西亚—泰西封，后来驻巴格达。

它的礼仪用阿拉米语，在哈里发治下发展壮大。牧首提摩太一世在位于780至823年，曾为中亚的突厥人、中国和印度任命都主教。

此后教会衰落。1370年以后，帖木儿的迫害使基督教在中亚绝迹，教会只留存于库尔德斯坦的山区和马拉巴尔的圣多马基督徒之中。17世纪，它的两支牧首世系先后断绝了与罗马的往来。

official_raw.en: $nestorianism$, named after Nestorius, teaches that Christ's divine and human natures are distinct and exist side by side. This doctrine was rejected by the Council of Ephesus but found a strong following in Persia and beyond. Nestorian Christians spread their faith across $asia$, becoming the largest $christian_ADJ$ religion in land area covered.
official_raw.zh: $nestorianism$以聂斯脱里命名，教导基督的神性与人性是完全分离的，并存于一体。这一教义被以弗所大公会议拒绝，但在波斯及其他地区找到了强大的追随者。聂斯脱里派基督徒将其信仰传播至$asia$，成为覆盖地域最广的$christian_ADJ$宗教。

en:
The traditional religion of the Achang, Tibeto-Burman people of western Yunnan descended from Qiang tribes, varied from place to place. In the Lianghe district they kept a primal belief in the spirits of all things, while the Achang of Husa took up Theravada Buddhism.

The heart of the old belief is the creation epic Zhepama and Zhemima, in which the first ancestors spin the heavens, weave the earth and make human beings, then outwit the demon king Lahong. They are the highest of the kind gods. At the Wo Luo festival people honour the ancestors with sacrifices, songs of the epic and dancing.

At a Buddhist funeral the monk leads the soul along a cloth tape tied to the coffin. Nothing metal is buried, since metal is thought to taint the soul.
zh:
阿昌人是滇西的藏缅语族民族，源出氐羌部落。他们的传统信仰各地不同：梁河一带保留着万物有灵的原始信仰，户撒的阿昌人则接受了上座部佛教。

旧信仰的核心是创世史诗《遮帕麻和遮咪麻》。诗里的始祖造天织地，创造人类，又智斗魔王腊訇。他们是最受崇拜的善神。窝罗节上，人们献祭祖先，唱诵史诗，跳舞聚会。

佛教葬礼上，僧人引导亡魂沿着系在棺木上的布带前行。入葬时不放任何金属物品，因为金属被认为会玷污灵魂。

en: The Ngbandi, the river people of the upper Ubangi, follow an animist belief in which seniority within the family and clan shapes religious as well as social life. A serpent cult is recorded among them.
zh: 恩本迪人是乌班吉河上游的河畔居民，他们信奉泛灵信仰，家庭和氏族中的长幼次序同时左右着宗教生活和社会生活。他们当中还有关于蛇崇拜的记载。

en:
N'haala is the traditional religion of the Balanta of Guinea-Bissau, rice farmers who by archaeologists' reckoning came to the coast in small groups between the 900s and 1300s. Their name is Mandinka for those who resist, and they kept to egalitarian villages governed by councils of elders, whose members were initiated at the Fanado ceremony.

In Balanta belief God is far away, and people reach the divine through their own spiritual practices, sacrifice and the worship of spirits such as Djon Cago. In the 1800s they spread across the region to resist the expansion of the Mandinka kingdom of Kaabu.
zh:
纳阿拉信仰是几内亚比绍巴兰塔人的传统宗教。巴兰塔人是稻农，据考古学家推算，他们在10至14世纪间分批小群来到海岸。他们的名字在曼丁卡语中意为“抗拒者”，一直生活在平等的村落里，由长老会议治理，长老须在法纳多仪式上入会。

巴兰塔人认为神远在天边，人们通过自己的灵性实践、献祭和对琼·卡戈等灵的崇拜与神灵相通。19世纪，他们散布到各地，以抵抗曼丁卡人的卡布王国扩张。

en:
The Nicobarese religion is the traditional animism of the people of the Nicobar Islands, a chain in the Bay of Bengal north of Sumatra. They believe in spirits, ghosts and the soul: when a person dies the soul leaves the body and becomes a ghost. Spirits are blamed for every misfortune, and shamans are called in to deal with the bad ones.

Painted sculptures carry the myth of Nicobarese origins and represent the spirits of living beings, natural elements and even everyday objects. In the houses, the spirits of the family's ancestors live in the sculptures.

The Danish East India Company began European colonisation of the islands in 1754. Moravian missionaries from Tranquebar who tried to settle on Nancowry died in great numbers of disease.
zh:
尼科巴泛灵论是尼科巴群岛居民的传统万物有灵信仰。尼科巴群岛位于孟加拉湾、苏门答腊以北。他们相信有精灵、鬼魂和灵魂：人死后灵魂离开身体，变成鬼魂。一切不幸都被归咎于精灵，遇到恶灵作祟，就请萨满来处置。

彩绘雕像承载着尼科巴人的起源神话，代表生灵、自然元素乃至日常器物的精灵。家中的雕像里住着本家祖先的灵。

1754年，丹麦东印度公司开始在群岛上进行欧洲人的殖民。从特兰奎巴前来、试图在楠考里岛定居的摩拉维亚教会传教士，大批死于疾病。

en:
In Norse paganism the Æsir and the Vanir, after a war, found they were equally powerful. Missionary pressure mounted from the ninth century, and Haakon Sigurdsson's rule in Norway (975–995) made paganism almost a state ideology until Olaf Tryggvason forced the nobility to convert. In about 1000 Iceland accepted Christian law at the Althing, with concessions to the old faith. Sweden was officially Christian by the twelfth century.

By 1337 the religion survived only in folklore. Its myths had been written down by Christians in Old Norse works of the thirteenth century.
zh:
诺斯多神教里，阿萨神族和华纳神族交战之后，发现彼此势均力敌。9世纪起，传教的压力不断增加：哈康·西居尔松在挪威统治期间（975—995年）使多神信仰几乎成了国家意识形态，直到奥拉夫·特里格瓦松强迫贵族改宗。约1000年，冰岛在阿尔庭通过了基督教法律，同时对旧信仰作出让步。瑞典到12世纪也已正式基督教化。

到1337年，这种宗教只留存在民间传说里。它的神话由基督徒写进13世纪的古诺尔斯语文献。

official_raw.en: The old religion of the $germanic_language_family$ of $scandinavian_region$, it includes a wide array of gods as the Æsir and Vanir, including the most famous Óðinn and Þórr. It considers the universe as nine different realms in the world tree Yggdrasill, of which Miðgarðr is the one in which humans live.
official_raw.zh: $scandinavian_region$半岛古日耳曼人的古老信仰，包含众多神祇，如阿萨神族与华纳神族，其中最著名的是奥丁与托尔。它认为宇宙由世界树尤格德拉希尔的九个不同领域组成，其中米德加尔特是人类居住之地。

en:
The Nu religion is the traditional animism of the Nu, a Tibeto-Burman people living in the deep gorges of the Nu (Salween), Dulong and upper Irrawaddy rivers in north-western Yunnan and Kachin State. Their beliefs held that the natural world was full of living powers.

Legend gave the Nu their rope bridges. A girl named A-Rong, watching a spider's web, devised a rope to cross the flooding river, and when a chieftain tried to force her into marriage she fled into the mountains and turned to stone in a cave; the flower-fairy festival in the third lunar month honours her.

The northern Nu took to Tibetan Buddhism, while most southern and central Nu kept their animist faith. French missionaries reached the south in the second half of the nineteenth century, and a minority became Christian.
zh:
怒族泛灵论是怒人的传统万物有灵信仰。怒人是藏缅语族民族，居住在怒江、独龙江和伊洛瓦底江上游的深山峡谷，分布在云南西北部和克钦邦；他们相信自然界充满有生命的力量。

传说怒人的溜索桥出自一位姑娘之手：阿茸看到蜘蛛网，想出用绳索渡过泛滥的怒江；有头人屡次逼她成婚，她逃入深山，在一个山洞里化作石像。三月的仙女节纪念的就是她。

北部怒人信奉藏传佛教，南部和中部的多数怒人保留了原有的泛灵信仰。19世纪后半叶法国传教士进入南部，少数人皈依基督教。

en:
Nuo is the exorcistic religion of central and southern China, most closely tied to the Tujia. Its roots go back to the old rite of driving out plague demons at the turn of the seasons, led in the Zhou dynasty by the fangxiangshi, an official in a bearskin with four golden eyes.

Its gods are shown as carved wooden masks. Mythology makes the highest pair Lord Nuo and Lady Nuo, the first two humans, who were unjustly beheaded and are worshipped as ancestors who answer prayers. Below them come the Taoist Three Pure Ones and then the Jade Emperor, whom the priests summon by blowing an ox horn.

Rites in nuo temples include dances, sacrifices and nuo theatre. They aim to strengthen the gods so that they can drive out evil beings.
zh:
傩教是中国中南部驱邪的信仰，与土家人关系最深。它的源头是古时在节令更替之际驱逐疫鬼的仪式；周代由方相氏主持，方相氏披熊皮，戴黄金四目。

傩教的神灵以木雕面具为像。神话里最高的一对神是傩公和傩婆，他们是最初的两个人，被冤杀斩首，后来作为有求必应的祖先受人祭拜。其下是道教三清，再下是玉帝，巫师吹牛角号召请他。

仪式在傩庙举行，包括傩舞、傩祭和傩戏。其目的是增强诸神的力量，让他们驱赶恶灵。

en:
Nyama names the spiritual power that the Mandé-speaking peoples of West Africa believe to exist in nature and in every living thing. They guard and use it through initiation associations such as Chiwara and Dwo, which even Muslim Mandinka kept, and through masks, which the Dogon say were made to hold the nyama released by a death.

Many Mandé peoples had been Muslim since the 1200s, but groups such as the Bobo kept their older beliefs entire, and the Bambara did not convert until the 1800s. Around Djenné-Djenno, ancestral cults flourished among the Soninke-related peoples.
zh:
恩亚马指曼德语诸族相信存在于自然界和一切生灵中的灵力。他们靠奇瓦拉、多沃这样的入会社团来守护和驾驭它，连穆斯林曼丁卡人也保留着这些社团；多贡人还说，面具就是为了承载死亡释放出的恩亚马而造的。

许多曼德人自13世纪起就是穆斯林，但博博人等群体完整保留着更古老的信仰，班巴拉人直到19世纪才皈依。杰内-杰诺一带的索宁凯相关族群中，祖先崇拜也很兴盛。

en:
Nyang Serai is the traditional faith of the Rejang, the rice farmers of the Barisan highlands in southwestern Sumatra. It is named for its best-known figure, the goddess of rice and fertility, whom the Rejang saw as their own version of the Javanese goddess Dewi Sri. Her worshippers offered sacrificial animals and incense.

At the great feast, the kedurai agung, the Rejang raised the punjung, a pile of produce that stood for a mountain, Mount Kaba, and prayed on its slopes. Feared spirits called smat lived in particular places, so people asked their leave before entering or taking anything from nature. The tiger was treated as an ancestor.

Islam arrived from Banten, Aceh and the Minangkabau lands from about the sixteenth century. The Rejang converted later than most of their neighbors.
zh:
娘瑟莱泛灵论是勒姜人的传统信仰。勒姜人是苏门答腊西南部巴里桑高地的稻农。这一信仰得名于其中最著名的神灵，也就是稻谷与丰产女神，勒姜人把她看作爪哇稻谷女神戴维诗丽的本地版本。信徒向她献上祭牲和焚香。

在盛大的节庆“克杜赖·阿贡”上，勒姜人堆起象征卡巴山的“蓬崇”，并在其山坡上祈祷。令人敬畏的精灵称为斯马特，居住在特定的地方，所以进入或从自然中取物之前要先请求允许。老虎则被当作祖先看待。

伊斯兰教大约从16世纪起自万丹、亚齐和米南加保传入。勒姜人改宗的时间比多数邻族要晚。

en:
Nyasaye is the traditional faith of the peoples around the Winam Gulf of Lake Victoria in what is now western Kenya, and the word is the name of God among the Luo and the Gusii. The Luo, who moved into the region from about 1490, saw Nyasaye as the creator and called him Obong'o Nyakalaga, the one of a kind and all powerful. Neighbouring Luhya speakers used a similar word, though their high god was also called Wele.

Beside the high god, people traditionally honoured ancestral spirits and spirits tied to rain, healing and misfortune. Diviners mediated with the spirit world, and among the Luo it was the diviner who crowned a chief.
zh:
尼亚萨耶教是今肯尼亚西部维多利亚湖温纳姆湾一带各族的传统信仰，尼亚萨耶一词在卢奥人和古西人那里就是神的名字。卢奥人约从1490年起迁入这一地区，把尼亚萨耶看作创世者，称他为奥邦奥·尼亚卡拉加，意为独一无二、全能者。邻近说卢亚语的各族也用相近的词，不过他们的至高神也被称为韦莱。

除至高神之外，人们传统上还敬奉祖先的灵，以及与降雨、治病、灾祸有关的各种灵。占卜师在人与灵界之间沟通，在卢奥人当中，酋长要由占卜师加冕。

en: Nyesoa is the creator god of the Kru peoples of the Liberian coast, as the early missionaries recorded. Beneath him the world was filled with territorial spirits, family guardians and the souls of the dead, who stayed close by and could influence events. Trained practitioners called deya treated illness and spiritual trouble with medicines and rites.
zh: 尼亚索阿是利比里亚海岸克鲁人的创世神，早期传教士这样记载。在他之下，世间充满地域之灵、家庭守护灵和留在近处、能左右事态的亡魂。经过专门训练的德亚用药物和仪式处理疾病与灵界的麻烦。

en:
Obian Shamanism is the traditional faith of the Ob-Ugric peoples, the Khanty and the Mansi, who lived along the Ob and its tributaries in western Siberia, the land the Russians called Yugra. Torum was the sky god; in a song of the Khanty, he sent his son to rule the earth, but the son forgot his father's advice, lost his immortality, turned into a beast and was killed by hunters.

The bear was the centre of the ritual year. After a successful bear hunt the people held a celebration lasting five or six days, with songs, dances and plays.

In the fifteenth century the Khanty princedoms were partly included in the Siberian Khanate. At the end of the sixteenth century Russia, led by the Cossack Yermak, set out to conquer the region.
zh:
鄂毕萨满教是鄂毕—乌戈尔语民族汉特人和曼西人的传统信仰；他们生活在西西伯利亚的鄂毕河及其支流沿岸，俄罗斯人称这片土地为尤格拉。托鲁姆是天神；在汉特人的一首歌里，他派儿子去统治大地，儿子却忘了父亲的告诫，失去了不死之身，变成野兽，被猎人杀死。

熊是一年祭祀的中心。猎熊成功之后要举行庆典，持续五六天，其间有歌、舞和戏剧。

15世纪，汉特人的几个公国一部分并入西伯利亚汗国。16世纪末，俄罗斯在哥萨克叶尔马克带领下着手征服这一地区。

en:
Odinala, also called Omenala or Odinani, is the traditional religion and customary law of the Igbo of southeastern Nigeria, and the kingdom of Nri in the northern Igbo heartland was its ritual centre. The supreme god Chukwu stands over lesser spirits, whose demands diviners called dibia learn through afa divination.

Ancestors are held to guard their lineages from the spirit world, and some return by reincarnation within the family. The priest-kings of Nri, the Eze Nri, were said to descend from the sky being Eri, and they spread their authority over roughly a quarter of Igboland by sending out converts who bound communities by ritual oath rather than by force.

Nri's influence lasted into the 1500s. It then waned from the 1700s as Benin and Igala rose and the Atlantic slave trade grew.
zh:
奥迪纳拉教又称奥梅纳拉，是尼日利亚东南部伊博人的传统宗教和习惯法，北部伊博腹地的恩里王国是它的仪式中心。至高神丘库之下是较小的神灵，祭司迪比亚通过阿法占卜得知他们的意旨。

人们认为祖先在灵界守护自己的世系，有的还会在家族中转世。恩里的祭司王埃泽·恩里据说是天降之人埃里的后裔，他派出皈依者，以仪式性的誓约而非武力把各社群联结起来，势力遍及伊博地区约四分之一。

恩里的影响一直持续到16世纪。18世纪起，随着贝宁和伊加拉的崛起以及大西洋奴隶贸易的扩大而衰落。

en:
The Omo religion stands for the traditional beliefs of the agro-pastoral peoples of the lower Omo valley in southern Ethiopia, such as the Mursi and the Hamar. Among the Mursi, a power greater than themselves, called Tumwi, is located in the sky. An inherited priest, the komoru, speaks for the community to Tumwi and performs public rites to bring rain and to guard people, cattle and crops from disease and raiders.

The Hamar have two ritual leaders, the bitta, who oversee spiritual matters without holding political power. Purity matters greatly to them and their neighbours: a person or child judged mingi, ritually polluted, was cast out from the community.
zh:
奥莫信仰指埃塞俄比亚南部奥莫河下游农牧民的传统信仰，例如穆尔西人和哈马尔人的信仰。穆尔西人相信有一种比自身更强大的力量，名为图姆维，位于天上。世袭的祭司科莫鲁代表群体与图姆维沟通，主持公开仪式求雨，保护人、牛和庄稼免受疾病和袭击。

哈马尔人有两位仪式领袖比塔，他们主管精神事务，不掌政治权力。洁净对他们和邻近族群都很重要：被认定为明吉、即仪式上受污染的人或孩子，会被逐出群体。

en:
The Orang Asli religion is the animism of the indigenous peoples of the Malay Peninsula, best described among the northern Semang. They hold that people and all natural things have souls, and picture the earth as a disc resting on a huge snake or turtle and joined to the sky by stone pillars.

The chief god of the Semang, the thunder god Karey, is cruel rather than loved, and punishes those who break taboos with lightning or illness. Each group has a shaman, the hala, who in trance speaks with the spirits and heals with herbs; the greatest halas are said to turn into tigers.

In the early 1500s the Aceh sultanate sent expeditions to seize slaves. In the 1700s and 1800s Minangkabau and Batak raiders sacked Orang Asli villages.
zh:
阿斯里泛灵论是马来半岛土著各族的万物有灵信仰，在北部的塞芒人当中记载得最为详细。他们认为人和一切自然之物都有灵魂，设想大地是一块圆盘，浮在一条巨蛇或一只巨龟之上，并以石柱与天空相连。

塞芒人的主神是雷神卡雷，他不受人爱戴，人们只是畏惧他的残酷；有人违犯禁忌，他就降下雷击或疾病来惩罚。每个群体都有一位称为哈拉的萨满，他在入迷状态中与诸灵交谈，用草药治病；最有本事的哈拉据说能变成老虎。

1500年代初，亚齐苏丹国派出远征队掳掠奴隶。到了1700年代和1800年代，米南佳保人和巴达克人的武装又接连洗劫阿斯里人的村寨。

en:
The Orang Laut, the ‘sea peoples’, were the boat-dwelling fishers and traders of the Riau Islands, the Strait of Singapore and the coasts of eastern Sumatra and the southern Malay Peninsula. Their traditional belief was the worship of spirits said to live in trees, water, rocks and caves.

Under Srivijaya, Malacca and Johor the Orang Laut patrolled the straits and guided traders to their rulers’ ports. When the last Malacca-Johor sultan was killed in 1699 they refused to accept the Bendahara family that took the throne, and the Bugis later replaced them as guardians of the straits. Many were drawn into the Malay world and Islam, but some groups, such as the Seletar, kept their old beliefs long afterwards.
zh:
罗越人意为“海上之民”，是廖内群岛、新加坡海峡以及苏门答腊东岸和马来半岛南部沿海一带以船为家的渔民和商人。他们的传统信仰是崇拜据说栖居在树木、水中、岩石和洞穴里的精灵。

在室利佛逝、马六甲和柔佛治下，罗越人巡守海峡，并把往来的商人引向统治者的港口。1699年马六甲—柔佛的末代苏丹被杀，罗越人拒绝承认继位的本达哈拉家族；后来布吉人取代他们成为海峡的守卫者。许多罗越人后来被吸纳进马来世界并接受了伊斯兰教，但也有一些群体，如实里达人，仍长久保留着旧有的信仰。

en: The Orang Rimba religion is the animist faith of the ‘people of the forest’, a small nomadic people of the lowland rainforests of Jambi and South Sumatra, known to the Malays as the Kubu. Traditionally they moved camp far away after a death, leaving the place of mourning behind.
zh: 库布泛灵论是“森林之民”的泛灵信仰。森林之民是栖居于占碑和南苏门答腊低地雨林的一个小型游猎民族，马来人称他们为库布人。传统上，营地里有人去世，他们就会迁到很远的地方，把哀伤之地留在身后。

en:
Ori religion is the ancestor-centred belief of the Madi and the closely related Lugbara, who live in the West Nile lands on the Sudan, Uganda and Congo borders. In the Lugbara record, ori are the ghosts of the patrilineal dead, who are traditionally believed to send sickness to the living when quarrels are left unresolved. A sick person is then assigned an animal, usually a sheep, which is killed after recovery, and its meat is placed at the dead ancestors' shrines before the lineage shares the rest.

Above the ancestors stands the creator god Adroa, a distant sky god, who is also thought to have an earthly aspect. Diviners, oracles and rainmakers served as intermediaries.
zh:
奥里祖灵崇拜是马迪人及与其关系密切的卢格巴拉人以祖先为中心的信仰，他们生活在苏丹、乌干达和刚果边界的西尼罗一带。据卢格巴拉人的记载，奥里是父系亡者的鬼魂，传统上认为争执未能化解时，他们会让活人生病。这时要为病人指定一头牲畜，通常是绵羊，病愈后宰杀，把肉放在祖先的神龛前，其余由世系群共享。

祖灵之上是创造神阿德罗阿，他是遥远的天神，也被认为有人间的一面。占卜师、神谕者和祈雨师充当沟通的中介。

en:
The Orthodox churches are self-governing, each ruled by its bishops in synod. Unlike the pope, the Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople has no authority over the others. They hold to the decrees of the seven ecumenical councils and the teaching of the Church Fathers, and parted from Rome in the schism of 1054. Mysticism was strong among the monks of Mount Athos, whose practice of hesychasm was defended by Gregory Palamas.

In 1337 Orthodoxy was the faith of Byzantium, Serbia, Bulgaria, Georgia, Wallachia and the Russian principalities. The union with Rome agreed at the Council of Florence in 1439 was rejected by most clergy and people in Constantinople, and the city fell to the Ottomans in 1453.
zh:
东正教的各教会实行自治，每个教会由其主教在会议中治理。与教宗不同，君士坦丁堡普世牧首对其他教会没有统辖权。各教会遵奉七次大公会议的决议和教父的教导，并在1054年的大分裂中与罗马分手。阿陀斯山的修士中神秘主义尤其浓厚，他们修行的静修主义由格里高利·帕拉马加以捍卫。

1337年，拜占庭、塞尔维亚、保加利亚、格鲁吉亚、瓦拉几亚和俄罗斯诸公国都信奉东正教。1439年佛罗伦萨会议上达成的与罗马的合一，被君士坦丁堡的大多数神职人员和民众拒绝，该城在1453年陷于奥斯曼人之手。

official_raw.en: The $orthodox_ADJ$ Church, rooted in the traditions of the early $christian_ADJ$ councils, emphasizes the continuity of apostolic teachings and sacred tradition. Centered on the $BYZ_ADJ$ Rite, it places great importance on liturgy, icons, and mysticism. The $orthodox_ADJ$ faith is led by patriarchs, with the Ecumenical Patriarch of Constantinople holding a primacy of honor.
official_raw.zh: $orthodox_ADJ$教会根植于$christian_ADJ$早期大公会议的传统，强调使徒教导与神圣传统的连续性。以$BYZ_ADJ$仪规为中心，$orthodox_ADJ$极为重视礼仪、圣像与神秘主义。$orthodox_ADJ$信仰由牧首领导，君士坦丁堡普世牧首享有荣誉上的首席地位。

en:
Pabichu is the name the game gives to the traditional religion of the Chiquitano, who call themselves Monkóx and live in the dry forests and savanna of the Chiquitania in eastern Bolivia. From 1692 Jesuit missions gathered them into mission towns, which lasted until the order was expelled in 1767.

Tradition gave each person three souls, of breath, blood and shadow. The shadow soul wandered in dreams and went to a paradise after death, though one that lingered had to be persuaded by a shaman to leave. Upayaretu, a giant rhea in the sky, guarded children, and eclipses of the moon, Pama Kuara, were dogs of the sky devouring it, so warriors shot arrows upward to drive them off.
zh:
帕比丘教是游戏对奇基托人传统信仰的称呼。奇基托人自称蒙科克斯，居住在玻利维亚东部奇基塔尼亚的干燥森林和稀树草原上。1692年起，耶稣会把他们集中到传教村镇里，这些村镇一直维持到1767年耶稣会士被逐出。

按传统，每个人有呼吸、血液和影子三个灵魂。影子之魂会在梦中游荡，人死后前往乐园，滞留不去的则要由萨满劝离。乌帕亚雷图是住在天上的巨型美洲鸵，守护孩子们；月亮名叫帕马·夸拉，月食被说成是天上的狗在吞吃它，战士们便向天空射箭把狗赶走。

en:
Puhagimism is the traditional shamanism of the Northern Paiute of the Great Basin. Its practitioner is the puhagim, a medicine man, and its central idea is puha, a power that gives life to the physical world and moves the elements, plants and animals alike.

To draw on this power the puhagim went to sacred places such as mountains, caves and waterways, where he cured the sick, made rain, and acted in war or sorcery. Illness was spiritual as well as bodily, and the shaman retrieved the soul of the sick, calling up power with a rattle, smoke and songs.

The creation tales were told by the elders around the winter fire. In one, the sagehen alone survives a flood and the Cannibal Nűműzóho then kills nearly all the people.
zh:
普哈吉萨满教是大盆地北派尤特人的传统萨满信仰。从事者称为普哈吉姆，即巫医；其核心观念是普哈，一种赋予物质世界以生命、推动元素、植物和动物运行的力量。

为了借用这种力量，普哈吉姆会前往山岭、洞穴和水道等圣地，在那里治病、求雨，也参与战争或施行巫术。疾病既是身体的，也是精神的，萨满要找回病人的灵魂，并借助响板、烟和歌曲唤来力量。

创世故事由长者在冬夜的篝火边讲述。其中一则说，一场洪水里只有艾草松鸡幸存，食人者努穆佐霍随后杀死了几乎所有人。

en:
The Palaung religion is the ethnic animism of the Palaung, who call themselves Ta'ang, an Austroasiatic people of the Shan highlands and the Yunnan frontier. It rests on a system of nature spirits called nats, which the Palaung honoured alongside the Buddhism most of them came to follow.

Palaung girls wear rattan hoops around the waist, and a legend explains them: in ancient times Palaung women could fly through the sky, until the men made rattan hoops and fitted them around the women's waists to keep them on the ground. Most Palaung followed Theravada Buddhism, and boys were sent to monasteries at the age of ten to learn the scriptures.
zh:
崩龙泛灵论是德昂人的民族传统信仰。德昂人自称塔昂，是掸邦高原和云南边境的南亚语系民族。这种信仰以称为“纳特”的自然神灵为基础，德昂人在后来多数改信佛教之后，仍与之并存。

德昂姑娘腰间戴藤篾腰箍，有一则传说解释了它的来历：古时德昂女子能在天空中飞舞，男人便用藤篾做成圈套在她们腰上，把她们留在地上。多数德昂人信奉南传上座部佛教，男孩到十岁便入寺为僧学习佛经。

en:
Paulicianism arose in Armenia in the seventh century and flourished on the frontier of the Byzantine Empire and the caliphate. Its founder was said to be Constantine of Mananalis, who founded his first congregation about 660 and was stoned to death twenty-seven years later. Byzantine writers also charged the Paulicians with rejecting the cross.

Persecution drove them to found a state around the fortress of Tephrike, whose leader Chrysocheres raided as far as Ephesus in 867. Basil I destroyed it by 878, and emperors then moved Paulicians to Thrace, where they lasted for centuries.

Under the Second Bulgarian Empire some Thracian Paulicians turned Orthodox. After the Ottoman conquest others became Muslims, and the rest were converted to Catholicism in the sixteenth or seventeenth century.
zh:
保禄派7世纪兴起于亚美尼亚，兴盛于拜占庭帝国与哈里发国的边境地带。传说其创始人是马纳纳利斯的君士坦丁，他约在660年建立了第一个会众团体，二十七年后被石头砸死。拜占庭作者还指责保禄派拒绝十字架。

迫害迫使他们围绕特弗里克要塞建立了一个国家，其首领克里索凯雷斯在867年一直劫掠到以弗所。巴西尔一世在878年前摧毁了它，此后皇帝们把保禄派迁往色雷斯，他们在那里延续了几个世纪。

在第二保加利亚帝国治下，一部分色雷斯的保禄派改宗东正教。奥斯曼人征服之后，另一些人成为穆斯林，其余的人在16或17世纪改宗天主教。

official_raw.en: $paulicianism$ is a dualist $christian_ADJ$ sect that rejects the material world as the creation of an evil force. Its followers hold that only the spiritual realm is pure and base their beliefs on the New Testament, rejecting the Old Testament entirely. Persecuted by both $catholic_ADJ$ and $orthodox_ADJ$ authorities, the $paulicianism_ADJ$ movement resisted assimilation and inspired later reformist movements.
official_raw.zh: $paulicianism$是一个二元论$christian_ADJ$派别，拒绝物质世界，认为其是邪恶力量的创造物。其信徒认为只有灵性领域是纯洁的，并基于新约建立其信仰，完全拒绝旧约。$paulicianism_ADJ$运动受到$catholic_ADJ$会与$orthodox_ADJ$会的迫害，但抵制了同化，并启发了后来的改革派运动。

en:
The Yurupari tradition belongs to the Tukano, Arawak and Maku peoples of the Vaupés basin in the Colombian and Brazilian Amazon. Its hero is the Son of the Sun, born to the virgin Ceucy, who conceived by eating a fruit.

Yurupari means the one who covers the mouth, because men keep the secrets of his religion. The name is Tupi, brought by missionaries who equated the figure with the Devil. He replaces the matriarchal laws of the world with the laws of the Sun.

His voice lives on in sacred flutes and trumpets of paxiúba palm, which women must not see. The central rite is a male initiation for boys of twelve to fifteen, when flutes roar with the voices of the ancestral Anaconda and Jaguar.
zh:
尤鲁帕里传统属于哥伦比亚与巴西亚马孙地区沃佩斯河流域的图卡诺人、阿拉瓦克人和马库人。传说的主角是太阳之子，母亲是处女塞乌西，她吃下一颗果子而受孕。

尤鲁帕里的意思是“捂住嘴的人”，因为男人要替他的宗教保守秘密。这个名字属于图皮语，由把这位神灵等同于魔鬼的传教士带来。他用太阳的律法取代世间母权制的旧法。

他的声音留存在用帕希乌巴棕榈制成的神圣长笛和号角里，女人不准看见。最核心的仪式是为十二至十五岁男孩举行的成年礼，仪式上笛声如祖先巨蟒和美洲豹的咆哮。

en:
The Mua Mua religion is that of the Pech, a Chibchan-speaking people of northeastern Honduras, who say they are the children of the lightning god Mua Mua. Lightning bolts are the spirits of the ancient men who rid the earth of the lizard-like Chaca-Chacay and of cannibal giants led by Takascró; the Pech sprang from them.

Mua Mua also fathered the god Patakako, conceived through white river foam as his mother washed clothes. With the rainbow god Piritakata, Patakako travelled to the end of the world, where four pillars hold up the universe.

He later climbed the nine levels of the sky to meet Kako, his nine-eyed counterpart. In the 1620s the Spanish gathered the Pech into mission towns, and Catholic faith replaced the old stories.
zh:
穆阿穆阿教属于洪都拉斯东北部讲奇布查语族语言的佩契人。他们自称是雷电之神穆阿穆阿的子孙。天上的闪电是远古人类的灵魂：这些人为大地清除了蜥蜴般的恰卡—恰凯和由塔卡斯克罗率领的食人巨人，佩契人便是由他们而生。

穆阿穆阿还是神帕塔卡科的父亲：帕塔卡科的母亲在河边洗衣时，河面的白色泡沫使她怀了孕。帕塔卡科与彩虹之神皮里塔卡塔一同走到世界的尽头，那里有四根柱子撑起宇宙。

他后来又登上九层天，去见自己在天上的对应者、长着九只眼睛的卡科。1620年代，西班牙人把佩契人集中到传教村镇中，天主教信仰取代了古老的故事。

en:
The Pelebegu religion is the traditional faith of the Batak peoples of North Sumatra, among them the Toba and Mandailing. The Toba believed that the first Batak descended from Si Raja Batak, whose family settled on Pusuk Buhit, a volcano by Lake Toba.

Its creator is Mula Jadi Na Bolon, ‘the beginning of becoming’, who lives in an upper world of seven levels. He received no sacrifices. Ritual centered instead on the tondi, the life-soul, and on the begu, the soul of the dead, which stayed near the village and had to be pacified with food and prayers.

Priests called datu healed the sick and foretold the future from the pustaha, a book of bark and wood. During the Minangkabau Padri wars of 1803—1837, the Mandailing Batak of the south were converted to Islam.
zh:
帕玛林教这里指苏门答腊北部巴塔克人的传统信仰，信徒包括托巴人和曼代林人。托巴人相信最早的巴塔克人是西·拉贾·巴塔克的后代，他的家族定居在多巴湖畔的火山普苏克·布希特。

创世神是“万物之始”穆拉·贾迪·纳·博隆，他居住在分为七层的上界，不受祭祀。仪式的重心在于生者的灵魂“通迪”，以及死者的灵魂“贝古”；贝古留在村子附近，要用食物和祷告来安抚。

称为达图的祭司为人治病，并用木皮制成的书“普斯塔哈”占卜未来。在米南加保的巴德里战争（1803—1837）期间，南部的曼代林巴塔克人被转为信奉伊斯兰教。

en:
Pengarap Asal, the original belief, is the traditional religion of the Iban, a Dayak people of western Borneo. Before expanding into what is now Sarawak, the Iban lived in the Kapuas basin; Benedict Sandin dated their move into the Batang Lupar valley to the 1550s, and they reached the Rejang in the early 1800s.

The Iban recognised a supreme being, Bunsu Petara, who had no parents and made the worlds, and seven lesser gods beneath him, including Sengalang Burong, god of war and healing. Omens decided much of life: the calls and flights of omen birds, which served Sengalang Burong, were read before a journey, raid or harvest.

Gawai Kenyalang, the Hornbill Festival, honoured Sengalang Burong and was held by successful raiders in the days of headhunting. Gawai Antu welcomed the souls of the dead.
zh:
阿萨尔信仰意为“原始的信仰”，是婆罗洲西部达雅克人中的伊班人的传统宗教。伊班人向今沙捞越扩张之前居住在卡普阿斯河流域；本尼迪克特·桑丁推算他们在1550年代迁入巴丹卢帕尔河谷，并在19世纪初到达拉让江流域。

伊班人承认一位无父无母、创造诸世界的至高神本苏·佩塔拉，其下有七位次级神明，包括主管战争与医治的森加朗·布隆。预兆左右着生活的许多方面：出门、出征和收获之前，人们要留意预兆鸟的鸣叫与飞行，这些鸟听命于森加朗·布隆。

犀鸟节（加外·克尼亚朗）敬奉森加朗·布隆，在猎头盛行的年代由出征得胜者举办。亡灵节（加外·安图）迎接死者的灵魂。

en:
Niparaya is the creator god of the Pericú, a seafaring people of the Cape Region at the southern tip of Baja California, whose lands ran from Todos Santos to La Paz. They lived on fish, shellfish and agave and never farmed or made pottery.

Fragments of their mythology were written down in the early 1730s. Niparaya was an all-powerful master who made heaven and earth. His wife was Amayicoyondi, and they had three sons. Quaayayp made the race of men and was later killed by them; Acaragui was the second.

Jesuit missions reached La Paz in 1720 and San José del Cabo in 1730. After the Pericú revolt of 1734 and a long toll of disease and fighting, the Pericú were culturally extinct by the time the Jesuits were expelled in 1768.
zh:
尼帕拉亚教是佩里库人对创世神尼帕拉亚的信仰。佩里库人是下加利福尼亚半岛南端海角地区的航海民族，领地从托多斯桑托斯延伸到拉巴斯。他们以鱼、贝类和龙舌兰为生，不务农，也不制陶。

他们的部分神话在18世纪30年代初被记录下来。尼帕拉亚是无所不能的主宰，创造了天与地。他的妻子叫阿马伊科永迪，两人生有三个儿子：夸亚伊普造出了人类，后来被人类杀死；第二个是阿卡拉吉。

耶稣会的传教站在1720年进入拉巴斯，1730年进入圣何塞德尔卡沃。1734年佩里库人起义之后，又经历了长期的疾病与战乱，到1768年耶稣会士被逐出时，佩里库人在文化上已经消亡。

en:
Pi is the game's name for the moon cult of the Andean highlands of what is now Ecuador, centred on Catequil, a god of thunder and water. In the Cayapa language pi means sacred water, and the springs and lakes where Catequil was thought to live were left untouched except during ritual.

Catequil was shown with a thunderbolt in his hand and the torso of a jaguar, and was tied to the waning moon. On such nights he was believed to release the animals in his care, and a man seeking leadership bathed in his spring in an initiation rite to win courage and fortune.

The Puruhá and the Caranqui kept lunar calendars. His cult spread north into Colombia and south to the Huamachuco of northern Peru, where he merged with the lightning god Illapa.
zh:
月神崇拜是游戏对今厄瓜多尔安第斯高地传统月神信仰的称呼，核心是雷电与水之神卡特基尔。在卡亚帕语里，“皮”意为圣水，卡特基尔据说居住的泉水和湖泊平时不许触碰，只在仪式中使用。

卡特基尔的形象是手持雷电、上身为美洲豹，与渐亏的月亮相连。据说在这样的夜晚，他会放出所看管的野兽；想要成为首领的人则在他的泉水中沐浴，通过成年仪式求取勇气与好运。

普鲁瓦人和卡兰基人使用太阴历。他的崇拜向北传入哥伦比亚，向南传到秘鲁北部的瓦马丘科人那里，并与雷电神伊利亚帕合流。

en:
Piil Pesenggiri is the code of honor of the Lampung people of southern Sumatra, who trace their origin to the kingdom of Sekala Brak under Mount Pesagi and later divided into the coastal Saibatin and the inland Pepadun. It makes pride, and a courage that never retreats from a challenge, the foundation of life.

Four further values go with it: juluk-adok, to live up to the customary title one bears; nemui-nyimah, to visit and receive guests generously; nengah-nyappur, to take an active part in the community; and sakai-sambayan, to help one another. The five are written in the Kuntara Raja Niti manuscript and symbolized by five flowers on the Lampung emblem.
zh:
