帕松吉里是苏门答腊南部楠榜人的荣誉准则。楠榜人追溯自己源出佩萨吉山下的色卡拉布拉克王国，后来分成沿海的赛巴廷人和内陆的佩帕敦人。这一准则以自尊和面对挑战绝不退缩的勇气为人生根基。

与之并列的还有四项价值：朱鲁克—阿多克，要与自己所享有的传统头衔相称；内穆伊—尼马赫，以慷慨好客的态度互相拜访、接待宾客；嫩加赫—尼亚普尔，积极参与群体生活；萨凯—桑巴扬，彼此互助。这五项载于《昆塔拉·拉贾·尼蒂》手稿，并以楠榜徽章上的五朵花作为象征。

en:
Kuksu was the religion of the Pomo, Patwin, Maidu and other peoples of Northern California, from the Sacramento Valley west to the Pacific coast. Its heart was a men’s secret society that met in underground dance rooms and appeared in costume at public dances, enacting spirit beings to secure health, good harvests, fertility and fair weather.

The Pomo told of Kuksu, a red-beaked supernatural being who lived in a sweathouse at the south end of the world and was a healer. The dancer who played him was often regarded as the medicine man.

Among the Patwin and Maidu a variant called Hesi admitted women. In the 1820s Spanish missionaries took many southern Pomo into the missions of San Rafael and Sonoma, and a smallpox epidemic from Fort Ross killed many in 1837.
zh:
库克苏是北加利福尼亚的波莫人、帕特温人、迈杜人等民族的宗教，分布范围从萨克拉门托河谷向西直到太平洋沿岸。它的核心是男子秘密社团，他们在地下舞室里聚会，并在公开的舞蹈中穿戴服饰出场，扮演诸灵，求取健康、丰收、生育和好天气。

波莫人讲述库克苏，一位红喙的超自然者，住在世界南端的发汗屋里，擅长治病。扮演他的舞者往往被视为巫医。

帕特温人和迈杜人中有一个称为赫西的支派，允许妇女参加。1820年代，西班牙传教士把许多南部的波莫人带进圣拉斐尔和索诺马的传教会；1837年，一场源自罗斯堡的天花疫情夺去了许多人的生命。

en:
Puntan religion is the traditional belief of the Chamorro of the Mariana Islands, named for one of the two creator siblings of their legend. As he lay dying, Puntan told his sister Fu'una to make his body into the world: his eyes became the sun and the moon, his eyebrows rainbows, his chest the sky.

Fu'una settled on the island of Guahan and turned herself into a giant rock, which split open and released all human beings. The ancient Chamorro venerated their ancestors but did not, it seems, worship gods in a formal religion.

In 1623 Christoph Carl Fernberger reported human sacrifice to placate a great fish. In 1672 the priest Diego Luis de San Vitores, who had baptised a child against its father's wishes, was killed together with his catechist Pedro Calungsod.
zh:
蓬坦崇拜是马里亚纳群岛查莫罗人的传统信仰，得名于他们传说中两位创世兄妹之一的蓬坦。蓬坦临终前吩咐妹妹富乌娜把他的身体造成世界：眼睛变成太阳和月亮，眉毛变成彩虹，胸膛变成天空。

富乌娜在瓜汉岛（今关岛）定居，把自己变成一块巨石，巨石裂开，放出了所有的人类。古代查莫罗人敬奉祖先，似乎并没有正式地崇拜神祇。

1623年，克里斯托夫·卡尔·费恩贝格尔记述说，他们用活人献祭来安抚一条大鱼。1672年，神父迭戈·路易斯·德·圣维托雷斯违背一位父亲的意愿给他的孩子施洗，随后同他的传教助手佩德罗·卡隆索德一起被杀。

en:
Qat religion is the traditional faith of Vanuatu, an animism built on mana, a transferable spiritual power, on tabu, and on the worship of ancestral spirits. Named figures varied by region: Qat in the Banks Islands, Tagaro on Ambae, Lisepsep across the archipelago.

Qat is the principal god of Banks Islands mythology. He was never formally worshipped, yet he was credited with the world itself, night, death and women. He carved the first men and women from dracaena wood and drummed them into life, and he cut through the night with a piece of red obsidian to make dawn.

His companion was the spider Marawa, and his eleven brothers were all named Tagaro. The Banks Islands were the first part of Vanuatu seen by a European, when Pedro Fernandez de Quiros sailed past in 1606.
zh:
喀特崇拜是瓦努阿图的传统信仰，属万物有灵论，建立在玛那（可以转移的灵力）、禁忌以及对祖先灵魂的崇拜之上。各地的神祇不同：班克斯群岛有喀特，安巴埃岛有塔加罗，利塞普塞普则见于整个群岛。

喀特是班克斯群岛神话里的主神。人们并未正式崇拜他，却把世界本身、黑夜、死亡和女人都归功于他。他用龙血树木头雕出第一批男女，再用击鼓使他们活过来，又用一片红色黑曜石划开黑夜，造出黎明。

他的伙伴是蜘蛛马拉瓦，他的十一个兄弟都叫塔加罗。班克斯群岛是瓦努阿图最早被欧洲人望见的地方：1606年，佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯的船队驶过这些岛屿。

en: The Rabha religion belongs to the Rabha, a Tibeto-Burman people of the plains of Lower Assam and the Dooars. Historically they were matrilineal and lived by farming, shifting cultivation, forest gathering and weaving.
zh: 拉巴泛灵论属于拉巴人，这是藏缅语族民族，居住在阿萨姆下游平原和杜阿尔斯。传统上他们行母系制，以稻作、山区轮垦、山林采集和纺织为生。

en: The Rebba religion belongs to the Gumuz, a people of the lowlands along the Blue Nile and its tributaries on the Ethiopian and Sudanese border. They traditionally believe in spirits called mus'a that dwell in houses, granaries, fields, trees and mountains, and ritual specialists called gafea deal with them.
zh: 雷巴教属于古穆兹人，他们居住在埃塞俄比亚与苏丹边界青尼罗河及其支流沿岸的低地。他们传统上相信有名为穆萨的灵栖居在房屋、谷仓、田野、树木和山岭之中，并由称为加费亚的仪式专家与它们打交道。

en:
Rmaism is the traditional religion of the Rma, or Qiang, of western Sichuan, a pantheism of gods of nature and human affairs and of Qiang progenitors. The God of Heaven, Mubyasei or Abamubita, is supreme.

Its central rite is the worship of white stones, which ritual is said to invest with the power of gods. Five, seven or nine pieces of white quartz stand on the roof of a house, the largest for the sky god, and cypress boughs are burned before them.

Rites are led by priests called shibi, shamans who train for years under a teacher and keep Qiang theology, history and myth. By the Ming dynasty the name Qiang was kept only for the non-Han people of the upper Min valley, and the wars of the 1580s brought heavy official repression.
zh:
白石崇拜是四川西部尔玛人，即羌人的传统信仰，是一种泛神论，崇拜自然诸神、人事诸神和羌人的始祖。天神木比塔（也作阿巴木比塔）是至高神。

这一信仰的核心仪式是敬拜白石，据说经过仪式，白石就具有诸神的力量。房顶上摆放五块、七块或九块白石英石，最大的一块代表天神，要在它们面前焚烧柏枝。

仪式由被称为释比的祭司主持，他们是拜师多年才得到这一职位的萨满，保管着羌人的神学、历史和神话。到明代，羌这个名称只用来称呼岷江上游的非汉人群体；1580年代前后的战事给他们带来了官府的严厉镇压。

en: Its followers lived in the Mossi kingdoms of the Volta basin, among them Wagadugu, Yatenga, Tenkodogo and Boussouma.
zh: 信奉者生活在沃尔特河流域的莫西诸国，其中有瓦加杜古、亚滕加、滕科多戈和布苏马。

en:
The Romuva pantheon was headed by Dievas, the sky god, with Perkūnas the thunder god, tied to the oak, executing his will. Žemyna was the earth goddess, Velnias lord of the dead, and Laima gave out fate.

Lithuania was Europe's last pagan state, and the Teutonic Knights crusaded against it for generations. Mindaugas was baptised in about 1250, but his people did not follow. In 1387 Jogaila, King of Poland, brought baptism to Lithuania proper, and Samogitia was the last region to convert, in 1413.

The old faith faded slowly. In 1547 Martynas Mažvydas's catechism urged readers to give up the cult of Žemėpatis, and fragments survived into the early 1800s.
zh:
洛姆瓦多神教的神谱以天神迪耶瓦斯为首，雷神佩尔库纳斯与橡树相联，是迪耶瓦斯意志的执行者。泽米娜是大地女神，韦尔尼亚斯是亡灵之主，莱玛分配命运。

立陶宛是欧洲最后的异教国家，条顿骑士团世世代代对它发动十字军。明道加斯约在1250年受洗，但他的人民并没有跟从。1387年，波兰国王雅盖沃把洗礼带到立陶宛本土；萨莫吉希亚是最后改宗的地区，时间在1413年。

旧信仰消退得很慢。1547年，马尔蒂纳斯·马日维达的教义问答书劝读者放弃对泽米帕蒂斯的崇拜，它的片段一直保留到19世纪初。

official_raw.en: The traditional beliefs of the $lithuanian_group$ people, it contains a whole pantheon of gods, as well as reverence for nature and the ancestors. Its ceremonies are performed with fire altars, around which ritual hymns or dainos are sung.
official_raw.zh: 这是$lithuanian_group$人的传统信仰，包含完整的神祇体系，以及对自然与祖先的崇敬。其仪式在火坛周围进行，伴随着圣歌或“达伊诺斯”的吟唱。

en:
Salishan Totemism is the traditional belief of the Coast Salish peoples, who live along the Salish Sea and Puget Sound from southern Vancouver Island to the Olympic Peninsula. Their nations speak different languages but share a world of guardian spirits and of transformation between human and animal forms.

Traditionally, a person sought a spirit power alone, through isolation and vision quests, and the power was tied to an animal such as the raven, bear or seal. In winter, spirit dances were held on the floors of cedar longhouses, where members showed their powers in song, dance and masks.

A person was thought to have several souls, and a sick man’s soul might be carried towards the underworld. A shaman journeyed there to bring it back; the Duwamish held a ceremony of soul recovery.
zh:
萨利什图腾崇拜是沿海萨利什诸民族的传统信仰。他们生活在萨利什海和普吉特海湾沿岸，从温哥华岛南部到奥林匹克半岛。他们的族群语言各异，但共有一个由守护灵和人兽互变构成的世界。

传统上，人要独自通过隔离和幻象追寻获得灵力，灵力与乌鸦、熊或海豹之类的动物相连。冬天，人们在雪松长屋的地板上举行灵舞，成员以歌、舞和面具展示自己的灵力。

人被认为有几重灵魂，病人的灵魂可能被带向冥界，萨满要前往那里把它找回；杜瓦米什人就有招魂的仪式。

en:
The Samaritans call themselves Israelites. Scholars place the origin of the community in Samaria, its distinct identity taking shape in Persian and Hellenistic times. Their only scripture is the Samaritan Torah, and they reject the later Jewish canon and rabbinic tradition. Their holy mountain is Gerizim, not the Temple Mount in Jerusalem. A hereditary high priest leads the worship there, and the Passover sacrifice is offered each year.

By the 14th century the community was small. The high priestly line of Eleazar died out in 1624, passing the office to the descendants of Ithamar, and by 1786 only about a hundred Samaritans remained.
zh:
撒玛利亚人自称以色列人。学者认为，这一群体形成于撒玛利亚，独特的身份在波斯和希腊化时期逐渐成形。他们唯一的经典是《撒玛利亚五经》，不承认后来的犹太教正典和拉比传统。他们的圣山是基立心山，而不是耶路撒冷的圣殿山。那里由世袭的大祭司主持礼拜，每年举行逾越节献祭。

到14世纪，这个群体已经很小。1624年，以利亚撒一系的大祭司血脉断绝，职位转到以他玛的后裔手中；到1786年，只剩下约一百名撒玛利亚人。

official_raw.en: The traditional faith of the $samaritan_culture$, it emerged from $judaism$ after the fall of the Kingdom of Israel. $samaritanism$ considers itself to be the unchanged faith of the $israelite_group$ people from the times of Moses, in contrast to what they believe is a corruption of the scriptures by $judaism$.
official_raw.zh: 撒玛利亚派是$samaritan_culture$人的传统信仰，起源于以色列王国灭亡后的$judaism$。$samaritanism$自认为是从摩西时代以来未改变的$israelite_group$，与他们认为被$judaism$篡改的经典形成对比。

en:
The Saṃmitīya was a branch of the Vātsīputrīya, themselves descended from the Sthavira order. Its followers were called personalists: they held that a person, or pudgala, is neither the same as the five aggregates nor different from them, and that this person is what is reborn and reaches nirvāṇa. Other schools attacked the idea as a disguised self.

The school was strongest in Sindh and Gujarat. When Xuanzang travelled in India in the seventh century he found it the largest of the non-Mahāyāna orders, and Yijing, writing in the 690s, reported that its monastic college at Valabhi rivalled Nālandā.

In Sindh, where it held most of the monasteries, the Arab conquest brought Islam and the school lost its base. It lingered in India until Buddhism itself vanished there.
zh:
正量部出自犊子部，而犊子部又源自上座部。信徒被称为“补特伽罗论者”，主张“补特伽罗”（人）与五蕴既不相同，也不相异，轮回和证得涅槃的就是这个人。其他部派攻击这种主张是变相的“我”。

正量部在信德和古吉拉特最为兴盛。7世纪玄奘游历印度时，发现它是小乘各部中最大的一派；义净在690年代记载，它在古吉拉特的伐腊毗寺院学府可与那烂陀寺相比。

在它拥有大部分寺院的信德，阿拉伯人的征服带来了伊斯兰教，正量部因此失去根基。它在印度一直延续到佛教本身在当地消亡。

official_raw.en: One of the many branches of early $buddhist$ in $india$, $sammitiya$ developed in $sindh_area$ becoming a great center of early $buddhist_ADJ$ schools even rivaling the Mahāyāna Nālandā. Being the biggest non-Mahāyāna $buddhist$ in $india$, it was removed from its place of prominence with the $muslim_ADJ$ invasions.
official_raw.zh: $sammitiya$是$india$早期$buddhist$的众多分支之一，在$sindh_area$地区发展，成为早期$buddhist_ADJ$的重要中心，甚至可与大乘佛教的那烂陀寺相媲美。作为$india$最大的非大乘$buddhist$派别，它在$muslim_ADJ$入侵后失去了其显赫地位。

en:
Samoyedic Shamanism is the traditional belief of the Samoyedic peoples of northern Siberia, the Nenets, Enets, Nganasans and Selkups, who lived by hunting, fishing and reindeer herding. It is a shamanistic and animistic system that stresses respect for the land.

Among the Nenets, the sky god Num was the good creator and high god, while his malevolent son Nga ruled the world below. The shaman, called a tadibya, could travel beneath the earth to Nga. In one tale, one who did so married Nga's daughter and came to hold up the world as the Old Man of the Earth. On the migrations a sacred sleigh carried bear skins and figures, and only elders opened it for rituals.

The Russians reached the Selkups about 1628 and later tried to convert them. Many kept their old religion.
zh:
萨摩耶德萨满教是西伯利亚北部萨摩耶德诸民族——涅涅茨人、埃涅茨人、恩加纳桑人和塞尔库普人——的传统信仰。他们以狩猎、捕鱼和放牧驯鹿为生。这是一套萨满教和万物有灵的体系，强调敬重土地。

在涅涅茨人中，天神努姆是善良的创造者和最高神，他邪恶的儿子恩加则统治地下世界。萨满称塔迪比亚，能够潜入地下去找恩加。据故事所说，有个萨满这样做之后娶了恩加的女儿，从此用手托住世界，被称为“大地老人”。迁徙途中，神圣雪橇载着熊皮和神像，只有长者才在举行仪式时打开它。

1628年前后，俄罗斯人到达塞尔库普人的地方，后来曾试图使他们改宗。许多人仍保留着旧日的宗教。

en:
Sanamahism is the ethnic religion of the Meitei people of the Imphal valley in Kangleipak, later Manipur. It takes its name from Lainingthou Sanamahi, the eldest son of the supreme god Sidaba Mapu, and the court chronicle Cheitharol Kumbaba traces it back to King Pakhangba.

The faith is polytheistic. Its chief deities include Sanamahi, Sidaba Mapu, Pakhangba and the wealth goddess Imoinu, while the umang lai, gods of the sacred groves, are honored at the Lai Haraoba festival. Every house kept a leipung, a mound in the courtyard that stood for the first land of creation.

In the early eighteenth century Hindu priests from Sylhet won King Pamheiba over to Vaishnavism. He made Hinduism the state religion in 1717, and in 1729 brought nearly all the Meitei into it. Sanamahi nonetheless stayed a household god.
zh:
萨那玛依教是刚莱博，即后来曼尼普尔的英帕尔河谷中梅泰人的民族宗教。它得名于莱宁图·萨那玛依，他是至高神西达巴·马普的长子；王室编年史《切塔罗尔·库姆巴巴》把这一信仰追溯到帕康巴王。

这是一种多神信仰。主神有萨那玛依、西达巴·马普、帕康巴和财富女神伊莫伊努等，圣林之神乌芒莱则在“莱·哈劳巴”节上受到祭祀。每家每户的院子里都设有一座莱彭土丘，象征创世之初的第一块陆地。

18世纪初，来自锡尔赫特的印度教祭司使帕姆海巴王皈依毗湿奴派。他在1717年把印度教定为国教，1729年又让几乎所有梅泰人都改宗印度教。尽管如此，萨那玛依仍作为家神保留下来。

en:
Masade, called Old Islam by outsiders, is a religion of the Sangihe Islands between Sulawesi and Mindanao. It grew out of the first spread of Islam in the archipelago, brought in the fifteenth century by an Arab named Maulana Moe'min with the support of Lamauge, a Muslim kingdom subject to Tabukan.

Under King Samangsialang there arose an imam known as Mawu Masade, who gave the faith its name. Its practice kept its own forms: prayer was held once a week, on Friday, with the imam standing among worshippers seated in a circle, and the rite called Diko'u Soro was held three days before the end of Ramadan.

In the following centuries the Sangihe Islands came under Ternate in the sixteenth century. Spanish rule followed, and from 1677 Dutch rule.
zh:
马萨德派被外人称为“古伊斯兰教”，是苏拉威西与棉兰老之间桑吉赫群岛上的一种宗教。它源自伊斯兰教在群岛的最初传播：15世纪，一位名叫毛拉纳·莫明的阿拉伯人在隶属塔布坎的伊斯兰王国拉毛盖的支持下传入伊斯兰教。

萨曼西亚朗王在位时，出现了一位被称为“马武·马萨德”的伊玛目，信仰因而得名。它的礼仪保留了自己的形式：祈祷每周只在星期五举行，伊玛目站在围坐成圈的信徒中间；斋月结束前三天要举行称为“迪科乌·索罗”的仪式。

此后几个世纪里，桑吉赫群岛在16世纪受特尔纳特控制。随后是西班牙统治，1677年起由荷兰人统治。

en:
In the Three Teachings, Confucianism supplied the ethics of family, state and ritual, Daoism the cosmos of the Dao, immortality and the folk gods, and Buddhism the doctrines of karma and rebirth. Under the Song, Neo-Confucianism, which rejected the mystical side of the others, came to dominate learning.

Yet the idea that the three were one grew ever stronger. Wang Chongyang of Quanzhen taught that Buddhism and Daoism had always been one family, and halls like the Hanging Temple at Hunyuan enshrined Confucius, Laozi and the Buddha together.

In the Ming, Lin Zhao'en (1517–1598) founded a society to join the three teachings, which became the Sanyi sect. A local official condemned it as heterodox in 1585, but after his death Lin was worshipped as the Lord of the Three-in-One in over a thousand temples.
zh:
三教之中，儒家提供家庭、国家和礼仪的伦理，道教提供道的宇宙观、长生之道和民间诸神，佛教则带来业报和轮回的教义。宋代，排斥佛道神秘一面的理学逐渐在学术上占据主导。

然而三教归一的主张却越来越盛。全真道的王重阳说佛道从来是一家，悬空寺等处的殿堂则把孔子、老子和释迦牟尼供奉在一起。

明代，林兆恩（1517—1598）创立社团，会通三教，后来发展为三一教。1585年，地方官员曾斥它为异端，林兆恩死后却被奉为三一教主，在一千多座祠庙中受到供奉。

official_raw.en: Called the 'Three Teachings', it is the combined blend and influences of $confucianism_policy$, $daoism_policy$, and $buddhist$. Being all three present in $china$ for centuries, and also influencing and being influenced by many other $chinese_group$ folk beliefs and deities, they have not always been in harmony among each other, but they have always been part of the $chinese_group$ way of life.
official_raw.zh: $confucianism_policy$思想、$daoism_policy$与$buddhist$相互交融的体系，在$china$被统称为“三教”。千百年来，它们共同植根于华夏沃土，与诸多$chinese_group$民间信仰及神明体系交织影响。虽三教并非始终和谐并存，却始终深刻塑造着$chinese_group$民族的生活方式与精神脉络。

en:
The Sao religion was the traditional belief of the walled city-states that stood around Lake Chad and along the Chari River. Each city was headed by a divine ruler who made few public appearances and then stayed hidden behind a screen, and oral tradition says the Sao clans were united by a single language and a single religion.

The Sao buried their dead in funerary urns and made bronze and terracotta figures of people and animals. After the Bornu empire expanded in the 1500s the Sao ceased to exist as a separate culture, and conversion to Islam changed their identity; the Kotoko inherited their city-states, and the Sara and other peoples trace their descent to them.
zh:
萨奥信仰是乍得湖周围和沙里河沿岸那些带城墙的城邦的传统信仰。每座城都由一位神圣的统治者领导，他很少公开露面，露面时也隐在屏风之后；口传说萨奥各氏族由同一种语言和同一种宗教联结在一起。

萨奥人用葬瓮埋葬死者，并制作人和动物的青铜与陶土塑像。16世纪博尔努帝国扩张之后，萨奥作为独立的文化不复存在，改信伊斯兰教改变了他们的身份；科托科人继承了他们的城邦，萨拉人等民族则追溯自己源出萨奥。

en:
In the animism of the Sámi of Sápmi, every notable thing in nature, from animals to rocks, was thought to have a soul. Beliefs varied from region to region. Common figures were Beaivi, the sun goddess and mother of humans, the thunder god Horagalles, and Jahbme-akka, mistress of the dead. Families offered reindeer at sieidis, unusual stones or landforms that were holy places, and the noaidi, or shaman, went into trance with a reindeer-hide drum to reach saivo, the underworld.

Catholic missionaries arrived in the thirteenth century. Pressure grew after the Reformation, when many drums were burned or confiscated in the 1600s and 1700s.
zh:
在萨米人的万物有灵信仰中，自然界一切显要的事物，从动物到岩石，都被认为有灵魂。各地信仰不尽相同。常见的神灵有太阳女神、人类之母贝亚维，雷神霍拉加勒斯，以及死者之主亚布梅—阿卡。各家在西耶迪（形状奇特的石头或地貌，是圣地）献祭驯鹿；诺埃蒂（萨满）敲着驯鹿皮鼓进入出神状态，前往地下世界萨伊沃。

天主教传教士13世纪就来到这里。宗教改革之后压力加大，许多萨米鼓在17和18世纪被烧毁或没收。

official_raw.en: The traditional religions practices of the $sapmi$ people, it contains a multitude of natural and animal spirits, as well as veneration of the dead. Some of the animals are particularly revered, like reindeer and bears.
official_raw.zh: 这是$sapmi$人的传统宗教实践，包含众多自然与动物灵体，以及对死者的崇敬。某些动物，如驯鹿与熊，受到特别尊崇。

en:
Sarnaism is the nature religion of the tribal peoples of the Chota Nagpur Plateau in eastern India, among them the Santal, Oraon, Ho and Munda. Its name comes from the Mundari word for a sacred grove, where the faith is practised. Its core principles are reverence for water, forest and land.

Each village has its sacred grove of sal trees, the home of the village deity, Gram Deota, where the whole community gathers for sacrifices twice a year, led by the village priest, the pahan. The groves are strictly protected: felling trees or harming animals is forbidden by custom.

The main festival is Sarhul, when ancestors are worshipped. The pahan brings three pots of water to the grove; if the level drops, the monsoon will fail, and if it holds, the rains will come.
zh:
娑罗教是印度东部乔塔那格浦尔高原部族民族的自然宗教，信徒包括桑塔尔人、奥朗人、霍人和蒙达人。它的名字来自蒙达语中的“圣林”，信仰就在圣林中举行。核心是敬畏水、森林和土地。

每个村庄都有一片娑罗树圣林，是村神戈拉姆·德奥塔的居所，全村人每年两次在这里集会献祭，由村中的祭司帕汉主持。圣林受到严格保护，按习俗，不许砍树或伤害动物。

主要的节日是萨尔胡尔节，这时人们祭拜祖先。帕汉把三罐水带到圣林；若罐中水位下降，就预示季风不来，若水位不变，雨水就会降临。

en:
Satsana Phi is the old native religion of the Tai peoples, among them the Shan, the Dai of Yunnan, the Lao and the Ahom of Assam. It is based on the worship of spirits called phi, of the vital forces called khwan, and of ancestors, and it was dominant until Hinduism and Buddhism arrived.

Guardian spirits watched over temples and the town pillar, the lak mueang, while others were old sky gods, the phi thaen. Everyone was thought to hold thirty-two khwan, and in the baci ceremony the lost khwan were called back and cotton strings tied round the wrist.

The Ahom carried the faith from Möng Mao into Assam with Sukaphaa in 1228. After 1397 Brahmin influence grew at court, and King Suhungmung, who reigned from 1497 to 1539, took the Hindu title Swarganarayana.
zh:
丕教是泰族诸民族古老的本土宗教，信徒包括掸人、云南的傣族、佬人和阿萨姆的阿洪姆人。它以崇拜称为丕的精灵、称为宽的生命灵气和祖先为基础，在印度教和佛教传来之前，一直是主流信仰。

守护神灵庇佑着寺庙和城镇的立柱“拉勐”，另有一些是古老的天神“丕天”。人们认为每个人身上有三十二个宽，在“巴西”仪式上，走失的宽被召回，并在手腕上拴上棉线。

1228年阿洪姆人随苏卡法从勐卯把这一信仰带入阿萨姆。1397年之后，婆罗门的影响在宫廷中增长；1497至1539年在位的苏洪蒙王取了印度教头衔斯瓦尔加纳拉亚纳。

en: The Sedang religion is the traditional animism of the Sedang, a Bahnaric-speaking highland people of Kon Tum and the neighbouring parts of Quang Nam and Quang Ngai in central Vietnam. Their festivals follow the swidden farming year, with one at the sowing in early July and another in early August, when the rice has turned green.
zh: 色当泛灵论是越南中部色当人的传统万物有灵信仰，色当人说巴拿语支的语言，居住在昆嵩省以及广南、广义两省的邻近山区。他们的节庆随刀耕火种的农事而行：7月初播种时有一次，8月初稻苗转绿时又有一次。

en:
The Comcaac religion is the traditional belief of the Comcaac, whom the Spanish called Seri, a people of the Gulf of California coast of Sonora. They did not develop a complex system of religious governance. Their view of the world, their rites and their festivals stayed close to nature.

Their main rites marked the onset of puberty and death, and their songs and stories turned on the sea, the animals and the ancient feats of heroes and warriors. They were never formally evangelized in colonial times, so their beliefs took in none of the Catholic elements found among many neighbouring peoples.

They fought the Spanish fiercely. In the 1660s a Spanish posse killed most of the adults of one band and handed the children out among the towns of Sonora.
zh:
科姆卡克信仰是科姆卡克人的传统信仰。科姆卡克人被西班牙人称作塞里人，生活在索诺拉的加利福尼亚湾沿岸。他们没有发展出复杂的宗教组织，对世界的看法、仪式和节庆都贴近自然。

他们最主要的仪式与青春期开始和死亡相关，歌谣和故事围绕大海、动物以及英雄和战士的古老功绩。殖民时期他们始终没有被正式传教，所以信仰中没有许多邻近民族那样的天主教成分。

他们顽强抵抗西班牙人。17世纪60年代，一支西班牙人的队伍杀死了某个游群的大部分成年人，把孩子分送到索诺拉的各个城镇。

en:
Shamans enter altered states such as trance to deal with the spirit world, and were believed to heal the sick, divine, speak with spirits and escort the souls of the dead to the afterlife. A Buryat epic tells of the first shaman, Kara-Gürgän, who could create life.

The word shaman itself comes from a Tungusic language, probably Evenki or Manchu, and reached English via Russian. The Dutch statesman Nicolaes Witsen carried it to western Europe in his book of 1692.
zh:
萨满通过出神等变换了的意识状态与灵界交往，人们相信萨满能治病、占卜、与灵体交谈，还能护送死者的灵魂前往来世。布里亚特的一首史诗讲到第一位萨满卡拉-古尔根，他能创造生命。

萨满这个词本身来自某种通古斯语，可能是鄂温克语或满语，经俄语传入英语。荷兰政治家尼古拉斯·维特森在1692年出版的书中把这个词带到了西欧。

official_raw.en: A shared set of practices and beliefs centering of the figure of the shaman, and individual capable of interacting with the spirit world and access the spirits or the spiritual energy to afect the physical world. Its specifics of spirits, gods, or rituals may vary, but the core concept of the spiritual world and its interactions with the material world remains in all $shamanism_ADJ$ practices.
official_raw.zh: 萨满教是一系列以萨满为核心的信仰与实践，萨满是能够与灵界互动并利用灵体或灵性能量影响物质世界的个体。其灵体、神祇或仪式的具体内容可能有所不同，但灵界与物质世界互动的核心理念存在于所有$shamanism_ADJ$实践中。

en:
Shiism reveres Ali ibn Abi Talib as Muhammad's cousin and son-in-law, and holds that his descendants, the Imams, are infallible guides. The martyrdom of Husayn at Karbala in 680 is mourned every year on Ashura.

The main branches differ over the line of Imams. Twelvers recognise twelve, the last of whom, the Mahdi, lives hidden in occultation; Ismailis follow Ismail ibn Jafar; Zaydis, the closest to Sunnism, are found in the highlands of Yemen.

In 1337 the Sarbadars, a Shia-ruled state, were newly established at Sabzevar in Khorasan. The great turning point came in 1501, when Ismail I made Twelver Shiism the official religion of Safavid Iran and a largely Sunni population was converted, often by force. After the Safavids fell in 1736, the Usuli school gained ground over the Akhbari.
zh:
什叶派尊阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜为穆罕默德的表弟兼女婿，相信阿里的后裔伊玛目是不会犯错的引路人。680年侯赛因在卡尔巴拉殉难，信徒每年在阿舒拉节哀悼。

各主要支派在伊玛目世系上各有主张。十二伊玛目派承认十二位伊玛目，最后一位马赫迪隐遁于“幽隐”之中；伊斯玛仪派追随伊斯玛仪·本·贾法尔；宰德派与逊尼派最为接近，见于也门高地。

1337年，由什叶派统治的萨尔巴达尔国刚在呼罗珊的萨卜泽瓦尔建立。真正的转折出现在1501年：伊斯玛仪一世宣布十二伊玛目派为萨法维波斯的国教，以逊尼派为主的居民常被强迫改宗。1736年萨法维王朝覆灭后，乌苏勒派压过了阿赫巴尔派。

official_raw.en: The basis of the $shia_ADJ$ faith is that Muḥammad designated 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib as his successor as the spiritual and political leader of $muslim$. As such, the $imamate$ is to follow 'Alī's line rather than the one established by 'Abū Bakr when he was chosen as $rank_empire_muslim_ruler_male$ at the meeting of Saqīfah by the companions of Muḥammad.
official_raw.zh: $shia_ADJ$信仰的基础是穆罕默德指定阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜为其继任者，作为$muslim$的精神与政治领袖。因此，$imamate$职位应按阿里的血统传承，而非穆罕默德的同伴在塞基法会议上选择阿布·伯克尔作为$rank_empire_muslim_ruler_male$时所确立的继承体系。

en:
Shintō has no founder or central authority. The kami are believed to dwell in mountains, rivers, trees and ancestors, and the rites are performed at shrines by priests called kannushi. Its oldest written traditions are the Kojiki of 712 and the Nihon Shoki, and the Ise Shrine, home of the sun goddess Amaterasu, is its holiest site.

Buddhism reached Japan in the sixth century, and from the eighth the kami were drawn into Buddhist cosmology. Shrines and temples were joined, and under the theory of honji suijaku the kami were taken to be local manifestations of buddhas, Amaterasu being identified with Dainichi Nyorai.

In the Sengoku period Yoshida Kanetomo (1435–1511) built Yoshida Shintō, which tried to give the kami an authority independent of Buddhism. It dominated shrine affairs until the late Edo period.
zh:
神道教没有创始人，也没有统一的权威。人们相信神栖居在山川草木和祖先之中，仪式由神职人员“神主”在神社中主持。最早的书面传统见于712年的《古事记》和《日本书纪》，供奉太阳女神天照大神的伊势神宫是神道教最神圣的地方。

佛教在6世纪传入日本，从8世纪起，诸神被纳入佛教的宇宙观。神社与寺院结合，按照本地垂迹说，神被看作佛的本土化身，天照大神就被等同于大日如来。

战国时代，吉田兼俱（1435—1511）建立了吉田神道，企图赋予神祇独立于佛教的权威。此后直到江户时代后期，吉田神道一直主导着神社事务。

official_raw.en: The diverse set of beliefs and practices revolving around Kami worship that were present in $japan_region$ before the arrival of $buddhist$ got intrinsically tied to and blended with $buddhist_ADJ$ practices and concepts as $buddhist$ spread through $japan_region$. The Kami and $buddhist_ADJ$ deities were identified with one another, with both sets of beliefs becoming functionally inseparable. This gave rise to a particularly $japanese_group$ flavor of $buddhist$ blended with a $buddhist$-influenced Kami worship.
official_raw.zh: 神道教是一系列围绕神祇崇拜的信仰与实践，在$buddhist$传入$japan_region$之前就已存在。随着$buddhist$在$japan_region$的传播，这些信仰与$buddhist_ADJ$的实践和教义紧密结合，相互交融。神道教的神祇与$buddhist$的诸佛被视作同一体，两种信仰在功能上变得密不可分。这催生了一种具有$japanese_group$特色的$buddhist_ADJ$形式，同时也形成了受$buddhist$影响的神道崇拜。

en:
Sikhism arose in the Punjab around the end of the fifteenth century from the teaching of Guru Nanak, who was born in 1469. It drew on the Sant and Bhakti traditions and won converts from both Hindus and Muslims.

Nanak named Lahina his successor in 1539, as Guru Angad. Guru Arjan built the first Harimandir Sahib, compiled the Adi Granth and was tortured to death by the Mughal emperor Jahangir in 1606.

The sixth guru, Hargobind, took up arms; Guru Tegh Bahadur was beheaded at Delhi in 1675 on Aurangzeb's order; and Guru Gobind Singh founded the Khalsa in 1699 and named the scripture, the Guru Granth Sahib, as the last guru. Later Sikh power rose in the Punjab, with Lahore as its capital.
zh:
锡克教大约于15世纪末兴起于旁遮普，源自古鲁那纳克的教导，那纳克生于1469年。它吸收了圣者传统和虔信运动，也赢得了印度教徒和穆斯林的皈依。

1539年，那纳克指定拉赫纳为继承人，即古鲁安加德。古鲁阿尔琼建成第一座哈里曼迪尔·萨希卜，编纂《阿迪·格兰特》，1606年被莫卧儿皇帝贾汉吉尔折磨致死。

第六代古鲁哈尔戈宾德拿起了武器；古鲁得格·巴哈都尔于1675年在德里被奥朗则布下令斩首；古鲁戈宾德·辛格于1699年创立卡尔萨，并指定经典《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》为最后的古鲁。此后锡克人的势力在旁遮普崛起，以拉合尔为都城。

official_raw.en: A religion founded by the teachings of the $character_title_guru$, it originates from the varied $hindu_ADJ$ faiths of $india$, and incorporates many influences from $muslim$. It believes in one creator, $sikhism_god_name$, and to conduct oneself honestly and selflessly for the benefit of all. It encourages connection with the divine through the use of contemplation and meditation, as well as recitation and music as ways to be conscious of God's presence.
official_raw.zh: 锡克教根据$character_title_guru$的教义创立，起源于$india$多样的$hindu_ADJ$信仰，并融合了许多$muslim$的影响。它信仰一位造物主“$sikhism_god_name$”，并倡导诚实无私地行事以造福众生。它鼓励通过冥想与沉思、诵经与音乐等方式与神圣连接，从而感知独一真神的存在。

en:
The Zenú, a farming and goldworking people of the Sinú and San Jorge river valleys on Colombia’s Caribbean coast, held women as the symbol of fertility and wisdom. Clay figurines of women were set in graves to stand for conception and rebirth in the underworld, as a seed germinates and grows.

The dead were buried with music and dance in mounds crowned with a tree hung with golden bells, and with gold breastplates that stood for the pregnancy of women and the virility of men. Each valley was a province, and the three chiefs of Finzenú, Panzenú and Zenúfana shared complementary political, religious and economic duties.

Between 1510 and 1535 disease and war destroyed the chiefdoms. The Spanish looted the gold of the tombs.
zh:
塞努人是哥伦比亚加勒比海岸塞努河与圣豪尔赫河流域从事农耕和金工的民族，以女性为丰产与智慧的象征。墓中放置女性陶俑，代表受孕和在冥界的重生，如同种子萌发生长。

死者下葬时有乐舞相伴，坟丘上栽一棵树，树枝上挂着金铃；陪葬的金胸甲象征女性的怀孕和男性的雄壮。每条河谷自成一省；芬塞努、潘塞努和塞努法纳的三位首领分担互补的政治、宗教和经济职责。

1510至1535年间，疾病和战争摧毁了各个酋邦。西班牙人劫掠了墓中的黄金。

en:
The Songhai and Zarma peoples along the middle Niger in West Africa centre their traditional belief on the holey, spirits approached through possession rites, and on a creator god, Yarkoy. Each hereditary group traditionally revered its own guardian spirit.

The rulers of Gao adopted Islam around 1009, yet the old practices survived beside it, even after Mali conquered the region near the end of the thirteenth century.

Sonni Ali, who ruled the Songhai from 1464 to 1492 and was taught the old rites by his mother, upheld them, which earned him a hostile name in the Muslim chronicles of Timbuktu. Askia Muhammad, who seized the throne in 1493, promoted Islam, but the spirit cults stayed strong in the villages after Morocco destroyed the empire in 1591.
zh:
尼日尔河中游一带的桑海人和扎尔马人，传统信仰以霍莱诸灵为核心，人们通过灵附仪式与它们沟通，并相信有一位造物神亚尔科伊。各个世袭群体传统上都敬奉自己的守护神灵。

加奥的统治者在1009年前后接受了伊斯兰教，但古老的习俗与之并存，13世纪末马里征服该地后也没有消失。

1464年至1492年在位的桑尼·阿里从母亲那里学得古老的仪式并加以维护，因此在廷巴克图的穆斯林编年史里留下恶名。1493年夺位的阿斯基亚·穆罕默德推行伊斯兰教，但1591年摩洛哥摧毁桑海帝国之后，精灵崇拜在乡村依然兴盛。

en:
Songsarek is also what the Garo of the Meghalaya hills call themselves, the ones obeying the deities. Most Garo followed the faith until Christianity spread through the Garo Hills in the second half of the nineteenth century.

Its highest god is Tatara Rabuga, said to be so high that he cannot be reached. His deputy Misi Saljong, god of the sun, crops and fertility, receives the first harvest at the Wangala festival, Susime is goddess of wealth, and Rokkime the mother goddess of rice is honoured at Agalmaka. The gods are appeased with animal sacrifices, and the flight of the wagtail is watched to foretell the season's rain.
zh:
梅加拉亚山区的加罗人也用“松萨雷”称呼自己，意为“服从神灵的人”。19世纪后半叶基督教在加罗丘陵传开之前，多数加罗人信奉这一信仰。

至高神是塔塔拉·拉布加，据说高得无法企及。他的副手米西·萨尔琼是太阳、庄稼和丰产之神，旺加拉节上要把初收的庄稼献给他；苏西梅是财富女神，稻米之母神洛基梅则在阿加尔马卡节受到祭祀。人们用牲祭安抚诸神，还观察鹡鸰的飞行来预测当季的降雨。

en:
The Sora, or Savara, are a Munda people of the Eastern Ghats hills in southern Odisha and northern coastal Andhra, whose traditional faith is shamanic. The Sora attribute every natural phenomenon to gods, deities or spirits.

They revere supernatural beings called kittung, who inhabit forests, mountains, villages, rivers and particular places. Sora shamans, the kuran, are usually women who keep the kittung content with yearly rituals, cattle sacrifices, dances and offerings. Traditionally a shaman in trance travels down to the underworld, leaving her body for the dead to speak through, and mourners argue with the dead, laugh at their jokes and weep at their accusations.
zh:
萨瓦拉人（又译索拉人）是东高止山脉的蒙达语族民族，分布在奥里萨南部和安得拉北部沿海，传统信仰带有萨满色彩。他们认为一切自然现象都出自神、神灵或精灵之手。

他们敬奉称为基通的超自然存在，基通栖息在森林、山岭、村庄、河流和特定地点。萨瓦拉的萨满称为库兰，通常是女性，通过每年的仪式、宰牛献祭、舞蹈和供品来取悦基通。传统上，萨满入迷后灵魂下到冥界，让亡者借用她的身体说话，送丧的人与亡者争辩，被他们的玩笑逗笑，又因他们的指责落泪。

en:
The strigolniki appeared in Pskov in the middle of the fourteenth century and spread to Novgorod and Tver. They denied that the Orthodox clergy held a lawful priesthood, attacked the ignorance of the priests and the fees charged for baptism, penance and communion, and demanded that laymen be allowed to preach.

The bishops of Novgorod opposed them, and in 1375 a crowd threw three of them, among them the teachers Karp and Nikita, off the bridge into the Volkhov. Persecution and quarrels brought the movement to an end in the early fifteenth century; the last mention of it dates from 1487.
zh:
剪裁派14世纪中叶出现在普斯科夫，后来传到诺夫哥罗德和特维尔。他们否认东正教神职人员的圣职合法，抨击神父的无知，以及为洗礼、告解和圣餐收取的费用，要求平信徒享有讲道的权利。

诺夫哥罗德的主教们反对他们，1375年，一群人把其中三人，包括教师卡尔普和尼基塔，从桥上扔进了沃尔霍夫河。迫害和内部争执使这一运动在15世纪初走向终结，对它的最后记载出现在1487年。

official_raw.en: Emerging in medieval $russian_region$, the $strigolniki$ is a reformist sect critical of the established $orthodox_ADJ$ Church. They condemn the corruption of priests, the selling of sacraments, and the accumulation of wealth by clergy. Favoring a simpler faith focused on personal piety, the $strigolniki_ADJ$ are a target by the $orthodox_ADJ$ Church and state authorities.
official_raw.zh: $strigolniki$兴起于中世纪$russian_region$地区，是一个批判既定$orthodox_ADJ$会的改革派教派。他们谴责神职人员的腐败、圣事的买卖以及教会财富的积累。$strigolniki_ADJ$倾向于一种更简单的信仰，专注于个人虔诚，因此成为$orthodox_ADJ$会与政府当局的目标。

en:
The Sui, who live in the southern mountain valleys of Guizhou and whose name, meaning water, was fixed under the Ming, are mainly polytheists who also worship their ancestors. Their religion counts more than nine hundred ghosts and gods, who can bring good fortune or bad.

Shamans, hired to pray and sacrifice for the sick and the dying, alone could read the Sui script, shuishu, a logographic script of at least five hundred characters used for divination and geomancy. Tradition credits its invention to a sage named Lu Duogong.

The year turned with the Duan festival, a harvest feast held from September to November, when bronze drums sounded and ancestors were thanked. On its eve and first morning no meat of land animals may be eaten, since breaking the taboo shows disrespect to the ancestors.
zh:
水族聚居在贵州南部的山谷里，“水”这一族名在明代定下来。他们主要信奉多神，也崇拜祖先。水族的宗教有九百多个鬼神，能带来福，也能带来祸。

人们请巫师为病人和垂危者祈祷献祭，只有巫师能读水书。水书是一种表意文字，至少有五百个字，用来占卜和看风水。传说它由一位叫陆铎公的贤人创制。

水族的新年是端节，是从9月到11月举行的丰收节，届时铜鼓声声，感谢祖先。端节前夜和头一天早晨不能吃陆地牲畜的肉，破了这条禁忌就是对祖先不敬。

en: The Sula people live on the Sula Islands in North Maluku, centred on Sulabesi and the south coast of Mangoli. The islands lay under the Sultanate of Ternate, which kept a governor, the Sangadji Sanana, to collect tribute, and in 1652 the Dutch East India Company built the stone fort De Verwachting at Sanana.
zh: 苏拉人生活在北马鲁古的苏拉群岛，集中在苏拉贝西岛和曼戈利岛南岸。群岛隶属特尔纳特苏丹国，后者派驻名为“桑加吉·萨纳纳”的总督收取贡赋；1652年荷兰东印度公司在萨纳纳修建了石砌的希望堡。

en:
Sunnism takes its name from the sunnah, the practice of the Prophet. Law rests on the Quran, the hadith and the consensus of scholars, applied through four schools: Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi'i and Hanbali. In creed, most Sunnis follow the Ashari or Maturidi schools of theology.

In 1337 Sunni rulers held most of the Islamic world, from Mamluk Egypt and the Sultanate of Delhi to the Golden Horde. After Selim I conquered Egypt in 1517 and ended the Mamluk-controlled Abbasid caliphate, the Ottoman sultans, now masters of Mecca and Medina, claimed the caliphate and led the Sunni world against Safavid Iran and its Shia state. In 1744 Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, drawing on the Hanbali scholar Ibn Taymiyya, allied himself with Muhammad bin Saud in Najd.
zh:
“逊尼”之名来自“逊奈”，即先知的行为典范。教法以《古兰经》、圣训和学者的公议为依据，通过哈乃斐、马立克、沙斐仪和罕百里四大教法学派加以运用。在信条上，多数逊尼派遵循艾什尔里派或马图里迪派的神学。

1337年，逊尼派统治者掌握着伊斯兰世界的大部分，从马木留克埃及、德里苏丹国到金帐汗国。1517年塞利姆一世征服埃及，终结了由马木留克控制的阿拔斯哈里发，掌管麦加与麦地那的奥斯曼苏丹随后以哈里发自居，率领逊尼派世界对抗萨法维伊朗的什叶派政权。1744年，穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜承接罕百里派学者伊本·泰米叶的主张，与穆罕默德·本·沙特在内志结盟。

official_raw.en: $sunni$ holds that the leadership of $muslim$ was passed to 'Abū Bakr when he was chosen as $rank_empire_muslim_ruler_male$ at the meeting of Saqīfah by the companions of Muḥammad, as the Prophet himself did not appoint any successor. It thus reveres the al-Rāshidūn, the first four $rank_empire_muslim_ruler_male$ after Muḥammad, as a model of governance.
official_raw.zh: $sunni$认为$muslim_ADJ$的领导权在穆罕默德的同伴于塞基法会议上选择阿布·伯克尔作为$rank_empire_muslim_ruler_male$时移交给他，因为先知本人并未指定任何继任者。因此，逊尼派尊崇“正统$rank_empire_muslim_ruler_male$”（穆罕默德之后的四位哈里发）作为治理的典范。

en:
Sũwõ' is the name the Bribri of Talamanca, in what is now Costa Rica, give to the oral traditions that make up their shamanic religion. At its centre is Sibö, the creator and culture hero, a luminous trickster who, according to the tales, defeated the devils called the Sòrburu and planted the sacred seeds at Suràyum, from which the Bribri grew.

The awápa, shamans, link the human and spirit worlds. They receive magic stones from Sibö in a ritual at a river. The spirit world is the human one turned upside down: the owner of fish takes the fish for yucca, since to him water is earth.

The Spanish Franciscan missions of the seventeenth century failed to hold the mountains. In 1709 the leader Pablo Presbere led a rising that burned fourteen mission churches.
zh:
苏沃是哥斯达黎加塔拉曼卡地区的比布里人给口头传统起的名字，这套传统构成了他们的萨满教。教义的中心是西博，他是创造者和文化英雄，一位光彩夺目的骗子式神灵：传说他击败了称作索尔布鲁的魔鬼，并把神圣的种子种在苏拉尧姆，比布里人就是从种子里长出来的。

阿瓦帕是萨满，沟通人间和灵界。他们在河边的仪式上从西博那里领受魔石。灵界是人间的倒影：鱼的主人把鱼当作木薯，因为在他眼里水就是土地。

17世纪，西班牙方济各会的传教站没能控制这片山区。1709年，首领巴勃罗·普雷斯贝雷领导起义，烧毁了十四座传教士建的教堂。

en:
The Mapuche of south-central Chile and southwest Argentina kept their independence from both the Inca and Spanish empires. Their faith has no formal leadership and varies by family and territory, and since the beliefs were passed down orally and later retold through Spanish missionaries, they are not precisely known.

The cosmos has three planes: the sky, wenu mapu, home of the gods and the ancestors; the earth, where good and evil contend; and the underworld, home of the harmful wekufe spirits. Nature spirits, the ngen, own particular places and punish trespassers.

Communities held prayer ceremonies, ngillatun, while machi healers and diviners communicated with the spirits. The god Ngünechen, equated by many with the Christian God, is attested only from the nineteenth century.
zh:
智利中南部和阿根廷西南部的马普切人始终没有被印加帝国和西班牙帝国征服。他们的信仰没有正式的领袖，各家族和地区各有差异；由于这些信仰靠口耳相传，后来又经西班牙传教士转述，具体面貌已难以确切知晓。

宇宙分为三层：天界韦努马普，是诸神和祖先的居所；大地，善恶在此争斗；冥界，是有害的韦库费诸灵的居所。自然之灵恩根各自拥有特定的地方，会惩罚擅自闯入的人。

人们举行祈祷仪式恩吉拉通，马奇这类医者兼占卜者则与灵界沟通。许多人把神恩格内切恩等同于基督教的上帝，但这位神要到19世纪才见于记载。

en:
Tapu is the Polynesian idea of what is holy and set apart, with a force of prohibition behind it. The word is shared across Polynesia, in Tonga, Samoa, Hawaii, where it is kapu, and in Māori; the English taboo comes from Captain James Cook's visit to Tonga in 1777.

Anything touched by tapu could not be approached or handled, and breaking it could bring sickness or death. A chief's house and belongings were tapu. Priests, among the Māori called tohunga, could declare a fishery tapu to protect it from overuse. In Hawaii the ʻai kapu forbade men and women to eat together and kept pork, most bananas and coconuts from women.

In 1819 the new king Kamehameha II, with Queen Keōpūolani and the high priest Hewahewa, ended the ʻai kapu by eating with women.
zh:
塔布是波利尼西亚人对神圣、被隔离之物的观念，背后有一种禁止的力量。这个词通行于波利尼西亚各地，汤加、萨摩亚和毛利人都用，在夏威夷则读作卡普；英语里的“taboo”一词，就是1777年詹姆斯·库克船长造访汤加后带回去的。

被塔布沾染的人和物，不可接近，也不可触碰，违犯者可能染病或丧命。酋长的房屋和财物都是塔布。祭司在毛利人中称为图洪加，可以宣布某处渔场为塔布，以防止过度取用。在夏威夷，“艾卡普”禁止男女同桌进食，并把猪肉、大多数香蕉和椰子列为女性不得食用之物。

1819年，新王卡美哈梅哈二世与王后凯奥普奥拉尼以及大祭司赫瓦赫瓦一起，通过与女性同席进食，终结了艾卡普。

en:
Tengri, the Eternal Blue Sky, appears in Chinese chronicles as the sky god of the Xiongnu in the fourth century BC. The Secret History of the Mongols, written in 1240, begins with Borte Chino, the Blue Wolf, born with a destiny from Tengri. In 1290 the Ilkhan Arghun told Pope Nicholas IV that the descendants of Genghis Khan, whether they accepted baptism or not, left that for Eternal Tengri to decide.

Tengrism's hold lasted until the fourteenth century, when the Golden Horde converted to Islam. After that it was largely submerged, and among the Mongols it lived on mixed with Tibetan Buddhism.
zh:
腾格里即永恒的蓝天，在公元前4世纪的中国史书里以匈奴天神的身份出现。1240年写成的《蒙古秘史》开篇就写孛儿帖·赤那，也就是苍狼，他生来带着腾格里赐予的天命。1290年，伊利汗阿鲁浑对教宗尼古拉四世说，成吉思汗的子孙，无论是否受洗，都留待永恒的腾格里去裁断。

腾格里信仰的地位一直延续到14世纪，那时金帐汗国皈依了伊斯兰教。此后它大多被掩盖，在蒙古人当中则与藏传佛教混合着存续下来。

official_raw.en: $tengri$ is a type of $shamanism_ADJ$ beliefs of the $turkic_group$ and $mongolian_group$ peoples, centered around the presence of the sky god $tengri_god_name$, who is worshiped as a personification of the universe. However, it also includes other deities, as it reveres nature and the deities that live in it, as well as the ancestors.
official_raw.zh: $tengri$是$turkic_group$与$mongolian_group$族群的一种$shamanism_ADJ$信仰，以天空之神$tengri_god_name$为中心，将其视为宇宙的化身。然而，它也包含其他神祇，因为它不仅敬仰自然及其栖居其中的神祇，也尊崇祖先的灵魂。

en:
The Tepehuán are mountain people of the Sierra Madre Occidental whose northern branch, the Ódami, live in southern Chihuahua. Their belief was a polytheism: gods were thought to dwell in idols and fetishes, and to come from underground, the source of all life, so the people owed them sustenance.

Jesuits described a principal idol, Ubumarai, a human head on a stone pillar. Shamans cured the sick and led the fasting, prayer and all-night dances called mitotes, held for rain and crops.

Jesuit missions began among the Tepehuán in 1596. In 1616 Quautlatas, a baptized messianic leader who bore a broken cross, preached that the angry gods would bless the land once the Spaniards were killed. His rising began the Tepehuán Revolt, put down by 1620.
zh:
特佩万人是西马德雷山脉的山地民族，其北支奥达姆人住在奇瓦瓦南部。他们的信仰是多神的：人们认为神灵居住在偶像与护符中，来自作为一切生命之源的地下，因此人们有义务供养它们。

耶稣会士记述过一尊主要的偶像乌布马赖，是石柱上的一个人头。萨满为人治病，主持斋戒、祈祷和通宵舞蹈，即米托特，用来祈求降雨和丰收。

1596年，耶稣会的传教活动在特佩万人中开始。1616年，受过洗的救世主式领袖夸乌特拉塔斯带着断裂的十字架，宣称只要杀光西班牙人，愤怒的诸神就会赐福这片土地。他的起事引发了特佩万起义，到1620年被镇压。

en:
Missionaries carried Theravāda to Sri Lanka under Ashoka. Its scriptures, the Pāli Canon, were written down in the first century BCE and are its sole authority.

In the eleventh century Sinhalese monks and Southeast Asian rulers began converting the mainland. Anawrahta of Pagan (1044–1077) and Ram Khamhaeng of Sukhothai in the late thirteenth century made it the faith of Burma and Thailand, and by the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries it was the state religion of Cambodia and Laos.

The Burmese and Thai kings styled themselves Dhamma kings. Ordination lapsed in Sri Lanka, and in 1753 the Thai monk Upali went to Kandy to ordain a new line of monks, founding the Siam Nikāya.
zh:
传教僧人在阿育王时代把上座部佛教带到斯里兰卡。它的经典巴利语三藏公元前1世纪写定，是它唯一的权威。

11世纪，僧伽罗僧人和东南亚的统治者开始让中南半岛的大部分地区改宗。蒲甘的阿奴律陀王（1044—1077）和13世纪后期素可泰的兰甘亨王使它成为缅甸和泰国的主流信仰，15、16世纪它又成为柬埔寨和老挝的国教。

缅甸和泰国的诸王自称护法之王。斯里兰卡的比丘受戒传承断绝，1753年泰国僧人乌帕利前往康提，为新一批僧人授戒，创立了暹罗派。

official_raw.en: Called 'School of the Elders', it adheres to the oldest traditions of $buddhist$. It rejects the Mahāyāna $sutra$ and thus the many $bodhisattva$ and the $bodhisattva$ path itself as being available to all. Instead, it focuses on the monastic community as the superior way of achieving enlightenment.
official_raw.zh: 上座部佛教直译为“长老部”，坚持$buddhist$最古老的传承。它拒绝接受大乘$sutra$，因此不接受$bodhisattva$，也不认可$bodhisattva$道为普世修行的途径。相反，它强调僧伽团体作为实现觉悟的优越方式。

en:
King Trisong Detsen made Buddhism the state religion of Tibet in the eighth century, inviting Padmasambhava and Śāntarakṣita, the founders of the Nyingma school, and Samye became its first monastery. In the eleventh century the Kagyu and Sakya schools arose from newer translations from India.

The Mongols took Tibet in the thirteenth century and made Sakya Paṇḍita their viceroy in 1249, and Buddhism became the de facto state religion of the Yuan dynasty. Bön, the older native faith, borrowed heavily from it and stands closest to the Nyingma school.

After the Yuan fell in 1368, rival noble families ruled Tibet. Tsongkhapa (1357–1419) founded the Gelug school, whose Dalai Lamas gained the Mongol title in 1578 from Altan Khan; the Fifth Dalai Lama set up the Ganden Phodrang government in the 1640s.
zh:
8世纪，赤松德赞定佛教为西藏国教，邀请宁玛派的创始人莲花生和寂护入藏，桑耶寺成为西藏第一座寺院。11世纪，噶举派和萨迦派在新译的印度教法的基础上兴起。

13世纪，蒙古人征服了西藏，并在1249年任命萨迦班智达为卫藏的总督，佛教成为元朝事实上的国教。更古老的本土宗教苯教深受它的影响，与宁玛派最为接近。

1368年元朝灭亡后，西藏由几个贵族家族轮流统治。宗喀巴（1357—1419）创立了格鲁派，1578年，该派的达赖喇嘛一称由俺答汗授予；五世达赖喇嘛于1640年代建立了甘丹颇章政权。

official_raw.en: The form of $buddhist$ developed along and around the mountains of the Himalayas emerged from the Mahāyāna tradition, but incorporated many of the esoteric practices of Vajrayāna due to its close contact with India and the later stages of development of $buddhist$ there.
official_raw.zh: 藏传佛教是沿喜马拉雅山脉发展起来的$buddhist$形式，源自大乘佛教传统，但由于与印度的密切接触以及$buddhist$在印度后期的发展，它融入了许多密宗实践。

en:
The Tiwa, or Lalung, are a Tibeto-Burman people of central Assam and the Meghalaya hills. Among the Hill Tiwa, seven old villages form the ritual as well as the political centre, and each village's chief, the loro, performs judicial and religious duties for a network of settlements.

Every clan keeps its own place of worship for its titular god, and festivals such as Sogra Phuja and Langkhon Phuja mark the year. At the Jonbeel fair, said to date from the fifteenth century at the latest, a fire worship is performed before the trading begins.
zh:
蒂瓦人（又称拉隆）是阿萨姆中部和梅加拉亚丘陵的藏缅语族民族。山地蒂瓦以七个古老的村寨为政治和仪式中心，村寨首领称为洛罗，为周围一片聚落履行司法与宗教职责。

每个氏族都有自己的祭祀地点，供奉本氏族的神，索格拉祭、朗孔祭等节日贯穿一年。乔恩比尔集市据说最晚可上溯到15世纪，开市之前要举行火祭。

en:
The religion of Tokelau centred on Tui Tokelau, the chief god of the atolls of Atafu, Nukunonu and Fakaofo, settled from Samoa about a thousand years ago. He was worshipped beside the usual Polynesian pantheon until Christianity came to the islands.

On Fakaofo, the chiefly island, the marae held a house containing a monumental slab of coral, covered with mats, that personified the god, and the principal chief, the ariki, was chief priest. In May all the people of Tokelau gathered at Fakaofo, marking the new year with a feast, prayers to Tui Tokelau for protection, and offerings of fish, coconuts and pandanus. A fire was lit in the temple, and the people danced through the night.
zh:
托克劳人的宗教以图伊·托克劳为中心，他是阿塔富、努库诺努和法考福三座环礁的主神，这三座环礁大约在一千年前由萨摩亚迁来的人定居。在基督教传入之前，人们在崇拜波利尼西亚通行诸神的同时，也崇拜他。

在作为酋长之岛的法考福，祭祀场里有一座房屋，里面立着一块用草席覆盖的巨大珊瑚石板，作为这位神的化身；首席酋长“阿里基”同时是大祭司。每年5月，托克劳各岛的人都聚集到法考福，以宴会、向图伊·托克劳祈求庇护的祈祷，以及鱼、椰子和露兜树果实的供品来庆祝新年。神庙里点起火，人们通宵起舞。

en:
The Wichí live along the headwaters of the Bermejo and Pilcomayo rivers in Argentina and Bolivia, and anthropologists class their faith as animism and shamanism. They worshipped the beings of nature and held that a supreme being, Tokuah, ruled the world.

Shamans fought disease with song and rattles, and some used the hallucinogenic plant Anadenanthera colubrina. The Wichí believed in both a good and an evil spirit, and in the souls of the dead being reborn in animals.
zh:
韦奇人生活在阿根廷和玻利维亚境内贝尔梅霍河与皮尔科马约河的上游一带，人类学家把他们的信仰归入泛灵论和萨满教。他们崇拜自然界的各种存在，并认为有一位至上者托克瓦统治着世界。

萨满用歌唱和响器对抗疾病，有些人还使用具有致幻作用的植物。韦奇人既相信有善灵，也相信有恶灵，并相信死者的灵魂会转生为动物。

en: The Tolaki, the largest people of Southeast Sulawesi, centre their belief on divine beings called sangia. In oral history a princess who appeared at Unaaha in the early tenth century was greeted as Sangia Ndudu, the descended god, and as Wekoila became the first ruler of Konawe.
zh: 托拉基人是苏拉威西东南部人数最多的民族，其信仰以称为“桑吉亚”的神性存在为中心。口传历史说，10世纪初一位公主出现在乌纳阿，被尊为“桑吉亚·恩杜杜”，意为降临的神，她取名韦科伊拉，成为科纳维的第一位统治者。

en:
The Bugis of South Sulawesi kept Tolotang, a pre-Islamic belief, above all around Amparita. Its followers honour a single god, Dewata SeuwaE, titled PatotoE, the one who determines fate, and some sources name La Panaungi as the founder.

Worship was directed at stones, wells and the graves of ancestors, and the Lontara manuscripts served as scripture. Rites were led by priests called Uwa, of whom the Uwatta, a descendant of the founder, officiated at weddings. Yearly the community gathered in the Sipulung at the tomb of I Pabbere, bringing rice and side dishes as provisions for the afterlife.

The Bugis kingdoms turned to Islam in the early seventeenth century. Part of the Tolotang community accepted it and became known as the Benteng, while the Towani Tolotang held to the old rites.
zh:
南苏拉威西的布吉人在伊斯兰教传入之前就有托洛唐教，以阿姆帕里塔一带保存得最完整。信徒敬奉唯一的神德瓦塔·塞乌瓦埃，其称号为帕托托埃，意为“决定命运者”，有的材料说创始人是拉·帕瑙吉。

人们向石头、水井和祖先的坟墓礼拜，《拉贡塔拉》手稿是他们的经典。仪式由称为“乌瓦”的祭司主持，其中“乌瓦塔”是创始人的后裔，主持婚礼。每年社群在伊·帕贝雷的墓前举行西普隆聚会，带上米饭和菜肴，作为来世的口粮。

17世纪初，布吉各王国改信伊斯兰教。托洛唐社群中一部分人接受了伊斯兰教，被称为本滕人，而托瓦尼托洛唐仍坚持旧有仪轨。

en:
Tomanuru, from the Bugis tomanurung, those who came down, is the belief in rulers sent from the upper world that underlies the founding stories of South Sulawesi's kingdoms. Before the fourteenth century tradition tells of two descents: first the sky being PatotoE, called Tamboro Langi, on Mount Latimojong, then his son Batara Guru with his wife We Nyilittimoq, whose arrival marked the rise of local lords.

Bone was founded in the early fourteenth century with the Tomanurung ri Matajang, who became its first ruler, La Ubbi. Gowa's line began about 1320 with the marriage of the Tumanurung, the unknown one, to a noble named Karaeng Bayo, and in Soppeng too the state was tied to such a descent.
zh:
托玛努鲁教的名字出自布吉语“托马努隆”，意为“从天上降下的人”，指南苏拉威西各王国建国传说所依据的、由上界派来的统治者。14世纪之前，传说有两次降临：先是天界的帕托托埃，又称坦博罗·朗伊，降在拉蒂莫荣山顶；其后是他的儿子巴塔拉·古鲁和妻子韦·尼利蒂莫克，他们的到来标志着半岛各地涌现出本地领主。

波尼在14世纪初随着“马塔扬的托马努隆”的降临而建立，其第一位统治者名叫拉·乌比。盖瓦的世系约在1320年始于一位身世不明的“图马努隆”与名叫卡拉恩·巴约的贵族结合；在索佩恩，国家的创立同样与这样的降临相连。

en:
Totemism is the practice, best known in North America, of linking a family, clan or people to an animal or spirit being that serves as its emblem. The word ‘totem’ is an English form of the Ojibwe doodem, and both the word and the beliefs behind it belong to the Ojibwe, though similar ideas are found among many peoples.

The Anishinaabe are divided into clans called doodeman, mostly named for animals. In their oral tradition the great Miigis beings rose from the Atlantic and gave them the Mide way of life.

On the Pacific Northwest coast, peoples carve monumental totem poles with bears, birds, frogs, people and supernatural beings. Like heraldry, the poles show the crest of a family or chief, tell stories the family owns, or mark a special occasion.
zh:
图腾崇拜指以北美洲最为人所知的一种做法：把一个家族、氏族或民族与某种动物或灵体联系起来、以此作为标志。“图腾”一词是奥吉布瓦语杜登的英语形式，这个词和它背后的信仰本属于奥吉布瓦人，不过类似的观念也见于许多民族。

阿尼什纳比人分为若干称为杜登曼的氏族，大多以动物命名。在他们的口传传统里，伟大的米吉斯诸灵从大西洋中升起，把密得之道传给他们。

在太平洋西北海岸，各民族雕刻巨大的图腾柱，柱上有熊、鸟、蛙、人和超自然的生灵。图腾柱像纹章一样，显示家族或酋长的徽记，讲述该家族拥有的故事，或纪念特殊的场合。

en:
The word shaman comes from the language of the Tungusic peoples of Manchuria and the Russian Far East, among them the Jurchens, Manchus and Evenks. Their belief is animistic and polytheistic, led by the sky god Abka Enduri, the source of all life, with many gods who enliven every part of nature.

Shamans are men and women of unusual ability who can perceive the ways of the gods, and every kin has its own shaman, who conducts sacrifices. The wilder rites for animal gods were forbidden by Hong Taiji in 1636, and by 1673 every communal shrine except the imperial one was banned.

The Manchus took the soldier-god Guan Yu as one of their gods. In 1747 the Qianlong Emperor published a manual of Manchu rites, translated into Chinese in 1780.
zh:
萨满这个词源自满洲和俄罗斯远东各通古斯民族的语言，这些民族有女真人、满族人和鄂温克人。他们的信仰万物有灵，崇拜多神，以天神阿布卡恩都里为首，他是一切生命的来源，众多神明使自然的每个部分都有了生机。

萨满是有非凡能力的男女，能感知诸神的旨意，每个氏族都有自己的萨满，主持祭祀。以动物神为对象的狂野仪式，皇太极早在1636年就加以禁止；到1673年，除皇家的堂子外，所有公共的祭祀场所一律被禁。

满族把武神关帝奉作神祇之一。1747年，乾隆皇帝颁布满文的满洲祭祀典礼，1780年又有了汉文译本。

en:
The Chiriguanos, also called the Ava Guaraní, were Guaraní-speaking farmers and warriors of the Andean foothills of south-eastern Bolivia. Tumpa, their word for a god, was also the title of the prophets who proclaimed themselves gods and called their people to fight the Spanish.

The Chiriguanos came from Guaraní who moved west from Paraguay in the early sixteenth century and mixed with the Chané. The Spanish called them people without religion, and until the nineteenth century they were impervious to missionaries: a Jesuit mission in 1767 had only 268 Chiriguano converts.

In 1778 and 1779 two prophetic leaders, one at Caiza and one at Mazavi, declared themselves gods and urged the Ava Guaraní to attack the Spanish. Both died between 1780 and 1781 after their attacks failed.
zh:
奇里瓜诺人又称阿瓦瓜拉尼人，是说瓜拉尼语的农民和武士，居住在玻利维亚东南部的安第斯山麓。屯帕在他们的语言里指神，也是先知的头衔，这些先知自称为神，号召族人与西班牙人作战。

奇里瓜诺人出自16世纪初从巴拉圭西迁的瓜拉尼人，与查内人混居融合而成。西班牙人说他们没有宗教，直到19世纪，他们一直对传教士无动于衷：1767年的一处耶稣会传教点，只有268名奇里瓜诺人皈依。

1778年和1779年，凯萨和马萨维各出现一位先知式的领袖，宣称自己是神，催促阿瓦瓜拉尼人进攻西班牙人。两人在进攻失败后，先后死于1780年至1781年间。

en:
The Chapacuran-speaking peoples of the Guaporé and Mamoré basin, on the border of Brazil and Bolivia, are best known through the Wariʼ, whose name means we, the people, and who traditionally lived in semi-nomadic riverside villages that they moved at least once every five years.

In the traditional Wariʼ view, being human is defined against game animals. Hunted animals can also count as human, since they sometimes act as predators, and the human body is a poor guide to who someone is, for it can be drawn into another being's point of view and changed into it. Tales warn of a mother whose child spotted a jaguar's tail between her legs.
zh:
巴西与玻利维亚边境瓜波雷河、马莫雷河流域讲查帕库拉语族语言的各族中，最著名的是瓦里人：瓦里的意思是“我们这些人”，他们传统上住在半游牧的河畔村落，至少每五年迁居一次。

在瓦里人的传统观念里，“人”是相对猎物而言的。被猎的动物有时也算人，因为它们有时会当捕食者；人的身体也不能说明一个人是谁，因为身体会被另一种存在的视角吸引，并变成那种存在。故事里讲过一个母亲，女儿发现她两腿之间露出了美洲豹的尾巴。

en:
The Udmurts, a Permic people of what is now Udmurtia in Russia, had as their oldest god Inmar, the god of the sky, inherited from the time when the Finno-Ugric peoples were still one. Prayers began by calling on Inmar, Kyldysin and Kuazh; scholars still argue whether these were separate gods or names of a single one.

The Udmurts also honoured many lesser spirits, such as Vumurt of the water and Nyulesmurt of the forest. Each clan had its own first ancestor and protector, the vorshud.

In 1557 Ivan the Terrible granted privileges to baptised Udmurt families. Forced conversion began in earnest only in the middle of the eighteenth century, when churches and schools were built and sacred groves and prayer places were destroyed.
zh:
乌德穆尔特人说彼尔姆语支的语言，居住在今俄罗斯的乌德穆尔特一带。他们最古老的神是天神英马尔，可上溯到芬兰—乌戈尔诸民族尚未分开的时代。祈祷常以呼唤英马尔、基尔迪辛和夸济开头；这些究竟是几位神，还是同一位神的不同称号，学者仍有争论。

乌德穆尔特人还崇敬许多低阶神灵，例如水中的武穆尔特和森林里的纽列斯穆尔特。每个氏族都有自己的始祖和保护者沃尔舒德。

1557年，伊凡雷帝给予受洗的乌德穆尔特家庭特权。直到18世纪中叶才开始大规模强制改宗，教堂和学校被修建起来，圣林和祈祷处被毁。

en:
Umiña was the emerald goddess of the Manteño, the coastal chiefdoms of what is now Ecuador. Their stories call her the green-eyed daughter of the chief Tohalli. In one version she was murdered and an emerald was taken from her heart; in another she opened her own breast during a drought and became a jewel.

The stone, said to be as large as an ostrich egg when the Spaniards arrived, was kept in a shrine at Manta, where a priest rubbed it on the sick, so she became goddess of health, fertility and rain. Her worship reached the Caranqui of the Andes, and the Manteño were said to have preferred death to giving her up.
zh:
乌米尼亚是曼特尼奥人的翡翠女神，曼特尼奥人是今厄瓜多尔沿海的诸酋邦。据说她是酋长托哈利的绿眼睛女儿。一种说法是她被人杀害，人们从她的心中取出一颗翡翠；另一种说法是，她在干旱中剖开自己的胸膛，化为一块宝石。

西班牙人到来时，这块宝石据说有鸵鸟蛋那么大，供奉在曼塔的神龛里，祭司用它擦拭病人的患处，于是她成了健康、丰产和降雨之神。对她的崇拜还传到安第斯山区的卡兰基人中，曼特尼奥人据说宁死也不肯交出她。

en:
The indigenous belief of the Ryukyu Islands centres on the utaki, sacred places that are usually a grove, spring, cave or mountain near a village, where ancestors and nature gods were venerated. Its holiest spot, the ibi, could be entered only by the noro, the priestesses. The women of the family were held spiritually superior, a belief called onarigami.

Sefa-utaki, where the goddess Amamikyu, who gave birth to the Ryukyu Islands, is said to have come down, was the most sacred official site of the Ryukyu Kingdom. In the traditional accounts Shō Hashi united the three kingdoms of Okinawa into one in the early fifteenth century.

King Shō En made his daughter the kikoe-ōgimi, the chief priestess, in 1469. After Satsuma invaded in 1609, Confucian thought wore down the priestesses' authority.
zh:
琉球群岛的本土信仰以御岳为中心。御岳是神圣的场所，通常是村庄附近的树林、泉水、洞穴或山丘，人们在那里敬奉祖先与自然诸神。其中最神圣的地点“伊比”只有祝女，即女祭司才能进入。人们认为家中的女性在灵性上更高一筹，这种信念称作“姐妹之灵”。

斋场御岳相传是生下琉球群岛的女神阿摩美久降临的地方，是琉球王国最神圣的官方场所。按传统史书的说法，尚巴志在15世纪初把冲绳本岛的三个王国统一为一个。

1469年，尚圆王让女儿担任最高女祭司闻得大君。1609年萨摩入侵之后，儒家思想逐渐削弱了女祭司的权威。

en: The Vaghua-speaking people live on Choiseul Island in the Solomon Islands, called Lauru by its inhabitants. Spaniards under Alvaro de Mendana sighted the island in April 1568 and charted it as San Marcos.
zh: 说瓦格瓦语（又称塔武拉语）的居民生活在所罗门群岛的舒瓦瑟尔岛上，岛上居民称这座岛为劳鲁。1568年4月，阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚率领的西班牙人望见这座岛，把它标作圣马科斯。

en:
The Vainakh peoples of the North Caucasus, the Chechens, the Ingush and the Batsbi, were polytheists before Christianity and Islam took hold among them. Their roots were the worship of natural forces, ancestors and spirits, with trees thought to be spirits' homes.

Dela was the supreme god and creator of the world, and Sela, the thunder god, was honoured beside him. The earth rests on the horns of a bull, and no Chechen or Ingush worked on Tuesday, the day of the bulls.

The Tkhaba-Yerdy church in what is now Ingushetia, said to have been built over an older pagan temple, was remodelled under Queen Tamar of Georgia between 1184 and 1213. Islam, present among the Chechens since the fourteenth century, spread only slowly, and the old religion was still strong in the nineteenth century.
zh:
北高加索的瓦伊纳赫人——车臣人、印古什人和巴茨比人——在基督教和伊斯兰教扎根之前信奉多神，根基是对自然力量、祖先和精灵的崇拜，树木被认为是精灵的居所。

德拉是最高神和世界的创造者，雷神谢拉与他并受尊崇。大地由一头公牛的角托着，车臣人和印古什人在“牛日”星期二不干活。

位于今印古什境内的特卡巴-叶尔德教堂，据说建在更古老的异教神庙之上，在格鲁吉亚塔玛尔女王时期的1184至1213年间经过改建。伊斯兰教自14世纪起已在车臣人中出现，但传播缓慢，直到19世纪，古老的信仰仍然很强。

en:
The traditional religion of the Vedda, who live as hunters and gatherers in the forests of Sri Lanka, is polytheistic and centres on the dead. The Veddas call their ancestors nae yaku and invoke them for success in hunting. These kindred spirits are held to watch over the living and give them flesh in the hunt.

The dead are neither good nor bad, and the living treat them like friends and relatives. Well-treated spirits remain kind, but neglected ones withdraw their help or turn hostile.

The Veddas share the shrine of Kataragama with their Buddhist, Hindu and Muslim neighbours, where the god Skanda is held to have met and married Valli, a Vedda girl. Over time many Veddas took on a nominal Buddhism or Hinduism, while the old rites continued.
zh:
维达人在斯里兰卡的森林里以狩猎采集为生。他们的传统信仰是多神教，以死者为中心。维达人把祖先称为奈亚库，打猎时要向他们祈求。这些亲人之灵被认为守护着活着的人，还在狩猎时给他们送来猎物。

死者既不算善，也不算恶，活人把他们当作朋友和亲属对待。祖灵受到善待就会一直仁慈，被怠慢则会撤回帮助，甚至变得怀有敌意。

维达人与信奉佛教、印度教和伊斯兰教的邻人共同敬拜卡塔拉伽摩圣地，相传斯堪陀神在那里遇见并迎娶了维达姑娘瓦利。时间一长，不少维达人名义上接受了佛教或印度教，旧有的仪式却照常延续。

en:
The Aja, Ewe and Fon peoples of the coast of what are now Benin, Togo and Ghana have worshipped the vodun, the spirits, since before written records. Vodun has no central authority, text or orthodoxy and is split into small cults, each devoted to a particular spirit.

One creator, Nana-Buluku, stands above countless vodun. His offspring Mawu-Lisa is a two-part deity, Lisa ruling sun and day, Mawu moon and night. Legba of the crossroads opens the way between people and spirits and is consulted first.

Dahomey grew from the Fon of the Abomey plateau, an offshoot of Allada founded about 1600. King Agaja took Allada in 1724 and Whydah in 1727. Through the Atlantic slave trade, followers of Vodun were carried to the Americas.
zh:
今贝宁、多哥和加纳沿海的阿贾人、埃维人和丰人，对沃敦（灵）的崇拜早于有文字记载的时代。巫毒教没有中央权威、经典和正统教义，分成许多各自供奉某位神灵的小教团。

一位创造神娜娜·布鲁库位于无数沃敦之上。他的后代玛武与莉萨是两部分合一的神，莉萨掌管太阳和白昼，玛武掌管月亮和黑夜。十字路口之神雷格巴沟通人与神灵，凡事先向他求问。

达荷美从阿波美高原的丰人中兴起，是约1600年建立的阿拉达的分支。国王阿贾加1724年攻取阿拉达，1727年攻取维达。随着大西洋奴隶贸易，巫毒教徒被带到了美洲。

en:
The Votians, a Finnic people of Ingria between the Gulf of Finland and Lake Peipus, held an old pagan belief and were counted among the founders of Novgorod. The earliest record of them, in 1069, has them joining Polotsk in an attack on Novgorod, and in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries papal bulls listed them among the pagan tribes.

They long kept their holy shrines. After Novgorod fell in the 1470s, Moscow deported many Votes and pressed conversion harder, and in 1534 the Archbishop of Novgorod, Macarius, complained to Ivan IV that they were still practising their pagan beliefs.

The monk Ilja, sent to convert them, destroyed many of the old shrines, and the priest Nikifor continued his work. Slowly the Votes were converted and became devout Orthodox Christians.
zh:
瓦佳人是居住在芬兰湾与楚德湖（佩普西湖）之间英格里亚的芬兰语族民族，信奉古老的异教，被视为诺夫哥罗德的奠基民族之一。1069年的记载最早提到他们，当时他们随波洛茨克人进攻诺夫哥罗德；12至13世纪的教皇诏书把他们列入异教部落。

他们长期保有自己的圣所。1470年代诺夫哥罗德陷落后，莫斯科流放了许多瓦佳人，并更急迫地推行改宗；1534年，诺夫哥罗德大主教马卡里向伊凡四世抱怨他们仍在奉行异教信仰。

被派去劝化他们的修士伊利亚摧毁了许多旧圣所，司祭尼基福尔继续他的工作。瓦佳人慢慢被改宗，成为虔诚的东正教徒。

en:
The Wa, an Austroasiatic people of the rugged hills between the Mekong and the Salween rivers, are animists. Wa tales say the first Wa were born of two female ancestors, Ya Htawm and Ya Htai, who lived as tadpoles in a lake called Nawng Hkaeo.

Rites centred on blood sacrifice: a village spirit healer met sickness with a chicken, a pig or a larger animal, and a buffalo was killed each year at a shrine's Y-shaped post. By local legend a human head made the rice fields fertile, and the Wa of the wilder hills were known as headhunters; those beside the Dai and Shan took up Theravada Buddhism and abandoned the practice.
zh:
佤人是南亚语系民族，居住在湄公河与萨尔温江之间崎岖的山地，信奉万物有灵。佤人的起源传说称，最初的佤人是两位女祖先雅托姆和雅泰所生，她们早年在一个叫侬凯奥的湖里以蝌蚪的形态生活。

祭祀以血祭为中心：寨中的灵医遇到疾病，就杀鸡、杀猪或杀更大的牲畜；寨中神庙每年在一根Y形木桩前宰杀一头水牛。据当地传说，献上人头能让稻田丰产，深山里的佤人因此以猎头著称；而与傣族、掸族相邻的佤人接受了南传上座部佛教，不再猎头。

en:
Among the Oromo and other Cushitic-speaking peoples of the Horn of Africa, the followers of Waaqeffanna, the Waaqeffataa, worship one God, Waaqa Tokkicha, who is said to have many names and is also called the Black God. Waaqeffanna has no canonical scripture and was handed down orally.

Waaqa acts through the ayyaana, spirits that carry messages but cannot create; they possess the men and women who become qaalluu, priests and ritual leaders. The Abbaa Muudaa, the Father of Ointment, was the highest qaalluu, and pilgrims travelled far with a bull and a sheep to be anointed.

The thirty-year struggle of 1529 to 1559 among Waaqeffanna followers, Christians and Muslims weakened all three. Many Oromo were later drawn into Muslim sultanates and the Christian Ethiopian Empire.
zh:
在奥罗莫人和非洲之角其他说库希特语的民族中，瓦格教徒崇拜唯一的神瓦格·托基查；据说他有许多名字，也被称为“黑色的神”。瓦格教没有经典，全靠口耳相传。

瓦格通过阿亚纳行事。阿亚纳是传递讯息却不能创造的灵，它们附在人身上，被附体的男女成为祭司和仪式主持者卡卢。阿巴穆达意为“圣油之父”，是最高的卡卢，朝圣者带着一头公牛和一只绵羊远道前来受膏。

1529至1559年间，瓦格教徒、基督徒和穆斯林之间持续三十年的争斗削弱了三方。许多奥罗莫人后来被卷入穆斯林苏丹国和基督教的埃塞俄比亚帝国。

en:
The Waldensians began in the late twelfth century as the Poor of Lyon, followers of Peter Waldo, a wealthy merchant who gave away his property around 1173 and preached apostolic poverty and lay preaching. Excommunicated in 1184, they were declared heretics in 1215 for refusing to accept the bishops' control over preaching.

The movement spread to the Cottian Alps, where preachers called barbas met small secret congregations. Persecution never ceased, and Pope Innocent VIII issued a bull in 1487 ordering their extermination.

At the Synod of Chanforan in 1532 the Waldensians joined the Reformed tradition and began to worship openly in French. Massacres followed, notably the Piedmont Easter of 1655. In 1689 their pastor Henri Arnaud led the exiles in the Glorious Return to their valleys.
zh:
瓦勒度派于12世纪末兴起，最初称为里昂穷人，追随彼得·瓦勒度。瓦勒度是一位富商，约1173年散尽家产，宣讲使徒式的清贫和平信徒传道。1184年被开除教籍，1215年又因拒绝接受主教对传道的控制而被宣布为异端。

这一运动传到科蒂安阿尔卑斯山，被称为“巴尔巴”的传道人在那里与秘密的小型会众聚会。迫害从未停止，1487年教宗英诺森八世还颁布诏书，下令消灭他们。

1532年的尚福朗会议上，瓦勒度派加入改革宗传统，开始用法语公开礼拜。此后屠杀不断，尤以1655年的皮埃蒙特复活节为甚。1689年，牧师亨利·阿尔诺率领流亡者“光荣回归”他们的山谷。

official_raw.en: Founded by Peter Waldo, the $waldensian$ is a reformist $christian_ADJ$ movement emphasizing simplicity, poverty, and the authority of scripture. They reject clerical wealth, the veneration of saints, and the necessity of sacraments for salvation. Persecuted as heretics, the $waldensian_ADJ$ movement have endured centuries of oppression while spreading their message across $europe$.
official_raw.zh: $waldensian$派由彼得·瓦勒度创立，是一个强调简朴、贫穷与圣经权威的$christian_ADJ$改革派运动。他们拒绝神职人员的财富、圣徒崇拜以及圣事对救赎的必要性。$waldensian_ADJ$作为异端受到迫害，但其精神在$europe$传播，并经受住了数个世纪的压迫。

en:
The Miskito, whose land runs along the Mosquito Coast from Cape Camarón in Honduras to the Río Grande de Matagalpa in Nicaragua, were in the era before the Miskito kings polytheists, with gods of the sun (Lapta), the moon (Kati), thunder (Alwani) and the sea, lakes and rivers (Lidawanka). No human sacrifices are recorded.

The shaman, called sukya, healed by finding cures in dreams and blowing smoke on the afflicted place. One leading shaman at a time, the Supreme Sukya or Okuli, spoke for the evil spirits called Lasas and was revered by neighbouring tribes.

In the seventeenth century English privateers allied with the Miskito and began to crown their leaders as kings, opening a long period of European influence on the coast.
zh:
米斯基托人的土地沿莫斯基托海岸分布，从洪都拉斯的卡马龙角延伸到尼加拉瓜的马塔加尔帕大河。在米斯基托诸王的时代之前，他们是多神信徒，有太阳神拉普塔、月亮神卡蒂、雷神阿尔瓦尼，以及掌管海洋、湖泊和河流的利达万卡。没有人祭的记录。

萨满称作苏基亚，靠在梦中寻得药方来治病，并向患处吹烟。同一时期只能有一位首席萨满，称为至尊苏基亚或奥库利，他代表被称作拉萨的恶灵，邻近各部落也尊崇他。

17世纪，英国私掠者与米斯基托人结盟，开始册封他们的首领为国王，海岸从此长期受到欧洲人的影响。

en:
The Warao, the ‘boat people’ of the Orinoco Delta in northeastern Venezuela, tell of their descent: a sky hunter shot a bird that fell through the floor of heaven, and he followed it down to the earth on a rope of heavenly cotton.

The world, Hobahi, is a circle ringed by water and filled with spirits, the hebu, who may be helpful, harmful or neutral toward people. The chief of them is Kanobo, ‘our grandfather’, who lives in the sacred stone guarded by the greatest shamans, the wisiratu.

The hebu were kept content with smoke from ritual tobacco and with shaman-led rituals. Without the hebu and the harmful magic of the hoa and the bahana, the Warao held, a person would be immortal.
zh:
瓦劳人居住在委内瑞拉东北部的奥里诺科河三角洲，名字意为“船民”。关于祖先的来历，他们说有位天上的猎人射中一只鸟，鸟穿过天界的地板坠落，猎人便顺着一根天上棉花搓成的绳子降到了大地。

世界称为霍巴希，是一个被水环绕的圆，里面住满了精灵赫布；他们对人类可能有益、有害，也可能中立。其中最重要的是“我们的祖父”卡诺波，他住在由最大的萨满威西拉图守护的圣石之中。

人们用仪式用的烟草之烟和由萨满主持的仪式来让赫布保持满意。瓦劳人认为，若没有赫布，也没有称为霍阿和巴哈纳的有害巫术，人就会长生不死。

en: The Wetar people, also called Wetter, are an Ambon-Timor people living on Wetar, an island in the Banda Sea in eastern Indonesia, who speak Wetarese.
zh: 韦塔人又称韦特尔人，属于安汶—帝汶族群，居住在印度尼西亚东部班达海中的韦塔岛上，说韦塔语。

en:
In China the wu and, for men, the xi, served as shamanic mediators between people and the spirits. The word wu is first recorded under the Shang dynasty, when dance and trance were a way of reaching the ancestors.

As Confucian thinking gained ground the wu lost their place at court and were pushed into popular religion, where Neo-Confucians branded their ecstatic rites as untutored and disorderly. In village and temple they lived on as healers and diviners, among them the tongji, youth mediums who in trance are possessed by a god to give oracles.

In the northeast a different shamanism took shape with the Tungusic peoples. In 1747 the Qianlong Emperor ordered the publication of a Shamanic Code to regulate rites he feared were being forgotten.
zh:
在中国，男称觋、女称巫的萨满式修行者在人和神灵之间充当中介。“巫”字最早见于商代的记载，当时舞蹈和入神是与祖先沟通的一种办法。

随着儒家思想占据上风，巫在朝廷里失去了位置，退入民间信仰；理学家称他们的狂迷仪式粗野无序。在乡村和庙宇里，巫仍是医病和占卜的人，如童乩，即青少年灵媒，入神后由神明附体，给出神谕。

东北则形成了另一种与通古斯诸族相关的萨满教。1747年乾隆皇帝下令编纂并刊行一部萨满祭祀典礼，用来规范他担心失传的祭祀。

en:
The Andaquí were a people of the upper Caquetá basin and the valleys of the Fragua and Suaza in southern Colombia. Their name is tied to the ritual drinking of yagé, a brew for which the shamans add the flowers of the borrachero tree to meet the ‘spirit of the yagé’. In their myth the borrachero’s giant flower became the sun after the yagé entered and fertilized it.

Shamanic healing was part of the Andaquí trade between the Andes and the forest. They joined the Pijao against a Spanish settlement in 1637 and the general uprising of the Putumayo and Caquetá tribes in 1721, and resisted into the eighteenth century.
zh:
安达基人生活在哥伦比亚南部卡克塔河上游流域以及弗拉瓜河和苏阿萨河谷地。他们的族名本身就与祭礼中饮用雅赫（死藤水）有关：萨满要在药剂里加入曼陀罗树的花，才能与“雅赫之灵”相会。他们的神话说，曼陀罗的巨花在被雅赫穿透并受孕之后，变成了太阳。

萨满的医术也是安达基人在安第斯山与森林之间贸易的一部分。1637年他们同皮豪人一起攻击西班牙人的殖民点，1721年又参加了普图马约和卡克塔各部落的总起义，抵抗一直延续到18世纪。

en:
In the creation myth of the Yapese, the islanders of Yap in the western Carolines, the god Gavur li yel yel makes the four layers of the cosmos, from his own dark tier to the underworld beneath the sea, and shapes the chief god Yanolop from clay.

Yanolop in turn conjures five more sky gods, who marry and beget further generations. Yälfaath the Elder, one of the first sky gods, made the first man and woman, Ganan and Nik, from earth.

Traditionally each person has two souls: one that lives on and wanders the earth, and one that dies and is eaten by the sky god Lug. After death a ritual prayer guides the soul to Gatsam, from where it may go to heaven and be judged in Yanolop's clubhouse.
zh:
在居住于西加罗林群岛雅浦岛上的雅浦人的创世神话里，神加武尔·利·耶尔·耶尔造出宇宙的四层，从他自己所在的幽暗一层，直到海下的冥界，又用泥土塑出主神亚诺洛普。

亚诺洛普又以意念化生五位天神，他们彼此婚配，繁衍出后续的几代神。最早一代天神中的老耶尔法特用泥土造出第一对男女加南和尼克。

传统上，人有两个灵魂：一个继续存活并在大地上游荡，另一个会死去，被天神鲁格吞食。人死后，仪式性的祈祷会把灵魂引到加察姆，由那里可以升入天界，并在亚诺洛普的会所接受审判。

en:
The Yao, a Hmong-Mien-speaking people of Hunan and Guangxi, trace their descent to the ancestor Panhu, a dog turned into a man. Since the thirteenth century their faith has been so thoroughly mixed with Taoism that it is often called Yao Taoism: the principal gods are the Three Pure Ones of canonical Taoism.

Every adult Yao man is initiated into the Taoist clergy through four grades, the first called hanging the lamps. High priests perform the rites for the higher gods.

The hunter god Zhang Wulang acts as exorcist and guide of souls, because the dead are believed to return to the Caves of Meishan to find peace. After the Miao and Yao risings of the 1370s and 1449 many moved south into Guangxi, Guangdong and Yunnan.
zh:
瑶族说苗瑶语系语言，居住在湖南和广西，自称是祖先盘瓠的后代，盘瓠本是狗，后来变成了人。13世纪以来，他们的信仰与道教深度交融，常被称为瑶族道教：主神是正统道教的三清。

每个瑶族成年男子都要经过四级传度入道，第一级叫“挂灯”。高阶祭司为天上诸神举行仪式。

猎神张五郎既是驱邪者，也是引导亡魂的神，因为人们相信死者要回到梅山洞里才能安息。1370年代和1449年的苗瑶起事之后，许多人向南迁入广西、广东和云南。

en:
Yastay was remembered as the protector of the mountain animals and of the hunt in the Andes of north-western Argentina and Chile, where the Diaguita lived. In a legend of their neighbours the Huarpe, Yastay warned the proud hunter Gilanco to stop killing animals for sport. When Gilanco ignored him, Pachamama, the earth mother, swept him away in a whirlwind of hot wind, and the Zonda is said to blow whenever someone disobeys her.

The Diaguita had no priestly class, only a shaman in each village who led the rites and healed the sick. Their lands fell to the Inca in the late fifteenth century, and from 1560 to 1667 they fought the Calchaquí Wars against the Spaniards.
zh:
亚斯塔伊被人们记作山中野兽和狩猎的保护神，流传在今阿根廷西北部和智利的安第斯山区，迪亚吉塔人就生活在这里。在邻近的瓦尔佩人的传说里，亚斯塔伊警告骄横的猎手希兰科不要再为取乐而滥杀野兽。希兰科不听，大地之母帕查玛玛便用热风的旋涡把他卷走，据说每当有人违背她的意愿，松达风就会吹起。

迪亚吉塔人没有祭司阶层，每个村落只有一名萨满，主持仪式、为人治病。他们的土地在15世纪后期落入印加手中；1560年至1667年间，他们又与西班牙人打了卡尔查基战争。

en:
The Yazidis speak Kurdish. Their faith was reshaped in the 12th century by the Sufi mystic Sheikh Adi ibn Musafir, who settled at Lalish, the holiest place of the faith. Yazidis believe that God entrusted the universe to seven angels, chief of whom is Tawusi Melek.

They hold to the transmigration of souls and revere the sun, sacred springs and fire. The community is divided into three endogamous castes, the murids, sheikhs and pirs.

Neighbouring Sunni Kurds sacked Lalish in 1414. Yazidism was once the religion of Kurdish emirates such as Bohtan, but from 1566 an Ottoman fatwa by the mufti Abu al-Su'ud licensed the killing and enslavement of Yazidis.
zh:
雅兹迪人说库尔德语。他们的信仰在12世纪由苏非神秘主义者谢赫阿迪·本·穆萨菲尔重新塑造；他定居在拉利什，那里是雅兹迪教的圣地。雅兹迪人相信上帝把宇宙托付给七位天使，天使之首是塔乌西·梅莱克。

他们相信灵魂转世，崇敬太阳、圣泉和火。社群分为穆里德、谢赫和皮尔三个内婚种姓。

1414年，邻近的逊尼派库尔德部落洗劫了拉利什。雅兹迪派曾是博赫坦等库尔德公国的宗教，但自1566年起，奥斯曼帝国的穆夫提艾布·苏欧德发布法特瓦，准许杀戮雅兹迪人并奴役他们。

official_raw.en: Emerging from an $iranian_group$ tradition, it also contains elements from $judaism$, $christian$, and $muslim$. It beliefs that the universe was created by God but that he appointed the 'Peacock Angel' Tawûsî Melek to rule over it. Although it contains many influences by other religions, especially in its esoteric practices, its core is rooted in the ancient $iranian_group$ religions.
official_raw.zh: 雅兹迪教起源于$iranian_group$传统，同时也包含$judaism$、$christian$与$muslim$的元素。它认为宇宙由上帝创造，但他任命“孔雀天使”塔乌西·梅莱克统治它。尽管它受到其他宗教的许多影响，尤其是在其神秘实践中，但其核心植根于古代$iranian_group$宗教。

en:
The Sikuani, also called Guahibo, live on the savannas of the Orinoco Llanos in eastern Colombia and western Venezuela. Their faith is named for yopo, the ground seeds of the yopo tree, which a shaman, the dopatubinü, inhales to communicate with Tsamani, the giver of traditional medicine.

The Sikuani say that the goods enjoyed by humanity came from four brothers who climbed to the sky and can be seen as the Pleiades. Life and all the edible plants sprang from a great tree, Kaliawirinai, felled by Kutsikutsi with the help of the squirrels. Every dead Sikuani was honored with a second funeral, the itomo.
zh:
西夸尼人又称瓜希博人，居住在哥伦比亚东部和委内瑞拉西部的奥里诺科平原草原上。他们的信仰得名于约波树的种子磨成的粉，巫师多帕图比尼吸入约波粉，以便与赐下传统医药的察马尼沟通。

西夸尼人说，人类享有的一切财富来自四位兄弟，他们升上了天空，成为可以看到的昴星团。生命和所有可食用的植物，则出自一棵大树卡利亚维里奈，它由库齐库齐在松鼠的帮助下砍倒。每个去世的西夸尼人，都要举行第二次葬礼“伊托莫”。

en:
The Yukaghirs hunted deer, moose and sable in the Kolyma basin of north-eastern Siberia, and their tribal groups reached from the Lena to the mouth of the Anadyr when the Russians arrived in the seventeenth century. They worshipped the spirits of their ancestors, fire, the Sun, hunting, earth and water. The most important was the Sun, the highest judge in every dispute.

Every clan had a shaman, who after death was treated as a deity: his body was dismembered and the clan kept the parts as relics. Dog sacrifice, a cult of the elk with its hunting taboos, and an epic poem about crows belonged to the old hunting life.
zh:
尤卡吉尔人在西伯利亚东北部的科雷马河流域猎取鹿、驼鹿和紫貂；17世纪俄国人到来时，他们的部落东西分布，从勒拿河一直到阿纳德尔河口。他们崇拜祖先、火、太阳、狩猎、大地和水的神灵。其中最重要的是太阳，他是一切纠纷的最高裁判。

每个氏族都有自己的萨满，萨满死后被当作神明看待：遗体被肢解，各部分留在氏族中当作圣物。杀狗献祭、带有狩猎禁忌的驼鹿崇拜，以及以乌鸦为主题的史诗，都属于古老的狩猎生活。

en:
The Yuman-speaking peoples of the lower Colorado River, southern California and Baja California each told their own stories. The Mohave knew a creator, Matavilya, who gave the people their clans. His younger brother Mastamho gave them the river and taught them to plant, and young Mohave took Datura as a sacrament when they came of age. For the Kumeyaay the world was first all salt water and tule; the brothers Tuchaipa and Yokomatis made it, and Tuchaipa raised the heavens by blowing tobacco smoke three times.

Kumeyaay sacred mountains such as Kuuchamaa were hubs of spiritual power, and Coyote was the trickster who changed the world with clever and mischievous deeds. Among the Cochimí, shamans wore capes of human hair on ceremonial occasions.
zh:
讲尤玛语的各民族分布在科罗拉多河下游、南加利福尼亚和下加利福尼亚，各有各的传说。莫哈维人相信有一位创造者马塔维利亚，他把氏族分给人们。他的弟弟马斯塔姆霍赐予人们河流，并教他们耕种；莫哈维青年成年时要服用曼陀罗作为圣礼。在库米亚伊人的传说里，世界起初只有咸水和香蒲；图柴帕与兄弟约科马蒂斯造出了世界，图柴帕还吹气三次、散出烟草，使天空升起。

库米亚伊人的圣山如库恰马山是灵力的中心，郊狼是用机智和恶作剧改变世界的骗子。科奇米人中，萨满在仪式上披着用人的头发制成的斗篷。

en:
The Yup'ik of western and south-western Alaska, around the Yukon-Kuskokwim delta and Bristol Bay, were animists. The shaman was the central figure of religious life and the middleman between spirits and people, working through music, dance and masks.

The Yup'ik believed that the great sea and land mammals they lived on understood human speech and demanded respect, so hunting followed rules to honour and appease their spirits. The qasgiq, the men's communal house, was the ceremonial centre; the shaman told carvers how to make the masks worn in its dances, and the masks were destroyed after use. The Bladder Festival and the Messenger Feast were among the great ceremonies.
zh:
阿拉斯加西部和西南部的尤皮克人分布在育空-库斯科奎姆三角洲和布里斯托尔湾一带，信奉万物有灵。萨满是宗教生活的中心人物，是精灵与人之间的中介，借助音乐、舞蹈和面具来沟通。

尤皮克人相信，赖以为生的大型海兽和陆兽听得懂人的话，要求受到尊重，因此狩猎要遵守规矩，以尊崇并安抚它们的灵魂。男子公屋是举行仪式的中心；萨满指点雕刻者怎样制作公屋舞蹈时戴的面具，面具用后就要销毁。膀胱节和信使宴是其中的大典。

en:
The Taíno of the Greater Antilles centred their faith on the zemi, which was both an ancestral spirit or deity and the sculpted object that housed it. Zemis were carved from wood, bone and stone, the most characteristic form being a three-pointed stone. Priests called behikes served them, and myths were sung and danced at ceremonies called areítos.

Yúcahu, son of the mother goddess Atabey, gave the cassava harvest. The creator Yaya killed his son Yayael and hung his bones in a gourd, from which fish poured out. The Sun and Moon were said to have come out of the cave of Iguanaboina.

After Columbus arrived in 1492 the cult was driven underground. The Taíno are thought to have hidden or destroyed their zemis to keep them from the Spanish.
zh:
大安的列斯群岛的泰诺人以“泽米”为信仰核心：它既是祖先之灵或神，也指供奉这些神灵的雕像。泽米用木头、骨头和石头雕成，最典型的形制是三尖石像。服侍它们的是称作贝希克的祭司，神话则在称作阿雷伊托的仪式上歌唱舞蹈。

尤卡胡是地母神阿塔贝之子，主管木薯的收成。创世神亚亚杀死了儿子亚亚埃尔，把他的骨头挂在葫芦里，葫芦里涌出了鱼。传说太阳和月亮从伊瓜纳博伊纳洞穴里出来。

1492年哥伦布到来后，这种信仰被迫转入地下。据信泰诺人把泽米藏起来或毁掉，免得落到西班牙人手里。

en:
Zoroastrians hold that humans must choose truth over the lie through good thoughts, words and deeds, joining the struggle until good triumphs. Fire is held sacred as the symbol of Ahura Mazda and is tended in temples by priests. Zoroastrianism was the state religion of the Achaemenid and Sasanian empires until the Arab conquest in the seventh century.

Under Muslim rule Zoroastrians became a minority. After the Mongol conquest the community withdrew to Yazd. The Parsis of Gujarat moved their Iranshah fire to Navsari in 1419, and in 1478 a layman travelled to Yazd with the first of the Rivayats, letters of ritual questions to Iranian priests. From 1501 the Safavid campaign to make Iran Shia bore heavily on the Zoroastrians who remained.
zh:
祆教徒认为，人要通过善思、善言、善行选择真理而非谎言，投身斗争，直到善获胜。火被视为阿胡拉·马兹达的象征，十分神圣，由祭司在神庙中看护。祆教曾是阿契美尼德王朝和萨珊帝国的国教，直到7世纪阿拉伯征服。

在穆斯林统治下，祆教徒成为少数。蒙古人征服后，教团退居亚兹德。古吉拉特的帕西人于1419年把伊朗沙圣火迁到瑙萨里；1478年，一位平信徒前往亚兹德，带去第一封“里瓦亚特”，向伊朗祭司询问仪式问题。1501年起，萨法维王朝推行什叶派化，使留在伊朗的祆教徒境况更加艰难。

official_raw.en: An ancient $iranian_group$ religion following the teachings of Zoroaster, also called Zarathustra, and the texts of the Avesta. It is based on a dualistic cosmology of good and evil, with the eternal conflict of the deity Ahura Mazdā and the destructive spirit Angra Mainyu, with a predicted ultimate triumph of good over evil.
official_raw.zh: 琐罗亚斯德教是一种古老的$iranian_group$宗教，遵循查拉图斯特拉（也称琐罗亚斯德）的教义与《阿维斯塔》经典。它基于善与恶的二元宇宙观，描述了神阿胡拉·马兹达与破坏灵安格拉·曼纽之间的永恒冲突，并预言善将最终战胜恶。

en:
Buddhism took different paths across Asia after 1337. In Burma, King Dhammazedi reformed the monastic community between 1476 and 1479 using the Sri Lankan Mahavihara tradition; Theravada also became firmly established in Ayutthaya.

In 1578 the Mongol leader Altan Khan met Sonam Gyatso and gave him the title Dalai Lama. Their alliance brought patronage to the Gelug school, which spread throughout Mongolia in the following century. In Japan, Zen remained influential under the Ashikaga and Tokugawa rulers.
zh:
1337年后，佛教在亚洲各地的发展各有不同。在缅甸，国王达摩悉提于1476—1479年依照斯里兰卡大寺派传统改革僧团；上座部佛教也在阿瑜陀耶稳固下来。

1578年，蒙古领袖俺答汗会见索南嘉措，授予他达赖喇嘛的称号。双方的结盟为格鲁派带来支持，此派在接下来的一个世纪传遍蒙古。在日本，禅宗在足利和德川统治时期保持影响力。

official_raw.en: Having its origins from the teachings of the Buddha, meaning 'The Awakened One' and also known by his princely name Siddhārtha Gautama or by the title #italic Śākyamuni#!, $buddhist$ expanded far and wide from its source in $india$. Influencing and getting influenced by the many countries and peoples and beliefs it spread to, many different $buddhist_ADJ$ schools emerged within it, with different approaches and interpretations on the path to liberation from Saṃsāra, the cycle of death and rebirth.
official_raw.zh: $buddhist$源于佛陀（意为“觉者”，本名悉达多·乔达摩，尊称#italic 释迦牟尼#!）的教导。自$india$发源后广传四方。在传播过程中与各地文化交融，形成了不同$buddhist_ADJ$宗派，对如何通过修行从生死轮回中解脱提出了不同的法门和阐释。

en:
Christianity in western Europe underwent a major upheaval after Martin Luther published his Ninety-five Theses in 1517. The Reformation spread from Saxony, while Huldrych Zwingli and John Calvin developed reform movements in Switzerland.

In England and Scotland, Thomas Cranmer and John Knox led separate reformations. The Catholic Church responded at the Council of Trent, and the religious divisions contributed to wars across Europe. From the fifteenth to seventeenth centuries, missionaries, migration and trade carried Christianity beyond Europe.
zh:
1517年马丁·路德发表《九十五条论纲》后，西欧基督教经历了重大变革。宗教改革从萨克森传播开来，胡尔德里希·茨温利和约翰·加尔文则在瑞士发展了各自的改革运动。

在英格兰和苏格兰，托马斯·克兰麦和约翰·诺克斯分别领导了宗教改革。天主教会在特伦托会议上作出回应，宗教分裂也促成了欧洲各地的战争。15至17世纪，传教、移民和贸易将基督教带到欧洲以外。

official_raw.en: Christianity, a prominent Abrahamic faith, centers on the life and teachings of Jesus Christ, emphasizing salvation through faith and adherence to biblical principles. Its diverse branches, including Catholicism, Protestantism, and Eastern Orthodoxy, wield significant influence across the globe, shaping history, politics, and culture.
official_raw.zh: 基督教作为重要的亚伯拉罕系宗教，以耶稣基督的生平与教导为核心，强调因信得救及遵行圣经训导。其包含天主教、新教与东正教等主要分支，在全世界范围内都拥有重大影响力，并对全球历史、政治及文化产生深远影响。

en:
Among the communities of the Dharmic religions, devotional movements spread across northern and eastern India from the fifteenth century. In Bengal, Chaitanya, who lived from 1486 to 1534, inspired a tradition centered on devotion to Krishna.

In Punjab, Guru Nanak, who lived from 1469 to 1539, founded Sikhism. The Sikh scripture later included hymns by Nanak and other Sikh gurus alongside those of devotional poets such as Kabir and Namdev. The movement also influenced devotional practices among Jains.
zh:
