在正法宗教的各个社群中，虔信运动从15世纪起传遍印度北部和东部。在孟加拉，1486—1534年在世的柴坦尼亚开创了以虔信黑天为中心的传统。

在旁遮普，1469—1539年在世的古鲁那纳克创立了锡克教。锡克教经典后来收入了那纳克及其他锡克教古鲁的赞歌，也收入了卡比尔和那姆德夫等虔信诗人的作品。这场运动也影响了耆那教徒的虔信活动。

official_raw.en: $dharmic_ADJ$ religions have their origin in $india$ and all have in common the concept of 'Dharma', meaning the correct behavior and way of living according to the cosmic laws of the universe.
official_raw.zh: $dharmic_ADJ$宗教的各个教派起源于$india$，均以“正法”为核心概念，即以宇宙法则为依据的正确行为与生活方式。

en:
Druze communities in Mount Lebanon came under Ottoman rule after Sultan Selim I conquered Syria in 1516. The Ma'n family retained local authority, although an Ottoman expedition attacked the Druze in 1585.

The Druze emir Fakhr al-Din II expanded his power from the Shuf into other parts of the Levant. An Ottoman campaign forced him into exile in 1613, but he returned in 1618 and defeated the governor of Damascus at Anjar in 1623. He surrendered to the Ottomans in 1633 and was executed in Constantinople in 1635.
zh:
1516年苏丹塞利姆一世征服叙利亚后，黎巴嫩山的德鲁兹派社群归于奥斯曼统治。马恩家族保有地方权力，但奥斯曼军队于1585年出兵袭击了德鲁兹人。

德鲁兹埃米尔法赫鲁丁二世从舒夫山区向黎凡特其他地区扩张势力。1613年奥斯曼军队的进攻迫使他流亡，他于1618年返回，并在1623年的安杰尔之战中击败大马士革总督。他于1633年向奥斯曼人投降，1635年在君士坦丁堡被处决。

official_raw.en: The $druze_group$ group covers all the religions that fall under this umbrella.
official_raw.zh: $druze_group$宗教组涵盖了信奉严格一神论、遵循伊斯玛仪派原则并蕴含诺斯替主义成分的所有宗教。

en:
In Kongo, sacred burial grounds linked ruling families to their ancestors. After Portuguese visitors arrived, King Nzinga a Nkuwu was baptized in 1491 as João I, but later abandoned Catholicism.

Christianity also acquired local expressions in Kongo. The prophet Kimpa Vita, trained as a religious medium, taught that Jesus and other Christian figures came from Kongo; King Pedro IV had her burned in 1706.
zh:
在刚果，神圣的墓地将统治家族与祖先联系起来。葡萄牙人到来后，国王恩津加·恩库武于1491年受洗，取名若昂一世，但后来放弃了天主教。

基督教在刚果也形成了地方性的表达。接受过灵媒训练的女先知金帕·维塔宣称耶稣和其他基督教人物来自刚果；国王佩德罗四世于1706年将她处以火刑。

en:
Among the Mapuche of southwestern Argentina and south-central Chile, machi communicated with spirits for healing and divination, while communal ceremonies included offerings and animal sacrifice. Spanish accounts from the sixteenth century onward described these beliefs amid warfare and Catholic missionary efforts.

Farther north, Jesuits established missions among the Guaraní in the early seventeenth century, gathering Indigenous people into settlements for Christian instruction. The Spanish crown expelled the Jesuits from the missions in 1767.
zh:
在阿根廷西南部和智利中南部的马普切人中，马奇通过与神灵交流治病和占卜；集体仪式则包括献祭和供奉。16世纪起，西班牙人的记载在战争和天主教传教的背景下描述了这些信仰。

更北方的瓜拉尼人地区，耶稣会士于17世纪初建立传教区，将原住民集中到聚居地接受基督教教导。1767年，西班牙王室将耶稣会士逐出传教区。

en:
Among the Pueblo peoples of the northern part of arid North America, religious practices were tied to rain and crops. Spanish soldiers reached Pueblo lands in 1540, and Franciscan missionaries later sought to replace local worship with Christianity.

In New Mexico, Alonso de Posada forbade Kachina dances and ordered ritual objects burned during his tenure from 1656 to 1665. Persecution of Pueblo religion helped provoke the revolt of 1680, which drove the Spanish from the province until their return in 1692.
zh:
在北美干旱地区北部的普韦布洛人中，宗教活动与降雨和作物息息相关。西班牙士兵于1540年抵达普韦布洛人的土地，方济各会传教士后来试图以基督教取代当地的祭祀。

在新墨西哥，阿隆索·德·波萨达于1656—1665年任职期间禁止卡奇那舞蹈，并下令焚烧仪式用品。对普韦布洛宗教的迫害促成了1680年的起义，西班牙人被逐出该省，直到1692年才返回。

en:
In Yunnan, Nakhi Dongba priests preserved ritual writings and performed ceremonies for gods and spirits of the natural world. Nakhi temples brought Dongba imagery together with Buddhist influences, while people at Baidi honoured the Shu nature spirits.

On Taiwan, Dutch rule from 1624 to 1662 brought a different encounter: missionaries taught Christianity and devised Romanized scripts for Indigenous languages. Among the Siraya, the resulting Sinkang script was still used in land contracts in the eighteenth century.
zh:
在云南，纳西族东巴保存仪式经书，并为自然界的神灵举行仪式。纳西族寺庙将东巴神像与佛教影响结合起来，白地的居民则祭祀自然神署。

在台湾，1624—1662年的荷兰统治带来了另一种遭遇：传教士传播基督教，并为原住民语言创制拉丁字母文字。西拉雅人使用的新港文书到了18世纪仍被用来书写土地契约。

en: Aboriginal ancestral beings were associated with the creation and meaning of places such as Uluru and Kata Tjuta. The Warlpiri called this complex of traditions Jukurrpa; it connected people and their ancestors to places and living things. In New South Wales, the Church Missionary Society established a mission in Wellington Valley in 1832 to convert Aboriginal people to Christianity.
zh: 在澳大利亚原住民的传统中，祖先神灵与乌鲁鲁和卡塔丘塔等地点的形成及其意义相联系。瓦尔皮里人称这套传统为梦创神话，将人及其祖先与特定的地方和生灵联系起来。在新南威尔士，教会传教协会于1832年在惠灵顿谷建立传教站，试图使原住民改信基督教。

en:
Guaraní communities in southern Brazil and neighbouring regions passed accounts of gods and spirits down orally, with narratives varying from place to place. In the early seventeenth century, Jesuits established missions among the Guaraní across the region where Brazil, Paraguay and Argentina meet.

The missions gathered Indigenous people into settlements for Christian instruction and offered some protection from enslavement. Raids by Brazilian slave traders led to the formation of armed Guaraní militias; in 1767 the Spanish crown expelled the Jesuits from its missions.
zh:
巴西南部及邻近地区的瓜拉尼人以口述方式传承神灵故事，各地的叙事有所不同。17世纪初，耶稣会士在巴西、巴拉圭与阿根廷交界一带的瓜拉尼人中建立传教区。

传教区将原住民集中到聚居地接受基督教教导，也提供了一定的保护，使他们免遭奴役。巴西奴隶贩子的袭击促使瓜拉尼人组建武装民兵；1767年，西班牙王室将耶稣会士逐出其传教区。

en:
Across the Greater Antilles, Taíno people honoured zemis, ancestral spirits and sacred figures represented in stone, wood and other materials. Ceremonial performances called areitos combined dance, music and speech to preserve stories and mark events such as harvests and the deaths of chiefs.

Columbus encountered Taíno communities in the Bahamas in 1492. Spanish conquest, forced labour and disease devastated their populations, while some ceremonial objects appear to have been hidden in caves from the newcomers.
zh:
在大安的列斯群岛，泰诺人崇敬泽米、祖灵和神圣人物，并用石头、木头等材料塑造神像。称为阿雷伊托的仪式表演结合舞蹈、音乐和讲述，保存故事，也纪念收获和酋长去世等事件。

1492年，哥伦布在巴哈马遇到泰诺人社群。西班牙人的征服、强迫劳动和疾病使当地人口锐减，一些仪式用品似乎被藏进洞穴，以免落入来者之手。

en:
In Talamanca, spanning southeastern Costa Rica and northern Panama, Bribri communities preserved spiritual practices amid resistance to Spanish rule. In 1709 the Indigenous leader Pablo Presbere led an uprising against forced removal and missionary establishments; rebels burned churches, and the Spanish captured him the following year.

Farther south, the Muisca of the Colombian highlands worshipped at Lake Guatavita and at temples of the sun and moon. Spanish conquest came in 1537–1540; a public Muisca ceremony was still held at Ubaque in 1563.
zh:
在横跨哥斯达黎加东南部和巴拿马北部的塔拉曼卡，布里布里人社群在抵抗西班牙统治的过程中保存了自己的信仰仪俗。1709年，原住民领袖巴勃罗·普雷斯贝雷领导起义，反对强制迁徙和传教机构；起义者焚烧教堂，西班牙人于次年俘获了他。

更南方的哥伦比亚高地，穆伊斯卡人在瓜塔维塔湖以及太阳神庙和月亮神庙祭祀。西班牙人于1537—1540年征服当地，但1563年穆伊斯卡人仍在乌瓦克举行过公开仪式。

en:
In Lithuania, Grand Duke Jogaila promoted Catholic baptism in 1387; his cousin Vytautas followed in Samogitia in 1413. Older Lithuanian myths nevertheless survived in stories, customs and festivals; from the late sixteenth century Jesuit missionaries also drew on popular beliefs in their work.

Farther north in Sápmi, local sacred places included unusual rocks and other features of the landscape. Sámi ritual specialists known as noaidi used drums in ceremonies to mediate between their communities and the spirit world.
zh:
在立陶宛，大公约盖拉于1387年推动民众接受天主教洗礼；他的堂兄弟维陶塔斯于1413年在萨莫吉希亚推行洗礼。较早的立陶宛神话仍在故事、习俗和节庆中流传；16世纪末起，耶稣会传教士也在传教中利用民间信仰。

更北方的萨米地区，当地圣地包括形状奇特的岩石等自然景物。被称为诺艾迪的萨米仪式专家在仪式中使用鼓，为社群与灵界沟通。

en:
Melanesian oral traditions preserved distinct accounts of the origins of land and sea. On New Britain's Gazelle Peninsula, the brothers To-Kabinana and To-Karvuvu were said to have fished the land up from the sea, while a Baining story told how a concealed waterhole spread to become the ocean.

In Fiji, spiritual leaders known as bete held an important place in communities governed by chiefs and elders. The ceremonial preparation and drinking of yaqona formed part of Fijian community rites. In the early nineteenth century, European missionaries, especially Methodists, began working in Fiji.
zh:
美拉尼西亚原始宗教的口传传统保留了各不相同的陆地与海洋起源故事。在新不列颠岛的加泽勒半岛，传说兄弟托卡比纳纳和托卡尔武武从海底钓起陆地；拜宁人的故事则讲述一处藏起来的水坑如何扩展成海洋。

在斐济，被称为贝特的宗教领袖在由酋长和长老治理的社群中占有重要地位。仪式性地制备和饮用卡瓦酒是斐济社群礼仪的一部分。19世纪初，欧洲传教士开始在斐济活动，其中尤以循道宗传教士为多。

en:
Micronesian traditions varied from island to island. On Kosrae, stories named Sinlaka as a goddess of breadfruit and Nalik as a patron of canoe building; on Guam, Chamorro beliefs included the spirits of ancestral people known as Taotao Mona.

Guam also had ritual specialists known as makhanas and healers called suruhanus. In 1668 Jesuit missionaries led by Diego Luis de San Vitores arrived on Guam to introduce Christianity, and the Catholic Church became a centre of village life.
zh:
密克罗尼西亚原始宗教的传统因岛屿而异。在科斯雷岛的故事中，辛拉卡是面包果女神，纳利克是造舟的守护神；关岛的查莫罗人则信奉被称为陶陶莫纳的祖灵。

关岛还有被称为马卡纳的仪式专家和被称为苏鲁哈努的医者。1668年，迭戈·路易斯·德·圣比托雷斯率领耶稣会传教士抵达关岛，传播基督教，天主教会逐渐成为村庄生活的中心。

en:
North American Indigenous traditions included the Algonquian concept of manitou, a spirit or spiritual power, and the Lakota understanding of Wakan Tanka, or Great Sacredness. Stories and oral histories carried beliefs and practices between generations.

In Spanish New Mexico, Franciscan missionaries sought to replace Pueblo worship with Christianity and forbade traditional ceremonies. Religious persecution helped provoke the Pueblo Revolt of 1680, which expelled the Spanish settlers from the province until their return in 1692.
zh:
北美洲原始宗教的传统包括阿尔冈昆人的马尼图观念，即灵或灵力，以及拉科塔人的瓦坎坦卡观念，即伟大的神圣力量。故事和口述历史使信仰与习俗代代相传。

在西属新墨西哥，方济各会传教士试图用基督教取代普韦布洛人的信仰，禁止传统仪式。宗教迫害促成了1680年的普韦布洛起义，西班牙殖民者被逐出该省，直到1692年才返回。

en: In Papuan traditions, imunu was a power understood to inhabit things, including ritual objects. Masked ceremonies gave this power a human or ancestral form.
zh: 巴布亚原始宗教中的伊穆努被视为存在于事物之中的力量，仪式物品也具有这种力量。戴面具的仪式赋予它人或祖先的形象。

en:
Permic traditions faced Christian missions in the lands of the Komi and Udmurt peoples. In 1376 Stephen of Perm began preaching along the Vychegda and Vym rivers; he destroyed sacred birches and became the first bishop of Perm in 1383.

Among the Udmurts, Ivan IV granted privileges to baptized families in 1557. In the mid-eighteenth century, a stronger campaign sent missionaries to build churches and schools, while sacred groves and traditional places of prayer were destroyed.
zh:
彼尔姆原始宗教在科米人和乌德穆尔特人的土地上面临基督教传教活动。1376年，彼尔姆的斯捷潘开始沿维切格达河和维姆河传教；他毁坏神圣的桦树，并于1383年成为首任彼尔姆主教。

1557年，伊凡四世向受洗的乌德穆尔特家庭授予特权。18世纪中叶，力度更大的传教运动派遣传教士修建教堂和学校，神林与传统祈祷场所也遭到破坏。

en:
Andean communities worshipped local and regional sacred beings as well as the gods of the Inca Empire. The Incas promoted the cult of the Sun while allowing local worship and incorporating some conquered peoples' deities into their religious order.

After the Spanish conquest, the Taki Unquy movement arose around 1564 in Huamanga and spread across the Andes. Its followers rejected the imposed Christian god and called for renewed worship of the huacas; Spanish officials suppressed the movement, which declined by about 1572.
zh:
安第斯原始宗教的信众既祭拜地方和地区性的神灵，也祭拜印加帝国的神祇。印加人推广太阳崇拜，同时允许地方祭祀，并将部分被征服民族的神祇纳入自己的宗教秩序。

西班牙征服后，塔基翁奎运动约于1564年在瓦曼加兴起，随后传遍安第斯地区。信众拒绝被强加的基督教神，呼吁恢复对瓦卡神灵的祭拜；西班牙官员镇压了这一运动，运动到1572年左右衰落。

en:
Polynesian oral traditions carried related stories across distant islands. In some island groups Tangaroa was a god of the sea and fishing, while stories of the trickster Māui were widely known.

In Hawaiʻi, the kapu system regulated food and relations between men and women. In 1819 King Kamehameha II ate with women, breaking the taboo; opponents of the change were defeated at Kuamoʻo that December. Christian missionaries arrived a few months later, hastening the decline of the old religion.
zh:
波利尼西亚原始宗教的口传传统在相距遥远的岛屿间流传着相近的故事。在一些岛群，唐加罗阿是海洋和渔业之神，而有关机智善变的毛伊的故事也广为人知。

在夏威夷，卡普禁戒制度规范食物和男女关系。1819年，卡美哈梅哈二世与女子同食，打破了禁戒；反对变革者于同年12月在库阿莫奥战败。基督教传教士数月后抵达，加速了旧信仰的衰落。

en:
In the Philippines, traditions within South East Asian folk religion included offerings to ancestral spirits and nature deities. Visayan ritual specialists known as babaylan acted as mediums in ceremonies for communicating with spirits.

Miguel López de Legazpi's expedition reached Cebu in 1565, beginning the Spanish conquest of the Philippines. Spanish colonizers subsequently burned some Indigenous religious writings and images of deities, while missionaries sought to spread Christianity.
zh:
在菲律宾，东南亚原始宗教的传统包括向祖灵和自然神献祭。米沙鄢人称为巴巴伊兰的仪式专家在与灵沟通的仪式中充当媒介。

米格尔·洛佩斯·德莱加斯皮的远征队于1565年抵达宿务，开始了西班牙对菲律宾的征服。此后，西班牙殖民者焚毁了一些原住民宗教文书和神像，传教士则致力于传播基督教。

en:
Among the Muisca of the Colombian highlands, South American religious traditions included worship at sacred lakes and temples. Their priests honoured the Sun god Sué at Suamox and the Moon goddess Chía at the temple in Chía; rituals also used coca, tobacco and yopo obtained through trade with peoples to the east.

Spanish forces conquered the Muisca between 1537 and 1540. A public Muisca religious ceremony was held at Ubaque in 1563, decades after the conquest.
zh:
在哥伦比亚高地的穆伊斯卡人中，南美洲原始宗教的传统包括在神圣湖泊和神庙举行祭祀。祭司在苏阿莫克斯祭拜太阳神苏埃，在奇亚的神庙祭拜月神奇亚；仪式中也使用古柯、烟草和通过贸易从东部民族处获得的约波。

西班牙军队于1537—1540年征服了穆伊斯卡人。征服几十年后，穆伊斯卡人于1563年在乌瓦克举行了一场公开宗教仪式。

en:
Communities of the Israelite traditions faced upheaval in different lands. Spain expelled its Jews in 1492, while Jews were readmitted to England in 1655. In revolutionary France, legal restrictions on Jews were abolished in 1791.

Samaritans maintained a separate tradition centered on Mount Gerizim near Nablus. Ottoman records counted communities in Nablus and Gaza in 1525–1526; by the seventeenth century, persecution and conversion had reduced their numbers. In 1624 the Samaritan high priestly line changed, and access to the mountain's summit was forbidden.
zh:
以色列宗教的社群在不同地区经历了动荡。西班牙于1492年驱逐犹太人，英格兰则于1655年重新准许犹太人定居。法国大革命期间，针对犹太人的法律限制于1791年被废除。

撒玛利亚人保持着独立的传统，以纳布卢斯附近的基利心山为中心。1525—1526年的奥斯曼记录记载了纳布卢斯和加沙的撒玛利亚社群；到17世纪，迫害和改宗使他们的人数减少。1624年，撒玛利亚大祭司的传承谱系发生更替，信徒也被禁止登上山顶。

official_raw.en: The Jews, descendants of ancient Hebrews, have spread across the known world after the destruction of their homeland. Bound by faith and tradition, they contribute as merchants, scholars, and craftsmen, while maintaining a connection to their shared heritage. Dispersed yet united, they embody a resilient identity, keeping the eternal hope for Zion alive in their hearts.
official_raw.zh: 作为古希伯来人的后裔，犹太人自失去故土以来便散居于世界各地。他们以信仰和传统为纽带，在各国作为商人、学者和工匠活跃，同时坚守着共同的文化传承。尽管流散于天涯海角，他们却始终保持着团结，这个坚韧的民族始终将重返锡安的希望铭记于心。

en:
Mandaean communities in southern Mesopotamia attracted the attention of European missionaries in the sixteenth century. Portuguese Jesuits encountered Mandaeans near the Strait of Hormuz in 1559 and called them Christians of Saint John. The name reflected their reverence for John the Baptist, although they followed their own religious tradition.

In Basra, Carmelite missionaries used the same name during the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. Across the border in Iran, Mandaeans suffered persecution under Qajar rule in the 1780s.
zh:
16世纪，美索不达米亚南部的曼达派社群引起了欧洲传教士的注意。1559年，葡萄牙耶稣会士在霍尔木兹海峡附近遇到曼达派信徒，称他们为圣约翰基督徒。这个名称反映出他们对施洗约翰的尊崇，但他们遵循自己的宗教传统。

16至17世纪，巴士拉的加尔默罗会传教士也使用了同一名称。在边境另一侧的伊朗，曼达派信徒于18世纪80年代遭到卡扎尔政权迫害。

official_raw.en: The $mandean_group$ faith groups the ethnoreligious communities that follow this gnostic monotheistic religion.
official_raw.zh: $mandean_group$宗教组是由多个信奉诺斯替一神论的民族宗教社群所共同组成的宗教团体。

en:
Manichaeism revived in China under the Yuan dynasty after centuries of persecution. At Cao'an in Fujian, a temple originally built as a thatched hut was rebuilt in stone in 1339.

The Ming emperor Hongwu banned the religion in 1370. Its followers increasingly blended their practices with Buddhism and Daoism, and later worshippers regarded Cao'an as a Buddhist temple. In Chinese Manichaean teaching, Mani was called the Buddha of Light, while a Daoist text used by believers described him as a reincarnation of Laozi.
zh:
摩尼教在中国经历数百年迫害后，于元朝时期复兴。福建草庵原是一座茅屋，1339年重建为石造寺庙。

明朝洪武皇帝于1370年禁止摩尼教。信徒逐渐将其仪式与佛教、道教融合，后来的礼拜者将草庵视为佛寺。在中国摩尼教的教导中，摩尼被称为光明佛；信徒使用的一部道教经典则称他是老子的化身。

official_raw.en: $manichean_group$ refers to those faiths related to the life philosophies that emerged from the teachings of the prophet Mani.
official_raw.zh: $manichaean_group$是源自先知摩尼所创教义的宗教思想体系，强调光明与黑暗的永恒斗争及灵魂的救赎。

en:
Islam spread along Southeast Asian trade routes, with Malacca becoming a center from which the faith traveled to other ports. Sufi orders carried it to Mindanao around 1380, while Muslim traders and missionaries reached the Cham in Vietnam.

In the west, the Ottoman conquest of Constantinople in 1453 brought the Byzantine capital under Muslim rule. In the sixteenth century, Safavid conversion policies helped establish Shia Islam across much of Iran and Azerbaijan, while the Ottomans extended their rule into Hungary.
zh:
伊斯兰教沿东南亚的贸易航线传播，马六甲成为信仰传往其他港口的中心。约1380年，苏非教团将它带到棉兰老岛；穆斯林商人和传教士也接触到越南的占婆人。

在西方，奥斯曼人于1453年攻占君士坦丁堡，使拜占庭首都落入穆斯林统治之下。16世纪，萨法维王朝的改宗政策推动什叶派在伊朗和阿塞拜疆大部分地区扎根；奥斯曼人的统治则扩展到匈牙利。

official_raw.en: Islam, a monotheistic religion founded by Prophet Muḥammad in the 7th century, espouses the belief in one God (Allāh) and follows the teachings of the $common_string_quran$. With its various denominations like Sunni and Shia, Islam has profoundly impacted societies, fostering cultural, scientific, and political advancements across continents.
official_raw.zh: 伊斯兰教是由先知穆罕默德于7世纪创立的一神论宗教，信奉独一真主安拉并遵行$common_string_quran$教导。其包含逊尼派与什叶派等不同教派，深刻影响了各大洲社会，促进了文化、科学及政治的发展。

en:
In Yucatán, Maní served as a Maya religious centre honouring Kukulcan, with an annual festival held there until 1341. After the Spanish arrived, the Xiu rulers of Maní allied with them; the conversion of a Xiu lord encouraged other western Maya lords to accept Spanish rule.

In 1562 the Franciscan Diego de Landa ordered Maya books and images burned at Maní. Farther south, the Itza of Petén resisted Franciscan attempts to convert them in 1618 and 1619.
zh:
在尤卡坦，马尼是玛雅人敬奉库库尔坎的宗教中心，每年的祭典一直举行到1341年。西班牙人到来后，马尼的休家族统治者与他们结盟；一位休家族领主皈依天主教，促使其他西部玛雅领主接受西班牙统治。

1562年，方济各会士雅各伯·德·兰达下令在马尼焚烧玛雅书籍和神像。更南方的佩滕地区，伊察人在1618年和1619年抵制了方济各会士的传教。

en:
Yazidi religious life centered on Lalish, where the tomb of Sheikh Adi drew pilgrims to the annual Feast of the Assembly. From the fourteenth century, religious reciters carried sacred peacock emblems from Shekhan to Yazidi villages.

In 1414 an alliance of neighboring Kurdish tribes raided Lalish. Under Ottoman rule, Yazidi leaders sometimes held provincial offices, but the community also faced military campaigns. An Ottoman expedition attacked the Yazidis of Sinjar in 1613, and another took the mountain in 1640 after heavy fighting.
zh:
雅兹迪派的宗教生活以拉利什为中心，谢赫阿迪的陵墓吸引信徒在一年一度的集会节前来朝圣。14世纪起，宗教赞唱者从谢汉携带神圣的孔雀徽像，走访雅兹迪村落。

1414年，邻近的库尔德部落联军袭击了拉利什。在奥斯曼统治下，雅兹迪领袖有时担任地方官职，但社群也遭到军事征讨。1613年奥斯曼军队进攻辛贾尔的雅兹迪人，1640年另一支军队经过激战攻占了这片山区。

official_raw.en: The $yazidi_group$ faiths are those beliefs of the ethnoreligious group known as $yazidism_ADJ$.
official_raw.zh: $yazidi_group$宗教组涵盖了那些被称为“孔雀天使国度”的独特族裔宗教群体所持守的信仰体系。

en:
Zoroastrian communities survived in Iran around Yazd and Kerman, while descendants of Iranian migrants became known as Parsis in Gujarat. Between 1478 and 1766, priests in India exchanged letters with their Iranian counterparts on religious and social questions.

In 1742 the sacred fire of Sanjan was moved to Udvada after disputes over priestly jurisdiction. Parsi families also followed the East India Company from Surat to Bombay as trade expanded there.
zh:
祆教社群在伊朗的亚兹德和克尔曼一带延续下来，移居印度的伊朗人后裔则在古吉拉特被称为帕西人。1478—1766年间，印度的祭司与伊朗的同教者通信，商讨宗教和社会问题。

由于祭司管辖权争议，桑詹的圣火于1742年迁到乌德瓦达。随着贸易发展，帕西家庭也跟随东印度公司从苏拉特迁往孟买。

official_raw.en: $zoroastrian_group$ is a grouping of religions that follow the faith created by Zoroaster.
official_raw.zh: $zoroastrian_group$宗教组（即琐罗亚斯德教）是尊奉先知琐罗亚斯德的教诲、以其启示为核心所建立的信仰体系。

en: Sources report an Adamite sect in North Africa in the second to fourth centuries. In fifteenth-century Bohemia the Adamites, or Pikarti, broke from the radical Taborites and founded a commune on an island in the Nežárka river. They held goods in common and rejected the priesthood and transubstantiation. In 1421 Jan Žižka attacked and suppressed them.
zh: 史料说2至4世纪的北非曾有亚当派。15世纪的波希米亚，亚当派（又称皮卡尔派）从胡斯派激进的塔博尔派中分裂出来，在内扎尔卡河的一座岛上建立了公社。他们实行财产公有，否认神职和圣餐变体论。1421年，扬·杰式卡进攻并镇压了他们。

official_raw.en: The Adamite sect insists upon nakedness during church services. Without the stylings of status or culture, we appear as equals in the eyes of God, a stark reminder of our shared humanity and of the innocence we enjoyed before the Fall.
official_raw.zh: 亚当派的信条要求其信徒在进行礼拜时应赤身裸体。洗脱了身份地位和文化的浮饰，我们在上帝的眼里都是平等的，这都提醒着我们，人类在犯下堕落的原罪之前，曾共同享受着人性和天真的愉悦。

en: Some scholars see adoptionism in the earliest Christian writings, but church leaders condemned it as heresy in the fourth and fifth centuries. In the 780s Elipandus, Archbishop of Toledo, and Felix, Bishop of Urgell, revived it in Spain, calling Christ the adopted son in his humanity. The Council of Frankfurt, called by Charlemagne, condemned it in 794.
zh: 有学者认为最早期的基督教文献中就有嗣子论，但教会领袖在4至5世纪把它定为异端。8世纪80年代，托莱多大主教埃利潘杜斯和乌赫尔主教菲利克斯在西班牙使其复兴，称基督在人性上是养子。查理大帝召集的法兰克福会议于794年谴责了它。

official_raw.en: Our belief posits that Jesus Christ became God's Son at his baptism or resurrection, rather than being eternally divine.
official_raw.zh: 我们的信条主张：耶稣基督于受洗或复活后方成为上帝之子，而非永恒具有神性。

en: In Zürich in 1525 Conrad Grebel and his followers began rebaptizing adults and were called Anabaptists. Felix Manz, one of them, was drowned in the Limmat in 1527 under a council ban on rebaptism.
zh: 1525年，康拉德·格雷贝尔及其追随者在苏黎世开始为成年人重新施洗，被称为再洗礼派。其中的菲利克斯·曼茨因市议会禁止再洗礼，于1527年在林特河中被淹死。

official_raw.en: Being baptized as an adult on the basis of profession of faith in Jesus Christ and as admission into a local community of faith is made by those who believe that saving grace and Church membership are gifts from God. The recipient's faith must be vocalized and cannot be imparted or transferred from one person to another.
official_raw.zh: 基于对耶稣基督宣示信仰并加入地方信众团体，成人受洗者坚信救赎恩典与教会成员资格乃神所赐。受洗者须亲口表明信仰，此恩无法转移或代受。

en:
Early Christians such as Tertullian and Clement of Alexandria held the Ten Commandments to be binding, and the Byzantine iconoclasm of the eighth century turned the question into open conflict.

Medieval dualist groups went further: Byzantine writers charged the Paulicians with rejecting the cross, and the Bogomils discarded it too. In the sixteenth century Calvinists stripped images from their churches.
zh:
早期基督徒如德尔图良和亚历山大的克雷芒认为十诫对基督徒有约束力，8世纪拜占庭的圣像破坏运动更把这个问题变成了公开冲突。

中世纪的二元论教派走得更远：拜占庭作者指责保禄派拒绝十字架，鲍格米勒派同样弃之不用。16世纪，加尔文宗信徒把图像从自己的教堂中清除出去。

official_raw.en: Symbols are not a proper way to represent our Lord, as they are means to represent idols or people. We will reject any representation, including the cross used by other Christians.
official_raw.zh: 任何具象化象征均属偶像崇拜或人为造作，并非表达我主信仰的正确方式。我们拒绝接受所有形象化宗教符号，其他基督教派别使用的十字架亦在此列。

en:
Jacobus Arminius (1560–1609) studied under Calvin's successor Theodore Beza but rejected unconditional election. For Arminius, God's election was of believers, conditional on faith, and grace could be resisted.

After his death his followers set out their views in the Five Articles of Remonstrance (1610) and were called Remonstrants. The Synod of Dort of 1618–19 condemned them as heretics; Holland officially tolerated them again about twelve years later.
zh:
雅各·阿民念（1560—1609）曾师从加尔文的继承人西奥多·贝扎，却不接受上帝无条件拣选的说法。在阿民念看来，拣选针对信徒，以信仰为条件，恩典也可以被抗拒。

他去世后，追随者在1610年的《抗辩五条》中陈述主张，因此被称为抗辩派。1618—1619年的多特会议把他们定为异端；约十二年后，荷兰官方重新容许他们存在。

official_raw.en: Arminianism is based on the pluralistic and humanitarian ideas of the Dutch Reformed theologian Jacobus Arminius.
official_raw.zh: 阿民念派是以荷兰改革宗神学家雅各·阿民念所提出的人道主义与多元主义神学思想为基础的派别。

en: The Bogomils sought purity through fasting and prayer, convinced that matter was Satan's work. Cathar Perfects renounced property, sex and meat. Around 1173 the rich merchant Peter Waldo gave away his goods to preach apostolic poverty, and his followers, the Waldensians, made voluntary poverty a mark of their movement.
zh: 鲍格米勒派相信物质是撒旦的作品，通过禁食和祈祷追求洁净；清洁派的完人则舍弃财产、性和肉食。约1173年，富商彼得·瓦勒度散尽家财，宣讲使徒式的清贫；他的追随者瓦勒度派把自愿守贫当作这一运动的标志。

official_raw.en: Materialistic pursuits blind us to the divine truth. Only by devoting ourselves to live simple lives without luxury can we achieve spiritual enlightenment.
official_raw.zh: 物质享受会阻碍我们认识神圣真理。唯有摒弃奢侈、保持简朴生活，才能获得灵性觉醒。

en: Early modern Catholic reports say that the Paulicians of the Balkans baptised with fire rather than water, which the English diplomat Paul Rycaut confirmed. Byzantine emperors had moved the sect to Thrace from the eighth century, and some of its members later turned Orthodox, Muslim or Catholic.
zh: 近代早期的天主教徒报告说，巴尔干的保禄派用火而不用水施洗，英国外交官保罗·里科特的记述也证实了这一点。拜占庭皇帝自8世纪起把这一教派迁往色雷斯，其成员后来有的改宗东正教，有的成为穆斯林，有的改信天主教。

official_raw.en: Our faith does not believe that baptims by water is permanent, as Saint John the Baptist admited. It is only by touching the four sides of the head of a person with a burning candle that a permanent baptism can happen.
official_raw.zh: 我们的信仰并不认可水洗礼的永久，正如施洗者圣约翰所承认的那样。只有用燃烧的蜡烛触碰一个人头部的四个方向，才能实现永久的洗礼。

en: Communion under both kinds ran against the Catholic Church of the time, in which only priests drank the consecrated wine. Jakoubek of Stříbro taught the doctrine in Prague in 1414. The chalice became the emblem of the Hussites, who made it one of the Four Articles of Prague in 1420, and later Lutheran and Reformed churches adopted it too.
zh: 兼领圣餐与当时的天主教会相悖，那时只有神父才能饮用圣化的酒。雅各贝克·斯特希布罗于1414年在布拉格宣讲这一教义。圣杯成为胡斯派的标志，1420年它被列为《布拉格四条款》之一；后来路德宗和改革宗教会也采用了饼酒同领。

official_raw.en: We believe that only a communion which includes both bread and wine is valid, even for lay members. Our clergymen will administer the communion under both kinds to every member of the service.
official_raw.zh: 我们坚信圣餐必须同时领受饼与酒才有效，包括平信徒亦如此。神职人员需向全体信徒分发酒与饼两种形式的圣餐。

en:
In the Greek city-states no central authority governed belief, so worship was regulated by each polis. Its priests were mostly drawn from the local elite, and its festivals bound the citizens together.

The Panathenaia of Athens, put in order by Peisistratos in 566 BC, ended in a procession up the Acropolis and sacrifices to Athena. Rome held the same view, that the peace of the gods depended on traditional rites performed correctly.
zh:
在希腊城邦里，信仰没有中央权威管辖，崇拜由各个城邦自行规范。祭司多出自本地的精英家族，节庆则把公民凝聚在一起。

雅典的泛雅典娜节由庇西特拉图在公元前566年整顿定型，节日以列队登上卫城、向雅典娜献祭告终。罗马人也持同样的看法，认为诸神的和平取决于传统仪式被如实举行。

official_raw.en: Honoring the gods is the same as maintaining the well-being of the state. Therefore, religious practices and ceremonies are a civic duty that we must uphold to ensure the prosperity of our polis.
official_raw.zh: 敬神等同于维护国家的利好。因此，为确保城邦的繁荣，宗教仪轨与庆典是我们必须履行的公民职责。

en: Peter Waldo's followers practised clerical poverty from the 1170s, and the Oxford theologian John Wycliffe insisted on the radical poverty of all clergy in the fourteenth century. The Hussites carried the idea into Bohemia: the Four Articles of Prague of 1420 called for priests to give up secular power.
zh: 彼得·瓦勒度的追随者自12世纪70年代起实行神职清贫，14世纪的牛津神学家约翰·威克里夫则主张所有神职人员都必须彻底守贫。胡斯派把这一主张带到波希米亚：1420年的《布拉格四条款》要求神职人员放弃世俗权力。

official_raw.en: The Clergy should own no riches and give up their material possessions. They should devote their attention to God rather than the secular world.
official_raw.zh: 神职人员不可积累财富，应当舍弃世俗财物，专注侍奉神而非世俗事务。

en:
The consolamentum, called heretication by its Catholic opponents, was the only sacrament of the Cathars. It was understood as a baptism in the Holy Spirit, bringing absolution and the power to preach.

Men and women alike received it, only twice in a lifetime: on confirmation in the faith and on the point of death. Those consoled became the Cathar Perfect.
zh:
神慰圣事（拉丁语 consolamentum）被天主教的反对者称为“异端化”，是清洁派唯一的圣事。它被理解为圣灵中的洗礼，带来赦罪和传道的权能。

男女都可以领受，一生只有两次：确认入教时和临终前。领受者成为清洁派的“完人”。

official_raw.en: As the process of living incurs, inevitably, in regret for our sins, the need to receive a consolation to enter Heaven pure and move closer to God becomes obvious. By receiving the #italic Consolamentum#!, our people are absolved of their sins upon impending death,
official_raw.zh: 因生活过程必然伴随对罪孽的悔恨，为纯洁进入天堂并亲近神，接受#italic 慰藉礼#!成为必要。民众临死前通过此礼得赦罪。

en:
Parliament's Act of Supremacy of 1534 made Henry VIII Supreme Head of the Church of England, replacing the pope. In 1558 the act under Elizabeth I gave her the title Supreme Governor.

In the Holy Roman Empire, Lutheran princes took over church government as emergency bishops, and the Peace of Augsburg of 1555 let each prince decide the faith of his territory.
zh:
1534年议会通过《至尊法案》，亨利八世取代教宗成为英格兰教会的最高首脑。1558年伊丽莎白一世时期的法案则授予她“最高管理者”的称号。

在神圣罗马帝国，路德宗诸侯以“紧急主教”的身份接管教会事务，1555年的《奥格斯堡和约》又允许各诸侯决定自己领地的信仰。

official_raw.en: The Church is no longer subject to one external, corrupt theocrat. Instead, all religious issues shall be now redirected to the ruler who serves as the new Head of the Faith.
official_raw.zh: 教会不再从属于外部腐败的神权机构。所有宗教事务由世俗统治者裁决，君主成为信仰最高领袖。

en: Statues of the household Lares stood at the table during family meals, and their blessing was sought at important family events. Other Lares guarded roads, fields, towns and the state. Neighbourhood Lares had crossroad shrines, the focus of the Compitalia, where freedmen and slaves served as cult officials. Unofficial cults survived into the early fifth century.
zh: 家宅拉尔的神像在家人用餐时摆在餐桌上，家中的一切重要场合都要求得他们的祝福。另一些拉尔守护道路、田地、城镇乃至国家。街坊的拉尔供奉在十字路口的神龛里，那里是十字路口节的中心，被释奴和奴隶都可以担任祭祀人员。非官方的崇拜一直延续到5世纪初。

official_raw.en: The domestic and familiar gods play a very important role for the people of our country. They protect and influence everything that happens in a person's domain, which commonly entails a household, but could also encompass roadways, neighborhoods, or even entire cities.
official_raw.zh: 家宅诸神在我国人民的生活中扮演着极其重要的角色。他们守护并影响着个人领域中的一切，这通常指一个家庭，但也可以延伸至道路、社区，甚至整座城市。

en: The Dionysian Mysteries had worshippers dance to drum and pipe by torchlight until they reached ecstasy. Rulers feared the cult, since slaves, outlaws and non-citizens found release there. Initiates were buried with gold tablets that guided them through the underworld.
zh: 狄俄尼索斯秘仪中，信徒在火把下随鼓和笛声起舞，直至进入出神状态。奴隶、亡命者和非公民都能在仪式中得到释放，不少统治者因此忌惮这一崇拜。入会者死后以金片陪葬，金片上写着穿越冥界的指引。

official_raw.en: The rituals, dance, and music of those initiated into the mysteries of Dionysus provide liberation and release to its members, without distinction of social classes. The death and rebirth of the god are mirrored by the cycle of the grape vine, growing from the earth, becoming wine, and finally being drunk by the acolytes in glory of Dionysus.
official_raw.zh: 受酒神狄俄尼索斯秘仪启示者的仪式、舞蹈与音乐，为其成员提供解脱与释放，无分社会阶级。神灵的死亡与重生，就如同葡萄藤的生长周期——从大地中萌发，酿成葡萄酒，最终被信徒们饮下，以此荣耀狄俄尼索斯。

en:
Tertullian says some pagans thought Christian eastward prayer meant sun worship. Later writers tied it to Christ's return, which Matthew likens to lightning from the east.

The Apostolic Constitutions of about 375–380 put the sanctuary at the east end of the church; Rome accepted the orientation only in the eighth or ninth century. The Coptic Church prays its seven daily hours facing east and builds or remodels its churches to match.
zh:
德尔图良说，有些异教徒因此以为基督徒崇拜太阳。后来的作者把它与基督的再临联系起来，《马太福音》把人子降临比作从东方发出的闪电。

约375—380年的《使徒宪章》规定教堂的圣所设在东端；罗马直到8或9世纪才接受这一朝向。科普特教会每日七次时辰祈祷都面向东方，教堂也按此方向建造或改建。

official_raw.en: It is common practice in all Christendom to pray towards the East, to the rising sun of Christ. Some other confessions may be more loose with this orientation, but for us there is simply no other manner of praying, both in public and in private, and all our churches need to be accomodated to follow that orientation.
official_raw.zh: 在整个基督教世界，面向东方、朝向基督的朝阳祈祷是普遍做法。其他一些教派可能对这一朝向要求不那么严格，但对我们而言，无论是在公开场合还是私下祈祷，都绝无其他方式，我们所有的教堂都必须按照这一朝向来建造。

en:
The Eleusinian Mysteries were yearly initiations into the cult of Demeter and Persephone at Eleusis. They enacted Persephone's ascent and reunion with her mother Demeter, a tale of life's return that promised initiates a reward after death.

Under Peisistratos the rites drew pilgrims from all Greece. Theodosius I closed them in AD 392, and in 396 Alaric looted the shrines.
zh:
厄琉息斯秘仪是每年在厄琉息斯为得墨忒耳和珀耳塞福涅举行的入会仪式。仪式演绎珀耳塞福涅返回人间、与母亲得墨忒耳重逢的故事，这是一个生命回归的故事，也向入会者许诺死后的回报。

在庇西特拉图治下，仪式吸引了希腊各地的朝圣者。公元392年狄奥多西一世下令关闭秘仪，396年阿拉里克洗劫了圣所。

official_raw.en: The acolytes of the Eleusinian mysteries follow the myth of the abduction of Persephone from her mother, Demeter, by the king of the underworld, Hades, and her subsequent release and deception. To the initiated, this myth represents the cycle of growth and rebirth of all plant life and the eternity of life as it flows from one generation to the next.
official_raw.zh: 厄琉息斯秘仪的追随者信奉这样一则神话：珀耳塞福涅被冥界之王哈迪斯从其母亲得墨忒耳身边劫走，珀耳塞福涅随后获释却又遭到欺骗。对已受启示者而言，这神话代表着所有植物生命生长与重生的循环，以及生命世代相传的永恒。

en: The Bogomils, who held that the body was Satan's work, built no churches but prayed in private houses and sought to purify the body by fasting and dancing.
zh: 鲍格米勒派认为肉体是撒旦的作品，不建教堂，而在私人住宅中祈祷，并通过禁食和舞蹈来净化身体。

official_raw.en: Some among our people practice a meditation style consisting in closing all the doors in a house while opening the #italic five doors#! or the five senses. We will introduce this practice everywhere.
official_raw.zh: 部分民众实践着一种冥想方式：关闭房屋所有门，同时开启#italic 五感之门#!。我们将全面推行此修行法。

en:
In January 1568 the Diet of the Three Nations of Transylvania, meeting at Torda at the request of the Antitrinitarian preacher Ferenc Dávid, authorized local communities to elect their own preachers.

The edict of John Sigismund Zápolya's realm gave the Catholic, Lutheran and Calvinist churches, and the Unitarians around Dávid, room to preach side by side. It did not grant individuals freedom of conscience, but it was an unprecedented act of toleration in sixteenth-century Europe.
zh:
1568年1月，特兰西瓦尼亚三民族议会应反三位一体论传道人费伦茨·达维德的请求在托尔达集会，授权各地方社区自行选举传道人。

这份在约翰·西吉斯蒙德·扎波利亚治下颁布的敕令，使天主教、路德宗、加尔文宗以及达维德周围的一位论派可以并存宣讲。它没有赋予个人良心自由，但在16世纪的欧洲是前所未有的宽容之举。

official_raw.en: There is much disagreement among the followers, but each sect shall be given the freedom to preach freely so long as God is in their hearts.
official_raw.zh: 尽管信徒存在分歧，各教派都享有宣讲自由，前提是心怀对神的敬畏。

en:
Gnosticism is the name given to a family of movements, fully developed by the mid-second century. Gnostics generally held that the material world was made by a flawed demiurge, not by the hidden supreme God.

Later dualist Christians echoed this view. The Bogomils taught that matter was Satan's work, and the Cathars, who derived from them, taught that souls were spirits trapped in flesh.
zh:
诺斯替主义是对一系列运动的统称，到2世纪中叶已完全成形。诺斯替派一般认为，物质世界是有缺陷的造物主所造，而非隐藏的至高神。

后来的二元论基督徒与此相呼应。鲍格米勒派教导说物质是撒旦的作品，源出于它的清洁派则称灵魂是被困在肉体里的灵。

official_raw.en: Gnosticism centers on personal salvation through #italic gnosis#!. We will escape the material world and return to a higher realm by seeking spiritual insight.
official_raw.zh: 诺斯替主义以灵知（#italic 诺斯#!）为个人救赎核心。我们通过寻求灵性觉悟脱离物质世界，回归神圣领域。

en:
Gomarism is the strict Calvinism of Franciscus Gomarus (1563–1641), born in Bruges and professor of theology at Leiden from 1594. He defended unconditional election.

After the Remonstrants stated their case in 1610, Gomarus' followers answered with the Counter-Remonstrance of 1611 and were called Counter-Remonstrants. At the Synod of Dort of 1618–19 they carried the day, and the Canons of Dort rejected the Arminian position.
zh:
戈马尔派是弗朗西斯·戈马尔（1563—1641）所持的严格加尔文主义。他生于布鲁日，1594年起任莱顿大学神学教授，坚持无条件拣选。

1610年抗辩派陈述主张后，戈马尔的追随者在1611年以《反抗辩书》作答，被称为反抗辩派。在1618—1619年的多特会议上，他们占了上风，《多特信经》否定了阿民念派的立场。

official_raw.en: Franciscus Gomarus opposes the beliefs of Jacobus Arminius who taught Pelagian doctrines and tried to create a new school of theology within the university where the two of them taught.
official_raw.zh: 弗朗西斯·戈马尔反对传播伯拉纠主义的雅各·阿民念，并试图在他们二人共同执教的大学中建立新的神学学院。

en: In Greek religion a hero was a legendary mortal honoured with rites at a shrine, the heroon, usually over his tomb. A neglected hero might send disease. Draco, the Athenian lawgiver, ordered local heroes honoured with the gods in the late seventh century BC.
zh: 在希腊宗教中，英雄是传说中的凡人，人们在他的祠堂（英雄祠）里举行祭仪，祠堂多建在他的墓上。被冷落的英雄会降下疾病。公元前7世纪晚期，雅典立法者德拉古下令把本地英雄与诸神一并祭祀。

official_raw.en: Our history is full of powerful figures who shaped our society and our character. These were the mortal sons of the gods, humans with extraordinary abilities who often met tragic fates, and who protected and led our ancestors into founding the great nation that we are today. It is now our duty to worship them and learn their lessons.
official_raw.zh: 我们的历史中充满了塑造了我们社会与品格的伟人。他们是诸神的凡生子嗣，拥有非凡能力却又常遭逢悲剧命运，他们曾保护并领导我们的祖先，最终建立起我们今天这个伟大的国家。敬拜他们并汲取他们的教训，是我们现在的责任。

en: The Bogomils rejected the church hierarchy and let each congregation ordain its own leaders, in an egalitarian spirit.
zh: 鲍格米勒派否定教会的等级制度，本着平等精神，由各个会众自行任命领袖。

official_raw.en: A shift will occur towards promoting and actively participating in productive work. This ethos will extend to our agricultural communities, inspired by the early Christians' model of a sacred cooperative community.
official_raw.zh: 我们将转向倡导并积极参与生产劳动。此理念将延伸至农业社区，效仿早期基督徒的神圣协作社群模式。

en:
The Roman imperial cult identified emperors and some of their relatives with the divinely sanctioned authority of the state. Shaped under Augustus, it spread through the provinces, though the Republic had never worshipped a living man.

The Senate could vote a dead emperor a state god by apotheosis, an honour Vespasian and Septimius Severus used to bolster new dynasties. The cult was bound up with Rome's official gods, and was abandoned when Theodosius I made Christianity the state religion.
zh:
罗马帝国崇拜把皇帝和部分皇室成员与国家得到神明认可的权威等同起来。它在奥古斯都治下成形，并传遍各行省，尽管共和国从未崇拜过在世之人。

元老院可以通过神化仪式把已故皇帝尊为国家神明；韦斯帕芗和塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁都曾借此巩固新王朝。该崇拜与罗马的官方诸神密不可分，狄奥多西一世以基督教为国教后，它被废弃。

official_raw.en: As the ancient emperors of Rome were once regarded as divine by the people and Senate, our ruler and their dynasty are also to be considered as such. Their greatness, majesty, and authority clearly mark them as not only divinely sanctioned, but as gods themselves.
official_raw.zh: 正如古罗马的皇帝曾被人民与元老院尊为神明，我们的统治者及其王朝也应被如此看待。他们的伟大、威严与权威，明示着他们不仅获神授之权，其本身即是神。

en: After the Reformation, churches no longer shared one creed but drew up confessions of their own, such as the Augsburg Confession of 1530 and the Gallic Confession of 1559.
zh: 宗教改革之后，各教会不再共用同一部信经，而是各自撰写信纲，如1530年的《奥格斯堡信条》和1559年的《高卢信条》。

official_raw.en: Allowing our people to formulate their own creeds will encourage the formation of individual opinions and allow to pave the way for the path to progress!
official_raw.zh: 允许信徒自行制定信纲，以此促进多元观点的形成，推动信仰进步！

en:
Arminianism was one of the first structured Protestant responses to Calvinist predestination. Its followers, the Remonstrants, were condemned at the Synod of Dort in 1618–19, and Arminians across Holland were imprisoned, banished or sworn to silence.

About twelve years later Holland officially granted the movement protection as a religion, though hostility with the Calvinists continued. Some early Remonstrants, such as Philipp van Limborch, moved towards rationalism.
zh:
阿民念派是新教最早对加尔文主义预定论作出的系统回应之一。其追随者抗辩派在1618—1619年的多特会议上受到谴责，荷兰各地的阿民念派被监禁、流放或勒令噤声。

约十二年后，荷兰官方承认这一运动为一种受保护的宗教，但它与加尔文派的敌意仍在继续。早期抗辩派中有人如腓力·范林堡转向理性主义。

official_raw.en: $arminianism_desc$ This religious movement is now institutionalized within our state.
official_raw.zh: $arminianism_desc$此宗教运动现已在我国制度化。

en:
The strict Calvinism of Franciscus Gomarus won state backing in the Dutch Republic. Prince Maurice of Nassau, siding with the Counter-Remonstrants, systematically removed Arminian magistrates from office and called a national synod at Dordrecht.

The Synod of Dort of 1618–19 was open mainly to Dutch Calvinists, with 28 delegates from foreign Reformed churches; 13 Remonstrants were barred from voting. It condemned Arminius and his followers as heretics, and its Canons answered the Arminian doctrines point by point.
zh:
弗朗西斯·戈马尔的严格加尔文主义在荷兰共和国得到了国家的支持。拿骚的莫里斯亲王站在反抗辩派一边，有步骤地把阿民念派官员撤职，并召集全国性会议于多德雷赫特。

1618—1619年的多特会议主要向荷兰加尔文派开放，另有28名外国改革宗教会的代表；13名抗辩派被禁止投票。会议把阿民念及其追随者定为异端，会议通过的《多特信经》逐条回应了阿民念派的教义。

official_raw.en: $gomarism_desc$ This religious movement is now institutionalized within our state.
official_raw.zh: $gomarism_desc$此宗教运动现已在我国制度化。

en:
Lutheran theologians held that war could never be holy. In Whether Soldiers, Too, Can Be Saved (1526), Martin Luther held that soldiering is a legitimate calling.

In On War Against the Turk (1529), he dropped the view that the Turks were God's scourge and urged Charles V and the Germans to resist them, but only in a defensive, secular war, never a crusade. In 1531 Lutheran princes formed the Schmalkaldic League against Charles V.
zh:
路德宗神学家否认战争可以是神圣的。1526年，马丁·路德在《士兵也能得救吗》中主张，从军是正当的职业。

1529年的《论对土耳其人的战争》里，他放弃了把土耳其人看作上帝降下的惩罚的旧看法，敦促查理五世和德意志人起而抵抗，但只能是防御性的世俗战争，绝不是十字军。1531年，路德宗诸侯组成施马尔卡尔登联盟，对抗查理五世。

official_raw.en: The new Church of the country is threatened by heathens and heretics alike. In a war of self-preservation, the Church will justify our conflicts with the Bible.
official_raw.zh: 我国的新教会正遭遇异教和异端的威胁。在自我防卫战争中，教会将以圣经正当化我们的冲突。

en:
The Mithraic mysteries, a Roman mystery cult of the god Mithras, were popular in the imperial army from the first to the fourth century. Initiates called themselves syndexioi, 'united by the handshake', and shared communal meals.

The central image of their temples showed Mithras slaying a bull. Centred on Rome, the cult reached Britain and Dacia. Christians persecuted it in the fourth century, and it was suppressed within the Empire by that century's end.
zh:
密特拉秘仪是罗马帝国奉祀密特拉神的秘密教派，1至4世纪在帝国军队中十分流行。入会者自称“辛德西奥伊”，意为“以握手结盟者”，并共享宴饮。

他们神殿的核心画面是密特拉屠牛。该教以罗马城为中心，传到了不列颠和达契亚。4世纪它遭到基督徒迫害，到世纪末在帝国境内被取缔。

official_raw.en: The initiates in the Mithraic mysteries who call themselves Syndexioi enjoyed a great deal of popularity in Rome and the Western Roman Empire during the height of the Empire. Their rituals, gatherings, and feasts took place in secret underground temples, but we can bring them back to the light, and revive their traditions for the benefit of our people.
official_raw.zh: 密特拉秘仪的入教者自称为辛德西奥伊（意为“立誓同道者”），在罗马帝国全盛时期于罗马城及西罗马帝国极受欢迎。他们的仪式、集会和宴饮都在秘密的地下神庙中进行，但我们可以将他们重新带回光明，为我们的民众复兴这些习俗。

en: Modalism's main teachers in the late second and third centuries were Noetus, Praxeas and Sabellius, whose name gave it the label Sabellianism. Church leaders condemned the doctrine, and the Nicene settlement of the fourth century affirmed the three persons as distinct.
zh: 2世纪末至3世纪，形态论的主要倡导者是诺埃图斯、普拉克塞亚斯和撒伯里乌，后者之名使它又被称为撒伯里乌主义。教会领袖谴责了这一教义，4世纪的尼西亚体系则确认三个位格各自有别。

official_raw.en: We believe that God is absolutely one, and the trinitarian concepts like the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit are merely different modes in which God manifests Himself.
official_raw.zh: 我们坚信上帝是绝对独一的存在，圣三（圣父、圣子、圣灵）只是神在不同时期显现的形态。

en:
Christian monasticism began in the Egyptian desert in the third century with hermits such as Anthony, and Pachomius organized the first communities there. Egypt's monasteries remained central to the Coptic church.

In the West the Rule of Benedict became the model. Protestant reformers rejected monastic vows, and between 1536 and 1541 Henry VIII dissolved every monastery in England, Wales and Ireland.
zh:
基督教隐修制度兴起于3世纪的埃及沙漠，最早的隐修者有安东尼，帕科缪随后在那里组织了第一批隐修团体。埃及的修道院此后一直是科普特教会的核心。

在西方，《本笃会规》成为典范。新教改革者否定修道誓愿，1536至1541年间，亨利八世解散了英格兰、威尔士和爱尔兰的全部修道院。

official_raw.en: The pleasures of fine food and drink only serve to distract us from service to the divine. Isolating ourselves in remote monasteries is the best way to avoid these temptations.
official_raw.zh: 美食享乐会干扰神圣侍奉。进入偏远修道院隐居是避免此类诱惑的最佳方式。

en:
Neoplatonism, founded by Plotinus (c. 205–271), flourished in the academies of Alexandria and Athens until the sixth century. In the fifteenth century Gemistos Plethon of Mystras drew on it in a pagan revival.

His Nomoi rejected Christianity for the worship of the Hellenic gods under Zeus, whom he saw as universal principles and planetary powers. After his death the work reached Patriarch Gennadius II, who burned it in 1460.
zh:
新柏拉图主义由普罗提诺（约205—271）创立，在亚历山大里亚和雅典的学园中兴盛，直到6世纪。15世纪，米斯特拉的格弥斯托士·卜列东借助它发起了一场异教复兴。

他在《法律书》中舍弃基督教，主张崇拜以宙斯为首的希腊诸神，并把诸神看作普遍的原理和行星的力量。他去世后，这部著作送到了牧首热那底乌斯二世手中，后者于1460年将其焚毁。

official_raw.en: The philosophers of our revival hold that all existence flows from The One — a single transcendent principle from which all gods and all things emanate. The traditional pantheon becomes allegory; the gods are aspects of The One. Omens lose their particular force, but faith in The One suffuses every act of governance.
official_raw.zh: 我国复兴时代的哲人主张，世间一切存在皆源自太一—— 这是唯一超越性本源，诸神与万物皆由其流溢而生。传统万神殿被赋予寓言意义，诸神皆为太一的不同显现。各类神谕预兆不再拥有独立神力，但对太一的信仰将渗透至一切治国理政之中。

en:
Mos maiorum complemented written law as the source of Roman social norms. It governed the household, whose head held great authority yet was expected to use it with moderation, and the bonds of patron and client.

Its virtues included gravitas, shown by Mucius Scaevola, who held his hand in a fire before the Etruscan king Lars Porsenna. Religion belonged to it too: correct rites preserved the peace of the gods.
zh:
祖宗之法是罗马人社会规范的来源，与成文法相辅相成。它约束着家庭——家长权威极大，却应当有节制地行使——也约束着庇护人与门客之间的关系。

其美德包括庄重，穆奇乌斯·斯凯沃拉便是例证：他在伊特鲁里亚国王拉尔斯·波尔塞纳面前把手伸进火中。宗教也属于其中：正确举行仪式，才能维持与诸神的和平。

official_raw.en: The unwritten code that ruled the lives of Romans from antiquity to the height of the Empire, the 'Way of the Ancestors.' This set of traditions and practices has defined what it means to be a Roman and how to behave both inside the household and in public.
official_raw.zh: 自远古时代直至帝国鼎盛时期，支配罗马人生活的不成文法则便是“祖先之道”。这套传统与习俗定义了何谓罗马人，以及在家中和公共场合应如何行事。

en: Constantine of Mananalis founded the Paulician sect at Kibossa about 660 and called himself Silvanus. The officer Simeon, sent to carry out his execution, joined the sect instead and became Titus; he was burned in 690.
zh: 马纳纳利斯的君士坦丁约在660年于基博萨创立保禄派，改名为西尔瓦努斯。奉命处决他的军官西门反而加入了该派，改名提多，于690年被烧死。

official_raw.en: The power of names is well known by our communities. Our faith leaders often change their names after the names of followers of Saint Paul, as common folks change the name of their settlements to those of places where our patron Saint dwelled.
official_raw.zh: 我们社群深知名字的力量。信仰领袖常改为圣保罗追随者之名，民众则用主保圣徒居所地名命名定居点。

en:
The Olympic Games were held at Olympia in honour of Zeus, traditionally from 776 BC and repeated every four years. City-states sent their champions, and an Olympic truce let athletes and pilgrims travel in safety; victors won olive wreaths.

Alliances were announced there, and priests sacrificed for victory in war. The last recorded games were held in AD 393, under Theodosius I.
zh:
奥林匹克运动会在奥林匹亚举行，为敬奉宙斯而设，传统上始于公元前776年，每四年一届。各城邦派出自己的优胜者，奥林匹克休战令保证运动员和朝圣者能安全前往；胜者获得橄榄枝冠。

各邦在此宣布结盟，战时祭司会为胜利献祭。最后一次有记录的运动会在公元393年举行，当时在位的是狄奥多西一世。

official_raw.en: The Olympic Games are a celebration of the gods and a demonstration of our country's strength and unity. Participation in the games is a civic duty that brings honor to our athletes.
official_raw.zh: 奥林匹克运动会是敬奉诸神的庆典，也是展示我国实力与团结的盛事。参与运动会是公民的职责，为我们的运动员带来荣耀。

en: The Church of England retained its episcopate after Henry VIII's break with Rome in 1534, and its bishops were appointed by the crown. The Church of Sweden also kept the historic episcopate and claims apostolic succession, retaining priests, vestments and the Mass through its Reformation.
zh: 1534年亨利八世与罗马决裂后，英格兰教会保留了主教制，主教由王室任命。瑞典教会同样保留了历史性的主教制，并宣称使徒统绪不断，在宗教改革中仍保留了神父、法衣和弥撒。

official_raw.en: Instead of discarding the appointment of bishops entirely, they will serve the Church as the administrators of larger areas.
official_raw.zh: 与其完全废除主教任命制度，不如让主教以区域管理者的身份服务教会。

en: In Bohemia the layman Petr Chelčický taught from about 1420 that violence must not be used in religious matters, that even sinners must not be killed, and that Christians should refuse military service. Most Hussites rejected his views, but his writings helped to found the Unity of the Brethren, established in 1457.
zh: 在波希米亚，平信徒彼得·切尔契茨基约从1420年起教导说，宗教事务不可使用暴力，连罪人也不可杀害，基督徒应拒绝服兵役。大多数胡斯派拒绝了他的主张，但他的著作促成了1457年成立的兄弟会。

official_raw.en: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called the children of God.
official_raw.zh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

en: Before the sixteenth century only a few priests and religious houses kept informal parish records. In England the system began on 5 September 1538, when Thomas Cromwell, as Henry VIII's Vicar General, ordered every parish to keep a register. The Catholic Council of Trent required registers of baptisms and marriages in 1563.
zh: 16世纪之前，只有少数神父和修会驻地做过非正式的堂区记录。英格兰的制度始于1538年9月5日，托马斯·克伦威尔以亨利八世教会代理总管的身份，命令每个堂区备置登记册。天主教的特伦托会议则在1563年要求登记洗礼和婚姻。

official_raw.en: Details of baptisms, marriages, and burials will from now on be documented in a parish register. Each parish priest will keep a book where they will enter these events and keep it in a sure coffer with two locks.
official_raw.zh: 所有洗礼、婚礼、葬礼的详细信息必须记录在教区登记册。各堂区教区需准备专用册籍，保存在双锁保险箱中。

en:
Among the Cathars the consolamentum was open to women as well as men. Women could therefore become Perfects and teach.

In 1204 Esclarmonde of Foix, sister of Count Raymond-Roger, received the rite at Fanjeaux from the Cathar bishop Guilhabert de Castres. Three other noblewomen, Aude de Fanjeaux, Fays de Durfort and Raymonde of Saint-Germain, received it with her, in her brother's presence.
zh:
在清洁派中，慰藉礼对女性和男性同样开放。女性因此也能成为完人并传道。

1204年，富瓦伯爵雷蒙-罗热的妹妹埃斯克拉蒙德在法尼若，由清洁派主教吉尔哈贝·德·卡斯特尔为她施行慰藉礼。同时受礼的还有三位贵妇，即奥德·德·法尼若、费斯·德·迪尔福尔和雷蒙德·德·圣日耳曼，她的兄长在场。

official_raw.en: While women do participate as equals in our communities, we will adopt a general rule everywhere so that they are treated as men are.
official_raw.zh: 女性在教会中享有与男性平等的参与权，我们将推行普遍规则，确保男女待遇一致。

en:
Byzantine writers reported that the Paulicians accepted the four Gospels, above all Luke's, fourteen epistles of Paul, those of John, James and Jude, and a letter to the Laodiceans they claimed to hold. Of Peter's epistles they rejected the First.

The Key of Truth, a text thought to be Paulician and copied in the eighteenth century, accepts the Old Testament. Scholars debate these reports.
zh:
拜占庭作者记述，保禄派接受四部福音书，尤其重视《路加福音》，还接受保禄的十四封书信，约翰、雅各和犹大的书信，以及一封他们自称拥有的《致老底嘉人书》。彼得的书信中，他们拒绝的是《彼得前书》。

《真理之钥》是一部被认为属于保禄派、18世纪抄写的文本，却接受《旧约》。学者对这些转述也有争论。

official_raw.en: Our people reject the Old Testament and its Prophets, as they reject the inclusion of the epistles of Saint Peter. Only the words of Saint Paul are appropriate.
official_raw.zh: 我们拒绝《旧约》及其先知，正如他们不接纳彼得的书信一般。唯圣保禄之言方为天启。

en: The Cathar Perfect avoided cheese, eggs, milk and meat, which they counted as by-products of sexual reproduction that would otherwise perpetuate the cycle of rebirth in the material world. The sect's diet was therefore described as pescatarian.
zh: 清洁派的完人不吃奶酪、蛋、奶和肉，视之为性繁殖的副产品，吃了就会使物质世界里的轮回延续下去。因此这一教派的饮食被称为鱼素。

official_raw.en: Animals are carriers of reincarnated souls, and because of that we cannot eat them. Fishes, beings spontaneously generated, cannot be considered animals and can be eaten.
official_raw.zh: 动物是转世灵魂的载体，因此我们不能食用它们。鱼类是自然生成的生物，并不被视为动物，所以可以食用。

en:
Pietism took shape within German Lutheranism when Philipp Spener began holding Bible meetings in his Frankfurt house about 1670. His Pia Desideria of 1675 urged small study groups within the church, a larger role for the laity and a faith shown in conduct.

August Hermann Francke founded the Halle orphanage in 1695, making Halle the movement's centre. His pupil Count Zinzendorf revived the Moravian Church in 1727.
zh:
虔敬主义在德意志路德宗内部成形，约1670年，菲利普·雅各布·施本尔开始在法兰克福的家中举行读经聚会。1675年，他出版《敬虔愿望》，主张在教会内设立小型查经团体，扩大平信徒的作用，并让信仰体现在行为上。

奥古斯特·赫尔曼·弗兰克于1695年创办哈勒孤儿院，哈勒由此成为这场运动的中心。他的学生辛岑多夫伯爵在1727年复兴了摩拉维亚教会。

official_raw.en: Pietism focuses on the individual piety of every believer and emphasizes the inner transformation that leads to a devout Christian life.
official_raw.zh: 虔敬主义强调每位信徒的个人虔敬，注重内在转变以践行虔诚基督徒生活。

en:
Prima scriptura, Latin for 'scripture first', is the historic Anglican position, unlike sola scriptura. Tradition and reason help to interpret the Bible, which remains the highest authority.

Article VI of the Thirty-nine Articles of 1571 declares Scripture sufficient for salvation. Richard Hooker answered the Puritans with a 'three-legged stool' of scripture, tradition and reason, later developed by Methodists into a quadrilateral.
zh:
圣经首位论（拉丁语 prima scriptura，意为“圣经优先”）是圣公宗历来的立场，不同于“唯独圣经”。传统与理性有助于解释《圣经》，《圣经》仍是最高权威。

1571年的《三十九条信纲》第六条宣布《圣经》足以使人得救。理查德·胡克以圣经、传统、理性构成的“三脚凳”回应清教徒，后来卫理公会又在此基础上发展出自己的四边形。

official_raw.en: While the Holy Scripture has to be considered the central source of salvation, it can not be considered the only source of divine revelation.
official_raw.zh: 尽管《圣经》必须被视为救赎的核心来源，但它不能被视作神圣启示的唯一来源。

en:
Stoning, the penalty the Old Testament prescribes for blasphemy and idolatry, was also used to punish religious dissent in the Christian East. The Paulician tradition remembered it in the fate of its founder, Constantine-Silvanus of Mananalis.

Imperial authorities arrested him for heresy and stoned him to death about 687. Simeon, the court official who carried out the sentence, was himself converted, took the name Titus and became Constantine's successor.
zh:
石刑是《旧约》对亵渎和偶像崇拜规定的刑罚，在基督教的东方也被用来惩处宗教异见。保禄派的传统把它记在创始人、马纳纳利斯的君士坦丁（西尔瓦努斯）的结局里。

帝国当局以异端罪名逮捕了他，约在687年用石头将他砸死。执行判决的宫廷官员西蒙后来自己皈依，改名提多，继任为保禄派的领袖。

official_raw.en: Stoning is a common practice to punish religious dissidents among our communities that stand out from our neighbors. This is most likely an inheritance from our Anatolian origins.
official_raw.zh: 在我们的社区，石刑是惩处宗教异见者的常见手段，这一行为可能继承自安纳托利亚传统。

en:
Punishment of Sin was the fourth of the Four Articles of Prague, the Hussite programme agreed in July 1420 by the moderate Praguers and the radical Taborites. It required that mortal sins, especially public ones, be checked and put right in every estate by those responsible.

The diet at Čáslav made the articles law in 1421. They were never fully accepted, however: at Basel in 1436 only the lay chalice was recognised.
zh:
罪罚平等是布拉格四条款中的第四条。该条款是胡斯派的纲领，由温和的布拉格派与激进的塔博尔派于1420年7月议定，要求各个等级里的一切死罪，尤其是公开的死罪，都由负有责任者加以制止和纠正。

1421年，恰斯拉夫议会把四条款定为法律。但它们始终没有被完全接受：1436年的巴塞尔会议只承认了平信徒领杯。

official_raw.en: All who sin must be punished equally, no matter wealth or rank. Even the nobility are not above the laws of God.
official_raw.zh: 所有有罪者都将被等量齐观的惩罚，无论财富和地位。即使是尊贵之人也不能逾越天主的法律。

en: The Cathars kept a single sacrament, the consolamentum, a baptism in the Holy Spirit that gave absolution and the power to preach. Their opponents reported that they dismissed the other sacraments of the Church. The Bogomils likewise rejected the church hierarchy. They did not build churches, since the body itself was held to be the temple.
zh: 清洁派只保留一种圣礼，即慰藉礼，也就是在圣灵中受的洗礼，它带来赦罪和传道的权能。其对手称他们把教会的其他圣礼视为无足轻重。鲍格米勒派同样否定教会等级制度。他们也不建教堂，因为认为身体本身就是神殿。

official_raw.en: Our doctrine rejects most Christian sacraments as they are mostly physical and are of no importance. The spiritual part is the only one that matters, to make us closer to God.
official_raw.zh: 我们的教义拒绝大多数基督教圣礼，因其本质为物质形式且无关紧要。唯有灵性部分能使人更亲近神。

en:
Ritual purity marks the Miaphysite churches. Coptic Christians wash their hands and face and take off their shoes before praying the seven daily hours of the Agpeya, and keep days of ritual purification.

In Ethiopia, where Old Testament practice weighs heavily, believers wash their hands before prayer and after meals much as Jews do. Women may not enter the church during menstruation, and the unclean stand by the church door and pray from outside during the liturgy.
zh:
洁净礼仪是基督合性派教会的鲜明特征。科普特基督徒在诵念《阿格佩亚》每日七次时辰祈祷之前，要洗手洗脸、脱鞋，并遵守洁净日。

埃塞俄比亚的教会深受旧约习俗影响，信徒在祈祷前和饭后洗手，做法与犹太人相近。妇女经期不得进入教堂，不洁者在礼拜时站在教堂门边，在外面祈祷。

official_raw.en: Both the soul and the body of the faithful must be clean and free of impurities if they are to get closer to God.
official_raw.zh: 信徒如果要更亲近上帝，其灵魂与身体都必须洁净无染。

en:
The Mysteries of the Great Gods were celebrated at a sanctuary on the island of Samothrace. Unlike Eleusis, initiation had no bar of age, sex, status or nationality: men and women, Greeks and foreigners, free and enslaved could all take part.

Alexander's successors vied to endow the site. The cult faded when the temples were closed during the late Roman persecution of pagans.
zh:
诸大神的秘仪在萨莫色雷斯岛的圣所举行。与厄琉息斯秘仪不同，入会没有年龄、性别、身份或国籍的限制：男人和女人、希腊人和外邦人、自由人和奴隶都可以参加。

亚历山大的继任者们争相捐建。罗马晚期迫害异教徒、神庙被关闭后，这一崇拜逐渐湮没。

official_raw.en: On the island of Samothrace, a mystery cult thrived during the height of Hellenism; it famously accepted anybody who wanted to join, no matter their social class. It is said that many mythological heroes, like Heracles, Jason, and Orpheus, were initiated at Samothrace. We can collect and reconstruct these mysteries from the remains and ruins, and bring this cult back to its former glory.
official_raw.zh: 在萨莫色雷斯岛上，一个神秘教派在希腊化时期蓬勃发展；它以广纳任何想加入的人而闻名，无论其社会阶层如何。据说许多神话英雄，如赫拉克勒斯、伊阿宋和俄耳甫斯，都在萨莫色雷斯接受了入会仪式。我们可以从遗迹和废墟中收集并重构这些奥秘，使该教派重现过去的辉煌。

en: Sola fide, Latin for 'faith alone', holds that good works are the evidence of faith, not its price. Martin Luther made it the centre of the Reformation after he attacked the sale of indulgences in 1517, and Lutheran and Reformed churches adopted it. The Council of Trent rejected it in its decree on justification of 1547.
zh: 唯独信心（拉丁语 sola fide，意为“唯独信仰”）认为善行是信仰的证据，而不是换取救赎的代价。1517年马丁·路德抨击赎罪券之后，把它变成宗教改革的核心，路德宗和改革宗教会都接受了这一教义。特伦托会议在1547年的称义法令中否定了它。

official_raw.en: No good deed can satisfy God. We are pardoned by the divine grace alone, which God has granted through His only Son, Jesus Christ.
official_raw.zh: 善行无法取悦神。我们仅因神恩得赦免，此恩典通过其独子耶稣基督赐予我们。

en:
Sola scriptura, Latin for 'by scripture alone', did not mean that Luther and Calvin discarded church tradition entirely; they ranked it beneath scripture. At the Diet of Worms in 1521 Luther refused to recant unless shown his error from scripture and plain reason.

The principle became the formal foundation of the Lutheran and Reformed churches. It was also a mark of the Hussites, who held the Bible above church tradition.
zh:
唯独圣经（拉丁语 sola scriptura，意为“唯凭圣经”）并不意味着路德和加尔文完全抛弃了教会传统，他们只是把它置于圣经之下。1521年的沃尔姆斯会议上，路德声称除非有人用圣经和明白的理性证明他有错，否则绝不收回主张。

这一原则成为路德宗和改革宗教会的形式根基。它也是主张圣经高于教会传统的胡斯派的特征。

official_raw.en: The Bible, the word of God delivered unto man, is the sole authority for Christian doctrine. All religious practices that cannot be supported by Biblical reference are to be denounced as heresy.
official_raw.zh: 圣经是上帝传达给人类的真言，是基督教教义的唯一权威。一切没有引用圣经支持的宗教行为都将被斥为异端。

en:
Soli Deo gloria, Latin for 'glory to God alone', directs praise to God rather than to the maker of an achievement. It came to be counted among the five solae summarizing the Reformers' beliefs.

Johann Sebastian Bach (1685—1750) wrote the initials S. D. G. at the end of all his church compositions. George Frideric Handel sometimes used the dedication, as in his Te Deum.
zh:
唯独神的荣耀（拉丁语 soli Deo gloria，意为“荣耀唯独归于神”）把赞美归于上帝，而不是成就的创造者。它后来被算作概括宗教改革者基本信念的五个“唯独”之一。

约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫（1685—1750）在所有教会作品的末尾都写上缩写 S. D. G.。格奥尔格·弗里德里希·亨德尔有时也用这一题献，如他的《感恩赞》。

official_raw.en: All human achievements can only be created with the the praise of God as their dedication.
official_raw.zh: 人类的一切成就，都只有以对上帝的赞美为献礼才能创造。

en:
The Miaphysite churches never settled on a single canon of scripture. The Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church has the broadest, an 81-book canon that includes the Book of Enoch, Jubilees and the three books of Meqabyan.

The Book of Enoch survives complete only in Ge'ez. The church's New Testament adds eight books drawn from church orders, among them the four books of Sinodos and the Didascalia.
zh:
基督合性派的教会从未确定唯一的经书正典。埃塞俄比亚正教会的正典最广，共81卷，包括《以诺书》、《禧年书》和三卷《梅卡比安书》。

《以诺书》只有吉兹语译本完整存世。该教会的新约还增添了八卷出自教会规章的书，其中有四卷《西诺杜斯》和《使徒训诲》。

official_raw.en: Books inspired by God are all deserving to be revered and studied, even those of less spiritual quality that are outright rejected by other confessions.
official_raw.zh: 受上帝启示而写的书籍都值得敬重与研习，即便是那些灵性价值较低、已被其他教派明确摒弃的书籍也不例外。

en:
The Perfects, or bons hommes, were the Cathar elite, admitted to the consolamentum, the movement's one sacrament, only after a period of probation. They gave up property, sex, oaths and meat, and travelled as preachers.

Ordinary believers often put off the rite until they were dying. The Inquisition made the Perfects its chief quarry in Languedoc after the Albigensian Crusade.
zh:
完人（拉丁语 perfecti，又称“善人”）是清洁派的精英，经过一段考验期后才获准领受慰藉礼，这是该派唯一的圣礼。他们舍弃财产、性、誓言和肉食，四处传道。

普通信徒往往拖到临终才领受此礼。阿尔比十字军之后，宗教裁判所把朗格多克的完人当作主要追捕对象。

official_raw.en: Those among us that are specially commited to God and the virtues all human should pursue are called Perfects. These men and women receive #italic Consolamentum#! for their devotion and become Perfects. Contrary to regular folks, Perfects receive #italic Consolamentum#! twice in their lifes: when they are elevated to their new role and before dying.
official_raw.zh: 特别虔信神与人类美德者称为“完人”。这些男女因奉献接受#italic 慰藉礼#!成为完人。与常人不同，完人一生接受两次#italic 慰藉礼#!：晋位时与临终前。

en: The Wycliffe Bible of 1382 was the first complete English translation, and the Czech Bible of Prague was printed in 1488. Martin Luther's German New Testament appeared in 1522 and William Tyndale's English one in 1526. The King James Bible followed in 1611.
zh: 1382年的威克里夫圣经是第一部完整的英语译本，捷克语的《布拉格圣经》于1488年印行。马丁·路德的德语新约出版于1522年，威廉·廷代尔的英语新约出版于1526年，钦定版圣经则在1611年问世。

official_raw.en: Translating Bibles to a language the people of our country speak gives them the best pathway to God in a way that speaks to their minds and hearts.
official_raw.zh: 将圣经译为国民语言，可使其以触及心灵和启迪思想的方式获得通达神的最佳路径。

en:
The Bogomils had no priesthood in the Orthodox sense. Each community was said to have its own twelve 'apostles', echoing the twelve disciples of Christ, and ordination was conferred by the congregation rather than by a bishop. Women could be raised to the rank of 'elect'.

The model fitted a movement that rejected church hierarchy and spread by wandering missionaries. These missionaries healed the sick and cast out evil spirits.
zh:
鲍格米勒派没有东正教意义上的神职阶层。据说每个社群各有十二名“使徒”，呼应基督的十二门徒；圣职由会众授予，而不是由主教授予。女性可以晋升为“选民”。

这种组织适合一个否定教会等级制度的运动，其传播靠云游传教士。这些传教士治疗病人，驱赶恶灵。

official_raw.en: Inspired by the organization of some communities, we will elect among our elders and perfect ones twelve wise men to act as a supreme council, without creating a true hierarchy.
official_raw.zh: 受部分社群组织启发，我们将从长者与完人中选举十二名智者组成最高议会，但不建立严格等级制度。

en: Medieval Catholic doctrine treated lending at interest as sinful usury, and the Third Lateran Council of 1179 condemned it. John Calvin allowed moderate interest, stating his view in a letter of 1545 to a friend, Claude de Sachins. In the same year Henry VIII's Parliament made interest up to ten per cent legal in England.
zh: 中世纪天主教教义把收息放贷视为罪恶的高利贷，1179年第三次拉特兰公会议即加以谴责。约翰·加尔文允许适度的利息，并在1545年写给友人克洛德·德·萨尚的信中表明了这一立场。同一年，亨利八世的议会在英格兰承认年息不超过百分之十为合法。

official_raw.en: Monetary loans with interest that enrich the lender is now allowed and no longer considered sinful.
official_raw.zh: 收取利息的货币贷款现在已被允许，这种贷款使放贷者致富，不再会被视为罪孽。

en:
In the Hussite Wars of the 1420s the armies sang the hymn 'Ye Who Are Warriors of God', led by a priest. It is said to have frightened a crusading army into flight.

In England the open-air pulpit at Paul's Cross was the most important public pulpit of Tudor times. It carried the crown's message to the people, among them the thanksgiving after the Armada in 1588.
zh:
15世纪20年代的胡斯战争中，军队高唱《尔等乃上帝的战士》，由一名教士领唱。据说这首歌曾把一支十字军吓得不战而逃。

在英格兰，圣保罗十字是都铎时期最重要的露天公共讲坛。王室的信息由此传达给民众，1588年击败无敌舰队后的感恩布道即在此举行。

official_raw.en: In times of conflicts, the faith preserves the hope of our people. The Church of our realm will preach from the Holy Book to keep the morale of the population up even during the darkest hours.
official_raw.zh: 战乱时期，信仰维系着人们的希望。即使在最黑暗的时刻，我国的教会也将手持圣典，坚持布道，以此鼓舞民众的士气。

en: Agwu Nsi is the Igbo arusi, or spirit, of divination. His sphere is the craft of the diviners, the dibia, who in Igbo religion learn the demands of the spirits through afa divination.
zh: 阿格乌是伊博人掌管占卜的阿鲁西，即神灵。他的领域是占卜师迪比亚的技艺；在伊博宗教中，迪比亚通过阿法占卜得知诸神灵的要求。

en: Ak Ana, the Holy Mother, was a Turkic goddess of water, who in the Altai creation myth urges Kayra to create the world. The fertility and productivity of the land were held to depend on her.
zh: 白母，即“圣母”，是突厥人的水神；在阿尔泰创世神话里，她促使凯尔拉创造世界。人们认为土地的丰饶和产出取决于她。

en: Aki Pen is the village guardian of the Gonds, one of the village deities who receive far more fervent devotion than the high god Baradeo. Before any festival he is worshipped together with the village mother goddess, the anwal.
zh: 阿吉宾是贡德人的村落守护神，是受到比高神婆罗提乌热切得多的崇拜的村神之一。每逢节庆之前，人们先要敬奉他，同时敬奉村母神安瓦尔。

en:
Among the Turkana, semi-nomadic herders of the Lake Turkana basin, Akuj is the single Supreme Being. He created the world and grants water, food, livestock and children.

Worship is mediated by the diviners, the ngimurok. Turkana tradition credits them, together with zebu cattle, for the wealth and power that let the Turkana defeat their Ateker rivals and, by the 1600s, occupy the whole Turkana basin.
zh:
图尔卡纳人是图尔卡纳湖盆地的半游牧牧民。在他们的信仰中，阿库吉是唯一的至高存在。他创造了世界，赐予水、食物、牲畜和子嗣。

敬奉阿库吉要经由占卜师恩吉穆罗克。图尔卡纳人的传统把财富和势力归功于恩吉穆罗克和瘤牛，正是它们使图尔卡纳人战胜了其他阿特克尔人对手，到17世纪已占据整个图尔卡纳盆地。

en: Alwet is counted among the offspring of the Dinka sky god Nhialic and is called the goddess of rain. The Dinka ask for rain in prayer along with a good harvest.
zh: 阿尔韦特被算作丁卡天神尼雅力克的后代，被称为雨之女神。丁卡人在祈祷中祈求降雨，也祈求丰收。

en:
Amadioha, ‘man of the people’, is the Igbo god of thunder and lightning, among the most popular Igbo deities. He does justice for the oppressed by striking their oppressors and their property, and is said to embody the collective will of the people.

His colour is red and his symbol a white ram. His main shrine is at Ozuzu in Etche, from which his worship is said to have spread through Igboland.
zh:
阿马迪奥哈意为“人民之人”，是伊博人的雷电之神，是最受欢迎的伊博神明之一。他为受压迫者主持公道，用雷击打击压迫者及其财产，据说代表民众的集体意志。

他的颜色是红色，象征物是白公羊。他的主神庙在埃特切的奥祖祖，据说他的崇拜由此传遍伊博地区。

en:
Anansi, ‘spider’, is the trickster of Akan religion and folklore, shown as a spider or a man with spider-like features and tied to stories, wisdom and cunning. In some tales he is a son of Asase Ya.

In one tale he flies on bird feathers gathered from every bird above the sky god Nyame’s village and learns the name of Nyame’s secret yam, becoming Nyame’s messenger. His tales travelled with the slave trade to Jamaica and Suriname.
zh:
阿南西意为“蜘蛛”，是阿肯人宗教和民间故事中的骗子，常被画成蜘蛛或带蜘蛛特征的人，与故事、智慧和机巧相联系。在某些故事里，他是阿萨塞亚之子。

其中一则故事讲他披上从各种鸟身上收集来的羽毛，飞到天神尼亚梅的村子上空，探出了尼亚梅秘密山药的名字，因而成为尼亚梅的信使。他的故事随奴隶贸易传到牙买加和苏里南。

en: Andriamahilala is the first woman of Malagasy myth, linked with the moon. She chose to die as the moon does, and be reborn each month.
zh: 安德里亚玛希拉拉是马达加斯加神话中的第一个女人，与月亮相连。她选择像月亮那样死去，并在每个月重生。

en: Andriambahomanana is the first man of Malagasy myth. He chose to die like the banana plant, which puts forth new shoots as it withers.
zh: 安德里亚姆巴霍马纳纳是马达加斯加神话中的第一个男人。他选择像香蕉树那样死去，枯萎时会长出新芽。

en: In one of several Merina origin myths, Andrianerinerina is the ancestor of the kings of Imerina. He is a son of the sky god Zanahary who came down to live among the island's first inhabitants.
zh: 在梅里纳人的几种起源神话之一中，安德里亚内里内里纳是伊梅里纳诸王的祖先。他是天神扎纳哈里之子，下凡来到岛上最早居民的中间。

en:
Nyame, also called Onyankopɔn, is the supreme sky god of the Akan of Ghana. His name is glossed as ‘the one who knows and sees everything’.

One account joins Nyame, Nyankopɔn and the creator Odomankoma in a single trinity. Akan sayings hold that Odomankoma made the universe, life and death, and that Death then killed him; Nyame is also said to have fathered Esum, Osrane and Owia, the Darkness, the Moon and the Sun.
zh:
尼亚梅又称奥尼扬科蓬，是加纳阿肯人的至高天神。他的名字意思是“知晓并看见一切者”。

有一种说法把尼亚梅、尼扬科蓬和创造者奥多曼科马合为一体。阿肯人的谚语说，奥多曼科马造出了宇宙、生命和死亡，随后被死亡杀死；传说尼亚梅还生下了黑暗之神埃苏姆、月神奥斯拉内和日神奥维亚。

en:
Asase Ya, ‘Earth born on Thursday’, is the Akan earth goddess, wife of the sky god Nyankopɔn and mother of Bea and Tano. The Fante call her Asase Afua.

She is pictured both as an old woman, mother of the dead, consulted by divination on community matters, and as a young woman of fertility and farming. She has no temples; sacrifices are made to her in the fields of the Asante and other Akan.
zh:
阿萨塞亚意为“星期四出生的大地”，是阿肯人的大地女神，天神尼扬科蓬之妻，比亚和塔诺之母。芳蒂人称她为阿萨塞阿芙娅。

她既是亡者之母的老妇形象，人们就社群事务以占卜向她求问，又是掌管生育与农耕的年轻女子。她没有神庙，阿散蒂人和其他阿肯人在田地里向她献祭。

en: The Kalenjin built no temples for Asis, believing that buildings would limit the power of the sun god. Each tribe set aside a hilltop as its place of sacrifice, called a kapkoros, where a priest known as a tisik led the worship, and every household kept a prayer tree or altar east of its door.
zh: 卡伦津人不为阿西斯建神庙，认为建筑会限制太阳神的力量。各部落划出一座山头作为祭祀之所，称为卡普科罗斯，由名叫蒂西克的祭司主持礼拜；每户人家在屋门东侧还设有祈祷树或祭坛。

en: Ayum is counted among the offspring of the Dinka sky god Nhialic and is described as the force that keeps rain from falling. She therefore appears in prayers for mild weather rather than as a god of a clan.
zh: 阿尤姆被算作丁卡天神尼雅力克的后代，被说成阻止降雨的力量。因此她出现在祈求风调雨顺的祷词里，而不是哪个氏族的主神。

en:
Bai Baianai was the Yakut spirit of the forest and its animals and the patron of hunters. He was pictured as a cheerful, noisy old man rich in furs.

Hunters made sacrifices to him before setting out, after a large catch and after long bad luck, offering kumis, fried cakes and butter. They also lit fires and prayed that the hunt would be fruitful and free of accidents.
zh:
白白阿奶是雅库特人的森林与走兽之灵，也是猎人的守护神。传说中他是住在林中、快活爱吵闹、拥有大量毛皮的老人。

猎人在出猎前、猎获颇丰时以及长久不得猎物时向他献祭，供品有马奶酒、煎饼和黄油。猎人还会点起篝火祈祷，愿狩猎丰收而平安无事。

en:
In Gond folk tradition Baradeo, also called Bhagavan, Kupar Lingo, Badadeo or Persa Pen, is the high god who oversees the lesser gods, the clan and village deities, and the ancestors. He is respected but not fervently worshipped; that devotion goes to clan and village deities, ancestors and totems.

Each Gond clan has its own persa pen, ‘great god’. It is tended by a clan priest and worshipped with sacrifices.
zh:
在贡德人的民间传统中，婆罗提乌又称巴关、库帕尔·林戈、巴达德奥或佩尔萨·彭，是统辖次级神明的高神，次级神明包括氏族神和村神，也包括祖先。人们敬重他，但并不热切地崇拜他；热切的虔诚献给氏族神和村神、祖先与图腾。

贡德人的每个氏族都有自己的佩尔萨·彭，意为“大神”。它由氏族祭司主持，以献祭敬奉。

en:
Bathoubwrai, 'the Elder', is the supreme and unseen god of the Boro, said to have created the five principles of air, fire, earth, water and ether. Traditionally he is worshipped through the sijou shrub planted in the courtyard or on common land, and at the household altar, where worshippers face east and turn the lamp five times.

The Kherai festival is the greatest of the Boro. It is held to appease him together with his daughter Mainao.
zh:
巴图布赖意为“长者”，是博多人至高而不可见的神，相传创造了空气、火、土、水、以太五大元素。传统上人们通过庭院或公地里栽种的西久树，以及家中的祭坛来敬奉他；拜神者面朝东方，把灯转五圈。

凯莱节是博多人最盛大的节日。它就是为取悦他和他的女儿买瑙而举行的。

en: Bura Bagh Raja is one of the four prominent household gods of the Boro of Assam. Sidney Endle lists him together with Bathoubwrai, Mainao and Song Bwrai.
zh: 布拉巴格王是阿萨姆博多人四位主要家神之一。西德尼·恩德尔把他与巴图布赖、买瑙和宋布赖并列。

en:
Chaac was the Maya god of rain and thunder, who struck the clouds with a lightning axe. Four Chaacs stood at the cardinal points, each with its own colour, and Chac Xib Chaac, the Chaac of the east, was also said to be a title of a king of Chichen Itza.

In the Yucatec Ch'a Cháak ceremony, four boys chanted as frogs at a banquet for the rain gods. In the sixteenth century rain was also sought at the cenotes.
zh:
恰克是玛雅人的雨与雷之神，用他的闪电斧劈打云层。四位恰克分别镇守四方，各有自己的颜色；据说东方的恰克“恰克·西布·恰克”同时是奇琴伊察一位国王的头衔。

尤卡坦的求雨仪式“恰·恰克”里，四个男孩扮作青蛙吟唱，为雨神们举行宴席。16世纪，人们还在石灰阱边祈雨。

en:
Chinchaycamac was the chief god of the Chincha, the seafaring and trading people of the Chincha Valley on the coast of Peru. His oracle, probably near the great adobe pyramids of La Centinela, was rich and prominent, receiving offerings from the Chincha and from others.

The Inca under Pachacuti first approached the Chincha peacefully. Tupac Inca Yupanqui annexed their kingdom, though its lords kept much of their autonomy.
zh:
钦查卡马克是钦查人的主神，钦查人是秘鲁海岸钦查河谷一带的航海和贸易民族。他的神谕所富有而著名，很可能设在拉森蒂内拉大型土坯金字塔附近，接受钦查人和其他人的供奉。

印加人在帕查库特克治下先以和平方式接触钦查人。托帕·印加·尤潘基随后吞并了这个王国，不过钦查的领主仍保留了大部分自治权。

en:
Coatlicue, ‘skirt of snakes’, also called Tēteoh īnnān, ‘mother of the gods’, was the Aztec goddess who gave birth to the moon, the stars and Huitzilopochtli. Toci, ‘our grandmother’, and Cihuacoatl, patron of women who died in childbirth, were seen as aspects of her.

In one version of the myth of the present sun, women including Coatlicue joined the gods who sacrificed themselves at Teotihuacan. The Aztecs were said to have worshipped their skirts, which came back to life.
zh:
科瓦特利奎意为“蛇裙”，又名“众神之母”特特奥·因南，是阿兹特克人的女神，生下了月亮、群星和维齐洛波奇特利。“我们的祖母”托奇，以及难产而死的妇女的守护神西瓦科亚特尔，被视为她的不同面相。

在讲述当前太阳诞生的一种说法里，在特奥蒂瓦坎自焚献身的诸神中也有包括科瓦特利奎在内的女性。据说阿兹特克人崇拜她们复活的裙子。

en: Many peoples held that one creator made the world and everything in it. For the Igbo this was Chukwu, source of all things, to whom every lesser spirit was an emanation or servant. The Akan knew Odomankoma, 'the only one who gives the universe', and the Malagasy Zanahary, who made humanity together with the earth god Ratovantany.
zh: 许多民族相信有一位创造者造出了世界和其中的一切。伊博人的创造者是楚库，万物之源，所有次级神灵都是他的化身或仆从。阿坎人称他为奥多芒科马，意为“唯一赐予宇宙者”；马达加斯加人称他为扎纳哈里，他与大地神拉托万塔尼共同创造了人类。

en:
Many religions gave death a god of its own, who either took life or ruled the afterlife. The Aztecs worshipped Mictlantecuhtli, king of Mictlan, the lowest part of the underworld, and set two clay statues of him at the House of Eagles north of the Great Temple of Tenochtitlan.

The Akan of Ghana knew Owuo, created, so the tale goes, to kill humans. In the end he killed even the creator Odomankoma.
zh:
许多宗教为死亡设了专门的神，他或者夺人性命，或者统治死后世界。阿兹特克人崇拜米克特兰特库特利，他是冥界最深处米克特兰的王，特诺奇蒂特兰大神庙以北的鹰之家入口立有他的两尊陶像。

加纳的阿坎人则有奥乌奥，据说他被创造出来就是为了杀人。最后连造物神奥多芒科马也死在他手里。

en: Dharti Ayo, also called Chalapachho Devi, is the mother goddess of the Sarna faith, identified with the earth or nature. Her worshippers are the Santal, Oraon, Ho and Munda peoples of the Chota Nagpur Plateau.
zh: 陀利底阿瑜又称查拉帕丘女神，是娑罗教的大地母神，与大地或自然等同。信奉她的是乔塔那格浦尔高原的桑塔尔人、奥朗人、霍人和蒙达人。

en:
Donyi is the Sun, addressed by the Tani peoples of Arunachal as Ane Donyi, 'Mother Sun'. The Minyong and Padam Adi told that she and the Moon were the two eyes of the creator Sedi, through which he keeps watch over the world after withdrawing from it.

Tani speech calls on her as a witness. A man falsely accused cries out 'Donyi-e!', trusting the Sun to reward the righteous and punish liars.
zh:
冬尼是太阳，阿鲁纳恰尔的塔尼诸族称她为“阿内冬尼”，即“太阳母亲”。敏荣和帕达姆两支阿迪人说，她与月亮是创造者塞迪的双眼，塞迪创世后退居幕后，就用这双眼睛注视着世界。

塔尼人的日常话语里会呼求她作证。被人诬为说谎的人高喊“冬尼啊”，相信太阳会奖赏正直者、惩罚说谎者。

en: Doying Bote is a god of the Tani peoples of Arunachal Pradesh. He is named with Donyi, Polo and Kine Nane among the chief gods of nature who are said to watch over the earth and humanity.
zh: 多英波特是阿鲁纳恰尔邦塔尼诸族的神。他与冬尼、波罗和基内纳内并列为自然诸神中的主神，相传他们注视着大地和人类。

en: Du Chie is a Dinka creator god, sometimes placed before and sometimes beside Nhialic. The Dinka address Nhialic first in prayer.
zh: 杜奇耶是丁卡人的创世神，有的说法把他放在尼雅力克之前，有的把他与后者并列。丁卡人祈祷时首先呼唤的是尼雅力克。

en:
Dzahui, whose name is the Mixtec word for rain, was the rain god and, before the Spanish conquest, the patron deity of the Mixtecs, who called themselves the people of the rain. Codices show him with the goggle mask and fangs of the central Mexican Tláloc.

His chief cult centre was Achiutla, where his sacred bundle was worshipped. In times of drought, disease and harvest, children were sacrificed to him on hilltops.
zh:
扎维的名字在米斯特克语中就是“雨”，他是雨神，西班牙征服之前也是米斯特克人的守护神，米斯特克人自称“雨之民”。手抄本里他戴着护目面具、露出獠牙，与墨西哥中部的特拉洛克相似。

他的主要崇拜中心是阿丘特拉，那里供奉着他的神圣包裹。遇到干旱、疫病和收获的时节，人们会在山顶向他献祭儿童。

en:
Earth was most often worshipped as a goddess. The Akan raised no temples to Asase Yaa but made offerings to her in their farm fields, and in Inca belief Mama Pacha was the goddess of the earth.

The Aztec earth deity Tlaltecuhtli was the god whose body created the world, and the Malagasy earth god Ratovantany shaped humans from soil and took back their bodies at death.
zh:
大地多被当作女神崇拜。阿坎人不为阿萨西·亚建庙，而是在农田里向她献祭；印加人信奉的大地女神是帕查玛玛。

阿兹特克人的大地神特拉尔特库特利，其身体创造了世界；马达加斯加的大地神拉托万塔尼则用泥土塑造人类，人死后又把尸体收回。

en: Egbesu is the deity of justice of the Ijaw people of the Niger Delta, and also the spiritual force by which evil is fought. The force may be used only in defence or to correct an injustice, and only by those in harmony with the universe. The leopard, panther and lion are the symbols of this divine power.
zh: 埃格贝苏是尼日尔河三角洲伊乔人的正义之神，也是对抗邪恶的精神力量。这种力量只能用于防卫或纠正不义，并且只有与宇宙和谐相合的人才能使用。豹、黑豹和狮子是这种神力的象征。

en:
Erlik was the lord of the underworld in Turkic and Altai belief, who sent sickness and death to humankind through his spirits. Traditionally people feared him and, especially among the Altai, offered animal sacrifices when illness struck; those who did not were said to have their dead taken as his slaves.

Shamans who venerated him were called black shamans, and their practice was generally frowned upon, since they bargained with demonic spirits.
zh:
尔力克是突厥和阿尔泰信仰里的冥界之主，通过他的诸多恶灵给人类带来疾病和死亡。传统上人们敬畏他，尤其在阿尔泰人当中，疾病降临时会献上牲畜祭祀；据说不献祭的人，死后会被他抓去当奴隶。

敬奉他的萨满被称为黑萨满，他们的做法通常不受欢迎，因为他们要与恶灵交涉。

en:
Fertility deities watched over crops and childbirth alike, and their worship was often tied to the earth. The Akan prayed to the goddess Asase Afua for fertility, love and farming, and to Asase Yaa for procreation and peace, with sacrifices in return for favour.

The Igbo earth goddess Ala was a goddess of fertility and creativity, and the Aztec rain god Tlaloc was worshipped for the fertility of the land.
zh:
生育神既庇佑庄稼，也庇佑人的生产，对他们的崇拜往往与大地相连。阿坎人向女神阿萨西·阿富阿祈求丰产、爱情和农事顺利，向阿萨西·亚祈求子嗣与平安，并献上祭品换取恩惠。

伊博人的大地女神阿拉掌管生育与创造，阿兹特克人的雨神特拉洛克也因土地的丰饶而受崇拜。

en:
The hearth fire was a god in the Ainu home. They prayed to the fire goddess Kamuy Fuchi, their most important female deity, in times of sickness, saw her hearth as the gateway between the human world and the world of the gods, and believed that the soul of the dead passed through her hearth on its way to the afterlife.

The Yoruba made Shango the orisha of fire and thunder, a deified third king of Oyo.
zh:
在阿伊努人家中，炉火就是神。他们在患病时向火神神威媪祈祷，她是阿伊努人最重要的女神；人们视她的炉灶为人界与神界之间的门户，并相信死者的灵魂要穿过她的炉灶才能到达来世。

约鲁巴人则以桑戈为火与雷的奥里沙，他是被奉为神的奥约第三位国王。

en:
Freyja, 'the Lady', was a Vanir goddess of love, fertility, gold and magic, who also took half of those slain in battle to her hall in Fólkvangr. Snorri calls her the easiest of the gods to pray to, above all in matters of love.

In the poem Hyndluljóð her devotee Óttar builds her a stone altar and often sacrifices to it, and she helps him learn his ancestry. The honorific fruvor, used of noble ladies, comes from her name.
zh:
弗蕾亚意为“女主人”，是华纳神族掌管爱情、丰产、黄金与魔法的女神，还把战死者的一半接到自己在福尔克范格的殿堂。斯诺里称她是诸神中最容易向她祈祷的一位，尤其在爱情方面。

在《欣德拉之歌》中，她的信徒奥塔尔为她垒起石坛，经常向她献祭，她也帮他查明了自己的祖先。称呼贵妇的尊称“弗吕尔”便来源于她的名字。

en:
Freyr, 'Lord', was a Vanir god of kingship, peace, fertility and good harvests, regarded as an ancestor of the Swedish royal house. Adam of Bremen describes his phallic image at Uppsala, where sacrifices were made to him at weddings, and says his statue at Skara was destroyed by Bishop Egino.

He owned the boar Gullinbursti and the ship Skíðblaðnir. The skald Egill Skallagrímsson called on Freyr and Njörðr to drive Eric Bloodaxe out of Norway.
zh:
弗雷意为“主人”，是华纳神族掌管王权、和平、丰产与丰收的神，被视为瑞典王室的祖先。不来梅的亚当描述过他在乌普萨拉的阳具形神像，婚礼上要向他献祭，还记载他在斯卡拉的神像被主教埃吉诺毁掉。

他拥有野猪古林布斯提和飞船斯基德布拉德尼尔。吟唱诗人埃吉尔·斯卡拉-格里姆松曾祈求弗雷和尼奥尔德把血斧埃里克逐出挪威。

en: ǃHãunu is a lightning figure in the mythology of the ǀXam, a San people of southern Africa, and the rival of ǂKágára. ǀXam tales tell of their fight in the east.
zh: 豪努是南部非洲桑人中克萨姆人神话里的闪电角色，是卡加拉的对手。克萨姆人的故事讲述了两者在东方的交战。

en:
Huehuetéotl, the Old God, was one of the oldest Mesoamerican deities, a god of fire shown as a bearded, toothless old man carrying a great brazier on his back. His effigies have been found at Cuicuilco and Monte Albán, at Teotihuacan, and as far away as the Guatemalan highlands.

In Aztec practice the Florentine Codex treats him as another name of Xiuhtecuhtli, and hearts torn from sacrificial victims were burned on coals to win back his favour.
zh:
休赫特奥特尔意为“老神”，是中美洲最古老的神祇之一，作为火神，形象是背负巨大火盆、留着胡子、没有牙齿的老人。他的神像在奎奎尔科和蒙特阿尔万、特奥蒂瓦坎都有发现，远至危地马拉高地。

在阿兹特克人的实践中，《佛罗伦萨手抄本》把他当作修特库特利的另一个名字；人们把祭牲的心脏放在炭火上焚烧，以重获他的恩宠。

en:
Huitzilopochtli was the solar and war god and the patron god of the Mexica and their capital Tenochtitlan. According to the Aubin Codex, he ordered them to leave Aztlán and guided their migration as the Mexica. Once minor, he was raised by Tlacaelel's reform to rank with Quetzalcoatl, Tlaloc and Tezcatlipoca.

The Mexica believed the sun needed blood to survive each 52-year cycle and offered him human hearts. The Templo Mayor, begun in 1325, fell to the Spaniards in 1521.
zh:
