维齐洛波奇特利是太阳与战争之神，也是墨西加人及其首都特诺奇蒂特兰的守护神。据《奥宾手抄本》记载，他命令族人离开阿兹特兰，并以“墨西加”之名引领他们迁徙。他原本只是一位次要的神，经特拉卡埃莱尔的宗教改革，地位提升到与魁札尔·科亚特尔、特拉洛克和特斯卡特利波卡并列。

墨西加人相信太阳需要鲜血才能度过每个52年的周期，因此向他献上人的心脏。大神庙于1325年始建，1521年被西班牙人摧毁。

en: Hun Hunahpu, ‘One Hunahpu’, is a figure of Maya mythology known from the Popol Vuh, the father of the Hero Twins Hunahpu and Xbalanque. Some scholars hold that the Classic Maya saw him reborn as the maize god.
zh: 胡恩·胡纳赫普意为“一·胡纳赫普”，是玛雅神话中见于《波波尔·乌》的人物，英雄双子胡纳赫普和希巴兰克的父亲。有学者认为，古典时期的玛雅人把他视作重生为玉米神的形象。

en: Hunntuattatteen is the wife of the San creator Kaggen, shown as a Cape hyrax and called the mother of bees.
zh: 洪图亚塔滕是桑人创造者卡根的妻子，形象为蹄兔，被称为蜜蜂之母。

en: Huracán, ‘One-Leg’, also called Heart of Sky, is a K'iche' Maya god of wind, storm and fire and one of the creator gods of the Popol Vuh. His name suggests a link with K'awiil, the one-legged god of lightning, and the word hurricane may derive from it.
zh: 胡拉坎意为“独腿”，又称“天之心”，是基切玛雅人的风、暴风和火之神，也是《波波尔·乌》中的创世神之一。他的名字让人联想到独腿的闪电神卡威尔，英语的“飓风”一词可能就源自这个名字。

en:
Ikenga, ‘strength of majesty’, is the horned figure that Igbo men, and women of high reputation, keep as a personal shrine. It joins a person’s Chi, or personal god, with the ancestors, the ndichie, and with the right hand, aka ikenga, the hand of power and achievement; it is activated by prayer and sacrifice.

Variants exist among neighbouring peoples: the Urhobo call it Ivri and the Edo Ikegobo.
zh:
伊肯伽意为“威严之力”，是带角的形象，伊博男子和声望高的女子将它作为个人的神龛。它把一个人的奇神（个人神）、祖先恩迪奇与右手阿卡伊肯伽联系在一起，右手代表力量与成就；通过祈祷和献祭使其发挥效力。

邻近民族也有类似的神龛像：乌尔霍博人称伊夫里，埃多人称伊凯戈博。

en: Ilat, the Kalenjin god of thunder and rain, ranks second to the sun god Asis. The Nandi distinguished a good Ilat whose distant rumbling drives danger away from a bad one whose close thunder strikes people dead.
zh: 伊拉特是卡伦津人的雷雨之神，地位仅次于太阳神阿西斯。南迪人把他分成两位：远处隆隆的雷声驱走危险的善神，和近处炸雷劈死人的恶神。

en:
Illapa was the Andean god of lightning, thunder, rain and war, among the highest-ranking gods of the Inca. According to Sarmiento de Gamboa, he gave Pachacuti a two-headed serpent idol as a protective talisman, and Pachacuti took him as his divine brother.

Temples to Illapa stood at Toqokachi in Cusco, where the church of San Blas was later built, and at Sacsayhuamán. As the empire grew, regional thunder gods such as Pariacaca and Apocatequil became local forms of him.
zh:
伊利亚帕是安第斯的闪电、雷鸣、降雨与战争之神，是印加万神殿中地位最高的神明之一。据萨米恩托·德·甘博亚记载，他赐给帕查库特克一尊双头蛇神像作为护身符，帕查库特克便奉他为神圣的兄弟。

库斯科的托科卡奇建有伊利亚帕的神庙，后来的圣布拉斯教堂就建在那里；萨克萨瓦曼也祭祀他。随着帝国扩张，帕里亚卡卡、阿波卡特基尔等地方的雷神都成了伊利亚帕的地方形态。

en:
Inti, the sun, was the national patron of the Inca state. The Sapa Inca and his family were held to descend from him, and his high priest ranked second only to the ruler.

Tradition credits Pachacuti with founding the Inti Raymi, the Inca New Year at the June solstice, a nine-day festival of processions, dances and animal sacrifices in Cusco. The last one attended by an Inca emperor was held in 1535, after which the Spaniards banned it.
zh:
太阳神因蒂是印加国家的守护神。萨帕·印加及其家族被认为是他的后裔，他的大祭司地位仅次于君主。

传统上认为帕查库特克创立了因蒂·赖米节，即6月至日的印加新年。这个持续九天的节日在库斯科举行，有游行、舞蹈和动物祭祀。印加皇帝亲自参加的最后一次在1535年，此后被西班牙人禁止。

en:
Ixchel was the aged jaguar goddess of midwifery and medicine, known by that name in sixteenth-century Yucatán. Bishop Diego de Landa called her the goddess of making children and of medicine.

In the month of Zip, physicians and shamans celebrated her feast, Ihcil Ixchel, bringing out divination stones and medicine bundles that held little idols of her. Scholars equate her with the Aztec goddess Toci.
zh:
伊希切尔是年迈的美洲豹女神，司掌助产与医药，这个名字见于16世纪的尤卡坦。主教雅各伯·德·兰达称她为“生育孩子的女神”和医药女神。

在齐普月，医生和萨满庆祝她的节日“伊希奇尔节”，拿出占卜石和装着她小神像的药包。学者把她与阿兹特克女神托奇相对应。

en: ǂKágára is a lightning figure in the mythology of the ǀXam, a San people of southern Africa. In ǀXam tales he fights his counterpart ǃHãunu in the east.
zh: 卡加拉是南部非洲桑人中克萨姆人神话里的闪电角色。在克萨姆人的故事中，他在东方与对手豪努交战。

en: Kaggen, the Mantis, is the best-known figure of San belief, known mainly from the /Xam. The eland he favoured is the most common helping animal in the trance dance, by which a shaman enters the spirit world.
zh: 卡根又称“螳螂”，是桑人信仰中最著名的形象，相关材料主要出自克萨姆人。他最宠爱的大角斑羚，是出神舞中最常见的助灵动物，萨满借此进入灵界。

en:
Kamuy-huci is the Ainu goddess of the hearth, one of the most important kamuy and keeper of the gateway between the human and kamuy worlds. As Iresu Kamuy, ‘People’s Teacher’, she brought fire to humans.

She also judges domestic affairs, punishing those who pollute a hearth. The hearth is also the abode of the dead: the Ainu word for ancestor means ‘those who dwell in the hearth’.
zh:
神威媪是阿伊努人的火塘女神，是最重要的神威之一，守护着人界与神威界之间的门户。作为伊雷苏神威，即“人类的教师”，她把火带给了人类。

她还裁判家事，惩罚玷污火塘的人。火塘也是亡者的居所：阿伊努语里的“祖先”一词意为“居于火塘者”。

en:
K'awiil was the Maya god of power, creation and lightning, shown with a long snout and one leg ending in a snake. Rain gods carried him as a lightning axe, and rulers held him as a scepter.

At Palenque, rulers and nobles hold infant forms of K'awiil in the stucco reliefs of the Temple of the Inscriptions, and the infant god was one of the city's three patron deities. In sixteenth-century Yucatán he was known as Bolon Dzacab.
zh:
卡威尔是玛雅人的权力、创造与闪电之神，形象是长吻，一条腿的末端是一条蛇。雨神把他当作闪电斧来持握，统治者则把他当作权杖。

在帕伦克，铭文神殿的灰泥浮雕上，统治者和贵族抱着婴儿形态的卡威尔，这位婴儿神也是该城的三位守护神之一。16世纪的尤卡坦，他被称为博隆·扎卡布。

en: Kayra Khan was the creator god of the Altai peoples, pictured in their creation myth as a white goose flying over the primordial waters. He is held to have made the lesser gods, among them Ülgen, and to rule from the seventeenth level of the universe.
zh: 凯尔拉汗是阿尔泰各族的创世神，在创世神话里化为一只飞越原初之水的白鹅。传说他创造了于尔根等次一级的神，居于宇宙的第十七层，统御一切。

en: Khuanu, 'mother of nature', is the wife of the supreme god Pathian in Mizo belief, a kindly goddess who blesses humans as a matriarch and is taken to embody Pathian's loving side. The Reverend Liangkhaia read her, as Khuavang or Khuanu, as the watcher and keeper of the village, khua, in the word Sakhua.
zh: 库阿努意为“自然之母”，在米佐人的信仰中是至高神帕提安的妻子，是仁慈的女神，以母亲般的身份赐福人类，被视为帕提安慈爱一面的化身。利昂凯亚牧师把她（称库阿旺或库阿努）解释为萨库阿一词中“库阿”所指的村庄看守者。

en:
Kim-un-kamuy, ‘god of the mountains’, also called Metotush Kamuy and Nuparikor Kamuy, is the Ainu god of bears and mountains. Bears are generally regarded as benevolent.

Every village that could afford it kept a captured bear cub for a year, then shot it with arrows in a bear ceremony. Its flesh was eaten to free its spirit to return to the heavens, where it told Kim-un-kamuy of the humans’ piety.
zh:
山熊神威意为“山之神”，又称梅托图什神威和努帕里科神威，是阿伊努人的熊神和山神。熊通常被视为仁慈的。

凡是有条件的村落，都会捕来一只幼熊养上一年，然后在熊祭上用箭将它射杀。人们吃它的肉，让它的灵魂得以返回天界，向山熊神威讲述人类的虔诚。

en: Kine Nane is a goddess of the Tani peoples of Arunachal Pradesh, named with Donyi, Polo and Doying Bote among the chief gods of nature who are said to watch over the earth and humanity.
zh: 基内纳内是阿鲁纳恰尔邦塔尼诸族的女神，与冬尼、波罗和多英波特并列为自然诸神中的主神，相传他们注视着大地和人类。

en:
Kotan-kar-kamuy, ‘village-making deity’, is the creator god of the Ainu. The missionary John Batchelor held that every kamuy answers to him and concluded that Ainu faith was originally monotheistic, a view Norbert Adami rejects, since he is rarely worshipped.

In one myth he tried to make fire for mankind. A poplar drill failed and became evil spirits; an elm succeeded, and its white shavings became the huntress goddess Hasinaw-uk-kamuy, its black shavings the bear Mountain God.
zh:
村作神威意为“造村之神”，是阿伊努人的创世神。传教士约翰·巴彻勒认为所有神威都对他负责，由此推断阿伊努信仰原本是一神教；诺伯特·亚当尼不同意，因为他很少受到祭拜。

有一则神话讲他想为人类造出火。杨木钻失败了，变成恶灵；榆木成功了，白色的木屑变成女猎神哈西瑙乌克神威，黑色的木屑变成熊形的山神。

en:
K'uk'ulkan, the Plumed Serpent, was a Maya serpent god whose cult, centred on Chichen Itza, was the first Mesoamerican religion to cross the old ethnic and linguistic divisions, spreading as far as the Guatemalan Highlands and northern Belize.

After Chichen Itza fell, Mayapan became the centre of the revived cult. At the Spanish arrival the high priest of K'uk'ulkan was the patriarch of the Xiu lineage.
zh:
库库尔坎意为“羽蛇”，是玛雅人的蛇神，他的崇拜以奇琴伊察为中心，是中美洲第一个超越旧有族群和语言界限的宗教，一直传到危地马拉高地和伯利兹北部。

奇琴伊察衰落后，玛雅潘成为复兴的库库尔坎崇拜的中心。西班牙人到来时，库库尔坎的大祭司是休族的族长。

en:
Legba, in Fon Lɛgbà and in Ewe and Mina Elegba, is the Vodun spirit of the crossroads, who opens communication between people and the spirit world. Elegba may have been taken over from the Yoruba, among whom the figure is called Eshu-Elegba.

He is the first spirit consulted when a new undertaking begins and is invoked at the start of every ceremony. He is believed to speak all human languages.
zh:
雷格巴在丰语中作Lɛgbà，在埃维语和米纳语中作埃莱格巴，是巫毒教中十字路口的灵，沟通人与灵界。埃莱格巴可能借自约鲁巴人，他们称这一形象为埃舒—埃莱格巴。

开始一项新事业时，人们首先向他求问；每场仪式开始时也要先召请他。相传他通晓人类的一切语言。

en:
Lisa is the male half of the dual creator deity Mawu-Lisa, worshipped by the Fon of Dahomey and other Gbe-speaking peoples. His name derives from Òrìṣànlá, a name of the Yoruba creator Ọbàtálá, whose traits merged with those of Mawu.

In Dahomean myth Mawu made humankind, and Lisa was told to teach people to build civilization. The pair are parents of Oba Koso, known as Hebioso among the Fon.
zh:
莉萨是双重创世神玛武与莉萨中的男性一半，受达荷美丰人和其他说格贝语的民族崇拜。他的名字源于奥里沙恩拉，即约鲁巴创造神奥巴塔拉的别名，其神性与玛武的神性合并。

达荷美神话中，玛武造出人类，莉萨受命教人建设文明。这一对神是奥巴·科索的父母，奥巴·科索在丰人中称为赫比奥索。

en:
Mainao is the daughter of the supreme god Bathoubwrai and the protector of the rice fields, sometimes equated with the Hindu Lakshmi. Bathou is never worshipped without her: her altar stands on the left of his, and worshippers turn the lamp seven times before it.

Among the four kinds of Kherai festival, the Darshan Kherai, held in the first week of Kartik, is meant for her and the winter rice crop.
zh:
买瑙是至高神巴图布赖的女儿，稻田的守护者，有时被等同于印度教的吉祥天女。祭拜巴图时必有买瑙：她的祭坛在巴图左侧，拜神者在她面前把灯转七圈。

凯莱节有四种，其中每年迦底迦月第一周举行的达尚凯莱节就是献给她的，与冬稻的收成相关。

en:
Mama Qucha, 'Mother Sea', was the Inca goddess of the sea and fish and guardian of sailors and fishermen. She was the wife of Wiraqucha and the mother of Inti and Mamaquilla, and one of the four Elemental Mothers beside Pachamama, Mama Nina and Mama Wayra.

People prayed to her to calm rough water and to bring good fishing; in some regions she was thought the goddess of all waters, lakes and rivers included.
zh:
玛玛·科查意为“海母”，是印加的海洋与鱼类女神，也是水手和渔民的守护者。她是维拉科查的妻子、因蒂和玛玛·基利亚之母，与帕查玛玛、玛玛·尼纳、玛玛·瓦伊拉并称四位元素之母。

人们向她祈求平息波涛、渔获丰盛；在一些地区，她被当作包括湖泊和河流在内的一切水域的女神。

en:
Mamaquilla, 'Mother Moon', was the Inca moon goddess, elder sister and wife of Inti and mother of the founders Manco Cápac and Mama Ocllo. She presided over marriage and the menstrual cycle and was seen as a defender of women.

Her temple at Cusco was served by priestesses and held a silver disc covering a whole wall. She was said to weep tears of silver, and a lunar eclipse was taken to mean that an animal was attacking her.
zh:
玛玛·基利亚意为“月母”，是印加的月亮女神，因蒂的姐姐和妻子，也是开国始祖曼科·卡帕克和玛玛·奥克略之母。她掌管婚姻和月经周期，被视为妇女的保护者。

她在库斯科的神庙由女祭司侍奉，里面有一面覆满整堵墙的银盘。传说她流下的眼泪是白银，月食则被认为是有野兽在攻击她。

en:
Marang Buru, ‘the Great Mountain’, is the supreme deity of the Santal, Bhumij, Ho and Munda peoples of eastern India. He is regarded as the cause of all causes, which makes the tribal religion both monotheistic and pantheistic. To the Santal the deity is a hill itself.

Among the names given to the protector of the village in the Sarna faith, Marang Buru stands beside Gram Deoti and Singbonga.
zh:
摩烂迦补卢意为“大山”，是印度东部桑塔尔人、布米吉人、霍人和蒙达人的至高神。他被视为万因之因，因此这些部落的宗教既是一神论的，也是泛神论的。对桑塔尔人来说，这位神就是一座山。

在娑罗教给村落保护神的各种名称中，摩烂迦补卢与村神格拉姆·德奥蒂和辛邦加并列。

en:
Mawu, ‘the Unsurpassable One’, is the creator goddess of Gbe-speaking peoples and West African Vodun. With her partner Lisa she forms the dual deity Mawu-Lisa, child of Nana Buluku.

In myth Mawu alone made humans from clay and set the primeval serpent Aido Hwedo beneath the earth to hold it up. She became the state deity of Dahomey, though the pair may have been borrowed from the Yoruba.
zh:
玛武意为“不可逾越者”，是说格贝语诸民族和西非巫毒教的创世女神。她与伴侣莉萨合为双重神明玛武与莉萨，是娜娜·布鲁库之子。

神话中，玛武独自用黏土造出人类，并让原初巨蛇艾多·赫韦多盘在大地之下将其托起。她成为达荷美的国家神，不过这一对神明可能借自约鲁巴人。

en: Mergen was a Turkic deity of abundance and wisdom, a son of Kayra and brother of Ülgen, pictured as a young man with a helmet and bow riding a white horse. His name means archer.
zh: 墨尔根是突厥人的丰饶与智慧之神，凯尔拉之子，于尔根之弟，形象是头戴头盔、手持弓箭、骑着白马的青年。他的名字在突厥语里意为弓箭手。

en:
Worship of a Feathered Serpent is first documented at Teotihuacan around the first century BC or AD and spread across Mesoamerica by the Late Classic period. The pyramid temple of Cholula, built in stages from the third century BC to the ninth century AD, is traditionally said to be dedicated to Quetzalcoatl.

By the Postclassic period Cholula was the centre of his cult, and in his aspect as Ehecatl he was the god of wind.
zh:
对羽蛇的崇拜，最早见于公元前1世纪或公元1世纪的特奥蒂瓦坎，到古典晚期已传遍中美洲。乔鲁拉的金字塔神庙从公元前3世纪起分阶段建造，直到公元9世纪，传统上认为是献给魁札尔·科亚特尔的。

到后古典时期，乔鲁拉成为他的崇拜中心，而以埃埃卡特尔的面相，他是风神。

en:
Mindiss is a female protector of the Fatick region in Serer religion. Strictly she is not a deity but a pangool, one of the ancestral spirits who intercede between the living and the supreme being Roog, though she has goddess-like attributes. She is a water pangool, yet also a blood pangool.

Offerings are made in her name at the River Sine, and she is said to appear to humans in the form of a manatee.
zh:
门迪丝是塞雷尔宗教中法蒂克一带的女性保护者。严格说来她不是神，而是潘古尔，即在生者与至高神鲁格之间代为说情的祖灵，只是带有女神般的属性。她属于水系潘古尔，同时也是血缘潘古尔。

人们在锡内河边以她的名义献上祭品，据说她会以海牛的形象出现在人前。

en: Among the Gonds, the village mother goddess, the anwal, is worshipped with the village guardian Aki Pen before any festival, in a pattern shared with other Dravidian folk traditions.
zh: 贡德人在每个节庆之前，都要敬奉村母神安瓦尔和村落守护神阿吉宾，这种模式与其他达罗毗荼民族的民间信仰相似。

en: The anwal is the village mother goddess of the Gonds, worshipped with the village guardian Aki Pen before any festival begins. Like him she receives the fervent devotion that Gond tradition keeps for village and clan deities rather than for the high god Baradeo.
zh: 安瓦尔是贡德人的村母神，在节庆开始之前与村落守护神阿吉宾一同受到敬奉。和他一样，她得到的是贡德传统留给村神和氏族神的热切虔诚，而不是献给高神婆罗提乌的。

en: The Gikuyu of Kenya prayed and sacrificed to Ngai, addressing him as Mwene Nyaga, the Owner of Brightness, a name tied to Kirinyaga, Mount Kenya. Traditional worship faced the mountain, where the god was held to look down on the people he had given their founding couple, Gikuyu and Mumbi.
zh: 肯尼亚的基库尤人向恩加伊祈祷和献祭，称他为“姆文内·尼亚加”，意为“光明之主”，这个名字与基库尤人所称的基里尼亚加，即肯尼亚山相连。传统上礼拜时面向这座山，人们相信神从那里俯视他赐给人们的始祖夫妇基库尤和穆姆比的后代。

en: Among the Dinka of the Nile plains, prayers are addressed first to Nhialic, the supreme god of sky and rain, and only then to clan divinities and ancestral spirits. People pray for mild weather, a good harvest, the protection of the community, the recovery of sick cattle and success in hunting, and a bull or ox is sacrificed.
zh: 在尼罗河平原上的丁卡人中，祈祷先向掌管天空和降雨的至高神尼雅力克诉说，然后才依次呼唤氏族神灵和祖先之灵。人们祈求风调雨顺、庄稼丰收、族人平安、病牛康复和狩猎顺利，并献祭一头公牛或阉牛。

en: Niparaya is the all-powerful master and creator of heaven and earth in the beliefs of the Pericú, an Indigenous people of the southern tip of Baja California. Fragments of their mythology were recorded in the early 1730s. His wife is Amayicoyondi, and they had three sons. One, Quaayayp, made the race of men and was later killed by them.
zh: 尼帕拉亚是下加利福尼亚半岛南端的佩里库人信仰中全能的主宰，天地的创造者。佩里库人神话的零星片段在18世纪30年代初被记录下来。他的妻子是阿马伊科永迪，两人生有三个儿子，其中一个名叫夸亚伊普，造出了人类，后来被人类杀死。

en:
Njörðr was a Vanir god of the sea, ships, fishing, wind and wealth, father of Freyr and Freyja, who lived at Nóatún. Snorri writes that he should be invoked in seafaring and fishing and could grant wealth in land and goods to those who asked.

His name survives in place names such as Njarðvík in Iceland and Närtuna in Sweden. Among Norwegians he was still thanked for a good catch of fish in the eighteenth century.
zh:
尼奥尔德是华纳神族的海洋、航行、渔业、风与财富之神，弗雷和弗蕾亚的父亲，居住在诺阿通。斯诺里写道，航海和捕鱼时应当向他祈求，他也能赐予求告者土地与财富。

他的名字留存在冰岛的尼亚尔德维克和瑞典的内尔图纳等地名中。在挪威民间，直到18世纪还有人在渔获丰盛时向他致谢。

en: Many Bantu-speaking peoples addressed a supreme sky god as Nyambe or by related names such as Nzambi, yet ritual attention fell more often on ancestors, who were thought to speak with the gods.
zh: 许多讲班图语的族群用尼扬贝或恩赞比等相近的名字称呼至高的天神，但仪式的重心更多落在祖先身上，人们认为祖先能与诸神交谈。

en:
Obatala, ‘King of White Cloth’, also called Oriṣanla, is the king of the orisha in Yoruba religion. Olodumare named him sculptor of humankind: he came down from Heaven on a chain and moulded the first humans from clay, and shapes each child in the womb.

In some versions Eshu tempts him into drinking palm wine and his brother Oduduwa outdoes him. Ife tradition also remembers a mortal Obatala as the city’s founder-king.
zh:
奥巴塔拉意为“白布之王”，又称奥里桑拉，是约鲁巴宗教中诸奥里沙的王。奥洛杜马雷称他为“人类的雕塑者”：他沿着一条锁链从天界降下，用黏土塑出最初的人类，并在母腹中塑造每个孩子。

在某些说法里，埃舒诱他喝下棕榈酒，弟弟奥杜杜瓦胜过了他。伊费的传统还记得一位名叫奥巴塔拉的凡人，是这座城的创建者和国王。

en:
Odin was the Norse god of war, the dead and poetic wisdom, who received slain warriors at Valhöll. Tacitus says the Suebi sacrificed on fixed days, human victims included, to a god he calls Mercury, usually taken to be Odin. Adam of Bremen writes that at Uppsala offerings were made to Wodan when war threatened.

A Danish gold bracteate of perhaps the fifth century reads 'He is Odin's man', and Old English royal houses traced their descent from Woden.
zh:
奥丁是北欧的战争、死者与诗性智慧之神，在瓦尔哈拉接纳阵亡的战士。塔西佗记载，苏维汇人在固定的日子向一位他称为墨丘利的神献祭，其中包括人牲，通常认为这位神就是奥丁。不来梅的亚当写道，乌普萨拉在战争临近时向沃坦献祭。

丹麦出土的一枚可能早至5世纪的金箔牌上刻着“他是奥丁之人”，古英格兰的王室也把自己的世系追溯到沃登。

en: Ogbunabali, ‘one who kills at night’, is the traditional Igbo deity of death. He is said to kill criminals and those who have broken an unspeakable taboo.
zh: 奥古纳巴利意为“夜里杀人者”，是伊博人传统上的死神。据说他夜间杀死罪犯和犯下不可言说禁忌的人。

en:
Olokun is the orisha of the ocean depths and ruler of all waters, held to be parent of Ajé, the orisha of wealth. He is worshipped in Yoruba and Edo cities of south-western Nigeria: in Ife, where the Oba Ijio is his chief priest, and at Badagry and Lagos.

In early Lagos the Oniru chief held an annual festival for Olokun to avert flooding. In Ife tradition Olokun was Oduduwa’s wife and became the sea after leaving him.
zh:
奥洛昆是掌管深海的奥里沙，统辖一切水域，被认为是财富之神阿杰的父母。他在尼日利亚西南部的约鲁巴和埃多城市受到崇拜：伊费的主祭司是奥巴·伊乔，巴达格里和拉各斯也有崇拜。

早期的拉各斯，奥尼鲁酋长每年为奥洛昆举行节庆，以免海岸遭水淹。在伊费的传说中，奥洛昆是奥杜杜瓦的妻子，离开他后变成了大海。

en:
Ọlọrun, also called Olodumare, is the supreme deity of the Yoruba, ruler of the Heavens and creator of the universe. The name contracts oní, ‘owner’, and ọ̀run, ‘the Heavens’, the abode of the spirits; Olodumare is read as ‘the All Sufficient’ or ‘owner of the pot from which the rainbow shines’.

In the Ife creation tradition Ọlọrun lets the orisha Obatala shape the first humans from clay, then breathes life into them.
zh:
欧洛伦又称奥洛杜马雷，是约鲁巴人的至高神，统治诸天，创造宇宙。这个名字由表示“拥有者”的oní和表示“诸天”、即灵的居所的ọ̀run缩合而成；奥洛杜马雷则被解释为“全足者”或“彩虹所出之壶的主人”。

在伊费的创世传统中，欧洛伦让奥里沙奥巴塔拉用黏土塑出最初的人类，再给他们吹入生命。

en:
Orí, literally ‘head’, is the Yoruba concept of a person’s spiritual intuition and destiny, and is often personified as an orisha in its own right. Whatever one becomes, the Yoruba hold, is as Orí destined.

Orí is therefore worshipped like an orisha: when things go wrong it is consulted, and appeased to set them right. A person who has built a balanced character, iwa-pele, is said to be aligned with Orí, his or her divine self.
zh:
奥里字面意思是“头”，是约鲁巴人对个人精神直觉和命运的概念，常被拟人化为一位独立的奥里沙。约鲁巴人认为，一个人最终成为什么样，都是奥里注定的。

因此人们像敬奉奥里沙一样敬奉奥里：事情不顺时向它求问，并加以安抚，使事情转好。养成了均衡品性伊瓦-佩莱的人，被认为与自己的神圣自我奥里相合。

en:
Pachamama, the Earth Mother, was the Andean goddess of land, harvest and fertility. Her shrines were sacred rocks or the trunks of legendary trees, and priests offered her llamas, guinea pigs and miniature garments burned in fire.

Myth made her the wife of Pachacamac, or in other tales the mother, and later wife, of Inti. Animal sacrifices at the Inti Raymi thanked her and asked for a good harvest. After the Spanish conquest she was identified with the Virgin Mary.
zh:
帕查玛玛即大地之母，是安第斯的土地、丰收与生育女神。她的神龛是神圣的岩石或传说中的树干，祭司向她献上美洲驼、豚鼠和烧掉的微型衣物。

神话称她是帕查卡马克的妻子，另一些说法里她是因蒂的母亲，又成为他的第二任妻子。因蒂·赖米节上的动物祭祀既是向她致谢，也是祈求丰收。西班牙人征服后，她被与圣母马利亚等同起来。

en:
Paruhang, also called Ninamma, 'Father', is the sky god of the Rai, one of the Kirati peoples of the eastern Himalaya, and the lord of flowers. As the husband of the earth goddess Sumnima he is held to be creator, preserver and sustainer of the Rai, and is sometimes equated with the Hindu Shiva.

In the silli dances of the Sakela festival, ancestors such as Paruhang and Nayuma are enacted.
zh:
帕茹夯又称尼纳玛，意为“父亲”，是东喜马拉雅基拉特诸族之一的莱人的天神，也是花之主。他是大地女神松米玛的丈夫，被奉为莱人的创造者、养育者和守护者，有时被等同于印度教的湿婆。

在萨克拉节的西里舞中，帕茹夯和纳尤玛等祖先的形象会被表演出来。

en:
Pathian is the supreme god of the Mizo, creator of the world and all in it, who lives in heaven and was believed to be kind and to help those who sought him. The righteous receive his blessings and good fortune, and the wicked calamities and misfortune.

Pu Vana and the goddess Khuanu are counted among his family, but traditionally the Mizo prayed to Pathian alone and not to his other forms.
zh:
帕提安是米佐人的至高神，世界和其中万物的创造者，居于天上，被认为仁慈，会帮助向他求助的人。他赐福运给正直者，降灾祸给恶人。

普·瓦纳和女神库阿努被视为他的家人，但传统上米佐人只向帕提安祈祷，不祈求他的其他化身。

en: Tai communities kept their guardian spirits close at hand, honouring them at the temple and at the town pillar, the lak mueang.
zh: 泰族的村镇把守护神灵供奉在身边，在寺庙和城镇立柱“拉勐”处祭祀它们。

en: The Tai peoples, in their old religion of Satsana Phi, honoured many phi, among them gods tied to the elements of heaven, earth, fire and water. Fire was one of these natural powers, to be appeased with offerings like the other spirits.
zh: 泰族诸民族的古老宗教丕教崇奉众多的丕，其中有与天、地、火、水等元素相联的神灵。火是这些自然力量之一，和其他神灵一样需要用供品来安抚。

en:
Phi Fa, or Phi Thaen, is the Tai god of rain and the sky, ruler of the heavens and creator god, prominent in the legends of Khun Borom. Thaen, ‘sky’, comes from the Chinese tian.

In the Phi Fa ritual, held for someone recovered from serious illness, a shaman invites the god. A night of dance around an altar to the khaen, a bamboo mouth organ, brings trance and calls for healing and protection.
zh:
丕法又称丕天，是泰人的雨神和天神，是诸天的统治者和创世神，在昆博罗姆的传说中占有重要地位。“滕”意为“天”，来自汉语的“天”字。

丕法仪式传统上为大病痊愈的人举行，由萨满邀请神前来。人们围着祭坛伴着竹笙起舞通宵，进入出神状态，祈求治愈与庇护。

en: In the baci ceremony the Tai called back a person's lost khwan, the vital forces, and tied cotton strings round the wrist.
zh: 在“巴西”仪式上，泰族人召回一个人走失的宽，即生命灵气，并在手腕上拴上棉线。

en:
Polo is the Moon, addressed by the Tani peoples of Arunachal as Abu Polo, 'Father Moon', and always paired with Donyi, the Sun. Together they stand for the balance of day and night, heat and cool.

In sacral speech 'Donyi-Polo' also means truth, and the Tani call themselves Donyi O, Polo Ome, 'children of the Sun and the Moon', trusting the pair to punish wrongdoers.
zh:
波罗是月亮，阿鲁纳恰尔的塔尼诸族称他为“阿布波罗”，即“月亮父亲”，总与太阳冬尼成对出现。两者合起来代表昼夜、冷热的平衡。

在神圣的话语中，“冬尼波罗”也指真理；塔尼人自称“冬尼之子、波罗之子”，相信这一对神明会惩罚作恶者。

en: Pu Vana, 'God in Heaven', is a benevolent spirit of the Mizo, said to be the grandfather of the Pathian family and most likely the father of Pathian himself. He was revered as the god of nature, holding the power of thunder and lightning, and so resembles the Hindu Indra.
zh: 普·瓦纳意为“天上的神”，是米佐人信仰中的仁慈神灵，据说是帕提安一家的祖父，很可能就是帕提安的父亲。他被奉为自然之神，掌管雷电，因此与印度教的因陀罗相似。

en:
Quetzalcoatl, the Feathered Serpent, was an Aztec creator god linked to wind, the planet Venus, learning, crafts and merchants, and the patron god of the priesthood. The two chief priests of the Templo Mayor bore the title Quetzalcoatl Tlamacazqui.

His main cult centre was Cholula, whose Great Pyramid is traditionally held to be dedicated to him. After the Spanish conquest, writers merged him with Ce Acatl Topiltzin, a ruler of Tollan, a conflation historians still debate.
zh:
魁札尔·科亚特尔，即羽蛇，是阿兹特克人的创世神之一，与风、金星、学识、工艺和商人相连，也是祭司阶层的守护神。大神庙的两位大祭司都带有“魁札尔·科亚特尔·特拉马卡兹基”的头衔。

他的主要崇拜中心是乔鲁拉，当地的大金字塔传统上被认为是献给他的。西班牙征服之后，作者们把他与托兰的统治者塞·阿卡特尔·托皮尔钦混为一谈，史学家对这一合并仍有争论。

en: Ratovantany is the Malagasy earth god who, with the sky god Zanahary, made the first humans and takes back their bodies at death. He does not appear to have been a prominent god of any Malagasy group.
zh: 拉托万塔尼是马达加斯加的大地神，他与天神扎纳哈里共同造人，人死后收回人的身体。他似乎没有成为任何马达加斯加族群崇奉的显要神明。

en:
Rep-un-kamuy is the Ainu god of the sea, sometimes pictured as an orca and sometimes as a carefree young man with a harpoon. The sea offered fishing, whale hunting and trading voyages that the land could not.

In one myth he throws a harpooned whale ashore near a village. Told that the humans butcher it with axes, he laughs and lets them have the meat, until he sees that they cut it with ritual swords in the proper manner.
zh:
海鲸神威是阿伊努人的海神，有时被画成虎鲸，有时是手持鱼叉、无忧无虑的年轻人。大海提供了陆地上没有的渔获、捕鲸和海上贸易的机会。

一则神话讲他把中了鱼叉的鲸抛到村子附近的岸上。有鸟告诉他人们用斧头粗暴地分割，他一笑置之，说肉本来就归人类，后来才发现人们其实是按规矩用神圣的刀切割鲸肉。

en:
Sakhua is the guardian spirit of a Mizo clan, the mark of its identity. Each clan had its own Sakhua and its own priest, the sadâwt, who made the offerings.

A man who set up a house apart from his parents performed the sakung: a sadâwt chanted and sacrificed a pig over three days, after which the man stood free of his father's Sakhua and held a family religion of his own.
zh:
萨库阿是米佐人氏族的守护神灵，代表氏族的身份。每个氏族都有自己的萨库阿和主持献祭的祭司“萨道特”。

男子另立门户时要举行“萨昆”仪式：萨道特诵经，并在三天里宰杀一头猪，此后这名男子便脱离父亲的萨库阿，有了属于自己家庭的信仰。

en:
Sakpata is the Vodun god of the earth, wellness and smallpox, worshipped by the Ewe, Fon and Adja peoples, from south-western Nigeria to the Volta region of Ghana. He can heal or inflict disease and madness, and is the Dahomean form of the Yoruba smallpox god Sopona.

Oral history says smallpox nearly destroyed these peoples’ ancestors at Adja Tado until a Yoruba man, Torgbui Anyi, cured them.
zh:
萨克帕塔是巫毒教中掌管大地、健康与天花的神，受埃维人、丰人和阿贾人崇拜，分布从尼日利亚西南部到加纳沃尔特地区。他既能治愈也能降下疾病和疯癫，是约鲁巴天花神索波纳在达荷美的形态。

口述历史称，这些民族的祖先在阿贾塔多一度几乎被天花灭绝，直到一位叫托布伊·阿尼的约鲁巴人治好了他们。

en:
Many peoples set their supreme god in the sky and honoured him as protector of all. The Akan knew Nyame as the sky god who sees and knows everything, the Malagasy knew Zanahary, the Dinka Nhialic, and the Oromo Waaqa, the creator of the world.

A sky father was often paired with an earth mother: the Akan made the earth goddess Asase Yaa the wife of Nyame.
zh:
许多民族把至高神安置在天上，奉他为一切人的守护者。阿坎人称天神为尼亚梅，意为洞察一切者；马达加斯加人称扎纳哈里，丁卡人称尼雅力克，奥罗莫人称世界的创造者为瓦卡。

天父常与地母成对出现：阿坎人把大地女神阿萨西·亚奉为尼亚梅的妻子。

en:
Song Bwrai, also called Song Raja, is one of the four prominent household gods of the Boro, named by Sidney Endle with Bathoubwrai, Mainao and Bura Bagh Raja. His shrine, the dham, stands inside the house, and it is chiefly women who worship him, with offerings made even during their monthly courses.

These offerings are afterwards carried out and laid at the sijou tree that represents Bathou.
zh:
宋布赖又称宋拉贾，是博多人四位主要家神之一，西德尼·恩德尔把他与巴图布赖、买瑙和布拉巴格王并列。他的神龛“达姆”设在屋内，主要由妇女祭拜，月经期间也要供奉。

这些供品事后会被拿出屋外，放到代表巴图的西久树下。

en:
Sumnima, also called Hengkhamma, is the supreme goddess of the Rai, one of the Kirati peoples of the eastern Himalaya. She is Mother Earth and ancestral mother, wife of the sky god Paruhang, and the pair are the Rai's creator and sustainer deities, sometimes equated with the Hindu Shiva and Parvati.

Her worship belongs to the Sakela festival, held twice a year at sowing and harvest, when the Rai thank Mother Nature and their ancestors with offerings and dance.
zh:
松米玛又称亨卡玛，是基拉特诸族之一的莱人的至高女神，居于东喜马拉雅。她是大地之母和祖先之母，天神帕茹夯的妻子；这一对神是莱人的创造者和养育者，有时被等同于印度教的湿婆与帕尔瓦蒂。

对她的崇拜体现在萨克拉节上：每年播种和收获时各举行一次，莱人用供品和舞蹈感谢大自然与祖先。

en: Supay, from the Quechua word for 'shadow', was an ambivalent spirit of the Andean underworld, a figure of night, darkness and death. The word itself was neutral: a Quechua-Spanish dictionary of 1560 by Domingo de Santo Tomás uses it for both good and bad spirits. Spanish missionaries afterwards turned Supay into the Christian Devil.
zh: 苏帕伊源自克丘亚语中的“影子”，是安第斯冥界里一个善恶不定的灵体，代表夜晚、黑暗和死亡。这个词本身是中性的：1560年多明戈·德·桑托·托马斯编的克丘亚语—西班牙语词典里，它既可指善灵，也可指恶灵。此后西班牙传教士把苏帕伊变成了基督教的魔鬼。

en: Takhar, or Taahkarr, is a demi-god of justice and vengeance in the traditional religion of the Serer of Senegal, the Gambia and Mauritania. He is worshipped at the foot of certain sacred trees in the forest, and the Serer priestly class evokes him and enforces the laws that his devotees must follow.
zh: 塔卡尔又作塔卡尔尔，是塞内加尔、冈比亚和毛里塔尼亚的塞雷尔人传统信仰中掌管正义与复仇的半神。人们在森林里某些圣树脚下敬拜他，塞雷尔人的祭司阶层负责召请他，并执行信徒必须遵守的律法。

en:
Tano, properly Ta Kora, is the Akan god of war and of the Tano River, regarded as the highest of the abosom. Among the Asante he is also a god of thunder and lightning.

His titles include ‘The One Who Wins Wars’ and ‘King within the Rock’, after the rock from which the river rises. His shrine on the river, the largest, holds crowns, staffs, umbrellas and a brass pan.
zh:
塔诺本名塔科拉，是阿肯人的战神，也是塔诺河之神，被视为诸阿博松中的最高者。在阿散蒂人中他还是雷电之神。

他的称号有“赢得战争者”和“岩中之王”，后者源于塔诺河发源的岩石。河边的神龛最大，供奉着王冠、权杖、华盖和一只铜盘。

en:
Tengri, the Eternal Blue Sky, was the patron god of the Turkic khans. The Göktürk rulers of the sixth to eighth centuries based their authority on a mandate from Tengri, bore titles such as tengrikut, from kut, the heavenly fortune he granted, and were regarded as his sons on earth.

A ninth-century divination book, the Irk Bitig, calls him Türük Tängrisi, the god of the Turks. His standing waned when the Uighur khagans adopted Manichaeism in the eighth century.
zh:
腾格里，即永恒的蓝天，是突厥诸可汗的守护神。6至8世纪的突厥统治者把权力建立在腾格里的授命之上，使用“腾格里库特”一类头衔，其中的“库特”指他赐予的天命福分，可汗被视为他在人间的儿子。

9世纪的占卜文献《占卜书》称他为“突厥人的腾格里”。8世纪回鹘可汗把摩尼教定为国教后，他在宫廷中的地位随之下降。

en: Tepeu, meaning ‘sovereign’, is a K'iche' Maya title attached to Q'uq'umatz, the Sovereign Plumed Serpent and one of the creator gods of the Popol Vuh. K'iche' rulers such as Tepepul also bore it.
zh: 特佩乌在基切语中意为“君主”，是基切玛雅人的称号，与《波波尔·乌》里的创世神之一、“君主羽蛇”古库马茨联系在一起；特佩普尔等基切统治者也使用这一称号。

en:
Tezcatlipoca, the Smoking Mirror, was a central Aztec god of the night sky, obsidian, conflict and divination. Bernardino de Sahagún's Florentine Codex records some 360 epithets for him, among them the lord of the near and nigh.

His chief festival was Toxcatl, held each May, in which a young man who had impersonated the god for a year was sacrificed. In May 1520 the Spaniards attacked the celebrants at Toxcatl, igniting open war.
zh:
特斯卡特利波卡，意为“冒烟的镜子”，是阿兹特克人信奉的核心神祇，司掌夜空、黑曜石、冲突与占卜。贝尔纳迪诺·德·萨阿贡的《佛罗伦萨手抄本》记录了他的约360个称号，其中有“近处与邻近之主”。

他的主要节日是每年5月的托什卡特节，节上要献祭一名扮演这位神整整一年的青年。1520年5月，西班牙人在托什卡特节上袭击了庆祝的人群，由此引发公开战争。

en:
Thunder gods were often gods of justice. The Yoruba of West Africa honoured Shango, who as the third Alaafin of Oyo was a warrior king, with a double-headed battle-axe as his emblem; his reign was said to have ended when lightning destroyed his palace.

The Igbo of southeastern Nigeria turned to Amadioha, the 'man of the people', who avenged the oppressed by striking down their oppressors; his white ram was his symbol, and the main shrine stands at Ozuzu.
zh:
雷神往往也是正义之神。西非的约鲁巴人敬奉桑戈，他生前是奥约的第三位阿拉芬，一位好战的国王，以双头战斧为标志；据说他的统治因闪电烧毁王宫而告终。

尼日利亚东南部的伊博人则求助阿马迪奥哈，意为“人民之人”，他劈击压迫者，为受压迫的人报仇；白公羊是他的象征，主神庙在奥祖祖。

en:
Tláloc was the Aztec god of rain, water and fertility, feared for his hail, thunder and lightning but honoured as a giver of life. His great rituals were held on Cerro Tláloc, the mountain where he was believed to dwell, and those who died by drowning, lightning or water-borne disease were thought to go to his paradise, Tlálocan.

At Tenochtitlan the Templo Mayor was dedicated jointly to him and Huitzilopochtli.
zh:
特拉洛克是阿兹特克人的雨水与丰产之神，人们畏惧他降下的冰雹、雷和闪电，又尊他为生命的赐予者。他的重大仪式在特拉洛克山举行，那里被认为是他的居所；溺水、遭雷击或死于水媒疾病的人，据信会前往他的乐园特拉洛坎。

在特诺奇蒂特兰，大神庙同时奉祀他和维齐洛波奇特利。

en:
Thor was the Norse thunder god, who wielded a hammer. In the temple at Uppsala described by Adam of Bremen he sat on the central throne between Odin and Freyr, and sacrifices were made to him in famine or plague.

About a thousand hammer pendants have been found from Scandinavia to England and the Baltic, and runestones in Denmark and Sweden call on him to hallow the runes. 'Thor's grove' is a common place name in Denmark.
zh:
托尔是北欧的雷神，手持战锤。在不来梅的亚当描述的乌普萨拉神庙里，他坐在居中的宝座上，奥丁与弗雷分坐两侧；遇到饥荒或瘟疫时便向他献祭。

从斯堪的纳维亚到英格兰和波罗的海沿岸，已发现约一千枚战锤吊坠；丹麦和瑞典的卢恩石碑上也有祈求托尔圣化这些卢恩的铭文。“托尔之林”是丹麦常见的地名。

en:
Týr was an ancient Germanic god of war and of the thing, the assembly of free men that made law and judged disputes. Roman writers equated him with Mars, and Frisian soldiers at Housesteads dedicated a third-century altar to Mars Thingsus.

His name gave Tuesday its name, and place names such as Tislund, 'Týr's grove', in Denmark and Tysnes in Norway point to his cult. Norse sources call him the son of the giant Hymir or of Odin.
zh:
提尔是古日耳曼人的战神，也是“庭”的神；“庭”是自由人制定法律、裁断争端的集会。罗马作者把他等同于玛尔斯，豪斯斯特兹要塞的弗里斯兰士兵在3世纪献上一座祭坛，献给“庭之玛尔斯”。

星期二以他的名字命名；丹麦的蒂斯隆德（意为“提尔之林”）和挪威的蒂斯内斯等地名也指向对他的崇拜。北欧文献称他是巨人许米尔或奥丁之子。

en:
U Blei Nong Thaw, the Creator God, is the supreme god of the Khasi, the hill people of Meghalaya. Khasi tradition names him U Blei Trai Kynrad, the Lord Master, who divided humankind into sixteen heavenly families, of which seven, the Hynñiewtrep, were left on earth.

A ladder resting on the sacred Lum Sohpetbneng peak let people pass to heaven until they were tricked into felling a divine tree on Lum Diengiei, which closed the way for ever.
zh:
乌勃黎·农陀是创世之神，是梅加拉亚山地的卡西人的至高神。卡西人的传统称他为乌勃黎·特赖·金拉德，即“主宰之主”，他把人类分成十六个天上的家族，其中七个留在了人间，称为欣尼乌特雷普。

一架靠在圣峰隆索佩特贝宁上的梯子本来可以让人上天，直到人们受骗砍倒了隆迪恩吉耶峰上的神树，通往天界的路从此断绝。

en: Khasi tradition said that the Lord Master first divided humankind into sixteen heavenly families, seven of which were left on earth.
zh: 卡西人的传说称，主宰最初把人类分成十六个天上的家族，其中七家被留在人间。

en: Khasi tradition told of a ladder on a sacred peak that once let people pass to heaven, until they were tricked into cutting down a divine tree.
zh: 卡西人的传说讲，圣峰上曾有一架天梯让人往来天界，直到人们受骗砍倒了一棵神树。

en: The Khasis had no script of their own and handed their religion down by word of mouth.
zh: 卡西人没有自己的文字，宗教靠口耳相传。

en:
Ülgen was the benevolent sky god of the Altai, Khakas and Shor peoples, who protected humankind against Erlik. Known chiefly from ethnography, he was traditionally honoured with animal sacrifice, above all of horses.

Every few years a shaman might offer a white horse and ride its soul up through the layers of heaven to Ülgen's golden house. Some Altai clans, such as the Soyon and the Irkit, did not honour him as the supreme god.
zh:
于尔根是阿尔泰、哈卡斯和绍尔各族的善良天神，保护人类抵御尔力克。关于他的记载主要来自民族志，传统上人们用牲畜祭祀他，尤其是马。

萨满每隔几年会献上一匹白马，骑着它的灵魂穿过一层层天界，前往于尔根的金色宫殿。阿尔泰的一些氏族，如索永和伊尔基特，并不把他尊为至高神。

en:
Umay was the Turkic goddess of mothers and children. An eighth-century inscription for the prince Kül Tigin praises his mother as being like Umay, and the khagans' wives, the katuns, were themselves counted as Umays, since their sons secured the dynasty.

In the eleventh century Mahmud al-Kashgari recorded that women who worshipped her bore sons. Traditionally Turkic women hung small cradles on strings to ask her for a child.
zh:
乌迈是突厥人的母亲与儿童女神。8世纪为阙特勤立的碑文称颂他的母亲如同乌迈，可汗的妻子哈屯也被视为乌迈，因为她们生下的儿子保证了王朝的延续。

11世纪，马赫穆德·喀什噶里记载，向她礼拜的妇女会生下男孩。传统上，突厥妇女会把系着小摇篮的绳子挂起来，向她求子。

en: Urpihuachac was a goddess of the Chincha, the seafaring people of the Peruvian coast; the name is said to mean 'she who bears doves'. Chincha tradition spoke of an island sanctuary, Urpihuachay, as the place from which their gods had come.
zh: 乌尔帕伊·瓦查克是秘鲁海岸航海民族钦查人的女神，名字据说意为“生出鸽子的女神”。钦查人相传诸神来自一座叫乌尔皮瓦查伊的圣岛。

en:
Wiraqucha was the creator god of the Andes before and under the Incas, who ranked his cult above even that of the sun. He was said to have made the universe, the sun, moon and stars, time and civilization, and to have ordered Tiwanaku built.

Imagined as a bearded man, he was the husband of the sea goddess Mama Qucha and the father of Inti. Commoners were not allowed to speak his name.
zh:
维拉科查是印加以前及印加治下安第斯地区的创世神，印加人把对他的崇拜置于太阳崇拜之上。据说他创造了宇宙、日月星辰、时间和文明，并下令修建了提亚瓦纳科。

他被想象为一个蓄须的男子，是海洋女神玛玛·科查的丈夫、因蒂的父亲。平民不得说出他的名字。

en:
The Oromo and related Cushitic peoples worshipped Waaqa as the one god, acting through ayyaana, intermediary spirits that possess chosen men and women and make them qallu priests and qallitti priestesses. These priests were expected to stay out of politics, yet could grant or withhold blessing from the Gadaa leadership.

Pilgrims travelled far to be anointed by the Abbaa Muudaa, the highest qallu.
zh:
奥罗莫人和相邻的库希特语民族崇拜作为唯一神的瓦格，神通过阿亚纳这种中介之灵行事，阿亚纳附在被选中的男女身上，使他们成为卡卢祭司和卡里提女祭司。这些祭司按规矩不干预政治，却能向盖达制度的领袖赐福或收回祝福。

朝圣者不远千里前来，请最高的卡卢阿巴穆达为自己涂油。

en:
Warriors across the world placed their wars under a god. The Yoruba of West Africa honoured Ogun, orisha of iron, metalwork and war, whose worship spread to the Edo and Itsekiri.

For the Maori, Tumatauenga was the god of war, and every war party was dedicated to him. In Hawaii the war god Ku was worshipped as Kukailimoku, the 'Snatcher of Land', with rituals that included human sacrifice.
zh:
世界各地的战士都把战事托付给一位神。西非的约鲁巴人敬奉奥贡，他是铁、金属加工和战争的奥里沙，对他的崇拜后来传到了埃多人和伊策基里人当中。

毛利人的战神是图玛陶恩加，每一支战队都要献给他。在夏威夷，战神库以库卡伊利莫库之名受人崇拜，意为“夺地者”，祭仪中包括人祭。

en:
Water had gods of its own among many peoples. The Yoruba revered Olokun, ruler of all waters and giver of wealth, health and prosperity, whose name passed into the religion of their Edo neighbours.

In Mexico the rain god Tlaloc was worshipped as a giver of life and sustenance, with mountaintop shrines and great rituals on Cerro Tlaloc, though he was also feared for hail, thunder and lightning.
zh:
水在许多民族那里都有自己的神。约鲁巴人敬奉奥洛昆，他统治一切水域，赐予财富、健康和繁荣，他的名字后来传入邻近的埃多人的宗教。

在墨西哥，雨神特拉洛克被奉为生命和养分的赐予者，人们在山顶设神庙，并在特拉洛克山上举行盛大的仪式，不过人们也畏惧他掌管的冰雹、雷和闪电。

en:
Winds were gods in many belief systems. The Aztecs worshipped Ehecatl, an aspect of Quetzalcoatl, and built his temple as a cylinder to lessen the resistance of the air.

In Maori myth Tawhirimatea, god of wind, storms and weather, took up arms when his brothers separated their parents, sky and earth, and destroyed the forests of Tane and drove Tangaroa, the sea god, into the ocean. The Yoruba orisha Oya ruled storms and strong winds.
zh:
风在许多信仰里都是神。阿兹特克人崇拜埃埃卡特尔，他是羽蛇神的一个侧面，人们把他的神庙建成圆柱形，以减少空气的阻力。

毛利神话里，风、暴风和天气之神塔维里马泰阿因兄弟们分开了天父和地母而大怒，毁掉了森林之神塔内的森林，把海神坦加罗阿赶进大海。约鲁巴人的奥里沙奥雅则掌管风暴和烈风。

en:
Xiuhtecuhtli, the Turquoise Lord or Lord of Fire, was the Aztec god of fire, heat and the year, whom they identified with the North Star. A sacred fire was always kept burning in his temples.

At each meal the Aztecs flung the first mouthful into the hearth in gratitude for fire. In the feast of Izcalli, boys hunted small water creatures in the swamps and offered them to the elders who guarded the fire god, receiving tamales in return.
zh:
修特库特利意为“绿松石之主”或“火之主”，是阿兹特克人的火、热与年岁之神，他们把他与北极星联系在一起。他的神庙里总有一团圣火长燃不熄。

每餐的第一口食物，阿兹特克人都要扔进炉灶，以感谢火的恩赐。在伊斯卡利节上，男孩们到沼泽里捕捉水中的小动物，献给看守火神的长者，换得玉米粉蒸肉。

en:
Yuma Sammang, 'Mother Earth' or 'Grandmother', also known as Ningwaphuma, is the great goddess of the Limbu, the Kirati people of eastern Nepal and Sikkim, who regard her as a maternal figure. In the Limbu view the supreme power Tagera Ningwaphuma takes female form on earth as Yuma Sammang and male form as Theba Sammang.

Traditionally the Limbu house itself represents her, and her shrine is its central pillar, where prayers and offerings are made twice a year.
zh:
玉玛桑芒意为“大地母亲”或“祖母”，又名宁瓦普马，是尼泊尔东部和锡金的基拉特人林布人的大女神，林布人把她看作母亲般的形象。在林布人看来，至高力量塔格拉·宁瓦普马在人间化为女性的玉玛桑芒和男性的特巴桑芒。

传统上，林布人的房屋本身就象征着她，她的神位是屋子中央的主柱，人们每年在这里祈祷、献供两次。

en: Zanahary is the Malagasy creator and sky god, and the national god of the Merina of the central highlands. The souls of the dead are held to return to him.
zh: 扎纳哈里是马达加斯加人的创世神和天神，也是中部高地梅里纳人的民族神，人们认为死者的灵魂回到他那里。

en:
The Alawite community traces its beginnings to Ibn Nusayr, a ninth-century follower of the tenth and eleventh imams. Al-Khasibi organized the community under the Hamdanids in northern Syria, and al-Tabarani moved to Latakia in 1032 and taught in the coastal region.

Alawite communities became established in the Syrian coastal mountains during Mamluk rule. In 1834–1835 Alawites rose against Egyptian rule in the region, but the revolt was suppressed.
zh:
阿拉维派社群追溯至9世纪的伊本·努赛尔，他是第十和第十一任伊玛目的追随者。哈西比在叙利亚北部的哈姆丹王朝统治时期组织了这一社群；塔巴拉尼于1032年前往拉塔基亚，在沿海地区传教。

马穆鲁克统治时期，阿拉维派社群在叙利亚沿海山区扎根。1834—1835年，阿拉维派信徒反抗埃及对当地的统治，但起义遭到镇压。

official_raw.en: The $alawi_school$, also called Nuṣairī, proclaim 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib, the first Imām according to [ShowReligionAdjective('shia')] beliefs, to be the manifestation of $muslim_god_name$ Himself. They differ substantially from the rest of the [ShowReligionAdjective('shia')] faith in both rituals and theology, believing in reincarnation and allowing the consumption of alcohol.
official_raw.zh: $alawi_school$又称努赛里派，宣称[ShowReligionAdjective('shia')]信仰中的第一位伊玛目阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜是$muslim_god_name$本身的显现。他们在仪式和神学上与[ShowReligionAdjective('shia')]信仰的其他部分有显著不同，相信轮回并允许饮酒。

en:
Alevism developed among Turkmen communities in Anatolia, where Sufi Islam and older customs met during the Seljuk expansion of the eleventh and twelfth centuries. From the late fifteenth century, many Qizilbash in Anatolia and Azerbaijan followed the Safavid leaders, wearing red headgear associated with the Twelve Imams.

In 1501 Qizilbash forces helped Ismail establish Safavid rule at Tabriz. Their association with the Safavids contributed to the persecution of Qizilbash communities under the Ottomans.
zh:
阿列维派在安纳托利亚的土库曼社群中形成；11至12世纪塞尔柱人扩张期间，苏菲派伊斯兰教与当地保留的古老习俗在这里相遇。15世纪末起，安纳托利亚和阿塞拜疆的许多奇兹尔巴什人追随萨法维领袖，佩戴与十二伊玛目相关的红色头饰。

1501年，奇兹尔巴什军队帮助伊斯玛仪在大不里士建立萨法维统治。他们与萨法维家族的联系促使奥斯曼政权迫害奇兹尔巴什社群。

official_raw.en: Following the teachings of Ḥājī Baktāš Walī, $alevism_school$ is a syncretic mystical school, emerging from the [ShowReligiousSchoolName('imamiya_school')] school but incorporating traditions from [ShowReligionName('tengri')] and older [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] beliefs. It also takes some aspects of Sufism, like the presence of a spiritual leader and mysticism practices.
official_raw.zh: $alevism_school$遵循哈吉·拜克塔什·瓦利的教义，是一种融合神秘学派，源自[ShowReligiousSchoolName('imamiya_school')]，但融入了[ShowReligionName('tengri')]信仰和古老的[ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')]信仰传统。它也吸收了苏菲派的一些方面，如精神领袖的存在和神秘主义实践。

en:
Ash'arī theology developed further through scholars such as al-Ghazali, who was appointed to the Nizamiyya of Baghdad in 1091. After a spiritual crisis he left Baghdad in 1095 and wrote works including The Revival of the Religious Sciences.

The fourteenth-century scholar Ibn Khaldun was also associated with Ash'arism. His Muqaddimah influenced Ottoman historians including Katip Çelebi in the seventeenth century, as they considered the rise and decline of states.
zh:
艾什尔里派神学经过安萨里等学者进一步发展；安萨里于1091年受任教于巴格达的尼扎米耶学院。经历精神危机后，他于1095年离开巴格达，著有《宗教科学复兴》等作品。

14世纪学者伊本·赫勒敦也与艾什尔里派有关。他的《历史绪论》影响了17世纪的卡蒂普·切莱比等奥斯曼史家，使他们借此思考国家的兴衰。

official_raw.en: The $ashari_school$ School of Theology is focused on the authority of the scriptures and rationalism, and was founded in the 9th century by Abū al-Ḥasan al-Ash'arī. His teachings of all universe being composed of atoms became the basis of the $ashari_school$ School proposition that all matter and time has been created by $muslim_god_name$, believing at the same time in free will and predestination.
official_raw.zh: $ashari_school$以经典权威和理性主义为核心，由艾布·哈桑·艾什尔里于9世纪创立。他关于宇宙由原子构成的教义成为$ashari_school$主张的基础，即所有物质和时间均由$muslim_god_name$创造，同时相信自由意志与宿命。

en:
Athari theology took shape among hadith scholars in the late eighth century, and Ahmad ibn Hanbal led the emerging traditionalist movement. The Hanbali scholar Ibn Taymiyya, born in Harran in 1263, became a prominent critic of speculative theology in Damascus.

In 1326 Ibn Taymiyya and his disciple Ibn al-Qayyim were imprisoned in the citadel of Damascus. Released after his teacher's death in 1328, Ibn al-Qayyim taught scholars of the Mamluk period until his own death in 1350.
zh:
圣训派神学于8世纪末在圣训学者中形成，艾哈迈德·本·罕百里领导了兴起的传统主义运动。1263年生于哈兰的罕百里派学者伊本·泰米叶后来在大马士革成为思辨神学的著名批评者。

1326年，伊本·泰米叶和弟子伊本·盖伊姆一同被囚禁在大马士革城堡。伊本·盖伊姆在老师于1328年去世后获释，此后教授马穆鲁克时代的学者，直至1350年去世。

official_raw.en: The $athari_school$ School of Theology rejects a rational interpretation of the scriptures in favor of a stricter reading of the texts of the $common_string_quran$ and Ḥadīth, considering them the sole authorities. Being against any form of religion innovation, refuses any kind of rationality that is not based upon the texts of the $common_string_quran$.
official_raw.zh: $athari_school$拒绝理性解释经典，主张严格阅读$common_string_quran$和圣训文本，视其为唯一权威。反对任何形式的宗教创新，拒绝任何不基于$common_string_quran$文本的理性。

en:
Balatkara Gana was established in northern India by the thirteenth century, as inscriptions at Un, Ahar and Hoshangabad attest. Its teacher Prabhachandra is remembered as the first bhattaraka of Delhi in the fourteenth century.

The Delhi lineage later produced branches elsewhere: Sakalakirti founded the Idar line in the fifteenth century, and Ratnakirti founded the Nagaur line after studying under Jinachandra.
zh:
勇护伽那至迟在13世纪已传入印度北部，乌恩、阿哈尔和霍尚加巴德的铭文留下了见证。其导师普拉巴旃陀罗被视为14世纪德里的首位跋吒罗迦。

德里传承后来在其他地方产生分支：萨迦罗吉尔蒂于15世纪开创伊达尔传承，拉特那吉尔蒂师从吉那旃陀罗后开创了瑙高尔传承。

official_raw.en: A section of [ShowReligiousSchoolName('mula_sangh_school')], the $balatkara_gana_school$ monastic order of [ShowReligionName('jain')] originated in the 8th century with the founder of the $STR_ADJ$ dynasty. As such, it is among the oldest in [ShowReligionNameWithNoTooltip('jain')].
official_raw.zh: 作为[ShowReligiousSchoolName('mula_sangh_school')]的分支，[ShowReligionName('jain')]$balatkara_gana_school$僧团创立于8世纪，由$STR_ADJ$王朝建立者奠基，属于[ShowReligionNameWithNoTooltip('jain')]最古老的传承之一。

en:
The Bektashi order spread through Anatolia and the Balkans, gaining influence among the Ottoman Janissaries in the fifteenth century. In the sixteenth century Balım Sultan systematized its rituals and teachings and came to be revered as its second elder.

After Mahmud II forcibly dissolved the Janissary corps in 1826, he banned the Bektashi order because of its ties to the soldiers. Lodges were destroyed or confiscated, and some dervishes were exiled or executed.
zh:
拜克塔什教团传播到安纳托利亚和巴尔干地区，15世纪在奥斯曼耶尼切里军团中获得影响。16世纪巴勒姆苏丹将教团的仪式和教义系统化，受到信徒尊崇，被称为第二导师。

1826年，马哈茂德二世强行解散耶尼切里军团后，因拜克塔什教团与军团关系密切而禁止该教团。教团的修院遭毁坏或没收，部分托钵僧被流放或处死。

official_raw.en: Named after Ḥājī Baktāš Walī, believed to be descendant of 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib, the $bektashi_school$ of Sufism nonetheless respects all companions of Muḥammad. Although originating from the [ShowReligionAdjective('sunni')] faith, it contains many beliefs and practices present also in other traditions, giving it many similarity to them.
official_raw.zh: 以哈吉·拜克塔什·瓦利命名，据说其是阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜的后裔。苏菲主义的$bektashi_school$同时尊重先知穆罕默德的所有圣门弟子。尽管起源于[ShowReligionAdjective('sunni')]传统，但其教义与实践融合了多种其他传统的信仰实践，形成了独特的综合体系。

en:
Mu'in al-Din Chishti brought the Chishti order to Ajmer in northern India, where he died in 1236. His tomb became a place of pilgrimage, while the teaching of Nizamuddin Auliya of Delhi helped the order spread across the subcontinent.

From the fourteenth century, rulers of the Delhi and Bengal sultanates patronized Chishti shrines. The Mughal emperor Akbar visited Mu'in al-Din's tomb after his victory at Chittorgarh in 1568.
zh:
穆因丁·契斯提将契斯提教团带到印度北部的阿杰梅尔，并于1236年在当地去世。他的陵墓成为朝圣地，而德里的尼扎姆丁·奥利亚的教导帮助教团传遍次大陆。

从14世纪起，德里苏丹国和孟加拉苏丹国的统治者资助契斯提教团的圣陵。莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴在1568年攻克吉托尔后，前往穆因丁的陵墓朝拜。

official_raw.en: Originating from [ShowLocationName('chishti_sarif')], the $chishti_school$ rejects wordly power and promotes tolerance and love. It also promotes music and poetry as a form to connect with the love of $muslim_god_name$.
official_raw.zh: $chishti_school$发源于[ShowLocationName('chishti_sarif')]，主张远离世俗权力，强调宽容与爱的核心价值。其灵修实践通过音乐与诗歌建立与$muslim_god_name$之爱的连接。

en:
The Mughal emperor Akbar promoted Dīn-i Ilāhī in 1582, after inviting scholars of different faiths to debate at his House of Worship in Fatehpur Sikri from 1575. The creed drew on Islam, Indian religions and other traditions, and attracted only a small circle at court.

Akbar's religious policy met opposition from Muslim scholars, including Ahmad Sirhindi. After Akbar's death in 1605, his successor Jahangir moved away from many of his religious policies.
zh:
莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴于1582年推行神圣信条，此前他从1575年起邀请不同信仰的学者在法泰赫布尔西格里的礼拜堂辩论。神圣信条吸收了伊斯兰教、印度诸宗教及其他传统的成分，追随者仅限于宫廷中的一小群人。

阿克巴的宗教政策遭到艾哈迈德·锡尔欣迪等穆斯林学者反对。1605年阿克巴去世后，继任者贾汉吉尔放弃了其父的许多宗教政策。

official_raw.en: Adopted from the Mongol code, $din_i_ilahi_school$ treats all religions as different sects, allowing the freedom of thought within the realm.
official_raw.zh: $din_i_ilahi_school$借鉴蒙古法典（扎撒），将所有宗教视为通向真理的不同教派。允许在领土范围内的自由思想。

en:
Abu Hanifa's pupils Abu Yusuf and Muhammad al-Shaybani transmitted the teachings that formed the early Ḥanafī school. Under the Abbasids, Abu Yusuf became chief judge during the reign of Harun al-Rashid, who ruled from 786 to 809.

The Ottoman Empire adopted Hanafi law as its official school. In seventeenth-century Mughal India, the compilation known as the Fatawa Alamgiri served as a legal reference under Emperor Aurangzeb and continued to be used in South Asia in the eighteenth century.
zh:
艾布·哈尼法的弟子艾布·优素福和穆罕默德·沙巴尼传授了构成早期哈乃斐学派的教义。在阿拔斯王朝时期，艾布·优素福于786—809年在位的哈里发哈伦·拉希德治下担任首席法官。

奥斯曼帝国将哈乃斐教法定为官方法学派。17世纪莫卧儿印度编纂的《阿拉姆吉尔教法汇编》在奥朗则布皇帝治下成为法律依据，18世纪仍在南亚使用。

official_raw.en: The $hanafi_school$ Madhhab is named after Abū Ḥanīfa Al-Nu'mān ibn Thābit. The school originated in Kufa and is prominent throughout the [ShowCultureName('farsi_culture')] and [ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')] world, including northern $india$. Though textual sources in the $common_string_quran$ and Ḥadīth are given preference, $hanafi_school$ followers have an inclusive view of sources and also employ analogy (Qiyās), juristic discretion (Istiḥsan), and local customs ('Urf) in their jurisprudence. Some view it as the most flexible of the schools.
official_raw.zh: $hanafi_school$以艾布·哈尼法·努尔曼·本·萨比特命名，起源于库法，在[ShowCultureName('farsi_culture')]和[ShowCultureGroupName('turkic_group')]世界（包括北$india$）占据重要地位。虽然$common_string_quran$和圣训的文本来源被优先考虑，但$hanafi_school$的追随者对来源持包容态度，并在教法学中运用类比（格亚斯）、司法裁量（伊斯提哈桑）和地方习俗（欧尔夫）。一些人认为它是各学派中最灵活的。

en:
The Ḥanbalī scholar Ibn Taymiyya, born in Harran in 1263, taught in Damascus and challenged practices associated with the veneration of saints. His disputes with scholars and rulers led to repeated imprisonment before his death in 1328.

In eighteenth-century Arabia, Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab drew on aspects of Ibn Taymiyya's teaching and joined with the house of Saud. The rise of his reform movement brought major changes to the Hanbali school.
zh:
罕百里学派学者伊本·泰米叶于1263年生于哈兰，后来在大马士革授课，并批评与圣徒崇敬有关的习俗。他与学者及统治者的争论使他屡次遭到监禁，直至1328年去世。

18世纪的阿拉伯，穆罕默德·伊本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜借鉴了伊本·泰米叶的部分教导，并与沙特家族结盟。他的改革运动兴起后，罕百里学派经历了重大变化。

official_raw.en: The $hanbali_school$ Madhhab is named after Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, and champions withholding from any speculative theology, Kalām. $hanbali_school$ followers maintain that the $common_string_quran$ and Sunnah are the only proper sources of jurisprudence and that they should be interpreted in a literal and traditionalist sense. Though it is accepted as a valid Madhhab, very few states actively promote the $hanbali_school$ school, and it was banned by the Abbasid Caliphs.
official_raw.zh: $hanbali_school$以艾哈迈德·本·罕百里命名，主张避免任何思辨神学（凯拉姆）。$hanbali_school$的追随者坚持认为$common_string_quran$和圣训是教法学的唯一正确来源，并应以字面意义和传统主义的方式解释。尽管它被认可为有效的教法学派，但很少有国家积极推广$hanbali_school$，甚至一度被阿拔斯王朝哈里发禁止。

en:
The Ibāḍī community developed in Basra, where Jābir ibn Zayd was an influential early scholar, before spreading to Oman and North Africa. In Oman, religious scholars traditionally selected an imam with both spiritual and temporal authority.

In 1624 Nāṣir ibn Murshid was elected imam and began uniting Oman's tribes against the Portuguese. His Yaʿrubid successors drove the Portuguese from Muscat and extended Omani power along the East African coast.
zh:
伊巴德派社群在巴士拉形成，贾比尔·本·宰德是当地有影响力的早期学者，教派后来传播到阿曼和北非。在阿曼，宗教学者依照传统推选兼掌宗教与世俗权力的伊玛目。

1624年，纳赛尔·本·穆尔希德当选伊玛目，开始团结阿曼部族对抗葡萄牙人。他的雅鲁巴王朝继任者将葡萄牙人逐出马斯喀特，并将阿曼势力扩展到东非海岸。

official_raw.en: Believed to be a descendant of the Al-Khawārij, who first were supporters of 'Alī ibn Abī Ṭālib but later rejected his arbitration. The $ibadi_school$ school distanced itself from the Al-Khawārij following 'Abd Allāh ibn Ibāḍ, taking a more moderate approach and a more positive view towards different $muslim_ADJ$ branches, having similarities with many of the other schools.
official_raw.zh: 该学派起源于哈瓦利吉派，其早期追随者虽支持阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜，但因其接受仲裁而与之决裂。在阿卜杜拉·本·伊巴德领导下，$ibadi_school$逐渐与哈瓦利吉派的激进立场划清界限，形成较为温和的教义体系。伊巴德派对$muslim_ADJ$各教派持包容态度，其法学理念与其他主流学派存在诸多共通之处。

en:
Before the Safavid conquest, Imāmīya communities were concentrated in Iranian towns and regions including Qom, Kashan and Sabzevar. In 1501 Shah Ismail I made Twelver Shiism the official religion of his new empire.

The Safavids promoted conversion across Iran and persecuted Sunni Muslims and other religious communities. Their policy helped establish Twelver Shiism as the dominant confession in Iran and intensified conflict with the Sunni Ottoman Empire.
zh:
萨非王朝征服之前，伊玛目派社群集中在库姆、卡尚和萨卜泽瓦尔等伊朗城镇及地区。1501年，沙阿伊斯玛仪一世将十二伊玛目派定为新帝国的官方宗教。

萨非王朝在伊朗各地推动改宗，迫害逊尼派穆斯林和其他宗教社群。这一政策促成十二伊玛目派在伊朗占据主导地位，也加剧了与逊尼派奥斯曼帝国的冲突。

official_raw.en: Also called 'Twelvers', $imamiya_school$ believes that 'Alī, the successor of Muḥammad, was followed by twelve infallible Imām chosen by divine decree. The last Imām, al-Mahdī, is expected to return as the savior of mankind, finally enforcing justice and peace in the world. They mainly follow [ShowReligiousSchoolName('jafari_school')] jurisprudence.
official_raw.zh: $imamiya_school$又称“十二伊玛目派”，认为穆罕默德的继任者阿里之后有十二位由神意选定的无过错的伊玛目。最后一位伊玛目马赫迪预计将作为人类的救世主回归，最终在世界上实现正义与和平。他们主要遵循[ShowReligiousSchoolName('jafari_school')]教法学。

en:
The Īsāwī order was founded in Meknes by Muhammad al-Hadi ben Issa, who lived from 1465 to 1526. His teachers included followers of the Shadhili and Jazuli traditions, the latter associated with the Moroccan mystic Muhammad al-Jazuli, author of a widely used prayer book.

Ben Issa built his own mausoleum in his Meknes lodge. Some followers attributed the development of the order's trance ceremony to a seventeenth-century disciple, while others placed it in the eighteenth century.
zh:
伊萨维教团由穆罕默德·哈迪·本·伊萨在梅克内斯创立，他生于1465年，卒于1526年。他的老师包括沙兹里和贾祖里传统的信徒；后者与摩洛哥神秘主义者穆罕默德·贾祖里有关，贾祖里著有广为流传的祈祷书。

本·伊萨在梅克内斯的修道所内建造了自己的陵墓。一些信徒认为教团的出神仪式由一名17世纪的弟子发展而成，另一些人则认为它出现于18世纪。

official_raw.en: Considered the most mystic of the religious schools, the $isawiyya_school$ has its roots from the lands of [ShowRegionName('maghreb_region')] whose heritage of psalms and prayers developed into rituals featuring dance and music.
official_raw.zh: $isawiyya_school$被视为最神秘的苏菲传统宗派之一，其根源可追溯至[ShowRegionName('maghreb_region')]地区。其灵修实践以诗篇与祈祷为核心，发展出独特的仪式体系。

en:
Ismā'īlī communities followed different lines of authority after earlier disputes over succession. By the fifteenth century Nizari imams had established a centre at Anjudan in Iran, where their community experienced a revival.

A later succession dispute among the Tayyibis produced the Sulaymani branch in 1592. Its Yemeni followers supported Sulayman ibn Hasan, while most Indian Tayyibis recognized Dawud ibn Qutb and became known as Dawoodi Bohras.
zh:
伊斯玛仪派社群在早期继承争议后遵循了不同的权威世系。到15世纪，尼扎里耶派伊玛目已在伊朗的安朱丹建立中心，社群在那里经历了复兴。

后来，塔伊比派内部的继承争议于1592年催生了苏莱曼尼支派。也门的追随者支持苏莱曼·本·哈桑，而印度的大多数塔伊比派信徒承认达伍德·本·库特布，后来被称为达伍德派博赫拉人。

official_raw.en: The $ismaili_school$ Madhhab is named after Ismā'īl ibn Ja'far, the successor of Ja'far al-Ṣādiq, and was the dominant school of faith in the Fatimid Caliphate but has lost much ground since its fall. The $ismaili_school$ school encompasses a number of increasingly divergent branches, and in many ways, they focus on the esoteric elements of [ShowReligionAdjective('shia')] faith more than the [ShowReligiousSchoolName('jafari_school')] or [ShowReligiousSchoolName('zaidi_school')].
official_raw.zh: $ismaili_school$以伊斯玛仪·本·贾法尔命名，他是贾法尔·萨迪克的继任者，曾是法蒂玛王朝的主要信仰派别，但自其衰落以来已失去许多影响力。$ismaili_school$包含许多日益分歧的分支，并在许多方面比[ShowReligiousSchoolName('jafari_school')]或[ShowReligiousSchoolName('zaidi_school')]更注重[ShowReligionAdjective('shia')]信仰的隐秘元素。

en:
Within Ja'farī jurisprudence, the Akhbari movement grew from the writings of Muhammad Amin al-Astarabadi, who died in 1627. Akhbaris challenged jurists' independent reasoning and emphasized the transmitted sayings of the Imams.

In the late eighteenth century, Muhammad Baqir Behbahani led a counterargument at Karbala and Najaf. His Usuli school, which upheld independent legal reasoning and the scrutiny of reports, gained predominance among Twelver scholars.
zh:
贾法里学派内部的阿赫巴尔派运动兴起于穆罕默德·阿明·阿斯塔拉巴迪的著作；他于1627年去世。阿赫巴尔派质疑法学家的独立推理，强调传述下来的伊玛目言行。

18世纪后期，穆罕默德·巴基尔·贝赫贝哈尼在卡尔巴拉和纳杰夫领导了反驳。他所属的乌苏勒派主张独立法律推理和审查传述，在十二伊玛目派学者中取得优势。

official_raw.en: The $jafari_school$ Madhhab is named after Ja'far al-Ṣādiq, the sixth Imām, and it focuses on independent reasoning by experts of Islamic Law, prefering that over analogy when establishing the Law. It also allows for a temporary marriage lasting a predeterminate period of time.
official_raw.zh: $jafari_school$以第六任伊玛目贾法尔·萨迪克命名，重视伊斯兰教法专家的独立推理，并优先于类比，还允许一种持续预定时间的临时婚姻。

en:
Kashtha Sangha was associated with several lineages, including the Mathura Sangha, supported by Agrawal Jains. Devasena's Darshanasara attributed its foundation to Kumarasena in Vikram Samvat 753, while other traditions named Lohacharya.

At Gwalior, inscriptions dated 1441 to 1474 record the consecration of rock-cut Jain images by Kashtha Sangha bhattarakas. The poet Raidhu, a lay disciple in that lineage, supervised many such ceremonies under the Tomara rulers.
zh:
木钵僧团包括多个传承，其中马图拉僧团得到阿格拉瓦尔耆那教徒支持。提婆犀那的《见解精要》认为鸠摩罗犀那于维克拉姆历753年创立了木钵僧团，另一些传统则将创立归于洛哈查里亚。

在瓜廖尔，1441—1474年的铭文记载了木钵僧团跋吒罗迦为耆那教摩崖造像举行开光仪式。该传承的在家弟子、诗人赖杜在托马拉王朝统治下主持了许多此类仪式。

official_raw.en: A prominent [ShowReligionAdjective('jain')] Digambara monastic school across Northern and Western $india$, originated with Lohacharya, that is, Sudharmāsvāmī. He was the fifth disciple of Mahāvīra, the 24th (and last) of the Tīrthaṅkara.
official_raw.zh: 一个著名的[ShowReligionAdjective('jain')]天衣派僧团，活跃于北$india$与西印度，由洛哈查里亚（即苏达摩斯瓦米）创立。苏达摩斯瓦米是大雄——第二十四代（即最后一代）渡津者——的第五弟子。

en:
Yahya Shirvani helped spread the Khalwati order from Baku and composed a devotional text used by many of its branches. Under the Ottoman sultan Bayezid II, who came to the throne in 1481, the order gained adherents among officials and soldiers.

Chelebi Khalifa moved its center from Amasya to Istanbul, where a former church became a lodge. In the seventeenth century the Khalwati poet Niyazi al-Misri spoke against the government and addressed a wider public.
zh:
叶海亚·希尔瓦尼帮助哈尔瓦提教团从巴库向外传播，并撰写了一部为教团许多分支使用的祈祷文。奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德二世于1481年即位，在他统治时期，教团吸引了官员和军人加入。

切莱比·哈里发把教团中心从阿马西亚迁往伊斯坦布尔，在一座旧教堂内建立修院。17世纪，哈尔瓦提派诗人尼亚齐·米斯里公开反对政府，并向更广泛的民众传教。

official_raw.en: The $khalwati_school$ takes its name from the act of retreating oneself for spiritual exercises in solitary. Thus, it emphasizes the individual ritual and spiritual practices, as well as retreat and asceticism.
official_raw.zh: $khalwati_school$得名于独处隐修（哈尔瓦）的实践，强调个人个人仪式与灵修的重要性，包括了退隐与苦行。

en:
Kharatara Gaccha traces its founding to Vardhamana Suri. His pupil Jineshvara earned the title Kharatara after defeating a rival in debate at Anahilvada Patan in 1024, giving the order its name.

In the sixteenth century Jinachandra Suri II met the Mughal emperor Akbar at Lahore through the intercession of the Jain official Karam Chand Bachhawat. In 1595 he travelled to Multan and Uch before returning to Rajasthan.
zh:
严律伽差追溯至创立者瓦尔达马纳·苏里。他的弟子吉内什瓦拉于1024年在阿纳希尔瓦达帕坦的辩论中击败对手，获得“严律”的称号，僧团也由此得名。

16世纪，吉纳旃陀罗·苏里二世经耆那教官员卡拉姆·旃德·巴恰瓦特引荐，在拉合尔会见莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴。1595年，他前往木尔坦和乌奇，随后返回拉贾斯坦。

official_raw.en: Also called #italic Vidhisangha#! or #italic Vidhimarga#!, meaning 'the Assembly' and 'Path of Proper Conduct' respectively, it is a Śvetāmbara monastic order that sees its own practices as the only spiritual correct ones. It encourages strict adherence to purity and religious doctrine and scriptures without deviation.
official_raw.zh: 这是白衣派的一个僧团组织，亦称#italic “正法之会”#!或#italic 正行之道#!。它视自身实践为唯一灵性正道，鼓励严格恪守纯洁性、宗教教义与经典，不容丝毫偏离。

en:
Mālikī law gained state support in al-Andalus under the Umayyads and remained dominant there under the Almoravids. The Almohads that followed favoured the Zahiri school, and the Christian reconquest eventually ended Muslim rule in Iberia.

In the fourteenth century, the Egyptian jurist Khalil ibn Ishaq taught in Medina and Cairo and wrote a concise manual of Maliki law. His Mukhtasar became an authoritative reference for jurists in North and West Africa.
zh:
马立克学派教法在安达卢斯的倭马亚王朝治下得到国家支持，在穆拉比特王朝统治时期仍居主导地位。其后的穆瓦希德王朝偏重扎希里学派，基督教徒的再征服最终结束了穆斯林在伊比利亚的统治。

14世纪，埃及法学家哈利勒·本·伊斯哈格在麦地那和开罗授课，并写下一部马立克教法简编。他的《简编》成为北非和西非法学家的权威参考书。

official_raw.en: The $maliki_school$ Madhhab is named after Mālik ibn Anas and is prominent in particular throughout [ShowSubContinentName('north_africa')] and [ShowRegionName('iberia_region')]. Jurisprudence is primarily based on the work and interpretations of ibn Anas and his student Saḥnūn as described in the al-Muwaṭṭa' and the Mudawwanah. One of the foremost centers of learning within the $maliki_school$ School is the Great Mosque of Āl Qayrawān, near [ShowLocationName('tunis')].
official_raw.zh: $maliki_school$以马立克·本·艾奈斯命名，在[ShowSubContinentName('north_africa')]和[ShowRegionName('iberia_region')]尤为盛行。该学派的教法学主要基于本·艾奈斯及其学生塞赫农的著作和解释，如《穆宛塔》和《穆达瓦纳》所述。$maliki_school$的重要学习中心之一是靠近[ShowLocationName('tunis')]的凯鲁万大清真寺。

en:
Māturīdī teaching spread from Transoxiana with Hanafi scholars who moved west from the late eleventh to the fourteenth century. Their teaching reached western Persia, Iraq, Anatolia, Syria and Egypt as Turkic powers expanded.

Maturidi theology held a prominent place under the Timurids and Ottomans. In Persia, where it had been influential among Sunnis, the Safavid dynasty made Twelver Shiism the state religion and pursued conversions from the sixteenth century.
zh:
马图里迪学派的教义随河中地区的哈乃斐学者传播，这些学者从11世纪末至14世纪陆续西迁。随着突厥政权扩张，他们将教义带到波斯西部、伊拉克、安纳托利亚、叙利亚和埃及。

马图里迪神学在帖木儿帝国和奥斯曼帝国占有重要地位。在该学派曾对逊尼派有影响的波斯，萨法维王朝从16世纪起将十二伊玛目派什叶教定为国教并推行改宗。

official_raw.en: The $maturidi_school$ School of Theology, taking the name from 'Abū Manṣūr al-Māturīdī, is a [ShowReligionAdjective('sunni')] school of theology emerging from the theological beliefs of the $hanafi_school$ School of Jurisprudence. It promotes the rational interpretation of the scriptures, and the importance of faith over one person's deeds.
official_raw.zh: $maturidi_school$神学学派以艾布·曼苏尔·马图里迪命名，是源自$hanafi_school$教法学派的一支[ShowReligionAdjective('sunni')]神学学派，提倡对经典的理性解释，并强调信仰优于个人行为。

en:
After Rumi's death in 1273, his son Sultan Walad and Husameddin Chelebi established the Mevlevi order and built his mausoleum at Konya. Sultan Walad, who died in 1312, made the shrine a center for the order.

Ottoman patronage helped the Mevlevis spread beyond Anatolia into the Balkans and Arab lands. In 1590 Sultan Murad III commissioned a Turkish translation of a fourteenth-century biography of Rumi, preserving his story for Ottoman readers.
zh:
鲁米于1273年去世后，他的儿子苏丹·瓦拉德和胡萨姆丁·切莱比建立了毛拉维教团，并在科尼亚为他修建陵墓。1312年去世的苏丹·瓦拉德使这座陵墓成为教团的中心。

奥斯曼统治者的资助帮助毛拉维教团从安纳托利亚传播到巴尔干和阿拉伯地区。1590年，苏丹穆拉德三世下令将一部14世纪的鲁米传记译成土耳其语，使奥斯曼读者得以阅读他的生平。

official_raw.en: Known for its whirling dervishes, the $mevlevi_school$ is formed upon the teachings of Jalāl al-Dīn Muḥammad Rūmī. It proclaims love as central to [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')], and it also emphasizes Sema, the movement meditation ceremony performed by way of whirling.
official_raw.zh: $mevlevi_school$以旋转舞闻名，其教义基于贾拉勒丁·穆罕默德·鲁米的教导。其核心教义强调爱为[ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')]的本质，并通过旋转仪式（萨玛）实现与安拉的合一。

en:
Mīmāṃsā drew on Jaimini's Mīmāṃsā Sūtra, dated to roughly the third or second century BCE, to interpret Vedic ritual obligations. Kumārila Bhaṭṭa and Prabhākara developed influential branches around the seventh century.

In the sixteenth century Appayya Dīkṣita argued that the Mīmāṃsā and Vedānta sūtras could not form a single unified work. In the seventeenth century Āpadeva wrote an introductory treatise on Mīmāṃsā.
zh:
弥曼差派依据阇弥尼的《弥曼差经》解释吠陀仪式的义务；这部经书约成于公元前3世纪或前2世纪。鸠摩罗罗·跋陀和普拉巴迦罗在约7世纪发展出有影响力的分支。

16世纪，阿帕耶·迪克希塔认为弥曼差与吠檀多的经书不能构成一部统一的著作。17世纪，阿帕提婆写了一部弥曼差入门论著。

official_raw.en: The $mimamsa_school$ focuses on the methodology of interpretation and critical explanation of texts. As such, it has a greater focus on philology, the philosophy of languages, and linguistic analysis.
official_raw.zh: $mimamsa_school$专注于文本解释与批判性分析的方法论。因此，它更注重文献学、语言哲学与语言分析。

en:
Mula Sangh developed lineages including the Deshiya Gana, associated with Shravanabelagola, and the Balatkara Gana, associated with Humbaj and northern India. Their institutional heads, called bhattarakas, maintained libraries and supervised religious installations.

One account attributes the establishment of the Delhi bhattaraka seat to Prabhachandra of Mula Sangh, who travelled from Gujarat during the reign of Muhammad bin Tughlaq in the fourteenth century.
zh:
根本僧团发展出多个传承，包括与舍拉瓦那贝尔戈拉有关的地方伽那，以及与洪巴杰和印度北部有关的勇护伽那。这些传承的教团首领称为跋吒罗迦，负责维护藏书并主持宗教安置仪式。

一种说法认为，德里跋吒罗迦席位由根本僧团的普拉巴旃陀罗建立，他在14世纪穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克统治时期从古吉拉特来到德里。

official_raw.en: Meaning 'root', it refers to the original practices of [ShowReligionName('jain')] coming from Kundakunda, a [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')] monk from the second century who authored many texts on [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')] philosophy, and the most important teacher for Digambara [ShowReligionNameWithNoTooltip('jain')].
official_raw.zh: 意为“根源”，指源自昆达昆达（公元2世纪[ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')]僧侣，著有多部[ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('jain')]哲学文献）的原始[ShowReligionName('jain')]实践，亦是[ShowReligionNameWithNoTooltip('jain')]天衣派最重要的导师传承。

en:
Among the Musta'lī, the Tayyibis recognized the infant al-Tayyib as imam after the death of al-Amir in 1130. Queen Arwa of Yemen established the office of da'i al-mutlaq to direct the community on his behalf.

Persecution by a local Zaydi ruler led the Tayyibi mission to move its headquarters from Yemen to India in 1567. In 1592 a dispute over its leadership divided the followers of Dawud ibn Qutb from those of Sulayman ibn Hasan.
zh:
穆斯塔利耶派中的塔伊比派在阿米尔于1130年去世后，承认年幼的塔伊比为伊玛目。也门女王阿尔瓦设立了全权达伊一职，代表他领导社群。

由于当地栽德派统治者的迫害，塔伊比派传教组织于1567年将总部从也门迁往印度。1592年，领袖继承争议使达伍德·本·库特布和苏莱曼·本·哈桑的追随者分裂。

official_raw.en: The $mustali_school$ stand in opposition to the [ShowReligiousSchoolName('nizari_school')] in that they accept the ascension of Al-Musta'lī bi'llāh to the throne of the Fatimid Caliphate. Although originating in [ShowRegionName('egypt_region')], they later spread to Western $india$ through missionary work.
official_raw.zh: $mustali_school$与[ShowReligiousSchoolName('nizari_school')]对立，接受穆斯塔利·比拉登上法蒂玛王朝王位。尽管起源于[ShowRegionName('egypt_region')]，但后来通过传教活动传播到西$india$。

en:
Mu'tazili theology arose in eighth-century Basra, where Wasil ibn Ata was remembered for leaving the circle of Hasan al-Basri after a dispute. The Abbasid caliph al-Ma'mun instituted an inquisition in 833 to enforce the doctrine of the created Quran; al-Mutawakkil ended it in 851.

Mu'tazili writings and teachings survived among Zaydi scholars in Yemen. There al-Shawkani, appointed chief judge in 1795, challenged Zaydi theological doctrines and advocated a return to scriptural sources.
zh:
穆尔太齐赖派神学兴起于8世纪的巴士拉，瓦绥勒·本·阿塔因一场争论离开哈桑·巴士里的学术圈而为人所知。阿拔斯王朝哈里发马蒙于833年设立宗教裁判，强制推行《古兰经》受造的教义；穆塔瓦基勒于851年终止了这一裁判。

穆尔太齐赖派的著作和教导在也门的宰德派学者中留存下来。1795年出任也门首席法官的肖卡尼质疑宰德派的神学教义，主张回归经典依据。

official_raw.en: The $mutazili_school$ School of Theology developed influenced by Greek and Indian philosophy and rationalism. It rejects the notion that the $common_string_quran$ and $muslim_god_name$ are coexistent, expressing that the scripture must logically come after the originator. It defends reason as long as it serves people to understand religious matters, and it supports that evil originates from errors of humanity due to their free will.
official_raw.zh: $mutazili_school$受希腊和印度哲学及理性主义影响，拒绝$common_string_quran$与$muslim_god_name$共存的观念，主张经典逻辑上应晚于造物主。它捍卫理性，只要其有助于理解宗教事务，并支持邪恶源于人类因自由意志所犯的错误。

en:
The Naqshbandi order took its name from Baha al-Din Naqshband, who was born near Bukhara in 1318. At the end of the sixteenth century Baqi Billah brought the order to India, where his disciple Ahmad Sirhindi founded the Mujaddidi branch.

Sirhindi's letters reached Mughal nobles and argued for stricter religious observance. In the early nineteenth century Khalid of Shahrazur established another influential branch in the Ottoman lands, with followers in Iraq and Syria.
zh:
纳格什班迪耶教团得名于巴哈丁·纳格什班德，他于1318年出生在布哈拉附近。16世纪末，巴基·比拉将教团带到印度；他的门徒艾哈迈德·西尔欣迪在那里创立了穆贾迪迪支派。

西尔欣迪致信莫卧儿贵族，主张更严格地遵守宗教规范。19世纪初，沙赫拉祖尔的哈立德在奥斯曼领土上创立了另一个颇有影响的支派，其追随者遍及伊拉克和叙利亚。

official_raw.en: Tracing its origin to Ja'far ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq, the $naqshbandi_school$ places more importance to the $sharia$ than other related schools. Its practices are organized around the silent invocation and conciousness.
official_raw.zh: $naqshbandi_school$可追溯至贾法尔·本·穆罕默德·萨迪克，比其他学派更强调伊斯兰教法（$sharia$）的价值。其核心实践包括默念与意识。

en:
Nizārī power in Iran centred on Alamut, a fortress taken by Hasan-i Sabbah in 1090. In 1256 the imam Rukn al-Din Khurshah surrendered it to the Mongols, who dismantled the stronghold and destroyed its library.

Nizari forces briefly recovered Alamut in 1275, though they held it for only a few years. By the fifteenth century the imams had moved to Anjudan in central Iran, where the community underwent a revival under leaders including Mustansir Billah II.
zh:
尼扎里耶派在伊朗的势力以阿剌模忒堡为中心，哈桑·萨巴赫于1090年取得这座要塞。1256年，伊玛目鲁克恩丁·胡尔沙向蒙古人交出要塞；蒙古人拆毁城堡，摧毁了馆藏。

尼扎里耶派军队于1275年短暂收复阿剌模忒堡，但只据守了几年。到15世纪，伊玛目已迁至伊朗中部的安朱丹，社群在穆斯坦绥尔·比拉二世等领袖治下经历复兴。

official_raw.en: The $nizari_school$ claim that Nizār ibn al-Mustanṣir was the true successor to the Fatimid Caliphate after his father death, and oppose al-Afḍal Shāhanshāh's coup to install Al-Musta'lī bi'llāh on the throne. Having originally split from the [ShowReligiousSchoolName('ismaili_school')], they have gained adherents from many other branches, and they follow [ShowReligiousSchoolName('jafari_school')] jurisprudence, focusing on pluralism and acceptance of differences.
official_raw.zh: $nizari_school$声称尼扎尔·本·穆斯坦绥尔是其父亲去世后法蒂玛王朝的真正继任者，并反对阿夫达尔·沙汗沙拥立穆斯塔利·比拉的政变。他们从[ShowReligiousSchoolName('ismaili_school')]分裂而出，从许多其他分支中获得了追随者，并遵循[ShowReligiousSchoolName('jafari_school')]教法学，注重多元化和接受差异。

en:
Nyāya took the Nyāya Sūtras, attributed to Akṣapāda Gautama, as a foundational text. In the thirteenth century Gaṅgeśa of Mithila founded the new Nyāya tradition and examined the school's methods in his Tattvacintāmaṇi.

Raghunātha Śiromaṇi of Nabadwip in Bengal carried the new tradition forward. Its precise language for analysing knowledge and reasoning remained in use among Indian philosophers through the eighteenth century.
zh:
正理派以传为足目乔答摩所作的《正理经》为基础典籍。13世纪，密提罗的甘盖沙创立新正理传统，在《真实思惟摩尼》中检视本派的方法。

孟加拉纳瓦德维普的拉古纳塔·希罗摩尼进一步发展了新正理传统。印度哲学家直到18世纪仍使用这一传统为分析知识与推理而发展的精密语言。

official_raw.en: $nyaya_school$ is a realist school, focusing on methodology and logic as the means of gaining knowledge. It states that our suffering is caused by mistakes due to incorrect knowledge and that liberation will be gained with the correct knowledge.
official_raw.zh: $nyaya_school$是一个现实主义学派，专注于方法论与逻辑作为获取知识的手段。它指出，我们的痛苦源于错误知识导致的误解，而正确的知识将带来解脱。

en:
The Qadiri order grew around Abdul Qadir Gilani's school in Baghdad, which his son Abdul Razzaq led after his death in 1166. By the end of the fifteenth century its branches had reached places as distant as Morocco, India and present-day Mali.

In 1535 the Ottoman sultan Suleiman commissioned a new shrine over Gilani's grave in Baghdad. In the eighteenth century al-Mukhtar al-Kunti helped spread the order through the middle Niger region and further west.
zh:
卡迪里教团在阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔·吉拉尼的巴格达学校周围发展起来；吉拉尼于1166年去世后，儿子阿卜杜勒·拉扎克继任学校领袖。到15世纪末，教团的分支已传播至摩洛哥、印度和今马里等地。

1535年，奥斯曼苏丹苏莱曼下令在巴格达的吉拉尼墓上新建圣陵。18世纪，穆赫塔尔·昆提帮助教团传播到尼日尔河中游和更西方的地区。

official_raw.en: Founded by 'Abdulqādir Gīlānī, the $qadiri_school$ promote a strict following of [ShowReligionAdjective('sunni')] law. It also has decentralized leadership, allowing each of its centers freedom of interpretation and practice, which has caused it to differenciate in multiple branches.
official_raw.zh: $qadiri_school$由阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔·吉拉尼创立，强调严格遵守[ShowReligionAdjective('sunni')]教法。其组织架构采取分散式领导，允许各地中心根据本地传统灵活实践，这一特性促使其发展出多个分支。

en:
The Safavid order passed through the family of Safi al-Din after his death in 1334. Under Junayd and Haydar in the fifteenth century, it became a militant movement supported by Qizilbash followers, while its leaders claimed spiritual and political authority.

In 1501 Haydar's son Ismail captured Tabriz and became shah, establishing the Safavid dynasty. He proclaimed Twelver Shiism the state religion and brought scholars from Syria and Lebanon to help establish it.
zh:
萨菲丁于1334年去世后，萨法维教团的领袖职位在其家族中传承。15世纪，在朱奈德和海达尔领导下，教团成为得到奇兹尔巴什信徒支持的军事运动，其领袖同时主张拥有宗教与政治权威。

1501年，海达尔之子伊斯玛仪攻占大不里士并称沙阿，建立萨法维王朝。他宣布十二伊玛目派什叶派为国教，并请来叙利亚和黎巴嫩的学者协助确立这一信仰。

official_raw.en: Founded by Ṣāfī ad-Dīn Isḥāq Ardabīlī upon the [ShowReligiousSchoolName('shafii_school')] teachings, the $safavid_school$ has later gotten close to the [ShowReligiousSchoolName('imamiya_school')] thought. Its zeal and strength of belief make its followers be certain of their place in the universe.
official_raw.zh: $safavid_school$由萨菲丁·伊斯哈格·阿尔达比勒基于[ShowReligiousSchoolName('shafii_school')]教义创立，后逐渐转向[ShowReligiousSchoolName('imamiya_school')]思想。其核心教义强调灵性热忱与信仰坚定，引导信徒在宇宙秩序中定位自我。

en: The Sāṃkhya system took a definitive form in the Sāṃkhyakārikā of the fourth century. Its account enumerated 25 principles and held that liberation came from distinguishing consciousness from nature. Vijñānabhikṣu, a philosopher from Bihar dated to the fifteenth or sixteenth century, wrote commentaries on Sāṃkhya and argued for a unity between it, Yoga and Vedānta.
zh: 数论派在4世纪的《数论颂》中形成了确定的体系。它列举了25种原理，认为辨别精神与自然便能获得解脱。来自比哈尔的哲学家毗若那比乞刍生活于15或16世纪，他为数论派著作作注，并主张数论、瑜伽与吠檀多三派存在统一性。

official_raw.en: Very influential for the other schools of [ShowCultureGroupName('indian_group')] philosophy, $samkhya_school$ is a dualistic school based on rationality. It proposes that the world is composed of both matter and spirit, and that knowledge can only be gained through perception and rational inference.
official_raw.zh: $samkhya_school$是基于理性的二元论学派,对其他[ShowCultureGroupName('indian_group')]哲学学派影响深远。它认为世界由物质与精神构成，而知识只能通过感知和理性推理获得。

en:
The Shadhili order gained a lasting literary tradition in Egypt and the Maghreb. Ibn Ata Allah, its third spiritual master, taught in Cairo and systematized its doctrines; his aphorisms, the Book of Wisdom, are his best-known work. He died in 1309.

In fifteenth-century Morocco, Muhammad al-Jazuli compiled the prayer book Dala'il al-Khayrat and gathered followers at Safi. In the late eighteenth century Muhammad al-Arabi al-Darqawi founded the Moroccan Darqawi branch.
zh:
沙兹里教团在埃及和马格里布形成了持久的著述传统。教团第三任精神导师伊本·阿塔·安拉在开罗授课并将教义系统化；他的箴言集《智慧书》最为知名。他于1309年去世。

15世纪，摩洛哥的穆罕默德·贾祖利编纂了祈祷书《善行指南》，并在萨菲聚集了追随者。18世纪末，穆罕默德·阿拉比·达尔卡维在摩洛哥创立了达尔卡维支派。

official_raw.en: Following the teachings of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Shāḏilī, the $shadhili_school$ promotes a life of contemplation and to be constantly mindful of $muslim_god_name$, even during normal everyday activities. Applying the teachings of [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')] to the follower's own lives is the key to transform their existance.
official_raw.zh: $shadhili_school$遵循阿布·哈桑·沙兹里的教义，主张通过日常沉思与时刻铭记$muslim_god_name$实现灵性提升。其核心实践强调将[ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')]教义融入日常生活，以此实现存在转变。

en:
The Shāfi'ī school became the official legal school of Egypt under the Ayyubids and remained influential under the Mamluks. In Damascus, the Shafi'i jurist al-Nawawi headed the Ashrafiyya hadith school from 1267 until his death in 1277.

Merchants carried Shafi'i jurisprudence across the Indian Ocean to India and Southeast Asia. In the sixteenth century, Ottoman expansion brought Hanafi judges in place of Shafi'i judges in territories under Ottoman rule.
zh:
沙斐仪学派在阿尤布王朝治下成为埃及的官方法学派，在马穆鲁克时期仍有影响。沙斐仪法学家纳瓦维从1267年起主持大马士革的阿什拉菲耶圣训学校，直到1277年去世。

商人将沙斐仪教法传过印度洋，带到印度和东南亚。16世纪奥斯曼帝国扩张后，其统治地区的沙斐仪法官被哈乃斐法官取代。

official_raw.en: The $shafii_school$ Madhhab is named after Imām Al-Shāfi'ī, and it is prominent in particular among [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] believers in [ShowRegionName('arabia_region')], [ShowSubContinentName('east_africa')], and East [ShowContinentName('asia')]. Unlike other Madhhab, the $shafii_school$ reject Istiḥsan and Istislah as sources of $sharia$, instead only relying on what is textually in the $common_string_quran$ or Ḥadīth.
official_raw.zh: $shafii_school$以伊玛目沙斐仪命名，在[ShowRegionName('arabia_region')]、[ShowSubContinentName('east_africa')]和东[ShowContinentName('asia')]的[ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')]信徒中尤为突出。与其他教法学派不同，$shafii_school$拒绝将司法裁量（伊斯提哈桑）和公共利益（伊斯提斯拉赫）作为$sharia$教法来源，仅依赖$common_string_quran$或圣训中的文本内容。

en:
The Suhrawardī order became prominent in western Iran under the Ilkhanate of 1256–1335, with lodges that carried its influence through Persianate society. Disciples of Umar Suhrawardi established branches in Delhi, Bengal and Multan.

Bahauddin Zakariya settled in Multan in 1222 and supported the Delhi sultan Iltutmish against its ruler in 1228. His descendants led the Multan branch, while other followers carried the order to Gujarat and Delhi.
zh:
苏哈拉瓦迪耶教团在1256—1335年的伊儿汗国统治下兴盛于伊朗西部，其苏菲修道所将影响传播到波斯文化圈。欧麦尔·苏哈拉瓦迪的弟子在德里、孟加拉和木尔坦建立了支派。

巴哈丁·扎卡里亚于1222年定居木尔坦，并在1228年支持德里苏丹伊勒图特米什对抗当地统治者。他的后裔领导木尔坦支派，其他信徒则将教团传至古吉拉特和德里。

official_raw.en: The $suhrawardi_school$ follows the teachings of Abū al-Najīb Abd al-Qādir Suhrawardī, but it is also influenced by the philosophy of Junayd of [ShowLocationName('baghdad')]. It states that people should devote themselves to true knownledge and being faithful to $muslim_god_name$, renouncing natural desires in favor of the spiritual needs.
official_raw.zh: $suhrawardi_school$遵循艾布·纳吉布·苏哈拉瓦迪的教义，并深受[ShowLocationName('baghdad')]的朱奈德哲学影响。其核心教义强调追求真知与对$muslim_god_name$的忠诚，主张通过克制自然欲望满足灵性需求。

en:
Tapa Gaccha took its name from a title granted to Jagatchandra Suri by Jaitrasimha, ruler of Mewar, at Aghatpur. The order dates its foundation to 1228.

In 1556 Hiravijaya became head of its Gujarat congregation. Emperor Akbar invited him to explain Jain teachings in 1582, and later issued decrees restricting animal slaughter during Jain festivals. Hiravijaya left his disciple Shantichandra at the imperial court.
zh:
苦行伽差的名称来自梅瓦尔统治者贾伊特拉辛哈在阿加特普尔授予贾·格特旃陀罗·苏里的称号。僧团以1228年为创立之年。

1556年，希拉维贾亚成为僧团古吉拉特教众的领袖。1582年，皇帝阿克巴邀请他讲解耆那教教义，后来颁令限制在耆那教节日期间宰杀动物。希拉维贾亚将弟子尚蒂旃陀罗留在了皇廷。

official_raw.en: Founded by Acharya Jagatchandra Suri, called 'The Meditative One', it is a Śvetāmbara monastic order that encourages veneration of religious figures and pilgrimage to holy temples.
official_raw.zh: 由阿阇梨贾·格特旃陀罗·苏里（被称为“禅修者”）创立，此白衣派僧团鼓励对宗教人物的尊崇与圣殿朝圣。

en: Upkeśa Gaccha traced its name to Upkeśapattan, where tradition credits the monk Ratnaprabhasuri with opposing animal sacrifice. In 1336 its monk Kakkasuri wrote the Nabhi-nandana-jinoddhara-prabandha, an account of the renovation of a temple of Rishabhanatha. The work belongs to a medieval Sanskrit genre cultivated by Jain scholars in western India.
zh: 顶髻伽差的名称追溯至乌帕凯沙帕坦；传说僧人拉特纳普拉巴苏里曾在那里反对动物祭祀。1336年，僧团的卡卡苏里写成《纳比之子圣像修复记》，记述一座梨沙婆那他寺庙的修复。这部作品属于印度西部耆那教学者所创作的中世纪梵文传记文学。

official_raw.en: The oldest monastic order of Śvetāmbara [ShowReligionName('jain')], it follows the lineage of Pārasanātha, the 23rd Tīrthaṅkara, unlike most other schools that follow the lineage of Mahāvīra.
official_raw.zh: 白衣派[ShowReligionName('jain')]最古老的僧团，遵循第二十三代渡津者波栗湿缚（胁尊者）的法脉，与大多数追随大雄法脉的派别不同。

en: Vaiśeṣika traced its systematic exposition to the Vaiśeṣika Sūtra of Kaṇāda, who is placed between the sixth and second centuries BCE. Although it developed independently, its methods and conclusions later drew close to those of Nyāya. In the second half of the seventeenth century Annambhaṭṭa wrote the Tarka-saṅgraha and his own commentary, presenting the combined Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika system to beginners.
zh: 胜论派的系统论述可追溯到迦那陀的《胜论经》；迦那陀生活的年代约在公元前6世纪至前2世纪之间。胜论派虽独立发展，后来在方法和结论上逐渐接近正理派。17世纪下半叶，安南巴塔写成《论理汇编》及其注释，向初学者介绍合流后的正理与胜论体系。

official_raw.en: $vaisheshika_school$ is a naturalist, atomistic school, claiming that all physical universe is formed by atoms and that all our experiences come from the aggregations and interactions of such atoms. A complete understanding of the world of experience is thus what brings us to knowledge.
official_raw.zh: $vaisheshika_school$是一个自然主义、原子论的学派，主张所有物质宇宙由原子构成，而我们的所有经验都源于这些原子的聚合与相互作用。因此，对经验世界的完全理解将带来知识。

en:
Vedānta traditions offered different readings of the Upanishads, the Brahma Sūtras and the Bhagavad Gītā. Vallabha, who lived from 1479 to 1531, founded the pure non-dualist tradition, while Chaitanya, who lived from 1486 to 1534, inspired a tradition of inconceivable difference and non-difference.
